tcz: Pathen in Semtilin van le leiset asem tai.
en: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
text:
GEN 1:1
Thadou: Pathen in Semtilin van le leiset asem tai.
English: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

tcz: Leiset chu agong bei le ahomkeu ahin, muthim chun twipi thuhtah chu akhukhum ahin, Hiche twipi chung'a chu Pathen lhagao chu ana lhale ahi.
en: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.
text:
GEN 1:2
Thadou: Leiset chu agong bei le ahomkeu ahin, muthim chun twipi thuhtah chu akhukhum ahin, Hiche twipi chung'a chu Pathen lhagao chu ana lhale ahi.
English: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

tcz: Pathen in; “Vah hung umhen,” atin, Vah chu aum tai.
en: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
text:
GEN 1:3
Thadou: Pathen in; “Vah hung umhen,” atin, Vah chu aum tai.
English: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

tcz: Pathen in vah chu aven pha asah e. Chule Pathen in vah chu muthim akon in asep khen tai.
en: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.
text:
GEN 1:4
Thadou: Pathen in vah chu aven pha asah e. Chule Pathen in vah chu muthim akon in asep khen tai.
English: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

tcz: Pathen'in vah chu sun asah in muthim chu jan asah tai. Hiche apat chun nilhah le jingkah ahung umdohtan hichu nikho masa pen ahung hitai.
en: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
text:
GEN 1:5
Thadou: Pathen'in vah chu sun asah in muthim chu jan asah tai. Hiche apat chun nilhah le jingkah ahung umdohtan hichu nikho masa pen ahung hitai.
English: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

tcz: Hichun Pathenin aseiyin, “Twipi sukhen dingin, vanthamjol hung kidal hen lang Van, twipi le leiset twipi chu alang alang ah sukhen hen,” atin.
en: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
text:
GEN 1:6
Thadou: Hichun Pathenin aseiyin, “Twipi sukhen dingin, vanthamjol hung kidal hen lang Van, twipi le leiset twipi chu alang alang ah sukhen hen,” atin.
English: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

tcz: Hiti chun asei bang in aum in, van twipi le leiset twipi chu alang alang ah asukhen tai.”
en: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
text:
GEN 1:7
Thadou: Hiti chun asei bang in aum in, van twipi le leiset twipi chu alang alang ah asukhen tai.”
English: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

tcz: Pathen in onghom chu vanthamjol asah in, hichun nilhah le jingkah achedoh kitin ahileh nikho nina ahi tai.
en: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
text:
GEN 1:8
Thadou: Pathen in onghom chu vanthamjol asah in, hichun nilhah le jingkah achedoh kitin ahileh nikho nina ahi tai.
English: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

tcz: Chule Pathen in aseiye, “Vantham jol'a twi umjouse chu mun khat'a kikhol khom hen lang chule tolgo lai um doh hen,” ati. Asei bang chun aum jeng tai.
en: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.
text:
GEN 1:9
Thadou: Chule Pathen in aseiye, “Vantham jol'a twi umjouse chu mun khat'a kikhol khom hen lang chule tolgo lai um doh hen,” ati. Asei bang chun aum jeng tai.
English: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

tcz: Pathen in tolgo lai chu leiset asah in chule twi jouse kikhol na mun chu twikhanglen asah e. Pathen in aven pha asa lheh jeng in ahi.
en: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.
text:
GEN 1:10
Thadou: Pathen in tolgo lai chu leiset asah in chule twi jouse kikhol na mun chu twikhanglen asah e. Pathen in aven pha asa lheh jeng in ahi.
English: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

tcz: Chuin Pathen'in aseiye, “Leiset in hamphung ho, amu nei hamphung, agathei hamhing chi chom chom leh thingphung aga amunei ho, hiche ho chun ama ama chi dungjui cheh ahin sepdoh kit diu ahi,” ati. Hiti chun ahung kehdoh tauve.
en: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.
text:
GEN 1:11
Thadou: Chuin Pathen'in aseiye, “Leiset in hamphung ho, amu nei hamphung, agathei hamhing chi chom chom leh thingphung aga amunei ho, hiche ho chun ama ama chi dungjui cheh ahin sepdoh kit diu ahi,” ati. Hiti chun ahung kehdoh tauve.
English: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

tcz: Leiset'in hamphung thingphung ama ama chi dung juiyin ahung kehdoh in, agathei amu nei thingphung ama ama chi dungjui yin ahung kehdoh tauvin ahi. Pathen'in aven pha asah lheh jeng in ahi.
en: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.
text:
GEN 1:12
Thadou: Leiset'in hamphung thingphung ama ama chi dung juiyin ahung kehdoh in, agathei amu nei thingphung ama ama chi dungjui yin ahung kehdoh tauvin ahi. Pathen'in aven pha asah lheh jeng in ahi.
English: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

tcz: Nilhah khat le jingkah khat achekit in nithum alhing tai.
en: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.
text:
GEN 1:13
Thadou: Nilhah khat le jingkah khat achekit in nithum alhing tai.
English: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

tcz: Chuin Pathen'in aseiye, “Sun le jan sepkhen dingin vanthomjol avah thei vahho hung kigol uhenlang, hiche ho chu kum kihei chin melchihnan jong, nikho simtoh nan jong chule kum simtoh nan jong pang'u hen.
en: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

tcz: Chujong le hiche ho chu vana vanthamjol akon in leiset salvah-in pang u-hen,’’ atin ahileh, hiti chun aum tai.
en: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.
text:
GEN 1:15
Thadou: Chujong le hiche ho chu vana vanthamjol akon in leiset salvah-in pang u-hen,’’ atin ahileh, hiti chun aum tai.
English: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

tcz: Hiche achun Pathen in vah alen cheh ni asem in, vah alenjo chu sunlaiya thunei ding in apansah-in, chule vah aneojo chu janlaiya thunei ding in apansah tai; hiti chun ahsi ho jong ahin sem tai.
en: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
text:
GEN 1:16
Thadou: Hiche achun Pathen in vah alen cheh ni asem in, vah alenjo chu sunlaiya thunei ding in apansah-in, chule vah aneojo chu janlaiya thunei ding in apansah tai; hiti chun ahsi ho jong ahin sem tai.
English: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

tcz: Pathen in vahho chu vanthamjol apat in leiset salvah din apansah tai.
en: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
text:
GEN 1:17
Thadou: Pathen in vahho chu vanthamjol apat in leiset salvah din apansah tai.
English: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

tcz: Sunlaiya thunei ding, janlaiya thunei ding, chule khovah le muthim sepkhen ding in apansah tan ahi. Pathen in aven ahileh pha asa lheh jeng in ahi.
en: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
text:
GEN 1:18
Thadou: Sunlaiya thunei ding, janlaiya thunei ding, chule khovah le muthim sepkhen ding in apansah tan ahi. Pathen in aven ahileh pha asa lheh jeng in ahi.
English: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

tcz: Hichu nikho li alhin ni ahi.
en: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
text:
GEN 1:19
Thadou: Hichu nikho li alhin ni ahi.
English: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

tcz: Pathen in aseiye, “Twija kon in nga ho leh ganhing ahingthei dangho umhen, chuleh vanthamjol ajong vachate ajat kimsoh in hung leng leu hen,’’ati.
en: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
text:
GEN 1:20
Thadou: Pathen in aseiye, “Twija kon in nga ho leh ganhing ahingthei dangho umhen, chuleh vanthamjol ajong vachate ajat kimsoh in hung leng leu hen,’’ati.
English: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen in twikhanglen'a ganhing ahing thei jouse ahona kijot le ding in asem in, hiche ho chun twi a kidil sah sah-uvin, ama ama jat cheh in alha uvin ahi, chujong le ajat jat in alhanei vachate jong asem in ahi. Hichu Pathen in aven pha asalheh jeng in ahi.
en: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.
text:
GEN 1:21
Thadou: Hiti chun Pathen in twikhanglen'a ganhing ahing thei jouse ahona kijot le ding in asem in, hiche ho chun twi a kidil sah sah-uvin, ama ama jat cheh in alha uvin ahi, chujong le ajat jat in alhanei vachate jong asem in ahi. Hichu Pathen in aven pha asalheh jeng in ahi.
English: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

tcz: Pathen in abonchauvin phatthei aboh in, “Hinpha uvin lang chule pung uvin, twikhanglen'a twi lah dimset uvin, chule leiset chunga vachate jong pung u-hen,’’ ati.
en: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
text:
GEN 1:22
Thadou: Pathen in abonchauvin phatthei aboh in, “Hinpha uvin lang chule pung uvin, twikhanglen'a twi lah dimset uvin, chule leiset chunga vachate jong pung u-hen,’’ ati.
English: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

tcz: Chuin nilhah khat le jingkah khat achen ni nga lhinna ahi tai.
en: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
text:
GEN 1:23
Thadou: Chuin nilhah khat le jingkah khat achen ni nga lhinna ahi tai.
English: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

tcz: Chuin Pathen in aseiye, “Leiset in ama akon in sa jat chom chom hin hingdoh hen! Ama ama jat dungyui cheh in, vah ngui thei gancha, tol'a kithol ganhing, leh gamsa ho jong hihen” ati. Hiti chun aum jeng tai.
en: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.
text:
GEN 1:24
Thadou: Chuin Pathen in aseiye, “Leiset in ama akon in sa jat chom chom hin hingdoh hen! Ama ama jat dungyui cheh in, vah ngui thei gancha, tol'a kithol ganhing, leh gamsa ho jong hihen” ati. Hiti chun aum jeng tai.
English: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.

tcz: Chuin leiset chunga gamsa ho ama ama jat cheh in chule gancha ho jong ama ama jat cheh in a-opma kithol ajat jat in asem'e. Pathen in hiche ho chu aven pha asa lheh jeng in ahi.
en: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.
text:
GEN 1:25
Thadou: Chuin leiset chunga gamsa ho ama ama jat cheh in chule gancha ho jong ama ama jat cheh in a-opma kithol ajat jat in asem'e. Pathen in hiche ho chu aven pha asa lheh jeng in ahi.
English: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Eihon mihem ho, eiho lim pu'in sem u-hitin. Amaho chun twikhanglen sunga nga ho jouse chunga thunei diu, vanlai jol'a leng le vacha ho chule vah ngui thei gancha ho, le gam sa ho, chule a opa a kithol chengse chung'a thunei vaihom in pang'u hen,” ati.
en: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”
text:
GEN 1:26
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Eihon mihem ho, eiho lim pu'in sem u-hitin. Amaho chun twikhanglen sunga nga ho jouse chunga thunei diu, vanlai jol'a leng le vacha ho chule vah ngui thei gancha ho, le gam sa ho, chule a opa a kithol chengse chung'a thunei vaihom in pang'u hen,” ati.
English: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen in ama lim mong mong in mihem chu asem in, Pathen lim tobang bang in ama lim chu asem tai, pasal le numei asem doh tan ahi.
en: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
text:
GEN 1:27
Thadou: Hiti chun Pathen in ama lim mong mong in mihem chu asem in, Pathen lim tobang bang in ama lim chu asem tai, pasal le numei asem doh tan ahi.
English: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

tcz: Pathen in amani chu phatthei aboh in amani jah'a aseiye, “Chipha lhon in chule pung jing lhon in simseng louvin leiset chung hinlo dimset un, chule nangni noiya vaihom na umhen, vanlai jol'a leng vachate chunga jong chule twikhanglen'a ahingthei jouse chunga hijong le aboncha ganhing namkim hihen chule leiset chunga lhale ganhing jouse hile achung uva thunei vaihom in pang lhon tan,’’ ati.
en: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”
text:
GEN 1:28
Thadou: Pathen in amani chu phatthei aboh in amani jah'a aseiye, “Chipha lhon in chule pung jing lhon in simseng louvin leiset chung hinlo dimset un, chule nangni noiya vaihom na umhen, vanlai jol'a leng vachate chunga jong chule twikhanglen'a ahingthei jouse chunga hijong le aboncha ganhing namkim hihen chule leiset chunga lhale ganhing jouse hile achung uva thunei vaihom in pang lhon tan,’’ ati.
English: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

tcz: Pathen in hitin jong seiye, “Ve lhon in keiman leiset chunga muchi gathei phung jouse le thingphung gathei jouse aboncha hi nangni kihinso theina dinga kapeh lhon nahitai.
en: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.
text:
GEN 1:29
Thadou: Pathen in hitin jong seiye, “Ve lhon in keiman leiset chunga muchi gathei phung jouse le thingphung gathei jouse aboncha hi nangni kihinso theina dinga kapeh lhon nahitai.
English: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

tcz: Chule leiset chunga um gamsa jouse hihen chunga leng vachate ho hijongle tol'a aop'a kithol ganhing jouse hijongle ahaithei hinna nei jouse aneh ding uva hamhing jouse kapeh doh ahi tai,’’ atile, hitobang chun aum tai.
en: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.
text:
GEN 1:30
Thadou: Chule leiset chunga um gamsa jouse hihen chunga leng vachate ho hijongle tol'a aop'a kithol ganhing jouse hijongle ahaithei hinna nei jouse aneh ding uva hamhing jouse kapeh doh ahi tai,’’ atile, hitobang chun aum tai.
English: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.

tcz: Chuin Pathen in asemsa chengse chu aboncha'n aven, “Apha lheh jeng in ahi,” hichea chun nilhah le jingkah khat ahung um doh in nigup lhinni ahung hitai.
en: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
text:
GEN 1:31
Thadou: Chuin Pathen in asemsa chengse chu aboncha'n aven, “Apha lheh jeng in ahi,” hichea chun nilhah le jingkah khat ahung um doh in nigup lhinni ahung hitai.
English: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

tcz: Hiti chun van le leiset chule asunga thil umjouse chu loupi tah a sem chai ahi tai.
en: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.
text:
GEN 2:1
Thadou: Hiti chun van le leiset chule asunga thil umjouse chu loupi tah a sem chai ahi tai.
English: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.

tcz: Hichun ni sagi lhin nin Pathen in athilsem chu aboncha achaiyin, hiti chun a thilsem ho jouse akon in ama akicholdo tai.
en: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.
text:
GEN 2:2
Thadou: Hichun ni sagi lhin nin Pathen in athilsem chu aboncha achaiyin, hiti chun a thilsem ho jouse akon in ama akicholdo tai.
English: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.

tcz: Hiche ni sagi lhinni chu Pathen in phatthei aboh in chule atheng ahi tin aphongdoh tai, ajeh chu athilsem le anatoh jousea kon'a akicholdo ni ahi.
en: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.
text:
GEN 2:3
Thadou: Hiche ni sagi lhinni chu Pathen in phatthei aboh in chule atheng ahi tin aphongdoh tai, ajeh chu athilsem le anatoh jousea kon'a akicholdo ni ahi.
English: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

tcz: Hiche hi van le leiset ahung kisemdoh a akhanggui hung kipatdoh dan ho chu hiti hi ana hi. Pakai Pathen in leiset le van ahinsem patni chun.
en: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.
text:
GEN 2:4
Thadou: Hiche hi van le leiset ahung kisemdoh a akhanggui hung kipatdoh dan ho chu hiti hi ana hi. Pakai Pathen in leiset le van ahinsem patni chun.
English: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.

tcz: Leiset chunga tollhang a jong hamphung keh doh loulai ahi, ajeh chu Pathen in gotwi leiset chunga ajuhsah loulai ahin chule hia chu koima natong ding umlou lai ana hi.
en: No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,
text:
GEN 2:5
Thadou: Leiset chunga tollhang a jong hamphung keh doh loulai ahi, ajeh chu Pathen in gotwi leiset chunga ajuhsah loulai ahin chule hia chu koima natong ding umlou lai ana hi.
English: No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

tcz: Ahin leiset'a kon in twimei a hung kaiyin chule leichung jouse chu twiyin achapnou vin ahi.
en: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.
text:
GEN 2:6
Thadou: Ahin leiset'a kon in twimei a hung kaiyin chule leichung jouse chu twiyin achapnou vin ahi.
English: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

tcz: Chuin Pakai Pathen in leichunga kon in vutvai achun mihem asemin, chule a nahhom'a hinna hu alhakhum a ahile mihem chu hinna nei ahung hitai.
en: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
text:
GEN 2:7
Thadou: Chuin Pakai Pathen in leichunga kon in vutvai achun mihem asemin, chule a nahhom'a hinna hu alhakhum a ahile mihem chu hinna nei ahung hitai.
English: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

tcz: Chuphat in Pathen injong niso lama Eden hon aphut dohin hiche achun asem sa mihem chu akoi tai.
en: The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.
text:
GEN 2:8
Thadou: Chuphat in Pathen injong niso lama Eden hon aphut dohin hiche achun asem sa mihem chu akoi tai.
English: The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

tcz: Chuin Pakai Pathen in leichung a kon in vetnom nom umle neh ding thingga namkim akedoh sah in ahi, chule honlai lung'a chun hinna thingphung jong chule ase le apha hetna thing-phung jong akesah in ahi.
en: Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
text:
GEN 2:9
Thadou: Chuin Pakai Pathen in leichung a kon in vetnom nom umle neh ding thingga namkim akedoh sah in ahi, chule honlai lung'a chun hinna thingphung jong chule ase le apha hetna thing-phung jong akesah in ahi.
English: Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

tcz: Hiche Eden hon'a kon chun honlei chapnou jing ding in vadung along in, vadung chu vadung li in ahung long khen'in vadung li asohdoh e.
en: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.
text:
GEN 2:10
Thadou: Hiche Eden hon'a kon chun honlei chapnou jing ding in vadung along in, vadung chu vadung li in ahung long khen'in vadung li asohdoh e.
English: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.

tcz: Vadung khatna chu ahile Pishon ahin, hiche chu sana kimuna vadung ahin Havilah gam pumpia long kimvel ahi.
en: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

tcz: Hiche gam'a sana kimu ho chu ahoi thei lheh in a namtwi jah nom umtah chule song namtwi jong akimui.
en: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.
text:
GEN 2:12
Thadou: Hiche gam'a sana kimu ho chu ahoi thei lheh in a namtwi jah nom umtah chule song namtwi jong akimui.
English: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.

tcz: Vadung ni lhinna chu amin Gihon ahin, hiche vadung chu Cush gam pumpia long kimvel ahi.
en: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.
text:
GEN 2:13
Thadou: Vadung ni lhinna chu amin Gihon ahin, hiche vadung chu Cush gam pumpia long kimvel ahi.
English: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

tcz: Vadung thum lhinna chu ahile Haddekel ahin, hiche vadung hin sah solam gam'a Asshur gam pumpia long ahin, chule vadung li lhinna chu Euphrates ahi.
en: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.
text:
GEN 2:14
Thadou: Vadung thum lhinna chu ahile Haddekel ahin, hiche vadung hin sah solam gam'a Asshur gam pumpia long ahin, chule vadung li lhinna chu Euphrates ahi.
English: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

tcz: Chuin Pakai Pathen in amisem dohpa chu Eden hon sunga apuilut in hiche hon'a natong ding le avetup ding in apansah tai.
en: The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
text:
GEN 2:15
Thadou: Chuin Pakai Pathen in amisem dohpa chu Eden hon sunga apuilut in hiche hon'a natong ding le avetup ding in apansah tai.
English: The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

tcz: Ahin Pathen in mipa koma athupeh chu, “Nang man hiche honsunga theiga ho khu nadei dei naneh thei cheh ahi.
en: The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;

tcz: Hinlah nangman hon lailung'a ase le apha hetna theiga vang naneh lou beh ding, hichu naneh nini, na thitei tei ding,’’ ahi.
en: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”
text:
GEN 2:17
Thadou: Hinlah nangman hon lailung'a ase le apha hetna theiga vang naneh lou beh ding, hichu naneh nini, na thitei tei ding,’’ ahi.
English: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”

tcz: Chujong le Pakai Pathen in aseiye, “Mihempa achanga a-umhi apha poi hijeh chun keiman a umkhom pi ding khat sempeh ing kate,’’ ati.
en: The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
text:
GEN 2:18
Thadou: Chujong le Pakai Pathen in aseiye, “Mihempa achanga a-umhi apha poi hijeh chun keiman a umkhom pi ding khat sempeh ing kate,’’ ati.
English: The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

tcz: Chuin Pakai Pathen in leivui chu leingan a sosah in chu in leichunga ganhing namkim asem in chule vacha ho chung lam'a alensah in chuin hiche ho jouse hi amin ipi pi asah em tin mihempa kom'a ahinpui khom in hiche a mihem pan amin vo najouse chu tuni geia amin a pangden ahi tai.
en: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.
text:
GEN 2:19
Thadou: Chuin Pakai Pathen in leivui chu leingan a sosah in chu in leichunga ganhing namkim asem in chule vacha ho chung lam'a alensah in chuin hiche ho jouse hi amin ipi pi asah em tin mihempa kom'a ahinpui khom in hiche a mihem pan amin vo najouse chu tuni geia amin a pangden ahi tai.
English: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.

tcz: Hiti chun mihempa in ganhing namkim chu aminvo cheh in chunga lengthei vachate ahin, chule loujaova sahang jouse jong aminvo soh keiyin ahin mihempa kithopi ding akimu doh hih laiye.
en: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.
text:
GEN 2:20
Thadou: Hiti chun mihempa in ganhing namkim chu aminvo cheh in chunga lengthei vachate ahin, chule loujaova sahang jouse jong aminvo soh keiyin ahin mihempa kithopi ding akimu doh hih laiye.
English: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen in mihempa chu a imut-mil sah in a imut-mil kah chun Pathen in anahgu khat aladoh in anung chu aphe in atom jol peh in ahi.
en: The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.
text:
GEN 2:21
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen in mihempa chu a imut-mil sah in a imut-mil kah chun Pathen in anahgu khat aladoh in anung chu aphe in atom jol peh in ahi.
English: The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

tcz: Chuin Pakai Pathen in Adam nahgu a lah doh'a kon chun numei khat asemdoh in amanu chu Adam kom'a ahin puilut in ahi.
en: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.
text:
GEN 2:22
Thadou: Chuin Pakai Pathen in Adam nahgu a lah doh'a kon chun numei khat asemdoh in amanu chu Adam kom'a ahin puilut in ahi.
English: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.

tcz: Hichun mihempan aseiye, “Amanu hi keima gu akon'a kisemdoh ahin, chule aphevou jang jong keima phevou ahin, amanu hi tu apat'a numei kiti ding ahi, ajeh chu amanu hi pasal'a kona kiladoh ahi,” ati.
en: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”
text:
GEN 2:23
Thadou: Hichun mihempan aseiye, “Amanu hi keima gu akon'a kisemdoh ahin, chule aphevou jang jong keima phevou ahin, amanu hi tu apat'a numei kiti ding ahi, ajeh chu amanu hi pasal'a kona kiladoh ahi,” ati.
English: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

tcz: Hijeh a chu pasal in anu le apa a dalhah a aji numei'a beh ding chule amani chu tipum khat kiti lhon ding ahiye.
en: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.
text:
GEN 2:24
Thadou: Hijeh a chu pasal in anu le apa a dalhah a aji numei'a beh ding chule amani chu tipum khat kiti lhon ding ahiye.
English: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

tcz: Ahin hichepet chun pasalpa ahin numeinu ahin ani gel lhon a sagoh keuva um lhon ahin, ahi vang'in jachat na anei lhon pon ahi.
en: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
text:
GEN 2:25
Thadou: Ahin hichepet chun pasalpa ahin numeinu ahin ani gel lhon a sagoh keuva um lhon ahin, ahi vang'in jachat na anei lhon pon ahi.
English: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.

tcz: Pathen thilsem jouse laha gul hi a lungthim thempen ahi. Nikhat chu aman numeinu adong in, “Pathen in honsunga theiga jouse naneh thei lhon lou beh ding ahi tia asei mong em?” ati.
en: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”
text:
GEN 3:1
Thadou: Pathen thilsem jouse laha gul hi a lungthim thempen ahi. Nikhat chu aman numeinu adong in, “Pathen in honsunga theiga jouse naneh thei lhon lou beh ding ahi tia asei mong em?” ati.
English: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”

tcz: Numei nu chun gul jaha keini'n “Eden hon sunga theiga jouse kaneh thei lhon ding ahi nai.”
en: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,
text:
GEN 3:2
Thadou: Numei nu chun gul jaha keini'n “Eden hon sunga theiga jouse kaneh thei lhon ding ahi nai.”
English: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,

tcz: Ahin Pathen in hitin aseiye, “Hon lailung a theiga vangkhu naneh lhon lou hel ding, lo jong nalo lhon lou hel ding ahi. Ahin iti ham khat'a nalo lhon a naneh lhon le nathi jeng lhon ding ahi,” tin aseiye.
en: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”
text:
GEN 3:3
Thadou: Ahin Pathen in hitin aseiye, “Hon lailung a theiga vangkhu naneh lhon lou hel ding, lo jong nalo lhon lou hel ding ahi. Ahin iti ham khat'a nalo lhon a naneh lhon le nathi jeng lhon ding ahi,” tin aseiye.
English: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”

tcz: Hinlah Satan in numeinu jah a aseiyin, “Nathi lhon loubeh ding ahi.
en: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,
text:
GEN 3:4
Thadou: Hinlah Satan in numeinu jah a aseiyin, “Nathi lhon loubeh ding ahi.
English: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in ahet ahi hichu naneh nini lhonle namit lhon hung hahdoh intin Pathen toh nabah lhon ding thilpha le thilse hetheiya naum lhon ding ahi ti Pathen in ahet jeh'a asei ahi bouve,” atitai.
en: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”
text:
GEN 3:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen in ahet ahi hichu naneh nini lhonle namit lhon hung hahdoh intin Pathen toh nabah lhon ding thilpha le thilse hetheiya naum lhon ding ahi ti Pathen in ahet jeh'a asei ahi bouve,” atitai.
English: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

tcz: Hiche a chun numeinun theiga chu aven ahile neh dinga tui chule mitvet dinga jong vetnom nom um, chule mi achihsah jeng ding jeh chun ahaduchat cheh tai. Hijeh chun numei nun theiga chu akilo in anetan chule a pasalpa jong them khat apen amapan jong ala in ane tai.
en: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.
text:
GEN 3:6
Thadou: Hiche a chun numeinun theiga chu aven ahile neh dinga tui chule mitvet dinga jong vetnom nom um, chule mi achihsah jeng ding jeh chun ahaduchat cheh tai. Hijeh chun numei nun theiga chu akilo in anetan chule a pasalpa jong them khat apen amapan jong ala in ane tai.
English: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.

tcz: Hiche apat chun amit lhon chu ahung hahdoh in tahsa sagoh keo ahilhon chu aki hechen lhon tai. Hichun thing-phung na akilo lhon in atahsa lhon chu akisel na lhon tan ahi.
en: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.
text:
GEN 3:7
Thadou: Hiche apat chun amit lhon chu ahung hahdoh in tahsa sagoh keo ahilhon chu aki hechen lhon tai. Hichun thing-phung na akilo lhon in atahsa lhon chu akisel na lhon tan ahi.
English: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.

tcz: Chuin nisa dai lhah lamin honsunga Pakai Pathen awgin chu ajalhon in hijeh chun hon lailung'a thinglah a chun amani tah Pakai Pathen masanga akisel mang lhon tai.
en: They heard the LORD God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.
text:
GEN 3:8
Thadou: Chuin nisa dai lhah lamin honsunga Pakai Pathen awgin chu ajalhon in hijeh chun hon lailung'a thinglah a chun amani tah Pakai Pathen masanga akisel mang lhon tai.
English: They heard the LORD God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.

tcz: Ahivang in Pakai Pathen in mihempa chu akouvin, “Adam hoiya umna hi tam?” atile,
en: The LORD God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”
text:
GEN 3:9
Thadou: Ahivang in Pakai Pathen in mihempa chu akouvin, “Adam hoiya umna hi tam?” atile,
English: The LORD God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

tcz: Adam in jong adonbut in “Keiman nangma honsung'a na hung chu ka hen ahile ka sagoh keo ka hijeh a ka kichat'a kisela kahi,” ati.
en: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
text:
GEN 3:10
Thadou: Adam in jong adonbut in “Keiman nangma honsung'a na hung chu ka hen ahile ka sagoh keo ka hijeh a ka kichat'a kisela kahi,” ati.
English: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”

tcz: Hichun Pathen in jong aseiye, koi ham nangma sa gohkeova na um'e tia na seipeh a chu? Honsung'a theiga nehih in kati chu naneh hitam? atile,
en: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”
text:
GEN 3:11
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in jong aseiye, koi ham nangma sa gohkeova na um'e tia na seipeh a chu? Honsung'a theiga nehih in kati chu naneh hitam? atile,
English: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

tcz: Adam in adonbut in, “Keiman ka um khompi dinga nangman neipeh numeinu hin theiga chu themkhat eipen keiman kana netai,” ati.
en: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
text:
GEN 3:12
Thadou: Adam in adonbut in, “Keiman ka um khompi dinga nangman neipeh numeinu hin theiga chu themkhat eipen keiman kana netai,” ati.
English: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”

tcz: Chuphat in Pakai Pathen in numeinu jah'a aseiye, “Nang in ipi dinga hitobang pihi nabol hitam!” atile numei nun adonbut'in, “Hiche gul hin eijol jol phat'a kaneh ahi bouve,” ati.
en: The LORD God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”
text:
GEN 3:13
Thadou: Chuphat in Pakai Pathen in numeinu jah'a aseiye, “Nang in ipi dinga hitobang pihi nabol hitam!” atile numei nun adonbut'in, “Hiche gul hin eijol jol phat'a kaneh ahi bouve,” ati.
English: The LORD God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

tcz: Hichun Pakai Pathen in gul jah'a, “Nangman hiche nana boldoh jeh in, ganhing jouse lah a nanghi sapset nachan ding na hinkho lhung keiya na oipoh'a na kithol tho ding, chule na hinkho sunga leivui naneh ding ahi.
en: The LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.
text:
GEN 3:14
Thadou: Hichun Pakai Pathen in gul jah'a, “Nangman hiche nana boldoh jeh in, ganhing jouse lah a nanghi sapset nachan ding na hinkho lhung keiya na oipoh'a na kithol tho ding, chule na hinkho sunga leivui naneh ding ahi.
English: The LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.

tcz: Keiman nangle numeinu chilhah kah a kidouna kakoi ding, amapa chun nangma hi na luchang avohchip a; nangman amapa kengphang na chuh peh ding ahi,”ati.
en: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”
text:
GEN 3:15
Thadou: Keiman nangle numeinu chilhah kah a kidouna kakoi ding, amapa chun nangma hi na luchang avohchip a; nangman amapa kengphang na chuh peh ding ahi,”ati.
English: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”

tcz: Pathen in numeinu jah'a chun hitin a seiye, “Keiman na naovop hahsatna kabe peh ding, nao-sonat gentheiya cha nahin doh ding ahi. Najipa chung'a vai nahom nom jing ding, ahi vang'a najipan nang chunga vai ahop ding ahi,”ati.
en: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”
text:
GEN 3:16
Thadou: Pathen in numeinu jah'a chun hitin a seiye, “Keiman na naovop hahsatna kabe peh ding, nao-sonat gentheiya cha nahin doh ding ahi. Najipa chung'a vai nahom nom jing ding, ahi vang'a najipan nang chunga vai ahop ding ahi,”ati.
English: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”

tcz: Chuin Pakai Pathen in Adam jah'a hitin ati, “Nangman naji thu nangaiya naneh louhel ding ahi tia ka thupehsa theiga naneh tah jeh in nangma jeh a leiset hi sapset chang ahitai. Chule na hinkho damlai sungse a gimna le genthei thohpum pum'a neh na kihol a naneh ding ahi.
en: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.
text:
GEN 3:17
Thadou: Chuin Pakai Pathen in Adam jah'a hitin ati, “Nangman naji thu nangaiya naneh louhel ding ahi tia ka thupehsa theiga naneh tah jeh in nangma jeh a leiset hi sapset chang ahitai. Chule na hinkho damlai sungse a gimna le genthei thohpum pum'a neh na kihol a naneh ding ahi.
English: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.

tcz: Chule nang doudin ling le mi-at thei jong hung kehdoh intin, chule nangma anche louhing a naki vahding ahi.
en: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.
text:
GEN 3:18
Thadou: Chule nang doudin ling le mi-at thei jong hung kehdoh intin, chule nangma anche louhing a naki vahding ahi.
English: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.

tcz: Na ti-ul na mai ja long pum'a anneh na kihol'a na neh ding, chule nangma leiset a kisemdoh nahin leiset na leso kit ding ahiye,” ati.
en: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are dust, and you shall return to dust.”
text:
GEN 3:19
Thadou: Na ti-ul na mai ja long pum'a anneh na kihol'a na neh ding, chule nangma leiset a kisemdoh nahin leiset na leso kit ding ahiye,” ati.
English: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are dust, and you shall return to dust.”

tcz: Hichun Adam in ajinu chu amin Eve asah tai. Ajeh chu amanu mijouse hung pen dohna minu ahi tan ahi.
en: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.
text:
GEN 3:20
Thadou: Hichun Adam in ajinu chu amin Eve asah tai. Ajeh chu amanu mijouse hung pen dohna minu ahi tan ahi.
English: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.

tcz: Hichun Pakai Pathen in savun akon in Adam le Eve ding von akhui peh in amani chu asilpeh in ahi.
en: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.
text:
GEN 3:21
Thadou: Hichun Pakai Pathen in savun akon in Adam le Eve ding von akhui peh in amani chu asilpeh in ahi.
English: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Tuapat'a hi Adam hi eiho lah'a khat tobang ahung hi tan, thilpha le thilse hethei jin a um tai, chule tunjong aman hinna thingphung ga khu kilo intin hin ne lhon leh tonsot'a hing den ding ahi tai ati.”
en: The LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”
text:
GEN 3:22
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Tuapat'a hi Adam hi eiho lah'a khat tobang ahung hi tan, thilpha le thilse hethei jin a um tai, chule tunjong aman hinna thingphung ga khu kilo intin hin ne lhon leh tonsot'a hing den ding ahi tai ati.”
English: The LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”

tcz: Hiche'a pat chun Pakai Pathen in Adam chu Eden hon a kon'in achondoh in amopohna chu alah peh tai.
en: Therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.
text:
GEN 3:23
Thadou: Hiche'a pat chun Pakai Pathen in Adam chu Eden hon a kon'in achondoh in amopohna chu alah peh tai.
English: Therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen in Adam anodoh jouvin, Eden hon nisolam'a hinna thingphung ngah ding in vantil Cherubim chu achen sah in, chule chemjam kou jeju chu akipei kimvel le sahtan ahi.
en: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
text:
GEN 3:24
Thadou: Hiti chun Pathen in Adam anodoh jouvin, Eden hon nisolam'a hinna thingphung ngah ding in vantil Cherubim chu achen sah in, chule chemjam kou jeju chu akipei kimvel le sahtan ahi.
English: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.

tcz: Chujouvin Adam le Eve akitimat lhon in ahile Eve'in nao ahin vopin Cain chu ahung peng tai, hiche'a chun amanu'n hitin aseiye, Pathen phatthei bohna jal in cha pasal khat kanei tai ati.
en: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with the LORD’s help.”
text:
GEN 4:1
Thadou: Chujouvin Adam le Eve akitimat lhon in ahile Eve'in nao ahin vopin Cain chu ahung peng tai, hiche'a chun amanu'n hitin aseiye, Pathen phatthei bohna jal in cha pasal khat kanei tai ati.
English: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with the LORD’s help.”

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou chun Eve chun chapa Abel ahing kit tai, hichun khonung in chapang teni chu ahung khanglen lhon tan, Abel chu kelngoi ching in ahung pang in, Cain vang chu loubol mi ahung hi tan ahi.
en: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
text:
GEN 4:2
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jou chun Eve chun chapa Abel ahing kit tai, hichun khonung in chapang teni chu ahung khanglen lhon tan, Abel chu kelngoi ching in ahung pang in, Cain vang chu loubol mi ahung hi tan ahi.
English: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

tcz: Phat phabep jouvin Cain in alousohga alhun phat in alousohga phabep ahin pon Pathen ading in kilhaina ahung sem tai.
en: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.
text:
GEN 4:3
Thadou: Phat phabep jouvin Cain in alousohga alhun phat in alousohga phabep ahin pon Pathen ading in kilhaina ahung sem tai.
English: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.

tcz: Hitobang ma chun Abel in jong akelngoi lah'a apeng masa athao pen tah khat chu Pathen ading in ahin pedoh tai, Hichun Pathen in Abel lam joh aven athilto jong kipahtah in asanpeh tai.
en: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. The LORD respected Abel and his offering,
text:
GEN 4:4
Thadou: Hitobang ma chun Abel in jong akelngoi lah'a apeng masa athao pen tah khat chu Pathen ading in ahin pedoh tai, Hichun Pathen in Abel lam joh aven athilto jong kipahtah in asanpeh tai.
English: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. The LORD respected Abel and his offering,

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in Cain thilto maicham chu asanpeh tapoi, hijeh chun Cain chu hatah in alunghang in akaiku jeng in ahi.
en: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.
text:
GEN 4:5
Thadou: Hinlah Pathen in Cain thilto maicham chu asanpeh tapoi, hijeh chun Cain chu hatah in alunghang in akaiku jeng in ahi.
English: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.

tcz: Hihe phat chun Pathen in Cain jah a, “Ibola nangle nang kilunghan nahi ham? chule ibola namai thim jeng a ham?
en: The LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?
text:
GEN 4:6
Thadou: Hihe phat chun Pathen in Cain jah a, “Ibola nangle nang kilunghan nahi ham? chule ibola namai thim jeng a ham?
English: The LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?

tcz: Thilpha bol dinga kilomho chu nabol le na kisan pehda ding ham? Ahin thilpha boldinga kilomho chu na bolnom loule kichih theiyin chonsetnan naval lhum ding ahitai. Hiche hohi na chinpha ding joh ahi,” ati.
en: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”
text:
GEN 4:7
Thadou: Thilpha bol dinga kilomho chu nabol le na kisan pehda ding ham? Ahin thilpha boldinga kilomho chu na bolnom loule kichih theiyin chonsetnan naval lhum ding ahitai. Hiche hohi na chinpha ding joh ahi,” ati.
English: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”

tcz: Nikhat chu Cain in asopipa Abel jah'a “Eini thinglhang lam'a che hite atin, gamlang agei lhon phat in Cain chu asopipa Abel chunga achun athat tai.”
en: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.
text:
GEN 4:8
Thadou: Nikhat chu Cain in asopipa Abel jah'a “Eini thinglhang lam'a che hite atin, gamlang agei lhon phat in Cain chu asopipa Abel chunga achun athat tai.”
English: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Pakai Pathen in Cain jah a, “Nasopipa Abel hoiya um hitam?” atile Cain'in jong adonbut in, “Kahe poi, Keima hi ka sopi pa Abel ching tup ka him?” ati.
en: The LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”
text:
GEN 4:9
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Pakai Pathen in Cain jah a, “Nasopipa Abel hoiya um hitam?” atile Cain'in jong adonbut in, “Kahe poi, Keima hi ka sopi pa Abel ching tup ka him?” ati.
English: The LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”

tcz: Hichun Pathen in jong Cain jah'a “Ipi nabol hitam? Na sopi pa Abel thisan chu tol'a kon'in keima angsung gei in ahung peng in ahi.
en: The LORD said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.
text:
GEN 4:10
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in jong Cain jah'a “Ipi nabol hitam? Na sopi pa Abel thisan chu tol'a kon'in keima angsung gei in ahung peng in ahi.
English: The LORD said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.

tcz: Hijeh chun tua patna nangma hi leiset chunga sapset na noija uma na hitai, na sopi pa Abel thisan in na chup ahitai.
en: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
text:
GEN 4:11
Thadou: Hijeh chun tua patna nangma hi leiset chunga sapset na noija uma na hitai, na sopi pa Abel thisan in na chup ahitai.
English: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

tcz: Leiset a kona nangma dinga ga imacha pung ding ahi tapoi, itobang in natong jong leh chun nangman leiseta in mun neilou gamvah mangpa na kiti ding ahi.”
en: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth.”
text:
GEN 4:12
Thadou: Leiset a kona nangma dinga ga imacha pung ding ahi tapoi, itobang in natong jong leh chun nangman leiseta in mun neilou gamvah mangpa na kiti ding ahi.”
English: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth.”

tcz: Chuphat in Cain chun Pathen henga aseiye, “Keima gotna kachan hi kei thoh jou hoi ahi poi.
en: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.
text:
GEN 4:13
Thadou: Chuphat in Cain chun Pathen henga aseiye, “Keima gotna kachan hi kei thoh jou hoi ahi poi.
English: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.

tcz: Vetan tunin nangma akon in neidel mangtai, nang in leichunga umna neilou neihi sahtai, tua pat'a hi koihijongle eitoh khapen pen chun eitha ding ahi tai.”
en: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”
text:
GEN 4:14
Thadou: Vetan tunin nangma akon in neidel mangtai, nang in leichunga umna neilou neihi sahtai, tua pat'a hi koihijongle eitoh khapen pen chun eitha ding ahi tai.”
English: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”

tcz: Pathen in adonbut in, “Ahipoi koi tobang nangma hinkho sumang dinga kigo a aumle keiman ama chunga sagi vei ka phulah ding ahi.” Hichea chun Pathen in Cain chu koiman atha louna ding in Cain chunga melchihna khat akoipeh in ahi.
en: The LORD said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” The LORD appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.
text:
GEN 4:15
Thadou: Pathen in adonbut in, “Ahipoi koi tobang nangma hinkho sumang dinga kigo a aumle keiman ama chunga sagi vei ka phulah ding ahi.” Hichea chun Pathen in Cain chu koiman atha louna ding in Cain chunga melchihna khat akoipeh in ahi.
English: The LORD said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” The LORD appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.

tcz: Hichea kon chun Cain in Pathen kom adalhan Eden niso lam a Nod muna chun acheng tai.
en: Cain left the LORD’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
text:
GEN 4:16
Thadou: Hichea kon chun Cain in Pathen kom adalhan Eden niso lam a Nod muna chun acheng tai.
English: Cain left the LORD’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

tcz: Cain chun ajinu aki timatpin ahile nao ahin vop kit tan hiche nao chu Enoch ahi. Chuin Cain in phat phabep jouvin khopi khat ahinsem dohin, achapa min aput sah in hiche khopi min chu Enoch asah tai.
en: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.
text:
GEN 4:17
Thadou: Cain chun ajinu aki timatpin ahile nao ahin vop kit tan hiche nao chu Enoch ahi. Chuin Cain in phat phabep jouvin khopi khat ahinsem dohin, achapa min aput sah in hiche khopi min chu Enoch asah tai.
English: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.

tcz: Enoch in chapa Irad ahing in, Irad chun Mehujael ahing in, Mehujael chun Methushael ahing in, Methushael chun Lamech ahing'e.
en: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.
text:
GEN 4:18
Thadou: Enoch in chapa Irad ahing in, Irad chun Mehujael ahing in, Mehujael chun Methushael ahing in, Methushael chun Lamech ahing'e.
English: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.

tcz: Lamech chun ji numei ni anei jin amasa nu chu ahile Adah ahin chule anina nu chu Zillah ahiye.
en: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.
text:
GEN 4:19
Thadou: Lamech chun ji numei ni anei jin amasa nu chu ahile Adah ahin chule anina nu chu Zillah ahiye.
English: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.

tcz: Adah in Jabal ahing in, amahi ahiye, khoilupon in a chenga gancha chingho ding'a apau chu.
en: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.
text:
GEN 4:20
Thadou: Adah in Jabal ahing in, amahi ahiye, khoilupon in a chenga gancha chingho ding'a apau chu.
English: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

tcz: Chule asopi pa min chu Jubal ahin, ama chu lathem gosem mut them masa pen ahiye.
en: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.
text:
GEN 4:21
Thadou: Chule asopi pa min chu Jubal ahin, ama chu lathem gosem mut them masa pen ahiye.
English: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.

tcz: Zillah jong chun Tubal-cain ahing in, ama chun manchah ding abonchan sum-eng jong thih jong ahin kheng'e. Chule Tubal-cain chun sopi numei khat anei jin amin Naamah ahi.
en: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.
text:
GEN 4:22
Thadou: Zillah jong chun Tubal-cain ahing in, ama chun manchah ding abonchan sum-eng jong thih jong ahin kheng'e. Chule Tubal-cain chun sopi numei khat anei jin amin Naamah ahi.
English: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.

tcz: Chujou vin nikhat chu Lamech chun ajite ni jaha hitin a seiye , “Vo Adah le Zillah ka aw kasei ngai lhon in, ‘Ajeh chu pasal khat in eimavo jeh in ka that'in golhang khat'in eiden jeh-in ka that tai.
en: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.
text:
GEN 4:23
Thadou: Chujou vin nikhat chu Lamech chun ajite ni jaha hitin a seiye , “Vo Adah le Zillah ka aw kasei ngai lhon in, ‘Ajeh chu pasal khat in eimavo jeh in ka that'in golhang khat'in eiden jeh-in ka that tai.
English: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.

tcz: Koi tabang mikhat in Cain chu atha le sagi vei gotna chang ding ahile keima hinkho lading koi tobang aumle som sagi vei gotna chang ding joh ahiye.”
en: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”
text:
GEN 4:24
Thadou: Koi tabang mikhat in Cain chu atha le sagi vei gotna chang ding ahile keima hinkho lading koi tobang aumle som sagi vei gotna chang ding joh ahiye.”
English: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”

tcz: Chuin Adam chun ajinu akitimat pikit in ahile amanun chapa khat ahing kit in, amin Seth asah tai; ijeh inem itile amanun hitin aseiye, “Pathen in chapa eipeh kit hi Abel khel a ei kipe ah ahi, ajeh chu Cain thapa khel ding in eipe tai,” ati.
en: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”
text:
GEN 4:25
Thadou: Chuin Adam chun ajinu akitimat pikit in ahile amanun chapa khat ahing kit in, amin Seth asah tai; ijeh inem itile amanun hitin aseiye, “Pathen in chapa eipeh kit hi Abel khel a ei kipe ah ahi, ajeh chu Cain thapa khel ding in eipe tai,” ati.
English: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”

tcz: Seth chu mipi lhing ahung hiphat in chapa khat aneiyin amin Enosh asah-e. Hiche apat chun mipi hon Pathen chu amin pan in ahou pan tauvin ahi.
en: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on the LORD’s name.
text:
GEN 4:26
Thadou: Seth chu mipi lhing ahung hiphat in chapa khat aneiyin amin Enosh asah-e. Hiche apat chun mipi hon Pathen chu amin pan in ahou pan tauvin ahi.
English: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on the LORD’s name.

tcz: Hiche hohi Adam te insung khanggui umdan kijihna lekhabu ahi. Pathen in mihem asem chu ama lim tobang din asem in ahi.
en: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.
text:
GEN 5:1
Thadou: Hiche hohi Adam te insung khanggui umdan kijihna lekhabu ahi. Pathen in mihem asem chu ama lim tobang din asem in ahi.
English: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

tcz: Pathenin numei le pasal ana semdoh in aman amisem doh teni chu phatthei aboh in chuin amani chu mihem asah tai.
en: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.
text:
GEN 5:2
Thadou: Pathenin numei le pasal ana semdoh in aman amisem doh teni chu phatthei aboh in chuin amani chu mihem asah tai.
English: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.

tcz: Adam chu kum jakhat le kum somthum alhinin ama limle ama mel to kilou cha khat ahing in hichepa chu amin Seth asah tai.
en: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
text:
GEN 5:3
Thadou: Adam chu kum jakhat le kum somthum alhinin ama limle ama mel to kilou cha khat ahing in hichepa chu amin Seth asah tai.
English: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

tcz: Seth apen jou chun Adam chu kum jaget tabang ahin be kit in, chu achun Adam in cha numei le pasal anei be na laiye.
en: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 5:4
Thadou: Seth apen jou chun Adam chu kum jaget tabang ahin be kit in, chu achun Adam in cha numei le pasal anei be na laiye.
English: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

tcz: Adam chu kum jako le kum somthum ahing nomsel in hiche jou chun ama athi tai.
en: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.
text:
GEN 5:5
Thadou: Adam chu kum jako le kum somthum ahing nomsel in hiche jou chun ama athi tai.
English: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

tcz: Seth chu kum jakhat le kum nga ahi chun ama chu Enosh pa ahung hi tai.
en: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.
text:
GEN 5:6
Thadou: Seth chu kum jakhat le kum nga ahi chun ama chu Enosh pa ahung hi tai.
English: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

tcz: Enosh pen jou chun Seth chu kum jaget le kum sagi ahin be nalai in chu achun aman cha numei le pasal adang ahin be nalaiye.
en: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 5:7
Thadou: Enosh pen jou chun Seth chu kum jaget le kum sagi ahin be nalai in chu achun aman cha numei le pasal adang ahin be nalaiye.
English: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

tcz: Hichun Seth chu kum jako le kumsom le kumni ahing in hiche jou chun aleiset hinkho abeitai.
en: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.
text:
GEN 5:8
Thadou: Hichun Seth chu kum jako le kumsom le kumni ahing in hiche jou chun aleiset hinkho abeitai.
English: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

tcz: Enosh chu kum somko ahi chun ama chu Kenan pa ahung hi tai.
en: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.
text:
GEN 5:9
Thadou: Enosh chu kum somko ahi chun ama chu Kenan pa ahung hi tai.
English: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

tcz: Kenan pen jou chun, Enosh chu kum jaget le kum som le kum nga ahing na laiyin chujou chun cha numei le cha pasal ahing na laiye.
en: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 5:10
Thadou: Kenan pen jou chun, Enosh chu kum jaget le kum som le kum nga ahing na laiyin chujou chun cha numei le cha pasal ahing na laiye.
English: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

tcz: Enosh chu kum jako le kum nga ahing in ama athi tai.
en: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.
text:
GEN 5:11
Thadou: Enosh chu kum jako le kum nga ahing in ama athi tai.
English: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

tcz: Kenan chu kum som sagi alhing in ama chu Mahalalel pa ahung hitai.
en: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.
text:
GEN 5:12
Thadou: Kenan chu kum som sagi alhing in ama chu Mahalalel pa ahung hitai.
English: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

tcz: Mahalalel pen jou chun, Kenan chu kum jaget le kum somli ahing na laiyin, chule aman chapa dang le chanu dang jong anei be nalaiye.
en: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters
text:
GEN 5:13
Thadou: Mahalalel pen jou chun, Kenan chu kum jaget le kum somli ahing na laiyin, chule aman chapa dang le chanu dang jong anei be nalaiye.
English: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters

tcz: Kenan chu kum jako le kum som gei ahing in chuin ama hinkho abeitai.
en: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.
text:
GEN 5:14
Thadou: Kenan chu kum jako le kum som gei ahing in chuin ama hinkho abeitai.
English: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

tcz: Hichun Mahalalel chu kum somgup le kum nga alhing in ama chu Jared pa ahung hi tai.
en: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.
text:
GEN 5:15
Thadou: Hichun Mahalalel chu kum somgup le kum nga alhing in ama chu Jared pa ahung hi tai.
English: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.

tcz: Jared pen jou chun, Mahalalel chu kum jaget le kum som thum jen ahing nalaiyin chule cha pasal le cha numei tamtah ahin be nalaiye.
en: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 5:16
Thadou: Jared pen jou chun, Mahalalel chu kum jaget le kum som thum jen ahing nalaiyin chule cha pasal le cha numei tamtah ahin be nalaiye.
English: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

tcz: Hichun Mahalalel kum jaget le kum somko le kum nga gei ahing in hichun ama leiset hinkho abeitai.
en: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.
text:
GEN 5:17
Thadou: Hichun Mahalalel kum jaget le kum somko le kum nga gei ahing in hichun ama leiset hinkho abeitai.
English: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

tcz: Jared chu kum jakhat le kum somgup le kum ni alhin in ama chu Enoch pa ahung hitai.
en: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.
text:
GEN 5:18
Thadou: Jared chu kum jakhat le kum somgup le kum ni alhin in ama chu Enoch pa ahung hitai.
English: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.

tcz: Enoch pen jou chun, Jared chu kum jaget gei ahingin, chuban in chapa le chanu dang jong ahing na laiye.
en: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 5:19
Thadou: Enoch pen jou chun, Jared chu kum jaget gei ahingin, chuban in chapa le chanu dang jong ahing na laiye.
English: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

tcz: Jared chu kum jako le kum som gup le kumni ahing in, hichun ama aleiset hinkho abeitai.
en: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.
text:
GEN 5:20
Thadou: Jared chu kum jako le kum som gup le kumni ahing in, hichun ama aleiset hinkho abeitai.
English: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

tcz: Enoch chu kum som gup le kum nga alhin in ama chu Methuselah pa ahung hitai.
en: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.
text:
GEN 5:21
Thadou: Enoch chu kum som gup le kum nga alhin in ama chu Methuselah pa ahung hitai.
English: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

tcz: Methuselah pen jou kum jathum sungin Enoch chu Pathen toh kinai tah in aum jing jeng in chule chapa dangle chanu dang tampi jong ahinbe nalaiye.
en: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 5:22
Thadou: Methuselah pen jou kum jathum sungin Enoch chu Pathen toh kinai tah in aum jing jeng in chule chapa dangle chanu dang tampi jong ahinbe nalaiye.
English: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

tcz: Hiti chun Enoch chu kum jathum le kum somgup le kum nga ahing in ahi.
en: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.
text:
GEN 5:23
Thadou: Hiti chun Enoch chu kum jathum le kum somgup le kum nga ahing in ahi.
English: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

tcz: Pathen toh kingaitah a umjing ahin nikhat chu ama akimu tapon Pathen in akou doh ahi tai.
en: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.
text:
GEN 5:24
Thadou: Pathen toh kingaitah a umjing ahin nikhat chu ama akimu tapon Pathen in akou doh ahi tai.
English: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

tcz: Methuselah chu kum jakhat le kum somget le kum sagi alhin in, ama chu Lamech pa ahung hitai.
en: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.
text:
GEN 5:25
Thadou: Methuselah chu kum jakhat le kum somget le kum sagi alhin in, ama chu Lamech pa ahung hitai.
English: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

tcz: Lamech pen jou chun, Methuselah chu kum jasagi le kum somget le kumni ahing in, hichun aman chapa le chanu dang tamtah anei be nalaiyin ahi.
en: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 5:26
Thadou: Lamech pen jou chun, Methuselah chu kum jasagi le kum somget le kumni ahing in, hichun aman chapa le chanu dang tamtah anei be nalaiyin ahi.
English: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

tcz: Methuselah chu kum jako le kumsom gup le kum ko ahing in hichun ama ahinkho abeitai.
en: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.
text:
GEN 5:27
Thadou: Methuselah chu kum jako le kumsom gup le kum ko ahing in hichun ama ahinkho abeitai.
English: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

tcz: Hichun Lamech chu kum jakhat le kum som get le kumni alhinin chapa khat ahing in,
en: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.
text:
GEN 5:28
Thadou: Hichun Lamech chu kum jakhat le kum som get le kumni alhinin chapa khat ahing in,
English: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.

tcz: Ama min chu Noah asah in hitin aseiye, “Pathen in agaosapsa gim genthei thoh'a ikhut uva i-tohgim nau hiche leiset'a kona ama hin eitha-ol sah ding'u ahi,”ati.
en: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”
text:
GEN 5:29
Thadou: Ama min chu Noah asah in hitin aseiye, “Pathen in agaosapsa gim genthei thoh'a ikhut uva i-tohgim nau hiche leiset'a kona ama hin eitha-ol sah ding'u ahi,”ati.
English: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”

tcz: Noah pen jou chun, Lamech chu kum ja nga le kum somko le kum nga ahing in hijou chun cha pasal le numei tamtah ahing na laiyin ahi.
en: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 5:30
Thadou: Noah pen jou chun, Lamech chu kum ja nga le kum somko le kum nga ahing in hijou chun cha pasal le numei tamtah ahing na laiyin ahi.
English: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

tcz: Lamech chu kum jasagi le kum som sagi le kum sagi ahing in, hichun aleiset hinkho abeitai.
en: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.
text:
GEN 5:31
Thadou: Lamech chu kum jasagi le kum som sagi le kum sagi ahing in, hichun aleiset hinkho abeitai.
English: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

tcz: Noah chu kum ja nga alhin'in, ama chu Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahing in ahi.
en: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
text:
GEN 5:32
Thadou: Noah chu kum ja nga alhin'in, ama chu Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahing in ahi.
English: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

tcz: Hiche achun leiset chunga mihem ahung pung pan tan ahile alah uva chanu jong tampi ahing tauve.
en: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,
text:
GEN 6:1
Thadou: Hiche achun leiset chunga mihem ahung pung pan tan ahile alah uva chanu jong tampi ahing tauve.
English: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

tcz: Chuin Pathen chapate chun numei hoitah ho chu amu uvin ama hon adei thei lheh jeng uvin, hijeh chun adei dei akilhen uvin ajinu ding in akipui tauvin ahi.
en: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
text:
GEN 6:2
Thadou: Chuin Pathen chapate chun numei hoitah ho chu amu uvin ama hon adei thei lheh jeng uvin, hijeh chun adei dei akilhen uvin ajinu ding in akipui tauvin ahi.
English: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Ka lhagao mihem sunga atonsot kumkho in chengden thei deh ponte, ajeh chu ama tahsaphe bou ahin, ahin nikho jong kum jakhat le kum somni bou hiding ahiye,” ati.
en: The LORD said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”
text:
GEN 6:3
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Ka lhagao mihem sunga atonsot kumkho in chengden thei deh ponte, ajeh chu ama tahsaphe bou ahin, ahin nikho jong kum jakhat le kum somni bou hiding ahiye,” ati.
English: The LORD said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”

tcz: Hiche lai chun leiset chunga Nephilim miho ana um uvin, chujong le Pathen chapate mihem Chanute henga ahunglut nung'u chun amahon jong cha ahin peh tauve; hiche ho chu khanglui laiya mihat te ana hiuvin, chule mi minthang ho chu ana hiuvin ahi.
en: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.
text:
GEN 6:4
Thadou: Hiche lai chun leiset chunga Nephilim miho ana um uvin, chujong le Pathen chapate mihem Chanute henga ahunglut nung'u chun amahon jong cha ahin peh tauve; hiche ho chu khanglui laiya mihat te ana hiuvin, chule mi minthang ho chu ana hiuvin ahi.
English: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

tcz: Pathen in leiset chunga mihem ho setna chu akhol chen jing in, chule Pathen in mihem ho thil phalou agel'u ahi loule lungthima ase abolnom ho'u chu aboncha aphalou jeng ahi chu amu doh tai.
en: The LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.
text:
GEN 6:5
Thadou: Pathen in leiset chunga mihem ho setna chu akhol chen jing in, chule Pathen in mihem ho thil phalou agel'u ahi loule lungthima ase abolnom ho'u chu aboncha aphalou jeng ahi chu amu doh tai.
English: The LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.

tcz: Hichun Pakai Pathenin mihem asem'a leiset chung'a aumsah hatah in akisih tai.
en: The LORD was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.
text:
GEN 6:6
Thadou: Hichun Pakai Pathenin mihem asem'a leiset chung'a aumsah hatah in akisih tai.
English: The LORD was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Keiman kasem doh mihem hohi leiset chunga kon'a kasuh mang ding ahitai, mihem jouse alen aneo, gancha alen aneo tolgo chunga lamjot thei jouse chule chunglam a leng vachate ahi uvin, ajeh chu hicheng pi kana semdoh hi ka kisih lheh tai,” ati.
en: The LORD said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”
text:
GEN 6:7
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Keiman kasem doh mihem hohi leiset chunga kon'a kasuh mang ding ahitai, mihem jouse alen aneo, gancha alen aneo tolgo chunga lamjot thei jouse chule chunglam a leng vachate ahi uvin, ajeh chu hicheng pi kana semdoh hi ka kisih lheh tai,” ati.
English: The LORD said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”
