tcz: Hinlah Noah chun Pathen lungdei lam in aum jing in ahi.
en: But Noah found favor in the LORD’s eyes.
text:
GEN 6:8
Thadou: Hinlah Noah chun Pathen lungdei lam in aum jing in ahi.
English: But Noah found favor in the LORD’s eyes.

tcz: Hiche hi Noah le a insung mite umchan thusim ahiye, Noah chu mi chonpha, hiche khanglai'a chu leichung'a mona neilou va um chu Noah bou anahi, chule Noah chu Pathen toh ki lhakang louhel le Pathen toh kihou mat jing mi ahi.
en: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.
text:
GEN 6:9
Thadou: Hiche hi Noah le a insung mite umchan thusim ahiye, Noah chu mi chonpha, hiche khanglai'a chu leichung'a mona neilou va um chu Noah bou anahi, chule Noah chu Pathen toh ki lhakang louhel le Pathen toh kihou mat jing mi ahi.
English: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

tcz: Noah chun chate thum aneiyin amaho chu ahi le Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahi uve.
en: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
text:
GEN 6:10
Thadou: Noah chun chate thum aneiyin amaho chu ahi le Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahi uve.
English: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in leiset chung ahinven ahile mihem ho phatlou na le kitahlou jeng amudoh tan ahi.
en: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
text:
GEN 6:11
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in leiset chung ahinven ahile mihem ho phatlou na le kitahlou jeng amudoh tan ahi.
English: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

tcz: Pathen in jong thilpha lou jouse le thudih louva vannoi pumpia mihemte khat cheh a jong asetnao chu amudoh sohhel tai.
en: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.
text:
GEN 6:12
Thadou: Pathen in jong thilpha lou jouse le thudih louva vannoi pumpia mihemte khat cheh a jong asetnao chu amudoh sohhel tai.
English: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Noah jah'a aseiyin, “Keiman tua hi hinna neiya avahle thei jouse ka suhmang ding ahi tai. Ajeh chu amaho jeh hin leiset chunga pumhat'a kino na jeng adim tan ahi, vetan kei man abonchauva leiset toh ka suhmang tha ding ahi tauve.
en: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.
text:
GEN 6:13
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in Noah jah'a aseiyin, “Keiman tua hi hinna neiya avahle thei jouse ka suhmang ding ahi tai. Ajeh chu amaho jeh hin leiset chunga pumhat'a kino na jeng adim tan ahi, vetan kei man abonchauva leiset toh ka suhmang tha ding ahi tauve.
English: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.

tcz: Nangman Gopher thingin kong innei lentah khat kisem in lang, kong innei sunga chun indan adan adan in khah tanin, chuteng asung le apo twilut na thei lai jouse na huhbing sohkei ding ahi.
en: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.
text:
GEN 6:14
Thadou: Nangman Gopher thingin kong innei lentah khat kisem in lang, kong innei sunga chun indan adan adan in khah tanin, chuteng asung le apo twilut na thei lai jouse na huhbing sohkei ding ahi.
English: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

tcz: Hiche kong chu tong jali le somnga sao hiding, chule asan dan chu tong somsagi le nga a sang hiding, chule avai lam chu tong somli le nga a len hiding ahi.
en: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
text:
GEN 6:15
Thadou: Hiche kong chu tong jali le somnga sao hiding, chule asan dan chu tong somsagi le nga a sang hiding, chule avai lam chu tong somli le nga a len hiding ahi.
English: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

tcz: Kong innei chu bangkot hong inlang achunglam chu khap somle get in sem inlang kong abanga kotpi hong in lang, indan noi nung danni lhinna, chule dan thum lhinna geiya nasem ding ahi.
en: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.
text:
GEN 6:16
Thadou: Kong innei chu bangkot hong inlang achunglam chu khap somle get in sem inlang kong abanga kotpi hong in lang, indan noi nung danni lhinna, chule dan thum lhinna geiya nasem ding ahi.
English: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

tcz: Tun ven kei man leichung jouse hi twisanglen a ka chupsah ding, hichu ganhing ahai thei jouse ahinkho kalah mang ding ahitai. Chule leichung'a umjouse ka suhmang ding ahi.
en: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is in the earth will die.
text:
GEN 6:17
Thadou: Tun ven kei man leichung jouse hi twisanglen a ka chupsah ding, hichu ganhing ahai thei jouse ahinkho kalah mang ding ahitai. Chule leichung'a umjouse ka suhmang ding ahi.
English: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is in the earth will die.

tcz: Hinlah keiman nangma toh kitep na khat nei ing kating, chujou teng le kongsunga nang nahin, na chapate ahi uvin, najinu chule namou tetoh nabon chauva kong sunga lut tauvin,
en: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.
text:
GEN 6:18
Thadou: Hinlah keiman nangma toh kitep na khat nei ing kating, chujou teng le kongsunga nang nahin, na chapate ahi uvin, najinu chule namou tetoh nabon chauva kong sunga lut tauvin,
English: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

tcz: Chule tahsa neiya hing gamsa namkim anu khat le apa khat cheh in kongsunga hin puilut un, ajeh chu twisang hatah ahung let teng na hinso jou thei nadiu ahi.
en: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.
text:
GEN 6:19
Thadou: Chule tahsa neiya hing gamsa namkim anu khat le apa khat cheh in kongsunga hin puilut un, ajeh chu twisang hatah ahung let teng na hinso jou thei nadiu ahi.
English: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

tcz: Vacha ho akop toni, gancha ho lah a jong ama ama jat dung juiya, tol'a aop'a kithol tho lah a jong ama ama jat dung jui cheh a anu khat le achal khat cheh navah hing dinga nahenga hung kitol lut ding ahi uve.
en: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.
text:
GEN 6:20
Thadou: Vacha ho akop toni, gancha ho lah a jong ama ama jat dung juiya, tol'a aop'a kithol tho lah a jong ama ama jat dung jui cheh a anu khat le achal khat cheh navah hing dinga nahenga hung kitol lut ding ahi uve.
English: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.

tcz: Chule nasuhmil theilou ding chu kong sunga naneh dingu an naneh diu ninglhingset a naki pohlut diu nakikhol khom diu ahi, Ajeh chu hiche an neh dingho chu nangho le gancha hon ding ahi,” ati.
en: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”
text:
GEN 6:21
Thadou: Chule nasuhmil theilou ding chu kong sunga naneh dingu an naneh diu ninglhingset a naki pohlut diu nakikhol khom diu ahi, Ajeh chu hiche an neh dingho chu nangho le gancha hon ding ahi,” ati.
English: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”

tcz: Hichun Noah in jong Pathen in asei peh bang bang in abolpan tan ahi.
en: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.
text:
GEN 6:22
Thadou: Hichun Noah in jong Pathen in asei peh bang bang in abolpan tan ahi.
English: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.

tcz: Chuin ima jouse ahina ding bang ahijou phat in Pathen in Noah chu ahoulim pitai. “Nangma le na insung mite kongsunga lut tauvin ajeh chu leiset chunga mihem holah'a mi chonpha thudih achon nang bou nahi”ati.
en: The LORD said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.
text:
GEN 7:1
Thadou: Chuin ima jouse ahina ding bang ahijou phat in Pathen in Noah chu ahoulim pitai. “Nangma le na insung mite kongsunga lut tauvin ajeh chu leiset chunga mihem holah'a mi chonpha thudih achon nang bou nahi”ati.
English: The LORD said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

tcz: Nangman gancha theng lah a konin kop sagi, kop khat a achal khat le anu khat cheh, chule gancha thenglou lah a kon a jong kop sagi ma kop khat a achal khat le anu khat cheh ki kailut inlang,
en: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.
text:
GEN 7:2
Thadou: Nangman gancha theng lah a konin kop sagi, kop khat a achal khat le anu khat cheh, chule gancha thenglou lah a kon a jong kop sagi ma kop khat a achal khat le anu khat cheh ki kailut inlang,
English: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

tcz: Chule chunga leng vachate lah a jong kop sagi cheh na puilut ding amaho lah a chu achal khat le anu khat akopto cheh ana puilut ding hichengse chu twisang let a kona nahinso thei na dinga navah a chikhai dinga nahing hoi ding ahi.
en: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.
text:
GEN 7:3
Thadou: Chule chunga leng vachate lah a jong kop sagi cheh na puilut ding amaho lah a chu achal khat le anu khat akopto cheh ana puilut ding hichengse chu twisang let a kona nahinso thei na dinga navah a chikhai dinga nahing hoi ding ahi.
English: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

tcz: Ni sagi jouva pat go hatah a leiset chunga ka juhsah pan ding ahitai, chule go chu ni somli le jan somli sunga ka juhsah ding leiset chunga umjouse le ahing thei jouse ka suh mang hel ding ahi tai,”ati.
en: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”
text:
GEN 7:4
Thadou: Ni sagi jouva pat go hatah a leiset chunga ka juhsah pan ding ahitai, chule go chu ni somli le jan somli sunga ka juhsah ding leiset chunga umjouse le ahing thei jouse ka suh mang hel ding ahi tai,”ati.
English: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”

tcz: Hiti chun Noah injong Pathen in athupeh bang bang chun abonchan abolsoh kei tan ahi.
en: Noah did everything that the LORD commanded him.
text:
GEN 7:5
Thadou: Hiti chun Noah injong Pathen in athupeh bang bang chun abonchan abolsoh kei tan ahi.
English: Noah did everything that the LORD commanded him.

tcz: Leiset chunga twisang ahunglet chun Noah chu kum jagup ana lhingtan ahi.
en: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.
text:
GEN 7:6
Thadou: Leiset chunga twisang ahunglet chun Noah chu kum jagup ana lhingtan ahi.
English: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

tcz: Hichun Noah chu achapate toh, ajinu toh, chule amoute toh twisanglen na kon'a ahoidoh theina diuvin kong sunga alut tai.
en: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.
text:
GEN 7:7
Thadou: Hichun Noah chu achapate toh, ajinu toh, chule amoute toh twisanglen na kon'a ahoidoh theina diuvin kong sunga alut tai.
English: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.

tcz: Satheng ho lah a ahin, sa thenglou ho lah a konin jong tol'a kithol thoho lah akonin jong,
en: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground
text:
GEN 7:8
Thadou: Satheng ho lah a ahin, sa thenglou ho lah a konin jong tol'a kithol thoho lah akonin jong,
English: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

tcz: Akop kop a anu khat le achal khat cheh, Pathen in Noah ahoulim pi nabang chun kong sunga chun Noah koma avahlut cheh tauvin ahi.
en: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.
text:
GEN 7:9
Thadou: Akop kop a anu khat le achal khat cheh, Pathen in Noah ahoulim pi nabang chun kong sunga chun Noah koma avahlut cheh tauvin ahi.
English: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

tcz: Chuin ni sagi lhin jou chun twisanglen go ahung ju pantan, leiset chung chu gotwi in achup tai.
en: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.
text:
GEN 7:10
Thadou: Chuin ni sagi lhin jou chun twisanglen go ahung ju pantan, leiset chung chu gotwi in achup tai.
English: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.

tcz: Noah chu kum jagup alhin kum lhani lhin na ah, leinoi ja twi umjouse ahung put tan, chule vanthamjol apat in hatah in go alon tho tai.
en: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.
text:
GEN 7:11
Thadou: Noah chu kum jagup alhin kum lhani lhin na ah, leinoi ja twi umjouse ahung put tan, chule vanthamjol apat in hatah in go alon tho tai.
English: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.

tcz: Ni somli le jan somli sung in go chu tang lou hel'in hatah in ajujom jing tan ahi.
en: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.
text:
GEN 7:12
Thadou: Ni somli le jan somli sung in go chu tang lou hel'in hatah in ajujom jing tan ahi.
English: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

tcz: Hiche nitah chun Noah ahin, Noah chapate Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahi uvin, Noah jinu ahin, amoute thum ahi uvin abonchauvin kong sunga alut tauve.
en: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—
text:
GEN 7:13
Thadou: Hiche nitah chun Noah ahin, Noah chapate Shem, Ham, chule Japheth ahi uvin, Noah jinu ahin, amoute thum ahi uvin abonchauvin kong sunga alut tauve.
English: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—

tcz: Amaho ahi uvin, kong sunga um gamsa hang ahin insa gancha alen aneo chule tol'a aop'a kitholtho ho jong ama ama jat dungjui cheh in, vachate jong ama ama chilhah dungjui a vacha namkim a kon ahiuve.
en: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
text:
GEN 7:14
Thadou: Amaho ahi uvin, kong sunga um gamsa hang ahin insa gancha alen aneo chule tol'a aop'a kitholtho ho jong ama ama jat dungjui cheh in, vachate jong ama ama chilhah dungjui a vacha namkim a kon ahiuve.
English: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

tcz: Akop akop in amaho chu kongsung ahin jon cheh un, hichun avetsah chu ahile hinna neiya tahsa hing ahiuve ti photchet na ahi.
en: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.
text:
GEN 7:15
Thadou: Akop akop in amaho chu kongsung ahin jon cheh un, hichun avetsah chu ahile hinna neiya tahsa hing ahiuve ti photchet na ahi.
English: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.

tcz: Hichu gancha ho lah a anu khat le achal khat ahung lut soh phat un Pathen in Noah atep peh bang chun, Pakai Pathen in kot akhah tai.
en: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then the LORD shut him in.
text:
GEN 7:16
Thadou: Hichu gancha ho lah a anu khat le achal khat ahung lut soh phat un Pathen in Noah atep peh bang chun, Pakai Pathen in kot akhah tai.
English: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then the LORD shut him in.

tcz: Chujouvin ni somli le jan somli sung in hatah in twisanglen chu akhang in leiset chung jouse achup tan, hichun kong chu twi in ahin potou cheh cheh tan leiset sanga sang jon alet dohtai.
en: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.
text:
GEN 7:17
Thadou: Chujouvin ni somli le jan somli sung in hatah in twisanglen chu akhang in leiset chung jouse achup tan, hichun kong chu twi in ahin potou cheh cheh tan leiset sanga sang jon alet dohtai.
English: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

tcz: Twi chu nasa tah in akhang tul tul jeng tan ahile kong chu twi chunga akitol le len ahi.
en: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.
text:
GEN 7:18
Thadou: Twi chu nasa tah in akhang tul tul jeng tan ahile kong chu twi chunga akitol le len ahi.
English: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

tcz: Achaina geiyin twi chun mol jouse lah a asangpen geiyin abonchan achup soh heltai.
en: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.
text:
GEN 7:19
Thadou: Achaina geiyin twi chun mol jouse lah a asangpen geiyin abonchan achup soh heltai.
English: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

tcz: Twi chu akhanbe jing in mol jouse lah a asangpen jong chu tong som ni jen thuh-in achup mang hel tai.
en: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.
text:
GEN 7:20
Thadou: Twi chu akhanbe jing in mol jouse lah a asangpen jong chu tong som ni jen thuh-in achup mang hel tai.
English: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.

tcz: Hijeh chun leiset chunga um ahing thei ahaithei jouse, chunga leng vachate ahin, in na kivah gancha ho ahin, gam'a gamsa ho ahiuvin, ahon hon a kiloiya leiset chung kitol le ganhing namkim ahiuvin chule mihemte geiyin agam soh heltai.
en: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.
text:
GEN 7:21
Thadou: Hijeh chun leiset chunga um ahing thei ahaithei jouse, chunga leng vachate ahin, in na kivah gancha ho ahin, gam'a gamsa ho ahiuvin, ahon hon a kiloiya leiset chung kitol le ganhing namkim ahiuvin chule mihemte geiyin agam soh heltai.
English: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

tcz: Ima jouse leiset chunga um kiti pou anahhom a hinna hu neiya haithei jouse abonchan athi gam soh tan ahi.
en: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.
text:
GEN 7:22
Thadou: Ima jouse leiset chunga um kiti pou anahhom a hinna hu neiya haithei jouse abonchan athi gam soh tan ahi.
English: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

tcz: Pathen in leiset chunga thil ahing thei jouse asumang sohhel tai. Mihem ho jouse, gancha ho, ganhing gamsa ho, tolgo chunga lamjot thei jouse, chunga leng vachate jouse abon'in athi soh hel tai. Ahin hichea sohcha a hing doh Noah le a insung mite chule kong sunga um ganhing anu khat le achal khat um ho bou ahiuve.
en: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.
text:
GEN 7:23
Thadou: Pathen in leiset chunga thil ahing thei jouse asumang sohhel tai. Mihem ho jouse, gancha ho, ganhing gamsa ho, tolgo chunga lamjot thei jouse, chunga leng vachate jouse abon'in athi soh hel tai. Ahin hichea sohcha a hing doh Noah le a insung mite chule kong sunga um ganhing anu khat le achal khat um ho bou ahiuve.
English: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

tcz: Hiche twisanglen chu leiset chung ni jakhat le nisom nga sung achup me.
en: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.
text:
GEN 7:24
Thadou: Hiche twisanglen chu leiset chung ni jakhat le nisom nga sung achup me.
English: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in Noah le gamsa hole gancha ho kong sunga umjouse ageldoh jingin, Leiset chunga huipi hattah ahin nun sahin ahile twisanglen chu ahung kem lheh tai.
en: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.
text:
GEN 8:1
Thadou: Hinlah Pathen in Noah le gamsa hole gancha ho kong sunga umjouse ageldoh jingin, Leiset chunga huipi hattah ahin nun sahin ahile twisanglen chu ahung kem lheh tai.
English: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

tcz: Leinoi lam a twi ho jong along kang tan, chule chunglam a van'a kona go nasa tah a ju jong athip tan ahi.
en: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.
text:
GEN 8:2
Thadou: Leinoi lam a twi ho jong along kang tan, chule chunglam a van'a kona go nasa tah a ju jong athip tan ahi.
English: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

tcz: Hichun twisanglen chu leiset chunga kon in ni jakhat le ni som nga jouvin akang hei hoitan ahi.
en: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.
text:
GEN 8:3
Thadou: Hichun twisanglen chu leiset chunga kon in ni jakhat le ni som nga jouvin akang hei hoitan ahi.
English: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.

tcz: Hiti chun ni somle ni sagi lhinni lha sagi chan na chun kong chu Ararat molchunga ahung kinga tai.
en: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.
text:
GEN 8:4
Thadou: Hiti chun ni somle ni sagi lhinni lha sagi chan na chun kong chu Ararat molchunga ahung kinga tai.
English: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

tcz: Lhani le akeh jouvin twi chu ahung kemtul tul'in mol dang dang ho jong molvum ahung kimu pantan ahi.
en: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.
text:
GEN 8:5
Thadou: Lhani le akeh jouvin twi chu ahung kemtul tul'in mol dang dang ho jong molvum ahung kimu pantan ahi.
English: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.

tcz: Chujouvin ni somli jou chun Noah in huikot kong sunga asem chu ahin hong doh tan,
en: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,
text:
GEN 8:6
Thadou: Chujouvin ni somli jou chun Noah in huikot kong sunga asem chu ahin hong doh tan,
English: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

tcz: Hichun vavom khat alha doh in ahile, leiset chung adung avaiyin aleng len, leiset chunga twi akan loulai jeh'in ahung kinungle kit tai.
en: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.
text:
GEN 8:7
Thadou: Hichun vavom khat alha doh in ahile, leiset chung adung avaiyin aleng len, leiset chunga twi akan loulai jeh'in ahung kinungle kit tai.
English: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

tcz: Chuin Noah in jong leiset chunga twi kang soh tam ti vetna dingin vakhu khat alendoh sah kit'in ahi.
en: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,
text:
GEN 8:8
Thadou: Chuin Noah in jong leiset chunga twi kang soh tam ti vetna dingin vakhu khat alendoh sah kit'in ahi.
English: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

tcz: Hinlah vakhu chu kingah na ding mun amu hihlaiye, Ajeh chu twijin leiset achup nahlai jeh in ahung ki nungle kitin, hichun Noah in vakhu chu akhut a adomlhan asung langa akoi lha kit tai.
en: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.
text:
GEN 8:9
Thadou: Hinlah vakhu chu kingah na ding mun amu hihlaiye, Ajeh chu twijin leiset achup nahlai jeh in ahung ki nungle kitin, hichun Noah in vakhu chu akhut a adomlhan asung langa akoi lha kit tai.
English: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

tcz: Chuin ni sagi akho ngaiyin, chujouvin kong'a kon chun vakhu chu alha doh kit'a ahile,
en: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.
text:
GEN 8:10
Thadou: Chuin ni sagi akho ngaiyin, chujouvin kong'a kon chun vakhu chu alha doh kit'a ahile,
English: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

tcz: Vakhu chu nilhah lang in ama henglam'a ahung kile kit'in, vetau amuh achun athah beh a kiloulha Olive thingna khat ahin pon, hijeh chun Noah in jong leiset chunga twipi akangsoh tai, ti ahedoh pai jin ahi.
en: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.
text:
GEN 8:11
Thadou: Vakhu chu nilhah lang in ama henglam'a ahung kile kit'in, vetau amuh achun athah beh a kiloulha Olive thingna khat ahin pon, hijeh chun Noah in jong leiset chunga twipi akangsoh tai, ti ahedoh pai jin ahi.
English: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

tcz: Chujouvin Noah jong ni sagi ma akho ngai kit'in vakhu chu alha doh kit'in ahile vakhu chu ahung kinung le kit tapoi.
en: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.
text:
GEN 8:12
Thadou: Chujouvin Noah jong ni sagi ma akho ngai kit'in vakhu chu alha doh kit'in ahile vakhu chu ahung kinung le kit tapoi.
English: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.

tcz: Noah hinkho chu kum jagup le kum khatna lha masapen, chu che lha ni masapen ni chun leiset chunga twipi abonchan akang soh heltan, hijeh chun Noah'in jong kong kusin chu ahoh lhan agahven ahile leiset chung chu ana go heltan ahi.
en: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.
text:
GEN 8:13
Thadou: Noah hinkho chu kum jagup le kum khatna lha masapen, chu che lha ni masapen ni chun leiset chunga twipi abonchan akang soh heltan, hijeh chun Noah'in jong kong kusin chu ahoh lhan agahven ahile leiset chung chu ana go heltan ahi.
English: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

tcz: Hiti chun lhani jou don chun leiset chung hoitah in ago hel tai.
en: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
text:
GEN 8:14
Thadou: Hiti chun lhani jou don chun leiset chung hoitah in ago hel tai.
English: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in ahoulimpin hitin ati,
en: God spoke to Noah, saying,
text:
GEN 8:15
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in ahoulimpin hitin ati,
English: God spoke to Noah, saying,

tcz: “Na boncha uvin kong sunga kon chun pot doh tauvin, nangma nahin, na jinu ahin, na chapate ahiuvin, chule na moute ahi uvin kilhon doh pin.
en: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.
text:
GEN 8:16
Thadou: “Na boncha uvin kong sunga kon chun pot doh tauvin, nangma nahin, na jinu ahin, na chapate ahiuvin, chule na moute ahi uvin kilhon doh pin.
English: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

tcz: Tahsa a hing ganhing jouse, naum khompi ho vachate ahi uvin, gancha ho ahi uvin, leiset chunga a op'a kitholtho ho ahiuvin, hiche ho chu leiset letthe thua ahung chikhai uva, ahung hinphat uva chule ahung punjalna ding uvin hinpui doh tan,” ati.
en: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”
text:
GEN 8:17
Thadou: Tahsa a hing ganhing jouse, naum khompi ho vachate ahi uvin, gancha ho ahi uvin, leiset chunga a op'a kitholtho ho ahiuvin, hiche ho chu leiset letthe thua ahung chikhai uva, ahung hinphat uva chule ahung punjalna ding uvin hinpui doh tan,” ati.
English: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

tcz: Hichun Noah ahin, ajinu ahin, achapate ho ahin amoute toh konga kon chun ahung potdoh tai.
en: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.
text:
GEN 8:18
Thadou: Hichun Noah ahin, ajinu ahin, achapate ho ahin amoute toh konga kon chun ahung potdoh tai.
English: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

tcz: Chuin gancha jouse alen aneo abonchauvin vacha ho ahiuvin ni ni in akop kop in anu khat le achal khat konga konin ahung potdoh'un ahi.
en: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.
text:
GEN 8:19
Thadou: Chuin gancha jouse alen aneo abonchauvin vacha ho ahiuvin ni ni in akop kop in anu khat le achal khat konga konin ahung potdoh'un ahi.
English: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.

tcz: Hichun Noah in maicham Pathen henga asemin, hi achun aman kipeh dohna maicham pumgo thilto saho chule vacha ho amaho akipeh doh na dung jui cheh in pumgo thilto ding in agou vam in ahi.
en: Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
text:
GEN 8:20
Thadou: Hichun Noah in maicham Pathen henga asemin, hi achun aman kipeh dohna maicham pumgo thilto saho chule vacha ho amaho akipeh doh na dung jui cheh in pumgo thilto ding in agou vam in ahi.
English: Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

tcz: Chuin anam tui maicham ahung kisem jeh chun Pathen alung lhai lheh jengin hitin ama aki houlim in aseiye, “Mihem jeh in keiman leiset hi gaosap kit tapong'e, ajeh chu mihem lung ngaito him him hi aneocha kipat'a hung gilou pan ahi tai; chule ganhing ka semsa ho jong hi sumang kit tapong'e.
en: The LORD smelled the pleasant aroma. The LORD said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.
text:
GEN 8:21
Thadou: Chuin anam tui maicham ahung kisem jeh chun Pathen alung lhai lheh jengin hitin ama aki houlim in aseiye, “Mihem jeh in keiman leiset hi gaosap kit tapong'e, ajeh chu mihem lung ngaito him him hi aneocha kipat'a hung gilou pan ahi tai; chule ganhing ka semsa ho jong hi sumang kit tapong'e.
English: The LORD smelled the pleasant aroma. The LORD said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.

tcz: Iti nama jongle leiset aum laisen muchi tuphat, chang aat phat, gam dap phat, gamsat phat, nipi lai le phalbi lai, sun laile jan beilou ding ahi,” ati.
en: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”
text:
GEN 8:22
Thadou: Iti nama jongle leiset aum laisen muchi tuphat, chang aat phat, gam dap phat, gamsat phat, nipi lai le phalbi lai, sun laile jan beilou ding ahi,” ati.
English: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Noah le achapate phatthei aboh in hitin ahou limpi in hitin aseiye, “Chale nao hing uvin, pung uvin lang leiset lochan sohkei uvin ati.
en: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
text:
GEN 9:1
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in Noah le achapate phatthei aboh in hitin ahou limpi in hitin aseiye, “Chale nao hing uvin, pung uvin lang leiset lochan sohkei uvin ati.
English: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.

tcz: Leiset chunga um sa jouse ahin chunga leng vachate jouse ahin chule gamsa a op'a kithol tho ho ahiuvin chule twikhanglen'a nga ho ahiuvin abonchauva nangho naki chat cheh dingu ahi, abon chaouva nangho khut na kapeh doh ahi tai.
en: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.
text:
GEN 9:2
Thadou: Leiset chunga um sa jouse ahin chunga leng vachate jouse ahin chule gamsa a op'a kithol tho ho ahiuvin chule twikhanglen'a nga ho ahiuvin abonchauva nangho naki chat cheh dingu ahi, abon chaouva nangho khut na kapeh doh ahi tai.
English: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.

tcz: Ahing theiya avahle thei jouse nangho dinga anneh a pang thei cheh ahiuve, anche louhing kapeh ma banga chu aboncha kapeh doh nahitauve.
en: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.
text:
GEN 9:3
Thadou: Ahing theiya avahle thei jouse nangho dinga anneh a pang thei cheh ahiuve, anche louhing kapeh ma banga chu aboncha kapeh doh nahitauve.
English: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.

tcz: Hinlah nangman naneh thei lou ding chu sahing athisan pum pum a naneh lou beh ding ahi.
en: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.
text:
GEN 9:4
Thadou: Hinlah nangman naneh thei lou ding chu sahing athisan pum pum a naneh lou beh ding ahi.
English: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.

tcz: Hinlah keiman kakhol childing chu koi tabang khat touvin mihem hinkho asuhbeiya thisan asole, itiham khat a gamsan mihem athale hiche gamsa chu thadoh pai ding chule koitabang in mihem hinkho asuh bei leh ama hinkho hi tabang ma achu suhbei ding ahiye.
en: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.
text:
GEN 9:5
Thadou: Hinlah keiman kakhol childing chu koi tabang khat touvin mihem hinkho asuhbeiya thisan asole, itiham khat a gamsan mihem athale hiche gamsa chu thadoh pai ding chule koitabang in mihem hinkho asuh bei leh ama hinkho hi tabang ma achu suhbei ding ahiye.
English: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

tcz: Koitobang in mihem hinkho asuhbei le hiche mihem hinkho sumang pachu ama hinkho jong hi tobang achu kisumang ding ahiye, ajeh chu Pathen in mihem hi ama lim bang banga asem doh ahiye.
en: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.
text:
GEN 9:6
Thadou: Koitobang in mihem hinkho asuhbei le hiche mihem hinkho sumang pachu ama hinkho jong hi tobang achu kisumang ding ahiye, ajeh chu Pathen in mihem hi ama lim bang banga asem doh ahiye.
English: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

tcz: Tuhin nangho hatah in punguvin lang leiset le asung dimset in cha le nao hing uvin lang, pung uvin chule hinlo chan soh kei uvin,” ati.
en: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”
text:
GEN 9:7
Thadou: Tuhin nangho hatah in punguvin lang leiset le asung dimset in cha le nao hing uvin lang, pung uvin chule hinlo chan soh kei uvin,” ati.
English: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Noah le achate ahoulim pin hitin aseiye.
en: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,
text:
GEN 9:8
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in Noah le achate ahoulim pin hitin aseiye.
English: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

tcz: “Kei man kaki tepna avel'in ka sudet nom lheh tai, nangtoh na chilhah te chengse ding injong,
en: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,
text:
GEN 9:9
Thadou: “Kei man kaki tepna avel'in ka sudet nom lheh tai, nangtoh na chilhah te chengse ding injong,
English: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

tcz: Chule gancha nam kim nangma toh kong sunga um chengse toh vacha ho ahin, insa ho ahin, chule gamsa hang ho jouse ahin chule leiset chunga atoi thei avahthei jouseding ahi.
en: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.
text:
GEN 9:10
Thadou: Chule gancha nam kim nangma toh kong sunga um chengse toh vacha ho ahin, insa ho ahin, chule gamsa hang ho jouse ahin chule leiset chunga atoi thei avahthei jouseding ahi.
English: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

tcz: Keiman nangho toh ka kitepna ka phudoh na ajehpen tah chu hiche hi ahi, tahsa a hingho twisanglen a kisumang kit louhel ding ahin, chule leiset suh mang na dinga jong twisang letna um kit louhel ding ahi tai,” ati.
en: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”
text:
GEN 9:11
Thadou: Keiman nangho toh ka kitepna ka phudoh na ajehpen tah chu hiche hi ahi, tahsa a hingho twisanglen a kisumang kit louhel ding ahin, chule leiset suh mang na dinga jong twisang letna um kit louhel ding ahi tai,” ati.
English: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

tcz: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Keiman ka kitepna ka phudoh hi nangho le nalhat khom piu ganhing nam kim ho ahi uvin chule tonsot'a khangguija mite ding ahin, i-kah uva amel chihna hiche hiding ahi.
en: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
text:
GEN 9:12
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Keiman ka kitepna ka phudoh hi nangho le nalhat khom piu ganhing nam kim ho ahi uvin chule tonsot'a khangguija mite ding ahin, i-kah uva amel chihna hiche hiding ahi.
English: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

tcz: Keiman ka semdohsa nisa vah emsel chu vantham jol'a ka koiye, hichu leiset le kei kikah a kitepna khat aum melchihna hiding ahi.
en: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
text:
GEN 9:13
Thadou: Keiman ka semdohsa nisa vah emsel chu vantham jol'a ka koiye, hichu leiset le kei kikah a kitepna khat aum melchihna hiding ahi.
English: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

tcz: Keiman meibol lhang leichunga kahin sol teng nisa vah emsel ho chu meilhang lah a hung kilang ding ahiye.
en: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,
text:
GEN 9:14
Thadou: Keiman meibol lhang leichunga kahin sol teng nisa vah emsel ho chu meilhang lah a hung kilang ding ahiye.
English: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

tcz: Hiche phat le chun keiman nangho le ikah uva ka kitepna chu hingel doh kit ingting, chuteng le gotwi chu tahsa hingte sumang dinga twi sanga hunglen kit lou hel ding ahiye.
en: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
text:
GEN 9:15
Thadou: Hiche phat le chun keiman nangho le ikah uva ka kitepna chu hingel doh kit ingting, chuteng le gotwi chu tahsa hingte sumang dinga twi sanga hunglen kit lou hel ding ahiye.
English: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

tcz: Keiman nisa vah emsel meilhang lah a kamuji tengle Pathen le leiset chunga tahsa a ahing thei jouse kah a tonsot kumkho a dinga kitepna chu kagel doh ding ahi,”ati.
en: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”
text:
GEN 9:16
Thadou: Keiman nisa vah emsel meilhang lah a kamuji tengle Pathen le leiset chunga tahsa a ahing thei jouse kah a tonsot kumkho a dinga kitepna chu kagel doh ding ahi,”ati.
English: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Noah ahoulim pin hitin aseiye, “Hiche hi leiset chunga tahsa ahingthei jouse toh kei kikah a kitepna ka phudoh chu amelchihna hi ding ahi,” ati.
en: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”
text:
GEN 9:17
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in Noah ahoulim pin hitin aseiye, “Hiche hi leiset chunga tahsa ahingthei jouse toh kei kikah a kitepna ka phudoh chu amelchihna hi ding ahi,” ati.
English: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

tcz: Noah chate ho kong sunga kon'a hung potdoh ho chu ahi leh Shem, Ham chule Japhath ahiuve, Ham kiti pa hi Canaan pa ahiye.
en: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.
text:
GEN 9:18
Thadou: Noah chate ho kong sunga kon'a hung potdoh ho chu ahi leh Shem, Ham chule Japhath ahiuve, Ham kiti pa hi Canaan pa ahiye.
English: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.

tcz: Amaho chenghi Noah chate a kona vannoi mihem hung dim ahi.
en: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.
text:
GEN 9:19
Thadou: Amaho chenghi Noah chate a kona vannoi mihem hung dim ahi.
English: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.

tcz: Chuin twisanglet kichai jou chun Noah in tolgo lah achun lou abol pan tan hia chun lengpi phung aphut doh tai.
en: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.
text:
GEN 9:20
Thadou: Chuin twisanglet kichai jou chun Noah in tolgo lah achun lou abol pan tan hia chun lengpi phung aphut doh tai.
English: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

tcz: Chujouvin nikhat chu Noah chun lengpitwi adon in ahile akham tan khoilupon buh sung ah chun asagoh keovin alum tai.
en: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.
text:
GEN 9:21
Thadou: Chujouvin nikhat chu Noah chun lengpitwi adon in ahile akham tan khoilupon buh sung ah chun asagoh keovin alum tai.
English: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

tcz: Ham Canaan pa chun apa Noah sagoh keova aum chu amun apot doh paiyin asopi teni aga het sah in ahile,
en: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.
text:
GEN 9:22
Thadou: Ham Canaan pa chun apa Noah sagoh keova aum chu amun apot doh paiyin asopi teni aga het sah in ahile,
English: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

tcz: Hichun Shem le Japheth in ponsil achoi lhon in alengkouva adom gel lhon a nunglam ngan anung toi lhon in apa akeova um chu agakhu khum lhonin, amai lhon vang ahei manggel lhon in apa akeova um amulhon poi.
en: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.
text:
GEN 9:23
Thadou: Hichun Shem le Japheth in ponsil achoi lhon in alengkouva adom gel lhon a nunglam ngan anung toi lhon in apa akeova um chu agakhu khum lhonin, amai lhon vang ahei manggel lhon in apa akeova um amulhon poi.
English: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

tcz: Noah hichun alupna a kon in ahung khah doh phat in achapa neopen in ana limbol chu ahedoh tai.
en: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.
text:
GEN 9:24
Thadou: Noah hichun alupna a kon in ahung khah doh phat in achapa neopen in ana limbol chu ahedoh tai.
English: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

tcz: Hichun Noah in hitin aseiyin: “Canaan vang gaosap chang hen, Asopi teni henga soh jouse soh in hung pang hen,” atin,
en: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”
text:
GEN 9:25
Thadou: Hichun Noah in hitin aseiyin: “Canaan vang gaosap chang hen, Asopi teni henga soh jouse soh in hung pang hen,” atin,
English: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”

tcz: Hichun Noah in hitin aseiye, “Pathen in Shem phattheiboh mai hen, ahin Canaan vang asopi soh himai hen,
en: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.
text:
GEN 9:26
Thadou: Hichun Noah in hitin aseiye, “Pathen in Shem phattheiboh mai hen, ahin Canaan vang asopi soh himai hen,
English: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.

tcz: Pathen in Japheth gam chu hatah in keh let peh hen, chule Japheth in Shem pon buh sung dunga jong chen sah hen, ahin Canaan vang asopi pa soh hijing mai hen,” ati.
en: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”
text:
GEN 9:27
Thadou: Pathen in Japheth gam chu hatah in keh let peh hen, chule Japheth in Shem pon buh sung dunga jong chen sah hen, ahin Canaan vang asopi pa soh hijing mai hen,” ati.
English: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”

tcz: Twisanglen kichai jouvin Noah chu kum jathum le kum som nga ahing nalaiye.
en: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.
text:
GEN 9:28
Thadou: Twisanglen kichai jouvin Noah chu kum jathum le kum som nga ahing nalaiye.
English: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

tcz: Hitichun Noah hin nikho abon bonin kum jako le kum somnga alhing in, chujouvin ama athi tai.
en: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.
text:
GEN 9:29
Thadou: Hitichun Noah hin nikho abon bonin kum jako le kum somnga alhing in, chujouvin ama athi tai.
English: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.

tcz: Hiche thusim hohi Noah chapate Shem, Ham chule Japheth chilhah thusim chu ahiye; Twisang let jou chun amaho akonin cha tamtah ahung punbe in ahi.
en: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.
text:
GEN 10:1
Thadou: Hiche thusim hohi Noah chapate Shem, Ham chule Japheth chilhah thusim chu ahiye; Twisang let jou chun amaho akonin cha tamtah ahung punbe in ahi.
English: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

tcz: Japheth chilhah ho chu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech chule Tiras ahiuve.
en: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
text:
GEN 10:2
Thadou: Japheth chilhah ho chu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech chule Tiras ahiuve.
English: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

tcz: Gomer chilhah ho chu Ashkenaz, Riphath chule Togarmath ahiuve.
en: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
text:
GEN 10:3
Thadou: Gomer chilhah ho chu Ashkenaz, Riphath chule Togarmath ahiuve.
English: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

tcz: Javan chilhah ho chu Elishah, Kittim, chule Rodanim ahiuve.
en: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
text:
GEN 10:4
Thadou: Javan chilhah ho chu Elishah, Kittim, chule Rodanim ahiuve.
English: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

tcz: Hiche apat chun amaho chilhah chengse chu leiset ahin toupha pan tauvin ama ama hithei na leh aphung achang akaidol chehin ama nam hina dol chehin acheng tauvin ahi.
en: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.
text:
GEN 10:5
Thadou: Hiche apat chun amaho chilhah chengse chu leiset ahin toupha pan tauvin ama ama hithei na leh aphung achang akaidol chehin ama nam hina dol chehin acheng tauvin ahi.
English: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

tcz: Ham chilhah ho chu Cush, Mizraim, Put, chule Canaan ahiuve.
en: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
text:
GEN 10:6
Thadou: Ham chilhah ho chu Cush, Mizraim, Put, chule Canaan ahiuve.
English: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

tcz: Cush chilhah ho chu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, chule Sabteca ahiuve.
en: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
text:
GEN 10:7
Thadou: Cush chilhah ho chu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, chule Sabteca ahiuve.
English: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

tcz: Cush kitipa hin leiset chunga mihat ahung pang masapen Nimrod chu ahing'in ahi.
en: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
text:
GEN 10:8
Thadou: Cush kitipa hin leiset chunga mihat ahung pang masapen Nimrod chu ahing'in ahi.
English: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

tcz: Hiche phat laiya chu vannoiya gamlen hat sakap them pen ahung hin, chule Pathen ging tah mi jong ana hi'e, hijeh chun mihon Nimrod banga gamlen hat sakapthem pen ahi tin aseiuve.
en: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.
text:
GEN 10:9
Thadou: Hiche phat laiya chu vannoiya gamlen hat sakap them pen ahung hin, chule Pathen ging tah mi jong ana hi'e, hijeh chun mihon Nimrod banga gamlen hat sakapthem pen ahi tin aseiuve.
English: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.

tcz: Hichun Cush chun alenggam chu Babylon khopi sunga Babylonia tin ahin semdoh'in, hiche khopi ho chu Erech, Akkad, chule Calneh ahiuve.
en: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
text:
GEN 10:10
Thadou: Hichun Cush chun alenggam chu Babylon khopi sunga Babylonia tin ahin semdoh'in, hiche khopi ho chu Erech, Akkad, chule Calneh ahiuve.
English: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

tcz: Aman hiche akon chun Assyria ajonin hikom achun Nineveh khopi aphut doh in aban'a Rehobothir khopi ahin Calah khopi jong ahin phut doh kit e.
en: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
text:
GEN 10:11
Thadou: Aman hiche akon chun Assyria ajonin hikom achun Nineveh khopi aphut doh in aban'a Rehobothir khopi ahin Calah khopi jong ahin phut doh kit e.
English: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

tcz: Chuban chun Nineveh le Calah khopi teni kikah achun Resen khopi aphut doh in khopi lentah ahi.
en: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.
text:
GEN 10:12
Thadou: Chuban chun Nineveh le Calah khopi teni kikah achun Resen khopi aphut doh in khopi lentah ahi.
English: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

tcz: Mizraim chu Ludite, Anamite, Naphuhite chule Lehabite ho cheng pa ahi.
en: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
text:
GEN 10:13
Thadou: Mizraim chu Ludite, Anamite, Naphuhite chule Lehabite ho cheng pa ahi.
English: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

tcz: Pathrusim ho, Casluhim ho, chule Caphtorim ho a kon a chu Philistine te hung kon dohna chu ahi.
en: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.
text:
GEN 10:14
Thadou: Pathrusim ho, Casluhim ho, chule Caphtorim ho a kon a chu Philistine te hung kon dohna chu ahi.
English: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

tcz: Canaan chapa tahpen chu Sidon, Sidon chilhah te hung kon dohna ho chu ahiuvin chule Hit chilhah ho jong Canaan akon ahiuve.
en: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,
text:
GEN 10:15
Thadou: Canaan chapa tahpen chu Sidon, Sidon chilhah te hung kon dohna ho chu ahiuvin chule Hit chilhah ho jong Canaan akon ahiuve.
English: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

tcz: Jebus ho, Amor ho, Girgash ho ahin,
en: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
text:
GEN 10:16
Thadou: Jebus ho, Amor ho, Girgash ho ahin,
English: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

tcz: Hivi teho, Arki ho, Sin ho ahin,
en: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
text:
GEN 10:17
Thadou: Hivi teho, Arki ho, Sin ho ahin,
English: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

tcz: Arvad ho, Zemar ho, chule Hamath ho jouse hi ama hinsa cheh ahiuve, ahin khonung in Canaan insung kon mite chu gamtina akithe cheh soh kei uvin ahi.
en: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.
text:
GEN 10:18
Thadou: Arvad ho, Zemar ho, chule Hamath ho jouse hi ama hinsa cheh ahiuve, ahin khonung in Canaan insung kon mite chu gamtina akithe cheh soh kei uvin ahi.
English: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

tcz: Hiche apat chun Canaan gamgi chu Sidonna pat Gerar lang jonin Gaza geiyin aki lhung lut peh in, Sodom lang jon in aki lhung in, Gomorrah aphan, Admah ahin phan, chule Zeboiim ahop in Lasha geiyin akilhung lut peh-e.
en: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.
text:
GEN 10:19
Thadou: Hiche apat chun Canaan gamgi chu Sidonna pat Gerar lang jonin Gaza geiyin aki lhung lut peh in, Sodom lang jon in aki lhung in, Gomorrah aphan, Admah ahin phan, chule Zeboiim ahop in Lasha geiyin akilhung lut peh-e.
English: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

tcz: Amaho cheng hi Ham chilhah ho ahi uvin, ama ama insung dungjuile, apao dung juile, agam dung jui chuleh ajat dung jui uva ahiye.
en: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.
text:
GEN 10:20
Thadou: Amaho cheng hi Ham chilhah ho ahi uvin, ama ama insung dungjuile, apao dung juile, agam dung jui chuleh ajat dung jui uva ahiye.
English: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

tcz: Shem chate pasal ho jouse apunbe in ama chu Japheth upa ahin, Ebel chilhah ho jouse hi Shem'a kona hung kon doh cheh ahiuve.
en: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.
text:
GEN 10:21
Thadou: Shem chate pasal ho jouse apunbe in ama chu Japheth upa ahin, Ebel chilhah ho jouse hi Shem'a kona hung kon doh cheh ahiuve.
English: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

tcz: Shem chilhah ho chu ahile Elam, Asshur, Arphaxed, Lud chule Ram ahiuve.
en: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
text:
GEN 10:22
Thadou: Shem chilhah ho chu ahile Elam, Asshur, Arphaxed, Lud chule Ram ahiuve.
English: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

tcz: Ram chilhah ho chu ahile Uz, Hul, Gether, chule Mash ahiuve.
en: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
text:
GEN 10:23
Thadou: Ram chilhah ho chu ahile Uz, Hul, Gether, chule Mash ahiuve.
English: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

tcz: Arphaxad chu Shelah pa ahin, chule Shelah chu Ebel pa ahiye.
en: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.
text:
GEN 10:24
Thadou: Arphaxad chu Shelah pa ahin, chule Shelah chu Ebel pa ahiye.
English: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

tcz: Ebel chun cha ni aneiyin amasa pachu Peleg (Hichu kisuh khenna tina ahi) ahi, Ijeh inem itile ama phatlai a chu vannoi chu ama ama paotho doh dungjuiya ahung umdoh laitah chu ahi, chule asopipa min chu Joktan ahi.
en: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
text:
GEN 10:25
Thadou: Ebel chun cha ni aneiyin amasa pachu Peleg (Hichu kisuh khenna tina ahi) ahi, Ijeh inem itile ama phatlai a chu vannoi chu ama ama paotho doh dungjuiya ahung umdoh laitah chu ahi, chule asopipa min chu Joktan ahi.
English: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

tcz: Joktan chapa chu Almodad ahin, Sheleph ahin, Hazarmaveth ahin, Jerah ahin,
en: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
text:
GEN 10:26
Thadou: Joktan chapa chu Almodad ahin, Sheleph ahin, Hazarmaveth ahin, Jerah ahin,
English: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

tcz: Hadoram ahin, Uzal ahin, Diklah ahin,
en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
text:
GEN 10:27
Thadou: Hadoram ahin, Uzal ahin, Diklah ahin,
English: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

tcz: Obal ahin, Abimael ahin, Sheba ahin,
en: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
text:
GEN 10:28
Thadou: Obal ahin, Abimael ahin, Sheba ahin,
English: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

tcz: Ophir ahin, Havilah ahin chule Jobab ahiuve. Amaho chengse hin Joktan chilhah cheh ahi uve.
en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
text:
GEN 10:29
Thadou: Ophir ahin, Havilah ahin chule Jobab ahiuve. Amaho chengse hin Joktan chilhah cheh ahi uve.
English: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

tcz: Ama hon gam ki-vaipohna atoupha u-chu Mesha apat'in Sephar lang jonin ahung kilhung in, nisolam'a thinglhang gamsung geiyin ahung kilhunglut peh-in ahi.
en: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
text:
GEN 10:30
Thadou: Ama hon gam ki-vaipohna atoupha u-chu Mesha apat'in Sephar lang jonin ahung kilhung in, nisolam'a thinglhang gamsung geiyin ahung kilhunglut peh-in ahi.
English: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

tcz: Amaho jouse hi Shem chilhah ahi uvin, a phungle achang, a pao tho'u dung jui le, agam dung jui le, ajat dungjui uva Shem chilhah te ahi uve.
en: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.
text:
GEN 10:31
Thadou: Amaho jouse hi Shem chilhah ahi uvin, a phungle achang, a pao tho'u dung jui le, agam dung jui le, ajat dungjui uva Shem chilhah te ahi uve.
English: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

tcz: Hiche phungle chang hung kimin phah se hi Noah chate a kon'a chi le nam hung kisem doh ama gui penna dung juiya vannoiya nam jouse hi hiche phungpi a kon'a twisanglet jouva patna hung um doh ahi.
en: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood.
text:
GEN 10:32
Thadou: Hiche phungle chang hung kimin phah se hi Noah chate a kon'a chi le nam hung kisem doh ama gui penna dung juiya vannoiya nam jouse hi hiche phungpi a kon'a twisanglet jouva patna hung um doh ahi.
English: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood.

tcz: Phatkhat lai tah chun vannoiya mihem jousen pao khat bou ana tho uvin, apao cheng manu jong tha khat cheh ana hi.
en: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
text:
GEN 11:1
Thadou: Phatkhat lai tah chun vannoiya mihem jousen pao khat bou ana tho uvin, apao cheng manu jong tha khat cheh ana hi.
English: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

tcz: Hiche lai chun miho chu nisolama konin ahung kichon uvin ahile Shinar gamsunga chun phaicham mun ong lentah ahin mudoh uvin, hikoma chun acheng tauve.
en: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.
text:
GEN 11:2
Thadou: Hiche lai chun miho chu nisolama konin ahung kichon uvin ahile Shinar gamsunga chun phaicham mun ong lentah ahin mudoh uvin, hikoma chun acheng tauve.
English: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

tcz: Hichun ama ho khat le khat aki hou un, “Eihon cheh gadengu hitin goutah lheng'u hite,” akiti uvin; hiti chun song panna pang dingin cheh amang uvin, songlou dingin leingan amang uve.
en: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.
text:
GEN 11:3
Thadou: Hichun ama ho khat le khat aki hou un, “Eihon cheh gadengu hitin goutah lheng'u hite,” akiti uvin; hiti chun song panna pang dingin cheh amang uvin, songlou dingin leingan amang uve.
English: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

tcz: Hichun amahon hitin aseiuve, “Hung un eihon khopi khat kisah uhitin, chule in sangtah khat a tingvum vantoh kibang khat sadoh uhitin, vannoiya imin'u ki thansah uhite, achuti loule leiset chunga iki moh thethang gam ding'u ahi,” atiuve.
en: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”
text:
GEN 11:4
Thadou: Hichun amahon hitin aseiuve, “Hung un eihon khopi khat kisah uhitin, chule in sangtah khat a tingvum vantoh kibang khat sadoh uhitin, vannoiya imin'u ki thansah uhite, achuti loule leiset chunga iki moh thethang gam ding'u ahi,” atiuve.
English: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

tcz: Hinlah Pakai Pathen chu mihemten khopi asah'u le insang asah doh'u veding in Pakai ahung kumlha tai.
en: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.
text:
GEN 11:5
Thadou: Hinlah Pakai Pathen chu mihemten khopi asah'u le insang asah doh'u veding in Pakai ahung kumlha tai.
English: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

tcz: Hichun Pakai Pathen in aseiye, “Vetan mipiho hi aki pumkhat thei lheh jeng uvin chule pao khatseh bou atho uvin, hijeh chun phat chomkhat jou teng le amaho hin ipi hijongle abolgot ho u-chu ajo lel lou beh dingu ahi.
en: The LORD said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.
text:
GEN 11:6
Thadou: Hichun Pakai Pathen in aseiye, “Vetan mipiho hi aki pumkhat thei lheh jeng uvin chule pao khatseh bou atho uvin, hijeh chun phat chomkhat jou teng le amaho hin ipi hijongle abolgot ho u-chu ajo lel lou beh dingu ahi.
English: The LORD said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

tcz: Hijeh chun hung un eiho ga kumsuh'u hitin apao'u ga suhkhen peh uhite, chutile khat le khat athusei kihet mon um tauvinte,” ati.
en: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”
text:
GEN 11:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun hung un eiho ga kumsuh'u hitin apao'u ga suhkhen peh uhite, chutile khat le khat athusei kihet mon um tauvinte,” ati.
English: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

tcz: Hiti chun Pakai Pathen in leiset chung ah abon uvin, athe cheh soh hel'in hiche apat'a chu khopi insah chu hung bouiya ahiuve.
en: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.
text:
GEN 11:8
Thadou: Hiti chun Pakai Pathen in leiset chung ah abon uvin, athe cheh soh hel'in hiche apat'a chu khopi insah chu hung bouiya ahiuve.
English: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

tcz: Hijeh a chu hiche kopi insang kisah chu Babel kiti ahi, ajeh chu Pathen in mipi ho lung asuhboui a paochom paochom athosah ahi tia hi Pathen in vannoiya ana thecheh'u ahi.
en: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth. From there, the LORD scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.
text:
GEN 11:9
Thadou: Hijeh a chu hiche kopi insang kisah chu Babel kiti ahi, ajeh chu Pathen in mipi ho lung asuhboui a paochom paochom athosah ahi tia hi Pathen in vannoiya ana thecheh'u ahi.
English: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth. From there, the LORD scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

tcz: Hiche hi Shem insung mite thusim ahi e. Twisang let kum ni jouvin Shem chu atahsa kum jakhat alhing in achapa Arpachshad chu ahing'e;
en: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

tcz: Arpachshad apen jou chun Shem chu kum ja nga ahingin, hichun aman cha numei le pasal tamtah ahinbei.
en: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 11:11
Thadou: Arpachshad apen jou chun Shem chu kum ja nga ahingin, hichun aman cha numei le pasal tamtah ahinbei.
English: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

tcz: Hichun Arpachshad chu kum som thumle kum nga alhin in ama chu Shelah pa ahung hitan ahi.
en: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.
text:
GEN 11:12
Thadou: Hichun Arpachshad chu kum som thumle kum nga alhin in ama chu Shelah pa ahung hitan ahi.
English: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

tcz: Shelah ahung pen jouchun Arpachshad chu kum jali le kum thum ahingin, chuin aman cha pasal le numei tamtah ahinbei.
en: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 11:13
Thadou: Shelah ahung pen jouchun Arpachshad chu kum jali le kum thum ahingin, chuin aman cha pasal le numei tamtah ahinbei.
English: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

tcz: Shelah kum som thum alhin in ama chu Eber pen na pa ahung hitai.
en: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.
text:
GEN 11:14
Thadou: Shelah kum som thum alhin in ama chu Eber pen na pa ahung hitai.
English: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.

tcz: Eber pen jou chun, Shelah chu kum jali le kum thum ahinbe in chuin cha pasal le cha numei jong ahin be nalaiye.
en: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 11:15
Thadou: Eber pen jou chun, Shelah chu kum jali le kum thum ahinbe in chuin cha pasal le cha numei jong ahin be nalaiye.
English: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

tcz: Eber kum som thumle kum nga alhin in ama chu Peleg pa ahung hi tan ahi.
en: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.
text:
GEN 11:16
Thadou: Eber kum som thumle kum nga alhin in ama chu Peleg pa ahung hi tan ahi.
English: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

tcz: Peleg pen jou chun Eber chu kum jali le kum somthum ahing nalaiyin, hiche jou chun aman cha pasal le cha numei tamtah ahinbe nalaiye.
en: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 11:17
Thadou: Peleg pen jou chun Eber chu kum jali le kum somthum ahing nalaiyin, hiche jou chun aman cha pasal le cha numei tamtah ahinbe nalaiye.
English: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

tcz: Peleg chu kum som thum alhinin, ama chu Reu pa ahung hitan ahi.
en: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.
text:
GEN 11:18
Thadou: Peleg chu kum som thum alhinin, ama chu Reu pa ahung hitan ahi.
English: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

tcz: Reu pen jou nung in Peleg chu kum jani le kum ko ahin be nalaiyin, cha pasal le cha numei tamtah ahin be nalaiye.
en: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 11:19
Thadou: Reu pen jou nung in Peleg chu kum jani le kum ko ahin be nalaiyin, cha pasal le cha numei tamtah ahin be nalaiye.
English: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

tcz: Reu chu kum som thumle kum ni bou alhinin Serug pen na pa ahung hitai.
en: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.
text:
GEN 11:20
Thadou: Reu chu kum som thumle kum ni bou alhinin Serug pen na pa ahung hitai.
English: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

tcz: Serug pen jou chun, Reu chu kum jani le kum sagi ahinbe nalaiyin, hiche jouchun aman cha pasal le cha numei tamtah anei be nalaiye.
en: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 11:21
Thadou: Serug pen jou chun, Reu chu kum jani le kum sagi ahinbe nalaiyin, hiche jouchun aman cha pasal le cha numei tamtah anei be nalaiye.
English: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

tcz: Serug kiti pachu kum som thum bou alhinin Nahor pa ahung hitai.
en: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.
text:
GEN 11:22
Thadou: Serug kiti pachu kum som thum bou alhinin Nahor pa ahung hitai.
English: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

tcz: Nahor pen jou chun Serug chu kum jani ahinbe nalaiyin, hiche jou chun aman cha pasal le cha numei phachompi ahinbe nalaiye.
en: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 11:23
Thadou: Nahor pen jou chun Serug chu kum jani ahinbe nalaiyin, hiche jou chun aman cha pasal le cha numei phachompi ahinbe nalaiye.
English: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

tcz: Nahor chu kum som ni le kum ko bou alhin in Terah apeng tai.
en: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.
text:
GEN 11:24
Thadou: Nahor chu kum som ni le kum ko bou alhin in Terah apeng tai.
English: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

tcz: Terah pen jou chun Nahol chu kum jakhat le kum som le kum ko ahing nalaiyin, hichun aman cha pasal le cha numei simsen lou ahinbe nalaiye.
en: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
text:
GEN 11:25
Thadou: Terah pen jou chun Nahol chu kum jakhat le kum som le kum ko ahing nalaiyin, hichun aman cha pasal le cha numei simsen lou ahinbe nalaiye.
English: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

tcz: Terah vang chu kum som sagi jen ahung lhinin Abram, Nahor, chule Haran ahin hingin ahi.
en: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
text:
GEN 11:26
Thadou: Terah vang chu kum som sagi jen ahung lhinin Abram, Nahor, chule Haran ahin hingin ahi.
English: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

tcz: Hiche hi Terahte thusim kisei ahi. Terah chun Abram, Nahor, chule Haran pa ahin, chule Haran chu Lot pa ahiye.
en: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.
text:
GEN 11:27
Thadou: Hiche hi Terahte thusim kisei ahi. Terah chun Abram, Nahor, chule Haran pa ahin, chule Haran chu Lot pa ahiye.
English: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

tcz: Ahin Haran chu apa Terah thi masang in, apenna Chaldeans gam'a Ur khopi achun athitai.
en: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.
text:
GEN 11:28
Thadou: Ahin Haran chu apa Terah thi masang in, apenna Chaldeans gam'a Ur khopi achun athitai.
English: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.

tcz: Ahin chutobang lai chun Abram le Nahor chun ji anei gel lhon in, Abram jinu min chu Sarai ahin, Nahor jinu min chu ahile Milcah ahin, Haran chanu ahiye; (Milcah le a sopi nu Iscah chu Nahor sopi pa Haran Chanute ahi lhon e).
en: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.
text:
GEN 11:29
Thadou: Ahin chutobang lai chun Abram le Nahor chun ji anei gel lhon in, Abram jinu min chu Sarai ahin, Nahor jinu min chu ahile Milcah ahin, Haran chanu ahiye; (Milcah le a sopi nu Iscah chu Nahor sopi pa Haran Chanute ahi lhon e).
English: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.

tcz: Ahin Sarai chu aching in naovop thei louvin cha hing lou vin aum tai.
en: Sarai was barren. She had no child.
text:
GEN 11:30
Thadou: Ahin Sarai chu aching in naovop thei louvin cha hing lou vin aum tai.
English: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

tcz: Nikhat Terah chun achapa Abram le amounu Sarai chule Haran chapa atupa Lot akipuiyin abonchauvin Chaldea gam khopi Ur a kon chun Canaan gam jon ding in ache tauve; Ahin Haran khopi ahin phah phat uvin hiche muna chun acheng den tauve.
en: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.
text:
GEN 11:31
Thadou: Nikhat Terah chun achapa Abram le amounu Sarai chule Haran chapa atupa Lot akipuiyin abonchauvin Chaldea gam khopi Ur a kon chun Canaan gam jon ding in ache tauve; Ahin Haran khopi ahin phah phat uvin hiche muna chun acheng den tauve.
English: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

tcz: Hichun Terah hinkho chu kum jani le kum nga alhing in, chujou vin Haran khoa chun Terah athi den tai.
en: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.
text:
GEN 11:32
Thadou: Hichun Terah hinkho chu kum jani le kum nga alhing in, chujou vin Haran khoa chun Terah athi den tai.
English: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

tcz: Pathen in Abram chu ana houlimpi in “Nagam, na insung mite, na sopiho chule napa sopi ho dalhan keiman gamthah ka musah ding khu jon tan,” ati.
en: Now the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.
text:
GEN 12:1
Thadou: Pathen in Abram chu ana houlimpi in “Nagam, na insung mite, na sopiho chule napa sopi ho dalhan keiman gamthah ka musah ding khu jon tan,” ati.
