en: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac said to him, “Because I said, ‘Lest I die because of her.’”
text:
GEN 26:9
Thadou: Hichun gang tah in Abimelech in Isaac chu akouvin, “Amanu chu na jinu hilou ham? ibola amanu chu ka sopinu ahe tia nasei ham?” Isaac in adonbut in, “Ka seina ajeh chu ahile ka innneipi jeh a koi tabang khat in eitha lo ding ham kati ahi.”
English: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac said to him, “Because I said, ‘Lest I die because of her.’”

tcz: Abimelech in aseiye, “Ipi dinga hiti pia chu neibol'u hitam? ilou themkhat in ka mite lah a khat touvin na jinu chu ana kipui hen ana luppi kha ta hen lang hileh nangma jeh a kei hon chonset lentah a neilhah sah ding'u hita chula em.”
en: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”
text:
GEN 26:10
Thadou: Abimelech in aseiye, “Ipi dinga hiti pia chu neibol'u hitam? ilou themkhat in ka mite lah a khat touvin na jinu chu ana kipui hen ana luppi kha ta hen lang hileh nangma jeh a kei hon chonset lentah a neilhah sah ding'u hita chula em.”
English: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”

tcz: Hichun Abimelech in danpi khat asem in mipi jouse henga aphong doh in ahi, “Koihi jong leh hiche mipa hihen ajinu hijong le ahin tongkha asuse aum leh thina chan a gotna kipe ding ahi.”
en: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”
text:
GEN 26:11
Thadou: Hichun Abimelech in danpi khat asem in mipi jouse henga aphong doh in ahi, “Koihi jong leh hiche mipa hihen ajinu hijong le ahin tongkha asuse aum leh thina chan a gotna kipe ding ahi.”
English: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”

tcz: Hiche kum chun Isaac in muchi akitun ahile kum dang sang in ajat jakhat val jena tamjon aki-aat e, hiti chun Pakaiyin ama phatthei ana boh'e.
en: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. The LORD blessed him.
text:
GEN 26:12
Thadou: Hiche kum chun Isaac in muchi akitun ahile kum dang sang in ajat jakhat val jena tamjon aki-aat e, hiti chun Pakaiyin ama phatthei ana boh'e.
English: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. The LORD blessed him.

tcz: Chua kon chun Isaac chu neile gou in ahung hao doh tan, anei le agou hatah in apun be cheh, apun be cheh jeng in ahi.
en: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.
text:
GEN 26:13
Thadou: Chua kon chun Isaac chu neile gou in ahung hao doh tan, anei le agou hatah in apun be cheh, apun be cheh jeng in ahi.
English: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.

tcz: Hitobang chun neile gou keu hilouvin kelngoi jong, keltah jong, bonghon jong chule soh le kol jong tamtah ahin neitan, hiche ho jeh hin Phalistine miten nasatah in ahung engse tauvin ahi.
en: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.
text:
GEN 26:14
Thadou: Hitobang chun neile gou keu hilouvin kelngoi jong, keltah jong, bonghon jong chule soh le kol jong tamtah ahin neitan, hiche ho jeh hin Phalistine miten nasatah in ahung engse tauvin ahi.
English: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.

tcz: Hichun Phalistine miho chu athangthip jeh'un Isaac twikhuh jouse chu abonchan asuhbing peh tauvin ahi. Hiche twikhuh ho sese hi apa Abraham adamlaiya asohten ana laihou chu ahi.
en: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.
text:
GEN 26:15
Thadou: Hichun Phalistine miho chu athangthip jeh'un Isaac twikhuh jouse chu abonchan asuhbing peh tauvin ahi. Hiche twikhuh ho sese hi apa Abraham adamlaiya asohten ana laihou chu ahi.
English: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.

tcz: Chuin Abimelech in achaina in Isaac komma aseiye, “Nangma keiho komma kon in chedoh tan ajeh chu nangma keiho sang in natha lhing jotai,” ati.
en: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”
text:
GEN 26:16
Thadou: Chuin Abimelech in achaina in Isaac komma aseiye, “Nangma keiho komma kon in chedoh tan ajeh chu nangma keiho sang in natha lhing jotai,” ati.
English: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”

tcz: Hichun Isaac chu amaho komma kon in achen Gerar phaicham ah amaho ponbuh akison uvin hiche mun achun aching tauve.
en: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.
text:
GEN 26:17
Thadou: Hichun Isaac chu amaho komma kon in achen Gerar phaicham ah amaho ponbuh akison uvin hiche mun achun aching tauve.
English: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.

tcz: Chuin Isaac in Apa Abraham thi jouva Palestine mipiten ana huhbing peh'u twikhuh ho sese chu alai hong kit'in apa Abraham'in ana minsah twikhuh min ho chu avel sah kit in asem hoisah kit tai.
en: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
text:
GEN 26:18
Thadou: Chuin Isaac in Apa Abraham thi jouva Palestine mipiten ana huhbing peh'u twikhuh ho sese chu alai hong kit'in apa Abraham'in ana minsah twikhuh min ho chu avel sah kit in asem hoisah kit tai.
English: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

tcz: Isaac sohten Gerar phaicham chu twikhuh alai uva ahile twisam phungkhat alai doh tauve.
en: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing water.
text:
GEN 26:19
Thadou: Isaac sohten Gerar phaicham chu twikhuh alai uva ahile twisam phungkhat alai doh tauve.
English: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing water.

tcz: Ahin Gerar gamma kelngoi chinghon Isaac kelngoi chingho komma chun “hiche twikhuh hi keiho twikhuh ahi,” atiuvin a kinelpi tauvin ahi; hichun Isaac in hiche twikhuh chu “Esek” asah'in hichun avetsah chu “Kiboina mun,” tina ahi.
en: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” So he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.
text:
GEN 26:20
Thadou: Ahin Gerar gamma kelngoi chinghon Isaac kelngoi chingho komma chun “hiche twikhuh hi keiho twikhuh ahi,” atiuvin a kinelpi tauvin ahi; hichun Isaac in hiche twikhuh chu “Esek” asah'in hichun avetsah chu “Kiboina mun,” tina ahi.
English: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” So he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.

tcz: Hichun Isaac sohten twikhuh chom dang khat alai kit'un ahile hiche mun jong chu boina ahung um kittan hichun Isaac in “Sitnah” (Tichu kitomona mun tina ahi) asah tan ahi.
en: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. So he called its name Sitnah.
text:
GEN 26:21
Thadou: Hichun Isaac sohten twikhuh chom dang khat alai kit'un ahile hiche mun jong chu boina ahung um kittan hichun Isaac in “Sitnah” (Tichu kitomona mun tina ahi) asah tan ahi.
English: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. So he called its name Sitnah.

tcz: Chuin Isaac in hiche mun chu adalhan akichon in twikhuh chom beh khat alai kit in ahile hiche mun a vang chun akinahpi tapouvin ahi, hijeh chun Isaac in hiche mun chu “Rehoboth” asah tai. “Ajeh chu tun vang Pathen in eiho ding in gam eihon peh tauve, agamsung ahin eiho cha le nao vin pungjal tauhite,” ati.
en: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. So he called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now the LORD has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”
text:
GEN 26:22
Thadou: Chuin Isaac in hiche mun chu adalhan akichon in twikhuh chom beh khat alai kit in ahile hiche mun a vang chun akinahpi tapouvin ahi, hijeh chun Isaac in hiche mun chu “Rehoboth” asah tai. “Ajeh chu tun vang Pathen in eiho ding in gam eihon peh tauve, agamsung ahin eiho cha le nao vin pungjal tauhite,” ati.
English: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. So he called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now the LORD has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”

tcz: Hiche mun a pat chun Isaac in Beersheba ah akichon kittai.
en: He went up from there to Beersheba.
text:
GEN 26:23
Thadou: Hiche mun a pat chun Isaac in Beersheba ah akichon kittai.
English: He went up from there to Beersheba.

tcz: Hiche jan lele chun Isaac henga Pathen ahung kilah in “Keima napa Abraham Pathen chu kahi, Imacha gichat na nei hih behin ajeh chu keiman nangma ka umpi jing nai, chule phatthei ka boh ding nahi, nason nachilhah te jong hatah a ka punsah ding amaho nam lentah ka soding ahi. Hiche hohi kasuh bulhing ding ahi. Ajeh chu ka sohpa Abraham koma kana kitep nasa ahi.”
en: The LORD appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”
text:
GEN 26:24
Thadou: Hiche jan lele chun Isaac henga Pathen ahung kilah in “Keima napa Abraham Pathen chu kahi, Imacha gichat na nei hih behin ajeh chu keiman nangma ka umpi jing nai, chule phatthei ka boh ding nahi, nason nachilhah te jong hatah a ka punsah ding amaho nam lentah ka soding ahi. Hiche hohi kasuh bulhing ding ahi. Ajeh chu ka sohpa Abraham koma kana kitep nasa ahi.”
English: The LORD appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”

tcz: Hichun Isaac in hiche mun achun maicham asem in Pathen ahou tai, chule aman aponbuh jong asongdoh kit in asohten twikhuh khat alaikit un ahi.
en: He built an altar there, and called on the LORD’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.
text:
GEN 26:25
Thadou: Hichun Isaac in hiche mun achun maicham asem in Pathen ahou tai, chule aman aponbuh jong asongdoh kit in asohten twikhuh khat alaikit un ahi.
English: He built an altar there, and called on the LORD’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.

tcz: Ni khat chu Abimelech jong Gerar gamma pat na semangpa Ahuzzath chule asepai lamkai Phicol akipuiyin Isaac to kimuto dingin ahungtai.
en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.
text:
GEN 26:26
Thadou: Ni khat chu Abimelech jong Gerar gamma pat na semangpa Ahuzzath chule asepai lamkai Phicol akipuiyin Isaac to kimuto dingin ahungtai.
English: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.

tcz: Isaac in amaho chu adong in, “Ipi dinga ka henga hung nahiuven nei vetda uva nagam uva patna neino doh hitalou ham?” ana ti.
en: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”
text:
GEN 26:27
Thadou: Isaac in amaho chu adong in, “Ipi dinga ka henga hung nahiuven nei vetda uva nagam uva patna neino doh hitalou ham?” ana ti.
English: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”

tcz: Ama hon adon but'un, “Keihon Pathen in nangma na umpi hi phatechan kamu chen tauve. Hijeh chun nangho le keiho kikah a kihou cham ding kanom ui, chule ikah uva kitepna khat sem kanom uve.
en: They said, “We saw plainly that the LORD was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let’s make a covenant with you,
text:
GEN 26:28
Thadou: Ama hon adon but'un, “Keihon Pathen in nangma na umpi hi phatechan kamu chen tauve. Hijeh chun nangho le keiho kikah a kihou cham ding kanom ui, chule ikah uva kitepna khat sem kanom uve.
English: They said, “We saw plainly that the LORD was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let’s make a covenant with you,

tcz: Ahi theile ki hou cham na inei thei ding'u dei aum lheh e, keima hon jong nangho chunga imacha bolse pou ving'e, kei hon nang ho ka ngailu jing uve. Chule lung damsel a kasol doh joh nahiuve. Ven! tun nangho Pathen in nasatah in phatthei naboh tauve.
en: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of the LORD.”
text:
GEN 26:29
Thadou: Ahi theile ki hou cham na inei thei ding'u dei aum lheh e, keima hon jong nangho chunga imacha bolse pou ving'e, kei hon nang ho ka ngailu jing uve. Chule lung damsel a kasol doh joh nahiuve. Ven! tun nangho Pathen in nasatah in phatthei naboh tauve.
English: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of the LORD.”

tcz: Hichun Isaac in kinopto na ankong nehkhom na asem in amahon abonchauvin anekhom un adonkhom un ahi.
en: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.
text:
GEN 26:30
Thadou: Hichun Isaac in kinopto na ankong nehkhom na asem in amahon abonchauvin anekhom un adonkhom un ahi.
English: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

tcz: Ajing in jingpi matah in akithou’ un amaho khat khat in kitepna anei uvin, hichun Isaac in amaho chu a in lam uva asolkit tan, amaho jong lunglhai sel in akinung le tauve.
en: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
text:
GEN 26:31
Thadou: Ajing in jingpi matah in akithou’ un amaho khat khat in kitepna anei uvin, hichun Isaac in amaho chu a in lam uva asolkit tan, amaho jong lunglhai sel in akinung le tauve.
English: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

tcz: Hiche ni ma ma chun Isaac sohten twisam thah khat alai doh'u chu thu ahung peuvin amahon aseiyun, “Keihon twisam thah khat kamu uve,” ahung tiuve.
en: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”
text:
GEN 26:32
Thadou: Hiche ni ma ma chun Isaac sohten twisam thah khat alai doh'u chu thu ahung peuvin amahon aseiyun, “Keihon twisam thah khat kamu uve,” ahung tiuve.
English: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”

tcz: Hichun Isaac in twisam thah chu Shebath asah tai. (Shebath tichu kinoptona tina ahi) Hiche nia patna chu tuni gei a hi Beershiba khopi kiti ahiye.
en: He called it “Shibah”. Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” to this day.
text:
GEN 26:33
Thadou: Hichun Isaac in twisam thah chu Shebath asah tai. (Shebath tichu kinoptona tina ahi) Hiche nia patna chu tuni gei a hi Beershiba khopi kiti ahiye.
English: He called it “Shibah”. Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” to this day.

tcz: Esau chu kum som li alhin chun Hit mite numei Beeri Judith le Hit mi mama Elon chanu Basemath chu ji ding in akipui jin ahi.
en: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
text:
GEN 26:34
Thadou: Esau chu kum som li alhin chun Hit mite numei Beeri Judith le Hit mi mama Elon chanu Basemath chu ji ding in akipui jin ahi.
English: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

tcz: Amavang Esau ji teni chu Isaac le Rebekah din thoh lel aum lheh jeng lhon in ahi.
en: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.
text:
GEN 26:35
Thadou: Amavang Esau ji teni chu Isaac le Rebekah din thoh lel aum lheh jeng lhon in ahi.
English: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.

tcz: Ateh a kho amu chen lou nung hin nikhat hi Isaac in achapa alenjo pachu akouve.
en: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”
text:
GEN 27:1
Thadou: Ateh a kho amu chen lou nung hin nikhat hi Isaac in achapa alenjo pachu akouve.
English: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”

tcz: “Ka chapa! Keima hi ateh kahi tai, Itih thiding kahim kasei thei tapoi,
en: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.
text:
GEN 27:2
Thadou: “Ka chapa! Keima hi ateh kahi tai, Itih thiding kahim kasei thei tapoi,
English: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.

tcz: Hijeh chun tun nangma kigong in lang na man chah nathalpi kigot inlang gamlah a kei ding sa gakap'in,
en: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.
text:
GEN 27:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun tun nangma kigong in lang na man chah nathalpi kigot inlang gamlah a kei ding sa gakap'in,
English: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.

tcz: Chuteng le keiman kadu lamtah in hin lhonin lang hinchoi jin keiman kaneh ding chuteng le nangma hi kahinkho abei masanga phatthei kaboh ding nahi ati.
en: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”
text:
GEN 27:4
Thadou: Chuteng le keiman kadu lamtah in hin lhonin lang hinchoi jin keiman kaneh ding chuteng le nangma hi kahinkho abei masanga phatthei kaboh ding nahi ati.
English: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”

tcz: Ahin Isaac le Esau kihou na chu Rebekah'in guhthim chan ana ngai jin hichun Esau chu gamleng ding a akon doh phat in;
en: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

tcz: Rebekah in Jacob jah'a hitin aseiye, “Ngaijin napa Isaac in na upa Esau hitin ahoulimpi kaja'e,” ati.
en: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,
text:
GEN 27:6
Thadou: Rebekah in Jacob jah'a hitin aseiye, “Ngaijin napa Isaac in na upa Esau hitin ahoulimpi kaja'e,” ati.
English: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,

tcz: “Sa neiga delpeh inlang kadu lamtah in hinhon in lang hinchoi in keiman ne ingting chule Pathen masanga phatthei kaboh ding nahi, kahinkho abei masang in,” ati.
en: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before the LORD before my death.’
text:
GEN 27:7
Thadou: “Sa neiga delpeh inlang kadu lamtah in hinhon in lang hinchoi in keiman ne ingting chule Pathen masanga phatthei kaboh ding nahi, kahinkho abei masang in,” ati.
English: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before the LORD before my death.’

tcz: Hijeh chun tun kachapa ka thusei hi phatechan ngaiyin kathu sei hohi najui ding ahi.
en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.
text:
GEN 27:8
Thadou: Hijeh chun tun kachapa ka thusei hi phatechan ngaiyin kathu sei hohi najui ding ahi.
English: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.

tcz: “Nangma kelngoi hon lah a gachen lang ahoitah cheh anouni hinkai jin chuteng le keiman napa dulam tah a kahon peh ding,
en: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.
text:
GEN 27:9
Thadou: “Nangma kelngoi hon lah a gachen lang ahoitah cheh anouni hinkai jin chuteng le keiman napa dulam tah a kahon peh ding,
English: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.

tcz: Hiche teng chule nangman napa komma nachoi ding aman aneh a aneh jou teng phatthei na boh ding ahi, ama ahinkho adampet ahi,” ati.
en: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”
text:
GEN 27:10
Thadou: Hiche teng chule nangman napa komma nachoi ding aman aneh a aneh jou teng phatthei na boh ding ahi, ama ahinkho adampet ahi,” ati.
English: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”

tcz: Ahin Jacob in anu Rebekah adonbut in ajah'a, “Vetem in ka upa Esau a tichung amul in ahin keima vou nem a timul lou ka hi.
en: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.
text:
GEN 27:11
Thadou: Ahin Jacob in anu Rebekah adonbut in ajah'a, “Vetem in ka upa Esau a tichung amul in ahin keima vou nem a timul lou ka hi.
English: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.

tcz: I kati ding ham? kapa in eihin jut le ta le jou a kabol ahin hetdoh leh koi phatthei chan sanga sapset na joh kachan joh ding ahi,” ati.
en: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”
text:
GEN 27:12
Thadou: I kati ding ham? kapa in eihin jut le ta le jou a kabol ahin hetdoh leh koi phatthei chan sanga sapset na joh kachan joh ding ahi,” ati.
English: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”

tcz: Hinlah anu Rebekah in adonbut in, “Sapsetna ho aumle keiman abon'in keiman kipoh tang kate ati, chapa bol in ka ti hohi na bol angaiye, che inlang kelngoi chu ka henga hin kailut loiyin ati!”
en: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”
text:
GEN 27:13
Thadou: Hinlah anu Rebekah in adonbut in, “Sapsetna ho aumle keiman abon'in keiman kipoh tang kate ati, chapa bol in ka ti hohi na bol angaiye, che inlang kelngoi chu ka henga hin kailut loiyin ati!”
English: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”

tcz: Hichun Jacob jong achen kelngoi chu anu kom'a ahin kailut tai. Chuin anun jong apa dulam tah in ahon peh tai.
en: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.
text:
GEN 27:14
Thadou: Hichun Jacob jong achen kelngoi chu anu kom'a ahin kailut tai. Chuin anun jong apa dulam tah in ahon peh tai.
English: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.

tcz: Hichun Esau von holah a aphapen chu insunga kon in agala doh in achapa aneojo pa Jacob chu avonpeh tan ahi.
en: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.
text:
GEN 27:15
Thadou: Hichun Esau von holah a aphapen chu insunga kon in agala doh in achapa aneojo pa Jacob chu avonpeh tan ahi.
English: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.

tcz: Chule kelngoi nou teni mulchu akhut teni le angong amul bei lai achun atom peh in ahi.
en: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.
text:
GEN 27:16
Thadou: Chule kelngoi nou teni mulchu akhut teni le angong amul bei lai achun atom peh in ahi.
English: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.

tcz: Hichun Rebekah in sa twitah a ahon chule changlhah ama semsa chu achapa Jacob khut a apetan ahi.
en: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
text:
GEN 27:17
Thadou: Hichun Rebekah in sa twitah a ahon chule changlhah ama semsa chu achapa Jacob khut a apetan ahi.
English: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in changlhah le kelsa chu apa aga pen “Hepa” atileh aman jong “Hoiyo koipen nahim ka chapa?”
en: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”
text:
GEN 27:18
Thadou: Hichun Jacob in changlhah le kelsa chu apa aga pen “Hepa” atileh aman jong “Hoiyo koipen nahim ka chapa?”
English: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”

tcz: Jacob'in a donbut in, “Keima Esau na chapa apeng masa chu kahi,” ati. “Keiman kahin subulhit tai nei nganse na chu lungset tah in kithou inlang ka hin choi sa twitah a kihon hi ne inlang phatthei neiboh tan,” ati.
en: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”
text:
GEN 27:19
Thadou: Jacob'in a donbut in, “Keima Esau na chapa apeng masa chu kahi,” ati. “Keiman kahin subulhit tai nei nganse na chu lungset tah in kithou inlang ka hin choi sa twitah a kihon hi ne inlang phatthei neiboh tan,” ati.
English: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”

tcz: Chuin Isaac in achapa chu adonbut in, “Iti dan ham? man gangtah in nahin vaidoh loijen in ka chapa atile aman jong adonbut in Pakai na Pathen in gangtah a eihin lolhin sah ahi bouve,” ati.
en: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because the LORD your God gave me success.”
text:
GEN 27:20
Thadou: Chuin Isaac in achapa chu adonbut in, “Iti dan ham? man gangtah in nahin vaidoh loijen in ka chapa atile aman jong adonbut in Pakai na Pathen in gangtah a eihin lolhin sah ahi bouve,” ati.
English: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because the LORD your God gave me success.”

tcz: Hichun Isaac in Jacob henga, “Hung ki khin nai jin katham phah thei nadin, nangma hi ka chapa Esau nahi mong nam nahi lou ham na jutle tem inge.
en: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”
text:
GEN 27:21
Thadou: Hichun Isaac in Jacob henga, “Hung ki khin nai jin katham phah thei nadin, nangma hi ka chapa Esau nahi mong nam nahi lou ham na jutle tem inge.
English: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Jacob in apa Isaac anailut in ahile ahin jutle tan ahi, a awso hila Jacob awso ahin, akhut teni vang hi Esau khut ahi ngal in atin ahi.
en: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”
text:
GEN 27:22
Thadou: Hijeh chun Jacob in apa Isaac anailut in ahile ahin jutle tan ahi, a awso hila Jacob awso ahin, akhut teni vang hi Esau khut ahi ngal in atin ahi.
English: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”

tcz: Amavang Jacob ahi chu ahetchen thei lou ahitai, ajeh chu Jacob khut chu a upa Esau khut tobanga mul ahijeh'in hichun Isaac chun Jacob chu phatthei abohtan ahi.
en: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.
text:
GEN 27:23
Thadou: Amavang Jacob ahi chu ahetchen thei lou ahitai, ajeh chu Jacob khut chu a upa Esau khut tobanga mul ahijeh'in hichun Isaac chun Jacob chu phatthei abohtan ahi.
English: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.

tcz: Isaac in adong pha kit leuvin, “Nangma hi kachapa Esau nahi mong hinam? atile, Jacob in adonbut in “Ka hinai,” ati.
en: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”
text:
GEN 27:24
Thadou: Isaac in adong pha kit leuvin, “Nangma hi kachapa Esau nahi mong hinam? atile, Jacob in adonbut in “Ka hinai,” ati.
English: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”

tcz: Chuphat in Isaac in aseiye, “Ka henga hindom naitan nangma phatthei kaboh thei na dingin kachapan gangtah a naga mat sa na hon chu ne ing kate,” ati, chuin Jacob in ahin doppeh phat in anen chule lengpitwi jong ahin dop peh in ahile Isaac chun adon tai.
en: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.
text:
GEN 27:25
Thadou: Chuphat in Isaac in aseiye, “Ka henga hindom naitan nangma phatthei kaboh thei na dingin kachapan gangtah a naga mat sa na hon chu ne ing kate,” ati, chuin Jacob in ahin doppeh phat in anen chule lengpitwi jong ahin dop peh in ahile Isaac chun adon tai.
English: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.

tcz: Hichun apa Isaac chun ajah a “eihin nailut in lang neihin bengchop tem in ka chapa,” atile,
en: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”
text:
GEN 27:26
Thadou: Hichun apa Isaac chun ajah a “eihin nailut in lang neihin bengchop tem in ka chapa,” atile,
English: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”

tcz: Jacob'in anai phei jin apa chu abengchop tai, chuin Isaac kivonna ho gimnam chu anah le len chuin achapa chu phatthei aboh in hitin aseiye, “Vetan kachapa gimnam hi Pakai phatthei bohsa gamlah gimnam abang'e.
en: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD has blessed.
text:
GEN 27:27
Thadou: Jacob'in anai phei jin apa chu abengchop tai, chuin Isaac kivonna ho gimnam chu anah le len chuin achapa chu phatthei aboh in hitin aseiye, “Vetan kachapa gimnam hi Pakai phatthei bohsa gamlah gimnam abang'e.
English: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD has blessed.

tcz: Tun Pakai Pathen in vana kon in daitwi na chap jing hen, leiset'a leipha lai lai nachan sah jing hen; chule chang le mim chule juning ninglhin sah jing hen.
en: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.
text:
GEN 27:28
Thadou: Tun Pakai Pathen in vana kon in daitwi na chap jing hen, leiset'a leipha lai lai nachan sah jing hen; chule chang le mim chule juning ninglhin sah jing hen.
English: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.

tcz: Nam simsen lou vin naja hen chule mihem tamtah nangma noija kun cheh hen lang, nasopi ho chunga vai hin hom jing in lang; nanu sunga peng doh pasal jouse jong na henga kun cheh uhen. Nangma na gaosapte chu gaosap chang hen, chule nangma phatthei na bohte chu phattheiboh chang hen!” ati.
en: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you.”
text:
GEN 27:29
Thadou: Nam simsen lou vin naja hen chule mihem tamtah nangma noija kun cheh hen lang, nasopi ho chunga vai hin hom jing in lang; nanu sunga peng doh pasal jouse jong na henga kun cheh uhen. Nangma na gaosapte chu gaosap chang hen, chule nangma phatthei na bohte chu phattheiboh chang hen!” ati.
English: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you.”

tcz: Isaac in Jacob phatthei aboh chai chai jin; Jacob in apa angsung agah dalhah ding kon chet in a upa Esau chu agam lena a kon in ahung lhung pai jeng tai.
en: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
text:
GEN 27:30
Thadou: Isaac in Jacob phatthei aboh chai chai jin; Jacob in apa angsung agah dalhah ding kon chet in a upa Esau chu agam lena a kon in ahung lhung pai jeng tai.
English: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

tcz: Chuin Esau in jong nehding a althet in ahon peh in apa henga ahin dop peh apa jah a aseitai. “Hepa hung kithou in lang na hai hai pet'a phatthei neiboh na ding in na chapa thasa hi hung ne o!” ati.
en: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”
text:
GEN 27:31
Thadou: Chuin Esau in jong nehding a althet in ahon peh in apa henga ahin dop peh apa jah a aseitai. “Hepa hung kithou in lang na hai hai pet'a phatthei neiboh na ding in na chapa thasa hi hung ne o!” ati.
English: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”

tcz: Ahin Isaac in adonbut in, “Nang koi nahim? Esau in adonbut in, “Na chapa apeng masa Esau kahi,” ati.
en: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”
text:
GEN 27:32
Thadou: Ahin Isaac in adonbut in, “Nang koi nahim? Esau in adonbut in, “Na chapa apeng masa Esau kahi,” ati.
English: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”

tcz: Isaac hatah in ati akithing tan aseiye, “Koiham Ijo langa hin dom a hung achu, keiman ama hin dop chu kana ne tai. Nangma hung lhun masang jep chun phatthei jong ka boh jou tai; phatthei na jouse jong ama achang jou tai.”
en: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”
text:
GEN 27:33
Thadou: Isaac hatah in ati akithing tan aseiye, “Koiham Ijo langa hin dom a hung achu, keiman ama hin dop chu kana ne tai. Nangma hung lhun masang jep chun phatthei jong ka boh jou tai; phatthei na jouse jong ama achang jou tai.”
English: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”

tcz: Chuin Esau in apa thusei jouse chu angai chai sohhel phat'in Esau jong ha kan akap'in hatah in alunghang in apa komma atao kit'in, “Hepa keima jong phatthei nei boh teitei in ong,” ati.
en: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”
text:
GEN 27:34
Thadou: Chuin Esau in apa thusei jouse chu angai chai sohhel phat'in Esau jong ha kan akap'in hatah in alunghang in apa komma atao kit'in, “Hepa keima jong phatthei nei boh teitei in ong,” ati.
English: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”

tcz: Hinlah Isaac in aseiye, “Na sopipa ahung in eihung lhem lha tai, nang phatthei na chan ding jouse nalah peh gam tai.”
en: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”
text:
GEN 27:35
Thadou: Hinlah Isaac in aseiye, “Na sopipa ahung in eihung lhem lha tai, nang phatthei na chan ding jouse nalah peh gam tai.”
English: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”

tcz: Esau in adonbut in, “Hiche jeh a chu amin Jacob kisah hitei jinte ong? Ajeh chu aman nivei jen eilhep lhah ahitai, phat masa in ka upat hina eina lah peh in, tun ka phatthei chan ding ana kilah doh kit e, atin hichun keiya dinga phatthei khat beh jong neina khen pehlou hitam?” atile.
en: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”
text:
GEN 27:36
Thadou: Esau in adonbut in, “Hiche jeh a chu amin Jacob kisah hitei jinte ong? Ajeh chu aman nivei jen eilhep lhah ahitai, phat masa in ka upat hina eina lah peh in, tun ka phatthei chan ding ana kilah doh kit e, atin hichun keiya dinga phatthei khat beh jong neina khen pehlou hitam?” atile.
English: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”

tcz: Isaac in Esau adonbut in, “keiman Jacob chu nangma chunga vaihom ding in ka koi tai, chule asopite jouse ama noija kun cheh diu, chule chang le mim ahin, juning ahin, haothei na jong kapeh ahitai,tua hijat nunga nangma ipi kabolpeh thei nahlai ding ham kachapa?” atitai.
en: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”
text:
GEN 27:37
Thadou: Isaac in Esau adonbut in, “keiman Jacob chu nangma chunga vaihom ding in ka koi tai, chule asopite jouse ama noija kun cheh diu, chule chang le mim ahin, juning ahin, haothei na jong kapeh ahitai,tua hijat nunga nangma ipi kabolpeh thei nahlai ding ham kachapa?” atitai.
English: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”

tcz: Ahi vang'in Esau in apa jah a “O hepa phatthei na khat chabeh jong umlou hitam? phatthei neiboh teitei yin ong Hepa!” atin apeng in akap tai.
en: Esau said to his father, “Do you have just one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
text:
GEN 27:38
Thadou: Ahi vang'in Esau in apa jah a “O hepa phatthei na khat chabeh jong umlou hitam? phatthei neiboh teitei yin ong Hepa!” atin apeng in akap tai.
English: Esau said to his father, “Do you have just one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

tcz: Chuin apa Isaac in ahoupin ajah a “Nangma leichung phalou lah lah a cheng ding na hitan, chule van daitwi in jong hin chap khata ponte.
en: Isaac his father answered him, “Behold, your dwelling will be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of the sky from above.
text:
GEN 27:39
Thadou: Chuin apa Isaac in ahoupin ajah a “Nangma leichung phalou lah lah a cheng ding na hitan, chule van daitwi in jong hin chap khata ponte.
English: Isaac his father answered him, “Behold, your dwelling will be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of the sky from above.

tcz: Nangma na chemjam a naki vahding chule na sopipa noija na um ding ahin nangma na hung ki- ondoh teng vangleh nangong chang'a kona ama namkol chu na pai lhah ding ahi tai,” ati.
en: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother. It will happen, when you will break loose, that you will shake his yoke from off your neck.”
text:
GEN 27:40
Thadou: Nangma na chemjam a naki vahding chule na sopipa noija na um ding ahin nangma na hung ki- ondoh teng vangleh nangong chang'a kona ama namkol chu na pai lhah ding ahi tai,” ati.
English: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother. It will happen, when you will break loose, that you will shake his yoke from off your neck.”

tcz: Hiche phat a pat chun Esau in Jacob chu hatah in ahin vetda pan ahi tai; ajeh chu apa Isaac in phatthei na jouse Jacob aboh jeh ahi. Chule Esau in alung thim sunga hitin agel tan, “Kapa hin nikho jong hi sotta pon tin a kichai teng le keiman ka naopa Jacob hi ka tha ding ahi,” ati.
en: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”
text:
GEN 27:41
Thadou: Hiche phat a pat chun Esau in Jacob chu hatah in ahin vetda pan ahi tai; ajeh chu apa Isaac in phatthei na jouse Jacob aboh jeh ahi. Chule Esau in alung thim sunga hitin agel tan, “Kapa hin nikho jong hi sotta pon tin a kichai teng le keiman ka naopa Jacob hi ka tha ding ahi,” ati.
English: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”

tcz: Ahin achapa alenjo Esau lungthim tohgon jouse chu Rebekah jah a aki seidoh khatan ahin Rebekah in mi asol'in achapa neojopa Jacob chu aga kousah in ajah a asei pehtai, “Ngaiyin na upa Esau khun nang thana ding in lungthim tohgon anei tai,
en: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.
text:
GEN 27:42
Thadou: Ahin achapa alenjo Esau lungthim tohgon jouse chu Rebekah jah a aki seidoh khatan ahin Rebekah in mi asol'in achapa neojopa Jacob chu aga kousah in ajah a asei pehtai, “Ngaiyin na upa Esau khun nang thana ding in lungthim tohgon anei tai,
English: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.

tcz: Chapa chingthei tah in ngai jin, tun kigong inlang kasopipa Laban kom Haran langa jam tan.
en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.
text:
GEN 27:43
Thadou: Chapa chingthei tah in ngai jin, tun kigong inlang kasopipa Laban kom Haran langa jam tan.
English: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.

tcz: Hiche mun achun ni ejat hijong leh ga umtan na upa Esau lungdam kahsen.
en: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away—
text:
GEN 27:44
Thadou: Hiche mun achun ni ejat hijong leh ga umtan na upa Esau lungdam kahsen.
English: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away—

tcz: Ama ahung lungdam a nabolset naho asuhmil hel'a ahung lungdam mong mong teng leh keiman mi hinsol ing ting nahung holdoh sah nang'e. Nang ni ucha nikhat a na manthah lhon ding ka nompoi.
en: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”
text:
GEN 27:45
Thadou: Ama ahung lungdam a nabolset naho asuhmil hel'a ahung lungdam mong mong teng leh keiman mi hinsol ing ting nahung holdoh sah nang'e. Nang ni ucha nikhat a na manthah lhon ding ka nompoi.
English: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”

tcz: Hichun Rebekah in Isaac komma aseiye, “Keiman hiche Hit mite numei ho kathei chim behset jeng tai, Ijem tin Jacob in hiche numei ho jin ahin kipui kit ding ka gel thei poi kathi lo tei ding ahi,” ati.
en: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”
text:
GEN 27:46
Thadou: Hichun Rebekah in Isaac komma aseiye, “Keiman hiche Hit mite numei ho kathei chim behset jeng tai, Ijem tin Jacob in hiche numei ho jin ahin kipui kit ding ka gel thei poi kathi lo tei ding ahi,” ati.
English: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”

tcz: Hichun Isaac in Jacob akouvin, phatthei aboh-in chule athu lhah in ajah a hitin aseiye, “Nangman hiche Canaan numei hohi jia nakipui thei louhel ding ahi;
en: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

tcz: Hijeh chun gangtah in kipatdoh in lang Padan-Ram a nanu upa Bethuel in a chen chukom akon chun nanu sopipa Laban Chanute joh ga kipuitan.
en: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
text:
GEN 28:2
Thadou: Hijeh chun gangtah in kipatdoh in lang Padan-Ram a nanu upa Bethuel in a chen chukom akon chun nanu sopipa Laban Chanute joh ga kipuitan.
English: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

tcz: Pa Pathen in phatthei naboh hen lang nacha nanao tha lhinsah hen, na punsah hen, chule amaho chu nam lentah hung himaiyu hen.
en: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,
text:
GEN 28:3
Thadou: Pa Pathen in phatthei naboh hen lang nacha nanao tha lhinsah hen, na punsah hen, chule amaho chu nam lentah hung himaiyu hen.
English: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,

tcz: Pathen in nangma le nachilhahte chunga phatthei naboh uhen, napu Abraham kom a anaki tepna ho chu tua nangma na khopem nagam jong hi nahin losoh ding ahi, Ajeh chu Pathen in Abraham ana pehsa ahitai.
en: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”
text:
GEN 28:4
Thadou: Pathen in nangma le nachilhahte chunga phatthei naboh uhen, napu Abraham kom a anaki tepna ho chu tua nangma na khopem nagam jong hi nahin losoh ding ahi, Ajeh chu Pathen in Abraham ana pehsa ahitai.
English: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”

tcz: Chule Isaac in Jacob chu asol mang tai, ama jong Padan-Ram langa Jacob le Esau hingnu Rebekah sopipa Syrian mi Bethuel chapa Laban henga ache tai.
en: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.
text:
GEN 28:5
Thadou: Chule Isaac in Jacob chu asol mang tai, ama jong Padan-Ram langa Jacob le Esau hingnu Rebekah sopipa Syrian mi Bethuel chapa Laban henga ache tai.
English: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

tcz: Esau in ahechen tai apa Isaac in Jacob phatthei aboh a Padan-Ram langa numei ji a gakipui dinga a phatsah a, chule phatthei aboh pet'a agihsal a “nangman hiche Canaan numei ho ji a naki pui thei lou ding ahi,” tia asei peh jong aja tai.
en: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”
text:
GEN 28:6
Thadou: Esau in ahechen tai apa Isaac in Jacob phatthei aboh a Padan-Ram langa numei ji a gakipui dinga a phatsah a, chule phatthei aboh pet'a agihsal a “nangman hiche Canaan numei ho ji a naki pui thei lou ding ahi,” tia asei peh jong aja tai.
English: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”

tcz: Chule Jacob in apa le anu thu angaiya Padan-Ram lam ah achetai.
en: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.
text:
GEN 28:7
Thadou: Chule Jacob in apa le anu thu angaiya Padan-Ram lam ah achetai.
English: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.

tcz: Chule Esau chun apa Isaac in Canaan numei ho chunga a lunglhai poi ti ahe chen tai.
en: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.
text:
GEN 28:8
Thadou: Chule Esau chun apa Isaac in Canaan numei ho chunga a lunglhai poi ti ahe chen tai.
English: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.

tcz: Hichun Esau jong apu Ishmael henga achen Abraham chapa Ishmael chanu Nebaioth sopinu Mahalath chu aji masa teni belap ding in aga kipui ben ahi.
en: So Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.
text:
GEN 28:9
Thadou: Hichun Esau jong apu Ishmael henga achen Abraham chapa Ishmael chanu Nebaioth sopinu Mahalath chu aji masa teni belap ding in aga kipui ben ahi.
English: So Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

tcz: Chule Jacob in Beersheba chu adalhan Haran lang ajon tai.
en: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
text:
GEN 28:10
Thadou: Chule Jacob in Beersheba chu adalhan Haran lang ajon tai.
English: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

tcz: Hiti chun gamkim lai khat ahung geidon hin nisan alhum den tai, hichun ama jong jan chun chukom muna ageh dentai, age na muna songho khat chu alan lukhap in aneiyin alumden tai.
en: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.
text:
GEN 28:11
Thadou: Hiti chun gamkim lai khat ahung geidon hin nisan alhum den tai, hichun ama jong jan chun chukom muna ageh dentai, age na muna songho khat chu alan lukhap in aneiyin alumden tai.
English: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

tcz: Ama hiti chun alup lhah chun amang a kalbi saotah akido amun leiset apat vantham jol geiya kidolut amun, hichun Jacob in Pakai vantilte akaltou akumsuh jing u chu amun ahi.
en: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
text:
GEN 28:12
Thadou: Ama hiti chun alup lhah chun amang a kalbi saotah akido amun leiset apat vantham jol geiya kidolut amun, hichun Jacob in Pakai vantilte akaltou akumsuh jing u chu amun ahi.
English: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

tcz: Chule kalbi achung langa chun Pakai adding in hitin aseiye, “Keima Pakai Pathen napu Abraham Pathen napa Isaac Pathen kahi. Tua naki choldo na mun hohi nangma leh nachilhahte kapeh doh ahitai.
en: Behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, “I am the LORD, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.
text:
GEN 28:13
Thadou: Chule kalbi achung langa chun Pakai adding in hitin aseiye, “Keima Pakai Pathen napu Abraham Pathen napa Isaac Pathen kahi. Tua naki choldo na mun hohi nangma leh nachilhahte kapeh doh ahitai.
English: Behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, “I am the LORD, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.

tcz: Na chilhahte chu tol'a leivui ja kaphahsah ding amaho chun solam, lhumlam, sahlam, lhanglam aboncha ahin lodim soh dingu ahi, chule leiset chunga nangma le na insung mite jeh a vannoi phatthei kaboh ding ahi.
en: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.
text:
GEN 28:14
Thadou: Na chilhahte chu tol'a leivui ja kaphahsah ding amaho chun solam, lhumlam, sahlam, lhanglam aboncha ahin lodim soh dingu ahi, chule leiset chunga nangma le na insung mite jeh a vannoi phatthei kaboh ding ahi.
English: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.

tcz: Itihchan hi jongle nangma ka umpi jing ding nache nachan a nikhat teng hiche gam'a hi kahin nung pui lut kit ding nahi, ajeh chu kaki tepna jouse ka suhbulhit masangse a donlouva ka koi louhel ding nahi.
en: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”
text:
GEN 28:15
Thadou: Itihchan hi jongle nangma ka umpi jing ding nache nachan a nikhat teng hiche gam'a hi kahin nung pui lut kit ding nahi, ajeh chu kaki tepna jouse ka suhbulhit masangse a donlouva ka koi louhel ding nahi.
English: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

tcz: Hichun Jacob a emutna kona ahung khang doh in hitin aseiye, “Hikom ahin Pathen a um mong'e tihi kana hetphah lou ahi.”
en: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”
text:
GEN 28:16
Thadou: Hichun Jacob a emutna kona ahung khang doh in hitin aseiye, “Hikom ahin Pathen a um mong'e tihi kana hetphah lou ahi.”
English: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”

tcz: Hinlah ama chu tijatnan adim in hitin aseiye, “Hiche lai mun hi Pathen in ahiloule thildang imacha ahi tapoi; chujong le hiche lai hi van gam kelkot phung ahi bouve,” ati.
en: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”
text:
GEN 28:17
Thadou: Hinlah ama chu tijatnan adim in hitin aseiye, “Hiche lai mun hi Pathen in ahiloule thildang imacha ahi tapoi; chujong le hiche lai hi van gam kelkot phung ahi bouve,” ati.
English: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”

tcz: Hichun Jacob jingkah matah in athouvin alukhap song chu alan khom phun aphut'in achunga chun thao twi asun khum in ahi.
en: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.
text:
GEN 28:18
Thadou: Hichun Jacob jingkah matah in athouvin alukhap song chu alan khom phun aphut'in achunga chun thao twi asun khum in ahi.
English: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.

tcz: Hiche mun chu Bethel asah tai, hichun avetsah chu Pathen hou in tina ahi; phat masalai chun Luz tin ana kihei.
en: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
text:
GEN 28:19
Thadou: Hiche mun chu Bethel asah tai, hichun avetsah chu Pathen hou in tina ahi; phat masalai chun Luz tin ana kihei.
English: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in kigahna khat aneiyin, “Keima Pathen in ei umpi jing le kakhol jinna hi kaneh ding bu chuleh sil le chen eipeh ding ahi,” ati.
en: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,
text:
GEN 28:20
Thadou: Hichun Jacob in kigahna khat aneiyin, “Keima Pathen in ei umpi jing le kakhol jinna hi kaneh ding bu chuleh sil le chen eipeh ding ahi,” ati.
English: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,

tcz: Chule keima kapa in damsel a ei nungpui lhung kitleh ama chu ka Pakai Pathen dihtah mong ahi tia ding det kahitai.
en: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and the LORD will be my God,
text:
GEN 28:21
Thadou: Chule keima kapa in damsel a ei nungpui lhung kitleh ama chu ka Pakai Pathen dihtah mong ahi tia ding det kahitai.
English: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and the LORD will be my God,

tcz: Chule hiche song khomphu a ka phudoh hi Pathen hou na in kiti ding ahi. Chuleh Pathen in eipeh jouse hi hopsom a hopkhat nangma kapeh ding ahi ati.
en: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”
text:
GEN 28:22
Thadou: Chule hiche song khomphu a ka phudoh hi Pathen hou na in kiti ding ahi. Chuleh Pathen in eipeh jouse hi hopsom a hopkhat nangma kapeh ding ahi ati.
English: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”

tcz: Hichun Jacob akhol che chu abanjom in solam mite gam chu ahung lhung tai.
en: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.
text:
GEN 29:1
Thadou: Hichun Jacob akhol che chu abanjom in solam mite gam chu ahung lhung tai.
English: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

tcz: Chuin aman agah ven ahile loulai a Twisam amun akomma chun kelngoi hon loi thum'a akol jong amun hiche gancha ho chu twikulla don ding twi ngah ahiuve, chule twisam chu songpi lentah in adal khum ahi.
en: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.
text:
GEN 29:2
Thadou: Chuin aman agah ven ahile loulai a Twisam amun akomma chun kelngoi hon loi thum'a akol jong amun hiche gancha ho chu twikulla don ding twi ngah ahiuve, chule twisam chu songpi lentah in adal khum ahi.
English: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.

tcz: Hitia chu kelngoi hon ho abonna ahung kisuh kimteng uleh kelngoi ching hon twikhuh kamsin songpi chu akhin doh jiuva kelngoi te twi achip sah jiuva achipva teng ule song chu akikoi na ngai ngai twikhuh kam a chu ale khin lut kit jiu ahi.
en: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back on the well’s mouth in its place.
text:
GEN 29:3
Thadou: Hitia chu kelngoi hon ho abonna ahung kisuh kimteng uleh kelngoi ching hon twikhuh kamsin songpi chu akhin doh jiuva kelngoi te twi achip sah jiuva achipva teng ule song chu akikoi na ngai ngai twikhuh kam a chu ale khin lut kit jiu ahi.
English: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back on the well’s mouth in its place.

tcz: Chuin Jacob in amaho jah a “Sopite ho hoiya hung kon na hiu ham?” atile amahon adon but un “Keiho Haran gam'a hung kon ka hiuve,” ati.
en: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”
text:
GEN 29:4
Thadou: Chuin Jacob in amaho jah a “Sopite ho hoiya hung kon na hiu ham?” atile amahon adon but un “Keiho Haran gam'a hung kon ka hiuve,” ati.
English: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”

tcz: Amapan adong kit in amaho chu “Nahor chapa Laban chu nahet khah hih uvem?” atile “Amahon jong kahe nauve,” atiuve.
en: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”
text:
GEN 29:5
Thadou: Amapan adong kit in amaho chu “Nahor chapa Laban chu nahet khah hih uvem?” atile “Amahon jong kahe nauve,” atiuve.
English: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”

tcz: Chuin Jacob in ajah uva “Ama chu dam dam a hinam? tia adohle amahon “henge adam jingnai ven tua hung kelngoi hontoh hung kilhon khu achanu Rachel hija khu,” atiuve.
en: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”
text:
GEN 29:6
Thadou: Chuin Jacob in ajah uva “Ama chu dam dam a hinam? tia adohle amahon “henge adam jingnai ven tua hung kelngoi hontoh hung kilhon khu achanu Rachel hija khu,” atiuve.
English: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”

tcz: Jacob in ama ho jah a “Tuhin nisa sangtah hinalai ja gancha hoi khom phat bon hilou lai, kelngoi hon chu twi chipsah uvin lang gavah pha uvin,” ati.
en: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”
text:
GEN 29:7
Thadou: Jacob in ama ho jah a “Tuhin nisa sangtah hinalai ja gancha hoi khom phat bon hilou lai, kelngoi hon chu twi chipsah uvin lang gavah pha uvin,” ati.
English: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”

tcz: Ama hon a donbut un, “Gancha ho jouse ahung kikim tokah in twi kipethei ponte atiuve, hichun kelngoi chingho chun songpi chu twisam kot apat chun atangdoh un kelngoi hon jouse twija ka vah va ding ahi,” atiuve.
en: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”
text:
GEN 29:8
Thadou: Ama hon a donbut un, “Gancha ho jouse ahung kikim tokah in twi kipethei ponte atiuve, hichun kelngoi chingho chun songpi chu twisam kot apat chun atangdoh un kelngoi hon jouse twija ka vah va ding ahi,” atiuve.
English: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”

tcz: Amahon hitia akihou lim pet tah uchun Rachel chu apa kelngoi hon hotoh ahung ki jot luttai, Ajeh chu amanu jong kelngoi ching a pang ahiye.
en: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.
text:
GEN 29:9
Thadou: Amahon hitia akihou lim pet tah uchun Rachel chu apa kelngoi hon hotoh ahung ki jot luttai, Ajeh chu amanu jong kelngoi ching a pang ahiye.
English: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.

tcz: Hichun Jacob in anu sopipa Laban chanu Rachel le anu sopipa Laban kelngoite amu phat in anai lut in twikhuh kamsin songpi chu alih doh in apupa kelngoi hon chu twi achip sah in ahi.
en: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
text:
GEN 29:10
Thadou: Hichun Jacob in anu sopipa Laban chanu Rachel le anu sopipa Laban kelngoite amu phat in anai lut in twikhuh kamsin songpi chu alih doh in apupa kelngoi hon chu twi achip sah in ahi.
English: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

tcz: Hichun Jacob'in Rachel chu abeng chop in awging tah in akap'e.
en: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
text:
GEN 29:11
Thadou: Hichun Jacob'in Rachel chu abeng chop in awging tah in akap'e.
English: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

tcz: Jacob in Rachel jah a apa sopinu Rebekah chapa ahi thusim aseipeh tan ahile Rachel chu achen apa aga hetsah tan ahi.
en: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.
text:
GEN 29:12
Thadou: Jacob in Rachel jah a apa sopinu Rebekah chapa ahi thusim aseipeh tan ahile Rachel chu achen apa aga hetsah tan ahi.
English: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.

tcz: Laban in Jacob asopinu chapa ahung lhun ahet chun akimu pin akoi jin achop jeng in chuin a in lama ahin puilut tai. Hichun Jacob in ima jouse thusimho chu aseipeh tai.
en: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.
text:
GEN 29:13
Thadou: Laban in Jacob asopinu chapa ahung lhun ahet chun akimu pin akoi jin achop jeng in chuin a in lama ahin puilut tai. Hichun Jacob in ima jouse thusimho chu aseipeh tai.
English: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.

tcz: Chuin Laban in Jacob henga aseiye, “Nangma hi kagu ka chang chule ka phevou mong nahi,” ati. Hichun Jacob chu apu Laban kom'a lhakhat sung aum tai.
en: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.
text:
GEN 29:14
Thadou: Chuin Laban in Jacob henga aseiye, “Nangma hi kagu ka chang chule ka phevou mong nahi,” ati. Hichun Jacob chu apu Laban kom'a lhakhat sung aum tai.
English: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.

tcz: Laban in Jacob henga aseiye, “Nangma hi ka insung mi nahi vang'in mohseh a tohman beiya na um ding chu adih thei poi, natoh man ipi hiding ham neisei peh tem in? tin adong tai.”
en: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”
text:
GEN 29:15
Thadou: Laban in Jacob henga aseiye, “Nangma hi ka insung mi nahi vang'in mohseh a tohman beiya na um ding chu adih thei poi, natoh man ipi hiding ham neisei peh tem in? tin adong tai.”
English: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”

tcz: Laban in chanu ni aneiyin, alenjo nu min chu Leah ahin, chule aneojo nu min chu Rachel ahi.
en: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
text:
GEN 29:16
Thadou: Laban in chanu ni aneiyin, alenjo nu min chu Leah ahin, chule aneojo nu min chu Rachel ahi.
English: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

tcz: Ahin Leah mit chu aleng thim in ama vang Rachel chu amelhoi jin, amaiso jong lungset aum lheh jenge.
en: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.
text:
GEN 29:17
Thadou: Ahin Leah mit chu aleng thim in ama vang Rachel chu amelhoi jin, amaiso jong lungset aum lheh jenge.
English: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.

tcz: Jacob'in Rachel chu hatah in adeichat jeh in hitin aseiye, “Keiman nang ding in kum sagi na nei tohsah in lang, na chanu aneojo nu Rachel hi keima ji din kipui tang kate,” ati.
en: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”
text:
GEN 29:18
Thadou: Jacob'in Rachel chu hatah in adeichat jeh in hitin aseiye, “Keiman nang ding in kum sagi na nei tohsah in lang, na chanu aneojo nu Rachel hi keima ji din kipui tang kate,” ati.
English: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

tcz: Laban in adonbut'in, “Hithei nante,” ati. “Ajeh chu keiman midang ho kapeh sanga nangma kapeh ding chu thilphajo ahibouve, Hijeh chun keima koma um jingtan,” ati.
en: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”
text:
GEN 29:19
Thadou: Laban in adonbut'in, “Hithei nante,” ati. “Ajeh chu keiman midang ho kapeh sanga nangma kapeh ding chu thilphajo ahibouve, Hijeh chun keima koma um jingtan,” ati.
English: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”

tcz: Hichun Jacob in kum sagi sung in Rachel man toh kitoh ding in na atong tan, Hinlah Jacob in Rachel angailut behset jeh chun ni chomcha toh abahsah in ahi.
en: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.
text:
GEN 29:20
Thadou: Hichun Jacob in kum sagi sung in Rachel man toh kitoh ding in na atong tan, Hinlah Jacob in Rachel angailut behset jeh chun ni chomcha toh abahsah in ahi.
English: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.

tcz: Chujouvin Jacob in Laban jah a hitin aseiye, “Keiman ka kitepna ho jouse ka subulhit tai, kajinu tun neipe tan ka luppi nom tai,” tin ahung thum tai.
en: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”
text:
GEN 29:21
Thadou: Chujouvin Jacob in Laban jah a hitin aseiye, “Keiman ka kitepna ho jouse ka subulhit tai, kajinu tun neipe tan ka luppi nom tai,” tin ahung thum tai.
English: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”

tcz: Hichun Laban in jetle veija cheng ule nao jouse akou khom soh keiyin kichen na golvah chu aboltai.
en: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
text:
GEN 29:22
Thadou: Hichun Laban in jetle veija cheng ule nao jouse akou khom soh keiyin kichen na golvah chu aboltai.
English: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

tcz: Hinlah hiche jan ahung thim phat chun Laban in Leah chu Jacob koma aga that lut pehtan, Jacob in hichenu chu alup khom petai.
en: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.
text:
GEN 29:23
Thadou: Hinlah hiche jan ahung thim phat chun Laban in Leah chu Jacob koma aga that lut pehtan, Jacob in hichenu chu alup khom petai.
English: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.

tcz: Laban in asohnu Zilpah jong chu Leah kithopi a pang ding in apeh tha tai.
en: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.
text:
GEN 29:24
Thadou: Laban in asohnu Zilpah jong chu Leah kithopi a pang ding in apeh tha tai.
English: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.

tcz: Ahin jingkah matah in Jacob ahung kitho leh Leah joh anahin, Jacob in Laban jah a aseiyin, “Ipi iti a hiti a hi neibol hitam? kum sagi nangma noiya na kana toh chu Rachel manding a katoh hilou ham? “Ibol a nei jou lhep ham? tin aseiye.
en: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”
text:
GEN 29:25
Thadou: Ahin jingkah matah in Jacob ahung kitho leh Leah joh anahin, Jacob in Laban jah a aseiyin, “Ipi iti a hiti a hi neibol hitam? kum sagi nangma noiya na kana toh chu Rachel manding a katoh hilou ham? “Ibol a nei jou lhep ham? tin aseiye.
English: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”

tcz: Laban in adonbut in “Kei ho chondana a unu umpet a hi anaonu jinei doh thei lou ahi.”
en: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.
text:
GEN 29:26
Thadou: Laban in adonbut in “Kei ho chondana a unu umpet a hi anaonu jinei doh thei lou ahi.”
English: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

tcz: Hiche hapta khat sunghi ji nei dan hi subu lhit tadin, hiche teng chule Rachel jong kapeh ding na hi, ahin nangman kum sagi ma kana, natoh kit ding ahi ati peh e.
en: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years.”
text:
GEN 29:27
Thadou: Hiche hapta khat sunghi ji nei dan hi subu lhit tadin, hiche teng chule Rachel jong kapeh ding na hi, ahin nangman kum sagi ma kana, natoh kit ding ahi ati peh e.
English: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years.”

tcz: Chuin Jacob in Leah chu hapta khat lhing in akichen pin hiche jou chun Laban in Rachel jong ajinu ding in ape tai.
en: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.
text:
GEN 29:28
Thadou: Chuin Jacob in Leah chu hapta khat lhing in akichen pin hiche jou chun Laban in Rachel jong ajinu ding in ape tai.
English: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.

tcz: Laban'in asohnu Bilhah jong chu achanu Rachel jenle a pang dingin apehtha tai.
en: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.
text:
GEN 29:29
Thadou: Laban'in asohnu Bilhah jong chu achanu Rachel jenle a pang dingin apehtha tai.
English: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.

tcz: Hichun Jacob'in Rachel jong alup khom pitan, aman Rachel chu Leah sang in hatah in adei jon, hichun Jacob in kum sagi ma Laban na atong kit'in ahi.
en: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him seven more years.
text:
GEN 29:30
Thadou: Hichun Jacob'in Rachel jong alup khom pitan, aman Rachel chu Leah sang in hatah in adei jon, hichun Jacob in kum sagi ma Laban na atong kit'in ahi.
English: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him seven more years.

tcz: Ahin Pathen in Leah kihot bol chu amudoh tan, hijeh chun anaobu ahondoh peh in, amavang Rachel chu aching in cha neilou in aum tai.
en: The LORD saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.
text:
GEN 29:31
Thadou: Ahin Pathen in Leah kihot bol chu amudoh tan, hijeh chun anaobu ahondoh peh in, amavang Rachel chu aching in cha neilou in aum tai.
English: The LORD saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.

tcz: Leah vang chu achung agih tan; chapa khat ahing in amin Reuben asah tai, Ijeh in em itile, “Pathen in ka gimna ho eihet pehtai, hiche jeh a hi ka jipan eilungset ding ahi tai,” ati.
en: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because the LORD has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”
text:
GEN 29:32
Thadou: Leah vang chu achung agih tan; chapa khat ahing in amin Reuben asah tai, Ijeh in em itile, “Pathen in ka gimna ho eihet pehtai, hiche jeh a hi ka jipan eilungset ding ahi tai,” ati.
English: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because the LORD has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”

tcz: Chuin aman nao avop kit in chapa khat ahing kit tai, ajeh chu “Keima eikihot bolhi Pakaiyin ajah doh phat'a chapa hiche jong hi eipeh kit ahiye,” Hijeh achu amin Simeon asah tai.
en: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because the LORD has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.
text:
GEN 29:33
Thadou: Chuin aman nao avop kit in chapa khat ahing kit tai, ajeh chu “Keima eikihot bolhi Pakaiyin ajah doh phat'a chapa hiche jong hi eipeh kit ahiye,” Hijeh achu amin Simeon asah tai.
English: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because the LORD has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.

tcz: Hichun Leah achung gih in, nao avop kittan ama nun hitin aseiye, “Tua pat'a hi ka jipa toh thakhat tipum khat kahi lhon ding ahi tai, ajeh chu keiman cha pasal thum ka hin pehtai hichun naosen chu amin chu Levi asah tai.”
en: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.
text:
GEN 29:34
Thadou: Hichun Leah achung gih in, nao avop kittan ama nun hitin aseiye, “Tua pat'a hi ka jipa toh thakhat tipum khat kahi lhon ding ahi tai, ajeh chu keiman cha pasal thum ka hin pehtai hichun naosen chu amin chu Levi asah tai.”
English: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.

tcz: Chujouvin Leah in nao avop kit in chapa khat ahing in, “Tuchunga vang Pakai ka thangvah na ding ahi,” atin hijeh chun amin Judah asah tai, chujou a pat in vang cha abang tan ahi.
en: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time I will praise the LORD.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.
text:
GEN 29:35
Thadou: Chujouvin Leah in nao avop kit in chapa khat ahing in, “Tuchunga vang Pakai ka thangvah na ding ahi,” atin hijeh chun amin Judah asah tai, chujou a pat in vang cha abang tan ahi.
English: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time I will praise the LORD.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.

tcz: Hichun Rachel'in Jacob cha ahinpeh lou akihet chet phat in a sopinu athangset pin, hijeh chun Jacob komma atao tan, “Keijong cha le nao nei hinpeh in achuti loule keima thi ding ka nom jotai atin ahi.”
en: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”
text:
GEN 30:1
Thadou: Hichun Rachel'in Jacob cha ahinpeh lou akihet chet phat in a sopinu athangset pin, hijeh chun Jacob komma atao tan, “Keijong cha le nao nei hinpeh in achuti loule keima thi ding ka nom jotai atin ahi.”
English: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”

tcz: Jacob chu Rachel chunga alung hang jah jeng in, “Keima Pathen ka hipoi ama ahi cha nei louva na koi, na naobu khah tan achu,” ati.
en: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”
text:
GEN 30:2
Thadou: Jacob chu Rachel chunga alung hang jah jeng in, “Keima Pathen ka hipoi ama ahi cha nei louva na koi, na naobu khah tan achu,” ati.
English: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”

tcz: Hichun Rachel in adonbut in, “Kasohnu Bilhah hi galup khompi tan, chutile amanun nao eihin peh intin chua konna chu keiman jong ka chilhah insung kaki semdoh thei ding ahi,” ati.
en: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”
text:
GEN 30:3
Thadou: Hichun Rachel in adonbut in, “Kasohnu Bilhah hi galup khompi tan, chutile amanun nao eihin peh intin chua konna chu keiman jong ka chilhah insung kaki semdoh thei ding ahi,” ati.
English: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”

tcz: Rachel in Bilhah asohnu chu Jacob ji din apetai chuin Jacob'in Bilhah chu akitimat pitai.
en: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.
text:
GEN 30:4
Thadou: Rachel in Bilhah asohnu chu Jacob ji din apetai chuin Jacob'in Bilhah chu akitimat pitai.
English: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.

tcz: Bilhah in nao ahinvop'in Jacob ding in chapa khat ahin peh tai.
en: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.
text:
GEN 30:5
Thadou: Bilhah in nao ahinvop'in Jacob ding in chapa khat ahin peh tai.
English: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

tcz: Hichun Rachel in aseiye, “Pathen in ka lunggel eisu bulhit pehtai, chule katao na jong eisan peh in chapa eipe tai atin hijeh chun naosen min chu Dan asahtai.”
en: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.
text:
GEN 30:6
Thadou: Hichun Rachel in aseiye, “Pathen in ka lunggel eisu bulhit pehtai, chule katao na jong eisan peh in chapa eipe tai atin hijeh chun naosen min chu Dan asahtai.”
