tcz: Jacob'in adonbut in, “Ka Pakai neihet them peh mai jin, chate ho hi alhasam thei lheh na laiyun, gancha bongnou hole kelnou ho jong api hontoh ki khen thei lou lai ahiuvin, nikhat sunga hatah in kihoi pai taleh gancha honte aboncha thigam jeng thei ahiuve.
en: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.
text:
GEN 33:13
Thadou: Jacob'in adonbut in, “Ka Pakai neihet them peh mai jin, chate ho hi alhasam thei lheh na laiyun, gancha bongnou hole kelnou ho jong api hontoh ki khen thei lou lai ahiuvin, nikhat sunga hatah in kihoi pai taleh gancha honte aboncha thigam jeng thei ahiuve.
English: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.

tcz: Hijeh chun lungset tah in na sohpa masanga kapu ana masa jeng in lang keiman olcha chan ka masanga gancha ho ki kalvan bang ule chapang te kikalvan bang bangu hin, Seir gam'a kapu heng kahin phah kah sen hung nange ati.
en: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”
text:
GEN 33:14
Thadou: Hijeh chun lungset tah in na sohpa masanga kapu ana masa jeng in lang keiman olcha chan ka masanga gancha ho ki kalvan bang ule chapang te kikalvan bang bangu hin, Seir gam'a kapu heng kahin phah kah sen hung nange ati.
English: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”

tcz: Apha lheh jenge tin Esau in adonbut in, “Hinlah ka miteho them khat tou dalhang kating nangho lam hil ding chule boina le hahsat na a pan lathei ding ati, Jacob in adonbut in, “Hiche hochu ngai ponte, lungset umtah'a kapu neina lamdot hi alhingset in ka sange,” ati.
en: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”
text:
GEN 33:15
Thadou: Apha lheh jenge tin Esau in adonbut in, “Hinlah ka miteho them khat tou dalhang kating nangho lam hil ding chule boina le hahsat na a pan lathei ding ati, Jacob in adonbut in, “Hiche hochu ngai ponte, lungset umtah'a kapu neina lamdot hi alhingset in ka sange,” ati.
English: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”

tcz: Hichun Esau chu aki nunghei jin Seir gam jon ding chun hiche ni mama chun achekit tai.
en: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.
text:
GEN 33:16
Thadou: Hichun Esau chu aki nunghei jin Seir gam jon ding chun hiche ni mama chun achekit tai.
English: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

tcz: Jacob vang chu ahile Succoth lama achen hiche muna chun inlim gancha ho din asong in, chule ama chenna ding in jong in aki sahtai. Hiche jeh a chu hiche mun chu Succoth kiti ahi. (Succoth tichu chenna mun tina ahi).
en: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
text:
GEN 33:17
Thadou: Jacob vang chu ahile Succoth lama achen hiche muna chun inlim gancha ho din asong in, chule ama chenna ding in jong in aki sahtai. Hiche jeh a chu hiche mun chu Succoth kiti ahi. (Succoth tichu chenna mun tina ahi).
English: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin Jacob chu Padan-Ram lammah kon in Shechem Canaan gam ahung lhung tan, hiche khopi phah masanga chun ngah mun khat asem kit tai.
en: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.
text:
GEN 33:18
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin Jacob chu Padan-Ram lammah kon in Shechem Canaan gam ahung lhung tan, hiche khopi phah masanga chun ngah mun khat asem kit tai.
English: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.

tcz: Jacob'in Shechempa Hamor chate khut akon chun gam leiset phabep sum (Qesitah*) jakhat in aki choh in hikom achun ponbuh akison tai.
en: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.
text:
GEN 33:19
Thadou: Jacob'in Shechempa Hamor chate khut akon chun gam leiset phabep sum (Qesitah*) jakhat in aki choh in hikom achun ponbuh akison tai.
English: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.

tcz: Hichun aman maicham atungdoh in amin chu *El-Elohe Israel asah tai.
en: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.
text:
GEN 33:20
Thadou: Hichun aman maicham atungdoh in amin chu *El-Elohe Israel asah tai.
English: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.

tcz: Jacob le Leah chanu Dinah chu nikhat apot doh in hiche gam'a cheng numei khangthah hotoh kimuto din achen ahi.
en: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
text:
GEN 34:1
Thadou: Jacob le Leah chanu Dinah chu nikhat apot doh in hiche gam'a cheng numei khangthah hotoh kimuto din achen ahi.
English: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

tcz: Ahin hiche gam'a lengpa chapa Shechem Homar Hivite kitipa chun Dinah chu aman in aluppi tan ahi.
en: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.
text:
GEN 34:2
Thadou: Ahin hiche gam'a lengpa chapa Shechem Homar Hivite kitipa chun Dinah chu aman in aluppi tan ahi.
English: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.

tcz: Ahin amapa chun ahin ngailu lheh tan, hichun aman thudihtah a kihou limpi a nopsah ding chu adei lheh tai.
en: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.
text:
GEN 34:3
Thadou: Ahin amapa chun ahin ngailu lheh tan, hichun aman thudihtah a kihou limpi a nopsah ding chu adei lheh tai.
English: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.

tcz: Shechem in apa Homar jah a asei tan, hiche numei nuhi neipui peh un kaji din ka deiye ati.
en: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”
text:
GEN 34:4
Thadou: Shechem in apa Homar jah a asei tan, hiche numei nuhi neipui peh un kaji din ka deiye ati.
English: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Jacob in thusoh aja tan Shechem in Dinah aluppia asuhset chu ahe tan, ahin Jacob in achate gamlah a gancha ho ching ahi jeh u chun amaho ahung lhun angah in kam chang khat jeng cha jong akeh poi.
en: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.
text:
GEN 34:5
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Jacob in thusoh aja tan Shechem in Dinah aluppia asuhset chu ahe tan, ahin Jacob in achate gamlah a gancha ho ching ahi jeh u chun amaho ahung lhun angah in kam chang khat jeng cha jong akeh poi.
English: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.

tcz: Hamor Shechem pachu Jacob henga kihoulim ding in ache dohtai.
en: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.
text:
GEN 34:6
Thadou: Hamor Shechem pachu Jacob henga kihoulim ding in ache dohtai.
English: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.

tcz: Chuin Jacob chate loulam akon in ahung lhung tauvin amahon hiche thuho ajah uchun alung nommo lheh un kidang jong asa lheh uvin hatah in alunghang uvin, asopinu Dinah Shechem in asuhset na Jacob insung asuhboi chu bollou ding khat ahiye atiuve.
en: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.
text:
GEN 34:7
Thadou: Chuin Jacob chate loulam akon in ahung lhung tauvin amahon hiche thuho ajah uchun alung nommo lheh un kidang jong asa lheh uvin hatah in alunghang uvin, asopinu Dinah Shechem in asuhset na Jacob insung asuhboi chu bollou ding khat ahiye atiuve.
English: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.

tcz: Hamor in Jacob le achate aki houlim pin, aman aseiye, “Kachapa Shechem in na chanu alungset lheh jeng in ahi, lungset tah in amani chu ki chensah uhite.
en: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
text:
GEN 34:8
Thadou: Hamor in Jacob le achate aki houlim pin, aman aseiye, “Kachapa Shechem in na chanu alungset lheh jeng in ahi, lungset tah in amani chu ki chensah uhite.
English: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.

tcz: Ahithei dingle eiho chate kila tou hite, kei hon nangho chanu ho kipui uving kating, keima ho chanute ho jong nangho chapate ho din kipui un ati.
en: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.
text:
GEN 34:9
Thadou: Ahithei dingle eiho chate kila tou hite, kei hon nangho chanu ho kipui uving kating, keima ho chanute ho jong nangho chapate ho din kipui un ati.
English: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.

tcz: Hiche gamsunga hi ichen khom theiyu ahi, chule khosa uvin bolthei toh thei tong un, na nop chanu neile gou jong na kilam theiyu ahi.”
en: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”
text:
GEN 34:10
Thadou: Hiche gamsunga hi ichen khom theiyu ahi, chule khosa uvin bolthei toh thei tong un, na nop chanu neile gou jong na kilam theiyu ahi.”
English: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”

tcz: Shechem chu Dinah sopiho le apa jah a ataotan, “Lungset tah in nei khotou vin, ahithei ding le kaji din kaki pui nom e chule nangma hon na thum channu chu keiman ka peh ding na hiuve.”
en: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.
text:
GEN 34:11
Thadou: Shechem chu Dinah sopiho le apa jah a ataotan, “Lungset tah in nei khotou vin, ahithei ding le kaji din kaki pui nom e chule nangma hon na thum channu chu keiman ka peh ding na hiuve.”
English: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.

tcz: Numei nu chu kaji dinga nei peh pou ule keiman ipi thilpeh hijongle suhto thei ding alen aneo hileh kapeh ding ahi ati.
en: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”
text:
GEN 34:12
Thadou: Numei nu chu kaji dinga nei peh pou ule keiman ipi thilpeh hijongle suhto thei ding alen aneo hileh kapeh ding ahi ati.
English: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”

tcz: Hinlah Shechem in Dinah ana luppi a asuhset tah jeh chun Jacob chate chun Hamor le achapa Shechem chu lungpha lou tah in ahoulimpi tauve.
en: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,
text:
GEN 34:13
Thadou: Hinlah Shechem in Dinah ana luppi a asuhset tah jeh chun Jacob chate chun Hamor le achapa Shechem chu lungpha lou tah in ahoulimpi tauve.
English: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,

tcz: Amahon adonbut un, “Hiche hi keima ho moh nop lhah thei ka hi pouve, Ajeh chu nangho hi chep tanlou na hiuvin, ka sopinu'u nanghon nakipui dingu chu keiho dinga jachat umtah khat hung hi ding ahi.
en: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.
text:
GEN 34:14
Thadou: Amahon adonbut un, “Hiche hi keima ho moh nop lhah thei ka hi pouve, Ajeh chu nangho hi chep tanlou na hiuvin, ka sopinu'u nanghon nakipui dingu chu keiho dinga jachat umtah khat hung hi ding ahi.
English: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.

tcz: Hinlah kihou cham theina khat vang aum'e, hichu ahileh na pasal ho jouse achep na tan thei diu le atiuve.
en: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,
text:
GEN 34:15
Thadou: Hinlah kihou cham theina khat vang aum'e, hichu ahileh na pasal ho jouse achep na tan thei diu le atiuve.
English: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,

tcz: Hiche teng chule ka chanu teho'u kapeh theiyu, chule nang ho chanu ho jong keima hon jong kaki pui thei dingu ahi atiuve.
en: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
text:
GEN 34:16
Thadou: Hiche teng chule ka chanu teho'u kapeh theiyu, chule nang ho chanu ho jong keima hon jong kaki pui thei dingu ahi atiuve.
English: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

tcz: Ahin nangho pasal hon acheptan ding anop lou ule ka sopinu'u ka peh theilou dingu ahi atiuve.
en: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”
text:
GEN 34:17
Thadou: Ahin nangho pasal hon acheptan ding anop lou ule ka sopinu'u ka peh theilou dingu ahi atiuve.
English: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”

tcz: Hamor le achapa Shechem chun amaho thilgon chu pha asa lhon in ahi.
en: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.
text:
GEN 34:18
Thadou: Hamor le achapa Shechem chun amaho thilgon chu pha asa lhon in ahi.
English: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.

tcz: Shechem chu alunglhai lheh in bol ding ho chu agei sang tapon, ajeh chu Dinah Jacob chanu adei behset jeh chun Shechem chu amaho insung milah a jathei umdol tah khat ahi.
en: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.
text:
GEN 34:19
Thadou: Shechem chu alunglhai lheh in bol ding ho chu agei sang tapon, ajeh chu Dinah Jacob chanu adei behset jeh chun Shechem chu amaho insung milah a jathei umdol tah khat ahi.
English: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.

tcz: Chuin Hamor le achapa Shechem khopi kelkot a ahung lhon in mipi ho laha aki hou na'u kinop tona ho chu ahung phong doh lhon in hitin asei lhon in ahi.
en: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,
text:
GEN 34:20
Thadou: Chuin Hamor le achapa Shechem khopi kelkot a ahung lhon in mipi ho laha aki hou na'u kinop tona ho chu ahung phong doh lhon in hitin asei lhon in ahi.
English: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,

tcz: Ama nin aphong doh lhon in hiche miho hi mipha eiho mi ahi ati lhon e, veuvin gam jong lentah enei uvin amaho chenna thei ding, amaho toh chengkhom uhitin, bolthei thei bol uhitin, eihon jong amaho chanute ijon thei ding'u chule amahon jong eiho chanute aki chenpi thei dingu ahi,” ati.
en: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let’s take their daughters to us for wives, and let’s give them our daughters.
text:
GEN 34:21
Thadou: Ama nin aphong doh lhon in hiche miho hi mipha eiho mi ahi ati lhon e, veuvin gam jong lentah enei uvin amaho chenna thei ding, amaho toh chengkhom uhitin, bolthei thei bol uhitin, eihon jong amaho chanute ijon thei ding'u chule amahon jong eiho chanute aki chenpi thei dingu ahi,” ati.
English: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let’s take their daughters to us for wives, and let’s give them our daughters.

tcz: Amaho toh eiho ichen khom thei na diuvin thil khat aum e, hichu ahileh eiho pasal jouse amaho banga chep ekitan tengu le ichen khom thei ding'u ahi.
en: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.
text:
GEN 34:22
Thadou: Amaho toh eiho ichen khom thei na diuvin thil khat aum e, hichu ahileh eiho pasal jouse amaho banga chep ekitan tengu le ichen khom thei ding'u ahi.
English: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.

tcz: Hinlah thilpha khat ihet dingu chu ichen khom tengule, agancha hou, anei agou hou jouse aboncha a eiho a hung hithei ahi. Hijeh chun amahon adei atup ho chu bolpeh leuhen amaho jong eiho lah a chen ding tha nom tah a hung cheng diu ahi tai.
en: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let’s give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”
text:
GEN 34:23
Thadou: Hinlah thilpha khat ihet dingu chu ichen khom tengule, agancha hou, anei agou hou jouse aboncha a eiho a hung hithei ahi. Hijeh chun amahon adei atup ho chu bolpeh leuhen amaho jong eiho lah a chen ding tha nom tah a hung cheng diu ahi tai.
English: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let’s give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”

tcz: Hichun khopi sunga cheng aching athem jouse Hamor le achapa Shechem thupeh chu anom cheh tauvin, chule pasal jousen achep akitan soh hel tauvin ahi.
en: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.
text:
GEN 34:24
Thadou: Hichun khopi sunga cheng aching athem jouse Hamor le achapa Shechem thupeh chu anom cheh tauvin, chule pasal jousen achep akitan soh hel tauvin ahi.
English: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

tcz: Ahin nithum jou don chun amaho cheptan na maha jong damtheng loulai in Jacob chateni Simon le Levi a sopinu Dinah toh peng khom teni chu ahung kon lhon in hiche khopi sunga pasal jouse chemjam in asat lih lhontan ahi.
en: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.
text:
GEN 34:25
Thadou: Ahin nithum jou don chun amaho cheptan na maha jong damtheng loulai in Jacob chateni Simon le Levi a sopinu Dinah toh peng khom teni chu ahung kon lhon in hiche khopi sunga pasal jouse chemjam in asat lih lhontan ahi.
English: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.

tcz: Hiche athi ho lah achun Hamor le achapa Shechem jong ajao lhon tai, Hichun Dinah chu Shechem in muna kon in amaho inlam a ahin pui lhon tan ahi.
en: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
text:
GEN 34:26
Thadou: Hiche athi ho lah achun Hamor le achapa Shechem jong ajao lhon tai, Hichun Dinah chu Shechem in muna kon in amaho inlam a ahin pui lhon tan ahi.
English: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou in Jacob chate ho ahung lhung cheh tauvin, amahon khopi sunga mipi athi amang akithat ho chu asopinu u ki suhthang na khopi chu achom theng hel uve.
en: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
text:
GEN 34:27
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jou in Jacob chate ho ahung lhung cheh tauvin, amahon khopi sunga mipi athi amang akithat ho chu asopinu u ki suhthang na khopi chu achom theng hel uve.
English: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

tcz: Amahon akelngoi hou ahin, abongchal hou chule sangan ho jouse phaicham khopi sungle tollhang a thil keo jouse akilah tauve.
en: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,
text:
GEN 34:28
Thadou: Amahon akelngoi hou ahin, abongchal hou chule sangan ho jouse phaicham khopi sungle tollhang a thil keo jouse akilah tauve.
English: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,

tcz: Anei agou jouse jong alah peh soh keijun, amaho jite chate jong alah peh un, amaho hetkhah nalouva apui mang tauve.
en: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.
text:
GEN 34:29
Thadou: Anei agou jouse jong alah peh soh keijun, amaho jite chate jong alah peh un, amaho hetkhah nalouva apui mang tauve.
English: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.

tcz: Jacob in phat chomkhat jouvin Simon le Levi koma hitin aseiye, “Keima hi neisuh mang lhon ahi tai, hiche gam mite le Canaan mite le Perizzites mite koma hin ka namse in ka ui lheh tai. chule eiho lhomcha ihiuvin amaho ahung kihou toh tengule eiho eisuh mang dingu ahi. keima kahin ka insung pumpi kaki chai helding ahitai,” ati.
en: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”
text:
GEN 34:30
Thadou: Jacob in phat chomkhat jouvin Simon le Levi koma hitin aseiye, “Keima hi neisuh mang lhon ahi tai, hiche gam mite le Canaan mite le Perizzites mite koma hin ka namse in ka ui lheh tai. chule eiho lhomcha ihiuvin amaho ahung kihou toh tengule eiho eisuh mang dingu ahi. keima kahin ka insung pumpi kaki chai helding ahitai,” ati.
English: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”

tcz: Ama hon lung hang tah in asei jun, “Ipi bol'a chu isopinu u chu numei kijoh banga abolset ham?” atiuve.
en: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”
text:
GEN 34:31
Thadou: Ama hon lung hang tah in asei jun, “Ipi bol'a chu isopinu u chu numei kijoh banga abolset ham?” atiuve.
English: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Jacob ahoulimpin, “Kithouvin lang Bethel lama kinungle kit inlang hikom a chun gacheng tan, chule na upa Esau koma nahung jampet'a nahenga hung kilah Pathen ding chun hikoma chun maicham khat gasem in,” ati.
en: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”
text:
GEN 35:1
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in Jacob ahoulimpin, “Kithouvin lang Bethel lama kinungle kit inlang hikom a chun gacheng tan, chule na upa Esau koma nahung jampet'a nahenga hung kilah Pathen ding chun hikoma chun maicham khat gasem in,” ati.
English: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”

tcz: Chuin Jacob in a insung mite ahin midang akoma cheng ho jah a hitin aseiye, “Doiphung jouse pai mang un, natahsa kisuhthengun, vonthah kivon un,
en: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.
text:
GEN 35:2
Thadou: Chuin Jacob in a insung mite ahin midang akoma cheng ho jah a hitin aseiye, “Doiphung jouse pai mang un, natahsa kisuhthengun, vonthah kivon un,
English: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

tcz: Tua eiho Bethel lama iche diu Pathen henga maicham ka semding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai in ka hahsat laitah a kataona eisan pehin, Ama in kache na kalam jotna jouse a eiumpi jinge ati.
en: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”
text:
GEN 35:3
Thadou: Tua eiho Bethel lama iche diu Pathen henga maicham ka semding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai in ka hahsat laitah a kataona eisan pehin, Ama in kache na kalam jotna jouse a eiumpi jinge ati.
English: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”

tcz: Hichun amahon gamdang mite indoi akoi jouseu chule abil uva abilba u abonchan Jacob apeuvin ahile Jacob'in abonchan Shechem nai vel'a gangpi phungnoi khat ah agavui mang tai.
en: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
text:
GEN 35:4
Thadou: Hichun amahon gamdang mite indoi akoi jouseu chule abil uva abilba u abonchan Jacob apeuvin ahile Jacob'in abonchan Shechem nai vel'a gangpi phungnoi khat ah agavui mang tai.
English: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

tcz: Amaho ahung kon doh uchun Pathen a kona tijat na mipi adimun, hijeh chun Jacob insung mite bulu din koimacha ahung kondoh ngam tapoi.
en: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
text:
GEN 35:5
Thadou: Amaho ahung kon doh uchun Pathen a kona tijat na mipi adimun, hijeh chun Jacob insung mite bulu din koimacha ahung kondoh ngam tapoi.
English: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.

tcz: Jacob le a insung mite Luz kiti mun hichu Bethel Cannan gam sunga um ahi. (Bethel ti chu Pathen in tina ahi).
en: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
text:
GEN 35:6
Thadou: Jacob le a insung mite Luz kiti mun hichu Bethel Cannan gam sunga um ahi. (Bethel ti chu Pathen in tina ahi).
English: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.

tcz: Chule hikom'a chun Jacob in maicham khat asem in, hiche lai mun chu EL-Bethel asah in ahi. Ajeh chu aupa henga kona ahung jam doh a chu hikoma chu Pathen ama among mong ahenga hung kiphong ahi.
en: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
text:
GEN 35:7
Thadou: Chule hikom'a chun Jacob in maicham khat asem in, hiche lai mun chu EL-Bethel asah in ahi. Ajeh chu aupa henga kona ahung jam doh a chu hikoma chu Pathen ama among mong ahenga hung kiphong ahi.
English: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

tcz: Rebekah jenle nu Deborah athi a chu Bethel noiya gangpi phungnoi khat ah ana kivui ahin, hiche jeh a chu hiche min chu lhilon na gangpi phung kisah ahiye.
en: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.
text:
GEN 35:8
Thadou: Rebekah jenle nu Deborah athi a chu Bethel noiya gangpi phungnoi khat ah ana kivui ahin, hiche jeh a chu hiche min chu lhilon na gangpi phung kisah ahiye.
English: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Jacob Padan-Arama kona ahung chun ana kimuto pi kitin, chuin Bethel muna Pathen in phatthei aboh kit in ahi.
en: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.
text:
GEN 35:9
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in Jacob Padan-Arama kona ahung chun ana kimuto pi kitin, chuin Bethel muna Pathen in phatthei aboh kit in ahi.
English: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.

tcz: Pathen in ahoulimpin ajah'a, “Namin hi Jacob ahin tunia patna hi nangma Jacob na kiti talou ding ahi. Amavang ISRAEL kiti ding na hitai,” hichun Pathen in ama pa min chu Israel asah tai.
en: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.
text:
GEN 35:10
Thadou: Pathen in ahoulimpin ajah'a, “Namin hi Jacob ahin tunia patna hi nangma Jacob na kiti talou ding ahi. Amavang ISRAEL kiti ding na hitai,” hichun Pathen in ama pa min chu Israel asah tai.
English: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Keima El-Shaddai kahi. Pathen hattah ka hi, hatah in ga un, hatah in pung tul tul un, nam lentah ka so ding nahi, chule chilhah jong tamtah kapeh ding nahi,” ati.
en: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.
text:
GEN 35:11
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in aseiye, “Keima El-Shaddai kahi. Pathen hattah ka hi, hatah in ga un, hatah in pung tul tul un, nam lentah ka so ding nahi, chule chilhah jong tamtah kapeh ding nahi,” ati.
English: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.

tcz: Chule khatvei Abraham, Isaac kapeh gamchu nangma le na insung mite kapeh kitding nahi, khonung teng jongle nangma kapeh ding nahi.
en: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”
text:
GEN 35:12
Thadou: Chule khatvei Abraham, Isaac kapeh gamchu nangma le na insung mite kapeh kitding nahi, khonung teng jongle nangma kapeh ding nahi.
English: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”

tcz: Hichun Pakai vantil chu Jacob akihoulimpi na akon in achemang tai.
en: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.
text:
GEN 35:13
Thadou: Hichun Pakai vantil chu Jacob akihoulimpi na akon in achemang tai.
English: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.

tcz: Jacob'in Pakai toa kimuto na melchihna ding in hiche muna chun song khom khat aphut doh kitin, hiche khom chunga chun kilhaina ju asun khum in, chule hiche chunga chun Olive thao twi asun khume.
en: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.
text:
GEN 35:14
Thadou: Jacob'in Pakai toa kimuto na melchihna ding in hiche muna chun song khom khat aphut doh kitin, hiche khom chunga chun kilhaina ju asun khum in, chule hiche chunga chun Olive thao twi asun khume.
English: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.

tcz: Chule Jacob'in hilai mun chu Bethel asah tan ahi.
en: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.
text:
GEN 35:15
Thadou: Chule Jacob'in hilai mun chu Bethel asah tan ahi.
English: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.

tcz: Jacob le a insung miten Bethel chu adalhau vin, Ephratha lam ajot laitah un Rachel chu anaovop nat ahung kipantan, akhol che nao jong lhung joujep lou lai ahin, amanu soh dingin ha nat nat'in ahung natai.
en: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.
text:
GEN 35:16
Thadou: Jacob le a insung miten Bethel chu adalhau vin, Ephratha lam ajot laitah un Rachel chu anaovop nat ahung kipantan, akhol che nao jong lhung joujep lou lai ahin, amanu soh dingin ha nat nat'in ahung natai.
English: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.

tcz: Rachel chu soh dinga hanat'a anat pet chun anaodom a pang a sohnu numei ho chun hitin ahoulimpi uve, “Nangma kicha hih in, lungneo hih beh in, chapa khat na neibe ding ahi,” atiuve.
en: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”
text:
GEN 35:17
Thadou: Rachel chu soh dinga hanat'a anat pet chun anaodom a pang a sohnu numei ho chun hitin ahoulimpi uve, “Nangma kicha hih in, lungneo hih beh in, chapa khat na neibe ding ahi,” atiuve.
English: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”

tcz: Hinlah Rachel chu alhagao apotdoh tai, ajeh chu amanu athia ahitan ahi; hijeh chun aman jong nao min chu Ben-oni asah in (Ben-oni tichu, ka thoh gimpeta kacha tina ahi), apan vang Benjamin asah tai. (Benjamin tichu, kajet lama pang chapa tina ahi).
en: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.
text:
GEN 35:18
Thadou: Hinlah Rachel chu alhagao apotdoh tai, ajeh chu amanu athia ahitan ahi; hijeh chun aman jong nao min chu Ben-oni asah in (Ben-oni tichu, ka thoh gimpeta kacha tina ahi), apan vang Benjamin asah tai. (Benjamin tichu, kajet lama pang chapa tina ahi).
English: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.

tcz: Rachel chu athitan Ephratha lampia avui tau vin ahi.
en: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).
text:
GEN 35:19
Thadou: Rachel chu athitan Ephratha lampia avui tau vin ahi.
English: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).

tcz: Jacob'in angailut hetjing nan Rachel lhan song asem peh in, tuni gei hin hiche Rachel lhan hi aum jing nalaiye.
en: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.
text:
GEN 35:20
Thadou: Jacob'in angailut hetjing nan Rachel lhan song asem peh in, tuni gei hin hiche Rachel lhan hi aum jing nalaiye.
English: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.

tcz: Hichun Israel (Jacob) chu achen pondal buh chu Eder inting vum geiyin atung doh e.
en: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
text:
GEN 35:21
Thadou: Hichun Israel (Jacob) chu achen pondal buh chu Eder inting vum geiyin atung doh e.
English: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

tcz: Israel chuche gamsunga ana cheng nalaiyin, ahin Reuben in apa jithahnu Bilhah chu ana chonsetpin ana luppi tan, hiche thu chu Israel in jong aja tai. Chule Jacob chapate chu som le ni alhinguve.
en: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.
text:
GEN 35:22
Thadou: Israel chuche gamsunga ana cheng nalaiyin, ahin Reuben in apa jithahnu Bilhah chu ana chonsetpin ana luppi tan, hiche thu chu Israel in jong aja tai. Chule Jacob chapate chu som le ni alhinguve.
English: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

tcz: Leah chapate chu Reuben, Jacob chapa apeng masa pen, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar chule Zebulun ahiuve.
en: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
text:
GEN 35:23
Thadou: Leah chapate chu Reuben, Jacob chapa apeng masa pen, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar chule Zebulun ahiuve.
English: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

tcz: Rachel chapate ni chu Joseph le Benjamin ahi lhon'e.
en: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
text:
GEN 35:24
Thadou: Rachel chapate ni chu Joseph le Benjamin ahi lhon'e.
English: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

tcz: Rachel sohnu Bilhah chapate nichu Dan le Naphtali ahilhon in,
en: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.
text:
GEN 35:25
Thadou: Rachel sohnu Bilhah chapate nichu Dan le Naphtali ahilhon in,
English: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.

tcz: Leah sohnu Zilpah chapate ni chu Gad le Asher ahi lhone. Hi chengse hi Jacob'in Padan-Ram gamsunga ahindoh achapate chu ahiuve.
en: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
text:
GEN 35:26
Thadou: Leah sohnu Zilpah chapate ni chu Gad le Asher ahi lhone. Hi chengse hi Jacob'in Padan-Ram gamsunga ahindoh achapate chu ahiuve.
English: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

tcz: Hichun Jacob apa Isaac koma ahung kinungle kit tan Mamre a Kiriath-arba gam (Hebron tiajong kisei) phatkhat laia Abraham le Isaac maljin na ana umna'u mun chu ahi.
en: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.
text:
GEN 35:27
Thadou: Hichun Jacob apa Isaac koma ahung kinungle kit tan Mamre a Kiriath-arba gam (Hebron tiajong kisei) phatkhat laia Abraham le Isaac maljin na ana umna'u mun chu ahi.
English: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.

tcz: Isaac chu akum kum jakhat le kum som get ana lhing tan ahi.
en: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.
text:
GEN 35:28
Thadou: Isaac chu akum kum jakhat le kum som get ana lhing tan ahi.
English: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.

tcz: Hichun Isaac ahaitan in ahinkho abeitai, anam mite ho jouse ateh akhang abonchauvin a nilhum gei in op cheh un, chuin achate ni Esau le Jacob in avui lhon tai.
en: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.
text:
GEN 35:29
Thadou: Hichun Isaac ahaitan in ahinkho abeitai, anam mite ho jouse ateh akhang abonchauvin a nilhum gei in op cheh un, chuin achate ni Esau le Jacob in avui lhon tai.
English: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.

tcz: Hiche hose hi Esau phunggui Edom tiajong kisei ahi.
en: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
text:
GEN 36:1
Thadou: Hiche hose hi Esau phunggui Edom tiajong kisei ahi.
English: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

tcz: Esau in Canaan nungah ni aji din ana ki pui'in khat nu chu Hite mi Adah Elton ahi, anina nu chu ahile Oholibamah Anah chanu ahin Zibeon Hivi tedinga atunu u ahi.
en: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;

tcz: Chule Esau in asopinu Basemath Ishmael chanu Nebaioth naonu jong ajidin aki puiye.
en: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
text:
GEN 36:3
Thadou: Chule Esau in asopinu Basemath Ishmael chanu Nebaioth naonu jong ajidin aki puiye.
English: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

tcz: Adah chun chapa amin Eliphaz Esau ahin peh in Basemath chun chapa Reul ahing in ahi.
en: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
text:
GEN 36:4
Thadou: Adah chun chapa amin Eliphaz Esau ahin peh in Basemath chun chapa Reul ahing in ahi.
English: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.

tcz: Oholibamath chun Canaan gam'a achen laiyin chapa thum Esau din ana hinpeh in, amaho min chu ahile Jeush, Jalam, chule Korah ahiuve.
en: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
text:
GEN 36:5
Thadou: Oholibamath chun Canaan gam'a achen laiyin chapa thum Esau din ana hinpeh in, amaho min chu ahile Jeush, Jalam, chule Korah ahiuve.
English: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

tcz: Esau in ajite le achate cheng abonchauvin, agancha ho jouse, abongchal ho jouse, chule anei agou thil jouse Canaan gam'a achen laiya alam doh jouse apon mun chom ajon tan, asopipa Jacob chu adalhatan ahi.
en: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
text:
GEN 36:6
Thadou: Esau in ajite le achate cheng abonchauvin, agancha ho jouse, abongchal ho jouse, chule anei agou thil jouse Canaan gam'a achen laiya alam doh jouse apon mun chom ajon tan, asopipa Jacob chu adalhatan ahi.
English: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile amaho anei agou ho chu apung lheh tan, aum khom ding'u ahahsa lheh tan, chule gamsung jong adam jou tapon, amani gancha ho lhat khom na ding jong ahi thei tapon ahi.
en: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.
text:
GEN 36:7
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile amaho anei agou ho chu apung lheh tan, aum khom ding'u ahahsa lheh tan, chule gamsung jong adam jou tapon, amani gancha ho lhat khom na ding jong ahi thei tapon ahi.
English: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Esau (Edom) chu thinglhang lam a Seir kiti muna acheng tai.
en: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
text:
GEN 36:8
Thadou: Hijeh a chu Esau (Edom) chu thinglhang lam a Seir kiti muna acheng tai.
English: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.

tcz: Hiche hohi Esau thusim Edomite pa Seir thinglhanga ahung chen namun chu ahi.
en: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:
text:
GEN 36:9
Thadou: Hiche hohi Esau thusim Edomite pa Seir thinglhanga ahung chen namun chu ahi.
English: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:

tcz: Ama hohi Esau chilhahte ho min ahi, Eliphaz kitipa hi Adah in ahin chule Reul kitipa hi Esau loinu Basemath in ahin ahiye.
en: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
text:
GEN 36:10
Thadou: Ama hohi Esau chilhahte ho min ahi, Eliphaz kitipa hi Adah in ahin chule Reul kitipa hi Esau loinu Basemath in ahin ahiye.
English: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.

tcz: Eliphaz chilhah ho Teman, Omar, Canaan chule Kanaz ahiuve.
en: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
text:
GEN 36:11
Thadou: Eliphaz chilhah ho Teman, Omar, Canaan chule Kanaz ahiuve.
English: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

tcz: Timna, Eliphaz jithahnu chapa khat ahing in amin chu Amalek ahi. Amaho se hi Esau jinu Adah in ahin ama hung kikhailha chilhah ho ahiuve.
en: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.
text:
GEN 36:12
Thadou: Timna, Eliphaz jithahnu chapa khat ahing in amin chu Amalek ahi. Amaho se hi Esau jinu Adah in ahin ama hung kikhailha chilhah ho ahiuve.
English: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.

tcz: Reul chapate ho chu Nahath, Zerath, Shammah chule Mizzah ahi. Amaho se hi Esau jinu Basemath chilhah ho ahiuve.
en: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
text:
GEN 36:13
Thadou: Reul chapate ho chu Nahath, Zerath, Shammah chule Mizzah ahi. Amaho se hi Esau jinu Basemath chilhah ho ahiuve.
English: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

tcz: Esau chate ho Aholibamath in ahin ho chu, Jeush, Jalam, chule Korah ahi uvin, Aholibamah hi Anah chanu Zibeon dinga atute ahung hitai.
en: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
text:
GEN 36:14
Thadou: Esau chate ho Aholibamath in ahin ho chu, Jeush, Jalam, chule Korah ahi uvin, Aholibamah hi Anah chanu Zibeon dinga atute ahung hitai.
English: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

tcz: Hiche hohi Esau chate chilhahte phung choma hung lamkai ho ahi uve, Esau chapa tahpen chilhah ho Eliphaz a hung kikhai lha ho, Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz ahin,
en: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
text:
GEN 36:15
Thadou: Hiche hohi Esau chate chilhahte phung choma hung lamkai ho ahi uve, Esau chapa tahpen chilhah ho Eliphaz a hung kikhai lha ho, Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz ahin,
English: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

tcz: Korah chule Gatam chule Amalek amaho se hi Eliphaz phung lamkai Edom gamsunga cheng ahiuvin, amaho jouse hi Esau jinu Adah chilhah a kona hung peng doh ahiuve.
en: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.
text:
GEN 36:16
Thadou: Korah chule Gatam chule Amalek amaho se hi Eliphaz phung lamkai Edom gamsunga cheng ahiuvin, amaho jouse hi Esau jinu Adah chilhah a kona hung peng doh ahiuve.
English: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.

tcz: Esau chapa Reul a kona hung pengdoh ho phung lamkai ho chu, Nahath, Zertah, Shammath chule Mizzah ahiuve. Amaho chenghi phung lamkai Edom gam sunga Reul chate ahin, Esau jinu Basemath chilhah a kona hung peng doh ahiuve.
en: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
text:
GEN 36:17
Thadou: Esau chapa Reul a kona hung pengdoh ho phung lamkai ho chu, Nahath, Zertah, Shammath chule Mizzah ahiuve. Amaho chenghi phung lamkai Edom gam sunga Reul chate ahin, Esau jinu Basemath chilhah a kona hung peng doh ahiuve.
English: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

tcz: Esau chate ho Oholibamah toh ahin ho Jeush, Jalam chule Korah ahiuve. Amaho se hi phung lamkai cheh jong ahung hitauvin, hiche phung lamkai ho sese hi Esau loinu Oholibamah kitinu Anah chanu chilhah a hung kon doh ahiuve.
en: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
text:
GEN 36:18
Thadou: Esau chate ho Oholibamah toh ahin ho Jeush, Jalam chule Korah ahiuve. Amaho se hi phung lamkai cheh jong ahung hitauvin, hiche phung lamkai ho sese hi Esau loinu Oholibamah kitinu Anah chanu chilhah a hung kon doh ahiuve.
English: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

tcz: Hiche phung hohi Esau a kona hung kon doh cheh ahiuvin, amaho hi Edom mi jong a kitiuve.
en: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
text:
GEN 36:19
Thadou: Hiche phung hohi Esau a kona hung kon doh cheh ahiuvin, amaho hi Edom mi jong a kitiuve.
English: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.

tcz: Seir Horite kitipa chate chengse hiche gam'a ana cheng ho chu amaho hi ahiuve, Lotan, Shobal, Anah chule Zeboan ahiuve.
en: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
text:
GEN 36:20
Thadou: Seir Horite kitipa chate chengse hiche gam'a ana cheng ho chu amaho hi ahiuve, Lotan, Shobal, Anah chule Zeboan ahiuve.
English: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

tcz: Edom gam'a cheng Seir chate langa pangho chu Horite chilhah ho chu Dishan, Ezer, chule Dishon ahiuve.
en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
text:
GEN 36:21
Thadou: Edom gam'a cheng Seir chate langa pangho chu Horite chilhah ho chu Dishan, Ezer, chule Dishon ahiuve.
English: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

tcz: Chule Lotan chate ho chu Hori le Heman ahin, Lotan sopinu min chu ahile Timna ahi.
en: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
text:
GEN 36:22
Thadou: Chule Lotan chate ho chu Hori le Heman ahin, Lotan sopinu min chu ahile Timna ahi.
English: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.

tcz: Shobal chapate chu Alvan ahin, Manahath ahin, Ebal ahin, Shepho ahin, chule Onam ahi.
en: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
text:
GEN 36:23
Thadou: Shobal chapate chu Alvan ahin, Manahath ahin, Ebal ahin, Shepho ahin, chule Onam ahi.
English: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

tcz: Zibeon chateni min chu Aiah le Anah ahilhone. Zibeon chapa Anah kitipa hin apa gancha sangante achin pet a nel gamgo lah a twisam putna ana mudoh ahi.
en: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
text:
GEN 36:24
Thadou: Zibeon chateni min chu Aiah le Anah ahilhone. Zibeon chapa Anah kitipa hin apa gancha sangante achin pet a nel gamgo lah a twisam putna ana mudoh ahi.
English: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

tcz: Anah chate ni chu Dishon le Anah chanu Oholibamah ahi lhone.
en: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
text:
GEN 36:25
Thadou: Anah chate ni chu Dishon le Anah chanu Oholibamah ahi lhone.
English: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.

tcz: Dishon chapate chu Hemdan le Eshban toh, Ithran toh, chule Cheran toh ahiuve.
en: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
text:
GEN 36:26
Thadou: Dishon chapate chu Hemdan le Eshban toh, Ithran toh, chule Cheran toh ahiuve.
English: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

tcz: Ezer chate ho chu Bilhan ahin, Zaavan ahin, chule Akan ahiuve.
en: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
text:
GEN 36:27
Thadou: Ezer chate ho chu Bilhan ahin, Zaavan ahin, chule Akan ahiuve.
English: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

tcz: Dishan chate ni chu Uz le Arana ahi lhone.
en: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
text:
GEN 36:28
Thadou: Dishan chate ni chu Uz le Arana ahi lhone.
English: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

tcz: Horite mi upa lamkai ho chu Lotan ahin, Shobal ahin, Zibeon ahin, Anah ahin,
en: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
text:
GEN 36:29
Thadou: Horite mi upa lamkai ho chu Lotan ahin, Shobal ahin, Zibeon ahin, Anah ahin,
English: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

tcz: Dishon, Ezer chule Dishan amaho cheng hi Horite mi upa ho amaho phung dungjuia Seir gamsunga cheng ahiuve.
en: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
text:
GEN 36:30
Thadou: Dishon, Ezer chule Dishan amaho cheng hi Horite mi upa ho amaho phung dungjuia Seir gamsunga cheng ahiuve.
English: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

tcz: Hiche lengho hi Edom gamsunga vai ana hom un amaho masanga Israel mite lah a leng vaipo ana um khalou lai ahi.
en: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
text:
GEN 36:31
Thadou: Hiche lengho hi Edom gamsunga vai ana hom un amaho masanga Israel mite lah a leng vaipo ana um khalou lai ahi.
English: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.

tcz: Beor chapa Bela chun Edom gamsunga lengvai anapon, ama khopi chu amin Dinhabah ahiye.
en: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.
text:
GEN 36:32
Thadou: Beor chapa Bela chun Edom gamsunga lengvai anapon, ama khopi chu amin Dinhabah ahiye.
English: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.

tcz: Bila athi jou chun Zerah chapa Johab chapa chu Bozrah gamsunga vaipon ahung pang in ahi.
en: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.
text:
GEN 36:33
Thadou: Bila athi jou chun Zerah chapa Johab chapa chu Bozrah gamsunga vaipon ahung pang in ahi.
English: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.

tcz: Johab athi jou chun Husham Temanite gam mipa chun lengvai ahin hom kit tai.
en: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
text:
GEN 36:34
Thadou: Johab athi jou chun Husham Temanite gam mipa chun lengvai ahin hom kit tai.
English: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

tcz: Hosham athi jou chun Bedal chapa Hadah chu lengvai ahinpon, ama chenna khopi Avith a pat'in Moab gamsunga Midianite ho jouse gal'a ahin joutan ahi.
en: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
text:
GEN 36:35
Thadou: Hosham athi jou chun Bedal chapa Hadah chu lengvai ahinpon, ama chenna khopi Avith a pat'in Moab gamsunga Midianite ho jouse gal'a ahin joutan ahi.
English: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.

tcz: Hadah athi jou chun Masrekah khopi a cheng Somlah in lengvai ahinpo kit tai.
en: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
text:
GEN 36:36
Thadou: Hadah athi jou chun Masrekah khopi a cheng Somlah in lengvai ahinpo kit tai.
English: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

tcz: Samlah athi jou chun Rehoboth vadung toh kinai khopi a cheng Saul chu ahung vaihom in ahi.
en: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.
text:
GEN 36:37
Thadou: Samlah athi jou chun Rehoboth vadung toh kinai khopi a cheng Saul chu ahung vaihom in ahi.
English: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.

tcz: Saul thi jou chun Achor chapa Baal-Hannan kitipa chun lengvai ahipo kit in ahi.
en: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
text:
GEN 36:38
Thadou: Saul thi jou chun Achor chapa Baal-Hannan kitipa chun lengvai ahipo kit in ahi.
English: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

tcz: Achor chapa Baal-Hannan athi jouchun, Hadar in Pau khopi apat in lengvai ahipo pantan, Hadar jinu min chu Mehetabel ahin Matred chanu Mazehab dinga atunu ahitai.
en: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
text:
GEN 36:39
Thadou: Achor chapa Baal-Hannan athi jouchun, Hadar in Pau khopi apat in lengvai ahipo pantan, Hadar jinu min chu Mehetabel ahin Matred chanu Mazehab dinga atunu ahitai.
English: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

tcz: Amaho phung lamkai jouse hi Esau chilhah a kona hung kondoh cheh ahiuvin, Timna gam'a cheng ahiuvin, mi upa Alvah ahin, mi upa Jetheth ahin,
en: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
text:
GEN 36:40
Thadou: Amaho phung lamkai jouse hi Esau chilhah a kona hung kondoh cheh ahiuvin, Timna gam'a cheng ahiuvin, mi upa Alvah ahin, mi upa Jetheth ahin,
English: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

tcz: Mi upa Oholibamah ahin, mi upa Elah ahin, mi upa Pinon ahin,
en: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
text:
GEN 36:41
Thadou: Mi upa Oholibamah ahin, mi upa Elah ahin, mi upa Pinon ahin,
English: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

tcz: Mi upa Kenaz ahin, mi upa Teman ahin, mi upa Mibzar ahin,
en: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
text:
GEN 36:42
Thadou: Mi upa Kenaz ahin, mi upa Teman ahin, mi upa Mibzar ahin,
English: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

tcz: Mi upa Magdiel ahin, chule mi upa Iram ahi; hicheng hi leiset atoupha na gamsung uva akho mun dung jui uva Edom chilhah a kon a mi upa ho chu ahiuve.
en: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
text:
GEN 36:43
Thadou: Mi upa Magdiel ahin, chule mi upa Iram ahi; hicheng hi leiset atoupha na gamsung uva akho mun dung jui uva Edom chilhah a kon a mi upa ho chu ahiuve.
English: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.

tcz: Hichun Jacob Canaan chu apa khopem na Canaan gamsunga anung chen kit tai.
en: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.
text:
GEN 37:1
Thadou: Hichun Jacob Canaan chu apa khopem na Canaan gamsunga anung chen kit tai.
English: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.

tcz: Hiche thusim hohi Jacob insung mite a ahi, Joseph kum som le sagi alhinin apa kelngoi ho asopi ho toh aching tup jingin avahva jingun, asopi ho apa jithah chate ho Bilhah le Zilpah chate ho toh natong khom jing ahiuve. Ahin nikhat chu Joseph in asopiho umchan phatlou dan apa kom ahin lhut tan ahi.
en: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.
text:
GEN 37:2
Thadou: Hiche thusim hohi Jacob insung mite a ahi, Joseph kum som le sagi alhinin apa kelngoi ho asopi ho toh aching tup jingin avahva jingun, asopi ho apa jithah chate ho Bilhah le Zilpah chate ho toh natong khom jing ahiuve. Ahin nikhat chu Joseph in asopiho umchan phatlou dan apa kom ahin lhut tan ahi.
English: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.

tcz: Amavang asopite hon Joseph chu avetda cheh un ahi, Ajeh chu apan midang ho sanga Joseph angailut najeh in amahon Joseph henga ngailut thucheng thupha seiding hahsa asa lheh un ahi.
en: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.
text:
GEN 37:4
Thadou: Amavang asopite hon Joseph chu avetda cheh un ahi, Ajeh chu apan midang ho sanga Joseph angailut najeh in amahon Joseph henga ngailut thucheng thupha seiding hahsa asa lheh un ahi.
English: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.

tcz: Joseph in nikhat mang anei in amang chu asopiho asei pehle amahon avetda cheh un ahi.
en: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.
text:
GEN 37:5
Thadou: Joseph in nikhat mang anei in amang chu asopiho asei pehle amahon avetda cheh un ahi.
English: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.

tcz: Aman aseiye, “Ngaijun ka mang ho kasei ding ahi ati.
en: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:
text:
GEN 37:6
Thadou: Aman aseiye, “Ngaijun ka mang ho kasei ding ahi ati.
English: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:

tcz: Ehon phailei lama chang phel ikan khom un, hiche tah chun hetman louvin keima changphal ho chu ading doh in, nangho changphal ho chu keima changphal masanga abohkhup uve,” ati.
en: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”
text:
GEN 37:7
Thadou: Ehon phailei lama chang phel ikan khom un, hiche tah chun hetman louvin keima changphal ho chu ading doh in, nangho changphal ho chu keima changphal masanga abohkhup uve,” ati.
English: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”

tcz: Hichun asopi hon adonbut un, “Amapa chun keiho chunga vaihom ding kigong nahim? Ahiloule keiho chunga thanei ding kigo mong nahim,” atiuve. Hichun amahon amang neitoh athusei doh ho jeh in hatah in avetdau vin ahi.
en: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.
text:
GEN 37:8
Thadou: Hichun asopi hon adonbut un, “Amapa chun keiho chunga vaihom ding kigong nahim? Ahiloule keiho chunga thanei ding kigo mong nahim,” atiuve. Hichun amahon amang neitoh athusei doh ho jeh in hatah in avetdau vin ahi.
English: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.

tcz: Joseph in mang khat aneibe kit in chuin asopi ho chu asei peh kit in aman aseiye, “Ngaijun mang khat ka neibe kitne ati, tun nisa, lha, chule ahsi som le khat ho jong keima masanga abohkhup cheh uve,” ati.
en: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”
text:
GEN 37:9
Thadou: Joseph in mang khat aneibe kit in chuin asopi ho chu asei peh kit in aman aseiye, “Ngaijun mang khat ka neibe kitne ati, tun nisa, lha, chule ahsi som le khat ho jong keima masanga abohkhup cheh uve,” ati.
English: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”

tcz: Tua mang aneipa hi Joseph in apa chule asopite ho jouse jong abonchan aseipeh soh keiyin ahi. Ahin apa in aphoh thip'in,” hiche mang chu ipi tina ham tin adonbut e, “nanu toh kei chule nasopi teho jouse atahbeh a kahung uva nang masanga ka hung boh khup dingu ham?”
en: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”
text:
GEN 37:10
Thadou: Tua mang aneipa hi Joseph in apa chule asopite ho jouse jong abonchan aseipeh soh keiyin ahi. Ahin apa in aphoh thip'in,” hiche mang chu ipi tina ham tin adonbut e, “nanu toh kei chule nasopi teho jouse atahbeh a kahung uva nang masanga ka hung boh khup dingu ham?”
English: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”

tcz: Ama vang Joseph sopiho chu alung ahang lheh un athangthip thei lheh un, apa vang chun hiche mang chu ipi tina ham ahet thei lou jeh in alung adong lheh in ahi.
en: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.
text:
GEN 37:11
Thadou: Ama vang Joseph sopiho chu alung ahang lheh un athangthip thei lheh un, apa vang chun hiche mang chu ipi tina ham ahet thei lou jeh in alung adong lheh in ahi.
English: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou chun Joseph sopiho chu Schechem lama apa kelngoi ching ding in achekit tauvin ahi.
en: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
text:
GEN 37:12
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jou chun Joseph sopiho chu Schechem lama apa kelngoi ching ding in achekit tauvin ahi.
English: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

tcz: Amaho chedoh jou phat chomkhat jouvin, Jacob in Joseph koma aseiye, “Nasopite ho Schechem lam a kelngoi hon ho aga vah un ahin, nangma naga che lou khoh ahi atin, Joseph in adonbut in, “keima kaga che ding ahi,” ati.
en: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”
text:
GEN 37:13
Thadou: Amaho chedoh jou phat chomkhat jouvin, Jacob in Joseph koma aseiye, “Nasopite ho Schechem lam a kelngoi hon ho aga vah un ahin, nangma naga che lou khoh ahi atin, Joseph in adonbut in, “keima kaga che ding ahi,” ati.
English: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”

tcz: Jacob in adon but in, “Nangma gache inlang na sopite ho chule kelngoi ho iti hina uvem gaven ati. Amaho thusoh kajah nom kitne, Hebron phaicham apat in asol tan, hichun Joseph hiche Schechem chu ahung lhung tan ahi.
en: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
text:
GEN 37:14
Thadou: Jacob in adon but in, “Nangma gache inlang na sopite ho chule kelngoi ho iti hina uvem gaven ati. Amaho thusoh kajah nom kitne, Hebron phaicham apat in asol tan, hichun Joseph hiche Schechem chu ahung lhung tan ahi.
English: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

tcz: Ahin vetan gamlah a lampi akimansah a ava koile na a mi khat in atoh khan mipa chun adongin “Ipi ham nahol le?” atile.
en: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”
text:
GEN 37:15
Thadou: Ahin vetan gamlah a lampi akimansah a ava koile na a mi khat in atoh khan mipa chun adongin “Ipi ham nahol le?” atile.
English: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”

tcz: Joseph in adonbut in, “Ka sopite ho kahol ahi atin, hoi langa gancha ho achin uham neisei peh thei ding ham,” ati.
en: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”
text:
GEN 37:16
Thadou: Joseph in adonbut in, “Ka sopite ho kahol ahi atin, hoi langa gancha ho achin uham neisei peh thei ding ham,” ati.
English: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”

tcz: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Amaho kihou limna kajan eiho Dothan lama chetau hite,” aki tiuve.
en: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.
text:
GEN 37:17
Thadou: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Amaho kihou limna kajan eiho Dothan lama chetau hite,” aki tiuve.
English: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.

tcz: Joseph ahung chun asopihon gam la thimtah ahivang in ahe pai tauvin, ama ahung lhun masang in asopite hon Joseph thadoh nading tohgon anei tauvin ahi.
en: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.
text:
GEN 37:18
Thadou: Joseph ahung chun asopihon gam la thimtah ahivang in ahe pai tauvin, ama ahung lhun masang in asopite hon Joseph thadoh nading tohgon anei tauvin ahi.
English: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.

tcz: “Tuhin mang neipa ahung tai,” amahon atiuve.
en: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.
text:
GEN 37:19
Thadou: “Tuhin mang neipa ahung tai,” amahon atiuve.
English: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.

tcz: Hung un amahi that doh taute, chule hiche kotong ho sung khat a pai mang taute. Ipa'u koma hitin seiyu hite, “Gancha khat in Joseph chu a nedoh tai, chule eihon veu hite ama amang ho chu hunggui lhung nam,” atiuve.
en: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”
text:
GEN 37:20
Thadou: Hung un amahi that doh taute, chule hiche kotong ho sung khat a pai mang taute. Ipa'u koma hitin seiyu hite, “Gancha khat in Joseph chu a nedoh tai, chule eihon veu hite ama amang ho chu hunggui lhung nam,” atiuve.
English: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”

tcz: Ahin Reuben in amaho tohgon lung thim ho chu ahet phat in Joseph kitho pi ding in ahungin, “Aman asei tai Joseph hi tha datau hite,” ati.
en: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”
text:
GEN 37:21
Thadou: Ahin Reuben in amaho tohgon lung thim ho chu ahet phat in Joseph kitho pi ding in ahungin, “Aman asei tai Joseph hi tha datau hite,” ati.
English: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”

tcz: Ibola thisan imoh lonsah ding'u ham? hilai kotong gamgo lah a seplut leuhen ama cham in eihon that hih jong leu hen ama thi ta lou ding ham. Reuben chu a lungthima Joseph chu huhdoh tei ding tichu ama dei ahi.
en: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.
text:
GEN 37:22
Thadou: Ibola thisan imoh lonsah ding'u ham? hilai kotong gamgo lah a seplut leuhen ama cham in eihon that hih jong leu hen ama thi ta lou ding ham. Reuben chu a lungthima Joseph chu huhdoh tei ding tichu ama dei ahi.
English: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.

tcz: Hichun Joseph ahung lhun chun asopite hon a sangkhol chol hoitah chu asut lhah peh pai tauvin ahi.
en: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;

tcz: Hichun amahon Joseph chu adah a aman uvin kotong sunga aseplut tauvin, hiche kotong chu imacha umlou twi jong veilou ahi.
en: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.
text:
GEN 37:24
Thadou: Hichun amahon Joseph chu adah a aman uvin kotong sunga aseplut tauvin, hiche kotong chu imacha umlou twi jong veilou ahi.
English: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.

tcz: Chule amaho sun an ne dinga aumlai tah'un, aga dadoh uva ahile vetan Gilead a kona hung sumkol veile Ishmael miho a sangan ho toh hung kilhona bego le thingthao namtwi toh chule lou namtwi hinpoa Egypt gam lang jonsuh ding amu uvin ahi.
en: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
text:
GEN 37:25
Thadou: Chule amaho sun an ne dinga aumlai tah'un, aga dadoh uva ahile vetan Gilead a kona hung sumkol veile Ishmael miho a sangan ho toh hung kilhona bego le thingthao namtwi toh chule lou namtwi hinpoa Egypt gam lang jonsuh ding amu uvin ahi.
English: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

tcz: Hichun Judah in a sopiho jah a aseiyin, “I sopipau itha doh uva ipi apha chom ding umham,” ati, chule athi san isel mang uva chu ipi phachom ding ham?
en: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?
text:
GEN 37:26
Thadou: Hichun Judah in a sopiho jah a aseiyin, “I sopipau itha doh uva ipi apha chom ding umham,” ati, chule athi san isel mang uva chu ipi phachom ding ham?
English: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?

tcz: Hung uvin Joseph hi Ishmael te koma joh doh tauhite, isopi nah nah iphe ivou nah nah chu a chunga jong ikhut lhapou hite,” atile asopiten jong asei angai cheh tauve.
en: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.
text:
GEN 37:27
Thadou: Hung uvin Joseph hi Ishmael te koma joh doh tauhite, isopi nah nah iphe ivou nah nah chu a chunga jong ikhut lhapou hite,” atile asopiten jong asei angai cheh tauve.
English: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.

tcz: Hiti chun Egypt gam'a kivei miho chun apui tauvin Joseph chu asopihon kotong a kon in a kaidoh un, Ishmael miho Midianite miho koma dangka somni in akijoh doh tauve.
en: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.
text:
GEN 37:28
Thadou: Hiti chun Egypt gam'a kivei miho chun apui tauvin Joseph chu asopihon kotong a kon in a kaidoh un, Ishmael miho Midianite miho koma dangka somni in akijoh doh tauve.
English: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Reuben chu kokhuh langa chun achekit'in ahile Joseph chu kokhuh sunga ana umtapoi, hichun Reuben chu alung akham lheh jengtan asang khol ho chu abottel in ahi.
en: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
text:
GEN 37:29
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Reuben chu kokhuh langa chun achekit'in ahile Joseph chu kokhuh sunga ana umtapoi, hichun Reuben chu alung akham lheh jengtan asang khol ho chu abottel in ahi.
English: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.

tcz: Hichun Reuben asopiho lah'a akinungle kit in lungkham tah in, “Joseph chu aum tapoi! tua hi keiman ipi kabol ding hitam,” ati.
en: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”
text:
GEN 37:30
Thadou: Hichun Reuben asopiho lah'a akinungle kit in lungkham tah in, “Joseph chu aum tapoi! tua hi keiman ipi kabol ding hitam,” ati.
English: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”

tcz: Hichun Joseph sopihon kelnou khat athat uvin, athisan chu Joseph sangkhol a chun anu tauve.
en: They took Joseph’s tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.
text:
GEN 37:31
Thadou: Hichun Joseph sopihon kelnou khat athat uvin, athisan chu Joseph sangkhol a chun anu tauve.
English: They took Joseph’s tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.

tcz: Amahon hichu sangkhol thisan anu u-chu apau Jacob athot un, mihon jong apau henga achoi uvin, “Hiche pihi ka mudoh uve, vetem in na chapa sangkhol chol hiya ham hilou ham,” atiuve.
en: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son’s tunic or not.”
text:
GEN 37:32
Thadou: Amahon hichu sangkhol thisan anu u-chu apau Jacob athot un, mihon jong apau henga achoi uvin, “Hiche pihi ka mudoh uve, vetem in na chapa sangkhol chol hiya ham hilou ham,” atiuve.
English: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son’s tunic or not.”

tcz: Jacob'in gangtah in ahedoh pai in, hitin asei tai, “Hiche hi kachapa sangkhol ahi monge gamsa khat in vang anehdoh ahitai ati, Joseph vang hi aphe avou lahthei hita ponte,” ati.
en: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”
text:
GEN 37:33
Thadou: Jacob'in gangtah in ahedoh pai in, hitin asei tai, “Hiche hi kachapa sangkhol ahi monge gamsa khat in vang anehdoh ahitai ati, Joseph vang hi aphe avou lahthei hita ponte,” ati.
English: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”

tcz: Hichun Jacob'in apon ho chu abot tel in khaodip pon akikhu khum tan, Ama ni sottah lung hemin genthei tah in achapa pul adoutan ahi.
en: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
text:
GEN 37:34
Thadou: Hichun Jacob'in apon ho chu abot tel in khaodip pon akikhu khum tan, Ama ni sottah lung hemin genthei tah in achapa pul adoutan ahi.
English: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.

tcz: Jacob chate jouse le achanute jousen lhepbi ding agong un, ahin amavang lhepbi jou ahitapoi, hitin amapan aseiye, “Keima lunghem pum in kachapa lhankhuh jon tang kate, tin Jacob chu akap e.”
