en: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.
text:
GEN 37:35
Thadou: Jacob chate jouse le achanute jousen lhepbi ding agong un, ahin amavang lhepbi jou ahitapoi, hitin amapan aseiye, “Keima lunghem pum in kachapa lhankhuh jon tang kate, tin Jacob chu akap e.”
English: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouchun Midian miho chun Joseph chu Potiphar kitipa Pharaoh Egypt lengpa koma semang pachong pa koma ajoh doh tauve. Potiphar natoh chu ahile sepai lah a semang pachong ahi.
en: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.
text:
GEN 37:36
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouchun Midian miho chun Joseph chu Potiphar kitipa Pharaoh Egypt lengpa koma semang pachong pa koma ajoh doh tauve. Potiphar natoh chu ahile sepai lah a semang pachong ahi.
English: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.

tcz: Hiche phat laitah chun Judah chun asopite adalhan Adullan kiti muna Hirah kitipa toh ana cheng khom lhon in ahi.
en: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
text:
GEN 38:1
Thadou: Hiche phat laitah chun Judah chun asopite adalhan Adullan kiti muna Hirah kitipa toh ana cheng khom lhon in ahi.
English: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

tcz: Chule Judah in Canan numei amin Shua kitinu chu aki chenpin chule ana kiti matpi tan ahi.
en: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.
text:
GEN 38:2
Thadou: Chule Judah in Canan numei amin Shua kitinu chu aki chenpin chule ana kiti matpi tan ahi.
English: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.

tcz: Amanu chu ahung kivopmon nao ahin neitan chule nao min chu Er asahtan ahi.
en: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.
text:
GEN 38:3
Thadou: Amanu chu ahung kivopmon nao ahin neitan chule nao min chu Er asahtan ahi.
English: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.

tcz: Chuin amanu akivopmo kit in nao pasal khat ahin hinbekit in nao min chu Onam asah tai.
en: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.
text:
GEN 38:4
Thadou: Chuin amanu akivopmo kit in nao pasal khat ahin hinbekit in nao min chu Onam asah tai.
English: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.

tcz: Abanin amanun nao pasal athum lhinna pachu amin Sheila asah in, Sheila apen lai tah a chu amaho Kezib kiti muna achen laitah'u ahiye.
en: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.
text:
GEN 38:5
Thadou: Abanin amanun nao pasal athum lhinna pachu amin Sheila asah in, Sheila apen lai tah a chu amaho Kezib kiti muna achen laitah'u ahiye.
English: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Judah in achapa atah pen Er ding in numei khang thah amin Tamar chu ajidin apui peh e.
en: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
text:
GEN 38:6
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Judah in achapa atah pen Er ding in numei khang thah amin Tamar chu ajidin apui peh e.
English: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

tcz: Hinlah Er chu migilou miphamo tah ahijeh chun Pakaiyin ahinkho ala dohtai.
en: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight. So the LORD killed him.
text:
GEN 38:7
Thadou: Hinlah Er chu migilou miphamo tah ahijeh chun Pakaiyin ahinkho ala dohtai.
English: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight. So the LORD killed him.

tcz: Hichun Judah Onam kitipa, Er sopipa koma hitin aseiye, “Nangma che inlang Tamar khu gaki chenpi tan ati, ajeh chu pasal khat insunga ahinkho abeitah le dan in aphal ahi, asopipan avet thei ding, na sopipa dinga chilhah nasem doh peh tei ding ahi.”
en: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”
text:
GEN 38:8
Thadou: Hichun Judah Onam kitipa, Er sopipa koma hitin aseiye, “Nangma che inlang Tamar khu gaki chenpi tan ati, ajeh chu pasal khat insunga ahinkho abeitah le dan in aphal ahi, asopipan avet thei ding, na sopipa dinga chilhah nasem doh peh tei ding ahi.”
English: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”

tcz: Amavang Onan kitipa chu anompon ama chilhah ahilou ding chu, hijeh chun a sopi pa ji toh alup khom lhona a kitimat teng abotwi ho chu tollhanga abolha jin, hijeh chun Tamar chun nao avop thei tapon asopipa adin jong chilhah gou aum doh jou tapon ahi.
en: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.
text:
GEN 38:9
Thadou: Amavang Onan kitipa chu anompon ama chilhah ahilou ding chu, hijeh chun a sopi pa ji toh alup khom lhona a kitimat teng abotwi ho chu tollhanga abolha jin, hijeh chun Tamar chun nao avop thei tapon asopipa adin jong chilhah gou aum doh jou tapon ahi.
English: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.

tcz: Amavang Pakaiyin Onan umchan chu gilou engse asa lheh in asopi pa athisa adin chapa ahin peh nom lou athang thip jeh ahi, hijeh chun Pakaiyin Onan hinkho jong asuh chom pehtai.
en: The thing which he did was evil in the LORD’s sight, and he killed him also.
text:
GEN 38:10
Thadou: Amavang Pakaiyin Onan umchan chu gilou engse asa lheh in asopi pa athisa adin chapa ahin peh nom lou athang thip jeh ahi, hijeh chun Pakaiyin Onan hinkho jong asuh chom pehtai.
English: The thing which he did was evil in the LORD’s sight, and he killed him also.

tcz: Hichun Judah in Tamar amounu jah a hitin aseiye, “Kachapa Sheila kikhan lhit kah in napa in'a meithai jin ga umdohtan,” ati. Ijeh-inem itile asopite ni bang in ama jong thiget in te tia anagel ahi. Hijeh chun Tamar jong achen apa in nah aga chengtai.
en: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up;” for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.
text:
GEN 38:11
Thadou: Hichun Judah in Tamar amounu jah a hitin aseiye, “Kachapa Sheila kikhan lhit kah in napa in'a meithai jin ga umdohtan,” ati. Ijeh-inem itile asopite ni bang in ama jong thiget in te tia anagel ahi. Hijeh chun Tamar jong achen apa in nah aga chengtai.
English: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up;” for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou in Shua chanu Judah jinu jong athi tai; ahin Judah chu aki lhep lung mong dom phat in agolpa Adullam mi Hirah chutoh Timnah a akelngoi mul vouho henga aga che tauve.
en: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.
text:
GEN 38:12
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jou in Shua chanu Judah jinu jong athi tai; ahin Judah chu aki lhep lung mong dom phat in agolpa Adullam mi Hirah chutoh Timnah a akelngoi mul vouho henga aga che tauve.
English: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.

tcz: Koiham khat in Tamar chu aseipeh in, “Ven na tehpu khu Timnah a kelngoi mul vou ding in ache touve,” a kiti peh e.
en: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
text:
GEN 38:13
Thadou: Koiham khat in Tamar chu aseipeh in, “Ven na tehpu khu Timnah a kelngoi mul vou ding in ache touve,” a kiti peh e.
English: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

tcz: Chuphat in amanun jong ameithai von chu akhel loijin, ponlu akikhun, akitomjol in Timnah lampia Enaim lamkot'a chun atou tai; ijeh-inem itile Sheila kikhan lhit ahitan, aji dinga amanu akipeh lou akimu ahitai.
en: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.
text:
GEN 38:14
Thadou: Chuphat in amanun jong ameithai von chu akhel loijin, ponlu akikhun, akitomjol in Timnah lampia Enaim lamkot'a chun atou tai; ijeh-inem itile Sheila kikhan lhit ahitan, aji dinga amanu akipeh lou akimu ahitai.
English: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.

tcz: Judah in amanu (Tamar), chu amun ahin Judah in numei kijoh ho ahisah in ahi, ajeh chu amanun amai asel jeh ahi.
en: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
text:
GEN 38:15
Thadou: Judah in amanu (Tamar), chu amun ahin Judah in numei kijoh ho ahisah in ahi, ajeh chu amanun amai asel jeh ahi.
English: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

tcz: Hichun Judah akihei jin, Tamar umna lampi koma amapan aseiyin, “Eini kitimat hite atin,” amapan amounu ahilam chu ahet doh lou ahin, hichun Tamar in adong tan “Ipi ijat neipeh ding ham ilupkhom lhon ding leh,” ati.
en: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”
text:
GEN 38:16
Thadou: Hichun Judah akihei jin, Tamar umna lampi koma amapan aseiyin, “Eini kitimat hite atin,” amapan amounu ahilam chu ahet doh lou ahin, hichun Tamar in adong tan “Ipi ijat neipeh ding ham ilupkhom lhon ding leh,” ati.
English: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”

tcz: Chuin Judah in adonbut in, “Keima kelnou lah a khat nahin thah peh nang'e,” ati, hichun ama nun aseiyin, “Nakitep naho chu ahung guilhun kaha iti ka tahsan thei ding ham,” ati.
en: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”
text:
GEN 38:17
Thadou: Chuin Judah in adonbut in, “Keima kelnou lah a khat nahin thah peh nang'e,” ati, hichun ama nun aseiyin, “Nakitep naho chu ahung guilhun kaha iti ka tahsan thei ding ham,” ati.
English: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”

tcz: Judah in adong in, “Itobang kitepna na dei ham ati,” amanun adonbut in, “Na Mohor le nakhao toh chule nakhut a nachoi na tenggol chu toh,” ati. Hijeh chun amapan hichengse chu apen amanu chu aluppin ahile aman jong nao avop tai.
en: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.
text:
GEN 38:18
Thadou: Judah in adong in, “Itobang kitepna na dei ham ati,” amanun adonbut in, “Na Mohor le nakhao toh chule nakhut a nachoi na tenggol chu toh,” ati. Hijeh chun amapan hichengse chu apen amanu chu aluppin ahile aman jong nao avop tai.
English: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Tamar a in lama a kinungle kit in a sangkhol chol akoi lhan masanga akivon na lui meithai sangkhol chu akivon in til abang chun hinkho amang kit tai.
en: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
text:
GEN 38:19
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Tamar a in lama a kinungle kit in a sangkhol chol akoi lhan masanga akivon na lui meithai sangkhol chu akivon in til abang chun hinkho amang kit tai.
English: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

tcz: Judah chun kelnou chu aloipa Adullam mipa khut'a numeinu henga khamgah na thil lhat doh dinga aga thahsah a ahile, Adullam mipan amanu chu agahol motan ahi.
en: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.
text:
GEN 38:20
Thadou: Judah chun kelnou chu aloipa Adullam mipa khut'a numeinu henga khamgah na thil lhat doh dinga aga thahsah a ahile, Adullam mipan amanu chu agahol motan ahi.
English: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.

tcz: Hichun Adullam mipa Hira in hi koma cheng ho chu adong in, “Ena-im jotna a tou numeinu aki johnu chu hoilam a che hitam, ama hon adonbut un, “Keima hon hikoma hin numei phalou atahsa joh kamu kha pouve,” atiuve.
en: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”
text:
GEN 38:21
Thadou: Hichun Adullam mipa Hira in hi koma cheng ho chu adong in, “Ena-im jotna a tou numeinu aki johnu chu hoilam a che hitam, ama hon adonbut un, “Keima hon hikoma hin numei phalou atahsa joh kamu kha pouve,” atiuve.
English: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”

tcz: Hichun Adullam mipa Hirah ahung ki nunglen thu umchan ho chu Judah asei peh tan ahi, “Keiman amanu umna chu kahol doh jou tapoi, chule chua cheng mihon jong hi tobang numei phalou atahsa joh aum poi,” atiuve.
en: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”
text:
GEN 38:22
Thadou: Hichun Adullam mipa Hirah ahung ki nunglen thu umchan ho chu Judah asei peh tan ahi, “Keiman amanu umna chu kahol doh jou tapoi, chule chua cheng mihon jong hi tobang numei phalou atahsa joh aum poi,” atiuve.
English: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”

tcz: Judah in aseiye, “Thil kana peh ho chu ama nun eina koi peh maita hen, kaki nopto na lhon dungjui a kelcha nou khat ka pen ahin nangman na holmo tan, amanu chu enung hol kit le khosunga mijousen ei nuisat ding'u ahi tai.”
en: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”
text:
GEN 38:23
Thadou: Judah in aseiye, “Thil kana peh ho chu ama nun eina koi peh maita hen, kaki nopto na lhon dungjui a kelcha nou khat ka pen ahin nangman na holmo tan, amanu chu enung hol kit le khosunga mijousen ei nuisat ding'u ahi tai.”
English: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”

tcz: Lhathum jou don chun Judah chu mihon asei peh tauvin, “Tamar na mounu chu numei kijoh banga ana bol thu ahije, chule tuhin amanun nao avoptai atiuve.” Hichun Judah in aseiye, “Amanu chu hinpui doh unlang halvam tauvin,” ati.
en: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”
text:
GEN 38:24
Thadou: Lhathum jou don chun Judah chu mihon asei peh tauvin, “Tamar na mounu chu numei kijoh banga ana bol thu ahije, chule tuhin amanun nao avoptai atiuve.” Hichun Judah in aseiye, “Amanu chu hinpui doh unlang halvam tauvin,” ati.
English: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”

tcz: Amavang amahon Tamar chu tha dingin ahin puidoh tauvin, Tamar in atehpu thu athot in hitin aseiye, “Hiche thil neipa tenggol ahin, khaodip ahin, Mahor ahin, koi thil pen ham? Ipi dinga thip beh cha um aham hiche neipa akona hi nao kavop ahi,” ati.
en: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”
text:
GEN 38:25
Thadou: Amavang amahon Tamar chu tha dingin ahin puidoh tauvin, Tamar in atehpu thu athot in hitin aseiye, “Hiche thil neipa tenggol ahin, khaodip ahin, Mahor ahin, koi thil pen ham? Ipi dinga thip beh cha um aham hiche neipa akona hi nao kavop ahi,” ati.
English: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”

tcz: Judah in gangtah in ama nei le gou chu amu mun agel doh paitan ahi, “Tamar hi keima sanga chonpha jo ahiye ati. Ajeh chu keiman kachapa Sheila toh akichen lhon na ding imacha kana gonlou jeh ahi,” ati, chupet tah chun Judah chu Tamar toh apum kitimat tapoi.
en: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.
text:
GEN 38:26
Thadou: Judah in gangtah in ama nei le gou chu amu mun agel doh paitan ahi, “Tamar hi keima sanga chonpha jo ahiye ati. Ajeh chu keiman kachapa Sheila toh akichen lhon na ding imacha kana gonlou jeh ahi,” ati, chupet tah chun Judah chu Tamar toh apum kitimat tapoi.
English: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.

tcz: Tamar dinga nao neina phat ahung naitan, amanun nao pasal ni pengkop ding ahi chu ahe tauvin ahi.
en: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.
text:
GEN 38:27
Thadou: Tamar dinga nao neina phat ahung naitan, amanun nao pasal ni pengkop ding ahi chu ahe tauvin ahi.
English: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.

tcz: Naoso nat akipan tan hiche pet tah chun naocha teni lah a khatpa akhut ahung doh in hichun numei lhacha a pangho chun patsan akhut'a akan peh un, “Hichepa hi hung peng masa ahi,” atiuve.
en: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”
text:
GEN 38:28
Thadou: Naoso nat akipan tan hiche pet tah chun naocha teni lah a khatpa akhut ahung doh in hichun numei lhacha a pangho chun patsan akhut'a akan peh un, “Hichepa hi hung peng masa ahi,” atiuve.
English: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”

tcz: Hinlah hiche naocha chun akhut akailut kit tan, asopipa joh ahung peng masa tai. Hichun numei lhacha ho chun “Hiche hi ipi ham atiuve.” Nang in iti dan'a amasa a peng dingpa nahin chop khup ham atiuve.” Hichun amapa min chu Perez asah tauve.
en: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.
text:
GEN 38:29
Thadou: Hinlah hiche naocha chun akhut akailut kit tan, asopipa joh ahung peng masa tai. Hichun numei lhacha ho chun “Hiche hi ipi ham atiuve.” Nang in iti dan'a amasa a peng dingpa nahin chop khup ham atiuve.” Hichun amapa min chu Perez asah tauve.
English: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.

tcz: Chujouvin, naosen patsan a akhut kikanpa chu ahung peng tan hichun amapa min chun Zerah asah tauve.
en: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.
text:
GEN 38:30
Thadou: Chujouvin, naosen patsan a akhut kikanpa chu ahung peng tan hichun amapa min chun Zerah asah tauve.
English: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.

tcz: Joseph chu Egypt gam'a ana puijun hiche apat a chu Ishmaelite sum-kolvei mihon Potiphar kiti pa koma ana joh un ahi. Potiphar natoh chu Egypt lengpa Pharaoh sepai lamkai a pang ahi.
en: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.
text:
GEN 39:1
Thadou: Joseph chu Egypt gam'a ana puijun hiche apat a chu Ishmaelite sum-kolvei mihon Potiphar kiti pa koma ana joh un ahi. Potiphar natoh chu Egypt lengpa Pharaoh sepai lamkai a pang ahi.
English: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.

tcz: Pathen in Joseph chu aumpi jing in, hijeh chun Egypt gamsunga abol lam jouse a alolhing jingin ahi.
en: The LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
text:
GEN 39:2
Thadou: Pathen in Joseph chu aumpi jing in, hijeh chun Egypt gamsunga abol lam jouse a alolhing jingin ahi.
English: The LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

tcz: Joseph chu Pathen in aumpi chu athil bol na jousea kon in apupan ahin muchen tan ahi.
en: His master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did prosper in his hand.
text:
GEN 39:3
Thadou: Joseph chu Pathen in aumpi chu athil bol na jousea kon in apupan ahin muchen tan ahi.
English: His master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did prosper in his hand.

tcz: Hichun Potiphar chu Joseph chunga alunglhai lheh jeng in, Joseph chu ama ban tah in akoi tan ahi. chule Potiphar in Joseph chu a insung jouse chule anei agou jouse vetup ding in atungdoh tan ahi.
en: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and Potiphar made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
text:
GEN 39:4
Thadou: Hichun Potiphar chu Joseph chunga alunglhai lheh jeng in, Joseph chu ama ban tah in akoi tan ahi. chule Potiphar in Joseph chu a insung jouse chule anei agou jouse vetup ding in atungdoh tan ahi.
English: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and Potiphar made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

tcz: Hiche nia pat'a chu Joseph chu apupa Potiphar insunga ima jouse vetup in anganse tai, chule Joseph chonphat jeh chun Potiphar insung chu Pakai phatthei bohna chu Potiphar nei jouse chung le a insung chung chule alouma chungah a achu tan ahi.
en: From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake. The LORD’s blessing was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.
text:
GEN 39:5
Thadou: Hiche nia pat'a chu Joseph chu apupa Potiphar insunga ima jouse vetup in anganse tai, chule Joseph chonphat jeh chun Potiphar insung chu Pakai phatthei bohna chu Potiphar nei jouse chung le a insung chung chule alouma chungah a achu tan ahi.
English: From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake. The LORD’s blessing was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.

tcz: Hichun Potiphar in Joseph chu ama insung vetup ding le anei agou ho jouse vetup ding in thanei na jouse ape dohtai, chule Joseph umjeh chun aman imacha ah akisaboi tapon, lungkham na jong aum tapon, chule aneh ding anneh tilou thil dang thil dang imacha ahepha tapoi. Joseph chu mi melhoitah vetnom nom umkhat ahi.
en: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.
text:
GEN 39:6
Thadou: Hichun Potiphar in Joseph chu ama insung vetup ding le anei agou ho jouse vetup ding in thanei na jouse ape dohtai, chule Joseph umjeh chun aman imacha ah akisaboi tapon, lungkham na jong aum tapon, chule aneh ding anneh tilou thil dang thil dang imacha ahepha tapoi. Joseph chu mi melhoitah vetnom nom umkhat ahi.
English: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.

tcz: Chule phat chomkhat jouvin, apupa loinun Joseph chu ahin velel tan, “Hung in eini lumkhom hitin kitimat hite tin Joseph chu ajol tai.”
en: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”
text:
GEN 39:7
Thadou: Chule phat chomkhat jouvin, apupa loinun Joseph chu ahin velel tan, “Hung in eini lumkhom hitin kitimat hite tin Joseph chu ajol tai.”
English: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”

tcz: Amavang Joseph anom pon, Joseph in Potiphar inneipi chu hitin adonbut e, “Ka pupan hiche insunga thil ho jouse vetup dinga ei nganse ahi,” ati.
en: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.
text:
GEN 39:8
Thadou: Amavang Joseph anom pon, Joseph in Potiphar inneipi chu hitin adonbut e, “Ka pupan hiche insunga thil ho jouse vetup dinga ei nganse ahi,” ati.
English: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.

tcz: Hiche insunga hi keima tilou thanei dang aum poi, kapu pan nangma chung a thaneina eipe poi, ajeh chu nangma aloinu nahi jeh in hi tobang thilpha lou chu iti keiman katoh a Pathen douna a chonset kabol ding ham ati.
en: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”
text:
GEN 39:9
Thadou: Hiche insunga hi keima tilou thanei dang aum poi, kapu pan nangma chung a thaneina eipe poi, ajeh chu nangma aloinu nahi jeh in hi tobang thilpha lou chu iti keiman katoh a Pathen douna a chonset kabol ding ham ati.
English: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”

tcz: Hiti chun ama nun aniseh in Joseph chu ano ano jeng in, amavang Joseph chu amanu toh lupkhom a ki timat ding chu pum noplou ahin, ahithei chan a jammang ding joh chu agot ahiye.
en: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
text:
GEN 39:10
Thadou: Hiti chun ama nun aniseh in Joseph chu ano ano jeng in, amavang Joseph chu amanu toh lupkhom a ki timat ding chu pum noplou ahin, ahithei chan a jammang ding joh chu agot ahiye.
English: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

tcz: Nikhat vang chu koima cha umlouna achun Joseph chu ama ngaiya natong ding in achen.
en: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.
text:
GEN 39:11
Thadou: Nikhat vang chu koima cha umlouna achun Joseph chu ama ngaiya natong ding in achen.
English: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.

tcz: Amanu chu ahung lut in a sangkhol ah akai jin, “Hung loiyin eini ilup khom lhon ding ahi,” ati. Hichun Joseph in a sangkhol asut lhan aki tom doh tai. Ahin a sangkhol chu Potiphar loinu khutna adalha den tan ahi.
en: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.
text:
GEN 39:12
Thadou: Amanu chu ahung lut in a sangkhol ah akai jin, “Hung loiyin eini ilup khom lhon ding ahi,” ati. Hichun Joseph in a sangkhol asut lhan aki tom doh tai. Ahin a sangkhol chu Potiphar loinu khutna adalha den tan ahi.
English: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.

tcz: Hichun Joseph la ajamdoh tan ahin amanun akhut a um asangkhol chu achoiyin,
en: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,
text:
GEN 39:13
Thadou: Hichun Joseph la ajamdoh tan ahin amanun akhut a um asangkhol chu achoiyin,
English: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,

tcz: Amanun insunga asohte jouse akou khom soh keiyin, hiche phat chun aja jousen ahin dellut cheh un, amanun hitin aseiye, “Kaloipan hiche Hebrew sohpa hi buhon, anneh sem dinga ahin puilut in, amahi ka insung demna a ahunglut in suhset ding eigon ahin keima awsangtah in kapeng in ahi,” ati.
en: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.
text:
GEN 39:14
Thadou: Amanun insunga asohte jouse akou khom soh keiyin, hiche phat chun aja jousen ahin dellut cheh un, amanun hitin aseiye, “Kaloipan hiche Hebrew sohpa hi buhon, anneh sem dinga ahin puilut in, amahi ka insung demna a ahunglut in suhset ding eigon ahin keima awsangtah in kapeng in ahi,” ati.
English: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.

tcz: Keima hatah a awsangtah a kapen phat in polam a ajam doh in ahin aman asangkhol chu kakoma ada lha dentai.
en: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”
text:
GEN 39:15
Thadou: Keima hatah a awsangtah a kapen phat in polam a ajam doh in ahin aman asangkhol chu kakoma ada lha dentai.
English: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

tcz: Hiti chun amanun sangkhol chun aloipa in ahung lhun masang in phatechan a koitup sel in ahi.
en: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.
text:
GEN 39:16
Thadou: Hiti chun amanun sangkhol chun aloipa in ahung lhun masang in phatechan a koitup sel in ahi.
English: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.

tcz: Hichun amanun aloipa koma thusoh ho chu asei tai; “Hebrew sohpa nahin puilut pa khun insunga ahung lut in suhset ding eigoi,” ati tai.
en: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,
text:
GEN 39:17
Thadou: Hichun amanun aloipa koma thusoh ho chu asei tai; “Hebrew sohpa nahin puilut pa khun insunga ahung lut in suhset ding eigoi,” ati tai.
English: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,

tcz: Amavang keima awsangtah a kapen phat in polam ah ajam doh in a sangkhol ada lhah ahi.
en: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”
text:
GEN 39:18
Thadou: Amavang keima awsangtah a kapen phat in polam ah ajam doh in a sangkhol ada lhah ahi.
English: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

tcz: Hichun Potiphar chu hatah in alung hang lheh tan ajinu thusimho Joseph in abolset kigot na thuho ajah doh phat chun.
en: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.
text:
GEN 39:19
Thadou: Hichun Potiphar chu hatah in alung hang lheh tan ajinu thusimho Joseph in abolset kigot na thuho ajah doh phat chun.
English: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.

tcz: Hichun Potiphar in Joseph chu songkul'a akoitan chule lengpan songkul'a umho to akihen khom un, ama jong hiti chun aum den tai.
en: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.
text:
GEN 39:20
Thadou: Hichun Potiphar in Joseph chu songkul'a akoitan chule lengpan songkul'a umho to akihen khom un, ama jong hiti chun aum den tai.
English: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.

tcz: Ahin Pathen in Joseph chu songkul'a jong aumpi jing in, angailut na ho jong avetsah jing in chule Pathen in Joseph chu songkul ngahpa tohjong kingailut na ape kit tai.
en: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
text:
GEN 39:21
Thadou: Ahin Pathen in Joseph chu songkul'a jong aumpi jing in, angailut na ho jong avetsah jing in chule Pathen in Joseph chu songkul ngahpa tohjong kingailut na ape kit tai.
English: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin songkul ngahpan Joseph chu songkul'a umho lah a alenpen in akoitan, hiche songkul sunga thil soh bouina jouse chu Joseph thaneina noiya akoi tai.
en: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.
text:
GEN 39:22
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin songkul ngahpan Joseph chu songkul'a umho lah a alenpen in akoitan, hiche songkul sunga thil soh bouina jouse chu Joseph thaneina noiya akoi tai.
English: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.

tcz: Pathen in Joseph chu aumpi jeh in imacha boina aumtapoi, athil bolna anatoh na jouse alolhingsel in hijeh chun songkul ngah pa jong imacha aboita poi, ajeh chu thil jouse Joseph in anga jeh chun imacha aphamo ding aumpoi.
en: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because the LORD was with him; and that which he did, the LORD made it prosper.
text:
GEN 39:23
Thadou: Pathen in Joseph chu aumpi jeh in imacha boina aumtapoi, athil bolna anatoh na jouse alolhingsel in hijeh chun songkul ngah pa jong imacha aboita poi, ajeh chu thil jouse Joseph in anga jeh chun imacha aphamo ding aumpoi.
English: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because the LORD was with him; and that which he did, the LORD made it prosper.

tcz: Hicheng thilsoh kichai nung chun Pharaoh lengpa natong ju vaihompa le an vai hompan apupa Egypt lengpa doumah abol lhon in achonse lhontai.
en: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.
text:
GEN 40:1
Thadou: Hicheng thilsoh kichai nung chun Pharaoh lengpa natong ju vaihompa le an vai hompan apupa Egypt lengpa doumah abol lhon in achonse lhontai.
English: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.

tcz: Hiche lamkai teni chunga hi Pharaoh nasatah in alunghang tan ahi.
en: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.
text:
GEN 40:2
Thadou: Hiche lamkai teni chunga hi Pharaoh nasatah in alunghang tan ahi.
English: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.

tcz: Chuin Pharaoh in amani chu Joseph umna lengpa songkul natong ho umna ah akoiyin ahi.
en: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
text:
GEN 40:3
Thadou: Chuin Pharaoh in amani chu Joseph umna lengpa songkul natong ho umna ah akoiyin ahi.
English: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

tcz: Songkul ngahpan amani chu Joseph thanei na noiya a umsah in Joseph in jong amani chu vetkolna anei jing in ahi.
en: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.
text:
GEN 40:4
Thadou: Songkul ngahpan amani chu Joseph thanei na noiya a umsah in Joseph in jong amani chu vetkolna anei jing in ahi.
English: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.

tcz: Jan khat chun songkul insunga kihen teni Egypt lengpa juvaihompa le an vaihompa chun mang khat cheh, amang ledohna toh kilhon cheh-in anei lhon in ahi.
en: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.
text:
GEN 40:5
Thadou: Jan khat chun songkul insunga kihen teni Egypt lengpa juvaihompa le an vaihompa chun mang khat cheh, amang ledohna toh kilhon cheh-in anei lhon in ahi.
English: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.

tcz: Hichun Joseph in amani chu jingkah lama amailhon lunglhai lou chu ahedohtan Joseph in amani chu adongin, ibola nang teni namai lhon kipah lou ham ati.
en: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.
text:
GEN 40:6
Thadou: Hichun Joseph in amani chu jingkah lama amailhon lunglhai lou chu ahedohtan Joseph in amani chu adongin, ibola nang teni namai lhon kipah lou ham ati.
English: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.

tcz: Joseph in adong in, “Sopi teni ibola namai lhon lhailou ham,” ati.
en: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”
text:
GEN 40:7
Thadou: Joseph in adong in, “Sopi teni ibola namai lhon lhailou ham,” ati.
English: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”

tcz: Amanin adon but lhon in, “Janlhah in keinin mang kanei gel lhon in amavang koi machan kamang ipi kisei na ahi aledoh thei aumpoi ati lhon e, ahin Joseph in adonbut in,” mang in ipi ahetsah dichu Pathen kin ahi. Chule namang lhon chu neisei peh lhon in ati.
en: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”
text:
GEN 40:8
Thadou: Amanin adon but lhon in, “Janlhah in keinin mang kanei gel lhon in amavang koi machan kamang ipi kisei na ahi aledoh thei aumpoi ati lhon e, ahin Joseph in adonbut in,” mang in ipi ahetsah dichu Pathen kin ahi. Chule namang lhon chu neisei peh lhon in ati.
English: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”

tcz: Hichun khon dom le a pang lamkai pa chun Joseph chu amang ho chu asei peh tai. Ka manga lengpi bah ka masanga ka mun.
en: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,
text:
GEN 40:9
Thadou: Hichun khon dom le a pang lamkai pa chun Joseph chu amang ho chu asei peh tai. Ka manga lengpi bah ka masanga ka mun.
English: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,

tcz: Hiche lengpi phunga chun abah thum ajam kamun, gang tah in ahung mum in chu in apah lha tai, hiche aga hochu lengpithei ga ahung hitai.
en: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.
text:
GEN 40:10
Thadou: Hiche lengpi phunga chun abah thum ajam kamun, gang tah in ahung mum in chu in apah lha tai, hiche aga hochu lengpithei ga ahung hitai.
English: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.

tcz: Pharaoh chakhon chu ka khut chunga ana um'in, hichun keiman lengpi ga chu ka sujot in atwi chu Pharaoh khona ka sun peh e.
en: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”
text:
GEN 40:11
Thadou: Pharaoh chakhon chu ka khut chunga ana um'in, hichun keiman lengpi ga chu ka sujot in atwi chu Pharaoh khona ka sun peh e.
English: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”

tcz: Joseph in hitin aseiye, “Lengpi bah thum hochu nithum tina ahi.
en: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.
text:
GEN 40:12
Thadou: Joseph in hitin aseiye, “Lengpi bah thum hochu nithum tina ahi.
English: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.

tcz: Nithum sunga hi Pharaoh in nithum jou teng nadom sang intin, chule masanga nana toh na a nanung koi kit ding ahi.
en: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.
text:
GEN 40:13
Thadou: Nithum sunga hi Pharaoh in nithum jou teng nadom sang intin, chule masanga nana toh na a nanung koi kit ding ahi.
English: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.

tcz: Chule nangma koma katao ahi, chanvou pha nahung chan teng neihin sumil hih beh in Pharaoh koma hitobang kathil bol hohi eina seipeh in, ajeh chu songkul'a kona eilha doh thei na ding in,” ati.
en: But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.
text:
GEN 40:14
Thadou: Chule nangma koma katao ahi, chanvou pha nahung chan teng neihin sumil hih beh in Pharaoh koma hitobang kathil bol hohi eina seipeh in, ajeh chu songkul'a kona eilha doh thei na ding in,” ati.
English: But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

tcz: Ajeh chu Hebrew gam a ka in apat a eikiman doh tua hiche songkul'a kaum hi mona neilou bolkhel ka neipoi.
en: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”
text:
GEN 40:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu Hebrew gam a ka in apat a eikiman doh tua hiche songkul'a kaum hi mona neilou bolkhel ka neipoi.
English: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”

tcz: Hichun changlhah hom'a lamkai pachu Joseph in amang hoitah a ale chu amu le ama jong atha anom lheh in; Joseph jah ah hitin aseiye, “Keiman jong jan mang kaneiye, ka manga chun paipeh thum changlhah dimset kalu chunga kapoi.
en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.
text:
GEN 40:16
Thadou: Hichun changlhah hom'a lamkai pachu Joseph in amang hoitah a ale chu amu le ama jong atha anom lheh in; Joseph jah ah hitin aseiye, “Keiman jong jan mang kaneiye, ka manga chun paipeh thum changlhah dimset kalu chunga kapoi.
English: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.

tcz: Paipeh achuna pa sunga chun changlhah ajat lhingsel in aum in, Pharaoh a ding ahi, ahin vacha ho ahung leng un ka luchunga changlhah ho chu ane doh tauve.”
en: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”
text:
GEN 40:17
Thadou: Paipeh achuna pa sunga chun changlhah ajat lhingsel in aum in, Pharaoh a ding ahi, ahin vacha ho ahung leng un ka luchunga changlhah ho chu ane doh tauve.”
English: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”

tcz: Joseph in amang chu ale pehtan, “Paipeh thum chun nithum ma avetsah ahin,
en: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.
text:
GEN 40:18
Thadou: Joseph in amang chu ale pehtan, “Paipeh thum chun nithum ma avetsah ahin,
English: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.

tcz: Nithum sunga hi Pharaoh in nalu adopsang ding thing phunga nakhai sang a, vachaten naphe anehchai ding'u ahi.”
en: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”
text:
GEN 40:19
Thadou: Nithum sunga hi Pharaoh in nalu adopsang ding thing phunga nakhai sang a, vachaten naphe anehchai ding'u ahi.”
English: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”

tcz: Pharaoh in nithum jou in ama penni kipapina in anoiya a semang pachonga pang jouse akou khom in hiche a pang dinga chu juvai hom lamkai pa le an vaihom lamkaipa chu alhadoh gel in,
en: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.
text:
GEN 40:20
Thadou: Pharaoh in nithum jou in ama penni kipapina in anoiya a semang pachonga pang jouse akou khom in hiche a pang dinga chu juvai hom lamkai pa le an vaihom lamkaipa chu alhadoh gel in,
English: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.

tcz: Ju vaihom pachu aju vaihom na ma man apansah kit'in, aman jong jukhon chu Pharaoh khut a agapetai.
en: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;

tcz: Ahin an vaihom lamkaipa vang chu Joseph in amani henga mang alepeh bang chun akhai lih tan ahi.
en: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.
text:
GEN 40:22
Thadou: Ahin an vaihom lamkaipa vang chu Joseph in amani henga mang alepeh bang chun akhai lih tan ahi.
English: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

tcz: Hichun ju vaihom lamkaipan Joseph chu ageldoh tapon asumil deltai.
en: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.
text:
GEN 40:23
Thadou: Hichun ju vaihom lamkaipan Joseph chu ageldoh tapon asumil deltai.
English: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.

tcz: Kum ni nungin Pharaoh in mang anei in ahile, vetan ama Nile vadung panga ana ding in ahi.
en: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed, and behold, he stood by the river.
text:
GEN 41:1
Thadou: Kum ni nungin Pharaoh in mang anei in ahile, vetan ama Nile vadung panga ana ding in ahi.
English: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed, and behold, he stood by the river.

tcz: Amanga chun bongchal sagi athao a thao cheh ahung kal doh un hamhing lah a chun alhaovin ahi.
en: Behold, seven cattle came up out of the river. They were sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.
text:
GEN 41:2
Thadou: Amanga chun bongchal sagi athao a thao cheh ahung kal doh un hamhing lah a chun alhaovin ahi.
English: Behold, seven cattle came up out of the river. They were sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.

tcz: Chujou in ama ho nunga chun bongchal sagi ma agon a gong cheh Nile vadunga kon chun ahung doh un, vadung panga bongchal sagi dangho koma chun ading uvin ahi.
en: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river.
text:
GEN 41:3
Thadou: Chujou in ama ho nunga chun bongchal sagi ma agon a gong cheh Nile vadunga kon chun ahung doh un, vadung panga bongchal sagi dangho koma chun ading uvin ahi.
English: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river.

tcz: Hichun bongchal agong ho chun bongchal athao sagi ho chu aval lhum tauvin ahi. Hiche mang anei pet tah chun Pharaoh chu ahung khang doh tai.
en: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.
text:
GEN 41:4
Thadou: Hichun bongchal agong ho chun bongchal athao sagi ho chu aval lhum tauvin ahi. Hiche mang anei pet tah chun Pharaoh chu ahung khang doh tai.
English: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.

tcz: Ahin Pharaoh a imulhu kit in mang anivei na aneiyin, hiche amanga hin changphal sagi hoitah vetnom nom um phungkhat a kona hung kikhai lha amun ahi.
en: He slept and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.
text:
GEN 41:5
Thadou: Ahin Pharaoh a imulhu kit in mang anivei na aneiyin, hiche amanga hin changphal sagi hoitah vetnom nom um phungkhat a kona hung kikhai lha amun ahi.
English: He slept and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.

tcz: Hichun changphal sagi amanga amu kit'in ahin hiche changphal ho chu ageo cheh chuh jeng in, solam huijin amut geo lheh jeng ahi.
en: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
text:
GEN 41:6
Thadou: Hichun changphal sagi amanga amu kit'in ahin hiche changphal ho chu ageo cheh chuh jeng in, solam huijin amut geo lheh jeng ahi.
English: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

tcz: Chuin hiche geo chih banga changphal ho chun changphal lom sagi ahoi phungkhat a kikhai lha ho chu aval lhum kittai. Hichun Pharaoh ahung doh kit'in ahile ajan mang ahichu agel doh in ahi.
en: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.
text:
GEN 41:7
Thadou: Chuin hiche geo chih banga changphal ho chun changphal lom sagi ahoi phungkhat a kikhai lha ho chu aval lhum kittai. Hichun Pharaoh ahung doh kit'in ahile ajan mang ahichu agel doh in ahi.
English: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.

tcz: Hiche ni ajingkah apat'in Pharaoh chu amang ho jeh chun a suboi lheh in aum thei tapoi. Hichun Pharaoh in amaho jouse koma amang chu asei tan, ahin amaho lah a khat beh in jong ipi kiseina ham tia chu a donbut thei aum pouve.
en: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.
text:
GEN 41:8
Thadou: Hiche ni ajingkah apat'in Pharaoh chu amang ho jeh chun a suboi lheh in aum thei tapoi. Hichun Pharaoh in amaho jouse koma amang chu asei tan, ahin amaho lah a khat beh in jong ipi kiseina ham tia chu a donbut thei aum pouve.
English: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.

tcz: Phat achaina langtah chun lengpa jukhon doma lamkai pachu ahung ding doh in, “Tunia keiman geldoh khat kaneiye phat masa a kana chatvai na atin Pharaoh koma aseitan ahi.
en: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.
text:
GEN 41:9
Thadou: Phat achaina langtah chun lengpa jukhon doma lamkai pachu ahung ding doh in, “Tunia keiman geldoh khat kaneiye phat masa a kana chatvai na atin Pharaoh koma aseitan ahi.
English: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.

tcz: Nangman nasoh teni chunga nana lunglhai pon changlhah hom lamkaipa le keima chunga, hijeh chun keini hi lengpa songkul'a neina koiyin ahi.
en: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker.
text:
GEN 41:10
Thadou: Nangman nasoh teni chunga nana lunglhai pon changlhah hom lamkaipa le keima chunga, hijeh chun keini hi lengpa songkul'a neina koiyin ahi.
English: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker.

tcz: Nikhat chu changlhah hompa le keiman mang chom cheh kanei lhon in ka mang lhon jong chu thusim chom cheh kanei lhon in,
en: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.
text:
GEN 41:11
Thadou: Nikhat chu changlhah hompa le keiman mang chom cheh kanei lhon in ka mang lhon jong chu thusim chom cheh kanei lhon in,
English: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.

tcz: Hiche laiphat chun Hebrew khangthah khat lengpa songkul'a chun keiho toh ana um'in, ama chu lengpa semang pachong pa soh a jong ana pang ahi, kamang nei lhon chu kasei lhon in ahile chu'in aman kamang lhon chu eile doh peh lhon e ati.
en: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. He interpreted to each man according to his dream.
text:
GEN 41:12
Thadou: Hiche laiphat chun Hebrew khangthah khat lengpa songkul'a chun keiho toh ana um'in, ama chu lengpa semang pachong pa soh a jong ana pang ahi, kamang nei lhon chu kasei lhon in ahile chu'in aman kamang lhon chu eile doh peh lhon e ati.
English: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. He interpreted to each man according to his dream.

tcz: Chule aman eiledoh peh lhon bang bang chun ahung guilhung cheh in ahi, keiman kana toh ngai ngai eikitohsah in an vaihompa akikhai lihtan ahi.”
en: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”
text:
GEN 41:13
Thadou: Chule aman eiledoh peh lhon bang bang chun ahung guilhung cheh in ahi, keiman kana toh ngai ngai eikitohsah in an vaihompa akikhai lihtan ahi.”
English: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”

tcz: Pharaoh in Joseph chu ahol in mi asol paijeng tan ama chu agan a gang in songkul'a kon in ahin puidoh jeng uvin, chuin avon ho akikhel in chule akhamul ho a kisuhtheng in, hichun ama Pharaoh toh kimuto din alut tai.
en: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.
text:
GEN 41:14
Thadou: Pharaoh in Joseph chu ahol in mi asol paijeng tan ama chu agan a gang in songkul'a kon in ahin puidoh jeng uvin, chuin avon ho akikhel in chule akhamul ho a kisuhtheng in, hichun ama Pharaoh toh kimuto din alut tai.
English: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh in Joseph koma aseitai, “Keiman janlhah in mang ka neijin koima chan ale doh theipon ahin keiman ka jah chu ahile mang kiti hohi nang man hetthei na nanei chu kana jai.”
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”
text:
GEN 41:15
Thadou: Hichun Pharaoh in Joseph koma aseitai, “Keiman janlhah in mang ka neijin koima chan ale doh theipon ahin keiman ka jah chu ahile mang kiti hohi nang man hetthei na nanei chu kana jai.”
English: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”

tcz: Joseph in adonbut in, “Hiche ho chu keima adinga thil hahsa ahi ati. Amavang Pathen in hiche ipi tina ham chu nahetsah theiye,” ati.
en: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”
text:
GEN 41:16
Thadou: Joseph in adonbut in, “Hiche ho chu keima adinga thil hahsa ahi ati. Amavang Pathen in hiche ipi tina ham chu nahetsah theiye,” ati.
English: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”

tcz: Chuin Pharaoh mang chu Joseph koma aseitai, aman hitin aseiye, “Ka mang in Nile vadung panga kana ding in.
en: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river;

tcz: Hiche a che a chun bongchal sagi hoitah kivah thao cheh vadunga kon chun ahung doh in chule hilaiya hampa dong ho chu ane pantan ahi.
en: and behold, seven fat and sleek cattle came up out of the river. They fed in the marsh grass;

tcz: Hinlah keiman chom khat jouvin bongchal adang sagi agong a gong ahoimo cheh ahung potdoh kit ka mun, keiman hitabang gancha gong aphe umlou Egypt gamsunga ka hinkhon kana mukha hih laiye.
en: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.
text:
GEN 41:19
Thadou: Hinlah keiman chom khat jouvin bongchal adang sagi agong a gong ahoimo cheh ahung potdoh kit ka mun, keiman hitabang gancha gong aphe umlou Egypt gamsunga ka hinkhon kana mukha hih laiye.
English: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.

tcz: Hiche bong agong melse tah hochun bongchal sagi athao ho chu aval lhum tan ahi.
en: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle;

tcz: Amahon aval lhum jou chun koiman ipi kabol ham tia ahethei jong aumpoi, amahon aval lhum jou uchun abepbep ahiuvin, hichun keima ka hung khang dohtai.
en: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
text:
GEN 41:21
Thadou: Amahon aval lhum jou chun koiman ipi kabol ham tia ahethei jong aumpoi, amahon aval lhum jou uchun abepbep ahiuvin, hichun keima ka hung khang dohtai.
English: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

tcz: Hichun keima ka imu lhu kit'in, chule keiman mang khat kaneibe kit'in, hichea kamang achun changvui sagi vetnom umtah phungkhat a ga ka mun ahi.
en: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good;

tcz: Chule chang vui sagi machu akiveigeosa akeoseh cheh, nisolam khohui mut geosa cheh, khat ho nunga chun ahungdoh doh uvin ahi.
en: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
text:
GEN 41:23
Thadou: Chule chang vui sagi machu akiveigeosa akeoseh cheh, nisolam khohui mut geosa cheh, khat ho nunga chun ahungdoh doh uvin ahi.
English: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

tcz: Chuin changvui ageosa ho chun changvui hoitah hochu avallhum kittan, hiche kamang hohi doithem ho koma kaseiyin, Hinlah ka mangho chu ipi kisei na ham koima chan eihil chen theipoi ati.
en: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”
text:
GEN 41:24
Thadou: Chuin changvui ageosa ho chun changvui hoitah hochu avallhum kittan, hiche kamang hohi doithem ho koma kaseiyin, Hinlah ka mangho chu ipi kisei na ham koima chan eihil chen theipoi ati.
English: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”

tcz: Joseph in adonbut in, “Pharaoh mang teni hi thakhat ahi, Pathen in Pharaoh hi ipi abol ding ahin hetsah masah ahi bouve.
en: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.
text:
GEN 41:25
Thadou: Joseph in adonbut in, “Pharaoh mang teni hi thakhat ahi, Pathen in Pharaoh hi ipi abol ding ahin hetsah masah ahi bouve.
English: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.

tcz: Bongchal sagi athao ahoi ho chule changvui sagi vetnom nom uma, aga hon avet sah nom chu ahile kum sagi sunga hi neh le chah neng ding avetsah ahi,” ati.
en: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.
text:
GEN 41:26
Thadou: Bongchal sagi athao ahoi ho chule changvui sagi vetnom nom uma, aga hon avet sah nom chu ahile kum sagi sunga hi neh le chah neng ding avetsah ahi,” ati.
English: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.

tcz: Chule bongchal sagi agong hole Changvui sagi ageosa aphunga goden solam huiyin asemgot den hon avetsah chu ahile kum sagi nasa tah a kel hunglha ding chu avetsah ahi.
en: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.
text:
GEN 41:27
Thadou: Chule bongchal sagi agong hole Changvui sagi ageosa aphunga goden solam huiyin asemgot den hon avetsah chu ahile kum sagi nasa tah a kel hunglha ding chu avetsah ahi.
English: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.

tcz: Hiche hohi keiman ka phondoh banga hung guilhung ding ahi, Ajeh chu Pathen in Pharaoh hi aphat ahung lhun masanga ipi abol dingho chu ahin hetsah ahiye ati.
en: That is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.
text:
GEN 41:28
Thadou: Hiche hohi keiman ka phondoh banga hung guilhung ding ahi, Ajeh chu Pathen in Pharaoh hi aphat ahung lhun masanga ipi abol dingho chu ahin hetsah ahiye ati.
English: That is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.

tcz: Tua patna Egypt gamsung a hi kum sagi hatah a neh le chah hung neng ding ahi.
en: Behold, seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt are coming.
text:
GEN 41:29
Thadou: Tua patna Egypt gamsung a hi kum sagi hatah a neh le chah hung neng ding ahi.
English: Behold, seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt are coming.

tcz: Amavang hiche joule chun kum sagi ma kel nasatah in hung lhan tin, chuteng chule chun Egypt gamsung ima ma ana tha lhing chu kisumil gam'a, kel lhah chun agamsung abah gam jeng ding ahi tai.
en: Seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,
text:
GEN 41:30
Thadou: Amavang hiche joule chun kum sagi ma kel nasatah in hung lhan tin, chuteng chule chun Egypt gamsung ima ma ana tha lhing chu kisumil gam'a, kel lhah chun agamsung abah gam jeng ding ahi tai.
English: Seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,

tcz: Hiche kel hung khoh hi gimnei lheh jeng ding kum tamtah neh le chah ana ninglhin na ho jouse chu koiman agel doh lou ding ahitai.
en: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.
text:
GEN 41:31
Thadou: Hiche kel hung khoh hi gimnei lheh jeng ding kum tamtah neh le chah ana ninglhin na ho jouse chu koiman agel doh lou ding ahitai.
English: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.

tcz: Pharaoh mang teni ahung ki hetsah na thupi pen tah chu ahile, Pathen in na ahin toh vahding ahiti gontup sa ahi tai, hung lhung vah tei ding ahi ati.
en: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
text:
GEN 41:32
Thadou: Pharaoh mang teni ahung ki hetsah na thupi pen tah chu ahile, Pathen in na ahin toh vahding ahiti gontup sa ahi tai, hung lhung vah tei ding ahi ati.
English: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Pharaoh in chingthei tah pasal chule thil hethem tah koitabang aholdoh a Egypt gamsung pumpia mopothei ahol angai tai.
en: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.
text:
GEN 41:33
Thadou: Hijeh a chu Pharaoh in chingthei tah pasal chule thil hethem tah koitabang aholdoh a Egypt gamsung pumpia mopothei ahol angai tai.
English: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh in agam agam a lamkai avetup ding mi lhengdoh henlang hiche teng chule louga sohho kum sagi neh anen sung chun hop nga lah a hop khat koidoh uhenlang,
en: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.
text:
GEN 41:34
Thadou: Hichun Pharaoh in agam agam a lamkai avetup ding mi lhengdoh henlang hiche teng chule louga sohho kum sagi neh anen sung chun hop nga lah a hop khat koidoh uhenlang,
English: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.

tcz: Pharaoh thanei na noiya tua patna neh le chah hiche kum sunga hatah a anen pet ahin changpang ahin koi dimset un, phatechan koitup uhenlang chule angah jong umjing hen, kho nung chan geiya khopi sunga neh le chah umjing thei nadin ati.
en: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and store grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.
text:
GEN 41:35
Thadou: Pharaoh thanei na noiya tua patna neh le chah hiche kum sunga hatah a anen pet ahin changpang ahin koi dimset un, phatechan koitup uhenlang chule angah jong umjing hen, kho nung chan geiya khopi sunga neh le chah umjing thei nadin ati.
English: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and store grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.

tcz: Tua chang le mim ho jouse hi phatechan mun khat a gamsung pumpin koikhom uhen, chutile kum sagi sunga nasatah a kel ahung khoh teng Egypt gam sunga mipi jouse kihinso thei ding ahi.
en: The food will be to supply the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; so that the land will not perish through the famine.”
text:
GEN 41:36
Thadou: Tua chang le mim ho jouse hi phatechan mun khat a gamsung pumpin koikhom uhen, chutile kum sagi sunga nasatah a kel ahung khoh teng Egypt gam sunga mipi jouse kihinso thei ding ahi.
English: The food will be to supply the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; so that the land will not perish through the famine.”

tcz: Hiche lungthim tohgon hi Pharaoh ahin ama semang pachong hon jong pha asa cheh tauvin ahi.
en: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
text:
GEN 41:37
Thadou: Hiche lungthim tohgon hi Pharaoh ahin ama semang pachong hon jong pha asa cheh tauvin ahi.
English: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh in amaho chu adongin, “Eihon hitobang pasal Pathen lhagao chenna hi imujou dingu hi nam,” ati.
en: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”
text:
GEN 41:38
Thadou: Hichun Pharaoh in amaho chu adongin, “Eihon hitobang pasal Pathen lhagao chenna hi imujou dingu hi nam,” ati.
English: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”

tcz: Hiche pet chun Pharaoh in Joseph ahoulimpi in, “Ajeh chu Pathen in ema jouse nangma nahetsah tah jeh in nang tobang koimacha ahethem le aching aumta poi.
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.
text:
GEN 41:39
Thadou: Hiche pet chun Pharaoh in Joseph ahoulimpi in, “Ajeh chu Pathen in ema jouse nangma nahetsah tah jeh in nang tobang koimacha ahethem le aching aumta poi.
English: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.

tcz: Nangma keima leng touna anatou ding ahitai, kamiten nangma thupeh jouse ajui cheh dingu ahitai. chule thil khat bou ikikhet nading chu keima kalengvai pohna bou lenjo ding kahi ati.
en: You shall be over my house. All my people will be ruled according to your word. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”
text:
GEN 41:40
Thadou: Nangma keima leng touna anatou ding ahitai, kamiten nangma thupeh jouse ajui cheh dingu ahitai. chule thil khat bou ikikhet nading chu keima kalengvai pohna bou lenjo ding kahi ati.
English: You shall be over my house. All my people will be ruled according to your word. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”

tcz: Pharaoh in Joseph jah ah aseitan, “Keiman nangma hi Egypt gam sunga thanei na le mopoh na kapeh doh nahi tai ati.”
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”
text:
GEN 41:41
Thadou: Pharaoh in Joseph jah ah aseitan, “Keiman nangma hi Egypt gam sunga thanei na le mopoh na kapeh doh nahi tai ati.”
English: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh in akhut a sana khutjem chu ala doh in Joseph khut a abupeh tai, Aman vonkang hoitah aki vonsah in chule sana khi jong angong a aki osah tai.
en: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.
text:
GEN 41:42
Thadou: Hichun Pharaoh in akhut a sana khutjem chu ala doh in Joseph khut a abupeh tai, Aman vonkang hoitah aki vonsah in chule sana khi jong angong a aki osah tai.
English: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.

tcz: Hichun lengpan Joseph chu asakol chunga atousah in amasanga chun “Mihon dilsu vo tin asamuvin ahi.” Hiti hin aman Joseph chu Egypt gam pumpi semang in ana pansah tai.
en: He made him ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.
text:
GEN 41:43
Thadou: Hichun lengpan Joseph chu asakol chunga atousah in amasanga chun “Mihon dilsu vo tin asamuvin ahi.” Hiti hin aman Joseph chu Egypt gam pumpi semang in ana pansah tai.
English: He made him ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.

tcz: Chule Pharaoh in Joseph kom a hitin aseiye, “Nangma phatsah louva Egypt gamsunga koima chan akhut alapthei lou ding, keima amina bou Pharaoh kahi ding ahi,” ati.
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh. Without you, no man shall lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”
text:
GEN 41:44
Thadou: Chule Pharaoh in Joseph kom a hitin aseiye, “Nangma phatsah louva Egypt gamsunga koima chan akhut alapthei lou ding, keima amina bou Pharaoh kahi ding ahi,” ati.
English: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh. Without you, no man shall lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh in Joseph chu Egypt te min thah apen Zaphenath-paneah Potiphera chanu Asenath chu Joseph ji din Pharaoh in agontup peh in ahi, hiche apatna chu Joseph in Egypt gamsung a mopoh na alah ahitai.
en: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
text:
GEN 41:45
Thadou: Hichun Pharaoh in Joseph chu Egypt te min thah apen Zaphenath-paneah Potiphera chanu Asenath chu Joseph ji din Pharaoh in agontup peh in ahi, hiche apatna chu Joseph in Egypt gamsung a mopoh na alah ahitai.
English: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

tcz: Egypt lengpa Pharaoh koma anatong dinga alut chun Joseph kum somthum alhing tai. Chuin Joseph chu Pharaoh angsunga konin apotdoh in Egypt gam leiset pumpi aga kholsoh keiyin ahi.
en: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
text:
GEN 41:46
Thadou: Egypt lengpa Pharaoh koma anatong dinga alut chun Joseph kum somthum alhing tai. Chuin Joseph chu Pharaoh angsunga konin apotdoh in Egypt gam leiset pumpi aga kholsoh keiyin ahi.
English: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

tcz: Ana kisei bang chun kum sagi sung chun neh le chah lousoh hatah in apungin ahi.
en: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.
text:
GEN 41:47
Thadou: Ana kisei bang chun kum sagi sung chun neh le chah lousoh hatah in apungin ahi.
English: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.

tcz: Hiche kum sagi sunga chun Joseph in chang le mim Egypt gamsunga kimu jouse chu mun khat a akoikhom soh kei in, chule khopi jousea akoina mun asem soh kei in ahi.
en: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities. He stored food in each city from the fields around that city.
text:
GEN 41:48
Thadou: Hiche kum sagi sunga chun Joseph in chang le mim Egypt gamsunga kimu jouse chu mun khat a akoikhom soh kei in, chule khopi jousea akoina mun asem soh kei in ahi.
English: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities. He stored food in each city from the fields around that city.

tcz: Hichun Joseph in chang le mim chu tamtah avum leo in akhol khom in, vadung panga neldi bang in atam valtah jeh chun hetlut jou jong ahita pon, achaina langa chun simsen lou ahitan sim jong asim tapouve,
en: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.
text:
GEN 41:49
Thadou: Hichun Joseph in chang le mim chu tamtah avum leo in akhol khom in, vadung panga neldi bang in atam valtah jeh chun hetlut jou jong ahita pon, achaina langa chun simsen lou ahitan sim jong asim tapouve,
English: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.

tcz: Kellhah kum hung lhun masang chun On thempu pa Potiphera chanu Asenath chun Joseph dingin chapa ni ana hinpeh-in
en: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.
text:
GEN 41:50
Thadou: Kellhah kum hung lhun masang chun On thempu pa Potiphera chanu Asenath chun Joseph dingin chapa ni ana hinpeh-in
English: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.

tcz: Joseph in achapa atahjo pa min chu Manasseh asah in, aman aseiyin, “Hiche hi ka Pathen in kagenthei na jouse eisuh milsahtai, chule kapa insung jong abonchaovin kasumil sohtai tina ahi.” (Manasseh: genthei tintang jouse suhmil na, chule insung mite jong mil jouta tina ahi).
en: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”
text:
GEN 41:51
Thadou: Joseph in achapa atahjo pa min chu Manasseh asah in, aman aseiyin, “Hiche hi ka Pathen in kagenthei na jouse eisuh milsahtai, chule kapa insung jong abonchaovin kasumil sohtai tina ahi.” (Manasseh: genthei tintang jouse suhmil na, chule insung mite jong mil jouta tina ahi).
English: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”

tcz: Joseph in achapa aneojo pa min chu Ephraim asah tai, “Aman hitin aseiye, “Ka Pathen ka hahsat na le kagenthei na jeh in lolhin na eipe tai,” ati.
en: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”
text:
GEN 41:52
Thadou: Joseph in achapa aneojo pa min chu Ephraim asah tai, “Aman hitin aseiye, “Ka Pathen ka hahsat na le kagenthei na jeh in lolhin na eipe tai,” ati.
English: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”

tcz: Egypt gamsunga kum sagi sunga chang le mim mang ketkut a ga jouse chu ahung kichai gamtan ahi.
en: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.
text:
GEN 41:53
Thadou: Egypt gamsunga kum sagi sunga chang le mim mang ketkut a ga jouse chu ahung kichai gamtan ahi.
English: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.

tcz: Hichun kum sagi kel lhah ahung kipantan, Joseph in anasei doh mabang in hiche a nasa tah a kel hah chun anaivel a gam ho jouse jong asuboi soh heltai, ama vang Egypt gamsunga chun neh le chah ahahsat na emacha aumpoi.
en: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
text:
GEN 41:54
Thadou: Hichun kum sagi kel lhah ahung kipantan, Joseph in anasei doh mabang in hiche a nasa tah a kel hah chun anaivel a gam ho jouse jong asuboi soh heltai, ama vang Egypt gamsunga chun neh le chah ahahsat na emacha aumpoi.
English: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

tcz: Egypt gamsunga kel ahung khoh lheh jeng tan, hichun mipi ho chu neh le chah ngaichat jeh in Pharaoh koma ahung un, hichun Pharaoh in Egypt mipi teho chu “Joseph koma asol in aman bol un atiho chu bol uvin,” ati.
en: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”
text:
GEN 41:55
Thadou: Egypt gamsunga kel ahung khoh lheh jeng tan, hichun mipi ho chu neh le chah ngaichat jeh in Pharaoh koma ahung un, hichun Pharaoh in Egypt mipi teho chu “Joseph koma asol in aman bol un atiho chu bol uvin,” ati.
English: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”

tcz: Hiti chun kel lhah chu hatah in ahung khohse cheh tan gamsung jouse aboilou aumta pon, Joseph in chang pang ho jouse chu ahong doh tan, Egypt mipite chu aki choh sah tai. Ajeh chu Egypt gamsunga kelkhoh chu asang lheh in hitobang kel hah chu ana umkha hihlaiye.
en: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
text:
GEN 41:56
Thadou: Hiti chun kel lhah chu hatah in ahung khohse cheh tan gamsung jouse aboilou aumta pon, Joseph in chang pang ho jouse chu ahong doh tan, Egypt mipite chu aki choh sah tai. Ajeh chu Egypt gamsunga kelkhoh chu asang lheh in hitobang kel hah chu ana umkha hihlaiye.
English: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.

tcz: Chule gam dang dang Egypt gam kimvel a jousen neh le chah akichoh thei nadiuvin Joseph heng ahinnai lut tauvin, Ajeh chu hitobang kel hah chu vannoi leiset chung jouse asuh boi cheh ahi.
en: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.
text:
GEN 41:57
Thadou: Chule gam dang dang Egypt gam kimvel a jousen neh le chah akichoh thei nadiuvin Joseph heng ahinnai lut tauvin, Ajeh chu hitobang kel hah chu vannoi leiset chung jouse asuh boi cheh ahi.
