Thadou: “Chehlhang semna ding'in changpol pe tahih un. Ama ama cheh kihol sah tauvin!
English: “You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.

tcz: Ahivang'a masang'a na bolsah ngai bang'uva chehlhang nasem sah jat u kibanga nasem sah dingu ahi. Achanvou u lhom jong lhom sah hih un. Athase gam tauve. Hijeh chun amahon, 'cheu hitin I-Pathen'u henga kilhaina gasem tauhite,' tia asap jengu ahi, ati.
en: You shall require from them the number of the bricks which they made before. You shall not diminish anything of it, for they are idle. Therefore they cry, saying, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to our God.’
text:
EXO 5:8
Thadou: Ahivang'a masang'a na bolsah ngai bang'uva chehlhang nasem sah jat u kibanga nasem sah dingu ahi. Achanvou u lhom jong lhom sah hih un. Athase gam tauve. Hijeh chun amahon, 'cheu hitin I-Pathen'u henga kilhaina gasem tauhite,' tia asap jengu ahi, ati.
English: You shall require from them the number of the bricks which they made before. You shall not diminish anything of it, for they are idle. Therefore they cry, saying, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to our God.’

tcz: Achung'uva natoh hahsa cheh koibe peh un! A-ulsau lonsah un! Hichun jou thu angaisah lou na diuva ahil dingu ahi!” ati.
en: Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it. Don’t let them pay any attention to lying words.”
text:
EXO 5:9
Thadou: Achung'uva natoh hahsa cheh koibe peh un! A-ulsau lonsah un! Hichun jou thu angaisah lou na diuva ahil dingu ahi!” ati.
English: Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it. Don’t let them pay any attention to lying words.”

tcz: Hichun soh natong vaipo ho leh natong lamkai ho chu acheuvin mipi ho heng'a asei peh tauvin: “Pharaoh in asei hiche hi ahi: Tuapat changpol kapeh talou ding'u nahi.
en: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.
text:
EXO 5:10
Thadou: Hichun soh natong vaipo ho leh natong lamkai ho chu acheuvin mipi ho heng'a asei peh tauvin: “Pharaoh in asei hiche hi ahi: Tuapat changpol kapeh talou ding'u nahi.
English: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.

tcz: Cheuvin lang nangma nangman ga kipoh uvin. Hoilaimun hijongle namu thei chan'un ga kihol tauvin. Ahinlah masanga banga chehlhang atam nathei chan'a na sem doh dingu ahi,” ati.
en: Go yourselves, get straw where you can find it, for nothing of your work shall be diminished.’”
text:
EXO 5:11
Thadou: Cheuvin lang nangma nangman ga kipoh uvin. Hoilaimun hijongle namu thei chan'un ga kihol tauvin. Ahinlah masanga banga chehlhang atam nathei chan'a na sem doh dingu ahi,” ati.
English: Go yourselves, get straw where you can find it, for nothing of your work shall be diminished.’”

tcz: Hijeh chun mipi jong Egypt gamtin ah changpol hol nan aki the cheh tauvin ahi.
en: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
text:
EXO 5:12
Thadou: Hijeh chun mipi jong Egypt gamtin ah changpol hol nan aki the cheh tauvin ahi.
English: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin, Egypt natong vaipo hon gah tah in aboljom nalaiyun, “Changpol kapeh laiyuva nasem bang'uva, niseh leh chehlhang nasem doh ding jat u nasuh bulhit tei ding'u ahi” tin ngeh na aneiyuve.
en: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”
text:
EXO 5:13
Thadou: Chomkhat jouvin, Egypt natong vaipo hon gah tah in aboljom nalaiyun, “Changpol kapeh laiyuva nasem bang'uva, niseh leh chehlhang nasem doh ding jat u nasuh bulhit tei ding'u ahi” tin ngeh na aneiyuve.
English: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”

tcz: Chuin Israel natong lamkaiya anganse hou chu ajep uvin, “Ipi ding'a janhia chule tunia jong natoh doh diu jat na toh doh louvu ham? tin ngehna aneiyuvin ahi.
en: The officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and were asked, “Why haven’t you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today, in making brick as before?”
text:
EXO 5:14
Thadou: Chuin Israel natong lamkaiya anganse hou chu ajep uvin, “Ipi ding'a janhia chule tunia jong natoh doh diu jat na toh doh louvu ham? tin ngehna aneiyuvin ahi.
English: The officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and were asked, “Why haven’t you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today, in making brick as before?”

tcz: Chuphat in Israel natong lamkai cheng Pharoah heng'a ache un chule atao uvin, “lungset tah in nasohte hi hitin neibol hih un,” tin athum un ahi.
en: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?
text:
EXO 5:15
Thadou: Chuphat in Israel natong lamkai cheng Pharoah heng'a ache un chule atao uvin, “lungset tah in nasohte hi hitin neibol hih un,” tin athum un ahi.
English: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?

tcz: “Changpol la eipe pouvin, ahinlah soh vaipo hon angeh nalaiyun “chehlhang sem'un!” tin eivo jing'un, ahinlah hiche hi keiho themmo ahi poi! Nangma mite ho mama ngoh ding ahijoi!” tin asei uve.
en: No straw is given to your servants, and they tell us, ‘Make brick!’ and behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people.”
text:
EXO 5:16
Thadou: “Changpol la eipe pouvin, ahinlah soh vaipo hon angeh nalaiyun “chehlhang sem'un!” tin eivo jing'un, ahinlah hiche hi keiho themmo ahi poi! Nangma mite ho mama ngoh ding ahijoi!” tin asei uve.
English: No straw is given to your servants, and they tell us, ‘Make brick!’ and behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people.”

tcz: Ahivang'in Pharoah apeng jah jeng'in, “Nangho na thaset u ahi! a thase na hiuve! Hijeh a chu hitia hi naseiyu ahi, 'Cheu hitin chule I-Pakaiyu heng'a kilhaina ga toh doh ute natiu ahi.'
en: But Pharaoh said, “You are idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to the LORD.’
text:
EXO 5:17
Thadou: Ahivang'in Pharoah apeng jah jeng'in, “Nangho na thaset u ahi! a thase na hiuve! Hijeh a chu hitia hi naseiyu ahi, 'Cheu hitin chule I-Pakaiyu heng'a kilhaina ga toh doh ute natiu ahi.'
English: But Pharaoh said, “You are idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to the LORD.’

tcz: “Tun natong din kileuvin! Nangho changpol na kipe lou diu, ahivang'a chehlhang nasem doh diu jat lhingset a nasem doh teitei ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”
text:
EXO 5:18
Thadou: “Tun natong din kileuvin! Nangho changpol na kipe lou diu, ahivang'a chehlhang nasem doh diu jat lhingset a nasem doh teitei ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”

tcz: “Niseh a chehlhang nasem jat u nakemsuh sah theilou ding'u ahi,” ati jeh u chun Israel natong lamkai hon nasa tah abol gim'a aum'u chu amu tauvin ahi.”
en: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble when it was said, “You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks!”
text:
EXO 5:19
Thadou: “Niseh a chehlhang nasem jat u nakemsuh sah theilou ding'u ahi,” ati jeh u chun Israel natong lamkai hon nasa tah abol gim'a aum'u chu amu tauvin ahi.”
English: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble when it was said, “You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks!”

tcz: Pharoah thutanna insung ahin dalhah phat un, pam lang'a amaho ana ngah Mose leh Aaron chu aki mupi uvin ahi.
en: They met Moses and Aaron, who stood along the way, as they came out from Pharaoh.
text:
EXO 5:20
Thadou: Pharoah thutanna insung ahin dalhah phat un, pam lang'a amaho ana ngah Mose leh Aaron chu aki mupi uvin ahi.
English: They met Moses and Aaron, who stood along the way, as they came out from Pharaoh.

tcz: Chuin natong lamkai ho chun ajah lhon'ah, “Pakaiyin nachung chang thu lhon tan hen lang gotna nape lhon hen, ijeh inem itileh Pharaoh leh alhacha ho angsung'a nei suh namset u ahi. Nangnin amaho khut a chemjam na koipeh lhon in, neitha gamsah kigot un ahi,” atiuve.
en: They said to them, “May the LORD look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!”
text:
EXO 5:21
Thadou: Chuin natong lamkai ho chun ajah lhon'ah, “Pakaiyin nachung chang thu lhon tan hen lang gotna nape lhon hen, ijeh inem itileh Pharaoh leh alhacha ho angsung'a nei suh namset u ahi. Nangnin amaho khut a chemjam na koipeh lhon in, neitha gamsah kigot un ahi,” atiuve.
English: They said to them, “May the LORD look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!”

tcz: Chuin Mose Pakai heng'a akile in akiphin tai, “Ipi ding'a namite chung'a hitobang gimna hi nalhun sah hitam, Pakai? Ipi ding'a keima nei sol ham?”
en: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?
text:
EXO 5:22
Thadou: Chuin Mose Pakai heng'a akile in akiphin tai, “Ipi ding'a namite chung'a hitobang gimna hi nalhun sah hitam, Pakai? Ipi ding'a keima nei sol ham?”
English: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?

tcz: Nangma thalheng'a thusei dinga Pharoah heng kahunga kipat namite chunga akhanse cheh cheh jon ahi. Hinlah nangman amaho huhdoh nadin ima nabol poi!”
en: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people. You have not rescued your people at all!”
text:
EXO 5:23
Thadou: Nangma thalheng'a thusei dinga Pharoah heng kahunga kipat namite chunga akhanse cheh cheh jon ahi. Hinlah nangman amaho huhdoh nadin ima nabol poi!”
English: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people. You have not rescued your people at all!”

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin, “Tua hi keiman Pharoah chung'a ipi ka bol'am namu ding ahi. Aman ka ban thahatna ahin hetdoh teng, aman mipi ho chu ahinsol doh ding ahi. Dih tah a, aman namphu a agamsung dalha dinga ahin soldoh ding'u ahi!”
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh, for by a strong hand he shall let them go, and by a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.”
text:
EXO 6:1
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin, “Tua hi keiman Pharoah chung'a ipi ka bol'am namu ding ahi. Aman ka ban thahatna ahin hetdoh teng, aman mipi ho chu ahinsol doh ding ahi. Dih tah a, aman namphu a agamsung dalha dinga ahin soldoh ding'u ahi!”
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh, for by a strong hand he shall let them go, and by a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.”

tcz: Chule Pathen in Mose henga aseiyin, “Keima Yahweh - 'Pakai' kahi.
en: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am the LORD.
text:
EXO 6:2
Thadou: Chule Pathen in Mose henga aseiyin, “Keima Yahweh - 'Pakai' kahi.
English: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am the LORD.

tcz: Abraham henga, Isaac henga, chule Jacob henga El-Shaddai - 'Hatchungnung Pathen' - aheng uva ka kilah in ahi, hinlah kamin, Yaweh, ahi ti amaho heng'a kaphong doh poi.
en: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name the LORD I was not known to them.
text:
EXO 6:3
Thadou: Abraham henga, Isaac henga, chule Jacob henga El-Shaddai - 'Hatchungnung Pathen' - aheng uva ka kilah in ahi, hinlah kamin, Yaweh, ahi ti amaho heng'a kaphong doh poi.
English: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name the LORD I was not known to them.

tcz: Chule kholjin miho banga achen nau gam, Canaan gam peh dinga kakitep na keiman amaho toh avel'in namdet na kanei kit in ahi.
en: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.
text:
EXO 6:4
Thadou: Chule kholjin miho banga achen nau gam, Canaan gam peh dinga kakitep na keiman amaho toh avel'in namdet na kanei kit in ahi.
English: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.

tcz: Israel mite, tua Egypt mite soh a pang ho thohgim na kaja nai ti hi naginchat mong thei ahi. Chule amaho toh ka kitepna jong phatah in kahe jing nai.
en: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.
text:
EXO 6:5
Thadou: Israel mite, tua Egypt mite soh a pang ho thohgim na kaja nai ti hi naginchat mong thei ahi. Chule amaho toh ka kitepna jong phatah in kahe jing nai.
English: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.

tcz: “Hijeh chun, Israel mite henga seiyin: 'Keima Pakai kahi. Egypt gam'a nasoh tan nauva kon'a kahuhdoh ding chule nathoh gimnauva kon'a kalha ong ding nahiuve. Keiman nangho ban thahat tah le thutan'a gimnei tah a kalhatdam ding nahiuve.
en: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.
text:
EXO 6:6
Thadou: “Hijeh chun, Israel mite henga seiyin: 'Keima Pakai kahi. Egypt gam'a nasoh tan nauva kon'a kahuhdoh ding chule nathoh gimnauva kon'a kalha ong ding nahiuve. Keiman nangho ban thahat tah le thutan'a gimnei tah a kalhatdam ding nahiuve.
English: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.

tcz: Keima mite nahi mong'uve tia kachu dingu, chule na Pathen'u kahi ding ahi. Chuteng keima hi nangho Pakai na Pathen'u Egypt gamma nathoh gim nauva kon'a nahin lha ong pau chu kahi nahin hetdoh dingu ahi.
en: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am the LORD your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
text:
EXO 6:7
Thadou: Keima mite nahi mong'uve tia kachu dingu, chule na Pathen'u kahi ding ahi. Chuteng keima hi nangho Pakai na Pathen'u Egypt gamma nathoh gim nauva kon'a nahin lha ong pau chu kahi nahin hetdoh dingu ahi.
English: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am the LORD your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

tcz: Keiman Abraham, Isaac, chuleh Jacob heng'a kakihahsel na gam'a chu ka puilut ding na hiuve. Nangho goulo ding mong monga kapeh ding nahiuve. Keima Pakai kahi!'”
en: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am the LORD.’”
text:
EXO 6:8
Thadou: Keiman Abraham, Isaac, chuleh Jacob heng'a kakihahsel na gam'a chu ka puilut ding na hiuve. Nangho goulo ding mong monga kapeh ding nahiuve. Keima Pakai kahi!'”
English: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am the LORD.’”

tcz: Pakaiyin asei bang'in Mose in jong Israel mite heng'a asei peh in, ahinlah amahon avel'in angainom tapouvin ahi. Ajeh chu amaho asoh channauva aki sugim'u chun alungphatmo sah val tauvin ahi.
en: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
text:
EXO 6:9
Thadou: Pakaiyin asei bang'in Mose in jong Israel mite heng'a asei peh in, ahinlah amahon avel'in angainom tapouvin ahi. Ajeh chu amaho asoh channauva aki sugim'u chun alungphatmo sah val tauvin ahi.
English: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
EXO 6:10
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: “Egypt lengpa Pharaoh heng'a leche in lang, Israel miten nagamsung dalha tauhen tin aheng'a gaseiyin.”
en: “Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”
text:
EXO 6:11
Thadou: “Egypt lengpa Pharaoh heng'a leche in lang, Israel miten nagamsung dalha tauhen tin aheng'a gaseiyin.”
English: “Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”

tcz: “Ahinlah Pakai!” Mose anompon, “Ka miten kathusei eingaipeh tapouvintin. Iti Pharaoh in ka thu ngai mong nante tia kakinep ding ham? Keima mipaomo kahi.”
en: Moses spoke before the LORD, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?”
text:
EXO 6:12
Thadou: “Ahinlah Pakai!” Mose anompon, “Ka miten kathusei eingaipeh tapouvintin. Iti Pharaoh in ka thu ngai mong nante tia kakinep ding ham? Keima mipaomo kahi.”
English: Moses spoke before the LORD, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?”

tcz: Ahivangin Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'a thu aseiyin Israelte ding leh Egypt lengpa Pharaoh ding'a abol lhonding ho ape lhon'in, Pakaiyin Israelte Egypt akon puidoh ding'in Mose leh Aaron thupeh anei tan ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 6:13
Thadou: Ahivangin Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'a thu aseiyin Israelte ding leh Egypt lengpa Pharaoh ding'a abol lhonding ho ape lhon'in, Pakaiyin Israelte Egypt akon puidoh ding'in Mose leh Aaron thupeh anei tan ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

tcz: Hichengse hi apu apate'u khang chedol'a Israel insung upa ho ahi: Israel insung'a apeng masapen Reuben chapate se chu: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, chule Carmi. Amaho chilhahse hi Reuben insung kon ahitauve.
en: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.
text:
EXO 6:14
Thadou: Hichengse hi apu apate'u khang chedol'a Israel insung upa ho ahi: Israel insung'a apeng masapen Reuben chapate se chu: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, chule Carmi. Amaho chilhahse hi Reuben insung kon ahitauve.
English: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.

tcz: Simeon chapate se chu: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar leh Shaul ahiuve. (Shaul hingnu vangchu Canaan numei ahi.) Amaho chilhahse hi Simeon insung kon ahitauve.
en: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.
text:
EXO 6:15
Thadou: Simeon chapate se chu: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar leh Shaul ahiuve. (Shaul hingnu vangchu Canaan numei ahi.) Amaho chilhahse hi Simeon insung kon ahitauve.
English: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.

tcz: Levi chilhahte se amaho insung minbu dungjuiya achapate chu: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari. (Levi chu kum ja le somthum le sagi ana hing'e).
en: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.
text:
EXO 6:16
Thadou: Levi chilhahte se amaho insung minbu dungjuiya achapate chu: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari. (Levi chu kum ja le somthum le sagi ana hing'e).
English: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.

tcz: Gershon chihahte chu Libni leh Shimei ahi lhonne. Anigel lhonin insung khangguiyin akisim lhon tan ahi.
en: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.
text:
EXO 6:17
Thadou: Gershon chihahte chu Libni leh Shimei ahi lhonne. Anigel lhonin insung khangguiyin akisim lhon tan ahi.
English: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.

tcz: Kohath chilhahte chu Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel ahi. (Kohath chu kum ja le somthum le thum ana hing'e.)
en: The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years.
text:
EXO 6:18
Thadou: Kohath chilhahte chu Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel ahi. (Kohath chu kum ja le somthum le thum ana hing'e.)
English: The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years.

tcz: Merari chilhahte chu: Mahli leh Mushi ahi lhon'e. Ama ho chengse hi Levi insung chedol minbua amin cheh uchu ahi.
en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
text:
EXO 6:19
Thadou: Merari chilhahte chu: Mahli leh Mushi ahi lhon'e. Ama ho chengse hi Levi insung chedol minbua amin cheh uchu ahi.
English: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.

tcz: Amram chun apa sopinu Jochebed chu jin aneiyin, amanun chapa ahin peh in, Aaron leh Mose ahi lhon'e. (Amram chu kum jale somthum le sagi ana hing'e.)
en: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.
text:
EXO 6:20
Thadou: Amram chun apa sopinu Jochebed chu jin aneiyin, amanun chapa ahin peh in, Aaron leh Mose ahi lhon'e. (Amram chu kum jale somthum le sagi ana hing'e.)
English: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.

tcz: Izhar chapate chu Korah, Nepheg leh Zicri ahiuve.
en: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
text:
EXO 6:21
Thadou: Izhar chapate chu Korah, Nepheg leh Zicri ahiuve.
English: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

tcz: Uzziel chapate chu, Mishael, Elzaphan leh Sithri ahiuve.
en: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
text:
EXO 6:22
Thadou: Uzziel chapate chu, Mishael, Elzaphan leh Sithri ahiuve.
English: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.

tcz: Aaron in Elisheba aki chenpin, amachu Amminadab chanu chule Nahson ding'a asopinu ahi. Amanun chapa ahindoh ho chu Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahiuve.
en: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
text:
EXO 6:23
Thadou: Aaron in Elisheba aki chenpin, amachu Amminadab chanu chule Nahson ding'a asopinu ahi. Amanun chapa ahindoh ho chu Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahiuve.
English: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

tcz: Korah chapate hochu Assir, Elkanah leh Abiasaph ahiuvin, amaho chilhah hi Korah insung mi ahitauve.
en: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
text:
EXO 6:24
Thadou: Korah chapate hochu Assir, Elkanah leh Abiasaph ahiuvin, amaho chilhah hi Korah insung mi ahitauve.
English: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.

tcz: Aaron chapa Eleazar chun Putiel chanute lah a khat ji in aneiyin, chuin amanun chapa khat ahing'in Phinehas ahi. Amaho chenghi Levi insung'a pu le pate ho insung bahkai dungjuiya chengse chu ahiuve.
en: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.
text:
EXO 6:25
Thadou: Aaron chapa Eleazar chun Putiel chanute lah a khat ji in aneiyin, chuin amanun chapa khat ahing'in Phinehas ahi. Amaho chenghi Levi insung'a pu le pate ho insung bahkai dungjuiya chengse chu ahiuve.
English: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.

tcz: Aaron leh Mose hichelaiya kimin phah teni mama hi ahilhon'e Pakaiyin ajah lhon'a, “Israel mite chu Egypt gamma kon in sepoyte bang'in hin lamkai lhon in,” tia asei chu.
en: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.”
text:
EXO 6:26
Thadou: Aaron leh Mose hichelaiya kimin phah teni mama hi ahilhon'e Pakaiyin ajah lhon'a, “Israel mite chu Egypt gamma kon in sepoyte bang'in hin lamkai lhon in,” tia asei chu.
English: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.”

tcz: Egypt lengpa, Pharaoh koma Israel mite Egypt gam'a konna puidoh ding'a thu sei chu, Mose leh Aaron ahi lhon'e.
en: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.
text:
EXO 6:27
Thadou: Egypt lengpa, Pharaoh koma Israel mite Egypt gam'a konna puidoh ding'a thu sei chu, Mose leh Aaron ahi lhon'e.
English: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.

tcz: Egypt gam'a Pakaiyin Mose ahoulimpi achun,
en: On the day when the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
text:
EXO 6:28
Thadou: Egypt gam'a Pakaiyin Mose ahoulimpi achun,
English: On the day when the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,

tcz: Aheng'a aseiyin, “Keima Pakai kahi! Egypt lengpa, Pharaoh henga seiyin, keiman naheng'a kasei jouse chu.”
en: The LORD said to Moses, “I am the LORD. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”
text:
EXO 6:29
Thadou: Aheng'a aseiyin, “Keima Pakai kahi! Egypt lengpa, Pharaoh henga seiyin, keiman naheng'a kasei jouse chu.”
English: The LORD said to Moses, “I am the LORD. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”

tcz: Ahinlah Mose in Pakai akinel pin, aseiyin, “Hichu ka bolthei lou ding ahi! ajeh chu keima mipaomo kahi! Ipi jeh a Pharaoh in ka thusei angai ding ham?” ati.
en: Moses said before the LORD, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”
text:
EXO 6:30
Thadou: Ahinlah Mose in Pakai akinel pin, aseiyin, “Hichu ka bolthei lou ding ahi! ajeh chu keima mipaomo kahi! Ipi jeh a Pharaoh in ka thusei angai ding ham?” ati.
English: Moses said before the LORD, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin, “Hiche hi phatechan ngaiyin. Pharaoh lengpa koma Pathen tobang'a kasem ding nahiye, chule na sopipa, Aaron, hi nang dia themgaova pang ding ahi.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
text:
EXO 7:1
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin, “Hiche hi phatechan ngaiyin. Pharaoh lengpa koma Pathen tobang'a kasem ding nahiye, chule na sopipa, Aaron, hi nang dia themgaova pang ding ahi.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.

tcz: Kathupeh jouse hi Aaron jah'a sei in lang, Aaron in Pharaoh heng'a Israel mite agamsung'a kon'a asol doh nading'a thu apeh tei ding ahi.
en: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
text:
EXO 7:2
Thadou: Kathupeh jouse hi Aaron jah'a sei in lang, Aaron in Pharaoh heng'a Israel mite agamsung'a kon'a asol doh nading'a thu apeh tei ding ahi.
English: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

tcz: Ahinlah Keiman Pharaoh lungthim ka suhtah ding, chuteng melchihna le thil kidang tampi Egypt gamsung'a kapunsah ding ahi.
en: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 7:3
Thadou: Ahinlah Keiman Pharaoh lungthim ka suhtah ding, chuteng melchihna le thil kidang tampi Egypt gamsung'a kapunsah ding ahi.
English: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

tcz: Hiche a jong chu Pharaoh in na thu angai lou lai ding ahi. Keiman Egypt gamsung'a ka khut kahin lhanjah ding. Keiman ka thaneina kon - kamite, Israelte - Egypt gam'a kon thutanna gimnei tah pum'a ka huh doh ding ahiuve.
en: But Pharaoh will not listen to you, so I will lay my hand on Egypt, and bring out my armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
text:
EXO 7:4
Thadou: Hiche a jong chu Pharaoh in na thu angai lou lai ding ahi. Keiman Egypt gamsung'a ka khut kahin lhanjah ding. Keiman ka thaneina kon - kamite, Israelte - Egypt gam'a kon thutanna gimnei tah pum'a ka huh doh ding ahiuve.
English: But Pharaoh will not listen to you, so I will lay my hand on Egypt, and bring out my armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

tcz: Keiman ka khut ban thahat ka hinlhan'a Israelte kahin puidoh teng, Egypt miten Keima hi Pakai kahi ahin hetdoh diu ahitai.”
en: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out from among them.”
text:
EXO 7:5
Thadou: Keiman ka khut ban thahat ka hinlhan'a Israelte kahin puidoh teng, Egypt miten Keima hi Pakai kahi ahin hetdoh diu ahitai.”
English: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out from among them.”

tcz: Chuin Pakai thupeh bang'in Mose leh Aaron injong abol lhon tan, ahi.
en: Moses and Aaron did so. As the LORD commanded them, so they did.
text:
EXO 7:6
Thadou: Chuin Pakai thupeh bang'in Mose leh Aaron injong abol lhon tan, ahi.
English: Moses and Aaron did so. As the LORD commanded them, so they did.

tcz: Pharaoh heng'a ngehna aganei lai lhon chun, Mose kum somget ahitan, chule Aaron chu kum som get leh kum thum ahitai.
en: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.
text:
EXO 7:7
Thadou: Pharaoh heng'a ngehna aganei lai lhon chun, Mose kum somget ahitan, chule Aaron chu kum som get leh kum thum ahitai.
English: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'ah thu aseiyin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
text:
EXO 7:8
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'ah thu aseiyin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

tcz: “Pharaoh in ngehna ahin nei ding, ‘thil kidang neivetsah lhonin.' hitobang ahin seiteng, Aaron henga seiyin ‘nateng gol chu la in lang Pharaoh masang laiya chun sep lhan, chuteng gul hung kisoh ding ahi.”
en: “When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, and it will become a serpent.’”
text:
EXO 7:9
Thadou: “Pharaoh in ngehna ahin nei ding, ‘thil kidang neivetsah lhonin.' hitobang ahin seiteng, Aaron henga seiyin ‘nateng gol chu la in lang Pharaoh masang laiya chun sep lhan, chuteng gul hung kisoh ding ahi.”
English: “When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, and it will become a serpent.’”

tcz: Chuin Mose leh Aaron jong Pharaoh heng'a achelhon in Pakai thupeh bang'in abol lhon tai. Aaron in tenggol chu Pharaoh le avaipipo teho angsung'a chun asep lhan ahile, gul ahung kisoh tai!
en: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as the LORD had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
text:
EXO 7:10
Thadou: Chuin Mose leh Aaron jong Pharaoh heng'a achelhon in Pakai thupeh bang'in abol lhon tai. Aaron in tenggol chu Pharaoh le avaipipo teho angsung'a chun asep lhan ahile, gul ahung kisoh tai!
English: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as the LORD had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh in ama miching ho le doithem ho a koukhom in, Egypt gamma mitphel doithem hon jong chuche tobang chu athemguh un abol'un ahi.
en: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. They also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same thing with their enchantments.
text:
EXO 7:11
Thadou: Hichun Pharaoh in ama miching ho le doithem ho a koukhom in, Egypt gamma mitphel doithem hon jong chuche tobang chu athemguh un abol'un ahi.
English: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. They also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same thing with their enchantments.

tcz: Atenggol'u tol'a a seplha cheh uvin ahile, amahoa jong gul aki sohtai! Ahinlah Aaron tenggol chun amaho tenggolho chu aval lhum soh tai.
en: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
text:
EXO 7:12
Thadou: Atenggol'u tol'a a seplha cheh uvin ahile, amahoa jong gul aki sohtai! Ahinlah Aaron tenggol chun amaho tenggolho chu aval lhum soh tai.
English: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

tcz: Hicheng nung jeng hin jong Pakaiyin asei masat bang chun Pharaoh lungthim chu atah jing nalaiyin, thu ima ngaisah in anei hih laiye.
en: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
text:
EXO 7:13
Thadou: Hicheng nung jeng hin jong Pakaiyin asei masat bang chun Pharaoh lungthim chu atah jing nalaiyin, thu ima ngaisah in anei hih laiye.
English: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin, “Pharaoh lungchang atah in, chule aman mipiho soldoh ding anom naipoi.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.
text:
EXO 7:14
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin, “Pharaoh lungchang atah in, chule aman mipiho soldoh ding anom naipoi.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.

tcz: Hijeh chun jingkah teng Pharaoh vadung lam'a hung suh teng nangma na che ding. Nile vadung pam'a nadin ding, hikoma chu nakimupi ding ahi. Na tenggol gul kisoh chu kichoi teiyin.
en: Go to Pharaoh in the morning. Behold, he is going out to the water. You shall stand by the river’s bank to meet him. You shall take the rod which was turned to a serpent in your hand.
text:
EXO 7:15
Thadou: Hijeh chun jingkah teng Pharaoh vadung lam'a hung suh teng nangma na che ding. Nile vadung pam'a nadin ding, hikoma chu nakimupi ding ahi. Na tenggol gul kisoh chu kichoi teiyin.
English: Go to Pharaoh in the morning. Behold, he is going out to the water. You shall stand by the river’s bank to meet him. You shall take the rod which was turned to a serpent in your hand.

tcz: Chuteng akoma hiti hin seiyin, 'Pakai, Hebrew mite Pathen in nakoma thuseiya eihin sol ahi: “Kamite soldoh tan, chuteng amahon gamthip noiya keima eihou na ding uvin.” Tugeiyin, nangman ama thusei iman na ngaisah poi.
en: You shall tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, “Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness. Behold, until now you haven’t listened.”
text:
EXO 7:16
Thadou: Chuteng akoma hiti hin seiyin, 'Pakai, Hebrew mite Pathen in nakoma thuseiya eihin sol ahi: “Kamite soldoh tan, chuteng amahon gamthip noiya keima eihou na ding uvin.” Tugeiyin, nangman ama thusei iman na ngaisah poi.
English: You shall tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, “Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness. Behold, until now you haven’t listened.”

tcz: Hijeh a chu hiche hi Pakaiyin asei ahi: “Keima Pakai kahina ka kilah sah ding ahi.” Vetan! Ka khut'a um tenngol hi mang cha'a Nile twi kajep ding, chu teng vadung hi thisan kisoh ding ahi.
en: The LORD says, “In this you shall know that I am the LORD. Behold: I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
text:
EXO 7:17
Thadou: Hijeh a chu hiche hi Pakaiyin asei ahi: “Keima Pakai kahina ka kilah sah ding ahi.” Vetan! Ka khut'a um tenngol hi mang cha'a Nile twi kajep ding, chu teng vadung hi thisan kisoh ding ahi.
English: The LORD says, “In this you shall know that I am the LORD. Behold: I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

tcz: Asung'a Nga jouse thi ding, chule vadung uilhahel ding, Egypt miten Nile vadung'a kon twi adon thei lou hel diu ahitai,” ati.
en: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river.”’”
text:
EXO 7:18
Thadou: Asung'a Nga jouse thi ding, chule vadung uilhahel ding, Egypt miten Nile vadung'a kon twi adon thei lou hel diu ahitai,” ati.
English: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river.”’”

tcz: Chu jongle Pakaiyin Mose heng ah aseiyin: “Aaron jah a seiyin, 'Na tenggol kimat in lang Egypt gam'a twi jouse chunga na khut jah in lang - vadung jouse, twinah jouse, luikhuh jouse chunga. Twi jouse thisan so sah tan. Egypt gam muntin'a twi jouse, thingtwikong le songkong jouse sunga twi jouse geiya thisan soh ding ahi.'”
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood. There will be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’”
text:
EXO 7:19
Thadou: Chu jongle Pakaiyin Mose heng ah aseiyin: “Aaron jah a seiyin, 'Na tenggol kimat in lang Egypt gam'a twi jouse chunga na khut jah in lang - vadung jouse, twinah jouse, luikhuh jouse chunga. Twi jouse thisan so sah tan. Egypt gam muntin'a twi jouse, thingtwikong le songkong jouse sunga twi jouse geiya thisan soh ding ahi.'”
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood. There will be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’”

tcz: Chuin Mose leh Aaron in jong Pakai thupeh bang'in abol lhon tan ahi. Pharaoh le athunei vaihomte hon avet laiyun, Aaron in jong a tenggol ajahdoh'in Nile luidung chu ajep jeng tan ahi. Phulou helouvin, Vadung twi apumpin thisan akisoh hel tan ahi.
en: Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and struck the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
text:
EXO 7:20
Thadou: Chuin Mose leh Aaron in jong Pakai thupeh bang'in abol lhon tan ahi. Pharaoh le athunei vaihomte hon avet laiyun, Aaron in jong a tenggol ajahdoh'in Nile luidung chu ajep jeng tan ahi. Phulou helouvin, Vadung twi apumpin thisan akisoh hel tan ahi.
English: Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and struck the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

tcz: Luidunga nga jouse athisoh heltan, chule twi anen behseh phat chun Egypt miten adon thei tapouvin ahi. Egypt gamsung pumpi mun jouse thisan dim ahitai.
en: The fish that were in the river died. The river became foul. The Egyptians couldn’t drink water from the river. The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 7:21
Thadou: Luidunga nga jouse athisoh heltan, chule twi anen behseh phat chun Egypt miten adon thei tapouvin ahi. Egypt gamsung pumpi mun jouse thisan dim ahitai.
English: The fish that were in the river died. The river became foul. The Egyptians couldn’t drink water from the river. The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.

tcz: Ahivang'in Egypt gam'a mitphel doithem hon jong adoiyu mangchan amahon jong twi thisan asosah uvin ahi. Hijeh chun Pharaoh lungthim chu atah jing nalaiye. Pakaiyin asei bang in Mose leh Aaron thusei chu nahsah in anei hih laiye.
en: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
text:
EXO 7:22
Thadou: Ahivang'in Egypt gam'a mitphel doithem hon jong adoiyu mangchan amahon jong twi thisan asosah uvin ahi. Hijeh chun Pharaoh lungthim chu atah jing nalaiye. Pakaiyin asei bang in Mose leh Aaron thusei chu nahsah in anei hih laiye.
English: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.

tcz: Pharaoh jong a leng inpi lam'ah akilen, hicheng thilsoh jouse ho chu alungthim'a gel lut kham asa hih laiye.
en: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn’t even take this to heart.
text:
EXO 7:23
Thadou: Pharaoh jong a leng inpi lam'ah akilen, hicheng thilsoh jouse ho chu alungthim'a gel lut kham asa hih laiye.
English: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn’t even take this to heart.

tcz: Ahin Egypt mite jousen luipang dung alai thuh'un twi akihol le tauvin ahi, ajeh chu amahon Nile luidunga twi chu a donthei tah louvu ahi.
en: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn’t drink the river water.
text:
EXO 7:24
Thadou: Ahin Egypt mite jousen luipang dung alai thuh'un twi akihol le tauvin ahi, ajeh chu amahon Nile luidunga twi chu a donthei tah louvu ahi.
English: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn’t drink the river water.

tcz: Pakaiyin Nile luidung ajep kal nisagi alhing tan ahi.
en: Seven days were fulfilled, after the LORD had struck the river.
text:
EXO 7:25
Thadou: Pakaiyin Nile luidung ajep kal nisagi alhing tan ahi.
English: Seven days were fulfilled, after the LORD had struck the river.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Pharaoh heng ah chen lang hiti hin gasei kit tem in, “Hiche hi Pakai thusei ahi: Kamite soldoh jeng tan, chutileh amahon keima kin abol ding'u ahiye.”
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
text:
EXO 8:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Pharaoh heng ah chen lang hiti hin gasei kit tem in, “Hiche hi Pakai thusei ahi: Kamite soldoh jeng tan, chutileh amahon keima kin abol ding'u ahiye.”
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

tcz: “Nahsah moa amaho nasol doh louva ahileh, nagam sung pumpia ukeng kahin lansah ding ahi.”
en: If you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs.
text:
EXO 8:2
Thadou: “Nahsah moa amaho nasol doh louva ahileh, nagam sung pumpia ukeng kahin lansah ding ahi.”
English: If you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs.

tcz: “Nile luidung jong ukeng dimlha jeng ding ahi. Na insung leh na lupna channa hungkal doh diu! Na mite leh na nung jui ho jouse kom channa lhung ding, na chang lhah meh nau jouse'a jong hung lut dimset ding ahiuve.”
en: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.
text:
EXO 8:3
Thadou: “Nile luidung jong ukeng dimlha jeng ding ahi. Na insung leh na lupna channa hungkal doh diu! Na mite leh na nung jui ho jouse kom channa lhung ding, na chang lhah meh nau jouse'a jong hung lut dimset ding ahiuve.”
English: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.

tcz: “Ukengte chung leh nanung juiho jouse chung'a chom le ding'u ahi.”
en: The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants.”’”
text:
EXO 8:4
Thadou: “Ukengte chung leh nanung juiho jouse chung'a chom le ding'u ahi.”
English: The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants.”’”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Aaron jah'a sei jin lang, ‘Egypt gamsung pumpi ukeng ten ahinlo dim nading in, natenggol jah in, twinah jouse, twilam jouse leh luidung jouse chu jeptan! Ukengten Egypt gam pumpi hinluo dim tante,tin seipeh in,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.’”
text:
EXO 8:5
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Aaron jah'a sei jin lang, ‘Egypt gamsung pumpi ukeng ten ahinlo dim nading in, natenggol jah in, twinah jouse, twilam jouse leh luidung jouse chu jeptan! Ukengten Egypt gam pumpi hinluo dim tante,tin seipeh in,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.’”

tcz: Aaron'in jong Egypt gamsung twi chung'a akhut ajah'in ajep tan ahile, ukengte ahung potdoh'un Egypt gamsung pumpi alodim jeng tan!
en: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 8:6
Thadou: Aaron'in jong Egypt gamsung twi chung'a akhut ajah'in ajep tan ahile, ukengte ahung potdoh'un Egypt gamsung pumpi alodim jeng tan!
English: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

tcz: Ahinlah Egypt gam'a mitphel doithem hon jong hitabang chun abolthei uve. Ukengte chu gamsung'a alhalut thei un ahile gam pumpi chu ukengte adim lhatai.
en: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 8:7
Thadou: Ahinlah Egypt gam'a mitphel doithem hon jong hitabang chun abolthei uve. Ukengte chu gamsung'a alhalut thei un ahile gam pumpi chu ukengte adim lhatai.
English: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.

tcz: Chu phat'in Pharaoh in Mose leh Aaron akouvin hiti hin aseije, “Pakai heng'a tao lhon tan, ajeh chu keima le ka mite jouse'a konna ukengte alah doh na ding in, chu teng keiman namite'u ka soldoh ding, amaho che uva Pakai kin aga bol diu ahi,” ati.
en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, “Entreat the LORD, that he take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to the LORD.”
text:
EXO 8:8
Thadou: Chu phat'in Pharaoh in Mose leh Aaron akouvin hiti hin aseije, “Pakai heng'a tao lhon tan, ajeh chu keima le ka mite jouse'a konna ukengte alah doh na ding in, chu teng keiman namite'u ka soldoh ding, amaho che uva Pakai kin aga bol diu ahi,” ati.
English: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, “Entreat the LORD, that he take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to the LORD.”

tcz: Mose'n adonbut in, “Nang le na sohte, chule namite ding'a itih phat'a katao ding nei seipeh in ati. Chuteng na in dung jouse'a ukengte Nile vadung lam'a kitol ding ahitai,” ati.
en: Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only.”
text:
EXO 8:9
Thadou: Mose'n adonbut in, “Nang le na sohte, chule namite ding'a itih phat'a katao ding nei seipeh in ati. Chuteng na in dung jouse'a ukengte Nile vadung lam'a kitol ding ahitai,” ati.
English: Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only.”

tcz: Pharaoh'in adonbut in ajah a, “Jing teng bol in,” ati. Mose'n henge, “Nasei bang bang hita hen. Chuti leh nangman keiho Pakai, Pathen tailou dang aum poi ti nahin hetdoh ding ahi,” ati.
en: Pharaoh said, “Tomorrow.” Moses said, “Let it be according to your word, that you may know that there is no one like the LORD our God.
text:
EXO 8:10
Thadou: Pharaoh'in adonbut in ajah a, “Jing teng bol in,” ati. Mose'n henge, “Nasei bang bang hita hen. Chuti leh nangman keiho Pakai, Pathen tailou dang aum poi ti nahin hetdoh ding ahi,” ati.
English: Pharaoh said, “Tomorrow.” Moses said, “Let it be according to your word, that you may know that there is no one like the LORD our God.

tcz: “Ukengten nangma leh na nungjui ho jouse le namite naboncha uva na dalhah diu, Nile luidung a bou umden diu ahi,” ati.
en: The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.”
text:
EXO 8:11
Thadou: “Ukengten nangma leh na nungjui ho jouse le namite naboncha uva na dalhah diu, Nile luidung a bou umden diu ahi,” ati.
English: The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.”

tcz: Chuin Mose leh Aaron jong Pharaoh angsung'a kon in achedoh lhon in, Mose chu Pakai lam sang in kap pum in ataovin, Pharaoh le amite akon in ukengte ladoh tan ati.
en: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to the LORD concerning the frogs which he had brought on Pharaoh.
text:
EXO 8:12
Thadou: Chuin Mose leh Aaron jong Pharaoh angsung'a kon in achedoh lhon in, Mose chu Pakai lam sang in kap pum in ataovin, Pharaoh le amite akon in ukengte ladoh tan ati.
English: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to the LORD concerning the frogs which he had brought on Pharaoh.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose taona chu asanpeh tan, indung jouse, lou jao leh gamsung'a ukeng jouse a sumang hel tan ahi.
en: The LORD did according to the word of Moses, and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courts, and out of the fields.
text:
EXO 8:13
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose taona chu asanpeh tan, indung jouse, lou jao leh gamsung'a ukeng jouse a sumang hel tan ahi.
English: The LORD did according to the word of Moses, and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courts, and out of the fields.

tcz: Egypt miten ukeng thisa hochu aloh khom'un ahile gamsung pumpi a uilha jeng tan ahi
en: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.
text:
EXO 8:14
Thadou: Egypt miten ukeng thisa hochu aloh khom'un ahile gamsung pumpi a uilha jeng tan ahi
English: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.

tcz: Ahinlah Pharaoh'in dinmun ahung oldom taiti ahin hetdoh phat in, angaija bang in a lungthim atah kit tai. Pakaiyin aseidohsa bang in Mose leh Aaron thusei chu anahsah kit tapoi.
en: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
text:
EXO 8:15
Thadou: Ahinlah Pharaoh'in dinmun ahung oldom taiti ahin hetdoh phat in, angaija bang in a lungthim atah kit tai. Pakaiyin aseidohsa bang in Mose leh Aaron thusei chu anahsah kit tapoi.
English: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Aaron heng'a sei inlang, ‘Na tenggol jandoh in tol lhang jep tem in. Chuteng Egypt gam pumpi'a thousi vaishi chule nen'in ahin lodim jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the earth, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.’”
text:
EXO 8:16
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Aaron heng'a sei inlang, ‘Na tenggol jandoh in tol lhang jep tem in. Chuteng Egypt gam pumpi'a thousi vaishi chule nen'in ahin lodim jeng ding ahi,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the earth, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.’”

tcz: Pakai thupeh bang in Mose leh Aaron'in jong abol lhontan. Aaron'in jong akhut ajah'in atenggol'a tol lham chu ajep'a ahile, thousi vaibong tamtah'in Egypt gam pumpi le gamsa jouse a lodim jeng tan chule boh nen in gamsung alodimjeng in ahi.
en: They did so; and Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and struck the dust of the earth, and there were lice on man, and on animal; all the dust of the earth became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 8:17
Thadou: Pakai thupeh bang in Mose leh Aaron'in jong abol lhontan. Aaron'in jong akhut ajah'in atenggol'a tol lham chu ajep'a ahile, thousi vaibong tamtah'in Egypt gam pumpi le gamsa jouse a lodim jeng tan chule boh nen in gamsung alodimjeng in ahi.
English: They did so; and Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and struck the dust of the earth, and there were lice on man, and on animal; all the dust of the earth became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

tcz: Pharaoh doithem choihon atabang bang abolthei jing vang uvin, tunvang alosam tauvin abolthei tapouvin ahi. Thousi vaibong'in mipi hole gamsung'a gancha jouse atomlha tauvin ahi.
en: The magicians tried with their enchantments to produce lice, but they couldn’t. There were lice on man, and on animal.
text:
EXO 8:18
Thadou: Pharaoh doithem choihon atabang bang abolthei jing vang uvin, tunvang alosam tauvin abolthei tapouvin ahi. Thousi vaibong'in mipi hole gamsung'a gancha jouse atomlha tauvin ahi.
English: The magicians tried with their enchantments to produce lice, but they couldn’t. There were lice on man, and on animal.

tcz: Hiti chun doithem choihon jong Pharaoh heng'a asei un, “Hiche hi Pathen khutnung mong ahi,” atitauve. Ahinlah Pharaoh lungthim chu angaija bang'in atah jing na laiye. Pakaiyin a seidoh sa bang in, Pharaoh'injong amaho thusei chu anahsah deh pon ahi.
en: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.
text:
EXO 8:19
Thadou: Hiti chun doithem choihon jong Pharaoh heng'a asei un, “Hiche hi Pathen khutnung mong ahi,” atitauve. Ahinlah Pharaoh lungthim chu angaija bang'in atah jing na laiye. Pakaiyin a seidoh sa bang in, Pharaoh'injong amaho thusei chu anahsah deh pon ahi.
English: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga hitihin a seikit tai, “Jingkah teng Nile vadung lam'a Pharaoh hung ding chuteng nangman na kimu piding.” Ajah'a Pakaiyin hiti hin asei je: “Kamite soldoh tan, ajeh chu amahon keima kin abol ding'u ahi,” tia nasei ding ahi, ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
text:
EXO 8:20
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga hitihin a seikit tai, “Jingkah teng Nile vadung lam'a Pharaoh hung ding chuteng nangman na kimu piding.” Ajah'a Pakaiyin hiti hin asei je: “Kamite soldoh tan, ajeh chu amahon keima kin abol ding'u ahi,” tia nasei ding ahi, ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

tcz: Na soldoh louva ahile, “Keiman namite, nanung juiho chule na insung jousea thousi vaisi kahin lansah ding ahi. Egypt mite in jouse thousi vaisin atomlhah jeng ding, Gam leiset pumpi jong dimlha jeng ding ahi, ati.
en: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on.
text:
EXO 8:21
Thadou: Na soldoh louva ahile, “Keiman namite, nanung juiho chule na insung jousea thousi vaisi kahin lansah ding ahi. Egypt mite in jouse thousi vaisin atomlhah jeng ding, Gam leiset pumpi jong dimlha jeng ding ahi, ati.
English: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on.

tcz: Ahinlah kamite chenna Goshen achom beh'a kahoidoh ding ahi. Thousi khatcha lenglut louhel ding ahi. Chuteng leiset pumpin keima hi Pakai kitipa chu kahi ti nahin hetdoh diu ahi,” ati.
en: I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there, to the end you may know that I am the LORD on the earth.
text:
EXO 8:22
Thadou: Ahinlah kamite chenna Goshen achom beh'a kahoidoh ding ahi. Thousi khatcha lenglut louhel ding ahi. Chuteng leiset pumpin keima hi Pakai kitipa chu kahi ti nahin hetdoh diu ahi,” ati.
English: I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there, to the end you may know that I am the LORD on the earth.

tcz: Keiman kamite leh na mite kah'a kikhenna ka sem doh ding, “Hiche thil kidang meilchihna hi jing nikho teng soh ding ahi,” ati.
en: I will put a division between my people and your people. This sign shall happen by tomorrow.”’”
text:
EXO 8:23
Thadou: Keiman kamite leh na mite kah'a kikhenna ka sem doh ding, “Hiche thil kidang meilchihna hi jing nikho teng soh ding ahi,” ati.
English: I will put a division between my people and your people. This sign shall happen by tomorrow.”’”

tcz: Pakaiyin aseidoh bang'in aboltan. “Thousi vaibong techun Pharaoh insung, anungjui ho ingsung leh gamsung in jousea a lenglut tauvin adimlha jeng tai.” Thousi vaibong ahon hon in Egypt gamsung'a ahung kitol lut tan ahile gamsung pumpi chu athim lha jeng tan ahi.
en: The LORD did so; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses. In all the land of Egypt the land was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies.
text:
EXO 8:24
Thadou: Pakaiyin aseidoh bang'in aboltan. “Thousi vaibong techun Pharaoh insung, anungjui ho ingsung leh gamsung in jousea a lenglut tauvin adimlha jeng tai.” Thousi vaibong ahon hon in Egypt gamsung'a ahung kitol lut tan ahile gamsung pumpi chu athim lha jeng tan ahi.
English: The LORD did so; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses. In all the land of Egypt the land was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies.

tcz: Chuphat in Pharaoh in Mose leh Aaron aga kouvin, hiti hin aseije, “Apha tai! che uvin lang Pakai maicham gasem taovin, ati.” Aman asei jin “Hichu Egypt gamsung'a na bol ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God in the land!”
text:
EXO 8:25
Thadou: Chuphat in Pharaoh in Mose leh Aaron aga kouvin, hiti hin aseije, “Apha tai! che uvin lang Pakai maicham gasem taovin, ati.” Aman asei jin “Hichu Egypt gamsung'a na bol ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God in the land!”

tcz: Mose'n a donbut in hitin aseije, “Hichu adih thei poi. Keihon Ka-Pakaiju le Ka-Pathen'u angsung'a kilhaina maicham kasem diu chu, hiche lai Egypt mite adia thil kitoh thei louding ahiye. Ven! Hitabang thilho pi chu bol taleng'u Egypt miten song'a eise lih gam ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: Moses said, “It isn’t appropriate to do so; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God. Behold, if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, won’t they stone us?
text:
EXO 8:26
Thadou: Mose'n a donbut in hitin aseije, “Hichu adih thei poi. Keihon Ka-Pakaiju le Ka-Pathen'u angsung'a kilhaina maicham kasem diu chu, hiche lai Egypt mite adia thil kitoh thei louding ahiye. Ven! Hitabang thilho pi chu bol taleng'u Egypt miten song'a eise lih gam ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: Moses said, “It isn’t appropriate to do so; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God. Behold, if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, won’t they stone us?

tcz: “Ka-Pakaiju leh ka-Pathen'u angsung'a kilhaina hi nithum sung hitei ding ahi, hichu Pakaiyin keima hodia a seidohsa ahi, ati.”
en: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.”
text:
EXO 8:27
Thadou: “Ka-Pakaiju leh ka-Pathen'u angsung'a kilhaina hi nithum sung hitei ding ahi, hichu Pakaiyin keima hodia a seidohsa ahi, ati.”
English: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.”

tcz: Pharaoh'in adonbut in ajah'a hiti hin aseije, “Apha tai, che tauvin,” keiman nangho gamthip noija na-Pakai ju kinbol ding'in kaphal tai, amavang na che gamlhat louhel ding'u ahi. “Tun che uvin lang keima ding in neitao peh'un,” ati.
en: Pharaoh said, “I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness, only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me.”
text:
EXO 8:28
Thadou: Pharaoh'in adonbut in ajah'a hiti hin aseije, “Apha tai, che tauvin,” keiman nangho gamthip noija na-Pakai ju kinbol ding'in kaphal tai, amavang na che gamlhat louhel ding'u ahi. “Tun che uvin lang keima ding in neitao peh'un,” ati.
English: Pharaoh said, “I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness, only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose thupeh anei jin,“Pharaoh heng'a che kit in lang ajah'a hiti hin sei jin. Hiche hi ahi Hebrew mite Pakai, Pathen'in asei chu: Kamite che'u hen lang, Keima kin gabol uhen.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
text:
EXO 9:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose thupeh anei jin,“Pharaoh heng'a che kit in lang ajah'a hiti hin sei jin. Hiche hi ahi Hebrew mite Pakai, Pathen'in asei chu: Kamite che'u hen lang, Keima kin gabol uhen.
English: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

tcz: Na soldoh louva Israel mite hi na umsah jeng ding'a ahile,
en: For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,
text:
EXO 9:2
Thadou: Na soldoh louva Israel mite hi na umsah jeng ding'a ahile,
English: For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,

tcz: Na loujaova na gancha jouse na sa kolte, sangante, sangongsao te, gancha hon, kelngoite leh na kelchate chung'a gamna hise kahin lansah ding thigam kei ding ahiuve, ati.
en: behold, the LORD’s hand is on your livestock which are in the field, on the horses, on the donkeys, on the camels, on the herds, and on the flocks with a very grievous pestilence.
text:
EXO 9:3
Thadou: Na loujaova na gancha jouse na sa kolte, sangante, sangongsao te, gancha hon, kelngoite leh na kelchate chung'a gamna hise kahin lansah ding thigam kei ding ahiuve, ati.
English: behold, the LORD’s hand is on your livestock which are in the field, on the horses, on the donkeys, on the camels, on the herds, and on the flocks with a very grievous pestilence.

tcz: Ahin lah Pakaiyin Isrrael te gancha ho leh Egypt mite gancha ho chung'a chom khenna ahin sem ding, Israel mite ganchaho vang chu khatcha jong thilou ding ahi!
en: The LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt; and nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel.”’”
text:
EXO 9:4
Thadou: Ahin lah Pakaiyin Isrrael te gancha ho leh Egypt mite gancha ho chung'a chom khenna ahin sem ding, Israel mite ganchaho vang chu khatcha jong thilou ding ahi!
English: The LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt; and nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel.”’”

tcz: “Pakaiyin hiche gamna hise ahin lan sah ding ahitai. Aman aseije jing nikho teng gamsung pumpia ahinlan sah ding ahi.”
en: The LORD appointed a set time, saying, “Tomorrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.”
text:
EXO 9:5
Thadou: “Pakaiyin hiche gamna hise ahin lan sah ding ahitai. Aman aseije jing nikho teng gamsung pumpia ahinlan sah ding ahi.”
English: The LORD appointed a set time, saying, “Tomorrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.”

tcz: Pakaiyin aseidoh bang in aboltai. A jing jingkah in Egypt mite gancha athigam hel tan, ahinlah Israel mite gancha vang chu khatcha jong athi hih beh jeng'e.
en: The LORD did that thing on the next day; and all the livestock of Egypt died, but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.
text:
EXO 9:6
Thadou: Pakaiyin aseidoh bang in aboltai. A jing jingkah in Egypt mite gancha athigam hel tan, ahinlah Israel mite gancha vang chu khatcha jong athi hih beh jeng'e.
English: The LORD did that thing on the next day; and all the livestock of Egypt died, but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.

tcz: Thilsoh umchan dol khol chil ding'in Pharaoh'vin asohte hochu asoltan ahile, Israel mite gancha hochu khat cha jeng jong athi pon ahi! Ama vang Pharaoh lung thim chu angaiya bang'in atah jing nalaiyin* aman mipiho chu asol doh dehpon ahi.
en: Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not so much as one of the livestock of the Israelites dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn, and he didn’t let the people go.
text:
EXO 9:7
Thadou: Thilsoh umchan dol khol chil ding'in Pharaoh'vin asohte hochu asoltan ahile, Israel mite gancha hochu khat cha jeng jong athi pon ahi! Ama vang Pharaoh lung thim chu angaiya bang'in atah jing nalaiyin* aman mipiho chu asol doh dehpon ahi.
English: Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not so much as one of the livestock of the Israelites dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn, and he didn’t let the people go.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'a asei jin, “lhum sung'a kon in vutdi tampi kiham lhon'in, hichu Pharaoh mitmu chang tah'a Mose'n vanlam'a athe touding ahi,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses and to Aaron, “Take handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh.
text:
EXO 9:8
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'a asei jin, “lhum sung'a kon in vutdi tampi kiham lhon'in, hichu Pharaoh mitmu chang tah'a Mose'n vanlam'a athe touding ahi,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses and to Aaron, “Take handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh.

tcz: “Egypt gamsung pumpi chu vulvai nelsel chun alodim jeng ding, chuteng mihem chung hile gancha chung hile uilut natna huoisen alhundan jeng diu ahi,” ati.
en: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt.”
text:
EXO 9:9
Thadou: “Egypt gamsung pumpi chu vulvai nelsel chun alodim jeng ding, chuteng mihem chung hile gancha chung hile uilut natna huoisen alhundan jeng diu ahi,” ati.
English: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt.”

tcz: “Chuin amanin jong lhumsung'a konin vutdi aki ham lhonin, Mose angsung'a ading lhon tai,” Pharaoh'vin avet jing laiyin, Mose'n vutdi chengse chu vanlam angan athetou le, vutdi niel chun gampumpi aluodim jing tan mihem le gancha hochung'a uilut natna huoisi alang’ tai.
en: They took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky; and it became boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal.
text:
EXO 9:10
Thadou: “Chuin amanin jong lhumsung'a konin vutdi aki ham lhonin, Mose angsung'a ading lhon tai,” Pharaoh'vin avet jing laiyin, Mose'n vutdi chengse chu vanlam angan athetou le, vutdi niel chun gampumpi aluodim jing tan mihem le gancha hochung'a uilut natna huoisi alang’ tai.
English: They took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky; and it became boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal.

tcz: Egypt gam'a doithem choiya thilbol ho chung'a jong achutan Mose angsung'a ading ngam ta pouvin, ajeh chu uilut natna huoisi chun amahole Egypt mite jouse alhun den jeng ahitai.
en: The magicians couldn’t stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians.
text:
EXO 9:11
Thadou: Egypt gam'a doithem choiya thilbol ho chung'a jong achutan Mose angsung'a ading ngam ta pouvin, ajeh chu uilut natna huoisi chun amahole Egypt mite jouse alhun den jeng ahitai.
English: The magicians couldn’t stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians.

tcz: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim asutah nalaijin, “Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseidohsa bang'in, Pharaoh in ngainahsa in anei hih laiye.”
en: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken to Moses.
text:
EXO 9:12
Thadou: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim asutah nalaijin, “Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseidohsa bang'in, Pharaoh in ngainahsa in anei hih laiye.”
English: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken to Moses.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei yin, “Jingkah matah'in thouvin Pharaoh angsung'a ga ding'in lang, ajah'a seijin. Hebrew mite Pakai Pathen in hiti hin aseije: “Kamite soldoh tan, keima kin agabol na ding uvin.”
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
text:
EXO 9:13
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei yin, “Jingkah matah'in thouvin Pharaoh angsung'a ga ding'in lang, ajah'a seijin. Hebrew mite Pakai Pathen in hiti hin aseije: “Kamite soldoh tan, keima kin agabol na ding uvin.”
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

tcz: “Na soldoh louva ahile, keiman natna huoisi ka hin lansah benah lai ding nangma le nanung juiho chule namite chung'a ka hin lansah cheh ding, chuteng nangman keima Pakai tailou leiset'a Pathen dang aum poi ti na hin hetdoh ding ahi,” ati.
en: For this time I will send all my plagues against your heart, against your officials, and against your people; that you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.
text:
EXO 9:14
Thadou: “Na soldoh louva ahile, keiman natna huoisi ka hin lansah benah lai ding nangma le nanung juiho chule namite chung'a ka hin lansah cheh ding, chuteng nangman keima Pakai tailou leiset'a Pathen dang aum poi ti na hin hetdoh ding ahi,” ati.
English: For this time I will send all my plagues against your heart, against your officials, and against your people; that you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.

tcz: “Tu jeng ajong keiman ka khut ka lhan jah'a nangma le namite chung'a gamna huise ka lansah'a leiset chung'a hi kasuh mang hel jeng thei na hiye.”
en: For now I would have stretched out my hand, and struck you and your people with pestilence, and you would have been cut off from the earth;

tcz: “Ahinlah keiman leiset pumpia ka thaneina ka musah bou na hin hichu leiset pumpia kithe jal ding ahi.”
en: but indeed for this cause I have made you stand: to show you my power, and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth,
text:
EXO 9:16
Thadou: “Ahinlah keiman leiset pumpia ka thaneina ka musah bou na hin hichu leiset pumpia kithe jal ding ahi.”
English: but indeed for this cause I have made you stand: to show you my power, and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth,

tcz: “Ahinlah hicheng jouse nung injong nangma leh nangma na kichoisang gunset in, kamite na soldoh hih laiye.”
en: because you still exalt yourself against my people, that you won’t let them go.
text:
EXO 9:17
Thadou: “Ahinlah hicheng jouse nung injong nangma leh nangma na kichoisang gunset in, kamite na soldoh hih laiye.”
English: because you still exalt yourself against my people, that you won’t let them go.

tcz: “Jing nikho tuphat dontah le keiman gilchang nasatah Egypt gamsung'a ima tichanna analha khaloulai chu kahin lhahsah ding ahiye.”
en: Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now.
text:
EXO 9:18
Thadou: “Jing nikho tuphat dontah le keiman gilchang nasatah Egypt gamsung'a ima tichanna analha khaloulai chu kahin lhahsah ding ahiye.”
English: Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now.

tcz: “Kino tan! Na loujaova gancha ho jouse hoitup ding in namite sol loijin, achuti louva ahile hi tabang gilchang ahung kheh teng lou jaova mihem hihen gancha hijong le aki dalha chan chu gilchang'in ase'a thi jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en: Now therefore command that all of your livestock and all that you have in the field be brought into shelter. The hail will come down on every man and animal that is found in the field, and isn’t brought home, and they will die.”’”
text:
EXO 9:19
Thadou: “Kino tan! Na loujaova gancha ho jouse hoitup ding in namite sol loijin, achuti louva ahile hi tabang gilchang ahung kheh teng lou jaova mihem hihen gancha hijong le aki dalha chan chu gilchang'in ase'a thi jeng ding ahi,” ati.
English: Now therefore command that all of your livestock and all that you have in the field be brought into shelter. The hail will come down on every man and animal that is found in the field, and isn’t brought home, and they will die.”’”

tcz: Pharaoh nungjuiho mi phabep chu Pakaiyin hitia asei jeh chun aki cha tauve. Amaho acheloi jun loujaova gancha hole asohte ho'u chu aga puilut taovin ahi.
en: Those who feared the LORD’s word among the servants of Pharaoh made their servants and their livestock flee into the houses.
text:
EXO 9:20
Thadou: Pharaoh nungjuiho mi phabep chu Pakaiyin hitia asei jeh chun aki cha tauve. Amaho acheloi jun loujaova gancha hole asohte ho'u chu aga puilut taovin ahi.
English: Those who feared the LORD’s word among the servants of Pharaoh made their servants and their livestock flee into the houses.

tcz: Ahinlah Pakai thusei ija sep louse vang chun a loujao dung uva kihong tah'in gancha alha thang nalai uve.
en: Whoever didn’t respect the LORD’s word left his servants and his livestock in the field.
text:
EXO 9:21
Thadou: Ahinlah Pakai thusei ija sep louse vang chun a loujao dung uva kihong tah'in gancha alha thang nalai uve.
English: Whoever didn’t respect the LORD’s word left his servants and his livestock in the field.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Egypt gamsung loujao tin cheng'a gelchang ahung kheh'a mihem ahin gancha ahin chule loujaova thingphung jouse hihen lang, Egypt gamsung pumpia thil umjouse ase khah na ding in vanlam nganlang na khut lhang jah tan,” tin asei tai.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, on man, and on animal, and on every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.”
text:
EXO 9:22
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Egypt gamsung loujao tin cheng'a gelchang ahung kheh'a mihem ahin gancha ahin chule loujaova thingphung jouse hihen lang, Egypt gamsung pumpia thil umjouse ase khah na ding in vanlam nganlang na khut lhang jah tan,” tin asei tai.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, on man, and on animal, and on every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.”

tcz: Chuin Mose'n jong vanlam asang in a tenggol chu agah jah doh jeng le,Pakaiyin van thamjol aki thinsah'in gelchang ahung khe tan, leiset chung geijin meikong ahung leng lha tan, Egypt gam pumpia Pakaiyin gilchang goju toh ki bang chat in a khehsah tan ahi.
en: Moses stretched out his rod toward the heavens, and the LORD sent thunder and hail; and lightning flashed down to the earth. The LORD rained hail on the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 9:23
Thadou: Chuin Mose'n jong vanlam asang in a tenggol chu agah jah doh jeng le,Pakaiyin van thamjol aki thinsah'in gelchang ahung khe tan, leiset chung geijin meikong ahung leng lha tan, Egypt gam pumpia Pakaiyin gilchang goju toh ki bang chat in a khehsah tan ahi.
English: Moses stretched out his rod toward the heavens, and the LORD sent thunder and hail; and lightning flashed down to the earth. The LORD rained hail on the land of Egypt.

tcz: Imatih chan a jong hitobang gilchang chu Egypt gamsunga anakhe khalou lai ahin, tanglou hel'in gelchan chu akhe tan meikou apah lha jeng in ahi.
en: So there was very severe hail, and lightning mixed with the hail, such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
text:
EXO 9:24
Thadou: Imatih chan a jong hitobang gilchang chu Egypt gamsunga anakhe khalou lai ahin, tanglou hel'in gelchan chu akhe tan meikou apah lha jeng in ahi.
English: So there was very severe hail, and lightning mixed with the hail, such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

tcz: Hitabang gelchang chun Egypt gamsung pumpi alodim lhajeng tan chule lou jaova umphot gancha hihen mihem hijong le aum jouse chu asep lhu jeng tan, gamsunga thingphung jouse jong asep thang deh tan ahi.
en: The hail struck throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and animal; and the hail struck every herb of the field, and broke every tree of the field.
text:
EXO 9:25
Thadou: Hitabang gelchang chun Egypt gamsung pumpi alodim lhajeng tan chule lou jaova umphot gancha hihen mihem hijong le aum jouse chu asep lhu jeng tan, gamsunga thingphung jouse jong asep thang deh tan ahi.
English: The hail struck throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and animal; and the hail struck every herb of the field, and broke every tree of the field.

tcz: Goshen mun Israel mite chenna mun bou chu ahoidoh tan ahi.
en: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.
text:
EXO 9:26
Thadou: Goshen mun Israel mite chenna mun bou chu ahoidoh tan ahi.
English: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.

tcz: Hitia thil asophat chun, Pharaoh in jong mi asol loijin Mose leh Aaron agakousah tan hiti hin aseiye, “Tun vang keima chonse ka hitai,” tin kilhaina aneiyin “Pakai hi thudih tanpa ahin, keima le kamite ka dih tapouve,” ati.
