en: Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, “I have sinned this time. The LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.
text:
EXO 9:27
Thadou: Hitia thil asophat chun, Pharaoh in jong mi asol loijin Mose leh Aaron agakousah tan hiti hin aseiye, “Tun vang keima chonse ka hitai,” tin kilhaina aneiyin “Pakai hi thudih tanpa ahin, keima le kamite ka dih tapouve,” ati.
English: Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, “I have sinned this time. The LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

tcz: Pakai henga nei tao peh lhon tan, ajeh chu vanthamjol aging jeng jung'e! gilchang na satah in akhe jing nalaijin ahi. Ka gim val taove. Keiman na soldoh tau ving'e; umjong umsot ta hih'un, ati.
en: Pray to the LORD; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.”
text:
EXO 9:28
Thadou: Pakai henga nei tao peh lhon tan, ajeh chu vanthamjol aging jeng jung'e! gilchang na satah in akhe jing nalaijin ahi. Ka gim val taove. Keiman na soldoh tau ving'e; umjong umsot ta hih'un, ati.
English: Pray to the LORD; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.”

tcz: Mose'n a donbut in, “ahi le aphai”, Khopi sung hi ka dalhah lhah leh keiman jong Pakai heng'a ka taoding ahi. Vanthamjol gin hung thip ding, gilchang khejong hung tang jeng ding, nangman jong leiset pumpi hi Pakaiya ahi ti na het doh ding ahi,” ati.
en: Moses said to him, “As soon as I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands to the LORD. The thunders shall cease, and there will not be any more hail; that you may know that the earth is the LORD’s.
text:
EXO 9:29
Thadou: Mose'n a donbut in, “ahi le aphai”, Khopi sung hi ka dalhah lhah leh keiman jong Pakai heng'a ka taoding ahi. Vanthamjol gin hung thip ding, gilchang khejong hung tang jeng ding, nangman jong leiset pumpi hi Pakaiya ahi ti na het doh ding ahi,” ati.
English: Moses said to him, “As soon as I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands to the LORD. The thunders shall cease, and there will not be any more hail; that you may know that the earth is the LORD’s.

tcz: “Ahinlah keiman kahe jing nalaije, nangma leh nasoh ten tuchan'in Pakai na ging hih lai uve,” ati.
en: But as for you and your servants, I know that you don’t yet fear the LORD God.”
text:
EXO 9:30
Thadou: “Ahinlah keiman kahe jing nalaije, nangma leh nasoh ten tuchan'in Pakai na ging hih lai uve,” ati.
English: But as for you and your servants, I know that you don’t yet fear the LORD God.”

tcz: Hiti chun gamsung'a Phaipheng jouse leh sakol chang abonchan amangthah hel jeng tai, sakol chang chu avui ado laitah ahin chule phaipheng chu ahung don doh laita ahiye.
en: The flax and the barley were struck, for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming.
text:
EXO 9:31
Thadou: Hiti chun gamsung'a Phaipheng jouse leh sakol chang abonchan amangthah hel jeng tai, sakol chang chu avui ado laitah ahin chule phaipheng chu ahung don doh laita ahiye.
English: The flax and the barley were struck, for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming.

tcz: Hiche lah achun suhlou chang leh butun chang vang ahoidoh nai, ajeh chu suhlou chang leh butuchang chu aduo aum lou laiphat ana hiye.
en: But the wheat and the spelt were not struck, for they had not grown up.
text:
EXO 9:32
Thadou: Hiche lah achun suhlou chang leh butun chang vang ahoidoh nai, ajeh chu suhlou chang leh butuchang chu aduo aum lou laiphat ana hiye.
English: But the wheat and the spelt were not struck, for they had not grown up.

tcz: Chu in Mose jong Pharaoh angsung khopi dalhan ache tai. Pakai lam asang in ataovin ahile, vanthamjol kithin le gelchang khe chu atang jeng tan, leiset pumpia gojuh jeng jong atang hel tan ahi.
en: Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread out his hands to the LORD; and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured on the earth.
text:
EXO 9:33
Thadou: Chu in Mose jong Pharaoh angsung khopi dalhan ache tai. Pakai lam asang in ataovin ahile, vanthamjol kithin le gelchang khe chu atang jeng tan, leiset pumpia gojuh jeng jong atang hel tan ahi.
English: Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread out his hands to the LORD; and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured on the earth.

tcz: Pharaoh’ in jong gojuh, van ki thin, leh gelchang kheh akitang taiti ahin hetdoh phat'in amale anung jui ho achonse kittao vin, angaiya bang'in Pharaoh lungthim atah kit tai.
en: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
text:
EXO 9:34
Thadou: Pharaoh’ in jong gojuh, van ki thin, leh gelchang kheh akitang taiti ahin hetdoh phat'in amale anung jui ho achonse kittao vin, angaiya bang'in Pharaoh lungthim atah kit tai.
English: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a ana seidoh sa bang in Pharaoh lung-thim angaiya bang'in atah kittan, Pharaoh'in jong Israel mite asoldoh deh poi.
en: The heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go, just as the LORD had spoken through Moses.
text:
EXO 9:35
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a ana seidoh sa bang in Pharaoh lung-thim angaiya bang'in atah kittan, Pharaoh'in jong Israel mite asoldoh deh poi.
English: The heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go, just as the LORD had spoken through Moses.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Pharaoh heng'a che kit inlang, ga seikit tan. Keiman ama leh a sohte ho lungthim ka suhtah ahin, melchihna hicheng jouse hi ka kilah sah ding ahi,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his servants, that I may show these my signs among them;

tcz: “Chule nangman jong na chapate leh natupa te jah'a ichan geija ka gimsah uva chule melchihna tampi ka musah uve ti na jahsah thei na diuva kasei ahiye. Nangho jeng in jong keima hi Pakai kitipa chu kahi ti na hetdoh jeng diu ahi,” ati.
en: and that you may tell in the hearing of your son, and of your son’s son, what things I have done to Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that you may know that I am the LORD.”
text:
EXO 10:2
Thadou: “Chule nangman jong na chapate leh natupa te jah'a ichan geija ka gimsah uva chule melchihna tampi ka musah uve ti na jahsah thei na diuva kasei ahiye. Nangho jeng in jong keima hi Pakai kitipa chu kahi ti na hetdoh jeng diu ahi,” ati.
English: and that you may tell in the hearing of your son, and of your son’s son, what things I have done to Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that you may know that I am the LORD.”

tcz: Mose leh Aaron jong Pharaoh heng'a achie lhonin asei lhon tai, “Hebrew mite Pakai, Pathen'in hitihin aseiye: Itih chan ka-angsung'a kunding da nahitam? Keima kin agabol na ding uvin, kamite soldoh tan.
en: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me? Let my people go, that they may serve me.
text:
EXO 10:3
Thadou: Mose leh Aaron jong Pharaoh heng'a achie lhonin asei lhon tai, “Hebrew mite Pakai, Pathen'in hitihin aseiye: Itih chan ka-angsung'a kunding da nahitam? Keima kin agabol na ding uvin, kamite soldoh tan.
English: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me? Let my people go, that they may serve me.

tcz: Nanop louva ahile, vetan! Jing nikho teng le na gamsung'a khaokho te kahin lansah ding ahi.
en: Or else, if you refuse to let my people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country,
text:
EXO 10:4
Thadou: Nanop louva ahile, vetan! Jing nikho teng le na gamsung'a khaokho te kahin lansah ding ahi.
English: Or else, if you refuse to let my people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country,

tcz: Gam pumpi a lodim soh uva tol lham jong na muthei louding ahi. Gilchang'in akheh lih lou amoh chengse khaokho ten aneh gam hel diu, loujaova keh thingphung hojouse jong anehchai kei ding'u ahiye.
en: and they shall cover the surface of the earth, so that one won’t be able to see the earth. They shall eat the residue of that which has escaped, which remains to you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which grows for you out of the field.
text:
EXO 10:5
Thadou: Gam pumpi a lodim soh uva tol lham jong na muthei louding ahi. Gilchang'in akheh lih lou amoh chengse khaokho ten aneh gam hel diu, loujaova keh thingphung hojouse jong anehchai kei ding'u ahiye.
English: and they shall cover the surface of the earth, so that one won’t be able to see the earth. They shall eat the residue of that which has escaped, which remains to you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which grows for you out of the field.

tcz: Nangma insung hinhen nasohte insung hi jong leh Egypt gam insung jouse ahin lodim soh hel jeng diu, hiche tabang thilsoh gimnei hi napu napateo khang'a pat na gamsung uva anaum khalou lai ahi, tin ahenga agasei lhon tai, chuin Mose jong Pharaoh angsung'a kon in a potdoh tan ahi.
en: Your houses shall be filled, and the houses of all your servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians, as neither your fathers nor your fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were on the earth to this day.’” He turned, and went out from Pharaoh.
text:
EXO 10:6
Thadou: Nangma insung hinhen nasohte insung hi jong leh Egypt gam insung jouse ahin lodim soh hel jeng diu, hiche tabang thilsoh gimnei hi napu napateo khang'a pat na gamsung uva anaum khalou lai ahi, tin ahenga agasei lhon tai, chuin Mose jong Pharaoh angsung'a kon in a potdoh tan ahi.
English: Your houses shall be filled, and the houses of all your servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians, as neither your fathers nor your fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were on the earth to this day.’” He turned, and went out from Pharaoh.

tcz: Pharaoh sohte hojong ahung uvin Pharaoh heng'a asei tauve. “amapa hi itih chan lom lom eiho ding'a hahsatna a lhunsah ding hitam? Mipi hohi chie uva a Pathen kin abolna diuvin soltan! Egypt mite pihi jou le nal'a mangthah gamding ahitauve ti na hetdoh hih laiyem?”
en: Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the men go, that they may serve the LORD, their God. Don’t you yet know that Egypt is destroyed?”
text:
EXO 10:7
Thadou: Pharaoh sohte hojong ahung uvin Pharaoh heng'a asei tauve. “amapa hi itih chan lom lom eiho ding'a hahsatna a lhunsah ding hitam? Mipi hohi chie uva a Pathen kin abolna diuvin soltan! Egypt mite pihi jou le nal'a mangthah gamding ahitauve ti na hetdoh hih laiyem?”
English: Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the men go, that they may serve the LORD, their God. Don’t you yet know that Egypt is destroyed?”

tcz: Chuin Mose leh Aaron chu Pharaoh heng'a ding in ahin puilut kit tauvin. Pharaoh in jong amani jah'a aseiyin,”che uvin lang na-Pakaiju leh Na-Pathen kin gabol taovin. Ahile koipen mong hi nahiuvem ache ding? tin amani chu adong tan, ahi.
en: Moses and Aaron were brought again to Pharaoh, and he said to them, “Go, serve the LORD your God; but who are those who will go?”
text:
EXO 10:8
Thadou: Chuin Mose leh Aaron chu Pharaoh heng'a ding in ahin puilut kit tauvin. Pharaoh in jong amani jah'a aseiyin,”che uvin lang na-Pakaiju leh Na-Pathen kin gabol taovin. Ahile koipen mong hi nahiuvem ache ding? tin amani chu adong tan, ahi.
English: Moses and Aaron were brought again to Pharaoh, and he said to them, “Go, serve the LORD your God; but who are those who will go?”

tcz: Mose'n a donbut'in, “ateh-akhang, kacha pate hou ahin ka chanu teho'u jaona khatcha kidalha lou ding ka hiuve. Ka kelngoi jouseo leh gancha jouse aboncha ka puisoh kei diu, chule keihon kut chu alouthei louva ka gabol teitei ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: Moses said, “We will go with our young and with our old. We will go with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds; for we must hold a feast to the LORD.”
text:
EXO 10:9
Thadou: Mose'n a donbut'in, “ateh-akhang, kacha pate hou ahin ka chanu teho'u jaona khatcha kidalha lou ding ka hiuve. Ka kelngoi jouseo leh gancha jouse aboncha ka puisoh kei diu, chule keihon kut chu alouthei louva ka gabol teitei ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: Moses said, “We will go with our young and with our old. We will go with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds; for we must hold a feast to the LORD.”

tcz: Pharaoh'in jong asei jin, “kei man nangho nacha sen gei uva kasol doh tha ngei ngeija ahile Pakai umpi nachu chang un! Na lungthim sung lhonna lungthim phalou na keng lhon'e.
en: He said to them, “The LORD be with you if I let you go with your little ones! See, evil is clearly before your faces.
text:
EXO 10:10
Thadou: Pharaoh'in jong asei jin, “kei man nangho nacha sen gei uva kasol doh tha ngei ngeija ahile Pakai umpi nachu chang un! Na lungthim sung lhonna lungthim phalou na keng lhon'e.
English: He said to them, “The LORD be with you if I let you go with your little ones! See, evil is clearly before your faces.

tcz: “Hiche vang chu hithei louhel ding ahi! Nangho lah'a Pasal chengse che uvin lang na Pakai ju kin gabol tauvin, hichu natup tenten uva hilou ham? Hiche phat chun Pharaoh angsung'a kon in a soldoh tauvin ahi.”
en: Not so! Go now you who are men, and serve the LORD; for that is what you desire!” Then they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.
text:
EXO 10:11
Thadou: “Hiche vang chu hithei louhel ding ahi! Nangho lah'a Pasal chengse che uvin lang na Pakai ju kin gabol tauvin, hichu natup tenten uva hilou ham? Hiche phat chun Pharaoh angsung'a kon in a soldoh tauvin ahi.”
English: Not so! Go now you who are men, and serve the LORD; for that is what you desire!” Then they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Egypt gamsung pumpia khaokhopite alan na ding in na khut jah doh jeng tan. Egypt gamsung'a hamphung gilchang in a khehlih moh chengse aboncha aneh gamset diu ahi,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up on the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail has left.”
text:
EXO 10:12
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Egypt gamsung pumpia khaokhopite alan na ding in na khut jah doh jeng tan. Egypt gamsung'a hamphung gilchang in a khehlih moh chengse aboncha aneh gamset diu ahi,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up on the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail has left.”

tcz: Mose’ atenggol chu Egypt gamsung pumpi chungvum a ajahdoh jeng tan ahile, hiche nikho chun Pakaiyin Egypt gamsung pumpi nilhum keileh khovah hel'in huiphalou solama kon'in tanglou vin anun sah tai. Jingkah in solam akon hui jin khaokhote ahon hon'in ahinpolut taovin ahi.
en: Moses stretched out his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind on the land all that day, and all night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
text:
EXO 10:13
Thadou: Mose’ atenggol chu Egypt gamsung pumpi chungvum a ajahdoh jeng tan ahile, hiche nikho chun Pakaiyin Egypt gamsung pumpi nilhum keileh khovah hel'in huiphalou solama kon'in tanglou vin anun sah tai. Jingkah in solam akon hui jin khaokhote ahon hon'in ahinpolut taovin ahi.
English: Moses stretched out his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind on the land all that day, and all night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

tcz: Chule Egypt gam pumpi chu khaokhoten alosoh hel jeng tan, hi tabang'a gamsunga khaokhote chu imatih channa ana um kha loulai ahiye.
en: The locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the borders of Egypt. They were very grievous. Before them there were no such locusts as they, nor will there ever be again.
text:
EXO 10:14
Thadou: Chule Egypt gam pumpi chu khaokhoten alosoh hel jeng tan, hi tabang'a gamsunga khaokhote chu imatih channa ana um kha loulai ahiye.
English: The locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the borders of Egypt. They were very grievous. Before them there were no such locusts as they, nor will there ever be again.

tcz: Khaokhoten gamsung pumpi alodim lhatau vin ahile mu athim lha jeng tai. Gelchang in akheh moh chengse gam leiset'a thing phung jouse jong anemang hel taovin, Egypt gamsung pumpi thingphung chule hamphung abonchan ana do khat jeng cha jong jong umlou vin khaokho ten anechai hel jeng taove.
en: For they covered the surface of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened, and they ate every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. There remained nothing green, either tree or herb of the field, through all the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 10:15
Thadou: Khaokhoten gamsung pumpi alodim lhatau vin ahile mu athim lha jeng tai. Gelchang in akheh moh chengse gam leiset'a thing phung jouse jong anemang hel taovin, Egypt gamsung pumpi thingphung chule hamphung abonchan ana do khat jeng cha jong jong umlou vin khaokho ten anechai hel jeng taove.
English: For they covered the surface of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened, and they ate every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. There remained nothing green, either tree or herb of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

tcz: Chuphat in Pharaoh in jong asohte ho asol loiyin, Mose leh Aaron agakousah un, hiti hin aseiye. “Keiman na Pakai leh nangni chung'a chonset phat louna kabol kha tai,” ati.
en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste, and he said, “I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.
text:
EXO 10:16
Thadou: Chuphat in Pharaoh in jong asohte ho asol loiyin, Mose leh Aaron agakousah un, hiti hin aseiye. “Keiman na Pakai leh nangni chung'a chonset phat louna kabol kha tai,” ati.
English: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste, and he said, “I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.

tcz: “Ka chonset na nei ngaidam lhon'in, Pakai heng'a neitao peh teitei lhon tan, hiche thi gamna huise hi keima angsung'a kon in tolmang jeng lhon tan,” ati.
en: Now therefore please forgive my sin again, and pray to the LORD your God, that he may also take away from me this death.”
text:
EXO 10:17
Thadou: “Ka chonset na nei ngaidam lhon'in, Pakai heng'a neitao peh teitei lhon tan, hiche thi gamna huise hi keima angsung'a kon in tolmang jeng lhon tan,” ati.
English: Now therefore please forgive my sin again, and pray to the LORD your God, that he may also take away from me this death.”

tcz: Mose jong Pharaoh angsung'a kon in a kondoh in Pakai heng'a aga tao tai,
en: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to the LORD.
text:
EXO 10:18
Thadou: Mose jong Pharaoh angsung'a kon in a kondoh in Pakai heng'a aga tao tai,
English: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to the LORD.

tcz: Pakaiyin nisolam a kon in hui hattah ahin nunsah'in ahile, hiche huipi chun khaokhote jouse twikhanglen dung laiya alhoh lut soh hel jeng tai. Egypt gamsung pumpia khaokhote chu khat jeng cha jong aum ta hih hel jeng'in ahi.
en: The LORD sent an exceedingly strong west wind, which took up the locusts, and drove them into the Red Sea. There remained not one locust in all the borders of Egypt.
text:
EXO 10:19
Thadou: Pakaiyin nisolam a kon in hui hattah ahin nunsah'in ahile, hiche huipi chun khaokhote jouse twikhanglen dung laiya alhoh lut soh hel jeng tai. Egypt gamsung pumpia khaokhote chu khat jeng cha jong aum ta hih hel jeng'in ahi.
English: The LORD sent an exceedingly strong west wind, which took up the locusts, and drove them into the Red Sea. There remained not one locust in all the borders of Egypt.

tcz: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim asutah jeng na laijin, Pharaoh in jong mipi ho chu asol doh hih laiye.
en: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go.
text:
EXO 10:20
Thadou: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim asutah jeng na laijin, Pharaoh in jong mipi ho chu asol doh hih laiye.
English: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Nakhut ban jah'in lang vanlam sang tem in, Egypt gamsung pumpi muthim'in alo soh hel jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.”
text:
EXO 10:21
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Nakhut ban jah'in lang vanlam sang tem in, Egypt gamsung pumpi muthim'in alo soh hel jeng ding ahi,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.”

tcz: Mose'n jong Pakaiyin athupeh bang'in vanlam asan jeng'a ahile, “Egypt gamsung pumpi nithum sung mu athim lha jeng tan, ahi.”
en: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.
text:
EXO 10:22
Thadou: Mose'n jong Pakaiyin athupeh bang'in vanlam asan jeng'a ahile, “Egypt gamsung pumpi nithum sung mu athim lha jeng tan, ahi.”
English: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.

tcz: Hiche phatsung chun khat le khat akimu thei tapouvin, koimacha jeng jong pot le thei lou ahi tai. Ahinlah Israel chate chenna mun vang chu khovah'in aumpi jing uve.
en: They didn’t see one another, and nobody rose from his place for three days; but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.
text:
EXO 10:23
Thadou: Hiche phatsung chun khat le khat akimu thei tapouvin, koimacha jeng jong pot le thei lou ahi tai. Ahinlah Israel chate chenna mun vang chu khovah'in aumpi jing uve.
English: They didn’t see one another, and nobody rose from his place for three days; but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

tcz: Ajonan Pharaoh in jong Mose a koukit tan, a heng'a aseije, “Cheuvin lang Pakai kin gabol tauvin,” nachate'u kipui jun lang, ahinlah na kelngoi hon teu vang na dalhah ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: Pharaoh called to Moses, and said, “Go, serve the LORD. Only let your flocks and your herds stay behind. Let your little ones also go with you.”
text:
EXO 10:24
Thadou: Ajonan Pharaoh in jong Mose a koukit tan, a heng'a aseije, “Cheuvin lang Pakai kin gabol tauvin,” nachate'u kipui jun lang, ahinlah na kelngoi hon teu vang na dalhah ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: Pharaoh called to Moses, and said, “Go, serve the LORD. Only let your flocks and your herds stay behind. Let your little ones also go with you.”

tcz: Mose'n adon but in, “hichu hithei him him ponte.” Ka gancha te'u chu nei puisah tei teiju angaije, ajeh chu ka Pakai u-leh ka Pathen angsung'a kilhaina a kaman chah ding'u ahi, ati.”
en: Moses said, “You must also give into our hand sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.
text:
EXO 10:25
Thadou: Mose'n adon but in, “hichu hithei him him ponte.” Ka gancha te'u chu nei puisah tei teiju angaije, ajeh chu ka Pakai u-leh ka Pathen angsung'a kilhaina a kaman chah ding'u ahi, ati.”
English: Moses said, “You must also give into our hand sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.

tcz: “Ka gancha teu aboncha, ka pui teitei diu ahiye; khat jeng cha jong ka dalhah thei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu ka ganchate'u lah a konna hi keihon Pakai angsung'a kilhaina'a kat doh ding'a ka lhen doh cheh cheh diu ahi. Chule amun ka lhun kahse uva itilam dol'a Pakai kin ka bol diu ham ti ka hechen nai pouve,” ati.
en: Our livestock also shall go with us. Not a hoof shall be left behind, for of it we must take to serve the LORD our God; and we don’t know with what we must serve the LORD, until we come there.”
text:
EXO 10:26
Thadou: “Ka gancha teu aboncha, ka pui teitei diu ahiye; khat jeng cha jong ka dalhah thei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu ka ganchate'u lah a konna hi keihon Pakai angsung'a kilhaina'a kat doh ding'a ka lhen doh cheh cheh diu ahi. Chule amun ka lhun kahse uva itilam dol'a Pakai kin ka bol diu ham ti ka hechen nai pouve,” ati.
English: Our livestock also shall go with us. Not a hoof shall be left behind, for of it we must take to serve the LORD our God; and we don’t know with what we must serve the LORD, until we come there.”

tcz: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim chu khatvei a sutah kit nalai jin, Pharaoh'in jong mipiho chu asol doh hih laiye.
en: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he wouldn’t let them go.
text:
EXO 10:27
Thadou: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim chu khatvei a sutah kit nalai jin, Pharaoh'in jong mipiho chu asol doh hih laiye.
English: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he wouldn’t let them go.

tcz: Chuin Pharaoh jong apeng jah jeng tan, “Mose henga aseiyin, ka- angsunga kon in potdoh jeng'in!” ati. “Keiman nangma ka gih nahiye. Avel'a nei hung kinung mupi kitthei lou hel ding ahi! Nei kimupi kit ngai ngaiya ahile hiche nikhoa chu nathi jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en: Pharaoh said to him, “Get away from me! Be careful to see my face no more; for in the day you see my face you shall die!”
text:
EXO 10:28
Thadou: Chuin Pharaoh jong apeng jah jeng tan, “Mose henga aseiyin, ka- angsunga kon in potdoh jeng'in!” ati. “Keiman nangma ka gih nahiye. Avel'a nei hung kinung mupi kitthei lou hel ding ahi! Nei kimupi kit ngai ngaiya ahile hiche nikhoa chu nathi jeng ding ahi,” ati.
English: Pharaoh said to him, “Get away from me! Be careful to see my face no more; for in the day you see my face you shall die!”

tcz: Mose'n a donbut in, “Apha jenge,” “Avella ka kimaito pi tah lou ding nahiye,” ati.
en: Moses said, “You have spoken well. I will see your face again no more.”
text:
EXO 10:29
Thadou: Mose'n a donbut in, “Apha jenge,” “Avella ka kimaito pi tah lou ding nahiye,” ati.
English: Moses said, “You have spoken well. I will see your face again no more.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Keiman Egypt gamsung leh Pharaoh chung'a ka hin lhunsah ding hoise khat aki vat nalaije. Hiche hi aso chai chai teng le, Pharaoh vin agam sung dalha ding'a nahin no jeng ding'u ahitai,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “I will bring yet one more plague on Pharaoh, and on Egypt; afterwards he will let you go. When he lets you go, he will surely thrust you out altogether.
text:
EXO 11:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Keiman Egypt gamsung leh Pharaoh chung'a ka hin lhunsah ding hoise khat aki vat nalaije. Hiche hi aso chai chai teng le, Pharaoh vin agam sung dalha ding'a nahin no jeng ding'u ahitai,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “I will bring yet one more plague on Pharaoh, and on Egypt; afterwards he will let you go. When he lets you go, he will surely thrust you out altogether.

tcz: “Israel mite heng'a seipeh in lang, ama ama cheh'in aheng akom Egypt mite sana dangka akijep na ding uvin kithum cheh taohen,” ati.
en: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man ask of his neighbor, and every woman of her neighbor, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.”
text:
EXO 11:2
Thadou: “Israel mite heng'a seipeh in lang, ama ama cheh'in aheng akom Egypt mite sana dangka akijep na ding uvin kithum cheh taohen,” ati.
English: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man ask of his neighbor, and every woman of her neighbor, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.”

tcz: Tun Pakaiyin Israel chate chu Egypt mite mitmun lunglhai na achansah tai. Chule Mose chu Egypt gamsung pumpia amin akithang in, Pharaoh mitmu chang leh mipite mitmun amin che lheh jeng tan ahi.
en: The LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.
text:
EXO 11:3
Thadou: Tun Pakaiyin Israel chate chu Egypt mite mitmun lunglhai na achansah tai. Chule Mose chu Egypt gamsung pumpia amin akithang in, Pharaoh mitmu chang leh mipite mitmun amin che lheh jeng tan ahi.
English: The LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n Pharaoh heng'a asei jin Hiche hi Pakaiyin aseiye: “Keiman jankim tah le Egypt mite lungthim kahin suhthou ding ahi.”
en: Moses said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘About midnight I will go out into the middle of Egypt,
text:
EXO 11:4
Thadou: Chuin Mose'n Pharaoh heng'a asei jin Hiche hi Pakaiyin aseiye: “Keiman jankim tah le Egypt mite lungthim kahin suhthou ding ahi.”
English: Moses said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘About midnight I will go out into the middle of Egypt,

tcz: Egypt gamsung'a chapang peng masa jouse, Pharaoh chapa peng masapen ahin, a laltouna'a peng masa penpa ahin, a sum buh laiya chang bong goija pang a sohnu chapa changei ja abonchauva thigam kei ding, gancha peng masa jouse jong aboncha thisoh hel ding ahiye,” ati.
en: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the female servant who is behind the mill, and all the firstborn of livestock.
text:
EXO 11:5
Thadou: Egypt gamsung'a chapang peng masa jouse, Pharaoh chapa peng masapen ahin, a laltouna'a peng masa penpa ahin, a sum buh laiya chang bong goija pang a sohnu chapa changei ja abonchauva thigam kei ding, gancha peng masa jouse jong aboncha thisoh hel ding ahiye,” ati.
English: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the female servant who is behind the mill, and all the firstborn of livestock.

tcz: “Chu teng Egypt gamsung pumpia ka le mao kithong lhading, ajeh chu hitabang thilsoh gimnei hi imatih channa anaum kha loulaiya ahin, Avella hung kilah kit talou ding chu ahi.”
en: There will be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there has not been, nor will be any more.
text:
EXO 11:6
Thadou: “Chu teng Egypt gamsung pumpia ka le mao kithong lhading, ajeh chu hitabang thilsoh gimnei hi imatih channa anaum kha loulaiya ahin, Avella hung kilah kit talou ding chu ahi.”
English: There will be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there has not been, nor will be any more.

tcz: “Ahinlah Israel mite vang chu lungmon nan aumpi jing diu, uicha jeng jong hampoh lou ding ahi. Chu teng Pakaiyin Egypt mite leh Israel mite kikah'a ijakai datkhenna asemdoh tai, hichu nanghon na hetdoh cheh ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: But against any of the children of Israel a dog won’t even bark or move its tongue, against man or animal, that you may know that the LORD makes a distinction between the Egyptians and Israel.
text:
EXO 11:7
Thadou: “Ahinlah Israel mite vang chu lungmon nan aumpi jing diu, uicha jeng jong hampoh lou ding ahi. Chu teng Pakaiyin Egypt mite leh Israel mite kikah'a ijakai datkhenna asemdoh tai, hichu nanghon na hetdoh cheh ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: But against any of the children of Israel a dog won’t even bark or move its tongue, against man or animal, that you may know that the LORD makes a distinction between the Egyptians and Israel.

tcz: “Chu teng Egypt gam'a nanung juiho leh nasohte abonchauva keima lam'a hung kipelut ding'u hitia hi asei diu ahi, khaiye! “Nangma leh nanung juiho abonchauvin hikoma kon hin potdoh tauvin,” tin aseije atipeh tai. Chuin Mose jong lungphamo tah'in Pharaoh angsung'a kon in a che doh tan ahi.
en: All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people who follow you;” and after that I will go out.’” He went out from Pharaoh in hot anger.
text:
EXO 11:8
Thadou: “Chu teng Egypt gam'a nanung juiho leh nasohte abonchauva keima lam'a hung kipelut ding'u hitia hi asei diu ahi, khaiye! “Nangma leh nanung juiho abonchauvin hikoma kon hin potdoh tauvin,” tin aseije atipeh tai. Chuin Mose jong lungphamo tah'in Pharaoh angsung'a kon in a che doh tan ahi.
English: All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people who follow you;” and after that I will go out.’” He went out from Pharaoh in hot anger.

tcz: Tun Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Pharaoh vin nangma thusei ahin moh ngai thei lou ding, ahinlah keiman Egypt gamsung'a thil kidang melchihna ka bolbe nahlai ding ahi,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh won’t listen to you, that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.”
text:
EXO 11:9
Thadou: Tun Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Pharaoh vin nangma thusei ahin moh ngai thei lou ding, ahinlah keiman Egypt gamsung'a thil kidang melchihna ka bolbe nahlai ding ahi,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh won’t listen to you, that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.”

tcz: Mose leh Aaron'in jong Egypt gam Pharaoh angsung'a thil kidang melchihna tampi aki lahsah lhon'in, ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim chu ki dang tah in asutah jing nalaijin ahile, Pharaoh'vin Israel mite chu Egypt gamsung a kon in ana soldoh hih laiye.
en: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh, but the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go out of his land.
text:
EXO 11:10
Thadou: Mose leh Aaron'in jong Egypt gam Pharaoh angsung'a thil kidang melchihna tampi aki lahsah lhon'in, ahinlah Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim chu ki dang tah in asutah jing nalaijin ahile, Pharaoh'vin Israel mite chu Egypt gamsung a kon in ana soldoh hih laiye.
English: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh, but the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go out of his land.

tcz: Israel mite Egypt gamma aum jing laijun, Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'a hicheng hi thupeh aneiye:
en: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
text:
EXO 12:1
Thadou: Israel mite Egypt gamma aum jing laijun, Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron heng'a hicheng hi thupeh aneiye:
English: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

tcz: “Tuapat hiche lha hi nang ho ding'a lha kipatna ahin, kumkhat adia lha kipatna'a kisim ding ahi tai,” ati.
en: “This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.
text:
EXO 12:2
Thadou: “Tuapat hiche lha hi nang ho ding'a lha kipatna ahin, kumkhat adia lha kipatna'a kisim ding ahi tai,” ati.
English: “This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.

tcz: “Israelte kikhop khomna munpi jouse ah ga seipeh lhon tan. Hiche lhasung nisom alhin niteng leh ama ama cheh in apu apateu insung kai lhah apat, insung khat cheh akon kelngoi khat cheh kat doh ding'a ahin kai diu ahiye.”
en: Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, ‘On the tenth day of this month, they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to their fathers’ houses, a lamb for a household;

tcz: Kelngoinou khat kitha ding'a insung khat'a mijat chu alhom khah'a ahile, inneipu le aheng akoma pa kinop to ding kelngoi nou adol ding cha bep khat chu aga kimat lhon ding, amichan cheh'in aneh khopset ding kelngoinou khat ding mijat chu phatecha nasim toh lhon ding ahi.
en: and if the household is too little for a lamb, then he and his neighbor next to his house shall take one according to the number of the souls. You shall make your count for the lamb according to what everyone can eat.
text:
EXO 12:4
Thadou: Kelngoinou khat kitha ding'a insung khat'a mijat chu alhom khah'a ahile, inneipu le aheng akoma pa kinop to ding kelngoi nou adol ding cha bep khat chu aga kimat lhon ding, amichan cheh'in aneh khopset ding kelngoinou khat ding mijat chu phatecha nasim toh lhon ding ahi.
English: and if the household is too little for a lamb, then he and his neighbor next to his house shall take one according to the number of the souls. You shall make your count for the lamb according to what everyone can eat.

tcz: “Kelngoinou chu nolna beihel hiding, kumkhat lhingsa hitei ding, hiche kelngoinou chu kelngoi honlah'a konna hihen kelcha honnlah konna hijong leh athah beh mong mong'a na kimat ding'u ahi.”
en: Your lamb shall be without defect, a male a year old. You shall take it from the sheep or from the goats.
text:
EXO 12:5
Thadou: “Kelngoinou chu nolna beihel hiding, kumkhat lhingsa hitei ding, hiche kelngoinou chu kelngoi honlah'a konna hihen kelcha honnlah konna hijong leh athah beh mong mong'a na kimat ding'u ahi.”
English: Your lamb shall be without defect, a male a year old. You shall take it from the sheep or from the goats.

tcz: “Hichea manchah ding kelngoinou chu hiche lha nisom leh nili lhinni geija nahen cheh diug'u hichu nilhum lam teng leh Israel kikhom pumpi chun ama amacheh adia akitha ding'u ahiye.”
en: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening.
text:
EXO 12:6
Thadou: “Hichea manchah ding kelngoinou chu hiche lha nisom leh nili lhinni geija nahen cheh diug'u hichu nilhum lam teng leh Israel kikhom pumpi chun ama amacheh adia akitha ding'u ahiye.”
English: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening.

tcz: Gancha kithat thisan chu phabep a sodoh diu, hichu kelngoinou thisan a chu in kotpi phung le inkam'a aloinat cheh cheh diu ahi.”
en: They shall take some of the blood, and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they shall eat it.
text:
EXO 12:7
Thadou: Gancha kithat thisan chu phabep a sodoh diu, hichu kelngoinou thisan a chu in kotpi phung le inkam'a aloinat cheh cheh diu ahi.”
English: They shall take some of the blood, and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they shall eat it.

tcz: “Hicheni jan teng chule kelngoinou sa chu meiya akihul min uva aneh cheh diu, hichu cholso lou changlhah leh anchekha toh ametha cheh cheh diu ahiye.”
en: They shall eat the meat in that night, roasted with fire, with unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs.
text:
EXO 12:8
Thadou: “Hicheni jan teng chule kelngoinou sa chu meiya akihul min uva aneh cheh diu, hichu cholso lou changlhah leh anchekha toh ametha cheh cheh diu ahiye.”
English: They shall eat the meat in that night, roasted with fire, with unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs.

tcz: “Hiche sa chu asel puma hihen twija kihonminsa hijong leh koimachan naneh thei lou hel diu ahi. Sa pumpi aluchang le akeng chule asung jouse jaona meiya na kihulmin tho uva naneh cheh diu ahi,” ati.
en: Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts.
text:
EXO 12:9
Thadou: “Hiche sa chu asel puma hihen twija kihonminsa hijong leh koimachan naneh thei lou hel diu ahi. Sa pumpi aluchang le akeng chule asung jouse jaona meiya na kihulmin tho uva naneh cheh diu ahi,” ati.
English: Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts.

tcz: “Sahel moh neocha jong jingkah chan'na na khovah sah louhel diu ahi. Jingkah geija ana um taphot chu meiya na govam jeng ding'u ahiye.”
en: You shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; but that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire.
text:
EXO 12:10
Thadou: “Sahel moh neocha jong jingkah chan'na na khovah sah louhel diu ahi. Jingkah geija ana um taphot chu meiya na govam jeng ding'u ahiye.”
English: You shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; but that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire.

tcz: “Hicheng hi sa naneh teng ule najui cheh ding'u ahiye: nangma cheh na kivon lhingsel uva, nakeng chot ho'u na kisi cheh diu, chule nakhut uva tenggol na kiphu soh kei ding'u ahi. Chu teng naneh khom soh kei uva hichu Pakaiya dia kalchuh kut ahiye,” ati.
en: This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD’s Passover.
text:
EXO 12:11
Thadou: “Hicheng hi sa naneh teng ule najui cheh ding'u ahiye: nangma cheh na kivon lhingsel uva, nakeng chot ho'u na kisi cheh diu, chule nakhut uva tenggol na kiphu soh kei ding'u ahi. Chu teng naneh khom soh kei uva hichu Pakaiya dia kalchuh kut ahiye,” ati.
English: This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD’s Passover.

tcz: “Hiche jan teng chule keiman Egypt gamsung kahin jotpa'a mihem leh gancha aboncha apeng lha masa jouse kasuh gam hel ding ahi. Chule Egypt gamsung'a milim doi kisemthu jouse chung'a jong thu katan ding ahiye, ajeh chu keima Pakai kahi!” ati.
en: For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and animal. I will execute judgments against all the gods of Egypt. I am the LORD.
text:
EXO 12:12
Thadou: “Hiche jan teng chule keiman Egypt gamsung kahin jotpa'a mihem leh gancha aboncha apeng lha masa jouse kasuh gam hel ding ahi. Chule Egypt gamsung'a milim doi kisemthu jouse chung'a jong thu katan ding ahiye, ajeh chu keima Pakai kahi!” ati.
English: For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and animal. I will execute judgments against all the gods of Egypt. I am the LORD.

tcz: “Ahinlah nangho jouse ding'a hiche thisan kiso chu melchihna hung kilah tading, keiman Egypt gampumpi ka hinsuh mang ding, hiche thisan chu kahin mudoh jiteng keiman nangho jouse chung'a natna hoise hung lang theijouse akonna kaven doh ding na hiuve,” ati.
en: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are. When I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague will be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 12:13
Thadou: “Ahinlah nangho jouse ding'a hiche thisan kiso chu melchihna hung kilah tading, keiman Egypt gampumpi ka hinsuh mang ding, hiche thisan chu kahin mudoh jiteng keiman nangho jouse chung'a natna hoise hung lang theijouse akonna kaven doh ding na hiuve,” ati.
English: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are. When I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague will be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.

tcz: “Hiche nikho hi nangho ding'a het jing na nikho'a pang jeng ding ahitai. Hichu kumsih chule akhang akhang'a Pakaiya dia kut nikho ahi ti na gel doh jeng ding'u ahiye. Na khang lhumkei uva chonna dan hiti'a nanit jing diu ahitai,” ati.
en: This day shall be a memorial for you. You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD. You shall keep it as a feast throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.
text:
EXO 12:14
Thadou: “Hiche nikho hi nangho ding'a het jing na nikho'a pang jeng ding ahitai. Hichu kumsih chule akhang akhang'a Pakaiya dia kut nikho ahi ti na gel doh jeng ding'u ahiye. Na khang lhumkei uva chonna dan hiti'a nanit jing diu ahitai,” ati.
English: This day shall be a memorial for you. You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD. You shall keep it as a feast throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.

tcz: “Ni sagi sung'a cholso lou chang lhah jeng naneh ding'u ahi. Ni sagi alhinni teng leh nangma insung cheh'a chol umjouse pamlamma na paidoh soh kei ding'u ahi. Nalah uva koitabang khat chun hiche cholso lou changlhah, ni sagi lhinnia pat naneh khah ngeingei uva ahile, amachu Israel mite lah'a konna kisumang jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en: “‘Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread; even the first day you shall put away yeast out of your houses, for whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
text:
EXO 12:15
Thadou: “Ni sagi sung'a cholso lou chang lhah jeng naneh ding'u ahi. Ni sagi alhinni teng leh nangma insung cheh'a chol umjouse pamlamma na paidoh soh kei ding'u ahi. Nalah uva koitabang khat chun hiche cholso lou changlhah, ni sagi lhinnia pat naneh khah ngeingei uva ahile, amachu Israel mite lah'a konna kisumang jeng ding ahi,” ati.
English: “‘Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread; even the first day you shall put away yeast out of your houses, for whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

tcz: “Kut kipat nikho masa pen'ni teng khompi len khat nanei uva, ni sagi alhinni teng jong leh khompilen theng khatma nanei diu ahi. Hiche nikho teni hi atumbeh a nanit cheh diu, amichan'in aneh khop ding nabol peh teitei ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: In the first day there shall be to you a holy convocation, and in the seventh day a holy convocation; no kind of work shall be done in them, except that which every man must eat, only that may be done by you.
text:
EXO 12:16
Thadou: “Kut kipat nikho masa pen'ni teng khompi len khat nanei uva, ni sagi alhinni teng jong leh khompilen theng khatma nanei diu ahi. Hiche nikho teni hi atumbeh a nanit cheh diu, amichan'in aneh khop ding nabol peh teitei ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: In the first day there shall be to you a holy convocation, and in the seventh day a holy convocation; no kind of work shall be done in them, except that which every man must eat, only that may be done by you.

tcz: “Hiche hi Cholsolou chang lhah kut'a naman diu ahiye, ajechu hiche nikhoa hi keiman nang ho Egypt gamsung'a konna ka hin puidoh nau na geldoh jing diu, nakhang lhumkei uva nangho jousen hiche nikho chu chonna dan ahi tia nanit jom jing ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this same day I have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt. Therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.
text:
EXO 12:17
Thadou: “Hiche hi Cholsolou chang lhah kut'a naman diu ahiye, ajechu hiche nikhoa hi keiman nang ho Egypt gamsung'a konna ka hin puidoh nau na geldoh jing diu, nakhang lhumkei uva nangho jousen hiche nikho chu chonna dan ahi tia nanit jom jing ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this same day I have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt. Therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.

tcz: “Lhamasa nisom le nili lhin nikho nilhah lam teng leh na boncha uva hiche chol solou chang lhah chu naneh pan diu ahi”
en: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the twenty first day of the month at evening.
text:
EXO 12:18
Thadou: “Lhamasa nisom le nili lhin nikho nilhah lam teng leh na boncha uva hiche chol solou chang lhah chu naneh pan diu ahi”
English: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the twenty first day of the month at evening.

tcz: “Ni sagi sungse'a vang chu nangma nangma insung cheh'a, chol sosa changlhah khat jeng cha jong kilah lou ding ahiye. Kholjin mi ahin agamsung cheng den miho hijong leochun cholsosa changlhah nekha tapou chu, Israel khompi akonna ki sumang jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en: There shall be no yeast found in your houses for seven days, for whoever eats that which is leavened, that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he is a foreigner, or one who is born in the land.
text:
EXO 12:19
Thadou: “Ni sagi sungse'a vang chu nangma nangma insung cheh'a, chol sosa changlhah khat jeng cha jong kilah lou ding ahiye. Kholjin mi ahin agamsung cheng den miho hijong leochun cholsosa changlhah nekha tapou chu, Israel khompi akonna ki sumang jeng ding ahi,” ati.
English: There shall be no yeast found in your houses for seven days, for whoever eats that which is leavened, that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he is a foreigner, or one who is born in the land.

tcz: ‘Hiche phatsung hin amitakip'in cholsosa changlhah kiti phot na neh lou hel ding'u ahiye. Ajeh chu chol solou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi.”
en: You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your habitations you shall eat unleavened bread.’”
text:
EXO 12:20
Thadou: ‘Hiche phatsung hin amitakip'in cholsosa changlhah kiti phot na neh lou hel ding'u ahiye. Ajeh chu chol solou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi.”
English: You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your habitations you shall eat unleavened bread.’”

tcz: “Chu in Mose'n jong Israel sung'a upa ho jouse akou khom in aheng uvah asei peh tai, “Che uvin, nangma cheh insung ding kelngoinou gakikai jun lang, chule kal chuh kut'a ding'in kithauvin.”
en: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said to them, “Draw out, and take lambs according to your families, and kill the Passover.
text:
EXO 12:21
Thadou: “Chu in Mose'n jong Israel sung'a upa ho jouse akou khom in aheng uvah asei peh tai, “Che uvin, nangma cheh insung ding kelngoinou gakikai jun lang, chule kal chuh kut'a ding'in kithauvin.”
English: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said to them, “Draw out, and take lambs according to your families, and kill the Passover.

tcz: “Khutsilna kong'a gan thisan chu koi jun. Chule hichu hyssop nado phabep lauvin lang dekot'uvin. Hissop chu lauvin lang thisan achun kotpi khom teni ahin kotpi chunglah inkam a chun loinat soh kei uvin. Jing khovah kahse'a koima chan hichu a kallhah theilou ding ahi,” ati.
en: You shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door posts with the blood that is in the basin. None of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.
text:
EXO 12:22
Thadou: “Khutsilna kong'a gan thisan chu koi jun. Chule hichu hyssop nado phabep lauvin lang dekot'uvin. Hissop chu lauvin lang thisan achun kotpi khom teni ahin kotpi chunglah inkam a chun loinat soh kei uvin. Jing khovah kahse'a koima chan hichu a kallhah theilou ding ahi,” ati.
English: You shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door posts with the blood that is in the basin. None of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.

tcz: Ajeh chu “Pakaiyin Egypt mite jouse sugamma hung ding kahi, chuteng Pakaiyin kotpi chung lah'a thisan kiloinat hochu amu ding, hitia chu a suh gam ding hojal achu hiche insung chu apeldoh ding ahiye, ati.”
en: For the LORD will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you.
text:
EXO 12:23
Thadou: Ajeh chu “Pakaiyin Egypt mite jouse sugamma hung ding kahi, chuteng Pakaiyin kotpi chung lah'a thisan kiloinat hochu amu ding, hitia chu a suh gam ding hojal achu hiche insung chu apeldoh ding ahiye, ati.”
English: For the LORD will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you.

tcz: “Geldoh jing'un, thupeh hichengse hi nangho jouse ding leh nachateo khang geija chonna dan ahi tia na jui jing ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever.
text:
EXO 12:24
Thadou: “Geldoh jing'un, thupeh hichengse hi nangho jouse ding leh nachateo khang geija chonna dan ahi tia na jui jing ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever.

tcz: “Pakaiyin nangho peh ding'a aki tepna sa gamsung na lhun teng ujongleh hiche chonna dan hi najui jing diu ahi,” ati.
en: It shall happen when you have come to the land which the LORD will give you, as he has promised, that you shall keep this service.
text:
EXO 12:25
Thadou: “Pakaiyin nangho peh ding'a aki tepna sa gamsung na lhun teng ujongleh hiche chonna dan hi najui jing diu ahi,” ati.
English: It shall happen when you have come to the land which the LORD will give you, as he has promised, that you shall keep this service.

tcz: “Chule hiche chonna hi na chate u vin ipi ding'a kibol ham, ti na hin doh ding'u ahi.”
en: It will happen, when your children ask you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’
text:
EXO 12:26
Thadou: “Chule hiche chonna hi na chate u vin ipi ding'a kibol ham, ti na hin doh ding'u ahi.”
English: It will happen, when your children ask you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’

tcz: “Nang hon jong na donbut uva, “hiche chonna dan hi Pakai ja dia gantha kilhaina ahin chule Pakaiyin Egypt mite anatha gamlai chun Aman Israel mite in hochu ana kalchuh ji'e tia nasei peh ding'u ahi. Chuin Mose'n thupeh hichengse chu achaiphat'in mipi jouse Pakai angsung'a akunlha sohkei uvin chibai aboh tauve.
en: that you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of the LORD’s Passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he struck the Egyptians, and spared our houses.’” The people bowed their heads and worshiped.
text:
EXO 12:27
Thadou: “Nang hon jong na donbut uva, “hiche chonna dan hi Pakai ja dia gantha kilhaina ahin chule Pakaiyin Egypt mite anatha gamlai chun Aman Israel mite in hochu ana kalchuh ji'e tia nasei peh ding'u ahi. Chuin Mose'n thupeh hichengse chu achaiphat'in mipi jouse Pakai angsung'a akunlha sohkei uvin chibai aboh tauve.
English: that you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of the LORD’s Passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he struck the Egyptians, and spared our houses.’” The people bowed their heads and worshiped.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong abol tauvin ahi.
en: The children of Israel went and did so; as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.
text:
EXO 12:28
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose leh Aaron athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong abol tauvin ahi.
English: The children of Israel went and did so; as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

tcz: Chule hiche Jan khangkim chun Pakaiyin Egypt gamsung'a nao cha pengmasa jouse, Pharaoh chapa apeng masapen alatouna toupa akipat, akimvella cheng asohpa chapa peng masapen ahin, chule gancha peng masa jouse athat gam hel tan ahi.
en: At midnight, the LORD struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of livestock.
text:
EXO 12:29
Thadou: Chule hiche Jan khangkim chun Pakaiyin Egypt gamsung'a nao cha pengmasa jouse, Pharaoh chapa apeng masapen alatouna toupa akipat, akimvella cheng asohpa chapa peng masapen ahin, chule gancha peng masa jouse athat gam hel tan ahi.
English: At midnight, the LORD struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of livestock.

tcz: Jankim laijin Pharaoh, asohteho chule Egypt mite abonchauvin athou doh taovin, Egypt gamsung pumpia ka le mao awgin akithong helsoh tai. Ajeh chu intin chang'a mi thina lou umlouva ahi tai.
en: Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for there was not a house where there was not one dead.
text:
EXO 12:30
Thadou: Jankim laijin Pharaoh, asohteho chule Egypt mite abonchauvin athou doh taovin, Egypt gamsung pumpia ka le mao awgin akithong helsoh tai. Ajeh chu intin chang'a mi thina lou umlouva ahi tai.
English: Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for there was not a house where there was not one dead.

tcz: Jankim lai jin Pharaoh'vin Mose le Aaron aga kousah tauvin, “Ka mite dalhan che tauvin chule Israel mite kipui jin che tauvin! Nei tepna bang un che uvin lang Pakai kin chu gabol jeng tauvin,” ati.
en: He called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, “Rise up, get out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as you have said!
text:
EXO 12:31
Thadou: Jankim lai jin Pharaoh'vin Mose le Aaron aga kousah tauvin, “Ka mite dalhan che tauvin chule Israel mite kipui jin che tauvin! Nei tepna bang un che uvin lang Pakai kin chu gabol jeng tauvin,” ati.
English: He called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, “Rise up, get out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as you have said!

tcz: “Na seima bang in na kelngoi jouseo leh nagan cha jouse'u abonchan ki pui unlang, che tauvin, nei dalhah ding tah jeh'un keima jong phatthei neichan lhon ding ahiye,” ati.
en: Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also!”
text:
EXO 12:32
Thadou: “Na seima bang in na kelngoi jouseo leh nagan cha jouse'u abonchan ki pui unlang, che tauvin, nei dalhah ding tah jeh'un keima jong phatthei neichan lhon ding ahiye,” ati.
English: Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also!”

tcz: Egypt miten abonchauvin Israelte ding in a kisaboi lheh jeng tauvin, Egypt gamsung'a konna Israel mite soldoh loiding lunggel akeng tauvin, ama hon hiti hin ase uve; “Keiho ka boncha uva thigam ding kahi tauve! tin asei uve.”
en: The Egyptians were urgent with the people, to send them out of the land in haste, for they said, “We are all dead men.”
text:
EXO 12:33
Thadou: Egypt miten abonchauvin Israelte ding in a kisaboi lheh jeng tauvin, Egypt gamsung'a konna Israel mite soldoh loiding lunggel akeng tauvin, ama hon hiti hin ase uve; “Keiho ka boncha uva thigam ding kahi tauve! tin asei uve.”
English: The Egyptians were urgent with the people, to send them out of the land in haste, for they said, “We are all dead men.”

tcz: Israel mite'n jong chang bong neldi anei jouse'u aki hamkhom tauvin. Chang bong ameh nau lhengkam jouse jao nan poh ding'in aki got cheh tauvin ahi.
en: The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.
text:
EXO 12:34
Thadou: Israel mite'n jong chang bong neldi anei jouse'u aki hamkhom tauvin. Chang bong ameh nau lhengkam jouse jao nan poh ding'in aki got cheh tauvin ahi.
English: The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.

tcz: Mose'n athu peh bang bang uvin, Israel mite'n jong abol tauvin ahi; Egypt mite akon'in sana le dangka kijep na ding jouse akithum doh gam tauvin ahi.
en: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing.
text:
EXO 12:35
Thadou: Mose'n athu peh bang bang uvin, Israel mite'n jong abol tauvin ahi; Egypt mite akon'in sana le dangka kijep na ding jouse akithum doh gam tauvin ahi.
English: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing.

tcz: Pakaiyin Israel mite chu Egypt mite mitmun alunglhaisah soh keijun ahile, Egypt miten jong anei chasun uchu itcha louhel lin ana pesoh kei uvin. Egypt mite haona jouse toh akon tauvin ahi!
en: The LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered the Egyptians.
text:
EXO 12:36
Thadou: Pakaiyin Israel mite chu Egypt mite mitmun alunglhaisah soh keijun ahile, Egypt miten jong anei chasun uchu itcha louhel lin ana pesoh kei uvin. Egypt mite haona jouse toh akon tauvin ahi!
English: The LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered the Egyptians.

tcz: Hiche jan chun Israel mite Rameses khopia kon in Succoth lam'a ding'in akipat doh tauvin ahi. Numei chapang simtha louvin keng lamma che pasal jat mong chu sang jagup alhing uve.
en: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot who were men, in addition to children.
text:
EXO 12:37
Thadou: Hiche jan chun Israel mite Rameses khopia kon in Succoth lam'a ding'in akipat doh tauvin ahi. Numei chapang simtha louvin keng lamma che pasal jat mong chu sang jagup alhing uve.
English: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot who were men, in addition to children.

tcz: Amaho ahiuvin chule miphum miphah, gancha ho, kelngoi hon tampi le gancha hon tampi jaonan aki tol tauve.
en: A mixed multitude went up also with them, with flocks, herds, and even very much livestock.
text:
EXO 12:38
Thadou: Amaho ahiuvin chule miphum miphah, gancha ho, kelngoi hon tampi le gancha hon tampi jaonan aki tol tauve.
English: A mixed multitude went up also with them, with flocks, herds, and even very much livestock.

tcz: Egypt gamsung'a aum lai uva kisem chang bong chu alhon lhon'in aki ken jiuvin ahi. Egypt gam'a kino tah'a ki soldoh ahiyeh uvin amahon chang lhah chu chol aso man tah louvu, chule ama cheh nehding jeng jong ana kigon man tapo uve.
en: They baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought out of Egypt; for it wasn’t leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt, and couldn’t wait, and they had not prepared any food for themselves.
text:
EXO 12:39
Thadou: Egypt gamsung'a aum lai uva kisem chang bong chu alhon lhon'in aki ken jiuvin ahi. Egypt gam'a kino tah'a ki soldoh ahiyeh uvin amahon chang lhah chu chol aso man tah louvu, chule ama cheh nehding jeng jong ana kigon man tapo uve.
English: They baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought out of Egypt; for it wasn’t leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt, and couldn’t wait, and they had not prepared any food for themselves.

tcz: Israel mite chu Egypt gamsung'a kum jali le kum som thum ana cheng uve.
en: Now the time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.
text:
EXO 12:40
Thadou: Israel mite chu Egypt gamsung'a kum jali le kum som thum ana cheng uve.
English: Now the time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.

tcz: Chuin, Kum jali le kum somthum lhin'nin Pakai thanei jin Israel mite chu Egypt gam'a kon'in ahin puidoh tauvin ahi.
en: At the end of four hundred thirty years, to the day, all of the LORD’s armies went out from the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 12:41
Thadou: Chuin, Kum jali le kum somthum lhin'nin Pakai thanei jin Israel mite chu Egypt gam'a kon'in ahin puidoh tauvin ahi.
English: At the end of four hundred thirty years, to the day, all of the LORD’s armies went out from the land of Egypt.

tcz: Hiche jan chun Pakaiyin Israel mite Egypt gam'a kon'na ahinpui doh ding kitepna aneiyin ahi. Hiche jan hi Pakai ding'a mong ahin, hijeh achu Israel mite'n akhang akhang'uva anit jing diu ahiye.
en: It is a night to be much observed to the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt. This is that night of the LORD, to be much observed by all the children of Israel throughout their generations.
text:
EXO 12:42
Thadou: Hiche jan chun Pakaiyin Israel mite Egypt gam'a kon'na ahinpui doh ding kitepna aneiyin ahi. Hiche jan hi Pakai ding'a mong ahin, hijeh achu Israel mite'n akhang akhang'uva anit jing diu ahiye.
English: It is a night to be much observed to the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt. This is that night of the LORD, to be much observed by all the children of Israel throughout their generations.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron heng'a aseijin, “Hichengse hi kalchuh kut kibol ding dan ahi. Kalchuh kut ankong hi kholjin min anehthei lou hel ding ahi.”
en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the ordinance of the Passover. No foreigner shall eat of it,
text:
EXO 12:43
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron heng'a aseijin, “Hichengse hi kalchuh kut kibol ding dan ahi. Kalchuh kut ankong hi kholjin min anehthei lou hel ding ahi.”
English: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the ordinance of the Passover. No foreigner shall eat of it,

tcz: Amavang hiche mihem chu sum'a kichodohsa le cheptan sa ahile aneh jeng thei ahinai,” ati.
en: but every man’s servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it.
text:
EXO 12:44
Thadou: Amavang hiche mihem chu sum'a kichodohsa le cheptan sa ahile aneh jeng thei ahinai,” ati.
English: but every man’s servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it.

tcz: “Kholjin maimai le tha'a kila akigoimi hon jong aneh thei lou ding ahi.”
en: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it.
text:
EXO 12:45
Thadou: “Kholjin maimai le tha'a kila akigoimi hon jong aneh thei lou ding ahi.”
English: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it.

tcz: “Insung cheh'a kalchuh kut an chu kine ding ahi. Inpolam'a naneh thei lou diu chule sagu hel neocha jong kipodoh thei lou ding ahiye.”
en: It must be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house. Do not break any of its bones.
text:
EXO 12:46
Thadou: “Insung cheh'a kalchuh kut an chu kine ding ahi. Inpolam'a naneh thei lou diu chule sagu hel neocha jong kipodoh thei lou ding ahiye.”
English: It must be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house. Do not break any of its bones.

tcz: “Hiche hi Isreal khompi jousen phatecha anit cheh diuva ahi.”
en: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
text:
EXO 12:47
Thadou: “Hiche hi Isreal khompi jousen phatecha anit cheh diuva ahi.”
English: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

tcz: “Gamdang mikhat tou ahung kholjin khah'a Pakai kalchuh kut'a ajaonom'a ahile pasal kiti phot chun achep kitan cheh uhen, chuteng kalchuh kut chu anailut'uva aneh thei ding chuteng amaho chu Israel mite bang'a lhathei ding ahiye.”
en: When a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, and would like to keep the Passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it. He shall be as one who is born in the land; but no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.
text:
EXO 12:48
Thadou: “Gamdang mikhat tou ahung kholjin khah'a Pakai kalchuh kut'a ajaonom'a ahile pasal kiti phot chun achep kitan cheh uhen, chuteng kalchuh kut chu anailut'uva aneh thei ding chuteng amaho chu Israel mite bang'a lhathei ding ahiye.”
English: When a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, and would like to keep the Passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it. He shall be as one who is born in the land; but no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.

tcz: “Hiche thupeh hi amitakip ading ahin, agammi Israelte hihen gamdang mi hijong le dan khat'a um cheh ding ahi,” ati.
en: One law shall be to him who is born at home, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you.”
text:
EXO 12:49
Thadou: “Hiche thupeh hi amitakip ading ahin, agammi Israelte hihen gamdang mi hijong le dan khat'a um cheh ding ahi,” ati.
English: One law shall be to him who is born at home, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong abolsoh kei uve.
en: All the children of Israel did so. As the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.
text:
EXO 12:50
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong abolsoh kei uve.
English: All the children of Israel did so. As the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

tcz: Hiche nikho chun Pakaiyin Israel mite Egypt gamsung a kon in galsat sepaite bang in ahin puidoh tauvin ahi.
en: That same day, the LORD brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
text:
EXO 12:51
Thadou: Hiche nikho chun Pakaiyin Israel mite Egypt gamsung a kon in galsat sepaite bang in ahin puidoh tauvin ahi.
English: That same day, the LORD brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
EXO 13:1
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: “Israel mite lah'a apeng lhamasa phot kaheng'a na katdoh ding ahi. Mihem hihen gancha hijong leh aboncha keija ahi,” ati.
en: “Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal. It is mine.”
text:
EXO 13:2
Thadou: “Israel mite lah'a apeng lhamasa phot kaheng'a na katdoh ding ahi. Mihem hihen gancha hijong leh aboncha keija ahi,” ati.
English: “Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal. It is mine.”

tcz: “Mose'n mipiho heng'a asei jin, “Hiche nikho hi imatih chan'na gedoh jing uvin Egypt gamma nasoh chan nauva konna nahung kitoldoh nikhou chu ahiye. Tunin Pakaiyin abanthahat pan'nan nahin puidoh tauve.” (geldoh jing un, cholsolou changlhah jeng naneh ding'u ahi),” ati.
en: Moses said to the people, “Remember this day, in which you came out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place. No leavened bread shall be eaten.
text:
EXO 13:3
Thadou: “Mose'n mipiho heng'a asei jin, “Hiche nikho hi imatih chan'na gedoh jing uvin Egypt gamma nasoh chan nauva konna nahung kitoldoh nikhou chu ahiye. Tunin Pakaiyin abanthahat pan'nan nahin puidoh tauve.” (geldoh jing un, cholsolou changlhah jeng naneh ding'u ahi),” ati.
English: Moses said to the people, “Remember this day, in which you came out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place. No leavened bread shall be eaten.

tcz: “Pakaiyin nangho chan dia napu napateu heng'a akitepna Canaan gam mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Hivi mite chule Jebus mite chenna (khoiju le bongnoi lonna gamsung'a nahin puilut teng uleh hiche lhasung'a chu nangman jong hiche chonna dan chu nabol ding ahi),” ati.
en: It shall be, when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, which he swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.
text:
EXO 13:5
Thadou: “Pakaiyin nangho chan dia napu napateu heng'a akitepna Canaan gam mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Hivi mite chule Jebus mite chenna (khoiju le bongnoi lonna gamsung'a nahin puilut teng uleh hiche lhasung'a chu nangman jong hiche chonna dan chu nabol ding ahi),” ati.
English: It shall be, when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, which he swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.

tcz: “Ni sagi sung'a chol solou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi. Ni sagi lhin ni teng le vang Pakai heng'a kut khat nabol diu ahi.”
en: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD.
text:
EXO 13:6
Thadou: “Ni sagi sung'a chol solou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi. Ni sagi lhin ni teng le vang Pakai heng'a kut khat nabol diu ahi.”
English: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD.

tcz: “Ni sagi sung'a cholsolou changlhah jeng bou naneh thei diu ahi. Tahbeh'in hiche nikho sagi sungse'a hi na gamsung kimvel'u aboncha koiman cholsosa changlhah kiti toh naum khom louhel diu ahi.”
en: Unleavened bread shall be eaten throughout the seven days; and no leavened bread shall be seen with you. No yeast shall be seen with you, within all your borders.
text:
EXO 13:7
Thadou: “Ni sagi sung'a cholsolou changlhah jeng bou naneh thei diu ahi. Tahbeh'in hiche nikho sagi sungse'a hi na gamsung kimvel'u aboncha koiman cholsosa changlhah kiti toh naum khom louhel diu ahi.”
English: Unleavened bread shall be eaten throughout the seven days; and no leavened bread shall be seen with you. No yeast shall be seen with you, within all your borders.

tcz: “Ni sagi lhinni teng leh na chate hou heng'a na sei uva, ‘Egypt gamsung'a keima ka um laiya Pakaiyin hiche melchihna hi eibol peh ahiye,’ nati ding ahi.
en: You shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘It is because of that which the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.’
text:
EXO 13:8
Thadou: “Ni sagi lhinni teng leh na chate hou heng'a na sei uva, ‘Egypt gamsung'a keima ka um laiya Pakaiyin hiche melchihna hi eibol peh ahiye,’ nati ding ahi.
English: You shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘It is because of that which the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.’

tcz: “Hiche golvah nahi melchihna khat'a pang jing ding, chule namit jeng ajong hetjing na a pang ding, hiche kihilna hi na kamsung'a navop jing ding ahi: Pakaiyin nangma abanthahat pan'a Egypt gamsung'a kon'na nahin puidoh ahi,” ati.
en: It shall be for a sign to you on your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that the LORD’s law may be in your mouth; for with a strong hand the LORD has brought you out of Egypt.
text:
EXO 13:9
Thadou: “Hiche golvah nahi melchihna khat'a pang jing ding, chule namit jeng ajong hetjing na a pang ding, hiche kihilna hi na kamsung'a navop jing ding ahi: Pakaiyin nangma abanthahat pan'a Egypt gamsung'a kon'na nahin puidoh ahi,” ati.
English: It shall be for a sign to you on your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that the LORD’s law may be in your mouth; for with a strong hand the LORD has brought you out of Egypt.

tcz: “Hijeh chun hiche golvahna hi kumseh'a ngai ngai ja bang'a na bol jing ding ahi.”
en: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year.
text:
EXO 13:10
Thadou: “Hijeh chun hiche golvahna hi kumseh'a ngai ngai ja bang'a na bol jing ding ahi.”
English: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year.

tcz: “Hiche chonna dan hi Pakaiyin khanglui ja pat'a kitepna anei bang'a hichu aguilhun kahse'a nabol jom jing ding, nangman Canaan mite chenna nalhun teng leh nabol ding ahiye,” ati.
en: “It shall be, when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanite, as he swore to you and to your fathers, and will give it to you,
text:
EXO 13:11
Thadou: “Hiche chonna dan hi Pakaiyin khanglui ja pat'a kitepna anei bang'a hichu aguilhun kahse'a nabol jom jing ding, nangman Canaan mite chenna nalhun teng leh nabol ding ahiye,” ati.
English: “It shall be, when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanite, as he swore to you and to your fathers, and will give it to you,

tcz: “Hijeh achu Israel sung'a konna pasal pengdoh masapen mihem hihen gancha hijong le Pakaiya dia napeh doh jing ding ahi, hichu Pakaiya ahi.”
en: that you shall set apart to the LORD all that opens the womb, and every firstborn that comes from an animal which you have. The males shall be the LORD’s.
text:
EXO 13:12
Thadou: “Hijeh achu Israel sung'a konna pasal pengdoh masapen mihem hihen gancha hijong le Pakaiya dia napeh doh jing ding ahi, hichu Pakaiya ahi.”
English: that you shall set apart to the LORD all that opens the womb, and every firstborn that comes from an animal which you have. The males shall be the LORD’s.

tcz: “Hiti achu sangan nou penglha masa chan chu kelngoi nouva nalhat ding, nalhat tah lou jong le sangan nou hochu angong chang na hekelep ding ahi. Chule na chapate lah'a apeng masa chan nale lhat doh cheh cheh ding ahi.”
en: Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck; and you shall redeem all the firstborn of man among your sons.
text:
EXO 13:13
Thadou: “Hiti achu sangan nou penglha masa chan chu kelngoi nouva nalhat ding, nalhat tah lou jong le sangan nou hochu angong chang na hekelep ding ahi. Chule na chapate lah'a apeng masa chan nale lhat doh cheh cheh ding ahi.”
English: Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck; and you shall redeem all the firstborn of man among your sons.

tcz: “Chule khonung teng, nachapan thil umchan dol'a nahin doh ding, hiche ho jouse hi ipijeh pentah'a kibol ham?” Nangman hitia hi na donbut ding, “Egypt gam'a soh ichan lai uva Pakaiyin abanthahat pan'na mipi jouse leh gancha aboncha ehin puidoh uva ahiye,” na ti ding ahi, ati.
en: It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage.
text:
EXO 13:14
Thadou: “Chule khonung teng, nachapan thil umchan dol'a nahin doh ding, hiche ho jouse hi ipijeh pentah'a kibol ham?” Nangman hitia hi na donbut ding, “Egypt gam'a soh ichan lai uva Pakaiyin abanthahat pan'na mipi jouse leh gancha aboncha ehin puidoh uva ahiye,” na ti ding ahi, ati.
English: It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage.

tcz: “Pharaoh ana lungtah lheh jing in ahile, Egypt gam'a konna ipotdoh diu chu ana phal tapon, ajonan Pakaiyin Egypt gamsung'a pasal peng masa jouse leh gancha jouse abonchan athat chaikeiye. Hijeh achu tuahi keiman Pakaiya dia kilhaina kasem ahin hibang'a chu keiman ka chapate lah'a peng masa pen chan chu lhatdohna kaneiji ahi.” tia na seipeh ding ahi,” ati.
en: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the LORD killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of livestock. Therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that opens the womb, being males; but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’
text:
EXO 13:15
Thadou: “Pharaoh ana lungtah lheh jing in ahile, Egypt gam'a konna ipotdoh diu chu ana phal tapon, ajonan Pakaiyin Egypt gamsung'a pasal peng masa jouse leh gancha jouse abonchan athat chaikeiye. Hijeh achu tuahi keiman Pakaiya dia kilhaina kasem ahin hibang'a chu keiman ka chapate lah'a peng masa pen chan chu lhatdohna kaneiji ahi.” tia na seipeh ding ahi,” ati.
English: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the LORD killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of livestock. Therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that opens the womb, being males; but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’

tcz: “Hiche chondan hi nakhut teni ahin, namit teni chule na nah lhong geija melchina thil'a navop jing ding ahiye. Hichu Pakaiyin abanthahat pan'na Egypt gam'a kon'na nahin puidoh het jing na ahi.”
en: It shall be for a sign on your hand, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt.”
text:
EXO 13:16
Thadou: “Hiche chondan hi nakhut teni ahin, namit teni chule na nah lhong geija melchina thil'a navop jing ding ahiye. Hichu Pakaiyin abanthahat pan'na Egypt gam'a kon'na nahin puidoh het jing na ahi.”
English: It shall be for a sign on your hand, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt.”

tcz: Ajonan Pharaoh vin Israel mite ahin soldoh tan ahile, gamtepna lamlhun'na naicha ahi vang chun, Pathen'in Philistine galbol hojih chun lampia ahinpui pouvin ahi. Pathen'in aseiye, “Kamite hon galtoh khata le alung heikhao vintin Egypt lam'a kile ding ahiuve,” ati.
en: When Pharaoh had let the people go, God didn’t lead them by the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, “Lest perhaps the people change their minds when they see war, and they return to Egypt”;

tcz: Pathen'in amaho chu gamthip lah'a ahinpui leuvin, vadung san* lammun chu ahin jon tauvin ahi. Israel mite chu galsat mibang in ahung kitol taovin ahi.
en: but God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea; and the children of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 13:18
