Thadou: Pathen'in amaho chu gamthip lah'a ahinpui leuvin, vadung san* lammun chu ahin jon tauvin ahi. Israel mite chu galsat mibang in ahung kitol taovin ahi.
English: but God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea; and the children of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.

tcz: Mose'n jong Joseph gu-le chang ahin choijin, ajeh chu Joseph in hiche thulhah nahi ana neijin, hiti hin aseiye, “Pathen nangho kithopia hung jing ding ahi. Aman nangho nahin panpi teng ule, hiche kagu kachang hi nahin poh jing ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had made the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones away from here with you.”
text:
EXO 13:19
Thadou: Mose'n jong Joseph gu-le chang ahin choijin, ajeh chu Joseph in hiche thulhah nahi ana neijin, hiti hin aseiye, “Pathen nangho kithopia hung jing ding ahi. Aman nangho nahin panpi teng ule, hiche kagu kachang hi nahin poh jing ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had made the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones away from here with you.”

tcz: Israel miten Succoth mun ahida lha uvin gamthip lah Etham kiti mun ahung lhung tauvin hiche mun'na chun ngahmun akisem tauve.”
en: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
text:
EXO 13:20
Thadou: Israel miten Succoth mun ahida lha uvin gamthip lah Etham kiti mun ahung lhung tauvin hiche mun'na chun ngahmun akisem tauve.”
English: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

tcz: Pakaiyin amite chu malam'a alhon pijing in, “Sunteng meibol khompi bang in alhon pe uvin, jan teng meivah khompi bang in alhon pi jiuve.”
en: The LORD went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, that they might go by day and by night:
text:
EXO 13:21
Thadou: Pakaiyin amite chu malam'a alhon pijing in, “Sunteng meibol khompi bang in alhon pe uvin, jan teng meivah khompi bang in alhon pi jiuve.”
English: The LORD went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, that they might go by day and by night:

tcz: Pakaiyin amite dalha louvin mei-lhang meivah'in aum pi jing uve.
en: the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.
text:
EXO 13:22
Thadou: Pakaiyin amite dalha louvin mei-lhang meivah'in aum pi jing uve.
English: the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a thupeh hicheng hi anei jin:
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
EXO 14:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a thupeh hicheng hi anei jin:
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: “Israel mite heng'a seiyin nung lam'a a kihei uva Pi-hahiroth le Migdol kikah san-dung chule Baalzephon gal lamma ngahmun asem naiduvin aheng uvah seipeh'un,” ati.
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon. You shall encamp opposite it by the sea.
text:
EXO 14:2
Thadou: “Israel mite heng'a seiyin nung lam'a a kihei uva Pi-hahiroth le Migdol kikah san-dung chule Baalzephon gal lamma ngahmun asem naiduvin aheng uvah seipeh'un,” ati.
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon. You shall encamp opposite it by the sea.

tcz: Chutileh Pharaoh in hitia hi angaito ding, “Israel mite alungdong tauvin, suhna ding helouvin gamthip noija akitol le tauve, ati ding ahi.”
en: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.’
text:
EXO 14:3
Thadou: Chutileh Pharaoh in hitia hi angaito ding, “Israel mite alungdong tauvin, suhna ding helouvin gamthip noija akitol le tauve, ati ding ahi.”
English: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.’

tcz: “Hitia chu keima avel'a Pharaoh lungthim ka suhtah ding, aman nangho nung ahin delding ahi.* Ajeh chu keiman ka gontupsa ahitai, Pharaoh le agalsat mite chung'a ka loupina kakilah sah ding ahi. Chuteng Egypt mite'n keima Pakai kahi ahin hetdoh diu ahitai! Aheng uva kisei peh bang'in Israel mite'n hiche munna chun ngahmun akisem tauvin ahi.
en: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will follow after them; and I will get honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies; and the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD.” They did so.
text:
EXO 14:4
Thadou: “Hitia chu keima avel'a Pharaoh lungthim ka suhtah ding, aman nangho nung ahin delding ahi.* Ajeh chu keiman ka gontupsa ahitai, Pharaoh le agalsat mite chung'a ka loupina kakilah sah ding ahi. Chuteng Egypt mite'n keima Pakai kahi ahin hetdoh diu ahitai! Aheng uva kisei peh bang'in Israel mite'n hiche munna chun ngahmun akisem tauvin ahi.
English: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will follow after them; and I will get honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies; and the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD.” They did so.

tcz: “Pharaoh lengpa le asohte ho heng'a Israel mite ajam tauve tithu alhun phat in, Pharaoh leh asohte lungthim akikhel kit tan, “Ipi khat ibol uva Israel mite asoh chan nauva kon'na jam gam'u hitam?” tin asei uve.
en: The king of Egypt was told that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed toward the people, and they said, “What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?”
text:
EXO 14:5
Thadou: “Pharaoh lengpa le asohte ho heng'a Israel mite ajam tauve tithu alhun phat in, Pharaoh leh asohte lungthim akikhel kit tan, “Ipi khat ibol uva Israel mite asoh chan nauva kon'na jam gam'u hitam?” tin asei uve.
English: The king of Egypt was told that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed toward the people, and they said, “What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?”

tcz: Pharaoh in jong agalsat miho le sakol kangtalai hochu agon tupsah loijin ahi.
en: He prepared his chariot, and took his army with him;

tcz: “Pharaoh vin sakol-kangtalai hatcheh jagup le Egypt gamsung'a sakol kangtalai dangho jouse abonchan vaihom mitam pichu atou tauvin ahi.”
en: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them.
text:
EXO 14:7
Thadou: “Pharaoh vin sakol-kangtalai hatcheh jagup le Egypt gamsung'a sakol kangtalai dangho jouse abonchan vaihom mitam pichu atou tauvin ahi.”
English: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them.

tcz: “Pakaiyin Pharaoh kiti Egypt lengpa lungthim asutah nalai jin ahile, aman jong Egypt gamsung dalha'a jam Israel mite nungchu adel tan ahi.”
en: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel; for the children of Israel went out with a high hand.
text:
EXO 14:8
Thadou: “Pakaiyin Pharaoh kiti Egypt lengpa lungthim asutah nalai jin ahile, aman jong Egypt gamsung dalha'a jam Israel mite nungchu adel tan ahi.”
English: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel; for the children of Israel went out with a high hand.

tcz: “Egypt mite'n jong Israelte chu Pharaoh'in galsat miho thaneina lhingset apen anung adel tauvin a sakol jouseo leh sakol-kangtalai jouse, sakol touthem jouse le agalsat mijouse abonchauvin adimlha tauvin ahi.”
en: The Egyptians pursued them. All the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen, and his army overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal Zephon.
text:
EXO 14:9
Thadou: “Egypt mite'n jong Israelte chu Pharaoh'in galsat miho thaneina lhingset apen anung adel tauvin a sakol jouseo leh sakol-kangtalai jouse, sakol touthem jouse le agalsat mijouse abonchauvin adimlha tauvin ahi.”
English: The Egyptians pursued them. All the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen, and his army overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal Zephon.

tcz: Pharaoh jong Israel mite umnalam anailut jep phat'in amahon Pharaoh lam chu avetou uvin, hichun amahon anung lam uva Egypt mite ahung kitol chu amu tauve. Abonchauvin Pakai heng'a atao uvin,
en: When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid. The children of Israel cried out to the LORD.
text:
EXO 14:10
Thadou: Pharaoh jong Israel mite umnalam anailut jep phat'in amahon Pharaoh lam chu avetou uvin, hichun amahon anung lam uva Egypt mite ahung kitol chu amu tauve. Abonchauvin Pakai heng'a atao uvin,
English: When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid. The children of Israel cried out to the LORD.

tcz: Mose heng'a asei un, “Ipi ding'a gamthip noija hi thigam ding'a neihin puidoh'u hitam? Hitia ka thi gam sang uva Egypt mite khut noija soh'a ka um'mu phajo lou ham? Ka chung uva ipi nabol jing hitam? Ipi dinga Egypt gamsung'a kona nei puidoh'u ham?
en: They said to Moses, “Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why have you treated us this way, to bring us out of Egypt?
text:
EXO 14:11
Thadou: Mose heng'a asei un, “Ipi ding'a gamthip noija hi thigam ding'a neihin puidoh'u hitam? Hitia ka thi gam sang uva Egypt mite khut noija soh'a ka um'mu phajo lou ham? Ka chung uva ipi nabol jing hitam? Ipi dinga Egypt gamsung'a kona nei puidoh'u ham?
English: They said to Moses, “Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why have you treated us this way, to bring us out of Egypt?

tcz: Egypt gamsung kaum lai uva chu, hi tabanghi soh tei ding ahi tia ka seiju hilou ham? Tunjong na henga ka seiju ahi, “Nei dalha jeng tauvin! Egypt mite khut noija soh in umkit tau vinge. Hiche laimunna ka thigam sang uvin Egypt mite khut noija soh'a ka um'u apha joi!” tin asei tauve.
en: Isn’t this the word that we spoke to you in Egypt, saying, ‘Leave us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.”
text:
EXO 14:12
Thadou: Egypt gamsung kaum lai uva chu, hi tabanghi soh tei ding ahi tia ka seiju hilou ham? Tunjong na henga ka seiju ahi, “Nei dalha jeng tauvin! Egypt mite khut noija soh in umkit tau vinge. Hiche laimunna ka thigam sang uvin Egypt mite khut noija soh'a ka um'u apha joi!” tin asei tauve.
English: Isn’t this the word that we spoke to you in Egypt, saying, ‘Leave us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.”

tcz: Ahinlah Mose'n mipi heng'a asei jin, “Kicha hihhel un, dingdet jing un veuvin, tunia hi Pakaiyin na huhdoh diu ahiye. Chule tunia kipat avella Egypt mite namukit tah lou diu ahi,” ati.
en: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will work for you today; for you will never again see the Egyptians whom you have seen today.
text:
EXO 14:13
Thadou: Ahinlah Mose'n mipi heng'a asei jin, “Kicha hihhel un, dingdet jing un veuvin, tunia hi Pakaiyin na huhdoh diu ahiye. Chule tunia kipat avella Egypt mite namukit tah lou diu ahi,” ati.
English: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will work for you today; for you will never again see the Egyptians whom you have seen today.

tcz: “Pakai amatah'in nangho galsat'a pang ding ahi.”
en: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.”
text:
EXO 14:14
Thadou: “Pakai amatah'in nangho galsat'a pang ding ahi.”
English: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Ipi ding'a keima heng'a tao na hiuvem? Mipiho ma lamma akitol na diuvin seijin!
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Why do you cry to me? Speak to the children of Israel, that they go forward.
text:
EXO 14:15
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin, “Ipi ding'a keima heng'a tao na hiuvem? Mipiho ma lamma akitol na diuvin seijin!
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Why do you cry to me? Speak to the children of Israel, that they go forward.

tcz: “Na-tenggol jan doh tem in twikhanglen-dung vum chu jep tan. Twipi chu sukhen'in chutileh Israel mite twikhanglen lai lung tolgo lah achu ki jot ding'u ahi.”
en: Lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it. Then the children of Israel shall go into the middle of the sea on dry ground.
text:
EXO 14:16
Thadou: “Na-tenggol jan doh tem in twikhanglen-dung vum chu jep tan. Twipi chu sukhen'in chutileh Israel mite twikhanglen lai lung tolgo lah achu ki jot ding'u ahi.”
English: Lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it. Then the children of Israel shall go into the middle of the sea on dry ground.

tcz: “Chule keiman Egypt mite lungthim kasuh tah ding, amahon Israel mite thagam na ding angai todiu ahi, chuteng asakol kangtalai jouseo, asakol tounau nangho that gam ding'a hungkon ahiuvin, abonchauva keiman kathaneina aheng uva ka kilah sah ding ahi.”
en: Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.
text:
EXO 14:17
Thadou: “Chule keiman Egypt mite lungthim kasuh tah ding, amahon Israel mite thagam na ding angai todiu ahi, chuteng asakol kangtalai jouseo, asakol tounau nangho that gam ding'a hungkon ahiuvin, abonchauva keiman kathaneina aheng uva ka kilah sah ding ahi.”
English: Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.

tcz: “Egypt mite ma-sang'a kaloupina kakimusah ding ahijoi, chuteng keima Pakai kahi ahin hetdoh diu ahi!” ati.
en: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I have gotten myself honor over Pharaoh, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.”
text:
EXO 14:18
Thadou: “Egypt mite ma-sang'a kaloupina kakimusah ding ahijoi, chuteng keima Pakai kahi ahin hetdoh diu ahi!” ati.
English: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I have gotten myself honor over Pharaoh, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.”

tcz: Chuin Pakai vantil'in Israel mite ahin lhonpi'n. Mipi masang lam'a meilom chu nunglam joh'a ahung tan ahi.
en: The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them, and stood behind them.
text:
EXO 14:19
Thadou: Chuin Pakai vantil'in Israel mite ahin lhonpi'n. Mipi masang lam'a meilom chu nunglam joh'a ahung tan ahi.
English: The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them, and stood behind them.

tcz: Chuin meilom chu Israel mite le Egypt mite kah'a ahung umtai. Mu-athim lha jeng tan, meilom jong meikong a kisoh'in kho ahung thim tan ahile, jan khovah keijin Israel mite chu Egypt miten ahin del pha tapo uvin ahi.
en: It came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel. There was the cloud and the darkness, yet it gave light by night. One didn’t come near the other all night.
text:
EXO 14:20
Thadou: Chuin meilom chu Israel mite le Egypt mite kah'a ahung umtai. Mu-athim lha jeng tan, meilom jong meikong a kisoh'in kho ahung thim tan ahile, jan khovah keijin Israel mite chu Egypt miten ahin del pha tapo uvin ahi.
English: It came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel. There was the cloud and the darkness, yet it gave light by night. One didn’t come near the other all night.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n a tenggol chu twikhanglen san-dung vumma ajah doh jing'a ahile, chuin Pakaiyin twikhanglen dung chu solamma kon hui ahung nung in ahinsem hoh tan ahi. Jan khovah keijin huijin twikhanglen chu asem in, twikhanglen jong aki khen'in tol lham golai ahung umdohtan ahi.
en: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
text:
EXO 14:21
Thadou: Chuin Mose'n a tenggol chu twikhanglen san-dung vumma ajah doh jing'a ahile, chuin Pakaiyin twikhanglen dung chu solamma kon hui ahung nung in ahinsem hoh tan ahi. Jan khovah keijin huijin twikhanglen chu asem in, twikhanglen jong aki khen'in tol lham golai ahung umdohtan ahi.
English: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

tcz: Chuphat'in Israel mite abonchauvin tolgo laiya chun akitol'un alang alang'abang-bang'in twi chu kiting tan ahi!
en: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
text:
EXO 14:22
Thadou: Chuphat'in Israel mite abonchauvin tolgo laiya chun akitol'un alang alang'abang-bang'in twi chu kiting tan ahi!
English: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

tcz: Chuin Egypt mite Pharaoh galsat sakol jouse, sakol kangtalai jouse chule sakol touthem jouse jaona'n Twikhanglen lailung'a kitol Israel mite chu adel tauvin ahi.
en: The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
text:
EXO 14:23
Thadou: Chuin Egypt mite Pharaoh galsat sakol jouse, sakol kangtalai jouse chule sakol touthem jouse jaona'n Twikhanglen lailung'a kitol Israel mite chu adel tauvin ahi.
English: The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

tcz: “Jingpi ahi phat in Pakaiyin Egypt mite chu meikong leh meilom mangchan ahin vesuh tauvin ahile, chuin Egypt galsat miho chu abonchauvin suh na ding beijin a nohgam tauvin ahi.
en: In the morning watch, the LORD looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egyptian army.
text:
EXO 14:24
Thadou: “Jingpi ahi phat in Pakaiyin Egypt mite chu meikong leh meilom mangchan ahin vesuh tauvin ahile, chuin Egypt galsat miho chu abonchauvin suh na ding beijin a nohgam tauvin ahi.
English: In the morning watch, the LORD looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egyptian army.

tcz: Pakaiyin a kangtalai jouse'u abonchan a tuhtang gam tan ahile, kangtalai hochu abonchan a kitang den gam tai. Egypt miten jong aseita'u vin! “Israel mite angsung'a kon'in jamdoh loiju hite,” ajeh chu “Pakaiyin Israel mite apan pin Egypt mite chung'a gal asat tai,” atiuve.
en: He took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egyptians said, “Let’s flee from the face of Israel, for the LORD fights for them against the Egyptians!”
text:
EXO 14:25
Thadou: Pakaiyin a kangtalai jouse'u abonchan a tuhtang gam tan ahile, kangtalai hochu abonchan a kitang den gam tai. Egypt miten jong aseita'u vin! “Israel mite angsung'a kon'in jamdoh loiju hite,” ajeh chu “Pakaiyin Israel mite apan pin Egypt mite chung'a gal asat tai,” atiuve.
English: He took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egyptians said, “Let’s flee from the face of Israel, for the LORD fights for them against the Egyptians!”

tcz: Israel mite agalkai phat uvin, Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Egypt mite twijin ale lonkhum na ding'in na tenggol jahdoh inlang twipilen chungvum hi jep tem in, ati.”
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come again on the Egyptians, on their chariots, and on their horsemen.”
text:
EXO 14:26
Thadou: Israel mite agalkai phat uvin, Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Egypt mite twijin ale lonkhum na ding'in na tenggol jahdoh inlang twipilen chungvum hi jep tem in, ati.”
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come again on the Egyptians, on their chariots, and on their horsemen.”

tcz: Nisa ahung sodoh toh ki lhon'in, Pakaiyin a thupeh bang in Mose'n Twipilen chung vumma akhut ajah tan ahile, Twipilen jong angai ja bang bang in ahung um doh kit tai.
en: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it. The LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.
text:
EXO 14:27
Thadou: Nisa ahung sodoh toh ki lhon'in, Pakaiyin a thupeh bang in Mose'n Twipilen chung vumma akhut ajah tan ahile, Twipilen jong angai ja bang bang in ahung um doh kit tai.
English: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it. The LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.

tcz: Chuin Twi akitol mat kit tan, Israel mite nung hindel a Egypt galsat miho le sakol touthem jouse, kangtalai jouse abonchauvin Twi jin achup gam hel taovin khat jeng cha jong asohcha tapouvin ahi.
en: The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into the sea. There remained not so much as one of them.
text:
EXO 14:28
Thadou: Chuin Twi akitol mat kit tan, Israel mite nung hindel a Egypt galsat miho le sakol touthem jouse, kangtalai jouse abonchauvin Twi jin achup gam hel taovin khat jeng cha jong asohcha tapouvin ahi.
English: The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into the sea. There remained not so much as one of them.

tcz: Ahinlah Israel mite chu Twipilen lailung'a tolgo achun akitol jing uvin, twipi jing jong ajet aveija akisong den jeng in ahi.
en: But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
text:
EXO 14:29
Thadou: Ahinlah Israel mite chu Twipilen lailung'a tolgo achun akitol jing uvin, twipi jing jong ajet aveija akisong den jeng in ahi.
English: But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

tcz: Hiche nikho'a hi Pakaiyin Israel mite chu Egypt mite khut akon'in ahu doh'in Israel mite'n amit tah uvin twi-khanglen galla Egypt mite thilong kijam hochu amutaovin ahi.
en: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
text:
EXO 14:30
Thadou: Hiche nikho'a hi Pakaiyin Israel mite chu Egypt mite khut akon'in ahu doh'in Israel mite'n amit tah uvin twi-khanglen galla Egypt mite thilong kijam hochu amutaovin ahi.
English: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.

tcz: Egypt miten Isreal mite douna anei uva Pakai thahat le natoh ki dang amuchen ta uvin ahile, Israel mite'n Pakai chu aging tauve. Pakai le alhachapa Mose jong aging uvin, tahsan ki phudetna anei tauvin ahi.
en: Israel saw the great work which the LORD did to the Egyptians, and the people feared the LORD; and they believed in the LORD and in his servant Moses.
text:
EXO 14:31
Thadou: Egypt miten Isreal mite douna anei uva Pakai thahat le natoh ki dang amuchen ta uvin ahile, Israel mite'n Pakai chu aging tauve. Pakai le alhachapa Mose jong aging uvin, tahsan ki phudetna anei tauvin ahi.
English: Israel saw the great work which the LORD did to the Egyptians, and the people feared the LORD; and they believed in the LORD and in his servant Moses.

tcz: Chuin Mose le Israel mite'n Pakai avahchoijun la asa uve: “Keiman Pakai vahchoila ka sah ding, ajeh chu aman loupitah in gal ajou tai; sakol ahin achung toupa Pakaiyin Twikhang len lailunga aseplut tan ahi.”
en: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to the LORD, and said, “I will sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.
text:
EXO 15:1
Thadou: Chuin Mose le Israel mite'n Pakai avahchoijun la asa uve: “Keiman Pakai vahchoila ka sah ding, ajeh chu aman loupitah in gal ajou tai; sakol ahin achung toupa Pakaiyin Twikhang len lailunga aseplut tan ahi.”
English: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to the LORD, and said, “I will sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.

tcz: “Pakai hi kei dinga, ka thahat nale ka vahchoi ding'a lomtah ahi; ajeh chu aman galjona eipetai.” Amahi ka Pathen, ka vahchoi ding ahi, chule kapau Pathen ahin, choiat ding'a lom Ama bou ahi!
en: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
text:
EXO 15:2
Thadou: “Pakai hi kei dinga, ka thahat nale ka vahchoi ding'a lomtah ahi; ajeh chu aman galjona eipetai.” Amahi ka Pathen, ka vahchoi ding ahi, chule kapau Pathen ahin, choiat ding'a lom Ama bou ahi!
English: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

tcz: “Pakai hi galhattah ahin, ajeh chu amin jong Yaweh ahiye!”.
en: The LORD is a man of war. The LORD is his name.
text:
EXO 15:3
Thadou: “Pakai hi galhattah ahin, ajeh chu amin jong Yaweh ahiye!”.
English: The LORD is a man of war. The LORD is his name.

tcz: “Pharaoh kangtalai jouse le agalsat jouse, Pakaiyin Twikhang len lailunga asep lut tauvin; Pharaoh deitum le alhen tumho abonchauvin Twikhanglen san dunga aseplut gamtauvin ahi”.
en: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.
text:
EXO 15:4
Thadou: “Pharaoh kangtalai jouse le agalsat jouse, Pakaiyin Twikhang len lailunga asep lut tauvin; Pharaoh deitum le alhen tumho abonchauvin Twikhanglen san dunga aseplut gamtauvin ahi”.
English: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.

tcz: “Twikhanglen kinong in achup gamsoh heljing uvin; abonchaovin songtum bangin Twinoi lamma a lhalhum gam tauve.”
en: The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone.
text:
EXO 15:5
Thadou: “Twikhanglen kinong in achup gamsoh heljing uvin; abonchaovin songtum bangin Twinoi lamma a lhalhum gam tauve.”
English: The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone.

tcz: “O Pakai nakhut jetlam hi loupe le thahat chungnung ahi. Melmate jeng jong a sugam hel tan ahi.”
en: Your right hand, LORD, is glorious in power. Your right hand, LORD, dashes the enemy in pieces.
text:
EXO 15:6
Thadou: “O Pakai nakhut jetlam hi loupe le thahat chungnung ahi. Melmate jeng jong a sugam hel tan ahi.”
English: Your right hand, LORD, is glorious in power. Your right hand, LORD, dashes the enemy in pieces.

tcz: “Na lalna leh na loupina jal in na melmate naleh khup jing e, Nalunghan na nasatah in nahin tahlang jitan ahile; abonchauvin meiyin changpol akah vamkei bang'in a kavam soh hel tauve.”
en: In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you. You send out your wrath. It consumes them as stubble.
text:
EXO 15:7
Thadou: “Na lalna leh na loupina jal in na melmate naleh khup jing e, Nalunghan na nasatah in nahin tahlang jitan ahile; abonchauvin meiyin changpol akah vamkei bang'in a kavam soh hel tauve.”
English: In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you. You send out your wrath. It consumes them as stubble.

tcz: “Nangma husan akonin twipi kinong jeng jong alhuh den in ahile atang jeng tai! Chule twikhanglen lailung'a twi kitangjong chu ale chupsoh heljeng in ahi.”
en: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.
text:
EXO 15:8
Thadou: “Nangma husan akonin twipi kinong jeng jong alhuh den in ahile atang jeng tai! Chule twikhanglen lailung'a twi kitangjong chu ale chupsoh heljeng in ahi.”
English: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.

tcz: “Chuin Melmapa chun hitin aseiye, keiman anung ka del ding ka phah tei ding ahi. Thil kiladoh kale lah ding chule ka deichat bangtah'a kakile lah ding ahiye; kachem jam ka sadoh ding, abonchauva kasat chap jeng ding ahiuve.”
en: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword. My hand will destroy them.’
text:
EXO 15:9
Thadou: “Chuin Melmapa chun hitin aseiye, keiman anung ka del ding ka phah tei ding ahi. Thil kiladoh kale lah ding chule ka deichat bangtah'a kakile lah ding ahiye; kachem jam ka sadoh ding, abonchauva kasat chap jeng ding ahiuve.”
English: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword. My hand will destroy them.’

tcz: “Ahinlah nangman na haikhum in ahile, abonchauvin twikhanglen in a chup tauve. Twipi hattah lailung'a alhum gam tauvin ahi.
en: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
text:
EXO 15:10
Thadou: “Ahinlah nangman na haikhum in ahile, abonchauvin twikhanglen in a chup tauve. Twipi hattah lailung'a alhum gam tauvin ahi.
English: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

tcz: “O Pakai, Pathen dangho jouse lah jeng'a jong koi macha nang kal lhah aumpon, amaho chu imacha toh'a kite thei deh pouvin, nangma kala koima cha thenna chang ding aum hih e. Loupi na leh tijat umtah'a thilbola koiham?”
en: Who is like you, LORD, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
text:
EXO 15:11
Thadou: “O Pakai, Pathen dangho jouse lah jeng'a jong koi macha nang kal lhah aumpon, amaho chu imacha toh'a kite thei deh pouvin, nangma kala koima cha thenna chang ding aum hih e. Loupi na leh tijat umtah'a thilbola koiham?”
English: Who is like you, LORD, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

tcz: “Nangman nakhut jetlam najahdoh in ahile, hichun leiset'a melmate avallhum gam tauve.”
en: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.
text:
EXO 15:12
Thadou: “Nangman nakhut jetlam najahdoh in ahile, hichun leiset'a melmate avallhum gam tauve.”
English: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.

tcz: Na lungsetna long louvin, na lhatdohsa mite aumpi jing in ahi. Na chena mun geijin namite nahin puilhung tai.”
en: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.
text:
EXO 15:13
Thadou: Na lungsetna long louvin, na lhatdohsa mite aumpi jing in ahi. Na chena mun geijin namite nahin puilhung tai.”
English: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.

tcz: “Mitin vaipin hichu ahin jasoh tauvin ahile; Philistine gamsung'a cheng jouse din nat hesoh achang tauve.”
en: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.
text:
EXO 15:14
Thadou: “Mitin vaipin hichu ahin jasoh tauvin ahile; Philistine gamsung'a cheng jouse din nat hesoh achang tauve.”
English: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.

tcz: “Edom gamsung'a lamkai kitiphot alung thomlhao gamtan; Moab gamma lamkai jouse jong aki thing soh hel tauve. Canaaan gam'a cheng jouse jong alung thoi gamta uve.”
en: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.
text:
EXO 15:15
Thadou: “Edom gamsung'a lamkai kitiphot alung thomlhao gamtan; Moab gamma lamkai jouse jong aki thing soh hel tauve. Canaaan gam'a cheng jouse jong alung thoi gamta uve.”
English: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.

tcz: “Nangman namite nahin puilut ding nangma molsang chungvum a chu na tundoh ding ahiye; ajeh chu nangman hiche laimun chu na chenna dinga na tundoh sa ahi tai, O Pakai nangman mun theng laijeng jong chu na khut te nia na tundoh ahi tai, ati.”
en: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, LORD, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.
text:
EXO 15:17
Thadou: “Nangman namite nahin puilut ding nangma molsang chungvum a chu na tundoh ding ahiye; ajeh chu nangman hiche laimun chu na chenna dinga na tundoh sa ahi tai, O Pakai nangman mun theng laijeng jong chu na khut te nia na tundoh ahi tai, ati.”
English: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, LORD, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.

tcz: “Pakai hi tonsot tonsot'a chung nung chang ahi tai!”
en: The LORD will reign forever and ever.”
text:
EXO 15:18
Thadou: “Pakai hi tonsot tonsot'a chung nung chang ahi tai!”
English: The LORD will reign forever and ever.”

tcz: Ajeh chu Pharaoh sakol kangtalai jouse twikhanglen lailung'a atol lut in, Pakai thahat chun achungvum uvah twikhangklen chu alechup sah gam ahitai. Ahinlah Israel chate abonchauvin twi-khanglen lailung tolgo lah achun akijot galkai sah tauvin ahi.
en: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.
text:
EXO 15:19
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pharaoh sakol kangtalai jouse twikhanglen lailung'a atol lut in, Pakai thahat chun achungvum uvah twikhangklen chu alechup sah gam ahitai. Ahinlah Israel chate abonchauvin twi-khanglen lailung tolgo lah achun akijot galkai sah tauvin ahi.
English: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.

tcz: Chuin Aaron a sopinu, themgao Miriam akhut'a khutbeh khat chu akilah in, numeija kaijousen amanu nung chu ajui tauvin, khutbeh jaonan apotdoh uvin alam uve.
en: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.
text:
EXO 15:20
Thadou: Chuin Aaron a sopinu, themgao Miriam akhut'a khutbeh khat chu akilah in, numeija kaijousen amanu nung chu ajui tauvin, khutbeh jaonan apotdoh uvin alam uve.
English: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.

tcz: Chule Miriam chun hiche jaila hi a-oijin ahi: “Pakai vahchoila sa'u hite, Aman loupitah'in gal asat'in ajou tai; sakol chung'a toupa jeng jong twikhang len lailung'a aleh khup jeng tai.”
en: Miriam answered them, “Sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.”
text:
EXO 15:21
Thadou: Chule Miriam chun hiche jaila hi a-oijin ahi: “Pakai vahchoila sa'u hite, Aman loupitah'in gal asat'in ajou tai; sakol chung'a toupa jeng jong twikhang len lailung'a aleh khup jeng tai.”
English: Miriam answered them, “Sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.”

tcz: Mose'n jong twikhanglen San akon'in Israelte chu ahin pui nalaijun, chuin Shur kiti neldi gam'a akitol lut tauvin ahi. twidon ding thei louvin nithum sung'in akitol tauve.
en: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
text:
EXO 15:22
Thadou: Mose'n jong twikhanglen San akon'in Israelte chu ahin pui nalaijun, chuin Shur kiti neldi gam'a akitol lut tauvin ahi. twidon ding thei louvin nithum sung'in akitol tauve.
English: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

tcz: Marah mun ahung geitauvin ahile hiche mun'na twi chu akha'n don thei ahi tapoi. Hijeh chun hichelai munchu Marah asah tauvin ahi (hichu akha tina ahi).
en: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.
text:
EXO 15:23
Thadou: Marah mun ahung geitauvin ahile hiche mun'na twi chu akha'n don thei ahi tapoi. Hijeh chun hichelai munchu Marah asah tauvin ahi (hichu akha tina ahi).
English: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.

tcz: Chuin mipi Mose chung'a aphunchel gamtaovin hiti hin aseyuve, “Ipi kadon diuva hitam?”
en: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”
text:
EXO 15:24
Thadou: Chuin mipi Mose chung'a aphunchel gamtaovin hiti hin aseyuve, “Ipi kadon diuva hitam?”
English: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”

tcz: Mose jong Pakai lamsang in kap pum in atao tai. Pakaiyin thing lhon neokhat avetsah in hichu asat doh'in twi lah chu akho lut'a ahile twi chu donthei ahung sohdoh tan ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin hiche Marah munna chun Israelte ding in chonna dan khat a sempeh'in Ama'a akitah jing na diuvin jong hilchetna aneiyin ahi.
en: Then he cried to the LORD. The LORD showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.
text:
EXO 15:25
Thadou: Mose jong Pakai lamsang in kap pum in atao tai. Pakaiyin thing lhon neokhat avetsah in hichu asat doh'in twi lah chu akho lut'a ahile twi chu donthei ahung sohdoh tan ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin hiche Marah munna chun Israelte ding in chonna dan khat a sempeh'in Ama'a akitah jing na diuvin jong hilchetna aneiyin ahi.
English: Then he cried to the LORD. The LORD showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.

tcz: “Aman hiti hin aseije, “Nangman ching thei tah'in na Pakai na Pathen thusei ngaijin, Ama mitmu'a thudih jeng'a na chon ding, a thupeh jouse na nit ding, hi tia chu Egypt mite chung'a gamna hoise ka lan sah chu nangho chung'a ka lansah louhel ding ahiye, ajeh chu keima nadamsah na Pakai chu kahi,” ati.
en: He said, “If you will diligently listen to the LORD your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am the LORD who heals you.”
text:
EXO 15:26
Thadou: “Aman hiti hin aseije, “Nangman ching thei tah'in na Pakai na Pathen thusei ngaijin, Ama mitmu'a thudih jeng'a na chon ding, a thupeh jouse na nit ding, hi tia chu Egypt mite chung'a gamna hoise ka lan sah chu nangho chung'a ka lansah louhel ding ahiye, ajeh chu keima nadamsah na Pakai chu kahi,” ati.
English: He said, “If you will diligently listen to the LORD your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am the LORD who heals you.”

tcz: Marah mun adalhah phat'uvin Israel mite jong Elim kiti twiko somleni putdoh namun tom-thing somsagi kenna munna twipang achun ngahmun akisem tauvin ahi.
en: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.
text:
EXO 15:27
Thadou: Marah mun adalhah phat'uvin Israel mite jong Elim kiti twiko somleni putdoh namun tom-thing somsagi kenna munna twipang achun ngahmun akisem tauvin ahi.
English: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.

tcz: Elim akon'in Israel mipi akitol uvin Sin* kiti gammang lam hichu Elim le Sinai molsang kahlah ahiye. Hiche mun chu Egypt gamsung'a konna ahungpotdoh kal'u lhani alhing tan, hiche lhasung nisom le ninga lhinin ahunglhung taovin ahi.
en: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 16:1
Thadou: Elim akon'in Israel mipi akitol uvin Sin* kiti gammang lam hichu Elim le Sinai molsang kahlah ahiye. Hiche mun chu Egypt gamsung'a konna ahungpotdoh kal'u lhani alhing tan, hiche lhasung nisom le ninga lhinin ahunglhung taovin ahi.
English: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

tcz: Hiche mun jeng ajong chun Isreal mite Mose le Aaron heng'a aphunchil taovin ahi.
en: The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;

tcz: Ama hon aseiyun, “Kada tangei uve! Egypt gamsunga kana um laiyun saneh ding hihen changlhah hijong le adimlha jeng jin, tun nangman hiche gamthip noiya hi kelthohsah'a thi gam sah ding nei got u hitam,” atiuve.
en: and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by the LORD’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots, when we ate our fill of bread, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.”
text:
EXO 16:3
Thadou: Ama hon aseiyun, “Kada tangei uve! Egypt gamsunga kana um laiyun saneh ding hihen changlhah hijong le adimlha jeng jin, tun nangman hiche gamthip noiya hi kelthohsah'a thi gam sah ding nei got u hitam,” atiuve.
English: and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by the LORD’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots, when we ate our fill of bread, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Vetan! Vanna konna keiman nangma ann kahinpeh ding nahiye. Nisih niseh'a aneh diu adeichannu agakilo ding'u ahi. Keiman amaho kapatep ding ahiuve, ajeh chu kathu angai nah uvem.”
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.
text:
EXO 16:4
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Vetan! Vanna konna keiman nangma ann kahinpeh ding nahiye. Nisih niseh'a aneh diu adeichannu agakilo ding'u ahi. Keiman amaho kapatep ding ahiuve, ajeh chu kathu angai nah uvem.”
English: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.

tcz: “Nigup lhinni teng keiman aneh khopset diuva an'neh kahin pehding ahiuve, hichu anehkhopset diu ajatnia tam hiding ahi.”
en: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”
text:
EXO 16:5
Thadou: “Nigup lhinni teng keiman aneh khopset diuva an'neh kahin pehding ahiuve, hichu anehkhopset diu ajatnia tam hiding ahi.”
English: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”

tcz: Chuin Mose le Aaron'injong Israel mite heng'a aseipeh lhon tan, “Nilhah lam teng na hetdoh ding'u ahiye, ajeh chu koiham Egypt gamsung'a konna nahin puidoh paochu,” atipeh lhon tai.
en: Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, “At evening, you shall know that the LORD has brought you out from the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 16:6
Thadou: Chuin Mose le Aaron'injong Israel mite heng'a aseipeh lhon tan, “Nilhah lam teng na hetdoh ding'u ahiye, ajeh chu koiham Egypt gamsung'a konna nahin puidoh paochu,” atipeh lhon tai.
English: Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, “At evening, you shall know that the LORD has brought you out from the land of Egypt.

tcz: “Chule jingkah lamteng Pakai loupina namudiu ahi, ajeh chu nangho nakiphin nau awgin Aman ajasoh tai, hichu Amadia doumah um ahin, hichu keini chung'a doumah naneijin phun hihhel un, ati lhon'e.”
en: In the morning, you shall see the LORD’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against the LORD. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”
text:
EXO 16:7
Thadou: “Chule jingkah lamteng Pakai loupina namudiu ahi, ajeh chu nangho nakiphin nau awgin Aman ajasoh tai, hichu Amadia doumah um ahin, hichu keini chung'a doumah naneijin phun hihhel un, ati lhon'e.”
English: In the morning, you shall see the LORD’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against the LORD. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”

tcz: Mose'n asei aseikit in, “Pakaiyin nilhah lamma naneh diu sa nahin peh diu, jingkah lama naneh diu changlhah nahin peh diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin nangho na phunchel uva ama douna thu na seinau aja soh tai. Keini a kon ipijeh'a na kiphin'nu ham? Henge, na phunchel nau chu keini douna hilouvin, Pathen douna ahijoi,” ati lhonne.
en: Moses said, “Now the LORD will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because the LORD hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.”
text:
EXO 16:8
Thadou: Mose'n asei aseikit in, “Pakaiyin nilhah lamma naneh diu sa nahin peh diu, jingkah lama naneh diu changlhah nahin peh diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin nangho na phunchel uva ama douna thu na seinau aja soh tai. Keini a kon ipijeh'a na kiphin'nu ham? Henge, na phunchel nau chu keini douna hilouvin, Pathen douna ahijoi,” ati lhonne.
English: Moses said, “Now the LORD will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because the LORD hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.”

tcz: Chuin Mose'n jong Aaron heng'a aseijin, “Israel mite jouse heng'a seipeh tem in: Nangma cheh Pakai angsung'a kipe lut uvin, ajeh chu Aman nang ho phunchel na ajahsoh ahi tai, tin seiyin,” ati.
en: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to the LORD, for he has heard your murmurings.’”
text:
EXO 16:9
Thadou: Chuin Mose'n jong Aaron heng'a aseijin, “Israel mite jouse heng'a seipeh tem in: Nangma cheh Pakai angsung'a kipe lut uvin, ajeh chu Aman nang ho phunchel na ajahsoh ahi tai, tin seiyin,” ati.
English: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to the LORD, for he has heard your murmurings.’”

tcz: Aaron'injong Isreal mite jouse heng'a aseiyin ahile, amahon gammang lah chu avel le jeng tauvin ahi. Amahon Pathen loupina thil chu vanlam'a amu tauvin ahi.
en: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the LORD’s glory appeared in the cloud.
text:
EXO 16:10
Thadou: Aaron'injong Isreal mite jouse heng'a aseiyin ahile, amahon gammang lah chu avel le jeng tauvin ahi. Amahon Pathen loupina thil chu vanlam'a amu tauvin ahi.
English: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the LORD’s glory appeared in the cloud.

tcz: Chu in Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
EXO 16:11
Thadou: Chu in Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei jin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: “Keiman Israel mite phunchelna ka jahsoh tan ahi. Tun nangman aheng uvah seijin, nilhah lamteng naneh diuva sa ka hin peh ding na hiuvin chule jingkah lamteng naneh diuva changlhah kahin peh ding na hiuve. Chuteng nanghon keima hi na-Pakai u-leh Na-Pathen'u kahi na hetdoh ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: “I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.’”
text:
EXO 16:12
Thadou: “Keiman Israel mite phunchelna ka jahsoh tan ahi. Tun nangman aheng uvah seijin, nilhah lamteng naneh diuva sa ka hin peh ding na hiuvin chule jingkah lamteng naneh diuva changlhah kahin peh ding na hiuve. Chuteng nanghon keima hi na-Pakai u-leh Na-Pathen'u kahi na hetdoh ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: “I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.’”

tcz: Hiche nilhah lam chun vamimte ahung kitol tauvin ahile ngahmun chu alo dimlha jeng tauve. Jingkah khovah machun ngahmun kim vel lah jouse chu daitwi jin ana chup in ahi.
en: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.
text:
EXO 16:13
Thadou: Hiche nilhah lam chun vamimte ahung kitol tauvin ahile ngahmun chu alo dimlha jeng tauve. Jingkah khovah machun ngahmun kim vel lah jouse chu daitwi jin ana chup in ahi.
English: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.

tcz: Chuin daitwi hochu ahung kihoh dohtan ahile, gammang lah akon chun thilpha tah khat alomlom chan ahung umtan, hichu abeh beh'a kigol'in anaum in ahi.
en: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.
text:
EXO 16:14
Thadou: Chuin daitwi hochu ahung kihoh dohtan ahile, gammang lah akon chun thilpha tah khat alomlom chan ahung umtan, hichu abeh beh'a kigol'in anaum in ahi.
English: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.

tcz: Israel miten jong hichu ahinmudoh taovin ahile, amaho akidong tochheh un, “hiche khu ipi ahidem?” amahon ipi ahichu ahedoh jou pouvin ahile. Chu in Mose'n ahil chen un, “Hiche hi nehding'a Pakaiyin napeh uvah ahi,” ati.
en: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which the LORD has given you to eat.
text:
EXO 16:15
Thadou: Israel miten jong hichu ahinmudoh taovin ahile, amaho akidong tochheh un, “hiche khu ipi ahidem?” amahon ipi ahichu ahedoh jou pouvin ahile. Chu in Mose'n ahil chen un, “Hiche hi nehding'a Pakaiyin napeh uvah ahi,” ati.
English: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which the LORD has given you to eat.

tcz: “Hicheng hi Pakaiyin aseije: Nangma insung cheh'in naneh khopset diu kilah unlang, chule mikhat'in vamim jatnia tamjo napon buh sung uvah kichoi lut un,” ati.
en: This is the thing which the LORD has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.’”
text:
EXO 16:16
Thadou: “Hicheng hi Pakaiyin aseije: Nangma insung cheh'in naneh khopset diu kilah unlang, chule mikhat'in vamim jatnia tamjo napon buh sung uvah kichoi lut un,” ati.
English: This is the thing which the LORD has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.’”

tcz: Pakaiyin athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong abol tauvin ahi, kimkhat in tampi a kichoi jun, akim khatma chun achoi khambep cheh aki choi uve.
en: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.
text:
EXO 16:17
Thadou: Pakaiyin athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong abol tauvin ahi, kimkhat in tampi a kichoi jun, akim khatma chun achoi khambep cheh aki choi uve.
English: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.

tcz: Ahinlah Omer dimkhat cheh atetoh uvin ahileh, tamtah hinkilah ho ahin chule ama ding khambep hin kilah ho jong hiti chun, kitam lah chom leh kilhom lah chom um louvin; abonchauvin kitoh chat chat'in akihom uvin aki choiyuve.
en: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.
text:
EXO 16:18
Thadou: Ahinlah Omer dimkhat cheh atetoh uvin ahileh, tamtah hinkilah ho ahin chule ama ding khambep hin kilah ho jong hiti chun, kitam lah chom leh kilhom lah chom um louvin; abonchauvin kitoh chat chat'in akihom uvin aki choiyuve.
English: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n aheng uvah aseiyin, “Jingkah khovah lhah channa ahelsi cha jeng jong na koi loudiu ahi,” ati.
en: Moses said to them, “Let no one leave of it until the morning.”
text:
EXO 16:19
Thadou: Chuin Mose'n aheng uvah aseiyin, “Jingkah khovah lhah channa ahelsi cha jeng jong na koi loudiu ahi,” ati.
English: Moses said to them, “Let no one leave of it until the morning.”

tcz: Kimkhat chun a ngaisah pouvin changlhah aneh moh uchu jingkah lam chan in akoi jun ahile, chang lhah akoi den hou chu thaan achu tan a uilha gam tai, Mose jong ama ho chung'a chun a lungpha mo tan ahi.
en: Notwithstanding they didn’t listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became foul; and Moses was angry with them.
text:
EXO 16:20
Thadou: Kimkhat chun a ngaisah pouvin changlhah aneh moh uchu jingkah lam chan in akoi jun ahile, chang lhah akoi den hou chu thaan achu tan a uilha gam tai, Mose jong ama ho chung'a chun a lungpha mo tan ahi.
English: Notwithstanding they didn’t listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became foul; and Moses was angry with them.

tcz: Jingkah sih'in Mipiho chun aneh khop cheh diu changlhah chu aga kilo jiuvin, nisa ahungsat doh teng levang changlhah hochu ajunmang jitan ahi.
en: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.
text:
EXO 16:21
Thadou: Jingkah sih'in Mipiho chun aneh khop cheh diu changlhah chu aga kilo jiuvin, nisa ahungsat doh teng levang changlhah hochu ajunmang jitan ahi.
English: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.

tcz: Nigup lhinni teng le changlhah chu achan jatbep cheh diuvin akilo jiuvin, hitia abol'u toh kilhon chun khompi lamkai ho ahung uvin Mose heng'a asei jiuvin ahi.
en: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
text:
EXO 16:22
Thadou: Nigup lhinni teng le changlhah chu achan jatbep cheh diuvin akilo jiuvin, hitia abol'u toh kilhon chun khompi lamkai ho ahung uvin Mose heng'a asei jiuvin ahi.
English: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

tcz: Aman aheng uvah aseiyin, “Pakaiyin hiti hin aseije: Jing nikho teng nangho nakicholdo diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiya dia Sabbath nikho theng ahi. Changlhah na kisem theijat channu tunin kisem unlang, hiche hochu jinglam'a ding jong kikoi doh taovin,” ati.
en: He said to them, “This is that which the LORD has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’”
text:
EXO 16:23
Thadou: Aman aheng uvah aseiyin, “Pakaiyin hiti hin aseije: Jing nikho teng nangho nakicholdo diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiya dia Sabbath nikho theng ahi. Changlhah na kisem theijat channu tunin kisem unlang, hiche hochu jinglam'a ding jong kikoi doh taovin,” ati.
English: He said to them, “This is that which the LORD has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’”

tcz: Mose'n athupeh bang'un, changlhah phabep chu achom in jingkah khovah chan in akoi jun ahi. Jingkah'in changlhah hochu ima ati tapon than jong chu louvin hoitah'in ana um'e.
en: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it.
text:
EXO 16:24
Thadou: Mose'n athupeh bang'un, changlhah phabep chu achom in jingkah khovah chan in akoi jun ahi. Jingkah'in changlhah hochu ima ati tapon than jong chu louvin hoitah'in ana um'e.
English: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it.

tcz: Mose'n aseijin, “Hiche changlhah hi tunin neuvin, ajeh chu tunikho hi Pakaiya dia Sabbath ahi. Ajeh chu tol lhamma chang lhah umlou ding ahiye,” ati.
en: Moses said, “Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to the LORD. Today you shall not find it in the field.
text:
EXO 16:25
Thadou: Mose'n aseijin, “Hiche changlhah hi tunin neuvin, ajeh chu tunikho hi Pakaiya dia Sabbath ahi. Ajeh chu tol lhamma chang lhah umlou ding ahiye,” ati.
English: Moses said, “Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to the LORD. Today you shall not find it in the field.

tcz: Nigup sung'a changlhah na kilo cheh diu, ni sagi niteng nalo thei lou ding'u ahiye,” ati.
en: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none.”
text:
EXO 16:26
Thadou: Nigup sung'a changlhah na kilo cheh diu, ni sagi niteng nalo thei lou ding'u ahiye,” ati.
English: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none.”

tcz: Kim khat chu Sabbath nikhon changlhah kilo din acheuvin, hinlah changlhah khat jeng cha jong amu tapouve.
en: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.
text:
EXO 16:27
Thadou: Kim khat chu Sabbath nikhon changlhah kilo din acheuvin, hinlah changlhah khat jeng cha jong amu tapouve.
English: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “hiche mite hin itih chan kathu peh apalkeh diu hitam?
en: The LORD said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?
text:
EXO 16:28
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “hiche mite hin itih chan kathu peh apalkeh diu hitam?
English: The LORD said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?

tcz: “Amahon ageldoh diu chu Sabbath nikho hi Pakaiya akon ahin Aman eipeh'u ahiye. Hijeh achu Pakajin nigup sung'in changlhah neh ding na peuvin, nigup lhinni man nini sung'a neh ding changlhah na peuve. Nalah uva koi hijong leu chun naum na cheh uva umthim beh jeng uvin lang,’ nisagi lhinni teng koima cha achenna munna konin pamlama potda jeng tahen,” ati.
en: Behold, because the LORD has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”
text:
EXO 16:29
Thadou: “Amahon ageldoh diu chu Sabbath nikho hi Pakaiya akon ahin Aman eipeh'u ahiye. Hijeh achu Pakajin nigup sung'in changlhah neh ding na peuvin, nigup lhinni man nini sung'a neh ding changlhah na peuve. Nalah uva koi hijong leu chun naum na cheh uva umthim beh jeng uvin lang,’ nisagi lhinni teng koima cha achenna munna konin pamlama potda jeng tahen,” ati.
English: Behold, because the LORD has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”

tcz: Nisagi lhin ni leh na boncha uvin ima ne louvin a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en: So the people rested on the seventh day.
text:
EXO 16:30
Thadou: Nisagi lhin ni leh na boncha uvin ima ne louvin a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
English: So the people rested on the seventh day.

tcz: Israel miten chang lhah chu Manna asah tauvin ahi. Hichu muchi mu tabang bang ahin, atwi dan jong khoiju ta bang ahiye.
en: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.
text:
EXO 16:31
Thadou: Israel miten chang lhah chu Manna asah tauvin ahi. Hichu muchi mu tabang bang ahin, atwi dan jong khoiju ta bang ahiye.
English: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.

tcz: Mose'n asei in, “Pakai thupeh chu hiche hi ahiye: “Nakhang lhumkei uva umjing ding in Manna ki hamdoh cheh uvin, hichu nakhang lhumkei uva mite hon Egypt gamsung'a konna ka hinpui uva gammang thip lah'a Manna'a kahin vah nao ahidan ahetdoh thei ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”
text:
EXO 16:32
Thadou: Mose'n asei in, “Pakai thupeh chu hiche hi ahiye: “Nakhang lhumkei uva umjing ding in Manna ki hamdoh cheh uvin, hichu nakhang lhumkei uva mite hon Egypt gamsung'a konna ka hinpui uva gammang thip lah'a Manna'a kahin vah nao ahidan ahetdoh thei ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”

tcz: Mose'n jong Aaron heng'a aseijin, “Belneo khat latem'in asung'a chun Manna phabep khat khum'in. Hichu akhang akhang'a umjing dia Pakai ansung'a nagakoi ding ahi,” ati.
en: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept throughout your generations.”
text:
EXO 16:33
Thadou: Mose'n jong Aaron heng'a aseijin, “Belneo khat latem'in asung'a chun Manna phabep khat khum'in. Hichu akhang akhang'a umjing dia Pakai ansung'a nagakoi ding ahi,” ati.
English: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept throughout your generations.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'in Aaron in jong aboltan ahi. Pakai angsunga akhang akhang'a het tohsah'a pang ding'in kitepna thingkong maiya chun akoi tan ahi.
en: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
text:
EXO 16:34
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'in Aaron in jong aboltan ahi. Pakai angsunga akhang akhang'a het tohsah'a pang ding'in kitepna thingkong maiya chun akoi tan ahi.
English: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

tcz: Israel mite'n jong achenna diu mun ahin phah kahseo vin, kum somli sung sen Manna jeng ahin neuvin, Canaan gam ahung lhun kahse uva ding'in Manna jeng chu ahin ne tauvin ahi.
en: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.
text:
EXO 16:35
Thadou: Israel mite'n jong achenna diu mun ahin phah kahseo vin, kum somli sung sen Manna jeng ahin neuvin, Canaan gam ahung lhun kahse uva ding'in Manna jeng chu ahin ne tauvin ahi.
English: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.

tcz: Manna Omer dimkhat chu Ephah khatseh hopsomma hop khat toh aki bang in ahi.
en: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah.
text:
EXO 16:36
Thadou: Manna Omer dimkhat chu Ephah khatseh hopsomma hop khat toh aki bang in ahi.
English: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah.

tcz: Pakai thupeh bang in Israel chate abonchauvin Sin* gammang akon in akitol uvin mun khat akon munchom khat'a akitol leuvin ahi. Rephidem kiti mun'na ngahmun akisem'uvin hinlah hiche lai mun'na chun twidon ding aumta pon ahi.
en: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to the LORD’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.
text:
EXO 17:1
Thadou: Pakai thupeh bang in Israel chate abonchauvin Sin* gammang akon in akitol uvin mun khat akon munchom khat'a akitol leuvin ahi. Rephidem kiti mun'na ngahmun akisem'uvin hinlah hiche lai mun'na chun twidon ding aumta pon ahi.
English: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to the LORD’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.

tcz: Mipi jong Mose heng'a avel lin a phunchel kit tauvin, “Don ding twi neipe uvin,” ati tauve. Mose'n a donbut in ajah uva, “Ipi ding'a kei koma ki phin'a na hiuvem? Chule ipi ding'a nang hon Pakai na patep u ham?”
en: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test the LORD?”
text:
EXO 17:2
Thadou: Mipi jong Mose heng'a avel lin a phunchel kit tauvin, “Don ding twi neipe uvin,” ati tauve. Mose'n a donbut in ajah uva, “Ipi ding'a kei koma ki phin'a na hiuvem? Chule ipi ding'a nang hon Pakai na patep u ham?”
English: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test the LORD?”

tcz: Mipihon twi angaicha jing uvin Mose dounan thu aseijun akiphin gam tauvin, “Ipi ding'a Egypt gamsung'a kon'na nei hin puidoh mong mong'u hitam? Nangman keiho le, ka chate'u chule ka gan chate'u ka boncha uva dangchah'a thigam sah ding nei got uva hitam?” tin asei uve.
en: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”
text:
EXO 17:3
Thadou: Mipihon twi angaicha jing uvin Mose dounan thu aseijun akiphin gam tauvin, “Ipi ding'a Egypt gamsung'a kon'na nei hin puidoh mong mong'u hitam? Nangman keiho le, ka chate'u chule ka gan chate'u ka boncha uva dangchah'a thigam sah ding nei got uva hitam?” tin asei uve.
English: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”

tcz: Chuin Mose jong Pathen heng'a kap pum'in ataovin, “Hiche miteho ding'a ipi kabol ding hitam? Song'a selih ding eigo tauve,” ati.
en: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”
text:
EXO 17:4
Thadou: Chuin Mose jong Pathen heng'a kap pum'in ataovin, “Hiche miteho ding'a ipi kabol ding hitam? Song'a selih ding eigo tauve,” ati.
English: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”

tcz: “Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Mipiho ma'sang a konchun ki khen doh tem'in chule Nile vadung San najepna tenggol chu kichoiyin lang Israel upa ho phabep kipuijin.”
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.
text:
EXO 17:5
Thadou: “Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Mipiho ma'sang a konchun ki khen doh tem'in chule Nile vadung San najepna tenggol chu kichoiyin lang Israel upa ho phabep kipuijin.”
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.

tcz: “Keiman Sinai molsang* songpi chungvum'ma ka dinpi ding nahiye, chuteng songpi chu jep lechun twi hung kikho doh jeng ding, Israel miten adon thei diu ahitai,” ati.
en: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
text:
EXO 17:6
Thadou: “Keiman Sinai molsang* songpi chungvum'ma ka dinpi ding nahiye, chuteng songpi chu jep lechun twi hung kikho doh jeng ding, Israel miten adon thei diu ahitai,” ati.
English: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

tcz: Mose'n jong hiche mun chu Massah asah tan ahi (hichu ‘patepna’ tia kihe ahi) Chule Maribah (hichu ‘ki khoh doh’ tina ahi) ajeh chu Isreal mite Mose heng'a aphunchil uva, Pakai doumah jing asei doh uvin, “Na Pakaiyin keiho hikoma hi ei umpi mong uva hinam?” atiuvin ahi.
en: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD among us, or not?”
text:
EXO 17:7
Thadou: Mose'n jong hiche mun chu Massah asah tan ahi (hichu ‘patepna’ tia kihe ahi) Chule Maribah (hichu ‘ki khoh doh’ tina ahi) ajeh chu Isreal mite Mose heng'a aphunchil uva, Pakai doumah jing asei doh uvin, “Na Pakaiyin keiho hikoma hi ei umpi mong uva hinam?” atiuvin ahi.
English: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD among us, or not?”

tcz: Israel mite Rephidim mun aum jinglai yun, Amalek mite ahung kon uvin akisat petauve.
en: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
text:
EXO 17:8
Thadou: Israel mite Rephidim mun aum jinglai yun, Amalek mite ahung kon uvin akisat petauve.
English: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n jong Joshua heng'a thupeh aneiyin, “Amalek mite toh kisat ding pasal galsat ding phabep khat lheng doh tem'in. Jing nikho le keima gamlah molsang'a ka din ding hichea chu Pathen bantha hat ka dopsang'a ka pan ding ahi,” ati.
en: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”
text:
EXO 17:9
Thadou: Chuin Mose'n jong Joshua heng'a thupeh aneiyin, “Amalek mite toh kisat ding pasal galsat ding phabep khat lheng doh tem'in. Jing nikho le keima gamlah molsang'a ka din ding hichea chu Pathen bantha hat ka dopsang'a ka pan ding ahi,” ati.
English: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”

tcz: Mose thupeh bang'in, Joshua'n jong Galsat ding pasal phabep alheng doh tan Amalek mite chu gal akisat pi tauvin ahi. Chuin Mose, Aaron leh Hur amaho cheng chu gam lah molsang lam'a akal tou tauvin ahi.
en: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
text:
EXO 17:10
Thadou: Mose thupeh bang'in, Joshua'n jong Galsat ding pasal phabep alheng doh tan Amalek mite chu gal akisat pi tauvin ahi. Chuin Mose, Aaron leh Hur amaho cheng chu gam lah molsang lam'a akal tou tauvin ahi.
English: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

tcz: Mose'n akhut teni a dopsang chan in Israel mite ahat be cheh jiuvin, chule akhutteni akham teng le vang Amelek mite ahat jita uvin ahi.
en: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
text:
EXO 17:11
Thadou: Mose'n akhut teni a dopsang chan in Israel mite ahat be cheh jiuvin, chule akhutteni akham teng le vang Amelek mite ahat jita uvin ahi.
English: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

tcz: Mose khut teni chu ahung khaam tan ahile aman jong adomsang joutapon chuin Aaron le Hur'in jong akhut ngap nading'in song ahol le hontan, a khut teni chu song chung'a angam lhan toumun in nilhum keijin akhut chu chol lou helin a domsang thei tan ahiye.
en: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.
text:
EXO 17:12
Thadou: Mose khut teni chu ahung khaam tan ahile aman jong adomsang joutapon chuin Aaron le Hur'in jong akhut ngap nading'in song ahol le hontan, a khut teni chu song chung'a angam lhan toumun in nilhum keijin akhut chu chol lou helin a domsang thei tan ahiye.
English: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.

tcz: Ajonan Joshua le agalsat mihon Amelek mite chu ajoutaovin ahi.
en: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
text:
EXO 17:13
Thadou: Ajonan Joshua le agalsat mihon Amelek mite chu ajoutaovin ahi.
English: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

tcz: Gal ajo phat uvin, Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Het jing na ding'in lekhajol khat lanlang hiche gal kisat chung chang thuhi sunlut'in lang Joshua nabeng'a avella nasim peh tan: vannoiya Amalek kihetna kiti keiman kasuh mang hel ahitai,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”
text:
EXO 17:14
Thadou: Gal ajo phat uvin, Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Het jing na ding'in lekhajol khat lanlang hiche gal kisat chung chang thuhi sunlut'in lang Joshua nabeng'a avella nasim peh tan: vannoiya Amalek kihetna kiti keiman kasuh mang hel ahitai,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”

tcz: Mose'n jong hiche lai munna chun maicham asem in, “YAWEH-NISSI” (Pakai chu kaponlop ahi) tin asah tai.
en: Moses built an altar, and called its name “The LORD our Banner”.
text:
EXO 17:15
Thadou: Mose'n jong hiche lai munna chun maicham asem in, “YAWEH-NISSI” (Pakai chu kaponlop ahi) tin asah tai.
English: Moses built an altar, and called its name “The LORD our Banner”.

tcz: Aman aseijin, “Amalek mite'n Pakai doumah'a chon masao ahin, tunvang! Pakaiyin imatih channa Amalek mite akidou peding ahitai,” ati.
en: He said, “The LORD has sworn: ‘The LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”
text:
EXO 17:16
Thadou: Aman aseijin, “Amalek mite'n Pakai doumah'a chon masao ahin, tunvang! Pakaiyin imatih channa Amalek mite akidou peding ahitai,” ati.
English: He said, “The LORD has sworn: ‘The LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”

tcz: Mose ding'a anupa pa, Jethro Midian thempupa'n Mose le asopi Israel mite chung'a Pakai natoh thil kidang abolho ajadoh tai. Amapan jong Pakaiyin Israel mite Egypt gam'ma kon'na ahin lhatdoh chu ki dang asaval jeng'in ahi.
en: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.
text:
EXO 18:1
Thadou: Mose ding'a anupa pa, Jethro Midian thempupa'n Mose le asopi Israel mite chung'a Pakai natoh thil kidang abolho ajadoh tai. Amapan jong Pakaiyin Israel mite Egypt gam'ma kon'na ahin lhatdoh chu ki dang asaval jeng'in ahi.
English: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.

tcz: Mose'n jong anupa pa, Jethro heng'a ajinu Zipporah le achapateni chu asol'in, chuin amahon insung'a apuilut uvin ahi.
en: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,
text:
EXO 18:2
Thadou: Mose'n jong anupa pa, Jethro heng'a ajinu Zipporah le achapateni chu asol'in, chuin amahon insung'a apuilut uvin ahi.
English: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,

tcz: Mose chapa pengmasa min chu Gershom ahin*, achapa apen lhah chun Mose'n hiti hin aseiye. “Mi gamsung'a khosa kahi,” tia ana minsah chu ahi.
en: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.
text:
EXO 18:3
Thadou: Mose chapa pengmasa min chu Gershom ahin*, achapa apen lhah chun Mose'n hiti hin aseiye. “Mi gamsung'a khosa kahi,” tia ana minsah chu ahi.
English: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.

tcz: Ani channa achapa min chu Eliezer* asah in, Mose'n hiti hin aseije, “Keima khangluiya pat ka Pathen chun Pharaoh chemjam akon eihuh hing ahi,” tia asah ahi.
en: The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”
text:
EXO 18:4
Thadou: Ani channa achapa min chu Eliezer* asah in, Mose'n hiti hin aseije, “Keima khangluiya pat ka Pathen chun Pharaoh chemjam akon eihuh hing ahi,” tia asah ahi.
English: The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”

tcz: Mose nupa pa, Jethro chu Mose vil lin gammang lam'a ahung tan ahile. Aman ajinu le achapa teni chu ahin puijin, Mose le amiten gamthip lah Pathen molsang kom'a ngahmun akisem nau mun'na ahinpha taovin ahi.
en: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.
text:
EXO 18:5
Thadou: Mose nupa pa, Jethro chu Mose vil lin gammang lam'a ahung tan ahile. Aman ajinu le achapa teni chu ahin puijin, Mose le amiten gamthip lah Pathen molsang kom'a ngahmun akisem nau mun'na ahinpha taovin ahi.
English: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.

tcz: Jethro'in jong Mose chu thu athot tan, “Keima Jethro nanupa pa kahin, keima nangma vil'a najinu le na chapa teni jaona hung kahi,” ati.
en: He said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.”
text:
EXO 18:6
Thadou: Jethro'in jong Mose chu thu athot tan, “Keima Jethro nanupa pa kahin, keima nangma vil'a najinu le na chapa teni jaona hung kahi,” ati.
English: He said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.”

tcz: Mose jong pamlam'a agache doh'in anupa pachu agakimu pitai. Amajong akum lhan abeng achop peh tan ahi. Hiti chun khat le khat akilem touvin Mose chen'na ponbuh sung'a alut taovin ahi.
en: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed and kissed him. They asked each other of their welfare, and they came into the tent.
text:
EXO 18:7
Thadou: Mose jong pamlam'a agache doh'in anupa pachu agakimu pitai. Amajong akum lhan abeng achop peh tan ahi. Hiti chun khat le khat akilem touvin Mose chen'na ponbuh sung'a alut taovin ahi.
English: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed and kissed him. They asked each other of their welfare, and they came into the tent.

tcz: Mose'n jong anupa pa heng'a Pakaiyin ichangeiya Egypt gam'a konna Israel mite chung'a na-ahintoh ham ti thudol'a aseipeh'in ahi.Chule lamkah jouse'a thohgim hahsa athoh nau le agenthei najouseo abonchan anupa pa heng'a asei peh in ahi.
