en: Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how the LORD delivered them.
text:
EXO 18:8
Thadou: Mose'n jong anupa pa heng'a Pakaiyin ichangeiya Egypt gam'a konna Israel mite chung'a na-ahintoh ham ti thudol'a aseipeh'in ahi.Chule lamkah jouse'a thohgim hahsa athoh nau le agenthei najouseo abonchan anupa pa heng'a asei peh in ahi.
English: Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how the LORD delivered them.

tcz: Pakaiyin Israelte ichangeiya Egypt mite khut'a kon ahin panpi hitam tithu le ahin huhdohna thudol phatah'a ahet chet phat'in alungthim akipah lheh jeng in ahi.
en: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.
text:
EXO 18:9
Thadou: Pakaiyin Israelte ichangeiya Egypt mite khut'a kon ahin panpi hitam tithu le ahin huhdohna thudol phatah'a ahet chet phat'in alungthim akipah lheh jeng in ahi.
English: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.

tcz: Jethro'n hiti hin aseiye, “Pathen thangvah in umhen.” “Ajeh chu Aman Pharaoh le Egypt mite akona nahin huhdoh jal in. Henge, Pakai bou chu ahiye Egypt mite thanei na konna na huh doh uva! ati.”
en: Jethro said, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
text:
EXO 18:10
Thadou: Jethro'n hiti hin aseiye, “Pathen thangvah in umhen.” “Ajeh chu Aman Pharaoh le Egypt mite akona nahin huhdoh jal in. Henge, Pakai bou chu ahiye Egypt mite thanei na konna na huh doh uva! ati.”
English: Jethro said, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

tcz: “Tun keiman ka hechen sel taije, Pakai hi pakai jouse lah a thanei chung nungpen Pakai ahiye. Ajeh chu Aman aban thahat apan'in Egypt mite akiletsah nauva kon'na ahin huhdoh ahi,” ati.
en: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”
text:
EXO 18:11
Thadou: “Tun keiman ka hechen sel taije, Pakai hi pakai jouse lah a thanei chung nungpen Pakai ahiye. Ajeh chu Aman aban thahat apan'in Egypt mite akiletsah nauva kon'na ahin huhdoh ahi,” ati.
English: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”

tcz: Chuin Jethro amachu Mose ding'a anupa pan jong Pathen angsung'a pumgo thilto kilhaina asem in ahi. Aaron le Israel sung'a upa ho ahung uvin Pathen angsung'a kilhaina ankong chu asoh khom uve.
en: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.
text:
EXO 18:12
Thadou: Chuin Jethro amachu Mose ding'a anupa pan jong Pathen angsung'a pumgo thilto kilhaina asem in ahi. Aaron le Israel sung'a upa ho ahung uvin Pathen angsung'a kilhaina ankong chu asoh khom uve.
English: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.

tcz: Ajing nikhon Mose'n jong atouna a kon'nin mipiho thutan ding'in ahung doh tan ahile, mipiho jong chu nilhum keijin ading tauve.
en: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.
text:
EXO 18:13
Thadou: Ajing nikhon Mose'n jong atouna a kon'nin mipiho thutan ding'in ahung doh tan ahile, mipiho jong chu nilhum keijin ading tauve.
English: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.

tcz: Mose nupa pan, hitia mipiho chung'a athilbol amudoh phat'in aman Mose heng'a aseijin, “Hiche laimunna hi ipi mong mong tongdoh inge nati ham? Ipi bol mong inge natia jingkah'a kipat nilhah lamchangeiya mipiho hi nahiti din sah hitam?” ati.
en: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”
text:
EXO 18:14
Thadou: Mose nupa pan, hitia mipiho chung'a athilbol amudoh phat'in aman Mose heng'a aseijin, “Hiche laimunna hi ipi mong mong tongdoh inge nati ham? Ipi bol mong inge natia jingkah'a kipat nilhah lamchangeiya mipiho hi nahiti din sah hitam?” ati.
English: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”

tcz: Mose'n adonbut'in ajah'a, “Ajeh chu mipiho hi kaheng'a hung uva Pathen akon kavai hopna hi akilah mang kigot uva ahi.”
en: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.
text:
EXO 18:15
Thadou: Mose'n adonbut'in ajah'a, “Ajeh chu mipiho hi kaheng'a hung uva Pathen akon kavai hopna hi akilah mang kigot uva ahi.”
English: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

tcz: “Amaho hi ahung kinah komu le kaheng ahin jonlut jiuvin, chuteng keiman thu katan peh jiuvin, Pathen akon nun leh khan dan toh kitoh'a Pathen phatsah bang'a ka hilchen jiuva ahiye,” ati.
en: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”
text:
EXO 18:16
Thadou: “Amaho hi ahung kinah komu le kaheng ahin jonlut jiuvin, chuteng keiman thu katan peh jiuvin, Pathen akon nun leh khan dan toh kitoh'a Pathen phatsah bang'a ka hilchen jiuva ahiye,” ati.
English: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”

tcz: Chuin Mose nupa pan ajah aseiyin, “na thilbol hi adih poije!” ati.
en: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.
text:
EXO 18:17
Thadou: Chuin Mose nupa pan ajah aseiyin, “na thilbol hi adih poije!” ati.
English: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.

tcz: “Mipi ahin nangma nahin na bon'uva na gimna diuva ahi bouve ajeh chu nathilbol hi abeipon ahi. Nangma changseh adin thi lhah satah khat ahiye,” ati.
en: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.
text:
EXO 18:18
Thadou: “Mipi ahin nangma nahin na bon'uva na gimna diuva ahi bouve ajeh chu nathilbol hi abeipon ahi. Nangma changseh adin thi lhah satah khat ahiye,” ati.
English: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.

tcz: “Tun keiman kahil nahiye, ajeh chu keiman kultah'a kahil nahi ngaijin lang Pathen'in naum pijing hen. Mipiho jouse khella hi Pathen ansung'a ding jing nahin, akibaotam nao jouse Pathen angsung'a na selhah ding ahijoi,” ati.
en: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.
text:
EXO 18:19
Thadou: “Tun keiman kahil nahiye, ajeh chu keiman kultah'a kahil nahi ngaijin lang Pathen'in naum pijing hen. Mipiho jouse khella hi Pathen ansung'a ding jing nahin, akibaotam nao jouse Pathen angsung'a na selhah ding ahijoi,” ati.
English: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.

tcz: “Mipiho hi Pathen akon chonna Danho le phatsahna ho hilchen in lang,hichu aboltei na diuva na thumop'a chule ajui cheh na diuva jong nasei ngaija ahi.”
en: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.
text:
EXO 18:20
Thadou: “Mipiho hi Pathen akon chonna Danho le phatsahna ho hilchen in lang,hichu aboltei na diuva na thumop'a chule ajui cheh na diuva jong nasei ngaija ahi.”
English: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

tcz: “Ahinlah mipiho lah akonna thilbol thei miman tam, Pathen ging, nehguh chah guh beija natong thei ding nalhen doh ding ahi. Amaho chun mijakhat lah hihen sangkhat lah hihen jakhat lah hijong le aloi loija vaihomma na pansah ding ahiye.”
en: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
text:
EXO 18:21
Thadou: “Ahinlah mipiho lah akonna thilbol thei miman tam, Pathen ging, nehguh chah guh beija natong thei ding nalhen doh ding ahi. Amaho chun mijakhat lah hihen sangkhat lah hihen jakhat lah hijong le aloi loija vaihomma na pansah ding ahiye.”
English: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

tcz: “Phat tinna mipi thutanna napan sah diu, thupi diuva thutanna ding aumvang le nangma heng'a hinpuiyun tin, thuneo hojouse vang chu amahon ama chamma atan lhah jeng theiju ahi. Nangma dia jong agom lam hijo ding chule amahon jong nangma nahin kithopi nau jong ahi,” ati.
en: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.
text:
EXO 18:22
Thadou: “Phat tinna mipi thutanna napan sah diu, thupi diuva thutanna ding aumvang le nangma heng'a hinpuiyun tin, thuneo hojouse vang chu amahon ama chamma atan lhah jeng theiju ahi. Nangma dia jong agom lam hijo ding chule amahon jong nangma nahin kithopi nau jong ahi,” ati.
English: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.

tcz: “Hichengse hi na jui'a ahile, nangma chunga Pathen in tohding nahin peh teng doujou'na tha naneijoh ding chule mipihon jong lungmoung sella ama ama in cheh akile jut thei diu ahi.”
en: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”
text:
EXO 18:23
Thadou: “Hichengse hi na jui'a ahile, nangma chunga Pathen in tohding nahin peh teng doujou'na tha naneijoh ding chule mipihon jong lungmoung sella ama ama in cheh akile jut thei diu ahi.”
English: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”

tcz: Mose'n jong anupa pa Jethro thusei chu angaijin, aman aseibang bang'in aboltan ahile apha lheh jeng tai.
en: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.
text:
EXO 18:24
Thadou: Mose'n jong anupa pa Jethro thusei chu angaijin, aman aseibang bang'in aboltan ahile apha lheh jeng tai.
English: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.

tcz: Israel mite lah akonin thilbol thei miman tam cheh alheng doh tan. Amaho chengse chu Israel mite lah'a lamkaija pang ding hichu mi sangkhat, jakhat chung'a vaihomin apan sah soh kei uve.
en: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
text:
EXO 18:25
Thadou: Israel mite lah akonin thilbol thei miman tam cheh alheng doh tan. Amaho chengse chu Israel mite lah'a lamkaija pang ding hichu mi sangkhat, jakhat chung'a vaihomin apan sah soh kei uve.
English: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

tcz: Amaho chun kiphunna le baotam na nei ho chu Mose heng'a ahin lhut lut jiuvin ahi. Thuneo boina hovang chu amahon acham'un a sulham jiuvin ahi,
en: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
text:
EXO 18:26
Thadou: Amaho chun kiphunna le baotam na nei ho chu Mose heng'a ahin lhut lut jiuvin ahi. Thuneo boina hovang chu amahon acham'un a sulham jiuvin ahi,
English: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

tcz: Hicheho jouse nung hin, Mose'n anupa pa asol in, anupa pa Jethro in jong alam pi ahung'na mama chu ahoh in akile tan ahi.
en: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.
text:
EXO 18:27
Thadou: Hicheho jouse nung hin, Mose'n anupa pa asol in, anupa pa Jethro in jong alam pi ahung'na mama chu ahoh in akile tan ahi.
English: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.

tcz: Israel miten Egypt gamsung* ahin dalhah kalseo lhani lhin'in Sinai mun gamthip ahung lhung atovin ahi.
en: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
text:
EXO 19:1
Thadou: Israel miten Egypt gamsung* ahin dalhah kalseo lhani lhin'in Sinai mun gamthip ahung lhung atovin ahi.
English: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.

tcz: Rephidim ngahmun ahin sukeh un ahin dalha tauvin, chuin Sinai mun'na ngahmun a kisem uvin hichu Sinai ngahmun tin aminsah uve.
en: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.
text:
EXO 19:2
Thadou: Rephidim ngahmun ahin sukeh un ahin dalha tauvin, chuin Sinai mun'na ngahmun a kisem uvin hichu Sinai ngahmun tin aminsah uve.
English: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.

tcz: Mose molchung lam akaltou tan Pakai toh agakimu ton ahile, Pakaiyin molchung'a kon'in ahin kouvin aseije, “Thupeh hicheng hi; Jacob insung le Israel mite heng'a seipeh tauvin:
en: Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:
text:
EXO 19:3
Thadou: Mose molchung lam akaltou tan Pakai toh agakimu ton ahile, Pakaiyin molchung'a kon'in ahin kouvin aseije, “Thupeh hicheng hi; Jacob insung le Israel mite heng'a seipeh tauvin:
English: Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:

tcz: “Egypt mite chung'a ipiti lamdolla na katoh, nang hon na musoh kei uve. Keiman nangho muvan lai lhaving'a ka hin pui uve ti namu chenset tauvin ahi.”
en: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.
text:
EXO 19:4
Thadou: “Egypt mite chung'a ipiti lamdolla na katoh, nang hon na musoh kei uve. Keiman nangho muvan lai lhaving'a ka hin pui uve ti namu chenset tauvin ahi.”
English: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.

tcz: Chule tua hi kathu nangai uva kakitepna nakoi jing uva ahileh, nangho hi vannoi mite jouse lah'a keima dia atumbeh'a naum diu; ajeh chu vannoi leiset pumpi hi keima'a ahi.”
en: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;

tcz: “Chule keima lenggam machu nangho naleng chan diu, kagam theng nalo ding'u ahi. Hiche thuhi nangman Israel mite heng'a naseipeh teiding ahi,” ati.
en: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”
text:
EXO 19:6
Thadou: “Chule keima lenggam machu nangho naleng chan diu, kagam theng nalo ding'u ahi. Hiche thuhi nangman Israel mite heng'a naseipeh teiding ahi,” ati.
English: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”

tcz: Chuin Mose molchung akon'in akumsuh'in Israel sung'a upa ho akou khom'in Pakaiyin a thupeh chengse abonchan a seipeh soh kei uve.
en: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which the LORD commanded him.
text:
EXO 19:7
Thadou: Chuin Mose molchung akon'in akumsuh'in Israel sung'a upa ho akou khom'in Pakaiyin a thupeh chengse abonchan a seipeh soh kei uve.
English: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which the LORD commanded him.

tcz: Chuin amahon adonbut cheh uvin, “Ijakai Pakai thupeh bang'a keihon kabol diu ahi,” atiuve.
en: All the people answered together, and said, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do.” Moses reported the words of the people to the LORD.
text:
EXO 19:8
Thadou: Chuin amahon adonbut cheh uvin, “Ijakai Pakai thupeh bang'a keihon kabol diu ahi,” atiuve.
English: All the people answered together, and said, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do.” Moses reported the words of the people to the LORD.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Keima naheng'a meilhang kiheh bang'a kahung ding, Nangma Mose kahin houpi teng Israel miten ajah cheh diu, chuteng amahon jong nangma nahin tahsan jing diu ahitai,” ati. Mose'n jong Israel miten adonbut'na chu Pakai heng'a aseijin ahi.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to the LORD.
text:
EXO 19:9
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Keima naheng'a meilhang kiheh bang'a kahung ding, Nangma Mose kahin houpi teng Israel miten ajah cheh diu, chuteng amahon jong nangma nahin tahsan jing diu ahitai,” ati. Mose'n jong Israel miten adonbut'na chu Pakai heng'a aseijin ahi.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to the LORD.

tcz: Chuin Pakajin Mose heng'a asei in, “Kumsuh inlang keima kahung nading'in Israel mite gongtup tan, tuni le jing nikhoa din seipeh uvin chule avon jeng u-jong kisop theng cheh u-hen,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,
text:
EXO 19:10
Thadou: Chuin Pakajin Mose heng'a asei in, “Kumsuh inlang keima kahung nading'in Israel mite gongtup tan, tuni le jing nikhoa din seipeh uvin chule avon jeng u-jong kisop theng cheh u-hen,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,

tcz: “Nithum lhin'nia ding'in kigontup sah soh kei uvin, nithum lhin niteng a mitmu tah uva Pakai chu Sinai Mol chung'a pat hung kumlha ding ahi tipeh'un,” ati.
en: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.
text:
EXO 19:11
Thadou: “Nithum lhin'nia ding'in kigontup sah soh kei uvin, nithum lhin niteng a mitmu tah uva Pakai chu Sinai Mol chung'a pat hung kumlha ding ahi tipeh'un,” ati.
English: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.

tcz: “Mipiho abonchauvin akimvel'uva melchih'na sempeh'in lang, seijin, kichih thei un! Koima molchung lam'a kaldoh hih hel'un chule akim vellah jeng jong koiman natham khah theilou diunahi. Koi hile molchung tham khachan chu thi jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.
text:
EXO 19:12
Thadou: “Mipiho abonchauvin akimvel'uva melchih'na sempeh'in lang, seijin, kichih thei un! Koima molchung lam'a kaldoh hih hel'un chule akim vellah jeng jong koiman natham khah theilou diunahi. Koi hile molchung tham khachan chu thi jeng ding ahi,” ati.
English: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.

tcz: “Melchihna pal kallhah khut kiti phot'in atohkhah'a ahile, hichejeh'a chu; song'a selih jeng ding, ahilou jong le, thalpi'a kap lih ding gancha hihen mihem hile hitabang'a chonchu ahing'a kiumsah ngailou ding ahi, tin seipeh un. Sumkon ahung kimut gin apat mipi jong molchung lam'a hung kitol diu ahiye.”
en: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”
text:
EXO 19:13
Thadou: “Melchihna pal kallhah khut kiti phot'in atohkhah'a ahile, hichejeh'a chu; song'a selih jeng ding, ahilou jong le, thalpi'a kap lih ding gancha hihen mihem hile hitabang'a chonchu ahing'a kiumsah ngailou ding ahi, tin seipeh un. Sumkon ahung kimut gin apat mipi jong molchung lam'a hung kitol diu ahiye.”
English: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”

tcz: Mose'n jong mipi lam chu ahin jonsuh tan. Aman mipi thenso'na anei jin, mipihon jong ama ama von cheh akisop theng uvin ahi.
en: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
text:
EXO 19:14
Thadou: Mose'n jong mipi lam chu ahin jonsuh tan. Aman mipi thenso'na anei jin, mipihon jong ama ama von cheh akisop theng uvin ahi.
English: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

tcz: Aman mipi heng'a asei jin, Nithum lhin nia ding in ki gotup cheh uvin chule numei angsung ki tiajong na lut louhel ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”
text:
EXO 19:15
Thadou: Aman mipi heng'a asei jin, Nithum lhin nia ding in ki gotup cheh uvin chule numei angsung ki tiajong na lut louhel ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”

tcz: Nithum lhin'ni jingkah khovah lam'in vahthamjol aki thing'in kolphe avah in, molchung vum chu meilhang'in atom lha jeng tan ahi. Sumkon hatah'in ahung ging tan ahile, ngahmun sung lam'a um mipi abonchauvin akicha lheh jeng tauve.
en: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.
text:
EXO 19:16
Thadou: Nithum lhin'ni jingkah khovah lam'in vahthamjol aki thing'in kolphe avah in, molchung vum chu meilhang'in atom lha jeng tan ahi. Sumkon hatah'in ahung ging tan ahile, ngahmun sung lam'a um mipi abonchauvin akicha lheh jeng tauve.
English: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.

tcz: Mose'n jong mipi abonchan Pathen toh kimaito ding'in ahin pui uvin, chuin mipi abonchauvin molchung kipatna lam'a chun adding den gam tauve.
en: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.
text:
EXO 19:17
Thadou: Mose'n jong mipi abonchan Pathen toh kimaito ding'in ahin pui uvin, chuin mipi abonchauvin molchung kipatna lam'a chun adding den gam tauve.
English: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.

tcz: Sinai molchung akon in Pakai chu meikong'in ahung kum lhan ahile, lhum sung'a kon'na meikhu bang'in ahung khudoh'in ahintomlha jeng tan, ling jong akihot lha jeng'in ahi.
en: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because the LORD descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.
text:
EXO 19:18
Thadou: Sinai molchung akon in Pakai chu meikong'in ahung kum lhan ahile, lhum sung'a kon'na meikhu bang'in ahung khudoh'in ahintomlha jeng tan, ling jong akihot lha jeng'in ahi.
English: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because the LORD descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.

tcz: Sumkon gin chu ahat cheh cheh jeng tan ahile, Mose jong akipat'in hiti hin aseije, van gin kithong lah akon'in Pathen'in ahin houpin ahi.
en: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.
text:
EXO 19:19
Thadou: Sumkon gin chu ahat cheh cheh jeng tan ahile, Mose jong akipat'in hiti hin aseije, van gin kithong lah akon'in Pathen'in ahin houpin ahi.
English: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

tcz: Pakai chu Sinai molchung vum'a kon'in ahung kumsuh tan chuin, Molchung vum'a kon'in Pakaiyin Mose ahin kouvin ahi. Mose jong akipatdoh'in molchung lam'a chun akal touvin ahi.
en: The LORD came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. The LORD called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
text:
EXO 19:20
Thadou: Pakai chu Sinai molchung vum'a kon'in ahung kumsuh tan chuin, Molchung vum'a kon'in Pakaiyin Mose ahin kouvin ahi. Mose jong akipatdoh'in molchung lam'a chun akal touvin ahi.
English: The LORD came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. The LORD called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei in, “Kumsuh inlang mipi heng'a seipeh loijin, ajeh chu Pakai ahinmu nomuva pal kigen khu ahin tumlhah ngai uva ahile thigam bep ding'u ahiye,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
text:
EXO 19:21
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei in, “Kumsuh inlang mipi heng'a seipeh loijin, ajeh chu Pakai ahinmu nomuva pal kigen khu ahin tumlhah ngai uva ahile thigam bep ding'u ahiye,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.

tcz: Chule thempu ho jeng jong atahsao amacheh kithenso uva eihin nailut thei diu bou ahi. Chutile Pakaiyin amaho lam pal chu atumkeh lou ding ahi, ati.
en: Let the priests also, who come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break out on them.”
text:
EXO 19:22
Thadou: Chule thempu ho jeng jong atahsao amacheh kithenso uva eihin nailut thei diu bou ahi. Chutile Pakaiyin amaho lam pal chu atumkeh lou ding ahi, ati.
English: Let the priests also, who come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break out on them.”

tcz: Mose'n jong Pakai heng'a aseijin, ahinlah Pakai in, mipi abonchauva Sinai molchung'a hung kal theilou diu ahi. Ajeh chu nangma thupeh bang'a molchung kimvella pal gen uvin, tia nei thupeh sa'u ahiye, ati.
en: Moses said to the LORD, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”
text:
EXO 19:23
Thadou: Mose'n jong Pakai heng'a aseijin, ahinlah Pakai in, mipi abonchauva Sinai molchung'a hung kal theilou diu ahi. Ajeh chu nangma thupeh bang'a molchung kimvella pal gen uvin, tia nei thupeh sa'u ahiye, ati.
English: Moses said to the LORD, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”

tcz: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin. “Chesuh inlang Aaron gakipuiyin lang hinki lhon pitan. Amavang mipi abonchauvin thupeh neijin lang khat cha jeng jong paltum keh'a Pakai lam'a hung theilou ding'u ahiye,” ati.
en: The LORD said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to the LORD, lest he break out against them.”
text:
EXO 19:24
Thadou: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseiyin. “Chesuh inlang Aaron gakipuiyin lang hinki lhon pitan. Amavang mipi abonchauvin thupeh neijin lang khat cha jeng jong paltum keh'a Pakai lam'a hung theilou ding'u ahiye,” ati.
English: The LORD said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to the LORD, lest he break out against them.”

tcz: Pakajin athupeh bang in Mose achesuh in mipi ho heng'a aga seipeh soh kei uve.
en: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.
text:
EXO 19:25
Thadou: Pakajin athupeh bang in Mose achesuh in mipi ho heng'a aga seipeh soh kei uve.
English: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin mipi heng'a thupeh hichengse hi anei in.
en: God spoke all these words, saying,
text:
EXO 20:1
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin mipi heng'a thupeh hichengse hi anei in.
English: God spoke all these words, saying,

tcz: Keima na-Pakai u-leh na-Pathen chu kahi, Egypt gamsung'a nasoh chan nauva konna nalhatdoh pau chu keima kahi,” ati.
en: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
text:
EXO 20:2
Thadou: Keima na-Pakai u-leh na-Pathen chu kahi, Egypt gamsung'a nasoh chan nauva konna nalhatdoh pau chu keima kahi,” ati.
English: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

tcz: “Keima tailou Pathen dang nanei louhel diu ahi.”
en: “You shall have no other gods before me.
text:
EXO 20:3
Thadou: “Keima tailou Pathen dang nanei louhel diu ahi.”
English: “You shall have no other gods before me.

tcz: “Nang hon vannoi leiset hihen twikhanglen'a um thil hijong leh alim na semthu uva pathen lim'a naman theilou ding'u ahi.”
en: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
text:
EXO 20:4
Thadou: “Nang hon vannoi leiset hihen twikhanglen'a um thil hijong leh alim na semthu uva pathen lim'a naman theilou ding'u ahi.”
English: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

tcz: “Hicheng ho ang sung'a chu naboh khup louhel diu, ajeh chu keima, na-Pakaiyu-leh na-Pathen-u kahin pathen dang na kisem uva ahileh, keiman nangho heng'a ka lethuh diu napu na pate'u le nangma insung cheh chule a khang thumle li na channa lethuh ding kahi,” ati.
en: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,
text:
EXO 20:5
Thadou: “Hicheng ho ang sung'a chu naboh khup louhel diu, ajeh chu keima, na-Pakaiyu-leh na-Pathen-u kahin pathen dang na kisem uva ahileh, keiman nangho heng'a ka lethuh diu napu na pate'u le nangma insung cheh chule a khang thumle li na channa lethuh ding kahi,” ati.
English: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

tcz: “Keima thupeh nit jinga, eingailu mi chu asang aja chung'a kalungset nalong lou chu ka umsah jing ding ahiye,” ati.
en: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
text:
EXO 20:6
Thadou: “Keima thupeh nit jinga, eingailu mi chu asang aja chung'a kalungset nalong lou chu ka umsah jing ding ahiye,” ati.
English: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

tcz: “Nangman Na-Pakai le Na-Pathen min jeng jong ajehbeija namin phah lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin Ama min ajehbeija minphah chung'a themmo achansah ding ahi.”
en: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God, for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
text:
EXO 20:7
Thadou: “Nangman Na-Pakai le Na-Pathen min jeng jong ajehbeija namin phah lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin Ama min ajehbeija minphah chung'a themmo achansah ding ahi.”
English: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God, for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

tcz: “Cholngah nikho hi atheng'a nanit jing ding ahiti, sumil hih hel'in.”
en: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
text:
EXO 20:8
Thadou: “Cholngah nikho hi atheng'a nanit jing ding ahiti, sumil hih hel'in.”
English: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

tcz: “Natoh ding cheng nigup sungse'a natoh chai ding,
en: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,
text:
EXO 20:9
Thadou: “Natoh ding cheng nigup sungse'a natoh chai ding,
English: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,

tcz: Ni sagi lhinni hi na-Pakaiya dia cholngah nikho, hiche nikhoa hi nangman natoh ima nabol louhel ding chule nangma nahin, nachapa, nachanu, na sohpa, na sohnu, na gancha jouse le na kelkot phung hungsung lha'a na kholjin mi naboncha uva ima natoh thei lou hel diuva ahiye.”
en: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;

tcz: “Ajeh chu Pakaiyin nigup sungsen van le leiset, twikhanglen le asung'a umjouse ana sem in; hiche nikhoa chu Pakaiyin cholngah nikho hi phatthei aboh'a ana lhandohsa ahi tai,” ati.
en: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.
text:
EXO 20:11
Thadou: “Ajeh chu Pakaiyin nigup sungsen van le leiset, twikhanglen le asung'a umjouse ana sem in; hiche nikhoa chu Pakaiyin cholngah nikho hi phatthei aboh'a ana lhandohsa ahi tai,” ati.
English: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.

tcz: “Chule Pakai na-Pathen in napehsa hiche leiset chunga na hinkho asot thei na ding in nanu napa ging jing in.”
en: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
text:
EXO 20:12
Thadou: “Chule Pakai na-Pathen in napehsa hiche leiset chunga na hinkho asot thei na ding in nanu napa ging jing in.”
English: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

tcz: “Toltha nabol lou ding ahi.”
en: “You shall not murder.
text:
EXO 20:13
Thadou: “Toltha nabol lou ding ahi.”
English: “You shall not murder.

tcz: “Mitoh jon nabol lou ding.”
en: “You shall not commit adultery.
text:
EXO 20:14
Thadou: “Mitoh jon nabol lou ding.”
English: “You shall not commit adultery.

tcz: “Guchat nabol lou ding.”
en: “You shall not steal.
text:
EXO 20:15
Thadou: “Guchat nabol lou ding.”
English: “You shall not steal.

tcz: “Na sopi muda man'na thuse pole a napan lou ding.”
en: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
text:
EXO 20:16
Thadou: “Na sopi muda man'na thuse pole a napan lou ding.”
English: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

tcz: “Na kinaipi khat inchen chu na thangsetpi lou ding ahi. Na sopi ji khat chu na deichat lou ding, chule asohpa ahin, asohnu ahin abong chal ahin, asangan hijong le na sopi chule na kinaipi koma thil ima navet lal lou hel ding ahi,” ati.
en: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”
text:
EXO 20:17
Thadou: “Na kinaipi khat inchen chu na thangsetpi lou ding ahi. Na sopi ji khat chu na deichat lou ding, chule asohpa ahin, asohnu ahin abong chal ahin, asangan hijong le na sopi chule na kinaipi koma thil ima navet lal lou hel ding ahi,” ati.
English: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”

tcz: Mipihon van gin nasa tah chu aja tauvin, kolphe jeng jong amu tauvin, sumkon gin jing jong athong jeju jeng tan, molchung lam'a kon meikhu amukit tauvin ahile amaho chung'a kichatna alhung ta, chuin amahon anailut ngam tapouvin ahile gamlha tah'in aum den tauve.
en: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.
text:
EXO 20:18
Thadou: Mipihon van gin nasa tah chu aja tauvin, kolphe jeng jong amu tauvin, sumkon gin jing jong athong jeju jeng tan, molchung lam'a kon meikhu amukit tauvin ahile amaho chung'a kichatna alhung ta, chuin amahon anailut ngam tapouvin ahile gamlha tah'in aum den tauve.
English: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.

tcz: “Chu in mipihon jong Mose heng'a asei tauvin, ‘Sei ding a na deisah chan keima ho heng'a seijeng tan, na sei kangai diu ahiye, ajeh chu Pathen in keiho heng'a thu seikha taleh mohseh'a ka thi gam lhah jeng ding'u ahi!”
en: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”
text:
EXO 20:19
Thadou: “Chu in mipihon jong Mose heng'a asei tauvin, ‘Sei ding a na deisah chan keima ho heng'a seijeng tan, na sei kangai diu ahiye, ajeh chu Pathen in keiho heng'a thu seikha taleh mohseh'a ka thi gam lhah jeng ding'u ahi!”
English: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”

tcz: “Mose'n a donbut uvin hiti hin aseiye, “Kicha hih un,” Pathen na gin diu chule na chonset thei lou na diuva, nangho sudet ding'a Pathen hung'a ahi joi!” ati.
en: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”
text:
EXO 20:20
Thadou: “Mose'n a donbut uvin hiti hin aseiye, “Kicha hih un,” Pathen na gin diu chule na chonset thei lou na diuva, nangho sudet ding'a Pathen hung'a ahi joi!” ati.
English: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”

tcz: “Meilhang kiheh muthim'in atom nalah Pathen angsung'a chun Mose ache lut tan ahile, mipi jong chu akicha uvin gamlha thimma chun ading densoh kei tauve.”
en: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.
text:
EXO 20:21
Thadou: “Meilhang kiheh muthim'in atom nalah Pathen angsung'a chun Mose ache lut tan ahile, mipi jong chu akicha uvin gamlha thimma chun ading densoh kei tauve.”
English: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Hiche hi Isarel mite heng'a seipeh tauvin: vanna kon in nang ho toh kihouna kaneije, tihi na mit tah uvin namu tauve,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
text:
EXO 20:22
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, “Hiche hi Isarel mite heng'a seipeh tauvin: vanna kon in nang ho toh kihouna kaneije, tihi na mit tah uvin namu tauve,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

tcz: “Geldoh jing un, ka masang'a dangka'a kijem patthen dang na sem louhel diu, dangka'a ki sem pathen dang kiti phot khat jeng cha jong nasem lou beh diu ahiye,” ati.
en: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.
text:
EXO 20:23
Thadou: “Geldoh jing un, ka masang'a dangka'a kijem patthen dang na sem louhel diu, dangka'a ki sem pathen dang kiti phot khat jeng cha jong nasem lou beh diu ahiye,” ati.
English: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.

tcz: “Keima ding'in vannoi leiset na maicham khat nasem ding, hiche maicham chung'a chu pumgo thilto, chule chamna thilto jouse jaona kelngoi nou ahin, bongchal thilto a ding chengse jong na todoh ding, hoichan'na hijong le Keima geldoh jing'na ding'a naheng'a kahung jing ding phatthei ka chansah ding nahiye,” ati.
en: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.
text:
EXO 20:24
Thadou: “Keima ding'in vannoi leiset na maicham khat nasem ding, hiche maicham chung'a chu pumgo thilto, chule chamna thilto jouse jaona kelngoi nou ahin, bongchal thilto a ding chengse jong na todoh ding, hoichan'na hijong le Keima geldoh jing'na ding'a naheng'a kahung jing ding phatthei ka chansah ding nahiye,” ati.
English: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.

tcz: “Chule nangman song maicham kiti khat nasem ding'a ahile, hicha song naman chah ding chu kijem pol ding chule songchung'a chu khut themma thiljem najihlut ding kitup tah'a na koi ding ahiye.
en: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.
text:
EXO 20:25
Thadou: “Chule nangman song maicham kiti khat nasem ding'a ahile, hicha song naman chah ding chu kijem pol ding chule songchung'a chu khut themma thiljem najihlut ding kitup tah'a na koi ding ahiye.
English: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.

tcz: “Maicham chungvum lam'a kalbi nado son ding chule nangma na sagohkeo jeng jong kimusah louva, ding-chang khenna na um ding ahiye,” ati.
en: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’
text:
EXO 20:26
Thadou: “Maicham chungvum lam'a kalbi nado son ding chule nangma na sagohkeo jeng jong kimusah louva, ding-chang khenna na um ding ahiye,” ati.
English: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’

tcz: “Hicheng se hi Israel mite chon'na ding dan ahiye.
en: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:
text:
EXO 21:1
Thadou: “Hicheng se hi Israel mite chon'na ding dan ahiye.
English: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:

tcz: “Hebrew mi soh ding'a na choh teng le, amachun kumgup sungse'a sohna chu atoh jing ding, kumsagi ahung lhin teng vang le soh'a kivul michu chamlhat chang ding che ding ahitai,” ati.
en: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.
text:
EXO 21:2
Thadou: “Hebrew mi soh ding'a na choh teng le, amachun kumgup sungse'a sohna chu atoh jing ding, kumsagi ahung lhin teng vang le soh'a kivul michu chamlhat chang ding che ding ahitai,” ati.
English: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.

tcz: “Soh'a pangpa chu amachang seh seh bou ahileh, amabou kile ding Chule, jineisa ahi khah tah le, ajinu jaona anilhon'na kilhon doh lhon ding ahi.”
en: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.
text:
EXO 21:3
Thadou: “Soh'a pangpa chu amachang seh seh bou ahileh, amabou kile ding Chule, jineisa ahi khah tah le, ajinu jaona anilhon'na kilhon doh lhon ding ahi.”
English: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.

tcz: “Hiche sohpa chu apupan ji aholpeh'a ahile, achate sese leh sohpa jinu chu apupa chang ding, ajona teng le sohpa chu achang seh'a che ding ahi.”
en: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
text:
EXO 21:4
Thadou: “Hiche sohpa chu apupan ji aholpeh'a ahile, achate sese leh sohpa jinu chu apupa chang ding, ajona teng le sohpa chu achang seh'a che ding ahi.”
English: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

tcz: Ahinlah sohpa chu hitia asei ding, ka pupa ahin ka jinu chule ka chate abonchauvin kalha ngaijin,’ chamlhat chang din che da jeng ing'e tia aseija,
en: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’
text:
EXO 21:5
Thadou: Ahinlah sohpa chu hitia asei ding, ka pupa ahin ka jinu chule ka chate abonchauvin kalha ngaijin,’ chamlhat chang din che da jeng ing'e tia aseija,
English: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’

tcz: Hichepa chu apupan Pathen heng'a ahin puiding, hiche asohpa chu kotphung gei hihen kotphung khom chang hijongh leh ahin puija, chuteng apupan thihtul khat'a asohpa bilkol a vuhom peh ding, hiche teng chule sohpa chun nilhum keija apupa kin'a kisa lal ding ahiye.
en: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.
text:
EXO 21:6
Thadou: Hichepa chu apupan Pathen heng'a ahin puiding, hiche asohpa chu kotphung gei hihen kotphung khom chang hijongh leh ahin puija, chuteng apupan thihtul khat'a asohpa bilkol a vuhom peh ding, hiche teng chule sohpa chun nilhum keija apupa kin'a kisa lal ding ahiye.
English: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.

tcz: Pasal khat bang chun achanu soh ding'a akijoh doh ding'a ahile, amanu chu soh pasal ho bang'a kisol doh lou ding ahi.
en: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.
text:
EXO 21:7
Thadou: Pasal khat bang chun achanu soh ding'a akijoh doh ding'a ahile, amanu chu soh pasal ho bang'a kisol doh lou ding ahi.
English: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.

tcz: Hiche sohnu chun apupa lunglhaina mong mong aboldoh jou lou ding'a ahile, apupan jong mi dang akilhat doh sah thei jeng ding, apupan hiche sohnu chu kitahna nei louvin anabol tan ahile amanu chu apupan jong gamchom ma joh doh son nading ima agel lou ding ahi.
en: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.
text:
EXO 21:8
Thadou: Hiche sohnu chun apupa lunglhaina mong mong aboldoh jou lou ding'a ahile, apupan jong mi dang akilhat doh sah thei jeng ding, apupan hiche sohnu chu kitahna nei louvin anabol tan ahile amanu chu apupan jong gamchom ma joh doh son nading ima agel lou ding ahi.
English: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.

tcz: “Ahinlah hiche sohnu chu apupan achapa sohnu a pang ding a agella ahile amanu chu achanu ngai ngai banga bol ding ahiye.”
en: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.
text:
EXO 21:9
Thadou: “Ahinlah hiche sohnu chu apupan achapa sohnu a pang ding a agella ahile amanu chu achanu ngai ngai banga bol ding ahiye.”
English: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.

tcz: “Ibang khat a achapa chun amading'a ji achom akipui khah tah a ahile, sohnu chu aji hina'a an-neh ding, sil-le-chen ding leh athaneina ima asuhnem peh chom lou ding ahi.”
en: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.
text:
EXO 21:10
Thadou: “Ibang khat a achapa chun amading'a ji achom akipui khah tah a ahile, sohnu chu aji hina'a an-neh ding, sil-le-chen ding leh athaneina ima asuhnem peh chom lou ding ahi.”
English: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.

tcz: “Asohnu dinga chu hicheng thum hochu abolpeh louva ahile, asohnu chun bat ima neilouva sum jong pelouva adalhah jeng thei ding ahi.”
en: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.
text:
EXO 21:11
Thadou: “Asohnu dinga chu hicheng thum hochu abolpeh louva ahile, asohnu chun bat ima neilouva sum jong pelouva adalhah jeng thei ding ahi.”
English: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.

tcz: “Khat touvin midang chun'a akhut alha khah'a ahile, akhut lhapa chu tha teitei ding ahi.”
en: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,
text:
EXO 21:12
Thadou: “Khat touvin midang chun'a akhut alha khah'a ahile, akhut lhapa chu tha teitei ding ahi.”
English: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,

tcz: “Ahinlah kihetkhelna maimaija konna ahile, hichu Pathen in amosah lou ding, keiman nangma munding kasem pehsa nahiye atia ahile hiche laimuna chu mivolihpa jamlut'a kihuh hing thei ding ahi.”
en: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.
text:
EXO 21:13
Thadou: “Ahinlah kihetkhelna maimaija konna ahile, hichu Pathen in amosah lou ding, keiman nangma munding kasem pehsa nahiye atia ahile hiche laimuna chu mivolihpa jamlut'a kihuh hing thei ding ahi.”
English: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.

tcz: “Amavang, khat touvin aloipa hamkhat chu atha jeng'a ahile, hiche mithat pachu keima maicham phung'a konna tha ding'a napuidoh ding ahi, ati.”
en: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.
text:
EXO 21:14
Thadou: “Amavang, khat touvin aloipa hamkhat chu atha jeng'a ahile, hiche mithat pachu keima maicham phung'a konna tha ding'a napuidoh ding ahi, ati.”
English: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.

tcz: “Koi hile, anuham apa ham vo'a achung'a khut lha aumma ahile ama chu tha jeng ding ahi.”
en: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.
text:
EXO 21:15
Thadou: “Koi hile, anuham apa ham vo'a achung'a khut lha aumma ahile ama chu tha jeng ding ahi.”
English: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.

tcz: “Mihem gumang aum'a, amiguhpa bang chu ana johdoh tah'a chule akomma ana um nah laiya, akomma aum pet hichu amatoh kimudoh khom hijong leh, akimu doh pachu tha jeng ding ahiye.”
en: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
text:
EXO 21:16
Thadou: “Mihem gumang aum'a, amiguhpa bang chu ana johdoh tah'a chule akomma ana um nah laiya, akomma aum pet hichu amatoh kimudoh khom hijong leh, akimu doh pachu tha jeng ding ahiye.”
English: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

tcz: “Koiman anu apa a engbol thei lou ding amavang anu engbol mihem chu tha jeng ding ahiye.”
en: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
text:
EXO 21:17
Thadou: “Koiman anu apa a engbol thei lou ding amavang anu engbol mihem chu tha jeng ding ahiye.”
English: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

tcz: “Tun, Pasal khat le pasal khat akinah a, khatpan jong khat pachu song tum'a asuh ham akhut tumma akhet hamma ahile hiche amisuh pachu thipei dehlouva ahile jalkhun anga ding ahi.”
en: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;

tcz: “Ahinlah alhupa chu ahung kitho doh'a tenggol mangcha a ava le theiya ahile, ama anasukhapa chu achungchang kisutheng thei ding, anat nasung'a aki jenna phat mansah chengse alepeh ding chule ajen dam sel ding ahiye.”
en: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.
text:
EXO 21:19
Thadou: “Ahinlah alhupa chu ahung kitho doh'a tenggol mangcha a ava le theiya ahile, ama anasukhapa chu achungchang kisutheng thei ding, anat nasung'a aki jenna phat mansah chengse alepeh ding chule ajen dam sel ding ahiye.”
English: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.

tcz: “Mihem khat touvin asohpa ham asohnu ham chung'a khut alha'a athikhah a ahile, soh neipa chu thina chang ding ahiye.”
en: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.
text:
EXO 21:20
Thadou: “Mihem khat touvin asohpa ham asohnu ham chung'a khut alha'a athikhah a ahile, soh neipa chu thina chang ding ahiye.”
English: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.

tcz: “Ahinlah hiche soh kijep penchu nikhat ahilou le nini sung'a adam theng tah'a ahile, sohchung'a khut lha mihem chu thina chang lou ding ahiye. Ajeh chu soh kivul michu ama nei gou khat ahi.”
en: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.
text:
EXO 21:21
Thadou: “Ahinlah hiche soh kijep penchu nikhat ahilou le nini sung'a adam theng tah'a ahile, sohchung'a khut lha mihem chu thina chang lou ding ahiye. Ajeh chu soh kivul michu ama nei gou khat ahi.”
English: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.

tcz: “Tun tekah nan, Pasal khat le pasal khat akinah tan, numei naovop lai chu asuh khah tah lhonna anaovop chu kisuhmo'a aphat louva ahungpot doh khah tah le, numeinu suhkha penpen chu ajipan jong anop channa aman adel khum jeng thei ahi. Ahinlah apeh ding chengse chu thutan vaihom hon aphatsah peh'u angaiye.”
en: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.
text:
EXO 21:22
Thadou: “Tun tekah nan, Pasal khat le pasal khat akinah tan, numei naovop lai chu asuh khah tah lhonna anaovop chu kisuhmo'a aphat louva ahungpot doh khah tah le, numeinu suhkha penpen chu ajipan jong anop channa aman adel khum jeng thei ahi. Ahinlah apeh ding chengse chu thutan vaihom hon aphatsah peh'u angaiye.”
English: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.

tcz: “Amavang numeinu kisuklhahna khonung'a ahung nat khat tah ahile: hiche hinkho khel ding'a chu hin kho khat ma lepeh ding ahi.”
en: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,
text:
EXO 21:23
Thadou: “Amavang numeinu kisuklhahna khonung'a ahung nat khat tah ahile: hiche hinkho khel ding'a chu hin kho khat ma lepeh ding ahi.”
English: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,

tcz: Mitchang khella michang hiding, haa khella haa hiding, khut khel la khut hiding, keng khel la kengg na peh ding ahi,
en: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
text:
EXO 21:24
Thadou: Mitchang khella michang hiding, haa khella haa hiding, khut khel la khut hiding, keng khel la kengg na peh ding ahi,
English: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

tcz: Meiyin akah'a ahile meikah jeh'a meiya nale peh ding, kimavo jeh'a namavoa chule kijep jeh'a chu nale jep jeng ding ahi, ati.
en: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.
text:
EXO 21:25
Thadou: Meiyin akah'a ahile meikah jeh'a meiya nale peh ding, kimavo jeh'a namavoa chule kijep jeh'a chu nale jep jeng ding ahi, ati.
English: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.

tcz: “Mihem koitobang khat chun asohpa ahilou leh asohnu ham mit asuh khah peh'a ahile, hiche soh chu amit adam loutah jeh'a chamlhat ding'a asol doh jeng ding ahiye.”
en: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
text:
EXO 21:26
Thadou: “Mihem koitobang khat chun asohpa ahilou leh asohnu ham mit asuh khah peh'a ahile, hiche soh chu amit adam loutah jeh'a chamlhat ding'a asol doh jeng ding ahiye.”
English: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

tcz: “Soh goiya pang pan jong asohnu ham, asohpa ham khat achu ahaa asuhlhoi peh a hile, ahaa asuh lhopipeh tah jeh'a hiche sohpa ham sohnu ham chu chmalhat chansah ding'a asol doh ding ahitai.”
en: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.
text:
EXO 21:27
Thadou: “Soh goiya pang pan jong asohnu ham, asohpa ham khat achu ahaa asuhlhoi peh a hile, ahaa asuh lhopipeh tah jeh'a hiche sohpa ham sohnu ham chu chmalhat chansah ding'a asol doh ding ahitai.”
English: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.

tcz: “Bongchal khattou vin numei ham pasal ham khat chu aki'a ahin pihlih khah'a ahile, hiche bongchal chu song'a selih jeng ding ahiye. Amavang bongsa chu koiman aneh theilou ding chuteng bong neipa ding'a achungchang thu kisutheng ahitai,” ati.
en: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.
text:
EXO 21:28
Thadou: “Bongchal khattou vin numei ham pasal ham khat chu aki'a ahin pihlih khah'a ahile, hiche bongchal chu song'a selih jeng ding ahiye. Amavang bongsa chu koiman aneh theilou ding chuteng bong neipa ding'a achungchang thu kisutheng ahitai,” ati.
English: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.

tcz: “Ahinlah hiche bongchal chun masang kisanna mihem dang ana pihlih sa ahileh, aneipa jeng'in jong anahsah lou ahitah leh, hiche bongchal in jong numei ham pasal ham chu aki a apihlih khah'a ahileh, bongchal chu thadoh jeng ding chule aneipa jeng jong anigel la tha teitei lhon ding ahiye.”
en: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.
text:
EXO 21:29
Thadou: “Ahinlah hiche bongchal chun masang kisanna mihem dang ana pihlih sa ahileh, aneipa jeng'in jong anahsah lou ahitah leh, hiche bongchal in jong numei ham pasal ham chu aki a apihlih khah'a ahileh, bongchal chu thadoh jeng ding chule aneipa jeng jong anigel la tha teitei lhon ding ahiye.”
English: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.

tcz: Amavang athipa chu longlhat na ding'a aki peh doh'a ahile, aki pehdoh sah jatchu aman jong long lhatna ding'a apeh ding ahi.”
en: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.
text:
EXO 21:30
Thadou: Amavang athipa chu longlhat na ding'a aki peh doh'a ahile, aki pehdoh sah jatchu aman jong long lhatna ding'a apeh ding ahi.”
English: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.

tcz: “Hiche bongchal chun numei ham pasal ham khat ahin peh lih khah bang le, hiche gancha neipa chu dan kisem dungjuija kitham gah ding ahi.”
en: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.
text:
EXO 21:31
Thadou: “Hiche bongchal chun numei ham pasal ham khat ahin peh lih khah bang le, hiche gancha neipa chu dan kisem dungjuija kitham gah ding ahi.”
English: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.

tcz: “Bongchal chun soh numeija pang ham pasal ham khat chu ahin pihlih bang leh, bongchal neipan jong sohneipa chu dangka shekel somthum apeh teitei ding chule hiche bongchal chu song'a aselih pai jeng ding ahi.”
en: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.
text:
EXO 21:32
Thadou: “Bongchal chun soh numeija pang ham pasal ham khat chu ahin pihlih bang leh, bongchal neipan jong sohneipa chu dangka shekel somthum apeh teitei ding chule hiche bongchal chu song'a aselih pai jeng ding ahi.”
English: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.

tcz: “Tekah nan mikhat chun kokhuh khah bit louva adalhah jeng'a chule hiche kokhuh sin kikhah bit louva adalhah'a sangan ham bongchal ham kokhuh'a alhah lut'a athi den tah'a ahileh,
en: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,
text:
EXO 21:33
Thadou: “Tekah nan mikhat chun kokhuh khah bit louva adalhah jeng'a chule hiche kokhuh sin kikhah bit louva adalhah'a sangan ham bongchal ham kokhuh'a alhah lut'a athi den tah'a ahileh,
English: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,

tcz: “Kokhuh neipan jong aphat toh kitoh chatna asem phat ding, gancha neipa jong sum apeh ding, a gancha pohlih vang chu ama chang ding ahi.”
en: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.
text:
EXO 21:34
Thadou: “Kokhuh neipan jong aphat toh kitoh chatna asem phat ding, gancha neipa jong sum apeh ding, a gancha pohlih vang chu ama chang ding ahi.”
English: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.

tcz: “Mihem khat bongchal chun mi dang khat bongchal a suhkhah a asuh khah bongchal chu athi jeng'a ahile, bong nei ten jong hiche bong chal athinai louchu akijoh doh diu aki johdohna man vang chu kihom lhon ding, hiche bongchal thisa jeng jong chu aman kihom lhon ding ahi.”
en: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.
text:
EXO 21:35
Thadou: “Mihem khat bongchal chun mi dang khat bongchal a suhkhah a asuh khah bongchal chu athi jeng'a ahile, bong nei ten jong hiche bong chal athinai louchu akijoh doh diu aki johdohna man vang chu kihom lhon ding, hiche bongchal thisa jeng jong chu aman kihom lhon ding ahi.”
English: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.

tcz: “Ahinlah hiche bongchal chun masang jeng'ajong gancha dang ana pihlih jeng'a ahile, aneipa jeng in jong ahilchahsa ahi a chule ngaisah'a akoi louva ahile, anei pan jong bongchal thi chu bongchal khat mama'a alesah ding, bongchal thisa vang chu ama chang teitei ding ahiye.”
en: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.
text:
EXO 21:36
Thadou: “Ahinlah hiche bongchal chun masang jeng'ajong gancha dang ana pihlih jeng'a ahile, aneipa jeng in jong ahilchahsa ahi a chule ngaisah'a akoi louva ahile, anei pan jong bongchal thi chu bongchal khat mama'a alesah ding, bongchal thisa vang chu ama chang teitei ding ahiye.”
English: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.

tcz: Mikhat touvin bongchal ham kelngoi ham aguhdoh'a hichu akitha ham ahilouleh akijoh doh'a ahile bongchal khat jat chu bongchal nga'a ale ding, chule kelngoi khat man dia kelngoi li alepeh ding ahi.
en: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
text:
EXO 22:1
Thadou: Mikhat touvin bongchal ham kelngoi ham aguhdoh'a hichu akitha ham ahilouleh akijoh doh'a ahile bongchal khat jat chu bongchal nga'a ale ding, chule kelngoi khat man dia kelngoi li alepeh ding ahi.
English: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

tcz: Gucha chun jankah a inbang aphetvang jeh'a ama chu akimatna aki vohlih khah tah'a ahileh, hiche guchapa hinkho that pachu tolthat a kisim lou ding ahi.
en: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.
text:
EXO 22:2
Thadou: Gucha chun jankah a inbang aphetvang jeh'a ama chu akimatna aki vohlih khah tah'a ahileh, hiche guchapa hinkho that pachu tolthat a kisim lou ding ahi.
English: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.

tcz: Ahinlah hiche thisoh hi sun khovah pet ahi leh vang mithat pachu tolthat a kisim ding ahi. “Ajeh chu gucha kiman chun, athil guhdoh jouse aboncha alesah kit ding ahin, a le sah joulouva ahi leh ama chu kijoh doh a athil guh ho sahna a kinei ding ahi.”
en: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
text:
EXO 22:3
Thadou: Ahinlah hiche thisoh hi sun khovah pet ahi leh vang mithat pachu tolthat a kisim ding ahi. “Ajeh chu gucha kiman chun, athil guhdoh jouse aboncha alesah kit ding ahin, a le sah joulouva ahi leh ama chu kijoh doh a athil guh ho sahna a kinei ding ahi.”
English: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

tcz: Khat touvin bongchal hihen lang, Sangan hihen, Kelcha hi jong leh aguh doh sa khat ama insung neilegou lah'a aga kimatdoh khah a ahileh ajat leni'a asah kit ding ahi.
en: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.
text:
EXO 22:4
Thadou: Khat touvin bongchal hihen lang, Sangan hihen, Kelcha hi jong leh aguh doh sa khat ama insung neilegou lah'a aga kimatdoh khah a ahileh ajat leni'a asah kit ding ahi.
English: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.

tcz: Mihem koihile loulaija gancha alut sah'a lengpi lei ham khat gasoh aneh khah'a ahileh gancha chingtup louva loulaija alha thang jeh'a hichepa chun aloulaija gasoh phapen achu a lepeh teitei ding ahiye.
en: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.
text:
EXO 22:5
Thadou: Mihem koihile loulaija gancha alut sah'a lengpi lei ham khat gasoh aneh khah'a ahileh gancha chingtup louva loulaija alha thang jeh'a hichepa chun aloulaija gasoh phapen achu a lepeh teitei ding ahiye.
English: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.

tcz: Chule Loulai meiyin ahinkah khah'a ling le khao leilah ahin kah jeng'a, chang aki at-lai leh a ki-at loulai mun lah chule loulai chu akah vam lhah jeng tah'a ahile, meihal kong pen pen chun akahvam cheng se aboncha ale sah cheh cheh ding ahiye.
en: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
text:
EXO 22:6
Thadou: Chule Loulai meiyin ahinkah khah'a ling le khao leilah ahin kah jeng'a, chang aki at-lai leh a ki-at loulai mun lah chule loulai chu akah vam lhah jeng tah'a ahile, meihal kong pen pen chun akahvam cheng se aboncha ale sah cheh cheh ding ahiye.
English: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

tcz: Tekahnan mi khat touvin aheng akoma sum ham thil khat koiding'a angensea ahile, hiche thil chu akoipa insung'a konna aki guhmang khah tah'a ahile hiche gucha pachu akimat matna'a athil guh chengse aboncha ajat nia alepeh cheh cheh ding ahiye.”
en: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.
text:
EXO 22:7
Thadou: Tekahnan mi khat touvin aheng akoma sum ham thil khat koiding'a angensea ahile, hiche thil chu akoipa insung'a konna aki guhmang khah tah'a ahile hiche gucha pachu akimat matna'a athil guh chengse aboncha ajat nia alepeh cheh cheh ding ahiye.”
English: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.

tcz: Amavang hiche guchapa chu akimat doh kha tah louva ahile athil koipa chu alah ham alou ham ti hetchetna ding'a Pathen ang sung'a kipui lut ding ahiye.”
en: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.
text:
EXO 22:8
Thadou: Amavang hiche guchapa chu akimat doh kha tah louva ahile athil koipa chu alah ham alou ham ti hetchetna ding'a Pathen ang sung'a kipui lut ding ahiye.”
English: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.

tcz: Ajeh chu kitahsan lelna chung chang kiti phot'a chu bongchal chung chang hihen, sangan chung chang hihen, kelngoi chule ponsil thua hijong le thil kiman sah chung chang thua khat touvin, “Hiche hi keima thil ahi”, hiche hi keima thil ahi titeni chung'a achu athem joh pen hetchetna ding'a Pathen ama-angsung'puilut’a umlhon ding ahi. Amani chu koipen themmo nachang'a Pathen angsung'a konna hetchet ahiteng ajatnia alepeh cheh cheh ding ahiye.”
en: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.
text:
EXO 22:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu kitahsan lelna chung chang kiti phot'a chu bongchal chung chang hihen, sangan chung chang hihen, kelngoi chule ponsil thua hijong le thil kiman sah chung chang thua khat touvin, “Hiche hi keima thil ahi”, hiche hi keima thil ahi titeni chung'a achu athem joh pen hetchetna ding'a Pathen ama-angsung'puilut’a umlhon ding ahi. Amani chu koipen themmo nachang'a Pathen angsung'a konna hetchet ahiteng ajatnia alepeh cheh cheh ding ahiye.”
English: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.

tcz: Tun tekahnan mi khat touvin aheng akom khat ngansena aneija sangan ahilou le bongchal ham kelngoi ham gancha khat pen pen apeh a ahile, hichu koima muphah nalou munkhat'a akidel mang tai.”
en: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;

tcz: Hitia chu aumkhah tah le ani gellhon na Pakai angsung'a kihahselna anei lhon ding ahi. Chu teng gancha neipan jong kihahselna chu anganse jeng ding hiche gancha chu asah lou ding ahi tai.”
en: the oath of the LORD shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
text:
EXO 22:11
Thadou: Hitia chu aumkhah tah le ani gellhon na Pakai angsung'a kihahselna anei lhon ding ahi. Chu teng gancha neipan jong kihahselna chu anganse jeng ding hiche gancha chu asah lou ding ahi tai.”
English: the oath of the LORD shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.

tcz: Ahinlah akoipa akonna kigumang anahi khah tah le, gancha koipan aneipa chu phatecha alepeh cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.
text:
EXO 22:12
Thadou: Ahinlah akoipa akonna kigumang anahi khah tah le, gancha koipan aneipa chu phatecha alepeh cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.

tcz: Gamsa hang in atha khah ahitah le hiche hetchetna chu gancha koipan jong avetsah ding, chu teng gancha koipan asah tah lou ding ahi.
en: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.
text:
EXO 22:13
Thadou: Gamsa hang in atha khah ahitah le hiche hetchetna chu gancha koipan jong avetsah ding, chu teng gancha koipan asah tah lou ding ahi.
English: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.

tcz: Mi khat touvin asopi khat koma gancha vaiding'a alah ham ahilou leh manchah ding hamma alah'a hiche gancha chu akisuh khah, ahilou leh athi khah tah'a ahile, hiche vang chu bat'a lapan aman phatah'a lepeh cheh cheh ding ahiye.
en: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.
text:
EXO 22:14
Thadou: Mi khat touvin asopi khat koma gancha vaiding'a alah ham ahilou leh manchah ding hamma alah'a hiche gancha chu akisuh khah, ahilou leh athi khah tah'a ahile, hiche vang chu bat'a lapan aman phatah'a lepeh cheh cheh ding ahiye.
English: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.

tcz: Ahinlah aneipa umpet toh aki tokhah'a ahile alapa chun asah tah lou ding, manpeh ding'a avai ahi jong le avaiman toh akito sah cheh cheh ding ahitai.”
en: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.
text:
EXO 22:15
Thadou: Ahinlah aneipa umpet toh aki tokhah'a ahile alapa chun asah tah lou ding, manpeh ding'a avai ahi jong le avaiman toh akito sah cheh cheh ding ahitai.”
English: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.

tcz: Pasal toh ki hepha loulai nungah khat chu pasal khat in ajol lhah'a alupi khah'a ahile, Pasal pan jong hiche nungahnu man chu apeh ding chuteng jia anei pai ding ahi.
en: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
text:
EXO 22:16
Thadou: Pasal toh ki hepha loulai nungah khat chu pasal khat in ajol lhah'a alupi khah'a ahile, Pasal pan jong hiche nungahnu man chu apeh ding chuteng jia anei pai ding ahi.
English: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.

tcz: Ahinlah nungahnu pan achanu chu hiche pasalpa chu apeh nom hih beh jeng'a ahileh, a lupkhom pipa chun nungah thengho man ki khum peh jat jat bang'a apeh ding ahiye.”
en: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
text:
EXO 22:17
Thadou: Ahinlah nungahnu pan achanu chu hiche pasalpa chu apeh nom hih beh jeng'a ahileh, a lupkhom pipa chun nungah thengho man ki khum peh jat jat bang'a apeh ding ahiye.”
English: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

tcz: Nangman numei doithem kiti jong na tha jeng ding ahiye.
en: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.
text:
EXO 22:18
Thadou: Nangman numei doithem kiti jong na tha jeng ding ahiye.
English: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.

tcz: Chule koi hijong le gancha toh lumkhom kitiphot chu tha jeng ding ahiye.
en: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.
text:
EXO 22:19
Thadou: Chule koi hijong le gancha toh lumkhom kitiphot chu tha jeng ding ahiye.
English: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.

tcz: Koi hijong leu chun Pakai kom tailouva kilhaina dang nei mihem chu tha jeng ding ahi.”
en: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to the LORD only, shall be utterly destroyed.
text:
EXO 22:20
Thadou: Koi hijong leu chun Pakai kom tailouva kilhaina dang nei mihem chu tha jeng ding ahi.”
English: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to the LORD only, shall be utterly destroyed.

tcz: Maljin kiti chu adih louva na bol louhel ding, na suhgenthei lou hel ding ahi. Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gamsung'a maljin ana hisa na hiuve.
en: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 22:21
Thadou: Maljin kiti chu adih louva na bol louhel ding, na suhgenthei lou hel ding ahi. Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gamsung'a maljin ana hisa na hiuve.
English: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

tcz: Meithai le chaga jeng jong nangailut ding ahi.
en: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
text:
EXO 22:22
Thadou: Meithai le chaga jeng jong nangailut ding ahi.
English: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.

tcz: Amaho na suhgim uva ahile amaho ka heng lama hung diu chuteng keiman amaho taona ka san ding ahi, ati.
en: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

tcz: Chuteng ka lungsatna na chung uva hung lhung ding najiteo kasat lhuh gamdiu, nacha teo chaga kisoh gam ding ahiuve, ati.
en: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
text:
EXO 22:24
Thadou: Chuteng ka lungsatna na chung uva hung lhung ding najiteo kasat lhuh gamdiu, nacha teo chaga kisoh gam ding ahiuve, ati.
English: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

tcz: Chule na heng na kom'a um ka mite khat tou sum le pai na bat sah ahile, vaichapa chung'a chun sumkol vei tabang'in umdan lang, sum tong jeng jong ama chung'a chu nadel khum lou hel ding ahiye.
en: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.
text:
EXO 22:25
Thadou: Chule na heng na kom'a um ka mite khat tou sum le pai na bat sah ahile, vaichapa chung'a chun sumkol vei tabang'in umdan lang, sum tong jeng jong ama chung'a chu nadel khum lou hel ding ahiye.
