English: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.

tcz: Naheng nakom ponsil khat tou tundoh ding'a nalah'a ahile, nisa leplhah masang'a hiche ponsil chu aneipa na ga lepeh ding ahi.
en: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,
text:
EXO 22:26
Thadou: Naheng nakom ponsil khat tou tundoh ding'a nalah'a ahile, nisa leplhah masang'a hiche ponsil chu aneipa na ga lepeh ding ahi.
English: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,

tcz: Ajeh chu aman hiche bou chu tahsa ponsilla anei ahin, pondang silla imutpi ding anei louva ahin ipi pon akisil ding ham? Keima heng'a hungtao khata henlang hile keiman amachu kangaipeh teitei ding ahi ajeh chu keima hi milainat pi jing kahi,” ati.
en: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.
text:
EXO 22:27
Thadou: Ajeh chu aman hiche bou chu tahsa ponsilla anei ahin, pondang silla imutpi ding anei louva ahin ipi pon akisil ding ham? Keima heng'a hungtao khata henlang hile keiman amachu kangaipeh teitei ding ahi ajeh chu keima hi milainat pi jing kahi,” ati.
English: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.

tcz: Pathen dou mah nasei thei lou ding chule namite lah'a vaihompa jeng jong gaosapna nabol lou ding ahi.
en: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
text:
EXO 22:28
Thadou: Pathen dou mah nasei thei lou ding chule namite lah'a vaihompa jeng jong gaosapna nabol lou ding ahi.
English: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.

tcz: Na lhosoh ga le na lengpi gasoh chengse chu lungopkaina neilou hel'a nakat doh jing ding, nachapate lah'a apeng masapen chu keima ding'a na todoh ding ahi, ati.
en: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.
text:
EXO 22:29
Thadou: Na lhosoh ga le na lengpi gasoh chengse chu lungopkaina neilou hel'a nakat doh jing ding, nachapate lah'a apeng masapen chu keima ding'a na todoh ding ahi, ati.
English: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.

tcz: Na bongchal le na kelngoi jeng jong hitia chu nabol ding, hiche gancha nou chu nisagi sung'a ahonsung umden jeng ding, ahinlah niget lhin niteng le keima neipeh doh ding ahiye.
en: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.
text:
EXO 22:30
Thadou: Na bongchal le na kelngoi jeng jong hitia chu nabol ding, hiche gancha nou chu nisagi sung'a ahonsung umden jeng ding, ahinlah niget lhin niteng le keima neipeh doh ding ahiye.
English: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.

tcz: Nangman jouthu na sei thei lou ding, muda jeh'a thet umtah hettohsah'a napan thei lou ding ahiye.
en: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
text:
EXO 23:1
Thadou: Nangman jouthu na sei thei lou ding, muda jeh'a thet umtah hettohsah'a napan thei lou ding ahiye.
English: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.

tcz: Chule thilse bolding'a mihem chele hojong najui a najop lou hel ding, mipi nung najui louva amaho khat le khat kikah'a them achan theina diuva jong hettohsah'a napan lou ding ahiye.”
en: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.
text:
EXO 23:2
Thadou: Chule thilse bolding'a mihem chele hojong najui a najop lou hel ding, mipi nung najui louva amaho khat le khat kikah'a them achan theina diuva jong hettohsah'a napan lou ding ahiye.”
English: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.

tcz: Vaichaho thukitanna jeng ajong pan nalah lou hel ding, sih neina lang neina jeng jong nabol lou ding ahi.
en: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.
text:
EXO 23:3
Thadou: Vaichaho thukitanna jeng ajong pan nalah lou hel ding, sih neina lang neina jeng jong nabol lou ding ahi.
English: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.

tcz: Chule na melma khat sangan ahi loule bongchal vah mang jong nadon peh lou ding, hiche gancha chu ama heng'a nahin le kailut peh joh ding ahi.
en: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
text:
EXO 23:4
Thadou: Chule na melma khat sangan ahi loule bongchal vah mang jong nadon peh lou ding, hiche gancha chu ama heng'a nahin le kailut peh joh ding ahi.
English: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

tcz: Nangma doumah bolpa sangan in apot apoh lal tah'a aopkhum ma ahile hichu, na dalhah jeng lou ding, sangan akitho doh theina ding'a na panhu teitei ding ahi joi.
en: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.
text:
EXO 23:5
Thadou: Nangma doumah bolpa sangan in apot apoh lal tah'a aopkhum ma ahile hichu, na dalhah jeng lou ding, sangan akitho doh theina ding'a na panhu teitei ding ahi joi.
English: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.

tcz: Vaicha thutanna'a adinmunanna konna achanding dolla thudih chu napam paipeh lou hel ding ahi.
en: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
text:
EXO 23:6
Thadou: Vaicha thutanna'a adinmunanna konna achanding dolla thudih chu napam paipeh lou hel ding ahi.
English: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

tcz: Jouthu phot'a kinilna le kihehtona chu najam san jeng ding, themmona beija mihem chu natha lou ding, ajeh chu keiman kahenai agiloupa chu them kachan sah him him lou ding ahiye.
en: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.
text:
EXO 23:7
Thadou: Jouthu phot'a kinilna le kihehtona chu najam san jeng ding, themmona beija mihem chu natha lou ding, ajeh chu keiman kahenai agiloupa chu them kachan sah him him lou ding ahiye.
English: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.

tcz: Nehguh chahguh jong nakilah thei lou ding, ajeh chu nehguh kitihi vaihomma pangpan amit asel mang jin chule adih'a pangte chu akhup athal'a alekhup jeng ahi.
en: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
text:
EXO 23:8
Thadou: Nehguh chahguh jong nakilah thei lou ding, ajeh chu nehguh kitihi vaihomma pangpan amit asel mang jin chule adih'a pangte chu akhup athal'a alekhup jeng ahi.
English: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.

tcz: Kholjin mijong na suhgim lou ding, ajeh chu kholjin mihon ichanna lunggel nei uvem ti na hetauve, amaho bang chu nanngho jong Egypt gamma khol jin mi'a nanaum'u ahiye.
en: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
text:
EXO 23:9
Thadou: Kholjin mijong na suhgim lou ding, ajeh chu kholjin mihon ichanna lunggel nei uvem ti na hetauve, amaho bang chu nanngho jong Egypt gamma khol jin mi'a nanaum'u ahiye.
English: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

tcz: Kum gup sung'a phatah'a na gam sung'a ann-ga natu ding, muchi gasoh na kilokhom ding ahi.
en: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,
text:
EXO 23:10
Thadou: Kum gup sung'a phatah'a na gam sung'a ann-ga natu ding, muchi gasoh na kilokhom ding ahi.
English: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

tcz: Kum sagi alhin teng hiche kum sung'a chu nagamsung nakicholdo sahding hiche nangma miten avaicha ho chun aneh diu, louna tong lou beh'a naki chol damsah thei ding, amahon aneh joulou aneh moh chengseo vang chu gamsa hon aneh diuva ahitai. Hiche bang bang'a chu lengpi leilai le Olive chu nabol cheh cheh diu ahi.
en: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.
text:
EXO 23:11
Thadou: Kum sagi alhin teng hiche kum sung'a chu nagamsung nakicholdo sahding hiche nangma miten avaicha ho chun aneh diu, louna tong lou beh'a naki chol damsah thei ding, amahon aneh joulou aneh moh chengseo vang chu gamsa hon aneh diuva ahitai. Hiche bang bang'a chu lengpi leilai le Olive chu nabol cheh cheh diu ahi.
English: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.

tcz: Nigup sung'a hi natoh ding chan natoh ding, chule ni sagi lhinni vang le nasangan jeng jong na choldam sah ding, na bongchal ahin sangan jeng jong choldo thei ding, na sohnu chapa ahin na jin ho jong ki chol do thei diu ahi.
en: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.
text:
EXO 23:12
Thadou: Nigup sung'a hi natoh ding chan natoh ding, chule ni sagi lhinni vang le nasangan jeng jong na choldam sah ding, na bongchal ahin sangan jeng jong choldo thei ding, na sohnu chapa ahin na jin ho jong ki chol do thei diu ahi.
English: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.

tcz: Naheng uva kasei doh hi nanit jeng jing diu, chule hichengse hi nakam sung uva jong napotdoh sah lou hel diu ahi.
en: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.
text:
EXO 23:13
Thadou: Naheng uva kasei doh hi nanit jeng jing diu, chule hichengse hi nakam sung uva jong napotdoh sah lou hel diu ahi.
English: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

tcz: Kumkhat sung'a keima dinga kut thumvei chan nabol ding ahi.
en: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
text:
EXO 23:14
Thadou: Kumkhat sung'a keima dinga kut thumvei chan nabol ding ahi.
English: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.

tcz: Chol solou chang-lhah kut, keiman phat katepeh dung juiya hi ding, Abib* lhasung hichu cholsolou changlhah ni sagi sung sea naneh ding hiche lhasung'a hi Egypt gamsung'a kon'a na hung doh na lha ahiye. Hijeh achu khat cha jong keima angsung'a khut goh keuva hung sung lha thei lou ding ahi.
en: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.
text:
EXO 23:15
Thadou: Chol solou chang-lhah kut, keiman phat katepeh dung juiya hi ding, Abib* lhasung hichu cholsolou changlhah ni sagi sung sea naneh ding hiche lhasung'a hi Egypt gamsung'a kon'a na hung doh na lha ahiye. Hijeh achu khat cha jong keima angsung'a khut goh keuva hung sung lha thei lou ding ahi.
English: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

tcz: Loulaija na lhosoh ga amasapen penchu nangman lholhun kut'a ding'a na kat doh jeng ding, hi tabang ma chu lou lai pumpia na lhosoh ga nahin chop khom teng jong le kut nabol ding ahi.”
en: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.
text:
EXO 23:16
Thadou: Loulaija na lhosoh ga amasapen penchu nangman lholhun kut'a ding'a na kat doh jeng ding, hi tabang ma chu lou lai pumpia na lhosoh ga nahin chop khom teng jong le kut nabol ding ahi.”
English: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.

tcz: Kum khat sung'a namite holah'a pasal'a kai lhah kiti phot chu Pakai Pathen keima ansung'a thumvei hung ki lah cheh diu ahi.”
en: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
text:
EXO 23:17
Thadou: Kum khat sung'a namite holah'a pasal'a kai lhah kiti phot chu Pakai Pathen keima ansung'a thumvei hung ki lah cheh diu ahi.”
English: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD.

tcz: Keima angsung'a kilhaina gancha kithat chu cholsosa changlhah jaona nahin totha thei lou ding, kaheng'a kilhaina sathao jeng jong khovah geija nakoi den lou ding ahi.
en: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.
text:
EXO 23:18
Thadou: Keima angsung'a kilhaina gancha kithat chu cholsosa changlhah jaona nahin totha thei lou ding, kaheng'a kilhaina sathao jeng jong khovah geija nakoi den lou ding ahi.
English: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.

tcz: Na leiset ga soh lah'a gamasa pen pen chu na Pakai na Pathen heng'a na hin poh lut masat pen ding, kelngoi sakithat jeng jong chu api noitwi mangcha'a nahon lou ding ahi.
en: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
text:
EXO 23:19
Thadou: Na leiset ga soh lah'a gamasa pen pen chu na Pakai na Pathen heng'a na hin poh lut masat pen ding, kelngoi sakithat jeng jong chu api noitwi mangcha'a nahon lou ding ahi.
English: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

tcz: Ven! Na chena channa nangma na ventup ding le na lhon pijing ding'in namasang lama vantil khat ka sol peh in ahi.”
en: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
text:
EXO 23:20
Thadou: Ven! Na chena channa nangma na ventup ding le na lhon pijing ding'in namasang lama vantil khat ka sol peh in ahi.”
English: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

tcz: Vantil khu jabol'in lang, athu napal keh thei louding, ama doumah thei himhim nabol lou ding ahiye, ajeh chu aman nasuhkhel channu ngaidam intin, ajeh chu amasung'a khu keima min um jeng'a ahi.
en: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.
text:
EXO 23:21
Thadou: Vantil khu jabol'in lang, athu napal keh thei louding, ama doumah thei himhim nabol lou ding ahiye, ajeh chu aman nasuhkhel channu ngaidam intin, ajeh chu amasung'a khu keima min um jeng'a ahi.
English: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.

tcz: Aman aseichan lunglut tah'a nangai jing ding, keiman kasei chan nabol'a ahile, namel mate dia melma'a kapan ding, nadoute ding'a adouva pang ding kahi, ati.
en: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.
text:
EXO 23:22
Thadou: Aman aseichan lunglut tah'a nangai jing ding, keiman kasei chan nabol'a ahile, namel mate dia melma'a kapan ding, nadoute ding'a adouva pang ding kahi, ati.
English: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.

tcz: Ka Vantil chu namasang lama lamkai jing ding, Amor mite, Hit mite, Periz mite, Canaan mite, Hivi mite, chule Jebus mite jouse abonchaova nahin pui teng leh keima tah in abonchauva ka suhmang hel jeng ding ahi, ati.
en: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.
text:
EXO 23:23
Thadou: Ka Vantil chu namasang lama lamkai jing ding, Amor mite, Hit mite, Periz mite, Canaan mite, Hivi mite, chule Jebus mite jouse abonchaova nahin pui teng leh keima tah in abonchauva ka suhmang hel jeng ding ahi, ati.
English: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.

tcz: Chule mihem in asem thu milim doi pathen ho masang kitia naboh khup lou ding, hicheho ding'a jong chu na kisahlal louhel ding, anatoh bang bang uva jong ima natoh thei lou ding aboncha na phuhlhuh ding, a songkhom tincheng jong na lekhup jeng ding ahiye.
en: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.
text:
EXO 23:24
Thadou: Chule mihem in asem thu milim doi pathen ho masang kitia naboh khup lou ding, hicheho ding'a jong chu na kisahlal louhel ding, anatoh bang bang uva jong ima natoh thei lou ding aboncha na phuhlhuh ding, a songkhom tincheng jong na lekhup jeng ding ahiye.
English: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.

tcz: Na boncha uva na Pakai Na Pathen nahou uva ama kin jeng na bol diu ahi.” Na boncha uva na Pakai na Pathen kin jeng a na kisah lel diu, amatah in na changlhah neh diu le na twidon ding jing ujong phatthei aboh ding, chu teng keiman na jalah uva konna phatthei nasa tah ka hin boh ding ahi, ati.”
en: You shall serve the LORD your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.
text:
EXO 23:25
Thadou: Na boncha uva na Pakai Na Pathen nahou uva ama kin jeng na bol diu ahi.” Na boncha uva na Pakai na Pathen kin jeng a na kisah lel diu, amatah in na changlhah neh diu le na twidon ding jing ujong phatthei aboh ding, chu teng keiman na jalah uva konna phatthei nasa tah ka hin boh ding ahi, ati.”
English: You shall serve the LORD your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.

tcz: Nangma gamsung achu koima aching kal val jong um thei lou ding, ama vang nangma hinkho chu ka suh bukim sel joh ding ahi.
en: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.
text:
EXO 23:26
Thadou: Nangma gamsung achu koima aching kal val jong um thei lou ding, ama vang nangma hinkho chu ka suh bukim sel joh ding ahi.
English: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.

tcz: Na masang tinna mihem ten aki chat thei chan ka ma sol peh ding, kidoupi ding'a nahin tupchan lungsung kasuh mol peh jing ding, chuteng nangma nahin doute jamcheh diu nangma nung lam jeng'a bou khodah diu ahi.
en: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
text:
EXO 23:27
Thadou: Na masang tinna mihem ten aki chat thei chan ka ma sol peh ding, kidoupi ding'a nahin tupchan lungsung kasuh mol peh jing ding, chuteng nangma nahin doute jamcheh diu nangma nung lam jeng'a bou khodah diu ahi.
English: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

tcz: Na masang'a khoi-ngel te kalha masat peh ding, Hivi mite, Canaan mite, Hit mie abonchauva khoingel ten a delmang hel diu ahi.
en: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
text:
EXO 23:28
Thadou: Na masang'a khoi-ngel te kalha masat peh ding, Hivi mite, Canaan mite, Hit mie abonchauva khoingel ten a delmang hel diu ahi.
English: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

tcz: Na masang'a vang amahochu kumkhat sung'a kadel cheh lou ding ahi, ajeh chu gamsung ahomkeu va aum khah le gamsa hungpung lha jeng ding gamsa ten nagma nahin dou khah diuva ahi.
en: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.
text:
EXO 23:29
Thadou: Na masang'a vang amahochu kumkhat sung'a kadel cheh lou ding ahi, ajeh chu gamsung ahomkeu va aum khah le gamsa hungpung lha jeng ding gamsa ten nagma nahin dou khah diuva ahi.
English: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.

tcz: Nangma na hung pun be jing ding, chuteng amaho khu aloiloija ka del cheh ding ahiuve, ati.
en: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.
text:
EXO 23:30
Thadou: Nangma na hung pun be jing ding, chuteng amaho khu aloiloija ka del cheh ding ahiuve, ati.
English: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

tcz: Na gam gi chu twisan dung len aki pat Palistinete twikhanglen chan hop'a ka kaipeh ding, gamang lah akipat Euphrates vadung channa kakai peh ding nahiye, ajeh chu hiche gamsung ana lo jouse keiman nangho khut a kapeh doh ding, amaho chu nangman jong nadelcheh jeng diu ahiye, ati.
en: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.
text:
EXO 23:31
Thadou: Na gam gi chu twisan dung len aki pat Palistinete twikhanglen chan hop'a ka kaipeh ding, gamang lah akipat Euphrates vadung channa kakai peh ding nahiye, ajeh chu hiche gamsung ana lo jouse keiman nangho khut a kapeh doh ding, amaho chu nangman jong nadelcheh jeng diu ahiye, ati.
English: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

tcz: Amite jouse lah hihen a semthu uva pathen hijong le kitepna neocha jong nanei theilou ding ahi.
en: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
text:
EXO 23:32
Thadou: Amite jouse lah hihen a semthu uva pathen hijong le kitepna neocha jong nanei theilou ding ahi.
English: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

tcz: Amaho jouse khu khat jeng cha jong na gamsung'a cheng thei loudiu ahi, ahinlah amaho pathen lim sem thuho kin nabol khah ngai ngaiya ahile vang, hichea chu nasatah'a nangma na kipel lhuh ding ahi, ati.
en: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”
text:
EXO 23:33
Thadou: Amaho jouse khu khat jeng cha jong na gamsung'a cheng thei loudiu ahi, ahinlah amaho pathen lim sem thuho kin nabol khah ngai ngaiya ahile vang, hichea chu nasatah'a nangma na kipel lhuh ding ahi, ati.
English: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

tcz: “Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, Pakai heng lama hung kal touvin nagma chule Aaron chule Nadab ahin, Abihu chule Isarel upate mi som sagi jong jaonan na boncha uva na hung diu ahiye. Gamlha thimma kon in chibai nahin boh diu ahi, ati.
en: He said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.
text:
EXO 24:1
Thadou: “Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin, Pakai heng lama hung kal touvin nagma chule Aaron chule Nadab ahin, Abihu chule Isarel upate mi som sagi jong jaonan na boncha uva na hung diu ahiye. Gamlha thimma kon in chibai nahin boh diu ahi, ati.
English: He said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.

tcz: Mose bouseh Pakai heng'a hung lut thei ding, adangse vang khat'a khat cha jong Pakai heng na hin nailut thei lou diu ahiye, hitia chu Mose le mipi aboncha hung kilhon lut thei lou ding ahi, ati.
en: Moses alone shall come near to the LORD, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”
text:
EXO 24:2
Thadou: Mose bouseh Pakai heng'a hung lut thei ding, adangse vang khat'a khat cha jong Pakai heng na hin nailut thei lou diu ahiye, hitia chu Mose le mipi aboncha hung kilhon lut thei lou ding ahi, ati.
English: Moses alone shall come near to the LORD, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”

tcz: Chuin Mose jong akum suh tan Pakaiyin apeh chonna dan thu abonchan mipi ho heng'a aseipeh soh keiyun ahi. Mipin jong ki thutoh tah'in awkhat in adonbut uvin asei uve, “Pakaiyin asei chan chu aboncha kabol diu ahi,” tin asei uve.
en: Moses came and told the people all the LORD’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which the LORD has spoken will we do.”
text:
EXO 24:3
Thadou: Chuin Mose jong akum suh tan Pakaiyin apeh chonna dan thu abonchan mipi ho heng'a aseipeh soh keiyun ahi. Mipin jong ki thutoh tah'in awkhat in adonbut uvin asei uve, “Pakaiyin asei chan chu aboncha kabol diu ahi,” tin asei uve.
English: Moses came and told the people all the LORD’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which the LORD has spoken will we do.”

tcz: Mose in jong Pakai thupeh chengse abonchan a sundoh soh keiyin, jingkah matah in athou doh in, molsang chung lama chu Israel phungsom leni bang bang chun, Maicham a keng somleni neikhat asem doh tan ahi.
en: Moses wrote all the LORD’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
text:
EXO 24:4
Thadou: Mose in jong Pakai thupeh chengse abonchan a sundoh soh keiyin, jingkah matah in athou doh in, molsang chung lama chu Israel phungsom leni bang bang chun, Maicham a keng somleni neikhat asem doh tan ahi.
English: Moses wrote all the LORD’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

tcz: Mose'n jong Israel te lah'a gollhang sese a sol tan, ama hon abonchauvin Pakaiya din pumgo thil to ahin choi cheh tauvin ahi.
en: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to the LORD.
text:
EXO 24:5
Thadou: Mose'n jong Israel te lah'a gollhang sese a sol tan, ama hon abonchauvin Pakaiya din pumgo thil to ahin choi cheh tauvin ahi.
English: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to the LORD.

tcz: Mose'n jong thisan phabep pi chu athal in, twibel sung ho achun asung lut in ahi. Chule thisan kehlang khatse chu maicham maija a chap khum in ahi.”
en: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
text:
EXO 24:6
Thadou: Mose'n jong thisan phabep pi chu athal in, twibel sung ho achun asung lut in ahi. Chule thisan kehlang khatse chu maicham maija a chap khum in ahi.”
English: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n jong kitepna lekhabu chu ahin choiyin mipi angsung'a chun ahin phongdoh tan ahile, mipi'n jong abonchauvin asei uvin, “Pakaiyin a sei chan aboncha ka bol kimsoh kei uva, chule keiho hin asei chan kangai uva pha tah a ka umdiu ahi” tin asei uve.
en: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that the LORD has said, and be obedient.”
text:
EXO 24:7
Thadou: Chuin Mose'n jong kitepna lekhabu chu ahin choiyin mipi angsung'a chun ahin phongdoh tan ahile, mipi'n jong abonchauvin asei uvin, “Pakaiyin a sei chan aboncha ka bol kimsoh kei uva, chule keiho hin asei chan kangai uva pha tah a ka umdiu ahi” tin asei uve.
English: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that the LORD has said, and be obedient.”

tcz: Chuin Mose'n jong thisan phasah khat alan mipiho chu achap khum uvin, aseipeh taove, “vetaovin, Thu kisei doh chengse toh ki saiya Pakaiyin nangho dia hiche thisan hi kitepna asem ahi” ati.
en: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words.”
text:
EXO 24:8
Thadou: Chuin Mose'n jong thisan phasah khat alan mipiho chu achap khum uvin, aseipeh taove, “vetaovin, Thu kisei doh chengse toh ki saiya Pakaiyin nangho dia hiche thisan hi kitepna asem ahi” ati.
English: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words.”

tcz: Hi chengse a kichai jin, Mose, Aaron, Nadab chule abihu jaonan, Israel mite lah'a upa som sagi chu akal tou taovin ahi.
en: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.
text:
EXO 24:9
Thadou: Hi chengse a kichai jin, Mose, Aaron, Nadab chule abihu jaonan, Israel mite lah'a upa som sagi chu akal tou taovin ahi.
English: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.

tcz: Abonchauvin Israel mite Pathen chu aga mu tauvin, Pathen keng phang noiya chun Sapphire song jeng keng lampi khat ana um in, athen dan jong van chung vum kihohsel la theng bep bep'in ana um in ahi.
en: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.
text:
EXO 24:10
Thadou: Abonchauvin Israel mite Pathen chu aga mu tauvin, Pathen keng phang noiya chun Sapphire song jeng keng lampi khat ana um in, athen dan jong van chung vum kihohsel la theng bep bep'in ana um in ahi.
English: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Israel mite chung'a chun doumah abol tapon, Pathen loupina chu nasa tah'in amu tauvin ahile, anneh jong phatah in aki sem un ane uve.
en: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.
text:
EXO 24:11
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Israel mite chung'a chun doumah abol tapon, Pathen loupina chu nasa tah'in amu tauvin ahile, anneh jong phatah in aki sem un ane uve.
English: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei peh in, Molsang chung lama khun keima heng'a hung kal in lang, hiche laimunna chun neina ngah tem in, keiman mipiho heng'a chonna dan ka sei peh chan chu hiche song puma khu ka peh tha ding na hitai, ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”
text:
EXO 24:12
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a asei peh in, Molsang chung lama khun keima heng'a hung kal in lang, hiche laimunna chun neina ngah tem in, keiman mipiho heng'a chonna dan ka sei peh chan chu hiche song puma khu ka peh tha ding na hitai, ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”

tcz: Mose jong achetan, alhacha Joshua chu akipuije, chuin Pathen molsang chung lama chun akal tou tan ahi.
en: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.
text:
EXO 24:13
Thadou: Mose jong achetan, alhacha Joshua chu akipuije, chuin Pathen molsang chung lama chun akal tou tan ahi.
English: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.

tcz: Mose'n jong upa ho heng'a seipeh uvin, “Kei ni naheng uva ka hung kile kit kahse lhona hiche laimun na hi nana umjing diu ahi, Aaron le Hur vang nangho toh na umkhom jing diu, nalah uva koi hile seinom nei chan Amani heng'a che a aga sei ding ahiye, ati.
en: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”
text:
EXO 24:14
Thadou: Mose'n jong upa ho heng'a seipeh uvin, “Kei ni naheng uva ka hung kile kit kahse lhona hiche laimun na hi nana umjing diu ahi, Aaron le Hur vang nangho toh na umkhom jing diu, nalah uva koi hile seinom nei chan Amani heng'a che a aga sei ding ahiye, ati.
English: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”

tcz: Mose jong molsang lama akaltoutan ahile mei lhang in mol chu ahin tomlha jeng tan ahi.
en: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
text:
EXO 24:15
Thadou: Mose jong molsang lama akaltoutan ahile mei lhang in mol chu ahin tomlha jeng tan ahi.
English: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

tcz: Hichun Pakai loupina chu Sinai molsang chung'a ahung kingam jeng tan ahile, nigup sungse hiche molsang chu meilhang in atom in athim lha jeng tai, nisagi lhin nin meibol abonchan ahung kihoh doh tan ahile Pakaiyin Mose ahin kou vin ahi.
en: The LORD’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.
text:
EXO 24:16
Thadou: Hichun Pakai loupina chu Sinai molsang chung'a ahung kingam jeng tan ahile, nigup sungse hiche molsang chu meilhang in atom in athim lha jeng tai, nisagi lhin nin meibol abonchan ahung kihoh doh tan ahile Pakaiyin Mose ahin kou vin ahi.
English: The LORD’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.

tcz: Molsang chung vumma Pakai loupina ahung kilah jeng chu Israel mite jouse mitmun jong meikong in thil akah vam tabang in amu tauvin ahiye.
en: The appearance of the LORD’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.
text:
EXO 24:17
Thadou: Molsang chung vumma Pakai loupina ahung kilah jeng chu Israel mite jouse mitmun jong meikong in thil akah vam tabang in amu tauvin ahiye.
English: The appearance of the LORD’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.

tcz: Mose chu Meibang kiheh lah a chun ache lut tan ahile, Mose jong molsang chung vum lama chun nisom li le jan som li a hung umden tan ahi.
en: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
text:
EXO 24:18
Thadou: Mose chu Meibang kiheh lah a chun ache lut tan ahile, Mose jong molsang chung vum lama chun nisom li le jan som li a hung umden tan ahi.
English: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
EXO 25:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jouse heng'a seipeh inlang, keima henglam'a thilto ding adon khom diu, amichang cheh keima ding'a thiltoh doh nom chan in thil hin dong khom cheh uhen, ati.
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.
text:
EXO 25:2
Thadou: Israel chate jouse heng'a seipeh inlang, keima henglam'a thilto ding adon khom diu, amichang cheh keima ding'a thiltoh doh nom chan in thil hin dong khom cheh uhen, ati.
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.

tcz: Israel chate jouse'a konna na don diu thil ho chu hicheng hi hiding ahite: “Sana, dangka, chule sum eng hiding ahi.
en: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,
text:
EXO 25:3
Thadou: Israel chate jouse'a konna na don diu thil ho chu hicheng hi hiding ahite: “Sana, dangka, chule sum eng hiding ahi.
English: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

tcz: A eng-dup, asan dup, asan thim, ho leh kelcha vun hose hiding,
en: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
text:
EXO 25:4
Thadou: A eng-dup, asan dup, asan thim, ho leh kelcha vun hose hiding,
English: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

tcz: Chule aki jut jolsa kelngoi chal vun, kelcha vun jao nan thinggi thing hi ding ahiye.
en: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
text:
EXO 25:5
Thadou: Chule aki jut jolsa kelngoi chal vun, kelcha vun jao nan thinggi thing hi ding ahiye.
English: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

tcz: Thaomei hoa manchah ding thaotwi jong, kinujol nading thao twi tah jaona hi ding ahi.
en: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
text:
EXO 25:6
Thadou: Thaomei hoa manchah ding thaotwi jong, kinujol nading thao twi tah jaona hi ding ahi.
English: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

tcz: Thempu in aki-O ding leh alengkou chung a a kikhai ding song mantam chu hi ding ahi.
en: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
text:
EXO 25:7
Thadou: Thempu in aki-O ding leh alengkou chung a a kikhai ding song mantam chu hi ding ahi.
English: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

tcz: Chujou teng Israel mite lailung a ka chenna ding muntheng tah khat na sem doh ding ahi.
en: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
text:
EXO 25:8
Thadou: Chujou teng Israel mite lailung a ka chenna ding muntheng tah khat na sem doh ding ahi.
English: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

tcz: Houbuh le asunga thilkeo ding ho aboncha ka vet sah ding hiche dung jui'a chu na bol diu ahiye, ati.
en: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.
text:
EXO 25:9
Thadou: Houbuh le asunga thilkeo ding ho aboncha ka vet sah ding hiche dung jui'a chu na bol diu ahiye, ati.
English: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.

tcz: Israel miten thinggi thing mangcha'a thingkong khat asem diu hichu, adung tongni, tong keh khatna sao hi ding, avai tongkhat le tongkeh'a sao chu asem ding u ahiye.
en: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
text:
EXO 25:10
Thadou: Israel miten thinggi thing mangcha'a thingkong khat asem diu hichu, adung tongni, tong keh khatna sao hi ding, avai tongkhat le tongkeh'a sao chu asem ding u ahiye.
English: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

tcz: Thingkong chu asung ahin apo sana a natom jol ding, agei gol jong sana a natom jol ding ahi.
en: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.
text:
EXO 25:11
Thadou: Thingkong chu asung ahin apo sana a natom jol ding, agei gol jong sana a natom jol ding ahi.
English: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

tcz: Hiche thingkong'a manchah ding achu sana chao kol li nalhah jun ding, chaokol ni chu thingkong pang lang khat'a akeng teni chung'a na khai ding, khat teni machu alang khat teni chung'a na khai lhah ding ahiye.
en: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
text:
EXO 25:12
Thadou: Hiche thingkong'a manchah ding achu sana chao kol li nalhah jun ding, chaokol ni chu thingkong pang lang khat'a akeng teni chung'a na khai ding, khat teni machu alang khat teni chung'a na khai lhah ding ahiye.
English: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

tcz: Nangman thinggi chu mol lhon ni tah nasui ding, hiche mol lhon teni chu anigella sana twiya natom jolsel ding ahi.
en: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
text:
EXO 25:13
Thadou: Nangman thinggi chu mol lhon ni tah nasui ding, hiche mol lhon teni chu anigella sana twiya natom jolsel ding ahi.
English: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

tcz: Hiche mol lhon teni chu kong putna kimang thing ahin hichu apang lang khat'a chaokol teni sung'a chu nathol lut cheh cheh ding ahiye.
en: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
text:
EXO 25:14
Thadou: Hiche mol lhon teni chu kong putna kimang thing ahin hichu apang lang khat'a chaokol teni sung'a chu nathol lut cheh cheh ding ahiye.
English: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.

tcz: Mol lhon teni chu thingkong pang a chaokol ki khai lha teni sung'a chu aputna dia kikhai den jing ding, hiche mol lhon teni chu koi macha gache a aga sut lhah lou hel ding ahiye.
en: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.
text:
EXO 25:15
Thadou: Mol lhon teni chu thingkong pang a chaokol ki khai lha teni sung'a chu aputna dia kikhai den jing ding, hiche mol lhon teni chu koi macha gache a aga sut lhah lou hel ding ahiye.
English: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.

tcz: Hiche thingkong sung keiman ka peh ding hettoh sahna chu na khum lut ding ahi, ati.
en: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.
text:
EXO 25:16
Thadou: Hiche thingkong sung keiman ka peh ding hettoh sahna chu na khum lut ding ahi, ati.
English: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

tcz: Sana touna chu na lah ding hiche a chu ngailut hepi touna khat na sem doh ding, hichu avai tongkhat le tong keh'a hi ding ahi.
en: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
text:
EXO 25:17
Thadou: Sana touna chu na lah ding hiche a chu ngailut hepi touna khat na sem doh ding, hichu avai tongkhat le tong keh'a hi ding ahi.
English: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

tcz: Nangman jong sana cherub ni nasem ding hichu ngailut hepi touna among lang tenia nakhet beh ding ahiye.
en: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
text:
EXO 25:18
Thadou: Nangman jong sana cherub ni nasem ding hichu ngailut hepi touna among lang tenia nakhet beh ding ahiye.
English: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

tcz: Amang lang khat'a ding chu cherub khat nasem teitei ding, ngailut hepi touna among lama ding'a na boncha uva Cherub nasem cheh cheh diu ahi.
en: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.
text:
EXO 25:19
Thadou: Amang lang khat'a ding chu cherub khat nasem teitei ding, ngailut hepi touna among lama ding'a na boncha uva Cherub nasem cheh cheh diu ahi.
English: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.

tcz: Cherub lha teni chung ani gel'a a chunglam angat lhon ding, alhate nichun ani gel'a ngailut hepi touna chu alekhu teitei lhon ding ahi.
en: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.
text:
EXO 25:20
Thadou: Cherub lha teni chung ani gel'a a chunglam angat lhon ding, alhate nichun ani gel'a ngailut hepi touna chu alekhu teitei lhon ding ahi.
English: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.

tcz: Hiche mun na chu keiman nang ka hin kimu peding, Ngailut hepi touna le hettoh sahna thingkong chung'a um Cherub teni kikah achu keiman Israel chate ding'a thil man lutah ka sei ding hichu keiman thu peh'a kapeh ding nahiye, ati.
en: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.
text:
EXO 25:22
Thadou: Hiche mun na chu keiman nang ka hin kimu peding, Ngailut hepi touna le hettoh sahna thingkong chung'a um Cherub teni kikah achu keiman Israel chate ding'a thil man lutah ka sei ding hichu keiman thu peh'a kapeh ding nahiye, ati.
English: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.

tcz: Thinggi thing na manchah ding hichu dokhang khat na sem ding, adung tong nia sao hi ding, avai lang tong khat hi ding, atun tong khat le akeh sao hi ding ahi.
en: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.
text:
EXO 25:23
Thadou: Thinggi thing na manchah ding hichu dokhang khat na sem ding, adung tong nia sao hi ding, avai lang tong khat hi ding, atun tong khat le akeh sao hi ding ahi.
English: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.

tcz: Hiche dokhang chu sana thengsella phatah'a natom khum ding, apam jouse aboncha sana keu seh'a natom peh ding ahi.
en: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
text:
EXO 25:24
Thadou: Hiche dokhang chu sana thengsella phatah'a natom khum ding, apam jouse aboncha sana keu seh'a natom peh ding ahi.
English: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

tcz: Dokhang kim vel'a chu a kol'a kiveithei ding ban jang toh ki bang'a lenkhat na kaikol ding, hiche akim vel'a kivei kol jong chu sana'a kijem lhah ding ahiye.
en: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.
text:
EXO 25:25
Thadou: Dokhang kim vel'a chu a kol'a kiveithei ding ban jang toh ki bang'a lenkhat na kaikol ding, hiche akim vel'a kivei kol jong chu sana'a kijem lhah ding ahiye.
English: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.

tcz: Dokhang'a manchah ding sana chaokol li nasem ding, hiche chaokol li chu dokhang keng ningli hosea chu naba peh ding ahi.
en: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.
text:
EXO 25:26
Thadou: Dokhang'a manchah ding sana chaokol li nasem ding, hiche chaokol li chu dokhang keng ningli hosea chu naba peh ding ahi.
English: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.

tcz: Dokhang kol kimvel chule chaokol hose chu kimatsoh kei ding, dokhang chu akijon teng le hiche chaokol ho achu thing jol thil lut ding chu teng kipuding ahi.
en: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.
text:
EXO 25:27
Thadou: Dokhang kol kimvel chule chaokol hose chu kimatsoh kei ding, dokhang chu akijon teng le hiche chaokol ho achu thing jol thil lut ding chu teng kipuding ahi.
English: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.

tcz: Thinggi thing phatah'a moljol phasah pikhat nasui nam ding hichengse chu sana'a natom jol ding, moljol hosese chu dokhang jon na le a kimang ding ahi.
en: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
text:
EXO 25:28
Thadou: Thinggi thing phatah'a moljol phasah pikhat nasui nam ding hichengse chu sana'a natom jol ding, moljol hosese chu dokhang jon na le a kimang ding ahi.
English: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

tcz: Lheng kong phasah pikhat na koi ding, lengpi twi sunlut nathei lheng le hai khat jong nakoi tha ding ahiye; hichu aboncha sana a natom jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.
text:
EXO 25:29
Thadou: Lheng kong phasah pikhat na koi ding, lengpi twi sunlut nathei lheng le hai khat jong nakoi tha ding ahiye; hichu aboncha sana a natom jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.

tcz: Hiche bang bang'a chu nangman jong keima ka umjing nai ti photchetna ding'a dokhang chung'a keima changlhah na koi jing ding ahi, ati.
en: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.
text:
EXO 25:30
Thadou: Hiche bang bang'a chu nangman jong keima ka umjing nai ti photchetna ding'a dokhang chung'a keima changlhah na koi jing ding ahi, ati.
English: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

tcz: Sana keu seh'a kisem thaomei khom khat nasem ding, thaomei tunna ding'a akhom chu sehcha'a na khet beh ding, akhon hose le alu langse chule pahcha a kijem chengse aboncha thakhat chat'a kigom khom ding ahi.
en: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.
text:
EXO 25:31
Thadou: Sana keu seh'a kisem thaomei khom khat nasem ding, thaomei tunna ding'a akhom chu sehcha'a na khet beh ding, akhon hose le alu langse chule pahcha a kijem chengse aboncha thakhat chat'a kigom khom ding ahi.
English: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

tcz: Thaomei phung ajet le avei apat abah gup hung um doh ding, thaomei pang lang khat a abah thum hung um doh ding chule khat lang'a ma chu abah thum hung kisep doh ding ahi.
en: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;

tcz: Hiche abah khat cheh apat chu thingga jom'a kisem doh bang'a khon thum chule aluchang umdoh ding, hichea pahcha jouse jong jaonan, hiti chun thaomei phung'a kon chun abah ahung jam doh'in ahi.
en: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;

tcz: Thaomei khomjong chu thingga ajom bang bang'a kisem khon li ahin alulam jaonan apahcha jouse chutoh ajao vin ahi.
en: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

tcz: Thaomei phung'a kon hung jamdoh abah gup chengse chu aluchang lamtoh thakhat chat'a hung soh doh tha ding ahiye.
en: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
text:
EXO 25:35
Thadou: Thaomei phung'a kon hung jamdoh abah gup chengse chu aluchang lamtoh thakhat chat'a hung soh doh tha ding ahiye.
English: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

tcz: A lulam se ho chu toh thaomei chu thakhat chat'a hung um ding, thaomei pumpi chu sehcha a kideng toh chet chet hiding, hichu sana theng sel'a kimang cha hiding ahi.
en: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
text:
EXO 25:36
Thadou: A lulam se ho chu toh thaomei chu thakhat chat'a hung um ding, thaomei pumpi chu sehcha a kideng toh chet chet hiding, hichu sana theng sel'a kimang cha hiding ahi.
English: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

tcz: Hichea det kong ding'a thaomei sagi na sem ding, amalam salvah dia hiche thaomei sagi ho chu tun doh cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.
text:
EXO 25:37
Thadou: Hichea det kong ding'a thaomei sagi na sem ding, amalam salvah dia hiche thaomei sagi ho chu tun doh cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.

tcz: Amei kong at tan na ding choi che ahin adop na kong tong aboncha sana twiya kisem jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.
text:
EXO 25:38
Thadou: Amei kong at tan na ding choi che ahin adop na kong tong aboncha sana twiya kisem jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.

tcz: Hichea kimangcha thilkeo jouse chu aboncha sana thengset a kisem cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.
text:
EXO 25:39
Thadou: Hichea kimangcha thilkeo jouse chu aboncha sana thengset a kisem cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.

tcz: Ven! hiche ho jouse hi aboncha molsang chunga alim nakimusah bang bang a nasem doh ding ahi, ati.
en: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.
text:
EXO 25:40
Thadou: Ven! hiche ho jouse hi aboncha molsang chunga alim nakimusah bang bang a nasem doh ding ahi, ati.
English: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.

tcz: Nangman nasah ding houbuh chu tupet pon'a kikhong hiding, pondal som khat'a nasah ding, pondum chule pon pol them naman khom ding, pondal chengse chu Cherub ho lim hoitah'a kisem bang'a nakhai cheh cheh ding'u ahiye. Hichengsea chu houbuh nasah ding ahi.
en: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.
text:
EXO 26:1
Thadou: Nangman nasah ding houbuh chu tupet pon'a kikhong hiding, pondal som khat'a nasah ding, pondum chule pon pol them naman khom ding, pondal chengse chu Cherub ho lim hoitah'a kisem bang'a nakhai cheh cheh ding'u ahiye. Hichengsea chu houbuh nasah ding ahi.
English: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.

tcz: Pondal tinchang chu adung tong som ni le tong get'a len le sao hiding, pondal khat cheh vang chu tong li cheh hiding, pondal kiti phot aboncha adung avai alet le aneo dan kibang cheh cheh ding ahiye.
en: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.
text:
EXO 26:2
Thadou: Pondal tinchang chu adung tong som ni le tong get'a len le sao hiding, pondal khat cheh vang chu tong li cheh hiding, pondal kiti phot aboncha adung avai alet le aneo dan kibang cheh cheh ding ahiye.
English: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.

tcz: Pondal nga chengse vang chu kigom soh keiding chule alang khat'a pondal nga jong chu kigom soh kei ding ahi.
en: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.
text:
EXO 26:3
Thadou: Pondal nga chengse vang chu kigom soh keiding chule alang khat'a pondal nga jong chu kigom soh kei ding ahi.
English: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.

tcz: Pondal masa chengse chu aninggol hoa akol kol'a tampi patdum'a nasem ding, hichebang bang'a chu pondal gol niloilah'a apam nung pen pondal gol lah'a chu abil nasut hom ding akol kola tampi nasem doh ding ahi.
en: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.
text:
EXO 26:4
Thadou: Pondal masa chengse chu aninggol hoa akol kol'a tampi patdum'a nasem ding, hichebang bang'a chu pondal gol niloilah'a apam nung pen pondal gol lah'a chu abil nasut hom ding akol kola tampi nasem doh ding ahi.
English: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.

tcz: Pondal kimkhat chu abil navu hom pehding akol kol somnga nasem peh ding, chule pondal kolni lhinna gollah ajong abil navu ding akoljong somnga jen nasem peh ding ahi. Akol navu hom chengse chu amacheh lhing'a toding ahi.
en: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.
text:
EXO 26:5
Thadou: Pondal kimkhat chu abil navu hom pehding akol kol somnga nasem peh ding, chule pondal kolni lhinna gollah ajong abil navu ding akoljong somnga jen nasem peh ding ahi. Akol navu hom chengse chu amacheh lhing'a toding ahi.
English: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.

tcz: Sana kol somnga nasem ding, hiche sana sumkol ho achu pondal chengse chu na kaimat cheh cheh ding, chuteng houbuh thil hojouse kigom khomma houbuh khat'a nasah doh ding ahi.
en: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.
text:
EXO 26:6
Thadou: Sana kol somnga nasem ding, hiche sana sumkol ho achu pondal chengse chu na kaimat cheh cheh ding, chuteng houbuh thil hojouse kigom khomma houbuh khat'a nasah doh ding ahi.
English: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.

tcz: Houbuh chung khuna ding nangman kelcha mul'a kikhong pon phabep naman chah ding, agoma ding'a pondal somle khat nasem ding ahiye.
en: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.
text:
EXO 26:7
Thadou: Houbuh chung khuna ding nangman kelcha mul'a kikhong pon phabep naman chah ding, agoma ding'a pondal somle khat nasem ding ahiye.
English: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

tcz: Pondal khat'a tongsom'a sao hi ding chule avai tong li cheh hiding, hiche pondal som le khat se chu aboncha alet le aneo dan kibang chet ding ahi.
en: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.
text:
EXO 26:8
Thadou: Pondal khat'a tongsom'a sao hi ding chule avai tong li cheh hiding, hiche pondal som le khat se chu aboncha alet le aneo dan kibang chet ding ahi.
English: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.

tcz: Pondal ngaho vang chu nakil mat soh kei ding, adang pondal gup jong na kilmat soh keiya, agup channa pondal vang chu ponbuh maiya chu na khu ding ahi.
en: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.
text:
EXO 26:9
Thadou: Pondal ngaho vang chu nakil mat soh kei ding, adang pondal gup jong na kilmat soh keiya, agup channa pondal vang chu ponbuh maiya chu na khu ding ahi.
English: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.

tcz: “Chule pondal golmasa pen chu apam chin lah'a akol somnga jen nasem ding, pondal golni channa jong chu aning gol hoa akol somnga mama navu hom ding ahi.”
en: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.
text:
EXO 26:10
Thadou: “Chule pondal golmasa pen chu apam chin lah'a akol somnga jen nasem ding, pondal golni channa jong chu aning gol hoa akol somnga mama navu hom ding ahi.”
English: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.

tcz: Nangman sum eng somnga jen na sem ding, sumkol hose chu aboncha pondal kol navu hom hoa chu nathil lut ding, ajeh chu ponbuh chu khatseh'a akitun doh na ding'a na kaimat soh kei ding ahiye.
en: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
text:
EXO 26:11
Thadou: Nangman sum eng somnga jen na sem ding, sumkol hose chu aboncha pondal kol navu hom hoa chu nathil lut ding, ajeh chu ponbuh chu khatseh'a akitun doh na ding'a na kaimat soh kei ding ahiye.
English: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

tcz: Chule ponbuh'a pondal amoh chengse chu, houbuh ponbuh nunglama chu nakailhah sah cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
text:
EXO 26:12
Thadou: Chule ponbuh'a pondal amoh chengse chu, houbuh ponbuh nunglama chu nakailhah sah cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

tcz: Ponbuh kisahna'a amoh chengse ho chu alang khat'a hihen khat lang a hijong le, houbuh lang to gella ding'a tongkhat cheh kikhai lhasuh ding ahi.
en: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
text:
EXO 26:13
Thadou: Ponbuh kisahna'a amoh chengse ho chu alang khat'a hihen khat lang a hijong le, houbuh lang to gella ding'a tongkhat cheh kikhai lhasuh ding ahi.
English: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

tcz: “Hiche ponbuh khu nading'a chu nangman jong kelgnoi chal vun le kelcha vun nemlai jeng naman chah ding ahiye.
en: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
text:
EXO 26:14
Thadou: “Hiche ponbuh khu nading'a chu nangman jong kelgnoi chal vun le kelcha vun nemlai jeng naman chah ding ahiye.
English: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

tcz: Houbuh'a manchah thil ho chu nanagman thinggi thing jol namsella nasem cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
text:
EXO 26:15
Thadou: Houbuh'a manchah thil ho chu nanagman thinggi thing jol namsella nasem cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.

tcz: Kol khat'a naman chah ding chu tongsom hiding, akol khat ding chu avai tongkhat'a sao le tong keh hiding ahi. Akol khatna tongsom hiding, chule akol khat ding chu avai tong khat le tong keh hiding ahi.
en: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.
text:
EXO 26:16
Thadou: Kol khat'a naman chah ding chu tongsom hiding, akol khat ding chu avai tongkhat'a sao le tong keh hiding ahi. Akol khatna tongsom hiding, chule akol khat ding chu avai tong khat le tong keh hiding ahi.
English: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.

tcz: Hiche thing kol khat cheh chu among lang'a abil navu hom peh cheh ding, houbuh thing kol jouse chu aboncha abil nahoi peh cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
text:
EXO 26:17
Thadou: Hiche thing kol khat cheh chu among lang'a abil navu hom peh cheh ding, houbuh thing kol jouse chu aboncha abil nahoi peh cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

tcz: Houbuh ding'a thing kol nasem peh ding chule lhang lamma dingse chu aboncha thing kol som cheh hiding ahi.
en: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.
text:
EXO 26:18
Thadou: Houbuh ding'a thing kol nasem peh ding chule lhang lamma dingse chu aboncha thing kol som cheh hiding ahi.
English: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.

tcz: Thing kol khat cheh le among lang suhmat nading'a chu, thingkol som in chung'a pansa ding'a abil hom somin nadinga'a dangka'a kisem abiltom somli nasem ding, thingkol khat among lang'a chu asuh mat nathei ding abil tom ni cheh nasem peh ding ahi.
en: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
text:
EXO 26:19
Thadou: Thing kol khat cheh le among lang suhmat nading'a chu, thingkol som in chung'a pansa ding'a abil hom somin nadinga'a dangka'a kisem abiltom somli nasem ding, thingkol khat among lang'a chu asuh mat nathei ding abil tom ni cheh nasem peh ding ahi.
English: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

tcz: A golni channa houbuh chung lamkaiya pang ding chu thingkol som nia nasem ding ahi.”
en: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,
text:
EXO 26:20
Thadou: A golni channa houbuh chung lamkaiya pang ding chu thingkol som nia nasem ding ahi.”
English: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,

tcz: Dangka'a kitomjol abil somli hiding, thing kol khat mong lang'a pang ding chu abil tomni hiding chule thingkol lang khat'a pansa ding jong chu abil tomni mama hi ding ahi.
en: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
text:
EXO 26:21
Thadou: Dangka'a kitomjol abil somli hiding, thing kol khat mong lang'a pang ding chu abil tomni hiding chule thingkol lang khat'a pansa ding jong chu abil tomni mama hi ding ahi.
English: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

tcz: Lhumlam nga'a houbuh nunglama pang ding chu thing kol gup nasem peh ding ahi.
en: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.
text:
EXO 26:22
Thadou: Lhumlam nga'a houbuh nunglama pang ding chu thing kol gup nasem peh ding ahi.
English: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

tcz: Chule houbuh nunglama'a pang dia abiltomma ding'a ni mama na sem peh ding ahiye.
en: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.
text:
EXO 26:23
Thadou: Chule houbuh nunglama'a pang dia abiltomma ding'a ni mama na sem peh ding ahiye.
English: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.

tcz: Hiche thing kol teni chu anoi lam douva pang lhon ding, chule a lulam'a vang chu chaokol masapen chutoh adangho kaimat na a pang ding ahi. Hiche teni chu aning koltenia pang ding mong mong ahiye.
en: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
text:
EXO 26:24
Thadou: Hiche thing kol teni chu anoi lam douva pang lhon ding, chule a lulam'a vang chu chaokol masapen chutoh adangho kaimat na a pang ding ahi. Hiche teni chu aning koltenia pang ding mong mong ahiye.
English: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

tcz: Dangka a kisem abil tom hojouse chu a gomma thingkol get hi ding, abil tom aboncha somle get lhing ding ahi; thingkol khat a pang ding chu abikol tom hi ding, anoija pang ding ma chu abiltom ni mama hi ding ahiye.
en: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
text:
EXO 26:25
Thadou: Dangka a kisem abil tom hojouse chu a gomma thingkol get hi ding, abil tom aboncha somle get lhing ding ahi; thingkol khat a pang ding chu abikol tom hi ding, anoija pang ding ma chu abiltom ni mama hi ding ahiye.
English: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

tcz: Houbuh lang khatna thingkol chengsea vang chu thinggi'a kisui nam kotgol nga nasem ding ahi.
en: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
text:
EXO 26:26
Thadou: Houbuh lang khatna thingkol chengsea vang chu thinggi'a kisui nam kotgol nga nasem ding ahi.
English: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

tcz: Hichu houbuh lang khat'a thingkol hose avaiya pang ding'a nga nasem ding, chule houbuh nunglama lhum lama pansa dinga agol'a jam ding'a ngama nasui ding ahi.
en: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.
text:
EXO 26:27
Thadou: Hichu houbuh lang khat'a thingkol hose avaiya pang ding'a nga nasem ding, chule houbuh nunglama lhum lama pansa dinga agol'a jam ding'a ngama nasui ding ahi.
English: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.

tcz: Chule thing kol chengse chu akimlaija pang ding'a alailha pen chu among langto gella ding'a pang ding ahi.”
en: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.
text:
EXO 26:28
Thadou: Chule thing kol chengse chu akimlaija pang ding'a alailha pen chu among langto gella ding'a pang ding ahi.”
English: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.

tcz: Hiche thingkol chengse chu aboncha sana'a natomjol selding chaokol hojouse jong chu aboncha sana ‘a natom jol ding, agola kijam jouse jong chu sana mama'a natom jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.
text:
EXO 26:29
Thadou: Hiche thingkol chengse chu aboncha sana'a natomjol selding chaokol hojouse jong chu aboncha sana ‘a natom jol ding, agola kijam jouse jong chu sana mama'a natom jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.

tcz: Molsang chung'a houbuh na kimu sah bang bang'a na tundoh teitei ding ahi.
en: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.
text:
EXO 26:30
Thadou: Molsang chung'a houbuh na kimu sah bang bang'a na tundoh teitei ding ahi.
English: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.

tcz: Chu teng houbuh chu pondum, ponsandup chule ponsan pol thim naman chah ding ponbuh chu nakhu ding, tupat ponnem ma ki khong naman chah tei teija; hiche pon ho chu aboncha khut a kikhong cheh cheh hiding, cherub lim bang'a kikhong ding ahi.
en: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.
text:
EXO 26:31
Thadou: Chu teng houbuh chu pondum, ponsandup chule ponsan pol thim naman chah ding ponbuh chu nakhu ding, tupat ponnem ma ki khong naman chah tei teija; hiche pon ho chu aboncha khut a kikhong cheh cheh hiding, cherub lim bang'a kikhong ding ahi.
English: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.

tcz: Chule aponchu sana akitom jol hiding thinggi thing'a kisui khom li chung'a hiding, abilkol a kol li ho achu na khai lhah cheh ding ahi.
en: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.
text:
EXO 26:32
Thadou: Chule aponchu sana akitom jol hiding thinggi thing'a kisui khom li chung'a hiding, abilkol a kol li ho achu na khai lhah cheh ding ahi.
English: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.

tcz: Alukhuh asumkol hochu na khai lhah cheh cheh ding, hettohsahna thingkong jong chu pon lukhuh noija chu nahin koi ding ahiye; hichu pon lukhuna akona chu mungtheng chung nung nga konna chu muntheng laichu na sem khen diu ahi.”
en: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.
text:
EXO 26:33
Thadou: Alukhuh asumkol hochu na khai lhah cheh cheh ding, hettohsahna thingkong jong chu pon lukhuh noija chu nahin koi ding ahiye; hichu pon lukhuna akona chu mungtheng chung nung nga konna chu muntheng laichu na sem khen diu ahi.”
English: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.

tcz: Chu teng het-tohsah na thing kong muntheng laiya chu hepi touna khat na do ding ahi.
en: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.
text:
EXO 26:34
Thadou: Chu teng het-tohsah na thing kong muntheng laiya chu hepi touna khat na do ding ahi.
English: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.

tcz: Pon lukhuna polama achu dokhang khat nasem ding houbuh lhang lama dokhang toh kinga to lhon ding akimlai tah achu thao Meivah natun ding ahi; hiche dokhang chu sahlam sang a nadoh doh ding ahi.”
en: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.
text:
EXO 26:35
Thadou: Pon lukhuna polama achu dokhang khat nasem ding houbuh lhang lama dokhang toh kinga to lhon ding akimlai tah achu thao Meivah natun ding ahi; hiche dokhang chu sahlam sang a nadoh doh ding ahi.”
English: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.

tcz: Ponbuh kot maiya ding chu pon dum leh pon sendup chule ponsan pol thim. Tupat pon nemma heojang pahcha jem kijepna hoa bou nasem peh ding ahi.
en: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.
text:
EXO 26:36
Thadou: Ponbuh kot maiya ding chu pon dum leh pon sendup chule ponsan pol thim. Tupat pon nemma heojang pahcha jem kijepna hoa bou nasem peh ding ahi.
English: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.

tcz: Pondah na ding'a thinggi khom nga nasui ding, hichengse chu aboncha sana a natom jolsel ding, akikhai lhah nading thihkol chengse jong sana twiya kisem jeng hiding, abil tom nga jong chu sum eng jenga nasem cheh cheh ding ahiye, ati.
en: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.
text:
EXO 26:37
Thadou: Pondah na ding'a thinggi khom nga nasui ding, hichengse chu aboncha sana a natom jolsel ding, akikhai lhah nading thihkol chengse jong sana twiya kisem jeng hiding, abil tom nga jong chu sum eng jenga nasem cheh cheh ding ahiye, ati.
English: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.

tcz: Chule maicham ding'a thinggi thing naman chah ding, maicham chu bempel'a kisem hi ding, hichu tong nga'a sao hiding, maicham chu abem pilla kisem hiding, asan lam vang chu tong thumma kisem ding ahi.”
en: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.
text:
EXO 27:1
Thadou: Chule maicham ding'a thinggi thing naman chah ding, maicham chu bempel'a kisem hi ding, hichu tong nga'a sao hiding, maicham chu abem pilla kisem hiding, asan lam vang chu tong thumma kisem ding ahi.”
English: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.

tcz: Maicham gol'a pang ding'a aki li na sem ding, aki sese chu maicham toh kigom khom cheh ding, hiche aki chengse chu sana'a natom jolsel ding ahi.
en: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.
text:
EXO 27:2
Thadou: Maicham gol'a pang ding'a aki li na sem ding, aki sese chu maicham toh kigom khom cheh ding, hiche aki chengse chu sana'a natom jolsel ding ahi.
English: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.

tcz: Vutvam ho lo doh nading'a bel phabep khat na sem ding, khe keh jong phabep khat nasui ding, twibel jong chule sumkhe jong nasem ding khangbel phabep khat jong nasem ding, manchah thilkeu jouse chu aboncha sum eng jeng a kisem hicheh cheh ding ahi.
en: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.
text:
EXO 27:3
Thadou: Vutvam ho lo doh nading'a bel phabep khat na sem ding, khe keh jong phabep khat nasui ding, twibel jong chule sumkhe jong nasem ding khangbel phabep khat jong nasem ding, manchah thilkeu jouse chu aboncha sum eng jeng a kisem hicheh cheh ding ahi.
