English: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

tcz: Maicham'a pansa ding chu kipheh chah kheh khat nasem ding, hichu len pheh'a kipheh chah kheh bang a na sem ma achunga chu sum eng koli jen na koi ding ahiye.
en: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.
text:
EXO 27:4
Thadou: Maicham'a pansa ding chu kipheh chah kheh khat nasem ding, hichu len pheh'a kipheh chah kheh bang a na sem ma achunga chu sum eng koli jen na koi ding ahiye.
English: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

tcz: Hichu maicham thinggi jol noija chu na koi ding, hitia chu lenpheh'a kipeh chah kheh chu akimlai tah'a hung kijung lhah ding ahiye.
en: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
text:
EXO 27:5
Thadou: Hichu maicham thinggi jol noija chu na koi ding, hitia chu lenpheh'a kipeh chah kheh chu akimlai tah'a hung kijung lhah ding ahiye.
English: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

tcz: Maicham putna ding'a moljol ni nasem ding hichu thinggi jeng na sem ding aboncha sana'a na tom jolsel ding ahi.
en: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.
text:
EXO 27:6
Thadou: Maicham putna ding'a moljol ni nasem ding hichu thinggi jeng na sem ding aboncha sana'a na tom jolsel ding ahi.
English: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

tcz: Hichu thingpel tabang'a nasem ding, alai nahom sah ding, molsang lama na kimusah bang a aboncha na bol sohkei ding ahi.
en: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.
text:
EXO 27:8
Thadou: Hichu thingpel tabang'a nasem ding, alai nahom sah ding, molsang lama na kimusah bang a aboncha na bol sohkei ding ahi.
English: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.

tcz: Houbuh munlaise chu pal naget khum cheh cheh ding, lhang lama pang ding pondal kikhai lha chengse chu tupat pon nemma kikhong hiding hichu pondal tong jakhat a sao naman chah ding ahi.
en: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.
text:
EXO 27:9
Thadou: Houbuh munlaise chu pal naget khum cheh cheh ding, lhang lama pang ding pondal kikhai lha chengse chu tupat pon nemma kikhong hiding hichu pondal tong jakhat a sao naman chah ding ahi.
English: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.

tcz: Akikhai lhah na ding khom jong agomma somni hiding, aboncha keija sum eng jeng'a kisem hiding ahiye. Akhompi'a pang ding le aning lah'a chengse vang chu aboncha dangka a kisem cheh cheh hi ding ahi.
en: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
text:
EXO 27:10
Thadou: Akikhai lhah na ding khom jong agomma somni hiding, aboncha keija sum eng jeng'a kisem hiding ahiye. Akhompi'a pang ding le aning lah'a chengse vang chu aboncha dangka a kisem cheh cheh hi ding ahi.
English: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

tcz: Pal kigen sah lamse'a chu pondal na khai lhung kei ding, aboncha sum eng jeng jakhat'a kikhai lha'a nasem ding, akhom ning dung'a pang thih koi chengse le alutom ho jouse aboncha dangka'a na sem peh ding ahi.
en: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
text:
EXO 27:11
Thadou: Pal kigen sah lamse'a chu pondal na khai lhung kei ding, aboncha sum eng jeng jakhat'a kikhai lha'a nasem ding, akhom ning dung'a pang thih koi chengse le alutom ho jouse aboncha dangka'a na sem peh ding ahi.
English: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

tcz: Nilhum lama pang pal kigen avaiya um chengse chu somnga jeng na khailhah ding, khompi som khat se chu atunlut nadinga somkhat cheh kisem ding ahi.
en: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
text:
EXO 27:12
Thadou: Nilhum lama pang pal kigen avaiya um chengse chu somnga jeng na khailhah ding, khompi som khat se chu atunlut nadinga somkhat cheh kisem ding ahi.
English: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

tcz: Nisom lama pal kigen maiya chu avai lang pang tong somnga nasem ding ahi.
en: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
text:
EXO 27:13
Thadou: Nisom lama pal kigen maiya chu avai lang pang tong somnga nasem ding ahi.
English: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

tcz: Kelkot'a pat alang khat sese a pondal vangchu tong som le tong nga'a sao ding, atun nading khom phung thum toh khomko thum hitha teitei ding ahi.
en: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
text:
EXO 27:14
Thadou: Kelkot'a pat alang khat sese a pondal vangchu tong som le tong nga'a sao ding, atun nading khom phung thum toh khomko thum hitha teitei ding ahi.
English: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

tcz: Alang khat'a pang ding pondal jonchu tong som le tong nga hiding, akhom pi phung thum jaona atunna ding thum toh hitha ding ahi.
en: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
text:
EXO 27:15
Thadou: Alang khat'a pang ding pondal jonchu tong som le tong nga hiding, akhom pi phung thum jaona atunna ding thum toh hitha ding ahi.
English: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

tcz: Kelkot'a pang ding pondal chu tong somni jen hiding, pon sen-ao thim leh pondup chule ponsandup thim hichu tupet pon nemma ki khong hi ding, hichu phatah'a na jep pol cheh cheh diu ahiye.
en: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.
text:
EXO 27:16
Thadou: Kelkot'a pang ding pondal chu tong somni jen hiding, pon sen-ao thim leh pondup chule ponsandup thim hichu tupet pon nemma ki khong hi ding, hichu phatah'a na jep pol cheh cheh diu ahiye.
English: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

tcz: Pal kiget'na a pang khom jouse chu aboncha dangka jeng'a na jep ding, khom phung chengse vang chu sum eng'a kijem hiding ahi.
en: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.
text:
EXO 27:17
Thadou: Pal kiget'na a pang khom jouse chu aboncha dangka jeng'a na jep ding, khom phung chengse vang chu sum eng'a kijem hiding ahi.
English: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

tcz: Pal kigen chu tong jakhat lhing ding, a vailam chu tong somnga jen hi ding, asan lam vang chu tong nga hi ding ahiye; hichengse chu aboncha tupat pon nemma ki khong jeng kikhai lha ding ahi.
en: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.
text:
EXO 27:18
Thadou: Pal kigen chu tong jakhat lhing ding, a vailam chu tong somnga jen hi ding, asan lam vang chu tong nga hi ding ahiye; hichengse chu aboncha tupat pon nemma ki khong jeng kikhai lha ding ahi.
English: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.

tcz: Hiche thil manchah jouse chu aboncha keiya, thil khaina jouse hihen lang, pal geiya ki khailha ding jouse hi jong le abon chakeija sum-eng jeng'a kisem naman chah diu ahiye.
en: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.
text:
EXO 27:19
Thadou: Hiche thil manchah jouse chu aboncha keiya, thil khaina jouse hihen lang, pal geiya ki khailha ding jouse hi jong le abon chakeija sum-eng jeng'a kisem naman chah diu ahiye.
English: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.

tcz: Nangman Israel chate ho thu na peh ding, amahon Olive'a ki ladoh thaomei thengsel chu ahin choi uva; a Ima tih channa kivah vah jeng ding a thaomei chu ahin tundoh diuva ahi.
en: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
text:
EXO 27:20
Thadou: Nangman Israel chate ho thu na peh ding, amahon Olive'a ki ladoh thaomei thengsel chu ahin choi uva; a Ima tih channa kivah vah jeng ding a thaomei chu ahin tundoh diuva ahi.
English: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

tcz: Kikhopna ponbuh sung ahin, chule het-tohsahna ponbuh mailam ma Aaron le achapaten hiche thaomei chu nilhah lama pat jingkah khovah chan geiya, Pakai angsung a akisah lal peh diu ahi.” Hichengse hi aboncha Israel chate ding a akhang akhang lhung keiyuva anit jing diu le chonna dan a aneijing diu ahiye.
en: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
text:
EXO 27:21
Thadou: Kikhopna ponbuh sung ahin, chule het-tohsahna ponbuh mailam ma Aaron le achapaten hiche thaomei chu nilhah lama pat jingkah khovah chan geiya, Pakai angsung a akisah lal peh diu ahi.” Hichengse hi aboncha Israel chate ding a akhang akhang lhung keiyuva anit jing diu le chonna dan a aneijing diu ahiye.
English: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

tcz: Israel chate lah'a kon in chien lang nasopipa Aaron le a chapate chengse khu ka heng a hinpui in; amaho chengse khu keima thempu a pang ding ahiuve, Aaron le Aaron chapate, Nadab le Abihu chule Eleazar le Ethamar, hi chengse chu hi diu ahi.
en: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
text:
EXO 28:1
Thadou: Israel chate lah'a kon in chien lang nasopipa Aaron le a chapate chengse khu ka heng a hinpui in; amaho chengse khu keima thempu a pang ding ahiuve, Aaron le Aaron chapate, Nadab le Abihu chule Eleazar le Ethamar, hi chengse chu hi diu ahi.
English: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

tcz: Na sopipa Aaron ding'a khu nangman aloupi na ding le amel hoi nading'a akivon nading nagon peh ding ahiye.
en: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.
text:
EXO 28:2
Thadou: Na sopipa Aaron ding'a khu nangman aloupi na ding le amel hoi nading'a akivon nading nagon peh ding ahiye.
English: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

tcz: Keiman nangma lungthim ahin chule tha ka peh chengse aboncha thilbol theina jousea chu thu nasei doh ding, chu teng amahon Aaron kivon na ding'a von tamtah akhon diu, amachu keima themo pua pang ding a thensona um ding ahiye.
en: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
text:
EXO 28:3
Thadou: Keiman nangma lungthim ahin chule tha ka peh chengse aboncha thilbol theina jousea chu thu nasei doh ding, chu teng amahon Aaron kivon na ding'a von tamtah akhon diu, amachu keima themo pua pang ding a thensona um ding ahiye.
English: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

tcz: Akivon na ding'a akhon peh diuva pon chu hicheng hi ahiye: Ompho a ding khat, kongah na ding khat, sangkhol chol khat, thempu natoh na ding a sangkhol achol khat le aponung a ding khatma, delkop'a ding khat, taigah na ding khat jaona hichu keima ding mong mong'a thempua pang ding na sopipa Aaron le a chapate din von theng chu kimsel la agon peh diu ahi.
en: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
text:
EXO 28:4
Thadou: Akivon na ding'a akhon peh diuva pon chu hicheng hi ahiye: Ompho a ding khat, kongah na ding khat, sangkhol chol khat, thempu natoh na ding a sangkhol achol khat le aponung a ding khatma, delkop'a ding khat, taigah na ding khat jaona hichu keima ding mong mong'a thempua pang ding na sopipa Aaron le a chapate din von theng chu kimsel la agon peh diu ahi.
English: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

tcz: Sana jong, pondum chule ponsandup jaona pon san pol thim hichu tupat ponnem ma kikhong chu amanchah diu ahi.”
en: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.
text:
EXO 28:5
Thadou: Sana jong, pondum chule ponsandup jaona pon san pol thim hichu tupat ponnem ma kikhong chu amanchah diu ahi.”
English: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.

tcz: Konggah'a pang dia sana, patdum, ponsandup, patsan polthim khut tem na nei tah'a kikhong hichu tupet ponemma asem peh cheh cheh ding'u ahi.
en: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.
text:
EXO 28:6
Thadou: Konggah'a pang dia sana, patdum, ponsandup, patsan polthim khut tem na nei tah'a kikhong hichu tupet ponemma asem peh cheh cheh ding'u ahi.
English: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.

tcz: Hichu aki jotmat na ding'a among lam teni alengkouva hung kikhai lhathei jong asem peh ding'u ahi.
en: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.
text:
EXO 28:7
Thadou: Hichu aki jotmat na ding'a among lam teni alengkouva hung kikhai lhathei jong asem peh ding'u ahi.
English: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.

tcz: Khut themna neitah'a kikhon pet chu ahin, kong'a kigah ding jong, konggah'a kigah ding'a kisem ki mang cha jat chengse chu akisem bang bang'a khut soh tah mong'a kisem hi ding, sana jaona, pat dum, patsan dup chule pansan pol thim, hichengse chu aboncha tupat ponnem ma kikhong cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
text:
EXO 28:8
Thadou: Khut themna neitah'a kikhon pet chu ahin, kong'a kigah ding jong, konggah'a kigah ding'a kisem ki mang cha jat chengse chu akisem bang bang'a khut soh tah mong'a kisem hi ding, sana jaona, pat dum, patsan dup chule pansan pol thim, hichengse chu aboncha tupat ponnem ma kikhong cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

tcz: Nangman song mantam ni na lah ding, Hiche songman tam ni chung a chu Israel chate ama ama min cheh nakhet lut ding ahi.
en: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.
text:
EXO 28:9
Thadou: Nangman song mantam ni na lah ding, Hiche songman tam ni chung a chu Israel chate ama ama min cheh nakhet lut ding ahi.
English: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.

tcz: Song mantam khat penna chu amin'u gup nakhet beh ding chule, amoh chengse hoding achu gupma ma khat joh'a chu nakhet peh diu ahi, hichea chu amin jouse ama ama cheh pen dungjuija nakhet peh cheh cheh diu ahi.
en: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.
text:
EXO 28:10
Thadou: Song mantam khat penna chu amin'u gup nakhet beh ding chule, amoh chengse hoding achu gupma ma khat joh'a chu nakhet peh diu ahi, hichea chu amin jouse ama ama cheh pen dungjuija nakhet peh cheh cheh diu ahi.
English: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.

tcz: Sana kheng them pan khut jem hoa thil hoitah a akhet them bang'a nangman jong songman tam chung'a chu Isarel chate min jouse na khet pol peh soh kei uva, na khet polna chan chu aboncha sana twiya nasun jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.
text:
EXO 28:11
Thadou: Sana kheng them pan khut jem hoa thil hoitah a akhet them bang'a nangman jong songman tam chung'a chu Isarel chate min jouse na khet pol peh soh kei uva, na khet polna chan chu aboncha sana twiya nasun jol cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.

tcz: Hichu song mantam teni chu Israel chate ding'a het jingna ding'a kong gah teni among geiya agen tenia chu na suh beh den ding; Aaron injong Israel chate het jing na ding'a amin jouse'u alengkou chung vumma apoh'a Pakai heng'a apoh lut peh diu ahi.
en: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD on his two shoulders for a memorial.
text:
EXO 28:12
Thadou: Hichu song mantam teni chu Israel chate ding'a het jingna ding'a kong gah teni among geiya agen tenia chu na suh beh den ding; Aaron injong Israel chate het jing na ding'a amin jouse'u alengkou chung vumma apoh'a Pakai heng'a apoh lut peh diu ahi.
English: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD on his two shoulders for a memorial.

tcz: Hiche khao veija kivei sana chu na jopmat cheh cheh ding ahiye.
en: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.
text:
EXO 28:14
Thadou: Hiche khao veija kivei sana chu na jopmat cheh cheh ding ahiye.
English: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.

tcz: Nangman thutanna munna akivonna ding ompho jong chu khut them tah'a nasem peh teitei ding, konggah kisem na bang bang'a nasem ding ahi; sana jong, patdum, patsan dup, patsan polthim chule hiche jong chu tupat pon nemma ki sem'a na sem peh cheh cheh ding ahiye.
en: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.
text:
EXO 28:15
Thadou: Nangman thutanna munna akivonna ding ompho jong chu khut them tah'a nasem peh teitei ding, konggah kisem na bang bang'a nasem ding ahi; sana jong, patdum, patsan dup, patsan polthim chule hiche jong chu tupat pon nemma ki sem'a na sem peh cheh cheh ding ahiye.
English: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.

tcz: Nangman ompho khat nasem ding hichu, aning li chule hichu thoni hiding adung khapkhat chule avai jong khap khat ma hi ding ahiye.
en: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.
text:
EXO 28:16
Thadou: Nangman ompho khat nasem ding hichu, aning li chule hichu thoni hiding adung khapkhat chule avai jong khap khat ma hi ding ahiye.
English: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.

tcz: A kimlaija gol lia song na gol ding chule amasa'a na gol ding chengse chu Sardis song hiding; Topaz song aiha song jong hiding ahi.
en: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;

tcz: Gol nina a pang ding hochu ahile, Emerald Song, sapphire song chule diamond song hiding ahi.
en: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

tcz: Gol thum lhinna pang ding hochu ahile; Jacinth song, Agate song chule Amethyst songhi ding ahi.
en: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

tcz: Golli channa ding chu ahi leh, Beryl song, Onyx song, Jesper songhi cheng chu ahiye; aboncha sana twija chap nou ding ahi.”
en: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.
text:
EXO 28:20
Thadou: Golli channa ding chu ahi leh, Beryl song, Onyx song, Jesper songhi cheng chu ahiye; aboncha sana twija chap nou ding ahi.”
English: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.

tcz: Song som leni chu ama ama mincheh dungjuiya Israel te khat khat cheh toh umtha ding; hiche bang bang achu Israel phung somleni ho chu songkhat cheh chu toh Mohor kinam den tha ding ahiuve.
en: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.
text:
EXO 28:21
Thadou: Song som leni chu ama ama mincheh dungjuiya Israel te khat khat cheh toh umtha ding; hiche bang bang achu Israel phung somleni ho chu songkhat cheh chu toh Mohor kinam den tha ding ahiuve.
English: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.

tcz: Nangman jong omphoa man chah ding in sana thengsel khao jang bang'a kiheh'a na sem ding ahi.
en: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
text:
EXO 28:22
Thadou: Nangman jong omphoa man chah ding in sana thengsel khao jang bang'a kiheh'a na sem ding ahi.
English: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

tcz: Ompho'a manchah ding'a sana kaokol nijong nasem ding, hiche chaojong teni chu ompho ning'a bupeh ding ahi.
en: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
text:
EXO 28:23
Thadou: Ompho'a manchah ding'a sana kaokol nijong nasem ding, hiche chaojong teni chu ompho ning'a bupeh ding ahi.
English: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

tcz: Hiche chaojang kol teni sung'a chu sana khaojang chu nathillut ding ahiye.
en: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
text:
EXO 28:24
Thadou: Hiche chaojang kol teni sung'a chu sana khaojang chu nathillut ding ahiye.
English: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

tcz: Hiche chaokol teni among lam akolsung'a patjang nathil lut ding; konggah teni masang lama chu um ding ahi.”
en: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.
text:
EXO 28:25
Thadou: Hiche chaokol teni among lam akolsung'a patjang nathil lut ding; konggah teni masang lama chu um ding ahi.”
English: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.

tcz: Sana chaokol ni nasem ding; hiche chaokol ompho agei tenia chule hiche teni chu ompho sung lama kon ageichanna konggah bantah a nathil lut ding ahi.
en: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.
text:
EXO 28:26
Thadou: Sana chaokol ni nasem ding; hiche chaokol ompho agei tenia chule hiche teni chu ompho sung lama kon ageichanna konggah bantah a nathil lut ding ahi.
English: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.

tcz: Hitia chu sana chaokol nijong nasem tha ding, hiche chaokol teni konggah lengkouva ki khailhahna noilang chule amasang lama na suhmat peh ding; kong gah ding a kisem hoitah chunga chu kikhai mat ding ahiye.
en: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
text:
EXO 28:27
Thadou: Hitia chu sana chaokol nijong nasem tha ding, hiche chaokol teni konggah lengkouva ki khailhahna noilang chule amasang lama na suhmat peh ding; kong gah ding a kisem hoitah chunga chu kikhai mat ding ahiye.
English: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

tcz: Ama hon patdum a manchah diu hichu omphoa chaokol sung tenia chu athil doh paijel ding u ahiye; hiche konggah a chaokol teni toh chun athil mat ding u, khut them na tah a kisem konngah chu toh asuh mat chat diu, ompho le konggah chu kikhen louva umjing ding ahi.
en: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.
text:
EXO 28:28
Thadou: Ama hon patdum a manchah diu hichu omphoa chaokol sung tenia chu athil doh paijel ding u ahiye; hiche konggah a chaokol teni toh chun athil mat ding u, khut them na tah a kisem konngah chu toh asuh mat chat diu, ompho le konggah chu kikhen louva umjing ding ahi.
English: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.

tcz: Hichu Aaron injong Pakai angsunga alut teng, Israel chate asuh mil louva, thutanna'a kivonna ompho achu Israel chate mincheng apoh jing ding ahi.
en: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.
text:
EXO 28:29
Thadou: Hichu Aaron injong Pakai angsunga alut teng, Israel chate asuh mil louva, thutanna'a kivonna ompho achu Israel chate mincheng apoh jing ding ahi.
English: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.

tcz: Hiche thutanna ompho chung achu Urim le Thummin chu adal na naman chah ding, Pakai ang sunga na lut teng hiche teni chu Aaron chunga kikhai den ding, Aaron in jong hichu Israel chate thutanna Pakai angsunga alut teng apoh ji ding ahi.
en: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before the LORD. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before the LORD continually.
text:
EXO 28:30
Thadou: Hiche thutanna ompho chung achu Urim le Thummin chu adal na naman chah ding, Pakai ang sunga na lut teng hiche teni chu Aaron chunga kikhai den ding, Aaron in jong hichu Israel chate thutanna Pakai angsunga alut teng apoh ji ding ahi.
English: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before the LORD. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before the LORD continually.

tcz: Thempu hon konggah a manchah cheng chu pondum jeng a nakhon peh ding ahi.
en: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
text:
EXO 28:31
Thadou: Thempu hon konggah a manchah cheng chu pondum jeng a nakhon peh ding ahi.
English: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

tcz: Hiche sangkhol chol a chu luchang hetlut nading ahomkhat na sem ding ahi. Hiche sangkhol chol achu luchang hetlut na ding ahom khat anei ding; Sangkhol dang bang'a angaija a ngong kol kimvelse chu pha tah'a ki pheh chah ding ahi.
en: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.
text:
EXO 28:32
Thadou: Hiche sangkhol chol a chu luchang hetlut nading ahomkhat na sem ding ahi. Hiche sangkhol chol achu luchang hetlut na ding ahom khat anei ding; Sangkhol dang bang'a angaija a ngong kol kimvelse chu pha tah'a ki pheh chah ding ahi.
English: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.

tcz: Sangkhol gei jouse aboncha ajem asan le adup a hi ding, asan-ao thim hichu kolbu theiga bang bang a nasem ding; kolbu thei lim a kisem chengse chu aboncha sana jeng a nasem a agei mong se a naum sah ding ahi.”
en: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:
text:
EXO 28:33
Thadou: Sangkhol gei jouse aboncha ajem asan le adup a hi ding, asan-ao thim hichu kolbu theiga bang bang a nasem ding; kolbu thei lim a kisem chengse chu aboncha sana jeng a nasem a agei mong se a naum sah ding ahi.”
English: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:

tcz: Sana chao khat naba na munna chu kolbuthei lima kisem khat cheh um ding, sangkhol chol gei lhung keija sana chao chu na ba peh ding hichu kolbu thei ga limma kisem khat cheh hi ding ahi.
en: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.
text:
EXO 28:34
Thadou: Sana chao khat naba na munna chu kolbuthei lima kisem khat cheh um ding, sangkhol chol gei lhung keija sana chao chu na ba peh ding hichu kolbu thei ga limma kisem khat cheh hi ding ahi.
English: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.

tcz: Aaron in houin sunga kin anei teng hiche sangkhol chol chu akiah ding, Pakai ansunga alut pat hihen ahung potdoh hijong leh hiche chao jang chu agin kija jeng ding, hichu akijah khah louva ahile athi a hi ding ahi.
en: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before the LORD, and when he comes out, that he not die.
text:
EXO 28:35
Thadou: Aaron in houin sunga kin anei teng hiche sangkhol chol chu akiah ding, Pakai ansunga alut pat hihen ahung potdoh hijong leh hiche chao jang chu agin kija jeng ding, hichu akijah khah louva ahile athi a hi ding ahi.
English: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before the LORD, and when he comes out, that he not die.

tcz: Sana theng set'a apheng khat na sem ding, Achung'a chu Mohor kijem bang'a Pakaiyin athenso ahitai tia ajem khat nakhet ding'a ahi.
en: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO THE LORD.’
text:
EXO 28:36
Thadou: Sana theng set'a apheng khat na sem ding, Achung'a chu Mohor kijem bang'a Pakaiyin athenso ahitai tia ajem khat nakhet ding'a ahi.
English: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO THE LORD.’

tcz: Sana pheng chu pat jang adum khat a delkop'a na kan chah peh ding, adelkop chu amai lam ama sang lang'a aki tah ding ahi.
en: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.
text:
EXO 28:37
Thadou: Sana pheng chu pat jang adum khat a delkop'a na kan chah peh ding, adelkop chu amai lam ama sang lang'a aki tah ding ahi.
English: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.

tcz: Sana pheng chu Aaron chal pang'a kitah jing ding, Aaron in jong Israel chaten thil theng ato ding chengse'u a thensoa chule themmona hung lut kha photphot chu hichu ama cheh in mona atahsa chung a akipoh ding, Pakai angsung'a santhei dol ahi na ding'a Aaron in jong achalpanga kitah jing ding ahi.
en: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.
text:
EXO 28:38
Thadou: Sana pheng chu Aaron chal pang'a kitah jing ding, Aaron in jong Israel chaten thil theng ato ding chengse'u a thensoa chule themmona hung lut kha photphot chu hichu ama cheh in mona atahsa chung a akipoh ding, Pakai angsung'a santhei dol ahi na ding'a Aaron in jong achalpanga kitah jing ding ahi.
English: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.

tcz: Hiche sangkhol chol chu tupet pom nemma na khon peh ding, delkop jing jong tupet ponnem ma na khon peh ding konggah jeng jong heu jang khatna khut themmna neitah mikhat in apheh peh ding ahi.
en: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.
text:
EXO 28:39
Thadou: Hiche sangkhol chol chu tupet pom nemma na khon peh ding, delkop jing jong tupet ponnem ma na khon peh ding konggah jeng jong heu jang khatna khut themmna neitah mikhat in apheh peh ding ahi.
English: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.

tcz: Chuteng nang man Aaron chapate jouse chu aloupi na diu le a vethoina diuva sangkhol ahin, konggah ahin, lukhuh ho jong na gonpeh cheh cheh diu ahi.
en: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.
text:
EXO 28:40
Thadou: Chuteng nang man Aaron chapate jouse chu aloupi na diu le a vethoina diuva sangkhol ahin, konggah ahin, lukhuh ho jong na gonpeh cheh cheh diu ahi.
English: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.

tcz: Hiche von hose chu na sopipa Aaron ahin chule a chapate chengse na von peh ding, thempua pang diu keima kin'a akisah lal na diuva thao na nu soh kei ding ahi.
en: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
text:
EXO 28:41
Thadou: Hiche von hose chu na sopipa Aaron ahin chule a chapate chengse na von peh ding, thempua pang diu keima kin'a akisah lal na diuva thao na nu soh kei ding ahi.
English: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

tcz: Nangman jong amaho se chu atahsa gohkeovu a kidal na diuva sangkhol chol na choh peh cheh cheh ding u ahiye; hiche sangkhol chol sese chun akong uva pat akhu jal channu akhu khum cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.
text:
EXO 28:42
Thadou: Nangman jong amaho se chu atahsa gohkeovu a kidal na diuva sangkhol chol na choh peh cheh cheh ding u ahiye; hiche sangkhol chol sese chun akong uva pat akhu jal channu akhu khum cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.

tcz: Aaron le achapate hochu kikhop khomna ponsunga ahunglut'u hihen, muntheng munna kinbol maicham phung ahin nailut pet'u hijong leh hiche delchol chengse chu a ki-ah soh kei diu ahi; achuti louva ahile amaho le amaho themmo akipoh lut uva hicheng toh chun thina ato tha khah diu ahi. Hiche dan chengse hi Aaron le ama nung a ason a chilhhahte ding geija chonna dan hi jing ding ahi tai, ati.
en: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.
text:
EXO 28:43
Thadou: Aaron le achapate hochu kikhop khomna ponsunga ahunglut'u hihen, muntheng munna kinbol maicham phung ahin nailut pet'u hijong leh hiche delchol chengse chu a ki-ah soh kei diu ahi; achuti louva ahile amaho le amaho themmo akipoh lut uva hicheng toh chun thina ato tha khah diu ahi. Hiche dan chengse hi Aaron le ama nung a ason a chilhhahte ding geija chonna dan hi jing ding ahi tai, ati.
English: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.

tcz: Nangman keima thempua pang dia hiteho hi na thenso teng le hicheng hi nabol peh cheh cheh ding ahi. Bongchal khat le kelngoi chal khat nahin mat ding ahi.
en: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,
text:
EXO 29:1
Thadou: Nangman keima thempua pang dia hiteho hi na thenso teng le hicheng hi nabol peh cheh cheh ding ahi. Bongchal khat le kelngoi chal khat nahin mat ding ahi.
English: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,

tcz: Chu teng cholso lou chang lhah lhon phabep jao na hi ding, hicheng chu thao toh kihelsa jeng hi ding ahi. Chule chol solou changlhah neldisel thao thoh kihel tha hi ding hiche ho chu aboncha suhlou chang bong akon na lah doh cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.
text:
EXO 29:2
Thadou: Chu teng cholso lou chang lhah lhon phabep jao na hi ding, hicheng chu thao toh kihelsa jeng hi ding ahi. Chule chol solou changlhah neldisel thao thoh kihel tha hi ding hiche ho chu aboncha suhlou chang bong akon na lah doh cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.

tcz: Hiche hojouse chu aboncha pucha khat a nakhum lut cheh cheh ding, apucha puma chu nahin todoh ding chuteng bongchal golpai le kelngoi chal na hin kai lut tha pai pai ding ahiye, ati.
en: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.
text:
EXO 29:3
Thadou: Hiche hojouse chu aboncha pucha khat a nakhum lut cheh cheh ding, apucha puma chu nahin todoh ding chuteng bongchal golpai le kelngoi chal na hin kai lut tha pai pai ding ahiye, ati.
English: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.

tcz: Chule nangman Aaron le achapa te chengse abonchauva kotpi phung maiya na hin puilut soh kei uva, abonchauva twiya nasil ngim soh kei ding ahi.
en: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
text:
EXO 29:4
Thadou: Chule nangman Aaron le achapa te chengse abonchauva kotpi phung maiya na hin puilut soh kei uva, abonchauva twiya nasil ngim soh kei ding ahi.
English: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

tcz: Chu teng nagman ponsil hochu na gah lah ding, Aaron chu sangkhol chol a kisem chule konggah chu navon peh ding; hitia chu konggah chu nagah peh ding, ompho jong navon peh ding, konggah ding a khut themna tah a kipheh chu nagah peh ding ahiye.
en: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
text:
EXO 29:5
Thadou: Chu teng nagman ponsil hochu na gah lah ding, Aaron chu sangkhol chol a kisem chule konggah chu navon peh ding; hitia chu konggah chu nagah peh ding, ompho jong navon peh ding, konggah ding a khut themna tah a kipheh chu nagah peh ding ahiye.
English: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

tcz: Aluchang'a delkop na kop peh ding, hiche delkop chunga chu lukhuh theng na khuh peh ding ahi.
en: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.
text:
EXO 29:6
Thadou: Aluchang'a delkop na kop peh ding, hiche delkop chunga chu lukhuh theng na khuh peh ding ahi.
English: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.

tcz: Chuteng tahsa chunga nuding thao chu na lah'a Aaron chu nanu khum ding ahi.
en: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.
text:
EXO 29:7
Thadou: Chuteng tahsa chunga nuding thao chu na lah'a Aaron chu nanu khum ding ahi.
English: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.

tcz: Chule hichu na bol chai teng le a chapate ho chu na hin puilut pai dng abonchauva sangkhol chol chu na ah peh soh kei diuva ahi.
en: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.
text:
EXO 29:8
Thadou: Chule hichu na bol chai teng le a chapate ho chu na hin puilut pai dng abonchauva sangkhol chol chu na ah peh soh kei diuva ahi.
English: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

tcz: Amaho chengse jong chu konggah nagah peh cheh cheh ding, hichu thempu hina beitih nei louva ama hon achonna dan a ahin cheh pe jing ding ahiuvin. Nangman Aaron le a chapate chu thempua pang ding na suh det ding ahi.
en: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.
text:
EXO 29:9
Thadou: Amaho chengse jong chu konggah nagah peh cheh cheh ding, hichu thempu hina beitih nei louva ama hon achonna dan a ahin cheh pe jing ding ahiuvin. Nangman Aaron le a chapate chu thempua pang ding na suh det ding ahi.
English: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.

tcz: Chu teng nangman kikhop na in maiya chu bong chal nahin kailut pai ding, hiche bongchal luchung nga chu Aaron le achapate cheng in akhut angap lhah cheh diu ah.
en: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.
text:
EXO 29:10
Thadou: Chu teng nangman kikhop na in maiya chu bong chal nahin kailut pai ding, hiche bongchal luchung nga chu Aaron le achapate cheng in akhut angap lhah cheh diu ah.
English: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.

tcz: Hiche bongchal chu Pakai angusng a natha ding ahiye.
en: You shall kill the bull before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
EXO 29:11
Thadou: Hiche bongchal chu Pakai angusng a natha ding ahiye.
English: You shall kill the bull before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Chule bongchal thisan chu na khut jung na dekot ding hichu selki hoa chu naloi nat cheh ding ahiye, gan thisan amoh chengse vang chu maicham maiya chu nasun lhah ding ahi.
en: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.
text:
EXO 29:12
Thadou: Chule bongchal thisan chu na khut jung na dekot ding hichu selki hoa chu naloi nat cheh ding ahiye, gan thisan amoh chengse vang chu maicham maiya chu nasun lhah ding ahi.
English: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.

tcz: Bongchal sathao jouse ahin, chule athin, akel tenia athao jouse jong nalha doh ding hichengse chu aboncha maicham chung a na go vam hel ding ahi.
en: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.
text:
EXO 29:13
Thadou: Bongchal sathao jouse ahin, chule athin, akel tenia athao jouse jong nalha doh ding hichengse chu aboncha maicham chung a na go vam hel ding ahi.
English: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

tcz: Hiche bongchalsa chu avun ahin chule a eh chengse chu pam lam ma meiya na go vam mang ding ahi; ajeh chu chonset kithoina ahiye.
en: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.
text:
EXO 29:14
Thadou: Hiche bongchalsa chu avun ahin chule a eh chengse chu pam lam ma meiya na go vam mang ding ahi; ajeh chu chonset kithoina ahiye.
English: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.

tcz: Chujou teng nangman kelngoi achal sang nei khat na hin kailut paipai ding, Chu teng Aaron le achapate ho jousen hiche kelngoi achal luchung'a chu akhut angap lhah cheh ding u ahi.
en: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
text:
EXO 29:15
Thadou: Chujou teng nangman kelngoi achal sang nei khat na hin kailut paipai ding, Chu teng Aaron le achapate ho jousen hiche kelngoi achal luchung'a chu akhut angap lhah cheh ding u ahi.
English: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

tcz: Chuteng nangman kelngoi chal chu natha ding, athisan phabep khat na lah ding maicham maiya akimvel lah achu nathe khum soh kei ding ahi.
en: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.
text:
EXO 29:16
Thadou: Chuteng nangman kelngoi chal chu natha ding, athisan phabep khat na lah ding maicham maiya akimvel lah achu nathe khum soh kei ding ahi.
English: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.

tcz: Kelngoi chal sa chu na sem ding, asung jouse jaona akeng jeng jong nasop ngim soh ding chule hitia chu asa na sem sa chengse leh a luchang jaona hichengse chu ki tupchet a na koi ding ahi.
en: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.
text:
EXO 29:17
Thadou: Kelngoi chal sa chu na sem ding, asung jouse jaona akeng jeng jong nasop ngim soh ding chule hitia chu asa na sem sa chengse leh a luchang jaona hichengse chu ki tupchet a na koi ding ahi.
English: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.

tcz: Hiche kelngoi chal sa chu aboncha maicham ma na go vam hel ding ahiye. Hichu Pakaiya dia pumgo thilto ahin, chule agimnam twi sel hichu lung lhaisah nading ahin, Pakaiya dia meiya govam hel ding ahi.
en: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to the LORD; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
text:
EXO 29:18
Thadou: Hiche kelngoi chal sa chu aboncha maicham ma na go vam hel ding ahiye. Hichu Pakaiya dia pumgo thilto ahin, chule agimnam twi sel hichu lung lhaisah nading ahin, Pakaiya dia meiya govam hel ding ahi.
English: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to the LORD; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

tcz: Hichu aki chai chai le kelngoi chal khat ma na kai lut kit ding Aaron le achapa ten jong kelngoi chal chunga chu akhut angap lhah cheh diu ahi.
en: “You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
text:
EXO 29:19
Thadou: Hichu aki chai chai le kelngoi chal khat ma na kai lut kit ding Aaron le achapa ten jong kelngoi chal chunga chu akhut angap lhah cheh diu ahi.
English: “You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

tcz: Chu teng kelngoi chal chu na tha ding, Athisan phabep na lah doh ding, Aaron bilkol jet lama nanu nat peh ding, chule akhut jetlamma akhutpi chense jaona akeng jetlamma khutpi chung jousea jong nanu nat peh cheh cheh ding ahi; chuteng athisan moh chengse chu maicham maiya nathe khum ding ahi.
en: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.
text:
EXO 29:20
Thadou: Chu teng kelngoi chal chu na tha ding, Athisan phabep na lah doh ding, Aaron bilkol jet lama nanu nat peh ding, chule akhut jetlamma akhutpi chense jaona akeng jetlamma khutpi chung jousea jong nanu nat peh cheh cheh ding ahi; chuteng athisan moh chengse chu maicham maiya nathe khum ding ahi.
English: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

tcz: Maicham chung a thisan phabep le thao kinu thei chu na lah ding Aaron ponsil cheng chung a chu na sun khum ding ahi; hitia chu Aaron le aponsil chengse kithenso a atheng a um ding, ama ahin chule a chapate jeng jong ki thenso na chang ding atheng a umjing ding ahitauve.
en: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
text:
EXO 29:21
Thadou: Maicham chung a thisan phabep le thao kinu thei chu na lah ding Aaron ponsil cheng chung a chu na sun khum ding ahi; hitia chu Aaron le aponsil chengse kithenso a atheng a um ding, ama ahin chule a chapate jeng jong ki thenso na chang ding atheng a umjing ding ahitauve.
English: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

tcz: Nangman jong kelngoi chal sa thao chengse ahin, chule amei thao ahin asung thao le amei thao ho ahin amel jetlam toh nalah tha ding ahiye; hichu ki suhdet na ding'a kelngoi chal ahi.
en: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),
text:
EXO 29:22
Thadou: Nangman jong kelngoi chal sa thao chengse ahin, chule amei thao ahin asung thao le amei thao ho ahin amel jetlam toh nalah tha ding ahiye; hichu ki suhdet na ding'a kelngoi chal ahi.
English: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),

tcz: Changlhah phengkhat ahin thao toh kihelsa chang lhah khat na lah ding, chang lhah pheng khatma toh nalah tha ding, hichu Pakai angsunga chol solou changlhah pucha sung a umho a konna chu na lah doh ding ahi.
en: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.
text:
EXO 29:23
Thadou: Changlhah phengkhat ahin thao toh kihelsa chang lhah khat na lah ding, chang lhah pheng khatma toh nalah tha ding, hichu Pakai angsunga chol solou changlhah pucha sung a umho a konna chu na lah doh ding ahi.
English: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.

tcz: Hichengse chu Aaron le achapate khutna na peh doh ding, aboncha chu Pakai angsunga thilpeh ding a na koi jing ding ahi.
en: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
text:
EXO 29:24
Thadou: Hichengse chu Aaron le achapate khutna na peh doh ding, aboncha chu Pakai angsunga thilpeh ding a na koi jing ding ahi.
English: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

tcz: Chuteng Aaron ahin chule achapate ho a konna na lelah doh kit ding, Pakai angsung maicham chunga chu nale halvam cheh cheh ding ajeh chu Pakai adia govam thilpeh khat a ki sim ahi.
en: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.
text:
EXO 29:25
Thadou: Chuteng Aaron ahin chule achapate ho a konna na lelah doh kit ding, Pakai angsung maicham chunga chu nale halvam cheh cheh ding ajeh chu Pakai adia govam thilpeh khat a ki sim ahi.
English: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.

tcz: Chule Aaron ki suhdet na kelngoi chal op-phang chu na lah ding, hichu Pakai angsunga thilto dinga na katdoh ding, hichu nangma na chan vou a paimang ding ahi.
en: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be your portion.
text:
EXO 29:26
Thadou: Chule Aaron ki suhdet na kelngoi chal op-phang chu na lah ding, hichu Pakai angsunga thilto dinga na katdoh ding, hichu nangma na chan vou a paimang ding ahi.
English: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be your portion.

tcz: Hiche thilto chu thempu ho chan ding chule amal toh chule ki suhdet na ding a kitoh doh ding chengse jaona Aaron le achapate chan ding ahi jeh a then sona na sem peh ding ahi.
en: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.
text:
EXO 29:27
Thadou: Hiche thilto chu thempu ho chan ding chule amal toh chule ki suhdet na ding a kitoh doh ding chengse jaona Aaron le achapate chan ding ahi jeh a then sona na sem peh ding ahi.
English: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.

tcz: Hichengse chu Aaron le a chapate jouse ding a akhang akhanga Israel chaten apeh cheh ding uva bat a anei cheh diu ahi, ajeh chu Israel cha ten chamna thil ahin to doh ding u hichu Aaron le achapate chan ding ahi. hichu Amaho jouse dia Pakaiya thil to ding ahiye.
en: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to the LORD.
text:
EXO 29:28
Thadou: Hichengse chu Aaron le a chapate jouse ding a akhang akhanga Israel chaten apeh cheh ding uva bat a anei cheh diu ahi, ajeh chu Israel cha ten chamna thil ahin to doh ding u hichu Aaron le achapate chan ding ahi. hichu Amaho jouse dia Pakaiya thil to ding ahiye.
English: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to the LORD.

tcz: Aaron kivonna ponsil chengse chu ama khang akichai teng achapate chan vou ding ahin, thao akinu uva hichu ki suhdetna a anei jing ding u ahi.
en: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.
text:
EXO 29:29
Thadou: Aaron kivonna ponsil chengse chu ama khang akichai teng achapate chan vou ding ahin, thao akinu uva hichu ki suhdetna a anei jing ding u ahi.
English: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.

tcz: Aaron umna munna achapa thempua pang ding pen pen chun kikhopna ponbuh sunga ahung sung lhah ding teng; ni sagi sungsea hiche vontheng chu aki von jing ding ahi.
en: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.
text:
EXO 29:30
Thadou: Aaron umna munna achapa thempua pang ding pen pen chun kikhopna ponbuh sunga ahung sung lhah ding teng; ni sagi sungsea hiche vontheng chu aki von jing ding ahi.
English: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.

tcz: Nangman jong kelngoichal ki suhdeh na chu na hin puiya, asa chu muntheng lai khat a naga hon min ding ahi.
en: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.
text:
EXO 29:31
Thadou: Nangman jong kelngoichal ki suhdeh na chu na hin puiya, asa chu muntheng lai khat a naga hon min ding ahi.
English: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.

tcz: Chuteng Aaron le achapaten kelngoi chalsa le pucha sung a kikoi chang lhah chengse chu aneh khom diu ahi.
en: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
EXO 29:32
Thadou: Chuteng Aaron le achapaten kelngoi chalsa le pucha sung a kikoi chang lhah chengse chu aneh khom diu ahi.
English: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Hichengse chu kisem hoina ding le kisem toh na pang ding, ajeh chu hiche thil jouse chu aboncha atheng sa ahi tai.
en: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.
text:
EXO 29:33
Thadou: Hichengse chu kisem hoina ding le kisem toh na pang ding, ajeh chu hiche thil jouse chu aboncha atheng sa ahi tai.
English: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.

tcz: Chu jong leh ki suhdet na sa moh ham changlhah moh ham khat jingkah khovah geiya aum khah a ahile; nangman hiche ho chu meiya na govam cheh ding ahiye, hichu koiman aneh thei lou ding ahi.
en: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
text:
EXO 29:34
Thadou: Chu jong leh ki suhdet na sa moh ham changlhah moh ham khat jingkah khovah geiya aum khah a ahile; nangman hiche ho chu meiya na govam cheh ding ahiye, hichu koiman aneh thei lou ding ahi.
English: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

tcz: Keiman nangma ka thupeh bang bang a hi Aaron le achapa ten abolna diuva na hil chah soh kei diu ahi, nisagi sungse amaho chu na suhdet ding ahi.
en: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.
text:
EXO 29:35
Thadou: Keiman nangma ka thupeh bang bang a hi Aaron le achapa ten abolna diuva na hil chah soh kei diu ahi, nisagi sungse amaho chu na suhdet ding ahi.
English: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.

tcz: Aniseh le ki suhdihna dinga chonset thilto a pang dia bongchal khat na kat doh jing ding, hichu na bol teng nangman maicham sunga konna chonset suhmang thei na dinga, maicham chu thao nanu cheh cheh ding, thensona na nei ding ahiye.
en: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.
text:
EXO 29:36
Thadou: Aniseh le ki suhdihna dinga chonset thilto a pang dia bongchal khat na kat doh jing ding, hichu na bol teng nangman maicham sunga konna chonset suhmang thei na dinga, maicham chu thao nanu cheh cheh ding, thensona na nei ding ahiye.
English: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.

tcz: Ni sagi sungsea nangman ki suhdetna maicham nasem jing ding, hichu maicham lah a atheng chung nung penna kisim ding ahin; ipi hi jong le hiche maicham sukha phot phot chu atheng aum jing ding ahi.
en: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.
text:
EXO 29:37
Thadou: Ni sagi sungsea nangman ki suhdetna maicham nasem jing ding, hichu maicham lah a atheng chung nung penna kisim ding ahin; ipi hi jong le hiche maicham sukha phot phot chu atheng aum jing ding ahi.
English: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.

tcz: Maicham chunga na thilto ding chu hicheng hi jing ding ahiye: Anisih a tanglou hel ding a kumkhat lhingsa kelngoi chal ni na kat doh jing ding ahi.”
en: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.
text:
EXO 29:38
Thadou: Maicham chunga na thilto ding chu hicheng hi jing ding ahiye: Anisih a tanglou hel ding a kumkhat lhingsa kelngoi chal ni na kat doh jing ding ahi.”
English: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.

tcz: Kelngoinou chu jingkah simma na kat doh jing ding chule kelngoinou dang khat chu nilhah lang a na kat doh ji ji ding ahi.
en: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening;

tcz: Kelngoinou kikat doh masa pachu ahin chang bong nel hopkhat a kitena hopsom jaona akiheh lhasa thaotwi khon dimkhat hopli a kihom hopkhat jaona, kilhaina ding a khon dimkhat hoplia kihom khat jaona hi ding ahi.
en: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.
text:
EXO 29:40
Thadou: Kelngoinou kikat doh masa pachu ahin chang bong nel hopkhat a kitena hopsom jaona akiheh lhasa thaotwi khon dimkhat hopli a kihom hopkhat jaona, kilhaina ding a khon dimkhat hoplia kihom khat jaona hi ding ahi.
English: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

tcz: Jingkah lama natoh bang bang chu nilhah lamma jong kelngoi chal khat na todoh ding ahin; kelgnoi chal aki toh doh jaona chule chang thil ki katdoh chu ahin, don ding a thilto jong na jaosah ding; Hichu Pakaiya dia gim namtui tah pumgo thilto a ki mang cha ding ahi.
en: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
text:
EXO 29:41
Thadou: Jingkah lama natoh bang bang chu nilhah lamma jong kelngoi chal khat na todoh ding ahin; kelgnoi chal aki toh doh jaona chule chang thil ki katdoh chu ahin, don ding a thilto jong na jaosah ding; Hichu Pakaiya dia gim namtui tah pumgo thilto a ki mang cha ding ahi.
English: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

tcz: Hi chengse hi na khang khang uva pumgo thilto a naman jing ding u ahi. hichu kikhop khomna ponbuh maiya na bol jing diu ahin, chu teng keiman nangma hiche kotpi phung maiya chu najah a thu ka sei peh ding nahiye.
en: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.
text:
EXO 29:42
Thadou: Hi chengse hi na khang khang uva pumgo thilto a naman jing ding u ahi. hichu kikhop khomna ponbuh maiya na bol jing diu ahin, chu teng keiman nangma hiche kotpi phung maiya chu najah a thu ka sei peh ding nahiye.
English: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.

tcz: Hiche mun laitah achu keiman jong Israel chate ka kimu pi ding, keima loupi nan amun chu asuh theng jing ding ahi.
en: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.
text:
EXO 29:43
Thadou: Hiche mun laitah achu keiman jong Israel chate ka kimu pi ding, keima loupi nan amun chu asuh theng jing ding ahi.
English: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.

tcz: Keiman jong ki khopkhomna ponbuh leh maicham ka suhtheng ding, Aaron leh a chapate ahin thempu a pang dia ka suhtheng ding ahiye.
en: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.
text:
EXO 29:44
Thadou: Keiman jong ki khopkhomna ponbuh leh maicham ka suhtheng ding, Aaron leh a chapate ahin thempu a pang dia ka suhtheng ding ahiye.
English: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.

tcz: Hichu teng leh Israel chate lah a kachen ding, amaho dinga keima hi a Pathen u ka hi jing ding ahiye, ati.
en: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
text:
EXO 29:45
Thadou: Hichu teng leh Israel chate lah a kachen ding, amaho dinga keima hi a Pathen u ka hi jing ding ahiye, ati.
English: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

tcz: Chu teng keima hi amaho jouse Pakai le Pathen ka hi jing ding, alah uva ka chen jing na ding a amaho hi keiman Egypt gam'a konna ka hin pui galkai uva ahi; ti ahin hetdoh diu ahi, ajeh chu keima hi Pakai dih tah amaho hin puidoh pachu ka hi, ati.
en: They shall know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.
text:
EXO 29:46
Thadou: Chu teng keima hi amaho jouse Pakai le Pathen ka hi jing ding, alah uva ka chen jing na ding a amaho hi keiman Egypt gam'a konna ka hin pui galkai uva ahi; ti ahin hetdoh diu ahi, ajeh chu keima hi Pakai dih tah amaho hin puidoh pachu ka hi, ati.
English: They shall know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.

tcz: Nang man gim-namtui kihalnam jing a maicham na sem ding ahiye, hiche maicham chu thinggi thing a na sem ding ahi.
en: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.
text:
EXO 30:1
Thadou: Nang man gim-namtui kihalnam jing a maicham na sem ding ahiye, hiche maicham chu thinggi thing a na sem ding ahi.
English: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.

tcz: Maicham chu adung tongkhat asao ding chule avai jong tongkhat a sao hi ding, a ning li um ding; a tunjong tongni a sao ding, hiche a kimang saki ho jong chu maicham toh thakhat'a um tha cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.
text:
EXO 30:2
Thadou: Maicham chu adung tongkhat asao ding chule avai jong tongkhat a sao hi ding, a ning li um ding; a tunjong tongni a sao ding, hiche a kimang saki ho jong chu maicham toh thakhat'a um tha cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.

tcz: Maicham chung lang chule ajet le avei a kimvel sese ahin saki ho jaonan, aboncha sana thengsel'a na tom jol ding, a kimvel jouse chu sana a na jep pahthet ding ahi.
en: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.
text:
EXO 30:3
Thadou: Maicham chung lang chule ajet le avei a kimvel sese ahin saki ho jaonan, aboncha sana thengsel'a na tom jol ding, a kimvel jouse chu sana a na jep pahthet ding ahi.
English: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.

tcz: Hiche maicham a manchah dia chu sana chaokol nijen nalhah ding, hiche chaokol teni chu maicham alang alang a sana ki jeppah na noiya abil na sem ma na ba peh chehcheh ding ahiye. Hiche chaokol teni sung a chu moljol ki thillut ding chu teng maicham chu kiputna ding ahi.
en: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.
text:
EXO 30:4
Thadou: Hiche maicham a manchah dia chu sana chaokol nijen nalhah ding, hiche chaokol teni chu maicham alang alang a sana ki jeppah na noiya abil na sem ma na ba peh chehcheh ding ahiye. Hiche chaokol teni sung a chu moljol ki thillut ding chu teng maicham chu kiputna ding ahi.
English: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.

tcz: Hiche maicham putna ding'a moljol teni jeng jong chu thinggi thing na suipeh ding, ania chu sana a na jep pah ding ahi.
en: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
text:
EXO 30:5
Thadou: Hiche maicham putna ding'a moljol teni jeng jong chu thinggi thing na suipeh ding, ania chu sana a na jep pah ding ahi.
English: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

tcz: Chule hiche hettoh-sahna thing-kong maicham ki khaina pondal maija chu, hettoh-sahna hepi laltouna mai lai tah hichu keiman nangma toh ka kimu to na ding a ka lhen dohna munna chu maicham na sem ding ahiye, ati.
en: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.
text:
EXO 30:6
Thadou: Chule hiche hettoh-sahna thing-kong maicham ki khaina pondal maija chu, hettoh-sahna hepi laltouna mai lai tah hichu keiman nangma toh ka kimu to na ding a ka lhen dohna munna chu maicham na sem ding ahiye, ati.
English: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.

tcz: Aaron in jong jingkah sim le hiche maicham kilhutna ho chu asuh theng jing ding chule hiche munna chu gimnatwi ahal nam jing ding ahi.
en: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.
text:
EXO 30:7
Thadou: Aaron in jong jingkah sim le hiche maicham kilhutna ho chu asuh theng jing ding chule hiche munna chu gimnatwi ahal nam jing ding ahi.
English: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.

tcz: Hiche bang achu nilhah lam jong le Aaron in gim namtui chu ahal nam jing ding, na khang lhum kei uva Pakaiya dia hiche gimnam tui chu na halnam jing diu ahi.
en: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
text:
EXO 30:8
Thadou: Hiche bang achu nilhah lam jong le Aaron in gim namtui chu ahal nam jing ding, na khang lhum kei uva Pakaiya dia hiche gimnam tui chu na halnam jing diu ahi.
English: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.

tcz: Hiche maicham chunga chu atheng lou ahin, chule gimnamtui hihen pumgo thil to hijong le na tothei lou diu ahi; don thei thilto jeng jong na sun khum lou hel diu ahi, ati.
en: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.
text:
EXO 30:9
Thadou: Hiche maicham chunga chu atheng lou ahin, chule gimnamtui hihen pumgo thil to hijong le na tothei lou diu ahi; don thei thilto jeng jong na sun khum lou hel diu ahi, ati.
English: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.

tcz: Kum khat sungse'a Aaron in jong sakiho chunga chu suhdetna abol ding, chule hiche na dinga chu suhdet na chonset thilpeh gan thisan amanchah ding ahiye; na khang lhum kei uva kumseh le khat vei cheh nabol diu, hichu Pakaiya dia thil theng chung nung penna pang ding ahi.
en: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to the LORD.”
text:
EXO 30:10
Thadou: Kum khat sungse'a Aaron in jong sakiho chunga chu suhdetna abol ding, chule hiche na dinga chu suhdet na chonset thilpeh gan thisan amanchah ding ahiye; na khang lhum kei uva kumseh le khat vei cheh nabol diu, hichu Pakaiya dia thil theng chung nung penna pang ding ahi.
English: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to the LORD.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseijin ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
EXO 30:11
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseijin ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Nangman Israel cha te na simma amin bu u na sem peh teng le, ama mimal cheh in along lhen diu akipoh cheh cheh diu ahi. Hitia chu nabol a amin u nasim teng achung'uva natna hoisi hung lang lou ding ahitai,” ati.
en: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are counted among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to the LORD when you count them, that there be no plague among them when you count them.
text:
EXO 30:12
Thadou: Nangman Israel cha te na simma amin bu u na sem peh teng le, ama mimal cheh in along lhen diu akipoh cheh cheh diu ahi. Hitia chu nabol a amin u nasim teng achung'uva natna hoisi hung lang lou ding ahitai,” ati.
English: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are counted among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to the LORD when you count them, that there be no plague among them when you count them.

tcz: Amin hungkisim ding jousen muntheng chunga chu longlhen man chah dinga shekel keh khat cheh ahin kipoh uva akoi diu ahi. hiche shekel khat chu Gerah dim khat toh'a kibang in, sekel keh khatma chu Pakaiya dia kikat doha ahi.
en: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel for an offering to the LORD.
text:
EXO 30:13
Thadou: Amin hungkisim ding jousen muntheng chunga chu longlhen man chah dinga shekel keh khat cheh ahin kipoh uva akoi diu ahi. hiche shekel khat chu Gerah dim khat toh'a kibang in, sekel keh khatma chu Pakaiya dia kikat doha ahi.
English: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel for an offering to the LORD.

tcz: Hiche min sim na pang kum somni'a lhah chunglam sen, Pakai heng'a thilpeh ding chengse chu apeh doh cheh diu ahiye.
en: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to the LORD.
text:
EXO 30:14
Thadou: Hiche min sim na pang kum somni'a lhah chunglam sen, Pakai heng'a thilpeh ding chengse chu apeh doh cheh diu ahiye.
English: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to the LORD.

tcz: Na boncha uvin Pakai ya dia thilpeh na peh teng uleh ahao avai khentum na beihel la shekel keh khat cheh na peh ding u ahi.
en: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.
text:
EXO 30:15
Thadou: Na boncha uvin Pakai ya dia thilpeh na peh teng uleh ahao avai khentum na beihel la shekel keh khat cheh na peh ding u ahi.
English: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.

tcz: Israel chaten ki suhdetna ding'a athilpeh chengse'u chu aboncha na lah khom ding, hiche a sum ho chengse chu kikhomna ponbuh thil le loa na man chah ding ahi. Hichea konna chu Israel chaten a natoh na uva konna Pathen in ahet jing ding u, hichu amaho Jouse longlhenna ding'a kibol jing ding ahi, ati.
en: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.”
text:
EXO 30:16
Thadou: Israel chaten ki suhdetna ding'a athilpeh chengse'u chu aboncha na lah khom ding, hiche a sum ho chengse chu kikhomna ponbuh thil le loa na man chah ding ahi. Hichea konna chu Israel chaten a natoh na uva konna Pathen in ahet jing ding u, hichu amaho Jouse longlhenna ding'a kibol jing ding ahi, ati.
