English: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga asei jin.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
EXO 30:17
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga asei jin.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Kisilna dinga sum eng kong khat na sem ding, atunna ding jong sum eng a na sem peh ding ahi. Hiche sum eng kong chu kikhop-khomna ponbuh le maicham kikah a na tun ding asung'a chu twi na sun dim ding ahi, ati.
en: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.
text:
EXO 30:18
Thadou: Kisilna dinga sum eng kong khat na sem ding, atunna ding jong sum eng a na sem peh ding ahi. Hiche sum eng kong chu kikhop-khomna ponbuh le maicham kikah a na tun ding asung'a chu twi na sun dim ding ahi, ati.
English: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

tcz: Hiche twiya chu Aaron le achapate jousen a khut ule akeng chengse'u a kisil ngim diu ahi.
en: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.
text:
EXO 30:19
Thadou: Hiche twiya chu Aaron le achapate jousen a khut ule akeng chengse'u a kisil ngim diu ahi.
English: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.

tcz: Aaron leh achapate houbuh sunga aluh ding teng ule, maicham a kin bolna dinga ahung nailut teng'u hi jong le, Pakaiya ding a thilto ding a hung u ham halnam ding thil a ahung u hijong le, abonchauva twiya chu kisil ngim soh kei ding u ahiye. Achuti louva ahile thina chang jeng ding ahiuve, ati.
en: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they not die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to the LORD.
text:
EXO 30:20
Thadou: Aaron leh achapate houbuh sunga aluh ding teng ule, maicham a kin bolna dinga ahung nailut teng'u hi jong le, Pakaiya ding a thilto ding a hung u ham halnam ding thil a ahung u hijong le, abonchauva twiya chu kisil ngim soh kei ding u ahiye. Achuti louva ahile thina chang jeng ding ahiuve, ati.
English: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they not die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to the LORD.

tcz: Ama hon akeng phang jouse'u le akhut jouseo akisil ngim chehcheh diu ahi, Ajeh chu hitia chu abollou uva ahile thina chang ding ahiuvin; a chate jouse'u ding hihen Aaron a ding hijong le ason achilhah jouseu va ding hi jong le hiche hi a khang a khang lhumkei uva chonna dan a ache pe jing diu ahi.
en: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”
text:
EXO 30:21
Thadou: Ama hon akeng phang jouse'u le akhut jouseo akisil ngim chehcheh diu ahi, Ajeh chu hitia chu abollou uva ahile thina chang ding ahiuvin; a chate jouse'u ding hihen Aaron a ding hijong le ason achilhah jouseu va ding hi jong le hiche hi a khang a khang lhumkei uva chonna dan a ache pe jing diu ahi.
English: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu asei jin.
en: Moreover the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
EXO 30:22
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu asei jin.
English: Moreover the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Nangman gimnamtui lah a anam tuipen na kilah ding, gimnam tui atwi lah Myrrh chu shekel ja-nga man nalah ding agim nam tui lah a ahoipen thingnam tuichu kehkhat nalah ding, hichu shekel jani le somnga alhing in, thingnam tui lah a jong anam twipen shekel jani le somnga mama nalah ding ahiye.
en: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;

tcz: Lingnamtui ga jing jong chu shekel kisim dungjuiya janga ma hi ding, chule Olive thao jong khon dimkhat ma na lah ding ahiye.
en: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.
text:
EXO 30:24
Thadou: Lingnamtui ga jing jong chu shekel kisim dungjuiya janga ma hi ding, chule Olive thao jong khon dimkhat ma na lah ding ahiye.
English: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.

tcz: “Hi chengse'a konna chu thao namtui sem them hon abolngai bang bang a, kinu thei dinga thao namtui nasem ding, hiche thao chu aboncha thao theng a kimang jing ding ahi.”
en: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.
text:
EXO 30:25
Thadou: “Hi chengse'a konna chu thao namtui sem them hon abolngai bang bang a, kinu thei dinga thao namtui nasem ding, hiche thao chu aboncha thao theng a kimang jing ding ahi.”
English: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.

tcz: Hiche thao chu kikhopna ponbuh a na nunam ding hettohsahna thingkong a jong chu na nunam ding ahiye.
en: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,
text:
EXO 30:26
Thadou: Hiche thao chu kikhopna ponbuh a na nunam ding hettohsahna thingkong a jong chu na nunam ding ahiye.
English: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,

tcz: Dokhang ahin, thilman chah ahin, thaomei khom ahin chule aman chah ho jouse jaonan, gim- namtui halna maicham jong aboncha nanu soh kei ding ahiye.
en: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,
text:
EXO 30:27
Thadou: Dokhang ahin, thilman chah ahin, thaomei khom ahin chule aman chah ho jouse jaonan, gim- namtui halna maicham jong aboncha nanu soh kei ding ahiye.
English: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

tcz: Hichu pumgo thilto le maicham thilto ahin, chule twikong ahin a kitunna jeng jong chu nanu soh kei ding ahi.
en: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.
text:
EXO 30:28
Thadou: Hichu pumgo thilto le maicham thilto ahin, chule twikong ahin a kitunna jeng jong chu nanu soh kei ding ahi.
English: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.

tcz: Thil hicheng se chu aboncha atheng ahi jing na dinga na thenso ding, ipi hi jong le hiche thil tongkha chan chu atheng a umjing ding ahi.
en: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.
text:
EXO 30:29
Thadou: Thil hicheng se chu aboncha atheng ahi jing na dinga na thenso ding, ipi hi jong le hiche thil tongkha chan chu atheng a umjing ding ahi.
English: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

tcz: Keima thempua pang ding'a Aaron le achapate jouse chu na thenso ding ahi.
en: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
text:
EXO 30:30
Thadou: Keima thempua pang ding'a Aaron le achapate jouse chu na thenso ding ahi.
English: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

tcz: Chu teng Nangman Israel chate henga na seipeh ding, hiche thao hi keima kinu ding a kasem ahin chule hichu akhang akhang a nakoi jing diu ahiye.
en: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.
text:
EXO 30:31
Thadou: Chu teng Nangman Israel chate henga na seipeh ding, hiche thao hi keima kinu ding a kasem ahin chule hichu akhang akhang a nakoi jing diu ahiye.
English: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.

tcz: Hiche thao theng chu moh mi chunga kinu khum theilou hel ding, hiche thao theng kihal khom bang chu thao dang toh na hel tha lou hel ding, hiche hi thao theng mong mong ahin, nang ho jouse dia athenga umjing ding ahiye.
en: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.
text:
EXO 30:32
Thadou: Hiche thao theng chu moh mi chunga kinu khum theilou hel ding, hiche thao theng kihal khom bang chu thao dang toh na hel tha lou hel ding, hiche hi thao theng mong mong ahin, nang ho jouse dia athenga umjing ding ahiye.
English: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.

tcz: Koi hile hiche thao theng chu adangho bang'a kihel chop ma aum ngai ngaija chule khol jin mi ham hetlou mikhat chung'a nanu nat ngai ngai uva ahile ama chu amite lah akon a ki delmang jeng ding ahi.”
en: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’”
text:
EXO 30:33
Thadou: Koi hile hiche thao theng chu adangho bang'a kihel chop ma aum ngai ngaija chule khol jin mi ham hetlou mikhat chung'a nanu nat ngai ngai uva ahile ama chu amite lah akon a ki delmang jeng ding ahi.”
English: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin, Thilnam twiho chu kilah inlang, Stacte, le Onycha, Chule Galbunum, thilnam tui ho jaonan Bego thengsel'a kihel hochu kilah tan ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum: sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.
text:
EXO 30:34
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin, Thilnam twiho chu kilah inlang, Stacte, le Onycha, Chule Galbunum, thilnam tui ho jaonan Bego thengsel'a kihel hochu kilah tan ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum: sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.

tcz: Thao namtui sem pa sem bang bang a na sem ding, chi naso khum ding thengsel'a na koi ding ahi.
en: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
text:
EXO 30:35
Thadou: Thao namtui sem pa sem bang bang a na sem ding, chi naso khum ding thengsel'a na koi ding ahi.
English: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

tcz: Ahalneo khat pha bep khat alum lumma na sem ding hicheng akonna chu akeh khat na khen doh a keiman nangma ka kimu pi na ding munna chu, hettosahna maicham maiya na koi ding, hichu nangho jouse dia thil theng chung nungpen ahi.
en: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.
text:
EXO 30:36
Thadou: Ahalneo khat pha bep khat alum lumma na sem ding hicheng akonna chu akeh khat na khen doh a keiman nangma ka kimu pi na ding munna chu, hettosahna maicham maiya na koi ding, hichu nangho jouse dia thil theng chung nungpen ahi.
English: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.

tcz: Nangman hiche na sem ding thao namtui chu nang ho manchah ding maimaija na kisem jeng lou diu ahiye; Ajeh chu nangma dinga Pakaiya dia atheng ahi.
en: You shall not make this incense, according to its composition, for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for the LORD.
text:
EXO 30:37
Thadou: Nangman hiche na sem ding thao namtui chu nang ho manchah ding maimaija na kisem jeng lou diu ahiye; Ajeh chu nangma dinga Pakaiya dia atheng ahi.
English: You shall not make this incense, according to its composition, for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for the LORD.

tcz: Koi hijong le nalah uva hiche gim namtui ja ki sem thil theng kihal mangcha aum khah a ahile ama chu amite lah a kon a delmang aum jeng ding ahi.
en: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”
text:
EXO 30:38
Thadou: Koi hijong le nalah uva hiche gim namtui ja ki sem thil theng kihal mangcha aum khah a ahile ama chu amite lah a kon a delmang aum jeng ding ahi.
English: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseijin, ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
EXO 31:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseijin, ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Vetan Judah phung akon Hur chapa ahin, Uri chapa Bezalel chu amin ka pan in ka kou e.
en: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
text:
EXO 31:2
Thadou: Vetan Judah phung akon Hur chapa ahin, Uri chapa Bezalel chu amin ka pan in ka kou e.
English: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

tcz: Keiman jong Bezalel chu Pathen lhangao ka dimsah in, chule thil boltheina le chihna khut themna jong ka petai.
en: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,
text:
EXO 31:3
Thadou: Keiman jong Bezalel chu Pathen lhangao ka dimsah in, chule thil boltheina le chihna khut themna jong ka petai.
English: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,

tcz: Thil lim jat chom chom a semna ding sana, chule sana dangka ahin sum eng khen themna tah ahi.
en: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,
text:
EXO 31:4
Thadou: Thil lim jat chom chom a semna ding sana, chule sana dangka ahin sum eng khen themna tah ahi.
English: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

tcz: Chule song tampi jong ahin, thingthem bol theina agomma Bezalel ka peh ahi tai, ati.
en: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.
text:
EXO 31:5
Thadou: Chule song tampi jong ahin, thingthem bol theina agomma Bezalel ka peh ahi tai, ati.
English: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.

tcz: Tun vetan, Bezalel kitipa hi Dan phunga kon Ahisamach chapa Oholiab toh ka kitho khomsah ahiye, hiche chung chonna keiman nangma ka thupeh chengse hi asuh bukimsel na ding un, Keima mi ahi jal a bolthei chan abolna ding ka peh a ahi, ati.
en: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:
text:
EXO 31:6
Thadou: Tun vetan, Bezalel kitipa hi Dan phunga kon Ahisamach chapa Oholiab toh ka kitho khomsah ahiye, hiche chung chonna keiman nangma ka thupeh chengse hi asuh bukimsel na ding un, Keima mi ahi jal a bolthei chan abolna ding ka peh a ahi, ati.
English: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

tcz: Kikhop khomna ponbuh ahin, hettoh sahna thingkong chule achunga hepi touna le asunglama thil jouse aboncha hi ding ahi.
en: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,
text:
EXO 31:7
Thadou: Kikhop khomna ponbuh ahin, hettoh sahna thingkong chule achunga hepi touna le asunglama thil jouse aboncha hi ding ahi.
English: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,

tcz: Dokhang chule manchah jouse jao nan, thaomei khom le amanchah chengse le gimnamtui kihalna jong hi ding ahi.
en: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,
text:
EXO 31:8
Thadou: Dokhang chule manchah jouse jao nan, thaomei khom le amanchah chengse le gimnamtui kihalna jong hi ding ahi.
English: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,

tcz: Pumgo thilto maicham semna manchah ahin, kisil thengna kong le aman chah jong hi ding ahi.
en: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,
text:
EXO 31:9
Thadou: Pumgo thilto maicham semna manchah ahin, kisil thengna kong le aman chah jong hi ding ahi.
English: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,

tcz: Phatah a kikhong ponsil chule hichu thempu-kin abolna diuva kikhong hi ding Aaron thempu chule achapate ding a akivon na diu atheng jong hi ding ahi.
en: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—
text:
EXO 31:10
Thadou: Phatah a kikhong ponsil chule hichu thempu-kin abolna diuva kikhong hi ding Aaron thempu chule achapate ding a akivon na diu atheng jong hi ding ahi.
English: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—

tcz: Tahsa a kinu ding thao namtui a kibol soh kei uva. Hitia chu ka thupeh chengse bang a aboltei tei diuva ahi.
en: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”
text:
EXO 31:11
Thadou: Tahsa a kinu ding thao namtui a kibol soh kei uva. Hitia chu ka thupeh chengse bang a aboltei tei diuva ahi.
English: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”

tcz: Hicheng jouse nung hin Pakaiyin Mose henga asei kit tan.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
EXO 31:12
Thadou: Hicheng jouse nung hin Pakaiyin Mose henga asei kit tan.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate henga seipeh tem in, nang hon keima cholngah nikho nanit teitei diu ahi, hiche cholngah nikho hi na khang lhum kei uva keima le nangho kikah a melchih na pang jing ding ahin; ajeh chu keima na Pakai uvin nangho jouse kathenso nao nahin hetjing diu ahi, ati.
en: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
text:
EXO 31:13
Thadou: Israel chate henga seipeh tem in, nang hon keima cholngah nikho nanit teitei diu ahi, hiche cholngah nikho hi na khang lhum kei uva keima le nangho kikah a melchih na pang jing ding ahin; ajeh chu keima na Pakai uvin nangho jouse kathenso nao nahin hetjing diu ahi, ati.
English: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

tcz: Na boncha uva cholngah nikho nanit teitei diu ahi, ajeh chu cholngah nikho hi nangho dinga atheng ahin; koi hile hiche cholngah nikho'a atheng lou a kikum kha chan chu thina chang ding ahiye. Chule cholngah nikhoa na tong a aumjong le hiche mipa chu amite lah akonna paidoh a um jeng ding ahi.
en: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
text:
EXO 31:14
Thadou: Na boncha uva cholngah nikho nanit teitei diu ahi, ajeh chu cholngah nikho hi nangho dinga atheng ahin; koi hile hiche cholngah nikho'a atheng lou a kikum kha chan chu thina chang ding ahiye. Chule cholngah nikhoa na tong a aumjong le hiche mipa chu amite lah akonna paidoh a um jeng ding ahi.
English: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

tcz: Nigup sungse'a toh thei channa toh ding, nisagi lhinni teng hichu nikho theng cholngah nikhoa naman chah diu ahin, ajeh chu Pakai nikho theng ahi. Koi hijong leh cholngah nikhoa na tong pen pen chu thina kichan sah ding ahi, ati.
en: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.
text:
EXO 31:15
Thadou: Nigup sungse'a toh thei channa toh ding, nisagi lhinni teng hichu nikho theng cholngah nikhoa naman chah diu ahin, ajeh chu Pakai nikho theng ahi. Koi hijong leh cholngah nikhoa na tong pen pen chu thina kichan sah ding ahi, ati.
English: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Israel chate jousen cholngah nikho theng hi beitih neilouva nanit jing diu, cholngah nikho chu aman jing diu, bei tih nei louva anit jing jing diuva ahiye.
en: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
text:
EXO 31:16
Thadou: Hijeh a chu Israel chate jousen cholngah nikho theng hi beitih neilouva nanit jing diu, cholngah nikho chu aman jing diu, bei tih nei louva anit jing jing diuva ahiye.
English: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

tcz: Ajeh chu ni gup sung chun Pakaiyin van le leiset anasem in; ni sagi lhin nin a kicholdo in ahi. hiche laitah jeh ahi nangman Israel chate jouse henga keima leh amaho kikah a melchih na apang jing ding ahi tin aheng uvah seiyin, ati.
en: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”
text:
EXO 31:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu ni gup sung chun Pakaiyin van le leiset anasem in; ni sagi lhin nin a kicholdo in ahi. hiche laitah jeh ahi nangman Israel chate jouse henga keima leh amaho kikah a melchih na apang jing ding ahi tin aheng uvah seiyin, ati.
English: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Sinai molsang chung a Mose henga hichengse asei chaisoh phat in, hettohsahna song pheng teni Pathen akon khutjih chu, Mose apetai.
en: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.
text:
EXO 31:18
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Sinai molsang chung a Mose henga hichengse asei chaisoh phat in, hettohsahna song pheng teni Pathen akon khutjih chu, Mose apetai.
English: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.

tcz: Mose chu Sinai Molsang akon in ahung kumlha vah tapon ahile, Israel mipi abonchauvin Aaron henga ahung uvin ajah a asei tauvin ahi; Nagman keiho eilam kai diuvin milim Pathen in neisem peh uvin, Mose Egypt gam'a kon'a eihin puidoh pa'u ageina lam ka hepha tapouvin, ama chungchang thua ima ka hepouve tin aseiyuve.
en: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”
text:
EXO 32:1
Thadou: Mose chu Sinai Molsang akon in ahung kumlha vah tapon ahile, Israel mipi abonchauvin Aaron henga ahung uvin ajah a asei tauvin ahi; Nagman keiho eilam kai diuvin milim Pathen in neisem peh uvin, Mose Egypt gam'a kon'a eihin puidoh pa'u ageina lam ka hepha tapouvin, ama chungchang thua ima ka hepouve tin aseiyuve.
English: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”

tcz: Aaron in jong aheng uva aseiyin, Na ji na chate'u bilba jouse sutlha uvin lang ka heng a na hin lhut soh kei diu ahi, ati.
en: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”
text:
EXO 32:2
Thadou: Aaron in jong aheng uva aseiyin, Na ji na chate'u bilba jouse sutlha uvin lang ka heng a na hin lhut soh kei diu ahi, ati.
English: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”

tcz: Chuin mipin jong abilba chengse'u a sutlha uvin Aaron henga ahin choi soh kei uve.
en: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
text:
EXO 32:3
Thadou: Chuin mipin jong abilba chengse'u a sutlha uvin Aaron henga ahin choi soh kei uve.
English: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.

tcz: Aaron in jong sana hochu alan, sana khen na manchah khat a kheng in, hichu bongnou khat limin akheng doh tai. Chuin mipin jong “Vo! Israel, Egypt gam'a konna na hin puidoh uva Pathen chu hiche hi ahi, atiuve”.
en: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”
text:
EXO 32:4
Thadou: Aaron in jong sana hochu alan, sana khen na manchah khat a kheng in, hichu bongnou khat limin akheng doh tai. Chuin mipin jong “Vo! Israel, Egypt gam'a konna na hin puidoh uva Pathen chu hiche hi ahi, atiuve”.
English: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”

tcz: Aaron in jong bongnou kilhajol chu aven, hiche lim kisemna maiya chun maicham asem in, Aaron in hitin aseiye; Jing nikho teng le Pakaiya di kut khat um ding ahi, ati.
en: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.”
text:
EXO 32:5
Thadou: Aaron in jong bongnou kilhajol chu aven, hiche lim kisemna maiya chun maicham asem in, Aaron in hitin aseiye; Jing nikho teng le Pakaiya di kut khat um ding ahi, ati.
English: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.”

tcz: Mipi jong chu jingkah matah in atou taovin Pakaiya din pumgo thilto maicham ahin choiyun, mipin jong neh le don ding twi jong atoh doh un, hiti chun ama ama malam cheh a nopsanan aumpai kit tauve.
en: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
text:
EXO 32:6
Thadou: Mipi jong chu jingkah matah in atou taovin Pakaiya din pumgo thilto maicham ahin choiyun, mipin jong neh le don ding twi jong atoh doh un, hiti chun ama ama malam cheh a nopsanan aumpai kit tauve.
English: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu a seikit in, ajah a, Chen lang na mite lam jon suh tan, ajeh chu nangman Egypt gamsunga konna nahin puidoh namite khu ama ama lam cheh a chon nun mangthah ding ahitaove, ati.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!
text:
EXO 32:7
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu a seikit in, ajah a, Chen lang na mite lam jon suh tan, ajeh chu nangman Egypt gamsunga konna nahin puidoh namite khu ama ama lam cheh a chon nun mangthah ding ahitaove, ati.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!

tcz: Keiman jui ding a ka peh jousea konin amaho achemang gam taovin, ama cham un bongnou lim asemun, chibai aboh un kithoi nan amang uvin hiti hin asei uve, “Vo israel mipite Egypt gam'a konna nahin puiod uva pathen chu hiche ho ahi, tin asam uve, ati.”
en: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”
text:
EXO 32:8
Thadou: Keiman jui ding a ka peh jousea konin amaho achemang gam taovin, ama cham un bongnou lim asemun, chibai aboh un kithoi nan amang uvin hiti hin asei uve, “Vo israel mipite Egypt gam'a konna nahin puiod uva pathen chu hiche ho ahi, tin asam uve, ati.”
English: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseijin, “Amaho chung chang thua keima kaki kum ding ahiye, ahi na'u abonchan kahesoh keijin milouchal te ahiuve, ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.
text:
EXO 32:9
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseijin, “Amaho chung chang thua keima kaki kum ding ahiye, ahi na'u abonchan kahesoh keijin milouchal te ahiuve, ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

tcz: Keima kaki kum ding, achung'uva kalung souna ka buhlhah ding abonchauva kabah gam hel ding ahiuve, amavang keiman in nangma hi nam lentah a katun ding nahi, ati.
en: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”
text:
EXO 32:10
Thadou: Keima kaki kum ding, achung'uva kalung souna ka buhlhah ding abonchauva kabah gam hel ding ahiuve, amavang keiman in nangma hi nam lentah a katun ding nahi, ati.
English: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”

tcz: Mose jong Pakai henga atao jing tan hitin aseije, “Ka Pakai na lungsatna Egypt gamma konna na hin puidoh namite chunga nalhun sah kigot jeng hi tam, ati.
en: Moses begged the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?
text:
EXO 32:11
Thadou: Mose jong Pakai henga atao jing tan hitin aseije, “Ka Pakai na lungsatna Egypt gamma konna na hin puidoh namite chunga nalhun sah kigot jeng hi tam, ati.
English: Moses begged the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?

tcz: Egypt miten hiti hin sei unte, Pakaiyin amaho hi thagam dinga ahin puidoh a, Pakaiyin amaho hi molsang chunga pat a ahin pui doh uva tha gam hel ding ati ahi tin gel unte, tia a seina thei diuva nabol ki got hi tam? Na lunghan na akon in lungset tah in na lung heijin lang hiche mite chunga hin suhgamna lhun sah hih beh jeng in tin a tauve.
en: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.
text:
EXO 32:12
Thadou: Egypt miten hiti hin sei unte, Pakaiyin amaho hi thagam dinga ahin puidoh a, Pakaiyin amaho hi molsang chunga pat a ahin pui doh uva tha gam hel ding ati ahi tin gel unte, tia a seina thei diuva nabol ki got hi tam? Na lunghan na akon in lungset tah in na lung heijin lang hiche mite chunga hin suhgamna lhun sah hih beh jeng in tin a tauve.
English: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.

tcz: Nalhacha masa Abraham, Isaac chule Israel chu avel in geldoh kit temin, aheng uvah kihahselna nana neiyin hitin naseiye, “Na son na chilhah teo kapunsah ding van'a ahsi jat kaphah sah diu chule keiman katepsa hiche gampumpi hi nanghon naluo soh hel ding u ahi, hichu nanghon atonsot tonsot geija ding ahi tia nasei chu avel in geldoh kit temin, ati.
en: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’”
text:
EXO 32:13
Thadou: Nalhacha masa Abraham, Isaac chule Israel chu avel in geldoh kit temin, aheng uvah kihahselna nana neiyin hitin naseiye, “Na son na chilhah teo kapunsah ding van'a ahsi jat kaphah sah diu chule keiman katepsa hiche gampumpi hi nanghon naluo soh hel ding u ahi, hichu nanghon atonsot tonsot geija ding ahi tia nasei chu avel in geldoh kit temin, ati.
English: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin amite chung a abol ding thil chu bol talouvin alung ahai tan ahi.
en: So the LORD turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.
text:
EXO 32:14
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin amite chung a abol ding thil chu bol talouvin alung ahai tan ahi.
English: So the LORD turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.

tcz: Mose jong molsang apat chun ahung kumsuh tan ahile, hettoh sahna songpheng teni a mailamma Pathen khut jih ki jih teni chu ahin choiyin ahi. Hiche song pehng teni chu anung lam ahin chu le amalam a jong anigel a lekha jem kisun ahi.
en: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.
text:
EXO 32:15
Thadou: Mose jong molsang apat chun ahung kumsuh tan ahile, hettoh sahna songpheng teni a mailamma Pathen khut jih ki jih teni chu ahin choiyin ahi. Hiche song pehng teni chu anung lam ahin chu le amalam a jong anigel a lekha jem kisun ahi.
English: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.

tcz: Hiche songpheng teni chu Pathen in asem ahin, Lekha jem kisung jeng jong chu Pathen lekha sut ma ahi. Hichu asong peng teni chunga chu a kijih sa ahiye.
en: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
text:
EXO 32:16
Thadou: Hiche songpheng teni chu Pathen in asem ahin, Lekha jem kisung jeng jong chu Pathen lekha sut ma ahi. Hichu asong peng teni chunga chu a kijih sa ahiye.
English: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

tcz: Chuin mipi awgin chu akithong jeng tan ahile Joshua injong Mose henga asei tai, “Ngahmun sunglama khu galkisat a hitam awgin khu ngaitiem in atin ahi”,
en: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”
text:
EXO 32:17
Thadou: Chuin mipi awgin chu akithong jeng tan ahile Joshua injong Mose henga asei tai, “Ngahmun sunglama khu galkisat a hitam awgin khu ngaitiem in atin ahi”,
English: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”

tcz: Mose'n jong a don but in aseije, “galjona awgin jong ahideh poi chule gal lal na jeh a awgin jong ahipoi, keiman ka jah dan in lakisa awgin joh ahiye, ati.
en: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”
text:
EXO 32:18
Thadou: Mose'n jong a don but in aseije, “galjona awgin jong ahideh poi chule gal lal na jeh a awgin jong ahipoi, keiman ka jah dan in lakisa awgin joh ahiye, ati.
English: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”

tcz: Mose jong ngahmun lailung ahung lhun tan ahile, bongnou lim ki sem thu chu amutan chule mipi abonchauva alam ujong chu amun ahile ama alungsa lheh jeng tan ahi. Chuin akhut tenia ahin choi songpheng teni chu tolla asep lhajeng tan ahile anigellin akeh jeng tan ahi.
en: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.
text:
EXO 32:19
Thadou: Mose jong ngahmun lailung ahung lhun tan ahile, bongnou lim ki sem thu chu amutan chule mipi abonchauva alam ujong chu amun ahile ama alungsa lheh jeng tan ahi. Chuin akhut tenia ahin choi songpheng teni chu tolla asep lhajeng tan ahile anigellin akeh jeng tan ahi.
English: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.

tcz: Mose'n jong bongnou lim kisem chu alan meiyin ahal vam lha jeng tan chuin tol lham ma jong agoidi jel in chu jouvin avutvai chengse chu twija asunglut in hiche twi chu Israel te abonchauvin adonsah in ahi.
en: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.
text:
EXO 32:20
Thadou: Mose'n jong bongnou lim kisem chu alan meiyin ahal vam lha jeng tan chuin tol lham ma jong agoidi jel in chu jouvin avutvai chengse chu twija asunglut in hiche twi chu Israel te abonchauvin adonsah in ahi.
English: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.

tcz: Mose'n jong Aaron henga aseiyin, hiche mite hon nachunga ipi lomlom a se abol uva nangman amaho chungchang thu jeh a hichan loma hi chonset nabol jeng hitam tin aseijin ahi.
en: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”
text:
EXO 32:21
Thadou: Mose'n jong Aaron henga aseiyin, hiche mite hon nachunga ipi lomlom a se abol uva nangman amaho chungchang thu jeh a hichan loma hi chonset nabol jeng hitam tin aseijin ahi.
English: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”

tcz: Aaron jeng jong chun aseijin ipilom ma nalung sat na na lhunsah jeng hitam kapu atin, amaho hi thilse bol ding a kipedoh ahitauve tin aseijin ahi.
en: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.
text:
EXO 32:22
Thadou: Aaron jeng jong chun aseijin ipilom ma nalung sat na na lhunsah jeng hitam kapu atin, amaho hi thilse bol ding a kipedoh ahitauve tin aseijin ahi.
English: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.

tcz: Amahon ka heng a asei un, ei lamkai thei diuvin pathen lim semthu tampi eisem peh un ajeh chu Mose kitipan Egypt gam'a kon in eihin puidoh uvin tun ama hoiya uma iti ham keihon ama chungchang imacha kahe tapouve tin asei uve.
en: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
text:
EXO 32:23
Thadou: Amahon ka heng a asei un, ei lamkai thei diuvin pathen lim semthu tampi eisem peh un ajeh chu Mose kitipan Egypt gam'a kon in eihin puidoh uvin tun ama hoiya uma iti ham keihon ama chungchang imacha kahe tapouve tin asei uve.
English: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

tcz: Keiman jong aheng uva ka seijin, sana bilba neichan in sutlha uvin katin ahile hichu kaheng a ahin choi jun, chuin keiman jong sana bilba jouse chu meilhum sung a kalhah a ahile bongnou lim in ahung soh doh tan ahi, ati.
en: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”
text:
EXO 32:24
Thadou: Keiman jong aheng uva ka seijin, sana bilba neichan in sutlha uvin katin ahile hichu kaheng a ahin choi jun, chuin keiman jong sana bilba jouse chu meilhum sung a kalhah a ahile bongnou lim in ahung soh doh tan ahi, ati.
English: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”

tcz: Aaron in hitia mipi anabol tah jeh chun Mose'n jong hiche mite hi akijumso ding mong mong a kilha thang ahitauve ti ahe chen tai.
en: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),
text:
EXO 32:25
Thadou: Aaron in hitia mipi anabol tah jeh chun Mose'n jong hiche mite hi akijumso ding mong mong a kilha thang ahitauve ti ahe chen tai.
English: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),

tcz: Mose jong achen ngahmun kelkot achun ading in, Pakaiya dia pang jing koikoi nalah uva um'em, kaheng lama hung un tin aseitan ahile, Levi chapate jouse chu Mose henglama ahung taovin ahi.
en: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on the LORD’s side, come to me!” All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.
text:
EXO 32:26
Thadou: Mose jong achen ngahmun kelkot achun ading in, Pakaiya dia pang jing koikoi nalah uva um'em, kaheng lama hung un tin aseitan ahile, Levi chapate jouse chu Mose henglama ahung taovin ahi.
English: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on the LORD’s side, come to me!” All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.

tcz: Mose'n jong amaho henga aseijin, Pakai Israel Pathen in aseije, Pasal ki tiphot in chem cha akong a ki poh cheh uhen, ngahmun kelkot alangto gel'in phetlha uvin lang, pasal a kai kiti phot in asopipa chu that jeng hen, chule pasal a kai phot chun a sopipa that jeng hen, pasal jousen aheng akom a in heng chan chu that jeng hen tin aseiye, ati.
en: He said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”
text:
EXO 32:27
Thadou: Mose'n jong amaho henga aseijin, Pakai Israel Pathen in aseije, Pasal ki tiphot in chem cha akong a ki poh cheh uhen, ngahmun kelkot alangto gel'in phetlha uvin lang, pasal a kai kiti phot in asopipa chu that jeng hen, chule pasal a kai phot chun a sopipa that jeng hen, pasal jousen aheng akom a in heng chan chu that jeng hen tin aseiye, ati.
English: He said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”

tcz: Chuin Levi chapaten jong Mose thupeh bang ban in mi a that tauvin ahile, hiche nikho chun mihem sang thum jen athi tauvin ahi.
en: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.
text:
EXO 32:28
Thadou: Chuin Levi chapaten jong Mose thupeh bang ban in mi a that tauvin ahile, hiche nikho chun mihem sang thum jen athi tauvin ahi.
English: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.

tcz: Mose'n jong hiti hin aseyin, tunia kipat nanghon na macham cheh uva Pakai kin nabol theina diuva, mi abangin achapa atha a, chule asopipa ham atha a, ajeh chu tuni nikhoa hi nang ho jouse chunga Pakaiyin nachung cheh uva thensona anei ahi, ati.
en: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”
text:
EXO 32:29
Thadou: Mose'n jong hiti hin aseyin, tunia kipat nanghon na macham cheh uva Pakai kin nabol theina diuva, mi abangin achapa atha a, chule asopipa ham atha a, ajeh chu tuni nikhoa hi nang ho jouse chunga Pakaiyin nachung cheh uva thensona anei ahi, ati.
English: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”

tcz: Mose'n jong ajing nikho in japi henga chun aseijin, nang hon chonsetna thanghoi tah nabol doh tauvin, keima tua hi Pakai henglama che touding ka hin, hiche chonset na bol uchu thoidamna na kisem peh diuva ahiye, ati.
en: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to the LORD. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”
text:
EXO 32:30
Thadou: Mose'n jong ajing nikho in japi henga chun aseijin, nang hon chonsetna thanghoi tah nabol doh tauvin, keima tua hi Pakai henglama che touding ka hin, hiche chonset na bol uchu thoidamna na kisem peh diuva ahiye, ati.
English: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to the LORD. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”

tcz: Mose jong Pakai henglama akilen asei tai, Hiche mipite jouse hi abonchauvin thanghoi tah in chonset abol tauvin ahi. ama amacham in pathen limsem thu tamtah ana kisem doh tauvin ahi, ati.
en: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.
text:
EXO 32:31
Thadou: Mose jong Pakai henglama akilen asei tai, Hiche mipite jouse hi abonchauvin thanghoi tah in chonset abol tauvin ahi. ama amacham in pathen limsem thu tamtah ana kisem doh tauvin ahi, ati.
English: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.

tcz: Hijong le Pakaiyin na lung ahile a chonset na'u jouse ngaidam teiyin, ngaidam thei lou dinmun ahitah le vang, na heng a ka hung tauve, nang man na jihdohsa hiche songpheng a kon chun keima hi nei sugam hel jeng tan tin atao tan ahi.
en: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”
text:
EXO 32:32
Thadou: Hijong le Pakaiyin na lung ahile a chonset na'u jouse ngaidam teiyin, ngaidam thei lou dinmun ahitah le vang, na heng a ka hung tauve, nang man na jihdohsa hiche songpheng a kon chun keima hi nei sugam hel jeng tan tin atao tan ahi.
English: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”

tcz: Chu in Pakaiyin Mose henga aseijin, “Koi hijong le keima doumah bol'a chonse pa bou chu hiche ka lekhasut akonna chu keiman jong ka suh gam hel jeng ding ahi,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.
text:
EXO 32:33
Thadou: Chu in Pakaiyin Mose henga aseijin, “Koi hijong le keima doumah bol'a chonse pa bou chu hiche ka lekhasut akonna chu keiman jong ka suh gam hel jeng ding ahi,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.

tcz: Tun nangma ki patdoh in keiman ka sei peh na mun, hiche mun channa chu mipi na ga lam kai ding ahiye. Ka vantil chu na masang lama masa ding, keiman nangma ka hung vil teng le koi hile hiche mite lah a achonse pen pen chu keiman lethuhna ka peh cheh cheh ding ahi,” ati.
en: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”
text:
EXO 32:34
Thadou: Tun nangma ki patdoh in keiman ka sei peh na mun, hiche mun channa chu mipi na ga lam kai ding ahiye. Ka vantil chu na masang lama masa ding, keiman nangma ka hung vil teng le koi hile hiche mite lah a achonse pen pen chu keiman lethuhna ka peh cheh cheh ding ahi,” ati.
English: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”

tcz: “Aaron in mi jouse bong lim ana sem peh tah jeh in Pakaiyin jong gamsunga natna hoise alansah tan ahi.”
en: The LORD struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.
text:
EXO 32:35
Thadou: “Aaron in mi jouse bong lim ana sem peh tah jeh in Pakaiyin jong gamsunga natna hoise alansah tan ahi.”
English: The LORD struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseijin, “kipat doh inlang che touvin, nangma chule Egypt gam'a konna nahin puidoh mite jouse jao nan, Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob henga kana kihah silna, na son na chilhha te ka peh ding ahi tia ka seina gam khu jon tauvin, ati.”
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’
text:
EXO 33:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseijin, “kipat doh inlang che touvin, nangma chule Egypt gam'a konna nahin puidoh mite jouse jao nan, Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob henga kana kihah silna, na son na chilhha te ka peh ding ahi tia ka seina gam khu jon tauvin, ati.”
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’

tcz: “Keiman na masang lama vantil khat ka sol ding, chuteng keiman Canaan mite, Amor mite, Hit mite, Periz mite, Hivi mite, Hit mite chule Jebus mite abonchauva ka deldoh gam hel ding ahiuve, ati.”
en: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
text:
EXO 33:2
Thadou: “Keiman na masang lama vantil khat ka sol ding, chuteng keiman Canaan mite, Amor mite, Hit mite, Periz mite, Hivi mite, Hit mite chule Jebus mite abonchauva ka deldoh gam hel ding ahiuve, ati.”
English: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

tcz: “Bongnoi le khoiju lonna gam khu jon taovin lang, ahin ka tahsa taha ka lhonpi lou ding nahi. Ajeh chu na louchal jeh'a lampi a ka moh suhgam jeng thei nahi, ati.
en: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”
text:
EXO 33:3
Thadou: “Bongnoi le khoiju lonna gam khu jon taovin lang, ahin ka tahsa taha ka lhonpi lou ding nahi. Ajeh chu na louchal jeh'a lampi a ka moh suhgam jeng thei nahi, ati.
English: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”

tcz: Mipin jong thu kisei awgin chu ajah doh phat uvin akap lha gam tauvin ahi. Mikhat jouse khat jeng cha jong a kivon na ngai yin a kivon ta pouvin ahi.”
en: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.
text:
EXO 33:4
Thadou: Mipin jong thu kisei awgin chu ajah doh phat uvin akap lha gam tauvin ahi. Mikhat jouse khat jeng cha jong a kivon na ngai yin a kivon ta pouvin ahi.”
English: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.

tcz: “Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseijin, Israel chate jouse henga seiyin, mi louchal te na hiuvin, bangkah khat na lhon tou pi jong leu, na louchal jal uva ka suhgam hel thei na hiuve, tun nangma chung cheh a na kivon na chengse'u sutlha uvin lang, chu teng keiman nangho lamhil ding dan na hin het them diu ahi, ati.”
en: The LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’”
text:
EXO 33:5
Thadou: “Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseijin, Israel chate jouse henga seiyin, mi louchal te na hiuvin, bangkah khat na lhon tou pi jong leu, na louchal jal uva ka suhgam hel thei na hiuve, tun nangma chung cheh a na kivon na chengse'u sutlha uvin lang, chu teng keiman nangho lamhil ding dan na hin het them diu ahi, ati.”
English: The LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’”

tcz: Chuin Horeb molsang akon in Israel chaten achung'uva kai akivon na jouse'u asut lha'u vin ahi.
en: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.
text:
EXO 33:6
Thadou: Chuin Horeb molsang akon in Israel chaten achung'uva kai akivon na jouse'u asut lha'u vin ahi.
English: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.

tcz: Mose'n jong ponbuh chu ana lang jing chule hichu ngah mun apat ki gamlha thim khat a ana son ji ahiye. Ponbuh chu kikhop khomna ponbuh ahin, miholah a koi hijong le Pakai holnom chan chu ngahmun pamlama ponbuh ki song lama chu ga che teitei ding ahi, ati.
en: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought the LORD went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.
text:
EXO 33:7
Thadou: Mose'n jong ponbuh chu ana lang jing chule hichu ngah mun apat ki gamlha thim khat a ana son ji ahiye. Ponbuh chu kikhop khomna ponbuh ahin, miholah a koi hijong le Pakai holnom chan chu ngahmun pamlama ponbuh ki song lama chu ga che teitei ding ahi, ati.
English: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought the LORD went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.

tcz: Mose jong chu ponbuh akonna ahung potdoh teng mipi abonchauvin ading doh jiuvin, mjouse jong chu ama ama kotpi phungbula ding den soh keijuva, Mose jong ponbuh asung lha kahsea mipin jong avet mang kei u ahi.
en: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.
text:
EXO 33:8
Thadou: Mose jong chu ponbuh akonna ahung potdoh teng mipi abonchauvin ading doh jiuvin, mjouse jong chu ama ama kotpi phungbula ding den soh keijuva, Mose jong ponbuh asung lha kahsea mipin jong avet mang kei u ahi.
English: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.

tcz: Chuin Mose jong ponbuh sung alut jiteng meibol chu ahung kitollut jin, kotpi phunga chun akitang den jin, chuteng Pakaiyin Mose chu akihoulim pijin ahi.
en: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and the LORD spoke with Moses.
text:
EXO 33:9
Thadou: Chuin Mose jong ponbuh sung alut jiteng meibol chu ahung kitollut jin, kotpi phunga chun akitang den jin, chuteng Pakaiyin Mose chu akihoulim pijin ahi.
English: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and the LORD spoke with Moses.

tcz: Mipiho jousen hiche meilhang kotpi phunga ahung kitan den amujiteng ule, Mipi jong abon chaovin ading doh uvin, amimal cheh in ama kotpi phung bul cheh a chibai aboh jiuvin ahi.
en: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.
text:
EXO 33:10
Thadou: Mipiho jousen hiche meilhang kotpi phunga ahung kitan den amujiteng ule, Mipi jong abon chaovin ading doh uvin, amimal cheh in ama kotpi phung bul cheh a chibai aboh jiuvin ahi.
English: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.

tcz: Mikhat in aloipa ahoulimpi bang bang in Pathen in Mose chu ahoulim pijin ahi. Mose jong ponbuh sunga ahung sunglhah kit teng, ama lhacha a pang leji Nun chapa Joshua jong hiti chun aum den jitai.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.
text:
EXO 33:11
Thadou: Mikhat in aloipa ahoulimpi bang bang in Pathen in Mose chu ahoulim pijin ahi. Mose jong ponbuh sunga ahung sunglhah kit teng, ama lhacha a pang leji Nun chapa Joshua jong hiti chun aum den jitai.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.

tcz: Mose'n Pakai henga aseijin, ven! Nangmatah in kajah a nasei ahi. Hiche mite hohi hinpui touvin tin naseiyin, ahinlah amahola a hi koipen toh neisol ding ham ti neiseipeh pon ahi. Ahinlah nangman naseiyin, keiman nangma hi hetsahna kapeh nahin chule nangman nasei jin keima lunglhaina vang nachang e nei tinai, ati.
en: Moses said to the LORD, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’
text:
EXO 33:12
Thadou: Mose'n Pakai henga aseijin, ven! Nangmatah in kajah a nasei ahi. Hiche mite hohi hinpui touvin tin naseiyin, ahinlah amahola a hi koipen toh neisol ding ham ti neiseipeh pon ahi. Ahinlah nangman naseiyin, keiman nangma hi hetsahna kapeh nahin chule nangman nasei jin keima lunglhaina vang nachang e nei tinai, ati.
English: Moses said to the LORD, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’

tcz: Tun nangma mitmua lunglhaina kachan tah a ahile, nahenga kahung taove, nangma kahetthem jinga chule namitmua jong lunglhaina kachan jing theina ding in, lamdih a kipugina ding jouse abonchan neihil inlang, amaho jong hi nagma mite ahiuve tijong hin sumil hih hel in, ati.
en: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”
text:
EXO 33:13
Thadou: Tun nangma mitmua lunglhaina kachan tah a ahile, nahenga kahung taove, nangma kahetthem jinga chule namitmua jong lunglhaina kachan jing theina ding in, lamdih a kipugina ding jouse abonchan neihil inlang, amaho jong hi nagma mite ahiuve tijong hin sumil hih hel in, ati.
English: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”

tcz: Pakaiyin aseijin, kami umpi nachun nalhon pi jing ding ahi. Hiche akonna chu nangma choldamna kachansah teiding nahiye, ati.
en: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
text:
EXO 33:14
Thadou: Pakaiyin aseijin, kami umpi nachun nalhon pi jing ding ahi. Hiche akonna chu nangma choldamna kachansah teiding nahiye, ati.
English: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

tcz: Mose'n jong Pakai henga aseijin, ahinaije, nangma umpi na chun neilhonpi jing louva ahile hiche munna pat hin neipuidoh dajeng taovin ati.
en: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.
text:
EXO 33:15
Thadou: Mose'n jong Pakai henga aseijin, ahinaije, nangma umpi na chun neilhonpi jing louva ahile hiche munna pat hin neipuidoh dajeng taovin ati.
English: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.

tcz: Keima kahin chule namite jouse ahin nangma mitmua lunglaina kachang uve tihi iti kihetdoh thei ding ham? Neilhon piteng ule keima ho hi atumbeh a neigel na'u ahin, keima ka hin chule namite abonchauva leiset chunga midang jouse akonna a tumbeh mong mong ka hitauve tihi ka het doh thei lou diu ham, ati.
en: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”
text:
EXO 33:16
Thadou: Keima kahin chule namite jouse ahin nangma mitmua lunglaina kachang uve tihi iti kihetdoh thei ding ham? Neilhon piteng ule keima ho hi atumbeh a neigel na'u ahin, keima ka hin chule namite abonchauva leiset chunga midang jouse akonna a tumbeh mong mong ka hitauve tihi ka het doh thei lou diu ham, ati.
English: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”

tcz: Chu in Pakaiyin Mose henga aseijin, “Na seidohsa hi keiman ka bol ding ahi. Ajeh chu kamit mua lunglhaina nachan ahin, hiche jeh chun keiman nangma ka het chenset na hitai,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”
text:
EXO 33:17
Thadou: Chu in Pakaiyin Mose henga aseijin, “Na seidohsa hi keiman ka bol ding ahi. Ajeh chu kamit mua lunglhaina nachan ahin, hiche jeh chun keiman nangma ka het chenset na hitai,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”

tcz: Mose'n jong asei jin, ka hung tauve,” na loupina ka heng'a kilah sah tei teijin ati tan ahile.”
en: Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”
text:
EXO 33:18
Thadou: Mose'n jong asei jin, ka hung tauve,” na loupina ka heng'a kilah sah tei teijin ati tan ahile.”
English: Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”

tcz: Pakaiyin adonbut in ajah a, “Ka loupi na aboncha na masang lama ka kitolsah ding, na masang lama pakai min ka sam phong peh ding, chule ka lungsetna chu na chan jing ding, hepi na jong nangma kachansah ding naiye,” ati.
en: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim the LORD’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”
text:
EXO 33:19
Thadou: Pakaiyin adonbut in ajah a, “Ka loupi na aboncha na masang lama ka kitolsah ding, na masang lama pakai min ka sam phong peh ding, chule ka lungsetna chu na chan jing ding, hepi na jong nangma kachansah ding naiye,” ati.
English: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim the LORD’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”

tcz: Chuin aman aseijin, “Ahinlah kamai vang namu thei lou ding ahiye, ajeh chu mihem koihile kamai muchan chu thijeng ding ahi,” ati.
en: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”
text:
EXO 33:20
Thadou: Chuin aman aseijin, “Ahinlah kamai vang namu thei lou ding ahiye, ajeh chu mihem koihile kamai muchan chu thijeng ding ahi,” ati.
English: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”

tcz: Pakaiyin aseijin, Ven! “Ka komma a onglaija hin hung ding inlang, hiche songpi chunga hi nadin ding ahiye.”
en: The LORD also said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.
text:
EXO 33:21
Thadou: Pakaiyin aseijin, Ven! “Ka komma a onglaija hin hung ding inlang, hiche songpi chunga hi nadin ding ahiye.”
English: The LORD also said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.

tcz: “Ka loupina ahung kitol teng le keiman songpi kikah a kasel ding, hiche laimunna chu kasel jing ding keiman kadalhah teng le bou kahoh doh kit ding ahi,” ati.
en: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;

tcz: “Ka dalhah teng le keiman ka hin hoh doh ding, chuteng kanung lam bou namu ding, itinama jong le kamai vang namu thei lou ding ahi,” ati.
en: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”
text:
EXO 33:23
Thadou: “Ka dalhah teng le keiman ka hin hoh doh ding, chuteng kanung lam bou namu ding, itinama jong le kamai vang namu thei lou ding ahi,” ati.
English: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”

tcz: Pakayin Mose henga thu aseijin, “Masang ngaiya bang'in songpheng'ni suiyin lang, hiche song pheng teni achu masang'a nangman nasekeh songpheng teni chung'a kijih thuchang chu keiman ka hin sut kit ding ahi.”
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.
text:
EXO 34:1
Thadou: Pakayin Mose henga thu aseijin, “Masang ngaiya bang'in songpheng'ni suiyin lang, hiche song pheng teni achu masang'a nangman nasekeh songpheng teni chung'a kijih thuchang chu keiman ka hin sut kit ding ahi.”
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

tcz: “Kigo'in lang jingkah teng'le Sinai molsang lam'a nahung kal touding, molsang vum'a kaheng'a nahung din ding ahi,” ati.
en: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.
text:
EXO 34:2
Thadou: “Kigo'in lang jingkah teng'le Sinai molsang lam'a nahung kal touding, molsang vum'a kaheng'a nahung din ding ahi,” ati.
English: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.

tcz: “Koima dang na hin kilhon pithei lou ding, hiche molsang jousea khu koi macha dang kilah thei lou ding ahi. Kelngoi hon ahin gancha kitiphot khat jeng cha jong molsang lah a khu nalhat sah lou ding ahi.”
en: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”
text:
EXO 34:3
Thadou: “Koima dang na hin kilhon pithei lou ding, hiche molsang jousea khu koi macha dang kilah thei lou ding ahi. Kelngoi hon ahin gancha kitiphot khat jeng cha jong molsang lah a khu nalhat sah lou ding ahi.”
English: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”

tcz: Mose'n jong masang'abang bang chun songpheng ni asuiyin, ajing jingkah matah'in athoudoh'in Pakai thupeh bang chun Sinai molsang chung vum'a ache tou tan, song pheng teni achoijin a kaltou tai.
en: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; then Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand two stone tablets.
text:
EXO 34:4
Thadou: Mose'n jong masang'abang bang chun songpheng ni asuiyin, ajing jingkah matah'in athoudoh'in Pakai thupeh bang chun Sinai molsang chung vum'a ache tou tan, song pheng teni achoijin a kaltou tai.
English: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; then Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand two stone tablets.

tcz: “Molvum lama kon'in Pakai chu mei bol in ahung tan chuin Mose toh'a ding khom lhonne. Chuin Pakai min chu sangtah in akouvin ahi.”
en: The LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the LORD’s name.
text:
EXO 34:5
Thadou: “Molvum lama kon'in Pakai chu mei bol in ahung tan chuin Mose toh'a ding khom lhonne. Chuin Pakai min chu sangtah in akouvin ahi.”
English: The LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the LORD’s name.

tcz: “Pakai jong Mose masa lang lama chen, a sei peh in, Pakai, Pakai hepi them le lunghang vah lou iti channa mi lungset them le dihna dimset jeng tin asei in ahi.”
en: The LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, “The LORD! The LORD, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,
text:
EXO 34:6
Thadou: “Pakai jong Mose masa lang lama chen, a sei peh in, Pakai, Pakai hepi them le lunghang vah lou iti channa mi lungset them le dihna dimset jeng tin asei in ahi.”
English: The LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, “The LORD! The LORD, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,

tcz: “Mihem asang asang chung'a lungset na nei jing, themmona le suhkhel na jouse jong ngaidam jia, amavang themmona alembaseh'a umsah lou mipa le chate kikah atute channa natong jing ding, chule khang thumle-li channa natong theiya ahi,” ati.
en: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”
text:
EXO 34:7
Thadou: “Mihem asang asang chung'a lungset na nei jing, themmona le suhkhel na jouse jong ngaidam jia, amavang themmona alembaseh'a umsah lou mipa le chate kikah atute channa natong jing ding, chule khang thumle-li channa natong theiya ahi,” ati.
English: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”

tcz: “Mose jong tol lhamma akun'in chibai aboh paijin ahi.”
en: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.
text:
EXO 34:8
Thadou: “Mose jong tol lhamma akun'in chibai aboh paijin ahi.”
English: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.

tcz: “Mose'n aseijin, “O Pakai nangma mitmua lunglhaina kachanna ahile, nahenga kataove, Pakai hi kalah uvah hung um henlang, kathemmo nao le kachonset najouse ngaidamin, nagoulo thei din neisem taovin,” ati.
en: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”
text:
EXO 34:9
Thadou: “Mose'n aseijin, “O Pakai nangma mitmua lunglhaina kachanna ahile, nahenga kataove, Pakai hi kalah uvah hung um henlang, kathemmo nao le kachonset najouse ngaidamin, nagoulo thei din neisem taovin,” ati.
English: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”

tcz: “Chuin Pakaiyin aseijin, Tua hi keiman nangma toh ikah'a kitepna ka sem ding ahi. Namite lah a keiman thil nasatah tah ka kilah sah ding, hi tabang thil ki dang hohi leiset'a ana umkha lou lai ahin, chule nam dang telah jeng ajong anasoh khalou lai ahi. Na chenna chan uva mihem hon Pakai thil bol ki dang ahin mudoh diu, ajeh chu keiman ka hinbol ding thil hi thil ki dang tah ahi,” ati.
en: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of the LORD; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.
text:
EXO 34:10
Thadou: “Chuin Pakaiyin aseijin, Tua hi keiman nangma toh ikah'a kitepna ka sem ding ahi. Namite lah a keiman thil nasatah tah ka kilah sah ding, hi tabang thil ki dang hohi leiset'a ana umkha lou lai ahin, chule nam dang telah jeng ajong anasoh khalou lai ahi. Na chenna chan uva mihem hon Pakai thil bol ki dang ahin mudoh diu, ajeh chu keiman ka hinbol ding thil hi thil ki dang tah ahi,” ati.
English: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of the LORD; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.

tcz: “Tunin ka thupeh hi na suhmil lou ding ahi. Nei hin ven, kei matah in namasang lama Amor mite, Canaan mite, Hit mite, Periz mite, Hivi mite le Jebus mite abonchauva kajam sah gam diu ahi.”
en: Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
text:
EXO 34:11
Thadou: “Tunin ka thupeh hi na suhmil lou ding ahi. Nei hin ven, kei matah in namasang lama Amor mite, Canaan mite, Hit mite, Periz mite, Hivi mite le Jebus mite abonchauva kajam sah gam diu ahi.”
English: Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

tcz: “Tun nangma ki cheh theiyin, na chenna gammite toh kitepna hinsem khan nate, achuti louva ahile hitabang kitepna chu kipal lhuh'na hung pang ding ahi,” ati.
en: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among you;

tcz: “Hijeh chun nangman hiche gammite maicham jouse chu nasuh set gamhel ding, akhompi jouseo jong nasuh lhuh soh kei ding ahi, chule Asher doi jong chu na phuh lhuh ding ahi.”
en: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;

tcz: “Ajeh chu nangma pathen dang angsung'a naboh khup'a natao theilou hel ding ahi. Ajeh chu amin jong Pakai chule Pathen chu hung thang tom jing thei ahi,” ati.
en: for you shall worship no other god; for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
text:
EXO 34:14
Thadou: “Ajeh chu nangma pathen dang angsung'a naboh khup'a natao theilou hel ding ahi. Ajeh chu amin jong Pakai chule Pathen chu hung thang tom jing thei ahi,” ati.
English: for you shall worship no other god; for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

tcz: “Hijeh chun agamsung chengte toh kitepna na sem thei lou ding, hiche mite chun a pathen'nu umchan atho diu amaho le amho kah a jonthan hoi in apat diu, hiche pathen semthu ho heng'a kilhaina asem teng ule nangma jong nahin tep diu ahin, hiche a na hinkou pen pen-sa ki lhaina chu naneh thei lou ding ahi,” ati.
en: “Don’t make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, lest they play the prostitute after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice;

tcz: “Na chapate ji ding'a agam cheng numei napuipeh theilou ding, a channute jouse'u a pathen'u umchan atho uva a ki joh bang uva khu, na chapate jeng jong hung ki joh lo ding'u ahi.”
en: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.
text:
EXO 34:16
Thadou: “Na chapate ji ding'a agam cheng numei napuipeh theilou ding, a channute jouse'u a pathen'u umchan atho uva a ki joh bang uva khu, na chapate jeng jong hung ki joh lo ding'u ahi.”
English: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.

tcz: “Chule nangma macham'ma pathen limsem thu kiti mong mong nahou lou ding ahi.”
en: “You shall make no cast idols for yourselves.
text:
EXO 34:17
Thadou: “Chule nangma macham'ma pathen limsem thu kiti mong mong nahou lou ding ahi.”
English: “You shall make no cast idols for yourselves.

tcz: “Chol solou changlhah kut jong imatih channa na man jing ding ahi. Ka thupeh bang bang'a aphat ahung lhun teng, Abib lha sungse'a chu nangman cholsolou changlhah na neh ding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche lha sunga hi nangma Egypt gam sung'a kon'a na hung doh ahi,” ati.
en: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.
text:
EXO 34:18
Thadou: “Chol solou changlhah kut jong imatih channa na man jing ding ahi. Ka thupeh bang bang'a aphat ahung lhun teng, Abib lha sungse'a chu nangman cholsolou changlhah na neh ding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche lha sunga hi nangma Egypt gam sung'a kon'a na hung doh ahi,” ati.
English: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.

tcz: “Chule ahung peng doh masa jouse chu keiya ding ahi. Achal'a kai lhah ki tiphot chu, gancha lah'a bong ahin, kelngoi hi jong le keija ding ahi.”
en: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.
text:
EXO 34:19
Thadou: “Chule ahung peng doh masa jouse chu keiya ding ahi. Achal'a kai lhah ki tiphot chu, gancha lah'a bong ahin, kelngoi hi jong le keija ding ahi.”
English: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.

tcz: “Sangan hung peng doh masa jong chu nangman kelngoi khat'a nalhat doh ding, ita bang khatna na lhat doh jou louva ahile hiche sangan nou chu angong chang na he boh peh ding ahi. Na chapate lah'a ahung peng doh masa pen jong lhat dohna na sem peh tei ding, ajeh chu na lah uva koima ka heng lam'a khut goh keuva hung kilah thei lou ding ahi.”
en: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.
text:
EXO 34:20
Thadou: “Sangan hung peng doh masa jong chu nangman kelngoi khat'a nalhat doh ding, ita bang khatna na lhat doh jou louva ahile hiche sangan nou chu angong chang na he boh peh ding ahi. Na chapate lah'a ahung peng doh masa pen jong lhat dohna na sem peh tei ding, ajeh chu na lah uva koima ka heng lam'a khut goh keuva hung kilah thei lou ding ahi.”
English: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.

tcz: “Ni gup sung se'a nangman tohthei chan natoh ding, ni sagi lhinni teng le na kichol do ding ahi. Lou na toh lai hihen lholhun lai hijong le nangma nakichol teitei ding ahi,” ati.
en: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.
text:
EXO 34:21
Thadou: “Ni gup sung se'a nangman tohthei chan natoh ding, ni sagi lhinni teng le na kichol do ding ahi. Lou na toh lai hihen lholhun lai hijong le nangma nakichol teitei ding ahi,” ati.
English: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.

tcz: “Ni sagi lhin nia kut jong na bol jing ding na nit teitei ding ahi. Chule suhlou chang kut jong na bol jing ding, kum lhun teng le muchi ga soh khop tup kut jong na bol cheh cheh ding ahi.”
en: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.
text:
EXO 34:22
Thadou: “Ni sagi lhin nia kut jong na bol jing ding na nit teitei ding ahi. Chule suhlou chang kut jong na bol jing ding, kum lhun teng le muchi ga soh khop tup kut jong na bol cheh cheh ding ahi.”
English: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.

tcz: “Kum khat sung'a namite lah'a pasal'a kai lhah jouse Israel Pakai, Pathen heng'a hung kilah cheh ding'u ahi.”
