en: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
text:
EXO 34:23
Thadou: “Kum khat sung'a namite lah'a pasal'a kai lhah jouse Israel Pakai, Pathen heng'a hung kilah cheh ding'u ahi.”
English: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.

tcz: “Ajeh chu keiman nam tin vaipi jouse masang'a ka huh doh'a hitia chu na gamgi ka suh len ding ahi. Ajeh chu nangma kumkhat sung'a Pakai heng'a kilah ding na che teng le hiche gamma kon'na chu khat jeng chan jong na umlou kah'a na gam sung lah ding lung aken lou hel ding'u ahi.”
en: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before the LORD, your God, three times in the year.
text:
EXO 34:24
Thadou: “Ajeh chu keiman nam tin vaipi jouse masang'a ka huh doh'a hitia chu na gamgi ka suh len ding ahi. Ajeh chu nangma kumkhat sung'a Pakai heng'a kilah ding na che teng le hiche gamma kon'na chu khat jeng chan jong na umlou kah'a na gam sung lah ding lung aken lou hel ding'u ahi.”
English: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before the LORD, your God, three times in the year.

tcz: “Ka heng'a ki lhaina sa kiti phot chol sosa toh na neh tha lou ding, kalchuh kut'a ding'a sa kithat chan jong jing khovah geiya na koi den theilou diu ahi.”
en: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning.
text:
EXO 34:25
Thadou: “Ka heng'a ki lhaina sa kiti phot chol sosa toh na neh tha lou ding, kalchuh kut'a ding'a sa kithat chan jong jing khovah geiya na koi den theilou diu ahi.”
English: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning.

tcz: “Na gamsung'a ga soh jouse jong na Pakai leh na Pathen heng'a nahin poh lut cheh cheh ding ahi. Chule kelngoi nou jeng jong api noitwija na hon min thei lou ding ahi.”
en: “You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”
text:
EXO 34:26
Thadou: “Na gamsung'a ga soh jouse jong na Pakai leh na Pathen heng'a nahin poh lut cheh cheh ding ahi. Chule kelngoi nou jeng jong api noitwija na hon min thei lou ding ahi.”
English: “You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”

tcz: “Pakaiyin Mose heng'a thu asei in, Ka thupeh chengse abonchan sun doh cheh cheh in, Ka thupeh chengse dung juiya hi Israel toh na kikah'a kitepna ka sem doh ding ahi,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”
text:
EXO 34:27
Thadou: “Pakaiyin Mose heng'a thu asei in, Ka thupeh chengse abonchan sun doh cheh cheh in, Ka thupeh chengse dung juiya hi Israel toh na kikah'a kitepna ka sem doh ding ahi,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”

tcz: Hiche laimun na chun Pakai le Mose chu ni som le jan som li jen aum khom in ahi. Hiche phatsung'a ahin Mose'n twi jong donlou an jong ne louvin aum in ahi. Hichea kitepna jouse chu Mose'n jong song pheng teni chung achun ajih lut tan ahi.”
en: He was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
text:
EXO 34:28
Thadou: Hiche laimun na chun Pakai le Mose chu ni som le jan som li jen aum khom in ahi. Hiche phatsung'a ahin Mose'n twi jong donlou an jong ne louvin aum in ahi. Hichea kitepna jouse chu Mose'n jong song pheng teni chung achun ajih lut tan ahi.”
English: He was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

tcz: “Sinai molsang lam'a kon'in Mose jong ahung kum suh'in ahile hettoh sahna song pheng teni chu ahin choiyin ahi. Mose mai chu vahlha jeng'e ajeh chu Pathen toh aga kihou lim jeh ahin hinlah aman ahedoh pon ahi.”
en: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.
text:
EXO 34:29
Thadou: “Sinai molsang lam'a kon'in Mose jong ahung kum suh'in ahile hettoh sahna song pheng teni chu ahin choiyin ahi. Mose mai chu vahlha jeng'e ajeh chu Pathen toh aga kihou lim jeh ahin hinlah aman ahedoh pon ahi.”
English: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.

tcz: “Chuin Aaron le Israel chate jousen amudoh taovin ahile, Mose chu amai avah lha jeng tan, chuin amaho abonchaovin akicha lheh jeng tauvin ave ngam ta pouvin nai jong ahin nai lut ngam tapouve.”
en: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.
text:
EXO 34:30
Thadou: “Chuin Aaron le Israel chate jousen amudoh taovin ahile, Mose chu amai avah lha jeng tan, chuin amaho abonchaovin akicha lheh jeng tauvin ave ngam ta pouvin nai jong ahin nai lut ngam tapouve.”
English: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.

tcz: Mose'n ahin kouvun, Chun in Aaron le khopi sung'a lamkai jouse Mose henglama ahung un, Mose'n jong ama ho chengse chu aki hou pin ahi.”
en: Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.
text:
EXO 34:31
Thadou: Mose'n ahin kouvun, Chun in Aaron le khopi sung'a lamkai jouse Mose henglama ahung un, Mose'n jong ama ho chengse chu aki hou pin ahi.”
English: Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.

tcz: “Israel chate ho jousen jong ahin nailut cheh uvin, Sinai molsang chung vumma Pakaiyin Mose ahoupi na bang bang in Mose'n jong Israel mite Jouse chu a houlim pi'n thu jouse chu ajah uva a sei peh tan ahi.”
en: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that the LORD had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
text:
EXO 34:32
Thadou: “Israel chate ho jousen jong ahin nailut cheh uvin, Sinai molsang chung vumma Pakaiyin Mose ahoupi na bang bang in Mose'n jong Israel mite Jouse chu a houlim pi'n thu jouse chu ajah uva a sei peh tan ahi.”
English: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that the LORD had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

tcz: “Mose'n jong thupeh Jouse aheng uva asei chai soh phat in amai dal ding in pon khat aki lekhu sah tai.”
en: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.
text:
EXO 34:33
Thadou: “Mose'n jong thupeh Jouse aheng uva asei chai soh phat in amai dal ding in pon khat aki lekhu sah tai.”
English: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

tcz: “Mose jong Pakai to kihoulim ding'a ache lut ji teng, ahung potdoh kit kahsen amai dalna ding'a ponkhu chu ahin ki lah doh kit ji tan ahi. Mose jong ahung poh doh'a Pakaiyin ipi ahin seipeh ahi dem ti Isreal mite heng'a a seipeh jin ahi.”
en: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
text:
EXO 34:34
Thadou: “Mose jong Pakai to kihoulim ding'a ache lut ji teng, ahung potdoh kit kahsen amai dalna ding'a ponkhu chu ahin ki lah doh kit ji tan ahi. Mose jong ahung poh doh'a Pakaiyin ipi ahin seipeh ahi dem ti Isreal mite heng'a a seipeh jin ahi.”
English: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

tcz: Israel cha ten jong Mose maichu ave uvin ahile, avah lha jeng in ahi. Mose jong Pakai toh kimu to ding'a ache lut kit kah sen amai dalna pon chu akikhu jin ahi.
en: The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone; so Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
text:
EXO 34:35
Thadou: Israel cha ten jong Mose maichu ave uvin ahile, avah lha jeng in ahi. Mose jong Pakai toh kimu to ding'a ache lut kit kah sen amai dalna pon chu akikhu jin ahi.
English: The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone; so Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

tcz: Mose'n jong Israel insung abonchauvin a kou khom soh keiyin ajah'uva a seipeh in ahi. Hi chengse hi Pakaiyin nangho jouse jui ding in aseiyin ahi.
en: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which the LORD has commanded, that you should do them.
text:
EXO 35:1
Thadou: Mose'n jong Israel insung abonchauvin a kou khom soh keiyin ajah'uva a seipeh in ahi. Hi chengse hi Pakaiyin nangho jouse jui ding in aseiyin ahi.
English: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which the LORD has commanded, that you should do them.

tcz: “Nanghon hapta sung'a tohthei chan na toh pan ding un ni gup na nei uvin, ni sagi lhinni hi nang ho dia nikho theng ahin, hiche nikhoa hi na kichol soh kei diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiya dia thenso ahi tai, koi hile hiche nikhoa na tong chan chu thina chang jeng ding ahiye.”
en: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to the LORD: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.
text:
EXO 35:2
Thadou: “Nanghon hapta sung'a tohthei chan na toh pan ding un ni gup na nei uvin, ni sagi lhinni hi nang ho dia nikho theng ahin, hiche nikhoa hi na kichol soh kei diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiya dia thenso ahi tai, koi hile hiche nikhoa na tong chan chu thina chang jeng ding ahiye.”
English: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to the LORD: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.

tcz: “Cholngah nikhoa hi nangma insung cheh'a mei jong nati kong louhel ding'u ahi.”
en: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’”
text:
EXO 35:3
Thadou: “Cholngah nikhoa hi nangma insung cheh'a mei jong nati kong louhel ding'u ahi.”
English: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’”

tcz: Chuin Mose'n Israel chate jouse heng'a a seipeh in, hiche hi Pakaiyin athupeh ahi:
en: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
text:
EXO 35:4
Thadou: Chuin Mose'n Israel chate jouse heng'a a seipeh in, hiche hi Pakaiyin athupeh ahi:
English: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,

tcz: “Pakai henga na thilpeh diu chu nangma nei cheh chu dong khommu vin lang, ami chancheh in Pakai ding'a thilpeh na kat doh diu chu ki choi cheh'uvin. Pakai ding'a hongphal tah in hicheng hi pehen: sana le dangka chule sum eng,”
en: ‘Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as the LORD’s offering: gold, silver, bronze,
text:
EXO 35:5
Thadou: “Pakai henga na thilpeh diu chu nangma nei cheh chu dong khommu vin lang, ami chancheh in Pakai ding'a thilpeh na kat doh diu chu ki choi cheh'uvin. Pakai ding'a hongphal tah in hicheng hi pehen: sana le dangka chule sum eng,”
English: ‘Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as the LORD’s offering: gold, silver, bronze,

tcz: “A engdum ahin, asan dup hichu hoitah'a kikhong hi ding; kelcha mul jaona hi ding ahiye.
en: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
text:
EXO 35:6
Thadou: “A engdum ahin, asan dup hichu hoitah'a kikhong hi ding; kelcha mul jaona hi ding ahiye.
English: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

tcz: “A ki nam-sel kelngoi chal vun chule kelcha vun ahin thinggi thing jaona hi ding ahi.
en: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
text:
EXO 35:7
Thadou: “A ki nam-sel kelngoi chal vun chule kelcha vun ahin thinggi thing jaona hi ding ahi.
English: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

tcz: “Thaomei ding'a Olive thao hi ding; chule kinu ding thao namtui jong halnam thei thao twi jao cheh cheh ding ahi;
en: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

tcz: “Songman tam, chule tun ding song jong konggah omphoa manchah ding jong ahi.
en: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
text:
EXO 35:9
Thadou: “Songman tam, chule tun ding song jong konggah omphoa manchah ding jong ahi.
English: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

tcz: “Koi hile na lah uva khutthem na tong thei jouse hung'un. Tundoh ding'a Pakai thupeh chengse sauvin:
en: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that the LORD has commanded:
text:
EXO 35:10
Thadou: “Koi hile na lah uva khutthem na tong thei jouse hung'un. Tundoh ding'a Pakai thupeh chengse sauvin:
English: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that the LORD has commanded:

tcz: “A ponbuh ding, a chung vum'a khu ding, athil manchah jouse jao nan, ajol le akhompi jouse jaona hiding ahi;
en: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;

tcz: “Thingkong chule aputna ding moljol teni jong; hepi touna, chule pon akhu khumna'a kimang jong hi ding ahiye;
en: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;

tcz: “Chule dokhang ahin amol jol ho jaona; manchah chengse le changlhah ki kat dohsa ho jaona hi ding ahi;
en: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;

tcz: “Meivah thaomei khom le aman chah chengse; chule Olive thao vahding jaona hi ding ahi.
en: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;

tcz: Gimnam tui lhut na ding; chule amol jol chengse kinu ding; thaotwi le halnam thei thao twi chengse jong; chule houbuh a manchah ding pondal chengse jong hiding ahi.
en: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

tcz: Pumgo thilto maicham; chule athil keo Jouse kisilna kong le atunna jong ahi;
en: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;

tcz: Amunna khai ding ho jong; akhailhah nading khom ho jaonan; chule kotbulla khai ding pon dal jong jaona hiding ahiye.
en: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

tcz: Houbuh kilmat na ding ahom ho ahin, akhao jouse jong jao cheh ding ahi.
en: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;

tcz: Muntheng'a manchah ding'a kikhong von jouse leh thempu kin bol'a apan teng ule aman chah diuva kikhong Aaron vontheng chengse ahin chule a chapate von chengse jong hi ding ahi.
en: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’”
text:
EXO 35:19
Thadou: Muntheng'a manchah ding'a kikhong von jouse leh thempu kin bol'a apan teng ule aman chah diuva kikhong Aaron vontheng chengse ahin chule a chapate von chengse jong hi ding ahi.
English: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’”

tcz: Chuin Israel insung pumpi'n Mose akon chun apotdoh tauvin ahi.
en: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
text:
EXO 35:20
Thadou: Chuin Israel insung pumpi'n Mose akon chun apotdoh tauvin ahi.
English: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

tcz: Chule alungthim'ma ki tilkhou na nei chan le lhagaova hel doh chan chu ahung khom uvin, ki khopkhomna ponbuh sung'a manchah ding ahin, kin bolna'a manchah ding chule ki von'na athenga manchah ding abonchan Pakai heng'a ahin lhut taovin ahi.
en: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought the LORD’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.
text:
EXO 35:21
Thadou: Chule alungthim'ma ki tilkhou na nei chan le lhagaova hel doh chan chu ahung khom uvin, ki khopkhomna ponbuh sung'a manchah ding ahin, kin bolna'a manchah ding chule ki von'na athenga manchah ding abonchan Pakai heng'a ahin lhut taovin ahi.
English: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought the LORD’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.

tcz: Numei le pasal ani gel'in ahung khom taovin ahi. Chuin heo jang ahin, khutjem, bilba, chaokol le sana'a ki sem thil jouse jong ahin choikhom soh kei uvin ahi. Ama ama michan cheh in sana thil peh jouse ahin choisoh kei uvin ahi.
en: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to the LORD.
text:
EXO 35:22
Thadou: Numei le pasal ani gel'in ahung khom taovin ahi. Chuin heo jang ahin, khutjem, bilba, chaokol le sana'a ki sem thil jouse jong ahin choikhom soh kei uvin ahi. Ama ama michan cheh in sana thil peh jouse ahin choisoh kei uvin ahi.
English: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to the LORD.

tcz: Ama cham'a kipedoh chan chun hi chengse hi ahin choiyun ahi: pon dum, sandup, a sanpol, tupat pon, kelcha mul, kelngoi chal vun, kelcha vun chengse jong anei channu ahin choi khom soh kei uvin ahi.
en: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.
text:
EXO 35:23
Thadou: Ama cham'a kipedoh chan chun hi chengse hi ahin choiyun ahi: pon dum, sandup, a sanpol, tupat pon, kelcha mul, kelngoi chal vun, kelcha vun chengse jong anei channu ahin choi khom soh kei uvin ahi.
English: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.

tcz: Ami takip in Pakaiya thilpeh ding ama ama cheh'in ahin choiyuvin ahi. Chule ipi thil'a ki mang hi jong le Pakaiya din ahin choi khom soh kei un ahi.
en: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought the LORD’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.
text:
EXO 35:24
Thadou: Ami takip in Pakaiya thilpeh ding ama ama cheh'in ahin choiyuvin ahi. Chule ipi thil'a ki mang hi jong le Pakaiya din ahin choi khom soh kei un ahi.
English: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought the LORD’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.

tcz: Ajou chan in ama cheh khut themna tah'in pat akhong un, chu teng hiche pat kikhong jouse chu asan hihen asan dup hijong le asanpol jaonan tupat ponnem'ma hijong le ahin choi khomsoh keiyuvin ahi.
en: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.
text:
EXO 35:25
Thadou: Ajou chan in ama cheh khut themna tah'in pat akhong un, chu teng hiche pat kikhong jouse chu asan hihen asan dup hijong le asanpol jaonan tupat ponnem'ma hijong le ahin choi khomsoh keiyuvin ahi.
English: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.

tcz: Numei ho jouse lah'a alung sung'a konna kipiehdohna nei channa chun kelcha mul'a kon'in abol cheh uvin ahi.
en: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.
text:
EXO 35:26
Thadou: Numei ho jouse lah'a alung sung'a konna kipiehdohna nei channa chun kelcha mul'a kon'in abol cheh uvin ahi.
English: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.

tcz: Japi lamkaija pang chengse'n jong konggah ding le omphoa beh ding'in songman tam jatchom cheh ahin choi khom uvin ahi.
en: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;

tcz: Chule ama hon gim namtui ahin, meivah'a pang ding thaotwi ahin, kinu ding thaotwi chule gimnam tuiya halnam thei jong ahin choi khom uve.
en: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
text:
EXO 35:28
Thadou: Chule ama hon gim namtui ahin, meivah'a pang ding thaotwi ahin, kinu ding thaotwi chule gimnam tuiya halnam thei jong ahin choi khom uve.
English: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

tcz: “Isreal chate lah'a numei ahin chule pasal ahin, Pakaiyin Mose heng'a a thupeh bang in bol inge tia a lungthim ma kon na ki tilkhouna nei channa chu Pakai heng'a ki pah le thanom tah in ipi hijong le apeh nom chan'u chu ahin choi khom uvin ahi.”
en: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to the LORD; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by Moses.
text:
EXO 35:29
Thadou: “Isreal chate lah'a numei ahin chule pasal ahin, Pakaiyin Mose heng'a a thupeh bang in bol inge tia a lungthim ma kon na ki tilkhouna nei channa chu Pakai heng'a ki pah le thanom tah in ipi hijong le apeh nom chan'u chu ahin choi khom uvin ahi.”
English: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to the LORD; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by Moses.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n Israel mite heng'a aseijin. “Juda phung'a kon Hur chapa Bezalel chu Pakaiyin alheng dohtan ahi.
en: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
text:
EXO 35:30
Thadou: Chuin Mose'n Israel mite heng'a aseijin. “Juda phung'a kon Hur chapa Bezalel chu Pakaiyin alheng dohtan ahi.
English: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

tcz: Pakaiyin Bezalel chu Pathen lhagao adimset sah jeng tan, amapa jong Chihna, le lung thim hat tah thil bol thei tah ahung hidoh tan ahi.”
en: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;

tcz: “Amapa chu thil jep dan jong them tah, sana le dangka jaonan thil ijakai sem dan jong amacham'in ahin he doh theiyin ahi.”
en: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,
text:
EXO 35:32
Thadou: “Amapa chu thil jep dan jong them tah, sana le dangka jaonan thil ijakai sem dan jong amacham'in ahin he doh theiyin ahi.”
English: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,

tcz: “A mapa chun tun ding song tam tah a sem in, thing jong ajat jat in ajem theiyin, khutthem na jouse achang theiyin ahi.”
en: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.
text:
EXO 35:33
Thadou: “A mapa chun tun ding song tam tah a sem in, thing jong ajat jat in ajem theiyin, khutthem na jouse achang theiyin ahi.”
English: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.

tcz: “Pakaiyin Bezalel chule Dan phungkai akon'in Ahismach chapa Oholiab ahin, ani tah lhon'in mijouse kihil nathei ding'in asem doh lhon tan ahi.”
en: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
text:
EXO 35:34
Thadou: “Pakaiyin Bezalel chule Dan phungkai akon'in Ahismach chapa Oholiab ahin, ani tah lhon'in mijouse kihil nathei ding'in asem doh lhon tan ahi.”
English: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

tcz: “Pakaiyin Amani chu natoh ijakai thepna ape lhon tan ahile, thilsem themna neijin, thembol in apang lhon in, thil lim gon dan jong, pon jep pol dan jong, a dum, asan pol, chule tupat pon bang khui themna jong apeh lhonna ahi. Bezalel le Oholiab in jong thil ijakai boltheina chu achang lhon tan ahi.”
en: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.
text:
EXO 35:35
Thadou: “Pakaiyin Amani chu natoh ijakai thepna ape lhon tan ahile, thilsem themna neijin, thembol in apang lhon in, thil lim gon dan jong, pon jep pol dan jong, a dum, asan pol, chule tupat pon bang khui themna jong apeh lhonna ahi. Bezalel le Oholiab in jong thil ijakai boltheina chu achang lhon tan ahi.”
English: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.

tcz: “Pakaiyin Bezale le Oholiab chu thilbol theina ape'n chule muntheng tun dohna mun chu chihna le ijakai bol ding jouse het them theina apie'n ahi. Pasal'a kailhah kitiphot in Pakai thupeh bang bang'a abol diu'vin a seiyin ahi.”
en: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD has commanded.”
text:
EXO 36:1
Thadou: “Pakaiyin Bezale le Oholiab chu thilbol theina ape'n chule muntheng tun dohna mun chu chihna le ijakai bol ding jouse het them theina apie'n ahi. Pasal'a kailhah kitiphot in Pakai thupeh bang bang'a abol diu'vin a seiyin ahi.”
English: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD has commanded.”

tcz: Mose'n jong Bezalel le Oholiab Pakaiyin thilbol theina apieh lhon bang chun adang hojouse'n jong natong ding'in ama cheh'in thanopna aneiyun ahi.
en: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.
text:
EXO 36:2
Thadou: Mose'n jong Bezalel le Oholiab Pakaiyin thilbol theina apieh lhon bang chun adang hojouse'n jong natong ding'in ama cheh'in thanopna aneiyun ahi.
English: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.

tcz: Mose in jong muntheng sah doh na ding le amun theng tun doh na ding chun Israel mite'n thil man chah ding a dondoh chengse'u chu natong ho ape tauvin ahi. Ahinlah ama hon jingkah sim in Mose heng'a thil lelo ahin choijun atohdoh jing uvin ahi.
en: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.
text:
EXO 36:3
Thadou: Mose in jong muntheng sah doh na ding le amun theng tun doh na ding chun Israel mite'n thil man chah ding a dondoh chengse'u chu natong ho ape tauvin ahi. Ahinlah ama hon jingkah sim in Mose heng'a thil lelo ahin choijun atohdoh jing uvin ahi.
English: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.

tcz: Ajo nan thilbol them ho chun mun theng munna ana toh banjom dalhan ache tauvin ahi.
en: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.
text:
EXO 36:4
Thadou: Ajo nan thilbol them ho chun mun theng munna ana toh banjom dalhan ache tauvin ahi.
English: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.

tcz: Ama hon Mose heng acheuvin hiti hin asei uve, Mipihon ka heng'uva Pakaiyin toh ding eipeh chengse'u sang'a tamjo eipe tauvin ahi, tin aga sei uve.
en: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.”
text:
EXO 36:5
Thadou: Ama hon Mose heng acheuvin hiti hin asei uve, Mipihon ka heng'uva Pakaiyin toh ding eipeh chengse'u sang'a tamjo eipe tauvin ahi, tin aga sei uve.
English: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.”

tcz: Chuin Mose'n jong aum nau ngahmun achun thu athot tauvin ahi: “Muntheng na toh na ding'in pasal hile numei hile thil ima hin peh be dajeng taovin, tia thu ahil'uvin, ajeh chu thil ijakai aning lhing'e tin aseiyin ahi!” Chuin mipi'n jong thil ijakai ahin choiyu chu angataovin ahi.
en: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.
text:
EXO 36:6
Thadou: Chuin Mose'n jong aum nau ngahmun achun thu athot tauvin ahi: “Muntheng na toh na ding'in pasal hile numei hile thil ima hin peh be dajeng taovin, tia thu ahil'uvin, ajeh chu thil ijakai aning lhing'e tin aseiyin ahi!” Chuin mipi'n jong thil ijakai ahin choiyu chu angataovin ahi.
English: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.

tcz: Thil le lo ahin choijeh uchun ijakai adimlha jeng tan, tohgon ding kalval'in manchah aum tan ahi.
en: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.
text:
EXO 36:7
Thadou: Thil le lo ahin choijeh uchun ijakai adimlha jeng tan, tohgon ding kalval'in manchah aum tan ahi.
English: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.

tcz: Natong them hochun pondal somkhat cheh amang uvin ponbuh akison taovin ahi. Bezalel in jong ponbuh'a kimang chu tupet ponnem kikhong ahin, adum le asadup le asanpol hochu ahin, thilbol theina tah'a cherub limbang bang kisem hose chu amangchan ahi.
en: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.
text:
EXO 36:8
Thadou: Natong them hochun pondal somkhat cheh amang uvin ponbuh akison taovin ahi. Bezalel in jong ponbuh'a kimang chu tupet ponnem kikhong ahin, adum le asadup le asanpol hochu ahin, thilbol theina tah'a cherub limbang bang kisem hose chu amangchan ahi.
English: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

tcz: Pondal khat cheh chu a dung tongsom li-le-tongni asaovin, a vailam'a pang pondal ho chengse vang chu tong gup alhing in ahi.
en: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.
text:
EXO 36:9
Thadou: Pondal khat cheh chu a dung tongsom li-le-tongni asaovin, a vailam'a pang pondal ho chengse vang chu tong gup alhing in ahi.
English: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.

tcz: Pondal lah'a nga chu khat le khat akilmat cheh cheh'in adang pondal nga chengse jong chu khat le khat akilmat in ahi.
en: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.
text:
EXO 36:10
Thadou: Pondal lah'a nga chu khat le khat akilmat cheh cheh'in adang pondal nga chengse jong chu khat le khat akilmat in ahi.
English: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.

tcz: Chule amasang lam'a pondal kigol chengse chu abil homkol tampi dum thim in asem peh'in chule pondal kikhai ageigol'a chengse jong chu abilhom tampi asem'in ahi.
en: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.
text:
EXO 36:11
Thadou: Chule amasang lam'a pondal kigol chengse chu abil homkol tampi dum thim in asem peh'in chule pondal kikhai ageigol'a chengse jong chu abilhom tampi asem'in ahi.
English: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.

tcz: Pondal masa joa abilhom somnga asem peh in, ani chana pondal chengse jong somnga ma asem in ahi. Aki kilmat na ho chu khat le khat kimai ngat tocheh in ahiuve.
en: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.
text:
EXO 36:12
Thadou: Pondal masa joa abilhom somnga asem peh in, ani chana pondal chengse jong somnga ma asem in ahi. Aki kilmat na ho chu khat le khat kimai ngat tocheh in ahiuve.
English: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.

tcz: Aman sana kol somnga asem in, sana kol hochun pondal khat le khat akilmat in, chuin houbuh chu pondal buh khat ahung sodoh tan ahi.
en: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.
text:
EXO 36:13
Thadou: Aman sana kol somnga asem in, sana kol hochun pondal khat le khat akilmat in, chuin houbuh chu pondal buh khat ahung sodoh tan ahi.
English: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.

tcz: Chuin aman houbuh chungvuma khu ding in kelcha'vun ho chu amang chan, pondal jong som le khat asem doh'in ahi.
en: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.
text:
EXO 36:14
Thadou: Chuin aman houbuh chungvuma khu ding in kelcha'vun ho chu amang chan, pondal jong som le khat asem doh'in ahi.
English: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

tcz: Pondal khat chu adung somli-le-nga cheh alhing in, chule adang pondal availama chu tong-gup alhing in ahi.
en: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.
text:
EXO 36:15
Thadou: Pondal khat chu adung somli-le-nga cheh alhing in, chule adang pondal availama chu tong-gup alhing in ahi.
English: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.

tcz: Bezalel'in jong pondal ngaho chengse chu akilmat soh keiyin, chule amoh pondal gup chengse chu anichanna achun apansah'in ahi.
en: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
text:
EXO 36:16
Thadou: Bezalel'in jong pondal ngaho chengse chu akilmat soh keiyin, chule amoh pondal gup chengse chu anichanna achun apansah'in ahi.
English: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

tcz: Aman pondal hoa chun abi lhom somnga asem peh in, hichun pondal saotah'a a kilmatsah cheh cheh ahi.
en: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.
text:
EXO 36:17
Thadou: Aman pondal hoa chun abi lhom somnga asem peh in, hichun pondal saotah'a a kilmatsah cheh cheh ahi.
English: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.

tcz: Chuin aman ponbuh khatseh'a akison doh theina ding le akilmat na ding in sum eng kol somnga asem in ahi. Hiti lamdol chun, ponbuh chu a khu khum na a sempeh in ahi.
en: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.
text:
EXO 36:18
Thadou: Chuin aman ponbuh khatseh'a akison doh theina ding le akilmat na ding in sum eng kol somnga asem in ahi. Hiti lamdol chun, ponbuh chu a khu khum na a sempeh in ahi.
English: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

tcz: Chule houbuh sem doh na ding in Bezalel chun thinggi thing pha bep asem doh'in ahi.
en: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
text:
EXO 36:20
Thadou: Chule houbuh sem doh na ding in Bezalel chun thinggi thing pha bep asem doh'in ahi.
English: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

tcz: Thingtun khat chu adung tongsom le tonnga alhing in, atun khat cheh chu inchi somni le sagi alhing in ahi.
en: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.
text:
EXO 36:21
Thadou: Thingtun khat chu adung tongsom le tonnga alhing in, atun khat cheh chu inchi somni le sagi alhing in ahi.
English: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.

tcz: Thingtun khat cheh chun atun na ni aneiyin ahi. Chule atunna jouse chu abonchan asem hoisoh keiyin ahi.
en: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.
text:
EXO 36:22
Thadou: Thingtun khat cheh chun atun na ni aneiyin ahi. Chule atunna jouse chu abonchan asem hoisoh keiyin ahi.
English: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.

tcz: Aman thingtun somni a semdoh in hichu lhanglam houbuh'a amang cha'n ahi.
en: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.
text:
EXO 36:23
Thadou: Aman thingtun somni a semdoh in hichu lhanglam houbuh'a amang cha'n ahi.
English: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

tcz: Aman jong atunna dangka in somli asem'in chule atunna khat abil'a pang ding achu abilhom jong asempeh cheh in ahi.
en: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
text:
EXO 36:24
Thadou: Aman jong atunna dangka in somli asem'in chule atunna khat abil'a pang ding achu abilhom jong asempeh cheh in ahi.
English: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

tcz: Houbuh solam'a pang ding chun atun somni ma asem peh'in ahi.
en: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards
text:
EXO 36:25
Thadou: Houbuh solam'a pang ding chun atun somni ma asem peh'in ahi.
English: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards

tcz: Atunna dangka somli'a kisem khomkhat na atunna chu ni asempeh cheh'in ahi.
en: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
text:
EXO 36:26
Thadou: Atunna dangka somli'a kisem khomkhat na atunna chu ni asempeh cheh'in ahi.
English: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

tcz: Aman houbuh nunglama pansa ding'in ajol gup asem'in
en: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
text:
EXO 36:27
Thadou: Aman houbuh nunglama pansa ding'in ajol gup asem'in
English: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

tcz: Houbuh nunglama pang ding chun atun ni ma asem peh'in ahi.
en: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.
text:
EXO 36:28
Thadou: Houbuh nunglama pang ding chun atun ni ma asem peh'in ahi.
English: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.

tcz: Hichea kimang atunna ho jouse chu abul lang achom cheh ahin, alu lamse vang chu anung lama chu kikai mat cheh'a ahiuvin, aning gol'a pang ding in atunna teni jong chu asem in ahi.
en: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.
text:
EXO 36:29
Thadou: Hichea kimang atunna ho jouse chu abul lang achom cheh ahin, alu lamse vang chu anung lama chu kikai mat cheh'a ahiuvin, aning gol'a pang ding in atunna teni jong chu asem in ahi.
English: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.

tcz: Aki tunna dangka chu toh'a semtha in ahile som le gup alhing in ahi. Ajol'a pang ding chun atunna ni cheh alhing in ahi.
en: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.
text:
EXO 36:30
Thadou: Aki tunna dangka chu toh'a semtha in ahile som le gup alhing in ahi. Ajol'a pang ding chun atunna ni cheh alhing in ahi.
English: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.

tcz: Chuin aman thinggi thing amang chan avaiya pang ding asuiyin, houbuh solam'a pang ding chun agolvai nga asem in,
en: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
text:
EXO 36:31
Thadou: Chuin aman thinggi thing amang chan avaiya pang ding asuiyin, houbuh solam'a pang ding chun agolvai nga asem in,
English: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

tcz: Chule lhanglam'a pansa ding'in agolvai nga ma asem'in ahi. Hichengse chun lhumlam angan ahi.
en: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.
text:
EXO 36:32
Thadou: Chule lhanglam'a pansa ding'in agolvai nga ma asem'in ahi. Hichengse chun lhumlam angan ahi.
English: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.

tcz: Aman alaigol lah'a pansa din among lang khat'a konna alang khat mong golla pang ding chun, ajol khat asem kit in ahi.
en: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.
text:
EXO 36:33
Thadou: Aman alaigol lah'a pansa din among lang khat'a konna alang khat mong golla pang ding chun, ajol khat asem kit in ahi.
English: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.

tcz: A tunna chengse chu abonchan sana in atom jol nam soh keiyin, sanakol jouse jong chu agolvai ho manchah din asempeh in, agolvaiya ho jouse jong chu sana mama'in atom jol soh keiye.
en: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
text:
EXO 36:34
Thadou: A tunna chengse chu abonchan sana in atom jol nam soh keiyin, sanakol jouse jong chu agolvai ho manchah din asempeh in, agolvaiya ho jouse jong chu sana mama'in atom jol soh keiye.
English: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

tcz: Houbuh chung lam'a pansa ding chun Bezalel in pondum, ponsandup le asan-ao tupat pon mang chan asem in, hiche pon chu khut themna nei tampi'n asem cherub lim tampi akhuijin ahi.
en: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.
text:
EXO 36:35
Thadou: Houbuh chung lam'a pansa ding chun Bezalel in pondum, ponsandup le asan-ao tupat pon mang chan asem in, hiche pon chu khut themna nei tampi'n asem cherub lim tampi akhuijin ahi.
English: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.

tcz: Hichea pansa ding chun thingggi thing-li a sem doh in chule akhom jong sana-li in ajol nam sel in, akol asempeh'in akhom li ding machun sana jong lijen asem'in ahi.
en: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.
text:
EXO 36:36
Thadou: Hichea pansa ding chun thingggi thing-li a sem doh in chule akhom jong sana-li in ajol nam sel in, akol asempeh'in akhom li ding machun sana jong lijen asem'in ahi.
English: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.

tcz: Chule aman ponbuh kot phung lam'a pansa ding chun adum, asan dup, asa-ao chule tupat pon jeng'a ajem in ahi.
en: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;

tcz: A kikhaina chengse chu sana jeng'a kisem atunna nga asempeh in ahi. Akhom chengse ahin chule atomna chengse chu sana jeng'in atom jol soh keiyin akhom nunglam'a pansa ding vang chun sumeng jeng mangchan asem'in ahi.
en: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.
text:
EXO 36:38
Thadou: A kikhaina chengse chu sana jeng'a kisem atunna nga asempeh in ahi. Akhom chengse ahin chule atomna chengse chu sana jeng'in atom jol soh keiyin akhom nunglam'a pansa ding vang chun sumeng jeng mangchan asem'in ahi.
English: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.

tcz: Chu ban'in Bezalel chun thinggi thing mangchan thingkong asem tan; adung tongni le akeh ahin, avai tongkhat le akeh chule atun tongkhat le akeh ma alhing in ahi.
en: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
text:
EXO 37:1
Thadou: Chu ban'in Bezalel chun thinggi thing mangchan thingkong asem tan; adung tongni le akeh ahin, avai tongkhat le akeh chule atun tongkhat le akeh ma alhing in ahi.
English: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

tcz: Aman jong asung lam le apolam ani gellin sana'in atomjol sellin, akimvel jouse jong sana mama in atom'in ahi.
en: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.
text:
EXO 37:2
Thadou: Aman jong asung lam le apolam ani gellin sana'in atomjol sellin, akimvel jouse jong sana mama in atom'in ahi.
English: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.

tcz: Aman jong aning gol'a pansa ding chun sana kol-li asem in pang lang khat'a chun kol-ni asem'in ahi.
en: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.
text:
EXO 37:3
Thadou: Aman jong aning gol'a pansa ding chun sana kol-li asem in pang lang khat'a chun kol-ni asem'in ahi.
English: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.

tcz: Chun aman moljol ni thinggi thing mangchan asuiyin, sana mama'in atom na'in ahi.
en: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
text:
EXO 37:4
Thadou: Chun aman moljol ni thinggi thing mangchan asuiyin, sana mama'in atom na'in ahi.
English: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

tcz: Thingkong putna ding in moljol teni chu thingkong geiya chaokol teni achun athil lut'in ahi.
en: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
text:
EXO 37:5
Thadou: Thingkong putna ding in moljol teni chu thingkong geiya chaokol teni achun athil lut'in ahi.
English: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

tcz: Chuin aman sana thengsellin thingkong khuna asem in, chule hepi touna jong asem in adung lam chu tong ni le akeh ahin, availam chu tongkhat le akeh alhing in ahi.
en: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.
text:
EXO 37:6
Thadou: Chuin aman sana thengsellin thingkong khuna asem in, chule hepi touna jong asem in adung lam chu tong ni le akeh ahin, availam chu tongkhat le akeh alhing in ahi.
English: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.

tcz: Chuin aman sana sehcha'a kikheng cherub lim bang'a um ni asem doh'in hepi touna among lam'a chun hiche teni chu apansah'in ahi.
en: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:
text:
EXO 37:7
Thadou: Chuin aman sana sehcha'a kikheng cherub lim bang'a um ni asem doh'in hepi touna among lam'a chun hiche teni chu apansah'in ahi.
English: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:

tcz: Chule aman cherub khat aning lam khat achun apansah'in among langkhat ma achun Cherub khat ma apan sah in hichengse chu khat'in asem doh'in ahi.
en: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.
text:
EXO 37:8
Thadou: Chule aman cherub khat aning lam khat achun apansah'in among langkhat ma achun Cherub khat ma apan sah in hichengse chu khat'in asem doh'in ahi.
English: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.

tcz: Cherubim teni chun chunglang anga lhon'in chule alha ajap lhon'in hepi touna chu alhaving tenin a veng bit lhon in ahi.
en: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.
text:
EXO 37:9
Thadou: Cherubim teni chun chunglang anga lhon'in chule alha ajap lhon'in hepi touna chu alhaving tenin a veng bit lhon in ahi.
English: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.

tcz: Chuin Bezalel in jong thinggi thing mangchan dokhang asem in ahi. Adunglam chu tongni in asem in, avai chu tong khat ahin chule atun lam chu tong khat le akeh alhing'in ahi.
en: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.
text:
EXO 37:10
Thadou: Chuin Bezalel in jong thinggi thing mangchan dokhang asem in ahi. Adunglam chu tongni in asem in, avai chu tong khat ahin chule atun lam chu tong khat le akeh alhing'in ahi.
English: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.

tcz: Aman akhom ho jouse chu sana in atom jol soh keiyin ahi.
en: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.
text:
EXO 37:11
Thadou: Aman akhom ho jouse chu sana in atom jol soh keiyin ahi.
English: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

tcz: Akimvel sechu khutphang tebep a saovin akhuna asem in chule ageikol jouse jong sana'in atomjol sohkeiyin ahi.
en: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.
text:
EXO 37:12
Thadou: Akimvel sechu khutphang tebep a saovin akhuna asem in chule ageikol jouse jong sana'in atomjol sohkeiyin ahi.
English: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.

tcz: Chuin aman dokhang'a manchah ding in sana chaokol-li asem in, dokhang keng-li lama chung apansah'in ahi.
en: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.
text:
EXO 37:13
Thadou: Chuin aman dokhang'a manchah ding in sana chaokol-li asem in, dokhang keng-li lama chung apansah'in ahi.
English: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.

tcz: Chaokol chengse chu abonchan kinai chan aumsah sohkeiyin, chaokol hose chu dokhang akijon teng kimang cha ding ahi.
en: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.
text:
EXO 37:14
Thadou: Chaokol chengse chu abonchan kinai chan aumsah sohkeiyin, chaokol hose chu dokhang akijon teng kimang cha ding ahi.
English: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.

tcz: Aman hichengse chu thinggi thing jeng mangchan asuiyin, abonchan sana'in atomjol sohkeiyin ahi.
en: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
text:
EXO 37:15
Thadou: Aman hichengse chu thinggi thing jeng mangchan asuiyin, abonchan sana'in atomjol sohkeiyin ahi.
English: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.

tcz: Chule dokhang'a machah ding chun sana kong thengsel phabep asem'in lhengkong ahin, gimnamtui halna ding chule lengpi twi chapna ding jong abonchan sana in atomjol sohkeiyin ahi.
en: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.
text:
EXO 37:16
Thadou: Chule dokhang'a machah ding chun sana kong thengsel phabep asem'in lhengkong ahin, gimnamtui halna ding chule lengpi twi chapna ding jong abonchan sana in atomjol sohkeiyin ahi.
English: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.

tcz: Chuin Bezalel'in thaomei khom asem'in hichu sana theng sela asem ahi. Thaomei khom tuna ding ahin aputna ding, anigellin phatah'in sehcha'n akheng in ahi. Hichea pahcha kijem'a pang le alutom ijakai jouse chutoh thaomei khom jong jaonan khat'in asem doh tan ahi.
en: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.
text:
EXO 37:17
Thadou: Chuin Bezalel'in thaomei khom asem'in hichu sana theng sela asem ahi. Thaomei khom tuna ding ahin aputna ding, anigellin phatah'in sehcha'n akheng in ahi. Hichea pahcha kijem'a pang le alutom ijakai jouse chutoh thaomei khom jong jaonan khat'in asem doh tan ahi.
English: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.

tcz: Thaomei khom chu gup ahin, aning ho a kon in abah thum cheh ahin jamdoh'in ahi.
en: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:
text:
EXO 37:18
Thadou: Thaomei khom chu gup ahin, aning ho a kon in abah thum cheh ahin jamdoh'in ahi.
English: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:

tcz: Alang alanga abah gup jamdoh hoakon chun thaomei vah khon bang in ajamdoh'in alu ajum in apah jeng jong ahung um doh in ahi.
en: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
text:
EXO 37:19
Thadou: Alang alanga abah gup jamdoh hoakon chun thaomei vah khon bang in ajamdoh'in alu ajum in apah jeng jong ahung um doh in ahi.
English: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

tcz: Hiche thaomei khom chu almond pahbang'in aning li aum'in ahi.
en: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

tcz: Thaomei khom akonna hung jam doh abah gup chengse chu toh'a noilam'a chengse jao nan khat in asem doh tan ahi.
en: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.
text:
EXO 37:21
Thadou: Thaomei khom akonna hung jam doh abah gup chengse chu toh'a noilam'a chengse jao nan khat in asem doh tan ahi.
English: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.

tcz: Almond bah hung jam doh chengse chu toh abonchauva khat ahung soh doh theiyin, hichengse chu sana thengsella kikheng jeng seh ahi.
en: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.
text:
EXO 37:22
Thadou: Almond bah hung jam doh chengse chu toh abonchauva khat ahung soh doh theiyin, hichengse chu sana thengsella kikheng jeng seh ahi.
English: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.

tcz: Aman jong thaomei sagi asem in amei khao che tanna chengse jaonan sana thengsel in asem doh in ahi.
en: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.
text:
EXO 37:23
Thadou: Aman jong thaomei sagi asem in amei khao che tanna chengse jaonan sana thengsel in asem doh in ahi.
English: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.

tcz: Thaomei khom chu ahin, aman chah jouse jaonan sana thengsel dangka somsagi le nga mangchan asem doh in ahi.
en: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.
text:
EXO 37:24
Thadou: Thaomei khom chu ahin, aman chah jouse jaonan sana thengsel dangka somsagi le nga mangchan asem doh in ahi.
English: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.

tcz: Bezalel chun gimnam tuiya ding'in maicham khat thinggi thing'in asem'in ahi. Hichu adung tong khat chule atun tong khat ahi. Chule hichea kimang cha saki chengse chu toh khat in ahung um doh in ahi.
en: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.
text:
EXO 37:25
Thadou: Bezalel chun gimnam tuiya ding'in maicham khat thinggi thing'in asem'in ahi. Hichu adung tong khat chule atun tong khat ahi. Chule hichea kimang cha saki chengse chu toh khat in ahung um doh in ahi.
English: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.

tcz: Aman maicham chu sana theng sel in atom namsel in, achung vumlam ahin chule ajet le avei jeng ajong, chu le a saki jouse jong abonchan sana in atom namsel in ahi. Hiti chun aboncha'n a kimvel jouse'a chun sana ajem in ahi.
en: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.
text:
EXO 37:26
Thadou: Aman maicham chu sana theng sel in atom namsel in, achung vumlam ahin chule ajet le avei jeng ajong, chu le a saki jouse jong abonchan sana in atom namsel in ahi. Hiti chun aboncha'n a kimvel jouse'a chun sana ajem in ahi.
English: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.

tcz: Sana ki jem pah noiya akol a pang ding in aman sana chaokol ni asem doh in, khat cheh chu akingat tohsah in akhaiyin, maicham put le na manchah ding in asem doh in ahi.
en: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.
text:
EXO 37:27
Thadou: Sana ki jem pah noiya akol a pang ding in aman sana chaokol ni asem doh in, khat cheh chu akingat tohsah in akhaiyin, maicham put le na manchah ding in asem doh in ahi.
English: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.

tcz: Aman amoljol jouse jong chu thinggi thing jeng'in asemin sana'in atomnam soh keiyin ahi.
en: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
text:
EXO 37:28
Thadou: Aman amoljol jouse jong chu thinggi thing jeng'in asemin sana'in atomnam soh keiyin ahi.
English: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

tcz: Chuin aman kinu thei ding'in thaotwi asem doh'in gimnamtui jeng jong chu halnam thei ding'in asem'in ahi. Hichengse chu abonchan thaosem them hon asemdoh bang bang'in asem tan ahi.
en: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
text:
EXO 37:29
Thadou: Chuin aman kinu thei ding'in thaotwi asem doh'in gimnamtui jeng jong chu halnam thei ding'in asem'in ahi. Hichengse chu abonchan thaosem them hon asemdoh bang bang'in asem tan ahi.
English: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.

tcz: Chuban in Bezalel in jong thinggi thing amangchan, pumgo thilto maicham asem in ahi. Hichu atun feet sagi le akeh ahin asaodan jong feet sagi le akehma alhing'in chule asan dan tong li-le-akeh alhing'in ahi.
en: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.
text:
EXO 38:1
Thadou: Chuban in Bezalel in jong thinggi thing amangchan, pumgo thilto maicham asem in ahi. Hichu atun feet sagi le akeh ahin asaodan jong feet sagi le akehma alhing'in chule asan dan tong li-le-akeh alhing'in ahi.
English: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.

tcz: Aman aningli chengse a chun saki-li asem'in hiti chun saki chengse le maicham chu khat'in aum doh theiye. Aman maicham chu sum-eng in atom in ahi.
en: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.
text:
EXO 38:2
Thadou: Aman aningli chengse a chun saki-li asem'in hiti chun saki chengse le maicham chu khat'in aum doh theiye. Aman maicham chu sum-eng in atom in ahi.
English: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

tcz: Chule aman maicham'a manchah ding in sum-eng a mangchan bel ahin, khe keh, khangbel, kong le sum khe asem in ahi.
en: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.
text:
EXO 38:3
Thadou: Chule aman maicham'a manchah ding in sum-eng a mangchan bel ahin, khe keh, khangbel, kong le sum khe asem in ahi.
English: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

tcz: Chu jouvin aman sum-eng jeng in lhuhkhuh asem in ahi.
en: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.
text:
EXO 38:4
Thadou: Chu jouvin aman sum-eng jeng in lhuhkhuh asem in ahi.
English: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

tcz: Aman hiche dopna ding chun ningli asem'in ajol toh tho a pansahna ahin, hichengse chu sum-eng jeng mangcha'a alhah ahi.
en: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.
text:
EXO 38:5
Thadou: Aman hiche dopna ding chun ningli asem'in ajol toh tho a pansahna ahin, hichengse chu sum-eng jeng mangcha'a alhah ahi.
English: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.

tcz: Aman thinggi mangcha'n thingjol jouse chu sum-eng jeng'in atom'in ahi.
en: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.
text:
EXO 38:6
Thadou: Aman thinggi mangcha'n thingjol jouse chu sum-eng jeng'in atom'in ahi.
English: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

tcz: Aman maicham putna ding'a akol-li asem ho chun, moljol chengse athillut'in ahi. Chuin maicham chu aumna ding asemtuoh'in ahi.
en: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.
text:
EXO 38:7
Thadou: Aman maicham putna ding'a akol-li asem ho chun, moljol chengse athillut'in ahi. Chuin maicham chu aumna ding asemtuoh'in ahi.
English: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.

tcz: Bezalal chun ponbuh kotphung'a lhacha'a pang numei ho kisil'na kong ahin chule atunna ding jong chu sum-eng jeng'a asem'in ahi.
en: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
EXO 38:8
Thadou: Bezalal chun ponbuh kotphung'a lhacha'a pang numei ho kisil'na kong ahin chule atunna ding jong chu sum-eng jeng'a asem'in ahi.
English: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Chuin Bezalel'in pal agen kimsoh keiyin, pal'a khaiding poun jouse chu tupat pomnem ma kisem jeng ahi. Chule lhanglam'a khai ding poundal se chu feet jakhat to somnga alhing'in ahi. hiche pal lhanglama khaiding pondal chengse jong chutupat ponnem jing a kikhong ahin agom chun tong jakhat jen ahilhng e.
en: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;

tcz: Apal khom somni ahin, aboncha sum-eng jeng'a kisem ahi. Palkhom'a akol kisem chengse jong dangka jeng'a kisem ahi.
en: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
text:
EXO 38:10
Thadou: Apal khom somni ahin, aboncha sum-eng jeng'a kisem ahi. Palkhom'a akol kisem chengse jong dangka jeng'a kisem ahi.
English: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

tcz: Aman pal sah lam'a pansa ding'in feet jakhat thoh somnga chule akhom somni jaona hichengse chu sum-eng jeng'a asem ahi. Pal khom ahin, akhaina kol aboncha sana le dangka jeng ahi.
en: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
text:
EXO 38:11
Thadou: Aman pal sah lam'a pansa ding'in feet jakhat thoh somnga chule akhom somni jaona hichengse chu sum-eng jeng'a asem ahi. Pal khom ahin, akhaina kol aboncha sana le dangka jeng ahi.
English: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

tcz: Chule lhumlam'a pondal pal chengse chu feet somsagi le nga alhing'in akhom ahin, akol kisem jouse chu sana le dangka jeng ahi.
en: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
text:
EXO 38:12
Thadou: Chule lhumlam'a pondal pal chengse chu feet somsagi le nga alhing'in akhom ahin, akol kisem jouse chu sana le dangka jeng ahi.
English: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

tcz: Mailam'a pansa pondal chengse jong chu tong somsagi le nga sao ahi.
en: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,
text:
EXO 38:13
Thadou: Mailam'a pansa pondal chengse jong chu tong somsagi le nga sao ahi.
English: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,

tcz: Kelkot polam'a pondal khat chu Tong somnileni akeh alhing in, chule atunna khom jong thum ahi.
en: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;

tcz: Chule kelkot langkhat'a pansa jong chu kibang'in asem'in Tong somni le ni ahin, chule atunna khom jong thum’ ahi.
en: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
text:
EXO 38:15
Thadou: Chule kelkot langkhat'a pansa jong chu kibang'in asem'in Tong somni le ni ahin, chule atunna khom jong thum’ ahi.
English: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

tcz: Pal kigetna'a pansa pondal jouse chu tupat ponnem jeng'a kisem ahi.
en: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.
text:
EXO 38:16
Thadou: Pal kigetna'a pansa pondal jouse chu tupat ponnem jeng'a kisem ahi.
English: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.

tcz: Palkhom ahin atunna khom aboncha sum-eng jeng'a kisem ahi. Akhom'a kimang ho jouse jong chu sana le dangka jeng'a kisem ahi.
en: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.
text:
EXO 38:17
Thadou: Palkhom ahin atunna khom aboncha sum-eng jeng'a kisem ahi. Akhom'a kimang ho jouse jong chu sana le dangka jeng'a kisem ahi.
English: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.

tcz: Aman palmai kot phung'a ding chun pondal asem'in ahi. Hichu Tong somthum in asaovin, asandan tong sagi le akeh ahi. Aboncha pal'a kigen chengse toh chun kibang ahi.
en: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.
text:
EXO 38:18
Thadou: Aman palmai kot phung'a ding chun pondal asem'in ahi. Hichu Tong somthum in asaovin, asandan tong sagi le akeh ahi. Aboncha pal'a kigen chengse toh chun kibang ahi.
English: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.

tcz: Akhom chengse chu li ahin, atunna jouse jong chu sum-eng jeng ahi. Chule atunna, akhaina kol jouse jong chu sana le dangka jeng ahi.
en: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.
text:
EXO 38:19
Thadou: Akhom chengse chu li ahin, atunna jouse jong chu sum-eng jeng ahi. Chule atunna, akhaina kol jouse jong chu sana le dangka jeng ahi.
English: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.

tcz: Houbuh ahin chule akimvella pondal jouse jong sum-eng jeng ahi.
en: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.
text:
EXO 38:20
Thadou: Houbuh ahin chule akimvella pondal jouse jong sum-eng jeng ahi.
English: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.

tcz: Hichengse houbuh ahin, chule hettohsana houbuh hichu Mose thupeh dungjuija kisem, thempu Aaron chapa Ithamar ngaisahna dungjuija Levi teho natoh nading'a kisem ahi.
en: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.
text:
EXO 38:21
Thadou: Hichengse houbuh ahin, chule hettohsana houbuh hichu Mose thupeh dungjuija kisem, thempu Aaron chapa Ithamar ngaisahna dungjuija Levi teho natoh nading'a kisem ahi.
English: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

tcz: Chule Juda phung khaiya kon Hur chapa, Uri chapa Bezalel'in jong Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang chu bolkim soh keiyin ahi.
en: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 38:22
Thadou: Chule Juda phung khaiya kon Hur chapa, Uri chapa Bezalel'in jong Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang chu bolkim soh keiyin ahi.
English: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Amapa chu Dan phung akon Ahismach chapa Oholiab chule khut themna neitah le ijakai thilbol them patdum ahin,ponsandup chule tupat ponnem bol them'a jong pang ahi.
en: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.
text:
EXO 38:23
Thadou: Amapa chu Dan phung akon Ahismach chapa Oholiab chule khut themna neitah le ijakai thilbol them patdum ahin,ponsandup chule tupat ponnem bol them'a jong pang ahi.
English: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.

tcz: Houbuh le muntheng sahdohna ding'in sana Shekhel somni le ko leh ja sagi leh somthum ahin choi khom uve.
en: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
text:
EXO 38:24
Thadou: Houbuh le muntheng sahdohna ding'in sana Shekhel somni le ko leh ja sagi leh somthum ahin choi khom uve.
English: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

tcz: Israel pumpi'n dangka talent jakhat toh Shekhel sangkhat toh jasagi leh som sagi leh nga jaonan apedoh'uvin muntheng sahna'a kimangcha shekel dungjuija kisim ahi.
en: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:
text:
EXO 38:25
Thadou: Israel pumpi'n dangka talent jakhat toh Shekhel sangkhat toh jasagi leh som sagi leh nga jaonan apedoh'uvin muntheng sahna'a kimangcha shekel dungjuija kisim ahi.
English: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:

tcz: Hiche dangka kidongkhom chengse hi min kisim dungjuiya hung kipielut chu ahi. (Hichu beka khat shekel kehkhat toh kibang ahin, muntheng laiya manchah ding ahi) Pasal Kum somni'a pat chunglamsea konna ki dong sangjagup le sangthum le janga le somnga alhing'in ahi.
en: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.
text:
EXO 38:26
Thadou: Hiche dangka kidongkhom chengse hi min kisim dungjuiya hung kipielut chu ahi. (Hichu beka khat shekel kehkhat toh kibang ahin, muntheng laiya manchah ding ahi) Pasal Kum somni'a pat chunglamsea konna ki dong sangjagup le sangthum le janga le somnga alhing'in ahi.
English: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.

tcz: Muntheng chung khunading, chule atunna ho aboncha'n sana le dangka sangsagi le janga alhing in atunna khat cheh chu dangka somsagi a ki sem ahi.
en: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.
text:
EXO 38:27
Thadou: Muntheng chung khunading, chule atunna ho aboncha'n sana le dangka sangsagi le janga alhing in atunna khat cheh chu dangka somsagi a ki sem ahi.
English: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.

tcz: Amoh cheng sang le dangka somli le nga chengse chu akhom ahin, akhaina nading'a kisem akol chengse tomnan amang in ahi.
en: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.
text:
EXO 38:28
Thadou: Amoh cheng sang le dangka somli le nga chengse chu akhom ahin, akhaina nading'a kisem akol chengse tomnan amang in ahi.
English: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.

tcz: Chule mipi chun sum-eng a kisem dangka sangnga le jathum le somkhat ahin choijun ahi.
en: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.
text:
EXO 38:29
Thadou: Chule mipi chun sum-eng a kisem dangka sangnga le jathum le somkhat ahin choijun ahi.
English: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

tcz: Hichengse chu akhomho chule houbuh semnan amang'in maicham achun sum-eng apansah'in chule sum-eng chu thil ijakai semnan jong amang'in ahi.
en: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,
text:
EXO 38:30
Thadou: Hichengse chu akhomho chule houbuh semnan amang'in maicham achun sum-eng apansah'in chule sum-eng chu thil ijakai semnan jong amang'in ahi.
English: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,

tcz: Sum-eng mangchan palkikai jouse, kelkot chule houbuh sung'a thil ijakai jouse semnan aneiyin ahi.
en: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.
text:
EXO 38:31
Thadou: Sum-eng mangchan palkikai jouse, kelkot chule houbuh sung'a thil ijakai jouse semnan aneiyin ahi.
English: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.

tcz: Muntheng'a natong ding hon aman chah diu'vin asan-dup chule asanpol bang'a kikhong pon akikhuiyu'vin—Aaron'in muntheng'a na-atoh teng akivonna ding hichu Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh ahi.
en: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 39:1
Thadou: Muntheng'a natong ding hon aman chah diu'vin asan-dup chule asanpol bang'a kikhong pon akikhuiyu'vin—Aaron'in muntheng'a na-atoh teng akivonna ding hichu Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh ahi.
English: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Bezalel chun sana mangcha'n konggah asem'in hichu asandup le asan-ao patnem jaonan asem'in ahi.
en: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
text:
EXO 39:2
