Thadou: Bezalel chun sana mangcha'n konggah asem'in hichu asandup le asan-ao patnem jaonan asem'in ahi.
English: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

tcz: Aman sana khat lim'in hoisel in khut them tah'in asem'in ahi. Hichu asandup, asan-ao patdum mangcha'n sehcha'n akheng tuoh'in asemdoh in ahi.
en: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.
text:
EXO 39:3
Thadou: Aman sana khat lim'in hoisel in khut them tah'in asem'in ahi. Hichu asandup, asan-ao patdum mangcha'n sehcha'n akheng tuoh'in asemdoh in ahi.
English: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.

tcz: Chule konggah akon chun akhaina ding anung le ama lam'a aumtuo'n lengkou changei jin akhailhah'na aum'in among lam chu akijopmat'in ahi.
en: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.
text:
EXO 39:4
Thadou: Chule konggah akon chun akhaina ding anung le ama lam'a aumtuo'n lengkou changei jin akhailhah'na aum'in among lam chu akijopmat'in ahi.
English: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

tcz: Hiche jong hi a ngaija bang'in hoisel'in asem'in: phatah'a ki pheh, adum, asan-dup, asan-ao sana jeng'a ki tom ponnem mangcha'a kisem, hichu Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh dungjuija kisem ahi.
en: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 39:5
Thadou: Hiche jong hi a ngaija bang'in hoisel'in asem'in: phatah'a ki pheh, adum, asan-dup, asan-ao sana jeng'a ki tom ponnem mangcha'a kisem, hichu Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh dungjuija kisem ahi.
English: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Chule Onyx song chu-ni amang chau'vin chuin sana alhon'in agol tuoh sohkeiyun ahi. Song-ho chu Israel mite ama ama insung dungjui cheh'in amin'u mohor kinam khum bang'in agol tuoh soh kei u've.
en: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.
text:
EXO 39:6
Thadou: Chule Onyx song chu-ni amang chau'vin chuin sana alhon'in agol tuoh sohkeiyun ahi. Song-ho chu Israel mite ama ama insung dungjui cheh'in amin'u mohor kinam khum bang'in agol tuoh soh kei u've.
English: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

tcz: Aman hiche song-agol chule kong-gah lengkou vumma ki khailha akon chun, Israel mite geldoh jing na ding'in asem tuoh sohkeijin. Hichengse jong hi Pakaiyin Mose a thupeh bang in abol sohkei u've.
en: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 39:7
Thadou: Aman hiche song-agol chule kong-gah lengkou vumma ki khailha akon chun, Israel mite geldoh jing na ding'in asem tuoh sohkeijin. Hichengse jong hi Pakaiyin Mose a thupeh bang in abol sohkei u've.
English: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Bezalel chun khutthem tah'in Ompho asem'in ahi. Aman konggah bang bang chun asemdoh'in hichu sana ahin, adum chule asan-dup ponnem jaonan asem'in ahi.
en: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
text:
EXO 39:8
Thadou: Bezalel chun khutthem tah'in Ompho asem'in ahi. Aman konggah bang bang chun asemdoh'in hichu sana ahin, adum chule asan-dup ponnem jaonan asem'in ahi.
English: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

tcz: Aman ompho chu lheptup theiyin asemdoh'in akilhep teng adung avai khutchang ko ahiye.
en: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.
text:
EXO 39:9
Thadou: Aman ompho chu lheptup theiyin asemdoh'in akilhep teng adung avai khutchang ko ahiye.
English: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.

tcz: Amahon song-mantam chu golli'n akoi jun. Amasan Carnelian song-san apansah'uvin, pale-green, chule emerald song ahi.
en: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;

tcz: Golni channa ding'in blue lapis lazuli, chule songgil ahi.
en: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

tcz: Gol-thum channa ding'in aiha song, khipi chule umbel song ahi.
en: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

tcz: Gol-li channa ding'in song-eng, Onyx song chule song-mantam-eng apansah'uve. Hi chengse hi abonchan sana twiyin akaimatsoh keiyun ahi.
en: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.
text:
EXO 39:13
Thadou: Gol-li channa ding'in song-eng, Onyx song chule song-mantam-eng apansah'uve. Hi chengse hi abonchan sana twiyin akaimatsoh keiyun ahi.
English: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.

tcz: Song-gol khat cheh chun Israel mite ama-ama kailhah dungjuiyin amin jouse toh akijih tha'n songkhat cheh achu Mohor kisem ahiye.
en: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
text:
EXO 39:14
Thadou: Song-gol khat cheh chun Israel mite ama-ama kailhah dungjuiyin amin jouse toh akijih tha'n songkhat cheh achu Mohor kisem ahiye.
English: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

tcz: Ompho le konggah kijopmatna ding chun sana thengsel la kisem khao bang'in akhuiyun ahi.
en: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
text:
EXO 39:15
Thadou: Ompho le konggah kijopmatna ding chun sana thengsel la kisem khao bang'in akhuiyun ahi.
English: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

tcz: Chule sana pat-jaang'a kisem le sana akol-ni jong asem uvin sana-kol teni chu ompho ning lama chun akaimat'uvin ahi.
en: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
text:
EXO 39:16
Thadou: Chule sana pat-jaang'a kisem le sana akol-ni jong asem uvin sana-kol teni chu ompho ning lama chun akaimat'uvin ahi.
English: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

tcz: Ompho tenia kikhai sana kol teni chu akhaimat'uvin ahi.
en: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
text:
EXO 39:17
Thadou: Ompho tenia kikhai sana kol teni chu akhaimat'uvin ahi.
English: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

tcz: Chule sana-pat-jaang teni le sana golteni chu a jopmat uvin ahi. Konggah khaina leng-kou tenia kon chun agen kikhailha tenichu ompho maiya chun abehpeh peh'uvin ahi.
en: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.
text:
EXO 39:18
Thadou: Chule sana-pat-jaang teni le sana golteni chu a jopmat uvin ahi. Konggah khaina leng-kou tenia kon chun agen kikhailha tenichu ompho maiya chun abehpeh peh'uvin ahi.
English: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.

tcz: Chuin ama hon sana kol-ni asemkit'vin, ompho geilam hichu konggah toh chun akaimat uvin ahi.
en: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.
text:
EXO 39:19
Thadou: Chuin ama hon sana kol-ni asemkit'vin, ompho geilam hichu konggah toh chun akaimat uvin ahi.
English: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

tcz: Chule sana-pat-jang kolni a semdoh kit uvin ani tah chun lengkou vumma konggah ki khaina achun akaimat uvin ahi.
en: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
text:
EXO 39:20
Thadou: Chule sana-pat-jang kolni a semdoh kit uvin ani tah chun lengkou vumma konggah ki khaina achun akaimat uvin ahi.
English: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

tcz: Chuin ompho chu pat-jaang khat mangcha'n akolsung'a chun athilmat'uvin konggah'a beh akol chengse toh athilmat uvin ahile phatah'a kipheh bang'in aumdoh tan ahi. Hitia abol phat uchun konggah le ompho chu achah kheh jeng tan ahi. Hichengse chu Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'in abol sohkei uvin ahi.
en: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 39:21
Thadou: Chuin ompho chu pat-jaang khat mangcha'n akolsung'a chun athilmat'uvin konggah'a beh akol chengse toh athilmat uvin ahile phatah'a kipheh bang'in aumdoh tan ahi. Hitia abol phat uchun konggah le ompho chu achah kheh jeng tan ahi. Hichengse chu Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'in abol sohkei uvin ahi.
English: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Bezalel chun adum'a kikhong kivonna ding'in sang-khol asem'in
en: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
text:
EXO 39:22
Thadou: Bezalel chun adum'a kikhong kivonna ding'in sang-khol asem'in
English: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

tcz: Hichu Aaron'in aki-ah ding chule hiche songkhol chol chu agei gol akhui-eh cheh cheh'in ahi.
en: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.
text:
EXO 39:23
Thadou: Hichu Aaron'in aki-ah ding chule hiche songkhol chol chu agei gol akhui-eh cheh cheh'in ahi.
English: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

tcz: Ama hon sangkhol-chol chu kolbu thei jem'in asem uvin patdum, asan-ao chule ponnem mangcha'n asemdoh'uvin ahi.
en: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.
text:
EXO 39:24
Thadou: Ama hon sangkhol-chol chu kolbu thei jem'in asem uvin patdum, asan-ao chule ponnem mangcha'n asemdoh'uvin ahi.
English: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.

tcz: Chuin amahon sana thengsel'in chaojang asem'uvin hichengse chu abonchan kolbuthei jem le sangkhol golla chun akoiyun ahi.
en: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;

tcz: Chao jang khat khaina achun kolbu theijem khat in akiba cheh-cheh in ahi. Hiche sangkhol-chol thempu khat chun na-atoh teng hoilai mun hijong le Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'a kivon ding ahiye.
en: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 39:26
Thadou: Chao jang khat khaina achun kolbu theijem khat in akiba cheh-cheh in ahi. Hiche sangkhol-chol thempu khat chun na-atoh teng hoilai mun hijong le Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'a kivon ding ahiye.
English: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Ama hon Aaron le achapate ho jouse ding'in sangkhol chol len tupat jeng'in asem peh'uvin ahi.
en: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,
text:
EXO 39:27
Thadou: Ama hon Aaron le achapate ho jouse ding'in sangkhol chol len tupat jeng'in asem peh'uvin ahi.
English: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

tcz: Delkop chule lukhuh ding jong jaonan toka-chol jong poun phatah'in asem'uvin ahi.
en: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,
text:
EXO 39:28
Thadou: Delkop chule lukhuh ding jong jaonan toka-chol jong poun phatah'in asem'uvin ahi.
English: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

tcz: Kigah-ding jouse chu pon-nem asan-dup, san-ao phatah'a heo jang'a kisem jeng, hichu Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'a kibol ahi.
en: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 39:29
Thadou: Kigah-ding jouse chu pon-nem asan-dup, san-ao phatah'a heo jang'a kisem jeng, hichu Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'a kibol ahi.
English: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Achaina'n lal lukhuh sana thengsel in a sem uvin ahi. Mohor kinam den bang in aum khum uvin: Pakai atheng e ti thucheng akoi un ahi.
en: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO THE LORD”.
text:
EXO 39:30
Thadou: Achaina'n lal lukhuh sana thengsel in a sem uvin ahi. Mohor kinam den bang in aum khum uvin: Pakai atheng e ti thucheng akoi un ahi.
English: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO THE LORD”.

tcz: Ama hon lukhuh chu adum khat Aaron delkop ding'in asem'uvin, hichu Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'a abol ahi.
en: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 39:31
Thadou: Ama hon lukhuh chu adum khat Aaron delkop ding'in asem'uvin, hichu Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'a abol ahi.
English: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Hiti chun ajona lam in kikhop khomna hou buh* chu sahchaiyin aum tai. Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong atong chai sohkeiyun ahi.
en: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they did.
text:
EXO 39:32
Thadou: Hiti chun ajona lam in kikhop khomna hou buh* chu sahchaiyin aum tai. Pakaiyin Mose athupeh bang'in Israel mite'n jong atong chai sohkeiyun ahi.
English: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they did.

tcz: Chuin ama hon Mose heng'a houbuh chule thil-le-lo ijakai abonchan ahin choijun: akhaina-kolho, agolho, akhomho, akhom noi nung'a ho hiti chun abonchan ahin choi sohkeiyun ahi.
en: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
text:
EXO 39:33
Thadou: Chuin ama hon Mose heng'a houbuh chule thil-le-lo ijakai abonchan ahin choijun: akhaina-kolho, agolho, akhomho, akhom noi nung'a ho hiti chun abonchan ahin choi sohkeiyun ahi.
English: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

tcz: Ponbuh khuna ding chun kelngoi chule kel chal-vun; hichengsea chu khuding ahi;
en: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,

tcz: Hettoh sahna thingkong; thingkong putna dinga moljol teni; chule hepi touna jaona,
en: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,
text:
EXO 39:35
Thadou: Hettoh sahna thingkong; thingkong putna dinga moljol teni; chule hepi touna jaona,
English: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

tcz: Dokhang le thilkeo ho; chule changlhah thilto chengse jaona ahi;
en: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

tcz: Sana thengsel'a ki semdoh thaomei-khom chule thaomei-khon chengse jaona, amanchah chengse le athaotwi jong jaona ahi;
en: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

tcz: Sana'a kisem maicham, chule kinu ding thaotwi; gimnamtui jaona le pondal jouse jong ahi.
en: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,
text:
EXO 39:38
Thadou: Sana'a kisem maicham, chule kinu ding thaotwi; gimnamtui jaona le pondal jouse jong ahi.
English: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

tcz: sum-eng'a kisem maicham; chule aputna ding'a sum-eng jolho jaonan; kisilna kong le atunna jouse jong ahi.
en: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,
text:
EXO 39:39
Thadou: sum-eng'a kisem maicham; chule aputna ding'a sum-eng jolho jaonan; kisilna kong le atunna jouse jong ahi.
English: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

tcz: Bangpheija kigol pondal ho; pal khom chengse ahin; chule houbuh lutna lam; houbuh'a kimang thil-le-lo jouse jaona ahi;
en: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

tcz: Thempu hoding'a hoitah'a kikhui hichu muntheng laiya na-atoh teng ule akivon nadiu Aaron thempu, chule achapate hon thempu kin abol teng ule akivon nadiu ahi.
en: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
text:
EXO 39:41
Thadou: Thempu hoding'a hoitah'a kikhui hichu muntheng laiya na-atoh teng ule akivon nadiu Aaron thempu, chule achapate hon thempu kin abol teng ule akivon nadiu ahi.
English: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh bang chun Israel mite'n jong abonchan ajuikimsoh keiyun ahi.
en: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
text:
EXO 39:42
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh bang chun Israel mite'n jong abonchan ajuikimsoh keiyun ahi.
English: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

tcz: Chuin Mose'n anatoh jouseao abonchan avelhan ahi. Amahon tohding ijakai Pakai thupeh bang'in atong kimsoh keiyuve ti amuchet phat chun, phatthei aboh taovin ahi.
en: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
text:
EXO 39:43
Thadou: Chuin Mose'n anatoh jouseao abonchan avelhan ahi. Amahon tohding ijakai Pakai thupeh bang'in atong kimsoh keiyuve ti amuchet phat chun, phatthei aboh taovin ahi.
English: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
EXO 40:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose heng'a aseijin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: “Kum-thah nikho masa pennia houbuh natundoh ding ahi.”
en: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
EXO 40:2
Thadou: “Kum-thah nikho masa pennia houbuh natundoh ding ahi.”
English: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: “Chule houbuh sung'a chu hettoh sahna thingkong na koi ding, hiche thing-kong chu muntheng chungnung mun ahin, hichu pondal na khu ding ahi”
en: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
text:
EXO 40:3
Thadou: “Chule houbuh sung'a chu hettoh sahna thingkong na koi ding, hiche thing-kong chu muntheng chungnung mun ahin, hichu pondal na khu ding ahi”
English: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.

tcz: “Dokhang hinpu'n lang, manchah thil-le-lo hojong jaonan, chule thaomei khom ahin thaomei vah chengse jong na hinchoi ding ahi.”
en: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.
text:
EXO 40:4
Thadou: “Dokhang hinpu'n lang, manchah thil-le-lo hojong jaonan, chule thaomei khom ahin thaomei vah chengse jong na hinchoi ding ahi.”
English: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.

tcz: “Hettohsahna thingkong maija chu gimnamtui lhut'na maicham nakoi ding ahi. Chuteng houbuh kotphung'a chu nakhai ding ahi.”
en: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
text:
EXO 40:5
Thadou: “Hettohsahna thingkong maija chu gimnamtui lhut'na maicham nakoi ding ahi. Chuteng houbuh kotphung'a chu nakhai ding ahi.”
English: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

tcz: “Kikhop khomna ponbuh lutna maiya chu hiche pumgo thilto maicham chu nasem ding ahi.”
en: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
EXO 40:6
Thadou: “Kikhop khomna ponbuh lutna maiya chu hiche pumgo thilto maicham chu nasem ding ahi.”
English: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: “Kikhop khomna ponbuh le pumgo thilto maicham kimlai donna chu kisil-na kong nakoi ding, adimset'a twi nadip ding ahi.”
en: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.
text:
EXO 40:7
Thadou: “Kikhop khomna ponbuh le pumgo thilto maicham kimlai donna chu kisil-na kong nakoi ding, adimset'a twi nadip ding ahi.”
English: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.

tcz: “Chule ponbuh kimvel jousea pal kaiyin lang, kelkot lut'na chu pondal nakhai cheh cheh ding ahi.”
en: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.
text:
EXO 40:8
Thadou: “Chule ponbuh kimvel jousea pal kaiyin lang, kelkot lut'na chu pondal nakhai cheh cheh ding ahi.”
English: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.

tcz: “Kinu thei thao chu choiyin lang houbuh sung'a thil-le-lo ijakai nanu sohkei ding, aboncha atheng ding'a nathenso ding ahi.”
en: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.
text:
EXO 40:9
Thadou: “Kinu thei thao chu choiyin lang houbuh sung'a thil-le-lo ijakai nanu sohkei ding, aboncha atheng ding'a nathenso ding ahi.”
English: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.

tcz: “Chule pumgo thilto maicham ahin athilkeo jouse jaona thao nanu ding, atheng ding'a thensona nanei ding ahi. Chuteng hiche maicham chu atheng chungnung'a pang ding ahi.”
en: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.
text:
EXO 40:10
Thadou: “Chule pumgo thilto maicham ahin athilkeo jouse jaona thao nanu ding, atheng ding'a thensona nanei ding ahi. Chuteng hiche maicham chu atheng chungnung'a pang ding ahi.”
English: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.

tcz: “Chu jou teng, kisilna-kong le atunna ho aboncha thao nanu ding, thensona naneipeh ding ahi.”
en: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.
text:
EXO 40:11
Thadou: “Chu jou teng, kisilna-kong le atunna ho aboncha thao nanu ding, thensona naneipeh ding ahi.”
English: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.

tcz: “Aaron le achapate chengse kikhop-khomna ponbuh sung lam'a hinpuijin lang, kong'a kilui twiya chu nasil diu ahi.”
en: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
text:
EXO 40:12
Thadou: “Aaron le achapate chengse kikhop-khomna ponbuh sung lam'a hinpuijin lang, kong'a kilui twiya chu nasil diu ahi.”
English: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

tcz: “Aaron chu thao nanu ding chule ponsil theng pen'na navon ding, ajeh chu keima kinbol thempu a pang diu ahi.”
en: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
text:
EXO 40:13
Thadou: “Aaron chu thao nanu ding chule ponsil theng pen'na navon ding, ajeh chu keima kinbol thempu a pang diu ahi.”
English: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

tcz: “Chule achapate chengse jong hinpuijin lang abonchaova sangkhol-chol na-ah peh ding ahi.”
en: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.
text:
EXO 40:14
Thadou: “Chule achapate chengse jong hinpuijin lang abonchaova sangkhol-chol na-ah peh ding ahi.”
English: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

tcz: “Apau Aaron thao nanu bang chun, amaho chengse jong thao nanu sohkei ding ahi. Ajeh chu abonchauva keima kinbol thempua pang diu ahi.”
en: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”
text:
EXO 40:15
Thadou: “Apau Aaron thao nanu bang chun, amaho chengse jong thao nanu sohkei ding ahi. Ajeh chu abonchauva keima kinbol thempua pang diu ahi.”
English: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”

tcz: Pakaiyin athupeh bang chun Mose'n jong atong kimsoh kei tan ahi.
en: Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.
text:
EXO 40:16
Thadou: Pakaiyin athupeh bang chun Mose'n jong atong kimsoh kei tan ahi.
English: Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.

tcz: Kumkit-kum thah lha masa nikho ma sapen'in houbuh chu atung doh tan ahi.
en: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.
text:
EXO 40:17
Thadou: Kumkit-kum thah lha masa nikho ma sapen'in houbuh chu atung doh tan ahi.
English: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.

tcz: Mose'n hichengse jaonan houbuh chu ana-tung doh tan ahi; akhom ho, amoljol ho, pal khom ho abonchan atong kimsoh keiyin ahi.
en: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.
text:
EXO 40:18
Thadou: Mose'n hichengse jaonan houbuh chu ana-tung doh tan ahi; akhom ho, amoljol ho, pal khom ho abonchan atong kimsoh keiyin ahi.
English: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.

tcz: Chuin aman houbuh chung lam'a pon akhu'n Pakai thupeh bang'in abol'in ahi.
en: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 40:19
Thadou: Chuin aman houbuh chung lam'a pon akhu'n Pakai thupeh bang'in abol'in ahi.
English: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Aman hettohsahna song-pheng chengse chu alan tingkong sung lam'a chu akoiyin ahi. Chuin aman thingkong chungvum'a chun moljol chu akoilut'in thingkong chungvum'a chun hepi touna akoiyin ahi.
en: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.
text:
EXO 40:20
Thadou: Aman hettohsahna song-pheng chengse chu alan tingkong sung lam'a chu akoiyin ahi. Chuin aman thingkong chungvum'a chun moljol chu akoilut'in thingkong chungvum'a chun hepi touna akoiyin ahi.
English: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.

tcz: Aman thingkong chu houbuh lailung'a ahin pu'n pondal kikhu chu ahohdoh paijin, Pakaiyin athupeh bang chun abol in ahi.
en: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 40:21
Thadou: Aman thingkong chu houbuh lailung'a ahin pu'n pondal kikhu chu ahohdoh paijin, Pakaiyin athupeh bang chun abol in ahi.
English: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Chuban in Mose'n houbuh sung lam'a chun dokhang akoiyin, polam pondal kilan'na achun akoiyin ahi.
en: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.
text:
EXO 40:22
Thadou: Chuban in Mose'n houbuh sung lam'a chun dokhang akoiyin, polam pondal kilan'na achun akoiyin ahi.
English: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.

tcz: Chule aman dokhang chung'a chun Pakai angsung'a ding in changlhah akoiyin ahi. Hichu Pakai thupeh bang'a abol ahiye.
en: He set the bread in order on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 40:23
Thadou: Chule aman dokhang chung'a chun Pakai angsung'a ding in changlhah akoiyin ahi. Hichu Pakai thupeh bang'a abol ahiye.
English: He set the bread in order on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Aman houbuh lhang lam dokhang chule muntheng laiya chu thaomei atung doh tan ahi.
en: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.
text:
EXO 40:24
Thadou: Aman houbuh lhang lam dokhang chule muntheng laiya chu thaomei atung doh tan ahi.
English: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.

tcz: Chuin aman thaomei chu atung doh tan, Pakaiyin athupeh bang'a abol ahi.
en: He lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 40:25
Thadou: Chuin aman thaomei chu atung doh tan, Pakaiyin athupeh bang'a abol ahi.
English: He lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Aman houbuh kotphung maija chun
en: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
text:
EXO 40:28
Thadou: Aman houbuh kotphung maija chun
English: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

tcz: Chule aman houbuh lut-na kotbul'a chun pumgo thilto maichan chu akoiyin ahi. Achung'a chun pumgo thilto akatdoh'in ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin athupeh bang'a abol ahi.
en: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 40:29
Thadou: Chule aman houbuh lut-na kotbul'a chun pumgo thilto maichan chu akoiyin ahi. Achung'a chun pumgo thilto akatdoh'in ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin athupeh bang'a abol ahi.
English: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Chu ban in Mose'n houbuh le maicham kimlaija chun kisilna-kong chu akoiyin ahi. Aman kong dimset chun twi adip tan, ajeh chu thempu kinbol'a pang hon kisilna'a amanchah ding ahi.
en: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.
text:
EXO 40:30
Thadou: Chu ban in Mose'n houbuh le maicham kimlaija chun kisilna-kong chu akoiyin ahi. Aman kong dimset chun twi adip tan, ajeh chu thempu kinbol'a pang hon kisilna'a amanchah ding ahi.
English: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.

tcz: Mose chule Aaron le achapate'n kong- sung'a twi chu kisilna'a aman chah diu ahi.
en: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.
text:
EXO 40:31
Thadou: Mose chule Aaron le achapate'n kong- sung'a twi chu kisilna'a aman chah diu ahi.
English: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

tcz: Houbuh maicham lam ahinjut lut teng ule, kisil ngimna'a aman jing ding'u ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh ahi.
en: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
EXO 40:32
Thadou: Houbuh maicham lam ahinjut lut teng ule, kisil ngimna'a aman jing ding'u ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin Mose heng'a athupeh ahi.
English: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Chuin aman houbuh le maicham kimvel chengsea chun pondal akhaiyin ahi. Chule kelkot lam'a jong pondal akhaijin ahi. Ajonan Mose'n natoh ijakai atong kimsoh keijin ahi.
en: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
text:
EXO 40:33
Thadou: Chuin aman houbuh le maicham kimvel chengsea chun pondal akhaiyin ahi. Chule kelkot lam'a jong pondal akhaijin ahi. Ajonan Mose'n natoh ijakai atong kimsoh keijin ahi.
English: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

tcz: Meibol'in ponbuh chu akhu jeng tan ahile, Pakai loupina chu kikhop khom'na ponbuh adim lha jeng tai.
en: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
text:
EXO 40:34
Thadou: Meibol'in ponbuh chu akhu jeng tan ahile, Pakai loupina chu kikhop khom'na ponbuh adim lha jeng tai.
English: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.

tcz: Mose chu houbuh sung lam'a chun alut thei tapon akiting den tai, ajeh chu meibol lom chu kiheh jeng ahitan, chule Pakai loupi na chun houbuh chu atomlhah jeng ahitai.
en: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
text:
EXO 40:35
Thadou: Mose chu houbuh sung lam'a chun alut thei tapon akiting den tai, ajeh chu meibol lom chu kiheh jeng ahitan, chule Pakai loupi na chun houbuh chu atomlhah jeng ahitai.
English: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.

tcz: Tun meibol jong chu houbuh akon'in ahung kitol tan ahile, Israel mite jeng jong meibol chie dungjuijin akitol tha jitauvin ahi.
en: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;

tcz: Amavang meibol aum den laisen, amaho jong aumden jitauve.
en: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.
text:
EXO 40:37
Thadou: Amavang meibol aum den laisen, amaho jong aumden jitauve.
English: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.

tcz: Pakaiya konna meibol chun nilhum kei jin houbuh chu atomlha jeng tan, janteng mei-kong in akilah'jin ahile Israel mite'n amittah'uvin amuthei jun ahi. Hiche hin a kholjin na chan uva ahin jui peh ahi.
en: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
text:
EXO 40:38
Thadou: Pakaiya konna meibol chun nilhum kei jin houbuh chu atomlha jeng tan, janteng mei-kong in akilah'jin ahile Israel mite'n amittah'uvin amuthei jun ahi. Hiche hin a kholjin na chan uva ahin jui peh ahi.
English: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose chu houbuh akon in akouvin, ajah’a hiti hin asei peh tai.
en: The LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,
text:
LEV 1:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose chu houbuh akon in akouvin, ajah’a hiti hin asei peh tai.
English: The LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

tcz: Hiche thupeh chengse hi Israelte hengah seipeh in, “Nang hon Pathen henga pumgo thilto nabol teng uleh, gamkol sung akon bong hon hihen kelcha hijong leh nato jing thei diu ahi.”
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to the LORD, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.
text:
LEV 1:2
Thadou: Hiche thupeh chengse hi Israelte hengah seipeh in, “Nang hon Pathen henga pumgo thilto nabol teng uleh, gamkol sung akon bong hon hihen kelcha hijong leh nato jing thei diu ahi.”
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to the LORD, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

tcz: Nangman gancha nato ding chu pumgo thilto ding gancha akul sunga pat hiding, nolna bei thilto hi ding hichu Pathen in asan thei na dinga houbuh kotphunga todoh ding ahi.
en: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD.
text:
LEV 1:3
Thadou: Nangman gancha nato ding chu pumgo thilto ding gancha akul sunga pat hiding, nolna bei thilto hi ding hichu Pathen in asan thei na dinga houbuh kotphunga todoh ding ahi.
English: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD.

tcz: Hiche gancha pumgo thilto chu aluchunga nakhut ngamlhan, chuteng kithoidam nadia hiche thilto chu Pakai adia santhei dol hiding ahi.
en: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
text:
LEV 1:4
Thadou: Hiche gancha pumgo thilto chu aluchunga nakhut ngamlhan, chuteng kithoidam nadia hiche thilto chu Pakai adia santhei dol hiding ahi.
English: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

tcz: “Chuteng leh Pakai Pathen ma sanga bongchal nou natha ding chule Aaron chapate leh thempu hon gancha thisan chu houbuh maiya maicham akimvel jousea athe khum diu ahi.”
en: He shall kill the bull before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
LEV 1:5
Thadou: “Chuteng leh Pakai Pathen ma sanga bongchal nou natha ding chule Aaron chapate leh thempu hon gancha thisan chu houbuh maiya maicham akimvel jousea athe khum diu ahi.”
English: He shall kill the bull before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Chutengleh gancha chu avun nalip ding abong bonga nasat chen ding ahi.
en: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.
text:
LEV 1:6
Thadou: Chutengleh gancha chu avun nalip ding abong bonga nasat chen ding ahi.
English: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

tcz: Hitia chu Aaron chapate thempu hon maicham chunga mei atikong diu, meikong chunga chu thing alom loma akoi diu ahi.
en: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

tcz: Amahon maicham kitonaa sa kisem ho chu, aluchang leh athao hochu maicham chung meikou lah achu aban bana akoi diu ahi.
en: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

tcz: Ama vang sasung jouse leh akeng ho jouse amasa pena twiya sop lhah ngimsel ding, hiche teng chule thempu pan pumgo thilto maicham chung meiya ahal vam ding, hichu Pakai, Pathen adia namtui tah thilto hi ding ahi.
en: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
text:
LEV 1:9
Thadou: Ama vang sasung jouse leh akeng ho jouse amasa pena twiya sop lhah ngimsel ding, hiche teng chule thempu pan pumgo thilto maicham chung meiya ahal vam ding, hichu Pakai, Pathen adia namtui tah thilto hi ding ahi.
English: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

tcz: Nangman pumgo thilto dinga gancha hon lah akon napeh teng, kelngoi ahilouleh kelcha hithei ahi; amavang hichu achal hitei ding chule nolna beihel hiding ahi.
en: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.
text:
LEV 1:10
Thadou: Nangman pumgo thilto dinga gancha hon lah akon napeh teng, kelngoi ahilouleh kelcha hithei ahi; amavang hichu achal hitei ding chule nolna beihel hiding ahi.
English: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.

tcz: Chuteng gancha chu maicham chunglama natha ding, Pakai angsunga Aaron thempu leh achapate hon, gancha thisan chu maicham phung anigli chunga achap kimvel soh diu ahi.
en: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
text:
LEV 1:11
Thadou: Chuteng gancha chu maicham chunglama natha ding, Pakai angsunga Aaron thempu leh achapate hon, gancha thisan chu maicham phung anigli chunga achap kimvel soh diu ahi.
English: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

tcz: Hiche teng chule thempu pan gancha maicham chu atum tum, alhang lhang nga asat khen ding, aluchang, alap leh athao jouse pumgo thilto maicham mei kong nga ahalvam ding ahi.
en: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,
text:
LEV 1:12
Thadou: Hiche teng chule thempu pan gancha maicham chu atum tum, alhang lhang nga asat khen ding, aluchang, alap leh athao jouse pumgo thilto maicham mei kong nga ahalvam ding ahi.
English: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

tcz: Ahinla sasung jouse chule akeng jouse chu amasa tah’a twiya asop theng ding ahi. Hiche teng chule thempu pan pumgo maicham pumpia maicham phung meiya ahal vam soh ding, hichu thilman lutah kipe, Pakaija dia gimnamtui kihal vam ahi.
en: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
text:
LEV 1:13
Thadou: Ahinla sasung jouse chule akeng jouse chu amasa tah’a twiya asop theng ding ahi. Hiche teng chule thempu pan pumgo maicham pumpia maicham phung meiya ahal vam soh ding, hichu thilman lutah kipe, Pakaija dia gimnamtui kihal vam ahi.
English: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

tcz: Nangman Pakaija pumgo maicham’a vacha napeh le, nalhen kah ding vakhu ahilou le vapal napeh ding ahi.
en: “‘If his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.
text:
LEV 1:14
Thadou: Nangman Pakaija pumgo maicham’a vacha napeh le, nalhen kah ding vakhu ahilou le vapal napeh ding ahi.
English: “‘If his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.

tcz: Hiche teng chule thempu pan vapal leh vakhu ham chu maicham phunga akoi ding, chuteng aluchang chu maicham phung chunga atan lhah ding, thempupan amasa pena hiche thisan jouse chu maicham aning gol jousea achap khum ding ahi.
en: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

tcz: Chule thempu pan achang-oi le amul jouse apaimang ding, niso lam maicham phung meivam lah’a ase lhah ding ahi.
en: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.
text:
LEV 1:16
Thadou: Chule thempu pan achang-oi le amul jouse apaimang ding, niso lam maicham phung meivam lah’a ase lhah ding ahi.
English: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

tcz: Chuteng thempu pan vapal lha ving tenia amat a abojal ding; asat tel lou hel ding chule maicham chunga meiya ahal vam ding, hichu pumgo maicham, gimnamtui Pakai adia kikat doh ahi.
en: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
text:
LEV 1:17
Thadou: Chuteng thempu pan vapal lha ving tenia amat a abojal ding; asat tel lou hel ding chule maicham chunga meiya ahal vam ding, hichu pumgo maicham, gimnamtui Pakai adia kikat doh ahi.
English: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

tcz: Nangman lhosohga Pathen maichama napeh tengleh, hiche lhosohga changbong neldisel chu nalhen doh ding, hiche changbong chunga chu Olive thao nasunkhuma, Bego toh nachap khum ding ahi.
en: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.

English: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.

tcz: Hichu Aaron chapate, Thempu ho koma nahin choi ding, Thempu ho chun changbong thaotwi toh kihalsa chu, khut a sip-kham khat ahamdoh ding, Bego namthei toh kihalsa changbong ho chengse chu maicham phunga ahal diu ahi. Hichu Pakaiya dia thilpeh pha leh gimnamtui tah hiding ahi.
en: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
text:

English: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

tcz: Gasoh maicham amoh chengse chu Aaron leh achapate jouse na hoppeh ding, hiche maicham thilpeh hi Pakai adia thilpeh athengpen leh aman lupen hiding ahi.
en: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

en: “‘No meal offering which you shall offer to the LORD shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.

tcz: Theichang gathah ho jouse jong, Pakai angsunga thilto dia nahin choi thei ahinai, hinlah hiche ho vang chu maicham phunga ki gouvam theilou hel ding ahi.
en: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to the LORD, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.
text:

English: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to the LORD, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.

tcz: Na lousohga maicham todoh ding jouse chu chi-al toh na haltha cheh ding ahi. Hichu Pathen tonsot'a dia na kiteppi nau na geldoh jing nau hiding ahi.
en: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.
text:

en: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
text:
LEV 5:1

English: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

tcz: “ahilouleh nangman sathenglou sathisa hamkhat chu hetlouva natoh khah a ahileh hichu chona dola thenglou ahi. Hitobanga nathilbol chu nahet doh tengle nangman nakisuhboh nale nachonsetna chu naphondoh ding ahi. Hitobang sathisa chu gamsa hihen, insa hihen, ahiloule tolla vah ho hijong le aboncha chunga nabol soh kei dingu ahi.
en: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.
text:
LEV 5:2
Thadou: “ahilouleh nangman sathenglou sathisa hamkhat chu hetlouva natoh khah a ahileh hichu chona dola thenglou ahi. Hitobanga nathilbol chu nahet doh tengle nangman nakisuhboh nale nachonsetna chu naphondoh ding ahi. Hitobang sathisa chu gamsa hihen, insa hihen, ahiloule tolla vah ho hijong le aboncha chunga nabol soh kei dingu ahi.
English: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.

tcz: “Ahilou jongle nangman hetlouvin mihem suhboh thei thilkhat natongkha tai. Hiche nathil tohkhah chu nahet doh ni nileh, nangman nachonsetna chu naphondoh ding ahi.
en: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.
text:
LEV 5:3
Thadou: “Ahilou jongle nangman hetlouvin mihem suhboh thei thilkhat natongkha tai. Hiche nathil tohkhah chu nahet doh ni nileh, nangman nachonsetna chu naphondoh ding ahi.
English: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.

tcz: “Ahiloule nangman aphatna ding hihen asetna ding hijongle ngolhoitah in nakihahsel tan ahi. Hichu ngolhoitah ahi ti nageldoh tengle, nachonsetna chu naphondoh ding ahi.
en: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil or to do good—whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him—when he knows of it, then he will be guilty of one of these.
text:
LEV 5:4
Thadou: “Ahiloule nangman aphatna ding hihen asetna ding hijongle ngolhoitah in nakihahsel tan ahi. Hichu ngolhoitah ahi ti nageldoh tengle, nachonsetna chu naphondoh ding ahi.
English: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil or to do good—whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him—when he knows of it, then he will be guilty of one of these.

tcz: Hitobang chonsetna ho hi khat pen pen hijongle nahin geldoh ni nileh, na chonsetna naphondoh ding ahi.
en: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned;

tcz: Chutengle chonset themona jeh a nangman gancha kul sunga kona kelngoi hihen kelcha hijongle anu khat Pakai henga nahin kai ding ahi. Hiche hi chonset thilto hiding thempupan nangma chonsetna a kona nasuhtheng nale Pakai toh nasuh dih na hiding ahi.
en: and he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD for his sin which he has sinned: a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.
text:
LEV 5:6
Thadou: Chutengle chonset themona jeh a nangman gancha kul sunga kona kelngoi hihen kelcha hijongle anu khat Pakai henga nahin kai ding ahi. Hiche hi chonset thilto hiding thempupan nangma chonsetna a kona nasuhtheng nale Pakai toh nasuh dih na hiding ahi.
English: and he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD for his sin which he has sinned: a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.

tcz: Ahinlah nangman kelngoi nahin kaijou hih jongle, chonset themmona jeh a thilto dinga vakhu ni ahilouleh vapal ni nahin choi ding ahi. Vahcha khat chu chonset thilto ding ahin chule khat chu pumgo thilto hiding ahi.
en: “‘If he can’t afford a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.
text:
LEV 5:7
Thadou: Ahinlah nangman kelngoi nahin kaijou hih jongle, chonset themmona jeh a thilto dinga vakhu ni ahilouleh vapal ni nahin choi ding ahi. Vahcha khat chu chonset thilto ding ahin chule khat chu pumgo thilto hiding ahi.
English: “‘If he can’t afford a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

tcz: Hichengse chu thempupa henga nahin choi ding, aman vacha khat pen chu chonset themmona thilto a ato ding ahi. Vacha ngong chang chu ahechip a, ahivanga aluchang chu atahsa toh akikhen sah lou ding ahi.
en: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering. He shall wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.
text:
LEV 5:8
Thadou: Hichengse chu thempupa henga nahin choi ding, aman vacha khat pen chu chonset themmona thilto a ato ding ahi. Vacha ngong chang chu ahechip a, ahivanga aluchang chu atahsa toh akikhen sah lou ding ahi.
English: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering. He shall wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.

tcz: Chuteng chonset thilto gan thisan phabep chu maicham ning ho a chu athekhum ding, chule thisan amoh chengse chu maicham bula chu alonlhah sah ding ahi. Hichu chonset thilto hiding ahi.
en: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.
text:
LEV 5:9
Thadou: Chuteng chonset thilto gan thisan phabep chu maicham ning ho a chu athekhum ding, chule thisan amoh chengse chu maicham bula chu alonlhah sah ding ahi. Hichu chonset thilto hiding ahi.
English: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

tcz: Hitia chu thempu pan vacha ani chana pachu pumgo thilto adia asem ding, akibolding dan kisei tobang chetna abol ding ahi. Hitobanga hi thempupa chun nachonsetna a kona nasuhthenga, Pakai toh nasuhdih a, chtengle ngaidama naum ding ahi.
en: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.
text:
LEV 5:10
Thadou: Hitia chu thempu pan vacha ani chana pachu pumgo thilto adia asem ding, akibolding dan kisei tobang chetna abol ding ahi. Hitobanga hi thempupa chun nachonsetna a kona nasuhthenga, Pakai toh nasuhdih a, chtengle ngaidama naum ding ahi.
English: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

tcz: Vakhu ni le vapal ni nahin choi jou louva ahileh, nachonset thilto dinga chu changbong ephah dimni nahin choi thei ahi. Hiche hi chonset thilto ahijeh chun, olive thao toh nahelkhom lou ding, thil namtui jong nalhah lut lou ding ahi.
en: “‘But if he can’t afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for that in which he has sinned, one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, and he shall not put any frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.
text:
LEV 5:11
Thadou: Vakhu ni le vapal ni nahin choi jou louva ahileh, nachonset thilto dinga chu changbong ephah dimni nahin choi thei ahi. Hiche hi chonset thilto ahijeh chun, olive thao toh nahelkhom lou ding, thil namtui jong nalhah lut lou ding ahi.
English: “‘But if he can’t afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for that in which he has sinned, one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, and he shall not put any frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

tcz: Changbong chu thempupa koma nahin choiding, chutengle aman changbong lah a kona chu khut dimkhat asodoh hing ahi. Pakaiya dinga thilpeh lutah napeh na bana hiche changbong chu Maicham chunga ahalvam ding ahi. Hichu chonset thilto ahi.
en: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of the LORD made by fire. It is a sin offering.
text:
LEV 5:12
Thadou: Changbong chu thempupa koma nahin choiding, chutengle aman changbong lah a kona chu khut dimkhat asodoh hing ahi. Pakaiya dinga thilpeh lutah napeh na bana hiche changbong chu Maicham chunga ahalvam ding ahi. Hichu chonset thilto ahi.
English: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of the LORD made by fire. It is a sin offering.

tcz: Hitobanga hi chonset jeh a themona neiho chu thempu pan asuhtheng a, Pakai anga asuhdih ding, chule achonset nau ngaidama umding ahi. Changbong amoh chengse chu lhosohga thilto kibolna banga, thempupa chang ding ahi.
en: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest’s, as the meal offering.’”
text:
LEV 5:13
Thadou: Hitobanga hi chonset jeh a themona neiho chu thempu pan asuhtheng a, Pakai anga asuhdih ding, chule achonset nau ngaidama umding ahi. Changbong amoh chengse chu lhosohga thilto kibolna banga, thempupa chang ding ahi.
English: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest’s, as the meal offering.’”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 5:14
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: “nalah uva khat touvin hettohlou jeh a Pakai thilthengho asuhboh a chonsetna naneikhah uva ahile, Pakai henga chonset thilto nahin choi ding ahi. Chonset thilto ding chu nangma a mong mong kelngoichal nolna bei hiding, ahiloule aman kibahpi khat dangka a nachoh ding, hichu muntheng phunga thiltena a kitetoh dungjuija hiding ahi.
en: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding the LORD’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.
text:
LEV 5:15
Thadou: “nalah uva khat touvin hettohlou jeh a Pakai thilthengho asuhboh a chonsetna naneikhah uva ahile, Pakai henga chonset thilto nahin choi ding ahi. Chonset thilto ding chu nangma a mong mong kelngoichal nolna bei hiding, ahiloule aman kibahpi khat dangka a nachoh ding, hichu muntheng phunga thiltena a kitetoh dungjuija hiding ahi.
English: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding the LORD’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

tcz: Thiltheng nasuhset ho chu aman napeh a nasem phat kitding kit ding, chule adang soma ni jong napehtha ding ahi. Thempupa koma napeh tengle, aman kilhaina kelngoichal toh chun chonset thilto a ato a nasuhtheng ding, Pakai toh nasuhdih a, chule ngaidama naum ding ahi.
en: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.
text:
LEV 5:16
Thadou: Thiltheng nasuhset ho chu aman napeh a nasem phat kitding kit ding, chule adang soma ni jong napehtha ding ahi. Thempupa koma napeh tengle, aman kilhaina kelngoichal toh chun chonset thilto a ato a nasuhtheng ding, Pakai toh nasuhdih a, chule ngaidama naum ding ahi.
English: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.

tcz: “vetsahnan Pakai thupeh ho lah a khat napelkeh in nachonsetai. Nangman nabolkhel chu nahetlouva nabol hijong le chonse nahithou thou ding chule nachonset jeh a chu bolgima naum ding ahi.
en: “If anyone sins, doing any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, though he didn’t know it, he is still guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
text:
LEV 5:17
Thadou: “vetsahnan Pakai thupeh ho lah a khat napelkeh in nachonsetai. Nangman nabolkhel chu nahetlouva nabol hijong le chonse nahithou thou ding chule nachonset jeh a chu bolgima naum ding ahi.
English: “If anyone sins, doing any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, though he didn’t know it, he is still guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

tcz: Hitobang chonset thilto dinga chu, thempupa henga nangma kelngoichal nolnabei khat nahin kailut ding, ahiloule aman kibahpi khat nachoh a nahin kailut ding ahi. Hitobanga hi thempupan hetlouva nabolkhah chonsetnaho a kona nasuhtheng ding, Pakai toh nasuhdih a, chule ngaidama naum ding ahi.
en: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.
text:
LEV 5:18
Thadou: Hitobang chonset thilto dinga chu, thempupa henga nangma kelngoichal nolnabei khat nahin kailut ding, ahiloule aman kibahpi khat nachoh a nahin kailut ding ahi. Hitobanga hi thempupan hetlouva nabolkhah chonsetnaho a kona nasuhtheng ding, Pakai toh nasuhdih a, chule ngaidama naum ding ahi.
English: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.

tcz: Hiche hi chonset thilto hiding ahi, ajeh chu Pakai douna a chonse nahi.
en: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before the LORD.”
text:
LEV 5:19
Thadou: Hiche hi chonset thilto hiding ahi, ajeh chu Pakai douna a chonse nahi.
English: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before the LORD.”

en: or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—

tcz: Hitobang chonsetnaho hi khatpen pen nabolkhah a ahileh, nangma chonse nahitai. Naguhmang jouse chu nalepeh ding, achamlouva nalahpeh sum hihen lang, min nakoisah naguhmangho hijongleh, ahilouleh thilmang namuho hihen lang,
en: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,
text:
LEV 6:4
Thadou: Hitobang chonsetnaho hi khatpen pen nabolkhah a ahileh, nangma chonse nahitai. Naguhmang jouse chu nalepeh ding, achamlouva nalahpeh sum hihen lang, min nakoisah naguhmangho hijongleh, ahilouleh thilmang namuho hihen lang,
English: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,

tcz: jouthu a nakihahsel a nalamdoh jouse hijongleh aboncha a nalepeh ding ahi. Nalahpeh ho jouse koma lhingsetna nalepeh ding lhingsetna nalepeh ding akelvala jong soma ni napeh tha ding ahi. Napehdoh nikho lechun chonset thilto jong napeh tha ding ahi.
en: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely: he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty.
text:
LEV 6:5
Thadou: jouthu a nakihahsel a nalamdoh jouse hijongleh aboncha a nalepeh ding ahi. Nalahpeh ho jouse koma lhingsetna nalepeh ding lhingsetna nalepeh ding akelvala jong soma ni napeh tha ding ahi. Napehdoh nikho lechun chonset thilto jong napeh tha ding ahi.
English: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely: he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty.

en: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.
text:
LEV 6:6
Thadou: Chonset thilto dinga chu, nangma a mong mong kelngoichal nolnabei khat nahin kaiding, nangma a aumlouleh aman kibahpi khat nachoh ding ahi.

en: The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”
text:
LEV 6:7

English: The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiye,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 6:8
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiye,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: “Aaron le achapate henga pumgo thilto chungchanga hilchahna hi seipeh tan. pumgo thilto chu ajing jingkah chan'a maicham chunga nadalhah den ding, chule maicham mei jong chu jankhovah keiya nakousah ding ahi.
en: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.
text:
LEV 6:9
Thadou: “Aaron le achapate henga pumgo thilto chungchanga hilchahna hi seipeh tan. pumgo thilto chu ajing jingkah chan'a maicham chunga nadalhah den ding, chule maicham mei jong chu jankhovah keiya nakousah ding ahi.
English: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

tcz: jingkah tengle, thempupan atupatpon von chu ahin kivona chule tupat pon vonsungnung chu ahin kivon jouteng chuleh, pumgo thilto kihal vamna vut ho chu ahin suhtheng ding, chule maicham ning langa akoi ding ahi.
en: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
text:
LEV 6:10
Thadou: jingkah tengle, thempupan atupatpon von chu ahin kivona chule tupat pon vonsungnung chu ahin kivon jouteng chuleh, pumgo thilto kihal vamna vut ho chu ahin suhtheng ding, chule maicham ning langa akoi ding ahi.
English: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

tcz: Chujoutengle avonho chu asutlhah ding, avon ngaiya kivon kit ding, chule vutvam ho chu ngahmun polama munthenglai khatna apohdoh ding ahi.
en: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.
text:
LEV 6:11
Thadou: Chujoutengle avonho chu asutlhah ding, avon ngaiya kivon kit ding, chule vutvam ho chu ngahmun polama munthenglai khatna apohdoh ding ahi.
English: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

tcz: Hiche phat sunga chu maichama mei chu kou jing ding; mitsah louhel ding ahi. Jingkah sehle thempupa'n meilah a chu thing ahetbe jing ding chuleh pumgo thilto a dinga agontup jing ding ahi.
en: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.
text:
LEV 6:12
Thadou: Hiche phat sunga chu maichama mei chu kou jing ding; mitsah louhel ding ahi. Jingkah sehle thempupa'n meilah a chu thing ahetbe jing ding chuleh pumgo thilto a dinga agontup jing ding ahi.
English: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

tcz: Maicham chunga mei chu phat jousea kou jing jeng ding, ding, mit louhel ding ahi.
en: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.
text:
LEV 6:13
Thadou: Maicham chunga mei chu phat jousea kou jing jeng ding, ding, mit louhel ding ahi.
English: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

tcz: Hichu lhosohga thilto maicham ahin, chule Aaron chapate jousen thilto ding chu Maicham Pakai angsunga ahin tocheh diu;
en: “‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.

tcz: Amaho jouse lah a mikhat pen chun athilto lah’a kona lhosoh changbong neldi khut dim khat aham doh ding, lhosoh thilto toh kihel thaotwi leh gimnamtui puma alah a, hichu mangtheilou maicham chunga chu agovam soh hel ding, Pakaiya dia gimnamtui soh ding ahi.
en: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to the LORD.
text:
LEV 6:15
Thadou: Amaho jouse lah a mikhat pen chun athilto lah’a kona lhosoh changbong neldi khut dim khat aham doh ding, lhosoh thilto toh kihel thaotwi leh gimnamtui puma alah a, hichu mangtheilou maicham chunga chu agovam soh hel ding, Pakaiya dia gimnamtui soh ding ahi.
English: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to the LORD.

tcz: Chule amoh chengse chu Aaron le achapate sesen aneh diu ahi. Aneh teng uleh cholso lou hiding, hichu muntheng lai khat a aganeh diu ahi; aneh nadiu mun chu kikhop khomna ponbuh sunga chu aneh diu ahi.
en: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
LEV 6:16
Thadou: Chule amoh chengse chu Aaron le achapate sesen aneh diu ahi. Aneh teng uleh cholso lou hiding, hichu muntheng lai khat a aganeh diu ahi; aneh nadiu mun chu kikhop khomna ponbuh sunga chu aneh diu ahi.
English: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Chule changlhah neh dia akiken teng uleh, cholso lou hi ding; hichu keiman pumgo maicham ka chan ka hoppeh ahin, chonset maicham le themmona chungnung ahi.
en: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as are the sin offering and the trespass offering.
text:
LEV 6:17
Thadou: Chule changlhah neh dia akiken teng uleh, cholso lou hi ding; hichu keiman pumgo maicham ka chan ka hoppeh ahin, chonset maicham le themmona chungnung ahi.
English: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as are the sin offering and the trespass offering.

tcz: Pathen akona pumgo thilto thudola nakhang lhung uva dia thu katep peh na hiuvin, hichu Aaron chate lah a pasal jousen aneh diu ahi, hiche maicham thilto hi koi hile atongkha chan theng jing ding ahi.
en: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”
text:
LEV 6:18
Thadou: Pathen akona pumgo thilto thudola nakhang lhung uva dia thu katep peh na hiuvin, hichu Aaron chate lah a pasal jousen aneh diu ahi, hiche maicham thilto hi koi hile atongkha chan theng jing ding ahi.
English: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”

tcz: Mose henga Pakaiyin hiti hin aseijin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 6:19
Thadou: Mose henga Pakaiyin hiti hin aseijin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Aaron le achapate hon thempu pan mun dia thao akinu nikho teng uleh, Pakai henga athilto diu chu hiche hiding ahi; lhosohga thilto dia changbong nelsel ephah dimkhat hopsom lah a hop khat hiding, akeh khat chu jingkah maichama atoding chule akeh langkhat ma chu nilhah lang maichama ato ding ahi.
en: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the LORD in the day when he is anointed: one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.
text:
LEV 6:20
Thadou: Aaron le achapate hon thempu pan mun dia thao akinu nikho teng uleh, Pakai henga athilto diu chu hiche hiding ahi; lhosohga thilto dia changbong nelsel ephah dimkhat hopsom lah a hop khat hiding, akeh khat chu jingkah maichama atoding chule akeh langkhat ma chu nilhah lang maichama ato ding ahi.
English: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the LORD in the day when he is anointed: one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.

tcz: Changbong nel chu khangbel sunga thaotwi toh kichoh hel ding, chuteng nangman dip a kihelsa chu maicham thilto dang ho banga apheng phenga nakoi tup ding; hichu Pakaiya dia gimnamtui dinga nahin choi ding ahi.
en: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
text:
LEV 6:21
Thadou: Changbong nel chu khangbel sunga thaotwi toh kichoh hel ding, chuteng nangman dip a kihelsa chu maicham thilto dang ho banga apheng phenga nakoi tup ding; hichu Pakaiya dia gimnamtui dinga nahin choi ding ahi.
English: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

tcz: Chule Aaron chapate ho lah a, ama khela thempu dia thaonu chang pachun, hiche maicham thilto chu a-itih chana dia Pakai heng lama ato ding, hiche ho jouse chu govam hiding ahi.
en: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to the LORD.
text:
LEV 6:22
Thadou: Chule Aaron chapate ho lah a, ama khela thempu dia thaonu chang pachun, hiche maicham thilto chu a-itih chana dia Pakai heng lama ato ding, hiche ho jouse chu govam hiding ahi.
English: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to the LORD.

tcz: Thempu koi hileh lhosohga maicham thilto ato doh jouse, aboncha agovam hel ding, hichu koima chan aneh thei lou ding ahi.
en: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”
text:
LEV 6:23
Thadou: Thempu koi hileh lhosohga maicham thilto ato doh jouse, aboncha agovam hel ding, hichu koima chan aneh thei lou ding ahi.
English: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”

tcz: Themmo jeh a maicham thilto ding chu hiche hi ahi, hichu atheng chung nung hiding ahi.
en: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering: It is most holy.
text:
LEV 7:1
Thadou: Themmo jeh a maicham thilto ding chu hiche hi ahi, hichu atheng chung nung hiding ahi.
English: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering: It is most holy.

tcz: “Pumgo thilto maicham phunga gancha kithana muna chu, hiche themmona thilto chu kithat ding chule gan thisan chu maicham ning gol jousea chapkhum ding ahi.”
en: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.
text:
LEV 7:2
Thadou: “Pumgo thilto maicham phunga gancha kithana muna chu, hiche themmona thilto chu kithat ding chule gan thisan chu maicham ning gol jousea chapkhum ding ahi.”
English: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.

tcz: Hitia chu thempu pan athao jouse aboncha maichama atodoh ding, amei tobuh thao, asung thao alap jouse toh,
en: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,
text:
LEV 7:3
Thadou: Hitia chu thempu pan athao jouse aboncha maichama atodoh ding, amei tobuh thao, asung thao alap jouse toh,
English: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,

tcz: Ataijung lah a akal teni leh akala athao um chengse, athin leh akal teni jaonaa aphe le athao jouse aboncha alah doh cheh cheh ding,
en: and he shall take away the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys;

tcz: Chuteng leh thempu pan pumgo thilto ding a Pakai heng lam, maichan chunga agovam hel ding ahi, ajeh chu themmo maicham thilto ahi.
en: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to the LORD: it is a trespass offering.
text:
LEV 7:5
Thadou: Chuteng leh thempu pan pumgo thilto ding a Pakai heng lam, maichan chunga agovam hel ding ahi, ajeh chu themmo maicham thilto ahi.
