English: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to the LORD: it is a trespass offering.

tcz: Hitobang maicham thilto chu thempu ho lah a pasal kiti phot in aneh thei ding, ahin muntheng sung lai khat a aneh ding dol ahi, hichu atheng lah a atheng chung nung khat ahiye.
en: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.
text:
LEV 7:6
Thadou: Hitobang maicham thilto chu thempu ho lah a pasal kiti phot in aneh thei ding, ahin muntheng sung lai khat a aneh ding dol ahi, hichu atheng lah a atheng chung nung khat ahiye.
English: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.

tcz: Themmona maicham thilto le chonset thilto hi akikhehna umbeh lou ahin, anitah a dan khat a um chu ahi, chutia chu athoiya pang thempupa chun ki thoi damna maicham thilto chu akilah ding ahi.
en: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.
text:
LEV 7:7
Thadou: Themmona maicham thilto le chonset thilto hi akikhehna umbeh lou ahin, anitah a dan khat a um chu ahi, chutia chu athoiya pang thempupa chun ki thoi damna maicham thilto chu akilah ding ahi.
English: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.

tcz: Pumgo maicham thilto a pang jouse sanpeh a toh doh a pang thempu pan hitabang maicham thil to savun cheng se chu akilah ding ahi.
en: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.
text:
LEV 7:8
Thadou: Pumgo maicham thilto a pang jouse sanpeh a toh doh a pang thempu pan hitabang maicham thil to savun cheng se chu akilah ding ahi.
English: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

tcz: Chule lhosohga maicham thilto, meilhum sunga kigousa, khang bela kihon sa le ki kang sa jouse chu aboncha hiche thempupa chun akilah ding ahi.
en: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.
text:
LEV 7:9
Thadou: Chule lhosohga maicham thilto, meilhum sunga kigousa, khang bela kihon sa le ki kang sa jouse chu aboncha hiche thempupa chun akilah ding ahi.
English: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.

tcz: Hitia chu lhosohga maicham thilto thaotwi kichap kotsa hihen, akichap kot lou hi jongleh, aboncha Aaron chapate chang diu ahi.
en: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.
text:
LEV 7:10
Thadou: Hitia chu lhosohga maicham thilto thaotwi kichap kotsa hihen, akichap kot lou hi jongleh, aboncha Aaron chapate chang diu ahi.
English: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche maicham thilto hi, koi hileh Pathen henga chamna maicham kilhaina ganthaa hitia hi chepi ding ahi.
en: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to the LORD:
text:
LEV 7:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu hiche maicham thilto hi, koi hileh Pathen henga chamna maicham kilhaina ganthaa hitia hi chepi ding ahi.
English: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to the LORD:

tcz: Maicham thiltoh pan thangvahna dia ato doh ding ahileh, hitobang thangvah maicham thilto ding chu changlhah thaotwi kichap khumsa changlhah pheng phabep chu toh, hiche thaotwi toh kihalsa changlhah le changbong neldil a kisem chutoh ato thading ahi.
en: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.
text:
LEV 7:12
Thadou: Maicham thiltoh pan thangvahna dia ato doh ding ahileh, hitobang thangvah maicham thilto ding chu changlhah thaotwi kichap khumsa changlhah pheng phabep chu toh, hiche thaotwi toh kihalsa changlhah le changbong neldil a kisem chutoh ato thading ahi.
English: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.

tcz: Amapa chun hiche thangvahna maicham thilto kilhaina gantha chu chol jaolou changlhah chutoh ahin totha ding ahi.
en: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread.
text:
LEV 7:13
Thadou: Amapa chun hiche thangvahna maicham thilto kilhaina gantha chu chol jaolou changlhah chutoh ahin totha ding ahi.
English: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread.

tcz: Chule hiche thilto ho jouse lah’a kona chu khat cheh alah doh ding, hichu Pakai maicham thiltoa apeh ding ahi. Hiche ho jouse chu chamna maicham thilto gancha thisan jouse chap jal'a pang thempupa chang ding ahi.
en: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to the LORD. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.
text:
LEV 7:14
Thadou: Chule hiche thilto ho jouse lah’a kona chu khat cheh alah doh ding, hichu Pakai maicham thiltoa apeh ding ahi. Hiche ho jouse chu chamna maicham thilto gancha thisan jouse chap jal'a pang thempupa chang ding ahi.
English: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to the LORD. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.

tcz: Hiche thangvahna maicham thilto kilhaina gancha kithat chu, anikhoa neh ding ahin, asa neo khat jeng jong khovah chan umsah lou ding ahi.
en: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.
text:
LEV 7:15
Thadou: Hiche thangvahna maicham thilto kilhaina gancha kithat chu, anikhoa neh ding ahin, asa neo khat jeng jong khovah chan umsah lou ding ahi.
English: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.

tcz: Chule hiche gancha kilhaina maicham toh doh pa chun, thu lolhin sah a kitoh doh ham ahilouleh deisah jal'a kitoh doh ahileh, hiche kilhaina gancha kitha nikho mama achu aneh ding amoh chengse chu ajing lam le aneh thei kit ahi.
en: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a free will offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice. On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten,
text:
LEV 7:16
Thadou: Chule hiche gancha kilhaina maicham toh doh pa chun, thu lolhin sah a kitoh doh ham ahilouleh deisah jal'a kitoh doh ahileh, hiche kilhaina gancha kitha nikho mama achu aneh ding amoh chengse chu ajing lam le aneh thei kit ahi.
English: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a free will offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice. On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten,

tcz: Chule ani thum chana sa umho vang chu meiya govam hel ding ahi.
en: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.
text:
LEV 7:17
Thadou: Chule ani thum chana sa umho vang chu meiya govam hel ding ahi.
English: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

tcz: Ito bangkhat a hiche mipan gancha kilhaina maicham thilto aneh nah laiya ahileh, hiche kilhaina maicham tohpa chu santhei dol ahipoi; hiche maicham thilto chu amapa dinga ngensea umthei lou ding ahi, ajeh chu hot umtah sohdoh ahitan hitobang thilto nekha sun chu chonset themmona chu chang jing ding ahi.
en: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it shall not be credited to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.
text:
LEV 7:18
Thadou: Ito bangkhat a hiche mipan gancha kilhaina maicham thilto aneh nah laiya ahileh, hiche kilhaina maicham tohpa chu santhei dol ahipoi; hiche maicham thilto chu amapa dinga ngensea umthei lou ding ahi, ajeh chu hot umtah sohdoh ahitan hitobang thilto nekha sun chu chonset themmona chu chang jing ding ahi.
English: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it shall not be credited to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.

tcz: Thil theng lou sa chu neh tah lou ding, hichu meiya govam hel ding ahi, hinlah mi koihileh atahsa chung theng chan chun sa aneh thei jing ahi.
en: “‘The meat that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the meat, everyone who is clean may eat it;

tcz: Ahinlah koibang khat chu ama tichung boh puma, Pakaiya dia kitoh doh kilhaina maicham nekha sun chu koi hileh amite lah a kona pampeiya umjing ding ahi.
en: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
text:
LEV 7:20
Thadou: Ahinlah koibang khat chu ama tichung boh puma, Pakaiya dia kitoh doh kilhaina maicham nekha sun chu koi hileh amite lah a kona pampeiya umjing ding ahi.
English: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

tcz: Koi hileh atheng lou tongkha achu, hiche atheng lou atoh khah pen pen chu, mihem ahin gancha theng lou hi jong le hiche ho jouse toh chun kilhaina maicham thilto ho chu nekha jing ta leh, amapa chu amite lah a kona pampeiya um jeng ding ahi.
en: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to the LORD, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”
text:
LEV 7:21
Thadou: Koi hileh atheng lou tongkha achu, hiche atheng lou atoh khah pen pen chu, mihem ahin gancha theng lou hi jong le hiche ho jouse toh chun kilhaina maicham thilto ho chu nekha jing ta leh, amapa chu amite lah a kona pampeiya um jeng ding ahi.
English: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to the LORD, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

tcz: Pathen in Mose henga hiti hin asei tan,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 7:22
Thadou: Pathen in Mose henga hiti hin asei tan,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jouse henga hiti hin thu sepeh in, sathao kiti phot bongchal thao hihen, kelngoi thao, kelcha thao hitaleh athao kiti phot chu neh da jeng un,
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.
text:
LEV 7:23
Thadou: Israel chate jouse henga hiti hin thu sepeh in, sathao kiti phot bongchal thao hihen, kelngoi thao, kelcha thao hitaleh athao kiti phot chu neh da jeng un,
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.

tcz: Gancha thikam thao hihen, gam mang lah a gamsa tha athao hijongleh hiche sa thao hochu lam choma kimang thei ding, hinlah neh vang naneh louhel diu ahi.
en: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.
text:
LEV 7:24
Thadou: Gancha thikam thao hihen, gam mang lah a gamsa tha athao hijongleh hiche sa thao hochu lam choma kimang thei ding, hinlah neh vang naneh louhel diu ahi.
English: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.

tcz: Hitobang achu koi hijong leu chun, Pathen henga govam dia kitoh doh gancha sa thao nekha chan chu namite lah uva kona pampeiya um ding ahi.
en: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to the LORD, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.
text:
LEV 7:25
Thadou: Hitobang achu koi hijong leu chun, Pathen henga govam dia kitoh doh gancha sa thao nekha chan chu namite lah uva kona pampeiya um ding ahi.
English: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to the LORD, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.

tcz: Nanghon thisan kiti phot, vacha thisan le gancha thisa kiti phot, nache lenauva thisan um phot chu naneh thei lou diu ahi.
en: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.
text:
LEV 7:26
Thadou: Nanghon thisan kiti phot, vacha thisan le gancha thisa kiti phot, nache lenauva thisan um phot chu naneh thei lou diu ahi.
English: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.

tcz: Hiche bang achu nalah uva koi hileh, thisan tep kha phot chu pampeiya um jeng ding ahi.
en: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”
text:
LEV 7:27
Thadou: Hiche bang achu nalah uva koi hileh, thisan tep kha phot chu pampeiya um jeng ding ahi.
English: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

tcz: Pathen in Mose henga hiti hin asei peh in,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 7:28
Thadou: Pathen in Mose henga hiti hin asei peh in,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jouse henga hiti hin seipeh tan, nalah uva koitobang in Pathen adia chamna maicham thilto kilhaina gancha apeh nom chan in peh jeng thei ahi.
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring his offering to the LORD out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
text:
LEV 7:29
Thadou: Israel chate jouse henga hiti hin seipeh tan, nalah uva koitobang in Pathen adia chamna maicham thilto kilhaina gancha apeh nom chan in peh jeng thei ahi.
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring his offering to the LORD out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

tcz: Amachun atahsa tah a hiche kilhaina gancha chu Pathen heng lama ahin kaiya, hichea chu athilto ding chu athao le a oppheng ahin choi ding, chuteng Pathen ansunga aoppheng lai chu maicham thennso naa pang ding ahi.
en: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.
text:
LEV 7:30
Thadou: Amachun atahsa tah a hiche kilhaina gancha chu Pathen heng lama ahin kaiya, hichea chu athilto ding chu athao le a oppheng ahin choi ding, chuteng Pathen ansunga aoppheng lai chu maicham thennso naa pang ding ahi.
English: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.

tcz: Chujou tengleh thempu pan sa thao chengse maicham phunga agovam hel ding, a oppheng jouse vang chu Aaron chapate chang ding ahi.
en: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
text:
LEV 7:31
Thadou: Chujou tengleh thempu pan sa thao chengse maicham phunga agovam hel ding, a oppheng jouse vang chu Aaron chapate chang ding ahi.
English: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

tcz: Chamna thilto nabol bang un, Sa amal khat pen chu thempupa henga napeh lut diu ahi.
en: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
text:
LEV 7:32
Thadou: Chamna thilto nabol bang un, Sa amal khat pen chu thempupa henga napeh lut diu ahi.
English: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

tcz: Hitia chu Aaron chapate ho lah a gancha thisan le athao toh'a pangpa chun, ama chan ding samal jet lam chu aki koi ding ahi.
en: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.
text:
LEV 7:33
Thadou: Hitia chu Aaron chapate ho lah a gancha thisan le athao toh'a pangpa chun, ama chan ding samal jet lam chu aki koi ding ahi.
English: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.

tcz: Ajeh chu kithenso sa oppheng le sa mal chu Israel chate jouse lah a kon kiladoh a, chamna maicham thilto apeh jouse lah uva kona kachom khen doh ahi.
en: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”
text:
LEV 7:34
Thadou: Ajeh chu kithenso sa oppheng le sa mal chu Israel chate jouse lah a kon kiladoh a, chamna maicham thilto apeh jouse lah uva kona kachom khen doh ahi.
English: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”

tcz: Hichu Aaron le achapate jouse chang diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho Pathen thempu adia akithen souva ahung kipeh doh nikhouva pat, Pathen henga pumgo maicham thilto jouse akilah diuva gotsa chu ana hitai.
en: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron, and the consecrated portion of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to the LORD in the priest’s office;

tcz: Chule thempu dia thao akinu nikhouva pat, hichu amaho chang diu ahitia Pathen in Israelte lah a ana phondohsa ahitai, hitia chu akhang lhung keiyuva tang louhela bat a anei jing diu ahi.
en: which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.
text:
LEV 7:36
Thadou: Chule thempu dia thao akinu nikhouva pat, hichu amaho chang diu ahitia Pathen in Israelte lah a ana phondohsa ahitai, hitia chu akhang lhung keiyuva tang louhela bat a anei jing diu ahi.
English: which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.

tcz: Hichu pumgo maicham thilto ding dan, lhosohga, themmona, kisuhthengna chule chamna maicham thilto dan hi ding ahi.
en: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings
text:
LEV 7:37
Thadou: Hichu pumgo maicham thilto ding dan, lhosohga, themmona, kisuhthengna chule chamna maicham thilto dan hi ding ahi.
English: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings

tcz: Gamthip lailunga Pathen in Mose henga athusei chun, Israel chaten Pathen henga maicham thilto ahinchoi diu ahitia, ana phondohsa ahitai.
en: which the LORD commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
text:
LEV 7:38
Thadou: Gamthip lailunga Pathen in Mose henga athusei chun, Israel chaten Pathen henga maicham thilto ahinchoi diu ahitia, ana phondohsa ahitai.
English: which the LORD commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in, Mose henga hiti hin aseiyin ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 8:1
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in, Mose henga hiti hin aseiyin ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Aaron leh achapate kou khom inlang, akivonna ding un, kiloi ding thaotwi choiyin chonset maicham thilto ding in bongchal le kelngoi achal nitoh puiyin chule cholso lou changlhah pucha khat jong nachoi peh ding u,
en: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;

tcz: Chuteng leh khopi sunga ami takip ki khopkhomna ponbuh kot phunga chun koukhom soh keiyin, ati.
en: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”
text:
LEV 8:3
Thadou: Chuteng leh khopi sunga ami takip ki khopkhomna ponbuh kot phunga chun koukhom soh keiyin, ati.
English: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”

tcz: Chuin Mose’n jong Pathen thupeh bang bang chun na atong in, khopi sunga konin amitakip chu kikhopkhomna ponbuh kot achun ahung kikhom soh tauve.
en: Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
LEV 8:4
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n jong Pathen thupeh bang bang chun na atong in, khopi sunga konin amitakip chu kikhopkhomna ponbuh kot achun ahung kikhom soh tauve.
English: Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Hichun Mose’n jong Mipi hojouse jah a thu aseiyin, hiche hi Pathen in bol dinga thupeh anei ahi.
en: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded to be done.”
text:
LEV 8:5
Thadou: Hichun Mose’n jong Mipi hojouse jah a thu aseiyin, hiche hi Pathen in bol dinga thupeh anei ahi.
English: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded to be done.”

tcz: Aaron le achapate ho Mose’n ahin puitan, abonchauvin tuiyin asiltheng soh tauve.
en: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
text:
LEV 8:6
Thadou: Aaron le achapate ho Mose’n ahin puitan, abonchauvin tuiyin asiltheng soh tauve.
English: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

tcz: Chuin Aaron chu sang khol lah a alenpen chu avonpeh tan, sangkhol chol jong avon peh in, konggah jong agah peh tan ahi, hichu khut them tah a kisem chalchep konggah chu agahpeh in ahi.
en: He put the tunic on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it.
text:
LEV 8:7
Thadou: Chuin Aaron chu sang khol lah a alenpen chu avonpeh tan, sangkhol chol jong avon peh in, konggah jong agah peh tan ahi, hichu khut them tah a kisem chalchep konggah chu agahpeh in ahi.
English: He put the tunic on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it.

tcz: Hiti chun ompho achung a atom peh in, chuin ompho chunga chun vahna le chamkimna akoi lhing sel’in ahi.
en: He placed the breastplate on him. He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate.
text:
LEV 8:8
Thadou: Hiti chun ompho achung a atom peh in, chuin ompho chunga chun vahna le chamkimna akoi lhing sel’in ahi.
English: He placed the breastplate on him. He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate.

tcz: Chuin Mose’n Aaron luchunga del akop peh in, adelkop mailama chun sana pheng lallukhuh akhaipeh tan, Pathen in Mose athupeh bang chun aboltai.
en: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
LEV 8:9
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n Aaron luchunga del akop peh in, adelkop mailama chun sana pheng lallukhuh akhaipeh tan, Pathen in Mose athupeh bang chun aboltai.
English: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Chuin Mose’n tahsaa anu ding thao chu alan, Pathen houbuh le asunga umjouse anu sohkeiyin, thensona aneiyin ahi.
en: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.
text:
LEV 8:10
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n tahsaa anu ding thao chu alan, Pathen houbuh le asunga umjouse anu sohkeiyin, thensona aneiyin ahi.
English: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

tcz: Hichea chu vel sagi jen achap khum ding, maicham leh ama manchah thil jouse jong chu thao achap soh in, kisilna konglen chule atunna jong thaotwi achap in abonchan athenso tan ahi.
en: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.
text:
LEV 8:11
Thadou: Hichea chu vel sagi jen achap khum ding, maicham leh ama manchah thil jouse jong chu thao achap soh in, kisilna konglen chule atunna jong thaotwi achap in abonchan athenso tan ahi.
English: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.

tcz: Thempu Aaron luchunga nu ding in thaotwi helkhat achap khum in, atahsa ajong anun, athenso paitan ahi.
en: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
text:
LEV 8:12
Thadou: Thempu Aaron luchunga nu ding in thaotwi helkhat achap khum in, atahsa ajong anun, athenso paitan ahi.
English: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

tcz: Chuin Aaron chapte ho chu Mose’n ahin puiyin, khat cheh in sangkhol len a ahpeh tauvin; konggah jeng jong gahpeh in aluchang cheh uva lukhuh akhuh peh cheh un, Pathen thupeh bang bang in Mose’n amaho chu khat cheh in abolpeh tauvin ahi.
en: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
LEV 8:13
Thadou: Chuin Aaron chapte ho chu Mose’n ahin puiyin, khat cheh in sangkhol len a ahpeh tauvin; konggah jeng jong gahpeh in aluchang cheh uva lukhuh akhuh peh cheh un, Pathen thupeh bang bang in Mose’n amaho chu khat cheh in abolpeh tauvin ahi.
English: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Hiti chun Chonset maicham thilto ding in, bongchal chu ahin kai luttan, chuin Aaron le achapate hon gancha luchanga chun akhut angam lhasoh keiyun ahi.
en: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.
text:
LEV 8:14
Thadou: Hiti chun Chonset maicham thilto ding in, bongchal chu ahin kai luttan, chuin Aaron le achapate hon gancha luchanga chun akhut angam lhasoh keiyun ahi.
English: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

tcz: Chuin bongchal chu Mose’n athat paiyin, athisan achun akhut jung aphum lut in, maicham phunga saki ho achun achap natsoh keiyin, maicham jong athenso in, ganthisan chu maicham khombul hoa achapnat soh helin, thensona sem in, hiachun kithoina jong aboltan ahi.
en: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.
text:
LEV 8:15
Thadou: Chuin bongchal chu Mose’n athat paiyin, athisan achun akhut jung aphum lut in, maicham phunga saki ho achun achap natsoh keiyin, maicham jong athenso in, ganthisan chu maicham khombul hoa achapnat soh helin, thensona sem in, hiachun kithoina jong aboltan ahi.
English: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.

tcz: Asunga athao jouse achom khen in, athin lah a aphe le athao le akal teni ahin, athao beh jouse jong achom khen in, hiti chun Mose’n maicham achun agouvam tai.
en: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.
text:
LEV 8:16
Thadou: Asunga athao jouse achom khen in, athin lah a aphe le athao le akal teni ahin, athao beh jouse jong achom khen in, hiti chun Mose’n maicham achun agouvam tai.
English: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.

tcz: Hiche bongchal avun atahsa ho chule aeh jaonan, Pathen thupeh bang bang in Mose’n polam ngah mun achun agouvam heltan ahi.
en: But the bull, and its skin, and its meat, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
LEV 8:17
Thadou: Hiche bongchal avun atahsa ho chule aeh jaonan, Pathen thupeh bang bang in Mose’n polam ngah mun achun agouvam heltan ahi.
English: But the bull, and its skin, and its meat, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Chuphat in pumgo maicham thilto ding in kelngoi chal ahin pelut in, hiti chun Aaron le achapaten kelngoi chal chunga chun akhut-u angam soh kei tauvin ahi.
en: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
text:
LEV 8:18
Thadou: Chuphat in pumgo maicham thilto ding in kelngoi chal ahin pelut in, hiti chun Aaron le achapaten kelngoi chal chunga chun akhut-u angam soh kei tauvin ahi.
English: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

tcz: Mose’n kelngoi chal chu athat in, gan thisan chu maicham aning gola achap khum in ahi.
en: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.
text:
LEV 8:19
Thadou: Mose’n kelngoi chal chu athat in, gan thisan chu maicham aning gola achap khum in ahi.
English: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

tcz: Kelngoi chal sa chu asem toh selin, aluchang ahin asa kisem toh sel leh athao abonchan Mose’n meiya agouvam tan ahi.
en: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
text:
LEV 8:20
Thadou: Kelngoi chal sa chu asem toh selin, aluchang ahin asa kisem toh sel leh athao abonchan Mose’n meiya agouvam tan ahi.
English: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

tcz: Gancha sa sung jouse ahin, akeng ahin; abonchan twiya asoptheng soh phat in, Pumgo maicham thiltoa ding in Mose’n kelngoi chal chu agoutan, Pathen thupeh dungjuiyin Mose’n Pathen heng lam adin pumgo thilto namtuisel chu akatdoh in ahi.
en: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
LEV 8:21
Thadou: Gancha sa sung jouse ahin, akeng ahin; abonchan twiya asoptheng soh phat in, Pumgo maicham thiltoa ding in Mose’n kelngoi chal chu agoutan, Pathen thupeh dungjuiyin Mose’n Pathen heng lam adin pumgo thilto namtuisel chu akatdoh in ahi.
English: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Chuin kelngoi chal khatma thensona ding in ahin kailut paiyin, Aaron le achapate hon gancha luchang achun akhut-u angam soh keiyun ahi.
en: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
text:
LEV 8:22
Thadou: Chuin kelngoi chal khatma thensona ding in ahin kailut paiyin, Aaron le achapate hon gancha luchang achun akhut-u angam soh keiyun ahi.
English: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

tcz: Hiti chun Mose’n jong Kelngoi chal thenso na chu athat tan, athisan phabep aladoh in, Aaron bilkol jetlam achun aloipeh in, akhut jetlang khupi achun thisan anupeh in, akeng phang khupia jong chun anupeh in ahi.
en: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.
text:
LEV 8:23
Thadou: Hiti chun Mose’n jong Kelngoi chal thenso na chu athat tan, athisan phabep aladoh in, Aaron bilkol jetlam achun aloipeh in, akhut jetlang khupi achun thisan anupeh in, akeng phang khupia jong chun anupeh in ahi.
English: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

tcz: Hiti chun Aaron chapate abonchauvin ahin puiyin, gan thisan hel khat khat abilkol jet lamu aninggol leh akhut jet lamu khutpi cheh-u ahin, akengphang jetlamu khupi achun anunat peh soh keiyin ahi. Gan thisan chu Mose’n jong maicham kimvela chun athe chap soh hel in ahi.
en: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.
text:
LEV 8:24
Thadou: Hiti chun Aaron chapate abonchauvin ahin puiyin, gan thisan hel khat khat abilkol jet lamu aninggol leh akhut jet lamu khutpi cheh-u ahin, akengphang jetlamu khupi achun anunat peh soh keiyin ahi. Gan thisan chu Mose’n jong maicham kimvela chun athe chap soh hel in ahi.
English: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

tcz: Athao ho jouse ahin, asunga athao ho jouse jaonan, athina aphe um cheng leh athao toh kihal akal teni jaonan, athao chengse chutoh amal jet lam achom khen in,
en: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;

tcz: Pathen angsunga kitung pucha sunga chol jaolou changlhah phengkhat, thao toh kihal chu mang chan, changlhah atum tuma umkhat jong alan, hiche ho jouse chu abonchan sathao holeh samal chunga chun akoiyin,
en: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.
text:
LEV 8:26
Thadou: Pathen angsunga kitung pucha sunga chol jaolou changlhah phengkhat, thao toh kihal chu mang chan, changlhah atum tuma umkhat jong alan, hiche ho jouse chu abonchan sathao holeh samal chunga chun akoiyin,
English: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.

tcz: Chuphat in Aaron le achapate khut a apedoh tan, hichengse chu abonchan Pathen angsunga thensona maicham din thennsona aneiyin ahi.
en: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.
text:
LEV 8:27
Thadou: Chuphat in Aaron le achapate khut a apedoh tan, hichengse chu abonchan Pathen angsunga thensona maicham din thennsona aneiyin ahi.
English: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.

tcz: Hiche ho chu abonchan Mose’n anung lah in, abonchan pumgo maicham thilto toh chun maicham phunga meiyin agouvam tai. Ajeh chu ki thensona maicham ahin, hichu Pathen heng lam adia gimnamtui tah pumgo thilto ahi.
en: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD.
text:
LEV 8:28
Thadou: Hiche ho chu abonchan Mose’n anung lah in, abonchan pumgo maicham thilto toh chun maicham phunga meiyin agouvam tai. Ajeh chu ki thensona maicham ahin, hichu Pathen heng lam adia gimnamtui tah pumgo thilto ahi.
English: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD.

tcz: Aoplhang se chu Mose’n aladoh in, Pathen heng lama thensona thilto din alhan in, hichu Pathen thupeh bang banga Mose’n chanvou anei ding ahi.
en: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
LEV 8:29
Thadou: Aoplhang se chu Mose’n aladoh in, Pathen heng lama thensona thilto din alhan in, hichu Pathen thupeh bang banga Mose’n chanvou anei ding ahi.
English: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Thao phabep khat le gan thisan phabep maicham chunga um chu nu ding in, Mose’n alan Aaron tahsa chung le aposil chung hoa chun achap khum in, Aaron le achapate jouse jaonan, achapate jouse ponsil ahin ama ponsil abonchan thensona aneiyin ahi.
en: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
text:
LEV 8:30
Thadou: Thao phabep khat le gan thisan phabep maicham chunga um chu nu ding in, Mose’n alan Aaron tahsa chung le aposil chung hoa chun achap khum in, Aaron le achapate jouse jaonan, achapate jouse ponsil ahin ama ponsil abonchan thensona aneiyin ahi.
English: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

tcz: Hiti chun Mose’n Aaron chule achapate jouse henga hiti hin aseipeh in, kikhop khomna ponbuh achun sa hi kihon tauvin, ajeh chu Aaron le achapa ten aneh diu ahi, tia ana kiphong doh bang bang achun; khopi phung lam achun sa thensona changlhah pucha sunga um chu naneh diu ahi.
en: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’
text:
LEV 8:31
Thadou: Hiti chun Mose’n Aaron chule achapate jouse henga hiti hin aseipeh in, kikhop khomna ponbuh achun sa hi kihon tauvin, ajeh chu Aaron le achapa ten aneh diu ahi, tia ana kiphong doh bang bang achun; khopi phung lam achun sa thensona changlhah pucha sunga um chu naneh diu ahi.
English: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

tcz: Hichea naneh moh chengseu chu, aboncha sa hihen changlhah hileh meiya nago vam diu ahi.
en: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire.
text:
LEV 8:32
Thadou: Hichea naneh moh chengseu chu, aboncha sa hihen changlhah hileh meiya nago vam diu ahi.
English: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire.

tcz: Chule ni sagi sung sesea koi machan kotpi phung apaltan lou ding, hichu thensona nikho ahung lhun kahsea koi macha pampot louhel ding na hiuve, ajeh chu na kithenso na dinga, na ki suhtheng ngaijah ahi.
en: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.
text:
LEV 8:33
Thadou: Chule ni sagi sung sesea koi machan kotpi phung apaltan lou ding, hichu thensona nikho ahung lhun kahsea koi macha pampot louhel ding na hiuve, ajeh chu na kithenso na dinga, na ki suhtheng ngaijah ahi.
English: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.

tcz: Hichu ahin tunia na kitong banga hi, Pathen in nang ho kithoina sem nadinga thupeh ana nei ahitai.
en: What has been done today, so the LORD has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.
text:
LEV 8:34
Thadou: Hichu ahin tunia na kitong banga hi, Pathen in nang ho kithoina sem nadinga thupeh ana nei ahitai.
English: What has been done today, so the LORD has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangho koihi jongleu chun nisagi sunga hi, ki khopkhomna ponbuh kotpi bula najan ge jeng diu; Pathen thupeh banga ima jouse najui diu, hiche bang bang achu keima jong ngensena eina kipe a ahi.
en: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep the LORD’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”
text:
LEV 8:35
Thadou: Hijeh chun nangho koihi jongleu chun nisagi sunga hi, ki khopkhomna ponbuh kotpi bula najan ge jeng diu; Pathen thupeh banga ima jouse najui diu, hiche bang bang achu keima jong ngensena eina kipe a ahi.
English: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep the LORD’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”

tcz: Chuin Aaron le achapate jousen, Pathen akon Mose’n athupeh bang uchun ijakai abol tauvin ahi.
en: Aaron and his sons did all the things which the LORD commanded by Moses.
text:
LEV 8:36
Thadou: Chuin Aaron le achapate jousen, Pathen akon Mose’n athupeh bang uchun ijakai abol tauvin ahi.
English: Aaron and his sons did all the things which the LORD commanded by Moses.

tcz: Chuin niget lhin nin, Mose’n Aaron chapate chengse le Israelte lah a upa ho akou khom in,
en: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

tcz: Aaron henga hiti hin aseipeh in, chonset maicham thilto ding in bongchal khat gakaiyin, chule pumgo maicham thiltoa toding in kelngoi chal khat ma gakaiyin lang, anitah achu Pathen henga na katdoh a,
en: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before the LORD.
text:
LEV 9:2
Thadou: Aaron henga hiti hin aseipeh in, chonset maicham thilto ding in bongchal khat gakaiyin, chule pumgo maicham thiltoa toding in kelngoi chal khat ma gakaiyin lang, anitah achu Pathen henga na katdoh a,
English: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before the LORD.

tcz: Hitia hi Israel chate henga na seipeh ding, chonset maicham thilto ding in, kelchal khat gakaiyun lang chule pumgo maicham thilto ding in, nolnabei bongnou khat leh kelngoi nou khat nahin kaidiu ahi.
en: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;

tcz: Pathen angsunga chamna maicham ki lhaina thiltoa din, bong chal khat le kelngoi chal khat naga kaidiu; lhosohga maicham thiltoa din changbong thaotwi kichapsa jong jaonan, ajeh chu tuni khoa hi nangho henga Pakai, Pathen hung kilah thei ahi, tin hil’un tin aseiye.
en: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today the LORD appears to you.’”
text:
LEV 9:4
Thadou: Pathen angsunga chamna maicham ki lhaina thiltoa din, bong chal khat le kelngoi chal khat naga kaidiu; lhosohga maicham thiltoa din changbong thaotwi kichapsa jong jaonan, ajeh chu tuni khoa hi nangho henga Pakai, Pathen hung kilah thei ahi, tin hil’un tin aseiye.
English: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today the LORD appears to you.’”

tcz: Hitobang chun amaho jousen Mose akona athu jah bang un, thil jouse chu kikhop khomna ponbuh mailam achun ahin poluh sohtauvin; chuin khopi sung akon japin ahin nailut un, abonchauvin Pathen ansung achun ading soh keiyun ahi.
en: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting. All the congregation came near and stood before the LORD.
text:
LEV 9:5
Thadou: Hitobang chun amaho jousen Mose akona athu jah bang un, thil jouse chu kikhop khomna ponbuh mailam achun ahin poluh sohtauvin; chuin khopi sung akon japin ahin nailut un, abonchauvin Pathen ansung achun ading soh keiyun ahi.
English: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting. All the congregation came near and stood before the LORD.

tcz: Chuin Mose’n ajah uva hiti hin aseipeh in, hitobang thil ho jouse hi Pathen in nang ho natoh dinga napeh doh-u ahitan, hichea chu Pakai, Pathen loupina nangho jal'a naheng uva hung kilah ding ahi.
en: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded that you should do; and the LORD’s glory shall appear to you.”
text:
LEV 9:6
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n ajah uva hiti hin aseipeh in, hitobang thil ho jouse hi Pathen in nang ho natoh dinga napeh doh-u ahitan, hichea chu Pakai, Pathen loupina nangho jal'a naheng uva hung kilah ding ahi.
English: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded that you should do; and the LORD’s glory shall appear to you.”

tcz: Hiti chun Mose’n jong Aaron henga hiti hin aseipeh in, maicham phung lam hin nailut in, chonset maicham thilto nato ding le pumgo maicham thilto nato ding chu hung toh'in lang, hichea chu nangma mimala ding ahin namite jousea ding hijongleh ki thoidamna nasem ding, Pathen thupeh bangmin japin maicham thilto dinga ahin choi chengse chu, hinchoi inlang amaho dia jong kithoidamna nasem peh diu ahi.
en: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as the LORD commanded.”
text:
LEV 9:7
Thadou: Hiti chun Mose’n jong Aaron henga hiti hin aseipeh in, maicham phung lam hin nailut in, chonset maicham thilto nato ding le pumgo maicham thilto nato ding chu hung toh'in lang, hichea chu nangma mimala ding ahin namite jousea ding hijongleh ki thoidamna nasem ding, Pathen thupeh bangmin japin maicham thilto dinga ahin choi chengse chu, hinchoi inlang amaho dia jong kithoidamna nasem peh diu ahi.
English: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as the LORD commanded.”

tcz: Aaron in jong maicham phung lam ahin nailut paiyin, ama mimal kithoi damna dia chonset maicham thilto bongnou chu athat tan ahi.
en: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
text:
LEV 9:8
Thadou: Aaron in jong maicham phung lam ahin nailut paiyin, ama mimal kithoi damna dia chonset maicham thilto bongnou chu athat tan ahi.
English: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

tcz: Gan thisan chu achapaten Aaron henglama ahin choiyun, hichun Aaron in jong gan thisan lah achun akhut jung aphum lut in; chuin maicham ning li saki hoa achun thisan aloinat in, thisan amoh chengse vang chu maicham phunga chun abonchan abolhan ahi.
en: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar;

tcz: Chule hiche chonset maicham thilto gancha thao le akal teni, athin a um aphe chengse chu Mose henga Pathen in anathu peh bang chun maicham chunga meiya agou vam I ahi.
en: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
LEV 9:10
Thadou: Chule hiche chonset maicham thilto gancha thao le akal teni, athin a um aphe chengse chu Mose henga Pathen in anathu peh bang chun maicham chunga meiya agou vam I ahi.
English: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Gancha tahsa le avun chengse vang chu, Aaron in polam mun khat a meiyin agou vam tan ahi.
en: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.
text:
LEV 9:11
Thadou: Gancha tahsa le avun chengse vang chu, Aaron in polam mun khat a meiyin agou vam tan ahi.
English: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.

tcz: Chuban in Pumgo maicham thiltoa kito doh gancha chu athattan, gan thisan chu Aaron chapaten ama heng lama ahin choiyun, hiti chun Aaron in jong maicham phung aning gol gola chun gan thisan chu achap khum soh keiyin ahi.
en: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
text:
LEV 9:12
Thadou: Chuban in Pumgo maicham thiltoa kito doh gancha chu athattan, gan thisan chu Aaron chapaten ama heng lama ahin choiyun, hiti chun Aaron in jong maicham phung aning gol gola chun gan thisan chu achap khum soh keiyin ahi.
English: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.

tcz: Chuin Aaron koma pumgo maicham sa um chu achapate hon asem khen khen un, aluchang jaonan ahin polut un; chuin Aaron in maicham chunga meiyin agou vam in ahi.
en: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.
text:
LEV 9:13
Thadou: Chuin Aaron koma pumgo maicham sa um chu achapate hon asem khen khen un, aluchang jaonan ahin polut un; chuin Aaron in maicham chunga meiyin agou vam in ahi.
English: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.

tcz: Sasung ahin akeng li ho ahin, abonchan Aaron in asop theng in pumgo maicham thilto ahin, abonchan maicham chunga chun meiyin agou vam in ahi.
en: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.
text:
LEV 9:14
Thadou: Sasung ahin akeng li ho ahin, abonchan Aaron in asop theng in pumgo maicham thilto ahin, abonchan maicham chunga chun meiyin agou vam in ahi.
English: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.

tcz: Hiche jouse kichaiyin, Aaron in japi maicham thilto chengse ahin kaiyin, japi dinga ki tohdoh chonset maicham thilto kelcha chu athat in, masanga thilto kibol bang bang chun chonset maicham thilto in apedoh tai.
en: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.
text:
LEV 9:15
Thadou: Hiche jouse kichaiyin, Aaron in japi maicham thilto chengse ahin kaiyin, japi dinga ki tohdoh chonset maicham thilto kelcha chu athat in, masanga thilto kibol bang bang chun chonset maicham thilto in apedoh tai.
English: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.

tcz: Pumgo maicham thilto jong ahin choilut in, dan kisem bang bang chun hiche jong chu akatdoh paiyin ahi.
en: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.
text:
LEV 9:16
Thadou: Pumgo maicham thilto jong ahin choilut in, dan kisem bang bang chun hiche jong chu akatdoh paiyin ahi.
English: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

tcz: Lhosohga akon maicham thilto ding ahin polut'in, maicham thilto ding chu akhut dim in aham doh in, pumgo maicham thilto jingkah seh’a kibolna mun achun agou vam in ahi.
en: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.
text:
LEV 9:17
Thadou: Lhosohga akon maicham thilto ding ahin polut'in, maicham thilto ding chu akhut dim in aham doh in, pumgo maicham thilto jingkah seh’a kibolna mun achun agou vam in ahi.
English: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.

tcz: Chuin Aaron in chamna maicham thilto kilhaina japi ding in, bongchal leh kelngoi athat in, gan thisan chu Aaron chapaten ama henga ahin choiyun ahileh, Aaron in jong gan thisan chu maicham phung gol gola chun achap khum in,
en: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people. Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar;

tcz: Bongchal leh kelngoi achal thaose chu, amei thaolai le asung alap thao jaonan akal teni le aphe um chengse,
en: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver;

tcz: Abonchan athao jouse jaonan aoplhang chungvuma chun akoi uvin, ahin hilah achun athao laise chu meiyin ahalvam un ahi.
en: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.
text:
LEV 9:20
Thadou: Abonchan athao jouse jaonan aoplhang chungvuma chun akoi uvin, ahin hilah achun athao laise chu meiyin ahalvam un ahi.
English: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.

tcz: Aoplhang kah le amal jetlam vang chu, Patheng henga Aaron in athensona maicham thilto din athenso paiyin, hiti chun Mose thupeh bang in aboltai.
en: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses commanded.
text:
LEV 9:21
Thadou: Aoplhang kah le amal jetlam vang chu, Patheng henga Aaron in athensona maicham thilto din athenso paiyin, hiti chun Mose thupeh bang in aboltai.
English: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses commanded.

tcz: Hiche jouse kichai nung in, Aaron in japi lamven phatthei aboh un ahi. Hiti chun hiche maicham thilto ho; chonset maicham thilto, pumgo maicham thilto leh chamna maicham thilto abonchan Pathen henga akatdoh nung chun ama ahung kumsuh tan ahi.
en: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.
text:
LEV 9:22
Thadou: Hiche jouse kichai nung in, Aaron in japi lamven phatthei aboh un ahi. Hiti chun hiche maicham thilto ho; chonset maicham thilto, pumgo maicham thilto leh chamna maicham thilto abonchan Pathen henga akatdoh nung chun ama ahung kumsuh tan ahi.
English: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.

tcz: Kikhop khomna ponbuh sung achun, Mose le Aaron asung lha lhon in, ahung pot doh kit lhon tan, japi chu phatthei aboh pai lhon in, apattah chun japi angsung achun Pathen loupina ahung kilah jeng in ahi.
en: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people; and the LORD’s glory appeared to all the people.
text:
LEV 9:23
Thadou: Kikhop khomna ponbuh sung achun, Mose le Aaron asung lha lhon in, ahung pot doh kit lhon tan, japi chu phatthei aboh pai lhon in, apattah chun japi angsung achun Pathen loupina ahung kilah jeng in ahi.
English: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people; and the LORD’s glory appeared to all the people.

tcz: Hiche pattah chun Pathen angsunga mei akou jeng tan, maicham phunga kikoi sa thao pumgo maicham thilto chu aka lha jeng tai, japin hiche thilsoh amu phat un a-ul lha tauvin, abonchaovin tollhang achun, amaiyu angasoh keiyun akun lha tauvin ahi.
en: Fire came out from before the LORD, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
text:
LEV 9:24
Thadou: Hiche pattah chun Pathen angsunga mei akou jeng tan, maicham phunga kikoi sa thao pumgo maicham thilto chu aka lha jeng tai, japin hiche thilsoh amu phat un a-ul lha tauvin, abonchaovin tollhang achun, amaiyu angasoh keiyun akun lha tauvin ahi.
English: Fire came out from before the LORD, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

tcz: Chule Nadab le Abihu, Aaron chateni chun meibom chu akilah lhon tan, asung achun mei atih kou lhon in, gimnamtui jong akoiluttha lhon in, Pathen thupeh loubeh in achon lhontai, thenna beihel khop in Pathen angsunga chun hiche gimnamtui chu ahal lha lhon in ahi.
en: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he had not commanded them.
text:
LEV 10:1
Thadou: Chule Nadab le Abihu, Aaron chateni chun meibom chu akilah lhon tan, asung achun mei atih kou lhon in, gimnamtui jong akoiluttha lhon in, Pathen thupeh loubeh in achon lhontai, thenna beihel khop in Pathen angsunga chun hiche gimnamtui chu ahal lha lhon in ahi.
English: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he had not commanded them.

tcz: Chuin Meikong hattah Pathen akon in ahung kou doh in, Pathen angsunga chun ani lhon in thina atoh lhon tan ahi.
en: Fire came out from before the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.
text:
LEV 10:2
Thadou: Chuin Meikong hattah Pathen akon in ahung kou doh in, Pathen angsunga chun ani lhon in thina atoh lhon tan ahi.
English: Fire came out from before the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.

tcz: Mose’n jong Aaron henga aseipeh in, hiche hi Pathen in ana thupeh keima heng lam hin nailut chan chu, Keiman jong thengsel'a kakimu sah ding, chitin namtin anga choi-at a kaum ding ahi, tia asei chu ahi, chuin Aaron jong thip chat in aumtai.
en: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what the LORD spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified.’” Aaron held his peace.
text:
LEV 10:3
Thadou: Mose’n jong Aaron henga aseipeh in, hiche hi Pathen in ana thupeh keima heng lam hin nailut chan chu, Keiman jong thengsel'a kakimu sah ding, chitin namtin anga choi-at a kaum ding ahi, tia asei chu ahi, chuin Aaron jong thip chat in aumtai.
English: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what the LORD spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified.’” Aaron held his peace.

tcz: Uzziel chapte ni Mishael le Elzaphan chu Aaron in akou lhon in, ajah lhona hiti hin aseipeh lhon in, muntheng sunga hung lut lhon in nasopite ni longdamsa hi polang ngahmun khat a gathah doh lhon in, ati.
en: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”
text:
LEV 10:4
Thadou: Uzziel chapte ni Mishael le Elzaphan chu Aaron in akou lhon in, ajah lhona hiti hin aseipeh lhon in, muntheng sunga hung lut lhon in nasopite ni longdamsa hi polang ngahmun khat a gathah doh lhon in, ati.
English: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”

tcz: Chuin amanin jong muntheng achun alut lhon in, Mose thupeh bang in asopi teni longdamsa chun asang khol len achun, akhu lhon in polang ngahmun achun apodoh lhon tan ahi.
en: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.
text:
LEV 10:5
Thadou: Chuin amanin jong muntheng achun alut lhon in, Mose thupeh bang in asopi teni longdamsa chun asang khol len achun, akhu lhon in polang ngahmun achun apodoh lhon tan ahi.
English: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.

tcz: Mose’n jong Aaron ahin achapateni Zar chule Ithamar henga hiti hin aseipeh in, na jangtel sam uchu lhaideh a naput louhel diu ahi, hitia chu na ponsil jeng-u jong na kesah lou diu, hichu nanit lou uva ahileh thina na chan jeng thei uahi, chugoh hi louvin na khopi sung uva jong lunghanna kibung lha thei ahi. Pathen lung hanna aso jah khah a ahileh, Israel chate jouse chu kap ding ahiuve.
en: Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, “Don’t let the hair of your heads go loose, and don’t tear your clothes, so that you don’t die, and so that he will not be angry with all the congregation; but let your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD has kindled.
text:
LEV 10:6
Thadou: Mose’n jong Aaron ahin achapateni Zar chule Ithamar henga hiti hin aseipeh in, na jangtel sam uchu lhaideh a naput louhel diu ahi, hitia chu na ponsil jeng-u jong na kesah lou diu, hichu nanit lou uva ahileh thina na chan jeng thei uahi, chugoh hi louvin na khopi sung uva jong lunghanna kibung lha thei ahi. Pathen lung hanna aso jah khah a ahileh, Israel chate jouse chu kap ding ahiuve.
English: Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, “Don’t let the hair of your heads go loose, and don’t tear your clothes, so that you don’t die, and so that he will not be angry with all the congregation; but let your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD has kindled.

tcz: Kikhop khomna ponbuh kotbul chu jabol unlang khokal hih un, hiche jong chu nanit lou uva ahileh thinan naphah diu ahi, ajeh chu nang hohi Pathen adia thaonu chang nahi tauve. Hiti chun Mose’n athupeh bang bang uchun abol tauvin ahi.
en: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of the LORD is on you.” They did according to the word of Moses.
text:
LEV 10:7
Thadou: Kikhop khomna ponbuh kotbul chu jabol unlang khokal hih un, hiche jong chu nanit lou uva ahileh thinan naphah diu ahi, ajeh chu nang hohi Pathen adia thaonu chang nahi tauve. Hiti chun Mose’n athupeh bang bang uchun abol tauvin ahi.
English: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of the LORD is on you.” They did according to the word of Moses.

tcz: Pathen in Aaron henga hiti hin jong aseipeh in,
en: Then the LORD said to Aaron,
text:
LEV 10:8
Thadou: Pathen in Aaron henga hiti hin jong aseipeh in,
English: Then the LORD said to Aaron,

tcz: Kikhop khomna pobuh sung lam nalut ding uva ahileh, na chapate jouse ahin chule nangma tah nahin nabonchauva ju leh khamna thei kitiphot nadon theilou diu ahi, ajeh chu thina na chan jeng thei diu; hijeh chun nakhang nakhang uva najui diuva thupeh ahi.
en: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
text:
LEV 10:9
Thadou: Kikhop khomna pobuh sung lam nalut ding uva ahileh, na chapate jouse ahin chule nangma tah nahin nabonchauva ju leh khamna thei kitiphot nadon theilou diu ahi, ajeh chu thina na chan jeng thei diu; hijeh chun nakhang nakhang uva najui diuva thupeh ahi.
English: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

tcz: Thil theng le thil ijakai athenglou hose chu, na chomkhen sohkei diu, atheng le atheng lou chu datkhen jidan nathep diu ahi.
en: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.
text:
LEV 10:10
Thadou: Thil theng le thil ijakai athenglou hose chu, na chomkhen sohkei diu, atheng le atheng lou chu datkhen jidan nathep diu ahi.
English: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.

tcz: Hiche jeh’a chu Pathen in Isarel chate jouse, Mose mangchaa athusei jouse nun le khan ding dan chengse chu phatah a na seipeh soh kei diu ahi, tin a seipeh in ahi.
en: You are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD has spoken to them by Moses.”
text:
LEV 10:11
Thadou: Hiche jeh’a chu Pathen in Isarel chate jouse, Mose mangchaa athusei jouse nun le khan ding dan chengse chu phatah a na seipeh soh kei diu ahi, tin a seipeh in ahi.
English: You are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD has spoken to them by Moses.”

tcz: Chuin Aaron chapa teni Eleazar le Ithamr adam nalai teni jah chun, Mose’n hiti hin aseipeh lhon in, Pathen adia lhosohga maicham thilto amoh chengse chu chomtup unlang, chol jaolou in maicham phung kom achun netauvin, hichu thil theng lah a achungnung pen ahi.
en: Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons who were left, “Take the meal offering that remains of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without yeast beside the altar; for it is most holy;

tcz: Hiche hi muntheng lai khat a naneh diu ahi, ajeh chu hiche hi Pathen adia pumgo maicham govam dinga thilto lah a kona kihom khena chapateu janaa nangho ding dia a-itih a kichom koi chu ahi. Hiche hi keima tah henga thupeh ahi, ati.
en: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of the LORD made by fire; for so I am commanded.
text:
LEV 10:13
Thadou: Hiche hi muntheng lai khat a naneh diu ahi, ajeh chu hiche hi Pathen adia pumgo maicham govam dinga thilto lah a kona kihom khena chapateu janaa nangho ding dia a-itih a kichom koi chu ahi. Hiche hi keima tah henga thupeh ahi, ati.
English: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of the LORD made by fire; for so I am commanded.

tcz: Hinlah ana kithensosa oplhang le sa amal anakitoh dohsa chu na chapate jouseu le na chanute jouseu janan, muntheng lailung khat a naneh khom diu ahi. Hichengse chu Nangho jouse chule Israel chate jousen chamna maicham thilto kilhaina gancha tha chu ahin, nangho le na chapa teu neh dinga a-itih a thupeh le aki koitup chu ahi.
en: The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they are given as your portion, and your sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.
text:
LEV 10:14
Thadou: Hinlah ana kithensosa oplhang le sa amal anakitoh dohsa chu na chapate jouseu le na chanute jouseu janan, muntheng lailung khat a naneh khom diu ahi. Hichengse chu Nangho jouse chule Israel chate jousen chamna maicham thilto kilhaina gancha tha chu ahin, nangho le na chapa teu neh dinga a-itih a thupeh le aki koitup chu ahi.
English: The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they are given as your portion, and your sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.

tcz: Sa aoplhang le sa amal ana kitoh dohsa chu hin choi unlang, pumgo maicham thilto ahin sathao jaona ahin pohlut diu, chuteng leh Pathen angsunga thensona maicham thilto dinga thensona umding, a-imatih chana dinga hiche maicham thilto jouse chu nangho jaonaa na chapate jouse chan ding ahin, Pathen thupeh bang banga chu umding ahi tin aseipeh in ahi.
en: They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever, as the LORD has commanded.”
text:
LEV 10:15
Thadou: Sa aoplhang le sa amal ana kitoh dohsa chu hin choi unlang, pumgo maicham thilto ahin sathao jaona ahin pohlut diu, chuteng leh Pathen angsunga thensona maicham thilto dinga thensona umding, a-imatih chana dinga hiche maicham thilto jouse chu nangho jaonaa na chapate jouse chan ding ahin, Pathen thupeh bang banga chu umding ahi tin aseipeh in ahi.
English: They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever, as the LORD has commanded.”

tcz: Chuin Chonset maicham thilto kelcha chungchang thua Mose’n kholchilna aneiyin, kelcha chu ana gouvam un ahi. Mose’n jong Aaron chapateni adamna lai Eleazar ahin Ithamar lunghanna achutan, hiti hin aseipeh lhon tai.
en: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burned. He was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, saying,
text:
LEV 10:16
Thadou: Chuin Chonset maicham thilto kelcha chungchang thua Mose’n kholchilna aneiyin, kelcha chu ana gouvam un ahi. Mose’n jong Aaron chapateni adamna lai Eleazar ahin Ithamar lunghanna achutan, hiti hin aseipeh lhon tai.
English: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burned. He was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, saying,

tcz: Chonset maicham thilto chu ipi dinga munthenga naneh lhon lou hitam? Thil lah a atheng chungnungpen nang ni chanvou ahitan, Pathen masanga khopi sung japi thoidamnaa na natoh lhon ding ahitia mopohna sangpen nakipe lhon hilou ham?
en: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
text:
LEV 10:17
Thadou: Chonset maicham thilto chu ipi dinga munthenga naneh lhon lou hitam? Thil lah a atheng chungnungpen nang ni chanvou ahitan, Pathen masanga khopi sung japi thoidamnaa na natoh lhon ding ahitia mopohna sangpen nakipe lhon hilou ham?
English: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?

tcz: Tun ganthisan chu muntheng lailunga akikoi lut tapon, kathu hetsah bang chun nangnin jong muntheng lai lunga chu naneh teitei lhon ding ahi, tin aseipeh lhon in ahi.
en: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.”
text:
LEV 10:18
Thadou: Tun ganthisan chu muntheng lailunga akikoi lut tapon, kathu hetsah bang chun nangnin jong muntheng lai lunga chu naneh teitei lhon ding ahi, tin aseipeh lhon in ahi.
English: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.”

tcz: Aaron in jong Mose henga aseitan, chonset jeh a Pumgo maicham thilto ding chu Pathen angsunga akat lhon in, hiche thilto hi angai ngai ahina laiye, hijeh chun keima tah mo eiki chansah ahi. Tuni hin hiche chonset maicham thilto sa hi kananeh hitaleh, Pathen mitmua san theidol ahidem? tin aseiyin ahi.
en: Aaron spoke to Moses, “Behold, today they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things as these have happened to me. If I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been pleasing in the LORD’s sight?”
text:
LEV 10:19
Thadou: Aaron in jong Mose henga aseitan, chonset jeh a Pumgo maicham thilto ding chu Pathen angsunga akat lhon in, hiche thilto hi angai ngai ahina laiye, hijeh chun keima tah mo eiki chansah ahi. Tuni hin hiche chonset maicham thilto sa hi kananeh hitaleh, Pathen mitmua san theidol ahidem? tin aseiyin ahi.
English: Aaron spoke to Moses, “Behold, today they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things as these have happened to me. If I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been pleasing in the LORD’s sight?”

tcz: Mose’n jong hitia Aaron in ahenga, aseiphat chun alung dam tan ahi.
en: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.
text:
LEV 10:20
Thadou: Mose’n jong hitia Aaron in ahenga, aseiphat chun alung dam tan ahi.
English: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron henga hiti hin, aseipeh lhon in,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,
text:
LEV 11:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron henga hiti hin, aseipeh lhon in,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

tcz: Israel chate henga hiti hin seipeh lhon in, hiti hin chon uhen, hiche ganhing leiset chunga lha le jouse hi naneh thei diuva um ganhing ho chu ahi.
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘These are the living things which you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.
text:
LEV 11:2
Thadou: Israel chate henga hiti hin seipeh lhon in, hiti hin chon uhen, hiche ganhing leiset chunga lha le jouse hi naneh thei diuva um ganhing ho chu ahi.
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘These are the living things which you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.

tcz: Gancha hochu abang atin ni kehkop, atin keh to, chule anehsa akama lhai hochu naneh thei diu gancha ho ahi.
en: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.
text:
LEV 11:3
Thadou: Gancha hochu abang atin ni kehkop, atin keh to, chule anehsa akama lhai hochu naneh thei diu gancha ho ahi.
English: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.

tcz: Gancha atin kika holeh anehsa ihdoh a avela lhai ji hochu, naneh diu hijong leh sangongsao vang naneh theilou diu ahi, ajeh chu anehsa aihdoh a alhai vang'in, atin akika poi. Hitobang gancha hohi nangho dia satheng lou aboh ahi.
en: “‘Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those who part the hoof: the camel, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
text:
LEV 11:4
Thadou: Gancha atin kika holeh anehsa ihdoh a avela lhai ji hochu, naneh diu hijong leh sangongsao vang naneh theilou diu ahi, ajeh chu anehsa aihdoh a alhai vang'in, atin akika poi. Hitobang gancha hohi nangho dia satheng lou aboh ahi.
English: “‘Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those who part the hoof: the camel, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

tcz: Jupi jeng jong athenglou anehsa aihdoh a alhaiji vang'in, atin kika lou ahi.
en: The hyrax, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
text:
LEV 11:5
Thadou: Jupi jeng jong athenglou anehsa aihdoh a alhaiji vang'in, atin kika lou ahi.
English: The hyrax, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

tcz: Talep kiti gan hing jong hi nangho dia aboh ahi, anehsa aihdoh a alhaiji vang'in, atin kika lou ahi.
en: The hare, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
text:
LEV 11:6
Thadou: Talep kiti gan hing jong hi nangho dia aboh ahi, anehsa aihdoh a alhaiji vang'in, atin kika lou ahi.
English: The hare, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

tcz: Gancha lah a vohcha jeng jong hi nang ho dia aboh ahi. Ajeh chu atin kika ahivang in, anehsa kiti aihdoh khapon lhai jong alhai poi.
en: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.
text:
LEV 11:7
Thadou: Gancha lah a vohcha jeng jong hi nang ho dia aboh ahi. Ajeh chu atin kika ahivang in, anehsa kiti aihdoh khapon lhai jong alhai poi.
English: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.

tcz: Hiche gancha hohi tohjong natoh khah lou diu, along jeng ujong nasuh loh lou diu satheng lou aboh ahiuve.
en: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.
text:
LEV 11:8
Thadou: Hiche gancha hohi tohjong natoh khah lou diu, along jeng ujong nasuh loh lou diu satheng lou aboh ahiuve.
English: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.

tcz: Tuilah a cheng ganhing naneh thei diu ho chu ahileh, tuikhanglen le vadunga cheng aving chule alip nei tapou naneh diu ahi.
en: “‘You may eat of all these that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.
text:
LEV 11:9
Thadou: Tuilah a cheng ganhing naneh thei diu ho chu ahileh, tuikhanglen le vadunga cheng aving chule alip nei tapou naneh diu ahi.
English: “‘You may eat of all these that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.

tcz: Ahinlah tuikhanglen le vadunga cheng jouse lah achun ahon hon'a lhakhom hihen, ipi ganhing chu hitaleh alip, aving neilou jouse nang ho dia atheng lou ahi.
en: All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,
text:
LEV 11:10
Thadou: Ahinlah tuikhanglen le vadunga cheng jouse lah achun ahon hon'a lhakhom hihen, ipi ganhing chu hitaleh alip, aving neilou jouse nang ho dia atheng lou ahi.
English: All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,

tcz: Hichengse chu nang ho dia thet umtah'a nagel diu, asa jong naneh louhel diu, athisa jong chu natoh khah louhel diu ahi.
en: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses.
text:
LEV 11:11
Thadou: Hichengse chu nang ho dia thet umtah'a nagel diu, asa jong naneh louhel diu, athisa jong chu natoh khah louhel diu ahi.
English: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses.

tcz: Twi lah'a alipbei le alhaving bei ganhing jouse, nang ho dia atheng lou aboh ahi.
en: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.
text:
LEV 11:12
Thadou: Twi lah'a alipbei le alhaving bei ganhing jouse, nang ho dia atheng lou aboh ahi.
English: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.

tcz: Vachate lah jeng ajong nathet bol diuva ganhing hochu ahileh, hiche hohi nathet bol diu naneh louhel diu ahi: muthong, muvanlai, mu ngaman,
en: “‘You shall detest these among the birds; they shall not be eaten because they are an abomination: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,
text:
LEV 11:13
Thadou: Vachate lah jeng ajong nathet bol diuva ganhing hochu ahileh, hiche hohi nathet bol diu naneh louhel diu ahi: muthong, muvanlai, mu ngaman,
English: “‘You shall detest these among the birds; they shall not be eaten because they are an abomination: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

tcz: Ipi mu hijong leh mubong hijong leh,
en: the red kite, any kind of black kite,
text:
LEV 11:14
Thadou: Ipi mu hijong leh mubong hijong leh,
English: the red kite, any kind of black kite,

tcz: Vangah hijong leh,
en: any kind of raven,
text:
LEV 11:15
Thadou: Vangah hijong leh,
English: any kind of raven,

tcz: Va ngongsang ahin, Bahpi ahin, twiva, itobang va hihen muvanlai jouse jaonan
en: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,
text:
LEV 11:16
Thadou: Va ngongsang ahin, Bahpi ahin, twiva, itobang va hihen muvanlai jouse jaonan
English: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

tcz: Sumbupi ahin, vatot muhsao ahin, twi vahong ahin,
en: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,
text:
LEV 11:17
Thadou: Sumbupi ahin, vatot muhsao ahin, twi vahong ahin,
English: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,

tcz: Twi va-ah ahin, vatot kamkabah ahin, muthong,
en: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,
text:
LEV 11:18
Thadou: Twi va-ah ahin, vatot kamkabah ahin, muthong,
English: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,

tcz: Twilungva ahin, ipiva hileh twi vakang jouse jaonan, sel ehva leh bah,
en: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.
text:
LEV 11:19
Thadou: Twilungva ahin, ipiva hileh twi vakang jouse jaonan, sel ehva leh bah,
English: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.

tcz: Alha neiya akenglia lamjot ganhing kiti phot, nangho dia thet umtah ganhing ahi.
