en: “‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.
text:
LEV 11:20
Thadou: Alha neiya akenglia lamjot ganhing kiti phot, nangho dia thet umtah ganhing ahi.
English: “‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.

tcz: Alha neiya akeng lia lam ajot jing vang chun, tol'a achop le achut le nathei akeng jung nei ho vang chu nang hon naneh thei diu ahinai.
en: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on the earth.
text:
LEV 11:21
Thadou: Alha neiya akeng lia lam ajot jing vang chun, tol'a achop le achut le nathei akeng jung nei ho vang chu nang hon naneh thei diu ahinai.
English: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on the earth.

tcz: Nangho neh thei ding chu hicheng se hi ahi: khaokho naneh thei diu, mul neilou khaokho hovang naneh lou diu, khongbai naneh thei diu, khaokhopi jat chengse naneh diu ahi.
en: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.
text:
LEV 11:22
Thadou: Nangho neh thei ding chu hicheng se hi ahi: khaokho naneh thei diu, mul neilou khaokho hovang naneh lou diu, khongbai naneh thei diu, khaokhopi jat chengse naneh diu ahi.
English: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.

tcz: Amavang tol'a vah akeng li um, lhaving neiya lengthei kit ganhing kiti jouse chu nangho dia thet um ahi.
en: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.
text:
LEV 11:23
Thadou: Amavang tol'a vah akeng li um, lhaving neiya lengthei kit ganhing kiti jouse chu nangho dia thet um ahi.
English: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.

tcz: Hiche hoa chu na kisuh boh thei diu ahi, akimin phah chengse hi nalah uva koi hijong leh, atongkha chu aboh ahin hichu nilhah geiya aboh a um ding ahi.
en: “‘By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 11:24
Thadou: Hiche hoa chu na kisuh boh thei diu ahi, akimin phah chengse hi nalah uva koi hijong leh, atongkha chu aboh ahin hichu nilhah geiya aboh a um ding ahi.
English: “‘By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Koi hijong leh hiche ganhing thisa tongkhaa kipoh aum khah leh, aponsil akisop theng ding nilhah geiya amachu aboh a um ding ahi.
en: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 11:25
Thadou: Koi hijong leh hiche ganhing thisa tongkhaa kipoh aum khah leh, aponsil akisop theng ding nilhah geiya amachu aboh a um ding ahi.
English: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Chule gancha tin kika neiya hinlah atin teni khe lhalouva, anehsa ihdoh kit a lhai kit lou gancha chu nang hodia aboh atheng lou ahi, koi hileh hiche gancha tongkha chan chu aboh a um ding ahi.
en: “‘Every animal which has a split hoof that isn’t completely divided, or doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.
text:
LEV 11:26
Thadou: Chule gancha tin kika neiya hinlah atin teni khe lhalouva, anehsa ihdoh kit a lhai kit lou gancha chu nang hodia aboh atheng lou ahi, koi hileh hiche gancha tongkha chan chu aboh a um ding ahi.
English: “‘Every animal which has a split hoof that isn’t completely divided, or doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.

tcz: Sa ho lah a akeng lia lamjot hihen, akengpeh tollhang chon jouse hijong leh, nang ho dia hichengse jong hi aboh a kisim ahi. koi hijong leu chun hiche sa thilong thamkha chan chu, nilhum geiya aboh a um ding ahi.
en: Whatever goes on its paws, among all animals that go on all fours, they are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 11:27
Thadou: Sa ho lah a akeng lia lamjot hihen, akengpeh tollhang chon jouse hijong leh, nang ho dia hichengse jong hi aboh a kisim ahi. koi hijong leu chun hiche sa thilong thamkha chan chu, nilhum geiya aboh a um ding ahi.
English: Whatever goes on its paws, among all animals that go on all fours, they are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Chule hitobang saboh tham kha chun aponsil akisop thenga, nilhum geiya aboh a um ding ahi, ajeh chu hichengse hi nangho dia atheng lou aboh a kisim jeng ding ahi.
en: He who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to you.
text:
LEV 11:28
Thadou: Chule hitobang saboh tham kha chun aponsil akisop thenga, nilhum geiya aboh a um ding ahi, ajeh chu hichengse hi nangho dia atheng lou aboh a kisim jeng ding ahi.
English: He who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to you.

tcz: Ahon hon'a lha khoma kiloikhom ganhing leiset chunga lha hichengse jong hi aboh ahi. Khoili ahin, jucha ahin, thangkip pi ahin, thangkip to kibangse ahin,
en: “‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,
text:
LEV 11:29
Thadou: Ahon hon'a lha khoma kiloikhom ganhing leiset chunga lha hichengse jong hi aboh ahi. Khoili ahin, jucha ahin, thangkip pi ahin, thangkip to kibangse ahin,
English: “‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,

tcz: Daidep ahin, Tang, Thangkip, Taangnam, jucha thangkip hichengse hi ahi.
en: the gecko, and the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.
text:
LEV 11:30
Thadou: Daidep ahin, Tang, Thangkip, Taangnam, jucha thangkip hichengse hi ahi.
English: the gecko, and the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.

tcz: Ahon hon'a lha ganhing hichengse chu aboh a um ding ahi, hicheng se hi athiteng leh nalah uva koihijong leu chun athilong tong kha aum leh, ama chu nilhum geiya aboh a umding ahi.
en: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 11:31
Thadou: Ahon hon'a lha ganhing hichengse chu aboh a um ding ahi, hicheng se hi athiteng leh nalah uva koihijong leu chun athilong tong kha aum leh, ama chu nilhum geiya aboh a umding ahi.
English: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Hiche ganhing hose hi athiteng ahung kipai lhah namuna aho khah pen pen chu thinglom lah hihen, ponsil chung hihen, savun chung hihen, dip chunga hijong leh, manchah jat chom choma kimang bel chung hijong leh, aho khah pen pen chu aboh a um ding, aho khah penpa chu nilhuma aboh ahitan, nilhum tengleh amapa chu kisutheng thei ding ahi.
en: Anything they fall on when they are dead shall be unclean; whether it is any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel it is, with which any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening. Then it will be clean.
text:
LEV 11:32
Thadou: Hiche ganhing hose hi athiteng ahung kipai lhah namuna aho khah pen pen chu thinglom lah hihen, ponsil chung hihen, savun chung hihen, dip chunga hijong leh, manchah jat chom choma kimang bel chung hijong leh, aho khah pen pen chu aboh a um ding, aho khah penpa chu nilhuma aboh ahitan, nilhum tengleh amapa chu kisutheng thei ding ahi.
English: Anything they fall on when they are dead shall be unclean; whether it is any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel it is, with which any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening. Then it will be clean.

tcz: Hitia ch ganhing aboh hose chu hetman louva leibel sung ahung ho lut khah tah a ahileh, hiche belsunga umjouse jaonaa chu atheng lou ahitan, aleibel jeng jong chu na tekeh diu ahi.
en: Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls and all that is in it shall be unclean. You shall break it.
text:
LEV 11:33
Thadou: Hitia ch ganhing aboh hose chu hetman louva leibel sung ahung ho lut khah tah a ahileh, hiche belsunga umjouse jaonaa chu atheng lou ahitan, aleibel jeng jong chu na tekeh diu ahi.
English: Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls and all that is in it shall be unclean. You shall break it.

tcz: Neh ding hijong leh hichu twiya sopngim thei ahitapon, athenglou aboh a um ding ahi. Hiche leibel sunga twi uma donkha aum khah a ahileh, ama jong chu twi aboh banga aboh a um ding ahi.
en: All food which may be eaten which is soaked in water shall be unclean. All drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
text:
LEV 11:34
Thadou: Neh ding hijong leh hichu twiya sopngim thei ahitapon, athenglou aboh a um ding ahi. Hiche leibel sunga twi uma donkha aum khah a ahileh, ama jong chu twi aboh banga aboh a um ding ahi.
English: All food which may be eaten which is soaked in water shall be unclean. All drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

tcz: Hitia chu hiche ganhing ho chun athijoua ahokhah pen pen chu atheng louva um ding, meithuh ahin, thaomei bom ho lah ahin, ahokhah pen pen chu tekah ding ahi, ajeh chu hiche manchah thil jouse chu aboh ahitan, nangho dia jong atheng loua pang ahitai.
en: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.
text:
LEV 11:35
Thadou: Hitia chu hiche ganhing ho chun athijoua ahokhah pen pen chu atheng louva um ding, meithuh ahin, thaomei bom ho lah ahin, ahokhah pen pen chu tekah ding ahi, ajeh chu hiche manchah thil jouse chu aboh ahitan, nangho dia jong atheng loua pang ahitai.
English: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.

tcz: Itobang khat a twinah le twisam putdoh namun ahikhah levang hichu athenga um ding ahinai, hinlah thil dang tongkha pen pen chu ganhing aboh bang banga chu aboh atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean, but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean.
text:
LEV 11:36
Thadou: Itobang khat a twinah le twisam putdoh namun ahikhah levang hichu athenga um ding ahinai, hinlah thil dang tongkha pen pen chu ganhing aboh bang banga chu aboh atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean, but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean.

tcz: Chule hitobang ganhing ho chun muchi tudia kikoi, hiche ganhing athisa neokhat touin atoh khah a ahileh, hiche muchi tuding chu athenga um ding ahi.
en: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.
text:
LEV 11:37
Thadou: Chule hitobang ganhing ho chun muchi tudia kikoi, hiche ganhing athisa neokhat touin atoh khah a ahileh, hiche muchi tuding chu athenga um ding ahi.
English: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.

tcz: Hiche muchi tuding chu twiya kichop nousa ahileh, hiche ganhing atheng lou thilong in ahokhah tah jeh a chu, hiche muchi tuding chu nangho dia atheng lou ahi.
en: But if water is put on the seed, and part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.
text:
LEV 11:38
Thadou: Hiche muchi tuding chu twiya kichop nousa ahileh, hiche ganhing atheng lou thilong in ahokhah tah jeh a chu, hiche muchi tuding chu nangho dia atheng lou ahi.
English: But if water is put on the seed, and part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.

tcz: Naneh ngaiyu gancha khattou athi khah a ahileh, hiche gancha thilong tongkha pen pen chu koi hijongleu chun nilhum keiya atheng loua um ding ahi.
en: “‘If any animal of which you may eat dies, he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 11:39
Thadou: Naneh ngaiyu gancha khattou athi khah a ahileh, hiche gancha thilong tongkha pen pen chu koi hijongleu chun nilhum keiya atheng loua um ding ahi.
English: “‘If any animal of which you may eat dies, he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Hiche gancha thikamsa nekha chan chun aponsil akisop ngim ding, hinlah amachu nilhum geiya athenglou aboh ahitai. Hiche bang achu koi hijong leu chun nalah uva hiche ganthikam pole apang aum khah leh, ama chun aponsil akisop ngima nilhum kahsea atheng loua um ding ahi.
en: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 11:40
Thadou: Hiche gancha thikamsa nekha chan chun aponsil akisop ngim ding, hinlah amachu nilhum geiya athenglou aboh ahitai. Hiche bang achu koi hijong leu chun nalah uva hiche ganthikam pole apang aum khah leh, ama chun aponsil akisop ngima nilhum kahsea atheng loua um ding ahi.
English: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Chule ganhing ahon hon'a lhakhom chele jouse chu, nanghon napam paidiu ahi, hichengse chu naneh thei louhel diu ahi.
en: “‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.
text:
LEV 11:41
Thadou: Chule ganhing ahon hon'a lhakhom chele jouse chu, nanghon napam paidiu ahi, hichengse chu naneh thei louhel diu ahi.
English: “‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.

tcz: Ganhing aop a kithol lea, akeng li neiya aoipoh a kithol, keng tamtah neiya kithol jaonaa ahon hon'a kithol khom hojong naneh lou diu, ajeh chu thet umtah ganhing ahiuve.
en: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
text:
LEV 11:42
Thadou: Ganhing aop a kithol lea, akeng li neiya aoipoh a kithol, keng tamtah neiya kithol jaonaa ahon hon'a kithol khom hojong naneh lou diu, ajeh chu thet umtah ganhing ahiuve.
English: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

tcz: Hitobang ganhing aop a kithol ahon hon'a lhakhom hochu, tohjong natoh khah lou diu hichea kona chu dalbola naum lou nadiu ahi; hichengsea kon chun kisu boh hih hel un, hijeh chun naboh nalou diuvin um cheh un.
en: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them.
text:
LEV 11:43
Thadou: Hitobang ganhing aop a kithol ahon hon'a lhakhom hochu, tohjong natoh khah lou diu hichea kona chu dalbola naum lou nadiu ahi; hichengsea kon chun kisu boh hih hel un, hijeh chun naboh nalou diuvin um cheh un.
English: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima hi nang ho jouse Pathen chu ka hin, keima kathen banga nang ho jong nathen diu, hijeh chun vannoi leiset a aop a kithol ganhing akona nakiven doh uva nakisuh boh lou diu ahi.
en: For I am the LORD your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.
text:
LEV 11:44
Thadou: Ajeh chu keima hi nang ho jouse Pathen chu ka hin, keima kathen banga nang ho jong nathen diu, hijeh chun vannoi leiset a aop a kithol ganhing akona nakiven doh uva nakisuh boh lou diu ahi.
English: For I am the LORD your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.

tcz: Hicheng ho jouse chung achu keima tah nangho jouse Pathen ka hi jeh in, nangho jouse Egypt gam'a kona nahin puidoh pau Pakai kahi, keima kathen bang banga hi nangho jong nathen diu ahi.
en: For I am the LORD who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
text:
LEV 11:45
Thadou: Hicheng ho jouse chung achu keima tah nangho jouse Pathen ka hi jeh in, nangho jouse Egypt gam'a kona nahin puidoh pau Pakai kahi, keima kathen bang banga hi nangho jong nathen diu ahi.
English: For I am the LORD who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

tcz: Tua na heng uva kisei hi ahileh, sa ahin, vacha ahin, twi lah'a cheng ganhing namkim ahin, twi lah'a kithol jouse ahin, leiset chunga ahon hon'a lhakhoma ganhing ho ahin chule achungchang cheh uva dan um ahin,
en: “‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,
text:
LEV 11:46
Thadou: Tua na heng uva kisei hi ahileh, sa ahin, vacha ahin, twi lah'a cheng ganhing namkim ahin, twi lah'a kithol jouse ahin, leiset chunga ahon hon'a lhakhoma ganhing ho ahin chule achungchang cheh uva dan um ahin,
English: “‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,

tcz: Hiche ganhing ho jouse lah akona chu atheng le athenglou dat khen nadinga, neh thei ding le nehthei lou ding thudola dan kisem ahi.
en: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.’”
text:
LEV 11:47
Thadou: Hiche ganhing ho jouse lah akona chu atheng le athenglou dat khen nadinga, neh thei ding le nehthei lou ding thudola dan kisem ahi.
English: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.’”

tcz: Hiti hin Pakaiyin, Mose henga thu aseipeh in,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 12:1
Thadou: Hiti hin Pakaiyin, Mose henga thu aseipeh in,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jouse jah a hiti hin seipeh in, Numei khat in nao avop a anavah lhah a nao chu pasal ahileh, hiche numeinu chu athi neipet banga, ni sagi sung aboh a um ding ahi.
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a woman conceives, and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her monthly period she shall be unclean.
text:
LEV 12:2
Thadou: Israel chate jouse jah a hiti hin seipeh in, Numei khat in nao avop a anavah lhah a nao chu pasal ahileh, hiche numeinu chu athi neipet banga, ni sagi sung aboh a um ding ahi.
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a woman conceives, and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her monthly period she shall be unclean.

tcz: Hitobanga chu niget lhinni le, achapa chu chep kitan ding ahi.
en: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
text:
LEV 12:3
Thadou: Hitobanga chu niget lhinni le, achapa chu chep kitan ding ahi.
English: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

tcz: Chujouteng hiche numeinu chu athisana kona thenso kinbolna dinga, nisom thumle nithum hitia chu um ding; hiche nikho kitipna nikho sunga chu hiche numeinu chun thiltheng khat jong atoh khah lou ding, houin munthenga jong lutlou ding ahi.
en: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.
text:
LEV 12:4
Thadou: Chujouteng hiche numeinu chu athisana kona thenso kinbolna dinga, nisom thumle nithum hitia chu um ding; hiche nikho kitipna nikho sunga chu hiche numeinu chun thiltheng khat jong atoh khah lou ding, houin munthenga jong lutlou ding ahi.
English: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.

tcz: Hiche numei chun cha ahin a numei ahileh, athi neiphat bang banga hapta ni kah atheng loua um ding; chujouteng athisana kona thenso nadia nisom le nigup angai banga anga ding ahi.
en: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her period; and she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days.
text:
LEV 12:5
Thadou: Hiche numei chun cha ahin a numei ahileh, athi neiphat bang banga hapta ni kah atheng loua um ding; chujouteng athisana kona thenso nadia nisom le nigup angai banga anga ding ahi.
English: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her period; and she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days.

tcz: Chapa pen dol hihen lang chanu pen dola hijong leh, jechan ding numeinu kithensona nikho jat alhin teng, hiche numeinu chun kikhop khomna ponbuh kotbula chu, thempu henga pumgo maicham thilto dinga kum khat lhing kelngoi ahin kai ding, chule chonset maicham thilto dinga vapal nou ahin choi thading ahi.
en: “‘When the days of her purification are completed for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting, a year old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove, for a sin offering.
text:
LEV 12:6
Thadou: Chapa pen dol hihen lang chanu pen dola hijong leh, jechan ding numeinu kithensona nikho jat alhin teng, hiche numeinu chun kikhop khomna ponbuh kotbula chu, thempu henga pumgo maicham thilto dinga kum khat lhing kelngoi ahin kai ding, chule chonset maicham thilto dinga vapal nou ahin choi thading ahi.
English: “‘When the days of her purification are completed for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting, a year old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove, for a sin offering.

tcz: Chuteng numei naosen neinu dia thempu pan kithoina dinga Pakai henga akatdoh peh ding, chule numei nu chu athisan lonna akona athenga umbep ding ahi. Hiche dan hi numei chanu le chapa hing thei jouse dinga dan ahi.
en: He shall offer it before the LORD, and make atonement for her; then she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. “‘This is the law for her who bears, whether a male or a female.
text:
LEV 12:7
Thadou: Chuteng numei naosen neinu dia thempu pan kithoina dinga Pakai henga akatdoh peh ding, chule numei nu chu athisan lonna akona athenga umbep ding ahi. Hiche dan hi numei chanu le chapa hing thei jouse dinga dan ahi.
English: He shall offer it before the LORD, and make atonement for her; then she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. “‘This is the law for her who bears, whether a male or a female.

tcz: Hiche numei chanei nuchun kelngoinou anei louva ahileh, vakhu nou ni pumgo maicham thiltoa anei ding, hiche lah a adang khat chu chonset maicham thiltoa ding, chuteng thempu pan amanu dinga kithoina asempeh a athenga um ding ahi.
en: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’”
text:
LEV 12:8
Thadou: Hiche numei chanei nuchun kelngoinou anei louva ahileh, vakhu nou ni pumgo maicham thiltoa anei ding, hiche lah a adang khat chu chonset maicham thiltoa ding, chuteng thempu pan amanu dinga kithoina asempeh a athenga um ding ahi.
English: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron henga, hiti hin thu aseipeh lhon in.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
text:
LEV 13:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron henga, hiti hin thu aseipeh lhon in.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

tcz: Koitobang khat chu atahsa vun pomdoh aboldoh ham, ahilouleh adul doh a ham auma ahileh, hiche natna akona chu avun ahung pat doh a, ahung phah lha dia ginmo ahileh, amapa chu thempupa Aaron kom ham ahilouleh achapate thempu ho heng lama puiding ahi.
en: “When a man shall have a swelling in his body’s skin, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes in the skin of his body the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.
text:
LEV 13:2
Thadou: Koitobang khat chu atahsa vun pomdoh aboldoh ham, ahilouleh adul doh a ham auma ahileh, hiche natna akona chu avun ahung pat doh a, ahung phah lha dia ginmo ahileh, amapa chu thempupa Aaron kom ham ahilouleh achapate thempu ho heng lama puiding ahi.
English: “When a man shall have a swelling in his body’s skin, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes in the skin of his body the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.

tcz: Chuteng thempu pan atahsa pat laichu avet peh ding, hiche atipat laiya amulse chu akan tom ding, chule hiche atahsa pat laichu atahsa vunpotho sanga asunglut joham khat akimu leh, hitobang tipat natna chu aphah veiya ahi; thempu pan ama chu avet lhah ding, hitobang natna nei mihem chu thempu pan ama hi aphah ahin abohtai, aphondoh ding ahi.
en: The priest shall examine the plague in the skin of the body. If the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the body’s skin, it is the plague of leprosy; so the priest shall examine him and pronounce him unclean.
text:
LEV 13:3
Thadou: Chuteng thempu pan atahsa pat laichu avet peh ding, hiche atipat laiya amulse chu akan tom ding, chule hiche atahsa pat laichu atahsa vunpotho sanga asunglut joham khat akimu leh, hitobang tipat natna chu aphah veiya ahi; thempu pan ama chu avet lhah ding, hitobang natna nei mihem chu thempu pan ama hi aphah ahin abohtai, aphondoh ding ahi.
English: The priest shall examine the plague in the skin of the body. If the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the body’s skin, it is the plague of leprosy; so the priest shall examine him and pronounce him unclean.

tcz: Atipat lai avunbeh chu akan chah ding, akang laichu avun tho sunga alut loulai leh, atahsaa amul jong akan chah loulai ahileh, hiche natna neipa chu thempu pan nisagi sunga angai banga ajehsah ding,
en: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and its hair hasn’t turned white, then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.
text:
LEV 13:4
Thadou: Atipat lai avunbeh chu akan chah ding, akang laichu avun tho sunga alut loulai leh, atahsaa amul jong akan chah loulai ahileh, hiche natna neipa chu thempu pan nisagi sunga angai banga ajehsah ding,
English: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and its hair hasn’t turned white, then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.

tcz: Chule nisagi lhinni leh thempu pan avela avet lhah kit ding, chuteng thempupa mitmu changa anat chu a oldoma, ati pat jeng jong avun beh dang hoa achalbe tahlouva ahileh, hiche natna neipa chu thempu pan ni sagi sung vet a akoi ding ahi.
en: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. Behold, if in his eyes the plague is arrested and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days.
text:
LEV 13:5
Thadou: Chule nisagi lhinni leh thempu pan avela avet lhah kit ding, chuteng thempupa mitmu changa anat chu a oldoma, ati pat jeng jong avun beh dang hoa achalbe tahlouva ahileh, hiche natna neipa chu thempu pan ni sagi sung vet a akoi ding ahi.
English: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. Behold, if in his eyes the plague is arrested and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days.

tcz: Ni sagi ahung lhin kit nikho tengleh thempu pan natna neipa chu avela avet lhah kit ding, atipat na chu avom doh a, atahsa chung dang hoa atipat chu achalbe tah louva ahileh, amapa chu thempu pan akisutheng ahitai, tia phondohna anei ding ahi. Hiche tipat chu tahsa chung boldoh tobang ahin, hiche natna neipa tipat neipa chun, aponsil ho akisop theng ding chuteng athenga um thei ding ahi.
en: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day. Behold, if the plague has faded and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It is a scab. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
text:
LEV 13:6
Thadou: Ni sagi ahung lhin kit nikho tengleh thempu pan natna neipa chu avela avet lhah kit ding, atipat na chu avom doh a, atahsa chung dang hoa atipat chu achalbe tah louva ahileh, amapa chu thempu pan akisutheng ahitai, tia phondohna anei ding ahi. Hiche tipat chu tahsa chung boldoh tobang ahin, hiche natna neipa tipat neipa chun, aponsil ho akisop theng ding chuteng athenga um thei ding ahi.
English: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day. Behold, if the plague has faded and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It is a scab. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

English: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it, then the itch is healed. He is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean.

en: “When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots,
text:
LEV 13:38
Thadou: Pasal hileh numei hileh atahsa chung aboldoh a, akang ahung sohdoh a duldoh khat tou anei khah leh,
English: “When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots,

tcz: Ahung boldoh lai chu vet lhahna thempupan anei ding, atahsa dullai chu akan dup hela, ati chunga kona soh maimai ahivang leh, hichu avunthoa hung kimu chen ahitan, hiche pachu athenga um ding ahi.
en: then the priest shall examine them. Behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash. It has broken out in the skin. He is clean.
text:
LEV 13:39
Thadou: Ahung boldoh lai chu vet lhahna thempupan anei ding, atahsa dullai chu akan dup hela, ati chunga kona soh maimai ahivang leh, hichu avunthoa hung kimu chen ahitan, hiche pachu athenga um ding ahi.
English: then the priest shall examine them. Behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash. It has broken out in the skin. He is clean.

tcz: Mihem koitobang khat chu, alujang sam pullha chai keiya auma alu kisan atolleua ahileh, amapa chu atheng ahi.
en: “If a man’s hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.
text:
LEV 13:40
Thadou: Mihem koitobang khat chu, alujang sam pullha chai keiya auma alu kisan atolleua ahileh, amapa chu atheng ahi.
English: “If a man’s hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.

tcz: Chule mikhat tou achal sam jouse apullhah a, alujang sam jouse apul lhah a adetol leuva leh amapa chu atheng ahi.
en: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, his forehead is bald. He is clean.
text:
LEV 13:41
Thadou: Chule mikhat tou achal sam jouse apullhah a, alujang sam jouse apul lhah a adetol leuva leh amapa chu atheng ahi.
English: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, his forehead is bald. He is clean.

tcz: Adetol lai ahin achal sam tollai ahin, hiche beh a kona chu avun san tobang ahung dul doh a ahileh, hitobang natna chu asung lama kona tithah natna hung sohdoh ahin, hichu adeh tollai le achalsam tollai achu hung sohdoh ahi.
en: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead.
text:
LEV 13:42
Thadou: Adetol lai ahin achal sam tollai ahin, hiche beh a kona chu avun san tobang ahung dul doh a ahileh, hitobang natna chu asung lama kona tithah natna hung sohdoh ahin, hichu adeh tollai le achalsam tollai achu hung sohdoh ahi.
English: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead.

tcz: Chuteng thempu pan amapa chu avet lhah ding, adeh tollai ham achal sam tollai mun hama, tin ahung sohdoh chu, tahsa chunga tithah natna banga agel khah tah leh,
en: Then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the swelling of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the body,
text:
LEV 13:43
Thadou: Chuteng thempu pan amapa chu avet lhah ding, adeh tollai ham achal sam tollai mun hama, tin ahung sohdoh chu, tahsa chunga tithah natna banga agel khah tah leh,
English: Then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the swelling of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the body,

tcz: Hiche pachu aphah ahitan, atheng louva ahitai, tia aphondoh ding, hiche pa chun alujang chunga natna chu akipoh ding ahitai.
en: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head.
text:
LEV 13:44
Thadou: Hiche pachu aphah ahitan, atheng louva ahitai, tia aphondoh ding, hiche pa chun alujang chunga natna chu akipoh ding ahitai.
English: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head.

tcz: Hitobang natna tithah vei mi chun ponse jong akisil ding, alujang sam aput lhai ding, amuh chung geiya pon'a aki toma, aboh, aboh tia penga asap ding ahi.
en: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’
text:
LEV 13:45
Thadou: Hitobang natna tithah vei mi chun ponse jong akisil ding, alujang sam aput lhai ding, amuh chung geiya pon'a aki toma, aboh, aboh tia penga asap ding ahi.
English: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’

tcz: Ama tobanga natna nei mihem chun, adammo sungsea atheng louva um ding ahi, ajeh chu aboh ahitan, amachu achangseh'a polam ngahmun tiphah ho umna muna cheng ding ahi.
en: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. His dwelling shall be outside of the camp.
text:
LEV 13:46
Thadou: Ama tobanga natna nei mihem chun, adammo sungsea atheng louva um ding ahi, ajeh chu aboh ahitan, amachu achangseh'a polam ngahmun tiphah ho umna muna cheng ding ahi.
English: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. His dwelling shall be outside of the camp.

tcz: Ponsil dunga tithah natna anat khah tah a ahileh: samul pon hihen, tupat ponnem hileh,
en: “The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it is a woolen garment, or a linen garment;

tcz: Adung le avaiya kikhong tupet ponnem hihen, samul pon hihen, savun hihen ipi savun a kisem hijong leh,
en: whether it is in warp or woof; of linen or of wool; whether in leather, or in anything made of leather;

tcz: Hiche ponsil chunga chu tina maha ahung dul liuva, asan jong ahung sodoh a ahileh, hiche ponsil chu man lutah a adung avai kipheh a kikhong hijong leh, savuna kikhong hihen ipi savuna ponsil kikhong hijong leh, hiche natna chu tithah phah natna ahin, thempupa heng lama puiya vetsah ding ahi.
en: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the leather, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything made of leather; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest.
text:
LEV 13:49
Thadou: Hiche ponsil chunga chu tina maha ahung dul liuva, asan jong ahung sodoh a ahileh, hiche ponsil chu man lutah a adung avai kipheh a kikhong hijong leh, savuna kikhong hihen ipi savuna ponsil kikhong hijong leh, hiche natna chu tithah phah natna ahin, thempupa heng lama puiya vetsah ding ahi.
English: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the leather, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything made of leather; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest.

tcz: Thempu pan anatna chu avet lhah soh keijya, hiche natna vei mihem chu nisagi sung vet a um ding ahi.
en: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.
text:
LEV 13:50
Thadou: Thempu pan anatna chu avet lhah soh keijya, hiche natna vei mihem chu nisagi sung vet a um ding ahi.
English: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.

tcz: Ni sagi lhin nikho tengleh thempupan avela vet lhahna anei kit ding, hichea jong chu anatna posila achalbe nalai leh, aponsil chu adung avaiya kipheh a chalchep a kikhong hihen, savun thoa kikhong hihen, ipi tobang hihen, savun jat jat a kikhong hijong leh, anatna chu tiphah natna ahin, hijeh achu aponsil pen pen chu atheng lou ahitai.
en: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever use the skin is used for, the plague is a destructive mildew. It is unclean.
text:
LEV 13:51
Thadou: Ni sagi lhin nikho tengleh thempupan avela vet lhahna anei kit ding, hichea jong chu anatna posila achalbe nalai leh, aponsil chu adung avaiya kipheh a chalchep a kikhong hihen, savun thoa kikhong hihen, ipi tobang hihen, savun jat jat a kikhong hijong leh, anatna chu tiphah natna ahin, hijeh achu aponsil pen pen chu atheng lou ahitai.
English: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever use the skin is used for, the plague is a destructive mildew. It is unclean.

tcz: Hiche mipa chun aponsil chu meiya agovam ding, adung avaiya kipheh chalchep pon hihen, sa vun hihen, tupat ponnem hileh, ipi sa vuna kisem von hijong leh, natna chunga akona titphah natna ahin, hichu meiya govam ding ahi.
en: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of leather, in which the plague is, for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.
text:
LEV 13:52
Thadou: Hiche mipa chun aponsil chu meiya agovam ding, adung avaiya kipheh chalchep pon hihen, sa vun hihen, tupat ponnem hileh, ipi sa vuna kisem von hijong leh, natna chunga akona titphah natna ahin, hichu meiya govam ding ahi.
English: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of leather, in which the plague is, for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.

tcz: Thempu pan avet a hiche adung avaiya kipheh chalchep a kikhong, ponsil chung lah hihen savuna kisem vonlah hijong leh, anat nachu chalbe louva auma ahileh,
en: “If the priest examines it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;

tcz: Hichea chu thempu pan ama ho henga thu aseiya, japi hon nat bena ponsil chu asop ngim diu, chuteng thempu pan hiche ponsil chu ni sagi sunga vet a aum sah ding ahi.
en: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing that the plague is in, and he shall isolate it seven more days.
text:
LEV 13:54
Thadou: Hichea chu thempu pan ama ho henga thu aseiya, japi hon nat bena ponsil chu asop ngim diu, chuteng thempu pan hiche ponsil chu ni sagi sunga vet a aum sah ding ahi.
English: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing that the plague is in, and he shall isolate it seven more days.

tcz: Hiche nat bena ponsil chu akisop ngim soh teng leh thempu pan avela avet lhah ding, natbe na ponsil vang chu akisop ngim jou tah louva ahileh, anatna chu ponsil chung achalbe louvang in, hiche ponsil chu aboh a um ding, tithah natna khem chu ponsil sung lang ham apolang hama abe jong leh hichu meiya govam ding ahi.
en: Then the priest shall examine it, after the plague is washed; and behold, if the plague hasn’t changed its color, and the plague hasn’t spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire. It is a mildewed spot, whether the bareness is inside or outside.
text:
LEV 13:55
Thadou: Hiche nat bena ponsil chu akisop ngim soh teng leh thempu pan avela avet lhah ding, natbe na ponsil vang chu akisop ngim jou tah louva ahileh, anatna chu ponsil chung achalbe louvang in, hiche ponsil chu aboh a um ding, tithah natna khem chu ponsil sung lang ham apolang hama abe jong leh hichu meiya govam ding ahi.
English: Then the priest shall examine it, after the plague is washed; and behold, if the plague hasn’t changed its color, and the plague hasn’t spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire. It is a mildewed spot, whether the bareness is inside or outside.

tcz: Thempu pan avet lhah laiya amahon hichu asop ngim thei uva, nat bena beh lai chu avom aum dana ahileh, hiche beh lai kahse chu ponsil vona kona chu abo-eh a apai jeng thei ahi, savuna kisem hihen adung avaiya kipheh chah kheh a ki khong hijong leh,
en: If the priest looks, and behold, the plague has faded after it is washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof;

tcz: Hiche jenga jong chu ponsil chung lah ham, adung avaiya kipheh a kikhong ponsil lah ham, savuna kisem von chung ham, chule ipi vona kisem hijong leh, savun von kisem chung jenga jong ahung sodoh a akimu kit nah laiya ahileh, hiche anatpi chu thi loulai ahin, chalbe nalai ahi, abena penvang chu meiya agovam manghel diu ahi.
en: and if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn what the plague is in with fire.
text:
LEV 13:57
Thadou: Hiche jenga jong chu ponsil chung lah ham, adung avaiya kipheh a kikhong ponsil lah ham, savuna kisem von chung ham, chule ipi vona kisem hijong leh, savun von kisem chung jenga jong ahung sodoh a akimu kit nah laiya ahileh, hiche anatpi chu thi loulai ahin, chalbe nalai ahi, abena penvang chu meiya agovam manghel diu ahi.
English: and if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn what the plague is in with fire.

tcz: Ahinlah aponsil ham, savuna kisem von ham ahilouleh ipi pena kisem ponsil hijong leh, savuna kisem jeng jong nasop ngim sel uva; hiche natpi chu abeihela ahileh ani chan nan jong sop kit un, chutileh theng ding ahitai.
en: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”
text:
LEV 13:58
Thadou: Ahinlah aponsil ham, savuna kisem von ham ahilouleh ipi pena kisem ponsil hijong leh, savuna kisem jeng jong nasop ngim sel uva; hiche natpi chu abeihela ahileh ani chan nan jong sop kit un, chutileh theng ding ahitai.
English: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”

tcz: Hichea akisei jouse hi tithah natna ham, samul pon chung lah ham, tupat ponnem chung ham, adung avaiya kipheh a kikhong ponsil chung ham, ipi pen vona kisem ponsil chung hihen, savuna kisem hitaleh achunga hiche tithah natna natpi achuh tah jeh a, itilam dola dantoh kitoh a phaham ti, abol ding dan ahi.
en: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
text:
LEV 13:59
Thadou: Hichea akisei jouse hi tithah natna ham, samul pon chung lah ham, tupat ponnem chung ham, adung avaiya kipheh a kikhong ponsil chung ham, ipi pen vona kisem ponsil chung hihen, savuna kisem hitaleh achunga hiche tithah natna natpi achuh tah jeh a, itilam dola dantoh kitoh a phaham ti, abol ding dan ahi.
English: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin thu aseipeh in,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 14:1

English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Hiche hi miphah kisuh theng nikhoa bol ding dan ahin, miphah chu thempupa henga puiding ahi.
en: “This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest,
text:
LEV 14:2
Thadou: Hiche hi miphah kisuh theng nikhoa bol ding dan ahin, miphah chu thempupa henga puiding ahi.
English: “This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest,
