en: and the priest shall go out of the camp. The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper,
text:
LEV 14:3
Thadou: Thempupa jong ngahmun polama pot doh’a chuteng thempu pan kholchilna anei ding ahi. Hichea chu miphah pachu damna achan khah a ahileh,
English: and the priest shall go out of the camp. The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper,

tcz: Thempu pan akisutheng ding pa jeh’a chu miho thu apeh ding, vacha hing thengsel ni jaonaa Cedar thing toh agalah sah a, ponsan thim chule hyssop jong agalahsah ding ahi.
en: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.
text:
LEV 14:4
Thadou: Thempu pan akisutheng ding pa jeh’a chu miho thu apeh ding, vacha hing thengsel ni jaonaa Cedar thing toh agalah sah a, ponsan thim chule hyssop jong agalahsah ding ahi.
English: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

tcz: Chuteng leh thempu pan miho henga thu apeh a, twi longlai chung khat achu leibel sunga vacha atha sah ding ahi.
en: The priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.
text:
LEV 14:5
Thadou: Chuteng leh thempu pan miho henga thu apeh a, twi longlai chung khat achu leibel sunga vacha atha sah ding ahi.
English: The priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

tcz: Vacha chu ahin nalai leh Cedar thing chule ponsan thim le hyssop pon chu alah a, twi longlai chunga kithat vacha thisan chu anunat soh kei ding,
en: As for the living bird, he shall take it, the cedar wood, the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.
text:
LEV 14:6
Thadou: Vacha chu ahin nalai leh Cedar thing chule ponsan thim le hyssop pon chu alah a, twi longlai chunga kithat vacha thisan chu anunat soh kei ding,
English: As for the living bird, he shall take it, the cedar wood, the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.

tcz: Chule tiphah nat akona akisutheng ding pa chunga chu sagi vei jen athin khum ding, chuteng tiphah nat veipa chu atheng ahitai, tia aphondoh a vacha hing jong chu ahinga alha doh a, hichu gamlah a alha mang ding ahi.
en: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.
text:
LEV 14:7
Thadou: Chule tiphah nat akona akisutheng ding pa chunga chu sagi vei jen athin khum ding, chuteng tiphah nat veipa chu atheng ahitai, tia aphondoh a vacha hing jong chu ahinga alha doh a, hichu gamlah a alha mang ding ahi.
English: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.

tcz: Thensona kibol peh ding pa chun aponsil aboncha akisop lhah a, asam jong aki chetol a, twija kisil thengsel ding, chuteng amapa chu athenga uma, hiche ho jouse akibol chaisoh teng leh masanga tiphah nat veipa chu naghmun sunga hung ding ahitan, hinlah amapa chu aponbuh polama ni sagi chan nichong nalai ding ahi.
en: “He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.
text:
LEV 14:8
Thadou: Thensona kibol peh ding pa chun aponsil aboncha akisop lhah a, asam jong aki chetol a, twija kisil thengsel ding, chuteng amapa chu athenga uma, hiche ho jouse akibol chaisoh teng leh masanga tiphah nat veipa chu naghmun sunga hung ding ahitan, hinlah amapa chu aponbuh polama ni sagi chan nichong nalai ding ahi.
English: “He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.

tcz: Ni sagi lhin nikho teng leh alujang sam jouse akivo ngima, anemul akhamul le amitmul jouse jong akivo ngimsoh kei ding, asama kai kiti phot avongim ding ahi. Chujou teng leh amapa chun aponsil jouse akisop thenga, atahsa twiya ki soplha ding, kisil thengsel'a, hitia chu amapa chu athenga um ding ahi.
en: It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows. He shall shave off all his hair. He shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his body in water. Then he shall be clean.
text:
LEV 14:9
Thadou: Ni sagi lhin nikho teng leh alujang sam jouse akivo ngima, anemul akhamul le amitmul jouse jong akivo ngimsoh kei ding, asama kai kiti phot avongim ding ahi. Chujou teng leh amapa chun aponsil jouse akisop thenga, atahsa twiya ki soplha ding, kisil thengsel'a, hitia chu amapa chu athenga um ding ahi.
English: It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows. He shall shave off all his hair. He shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his body in water. Then he shall be clean.

tcz: Niget lhinni teng leh, masanga miphah pa chun nolna beihel kelngoi chal ni leh, nolnabei kelngoi pi khat aga mat ding, hiche kelngoi chu kum khat lhingsa hi ding, changbong neldi thaotwi kichapsa ephah dimkhat hopsoma hop thum toh agalah thaa, thaotwi khon dimkhat toh agathal tha ding ahi.
en: “On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect, one ewe lamb a year old without defect, three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.
text:
LEV 14:10
Thadou: Niget lhinni teng leh, masanga miphah pa chun nolna beihel kelngoi chal ni leh, nolnabei kelngoi pi khat aga mat ding, hiche kelngoi chu kum khat lhingsa hi ding, changbong neldi thaotwi kichapsa ephah dimkhat hopsoma hop thum toh agalah thaa, thaotwi khon dimkhat toh agathal tha ding ahi.
English: “On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect, one ewe lamb a year old without defect, three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.

tcz: Chujou teng leh miphah pa suthenga pang ding thempu pan miphah pa ahin, thil hichengse chu kikhop khomna ponbuh kotpi phunga, Pakai angsunga atousah ding ahi.
en: The priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
LEV 14:11
Thadou: Chujou teng leh miphah pa suthenga pang ding thempu pan miphah pa ahin, thil hichengse chu kikhop khomna ponbuh kotpi phunga, Pakai angsunga atousah ding ahi.
English: The priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Thempu pan kelngoi chal khat joh chu amat a thaotwi khon dimkhat chu themmona maicham thiltoa atoding, hiche teni chu Pathen angsunga themmona maicham thiltoa atodoh ding ahi.
en: “The priest shall take one of the male lambs, and offer him for a trespass offering, with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
text:
LEV 14:12
Thadou: Thempu pan kelngoi chal khat joh chu amat a thaotwi khon dimkhat chu themmona maicham thiltoa atoding, hiche teni chu Pathen angsunga themmona maicham thiltoa atodoh ding ahi.
English: “The priest shall take one of the male lambs, and offer him for a trespass offering, with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

tcz: Chule kelngoi chal chu miho chonset maicham thilto chule pumgo maicham thilto athana mun-u muntheng laiya chu atha ding ahi, ajeh chu hiche themmona maicham thilto jong hi chonset maicham thilto banga thempupa chan ding dol ahin, athilto dohsa chu atheng chungnung ahi.
en: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.
text:
LEV 14:13
Thadou: Chule kelngoi chal chu miho chonset maicham thilto chule pumgo maicham thilto athana mun-u muntheng laiya chu atha ding ahi, ajeh chu hiche themmona maicham thilto jong hi chonset maicham thilto banga thempupa chan ding dol ahin, athilto dohsa chu atheng chungnung ahi.
English: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.

tcz: Thempu pan hiche themmona maicham thilto thisan chu phabep khat aham doh a, thempu pan jong hiche thisan chu alah a aki thenso ding pa jetlam khut khopia abilkol geiya anunat soh ding, akeng khopi jetlam'a jong anunat peh ding ahi.
en: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
text:
LEV 14:14
Thadou: Thempu pan hiche themmona maicham thilto thisan chu phabep khat aham doh a, thempu pan jong hiche thisan chu alah a aki thenso ding pa jetlam khut khopia abilkol geiya anunat soh ding, akeng khopi jetlam'a jong anunat peh ding ahi.
English: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

tcz: Thempu pan jong khon dimkhat akona thaotwi helkhat athaldoh a, hichu akhut veilam khut phang chunga asun lhah ding,
en: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.
text:
LEV 14:15
Thadou: Thempu pan jong khon dimkhat akona thaotwi helkhat athaldoh a, hichu akhut veilam khut phang chunga asun lhah ding,
English: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.

tcz: Hiche akhut veilam khut phang chunga asun lhahsa thaotwi chu, akhut jetlam khut junga akhoi nat ding, Pakai angsung achu vel sagi jen athin ding ahi.
en: The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.
text:
LEV 14:16
Thadou: Hiche akhut veilam khut phang chunga asun lhahsa thaotwi chu, akhut jetlam khut junga akhoi nat ding, Pakai angsung achu vel sagi jen athin ding ahi.
English: The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.

tcz: Akhut a umnalai thaotwi phabep chu akisutheng ding pa, ajetlam bilkola chu thempu pan anunat peh a, ajetlam khut pia jong anunat peh a, akeng phang lam khopia jong hitia chu themmo maicham thilto thisan kiloina chunga chu anunat peh ding ahi.
en: The priest shall put some of the rest of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering.
text:
LEV 14:17
Thadou: Akhut a umnalai thaotwi phabep chu akisutheng ding pa, ajetlam bilkola chu thempu pan anunat peh a, ajetlam khut pia jong anunat peh a, akeng phang lam khopia jong hitia chu themmo maicham thilto thisan kiloina chunga chu anunat peh ding ahi.
English: The priest shall put some of the rest of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering.

tcz: Hichea thaotwi amoh chengse chu thempu pan jong aki sutheng ding pa luchang achu anupeh ding ahi. Hitia chu tiphah nat veipa chu, Pakai angsunga kithoidamna asempeh ding ahi.
en: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD.
text:
LEV 14:18
Thadou: Hichea thaotwi amoh chengse chu thempu pan jong aki sutheng ding pa luchang achu anupeh ding ahi. Hitia chu tiphah nat veipa chu, Pakai angsunga kithoidamna asempeh ding ahi.
English: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD.

tcz: Thempu pan jong athenlounaa kona kisuh thengna le aki thoidam dingpa dia chonset maicham thilto asempeh ding ahi. Hi chu abol chai teng leh, pumgo maicham thilto jong chu atha paipai ding ahi.
en: “The priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness. Afterward he shall kill the burnt offering;

tcz: Thempu pan jong pumgo maicham thilto le lhosoh thilto chu maicham chunga agato doh ding, hitia chu tiphah natveipa chu thempun athoidama, chuteng tiphah veipa chu theng ding ahitai.
en: then the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
text:
LEV 14:20
Thadou: Thempu pan jong pumgo maicham thilto le lhosoh thilto chu maicham chunga agato doh ding, hitia chu tiphah natveipa chu thempun athoidama, chuteng tiphah veipa chu theng ding ahitai.
English: then the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

tcz: Chule tiphah nat veipa chu mivai cha ahikhah a, athilto ding ato joulou tah a ahileh, themmo thilto dinga kelngoi chal khat beh ahin toding, hichu amapa kithoidamna thiltoa pang ding, chule changbong neldi thaotwi kichapsa iphah dimkhat hopsoma hop khat lhosoh thilto dinga thaotwi khon dimkhat toh jaonaa atoding ahi.
en: “If he is poor, and can’t afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;

tcz: Hitobanga chu aman jong hiche khela chu, atodoh kham vakhu ni le vapal nou ni jong ato thei ahi; vacha khat pen chu chonset thiltoa ding ahin, chule vacha khat chu pumgo thiltoa pang ding ahi.
en: and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to afford; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
text:
LEV 14:22
Thadou: Hitobanga chu aman jong hiche khela chu, atodoh kham vakhu ni le vapal nou ni jong ato thei ahi; vacha khat pen chu chonset thiltoa ding ahin, chule vacha khat chu pumgo thiltoa pang ding ahi.
English: and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to afford; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

tcz: Miphahpa chun niget lhin ni tengleh, akisuh thengna ding kikhop khomna ponbuh kot phung Pakai angsunga, thempu henga ahin choi ding ahi.
en: “On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before the LORD.
text:
LEV 14:23
Thadou: Miphahpa chun niget lhin ni tengleh, akisuh thengna ding kikhop khomna ponbuh kot phung Pakai angsunga, thempu henga ahin choi ding ahi.
English: “On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before the LORD.

tcz: Hiche themmona thilto kelngoi chu thempu pan amat ding, khon dimkhat thaotwi jaonaa thempupan anitah a, thenso thilto dinga Pakai angsunga athenso ding ahi.
en: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
text:
LEV 14:24
Thadou: Hiche themmona thilto kelngoi chu thempu pan amat ding, khon dimkhat thaotwi jaonaa thempupan anitah a, thenso thilto dinga Pakai angsunga athenso ding ahi.
English: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

tcz: Chuteng amapan themmo thiltoa ki tohdohsa kelngoi chu athaa, hiche themmo thilto gan thisan chu thempu pan themkhat alah ding, hichu aki sutheng ding pa bilkol jetlam'a aloinat peh ding, akhut jetlam khutpia jong aloipeh ding, akeng phang jetlang khutpia jong aloinat peh ding ahi.
en: He shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering. The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
text:
LEV 14:25
Thadou: Chuteng amapan themmo thiltoa ki tohdohsa kelngoi chu athaa, hiche themmo thilto gan thisan chu thempu pan themkhat alah ding, hichu aki sutheng ding pa bilkol jetlam'a aloinat peh ding, akhut jetlam khutpia jong aloipeh ding, akeng phang jetlang khutpia jong aloinat peh ding ahi.
English: He shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering. The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

tcz: Chule thempu pan jong amatah khut veilama chu, thaotwi helkhat asun lhah ding,
en: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;

tcz: Akhut veilam khut phanga kisung lha thaotwi chu akhut jetlam khut junga akhoinat ding, hichu Pakai angsunga sagi veijen athin khum ding ahi.
en: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD.
text:
LEV 14:27
Thadou: Akhut veilam khut phanga kisung lha thaotwi chu akhut jetlam khut junga akhoinat ding, hichu Pakai angsunga sagi veijen athin khum ding ahi.
English: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD.

tcz: Akisu theng ding pa bilkol jet langa chu, thempu pan jong thaotwi themkhat aloinat ding, akhut jetlang khutpi le akengphang jetlang akhopi jaonaa themmo thilto thisan kiloina chunga chu aloinat cheh ding ahi.
en: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.
text:
LEV 14:28
Thadou: Akisu theng ding pa bilkol jet langa chu, thempu pan jong thaotwi themkhat aloinat ding, akhut jetlang khutpi le akengphang jetlang akhopi jaonaa themmo thilto thisan kiloina chunga chu aloinat cheh ding ahi.
English: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.

tcz: Thempupa khut phanga umnalai thaotwi moh chengse chu, thempu pan jong aki sutheng ding pa luchanga chu anupeh ding, chuteng Pakai angsunga athoidam ding ahi.
en: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.
text:
LEV 14:29
Thadou: Thempupa khut phanga umnalai thaotwi moh chengse chu, thempu pan jong aki sutheng ding pa luchanga chu anupeh ding, chuteng Pakai angsunga athoidam ding ahi.
English: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.

tcz: Tiphah natveipa chun ajokham chabep a vakhu ni ahin, vapal nou ni ahinto ding,
en: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, which ever he is able to afford,
text:
LEV 14:30
Thadou: Tiphah natveipa chun ajokham chabep a vakhu ni ahin, vapal nou ni ahinto ding,
English: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, which ever he is able to afford,

tcz: Lhosohga thilto jouse jaonaa chonset thilto ding atodoh a chule vacha khatpen chu pumgo thilto dinga atodoh a, chuting leh thempu pan aki sutheng ding pa dia chu, Pakai angsunga kithoidamna asempeh ding ahi.
en: of the kind he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before the LORD.”
text:
LEV 14:31
Thadou: Lhosohga thilto jouse jaonaa chonset thilto ding atodoh a chule vacha khatpen chu pumgo thilto dinga atodoh a, chuting leh thempu pan aki sutheng ding pa dia chu, Pakai angsunga kithoidamna asempeh ding ahi.
English: of the kind he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before the LORD.”

tcz: Hiche hi mihem tiphah nat veiya akisuh thengna dinga thilto lhingsel, atoh jouloupa dinga chu dan kisem peh ahi.
en: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.
text:
LEV 14:32
Thadou: Hiche hi mihem tiphah nat veiya akisuh thengna dinga thilto lhingsel, atoh jouloupa dinga chu dan kisem peh ahi.
English: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.

tcz: Pathen in Mose le Aaron, ajah lhona thu aseipeh in,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
text:
LEV 14:33
Thadou: Pathen in Mose le Aaron, ajah lhona thu aseipeh in,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

tcz: “Keiman nangho gamlo dinga kapeh Canaan gamsung nalhun teng uleh, na chennau gamsunga chu, koitobang nalah uva kona insung khat a tiphah natna ka lhunsah khah a ahileh,
en: “When you have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession,
text:
LEV 14:34
Thadou: “Keiman nangho gamlo dinga kapeh Canaan gamsung nalhun teng uleh, na chennau gamsunga chu, koitobang nalah uva kona insung khat a tiphah natna ka lhunsah khah a ahileh,
English: “When you have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession,

tcz: Hiche inneipu chu thempupa henglama hunga thu ahung peh ding, ka insunga natna hi lungdon aum lheh jinge, tia ahung sei ding ahi.
en: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house.’
text:
LEV 14:35
Thadou: Hiche inneipu chu thempupa henglama hunga thu ahung peh ding, ka insunga natna hi lungdon aum lheh jinge, tia ahung sei ding ahi.
English: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house.’

tcz: Chuteng thempu pan hiche natna chu avetchil masanga, in'a chenghon abonchauva insung adalhah diuva thu asei peh ding; thempu pan thu aseipeh masat diu ahi. Achuti louva ahileh hiche insunga cheng jouse chu atheng louva umdiu, hitia chu mihon hiche insung chu adalhah soh teng uleh thempupa insung lut bep ding ahi.
en: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean. Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.
text:
LEV 14:36
Thadou: Chuteng thempu pan hiche natna chu avetchil masanga, in'a chenghon abonchauva insung adalhah diuva thu asei peh ding; thempu pan thu aseipeh masat diu ahi. Achuti louva ahileh hiche insunga cheng jouse chu atheng louva umdiu, hitia chu mihon hiche insung chu adalhah soh teng uleh thempupa insung lut bep ding ahi.
English: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean. Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.

tcz: Hiche natna chu thempu pan avet chilpeh a, natna chu inbang lah a anabe khah a, adum dehduh ahilouleh asan thima akilah a ahileh, hiche natpi chu inbanga asung lut khah tah leh,
en: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall,
text:
LEV 14:37
Thadou: Hiche natna chu thempu pan avet chilpeh a, natna chu inbang lah a anabe khah a, adum dehduh ahilouleh asan thima akilah a ahileh, hiche natpi chu inbanga asung lut khah tah leh,
English: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall,

tcz: Thempu pan insung adalhah'a kotpi chu akal lhah ding, hiche in chu ni sagi sunga vet a um dinga kotpi akamkhum ding ahi.
en: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.
text:
LEV 14:38
Thadou: Thempu pan insung adalhah'a kotpi chu akal lhah ding, hiche in chu ni sagi sunga vet a um dinga kotpi akamkhum ding ahi.
English: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.

tcz: Thempupa jong ni sagi lhin ni leh hung kit a, ahung vetlhah ding, natpi chu in bang lah a ana kithejal bea ahileh,
en: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house,
text:
LEV 14:39
Thadou: Thempupa jong ni sagi lhin ni leh hung kit a, ahung vetlhah ding, natpi chu in bang lah a ana kithejal bea ahileh,
English: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house,

tcz: Miho jouse chu thempu pan thu apeh ding, in bang lah a natpi bedenna hochu akhodoh soh kei diu, khopamlam munsang lai khat a agase lhah diuva thu apeh ding ahi.
en: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city.
text:
LEV 14:40
Thadou: Miho jouse chu thempu pan thu apeh ding, in bang lah a natpi bedenna hochu akhodoh soh kei diu, khopamlam munsang lai khat a agase lhah diuva thu apeh ding ahi.
English: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city.

tcz: Insung lam chu atheh ngim sah soh kei ding, akimvel lhung keiya akho ngimsah ding, athah jut namsah kit ding, ahinlah akikhoh dohsa chengse vang chu, khopam lam munsang lai diu khat a agaboh lhah sah diu ahi.
en: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.
text:
LEV 14:41
Thadou: Insung lam chu atheh ngim sah soh kei ding, akimvel lhung keiya akho ngimsah ding, athah jut namsah kit ding, ahinlah akikhoh dohsa chengse vang chu, khopam lam munsang lai diu khat a agaboh lhah sah diu ahi.
English: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.

tcz: Natpi bena song kikhoh doh chengse nung jenga jong adang akoilut kit uva, inloi namna chu alah a aloinam kit ding ahi.
en: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.
text:
LEV 14:42
Thadou: Natpi bena song kikhoh doh chengse nung jenga jong adang akoilut kit uva, inloi namna chu alah a aloinam kit ding ahi.
English: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

tcz: Ibangkhat a natpi bena song jouse alah doh a asuhtheng jou ahilouleh, aloinam jou nunga jong insunga chu natpi akithe jah kit nah laiya ahileh,
en: “If the plague comes again, and breaks out in the house after he has taken out the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it was plastered,
text:
LEV 14:43
Thadou: Ibangkhat a natpi bena song jouse alah doh a asuhtheng jou ahilouleh, aloinam jou nunga jong insunga chu natpi akithe jah kit nah laiya ahileh,
English: “If the plague comes again, and breaks out in the house after he has taken out the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it was plastered,

tcz: Thempupa chea agavet lhah kit ding, natpi mong mong ahia insunga chu ana kithe jah kit a ahileh, hitobang natna chu mihem tiphah natna phaloutah insung hung lut ahitan, hiche in chu athenglou ahitai.
en: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean.
text:
LEV 14:44
Thadou: Thempupa chea agavet lhah kit ding, natpi mong mong ahia insunga chu ana kithe jah kit a ahileh, hitobang natna chu mihem tiphah natna phaloutah insung hung lut ahitan, hiche in chu athenglou ahitai.
English: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean.

tcz: Amapan jong hiche a-in chu aphetlhah jeng ding, ain-a song holeh thing ho chule invai kijutna jouse jong aphit ngimsela, aboncha khopamlam munsang lai khat a agahthah mang ding ahi.
en: He shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the house’s mortar. He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place.
text:
LEV 14:45
Thadou: Amapan jong hiche a-in chu aphetlhah jeng ding, ain-a song holeh thing ho chule invai kijutna jouse jong aphit ngimsela, aboncha khopamlam munsang lai khat a agahthah mang ding ahi.
English: He shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the house’s mortar. He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place.

tcz: Hiche jouse nunga jong hi, a-in hi atheng louva kikoi kotpi kikam densa ahin, koi hileh kotpi kikam sunga lut kha aum leh nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 14:46
Thadou: Hiche jouse nunga jong hi, a-in hi atheng louva kikoi kotpi kikam densa ahin, koi hileh kotpi kikam sunga lut kha aum leh nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Koi hileh hiche insunga imu khapen pen jong chun aponsil akisop lhah ding chule insunga an nekha pen pen injong, aposil jouse akisop theng ding ahi.
en: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.
text:
LEV 14:47
Thadou: Koi hileh hiche insunga imu khapen pen jong chun aponsil akisop lhah ding chule insunga an nekha pen pen injong, aposil jouse akisop theng ding ahi.
English: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

tcz: Ahinlah thempu pan ahung vet lhah kit a, natpi chu insung kijut namlai hoa ana kithe jah tah louva ahileh, hichea chu thempu pan jong a-in chu athengtai, tia aphondoh ding ahi, ajeh chu hiche natpi akona chu damna chang ahitai.
en: “If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
text:
LEV 14:48
Thadou: Ahinlah thempu pan ahung vet lhah kit a, natpi chu insung kijut namlai hoa ana kithe jah tah louva ahileh, hichea chu thempu pan jong a-in chu athengtai, tia aphondoh ding ahi, ajeh chu hiche natpi akona chu damna chang ahitai.
English: “If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

tcz: Hiche insuh theng nadia chu vahcha ni agakimat ding, cedar thing, ponsandup le hyssop pon ahin choitha ding,
en: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.
text:
LEV 14:49
Thadou: Hiche insuh theng nadia chu vahcha ni agakimat ding, cedar thing, ponsandup le hyssop pon ahin choitha ding,
English: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

tcz: Vachate ni lah a khat pen chu, twi long chung leibel sunga atha ding,
en: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.
text:
LEV 14:50
Thadou: Vachate ni lah a khat pen chu, twi long chung leibel sunga atha ding,
English: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

tcz: Cedar thing le hyssop pon, ponsandup jaonaa vacha ahing nalai chutoh ahin choi ding, hichengse chu twi long chunga vacha kithat thisan lah achu akoilut ding, a-in chu thisana vel sagi jen athin khum ding ahi.
en: He shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.
text:
LEV 14:51
Thadou: Cedar thing le hyssop pon, ponsandup jaonaa vacha ahing nalai chutoh ahin choi ding, hichengse chu twi long chunga vacha kithat thisan lah achu akoilut ding, a-in chu thisana vel sagi jen athin khum ding ahi.
English: He shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

tcz: Hitia chu ain vacha thisan toh tuilong pet jaona a, vacha hing chutoh, cedar thing ahin, hyssop pon, ponsandup jaona a asuhtheng ding ahi.
en: He shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, with the living bird, with the cedar wood, with the hyssop, and with the scarlet;

tcz: Chujou teng leh vacha hing chu khopi sung akona gamlah langa alha mang ding, hichea chu insuh theng naleh thoina asem ding, chuteng in chu athenga um ding ahi, ati.
en: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field. So shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.”
text:
LEV 14:53
Thadou: Chujou teng leh vacha hing chu khopi sung akona gamlah langa alha mang ding, hichea chu insuh theng naleh thoina asem ding, chuteng in chu athenga um ding ahi, ati.
English: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field. So shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.”

tcz: Danthu hi mihem tiphah natna vei chung changa bolding dan hihen, tithah hihen,
en: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,
text:
LEV 14:54
Thadou: Danthu hi mihem tiphah natna vei chung changa bolding dan hihen, tithah hihen,
English: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,

tcz: Ponsil le chen hihen chule inchunga hung chu jeng phah natna thudol hijong leh,
en: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,
text:
LEV 14:55
Thadou: Ponsil le chen hihen chule inchunga hung chu jeng phah natna thudol hijong leh,
English: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,

tcz: Apomdoh ham, adul doh ham, aboldoh hijong leh,
en: and for a swelling, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;

tcz: Hicheng jouse chu agomsoh a ding ahitan, atheng ding ahitai, ti photchet nadia dan thu chu ahi. Mihem tiphah nat veina chung chnaga dan thu chu ahi.
en: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.
text:
LEV 14:57
Thadou: Hicheng jouse chu agomsoh a ding ahitan, atheng ding ahitai, ti photchet nadia dan thu chu ahi. Mihem tiphah nat veina chung chnaga dan thu chu ahi.
English: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in Mose le Aaron henga hiti hin aseipeh in ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
text:
LEV 15:1
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in Mose le Aaron henga hiti hin aseipeh in ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

tcz: “Israel chate jah’a seipeh lhon inlang hiti hin um uhen, pasal khat chu ahinpia thilong aum khah a ahileh, hiche thi hung longdoh chu atheng lou ahi.”
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.
text:
LEV 15:2
Thadou: “Israel chate jah’a seipeh lhon inlang hiti hin um uhen, pasal khat chu ahinpia thilong aum khah a ahileh, hiche thi hung longdoh chu atheng lou ahi.”
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.

tcz: Hitia thilong doh akona pasalpa athenglou ahitia dan kisem chu, atahsa akona athilon chu tanglou hela ahunglon jinga, chule atahsa akona akitang densah a ahijong leh, hichepa chu asunga athenglou aboh uma ahitai.
en: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.
text:
LEV 15:3
Thadou: Hitia thilong doh akona pasalpa athenglou ahitia dan kisem chu, atahsa akona athilon chu tanglou hela ahunglon jinga, chule atahsa akona akitang densah a ahijong leh, hichepa chu asunga athenglou aboh uma ahitai.
English: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.

tcz: Athia longpa imutna jalkhun chu atheng loua umjing ding, itobang thil hijong leh atoupha chan chu aboh a kisim ahi.
en: “‘Every bed on which he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.
text:
LEV 15:4
Thadou: Athia longpa imutna jalkhun chu atheng loua umjing ding, itobang thil hijong leh atoupha chan chu aboh a kisim ahi.
English: “‘Every bed on which he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.

tcz: Hijeh chun mihem koi hileh athi longpa imutna tongkha chan chun, aponsil jouse akisop ngimsel ding amatah jeng jong twiya kisil thenga, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:5
Thadou: Hijeh chun mihem koi hileh athi longpa imutna tongkha chan chun, aponsil jouse akisop ngimsel ding amatah jeng jong twiya kisil thenga, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Hitia chu koi hijong leh athilongpa touna muna toukha chan chun, aponsil jouse akisop theng ding, amatah jong twiya kisil lha ding, nilhum keiya aboh a um ding ahi.
en: He who sits on anything on which the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:6
Thadou: Hitia chu koi hijong leh athilongpa touna muna toukha chan chun, aponsil jouse akisop theng ding, amatah jong twiya kisil lha ding, nilhum keiya aboh a um ding ahi.
English: He who sits on anything on which the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Hitobanga chu koi hijong leh, hiche athilong pa tahsa tongkha chan chun, aponsil jouse akisop thenga, ama jeng jong twiya kisil lha ding, nilhum keiya atheng loua um ding ahi.
en: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:7
Thadou: Hitobanga chu koi hijong leh, hiche athilong pa tahsa tongkha chan chun, aponsil jouse akisop thenga, ama jeng jong twiya kisil lha ding, nilhum keiya atheng loua um ding ahi.
English: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Chutia chu athilong pa chun mi koi tobang khat chu ngimsela aum pet a achil aset khum khah banga ahileh, aset khum pen pen chun aponsil jouse akisop ngim ding, amatah jong twiya kisil lha ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:8
Thadou: Chutia chu athilong pa chun mi koi tobang khat chu ngimsela aum pet a achil aset khum khah banga ahileh, aset khum pen pen chun aponsil jouse akisop ngim ding, amatah jong twiya kisil lha ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Chule hiche athia longpa touna sakol jeng jong chu atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.
text:
LEV 15:9
Thadou: Chule hiche athia longpa touna sakol jeng jong chu atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

tcz: Ipi thil hijong leh athia longpaa umsa kiti phot tongkha auma ahileh nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi, hitobang thil kilah khah aum leh ama chun aponsil jouse akisop theng ding, amatah jeng jong twiya kisil lha a, hicheng jouse nunga chu nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:10
Thadou: Ipi thil hijong leh athia longpaa umsa kiti phot tongkha auma ahileh nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi, hitobang thil kilah khah aum leh ama chun aponsil jouse akisop theng ding, amatah jeng jong twiya kisil lha a, hicheng jouse nunga chu nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Koi hijong leh athia longpan akhut twiya sop ngim louva atham khat napen pen chun, aponsil jouse akisop theng ding, amatah jong twiya kisil lha ding nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: “‘Whomever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:11
Thadou: Koi hijong leh athia longpan akhut twiya sop ngim louva atham khat napen pen chun, aponsil jouse akisop theng ding, amatah jong twiya kisil lha ding nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: “‘Whomever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Chu jongleh athia longpan atoh khah leibel kiti phot chu tekeh jeng ding, chule thinga kona kisem manchah ahikhah jongleh, hichu twiya sop ngimsel ding ahi.
en: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
text:
LEV 15:12
Thadou: Chu jongleh athia longpan atoh khah leibel kiti phot chu tekeh jeng ding, chule thinga kona kisem manchah ahikhah jongleh, hichu twiya sop ngimsel ding ahi.
English: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

tcz: Athia longpa chu akibol damteng, athilon jeh a suhda na achan jal'a chu amapan jong, akisuh thengna ding, ni sagi sung anga ding aponsil jouse jong akisop ngimsoh hel ding ahi. Atahsa ahinpi jeng jong chu twi long alhai lai mun khat achu akisil thenga, chuteng athenga um ding ahi.
en: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
text:
LEV 15:13
Thadou: Athia longpa chu akibol damteng, athilon jeh a suhda na achan jal'a chu amapan jong, akisuh thengna ding, ni sagi sung anga ding aponsil jouse jong akisop ngimsoh hel ding ahi. Atahsa ahinpi jeng jong chu twi long alhai lai mun khat achu akisil thenga, chuteng athenga um ding ahi.
English: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

tcz: Niget alhin teng athia longpa chun vakhu ni ahilouleh vapalnou ni ham ahin choi ding, kikhop khomna ponbuh kotphung bula Pathen angsunga hunglut ding, hiche vacha teni chu thempupa henga apeh lut ding ahi.
en: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.
text:
LEV 15:14
Thadou: Niget alhin teng athia longpa chun vakhu ni ahilouleh vapalnou ni ham ahin choi ding, kikhop khomna ponbuh kotphung bula Pathen angsunga hunglut ding, hiche vacha teni chu thempupa henga apeh lut ding ahi.
English: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.

tcz: Vacha teni chu khat penpen thempu pan alah a chonset thilto dinga atodoh peh ding, adang khat chu pumgo thiltoa atodoh peh a; thempu pan jong athia longpa ding jal'a Pathen angsunga athoi ding ahi.
en: The priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD for his discharge.
text:
LEV 15:15
Thadou: Vacha teni chu khat penpen thempu pan alah a chonset thilto dinga atodoh peh ding, adang khat chu pumgo thiltoa atodoh peh a; thempu pan jong athia longpa ding jal'a Pathen angsunga athoi ding ahi.
English: The priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD for his discharge.

tcz: Pasal koi ham khat chun abotwi achedoh a ahileh, atahsa jouse twiya asiltheng ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:16
Thadou: Pasal koi ham khat chun abotwi achedoh a ahileh, atahsa jouse twiya asiltheng ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Ponsil chung lah ahin savun chung hijong leh abotwi vet lhahna chu twiya soptheng ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:17
Thadou: Ponsil chung lah ahin savun chung hijong leh abotwi vet lhahna chu twiya soptheng ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Numei khat tou chu pasal toh alup khom naa abotwi ache khuma ahileh, amani chu twiya kisil lha lhon ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um lhon ding ahi.
en: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:18
Thadou: Numei khat tou chu pasal toh alup khom naa abotwi ache khuma ahileh, amani chu twiya kisil lha lhon ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um lhon ding ahi.
English: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Numei khat touvin ahinpia kona thilong doh ngei chu anei teng, amanu chu nisagi sunga atheng louva um ding, koi hijong leh hiche numeinu tongkha chan chu nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days. Whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:19
Thadou: Numei khat touvin ahinpia kona thilong doh ngei chu anei teng, amanu chu nisagi sunga atheng louva um ding, koi hijong leh hiche numeinu tongkha chan chu nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days. Whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Chule numei nun athi neilai tah a imut naa aneipen chu ipi hijong leh, atheng louva um jeng ding ahi; hitia chu ipi thil hijong leh atoupha chan chu atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.
text:
LEV 15:20
Thadou: Chule numei nun athi neilai tah a imut naa aneipen chu ipi hijong leh, atheng louva um jeng ding ahi; hitia chu ipi thil hijong leh atoupha chan chu atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.

tcz: Koi hijong leh hiche numeinu imutna jal khun tongkha aum khah leh, atongkha pen pen chun akivonna jouse akisop ngim ding, amatah jong twiya kisil lha ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:21
Thadou: Koi hijong leh hiche numeinu imutna jal khun tongkha aum khah leh, atongkha pen pen chun akivonna jouse akisop ngim ding, amatah jong twiya kisil lha ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Hitia chu ipi thil hijong leh hiche numei thinei nun atoupha tongkha chan chun akivonna jouse akisop lhah a, amatah jong twiya kisil theng ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:22
Thadou: Hitia chu ipi thil hijong leh hiche numei thinei nun atoupha tongkha chan chun akivonna jouse akisop lhah a, amatah jong twiya kisil theng ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Hiche numei thinei nun atouphana chu pasal koi hileh, atongkha chan chu nilhum keiya athenglouva um jeng ding ahi.
en: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:23
Thadou: Hiche numei thinei nun atouphana chu pasal koi hileh, atongkha chan chu nilhum keiya athenglouva um jeng ding ahi.
English: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Pasal koi hileh hiche numei thi neinu chu aluppi noma aluppi khah a ahileh, numeinu thichu pasalpa chunga nat ahitan, pasalpa cu nisagi sunga aboh a um ding chule hichepa lupna jalkhun chu atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed he lies on shall be unclean.
text:
LEV 15:24
Thadou: Pasal koi hileh hiche numei thi neinu chu aluppi noma aluppi khah a ahileh, numeinu thichu pasalpa chunga nat ahitan, pasalpa cu nisagi sunga aboh a um ding chule hichepa lupna jalkhun chu atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed he lies on shall be unclean.

tcz: Numei khattou nikho tampi athi tang louva alon khah a ahileh, athi neina ding phat jong hitalou, hitia chu athineina phat kalvala athi alon jing tah a ahileh, athilon sungsea chu numeinu chu atheng louva um ding, angaiya athi neilaia aboh a aum banga um ding ahi.
en: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period. She is unclean.
text:
LEV 15:25
Thadou: Numei khattou nikho tampi athi tang louva alon khah a ahileh, athi neina ding phat jong hitalou, hitia chu athineina phat kalvala athi alon jing tah a ahileh, athilon sungsea chu numeinu chu atheng louva um ding, angaiya athi neilaia aboh a aum banga um ding ahi.
English: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period. She is unclean.

tcz: Athilon sungsea a-imutna jalkhun chu, angaiya athinei laiya a-imutna jalkhun banga chu atheng louva um ding; ipi thil hijong leh numei nun atoupha chan chu angaiya athinei lai banga atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: Every bed she lies on all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period. Everything she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.
text:
LEV 15:26
Thadou: Athilon sungsea a-imutna jalkhun chu, angaiya athinei laiya a-imutna jalkhun banga chu atheng louva um ding; ipi thil hijong leh numei nun atoupha chan chu angaiya athinei lai banga atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: Every bed she lies on all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period. Everything she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.

tcz: Chule hiche jalkhun leh touna tongkha chan chun aponsil jouse akisop ngim ding, amatah jong twiya kisil lha ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
text:
LEV 15:27
Thadou: Chule hiche jalkhun leh touna tongkha chan chun aponsil jouse akisop ngim ding, amatah jong twiya kisil lha ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

tcz: Hiche numeinu chu athilonna akona boldamna achan khah leh, numeinu chu ni sagi sunga vet a um ding, chuteng amanu chu athenga kisim bep ding ahi.
en: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
text:
LEV 15:28
Thadou: Hiche numeinu chu athilonna akona boldamna achan khah leh, numeinu chu ni sagi sunga vet a um ding, chuteng amanu chu athenga kisim bep ding ahi.
English: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

tcz: Niget lhin ni tengleh numeinu chun vakhu ni ham vapal nou niham chu agakimat a, hiche vacha teni chu thempu henga, kikhop khomna ponbuh kot bula chu ahin choi ding ahi.
en: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
LEV 15:29
Thadou: Niget lhin ni tengleh numeinu chun vakhu ni ham vapal nou niham chu agakimat a, hiche vacha teni chu thempu henga, kikhop khomna ponbuh kot bula chu ahin choi ding ahi.
English: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Thempu pan jong vacha khat pen pen chu chonset thiltoa atohdoh peh a, chule vacha adang khat chu pumgo thiltoa atodoh peh ding, thempu pan hitia chu numeinu thilon doh thoidamna chu asempeh ding ahi.
en: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the uncleanness of her discharge.
text:
LEV 15:30
Thadou: Thempu pan jong vacha khat pen pen chu chonset thiltoa atohdoh peh a, chule vacha adang khat chu pumgo thiltoa atodoh peh ding, thempu pan hitia chu numeinu thilon doh thoidamna chu asempeh ding ahi.
English: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the uncleanness of her discharge.

tcz: Hitia hi nangho jousen Israel chate athenlou nauleh aboh nauva kona nachom khen doh diu; achuti louva ahileh amaho lailunga kitung keima houbuh aboh a aumsah diu, hichea chu athenlou nauleh aboh nauva kona chu thijeng theiyu ahi.
en: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”
text:
LEV 15:31
Thadou: Hitia hi nangho jousen Israel chate athenlou nauleh aboh nauva kona nachom khen doh diu; achuti louva ahileh amaho lailunga kitung keima houbuh aboh a aumsah diu, hichea chu athenlou nauleh aboh nauva kona chu thijeng theiyu ahi.
English: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”

tcz: Hitobang danthu hi pasal thinei le abotwi che doh jeh a, atheng lou aboh a umpa ding ahi.
en: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;

tcz: Chule numei thinei pet thudola, numei hileh pasal hileh aphat achang louva ahin pia kona tang louva thilong ho jaonaa, numei athilon pat a pasal in aluppi ho ding dan kisem chu ahi.
en: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.
text:
LEV 15:33
Thadou: Chule numei thinei pet thudola, numei hileh pasal hileh aphat achang louva ahin pia kona tang louva thilong ho jaonaa, numei athilon pat a pasal in aluppi ho ding dan kisem chu ahi.
English: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.

tcz: Dan toh kitoh louva Pathen angsunga thilto anabol lhon jal'a, thina chang teni Aaron chapate ni thinung in Pakai, Pathen in Mose henga hiti hin aseipeh in,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before the LORD, and died;

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in Mose henga hiti hin asei tan, “Na sopipa Aaron jah a seipeh tan pondal kidalna muntheng lailung, thingkong chunga um ngailut hepi touna maiya ama cham in alut nom phat chan in hung lut lou ding, hichu ahilouleh thi jeng thei ahi; ajeh chu hichea ngailut hepi touna chunga khu keima meiloma kilahji kahi.”
en: and the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.
text:
LEV 16:2
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in Mose henga hiti hin asei tan, “Na sopipa Aaron jah a seipeh tan pondal kidalna muntheng lailung, thingkong chunga um ngailut hepi touna maiya ama cham in alut nom phat chan in hung lut lou ding, hichu ahilouleh thi jeng thei ahi; ajeh chu hichea ngailut hepi touna chunga khu keima meiloma kilahji kahi.”
English: and the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

tcz: Aaron vang hiche munthenga hi lut theia, chonset thilto dinga bongchal gol khat leh kelngoi chal khat jaonaa ahin kai ding,
en: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
text:
LEV 16:3
Thadou: Aaron vang hiche munthenga hi lut theia, chonset thilto dinga bongchal gol khat leh kelngoi chal khat jaonaa ahin kai ding,
English: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

tcz: Chule tupet ponnema kikhui sangkhol chol len chu aki ah ding, tupet ponnem a kikhui toka chol jong akichen a, chule tupet ponnem a kikhui chalchep konggah chu akong akigah a, tupet'a kikhong delkop jong akop ding, hichengse hi von lah a atheng ahin, hijeh chun thempu pan jong hiche von hochu akivon theina din atahsa pumpi tuiya kisil thengsel ding ahi.
en: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.
text:
LEV 16:4
Thadou: Chule tupet ponnema kikhui sangkhol chol len chu aki ah ding, tupet ponnem a kikhui toka chol jong akichen a, chule tupet ponnem a kikhui chalchep konggah chu akong akigah a, tupet'a kikhong delkop jong akop ding, hichengse hi von lah a atheng ahin, hijeh chun thempu pan jong hiche von hochu akivon theina din atahsa pumpi tuiya kisil thengsel ding ahi.
English: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

tcz: Chule Israel chate khoppi apat chu kelchal nou nitah, pumgo thiltoa to dinga kelchal khat ma akimat ding ahi.
en: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
text:
LEV 16:5
Thadou: Chule Israel chate khoppi apat chu kelchal nou nitah, pumgo thiltoa to dinga kelchal khat ma akimat ding ahi.
English: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

tcz: Aaron in jong atumbeh a ama dinga bongchal khat atodoh ding, hitia chu amading leh ainsung mite dinga kithoidamna anei masat ding ahi.
en: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.
text:
LEV 16:6
Thadou: Aaron in jong atumbeh a ama dinga bongchal khat atodoh ding, hitia chu amading leh ainsung mite dinga kithoidamna anei masat ding ahi.
English: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.

tcz: Chule Aaron in jong kelchal teni chu akai ding, kikhop khomna ponbuh kotbul Pathen ansunga chu adinsah a,
en: He shall take the two goats, and set them before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
LEV 16:7
Thadou: Chule Aaron in jong kelchal teni chu akai ding, kikhop khomna ponbuh kotbul Pathen ansunga chu adinsah a,
English: He shall take the two goats, and set them before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Chule Aaron in jong kelchal teni dia phun asan ding, hiche aphunsan lah a khat chu, Pakai ding chule aphunsan khat vang chu Azazel chang ding ahi.
en: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
text:
LEV 16:8
Thadou: Chule Aaron in jong kelchal teni dia phun asan ding, hiche aphunsan lah a khat chu, Pakai ding chule aphunsan khat vang chu Azazel chang ding ahi.
English: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

tcz: Chule Aaron in jong Pakaiya dia phun, achunga phunchan chuhna kelcha chu akai ding, chonset thiltoa atodoh ding ahi.
en: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer him for a sin offering.
text:
LEV 16:9
Thadou: Chule Aaron in jong Pakaiya dia phun, achunga phunchan chuhna kelcha chu akai ding, chonset thiltoa atodoh ding ahi.
English: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer him for a sin offering.

tcz: Hitobanga chu Azazel chan ding phun pha, achunga phunchan chuhna kelcha chu kithoidamna dinga ahing laiya todoh ding, hichu Azazel chan dinga gamlah a ahinga lha mang ding ahi.
en: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.
text:
LEV 16:10
Thadou: Hitobanga chu Azazel chan ding phun pha, achunga phunchan chuhna kelcha chu kithoidamna dinga ahing laiya todoh ding, hichu Azazel chan dinga gamlah a ahinga lha mang ding ahi.
English: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.

tcz: Aaron in jong amatah chonset thilto dinga bongchal chu atodoh ding, hiche bongchal chu ama chonset thilto dinga akitha ding ahi.
en: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.
text:
LEV 16:11
Thadou: Aaron in jong amatah chonset thilto dinga bongchal chu atodoh ding, hiche bongchal chu ama chonset thilto dinga akitha ding ahi.
English: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

tcz: Chule Aaron in jong Pakai angsung maicham phunga pat, meiam kong khat dim hichu gimnamtui lhutna ding, chule hoitah a kisemsa gimnamtui khut dimni aham doh a, hichu pondal kikhai kal lama chu apohlut ding ahi.
en: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.
text:
LEV 16:12
Thadou: Chule Aaron in jong Pakai angsung maicham phunga pat, meiam kong khat dim hichu gimnamtui lhutna ding, chule hoitah a kisemsa gimnamtui khut dimni aham doh a, hichu pondal kikhai kal lama chu apohlut ding ahi.
English: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.

tcz: Hitia chu Pakai angsunga meikong lah a gimnamtui chu alelhah ding, chule hettohsahna dinga kido ngailut hepi touna chu, gimnamtui kilhutna meikhu chun atom sohhel ding ahi, hichu ahilouleh thinan alhun thei ahi.
en: He shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.
text:
LEV 16:13
Thadou: Hitia chu Pakai angsunga meikong lah a gimnamtui chu alelhah ding, chule hettohsahna dinga kido ngailut hepi touna chu, gimnamtui kilhutna meikhu chun atom sohhel ding ahi, hichu ahilouleh thinan alhun thei ahi.
English: He shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.

tcz: Chule bongchal thisan chu themkhat alah ding, akhut jung akona ngailut hepi touna mailah a chu athe lhah ding, ngailut hepi touna mailah a chu akhut jung akona sagi veijen athe khum ding ahi.
en: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.
text:
LEV 16:14
Thadou: Chule bongchal thisan chu themkhat alah ding, akhut jung akona ngailut hepi touna mailah a chu athe lhah ding, ngailut hepi touna mailah a chu akhut jung akona sagi veijen athe khum ding ahi.
English: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

tcz: Hiche jouteng chule mipi dinga chonset thilto kelcha chu atha ding, athisan vang chu pondal sunglama achoilut a, hiche kelcha thisan chu bongchal thisan kibolna bang bang achu abol ding, ngailut hepi touna chungvum chule ngailut hepi touna maiya chu athin khum ding ahi.
en: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.
text:
LEV 16:15
Thadou: Hiche jouteng chule mipi dinga chonset thilto kelcha chu atha ding, athisan vang chu pondal sunglama achoilut a, hiche kelcha thisan chu bongchal thisan kibolna bang bang achu abol ding, ngailut hepi touna chungvum chule ngailut hepi touna maiya chu athin khum ding ahi.
English: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

tcz: Hitobang achu Israel chate aboh a aumna jouseu leh chonset a aumnauva kona muntheng pen chu asuhtheng ding, hitobang akona hi ngahmun lailung chu atheng loua umji ahitan, suh thengna abolji ding ahi.
en: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.
text:
LEV 16:16
Thadou: Hitobang achu Israel chate aboh a aumna jouseu leh chonset a aumnauva kona muntheng pen chu asuhtheng ding, hitobang akona hi ngahmun lailung chu atheng loua umji ahitan, suh thengna abolji ding ahi.
English: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.

tcz: Muntheng pen suhthengna dia Aaron asung lhah a ahung potdoh kit kahsea, kikhop khomna ponbuh sunga koima umthei lou ding ahi. Amavang ama le ainsung mite chule miho dinga thensona anei ding,
en: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.
text:
LEV 16:17
Thadou: Muntheng pen suhthengna dia Aaron asung lhah a ahung potdoh kit kahsea, kikhop khomna ponbuh sunga koima umthei lou ding ahi. Amavang ama le ainsung mite chule miho dinga thensona anei ding,
English: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

tcz: Chule maicham phunga pumgo thilto abola suh thengna anei ding, hichea chu bongchal thisan phabep le kelcha thisan phabep alah a, maicham ninga selki hose chu anunat ding ahi.
en: “He shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.
text:
LEV 16:18
Thadou: Chule maicham phunga pumgo thilto abola suh thengna anei ding, hichea chu bongchal thisan phabep le kelcha thisan phabep alah a, maicham ninga selki hose chu anunat ding ahi.
English: “He shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.

tcz: Hiche thisan chu akhut junga akhoi ding, chuteng maicham chung vum lah achu athin khum ding ahi. Hitia hi Israelte chonset jal'a maicham asema athenso ding ahi.
en: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
text:
LEV 16:19
Thadou: Hiche thisan chu akhut junga akhoi ding, chuteng maicham chung vum lah achu athin khum ding ahi. Hitia hi Israelte chonset jal'a maicham asema athenso ding ahi.
English: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

tcz: Chule Aaron in jong muntheng pen jouse le Pakai Pathen chenna ponbuh suhthengna chule maicham sutheng naho achai kimsoh teng leh, phun phatna dia kelcha chu akatdoh ding ahi.
en: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.
text:
LEV 16:20
Thadou: Chule Aaron in jong muntheng pen jouse le Pakai Pathen chenna ponbuh suhthengna chule maicham sutheng naho achai kimsoh teng leh, phun phatna dia kelcha chu akatdoh ding ahi.
English: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

tcz: Chuteng Aaron in akhut teni kelcha chunga chu angap ding, chonset thil ho ahin, gitlouna jouse, Israel chaten doumah aboldoh jouseu aphondoh ding, kelcha chunga buhlhah peh banga abola, chuteng son umtah mikhat chun gammang lah a dellut ding ahi.
en: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.
text:
LEV 16:21
Thadou: Chuteng Aaron in akhut teni kelcha chunga chu angap ding, chonset thil ho ahin, gitlouna jouse, Israel chaten doumah aboldoh jouseu aphondoh ding, kelcha chunga buhlhah peh banga abola, chuteng son umtah mikhat chun gammang lah a dellut ding ahi.
English: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.

tcz: Hiche kelcha chun achonsetna ho jouseu chu, chenna loubeh gammang lah khat a apohmang ding ahi.
en: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.
text:
LEV 16:22
Thadou: Hiche kelcha chun achonsetna ho jouseu chu, chenna loubeh gammang lah khat a apohmang ding ahi.
English: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.

tcz: Chujouteng muntheng sung alut masanga, thempu vona kivon chengse chu kikhop khomna ponbuh lut a Aaron in aga puilut ding, hiche muna chu ahin dalhah diu ahi.
en: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.
text:
LEV 16:23
Thadou: Chujouteng muntheng sung alut masanga, thempu vona kivon chengse chu kikhop khomna ponbuh lut a Aaron in aga puilut ding, hiche muna chu ahin dalhah diu ahi.
English: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

tcz: Chule muntheng khat a kisil lha ding, akivona ngai banga kivona hichea chu amatah chonsetna le mipi chonset thensona dinga, pumgo thilto chu anei ding ahi.
en: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
text:
LEV 16:24
Thadou: Chule muntheng khat a kisil lha ding, akivona ngai banga kivona hichea chu amatah chonsetna le mipi chonset thensona dinga, pumgo thilto chu anei ding ahi.
English: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

tcz: Chule chonset thoidam nadia sathao jouse chu, maicham phunga agovam ding ahi.
en: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.
text:
LEV 16:25
Thadou: Chule chonset thoidam nadia sathao jouse chu, maicham phunga agovam ding ahi.
English: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

tcz: Chule gammang lah a kelcha delmang pachu, ngahmun ahung lhun kah a avon jouse akisop lhah ding, ama jeng jong kisil lha ding ahi.
en: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
text:
LEV 16:26
Thadou: Chule gammang lah a kelcha delmang pachu, ngahmun ahung lhun kah a avon jouse akisop lhah ding, ama jeng jong kisil lha ding ahi.
English: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

tcz: Chonset thoidamna dia kithat bongchal le kelcha teni thisan jong chonset abeina thei ding in, muntheng pena kikoisa chu ngahmun polama govam ding, avun leh asa chule agil jaonaa aboncha govam ding ahi.
en: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.
text:
LEV 16:27
Thadou: Chonset thoidamna dia kithat bongchal le kelcha teni thisan jong chonset abeina thei ding in, muntheng pena kikoisa chu ngahmun polama govam ding, avun leh asa chule agil jaonaa aboncha govam ding ahi.
English: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

tcz: Hitia chu agouvam penpen in ngahmun asung lhah kah a, aponsil jouse asop lhah ding, chuteng ngahmun lai achu sunglha bep ding ahi.
en: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
text:
LEV 16:28
Thadou: Hitia chu agouvam penpen in ngahmun asung lhah kah a, aponsil jouse asop lhah ding, chuteng ngahmun lai achu sunglha bep ding ahi.
English: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

tcz: Chule hiche dan hi akhang akhanga na jui diu, lha sagi, nisom alhin nikho teng Israel chate chule alah uva cheng gamchom mihon an angol diu, na atoh louhel diu ahi.
en: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, whether native-born or a stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;

tcz: Hou thulam dola thenna anei na ding un, hiche nikhoa chu achonset nau thoidamna nei ding ahi.
en: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
text:
LEV 16:30
Thadou: Hou thulam dola thenna anei na ding un, hiche nikhoa chu achonset nau thoidamna nei ding ahi.
English: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before the LORD.

tcz: Hiche nikho hi nikho theng ahin, an ngol ding natoh jong bol louva umding ahi. Hitia chu dan jouse hi akhang akhanga chepi ding ahi.
en: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.
text:
LEV 16:31

English: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.

English: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.
