en: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.
text:
LEV 16:33
Thadou: Pakai chenna ponbuh chule muntheng chungnung, maicham phung chule thempu ho jouse le mipi ho chu suhthengna abolpeh ding ahi.
English: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

tcz: Hitia chu dan hichengse hi akhang akhanga jui ding ahi. Israel chate achonset nauva kona suhthengna thei dia, hiche kithoidamna hi kumseh a khatvei bol ding, hichu Pakai, Pathen thupeh bang in Mose’n jong aboltan ahi.
en: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
LEV 16:34
Thadou: Hitia chu dan hichengse hi akhang akhanga jui ding ahi. Israel chate achonset nauva kona suhthengna thei dia, hiche kithoidamna hi kumseh a khatvei bol ding, hichu Pakai, Pathen thupeh bang in Mose’n jong aboltan ahi.
English: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as the LORD commanded Moses.

text:

en: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is the thing which the LORD has commanded:
text:

English: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is the thing which the LORD has commanded:

en: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,
text:

English: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,

tcz: Hiche thupeh in adeisah pen chu, gammang tollah a kithat gancha jouse chu, Pakai angsunga ahin kailut diuva thupeh ahi. Kotbul lama thempupa henga ahinkai lut diu, kiloikhomna thilto dia kithat ding ahi.
en: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to the LORD.
text:
LEV 17:5
Thadou: Hiche thupeh in adeisah pen chu, gammang tollah a kithat gancha jouse chu, Pakai angsunga ahin kailut diuva thupeh ahi. Kotbul lama thempupa henga ahinkai lut diu, kiloikhomna thilto dia kithat ding ahi.
English: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to the LORD.

tcz: Thisan chu thempu pan ki khop khomna ponbuh kot phung maicham kimvel jousea athe thang ding, Pakaiya dia sathao hochu gimnamtuiya agovam ding ahi.
en: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on the LORD’s altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
text:
LEV 17:6
Thadou: Thisan chu thempu pan ki khop khomna ponbuh kot phung maicham kimvel jousea athe thang ding, Pakaiya dia sathao hochu gimnamtuiya agovam ding ahi.
English: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on the LORD’s altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

tcz: Israel chaten Pathen ajoulhep nauva kelcha limsemthu, doihou dinga gammang lah a gancha atha kitlou diu ahi. Hiche dan thupeh hi Israelten akhang akhanga ajui diu ahi.
en: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols, after which they play the prostitute. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.’
text:

Thadou: Israel chaten Pathen ajoulhep nauva kelcha limsemthu, doihou dinga gammang lah a gancha atha kitlou diu ahi. Hiche dan thupeh hi Israelten akhang akhanga ajui diu ahi.
English: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols, after which they play the prostitute. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.’

text:

English: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,

tcz: Kikhop khomna ponbuh kotphung tailouva Pathen adia kilhaina sem jouse, Pathen mite holah a kona kisim thalou ding ahi.
en: and doesn’t bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD, that man shall be cut off from his people.
text:
LEV 17:9
Thadou: Kikhop khomna ponbuh kotphung tailouva Pathen adia kilhaina sem jouse, Pathen mite holah a kona kisim thalou ding ahi.
English: and doesn’t bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD, that man shall be cut off from his people.

tcz: Israel hihen gamchom mi hijong leh, thisan lhoh lha theng louva sa toh neh tha aum le, hichu Pakai, Pathen toh kidou ahin, amite lah akona simtha lou ding ahi.
en: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
text:
LEV 17:10
Thadou: Israel hihen gamchom mi hijong leh, thisan lhoh lha theng louva sa toh neh tha aum le, hichu Pakai, Pathen toh kidou ahin, amite lah akona simtha lou ding ahi.
English: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

tcz: Ganhing jouse hinna hi thisan akon ahi, hiche jeh achu Pakaiyin mi jouse chonset suhmang ahitheina dinga, hichu maicham phunga asun lhah dinga thupeh ahi.
en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.
text:
LEV 17:11
Thadou: Ganhing jouse hinna hi thisan akon ahi, hiche jeh achu Pakaiyin mi jouse chonset suhmang ahitheina dinga, hichu maicham phunga asun lhah dinga thupeh ahi.
English: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Israel chate le alah uva cheng gamchom miho jaonaa, sa chu thisan jaonaa neh lou dia athupeh ahi.
en: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”
text:
LEV 17:12
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Israel chate le alah uva cheng gamchom miho jaonaa, sa chu thisan jaonaa neh lou dia athupeh ahi.
English: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”

tcz: Israel mi hihen, gamchom mi alah uva cheng hi jong leh, gamlah a saham vacha ham, houtoh kitoh a atheng, hiche ho that pen pen chu thisanso ahitan, hichu leiset avuh khu ding ahi.
en: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.
text:
LEV 17:13
Thadou: Israel mi hihen, gamchom mi alah uva cheng hi jong leh, gamlah a saham vacha ham, houtoh kitoh a atheng, hiche ho that pen pen chu thisanso ahitan, hichu leiset avuh khu ding ahi.
English: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.

tcz: Ganhing hinna kiti hi thisan ahin, hibanga chu sa kiti phot Israel chaten thisan jaonaa nehlou dia Pakai thupeh ahi, koi hileh anetha chu amite lah a kona pampeiya um ding ahi.
en: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”
text:
LEV 17:14
Thadou: Ganhing hinna kiti hi thisan ahin, hibanga chu sa kiti phot Israel chaten thisan jaonaa nehlou dia Pakai thupeh ahi, koi hileh anetha chu amite lah a kona pampeiya um ding ahi.
English: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”

tcz: Israel mi hihen gamchom mi hijong leh, gan thikam ahilouleh, sa hang ham in atha nekha aum le avon jouse akisop theng ding, ama jong kisil lha ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
en: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.
text:
LEV 17:15
Thadou: Israel mi hihen gamchom mi hijong leh, gan thikam ahilouleh, sa hang ham in atha nekha aum le avon jouse akisop theng ding, ama jong kisil lha ding, nilhum keiya atheng louva um ding ahi.
English: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.

tcz: Hichu abol tah louva ahileh, themmo chang ding ahi.
en: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”
text:
LEV 17:16
Thadou: Hichu abol tah louva ahileh, themmo chang ding ahi.
English: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in Mose henga hiti hin thu aseipeh in,
en: The LORD said to Moses,
text:
LEV 18:1
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in Mose henga hiti hin thu aseipeh in,
English: The LORD said to Moses,

tcz: Israel chate henga seipeh inlang, Keima hi nangho Pakai, na Pathen u-chu kahi, ati.
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.
text:
LEV 18:2
Thadou: Israel chate henga seipeh inlang, Keima hi nangho Pakai, na Pathen u-chu kahi, ati.
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.

tcz: Nang hon na bonchauva masanga Egypt gamsunga, nachen laiyuva nachonna bang un, Keiman kahinpui lutna Canaan gam'a vang nachon louhel diu ahi. Amaho chonna dan jouse hi najui lou diu ahi.
en: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.
text:
LEV 18:3
Thadou: Nang hon na bonchauva masanga Egypt gamsunga, nachen laiyuva nachonna bang un, Keiman kahinpui lutna Canaan gam'a vang nachon louhel diu ahi. Amaho chonna dan jouse hi najui lou diu ahi.
English: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.

tcz: Nanghon na bonchauva keima chonna dan jeng nanit diu, nunle khan tohthoa keima chonna dan aboncha najui diu ahi. Ajeh chu keima nang ho Pakai leh Pathen kahi.
en: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD your God.
text:
LEV 18:4
Thadou: Nanghon na bonchauva keima chonna dan jeng nanit diu, nunle khan tohthoa keima chonna dan aboncha najui diu ahi. Ajeh chu keima nang ho Pakai leh Pathen kahi.
English: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD your God.

tcz: Hijeh chun nabonchauva keima chondan jouse le chonna dan aboncha, nun le khan tohthoa nanit jing diu ahi, hichu nit ding chua kona hinna ahiye, ajeh chu keima Pakai chu kahi.
en: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 18:5
Thadou: Hijeh chun nabonchauva keima chondan jouse le chonna dan aboncha, nun le khan tohthoa nanit jing diu ahi, hichu nit ding chua kona hinna ahiye, ajeh chu keima Pakai chu kahi.
English: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am the LORD.

tcz: Nangho jouse leh pasal kiti phot in aki naipi ainko ham chu, ajotlut a anih ahopeh louhel ding ahi. Pakai le Pathen keima kaum jing e.
en: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 18:6
Thadou: Nangho jouse leh pasal kiti phot in aki naipi ainko ham chu, ajotlut a anih ahopeh louhel ding ahi. Pakai le Pathen keima kaum jing e.
English: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.

tcz: Nanu sagoh keoham, napa delchen nasut peh thei louhel ding, nanu nih chen le sil jong naho peh thei louhel ding ahi; ajeh chu ama nahingnu ahin, nangman anih chu naho peh louhel ding ahi.
en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
text:
LEV 18:7
Thadou: Nanu sagoh keoham, napa delchen nasut peh thei louhel ding, nanu nih chen le sil jong naho peh thei louhel ding ahi; ajeh chu ama nahingnu ahin, nangman anih chu naho peh louhel ding ahi.
English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

tcz: Napa jinu nih chen jong naho lou ding, hichu nabol khah ngai ngai leh napa delchen nasut tobang ahi.
en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.
text:
LEV 18:8
Thadou: Napa jinu nih chen jong naho lou ding, hichu nabol khah ngai ngai leh napa delchen nasut tobang ahi.
English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.

tcz: Napa akona na numei channu hihen, nanu akona numei chanu hi jongleh, hiche na sopi numei chu insung akona peng hihen kholgama kona peng hijong leh, anih naho peh louhel ding ahi.
en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or born abroad.
text:
LEV 18:9
Thadou: Napa akona na numei channu hihen, nanu akona numei chanu hi jongleh, hiche na sopi numei chu insung akona peng hihen kholgama kona peng hijong leh, anih naho peh louhel ding ahi.
English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or born abroad.

tcz: Na chapate chanu, na tunu te ham khat chu anih na hopeh louhel ding ahi; ajeh chu na tute nihchen na hodoh peh chu nangma le nangmaa kihoh doh peh tobang nahi.
en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.
text:
LEV 18:10
Thadou: Na chapate chanu, na tunu te ham khat chu anih na hopeh louhel ding ahi; ajeh chu na tute nihchen na hodoh peh chu nangma le nangmaa kihoh doh peh tobang nahi.
English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.

tcz: Nangman napa jinu chanu ham, napa akona hungpeng numei chu anih naho peh louhel ding ahi, hiche nu chu na sopinu ahi.
en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.
text:
LEV 18:11
Thadou: Nangman napa jinu chanu ham, napa akona hungpeng numei chu anih naho peh louhel ding ahi, hiche nu chu na sopinu ahi.
English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.

tcz: Nangman napa sopi numei jeng jong anih na hodoh peh louhel ding ahi, hiche nu chu napa dings sopi kinai cha ahi.
en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.
text:
LEV 18:12
Thadou: Nangman napa sopi numei jeng jong anih na hodoh peh louhel ding ahi, hiche nu chu napa dings sopi kinai cha ahi.
English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.

tcz: Nanu sopi numei jong anih nahopeh thei louhel ding, nanu akona asopi numei akinai picha ahibouve.
en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.
text:
LEV 18:13
Thadou: Nanu sopi numei jong anih nahopeh thei louhel ding, nanu akona asopi numei akinai picha ahibouve.
English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.

tcz: Napa sopipa delchen jong nalhep peh lou ding, ajinu jong nanailut thei lou ding ahi, ajeh chu nang dia nanu ngahnu ahi.
en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.
text:
LEV 18:14
Thadou: Napa sopipa delchen jong nalhep peh lou ding, ajinu jong nanailut thei lou ding ahi, ajeh chu nang dia nanu ngahnu ahi.
English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.

tcz: Namou nu jeng jong anih na hodoh lou ding ahi, ajeh chu amanu hi nangma chapa dia ajinu ahin, anih na hodoh thei louhel ding ahi.
en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
text:
LEV 18:15
Thadou: Namou nu jeng jong anih na hodoh lou ding ahi, ajeh chu amanu hi nangma chapa dia ajinu ahin, anih na hodoh thei louhel ding ahi.
English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

tcz: Na sopipa jinu nih jong na hodoh peh thei lou ding, ajeh chu amanu chu na sopipa nabolna tobang bang hi ding ahi.
en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.
text:
LEV 18:16
Thadou: Na sopipa jinu nih jong na hodoh peh thei lou ding, ajeh chu amanu chu na sopipa nabolna tobang bang hi ding ahi.
English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.

tcz: Numei khat chu anih na hodoh pehtah jong leh, achanu chu anih na hopeh louhel ding ahi; chule hiche numei nu chapa le chanu hihen achanu hijong leh, anih hodoh dia na kipui thei lou ding, amaho cheng chu nangdia na kinaipi tikhat nahiuvin, hichu nabol khah tah leh gitlounaa chon chu na hitai.
en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.
text:
LEV 18:17
Thadou: Numei khat chu anih na hodoh pehtah jong leh, achanu chu anih na hopeh louhel ding ahi; chule hiche numei nu chapa le chanu hihen achanu hijong leh, anih hodoh dia na kipui thei lou ding, amaho cheng chu nangdia na kinaipi tikhat nahiuvin, hichu nabol khah tah leh gitlounaa chon chu na hitai.
English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.

tcz: Chule numei khat chu asopinu dam lai sung sea, asopinu chu anih hodoh peh dia napui thei louhel ding ahi.
en: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.
text:
LEV 18:18
Thadou: Chule numei khat chu asopinu dam lai sung sea, asopinu chu anih hodoh peh dia napui thei louhel ding ahi.
English: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.

tcz: Numei chu a thinei pet a na nai lut a anih na hopeh lou hel ding ahiye.
en: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.
text:
LEV 18:19
Thadou: Numei chu a thinei pet a na nai lut a anih na hopeh lou hel ding ahiye.
English: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

tcz: Nangman kiphal theng tah dana na in hengpa jinu chu luppi ding lung na vop lou hel ding, amanu chutoh chonset a na lhalut a na kisuh boh thei lou ding ahi.
en: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.
text:
LEV 18:20
Thadou: Nangman kiphal theng tah dana na in hengpa jinu chu luppi ding lung na vop lou hel ding, amanu chutoh chonset a na lhalut a na kisuh boh thei lou ding ahi.
English: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

tcz: Na chate khat a khat cha jong meiya govam ding chule Molech adia na todoh lou hel ding, hiche hoa kona chu na Pakai le Pathen min nasuh thang theilou ding ahi, ajeh chu keima Pathen kahi.
en: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 18:21
Thadou: Na chate khat a khat cha jong meiya govam ding chule Molech adia na todoh lou hel ding, hiche hoa kona chu na Pakai le Pathen min nasuh thang theilou ding ahi, ajeh chu keima Pathen kahi.
English: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

tcz: Pasal hi numei tobang banga na luppi thei louhel ding, hichu thet umtah thil bol ahi.
en: “‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.
text:
LEV 18:22
Thadou: Pasal hi numei tobang banga na luppi thei louhel ding, hichu thet umtah thil bol ahi.
English: “‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.

tcz: Kiphal theng tah dana gancha nanai lut a na luppi lou hel ding ahi, hitobang chu chonset ahibouve, numei jeng jong kiphal thengtah a gancha angsunga kona kido louhel ding ahi, hichu conset lah a gitlouna lenpen khat ahi.
en: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.
text:
LEV 18:23
Thadou: Kiphal theng tah dana gancha nanai lut a na luppi lou hel ding ahi, hitobang chu chonset ahibouve, numei jeng jong kiphal thengtah a gancha angsunga kona kido louhel ding ahi, hichu conset lah a gitlouna lenpen khat ahi.
English: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.

tcz: Hichengsea kon hin nangho chonset a lhalut hihhel un, ajeh chu keima tah in nang ho masang a namtin vaipi kadohna chu hitobanga ana chonset khah jih-u ahi.
en: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.
text:
LEV 18:24
Thadou: Hichengsea kon hin nangho chonset a lhalut hihhel un, ajeh chu keima tah in nang ho masang a namtin vaipi kadohna chu hitobanga ana chonset khah jih-u ahi.
English: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.

tcz: Hitia chu gamle leiset jong ana suhboh uva ahitai; hichea kona chu themmo channa talent kamat sah ahin, hitobanga chu agam leiset a cheng mite jouse jong acham loua kitol mang ahitauve.
en: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.
text:
LEV 18:25
Thadou: Hitia chu gamle leiset jong ana suhboh uva ahitai; hichea kona chu themmo channa talent kamat sah ahin, hitobanga chu agam leiset a cheng mite jouse jong acham loua kitol mang ahitauve.
English: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.

tcz: Nanghon nabonchauva keima chonna dan ngai le ka chonna jouse hi nit soh keiyun; agama cheng hihen ahilouleh, nalah uva kona hung kholjin hijong leh, hitia thet umtah thil ho hi khat a khat cha jong nabol thei louhel diu ahi.
en: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you
text:
LEV 18:26
Thadou: Nanghon nabonchauva keima chonna dan ngai le ka chonna jouse hi nit soh keiyun; agama cheng hihen ahilouleh, nalah uva kona hung kholjin hijong leh, hitia thet umtah thil ho hi khat a khat cha jong nabol thei louhel diu ahi.
English: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you

tcz: Ajeh chu thil thet umtah hicheng jouse hi, nang ho masanga cheng mite nana bolu ahitan; hiti chun agam jeng jong ana suboh tauvin ahi.
en: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),
text:
LEV 18:27
Thadou: Ajeh chu thil thet umtah hicheng jouse hi, nang ho masanga cheng mite nana bolu ahitan; hiti chun agam jeng jong ana suboh tauvin ahi.
English: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),

tcz: Tun nanghon agam hi suboh kit leuchun, nangho masanga ana cheng namtin vaipi te bang banga chu nache doh jeng diu ahi.
en: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
text:
LEV 18:28
Thadou: Tun nanghon agam hi suboh kit leuchun, nangho masanga ana cheng namtin vaipi te bang banga chu nache doh jeng diu ahi.
English: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

tcz: Koihi jongleh hitobang thil thet umtah'a kona chonkha aum ngai ngai leh, hitobang bol kha mihem chu nang ho jouse lah akona pampeiya um jeng ding ahi.
en: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.
text:
LEV 18:29
Thadou: Koihi jongleh hitobang thil thet umtah'a kona chonkha aum ngai ngai leh, hitobang bol kha mihem chu nang ho jouse lah akona pampeiya um jeng ding ahi.
English: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

tcz: Keima thupeh hi nanit jeng diu, namasang uva mite nana bolsau thet umtah chondan chengse hi, nabol louhel diu ahi, hichea kon chun kisuboh hihhel un, Keima hi nangho Pakai le na Pathen u-kahi, ati.
en: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am the LORD your God.’”
text:
LEV 18:30
Thadou: Keima thupeh hi nanit jeng diu, namasang uva mite nana bolsau thet umtah chondan chengse hi, nabol louhel diu ahi, hichea kon chun kisuboh hihhel un, Keima hi nangho Pakai le na Pathen u-kahi, ati.
English: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am the LORD your God.’”

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in Mose henga hiti hinaseipeh in ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 19:1
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in Mose henga hiti hinaseipeh in ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jouse kikhop khomnaa hiti hin seipeh tan, na Pakai le na Pathenu keima then bang banga hi nangho jong nathen diu ahi.
en: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, the LORD your God, am holy.
text:
LEV 19:2
Thadou: Israel chate jouse kikhop khomnaa hiti hin seipeh tan, na Pakai le na Pathenu keima then bang banga hi nangho jong nathen diu ahi.
English: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, the LORD your God, am holy.

tcz: Nalah uva koi hileh nu le pa jabolna nanei cheh diu, keima cholngahna nikho jeng jong nanit cheh diu ahi, keima hi na Pakai ule na Pathenu kahi.
en: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.
text:
LEV 19:3
Thadou: Nalah uva koi hileh nu le pa jabolna nanei cheh diu, keima cholngahna nikho jeng jong nanit cheh diu ahi, keima hi na Pakai ule na Pathenu kahi.
English: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.

tcz: Milim doi kisem thu houhih hel un, milim doi jong semthua jabolna chansah di gohih hel un, Pakai le na Pathenu keima kaum e.
en: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.
text:
LEV 19:4
Thadou: Milim doi kisem thu houhih hel un, milim doi jong semthua jabolna chansah di gohih hel un, Pakai le na Pathenu keima kaum e.
English: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.

tcz: Nanghon chamna thilto ahin, kilhaina gantha ahin Pakai henglama katdoh ding nanop uva ahileh, nangma cheh jong santhei dolin kisemtoh masauvin lang, chuteng hichu nakat doh diu ahi.
en: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.
text:
LEV 19:5
Thadou: Nanghon chamna thilto ahin, kilhaina gantha ahin Pakai henglama katdoh ding nanop uva ahileh, nangma cheh jong santhei dolin kisemtoh masauvin lang, chuteng hichu nakat doh diu ahi.
English: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.

tcz: Nathil to chengseu chu akikat doh nikhoa neh chai ding, ajing nikho chan kat ding neh thei pai hiding, hitia chu nithum lhinni geiya amoh chengse chu aboncha meiya govam ding ahi.
en: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.
text:
LEV 19:6
Thadou: Nathil to chengseu chu akikat doh nikhoa neh chai ding, ajing nikho chan kat ding neh thei pai hiding, hitia chu nithum lhinni geiya amoh chengse chu aboncha meiya govam ding ahi.
English: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.

tcz: Nithum lhin nikhoa hiche thilto nekha chan chun, athil kitoh doh chu thet umtah ahitan, santhei dol ahitapoi.
en: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;

tcz: Chule koi hijong leh hiche sa nekha chan chun ama cheh in themmona akipoh ding ahi; ajeh chu aman Pakaiya thiltheng asuh thang ahitan, ama chu amite lah akona pampaiya um ding ahi.
en: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of the LORD, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.
text:
LEV 19:8
Thadou: Chule koi hijong leh hiche sa nekha chan chun ama cheh in themmona akipoh ding ahi; ajeh chu aman Pakaiya thiltheng asuh thang ahitan, ama chu amite lah akona pampaiya um ding ahi.
English: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of the LORD, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

tcz: Chule nanghon leiset gasoh nachop khom teng uleh, nalou beh uchu apam chin geiya nachop khom lou diu, chule changphal jeng jong changpal geiya chom lou ding ahi.
en: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.
text:
LEV 19:9
Thadou: Chule nanghon leiset gasoh nachop khom teng uleh, nalou beh uchu apam chin geiya nachop khom lou diu, chule changphal jeng jong changpal geiya chom lou ding ahi.
English: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

tcz: Chule na lengpigui jong ngimsela nachom lou ding, na lengpi lei laiya lengpithei ajam thang ho jouse jong nalo ngim lou ding ahi, hichengse chu vaichate le kholjin hodia nakhen tei ding ahi, keima hi Pakai na Pathenu kahi.
en: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.
text:
LEV 19:10
Thadou: Chule na lengpigui jong ngimsela nachom lou ding, na lengpi lei laiya lengpithei ajam thang ho jouse jong nalo ngim lou ding ahi, hichengse chu vaichate le kholjin hodia nakhen tei ding ahi, keima hi Pakai na Pathenu kahi.
English: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.

tcz: Guchat kiti bol hih hel un, koi hijong leu chun naheng nakom cheh u jouva nabol louhel diu ahi.
en: “‘You shall not steal. “‘You shall not lie. “‘You shall not deceive one another.
text:
LEV 19:11
Thadou: Guchat kiti bol hih hel un, koi hijong leu chun naheng nakom cheh u jouva nabol louhel diu ahi.
English: “‘You shall not steal. “‘You shall not lie. “‘You shall not deceive one another.

tcz: Keima min pana jouthua koima nalhep lhah louhel diu, hiche hoa chu na Pathen min nasuhchat veilou ding ahi; keima hi Pakai kahi.
en: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 19:12
Thadou: Keima min pana jouthua koima nalhep lhah louhel diu, hiche hoa chu na Pathen min nasuhchat veilou ding ahi; keima hi Pakai kahi.
English: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

tcz: Nang man naheng nakom nachoma nasuhgim thei lou ding, thalah soh natoh man jong pelouva najan khovah sah lou ding, peh ding dol napeh ding ahi, keima hi Pakai chu kahi.
en: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.
text:
LEV 19:13
Thadou: Nang man naheng nakom nachoma nasuhgim thei lou ding, thalah soh natoh man jong pelouva najan khovah sah lou ding, peh ding dol napeh ding ahi, keima hi Pakai chu kahi.
English: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.

tcz: Na-ngong mi jong nagaosap louhel ding chule mitcho masang jenga jong aki pallhuh nathei ima nakoi lou ding, hiche ho sanga chu na Pathen gin ding hi na thupi sah ding ahi, keima hi Pakai chu kahi.
en: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 19:14
Thadou: Na-ngong mi jong nagaosap louhel ding chule mitcho masang jenga jong aki pallhuh nathei ima nakoi lou ding, hiche ho sanga chu na Pathen gin ding hi na thupi sah ding ahi, keima hi Pakai chu kahi.
English: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.

tcz: Nanghon thu natan teng uleh adih louvin tanding go hihhel un, vaichaho chunga langneina nanei ham, ahilouleh milen ho chunga jong khentumna ima nabol louding ahi. Ahinlah thu chu adihtah a naheng nakom chunga natan ding ahi.
en: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.
text:
LEV 19:15
Thadou: Nanghon thu natan teng uleh adih louvin tanding go hihhel un, vaichaho chunga langneina nanei ham, ahilouleh milen ho chunga jong khentumna ima nabol louding ahi. Ahinlah thu chu adihtah a naheng nakom chunga natan ding ahi.
English: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.

tcz: Nangma mikah lah a thuse polea chesuh chetou nabol louhel ding, chule naheng nakom jeng jong athi nathei ding nagela na kidou pithei lou ding ahi. Keima Pakai in ka umpi jing uve.
en: “‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 19:16
Thadou: Nangma mikah lah a thuse polea chesuh chetou nabol louhel ding, chule naheng nakom jeng jong athi nathei ding nagela na kidou pithei lou ding ahi. Keima Pakai in ka umpi jing uve.
English: “‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.

tcz: Na lungthim sung akona naheng nakom na thetbol lou ding, hiti sang chun naheng nakom in atohmo thudola phatah a naki houlimpi joh ding ahi, ajeh chu achunga phatlouna lhung thei ahi.
en: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.
text:
LEV 19:17
Thadou: Na lungthim sung akona naheng nakom na thetbol lou ding, hiti sang chun naheng nakom in atohmo thudola phatah a naki houlimpi joh ding ahi, ajeh chu achunga phatlouna lhung thei ahi.
English: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

tcz: Nangman namite lah a kona achapateu chunga phulahna nabol lou ding, tahsa lunghimona jong nei hihhel in, chuti sang chun nangma na kingailut banga, naheng nakom nangailut ding ahi, keima Pakai ka umjing e.
en: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 19:18
Thadou: Nangman namite lah a kona achapateu chunga phulahna nabol lou ding, tahsa lunghimona jong nei hihhel in, chuti sang chun nangma na kingailut banga, naheng nakom nangailut ding ahi, keima Pakai ka umjing e.
English: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.

tcz: Na bonchauva keima chonna dan jouse nanit soh kei diu ahi, na gancha hochu jatchom chom na kitimat sah a, na kingai sah louhel ding, na loulai jenga jong muchi jatchom chom na tuhel lou ding, chule ponsil jatchom cheh a kikhui von na tahsa chunga navon louhel ding ahi.
en: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals. “‘You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; “‘Don’t wear a garment made of two kinds of material.
text:
LEV 19:19
Thadou: Na bonchauva keima chonna dan jouse nanit soh kei diu ahi, na gancha hochu jatchom chom na kitimat sah a, na kingai sah louhel ding, na loulai jenga jong muchi jatchom chom na tuhel lou ding, chule ponsil jatchom cheh a kikhui von na tahsa chunga navon louhel ding ahi.
English: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals. “‘You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; “‘Don’t wear a garment made of two kinds of material.

tcz: Pasal koi hileh huh jeh a numeiya kicho doh loulai, chamlhatna jong kipe nailou, ahinlah pasal chom khat toh kitepsa khat chu aluppi tah a ahilea, hichu phatah a kholtoh masat a, anumeinu chu chamlhatna kichansah nailou ahin. hijeh achu thina chan mochan sah lou ding ahi.
en: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
text:
LEV 19:20
Thadou: Pasal koi hileh huh jeh a numeiya kicho doh loulai, chamlhatna jong kipe nailou, ahinlah pasal chom khat toh kitepsa khat chu aluppi tah a ahilea, hichu phatah a kholtoh masat a, anumeinu chu chamlhatna kichansah nailou ahin. hijeh achu thina chan mochan sah lou ding ahi.
English: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

tcz: Hiche mihempa chun athemmo thilto ding, ama ding mong monga kikhop khomna ponbuh kotpi maiya Pakai angsunga ahin kai lut ding, hichea themmona thilto ding chu kelngoi chal khat hi ding ahi.
en: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.
text:
LEV 19:21
Thadou: Hiche mihempa chun athemmo thilto ding, ama ding mong monga kikhop khomna ponbuh kotpi maiya Pakai angsunga ahin kai lut ding, hichea themmona thilto ding chu kelngoi chal khat hi ding ahi.
English: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.

tcz: Hiche themmona thilto hiche mipa chun abol jeh achu, thempu pan jong themmona thilto kelchal chu Pakai angsunga thoidamna anei peh ding, hichea chu chonset abol khahna akona ngaidamna chang ding ahi.
en: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he has committed; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.
text:
LEV 19:22
Thadou: Hiche themmona thilto hiche mipa chun abol jeh achu, thempu pan jong themmona thilto kelchal chu Pakai angsunga thoidamna anei peh ding, hichea chu chonset abol khahna akona ngaidamna chang ding ahi.
English: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he has committed; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.

tcz: Na bonchauva gamsung nahung lutteng uleh, thing agathei natu jouseu aga masa chengse chu mihem chep kitan peh banga nagel diu, kumthum sunga thingga jouse chu cheptan lou ahitia, nagel cheh diu ahi. Hiche thingga hochu koiman aneh thei lou lai ding ahi.
en: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.
text:
LEV 19:23
Thadou: Na bonchauva gamsung nahung lutteng uleh, thing agathei natu jouseu aga masa chengse chu mihem chep kitan peh banga nagel diu, kumthum sunga thingga jouse chu cheptan lou ahitia, nagel cheh diu ahi. Hiche thingga hochu koiman aneh thei lou lai ding ahi.
English: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.

tcz: Kumli ahung lhin teng chule hiche kuma chu thingga jouse aboncha, Pakai angsunga thangvahna kut khat a thensona um cheh ding ahi.
en: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to the LORD.
text:
LEV 19:24
Thadou: Kumli ahung lhin teng chule hiche kuma chu thingga jouse aboncha, Pakai angsunga thangvahna kut khat a thensona um cheh ding ahi.
English: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to the LORD.

tcz: Chule kum nga lhin teng thingga jouse chu naneh thei diu, nanghon gamga jouse chu nangma nangma ding cheh a nakilo lhah jeng thei u ahitai. Pakai na Pathenu keima kaum jing e.
en: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am the LORD your God.
text:
LEV 19:25
Thadou: Chule kum nga lhin teng thingga jouse chu naneh thei diu, nanghon gamga jouse chu nangma nangma ding cheh a nakilo lhah jeng thei u ahitai. Pakai na Pathenu keima kaum jing e.
English: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am the LORD your God.

tcz: Nanghon ipisa hitaleh athisan pum in netha hihhel un, phun jong sanghih unlang mitpheldoi kiti jong choi hih hel un.
en: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.
text:
LEV 19:26
Thadou: Nanghon ipisa hitaleh athisan pum in netha hihhel un, phun jong sanghih unlang mitpheldoi kiti jong choi hih hel un.
English: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.

tcz: Nachal samu jong som hih unlang, nabeng mul-u jong among lamse natan thei lou diu ahi.
en: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.
text:
LEV 19:27
Thadou: Nachal samu jong som hih unlang, nabeng mul-u jong among lamse natan thei lou diu ahi.
English: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.

tcz: Mithi hojeh in natahsa chungu atpop ding go hih unlang, na tahsa na tichung hou na atkeh louhel diu, na tahsa cheh uchu milim hoa khat chan nasem thei lou diu ahi, Pakai kitipa keima kaum jing e.
en: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 19:28
Thadou: Mithi hojeh in natahsa chungu atpop ding go hih unlang, na tahsa na tichung hou na atkeh louhel diu, na tahsa cheh uchu milim hoa khat chan nasem thei lou diu ahi, Pakai kitipa keima kaum jing e.
English: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am the LORD.

tcz: Na chanu chu aki joh a pansah ding got dan lang, na kisuh bohsah louhel ding ahi, achuti louva ahileh gamsung pumpi jeng jong akijoh a pang ding, hitia chu gamsung pumpi phatlounan ahinlo jeng thei ahi.
en: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.
text:
LEV 19:29
Thadou: Na chanu chu aki joh a pansah ding got dan lang, na kisuh bohsah louhel ding ahi, achuti louva ahileh gamsung pumpi jeng jong akijoh a pang ding, hitia chu gamsung pumpi phatlounan ahinlo jeng thei ahi.
English: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.

tcz: Keima cholngah nikho jouse chu nanit cheh diu, keima muntheng jong jabolna nanei jing diu ahi. Keima na Pathenu chu kahi.
en: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 19:30
Thadou: Keima cholngah nikho jouse chu nanit cheh diu, keima muntheng jong jabolna nanei jing diu ahi. Keima na Pathenu chu kahi.
English: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am the LORD.

tcz: Doithem hole lhagao phalou ho heng jong jon louvin don jong don hih un, hiche hochu gellut daovin lang, hiche hochun kisuboh khaget un nate, Pakai na Pathenu keima kaum jing e.
en: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.
text:
LEV 19:31
Thadou: Doithem hole lhagao phalou ho heng jong jon louvin don jong don hih un, hiche hochu gellut daovin lang, hiche hochun kisuboh khaget un nate, Pakai na Pathenu keima kaum jing e.
English: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.

tcz: Tehse lukang jabolna napeh a amasanga na dindoh ding, upa masanga jong jabolna nanei ding chule Pakai na Pathen jong nagin jing ding ahi, keima Pakai kahi.
en: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 19:32
Thadou: Tehse lukang jabolna napeh a amasanga na dindoh ding, upa masanga jong jabolna nanei ding chule Pakai na Pathen jong nagin jing ding ahi, keima Pakai kahi.
English: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.

tcz: Kholgam mi khattou toh nagam sunga kholjin khomna nanei leh, nabonchauvin hiche kholjin mi chu aphalouva nabol thei lou diu ahi.
en: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.
text:
LEV 19:33
Thadou: Kholgam mi khattou toh nagam sunga kholjin khomna nanei leh, nabonchauvin hiche kholjin mi chu aphalouva nabol thei lou diu ahi.
English: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.

tcz: Na lah uva hung kholjin le kholgam mi chu nalah uva kona peng doh banga umjing ding, hiche kholjinpa chu nangma cheh na kingai bang bang uva nangailut cheh diu ahi, ajeh chu nabonchauva Egypt gamsunga ana kholjinsa nahi tauve, Pakai na Pathenu keima kahi jing e.
en: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
text:
LEV 19:34
Thadou: Na lah uva hung kholjin le kholgam mi chu nalah uva kona peng doh banga umjing ding, hiche kholjinpa chu nangma cheh na kingai bang bang uva nangailut cheh diu ahi, ajeh chu nabonchauva Egypt gamsunga ana kholjinsa nahi tauve, Pakai na Pathenu keima kahi jing e.
English: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

tcz: Thu natannau mun jouse, ipiham khat tou adung avai natenau ahin chule thil ajat nasim nau hijong leh, adih louva nabol louhel diu ahi.
en: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
text:
LEV 19:35
Thadou: Thu natannau mun jouse, ipiham khat tou adung avai natenau ahin chule thil ajat nasim nau hijong leh, adih louva nabol louhel diu ahi.
English: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.

tcz: Lep toh le ding thil jouse jong dihtah a kitoh del dela nakoi diu, thil agih tena jong adihtah naman diu, ephah jong akitoh chet chet naman diu adihtah chu naman diu ahi, keima hi Pakai na Pathenu kahin, Egypt gam'a kona nahin puigal kaipau chu kahi jing e.
en: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
text:
LEV 19:36
Thadou: Lep toh le ding thil jouse jong dihtah a kitoh del dela nakoi diu, thil agih tena jong adihtah naman diu, ephah jong akitoh chet chet naman diu adihtah chu naman diu ahi, keima hi Pakai na Pathenu kahin, Egypt gam'a kona nahin puigal kaipau chu kahi jing e.
English: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

tcz: Hijeh chun nabonvchauvin keima chonna dan jouse kachon dan aboncha keiya na jui uva, nabol jing diu ahi, keima Pakai kahi jing e, ati.
en: “‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am the LORD.’”
text:
LEV 19:37
Thadou: Hijeh chun nabonvchauvin keima chonna dan jouse kachon dan aboncha keiya na jui uva, nabol jing diu ahi, keima Pakai kahi jing e, ati.
English: “‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am the LORD.’”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose jah a hiti hin aseipeh in ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 20:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose jah a hiti hin aseipeh in ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jah in seipeh tan, Israel chate lah a mihem kiti phot hihen, chule ahung kholjin kholgam mi hijongle achateu Molech houna dia tohdoh aumleh, thina chang jeng ding, amapa chu gamsung cheng miten songa aselih jeng ding ahi.
en: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.
text:
LEV 20:2
Thadou: Israel chate jah in seipeh tan, Israel chate lah a mihem kiti phot hihen, chule ahung kholjin kholgam mi hijongle achateu Molech houna dia tohdoh aumleh, thina chang jeng ding, amapa chu gamsung cheng miten songa aselih jeng ding ahi.
English: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.

tcz: Chule hitobang mihem chu keiman jong kaki doupi ding, amite lah akona hitobang mihem chu paidoh a umjeng ding ahi; ajeh chu aman asunga kona pengdoh khat chu Molech houna din akatdoh in, hichun keima muntheng asuh boh ahitan, kamin jong asuh chatvei ahi.
en: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
text:
LEV 20:3
Thadou: Chule hitobang mihem chu keiman jong kaki doupi ding, amite lah akona hitobang mihem chu paidoh a umjeng ding ahi; ajeh chu aman asunga kona pengdoh khat chu Molech houna din akatdoh in, hichun keima muntheng asuh boh ahitan, kamin jong asuh chatvei ahi.
English: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

tcz: Ahilou jongleh gamsung cheng miten, hichepan achate Molech houna dinga akatdoh chu akimu mosah khah uva, thana chan dinmuna kona ahoidoh sah khah tah ule,
en: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,
text:
LEV 20:4
Thadou: Ahilou jongleh gamsung cheng miten, hichepan achate Molech houna dinga akatdoh chu akimu mosah khah uva, thana chan dinmuna kona ahoidoh sah khah tah ule,
English: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,

tcz: Kei matah in hichepa douna chung chona ainsung mite dounaa kahung kilah jeng ding, amajong chule ama nungjuia pang Molech houna'a kimangcha akijoh sese chu abonchauva, amite lah uva kona kapampai jeng ding ahi.
en: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.
text:
LEV 20:5
Thadou: Kei matah in hichepa douna chung chona ainsung mite dounaa kahung kilah jeng ding, amajong chule ama nungjuia pang Molech houna'a kimangcha akijoh sese chu abonchauva, amite lah uva kona kapampai jeng ding ahi.
English: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.

tcz: Mihem koitobang lhagao dihlou hole doithempuho tahsanna neiya amaho juiya apan khah leh, amaho nung ajuiya akijoh ho chona achon tah ahileh, keimatah in hitobang chonna akona chu kamai kahin lah jeng ding, hitia chu ama chu amite lah akona pampaiya um jeng ding ahi.
en: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.
text:
LEV 20:6
Thadou: Mihem koitobang lhagao dihlou hole doithempuho tahsanna neiya amaho juiya apan khah leh, amaho nung ajuiya akijoh ho chona achon tah ahileh, keimatah in hitobang chonna akona chu kamai kahin lah jeng ding, hitia chu ama chu amite lah akona pampaiya um jeng ding ahi.
English: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.

tcz: Nang ma cheh kithenso unlang atheng in umdoh jeng tauvin, ajeh chu keima Pakai na Pathenu chu kahi.
en: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am the LORD your God.
text:
LEV 20:7
Thadou: Nang ma cheh kithenso unlang atheng in umdoh jeng tauvin, ajeh chu keima Pakai na Pathenu chu kahi.
English: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am the LORD your God.

tcz: Chule kachonna dan jouse nanitsoh kei uva, hichengse chu nanjui cheh diu ahi, keima nangho jouse sutheng na Pakai uchu kahiye.
en: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
text:
LEV 20:8
Thadou: Chule kachonna dan jouse nanitsoh kei uva, hichengse chu nanjui cheh diu ahi, keima nangho jouse sutheng na Pakai uchu kahiye.
English: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

tcz: Koi hileh nalah uva apa ham anu ham, gaosapna neiya naum uva ahileh, amachu thina chang ding ahi, aman amapa ahilou leh amanu agaosap tah jeh chun, athisan chu ama chunga chu ding ahi.
en: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon himself.
text:
LEV 20:9
Thadou: Koi hileh nalah uva apa ham anu ham, gaosapna neiya naum uva ahileh, amachu thina chang ding ahi, aman amapa ahilou leh amanu agaosap tah jeh chun, athisan chu ama chunga chu ding ahi.
English: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon himself.

tcz: Pasal koi hileh aheng akompa jinu chu achonset pikhah tah leh, ajongpa ahin ajonpinu jaonaa anilhona thana chan chang lhon ding ahi.
en: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
text:
LEV 20:10
Thadou: Pasal koi hileh aheng akompa jinu chu achonset pikhah tah leh, ajongpa ahin ajonpinu jaonaa anilhona thana chan chang lhon ding ahi.
English: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

tcz: Koi hileh apa jinu toh lumkhom aumkhah le ama chun apa delchen alhep peh ahitan, ani lhona thina chang jeng lhon ding, thisan soman jong ama nin achung cheh lhona akipoh lhon ding ahi.
en: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
text:
LEV 20:11
Thadou: Koi hileh apa jinu toh lumkhom aumkhah le ama chun apa delchen alhep peh ahitan, ani lhona thina chang jeng lhon ding, thisan soman jong ama nin achung cheh lhona akipoh lhon ding ahi.
English: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

tcz: Amounu luppi pasal aum khah jongleh, amapa ahin amounu jong ani lhonna thina chang jeng lhon ding ahi, ajeh chu chonset gitlouna chu abol khah lhon ahitan, thisan soman jong achung cheh lhona akipoh lhon ding ahi.
en: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
text:
LEV 20:12
Thadou: Amounu luppi pasal aum khah jongleh, amapa ahin amounu jong ani lhonna thina chang jeng lhon ding ahi, ajeh chu chonset gitlouna chu abol khah lhon ahitan, thisan soman jong achung cheh lhona akipoh lhon ding ahi.
English: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

tcz: Numei kilup khompi bang banga pasal khat chun pasal khat a luppi tah a ahileh, thet umtah'a chonkha ahilhon tan, ani lhona thina chansah jeng ding, athisan kisona lhon kisona chu ama cheh in akipoh lhon ding ahi.
en: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
text:
LEV 20:13
Thadou: Numei kilup khompi bang banga pasal khat chun pasal khat a luppi tah a ahileh, thet umtah'a chonkha ahilhon tan, ani lhona thina chansah jeng ding, athisan kisona lhon kisona chu ama cheh in akipoh lhon ding ahi.
English: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

tcz: Numei khat jaonaa anu jong ji dinga akipui tha khah a ahileh, hiche pasalpa chun thilphalou chungnung abol khah ahitan, pasalpa jaonaa numei teni ahin, abonchauva meiya govam heldiu, ajeh chu nalah uva hitobang thilse avela aum kit louna ding ahi.
en: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.
text:
LEV 20:14
Thadou: Numei khat jaonaa anu jong ji dinga akipui tha khah a ahileh, hiche pasalpa chun thilphalou chungnung abol khah ahitan, pasalpa jaonaa numei teni ahin, abonchauva meiya govam heldiu, ajeh chu nalah uva hitobang thilse avela aum kit louna ding ahi.
English: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.

tcz: Ama kiphal thengtah a gancha lup khom pi pasal kiti chu thadoh jeng ding ahi, a kitimatpi gancha jeng jong chu natha doh jeng diu ahi.
en: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.
text:
LEV 20:15
Thadou: Ama kiphal thengtah a gancha lup khom pi pasal kiti chu thadoh jeng ding ahi, a kitimatpi gancha jeng jong chu natha doh jeng diu ahi.
English: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.

tcz: Gancha kitiphot koma gachea ki timatsah ding gela kido numei chu, gancha ahin numeinu ahin natha jeng ding, hitia chu ani tah lhona thana nachan sah a, athisan lhon sona chu amani chung cheh a mo akipoh lhon ding ahi.
en: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.
text:
LEV 20:16
Thadou: Gancha kitiphot koma gachea ki timatsah ding gela kido numei chu, gancha ahin numeinu ahin natha jeng ding, hitia chu ani tah lhona thana nachan sah a, athisan lhon sona chu amani chung cheh a mo akipoh lhon ding ahi.
English: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.

tcz: A sopinu apa chanu ham ahilouleh anu chanu ham kipui aumleh, apan amanu chu anih alhap peh ding amanun apa del alhep peh ding, pasal pan jong sagoh keova aum chu avet a, numei nun jong hichepa sagohkeova aumchu avet peh khah tah leh, hichu jachat na lah a jachat sangpen ahitan, hitia aum khah lhontah jeh achu achate ahilouleh amite lah akona pampaiya um jeng ding ahilone, hichepa chun asopinu nih alhep lhah peh ahitan themmona chu aman akipoh ding ahi.
en: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.
text:
LEV 20:17
Thadou: A sopinu apa chanu ham ahilouleh anu chanu ham kipui aumleh, apan amanu chu anih alhap peh ding amanun apa del alhep peh ding, pasal pan jong sagoh keova aum chu avet a, numei nun jong hichepa sagohkeova aumchu avet peh khah tah leh, hichu jachat na lah a jachat sangpen ahitan, hitia aum khah lhontah jeh achu achate ahilouleh amite lah akona pampaiya um jeng ding ahilone, hichepa chun asopinu nih alhep lhah peh ahitan themmona chu aman akipoh ding ahi.
English: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.

tcz: Numei in phat ngai banga thi aneiya, hiche pet achu pasal in alup pia ahileh, anih alheppeh a sagoh keova alupsah a ahileh, hichepa chun numei thisan hung potdoh sagoh keova alupsah ahin, chule amanu jong athisan lonlai tah a lumlha jeng ahitan, hijeh achu hiche teni chu amite lah’a kona pampaiya um jeng lhon ding ahi.
en: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness, he has made her fountain naked, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
text:
LEV 20:18
Thadou: Numei in phat ngai banga thi aneiya, hiche pet achu pasal in alup pia ahileh, anih alheppeh a sagoh keova alupsah a ahileh, hichepa chun numei thisan hung potdoh sagoh keova alupsah ahin, chule amanu jong athisan lonlai tah a lumlha jeng ahitan, hijeh achu hiche teni chu amite lah’a kona pampaiya um jeng lhon ding ahi.
English: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness, he has made her fountain naked, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

tcz: Nanu sopinu ham na pa sopinu ham nih chu na sut theilou hel ding, hitia kibol chu a inko puma akeova ajam ahitan; hitia chon ho chun themmona ama cheh in akipoh diu ahi.
en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister, for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity.
text:
LEV 20:19
Thadou: Nanu sopinu ham na pa sopinu ham nih chu na sut theilou hel ding, hitia kibol chu a inko puma akeova ajam ahitan; hitia chon ho chun themmona ama cheh in akipoh diu ahi.
English: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister, for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity.

tcz: Apaneo jinu luppi pasal chun apaneo del asutpeh tobang ahitan, hiche pasalpa le numeinu chun achonset lhon akipoh cheh lhon ding, cha hingthei louva thi lhon ding ahi.
en: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.
text:
LEV 20:20
Thadou: Apaneo jinu luppi pasal chun apaneo del asutpeh tobang ahitan, hiche pasalpa le numeinu chun achonset lhon akipoh cheh lhon ding, cha hingthei louva thi lhon ding ahi.
English: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.

tcz: Asopipa jinu jidia kipui pasal aum khah tah leh, hichepa chun dihlouna aboldoh ahitan, hichepa chun asopipa delchen asut ahitan, hijeh a chu numeinu jaonaa anilhona thi jeng ding ahi lhone.
en: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.
text:
LEV 20:21
Thadou: Asopipa jinu jidia kipui pasal aum khah tah leh, hichepa chun dihlouna aboldoh ahitan, hichepa chun asopipa delchen asut ahitan, hijeh a chu numeinu jaonaa anilhona thi jeng ding ahi lhone.
English: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.

tcz: Nabon chauvin keima chondan le ka chondan jouse najui sohkei diu, aboncha keiya nabol tahtah diu ahi, chuteng na chenna diu gamsung ka puilut nauva kona hi kapaidoh lou ding nahiuve.
en: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.
text:
LEV 20:22
Thadou: Nabon chauvin keima chondan le ka chondan jouse najui sohkei diu, aboncha keiya nabol tahtah diu ahi, chuteng na chenna diu gamsung ka puilut nauva kona hi kapaidoh lou ding nahiuve.
English: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.

tcz: Chule nangho masanga kana paidoh namtin le vaipi ho chonna bang chun, chon hihhel un; ajeh chu hitobang hoa chonna hinkho ana mantah jeh un, keima adia amaho chu thet umtah anahi tauve.
en: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
text:
LEV 20:23
Thadou: Chule nangho masanga kana paidoh namtin le vaipi ho chonna bang chun, chon hihhel un; ajeh chu hitobang hoa chonna hinkho ana mantah jeh un, keima adia amaho chu thet umtah anahi tauve.
English: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

tcz: Hiti hojeh a chu najah uva ka seipeh nahiuve, amaho chenna gampumpi nanghon nalosoh uva, keiman jong hiche gam'a bongnoi le khoiju lonna hi nalo nadiuva kapeh nahi tauve, tia kasei ahi. Namtin vaipi lah a nangho atuma lheng doh achu na Pakaiyu le na Pathenu keima hi kahi.
en: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am the LORD your God, who has separated you from the peoples.
text:
LEV 20:24
Thadou: Hiti hojeh a chu najah uva ka seipeh nahiuve, amaho chenna gampumpi nanghon nalosoh uva, keiman jong hiche gam'a bongnoi le khoiju lonna hi nalo nadiuva kapeh nahi tauve, tia kasei ahi. Namtin vaipi lah a nangho atuma lheng doh achu na Pakaiyu le na Pathenu keima hi kahi.
English: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am the LORD your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

tcz: Hijeh chun na bonchauvin satheng le satheng lou chu hom khen unlang, vacha atheng ahin athenglou ho nakhen diu; hitia chu hiche ganhing ho ahin, vachate ahin tollhanga kithol tho hijong leh khat a khat cha nakisuh boh thei lou diu ahi, hichengse hi athenglou aboh a kase khen sa ahi.
en: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean. You shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.
text:
LEV 20:25
Thadou: Hijeh chun na bonchauvin satheng le satheng lou chu hom khen unlang, vacha atheng ahin athenglou ho nakhen diu; hitia chu hiche ganhing ho ahin, vachate ahin tollhanga kithol tho hijong leh khat a khat cha nakisuh boh thei lou diu ahi, hichengse hi athenglou aboh a kase khen sa ahi.
English: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean. You shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.

tcz: Na bonchauva keima dia athenga naum diu, keima hi Pakai kitipa athenga um chu kahin, keima mite nahi na diuva namtin le vaipi lah akona kalhen dohsa chu nahi tauve.
en: You shall be holy to me, for I, the LORD, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.
text:
LEV 20:26
Thadou: Na bonchauva keima dia athenga naum diu, keima hi Pakai kitipa athenga um chu kahin, keima mite nahi na diuva namtin le vaipi lah akona kalhen dohsa chu nahi tauve.
English: You shall be holy to me, for I, the LORD, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.

tcz: Pasal hihen numei hileh lhagao phalou vop a pang ham, mitphel doithem ham, ani gela thina chansah jeng ding ahi lhone, songa selih jeng ding, athisan sona jal'a mona jong ama ho chung cheh a lechuh ding ahi, ati.
en: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.’”
text:
LEV 20:27
Thadou: Pasal hihen numei hileh lhagao phalou vop a pang ham, mitphel doithem ham, ani gela thina chansah jeng ding ahi lhone, songa selih jeng ding, athisan sona jal'a mona jong ama ho chung cheh a lechuh ding ahi, ati.
English: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.’”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin aseipeh in, keiman kathupeh chengse hi Aaron chapate thempuho jah a seipeh tan. “Thempu koi hileh aheng akom thivuina kina, panga kisuboh thei lou ding ahi.”
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,
text:
LEV 21:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin aseipeh in, keiman kathupeh chengse hi Aaron chapate thempuho jah a seipeh tan. “Thempu koi hileh aheng akom thivuina kina, panga kisuboh thei lou ding ahi.”
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,

tcz: Inko khat akinaipi hichu anu ham, apa ham, achanu ham chule asopipa ham ahikhah louleh,
en: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,
text:
LEV 21:2
Thadou: Inko khat akinaipi hichu anu ham, apa ham, achanu ham chule asopipa ham ahikhah louleh,
English: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,

tcz: Asopinu chu nungah laileh atheng hinalai ahileh, hichenu chu ajipa um nailou ahin, amadia jong insungkhat a umnalai ahin, asopinu chunga vang hi athilong aop a kisuhboh thei ahi.
en: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.
text:
LEV 21:3
Thadou: Asopinu chu nungah laileh atheng hinalai ahileh, hichenu chu ajipa um nailou ahin, amadia jong insungkhat a umnalai ahin, asopinu chunga vang hi athilong aop a kisuhboh thei ahi.
English: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.

tcz: Pasal khat mipa dinmun ahinunga amite lah a kisuh boh louhel ding, amale ama jeng jong kisunoh phah lou ding ahi.
en: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
text:
LEV 21:4
Thadou: Pasal khat mipa dinmun ahinunga amite lah a kisuh boh louhel ding, amale ama jeng jong kisunoh phah lou ding ahi.
English: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

tcz: Amahon aluchang-u akihotol thei loudiu, abeng mul jeng ujong akivo chai lou diu, chule atahsa jeng ujong timaha umthei lou ding ahi.
en: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.
text:
LEV 21:5
Thadou: Amahon aluchang-u akihotol thei loudiu, abeng mul jeng ujong akivo chai lou diu, chule atahsa jeng ujong timaha umthei lou ding ahi.
English: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.

tcz: Abonchauva Pathen adia atheng hidiu, a Pathen pau min asuh thang louhel diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho hin a Pathen pau nehdia changlhah thilto jouse Pakai lama ahinto doh jio ahin, hijeh achu amaho hi athenga umdiu ahi.
en: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.
text:
LEV 21:6
Thadou: Abonchauva Pathen adia atheng hidiu, a Pathen pau min asuh thang louhel diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho hin a Pathen pau nehdia changlhah thilto jouse Pakai lama ahinto doh jio ahin, hijeh achu amaho hi athenga umdiu ahi.
English: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.

tcz: Numei aki johsa kiti jong akichen pithei lou diu, ajipa khat in adalhahsa numei jong chu akichenpi thei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu hiche thempu chu a Pathen pa dia atheng ahi.
en: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.
text:
LEV 21:7
Thadou: Numei aki johsa kiti jong akichen pithei lou diu, ajipa khat in adalhahsa numei jong chu akichenpi thei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu hiche thempu chu a Pathen pa dia atheng ahi.
English: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.

tcz: Nangman ama chu thensona nanei peh a, ajeh chu amapan na Pathen adia changlhah atodohji ahin, amajong nangdia atheng ahin, hiche jouse chunga hin nangho thensoa pang Pakai keima hi, atheng jing kahi.
en: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I the LORD, who sanctify you, am holy.
text:
LEV 21:8
Thadou: Nangman ama chu thensona nanei peh a, ajeh chu amapan na Pathen adia changlhah atodohji ahin, amajong nangdia atheng ahin, hiche jouse chunga hin nangho thensoa pang Pakai keima hi, atheng jing kahi.
English: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I the LORD, who sanctify you, am holy.

tcz: Chule thempupa chanu chu akijoh a apan khah a ama le ama akisuh boh khah tah leh, hiche nu chun apa jeng jong asuhboh ahitan, hitia chon numei kiti phot chu meiya govam hel ding ahi.
en: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.
text:
LEV 21:9
Thadou: Chule thempupa chanu chu akijoh a apan khah a ama le ama akisuh boh khah tah leh, hiche nu chun apa jeng jong asuhboh ahitan, hitia chon numei kiti phot chu meiya govam hel ding ahi.
English: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.

tcz: Chule asopi holah a thempu chungnung penpa, angaiya alua kinu thaotwi kinusa, vontheng ngena kivon dinga thenso nachang khat chun, asam alhaiya putda henlang, aponsil jong akehlai aumsah lou ding ahi.
en: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.
text:
LEV 21:10
Thadou: Chule asopi holah a thempu chungnung penpa, angaiya alua kinu thaotwi kinusa, vontheng ngena kivon dinga thenso nachang khat chun, asam alhaiya putda henlang, aponsil jong akehlai aumsah lou ding ahi.
English: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.

tcz: Apa hihen anu hijongleh mithi long anailut a, ama le ama kisuboh thei louhel ding ahi.
en: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.
text:
LEV 21:11
Thadou: Apa hihen anu hijongleh mithi long anailut a, ama le ama kisuboh thei louhel ding ahi.
English: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.

tcz: Muntheng lai chu adalhah'a hiche muntheng chu asuhboh thei louhel ding ahi, ajeh chu amahi a Pathen akona thensona thaotwi akinu chu achunga akipoh le ahitan, keima Pakai chu kahi.
en: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 21:12
Thadou: Muntheng lai chu adalhah'a hiche muntheng chu asuhboh thei louhel ding ahi, ajeh chu amahi a Pathen akona thensona thaotwi akinu chu achunga akipoh le ahitan, keima Pakai chu kahi.
English: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am the LORD.

tcz: Chule amapan jong aji ding nu chu, nungah theng ahiphat a akipui ding ahi.
en: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.
text:
LEV 21:13
Thadou: Chule amapan jong aji ding nu chu, nungah theng ahiphat a akipui ding ahi.
English: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.

tcz: Meithai hihen akidasa hijong leh, chule akisubohsa numei hihen akijohsa hijong leh, amaho tobang chu thempu pan ji dinga akipui thei louhel ding, amaji ding chu amite lah a kon mong mong nungah thengset akipui ding ahi.
en: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.
text:
LEV 21:14
