Thadou: Meithai hihen akidasa hijong leh, chule akisubohsa numei hihen akijohsa hijong leh, amaho tobang chu thempu pan ji dinga akipui thei louhel ding, amaji ding chu amite lah a kon mong mong nungah thengset akipui ding ahi.
English: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.

tcz: Hichu abol teng amite lah a chu ama chate jeng jong asuhboh tah lou ding, ajeh chu amapa thensoa pang chu keima Pakai kahi, ati.
en: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.’”
text:
LEV 21:15
Thadou: Hichu abol teng amite lah a chu ama chate jeng jong asuhboh tah lou ding, ajeh chu amapa thensoa pang chu keima Pakai kahi, ati.
English: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.’”

tcz: Chule Pakaiyin Mose hengah thu aseiyin, hiti hin bolin, ati.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 21:16
Thadou: Chule Pakaiyin Mose hengah thu aseiyin, hiti hin bolin, ati.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Aaron jah a seipeh tan, nason na chilhah teho chu akhang akhang uva, abonchauva atahsa chunga losapna nei jouse a Pathen dinga changlhah tohdoh dia hungsung lha thei lou ding ahiuve.
en: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.
text:
LEV 21:17
Thadou: Aaron jah a seipeh tan, nason na chilhah teho chu akhang akhang uva, abonchauva atahsa chunga losapna nei jouse a Pathen dinga changlhah tohdoh dia hungsung lha thei lou ding ahiuve.
English: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.

tcz: Koi hileh tahsaa losapna nei chu, amitcho hihen, a elbai hihen, anah jom hihen atumpoh hijong leh,
en: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,
text:
LEV 21:18
Thadou: Koi hileh tahsaa losapna nei chu, amitcho hihen, a elbai hihen, anah jom hihen atumpoh hijong leh,
English: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

tcz: Mi koi hileh akeng phang ham ahilouleh, akhut kisuh boh ahikhah a,
en: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,
text:
LEV 21:19
Thadou: Mi koi hileh akeng phang ham ahilouleh, akhut kisuh boh ahikhah a,
English: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,

tcz: Chule atingbong ham adung nem amitkho mulou, tiphah natna ham, atibol lha jeng ham atilchang kisuh keh aum leh,
en: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.
text:
LEV 21:20
Thadou: Chule atingbong ham adung nem amitkho mulou, tiphah natna ham, atibol lha jeng ham atilchang kisuh keh aum leh,
English: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.

tcz: Aaron chapate lah a kona hitobang atibukim lou puma, Pakai dia pumgo thilto tohdoh a pangthei louhel diu ahi, amapa tahsa chu aboh nei ahitan, hijeh achu a Pathen dia changlhah tohdoh a hungsung lhate hi louhel ding ahi.
en: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.
text:
LEV 21:21
Thadou: Aaron chapate lah a kona hitobang atibukim lou puma, Pakai dia pumgo thilto tohdoh a pangthei louhel diu ahi, amapa tahsa chu aboh nei ahitan, hijeh achu a Pathen dia changlhah tohdoh a hungsung lhate hi louhel ding ahi.
English: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

tcz: Ama chun a Pathen dia changlhah kitoh doh chu aneh thei ding, thil thengho chule atheng pen thil dang ho jong chu aneh thei ding ahinai,
en: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
text:
LEV 21:22
Thadou: Ama chun a Pathen dia changlhah kitoh doh chu aneh thei ding, thil thengho chule atheng pen thil dang ho jong chu aneh thei ding ahinai,
English: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

tcz: Ahinlah pondal phung hung lut a maicham phung jeng jong ajotpa louhel ding ahi, ajeh chu atibah kimlou ahitan, keima muntheng penchu asuhboh louhel ding ahi. Thempu jouse sutheng chu keima bou kahi, ati.
en: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”
text:
LEV 21:23
Thadou: Ahinlah pondal phung hung lut a maicham phung jeng jong ajotpa louhel ding ahi, ajeh chu atibah kimlou ahitan, keima muntheng penchu asuhboh louhel ding ahi. Thempu jouse sutheng chu keima bou kahi, ati.
English: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

tcz: Hicheng jouse hi abonchan, Mose’n Aaron ahin Aaron chapate jouse jah a anathupeh tan ahi.
en: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.
text:
LEV 21:24
Thadou: Hicheng jouse hi abonchan, Mose’n Aaron ahin Aaron chapate jouse jah a anathupeh tan ahi.
English: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga, thu hiti hin aseipeh tan ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 22:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga, thu hiti hin aseipeh tan ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Aaron leh achapate henga seipeh unlang kamin theng asuhboh louna diuvin, Israel chate akona thiltheng aboncha keima lama ahin katdoh a houva kona akidalsena diuvin seipeh in, keima Pakai kahi.
en: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 22:2
Thadou: Aaron leh achapate henga seipeh unlang kamin theng asuhboh louna diuvin, Israel chate akona thiltheng aboncha keima lama ahin katdoh a houva kona akidalsena diuvin seipeh in, keima Pakai kahi.
English: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am the LORD.

tcz: Hiti hin seipeh tauvin, nanghon nakhang nakhang uva nachilhah teu chan geiya, then louna chang puma Israel chate jousen thil theng kitiphot ajot a asung lhah jeng a ahileh; amachu ka angsung akona paidoh a um jeng ding ahi, ajeh chu keima Pakai chu kahi.
en: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 22:3
Thadou: Hiti hin seipeh tauvin, nanghon nakhang nakhang uva nachilhah teu chan geiya, then louna chang puma Israel chate jousen thil theng kitiphot ajot a asung lhah jeng a ahileh; amachu ka angsung akona paidoh a um jeng ding ahi, ajeh chu keima Pakai chu kahi.
English: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am the LORD.

tcz: Aaron chilhah kitiphot koima chan miphah hihen, athi long puma natna thoh hijongleh athen kahsea thil theng cheng chu aneh loubeh ding ahi. Koi hijong leh hiche hi thil thenglou ahitai tia, ahivanga tongkha nah nah chun mithi long tongkha hihen botwi potdoh jeh a athenglou ahitia kisei tongkha aum jongleh,
en: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,
text:
LEV 22:4
Thadou: Aaron chilhah kitiphot koima chan miphah hihen, athi long puma natna thoh hijongleh athen kahsea thil theng cheng chu aneh loubeh ding ahi. Koi hijong leh hiche hi thil thenglou ahitai tia, ahivanga tongkha nah nah chun mithi long tongkha hihen botwi potdoh jeh a athenglou ahitia kisei tongkha aum jongleh,
English: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,

tcz: Aop lhanga kithol tho ipi ganhing hile aboh ahitia, ahivanga tongkha chule athenlouna akon kilason thei asuh khahna akon aboh aum thei hijongleh, mihem a dia aboh ahina thei kiti poupou chu,
en: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—
text:
LEV 22:5
Thadou: Aop lhanga kithol tho ipi ganhing hile aboh ahitia, ahivanga tongkha chule athenlouna akon kilason thei asuh khahna akon aboh aum thei hijongleh, mihem a dia aboh ahina thei kiti poupou chu,
English: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—

tcz: Koi hileh hiche tongkha pen pen chu nilhum keiya aboh a um jeng ding, atibah pumpi twi a kisil lha ding achuti louva ahileh, hiche mihem chun thiltheng kiti aneh thei lou ding ahi.
en: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.
text:
LEV 22:6
Thadou: Koi hileh hiche tongkha pen pen chu nilhum keiya aboh a um jeng ding, atibah pumpi twi a kisil lha ding achuti louva ahileh, hiche mihem chun thiltheng kiti aneh thei lou ding ahi.
English: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.

tcz: Chule nisa alhum teng levang ama chu athenga umkit ding ahitai, hitia chu thiltheng hojong aneh thei ding ahi, ajeh chu aboncha amapa dia chu hinna anneh a anei ahi.
en: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
text:
LEV 22:7
Thadou: Chule nisa alhum teng levang ama chu athenga umkit ding ahitai, hitia chu thiltheng hojong aneh thei ding ahi, ajeh chu aboncha amapa dia chu hinna anneh a anei ahi.
English: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

tcz: Koi hileh sa thikam ahilouleh gamsa hang in athasa kiti phot aneh lou ding, hichu ne-in ama leh ama kisuboh hih hel hen, keima Pakai kahi, ati.
en: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 22:8
Thadou: Koi hileh sa thikam ahilouleh gamsa hang in athasa kiti phot aneh lou ding, hichu ne-in ama leh ama kisuboh hih hel hen, keima Pakai kahi, ati.
English: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am the LORD.

tcz: Hitia chu kathu lhah hi phatecha anitsoh keidiu, hichu ahilouva ahileh abonchauva chonset anei khah teidiu, thiltheng chu ahin suhkhah teng uleh, thina chan achung'uva lhung ding, amaho jouse suthenga Pakai chu keima hi kahi, ati.
en: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
text:
LEV 22:9
Thadou: Hitia chu kathu lhah hi phatecha anitsoh keidiu, hichu ahilouva ahileh abonchauva chonset anei khah teidiu, thiltheng chu ahin suhkhah teng uleh, thina chan achung'uva lhung ding, amaho jouse suthenga Pakai chu keima hi kahi, ati.
English: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

tcz: Thiltheng kiti phot ahung gamvaikon hon aneh theilou ding, thempu koma hung kholjin hihen asoh thagoi hijeng jong leh thiltheng chu aneh thei lou ding ahi.
en: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
text:
LEV 22:10
Thadou: Thiltheng kiti phot ahung gamvaikon hon aneh theilou ding, thempu koma hung kholjin hihen asoh thagoi hijeng jong leh thiltheng chu aneh thei lou ding ahi.
English: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

tcz: Thempupa dia asoh ham, suma achohdohsa ham, ahilouleh ama insung tah a pengden ham vang chun thempupa dia kipe neh leh chah hochu nethei nante.
en: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.
text:
LEV 22:11
Thadou: Thempupa dia asoh ham, suma achohdohsa ham, ahilouleh ama insung tah a pengden ham vang chun thempupa dia kipe neh leh chah hochu nethei nante.
English: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.

tcz: Thempupa chanu ham khat chu thempu hilou khat toh akichen leh, thilto thengho aneh thei lou ding ahi.
en: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.
text:
LEV 22:12
Thadou: Thempupa chanu ham khat chu thempu hilou khat toh akichen leh, thilto thengho aneh thei lou ding ahi.
English: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

tcz: Meithainu ham, akidasa numei ham, cha hinglouva um hichu apa inlama hung kile kit a apa jeng jong kingainaa neikit chu, thempu hina jal’in apan amu thil chengse vang chu aneh thei ding ahi. Hitia chu thempu insung kon hon bou hitobang thilto hohi aneh thei ding ahi.
en: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but no stranger shall eat any of it.
text:
LEV 22:13
Thadou: Meithainu ham, akidasa numei ham, cha hinglouva um hichu apa inlama hung kile kit a apa jeng jong kingainaa neikit chu, thempu hina jal’in apan amu thil chengse vang chu aneh thei ding ahi. Hitia chu thempu insung kon hon bou hitobang thilto hohi aneh thei ding ahi.
English: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but no stranger shall eat any of it.

tcz: Thempu insung hilou ima hetoh louva thilto thengho nekha aum leh, amachun aneh doh jat man thempupa henga alepeh ding, hitia chu aman jat mong mong jakhat a somni to apeh tha jeng ding ahi.
en: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.
text:
LEV 22:14
Thadou: Thempu insung hilou ima hetoh louva thilto thengho nekha aum leh, amachun aneh doh jat man thempupa henga alepeh ding, hitia chu aman jat mong mong jakhat a somni to apeh tha jeng ding ahi.
English: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

tcz: Thempuhon thilto theng Israelten Pakai henga ahinto houchu, asuhboh thei lou diu ahi.
en: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to the LORD,
text:
LEV 22:15
Thadou: Thempuhon thilto theng Israelten Pakai henga ahinto houchu, asuhboh thei lou diu ahi.
English: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to the LORD,

tcz: Nehsah dia lomlou ho anehsah da jeng diu, hitobang chu aneh sah angai ule themmona chule talent matnaa kibol doh jeng thei diu ahi. Keima Pakai chu kahin, thilto jouse sutheng pachu kahi, ati.
en: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”
text:
LEV 22:16
Thadou: Nehsah dia lomlou ho anehsah da jeng diu, hitobang chu aneh sah angai ule themmona chule talent matnaa kibol doh jeng thei diu ahi. Keima Pakai chu kahin, thilto jouse sutheng pachu kahi, ati.
English: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseipeh in.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 22:17
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseipeh in.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Abana kisei chondan jouse hi aboncha Aaron le achapate chule Israelte seipeh ding in athumop tan ahi. Israel ham ahilouleh Israel gamsunga ahung cheng midang koiham khat chun pumgo thilto ato tengleh, deilhen thilto hihen, kinepna dia lolhinsah ding thilto hi jongleh, hichu nolna beihel gancha bou ato thei ding ahi.
en: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to the LORD for a burnt offering:
text:
LEV 22:18
Thadou: Abana kisei chondan jouse hi aboncha Aaron le achapate chule Israelte seipeh ding in athumop tan ahi. Israel ham ahilouleh Israel gamsunga ahung cheng midang koiham khat chun pumgo thilto ato tengleh, deilhen thilto hihen, kinepna dia lolhinsah ding thilto hi jongleh, hichu nolna beihel gancha bou ato thei ding ahi.
English: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to the LORD for a burnt offering:

tcz: Santhei ding dol chu ahileh achal hi ding, hichu nolna beihel hiding ahi.
en: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.
text:
LEV 22:19
Thadou: Santhei ding dol chu ahileh achal hi ding, hichu nolna beihel hiding ahi.
English: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.

tcz: Nolna nei gancha tohdoh chu Pakai adia santhei dol hilou ding ahi.
en: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.
text:
LEV 22:20
Thadou: Nolna nei gancha tohdoh chu Pakai adia santhei dol hilou ding ahi.
English: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.

tcz: Kitepna bulhitsahna ham, deilhen tum adia thilto ham, Pakai heng lama kikhop khomna dia katdoh chun nolnabei ato le bou santhei dol hiding ahi.
en: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.
text:
LEV 22:21
Thadou: Kitepna bulhitsahna ham, deilhen tum adia thilto ham, Pakai heng lama kikhop khomna dia katdoh chun nolnabei ato le bou santhei dol hiding ahi.
English: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.

tcz: Gancha amit khomu lou ham, a elbai ham, ati bukim lou ham, atiphah ham, atibol ham, apat ham khat chu Pakai dinga nato doh thei louhel diu ahi. Thilto doh chu neh le chah ding ahijeh'in, hitobang hohi maicham phunga pehda jeng uvin, ati.
en: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD.
text:
LEV 22:22
Thadou: Gancha amit khomu lou ham, a elbai ham, ati bukim lou ham, atiphah ham, atibol ham, apat ham khat chu Pakai dinga nato doh thei louhel diu ahi. Thilto doh chu neh le chah ding ahijeh'in, hitobang hohi maicham phunga pehda jeng uvin, ati.
English: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD.

tcz: Deilhen chombeh thilto din natna neiya, akhang theilou tibu kimlou hi jongleh todoh jeng thei ahi. Ahinlah hitobang hochu kitepna molso nadia vang santhei dol ahipoi.
en: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
text:
LEV 22:23
Thadou: Deilhen chombeh thilto din natna neiya, akhang theilou tibu kimlou hi jongleh todoh jeng thei ahi. Ahinlah hitobang hochu kitepna molso nadia vang santhei dol ahipoi.
English: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

tcz: Gancha atil kilasa ahin, akisukeh saham, akigot kehsa ham chu, Pakai henga nato lou diu ahi. Hitobang chondan kiti hi, nangho gamsunga najom thei lou diu ahi.
en: You must not offer to the LORD that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.
text:
LEV 22:24
Thadou: Gancha atil kilasa ahin, akisukeh saham, akigot kehsa ham chu, Pakai henga nato lou diu ahi. Hitobang chondan kiti hi, nangho gamsunga najom thei lou diu ahi.
English: You must not offer to the LORD that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.

tcz: Gamchom mi akona kichosa gancha kiti chu nehthei ding thilto kitia nakatdoh lou diu, hitobang gancha hi nolnaa dim jeng ahin, santhei dol ahipoi.
en: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”
text:
LEV 22:25
Thadou: Gamchom mi akona kichosa gancha kiti chu nehthei ding thilto kitia nakatdoh lou diu, hitobang gancha hi nolnaa dim jeng ahin, santhei dol ahipoi.
English: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”

tcz: Ni sagi jou teng leh vang, hichu neh leh chah thilto dinga santhei dol hibep ding ahi.
en: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to the LORD.
text:
LEV 22:27
Thadou: Ni sagi jou teng leh vang, hichu neh leh chah thilto dinga santhei dol hibep ding ahi.
English: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to the LORD.

tcz: Nikhat sung chun bongpi anou jaonan chule kelngoi api chutoh, kelpi le anou chu ki lhaina nabol kop louhel diu ahi.
en: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
text:
LEV 22:28
Thadou: Nikhat sung chun bongpi anou jaonan chule kelngoi api chutoh, kelpi le anou chu ki lhaina nabol kop louhel diu ahi.
English: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

tcz: Pakai lama thangvah thilto na katdoh teng uleh, santhei ahina tei ding in, abol ding dan kisem jouse hi abonchan jui cheh un,
en: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
text:
LEV 22:29
Thadou: Pakai lama thangvah thilto na katdoh teng uleh, santhei ahina tei ding in, abol ding dan kisem jouse hi abonchan jui cheh un,
English: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

tcz: Hiti chun nathilto doh nikho mama chun nechai jeng un, ajing nikho chan in naneh moh houchu khen hih hel un,
en: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 22:30
Thadou: Hiti chun nathilto doh nikho mama chun nechai jeng un, ajing nikho chan in naneh moh houchu khen hih hel un,
English: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am the LORD.

tcz: Pakiyin aseiye, ka thupeh chengse bol un ajeh chu keima Pakai kahi, ati.
en: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 22:31
Thadou: Pakiyin aseiye, ka thupeh chengse bol un ajeh chu keima Pakai kahi, ati.
English: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am the LORD.

tcz: Ka mintheng hi suthang hih hel un, Israel pumpin kathen dan joh seiphong hen, keima Pakai chu kahin, keiman ka suhtheng nahiuve, ati.
en: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am the LORD who makes you holy,
text:
LEV 22:32
Thadou: Ka mintheng hi suthang hih hel un, Israel pumpin kathen dan joh seiphong hen, keima Pakai chu kahin, keiman ka suhtheng nahiuve, ati.
English: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am the LORD who makes you holy,

tcz: Nangho Pathen hina dia Egypt gam'a kona kahin pui galkai nahi tauvin, keima Pakai chu kahi, ati.
en: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am the LORD.”
text:
LEV 22:33
Thadou: Nangho Pathen hina dia Egypt gam'a kona kahin pui galkai nahi tauvin, keima Pakai chu kahi, ati.
English: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am the LORD.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseiyin, hiti hin bolin, ati.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 23:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseiyin, hiti hin bolin, ati.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jouse jah a seipeh tan, Pakai dia phat tepsa kut na bonchauva atheng ahitia na phondoh cheh diu, keima dia hiche phat tepsa kut ho chu ahileh,
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.
text:
LEV 23:2
Thadou: Israel chate jouse jah a seipeh tan, Pakai dia phat tepsa kut na bonchauva atheng ahitia na phondoh cheh diu, keima dia hiche phat tepsa kut ho chu ahileh,
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

tcz: Nigup sunga mihon na akitoh cheh ding, nisagi lhinni vang chu imacha bol louva ki choldo nikhoa nanei cheh diu, hichu thengsel'a kikhop nikhoa ding ahi, hiche nikho kitia hi natoh nabol thei louhel diu ahi. Hoilai chana cheng jong leu chun, hiche nikho hi kicholdo nikhoa nanit jing diuva thupeh ahi.
en: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.
text:
LEV 23:3
Thadou: Nigup sunga mihon na akitoh cheh ding, nisagi lhinni vang chu imacha bol louva ki choldo nikhoa nanei cheh diu, hichu thengsel'a kikhop nikhoa ding ahi, hiche nikho kitia hi natoh nabol thei louhel diu ahi. Hoilai chana cheng jong leu chun, hiche nikho hi kicholdo nikhoa nanit jing diuva thupeh ahi.
English: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.

tcz: Hicheng hi Pakaiya dia phat ana kitepsa kikhop khomna theng chu ahin, hitobang nikho jousea hi aphat kitepsa dung juicheh a, nanghon mi nakou khom diu ahi.
en: “‘These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.
text:
LEV 23:4
Thadou: Hicheng hi Pakaiya dia phat ana kitepsa kikhop khomna theng chu ahin, hitobang nikho jousea hi aphat kitepsa dung juicheh a, nanghon mi nakou khom diu ahi.
English: “‘These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

tcz: Lhamasa nisom le nili lhin nikho, hiche nilhah lam vang chu Pakai dia kalchuh kut hiding ahi.
en: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is the LORD’s Passover.
text:
LEV 23:5
Thadou: Lhamasa nisom le nili lhin nikho, hiche nilhah lam vang chu Pakai dia kalchuh kut hiding ahi.
English: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is the LORD’s Passover.

tcz: Chule hiche lhasung nisom le ninga lhinni chu, Pakai dia cholsolou changlhah kut nikho ding ahin, ni sagi sung vang chun chol solou changlhah tang loua naneh diu ahi.
en: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
text:
LEV 23:6
Thadou: Chule hiche lhasung nisom le ninga lhinni chu, Pakai dia cholsolou changlhah kut nikho ding ahin, ni sagi sung vang chun chol solou changlhah tang loua naneh diu ahi.
English: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

tcz: Nikho masapen nileh na bonchauva khompi theng naman diu, lel nathei na natoh lou diu ahi.
en: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
text:
LEV 23:7
Thadou: Nikho masapen nileh na bonchauva khompi theng naman diu, lel nathei na natoh lou diu ahi.
English: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

tcz: Ni sagi sungsea chu Pakai dia govam thil tang louva na katdoh diu, ni sagi lhin nikho vangleh khompi theng nikho ahitan, hiche nikho tengchu leh na bonchauva na kichol diu lelna thei na natoh lou diu ahi.
en: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”
text:
LEV 23:8
Thadou: Ni sagi sungsea chu Pakai dia govam thil tang louva na katdoh diu, ni sagi lhin nikho vangleh khompi theng nikho ahitan, hiche nikho tengchu leh na bonchauva na kichol diu lelna thei na natoh lou diu ahi.
English: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu asei peh in, hiti hin bol in, ati.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 23:9
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu asei peh in, hiti hin bol in, ati.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate henga ajah uva hiti hin seiyin, keiman kapeh nau gamsung nahin phah uva gamga soh nahin lo teng uleh, nachangphal gao masapen chu thempupa lama nachoi diu ahi.
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.
text:
LEV 23:10
Thadou: Israel chate henga ajah uva hiti hin seiyin, keiman kapeh nau gamsung nahin phah uva gamga soh nahin lo teng uleh, nachangphal gao masapen chu thempupa lama nachoi diu ahi.
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.

tcz: Hichea kona chu thempu pan nangho santhei dol nahi thei nadiuva nathenso diu, ajing nikho cholngah ni teng leh thempu pan thensona anei ding ahi.
en: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.
text:
LEV 23:11
Thadou: Hichea kona chu thempu pan nangho santhei dol nahi thei nadiuva nathenso diu, ajing nikho cholngah ni teng leh thempu pan thensona anei ding ahi.
English: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

tcz: Hiche thensona kibol nikhoa changpal nakatdoh teng uleh, kelngoinou achal khat jong Pakaiya dia nolnabei hel chu nakat doh tha diu ahi.
en: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD.
text:
LEV 23:12
Thadou: Hiche thensona kibol nikhoa changpal nakatdoh teng uleh, kelngoinou achal khat jong Pakaiya dia nolnabei hel chu nakat doh tha diu ahi.
English: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD.

tcz: Hiche nikhoa lhosohga katdoh ding chu, suhlou changbong neldisel Ephah khat dim, hopsoma hopni kiso ding; hichu thaotwi toh kihal, Pakaiya dia gimnamtui sela govam ding, don ding lengpithei jong chu khon dimkhat hoplia kona hopkhat chu hichea ding chu ahi.
en: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
text:
LEV 23:13
Thadou: Hiche nikhoa lhosohga katdoh ding chu, suhlou changbong neldisel Ephah khat dim, hopsoma hopni kiso ding; hichu thaotwi toh kihal, Pakaiya dia gimnamtui sela govam ding, don ding lengpithei jong chu khon dimkhat hoplia kona hopkhat chu hichea ding chu ahi.
English: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

tcz: Chule hiche nikho masang chun, na Pathen pa diuva thilto ding nahin pohlut kahseo vin, changlhah jong nehdao vinlang, chang kikang poh ahin changlhah kigou tho jong nehdauvin, hoilai chana cheng jong leuchun hicheng hi nakhang nakhang uva chonna dan in jui jing un.
en: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
text:
LEV 23:14
Thadou: Chule hiche nikho masang chun, na Pathen pa diuva thilto ding nahin pohlut kahseo vin, changlhah jong nehdao vinlang, chang kikang poh ahin changlhah kigou tho jong nehdauvin, hoilai chana cheng jong leuchun hicheng hi nakhang nakhang uva chonna dan in jui jing un.
English: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

tcz: Cholngah nikho aki chai apat, changpal nahin choi uva, thensona thilto nabol nikho uva pat nikho nasim cheh cheh diu, hapta sagi chan nasim diu ahi.
en: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.
text:
LEV 23:15
Thadou: Cholngah nikho aki chai apat, changpal nahin choi uva, thensona thilto nabol nikho uva pat nikho nasim cheh cheh diu, hapta sagi chan nasim diu ahi.
English: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.

tcz: Cholngah nikho vel sagi chan geiya nasim uva chule ajing nikho nisomnga lhin changeiya nasim tha diu, chujou tengleh Pakai heng lama lhosohga thilto nakatdoh diu ahi.
en: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD.
text:
LEV 23:16
Thadou: Cholngah nikho vel sagi chan geiya nasim uva chule ajing nikho nisomnga lhin changeiya nasim tha diu, chujou tengleh Pakai heng lama lhosohga thilto nakatdoh diu ahi.
English: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD.

tcz: Na inson cheh uva pat Ephah dim khat cheh hopsom lah a, hopnia kikhen thenso thilto dinga changlhah lhonsao ni jaona nahin choi diu ahi, hiche teni chu cholsosa ahin, Pakaiya dia lhohsoga masapen thiltoa pang ding ahi.
en: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD.
text:
LEV 23:17
Thadou: Na inson cheh uva pat Ephah dim khat cheh hopsom lah a, hopnia kikhen thenso thilto dinga changlhah lhonsao ni jaona nahin choi diu ahi, hiche teni chu cholsosa ahin, Pakaiya dia lhohsoga masapen thiltoa pang ding ahi.
English: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD.

tcz: Chule hiche changlhah jaona chu kumkhat lhing tasa nolna beihel kelngoi sagi, bongchal golpai khat, kelngoi chal ni jaona nakat doh uva, hiche gancha ho chu Pakaiya dia pumgo thiltoa kimang ding gimnamtui sela meiya govam ding ahi.
en: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to the LORD, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to the LORD.
text:
LEV 23:18
Thadou: Chule hiche changlhah jaona chu kumkhat lhing tasa nolna beihel kelngoi sagi, bongchal golpai khat, kelngoi chal ni jaona nakat doh uva, hiche gancha ho chu Pakaiya dia pumgo thiltoa kimang ding gimnamtui sela meiya govam ding ahi.
English: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to the LORD, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to the LORD.

tcz: Chonset thilto ding in kelchal khat mang unlang, chamna thilto le gantha ki lhaina dinga kum khat a tah kelchal ni nahin kat diu ahi.
en: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
text:
LEV 23:19
Thadou: Chonset thilto ding in kelchal khat mang unlang, chamna thilto le gantha ki lhaina dinga kum khat a tah kelchal ni nahin kat diu ahi.
English: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

tcz: Chule hicheng ho chu thempu pan Pakai angsunga thensona anei ding, lhosohga masa thilto changlhah jaonaa, kelngoi chalteni jong chu athenso tha ding ahi, hiche hose hi thempu dia Pakai angsunga thil thengsel'a um ahi.
en: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
text:
LEV 23:20
Thadou: Chule hicheng ho chu thempu pan Pakai angsunga thensona anei ding, lhosohga masa thilto changlhah jaonaa, kelngoi chalteni jong chu athenso tha ding ahi, hiche hose hi thempu dia Pakai angsunga thil thengsel'a um ahi.
English: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

tcz: Hiche nikhoa hi khompi khat nanei diu, hichu khompi thengsel'a naman uva, lel nathei natoh nabol lou diu, na khang lhum keiyuva hoichana chejong leuchun, hiche hi chonna dan dungjuiya najui jing diu ahi.
en: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
text:
LEV 23:21
Thadou: Hiche nikhoa hi khompi khat nanei diu, hichu khompi thengsel'a naman uva, lel nathei natoh nabol lou diu, na khang lhum keiyuva hoichana chejong leuchun, hiche hi chonna dan dungjuiya najui jing diu ahi.
English: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

tcz: Na bonchauva na gamsung uva kona chang na-at teng uleh, na lou jao uchu apam chin jousea na-at chai lou diu, nachang at na nung uva chang khai ho jong nachom thengsel lou diu ahi; vaichate leh kholjin hodia na koipeh diu ahi, ajeh chu keima nangho Pakai, Pathen kaum jing e, ati.
en: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.’”
text:
LEV 23:22
Thadou: Na bonchauva na gamsung uva kona chang na-at teng uleh, na lou jao uchu apam chin jousea na-at chai lou diu, nachang at na nung uva chang khai ho jong nachom thengsel lou diu ahi; vaichate leh kholjin hodia na koipeh diu ahi, ajeh chu keima nangho Pakai, Pathen kaum jing e, ati.
English: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.’”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu asei peh in hiti hin bol in, ati.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 23:23
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu asei peh in hiti hin bol in, ati.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jouse jah a hiti hin sei peh tan, lha sagi lhin teng, hiche lhasung nimasa nileh na bonchauva naki chol uva khompi theng nanei diu, sumkon mutgin tothoa naphon jal jidiu ahi.
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
text:
LEV 23:24
Thadou: Israel chate jouse jah a hiti hin sei peh tan, lha sagi lhin teng, hiche lhasung nimasa nileh na bonchauva naki chol uva khompi theng nanei diu, sumkon mutgin tothoa naphon jal jidiu ahi.
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

tcz: Thabeina thei natong hih un, Pakai henga pumgo thilto nahaimil lou diu ahi.
en: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.’”
text:
LEV 23:25
Thadou: Thabeina thei natong hih un, Pakai henga pumgo thilto nahaimil lou diu ahi.
English: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.’”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseipeh in, hiti hin bolin, ati.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 23:26
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseipeh in, hiti hin bolin, ati.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Lha sagi lhin nikho nisom alhin nikho hi ki thoidamna ahin, hiche nikhoa hi thonlouva khompi theng khat nabol diu, an ngol tothoa Pakai dia pumgo thilto nato doh diu ahi.
en: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.
text:
LEV 23:27
Thadou: Lha sagi lhin nikho nisom alhin nikho hi ki thoidamna ahin, hiche nikhoa hi thonlouva khompi theng khat nabol diu, an ngol tothoa Pakai dia pumgo thilto nato doh diu ahi.
English: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.

tcz: Hiche nikhoa hi koima chan thabeina thei natoh nabol lou diu, ajeh chu kithoidamna nikho loupi khat ahin, na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu henga thoidamna nanei diu ahi.
en: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the LORD your God.
text:
LEV 23:28
Thadou: Hiche nikhoa hi koima chan thabeina thei natoh nabol lou diu, ajeh chu kithoidamna nikho loupi khat ahin, na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu henga thoidamna nanei diu ahi.
English: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the LORD your God.

tcz: Koi hijong leh hiche nikhoa an ngol lou aum leh, amite lah akona pampeiya um ding ahi.
en: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.
text:
LEV 23:29
Thadou: Koi hijong leh hiche nikhoa an ngol lou aum leh, amite lah akona pampeiya um ding ahi.
English: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.

tcz: Hitia chu koi hijong leu chun, hiche nikhoa hi thabeina thei natong aum khah leh, ama chu amite lah a kona kasuh mang ding ahi.
en: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.
text:
LEV 23:30
Thadou: Hitia chu koi hijong leu chun, hiche nikhoa hi thabeina thei natong aum khah leh, ama chu amite lah a kona kasuh mang ding ahi.
English: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.

tcz: Na bonchauva natoh thilbol akon na nakikangse cheh diu, hoilai muna hijong leh na chenna jouseuva chonna dan ahitia, najui cheh diu ahi.
en: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
text:
LEV 23:31
Thadou: Na bonchauva natoh thilbol akon na nakikangse cheh diu, hoilai muna hijong leh na chenna jouseuva chonna dan ahitia, najui cheh diu ahi.
English: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

tcz: Hiche nikho hi na boncha diuva kicholdo nikhoa naman jing diu, hitia chu an ngol tothoa, hiche lhasung nikho ahung lhin niapat, ajing nilhah lam chana choldonaa naman cheh diu ahi, ati.
en: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”
text:
LEV 23:32
Thadou: Hiche nikho hi na boncha diuva kicholdo nikhoa naman jing diu, hitia chu an ngol tothoa, hiche lhasung nikho ahung lhin niapat, ajing nilhah lam chana choldonaa naman cheh diu ahi, ati.
English: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

tcz: Pakiyin Mose henga thu aseipeh in, hiti hin bol in, ati.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 23:33
Thadou: Pakiyin Mose henga thu aseipeh in, hiti hin bol in, ati.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate jouse henga seipeh tan, lhasagi lhinna chule nisom le ninga lhin nikhoa pat, ni sagi sungse hi Pakaiya dia ponbuh kut a kimang ding ahi.
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to the LORD.
text:
LEV 23:34
Thadou: Israel chate jouse henga seipeh tan, lhasagi lhinna chule nisom le ninga lhin nikhoa pat, ni sagi sungse hi Pakaiya dia ponbuh kut a kimang ding ahi.
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to the LORD.

tcz: Kut akipat nikho chu khompi theng nikho ahin, hijeh chun thabei nathei natoh ima bolhih un, ati.
en: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
text:
LEV 23:35
Thadou: Kut akipat nikho chu khompi theng nikho ahin, hijeh chun thabei nathei natoh ima bolhih un, ati.
English: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

tcz: Tanglou hela ni sagi sunga Pakaiya dia thilto nabol jom jing diu, niget alhin nikho tengleh khompi theng khat nabol diu, Pakai ansunga pumgo thilto nakat doh diuchu ahin, hichu khompi theng laitah ahijeh'in thabei nathei natoh akon nakikangse cheh diu ahi.
en: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.
text:
LEV 23:36
Thadou: Tanglou hela ni sagi sunga Pakaiya dia thilto nabol jom jing diu, niget alhin nikho tengleh khompi theng khat nabol diu, Pakai ansunga pumgo thilto nakat doh diuchu ahin, hichu khompi theng laitah ahijeh'in thabei nathei natoh akon nakikangse cheh diu ahi.
English: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.

tcz: Achunga kimin phah chengse hi, Pakaiya dia phat tepsa kut hochu ahin, hiche nading chun Israel chate koukhom soh keiyun lang, khompi theng tothoa, thilto ding ho ahin, pumgo thiltonaa naman diu, anikho mama a abol ding dan jouse govam ding hihen, donthei lengpitwi hi jongleh, nabol diu ahi.
en: “‘These are the appointed feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—
text:
LEV 23:37
Thadou: Achunga kimin phah chengse hi, Pakaiya dia phat tepsa kut hochu ahin, hiche nading chun Israel chate koukhom soh keiyun lang, khompi theng tothoa, thilto ding ho ahin, pumgo thiltonaa naman diu, anikho mama a abol ding dan jouse govam ding hihen, donthei lengpitwi hi jongleh, nabol diu ahi.
English: “‘These are the appointed feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—

tcz: Hiche ho jouse hi na bonchauva Pakaiya dia na thiltou hichu deilhen choma na thilto uva ahitan, chule athenso ho jouse jaonan, nathil pehdoh jouseu leh Pakaiya dia cholngah nikho le adang dang nanit kimsel hou kisim tha lou ahi.
en: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to the LORD.
text:
LEV 23:38
Thadou: Hiche ho jouse hi na bonchauva Pakaiya dia na thiltou hichu deilhen choma na thilto uva ahitan, chule athenso ho jouse jaonan, nathil pehdoh jouseu leh Pakaiya dia cholngah nikho le adang dang nanit kimsel hou kisim tha lou ahi.
English: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to the LORD.

tcz: Lhasagi chan nisom leh ninga lhin nikho leh, na bonchauva gamsung lho sohga nachop kimsoh niuva pat nasim uva Pakaiya dia ni sagi sungsea kut tang louva nabol jom jing diu, hiti chun kut akipat nichu choldo nikho theng hiding, niget lhin nichan chu choldo nikhoa naman diu ahi.
en: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.
text:
LEV 23:39
Thadou: Lhasagi chan nisom leh ninga lhin nikho leh, na bonchauva gamsung lho sohga nachop kimsoh niuva pat nasim uva Pakaiya dia ni sagi sungsea kut tang louva nabol jom jing diu, hiti chun kut akipat nichu choldo nikho theng hiding, niget lhin nichan chu choldo nikhoa naman diu ahi.
English: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

tcz: Kut kipat nikho teng thingga ahoilai nalo lhah diu, lusuna tampi jaona, thingboh phatah tah na helhah diu, vadung pang lah a tomdo he tohthoa, hicheng chu na kichoi uva, na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu angsunga tang louva nakipa jing diu ahi.
en: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
text:
LEV 23:40
Thadou: Kut kipat nikho teng thingga ahoilai nalo lhah diu, lusuna tampi jaona, thingboh phatah tah na helhah diu, vadung pang lah a tomdo he tohthoa, hicheng chu na kichoi uva, na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu angsunga tang louva nakipa jing diu ahi.
English: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

tcz: Kumkhat seh le Pakai heng lama ni sagi tang louva kut khat nabol jing diu, hichu nakhang lhumkei uva chonna dan ngaiya naman chah jing diu, lhasagi lhinna lhasung achu naman diu ahi, ati.
en: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.
text:
LEV 23:41
Thadou: Kumkhat seh le Pakai heng lama ni sagi tang louva kut khat nabol jing diu, hichu nakhang lhumkei uva chonna dan ngaiya naman chah jing diu, lhasagi lhinna lhasung achu naman diu ahi, ati.
English: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.

tcz: Ni sagi sunga na bonchauva lhambuh a nachen diu, Israel sungkon agammi cheng aboncha lhambuh sunga cheng ding ahiuve.
en: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,
text:
LEV 23:42
Thadou: Ni sagi sunga na bonchauva lhambuh a nachen diu, Israel sungkon agammi cheng aboncha lhambuh sunga cheng ding ahiuve.
English: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,

tcz: Hichea kon chun nachilhah teuvin keima tah in Egypt gam'a kona, Isarel chate jouse kahin puidoh chun lhambuh sung a bou kachen sah ji'e ti, ahin hetdoh thei diu ahi, ajeh chu keima hi na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu kahi, ati.
en: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”
text:
LEV 23:43
Thadou: Hichea kon chun nachilhah teuvin keima tah in Egypt gam'a kona, Isarel chate jouse kahin puidoh chun lhambuh sung a bou kachen sah ji'e ti, ahin hetdoh thei diu ahi, ajeh chu keima hi na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu kahi, ati.
English: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”

tcz: Mose’n Pakai dinga phat tepsa kut ho jouse chu, Israel chate jouse lah a aphondoh peh ahi.
en: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD.
text:
LEV 23:44
Thadou: Mose’n Pakai dinga phat tepsa kut ho jouse chu, Israel chate jouse lah a aphondoh peh ahi.
English: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose hengah thu asepeh in, hiti hin bol in, ati.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 24:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose hengah thu asepeh in, hiti hin bol in, ati.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Isarel chate ho henga seipeh tan, mit theilou helding vah jing din, olive thaomei chu nahin choipeh nading un seipeh tauvin.
en: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
text:
LEV 24:2
Thadou: Isarel chate ho henga seipeh tan, mit theilou helding vah jing din, olive thaomei chu nahin choipeh nading un seipeh tauvin.
English: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

tcz: Ki khop khomna ponbuh hettohsahna pon kilang doh, hiche muna chu Aaron in thaomei kivah chu tang louva avet kol jing ding ahi. Hiche thaomei hi Pakai angsunga nilhah muthima pat jingkah khovah geiya kivah khovah hel ding ahi. Hiche hi nakhang lhumkei uva chonna dana nanei jing diu ahi.
en: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
text:
LEV 24:3
Thadou: Ki khop khomna ponbuh hettohsahna pon kilang doh, hiche muna chu Aaron in thaomei kivah chu tang louva avet kol jing ding ahi. Hiche thaomei hi Pakai angsunga nilhah muthima pat jingkah khovah geiya kivah khovah hel ding ahi. Hiche hi nakhang lhumkei uva chonna dana nanei jing diu ahi.
English: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

tcz: Aaron in jong Pakai sana thaomei khom phunga chu, hiche thaomei kivah jouse chu avah jingnai ti, photchetna avetkol jing ding ahi.
en: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.
text:
LEV 24:4
Thadou: Aaron in jong Pakai sana thaomei khom phunga chu, hiche thaomei kivah jouse chu avah jingnai ti, photchetna avetkol jing ding ahi.
English: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.

tcz: Chule nangman chang bonga kigoidi chu nalah ding, hichu changlhah lhonsom le ni nasoa naken ding, lhonkhat cheh chu Ephah dimkhat hopsoma hopni lhingsela kisem hiding ahi.
en: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.
text:
LEV 24:5
Thadou: Chule nangman chang bonga kigoidi chu nalah ding, hichu changlhah lhonsom le ni nasoa naken ding, lhonkhat cheh chu Ephah dimkhat hopsoma hopni lhingsela kisem hiding ahi.
English: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.

tcz: Chang lhah nasemsa chu golni nia nagol ding, golkhat achu changlhah lhongup pang ding, sana thengsel'a kisem touna chunga chu nagola nakoi ding ahi.
en: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.
text:
LEV 24:6
Thadou: Chang lhah nasemsa chu golni nia nagol ding, golkhat achu changlhah lhongup pang ding, sana thengsel'a kisem touna chunga chu nagola nakoi ding ahi.
English: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.

tcz: Gimnamtui nalah a changlhah golkhat chu nasun den ding, hichu nangman nato doh changlhah toh chun Pakaiya dia govam thiltoa kitoh doh tha ding ahi.
en: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.
text:
LEV 24:7
Thadou: Gimnamtui nalah a changlhah golkhat chu nasun den ding, hichu nangman nato doh changlhah toh chun Pakaiya dia govam thiltoa kitoh doh tha ding ahi.
English: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.

tcz: Cholngah nikho seh le hichu Pakai angsunga kigol doh ding, hitia chu beitih umlouva Israel chaten machah thei hochu akatdoh jing diu ahi.
en: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.
text:
LEV 24:8
Thadou: Cholngah nikho seh le hichu Pakai angsunga kigol doh ding, hitia chu beitih umlouva Israel chaten machah thei hochu akatdoh jing diu ahi.
English: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.

tcz: Hiche thilto hose hi Aaron le achapate ho ding ahin, hitia chu hiche thilto hochu muntheng laiya anehji diu ahi, ajeh chu hiche thilto chu Aaron ding Pakaiya dia pumgo thilto kitoh dohsa, ama chanvou dia thiltheng tah ahin, hichu tang louva chonna dan dinga juijing ding ahi.
en: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”
text:
LEV 24:9
Thadou: Hiche thilto hose hi Aaron le achapate ho ding ahin, hitia chu hiche thilto hochu muntheng laiya anehji diu ahi, ajeh chu hiche thilto chu Aaron ding Pakaiya dia pumgo thilto kitoh dohsa, ama chanvou dia thiltheng tah ahin, hichu tang louva chonna dan dinga juijing ding ahi.
English: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”

tcz: Pasal khat chu anu Israel numei chule apa Egypt mi, hichepa chu ahungvah doh le tan ngahmun khat a avah lut in ahileh, hichun Israel chaten aum kemvel tauvin, chuin Israel numei nu chapa jong Israel chapa khat toh chun akiboi lhontan ahi.
en: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
text:
LEV 24:10
Thadou: Pasal khat chu anu Israel numei chule apa Egypt mi, hichepa chu ahungvah doh le tan ngahmun khat a avah lut in ahileh, hichun Israel chaten aum kemvel tauvin, chuin Israel numei nu chapa jong Israel chapa khat toh chun akiboi lhontan ahi.
English: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

tcz: Israel numeinu chapan jong Pathen pa min panin taitomna toh thon agao sapjeng tai, chuin mipi hon ama chu Mose heng lama ahin pui tauve. Hichepa anu min chu Shelomith ahin, Dan phung akona Dibri chanu ahi.
en: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
text:
LEV 24:11
Thadou: Israel numeinu chapan jong Pathen pa min panin taitomna toh thon agao sapjeng tai, chuin mipi hon ama chu Mose heng lama ahin pui tauve. Hichepa anu min chu Shelomith ahin, Dan phung akona Dibri chanu ahi.
English: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

tcz: Amahon jong hichepa hi iti ding hi tam atiuvin, Pakai lunglam aheng uva ahung kilah kahsea din, mihenna kul sunga chun akhumlut tauve.
en: They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.
text:
LEV 24:12
Thadou: Amahon jong hichepa hi iti ding hi tam atiuvin, Pakai lunglam aheng uva ahung kilah kahsea din, mihenna kul sunga chun akhumlut tauve.
English: They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseiyin, hiti hin bolin, ati.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 24:13
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseiyin, hiti hin bolin, ati.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Pathen gaosap mipa chu polam ngahmuna hin kaidoh inlang, aman agaosapna awchang japha chan in, aluchunga akhut angap lhah cheh diu, hiche jouteng leh khompi thenga mipi jousen song in seplih jeng tauhen, ati.
en: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
text:
LEV 24:14
Thadou: Pathen gaosap mipa chu polam ngahmuna hin kaidoh inlang, aman agaosapna awchang japha chan in, aluchunga akhut angap lhah cheh diu, hiche jouteng leh khompi thenga mipi jousen song in seplih jeng tauhen, ati.
English: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

tcz: Chule Israel chate henga ajah uva hiti hin aseipeh tan, koi hileh Pathen gaosap mihem aum khah leh, hiche mihem chun amatah themmona akipoh ding ahi.
en: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
text:
LEV 24:15
Thadou: Chule Israel chate henga ajah uva hiti hin aseipeh tan, koi hileh Pathen gaosap mihem aum khah leh, hiche mihem chun amatah themmona akipoh ding ahi.
English: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

tcz: Pathen taitom mihem chu thajeng ding ahi, khompia pang mihem jousen amachu songa aselih diu, kholgammi hihen agamsung chengden hi jongleh, Pathen min taitom mihem kiti phot chu thana chang ding ahi.
en: He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.
text:
LEV 24:16
Thadou: Pathen taitom mihem chu thajeng ding ahi, khompia pang mihem jousen amachu songa aselih diu, kholgammi hihen agamsung chengden hi jongleh, Pathen min taitom mihem kiti phot chu thana chang ding ahi.
English: He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.

tcz: Chule mihem khat that chu, ama jong thina chansah ding ahi.
en: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
text:
LEV 24:17
Thadou: Chule mihem khat that chu, ama jong thina chansah ding ahi.
English: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

tcz: Koi hileh gancha that achu ama chun akhel apeh doh pai ding, hiche gancha khel thei dia chu gancha hing khat alepeh ding ahi.
en: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.
text:
LEV 24:18
Thadou: Koi hileh gancha that achu ama chun akhel apeh doh pai ding, hiche gancha khel thei dia chu gancha hing khat alepeh ding ahi.
English: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

tcz: Koi hileh ain-heng khattou amavo khah leh, aman hichepa abolna banga chu ama chunga jong bolgimna lhung ding ahi.
en: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:
text:
LEV 24:19
Thadou: Koi hileh ain-heng khattou amavo khah leh, aman hichepa abolna banga chu ama chunga jong bolgimna lhung ding ahi.
English: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:

tcz: Agu ham achang ham asuh chep a ahileh, ama jeng jong agu achang suhchep del ding, amit asuh chot tah jong leh ama mit jong hitia chu suhchot peh ding, aha ham khat asuh lhoi khah jong leh ama ha jong suh lhoi pai ding; aman mi abol gimset banga chu ama chunga jong abepbep a lhunsah ding ahi.
en: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.
text:
LEV 24:20
Thadou: Agu ham achang ham asuh chep a ahileh, ama jeng jong agu achang suhchep del ding, amit asuh chot tah jong leh ama mit jong hitia chu suhchot peh ding, aha ham khat asuh lhoi khah jong leh ama ha jong suh lhoi pai ding; aman mi abol gimset banga chu ama chunga jong abepbep a lhunsah ding ahi.
English: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.

tcz: Gancha that aum leh hiche athat pen pen chun akhel ahola apeh le ding, mihem chunga hem lama thatpa chu ama jeng jong tha ding ahi.
en: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.
text:
LEV 24:21
Thadou: Gancha that aum leh hiche athat pen pen chun akhel ahola apeh le ding, mihem chunga hem lama thatpa chu ama jeng jong tha ding ahi.
English: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

tcz: Na bonchauvin kholgam akona mihem hihen, agamsung akon hijong leuchun abonchauva danthu khat a chondel del diu, ajeh chu keima Pakai leh nangho jouse Pathen pachu kahi, ati.
en: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”
text:
LEV 24:22
Thadou: Na bonchauvin kholgam akona mihem hihen, agamsung akon hijong leuchun abonchauva danthu khat a chondel del diu, ajeh chu keima Pakai leh nangho jouse Pathen pachu kahi, ati.
English: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”

tcz: Mose jong hiti chun Israel chate jouse jah aseipeh soh tan, chuin amahon Pathen taitomna neipa chu polam ngah munkhat a ahin kaiyun, amapa chu song in aseplih tauvin ahi. Pathen thupeh bang in Israel chate jousen abolun ahi.
en: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
LEV 24:23
Thadou: Mose jong hiti chun Israel chate jouse jah aseipeh soh tan, chuin amahon Pathen taitomna neipa chu polam ngah munkhat a ahin kaiyun, amapa chu song in aseplih tauvin ahi. Pathen thupeh bang in Israel chate jousen abolun ahi.
English: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Pakaiyin Sinai molsang chunga konin, Mose henga hiti hin aseipeh in,
en: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,
text:
LEV 25:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Sinai molsang chunga konin, Mose henga hiti hin aseipeh in,
English: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,

tcz: Israel chate jouse jah a seiyin, na bonchauva keiman kapehna gam nahung lhun teng uleh agam pumpia jong Pakaiya dia choldam kum anei tei ding ahi.
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to the LORD.
text:
LEV 25:2
Thadou: Israel chate jouse jah a seiyin, na bonchauva keiman kapehna gam nahung lhun teng uleh agam pumpia jong Pakaiya dia choldam kum anei tei ding ahi.
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to the LORD.

tcz: Kumgup sunga na loujaova muchi nathe ding, hitia chu kumgup sunga na lengpi thei nalho ngimsela, chuteng aga nakilo ding ahi.
en: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;

tcz: Kum sagi lhinkum levang agamsung pumpin choldam kum anit ding, hitia chu lou jaova muche jeng jong natu thei lou ding, na lengpithei lei jong nalho ngimtah lou ding ahi.
en: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to the LORD. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.
text:
LEV 25:4
Thadou: Kum sagi lhinkum levang agamsung pumpin choldam kum anit ding, hitia chu lou jaova muche jeng jong natu thei lou ding, na lengpithei lei jong nalho ngimtah lou ding ahi.
English: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to the LORD. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.

tcz: Chule changval hung kehdoh ho jong na-at lou ding, lengpi lei lholou laiya hung kehdoh aga ho jong nadon da jeng ding, ajeh chu na boncha diuva choldamna kum ahi.
en: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.
text:
LEV 25:5
Thadou: Chule changval hung kehdoh ho jong na-at lou ding, lengpi lei lholou laiya hung kehdoh aga ho jong nadon da jeng ding, ajeh chu na boncha diuva choldamna kum ahi.
English: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

tcz: Gamsung pumpia dia choldamna kum ahitan, ami chan cheh ading in chule nangma nahin nasoh pasal ham nasoh numei hijon gleh; natha lah mihem hihen lang gamchom ahung kholjin hijong leh, na bonchauva dia anneh ding nahin ngaito peh diu ahi, ati.
en: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.
text:
LEV 25:6
Thadou: Gamsung pumpia dia choldamna kum ahitan, ami chan cheh ading in chule nangma nahin nasoh pasal ham nasoh numei hijon gleh; natha lah mihem hihen lang gamchom ahung kholjin hijong leh, na bonchauva dia anneh ding nahin ngaito peh diu ahi, ati.
English: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.

tcz: Nangma gancha ho ahin, na gam'a um gamsa ho jaona hiche gamga soh hochu aneh diu ahi.
en: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.
text:
LEV 25:7
Thadou: Nangma gancha ho ahin, na gam'a um gamsa ho jaona hiche gamga soh hochu aneh diu ahi.
English: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

tcz: Kum khat sunga hapta sagi nasim dohji ding, hatpa sagi veijen na simdoh ding hitia chu agoma kumsom li leh kumko aphah ding ahi.
en: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.
text:
LEV 25:8
Thadou: Kum khat sunga hapta sagi nasim dohji ding, hatpa sagi veijen na simdoh ding hitia chu agoma kumsom li leh kumko aphah ding ahi.
English: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.

tcz: Hiche jou tengleh nangman lha sagi lhinna hiche lhasung mama achu, nisom lhin nikho chule sumkon namut ging ding, hichea chu kithoidamna nikho nagam pumpiuva thong jejua sum kon na lhangsap uva nathejal soh diu ahi.
en: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.
text:
LEV 25:9
Thadou: Hiche jou tengleh nangman lha sagi lhinna hiche lhasung mama achu, nisom lhin nikho chule sumkon namut ging ding, hichea chu kithoidamna nikho nagam pumpiuva thong jejua sum kon na lhangsap uva nathejal soh diu ahi.
English: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.

tcz: Kum nga don ahung lhin teng hiche kum chu kum theng tah ahi, hichu na phonjal diu, gamsung pumpia khosa jouse henga chamlhat kum ahitia naphon jalsoh diu ahi; hiche kum hi naboncha diuva jubilee kum ahitan, mihem koi hileh athilkeo jouse akile lah kit ding, mihem jeng jong ama cheh in muna kile cheh ding nahiuve.
en: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.
text:
LEV 25:10
Thadou: Kum nga don ahung lhin teng hiche kum chu kum theng tah ahi, hichu na phonjal diu, gamsung pumpia khosa jouse henga chamlhat kum ahitia naphon jalsoh diu ahi; hiche kum hi naboncha diuva jubilee kum ahitan, mihem koi hileh athilkeo jouse akile lah kit ding, mihem jeng jong ama cheh in muna kile cheh ding nahiuve.
English: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.

tcz: Hiche kum somnga lhinkum hi nangho jouse dia jubilee kum ahitan, hiche kuma hi muchi jeng jong natu louhel diu, achama hung keh muche chang jeng jong na-at da jeng diu, lengpilei nalho louna beh a hung kehdoh aga ho jong nadon lou ding ahi, ati.
en: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.
text:
LEV 25:11
Thadou: Hiche kum somnga lhinkum hi nangho jouse dia jubilee kum ahitan, hiche kuma hi muchi jeng jong natu louhel diu, achama hung keh muche chang jeng jong na-at da jeng diu, lengpilei nalho louna beh a hung kehdoh aga ho jong nadon lou ding ahi, ati.
English: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.

tcz: Ajeh chu Jubilee kum hi kum theng tah ahi, na boncha diuva atheng ahi; hijeh chun agamsunga anagasa hobou naneh diu ahi.
en: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.
text:
LEV 25:12
Thadou: Ajeh chu Jubilee kum hi kum theng tah ahi, na boncha diuva atheng ahi; hijeh chun agamsunga anagasa hobou naneh diu ahi.
English: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.

tcz: Hitia chu Jubilee kum ahung lhun teng, na boncha uva koi hileh agoulo cheh chu na kile pehto diu ahi.
en: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.
text:
LEV 25:13
Thadou: Hitia chu Jubilee kum ahung lhun teng, na boncha uva koi hileh agoulo cheh chu na kile pehto diu ahi.
English: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.

tcz: Na kinaipi henga na thil joh ham, ahilouleh nathil chohsa ham jeng jong chu, hitia thil joh chung chang leh akijoh doh thil chung changa na sopi khat toh adih louva na kibol to thei lou ding ahi.
en: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.
text:
LEV 25:14
Thadou: Na kinaipi henga na thil joh ham, ahilouleh nathil chohsa ham jeng jong chu, hitia thil joh chung chang leh akijoh doh thil chung changa na sopi khat toh adih louva na kibol to thei lou ding ahi.
English: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.

tcz: Chule Jubilee aki chaiya pat naheng nakoma na thilchoh chule akum ijat sunga hi jongleh, agamga soh toh kitoh a nangma koma thil ale joh ding ahi, ati.
en: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.
text:
LEV 25:15
Thadou: Chule Jubilee aki chaiya pat naheng nakoma na thilchoh chule akum ijat sunga hi jongleh, agamga soh toh kitoh a nangma koma thil ale joh ding ahi, ati.
English: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.

tcz: Kum vang chu ahung tamkhah tah leh hiche thilman chun nasan sah ding, ahinlah akumjat chu alhom khah vangleh athilman jeng jong nalhom sah ding ahi, ajeh chu akum kisim jat dungjuiya aman jong gamga toh ajoh ahi, ati.
en: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.
text:
LEV 25:16
Thadou: Kum vang chu ahung tamkhah tah leh hiche thilman chun nasan sah ding, ahinlah akumjat chu alhom khah vangleh athilman jeng jong nalhom sah ding ahi, ajeh chu akum kisim jat dungjuiya aman jong gamga toh ajoh ahi, ati.
English: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.

tcz: Na bonchauva khat leh khat nakisuh gimlou heldiu, hiche sangchun na Pathen chu ging jing in, ajeh chu keima na Pakai leh na Pathenu chu kahi, ati.
en: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.
text:
LEV 25:17
Thadou: Na bonchauva khat leh khat nakisuh gimlou heldiu, hiche sangchun na Pathen chu ging jing in, ajeh chu keima na Pakai leh na Pathenu chu kahi, ati.
English: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.

tcz: Na bonchauva ka chonna dan jouse najuikim soh kei diu, hiche ho jouse chutoh natoh doh diu ahi, chuteng gamsung pumpia na bonchauva lungmong sela nakhosah diu ahi.
en: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.
text:
LEV 25:18
Thadou: Na bonchauva ka chonna dan jouse najuikim soh kei diu, hiche ho jouse chutoh natoh doh diu ahi, chuteng gamsung pumpia na bonchauva lungmong sela nakhosah diu ahi.
English: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.
