tcz: Agamsunga jong gamga pha hung um doh ding, hitia chu oiva sela naneh thei diu, agam sunga lungmong sela nachen thei diu ahi.
en: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
text:
LEV 25:19
Thadou: Agamsunga jong gamga pha hung um doh ding, hitia chu oiva sela naneh thei diu, agam sunga lungmong sela nachen thei diu ahi.
English: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

tcz: Na bonchauva na ngaito uva, kum sagi ahung lhin kum le ipi ham ineh diu, muchi la itu ta pouvin, chang jeng jong i-at lou diu hitam, tia na lung don khah uva ahi leh,
en: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”
text:
LEV 25:20
Thadou: Na bonchauva na ngaito uva, kum sagi ahung lhin kum le ipi ham ineh diu, muchi la itu ta pouvin, chang jeng jong i-at lou diu hitam, tia na lung don khah uva ahi leh,
English: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”

tcz: Keima tah in kumgup alhin kumle na boncha chung cheh uva phattheina kahin bung lhah peh diu, hichun kum thum sungsea naneh khop diuva anga ahin sodoh ding ahi.
en: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.
text:
LEV 25:21
Thadou: Keima tah in kumgup alhin kumle na boncha chung cheh uva phattheina kahin bung lhah peh diu, hichun kum thum sungsea naneh khop diuva anga ahin sodoh ding ahi.
English: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.

tcz: Na bonchauvin kum get lhin kum apat muchi tujong leu chun lhosoh ga aumsa alui hobou naneh diu, kumko ahung lhina lhosohga athah kahsea lhosohga alui hobou naneh na ai diu ahi, ati.
en: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.
text:
LEV 25:22
Thadou: Na bonchauvin kum get lhin kum apat muchi tujong leu chun lhosoh ga aumsa alui hobou naneh diu, kumko ahung lhina lhosohga athah kahsea lhosohga alui hobou naneh na ai diu ahi, ati.
English: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.

tcz: Gam leiset kiti jong najoh doh thei lou diu, aneipa kei kahin, na bonchauva gamchom mi kholjina kanei nahiuve, ati.
en: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.
text:
LEV 25:23
Thadou: Gam leiset kiti jong najoh doh thei lou diu, aneipa kei kahin, na bonchauva gamchom mi kholjina kanei nahiuve, ati.
English: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.

tcz: Hijeh chun hoilai chan hi jongleh nachen na jouse uva, gam leiset lhatdohna man na bonchauva napeh cheh diu ahi.
en: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.
text:
LEV 25:24
Thadou: Hijeh chun hoilai chan hi jongleh nachen na jouse uva, gam leiset lhatdohna man na bonchauva napeh cheh diu ahi.
English: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.

tcz: Na sopipa hamkhat hahsatna ato jeh a, agam leiset ajoh doh khah a ahileh, ama bana asopipa chu hunga athiljoh doh chu ahung lhat ding ahi.
en: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.
text:
LEV 25:25
Thadou: Na sopipa hamkhat hahsatna ato jeh a, agam leiset ajoh doh khah a ahileh, ama bana asopipa chu hunga athiljoh doh chu ahung lhat ding ahi.
English: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.

tcz: Ahinlah ajoh dohpa ham khat chun, asopi alhat doh thei mi anei tah louva, amavang khonunga ahung haodoh thei dinga auma ahileh, aman ahin kilhat doh thei ding ahi.
en: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,
text:
LEV 25:26
Thadou: Ahinlah ajoh dohpa ham khat chun, asopi alhat doh thei mi anei tah louva, amavang khonunga ahung haodoh thei dinga auma ahileh, aman ahin kilhat doh thei ding ahi.
English: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,

tcz: Hitia chu agamjoh doh pan jong ajohdoh kuma pat phatah a sim ding, ajohna pa henga chu aman jat apeh dia lom cheng chutoh apeh dohtha ding, chujou tengleh ana chodoh pa chun agam leiset chu aboncha anung peh kit ding ahi.
en: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.
text:
LEV 25:27
Thadou: Hitia chu agamjoh doh pan jong ajohdoh kuma pat phatah a sim ding, ajohna pa henga chu aman jat apeh dia lom cheng chutoh apeh dohtha ding, chujou tengleh ana chodoh pa chun agam leiset chu aboncha anung peh kit ding ahi.
English: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.

tcz: Ahinlah amapa chun alhat dohna ding aneilouva ahileh, Jubilee kum ahung lhun kahsea ajoh dohnapa koma chu athil joh doh chu chuti um ding ahitan, Jubilee kum ahung lhun phat levang chun achopa chun ale lhatdoh ding, athil neipa chu lechan kit ding ahi.
en: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.
text:
LEV 25:28
Thadou: Ahinlah amapa chun alhat dohna ding aneilouva ahileh, Jubilee kum ahung lhun kahsea ajoh dohnapa koma chu athil joh doh chu chuti um ding ahitan, Jubilee kum ahung lhun phat levang chun achopa chun ale lhatdoh ding, athil neipa chu lechan kit ding ahi.
English: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.

tcz: Kula kigensa gam leiset behkah khat tou johdoh a umleh, hiche ajohdoh pa chun ajoh kum sunga chu akile lhat dohthei ding ahi. Ajeh chu kum khat sunga chu akile lhatdohna dia thu anei ahi.
en: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.
text:
LEV 25:29
Thadou: Kula kigensa gam leiset behkah khat tou johdoh a umleh, hiche ajohdoh pa chun ajoh kum sunga chu akile lhat dohthei ding ahi. Ajeh chu kum khat sunga chu akile lhatdohna dia thu anei ahi.
English: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.

tcz: Ahinlah a-in chu kum sunga chu alhatdoh jou louva ahileh, khopi sunga kul ki gensa ki johdoh a akichohpa chun akhang lhum keiya anei ding ahitan, Jubilee kum hung lhung jongleh akile lhatna ding thu anei lou ahitai.
en: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.
text:
LEV 25:30
Thadou: Ahinlah a-in chu kum sunga chu alhatdoh jou louva ahileh, khopi sunga kul ki gensa ki johdoh a akichohpa chun akhang lhum keiya anei ding ahitan, Jubilee kum hung lhung jongleh akile lhatna ding thu anei lou ahitai.
English: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.

tcz: Kul kigen lou khopi neocha sunga in ki johdoh ho vang chu, amin mai maiya ki sim peh ding, hiche ho chu lhatdohna tha um ding, hichu Jubilee kum ahung lhunteng lhatdoh ding ahi.
en: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.
text:
LEV 25:31
Thadou: Kul kigen lou khopi neocha sunga in ki johdoh ho vang chu, amin mai maiya ki sim peh ding, hiche ho chu lhatdohna tha um ding, hichu Jubilee kum ahung lhunteng lhatdoh ding ahi.
English: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

tcz: Ahinlah Levite chenna khopi ho chu, ama ho ana chennasa akhopi sung uva in ho vang chu, Leviten itih phatlai hi jongleh akile lhatdoh thei diu ahi.
en: “‘Nevertheless, in the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time.
text:
LEV 25:32
Thadou: Ahinlah Levite chenna khopi ho chu, ama ho ana chennasa akhopi sung uva in ho vang chu, Leviten itih phatlai hi jongleh akile lhatdoh thei diu ahi.
English: “‘Nevertheless, in the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time.

tcz: Koi hileh Levi mite akona athuneina aman chah louva ahileh, amaho chenna khopi sunga ana kijoh dohsa in vangchu, Jubilee kum ahung lhun teng kile peh cheh cheh ding ahi, ajeh chu Israel chate chenna tin cheng chu Levi mite dia amaho goulo jeng ahibouve.
en: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
text:
LEV 25:33
Thadou: Koi hileh Levi mite akona athuneina aman chah louva ahileh, amaho chenna khopi sunga ana kijoh dohsa in vangchu, Jubilee kum ahung lhun teng kile peh cheh cheh ding ahi, ajeh chu Israel chate chenna tin cheng chu Levi mite dia amaho goulo jeng ahibouve.
English: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

tcz: Levi mite dia kikoi gam beh jouse chu, khat a khat cha kijoh doh thei lou ding, hichu amaho dia tonsot goulo ding ahi.
en: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.
text:
LEV 25:34
Thadou: Levi mite dia kikoi gam beh jouse chu, khat a khat cha kijoh doh thei lou ding, hichu amaho dia tonsot goulo ding ahi.
English: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.

tcz: Na sopipa chu aneilel valtah a, nakom tah a akivah lelna aum doh a ahileh, nangman jong ima dang gel louva ama chu navah jeng ding, kholgam akona jin banga nakom a khosa jeng ding ahi.
en: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.
text:
LEV 25:35
Thadou: Na sopipa chu aneilel valtah a, nakom tah a akivah lelna aum doh a ahileh, nangman jong ima dang gel louva ama chu navah jeng ding, kholgam akona jin banga nakom a khosa jeng ding ahi.
English: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.

tcz: Natoh le tham akon in apung akal jong tep peh dan lang, na Pathen maiven na sopipa chu nakoma khosa teijo hen, ati.
en: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.
text:
LEV 25:36
Thadou: Natoh le tham akon in apung akal jong tep peh dan lang, na Pathen maiven na sopipa chu nakoma khosa teijo hen, ati.
English: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.

tcz: Ama chu veikan dia sum bat napeh thei lou ding, nehle chah jeng jong apung dia nei peh lou ding ahi.
en: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.
text:
LEV 25:37
Thadou: Ama chu veikan dia sum bat napeh thei lou ding, nehle chah jeng jong apung dia nei peh lou ding ahi.
English: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.

tcz: Ajeh chu kei matah hi na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu kahin, nang ho Pathen kahiye tia Cannan gam kapeh diu ahitia, Egypt gam'a kona nahin puigal kaipau chu kahi, ati.
en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
text:
LEV 25:38
Thadou: Ajeh chu kei matah hi na Pakaiyu leh na Pathenu kahin, nang ho Pathen kahiye tia Cannan gam kapeh diu ahitia, Egypt gam'a kona nahin puigal kaipau chu kahi, ati.
English: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangma nai lama cheng na sopipa chu anei lelval tah a nangma koma ama le ama ahung ki peh lut tah leh, ama chu soh tobanga nagoi thei lou ding ahi.
en: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.
text:
LEV 25:39
Thadou: Hijeh chun nangma nai lama cheng na sopipa chu anei lelval tah a nangma koma ama le ama ahung ki peh lut tah leh, ama chu soh tobanga nagoi thei lou ding ahi.
English: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.

tcz: Amapa chu na koma thalah mi banga khosa jeng ding, Jubilee kum ahung lhun kahsea na koma khosa ding ahi.
en: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.
text:
LEV 25:40
Thadou: Amapa chu na koma thalah mi banga khosa jeng ding, Jubilee kum ahung lhun kahsea na koma khosa ding ahi.
English: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.

tcz: Jubilee akichai teng nangma dalhaa pot tading achate jouse jaona che diu, a insung lama leche diu, apu apa khanga gou ho chu lechan ding ahiuve.
en: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.
text:
LEV 25:41
Thadou: Jubilee akichai teng nangma dalhaa pot tading achate jouse jaona che diu, a insung lama leche diu, apu apa khanga gou ho chu lechan ding ahiuve.
English: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.

tcz: Ajeh chu abonchauva keima lhachaa pang ahiuvin; abonchauva Egypt gam'a kona kahin puigal kai ahiuve, hiche jeh chun amaho hi abonchauva sohjoh a najoh doh lou diu ahi.
en: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.
text:
LEV 25:42
Thadou: Ajeh chu abonchauva keima lhachaa pang ahiuvin; abonchauva Egypt gam'a kona kahin puigal kai ahiuve, hiche jeh chun amaho hi abonchauva sohjoh a najoh doh lou diu ahi.
English: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

tcz: Nangman ama ho jouse munemna neitah a thu nasei lou ding, na Pathen ging khencha hinkho naman ding ahi.
en: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.
text:
LEV 25:43
Thadou: Nangman ama ho jouse munemna neitah a thu nasei lou ding, na Pathen ging khencha hinkho naman ding ahi.
English: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

tcz: Soh pasal ho in numei jong nanei jeng thei ahin, hiche soh ding achu nakom lah a namtin vaipi hochu na chohdoh a navul thei ahi.
en: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.
text:
LEV 25:44
Thadou: Soh pasal ho in numei jong nanei jeng thei ahin, hiche soh ding achu nakom lah a namtin vaipi hochu na chohdoh a navul thei ahi.
English: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.

tcz: Na bonchauva nalah uva chenglut kholgam mih hochu nachoh doh uva, soh a nalap thei diu ahi, nagam sung pumpiuva chengsa ho jong nachoh thei diu, hitobang mi nachoh doh hou chu na in cheh uva uma nalap le thei diu ahi.
en: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.
text:
LEV 25:45
Thadou: Na bonchauva nalah uva chenglut kholgam mih hochu nachoh doh uva, soh a nalap thei diu ahi, nagam sung pumpiuva chengsa ho jong nachoh thei diu, hitobang mi nachoh doh hou chu na in cheh uva uma nalap le thei diu ahi.
English: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.

tcz: Chule soh ho chu na chateu banga na goulo diuva na umsah uva, khonunga goulo ding jong nakoi peh diu, nangho Israelte lah a vang khat in khat chunga thuneina tah a vaihoma chatloh thei lou ding ah.
en: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.
text:
LEV 25:46
Thadou: Chule soh ho chu na chateu banga na goulo diuva na umsah uva, khonunga goulo ding jong nakoi peh diu, nangho Israelte lah a vang khat in khat chunga thuneina tah a vaihoma chatloh thei lou ding ah.
English: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.

tcz: Na koma cheng kholjin mi chu ahung haodoh jeng tah a, na koma cheng na sopi pakhat machu achen dan ahah satval tah a ahileh; amajeng jong na koma cheng kholjin mipa koma ahung kipeh doh jeng tah a ahileh, chule asopi ho kom ham khat a akijoh doh jeng tah a ahileh,
en: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,
text:
LEV 25:47
Thadou: Na koma cheng kholjin mi chu ahung haodoh jeng tah a, na koma cheng na sopi pakhat machu achen dan ahah satval tah a ahileh; amajeng jong na koma cheng kholjin mipa koma ahung kipeh doh jeng tah a ahileh, chule asopi ho kom ham khat a akijoh doh jeng tah a ahileh,
English: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,

tcz: Hitia akijoh nunga chu lelhat kit thei ahi, asopi ho lah akona khat penpen in amapa chu ale lhat kit ding,
en: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;

tcz: Ahilouleh apaneo ham apaneo chapa ham khat in jong ale lhat thei ahi, amatoh kinai asopi aheng akom aphung chan khompi ainsung toh kinai pen khat injong alhat doh thei ding, hiche kala chu ama le ama ahung neijou tah levang ama chama kilhat ding ahi.
en: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.
text:
LEV 25:49
Thadou: Ahilouleh apaneo ham apaneo chapa ham khat in jong ale lhat thei ahi, amatoh kinai asopi aheng akom aphung chan khompi ainsung toh kinai pen khat injong alhat doh thei ding, hiche kala chu ama le ama ahung neijou tah levang ama chama kilhat ding ahi.
English: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.

tcz: Ana ki chohdoh patoh akinopto banga, ama le ama akijoh doh niapat Jubilee kum chana asim ding, aman jat chu akum tam leh lhom dungjuiya alepeh ding ahi, anakichoh pan amapa alap sungsea chu thalah man toh kibang ding ahi.
en: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.
text:
LEV 25:50
Thadou: Ana ki chohdoh patoh akinopto banga, ama le ama akijoh doh niapat Jubilee kum chana asim ding, aman jat chu akum tam leh lhom dungjuiya alepeh ding ahi, anakichoh pan amapa alap sungsea chu thalah man toh kibang ding ahi.
English: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.

tcz: Jubilee kum lhunna ding kum phabep avat nah laileh, aki lhatdohna dia ana ki chohdohna man chu alang khat alepeh ding ahi.
en: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
text:
LEV 25:51
Thadou: Jubilee kum lhunna ding kum phabep avat nah laileh, aki lhatdohna dia ana ki chohdohna man chu alang khat alepeh ding ahi.
English: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

tcz: Ahinlah Jubilee lhinna ding chu kum lhomcha akivat tah a ahileh, aki choh apat akum jat chu avet toh lhon ding, hiche kuma pat chu atohman jat dungjuiya avaldoh chengse chu akile lhat dohna dia ale dip ding ahi.
en: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.
text:
LEV 25:52
Thadou: Ahinlah Jubilee lhinna ding chu kum lhomcha akivat tah a ahileh, aki choh apat akum jat chu avet toh lhon ding, hiche kuma pat chu atohman jat dungjuiya avaldoh chengse chu akile lhat dohna dia ale dip ding ahi.
English: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.

tcz: Tohman akisim teng hichepa chu thagoi man bep bep a kisim peh ding, koi hileh hichepa tobang chunga engset nanei thei hoa kona navet tup ding ahi.
en: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.
text:
LEV 25:53
Thadou: Tohman akisim teng hichepa chu thagoi man bep bep a kisim peh ding, koi hileh hichepa tobang chunga engset nanei thei hoa kona navet tup ding ahi.
English: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse nunga hi, amapa hi aki lhatdoh joulou tah vangleh, chuti uma Jubilee kum ahung lhun teng lhat ding, ama ahin achate jouse jaona lhat tha ding ahitai.
en: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him.
text:
LEV 25:54
Thadou: Hiche ho jouse nunga hi, amapa hi aki lhatdoh joulou tah vangleh, chuti uma Jubilee kum ahung lhun teng lhat ding, ama ahin achate jouse jaona lhat tha ding ahitai.
English: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him.

tcz: Ajeh chu Israel chate hi abonchauva keima lhacha ngen ahiuvin, amaho hi ka lhacha ahin, Egypt gam'a kona keima tah in kahin puigal kai ahiuvin, keima hi na Pakaiyu le na Pathenu chu kahi jinge, ati.
en: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
text:
LEV 25:55
Thadou: Ajeh chu Israel chate hi abonchauva keima lhacha ngen ahiuvin, amaho hi ka lhacha ahin, Egypt gam'a kona keima tah in kahin puigal kai ahiuvin, keima hi na Pakaiyu le na Pathenu chu kahi jinge, ati.
English: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

tcz: Na bonchauva milimdoi nasem thu louhel diu, milim akisem hihen songa tun ding hi jongleh, khat a khat cha natundoh theilou diu ahi, gamsung pumpi naumnau kitia hi song milim natundoh theilou diu, hiche ho chu nabol uva amasanga naboh khup loubeh diu ahi; ajeh chu keima na Pakai uleh na Pathen pau kaum jing e, ati.
en: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am the LORD your God.
text:
LEV 26:1
Thadou: Na bonchauva milimdoi nasem thu louhel diu, milim akisem hihen songa tun ding hi jongleh, khat a khat cha natundoh theilou diu ahi, gamsung pumpi naumnau kitia hi song milim natundoh theilou diu, hiche ho chu nabol uva amasanga naboh khup loubeh diu ahi; ajeh chu keima na Pakai uleh na Pathen pau kaum jing e, ati.
English: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am the LORD your God.

tcz: Na bonchauva ka cholngah nikho chu nanit kimsoh kei diu chule ka muntheng jeng jong jabolna napeh jing diu ahi. Ajeh chu keima Pakai kahi.
en: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.
text:
LEV 26:2
Thadou: Na bonchauva ka cholngah nikho chu nanit kimsoh kei diu chule ka muntheng jeng jong jabolna napeh jing diu ahi. Ajeh chu keima Pakai kahi.
English: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.

tcz: Na bonchauva ka chonna dan ho najui kimsoh keidiu, ka thupeh chengse jong aboncha nanit kimsoh keidiu aboncha nabol kimsel teng uleh,
en: “‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,
text:
LEV 26:3
Thadou: Na bonchauva ka chonna dan ho najui kimsoh keidiu, ka thupeh chengse jong aboncha nanit kimsoh keidiu aboncha nabol kimsel teng uleh,
English: “‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,

tcz: Hichea chu keima tah in nangho jouse dia gotwi kahin lhah sah ding, chuting leh agam leiset pumpia konin gamsa hung kisep doh becheh ding, thingga jeng jong hagaa hung ga ding ahi.
en: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
text:
LEV 26:4
Thadou: Hichea chu keima tah in nangho jouse dia gotwi kahin lhah sah ding, chuting leh agam leiset pumpia konin gamsa hung kisep doh becheh ding, thingga jeng jong hagaa hung ga ding ahi.
English: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

tcz: Chuteng na loujao dung uva thingga lou ding le lengpi theiga lou ding, alhang alhanga mihem kikaiya, chuteng na oivasel uva changlhah naneh cheh diu nagam sung jeng uva jong lungmong le lhamonga na khosah diu ahi.
en: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
text:
LEV 26:5
Thadou: Chuteng na loujao dung uva thingga lou ding le lengpi theiga lou ding, alhang alhanga mihem kikaiya, chuteng na oivasel uva changlhah naneh cheh diu nagam sung jeng uva jong lungmong le lhamonga na khosah diu ahi.
English: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

tcz: Chuteng keiman nangho gamsung pumpia chamna ka umsah ding, nomtah a na choldo diu koiman nasuh kichat tahlou diu ahi, gamsung pumpia gamsa phalou jouse katol manghel ding, na chennau gam jenga jong hem mangchaa kitona um talou ding ahi.
en: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
text:
LEV 26:6
Thadou: Chuteng keiman nangho gamsung pumpia chamna ka umsah ding, nomtah a na choldo diu koiman nasuh kichat tahlou diu ahi, gamsung pumpia gamsa phalou jouse katol manghel ding, na chennau gam jenga jong hem mangchaa kitona um talou ding ahi.
English: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

tcz: Namel mateu nadel jam diu, na masang lai tah uva chem jam tothoa nasat lih jeng diu ahi.
en: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
text:
LEV 26:7
Thadou: Namel mateu nadel jam diu, na masang lai tah uva chem jam tothoa nasat lih jeng diu ahi.
English: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

tcz: Nang hoa kona mi nga jeng in jong mi jakhat nadel jam thei diu, chule nangho mi jakhat seh in melma sangsom nadel jam thei kit diu ahi, namel mateu chu chemjam lama nasat chop joukei diu ahi.
en: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
text:
LEV 26:8
Thadou: Nang hoa kona mi nga jeng in jong mi jakhat nadel jam thei diu, chule nangho mi jakhat seh in melma sangsom nadel jam thei kit diu ahi, namel mateu chu chemjam lama nasat chop joukei diu ahi.
English: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

tcz: Na bonchauva kagel khoh cheh diu, na boncha chung uva ka kitepna jong guilhun sah ding kahi.
en: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.
text:
LEV 26:9
Thadou: Na bonchauva kagel khoh cheh diu, na boncha chung uva ka kitepna jong guilhun sah ding kahi.
English: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

tcz: Na bonchauva nahou thei diu lho sohga abeisa naneh uva, lhosohga thah ahung lhun kit teng aumsa ho chu na otdoh diu ahi.
en: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.
text:
LEV 26:10
Thadou: Na bonchauva nahou thei diu lho sohga abeisa naneh uva, lhosohga thah ahung lhun kit teng aumsa ho chu na otdoh diu ahi.
English: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.

tcz: Keima tah jong nalah uva khosa ding kahin, ka lungsung jenga jong kidah tah a na kibol kit lou diu ahi.
en: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.
text:
LEV 26:11
Thadou: Keima tah jong nalah uva khosa ding kahin, ka lungsung jenga jong kidah tah a na kibol kit lou diu ahi.
English: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.

tcz: Chule nalah uva kalhat le ding, na Pathen pau chu kahi jing ding, na bonchauva ka mite nahi jing diu ahi.
en: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.
text:
LEV 26:12
Thadou: Chule nalah uva kalhat le ding, na Pathen pau chu kahi jing ding, na bonchauva ka mite nahi jing diu ahi.
English: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.

tcz: Egypt gam mite soh nahi lou na diuva, agam sung uva kona hinpui galkai Pakai na Pathen uchu keima hi kahin, keiman na bonchauva namkol chu kasuh chip a nangho jouse dingdet puma ka che sah nahiuve.
en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.
text:
LEV 26:13
Thadou: Egypt gam mite soh nahi lou na diuva, agam sung uva kona hinpui galkai Pakai na Pathen uchu keima hi kahin, keiman na bonchauva namkol chu kasuh chip a nangho jouse dingdet puma ka che sah nahiuve.
English: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.

tcz: Na bonchauvin kathu nit ding nanom pouve, thupeh jouse jong najui tapouvin ahi.
en: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,
text:
LEV 26:14
Thadou: Na bonchauvin kathu nit ding nanom pouve, thupeh jouse jong najui tapouvin ahi.
English: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,

tcz: Ka chonna dan aboncha nahsah louva na koi uleh, na hinkho sung uva ka chondan ho kidah le thet a nakoi khah uleh, ka thupeh khat cha beh jong bol ding go louhela naum uva, ka kitepna napel keh khah tah uleh,
en: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,
text:
LEV 26:15
Thadou: Ka chonna dan aboncha nahsah louva na koi uleh, na hinkho sung uva ka chondan ho kidah le thet a nakoi khah uleh, ka thupeh khat cha beh jong bol ding go louhela naum uva, ka kitepna napel keh khah tah uleh,
English: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,

tcz: Keima tah in naboncha chung uva hitobang chu ka lhunsah ding. Na chung cheh uva lunggim hesoh lhung jeng ding chule na gam nadiu ka lhunsah a, nahai hu jengu jong bing leuva ka lhunsah ding ahi, namel mateu neh chai ding bep sohdoh ahi.
en: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.
text:
LEV 26:16
Thadou: Keima tah in naboncha chung uva hitobang chu ka lhunsah ding. Na chung cheh uva lunggim hesoh lhung jeng ding chule na gam nadiu ka lhunsah a, nahai hu jengu jong bing leuva ka lhunsah ding ahi, namel mateu neh chai ding bep sohdoh ahi.
English: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

tcz: Na bonchauva kaki doupi soh keiyuva, namel mateu masanga jong na kisuhgam set diu ahi, nadei lou uleh nathet bol teu aboncha nangho chung vum'a vaihom thuneiya umdiu, koima dellou beh a ha jama najam cheh diu ahi.
en: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.
text:
LEV 26:17
Thadou: Na bonchauva kaki doupi soh keiyuva, namel mateu masanga jong na kisuhgam set diu ahi, nadei lou uleh nathet bol teu aboncha nangho chung vum'a vaihom thuneiya umdiu, koima dellou beh a ha jama najam cheh diu ahi.
English: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

tcz: Akisei chengse nahsah a koi louva kathu jeng jong na kijah mosah ngei ngei uleh, na chonset nauva kona vel sagi jen bolgimna ka lechuh sah ding nahiuve.
en: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
text:
LEV 26:18
Thadou: Akisei chengse nahsah a koi louva kathu jeng jong na kijah mosah ngei ngei uleh, na chonset nauva kona vel sagi jen bolgimna ka lechuh sah ding nahiuve.
English: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

tcz: Na kiletsah nau le natha nei sunu aboncha kasuh manghel ding, na chung cheh uva thih ka chuh sah a, na gam sung jengu jong sum eng ka hisah ding ahi.
en: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.
text:
LEV 26:19
Thadou: Na kiletsah nau le natha nei sunu aboncha kasuh manghel ding, na chung cheh uva thih ka chuh sah a, na gam sung jengu jong sum eng ka hisah ding ahi.
English: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.

tcz: Hitia chu na thanei na jouseu pannabei jeng hi tading, nagam leiset pum piuva jong lhosohga um talou ding, gamsung pumpia thing phung jouse gasoh thei louhel ding ahi.
en: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.
text:
LEV 26:20
Thadou: Hitia chu na thanei na jouseu pannabei jeng hi tading, nagam leiset pum piuva jong lhosohga um talou ding, gamsung pumpia thing phung jouse gasoh thei louhel ding ahi.
English: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

tcz: Keima dounaa na kisah uva na chon khah uleh, keima tah in nat phalou jouse na gamsung ule na boncha chung uva, kalan sah ding ahi.
en: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.
text:
LEV 26:21
Thadou: Keima dounaa na kisah uva na chon khah uleh, keima tah in nat phalou jouse na gamsung ule na boncha chung uva, kalan sah ding ahi.
English: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.

tcz: Keima tah in na boncha chung uva gamsa hang jouse kahin hoilut peh diu, na chateu aboncha abah gamset diu, gancha jeng jong natha chai peh kei uva; na bonchauva na manthai cheh cheh diu, naki jotna jouseu jong thip del ding ahi.
en: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.
text:
LEV 26:22
Thadou: Keima tah in na boncha chung uva gamsa hang jouse kahin hoilut peh diu, na chateu aboncha abah gamset diu, gancha jeng jong natha chai peh kei uva; na bonchauva na manthai cheh cheh diu, naki jotna jouseu jong thip del ding ahi.
English: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse nunga jong na khah doh thei lou uva, nei ki doupi nah lai uva ahileh,
en: “‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,
text:
LEV 26:23
Thadou: Hiche ho jouse nunga jong na khah doh thei lou uva, nei ki doupi nah lai uva ahileh,
English: “‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,

tcz: Keiman na bonchauva kahin kile doupi diu, na chonset jaluva na bonchauva talent namat cheh diu, na pumpiuva kasuh gamset ding nahiuve.
en: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.
text:
LEV 26:24
Thadou: Keiman na bonchauva kahin kile doupi diu, na chonset jaluva na bonchauva talent namat cheh diu, na pumpiuva kasuh gamset ding nahiuve.
English: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.

tcz: Kitepna phulahna chemjam hem chu na chunguva kahin jah jeng ding, Na khopi lai lung uva kikhom khom unlang aning aum jong leu chun, na boncha chung cheh uva natna huise hung lang in tin, chuteng na kidou piteu ma sanga nakun cheh diu ahi.
en: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
text:
LEV 26:25
Thadou: Kitepna phulahna chemjam hem chu na chunguva kahin jah jeng ding, Na khopi lai lung uva kikhom khom unlang aning aum jong leu chun, na boncha chung cheh uva natna huise hung lang in tin, chuteng na kidou piteu ma sanga nakun cheh diu ahi.
English: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

tcz: Nang ho hinna changlhah mol chu kalah peh diu, nalah uva numei som seh seh in jong chang lhah pha bep cha bou anei diu, hichu kitup tah a atena toh kitoh chet a tepeh cheh cheh ding, naneh jeng vang uva oivanaa neh diu ahitapoi.
en: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.
text:
LEV 26:26
Thadou: Nang ho hinna changlhah mol chu kalah peh diu, nalah uva numei som seh seh in jong chang lhah pha bep cha bou anei diu, hichu kitup tah a atena toh kitoh chet a tepeh cheh cheh ding, naneh jeng vang uva oivanaa neh diu ahitapoi.
English: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.

tcz: Kathu naki jah mosah uva, nei ki doupi nah laiyu ahileh,
en: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me,
text:
LEV 26:27
Thadou: Kathu naki jah mosah uva, nei ki doupi nah laiyu ahileh,
English: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me,

tcz: Na chunguva lungsatna tothoa ka doudal diu, hiche chonsetna nanei jaluva ajat sagi vei nachung cheh uva lethuhna chu ding ahi.
en: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.
text:
LEV 26:28
Thadou: Na chunguva lungsatna tothoa ka doudal diu, hiche chonsetna nanei jaluva ajat sagi vei nachung cheh uva lethuhna chu ding ahi.
English: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.

tcz: Na chateu tahsa geiya, numei kithei lou pasal kitheilouva nahin neh nah laidiu ahi.
en: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.
text:
LEV 26:29
Thadou: Na chateu tahsa geiya, numei kithei lou pasal kitheilouva nahin neh nah laidiu ahi.
English: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

tcz: Na chunguva munsang lai jouse kahin suh chim jeng ding, gim namtui na halvam nau maicham phung jeng jong kasuh jaldeh ding, hinkho lhum keiya ka kidah uva kathet ding nahiuve.
en: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.
text:
LEV 26:30
Thadou: Na chunguva munsang lai jouse kahin suh chim jeng ding, gim namtui na halvam nau maicham phung jeng jong kasuh jaldeh ding, hinkho lhum keiya ka kidah uva kathet ding nahiuve.
English: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.

tcz: Na chennau khopi aboncha aching ding koima um louva kalha ding, muntheng lai nanei chengseo jong thipdel ding, nagim namtui lhut nam jengu jong kanah sahpeh lou ding nahiuve.
en: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.
text:
LEV 26:31
Thadou: Na chennau khopi aboncha aching ding koima um louva kalha ding, muntheng lai nanei chengseo jong thipdel ding, nagim namtui lhut nam jengu jong kanah sahpeh lou ding nahiuve.
English: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.

tcz: Gamsung pumpi akeuseh a um ding, nagam sunguva um nakidou piteuvin nalung don jeng diu ahi.
en: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it.
text:
LEV 26:32
Thadou: Gamsung pumpi akeuseh a um ding, nagam sunguva um nakidou piteuvin nalung don jeng diu ahi.
English: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it.

tcz: Namtin chitin lah a kathejal sohhel diu, chemjam kalap a hajam a kajam sah diu, nagam sungu aboncha akeova umding, nakhopi jengu jong thip dela um ding ahi.
en: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
text:
LEV 26:33
Thadou: Namtin chitin lah a kathejal sohhel diu, chemjam kalap a hajam a kajam sah diu, nagam sungu aboncha akeova umding, nakhopi jengu jong thip dela um ding ahi.
English: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.

tcz: Na bonchauva na kidoupi teu gam'a na vaitham sung seuva na gamsung uchu thip dela koima um louva umding, chuteng agam sung pumpi chu kitha kimat ima louva choldam sel ding ahi.
en: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
text:
LEV 26:34
Thadou: Na bonchauva na kidoupi teu gam'a na vaitham sung seuva na gamsung uchu thip dela koima um louva umding, chuteng agam sung pumpi chu kitha kimat ima louva choldam sel ding ahi.
English: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.

tcz: Gamsung chu akeuva aum channa chol damsel ahin, ajeh chu nachen laiyuva cholngah nikho nanit tapouvin hijeh achu cholngah nikho banga chol damsel ding ahitai.
en: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.
text:
LEV 26:35
Thadou: Gamsung chu akeuva aum channa chol damsel ahin, ajeh chu nachen laiyuva cholngah nikho nanit tapouvin hijeh achu cholngah nikho banga chol damsel ding ahitai.
English: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.

tcz: Nalah uva kona athi moh cheng ahing nalai na kidou piteu gamsunga cheng ho jeng jong alungthimu kasuh nemdeh peh diu, nathu khat a kheh lhah a agin khu chemjam kilam banga tijat tothoa jam lele uva, mikhat seh del maimaia jong jamcheh ji diu ahi.
en: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.
text:
LEV 26:36
Thadou: Nalah uva kona athi moh cheng ahing nalai na kidou piteu gamsunga cheng ho jeng jong alungthimu kasuh nemdeh peh diu, nathu khat a kheh lhah a agin khu chemjam kilam banga tijat tothoa jam lele uva, mikhat seh del maimaia jong jamcheh ji diu ahi.
English: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.

tcz: Koima del louva ama ho le ama ho kigela chemjam in adel banga jamcheh diu, khat le khat kinolhua jamcheh cheh jeng ding ahiuvin, na bonchauva naki doupiteu masang kitia nalhuh lhuh jeng diu ahi.
en: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.
text:
LEV 26:37
Thadou: Koima del louva ama ho le ama ho kigela chemjam in adel banga jamcheh diu, khat le khat kinolhua jamcheh cheh jeng ding ahiuvin, na bonchauva naki doupiteu masang kitia nalhuh lhuh jeng diu ahi.
English: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.

tcz: Namtin lah a navaitham gam kei diu, na kidou piteu gam leiset chun nasuh gamset jeng diu ahi.
en: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.
text:
LEV 26:38
Thadou: Namtin lah a navaitham gam kei diu, na kidou piteu gam leiset chun nasuh gamset jeng diu ahi.
English: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.

tcz: Na kidou piteu gamsunga chengho ahing doh chengse jong chu achonset jaluva meidoi gamkei diu, apu apateu chonset a alhah nauva kona amaho jouse jong apu apateu akilo diu meidoi joukei diu ahi.
en: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.
text:
LEV 26:39
Thadou: Na kidou piteu gamsunga chengho ahing doh chengse jong chu achonset jaluva meidoi gamkei diu, apu apateu chonset a alhah nauva kona amaho jouse jong apu apateu akilo diu meidoi joukei diu ahi.
English: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.

tcz: Abonchauva keima douna jeh’a chon khelna abol uva, keima eiki doupi uva joule nal thua achon uva apu apateu chonset phondohna neiya,
en: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,
text:
LEV 26:40
Thadou: Abonchauva keima douna jeh’a chon khelna abol uva, keima eiki doupi uva joule nal thua achon uva apu apateu chonset phondohna neiya,
English: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,

tcz: Hitia achon khah tah jeh uva chu keiman jong akale lama lethuhna achung'uva ka lhunsah ding, akidoupi teu angsunga kapui lut nau ajehmpentah aphondoh thei ule; alung tahna jengu,jong aki suhnem thei uva, achonset nauva kona kisem thahna anei thei uleh,
en: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,
text:
LEV 26:41
Thadou: Hitia achon khah tah jeh uva chu keiman jong akale lama lethuhna achung'uva ka lhunsah ding, akidoupi teu angsunga kapui lut nau ajehmpentah aphondoh thei ule; alung tahna jengu,jong aki suhnem thei uva, achonset nauva kona kisem thahna anei thei uleh,
English: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,

tcz: Jacob henga ka kitepna kageldoh kit ding chule Isaac toh ka kitepna jong kagel doh ding, hitia chu Abraham henga ka kitepna jong kagel doh ding, agam leiset pumpi jong kahin geldoh thaa ka huhdoh kit ding ahi.
en: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.
text:
LEV 26:42
Thadou: Jacob henga ka kitepna kageldoh kit ding chule Isaac toh ka kitepna jong kagel doh ding, hitia chu Abraham henga ka kitepna jong kagel doh ding, agam leiset pumpi jong kahin geldoh thaa ka huhdoh kit ding ahi.
English: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.

tcz: Adalhahna agam sung pumpiu chu cholngah nikho tobanga anisih a choldamnaa aman chah diu, hitia chu chondan jouse nahsah moa akoi uva ahinkho sung uva keima doumah le kidahna achonset jouseova kona kisemphatna achunguva lhung ding ahi.
en: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.
text:
LEV 26:43
Thadou: Adalhahna agam sung pumpiu chu cholngah nikho tobanga anisih a choldamnaa aman chah diu, hitia chu chondan jouse nahsah moa akoi uva ahinkho sung uva keima doumah le kidahna achonset jouseova kona kisemphatna achunguva lhung ding ahi.
English: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse jal'a hi abonchauva akidou piteo gamsunga achen teng uleh, keiman jong abonchauva sumil louhela ka hebol cheh diu, ka kitepna jong umjing ding ahi, ajeh chu keima na Pakai uleh na Pathen uchu kahi jing jenge, ati.
en: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.
text:
LEV 26:44
Thadou: Hiche ho jouse jal'a hi abonchauva akidou piteo gamsunga achen teng uleh, keiman jong abonchauva sumil louhela ka hebol cheh diu, ka kitepna jong umjing ding ahi, ajeh chu keima na Pakai uleh na Pathen uchu kahi jing jenge, ati.
English: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.

tcz: Amaho jouse Pathen kahi jing na dinga keima tah in Egypt gamsunga kona mi jouse mitmu changtah a kahin puigal kaiyu ahin, apu apateu chunga kana kitepna keiman achunguva gelkhohna kanei ding ahi, keima Pakai chu kahi jing jeng e, ati.
en: But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.’”
text:
LEV 26:45
Thadou: Amaho jouse Pathen kahi jing na dinga keima tah in Egypt gamsunga kona mi jouse mitmu changtah a kahin puigal kaiyu ahin, apu apateu chunga kana kitepna keiman achunguva gelkhohna kanei ding ahi, keima Pakai chu kahi jing jeng e, ati.
English: But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.’”

tcz: Hiche chondan jouse ahin chonna dan jouse jaonan, danthu chengse toh Pakaiyin ama tah le Israel chate dinga akoichu ahitia, Mose henga ana thupeh chengse chu ahi.
en: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.
text:
LEV 26:46
Thadou: Hiche chondan jouse ahin chonna dan jouse jaonan, danthu chengse toh Pakaiyin ama tah le Israel chate dinga akoichu ahitia, Mose henga ana thupeh chengse chu ahi.
English: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin asei peh in,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
LEV 27:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin asei peh in,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate henga chondan chengse hi asei peh in, kinop toh jeh a mihem khat chu Pakaiya dia kipeh dohna anei ding ahi, sum aki seijat hi apeh a kilhat doh thei ding ahi.
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to the LORD in a vow, according to your valuation,
text:
LEV 27:2
Thadou: Israel chate henga chondan chengse hi asei peh in, kinop toh jeh a mihem khat chu Pakaiya dia kipeh dohna anei ding ahi, sum aki seijat hi apeh a kilhat doh thei ding ahi.
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to the LORD in a vow, according to your valuation,

tcz: Kitepna dungjui cheh le aki chepi bang banga pasal kum somni apat kumsom gup chan chu dangka somnga jaonan shekel jaonan sanaa kisem shekel somnga hichu muntheng laiya ding ahi.
en: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
text:
LEV 27:3
Thadou: Kitepna dungjui cheh le aki chepi bang banga pasal kum somni apat kumsom gup chan chu dangka somnga jaonan shekel jaonan sanaa kisem shekel somnga hichu muntheng laiya ding ahi.
English: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

tcz: Chule numei ahileh amanu chun dangka somngaa kitepna anei ding ahi.
en: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
text:
LEV 27:4
Thadou: Chule numei ahileh amanu chun dangka somngaa kitepna anei ding ahi.
English: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.

tcz: Hitia chu Pasal kum nga apat somni chan, dangka somni hiding, numei vang chu dangka somkhat hiding ahi.
en: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
text:
LEV 27:5
Thadou: Hitia chu Pasal kum nga apat somni chan, dangka somni hiding, numei vang chu dangka somkhat hiding ahi.
English: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

tcz: Chule naosen kum nga apat noilam dangka cheng nga hi ding, numei ahileh dangka cheng thum hi ding ahi.
en: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.
text:
LEV 27:6
Thadou: Chule naosen kum nga apat noilam dangka cheng nga hi ding, numei ahileh dangka cheng thum hi ding ahi.
English: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

tcz: Amavang pasal kum somgup chunglam dangka somle nga hi ding, numei kum somgup chung lamse ahileh dangka somkhat a lhatdoh thei ahi.
en: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
text:
LEV 27:7
Thadou: Amavang pasal kum somgup chunglam dangka somle nga hi ding, numei kum somgup chung lamse ahileh dangka somkhat a lhatdoh thei ahi.
English: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

tcz: Ahinlah hitobanga kitepna nei dingpa chun, hiche chepi ding chu angaplal banga ahileh, ana kikat dohsa mihempa chu thempu lama apui ding, chuteng thempu pan aman ato khambep ateppeh ding, hiche mipan ajokham ding chu atep peh ding ahi.
en: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.
text:
LEV 27:8
Thadou: Ahinlah hitobanga kitepna nei dingpa chun, hiche chepi ding chu angaplal banga ahileh, ana kikat dohsa mihempa chu thempu lama apui ding, chuteng thempu pan aman ato khambep ateppeh ding, hiche mipan ajokham ding chu atep peh ding ahi.
English: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.

tcz: Amavang hiche kitepna hi gancha peh ding toh kisaiya kitepna nei ding ahileh, Pakai lama santhei ding, hitia chu Pakaiya dia kipe dohsa chu atheng ahi.
en: “‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to the LORD, all that any man gives of such to the LORD becomes holy.
text:
LEV 27:9
Thadou: Amavang hiche kitepna hi gancha peh ding toh kisaiya kitepna nei ding ahileh, Pakai lama santhei ding, hitia chu Pakaiya dia kipe dohsa chu atheng ahi.
English: “‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to the LORD, all that any man gives of such to the LORD becomes holy.

tcz: Kitepna neipa chun gancha chu aphajo ding gelna jal'a adang khat a akhel thei lou ding, apeh khel dia aum jong leh, akatdoh masat le akhel dia akatdoh chu ania atheng ahi.
en: He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy.
text:
LEV 27:10
Thadou: Kitepna neipa chun gancha chu aphajo ding gelna jal'a adang khat a akhel thei lou ding, apeh khel dia aum jong leh, akatdoh masat le akhel dia akatdoh chu ania atheng ahi.
English: He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy.

tcz: Pakai lama katdoh theilou hichu gancha theng lou kitepna ahi vangleh, kitepna nei dingpa chun agancha chu thempupa heng lama akai ding ahi.
en: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to the LORD, then he shall set the animal before the priest;

tcz: Thempu pan aman lutdan le aman lut lou dan atetoh ding, thempu pan aphatsah dungjuiya hichu achaina hi ding ahi.
en: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.
text:
LEV 27:12
Thadou: Thempu pan aman lutdan le aman lut lou dan atetoh ding, thempu pan aphatsah dungjuiya hichu achaina hi ding ahi.
English: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.

tcz: Ahinlah akatdoh pa chun akile lhat noma ahileh, aman jat jaonaa jakhat lah a somni toh alepeh tha ding ahi.
en: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.
text:
LEV 27:13
Thadou: Ahinlah akatdoh pa chun akile lhat noma ahileh, aman jat jaonaa jakhat lah a somni toh alepeh tha ding ahi.
English: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

tcz: Chule mi koi hileh a in atheng dinga Pakai henga apehdoh noma ahileh, in ahoi dan le ahoi loudan dungjuiya thempu pan jong atetoh chet ding, thempu pan atetoh bang banga chu achaina hi jeng ding ahi.
en: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to the LORD, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.
text:
LEV 27:14
Thadou: Chule mi koi hileh a in atheng dinga Pakai henga apehdoh noma ahileh, in ahoi dan le ahoi loudan dungjuiya thempu pan jong atetoh chet ding, thempu pan atetoh bang banga chu achaina hi jeng ding ahi.
English: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to the LORD, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.

tcz: In pedoh pa chun akile lhatdoh noma ahileh, aman sum leh jakhat lah a somni chu toh ale peh tha jeng ding ahi. Hichea bouchu akitepna banga lechan thei ding ahi.
en: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.
text:
LEV 27:15
Thadou: In pedoh pa chun akile lhatdoh noma ahileh, aman sum leh jakhat lah a somni chu toh ale peh tha jeng ding ahi. Hichea bouchu akitepna banga lechan thei ding ahi.
English: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

tcz: Chule koi ham khat chun Pakaiya dia agam beh khat tou apeh doh noma ahileh, hiche gambeh khat chu muchi kitu lutjat ding toh atetoh a, chuteng suhlou chang shekel somni ki tulutna thei gambeh chu sum somkhat man jat atepeh ding ahi.
en: “‘If a man dedicates to the LORD part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
text:
LEV 27:16
Thadou: Chule koi ham khat chun Pakaiya dia agam beh khat tou apeh doh noma ahileh, hiche gambeh khat chu muchi kitu lutjat ding toh atetoh a, chuteng suhlou chang shekel somni ki tulutna thei gambeh chu sum somkhat man jat atepeh ding ahi.
English: “‘If a man dedicates to the LORD part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

tcz: Thil kile pehna kum kut kon chaa apeh doh khah ahile vang, aki tepehna banga aman jat jong lhingset a apeh ding ahi.
en: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.
text:
LEV 27:17
Thadou: Thil kile pehna kum kut kon chaa apeh doh khah ahile vang, aki tepehna banga aman jat jong lhingset a apeh ding ahi.
English: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.

tcz: Ahinlah agambeh chu apat a alhat doh jou louva ahileh, thil kile pehna kum kut ahung lhun kahsea dinga thempu pan aman jat atetoh peh ding, aman hichea chu lhat dohna anei thei ding ahi.
en: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.
text:
LEV 27:18
Thadou: Ahinlah agambeh chu apat a alhat doh jou louva ahileh, thil kile pehna kum kut ahung lhun kahsea dinga thempu pan aman jat atetoh peh ding, aman hichea chu lhat dohna anei thei ding ahi.
English: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.

tcz: Agam beh pedoh pa chun akile lhat noma ahileh, sum aman jat bang banga jakhat lah a somni toh alepeh tha ding, hichea bouchu lechan thei ding ahi.
en: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.
text:
LEV 27:19
Thadou: Agam beh pedoh pa chun akile lhat noma ahileh, sum aman jat bang banga jakhat lah a somni toh alepeh tha ding, hichea bouchu lechan thei ding ahi.
English: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

tcz: Pakai henga chodoh louva midang kom khat touva agam beh chu ajoh doh khah bang leh, hichu itih chan hijong leh akile lhatdoh thei talou ding ahi.
en: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;

tcz: Amavang thil kile peh to kum ahung lhung ding, chuting leh imatih chana Pakai gambeh mong monga um ding, hitia chu thempu pan ama neiya akisim ding ahi.
en: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to the LORD, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.
text:
LEV 27:21
Thadou: Amavang thil kile peh to kum ahung lhung ding, chuting leh imatih chana Pakai gambeh mong monga um ding, hitia chu thempu pan ama neiya akisim ding ahi.
English: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to the LORD, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.

tcz: Chule koi hileh aki chodohsa gambeh khattou Pakaiya dia apehdoh noma ahileh, hichu ama gambeh hilou ding ahi.
en: “‘If he dedicates a field to the LORD which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,
text:
LEV 27:22
Thadou: Chule koi hileh aki chodohsa gambeh khattou Pakaiya dia apehdoh noma ahileh, hichu ama gambeh hilou ding ahi.
English: “‘If he dedicates a field to the LORD which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,

tcz: Hitia chu thempu pan thil man lepeh kum ahung lhun ding to kitoh a aman jat atepeh
en: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to the LORD.
text:
LEV 27:23
Thadou: Hitia chu thempu pan thil man lepeh kum ahung lhun ding to kitoh a aman jat atepeh
English: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to the LORD.

tcz: Thil kilepeh na kum ahung lhun teng leh, hiche gambeh chu aneisa pa ahilouleh aki naipi henga lepeh kit ding ahi.
en: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.
text:
LEV 27:24
Thadou: Thil kilepeh na kum ahung lhun teng leh, hiche gambeh chu aneisa pa ahilouleh aki naipi henga lepeh kit ding ahi.
English: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.

tcz: Thilman ho aboncha chondan dungjuiya akiman dan bang banga ale teppeh cheh ding, hichu Gerah somni jaona shekel toh kitoh ding ahi.
en: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.
text:
LEV 27:25
Thadou: Thilman ho aboncha chondan dungjuiya akiman dan bang banga ale teppeh cheh ding, hichu Gerah somni jaona shekel toh kitoh ding ahi.

en: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

en: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

NUM 2:33
Thadou: Pakai thu peh bang chun Levite vang chu amin u akisim tha tapon ahi.
English: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Hitichun Pakai in Mose ana thupeh bang bang chun Israelten imajouse abolsohkei tauvin ahi. Pakai thupeh jui in ama ama insung leh phung jem noi cheh a chun akijotji un chuleh ngahmun jong asemji tauve.
en: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

tcz: Hiche hi Sinai molchunga Pakaiyin Mose ahoupi lai a ana kijihlut Aaron le Mose insung khanggui thu chu ahi.

NUM 3:1
Thadou: Hiche hi Sinai molchunga Pakaiyin Mose ahoupi lai a ana kijihlut Aaron le Mose insung khanggui thu chu ahi.
English: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.

tcz: Aaron chapateho min chu Nadab (atah pen), Abihu, Elezear chule Ithamar ahiuve.
en: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
text:
NUM 3:2
Thadou: Aaron chapateho min chu Nadab (atah pen), Abihu, Elezear chule Ithamar ahiuve.
English: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

en: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.
text:
NUM 3:3
Thadou: Hiche Aaron chapateho chengse hin thempu kintheng atoh thei nading uva thao anu uva chule atumbeh a kilhandoh ahiuve.
English: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

tcz: Ahinlah Nadab le Abihu chu Pathen umpet a Sinai gamthip a maicham asemlai uva Pathen thupeh toh kikal a meikong dihlou ahal lhon jeh chun, ani lhonin hiche muna chun athilhon tan ahi. Chapa dang aneitahlou jeh in kintheng natong ding chu adalhahlhon Eleazer le Ithamar chutoh apalhon Aaraon chubou ahitauve.
en: Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD when they offered strange fire before the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.
text:
NUM 3:4

text:
NUM 3:5
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseiyin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

text:

tcz: Levi chilhahho jouse chun Aaron leh achapate vaihomna noi a umsah in. Amaho chu Israel mipiho jouse lah a kon a Aaron le achapate jenle ding leh kithopi ding a kipehdoh ah ahitauvin ahi.
en: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.

Thadou: Levi chilhahho jouse chun Aaron leh achapate vaihomna noi a umsah in. Amaho chu Israel mipiho jouse lah a kon a Aaron le achapate jenle ding leh kithopi ding a kipehdoh ah ahitauvin ahi.

tcz: Aaron le achapateho jouse chun thempu kintheng na atoh ding uvin seipeh in. Koi hijongleh nganse changlou a muntheng ganailut hochu thitei teidiu ahi.
en: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”
text:
NUM 3:10
Thadou: Aaron le achapateho jouse chun thempu kintheng na atoh ding uvin seipeh in. Koi hijongleh nganse changlou a muntheng ganailut hochu thitei teidiu ahi.

tcz: “Ven, Levite hi Israel japi lah kon a Israel chapate apengmasa jouse thalheng a natong ding a kalhendoh ahitai. Leviteho jouse keiya ahi.
en: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,

English: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,

tcz: Ajehchu chapa tahpen jouse keima a ahi. Egypt chapate lah a apeng masa jouse kanasuhgam nikho apatna keima Israel chapa tahpen jouse hi keidia atumbeh a ka lhendohsa ahin, mihem a hihen gancha a hi jongleh amaho jouse chu keia ahiuve; Keima Pakai chu kahi.”
en: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am the LORD.”
text:

Thadou: Ajehchu chapa tahpen jouse keima a ahi. Egypt chapate lah a apeng masa jouse kanasuhgam nikho apatna keima Israel chapa tahpen jouse hi keidia atumbeh a ka lhendohsa ahin, mihem a hihen gancha a hi jongleh amaho jouse chu keia ahiuve; Keima Pakai chu kahi.”
English: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am the LORD.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Sinai molchung a chun Mose hengah thu aseikit in, hiti hin ati,

NUM 3:14
Thadou: Pakaiyin Sinai molchung a chun Mose hengah thu aseikit in, hiti hin ati,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

tcz: “Levite chu ama ama insung leh phung kailhah in amin u jihlut cheh in. Pasal jouse lhakhat a pat chunglam se jihlut in.”
en: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”
text:
NUM 3:15
Thadou: “Levite chu ama ama insung leh phung kailhah in amin u jihlut cheh in. Pasal jouse lhakhat a pat chunglam se jihlut in.”
English: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”

tcz: Hichun Mose chun Pakai thupeh bang chun minho chu ajihlut tan ahi.

text:
NUM 3:16
Thadou: Hichun Mose chun Pakai thupeh bang chun minho chu ajihlut tan ahi.
English: Moses counted them according to the LORD’s word, as he was commanded.

English: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

NUM 3:20
Thadou: Merari a kon a phungguiho chu ama chilhahte lah a kon a mini min, Mahli le Mushi a kiminsah ahiuve.
English: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.

tcz: Gershon chilhahte chu Libni le Shimei phunggui akon ahiuvin ahi.
en: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.
text:
NUM 3:21
Thadou: Gershon chilhahte chu Libni le Shimei phunggui akon ahiuvin ahi.
English: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.

en: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.
text:

Thadou: Gershonte phunggui a kon a Pasal kum khat a pat chunglam chu abonchauvin mi 7,500 aum uve.
English: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.

Thadou: Amaho chu houbuh akon a lhumlam lang chu angahmun kisahna ding uva kipedoh ahiuve.
English: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

tcz: Gershonte phungho chung a lamkai a ana pang chu Lael chapa Eliasaph ahi.

text:
NUM 3:24
Thadou: Gershonte phungho chung a lamkai a ana pang chu Lael chapa Eliasaph ahi.
English: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.

tcz: Hiche phung teni chung a mopohna a um chu ahileh houbuh avetsui diu, ponbuhtheng leh achung a kidal akhuna chengse ahin, maicham ponbuh lutna phung a kikhai pondal ahin,
en: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
text:
NUM 3:25
Thadou: Hiche phung teni chung a mopohna a um chu ahileh houbuh avetsui diu, ponbuhtheng leh achung a kidal akhuna chengse ahin, maicham ponbuh lutna phung a kikhai pondal ahin,
English: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

en: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.
text:

Thadou: Maicham ponbuh leh maicham phung kimvel a ki-dah pondal chengse ahin, a khaoho ahin, chuleh manchah akimangcha ding jouse jaona a ahiye.
English: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.

tcz: Kohath chilhahte chu Amram, Izhar, Hebron chule Uzziel phung a kon ahiuve.
en: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.
text:
NUM 3:27
Thadou: Kohath chilhahte chu Amram, Izhar, Hebron chule Uzziel phung a kon ahiuve.
English: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.

tcz: Gershonte phunggui a kon a Pasal kum khat a pat chunglam chu abonchauvin mi 8,600 aum uvin, amaho chu muntheng ventup leh vettupna mopohna kipe ahiuvin,
en: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.
text:
NUM 3:28
Thadou: Gershonte phunggui a kon a Pasal kum khat a pat chunglam chu abonchauvin mi 8,600 aum uvin, amaho chu muntheng ventup leh vettupna mopohna kipe ahiuvin,
English: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.

tcz: chuleh angahmun sahna ding uva Houbuh a kon a lhanglam kipe ahiuve.
en: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.
text:
NUM 3:29
Thadou: chuleh angahmun sahna ding uva Houbuh a kon a lhanglam kipe ahiuve.
English: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.

tcz: Kohath phungho chung a lamkai a ana pang chu Uzzeil chapa Elizaphan ahi.

text:
NUM 3:30
