English: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

tcz: Hiche phung li ho hin Pathen thingkhong, dokhang, thaomei khom, maicham phungho, houbuh sung a kimang thil le lo chom chomho, asung dan pondal, chuleh amaho manchah ding a angaicha jouse chung a mopohna anei ding u ahi.
en: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.
text:
NUM 3:31
Thadou: Hiche phung li ho hin Pathen thingkhong, dokhang, thaomei khom, maicham phungho, houbuh sung a kimang thil le lo chom chomho, asung dan pondal, chuleh amaho manchah ding a angaicha jouse chung a mopohna anei ding u ahi.
English: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.

tcz: Thempupa Aaron chapa Eleazer chu, Levite ho jouse chung a vaihom pipu anahin, houbuh sung a nakitong jouse vetup ding a deichom a mopohna kipe ahi
en: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.
text:
NUM 3:32
Thadou: Thempupa Aaron chapa Eleazer chu, Levite ho jouse chung a vaihom pipu anahin, houbuh sung a nakitong jouse vetup ding a deichom a mopohna kipe ahi
English: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.

tcz: Merari chilhahte chu Mushi le Mahli phung a kon ahiuve.
en: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.
text:
NUM 3:33
Thadou: Merari chilhahte chu Mushi le Mahli phung a kon ahiuve.
English: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

tcz: Merari phunggui a kon a Pasal kum khat a pat chunglam chu abonchauvin mi 6,200 aum uve.
en: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
text:
NUM 3:34
Thadou: Merari phunggui a kon a Pasal kum khat a pat chunglam chu abonchauvin mi 6,200 aum uve.
English: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.

tcz: Amaho chu houbuh akon a Sahlam lang chu angahmun kisahna ding uva kipedoh ahiuve. Merari phungho chung a lamkai a ana pang chu Abihal chapa Zuriel ahi.
en: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.
text:
NUM 3:35
Thadou: Amaho chu houbuh akon a Sahlam lang chu angahmun kisahna ding uva kipedoh ahiuve. Merari phungho chung a lamkai a ana pang chu Abihal chapa Zuriel ahi.
English: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.

tcz: Hiche phung teni hin houbuh thingkolho, ingolvaiho, akhumho, akhumdouho leh amaho manding manchah ho jouse avetup diu ahi.
en: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,
text:
NUM 3:36
Thadou: Hiche phung teni hin houbuh thingkolho, ingolvaiho, akhumho, akhumdouho leh amaho manding manchah ho jouse avetup diu ahi.
English: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,

tcz: Chuleh houbuh kimvel a palkhumho leh athehho ahin, akikhainaho le khaoho jouse jong avettup ding u ahi.
en: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.
text:
NUM 3:37
Thadou: Chuleh houbuh kimvel a palkhumho leh athehho ahin, akikhainaho le khaoho jouse jong avettup ding u ahi.
English: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.

tcz: Maicham ponbuh mai lhang, solam niso lamkot lang sese chu, Israel mipi ho thalheng a Houbuh muntheng a natohna ding a mopohna nunungpen kipe, Mose le Aaron chapate ponbuh kisahna dinga ana kikoitup a ahi. Koi hijeng jong leh Thempu le Levite tilou Houbuh muntheng maicham lang hin nailailut tapou chu tha jeng ding ahi.
en: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, with Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
text:
NUM 3:38
Thadou: Maicham ponbuh mai lhang, solam niso lamkot lang sese chu, Israel mipi ho thalheng a Houbuh muntheng a natohna ding a mopohna nunungpen kipe, Mose le Aaron chapate ponbuh kisahna dinga ana kikoitup a ahi. Koi hijeng jong leh Thempu le Levite tilou Houbuh muntheng maicham lang hin nailailut tapou chu tha jeng ding ahi.
English: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, with Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.

tcz: Mose le Aaron chun Pakai thupeh banga Levite phunghoa a kon in pasal lhakhatna pat chunglam se chu asim lhon in ahileh mi 22,000 alhing uvin ahi.
en: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of the LORD, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
text:
NUM 3:39
Thadou: Mose le Aaron chun Pakai thupeh banga Levite phunghoa a kon in pasal lhakhatna pat chunglam se chu asim lhon in ahileh mi 22,000 alhing uvin ahi.
English: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of the LORD, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseiyin, “Tun nangman Israelte chapate apeng masa lhakhat lhingtasa apat chunglam jouse amin u jih lut in.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
text:
NUM 3:40
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseiyin, “Tun nangman Israelte chapate apeng masa lhakhat lhingtasa apat chunglam jouse amin u jih lut in.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

tcz: Keima Pakai kahin, keima ding a Levite chu, Israel chapa tahpenho thalhelng ding a kikoitup teitei ding ahi. Chuleh Israelte pumpi a gancha apengdoh masa ho khel ding a Levite gancha ho chu kikoitup teitei ding ahi.
en: You shall take the Levites for me—I am the LORD—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”
text:
NUM 3:41
Thadou: Keima Pakai kahin, keima ding a Levite chu, Israel chapa tahpenho thalhelng ding a kikoitup teitei ding ahi. Chuleh Israelte pumpi a gancha apengdoh masa ho khel ding a Levite gancha ho chu kikoitup teitei ding ahi.
English: You shall take the Levites for me—I am the LORD—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”

tcz: Hitichun Mosen Pathen thupeh bangtah in Israel chapate lah a atahpen ho chu asimtan ahi.
en: Moses counted, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
text:
NUM 3:42
Thadou: Hitichun Mosen Pathen thupeh bangtah in Israel chapate lah a atahpen ho chu asimtan ahi.
English: Moses counted, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseiyin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 3:44
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose jah a aseiyin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: “Levite chu Israel chapate lah a atahpen ho thalheng chun la in. Chuleh Israelte gancha apeng masa ho khel ding a Levite gancha ho chu nalah ding ahi. Keima Pakai kahi, Levite chu keiya ahibouve.
en: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am the LORD.
text:
NUM 3:45
Thadou: “Levite chu Israel chapate lah a atahpen ho thalheng chun la in. Chuleh Israelte gancha apeng masa ho khel ding a Levite gancha ho chu nalah ding ahi. Keima Pakai kahi, Levite chu keiya ahibouve.
English: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am the LORD.

tcz: Levite sang in Israel chapate apeng masa mi 273 in atamjo uvin ahi. Amaho lhatdoh a aum thei na ding un,
en: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,
text:
NUM 3:46
Thadou: Levite sang in Israel chapate apeng masa mi 273 in atamjo uvin ahi. Amaho lhatdoh a aum thei na ding un,
English: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,

tcz: mikhat cheh a ding a Sumgoi a Shekel nga nalahkhom ding, hiche shekel chu muntheng laiya shekel ho toh agihdan nakibahsah ding, gerah somnia shekel khat dungjuiya nate ding ahi.
en: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs);

tcz: Chapa pengmasa avahdoh ho lhatdoh na ding in hiche sum chu Aaron le achapate petan.”
en: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”
text:
NUM 3:48
Thadou: Chapa pengmasa avahdoh ho lhatdoh na ding in hiche sum chu Aaron le achapate petan.”
English: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”

tcz: Hiti chun Levite jat sang a hung tamjo Israel chapa tahpen ho lhatdoh a aum nading uvin Mosen in sum ho chu achom khom in ahi.
en: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;

tcz: Aman Israel chapate lah a apengmasa ho thalheng chun sum pum 1,365 achomdoh in ahi. Hiche ho khat cheh hi muntheng a Shekel khat cheh toh agihdan kibang cheh ahiuve.
en: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

tcz: Chuin Pathen in thu apeh bang bang chun, akilhatdoh thei nadiuvin Mose in hiche sumho chu Aaron le achapate apetan ahi.
en: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to the LORD’s word, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
NUM 3:51
Thadou: Chuin Pathen in thu apeh bang bang chun, akilhatdoh thei nadiuvin Mose in hiche sumho chu Aaron le achapate apetan ahi.
English: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to the LORD’s word, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron henga thu aseijin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
text:
NUM 4:1
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron henga thu aseijin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

tcz: Levi phung sung a kon a Kohath insung le chilhahte chu aminhou najih lut ding ahi.
en: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
text:
NUM 4:2
Thadou: Levi phung sung a kon a Kohath insung le chilhahte chu aminhou najih lut ding ahi.
English: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

tcz: Amaho lah a houbuh sunglam maicham phunga natong thei ding a lhinna nei, kum somthum apat kum-somnga sungse hochu abonchan jihlut in.
en: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
text:
NUM 4:3
Thadou: Amaho lah a houbuh sunglam maicham phunga natong thei ding a lhinna nei, kum somthum apat kum-somnga sungse hochu abonchan jihlut in.
English: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: “Kohath hon Houbuh sunga anatoh ding u chu manchah thil athenga umho jouse vettupna chungchang chu ahi.
en: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.
text:
NUM 4:4
Thadou: “Kohath hon Houbuh sunga anatoh ding u chu manchah thil athenga umho jouse vettupna chungchang chu ahi.
English: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.

tcz: Amahon ngahmun u achon ding teng ule Houbuh maicham sunnung pondal chu Aaron le achaten alahlhah diu kitepna thingkong khuna a anei ding u ahi.
en: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,
text:
NUM 4:5
Thadou: Amahon ngahmun u achon ding teng ule Houbuh maicham sunnung pondal chu Aaron le achaten alahlhah diu kitepna thingkong khuna a anei ding u ahi.
English: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,

tcz: Chuteng hiche pondal chu kelcha vun kisuhtah a atom dingu, hiche ho jouse chu pondum khatseh a apha chansoh ding u ahi. Chiho jouse kichai teng thingkhong chu aputna thinglhon toh asuhto ding u ahi.
en: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.
text:
NUM 4:6
Thadou: Chuteng hiche pondal chu kelcha vun kisuhtah a atom dingu, hiche ho jouse chu pondum khatseh a apha chansoh ding u ahi. Chiho jouse kichai teng thingkhong chu aputna thinglhon toh asuhto ding u ahi.
English: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.

tcz: “Abankit a Changlhah a umpi jing ahiu melchihna, hiche Changlhah kikoina dokhang chunga pondum khat aphajal ding u ahi. chuleh hiche pon kipha chung a chu lheng kongho, gimnamtui halna lhengho, khonho, tui lhitthengna, chuleh deisahtah a aumjing jeng changlhah ho kikoi ding ahi.
en: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.
text:
NUM 4:7
Thadou: “Abankit a Changlhah a umpi jing ahiu melchihna, hiche Changlhah kikoina dokhang chunga pondum khat aphajal ding u ahi. chuleh hiche pon kipha chung a chu lheng kongho, gimnamtui halna lhengho, khonho, tui lhitthengna, chuleh deisahtah a aumjing jeng changlhah ho kikoi ding ahi.
English: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.

tcz: Amahon hicheho jouse chu ponsan a akhu diu, chutengle kelchavun thengsel'a hiche ponsan chu kikhuson kit diu ahi. Chujouteng dokhang chu aputna ding thinglhon toh asuhto ding u ahi.
en: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
text:
NUM 4:8
Thadou: Amahon hicheho jouse chu ponsan a akhu diu, chutengle kelchavun thengsel'a hiche ponsan chu kikhuson kit diu ahi. Chujouteng dokhang chu aputna ding thinglhon toh asuhto ding u ahi.
English: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

tcz: Hicheban jom a chu amahon pondum-eng achu thaomei khum chu ahin khu a, thaomei semtohna, achoina kong, chuleh Olive thao kikoina khon jong chu akhu khum dingu ahi.
en: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.
text:
NUM 4:9
Thadou: Hicheban jom a chu amahon pondum-eng achu thaomei khum chu ahin khu a, thaomei semtohna, achoina kong, chuleh Olive thao kikoina khon jong chu akhu khum dingu ahi.
English: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.

tcz: Chule amahon pondum a chu thaomei khom leh athil manchah ho jouse chu kelchavun thengsel'a atom khum uva chuleh hiche alom chu akiputna kolchahna chung a chu akoi ding u ahi.
en: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.
text:
NUM 4:10
Thadou: Chule amahon pondum a chu thaomei khom leh athil manchah ho jouse chu kelchavun thengsel'a atom khum uva chuleh hiche alom chu akiputna kolchahna chung a chu akoi ding u ahi.
English: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.

tcz: “Chuban leh pondum khat a sana gimnamtui maicham kilhaina chung a aphajal ding u, kelchavun thengsel'a hiche pon chu akhu diu ahi. Chuteng aputna ding thinglhon toh maicham chu asuhto ding u ahi.
en: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
text:
NUM 4:11
Thadou: “Chuban leh pondum khat a sana gimnamtui maicham kilhaina chung a aphajal ding u, kelchavun thengsel'a hiche pon chu akhu diu ahi. Chuteng aputna ding thinglhon toh maicham chu asuhto ding u ahi.
English: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

tcz: Maicham kin a dia manchah akigongtuplou laise chu pondum khat a tomding, kelchavun thengsel khat a hiche pon chu kitomson ding, chuteng aputna kolchah a chu kikoi ding ahi.
en: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.
text:
NUM 4:12
Thadou: Maicham kin a dia manchah akigongtuplou laise chu pondum khat a tomding, kelchavun thengsel khat a hiche pon chu kitomson ding, chuteng aputna kolchah a chu kikoi ding ahi.
English: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

tcz: “Amahon kilhaina ding a maicham phung a kon a vutvam hochu alodoh diu, chule ponsandup a maicham phung chu atom diu ahi.
en: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.
text:
NUM 4:13
Thadou: “Amahon kilhaina ding a maicham phung a kon a vutvam hochu alodoh diu, chule ponsandup a maicham phung chu atom diu ahi.
English: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.

tcz: Maicham thilkeuho jouse - meihalna kong, thihkhe, leilodohna longkhol, kisilna kongho, chuleh thilkoina ho jouse - pon chung a chu kikoi a, chuleh kelchavun thengsel chu hiche ho chung a chu kiphajal a kikhu ding ahi. Chuteng aputna thingjol chutoh asuhto ding u ahi.
en: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.
text:
NUM 4:14
Thadou: Maicham thilkeuho jouse - meihalna kong, thihkhe, leilodohna longkhol, kisilna kongho, chuleh thilkoina ho jouse - pon chung a chu kikoi a, chuleh kelchavun thengsel chu hiche ho chung a chu kiphajal a kikhu ding ahi. Chuteng aputna thingjol chutoh asuhto ding u ahi.
English: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.

tcz: Aaron le achapaten munthengho ahin, atheng a um thil le lo ho ahin, ahintom jousoh teng ule ngahmun a kon a kitol theidiu ahitai. Kohath chapaten hiche hi lhun nading mun chan ahin putdiu ahi. Ahivang a thil theng hochu asuhkhah louhel ding u ahi, achuti louleh thilo ding ahiuve. Hichengse hi Kohath chapaten houbuh a kona aput diu ho chu ahi.
en: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.
text:
NUM 4:15
Thadou: Aaron le achapaten munthengho ahin, atheng a um thil le lo ho ahin, ahintom jousoh teng ule ngahmun a kon a kitol theidiu ahitai. Kohath chapaten hiche hi lhun nading mun chan ahin putdiu ahi. Ahivang a thil theng hochu asuhkhah louhel ding u ahi, achuti louleh thilo ding ahiuve. Hichengse hi Kohath chapaten houbuh a kona aput diu ho chu ahi.
English: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Aaron chapa Eleazer thempupa mopohna chu thaomei khom a thaotuiho, gim namtui ho, niseh a kitoh lhosoh thiltoho, kinuding thaotui ho avettup jing ding ahi. Houbuh pumpi leh asung thil ijakai, muntheng le muntheng a akimangcha jouse chu Eleazar vettup na noi a um ding ahi.
en: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”
text:
NUM 4:16
Thadou: Aaron chapa Eleazer thempupa mopohna chu thaomei khom a thaotuiho, gim namtui ho, niseh a kitoh lhosoh thiltoho, kinuding thaotui ho avettup jing ding ahi. Houbuh pumpi leh asung thil ijakai, muntheng le muntheng a akimangcha jouse chu Eleazar vettup na noi a um ding ahi.
English: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron henga thu aseiyin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
text:
NUM 4:17
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose le Aaron henga thu aseiyin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

tcz: “Levite phung a konin Kohath chilhah ho mahthah sahhih in.
en: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

tcz: Muntheng pen thil ho ahin nailut teng a thilou nadiuva nang in hiche hi nabolpeh ding ahi. Aaron le achapaten aki lhonlutpi jing diu chule amichang cheh a atoding abol ding u chu napeh cheh ding ahi.
en: but do this to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;

tcz: Kohath chilhah techu phat chomcha hijongleh muntheng laiya thil umho veding a lutlou hel ding u ahiuve, achuti louleh thitei teidiu ahi.”
en: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”
text:
NUM 4:20
Thadou: Kohath chilhah techu phat chomcha hijongleh muntheng laiya thil umho veding a lutlou hel ding u ahiuve, achuti louleh thitei teidiu ahi.”
English: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga ahin asei in,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 4:21

Thadou: “Chuteng Thempupan Numeinu chu Pakai thutanna ang a adinsah ding ahiye.
English: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD.

tcz: Thempu chun leikhonlen a tuitheng themkhat asodoh a Houbuh mai leitol a konna leivui alahdoh chu asunkhum ding ahi.
en: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.
text:
NUM 5:17
Thadou: Thempu chun leikhonlen a tuitheng themkhat asodoh a Houbuh mai leitol a konna leivui alahdoh chu asunkhum ding ahi.
English: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

tcz: Thempu pan hiche numeinu chu Pathen henga ahin kilahsah teng, amanu sam chu alheplhah peh ding chule akhutteni chu hettohsah kilhaina a chu akoipeh ding ahi - hichu inneipu ginmona chu atah alhem ahi hetthei na dinga kibol ahi. Hiche teng Thempu chu numeinu nunglam a ding, athemmo pen pen gaosap chan na ding tuikha umna leikhonlen, chu ahin dop ding ahi.
en: The priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.
text:
NUM 5:18
Thadou: Thempu pan hiche numeinu chu Pathen henga ahin kilahsah teng, amanu sam chu alheplhah peh ding chule akhutteni chu hettohsah kilhaina a chu akoipeh ding ahi - hichu inneipu ginmona chu atah alhem ahi hetthei na dinga kibol ahi. Hiche teng Thempu chu numeinu nunglam a ding, athemmo pen pen gaosap chan na ding tuikha umna leikhonlen, chu ahin dop ding ahi.
English: The priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.

tcz: Hiche teng chule Thempupan numeinu kitepna noi a aumsah a, “Najipa thunoiya naum sung a Pasal dangtoh nana chonset khah louva, nana chonchatvei louva nana kisuhboh lou leh, hiche gaosapna tuikhatah hi nathoh jou ding himei tahen” tia asei ding ahi.
en: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.
text:
NUM 5:19
Thadou: Hiche teng chule Thempupan numeinu kitepna noi a aumsah a, “Najipa thunoiya naum sung a Pasal dangtoh nana chonset khah louva, nana chonchatvei louva nana kisuhboh lou leh, hiche gaosapna tuikhatah hi nathoh jou ding himei tahen” tia asei ding ahi.
English: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.

tcz: Ahinlah na in-neipu adia kitahjou lou jeh a nana chekhel khah tah a, pasal dang toh nana chonset a nana kisuhboh khah tah a ahileh,'
en: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”
text:
NUM 5:20
Thadou: Ahinlah na in-neipu adia kitahjou lou jeh a nana chekhel khah tah a, pasal dang toh nana chonset a nana kisuhboh khah tah a ahileh,'
English: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”

tcz: “Thempu pan numeinu chu kitepna noi a aum sah ding, hitia hi asei ding ahi, ‘Pakaiyin chaneithei louva nakoi a, nanaobun panna aneilouva, nathong apomsah teng mipi jousen Pakai sapsetna nachunga lhung ahitai ti hehen.
en: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “May the LORD make you a curse and an oath among your people, when the LORD allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;

tcz: Tuhin hiche sapsetna tuihi nasung a lut henlang, nathong pomsah hen lang, naobu jong pannabei himai tahen.’ Chuleh numeinu chu, ‘Henge, hung lhung tahen’ atisah ding ahi.
en: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”
text:
NUM 5:22
Thadou: Tuhin hiche sapsetna tuihi nasung a lut henlang, nathong pomsah hen lang, naobu jong pannabei himai tahen.’ Chuleh numeinu chu, ‘Henge, hung lhung tahen’ atisah ding ahi.
English: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”

tcz: Chule Thempupa chun hiche sapsetna thucheng ho chu savun chunga ajihdoh a hiche tuikha a chu a sop lhah ding ahi.
en: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness.
text:
NUM 5:23
Thadou: Chule Thempupa chun hiche sapsetna thucheng ho chu savun chunga ajihdoh a hiche tuikha a chu a sop lhah ding ahi.
English: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness.

tcz: Hiche sapsetna polut tuikha chu numeinu adonsah ding ahi. Itiham khat a hiche numei chu themmo chang ahikhah leh tui chun amanu oisung aphah teng, hiche chun khajenjun a athohlelsah ding ahi.
en: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.
text:
NUM 5:24
Thadou: Hiche sapsetna polut tuikha chu numeinu adonsah ding ahi. Itiham khat a hiche numei chu themmo chang ahikhah leh tui chun amanu oisung aphah teng, hiche chun khajenjun a athohlelsah ding ahi.
English: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.

tcz: Thempu pan hiche thangtom kilhaina chu numeinu khutna kon a alahdoh a, Pakai masang a dopsang ding, chuleh maicham phung a achoi ding ahitai.
en: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.
text:
NUM 5:25
Thadou: Thempu pan hiche thangtom kilhaina chu numeinu khutna kon a alahdoh a, Pakai masang a dopsang ding, chuleh maicham phung a achoi ding ahitai.
English: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.

tcz: Thempupa chun hiche changbong khutsip dim khat chu mangmo thilto ding a ahamdoh a maicham phunga ahalvam ding, tui chu numei adonsah teitei ding ahi.
en: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.
text:
NUM 5:26
Thadou: Thempupa chun hiche changbong khutsip dim khat chu mangmo thilto ding a ahamdoh a maicham phunga ahalvam ding, tui chu numei adonsah teitei ding ahi.
English: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

tcz: Hiche numeinu chu a jipa angsung a kitah joulouva ana kisuboh khah tahleh, hiche sapsetna po tui chun numeinu chu khajenjun a atholelsah ding ahi. athong hung poh ding chule anaobu jong panna bei hiding, chuteng chuleh amanu min chu amite lah a sapsetna hiding ahitai.
en: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.
text:
NUM 5:27
Thadou: Hiche numeinu chu a jipa angsung a kitah joulouva ana kisuboh khah tahleh, hiche sapsetna po tui chun numeinu chu khajenjun a atholelsah ding ahi. athong hung poh ding chule anaobu jong panna bei hiding, chuteng chuleh amanu min chu amite lah a sapsetna hiding ahitai.
English: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.

tcz: Ahinlah amanu chu anathen jinga kisuhbuh khah lou ahileh, imacha tilou ding, naosen jong aneithei ding ahi.
en: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.
text:
NUM 5:28
Thadou: Ahinlah amanu chu anathen jinga kisuhbuh khah lou ahileh, imacha tilou ding, naosen jong aneithei ding ahi.
English: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.

tcz: “Hiche hi ginmona thu suhlhepna dinga chonna dan ahi. Numei chu ajipa thuneina noiya aum sung a akisuhboh khah a ana chon chatvei khah tah a,
en: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,
text:
NUM 5:29
Thadou: “Hiche hi ginmona thu suhlhepna dinga chonna dan ahi. Numei chu ajipa thuneina noiya aum sung a akisuhboh khah a ana chon chatvei khah tah a,
English: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,

tcz: ahilouleh Pasal khat chun ajinu chu kitahjoulou ding a ahin ginmo khah tahleh, ajipa chun ajinu chu Pakai angsung a apui ding, chuteng Thempu chun hiche chonna dan jouse hi abol ding ahi.
en: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.
text:
NUM 5:30
Thadou: ahilouleh Pasal khat chun ajinu chu kitahjoulou ding a ahin ginmo khah tahleh, ajipa chun ajinu chu Pakai angsung a apui ding, chuteng Thempu chun hiche chonna dan jouse hi abol ding ahi.
English: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.

tcz: Hiche thua vang ajipa themmona itobang hijong leh ongthol ding, ajinu vang achonsetna dungjuiya themmo chang ding ahi.”
en: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”
text:
NUM 5:31
Thadou: Hiche thua vang ajipa themmona itobang hijong leh ongthol ding, ajinu vang achonsetna dungjuiya themmo chang ding ahi.”
English: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin aseyin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 6:1
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin aseyin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: “Israel mite chu hiche hilchahna hohi pen. Mipiho lah a koi hijong leh, numei hihen pasal hijong leh atumbeh a Nazirte kitepna a kitem aum a, Pakaiya dia atumbeh a ama leh ama kipedoh aum leh,
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD,
text:
NUM 6:2
Thadou: “Israel mite chu hiche hilchahna hohi pen. Mipiho lah a koi hijong leh, numei hihen pasal hijong leh atumbeh a Nazirte kitepna a kitem aum a, Pakaiya dia atumbeh a ama leh ama kipedoh aum leh,
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD,

tcz: Amaho chun khamnathei juho leh lengpithei tuiho don angah ding u ahi. Hitobang miho chun lengpi theitui ahilouleh adangdang khamnathei a kisem juthuh kilhahna ho chu aman lou ding u ahi. Lengpiga apat a tuikilhithah jeng jong adonlou ding, Lengpi theiga ahin Lengpi theiga gopsaho jeng jong aneh uva adonlou ding u ahi.
en: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.
text:
NUM 6:3
Thadou: Amaho chun khamnathei juho leh lengpithei tuiho don angah ding u ahi. Hitobang miho chun lengpi theitui ahilouleh adangdang khamnathei a kisem juthuh kilhahna ho chu aman lou ding u ahi. Lengpiga apat a tuikilhithah jeng jong adonlou ding, Lengpi theiga ahin Lengpi theiga gopsaho jeng jong aneh uva adonlou ding u ahi.
English: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.

tcz: Amaho chu Nazirte kitepna kol sung a aum laise uva, lengpigui a kon a kisemdoh ho chu aneh diu le adondiu phal ahipoi - Lengpi thei ahoh le amu jeng jong aneh lou ding u ahi.
en: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.
text:
NUM 6:4
Thadou: Amaho chu Nazirte kitepna kol sung a aum laise uva, lengpigui a kon a kisemdoh ho chu aneh diu le adondiu phal ahipoi - Lengpi thei ahoh le amu jeng jong aneh lou ding u ahi.
English: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.

tcz: “Nazirte tia kitepna kol sunga aum sung sese uva chu asam u jong ache louhel diu ahi. Akitepnau suhbulhit a aum phatsungse a chu asam u akihoisao ding u ahi.
en: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to the LORD. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
text:
NUM 6:5
Thadou: “Nazirte tia kitepna kol sunga aum sung sese uva chu asam u jong ache louhel diu ahi. Akitepnau suhbulhit a aum phatsungse a chu asam u akihoisao ding u ahi.
English: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to the LORD. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

tcz: Chule hiche kitepna kol sung a aum sung sese uva hi thilong umna'a vel lah a che lou ding ahiuve.
en: “‘All the days that he separates himself to the LORD he shall not go near a dead body.
text:
NUM 6:6
Thadou: Chule hiche kitepna kol sung a aum sung sese uva hi thilong umna'a vel lah a che lou ding ahiuve.
English: “‘All the days that he separates himself to the LORD he shall not go near a dead body.

tcz: Hiche mithi long chu apen na mong mong pa hihen, anu hihen, sopipa ahilouleh asopinu hijongle amaho chu kisuboh lou ding ahiuve, ajehchu alu uva asam uchu Pathen a dinga kitum lhandoh ahinau lim a um ahi.
en: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.
text:
NUM 6:7
Thadou: Hiche mithi long chu apen na mong mong pa hihen, anu hihen, sopipa ahilouleh asopinu hijongle amaho chu kisuboh lou ding ahiuve, ajehchu alu uva asam uchu Pathen a dinga kitum lhandoh ahinau lim a um ahi.
English: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.

tcz: Pakai kintheng natong dinga lhenchom a aum chan uva hiche kigahna ho hi ajui jing diu ahi.
en: All the days of his separation he is holy to the LORD.
text:
NUM 6:8
Thadou: Pakai kintheng natong dinga lhenchom a aum chan uva hiche kigahna ho hi ajui jing diu ahi.
English: All the days of his separation he is holy to the LORD.

tcz: Itiham khat a ama angsung a mikhat chu alhuh a athi jeng tah a ahileh asam kithenso chu kisuhboh ahi tai. Nikho sagi kho ngai dingu, asam u akivotol ding u ahi. Chuteng amaho chu akisuhbohna uva kon a atheng a umkit a ahitauve.
en: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.
text:
NUM 6:9
Thadou: Itiham khat a ama angsung a mikhat chu alhuh a athi jeng tah a ahileh asam kithenso chu kisuhboh ahi tai. Nikho sagi kho ngai dingu, asam u akivotol ding u ahi. Chuteng amaho chu akisuhbohna uva kon a atheng a umkit a ahitauve.
English: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.

tcz: Ni get lhinni teng vakho kopkhat ahi louleh in vapal nou ni houbuh maicham lutna dontah a thempu kom a ahin choi ding u ahi.
en: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
NUM 6:10
Thadou: Ni get lhinni teng vakho kopkhat ahi louleh in vapal nou ni houbuh maicham lutna dontah a thempu kom a ahin choi ding u ahi.
English: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Thempu chun vachateni lah a khat chu chonset kilhaina a akatdoh ding, khatpen chu pumgo maichamma a dia akatdoh ding ahi. Hitia dol a chu thempupan mithi tahsa suhkhah jeh a themmo channa chu asuhtheng ding ahitai. Amahon akitep nau chu aphudet kit uva, asam u chu aki hoisao kitdiu ahitai.
en: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.
text:
NUM 6:11
Thadou: Thempu chun vachateni lah a khat chu chonset kilhaina a akatdoh ding, khatpen chu pumgo maichamma a dia akatdoh ding ahi. Hitia dol a chu thempupan mithi tahsa suhkhah jeh a themmo channa chu asuhtheng ding ahitai. Amahon akitep nau chu aphudet kit uva, asam u chu aki hoisao kitdiu ahitai.
English: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.

tcz: Amaho aboh a aum masang uva kitepna nikho ajo cheng uchu kisimlou a ahitai. Amaho chu athahbeh a Pakai angsung a Nazir ahinau chu alhumkei a ding a kilhandohkitna ding u chuleh amacheh in themmo kilhaina thilto ding a kumkhat lhingsa kelngoi achal khat ahin kai ding ahi.
en: He shall separate to the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.
text:
NUM 6:12
Thadou: Amaho aboh a aum masang uva kitepna nikho ajo cheng uchu kisimlou a ahitai. Amaho chu athahbeh a Pakai angsung a Nazir ahinau chu alhumkei a ding a kilhandohkitna ding u chuleh amacheh in themmo kilhaina thilto ding a kumkhat lhingsa kelngoi achal khat ahin kai ding ahi.
English: He shall separate to the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.

tcz: “Hiche hi Nazirte chonna dan chu ahi. Nazir a dia akilhekhen nau phat nunung lam teng, houbuh kotphung a chu che diu
en: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting,
text:
NUM 6:13
Thadou: “Hiche hi Nazirte chonna dan chu ahi. Nazir a dia akilhekhen nau phat nunung lam teng, houbuh kotphung a chu che diu
English: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting,

tcz: chule Pakai ang a thilto hou alhantheng diu ahi. Hichu kumkhat lhingsa nolnabeihel kelngoichal khat pumgo thilto ading, kumkhat lhingsa nolnabeihel kelngoi anu khat chonset kilhaina ding chuleh nolnabei kelngoi achal lhingset khat hichu chamna maicham ding,
en: and he shall offer his offering to the LORD: one male lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering, one ewe lamb a year old without defect for a sin offering, one ram without defect for peace offerings,
text:
NUM 6:14
Thadou: chule Pakai ang a thilto hou alhantheng diu ahi. Hichu kumkhat lhingsa nolnabeihel kelngoichal khat pumgo thilto ading, kumkhat lhingsa nolnabeihel kelngoi anu khat chonset kilhaina ding chuleh nolnabei kelngoi achal lhingset khat hichu chamna maicham ding,

en: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil with their meal offering and their drink offerings.

English: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil with their meal offering and their drink offerings.

en: The priest shall present them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.
text:
NUM 6:16

English: The priest shall present them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.

en: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering and its drink offering.
text:
NUM 6:17
Thadou: aban'a chamna maicham ding a kelngoichal lhinsel chu ahin, chuleh Cholsolou changlhah pocha khat ahi. Pehding a umsa lhosoh thilto leh atwi a kilhaina thiltoho ho hjong chu Thempu in Pakai kom a pehdohna anei ding ahi.
English: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering and its drink offering.

tcz: “Chuteng Nazirte hochun Houbuh lutna kotphung achu asam u akivolhah diu ahi. Chamna maicham kilhaina noi a meilah a chu anakikat dohsa asam u chu akoilut diu ahi.
en: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.
text:
NUM 6:18
Thadou: “Chuteng Nazirte hochun Houbuh lutna kotphung achu asam u akivolhah diu ahi. Chamna maicham kilhaina noi a meilah a chu anakikat dohsa asam u chu akoilut diu ahi.
English: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.

tcz: Nazir hon asam u akivotol jouteng uleh, thempun amaho cheh ding a akihulmin sa kelngoi chal dah chu alah ding, Pocha sung a um cholsolou changlhah leh changlhah neocha cha a paset a kisem chu alah ding ahi. Hicheng se chu aman Nazirpa khut teni a akoi ding ahi.
en: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved the head of his separation;

tcz: Thempun hicheho chu adopsang a kilhanna thilpeh tumbeh Pakai anga a abol ding ahi. Thempupa dinga atheng hung kitoh dohho chu ahileh, atumbeh a hung kitoh a-omlhang leh thengtah a Pakai anga a kitohdoh leh kidomsang a-mal jaona cheng chu hiding ahi. Hiche kintheng hi ahung kichai teng Nazirpa chun lengpi tui adonthei ding ahitai.
en: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD. They are holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.

tcz: Hiche hi, kilhaina hicheng Pathen kom hinlhut ding a kitepna nei Nazirte chonna dan chu ahi. Hiche chungchon a kilhaina apehjou chan uva jong apeh thei u ahi. Chuleh amaho chu Nazir tia lhendoh chom a aumteng uleh khopho tah a hitia akitepna jouseu chu abol ding u ahi.
en: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows and of his offering to the LORD for his separation, in addition to that which he is able to afford. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.’”

en: and they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox. They presented them before the tabernacle.

tcz: Ahinlah Houbuh a kimang cha thil theng hochu alengkou uva apoh ding u ahijeh chun Kohatte vangchu kangtalaiho le Bongchalho imacha apepon ahi.

tcz: Israel a phung lamkai hon maichamphung thao ana kinu a kilhandohna maicham dia ahintodoh hou chu: Sumeng lheng kong len som le ni, Sumeng kisilna kong som le ni, Gimnamtui kikholna Sana lhengkongho ahiuve.
en: This was the dedication offering of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;

tcz: Houintheng a shekel kitena a ilep leh Sumeng lhengkong len khat gihdan chu 3-1/4 pounds ahin chuleh Sumeng kisilna kong khat gihdan chu 1-3/4 pounds ahi. Sumeng mong mong agihdan chu 60 pounds ahi.
en: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

tcz: Houintheng a shekel kitena a ilep leh Sana lhengkong somleni khat cheh gimnamtui jaona a agihdan chu 4 ounces ahin. Sana mong mong agom a agihdan chu 3 pounds ahi.
en: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;

tcz: Bongchal anou somleni, kelngoi achal lhingset somleni, kum khat lhing cheh kelngoi achal som le ni pumgo thilto a ding in ahung kitoh in, todoh ding a umsa lhosoh maicham jong ahi. Chonset kilheina maicham ding in kelcha achal som le ni ahung kikailut in ahi.
en: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;

tcz: Chamna maicham ding in Bongchal somni le li, kelngoi achal lhingset somgup, kelchal somgup, kumkhat lhingsa kelngoi chal somgup ahung kitohdoh in ahi. Hicheng hi maicham phung thao akinu jouva maicham phung a dia kikatdohna maicham dia hung kitohho ahi.
en: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering of the altar, after it was anointed.
text:

English: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering of the altar, after it was anointed.

tcz: Mose chu Pakai toh kihou ding a Houbuh sunga alutji teng, aman houpina awgin thingkhong akhu (Themmona akon a themchanna mun - Kitepna thingkhong chung a kinga) chung a Cherubim teni lailung a kon chun aja jin ahi. Hiche lai mun a kon a chu Pakai in amachu ahin houpi ji ahiye.
en: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.
text:
NUM 7:89
Thadou: Mose chu Pakai toh kihou ding a Houbuh sunga alutji teng, aman houpina awgin thingkhong akhu (Themmona akon a themchanna mun - Kitepna thingkhong chung a kinga) chung a Cherubim teni lailung a kon chun aja jin ahi. Hiche lai mun a kon a chu Pakai in amachu ahin houpi ji ahiye.
English: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 8:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: “Aaron in hiche hilchahna ho hi pe in: Thaomei khom sagi chu atunna a natundoh teng le, amalam ma thaomei khom mailah chu a salvah jou nading nading in tundoh in.”
en: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”
text:
NUM 8:2
Thadou: “Aaron in hiche hilchahna ho hi pe in: Thaomei khom sagi chu atunna a natundoh teng le, amalam ma thaomei khom mailah chu a salvah jou nading nading in tundoh in.”
English: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”

tcz: Aron in chutichun aboltan ahi. Thaomei khom Sagiho chun amailam salvahna din Pakaiyin Mose henga asei bang bang chun atungdohtan ahi.
en: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
NUM 8:3
Thadou: Aron in chutichun aboltan ahi. Thaomei khom Sagiho chun amailam salvahna din Pakaiyin Mose henga asei bang bang chun atungdohtan ahi.
English: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Hiche thaomei khom aboncha a, akhombul apat ajem kisemna changei chu sana kikhen a kisemdoh ahi. Hiche hi Pathen in Mose alim umding dol avetsah bangtah a kisem a ahi.
en: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work. He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which the LORD had shown Moses.
text:
NUM 8:4
Thadou: Hiche thaomei khom aboncha a, akhombul apat ajem kisemna changei chu sana kikhen a kisemdoh ahi. Hiche hi Pathen in Mose alim umding dol avetsah bangtah a kisem a ahi.
English: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work. He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which the LORD had shown Moses.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga ahisei in,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 8:5
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga ahisei in,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: “Tun Israel mipi adangho jouse a kon in Levite tumkhen inlang, chonna dan ngai bang in sutheng sohkei in.
en: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
text:
NUM 8:6
Thadou: “Tun Israel mipi adangho jouse a kon in Levite tumkhen inlang, chonna dan ngai bang in sutheng sohkei in.
English: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

tcz: Kisuhtheng na tui chu nathinkhum ding, amaho apumpiuva atahsa uva amul jouseu kivoumui diu chule amanchah jing apon hou akisoptheng diu ahi. Hitia chu abolteng uleh chonna dol a atheng a ahitauve.
en: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.
text:
NUM 8:7
Thadou: Kisuhtheng na tui chu nathinkhum ding, amaho apumpiuva atahsa uva amul jouseu kivoumui diu chule amanchah jing apon hou akisoptheng diu ahi. Hitia chu abolteng uleh chonna dol a atheng a ahitauve.
English: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

tcz: Bongchal gol khat leh lhosohga maicham a kon a changbong Olive thao a kisunum chip chep, chule Bongchal golkhat mama toh chonset kilheina maicham a ding a ahin to dingu ahi.
en: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.
text:
NUM 8:8
Thadou: Bongchal gol khat leh lhosohga maicham a kon a changbong Olive thao a kisunum chip chep, chule Bongchal golkhat mama toh chonset kilheina maicham a ding a ahin to dingu ahi.
English: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.

tcz: Chuteng Israel nam mite jouse chu nakhopkhom a Houbuh kotphung a umdia Levite chu na peh doh ding ahi.
en: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
text:
NUM 8:9
Thadou: Chuteng Israel nam mite jouse chu nakhopkhom a Houbuh kotphung a umdia Levite chu na peh doh ding ahi.
English: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.

tcz: Pathen na dinga Levite chu napeh doh teng le, Israel miten amaho chunga chu akhut u angap diu ahi.
en: You shall present the Levites before the LORD. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,
text:
NUM 8:10
Thadou: Pathen na dinga Levite chu napeh doh teng le, Israel miten amaho chunga chu akhut u angap diu ahi.
English: You shall present the Levites before the LORD. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,

tcz: Aaron in akhut teni adopsanga Israel mipite lah a kon a Levite chu Pathen a dinga atumbeh a katohna aneiding, hitiachu Pathen lhacha natong ding a lhandohna anei ding ahi.
en: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of the LORD.
text:
NUM 8:11
Thadou: Aaron in akhut teni adopsanga Israel mipite lah a kon a Levite chu Pathen a dinga atumbeh a katohna aneiding, hitiachu Pathen lhacha natong ding a lhandohna anei ding ahi.
English: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of the LORD.

tcz: Hiche jouteng chule Levite jousen Bongnou achalni chung nga khut ngapna anei diu, Bongchalnou khat chu chule chonset maicham kisem chu pumgo maicham kisem na ding ahin, Pathen henga Levite chun ki suhtheng na anei diu cham dela umdiu ahiye.
en: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.
text:
NUM 8:12
Thadou: Hiche jouteng chule Levite jousen Bongnou achalni chung nga khut ngapna anei diu, Bongchalnou khat chu chule chonset maicham kisem chu pumgo maicham kisem na ding ahin, Pathen henga Levite chun ki suhtheng na anei diu cham dela umdiu ahiye.
English: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.

tcz: Aaron le achaten Levite chu Amaho ma sanga adin sah uva, akhot u adop sang jou teng uleh Pathen masanga loupi tah’a maicham a sempeh diu ahi.
en: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to the LORD.
text:
NUM 8:13
Thadou: Aaron le achaten Levite chu Amaho ma sanga adin sah uva, akhot u adop sang jou teng uleh Pathen masanga loupi tah’a maicham a sempeh diu ahi.
English: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to the LORD.

tcz: Levite chu Israel mipi telah akonna natum khandoh diu, ajeh chu amaho keija umjing diu ahi.
en: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
text:
NUM 8:14
Thadou: Levite chu Israel mipi telah akonna natum khandoh diu, ajeh chu amaho keija umjing diu ahi.
English: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

tcz: Hi chengse kichai teng, Houbuh sunga chu lut diu ana toh diu ijakai ajom thei diu ahi tai. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin amaho chu asuh thenga na pehdoh ahi tan nangma heng nga loupi tah ana peh doh ahi tai.
en: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.
text:
NUM 8:15
Thadou: Hi chengse kichai teng, Houbuh sunga chu lut diu ana toh diu ijakai ajom thei diu ahi tai. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin amaho chu asuh thenga na pehdoh ahi tan nangma heng nga loupi tah ana peh doh ahi tai.
English: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.

tcz: Israel mipite ding in Levite hi keima dinga kikoisa ahin Israelte chi lhah’a pang masa pen ho chu keima kona phondoh le lhen doh tum ahi tai. Levite chu numei chilhah apat kilah doh ahiye.
en: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.
text:
NUM 8:16
Thadou: Israel mipite ding in Levite hi keima dinga kikoisa ahin Israelte chi lhah’a pang masa pen ho chu keima kona phondoh le lhen doh tum ahi tai. Levite chu numei chilhah apat kilah doh ahiye.
English: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.

tcz: Israel mipite lah’a peng masapen mihem pasal ahin gancha hi jong leh keima ahi soh keiyin, Egypt mite pasal chapa masapen jouse kana suhmang nia pat chun keima dinga kana gontup sa ahi tai.
en: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.
text:
NUM 8:17
Thadou: Israel mipite lah’a peng masapen mihem pasal ahin gancha hi jong leh keima ahi soh keiyin, Egypt mite pasal chapa masapen jouse kana suhmang nia pat chun keima dinga kana gontup sa ahi tai.
English: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.

tcz: Levite phung hi keiman Israelte lah’a chapa peng masa penna ka koi ahi tai.
en: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
text:
NUM 8:18
Thadou: Levite phung hi keiman Israelte lah’a chapa peng masa penna ka koi ahi tai.
English: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

tcz: Aaron le achate ho hi Levite vetup ding nga ki sem ahi tai. Israelte tha khel lah maicham Houbuh a kin theng na tong ding ahiuvin, pumgo maichamma kisuh thengna kin thenga a na tong le ding mong mong ahiuve.
en: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”
text:
NUM 8:19
Thadou: Aaron le achate ho hi Levite vetup ding nga ki sem ahi tai. Israelte tha khel lah maicham Houbuh a kin theng na tong ding ahiuvin, pumgo maichamma kisuh thengna kin thenga a na tong le ding mong mong ahiuve.
English: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”

tcz: Mose Aaron chule Israel mipi jousen Levite chu alheng doh un Pathen in amaho thu apeh dung juiyin abol tauvin ahi.
en: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.
text:
NUM 8:20
Thadou: Mose Aaron chule Israel mipi jousen Levite chu alheng doh un Pathen in amaho thu apeh dung juiyin abol tauvin ahi.
English: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.

tcz: Leviten achonset na’u chu aki soptheng uvin chule aponsil ho jong aki noilhah un. Pathen masang nga loupi tah in maicham asem peh tai. Aaron in amaho chu maicham athengsel na ding uvin abolpeh in ajeh chu Pathen toh chamdela aum na diu ahiye.
en: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before the LORD and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
text:
NUM 8:21
Thadou: Leviten achonset na’u chu aki soptheng uvin chule aponsil ho jong aki noilhah un. Pathen masang nga loupi tah in maicham asem peh tai. Aaron in amaho chu maicham athengsel na ding uvin abolpeh in ajeh chu Pathen toh chamdela aum na diu ahiye.
English: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before the LORD and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

tcz: Chu teng Levite chu Houbuh maicham’a sunglha diu kintheng na toh apat diu, Aaron le achaten aki thopi diu ahiye. Amaho thu nit ding aki pat jouse Pathen in Levite jui dinga Mose ahin hetsah ho chun anit soh keiyun ahi.
en: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
text:
NUM 8:22
Thadou: Chu teng Levite chu Houbuh maicham’a sunglha diu kintheng na toh apat diu, Aaron le achaten aki thopi diu ahiye. Amaho thu nit ding aki pat jouse Pathen in Levite jui dinga Mose ahin hetsah ho chun anit soh keiyun ahi.
English: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

tcz: Chu in PakaiyinMose hengah hiti hin aseiyin ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 8:23
Thadou: Chu in PakaiyinMose hengah hiti hin aseiyin ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Hiche dan hi Leviten anit’u ngaijin, Houbuh sunga chu kintheng na toh apat na diuva chu kum-somni le nga beh alhin’u ngaiding ahiye.
en: “This is what is assigned to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;

tcz: Chule Levite chu kum-somnga alhin teng ule kichol thei ding ahitauve.
en: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more,
text:
NUM 8:25
Thadou: Chule Levite chu kum-somnga alhin teng ule kichol thei ding ahitauve.
English: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more,

tcz: Levite chu akichol joulam teng ule asopiu aloi agol hon Houbuh kimvella ajenle a jong pangthei nalaiju ahi. Ahin lah akintheng na tong vang pang thai ta lou ding ahi. Hi chengse hi Levite kin theng natoh na muna aman chah diu dan ahiye.
en: but shall assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. This is how you shall have the Levites do their duties.”
text:
NUM 8:26
Thadou: Levite chu akichol joulam teng ule asopiu aloi agol hon Houbuh kimvella ajenle a jong pangthei nalaiju ahi. Ahin lah akintheng na tong vang pang thai ta lou ding ahi. Hi chengse hi Levite kin theng natoh na muna aman chah diu dan ahiye.
English: but shall assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. This is how you shall have the Levites do their duties.”

tcz: Israelte chu Egypt a patna ahung kichon doh jou kum khat ahung lhing chun Sinai lhang a gamthip lah a chun Pakaiyin Mose kom a ahin seiyin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
text:
NUM 9:1
Thadou: Israelte chu Egypt a patna ahung kichon doh jou kum khat ahung lhing chun Sinai lhang a gamthip lah a chun Pakaiyin Mose kom a ahin seiyin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

tcz: Kalchuh kut kiman na ding phat kitepna a hi aman ding uvin Israel mite chu seipeh tan ,
en: “Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.
text:
NUM 9:2
Thadou: Kalchuh kut kiman na ding phat kitepna a hi aman ding uvin Israel mite chu seipeh tan ,
English: “Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.

tcz: hichu lha masa pen nisom le nili lhina a khojin chip chep phat hiding ahi. Hiche kipathanop kibol ding dan thupeh ho leh dan umho phate a najui sah ding ahi.
en: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances.”
text:
NUM 9:3
Thadou: hichu lha masa pen nisom le nili lhina a khojin chip chep phat hiding ahi. Hiche kipathanop kibol ding dan thupeh ho leh dan umho phate a najui sah ding ahi.
English: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances.”

tcz: Mosen jong mipi henga kalchuh kut kipa golnop abol ding uvin aseipeh tan ahi,
en: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover.
text:
NUM 9:4
Thadou: Mosen jong mipi henga kalchuh kut kipa golnop abol ding uvin aseipeh tan ahi,
English: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover.

tcz: ajeh chu Sinai lhang gamthip lah a nisomle nili ahung lhin a khovah chip chep in ahinphah den un ahitai. Pathen in Mose thu apeh bang bang chun amahon jong kipagolnop chu aboltauvin ahi.
en: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.
text:
NUM 9:5
Thadou: ajeh chu Sinai lhang gamthip lah a nisomle nili ahung lhin a khovah chip chep in ahinphah den un ahitai. Pathen in Mose thu apeh bang bang chun amahon jong kipagolnop chu aboltauvin ahi.
English: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.

tcz: Ahinlah ama ho lah a mi phabep chun mithi long ana thamkhah jeh un, chonna ngai bang in akisuboh a ahitauvin, hiche nikho a Kalchuh kut kipa golnop a chun alha thei tapouve. Hiche nikho chun Mose leh Aaron kom a ahung un
en: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.
text:
NUM 9:6
Thadou: Ahinlah ama ho lah a mi phabep chun mithi long ana thamkhah jeh un, chonna ngai bang in akisuboh a ahitauvin, hiche nikho a Kalchuh kut kipa golnop a chun alha thei tapouve. Hiche nikho chun Mose leh Aaron kom a ahung un
English: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.

tcz: “keihon mithi long ka tham khah tah jeh un, chonna ngai banga atheng louva ka hi tauve. Hijong leh Israel mipin asem leng a keihon jong Pathen ang a maicham kasem mo diu ham?” ahungtiuvin ahi.
en: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”
text:
NUM 9:7
Thadou: “keihon mithi long ka tham khah tah jeh un, chonna ngai banga atheng louva ka hi tauve. Hijong leh Israel mipin asem leng a keihon jong Pathen ang a maicham kasem mo diu ham?” ahungtiuvin ahi.
English: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”

tcz: Mose chun a donbut, “Nangho ding a Pathen a kon a hilchahna kamu kah khongai un” ati.
en: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what the LORD will command concerning you.”
text:
NUM 9:8
Thadou: Mose chun a donbut, “Nangho ding a Pathen a kon a hilchahna kamu kah khongai un” ati.
English: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what the LORD will command concerning you.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose ahin donbutna chu hiche hi ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 9:9
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose ahin donbutna chu hiche hi ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: “Hiche hilchahna ho hi Israel mipite seipeh in: Tukhang hihen lang khang hunglhung ding ho hijongleh chonna ngai bang a akisuhboh kha hihen, kholgam a chedoh ho hijongleh Kalchuh kut kipa golnop a pangthei ding u ahi.
en: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to the LORD.
text:
NUM 9:10
Thadou: “Hiche hilchahna ho hi Israel mipite seipeh in: Tukhang hihen lang khang hunglhung ding ho hijongleh chonna ngai bang a akisuhboh kha hihen, kholgam a chedoh ho hijongleh Kalchuh kut kipa golnop a pangthei ding u ahi.
English: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to the LORD.

tcz: Kalchuhkut kipa golnop kichai lhakhat lhin teng kalchuh kut maicham thilto abol ding u ahi, hichu lhani lhinna a nisom le nili lhinna khojin chip chep phat hiding ahi. Hicheteng chuleh Kalchuh kut kelngoi sa chu anche kha le cholsolou changlhah toh aneh tha dingu ahi.
en: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
text:
NUM 9:11
Thadou: Kalchuhkut kipa golnop kichai lhakhat lhin teng kalchuh kut maicham thilto abol ding u ahi, hichu lhani lhinna a nisom le nili lhinna khojin chip chep phat hiding ahi. Hicheteng chuleh Kalchuh kut kelngoi sa chu anche kha le cholsolou changlhah toh aneh tha dingu ahi.
English: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

tcz: Amahon kelngoi chu jingkah khovah geija akoi thei lou ding u, chuleh hiche agu jong asuh boh thei lou dingu ahiye. Kalchuh kut kiman na chungchang a dan umho hi ajui cheh ding u ahi.
en: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.
text:
NUM 9:12
Thadou: Amahon kelngoi chu jingkah khovah geija akoi thei lou ding u, chuleh hiche agu jong asuh boh thei lou dingu ahiye. Kalchuh kut kiman na chungchang a dan umho hi ajui cheh ding u ahi.
English: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.

tcz: “Ahin Israelmi hiya chon na ngai a aboh jong hilou, kholche a jin doh jong hilou, ahivang a Kalchuh kut nahsah lou miho chu Israel nampi akonna kah lhah’a umding ahi. Pathen maicham jong aphat tah ahin todoh lou leh achonsetna jal a themmo chang a um ding ahiuve.
en: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
text:
NUM 9:13
Thadou: “Ahin Israelmi hiya chon na ngai a aboh jong hilou, kholche a jin doh jong hilou, ahivang a Kalchuh kut nahsah lou miho chu Israel nampi akonna kah lhah’a umding ahi. Pathen maicham jong aphat tah ahin todoh lou leh achonsetna jal a themmo chang a um ding ahiuve.
English: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

tcz: Nangho lah a nam dangmi Kalchuh kut golnop a jaonom aumleh, nit ding leh jui ding a kipe jouse hi anit ngaiyin, hiche dan hin Israel nam chilhah a kon hihenlang, gamdang chilhah a kon a koi hijongle akan soh kei ding ahi.
en: “‘If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to the LORD, then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner and for him who is born in the land.’”
text:
NUM 9:14
Thadou: Nangho lah a nam dangmi Kalchuh kut golnop a jaonom aumleh, nit ding leh jui ding a kipe jouse hi anit ngaiyin, hiche dan hin Israel nam chilhah a kon hihenlang, gamdang chilhah a kon a koi hijongle akan soh kei ding ahi.
English: “‘If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to the LORD, then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner and for him who is born in the land.’”

tcz: Houbuh ahin phudoh nikho uchun, meilom in Houbuh chu atom tan ahi. Houbuh chung nga meilom nilhah apat jingkah geiya umchu meikong lomtoh abang jeng in ahi.
en: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.
text:
NUM 9:15
Thadou: Houbuh ahin phudoh nikho uchun, meilom in Houbuh chu atom tan ahi. Houbuh chung nga meilom nilhah apat jingkah geiya umchu meikong lomtoh abang jeng in ahi.
English: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.

tcz: Hiche meilom houbuh chung a um, jan tengle meikong alom a hung kilah ji tobang chun aum jing tan ahi.
en: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.
text:
NUM 9:16
Thadou: Hiche meilom houbuh chung a um, jan tengle meikong alom a hung kilah ji tobang chun aum jing tan ahi.
English: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.

tcz: Houbuh chunga meilom chu akihohdal ji teng, Israel mipiten hiche amaicham ponbuh chu aphet lhah jiuvin meibol lom chu ajui ji uvin ahi. Chuleh hiche meilom akingah ngah na a chun Israel mipi ten ngahmun akisemkit jiuvin ahi.
en: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.
text:
NUM 9:17
Thadou: Houbuh chunga meilom chu akihohdal ji teng, Israel mipiten hiche amaicham ponbuh chu aphet lhah jiuvin meibol lom chu ajui ji uvin ahi. Chuleh hiche meilom akingah ngah na a chun Israel mipi ten ngahmun akisemkit jiuvin ahi.
English: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.

tcz: Hitichun che ding a Pathen thupeh amu dung juiyin lam ajot un, ngahmun asa jiuvin ahi. chuleh houbuh chung a meilom aum chan chun ngahmun dalhalouvin aum jiuvin ahi.
en: At the commandment of the LORD, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of the LORD they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.
text:
NUM 9:18
Thadou: Hitichun che ding a Pathen thupeh amu dung juiyin lam ajot un, ngahmun asa jiuvin ahi. chuleh houbuh chung a meilom aum chan chun ngahmun dalhalouvin aum jiuvin ahi.
English: At the commandment of the LORD, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of the LORD they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.

tcz: Hiche meilom chu Houbuh chung nga nisot tah aum ji teng Israel techu akichol jiuvin Pathen Houna dinga atoh ding umho chu atong jiuvin ahi.
en: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the LORD’s command, and didn’t travel.
text:
NUM 9:19
Thadou: Hiche meilom chu Houbuh chung nga nisot tah aum ji teng Israel techu akichol jiuvin Pathen Houna dinga atoh ding umho chu atong jiuvin ahi.
English: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the LORD’s command, and didn’t travel.

tcz: Phatkhat khat teng Pathen thupeh dungjui in meilom chu Houbuh chung nga ni chom chacha bou akingaji in, amaho jong ni chomcha bou akichol jiuve. Chuteng Pathen thupeh dung in ngahmun chu aphet lha uvin ache jomkit jitauvin ahi.
