en: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of the LORD they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of the LORD they traveled.
text:
NUM 9:20
Thadou: Phatkhat khat teng Pathen thupeh dungjui in meilom chu Houbuh chung nga ni chom chacha bou akingaji in, amaho jong ni chomcha bou akichol jiuve. Chuteng Pathen thupeh dung in ngahmun chu aphet lha uvin ache jomkit jitauvin ahi.
English: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of the LORD they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of the LORD they traveled.

tcz: Phat chomkhat kit teng Meilom chu jankhovah in aum in Jingkah teng akichon doh jin ahi. Ahinlah sun hihen jan hita jong leh hiche meilom chu ahung ki hohdoh teng ngahmun chu aphetlha jiuvin ache jom jingji un ahi.
en: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.
text:
NUM 9:21
Thadou: Phat chomkhat kit teng Meilom chu jankhovah in aum in Jingkah teng akichon doh jin ahi. Ahinlah sun hihen jan hita jong leh hiche meilom chu ahung ki hohdoh teng ngahmun chu aphetlha jiuvin ache jom jingji un ahi.
English: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.

tcz: Houbuh maicham chunga meilom chu ni ni umhen, lhakhat umhen, ahilouleh kumkhat umjong leh, Israel mipite chu ngahmun na chun aki chol jing jiuvin apotdoh jipouvin ahi. Amavang Meilom chu Houbuh chunga ahung kihoh dal teng ngahmun chu aphet un achejom kit jitauvin ahi.
en: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.
text:
NUM 9:22
Thadou: Houbuh maicham chunga meilom chu ni ni umhen, lhakhat umhen, ahilouleh kumkhat umjong leh, Israel mipite chu ngahmun na chun aki chol jing jiuvin apotdoh jipouvin ahi. Amavang Meilom chu Houbuh chunga ahung kihoh dal teng ngahmun chu aphet un achejom kit jitauvin ahi.
English: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.

tcz: Hitichun Pakai thupeh bangtah in akichol un, akalsong jing un ahi, chule Pathen in Mose a kon a athupeh jouse chu abolkim soh jing un ahi.
en: At the commandment of the LORD they encamped, and at the commandment of the LORD they traveled. They kept the LORD’s command, at the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
text:
NUM 9:23
Thadou: Hitichun Pakai thupeh bangtah in akichol un, akalsong jing un ahi, chule Pathen in Mose a kon a athupeh jouse chu abolkim soh jing un ahi.
English: At the commandment of the LORD they encamped, and at the commandment of the LORD they traveled. They kept the LORD’s command, at the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin aseijin ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 10:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin aseijin ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Mipi ho koukhomna ding leh ponbuh phetlhahna ding a melchihna a manchah din dangka sehcha a kikhengjol pengkul ni sem doh in.
en: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.
text:
NUM 10:2
Thadou: Mipi ho koukhomna ding leh ponbuh phetlhahna ding a melchihna a manchah din dangka sehcha a kikhengjol pengkul ni sem doh in.
English: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.

tcz: Hiche Pengkul teni chu ahung kimut ji teng mipi ho chu Houbuh lutna kotphung a nangma masang nga hungkhom ji ding u ahi.
en: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
NUM 10:3
Thadou: Hiche Pengkul teni chu ahung kimut ji teng mipi ho chu Houbuh lutna kotphung a nangma masang nga hungkhom ji ding u ahi.
English: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Ahinlah pengkul khat bou chu ahung kimut tah vangleh Lamkai hobou - Israel phung lamkai jouse atahsa tah uva na masang a hung kilah cheh diu ahi.
en: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.
text:
NUM 10:4
Thadou: Ahinlah pengkul khat bou chu ahung kimut tah vangleh Lamkai hobou - Israel phung lamkai jouse atahsa tah uva na masang a hung kilah cheh diu ahi.
English: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.

tcz: Nangma in hiche gin a chu hetsahna nanei teng, Houbuh a kon solam a ngahmun nei phung ho chun angahmun u chu aphet lhah uva malam a chu che jom ding ahiuve.
en: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.
text:
NUM 10:5
Thadou: Nangma in hiche gin a chu hetsahna nanei teng, Houbuh a kon solam a ngahmun nei phung ho chun angahmun u chu aphet lhah uva malam a chu che jom ding ahiuve.
English: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.

tcz: Nangma in hiche gin a hetsahna anivei channa nanei teng lhanglam a ngahmun neihon ajui ding u ahi. Achejom jing ding u hetsahana a chu nangman agin chom naginsah ding ahi.
en: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
text:
NUM 10:6
Thadou: Nangma in hiche gin a hetsahna anivei channa nanei teng lhanglam a ngahmun neihon ajui ding u ahi. Achejom jing ding u hetsahana a chu nangman agin chom naginsah ding ahi.
English: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

tcz: Ahinlah mipi kikhom khom hen nati teng, pengkul chu awgin chomjep in mut in.
en: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
text:
NUM 10:7
Thadou: Ahinlah mipi kikhom khom hen nati teng, pengkul chu awgin chomjep in mut in.
English: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

tcz: Aaron chilhah, thempu ho bou chun pengkolho amut thei ding u ahiye. Hiche hi nanga ding a akhang akhang a aumden jing ding leh nitjing ding dan chu ahi.
en: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.
text:
NUM 10:8
Thadou: Aaron chilhah, thempu ho bou chun pengkolho amut thei ding u ahiye. Hiche hi nanga ding a akhang akhang a aumden jing ding leh nitjing ding dan chu ahi.
English: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.

tcz: “Nangma ho gamsung nga na hung lut uva, nangho doujing namelmateho sat ding a nakon doh ding teng uleh pengkulho kigottup nadia naginsah diu ahi. Hiche teng chu leh na Pakaiyin na hin geldoh ding, na melmate akonna nahuh doh ding ahi.
en: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before the LORD your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.
text:
NUM 10:9
Thadou: “Nangma ho gamsung nga na hung lut uva, nangho doujing namelmateho sat ding a nakon doh ding teng uleh pengkulho kigottup nadia naginsah diu ahi. Hiche teng chu leh na Pakaiyin na hin geldoh ding, na melmate akonna nahuh doh ding ahi.
English: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before the LORD your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.

tcz: Na pengkulho chu kipa thanop phat na jong na mut ging ding, kumsung a kipa golnop ho leh lha thah hung ki sim pan phat ho a jong namut ging ding ahi. Hiche pengkulho chu kipana maicham kisem phat hihen, pumgo maicham kibol sih hijongle hiche maichamho chung a chu namutging ding ahi. Hiche pengkulho gin chun na Pathen ana kitepna hin gel doh sah ding ahi. Keima na Pakai, Pathen chu ka hiye.”
en: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am the LORD your God.”
text:
NUM 10:10
Thadou: Na pengkulho chu kipa thanop phat na jong na mut ging ding, kumsung a kipa golnop ho leh lha thah hung ki sim pan phat ho a jong namut ging ding ahi. Hiche pengkulho chu kipana maicham kisem phat hihen, pumgo maicham kibol sih hijongle hiche maichamho chung a chu namutging ding ahi. Hiche pengkulho gin chun na Pathen ana kitepna hin gel doh sah ding ahi. Keima na Pakai, Pathen chu ka hiye.”
English: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am the LORD your God.”

tcz: Kumni jouva Israelte Egypt gam a konna ahung dohnau - alhani channa a ni somni alhinni chun - meilom chu kitepna ponbuh akon chun akikhang doh tan ahi.
en: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.
text:
NUM 10:11
Thadou: Kumni jouva Israelte Egypt gam a konna ahung dohnau - alhani channa a ni somni alhinni chun - meilom chu kitepna ponbuh akon chun akikhang doh tan ahi.
English: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.

tcz: Hijehchun Israel mipi chun Sinai gamthip lah a kon in ahungdoh un Paran gamthiplah aphah uva meilom akingah masang sen mun chom chom in ana kitol le le un ahi.
en: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.
text:
NUM 10:12
Thadou: Hijehchun Israel mipi chun Sinai gamthip lah a kon in ahungdoh un Paran gamthiplah aphah uva meilom akingah masang sen mun chom chom in ana kitol le le un ahi.
English: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

tcz: Mose in Pakaiya kon hilchahna amu bang tah a, Israel mipi ho amasapen a ding a ahung kitol pan un chun,
en: They first went forward according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
text:
NUM 10:13
Thadou: Mose in Pakaiya kon hilchahna amu bang tah a, Israel mipi ho amasapen a ding a ahung kitol pan un chun,
English: They first went forward according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

tcz: Judate aloiloi a um ho chun aponlap noi uva lam akai un ahi. Chuleh alamkai uva pang chu Aminadab chapa Nahshon ahi.
en: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.
text:
NUM 10:14
Thadou: Judate aloiloi a um ho chun aponlap noi uva lam akai un ahi. Chuleh alamkai uva pang chu Aminadab chapa Nahshon ahi.
English: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

tcz: Amaho banjom chu Issacharte ahiuvin, a hin Lamkai a chu Nathanel kitipa Zuar chapa ahi.
en: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.
text:
NUM 10:15
Thadou: Amaho banjom chu Issacharte ahiuvin, a hin Lamkai a chu Nathanel kitipa Zuar chapa ahi.
English: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.

tcz: Chule Zebulun chilhah hon ajom un, Helon chapa Eliab chu ahinlamkai in ahi.
en: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.
text:
NUM 10:16
Thadou: Chule Zebulun chilhah hon ajom un, Helon chapa Eliab chu ahinlamkai in ahi.
English: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

tcz: Hichun Houbuh chu aphet lha uvin Levite sung a kon a Gershon te le Merari te chun houbuh apo uvin abanjom in acheuvin ahi.
en: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.
text:
NUM 10:17
Thadou: Hichun Houbuh chu aphet lha uvin Levite sung a kon a Gershon te le Merari te chun houbuh apo uvin abanjom in acheuvin ahi.
English: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.

tcz: Reubente ho aloiloi a umho chun aponlap noi uva abanjom un, Sheduir chapa Elizer chun amaho ahin lamkai in ahi.
en: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.
text:
NUM 10:18
Thadou: Reubente ho aloiloi a umho chun aponlap noi uva abanjom un, Sheduir chapa Elizer chun amaho ahin lamkai in ahi.
English: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.

tcz: Aban achu Semeonte aloiloi a umhon ahinjuiyun, amaho Lamkai pachu Shelumiel, Zunishadai chapa ahi.
en: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.
text:
NUM 10:19
Thadou: Aban achu Semeonte aloiloi a umhon ahinjuiyun, amaho Lamkai pachu Shelumiel, Zunishadai chapa ahi.
English: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

tcz: Chule aloiloi a um Gadte ahiuvin, Elisab kitipa, Deuel chapan ahin lamkai in ahi.
en: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.
text:
NUM 10:20
Thadou: Chule aloiloi a um Gadte ahiuvin, Elisab kitipa, Deuel chapan ahin lamkai in ahi.
English: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

tcz: Hiche banjom chu Levite lah a kon a Kohathte ahiuvin houbuh sung a manchah atheng ho jouse ahin po un ahi. Ngahmun thah alhun masang un Houbuh chu Ngahmun thah a chun tun dohsan ana um jitan ahi.
en: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.
text:
NUM 10:21
Thadou: Hiche banjom chu Levite lah a kon a Kohathte ahiuvin houbuh sung a manchah atheng ho jouse ahin po un ahi. Ngahmun thah alhun masang un Houbuh chu Ngahmun thah a chun tun dohsan ana um jitan ahi.
English: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

tcz: Hiche banjomma chun Ephraimte chu aponlop noiuvah aloiloi in ahung kitol un ahi. Amaho Lamkai a hungpang a chu Amihud chapa Elishama ahi.
en: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.
text:
NUM 10:22
Thadou: Hiche banjomma chun Ephraimte chu aponlop noiuvah aloiloi in ahung kitol un ahi. Amaho Lamkai a hungpang a chu Amihud chapa Elishama ahi.
English: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.

tcz: Amaho chu Manasseh te aloiloi a umho chun ahinjui un, Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel kitipan ahin lamkai un ahi.
en: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.
text:
NUM 10:23
Thadou: Amaho chu Manasseh te aloiloi a umho chun ahinjui un, Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel kitipan ahin lamkai un ahi.
English: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

tcz: Chuleh Benjamin phung a kon aloiloi a umho ahiuvin, Abidan chapa Gideon in ahin lamkaiyin ahi.
en: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.
text:
NUM 10:24
Thadou: Chuleh Benjamin phung a kon aloiloi a umho ahiuvin, Abidan chapa Gideon in ahin lamkaiyin ahi.
English: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

tcz: Anunung pen chu Dan phung a aponlap noi a aloi loi a kitolho ahiuvin, amaho hi phungho jouse ngahmun vengtup a ahiuve. Amaho Lamkai pachu ahi leh Ahiezel, Ammishaddai chapa ahiye.
en: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.
text:
NUM 10:25
Thadou: Anunung pen chu Dan phung a aponlap noi a aloi loi a kitolho ahiuvin, amaho hi phungho jouse ngahmun vengtup a ahiuve. Amaho Lamkai pachu ahi leh Ahiezel, Ammishaddai chapa ahiye.
English: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.

tcz: Amaho Banjomma hung kitol ho chu ahileh Okran chapa Piegel lamkaina a Asherte aloiloi a umho ahiuve.
en: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.
text:
NUM 10:26
Thadou: Amaho Banjomma hung kitol ho chu ahileh Okran chapa Piegel lamkaina a Asherte aloiloi a umho ahiuve.
English: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.

tcz: Chuleh Enan chapa Ahira in ahin lamkai, Naphtali te aloiloi a umhon ahin jui un ahi.
en: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.
text:
NUM 10:27
Thadou: Chuleh Enan chapa Ahira in ahin lamkai, Naphtali te aloiloi a umhon ahin jui un ahi.
English: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

tcz: Hitia hi agol gol a Israel chilhahte, ama ama kihopkhen dol cheh a hung kitol jiu ahi uve.
en: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.
text:
NUM 10:28
Thadou: Hitia hi agol gol a Israel chilhahte, ama ama kihopkhen dol cheh a hung kitol jiu ahi uve.
English: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.

tcz: Nikhat chu Mose’n ajinu sopi pa, Median mipa Reuel chapa Hobab kom a aseiyin, “eiho hi Pakaiyin ei tep pehnao lam chu jot jing ihiuve, ajehchu Pakaiyin asei chu, 'ka pehding nahiuve'. Nangma keima holah hung tan, keihon nangma ngailut tah a kabol diu ahi, ajehchu Pakaiyin Israelte chu kidangtah phattheina ho bohding kitepna anei ahi' ati.
en: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which the LORD said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for the LORD has spoken good concerning Israel.”
text:
NUM 10:29
Thadou: Nikhat chu Mose’n ajinu sopi pa, Median mipa Reuel chapa Hobab kom a aseiyin, “eiho hi Pakaiyin ei tep pehnao lam chu jot jing ihiuve, ajehchu Pakaiyin asei chu, 'ka pehding nahiuve'. Nangma keima holah hung tan, keihon nangma ngailut tah a kabol diu ahi, ajehchu Pakaiyin Israelte chu kidangtah phattheina ho bohding kitepna anei ahi' ati.
English: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which the LORD said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for the LORD has spoken good concerning Israel.”

tcz: Hobab in adonbut in, 'Ahipoi, keima kache louding ahi. Keima ka gam le ka insung mite henga kile ding kahiye.'
en: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”
text:
NUM 10:30
Thadou: Hobab in adonbut in, 'Ahipoi, keima kache louding ahi. Keima ka gam le ka insung mite henga kile ding kahiye.'
English: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”

tcz: Mose ataovin ahi, 'Neidalhah hih un, gamthip a hoilai a ngahmun kisongding ham ti nang in nahet ahi. Hungin land neihun lamhil un.
en: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.
text:
NUM 10:31
Thadou: Mose ataovin ahi, 'Neidalhah hih un, gamthip a hoilai a ngahmun kisongding ham ti nang in nahet ahi. Hungin land neihun lamhil un.
English: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

tcz: Kaseinei nop peh leh, Pakaiya kon phattheina kachanho jouseu i nei khom diu ahi' ati.
en: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good the LORD does to us, we will do the same to you.”
text:
NUM 10:32
Thadou: Kaseinei nop peh leh, Pakaiya kon phattheina kachanho jouseu i nei khom diu ahi' ati.
English: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good the LORD does to us, we will do the same to you.”

tcz: Hitichun Pakai molsang chung adalhah jou uchun nithum sung ana kitol un, kingah nading mun phochen ding in Pakai kitepna thingkong in ana amakai un ahi.
en: They set forward from the Mount of the LORD three days’ journey. The ark of the LORD’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.
text:
NUM 10:33
Thadou: Hitichun Pakai molsang chung adalhah jou uchun nithum sung ana kitol un, kingah nading mun phochen ding in Pakai kitepna thingkong in ana amakai un ahi.
English: They set forward from the Mount of the LORD three days’ journey. The ark of the LORD’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

tcz: Hitia niseh a lam ajot jing lai un, Pakai meibol lom in akhu khum jing un apuile jing uve.
en: The cloud of the LORD was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
text:
NUM 10:34
Thadou: Hitia niseh a lam ajot jing lai un, Pakai meibol lom in akhu khum jing un apuile jing uve.
English: The cloud of the LORD was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

tcz: Chule thingkong chu akitoldoh ji teng, Mose’n aw sangtah in a sam ding, “kipatdoh tan, O Pakai, namelma te kithecheh uhen, nangma angsung a kon in jammang uhen” atiding ahi.
en: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, LORD, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”
text:
NUM 10:35
Thadou: Chule thingkong chu akitoldoh ji teng, Mose’n aw sangtah in a sam ding, “kipatdoh tan, O Pakai, namelma te kithecheh uhen, nangma angsung a kon in jammang uhen” atiding ahi.
English: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, LORD, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”

tcz: Chule thingkong chu akikoi lhah teng, “Simsenlou asang sang umna Israelte heng a hung ki le kit tan Pakai” tia aman aseikit ding ahi.
en: When it rested, he said, “Return, LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
text:
NUM 10:36
Thadou: Chule thingkong chu akikoi lhah teng, “Simsenlou asang sang umna Israelte heng a hung ki le kit tan Pakai” tia aman aseikit ding ahi.
English: When it rested, he said, “Return, LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin mipite hochu hahsat genthei jeh a lunglhei louna ahin phong doh tauvin, chule Pakai in aseidohho jouseu abonchan ajasoh keiyin ahi. Hiche Pathen lunghanna chu amaho chunga akoujah jengtan, amaho hal vam ding meikong asoltan, chule ngahmun polam a um mi phabeppi chu asumang tan ahi.
en: The people were complaining in the ears of the LORD. When the LORD heard it, his anger burned; and the LORD’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.
text:
NUM 11:1
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin mipite hochu hahsat genthei jeh a lunglhei louna ahin phong doh tauvin, chule Pakai in aseidohho jouseu abonchan ajasoh keiyin ahi. Hiche Pathen lunghanna chu amaho chunga akoujah jengtan, amaho hal vam ding meikong asoltan, chule ngahmun polam a um mi phabeppi chu asumang tan ahi.
English: The people were complaining in the ears of the LORD. When the LORD heard it, his anger burned; and the LORD’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

tcz: Hichun mite hochu Mose henga kithopina ngaichan akap un amao tauvin, chuin Mose chun Pathen henga taona anei phat in, meikong chu athiptai.
en: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire abated.
text:
NUM 11:2
Thadou: Hichun mite hochu Mose henga kithopina ngaichan akap un amao tauvin, chuin Mose chun Pathen henga taona anei phat in, meikong chu athiptai.
English: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire abated.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouchun, hiche lai lhang chu Taberah(Hichu 'mei kou namun' tina ahi) tin akihetai ajehchu Pathenna konna meikong chun amaho lah a mi phabep ahal lhah namun ahi.
en: The name of that place was called Taberah, because the LORD’s fire burned among them.
text:
NUM 11:3
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouchun, hiche lai lhang chu Taberah(Hichu 'mei kou namun' tina ahi) tin akihetai ajehchu Pathenna konna meikong chun amaho lah a mi phabep ahal lhah namun ahi.
English: The name of that place was called Taberah, because the LORD’s fire burned among them.

tcz: Israel mite toh lamjot khom namdang ho chun Egypt gam'a neh le chah ho chu ahin ngaicha tauvin, hichun Israel chate jong ahung kiphin kit tauvin, “Oh, Sa themkhat beh neipe un!” tin a eujah tauvin ahi.
en: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?
text:
NUM 11:4
Thadou: Israel mite toh lamjot khom namdang ho chun Egypt gam'a neh le chah ho chu ahin ngaicha tauvin, hichun Israel chate jong ahung kiphin kit tauvin, “Oh, Sa themkhat beh neipe un!” tin a eujah tauvin ahi.
English: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?

tcz: Egypt gam sung a nga aman beija kaneh jiu ka lhangai jun ahi. Chule changmaiho, donkhoho, leeks, louthul atil neiho, chule changnam(Garlic) ho akingai cha chan akimutheije tin asam uve.
en: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;

tcz: Ahinlah tuhin imacha ka duchat hou kanei tapouvin, Tua kamu kaneh jing uhi hiche Manna bou hi ahitai.
en: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”
text:
NUM 11:6
Thadou: Ahinlah tuhin imacha ka duchat hou kanei tapouvin, Tua kamu kaneh jing uhi hiche Manna bou hi ahitai.
English: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”

tcz: Manna kiti chule louthul amu neocha cha hotobang ahin hiche ai-eng tobanga eng dup a kiselum a ahi.
en: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.
text:
NUM 11:7
Thadou: Manna kiti chule louthul amu neocha cha hotobang ahin hiche ai-eng tobanga eng dup a kiselum a ahi.
English: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.

tcz: Mipi chu pamlam a gache uva ahin kilokhom uva, changbong tobang asothei nadia khutpei changsuhgoina manchah amangcha jiuvin ahilou jong leh agoi nel tho jiu ahiye. Hiche amahon changbong tobang chu bel lah ahon uva changlhah pheng ahin sodoh sah jiu ahi. Changlhah pheng chu Olive thao toh kihal jia nehthei tui in atui in ahi.
en: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.
text:
NUM 11:8
Thadou: Mipi chu pamlam a gache uva ahin kilokhom uva, changbong tobang asothei nadia khutpei changsuhgoina manchah amangcha jiuvin ahilou jong leh agoi nel tho jiu ahiye. Hiche amahon changbong tobang chu bel lah ahon uva changlhah pheng ahin sodoh sah jiu ahi. Changlhah pheng chu Olive thao toh kihal jia nehthei tui in atui in ahi.
English: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

tcz: Hiche manna chu ngahmuna jankim teng daitui toh hung khelha tha jia ahiye.
en: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.
text:
NUM 11:9
Thadou: Hiche manna chu ngahmuna jankim teng daitui toh hung khelha tha jia ahiye.
English: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.

tcz: Hichun Mose’n mipi ho jouse ama ama insunga amaponbuh a in kotbul a kiphinna husa ajan, chule Pakai lunghanna akhong gei leutan, Mose jong alung nopmo asah lheh in ahi.
en: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and the LORD’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.
text:
NUM 11:10
Thadou: Hichun Mose’n mipi ho jouse ama ama insunga amaponbuh a in kotbul a kiphinna husa ajan, chule Pakai lunghanna akhong gei leutan, Mose jong alung nopmo asah lheh in ahi.
English: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and the LORD’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.

tcz: Chu in Mose’n Pakai henga aseijin, “Ipidia nasoh hi hiti lom lom a hi nei gimbol hitam? Kachung a khotona nei nei in! Bolkhel ipi kanei a, mipi ho pohgih jouse kapoh ding naphal ham?
en: Moses said to the LORD, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?
text:
NUM 11:11
Thadou: Chu in Mose’n Pakai henga aseijin, “Ipidia nasoh hi hiti lom lom a hi nei gimbol hitam? Kachung a khotona nei nei in! Bolkhel ipi kanei a, mipi ho pohgih jouse kapoh ding naphal ham?
English: Moses said to the LORD, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?

tcz: Keiman amaho hi kahindoh sa hiuvem? hiche vannoiya hi ka hin poh lut hiuvem? Minun naosen ajenle a apoh le bang a ipi dia amaho hi kaban a kadople ding a neiseipeh ham? Apu apateo nana peh na gam a chu iti keiman amaho hi ka puilut jou ding ham?
en: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?
text:
NUM 11:12
Thadou: Keiman amaho hi kahindoh sa hiuvem? hiche vannoiya hi ka hin poh lut hiuvem? Minun naosen ajenle a apoh le bang a ipi dia amaho hi kaban a kadople ding a neiseipeh ham? Apu apateo nana peh na gam a chu iti keiman amaho hi ka puilut jou ding ham?
English: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?

tcz: Keiman hoilam a hiche mipi ho neh dinga saphe ka lah ding hitam? Amaho akiphin phin jeng un, “Saphe kaneh ding nei piuvin!” atiuve.
en: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’
text:
NUM 11:13
Thadou: Keiman hoilam a hiche mipi ho neh dinga saphe ka lah ding hitam? Amaho akiphin phin jeng un, “Saphe kaneh ding nei piuvin!” atiuve.
English: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’

tcz: Keiman hiche mipi ho hi kachangin ka jou tapoi! Hiche pohgih hi kapohjou kalval in agihtai!
en: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
text:
NUM 11:14
Thadou: Keiman hiche mipi ho hi kachangin ka jou tapoi! Hiche pohgih hi kapohjou kalval in agihtai!
English: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

tcz: Hitobang tah a hi gimsah ding mong neitileh, kipat in lang nei that doh tan. Neihin khohsah in lang hiche gim genthei ho a kon hin nei huidoh o!”
en: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”
text:
NUM 11:15
Thadou: Hitobang tah a hi gimsah ding mong neitileh, kipat in lang nei that doh tan. Neihin khohsah in lang hiche gim genthei ho a kon hin nei huidoh o!”
English: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Mose kom a ahinsei in, “Keima angsung a Israel mipi te lamkai leh Upa ho som sagi hin puilut in. Hiche lamkai hochu Houbuh a nang doh ding khom uhen.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.
text:
NUM 11:16
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in Mose kom a ahinsei in, “Keima angsung a Israel mipi te lamkai leh Upa ho som sagi hin puilut in. Hiche lamkai hochu Houbuh a nang doh ding khom uhen.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

tcz: Keima hung kumlha ingting kahin houpi ding nahi. Keiman nang a um lhagao phabep khat la ingting amaho chunga hiche lhagao chu ka khumlut peh ding ahi. Amahon mipiho pohgih chu a pohhu diu, nang in nachang a napoh ngailou ding ahitai.
en: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.
text:
NUM 11:17
Thadou: Keima hung kumlha ingting kahin houpi ding nahi. Keiman nang a um lhagao phabep khat la ingting amaho chunga hiche lhagao chu ka khumlut peh ding ahi. Amahon mipiho pohgih chu a pohhu diu, nang in nachang a napoh ngailou ding ahitai.
English: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.

tcz: “Chule mipi ho chu seipeh un, 'nangho kisutheng un, ajehchu jing nikho teng nang hon sa nehding nanei ding u ahitai. Nangho na kiphin un, chuleh Pathen in naka nau ajatai. 'Saphe themkhat jeh in Egypt ma um kanom jouve! na tiuve' tuahi Pakai in nang ho nahin peh diu naneh tei dingu ahi tai.
en: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.
text:
NUM 11:18
Thadou: “Chule mipi ho chu seipeh un, 'nangho kisutheng un, ajehchu jing nikho teng nang hon sa nehding nanei ding u ahitai. Nangho na kiphin un, chuleh Pathen in naka nau ajatai. 'Saphe themkhat jeh in Egypt ma um kanom jouve! na tiuve' tuahi Pakai in nang ho nahin peh diu naneh tei dingu ahi tai.
English: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.

tcz: Hichu nikhat ahi louleh nini tina jong ahi tapon, ni nga, nisom chule nisomni tina jong ahi tapoi, ati.
en: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,
text:
NUM 11:19
Thadou: Hichu nikhat ahi louleh nini tina jong ahi tapon, ni nga, nisom chule nisomni tina jong ahi tapoi, ati.
English: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,

tcz: Nang hon lhakhat sunga nachimdeh tokah uva naneh diu ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon nakom uva umjing Pakai napampai un, chuleh ama kom a kiphinnan naseiyun, “Idia Egypt gam ihin dalhah mong mong uham” natiuve.””
en: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected the LORD who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”
text:
NUM 11:20
Thadou: Nang hon lhakhat sunga nachimdeh tokah uva naneh diu ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon nakom uva umjing Pakai napampai un, chuleh ama kom a kiphinnan naseiyun, “Idia Egypt gam ihin dalhah mong mong uham” natiuve.””
English: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected the LORD who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”

tcz: Ahin Mose chun Pakai chu adonbut nin, “tuahi mihem sang jagup keima toh um kahiuve, ahin Pakai nangma in 'lhakhat sungse aneh diu kapeh ding ahi! nati.'
en: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’
text:
NUM 11:21
Thadou: Ahin Mose chun Pakai chu adonbut nin, “tuahi mihem sang jagup keima toh um kahiuve, ahin Pakai nangma in 'lhakhat sungse aneh diu kapeh ding ahi! nati.'
English: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’

tcz: Kaganchan neihou jouse kithat jongleh, mihem hijat kipejou nantem? tui khanglen’a um nga jouse kiman hen lang hita jong leh hiche ho jeh achu lhing mong ding hinam?
en: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”
text:
NUM 11:22
Thadou: Kaganchan neihou jouse kithat jongleh, mihem hijat kipejou nantem? tui khanglen’a um nga jouse kiman hen lang hita jong leh hiche ho jeh achu lhing mong ding hinam?
English: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseijin, “Ka khut hin atha lhasam aham? Tua hi nang man kathusei hi atah ahi alhem ahi na hetchen ding ahitai!” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Has the LORD’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”
text:
NUM 11:23
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseijin, “Ka khut hin atha lhasam aham? Tua hi nang man kathusei hi atah ahi alhem ahi na hetchen ding ahitai!” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Has the LORD’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”

tcz: Hichun Mose aga potdoh tan Pakaiyin ahenga asei bang chun mipi ho aga hetsah tan ahi. Mosen Upa ho mi som sagi asukhom in chu Houbuh kim vella chun adin sah tan ahi.
en: Moses went out, and told the people the LORD’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.
text:
NUM 11:24
Thadou: Hichun Mose aga potdoh tan Pakaiyin ahenga asei bang chun mipi ho aga hetsah tan ahi. Mosen Upa ho mi som sagi asukhom in chu Houbuh kim vella chun adin sah tan ahi.
English: Moses went out, and told the people the LORD’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.

tcz: Chuin meilom lah a kon chun Pakai ahung kumlhan Mose chu akihoulim pitai. Hichun Upa somsagi ho chu Mose apeh bang bang Lhagao chu amaho jouse chungnga apetan ahi. Chule lhagao ho chun mi somsagiho chunga achuh phatun, gaova thu aphongdoh tauvin ahi. Ahinlah hiche tobang thil umchan dol chu asoh kit tapon ahi.
en: The LORD came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.
text:
NUM 11:25
Thadou: Chuin meilom lah a kon chun Pakai ahung kumlhan Mose chu akihoulim pitai. Hichun Upa somsagi ho chu Mose apeh bang bang Lhagao chu amaho jouse chungnga apetan ahi. Chule lhagao ho chun mi somsagiho chunga achuh phatun, gaova thu aphongdoh tauvin ahi. Ahinlah hiche tobang thil umchan dol chu asoh kit tapon ahi.
English: The LORD came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

tcz: Mipa ni Eldad le Medad chu ngahmun nunglam ah aum lhon in ahi. Amani chu upa ho min kijih lut na a ajao lhon in, ahinlah amanin houbuh chu adalhah hon lou beh ahi tai. Ahijeng vang in amani chunga jong chun Lhagao chu aum tan, hichun amani jong chun gaothu aphong doh lhon e.
en: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
text:
NUM 11:26
Thadou: Mipa ni Eldad le Medad chu ngahmun nunglam ah aum lhon in ahi. Amani chu upa ho min kijih lut na a ajao lhon in, ahinlah amanin houbuh chu adalhah hon lou beh ahi tai. Ahijeng vang in amani chunga jong chun Lhagao chu aum tan, hichun amani jong chun gaothu aphong doh lhon e.
English: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

tcz: Pasal gollhang khat alhaiyin Mose koma thu chu agah lhut tan, “Eldad le Medad in gaothu aphong doh lhon tai!” ahung ti.
en: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”
text:
NUM 11:27
Thadou: Pasal gollhang khat alhaiyin Mose koma thu chu agah lhut tan, “Eldad le Medad in gaothu aphong doh lhon tai!” ahung ti.
English: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

tcz: Nun chapa Joshua, aneo laiya pat a Mose kithopi a hung pang pa vang chun lunglhai louna aphong doh in “Mose kapu, Eldad le Medad khu kicholdo sah tan!” tin aseiye.
en: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”
text:
NUM 11:28
Thadou: Nun chapa Joshua, aneo laiya pat a Mose kithopi a hung pang pa vang chun lunglhai louna aphong doh in “Mose kapu, Eldad le Medad khu kicholdo sah tan!” tin aseiye.
English: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”

tcz: Ahinlah Mosen a donbut in, “Keima a ding ngaito na a ipi na thangset pi ham? Keiman ka dei pha ka sah vang chu mi jouse hi themgao hihen lang chuleh Pakai in alhagao chu amaho jouse chung nga jong chun koi cheh le kati!” atin ahi.
en: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets, that the LORD would put his Spirit on them!”
text:
NUM 11:29
Thadou: Ahinlah Mosen a donbut in, “Keima a ding ngaito na a ipi na thangset pi ham? Keiman ka dei pha ka sah vang chu mi jouse hi themgao hihen lang chuleh Pakai in alhagao chu amaho jouse chung nga jong chun koi cheh le kati!” atin ahi.
English: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets, that the LORD would put his Spirit on them!”

tcz: Hichun Mose jong chu Upa ho chutoh ngahmun kom langa akile kit tauve.
en: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
text:
NUM 11:30
Thadou: Hichun Mose jong chu Upa ho chutoh ngahmun kom langa akile kit tauve.
English: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

tcz: Hitichun Pakaiyin Vamin puiding in tuikhanglen a huipi ahin nunsah tan, ngahmun chung leh kimvel jousea vamin akhehsah tan ahi. Amaho umna akon a avetna lamlam u miles a gamlha chan a chun tol a kon feet thum sang bou leng thei Vamim adimsoh tan ahi.
en: A wind from the LORD went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.
text:
NUM 11:31
Thadou: Hitichun Pakaiyin Vamin puiding in tuikhanglen a huipi ahin nunsah tan, ngahmun chung leh kimvel jousea vamin akhehsah tan ahi. Amaho umna akon a avetna lamlam u miles a gamlha chan a chun tol a kon feet thum sang bou leng thei Vamim adimsoh tan ahi.
English: A wind from the LORD went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.

tcz: Hichun mipi chu a potdoh'un hiche Vamim chu nilhum kei jin aman un hiche ni jan khovah keijin jong chuleh ajing gei jong chun aloh khom na laijun ahi. Koiman bushels somnga sang a lhomjo amanpouvin ahi! Ngahmun kimvel a chun Vamin sa ho chu agot nading in aphou un ahi.
en: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.
text:
NUM 11:32
Thadou: Hichun mipi chu a potdoh'un hiche Vamim chu nilhum kei jin aman un hiche ni jan khovah keijin jong chuleh ajing gei jong chun aloh khom na laijun ahi. Koiman bushels somnga sang a lhomjo amanpouvin ahi! Ngahmun kimvel a chun Vamin sa ho chu agot nading in aphou un ahi.
English: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.

tcz: Ahinlah Israelten saphe chu akam uva alhai’u aval lhah ding kontah u chun Pakai lung hanna achung'uva ahung chu tan, pul gimneitah alhunsah tan ahi.
en: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the LORD’s anger burned against the people, and the LORD struck the people with a very great plague.
text:
NUM 11:33
Thadou: Ahinlah Israelten saphe chu akam uva alhai’u aval lhah ding kontah u chun Pakai lung hanna achung'uva ahung chu tan, pul gimneitah alhunsah tan ahi.
English: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the LORD’s anger burned against the people, and the LORD struck the people with a very great plague.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun hilaimun chu Kibroth-Hattaavah(milop ho lhankhuh) aki sahtai ajehchu amahon Egypt lamah saphe ngai cha jing miho avuinao chu ahi.
en: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.
text:
NUM 11:34
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun hilaimun chu Kibroth-Hattaavah(milop ho lhankhuh) aki sahtai ajehchu amahon Egypt lamah saphe ngai cha jing miho avuinao chu ahi.
English: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.

tcz: Kibroth-Hattaavah apat chun Israel mite chu Hazeroth gei chu ahung kitol un, phat chomkhat hilai mun a chun ahung kichol uve.
en: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.
text:
NUM 11:35
Thadou: Kibroth-Hattaavah apat chun Israel mite chu Hazeroth gei chu ahung kitol un, phat chomkhat hilai mun a chun ahung kichol uve.
English: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.

tcz: Hazeroth muna aum laijun, Mose in Cush a kon numei khat akichenpi jeh in Miriam le Aaron chun ama demna thu aseilhontai.
en: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
text:
NUM 12:1
Thadou: Hazeroth muna aum laijun, Mose in Cush a kon numei khat akichenpi jeh in Miriam le Aaron chun ama demna thu aseilhontai.
English: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

tcz: Amani hiti hin asei lhon in, “Pakai chu Mose henga bou kilah thei ham? Eini heng a jong hung ki lahdoh hung kilah hilouham?” atilhon e. Hilah amani thusei chu Pakaiyin ajasoh kei in ahi.
en: They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.
text:
NUM 12:2
Thadou: Amani hiti hin asei lhon in, “Pakai chu Mose henga bou kilah thei ham? Eini heng a jong hung ki lahdoh hung kilah hilouham?” atilhon e. Hilah amani thusei chu Pakaiyin ajasoh kei in ahi.
English: They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.

tcz: (Mose chu akineosah lheh jeng in ahi- Leiset a akineosahpen pa sang in akineosah joh nalai in ahi).
en: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.
text:
NUM 12:3
Thadou: (Mose chu akineosah lheh jeng in ahi- Leiset a akineosahpen pa sang in akineosah joh nalai in ahi).
English: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

tcz: Hichun gang tah in Pakaiyin Mose, Aaron chule Miriam chu akouloi in hitin asei peh tai, “Nathum un Houbuh lama gache taovin” ati, hichun amaho thum in jong hilam chu ajon tauvin ahi.
en: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.
text:
NUM 12:4
Thadou: Hichun gang tah in Pakaiyin Mose, Aaron chule Miriam chu akouloi in hitin asei peh tai, “Nathum un Houbuh lama gache taovin” ati, hichun amaho thum in jong hilam chu ajon tauvin ahi.
English: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

tcz: Chuin Pathen chu meilom in ahung kumlhan houbuh lutna a chun ading den in, “Aaron leh Miriam” tin ahinkou in ahileh, amaninjong ahin nailut lhon in ahi.
en: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.
text:
NUM 12:5
Thadou: Chuin Pathen chu meilom in ahung kumlhan houbuh lutna a chun ading den in, “Aaron leh Miriam” tin ahinkou in ahileh, amaninjong ahin nailut lhon in ahi.
English: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

tcz: Chu in Pathen in ahoulim pilhon in tuhin ka thusei hohi ngailhon in: “Nangma ho lah’a themgao um ahileh, Keima, Pakaiyin, gaova kaki phon tah hih ding ham. Ahilouleh manga kaki houlim pi ding ahi tai, ati.
en: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.
text:
NUM 12:6
Thadou: Chu in Pathen in ahoulim pilhon in tuhin ka thusei hohi ngailhon in: “Nangma ho lah’a themgao um ahileh, Keima, Pakaiyin, gaova kaki phon tah hih ding ham. Ahilouleh manga kaki houlim pi ding ahi tai, ati.
English: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

tcz: Hinlah kasohpa Mose vang hitobang chu ahipoi, Ka insung pumpi a amahi katahsan pentah ahi.
en: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.
text:
NUM 12:7
Thadou: Hinlah kasohpa Mose vang hitobang chu ahipoi, Ka insung pumpi a amahi katahsan pentah ahi.
English: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

tcz: Keima amatoh gaophelphul hilouva kichentah kimaingat toa kihoulim kahi lhon e! Aman Pakai chu ahina bang tah a amu ahi. Chiti ahileh idia kasohpa Mose dem ding kicha lou nahivem?
en: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”
text:
NUM 12:8
Thadou: Keima amatoh gaophelphul hilouva kichentah kimaingat toa kihoulim kahi lhon e! Aman Pakai chu ahina bang tah a amu ahi. Chiti ahileh idia kasohpa Mose dem ding kicha lou nahivem?
English: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

tcz: Pakai chu amaho chunga chun alunghang lheh jeng tan, a dalha lhon tai.
en: The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.
text:
NUM 12:9
Thadou: Pakai chu amaho chunga chun alunghang lheh jeng tan, a dalha lhon tai.
English: The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.

tcz: Houbuh chunga meilhang akitol toh lhon in, Miriam chu ading in, Tiphah natna jeh chun avun chu buhbang bang in abang tan ahi. Aaron in Miriam chunga thilsoh ijakai amusoh phat in,
en: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
text:
NUM 12:10
Thadou: Houbuh chunga meilhang akitol toh lhon in, Miriam chu ading in, Tiphah natna jeh chun avun chu buhbang bang in abang tan ahi. Aaron in Miriam chunga thilsoh ijakai amusoh phat in,
English: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

tcz: Mose henga akaptan, “Oh! kapu hiche ngolhoitah chonsetna kana boldoh jeh lhon in gotna neipelhon hih beh in.
en: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.
text:
NUM 12:11
Thadou: Mose henga akaptan, “Oh! kapu hiche ngolhoitah chonsetna kana boldoh jeh lhon in gotna neipelhon hih beh in.
English: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

tcz: Amanu jong hi naosen athisa a hung peng, apen lhah lhah a amonsa bang in koi hih beh in,” ati.
en: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
text:
NUM 12:12
Thadou: Amanu jong hi naosen athisa a hung peng, apen lhah lhah a amonsa bang in koi hih beh in,” ati.
English: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

tcz: Hichun Mose Pakai anga a akapjah jeng tan, “O Pakai, katao ahi, lung set tah in amanu hi damsah tan!” ati.
en: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”
text:
NUM 12:13
Thadou: Hichun Mose Pakai anga a akapjah jeng tan, “O Pakai, katao ahi, lung set tah in amanu hi damsah tan!” ati.
English: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

tcz: Ahin Pakaiyin Mose jah a seitan, “Amanu hi apa chun achil aset khum hitaleh, ni sagi sung chu aboh a um a jum le ja athoh lou ding ham? hijeh chun amanu hi ngahmun pamlamma nisagi sung koidoh un lang, chujou teng lah lut kit thei hiding ahi” ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”
text:
NUM 12:14
Thadou: Ahin Pakaiyin Mose jah a seitan, “Amanu hi apa chun achil aset khum hitaleh, ni sagi sung chu aboh a um a jum le ja athoh lou ding ham? hijeh chun amanu hi ngahmun pamlamma nisagi sung koidoh un lang, chujou teng lah lut kit thei hiding ahi” ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

tcz: Hiti chun Miriam chu ngahmun pam lamah ni sagi aumsah un, chuleh akitol kit masang un, amanu chu ngahmun sung nga ahung kit ding chu mipiho chun angah un ahi.
en: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.
text:
NUM 12:15
Thadou: Hiti chun Miriam chu ngahmun pam lamah ni sagi aumsah un, chuleh akitol kit masang un, amanu chu ngahmun sung nga ahung kit ding chu mipiho chun angah un ahi.
English: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

tcz: Hitichun Hazeroth adalha tauvin ache peh un Paran gamthip munkhat a ngahmun khat akisemkit tauvin ahi.
en: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
text:
NUM 12:16
Thadou: Hitichun Hazeroth adalha tauvin ache peh un Paran gamthip munkhat a ngahmun khat akisemkit tauvin ahi.
English: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu hichengse hi aseijin ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 13:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu hichengse hi aseijin ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Canaan gam gakhol toh ding Pasal ho jouse chuga hetchen sahtan, gam chu keiman Israelte kapeh ding ahitai Pasal khat cheh phung dungjuiya lamkai hinah jallin acheding in ngense cheh un.
en: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”
text:
NUM 13:2
Thadou: Canaan gam gakhol toh ding Pasal ho jouse chuga hetchen sahtan, gam chu keiman Israelte kapeh ding ahitai Pasal khat cheh phung dungjuiya lamkai hinah jallin acheding in ngense cheh un.
English: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

tcz: Hichun Mose’n Pathen in anganse na dungjuiyin abol in, gamthip lah’a pat chun Mose’n Pasal somleni Israel phungsom le ni ho lamkai ho chu ngahmun apat’nin asol doh in ahi.
en: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of the LORD. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.
text:
NUM 13:3
Thadou: Hichun Mose’n Pathen in anganse na dungjuiyin abol in, gamthip lah’a pat chun Mose’n Pasal somleni Israel phungsom le ni ho lamkai ho chu ngahmun apat’nin asol doh in ahi.
English: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of the LORD. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.

tcz: Ama cheh phung min chule alamkai ho chu; Reuben-Shammur, Zuar chapa ahiuve.
en: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
text:
NUM 13:4
Thadou: Ama cheh phung min chule alamkai ho chu; Reuben-Shammur, Zuar chapa ahiuve.
English: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

tcz: Simeon-Shaphat, Hori chapa ahin,
en: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
text:
NUM 13:5
Thadou: Simeon-Shaphat, Hori chapa ahin,
English: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

tcz: Judah-Cazb hi Jiphanneh chapa ahi.
en: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
text:
NUM 13:6
Thadou: Judah-Cazb hi Jiphanneh chapa ahi.
English: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

tcz: Issachar- Igal hi Joseph chapa ahiye.
en: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
text:
NUM 13:7
Thadou: Issachar- Igal hi Joseph chapa ahiye.
English: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

tcz: Ephraim-Hosea hi nun chapa ahi.
en: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
text:
NUM 13:8
Thadou: Ephraim-Hosea hi nun chapa ahi.
English: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

tcz: Benjamin- Pate hi phunglmakai Raphu chapa ahiye.
en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
text:
NUM 13:9
Thadou: Benjamin- Pate hi phunglmakai Raphu chapa ahiye.
English: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

tcz: Zebulun- Gadad hi Lamkai Guset chapa ahiye.
en: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
text:
NUM 13:10
Thadou: Zebulun- Gadad hi Lamkai Guset chapa ahiye.
English: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

tcz: Manasseh- Gadi hi joseph chapa ahin suse chapa ahiye.
en: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
text:
NUM 13:11
Thadou: Manasseh- Gadi hi joseph chapa ahin suse chapa ahiye.
English: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

tcz: Dan- Ammiel hi Lamkai Gemnah chapa ahi.
en: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
text:
NUM 13:12
Thadou: Dan- Ammiel hi Lamkai Gemnah chapa ahi.
English: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

tcz: Asher- Sethan lamkai Michal chapa ahi.
en: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
text:
NUM 13:13
Thadou: Asher- Sethan lamkai Michal chapa ahi.
English: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

tcz: Napthali-Nabi hi Vophsi chapa ahi.
en: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
text:
NUM 13:14
Thadou: Napthali-Nabi hi Vophsi chapa ahi.
English: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

tcz: Gad- Guel hi mala chapa ahi.
en: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
text:
NUM 13:15
Thadou: Gad- Guel hi mala chapa ahi.
English: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

tcz: Amaho chengse hi Mose’n gamkhol chin ding nga alhen doh ho, Mose’n Hosea chule Nun chapa amachu akouvin Joshua min asah tai.
en: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
text:
NUM 13:16
Thadou: Amaho chengse hi Mose’n gamkhol chin ding nga alhen doh ho, Mose’n Hosea chule Nun chapa amachu akouvin Joshua min asah tai.
English: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

tcz: Mose’n hiche Pasal a soldoh ho chu hiche thugah na ho chu aneiyun gam leiset kholchil ding nga nganse na anei dung juiyin nangho cheuvin sahlam mah negar hopat un thinglhang lam naho diu ahi, ati.
en: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.
text:
NUM 13:17
Thadou: Mose’n hiche Pasal a soldoh ho chu hiche thugah na ho chu aneiyun gam leiset kholchil ding nga nganse na anei dung juiyin nangho cheuvin sahlam mah negar hopat un thinglhang lam naho diu ahi, ati.
English: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.

tcz: Cheuvin lang gam umdan ijakai kholchilna ganei jun lang mihem um dol jong hinve chil unlang, hiche muna cheng ding chu mi ijat adol ding ham tijong hinkhol un, ati.
en: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

tcz: Amaho chenna gamho chu apha ham, aseham akhosah dan u ijakai hinkhol un chule khopi umdan jong hinve chil un.
en: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

tcz: Leiset chu thao putna ham ahilouleh gamgo apha lou ham? Hilai kom dunga chu thing phung tamtah umham? Thei phung thing phung aga hoi pen tah vetchil dia na hinpoh diu ahi.
en: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.
text:
NUM 13:20
Thadou: Leiset chu thao putna ham ahilouleh gamgo apha lou ham? Hilai kom dunga chu thing phung tamtah umham? Thei phung thing phung aga hoi pen tah vetchil dia na hinpoh diu ahi.
English: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.

tcz: Hichun achie tou un Zin gamthip apat akhol chil un Rebob kiti gei chu Leboh Hamath kom dung gei chu abonchan gakholsoh keiyun.
en: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
text:
NUM 13:21
Thadou: Hichun achie tou un Zin gamthip apat akhol chil un Rebob kiti gei chu Leboh Hamath kom dung gei chu abonchan gakholsoh keiyun.
English: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

tcz: Sahlam ahoh paovin gamthip kiti mun chu ajot paovin chuin Hebron alhung tauve. Hikom mun chu Amal chilhah te ahin Sheshal chule Tamal ho chun ana um uve. Hebron khopi chu Egypt khopi Zoan kiti sanga kum-sagi masanga kisem masa ahi.
en: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
text:
NUM 13:22
Thadou: Sahlam ahoh paovin gamthip kiti mun chu ajot paovin chuin Hebron alhung tauve. Hikom mun chu Amal chilhah te ahin Sheshal chule Tamal ho chun ana um uve. Hebron khopi chu Egypt khopi Zoan kiti sanga kum-sagi masanga kisem masa ahi.
English: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

tcz: Amahon Eschort phaicham ahin phah uchun lengpi thei boh khat ahin sat lhauvin amani kikah ah ahin polut un chuleh kolbu thei jong Olive phung jong jaonan ahinpo lhonne.
en: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.
text:
NUM 13:23
Thadou: Amahon Eschort phaicham ahin phah uchun lengpi thei boh khat ahin sat lhauvin amani kikah ah ahin polut un chuleh kolbu thei jong Olive phung jong jaonan ahinpo lhonne.
English: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.

tcz: Hiche lai mun chu Eschort phaicham aki tin ahi. Ajeh chu Israel mihon hikomma chu lengpi thei avat u ahi.
en: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.
text:
NUM 13:24
Thadou: Hiche lai mun chu Eschort phaicham aki tin ahi. Ajeh chu Israel mihon hikomma chu lengpi thei avat u ahi.
English: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.

tcz: Ni somli jen gam le go kholchih na anei jou phat un Pasal ho chu ahung kinung le gam tauve.
en: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
text:
NUM 13:25
Thadou: Ni somli jen gam le go kholchih na anei jou phat un Pasal ho chu ahung kinung le gam tauve.
English: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

tcz: Tun amaho ahung ki nung le taovin Mose le Aaron kom ahin chule Israel mipi jouse jong chu Paran gamthip ma chun aum un ahi.
en: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.
text:
NUM 13:26
Thadou: Tun amaho ahung ki nung le taovin Mose le Aaron kom ahin chule Israel mipi jouse jong chu Paran gamthip ma chun aum un ahi.
English: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.

tcz: Hichun amahon Mose jah hiti hin asei un, keiho nei nganse nauva kaga che un gam leiset vedin, hiche gam hi khoiju le bongnoi lonna chule hichengse hi gamsunga gasoh ho ahi.
en: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
text:
NUM 13:27
Thadou: Hichun amahon Mose jah hiti hin asei un, keiho nei nganse nauva kaga che un gam leiset vedin, hiche gam hi khoiju le bongnoi lonna chule hichengse hi gamsunga gasoh ho ahi.
English: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

tcz: Ahinlah hilai gamma umho chu thil bolthei na hangsan tah ahiuvin, khopi ho jong chu hoitah in aveng tup un amel’u jong alen theiyin hikomma chun Anak mite a khosa uvin ahi.
en: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.
text:
NUM 13:28
Thadou: Ahinlah hilai gamma umho chu thil bolthei na hangsan tah ahiuvin, khopi ho jong chu hoitah in aveng tup un amel’u jong alen theiyin hikomma chun Anak mite a khosa uvin ahi.
English: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.

tcz: Amalek mite vang noilam alouvin, hit mite ahin Amor mite ho jouse thinglhang lam aloh soh un, chuleh Cannan mite vang'in Jordan phai vadung lang tui khanglen kom lang aloh soh hellun ahi.
en: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”
text:
NUM 13:29
Thadou: Amalek mite vang noilam alouvin, hit mite ahin Amor mite ho jouse thinglhang lam aloh soh un, chuleh Cannan mite vang'in Jordan phai vadung lang tui khanglen kom lang aloh soh hellun ahi.
English: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”

tcz: Ahinlah Caleb in mipi ho chu aphoh thip in Mose heng lam adin ahung taovin, Caleb in hitin aseiyin, eiho che’u hitin hiche gam chu lahlut ding ngaito tauhite, ajeh chu hiche mite hi ijo teidiu ahi.
en: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”
text:
NUM 13:30
Thadou: Ahinlah Caleb in mipi ho chu aphoh thip in Mose heng lam adin ahung taovin, Caleb in hitin aseiyin, eiho che’u hitin hiche gam chu lahlut ding ngaito tauhite, ajeh chu hiche mite hi ijo teidiu ahi.
English: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”

tcz: Amavang Caleb toh gam kholle a che ho lah mi phabep loi chu anom pouvin, Anak mite ho chu eiho sanga hat jo ahiuvin, eiho Amaho chu ima ilo theilou diu ahi tin asei uve.
en: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”
text:
NUM 13:31
Thadou: Amavang Caleb toh gam kholle a che ho lah mi phabep loi chu anom pouvin, Anak mite ho chu eiho sanga hat jo ahiuvin, eiho Amaho chu ima ilo theilou diu ahi tin asei uve.
English: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

tcz: Hichun Amaho lah’a mi phabep loi chun hiche thupha lou hi Israel mite lah’a ahin sei phong uvin ahi. Gam leiset keiman ka khol chil jou pon nang ho gam neite ahat theiyun Amahon hetman louva eisuhgam jeng theiyu ahi, ati.
en: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.
text:
NUM 13:32
Thadou: Hichun Amaho lah’a mi phabep loi chun hiche thupha lou hi Israel mite lah’a ahin sei phong uvin ahi. Gam leiset keiman ka khol chil jou pon nang ho gam neite ahat theiyun Amahon hetman louva eisuhgam jeng theiyu ahi, ati.
English: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.

tcz: Keihon Anak mite chu kamu uvin amaho toh teding in eiho hi khongbai tabang bep ihiuvin Anak mite jeng in jong hitia chu eigellu ahiye.
en: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”
text:
NUM 13:33
Thadou: Keihon Anak mite chu kamu uvin amaho toh teding in eiho hi khongbai tabang bep ihiuvin Anak mite jeng in jong hitia chu eigellu ahiye.
English: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”

tcz: Hichun Israel mite abonchauvin aw-sang tah in akap un chu leh amaho chu jan khovah geijin akap’un hiche mipiho awgin chu lakisa’a ki thong bang in Mose leh Aaron dounan aboldoh tauvin ahi.
en: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
text:
NUM 14:1
Thadou: Hichun Israel mite abonchauvin aw-sang tah in akap un chu leh amaho chu jan khovah geijin akap’un hiche mipiho awgin chu lakisa’a ki thong bang in Mose leh Aaron dounan aboldoh tauvin ahi.
English: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

tcz: Hiche mipi awgin lakisa chu akithong jing in Mose le Aaron douna kibol ahin Egypt gamah ana thidoh kihi le pha jonte tin asam uve.
en: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!
text:
NUM 14:2
Thadou: Hiche mipi awgin lakisa chu akithong jing in Mose le Aaron douna kibol ahin Egypt gamah ana thidoh kihi le pha jonte tin asam uve.
English: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!

tcz: Pakaiyin hilang gam lah ahi eipui doh jing’u ham gal’a thi bep dinga ka jite hou numei chapang jaona athigam bep dinga Egypt gamsunga konna nei hin puidoh u ham tin asei uve.
en: Why does the LORD bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”
text:
NUM 14:3
Thadou: Pakaiyin hilang gam lah ahi eipui doh jing’u ham gal’a thi bep dinga ka jite hou numei chapang jaona athigam bep dinga Egypt gamsunga konna nei hin puidoh u ham tin asei uve.
English: Why does the LORD bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”

tcz: Hi chun Amaho khat le khat aki hou khom mun eihon lamkai thah lheng u hitin Egypt lamah kinung le tauhite tin akihou lim tauvin ahi.
en: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”
text:
NUM 14:4
Thadou: Hi chun Amaho khat le khat aki hou khom mun eihon lamkai thah lheng u hitin Egypt lamah kinung le tauhite tin akihou lim tauvin ahi.
English: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”

tcz: Hichun Mose le Aaron chu Israel mite jouse masang tol lang ngan akun lha lhon tan ahi.
en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
text:
NUM 14:5
Thadou: Hichun Mose le Aaron chu Israel mite jouse masang tol lang ngan akun lha lhon tan ahi.
English: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

tcz: Pasal mini gam kholla che teni chu Nun chapa Joshua le Jephanneh chapa Caleb chun aponsil lhon abotkeh lhon tai.
en: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
text:
NUM 14:6
Thadou: Pasal mini gam kholla che teni chu Nun chapa Joshua le Jephanneh chapa Caleb chun aponsil lhon abotkeh lhon tai.
English: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.

tcz: Ama nin Israel mipi teho lah’a asei lhon tan, keini’n ka khol chil lhon gam ho chu ki dang tah le loupi tah ahiye, tin asei lhon’e.
en: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.
text:
NUM 14:7
Thadou: Ama nin Israel mipi teho lah’a asei lhon tan, keini’n ka khol chil lhon gam ho chu ki dang tah le loupi tah ahiye, tin asei lhon’e.
English: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.

tcz: Chule Pathen hi eiho dinga hiche gamsung khu eiphatsah peh uva ahi tan Pakai chun agamsunga ei pui lut diu, khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam ahiye.
en: If the LORD delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.
text:
NUM 14:8
Thadou: Chule Pathen hi eiho dinga hiche gamsung khu eiphatsah peh uva ahi tan Pakai chun agamsunga ei pui lut diu, khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam ahiye.
English: If the LORD delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.

tcz: Pakai chu douhih un, chule hiche gamsunga chengte jong kicha hih un. Eiho a ding in amaho khu apanpi ding umlou anchah a pang tobangbep ahiuve! Avengtup ding aneipouve, Pathen thahat chungnung aum in aman abanthahat in ei panpi jing diu ahiye.
en: Only don’t rebel against the LORD, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and the LORD is with us. Don’t fear them.”
text:
NUM 14:9
Thadou: Pakai chu douhih un, chule hiche gamsunga chengte jong kicha hih un. Eiho a ding in amaho khu apanpi ding umlou anchah a pang tobangbep ahiuve! Avengtup ding aneipouve, Pathen thahat chungnung aum in aman abanthahat in ei panpi jing diu ahiye.
English: Only don’t rebel against the LORD, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and the LORD is with us. Don’t fear them.”

tcz: Amavang Mipi jouse chu Joshua le Caleb chu songa se lih ding agong tauvin Pakai, Pathen loupina chungnung chu Israelte chunga ahung kitah lang tan houbuh thingkong chu ahung kilah tan ahi.
en: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. The LORD’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.
text:
NUM 14:10
Thadou: Amavang Mipi jouse chu Joshua le Caleb chu songa se lih ding agong tauvin Pakai, Pathen loupina chungnung chu Israelte chunga ahung kitah lang tan houbuh thingkong chu ahung kilah tan ahi.
English: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. The LORD’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.

tcz: Chu in Pathen in Mose chu a houlimpi tan itih chan hiche Israel mite hin donlou nahsah louva eikoi diu hitam? Thet-um tah thil ki dang tampi aboldoh tauvin ahi.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?
text:
NUM 14:11
Thadou: Chu in Pathen in Mose chu a houlimpi tan itih chan hiche Israel mite hin donlou nahsah louva eikoi diu hitam? Thet-um tah thil ki dang tampi aboldoh tauvin ahi.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?

tcz: Keiman amaho chu ka kihet mosah ding chule ka suh mang ding ahiuve. Ahinlah keiman nangma mihat tah ka so ding, Amaho sanga hat jo phajo ka so ding na hi, ati.
en: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”
text:
NUM 14:12
Thadou: Keiman amaho chu ka kihet mosah ding chule ka suh mang ding ahiuve. Ahinlah keiman nangma mihat tah ka so ding, Amaho sanga hat jo phajo ka so ding na hi, ati.
English: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”

tcz: Ahin lah Mose vang chu anom pon a lung phamo lheh in Egypt miten ipi agel diuvem hiche thil um dan ahin het teng ule Mose’n Pathen chu adong tan Egypte ahat soh hel lin nangma tha hatna Israel mite na hin pui doh’a Egypt apat na hung sohchat’u ahiye.
en: Moses said to the LORD, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.
text:
NUM 14:13
