Thadou: Ahinlah Balaam in Balak chu hitin a donbut in Balaam in alenggam toh ei peh tha henlang sana dangka toh kikoi dimset hita jongle ka Pathen lungdei lou ahikhah le keiman imacha ka bol theina ding’a, thilbol theina neilou ka hi ding ahiye, ati.
English: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

tcz: Ahinlah jan khat tabang umbe un, keiman jong Pakai, Pathen in kahenga epi aseibe ding ham kahetdoh thei nadin.
en: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else the LORD will speak to me.”
text:
NUM 22:19
Thadou: Ahinlah jan khat tabang umbe un, keiman jong Pakai, Pathen in kahenga epi aseibe ding ham kahetdoh thei nadin.
English: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else the LORD will speak to me.”

tcz: Hiche ni jan chun Pathen Vantil chu Balaam heng a ahung kilah tan hiche miluntah hohi na heng’a ding a hung kholjin ahi tah jeh un, nangma kipatdoh inlang amaho toh chekhom un, ahinlah nangman keima thupeh na jui ding ahi.
en: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”
text:
NUM 22:20
Thadou: Hiche ni jan chun Pathen Vantil chu Balaam heng a ahung kilah tan hiche miluntah hohi na heng’a ding a hung kholjin ahi tah jeh un, nangma kipatdoh inlang amaho toh chekhom un, ahinlah nangman keima thupeh na jui ding ahi.
English: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”

tcz: Hichun ajing in Balaam aki thoudoh in asangan a atoudoh in Moab mite lamkai hochu toh akipat doh tauvin ahi.
en: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.
text:
NUM 22:21
Thadou: Hichun ajing in Balaam aki thoudoh in asangan a atoudoh in Moab mite lamkai hochu toh akipat doh tauvin ahi.
English: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

tcz: Hitia Balaam ache jeh chun, Pathen chu alunghang tan hijeh chun Pakai Vantil asol in lamlen laitah a Balaam tingtan ding chun ana pang tai. Balaam chu asoh mini toh kilhon ahi.
en: God’s anger burned because he went; and the LORD’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
text:
NUM 22:22
Thadou: Hitia Balaam ache jeh chun, Pathen chu alunghang tan hijeh chun Pakai Vantil asol in lamlen laitah a Balaam tingtan ding chun ana pang tai. Balaam chu asoh mini toh kilhon ahi.
English: God’s anger burned because he went; and the LORD’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

tcz: Balaam sangan chun Pakai Vantil lamlen na aum a, achemjam akhut a achoi chu a mudoh tan sangan chu lamlen a kon in phailei lam a lhai lha tan amavang Balaam in sangan chu ajep in lamlen ah ahin puilut kit tan ahi.
en: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.
text:
NUM 22:23
Thadou: Balaam sangan chun Pakai Vantil lamlen na aum a, achemjam akhut a achoi chu a mudoh tan sangan chu lamlen a kon in phailei lam a lhai lha tan amavang Balaam in sangan chu ajep in lamlen ah ahin puilut kit tan ahi.
English: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.

tcz: Hichun Pakai vantil chu lam ajum lang aneo lang lengpi thei lei teni kikah ah ana ding tan ahi.
en: Then the LORD’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
text:
NUM 22:24
Thadou: Hichun Pakai vantil chu lam ajum lang aneo lang lengpi thei lei teni kikah ah ana ding tan ahi.
English: Then the LORD’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

tcz: Sangan chun Pathen Vantil chu amu phat in aki tol doh kigo in Balaam keng toh bang chu anom beh khatai. Hichun Balaam in sangan chu ajep kit tan ahi.
en: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.
text:
NUM 22:25
Thadou: Sangan chun Pathen Vantil chu amu phat in aki tol doh kigo in Balaam keng toh bang chu anom beh khatai. Hichun Balaam in sangan chu ajep kit tan ahi.
English: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.

tcz: Pakai Vantil chu aki phei khin doh kit in akeng jep ah chun, ajet le avei ja sangan lhaidoh na ding umlou na ahchun ana ting kit’e.
en: The LORD’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
text:
NUM 22:26
Thadou: Pakai Vantil chu aki phei khin doh kit in akeng jep ah chun, ajet le avei ja sangan lhaidoh na ding umlou na ahchun ana ting kit’e.
English: The LORD’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

tcz: Hi chun sakol chun Pakai Vantil chu amu phat in, Balaam anoija abohkhup tan ahileh, Balaam chu alung hang lheh in sangan chu ajep tai.
en: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.
text:
NUM 22:27
Thadou: Hi chun sakol chun Pakai Vantil chu amu phat in, Balaam anoija abohkhup tan ahileh, Balaam chu alung hang lheh in sangan chu ajep tai.
English: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin sangan chu thusei theina apen; Balaam chu ahin donbut in, “Ipi kabol khel’a thumveijen nei jep hitam?” tin adong tai.
en: The LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”
text:
NUM 22:28
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin sangan chu thusei theina apen; Balaam chu ahin donbut in, “Ipi kabol khel’a thumveijen nei jep hitam?” tin adong tai.
English: The LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”

tcz: Nang in kei mingol tah neiso tah hila” tin Balaam akisen in, “Ka khut na hin chemjam um choi hileng ka dot lih ding na hitai”, ati.
en: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”
text:
NUM 22:29
Thadou: Nang in kei mingol tah neiso tah hila” tin Balaam akisen in, “Ka khut na hin chemjam um choi hileng ka dot lih ding na hitai”, ati.
English: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”

tcz: Na damsung’a na tou jingna na sangan chu kahi hilou ham? tin Sangan chun ahin donbut in, Keima nidang a chu hitabang a hi ka um khah em? ati. Balaam in adonbut in “Ahi nai! Na um khapoi” ati.
en: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”
text:
NUM 22:30
Thadou: Na damsung’a na tou jingna na sangan chu kahi hilou ham? tin Sangan chun ahin donbut in, Keima nidang a chu hitabang a hi ka um khah em? ati. Balaam in adonbut in “Ahi nai! Na um khapoi” ati.
English: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”

tcz: Hichun Pakai-Pathen in Balaam mitchu ahin hadoh sah tan hichun Balaam in Pakai Vantil lamka laiya adin’a chemjam akhutna aki choi chu amu phat in, amai ja akun suh in Pakai Pathen abohkhup tai.
en: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.
text:
NUM 22:31
Thadou: Hichun Pakai-Pathen in Balaam mitchu ahin hadoh sah tan hichun Balaam in Pakai Vantil lamka laiya adin’a chemjam akhutna aki choi chu amu phat in, amai ja akun suh in Pakai Pathen abohkhup tai.
English: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.

tcz: Pakai Vantil chun thudoh anei jin, ipi bolla na sangan chu navoh hitam ati Ven- keima nalampi su bing nga hung nga kahi ijeh inam itileh nangma hi mi louchal tah nahi, ati.
en: The LORD’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.
text:
NUM 22:32
Thadou: Pakai Vantil chun thudoh anei jin, ipi bolla na sangan chu navoh hitam ati Ven- keima nalampi su bing nga hung nga kahi ijeh inam itileh nangma hi mi louchal tah nahi, ati.
English: The LORD’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.

tcz: Sangan chun thumveijen ei mu ahin ei otdoh ji, tun keima in Sangan hi ka hoidoh sah a nangma hi katha doh ding nahi tai.
en: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”
text:
NUM 22:33
Thadou: Sangan chun thumveijen ei mu ahin ei otdoh ji, tun keima in Sangan hi ka hoidoh sah a nangma hi katha doh ding nahi tai.
English: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”

tcz: Hichun Balaam min Pakai vantil komma chun ngaidam athum tan, keima kachon kheltan keiman ka lampia neina tin chu ka geldoh lou ahi. Ka in lam ah kinungle kit tang kate, Pakai jin neiphal peh lou leh tin aseiye.
en: Balaam said to the LORD’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”
text:
NUM 22:34
Thadou: Hichun Balaam min Pakai vantil komma chun ngaidam athum tan, keima kachon kheltan keiman ka lampia neina tin chu ka geldoh lou ahi. Ka in lam ah kinungle kit tang kate, Pakai jin neiphal peh lou leh tin aseiye.
English: Balaam said to the LORD’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”

tcz: Ahilah, Pakai- Pathen chun Balaam chu a donbut in hiche miho toh hin kilhon in chen, Ahinlah kei seiho bou na bol ding ahi. Hichun Balaam chu Balak milun ho chu toh achekhom tauvin ahi.
en: The LORD’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
text:
NUM 22:35
Thadou: Ahilah, Pakai- Pathen chun Balaam chu a donbut in hiche miho toh hin kilhon in chen, Ahinlah kei seiho bou na bol ding ahi. Hichun Balaam chu Balak milun ho chu toh achekhom tauvin ahi.
English: The LORD’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

tcz: Balak Lengpa in Balaam chu ahung ahet phat in lamlen’a kimu pi din ache tai, Balak chu Moab mite gam ning gei Arnon vadung gei aga lam ton ahi.
en: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.
text:
NUM 22:36
Thadou: Balak Lengpa in Balaam chu ahung ahet phat in lamlen’a kimu pi din ache tai, Balak chu Moab mite gam ning gei Arnon vadung gei aga lam ton ahi.
English: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.

tcz: Balak in Balaam thudoh aneitan keima heng nga gang tah a nahung na ding a thu ka hin nei hilou ham Ibol’a na hung louham ati. Keiman kipa man ka peh dia ka thutep hohi na tahsan louham tin asei in ahi.
en: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”
text:
NUM 22:37
Thadou: Balak in Balaam thudoh aneitan keima heng nga gang tah a nahung na ding a thu ka hin nei hilou ham Ibol’a na hung louham ati. Keiman kipa man ka peh dia ka thutep hohi na tahsan louham tin asei in ahi.
English: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”

tcz: Balaam min a donbut in ven, keima vang ka hung tai ahinlah keiman bolthei imacha ka nei poi, keiman ka dei dei a jong ka seithei ahi poi, Pakai, Pathen in ka kam a eipeh bou ka kasei doh ding ahi bouve, ati.
en: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”
text:
NUM 22:38
Thadou: Balaam min a donbut in ven, keima vang ka hung tai ahinlah keiman bolthei imacha ka nei poi, keiman ka dei dei a jong ka seithei ahi poi, Pakai, Pathen in ka kam a eipeh bou ka kasei doh ding ahi bouve, ati.
English: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”

tcz: Hichun Balaam min Balak chu Kiriath Huzoth tigei aki lhon pin ahi.
en: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.
text:
NUM 22:39
Thadou: Hichun Balaam min Balak chu Kiriath Huzoth tigei aki lhon pin ahi.
English: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.

tcz: Hilai mun achun Balak lengpan abolngai jing bang in, kengoi le Bongchal ah pumgo thilto maicham aneiyin ahi. Balak in hiche Saphe tham khat chu Balaam toh alhonpi ho chu apen ahi.
en: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.
text:
NUM 22:40
Thadou: Hilai mun achun Balak lengpan abolngai jing bang in, kengoi le Bongchal ah pumgo thilto maicham aneiyin ahi. Balak in hiche Saphe tham khat chu Balaam toh alhonpi ho chu apen ahi.
English: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.

tcz: A jing jingkah chun Balak in Balaam chu Bamoth Baal molsang chung a apuidoh in, ahi, ajeh chu hilai mun apat na hi Israel mite vahle ho chu a umna apat kimu ahi.
en: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.
text:
NUM 22:41
Thadou: A jing jingkah chun Balak in Balaam chu Bamoth Baal molsang chung a apuidoh in, ahi, ajeh chu hilai mun apat na hi Israel mite vahle ho chu a umna apat kimu ahi.
English: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.

tcz: Chuin balaam’in jong Balak lengpa komma asei tan Pumgo thilto Maicham nato na ding mun-sagi nei bol peh tan chuleh bongchal sagi chule kelngoi chal sagi neigon tup peh tan ati.
en: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”
text:
NUM 23:1
Thadou: Chuin balaam’in jong Balak lengpa komma asei tan Pumgo thilto Maicham nato na ding mun-sagi nei bol peh tan chuleh bongchal sagi chule kelngoi chal sagi neigon tup peh tan ati.
English: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”

tcz: Balak in Balaam thupeh ho chu angaijin chu in achelhon tan, pumgo maicham asem lhon in bongchal nou ahin kelchal pumgo thil tona chunga akatdoh lhon tai.
en: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.
text:
NUM 23:2
Thadou: Balak in Balaam thupeh ho chu angaijin chu in achelhon tan, pumgo maicham asem lhon in bongchal nou ahin kelchal pumgo thil tona chunga akatdoh lhon tai.
English: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

tcz: Hichun Balaam min Balak komma hitin aseitan, hikom pumgo maicham kihal na ahin ana um ta din, keima Pathen in eiki hou lim pi hinam ti kaga kholchil ding, chuteng hiche ho chu nangma ka sei peh ding na hi ati. Hichun Balaam chu Molchung gei achangin akal tan ahi.
en: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.
text:
NUM 23:3
Thadou: Hichun Balaam min Balak komma hitin aseitan, hikom pumgo maicham kihal na ahin ana um ta din, keima Pathen in eiki hou lim pi hinam ti kaga kholchil ding, chuteng hiche ho chu nangma ka sei peh ding na hi ati. Hichun Balaam chu Molchung gei achangin akal tan ahi.
English: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.

tcz: Hilai achun Pathen in Balaam akimupin a sei pehtai, “Kei man Mai-cham sagi ka bol tai, chuleh bongchal nou khat cheh le kelngoi chal khat cheh ka lhandoh tai ati.
en: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”
text:
NUM 23:4
Thadou: Hilai achun Pathen in Balaam akimupin a sei pehtai, “Kei man Mai-cham sagi ka bol tai, chuleh bongchal nou khat cheh le kelngoi chal khat cheh ka lhandoh tai ati.
English: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”

tcz: Hichun Pathen in Balaam chu ahoulim pin Balak asei peh ding thu apen; Hijou chun Nangma nung che tan Balak heng lam ah hiche ka thu sei doh hohi sei peh tan, ati.
en: The LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”
text:
NUM 23:5
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in Balaam chu ahoulim pin Balak asei peh ding thu apen; Hijou chun Nangma nung che tan Balak heng lam ah hiche ka thu sei doh hohi sei peh tan, ati.
English: The LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”

tcz: Balaam chu a hung ki nung le tan ahi leh Balak lengpa chu Moab mi a milunho chu toh pumgo maicham lhan doh na muna ana ding kim tauve.
en: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.
text:
NUM 23:6
Thadou: Balaam chu a hung ki nung le tan ahi leh Balak lengpa chu Moab mi a milunho chu toh pumgo maicham lhan doh na muna ana ding kim tauve.
English: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

tcz: Ahinlah, Pakaiyin a gaosap lou ho chu keiman iti ka gaosap ding ham? Pathen in themmo achan louho chu iti themmo ka chan ding ham ati.
en: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom the LORD has not defied?
text:
NUM 23:8
Thadou: Ahinlah, Pakaiyin a gaosap lou ho chu keiman iti ka gaosap ding ham? Pathen in themmo achan louho chu iti themmo ka chan ding ham ati.
English: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom the LORD has not defied?

tcz: Keiman molchunga pat kaven, amaho chu molvum apat hin kamu soh kei uve. Hiteho hi chidang nam dang te akon lhenchom ahiu kamu doh e.
en: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.
text:
NUM 23:9
Thadou: Keiman molchunga pat kaven, amaho chu molvum apat hin kamu soh kei uve. Hiteho hi chidang nam dang te akon lhenchom ahiu kamu doh e.
English: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.

tcz: Koiham Israel chilhah ho simjou ding chu, simseng lou neldi ja ahiuve. Israel mite chu koima chan simjou lou ding ahi. Keijong hiche nam thengho bang in um inting, amaho thi bang in thileng kati.
en: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”
text:
NUM 23:10
Thadou: Koiham Israel chilhah ho simjou ding chu, simseng lou neldi ja ahiuve. Israel mite chu koima chan simjou lou ding ahi. Keijong hiche nam thengho bang in um inting, amaho thi bang in thileng kati.
English: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”

tcz: Hichun Balak Lengpan Balaam heng’a asei jin, Ipi neilo hitam? ka melma te gaosap dinga ka kou na hin ahinlah nang in Phatthei na boh jo tai ati
en: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”
text:
NUM 23:11
Thadou: Hichun Balak Lengpan Balaam heng’a asei jin, Ipi neilo hitam? ka melma te gaosap dinga ka kou na hin ahinlah nang in Phatthei na boh jo tai ati
English: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”

tcz: Ahinlah, Balaam chun a donbut in “Keiman vang Pathen in thu cheng ka lung thimma ei seipeh ho bou ka sei doh ding ahi bouve” ati.
en: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD puts in my mouth?”
text:
NUM 23:12
Thadou: Ahinlah, Balaam chun a donbut in “Keiman vang Pathen in thu cheng ka lung thimma ei seipeh ho bou ka sei doh ding ahi bouve” ati.
English: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD puts in my mouth?”

tcz: Hichun Balak Lengpan Balaam chu mun chomma akou kit in. Hilai’a khu nang in mi dang chi dang Israel nam chom khat aum in, amavang abonchauvin kati poi hiche a um ho beh khu nei gao sap peh in kati.
en: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”
text:
NUM 23:13
Thadou: Hichun Balak Lengpan Balaam chu mun chomma akou kit in. Hilai’a khu nang in mi dang chi dang Israel nam chom khat aum in, amavang abonchauvin kati poi hiche a um ho beh khu nei gao sap peh in kati.
English: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”

tcz: Balak chu Zophim kiti damchup aum Pisgah molchunga apui touvin Balaam in maicham phung-sagi a tung doh in hiche maicham phol chunga bongnou chal chuleh kelngoi khat chu akat doh tan ahi.
en: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
text:
NUM 23:14
Thadou: Balak chu Zophim kiti damchup aum Pisgah molchunga apui touvin Balaam in maicham phung-sagi a tung doh in hiche maicham phol chunga bongnou chal chuleh kelngoi khat chu akat doh tan ahi.
English: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

tcz: Balaam in jong Balak lengpa komma aseitan, nangma hikomma ana um ta din phat chomkhat keima kaga potdoh ding Pathen in ipi ei houlimpi ding ham keima Pathen toh kihou lim’a pot doh ding ka hi.
en: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”
text:
NUM 23:15
Thadou: Balaam in jong Balak lengpa komma aseitan, nangma hikomma ana um ta din phat chomkhat keima kaga potdoh ding Pathen in ipi ei houlimpi ding ham keima Pathen toh kihou lim’a pot doh ding ka hi.
English: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”

tcz: Chule Pakaiyin akimupin aki houlimpi tan, hichun Pathen in Balak komma che in lang hi tin ki houlimpi in a thuhet ho chu hetsah tan, ati.
en: The LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”
text:
NUM 23:16
Thadou: Chule Pakaiyin akimupin aki houlimpi tan, hichun Pathen in Balak komma che in lang hi tin ki houlimpi in a thuhet ho chu hetsah tan, ati.
English: The LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”

tcz: Balaam chu akinung le phat in Balak lampi ahin Moab mite hochu toh maicham phol muna chun thanom tah le ngahlal tah in ana um un ahi. Balak in a dongtan Pathen in epi nasei peh hitam tin a dong tan ahi.
en: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has the LORD spoken?”
text:
NUM 23:17
Thadou: Balaam chu akinung le phat in Balak lampi ahin Moab mite hochu toh maicham phol muna chun thanom tah le ngahlal tah in ana um un ahi. Balak in a dongtan Pathen in epi nasei peh hitam tin a dong tan ahi.
English: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has the LORD spoken?”

tcz: Balaam in hiche thuchih ho a sei dohtan, Zippor chapa Balak ka thusei hohi ngai tem in, Ki thoudoh tan, ati.
en: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.
text:
NUM 23:18
Thadou: Balaam in hiche thuchih ho a sei dohtan, Zippor chapa Balak ka thusei hohi ngai tem in, Ki thoudoh tan, ati.
English: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.

tcz: Pakai hi mihem ahilou jeh in jou asei poi, Pathen hi mihem ahi loujeh in lunggel akhel ngai poi, Pakai-Pathen nin ana phondoh ana sei doh aboltan atoh lou um kha tam? Pathen in ana kitepna atoh doh louna suhbulhit louna um kha tam? tin aseiye.
en: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?
text:
NUM 23:19
Thadou: Pakai hi mihem ahilou jeh in jou asei poi, Pathen hi mihem ahi loujeh in lunggel akhel ngai poi, Pakai-Pathen nin ana phondoh ana sei doh aboltan atoh lou um kha tam? Pathen in ana kitepna atoh doh louna suhbulhit louna um kha tam? tin aseiye.
English: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?

tcz: Ngaijun keiman Pathen holna ding in thupeh kamui, Pakai-Pathen in phatthei aboh sa chu koiman akham thei poi, ka nung lah doh thei poi, ati.
en: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.
text:
NUM 23:20
Thadou: Ngaijun keiman Pathen holna ding in thupeh kamui, Pakai-Pathen in phatthei aboh sa chu koiman akham thei poi, ka nung lah doh thei poi, ati.
English: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

tcz: Ama tohgon na a Jacob din manthah na imacha aum poi Israelte din lhaset na toh phalou imacha aum poi Pakaiyin ei umpi jing uvin Isreal a ana ki phut det ihi tauve.
en: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. The LORD his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.
text:
NUM 23:21
Thadou: Ama tohgon na a Jacob din manthah na imacha aum poi Israelte din lhaset na toh phalou imacha aum poi Pakaiyin ei umpi jing uvin Isreal a ana ki phut det ihi tauve.
English: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. The LORD his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.

tcz: Eygpt a konna Pakaiyin ahin pui doh u ahi tai Israelte ding a Pakai chu bongchal hang sen tah ahiye.
en: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.
text:
NUM 23:22
Thadou: Eygpt a konna Pakaiyin ahin pui doh u ahi tai Israelte ding a Pakai chu bongchal hang sen tah ahiye.
English: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

tcz: Sapset na in Jacob a sukhah lou beh ding, Isreal chung nga hile gam thahat kitah lang ding hi jong le, tuapat Jacob henga patna hiti a ka sei ding Pathen in Israel te din hitabang loupina abol ahi tai, ati.
en: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’
text:
NUM 23:23
Thadou: Sapset na in Jacob a sukhah lou beh ding, Isreal chung nga hile gam thahat kitah lang ding hi jong le, tuapat Jacob henga patna hiti a ka sei ding Pathen in Israel te din hitabang loupina abol ahi tai, ati.
English: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’

tcz: Veuvin mipi hochu keipi bang in ading doh un chule keipi bahkai bangtah in a ding doh tai, anneh ding an chah aval lhum masang nga kum lha lou ahi sa kitah thisan adon kahse a ding ahi, ati.
en: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”
text:
NUM 23:24
Thadou: Veuvin mipi hochu keipi bang in ading doh un chule keipi bahkai bangtah in a ding doh tai, anneh ding an chah aval lhum masang nga kum lha lou ahi sa kitah thisan adon kahse a ding ahi, ati.
English: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”

tcz: Hichun Balak lengpa chun Balaam henga asei tan aphai amahohi nagaosap lou ding ahitah leh phatthei jong boh dajeng tan, atileh;
en: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”

tcz: Ahin Balaam in Balak chu ahoulim pitan kana phondoh bangtah in Pakaiyin a phondoh hochu ka bol ding ka toh ding ahi kana ti ahi ajeh chu Balaam in thuphon dohna chu thumvei anei ahi.
en: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that the LORD speaks, that I must do’?”
text:
NUM 23:26
Thadou: Ahin Balaam in Balak chu ahoulim pitan kana phondoh bangtah in Pakaiyin a phondoh hochu ka bol ding ka toh ding ahi kana ti ahi ajeh chu Balaam in thuphon dohna chu thumvei anei ahi.
English: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that the LORD speaks, that I must do’?”

tcz: Chu in Balak in Balaam chu ahou lim pitan, lungset tah in neihin jui tan keiman nangma hi munchom’a kapui ding akhatna Pathen lunglam ahung hi thei leh Israel mite chu keima a ding a nei gaosap peh thei ahi.
en: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”
text:
NUM 23:27
Thadou: Chu in Balak in Balaam chu ahou lim pitan, lungset tah in neihin jui tan keiman nangma hi munchom’a kapui ding akhatna Pathen lunglam ahung hi thei leh Israel mite chu keima a ding a nei gaosap peh thei ahi.
English: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”

tcz: Balak in Balaam chu Peor molchung sang lam ah apui tou tan gam ong tamtah ahung kisuh vet na munah chun apuijin ahi.
en: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.
text:
NUM 23:28
Thadou: Balak in Balaam chu Peor molchung sang lam ah apui tou tan gam ong tamtah ahung kisuh vet na munah chun apuijin ahi.
English: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.

tcz: Balak in Balaam chu ahou lim pitan hikom ahin maicham phung sagi nei sempeh in chule bongnou chal sagi chule kelngoi achal sagi maicham kintheng adin nei gonpeh in, ati.
en: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”
text:
NUM 23:29
Thadou: Balak in Balaam chu ahou lim pitan hikom ahin maicham phung sagi nei sempeh in chule bongnou chal sagi chule kelngoi achal sagi maicham kintheng adin nei gonpeh in, ati.
English: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

tcz: Hichun Balak in Balaam dei dol tah le asei dung jui jin bongnou chal sagi maicham phol chunga akoi in chule kelngoi chal sagi umna maicham phol chunga ajam lhatan, ahi.
en: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
text:
NUM 23:30
Thadou: Hichun Balak in Balaam dei dol tah le asei dung jui jin bongnou chal sagi maicham phol chunga akoi in chule kelngoi chal sagi umna maicham phol chunga ajam lhatan, ahi.
English: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

tcz: Balaam Israel mite phatthei aboh leh Pathen a lunglhai chu ahet phat chun phat dang laiya bang’in doithu ho mangcha din aki go ta pon, gamthip lam agal vet e.
en: When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
text:
NUM 24:1
Thadou: Balaam Israel mite phatthei aboh leh Pathen a lunglhai chu ahet phat chun phat dang laiya bang’in doithu ho mangcha din aki go ta pon, gamthip lam agal vet e.
English: When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

tcz: Hitia Balaam a dadoh a avetpet chun Israel mite ama phung cheh a akigol u-chu amu tan chu in Pathen lhagao chu Balaam chung ah ahung chu tan ahi.
en: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.
text:
NUM 24:2
Thadou: Hitia Balaam a dadoh a avetpet chun Israel mite ama phung cheh a akigol u-chu amu tan chu in Pathen lhagao chu Balaam chung ah ahung chu tan ahi.
English: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.

tcz: Hichun Balaam in akam akehdoh in asei pan tai. Beor chapa Balaam in asei doh ho; kho kimusah pa thusei dohho;
en: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

tcz: Pathen thupeh awgin japa chun, hatchung-nung gaova muthei pa, Ama angsung a bohkhup a amit-ha let-sah pa:
en: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
text:
NUM 24:4
Thadou: Pathen thupeh awgin japa chun, hatchung-nung gaova muthei pa, Ama angsung a bohkhup a amit-ha let-sah pa:
English: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

tcz: Vo Jacob na ponbuh hohi iti hoiya hitam mo! O Israel na inpi ho lungset aum tangeije.
en: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!
text:
NUM 24:5
Thadou: Vo Jacob na ponbuh hohi iti hoiya hitam mo! O Israel na inpi ho lungset aum tangeije.
English: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!

tcz: Palm thingna hing dildel bang leh luipang a honlei kisem bang in a kijao-jahdeh jeng in; Pakaiyin a phudoh sa, Vadung pang’a keh Cedar phungho to abang jeng’e.
en: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.
text:
NUM 24:6
Thadou: Palm thingna hing dildel bang leh luipang a honlei kisem bang in a kijao-jahdeh jeng in; Pakaiyin a phudoh sa, Vadung pang’a keh Cedar phungho to abang jeng’e.
English: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.

tcz: A twibel akon twi hing hung putdoh intin; a chilhah hon angaichat jouse anei uve. A lengpa’u jong Agag sang in thupi jo in, a lenggam’u jong ki domsang ding ahi.
en: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.
text:
NUM 24:7
Thadou: A twibel akon twi hing hung putdoh intin; a chilhah hon angaichat jouse anei uve. A lengpa’u jong Agag sang in thupi jo in, a lenggam’u jong ki domsang ding ahi.
English: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

tcz: Pathen chun Eygpt a kon ahin pui doh ahi; Ama thahatna chu Gam-bong hangsan tah abangin, Amaho douvah nam jouse avallhum sohtan, agu achang jouseu asuh boh pih in, athalpi hattah chun a kap ji.
en: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.
text:
NUM 24:8
Thadou: Pathen chun Eygpt a kon ahin pui doh ahi; Ama thahatna chu Gam-bong hangsan tah abangin, Amaho douvah nam jouse avallhum sohtan, agu achang jouseu asuh boh pih in, athalpi hattah chun a kap ji.
English: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

tcz: Keipi bang chan Israel ten alonvuh un, alo tauve; Koiham amaho suthou ngam ding’a chu? Vo Israel nangma na phatthei ho chu ahampha uvin, Nangma na gaosap ho chu avangse ahiuve.
en: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”
text:
NUM 24:9
Thadou: Keipi bang chan Israel ten alonvuh un, alo tauve; Koiham amaho suthou ngam ding’a chu? Vo Israel nangma na phatthei ho chu ahampha uvin, Nangma na gaosap ho chu avangse ahiuve.
English: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”

tcz: Hichun Balak chu Balaam chunga hatah in alung hang tan Balak in Balaam khut teni chu a volhan chuin Balak in Balaam kom mah hitin asei tai, keiman ka melmate gaosap ding a kakou nahin nangman lolhing tah a thumvei phatthei naboh joh ahitai.
en: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.
text:
NUM 24:10
Thadou: Hichun Balak chu Balaam chunga hatah in alung hang tan Balak in Balaam khut teni chu a volhan chuin Balak in Balaam kom mah hitin asei tai, keiman ka melmate gaosap ding a kakou nahin nangman lolhing tah a thumvei phatthei naboh joh ahitai.
English: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

tcz: Tun nangma na gam lamah kinungle kit tan, keiman nangma hi loupi tah a jabol ding tia kana seidoh ahin, dih tah a sei ding in Pathen in thupitah a nachen na ding ah kon in na tum chondoh joh ahi tai.
en: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor.”
text:
NUM 24:11
Thadou: Tun nangma na gam lamah kinungle kit tan, keiman nangma hi loupi tah a jabol ding tia kana seidoh ahin, dih tah a sei ding in Pathen in thupitah a nachen na ding ah kon in na tum chondoh joh ahi tai.
English: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor.”

tcz: Hichu Balaam in Balak kom ah asei tan keiman a solchah pa komma ka na seipeh hita lou ham? Keima henga nahin solpa heng lamma chu, ati.
en: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,
text:
NUM 24:12
Thadou: Hichu Balaam in Balak kom ah asei tan keiman a solchah pa komma ka na seipeh hita lou ham? Keima henga nahin solpa heng lamma chu, ati.
English: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

tcz: Balaam chun aseiyin sana le dangka insung dimset eikipe jongle keima Pathen thupeh kalval ah ka che be theipoi ati thilpha bol ding chu kakin ahin, keima dei bang tah in ka chal thei poi. Pathen in ei houlimpi ho chu keiman ka sei doh ngai ahi.
en: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the LORD’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what the LORD says’?
text:
NUM 24:13
Thadou: Balaam chun aseiyin sana le dangka insung dimset eikipe jongle keima Pathen thupeh kalval ah ka che be theipoi ati thilpha bol ding chu kakin ahin, keima dei bang tah in ka chal thei poi. Pathen in ei houlimpi ho chu keiman ka sei doh ngai ahi.
English: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the LORD’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what the LORD says’?

tcz: Chule tua jong keima dihtah a sei ding ahileh kanam ka insung mite lah a che ding ka hitai, hung tan keiman ka sei peh nahi hiche mipi teho hin nangma mite nam lentah chunga ahin bol diu khonung teng Balaam in gaova thusei livei na chan chu hiding ahi.
en: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”
text:
NUM 24:14
Thadou: Chule tua jong keima dihtah a sei ding ahileh kanam ka insung mite lah a che ding ka hitai, hung tan keiman ka sei peh nahi hiche mipi teho hin nangma mite nam lentah chunga ahin bol diu khonung teng Balaam in gaova thusei livei na chan chu hiding ahi.
English: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

tcz: Hichun Balak hin athu lhun bu chu aki lah in hitin asei tan, Balaam chapan hitin a seije pasal koi tabang khovah muthei hon hitin aseiye, ati.
en: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

tcz: Balak in hitin aseijin Pathen thu chu aja tauvin chungnung penna thujong aja tauvin ahi. Chungnung penna gaothu mitphel in ahung lhung tan ahin amit chun kho amutan ahi.
en: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
text:
NUM 24:16
Thadou: Balak in hitin aseijin Pathen thu chu aja tauvin chungnung penna thujong aja tauvin ahi. Chungnung penna gaothu mitphel in ahung lhung tan ahin amit chun kho amutan ahi.
English: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

tcz: Ama chu ka ven hinlah ka mu theipoi, amavang Jacob apatna valpa khang hung doh ding ahi. Israel la patna tenggol khat hunngpeng doh ding chule Moab te aning keh ajep chip ding Tumelt chate asuh gam ding ahiye.
en: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.
text:
NUM 24:17
Thadou: Ama chu ka ven hinlah ka mu theipoi, amavang Jacob apatna valpa khang hung doh ding ahi. Israel la patna tenggol khat hunngpeng doh ding chule Moab te aning keh ajep chip ding Tumelt chate asuh gam ding ahiye.
English: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.

tcz: Sedom jong toupha a um ding Seir doupa jong toupha a umding ahi. Amavang Israel chu thahat cheh ding ahi.
en: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.
text:
NUM 24:18
Thadou: Sedom jong toupha a um ding Seir doupa jong toupha a umding ahi. Amavang Israel chu thahat cheh ding ahi.
English: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

tcz: Jacob a patna hung ding jahda chun thaneina anei tah ding hiche khopi a amapa umjing nalaipa chu suhgam’a um ding ahiye.
en: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”
text:
NUM 24:19
Thadou: Jacob a patna hung ding jahda chun thaneina anei tah ding hiche khopi a amapa umjing nalaipa chu suhgam’a um ding ahiye.
English: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”

tcz: Chuin Balak in Amalekte techu aven Amalekte mite chu nam lah a amasa loi pentah ahin, amahi athini geiya anu khah penna pang ding ahi.
en: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”
text:
NUM 24:20
Thadou: Chuin Balak in Amalekte techu aven Amalekte mite chu nam lah a amasa loi pentah ahin, amahi athini geiya anu khah penna pang ding ahi.
English: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”

tcz: Chuin Balak in Mitbah Oraeh chu aki lah kit tan chu in hitin asei tai nangma pansat nahi ada tangeiye ati.
en: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.
text:
NUM 24:21
Thadou: Chuin Balak in Mitbah Oraeh chu aki lah kit tan chu in hitin asei tai nangma pansat nahi ada tangeiye ati.
English: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

tcz: Nangma Cannan mite jong suhmanga na um ding Asshur ten soh changa nangma na koi ding ahi.
en: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”
text:
NUM 24:22
Thadou: Nangma Cannan mite jong suhmanga na um ding Asshur ten soh changa nangma na koi ding ahi.
English: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”

tcz: Hichun Balak in gaova aseitan, Oh hitobang tah a hi Pathen in na atoh le koi cheng jou ding hinam?
en: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?
text:
NUM 24:23
Thadou: Hichun Balak in gaova aseitan, Oh hitobang tah a hi Pathen in na atoh le koi cheng jou ding hinam?
English: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?

tcz: Chuin twikong ahung kipat doh tan amaho chun Assyria mite chule Eber chu ahopa uvin, amaho jong chu suhmang a um ding ahiuve, ati.
en: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”
text:
NUM 24:24
Thadou: Chuin twikong ahung kipat doh tan amaho chun Assyria mite chule Eber chu ahopa uvin, amaho jong chu suhmang a um ding ahiuve, ati.
English: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”

tcz: chujouvin Balaam in adalhan a inlamma akiletan, chuleh Balak jong achi nading lampi ah achitan ahi.
en: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.
text:
NUM 24:25
Thadou: chujouvin Balaam in adalhan a inlamma akiletan, chuleh Balak jong achi nading lampi ah achitan ahi.
English: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

tcz: Israel mite chu Acacia Grove mun’a aum laitah uchun Pasal chengse Moab mite numeiho toh ajong tauve.
en: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;

tcz: Hiche Moab numei techun a Pathen kom uvah kilhan doh din atem uvin ahi. Israel mite chun akilhan na thilho’u chu ane uvin hiche a pathen angsung uvah jong abohkhup tauve.
en: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.
text:
NUM 25:2
Thadou: Hiche Moab numei techun a Pathen kom uvah kilhan doh din atem uvin ahi. Israel mite chun akilhan na thilho’u chu ane uvin hiche a pathen angsung uvah jong abohkhup tauve.
English: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.

tcz: Hiti pichun Israel miten Baal-Peor kiti ahou uchu ajop tauvin; Pathen lunghan na chu ahung deu jah jeng tai.
en: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and the LORD’s anger burned against Israel.
text:
NUM 25:3
Thadou: Hiti pichun Israel miten Baal-Peor kiti ahou uchu ajop tauvin; Pathen lunghan na chu ahung deu jah jeng tai.
English: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and the LORD’s anger burned against Israel.

tcz: Pathen in Mose chu a houlimpin hiche mite lamkai hohi kou khom un Pathen masang ah; sunkim laitah leh amaho hinkhom in alamkai na’u lahdoh pehtan, hiche jeh achu Israel mite chunga Pathen lunghanna aki chon mang thei na ding in, ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to the LORD before the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel.”
text:
NUM 25:4
Thadou: Pathen in Mose chu a houlimpin hiche mite lamkai hohi kou khom un Pathen masang ah; sunkim laitah leh amaho hinkhom in alamkai na’u lahdoh pehtan, hiche jeh achu Israel mite chunga Pathen lunghanna aki chon mang thei na ding in, ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to the LORD before the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel.”

tcz: Hichun Mose’n Israelte Thutan lamkai ho thu atan tai: Nang hon namite lah uva koi hitajong leh Baal-Peor hou nungjui jouse na thadoh diu ahi ati.
en: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”
text:
NUM 25:5
Thadou: Hichun Mose’n Israelte Thutan lamkai ho thu atan tai: Nang hon namite lah uva koi hitajong leh Baal-Peor hou nungjui jouse na thadoh diu ahi ati.
English: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”

tcz: Hichun Israel mi khat nin Ama insung mite masanga Midian numei khat Mose masang laitah achun ahin puilut’e; Hichu Israel mipite chu houbuh masanga kap le maova aum lai tah u ahiye.
en: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
NUM 25:6
Thadou: Hichun Israel mi khat nin Ama insung mite masanga Midian numei khat Mose masang laitah achun ahin puilut’e; Hichu Israel mipite chu houbuh masanga kap le maova aum lai tah u ahiye.
English: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Chuin Phinehas kiti Eleazer chapa Aaron thempu pa tupa chun amu phat in, Israel mipi kikhopna chu a dalhan, achom doh phut in, a khutna tengcha a kichoi jin ahi.
en: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.
text:
NUM 25:7
Thadou: Chuin Phinehas kiti Eleazer chapa Aaron thempu pa tupa chun amu phat in, Israel mipi kikhopna chu a dalhan, achom doh phut in, a khutna tengcha a kichoi jin ahi.
English: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.

tcz: Apon buh sunggei ajui lut in, A tengpi hin choi chun Pasal pa tahsa leh numeinu oipoh chu asun peijin akilbeh tha jeng tai. Hiche jeh chun Israel mite chunga gotna Hise lang chu atang hel tai.
en: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.
text:
NUM 25:8
Thadou: Apon buh sunggei ajui lut in, A tengpi hin choi chun Pasal pa tahsa leh numeinu oipoh chu asun peijin akilbeh tha jeng tai. Hiche jeh chun Israel mite chunga gotna Hise lang chu atang hel tai.
English: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.

tcz: Pul’a thi mi jat mong mong chu sang-somni le sangli ahi.
en: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.
text:
NUM 25:9
Thadou: Pul’a thi mi jat mong mong chu sang-somni le sangli ahi.
English: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin thu aseiyin ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 25:10
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin thu aseiyin ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Eleazer chapa Phenahas kiti Aaron thempu tupa ama tah hin Israel chate chunga ka lung hanna jouse eisuh mang peh’a; ei kipasah ahitai. Ajeh chu amapa hi keima dinga thangtom tah leh gunchu tah in apang in, hiche ho jeh a chu Israel chate ka suh mang lou ding ahi tai, tin a seije.
en: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.
text:
NUM 25:11
Thadou: Eleazer chapa Phenahas kiti Aaron thempu tupa ama tah hin Israel chate chunga ka lung hanna jouse eisuh mang peh’a; ei kipasah ahitai. Ajeh chu amapa hi keima dinga thangtom tah leh gunchu tah in apang in, hiche ho jeh a chu Israel chate ka suh mang lou ding ahi tai, tin a seije.
English: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

tcz: Tun ama ga seipeh un; Israel te chungah Cham le lungmon anei tah diuvin kitepna kabol e.
en: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.
text:
NUM 25:12
Thadou: Tun ama ga seipeh un; Israel te chungah Cham le lungmon anei tah diuvin kitepna kabol e.
English: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.

tcz: Ka kitepna ahin keiman Ama ahin Ama chilhah ho chunga atonsot na thempu phunga ka semdoh ding ahi ajeh chu Phenehas chu a Pathen ding’a thang tom tah a pang ahi tan Israel chate ding a ki suhtheng na maicham sem dohpa kiti ding ahi tai.
en: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”
text:
NUM 25:13
Thadou: Ka kitepna ahin keiman Ama ahin Ama chilhah ho chunga atonsot na thempu phunga ka semdoh ding ahi ajeh chu Phenehas chu a Pathen ding’a thang tom tah a pang ahi tan Israel chate ding a ki suhtheng na maicham sem dohpa kiti ding ahi tai.
English: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

tcz: Midian numei toh thi khom pasal pa min chu Zimri ahin, Salu chapa ahin Simeon phung lamkai pa chilhah ho ahi.
en: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.
text:
NUM 25:14
Thadou: Midian numei toh thi khom pasal pa min chu Zimri ahin, Salu chapa ahin Simeon phung lamkai pa chilhah ho ahi.
English: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

tcz: Chuleh Midian numei thina toh chu ahi leh Cozbi akitin Zur chanu ahin Zur chu ahile Midian te insung phung lamkai ahi.
en: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.
text:
NUM 25:15
Thadou: Chuleh Midian numei thina toh chu ahi leh Cozbi akitin Zur chanu ahin Zur chu ahile Midian te insung phung lamkai ahi.
English: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.

tcz: Chuin PakaiyinMose henga thu hiti hin aseiyin ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 25:16
Thadou: Chuin PakaiyinMose henga thu hiti hin aseiyin ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Midian mite chu sugimtan chule amaho chunga gimna nalhunsah ding ahi, ati.
en: “Harass the Midianites, and strike them;

tcz: Ajeh chu Moab mite in na suhgam thei’u ahin Peor Baal kimanchah na dung juiya Cozbi thua jong nabol sahtan, Midian te lamkai pa chanu jong chu pulla thi lo ahitai. Ijeh nam itileh Peor Baar jeh a hichu lhung ahiye.
en: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”
text:
NUM 25:18
Thadou: Ajeh chu Moab mite in na suhgam thei’u ahin Peor Baal kimanchah na dung juiya Cozbi thua jong nabol sahtan, Midian te lamkai pa chanu jong chu pulla thi lo ahitai. Ijeh nam itileh Peor Baar jeh a hichu lhung ahiye.
English: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”

tcz: Gamna hoiset naphat aki chai tan Pakaiyin Mose ahin Eleazer kiti Aaron thempupa chapa koma hitin asei tan ahi,
en: After the plague, the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
text:
NUM 26:1
Thadou: Gamna hoiset naphat aki chai tan Pakaiyin Mose ahin Eleazer kiti Aaron thempupa chapa koma hitin asei tan ahi,
English: After the plague, the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

tcz: “Israel chate minlahna neijun kum somnia pat chunglam jouse apa insung a konna hiding amaho chengse chu galsat ding ahiuve.”
en: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”
text:
NUM 26:2
Thadou: “Israel chate minlahna neijun kum somnia pat chunglam jouse apa insung a konna hiding amaho chengse chu galsat ding ahiuve.”
English: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”

tcz: Chu in Mose le Aaron chapa Eleazer thempu pa’n hiti hin aseijin Moab tolpi laiya Jordan kom ah Jericho gal lang a aum laitah un, Israel lamkai ho hengah hiti hin aseijin ahi:
en: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
text:
NUM 26:3
Thadou: Chu in Mose le Aaron chapa Eleazer thempu pa’n hiti hin aseijin Moab tolpi laiya Jordan kom ah Jericho gal lang a aum laitah un, Israel lamkai ho hengah hiti hin aseijin ahi:
English: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose le Israel mite Eygpt ma konna ahung doh uva patna thupih dungjuiya kum som nia pat chunglam min jihlutna neiyun ati bang tah chun abol tauvin ahi.
en: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those who came out of the land of Egypt.
text:
NUM 26:4
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose le Israel mite Eygpt ma konna ahung doh uva patna thupih dungjuiya kum som nia pat chunglam min jihlutna neiyun ati bang tah chun abol tauvin ahi.
English: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those who came out of the land of Egypt.

tcz: Israel chapa Reuben chate hochu Hanoch ahin, Hanoch chate ho jouse hung kondoh nau apabullu chu ahiye.
en: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

tcz: Hezron mite ho hi Hezron a hungkon doh ahiuvin chule Carmite jonghi Carmi a hung peng ahiuve.
en: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
text:
NUM 26:6
Thadou: Hezron mite ho hi Hezron a hungkon doh ahiuvin chule Carmite jonghi Carmi a hung peng ahiuve.
English: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

tcz: Reuben insung mite jat chu sangsomli le sangthum toh jasagi le somthum ahiuve.
en: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
text:
NUM 26:7
Thadou: Reuben insung mite jat chu sangsomli le sangthum toh jasagi le somthum ahiuve.
English: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

tcz: Pallu chu Eliab te hungkon doh na ahi,
en: The son of Pallu: Eliab.
text:
NUM 26:8
Thadou: Pallu chu Eliab te hungkon doh na ahi,
English: The son of Pallu: Eliab.

tcz: Eliab chate thum Dathan,Abiram, chule Nemuel amaho cheng hi nampi phungpi lah a afel pentah hochu ahiuvin chule Dathan le Abiram hi Korah toh kiloikhom uva Mose le Aaron ana doudal’uva, Pakai jeng jong nahsah louva anadoudal u ahi.
en: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against the LORD;

tcz: Chuin gamthip leiset chu meiyin ahin katan amaho jouse chu Korah toh abonchavin phung lamkai nam lamkai jouse aval lhum in athitauvin ahi. Hiche meikong in ahalvam chu mi jani le somnga ahiuvin amaho chu muthei melchih in aum tauve.
en: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.
text:
NUM 26:10
Thadou: Chuin gamthip leiset chu meiyin ahin katan amaho jouse chu Korah toh abonchavin phung lamkai nam lamkai jouse aval lhum in athitauvin ahi. Hiche meikong in ahalvam chu mi jani le somnga ahiuvin amaho chu muthei melchih in aum tauve.
English: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

tcz: Ahinlah, hiche nikho chun Korah chate chu anathi pou vin ahi.
en: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.
text:
NUM 26:11
Thadou: Ahinlah, hiche nikho chun Korah chate chu anathi pou vin ahi.
English: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.

tcz: Simeon chapate ho aphung min dung jui a Nemuel akihi sah in Nemuel te chilhah ho vang Jamin ahiuvin, Jamin chilhah hochu Jachin ahi uve, Jachin chilhah hochu Jachin te tin akihe.
en: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

tcz: Zera chilhah techu Zera tin akihen Zelha chilhah techu Shaul akiti uvi, amaho chu Shual te chilhah akitiuvin ahi.
en: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
text:
NUM 26:13
Thadou: Zera chilhah techu Zera tin akihen Zelha chilhah techu Shaul akiti uvi, amaho chu Shual te chilhah akitiuvin ahi.
English: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

tcz: Amaho jouse hi Simeon chilhah te ahiuvin agomma sangsom ni le sang ni toh jani ahiuve.
en: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
text:
NUM 26:14
Thadou: Amaho jouse hi Simeon chilhah te ahiuvin agomma sangsom ni le sang ni toh jani ahiuve.
English: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

tcz: Gad chilhah te phung dungjui in-Zephonte akiti uvin Zephonte a kon chu Haggi ahiuvin, Haggi te chilhah apat na Shuni hung pengdoh a Shuni mite hung kitiuva ahiye.
en: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

tcz: Ozni phungmi a konna chu Ozni mite hung kondoh ahiuvin Eri a konna chu Eri insung mite hung kon ahiuve.
en: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

tcz: Arod mite a konna phung mite jouse hung kondoh ahiuve, Areli a konna Areli mite hung kondoh ahiuve.
en: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
text:
NUM 26:17
Thadou: Arod mite a konna phung mite jouse hung kondoh ahiuve, Areli a konna Areli mite hung kondoh ahiuve.
English: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

tcz: Amaho jouse Gad-insung phung mite jouse chu amijat mong mong sangsom li le sangnga ahiuve.
en: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
text:
NUM 26:18
Thadou: Amaho jouse Gad-insung phung mite jouse chu amijat mong mong sangsom li le sangnga ahiuve.
English: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

tcz: Juda in chapa ni anei in, Er le Onan ahilhon in chuleh amani hi Canaan gam aumlai uva anathi lhon ahitai.
en: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
text:
NUM 26:19
Thadou: Juda in chapa ni anei in, Er le Onan ahilhon in chuleh amani hi Canaan gam aumlai uva anathi lhon ahitai.
English: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

tcz: Amaho phung dungjuiya Shela akiti uvin Shela chilhah akon Perez a konna Pera mite akitiuvin, Zera mite hi Zerah chilhah a konna hung kon doh ahi uvin ahi.
en: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.
text:
NUM 26:20
Thadou: Amaho phung dungjuiya Shela akiti uvin Shela chilhah akon Perez a konna Pera mite akitiuvin, Zera mite hi Zerah chilhah a konna hung kon doh ahi uvin ahi.
English: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

tcz: Chule Perez chilhah te hochu Hezron akiti uvin chule Hamul akon nin Hamut te chilhah ahung kondoh uvin ahi.
en: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
text:
NUM 26:21
Thadou: Chule Perez chilhah te hochu Hezron akiti uvin chule Hamul akon nin Hamut te chilhah ahung kondoh uvin ahi.
English: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

tcz: Hiche hohi Judate chilhah ho insung dungjuiya mijat chu sangsom sagi le gup toh janga ahiuve.
en: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.
text:
NUM 26:22
Thadou: Hiche hohi Judate chilhah ho insung dungjuiya mijat chu sangsom sagi le gup toh janga ahiuve.
English: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

tcz: Issachar te chilhah ho insung dungjui ja Tol'a akiti uvin Tol'a te a konna chu Puah ahung hiuvin hiche a konna chu Puah phungmi hungsoh doh ahiuve.
en: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

tcz: Jashub a konna Jashub insung mite chilhah ho a hung kondoh un Shimron a konna Shimron chilhah te hung kon doh ahiuve.
en: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
text:
NUM 26:24
Thadou: Jashub a konna Jashub insung mite chilhah ho a hung kondoh un Shimron a konna Shimron chilhah te hung kon doh ahiuve.
English: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

tcz: Amaho hi Issachar chilhah ho ahiuvin amaho jouse abonchauvin mijat sangsom guple sangli le jathum ahi.
en: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.
text:
NUM 26:25
Thadou: Amaho hi Issachar chilhah ho ahiuvin amaho jouse abonchauvin mijat sangsom guple sangli le jathum ahi.
English: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

tcz: Zebulun insung mi chilhah hohi Sered ahiuvin Sared te akon in Elonite insung mi ahung doh’un chule Jahleel a konna Jahleel insung mite ahung kondoh un ahi.
en: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
text:
NUM 26:26
Thadou: Zebulun insung mi chilhah hohi Sered ahiuvin Sared te akon in Elonite insung mi ahung doh’un chule Jahleel a konna Jahleel insung mite ahung kondoh un ahi.
English: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

tcz: Amaho jouse hi Zebelun insung mite ahiuvin amaho jouse mijat abonchauvin sangsom gup le janga ahiuve.
en: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.
text:
NUM 26:27
Thadou: Amaho jouse hi Zebelun insung mite ahiuvin amaho jouse mijat abonchauvin sangsom gup le janga ahiuve.
English: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

tcz: Joseph chilhah ho Manasseh le Ephraim a konna chateho ahiuve.
en: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
text:
NUM 26:28
Thadou: Joseph chilhah ho Manasseh le Ephraim a konna chateho ahiuve.
English: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

tcz: Manasseh chilhah ho-Makir chilhah ho Makir in Gilead ahing in Gilead apatna Gilead insung mite chilhah ho hung pengdoh ahiuve.
en: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
text:
NUM 26:29
Thadou: Manasseh chilhah ho-Makir chilhah ho Makir in Gilead ahing in Gilead apatna Gilead insung mite chilhah ho hung pengdoh ahiuve.
English: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

tcz: Gilead chate son le pah ho chu Iezer mite hungdoh ahiuvin chule Helek a konna Helek mite chilhah ho hung pengdoh ahiuve.
en: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

tcz: Asriel apatna Asriel son le pah ho hung pengdoh ahiuvin Shechem mi apatna shechem chilahah hung kondoh ahiuve.
en: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

tcz: Shemida apatna Shemida mite hung kondoh ahiuvin Hepher a patna Hepher mite son le pah hung kondoh ahiuve.
en: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
text:
NUM 26:32
Thadou: Shemida apatna Shemida mite hung kondoh ahiuvin Hepher a patna Hepher mite son le pah hung kondoh ahiuve.
English: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

tcz: Tua hin Hepher’s chapa Zelophehad nin chapa khat jong anei tapon, ahinlah Zelophehad nin vang chanu ahing tan amaho chu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah chule Tirzah ahiuve.
en: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
text:
NUM 26:33
Thadou: Tua hin Hepher’s chapa Zelophehad nin chapa khat jong anei tapon, ahinlah Zelophehad nin vang chanu ahing tan amaho chu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah chule Tirzah ahiuve.
English: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

tcz: Manasseh insung mi son le pah chilhah mijat chu sangsomnga le sangni toh jasagi jen ahiuve.
en: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
text:
NUM 26:34
Thadou: Manasseh insung mi son le pah chilhah mijat chu sangsomnga le sangni toh jasagi jen ahiuve.
English: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

tcz: Ephraim chate hochu ahiuvin ahi: Shuthelah chilhah hohi nam min a konna hung potdohu ahin Beker chilhah ho jong Beker a kon ahin Tahan chilhah son le pah ho jong Tahan na hung kondoh Ephraim, Shuthelah, Beker ahiuve.
en: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
text:
NUM 26:35
Thadou: Ephraim chate hochu ahiuvin ahi: Shuthelah chilhah hohi nam min a konna hung potdohu ahin Beker chilhah ho jong Beker a kon ahin Tahan chilhah son le pah ho jong Tahan na hung kondoh Ephraim, Shuthelah, Beker ahiuve.
English: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

tcz: Shuthelah son le pah amaho hi ahiuve, Eran chilhah a konna Eran mite hung kondoh u ahiye.
en: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
text:
NUM 26:36
Thadou: Shuthelah son le pah amaho hi ahiuve, Eran chilhah a konna Eran mite hung kondoh u ahiye.
English: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

tcz: Ephraim chate chilhah hi amaho jouse hi ahiuvin, amaho jouse abonchauvin mijat sangsom thumleni toh janga ahiuve.
en: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
text:
NUM 26:37
Thadou: Ephraim chate chilhah hi amaho jouse hi ahiuvin, amaho jouse abonchauvin mijat sangsom thumleni toh janga ahiuve.
English: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

tcz: Benjamin chate hi Bela a konna Bela mi ahung kon doh un, Ashbel la konna Ashbel insung mite ahung doh in Ahiram ma konna Ahiram son le pah chilhah te hung peng doh u ahi.
en: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

tcz: Shupham ma kon in Shupham insung mite hojouse ahung kon doh un Hupham a konna Hupham mite hung kondoh ahi.
en: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
text:
NUM 26:39
Thadou: Shupham ma kon in Shupham insung mite hojouse ahung kon doh un Hupham a konna Hupham mite hung kondoh ahi.
English: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

tcz: Chule Bela chate hi Ard le Naaman ahin Ard na konna chu Ard insung mite jouse hung kondoh a Chule Naaman a konna Naaman mite hung kon doh ahiuve.
en: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
text:
NUM 26:40
Thadou: Chule Bela chate hi Ard le Naaman ahin Ard na konna chu Ard insung mite jouse hung kondoh a Chule Naaman a konna Naaman mite hung kon doh ahiuve.
English: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

tcz: Benjamin chilhah a konna hung peng doh jouse hi sangsomli le sangnga le jagup ahiuve.
en: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
text:
NUM 26:41
Thadou: Benjamin chilhah a konna hung peng doh jouse hi sangsomli le sangnga le jagup ahiuve.
English: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

tcz: Dan insung phung mite ahiuve Shubam ma konna Shubam chilhah te jouse hung peng doh ahin amaho jouse hi Dan insung chilhah ahiuve.
en: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
text:
NUM 26:42
Thadou: Dan insung phung mite ahiuve Shubam ma konna Shubam chilhah te jouse hung peng doh ahin amaho jouse hi Dan insung chilhah ahiuve.
English: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

tcz: Shubam mite jouse chu insung mite chilhah jouse abonchauvin sangsomgup le sangli le jali ahiuve.
en: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
text:
NUM 26:43
Thadou: Shubam mite jouse chu insung mite chilhah jouse abonchauvin sangsomgup le sangli le jali ahiuve.
English: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

tcz: Asher chilhah amaho jouse hi ahiuvin Jimna chilhah te ahung peng lhauvin, Jesuit chilhah a kon in Jesui son le pah ho ahung penglha un chule Beriah te chilhah a apat nin Beriit te son le pah ho ahiuve.
en: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.
text:
NUM 26:44
Thadou: Asher chilhah amaho jouse hi ahiuvin Jimna chilhah te ahung peng lhauvin, Jesuit chilhah a kon in Jesui son le pah ho ahung penglha un chule Beriah te chilhah a apat nin Beriit te son le pah ho ahiuve.
English: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

tcz: Beriah te chilhah akon Heber ahung pengtan Heber a kon in Heber son le pah ho ahung peng’un ahi.
en: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
text:
NUM 26:45
Thadou: Beriah te chilhah akon Heber ahung pengtan Heber a kon in Heber son le pah ho ahung peng’un ahi.
English: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

tcz: Asher chanu chu Serah ahi.
en: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
text:
NUM 26:46
Thadou: Asher chanu chu Serah ahi.
English: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

tcz: Hiche hohi Asher insung mi chilhah hochu ahiuvin amijat u chu sangsomnga le thumle jali aiuve.
en: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.
text:
NUM 26:47
Thadou: Hiche hohi Asher insung mi chilhah hochu ahiuvin amijat u chu sangsomnga le thumle jali aiuve.
English: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

tcz: Naphtali insung mite a konna hung kondoh chu Jahzeel, Jahzeel chilhah ho ahung pengdoh un chule Guni apat nin Guni son le pah ho ahung peng un ahi.
en: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

tcz: Jezer a patnin Jezer mite ahung pengdoh un, Shillem ma pat nin Shillem chilhah hochu ahung pengdoh un ahi.
en: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
text:
NUM 26:49
Thadou: Jezer a patnin Jezer mite ahung pengdoh un, Shillem ma pat nin Shillem chilhah hochu ahung pengdoh un ahi.
English: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

tcz: Hiche mipi jouse hi Naphtali son le pah chilhah jouse ahiuvin, abonchauvin mijat sangsomli le sangnga le jali ahiuve.
en: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
text:
NUM 26:50
Thadou: Hiche mipi jouse hi Naphtali son le pah chilhah jouse ahiuvin, abonchauvin mijat sangsomli le sangnga le jali ahiuve.
English: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

tcz: Hicheho jouse hi Isreal mite jat ahiuve, abonchauva sangsom gup le khat le jasagi le somthum le ko ahiuve.
