en: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
text:
NUM 26:51
Thadou: Hicheho jouse hi Isreal mite jat ahiuve, abonchauva sangsom gup le khat le jasagi le somthum le ko ahiuve.
English: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

tcz: Chuin PakaiyinMose henga hiti hin aseiyin,
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 26:52
Thadou: Chuin PakaiyinMose henga hiti hin aseiyin,
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Hiche gam leiset hi hoppih tan, aphungdung jui, Anam dungjui chuleh amijat kijihlut dungjui in.
en: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
text:
NUM 26:53
Thadou: Hiche gam leiset hi hoppih tan, aphungdung jui, Anam dungjui chuleh amijat kijihlut dungjui in.
English: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

tcz: Phung tam mitam hochu atam dungjui ja nei le gou achanvou uchu natam peh ding chule phung lhom diu hochu chanvou alhom jep napeh ding ahi amaho jouse achanvou uhi achandiu lom cheh a na peh angaiye.
en: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.
text:
NUM 26:54
Thadou: Phung tam mitam hochu atam dungjui ja nei le gou achanvou uchu natam peh ding chule phung lhom diu hochu chanvou alhom jep napeh ding ahi amaho jouse achanvou uhi achandiu lom cheh a na peh angaiye.
English: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.

tcz: Ahin lah gam le leiset ho ama ama vang dungjuiya kihom ding ahiuve, ama ama hungkondoh na phung min dungjui ja kihom khan cheh ding ahi.
en: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
text:
NUM 26:55
Thadou: Ahin lah gam le leiset ho ama ama vang dungjuiya kihom ding ahiuve, ama ama hungkondoh na phung min dungjui ja kihom khan cheh ding ahi.
English: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

tcz: Hitia chu vang kisan dungjui a atam leh alhom a gam chu kihom ding’u ahi.
en: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”
text:
NUM 26:56
Thadou: Hitia chu vang kisan dungjui a atam leh alhom a gam chu kihom ding’u ahi.
English: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

tcz: Amahohi aphung dungjuija Levite insung mite ahiuvin; Gershon insung mite chu, amaho chu Gershon son le pah kiti diu, Kohath a konna chu Kohath chilhah kiti diu chule Merari a konna hungpot doh ho chu Merari chilhah hi diu ahi.
en: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
text:
NUM 26:57
Thadou: Amahohi aphung dungjuija Levite insung mite ahiuvin; Gershon insung mite chu, amaho chu Gershon son le pah kiti diu, Kohath a konna chu Kohath chilhah kiti diu chule Merari a konna hungpot doh ho chu Merari chilhah hi diu ahi.
English: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

tcz: amahohi Levite insung mite ahiuvin Libnite kiti diu ahi. Amaho hi Hebron insung mite kiti diu, Amaho chu Mahlite chilhah kiti ding, Mushites insung mite kiti ding, Korath te insung mite kiti diu chule Korath kitipa hin Amram ahing in ahi.
en: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
text:
NUM 26:58
Thadou: amahohi Levite insung mite ahiuvin Libnite kiti diu ahi. Amaho hi Hebron insung mite kiti diu, Amaho chu Mahlite chilhah kiti ding, Mushites insung mite kiti ding, Korath te insung mite kiti diu chule Korath kitipa hin Amram ahing in ahi.
English: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

tcz: Jochebed hi Amram inneipu ahin Levite chanu Eygpt ma Levi insunga peng ahin, Jochebed chate ho chu Aaron le Mose chule asopi nu lhon Miriam toh ahiuve.
en: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
text:
NUM 26:59
Thadou: Jochebed hi Amram inneipu ahin Levite chanu Eygpt ma Levi insunga peng ahin, Jochebed chate ho chu Aaron le Mose chule asopi nu lhon Miriam toh ahiuve.
English: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

tcz: Aaron chate hochu Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar chule Ithamar ahiuve.
en: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
text:
NUM 26:60
Thadou: Aaron chate hochu Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar chule Ithamar ahiuve.
English: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

tcz: Chule Nabad le Abihun Pathen meikong thupih phallou a ahal lhon jeh in athi lhon tai.
en: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
text:
NUM 26:61
Thadou: Chule Nabad le Abihun Pathen meikong thupih phallou a ahal lhon jeh in athi lhon tai.
English: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD.

tcz: Tuhin amaho Levite jouse pasal chapang lhakhat apet chunglam jouse sangsomni le sangthum jen chu Israel midang hotoh kisim tha lou ahiuve. Ajeh chu Isreal te lah achu amaho neile gou kisim thalou ahi.
en: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
text:
NUM 26:62
Thadou: Tuhin amaho Levite jouse pasal chapang lhakhat apet chunglam jouse sangsomni le sangthum jen chu Israel midang hotoh kisim tha lou ahiuve. Ajeh chu Isreal te lah achu amaho neile gou kisim thalou ahi.
English: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

tcz: Israel miho chu Moab gam a Jordan gallam mah Jericho pang lah a Mose le Aaron Thempupa in mi jat asim doh lhen doh hochu ahiuve.
en: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
text:
NUM 26:63
Thadou: Israel miho chu Moab gam a Jordan gallam mah Jericho pang lah a Mose le Aaron Thempupa in mi jat asim doh lhen doh hochu ahiuve.
English: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

tcz: Sinai molchunga Mose le Aaron thempu pan Israelte ana sim hin amaho jouse hi kasim thalou ahitai, ajeh chu amaho hi cannan gamma khoiju le bongnoi lon nagam lut lou diu ahitai.
en: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
text:
NUM 26:64
Thadou: Sinai molchunga Mose le Aaron thempu pan Israelte ana sim hin amaho jouse hi kasim thalou ahitai, ajeh chu amaho hi cannan gamma khoiju le bongnoi lon nagam lut lou diu ahitai.
English: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho hi Pathen in ana sei peh in “Amaho jouse hi thonlouva gamthip lah’a thitei ding ahi tauve” amaho lah achu pasal khat jong lutthei talou ding Caleb kiti Jephunneh chule Joshua kiti Nunchapa amani tailou adangse khat jeng cha jong lutthei lou diu ahi.
en: For the LORD had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
text:
NUM 26:65
Thadou: Ajeh chu amaho hi Pathen in ana sei peh in “Amaho jouse hi thonlouva gamthip lah’a thitei ding ahi tauve” amaho lah achu pasal khat jong lutthei talou ding Caleb kiti Jephunneh chule Joshua kiti Nunchapa amani tailou adangse khat jeng cha jong lutthei lou diu ahi.
English: For the LORD had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

tcz: Joseph chate Manasseh chilhah ho Zelophat chateho Hepher chate Gilead chateho, Makhir chate chule achanu teuho min hou jouse chu mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah chule Tirzah ahiuve amaho jouse ahung khomsoh keiyun ahi.
en: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
text:
NUM 27:1
Thadou: Joseph chate Manasseh chilhah ho Zelophat chateho Hepher chate Gilead chateho, Makhir chate chule achanu teuho min hou jouse chu mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah chule Tirzah ahiuve amaho jouse ahung khomsoh keiyun ahi.
English: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

tcz: Chuin amaho chu Mose masang, Eleazer thempu masang, chuleh Japi lamkai ho masanga houbuh leitol ah ading un ahi.
en: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,
text:
NUM 27:2
Thadou: Chuin amaho chu Mose masang, Eleazer thempu masang, chuleh Japi lamkai ho masanga houbuh leitol ah ading un ahi.
English: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

tcz: Kapu teuchu gamthip lah a ahinkhou ana beitan, Korah mite lah a khat pen chu ana hi pon amachu mi holah a Pathen lungdei lou bol ho khat chu ahin amavang ama chonset jal'a ahinkho beija ahitai chule chapa neilou ahiye.
en: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.
text:
NUM 27:3
Thadou: Kapu teuchu gamthip lah a ahinkhou ana beitan, Korah mite lah a khat pen chu ana hi pon amachu mi holah a Pathen lungdei lou bol ho khat chu ahin amavang ama chonset jal'a ahinkho beija ahitai chule chapa neilou ahiye.
English: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.

tcz: Epijeh a kapateu min chu aphung sung uva kon mang jeng ding ham chapa aneilou jeh mei a? Chanvou neilegou ka insung mite dang ho a tabong neipiu vin ati.
en: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”
text:
NUM 27:4
Thadou: Epijeh a kapateu min chu aphung sung uva kon mang jeng ding ham chapa aneilou jeh mei a? Chanvou neilegou ka insung mite dang ho a tabong neipiu vin ati.
English: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

tcz: Hichun Mose’n amaho thule la boina chu Pathen masanga apolut tan ahi.
en: Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
text:
NUM 27:5
Thadou: Hichun Mose’n amaho thule la boina chu Pathen masanga apolut tan ahi.
English: Moses brought their cause before the LORD.

tcz: Chuin PakaiyinMose hitin ahin donbut in ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 27:6
Thadou: Chuin PakaiyinMose hitin ahin donbut in ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Zelophehad chanute kiphin ahi ding mong tah ahiye. Mose nangman amaho neile gou apaho sopite ho lah a ding’a hin napeh tei angaiye chule apate ho chan vou ding u chu na peh teidiu ahi, ati.
en: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
text:
NUM 27:7
Thadou: Zelophehad chanute kiphin ahi ding mong tah ahiye. Mose nangman amaho neile gou apaho sopite ho lah a ding’a hin napeh tei angaiye chule apate ho chan vou ding u chu na peh teidiu ahi, ati.
English: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

tcz: Israel mite chu sei pih tan, pasal khat chu ahinkho abeiya chule chapa neilouva aum tah a ahile anei le agou jouse chu achanute chang ding ahi.
en: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
text:
NUM 27:8
Thadou: Israel mite chu sei pih tan, pasal khat chu ahinkho abeiya chule chapa neilouva aum tah a ahile anei le agou jouse chu achanute chang ding ahi.
English: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

tcz: Amapa chun chanu anei tah hih le anei le agou hou chu asopite na peh ding ahi tai.
en: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
text:
NUM 27:9
Thadou: Amapa chun chanu anei tah hih le anei le agou hou chu asopite na peh ding ahi tai.
English: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

tcz: Israel mikhat chu athi tah a sopi aneitah lou leh achan vou aneile agou chu apa sopite ho napeh ding ahiye.
en: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
text:
NUM 27:10
Thadou: Israel mikhat chu athi tah a sopi aneitah lou leh achan vou aneile agou chu apa sopite ho napeh ding ahiye.
English: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

tcz: Nikhat Pathen in Mose komah asei in, “Nisolam vadung kom a molchung khat pen ah kel tou inlang chule keiman Israel te kapeh nading gamsung khu gah vetem in ati.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
text:
NUM 27:12
Thadou: Nikhat Pathen in Mose komah asei in, “Nisolam vadung kom a molchung khat pen ah kel tou inlang chule keiman Israel te kapeh nading gamsung khu gah vetem in ati.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

tcz: Nangma in natahsa tah a namu teng nangma jong nasoopipa Aaron bonga nathi ding ahitai,
en: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

tcz: Ajeh chu mipite ho gamthip lah Zin’a akiphin laitah un keiman kathendol amaho kom a twichungah phongjel lhonin kati chu nangnin keima doumah joh in nachon lhon tan ahi. (Hichehi Kadesh kiti Zin gammang a Meribah twi chu ahi).
en: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
text:
NUM 27:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu mipite ho gamthip lah Zin’a akiphin laitah un keiman kathendol amaho kom a twichungah phongjel lhonin kati chu nangnin keima doumah joh in nachon lhon tan ahi. (Hichehi Kadesh kiti Zin gammang a Meribah twi chu ahi).
English: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

tcz: Chuin Mose’n Pakai henga hiti hin aseijin ahi.
en: Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,
text:
NUM 27:15
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n Pakai henga hiti hin aseijin ahi.
English: Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,

tcz: Pakaiyin vannoiya lhangho jouse mi jouse pasal jouse chunga vaihom ding lheng doh tahen, ati.
en: “Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
text:
NUM 27:16
Thadou: Pakaiyin vannoiya lhangho jouse mi jouse pasal jouse chunga vaihom ding lheng doh tahen, ati.
English: “Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

tcz: Amaho lah a konna hungpot doh ding amaho lah a gamsung lutthei hiding koitabang amaho lah a konna hin puidoh theiya hin nung lhunsah kit thei hiding Pathen mipi te, hijeh achu kelngoi aching umlou bang nga a umlou nadiu ahi.
en: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”
text:
NUM 27:17
Thadou: Amaho lah a konna hungpot doh ding amaho lah a gamsung lutthei hiding koitabang amaho lah a konna hin puidoh theiya hin nung lhunsah kit thei hiding Pathen mipi te, hijeh achu kelngoi aching umlou bang nga a umlou nadiu ahi.
English: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

tcz: Chu in PakaiyinMose aki houlimpi tan Joshua kiti Nun chapa lhagao neisa pahi nangman heng a kou inlang achungah nakhut ngam in atie.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.
text:
NUM 27:18
Thadou: Chu in PakaiyinMose aki houlimpi tan Joshua kiti Nun chapa lhagao neisa pahi nangman heng a kou inlang achungah nakhut ngam in atie.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.

tcz: Eleazer thempu pa leh mipi jouse masangah dinsah inlang chuleh mipi jouse het in amachu mipite puihoi din thupeh nei in.
en: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.
text:
NUM 27:19
Thadou: Eleazer thempu pa leh mipi jouse masangah dinsah inlang chuleh mipi jouse het in amachu mipite puihoi din thupeh nei in.
English: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

tcz: Chule Joshua chu nangman thanei nachu napeh ding hiche jeh achu Israel mipi te lah a thuneina anei thei nading ahi.
en: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
text:
NUM 27:20
Thadou: Chule Joshua chu nangman thanei nachu napeh ding hiche jeh achu Israel mipi te lah a thuneina anei thei nading ahi.
English: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

tcz: Eleazer thempu pa masang a ding ding chule Pathen lam gel doh jing a aum na laiya Urim thutanna umna ahin, amapa thupeh dungjuiya potdoh diu chule amapa thuneina a hung sung lha diu Joshua le Israel mipi jouse umkhom diu ahi.
en: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”
text:
NUM 27:21
Thadou: Eleazer thempu pa masang a ding ding chule Pathen lam gel doh jing a aum na laiya Urim thutanna umna ahin, amapa thupeh dungjuiya potdoh diu chule amapa thuneina a hung sung lha diu Joshua le Israel mipi jouse umkhom diu ahi.
English: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

tcz: Hichun Mose’n jong Pathen thupeh dungjui in abollin hichun Mose’n Joshua chu Eleazer thempu pa masang leh Israel mipite masangah adinsah tan ahi.
en: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
text:
NUM 27:22
Thadou: Hichun Mose’n jong Pathen thupeh dungjui in abollin hichun Mose’n Joshua chu Eleazer thempu pa masang leh Israel mipite masangah adinsah tan ahi.
English: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

tcz: Chule Mose’n akhut chu Joshua chunga angam in phatthei abohtan Pathen nin aphatsah a thu apeh bangtah in aboltan ahi.
en: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD spoke by Moses.
text:
NUM 27:23
Thadou: Chule Mose’n akhut chu Joshua chunga angam in phatthei abohtan Pathen nin aphatsah a thu apeh bangtah in aboltan ahi.
English: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD spoke by Moses.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseipeh tan ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 28:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga thu aseipeh tan ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel mite henga hiti hin seijin, keima dinga govam thilto keima neh ding, hochu kipel lou hela aphat cha ka henga na hin lhut jing diu ahi.
en: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’
text:
NUM 28:2
Thadou: Israel mite henga hiti hin seijin, keima dinga govam thilto keima neh ding, hochu kipel lou hela aphat cha ka henga na hin lhut jing diu ahi.
English: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’

tcz: Chule amaho henga hitia hi naseipeh ding, nanghon Pakai dinga govam thilto nabol diu chu hiche hi ahi. Nisih le abei theilou ding thiltoa pang ding, kumkhat lhingsa, kelngoichal nolna bei natodoh jing diu ahi.
en: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
text:
NUM 28:3
Thadou: Chule amaho henga hitia hi naseipeh ding, nanghon Pakai dinga govam thilto nabol diu chu hiche hi ahi. Nisih le abei theilou ding thiltoa pang ding, kumkhat lhingsa, kelngoichal nolna bei natodoh jing diu ahi.
English: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

tcz: Hitia chu kelngoi khatpen chu jingkah lama nato doh diu, khatma chu nilhah lama na todoh diu ahi.
en: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,
text:
NUM 28:4
Thadou: Hitia chu kelngoi khatpen chu jingkah lama nato doh diu, khatma chu nilhah lama na todoh diu ahi.
English: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,

tcz: Chule lhosohga thilto a pangdia chang bong neldisel ephah dim khat hopsomma hopkhat le thaotui kiheh lhasa Hin dim khat, hopsomma hopsom a hopli toh kihelsa jaona natodoh ding ahi.
en: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
text:
NUM 28:5
Thadou: Chule lhosohga thilto a pangdia chang bong neldisel ephah dim khat hopsomma hopkhat le thaotui kiheh lhasa Hin dim khat, hopsomma hopsom a hopli toh kihelsa jaona natodoh ding ahi.
English: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

tcz: Hiche thilto hi beitih neilou pumgo thiltoa pang jing dinga Sinai molchunga thupeh anahitai.
en: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
text:
NUM 28:6
Thadou: Hiche thilto hi beitih neilou pumgo thiltoa pang jing dinga Sinai molchunga thupeh anahitai.
English: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

tcz: Lengpitwi jaona to ding chu kengoi khat cheh jaona to ding ahi jeh chun Hin dimkhat hoplia hopkhat jaona hi ding ahi. Muntheng laiya hiche lengpitwi thengsel hi Pakai dinga nasun lhah ding ahi.
en: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD in the holy place.
text:
NUM 28:7
Thadou: Lengpitwi jaona to ding chu kengoi khat cheh jaona to ding ahi jeh chun Hin dimkhat hoplia hopkhat jaona hi ding ahi. Muntheng laiya hiche lengpitwi thengsel hi Pakai dinga nasun lhah ding ahi.
English: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD in the holy place.

tcz: Chule kelngoi khatpen jong chu nilhah lam teng natodoh ding, jingkah lama na thilto banga lhosoh leh lengpi twi ki bolna banga, meiya govam thiltoa nabol ding Pakai dinga gim namtui tah naso ding ahi.
en: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
text:
NUM 28:8
Thadou: Chule kelngoi khatpen jong chu nilhah lam teng natodoh ding, jingkah lama na thilto banga lhosoh leh lengpi twi ki bolna banga, meiya govam thiltoa nabol ding Pakai dinga gim namtui tah naso ding ahi.
English: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

tcz: Cholngah nikho seh le kelngoi achal ni kumkhat lhingsa nolna bei na todoh diu, lhosohga thilto dinga jong changbong neldisel Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hopkhat thaotui toh helsa hi ding, lengpitwi jaona hi ding ahi.
en: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:
text:
NUM 28:9
Thadou: Cholngah nikho seh le kelngoi achal ni kumkhat lhingsa nolna bei na todoh diu, lhosohga thilto dinga jong changbong neldisel Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hopkhat thaotui toh helsa hi ding, lengpitwi jaona hi ding ahi.
English: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

tcz: Hichu bei tih nei louva pumgo thilto kitoh le lengpitwi sim louva jong, hichu cholngah nikho seh a thilto ding chengse ahi.
en: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
text:
NUM 28:10
Thadou: Hichu bei tih nei louva pumgo thilto kitoh le lengpitwi sim louva jong, hichu cholngah nikho seh a thilto ding chengse ahi.
English: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

tcz: Kum sunga lha na sim nau lha kipat na jong chu Pakai dinga thilto na bol diu ahi. Kumkhat lhingsa bongchal ni nolna bei hel leh kengoi chal khat toh kelngoi achal sagi jaona hi ding ahi.
en: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,
text:
NUM 28:11
Thadou: Kum sunga lha na sim nau lha kipat na jong chu Pakai dinga thilto na bol diu ahi. Kumkhat lhingsa bongchal ni nolna bei hel leh kengoi chal khat toh kelngoi achal sagi jaona hi ding ahi.
English: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,

tcz: Chule bongchal khat cheh toh to tha dinga lhosohga thilto ding changbong neldisel Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hop thum thaotui jaona hi ding ahi. Kelngoi chal khat toh totha ding changbong neldisel ephah dim khat hopsomma hopni thaotui toh helsa hi ding ahi.
en: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;

tcz: Kelngoi chal khat cheh toh totha dinga lhosohga thilto jaona ephah hopsomma hop khat thaotui jaona hiding, hichengse chu gimnam tuitah pumgo thiltoa pang ding, Pakai dinga meiya govam thilto ding ahi.
en: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
text:
NUM 28:13
Thadou: Kelngoi chal khat cheh toh totha dinga lhosohga thilto jaona ephah hopsomma hop khat thaotui jaona hiding, hichengse chu gimnam tuitah pumgo thiltoa pang ding, Pakai dinga meiya govam thilto ding ahi.
English: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

tcz: Lengpitwi thilto ding chu bongchal khat dinga lengpitwi Hin khat hopthumma hopkhat dim hiding, chule kengoi khat jaona toding chu Hin dimkhat hoplia hop khat hiding, hichengse hi kumkhat sunga lhaseh le pumgo thiltoa pang ding ahi.
en: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
text:
NUM 28:14
Thadou: Lengpitwi thilto ding chu bongchal khat dinga lengpitwi Hin khat hopthumma hopkhat dim hiding, chule kengoi khat jaona toding chu Hin dimkhat hoplia hop khat hiding, hichengse hi kumkhat sunga lhaseh le pumgo thiltoa pang ding ahi.
English: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

tcz: Chule Pakaija chonset thilto dinga manchah ding chu kelngoichal khat hiding, hichu tantih nei louva to jing ding pumgo thilto lengpitwi komma chu todoh ding ahiye.
en: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
text:
NUM 28:15
Thadou: Chule Pakaija chonset thilto dinga manchah ding chu kelngoichal khat hiding, hichu tantih nei louva to jing ding pumgo thilto lengpitwi komma chu todoh ding ahiye.
English: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

tcz: Chule lhamasa pen nisom leh nili lhin nikho hi Pakai dinga kalchuh kut ahi.
en: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’s Passover.
text:
NUM 28:16
Thadou: Chule lhamasa pen nisom leh nili lhin nikho hi Pakai dinga kalchuh kut ahi.
English: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’s Passover.

tcz: Hiche lha nisom le ninga lhinni hi kut nikho ding ahin, nisagi sunga cholsolou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi.
en: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
text:
NUM 28:17
Thadou: Hiche lha nisom le ninga lhinni hi kut nikho ding ahin, nisagi sunga cholsolou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi.
English: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

tcz: Kut nikho masapen nile khoppi theng kibol ding, hiche nikho teng natoh nabol lou hel diu ahi.
en: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,
text:
NUM 28:18
Thadou: Kut nikho masapen nile khoppi theng kibol ding, hiche nikho teng natoh nabol lou hel diu ahi.
English: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,

tcz: Meiya govam thilto hichu Pakaija dinga natoh doh nikhou hiding ahi. Hiche dinga chu bongchal ni leh kelngoi chal khat jaona chule kumkhat lhingsa cheh kengoichal sagi jaona hiding ahi. Hichengse chu nolna bei jing hidiu ahi.
en: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,
text:
NUM 28:19
Thadou: Meiya govam thilto hichu Pakaija dinga natoh doh nikhou hiding ahi. Hiche dinga chu bongchal ni leh kelngoi chal khat jaona chule kumkhat lhingsa cheh kengoichal sagi jaona hiding ahi. Hichengse chu nolna bei jing hidiu ahi.
English: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,

tcz: Hichengse toh totha ding chu lhosohga thilto changbong nel disel thaotui toh Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hopthum chu bongchal khat toh nato tha diu, kelngoi chal khat dinga Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hopni jaona na to ding ahi.
en: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.
text:
NUM 28:20
Thadou: Hichengse toh totha ding chu lhosohga thilto changbong nel disel thaotui toh Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hopthum chu bongchal khat toh nato tha diu, kelngoi chal khat dinga Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hopni jaona na to ding ahi.
English: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.

tcz: Kelngoi chal khat toh totha dinga ephah dim khat hopsomma hop khat jaona kelngoichal sagi ding ahi.
en: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

tcz: Na boncha diuva chonset ki thoidam na thilto a pang dinga kelchal khat jong hi ding ahi.
en: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
text:
NUM 28:22
Thadou: Na boncha diuva chonset ki thoidam na thilto a pang dinga kelchal khat jong hi ding ahi.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

tcz: Jingkah seh le tantih neilouva kitoh doh thilto pumgo thilto sim louva hichengse jong hi todoh ding ahi.
en: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
text:
NUM 28:23
Thadou: Jingkah seh le tantih neilouva kitoh doh thilto pumgo thilto sim louva hichengse jong hi todoh ding ahi.
English: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

tcz: Ni sagi sunga hitia chu nabol jing diu, nisih leh meiya govam ding, Pakai anneh ding hichu gimnam tuitah dinga natodiu, hiche jong hi tantih neilou kitoh pumgo thilto leh lengpitwi ki todoh na muna chu na todoh diu ahi.
en: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
text:
NUM 28:24
Thadou: Ni sagi sunga hitia chu nabol jing diu, nisih leh meiya govam ding, Pakai anneh ding hichu gimnam tuitah dinga natodiu, hiche jong hi tantih neilou kitoh pumgo thilto leh lengpitwi ki todoh na muna chu na todoh diu ahi.
English: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

tcz: Ni sagi lhinni leh khoppi khat na bol diu, hiche nikho a chu na toh hahsa na bol lou hel diu ahi.
en: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
text:
NUM 28:25
Thadou: Ni sagi lhinni leh khoppi khat na bol diu, hiche nikho a chu na toh hahsa na bol lou hel diu ahi.
English: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

tcz: Hapta seh le kut na bol jing diu, Pakai dinga lhosoh thilto changthah na hin todiu, lhoh sohga masa na hin to nikhou jong leh khoppi theng na nei diu, hiche nikho sih le chun natoh hahsa na bol thei lou diu ahi.
en: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to the LORD in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;

tcz: Hiche ho jouse sanga chu Pakai dinga gim namtui pumgo thilto na todoh joh diu ahi. Hichu bongchal golni kelngoi chal khattoh achal cheh sagi jaona hi ding, kelngoi hose chu aboncha kum khat lhingsa cheh hi ding ahi.
en: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

tcz: Lhosohga thilto toh tho ding chu bongchal khat jaona changbong neldisel thaotui toh halsa Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hop thum hi ding, kelngoi chal khat dinga hopsom ma hopni bou hi ding ahi.
en: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,
text:
NUM 28:28
Thadou: Lhosohga thilto toh tho ding chu bongchal khat jaona changbong neldisel thaotui toh halsa Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hop thum hi ding, kelngoi chal khat dinga hopsom ma hopni bou hi ding ahi.
English: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,

tcz: Kelngoi chal sagi hi ding chu khat cheh dinga hopsom ma hop khat hi ding ahi.
en: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

tcz: Na kithoi dam na diuva kelchal jong hi ding ahi.
en: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.
text:
NUM 28:30
Thadou: Na kithoi dam na diuva kelchal jong hi ding ahi.
English: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.

tcz: Tantih nei louva ki bol leh lhosohga thilto kibol tai louva jong nanghon hichengse chu na todoh diu, lengpitwi thilto jaona natotha diu, thilto jouse chu nolna bei hel hi ding ahi.
en: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.
text:
NUM 28:31
Thadou: Tantih nei louva ki bol leh lhosohga thilto kibol tai louva jong nanghon hichengse chu na todoh diu, lengpitwi thilto jaona natotha diu, thilto jouse chu nolna bei hel hi ding ahi.
English: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.

tcz: Lha sagi alhin teng, nikho masa khat nasem diu hiche nikhoa chu natoh hahsa kiti na toh lou diu ahi. Hiche nikho chu nangho dinga sumkon kimut ging ni hi ding ahi.
en: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.
text:
NUM 29:1
Thadou: Lha sagi alhin teng, nikho masa khat nasem diu hiche nikhoa chu natoh hahsa kiti na toh lou diu ahi. Hiche nikho chu nangho dinga sumkon kimut ging ni hi ding ahi.
English: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai dinga gimnamtui pumgo thilto nahinto cheh diu, hichu bongchal gol khat kelngoi chal khat, kumkhat lhingsa cheh kelngoi chal sagi jaona hi ding ahi.
en: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

tcz: Hicheng jouse toh totha ding chu bongchal changbong jaona hichu thaotui toh halsa ephah khat hopsom a hop thum hi ding, kelngoi chal jaona ahi leh ephah hopsom a hopni hi ding ahi.
en: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,
text:
NUM 29:3
Thadou: Hicheng jouse toh totha ding chu bongchal changbong jaona hichu thaotui toh halsa ephah khat hopsom a hop thum hi ding, kelngoi chal jaona ahi leh ephah hopsom a hopni hi ding ahi.
English: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,

tcz: Kelngoi chal sagi ho toh totha ding chun khat cheh chunga chu ephah hopsomma hop khat cheh hidng ahi.
en: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

tcz: Chonset nakithoi dam na diu thilto ding chu kelchal khatma hiding ahi.
en: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

tcz: Hichengse hi aboncha lha thah seh leh pumgo thilto, lhosohga ki toh doh, tan tih nei louva ki tohdoh jing, dan dungjui ja kitoh doh lengpitwi thilto ahin, hichu Pakai dinga gimnam tuitah dinga meiya govam dinga ki tohdoh thil to ho chung chonna adang jong ki tohdoh be ding ahi.
en: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
text:
NUM 29:6
Thadou: Hichengse hi aboncha lha thah seh leh pumgo thilto, lhosohga ki toh doh, tan tih nei louva ki tohdoh jing, dan dungjui ja kitoh doh lengpitwi thilto ahin, hichu Pakai dinga gimnam tuitah dinga meiya govam dinga ki tohdoh thil to ho chung chonna adang jong ki tohdoh be ding ahi.
English: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

tcz: Nanghon lha sagi lhinna nikho masa penni leh kikhop theng khat nabol diu, bu nelouva, natoh hahsa jong nabol lou diu ahi.
en: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;

tcz: Amavang Pakaija dinga gimnam tui jeng pumgo thilto nachoi diu, bongchal khat leh kelngoi chal khat, kumkhat lhingsa cheh kelngoi chal sagi nolnabei jaona natodoh tha diu ahi.
en: but you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect;

tcz: Hichengse jaona lhohsohga thilto ahin, changbong nel thaotui toh kilhelsa Ephah dimkhat hopsomma hop thumchu bongchal khat dinga nato diu, kelngoi chal jaona toding chu ephah khat hopsomma hopni ma hi ding ahiye.
en: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,
text:
NUM 29:9
Thadou: Hichengse jaona lhohsohga thilto ahin, changbong nel thaotui toh kilhelsa Ephah dimkhat hopsomma hop thumchu bongchal khat dinga nato diu, kelngoi chal jaona toding chu ephah khat hopsomma hopni ma hi ding ahiye.
English: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,

tcz: Kelngoi chal sagi chengse chu khat cheh toh totha ding’a Ephah khat hopsomma hop khat cheh na todiu ahi.
en: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

tcz: Chule chonset ki thoidamna dinga thilto leh tantih neilouva pumgo thilto kitoh ji, lhosohga thilto le lengpitwi ki tohdoh kal val a jong chonset thilto dinga kelchal khat na todoh tha diu ahi.
en: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.
text:
NUM 29:11
Thadou: Chule chonset ki thoidamna dinga thilto leh tantih neilouva pumgo thilto kitoh ji, lhosohga thilto le lengpitwi ki tohdoh kal val a jong chonset thilto dinga kelchal khat na todoh tha diu ahi.
English: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

tcz: Lha sagi lhin ni, nisom leh ninga lhin nikho teng khoppi theng khat naman diu, Pakaija dinga ni sagi sunga kut na bol diu, na toh hahsa kiti na toh louhel diu ahi.
en: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days.
text:
NUM 29:12
Thadou: Lha sagi lhin ni, nisom leh ninga lhin nikho teng khoppi theng khat naman diu, Pakaija dinga ni sagi sunga kut na bol diu, na toh hahsa kiti na toh louhel diu ahi.
English: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days.

tcz: Hichea chu Pakaiya dinga gim namtui tah dinga thilto na bol diu, meiya ki gouvam thilto, pumgo thilto dinga bongchal gol som leh thum, kelngoi chal vang ni hi ding, kumkhat lhingsa cheh nolnabei hel kelngoi chal som le ni jaona hi ding ahi.
en: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect;

tcz: Hiche ho toh todoh tha ding chu lhohsoh-ga thilto chang bong nel thaotui toh helsa, bonchal som le thum hotoh to doh tha ding chu ephah dimkhat hopsomma hop thum hi ding, kelngoi chal teni toh to tha ding chu Ephah dimkhat hopsom ma hop ni hi ding ahiye.
en: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,
text:
NUM 29:14
Thadou: Hiche ho toh todoh tha ding chu lhohsoh-ga thilto chang bong nel thaotui toh helsa, bonchal som le thum hotoh to doh tha ding chu ephah dimkhat hopsomma hop thum hi ding, kelngoi chal teni toh to tha ding chu Ephah dimkhat hopsom ma hop ni hi ding ahiye.
English: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,

tcz: Kelngoi chal somleli hotoh totha ding chu Ephah dim khat hopsom ma hopkhat cheh jaona to doh ding ahi.
en: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

tcz: Chule tantih nei louva pumgo thilto ki toh dohji leh lhosohga lengpitwi chung chonna chonset thilto dinga kelchal khatma hi ding ahiye.
en: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
text:
NUM 29:16
Thadou: Chule tantih nei louva pumgo thilto ki toh dohji leh lhosohga lengpitwi chung chonna chonset thilto dinga kelchal khatma hi ding ahiye.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

tcz: Nikhoni lhinni teng bongchal ni, kelngoi chal ni, kumkhat lhingsa cheh kelngoi chal nolna bei somleli jaona hi ding ahi.
en: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

tcz: Dan dungjui ya bongchal ho leh kelngoi chal teni, kelngoi chal hotoh totha ding chu ajat atam leh alhom dung jui cheh hi ding, lhosohga thilto le lengpitwi thilto toh to tha ding ahi.
en: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

tcz: Chule tantih nei louva thilto kitoh doh ji pumgo thil to le lhosohga thilto, lengpi tui ki tohdoh chung chonna chonset thilto dinga kelngoi chal khat hi ding ahiye.
en: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.
text:
NUM 29:19
Thadou: Chule tantih nei louva thilto kitoh doh ji pumgo thil to le lhosohga thilto, lengpi tui ki tohdoh chung chonna chonset thilto dinga kelngoi chal khat hi ding ahiye.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.

tcz: Nithum lhinni le bongchal som le khat hi ding, kelngoi chal ni, kumkhat lhingsa cheh kelngoi chal nolna bei cheh som le li hi ding ahiye.
en: “‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

tcz: Dan dung jui'a bongchal ho leh kelngoi chal teni ahin, ajat atam alhom dung jui cheh a to doh ding chule lengpitwi jong jaona lai ding ahi.
en: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

tcz: Chule tantih nei louva pumgo thilto ki tohdoh ji lhosohga ki tohdoh le lengpitwi kitoh doh ji chung chonna chonset thilto ding kelchal khat hina lai ding ahi.
en: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
text:
NUM 29:22
Thadou: Chule tantih nei louva pumgo thilto ki tohdoh ji lhosohga ki tohdoh le lengpitwi kitoh doh ji chung chonna chonset thilto ding kelchal khat hina lai ding ahi.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

tcz: Nili lhinni teng bongchal som hi ding, kelngoi chal ni, kumkhat lhingsa cheh kelngoichal som le li hi ding ahiye.
en: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

tcz: Dan kisem dungjuija, bongchal hole kelngoi chal teni totha ding, chu leh kelngoi chal ho toh totha ding chu ajat atam le alhom dung jui'a lhosohga thilto lengpitwi toh totha cheh ding ahiye.
en: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

tcz: Tantih neilouva thilto kitoh ji pumgo thilto leh lengpitwi kitoh chung chonna chonset thilto dinga kelchal khat na todoh tha diu ahi.
en: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
text:
NUM 29:25
Thadou: Tantih neilouva thilto kitoh ji pumgo thilto leh lengpitwi kitoh chung chonna chonset thilto dinga kelchal khat na todoh tha diu ahi.
English: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

tcz: Ninga lhinni teng bongchal ko hi ding, kelngoi chal ni, kum khat lhing sa cheh kelngoi chal somleli jaona hi ding ahi.
en: “‘On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

tcz: Dan kisem dungjuija bongchal ho leh kelngoi chal teni toh totha ding chu ajat atam leh alhom dungjuiya lhosohga thilto ding jong jao cheh ding ahi.
en: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,
text:

en: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

en: “‘You shall offer these to the LORD in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”
text:
NUM 29:39

English: “‘You shall offer these to the LORD in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”

text:
NUM 30:1
Thadou: Mose’n Israel chate phung sung upa ho henga thu aseipeh in, hiche hi Pakai thupeh ahiye, ati.
English: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded.

tcz: Na lah uva Pasal khat touvin kitepna anei khah tah’a ahi loule ama kihen oh na ding bepma aki hahsel hamma, ama le ama thilkhat chung changa aki peh doh jeng tah a ahile, hiche a thusei dohsa chu apel keh thei lou hel ding ahi. Akam sung’a konna a thusei dohsa bang bang’a asuhbulhit teitei ding ahi.
en: When a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
text:
NUM 30:2
Thadou: Na lah uva Pasal khat touvin kitepna anei khah tah’a ahi loule ama kihen oh na ding bepma aki hahsel hamma, ama le ama thilkhat chung changa aki peh doh jeng tah a ahile, hiche a thusei dohsa chu apel keh thei lou hel ding ahi. Akam sung’a konna a thusei dohsa bang bang’a asuhbulhit teitei ding ahi.
English: When a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

tcz: Chule numei khat touvin a khandon laiya, hichu apa insunga achen laiya ki tepna khat tou aneiya ama le ama thil khat toh lheh to dinga ki tepna asem tan ahi.
en: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,
text:
NUM 30:3
Thadou: Chule numei khat touvin a khandon laiya, hichu apa insunga achen laiya ki tepna khat tou aneiya ama le ama thil khat toh lheh to dinga ki tepna asem tan ahi.
English: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

tcz: Numei nun kitepna a sem bang banga ama leh ama thil khat toh lheh to ding’a a kitepna chu apet tah jeng ajong apa chun a jahsoh keija ahin lah apa chu ima sei louva aum a ahile, numei nun kitepna asem chu ama nun aki dinpi jing ding, hi tia chu ama leh aman kitepna asem a thil khat toh lheh to ding aki tep na jong sumil louva um ding hichu a suh bulhit teitei ding ahiye.
en: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
text:
NUM 30:4
Thadou: Numei nun kitepna a sem bang banga ama leh ama thil khat toh lheh to ding’a a kitepna chu apet tah jeng ajong apa chun a jahsoh keija ahin lah apa chu ima sei louva aum a ahile, numei nun kitepna asem chu ama nun aki dinpi jing ding, hi tia chu ama leh aman kitepna asem a thil khat toh lheh to ding aki tep na jong sumil louva um ding hichu a suh bulhit teitei ding ahiye.
English: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

tcz: Ahin lah hiche numei nun kitepna anei chu apan ajah doh nini leh a lunglhai louna ahija, aphat sah louna ahin phondoh a ahile, numei nun kitepna asem chu donse a um talou ding, apan angai mah jeh a Pakaiyin hiche numei nu hi a ngaidam ding ahi tai.
en: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. The LORD will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.
text:
NUM 30:5
Thadou: Ahin lah hiche numei nun kitepna anei chu apan ajah doh nini leh a lunglhai louna ahija, aphat sah louna ahin phondoh a ahile, numei nun kitepna asem chu donse a um talou ding, apan angai mah jeh a Pakaiyin hiche numei nu hi a ngaidam ding ahi tai.
English: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. The LORD will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

tcz: Amavang hiche numei nu hin khonung ding gel louva kitepna asem jeng’a, ama le ama aki hen-oh tah a, kitepna anei sung’a hi pasal khat touvin a kichenpi tah’a ahija.
en: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,
text:
NUM 30:6
Thadou: Amavang hiche numei nu hin khonung ding gel louva kitepna asem jeng’a, ama le ama aki hen-oh tah a, kitepna anei sung’a hi pasal khat touvin a kichenpi tah’a ahija.
English: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,

tcz: Khonung’a aji pan hiche kitepna anei chu ahin het doh’a ima sei louva aum a ahile, hiche numeinu kitepna chu ding det jing ding, amanun ama leh ama ding’a kikan na ding’a kitepna asem chu ki sudet jing ding ahi tai.
en: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
text:
NUM 30:7
Thadou: Khonung’a aji pan hiche kitepna anei chu ahin het doh’a ima sei louva aum a ahile, hiche numeinu kitepna chu ding det jing ding, amanun ama leh ama ding’a kikan na ding’a kitepna asem chu ki sudet jing ding ahi tai.
English: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

tcz: Ahinlah numeinun kitepna a semdoh sa chu a jipa’n ajah doh ni nia a dei sah louna aphondoh a ahile, aji pan jong ajinu khonung ding gel louva kitepna ana sem a ama leh ama a kikan chung thu chu asem hoi peh a ahile, Pakaiyin amanu chu a ngaidam ding ahitai.
en: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. The LORD will forgive her.
text:
NUM 30:8
Thadou: Ahinlah numeinun kitepna a semdoh sa chu a jipa’n ajah doh ni nia a dei sah louna aphondoh a ahile, aji pan jong ajinu khonung ding gel louva kitepna ana sem a ama leh ama a kikan chung thu chu asem hoi peh a ahile, Pakaiyin amanu chu a ngaidam ding ahitai.
English: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. The LORD will forgive her.

tcz: Chule meithaisa a kidasa numei khat in kitepna asem vang chu ama leh ama kihen ohsa ahi tan, hichu suhboija umlou ding numeinu douna ding’a hing jing ding ahi tai.
en: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.
text:
NUM 30:9
Thadou: Chule meithaisa a kidasa numei khat in kitepna asem vang chu ama leh ama kihen ohsa ahi tan, hichu suhboija umlou ding numeinu douna ding’a hing jing ding ahi tai.
English: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.

tcz: Numei chun aji pa insunga aum laijin kitepna khat asem doh tan, ama leh ama chu thil man khat ding’a a kihahsel in aki tung doh jeng tan ahi.
en: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,
text:
NUM 30:10
Thadou: Numei chun aji pa insunga aum laijin kitepna khat asem doh tan, ama leh ama chu thil man khat ding’a a kihahsel in aki tung doh jeng tan ahi.
English: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

tcz: Hiche numeinu thil bol jouse chu ajipan ahetdoh nung jeng ajong ima seilouva aumma ahile, numeinu kitepna chu ijakai ding det jing ding, ama le ama thil man ding’a kitepna aneina chu keh theilou ding ahi tai.
en: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.
text:
NUM 30:11
Thadou: Hiche numeinu thil bol jouse chu ajipan ahetdoh nung jeng ajong ima seilouva aumma ahile, numeinu kitepna chu ijakai ding det jing ding, ama le ama thil man ding’a kitepna aneina chu keh theilou ding ahi tai.
English: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.

tcz: Ahinlah ajinun a thilbol jouse chu ajipan ajah doh ni leh deisah talouvin subei jeng henlang hile, hiche numeinun akitepna jouse chu suhbeija umjing ding ahi tai. Ajipa in aboncha a suhbei bang’a numeinu jong chu Pakaiyin a ngaidam ding ahi tai.
en: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. The LORD will forgive her.
text:
NUM 30:12
Thadou: Ahinlah ajinun a thilbol jouse chu ajipan ajah doh ni leh deisah talouvin subei jeng henlang hile, hiche numeinun akitepna jouse chu suhbeija umjing ding ahi tai. Ajipa in aboncha a suhbei bang’a numeinu jong chu Pakaiyin a ngaidam ding ahi tai.
English: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. The LORD will forgive her.

tcz: Numei khat chun gentheina ding’a kitepna asem a kihahselna anei khah tah a ahi leh hi chu a jipan a suhdet peh thei ding, lah jong alah doh peh thei ahi.
en: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
text:
NUM 30:13
Thadou: Numei khat chun gentheina ding’a kitepna asem a kihahselna anei khah tah a ahi leh hi chu a jipan a suhdet peh thei ding, lah jong alah doh peh thei ahi.
English: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

tcz: Hitabang chu ajipan ahin jah doh nikho leh ima sei louva a-uma ahile numei nun kitepna asem jouse chu ki phutdet ahitan, ajeh chu ijakai ajah doh nung jeng’a jong ima seilouva aum jeh chun a suhdet peh tan ahi.
en: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.
text:
NUM 30:14
Thadou: Hitabang chu ajipan ahin jah doh nikho leh ima sei louva a-uma ahile numei nun kitepna asem jouse chu ki phutdet ahitan, ajeh chu ijakai ajah doh nung jeng’a jong ima seilouva aum jeh chun a suhdet peh tan ahi.
English: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.

tcz: Amavang ajipan hichengse hi ajah doh nunga asuh mang peh a ahile, hichun ajipan ajinu themmo na chu apoh hu ahi taiti photchet na ahi.
en: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”
text:
NUM 30:15
Thadou: Amavang ajipan hichengse hi ajah doh nunga asuh mang peh a ahile, hichun ajipan ajinu themmo na chu apoh hu ahi taiti photchet na ahi.
English: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

tcz: Hichengse hi Mose’n pasal le numei kah a chondan mipa leh a chanu a nungah laiya, insung a chen laiya apa toh akah lhonna ding’a a thupeh chu ahi.
en: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.
text:
NUM 30:16
Thadou: Hichengse hi Mose’n pasal le numei kah a chondan mipa leh a chanu a nungah laiya, insung a chen laiya apa toh akah lhonna ding’a a thupeh chu ahi.
English: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin thu a seipeh tan ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 31:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin thu a seipeh tan ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate hi Midian mite chunga galjona chansah tan, Hiche thilsoh akichai teng nangma jong namite a thisa ho toh umkhom ding ahitai.
en: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
text:
NUM 31:2
Thadou: Israel chate hi Midian mite chunga galjona chansah tan, Hiche thilsoh akichai teng nangma jong namite a thisa ho toh umkhom ding ahitai.
English: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

tcz: Chuin Mose’n japi henga a seipeh tan, cheuvin lang Midian mite gasat tauvin, ajeh chu hiche mite chunga hi Pakaiyin phu nalah teitei diu, na lah uva mi phabep galvon tothoa na kon diu ahiye.
en: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute the LORD’s vengeance on Midian.
text:
NUM 31:3
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n japi henga a seipeh tan, cheuvin lang Midian mite gasat tauvin, ajeh chu hiche mite chunga hi Pakaiyin phu nalah teitei diu, na lah uva mi phabep galvon tothoa na kon diu ahiye.
English: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute the LORD’s vengeance on Midian.

tcz: Israel phung sung’a kon mi sangkhat cheh dong khom unlang amaho chu galsat akon ding ahiuve.
en: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”
text:
NUM 31:4
Thadou: Israel phung sung’a kon mi sangkhat cheh dong khom unlang amaho chu galsat akon ding ahiuve.
English: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”

tcz: Chuin Israel mi asang sang lah akon in ama phung sunga kon mi sangkhat cheh adong khom tauvin, galsat ding mong mong in mi sangsom le sangni a kondoh tauvin ahi.
en: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
text:
NUM 31:5
Thadou: Chuin Israel mi asang sang lah akon in ama phung sunga kon mi sangkhat cheh adong khom tauvin, galsat ding mong mong in mi sangsom le sangni a kondoh tauvin ahi.
English: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

tcz: Amaho jouse chu galsat ding in akondoh tauvin, ama phung sunga kon mi sang khat cheh leh Eleazer thempupa chapa Phinehas jaonan, muntheng laiya kimang Bubel phabep, mut ging ding in a khuta pha bep a kichoi jin ahi.
en: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
text:
NUM 31:6
Thadou: Amaho jouse chu galsat ding in akondoh tauvin, ama phung sunga kon mi sang khat cheh leh Eleazer thempupa chapa Phinehas jaonan, muntheng laiya kimang Bubel phabep, mut ging ding in a khuta pha bep a kichoi jin ahi.
English: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga a thupeh bang chun a mahon Midian mite chu gal asat khum tauvin, Pasal a kailhah kiti phot a that chai hel tauve.
en: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses. They killed every male.
text:
NUM 31:7
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga a thupeh bang chun a mahon Midian mite chu gal asat khum tauvin, Pasal a kailhah kiti phot a that chai hel tauve.
English: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses. They killed every male.

tcz: A mitha na lah uva chun Midian mite lah a Lengho jong ajao uvin, Leng atha hou chu Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur chule Reba ahiuve. Midian mite chu leng nga ahiuvin, chule Beor chapa Balaam jong chu Israel chaten chemjam in asat lih tauvin ahi.
en: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
text:
NUM 31:8
Thadou: A mitha na lah uva chun Midian mite lah a Lengho jong ajao uvin, Leng atha hou chu Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur chule Reba ahiuve. Midian mite chu leng nga ahiuvin, chule Beor chapa Balaam jong chu Israel chaten chemjam in asat lih tauvin ahi.
English: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

tcz: Hiti chun Israel miten Midian numei le chapang hochu ahin pui tauvin, a gancha hou ahin, a thilkeo jouse’u abonchan ahin chom gam hel taove.
en: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.
text:
NUM 31:9
Thadou: Hiti chun Israel miten Midian numei le chapang hochu ahin pui tauvin, a gancha hou ahin, a thilkeo jouse’u abonchan ahin chom gam hel taove.
English: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.

tcz: Midian mite chenna jouse chule angahmun jouseu leh akhopi jouseu abonchan meiyin ahal vam hel taovin ahi.
en: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.
text:
NUM 31:10
Thadou: Midian mite chenna jouse chule angahmun jouseu leh akhopi jouseu abonchan meiyin ahal vam hel taovin ahi.
English: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.

tcz: Thil asuh set jouseu ahin, gancha abonchan a chom soh kei tauvin ahi.
en: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.
text:
NUM 31:11
Thadou: Thil asuh set jouseu ahin, gancha abonchan a chom soh kei tauvin ahi.
English: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.

tcz: Chu in galsat miho chun galhing hochu abonchaovin agal thilkeo hou jaonan akai tauvin ahi. Hiche ho jouse chu Mose henga chule Eleazer thempupa henga, Israel chate khopi pumpi henga ahin kaijun, Moab phaicham, Jordan vadung pang, Jericho ngahmun a sem na’uva chun abonchauvin ahin kai lhung soh kei tauvin ahi.
en: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
text:
NUM 31:12
Thadou: Chu in galsat miho chun galhing hochu abonchaovin agal thilkeo hou jaonan akai tauvin ahi. Hiche ho jouse chu Mose henga chule Eleazer thempupa henga, Israel chate khopi pumpi henga ahin kaijun, Moab phaicham, Jordan vadung pang, Jericho ngahmun a sem na’uva chun abonchauvin ahin kai lhung soh kei tauvin ahi.
English: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

tcz: Mose leh Eleazer thempupa chule khopi sunga lamkai jouse chu polama ache tauvin, galsat miho chu toh aga kimu to tauve.
en: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.
text:
NUM 31:13
Thadou: Mose leh Eleazer thempupa chule khopi sunga lamkai jouse chu polama ache tauvin, galsat miho chu toh aga kimu to tauve.
English: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.

tcz: Chuin Mose jong galsat miho asang sang ahin, aja ja chunga thunei lamkai ahung kinung le ho chunga chun alung hang tan ahi.
en: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
text:
NUM 31:14
Thadou: Chuin Mose jong galsat miho asang sang ahin, aja ja chunga thunei lamkai ahung kinung le ho chunga chun alung hang tan ahi.
English: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

tcz: Mose’n ajah uva hiti hin a sei tan ahi. Ipi dinga numei ho hi na hing hoiyu ham?
en: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?
text:
NUM 31:15
Thadou: Mose’n ajah uva hiti hin a sei tan ahi. Ipi dinga numei ho hi na hing hoiyu ham?
English: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

tcz: Hiche Numei ho jeh leh Balaam thuhil jeh’a Peor chung chang thu’a Israel chate jouse Pakai adia thet-umtah'a ana chon ahiuvin, hiche jeh chun Pakai mite chunga gamna hoise ana lan sah ahi.
en: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD.
text:
NUM 31:16
Thadou: Hiche Numei ho jeh leh Balaam thuhil jeh’a Peor chung chang thu’a Israel chate jouse Pakai adia thet-umtah'a ana chon ahiuvin, hiche jeh chun Pakai mite chunga gamna hoise ana lan sah ahi.
English: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD.

tcz: Hijeh chun tun naosen na hin poh lah uva pasal akai lhah jouse that tauvin, chule numei hija pasal toh ana kitimat sa jouse jong that jeng tauvin ati.
en: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.
text:
NUM 31:17
Thadou: Hijeh chun tun naosen na hin poh lah uva pasal akai lhah jouse that tauvin, chule numei hija pasal toh ana kitimat sa jouse jong that jeng tauvin ati.
English: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

tcz: Ahinlah numei hija pasal toh kitimat lou lai chengse chu nang ho ding in hing hoiyun.
en: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
text:
NUM 31:18
Thadou: Ahinlah numei hija pasal toh kitimat lou lai chengse chu nang ho ding in hing hoiyun.
English: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

tcz: Chule nangho jouse lah’a gal a mithat ahin, mithi tongkha chan chu, ngahmun polam a ni sagi sung naum diu, nangho jouse na hiuvin, galhing a nahin kai jouse’u nithum lhinni le nisagi lhin nia na kisuh theng soh kei diu ahi.
en: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
text:
NUM 31:19
Thadou: Chule nangho jouse lah’a gal a mithat ahin, mithi tongkha chan chu, ngahmun polam a ni sagi sung naum diu, nangho jouse na hiuvin, galhing a nahin kai jouse’u nithum lhinni le nisagi lhin nia na kisuh theng soh kei diu ahi.
English: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

tcz: Na ponsil u kelvun a kisem ahin, savun a kisem, chule thing them akonna kisem manchah jouse aboncha nasuh thengsoh kei diu ahi.
en: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”
text:
NUM 31:20
Thadou: Na ponsil u kelvun a kisem ahin, savun a kisem, chule thing them akonna kisem manchah jouse aboncha nasuh thengsoh kei diu ahi.
English: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”

tcz: Eleazer thempu pan galsat akon ho henga a seiyin, PakaiyinMose a thupeh sa danthu a kisem chondan chu hiche hi ahi.
en: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses.
text:
NUM 31:21
Thadou: Eleazer thempu pan galsat akon ho henga a seiyin, PakaiyinMose a thupeh sa danthu a kisem chondan chu hiche hi ahi.
English: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses.

tcz: Sana leh dangka, sum eng, chule hahngeh jaona bou ahi.
en: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
text:
NUM 31:22
Thadou: Sana leh dangka, sum eng, chule hahngeh jaona bou ahi.
English: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

tcz: Thilkeu mei jin akah vam thei lou chengse bou chu meiya na leudiu chu teng athenga na sim bep diu ahiye. Chule thilkeu ho chu thil theng lou kisopna tui mangcha a na sop theng diu, meiya leuva atheng theilou jouse jong na soptheng tho cheh diu ahi.
en: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.
text:
NUM 31:23
Thadou: Thilkeu mei jin akah vam thei lou chengse bou chu meiya na leudiu chu teng athenga na sim bep diu ahiye. Chule thilkeu ho chu thil theng lou kisopna tui mangcha a na sop theng diu, meiya leuva atheng theilou jouse jong na soptheng tho cheh diu ahi.
English: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

tcz: Nisagi lhinni teng leh na ponsil jouse’u nasop theng soh kei diu, chu teng na then bep diu, hichea chu ngahmun nahung lut thei bep diu ahi.
en: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”
text:
NUM 31:24
Thadou: Nisagi lhinni teng leh na ponsil jouse’u nasop theng soh kei diu, chu teng na then bep diu, hichea chu ngahmun nahung lut thei bep diu ahi.
English: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin a seipeh tan ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 31:25
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin a seipeh tan ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Nang leh Eleazer thempu ahin, khopi sunga lamkai chengse ahin, gal hinga nahin puiyu mihem ho leh ganchaho jouse a-bonchan simtoh tem’un.
en: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

tcz: Galsatna akonna ki chomdoh thilho chu hopni na soding, hopkhat chu galsat miho napeh ding, chule khopi pumpi vang chu chan khatpen chu napeh ding ahi.
en: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
text:
NUM 31:27
Thadou: Galsatna akonna ki chomdoh thilho chu hopni na soding, hopkhat chu galsat miho napeh ding, chule khopi pumpi vang chu chan khatpen chu napeh ding ahi.
English: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

tcz: Galsat miho lah akon chun Pakai ding in kai dong sem in lang, mihem ahin, bongchal, sangan, kelngoi ho jong janga lah a khat cheh na lah doh ding ahi.
en: Levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.
text:
NUM 31:28
Thadou: Galsat miho lah akon chun Pakai ding in kai dong sem in lang, mihem ahin, bongchal, sangan, kelngoi ho jong janga lah a khat cheh na lah doh ding ahi.
English: Levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

tcz: Hiche lahdoh ding ho hi galsat miho chan akon lah doh ding ahin, Pakai dinga thilto ding hichu Eleazer thempupa chang ding ahi.
en: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for the LORD’s wave offering.
text:
NUM 31:29
Thadou: Hiche lahdoh ding ho hi galsat miho chan akon lah doh ding ahin, Pakai dinga thilto ding hichu Eleazer thempupa chang ding ahi.
English: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for the LORD’s wave offering.

tcz: Israel chate jouse lah a konna chan ding chu mihem hihen, bongchal hi jong leh, sangan ho ahin, kelngoi hon, gancha jouse jong somnga lah a khat cheh lahdoh ding, hi chengse chu Pakai houbuh kinbolna mun’a na tong Levi mite chan ding ahiye.
