en: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle.”
text:
NUM 31:30
Thadou: Israel chate jouse lah a konna chan ding chu mihem hihen, bongchal hi jong leh, sangan ho ahin, kelngoi hon, gancha jouse jong somnga lah a khat cheh lahdoh ding, hi chengse chu Pakai houbuh kinbolna mun’a na tong Levi mite chan ding ahiye.
English: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle.”

tcz: Pakai thupeh bang chun Mose leh Eleazer thempupan jong abol lhon tan ahi.
en: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
NUM 31:31
Thadou: Pakai thupeh bang chun Mose leh Eleazer thempupan jong abol lhon tan ahi.
English: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Gal muna kon galsat mihon ahin chomdoh u gal thil jouse ahin, kelngoi sang ja gup leh sang som sagi leh sang somnga alhing in ahi.
en: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
text:
NUM 31:32
Thadou: Gal muna kon galsat mihon ahin chomdoh u gal thil jouse ahin, kelngoi sang ja gup leh sang som sagi leh sang somnga alhing in ahi.
English: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

tcz: Chule bong sang somsagi leh sangni ma alhing in ahi.
en: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,
text:
NUM 31:33
Thadou: Chule bong sang somsagi leh sangni ma alhing in ahi.
English: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

tcz: Sangan vang chu sang somgup le sang khat ahi.
en: sixty-one thousand donkeys,
text:
NUM 31:34
Thadou: Sangan vang chu sang somgup le sang khat ahi.
English: sixty-one thousand donkeys,

tcz: Mihem pasal toh kitimat loulai numei agomma sang somthum leh sang ni alhing in ahi.
en: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.
text:
NUM 31:35
Thadou: Mihem pasal toh kitimat loulai numei agomma sang somthum leh sang ni alhing in ahi.
English: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

tcz: Galsat akondoh ho chan ding chu kelngoi sang jathum le sang som thum leh sang sagi toh janga ahi.
en: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;

tcz: Hichengse lah a Pakai chan ding chu kelngoi jagup leh som sagi leh nga alhing in ahi.
en: and the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.
text:
NUM 31:37
Thadou: Hichengse lah a Pakai chan ding chu kelngoi jagup leh som sagi leh nga alhing in ahi.
English: and the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

tcz: Galsat miho chan ding chu sang somthum le sang gup ahin, hiche lah achun Pakai chan ding chu somsagi leh ni alhing in ahi.
en: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD’s tribute was seventy-two.
text:
NUM 31:38
Thadou: Galsat miho chan ding chu sang somthum le sang gup ahin, hiche lah achun Pakai chan ding chu somsagi leh ni alhing in ahi.
English: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD’s tribute was seventy-two.

tcz: Galsat miho chan ding chu sang som thum leh janga alhing in, Pakai chan ding chu somgup leh khat alhing in ahi.
en: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the LORD’s tribute was sixty-one.
text:
NUM 31:39
Thadou: Galsat miho chan ding chu sang som thum leh janga alhing in, Pakai chan ding chu somgup leh khat alhing in ahi.
English: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the LORD’s tribute was sixty-one.

tcz: Galsat miho chan ding mihem chu sangsom le sang gup ahin, Pakai chan ding mihem chu mihem somthum le ni ahiye.
en: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the LORD’s tribute was thirty-two persons.
text:
NUM 31:40
Thadou: Galsat miho chan ding mihem chu sangsom le sang gup ahin, Pakai chan ding mihem chu mihem somthum le ni ahiye.
English: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the LORD’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

tcz: PakaiyinMose athupeh bang chun Mose chun Pakai dinga a thilto-lom chu Eleazer thempupa henga apedoh tan ahi.
en: Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
NUM 31:41
Thadou: PakaiyinMose athupeh bang chun Mose chun Pakai dinga a thilto-lom chu Eleazer thempupa henga apedoh tan ahi.
English: Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Galsat miho chan akon ahin Israel chate chan akon akeh khat cheh Mose’n achomma a koidoh in ahi.
en: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought
text:
NUM 31:42
Thadou: Galsat miho chan akon ahin Israel chate chan akon akeh khat cheh Mose’n achomma a koidoh in ahi.
English: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought

tcz: Khopi chan dinga kikheng doh akeh khat jat mong mong chu kelngoi sang jathum leh sang som thum sang sagi leh janga alhing in ahi.
en: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
text:
NUM 31:43
Thadou: Khopi chan dinga kikheng doh akeh khat jat mong mong chu kelngoi sang jathum leh sang som thum sang sagi leh janga alhing in ahi.
English: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

tcz: Bong vang chu sang somthum leh sang gup alhing in ahi.
en: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,
text:
NUM 31:44
Thadou: Bong vang chu sang somthum leh sang gup alhing in ahi.
English: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

tcz: Sangan chu sang somthum leh janga alhing in ahi.
en: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
text:
NUM 31:45
Thadou: Sangan chu sang somthum leh janga alhing in ahi.
English: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

tcz: Mihem mong mong chu sang somthum le sanggup alhing in ahi.
en: and sixteen thousand persons),
text:
NUM 31:46
Thadou: Mihem mong mong chu sang somthum le sanggup alhing in ahi.
English: and sixteen thousand persons),

tcz: Israel chate chan akon chun Mose’n phabep khat akheng doh kit in, Pakayin Mose henga asei bang in, Mihem ahin ganchalah akon hileh somnga lah a kon chun khat cheh alheng doh in, hichengse chu Pakai houbuh alhacha a pang Levi mite ho chu apen ahi.
en: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
NUM 31:47
Thadou: Israel chate chan akon chun Mose’n phabep khat akheng doh kit in, Pakayin Mose henga asei bang in, Mihem ahin ganchalah akon hileh somnga lah a kon chun khat cheh alheng doh in, hichengse chu Pakai houbuh alhacha a pang Levi mite ho chu apen ahi.
English: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Chuleh Galsat miho asang sang chunga vaihom thuneiya pang, asang sang chunga vaihom le aja ja chunga vaihomma pang ho chu Mose henga ahung khom soh keiyun ahi.
en: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
text:
NUM 31:48
Thadou: Chuleh Galsat miho asang sang chunga vaihom thuneiya pang, asang sang chunga vaihom le aja ja chunga vaihomma pang ho chu Mose henga ahung khom soh keiyun ahi.
English: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.

tcz: Galsat lamkai ho chun Mose henga hiti hin aseitaovin ahi. Na lhacha a pang keihon ka thuneina noi uva um galsat miho abonchan ka sim toh soh kei un, mihem khat jeng cha jong kalah uva alhasam le amang thai aum poi, atiuve.
en: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.
text:
NUM 31:49
Thadou: Galsat lamkai ho chun Mose henga hiti hin aseitaovin ahi. Na lhacha a pang keihon ka thuneina noi uva um galsat miho abonchan ka sim toh soh kei un, mihem khat jeng cha jong kalah uva alhasam le amang thai aum poi, atiuve.
English: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

tcz: Pakai ding’a thilto chu kei hon mihem ama ama kipehdoh na cheh in, sana kol a kisem chaokol ahin, chao jang, mohor numna khut jem, bilba ho, khi vui ho, hichengse akon in Pakai angsunga keiho kithoidam na ding in ka hin choi tauve, tin asei un ahi.
en: We have brought the LORD’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before the LORD.”
text:
NUM 31:50
Thadou: Pakai ding’a thilto chu kei hon mihem ama ama kipehdoh na cheh in, sana kol a kisem chaokol ahin, chao jang, mohor numna khut jem, bilba ho, khi vui ho, hichengse akon in Pakai angsunga keiho kithoidam na ding in ka hin choi tauve, tin asei un ahi.
English: We have brought the LORD’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before the LORD.”

tcz: Chuin Mose leh Eleazer thempupan Galsat mihon ahin choi thilo jouse chu a kilah lhon tan ahi.
en: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.
text:
NUM 31:51
Thadou: Chuin Mose leh Eleazer thempupan Galsat mihon ahin choi thilo jouse chu a kilah lhon tan ahi.
English: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

tcz: Pakai henga amanin atodoh thilto ho chu sana bouseh chu dangka shekel sang som le sanggup toh jasagi leh somnga alhing in, aboncha galsat lamkai ho, asang sang chung leh aja ja chunga thunei hon a todoh u ahi.
en: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.
text:
NUM 31:52
Thadou: Pakai henga amanin atodoh thilto ho chu sana bouseh chu dangka shekel sang som le sanggup toh jasagi leh somnga alhing in, aboncha galsat lamkai ho, asang sang chung leh aja ja chunga thunei hon a todoh u ahi.
English: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

tcz: Galsat akon miho jouse chun ama ama chan ding dol thil akilah soh keiyun ahi.
en: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.
text:
NUM 31:53
Thadou: Galsat akon miho jouse chun ama ama chan ding dol thil akilah soh keiyun ahi.
English: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.

tcz: Mose leh Eleazer chun galsat mi asang sang chunga thunei vaihom apang ho akon chun sana tampi chu ala lhon tan, Pakai angsunga Israel chate geldoh a aum jing na ding in kikhopna ponbuh sung lam achun ahin choi lut lhon tan ahi.
en: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
text:
NUM 31:54
Thadou: Mose leh Eleazer chun galsat mi asang sang chunga thunei vaihom apang ho akon chun sana tampi chu ala lhon tan, Pakai angsunga Israel chate geldoh a aum jing na ding in kikhopna ponbuh sung lam achun ahin choi lut lhon tan ahi.
English: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.

tcz: Reuben leh Gad chilhahten bong hon tampi anavul un ahi. Chuin Jazer gam leh Gilead gam amudoh taovin ahile, hiche mun chu bong honte vahna ding’a ki lem tah a sohdoh tan ahi.
en: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.
text:
NUM 32:1
Thadou: Reuben leh Gad chilhahten bong hon tampi anavul un ahi. Chuin Jazer gam leh Gilead gam amudoh taovin ahile, hiche mun chu bong honte vahna ding’a ki lem tah a sohdoh tan ahi.
English: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.

tcz: Chuin Gad chate ahin Reuben chate ahin Mose leh Eleazer thempupa leh khoppi lamkai ho jouse hengah ahung un hiti hin a sei tauvin ahi.
en: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,
text:
NUM 32:2
Thadou: Chuin Gad chate ahin Reuben chate ahin Mose leh Eleazer thempupa leh khoppi lamkai ho jouse hengah ahung un hiti hin a sei tauvin ahi.
English: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

tcz: Dibon leh Ataroth, Jazer, Nimrah, Hershbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo chule Beon ahiuve.
en: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
text:
NUM 32:3
Thadou: Dibon leh Ataroth, Jazer, Nimrah, Hershbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo chule Beon ahiuve.
English: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

tcz: Pakaiyin mitmu changtah ah hichete ho Israel khoppi ana suhmang ahin, hiche gamsung chu bong vahna ding mong mong in aum tan, lhacha a pang ho jeng in jong bong ka nei uve atiuvin ahi.
en: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”
text:
NUM 32:4
Thadou: Pakaiyin mitmu changtah ah hichete ho Israel khoppi ana suhmang ahin, hiche gamsung chu bong vahna ding mong mong in aum tan, lhacha a pang ho jeng in jong bong ka nei uve atiuvin ahi.
English: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”

tcz: Chuin hiti hin aseijun, namitmua na lunglhaina lam katouva ahile, hiche gamsung hi nalhacha keiho chanvou in neisem peh tauvin, Jordan vadung gal lamma vang nei puida tauvin, tin asei uve.
en: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”
text:
NUM 32:5
Thadou: Chuin hiti hin aseijun, namitmua na lunglhaina lam katouva ahile, hiche gamsung hi nalhacha keiho chanvou in neisem peh tauvin, Jordan vadung gal lamma vang nei puida tauvin, tin asei uve.
English: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

tcz: Mose’n jong Gad leh Reuben chate henga aseijin, na sopite hou galsat laitah a hi nangho tou thip beh a um deng ding na tiuham.
en: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
text:
NUM 32:6
Thadou: Mose’n jong Gad leh Reuben chate henga aseijin, na sopite hou galsat laitah a hi nangho tou thip beh a um deng ding na tiuham.
English: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in a pehsa hiche gamsunga alut diu chu ipi dinga na lungthoi sah jeng’u ham?
en: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?
text:
NUM 32:7
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in a pehsa hiche gamsunga alut diu chu ipi dinga na lungthoi sah jeng’u ham?
English: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?

tcz: Napate uvin jong Kadesh Barnea apat hiche gam velhi dinga ka sol chun hiti hin asei un ahi.
en: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
text:
NUM 32:8
Thadou: Napate uvin jong Kadesh Barnea apat hiche gam velhi dinga ka sol chun hiti hin asei un ahi.
English: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

tcz: Abonchauvin Eshcol phaicham geijin akitol tauvin, hiche gamsung chu amit tah uvin agamu tauve, Pakaiyin Israel chate apehsa gamsung alut diu sa chu ana lung thoisah jeng tauvin ahi.
en: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
text:
NUM 32:9
Thadou: Abonchauvin Eshcol phaicham geijin akitol tauvin, hiche gamsung chu amit tah uvin agamu tauve, Pakaiyin Israel chate apehsa gamsung alut diu sa chu ana lung thoisah jeng tauvin ahi.
English: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

tcz: Hiche nikho chun Pakai, Pathen alung hang doh jeng tan ahile hiti hin ki hahselna anei tan ahi.
en: The LORD’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,
text:
NUM 32:10
Thadou: Hiche nikho chun Pakai, Pathen alung hang doh jeng tan ahile hiti hin ki hahselna anei tan ahi.
English: The LORD’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,

tcz: Kum somnia lhah chunglam se, Egypt gamsung’a konna hungpot doh hon, Isaac, Abraham leh Jacob henga ka kitep nasa gamsunga chu lut theilou hel diu ahitai. Ajeh chu amaho hin cham kimsel in kanung ajui tapouvin ahi.
en: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,
text:
NUM 32:11
Thadou: Kum somnia lhah chunglam se, Egypt gamsung’a konna hungpot doh hon, Isaac, Abraham leh Jacob henga ka kitep nasa gamsunga chu lut theilou hel diu ahitai. Ajeh chu amaho hin cham kimsel in kanung ajui tapouvin ahi.
English: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,

tcz: Keniz apat Jephunneh cha Caleb leh Nun chapa Joshua kalvalla adang koima chan hiche gamsung khu amuthei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amani hin Chamkim sella Pakai, Pathen nung ajuilhon ahi.
en: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed the LORD completely.’
text:
NUM 32:12
Thadou: Keniz apat Jephunneh cha Caleb leh Nun chapa Joshua kalvalla adang koima chan hiche gamsung khu amuthei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amani hin Chamkim sella Pakai, Pathen nung ajuilhon ahi.
English: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed the LORD completely.’

tcz: Israel chung’a Pakai, Pathen alunghang jeng tan ahile, chuin Israel mite hiche khang mite ho chu Pakai mitmua thilse bol jouse athigam kahsen kum som li sung in gamthip noiya avale sah tan ahi.
en: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD’s sight was consumed.
text:
NUM 32:13
Thadou: Israel chung’a Pakai, Pathen alunghang jeng tan ahile, chuin Israel mite hiche khang mite ho chu Pakai mitmua thilse bol jouse athigam kahsen kum som li sung in gamthip noiya avale sah tan ahi.
English: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD’s sight was consumed.

tcz: Nangho jong napu napate hou akonna chonsetna chun nahin jui peh taovin, hijeh chun Israel mite chunga Pakai lung hanna chu asang jocheh a lung hansah ding nagel uve!
en: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
text:
NUM 32:14
Thadou: Nangho jong napu napate hou akonna chonsetna chun nahin jui peh taovin, hijeh chun Israel mite chunga Pakai lung hanna chu asang jocheh a lung hansah ding nagel uve!
English: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

tcz: Chule Pakai nung najuina uva konna na kihei mang hel uva ahile, aman hiche mite hohi gamthip noiya don louva ahin koi ding, chu teng hiche mite ho chunga hi manthahna na alhunsah teitei ding ahi tai, ati.
en: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”
text:
NUM 32:15
Thadou: Chule Pakai nung najuina uva konna na kihei mang hel uva ahile, aman hiche mite hohi gamthip noiya don louva ahin koi ding, chu teng hiche mite ho chunga hi manthahna na alhunsah teitei ding ahi tai, ati.
English: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”

tcz: Chuin Gad leh Reuben chate Mose ang sung’a ahung lut tauvin, hiti hin asei uve, hiche muna hin kelngoinou tampi ka nei uvin, hijeh chun kelngoi kul ka sempeh uva, chule ka cha ka naote hou dinga jong chenna in phabep ka sah peh diu ahi.
en: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;

tcz: Khat cheh in manchah kapat uva, Israel mite gal lamkaiya ka pan diu, amaho jouse chenna ding mun kamu kahse uva kigosa demma umjing ka hiuvin, ahinlah a gamsunga chengte ho jal a hi numei chapang ho kulpi kaikhum ma ven bit ding ka tiu ahi.
en: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
text:
NUM 32:17
Thadou: Khat cheh in manchah kapat uva, Israel mite gal lamkaiya ka pan diu, amaho jouse chenna ding mun kamu kahse uva kigosa demma umjing ka hiuvin, ahinlah a gamsunga chengte ho jal a hi numei chapang ho kulpi kaikhum ma ven bit ding ka tiu ahi.
English: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

tcz: Chule Israel chaten khat cheh a chen mun anei kahse’a keiho inlam hung kile lou ding kahi tauve.
en: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.
text:
NUM 32:18
Thadou: Chule Israel chaten khat cheh a chen mun anei kahse’a keiho inlam hung kile lou ding kahi tauve.
English: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho toh Jordan vadung gal lamma khu gou kalo khom thei lou diu ahi. Solam gamkai Jordan lam hi keiho goulo ding a hung kisep doh ahitai.
en: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”
text:
NUM 32:19
Thadou: Ajeh chu amaho toh Jordan vadung gal lamma khu gou kalo khom thei lou diu ahi. Solam gamkai Jordan lam hi keiho goulo ding a hung kisep doh ahitai.
English: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

tcz: Chuin Mose’n jong amaho jouse henga aseijin, na bonchao va hitia hi na bolsoh kei diu, khat cheh manchah toh na kondoh uva, Pakai ansunga galsat dinga na kon doh sohkei diu ahi.
en: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,
text:
NUM 32:20
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n jong amaho jouse henga aseijin, na bonchao va hitia hi na bolsoh kei diu, khat cheh manchah toh na kondoh uva, Pakai ansunga galsat dinga na kon doh sohkei diu ahi.
English: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,

tcz: Gal manchah choi jouse Jordan vadung na galkai soh kei diu, chu teng Pakaiyin amasang lama amel mate asat gamhel kahsea Pakai angsunga gal na sat jing diu ahi.
en: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven out his enemies from before him,
text:
NUM 32:21
Thadou: Gal manchah choi jouse Jordan vadung na galkai soh kei diu, chu teng Pakaiyin amasang lama amel mate asat gamhel kahsea Pakai angsunga gal na sat jing diu ahi.
English: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

tcz: Hiche gamsung chu Pakaija konna athua ki nunsah na ahung um doh teng leh na boncha uva Israel mite na chung uva kigahna ho Jousea konna na onthol diu, na hung kinung lekit uva chu teng hiche gamsung hi Pakai, Pathen jal'a nangho jouse chenna hiding ahi tai.
en: and the land is subdued before the LORD; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
text:
NUM 32:22
Thadou: Hiche gamsung chu Pakaija konna athua ki nunsah na ahung um doh teng leh na boncha uva Israel mite na chung uva kigahna ho Jousea konna na onthol diu, na hung kinung lekit uva chu teng hiche gamsung hi Pakai, Pathen jal'a nangho jouse chenna hiding ahi tai.
English: and the land is subdued before the LORD; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

tcz: Hi tabang’a hi nabol lou uva ahile, nangho jouse jong Pakai doumah a umna hidiu, hiche na chonset nau hin na hin holdoh teidiu ahi, tihi kichih theijun, ati.
en: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD; and be sure your sin will find you out.
text:
NUM 32:23
Thadou: Hi tabang’a hi nabol lou uva ahile, nangho jouse jong Pakai doumah a umna hidiu, hiche na chonset nau hin na hin holdoh teidiu ahi, tihi kichih theijun, ati.
English: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD; and be sure your sin will find you out.

tcz: Na numei chapang ho ding in chen mun phabep sahpeh unlang, na kelngoi tehou kul jong sem peh uvin lang, amavang na kitepna’u aboncha na bolsoh kei diu ahi.
en: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”
text:
NUM 32:24
Thadou: Na numei chapang ho ding in chen mun phabep sahpeh unlang, na kelngoi tehou kul jong sem peh uvin lang, amavang na kitepna’u aboncha na bolsoh kei diu ahi.
English: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

tcz: Chuin Gad leh Reuben chate hon Pakai henga hiti hin asei tauvin ahi. Nei thupeh bang bang uva na lhacha ten ka bol jing diu ahiye.
en: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
text:
NUM 32:25
Thadou: Chuin Gad leh Reuben chate hon Pakai henga hiti hin asei tauvin ahi. Nei thupeh bang bang uva na lhacha ten ka bol jing diu ahiye.
English: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

tcz: Ka chasen jouseu leh ka jite hou, kelngoite jouse abonchan Gilead khopi mun alha ngai diu ahi tai.
en: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

tcz: Ka heng uva na thu lhah banga hi nalhacha te galman chah panna Pakai angsunga galsat ding in Jordan vadung galkai soh kei diu kahi, ati.
en: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord says.”
text:
NUM 32:27
Thadou: Ka heng uva na thu lhah banga hi nalhacha te galman chah panna Pakai angsunga galsat ding in Jordan vadung galkai soh kei diu kahi, ati.
English: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord says.”

tcz: Chuin Mose’n aboncha’u chung thudol a Eleazer thempupa ahin Nun chapa Joshua chule Israel chate phung kailhah ama ama pa janglhah cheh henga thu ape tan ahi.
en: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.
text:
NUM 32:28
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n aboncha’u chung thudol a Eleazer thempupa ahin Nun chapa Joshua chule Israel chate phung kailhah ama ama pa janglhah cheh henga thu ape tan ahi.
English: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.

tcz: Mose’n amaho henga hiti chun thu aseijin, Gad chate ahin Reuben chate abonchauva galmanchah choiya Pakai angsunga galsat dinga Jordan vadung agalkai soh kei uva, agam jeng jong hi Pakai angsunga ama thua anun a ahile, Gilead gam mun hi Amaho chen mun ding’a na peh doh jeng diu ahi.
en: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

tcz: Ahinlah amaho hin gal manchah la kichoi ngal uva nangho jaona agal kaikhom tah lou uva ahile, amaho hin Canaan gamsung’a nangho jouse lah’a chenna mun anei lou diu ahi.
en: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
text:
NUM 32:30
Thadou: Ahinlah amaho hin gal manchah la kichoi ngal uva nangho jaona agal kaikhom tah lou uva ahile, amaho hin Canaan gamsung’a nangho jouse lah’a chenna mun anei lou diu ahi.
English: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

tcz: Chuin Gad chate leh Reuben chaten ahenga hiti hin asei un, na lhacha ho josue henga Pakaiyin asei bang banga keihon jong ka suh-bukim soh kei diu ahi, tai.
en: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.
text:
NUM 32:31
Thadou: Chuin Gad chate leh Reuben chaten ahenga hiti hin asei un, na lhacha ho josue henga Pakaiyin asei bang banga keihon jong ka suh-bukim soh kei diu ahi, tai.
English: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.

tcz: Ka boncha uva galmanchah choija ka kipat doh diu Pakai angsunga konna Jordan ka galkai uva Canaan gamsung ka lut diu, ka chen mun ahin ka goulo diu ijakai Jordan vadung gal lamma ana umsa hita hen, atiuve.
en: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
text:
NUM 32:32
Thadou: Ka boncha uva galmanchah choija ka kipat doh diu Pakai angsunga konna Jordan ka galkai uva Canaan gamsung ka lut diu, ka chen mun ahin ka goulo diu ijakai Jordan vadung gal lamma ana umsa hita hen, atiuve.
English: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

tcz: Chuin Mose’n jong Gad chate ahin Reuben chate ahin Joseph chapa Manasseh phung phabep chu Amor mite lengpa Sihon lenggam leh Og lenggam, agamgi chin dunga khopi josue hain chule agam sunga khopi jouse abonchan apedoh sohkei tan ahi.
en: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
text:
NUM 32:33
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n jong Gad chate ahin Reuben chate ahin Joseph chapa Manasseh phung phabep chu Amor mite lengpa Sihon lenggam leh Og lenggam, agamgi chin dunga khopi josue hain chule agam sunga khopi jouse abonchan apedoh sohkei tan ahi.
English: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

tcz: Gad chaten khopi atundoh hou chu Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
en: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
text:
NUM 32:34
Thadou: Gad chaten khopi atundoh hou chu Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
English: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

tcz: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
en: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
text:
NUM 32:35
Thadou: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
English: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

tcz: Beth-nimrah, Beth-haran khopi jouse chu kul akai khum soh keiyun, kelngoite um nading mun jong tampi asem doh peh tauvin ahi.
en: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.
text:
NUM 32:36
Thadou: Beth-nimrah, Beth-haran khopi jouse chu kul akai khum soh keiyun, kelngoite um nading mun jong tampi asem doh peh tauvin ahi.
English: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.

tcz: Reuben chate jong chun Heshbon leh Elealeh khopi Kiria-thaim,
en: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
text:
NUM 32:37
Thadou: Reuben chate jong chun Heshbon leh Elealeh khopi Kiria-thaim,
English: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

tcz: Nebo, Baalmeon hichengse hi atundoh tauvin, main jeng u-jong akhelsoh hel tauve, Sibmah jong anatungdoh uvin, amahon atundoh khopi josue abonchan amin akhelsoh keityun ahi.
en: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.
text:
NUM 32:38
Thadou: Nebo, Baalmeon hichengse hi atundoh tauvin, main jeng u-jong akhelsoh hel tauve, Sibmah jong anatungdoh uvin, amahon atundoh khopi josue abonchan amin akhelsoh keityun ahi.
English: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.

tcz: Chuin Manasseh chapa Machir chate acheuvin Gilead agasat uvin ahile ahin jou tauve, agamsunga ana cheng Amor mite chu abonchaovin adel jam gamhel taovin ahi.
en: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.
text:
NUM 32:39
Thadou: Chuin Manasseh chapa Machir chate acheuvin Gilead agasat uvin ahile ahin jou tauve, agamsunga ana cheng Amor mite chu abonchaovin adel jam gamhel taovin ahi.
English: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.

tcz: Mose’n jong Manasseh chapa Machir chu Gilead henga ape doh tan, khosunga chun acheng khom tauvin ahi.
en: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
text:
NUM 32:40
Thadou: Mose’n jong Manasseh chapa Machir chu Gilead henga ape doh tan, khosunga chun acheng khom tauvin ahi.
English: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.

tcz: Manasseh chapa Jair chu a kipat doh kit tan a kimvel’a khoneo hochu abonchan agalo tan, hi chengse chu Jair ngahmun asah soh keiyin ahi.
en: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.
text:
NUM 32:41
Thadou: Manasseh chapa Jair chu a kipat doh kit tan a kimvel’a khoneo hochu abonchan agalo tan, hi chengse chu Jair ngahmun asah soh keiyin ahi.
English: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.

tcz: Hitichun Nobah jong akondoh paiyin Kenath khopi abonchan agalo kittan, hichengse chu amin Naboh aputsah tan ahi.
en: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
text:
NUM 32:42
Thadou: Hitichun Nobah jong akondoh paiyin Kenath khopi abonchan agalo kittan, hichengse chu amin Naboh aputsah tan ahi.
English: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

tcz: Egypt gamsunga konna ahin lhonpi Mose leh Aaron makaina kon ahung kitol uva kon in, a kholjin na’u chan chin bannei chan ahung um peh in ahi.
en: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
text:
NUM 33:1
Thadou: Egypt gamsunga konna ahin lhonpi Mose leh Aaron makaina kon ahung kitol uva kon in, a kholjin na’u chan chin bannei chan ahung um peh in ahi.
English: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

tcz: Hiti chun Pakai, Pathen thu peh bang bang chun Mose’n jong bannei chan anajih lut tan, ahung kipat doh na’u mun jouse banga bannei cha ahung kholjin na hou chu hiche hi ahi.
en: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of the LORD. These are their journeys according to their starting points.
text:
NUM 33:2
Thadou: Hiti chun Pakai, Pathen thu peh bang bang chun Mose’n jong bannei chan anajih lut tan, ahung kipat doh na’u mun jouse banga bannei cha ahung kholjin na hou chu hiche hi ahi.
English: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of the LORD. These are their journeys according to their starting points.

tcz: Lhamasa pen, nisom le ninga lhinni chun Israel chate Rameses khopi lam akon in ahung kitol tauvin, kalchuh kut kichai sun kim don tah in Egypt mite mitmu tah in ahung ki toldoh tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
text:
NUM 33:3
Thadou: Lhamasa pen, nisom le ninga lhinni chun Israel chate Rameses khopi lam akon in ahung kitol tauvin, kalchuh kut kichai sun kim don tah in Egypt mite mitmu tah in ahung ki toldoh tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

tcz: Hiti chun Egypt mite gamsung a kon’a chapa peng masa chan chun thina atoh tan, Pakaiyin thina atosah chan un Amahon jong akivui jing tauvin, ajeh chu Pakaiyin Egypt mite lah a milimdoi kisem thua umho chung’a jong thutanna alhunsah a hitia hi alhun den jeng u ahi tai.
en: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck among them. The LORD also executed judgments on their gods.
text:
NUM 33:4
Thadou: Hiti chun Egypt mite gamsung a kon’a chapa peng masa chan chun thina atoh tan, Pakaiyin thina atosah chan un Amahon jong akivui jing tauvin, ajeh chu Pakaiyin Egypt mite lah a milimdoi kisem thua umho chung’a jong thutanna alhunsah a hitia hi alhun den jeng u ahi tai.
English: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck among them. The LORD also executed judgments on their gods.

tcz: Israel chate chu Rameses khopi akon in ahung kitol pan tauvin, Succoth muna ngahmun a kisem un a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.
text:
NUM 33:5
Thadou: Israel chate chu Rameses khopi akon in ahung kitol pan tauvin, Succoth muna ngahmun a kisem un a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
English: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

tcz: Succoth muna kon chun akitol kit uvin, gammang lah a Etham kiti laiya chun ngahmun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
text:
NUM 33:6
Thadou: Succoth muna kon chun akitol kit uvin, gammang lah a Etham kiti laiya chun ngahmun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

tcz: Etham muna kon in akitol kit tauvin Baal-zephon solam gamkaija um Pihahiroth lama akile tol kit un, Migdol maija chun ngahmun a kisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.
text:
NUM 33:7
Thadou: Etham muna kon in akitol kit tauvin Baal-zephon solam gamkaija um Pihahiroth lama akile tol kit un, Migdol maija chun ngahmun a kisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.

tcz: Hahiroth akon chun akitol kit tauvin tuikhanglen lai lung chu apal galkai uvin Etham gam thip noiya chun ni thum sung in akitol tol tauvin, Marah kiti laiya chun ngahmun a kisem uvin hiche muna chun a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
text:
NUM 33:8
Thadou: Hahiroth akon chun akitol kit tauvin tuikhanglen lai lung chu apal galkai uvin Etham gam thip noiya chun ni thum sung in akitol tol tauvin, Marah kiti laiya chun ngahmun a kisem uvin hiche muna chun a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

tcz: Marah akon chun akitol kit tauvin Elim mun apha tauvin ahile hiche muna chun tuinah som-le-ni ana um'in, tom phung jong somsagi akeh in, hikomma chun ngah mun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.
text:
NUM 33:9
Thadou: Marah akon chun akitol kit tauvin Elim mun apha tauvin ahile hiche muna chun tuinah som-le-ni ana um'in, tom phung jong somsagi akeh in, hikomma chun ngah mun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.

tcz: Elim akon in akitol kit tauvin Tuikhanglen sen pang’a chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kichol do tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
text:
NUM 33:10
Thadou: Elim akon in akitol kit tauvin Tuikhanglen sen pang’a chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kichol do tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

tcz: Tuikhanglen sen pang a kon chun a kitol kit tauvin, Sin gammang lah a chun ngahmun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
text:
NUM 33:11
Thadou: Tuikhanglen sen pang a kon chun a kitol kit tauvin, Sin gammang lah a chun ngahmun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

tcz: Sin gammang lah akon chun akitol kit tauvin, Dophkah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
text:
NUM 33:12
Thadou: Sin gammang lah akon chun akitol kit tauvin, Dophkah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

tcz: Dophkah muna kon chun a kitol doh kit uvin, Alush kiti muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin a kicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
text:
NUM 33:13
Thadou: Dophkah muna kon chun a kitol doh kit uvin, Alush kiti muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin a kicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

tcz: Alush muna kon in akitoldoh kit tauvin, Rephidim muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin a kicholdo tauvin ahile hiche muna chun tui don ding ana um tapon ahi.
en: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
text:
NUM 33:14
Thadou: Alush muna kon in akitoldoh kit tauvin, Rephidim muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin a kicholdo tauvin ahile hiche muna chun tui don ding ana um tapon ahi.
English: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

tcz: Rephidim muna kon chun a kitol kit tauvin Sinai gamthip laiya ngahmun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
text:
NUM 33:15
Thadou: Rephidim muna kon chun a kitol kit tauvin Sinai gamthip laiya ngahmun akisem uvin, a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

tcz: Sinai gamthip laiya kon chun akitol kit tauvin Kibroth-hattaavah muna chun ngahmun aki sem uvin aki choldo tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.
text:
NUM 33:16
Thadou: Sinai gamthip laiya kon chun akitol kit tauvin Kibroth-hattaavah muna chun ngahmun aki sem uvin aki choldo tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.

tcz: Kibroth-hattaavah akon akitol kit tauvin Hezeroth muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
text:
NUM 33:17
Thadou: Kibroth-hattaavah akon akitol kit tauvin Hezeroth muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

tcz: Hazeroth muna kon in akitol kit tauvin Rithmah muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
text:
NUM 33:18
Thadou: Hazeroth muna kon in akitol kit tauvin Rithmah muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

tcz: Rithmah akon in akitol kit tauvin Rimmonperez muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.
text:
NUM 33:19
Thadou: Rithmah akon in akitol kit tauvin Rimmonperez muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.

tcz: Rimmon-perez akon in akitol kit tauvin Libnah muna ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.
text:
NUM 33:20
Thadou: Rimmon-perez akon in akitol kit tauvin Libnah muna ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.

tcz: Libnah akon chun a kipatdoh uvin Rissah muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
text:
NUM 33:21
Thadou: Libnah akon chun a kipatdoh uvin Rissah muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

tcz: Rissah akon a kitol kit uvin Kehelathah muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin akicholdo kittauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
text:
NUM 33:22
Thadou: Rissah akon a kitol kit uvin Kehelathah muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin akicholdo kittauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

tcz: Kehelathah akon in akitol kit tauvin Shepher molsang achun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.
text:
NUM 33:23
Thadou: Kehelathah akon in akitol kit tauvin Shepher molsang achun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.

tcz: Shepher molsang akon akitol kittaovin Haradah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.
text:
NUM 33:24
Thadou: Shepher molsang akon akitol kittaovin Haradah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

tcz: Haradah akon akitol kittaovin Makheloth muna ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
text:
NUM 33:25
Thadou: Haradah akon akitol kittaovin Makheloth muna ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

tcz: Makheloth akon in akitol kit tauvin Tahath muna ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo kittaovin ahi.
en: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.
text:
NUM 33:26
Thadou: Makheloth akon in akitol kit tauvin Tahath muna ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo kittaovin ahi.
English: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

tcz: Tahath akon akitol kittaovin Terah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.
text:
NUM 33:27
Thadou: Tahath akon akitol kittaovin Terah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

tcz: Terah akon in akitol kit uvin Mithkah achun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.
text:
NUM 33:28
Thadou: Terah akon in akitol kit uvin Mithkah achun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo kit tauvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

tcz: Mithcah akon in a kitol kit uvin Hashmonah muna ngah mun a kisem uvin aki choldo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
text:
NUM 33:29
Thadou: Mithcah akon in a kitol kit uvin Hashmonah muna ngah mun a kisem uvin aki choldo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

tcz: Hashmonah akon a kitol kit uvin, Moseroth kiti laiya chun ngahmun akisem uvin aki choldo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
text:
NUM 33:30
Thadou: Hashmonah akon a kitol kit uvin, Moseroth kiti laiya chun ngahmun akisem uvin aki choldo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

tcz: Moseroth akon in akitol kit uvin Benejaakan kiti laiya chun ngahmun akisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.
text:
NUM 33:31
Thadou: Moseroth akon in akitol kit uvin Benejaakan kiti laiya chun ngahmun akisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.

tcz: Bene-jaakan kitilaija kon chun akitol kit tauvin, Hor-haggidgad muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.
text:
NUM 33:32
Thadou: Bene-jaakan kitilaija kon chun akitol kit tauvin, Hor-haggidgad muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.

tcz: Hor-haggidgad mun laiya kon in akitol kit tauvin Jotbathah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin aki choldo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
text:
NUM 33:33
Thadou: Hor-haggidgad mun laiya kon in akitol kit tauvin Jotbathah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin aki choldo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

tcz: Jotbathah akon in aki tol kit uvin Abronah kiti laiya chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.
text:
NUM 33:34
Thadou: Jotbathah akon in aki tol kit uvin Abronah kiti laiya chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

tcz: Abronah akon in akitol kit uvin Ezion-geber muna chun ngahmun aki sem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.
text:
NUM 33:35
Thadou: Abronah akon in akitol kit uvin Ezion-geber muna chun ngahmun aki sem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.

tcz: Ezion-geber kiti laiya kon chun a kitol kit uvin, Kadesh muna chun naghmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahin.
en: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
text:
NUM 33:36
Thadou: Ezion-geber kiti laiya kon chun a kitol kit uvin, Kadesh muna chun naghmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahin.
English: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

tcz: Kadesh akon chun akitol kit uvin Edom gami Hor mol chunga chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
text:
NUM 33:37
Thadou: Kadesh akon chun akitol kit uvin Edom gami Hor mol chunga chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen thupeh dungjui in Aaron chu Hor molsang lama akal tou tan, hiche muna chu a thitan ahi. Ama thi nikho chu Israel chtae Egypt gamsunga konna ahung ki tol kal u kumsom li lhin kum, lhanga lhinna nikho masapen ni ahiye.
en: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
text:
NUM 33:38
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen thupeh dungjui in Aaron chu Hor molsang lama akal tou tan, hiche muna chu a thitan ahi. Ama thi nikho chu Israel chtae Egypt gamsunga konna ahung ki tol kal u kumsom li lhin kum, lhanga lhinna nikho masapen ni ahiye.
English: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

tcz: Hor mol chung’a a thitan ahile, Aaron chu kum jakhat le somni le thum'a lhing tan ahi.
en: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.
text:
NUM 33:39
Thadou: Hor mol chung’a a thitan ahile, Aaron chu kum jakhat le somni le thum'a lhing tan ahi.
English: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

tcz: Canaan gam, Ngeb muna cheng, Canaan mi Arad lengpa chun Israel chate ahung kitol thu chu ana jaodh tan ahi.
en: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
text:
NUM 33:40
Thadou: Canaan gam, Ngeb muna cheng, Canaan mi Arad lengpa chun Israel chate ahung kitol thu chu ana jaodh tan ahi.
English: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

tcz: Chu phat in Israel chate Hor molchunga kon in akitol kittaovin Zalmonah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo kit uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.
text:
NUM 33:41
Thadou: Chu phat in Israel chate Hor molchunga kon in akitol kittaovin Zalmonah muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo kit uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

tcz: Zalmonah akon aki tol kit uvin Punon muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.
text:
NUM 33:42
Thadou: Zalmonah akon aki tol kit uvin Punon muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

tcz: Punon akon aki tol kit uvin Oboth muna chun ngahmun aki sem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
text:
NUM 33:43
Thadou: Punon akon aki tol kit uvin Oboth muna chun ngahmun aki sem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

tcz: Oboth akon akitol kit uvin Moab gam, Iyeabarim muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.
text:
NUM 33:44
Thadou: Oboth akon akitol kit uvin Moab gam, Iyeabarim muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.

tcz: Iyim akon akitol kit uvin Dibon-gad muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicgholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.
text:
NUM 33:45
Thadou: Iyim akon akitol kit uvin Dibon-gad muna chun ngahmun akisem uvin akicgholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

tcz: Dibon-gad akon akitol kit uvin Almon-Biblathaim muna chun ngahmun aki sem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.
text:
NUM 33:46
Thadou: Dibon-gad akon akitol kit uvin Almon-Biblathaim muna chun ngahmun aki sem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.

tcz: Almon-diblathaim akon chun a kitol kit uvin, Nebo gal lam Abarim molsang chunga chun ngahmun akisem uvin aki choldo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
text:
NUM 33:47
Thadou: Almon-diblathaim akon chun a kitol kit uvin, Nebo gal lam Abarim molsang chunga chun ngahmun akisem uvin aki choldo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

tcz: Abarim molsang akon akitol kit uvin Moab phaicham, Jordan vadung pang, Jericho muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
en: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
text:
NUM 33:48
Thadou: Abarim molsang akon akitol kit uvin Moab phaicham, Jordan vadung pang, Jericho muna chun ngahmun a kisem uvin a kicholdo uvin ahi.
English: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

tcz: Jordan vadung pang Beth-jeshimoth akon Moab phaicham Abel-shittim mun chan gei jin ngahmun akisem uvin ahi.
en: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.
text:
NUM 33:49
Thadou: Jordan vadung pang Beth-jeshimoth akon Moab phaicham Abel-shittim mun chan gei jin ngahmun akisem uvin ahi.
English: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

tcz: Moab phaicham Jordan vadung pangah, Pakiajin Mose henga thu asei peh in ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
text:
NUM 33:50
Thadou: Moab phaicham Jordan vadung pangah, Pakiajin Mose henga thu asei peh in ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

tcz: Israel chate heng’a hiti hin seijin, Jordan vadung nagal kai diu chu teng Canaan gam na lut diu ahi.
en: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
text:
NUM 33:51
Thadou: Israel chate heng’a hiti hin seijin, Jordan vadung nagal kai diu chu teng Canaan gam na lut diu ahi.
English: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

tcz: Na malam uva gamsung a cheng ho khu abonchauva nadel mangsoh kei diu, song chung’a ijakai kijem hojong na suh mang hel uva, milimdoi akisem jouse’u jong nasuh mangpeh diu, adoibom jeng ujong na suhset peh diu ahi.
en: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.
text:
NUM 33:52
Thadou: Na malam uva gamsung a cheng ho khu abonchauva nadel mangsoh kei diu, song chung’a ijakai kijem hojong na suh mang hel uva, milimdoi akisem jouse’u jong nasuh mangpeh diu, adoibom jeng ujong na suhset peh diu ahi.
English: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

tcz: Hiche gamsung khu apumpia nalo diu, hiche gamsung hi nangho chan dinga ka pehdoh sa ahi tai.
en: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.
text:
NUM 33:53
Thadou: Hiche gamsung khu apumpia nalo diu, hiche gamsung hi nangho chan dinga ka pehdoh sa ahi tai.
English: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.

tcz: Ama phung cheh in chenna ding’a gam hi anei thei ding vangsan na jong na nei diu, phung sung’a mitamte agam jeng jong na keh let peh diu, mi lhom diu phung sung chu agamlo jeng jong neojo hiding ahi.
en: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.
text:
NUM 33:54
Thadou: Ama phung cheh in chenna ding’a gam hi anei thei ding vangsan na jong na nei diu, phung sung’a mitamte agam jeng jong na keh let peh diu, mi lhom diu phung sung chu agamlo jeng jong neojo hiding ahi.
English: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

tcz: Amavang na malam uva cheng te khu agam ma konna na del mang lou uva ahile, hiche gam muna cheng den chengse chu hem le thal a hung pang ding, ling leh khao banga hung um doh diu, lung mong a jong na chensah thei lou diu, tija tah’a na hin jing diu ahi.
en: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.
text:
NUM 33:55
Thadou: Amavang na malam uva cheng te khu agam ma konna na del mang lou uva ahile, hiche gam muna cheng den chengse chu hem le thal a hung pang ding, ling leh khao banga hung um doh diu, lung mong a jong na chensah thei lou diu, tija tah’a na hin jing diu ahi.
English: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman amaho chung’a na katoh kigot na banga nang ho chung’a katoh joh ding ahi, tia na seipeh ding ahi.
en: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”
text:
NUM 33:56
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman amaho chung’a na katoh kigot na banga nang ho chung’a katoh joh ding ahi, tia na seipeh ding ahi.
English: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose heng’a thu aseiyin.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 34:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose heng’a thu aseiyin.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Israel chate henga thupeh neijin lang aheng uva hiti hin seijin, nangho Canaan gam sung nalut diu, Canaan gam sung pumpi nang ho chan ding ahi tai.
en: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),
text:
NUM 34:2
Thadou: Israel chate henga thupeh neijin lang aheng uva hiti hin seijin, nangho Canaan gam sung nalut diu, Canaan gam sung pumpi nang ho chan ding ahi tai.
English: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

tcz: Lhanglam na gamgi diu kipatna hi Zin gammang akon hung kipan ahin, hichun Edom gamgi ahin jui peh ahin, lhanglam a na gamgi diu chu twikhanglen ki-ngahna apat hung kite pan ding ahi.
en: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
text:
NUM 34:3
Thadou: Lhanglam na gamgi diu kipatna hi Zin gammang akon hung kipan ahin, hichun Edom gamgi ahin jui peh ahin, lhanglam a na gamgi diu chu twikhanglen ki-ngahna apat hung kite pan ding ahi.
English: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.

tcz: Chule na gamgi u-hin Akrabbim chesuh nalam ajui peh ding Zin aga phah a gamgi achaina lam chu Kadeshbarnea chan gei hi ding ahi. Chule Hazaraddar mun chan ajui peh ding Azmon changei a jui ding ahi.
en: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.
text:
NUM 34:4
Thadou: Chule na gamgi u-hin Akrabbim chesuh nalam ajui peh ding Zin aga phah a gamgi achaina lam chu Kadeshbarnea chan gei hi ding ahi. Chule Hazaraddar mun chan ajui peh ding Azmon changei a jui ding ahi.
English: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.

tcz: Hiche gamgi hi Azmon apat Egypt vadung channa a jui peh ding, achaina hi tuikhanglen muna kilhung lut ding ahi.
en: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.
text:
NUM 34:5
Thadou: Hiche gamgi hi Azmon apat Egypt vadung channa a jui peh ding, achaina hi tuikhanglen muna kilhung lut ding ahi.
English: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.

tcz: Chule lhumlam na gamgi u-hi tuikhanglen lenpen hi a jui jing ding, twikhanglen pang hi a jui peh ding, hiche hi lhumlam gamgi’a nanei jing diu ahi tai.
en: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.
text:
NUM 34:6
Thadou: Chule lhumlam na gamgi u-hi tuikhanglen lenpen hi a jui jing ding, twikhanglen pang hi a jui peh ding, hiche hi lhumlam gamgi’a nanei jing diu ahi tai.
English: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

tcz: Sahlam gamkaija gamgi vang chu hitia hi umding ahi, Twikhanglen apat gamgi ahin juipeh ding hichu Hor molsang channa natetoh diu ahi.
en: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.
text:
NUM 34:7
Thadou: Sahlam gamkaija gamgi vang chu hitia hi umding ahi, Twikhanglen apat gamgi ahin juipeh ding hichu Hor molsang channa natetoh diu ahi.
English: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

tcz: Hor molsanga pat gamgi bannei cha nahin juipeh diu Hamath channa na juilut peh diu, Zedad mun geiya gamgi nate lhung diu ahi.
en: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.
text:
NUM 34:8
Thadou: Hor molsanga pat gamgi bannei cha nahin juipeh diu Hamath channa na juilut peh diu, Zedad mun geiya gamgi nate lhung diu ahi.
English: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.

tcz: Ajeh chu Ziphron geiya gamgi kikeh len ahin, Hazarenan muna kichai ding, hichan geichu sahlam muna nangho gamgi’a umjing ding ahiye.
en: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
text:
NUM 34:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu Ziphron geiya gamgi kikeh len ahin, Hazarenan muna kichai ding, hichan geichu sahlam muna nangho gamgi’a umjing ding ahiye.
English: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.

tcz: Solam gamgi vang chu Hazarenan apat Shepham mun channa nate lhung diu ahi.
en: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
text:
NUM 34:10
Thadou: Solam gamgi vang chu Hazarenan apat Shepham mun channa nate lhung diu ahi.
English: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

tcz: Chule hiche gamgi chu Shepham apat na Ain solam gamkaiya um Riblah changei ja kilhung lut ding, chu teng agamgi chu solam Chinnereth Twikhanglen pang geiya gamgi ki lhung ding ahi.
en: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.
text:
NUM 34:11
Thadou: Chule hiche gamgi chu Shepham apat na Ain solam gamkaiya um Riblah changei ja kilhung lut ding, chu teng agamgi chu solam Chinnereth Twikhanglen pang geiya gamgi ki lhung ding ahi.
English: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.

tcz: Chuban leh gamgi chu Jordan vadung apat ki lhungsuh peh ding Twikhanglen changeiya kilhung lha ding ahi. Gamgi tampi kilhunga avel kimsoh ding, hiche gamsunga chu nnagho nachen diu ahi, tin aheng uvah seipeh tauvin, ati.
en: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”
text:
NUM 34:12
Thadou: Chuban leh gamgi chu Jordan vadung apat ki lhungsuh peh ding Twikhanglen changeiya kilhung lha ding ahi. Gamgi tampi kilhunga avel kimsoh ding, hiche gamsunga chu nnagho nachen diu ahi, tin aheng uvah seipeh tauvin, ati.
English: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

tcz: Chuin Mose’n Israel chate henga hiti hin aseijin, Pakaiyin phungko leh phung kehkhat jaona mi apeh ding ahi tia kitepna a neisa chu hiche hi nangho jouse goulo ding’a kipe na hi tauve.
en: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

tcz: Ajeh chu apa jang-lhah akonna Reuben chate ahin chule apa jang-lhah dungjuiya Gad chate ahiuvin, hichu Manasseh phunga konna akeh khat jeng in jong a kimu soh keija ahitai.
en: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.
text:
NUM 34:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu apa jang-lhah akonna Reuben chate ahin chule apa jang-lhah dungjuiya Gad chate ahiuvin, hichu Manasseh phunga konna akeh khat jeng in jong a kimu soh keija ahitai.
English: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

tcz: Hijeh chun phungni leh phung akehkhat jao nan niso lam akon Jordan gal lam hichu Jericho khopia chu achandiu gou aga kimu doh tauvin ahi.
en: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”
text:
NUM 34:15
Thadou: Hijeh chun phungni leh phung akehkhat jao nan niso lam akon Jordan gal lam hichu Jericho khopia chu achandiu gou aga kimu doh tauvin ahi.
English: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin aseiyin ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
text:
NUM 34:16
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga hiti hin aseiyin ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

tcz: Nachan diu gam homtoh le’a pang ding ho chu amin u hicheng hi ahiye: Eleazer thempu, Nun chapa Joshua jaona hi ding ahi.
en: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
text:
NUM 34:17
Thadou: Nachan diu gam homtoh le’a pang ding ho chu amin u hicheng hi ahiye: Eleazer thempu, Nun chapa Joshua jaona hi ding ahi.
English: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

tcz: Na phung sung cheh uva konna lamkai khat cheh gam homtoh a pang ding’a na lhen dohsoh kei diu ahi.
en: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
text:
NUM 34:18
Thadou: Na phung sung cheh uva konna lamkai khat cheh gam homtoh a pang ding’a na lhen dohsoh kei diu ahi.
English: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

tcz: Na lhendoh diu chengse ho min chu hi cheng hi ahi: Juda phunggol ding in Jephunneh chapa Caleb hi ding ahi.
en: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
text:
NUM 34:19
Thadou: Na lhendoh diu chengse ho min chu hi cheng hi ahi: Juda phunggol ding in Jephunneh chapa Caleb hi ding ahi.
English: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

tcz: Simeon chate lah akonna Ammihud chapa Shemuel pang ding ahi.
en: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
text:
NUM 34:20
Thadou: Simeon chate lah akonna Ammihud chapa Shemuel pang ding ahi.
English: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

tcz: Benjamin phung sunga ding’a Chislon chapa Elidad hi ding ahi.
en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
text:
NUM 34:21
Thadou: Benjamin phung sunga ding’a Chislon chapa Elidad hi ding ahi.
English: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

tcz: Dan phung sunga konna lamkaiya ana pang Jogli chapa Bukki hi ding ahi.
en: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
text:
NUM 34:22
Thadou: Dan phung sunga konna lamkaiya ana pang Jogli chapa Bukki hi ding ahi.
English: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

tcz: Joseph chate Manasseh chate lamkai ja pang ding chu Ephod chapa Hanniel hi ding ahi.
en: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
text:
NUM 34:23
Thadou: Joseph chate Manasseh chate lamkai ja pang ding chu Ephod chapa Hanniel hi ding ahi.
English: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

tcz: Ephraim chate lah a lamkaija pang ding chu Shiphtan chapa Kemuel hi ding ahi.
en: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
text:
NUM 34:24
Thadou: Ephraim chate lah a lamkaija pang ding chu Shiphtan chapa Kemuel hi ding ahi.
English: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

tcz: Zebulun chate lah a lamkaiya pang ding chu Parnach chapa Elizaphan hi ding ahi.
en: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
text:
NUM 34:25
Thadou: Zebulun chate lah a lamkaiya pang ding chu Parnach chapa Elizaphan hi ding ahi.
English: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

tcz: Issachar chate phung sunga konna lamkaiya pang ding chu Azzan chapa Paltiel hi ding ahi.
en: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
text:
NUM 34:26
Thadou: Issachar chate phung sunga konna lamkaiya pang ding chu Azzan chapa Paltiel hi ding ahi.
English: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

tcz: Asher chate lah a lamkaiya pang ding chu Shelomi chapa Ahihud hi ding ahi.
en: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
text:
NUM 34:27
Thadou: Asher chate lah a lamkaiya pang ding chu Shelomi chapa Ahihud hi ding ahi.
English: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

tcz: Naphtali chate lah alamkaiya pang ding chu Ammihud chapa Pedahel hi ding ahi.
en: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”
text:
NUM 34:28
Thadou: Naphtali chate lah alamkaiya pang ding chu Ammihud chapa Pedahel hi ding ahi.
English: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

tcz: Hi tabang ahi Israel chate’n Canaan gam sung a lodiu chu Pakaiyin gam homtoh ding’a angense chu Amaho chengse hi ahiye.
en: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
text:
NUM 34:29
Thadou: Hi tabang ahi Israel chate’n Canaan gam sung a lodiu chu Pakaiyin gam homtoh ding’a angense chu Amaho chengse hi ahiye.
English: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

tcz: Israel te Moab phaicham Jordan vadung pang Jerecho mun aum un PakaiyinMose henga thu asei peh in ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
text:
NUM 35:1
Thadou: Israel te Moab phaicham Jordan vadung pang Jerecho mun aum un PakaiyinMose henga thu asei peh in ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

tcz: Isreal chate chenna mun ahin Levite goulo jong apeh na diu vin ajah uva thu sei peh in, khopi jouse kimvel la Levi miten gancha anei sun’u avah na diuvin mun jong na peh diu ahi.
en: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.
text:
NUM 35:2
Thadou: Isreal chate chenna mun ahin Levite goulo jong apeh na diu vin ajah uva thu sei peh in, khopi jouse kimvel la Levi miten gancha anei sun’u avah na diuvin mun jong na peh diu ahi.
English: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.

tcz: Levi mite chu khopi chengse cheng diu, hamhing kena gambeh chengse jong bonghon vah na a anei uva aman chah diu ahi tai.
en: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.
text:
NUM 35:3
Thadou: Levi mite chu khopi chengse cheng diu, hamhing kena gambeh chengse jong bonghon vah na a anei uva aman chah diu ahi tai.
English: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.

tcz: Chule Levi mite gancha hon vahna dinga na peh diu gambeh chu khopi pal kigen kimvel apat tong sangkhat a sao gambeh sung napeh teidiu ahi.
en: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.
text:
NUM 35:4
Thadou: Chule Levi mite gancha hon vahna dinga na peh diu gambeh chu khopi pal kigen kimvel apat tong sangkhat a sao gambeh sung napeh teidiu ahi.
English: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.

tcz: Hichu khopi pam solam tong sangni a sao na tedoh diu, lhanglam jong tong sangni ma na tedoh diu, chunglam jong tongsani na tedoh diu khopi chu a lailung tah a na umsah diu, khopi vel Jousea a kitedohsa mun chengse chu Levi mite gancha ho hamhing neh na muna anei diu ahi tai.
en: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.
text:
NUM 35:5
Thadou: Hichu khopi pam solam tong sangni a sao na tedoh diu, lhanglam jong tong sangni ma na tedoh diu, chunglam jong tongsani na tedoh diu khopi chu a lailung tah a na umsah diu, khopi vel Jousea a kitedohsa mun chengse chu Levi mite gancha ho hamhing neh na muna anei diu ahi tai.
English: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.
