Thadou: Alal-na khopi somgup ijousoh kei tauvin, hichu Argob gamkai Bashan lenggam pumpi ahi. Khopi khat jeng cha jong asohcha tapoi.
English: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

tcz: Hiche khopi ho jouse chu akimvel aboncha pal phatah a kigen le kelkot phatah a kisem soh kei ahi. Chule kho phabep akimvela pal kigen lou jong ilo tauvin ahi.
en: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.
text:
DEU 3:5
Thadou: Hiche khopi ho jouse chu akimvel aboncha pal phatah a kigen le kelkot phatah a kisem soh kei ahi. Chule kho phabep akimvela pal kigen lou jong ilo tauvin ahi.
English: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.

tcz: Hesbon lengpa Sihon isuhgam bang uvin, Bashan lenggam pumpi jong abonchan ijousoh hel tauvin ahi. Khopi tin’a mihem jouse ithat soheki uvin numei chapang jaona pasal jouse ahi.
en: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.
text:
DEU 3:6
Thadou: Hesbon lengpa Sihon isuhgam bang uvin, Bashan lenggam pumpi jong abonchan ijousoh hel tauvin ahi. Khopi tin’a mihem jouse ithat soheki uvin numei chapang jaona pasal jouse ahi.
English: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.

tcz: Khopi jousea gancha ho ihinghoi uvin, thil ijakai manlu jouse jong ichom tauvin ahi.
en: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.
text:
DEU 3:7
Thadou: Khopi jousea gancha ho ihinghoi uvin, thil ijakai manlu jouse jong ichom tauvin ahi.
English: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.

tcz: Amor mite lengpa lalna gam lhumlam Jordan vadung jong ilo’uvin, hichu Arnon Gorge apat Hermon molsang changei ahi.
en: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.
text:
DEU 3:8
Thadou: Amor mite lengpa lalna gam lhumlam Jordan vadung jong ilo’uvin, hichu Arnon Gorge apat Hermon molsang changei ahi.
English: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.

tcz: (Sidon mite chun Hermon molsang chu Sirion tin akou un chule Amor miten Senir tin akou uve.)
en: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)
text:
DEU 3:9
Thadou: (Sidon mite chun Hermon molsang chu Sirion tin akou un chule Amor miten Senir tin akou uve.)
English: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)

tcz: Tun eihon Gilead le Bashan gamkai pumpi ijousoh tauvin, Og lengpa gamvai pohna Salecah le Edrei changeiyin ijousoh hel tauvin ahi.
en: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
text:
DEU 3:10
Thadou: Tun eihon Gilead le Bashan gamkai pumpi ijousoh tauvin, Og lengpa gamvai pohna Salecah le Edrei changeiyin ijousoh hel tauvin ahi.
English: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

tcz: (Bashan lengpa Og chu Rephaim mite dinga leng nukhah pen ahitan. Alupna chu thih a kisem ahin, chule asan dan adung feet som le thum, availam letdan feet gup alhing in ahi. Hiche lengpa lim hi Ammon mite khopi Rabbah muna aum nalayin ahi.)
en: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)
text:
DEU 3:11
Thadou: (Bashan lengpa Og chu Rephaim mite dinga leng nukhah pen ahitan. Alupna chu thih a kisem ahin, chule asan dan adung feet som le thum, availam letdan feet gup alhing in ahi. Hiche lengpa lim hi Ammon mite khopi Rabbah muna aum nalayin ahi.)
English: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)

tcz: Hiche gam pumpi chu ilo tauvin ahileh, keiman Reuben le Gad insung ading in Aroer apat Arnon Gorge changei in chule Gilead gam kehkhat le khopi phabep jaonan kapedoh tan ahi.
en: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;

tcz: Manasseh chilhahte ding in, Gilead gam kehkhat le Bashan gam pumpi Og lengpa lalna gam chu ka pedoh tan ahi. (Hiche hi Bashan gam Argob gamkai pumpi hi Rephaim tia kihe ahi).
en: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.
text:
DEU 3:13
Thadou: Manasseh chilhahte ding in, Gilead gam kehkhat le Bashan gam pumpi Og lengpa lalna gam chu ka pedoh tan ahi. (Hiche hi Bashan gam Argob gamkai pumpi hi Rephaim tia kihe ahi).
English: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.

tcz: Manasseh insunga lamkai amin Jair, ama hin Bashan, Argob gamkai pumpi ajousoh hel in, Geshur mite le Maacah mite gamgi changei ahi. Jair chun hiche gam chu ama min aputsah in, Jair khopi asah tan, tuni chan in Jair tin akihe jing na laiyin ahi.
en: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)
text:
DEU 3:14
Thadou: Manasseh insunga lamkai amin Jair, ama hin Bashan, Argob gamkai pumpi ajousoh hel in, Geshur mite le Maacah mite gamgi changei ahi. Jair chun hiche gam chu ama min aputsah in, Jair khopi asah tan, tuni chan in Jair tin akihe jing na laiyin ahi.
English: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)

tcz: Keiman Gilead chu Makir insung kapedoh tai.
en: I gave Gilead to Machir.
text:
DEU 3:15
Thadou: Keiman Gilead chu Makir insung kapedoh tai.
English: I gave Gilead to Machir.

tcz: Chule keiman Reuben le Gad insunga ding in Gilead gam phabep jong kapen ahi. Arnon Gorge lhanglam lailung apat Ammon mite chenna Jabbok vadung chan ahi.
en: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

tcz: Jordan phaicham Galilee dillen lhanglam San dung, apat Jordan vadung gamgi changei ahi. Hichu solam Pisgah toh kimat ahitai.
en: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.
text:
DEU 3:17
Thadou: Jordan phaicham Galilee dillen lhanglam San dung, apat Jordan vadung gamgi changei ahi. Hichu solam Pisgah toh kimat ahitai.
English: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.

tcz: Hiche phatlai chun keiman ama insung cheh, lhumlam Jordan a cheng ding in thupeh ka neiyin ahi: Hiche gam pumpi hi Pakai, Pathen in nangho napehsau hijongleh, na gal-miteuvin na sopite ho chenna Jordan gam aho pauva galkai diu ahi.
en: I commanded you at that time, saying, “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.
text:
DEU 3:18
Thadou: Hiche phatlai chun keiman ama insung cheh, lhumlam Jordan a cheng ding in thupeh ka neiyin ahi: Hiche gam pumpi hi Pakai, Pathen in nangho napehsau hijongleh, na gal-miteuvin na sopite ho chenna Jordan gam aho pauva galkai diu ahi.
English: I commanded you at that time, saying, “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.

tcz: Chule najiteu, nachateu chule na gancha jouseo jaona keiman kapeh khopi hoa cheng diu ahi.
en: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,
text:
DEU 3:19
Thadou: Chule najiteu, nachateu chule na gancha jouseo jaona keiman kapeh khopi hoa cheng diu ahi.
English: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,

tcz: Pakaiyin Israel mite dinga kivenbitna gam napedoh tauvin, chuin amahon Jordan vadung changeiyin aching uvin, chuin nangho nabon chauvin Pakaiyin na pehnau gam achun nacheng khom tauvin ahi.
en: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”
text:
DEU 3:20
Thadou: Pakaiyin Israel mite dinga kivenbitna gam napedoh tauvin, chuin amahon Jordan vadung changeiyin aching uvin, chuin nangho nabon chauvin Pakaiyin na pehnau gam achun nacheng khom tauvin ahi.
English: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”

tcz: Hichun keiman Joshua henga thupeh hicheng hi kaneiyin: Nanghon hiche leng teni chunga Pakai natoh abonchan namusoh tauvin. Pakaiyin lhumlam gamkai Jordan chengsea angaiya bang banga na atoh ding ahi.
en: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. So shall the LORD do to all the kingdoms where you go over.
text:
DEU 3:21
Thadou: Hichun keiman Joshua henga thupeh hicheng hi kaneiyin: Nanghon hiche leng teni chunga Pakai natoh abonchan namusoh tauvin. Pakaiyin lhumlam gamkai Jordan chengsea angaiya bang banga na atoh ding ahi.
English: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. So shall the LORD do to all the kingdoms where you go over.

tcz: Hijeh chun hiche nam mite khu kicha hih in, Pakaiyin nangma dinga gal asat ding ahi.
en: You shall not fear them; for the LORD your God himself fights for you.”
text:
DEU 3:22
Thadou: Hijeh chun hiche nam mite khu kicha hih in, Pakaiyin nangma dinga gal asat ding ahi.
English: You shall not fear them; for the LORD your God himself fights for you.”

tcz: Chuin keima Pakai henga katao vin hiti hin kaseiye.
en: I begged GOD at that time, saying,
text:
DEU 3:23
Thadou: Chuin keima Pakai henga katao vin hiti hin kaseiye.
English: I begged GOD at that time, saying,

tcz: O Thanei chungnung Pakai, nangman keima nasohpa henga naban thahat naki lahsah in ka musoh tai. Koiham pathen dang van leh leiset a hitobang thil kidang bol thei ding?
en: “Lord GOD, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?
text:
DEU 3:24
Thadou: O Thanei chungnung Pakai, nangman keima nasohpa henga naban thahat naki lahsah in ka musoh tai. Koiham pathen dang van leh leiset a hitobang thil kidang bol thei ding?
English: “Lord GOD, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?

tcz: Nalung ahileh, Jordan hi nei galkai sah in lang, gamhoi tah Lebanon molsang ho nei musah tan, ati.
en: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”
text:
DEU 3:25
Thadou: Nalung ahileh, Jordan hi nei galkai sah in lang, gamhoi tah Lebanon molsang ho nei musah tan, ati.
English: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”

tcz: Hinlah nangho jeh in Pakai ka henga alungphamo tan, ka taona angaisah tapoi. Chuin aman aseiyin, aphatai! Imadang seibe datan, ati.
en: But the LORD was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. The LORD said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.
text:
DEU 3:26
Thadou: Hinlah nangho jeh in Pakai ka henga alungphamo tan, ka taona angaisah tapoi. Chuin aman aseiyin, aphatai! Imadang seibe datan, ati.
English: But the LORD was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. The LORD said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.

tcz: Pisgah molchunga kaltouvin lang, gam jouse gavetan, amavang Jordan vadung na galkai lou ding ahi.
en: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.
text:
DEU 3:27
Thadou: Pisgah molchunga kaltouvin lang, gam jouse gavetan, amavang Jordan vadung na galkai lou ding ahi.
English: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.

tcz: Nangma khel in, Joshua thaneina pen lang hilchah jotan, ajeh chu Joshua in mipi aboncha Jordan chan agalkai pia, alam kai ding ahi. Masanga namu gam jouse aboncha aman mipi apeh ding ahi.
en: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”
text:
DEU 3:28
Thadou: Nangma khel in, Joshua thaneina pen lang hilchah jotan, ajeh chu Joshua in mipi aboncha Jordan chan agalkai pia, alam kai ding ahi. Masanga namu gam jouse aboncha aman mipi apeh ding ahi.
English: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”

tcz: Chuin Beth-peor kiti muna chun kaum tauvin ahi.
en: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.
text:
DEU 3:29
Thadou: Chuin Beth-peor kiti muna chun kaum tauvin ahi.
English: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

tcz: Tun, Israel miten danthu kahil jouseu phatah in ngaiyun, Pakai, Pathen in napu, napateu khanga pat napehnau gam nalhun thei nadiu le agama nachen thei nadiu ahi.
en: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, gives you.
text:
DEU 4:1
Thadou: Tun, Israel miten danthu kahil jouseu phatah in ngaiyun, Pakai, Pathen in napu, napateu khanga pat napehnau gam nalhun thei nadiu le agama nachen thei nadiu ahi.
English: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, gives you.

tcz: Kathupeh a kon in ngaisah louna ima neihih hel uvin. Pakai, Pathen akona ka thupeh chengse hi phatah a najui diu ahi.
en: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
text:
DEU 4:2
Thadou: Kathupeh a kon in ngaisah louna ima neihih hel uvin. Pakai, Pathen akona ka thupeh chengse hi phatah a najui diu ahi.
English: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

tcz: Baapeor muna Pakaiyin nangho dinga ichangeiya na atoh namusoh keiyun ahi. Hiche muna chun Pakai, Pathen in Baal doi hou jouse abonchan asugam sohkeiye.
en: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal Peor; for the LORD your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.
text:
DEU 4:3
Thadou: Baapeor muna Pakaiyin nangho dinga ichangeiya na atoh namusoh keiyun ahi. Hiche muna chun Pakai, Pathen in Baal doi hou jouse abonchan asugam sohkeiye.
English: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal Peor; for the LORD your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai, Pathen tahsan a thua nung jouse, tuni chan in nabon chauvin nadam nalaiyun ahi.
en: But you who were faithful to the LORD your God are all alive today.
text:
DEU 4:4
Thadou: Hinlah Pakai, Pathen tahsan a thua nung jouse, tuni chan in nabon chauvin nadam nalaiyun ahi.
English: But you who were faithful to the LORD your God are all alive today.

tcz: Vetan, Pakai, Pathen akona juiding dan hichengse hi nangho dinga thupeh ahi. Ajeh chu hichengse hi gamsung nalut teng uleh phatah a najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
en: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.
text:
DEU 4:5
Thadou: Vetan, Pakai, Pathen akona juiding dan hichengse hi nangho dinga thupeh ahi. Ajeh chu hichengse hi gamsung nalut teng uleh phatah a najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
English: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.

tcz: Hichengse hi najui uva ahileh, na kimvel uva cheng nam dangte sanga athem leh achinga naum diu ahi. Hitobang nunle khan ahin jahdoh teng uleh, hiche nam mite hi datmah umtah in aching lheh uve tia asei diu ahi!
en: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
text:
DEU 4:6
Thadou: Hichengse hi najui uva ahileh, na kimvel uva cheng nam dangte sanga athem leh achinga naum diu ahi. Hitobang nunle khan ahin jahdoh teng uleh, hiche nam mite hi datmah umtah in aching lheh uve tia asei diu ahi!
English: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen ikom cha uva aum jing banga, eiho Pathen tobang nam dang ten anei khah ngai em?
en: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as the LORD our God is whenever we call on him?
text:
DEU 4:7
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen ikom cha uva aum jing banga, eiho Pathen tobang nam dang ten anei khah ngai em?
English: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as the LORD our God is whenever we call on him?

tcz: Hitobanga chu keiman jong na masang uva ka koipeh danthu hijatpi hi, kicheh tah’a ka koipeh banguva koi dang nam in hitobang anei khah ngai em?
en: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
text:
DEU 4:8
Thadou: Hitobanga chu keiman jong na masang uva ka koipeh danthu hijatpi hi, kicheh tah’a ka koipeh banguva koi dang nam in hitobang anei khah ngai em?
English: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh vetan! Nanghon namit tah uva namu chan uchu nahaimil lou diu ahi. Hiche hi na damsung uva nalung thim uva kona na jamdoh sah lou diu ahi! Natu na chate changeiya achin jing diu ahi.
en: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—
text:
DEU 4:9
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh vetan! Nanghon namit tah uva namu chan uchu nahaimil lou diu ahi. Hiche hi na damsung uva nalung thim uva kona na jamdoh sah lou diu ahi! Natu na chate changeiya achin jing diu ahi.
English: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—

tcz: Chule Pakai, Pathen in Sinai mol chunga adin nikhoa ka henga thu asei chu na haimil lou diu ahi. Mipi ho abonchan ka henga hinpuiyin, keiman ijakai kahil diu ahi. Chutileh amahon keima gin ding dan ahet uva, atu acha khang gei uva jong keima eigin jing diu ahi.
en: the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”
text:
DEU 4:10
Thadou: Chule Pakai, Pathen in Sinai mol chunga adin nikhoa ka henga thu asei chu na haimil lou diu ahi. Mipi ho abonchan ka henga hinpuiyin, keiman ijakai kahil diu ahi. Chutileh amahon keima gin ding dan ahet uva, atu acha khang gei uva jong keima eigin jing diu ahi.
English: the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”

tcz: Nangma mol chunga na keng in nahung ding in, Molchung vum jouse meibol in atom in chuin mu athim lhatan ahi.
en: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
text:
DEU 4:11
Thadou: Nangma mol chunga na keng in nahung ding in, Molchung vum jouse meibol in atom in chuin mu athim lhatan ahi.
English: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin nangma henga thu aseiyin, meikong in akilah in, Ama awgin chu najan ahinlah tahmel in namupoi; ajeh chu awgin bou najah ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.
text:
DEU 4:12
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin nangma henga thu aseiyin, meikong in akilah in, Ama awgin chu najan ahinlah tahmel in namupoi; ajeh chu awgin bou najah ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.

tcz: Pakaiyin kitepna asem in, Thupeh som nanit jing diuvin thupeh aneiyin, songpheng ni chunga ajihdoh in ahi.
en: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.
text:
DEU 4:13
Thadou: Pakaiyin kitepna asem in, Thupeh som nanit jing diuvin thupeh aneiyin, songpheng ni chunga ajihdoh in ahi.
English: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.

tcz: Hiche muna chun Pakaiyin thupeh aneiyin, nangho gamsung nalut kon teng uleh danthu najui diuvin abonchan eihil in ahi.
en: The LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.
text:
DEU 4:14
Thadou: Hiche muna chun Pakaiyin thupeh aneiyin, nangho gamsung nalut kon teng uleh danthu najui diuvin abonchan eihil in ahi.
English: The LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangho ching theiyun! Sinai mol chunga Pakaiyin najah uva thu asei nikho chun, nanghon tahmel in namu pouve.
en: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
text:
DEU 4:15
Thadou: Hijeh chun nangho ching theiyun! Sinai mol chunga Pakaiyin najah uva thu asei nikho chun, nanghon tahmel in namu pouve.
English: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,

tcz: Hijeh chun nanghon milim doi numei leh pasal lima semthu a-angsunga na bokhup uva na kisuhboh louhel diu,
en: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
text:
DEU 4:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun nanghon milim doi numei leh pasal lima semthu a-angsunga na bokhup uva na kisuhboh louhel diu,
English: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

tcz: tol-lhang lah a ganhing hihen, twipi noiya um ganhing limsem thu kitiphot angsunga na bohkhup lou diu ahi.
en: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

tcz: Chunglang vea lha, ahsite chule vanthamjola thil ho jong bohkhup a akin bol ding na ngaito louhel diu ahi. Hichengse khu aboncha Pakai, Pathen in leiset a cheng mihemte apeh ahi.
en: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which the LORD your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.
text:
DEU 4:19
Thadou: Chunglang vea lha, ahsite chule vanthamjola thil ho jong bohkhup a akin bol ding na ngaito louhel diu ahi. Hichengse khu aboncha Pakai, Pathen in leiset a cheng mihemte apeh ahi.
English: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which the LORD your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho hi Pakai, Pathen in Egypt gamsung meilhum lah’a kiloidoh a Pathen dei tum mong mong dinga tunia hi nasemu ahin, hichu nasuhmil lou diu ahi.
en: But the LORD has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.
text:
DEU 4:20
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangho hi Pakai, Pathen in Egypt gamsung meilhum lah’a kiloidoh a Pathen dei tum mong mong dinga tunia hi nasemu ahin, hichu nasuhmil lou diu ahi.
English: But the LORD has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.

tcz: Hinlah nangho jeh in Pakai ka henga alungphamo tan. Pakaiyin kitepna asem in keima Jordan vadung galkaiya, keima hiche gamsunga khu kalut thei lou ding ahitai.
en: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance;

tcz: Keima khela hiche gamsung lodinga Jordan vadung nagal kai diu ahi. Keima vang hiche solam vadung pama hi thiden ding kahi tai.
en: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.
text:
DEU 4:22
Thadou: Keima khela hiche gamsung lodinga Jordan vadung nagal kai diu ahi. Keima vang hiche solam vadung pama hi thiden ding kahi tai.
English: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.

tcz: Hijeh chun chingthei un Pakai, Pathen in kitepna napeh hou aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi. Pathen doumah milim doi sem ding gohih un, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen dinga doumah umtah ahi.
en: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which the LORD your God has forbidden you.
text:
DEU 4:23
Thadou: Hijeh chun chingthei un Pakai, Pathen in kitepna napeh hou aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi. Pathen doumah milim doi sem ding gohih un, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen dinga doumah umtah ahi.
English: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which the LORD your God has forbidden you.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen hi meikong a kilahji ahin; thangtomna aneiji ahi.
en: For the LORD your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
text:
DEU 4:24
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen hi meikong a kilahji ahin; thangtomna aneiji ahi.
English: For the LORD your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.

tcz: Ahung lhung ding phat hoa, tu le cha nahin neiyuva gam sunga na hung chen teng uleh, milim doi kiti sema a-angsunga na bohkhup louhel diu ahi. Hitobang thil hi Pakai dinga thet umtah leh Pakai lunghan na ahi.
en: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,
text:
DEU 4:25
Thadou: Ahung lhung ding phat hoa, tu le cha nahin neiyuva gam sunga na hung chen teng uleh, milim doi kiti sema a-angsunga na bohkhup louhel diu ahi. Hitobang thil hi Pakai dinga thet umtah leh Pakai lunghan na ahi.
English: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,

tcz: Tuna van leh leiset kasan hi nangho hettohsahna ding ahi. Ka kitepna na suhkeh uva ahileh, Jordan vadung galkaiya gamsunga na hetman lou uva na manthah jeng diu ahi. Hinkho chomcha bou nanei diu; hetman louva thinan na lhunden diu ahi.
en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.
text:
DEU 4:26
Thadou: Tuna van leh leiset kasan hi nangho hettohsahna ding ahi. Ka kitepna na suhkeh uva ahileh, Jordan vadung galkaiya gamsunga na hetman lou uva na manthah jeng diu ahi. Hinkho chomcha bou nanei diu; hetman louva thinan na lhunden diu ahi.
English: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.

tcz: Ajeh chu nam dangte lah a Pakaiyin nathe cheh diu, lhom cha bouvin gamsung nalo diu ahi.
en: The LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where the LORD will lead you away.
text:
DEU 4:27
Thadou: Ajeh chu nam dangte lah a Pakaiyin nathe cheh diu, lhom cha bouvin gamsung nalo diu ahi.
English: The LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where the LORD will lead you away.

tcz: Hiche muna chu, gamdang mite lah a milim doi song le thinga kisem thu, ima jathei lou, muthei lou ho kin nabol diu ahi.
en: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
text:
DEU 4:28
Thadou: Hiche muna chu, gamdang mite lah a milim doi song le thinga kisem thu, ima jathei lou, muthei lou ho kin nabol diu ahi.
English: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

tcz: Chuteng Pakai, Pathen nahin hol kit diu, nalung thim pumpiuva nahin hol teng uleh namu bep diu ahi.
en: But from there you shall seek the LORD your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.
text:
DEU 4:29
Thadou: Chuteng Pakai, Pathen nahin hol kit diu, nalung thim pumpiuva nahin hol teng uleh namu bep diu ahi.
English: But from there you shall seek the LORD your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.

tcz: Ahung lhung ding phat hoa, hitobang din muna naum uva gim genthei nan nalhun den teng uleh, Pakai, Pathen angsung nahin bel diu, Pakai thusei jouse nangai diu ahi.
en: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to the LORD your God and listen to his voice.
text:
DEU 4:30
Thadou: Ahung lhung ding phat hoa, hitobang din muna naum uva gim genthei nan nalhun den teng uleh, Pakai, Pathen angsung nahin bel diu, Pakai thusei jouse nangai diu ahi.
English: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to the LORD your God and listen to his voice.

tcz: Ajeh chu na Pakaiyu, Pathen uhi ngailutna a dim jeng ahin; na lung na heija Pakai lam nahin bel teng aman na damsah ding ahi. Ijeh inem itileh, napu napateu khang apat akitepna ageldoh jing in ahi.
en: For the LORD your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.
text:
DEU 4:31
Thadou: Ajeh chu na Pakaiyu, Pathen uhi ngailutna a dim jeng ahin; na lung na heija Pakai lam nahin bel teng aman na damsah ding ahi. Ijeh inem itileh, napu napateu khang apat akitepna ageldoh jing in ahi.
English: For the LORD your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.

tcz: Tun leiset ahung kisem apat tuchana Pathen in ichangeiya mihemte akhohsah ham, ti thusimle vanthamjola ijakai jouse kholdoh uvin. Hitobang thil ki dang hohi najah a namu khah uvem?
en: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?
text:
DEU 4:32
Thadou: Tun leiset ahung kisem apat tuchana Pathen in ichangeiya mihemte akhohsah ham, ti thusimle vanthamjola ijakai jouse kholdoh uvin. Hitobang thil ki dang hohi najah a namu khah uvem?
English: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?

tcz: Nanghon meikonga Pathen akilah a, awgin najah bang uva nam dang ten hitobang thil kidang atokhah tah uvem?
en: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
text:
DEU 4:33
Thadou: Nanghon meikonga Pathen akilah a, awgin najah bang uva nam dang ten hitobang thil kidang atokhah tah uvem?
English: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?

tcz: Pathen dang in nampi khat gim hesoh na a kon apui doh a, thil kidang ijakai aki lahsah gal asat peh, ban thahat pana kithopina, ki dang tah a na-atohna um kha tam? Ahinlah nangho Pakai, Pathen in Egypt gam naum lai uva anatoh ijakai na musoh kei tauvin ahi.
en: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
text:
DEU 4:34
Thadou: Pathen dang in nampi khat gim hesoh na a kon apui doh a, thil kidang ijakai aki lahsah gal asat peh, ban thahat pana kithopina, ki dang tah a na-atohna um kha tam? Ahinlah nangho Pakai, Pathen in Egypt gam naum lai uva anatoh ijakai na musoh kei tauvin ahi.
English: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

tcz: Pakaiyin ijakai na muchen sah tauve, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen tobang dang umlou ahi.
en: It was shown to you so that you might know that the LORD is God. There is no one else besides him.
text:
DEU 4:35
Thadou: Pakaiyin ijakai na muchen sah tauve, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen tobang dang umlou ahi.
English: It was shown to you so that you might know that the LORD is God. There is no one else besides him.

tcz: Pakaiyin vana kon in awgin na jahsah uvin, thupeh ijakai aneiyin ahi. Pakai meikonga akilah in nang ho nahou piu vin ahi.
en: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.
text:
DEU 4:36
Thadou: Pakaiyin vana kon in awgin na jahsah uvin, thupeh ijakai aneiyin ahi. Pakai meikonga akilah in nang ho nahou piu vin ahi.
English: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin napu napateu angailun chule a chilhahte changei phatthei aboh ahi. Pakaiyin abanthahat apan in, Egypt gam'a kona nahin pui galkaiyu ahitai.
en: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;

tcz: Nangho ding in namdangte gamlha tah in achon doh in, Pakaiyin nangho chenna ding gamnom tah na peuvin, tunin na cheng tauvin ahi.
en: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.
text:
DEU 4:38
Thadou: Nangho ding in namdangte gamlha tah in achon doh in, Pakaiyin nangho chenna ding gamnom tah na peuvin, tunin na cheng tauvin ahi.
English: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.

tcz: Hijeh achu hiche hi na geldoh jing diu leh na lungthim uva na chin jing diu ahi: Pakai, Pathen hi vana jong leiset a jong Pathen ahin, Pathen dang ama tobang aumpoi.
en: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that the LORD himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.
text:
DEU 4:39
Thadou: Hijeh achu hiche hi na geldoh jing diu leh na lungthim uva na chin jing diu ahi: Pakai, Pathen hi vana jong leiset a jong Pathen ahin, Pathen dang ama tobang aumpoi.
English: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that the LORD himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.

tcz: Tunia ka thupeh chengse aboncha na juikim soh keiyuva ahileh, ijakai phacham kimsoh kei ding nachateu changeiya phatthei chang diu ahi. Imatih chana gam sunga kipah leh lungmonga nachen diu, na hinkhou asotna dinga Keiman thupeh hichengse aboncha kapeh nahiuve.
en: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD your God gives you for all time.
text:
DEU 4:40
Thadou: Tunia ka thupeh chengse aboncha na juikim soh keiyuva ahileh, ijakai phacham kimsoh kei ding nachateu changeiya phatthei chang diu ahi. Imatih chana gam sunga kipah leh lungmonga nachen diu, na hinkhou asotna dinga Keiman thupeh hichengse aboncha kapeh nahiuve.
English: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD your God gives you for all time.

tcz: Chuin Mose’n khopi thum solam Jordan vadunga kichol nading in atung doh in ahi.
en: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,
text:
DEU 4:41
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n khopi thum solam Jordan vadunga kichol nading in atung doh in ahi.
English: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,

tcz: Koi tobang'in mihem khat alam louva atha a, suhna ding beiya auma ahileh, ama chu hiche muna hi jamlut ding ahinkho aki huhdoh ding ahi.
en: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
text:
DEU 4:42
Thadou: Koi tobang'in mihem khat alam louva atha a, suhna ding beiya auma ahileh, ama chu hiche muna hi jamlut ding ahinkho aki huhdoh ding ahi.
English: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:

tcz: Khopi thum hochu: Bezer kiti gamthip lah a hichu Reuben in sunga ding; Ramoth kiti Gilead muna hichu Gad in sunga ding; Golan kiti Bashan muna hichu Manasseh insunga ding ahi.
en: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
text:
DEU 4:43
Thadou: Khopi thum hochu: Bezer kiti gamthip lah a hichu Reuben in sunga ding; Ramoth kiti Gilead muna hichu Gad in sunga ding; Golan kiti Bashan muna hichu Manasseh insunga ding ahi.
English: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

tcz: Thupeh hichengse hi Mose’n Israel mite henga aseipeh ahi.
en: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.
text:
DEU 4:44
Thadou: Thupeh hichengse hi Mose’n Israel mite henga aseipeh ahi.
English: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.

tcz: Hichengse hi danthu jui ding’a Mose’n Israel miten Egypt gam adalhah uva apeh,
en: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,
text:
DEU 4:45
Thadou: Hichengse hi danthu jui ding’a Mose’n Israel miten Egypt gam adalhah uva apeh,
English: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,

tcz: Beth-peor toh kinai solam Jordan vadung phaicham ngahmun aum laiyuva apeh ahi. Phat masa chun hiche gam hi Amor mite lengpa Sihon in Hesbon muna kona ana vaipoh ahi. Hinlah Egypt gam'a kona Mose leh Israel mite ahung doh uchun ana sugam hel tauvin ahi.
en: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.
text:
DEU 4:46
Thadou: Beth-peor toh kinai solam Jordan vadung phaicham ngahmun aum laiyuva apeh ahi. Phat masa chun hiche gam hi Amor mite lengpa Sihon in Hesbon muna kona ana vaipoh ahi. Hinlah Egypt gam'a kona Mose leh Israel mite ahung doh uchun ana sugam hel tauvin ahi.
English: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.

tcz: Chuin Israel miten Bashan lengpa Og lalna gam leh anei agou jouse achom chai keiyuvin, solama Amor mite leng teni jaona ahi.
en: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;

tcz: Israel miten Aroer apat Arnon Gorge chule Sirion mol Hermon tiajong kihe changeiyin ajousoh hel tauve.
en: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Zion (also called Hermon),
text:
DEU 4:48
Thadou: Israel miten Aroer apat Arnon Gorge chule Sirion mol Hermon tiajong kihe changeiyin ajousoh hel tauve.
English: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Zion (also called Hermon),

tcz: Chuin amahon solam gamkai Jordan vadung pang leh, lhanglam San dung changeiyin ajousoh uvin, Pisgah noilam changei ahi.
en: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
text:
DEU 4:49
Thadou: Chuin amahon solam gamkai Jordan vadung pang leh, lhanglam San dung changeiyin ajousoh uvin, Pisgah noilam changei ahi.
English: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.

tcz: Mose’n Israel mite akoukhom in aheng uva aseipeh tan ahi, Israel miten phatah in ngaiyun. Tunin Dan thupeh chengse hi jasoh keiyun, kihilnan neiyun lang najui kimsoh kei diu ahi!
en: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”
text:
DEU 5:1
Thadou: Mose’n Israel mite akoukhom in aheng uva aseipeh tan ahi, Israel miten phatah in ngaiyun. Tunin Dan thupeh chengse hi jasoh keiyun, kihilnan neiyun lang najui kimsoh kei diu ahi!
English: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in Sinai mola kitepna eisem peh tauvin ahi.
en: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
text:
DEU 5:2
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in Sinai mola kitepna eisem peh tauvin ahi.
English: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

tcz: Pakaiyin hiche kitepna hi ipu-ipateu toh asem ahipon, amavang tunikhoa eiho jouse dinga asem ahi.
en: The LORD didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.
text:
DEU 5:3
Thadou: Pakaiyin hiche kitepna hi ipu-ipateu toh asem ahipon, amavang tunikhoa eiho jouse dinga asem ahi.
English: The LORD didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.

tcz: Pakai mol chunga meikong in akilah in nangho kimaiton nakihou limpiuvin ahi.
en: The LORD spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,
text:
DEU 5:4
Thadou: Pakai mol chunga meikong in akilah in nangho kimaiton nakihou limpiuvin ahi.
English: The LORD spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,

tcz: Nangho leh Pakai kimlaiya keima ka ding in ahi, ajeh chu nanghon meikong nakicha uvin molchung na nailut ngam tapouve. Pakaiyin ka henga thu aseiyin, athusei doh aboncha nangho kapeh son ahi. Pakai thuseidoh chu hiche hi ahi:
en: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to show you the LORD’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,
text:
DEU 5:5
Thadou: Nangho leh Pakai kimlaiya keima ka ding in ahi, ajeh chu nanghon meikong nakicha uvin molchung na nailut ngam tapouve. Pakaiyin ka henga thu aseiyin, athusei doh aboncha nangho kapeh son ahi. Pakai thuseidoh chu hiche hi ahi:
English: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to show you the LORD’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,

tcz: Keima na Pakai leh na Pathen kahi, Egypt gam'a soh a naum laiyuva na huhdoh pau chu kahi.
en: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
text:
DEU 5:6
Thadou: Keima na Pakai leh na Pathen kahi, Egypt gam'a soh a naum laiyuva na huhdoh pau chu kahi.
English: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

tcz: Kei tailou Pathen dang nanei loudiu ahi.
en: “You shall have no other gods before me.
text:
DEU 5:7
Thadou: Kei tailou Pathen dang nanei loudiu ahi.
English: “You shall have no other gods before me.

tcz: Milim semthu kiti nanei thei lou diu, van le leiset chule twikhanglen sunga hijongleh pathen lim semthu nanei thei lou diu ahi.
en: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
text:
DEU 5:8
Thadou: Milim semthu kiti nanei thei lou diu, van le leiset chule twikhanglen sunga hijongleh pathen lim semthu nanei thei lou diu ahi.
English: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

tcz: Hitobang lim semthu ho ang sunga chu naboh khup uva, akin nabol louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu keima na Pakaiyu leh na Pathen u-kahin, pathen dang semthua kona thang-tomji ka hin, hiche chonset nachu nacha teu khang geiya pap kalhunsah ding; keima ei pam pai insung pumpi chunga, khangthum leh li chan geiya lethuhna ka lhunsah ding ahi.
en: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me
text:
DEU 5:9
Thadou: Hitobang lim semthu ho ang sunga chu naboh khup uva, akin nabol louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu keima na Pakaiyu leh na Pathen u-kahin, pathen dang semthua kona thang-tomji ka hin, hiche chonset nachu nacha teu khang geiya pap kalhunsah ding; keima ei pam pai insung pumpi chunga, khangthum leh li chan geiya lethuhna ka lhunsah ding ahi.
English: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me

tcz: Hinlah ka thupeh nit a keima eingailu jing ho chunga, akhang akhanga ngailutna kalhunsah ding ahi.
en: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
text:
DEU 5:10
Thadou: Hinlah ka thupeh nit a keima eingailu jing ho chunga, akhang akhanga ngailutna kalhunsah ding ahi.
English: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen min nasuhboh louhel diu ahi. Koihileh Pakai min suboh chan chu ngaidam chang lou ding ahi.
en: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
text:
DEU 5:11
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen min nasuhboh louhel diu ahi. Koihileh Pakai min suboh chan chu ngaidam chang lou ding ahi.
English: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen thupeh banga, Sabbath nikho theng chu nanit jing diu ahi.
en: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the LORD your God commanded you.
text:
DEU 5:12
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen thupeh banga, Sabbath nikho theng chu nanit jing diu ahi.
English: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the LORD your God commanded you.

tcz: Natohna ding nigup naneiyun ahi,
en: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;

tcz: hinlah nisagi lhinni Sabbath nikho hi Pakai, Pathen dinga nikho theng ki katdoh ahi. Hiche nikhoa hi koi machan insung natoh abol theilou ding, hiche hi nangho nahiuvin, nachapateu le nachanuteu, nasoh pasal ho le nasoh numei hou, bongchal holeh, sa-ngan ho chule nagancha jouse jaona, chule gamdangmi nalah uva hung cheng ho jaona hi ding ahi.
en: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.
text:
DEU 5:14
Thadou: hinlah nisagi lhinni Sabbath nikho hi Pakai, Pathen dinga nikho theng ki katdoh ahi. Hiche nikhoa hi koi machan insung natoh abol theilou ding, hiche hi nangho nahiuvin, nachapateu le nachanuteu, nasoh pasal ho le nasoh numei hou, bongchal holeh, sa-ngan ho chule nagancha jouse jaona, chule gamdangmi nalah uva hung cheng ho jaona hi ding ahi.
English: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.

tcz: Hiche hi nasuhmil lou diu ahi, khatvei chu Egypt gam sunga soh a um nahiuvin, hinlah Pakai, Pathen in abanthahat pana nahin puidoh'u ahi. Hiche jeh achu Pakai, Pathen in Sabbath nikhoa ki chol dinga thupeh anei ahi.
en: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
text:
DEU 5:15
Thadou: Hiche hi nasuhmil lou diu ahi, khatvei chu Egypt gam sunga soh a um nahiuvin, hinlah Pakai, Pathen in abanthahat pana nahin puidoh'u ahi. Hiche jeh achu Pakai, Pathen in Sabbath nikhoa ki chol dinga thupeh anei ahi.
English: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen thupeh bang in nanu, napa jabol un. Chutileh nahinkhou sot ding Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gam sunga lung monga nachen diu ahi.
en: “Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
text:
DEU 5:16
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen thupeh bang in nanu, napa jabol un. Chutileh nahinkhou sot ding Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gam sunga lung monga nachen diu ahi.
English: “Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

tcz: Toltha nabol lou diu ahi.
en: “You shall not murder.
text:
DEU 5:17
Thadou: Toltha nabol lou diu ahi.
English: “You shall not murder.

tcz: Jon thanhoi nabol lou diu ahi.
en: “You shall not commit adultery.
text:
DEU 5:18
Thadou: Jon thanhoi nabol lou diu ahi.
English: “You shall not commit adultery.

tcz: Gu chat nabol lou diu ahi.
en: “You shall not steal.
text:
DEU 5:19
Thadou: Gu chat nabol lou diu ahi.
English: “You shall not steal.

tcz: Na sopi nalhep chatvai lou diu ahi.
en: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
text:
DEU 5:20
Thadou: Na sopi nalhep chatvai lou diu ahi.
English: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

tcz: Na sopi jitoh nalupkhom lou diu ahi. Chule nasopi gam jong nachu lou diu, asoh numei hihen pasal hijongleh, abongchal hihen, asangante hijongleh nasopi nei le gou, ijakai lepthola nalah thei lou diu ahi.
en: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”
text:
DEU 5:21
Thadou: Na sopi jitoh nalupkhom lou diu ahi. Chule nasopi gam jong nachu lou diu, asoh numei hihen pasal hijongleh, abongchal hihen, asangante hijongleh nasopi nei le gou, ijakai lepthola nalah thei lou diu ahi.
English: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”

tcz: Hichengse hi molchunga nakal laiyuva Pakaiyin aseidohsa ahitai. Pakai chu meikong in akilah in aw-sang tah in asam in, chuin meibol le muthim in atomlha jeng in ahi. Hiche laimuna chu aboncha aseiya chule hichengse chu aboncha song pheng nia ajihlut a keima eipeh ahi.
en: The LORD spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.
text:
DEU 5:22
Thadou: Hichengse hi molchunga nakal laiyuva Pakaiyin aseidohsa ahitai. Pakai chu meikong in akilah in aw-sang tah in asam in, chuin meibol le muthim in atomlha jeng in ahi. Hiche laimuna chu aboncha aseiya chule hichengse chu aboncha song pheng nia ajihlut a keima eipeh ahi.
English: The LORD spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.

tcz: Nanghon awgin le mu-athime ti najauvin chule molchung pumpi athimlha jeng tan ahileh, na insung cheh uva koin lamkaiho le upa ho ka henga ahung uvin ahi.
en: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

tcz: Amahon hiti hin aseiyuve, vetan! IPakaiyu le i-Pathen uvin aloupina ki dangtah in eimusah uvin aw-sangtah meikonga kilah chu kaja uvin, tunin kamu tauve. Ajeh chu Pathen in mihemte henga thu aseiyin, hinlah ima kati deh pouvin ahi.
en: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.
text:
DEU 5:24
Thadou: Amahon hiti hin aseiyuve, vetan! IPakaiyu le i-Pathen uvin aloupina ki dangtah in eimusah uvin aw-sangtah meikonga kilah chu kaja uvin, tunin kamu tauve. Ajeh chu Pathen in mihemte henga thu aseiyin, hinlah ima kati deh pouvin ahi.
English: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.

tcz: Tunvang ipi dinga thi ikichat kit diu ham? Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in iheng uva thu asei kit a ahileh, thinan ilhun den uva meikonga iki govam jeng theiyu ahi.
en: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the LORD our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.
text:
DEU 5:25
Thadou: Tunvang ipi dinga thi ikichat kit diu ham? Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in iheng uva thu asei kit a ahileh, thinan ilhun den uva meikonga iki govam jeng theiyu ahi.
English: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the LORD our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.

tcz: Haina hu neiya hing itobang hijongleh, eiho banga hing jing Pathen awgin ja'a thi louva hing thei aum dem?
en: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?
text:
DEU 5:26
Thadou: Haina hu neiya hing itobang hijongleh, eiho banga hing jing Pathen awgin ja'a thi louva hing thei aum dem?
English: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?

tcz: Tun nangho cheuvin lang Pakai, Pathen in ipi asei em gangai tauvin. Chule hung kile kit unlang Pakaiyin ipi asei em ti kaheng uva hung seiyun, chuteng keihon kangai uva kajui diu ahi.
en: Go near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say, and tell us all that the LORD our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”
text:
DEU 5:27
Thadou: Tun nangho cheuvin lang Pakai, Pathen in ipi asei em gangai tauvin. Chule hung kile kit unlang Pakaiyin ipi asei em ti kaheng uva hung seiyun, chuteng keihon kangai uva kajui diu ahi.
English: Go near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say, and tell us all that the LORD our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”

tcz: Keima henga nangeh chan’u Pakaiyin ajasoh tan ahi. Pakaiyin hiti hin aseiye, mipihon nangma henga ipi asei uvem ti keiman ka hesoh keiyin, chule amahon thudih aseiyu ahi.
en: The LORD heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and the LORD said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.
text:
DEU 5:28
Thadou: Keima henga nangeh chan’u Pakaiyin ajasoh tan ahi. Pakaiyin hiti hin aseiye, mipihon nangma henga ipi asei uvem ti keiman ka hesoh keiyin, chule amahon thudih aseiyu ahi.
English: The LORD heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and the LORD said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.

tcz: Oh, hitia hi amahon lung ngaichatna anei jing diu chule hiche bang achu amahon keima eigin jing diu, ka thupeh jong anit jing diu ahi! Hitia chu achon jing uva ahileh, amaho leh achilhah teu chan geiya phatthei chang diu ahi.
en: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!
text:
DEU 5:29
Thadou: Oh, hitia hi amahon lung ngaichatna anei jing diu chule hiche bang achu amahon keima eigin jing diu, ka thupeh jong anit jing diu ahi! Hitia chu achon jing uva ahileh, amaho leh achilhah teu chan geiya phatthei chang diu ahi.
English: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!

tcz: Nangma chen lang aheng uva gasei tan, “Na ponbuh cheh uva kile tauvin.”
en: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’
text:
DEU 5:30
Thadou: Nangma chen lang aheng uva gasei tan, “Na ponbuh cheh uva kile tauvin.”
English: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’

tcz: Hinlah nangma hiche muna hin ding den nalaiyin chonna dan thupeh aboncha kasei peh ding nahi. Chule hichengse hi aboncha mipiho henga naseipeh ding chutileh amahon achen nau gamsunga chu ajui jing diu ahi.
en: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.”
text:
DEU 5:31
Thadou: Hinlah nangma hiche muna hin ding den nalaiyin chonna dan thupeh aboncha kasei peh ding nahi. Chule hichengse hi aboncha mipiho henga naseipeh ding chutileh amahon achen nau gamsunga chu ajui jing diu ahi.
English: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.”

tcz: Chuin Mose’n mipiho henga aseiyin, nang hon chingthei tah in Pakai, Pathen thupeh aboncha jui ding go uvin.
en: You shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.
text:
DEU 5:32
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n mipiho henga aseiyin, nang hon chingthei tah in Pakai, Pathen thupeh aboncha jui ding go uvin.
English: You shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in nathupeh nau lampi chu jui jing uvin. Chutileh nalhun nadiu gamsunga hinkho sot tah nachen thei diu ahi.
en: You shall walk in all the way which the LORD your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.
text:
DEU 5:33
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in nathupeh nau lampi chu jui jing uvin. Chutileh nalhun nadiu gamsunga hinkho sot tah nachen thei diu ahi.
English: You shall walk in all the way which the LORD your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in nangho seipeh dinga danthu eipeh hichengse hi ahi. Hiche gamsung nalut teng uleh, najui kimsoh kei diu ahi,
en: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;

tcz: chutileh nadam sunguva natu nachateu khang geiya keima eigin jing diu ahi. Pakai thupeh aboncha nanit soh keiyuva ahileh, lungmonga naum diu chule nahinkhou jong sot ding ahi.
en: that you might fear the LORD your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.
text:
DEU 6:2
Thadou: chutileh nadam sunguva natu nachateu khang geiya keima eigin jing diu ahi. Pakai thupeh aboncha nanit soh keiyuva ahileh, lungmonga naum diu chule nahinkhou jong sot ding ahi.
English: that you might fear the LORD your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.

tcz: Phatah in ngaiyun, Israel, ajeh chu hichengse hi najui kimsel diu ahi. Chutileh ijakai phacham kimsoh kei ding, napu napateu khanga pat Pakai, Pathen kitepna banga khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam'a chu nachen diu ahi.
en: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
text:
DEU 6:3
Thadou: Phatah in ngaiyun, Israel, ajeh chu hichengse hi najui kimsel diu ahi. Chutileh ijakai phacham kimsoh kei ding, napu napateu khanga pat Pakai, Pathen kitepna banga khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam'a chu nachen diu ahi.
English: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

tcz: O Israel ngaiyun! Pakai hi i-Pathen’u ahi, chule Pakai ama bou ahi.
en: Hear, Israel: The LORD is our God. The LORD is one.
text:
DEU 6:4
Thadou: O Israel ngaiyun! Pakai hi i-Pathen’u ahi, chule Pakai ama bou ahi.
English: Hear, Israel: The LORD is our God. The LORD is one.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai le na Pathen'u nalung thim pumpiu le natha neisun in ngailu uvin.
en: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
text:
DEU 6:5
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakai le na Pathen'u nalung thim pumpiu le natha neisun in ngailu uvin.
English: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

tcz: Tunia ka thupeh chengse aboncha chunga kipehna naneiyuva najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
en: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;

tcz: Hichengse hi nachateu henga avel vel'a naseipeh diu ahi. In muna naumpet'u hihen, lam najot pet'u hihen, nalup konu hihen, nakithodoh pet'u hijongleh, aheng uva naseipeh jing diu ahi.
en: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
text:
DEU 6:7
Thadou: Hichengse hi nachateu henga avel vel'a naseipeh diu ahi. In muna naumpet'u hihen, lam najot pet'u hihen, nalup konu hihen, nakithodoh pet'u hijongleh, aheng uva naseipeh jing diu ahi.
English: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.

tcz: Hichengse chu na khut’uva kikhi jing unlang chule nachalpang uva jong nakhi chah jing diu, hitia chu na suhmil lou diu ahi.
en: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
text:
DEU 6:8
Thadou: Hichengse chu na khut’uva kikhi jing unlang chule nachalpang uva jong nakhi chah jing diu, hitia chu na suhmil lou diu ahi.
English: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

tcz: Na in kot phung uva jong jih unlang chule kelkot mai ajong najih sohkei diu ahi.
en: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.
text:
DEU 6:9
Thadou: Na in kot phung uva jong jih unlang chule kelkot mai ajong najih sohkei diu ahi.
English: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.

tcz: Ajeh chu na Pakaiyu, na Pathen uvin napu na pateu Abraham, Isaac le Jacob henga akitepna gam sunga napuilut vah diu ahitai. Hiche khopi hoa hi ijakai bukimsel, hichu nang hon man beiya namu diu ahi.
en: It shall be, when the LORD your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,
text:
DEU 6:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu na Pakaiyu, na Pathen uvin napu na pateu Abraham, Isaac le Jacob henga akitepna gam sunga napuilut vah diu ahitai. Hiche khopi hoa hi ijakai bukimsel, hichu nang hon man beiya namu diu ahi.
English: It shall be, when the LORD your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,

tcz: Insung hoa chu neileh gou ijakai aki lamsa hi ding ahi. Twikul ho jong aki laisa ahin, Olive thing phung le adanghoa kona jong aga naneh diu, hicheho jouse hi nanghon tu lou hela aga nalo diu ahi. Hiche hohi naneh teng uleh gamsung pumpi nalodim diu ahitai.
en: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;

tcz: Chuleh chingthei un Pakai, na Pathen'u nasuh mil lou diu ahi, ajeh chu Egypt gam'a soh a naum laiyuva Pakaiyin na huhdoh’u ahi.
en: then beware lest you forget the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
text:
DEU 6:12
Thadou: Chuleh chingthei un Pakai, na Pathen'u nasuh mil lou diu ahi, ajeh chu Egypt gam'a soh a naum laiyuva Pakaiyin na huhdoh’u ahi.
English: then beware lest you forget the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u nagin diu chule Pakai kin jenga na kisah lel diu ahi. Ki hahselna nanei ujongleh Pakai min pana naki hahsel diu ahi.
en: You shall fear the LORD your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.
text:
DEU 6:13
Thadou: Nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u nagin diu chule Pakai kin jenga na kisah lel diu ahi. Ki hahselna nanei ujongleh Pakai min pana naki hahsel diu ahi.
English: You shall fear the LORD your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.

tcz: Na kimvel uva nam dangte pathen semthu angsunga naboh khup lou diu ahi.
en: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,
text:
DEU 6:14
Thadou: Na kimvel uva nam dangte pathen semthu angsunga naboh khup lou diu ahi.
English: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen hi thangtom thei ahi. Pakai lunghanna chun leiset chunga kona natol mang jeng theiyu ahi.
en: for the LORD your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of the LORD your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.
text:
DEU 6:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen hi thangtom thei ahi. Pakai lunghanna chun leiset chunga kona natol mang jeng theiyu ahi.
English: for the LORD your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of the LORD your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.

tcz: Nanghon Massah muna Pakai, Pathen napatep banguva avela napatep kitlou diu ahi.
en: You shall not tempt the LORD your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
text:
DEU 6:16
Thadou: Nanghon Massah muna Pakai, Pathen napatep banguva avela napatep kitlou diu ahi.
English: You shall not tempt the LORD your God, as you tempted him in Massah.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh phatah a nanit jing diu, Dan jouse najui kim sohkei diu ahi.
en: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
text:
DEU 6:17
Thadou: Nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh phatah a nanit jing diu, Dan jouse najui kim sohkei diu ahi.
English: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.

tcz: Pathen mitmua apha jeng bol ding go uvin, chutileh ijakai pha chamkim soh kei ding ahi. Chuteng Pakaiyin napu napateu khanga pat’a kitepna gam sunga nachen diu ahi.
en: You shall do that which is right and good in the LORD’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which the LORD swore to your fathers,
text:
DEU 6:18
Thadou: Pathen mitmua apha jeng bol ding go uvin, chutileh ijakai pha chamkim soh kei ding ahi. Chuteng Pakaiyin napu napateu khanga pat’a kitepna gam sunga nachen diu ahi.
English: You shall do that which is right and good in the LORD’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which the LORD swore to your fathers,

tcz: Pakaiyin asei bang in, hiche gam sunga nagal miteu aboncha Pakaiyin asuhmang hel ding ahi.
en: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as the LORD has spoken.
text:
DEU 6:19
Thadou: Pakaiyin asei bang in, hiche gam sunga nagal miteu aboncha Pakaiyin asuhmang hel ding ahi.
English: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as the LORD has spoken.

tcz: Khonung le nachateu vin hitia hi ahin sei diu, hiche dan le thupeh jui ding hohi ipi jeh a Pakai, Pathen in napeh ham? tia nahin doh diu ahi.
en: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD our God has commanded you mean?”
text:
DEU 6:20
Thadou: Khonung le nachateu vin hitia hi ahin sei diu, hiche dan le thupeh jui ding hohi ipi jeh a Pakai, Pathen in napeh ham? tia nahin doh diu ahi.
English: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD our God has commanded you mean?”

tcz: Chuteng nanghon hitia hi na donbut diu, keiho Egypt gamsunga Pharaoh angsunga soh a kana um laiyuva Pakai, Pathen in abanthahat a eihin huh doh'u ahi.
en: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;

tcz: Pakaiyin Egypt gamsunga Pharaoh le amite henga thil kidang ijakai aki lahsah in, ipu ipateu khanga pat akitepna gamsunga cheng dia eihin puiyu ahi.
en: and the LORD showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;

tcz: Pakaiyin Egypt gamsunga kona eihin puigal kaiyu ahin, ajeh chu eihon hiche gam ilo thei nadiu ahi.
en: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.
text:
DEU 6:23
Thadou: Pakaiyin Egypt gamsunga kona eihin puigal kaiyu ahin, ajeh chu eihon hiche gam ilo thei nadiu ahi.
English: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.

tcz: Hijeh achu Pakai, Pathen in hiche dan thupeh jui ding jouse hi eipeh uva, hichengse ijui kimsoh kei uva ahileh ihinkhou sot ding chule imatih chana phatthei ichan diu ahi. Hichu tuni chan geiya idamnau ahi.
en: The LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.
text:
DEU 6:24
Thadou: Hijeh achu Pakai, Pathen in hiche dan thupeh jui ding jouse hi eipeh uva, hichengse ijui kimsoh kei uva ahileh ihinkhou sot ding chule imatih chana phatthei ichan diu ahi. Hichu tuni chan geiya idamnau ahi.
English: The LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen akona dan le thupeh aboncha ijui uva ahileh Pakaiyin eiho jouse them changa eisim diu ahi.
en: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he has commanded us.”
text:
DEU 6:25
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen akona dan le thupeh aboncha ijui uva ahileh Pakaiyin eiho jouse them changa eisim diu ahi.
English: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he has commanded us.”

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen uvin gam sunga nahin puilut teng uleh, nam dang tampi umho khu asuhmang ding ahi: Hit mite, Girgash mite, Amor mite, Canaan mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite le Jebus mite ahi. Hiche nam sagi hohi nang ho sanga hatjo le pungjo ahiuve.
en: When the LORD your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—seven nations greater and mightier than you;

tcz: Pakaiyin akhut akona nang ho nahin pehdoh tenguleh, nang hon abonchauva nasuh gamsoh keidiu ahi. Amaho toh ki chamna ima semlouva abonchauva natha gam diu ahi.
en: and when the LORD your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.
text:
DEU 7:2
Thadou: Pakaiyin akhut akona nang ho nahin pehdoh tenguleh, nang hon abonchauva nasuh gamsoh keidiu ahi. Amaho toh ki chamna ima semlouva abonchauva natha gam diu ahi.
English: and when the LORD your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.

tcz: Chule amaho toh chun na kichen thei lou diu ahi. Na chanuteu le nachapate hou chu amaho chanute le chapate toh nakichen sah louhel diu ahi.
en: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.
text:
DEU 7:3
Thadou: Chule amaho toh chun na kichen thei lou diu ahi. Na chanuteu le nachapate hou chu amaho chanute le chapate toh nakichen sah louhel diu ahi.
English: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.

tcz: Ajeh chu ama hon na chateu apui mang diu, semthu pathen angsunga abohkhup sah diu ahi. Chuteng Pakai lunghanna nachung uva hung chu jeng ding, chomlou kah a na manthah lo diu ahi.
en: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So the LORD’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.
text:
DEU 7:4
Thadou: Ajeh chu ama hon na chateu apui mang diu, semthu pathen angsunga abohkhup sah diu ahi. Chuteng Pakai lunghanna nachung uva hung chu jeng ding, chomlou kah a na manthah lo diu ahi.
English: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So the LORD’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.

tcz: Hitia hi nabol teidiu ahi, amaicham phung hou le akhom ho aboncha naphuh lhuh peh diu ahi. Chule Asherah ho jong naphuh lhuh diu aboncha meiya nahal vam diu ahi.
en: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.
text:
DEU 7:5
Thadou: Hitia hi nabol teidiu ahi, amaicham phung hou le akhom ho aboncha naphuh lhuh peh diu ahi. Chule Asherah ho jong naphuh lhuh diu aboncha meiya nahal vam diu ahi.
English: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho Pakai, Pathen in vannoi mite lah atumbeh a na lhen’u ahin, chule nangho amagou nahi tauvin, Pakai dinga mithengte nahi tauve.
en: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.
text:
DEU 7:6
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangho Pakai, Pathen in vannoi mite lah atumbeh a na lhen’u ahin, chule nangho amagou nahi tauvin, Pakai dinga mithengte nahi tauve.
English: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

tcz: Pakaiyin namdang te banga thalhing le hatjo nahijeh uva nalhen tumu hilouvin, amavang nam neopen nahijeh uva nalhen joh’u ahi!
en: The LORD didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;
