tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin akitepna ageldoh jing in, nachung uva ngailutna anei jing in ahi. Hijeh achu Pakaiyin athahat pana Egypt gam Pharaoh akon suhgimna nachan nauva kona nahuh doh’u ahi.
en: but because the LORD loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, the LORD has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
text:
DEU 7:8
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin akitepna ageldoh jing in, nachung uva ngailutna anei jing in ahi. Hijeh achu Pakaiyin athahat pana Egypt gam Pharaoh akon suhgimna nachan nauva kona nahuh doh’u ahi.
English: but because the LORD loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, the LORD has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

tcz: Hijeh chun hethem un Pakai, Pathen hi nang ho Pathen dihtah mong ahi. Pakai ngailua athupeh nit jing mite chunga, akhang akhanga akitepna akoi jing in ngailutna jong anei jing in ahi.
en: Know therefore that the LORD your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,
text:
DEU 7:9
Thadou: Hijeh chun hethem un Pakai, Pathen hi nang ho Pathen dihtah mong ahi. Pakai ngailua athupeh nit jing mite chunga, akhang akhanga akitepna akoi jing in ngailutna jong anei jing in ahi.
English: Know therefore that the LORD your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,

tcz: Hinlah Pakai nasah louva umho chunga gim genthei alhunsah in asumang jin ahi.
en: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.
text:
DEU 7:10
Thadou: Hinlah Pakai nasah louva umho chunga gim genthei alhunsah in asumang jin ahi.
English: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.

tcz: Hijeh chun tunia thupeh kapeh chengse hi aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
en: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.
text:
DEU 7:11
Thadou: Hijeh chun tunia thupeh kapeh chengse hi aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
English: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.

tcz: Dan le thupeh aboncha najui kimsoh keiyuva ahileh Pakai, Pathen in na chung uva alungsetna longlou chu akoi jing ding ahi. Ajeh chu napu napateu khanga pet akitepna ahi.
en: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that the LORD your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.
text:
DEU 7:12
Thadou: Dan le thupeh aboncha najui kimsoh keiyuva ahileh Pakai, Pathen in na chung uva alungsetna longlou chu akoi jing ding ahi. Ajeh chu napu napateu khanga pet akitepna ahi.
English: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that the LORD your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.

tcz: Pakaiyin phatthei naleh Ami ngailutna chun naumpi jing diu chule cha jong tampi nahin diu ahi. Pakaiyin gampha tah gaphaso nading leh naganchateu kivahna ding napeh diu, napu napateu khanga peh dinga akitepna gam nalhun tenguleh louga phatah nachom khom diu, lengpi thah leh Olive thao chule bonghon tampi leh kelngoi hon tampi jaona nanei diu ahi.
en: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.
text:
DEU 7:13
Thadou: Pakaiyin phatthei naleh Ami ngailutna chun naumpi jing diu chule cha jong tampi nahin diu ahi. Pakaiyin gampha tah gaphaso nading leh naganchateu kivahna ding napeh diu, napu napateu khanga peh dinga akitepna gam nalhun tenguleh louga phatah nachom khom diu, lengpi thah leh Olive thao chule bonghon tampi leh kelngoi hon tampi jaona nanei diu ahi.
English: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.

tcz: Chutengleh Vannoiya nam dangte jouse sanga phatthei nachan diu ahi. Numei, pasal hihen nagancha teu hijongleh cha nei louva khatcha naum lou diu ahi.
en: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.
text:
DEU 7:14
Thadou: Chutengleh Vannoiya nam dangte jouse sanga phatthei nachan diu ahi. Numei, pasal hihen nagancha teu hijongleh cha nei louva khatcha naum lou diu ahi.
English: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.

tcz: Chule dammo veisetna akona Pakaiyin navenbit jing diu ahi. Egypt gam'a gim genthei nathoh bang uva nathoh sah lou diu, na doumah jouseu aboncha asuh mang ding ahi.
en: The LORD will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.
text:
DEU 7:15
Thadou: Chule dammo veisetna akona Pakaiyin navenbit jing diu ahi. Egypt gam'a gim genthei nathoh bang uva nathoh sah lou diu, na doumah jouseu aboncha asuh mang ding ahi.
English: The LORD will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in nam dangte nakhut a apehdoh chengse aboncha nasuh gam diu ahi. Ngailutna beiya nabol diu chule amaho pathen angsunga nabohkhup lou heldiu ahi.
en: You shall consume all the peoples whom the LORD your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.
text:
DEU 7:16
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in nam dangte nakhut a apehdoh chengse aboncha nasuh gam diu ahi. Ngailutna beiya nabol diu chule amaho pathen angsunga nabohkhup lou heldiu ahi.
English: You shall consume all the peoples whom the LORD your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.

tcz: Amavang nanghon hitia hi nasei diu, hiche nam mite hi eiho sang in ahat jouvin, iti iki doupi thei diu ham?
en: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”
text:
DEU 7:17
Thadou: Amavang nanghon hitia hi nasei diu, hiche nam mite hi eiho sang in ahat jouvin, iti iki doupi thei diu ham?
English: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”

tcz: Hinlah nakichat thei lou diu ahi! Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin Egypt gam Pharaoh henga ichan geiya na atoh ham ti nageldoh diu ahi.
en: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:
text:
DEU 7:18
Thadou: Hinlah nakichat thei lou diu ahi! Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin Egypt gam Pharaoh henga ichan geiya na atoh ham ti nageldoh diu ahi.
English: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen uvin amaho chunga tijat umtah’a na atoh geldoh jing un, hichu nangho mitmu tah a thilsoh ahi! Chule thil ki dang ijakai akilahsah ho geldoh jing uvin, abanthahat pana anatoh thil kidang hoa kona Egypt gam'a pet nahin puiyu chu na suhmil lou diu ahi. Hiche banga chu Pakai, Pathen in tua nagal miteu chunga na atoh ding ahi.
en: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which the LORD your God brought you out. So shall the LORD your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.
text:
DEU 7:19
Thadou: Pakai, na Pathen uvin amaho chunga tijat umtah’a na atoh geldoh jing un, hichu nangho mitmu tah a thilsoh ahi! Chule thil ki dang ijakai akilahsah ho geldoh jing uvin, abanthahat pana anatoh thil kidang hoa kona Egypt gam'a pet nahin puiyu chu na suhmil lou diu ahi. Hiche banga chu Pakai, Pathen in tua nagal miteu chunga na atoh ding ahi.
English: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which the LORD your God brought you out. So shall the LORD your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen uvin tijatna phabep namasang lam uva ahin koi ding, chuteng ijakai atol mang soh ding ahi.
en: Moreover the LORD your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.
text:
DEU 7:20
Thadou: Pakai, na Pathen uvin tijatna phabep namasang lam uva ahin koi ding, chuteng ijakai atol mang soh ding ahi.
English: Moreover the LORD your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.

tcz: Hiche nam mite chunga chu kichatna nanei louhel diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin na umpi jing uve, Pathen thilbol thei kidang ahi.
en: You shall not be scared of them; for the LORD your God is among you, a great and awesome God.
text:
DEU 7:21
Thadou: Hiche nam mite chunga chu kichatna nanei louhel diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin na umpi jing uve, Pathen thilbol thei kidang ahi.
English: You shall not be scared of them; for the LORD your God is among you, a great and awesome God.

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen uvin hiche nam mite hohi aloi loiya asuh mang ding ahi. Khatvei pansa nasuhmang jeng thei lou diu ahi. Achuti louva ahile gamsate hung dimlha jeng ding ahi.
en: The LORD your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.
text:
DEU 7:22
Thadou: Pakai, na Pathen uvin hiche nam mite hohi aloi loiya asuh mang ding ahi. Khatvei pansa nasuhmang jeng thei lou diu ahi. Achuti louva ahile gamsate hung dimlha jeng ding ahi.
English: The LORD your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai, na Pathen uvin abonchauva nangho khut a apeh doh ding ahi. Amaho abei kahseuva Pakaiyin asuhnoh phah diu ahi.
en: But the LORD your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.
text:
DEU 7:23
Thadou: Hinlah Pakai, na Pathen uvin abonchauva nangho khut a apeh doh ding ahi. Amaho abei kahseuva Pakaiyin asuhnoh phah diu ahi.
English: But the LORD your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.

tcz: Pakaiyin alengte hou nangho khut a apehdoh ding, chuteng nanghon leiset a amin hou nasuh mang diu ahi.
en: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.
text:
DEU 7:24
Thadou: Pakaiyin alengte hou nangho khut a apehdoh ding, chuteng nanghon leiset a amin hou nasuh mang diu ahi.
English: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.

tcz: Chule amilim doi semthu hou aboncha nahalvam peh diu, milim doi tomna ki mang sum-eng hijongleh khat jeng cha na kilah thei lou diu ahi.
en: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to the LORD your God.
text:
DEU 7:25
Thadou: Chule amilim doi semthu hou aboncha nahalvam peh diu, milim doi tomna ki mang sum-eng hijongleh khat jeng cha na kilah thei lou diu ahi.
English: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to the LORD your God.

tcz: Na insung'u suboh thei ima nanei thei lou diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho kibolna banga nangho jong thina nachan diu ahi. Hitobang thil hoa kona gamna kipan ding chule na kidalse jing diu ahi.
en: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.
text:
DEU 7:26
Thadou: Na insung'u suboh thei ima nanei thei lou diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho kibolna banga nangho jong thina nachan diu ahi. Hitobang thil hoa kona gamna kipan ding chule na kidalse jing diu ahi.
English: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.

tcz: Tunia ka thupeh chengse hi chingthei tah in jui bukim soh keiyuvin. Chutileh nahinkhou sot intin, Pakaiyin napu napate khanga pat peh dinga akitepna gam nalo thei diu ahi.
en: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers.
text:
DEU 8:1
Thadou: Tunia ka thupeh chengse hi chingthei tah in jui bukim soh keiyuvin. Chutileh nahinkhou sot intin, Pakaiyin napu napate khanga pat peh dinga akitepna gam nalo thei diu ahi.
English: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers.

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen uvin kum somli gamthip lah akona nahin puidohna geldoh jing un, ajeh chu Pakai thupeh ijakai nanit kimsoh nadiuva nangho patepna ahi.
en: You shall remember all the way which the LORD your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.
text:
DEU 8:2
Thadou: Pakai, na Pathen uvin kum somli gamthip lah akona nahin puidohna geldoh jing un, ajeh chu Pakai thupeh ijakai nanit kimsoh nadiuva nangho patepna ahi.
English: You shall remember all the way which the LORD your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.

tcz: Henge, Pakaiyin gilkiela naum laipet tah uvin mana napiuvin ahi. Hiche tobang an-hi napu, napateu khanga jong um khalou ahi. Ajeh chu mihemte hi changlhah jengseh a hing jou ahipoi ti, Pakaiyin nahetsah nau ahin; amavang Pakai kam sunga kona hung potdoh thu changa bou hinga nahiuve.
en: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of the LORD’s mouth.
text:
DEU 8:3
Thadou: Henge, Pakaiyin gilkiela naum laipet tah uvin mana napiuvin ahi. Hiche tobang an-hi napu, napateu khanga jong um khalou ahi. Ajeh chu mihemte hi changlhah jengseh a hing jou ahipoi ti, Pakaiyin nahetsah nau ahin; amavang Pakai kam sunga kona hung potdoh thu changa bou hinga nahiuve.
English: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of the LORD’s mouth.

tcz: Kum somli sung in von-ah ding jong nangaicha pouvin chule nakeng ujong imacha atipon ahi.
en: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.
text:
DEU 8:4
Thadou: Kum somli sung in von-ah ding jong nangaicha pouvin chule nakeng ujong imacha atipon ahi.
English: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.

tcz: Hichu geltem uvin: Minu mipan acha ahilna banga, Pakaiyin nang ho phatchomna dinga bou nakhoukhah nau ahi.
en: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.
text:
DEU 8:5
Thadou: Hichu geltem uvin: Minu mipan acha ahilna banga, Pakaiyin nang ho phatchomna dinga bou nakhoukhah nau ahi.
English: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh chengse abonchan nit kimsoh keiyun lang, Pakai ging jinga hinkho naman diu ahi.
en: You shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
text:
DEU 8:6
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh chengse abonchan nit kimsoh keiyun lang, Pakai ging jinga hinkho naman diu ahi.
English: You shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin na gamu phatah twi nenna muna nahin puiyuva, hichu phaicham leh thing lhang gam aboncha ahi.
en: For the LORD your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;

tcz: Hiche gam pumpi hi mimchang le kolbu lei jeng ahin; theiba phung, kolbu thei phung, Olive phung leh khoiju lonna gam ahi.
en: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;

tcz: Hiche gamsung hi Pakaiyin ijakai kimsela twi achap nou ahin, chule agam sunga thih jong song banga kimang ahin, thinglhang gam song mantam jeng uma ahi.
en: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.
text:
DEU 8:9
Thadou: Hiche gamsung hi Pakaiyin ijakai kimsela twi achap nou ahin, chule agam sunga thih jong song banga kimang ahin, thinglhang gam song mantam jeng uma ahi.
English: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.

tcz: Agamsungga naneh teng uleh Pakai, na Pathen'u thangvahna napeh jing diu ahi.
en: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which he has given you.
text:
DEU 8:10
Thadou: Agamsungga naneh teng uleh Pakai, na Pathen'u thangvahna napeh jing diu ahi.
English: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which he has given you.

tcz: Hinlah chingthei tah in um uvin! Ajeh chu hiche gampha laitah jeh a chu tunikhoa Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh nasuh millou diu ahi.
en: Beware lest you forget the LORD your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;

tcz: Nanghon innom nahin kisah doh diu chule haosatah a nain chen diu,
en: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;

tcz: chule nagan chateu jong hung pung cheh cheh ding, sana leh dangka ijakai kimsela nahin neidiu chuteng chingthei tah naum diu ahi.
en: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;

tcz: Chutengleh kiletsah hoithona imacha naneilou diu ahi. Ajeh chu Egypt gamsunga gim genthei nathoh lai uva Pakai, Pathen in nahuh doh’u ahi.
en: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;

tcz: Pakaiyin gamthip noiya aipi hang leh gulse holah a nahin puidoh nau nagel doh jing diu, hiche mun chu tolgo lah le gamsa mun ahin, hinlah Pakaiyin twi nape uvin ahi.
en: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;

tcz: Pakaiyin gamthip noiya manna in navah vaset uvin, hichu napu napateu khanga um khalou anneh ahi. Hiche hi Pakaiyin nangho patepna dinga abol ahin athua nanun cheh diu ahi.
en: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;

tcz: Hiche ho jouse Pakaiyin nang ho dinga na atoh ahin, keima hatna a ka kilamdoh ahitia ima nasei louhel diu ahi.
en: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”
text:
DEU 8:17
Thadou: Hiche ho jouse Pakaiyin nang ho dinga na atoh ahin, keima hatna a ka kilamdoh ahitia ima nasei louhel diu ahi.
English: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen'u na geldoh jing diu ahi. Pakai bouvin nangho lolhin theina dinga tha napeh’u ahi, ajeh chu napu, napa teu khanga pat kitepna gui lhunsah nading ahi.
en: But you shall remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.
text:
DEU 8:18
Thadou: Pakai, na Pathen'u na geldoh jing diu ahi. Pakai bouvin nangho lolhin theina dinga tha napeh’u ahi, ajeh chu napu, napa teu khanga pat kitepna gui lhunsah nading ahi.
English: But you shall remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.

tcz: Hiche hi nahet jing diuva ka thupeh ahi: Pakai, na Pathen'u sumila pathen dang angsunga na bohkhup uva ahileh, na chung uva thina lhung jeng ding ahi.
en: It shall be, if you shall forget the LORD your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.
text:
DEU 8:19
Thadou: Hiche hi nahet jing diuva ka thupeh ahi: Pakai, na Pathen'u sumila pathen dang angsunga na bohkhup uva ahileh, na chung uva thina lhung jeng ding ahi.
English: It shall be, if you shall forget the LORD your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen nah sah louva naum uva ahileh, nam dang ki sumang ho banga nangho jong na ki sumang diu ahi.
en: As the nations that the LORD makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.
text:
DEU 8:20
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen nah sah louva naum uva ahileh, nam dang ki sumang ho banga nangho jong na ki sumang diu ahi.
English: As the nations that the LORD makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

tcz: Ngaiyun, O Israel! Tunia hi nangman Jordan vadung galkaiya namdangte chenna nalut ding ahitan, amaho khu nangho jouse sanga hatthei ahiuve. Khopi sunga acheng uvin chule akhopi kimvel uva pal kigen jouse jong vanthamjol chana sang ahi!
en: Hear, Israel! You are to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to the sky,
text:
DEU 9:1
Thadou: Ngaiyun, O Israel! Tunia hi nangman Jordan vadung galkaiya namdangte chenna nalut ding ahitan, amaho khu nangho jouse sanga hatthei ahiuve. Khopi sunga acheng uvin chule akhopi kimvel uva pal kigen jouse jong vanthamjol chana sang ahi!
English: Hear, Israel! You are to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to the sky,

tcz: Amaho khu nangho sang in asang jouvin chule athahat jouvin abonchauva Anak chilhah ahiuve. Hijeh chun amahoa konin awchang naja tauvin, Anak mite kalvala chung nungjo koi ham? tin asei uve.
en: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”
text:
DEU 9:2
Thadou: Amaho khu nangho sang in asang jouvin chule athahat jouvin abonchauva Anak chilhah ahiuve. Hijeh chun amahoa konin awchang naja tauvin, Anak mite kalvala chung nungjo koi ham? tin asei uve.
English: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”

tcz: Ahinlah nahe sohkei uve tunikhoa hi Pakai, Pathen in ki dangtah’a aluchung vumuva meikong akilah sah ding asuh gam hel diu ahi. Pakaiyin ahin suhnem diu chuteng nanghon baithet’a natha gam diu ahi. Hichu Pakai, Pathen kitepna ahi.
en: Know therefore today that the LORD your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire. He will destroy them and he will bring them down before you. So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly, as the LORD has spoken to you.
text:
DEU 9:3
Thadou: Ahinlah nahe sohkei uve tunikhoa hi Pakai, Pathen in ki dangtah’a aluchung vumuva meikong akilah sah ding asuh gam hel diu ahi. Pakaiyin ahin suhnem diu chuteng nanghon baithet’a natha gam diu ahi. Hichu Pakai, Pathen kitepna ahi.
English: Know therefore today that the LORD your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire. He will destroy them and he will bring them down before you. So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly, as the LORD has spoken to you.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in nangho dinga hitobang natoh ahin chaisoh tengleh, ka chonphat jeh uva Pakaiyin hiche gam hi eipeh’u ahi, tia nasei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu hiche nam mite phatlou jeh’a Pakaiyin agam uva kona asoldoh joh ahi.
en: Don’t say in your heart, after the LORD your God has thrust them out from before you, “For my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land;” because the LORD drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.
text:
DEU 9:4
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in nangho dinga hitobang natoh ahin chaisoh tengleh, ka chonphat jeh uva Pakaiyin hiche gam hi eipeh’u ahi, tia nasei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu hiche nam mite phatlou jeh’a Pakaiyin agam uva kona asoldoh joh ahi.
English: Don’t say in your heart, after the LORD your God has thrust them out from before you, “For my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land;” because the LORD drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.

tcz: Nangho chonphat vanga hiche gam hi nalo diu ahipoi. Hinlah hiche nam mite phatlou jeh’a adelmang ahin chule Pakai, Pathen in napu napateu Abraham, Isaac le Jacob henga aki tepna asuh bukim ahi.
en: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
text:
DEU 9:5
Thadou: Nangho chonphat vanga hiche gam hi nalo diu ahipoi. Hinlah hiche nam mite phatlou jeh’a adelmang ahin chule Pakai, Pathen in napu napateu Abraham, Isaac le Jacob henga aki tepna asuh bukim ahi.
English: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

tcz: Nangho chonphat vanga Pakaiyin hiche gam hi napeh’u ahipoi ti nahet diu ahi, ajeh chu nangho milungtahte nahiuve.
en: Know therefore that the LORD your God doesn’t give you this good land to possess for your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people.
text:
DEU 9:6
Thadou: Nangho chonphat vanga Pakaiyin hiche gam hi napeh’u ahipoi ti nahet diu ahi, ajeh chu nangho milungtahte nahiuve.
English: Know therefore that the LORD your God doesn’t give you this good land to possess for your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people.

tcz: Gamthip noiya Pakai nalunghan sahnau geldoh jing uvin. Egypt gam nahin dalhah nikho uva pat tuni chana vel ijat Pakai, Pathen doumah nabol doh tah uvem.
en: Remember, and don’t forget, how you provoked the LORD your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against the LORD.
text:
DEU 9:7
Thadou: Gamthip noiya Pakai nalunghan sahnau geldoh jing uvin. Egypt gam nahin dalhah nikho uva pat tuni chana vel ijat Pakai, Pathen doumah nabol doh tah uvem.
English: Remember, and don’t forget, how you provoked the LORD your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against the LORD.

tcz: Sinai mol jenga jong Pakai doumah nabol uvin hi chun Pakaiyin thagam ding nago uvin ahi.
en: Also in Horeb you provoked the LORD to wrath, and the LORD was angry with you to destroy you.
text:
DEU 9:8
Thadou: Sinai mol jenga jong Pakai doumah nabol uvin hi chun Pakaiyin thagam ding nago uvin ahi.
English: Also in Horeb you provoked the LORD to wrath, and the LORD was angry with you to destroy you.

tcz: Hiche hi Sinai molchung ka umlaiya thilsoh ahin, Pakayin songpheng-ni ah imatih chana ding in kitepna chu asem tan ahi. Nisomli le jansomli jen an nelou twidon louvin kaum in ahi.
en: When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.
text:
DEU 9:9
Thadou: Hiche hi Sinai molchung ka umlaiya thilsoh ahin, Pakayin songpheng-ni ah imatih chana ding in kitepna chu asem tan ahi. Nisomli le jansomli jen an nelou twidon louvin kaum in ahi.
English: When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin songpheng-ni eipen hichu Pathen amatah molchunga naum laiyuva athu seidoh chengse akhut’a ajih doh ahi.
en: The LORD delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which the LORD spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.
text:
DEU 9:10
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin songpheng-ni eipen hichu Pathen amatah molchunga naum laiyuva athu seidoh chengse akhut’a ajih doh ahi.
English: The LORD delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which the LORD spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.

tcz: Ni somli le jansomli lhin nikhon Pakaiyin kitepna songpheng teni chu eipe tan ahi.
en: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.
text:
DEU 9:11
Thadou: Ni somli le jansomli lhin nikhon Pakaiyin kitepna songpheng teni chu eipe tan ahi.
English: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin ka henga aseiyin, Kipat in che tan! Egypt gam'a kona nahin puidoh miten doumah jeng aboltauve. Chomlou kah in ka thupeh nahsah louvin aki hei mang tauve! Sana limdoi sem in hinkho amang tauvin ahi!
en: The LORD said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. They have quickly turned away from the way which I commanded them. They have made a molten image for themselves!”
text:
DEU 9:12
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin ka henga aseiyin, Kipat in che tan! Egypt gam'a kona nahin puidoh miten doumah jeng aboltauve. Chomlou kah in ka thupeh nahsah louvin aki hei mang tauve! Sana limdoi sem in hinkho amang tauvin ahi!
English: The LORD said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. They have quickly turned away from the way which I commanded them. They have made a molten image for themselves!”

tcz: Pakaiyin ka henga asei kit in, ‘Hiche mite lungtah le thungai louna ka muchen tai.
en: Furthermore the LORD spoke to me, saying, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.
text:
DEU 9:13
Thadou: Pakaiyin ka henga asei kit in, ‘Hiche mite lungtah le thungai louna ka muchen tai.
English: Furthermore the LORD spoke to me, saying, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

tcz: Tun keima che ingting hiche mite hi vannoiya kasuh mang jeng diu ahi. Amaho sanga hatjo le chung nung joa keiman na chillhahte ka tundoh ding ahi.
en: Leave me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under the sky; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.”
text:
DEU 9:14
Thadou: Tun keima che ingting hiche mite hi vannoiya kasuh mang jeng diu ahi. Amaho sanga hatjo le chung nung joa keiman na chillhahte ka tundoh ding ahi.
English: Leave me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under the sky; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.”

tcz: Chuin molchung vum'a meikong akilui jeng tan ahile, keima ka hung kumsuh in mon mang theilou kitepna songpheng teni chu kahin choiyin ahi.
en: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.
text:
DEU 9:15
Thadou: Chuin molchung vum'a meikong akilui jeng tan ahile, keima ka hung kumsuh in mon mang theilou kitepna songpheng teni chu kahin choiyin ahi.
English: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.

tcz: Keiman kahin vesuh in ahileh, Pakai ding in chonset gitlouna nabol tauve ti ka muchen tai. Sana mangchan bonglim doi nakisem thu tauvin ahi. Pakai, Pathen in nathupeh nauva kon in chom loukah in nakihei mang tauve!
en: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against the LORD your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly turned away from the way which the LORD had commanded you.
text:
DEU 9:16
Thadou: Keiman kahin vesuh in ahileh, Pakai ding in chonset gitlouna nabol tauve ti ka muchen tai. Sana mangchan bonglim doi nakisem thu tauvin ahi. Pakai, Pathen in nathupeh nauva kon in chom loukah in nakihei mang tauve!
English: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against the LORD your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly turned away from the way which the LORD had commanded you.

tcz: Chuin keiman songpheng teni chu tol lhama kasep lhan namit mutah uvin kasep in ahi.
en: I took hold of the two tablets, and threw them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.
text:
DEU 9:17
Thadou: Chuin keiman songpheng teni chu tol lhama kasep lhan namit mutah uvin kasep in ahi.
English: I took hold of the two tablets, and threw them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai, Pathen angsunga nisomli le jan somli masang chun keiman an jong ka nepon chule twi jong ka don poi. Ajeh chu nang hon Pakai doumah bol in hinkho namang tauvin ahi.
en: I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.
text:
DEU 9:18
Thadou: Hinlah Pakai, Pathen angsunga nisomli le jan somli masang chun keiman an jong ka nepon chule twi jong ka don poi. Ajeh chu nang hon Pakai doumah bol in hinkho namang tauvin ahi.
English: I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

tcz: Pakai lunghanna nachung uva ahung chuh a na thagam diu chu keima ka kicha lheh jenge, hinlah Pakaiyin ka taona eisanpeh kit in ahi.
en: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which the LORD was angry against you to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me that time also.
text:
DEU 9:19
Thadou: Pakai lunghanna nachung uva ahung chuh a na thagam diu chu keima ka kicha lheh jenge, hinlah Pakaiyin ka taona eisanpeh kit in ahi.
English: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which the LORD was angry against you to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me that time also.

tcz: Pakai chu Joshua chunga alung phamo lheh jeng tan, tha ding agon ahi. Aaron dingin ka taovin ahileh Pakaiyin ahing hoi tan ahi.
en: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.
text:
DEU 9:20
Thadou: Pakai chu Joshua chunga alung phamo lheh jeng tan, tha ding agon ahi. Aaron dingin ka taovin ahileh Pakaiyin ahing hoi tan ahi.
English: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

tcz: Na chonset nau bonglim chu kalan nen lah a meiyin ka halvam tan ahi. Mei kihalna vutvai abonchan kalan molchung akona vadung twi a kasep lhatan ahi.
en: I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain.
text:
DEU 9:21
Thadou: Na chonset nau bonglim chu kalan nen lah a meiyin ka halvam tan ahi. Mei kihalna vutvai abonchan kalan molchung akona vadung twi a kasep lhatan ahi.
English: I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain.

tcz: Massah, Taberah le Kibroth-hattavah muna jong Pakai doumah nabol uvin ahi.
en: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked the LORD to wrath.
text:
DEU 9:22
Thadou: Massah, Taberah le Kibroth-hattavah muna jong Pakai doumah nabol uvin ahi.
English: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked the LORD to wrath.

tcz: Chuin Kadesh-barnea muna Pakaiyin hiche thupeh mangchan nasol tauvin ahi: Chetou un keiman kapehna gamkhu galo tauvin. Hinlah Pakai, Pathen thupeh nah sah louvin hinkho namang uvin ahi.
en: When the LORD sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and you didn’t believe him or listen to his voice.
text:
DEU 9:23
Thadou: Chuin Kadesh-barnea muna Pakaiyin hiche thupeh mangchan nasol tauvin ahi: Chetou un keiman kapehna gamkhu galo tauvin. Hinlah Pakai, Pathen thupeh nah sah louvin hinkho namang uvin ahi.
English: When the LORD sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and you didn’t believe him or listen to his voice.

tcz: Henge, Pakai doumah jeng nabol uve tihi keiman kahin he jing in ahi.
en: You have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
text:
DEU 9:24
Thadou: Henge, Pakai doumah jeng nabol uve tihi keiman kahin he jing in ahi.
English: You have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.

tcz: Hijeh achu nisomli le jan somli Pakai henga ka bohkhup in ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin nabonchauva thagam ding na got’u ahi.
en: So I fell down before the LORD the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because the LORD had said he would destroy you.
text:
DEU 9:25
Thadou: Hijeh achu nisomli le jan somli Pakai henga ka bohkhup in ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin nabonchauva thagam ding na got’u ahi.
English: So I fell down before the LORD the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because the LORD had said he would destroy you.

tcz: Pakai henga hiti hin kataove, O thaneipen Pakai, hiche mite hi sugam louvin, hinghoi tauvin. Amaho hi namite ahiuve. Chule amaho hi nagoulupen Egypt gam'a nahuh doh’a naban thahat pana nahin puidoh ahiuve.
en: I prayed to the LORD, and said, “Lord GOD, don’t destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed through your greatness, that you have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
text:
DEU 9:26
Thadou: Pakai henga hiti hin kataove, O thaneipen Pakai, hiche mite hi sugam louvin, hinghoi tauvin. Amaho hi namite ahiuve. Chule amaho hi nagoulupen Egypt gam'a nahuh doh’a naban thahat pana nahin puidoh ahiuve.
English: I prayed to the LORD, and said, “Lord GOD, don’t destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed through your greatness, that you have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

tcz: Hiche mite chonsetna leh lungtahna akon in ngaidam tan, chule ka puluiyu Abraham, Isaac le Jacob geldoh in, ati.
en: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Don’t look at the stubbornness of this people, nor at their wickedness, nor at their sin,
text:
DEU 9:27
Thadou: Hiche mite chonsetna leh lungtahna akon in ngaidam tan, chule ka puluiyu Abraham, Isaac le Jacob geldoh in, ati.
English: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Don’t look at the stubbornness of this people, nor at their wickedness, nor at their sin,

tcz: Hiche mite hi nasuh manga ahileh, Egypt miten hitia hi asei diu, ‘Israel mite athi gam tauve, ajeh chu Pakaiyin aki tepna gam'a chu apui lhung lou ahitai.’ Ahilouleh hiche mite hi Pakaiyin avetda jeh’a asuh gam ahitauve; thagam dinga apuile ahi, tia asei diu ahi.
en: lest the land you brought us out from say, ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised to them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’
text:
DEU 9:28
Thadou: Hiche mite hi nasuh manga ahileh, Egypt miten hitia hi asei diu, ‘Israel mite athi gam tauve, ajeh chu Pakaiyin aki tepna gam'a chu apui lhung lou ahitai.’ Ahilouleh hiche mite hi Pakaiyin avetda jeh’a asuh gam ahitauve; thagam dinga apuile ahi, tia asei diu ahi.
English: lest the land you brought us out from say, ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised to them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche mite hi nang man naban thahat pana Egypt gamsunga kona nahin puidoh ahiuve.
en: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.”
text:
DEU 9:29
Thadou: Ajeh chu hiche mite hi nang man naban thahat pana Egypt gamsunga kona nahin puidoh ahiuve.
English: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin kaheng ah hiti hin aseiyin, Songpheng ni masanga toh kibang chat hin choiyin chule thingkong khat phatah in sem inlang asunga khum ding ahi. Hiche na ding chun molchunga kahenga hung kaltouvin.
en: At that time the LORD said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.
text:
DEU 10:1
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin kaheng ah hiti hin aseiyin, Songpheng ni masanga toh kibang chat hin choiyin chule thingkong khat phatah in sem inlang asunga khum ding ahi. Hiche na ding chun molchunga kahenga hung kaltouvin.
English: At that time the LORD said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

tcz: Hiche songpheng chunga chu masanga na sekeh chunga thucheng kijih bang banga kajih lut ding, hichu thingkong sunga nakoi ding ahi.
en: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”
text:
DEU 10:2
Thadou: Hiche songpheng chunga chu masanga na sekeh chunga thucheng kijih bang banga kajih lut ding, hichu thingkong sunga nakoi ding ahi.
English: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”

tcz: Keiman thinggi thingkong in kasem in chule amasanga bang bang in songpheng ni ka suitoh in ahi.
en: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.
text:
DEU 10:3
Thadou: Keiman thinggi thingkong in kasem in chule amasanga bang bang in songpheng ni ka suitoh in ahi.
English: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin avelin thupeh som hochu ajih lut in, keima eipetan ahi. Songpheng teni chu kakhut in kachoiyin, molchung lama kakal tou tan ahi.
en: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me.
text:
DEU 10:4
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin avelin thupeh som hochu ajih lut in, keima eipetan ahi. Songpheng teni chu kakhut in kachoiyin, molchung lama kakal tou tan ahi.
English: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me.

tcz: Molchunga kon ka hung ki heisuh in, kitepna songpheng teni chu thingkong sunga kakoi tan, hichu Pakai thupeh banga kei man kabol ahi. Songpheng teni chu thingkong sunga aumtai.
en: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as the LORD commanded me.
text:
DEU 10:5
Thadou: Molchunga kon ka hung ki heisuh in, kitepna songpheng teni chu thingkong sunga kakoi tan, hichu Pakai thupeh banga kei man kabol ahi. Songpheng teni chu thingkong sunga aumtai.
English: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as the LORD commanded me.

tcz: Israel mite chu Jaakan twikul muna kon in Moserah kiti Aaron kivuina muna chun akitol tauvin ahi. Achapa Eleazar chun thempu na atoh ahi.
en: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.
text:
DEU 10:6
Thadou: Israel mite chu Jaakan twikul muna kon in Moserah kiti Aaron kivuina muna chun akitol tauvin ahi. Achapa Eleazar chun thempu na atoh ahi.
English: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.

tcz: Hiche muna pat chun, Gudgodah mun ajon tauvin, aban'in Jotbathah hiche muna chu twisam tampi putna mun ahi.
en: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.
text:
DEU 10:7
Thadou: Hiche muna pat chun, Gudgodah mun ajon tauvin, aban'in Jotbathah hiche muna chu twisam tampi putna mun ahi.
English: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Levi insung mite chu thingkong pu dingin adei lhen tan, chuleh Pakai angsunga ding diu Pakai mina thempu na atoh diu ahi. Hiche hi amaho natoh ding ahi.
en: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to stand before the LORD to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.
text:
DEU 10:8
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin Levi insung mite chu thingkong pu dingin adei lhen tan, chuleh Pakai angsunga ding diu Pakai mina thempu na atoh diu ahi. Hiche hi amaho natoh ding ahi.
English: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to stand before the LORD to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.

tcz: Hiche jeh achu Israel mite lah’a Levi insung chu chenna ding gamtum neilouva um ahiuvin, Pakai hi amaho dinga agoulupenu leh Pakai, Pathen thempu kinbol dinga um ahitauve.
en: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD your God spoke to him.)
text:
DEU 10:9
Thadou: Hiche jeh achu Israel mite lah’a Levi insung chu chenna ding gamtum neilouva um ahiuvin, Pakai hi amaho dinga agoulupenu leh Pakai, Pathen thempu kinbol dinga um ahitauve.
English: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD your God spoke to him.)

tcz: Keiman amasa pena ding in, ‘Nisomli le jan somli molchunga Pakai henga kaum in, Pakaiyin avelin ka taona asang in nangho nahing hoi tauvin ahi.’
en: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD listened to me that time also. The LORD would not destroy you.
text:
DEU 10:10
Thadou: Keiman amasa pena ding in, ‘Nisomli le jan somli molchunga Pakai henga kaum in, Pakaiyin avelin ka taona asang in nangho nahing hoi tauvin ahi.’
English: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD listened to me that time also. The LORD would not destroy you.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin ka henga aseiyin, keiman napuluiteu khang apat peh dinga ka kitepna, gamlo din mipiho lamkai tan, ati.
en: The LORD said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”
text:
DEU 10:11
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin ka henga aseiyin, keiman napuluiteu khang apat peh dinga ka kitepna, gamlo din mipiho lamkai tan, ati.
English: The LORD said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”

tcz: Chule tun, Israel mite, Pakai, Pathen in nanghoa kona adei chu ipi ham? Pakaiyin nang hoa kona adeichu Pakai ging jing unlang chule Pakai lunglam jeng nabol diu, na lungthim pumpiuva Pakai lam jeng nakat diu ahi.
en: Now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
text:
DEU 10:12
Thadou: Chule tun, Israel mite, Pakai, Pathen in nanghoa kona adei chu ipi ham? Pakaiyin nang hoa kona adeichu Pakai ging jing unlang chule Pakai lunglam jeng nabol diu, na lungthim pumpiuva Pakai lam jeng nakat diu ahi.
English: Now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

tcz: Chule tunia najah uva kasei, Pakai, Pathen akona thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
en: to keep the LORD’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?
text:
DEU 10:13
Thadou: Chule tunia najah uva kasei, Pakai, Pathen akona thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
English: to keep the LORD’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?

tcz: Veuvin! Chung sangpen leh leiset chunga thil ijakai jouse hi Pakai, Pathen a bou ahi.
en: Behold, to the LORD your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.
text:
DEU 10:14
Thadou: Veuvin! Chung sangpen leh leiset chunga thil ijakai jouse hi Pakai, Pathen a bou ahi.
English: Behold, to the LORD your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin napuluiteu ana ngailun hijeh achu, achilhahteu nangho jouse jong nam dang jouse sanga Pakaiyin na khohsah joh’u ahi.
en: Only the LORD had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.
text:
DEU 10:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin napuluiteu ana ngailun hijeh achu, achilhahteu nangho jouse jong nam dang jouse sanga Pakaiyin na khohsah joh’u ahi.
English: Only the LORD had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.

tcz: Hijeh chun na lungtah nauva kon in, na lung heiyun.
en: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.
text:
DEU 10:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun na lungtah nauva kon in, na lung heiyun.
English: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai le na Pathen uhi pathen jouse lah’a Pathen chung nung, pakai jouse lah’a Pakai chungpen ahi. Ki dangtah Pathen ahin, sihnei langneina beihel Pathen ahi.
en: For the LORD your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.
text:
DEU 10:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakai le na Pathen uhi pathen jouse lah’a Pathen chung nung, pakai jouse lah’a Pakai chungpen ahi. Ki dangtah Pathen ahin, sihnei langneina beihel Pathen ahi.
English: For the LORD your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.

tcz: Pakaiyin meithaiho leh chagaho angailun chule gamdangmi nalah uva chengho angailun, von ki-ah ding apeuvin ahi.
en: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.
text:
DEU 10:18
Thadou: Pakaiyin meithaiho leh chagaho angailun chule gamdangmi nalah uva chengho angailun, von ki-ah ding apeuvin ahi.
English: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.

tcz: Hijeh chun nanghon jong kholjinmi na ngailut diu ahi, ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gam'a kholjina hinkho na-namanu ahi.
en: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
text:
DEU 10:19
Thadou: Hijeh chun nanghon jong kholjinmi na ngailut diu ahi, ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gam'a kholjina hinkho na-namanu ahi.
English: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u kin jeng nabol diu ahi. Kitepna ijakai Pakai min jenga nanei diu ahi.
en: You shall fear the LORD your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.
text:
DEU 10:20
Thadou: Nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u kin jeng nabol diu ahi. Kitepna ijakai Pakai min jenga nanei diu ahi.
English: You shall fear the LORD your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.

tcz: Pakai ama bou Pathen ahin, chule Pakai bou choi-at dinga lom ahi. Ajeh chu ama bouvin thil kidang ijakai abol in, hichu namit tah uvin namu soh kei uve.
en: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.
text:
DEU 10:21
Thadou: Pakai ama bou Pathen ahin, chule Pakai bou choi-at dinga lom ahi. Ajeh chu ama bouvin thil kidang ijakai abol in, hichu namit tah uvin namu soh kei uve.
English: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.

tcz: Napu napate hou Egypt gam'a ache uchun amaho mi somsagi bou ahiuve. Hinlah tun nangho Pakai, Pathen in vana ahsi jat in na semdoh tauvin ahi.
en: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now the LORD your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.
text:
DEU 10:22
Thadou: Napu napate hou Egypt gam'a ache uchun amaho mi somsagi bou ahiuve. Hinlah tun nangho Pakai, Pathen in vana ahsi jat in na semdoh tauvin ahi.
English: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now the LORD your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen na ngailut diu chule Pakai dan leh thupeh aboncha najui teidiu ahi.
en: Therefore you shall love the LORD your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.
text:
DEU 11:1
Thadou: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen na ngailut diu chule Pakai dan leh thupeh aboncha najui teidiu ahi.
English: Therefore you shall love the LORD your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.

tcz: Chule nalungthim in haimil hih uvin, ajeh chu keiman nachateu henga thu hichengse Pakaiya kona dan leh thupeh khat jengcha jong ajah uvin kasei pon, amahon Pakai, Pathen loupi le thahatna mu jong amudoh hih laiyuve.
en: Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm,
text:
DEU 11:2
Thadou: Chule nalungthim in haimil hih uvin, ajeh chu keiman nachateu henga thu hichengse Pakaiya kona dan leh thupeh khat jengcha jong ajah uvin kasei pon, amahon Pakai, Pathen loupi le thahatna mu jong amudoh hih laiyuve.
English: Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm,

tcz: Pakaiyin Egypt gam Pharaoh henga thil kidang tampi akilahsah in, hinlah amahon hichu amu hih laiyuve.
en: his signs, and his works, which he did in the middle of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and to all his land;

tcz: Pakaiyin Egypt galsat miho le asakol kangtalai hou chunga itobanga na-atoh ham ti amu pouvin, chule Egypt miten nahindal laitah uva Twipi San dunga Pakai natoh jong amunai pouvin ahi. Amaho chu Pakaiyin asumang hel tauve.
en: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how the LORD has destroyed them to this day;

tcz: Gamthip akon tuni chanin Pakaiyin, ichangeiya nakhohsah uham ti nachateu vin amu nai pouve.
en: and what he did to you in the wilderness until you came to this place;

tcz: Reuben chilhah, Eliab chapa teni Dathan leh Abiram chunga Pathen natoh jong nachaten amu pouvin ahi. Gamleiset Israel mite chenna aki hoh in, chuin amaho abonchauvin agam hel tauvin; aponbuh hou ahin chule anei leh agou ganchahou, jaonan abonchan amang heltan ahi.
en: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben—how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, their tents, and every living thing that followed them, in the middle of all Israel;

tcz: Hinlah nanghon Pakai natoh ki dang abonchan namu soh kei tauvin ahi.
en: but your eyes have seen all of the LORD’s great work which he did.
text:
DEU 11:7
Thadou: Hinlah nanghon Pakai natoh ki dang abonchan namu soh kei tauvin ahi.
English: but your eyes have seen all of the LORD’s great work which he did.

tcz: Hijeh chun chingtheiyun, tunia thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh keidiu ahi. Chutileh na thahat diu nalhunna diu gamsung nalo thei diu ahi.
en: Therefore you shall keep the entire commandment which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land that you go over to possess;

tcz: Thupeh hi chengse najui uva ahileh Pakaiyin napu napateu khanga peh dinga akitepna gam napeh diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho chilhahten hiche khoiju leh bongnoi lonna gam khu aluodiu ahi.
en: and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.
text:
DEU 11:9
Thadou: Thupeh hi chengse najui uva ahileh Pakaiyin napu napateu khanga peh dinga akitepna gam napeh diu ahi, ajeh chu amaho chilhahten hiche khoiju leh bongnoi lonna gam khu aluodiu ahi.
English: and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.

tcz: Hiche gam naluodiu khu nahin dalhah’u Egypt gam tobang ahipon, hiche gam leiset achun hon sunga ipi muchi hijongleh aga aphapon ahi.
en: For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed and watered it with your foot, as a garden of herbs;

tcz: Amavang naluo diu gam hi go jong aneng in, gamphatah ahi.
en: but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,
text:
DEU 11:11
Thadou: Amavang naluo diu gam hi go jong aneng in, gamphatah ahi.
English: but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,

tcz: Hiche gam sung pumpi hi Pakaiyin nangho jouse dinga, aphatcha avet kol jing ahi.
en: a land which the LORD your God cares for. The LORD your God’s eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.
text:
DEU 11:12
Thadou: Hiche gam sung pumpi hi Pakaiyin nangho jouse dinga, aphatcha avet kol jing ahi.
English: a land which the LORD your God cares for. The LORD your God’s eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.

tcz: Tunia naheng uva ka thupeh chengse najui uva chule Pakai, Pathen kin jing nabol uva ahileh,
en: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to my commandments which I command you today, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,
text:
DEU 11:13
Thadou: Tunia naheng uva ka thupeh chengse najui uva chule Pakai, Pathen kin jing nabol uva ahileh,
English: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to my commandments which I command you today, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

tcz: Pakaiyin go-nangai chat tenguleh gamsunga go ahin juhsah ding, chule chang khoptup phat ahiteng jongleh go juh atansah ding ahi. Chuteng nanghon louga, lengpithei leh Olive thao nakhop tup diu ahi.
en: that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.
text:
DEU 11:14
Thadou: Pakaiyin go-nangai chat tenguleh gamsunga go ahin juhsah ding, chule chang khoptup phat ahiteng jongleh go juh atansah ding ahi. Chuteng nanghon louga, lengpithei leh Olive thao nakhop tup diu ahi.
English: that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.

tcz: Nagan chate diuva anpha tah tah napeh diu chule nanghon nadu chan’u naneh thei diu ahi.
en: I will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be full.
text:
DEU 11:15
Thadou: Nagan chate diuva anpha tah tah napeh diu chule nanghon nadu chan’u naneh thei diu ahi.
English: I will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be full.

tcz: Hinlah chingtheiyun. Na lungthim'u phat mosah hih uvin, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen akona Pathen dang nabel lo diu ahi.
en: Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;

tcz: Achuti louva ahileh Pakai lunghanna chun na halvam jeng diu, Pakaiyin vankot akha ding gotwi aum lou teng nanghon ahina banga chang na khop tup thei lou diu ahi. Chuteng hiche gampha muna chu hetman louva na thigam jeng diu ahi.
en: and the LORD’s anger be kindled against you, and he shut up the sky so that there is no rain, and the land doesn’t yield its fruit; and you perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD gives you.
text:
DEU 11:17
Thadou: Achuti louva ahileh Pakai lunghanna chun na halvam jeng diu, Pakaiyin vankot akha ding gotwi aum lou teng nanghon ahina banga chang na khop tup thei lou diu ahi. Chuteng hiche gampha muna chu hetman louva na thigam jeng diu ahi.
English: and the LORD’s anger be kindled against you, and he shut up the sky so that there is no rain, and the land doesn’t yield its fruit; and you perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD gives you.

tcz: Hijeh chun ka thupeh chengse hi nalungthim cheh uva koiyun. Na khut uva kibu’uvin chule naluchang uva kop un chutileh imatih chana na haimil lou diu ahi.
en: Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul. You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
text:
DEU 11:18
Thadou: Hijeh chun ka thupeh chengse hi nalungthim cheh uva koiyun. Na khut uva kibu’uvin chule naluchang uva kop un chutileh imatih chana na haimil lou diu ahi.
English: Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul. You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

tcz: Na chateu henga na seipeh soh kei diu ahi. Insunga naumpet’u hihen, lam najot pet, imut kon chule nathodoh kon teng ujongleh naseipeh diu ahi.
en: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.
text:
DEU 11:19
Thadou: Na chateu henga na seipeh soh kei diu ahi. Insunga naumpet’u hihen, lam najot pet, imut kon chule nathodoh kon teng ujongleh naseipeh diu ahi.
English: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.

tcz: Thupeh chengse chu kot phung leh kelkot jousea najih diu ahi.
en: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates;

tcz: Chutileh vanthamjol um laisea, Pakaiyin napehnau gamsunga nangho leh na chateu chule na chilhahteu changeiya lung monga na chen diu ahi.
en: that your days and your children’s days may be multiplied in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.
text:
DEU 11:21
Thadou: Chutileh vanthamjol um laisea, Pakaiyin napehnau gamsunga nangho leh na chateu chule na chilhahteu changeiya lung monga na chen diu ahi.
English: that your days and your children’s days may be multiplied in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

tcz: Ka thupeh jouse hi chingthei tah a najui diu ahi. Pakai, Pathen lama nache jing diu, chule hichu natuh chah jing diu,
en: For if you shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you—to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cling to him—
text:
DEU 11:22
Thadou: Ka thupeh jouse hi chingthei tah a najui diu ahi. Pakai, Pathen lama nache jing diu, chule hichu natuh chah jing diu,
English: For if you shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you—to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cling to him—

tcz: Chuteng Pakaiyin namasang uva nam dang jouse ajamsah ding ahi. Amaho athao hat jo jongleh, Pakaiyin agamu nangho khut a apeh doh ding ahi.
en: then the LORD will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.
text:
DEU 11:23
Thadou: Chuteng Pakaiyin namasang uva nam dang jouse ajamsah ding ahi. Amaho athao hat jo jongleh, Pakaiyin agamu nangho khut a apeh doh ding ahi.
English: then the LORD will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.

tcz: Anneh nakiholna jouseu chu nangho gam hi ding ahi. Chule solam gamkaiya pat lhumlam chan, hichu Euphrate vadung changeiya nalo diu, hiche gamsunga chu koima chan nasuh loh thei lou diu ahi.
en: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall be your border.
text:
DEU 11:24
Thadou: Anneh nakiholna jouseu chu nangho gam hi ding ahi. Chule solam gamkaiya pat lhumlam chan, hichu Euphrate vadung changeiya nalo diu, hiche gamsunga chu koima chan nasuh loh thei lou diu ahi.
English: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall be your border.

tcz: Pakaiyin kitepna anei banga koimachan ima nalo theilou diu chule na chennau gam jousea lungmonga na chen diu ahi.
en: No man will be able to stand before you. The LORD your God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land that you tread on, as he has spoken to you.
text:
DEU 11:25
Thadou: Pakaiyin kitepna anei banga koimachan ima nalo theilou diu chule na chennau gam jousea lungmonga na chen diu ahi.
English: No man will be able to stand before you. The LORD your God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land that you tread on, as he has spoken to you.

tcz: Vetan, tunin keiman thilni kapeh diu, hichu nanghon khat joh sang nakilhen diu, hichu phat theina leh gao sapna ahi.
en: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:
text:
DEU 11:26
Thadou: Vetan, tunin keiman thilni kapeh diu, hichu nanghon khat joh sang nakilhen diu, hichu phat theina leh gao sapna ahi.
English: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh chengse hi na nitsoh keiyuva ahileh, nangho phatthei na chan diu ahi.
en: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you today;

tcz: Hinlah thupeh hichengse hi jui louva, nahsahmoa na koiyuva Pathen akona na kihei manguva, imatih chana nahet khah lou pathen dang kin naboluva ahileh gaosapna nachan teitei diu ahi.
en: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn away out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.
text:
DEU 11:28
Thadou: Hinlah thupeh hichengse hi jui louva, nahsahmoa na koiyuva Pathen akona na kihei manguva, imatih chana nahet khah lou pathen dang kin naboluva ahileh gaosapna nachan teitei diu ahi.
English: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn away out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.

tcz: Gamsung nalhun tenguleh Pakai, Pathen phattheina Gerizim molsanga naphon doh diu chule gaosapna vang chu Ebal molsang hiding ahi.
en: It shall happen, when the LORD your God brings you into the land that you go to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.
text:
DEU 11:29
Thadou: Gamsung nalhun tenguleh Pakai, Pathen phattheina Gerizim molsanga naphon doh diu chule gaosapna vang chu Ebal molsang hiding ahi.
English: It shall happen, when the LORD your God brings you into the land that you go to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.

tcz: Hiche molsang teni hi, lhumlam Jordan phaicham a Canaan mite chenna, Gilgal khopi toh kinai cha, Moreh apat ki gamlha talou ahi.
en: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?
text:
DEU 11:30
Thadou: Hiche molsang teni hi, lhumlam Jordan phaicham a Canaan mite chenna, Gilgal khopi toh kinai cha, Moreh apat ki gamlha talou ahi.
English: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?

tcz: Ajeh chu nanghon Jordan vadung galkaiya Pakai, Pathen in peh dinga atepsa gam lhung ding nahi tauve. Gamsung nalhun uva, nachen tenguleh,
en: For you are to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.
text:
DEU 11:31
Thadou: Ajeh chu nanghon Jordan vadung galkaiya Pakai, Pathen in peh dinga atepsa gam lhung ding nahi tauve. Gamsung nalhun uva, nachen tenguleh,
English: For you are to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.

tcz: tunia keiman kapeh dan jui ding jouse, aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
en: You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.
text:
DEU 11:32
Thadou: tunia keiman kapeh dan jui ding jouse, aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
English: You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.

tcz: Hichengse hi napu, napateu khanga Pakai, Pathen in dan leh thupeh jui dinga na peh’u ahi. Hoilai mun hijongleh nadam sunguva najui jing diu ahi.
en: These are the statutes and the ordinances which you shall observe to do in the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess all the days that you live on the earth.
text:
DEU 12:1
Thadou: Hichengse hi napu, napateu khanga Pakai, Pathen in dan leh thupeh jui dinga na peh’u ahi. Hoilai mun hijongleh nadam sunguva najui jing diu ahi.
English: These are the statutes and the ordinances which you shall observe to do in the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess all the days that you live on the earth.

tcz: Hiche gam khu nalhun uva, nam dangte abonchauva nano mang tenguleh, a pathen milim semthu jouseu molchunga hihen, gammang lah chule thingphung tinchenga hijongleh nasuh manghel diu ahi.
en: You shall surely destroy all the places in which the nations that you shall dispossess served their gods: on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
text:
DEU 12:2
Thadou: Hiche gam khu nalhun uva, nam dangte abonchauva nano mang tenguleh, a pathen milim semthu jouseu molchunga hihen, gammang lah chule thingphung tinchenga hijongleh nasuh manghel diu ahi.
English: You shall surely destroy all the places in which the nations that you shall dispossess served their gods: on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

tcz: Amaicham hou nasuh set diu chule maicham phung jouse jong nasuh chim diu ahi. Asherah ho jong meiya nahal vam diu chule apathen min jouseu aboncha nasuh manghel diu ahi.
en: You shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, and burn their Asherah poles with fire. You shall cut down the engraved images of their gods. You shall destroy their name out of that place.
text:
DEU 12:3
Thadou: Amaicham hou nasuh set diu chule maicham phung jouse jong nasuh chim diu ahi. Asherah ho jong meiya nahal vam diu chule apathen min jouseu aboncha nasuh manghel diu ahi.
English: You shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, and burn their Asherah poles with fire. You shall cut down the engraved images of their gods. You shall destroy their name out of that place.

tcz: Hiche Pagan miten pathen ahou banga nanghon nahou lou diu ahi.
en: You shall not do so to the LORD your God.
text:
DEU 12:4
Thadou: Hiche Pagan miten pathen ahou banga nanghon nahou lou diu ahi.
English: You shall not do so to the LORD your God.

tcz: Amavang nang hon Pakai, Pathen houna ding muna Israel insung aboncha kikhop khomna muna chu, gin leh jabol tah’a nahou diu ahi.
en: But to the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his habitation, and you shall come there.
text:
DEU 12:5
Thadou: Amavang nang hon Pakai, Pathen houna ding muna Israel insung aboncha kikhop khomna muna chu, gin leh jabol tah’a nahou diu ahi.
English: But to the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his habitation, and you shall come there.

tcz: Hiche muna chu pumgo thilto nahin choi diu, nathilto diu soma khat, kitepna suhbuh lhitna ding thilto chule na gancha penglha masa jouseu jong na todoh cheh cheh diu ahi.
en: You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your free will offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock there.
text:
DEU 12:6
Thadou: Hiche muna chu pumgo thilto nahin choi diu, nathilto diu soma khat, kitepna suhbuh lhitna ding thilto chule na gancha penglha masa jouseu jong na todoh cheh cheh diu ahi.
English: You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your free will offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock there.

tcz: Hiche muna chu nang leh na insung miten Pakai ansunga an neh khom nanei diu, Pakai phatthei naho nachan diu ahi, ajeh chu nangman Pakai thupeh nanit jal ahi.
en: There you shall eat before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households, in which the LORD your God has blessed you.
text:
DEU 12:7
Thadou: Hiche muna chu nang leh na insung miten Pakai ansunga an neh khom nanei diu, Pakai phatthei naho nachan diu ahi, ajeh chu nangman Pakai thupeh nanit jal ahi.
English: There you shall eat before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households, in which the LORD your God has blessed you.

tcz: Pakai kin nabol danu jong kikhel ding ahi. Tunin nabon chauvin natao uve.
en: You shall not do all the things that we do here today, every man whatever is right in his own eyes;

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin atumbeh a napeh naugam nangho jouse dinga choldona gam chu na lhun nailou’u ahi.
en: for you haven’t yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which the LORD your God gives you.
text:
DEU 12:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin atumbeh a napeh naugam nangho jouse dinga choldona gam chu na lhun nailou’u ahi.
English: for you haven’t yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which the LORD your God gives you.

tcz: Hinlah nanghon chomlou kah’a Jordan vadung nagal kai diu chule gamsung nalhun diu ahi. Pakaiyin nagal mite hou jouse akona choldamna napeh tenguleh,
en: But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land which the LORD your God causes you to inherit, and he gives you rest from all your enemies around you, so that you dwell in safety,
text:
DEU 12:10
Thadou: Hinlah nanghon chomlou kah’a Jordan vadung nagal kai diu chule gamsung nalhun diu ahi. Pakaiyin nagal mite hou jouse akona choldamna napeh tenguleh,
English: But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land which the LORD your God causes you to inherit, and he gives you rest from all your enemies around you, so that you dwell in safety,

tcz: na bonchauva keiman ka thupeh chengse nahin choi diu pumgo thilto, na thilto diu ho, kitepna suh bulhit nading thilto hichengse hi, Pakai amintheng loupina ding muna chu nahin choisoh kei diu ahi.
en: then it shall happen that to the place which the LORD your God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow to the LORD.
text:
DEU 12:11
Thadou: na bonchauva keiman ka thupeh chengse nahin choi diu pumgo thilto, na thilto diu ho, kitepna suh bulhit nading thilto hichengse hi, Pakai amintheng loupina ding muna chu nahin choisoh kei diu ahi.
English: then it shall happen that to the place which the LORD your God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow to the LORD.

tcz: Hiche muna chu nachanuteu ahin, nachapateu chule nasohte jouseu jaona Pakai henga thangvahna nanei khom diu ahi. Chule khopi sunga nachen khompiu Levi mite nagel doh jing diu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon gam chanvou anei lou’u ahi.
en: You shall rejoice before the LORD your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
text:
DEU 12:12
Thadou: Hiche muna chu nachanuteu ahin, nachapateu chule nasohte jouseu jaona Pakai henga thangvahna nanei khom diu ahi. Chule khopi sunga nachen khompiu Levi mite nagel doh jing diu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon gam chanvou anei lou’u ahi.
English: You shall rejoice before the LORD your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

tcz: Nangho chingtheiyun, ajeh chu mun jousea pumgo thilto na katdoh thei lou diu ahi.
en: Be careful that you don’t offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see;

tcz: Na insung miteu chenna mun, hichu Pakaiyin adeilhenna muna vang chu natodoh thei diu ahi. Hiche muna chu pumgo thilto natodoh diu chule ka thupeh aboncha nabol kimsoh kei diu ahi.
