en: but in the place which the LORD chooses in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.
text:
DEU 12:14
Thadou: Na insung miteu chenna mun, hichu Pakaiyin adeilhenna muna vang chu natodoh thei diu ahi. Hiche muna chu pumgo thilto natodoh diu chule ka thupeh aboncha nabol kimsoh kei diu ahi.
English: but in the place which the LORD chooses in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.

tcz: Nagan chate vang chu na kitha a khopi tinchanga naneh jeng theiyu ahi. Pakai, Pathen in phatthei aboh ganchaho chu nadei chan naneh jeng theiyu ahi. Sakhisa leh Sapeng jong naneh bang bang uva hi nanop chan’u naneh thei diu ahi.
en: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to the LORD your God’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.
text:
DEU 12:15
Thadou: Nagan chate vang chu na kitha a khopi tinchanga naneh jeng theiyu ahi. Pakai, Pathen in phatthei aboh ganchaho chu nadei chan naneh jeng theiyu ahi. Sakhisa leh Sapeng jong naneh bang bang uva hi nanop chan’u naneh thei diu ahi.
English: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to the LORD your God’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.

tcz: Gan thisanho vang chu meiya nago lou diu, chule gan thisan jouse chu tollham a twi kisung banga nasun lhah diu ahi.
en: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.
text:
DEU 12:16
Thadou: Gan thisanho vang chu meiya nago lou diu, chule gan thisan jouse chu tollham a twi kisung banga nasun lhah diu ahi.
English: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

tcz: Hinlah nanghon na thilto hou chu na khopi sung uva naneh thei lou diu, hichu soma khat ahin, gathah, Olive thao, nagancha asoh masaho ahin chule kitepna thilto, chule mimal kipehna thilto ho hijongleh khopi dunga naneh thang lou diu ahi.
en: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, or of your new wine, or of your oil, or the firstborn of your herd or of your flock, nor any of your vows which you vow, nor your free will offerings, nor the wave offering of your hand;

tcz: Hichengse chu Pakaiyin adeilhen na muna chu naneh diu ahi. Na chateu ahin, nasohteu ahin chule khopi sunga Levi mite jaona hichu Pakai, Pathen ansunga golvah nabol khom diu ahi.
en: but you shall eat them before the LORD your God in the place which the LORD your God shall choose: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates. You shall rejoice before the LORD your God in all that you put your hand to.
text:
DEU 12:18
Thadou: Hichengse chu Pakaiyin adeilhen na muna chu naneh diu ahi. Na chateu ahin, nasohteu ahin chule khopi sunga Levi mite jaona hichu Pakai, Pathen ansunga golvah nabol khom diu ahi.
English: but you shall eat them before the LORD your God in the place which the LORD your God shall choose: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates. You shall rejoice before the LORD your God in all that you put your hand to.

tcz: Chule nadam sung uva Levi mite nageldoh jing diu ahi.
en: Be careful that you don’t forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.
text:
DEU 12:19
Thadou: Chule nadam sung uva Levi mite nageldoh jing diu ahi.
English: Be careful that you don’t forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.

tcz: Pakaiyin akitepna banga nagam-u ahin keh let ding, nang hon sa nadu chanu hoilai muna hijongleh naneh thei diu ahi.
en: When the LORD your God enlarges your border, as he has promised you, and you say, “I want to eat meat,” because your soul desires to eat meat, you may eat meat, after all the desire of your soul.
text:
DEU 12:20
Thadou: Pakaiyin akitepna banga nagam-u ahin keh let ding, nang hon sa nadu chanu hoilai muna hijongleh naneh thei diu ahi.
English: When the LORD your God enlarges your border, as he has promised you, and you say, “I want to eat meat,” because your soul desires to eat meat, you may eat meat, after all the desire of your soul.

tcz: Hichu Pakai deilhenna mun, Pakaiyin akinbol nadia adeilhen namun’a jong naneh thei diu nain muna pat kenglama saotah kijot ahi. Chutengleh gancha lah’a nakel hon, na kelngoi hon chule nabong hon lah’a nadei na kitha uva naneh jeng theiyu ahi.
en: If the place which the LORD your God shall choose to put his name is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock, which the LORD has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within your gates, after all the desire of your soul.
text:
DEU 12:21
Thadou: Hichu Pakai deilhenna mun, Pakaiyin akinbol nadia adeilhen namun’a jong naneh thei diu nain muna pat kenglama saotah kijot ahi. Chutengleh gancha lah’a nakel hon, na kelngoi hon chule nabong hon lah’a nadei na kitha uva naneh jeng theiyu ahi.
English: If the place which the LORD your God shall choose to put his name is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock, which the LORD has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within your gates, after all the desire of your soul.

tcz: Nalah uva koi hijongleh atheng hihen, aboh hileh hichu aneh jeng thei ding, Sapeng le Sakhisa banga naneh diu ahi.
en: Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.
text:
DEU 12:22
Thadou: Nalah uva koi hijongleh atheng hihen, aboh hileh hichu aneh jeng thei ding, Sapeng le Sakhisa banga naneh diu ahi.
English: Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.

tcz: Gan thisan vang chu meiya nago vam thei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu thisan hi hinkho tobang ahin, hinna thisan chule gancha meiya na gotha lou diu ahi.
en: Only be sure that you don’t eat the blood; for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.
text:
DEU 12:23
Thadou: Gan thisan vang chu meiya nago vam thei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu thisan hi hinkho tobang ahin, hinna thisan chule gancha meiya na gotha lou diu ahi.
English: Only be sure that you don’t eat the blood; for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.

tcz: Hiche khel chun ganthisan chu, twi banga tol lhama nasun lhah diu ahi.
en: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.
text:
DEU 12:24
Thadou: Hiche khel chun ganthisan chu, twi banga tol lhama nasun lhah diu ahi.
English: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

tcz: Gan thisan chu meiya nago vam louhel diu ahi. Chutileh nangho leh nachateu nabon chau chunga, ijakai phacham kimsoh kei ding ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon Pakai lunglam nabol jeh’u ahi.
en: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do that which is right in the LORD’s eyes.
text:
DEU 12:25
Thadou: Gan thisan chu meiya nago vam louhel diu ahi. Chutileh nangho leh nachateu nabon chau chunga, ijakai phacham kimsoh kei ding ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon Pakai lunglam nabol jeh’u ahi.
English: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do that which is right in the LORD’s eyes.

tcz: Atumbeh a nathilpeh diu leh kitepna thilto chu choiyun lang, Pakaiyin adei lhenna muna chu naga koi diu ahi.
en: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which the LORD shall choose.
text:
DEU 12:26
Thadou: Atumbeh a nathilpeh diu leh kitepna thilto chu choiyun lang, Pakaiyin adei lhenna muna chu naga koi diu ahi.
English: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which the LORD shall choose.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen maicham phunga chu pumgo thilto gan thisan naga todoh teitei diu ahi. Gan thisan jouse chu Pakai maicham kimvela nathe khum soh kei diu, asa vang naneh thei diu ahi.
en: You shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on the LORD your God’s altar. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the LORD your God’s altar, and you shall eat the meat.
text:
DEU 12:27
Thadou: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen maicham phunga chu pumgo thilto gan thisan naga todoh teitei diu ahi. Gan thisan jouse chu Pakai maicham kimvela nathe khum soh kei diu, asa vang naneh thei diu ahi.
English: You shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on the LORD your God’s altar. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the LORD your God’s altar, and you shall eat the meat.

tcz: Chingtheiyun ka thupeh aboncha najui kim soh kei diu ahi. Chutileh nangho leh nachateu chunga ijakai phacham kimsoh ding ahi, ajeh chu Pakai lunglama nachon jalu ahi.
en: Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do that which is good and right in the LORD your God’s eyes.
text:
DEU 12:28
Thadou: Chingtheiyun ka thupeh aboncha najui kim soh kei diu ahi. Chutileh nangho leh nachateu chunga ijakai phacham kimsoh ding ahi, ajeh chu Pakai lunglama nachon jalu ahi.
English: Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do that which is good and right in the LORD your God’s eyes.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen na-masang lamuva che jing ding, chuteng nam dangte jam gam diu agamsunga kona asuh manghel diu ahi.
en: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations from before you where you go in to dispossess them, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,
text:
DEU 12:29
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen na-masang lamuva che jing ding, chuteng nam dangte jam gam diu agamsunga kona asuh manghel diu ahi.
English: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations from before you where you go in to dispossess them, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,

tcz: Hiche muna chu achon chan’u jui ding nagot louhel diu chule apathen hou kin jong nabol lou heldiu ahi. A pathen hou chungchang hetnomna jong nei louva, hiche nam mite hin pathen iti ahou uham tiajong nadoh lou diu ahi.
en: be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire after their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”
text:
DEU 12:30
Thadou: Hiche muna chu achon chan’u jui ding nagot louhel diu chule apathen hou kin jong nabol lou heldiu ahi. A pathen hou chungchang hetnomna jong nei louva, hiche nam mite hin pathen iti ahou uham tiajong nadoh lou diu ahi.
English: be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire after their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”

tcz: Nanghon nam dangten apathen’u ahou bang uva Pakai, Pathen nahou louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Pakai lama dinga doumah jeng abol uvin, achapateu leh achanute hou jeng jong apathen diuva akat doh jiu ahi.
en: You shall not do so to the LORD your God; for every abomination to the LORD, which he hates, they have done to their gods; for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.
text:
DEU 12:31
Thadou: Nanghon nam dangten apathen’u ahou bang uva Pakai, Pathen nahou louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Pakai lama dinga doumah jeng abol uvin, achapateu leh achanute hou jeng jong apathen diuva akat doh jiu ahi.
English: You shall not do so to the LORD your God; for every abomination to the LORD, which he hates, they have done to their gods; for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.

tcz: Chule nalah uva gaothusei ho khonunga hung lhung ding aseiyun, amahon thil kidang melchihna ho aki lahsah uve.
en: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,
text:
DEU 13:1
Thadou: Chule nalah uva gaothusei ho khonunga hung lhung ding aseiyun, amahon thil kidang melchihna ho aki lahsah uve.
English: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,

tcz: Hiche bang chun gaothua asei doh jouseu agui lhung in ahi. Amaho chun hiti hin hinseiyu henlang, ‘Hung un, pathen dang hou tauhite, ajeh chu hiche pathen ho hi imatih chana nahet khah louvu ahi.
en: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, “Let’s go after other gods” (which you have not known) “and let’s serve them,”
text:
DEU 13:2
Thadou: Hiche bang chun gaothua asei doh jouseu agui lhung in ahi. Amaho chun hiti hin hinseiyu henlang, ‘Hung un, pathen dang hou tauhite, ajeh chu hiche pathen ho hi imatih chana nahet khah louvu ahi.
English: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, “Let’s go after other gods” (which you have not known) “and let’s serve them,”

tcz: Hitia chu ahinsei diu amavang, na nahsah louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu nPakai, na Pathen'u thua nanun jing diu chule nalungthim pumpiuva Pakai lam jeng nakat diu, chuteng Pakaiyin nangho nangailut jing diu ahi.
en: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for the LORD your God is testing you, to know whether you love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
text:
DEU 13:3
Thadou: Hitia chu ahinsei diu amavang, na nahsah louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu nPakai, na Pathen'u thua nanun jing diu chule nalungthim pumpiuva Pakai lam jeng nakat diu, chuteng Pakaiyin nangho nangailut jing diu ahi.
English: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for the LORD your God is testing you, to know whether you love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen'u kin jeng nabol diu ahi. Pakai thupeh nanit jing diu, Pakai thusei a bou nanun diu chule Ama lam jeng nakat diu ahi.
en: You shall walk after the LORD your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.
text:
DEU 13:4
Thadou: Pakai, na Pathen'u kin jeng nabol diu ahi. Pakai thupeh nanit jing diu, Pakai thusei a bou nanun diu chule Ama lam jeng nakat diu ahi.
English: You shall walk after the LORD your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.

tcz: Alam louva gaothusei doh’a khonung ding thilmu ho abonchauva thina chang diu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon nahuhhing pau Pakai, na Pathen'u Egypt gam'a kona nahin puidoh pau doumah jeng abol tauvin ahi. Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh a konin puimang ding nagouvin, hijeh achu thina nachansah teitei diu ahi. Hitia chu nalah uva kona phatlou naho natol mang diu ahi.
en: That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which the LORD your God commanded you to walk in. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
text:
DEU 13:5
Thadou: Alam louva gaothusei doh’a khonung ding thilmu ho abonchauva thina chang diu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon nahuhhing pau Pakai, na Pathen'u Egypt gam'a kona nahin puidoh pau doumah jeng abol tauvin ahi. Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh a konin puimang ding nagouvin, hijeh achu thina nachansah teitei diu ahi. Hitia chu nalah uva kona phatlou naho natol mang diu ahi.
English: That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which the LORD your God commanded you to walk in. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

tcz: Mikhat touvin guhthima nahin lhep diu nasopipa, nachanu ham nachapa, nangailuttah najinu, ahilouleh naloi ngaipen najah uva hitia hi asei diu, ‘pathen dang hou din cheu hite ati diu, hinlah hiche pathen hohi napu, na pateu jeng in jong ana het khah lou ahi.
en: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods”—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;

tcz: Nahin lhep patep diu, napu, napateu khanga pat le leiset a nahet khah lou pathen hou tauvin, atidiu ahi.
en: of the gods of the peoples who are around you, near to you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth—
text:
DEU 13:7
Thadou: Nahin lhep patep diu, napu, napateu khanga pat le leiset a nahet khah lou pathen hou tauvin, atidiu ahi.
English: of the gods of the peoples who are around you, near to you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth—

tcz: Hinlah athu uva nanun louhel diu ahi. Chule hepina jong nanei lou diu, ven jong naven bit thei lou hel diu ahi.
en: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him; neither shall your eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him;

tcz: Amaho chu thina nachansah teitei diu ahi! Amasa tah in kho lhangsam leu chun mipin nahin kithopi diu ahi.
en: but you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people.
text:
DEU 13:9
Thadou: Amaho chu thina nachansah teitei diu ahi! Amasa tah in kho lhangsam leu chun mipin nahin kithopi diu ahi.
English: but you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people.

tcz: Phat louna keng mihem chu thina nachansah diu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Pakai, na Pathen a konin puimang ding nagouve. Egypt gam'a soh a naum laiyuva Pakaiyin nahuhdoh'u ahi.
en: You shall stone him to death with stones, because he has sought to draw you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
text:
DEU 13:10
Thadou: Phat louna keng mihem chu thina nachansah diu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Pakai, na Pathen a konin puimang ding nagouve. Egypt gam'a soh a naum laiyuva Pakaiyin nahuhdoh'u ahi.
English: You shall stone him to death with stones, because he has sought to draw you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

tcz: Chuteng Israel pumpin ajahsoh kei diu kichatna anei diu, adih louva chonkit talou ding ahiuve.
en: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.
text:
DEU 13:11
Thadou: Chuteng Israel pumpin ajahsoh kei diu kichatna anei diu, adih louva chonkit talou ding ahiuve.
English: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen uvin napehnau khopi sunga nachen tenguleh, nanghon hitia thu kisei najah diu,
en: If you hear about one of your cities, which the LORD your God gives you to dwell there, that
text:
DEU 13:12
Thadou: Pakai, na Pathen uvin napehnau khopi sunga nachen tenguleh, nanghon hitia thu kisei najah diu,
English: If you hear about one of your cities, which the LORD your God gives you to dwell there, that

tcz: nalah uva gaothusei hon nasopi hou henga hiti hin aseiyun alam kaiyuve, pathen dang houvin cheu hite atiuvin, hinlah hiche pathen ho khu imatih chana nahet khah louvu ahi.’
en: certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods,” which you have not known,
text:
DEU 13:13
Thadou: nalah uva gaothusei hon nasopi hou henga hiti hin aseiyun alam kaiyuve, pathen dang houvin cheu hite atiuvin, hinlah hiche pathen ho khu imatih chana nahet khah louvu ahi.’
English: certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods,” which you have not known,

tcz: Hitobang dimun hoa kona nakikhol cheh diu ahi. Nalah uva hitobang thil aum mong taiti aki cheh tengleh,
en: then you shall inquire, investigate, and ask diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination was done among you,
text:
DEU 13:14
Thadou: Hitobang dimun hoa kona nakikhol cheh diu ahi. Nalah uva hitobang thil aum mong taiti aki cheh tengleh,
English: then you shall inquire, investigate, and ask diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination was done among you,

tcz: hiche khopi sung leh achilhahte jouseu le agancha jouseu jaona nasuh manghel diu ahi.
en: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is therein and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.
text:
DEU 13:15
Thadou: hiche khopi sung leh achilhahte jouseu le agancha jouseu jaona nasuh manghel diu ahi.
English: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is therein and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.

tcz: Mun kihong laiya chu aboncha nahalvam heldiu chule khopi chu Pakai, Pathen dinga pumgo thiltoa pang ding ahi. Hiche khopi chu kiledoh kit talou ding chule sajong kisadoh kit lou ding ahitai.
en: You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its street, and shall burn with fire the city, with all of its plunder, to the LORD your God. It shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.
text:
DEU 13:16
Thadou: Mun kihong laiya chu aboncha nahalvam heldiu chule khopi chu Pakai, Pathen dinga pumgo thiltoa pang ding ahi. Hiche khopi chu kiledoh kit talou ding chule sajong kisadoh kit lou ding ahitai.
English: You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its street, and shall burn with fire the city, with all of its plunder, to the LORD your God. It shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.

tcz: Khopi sahdoh nathei thil khat cha jong naum den sahlou diu ahi. Chuteng Pakai milungsetna chu nachan diu chule hepina dimset a napu, napateu khanga akitepna banga nam lentah naso diu ahi.
en: Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger and show you mercy, and have compassion on you and multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers,
text:
DEU 13:17
Thadou: Khopi sahdoh nathei thil khat cha jong naum den sahlou diu ahi. Chuteng Pakai milungsetna chu nachan diu chule hepina dimset a napu, napateu khanga akitepna banga nam lentah naso diu ahi.
English: Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger and show you mercy, and have compassion on you and multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers,

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh aboncha najui kimsoh keiyuva ahileh, Pathen mihepina chu nachan jing diu ahi.
en: when you listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep all his commandments which I command you today, to do that which is right in the LORD your God’s eyes.
text:
DEU 13:18
Thadou: Pakai, na Pathen'u thupeh aboncha najui kimsoh keiyuva ahileh, Pathen mihepina chu nachan jing diu ahi.
English: when you listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep all his commandments which I command you today, to do that which is right in the LORD your God’s eyes.

tcz: Nangho Pakai, na Pathen a mong nahinau photchetna ding in, nachalsam kalval uva navotol louhel diu ahi. Hichu athiho lunghempina ahi.
en: You are the children of the LORD your God. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.
text:
DEU 14:1
Thadou: Nangho Pakai, na Pathen a mong nahinau photchetna ding in, nachalsam kalval uva navotol louhel diu ahi. Hichu athiho lunghempina ahi.
English: You are the children of the LORD your God. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen diuva nangho atheng nahi tauve, leiset chunga nam jouse lah a goulu pena nalhen doh’u ahitai.
en: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.
text:
DEU 14:2
Thadou: Pakai, na Pathen diuva nangho atheng nahi tauve, leiset chunga nam jouse lah a goulu pena nalhen doh’u ahitai.
English: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

tcz: Chule gancha boh kiti phot naneh thei lou diu ahi.
en: You shall not eat any abominable thing.
text:
DEU 14:3
Thadou: Chule gancha boh kiti phot naneh thei lou diu ahi.
English: You shall not eat any abominable thing.

tcz: Hichengse vang hi naneh thei diu ahi: bongchal, kelngoi, kelcha,
en: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,
text:
DEU 14:4
Thadou: Hichengse vang hi naneh thei diu ahi: bongchal, kelngoi, kelcha,
English: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

tcz: sajuh, pelkai, sakhi, gam kel, chule molchunga kelngoi jaona neneh thei diu ahi.
en: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.
text:
DEU 14:5
Thadou: sajuh, pelkai, sakhi, gam kel, chule molchunga kelngoi jaona neneh thei diu ahi.
English: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.

tcz: Hinlah a-an lhai umlou sa vang chu naneh lou diu ahi. Hichu sangong sang, talep, bui amaho cheng hin an-lhai aneiyun ahinlah a-ihdoh pouvin ahi. Hijeh achu hiche gancha hohi nangho dinga atheng lou ahi.
en: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of those who have the hoof split: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.
text:
DEU 14:7
Thadou: Hinlah a-an lhai umlou sa vang chu naneh lou diu ahi. Hichu sangong sang, talep, bui amaho cheng hin an-lhai aneiyun ahinlah a-ihdoh pouvin ahi. Hijeh achu hiche gancha hohi nangho dinga atheng lou ahi.
English: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of those who have the hoof split: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.

tcz: Chule vohcha jong naneh lou diu ahi. Anlhai aneiyin hinlah a-ihdoh poi, hijeh achu nangho dia atheng lou ahiye. Hiche gancha hose hi neh jong naneh thei lou diu chule tohjong natoh khah lou diu ahi.
en: The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses.
text:
DEU 14:8
Thadou: Chule vohcha jong naneh lou diu ahi. Anlhai aneiyin hinlah a-ihdoh poi, hijeh achu nangho dia atheng lou ahiye. Hiche gancha hose hi neh jong naneh thei lou diu chule tohjong natoh khah lou diu ahi.
English: The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses.

tcz: Twikhanglen'a cheng ganhing lah a, aling nei naneh thei diu ahi.
en: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.
text:
DEU 14:9
Thadou: Twikhanglen'a cheng ganhing lah a, aling nei naneh thei diu ahi.
English: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.

tcz: Hijeh chun twikhanglen'a um alingnei naneh diu, hinlah aling nei lou kitiphot vang naneh lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu hichengse hi nangho dia atheng lou ahi.
en: You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.
text:
DEU 14:10
Thadou: Hijeh chun twikhanglen'a um alingnei naneh diu, hinlah aling nei lou kitiphot vang naneh lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu hichengse hi nangho dia atheng lou ahi.
English: You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.

tcz: Chule nanghon chungleng vacha namkim naneh thei diu ahi.
en: Of all clean birds you may eat.
text:
DEU 14:11
Thadou: Chule nanghon chungleng vacha namkim naneh thei diu ahi.
English: Of all clean birds you may eat.

tcz: Hinlah vacha hichengse hi naneh thei lou diu ahi: muthang chule mubong naneh lou diu,
en: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,
text:
DEU 14:12
Thadou: Hinlah vacha hichengse hi naneh thei lou diu ahi: muthang chule mubong naneh lou diu,
English: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,

tcz: chule Muvom, muthi, sumbupi,
en: the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind,
text:
DEU 14:13
Thadou: chule Muvom, muthi, sumbupi,
English: the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind,

tcz: va-ah leh ama tobang va dang jouse,
en: every raven of any kind,
text:
DEU 14:14
Thadou: va-ah leh ama tobang va dang jouse,
English: every raven of any kind,

tcz: muthi, muthi-muhchom, chule adang phabep jaona,
en: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk of any kind,
text:
DEU 14:15
Thadou: muthi, muthi-muhchom, chule adang phabep jaona,
English: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk of any kind,

tcz: sumbupi nou, sumbupi len, sumbu changlit,
en: the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,
text:
DEU 14:16
Thadou: sumbupi nou, sumbupi len, sumbu changlit,
English: the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,

tcz: muthibong, sumbu changlit, sumbupi, Egypt mite muthi,
en: the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,
text:
DEU 14:17
Thadou: muthibong, sumbu changlit, sumbupi, Egypt mite muthi,
English: the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,

tcz: bah chule adang phabep jaona naneh lou diu ahi.
en: the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.
text:
DEU 14:18
Thadou: bah chule adang phabep jaona naneh lou diu ahi.
English: the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.

tcz: Tollham a ganhing vahle jouse hi naneh lou diu ahi, ajeh chu atheng lou ahi.
en: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.
text:
DEU 14:19
Thadou: Tollham a ganhing vahle jouse hi naneh lou diu ahi, ajeh chu atheng lou ahi.
English: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

tcz: Hinlah vacha lhanei atheng kitiphot chu naneh diu ahi.
en: Of all clean birds you may eat.
text:
DEU 14:20
Thadou: Hinlah vacha lhanei atheng kitiphot chu naneh diu ahi.
English: Of all clean birds you may eat.

tcz: Ganthikam kiti naneh louhel diu ahi. Nakhopi sunguva kholjin miho naneh sah thei diu ahilouleh na hetkhah lou mikoma najoh thei diu ahi. Amavang nanghon naneh thei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen diuva atheng nahiuve. Chule nanghon kelchanou chu kelchapi noituiya nahon lou diu ahi.
en: You shall not eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you who is within your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to the LORD your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
text:
DEU 14:21
Thadou: Ganthikam kiti naneh louhel diu ahi. Nakhopi sunguva kholjin miho naneh sah thei diu ahilouleh na hetkhah lou mikoma najoh thei diu ahi. Amavang nanghon naneh thei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen diuva atheng nahiuve. Chule nanghon kelchanou chu kelchapi noituiya nahon lou diu ahi.
English: You shall not eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you who is within your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to the LORD your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

tcz: Gasoh lah a somakhat ding nakoi doh diu gasoh jouse lah a, somakhat kumseh le na katdoh diu ahi.
en: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.
text:
DEU 14:22
Thadou: Gasoh lah a somakhat ding nakoi doh diu gasoh jouse lah a, somakhat kumseh le na katdoh diu ahi.
English: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.

tcz: Hiche somakhat chu Pathen houna muna nahin choi diu Pakai, Pathen in amin dopsang nadinga alhenna muna chu nahin choi diu, hichu Pakai angsunga naneh diu ahi.
en: You shall eat before the LORD your God, in the place which he chooses to cause his name to dwell, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock; that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.
text:
DEU 14:23
Thadou: Hiche somakhat chu Pathen houna muna nahin choi diu Pakai, Pathen in amin dopsang nadinga alhenna muna chu nahin choi diu, hichu Pakai angsunga naneh diu ahi.
English: You shall eat before the LORD your God, in the place which he chooses to cause his name to dwell, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock; that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen uvin phatthei nahin boh tenguleh mun gam lha tah hijongleh lousohga tamtah nalo diu, chuteng hoilai muna kon hijongleh somakhat nahin choi diu ahi.
en: If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it because the place which the LORD your God shall choose to set his name there is too far from you, when the LORD your God blesses you,
text:
DEU 14:24
Thadou: Pakai, na Pathen uvin phatthei nahin boh tenguleh mun gam lha tah hijongleh lousohga tamtah nalo diu, chuteng hoilai muna kon hijongleh somakhat nahin choi diu ahi.
English: If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it because the place which the LORD your God shall choose to set his name there is too far from you, when the LORD your God blesses you,

tcz: Amun chu agamlhat behseh a ahileh, hiche gasoh chu najoh diu najohna manu vang chu Pakai, na Pathen'u houna muna chu nalhut diu ahi.
en: then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose.
text:
DEU 14:25
Thadou: Amun chu agamlhat behseh a ahileh, hiche gasoh chu najoh diu najohna manu vang chu Pakai, na Pathen'u houna muna chu nalhut diu ahi.
English: then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose.

tcz: Nahung lhun tenguleh, nanghon nadeichan nasumuva nakichoh diu bongchal, kelngoi, kelcha, lengpitwi chule adang donthei nachoh jeng theiyu ahi. Chuteng nangho leh nainsung mi teuvin Pakai ansunga an-najon khom diu ahi.
en: You shall trade the money for whatever your soul desires: for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul asks of you. You shall eat there before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.
text:
DEU 14:26
Thadou: Nahung lhun tenguleh, nanghon nadeichan nasumuva nakichoh diu bongchal, kelngoi, kelcha, lengpitwi chule adang donthei nachoh jeng theiyu ahi. Chuteng nangho leh nainsung mi teuvin Pakai ansunga an-najon khom diu ahi.
English: You shall trade the money for whatever your soul desires: for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul asks of you. You shall eat there before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.

tcz: Chule nalah uva Levi mite nahebol jing diu ahi. Ajeh chu amaho chenna ding nei louva um ahiuve.
en: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
text:
DEU 14:27
Thadou: Chule nalah uva Levi mite nahebol jing diu ahi. Ajeh chu amaho chenna ding nei louva um ahiuve.
English: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

tcz: Kumthum lhinsih leh somakhat achombeh a nahin choi diu, hichu khopi toh kinaichaa nakhol khom diu,
en: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.
text:
DEU 14:28
Thadou: Kumthum lhinsih leh somakhat achombeh a nahin choi diu, hichu khopi toh kinaichaa nakhol khom diu,
English: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.

tcz: hichu Levi mite napeh diu ahi. Ajeh chu amaho gam nei louva khosa ahiuvin, hichu amahon aneh uva lungkim sela umdiu ahit. Chutile Pakai, na Pathen uvin phatthei naboh diu ahi.
en: The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, as well as the foreigner living among you, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.
text:
DEU 14:29
Thadou: hichu Levi mite napeh diu ahi. Ajeh chu amaho gam nei louva khosa ahiuvin, hichu amahon aneh uva lungkim sela umdiu ahit. Chutile Pakai, na Pathen uvin phatthei naboh diu ahi.
English: The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, as well as the foreigner living among you, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.

tcz: Kum sagi alhinseh leh khat koma sumpa bat a nalah jouseu chu nale sah diu ahi.
en: At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.
text:
DEU 15:1
Thadou: Kum sagi alhinseh leh khat koma sumpa bat a nalah jouseu chu nale sah diu ahi.
English: At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.

tcz: Hichu nabol teitei diu ahi. Israel mite lah a hitobanga thil bat a kila jouse chu nakile sahto naphat-u ahi. Koiman asopi aheng akoma thil bat a alah thei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen dinga kilha ongna lhung ahi.
en: This is the way it shall be done: every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor. He shall not require payment from his neighbor and his brother, because the LORD’s release has been proclaimed.
text:
DEU 15:2
Thadou: Hichu nabol teitei diu ahi. Israel mite lah a hitobanga thil bat a kila jouse chu nakile sahto naphat-u ahi. Koiman asopi aheng akoma thil bat a alah thei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen dinga kilha ongna lhung ahi.
English: This is the way it shall be done: every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor. He shall not require payment from his neighbor and his brother, because the LORD’s release has been proclaimed.

tcz: Hiche bat kilesahto nahi Israel mite insunga ding bou ahin, kholjin miho jao lou ahi.
en: Of a foreigner you may require it; but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release.
text:
DEU 15:3
Thadou: Hiche bat kilesahto nahi Israel mite insunga ding bou ahin, kholjin miho jao lou ahi.
English: Of a foreigner you may require it; but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release.

tcz: Koima vaichatah a umlou ding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin na pehnau gamsunga phat theina hung lhung ding ahi.
en: However there will be no poor with you (for the LORD will surely bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess)
text:
DEU 15:4
Thadou: Koima vaichatah a umlou ding ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin na pehnau gamsunga phat theina hung lhung ding ahi.
English: However there will be no poor with you (for the LORD will surely bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess)

tcz: Tunia keiman kapeh thupeh aboncha nanit kimsoh keiyuva ahileh Pakai, Pathen in phattheina chamkim naboh diu ahi.
en: if only you diligently listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all this commandment which I command you today.
text:
DEU 15:5
Thadou: Tunia keiman kapeh thupeh aboncha nanit kimsoh keiyuva ahileh Pakai, Pathen in phattheina chamkim naboh diu ahi.
English: if only you diligently listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all this commandment which I command you today.

tcz: Chuteng Pakai, na Pathen uvin akitepna banga phatthei naboh teidiu ahi. Nam dangten naheng uva sumpa ahin lah diu chule nanghon vang bat a ima nalah lou diu ahitai. Namdangte chunga vaihoma napan diu, nangho chunga koiman thaneina a vai ahop lou ding ahi.
en: For the LORD your God will bless you, as he promised you. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow. You will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.
text:
DEU 15:6
Thadou: Chuteng Pakai, na Pathen uvin akitepna banga phatthei naboh teidiu ahi. Nam dangten naheng uva sumpa ahin lah diu chule nanghon vang bat a ima nalah lou diu ahitai. Namdangte chunga vaihoma napan diu, nangho chunga koiman thaneina a vai ahop lou ding ahi.
English: For the LORD your God will bless you, as he promised you. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow. You will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai, na Pathen uvin napehnau gam nalhun tenguleh, Israel insunga kona avaicha aum khah leh amachu nadal bol lou hel diu ahi.
en: If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother;

tcz: Hongphal tah a amaho chu achandiu gambeh napeh diu ahi.
en: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.
text:
DEU 15:8
Thadou: Hongphal tah a amaho chu achandiu gambeh napeh diu ahi.
English: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.

tcz: Bat a thilpeh ding hijongleh itlou hela napeh diu ahi. Ajeh chu khat leh khat bat a kona kilepeh naphat chu nakhut uva umjing ahi. Bat a peh ding nada uva mikhat nachung uva lhisona aneiya ahileh, phat louna chonset achu lhalut nahitauve.
en: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to the LORD against you, and it be sin to you.
text:
DEU 15:9
Thadou: Bat a thilpeh ding hijongleh itlou hela napeh diu ahi. Ajeh chu khat leh khat bat a kona kilepeh naphat chu nakhut uva umjing ahi. Bat a peh ding nada uva mikhat nachung uva lhisona aneiya ahileh, phat louna chonset achu lhalut nahitauve.
English: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to the LORD against you, and it be sin to you.

tcz: Vaichaten angaichat banga hongphal tah a napeh diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin natoh nalam lamuva phatthei naboh diu ahi.
en: You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing the LORD your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to.
text:
DEU 15:10
Thadou: Vaichaten angaichat banga hongphal tah a napeh diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin natoh nalam lamuva phatthei naboh diu ahi.
English: You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing the LORD your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to.

tcz: Na chennau gamusunga chu vaicha umjing ding ahi. Hiche thupeh hi najui jing diu ahi, ajeh chu Israel mite lah hihen midang lah hileh vaicha a hinkho mang umjing ding ahi.
en: For the poor will never cease out of the land. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, in your land.
text:
DEU 15:11
Thadou: Na chennau gamusunga chu vaicha umjing ding ahi. Hiche thupeh hi najui jing diu ahi, ajeh chu Israel mite lah hihen midang lah hileh vaicha a hinkho mang umjing ding ahi.
English: For the poor will never cease out of the land. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, in your land.

tcz: Hebrew mite lah akona numei hileh pasal hileh soh dinga kiphal aum leh kum gup sunga nangho najen diu, kumsagi ahung lhun tengleh nanghon hiche sohnu ham sohpa ham chu, chamlhatna napeh diu ahi.
en: If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.
text:
DEU 15:12
Thadou: Hebrew mite lah akona numei hileh pasal hileh soh dinga kiphal aum leh kum gup sunga nangho najen diu, kumsagi ahung lhun tengleh nanghon hiche sohnu ham sohpa ham chu, chamlhatna napeh diu ahi.
English: If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.

tcz: Soh pasal chu nasol doh tenguleh, khut goh keuva nasol lou diu ahi.
en: When you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty.
text:
DEU 15:13
Thadou: Soh pasal chu nasol doh tenguleh, khut goh keuva nasol lou diu ahi.
English: When you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty.

tcz: Alhahna dinga gancha honkhat napeh diu, najubel tun nauleh lhongdapna toh napeh tha diu ahi. Nanei nagou lah uva kijepna phabep jong napeh tha diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in ijakai napeh'u ahi.
en: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As the LORD your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.
text:
DEU 15:14
Thadou: Alhahna dinga gancha honkhat napeh diu, najubel tun nauleh lhongdapna toh napeh tha diu ahi. Nanei nagou lah uva kijepna phabep jong napeh tha diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in ijakai napeh'u ahi.
English: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As the LORD your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.

tcz: Hiche hi nageldoh jing diu ahi. Nangho Egypt gam'a soh in nana um un Pakai, Pathen in na lhatdoh’u ahi! Hijeh a chu keiman hiche thupeh hi nangho kapeh nahiuve.
en: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.
text:
DEU 15:15
Thadou: Hiche hi nageldoh jing diu ahi. Nangho Egypt gam'a soh in nana um un Pakai, Pathen in na lhatdoh’u ahi! Hijeh a chu keiman hiche thupeh hi nangho kapeh nahiuve.
English: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.

tcz: Hinlah soh chun ‘Keiman ka dalhah lou ding nahi’ tia aseiya ahileh, ajeh chu aman nangma leh na insung mite angailut jal ahi.
en: It shall be, if he tells you, “I will not go out from you,” because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you,
text:
DEU 15:16
Thadou: Hinlah soh chun ‘Keiman ka dalhah lou ding nahi’ tia aseiya ahileh, ajeh chu aman nangma leh na insung mite angailut jal ahi.
English: It shall be, if he tells you, “I will not go out from you,” because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you,

tcz: Hitobang dinmuna kona hi nanghon jong nakotbul uva kona nasoh uchu, nahin lepui diu chuteng hinkho lhumkeiya nahenguva um thei ding ahi.
en: then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.
text:
DEU 15:17
Thadou: Hitobang dinmuna kona hi nanghon jong nakotbul uva kona nasoh uchu, nahin lepui diu chuteng hinkho lhumkeiya nahenguva um thei ding ahi.
English: then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.

tcz: Nasoh uchu nasoldoh tenguleh hahsatna a nagel lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu kum gup sunga ajo chana nahin jenu ahitan, Pakai na Pathen uvin phatthei naboh diu ahi.
en: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. The LORD your God will bless you in all that you do.
text:
DEU 15:18
Thadou: Nasoh uchu nasoldoh tenguleh hahsatna a nagel lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu kum gup sunga ajo chana nahin jenu ahitan, Pakai na Pathen uvin phatthei naboh diu ahi.
English: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. The LORD your God will bless you in all that you do.

tcz: Na ganchate lah uva kona apeng masa jouse Pakai, Pathen henga nahin choi diu ahi. Na ganchateu lah a apeng masa kitiphot chu louna natohsah lou diu chule gancha hon lah a nalhatsah lou diu ahi.
en: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to the LORD your God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.
text:
DEU 15:19
Thadou: Na ganchate lah uva kona apeng masa jouse Pakai, Pathen henga nahin choi diu ahi. Na ganchateu lah a apeng masa kitiphot chu louna natohsah lou diu chule gancha hon lah a nalhatsah lou diu ahi.
English: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to the LORD your God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.

tcz: Ajeh chu gancha peng masa jouse hi Pakai, Pathen henga nahin choidiu nangho leh nainsung mi teuvin Pakaiyin alhena muna chu kumseh leh naneh khom diu ahi.
en: You shall eat it before the LORD your God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, you and your household.
text:
DEU 15:20
Thadou: Ajeh chu gancha peng masa jouse hi Pakai, Pathen henga nahin choidiu nangho leh nainsung mi teuvin Pakaiyin alhena muna chu kumseh leh naneh khom diu ahi.
English: You shall eat it before the LORD your God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, you and your household.

tcz: Hinlah hiche gancha pengmasa chu a elbai ham ahilouleh mitcho ahikhah leh nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u henga na katdoh lou diu ahi.
en: If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.
text:
DEU 15:21
Thadou: Hinlah hiche gancha pengmasa chu a elbai ham ahilouleh mitcho ahikhah leh nanghon Pakai, na Pathen'u henga na katdoh lou diu ahi.
English: If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.

tcz: Hichu nangho leh nainsung mi teuvin nain mun uva naneh jeng theiyu ahi. Hichu koi hileh aboh hihen aboh lou hijongleh sa juhsa naneh bang uva naneh thei diu ahi.
en: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.
text:
DEU 15:22
Thadou: Hichu nangho leh nainsung mi teuvin nain mun uva naneh jeng theiyu ahi. Hichu koi hileh aboh hihen aboh lou hijongleh sa juhsa naneh bang uva naneh thei diu ahi.
English: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.

tcz: Chule sa thisan chu meiya na halvam thei lou diu ahi. Hichu tol lham chunga nasun lhah diu ahi.
en: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.
text:
DEU 15:23
Thadou: Chule sa thisan chu meiya na halvam thei lou diu ahi. Hichu tol lham chunga nasun lhah diu ahi.
English: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.

tcz: Pakai, na Pathen uva dinga kumseh le kut nabol diu ahi. Hichu Abib* lhamasa hiding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche lhasunga hi Pakaiyin Egypt gam'a kona jan muthim noiya nahin puidoh-u ahi.
en: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to the LORD your God; for in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night.
text:
DEU 16:1
Thadou: Pakai, na Pathen uva dinga kumseh le kut nabol diu ahi. Hichu Abib* lhamasa hiding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche lhasunga hi Pakaiyin Egypt gam'a kona jan muthim noiya nahin puidoh-u ahi.
English: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to the LORD your God; for in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

tcz: Hiche kut ading chun nagan chateu lah a kon katdoh ding chengse chu Pakai, Pathen in adeilhenna houmun a chu nahin choi diu, hiche mun chu Pathen loupina ding ahi.
en: You shall sacrifice the Passover to the LORD your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.
text:
DEU 16:2
Thadou: Hiche kut ading chun nagan chateu lah a kon katdoh ding chengse chu Pakai, Pathen in adeilhenna houmun a chu nahin choi diu, hiche mun chu Pathen loupina ding ahi.
English: You shall sacrifice the Passover to the LORD your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

tcz: Hichu cholsolou changlhah toh aneh tha diu ahi. Nisagi sunga cholsolou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi, ajeh chu Egypt gam'a kona kinotah a nahungnau avetsah ahi. Hiche changlhah hi neuvin suhgim vetsahna changlhah ahin, chutileh nadam lai sung seuva Egypt gam'a kona nahung potdoh nau na geldoh jing diu ahi.
en: You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
text:
DEU 16:3
Thadou: Hichu cholsolou changlhah toh aneh tha diu ahi. Nisagi sunga cholsolou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi, ajeh chu Egypt gam'a kona kinotah a nahungnau avetsah ahi. Hiche changlhah hi neuvin suhgim vetsahna changlhah ahin, chutileh nadam lai sung seuva Egypt gam'a kona nahung potdoh nau na geldoh jing diu ahi.
English: You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

tcz: Hiche nisagi sunga hin koiman cholsosa a-in muna koihih hen. Kut adia kelngoi natha tenguleh, hiche sa chu koiman jingkah khovah geiyin koihih hen.
en: No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days; neither shall any of the meat, which you sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.
text:
DEU 16:4
Thadou: Hiche nisagi sunga hin koiman cholsosa a-in muna koihih hen. Kut adia kelngoi natha tenguleh, hiche sa chu koiman jingkah khovah geiyin koihih hen.
English: No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days; neither shall any of the meat, which you sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.

tcz: Hiche kut hi khopi tinchenga nabol thei lou diu ahi.
en: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you;

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in adeilhenna mun a bou chu nabol diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin amin choiatna dinga alhen ahi. Nisa alep lhah tengleh hichu Egypt gam'a nahung potdoh nau vetsahna nabol diu ahi.
en: but at the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came out of Egypt.
text:
DEU 16:6
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in adeilhenna mun a bou chu nabol diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakai, na Pathen uvin amin choiatna dinga alhen ahi. Nisa alep lhah tengleh hichu Egypt gam'a nahung potdoh nau vetsahna nabol diu ahi.
English: but at the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came out of Egypt.

tcz: Sachu nakisem diu Pakaiyin alhenna muna chu naneh diu ahi. Chule jingkah lam leh na ponbuh mun cheh uva nakile thei diu ahitai.
en: You shall roast and eat it in the place which the LORD your God chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents.
text:
DEU 16:7
Thadou: Sachu nakisem diu Pakaiyin alhenna muna chu naneh diu ahi. Chule jingkah lam leh na ponbuh mun cheh uva nakile thei diu ahitai.
English: You shall roast and eat it in the place which the LORD your God chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents.

tcz: Hinlah aban nigup sunga chu cholsolou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi. Anisagi lhin ni chu Pakai, Pathen adia nikho thenga nanit sohkei diu, koiman na atoh thei lou ding ahi.
en: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD your God. You shall do no work.
text:
DEU 16:8
Thadou: Hinlah aban nigup sunga chu cholsolou changlhah jeng naneh diu ahi. Anisagi lhin ni chu Pakai, Pathen adia nikho thenga nanit sohkei diu, koiman na atoh thei lou ding ahi.
English: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD your God. You shall do no work.

tcz: Lousohga nakhop tup nikho uva pat hapta sagi nasim diu ahi.
en: You shall count for yourselves seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.
text:
DEU 16:9
Thadou: Lousohga nakhop tup nikho uva pat hapta sagi nasim diu ahi.
English: You shall count for yourselves seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.

tcz: Chujou tengleh Pakai, na Pathen uva dinga kal chuh kut golvah nabol diu ahi. Pakaiya kona phatthei nachanna hou ijakai nahin choisoh kei diu ahi.
en: You shall keep the feast of weeks to the LORD your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how the LORD your God blesses you.
text:
DEU 16:10
Thadou: Chujou tengleh Pakai, na Pathen uva dinga kal chuh kut golvah nabol diu ahi. Pakaiya kona phatthei nachanna hou ijakai nahin choisoh kei diu ahi.
English: You shall keep the feast of weeks to the LORD your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how the LORD your God blesses you.

tcz: Chuteng Pakai, na Pathen uvin houmun adei lhenna muna chu na hinchoi diu golvah nabol diu, hiche muna chu Pathen min choiat a um ding ahi. Na khopi sung uva nachanuteu leh na chapateu chule Levi mite ahin, chagate, kholjin miho chule meithai ho jaona a golvah nabol khom diu ahi.
en: You shall rejoice before the LORD your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.
text:
DEU 16:11
Thadou: Chuteng Pakai, na Pathen uvin houmun adei lhenna muna chu na hinchoi diu golvah nabol diu, hiche muna chu Pathen min choiat a um ding ahi. Na khopi sung uva nachanuteu leh na chapateu chule Levi mite ahin, chagate, kholjin miho chule meithai ho jaona a golvah nabol khom diu ahi.
English: You shall rejoice before the LORD your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gam'a soh-changa hinkho mang na hiuve ti nageldoh jing diu, thupeh hi chengse hi najui diu ahi.
en: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.
text:
DEU 16:12
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gam'a soh-changa hinkho mang na hiuve ti nageldoh jing diu, thupeh hi chengse hi najui diu ahi.
English: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.

tcz: Lhosohga, lengpiga ijakai nakhop tup tenguleh nisagi sunga lholhun kut naman teidiu ahi.
en: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.
text:
DEU 16:13
Thadou: Lhosohga, lengpiga ijakai nakhop tup tenguleh nisagi sunga lholhun kut naman teidiu ahi.
English: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.

tcz: Hiche golvah loupi hi nachanuteu leh nachapateu, nasoh tehou, Levi mite, chaga ho, kholjin mi chule meithai ho jaona nabol diu ahi.
en: You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.
text:
DEU 16:14
Thadou: Hiche golvah loupi hi nachanuteu leh nachapateu, nasoh tehou, Levi mite, chaga ho, kholjin mi chule meithai ho jaona nabol diu ahi.
English: You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.

tcz: Hiche golvah hi nisagi sunga Pakaiyin alhenna muna chu nabol diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiya kona phatthei nachannau gasoh chu ahin, hiche kut hi mijouse adia kipana hi ding ahi.
en: You shall keep a feast to the LORD your God seven days in the place which the LORD chooses, because the LORD your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.
text:
DEU 16:15
Thadou: Hiche golvah hi nisagi sunga Pakaiyin alhenna muna chu nabol diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiya kona phatthei nachannau gasoh chu ahin, hiche kut hi mijouse adia kipana hi ding ahi.
English: You shall keep a feast to the LORD your God seven days in the place which the LORD chooses, because the LORD your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.

tcz: Kumseh leh Israel miten hiche kut thum hohi aman jing diu ahi: Mon mang theilou chang lhah kut, lholhun kut chule khoptup kut ahi. Hiche ahung lhun tengleh pasal a kailha kitiphot Pakai, Pathen angsunga kilah ding, koimachan khut goh keuva Pakai angsung anai lut thei lou ding ahi.
en: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before the LORD your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths. They shall not appear before the LORD empty.
text:
DEU 16:16
Thadou: Kumseh leh Israel miten hiche kut thum hohi aman jing diu ahi: Mon mang theilou chang lhah kut, lholhun kut chule khoptup kut ahi. Hiche ahung lhun tengleh pasal a kailha kitiphot Pakai, Pathen angsunga kilah ding, koimachan khut goh keuva Pakai angsung anai lut thei lou ding ahi.
English: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before the LORD your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths. They shall not appear before the LORD empty.

tcz: Mijousen ajokham khama phattheina chu Pakai henga ahin lhut cheh diu ahi.
en: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the LORD your God’s blessing which he has given you.
text:
DEU 16:17
Thadou: Mijousen ajokham khama phattheina chu Pakai henga ahin lhut cheh diu ahi.
English: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the LORD your God’s blessing which he has given you.

tcz: Pakaiyin napeh nau khopi jousea thutan vaihoma pang ding nakoisoh kei diu ahi. Amaho chun miho chunga chamdela thu atan diu ahi.
en: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which the LORD your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
text:
DEU 16:18
Thadou: Pakaiyin napeh nau khopi jousea thutan vaihoma pang ding nakoisoh kei diu ahi. Amaho chun miho chunga chamdela thu atan diu ahi.
English: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which the LORD your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

tcz: Koima chunga langnei sihneiya thil ima nabol lou diu ahi. Aching athem hihen, khomu louva hijongleh Pakai mit mua chamdela thu natan diu ahi.
en: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.
text:
DEU 16:19
Thadou: Koima chunga langnei sihneiya thil ima nabol lou diu ahi. Aching athem hihen, khomu louva hijongleh Pakai mit mua chamdela thu natan diu ahi.
English: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.

tcz: Adih a kivaihopna chu umjing hen, chutileh Pakai, na Pathen uvin napeh nau gamsunga lungmonga nachen diu ahi.
en: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which the LORD your God gives you.
text:
DEU 16:20
Thadou: Adih a kivaihopna chu umjing hen, chutileh Pakai, na Pathen uvin napeh nau gamsunga lungmonga nachen diu ahi.
English: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which the LORD your God gives you.

tcz: Asherah thing mangcha a pathen lim nasemthu louhel diu ahi.
en: You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside the LORD your God’s altar, which you shall make for yourselves.
text:
DEU 16:21
Thadou: Asherah thing mangcha a pathen lim nasemthu louhel diu ahi.
English: You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside the LORD your God’s altar, which you shall make for yourselves.

tcz: Chule aguh a hou dinga khom ima naphu thei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen adia hitobang chu thet umtah ahi.
en: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which the LORD your God hates.
text:
DEU 16:22
Thadou: Chule aguh a hou dinga khom ima naphu thei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen adia hitobang chu thet umtah ahi.
English: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which the LORD your God hates.

tcz: Ana damlou gancha kiti phot Pakai, Pathen henga nakatdoh thei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiya dia hitobang thilpeh hohi thet um ahi.
en: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil; for that is an abomination to the LORD your God.
text:
DEU 17:1
Thadou: Ana damlou gancha kiti phot Pakai, Pathen henga nakatdoh thei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiya dia hitobang thilpeh hohi thet um ahi.
English: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil; for that is an abomination to the LORD your God.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gam'a nachen tenguleh, nalah uva kona numei hileh pasal hileh Pakai, na Pathen'u mitmua aphalou nabol thei lou diu chule kitepna nasuhboh thei lou diu ahi.
en: If there is found among you, within any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you, a man or woman who does that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight in transgressing his covenant,
text:
DEU 17:2
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gam'a nachen tenguleh, nalah uva kona numei hileh pasal hileh Pakai, na Pathen'u mitmua aphalou nabol thei lou diu chule kitepna nasuhboh thei lou diu ahi.
English: If there is found among you, within any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you, a man or woman who does that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight in transgressing his covenant,

tcz: Semthu pathen dang angsung, nisa chule ahsiho vamthamjol kitiho jouse angsunga naboh khup theilou diu ahi.
en: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun, or the moon, or any of the stars of the sky, which I have not commanded,
text:
DEU 17:3
Thadou: Semthu pathen dang angsung, nisa chule ahsiho vamthamjol kitiho jouse angsunga naboh khup theilou diu ahi.
English: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun, or the moon, or any of the stars of the sky, which I have not commanded,

tcz: Hitobang hohi nakhol chilsoh kei diu ahi. Ajeh chu Israel mite lah a hitobang hi umkha get inte.
en: and you are told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,
text:
DEU 17:4
Thadou: Hitobang hohi nakhol chilsoh kei diu ahi. Ajeh chu Israel mite lah a hitobang hi umkha get inte.
English: and you are told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,

tcz: Numei hileh pasal hileh hitobanga chon chu, khopi pam lama nodoh ding songa se lih ding ahi.
en: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, even that same man or woman; and you shall stone them to death with stones.
text:
DEU 17:5
Thadou: Numei hileh pasal hileh hitobanga chon chu, khopi pam lama nodoh ding songa se lih ding ahi.
English: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, even that same man or woman; and you shall stone them to death with stones.

tcz: Hinlah mikhat jeng seh thutannan mithat hih un, mithum beh thutanna'a chu thina nachan sah thei diu ahi.
en: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
text:
DEU 17:6
Thadou: Hinlah mikhat jeng seh thutannan mithat hih un, mithum beh thutanna'a chu thina nachan sah thei diu ahi.
English: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

tcz: Thutanpa chun songa ase masat ding, chuteng mipin ase ding ahi. Hitia chu nalah uva kona aphalouva chon chu nano doh diu ahi.
en: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
text:
DEU 17:7
Thadou: Thutanpa chun songa ase masat ding, chuteng mipin ase ding ahi. Hitia chu nalah uva kona aphalouva chon chu nano doh diu ahi.
English: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

tcz: Nalah uva thilsoh chung thu tanna ahahsat behseh a, hichu phat louna, tol-that, mithat chule dan chung kalvala chon achung thua boina chom chom neiya auma ahileh, hitobang chu Pakai, na Pathen henga nalhut diu ahi.
en: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which the LORD your God chooses.
text:
DEU 17:8
Thadou: Nalah uva thilsoh chung thu tanna ahahsat behseh a, hichu phat louna, tol-that, mithat chule dan chung kalvala chon achung thua boina chom chom neiya auma ahileh, hitobang chu Pakai, na Pathen henga nalhut diu ahi.
English: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which the LORD your God chooses.

tcz: Chule hitobang ho chu danthempuho henga aphatcha napui diu ahi. Amahon achungchang thu angai diu chuteng thu lhuhna asem diu ahi.
en: You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days. You shall inquire, and they shall give you the verdict.
text:
DEU 17:9
Thadou: Chule hitobang ho chu danthempuho henga aphatcha napui diu ahi. Amahon achungchang thu angai diu chuteng thu lhuhna asem diu ahi.
English: You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days. You shall inquire, and they shall give you the verdict.

tcz: Amahon thu lhuhna asem uchu Pakai muntheng lama nahin lhut diu, amahon asei bang uva nabol diu ahi.
en: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which the LORD chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.
text:
DEU 17:10
Thadou: Amahon thu lhuhna asem uchu Pakai muntheng lama nahin lhut diu, amahon asei bang uva nabol diu ahi.
English: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which the LORD chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.

tcz: Dan dung juiya thulhuhna chu ahin phondoh tenguleh, thulhuhna jouse chu ahina banga chelha ding, imacha na hapbe thei tah lou diu ahi.
en: According to the decisions of the law which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn away from the sentence which they announce to you, to the right hand, nor to the left.
text:
DEU 17:11
Thadou: Dan dung juiya thulhuhna chu ahin phondoh tenguleh, thulhuhna jouse chu ahina banga chelha ding, imacha na hapbe thei tah lou diu ahi.
English: According to the decisions of the law which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn away from the sentence which they announce to you, to the right hand, nor to the left.

tcz: Koihileh Pakai, Pathen angsunga thutan vaihom ho natohna deilou vetsahna jal'a kisa auma ahileh, thina chang ding ahi. Hitia chu phat louna kiti phot Israel mite lah akona nano mang diu ahi.
en: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before the LORD your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.
text:
DEU 17:12
Thadou: Koihileh Pakai, Pathen angsunga thutan vaihom ho natohna deilou vetsahna jal'a kisa auma ahileh, thina chang ding ahi. Hitia chu phat louna kiti phot Israel mite lah akona nano mang diu ahi.
English: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before the LORD your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.

tcz: Hitobang chu mi jousen ahin jahsoh kei diu, chuteng koima aphalouva chon ngam talou ding ahi.
en: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
text:
DEU 17:13
Thadou: Hitobang chu mi jousen ahin jahsoh kei diu, chuteng koima aphalouva chon ngam talou ding ahi.
English: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gamsung nalhun diu ahitai. Hiche gamsung nalhun tenguleh, i-lamkai diuvin leng khat, nam dangte kivaipoh nabang in tungdoh tauhite tia nasei diu ahi.
en: When you have come to the land which the LORD your God gives you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, “I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,”
text:
DEU 17:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gamsung nalhun diu ahitai. Hiche gamsung nalhun tenguleh, i-lamkai diuvin leng khat, nam dangte kivaipoh nabang in tungdoh tauhite tia nasei diu ahi.
English: When you have come to the land which the LORD your God gives you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, “I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,”

tcz: Chutengleh Israel mite lah a Pakai, Pathen in atundoh ding ahi. Hichu nalah uva mikhat pen pang ding, amavang kholjin mi nalhen thei lou diu ahi.
en: you shall surely set him whom the LORD your God chooses as king over yourselves. You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.
text:
DEU 17:15
Thadou: Chutengleh Israel mite lah a Pakai, Pathen in atundoh ding ahi. Hichu nalah uva mikhat pen pang ding, amavang kholjin mi nalhen thei lou diu ahi.
English: you shall surely set him whom the LORD your God chooses as king over yourselves. You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.

tcz: Leng a pang pen ding pen chun, sakol kangtalai ngaichat jeh’a mikhat tou Egypt gam'a sakol kangtalai cho dinga asol thei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu nangho Egypt gam nakile kit thei lou diu ahitai.
en: Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses; because the LORD has said to you, “You shall not go back that way again.”
text:
DEU 17:16
Thadou: Leng a pang pen ding pen chun, sakol kangtalai ngaichat jeh’a mikhat tou Egypt gam'a sakol kangtalai cho dinga asol thei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu nangho Egypt gam nakile kit thei lou diu ahitai.
English: Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses; because the LORD has said to you, “You shall not go back that way again.”

tcz: Lengpa chun jitampi anei thei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Pakai akona apui mang thei diu ahi. Chule ama ding jeng ajong sana leh dangka akikhol thei lou ding ahi.
en: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.
text:
DEU 17:17
Thadou: Lengpa chun jitampi anei thei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Pakai akona apui mang thei diu ahi. Chule ama ding jeng ajong sana leh dangka akikhol thei lou ding ahi.
English: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

tcz: Leng touna mun alo tengleh, amapa chun danbu akilah ding, alal-touna muna chu akikoi ding ahi.
en: It shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book, out of that which is before the Levitical priests.
text:
DEU 17:18
Thadou: Leng touna mun alo tengleh, amapa chun danbu akilah ding, alal-touna muna chu akikoi ding ahi.
English: It shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book, out of that which is before the Levitical priests.

tcz: Hiche danbu lekhajol chu akoma akoi ding adamlai sunga asim jing ding ahi. Hichea kona chu dan leh thupeh ijakai Pakaiya kon in aume ti amu chet ding, dengchang tah’a ajui jing ding ahi.
en: It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them;

tcz: Hiche lekhajol asima kona chu kiletsahna puma, achenkhompi mi jouse sanga chungnung kahi tia umlou ding ahi. Chule hichea kona hi lamchoma kihei mang louva umjing ding kahi tijong ahet doh thei ding ahi. Keima leh ka chilhah ten Israel sung hi akhang akhanga ka vaihop diu ahi, tijong het dohna anei thei diu ahi.
en: that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand, or to the left, to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children, in the middle of Israel.
text:
DEU 17:20
Thadou: Hiche lekhajol asima kona chu kiletsahna puma, achenkhompi mi jouse sanga chungnung kahi tia umlou ding ahi. Chule hichea kona hi lamchoma kihei mang louva umjing ding kahi tijong ahet doh thei ding ahi. Keima leh ka chilhah ten Israel sung hi akhang akhanga ka vaihop diu ahi, tijong het dohna anei thei diu ahi.
English: that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand, or to the left, to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children, in the middle of Israel.

tcz: Thempu hon hiche hi nageldoh jing diu ahi, ajeh chu Israel insung mijouse lah a Levi insung kailhah hi chenna ding gam chang lou ahiuve. Hijeh achu Thempua pang Levi mite hon Pakai, Pathen adia ki katdoh chengse hi chang diu ahi.
en: The priests and the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire and his portion.
text:
DEU 18:1
Thadou: Thempu hon hiche hi nageldoh jing diu ahi, ajeh chu Israel insung mijouse lah a Levi insung kailhah hi chenna ding gam chang lou ahiuve. Hijeh achu Thempua pang Levi mite hon Pakai, Pathen adia ki katdoh chengse hi chang diu ahi.
