en: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in nangho nahuhdoh diu leh ngahmuna chu nangho huhdoh dinga umjing ahin, hiche naum nau ngahmun chu kisutheng jing ding ahi. Chutileh Pakai, Pathen in naum nau ngamuna chu thil thenglou ima amudoh lou ding, nang hoa kona kihei mang louva na umpi jing diu ahi.
en: for the LORD your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.
text:
DEU 23:14
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in nangho nahuhdoh diu leh ngahmuna chu nangho huhdoh dinga umjing ahin, hiche naum nau ngahmun chu kisutheng jing ding ahi. Chutileh Pakai, Pathen in naum nau ngamuna chu thil thenglou ima amudoh lou ding, nang hoa kona kihei mang louva na umpi jing diu ahi.
English: for the LORD your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.

tcz: Aneipa akona hung jamdoh soh chu, nanghon aneipa chu namoh peh jeng thei lou'u ahi.
en: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.
text:
DEU 23:15
Thadou: Aneipa akona hung jamdoh soh chu, nanghon aneipa chu namoh peh jeng thei lou'u ahi.
English: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.

tcz: Amatoh chun nachen khom jing diu, hoilai muna hijongleh na khopi sung'uva chu aman adeilhenna mun pena chu nachen sah jeng diu ahi. Chule hiche soh chu nanghon jong achunga gimna ima nalhun sah thei lou diu ahi.
en: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.
text:
DEU 23:16
Thadou: Amatoh chun nachen khom jing diu, hoilai muna hijongleh na khopi sung'uva chu aman adeilhenna mun pena chu nachen sah jeng diu ahi. Chule hiche soh chu nanghon jong achunga gimna ima nalhun sah thei lou diu ahi.
English: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.

tcz: Chule Israel insunga kona numei khat jeng cha jong noti a kichem chavei um thei lou ding ahi. Hitobanga chu Israel insung’a pasal hon jong milim semthu doia neiya notia kisa chavei um theilou ding ahi.
en: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.
text:
DEU 23:17
Thadou: Chule Israel insunga kona numei khat jeng cha jong noti a kichem chavei um thei lou ding ahi. Hitobanga chu Israel insung’a pasal hon jong milim semthu doia neiya notia kisa chavei um theilou ding ahi.
English: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

tcz: Ucha kithana man le notia kona man chu Pakai, Pathen henga nahin choidiu nato doh thei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu hiche teni hi Pakaiya dinga thet umtah ahi.
en: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of the LORD your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to the LORD your God.
text:
DEU 23:18
Thadou: Ucha kithana man le notia kona man chu Pakai, Pathen henga nahin choidiu nato doh thei lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu hiche teni hi Pakaiya dinga thet umtah ahi.
English: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of the LORD your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to the LORD your God.

tcz: Na sopi khat chu sum thoiya nabat sah theilou diu, napeh'u jongleh hichu athoiya napeh thei lou diu, ipi hi jongleh aneh chan chu bat a ima um thei lou ding ahi.
en: You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.
text:
DEU 23:19
Thadou: Na sopi khat chu sum thoiya nabat sah theilou diu, napeh'u jongleh hichu athoiya napeh thei lou diu, ipi hi jongleh aneh chan chu bat a ima um thei lou ding ahi.
English: You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.

tcz: Amavang hitobang chu gamchom miho chunga nabol thei diu, ahinlah nasopi kiti pou chunga athoi kiti napeh thei lou diu ahi. Athoi nalah lou'uva ahileh tua nachen lutna diu muna khu Pakai, Pathen in phattheina lhingsela naboh diu ahi.
en: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that the LORD your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.
text:
DEU 23:20
Thadou: Amavang hitobang chu gamchom miho chunga nabol thei diu, ahinlah nasopi kiti pou chunga athoi kiti napeh thei lou diu ahi. Athoi nalah lou'uva ahileh tua nachen lutna diu muna khu Pakai, Pathen in phattheina lhingsela naboh diu ahi.
English: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that the LORD your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen adia thilkhat peh ding natiuva ahileh hichu napeh ding tenguleh lungkihna ima nanei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in nangho chunga ahin del khum jeng ding, napeh lou'uva ahileh hichu nangho dinga chonset a kisim ding ahi.
en: When you vow a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for the LORD your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.
text:
DEU 23:21
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen adia thilkhat peh ding natiuva ahileh hichu napeh ding tenguleh lungkihna ima nanei louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in nangho chunga ahin del khum jeng ding, napeh lou'uva ahileh hichu nangho dinga chonset a kisim ding ahi.
English: When you vow a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for the LORD your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.

tcz: Kitepna nanei lou'uva ahileh hichu chonset a ki sim lou ahi.
en: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.
text:
DEU 23:22
Thadou: Kitepna nanei lou'uva ahileh hichu chonset a ki sim lou ahi.
English: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.

tcz: Nakam a nasei dohsau khat chu nabol doh tei nadin ki hambol jing uvin, ajeh chu nangho jong Pakai, Pathen henga kitepna nei puma nakam'uva napot dohsah'u ahitai.
en: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to the LORD your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.
text:
DEU 23:23
Thadou: Nakam a nasei dohsau khat chu nabol doh tei nadin ki hambol jing uvin, ajeh chu nangho jong Pakai, Pathen henga kitepna nei puma nakam'uva napot dohsah'u ahitai.
English: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to the LORD your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.

tcz: Chule nangho lengpi leiya nachen lut tenguleh nadei chan'u naneh jeng theiyu ahi. Ahinlah neocha jeng jong nasakhao-dip sung'uva naki het lut louhel diu ahi.
en: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.
text:
DEU 23:24
Thadou: Chule nangho lengpi leiya nachen lut tenguleh nadei chan'u naneh jeng theiyu ahi. Ahinlah neocha jeng jong nasakhao-dip sung'uva naki het lut louhel diu ahi.
English: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.

tcz: Na heng nakom pau loulaiya nagache lut tenguleh achangvui chu na kisi theiyu ahi. Amavang, koite mangcha a naheng nakompa changvui chu na-at thei louhel diu ahi.
en: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.
text:
DEU 23:25
Thadou: Na heng nakom pau loulaiya nagache lut tenguleh achangvui chu na kisi theiyu ahi. Amavang, koite mangcha a naheng nakompa changvui chu na-at thei louhel diu ahi.
English: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.

tcz: Pasal in numei chu ji dinga akipui teng, hiche numeinu chu achung’a themmo na ana um khah tah a, ajipa chu alung lhaisah jou tah louva ahileh, ajipan jong kidana lekha phatah asut ding hichu akichoi sah a, a insunga kona asoldoh ding ahi.
en: When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing in her, that he shall write her a certificate of divorce, put it in her hand, and send her out of his house.
text:
DEU 24:1
Thadou: Pasal in numei chu ji dinga akipui teng, hiche numeinu chu achung’a themmo na ana um khah tah a, ajipa chu alung lhaisah jou tah louva ahileh, ajipan jong kidana lekha phatah asut ding hichu akichoi sah a, a insunga kona asoldoh ding ahi.
English: When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing in her, that he shall write her a certificate of divorce, put it in her hand, and send her out of his house.

tcz: Chuteng numeinu chu che a, pasal dang khat toh gaki cheng thei ahi.
en: When she has departed out of his house, she may go and be another man’s wife.
text:
DEU 24:2
Thadou: Chuteng numeinu chu che a, pasal dang khat toh gaki cheng thei ahi.
English: When she has departed out of his house, she may go and be another man’s wife.

tcz: Chule hiche ajipa jong chun numeinu chunga chu, lungkim louna aneikhah a ahileh, amasa ngaiya banga kidana lekha asut peh ding akichoi sah a a-insunga kona asoldoh jeng ding ahi. Ahinlah aji luipa chu ana thi khah tah leh,
en: If the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, who took her to be his wife;

tcz: Ama nu dinga ajimasa pa aluipa chun, ji dinga aki lepui thei tah lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu hitobang thil hohi Pakaiya dia thet umtah ahin, Pakai, Pathen in napeh nau gamsunga hitobang thilpha lou aboh hohi na umsah loudiu ahi.
en: her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled; for that would be an abomination to the LORD. You shall not cause the land to sin, which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance.
text:
DEU 24:4
Thadou: Ama nu dinga ajimasa pa aluipa chun, ji dinga aki lepui thei tah lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu hitobang thil hohi Pakaiya dia thet umtah ahin, Pakai, Pathen in napeh nau gamsunga hitobang thilpha lou aboh hohi na umsah loudiu ahi.
English: her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled; for that would be an abomination to the LORD. You shall not cause the land to sin, which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance.

tcz: Pasal khat chu ajinei thah ahileh, amapa chu galsat mia panda hen chule natoh dang jong bolsah lou ding ahi. Kum khat lhingset ain muna um ding, alungdei pennu chutoh noma umkhom ding ahi.
en: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.
text:
DEU 24:5
Thadou: Pasal khat chu ajinei thah ahileh, amapa chu galsat mia panda hen chule natoh dang jong bolsah lou ding ahi. Kum khat lhingset ain muna um ding, alungdei pennu chutoh noma umkhom ding ahi.
English: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.

tcz: Chule koiman chang sum man, sumhei song man hijong leh thil dang khat toh kisaiya bat a alah thei lou ding ahi. Hichu alah khah tah a ahileh, mihem hinkho thil bat mana alah ahitai.
en: No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.
text:
DEU 24:6
Thadou: Chule koiman chang sum man, sumhei song man hijong leh thil dang khat toh kisaiya bat a alah thei lou ding ahi. Hichu alah khah tah a ahileh, mihem hinkho thil bat mana alah ahitai.
English: No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.

tcz: Koi hileh asopi Israel mi khat tou aguh a aguh pattah akimat doh’a ahileh, hiche ami guhdoh chu soh banga abol tah a, aki joh mang jenga, hitobang gucha chu thina nachan sah diu, hiche ho chu nalah uva kona nasuh mang diu ahi.
en: If a man is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel, and he deals with him as a slave, or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
text:
DEU 24:7
Thadou: Koi hileh asopi Israel mi khat tou aguh a aguh pattah akimat doh’a ahileh, hiche ami guhdoh chu soh banga abol tah a, aki joh mang jenga, hitobang gucha chu thina nachan sah diu, hiche ho chu nalah uva kona nasuh mang diu ahi.
English: If a man is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel, and he deals with him as a slave, or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

tcz: Chule phah natna chung chang thudol ahin, Levi thempu hon nahilna bang uva nabol na diuvin limgeh chan um uvin, keima thupeh banga nanghon jong nabol doh theina diu ahi.
en: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you. As I commanded them, so you shall observe to do.
text:
DEU 24:8
Thadou: Chule phah natna chung chang thudol ahin, Levi thempu hon nahilna bang uva nabol na diuvin limgeh chan um uvin, keima thupeh banga nanghon jong nabol doh theina diu ahi.
English: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you. As I commanded them, so you shall observe to do.

tcz: Ajeh chu Egypt gamsunga kona nahung potdoh uva Pakai, Pathen in Miriam abolna chung thudol achun limgeh chan um un.
en: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.
text:
DEU 24:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu Egypt gamsunga kona nahung potdoh uva Pakai, Pathen in Miriam abolna chung thudol achun limgeh chan um un.
English: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.

tcz: Na sopi khat touvin thil khat bat a alah khah tah’a ahileh, nangho jong ama insunga chu namoh lut lou diu chule hiche hi akhela kaki lah ding ahi, tiajong thil ho chu nalhen thei lou diu ahi.
en: When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.
text:
DEU 24:10
Thadou: Na sopi khat touvin thil khat bat a alah khah tah’a ahileh, nangho jong ama insunga chu namoh lut lou diu chule hiche hi akhela kaki lah ding ahi, tiajong thil ho chu nalhen thei lou diu ahi.
English: When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.

tcz: Chule nangho in polama naum diu, nangho thil bat a lapa vang chu insunga lut a, nabat sahna diuva thil na lepeh diu pen chu ahin choidoh diu ahi.
en: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you.
text:
DEU 24:11
Thadou: Chule nangho in polama naum diu, nangho thil bat a lapa vang chu insunga lut a, nabat sahna diuva thil na lepeh diu pen chu ahin choidoh diu ahi.
English: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you.

tcz: Nangho thil bat a lapa chu mivaicha neilal ahi khah tahleh, nanghon achunga asea lethuhna nanei lou diu ahi.
en: If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.
text:
DEU 24:12
Thadou: Nangho thil bat a lapa chu mivaicha neilal ahi khah tahleh, nanghon achunga asea lethuhna nanei lou diu ahi.
English: If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.

tcz: Nisa lhum tengleh hiche athil bat man chu nale sah diu, chuteng aman aponsil achol pen chu lupna a aman ding, nanghon jong phatthei nachan tei diu ahi. Hichu Pakai, Pathen maiya thil dih tah ahi.
en: You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It shall be righteousness to you before the LORD your God.
text:
DEU 24:13
Thadou: Nisa lhum tengleh hiche athil bat man chu nale sah diu, chuteng aman aponsil achol pen chu lupna a aman ding, nanghon jong phatthei nachan tei diu ahi. Hichu Pakai, Pathen maiya thil dih tah ahi.
English: You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It shall be righteousness to you before the LORD your God.

tcz: Soh thalah khat chu nasuh gimlou hel diu, hitobanga vaichaa hinkho mang mihem chu, nagam sung'uva cheng nasopi mikhat tou hi nante.
en: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates.
text:
DEU 24:14
Thadou: Soh thalah khat chu nasuh gimlou hel diu, hitobanga vaichaa hinkho mang mihem chu, nagam sung'uva cheng nasopi mikhat tou hi nante.
English: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates.

tcz: Hitobang mihem chu naki thalah nikho mamau nilhum masang a, atohman chu napeh diu ahi. Ama chu mivaicha tah ahin, athaman chu anga jing ding, a chuti louva ahileh ama akona lhasetna hung lhung thei ding, aman jong nangho douna jal'a Pakai henga thu hinsei in tin, hichu nangho dinga chonset ahi.
en: In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it, for he is poor and sets his heart on it, lest he cry against you to the LORD, and it be sin to you.
text:
DEU 24:15
Thadou: Hitobang mihem chu naki thalah nikho mamau nilhum masang a, atohman chu napeh diu ahi. Ama chu mivaicha tah ahin, athaman chu anga jing ding, a chuti louva ahileh ama akona lhasetna hung lhung thei ding, aman jong nangho douna jal'a Pakai henga thu hinsei in tin, hichu nangho dinga chonset ahi.
English: In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it, for he is poor and sets his heart on it, lest he cry against you to the LORD, and it be sin to you.

tcz: Chule mipa ho chu achate jal'a thina ki chansah louhel diu, achate jal'a jong apate thina ki chansah lou ding ahi. Amavang koi hileh ama ama chonset jal'a bou chu thina kichan sah ding ahi.
en: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
text:
DEU 24:16
Thadou: Chule mipa ho chu achate jal'a thina ki chansah louhel diu, achate jal'a jong apate thina ki chansah lou ding ahi. Amavang koi hileh ama ama chonset jal'a bou chu thina kichan sah ding ahi.
English: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

tcz: Khopem mikhat leh chagapa chung thua adihna thutan chu nahei loudiu, meithai ho ponsil jong thilbat mana nalah peh thei lou diu ahi.
en: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow’s clothing in pledge;

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gamsunga soh changsa nahiuvin, Pakai, Pathen akona lhatdamsa ihiuve, ti nasuh mil lou diu, hiche pen tah jeh’a chu keiman bol in tia ka thupeh chu nabol jeng diu ahi.
en: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.
text:
DEU 24:18
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gamsunga soh changsa nahiuvin, Pakai, Pathen akona lhatdamsa ihiuve, ti nasuh mil lou diu, hiche pen tah jeh’a chu keiman bol in tia ka thupeh chu nabol jeng diu ahi.
English: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

tcz: Lou laiya chang at a nakon tenguleh, lou laiya changpal nada lhah thei lou diu, changpal le akhai athang ho jong nanung lo thei lou diu ahi. Hiche ho chu chaga hole nubei, pabei meithai ho ding ahi. Chuteng Pakai, Pathen in nabol natoh jouseuva kona phattheina dimset naboh diu ahi.
en: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
text:
DEU 24:19
Thadou: Lou laiya chang at a nakon tenguleh, lou laiya changpal nada lhah thei lou diu, changpal le akhai athang ho jong nanung lo thei lou diu ahi. Hiche ho chu chaga hole nubei, pabei meithai ho ding ahi. Chuteng Pakai, Pathen in nabol natoh jouseuva kona phattheina dimset naboh diu ahi.
English: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

tcz: Olive thing na phuh lhuh tenguleh, avel vel'a nivei chang naphuh lou diu, mivaicha, chaga, nulou, palou ho dinga nakhen tei diu ahi.
en: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
text:
DEU 24:20
Thadou: Olive thing na phuh lhuh tenguleh, avel vel'a nivei chang naphuh lou diu, mivaicha, chaga, nulou, palou ho dinga nakhen tei diu ahi.
English: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

tcz: Lengpi leiya lengpiga naki chop khom teng ujongleh, nada lhah nasa nung'uva akhai chengse chu na donlou diu ahi. Ajeh chu chaga, mivaicha, meithai nulou, palou ho ding ahiye.
en: When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
text:
DEU 24:21
Thadou: Lengpi leiya lengpiga naki chop khom teng ujongleh, nada lhah nasa nung'uva akhai chengse chu na donlou diu ahi. Ajeh chu chaga, mivaicha, meithai nulou, palou ho ding ahiye.
English: When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gam sunga ana soh changsa chu nahiuvin, hichu nagel doh jing diu chule hichengse hi nabol diuva ka thupeh nahi.
en: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.
text:
DEU 24:22
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangho jong Egypt gam sunga ana soh changsa chu nahiuvin, hichu nagel doh jing diu chule hichengse hi nabol diuva ka thupeh nahi.
English: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

tcz: Mihem khat le khat akinah a, akiheh lhona ahileh, thutan vaihom hon achungthu lhon atan peh diu, themmo nanei lou chu them achansah diu, themmo nanei chu themmo achansah diu ahi.
en: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.
text:
DEU 25:1
Thadou: Mihem khat le khat akinah a, akiheh lhona ahileh, thutan vaihom hon achungthu lhon atan peh diu, themmo nanei lou chu them achansah diu, themmo nanei chu themmo achansah diu ahi.
English: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.

tcz: Chule themmo changpa chu voh ding alhah khah tah a ahileh, thutan vaihompa chun themmo changpa chu alupsah ding, them changpa mitmua chu athemmona jat dung juiya avoh ding ahi.
en: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.
text:
DEU 25:2
Thadou: Chule themmo changpa chu voh ding alhah khah tah a ahileh, thutan vaihompa chun themmo changpa chu alupsah ding, them changpa mitmua chu athemmona jat dung juiya avoh ding ahi.
English: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.

tcz: Hitobang mihem chu molsom li chan thoh thei ding, hiche kal achu thoh thei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amapa chu miho masang in kijep jep jing tahen lang hileh, aki neosah behseh jeh achu muset a naum thei diu ahi.
en: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.
text:
DEU 25:3
Thadou: Hitobang mihem chu molsom li chan thoh thei ding, hiche kal achu thoh thei lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu amapa chu miho masang in kijep jep jing tahen lang hileh, aki neosah behseh jeh achu muset a naum thei diu ahi.
English: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.

tcz: Chule insunga pasal ni chengkhom teni chu khat joh sang chu chapa beiya thina ato khah tah a ahileh, athipa jinu chu pasal dang ang sunga chea jinei thei lou ding ahi. Amavang numei nu jipa sopipa vang chu hiche nu angsunga chu, che ding amanu chu ajia aki puiding ahi. Asopi ji khat kive kol bang banga avet kol ding ahi.
en: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.
text:
DEU 25:5
Thadou: Chule insunga pasal ni chengkhom teni chu khat joh sang chu chapa beiya thina ato khah tah a ahileh, athipa jinu chu pasal dang ang sunga chea jinei thei lou ding ahi. Amavang numei nu jipa sopipa vang chu hiche nu angsunga chu, che ding amanu chu ajia aki puiding ahi. Asopi ji khat kive kol bang banga avet kol ding ahi.
English: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.

tcz: Hichea chapa ahin masat pen chu, a sopipa athi tasa chu khanggui jop mat nadinga, Israel insunga ama minchu suhmanga um lou ding ahi.
en: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.
text:
DEU 25:6
Thadou: Hichea chapa ahin masat pen chu, a sopipa athi tasa chu khanggui jop mat nadinga, Israel insunga ama minchu suhmanga um lou ding ahi.
English: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.

tcz: Ahinlah adam nalaiya sopipa chun athipa jinu chu deilouva, ji dinga akipui nom tah louva ahileh, asopipa jinu jong che ding kelkot phung lama thutan vaihom ho henga hitia hi agasei ding ahi. Ka jipa sopipan athisa asopipa hi Israel insunga amin ajop nom tapon ahi.
en: If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”
text:
DEU 25:7
Thadou: Ahinlah adam nalaiya sopipa chun athipa jinu chu deilouva, ji dinga akipui nom tah louva ahileh, asopipa jinu jong che ding kelkot phung lama thutan vaihom ho henga hitia hi agasei ding ahi. Ka jipa sopipan athisa asopipa hi Israel insunga amin ajop nom tapon ahi.
English: If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”

tcz: Chuteng hiche khopi sunga upa chengse chu, cheuva amapa koma chu agasei diu ahi. Amavang hichan nunga jong ‘Keiman hichenu hi kaji dinga ka kipui lou ding ahi’ tia asei nah laiya,
en: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him. If he stands and says, “I don’t want to take her,”
text:
DEU 25:8
Thadou: Chuteng hiche khopi sunga upa chengse chu, cheuva amapa koma chu agasei diu ahi. Amavang hichan nunga jong ‘Keiman hichenu hi kaji dinga ka kipui lou ding ahi’ tia asei nah laiya,
English: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him. If he stands and says, “I don’t want to take her,”

tcz: Chule asopi athipa ji nun jong anailut ding, amapa chu akengchot asut peh ding, amai chang chil aset den ding, hitia hi ahenga asei peh ding, ‘Pasal koi hi jongleh asopipa khela insung khat sem doh nomlou chu hitia hi kibol ding ahi,’ tia asei ding ahi.
en: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”
text:
DEU 25:9
Thadou: Chule asopi athipa ji nun jong anailut ding, amapa chu akengchot asut peh ding, amai chang chil aset den ding, hitia hi ahenga asei peh ding, ‘Pasal koi hi jongleh asopipa khela insung khat sem doh nomlou chu hitia hi kibol ding ahi,’ tia asei ding ahi.
English: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”

tcz: Amavang chu amin Israel insung ahi tia kisei ding, chule akengchot kisut lhah peh pa insung tiajong kihe ding ahi.
en: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”
text:
DEU 25:10
Thadou: Amavang chu amin Israel insung ahi tia kisei ding, chule akengchot kisut lhah peh pa insung tiajong kihe ding ahi.
English: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”

tcz: Pasal khat leh khat chu akinah a, pasal dang khatpa jinu ham chun khatpa akona chu ajipa chu huhdoh ding agot a ahileh, hiche nu chun anai lut a khatpa chu ahinpia amat a ahe peh jenga ahileh,
en: When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts,
text:
DEU 25:11
Thadou: Pasal khat leh khat chu akinah a, pasal dang khatpa jinu ham chun khatpa akona chu ajipa chu huhdoh ding agot a ahileh, hiche nu chun anai lut a khatpa chu ahinpia amat a ahe peh jenga ahileh,
English: When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts,

tcz: Hiche numei chu akhut natan peh diu, lung sa-ihna beihel a naum diu ahi.
en: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.
text:
DEU 25:12
Thadou: Hiche numei chu akhut natan peh diu, lung sa-ihna beihel a naum diu ahi.
English: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.

tcz: Chule nasakhao sung jeng'uva jong thil tena ni napoh kop lou diu, khat alen khat aneo tia napoh kop lou diu ahi.
en: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.
text:
DEU 25:13
Thadou: Chule nasakhao sung jeng'uva jong thil tena ni napoh kop lou diu, khat alen khat aneo tia napoh kop lou diu ahi.
English: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.

tcz: Nangho insung jenga jong thil tena alenkhat ahin, aneokhat hiteni chu nakoi tha lou diu ahi.
en: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.
text:
DEU 25:14
Thadou: Nangho insung jenga jong thil tena alenkhat ahin, aneokhat hiteni chu nakoi tha lou diu ahi.
English: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.

tcz: Thil agih tena achoma nakoi diu, aboncha bukimsel ding, hitia chu najui kim soh keiyuva ahileh, Pakai, Pathen in nangho nachennau gamsung jousea phat theina lhingset naboh diu ahi.
en: You shall have a perfect and just weight. You shall have a perfect and just measure, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
text:
DEU 25:15
Thadou: Thil agih tena achoma nakoi diu, aboncha bukimsel ding, hitia chu najui kim soh keiyuva ahileh, Pakai, Pathen in nangho nachennau gamsung jousea phat theina lhingset naboh diu ahi.
English: You shall have a perfect and just weight. You shall have a perfect and just measure, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

tcz: Ajeh chu hitia thil adih louva bola natohna jouse chu Pakai, Pathen dinga thet umtah ahi.
en: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to the LORD your God.
text:
DEU 25:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu hitia thil adih louva bola natohna jouse chu Pakai, Pathen dinga thet umtah ahi.
English: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to the LORD your God.

tcz: Nangho Egypt gam sunga kona nahung pot laiyuva, Amalek miten ichan geiya nabol gimu hitam, nalam lhah nauva nabol na jouseu chu nagel doh jing diu ahi.
en: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,
text:
DEU 25:17
Thadou: Nangho Egypt gam sunga kona nahung pot laiyuva, Amalek miten ichan geiya nabol gimu hitam, nalam lhah nauva nabol na jouseu chu nagel doh jing diu ahi.
English: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,

tcz: Amahon nalam lhah laitah un nadel khum jeng uvin, na chol laitah uva ichangeiya gim genthei a nalhau hitam? Pathen ging louhel in nachung uva na atong tauvin ahi.
en: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.
text:
DEU 25:18
Thadou: Amahon nalam lhah laitah un nadel khum jeng uvin, na chol laitah uva ichangeiya gim genthei a nalhau hitam? Pathen ging louhel in nachung uva na atong tauvin ahi.
English: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in nangho choldamna nape tauvin, nakim vel'uva namel mateu jousea kona nacholdo sah diu, Pakai, Pathen in napehnau nagoulo nadiu muna nachen lut tenguleh, nanghon jong vannoi leiset a Amelek mite chenna jouse chu nasuh mang hel diu ahi, tichu nagel doh jing diu ahi.
en: Therefore it shall be, when the LORD your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it, that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. You shall not forget.
text:
DEU 25:19
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in nangho choldamna nape tauvin, nakim vel'uva namel mateu jousea kona nacholdo sah diu, Pakai, Pathen in napehnau nagoulo nadiu muna nachen lut tenguleh, nanghon jong vannoi leiset a Amelek mite chenna jouse chu nasuh mang hel diu ahi, tichu nagel doh jing diu ahi.
English: Therefore it shall be, when the LORD your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it, that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. You shall not forget.

tcz: Nangho Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gamsunga nachenlut tenguleh,
en: It shall be, when you have come in to the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,
text:
DEU 26:1
Thadou: Nangho Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gamsunga nachenlut tenguleh,
English: It shall be, when you have come in to the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in napeh'u, nalou lhosoh-gau masa akona phabep khat nakoidoh diu, hichengse chu pucha sunga nakoi khom diu, chuteng Pakai, Pathen in adeilhenna mun achu nachea'uva naga lhut diu ahi.
en: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that the LORD your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.
text:
DEU 26:2
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in napeh'u, nalou lhosoh-gau masa akona phabep khat nakoidoh diu, hichengse chu pucha sunga nakoi khom diu, chuteng Pakai, Pathen in adeilhenna mun achu nachea'uva naga lhut diu ahi.
English: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that the LORD your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

tcz: Hiche laimuna thempu natongpa koma chu nache uva, hitia hi ahenga nagasei diu ahi. Tunin keiman Pakai, Pathen henga ka phondoh ahitai, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in ipului khang uva pat aki tepna gamsunga keima ka hung lhung tai, tia nasei diu ahi.
en: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to the LORD your God, that I have come to the land which the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.”
text:
DEU 26:3
Thadou: Hiche laimuna thempu natongpa koma chu nache uva, hitia hi ahenga nagasei diu ahi. Tunin keiman Pakai, Pathen henga ka phondoh ahitai, ajeh chu Pakai, Pathen in ipului khang uva pat aki tepna gamsunga keima ka hung lhung tai, tia nasei diu ahi.
English: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to the LORD your God, that I have come to the land which the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.”

tcz: Hiteng chule, Thempu pan jong na pocha uchu na doplhah peh diu, hichu Pakai, Pathen maicham maiya nagakoi peh diu ahi.
en: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before the LORD your God’s altar.
text:
DEU 26:4
Thadou: Hiteng chule, Thempu pan jong na pocha uchu na doplhah peh diu, hichu Pakai, Pathen maicham maiya nagakoi peh diu ahi.
English: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before the LORD your God’s altar.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen henga hitia hi nasei diu, keima pupa chu Ram mi anahin, hiche muna chu khopem ahin, ami jeng jong lhomcha bou ahi. Chomlou kah in Egypt gamsunga nam lentah ahung hidoh tan, ahung hatdoh jeng tan ahileh mihem jeng jong tampi ahung hidoh tan ahi.
en: You shall answer and say before the LORD your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.
text:
DEU 26:5
Thadou: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen henga hitia hi nasei diu, keima pupa chu Ram mi anahin, hiche muna chu khopem ahin, ami jeng jong lhomcha bou ahi. Chomlou kah in Egypt gamsunga nam lentah ahung hidoh tan, ahung hatdoh jeng tan ahileh mihem jeng jong tampi ahung hidoh tan ahi.
English: You shall answer and say before the LORD your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.

tcz: Chujouvin Egypt miten ei sugim lheh jeng tauvin, gentheina tin chang eithoh sah uvin, soh le kol in hinkho iman sah uvin ahi.
en: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.
text:
DEU 26:6
Thadou: Chujouvin Egypt miten ei sugim lheh jeng tauvin, gentheina tin chang eithoh sah uvin, soh le kol in hinkho iman sah uvin ahi.
English: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.

tcz: Chuin kapu, kapa luiteu khanga pat, Pathen henga chun ka tao un, Pakaiyin ka taonau awgin ajatan ahileh, ka thoh gimna jouseu le gim hesoh a ka umna jouseu amusoh kei tan ahi.
en: Then we cried to the LORD, the God of our fathers. The LORD heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.
text:
DEU 26:7
Thadou: Chuin kapu, kapa luiteu khanga pat, Pathen henga chun ka tao un, Pakaiyin ka taonau awgin ajatan ahileh, ka thoh gimna jouseu le gim hesoh a ka umna jouseu amusoh kei tan ahi.
English: Then we cried to the LORD, the God of our fathers. The LORD heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.

tcz: Chutah chun Pakaiyin athahat apan in, abanjang thahat apantan, kichat umtah leh melchihna kidang tamtah tothon Egypt gamsunga kon chun Pathen in eihin puidoh tauvin ahi.
en: The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;

tcz: Hichea kon chun eihin pui galkai uvin ahileh, khoiju le bongnoi lonna gamsunga chun ka hung galkai lhung tauvin ahi.
en: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
text:
DEU 26:9
Thadou: Hichea kon chun eihin pui galkai uvin ahileh, khoiju le bongnoi lonna gamsunga chun ka hung galkai lhung tauvin ahi.
English: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

tcz: Tun Pakai vetan, nagman nei peh'u leiset gamasa chengse kahin lhut tai. Chuteng leh Pakai, Pathen angsunga hi natun doh diu, Pakai, Pathen chu chibai naboh diu ahi.
en: Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, the LORD, have given me.” You shall set it down before the LORD your God, and worship before the LORD your God.
text:
DEU 26:10
Thadou: Tun Pakai vetan, nagman nei peh'u leiset gamasa chengse kahin lhut tai. Chuteng leh Pakai, Pathen angsunga hi natun doh diu, Pakai, Pathen chu chibai naboh diu ahi.
English: Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, the LORD, have given me.” You shall set it down before the LORD your God, and worship before the LORD your God.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen akona thilpeh jouse hin kipana nachan sah diu, nangho nahiu vin, Levi mite ahin chule nalah uva hung kholjin miho jouse jaona na kipa soh kei diu ahi.
en: You shall rejoice in all the good which the LORD your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the foreigner who is among you.
text:
DEU 26:11
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen akona thilpeh jouse hin kipana nachan sah diu, nangho nahiu vin, Levi mite ahin chule nalah uva hung kholjin miho jouse jaona na kipa soh kei diu ahi.
English: You shall rejoice in all the good which the LORD your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the foreigner who is among you.

tcz: Chule hopsom pehna dinga, kum thum sunga peh ding dol chengse nasim toh soh kei diu, hichengse chu Levi mite ahin, nulou palou, meithai ho dinga na khindoh ding, na khopi sung'uva cheng jousen aneh uva va sohkei diu ahi.
en: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.
text:
DEU 26:12
Thadou: Chule hopsom pehna dinga, kum thum sunga peh ding dol chengse nasim toh soh kei diu, hichengse chu Levi mite ahin, nulou palou, meithai ho dinga na khindoh ding, na khopi sung'uva cheng jousen aneh uva va sohkei diu ahi.
English: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.

tcz: Chule Pakai, Pathen angsunga nasei diu, ka insunga kon in ijakai atheng jouse chu ka koidoh soh kei tan ahi. Hiti chun, athil theng jouse akon chun Levi mite, kholjin mi, nulou, palou chule chaga hole meithai ho kape tan ahi. Na thupeh abonchan ka subukim soh keiyun ahi.
en: You shall say before the LORD your God, “I have put away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all your commandment which you have commanded me. I have not transgressed any of your commandments, neither have I forgotten them.
text:
DEU 26:13
Thadou: Chule Pakai, Pathen angsunga nasei diu, ka insunga kon in ijakai atheng jouse chu ka koidoh soh kei tan ahi. Hiti chun, athil theng jouse akon chun Levi mite, kholjin mi, nulou, palou chule chaga hole meithai ho kape tan ahi. Na thupeh abonchan ka subukim soh keiyun ahi.
English: You shall say before the LORD your God, “I have put away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all your commandment which you have commanded me. I have not transgressed any of your commandments, neither have I forgotten them.

tcz: Kaboi pet tah jeng in jong hopsom ka mangcha hih nai, atheng lou dinmuna kaum laiyin jong hopsom neocha jong ka kilah hih uve, hopsom kiti hi mithi opnan jong thilpeh a kamang khapouvin, keiho hin Pakai thupeh abonchan kajui jing un, nangma thupeh bang bang in ijakai ka bol kimsoh keiyun ahi.
en: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor given of it for the dead. I have listened to the LORD my God’s voice. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.
text:
DEU 26:14
Thadou: Kaboi pet tah jeng in jong hopsom ka mangcha hih nai, atheng lou dinmuna kaum laiyin jong hopsom neocha jong ka kilah hih uve, hopsom kiti hi mithi opnan jong thilpeh a kamang khapouvin, keiho hin Pakai thupeh abonchan kajui jing un, nangma thupeh bang bang in ijakai ka bol kimsoh keiyun ahi.
English: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor given of it for the dead. I have listened to the LORD my God’s voice. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.

tcz: Na umna muntheng laiya kon chun neihin vetan, chule nami Israelte napehna gamsunga hin phatthei lhingset hin boh tauvin, ajeh chu hiche gamsung hi khoiju leh bongnoi lonna gam ahin, kapu kappa teu khang apat eipeh sau ana hitai, tia nasei ding ahi.
en: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”
text:
DEU 26:15
Thadou: Na umna muntheng laiya kon chun neihin vetan, chule nami Israelte napehna gamsunga hin phatthei lhingset hin boh tauvin, ajeh chu hiche gamsung hi khoiju leh bongnoi lonna gam ahin, kapu kappa teu khang apat eipeh sau ana hitai, tia nasei ding ahi.
English: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai, Pathen in tuni hin nanghon hiche chondan josue hi na jui diuvin nape tauve. Hicheng ho jouse hi nahinkho lhum keiyuva natoh doh nadiuva limgeh chaa naum diu ahi.
en: Today the LORD your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.
text:
DEU 26:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakai, Pathen in tuni hin nanghon hiche chondan josue hi na jui diuvin nape tauve. Hicheng ho jouse hi nahinkho lhum keiyuva natoh doh nadiuva limgeh chaa naum diu ahi.
English: Today the LORD your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.

tcz: Ajeh chu nanghon hiche hi tunia, Pakai thudola naphon doh'u ahitan, nangho dia tonsot Pathen ahijing in, ama lampi jinga na lamlhah diu chule achonna dan jouse le athupeh aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
en: You have declared today that the LORD is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.
text:
DEU 26:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu nanghon hiche hi tunia, Pakai thudola naphon doh'u ahitan, nangho dia tonsot Pathen ahijing in, ama lampi jinga na lamlhah diu chule achonna dan jouse le athupeh aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
English: You have declared today that the LORD is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.

tcz: Pakaiyin hiti hin aseiyin, na chung chang thua aphongdoh in, nang hohi aman aphondoh banga amite mong mong ama dia lhentum chu nahi diu, athupeh jouse hi nanit bukim soh kei diu ahi.
en: The LORD has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.
text:
DEU 26:18
Thadou: Pakaiyin hiti hin aseiyin, na chung chang thua aphongdoh in, nang hohi aman aphondoh banga amite mong mong ama dia lhentum chu nahi diu, athupeh jouse hi nanit bukim soh kei diu ahi.
English: The LORD has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.

tcz: Chuteng Pakaiyin, asemsa vannoi leiset mite lah a choi-atna dim, jabolna dimset a natun doh diu ahitai. Pakaiyin aseidohsa bang banga nang hohi nam thengte nahi jing diu ahi.
en: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to the LORD your God, as he has spoken.
text:
DEU 26:19
Thadou: Chuteng Pakaiyin, asemsa vannoi leiset mite lah a choi-atna dim, jabolna dimset a natun doh diu ahitai. Pakaiyin aseidohsa bang banga nang hohi nam thengte nahi jing diu ahi.
English: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to the LORD your God, as he has spoken.

tcz: Chuin Mose chu Israel upa chengse toh akilhon tan, miho henga hiti hin aseiye. tunia ka thupeh chengse hi aboncha nanit soh kei diu ahi.
en: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.
text:
DEU 27:1
Thadou: Chuin Mose chu Israel upa chengse toh akilhon tan, miho henga hiti hin aseiye. tunia ka thupeh chengse hi aboncha nanit soh kei diu ahi.
English: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in napeh nau gamsung nahin jot uva Jordan vadung nahung gal kai tenguleh, song len phabep natun diu hiche songho chu songlou mangchaa abona na loinam soh kei diu ahi.
en: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which the LORD your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.
text:
DEU 27:2
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in napeh nau gamsung nahin jot uva Jordan vadung nahung gal kai tenguleh, song len phabep natun diu hiche songho chu songlou mangchaa abona na loinam soh kei diu ahi.
English: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which the LORD your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.

tcz: Hiche song kiphut ho chunga chu Pakaiyin, napu luite hou henga athutepsa banga nagal kai tah jeh uva, Pakai, Pathen in na pehnau gamsung nalut tengule, dan thu akisei thu chengse aboncha najihlut soh kei diu ahi.
en: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which the LORD your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
text:
DEU 27:3
Thadou: Hiche song kiphut ho chunga chu Pakaiyin, napu luite hou henga athutepsa banga nagal kai tah jeh uva, Pakai, Pathen in na pehnau gamsung nalut tengule, dan thu akisei thu chengse aboncha najihlut soh kei diu ahi.
English: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which the LORD your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.

tcz: Tunia kathupeh banga Jordan nagal kai tenguleh songho chu naphudoh soh kei diu, Ebal molchunga chu natun doh soh kei diu, hiche songho chu aboncha song-lou mangchaa na loijol namsoh kei diu ahi.
en: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.
text:
DEU 27:4
Thadou: Tunia kathupeh banga Jordan nagal kai tenguleh songho chu naphudoh soh kei diu, Ebal molchunga chu natun doh soh kei diu, hiche songho chu aboncha song-lou mangchaa na loijol namsoh kei diu ahi.
English: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.

tcz: Hiche muna chu Pakai, Pathen dinga maicham khat natun doh diu, maicham chu song jeng mangchaa nasem diu, songho suhnamna dinga chu thih jeng naman lou diu ahi.
en: There you shall build an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.
text:
DEU 27:5
Thadou: Hiche muna chu Pakai, Pathen dinga maicham khat natun doh diu, maicham chu song jeng mangchaa nasem diu, songho suhnamna dinga chu thih jeng naman lou diu ahi.
English: There you shall build an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen dinga natun doh'u maicham chu thih manchah jeng hilou ding, hiche maicham chu pumgo thilto katdohnaa naman chah diu ahi.
en: You shall build the LORD your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.
text:
DEU 27:6
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen dinga natun doh'u maicham chu thih manchah jeng hilou ding, hiche maicham chu pumgo thilto katdohnaa naman chah diu ahi.
English: You shall build the LORD your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.

tcz: Hiche maicham chunga chu chamna thil jong nakat doh diu, asa jong chu nanghon naneh jeng diu, Pakai, Pathen angsunga kipah tah a naum diu ahi.
en: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before the LORD your God.
text:
DEU 27:7
Thadou: Hiche maicham chunga chu chamna thil jong nakat doh diu, asa jong chu nanghon naneh jeng diu, Pakai, Pathen angsunga kipah tah a naum diu ahi.
English: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before the LORD your God.

tcz: Chuteng danthu jouse hi aboncha kichihsela, hiche song chunga hi najih doh sohkei diu ahi.
en: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”
text:
DEU 27:8
Thadou: Chuteng danthu jouse hi aboncha kichihsela, hiche song chunga hi najih doh sohkei diu ahi.
English: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”

tcz: Hiti chun Mose jong Levi thempuho jaonan thu aseiyin, Israel insung pumpi henga hiti hin aseiyin. Vo Israelte ngaiyun, tunia pat nangho Pakai, Pathen dinga amite nahi tauve
en: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of the LORD your God.
text:
DEU 27:9
Thadou: Hiti chun Mose jong Levi thempuho jaonan thu aseiyin, Israel insung pumpi henga hiti hin aseiyin. Vo Israelte ngaiyun, tunia pat nangho Pakai, Pathen dinga amite nahi tauve
English: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of the LORD your God.

tcz: Ajeh chu nanghon Pakai, Pathen thusei jeng nangai diu, athupeh leh tunia achona dan thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
en: You shall therefore obey the LORD your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”
text:
DEU 27:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu nanghon Pakai, Pathen thusei jeng nangai diu, athupeh leh tunia achona dan thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh kei diu ahi.
English: You shall therefore obey the LORD your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”

tcz: Mose’n jong mipi jouse chu aphohsal jeng in, aheng uvah hiti hin asei tan ahi.
en: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,
text:
DEU 27:11
Thadou: Mose’n jong mipi jouse chu aphohsal jeng in, aheng uvah hiti hin asei tan ahi.
English: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,

tcz: Jordan vadung nagal kai tenguleh, mipi aboncha phatthei bohna chang dinga aboncha Gerizim molchunga ding den soh kei diu ahi. Simeon ahin, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph chule Benjamin hichengse chu hidiu ahi.
en: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
text:
DEU 27:12
Thadou: Jordan vadung nagal kai tenguleh, mipi aboncha phatthei bohna chang dinga aboncha Gerizim molchunga ding den soh kei diu ahi. Simeon ahin, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph chule Benjamin hichengse chu hidiu ahi.
English: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

tcz: Ebal molsang gaosap chansah dinga mipi hijat chu kitang den ding Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan chule Naphtali ahiuve.
en: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
text:
DEU 27:13
Thadou: Ebal molsang gaosap chansah dinga mipi hijat chu kitang den ding Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan chule Naphtali ahiuve.
English: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

tcz: Chuteng Levi miten jong aw-sangtah'a aphondoh uva, Israel pumpin hichu ajah soh kei diu ahi.
en: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,
text:
DEU 27:14
Thadou: Chuteng Levi miten jong aw-sangtah'a aphondoh uva, Israel pumpin hichu ajah soh kei diu ahi.
English: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,

tcz: Chule Pakaiya dia thet um mihem khutsem milim kilha jol ho, guhthima hou ding go ah michu apat patna gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi, tia lhangphong tah a asap jal diu, mipin jong hichu adonbut’a Amen! atipeh diu ahi.
en: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’
text:
DEU 27:15
Thadou: Chule Pakaiya dia thet um mihem khutsem milim kilha jol ho, guhthima hou ding go ah michu apat patna gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi, tia lhangphong tah a asap jal diu, mipin jong hichu adonbut’a Amen! atipeh diu ahi.
English: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’

tcz: Koi hileh anu le apa jabol lou mihem chu gaosap na chang jeng hen tia asap teng, hichu adonbut uva Amen! atipeh diu ahi.
en: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
text:
DEU 27:16
Thadou: Koi hileh anu le apa jabol lou mihem chu gaosap na chang jeng hen tia asap teng, hichu adonbut uva Amen! atipeh diu ahi.
English: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

tcz: Aheng akom asopi toh agamgi sukeh chan chu gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi. Hichu mipi hon adonbut diu, Amen! ati peh diu ahi.
en: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
text:
DEU 27:17
Thadou: Aheng akom asopi toh agamgi sukeh chan chu gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi. Hichu mipi hon adonbut diu, Amen! ati peh diu ahi.
English: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

tcz: Lamlhahna dunga mitcho elbai sugim ham, puicha vai ham khat chu gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi. Hiche jong chu mipin a donbut’a, Amen! atipeh diu ahi.
en: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
text:
DEU 27:18
Thadou: Lamlhahna dunga mitcho elbai sugim ham, puicha vai ham khat chu gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi. Hiche jong chu mipin a donbut’a, Amen! atipeh diu ahi.
English: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

tcz: Kholjin miho leh chaga meithai kikah a thu adih louva tan mihem chu, gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi. Hitia ahinsei teng mipin adonbut’a, Amen! ati sohkei diu ahi.
en: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
text:
DEU 27:19
Thadou: Kholjin miho leh chaga meithai kikah a thu adih louva tan mihem chu, gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi. Hitia ahinsei teng mipin adonbut’a, Amen! ati sohkei diu ahi.
English: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

tcz: Pasal khat touvin apa jinu chu aluppi khah tah a ahileh, amapa chu gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi. Ajeh chu amapa hin apa jinu nih ahopeh’e atiuleh mipin jong, Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
en: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
text:
DEU 27:20
Thadou: Pasal khat touvin apa jinu chu aluppi khah tah a ahileh, amapa chu gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi. Ajeh chu amapa hin apa jinu nih ahopeh’e atiuleh mipin jong, Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
English: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

tcz: Ijemtia gancha toh lumkhom aum khah tah ahileh, amachu gaosapna chang jeng hen, tia asei teng mipin jong, Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
en: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
text:
DEU 27:21
Thadou: Ijemtia gancha toh lumkhom aum khah tah ahileh, amachu gaosapna chang jeng hen, tia asei teng mipin jong, Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
English: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

tcz: Pasal koi hileh apa sopinu toh lum khom ham, ahilouleh anu chanu toh lumkhom auma ahileh, amapa chu gaosapna chang jeng hen tia asei tengleh, mipin jong Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
en: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
text:
DEU 27:22
Thadou: Pasal koi hileh apa sopinu toh lum khom ham, ahilouleh anu chanu toh lumkhom auma ahileh, amapa chu gaosapna chang jeng hen tia asei tengleh, mipin jong Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
English: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

tcz: Pasal koi hileh ajinu, nu toh lumkhom auma ahileh ama chu gaosapna chang jeng hen tia asei teng, mipin jong Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
en: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
text:
DEU 27:23
Thadou: Pasal koi hileh ajinu, nu toh lumkhom auma ahileh ama chu gaosapna chang jeng hen tia asei teng, mipin jong Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
English: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

tcz: Mihem koi hijongleh aheng akoma chenga sopipa aguh a thimtha tapou chu, gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi, tia asei tengleh mipin jong Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
en: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
text:
DEU 27:24
Thadou: Mihem koi hijongleh aheng akoma chenga sopipa aguh a thimtha tapou chu, gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi, tia asei tengleh mipin jong Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
English: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

tcz: Themmona beiya mihem chunga thina chansah dinga sum guh ne mihem chu gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi, tia asei tengleh Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
en: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
text:
DEU 27:25
Thadou: Themmona beiya mihem chunga thina chansah dinga sum guh ne mihem chu gaosapna chang jeng ding ahi, tia asei tengleh Amen! tia adonbut diu ahi.
English: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

tcz: Koi hileh athu seidohsa aboncha tong molso lou chan chu gaosapna achung’a chang ding ahi. Hichu mipi hon abonchauva Amen! tia adonbut soh kei diu ahi.
en: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’”
text:
DEU 27:26
Thadou: Koi hileh athu seidohsa aboncha tong molso lou chan chu gaosapna achung’a chang ding ahi. Hichu mipi hon abonchauva Amen! tia adonbut soh kei diu ahi.
English: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’”

tcz: Pakai, Pathen thua nanun jing'uva tuni khoa ka thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh keiyuva ahileh, Pakaiyin vannoi leiset a nam jouse lah’a nangho achungnung pena natun diu ahi.
en: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
text:
DEU 28:1
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen thua nanun jing'uva tuni khoa ka thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh keiyuva ahileh, Pakaiyin vannoi leiset a nam jouse lah’a nangho achungnung pena natun diu ahi.
English: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen thusei aboncha nangai jing'uva ahileh, phattheina lhingset nachan diu ahi.
en: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to the LORD your God’s voice.
text:
DEU 28:2
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen thusei aboncha nangai jing'uva ahileh, phattheina lhingset nachan diu ahi.
English: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

tcz: Khopi sung le lou jao lah ajong, phattheina lhingset nachan diu ahi.
en: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.
text:
DEU 28:3
Thadou: Khopi sung le lou jao lah ajong, phattheina lhingset nachan diu ahi.
English: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.

tcz: Natu nachateu jong phatthei na chang jing ding, nalou gasoh jeng ujong phattheina chang ding, nagan chateu jouse jong phattheina chang ding, naganchateu le nasangan teu jouse jong phat theina lhingset chang diu ahi.
en: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.
text:
DEU 28:4
Thadou: Natu nachateu jong phatthei na chang jing ding, nalou gasoh jeng ujong phattheina chang ding, nagan chateu jouse jong phattheina chang ding, naganchateu le nasangan teu jouse jong phat theina lhingset chang diu ahi.
English: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.

tcz: Na dip jeng ujong phattheina chang dimset ding, nachang sum buh ujong phattheina chang ding ahi.
en: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.
text:
DEU 28:5
Thadou: Na dip jeng ujong phattheina chang dimset ding, nachang sum buh ujong phattheina chang ding ahi.
English: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.

tcz: Na vailhun navaikon teng ujongleh, phattheina nachan diu ahi.
en: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.
text:
DEU 28:6
Thadou: Na vailhun navaikon teng ujongleh, phattheina nachan diu ahi.
English: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.

tcz: Nagal mite jouseu Pakaiyin lethuhna aneiya gal alal sah ding, lampi khat a bou hung kon diu ahin, ahinlah lampi sagi jena jam cheh soh kei diu ahi.
en: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.
text:
DEU 28:7
Thadou: Nagal mite jouseu Pakaiyin lethuhna aneiya gal alal sah ding, lampi khat a bou hung kon diu ahin, ahinlah lampi sagi jena jam cheh soh kei diu ahi.
English: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.

tcz: Na chang pang jong phatthei naboh peh diu, nabol natoh jouseu jong aboncha phatthei naboh peh diu ahi. Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gam sunga chu phattheina lhingset lhung ding ahi.
en: The LORD will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.
text:
DEU 28:8
Thadou: Na chang pang jong phatthei naboh peh diu, nabol natoh jouseu jong aboncha phatthei naboh peh diu ahi. Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gam sunga chu phattheina lhingset lhung ding ahi.
English: The LORD will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen thupeh chengse aboncha nanit soh keiyuva, Ama lam jeng nakat uva ahileh, nangho henga akitepna banga vannoi leiset a nam mite jouse lah a, nam dei lhena natun diu ahi.
en: The LORD will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and walk in his ways.
text:
DEU 28:9
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen thupeh chengse aboncha nanit soh keiyuva, Ama lam jeng nakat uva ahileh, nangho henga akitepna banga vannoi leiset a nam mite jouse lah a, nam dei lhena natun diu ahi.
English: The LORD will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and walk in his ways.

tcz: Hitia chu nabol tenguleh, namtin vaipin ama hi Pakai jal ahimong’e ti aphot chet diu, namtin vaipin nagin soh kei diu ahi.
en: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the LORD’s name, and they will be afraid of you.
text:
DEU 28:10
Thadou: Hitia chu nabol tenguleh, namtin vaipin ama hi Pakai jal ahimong’e ti aphot chet diu, namtin vaipin nagin soh kei diu ahi.
English: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the LORD’s name, and they will be afraid of you.

tcz: Ima jouse bukimsela phatthei naboh diu, nacha na nanao teu jouse, nagancha teu, nalou ga jouseu, napu napateu khanga pat Pakaiyin asei dohsa kapeh ding ahi, atina gamsunga chu nangho haosatna dimset a naum diu ahi.
en: The LORD will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
text:
DEU 28:11
Thadou: Ima jouse bukimsela phatthei naboh diu, nacha na nanao teu jouse, nagancha teu, nalou ga jouseu, napu napateu khanga pat Pakaiyin asei dohsa kapeh ding ahi, atina gamsunga chu nangho haosatna dimset a naum diu ahi.
English: The LORD will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.

tcz: Chuteng Pakaiyin agoukholna jouse hin hong doh soh keiyin tin, kum kihei phat cha ahibanga gotwi hung juntin, natoh jouseu chu aboncha phattheina changsoh hel ding, namtin vaipi ho na neichan batna napeh diu, ahinlah nanghon mi danga na batlou diu ahi.
en: The LORD will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.
text:
DEU 28:12
Thadou: Chuteng Pakaiyin agoukholna jouse hin hong doh soh keiyin tin, kum kihei phat cha ahibanga gotwi hung juntin, natoh jouseu chu aboncha phattheina changsoh hel ding, namtin vaipi ho na neichan batna napeh diu, ahinlah nanghon mi danga na batlou diu ahi.
English: The LORD will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.

tcz: Pakaiyin nangho aluchang lama napansah uva, ameito lam mong monga na pansah louhel diu ahi. Khantouna jeng nahi diu, lhahsuh nan nahin jui louhel diu ahi. Tunia chonna dan thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh keiyuva ahileh, nangho phatthei nachan tei diu ahi.
en: The LORD will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,
text:
DEU 28:13
Thadou: Pakaiyin nangho aluchang lama napansah uva, ameito lam mong monga na pansah louhel diu ahi. Khantouna jeng nahi diu, lhahsuh nan nahin jui louhel diu ahi. Tunia chonna dan thupeh chengse aboncha najui kimsoh keiyuva ahileh, nangho phatthei nachan tei diu ahi.
English: The LORD will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,

tcz: Tunia ka thupeh chengsea kona hi na kihei mang thei lou diu, jetlam le veilam ani gela na palkeh loudiu, pathen milim semthu hoa kona naki kangse diu, hiche ho tobang chu najen le lou hel diu ahiti, sumil louva nagel doh jing diu ahi.
en: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
text:
DEU 28:14
Thadou: Tunia ka thupeh chengsea kona hi na kihei mang thei lou diu, jetlam le veilam ani gela na palkeh loudiu, pathen milim semthu hoa kona naki kangse diu, hiche ho tobang chu najen le lou hel diu ahiti, sumil louva nagel doh jing diu ahi.
English: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen thupeh nahsah louva na koiyuva, tunia keiman ka thupeh leh ama hoa kona thupeh chonna dan chengse nabol doh theina diuva chingthei tah’a najui lou'uva ahileh, anoiya gaosapna hohin nalhun den jeng diu ahi.
en: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.
text:
DEU 28:15
Thadou: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen thupeh nahsah louva na koiyuva, tunia keiman ka thupeh leh ama hoa kona thupeh chonna dan chengse nabol doh theina diuva chingthei tah’a najui lou'uva ahileh, anoiya gaosapna hohin nalhun den jeng diu ahi.
English: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.

tcz: Na chennau khopi sung ahin loumun hi jongleh, gaosapna nachan diu ahi.
en: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.
text:
DEU 28:16
Thadou: Na chennau khopi sung ahin loumun hi jongleh, gaosapna nachan diu ahi.
English: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.

tcz: Na dip'u ahin, nachang bong goina jeng ujong, gaosapna chang ding ahi.
en: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.
text:
DEU 28:17
Thadou: Na dip'u ahin, nachang bong goina jeng ujong, gaosapna chang ding ahi.
English: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.

tcz: Na chilhahteu ahin, naleiset ga chung'uva jong gaosapna lhung ding, naganchateu jong pung thei louva, nakelngoi nouteu jong pung be talou ding ahi.
en: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.
text:
DEU 28:18
Thadou: Na chilhahteu ahin, naleiset ga chung'uva jong gaosapna lhung ding, naganchateu jong pung thei louva, nakelngoi nouteu jong pung be talou ding ahi.
English: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.

tcz: Na vailhun, navai kondoh geiyuva gaosapna nachan diu ahi.
en: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.
text:
DEU 28:19
Thadou: Na vailhun, navai kondoh geiyuva gaosapna nachan diu ahi.
English: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in nachung'uva gaosapna tinchang ahin lhun den ding, kisuh nohphahna, lung-opkaina, chule gimna ijakai jouse keima thupeh chengse nadonse tahlou jeh'uva nachung'uva hijatpi chu lhung jeng ding ahi.
en: The LORD will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.
text:
DEU 28:20
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in nachung'uva gaosapna tinchang ahin lhun den ding, kisuh nohphahna, lung-opkaina, chule gimna ijakai jouse keima thupeh chengse nadonse tahlou jeh'uva nachung'uva hijatpi chu lhung jeng ding ahi.
English: The LORD will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.

tcz: Na jotna diu gam sunga nachen lut kahseh uva Pakai, Pathen in nachung'uva hise natna jat kim nachung'uva alhunsah ding ahi.
en: The LORD will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.
text:
DEU 28:21
Thadou: Na jotna diu gam sunga nachen lut kahseh uva Pakai, Pathen in nachung'uva hise natna jat kim nachung'uva alhunsah ding ahi.
English: The LORD will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.

tcz: Pakaiyin natna ki dang nachung'uva alhunsah ding, khosih, tipat, tichung sat, chemjam pana nasat gamhel diu, nget leh thing lung nachung'uva alhunsah ding, bolgimna hijatpi hi, nathi masang seuva najui le diu ahi.
en: The LORD will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.
text:
DEU 28:22
Thadou: Pakaiyin natna ki dang nachung'uva alhunsah ding, khosih, tipat, tichung sat, chemjam pana nasat gamhel diu, nget leh thing lung nachung'uva alhunsah ding, bolgimna hijatpi hi, nathi masang seuva najui le diu ahi.
English: The LORD will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.

tcz: Nalu lam'uva von chengse sumeng kisoh tading, natahsa noilam chengseu thing kisoh ding ahi.
en: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.
text:
DEU 28:23
Thadou: Nalu lam'uva von chengse sumeng kisoh tading, natahsa noilam chengseu thing kisoh ding ahi.
English: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.

tcz: Chuteng Pakai, Pathen in nagam sung'uva gotwi jouse leivui leh neldi aki sosah ding, nathi masang seuva vana kona hung leng suh suh jing ding ahi.
en: The LORD will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.
text:
DEU 28:24
Thadou: Chuteng Pakai, Pathen in nagam sung'uva gotwi jouse leivui leh neldi aki sosah ding, nathi masang seuva vana kona hung leng suh suh jing ding ahi.
