English: The LORD will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.

tcz: Pakaiyin nangho namel mateu masanga na panpi lou diu, na melmateu toh ki maito dinga lampi khatseh bou na juisah diu, nagal miteu masanga lampi sagi kisoa na jam cheh diu, hi tia chu leiset chunga lenggam jouse lah a kicha puma hinkho naman jing diu ahi.
en: The LORD will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.
text:
DEU 28:25
Thadou: Pakaiyin nangho namel mateu masanga na panpi lou diu, na melmateu toh ki maito dinga lampi khatseh bou na juisah diu, nagal miteu masanga lampi sagi kisoa na jam cheh diu, hi tia chu leiset chunga lenggam jouse lah a kicha puma hinkho naman jing diu ahi.
English: The LORD will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

tcz: Nathi long jouseu chungleng vachaten aneh diu, leiset a ganhing namkim in kivahna anei diu, hitia chu aneh tenguleh, leiset a mihem khat jeng cha jong ahoh mang dinga hung ki lulah lou diu ahi.
en: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.
text:
DEU 28:26
Thadou: Nathi long jouseu chungleng vachaten aneh diu, leiset a ganhing namkim in kivahna anei diu, hitia chu aneh tenguleh, leiset a mihem khat jeng cha jong ahoh mang dinga hung ki lulah lou diu ahi.
English: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.

tcz: Chuteng Pakaiyin Egypt gamsunga naum laiyuva uilut ana lansah banga ahin lansah kit ding, na tichung'u pom ding, thisan soh leu ding, boldammo hela tipat natna naneiyuva hinkho naman diu ahi.
en: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.
text:
DEU 28:27
Thadou: Chuteng Pakaiyin Egypt gamsunga naum laiyuva uilut ana lansah banga ahin lansah kit ding, na tichung'u pom ding, thisan soh leu ding, boldammo hela tipat natna naneiyuva hinkho naman diu ahi.
English: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.

tcz: Pakaiyin nangol sah diu, kho namu thei lou diu, nalung thim pumpiu na suhnoh phahpeh diu ahi.
en: The LORD will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
text:
DEU 28:28
Thadou: Pakaiyin nangol sah diu, kho namu thei lou diu, nalung thim pumpiu na suhnoh phahpeh diu ahi.
English: The LORD will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.

tcz: Chuteng nangho mitcho banga sun jenga jong naki mai lele diu, ipia ki salal jong leu chun na machal thei lou diu, mitin in nasuh genthei diu chule amaho chun nachom gamset diu ahina laiye.
en: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.
text:
DEU 28:29
Thadou: Chuteng nangho mitcho banga sun jenga jong naki mai lele diu, ipia ki salal jong leu chun na machal thei lou diu, mitin in nasuh genthei diu chule amaho chun nachom gamset diu ahina laiye.
English: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.

tcz: Jidia numei nakihol diu, amanu chu pasal dangkhat toh lum khom ding, in jong naki sah diu hinlah asunga nachen theilou diu ahi. Chule lengpi lei jong nalho diu, ahinlah aga chu naneh thei lou diu ahi.
en: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.
text:
DEU 28:30
Thadou: Jidia numei nakihol diu, amanu chu pasal dangkhat toh lum khom ding, in jong naki sah diu hinlah asunga nachen theilou diu ahi. Chule lengpi lei jong nalho diu, ahinlah aga chu naneh thei lou diu ahi.
English: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.

tcz: Nama sang laiyuva na bongchal uchu ki that ding ahinlah asa chu naneh thei lou diu, hunama nasangan'u kila ding ahinlah na kile lah thei tah lou diu, nakelngoi jeng ujong nangho melmate khut a kipedoh ding, koi machan nangho napan hu tahlou diu ahi.
en: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.
text:
DEU 28:31
Thadou: Nama sang laiyuva na bongchal uchu ki that ding ahinlah asa chu naneh thei lou diu, hunama nasangan'u kila ding ahinlah na kile lah thei tah lou diu, nakelngoi jeng ujong nangho melmate khut a kipedoh ding, koi machan nangho napan hu tahlou diu ahi.
English: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.

tcz: Chule nachanuteu ahin, nachapateu abonchauva namdang te khut a kipedoh tadiu, nilhum in velhi jong leuchun nachan kit tahlou diu, naban thahat'u pana amaho chudoh jouna tha nanei lou diu ahi.
en: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.
text:
DEU 28:32
Thadou: Chule nachanuteu ahin, nachapateu abonchauva namdang te khut a kipedoh tadiu, nilhum in velhi jong leuchun nachan kit tahlou diu, naban thahat'u pana amaho chudoh jouna tha nanei lou diu ahi.
English: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.

tcz: Imatih a nahet khah lou'u nam dang khat in, nalou-gasoh'u nahin hampeh chai keiyun tin, chuteng nangho chunga tantih nei louva hiche thoh gimna chu umjing ding ahi.
en: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,
text:
DEU 28:33
Thadou: Imatih a nahet khah lou'u nam dang khat in, nalou-gasoh'u nahin hampeh chai keiyun tin, chuteng nangho chunga tantih nei louva hiche thoh gimna chu umjing ding ahi.
English: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,

tcz: Namit teniuvin venan nate, ahinlah nangho mingol kibol nabanga na kidel mang diu ahi.
en: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.
text:
DEU 28:34
Thadou: Namit teniuvin venan nate, ahinlah nangho mingol kibol nabanga na kidel mang diu ahi.
English: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.

tcz: Natibah hou hungdul doh ding, abeh beh a hung pat ding, na kengtouva pat nalu chan'u pat ding nadam doh lou diu ahi.
en: The LORD will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.
text:
DEU 28:35
Thadou: Natibah hou hungdul doh ding, abeh beh a hung pat ding, na kengtouva pat nalu chan'u pat ding nadam doh lou diu ahi.
English: The LORD will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.

tcz: Nangho nahiuvin, nachung'uva lengvai homte ahin, Pakaiyin napu, napateu jeng in jong ahet phah louhel nam mite khat angsunga nahin puilut diu, hiche muna chu thing le songa kisem pathen lim nahou diu ajen lea napan diu ahi.
en: The LORD will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.
text:
DEU 28:36
Thadou: Nangho nahiuvin, nachung'uva lengvai homte ahin, Pakaiyin napu, napateu jeng in jong ahet phah louhel nam mite khat angsunga nahin puilut diu, hiche muna chu thing le songa kisem pathen lim nahou diu ajen lea napan diu ahi.
English: The LORD will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.

tcz: Hiche muna chu Pakaiyin napui lhung diu, mitin ma angsunga kicha puma naum lodiu, imatih chana sei chah a naum diu ahi.
en: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where the LORD will lead you away.
text:
DEU 28:37
Thadou: Hiche muna chu Pakaiyin napui lhung diu, mitin ma angsunga kicha puma naum lodiu, imatih chana sei chah a naum diu ahi.
English: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where the LORD will lead you away.

tcz: Chule loulaiya tuthei muchi ijakai napoh diu, ahinlah aga seikham lou chakhat nalo khom diu, ajeh chu khaokhopi ten aneh chaigam diu ahibouve.
en: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.
text:
DEU 28:38
Thadou: Chule loulaiya tuthei muchi ijakai napoh diu, ahinlah aga seikham lou chakhat nalo khom diu, ajeh chu khaokhopi ten aneh chaigam diu ahibouve.
English: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.

tcz: Lengpi lei jeng jong nalho'uva naki sah lel pi diu, ahinlah lengpitwi chu nadon louhel diu, hiche lengpi chu lung in aneh gamset ding ahi.
en: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.
text:
DEU 28:39
Thadou: Lengpi lei jeng jong nalho'uva naki sah lel pi diu, ahinlah lengpitwi chu nadon louhel diu, hiche lengpi chu lung in aneh gamset ding ahi.
English: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.

tcz: Nachennau gamsunga Olive thingphung tampi nanei diu, ahinlah atwi chu nakinu thei deh deh lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu Olive thingphung nanei chengseu aboncha kisat chop ding ahi.
en: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.
text:
DEU 28:40
Thadou: Nachennau gamsunga Olive thingphung tampi nanei diu, ahinlah atwi chu nakinu thei deh deh lou diu ahi. Ajeh chu Olive thingphung nanei chengseu aboncha kisat chop ding ahi.
English: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.

tcz: Chule nanghon chapa tamtah nanei diu, ahinlah khat a khat jeng cha jong nachan lou diu, aboncha sohchang dinga chediu chule nangho panhu ding mihem khat jeng cha jong kisep lou ding ahi.
en: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.
text:
DEU 28:41
Thadou: Chule nanghon chapa tamtah nanei diu, ahinlah khat a khat jeng cha jong nachan lou diu, aboncha sohchang dinga chediu chule nangho panhu ding mihem khat jeng cha jong kisep lou ding ahi.
English: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.

tcz: Nathing phunghou ahin chule nachennau leiset aboncha khaokhote chenna jeng ding ahibouve.
en: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.
text:
DEU 28:42
Thadou: Nathing phunghou ahin chule nachennau leiset aboncha khaokhote chenna jeng ding ahibouve.
English: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.

tcz: Na heng'uva hung chenga kholjin mi chu nangho sanga khang toujing ding, nangho vang na kheh suh cheh cheh diu ahi.
en: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.
text:
DEU 28:43
Thadou: Na heng'uva hung chenga kholjin mi chu nangho sanga khang toujing ding, nangho vang na kheh suh cheh cheh diu ahi.
English: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.

tcz: Nanghon jong ama koma chu thil ijakai bat a nakilah diu, ama jeng hatna chang ding, nangho ameiya napan diu amavang alua pang ding ahi.
en: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
text:
DEU 28:44
Thadou: Nanghon jong ama koma chu thil ijakai bat a nakilah diu, ama jeng hatna chang ding, nangho ameiya napan diu amavang alua pang ding ahi.
English: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse hi gaosapna ahin nachung'uva lhung tading, hichengse chun nangho nung ahindel ding naphah thu thu'uva, chuteng nangho naki suhgep hel diu ahi, ajeh chu nanghon Pakai, Pathen thusei nangai tapouvin, achonna dan thupeh chengse jong jui ding nagel lou-u ahi.
en: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.
text:
DEU 28:45
Thadou: Hiche ho jouse hi gaosapna ahin nachung'uva lhung tading, hichengse chun nangho nung ahindel ding naphah thu thu'uva, chuteng nangho naki suhgep hel diu ahi, ajeh chu nanghon Pakai, Pathen thusei nangai tapouvin, achonna dan thupeh chengse jong jui ding nagel lou-u ahi.
English: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.

tcz: Hitobang gaosapna hi nachung'uva umjing ding, melchihna le datmo umtah soh ding, nachi lhahteu chan geiya mangthei louva umjing ding ahi.
en: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.
text:
DEU 28:46
Thadou: Hitobang gaosapna hi nachung'uva umjing ding, melchihna le datmo umtah soh ding, nachi lhahteu chan geiya mangthei louva umjing ding ahi.
English: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.

tcz: Chuteng nangho thil hijat jouse chunga hin lungthim kipah in naum jou tahih uvin, Pakai, Pathen kin jeng jong bolding nago tapouve.
en: Because you didn’t serve the LORD your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;

tcz: Chule nangho gilkela naum diu, ponsil jeng jong nanei lou diu, thilse hijat chunga jong Pakaiyin namel mateu dinga ahinsol miho jenlea napan diu, naman thah kahseuva sohnam kihen oh nachun nakan chah diu ahi.
en: therefore you will serve your enemies whom the LORD sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.
text:
DEU 28:48
Thadou: Chule nangho gilkela naum diu, ponsil jeng jong nanei lou diu, thilse hijat chunga jong Pakaiyin namel mateu dinga ahinsol miho jenlea napan diu, naman thah kahseuva sohnam kihen oh nachun nakan chah diu ahi.
English: therefore you will serve your enemies whom the LORD sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

tcz: Hitia chu nangho toh kidou dinga Pakaiyin, leiset kol ning lam akon nam khat ahin puiya, muvanlai banga hung leng lut jeng diu, hiche nam mite pao chu het jong nahet phah lou diu,
en: The LORD will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,
text:
DEU 28:49
Thadou: Hitia chu nangho toh kidou dinga Pakaiyin, leiset kol ning lam akon nam khat ahin puiya, muvanlai banga hung leng lut jeng diu, hiche nam mite pao chu het jong nahet phah lou diu,
English: The LORD will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,

tcz: Hiche nam mite chu ahang san uvin, upa ho jong aging pouvin chule khangdong ho jong aging pouvin ahi.
en: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.
text:
DEU 28:50
Thadou: Hiche nam mite chu ahang san uvin, upa ho jong aging pouvin chule khangdong ho jong aging pouvin ahi.
English: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.

tcz: Amaho hin nagancha teu akitha diu, nasuh gep kahse uva abol diu, na chang jeng ujong themcha akhen lou diu, lengpithei leh thaotwi themcha jong akhen lou diu, nagan chateu ahin na kelngoinouteu ahin, aboncha asuh gamkah seuva amahon nachennau gamsung adalhah louhel diu ahi.
en: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.
text:
DEU 28:51
Thadou: Amaho hin nagancha teu akitha diu, nasuh gep kahse uva abol diu, na chang jeng ujong themcha akhen lou diu, lengpithei leh thaotwi themcha jong akhen lou diu, nagan chateu ahin na kelngoinouteu ahin, aboncha asuh gamkah seuva amahon nachennau gamsung adalhah louhel diu ahi.
English: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.

tcz: Na chennau gam na kisonpi namun'u khopi kul sangtah tah’a ki kaina mun ho, naum kim veluva avoh chim kah seuva ano khum diu, hitobanga chu Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gamsung khopi jousea ngengsi khong tading, tang louva na umkhum diu ahi.
en: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which the LORD your God has given you.
text:
DEU 28:52
Thadou: Na chennau gam na kisonpi namun'u khopi kul sangtah tah’a ki kaina mun ho, naum kim veluva avoh chim kah seuva ano khum diu, hitobanga chu Pakai, Pathen in napehnau gamsung khopi jousea ngengsi khong tading, tang louva na umkhum diu ahi.
English: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which the LORD your God has given you.

tcz: Nanghoa kon ahung pengdoh nachanuteu leh nachapateu aboncha Pakaiya kona gou thilpeh manlutah hijongleh, namel mateu'vin nahin umkhum uva nagim behseh tenguleh na kitha diu amaho chu anneh a nanei diu ahi.
en: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.
text:
DEU 28:53
Thadou: Nanghoa kon ahung pengdoh nachanuteu leh nachapateu aboncha Pakaiya kona gou thilpeh manlutah hijongleh, namel mateu'vin nahin umkhum uva nagim behseh tenguleh na kitha diu amaho chu anneh a nanei diu ahi.
English: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.

tcz: Nangho lah a milung neng ahin, ahongphal ahin, nasopi ahin, najinu hijongleh neh ding vetsahna a hung pang tading, nachateu lah uva athinu khah pen jong chu neh ki chupia hung pang ding ahi.
en: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,
text:
DEU 28:54
Thadou: Nangho lah a milung neng ahin, ahongphal ahin, nasopi ahin, najinu hijongleh neh ding vetsahna a hung pang tading, nachateu lah uva athinu khah pen jong chu neh ki chupia hung pang ding ahi.
English: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,

tcz: Mi phatah khat jong chun achate akithaa aneh teng, ama tahsa jeng jong chu hop ding agel louhel ding ahi. Ajeh chu namel mateu vin na khopi sung jouseu aumkimvel soh hel tauvin ahileh, nagim behseh jeng tauve.
en: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.
text:
DEU 28:55
Thadou: Mi phatah khat jong chun achate akithaa aneh teng, ama tahsa jeng jong chu hop ding agel louhel ding ahi. Ajeh chu namel mateu vin na khopi sung jouseu aumkimvel soh hel tauvin ahileh, nagim behseh jeng tauve.
English: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.

tcz: Chule numei chonnem tah le lungneng nu, achon nem behseh jeh a akeng khotaljum jeng jong tol chotsah nom louhel nu chun, ajipa le achanu leh achapte jeng jong akitha aneh ding ahi.
en: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,
text:
DEU 28:56
Thadou: Chule numei chonnem tah le lungneng nu, achon nem behseh jeh a akeng khotaljum jeng jong tol chotsah nom louhel nu chun, ajipa le achanu leh achapte jeng jong akitha aneh ding ahi.
English: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,

tcz: Hiche numei hochun, akal kah akona hung peng naosen chu akidop lhah a aneh jeng diu ahi. Ajeh chu namel mateu vin nasugim behseh tauvin, na umkhum sohhel tauvin ahileh, neh leh chah ijakai khat a khat jengcha jong muna nanei tapouve.
en: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.
text:
DEU 28:57
Thadou: Hiche numei hochun, akal kah akona hung peng naosen chu akidop lhah a aneh jeng diu ahi. Ajeh chu namel mateu vin nasugim behseh tauvin, na umkhum sohhel tauvin ahileh, neh leh chah ijakai khat a khat jengcha jong muna nanei tapouve.
English: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.

tcz: Hijeh chun hiche lekhabua danthu kijih jouse hi aboncha nanit bukimsoh keiyuva, limgeh chaa nakho sah lou'uva, Pakai, Pathen hi na kichat a najabol diu ahi.
en: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD your God,
text:
DEU 28:58
Thadou: Hijeh chun hiche lekhabua danthu kijih jouse hi aboncha nanit bukimsoh keiyuva, limgeh chaa nakho sah lou'uva, Pakai, Pathen hi na kichat a najabol diu ahi.
English: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD your God,

tcz: Achuti louva ahileh, Pakaiyin nachung'uva gim gentheina sangpen ahin lhunsah ding, hiche chung chona chu natna nasatah hung lhung ding tantih nei louva nadammo diu nachung'uva hichu ahin lhunsah ding ahi.
en: then the LORD will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.
text:
DEU 28:59
Thadou: Achuti louva ahileh, Pakaiyin nachung'uva gim gentheina sangpen ahin lhunsah ding, hiche chung chona chu natna nasatah hung lhung ding tantih nei louva nadammo diu nachung'uva hichu ahin lhunsah ding ahi.
English: then the LORD will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.

tcz: Egypt gamsunga nat thohlel naho jouse avela nachung'uva ahin lhunsah ding, tantih nei louva gim genthei nathoh diu ahi.
en: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.
text:
DEU 28:60
Thadou: Egypt gamsunga nat thohlel naho jouse avela nachung'uva ahin lhunsah ding, tantih nei louva gim genthei nathoh diu ahi.
English: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.

tcz: Nangho naki suh mang kahseava dinga danthua kijih lutlou natna jouse hi, Pakaiyin nachung'uva ahin lhunsah ding ahi.
en: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, the LORD will bring them on you until you are destroyed.
text:
DEU 28:61
Thadou: Nangho naki suh mang kahseava dinga danthua kijih lutlou natna jouse hi, Pakaiyin nachung'uva ahin lhunsah ding ahi.
English: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, the LORD will bring them on you until you are destroyed.

tcz: Nangho hapun in pungbe uvin lang, vanna ahsija pha jong leu chun, lhomcha bou nahi diu ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon Pakai, Pathen thusei nangai tapouve.
en: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.
text:
DEU 28:62
Thadou: Nangho hapun in pungbe uvin lang, vanna ahsija pha jong leu chun, lhomcha bou nahi diu ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon Pakai, Pathen thusei nangai tapouve.
English: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

tcz: Pakaiyin nachung'uva thilpha ahin lhunsah a alung oi ji bang’a, hitobang gimna ahung lhun teng jongleh lungoi ding ahi. Na chennau gamsunga kona nadel mang jeng diu ahi.
en: It will happen that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so the LORD will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.
text:
DEU 28:63
Thadou: Pakaiyin nachung'uva thilpha ahin lhunsah a alung oi ji bang’a, hitobang gimna ahung lhun teng jongleh lungoi ding ahi. Na chennau gamsunga kona nadel mang jeng diu ahi.
English: It will happen that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so the LORD will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.

tcz: Pakaiyin leiset kong ningli jousea nathe cheh jeng diu, napu napateu jeng in jong ahet khah louna mun, hiche muna chu milim semthu pathen nahou diu, akinbola nagapan diu ahi.
en: The LORD will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.
text:
DEU 28:64
Thadou: Pakaiyin leiset kong ningli jousea nathe cheh jeng diu, napu napateu jeng in jong ahet khah louna mun, hiche muna chu milim semthu pathen nahou diu, akinbola nagapan diu ahi.
English: The LORD will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.

tcz: Chule hiche munhoa chu namtin vaipi dimlha jeng ding, ong thol heuva nachen louhel diu, na keng khotal kisan'u kichol lou ding, nalungthim'u linglao tading, namit vet jeng ujong phamo tading, nahinkho jeng ujong genthei ding maonaa kichai ding ahi.
en: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but the LORD will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.
text:
DEU 28:65
Thadou: Chule hiche munhoa chu namtin vaipi dimlha jeng ding, ong thol heuva nachen louhel diu, na keng khotal kisan'u kichol lou ding, nalungthim'u linglao tading, namit vet jeng ujong phamo tading, nahinkho jeng ujong genthei ding maonaa kichai ding ahi.
English: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but the LORD will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.

tcz: Asun ajana kichatna jing hinkho naman diu, nahinkho sung'uva lungngam pela naum thei lou diu ahi.
en: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.
text:
DEU 28:66
Thadou: Asun ajana kichatna jing hinkho naman diu, nahinkho sung'uva lungngam pela naum thei lou diu ahi.
English: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.

tcz: Jingkah ahileh, O nilhah ka lhangai ta ngeiye, nilhah teng O, jingkah ka lhangai ta ngei! tia nasei diu, namit teniuva navet diu hichu kichatna jing in navop diu, hahsatna chun naum pi jing diu ahi.
en: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.
text:
DEU 28:67
Thadou: Jingkah ahileh, O nilhah ka lhangai ta ngeiye, nilhah teng O, jingkah ka lhangai ta ngei! tia nasei diu, namit teniuva navet diu hichu kichatna jing in navop diu, hahsatna chun naum pi jing diu ahi.
English: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.

tcz: Chujou tengleh Pakaiyin Egypt gam lama nahin lepui kit diu, kei man hiche lampi chu nale che kit lou diu ahi, tijong leng Pakaiyin nahin lepui kit diu, namel mateu angsunga soh numei chule soh pasala nagapan soh keidiu, hiche jouse nunga jong chu koiman nachoh nom lou diu ahi.
en: The LORD will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.
text:
DEU 28:68
Thadou: Chujou tengleh Pakaiyin Egypt gam lama nahin lepui kit diu, kei man hiche lampi chu nale che kit lou diu ahi, tijong leng Pakaiyin nahin lepui kit diu, namel mateu angsunga soh numei chule soh pasala nagapan soh keidiu, hiche jouse nunga jong chu koiman nachoh nom lou diu ahi.
English: The LORD will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.

tcz: Pakaiyin Horeb molchunga akitepna thu anasei, Moab gamsunga Israel mite henga Mose adin a thupeh kitepna asemho chu hi chengse hi ahi.
en: These are the words of the covenant which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
text:
DEU 29:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Horeb molchunga akitepna thu anasei, Moab gamsunga Israel mite henga Mose adin a thupeh kitepna asemho chu hi chengse hi ahi.
English: These are the words of the covenant which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

tcz: Chuin Mose’n Israel mi chan chu akou khomsoh keiyin aheng uvah thu aseitan ahi. Egypt gamsunga naum laiyuva Pakaiyin Pharaoh chunga ipi abola chuleh asohte ahin, agamsung pumpi abolna jouse namit tah uvin na musoh tauve.
en: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the LORD did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;

tcz: Nanghon melchihna leh Patepna tinchang tothoa, thil kidang tampi namit uva namu soh keiyu ahitai.
en: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.
text:
DEU 29:3
Thadou: Nanghon melchihna leh Patepna tinchang tothoa, thil kidang tampi namit uva namu soh keiyu ahitai.
English: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.

tcz: Ahinlah Pakayin tuni chan in, nangho jouse hetkhen theina lungthim nape hihlai uve.
en: But the LORD has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.
text:
DEU 29:4
Thadou: Ahinlah Pakayin tuni chan in, nangho jouse hetkhen theina lungthim nape hihlai uve.
English: But the LORD has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.

tcz: Keiman nangho gamthip noiya kum somli sungin kapui leuvin, natahsa chung uva ponsil kaijouse khat jeng cha jong aehpon, nakeng chut jeng ujong khat jeng cha asepon ahi.
en: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown old on your feet.
text:
DEU 29:5
Thadou: Keiman nangho gamthip noiya kum somli sungin kapui leuvin, natahsa chung uva ponsil kaijouse khat jeng cha jong aehpon, nakeng chut jeng ujong khat jeng cha asepon ahi.
English: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown old on your feet.

tcz: Keima hi nangho jouse Pakai, Pathen kahi nahetdoh thei na diuvin, nanghon changlhah nane pouvin, twi jong nadon pouvin, khamna thei kiti jong nadonkha pouvin ahi.
en: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am the LORD your God.
text:
DEU 29:6
Thadou: Keima hi nangho jouse Pakai, Pathen kahi nahetdoh thei na diuvin, nanghon changlhah nane pouvin, twi jong nadon pouvin, khamna thei kiti jong nadonkha pouvin ahi.
English: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am the LORD your God.

tcz: Ahinlah Hesbon lengpa Og chun kisatpi ding in eihin nailut tauvin ahileh, hikoma chun eihon jong amani chunga galjona chu inei tauve.
en: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.
text:
DEU 29:7
Thadou: Ahinlah Hesbon lengpa Og chun kisatpi ding in eihin nailut tauvin ahileh, hikoma chun eihon jong amani chunga galjona chu inei tauve.
English: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.

tcz: Chuin hiche teni gam chu ilahpeh tauvin, Reuben in gouva alo ding in agam keh khatset chu ipeuvin ahi.
en: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.
text:
DEU 29:8
Thadou: Chuin hiche teni gam chu ilahpeh tauvin, Reuben in gouva alo ding in agam keh khatset chu ipeuvin ahi.
English: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.

tcz: Chuti ahijeh chun hiche kitepna thudola kisei thudol hohi, aboncha nabol sohhel thei nadiu vin ching thei un, chutin bolleu chun na khut a nathil bol jouseu nakhan tou thei diu ahi.
en: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.
text:
DEU 29:9
Thadou: Chuti ahijeh chun hiche kitepna thudola kisei thudol hohi, aboncha nabol sohhel thei nadiu vin ching thei un, chutin bolleu chun na khut a nathil bol jouseu nakhan tou thei diu ahi.
English: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.

tcz: Tunia hi nangho nabon chauva Pakai, Pathen angsunga nadin soh keidiu ahi. Nangma phungkhai sung cheh akon lamkai, upa ho chule nalah uva vaihom ho jaona Israel mi kitiphot thonlouva pang ding ahi.
en: All of you stand today in the presence of the LORD your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,
text:
DEU 29:10
Thadou: Tunia hi nangho nabon chauva Pakai, Pathen angsunga nadin soh keidiu ahi. Nangma phungkhai sung cheh akon lamkai, upa ho chule nalah uva vaihom ho jaona Israel mi kitiphot thonlouva pang ding ahi.
English: All of you stand today in the presence of the LORD your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,

tcz: Numei chapang ho jouse, ngahmun a cheng khopem ho ahin, nathing poa pang ahin, natwi thala pang mi hi jongleh jao kimsoh kei ding ahi.
en: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,
text:
DEU 29:11
Thadou: Numei chapang ho jouse, ngahmun a cheng khopem ho ahin, nathing poa pang ahin, natwi thala pang mi hi jongleh jao kimsoh kei ding ahi.
English: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,

tcz: Nangman jong Pakai, Pathen kihahselna banga hitia chu nabol ding, tunin nangman Pakai, Pathen nangtoh asemna kitepna sunga hi nalut ding ahi.
en: that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, and into his oath, which the LORD your God makes with you today,
text:
DEU 29:12
Thadou: Nangman jong Pakai, Pathen kihahselna banga hitia chu nabol ding, tunin nangman Pakai, Pathen nangtoh asemna kitepna sunga hi nalut ding ahi.
English: that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, and into his oath, which the LORD your God makes with you today,

tcz: Ajeh chu hitia nabol tengleh, Pakaiyin nangma nam khat dinga natun doh ding, nangma koma asei dohsa leh napu, napa Abraham, Isaac, Jacob henga athutep banga nangma Pathen jong ahi.
en: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
text:
DEU 29:13
Thadou: Ajeh chu hitia nabol tengleh, Pakaiyin nangma nam khat dinga natun doh ding, nangma koma asei dohsa leh napu, napa Abraham, Isaac, Jacob henga athutep banga nangma Pathen jong ahi.
English: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

tcz: Hiche kitepna hi keiman nangho toh keima kikah dinga bou kasem ahipoi.
en: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,
text:
DEU 29:14
Thadou: Hiche kitepna hi keiman nangho toh keima kikah dinga bou kasem ahipoi.
English: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,

tcz: Tunin ilah uva jaolou hihen lang, Pakai, Pathen asunga umjouse dinga jong ki semdoh ahi.
en: but with those who stand here with us today before the LORD our God, and also with those who are not here with us today
text:
DEU 29:15
Thadou: Tunin ilah uva jaolou hihen lang, Pakai, Pathen asunga umjouse dinga jong ki semdoh ahi.
English: but with those who stand here with us today before the LORD our God, and also with those who are not here with us today

tcz: Egypt gamsunga ichenlai uva pat, namtin vaipi ijat hamkhat nahin pal galkai tauve, tihi na hesoh keiyun ahi.
en: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;

tcz: Hiche muna chu namtin vaipi thilbol thet um tahtah thing leh song’a ki sem milim doi jouse ahin, dangka leh sanaa kisem, hitobanga milim doi ki semthu jouse abonchan na mittah uvin namusoh tauve..
en: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);

tcz: Ajeh chu nalah uva pasal khat ham, numei khat ham, insung khat, namkhat chu alungthim ahei mang jenga hiche milimdoi ki semthu ho kinbola pang jeng thei ahi. Chule nalah uva kona thilse khat chu hung kondoh jeng thei ahin, thingga nehthei lou akha ahinsoh doh jeng ding ahi.
en: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from the LORD our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;

tcz: Mi khat touvin kitepna thu kisei doh chengse ahin jah doh a, ama leh ama kichoi sang nan nei ta henlang; alungthim sunga hiti hin sei jeng taleh, ka lungthim sunga louchal tah in thusei jong leng, ka thi lou ding ahi. Dangchah pet tah a twidon dinga aum laiya twijin alhoh banga, manthahna akibol doh teitei ding ahi.
en: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart,” to destroy the moist with the dry.
text:
DEU 29:19
Thadou: Mi khat touvin kitepna thu kisei doh chengse ahin jah doh a, ama leh ama kichoi sang nan nei ta henlang; alungthim sunga hiti hin sei jeng taleh, ka lungthim sunga louchal tah in thusei jong leng, ka thi lou ding ahi. Dangchah pet tah a twidon dinga aum laiya twijin alhoh banga, manthahna akibol doh teitei ding ahi.
English: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart,” to destroy the moist with the dry.

tcz: Hitobanga chon mihem chu Pakaiyin ngaidam achan lou ding, hitia doumah bol mihem chunga chu Pakai lunghang ding; danthu lekhabua kisun gaosapna jouse amapa chunga chu hung lhung jeng ding, chuteng Pakaiyin hichepa min chu vannoiya asuh manga avela umkit talou ding ahi.
en: The LORD will not pardon him, but then the LORD’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and the LORD will blot out his name from under the sky.
text:
DEU 29:20
Thadou: Hitobanga chon mihem chu Pakaiyin ngaidam achan lou ding, hitia doumah bol mihem chunga chu Pakai lunghang ding; danthu lekhabua kisun gaosapna jouse amapa chunga chu hung lhung jeng ding, chuteng Pakaiyin hichepa min chu vannoiya asuh manga avela umkit talou ding ahi.
English: The LORD will not pardon him, but then the LORD’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and the LORD will blot out his name from under the sky.

tcz: Danthu kisutna lekhabua kitepna chu leh gaosapna ki seidoh bang’a chu gaosapna achung’a lhung jeng ding, hi tia chon mihem chu Pakaiyin Israel mite lah akona apam paidoh jeng ding ahi.
en: The LORD will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.
text:
DEU 29:21
Thadou: Danthu kisutna lekhabua kitepna chu leh gaosapna ki seidoh bang’a chu gaosapna achung’a lhung jeng ding, hi tia chon mihem chu Pakaiyin Israel mite lah akona apam paidoh jeng ding ahi.
English: The LORD will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.

tcz: Ahung khanglen ding khangdong ho, nama banuva hung kipatdoh ding nachateu ahin, hetphah lou gam'a kona hung kholjin mi jaona Pakaiyin agimsah nau, gentheina chung nung hi amittah uva ahin musah tenguleh ahet them diu ahitai.
en: The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which the LORD has made it sick,
text:
DEU 29:22
Thadou: Ahung khanglen ding khangdong ho, nama banuva hung kipatdoh ding nachateu ahin, hetphah lou gam'a kona hung kholjin mi jaona Pakaiyin agimsah nau, gentheina chung nung hi amittah uva ahin musah tenguleh ahet them diu ahitai.
English: The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which the LORD has made it sick,

tcz: Gamsunga cheng jousen kat-song leh chilhang abah diu, muchi tuna lou mun jouse imacha keh talou ding, Sodom leh Gomorrah banga kile khup jenga, Admah leh Zeboiim banga Pakaiyin alunghan teng alekhup del tobang soh ding ahi.
en: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath.
text:
DEU 29:23
Thadou: Gamsunga cheng jousen kat-song leh chilhang abah diu, muchi tuna lou mun jouse imacha keh talou ding, Sodom leh Gomorrah banga kile khup jenga, Admah leh Zeboiim banga Pakaiyin alunghan teng alekhup del tobang soh ding ahi.
English: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath.

tcz: Namtin in hitia asei ding, ipi jeh pen tah’a Pakaiyin hiche gamsung hi hitia hi abol jeng hitam? Ipi jeh’a hiti loma hi lunghang ahidem? tia asei diu, tija sohkei diu ahi.
en: Even all the nations will say, “Why has the LORD done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”
text:
DEU 29:24
Thadou: Namtin in hitia asei ding, ipi jeh pen tah’a Pakaiyin hiche gamsung hi hitia hi abol jeng hitam? Ipi jeh’a hiti loma hi lunghang ahidem? tia asei diu, tija sohkei diu ahi.
English: Even all the nations will say, “Why has the LORD done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”

tcz: Chuteng leh mipin hitia hi asei diu, amaho hi Egypt gamsunga aum laiyuva apu, apate hou henga Pakaiyin athupeh angai lou jeh uva, hitobang hi achung'uva lhung ahi.
en: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,
text:
DEU 29:25
Thadou: Chuteng leh mipin hitia hi asei diu, amaho hi Egypt gamsunga aum laiyuva apu, apate hou henga Pakaiyin athupeh angai lou jeh uva, hitobang hi achung'uva lhung ahi.
English: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon pathen lim semthu kinbol len apang uvin, chibai aboh un, Pakaiyin abol diuva adeilou beh thil abol tauvin pathen limsem thu ahou un chule ahetkhah lou hel’u ahou tauvin ahileh, achung'uva hitobang thil khu lhung ahiye.
en: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.
text:
DEU 29:26
Thadou: Ajeh chu amahon pathen lim semthu kinbol len apang uvin, chibai aboh un, Pakaiyin abol diuva adeilou beh thil abol tauvin pathen limsem thu ahou un chule ahetkhah lou hel’u ahou tauvin ahileh, achung'uva hitobang thil khu lhung ahiye.
English: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.

tcz: Hijeh achu gamsunga Pakai lunghanna hung lhung jenga, hiche danthu lekhabua kisun gaosapna jouse hi hung lhung jeng ahitai.
en: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.
text:
DEU 29:27
Thadou: Hijeh achu gamsunga Pakai lunghanna hung lhung jenga, hiche danthu lekhabua kisun gaosapna jouse hi hung lhung jeng ahitai.
English: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen chu alunghang behseh jeng tan ahileh, hiche nam mite hi agam sunga kona apaidoh jenga, tulai din muna aum bang uva gamdangte khut’a apehdoh jeng ahi.
en: The LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”
text:
DEU 29:28
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen chu alunghang behseh jeng tan ahileh, hiche nam mite hi agam sunga kona apaidoh jenga, tulai din muna aum bang uva gamdangte khut’a apehdoh jeng ahi.
English: The LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”

tcz: Hichengse hin nahin lhun den jeng uva, ka seidohsa phattheina leh gaosapna ahin, Pakai, Pathen henga nacheuva hiche gamsunga chu nachen tenguleh, na lungthim uva nageldoh sohkei diu ahi.
en: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you,
text:
DEU 30:1
Thadou: Hichengse hin nahin lhun den jeng uva, ka seidohsa phattheina leh gaosapna ahin, Pakai, Pathen henga nacheuva hiche gamsunga chu nachen tenguleh, na lungthim uva nageldoh sohkei diu ahi.
English: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you,

tcz: Chuteng nanghon nahin nachateu chengse jaona a Pakai, Pathen henga na hung kile diu, tunia ka thupeh chengse hi Pakai awgin mong ahiti, kichihset a najah a nangai diu ahi.
en: and return to the LORD your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,
text:
DEU 30:2
Thadou: Chuteng nanghon nahin nachateu chengse jaona a Pakai, Pathen henga na hung kile diu, tunia ka thupeh chengse hi Pakai awgin mong ahiti, kichihset a najah a nangai diu ahi.
English: and return to the LORD your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in na phatthei nadiu lampi ahinsem ding, na chunguva lungsetna aumsah ding, Pakaiyin muntina nathe cheh nauva kona nahin suh khom kitdiu ahi.
en: that then the LORD your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you.
text:
DEU 30:3
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in na phatthei nadiu lampi ahinsem ding, na chunguva lungsetna aumsah ding, Pakaiyin muntina nathe cheh nauva kona nahin suh khom kitdiu ahi.
English: that then the LORD your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you.

tcz: Vannoi tin chenga kithe cheh jong leu chun, hiche muna kon chun Pakai, Pathen in nahin sukhom soh keiyun tin, khat jeng cha jong ki dalha louva na kisuh kimsel diu ahi.
en: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.
text:
DEU 30:4
Thadou: Vannoi tin chenga kithe cheh jong leu chun, hiche muna kon chun Pakai, Pathen in nahin sukhom soh keiyun tin, khat jeng cha jong ki dalha louva na kisuh kimsel diu ahi.
English: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in napu luiteu chenna muna chu nahin puilut diu, hiche muna chu chenna phatah nanei diu, Pakaiyin napu luiyu, napa luiteu sanga haosatna napeh diu, ha puna na punbe diu ahi.
en: The LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.
text:
DEU 30:5
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in napu luiteu chenna muna chu nahin puilut diu, hiche muna chu chenna phatah nanei diu, Pakaiyin napu luiyu, napa luiteu sanga haosatna napeh diu, ha puna na punbe diu ahi.
English: The LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in nangho leh nachilhahteu lungthim sunga chep atan ding, chuteng Pakai, Pathen chu na lungthim sung pumpiuva na ngailut diu chule na hebol diu ahi.
en: The LORD your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.
text:
DEU 30:6
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in nangho leh nachilhahteu lungthim sunga chep atan ding, chuteng Pakai, Pathen chu na lungthim sung pumpiuva na ngailut diu chule na hebol diu ahi.
English: The LORD your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.

tcz: Chule Pakai, Pathen in nangho sugentheiya pang galmite chunga, gaosapna hichengse hi aboncha alhunsah ding ahi.
en: The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.
text:
DEU 30:7
Thadou: Chule Pakai, Pathen in nangho sugentheiya pang galmite chunga, gaosapna hichengse hi aboncha alhunsah ding ahi.
English: The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.

tcz: Chuni tengleh nanghon avela Pakai awgin na ngaiyuva, Pakaiya kona thupeh keiman ka pehson chengse aboncha na nitsoh kei diu ahi.
en: You shall return and obey the LORD’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.
text:
DEU 30:8
Thadou: Chuni tengleh nanghon avela Pakai awgin na ngaiyuva, Pakaiya kona thupeh keiman ka pehson chengse aboncha na nitsoh kei diu ahi.
English: You shall return and obey the LORD’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.

tcz: Nangho Pakai, Pathen in nabol natohna jouseu natha hatsah diu, na haodoh sah jeng diu, na chilhahteu ahin, na ganchateu ahin, thalhing soh kei diu ahi. Ajeh chu napu luiteu ahaosat uva akipa bang uva, Pakaiyin nangho na haosah'uva nakipa diu chu adeisah ahi.
en: The LORD your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for the LORD will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,
text:
DEU 30:9
Thadou: Nangho Pakai, Pathen in nabol natohna jouseu natha hatsah diu, na haodoh sah jeng diu, na chilhahteu ahin, na ganchateu ahin, thalhing soh kei diu ahi. Ajeh chu napu luiteu ahaosat uva akipa bang uva, Pakaiyin nangho na haosah'uva nakipa diu chu adeisah ahi.
English: The LORD your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for the LORD will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,

tcz: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen thupeh chengse hi na ngaiyuva, achonna jouse, danthu lekhabua kisun jouse hi nanit soh keiyuva, na chilhahteu ahin, na ganchateu ahin, na theiga hou jong aboncha bulhing sel ding ahi. Ajeh chu napu luiyu, napa luiteu ahao banga nangho jong na haosat uva Pakai, Pathen henga na hung kihei lut diu ahi.
en: if you will obey the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
text:
DEU 30:10
Thadou: Nanghon Pakai, Pathen thupeh chengse hi na ngaiyuva, achonna jouse, danthu lekhabua kisun jouse hi nanit soh keiyuva, na chilhahteu ahin, na ganchateu ahin, na theiga hou jong aboncha bulhing sel ding ahi. Ajeh chu napu luiyu, napa luiteu ahao banga nangho jong na haosat uva Pakai, Pathen henga na hung kihei lut diu ahi.
English: if you will obey the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

tcz: Ajeh chu tunia ka thupeh chengse hi thil hahsa tah leh, jui hah ding ahipoi.
en: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.
text:
DEU 30:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu tunia ka thupeh chengse hi thil hahsa tah leh, jui hah ding ahipoi.
English: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.

tcz: Chule hiche hi vana aum in, nanghon ijah uva iboldoh na diuvin, koiham vana kal touva thuchin eihin poh peh diu ham tinjong seihih un.
en: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
text:
DEU 30:12
Thadou: Chule hiche hi vana aum in, nanghon ijah uva iboldoh na diuvin, koiham vana kal touva thuchin eihin poh peh diu ham tinjong seihih un.
English: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

tcz: Nanghon hiche hi twikhanglen gala uma, koipen ham ilah uva galkaiya thuchin eihin poh peh diu ham? tiajong na sei lou diu ahi.
en: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
text:
DEU 30:13
Thadou: Nanghon hiche hi twikhanglen gala uma, koipen ham ilah uva galkaiya thuchin eihin poh peh diu ham? tiajong na sei lou diu ahi.
English: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

tcz: Hichengse hi gamla tah a aumpon, na lungthim uleh na kam sung'uva bou um ahi. Hitobang hi nanghon nabol doh diu mong ahi.
en: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.
text:
DEU 30:14
Thadou: Hichengse hi gamla tah a aumpon, na lungthim uleh na kam sung'uva bou um ahi. Hitobang hi nanghon nabol doh diu mong ahi.
English: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.

tcz: Vetan, keiman na masang lam'uva hinna leh thilpha kakoi in, thina leh thilse jong ka koipeh uve.
en: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.
text:
DEU 30:15
Thadou: Vetan, keiman na masang lam'uva hinna leh thilpha kakoi in, thina leh thilse jong ka koipeh uve.
English: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.

tcz: Pakai, Pathen in na thupeh chengseu keiman ka seidoh peh hohi nanit soh keiyuva, Pakai, Pathen na ngailut uva, Ama lamlhah jenga bou nalam lhah uva, Ama thupeh chengse leh achonna dan jouse na nitsoh keijyuva ahileh, nangho na pun diu, chule tua na jot lutna diu gam sunga khu phattheina lhingset na chan diu ahi.
en: For I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that the LORD your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.
text:
DEU 30:16
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen in na thupeh chengseu keiman ka seidoh peh hohi nanit soh keiyuva, Pakai, Pathen na ngailut uva, Ama lamlhah jenga bou nalam lhah uva, Ama thupeh chengse leh achonna dan jouse na nitsoh keijyuva ahileh, nangho na pun diu, chule tua na jot lutna diu gam sunga khu phattheina lhingset na chan diu ahi.
English: For I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that the LORD your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.

tcz: Ahinlah na lungthim'uva na kihei mang jeng uva, Pakai thupeh chengse nahsah moa na um-uva ahileh, pathen lim semthu chibai boh midang toh na che khah uva, hiche ho chu na jen leava ahileh,
en: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,
text:
DEU 30:17
Thadou: Ahinlah na lungthim'uva na kihei mang jeng uva, Pakai thupeh chengse nahsah moa na um-uva ahileh, pathen lim semthu chibai boh midang toh na che khah uva, hiche ho chu na jen leava ahileh,
English: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,

tcz: Tunia hi na jah uva ka seipeh nahiuve, nangho na bonchauva manthah nan nalhun den diu ahi. Jordan vadung galkaiya chenna dinga na che lutna diu muna khu, iti nama jongleh na chensot lou diu ahi.
en: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.
text:
DEU 30:18
Thadou: Tunia hi na jah uva ka seipeh nahiuve, nangho na bonchauva manthah nan nalhun den diu ahi. Jordan vadung galkaiya chenna dinga na che lutna diu muna khu, iti nama jongleh na chensot lou diu ahi.
English: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.

tcz: Tunin keiman nangho douna hettohsah na ding in van leh lei kakou khom in, ajeh chu na masang lam'uva hinna leh thina ka koipeh un, phatthei na leh gaosapna jong ka koipeh un ahi. Hijeh chun tunin hinna hi kilhen unlang nason na chilhah jeng ujong hinna chang diu ahi.
en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,
text:
DEU 30:19
Thadou: Tunin keiman nangho douna hettohsah na ding in van leh lei kakou khom in, ajeh chu na masang lam'uva hinna leh thina ka koipeh un, phatthei na leh gaosapna jong ka koipeh un ahi. Hijeh chun tunin hinna hi kilhen unlang nason na chilhah jeng ujong hinna chang diu ahi.
English: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,

tcz: Pakai, Pathen ngailutna neiyun lang, athupeh chengse nit jing un, ama jenga kingai leu chun thilpha ahi. Ajeh chu nangho dinga hinna leh hinkho sotna ahin, chuteng Pakaiyin napu luiyu Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob henga aki hahsel a, amaho peh dinga ana kitepna gam sunga khu nangho na chen diu ahi.
en: to love the LORD your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
text:
DEU 30:20
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen ngailutna neiyun lang, athupeh chengse nit jing un, ama jenga kingai leu chun thilpha ahi. Ajeh chu nangho dinga hinna leh hinkho sotna ahin, chuteng Pakaiyin napu luiyu Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob henga aki hahsel a, amaho peh dinga ana kitepna gam sunga khu nangho na chen diu ahi.
English: to love the LORD your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

tcz: Chuin Mose’n Israel mite henga, thuhi chengse hi asei peh in ahi.
en: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.
text:
DEU 31:1
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n Israel mite henga, thuhi chengse hi asei peh in ahi.
English: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

tcz: Ajah uvah hiti hin aseiye, tunin keima kum jakhat leh kum somni ka lhing tai, ajeh chu keima che le vale kabol tahlou ding hichu Pakaiyin ka henga aseiyin, nangman hiche Jordan hi nagal kai thei lou ding ahi, ati.
en: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. The LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’
text:
DEU 31:2
Thadou: Ajah uvah hiti hin aseiye, tunin keima kum jakhat leh kum somni ka lhing tai, ajeh chu keima che le vale kabol tahlou ding hichu Pakaiyin ka henga aseiyin, nangman hiche Jordan hi nagal kai thei lou ding ahi, ati.
English: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. The LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’

tcz: Pakai, Pathen chu nama sang lam'uva che ding, Aman nalam kai diu nama sang lam'uva namtin vaipi hijat pi hi asuh mang jeng ding, nama sang'uva nam mite hon chenna ding gam anei lou diu ahi. Pakai thupeh banga Joshua in nalam kai lhung diu ahi.
en: The LORD your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as the LORD has spoken.
text:
DEU 31:3
Thadou: Pakai, Pathen chu nama sang lam'uva che ding, Aman nalam kai diu nama sang lam'uva namtin vaipi hijat pi hi asuh mang jeng ding, nama sang'uva nam mite hon chenna ding gam anei lou diu ahi. Pakai thupeh banga Joshua in nalam kai lhung diu ahi.
English: The LORD your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as the LORD has spoken.

tcz: Hiche nam tin vaipi khu jat chunga khu, Pakaiyin Amor mite lah a leng teni Sihon leh Og abolna bang banga asuh mang diu ahi.
en: The LORD will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.
text:
DEU 31:4
Thadou: Hiche nam tin vaipi khu jat chunga khu, Pakaiyin Amor mite lah a leng teni Sihon leh Og abolna bang banga asuh mang diu ahi.
English: The LORD will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.

tcz: Pakaiyin amaho jouse khu nangho khut a ahin pehdoh ding, chuteng keiman ka thupeh banga hi nabol diu ahi.
en: The LORD will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.
text:
DEU 31:5
Thadou: Pakaiyin amaho jouse khu nangho khut a ahin pehdoh ding, chuteng keiman ka thupeh banga hi nabol diu ahi.
English: The LORD will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.

tcz: Kichatna ima nanei thei lou diu, chule nahat uva nahansan diu, ging lou hela naum diu ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon na kilhon piu hi Pakai, Pathen ahijing in, Pakaiyin na umpi jing uvin nada lhah louhel diu ahi.
en: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
text:
DEU 31:6
Thadou: Kichatna ima nanei thei lou diu, chule nahat uva nahansan diu, ging lou hela naum diu ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon na kilhon piu hi Pakai, Pathen ahijing in, Pakaiyin na umpi jing uvin nada lhah louhel diu ahi.
English: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

tcz: Chuin Mose’n jong Joshua akouvin Israel mite jouse mitmun aheng’a hiti hin aseipeh tai. Hat unlang hangsan uvn, mipi hijat hi napuiyuva Pakaiyin apu apateu khanga akitepna gamsung’a na puilut diu, amaho hi hiche gam sunga chu nachen sah a agam pumpi nalo sah tei diu ahi.
en: Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land which the LORD has sworn to their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.
text:
DEU 31:7
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n jong Joshua akouvin Israel mite jouse mitmun aheng’a hiti hin aseipeh tai. Hat unlang hangsan uvn, mipi hijat hi napuiyuva Pakaiyin apu apateu khanga akitepna gamsung’a na puilut diu, amaho hi hiche gam sunga chu nachen sah a agam pumpi nalo sah tei diu ahi.
English: Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land which the LORD has sworn to their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.

tcz: Na masang lam'uva lamkai hi Pakai bou ahin, aman nalhonpi jing un, dalha louva ijakai asuh bukim soh ding, hiche miho chunga khu kichatna nanei lou diu, lungthoi louhela naum jing diu ahi.
en: The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”
text:
DEU 31:8
Thadou: Na masang lam'uva lamkai hi Pakai bou ahin, aman nalhonpi jing un, dalha louva ijakai asuh bukim soh ding, hiche miho chunga khu kichatna nanei lou diu, lungthoi louhela naum jing diu ahi.
English: The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”

tcz: Chuin Mose’n danthu chu asundoh in, danthu lekhabu chu Levi chapate Pakai thingkong pua pangho chengse chu abonchan ape soh keiyin ahi.
en: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.
text:
DEU 31:9
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n danthu chu asundoh in, danthu lekhabu chu Levi chapate Pakai thingkong pua pangho chengse chu abonchan ape soh keiyin ahi.
English: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.

tcz: Mose’n amaho chengse chu thu apen hiti hin aseiye. Kum sagi ahung kichaiya, ki lhadohna phat ahung lhin teng, hichu lhambuh kut bolphat toh kitoh ding ahi.
en: Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths,
text:
DEU 31:10
Thadou: Mose’n amaho chengse chu thu apen hiti hin aseiye. Kum sagi ahung kichaiya, ki lhadohna phat ahung lhin teng, hichu lhambuh kut bolphat toh kitoh ding ahi.
English: Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths,

tcz: Israel mite hi Pakai, Pathen in adeilhen namuna chu ahung kilah tengleh, Israel mite jouse jah dinga hiche danthu lekhabu hi nasem doh ding ahi.
en: when all Israel has come to appear before the LORD your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
text:
DEU 31:11
Thadou: Israel mite hi Pakai, Pathen in adeilhen namuna chu ahung kilah tengleh, Israel mite jouse jah dinga hiche danthu lekhabu hi nasem doh ding ahi.
English: when all Israel has come to appear before the LORD your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

tcz: Mipi ho chu nakhop kimsoh kei ding, pasal ahin, numei ahin, ajahsoh kei diu Pakai, Pathen gindan ahet them cheh diu, hiche danthua ki sei jouse aboldoh sohkei na diuva nathu mop cheh diu ahi.
en: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,
text:
DEU 31:12
Thadou: Mipi ho chu nakhop kimsoh kei ding, pasal ahin, numei ahin, ajahsoh kei diu Pakai, Pathen gindan ahet them cheh diu, hiche danthua ki sei jouse aboldoh sohkei na diuva nathu mop cheh diu ahi.
English: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,

tcz: Ajakha loulai achilhahte geiyin ajah theina ding in, Jordan galkaiya hiche gamsung nalut tenguleh hichengse hi nachate hou nahil jing diu ahi.
en: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”
text:
DEU 31:13
Thadou: Ajakha loulai achilhahte geiyin ajah theina ding in, Jordan galkaiya hiche gamsung nalut tenguleh hichengse hi nachate hou nahil jing diu ahi.
English: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin, nathi nading nikho ahung naitai, Joshua henga seiyin lang ponbuh sunga hung lut lhon in, chutengleh keiman Joshua hi tha kapeh kit ding ahi. Hiti chun Mose leh Joshua jong achelhon in, ponbuh sunga chun aga lut lhon tan ahi.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him.” Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting.
text:
DEU 31:14
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose henga aseiyin, nathi nading nikho ahung naitai, Joshua henga seiyin lang ponbuh sunga hung lut lhon in, chutengleh keiman Joshua hi tha kapeh kit ding ahi. Hiti chun Mose leh Joshua jong achelhon in, ponbuh sunga chun aga lut lhon tan ahi.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him.” Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Chutah chun Pakai chu ponbuh sunga meibang lom bang in ahung kilah in ahung kitung tan ahi. Hiti chun meibang lom chu ponbuh kotpi phung achun khom bang in akitung tan ahi.
en: The LORD appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.
text:
DEU 31:15
Thadou: Chutah chun Pakai chu ponbuh sunga meibang lom bang in ahung kilah in ahung kitung tan ahi. Hiti chun meibang lom chu ponbuh kotpi phung achun khom bang in akitung tan ahi.
English: The LORD appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin, Mose henga aseiyin, ven! Nangma napu, napate toh nalup khom nading phat ahung naitai. Nangma nung tengleh hiche mite hi abonchauva ahet phah lou nau gamsung ahin chot lut diu, pathen lim semthu nung ahinjui uva, notiho lah a vahlut gamdiu, keima umna jeng jong hepha louva umdiu, keima toh kitepna kasem jeng jong asuh keh hel diu ahi.
en: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them, and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them.
text:
DEU 31:16
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin, Mose henga aseiyin, ven! Nangma napu, napate toh nalup khom nading phat ahung naitai. Nangma nung tengleh hiche mite hi abonchauva ahet phah lou nau gamsung ahin chot lut diu, pathen lim semthu nung ahinjui uva, notiho lah a vahlut gamdiu, keima umna jeng jong hepha louva umdiu, keima toh kitepna kasem jeng jong asuh keh hel diu ahi.
English: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them, and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them.

tcz: Chutia achon ni tenguleh keima lunghanna achung'uva hung soudoh jeng ding, keiman jong amaho kanung ngat jeng ding, chuteng mihon amaho abah gam jeng diu, thilse tincheng le hesoh gentheinan abop diu, eiho Pathen in ei umpi lou phat uva thilse hijatpi hi eiho chunga hung lhung jeng ahitai, tia asei diu ahi.
en: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come on them; so that they will say in that day, ‘Haven’t these evils come on us because our God is not among us?’
text:
DEU 31:17
Thadou: Chutia achon ni tenguleh keima lunghanna achung'uva hung soudoh jeng ding, keiman jong amaho kanung ngat jeng ding, chuteng mihon amaho abah gam jeng diu, thilse tincheng le hesoh gentheinan abop diu, eiho Pathen in ei umpi lou phat uva thilse hijatpi hi eiho chunga hung lhung jeng ahitai, tia asei diu ahi.
English: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come on them; so that they will say in that day, ‘Haven’t these evils come on us because our God is not among us?’

tcz: Hitia thil ahin bol niteng uleh keiman jong ama hoa kona kamai kasel manga ka nung sun diu, ajeh chu amaho hin pathen semthu ho abel gam tauvin ahi.
en: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.
text:
DEU 31:18
Thadou: Hitia thil ahin bol niteng uleh keiman jong ama hoa kona kamai kasel manga ka nung sun diu, ajeh chu amaho hin pathen semthu ho abel gam tauvin ahi.
English: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.

tcz: Tun nanghon hichengse sun doh unlang, Israel mite henga nahil them diu ahi. Hiche hi Israel mite douna keima hettoh sahna apang jing din akam sung uvah mop soh keiyun.
en: “Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
text:
DEU 31:19
Thadou: Tun nanghon hichengse sun doh unlang, Israel mite henga nahil them diu ahi. Hiche hi Israel mite douna keima hettoh sahna apang jing din akam sung uvah mop soh keiyun.
English: “Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

tcz: Ajeh chu apu, apate hou peh dinga ka kihahselna gamsung khoiju leh bongnoi lonna gam sunga ka hinpui lut phat uvin, anomsa gam tauvin, tun akihei mang gamsoh keiyun pathen chom chom abel tauvin, hiche ho kinbol in apang un, keima don louvin eikoi tauvin ahi.
en: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.
text:
DEU 31:20
Thadou: Ajeh chu apu, apate hou peh dinga ka kihahselna gamsung khoiju leh bongnoi lonna gam sunga ka hinpui lut phat uvin, anomsa gam tauvin, tun akihei mang gamsoh keiyun pathen chom chom abel tauvin, hiche ho kinbol in apang un, keima don louvin eikoi tauvin ahi.
English: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.

tcz: Thilse tincheng in ahin lhun den diu, hiche la hi amaho dinga hettohsanaa hung pang jing ding ahi. Hiche la hi haimil louhela achilhahteu khangeiya achin jing diu, ajeh chu keiman katepna gam sunga kahin puilut masang uva alunggel ngaitou ijakai ka hetsoh ahitai.
en: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”
text:
DEU 31:21
Thadou: Thilse tincheng in ahin lhun den diu, hiche la hi amaho dinga hettohsanaa hung pang jing ding ahi. Hiche la hi haimil louhela achilhahteu khangeiya achin jing diu, ajeh chu keiman katepna gam sunga kahin puilut masang uva alunggel ngaitou ijakai ka hetsoh ahitai.
English: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”

tcz: Chuin Mose’n jong hiche nikho mama chun la chu asundoh in, Israel mite jouse ahilthem soh keiyin ahi.
en: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.
text:
DEU 31:22
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n jong hiche nikho mama chun la chu asundoh in, Israel mite jouse ahilthem soh keiyin ahi.
