English: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.

tcz: Pakaiyin, Nun chapa Joshua tha apen ahenga hiti hin asei peh e. Hat jing in, hangsan jing in, ajeh chu nangman Israel chate jouse ka kitepna gam sunga khu nahin puilut ding, kei man ka umpi jing nai, ati.
en: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”
text:
DEU 31:23
Thadou: Pakaiyin, Nun chapa Joshua tha apen ahenga hiti hin asei peh e. Hat jing in, hangsan jing in, ajeh chu nangman Israel chate jouse ka kitepna gam sunga khu nahin puilut ding, kei man ka umpi jing nai, ati.
English: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”

tcz: Mose’n jong hiche danthu chengse chu abonchan asundoh soh keiyin, achaina geiyin asundoh soh keiyin ahi.
en: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
text:
DEU 31:24
Thadou: Mose’n jong hiche danthu chengse chu abonchan asundoh soh keiyin, achaina geiyin asundoh soh keiyin ahi.
English: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

tcz: Chuin Mose’n Pakai kitepna thingkong pua pang, Levi mite henga hiti hin aseipeh tauve.
en: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, saying,
text:
DEU 31:25
Thadou: Chuin Mose’n Pakai kitepna thingkong pua pang, Levi mite henga hiti hin aseipeh tauve.
English: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, saying,

tcz: Hiche danthu lekhabu hi, Pakai kitepna thing kong sunga chun koijun, hiche hi nangho douna hettoh sahnaa pang jing ding ahi.
en: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of the LORD your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.
text:
DEU 31:26
Thadou: Hiche danthu lekhabu hi, Pakai kitepna thing kong sunga chun koijun, hiche hi nangho douna hettoh sahnaa pang jing ding ahi.
English: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of the LORD your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.

tcz: Ajeh chu doumah mah in nachon in, nalou chal e tijong kahen, tun vevin, nangho toh kaum jing in jong Pakai doumah tampi nabol un, ka thi nung le ijat nabolbe diu hitam!
en: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against the LORD. How much more after my death?
text:
DEU 31:27
Thadou: Ajeh chu doumah mah in nachon in, nalou chal e tijong kahen, tun vevin, nangho toh kaum jing in jong Pakai doumah tampi nabol un, ka thi nung le ijat nabolbe diu hitam!
English: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against the LORD. How much more after my death?

tcz: Nalah uva upa ho jouse na phung kailhah cheh uva kon in ka henga hinsol tauvin, nalah uva vaihoma pangho jong hinkou khom unlang, thu hijat chengse hi aheng uva ka seipeh ding, amaho douna hettohsana apang dinga van leh leiset kakou khom ding ahi.
en: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
text:
DEU 31:28
Thadou: Nalah uva upa ho jouse na phung kailhah cheh uva kon in ka henga hinsol tauvin, nalah uva vaihoma pangho jong hinkou khom unlang, thu hijat chengse hi aheng uva ka seipeh ding, amaho douna hettohsana apang dinga van leh leiset kakou khom ding ahi.
English: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima thi nung teng melse tah tah a nachon diu, ka thupeh jousea kona na kihei manghel diu ahiti, ka hesoh keiyin, akhon nileh nachung uva thilse hung lhung ding, Pakai mit mua thilse jeng nahin bol diu, nakhut chaloh danu ijakaiya kona Pakai lunghanna na chung uva hung lhung ding ahi.
en: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will happen to you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.”
text:
DEU 31:29
Thadou: Ajeh chu keima thi nung teng melse tah tah a nachon diu, ka thupeh jousea kona na kihei manghel diu ahiti, ka hesoh keiyin, akhon nileh nachung uva thilse hung lhung ding, Pakai mit mua thilse jeng nahin bol diu, nakhut chaloh danu ijakaiya kona Pakai lunghanna na chung uva hung lhung ding ahi.
English: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will happen to you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.”

tcz: Mose’n jong hiche la chu Israel mite jouse nabenga ahetsah tan ahi.
en: Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.
text:
DEU 31:30
Thadou: Mose’n jong hiche la chu Israel mite jouse nabenga ahetsah tan ahi.
English: Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.

tcz: Vannoi leiset pumpin ngaiyun, ajeh chu keiman naheng uva hiche thuhi ka seiyin ahi. Keima kam sunga kona thu kisei hi leiset pumpin ngaisoh keiyun.
en: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
text:
DEU 32:1
Thadou: Vannoi leiset pumpin ngaiyun, ajeh chu keiman naheng uva hiche thuhi ka seiyin ahi. Keima kam sunga kona thu kisei hi leiset pumpin ngaisoh keiyun.
English: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

tcz: Keiman nangho jah ding’a ka sei hi goju bang jeng hen, chule ka thusei jong daitwi bang in kai jeng hen, hampa lah gotwi nel bang in kai hen, hamhing lah a gotwiju bang in hung hen, ati.
en: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.
text:
DEU 32:2
Thadou: Keiman nangho jah ding’a ka sei hi goju bang jeng hen, chule ka thusei jong daitwi bang in kai jeng hen, hampa lah gotwi nel bang in kai hen, hamhing lah a gotwiju bang in hung hen, ati.
English: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman Pakai min ka sam jal jeng in, O Pathen alen tangeiye, tin sam cheh uhen!
en: For I will proclaim the LORD’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!
text:
DEU 32:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman Pakai min ka sam jal jeng in, O Pathen alen tangeiye, tin sam cheh uhen!
English: For I will proclaim the LORD’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!

tcz: Pathen hi songpi ahin, athilbol achamkim tangeiye. Ajeh chu alamlhah aboncha thudih jeng ahin, temmona imacha umlou leh kitahna dim jeng ahin, a kitah le adihna jeng ahi.
en: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
text:
DEU 32:4
Thadou: Pathen hi songpi ahin, athilbol achamkim tangeiye. Ajeh chu alamlhah aboncha thudih jeng ahin, temmona imacha umlou leh kitahna dim jeng ahin, a kitah le adihna jeng ahi.
English: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.

tcz: Hiche mitehon vang Ama hi a lam louvin abol'un, abonchauvin achate hi khalou tobang asoh tauvin, ajeh chu abonchauva nolna jeng ahiuvin, khang lamvaitah le lungput gih tah ahiuve.
en: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.
text:
DEU 32:5
Thadou: Hiche mitehon vang Ama hi a lam louvin abol'un, abonchauvin achate hi khalou tobang asoh tauvin, ajeh chu abonchauva nolna jeng ahiuvin, khang lamvaitah le lungput gih tah ahiuve.
English: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.

tcz: Hitobanga chu Pakai hi lethuhna nei ding nagot uham, vo lungthim beiho, angol gam'a na hitauve! Ama hi nasempa, na Pathen hilou ham? Nangho sema tungdoh achu koi ham?
en: Is this the way you repay the LORD, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.
text:
DEU 32:6
Thadou: Hitobanga chu Pakai hi lethuhna nei ding nagot uham, vo lungthim beiho, angol gam'a na hitauve! Ama hi nasempa, na Pathen hilou ham? Nangho sema tungdoh achu koi ham?
English: Is this the way you repay the LORD, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.

tcz: Nikho masa lai chu geldoh in, kum masa laiya khang tamtah jong chu geldoh in, napa chu kidoh un aman nahil chen soh kei diu, na upate hou dong leu chun ama hon nahil diu ahi.
en: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.
text:
DEU 32:7
Thadou: Nikho masa lai chu geldoh in, kum masa laiya khang tamtah jong chu geldoh in, napa chu kidoh un aman nahil chen soh kei diu, na upate hou dong leu chun ama hon nahil diu ahi.
English: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.

tcz: Hatchungnung pen in nampi goulo ahop peh chun, Aman mihem chate alheng khen soh keiyin. Israel mite atam leh alhom dungjuiyin gamgi anasat khen pehsoh keiyin ahi.
en: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.
text:
DEU 32:8
Thadou: Hatchungnung pen in nampi goulo ahop peh chun, Aman mihem chate alheng khen soh keiyin. Israel mite atam leh alhom dungjuiyin gamgi anasat khen pehsoh keiyin ahi.
English: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai chan chu amite chan ding ahin, Jacob hi ama chan ding hichu agoulo ding mong ahi.
en: For the LORD’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
text:
DEU 32:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakai chan chu amite chan ding ahin, Jacob hi ama chan ding hichu agoulo ding mong ahi.
English: For the LORD’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

tcz: Jacob chu gamthip laiya akimu in, gam mang thim lah a ki mudoh ahi. Pakaiyin amahi aveng tup jing in, khohsahna anei jing in, hiti chun amitmu jenga khohsahna lhingsel aneiyin ahi.
en: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.
text:
DEU 32:10
Thadou: Jacob chu gamthip laiya akimu in, gam mang thim lah a ki mudoh ahi. Pakaiyin amahi aveng tup jing in, khohsahna anei jing in, hiti chun amitmu jenga khohsahna lhingsel aneiyin ahi.
English: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.

tcz: Muvanlai in abu avil jinga, abu sunga anoute avet lhih jing bang in ave lhih jing in ahi. Jacob hi kolchah jing ding in alhaving ajah dohjin, alhaving’a Jacob hi apo le jin ahi.
en: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.
text:
DEU 32:11
Thadou: Muvanlai in abu avil jinga, abu sunga anoute avet lhih jing bang in ave lhih jing in ahi. Jacob hi kolchah jing ding in alhaving ajah dohjin, alhaving’a Jacob hi apo le jin ahi.
English: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.

tcz: Pakai ama tah in ahin pui len, Jacob in aki voppi chu pathen dang ahipoi.
en: The LORD alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.
text:
DEU 32:12
Thadou: Pakai ama tah in ahin pui len, Jacob in aki voppi chu pathen dang ahipoi.
English: The LORD alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.

tcz: Pakaiyin ama chu leiset chung mun sang lai laiya atousah jin, aman jong lhosohga akilo jin ane jin ahi. Songpia kon in khoiju achepsah jin, meituh song akon in jong thaotwi apot dohsah jin ahi.
en: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;

tcz: Bonghon lah akon in bongnoi apen, kelngoi hon lah akon in noitwi apejin, kelngoite ahin kelngoi chalte abonchan thaotwi in avah va jin, Bashan phaichama bonghon leh kelchan avah jin ahi. Suhlou chang leh lengpitwi chu nadon jin ahi.
en: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.
text:
DEU 32:14
Thadou: Bonghon lah akon in bongnoi apen, kelngoi hon lah akon in noitwi apejin, kelngoite ahin kelngoi chalte abonchan thaotwi in avah va jin, Bashan phaichama bonghon leh kelchan avah jin ahi. Suhlou chang leh lengpitwi chu nadon jin ahi.
English: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.

tcz: Jeshurun chu ahung thaobehseh tan ahileh, akeng in athai mang mang in, nang jong nathao behseh tan nanoi gei gol jong achop lha jeng tan, Chuin asempa Pathen jeng jong asumil lotan, Ahuhhingpu Pathen jeng jong chu tot chavei nan aneitan ahi.
en: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.
text:
DEU 32:15
Thadou: Jeshurun chu ahung thaobehseh tan ahileh, akeng in athai mang mang in, nang jong nathao behseh tan nanoi gei gol jong achop lha jeng tan, Chuin asempa Pathen jeng jong asumil lotan, Ahuhhingpu Pathen jeng jong chu tot chavei nan aneitan ahi.
English: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.

tcz: Hetphah lou pathen kin abol jeh uchun asu lung hang tauvin, chondan thet umtah tah abol'un, Pakai chu aphin lunghang tauve.
en: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.
text:
DEU 32:16
Thadou: Hetphah lou pathen kin abol jeh uchun asu lung hang tauvin, chondan thet umtah tah abol'un, Pakai chu aphin lunghang tauve.
English: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.

tcz: Pathen hilou thilha ho henga kilhaina asem uvin, imatih chana ahet phah lou-u pathen lim semthu, pathen lim kisem thu thahho, hitobang ho chu napu napate hon jong ana het khah lou hel ahi.
en: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.
text:
DEU 32:17
Thadou: Pathen hilou thilha ho henga kilhaina asem uvin, imatih chana ahet phah lou-u pathen lim semthu, pathen lim kisem thu thahho, hitobang ho chu napu napate hon jong ana het khah lou hel ahi.
English: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.

tcz: Nangman nasempa songpi chu nagel jing jeng pon, nahingpa Pathen hi nasumil tan ahi.
en: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
text:
DEU 32:18
Thadou: Nangman nasempa songpi chu nagel jing jeng pon, nahingpa Pathen hi nasumil tan ahi.
English: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.

tcz: Pakaiyin athilbol-u ijakai amu chet phat in akidah lheh jeng tan, achapate, acha nuteuvin aphin lung hang gam tauvin ahi.
en: The LORD saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
text:
DEU 32:19
Thadou: Pakaiyin athilbol-u ijakai amu chet phat in akidah lheh jeng tan, achapate, acha nuteuvin aphin lung hang gam tauvin ahi.
English: The LORD saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin aseijin, keiman hiche mihemte akona kamai kasel mang ding, akhonna geiya itobang tauvem ti ka vet lhih jing ding, amaho hi abonchauva khanglam vaitah ahiuvin, asung jeng uva jong tahsanna bei ahi.
en: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.
text:
DEU 32:20
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin aseijin, keiman hiche mihemte akona kamai kasel mang ding, akhonna geiya itobang tauvem ti ka vet lhih jing ding, amaho hi abonchauva khanglam vaitah ahiuvin, asung jeng uva jong tahsanna bei ahi.
English: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.

tcz: Hiche mite hohin Pathen hi lou achombeh pathen kinbol in apang tauvin, keima ei hepha tapouvin, milim doi asem hou jeh in keima kalung ahansah tauvin, ajeh chu keiman mihem to tethei lou ho kaphin lunghang’a achung'uva ka thangtom sah ding, nam lah a angolpente ka phin lunghang peh ding ahiuve.
en: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
text:
DEU 32:21
Thadou: Hiche mite hohin Pathen hi lou achombeh pathen kinbol in apang tauvin, keima ei hepha tapouvin, milim doi asem hou jeh in keima kalung ahansah tauvin, ajeh chu keiman mihem to tethei lou ho kaphin lunghang’a achung'uva ka thangtom sah ding, nam lah a angolpente ka phin lunghang peh ding ahiuve.
English: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

tcz: Keima kalung ahana konin mei ahung kong doh jeng in, hiche meichun noimi gamchan akichai theiyin, leiset leh achunga thil jouse jong akichai hel soh jeng tan, molsang vum jouse jong meiyin akachai soh tan ahi.
en: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.
text:
DEU 32:22
Thadou: Keima kalung ahana konin mei ahung kong doh jeng in, hiche meichun noimi gamchan akichai theiyin, leiset leh achunga thil jouse jong akichai hel soh jeng tan, molsang vum jouse jong meiyin akachai soh tan ahi.
English: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.

tcz: Hiche mite chunga hi thilse simjou lou kasit dimset jeng ding, achung'uva thalpi chang kakap ding ahi.
en: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.
text:
DEU 32:23
Thadou: Hiche mite chunga hi thilse simjou lou kasit dimset jeng ding, achung'uva thalpi chang kakap ding ahi.
English: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.

tcz: Hiche mite hi gilkela thigamna ato diu, meikong in aleugam diu, gamna huise in alhun den jeng diu, amaho douna gamsa ka hansah ding, leivuiya kithol gulsi achung'uva kahan sah ding ahi.
en: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.
text:
DEU 32:24
Thadou: Hiche mite hi gilkela thigamna ato diu, meikong in aleugam diu, gamna huise in alhun den jeng diu, amaho douna gamsa ka hansah ding, leivuiya kithol gulsi achung'uva kahan sah ding ahi.
English: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

tcz: Chule polama chemjam hem kalap sah ding, insung jeng ajong tijatna jeng lhung ding, nungah—gollhangho aboncha thigam ding, nao noichep leh pasal sam kangsa jeng jong atha gamset ding ahi.
en: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.
text:
DEU 32:25
Thadou: Chule polama chemjam hem kalap sah ding, insung jeng ajong tijatna jeng lhung ding, nungah—gollhangho aboncha thigam ding, nao noichep leh pasal sam kangsa jeng jong atha gamset ding ahi.
English: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.

tcz: Keiman hitia hi ka seiya, gam jousea ka thejal soh hel ding, amaho geldohna bei hel ta ding ahi.
en: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;

tcz: Hiche melmate kiletsahna hi kagin lou ham? Amelmate hou gilkel nan hinpha khante, ahilou jong leh hitia hi asei diu, ikhut thahat uvin gal ei josah tauvin, thil hichengse hi Pakaiyin eibol peh uva ahi oi, tia asei diu ahi.
en: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted; the LORD has not done all this.’”
text:
DEU 32:27
Thadou: Hiche melmate kiletsahna hi kagin lou ham? Amelmate hou gilkel nan hinpha khante, ahilou jong leh hitia hi asei diu, ikhut thahat uvin gal ei josah tauvin, thil hichengse hi Pakaiyin eibol peh uva ahi oi, tia asei diu ahi.
English: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted; the LORD has not done all this.’”

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho hi lunggel beiya hinkho mang nam ahiuvin, alungthim sung uva jong hetkhenna ima umlou ahiye.
en: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.
text:
DEU 32:28
Thadou: Ajeh chu amaho hi lunggel beiya hinkho mang nam ahiuvin, alungthim sung uva jong hetkhenna ima umlou ahiye.
English: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.

tcz: Hetkhenna nei hileu hitobang hi ahetthem diu, kho nung chana ato diu thil jong ahet khen thei diu ahi.
en: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
text:
DEU 32:29
Thadou: Hetkhenna nei hileu hitobang hi ahetthem diu, kho nung chana ato diu thil jong ahet khen thei diu ahi.
English: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

tcz: Mikhat chun mi sang khat chu adeljam thei pon, mini seh in jong mihem sangsom adeljam thei pon ahi.
en: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had delivered them up?
text:
DEU 32:30
Thadou: Mikhat chun mi sang khat chu adeljam thei pon, mini seh in jong mihem sangsom adeljam thei pon ahi.
English: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had delivered them up?

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho songpi chu eiho songpi tobang ahi pon, imelma teu hi amaho leh amaho kah a thutan'a pang jeng ahiuve.
en: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.
text:
DEU 32:31
Thadou: Ajeh chu amaho songpi chu eiho songpi tobang ahi pon, imelma teu hi amaho leh amaho kah a thutan'a pang jeng ahiuve.
English: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.

tcz: Amaho lengpigui hi Sadom akona hung jam lut ahin, Gomorrah loujao akona hung jamdoh ahi. Hiche lengpiga ho chu thina thei jing ahin, agaboh jouse jong akha ngen ahi.
en: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.
text:
DEU 32:32
Thadou: Amaho lengpigui hi Sadom akona hung jam lut ahin, Gomorrah loujao akona hung jamdoh ahi. Hiche lengpiga ho chu thina thei jing ahin, agaboh jouse jong akha ngen ahi.
English: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.

tcz: Amaho lengpitwi chu gulgu jeng ahin, aboncha gulsegu phalou ngen jeng ahi.
en: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.
text:
DEU 32:33
Thadou: Amaho lengpitwi chu gulgu jeng ahin, aboncha gulsegu phalou ngen jeng ahi.
English: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.

tcz: Hichengse keima koma kikhola ahipon, nathil khol khomna in muna chu mohor kinam khuma hilou ham?
en: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
text:
DEU 32:34
Thadou: Hichengse keima koma kikhola ahipon, nathil khol khomna in muna chu mohor kinam khuma hilou ham?
English: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?

tcz: Phulah leh lethuhna kiti hi ania keiya ahi. Ajeh chu keng aki lhonal uva, hamsetna ato na diu ahung nai tan ahileh, hichete manthahna chu hetphah louva hung lhung jeng ding ahi.
en: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”
text:
DEU 32:35
Thadou: Phulah leh lethuhna kiti hi ania keiya ahi. Ajeh chu keng aki lhonal uva, hamsetna ato na diu ahung nai tan ahileh, hichete manthahna chu hetphah louva hung lhung jeng ding ahi.
English: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin amite suhdihna anei ding, alhachate chunga jong lainatna ahin nei thei ding ahi. Athahat nau aboncha kichai tading, sohchanga ahin ipi hijong leh abeisoh tai, ti amuchet diu ahi.
en: For the LORD will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.
text:
DEU 32:36
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin amite suhdihna anei ding, alhachate chunga jong lainatna ahin nei thei ding ahi. Athahat nau aboncha kichai tading, sohchanga ahin ipi hijong leh abeisoh tai, ti amuchet diu ahi.
English: For the LORD will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.

tcz: Chuteng aman hiti ahi asei ding, hichete pathen limsem thu hoiya um hitam, akisel nau songpi hoiya um hitam, tia asei diu ahi.
en: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,
text:
DEU 32:37
Thadou: Chuteng aman hiti ahi asei ding, hichete pathen limsem thu hoiya um hitam, akisel nau songpi hoiya um hitam, tia asei diu ahi.
English: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,

tcz: Koiyin hiche teho kilhaina sathao aneh a, lengpitwi don dinga kikoi jong koipen in adon hitam? Hitobang pathen limsem thu hochu hung uvintin, nathoh gimnauva kon in nahung pan pitao hen, ati.
en: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.
text:
DEU 32:38
Thadou: Koiyin hiche teho kilhaina sathao aneh a, lengpitwi don dinga kikoi jong koipen in adon hitam? Hitobang pathen limsem thu hochu hung uvintin, nathoh gimnauva kon in nahung pan pitao hen, ati.
English: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.

tcz: Tun neihin vetem un, Pathen kiti chu keima tah hi kahin, keima tailou pathen dang aum pon, keima tah in mihem ka that jin, hin jong ka hinsah kitjin ahi. Kam'a vojin, ka sudam kit jitai, kei khut a kona eichulha jou ding koima dang aum pon ahi.
en: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.
text:
DEU 32:39
Thadou: Tun neihin vetem un, Pathen kiti chu keima tah hi kahin, keima tailou pathen dang aum pon, keima tah in mihem ka that jin, hin jong ka hinsah kitjin ahi. Kam'a vojin, ka sudam kit jitai, kei khut a kona eichulha jou ding koima dang aum pon ahi.
English: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman vanlam kasang in, atonsot tonsot'a hing jing ka hi jeh in hiti chun ka seiyin ahi.
en: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,
text:
DEU 32:40
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman vanlam kasang in, atonsot tonsot'a hing jing ka hi jeh in hiti chun ka seiyin ahi.
English: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,

tcz: Ka chemjam ka kinol hem teng ka khut a kona thutanna ka neiyin ahi. Keima eidou chan chunga phulahna ka lhunsah ding, keima eithette chunga lethuhna ka lhunsah ding ahi.
en: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.
text:
DEU 32:41
Thadou: Ka chemjam ka kinol hem teng ka khut a kona thutanna ka neiyin ahi. Keima eidou chan chunga phulahna ka lhunsah ding, keima eithette chunga lethuhna ka lhunsah ding ahi.
English: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.

tcz: Kathalpi chang jouse thisan a ka dekot ding, ka chemjam jeng in jong tahsa jeng asat gamhel ding, akithatsa mihemho thisan, sohchanna gal hinga kikai ho, melma samsao tah tah ho lu ka tansah jin ahi.
en: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”
text:
DEU 32:42
Thadou: Kathalpi chang jouse thisan a ka dekot ding, ka chemjam jeng in jong tahsa jeng asat gamhel ding, akithatsa mihemho thisan, sohchanna gal hinga kikai ho, melma samsao tah tah ho lu ka tansah jin ahi.
English: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”

tcz: Vo namtin vaipite jouse, vahchoi un amiten, ajeh chu Pakaiyin alhachaa pangte thisan phu chu alatan ahi. Ama doute chunga phu alan, amite ding mong monga gam sung hi asuh theng ahi.
en: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.
text:
DEU 32:43
Thadou: Vo namtin vaipite jouse, vahchoi un amiten, ajeh chu Pakaiyin alhachaa pangte thisan phu chu alatan ahi. Ama doute chunga phu alan, amite ding mong monga gam sung hi asuh theng ahi.
English: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.

tcz: Chuin Mose chu Nun chapa Joshua toh ahung kilhon in, Mose ahin Joshua ahin ahi lhon in Israel mite jouse henga la thu kisei chu ana beng uvah ajah cheh na diuvin asei peh sohkeiyin ahi.
en: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.
text:
DEU 32:44
Thadou: Chuin Mose chu Nun chapa Joshua toh ahung kilhon in, Mose ahin Joshua ahin ahi lhon in Israel mite jouse henga la thu kisei chu ana beng uvah ajah cheh na diuvin asei peh sohkeiyin ahi.
English: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

tcz: Mose’n thu chu jat chu Israel mite jouse henga aseipeh soh keiyin ahi.
en: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.
text:
DEU 32:45
Thadou: Mose’n thu chu jat chu Israel mite jouse henga aseipeh soh keiyin ahi.
English: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.

tcz: Mose’n miho jouse henga hiti hin aseiyin. Tunia keiman naheng uva thu hijat ka seipeh chengse hi na lungthim cheh uvah koi soh keiyun, hichu nung teng nachate hou henga naseipeh thei diu, chuteng amahon jong hiche danthu a kisei doh jouse hi aboldoh tei na diuva ching thei tah a um ding ahiuve.
en: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
text:
DEU 32:46
Thadou: Mose’n miho jouse henga hiti hin aseiyin. Tunia keiman naheng uva thu hijat ka seipeh chengse hi na lungthim cheh uvah koi soh keiyun, hichu nung teng nachate hou henga naseipeh thei diu, chuteng amahon jong hiche danthu a kisei doh jouse hi aboldoh tei na diuva ching thei tah a um ding ahiuve.
English: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

tcz: Hiche hi nang ho jouse dinga thasetna ding ahipon, nahin theina diujoh ahi. Hichea kona nagal kai nadiu Jordan gal gamsunga khu nahin khou sot ding ahi, tin aheng uvah aseipeh e.
en: For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”
text:
DEU 32:47
Thadou: Hiche hi nang ho jouse dinga thasetna ding ahipon, nahin theina diujoh ahi. Hichea kona nagal kai nadiu Jordan gal gamsunga khu nahin khou sot ding ahi, tin aheng uvah aseipeh e.
English: For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

tcz: Chuni ma ma chun Pakaiyin, Mose jah a hiti hin asei peh in ahi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying,
text:
DEU 32:48
Thadou: Chuni ma ma chun Pakaiyin, Mose jah a hiti hin asei peh in ahi.
English: The LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

tcz: Jericho toh kigalsai, Moab gamsunga, Nebo molsang, Abarim molsang kiti lai akhun kaldoh in, hiche muna kon khun keiman Israel mite chenna dinga kapehna gamsung, Canaan gamsung khu nagavet ding ahi, ati.
en: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.
text:
DEU 32:49
Thadou: Jericho toh kigalsai, Moab gamsunga, Nebo molsang, Abarim molsang kiti lai akhun kaldoh in, hiche muna kon khun keiman Israel mite chenna dinga kapehna gamsung, Canaan gamsung khu nagavet ding ahi, ati.
English: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.

tcz: Hiche nakal touna molsang chunga khu nahung thiden ding, namite hotoh nahung kigop khom ding ahi. Hor molsang chunga nasopipa Aaron athia amite toh akigop khom banga nangma jong nachuti ding ahi, ati.
en: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;

tcz: Ajeh chu Zin gamthip noi, Meribath-Kadesh tui phunga Israel mite lailungtah ah keima thu napal keh in, hiche muna chun Israel mite lah keima hi atheng in nei bol tapon ahi.
en: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.
text:
DEU 32:51
Thadou: Ajeh chu Zin gamthip noi, Meribath-Kadesh tui phunga Israel mite lailungtah ah keima thu napal keh in, hiche muna chun Israel mite lah keima hi atheng in nei bol tapon ahi.
English: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.

tcz: Hijeh achu nangman namasang lama hiche gamsung khu namit a namu bepding, ahinlah keiman Israel mite kapehna gamsung vang nachutlut thei lou ding ahitai.
en: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”
text:
DEU 32:52
Thadou: Hijeh achu nangman namasang lama hiche gamsung khu namit a namu bepding, ahinlah keiman Israel mite kapehna gamsung vang nachutlut thei lou ding ahitai.
English: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”

tcz: Hiche hi Pathen mi Mose chun athi masanga Israel mite phatthei abohna thuchang chu ahi.
en: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
text:
DEU 33:1
Thadou: Hiche hi Pathen mi Mose chun athi masanga Israel mite phatthei abohna thuchang chu ahi.
English: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

tcz: Mose’n hiti hin aseiyin, Sinai molsang akipat Pakai ahung kondoh tai, Seir akon in eiho mun ahung lhung tan, Paran molsang chun ahinsal vah jeng in, Mitheng sang-som kikhopna kon chun ahung in, Pakai chun akhut jet lama kon in meikong chu diu jejun ahin choiyin ahi.
en: He said, “The LORD came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.
text:
DEU 33:2
Thadou: Mose’n hiti hin aseiyin, Sinai molsang akipat Pakai ahung kondoh tai, Seir akon in eiho mun ahung lhung tan, Paran molsang chun ahinsal vah jeng in, Mitheng sang-som kikhopna kon chun ahung in, Pakai chun akhut jet lama kon in meikong chu diu jejun ahin choiyin ahi.
English: He said, “The LORD came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.

tcz: Pakaiyin amiteho angailun, Pakai dinga thensona chang jouse chu akhut a um ahi. Amahon nanung ahinjui diu, nangma akona kihil diu ahi.
en: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.
text:
DEU 33:3
Thadou: Pakaiyin amiteho angailun, Pakai dinga thensona chang jouse chu akhut a um ahi. Amahon nanung ahinjui diu, nangma akona kihil diu ahi.
English: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.

tcz: Mose’n keiho jouse ding in danthubu khat eikoi peh tauve, hichu Jacob mite dinga agoulo diuva apeh ahi.
en: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.
text:
DEU 33:4
Thadou: Mose’n keiho jouse ding in danthubu khat eikoi peh tauve, hichu Jacob mite dinga agoulo diuva apeh ahi.
English: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.

tcz: Hiti chun Pakai chu Jeshurun muna leng achang tai, mipi lamkaiya pangho chu aki khomsoh keiyun, Israel phung jouse abonchan akikhom kimsoh keiyun ahi.
en: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.
text:
DEU 33:5
Thadou: Hiti chun Pakai chu Jeshurun muna leng achang tai, mipi lamkaiya pangho chu aki khomsoh keiyun, Israel phung jouse abonchan akikhom kimsoh keiyun ahi.
English: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.

tcz: Reuben chu hingjing hen lang amite jong lhom cha hithei lou ding ahi, ati.
en: “Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.”
text:
DEU 33:6
Thadou: Reuben chu hingjing hen lang amite jong lhom cha hithei lou ding ahi, ati.
English: “Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.”

tcz: Mose chun hichengse hi Judah chung chang thudola asei ahi. O Pakai Judah taona awgin khu ngaiyin, Judah khu amite lah a hinpui lut teiyin, Nakhut ban thahat teni chun adihna khu panpi jou henlang, akidoupi jouse chunga jong jona chang hen, ati.
en: This is for Judah. He said, “Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended for himself. You shall be a help against his adversaries.”
text:
DEU 33:7
Thadou: Mose chun hichengse hi Judah chung chang thudola asei ahi. O Pakai Judah taona awgin khu ngaiyin, Judah khu amite lah a hinpui lut teiyin, Nakhut ban thahat teni chun adihna khu panpi jou henlang, akidoupi jouse chunga jong jona chang hen, ati.
English: This is for Judah. He said, “Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended for himself. You shall be a help against his adversaries.”

tcz: Levi chung chang thudola aman hitihin aseiye; tun nangman Urim chu Levi henga pen lang, nadei sah tah pahi nangman petan, Massah muna napatepsa ahitan, Merribah muna twi najep doh sah ahi.
en: About Levi he said, “Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.
text:
DEU 33:8
Thadou: Levi chung chang thudola aman hitihin aseiye; tun nangman Urim chu Levi henga pen lang, nadei sah tah pahi nangman petan, Massah muna napatepsa ahitan, Merribah muna twi najep doh sah ahi.
English: About Levi he said, “Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.

tcz: Hichepa hin anu leh apa thudola hiti hin aseiyin, keiman kanu leh kapa kamu khapoi, ati. Asopi pasal chengse jong ahekha tapon, achate jouse jong hetphah in akoi tapoi. Ahinlah amaho chun nangma thusei jouse anit soh keiyun, nakitepna jong anit jing un ahi.
en: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children; for they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.
text:
DEU 33:9
Thadou: Hichepa hin anu leh apa thudola hiti hin aseiyin, keiman kanu leh kapa kamu khapoi, ati. Asopi pasal chengse jong ahekha tapon, achate jouse jong hetphah in akoi tapoi. Ahinlah amaho chun nangma thusei jouse anit soh keiyun, nakitepna jong anit jing un ahi.
English: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children; for they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.

tcz: Amaho hin nachon dan jouse Jacob hilna aman diu, nadan thu jouse jong Israel ahil diu ahi. Nangma angsunga gimnamtui alhutdiu, namai cham chunga jong pumgo thilto alhut vam diu ahi.
en: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.
text:
DEU 33:10
Thadou: Amaho hin nachon dan jouse Jacob hilna aman diu, nadan thu jouse jong Israel ahil diu ahi. Nangma angsunga gimnamtui alhutdiu, namai cham chunga jong pumgo thilto alhut vam diu ahi.
English: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.

tcz: Pakai, anei agou jouse phattheiboh inlang, akhutsoh ijakai sanpeh tei teiyin lang, ama doumah a umjouse jong akhel buh vohchip peh in lang, ama hot bolte aki thodoh kit lou hel na diuvin boltan, ati.
en: LORD, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”
text:
DEU 33:11
Thadou: Pakai, anei agou jouse phattheiboh inlang, akhutsoh ijakai sanpeh tei teiyin lang, ama doumah a umjouse jong akhel buh vohchip peh in lang, ama hot bolte aki thodoh kit lou hel na diuvin boltan, ati.
English: LORD, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”

tcz: Benjamin thudola aman hiti hin aseiye, Pakai ngailutna neipa, ama chu lung mong sel in acheng jing nai, Niseh in Pakaiyin ahongpha jing nan, alengkou teni ajong avengtup jing nai, ati.
en: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of the LORD will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”
text:
DEU 33:12
Thadou: Benjamin thudola aman hiti hin aseiye, Pakai ngailutna neipa, ama chu lung mong sel in acheng jing nai, Niseh in Pakaiyin ahongpha jing nan, alengkou teni ajong avengtup jing nai, ati.
English: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of the LORD will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”

tcz: Joseph thudola aman hiti hin aseitan, Joseph gamsung hi Pakaiyin phatthei abohtan, van gam akon in phatthei aboh in, leinoiya um thilpha chan geiyin apetan ahi.
en: About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by the LORD, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,
text:
DEU 33:13
Thadou: Joseph thudola aman hiti hin aseitan, Joseph gamsung hi Pakaiyin phatthei abohtan, van gam akon in phatthei aboh in, leinoiya um thilpha chan geiyin apetan ahi.
English: About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by the LORD, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,

tcz: Nisa akonna hung ga doh ji thing phapen chu apen, lha chu jat sung’a thing ga neng jen jun jong chu apen ahi.
en: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,
text:
DEU 33:14
Thadou: Nisa akonna hung ga doh ji thing phapen chu apen, lha chu jat sung’a thing ga neng jen jun jong chu apen ahi.
English: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,

tcz: Gollui laiya dinga thilpha pentah chu ahin, khangluiya pat beitih nei louva thinglhang mun nom ahi.
en: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,
text:
DEU 33:15
Thadou: Gollui laiya dinga thilpha pentah chu ahin, khangluiya pat beitih nei louva thinglhang mun nom ahi.
English: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,

tcz: Leiset ga phapen leh asunga ga dimset ahin, hamboh lah a khosa pa dinga jong phatthei channa ahin, hichengse hi Joseph chunga hung um tahen lang, asopiho jouse lah a leng chapa bang’a umpa, a luchang’a akhuh lal lukhuh chung’a chun hung lhung jeng hen.
en: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.
text:
DEU 33:16
Thadou: Leiset ga phapen leh asunga ga dimset ahin, hamboh lah a khosa pa dinga jong phatthei channa ahin, hichengse hi Joseph chunga hung um tahen lang, asopiho jouse lah a leng chapa bang’a umpa, a luchang’a akhuh lal lukhuh chung’a chun hung lhung jeng hen.
English: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.

tcz: Ama dinga abongchal peng masa chun aloupina aki lahsah in, asaki jeng jong gam lah abongchal ki abangin ahi. Hicheho jouse chu leiset kichaina lam chana galkai ding, Ephraim phung sunga galsatmi sang som soma pang chu ahiu vin, Manasseh phung akona galsatmi asang sanga pang jong hiti ma chu ahisoh kei uve.
en: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”
text:
DEU 33:17
Thadou: Ama dinga abongchal peng masa chun aloupina aki lahsah in, asaki jeng jong gam lah abongchal ki abangin ahi. Hicheho jouse chu leiset kichaina lam chana galkai ding, Ephraim phung sunga galsatmi sang som soma pang chu ahiu vin, Manasseh phung akona galsatmi asang sanga pang jong hiti ma chu ahisoh kei uve.
English: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”

tcz: Chule ama chun Zebulun chung chang thudol a asei soh tan ahi. Nangma Zebulun vai nakon teng kipah leh thanom in kon doh jing in, Issachar nangma jong naponbuh sunga kipah leh thanom in umjing in, ati.
en: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.
text:
DEU 33:18
Thadou: Chule ama chun Zebulun chung chang thudol a asei soh tan ahi. Nangma Zebulun vai nakon teng kipah leh thanom in kon doh jing in, Issachar nangma jong naponbuh sunga kipah leh thanom in umjing in, ati.
English: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.

tcz: Amaho chun molsang chung dunga mitin vaipi akou khom diu, hiche muna chu kilhaina gantha adih lama abol diu, ajeh chu amaho hin tui khanglen tuidan chu atep kha tauve, Neldi lei lah a gou ki sel guh jouse jong aga mudoh tauvin ahi.
en: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”
text:
DEU 33:19
Thadou: Amaho chun molsang chung dunga mitin vaipi akou khom diu, hiche muna chu kilhaina gantha adih lama abol diu, ajeh chu amaho hin tui khanglen tuidan chu atep kha tauve, Neldi lei lah a gou ki sel guh jouse jong aga mudoh tauvin ahi.
English: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”

tcz: Chuin Gad chung chang thudola aseiyin, Koi hile Gad dinga gam kehpeh achu nun nom hen, Gad hi sakeijin akol khum jin, ama chun miho ban aheh lha jin, amai akhot phon jin, aluchang jeng jong akhot eh peh jin ahi.
en: About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.
text:
DEU 33:20
Thadou: Chuin Gad chung chang thudola aseiyin, Koi hile Gad dinga gam kehpeh achu nun nom hen, Gad hi sakeijin akol khum jin, ama chun miho ban aheh lha jin, amai akhot phon jin, aluchang jeng jong akhot eh peh jin ahi.
English: About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.

tcz: Ama chun gampha laitah ama ding chun akilhen doh tan, gal lamkaiya pang pa dinga kikoi chu aki mudoh tan ahi. Ama chu mipi lamkaiyin ahung pang doh tan, Pakaiya dia thu dih jing athu peh bang bang in abol jin, Israel mite chung’a hitichun vai ahom jin ahi.
en: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of the LORD, His ordinances with Israel.”
text:
DEU 33:21
Thadou: Ama chun gampha laitah ama ding chun akilhen doh tan, gal lamkaiya pang pa dinga kikoi chu aki mudoh tan ahi. Ama chu mipi lamkaiyin ahung pang doh tan, Pakaiya dia thu dih jing athu peh bang bang in abol jin, Israel mite chung’a hitichun vai ahom jin ahi.
English: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of the LORD, His ordinances with Israel.”

tcz: Chule Dan chung chang thudol a hiti hin aseiye, Dan hi sakei nou ahi. Amachu Basan akon in ahung kichom doh jin ahi, ati.
en: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”
text:
DEU 33:22
Thadou: Chule Dan chung chang thudol a hiti hin aseiye, Dan hi sakei nou ahi. Amachu Basan akon in ahung kichom doh jin ahi, ati.
English: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”

tcz: Naptali thudol a hiti hin aseiye, vo Naptali alungdei achun lunglhei jing in, hiche hi Pakaiya konna phattheina lhingset ahiye. Tui-khanglen leh lhanglam gamsung sese khu chonphan lang chenna gam in nei tan, ati.
en: About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of the LORD’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”
text:
DEU 33:23
Thadou: Naptali thudol a hiti hin aseiye, vo Naptali alungdei achun lunglhei jing in, hiche hi Pakaiya konna phattheina lhingset ahiye. Tui-khanglen leh lhanglam gamsung sese khu chonphan lang chenna gam in nei tan, ati.
English: About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of the LORD’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”

tcz: Asher chung chang thudol a hiti hin aseiye, Asher chateho hi anunnom pen tah chu ahiuvin, hijeh achu asopi hon ama chunga hi lunglhaina anei cheh diu, akeng phang jeng jong thao tuiya kide jol lha jeng ding ahi.
en: About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.
text:
DEU 33:24
Thadou: Asher chung chang thudol a hiti hin aseiye, Asher chateho hi anunnom pen tah chu ahiuvin, hijeh achu asopi hon ama chunga hi lunglhaina anei cheh diu, akeng phang jeng jong thao tuiya kide jol lha jeng ding ahi.
English: About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.

tcz: Nangma kelkot gol chu thih leh sum eng jeng hiding, nadam sunga lungmong sela nachen ding ahi.
en: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.
text:
DEU 33:25
Thadou: Nangma kelkot gol chu thih leh sum eng jeng hiding, nadam sunga lungmong sela nachen ding ahi.
English: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.

tcz: Jeshurun Pathen banga Pathen dang khat cha jong aumpon, nangma kithopi dinga van chunga toupa, alal loupina meibol lhang chung vum'a toupa ahi.
en: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.
text:
DEU 33:26
Thadou: Jeshurun Pathen banga Pathen dang khat cha jong aumpon, nangma kithopi dinga van chunga toupa, alal loupina meibol lhang chung vum'a toupa ahi.
English: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.

tcz: Tonsot Pathen hi nachenna mun ahin, abanjang thahat chun nangma nakol chah jing in ahi. Na masang lama namel mate adeljam in, sumang in tinjong asei tai.
en: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’
text:
DEU 33:27
Thadou: Tonsot Pathen hi nachenna mun ahin, abanjang thahat chun nangma nakol chah jing in ahi. Na masang lama namel mate adeljam in, sumang in tinjong asei tai.
English: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’

tcz: Hitichun Israel mite chu lungmong in acheng un, Jacob tuinah chu lhen tum asoh doh tan ahi. Ajeh chu hiche mun chu chang phatna leh lengpi tui tamna mun ahi.
en: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.
text:
DEU 33:28
Thadou: Hitichun Israel mite chu lungmong in acheng un, Jacob tuinah chu lhen tum asoh doh tan ahi. Ajeh chu hiche mun chu chang phatna leh lengpi tui tamna mun ahi.
English: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.

tcz: Vo Israel nangma anun nom nahiye, nang tobang ding koi ham? Pakaiyin ahuh hing nam mite, Pakai chu nangma din apang in, nagaljona chemjam ahi. Namelmate hon nangma suhmang ding nago uvinte, ahinlah nangman achen nau molsang jouse na chot chimsoh hel ding ahi.
en: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”
text:
DEU 33:29
Thadou: Vo Israel nangma anun nom nahiye, nang tobang ding koi ham? Pakaiyin ahuh hing nam mite, Pakai chu nangma din apang in, nagaljona chemjam ahi. Namelmate hon nangma suhmang ding nago uvinte, ahinlah nangman achen nau molsang jouse na chot chimsoh hel ding ahi.
English: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”

tcz: Moab phaicham akon in Mose chu Jericho toh kinai Nebo molsang Pisgah molchunga chun akal tou tan ahi. Pakaiyin Mose chu gamsung jouse abonchan avetsah soh keiyin, Gilead apat Dan chan chu avetsah soh keiyin ahi.
en: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. The LORD showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,
text:
DEU 34:1
Thadou: Moab phaicham akon in Mose chu Jericho toh kinai Nebo molsang Pisgah molchunga chun akal tou tan ahi. Pakaiyin Mose chu gamsung jouse abonchan avetsah soh keiyin, Gilead apat Dan chan chu avetsah soh keiyin ahi.
English: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. The LORD showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,

tcz: Naphtali gamsung jouse, Ephraim, Mannaseh, Judah gamsung leh lhum lam gamkai sung jouse ahi.
en: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,
text:
DEU 34:2
Thadou: Naphtali gamsung jouse, Ephraim, Mannaseh, Judah gamsung leh lhum lam gamkai sung jouse ahi.
English: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,

tcz: Negeb gamsung phaicham, tomthing kena mun, Jericho khopi phaicham apat Zoar mun chan ahi.
en: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.
text:
DEU 34:3
Thadou: Negeb gamsung phaicham, tomthing kena mun, Jericho khopi phaicham apat Zoar mun chan ahi.
English: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga asei tan, Keima Abraham, Isaac leh Jacob henga ka kihahselna, keiman nason nachilhahte kapeh ding ahi, tia kaki tepna gam chu hiche hi ahi. Tun keiman namit in ka vetsah in, ahinlah hiche gamsung’a hi nangma nalut lou hel ding ahi tai, ati.
en: The LORD said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”
text:
DEU 34:4
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin Mose henga asei tan, Keima Abraham, Isaac leh Jacob henga ka kihahselna, keiman nason nachilhahte kapeh ding ahi, tia kaki tepna gam chu hiche hi ahi. Tun keiman namit in ka vetsah in, ahinlah hiche gamsung’a hi nangma nalut lou hel ding ahi tai, ati.
English: The LORD said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”

tcz: Hiti chun Pakai lhacha Mose chu Pakai thusei bang chun Moab gam sung’a ahitan ahi.
en: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the LORD’s word.
text:
DEU 34:5
Thadou: Hiti chun Pakai lhacha Mose chu Pakai thusei bang chun Moab gam sung’a ahitan ahi.
English: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the LORD’s word.

tcz: Chuin Pathen in Mose chu Beth-peor gal lam, Moab phaicham achun avuitan ahi, ahinlah tuni chan in koiman Mose kivuina lhan chu ahedoh pon ahi.
en: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.
text:
DEU 34:6
Thadou: Chuin Pathen in Mose chu Beth-peor gal lam, Moab phaicham achun avuitan ahi, ahinlah tuni chan in koiman Mose kivuina lhan chu ahedoh pon ahi.
English: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.

tcz: Mose athichun akum jakhat leh somni alhing tan, amit jong athim pon, athahatna jong alha kang hih laiyin ahi.
en: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.
text:
DEU 34:7
Thadou: Mose athichun akum jakhat leh somni alhing tan, amit jong athim pon, athahatna jong alha kang hih laiyin ahi.
English: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.

tcz: Israel mipi chu Moab phaicham sunga nisom thum sung in Mose puldounan akap tauvin ahi, Mose ding in thi opna kana chu alhung tan ahi.
en: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.
text:
DEU 34:8
Thadou: Israel mipi chu Moab phaicham sunga nisom thum sung in Mose puldounan akap tauvin ahi, Mose ding in thi opna kana chu alhung tan ahi.
English: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.

tcz: Nun chapa Joshua chu Mose’n a chung’a akhut angap jeh in Joshua chu lhagao leh chihna adim jeng tan ahi. Pakaiyin Mose henga thu apeh bang chun Israel miten jong Joshua thusei ijakai angai tauvin ahi.
en: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
DEU 34:9
Thadou: Nun chapa Joshua chu Mose’n a chung’a akhut angap jeh in Joshua chu lhagao leh chihna adim jeng tan ahi. Pakaiyin Mose henga thu apeh bang chun Israel miten jong Joshua thusei ijakai angai tauvin ahi.
English: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Hiche kalse chu Israel nam mite lah a kon in Mose banga Pakaiyin amanchah themgao ahung peng doh tapon ahi.
en: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
text:
DEU 34:10
Thadou: Hiche kalse chu Israel nam mite lah a kon in Mose banga Pakaiyin amanchah themgao ahung peng doh tapon ahi.
English: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,

tcz: Mose chu Egypt gamsunga melchihna tmapi abolsah in, thil kidang chujat abolsah in, Pharaoh leh asohte maija akilahsah in, Pharaoh ang sung’a thilkidang akilahsahho bang a bolthei ding Israel sunga kon in ahung peng doh tapon ahi.
en: in all the signs and the wonders which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
text:
DEU 34:11
Thadou: Mose chu Egypt gamsunga melchihna tmapi abolsah in, thil kidang chujat abolsah in, Pharaoh leh asohte maija akilahsah in, Pharaoh ang sung’a thilkidang akilahsahho bang a bolthei ding Israel sunga kon in ahung peng doh tapon ahi.
English: in all the signs and the wonders which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

tcz: Thahatna kidang tah leh thilbol theina kidang nasatah tah Mose’n Israel mite lah akonna boldoh mihem khat a khat jeng cha jong akisep doh tapon ahi.
en: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
text:
DEU 34:12
Thadou: Thahatna kidang tah leh thilbol theina kidang nasatah tah Mose’n Israel mite lah akonna boldoh mihem khat a khat jeng cha jong akisep doh tapon ahi.
English: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.

tcz: Pakai lhacha Mose athiphatnin Nun chapa Mose lhacha a pang Joshua komma chun Pakaiyin thu ahin seijin,
en: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD, the LORD spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,
text:
JOS 1:1
Thadou: Pakai lhacha Mose athiphatnin Nun chapa Mose lhacha a pang Joshua komma chun Pakaiyin thu ahin seijin,
English: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD, the LORD spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,

tcz: “Kalhacha Mose athitai, hijeh chun nangma kipatnin lang hiche Jordan hi galkaijin, nangle hiche mipiho hin Keiman Israel chate kapehna gam hi jonlut tauvin.
en: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.
text:
JOS 1:2
Thadou: “Kalhacha Mose athitai, hijeh chun nangma kipatnin lang hiche Jordan hi galkaijin, nangle hiche mipiho hin Keiman Israel chate kapehna gam hi jonlut tauvin.
English: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.

tcz: Mose koma kanateppehna bang banga chu hoilai mun hijongleh nakengphang’un achotphana muntin chu nangho kapehding nahiuve.
en: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.
text:
JOS 1:3
Thadou: Mose koma kanateppehna bang banga chu hoilai mun hijongleh nakengphang’un achotphana muntin chu nangho kapehding nahiuve.
English: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.

tcz: Gamthip gam le Lebanon gamma vadunglen changgei, Eupharates vadung, Hit mite gampumpi chuleh nisa lhumna lang twikhanglen changgei nagam’u hiding ahi.
en: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.
text:
JOS 1:4
Thadou: Gamthip gam le Lebanon gamma vadunglen changgei, Eupharates vadung, Hit mite gampumpi chuleh nisa lhumna lang twikhanglen changgei nagam’u hiding ahi.
English: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

tcz: Nahinkho lhumkeijuva namasang uva koimacha dingjoulou ding, Mose kana dinpi banga nangho jong kadinpi jingdiu, kadalhah louheldiu chuleh kanungsun louhel ding nahiuve.
en: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.
text:
JOS 1:5
Thadou: Nahinkho lhumkeijuva namasang uva koimacha dingjoulou ding, Mose kana dinpi banga nangho jong kadinpi jingdiu, kadalhah louheldiu chuleh kanungsun louhel ding nahiuve.
English: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.

tcz: Hatninlang hangin, hiche mite hi pehdinga apu apateu kanateppeh gamchu agoulo diuva nahoppeh ding ahi.
en: “Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.
text:
JOS 1:6
Thadou: Hatninlang hangin, hiche mite hi pehdinga apu apateu kanateppeh gamchu agoulo diuva nahoppeh ding ahi.
English: “Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.

tcz: Hatninlang hangpou pouvin, Kalhacha Mose kanapeh danthu jouse nanit jouna dingin, hichea konhin jetlang hihen veiling hijongleh kiheimang hihbeh’in, chutileh nachena channa nakhantou theiding ahi.
en: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.
text:
JOS 1:7
Thadou: Hatninlang hangpou pouvin, Kalhacha Mose kanapeh danthu jouse nanit jouna dingin, hichea konhin jetlang hihen veiling hijongleh kiheimang hihbeh’in, chutileh nachena channa nakhantou theiding ahi.
English: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.

tcz: Hiche danthubu hi, nakamma kon mangthah louhel ding, amavang asun ajanna nageljoh ding, akijih dungjuija hi nachon jingdiu ahi. Chitilebou nakhantou ding chuleh nalolhin teiding'u ahi.
en: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
text:
JOS 1:8
Thadou: Hiche danthubu hi, nakamma kon mangthah louhel ding, amavang asun ajanna nageljoh ding, akijih dungjuija hi nachon jingdiu ahi. Chitilebou nakhantou ding chuleh nalolhin teiding'u ahi.
English: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.

tcz: Keiman thupeh kahinpeh louva nabol ham? Hatninlang hangin, kicha hihbeh’in, tijatna jong neihih in ajeh chu na Pakai na Pathennin nachena chan’uva nalhonpi jing dingu ahi,” ati.
en: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
text:
JOS 1:9
Thadou: Keiman thupeh kahinpeh louva nabol ham? Hatninlang hangin, kicha hihbeh’in, tijatna jong neihih in ajeh chu na Pakai na Pathennin nachena chan’uva nalhonpi jing dingu ahi,” ati.
English: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”

tcz: Chujouchun, Josuha’in mipi lamkaiho chu thu apen hitin aseije,
en: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
text:
JOS 1:10
Thadou: Chujouchun, Josuha’in mipi lamkaiho chu thu apen hitin aseije,
English: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

tcz: “Ponbuh sunga khun cheuvin lang mipiho khu anehdiu akigot toh dingun gaseipeh’un, ajeh chu nithum sunga hi Jordan luipi khu nagalkaijuva Pakai na Pathen in napeh’u gamkhu galotauvin.
en: “Pass through the middle of the camp, and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare food; for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess.’”
text:
JOS 1:11
Thadou: “Ponbuh sunga khun cheuvin lang mipiho khu anehdiu akigot toh dingun gaseipeh’un, ajeh chu nithum sunga hi Jordan luipi khu nagalkaijuva Pakai na Pathen in napeh’u gamkhu galotauvin.
English: “Pass through the middle of the camp, and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare food; for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess.’”

tcz: Chuleh Reuben phungleh Gad phung chuleh Mannasseh phung akehkhat ho kommachun Joshua’n hitin aseije,
en: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying,
text:
JOS 1:12
Thadou: Chuleh Reuben phungleh Gad phung chuleh Mannasseh phung akehkhat ho kommachun Joshua’n hitin aseije,
English: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying,

tcz: Pakai lhacha Mose’n nakom uva aseichu sumil hih’un, Pakai na Pathennun nakicholdosah tauvin, chuleh hiche gamhi napeh’u ahitai.
en: “Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, ‘The LORD your God gives you rest, and will give you this land.
text:
JOS 1:13
Thadou: Pakai lhacha Mose’n nakom uva aseichu sumil hih’un, Pakai na Pathennun nakicholdosah tauvin, chuleh hiche gamhi napeh’u ahitai.
English: “Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, ‘The LORD your God gives you rest, and will give you this land.

tcz: Najiteule nachateu, chuleh naganchateu chu Mose’n napehnao hiche Jordan solam gamkaiyah hin umsah’un, ahinlah nalah’uva gal-hat hole mihangsan chengse chun galmanchah akipat uva asopihou masanga hi gal lamkaija pangdiu,
en: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan; but you shall pass over before your brothers armed, all the mighty men of valor, and shall help them
text:
JOS 1:14
Thadou: Najiteule nachateu, chuleh naganchateu chu Mose’n napehnao hiche Jordan solam gamkaiyah hin umsah’un, ahinlah nalah’uva gal-hat hole mihangsan chengse chun galmanchah akipat uva asopihou masanga hi gal lamkaija pangdiu,
English: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan; but you shall pass over before your brothers armed, all the mighty men of valor, and shall help them

tcz: Pakaiyin nangho gam napeh banguva amaho jong alodiu gam apeh kahseuva nakithopidiu ahi. Chujouteng leh nahung kileuva Pakai lhacha Mose’n napehnao Jordan solam nagam uva nachendiu ahi.
en: until the LORD has given your brothers rest, as he has given you, and they have also possessed the land which the LORD your God gives them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess it, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise.’”
text:
JOS 1:15
Thadou: Pakaiyin nangho gam napeh banguva amaho jong alodiu gam apeh kahseuva nakithopidiu ahi. Chujouteng leh nahung kileuva Pakai lhacha Mose’n napehnao Jordan solam nagam uva nachendiu ahi.
English: until the LORD has given your brothers rest, as he has given you, and they have also possessed the land which the LORD your God gives them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess it, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise.’”

tcz: Hitichun amahon Joshua chu adonbutnun, “Ipi hileh nangin neithupeh jouseu chu kaboldiu, chuleh neisol solnauva chu kache jengdiu ahi atiuve”.
en: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
text:
JOS 1:16
Thadou: Hitichun amahon Joshua chu adonbutnun, “Ipi hileh nangin neithupeh jouseu chu kaboldiu, chuleh neisol solnauva chu kache jengdiu ahi atiuve”.
English: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

tcz: “Keihon Mose thu kanangai bang banguva chu imalam jousea nangma thujong kangai diu ahi. Pakai na Pathen chun Mose ana umpi bang bangin nangjong naumpi jinghen,” atiuve.
en: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so will we listen to you. Only may the LORD your God be with you, as he was with Moses.
text:
JOS 1:17
Thadou: “Keihon Mose thu kanangai bang banguva chu imalam jousea nangma thujong kangai diu ahi. Pakai na Pathen chun Mose ana umpi bang bangin nangjong naumpi jinghen,” atiuve.
English: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so will we listen to you. Only may the LORD your God be with you, as he was with Moses.

tcz: “Koi hileh nangma thupeh jouse chu nitlouva aumma, nahindouva aumpoupou leh thadoh jengding ahi. Hatninlang hangpou pouvin”.
en: Whoever rebels against your commandment, and doesn’t listen to your words in all that you command him shall himself be put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”
text:
JOS 1:18
Thadou: “Koi hileh nangma thupeh jouse chu nitlouva aumma, nahindouva aumpoupou leh thadoh jengding ahi. Hatninlang hangpou pouvin”.
English: Whoever rebels against your commandment, and doesn’t listen to your words in all that you command him shall himself be put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”

tcz: Nun chapa Joshua’n Shittim’a kon in aguh’a gamvelhi dingin mini anasoldoh’in hitihin anavailhah’in ahi. Chelhonnin lang Jericho geijin agamchu gakholpeh lhonnin ati. Hitichun amani achelhonnin Rahab notinu in na agalhung lhonnin hicheachun agageh lhontan ahi.
en: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.” They went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and slept there.
text:
JOS 2:1
Thadou: Nun chapa Joshua’n Shittim’a kon in aguh’a gamvelhi dingin mini anasoldoh’in hitihin anavailhah’in ahi. Chelhonnin lang Jericho geijin agamchu gakholpeh lhonnin ati. Hitichun amani achelhonnin Rahab notinu in na agalhung lhonnin hicheachun agageh lhontan ahi.
English: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.” They went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and slept there.

tcz: Hiche chu Jericho lengpa kom agalhut tauvin, “Ven, hiche gam kholtoh dingin Israel mi phabep tujannin ahunguve,” agatiuvin ahi.
en: The king of Jericho was told, “Behold, men of the children of Israel came in here tonight to spy out the land.”
text:
JOS 2:2
Thadou: Hiche chu Jericho lengpa kom agalhut tauvin, “Ven, hiche gam kholtoh dingin Israel mi phabep tujannin ahunguve,” agatiuvin ahi.
English: The king of Jericho was told, “Behold, men of the children of Israel came in here tonight to spy out the land.”

tcz: Hichun Jericho lengpan Rahab kommachun mi asollin hitihin agaseisah e, “Hiche gamsung velhi dinga hungho nainna hunglut hochu hinpuidoh’in” atin ahi.
en: Jericho’s king sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered into your house; for they have come to spy out all the land.”
text:
JOS 2:3
Thadou: Hichun Jericho lengpan Rahab kommachun mi asollin hitihin agaseisah e, “Hiche gamsung velhi dinga hungho nainna hunglut hochu hinpuidoh’in” atin ahi.
English: Jericho’s king sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered into your house; for they have come to spy out all the land.”

tcz: Rahab chun miteni chu anasel ahinai, ahinla aman anadonbutnin, “Amani chu ahunglhonnai ahin hoiya konna hunglhonham ti keiman kahepoi.
en: The woman took the two men and hid them. Then she said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I didn’t know where they came from.
text:
JOS 2:4
Thadou: Rahab chun miteni chu anasel ahinai, ahinla aman anadonbutnin, “Amani chu ahunglhonnai ahin hoiya konna hunglhonham ti keiman kahepoi.
English: The woman took the two men and hid them. Then she said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I didn’t know where they came from.

tcz: Kho ahung jinkon kelkot kikhading konchakhun apotdoh lhontai, hoilangpen ajotlhon ham keiman kahepoi, delloi leuchun naphahdiu ahi,” ati.
en: About the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark, the men went out. Where the men went, I don’t know. Pursue them quickly. You may catch up with them.”
text:
JOS 2:5
Thadou: Kho ahung jinkon kelkot kikhading konchakhun apotdoh lhontai, hoilangpen ajotlhon ham keiman kahepoi, delloi leuchun naphahdiu ahi,” ati.
English: About the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark, the men went out. Where the men went, I don’t know. Pursue them quickly. You may catch up with them.”

tcz: Ahinlah amanun amani chu indan chunglanga apuitouvin patkung lom inchunga anaphou lah’a chun asellin ahi.
en: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.
text:
JOS 2:6
Thadou: Ahinlah amanun amani chu indan chunglanga apuitouvin patkung lom inchunga anaphou lah’a chun asellin ahi.
English: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.

tcz: Hiche jouchun lengpa sepaiten Jordan panmun lampi geijin aganungdel’un ahi. Anungdel ho chu apotdoh jou jouvun Jericho khopi kelkot chu akhahtauvin ahi.
en: The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.
text:
JOS 2:7
Thadou: Hiche jouchun lengpa sepaiten Jordan panmun lampi geijin aganungdel’un ahi. Anungdel ho chu apotdoh jou jouvun Jericho khopi kelkot chu akhahtauvin ahi.
English: The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.

tcz: Gamvelhi teni jan alup masang lhon in, Rahab inchunga amani chu kihoulimpi dingin kaltouvin,
en: Before they had lain down, she came up to them on the roof.
text:
JOS 2:8
Thadou: Gamvelhi teni jan alup masang lhon in, Rahab inchunga amani chu kihoulimpi dingin kaltouvin,
