Thadou: Solam le lhumlam gamkaija um Canaan lengho, Amor mite lengho, Hit mite, Perizz mite, thinglhang gamma um Jabus mite, Mizpah gamsunga um Hermon molken suhlanga khopihoa um Hivi miteho jouse chu akouvin ahi.
English: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the hill country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

tcz: Hiche lengho jouse hi galsat dingin ahungkon tauve. Amahohi ahung kiloikhommun asepai houhi ahintit khommun ahileh alet-lha jengin ahi. Asakol houleh akangtalai hou twikhanglen panga neldiho bangin gamkom alosoh jengun ahi.
en: They went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, even as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.
text:
JOS 11:4
Thadou: Hiche lengho jouse hi galsat dingin ahungkon tauve. Amahohi ahung kiloikhommun asepai houhi ahintit khommun ahileh alet-lha jengin ahi. Asakol houleh akangtalai hou twikhanglen panga neldiho bangin gamkom alosoh jengun ahi.
English: They went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, even as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.

tcz: Hiche lengho hin athau ajekhommun Israelte satdingin Merom komma tuipang vellah ngahmun asemmun ahi.
en: All these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.
text:
JOS 11:5
Thadou: Hiche lengho hin athau ajekhommun Israelte satdingin Merom komma tuipang vellah ngahmun asemmun ahi.
English: All these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Joshua kommah hitin ahinseijin, “Amaho khu kichahih’in, jing nikho tuphat tahle hin, amahohi athisa banga Israelte kahinpehdoh ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh asakolte akeng nasuhbeijuva akangtalai hou nahallhah diu ahi,” ati.
en: The LORD said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid because of them; for tomorrow at this time, I will deliver them up all slain before Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.”
text:
JOS 11:6
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin Joshua kommah hitin ahinseijin, “Amaho khu kichahih’in, jing nikho tuphat tahle hin, amahohi athisa banga Israelte kahinpehdoh ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh asakolte akeng nasuhbeijuva akangtalai hou nahallhah diu ahi,” ati.
English: The LORD said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid because of them; for tomorrow at this time, I will deliver them up all slain before Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.”

tcz: Hitichun Joshua leh asepaite jousen Merom komma tuipanga chun alhailutnun gangtah’in adelkhum tauvin ahi.
en: So Joshua came suddenly, with all the warriors, against them by the waters of Merom, and attacked them.
text:
JOS 11:7
Thadou: Hitichun Joshua leh asepaite jousen Merom komma tuipanga chun alhailutnun gangtah’in adelkhum tauvin ahi.
English: So Joshua came suddenly, with all the warriors, against them by the waters of Merom, and attacked them.

tcz: Pakaiyin amaho chu Israelte khutnah ahinpedoh tan, hitichun amahon Sidon gamlenlang geileh Misrephath-maim changgei chuleh Mizpah solam phaicham geipeh’in ahindellutnun amaho chu khatcha hinghoi louvin ahin thatsoh keijun ahi.
en: The LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpah eastward. They struck them until they left them no one remaining.
text:
JOS 11:8
Thadou: Pakaiyin amaho chu Israelte khutnah ahinpedoh tan, hitichun amahon Sidon gamlenlang geileh Misrephath-maim changgei chuleh Mizpah solam phaicham geipeh’in ahindellutnun amaho chu khatcha hinghoi louvin ahin thatsoh keijun ahi.
English: The LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpah eastward. They struck them until they left them no one remaining.

tcz: Pakaiyin aseipeh bang bangin Joshua’n asakolteu keng asatbai peh’in chuleh akangtalai jouseu ahallhah peh’in ahi.
en: Joshua did to them as the LORD told him. He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.
text:
JOS 11:9
Thadou: Pakaiyin aseipeh bang bangin Joshua’n asakolteu keng asatbai peh’in chuleh akangtalai jouseu ahallhah peh’in ahi.
English: Joshua did to them as the LORD told him. He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.

tcz: Hiche jouchun Joshua ahung kinunglen Hazor chu alan chuleh alengpau chu athatnin ahi. Phatchomkhat achu Hazor hi hiche lenggam ho jouse bulpi anahin ahi.
en: Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor used to be the head of all those kingdoms.
text:
JOS 11:10
Thadou: Hiche jouchun Joshua ahung kinunglen Hazor chu alan chuleh alengpau chu athatnin ahi. Phatchomkhat achu Hazor hi hiche lenggam ho jouse bulpi anahin ahi.
English: Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor used to be the head of all those kingdoms.

tcz: Israelten hiche khopi sunga mihing ching jouse abonchan asumang sohkeijin mi khatcha jong ahing hoipon ahi. Hitichun Joshua’n khopi chu ahallhatan ahi.
en: They struck all the souls who were in it with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them. There was no one left who breathed. He burned Hazor with fire.
text:
JOS 11:11
Thadou: Israelten hiche khopi sunga mihing ching jouse abonchan asumang sohkeijin mi khatcha jong ahing hoipon ahi. Hitichun Joshua’n khopi chu ahallhatan ahi.
English: They struck all the souls who were in it with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them. There was no one left who breathed. He burned Hazor with fire.

tcz: Pakai lhacha Mose’n athupeh bang bangin Joshua’n lengdangho jouse leh amipiteu abonchan asumang sohkeijin ahi.
en: Joshua captured all the cities of those kings, with their kings, and he struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.
text:
JOS 11:12
Thadou: Pakai lhacha Mose’n athupeh bang bangin Joshua’n lengdangho jouse leh amipiteu abonchan asumang sohkeijin ahi.
English: Joshua captured all the cities of those kings, with their kings, and he struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.

tcz: Joshua’n anahallhah Hazor tailou Israelten lhangchunga kitungdoh khopiho chu anahallha pouvin ahi.
en: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only. Joshua burned that.
text:
JOS 11:13
Thadou: Joshua’n anahallhah Hazor tailou Israelten lhangchunga kitungdoh khopiho chu anahallha pouvin ahi.
English: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only. Joshua burned that.

tcz: Israelten khopi asuhmang houva achomdoh’u neile gou holeh ganchaho chu akilah’un ahi. Ahinla koimacha hinghoi louvin mihing jouse chu athatgam sohkeijin ahi.
en: The children of Israel took all the plunder of these cities, with the livestock, as plunder for themselves; but every man they struck with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them. They didn’t leave any who breathed.
text:
JOS 11:14
Thadou: Israelten khopi asuhmang houva achomdoh’u neile gou holeh ganchaho chu akilah’un ahi. Ahinla koimacha hinghoi louvin mihing jouse chu athatgam sohkeijin ahi.
English: The children of Israel took all the plunder of these cities, with the livestock, as plunder for themselves; but every man they struck with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them. They didn’t leave any who breathed.

tcz: Pathen thupeh dungjuija Mose’n Joshua chu thu anapeh ahi. Hitichun Joshua’n Pathen thupeh dungjuija Mose’n anathupeh ho jouse chu atongdoh sohkeijin ahi.
en: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua. Joshua did so. He left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
JOS 11:15
Thadou: Pathen thupeh dungjuija Mose’n Joshua chu thu anapeh ahi. Hitichun Joshua’n Pathen thupeh dungjuija Mose’n anathupeh ho jouse chu atongdoh sohkeijin ahi.
English: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua. Joshua did so. He left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Hitihin Joshua’n gamsung pumpi hi anajouvin, thinglhang gam Negiv gampumpi, Goshen khopile vella gampumpi, Kolbul solam gamho, Jordan phaicham gamho, Israel molsangho leh Galilee molbul gamho jouse analasoh keijin ahi.
en: So Joshua captured all that land, the hill country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel, and the lowland of the same,
text:
JOS 11:16
Thadou: Hitihin Joshua’n gamsung pumpi hi anajouvin, thinglhang gam Negiv gampumpi, Goshen khopile vella gampumpi, Kolbul solam gamho, Jordan phaicham gamho, Israel molsangho leh Galilee molbul gamho jouse analasoh keijin ahi.
English: So Joshua captured all that land, the hill country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel, and the lowland of the same,

tcz: Tun Israel gamchu Halak mol’apatnin ahung kijedoh’in lhanglanga Seir changgei aphan, chuleh sahlang gam Lebanon phaicham Hermon molbulla Baal-gad changgei ahopmin ahi. Joshua in hiche gam lengho jouse anathatgam sohkeijin ahi.
en: from Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. He took all their kings, struck them, and put them to death.
text:
JOS 11:17
Thadou: Tun Israel gamchu Halak mol’apatnin ahung kijedoh’in lhanglanga Seir changgei aphan, chuleh sahlang gam Lebanon phaicham Hermon molbulla Baal-gad changgei ahopmin ahi. Joshua in hiche gam lengho jouse anathatgam sohkeijin ahi.
English: from Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. He took all their kings, struck them, and put them to death.

tcz: Hiche tohmolsona dingahin phat sottah gal anadouvun ahi.
en: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
text:
JOS 11:18
Thadou: Hiche tohmolsona dingahin phat sottah gal anadouvun ahi.
English: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

tcz: Hiche gamhoa hin Gibeon a Hivi mite tailou khatchan Israelte hi ana kichampi pon ahi. Hiche Gibeon miho tailou gamdang miho jouse vangchu anathatgam sohhellun ahi.
en: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took all in battle.
text:
JOS 11:19
Thadou: Hiche gamhoa hin Gibeon a Hivi mite tailou khatchan Israelte hi ana kichampi pon ahi. Hiche Gibeon miho tailou gamdang miho jouse vangchu anathatgam sohhellun ahi.
English: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took all in battle.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin alungu asuhtah peh’a Israelte chu anakisatpiu ahi. Hijeh achu amaho chu Pakaiyin Mose anathupeh bangin khotona beihellin anasumang’un ahi.
en: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text:
JOS 11:20
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin alungu asuhtah peh’a Israelte chu anakisatpiu ahi. Hijeh achu amaho chu Pakaiyin Mose anathupeh bangin khotona beihellin anasumang’un ahi.
English: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

tcz: Hichephat sungah hin Joshua’n Hebron thinglhanggam pumpi le Dibar, Anab, Israelte le Judah gamsung pumpia cheng Anak chilhah hojouse ana sumang sohkeijun ahi. Aman amahohi achennao khopiho jouse pummin anathatgam sohkeijin ahi.
en: Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.
text:
JOS 11:21
Thadou: Hichephat sungah hin Joshua’n Hebron thinglhanggam pumpi le Dibar, Anab, Israelte le Judah gamsung pumpia cheng Anak chilhah hojouse ana sumang sohkeijun ahi. Aman amahohi achennao khopiho jouse pummin anathatgam sohkeijin ahi.
English: Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.

tcz: Israel gamsung pumpia Anak chilhahho hi khatcha akihinghoi anaumpouvin ahi. Ahinlah Gaza, Gath gamma vang amoh themkhat aumnalaijin ahi.
en: There were none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel. Only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain.
text:
JOS 11:22
Thadou: Israel gamsung pumpia Anak chilhahho hi khatcha akihinghoi anaumpouvin ahi. Ahinlah Gaza, Gath gamma vang amoh themkhat aumnalaijin ahi.
English: There were none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel. Only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose anaseipeh bang bangin Joshua’n gamsung pumpi chu analatan ahi. Aman Israelte chu agouchan diuvin aphung aphung dungjuijin anahoppeh’in ahi. Hitichun galsatna a kon in gamsung chu ana kicholdo tan ahi.
en: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.
text:
JOS 11:23
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin Mose anaseipeh bang bangin Joshua’n gamsung pumpi chu analatan ahi. Aman Israelte chu agouchan diuvin aphung aphung dungjuijin anahoppeh’in ahi. Hitichun galsatna a kon in gamsung chu ana kicholdo tan ahi.
English: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.

tcz: Israelten ana thagammuva agammu analahpeh’u Jordan vadung solam’a cheng lengho chu hichehohi ahiuve. Agamlah uchu Armon vadunga konna Hermon molchan ahung kijedoh’in, Jordan phaicham solam gamkaise jong ahopmin ahi.
en: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:
text:
JOS 12:1
Thadou: Israelten ana thagammuva agammu analahpeh’u Jordan vadung solam’a cheng lengho chu hichehohi ahiuve. Agamlah uchu Armon vadunga konna Hermon molchan ahung kijedoh’in, Jordan phaicham solam gamkaise jong ahopmin ahi.
English: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:

tcz: Heshbon’a cheng Amormi Sihon lengpa jong chu anajouvun ahi, ama lenggam chun Arnon vadung geichinna um Aroer jong ahopmin, hiche chu Arnon vadung akimma konna Jabbek vadunggei ahin hiche hin Ammon mite gamgi melchihna chu ahitai.
en: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;

tcz: Sihon thaneina in Jordan phaicham solam gamkai Galilee tuilen sahlanga konna Chitwilen changgei ahopmin, Bath-jeshemath leh Pisgah lhanglang jong ahopphan ahi.
en: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:
text:
JOS 12:3
Thadou: Sihon thaneina in Jordan phaicham solam gamkai Galilee tuilen sahlanga konna Chitwilen changgei ahopmin, Bath-jeshemath leh Pisgah lhanglang jong ahopphan ahi.
English: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:

tcz: Ashteroth khopile Edrei khopia anacheng Raph-aim mite lah’a hingdohpa, Bashan lengpa Og kitipa jong ahin,
en: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
text:
JOS 12:4
Thadou: Ashteroth khopile Edrei khopia anacheng Raph-aim mite lah’a hingdohpa, Bashan lengpa Og kitipa jong ahin,
English: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

tcz: Amahin Hermon molsang pumpi chungleh Salecah gammang toh, chuleh Bashan gamsungsese chunga vaihomma anapanga Geshur mite leh Maacah mite gamgi geija anapehtha ahin, chutengleh Gilead gam kehkhat chunga jong vaihomma, Heshbon lengpa Sihon gamgi geija vai anahom ahi.
en: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
text:
JOS 12:5
Thadou: Amahin Hermon molsang pumpi chungleh Salecah gammang toh, chuleh Bashan gamsungsese chunga vaihomma anapanga Geshur mite leh Maacah mite gamgi geija anapehtha ahin, chutengleh Gilead gam kehkhat chunga jong vaihomma, Heshbon lengpa Sihon gamgi geija vai anahom ahi.
English: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

tcz: Pakai lhacha Mose le Israel chaten hiche leng teni hi akisatpiuvin ajoutauve, hicheahi Pakai lhacha Mose in amani gamsung pumpi chu Reuben chate leh Gad chate chuleh Manasseh phung kehkhat chenna dia anapeh ahi.
en: Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
text:
JOS 12:6
Thadou: Pakai lhacha Mose le Israel chaten hiche leng teni hi akisatpiuvin ajoutauve, hicheahi Pakai lhacha Mose in amani gamsung pumpi chu Reuben chate leh Gad chate chuleh Manasseh phung kehkhat chenna dia anapeh ahi.
English: Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

tcz: Jordan vadung gal nilhumlam Lebanon phaicham Baal-gad kiti laiya patna Seir niso lamma hung kikhangdoh Halak molsang geija Joshua leh Israel chaten asatgammuva Joshua’n agamjouseu Israel phung mite chenna dia anapehdoh agamnei lengho chu hichenghi ahiuvin,
en: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

tcz: Agam hop monghi thinglhang gamsung jong, phaigam jong Arabah gamsung jong molken suhsejong, gamthip sungjong, Nageb gamsung jong ahin, Hit mite, Amor mite, Canaan mite Periz mite, Hivi mite chule Jebus gamsung sese chu ahi.
en: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
text:
JOS 12:8
Thadou: Agam hop monghi thinglhang gamsung jong, phaigam jong Arabah gamsung jong molken suhsejong, gamthip sungjong, Nageb gamsung jong ahin, Hit mite, Amor mite, Canaan mite Periz mite, Hivi mite chule Jebus gamsung sese chu ahi.
English: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

tcz: Alengho chu Jericho lengpa ahin Bethel khopia konna Ai khopi lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;

tcz: Jerusalem lengpa ahin, Hebron lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

tcz: Jermuth lengpa ahin, Lachish lengpa khat ahin,
en: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

tcz: Eglon lengpa ahin, Gezer lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

tcz: Debir lengpa ahin, Geder lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

tcz: Hormah lengpa ahin, Arad lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

tcz: Libnah lengpa ahin, Adullam lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

tcz: Makkedah lengpa ahin, Bethel lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

tcz: Tappuah lengpa ahin, Hepher lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

tcz: Aphah lengpa ahin, Lasher’on lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;

tcz: Madon lengpa ahin, Hazor lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

tcz: Shimron-meron lengpa ahin, Ach-shaph lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Shimron Meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

tcz: Taunach lengpa ahin, Magiddo lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

tcz: Kadesh lengpa ahin, Carmel molla Jokni’am lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;

tcz: Naphatdor gamma Dor lengpa ahin, Galilee gamma Goi’im lengpa ahin,
en: the king of Dor in the height of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;

tcz: Tirzah lengpa khatjong ahin, abonchan leng somthum le khat chu anajouvin ahi.
en: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty-one.
text:
JOS 12:24
Thadou: Tirzah lengpa khatjong ahin, abonchan leng somthum le khat chu anajouvin ahi.
English: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty-one.

tcz: Joshua chu atehtan akum jong atamlheh tan, hichun Pakaiyin akomma hitihin thu ahin seijin ahi, “Nangla natehtan, nakumjong atamthim lhehtan ahinlah gamlahding hi atamlheh jeng nalaijin ahi.
en: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. The LORD said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.
text:
JOS 13:1
Thadou: Joshua chu atehtan akum jong atamlheh tan, hichun Pakaiyin akomma hitihin thu ahin seijin ahi, “Nangla natehtan, nakumjong atamthim lhehtan ahinlah gamlahding hi atamlheh jeng nalaijin ahi.
English: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. The LORD said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.

tcz: Gamlahding vatnalai hochu Philistinete gamleh Geshur gamho sese jong ahinalaije.
en: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;

tcz: Egypt solam’a um Sihor gamma konna Ekron solam gamgi changgei (Canaan gammia kisimma ahi) chuleh Philistine vaipote nga ho, Gaza, Ashdod, Gath, leh Ekron jong ahopmin chuleh Avvit mite gamjong ahopthan ahi.
en: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,
text:
JOS 13:3
Thadou: Egypt solam’a um Sihor gamma konna Ekron solam gamgi changgei (Canaan gammia kisimma ahi) chuleh Philistine vaipote nga ho, Gaza, Ashdod, Gath, leh Ekron jong ahopmin chuleh Avvit mite gamjong ahopthan ahi.
English: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,

tcz: Lhanglam gamma ahileh Canaan mite gampumpi ahin, chule Sidon mite gamsunga Maarah changgei leh Aphek gei, chujongleh Amor mite gamgi changgei ahin,
en: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;

tcz: Gebal mite leh Lebanon gampumpi, nisolam lengsese, Baal-gad khopi apat Hermon molsang nisolam gei ahin, Hamath khopi jotna kotphung gei ahithai,
en: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;

tcz: Chule Lebanon apatna Misrephothmaim changgeija mite ahiuvin, Sidon mite pumpummin thinglhang gamma cheng thinglhang mite aboncha ahiuve. Mihem hijat hi aboncha keima mong mong’in Israel chate masanga kadelmang ding ahi, nangma kahilla kathupeh bang bangchun agamhi Israelten alouva achenpha diuvin hoppeh poupou tan.
en: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.
text:
JOS 13:6
Thadou: Chule Lebanon apatna Misrephothmaim changgeija mite ahiuvin, Sidon mite pumpummin thinglhang gamma cheng thinglhang mite aboncha ahiuve. Mihem hijat hi aboncha keima mong mong’in Israel chate masanga kadelmang ding ahi, nangma kahilla kathupeh bang bangchun agamhi Israelten alouva achenpha diuvin hoppeh poupou tan.
English: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.

tcz: Chuti ahiyeh chun nangman tuhin hiche gamhi Israel phung holeh Manasseh phung kehkhat goulo din hoppehtan” ati.
en: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”
text:
JOS 13:7
Thadou: Chuti ahiyeh chun nangman tuhin hiche gamhi Israel phung holeh Manasseh phung kehkhat goulo din hoppehtan” ati.
English: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”

tcz: Manasseh phung kehkhat leh Reuben chate chule Gad chate chun Pakai lhacha Mose’n apehsao Jordan vadung gal nisolam gamsung chu agoulo achan diuvin akisem tauve.
en: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them:
text:
JOS 13:8
Thadou: Manasseh phung kehkhat leh Reuben chate chule Gad chate chun Pakai lhacha Mose’n apehsao Jordan vadung gal nisolam gamsung chu agoulo achan diuvin akisem tauve.
English: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them:

tcz: Agamchu Arnon phaicham pamchinna Aroer khopia pat phaicham lailunga khopi changgei ahipeh’in Madaba gam dokhang banga kikhangdohlai jong ahopsoh keijin Dibon changei ahi.
en: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;

tcz: Heshbon lengvaipo Amor mite lengpa Sihon khopi jouse jong ahin Ammon mite gamgi changei ahi.
en: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;

tcz: Chujongleh Gilead gam ahin, Geshur mite leh Ma-acath mite lhangmang geijin ahopmin Hermon molsang pumpi jong ahin, chuleh Bashan pumpi ahop peh’in Salicah gei ahipeh’e.
en: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;

tcz: Ashtaroth khopi le Edrei khopia lengvaipoa anapang Bashan gamsunga Og lengpa lenggam abonchan ahopmin hiche Og kitipa hi Repham mite lah’a achangseh'a anahingdoh mikhat jong ahi, hichengse hi Mose in gal’a akisatpia ajosoh keija adelmang sohkei ahi.
en: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.
text:
JOS 13:12
Thadou: Ashtaroth khopi le Edrei khopia lengvaipoa anapang Bashan gamsunga Og lengpa lenggam abonchan ahopmin hiche Og kitipa hi Repham mite lah’a achangseh'a anahingdoh mikhat jong ahi, hichengse hi Mose in gal’a akisatpia ajosoh keija adelmang sohkei ahi.
English: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.

tcz: Ahinlah Israel chaten Geshur mite leh Ma-acath mite chu tuni geijin Israel lailunga acheng cheng tauvin ahi.
en: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.
text:
JOS 13:13
Thadou: Ahinlah Israel chaten Geshur mite leh Ma-acath mite chu tuni geijin Israel lailunga acheng cheng tauvin ahi.
English: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.

tcz: Mose in goulo ding apehlouhel phung chu Levi phungbou ahitai. Pakaiyin aseipeh banga Pakai Israel Pathen henga govam thilto chengse chu Levite chanding agoulo diuva ummah ahi.
en: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of the LORD, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.
text:
JOS 13:14
Thadou: Mose in goulo ding apehlouhel phung chu Levi phungbou ahitai. Pakaiyin aseipeh banga Pakai Israel Pathen henga govam thilto chengse chu Levite chanding agoulo diuva ummah ahi.
English: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of the LORD, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.

tcz: Reuben chate phung jongchu Mose in ama ama insung dungjui cheh’in agoulo diu anapei.
en: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.
text:
JOS 13:15
Thadou: Reuben chate phung jongchu Mose in ama ama insung dungjui cheh’in agoulo diu anapei.
English: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.

tcz: Hijechun Reuben phung mite gamgi hopchu ahileh Arnon phaicham pamchinna kisa Aroer khopia kipan chuche phaicham lailunga khopi changei ahin, Medeba gam dokhang banga kikhangdoh chengse jong ahopme.
en: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;

tcz: Heshbon khopi jong ahin dokhang banga kikhangdoh gamsunga Heshbon khopi jouse chutoh ahithai, akhopi hochu Dibon leh Bamoth leh Bamoth-baal, Bethbaalmeon jong ahin,
en: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
text:
JOS 13:17
Thadou: Heshbon khopi jong ahin dokhang banga kikhangdoh gamsunga Heshbon khopi jouse chutoh ahithai, akhopi hochu Dibon leh Bamoth leh Bamoth-baal, Bethbaalmeon jong ahin,
English: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

tcz: Jahaz jong Kedemoth jong Mepha-ath jong,
en: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
text:
JOS 13:18
Thadou: Jahaz jong Kedemoth jong Mepha-ath jong,
English: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

tcz: Kiriatha-im jong Sibmah jong phaikola thinglhang vumma Zereth Shahar jong,
en: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,
text:
JOS 13:19
Thadou: Kiriatha-im jong Sibmah jong phaikola thinglhang vumma Zereth Shahar jong,
English: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,

tcz: Bethpoer jong Pisgah lhang panglang sese jong Beth-jishimoth jong ahi.
en: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,
text:
JOS 13:20
Thadou: Bethpoer jong Pisgah lhang panglang sese jong Beth-jishimoth jong ahi.
English: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,

tcz: Hicheng lah’a hi dokhang langa kido gamsunga khopi jouse leh Amor mite lengpa Sihon lenggam pumpi ahithai, hiche Sihon hi Heshbon khopia lengvaipoa anapang ahin Mose in hiche Sihon hileh Midian lamkai ho Evi, Rekem, Zurle Hur chule Reba kiti Sihon lengpa chapate agamsunga chengse chu anajotha ahitai.
en: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.
text:
JOS 13:21
Thadou: Hicheng lah’a hi dokhang langa kido gamsunga khopi jouse leh Amor mite lengpa Sihon lenggam pumpi ahithai, hiche Sihon hi Heshbon khopia lengvaipoa anapang ahin Mose in hiche Sihon hileh Midian lamkai ho Evi, Rekem, Zurle Hur chule Reba kiti Sihon lengpa chapate agamsunga chengse chu anajotha ahitai.
English: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.

tcz: Baalam kitipa Beor chapa phunsan thempa jongchu Israel chaten midang atha lah uva chu chemjamma asatlihthau ahitan ahi.
en: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.
text:
JOS 13:22
Thadou: Baalam kitipa Beor chapa phunsan thempa jongchu Israel chaten midang atha lah uva chu chemjamma asatlihthau ahitan ahi.
English: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.

tcz: Hitihin Reuben chate gamgi chu Jordan vadung hi ahiyenge. Hichehi Reuben chate goulo ahin, ama ama insung dungjui cheh’a khopiho jong khoneoho jong chentha cheh ahiuve.
en: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.
text:
JOS 13:23
Thadou: Hitihin Reuben chate gamgi chu Jordan vadung hi ahiyenge. Hichehi Reuben chate goulo ahin, ama ama insung dungjui cheh’a khopiho jong khoneoho jong chentha cheh ahiuve.
English: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.

tcz: Gad phung jongchu Mose’in ama ama insung dungjui cheh in goulo gam anapei.
en: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.
text:
JOS 13:24
Thadou: Gad phung jongchu Mose’in ama ama insung dungjui cheh in goulo gam anapei.
English: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.

tcz: Chule Gad chate gamgi hopsese chu, Jazer kho ahin, Gilead gam khopi chengse ahin, Ammon mite gamsung kehkhat toh ahin, chule Rabbah nisolama um Aroer khopi gei ahiye.
en: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;

tcz: Chuin Heshbon khopia pat Ramath-mizpeh le Betonim khopi gei ahin, chule Mahanaim khopia pat Lo-debar gamsung gei ahiye.
en: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;

tcz: Chutengleh phaichamma ahileh Beth-haram ahin, Beth-nimrah ahin, Succoth ahin, chule Zaphon le Heshbon lengpa Sihon lenggam sunga adang jouse toh ahitha’n, Jordan gamgia vadung gamgia panga Jordan vadung gallama niso lamma Galilee tuilen tolam among lamtoh kimatpai ahitai.
en: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.
text:
JOS 13:27
Thadou: Chutengleh phaichamma ahileh Beth-haram ahin, Beth-nimrah ahin, Succoth ahin, chule Zaphon le Heshbon lengpa Sihon lenggam sunga adang jouse toh ahitha’n, Jordan gamgia vadung gamgia panga Jordan vadung gallama niso lamma Galilee tuilen tolam among lamtoh kimatpai ahitai.
English: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.

tcz: Hichehi ama ama insung dungjui cheh’a akhopi jouse leh akhoneo jouse pumpumma kihoppeh Gad chate gamchan agoulou ahi.
en: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.
text:
JOS 13:28
Thadou: Hichehi ama ama insung dungjui cheh’a akhopi jouse leh akhoneo jouse pumpumma kihoppeh Gad chate gamchan agoulou ahi.
English: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.

tcz: Manasseh phung kehkhat jong chu Mose in goulo gam anapen agam goulo chu Manasseh phung kehkhat jong ama ama insung dungjui cheh’in akihom’uvin ahi.
en: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.
text:
JOS 13:29
Thadou: Manasseh phung kehkhat jong chu Mose in goulo gam anapen agam goulo chu Manasseh phung kehkhat jong ama ama insung dungjui cheh’in akihom’uvin ahi.
English: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.

tcz: Manasseh phung kehkhat gamhop lhang le molchu Mahanaim a ahung kipannin, Bashan gamsung jouse ahin adeh deh’in Bashan gamma Og lengpa lenggam pumpitoh Bashan gamsunga um Jair kholendom jouse jong ahin, abonchan khopi somgup jen alhing’in,
en: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.
text:
JOS 13:30
Thadou: Manasseh phung kehkhat gamhop lhang le molchu Mahanaim a ahung kipannin, Bashan gamsung jouse ahin adeh deh’in Bashan gamma Og lengpa lenggam pumpitoh Bashan gamsunga um Jair kholendom jouse jong ahin, abonchan khopi somgup jen alhing’in,
English: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.

tcz: Gilead kikahtoh, Asharoth toh Edrei toh ahin, abonna hi Bashan gamsunga Og lengpa lenggama khopi jong ahiuve, hijat hi Manasseh chapa Makir chate leh Makir phungmite alangkhat kihomma ama ama insung dungjuija chan kipesohkei ahiuve.
en: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.
text:
JOS 13:31
Thadou: Gilead kikahtoh, Asharoth toh Edrei toh ahin, abonna hi Bashan gamsunga Og lengpa lenggama khopi jong ahiuve, hijat hi Manasseh chapa Makir chate leh Makir phungmite alangkhat kihomma ama ama insung dungjuija chan kipesohkei ahiuve.
English: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.

tcz: Gam goulo hijatpihi Mose in Jordan vadung gal Jericho khopi nisolam Moab phaichamma anahopdoh ahitai.
en: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.
text:
JOS 13:32
Thadou: Gam goulo hijatpihi Mose in Jordan vadung gal Jericho khopi nisolam Moab phaichamma anahopdoh ahitai.
English: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.

tcz: Levi phung vangchu Mose in goulo gam achansah poi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin ajah uva aseisa banga Pakai Israel Pathen chu Levite goulo ahiyenge.
en: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.
text:
JOS 13:33
Thadou: Levi phung vangchu Mose in goulo gam achansah poi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin ajah uva aseisa banga Pakai Israel Pathen chu Levite goulo ahiyenge.
English: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.

tcz: Canaan gamsunga Eleazer thempupa leh Nun chapa Joshua chuleh apu apau, insung lhah dungjuija Israel chate phung jousea lamkai hon Israel chate goulo dia ana hoppeh u, Israel chaten jong akisan cheh agoulo’u gamsung cheh chu hichenghi ahi.
en: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,
text:
JOS 14:1
Thadou: Canaan gamsunga Eleazer thempupa leh Nun chapa Joshua chuleh apu apau, insung lhah dungjuija Israel chate phung jousea lamkai hon Israel chate goulo dia ana hoppeh u, Israel chaten jong akisan cheh agoulo’u gamsung cheh chu hichenghi ahi.
English: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,

tcz: Israel phungkole akeh khat gam kihop dingdolla Pakaiyin Mose thu anapeh bang bangin agoulo diu gamchan chu vang kisana kihom anahi.
en: by the lot of their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.
text:
JOS 14:2
Thadou: Israel phungkole akeh khat gam kihop dingdolla Pakaiyin Mose thu anapeh bang bangin agoulo diu gamchan chu vang kisana kihom anahi.
English: by the lot of their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.

tcz: Israel phungni le phung kehkhat vang chu Mose in agoulo diuva Jordan vadung gallama gam anapehsa ahitai, Levi phungmite chu Israel lah a gouloding gam apeh lou mong mong ahi.
en: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.
text:
JOS 14:3
Thadou: Israel phungni le phung kehkhat vang chu Mose in agoulo diuva Jordan vadung gallama gam anapehsa ahitai, Levi phungmite chu Israel lah a gouloding gam apeh lou mong mong ahi.
English: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

tcz: Chujongleh Joseph Chate chu phungni akisouvin, Manasseh le Ephraim ahi, Levite vangchu gamsunga amaho chanding gam akipepon, achenna diu khopi mai ail eh gancha vahna diu hamhing gamtoh athilkeo u maimaibou ahi.
en: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.
text:
JOS 14:4
Thadou: Chujongleh Joseph Chate chu phungni akisouvin, Manasseh le Ephraim ahi, Levite vangchu gamsunga amaho chanding gam akipepon, achenna diu khopi mai ail eh gancha vahna diu hamhing gamtoh athilkeo u maimaibou ahi.
English: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose ahilla athupeh bang bangin Israel chaten abolsoh keiyin gam akihom tauve.
en: The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses, and they divided the land.
text:
JOS 14:5
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose ahilla athupeh bang bangin Israel chaten abolsoh keiyin gam akihom tauve.
English: The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses, and they divided the land.

tcz: Gilgal achun Judah chate thalheng in miphabep Kenizz mi kitipa, Jephunneh Chapa Caleb lamkai nan ahung kitol touvin,Joshua jah a chun hitin aseiyin, “Kadesh Barnea kiti munna chu keile nang chungchang thudolla Pakaiyin Pathenmi Mose jaha ipi anaseipeh geldoh in.
en: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the thing that the LORD spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea.
text:
JOS 14:6
Thadou: Gilgal achun Judah chate thalheng in miphabep Kenizz mi kitipa, Jephunneh Chapa Caleb lamkai nan ahung kitol touvin,Joshua jah a chun hitin aseiyin, “Kadesh Barnea kiti munna chu keile nang chungchang thudolla Pakaiyin Pathenmi Mose jaha ipi anaseipeh geldoh in.
English: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the thing that the LORD spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea.

tcz: Pakai lhacha Mose Kadesh-barnea muna konna Cannan gam velhidia eina sol chun keima kum somli kana lhingtai, hichea chun keiman kalungsunga kahet chanchu Mose henga thu kahin lhutnin ahi.
en: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land. I brought him word again as it was in my heart.
text:
JOS 14:7
Thadou: Pakai lhacha Mose Kadesh-barnea muna konna Cannan gam velhidia eina sol chun keima kum somli kana lhingtai, hichea chun keiman kalungsunga kahet chanchu Mose henga thu kahin lhutnin ahi.
English: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land. I brought him word again as it was in my heart.

tcz: Ahinla kachepi khompi kasopiho chun gamptep gam jotlutding chu mipi lungthim asulhadeh jeng un ahi, ahinlah keivangin Pakai ka Pathen chu lungthim pumpin kajui lhum keijin ahi.
en: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed the LORD my God.
text:
JOS 14:8
Thadou: Ahinla kachepi khompi kasopiho chun gamptep gam jotlutding chu mipi lungthim asulhadeh jeng un ahi, ahinlah keivangin Pakai ka Pathen chu lungthim pumpin kajui lhum keijin ahi.
English: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed the LORD my God.

tcz: Hijeh chun hiche nikho chun, Mose akihahsel in aseitan ahi,”Tahbehin nakengphang achotphana muntinchu aitih a nangle nachilhahte goullo dinga nachan ding ahi, ajeh chu nangin Pakai ka Pathen chu najuilhum keiyin ahi” einatin ahi.
en: Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have wholly followed the LORD my God.’
text:
JOS 14:9
Thadou: Hijeh chun hiche nikho chun, Mose akihahsel in aseitan ahi,”Tahbehin nakengphang achotphana muntinchu aitih a nangle nachilhahte goullo dinga nachan ding ahi, ajeh chu nangin Pakai ka Pathen chu najuilhum keiyin ahi” einatin ahi.
English: Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have wholly followed the LORD my God.’

tcz: “Tun vetan, Pakiyin aseibang bangin Israel gamthip gamma akitolle laiya Pakiyin Mose jah a hiche thu anaseija pat tuphat geihin keima eihing hoinalaiyin, tuhin kum somgetlenga kalhingtai.
en: “Now, behold, the LORD has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that the LORD spoke this word to Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness. Now, behold, I am eighty-five years old, today.
text:
JOS 14:10
Thadou: “Tun vetan, Pakiyin aseibang bangin Israel gamthip gamma akitolle laiya Pakiyin Mose jah a hiche thu anaseija pat tuphat geihin keima eihing hoinalaiyin, tuhin kum somgetlenga kalhingtai.
English: “Now, behold, the LORD has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that the LORD spoke this word to Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness. Now, behold, I am eighty-five years old, today.

tcz: Tuni geihin Mose’n gamvea einasol lai bangin katha ahat nalaiyin, hichepetna katha hat bang bangin kahat nalaiyin, galkon theileh gallamkaithei kahi nalaije.
en: As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now for war, to go out and to come in.
text:
JOS 14:11
Thadou: Tuni geihin Mose’n gamvea einasol lai bangin katha ahat nalaiyin, hichepetna katha hat bang bangin kahat nalaiyin, galkon theileh gallamkaithei kahi nalaije.
English: As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now for war, to go out and to come in.

tcz: Chuti ahiyeh chun Chuche nikhoa Pakaiyin eina teppeh bang bangchun hiche molkhu neipetan. Gamvellhi ichelai’juva thupitah a khopi kul kigetkhum ho sunga cheng Anak chilhah hochu nahen ahi. Ahiyeng vang'in Pakaiyin eiumpileh Aman aseibang banga ama hokhu kajoa kanodoh ding ahi,” ati.
en: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which the LORD spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that the LORD will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as the LORD said.”
text:
JOS 14:12
Thadou: Chuti ahiyeh chun Chuche nikhoa Pakaiyin eina teppeh bang bangchun hiche molkhu neipetan. Gamvellhi ichelai’juva thupitah a khopi kul kigetkhum ho sunga cheng Anak chilhah hochu nahen ahi. Ahiyeng vang'in Pakaiyin eiumpileh Aman aseibang banga ama hokhu kajoa kanodoh ding ahi,” ati.
English: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which the LORD spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that the LORD will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as the LORD said.”

tcz: Hitichun Jephunneh Chapa Caleb chu Joshua’n phatthei aboh in ama chantum dingin Hebron chu anapetan ahi.
en: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.
text:
JOS 14:13
Thadou: Hitichun Jephunneh Chapa Caleb chu Joshua’n phatthei aboh in ama chantum dingin Hebron chu anapetan ahi.
English: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

tcz: Hitihin, Hebron chu Jephunneh Chapa Caleb le achilhahte achengden tauvin ahi, ajeh chu aman Israel Pakai Pathen chu anajuilhum keijin ahi.
en: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed the LORD, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.
text:
JOS 14:14
Thadou: Hitihin, Hebron chu Jephunneh Chapa Caleb le achilhahte achengden tauvin ahi, ajeh chu aman Israel Pakai Pathen chu anajuilhum keijin ahi.
English: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed the LORD, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.

tcz: (Tumasang chun Hebron hi Kiriath-arba ana kitin ahi. Hichehi Anak chilhah galhat penpa Arba minna kisah ahi) Hitichun gamleiset chu galdouna a kon in anakicholdotan ahi.
en: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.
text:
JOS 14:15
Thadou: (Tumasang chun Hebron hi Kiriath-arba ana kitin ahi. Hichehi Anak chilhah galhat penpa Arba minna kisah ahi) Hitichun gamleiset chu galdouna a kon in anakicholdotan ahi.
English: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.

tcz: Judah phung sunga chun ainsung dungjui cheh a achandiu chu hitihin akihoppehin ahi. Zin gammanga Edom gamgi lhanglang chu alhangnung penna gamgi chu ahitai.
en: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.
text:
JOS 15:1
Thadou: Judah phung sunga chun ainsung dungjui cheh a achandiu chu hitihin akihoppehin ahi. Zin gammanga Edom gamgi lhanglang chu alhangnung penna gamgi chu ahitai.
English: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.

tcz: Chuleh lhanglang gamgichu lhanglang ngat tuikolla pat Chitwilen lang changei ahi.
en: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;

tcz: Hitichun Akrabbim lhanglang ninga achesuh in Zin gam ahopan, Kadesh-barnea lhanglang ning langa akaltouvin, chuleh Hezron ahopan chuleh Adar langa akaltouvin chuleh Karka vel kollang ahopan ahi.
en: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;

tcz: Hichea kon chun Azmon lang ajonnin achainan Egypt vadung langa achepeh in Mediterranean twikhanglen changei alhungin ahi. Hichehi amaho lhanglang gamgi chu ahitai.
en: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.
text:
JOS 15:4
Thadou: Hichea kon chun Azmon lang ajonnin achainan Egypt vadung langa achepeh in Mediterranean twikhanglen changei alhungin ahi. Hichehi amaho lhanglang gamgi chu ahitai.
English: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.

tcz: Chutengleh solam gamgichu Chitwilen changei akilhung dohin Jordan kom changeijin achepehin ahi. Sahlang gamkaiya gamgi chu Jordan vadung ola chun akipannin. Chitwilen achun alonglutnin ahi.
en: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.
text:
JOS 15:5
Thadou: Chutengleh solam gamgichu Chitwilen changei akilhung dohin Jordan kom changeijin achepehin ahi. Sahlang gamkaiya gamgi chu Jordan vadung ola chun akipannin. Chitwilen achun alonglutnin ahi.
English: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.

tcz: Beth-hoglah-a konin achetouvin Beth-arabah sahlang geijin ache-in Bohan songphung gei achu gamgi kilhungdoh peh in ahi.(Bohan chu Reuben chapa ahi).
en: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
text:
JOS 15:6
Thadou: Beth-hoglah-a konin achetouvin Beth-arabah sahlang geijin ache-in Bohan songphung gei achu gamgi kilhungdoh peh in ahi.(Bohan chu Reuben chapa ahi).
English: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

tcz: Hichea patna gamgi chu Achor phaicham Dabir la konna chetoupeh a Gilgal langa chetouva ahi. Hichehi Adummin kaltouna masang ahi. Gamgi chu En-shamesh tuitah geijin achepeh in En-rogel munnah akichaijin ahi.
en: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.
text:
JOS 15:7
Thadou: Hichea patna gamgi chu Achor phaicham Dabir la konna chetoupeh a Gilgal langa chetouva ahi. Hichehi Adummin kaltouna masang ahi. Gamgi chu En-shamesh tuitah geijin achepeh in En-rogel munnah akichaijin ahi.
English: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.

tcz: Gamgi chun Ben Hinnom phaicham chu apal galkaijin erusalem khopi kitundohna munlang Jebus mite chenna lhangsuh a chun akilhungdoh peh in ahi.
en: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.
text:
JOS 15:8
Thadou: Gamgi chun Ben Hinnom phaicham chu apal galkaijin erusalem khopi kitundohna munlang Jebus mite chenna lhangsuh a chun akilhungdoh peh in ahi.
English: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.

tcz: Hicheakon chun gamgi molsang chung vumma kon in ahung kijidoh in, Nephtoah tuiputna changeijin achetoupeh in, hichea kon chun Ephron lhang khopiho changeijin akilhunglutnin ahi. Hicheakon chun Baalah (Hichu Kiriath-jearim akiti’e) akiheilut’a ahi.
en: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (also called Kiriath Jearim);

tcz: Gamgi chun Baalah lhumlam avellin Seir thinglhang chu ajonlutnin, Jearim molsang sahlama Kesalon khopi sung ahohpan, chuin Beth-shemesh langa akigolsuh in, Timnah lang ajotpaije
en: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim (also called Chesalon) on the north, and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;

tcz: Hichea konchun gamgi chu Ekron sahlang thinglhang chu ajonlutnin hichea kon chun Shikkeron leh Baalah lhanglang ajonnin ahi.Hichebanna chun Jabneel ahohpan Mediterranean twikhanglennah akichaijin ahi.
en: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
text:
JOS 15:11
Thadou: Hichea konchun gamgi chu Ekron sahlang thinglhang chu ajonlutnin hichea kon chun Shikkeron leh Baalah lhanglang ajonnin ahi.Hichebanna chun Jabneel ahohpan Mediterranean twikhanglennah akichaijin ahi.
English: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

tcz: Lhumlam gamgi chu Mediterranean twikhanglenpangjui chu ahipehe.Hichehi Juda phung bahkaiho gamgi chu ahi.
en: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.
text:
JOS 15:12
Thadou: Lhumlam gamgi chu Mediterranean twikhanglenpangjui chu ahipehe.Hichehi Juda phung bahkaiho gamgi chu ahi.
English: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.

tcz: Pakaiyin Judah gambihkhatchu Jephunneh chapa Caleb apehdingin Joshua chu thu apen ahi.Hijeh chun Caleb chu Kiriath-arba (Hebron tina ahi) khopichu apen ahi. Hiche Hebron hi Anak apu apateu minkhatna anakiminvo ahi.
en: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).
text:
JOS 15:13
Thadou: Pakaiyin Judah gambihkhatchu Jephunneh chapa Caleb apehdingin Joshua chu thu apen ahi.Hijeh chun Caleb chu Kiriath-arba (Hebron tina ahi) khopichu apen ahi. Hiche Hebron hi Anak apu apateu minkhatna anakiminvo ahi.
English: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).

tcz: Caleb chun Anak chate Sheshai, Ahiman leh Talmai chilhah hon thum hochu ana no doh in ahi.
en: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
text:
JOS 15:14
Thadou: Caleb chun Anak chate Sheshai, Ahiman leh Talmai chilhah hon thum hochu ana no doh in ahi.
English: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

tcz: Hichea kon chun Debir khopi (tumasanga chu Kiriath-sepher kiti ahi) achengte galkisatpi din anakontai.
en: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.
text:
JOS 15:15
Thadou: Hichea kon chun Debir khopi (tumasanga chu Kiriath-sepher kiti ahi) achengte galkisatpi din anakontai.
English: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.

tcz: Caleb min aseijin, “Koi hileh Kiriath-sepher nokhumna galla galjou penchu kachanu Acsah akichen pidinga kapeh ding ahi” ati.
en: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”
text:
JOS 15:16
Thadou: Caleb min aseijin, “Koi hileh Kiriath-sepher nokhumna galla galjou penchu kachanu Acsah akichen pidinga kapeh ding ahi” ati.
English: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”

tcz: Caleb sopipa Kenaz chapa Othniel chun aga joutan ahileh Acsah chu Othniel ji ahung hitai.
en: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
text:
JOS 15:17
Thadou: Caleb sopipa Kenaz chapa Othniel chun aga joutan ahileh Acsah chu Othniel ji ahung hitai.
English: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

tcz: Acsah in Othniel akichenpi chun amanun apa komma loumun khat thumdin ajipa chu angeh in ahi.Amanu asangan chunga konna akum lhahchun Caleb in “Ipi nadeiham?” tin anadonge.
en: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”
text:
JOS 15:18
Thadou: Acsah in Othniel akichenpi chun amanun apa komma loumun khat thumdin ajipa chu angeh in ahi.Amanu asangan chunga konna akum lhahchun Caleb in “Ipi nadeiham?” tin anadonge.
English: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”

tcz: Amanun aseijin, “Negev ma gamkhat bon neipeh ahitahleh twinah khatjong neipehthan ati.” Hitichun Caleb injong sahlang twinah leh lhanglang twinah khat apen ahi.
en: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
text:
JOS 15:19
Thadou: Amanun aseijin, “Negev ma gamkhat bon neipeh ahitahleh twinah khatjong neipehthan ati.” Hitichun Caleb injong sahlang twinah leh lhanglang twinah khat apen ahi.
English: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

tcz: Hichehi Judah phungin abahkai abahkai dungjuija ainsung chehuva achenna diuva kipe munchu ahi.
en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
text:
JOS 15:20
Thadou: Hichehi Judah phungin abahkai abahkai dungjuija ainsung chehuva achenna diuva kipe munchu ahi.
English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

en: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;

tcz: Ekron na kon chun lhumlam gamgi chin geijin akijedohin Ashdod komma khogeiho leh khoho jouse jong ahop’in ahi.
en: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.
text:

Thadou: Ekron na kon chun lhumlam gamgi chin geijin akijedohin Ashdod komma khogeiho leh khoho jouse jong ahop’in ahi.
English: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.

tcz: Ashdod avella khojouse chule Gaza le asunga khohojouse, Egypt vadung leh Mediterranean twikhanglen pang changei ahopmin ahi.
en: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.

Thadou: Ashdod avella khojouse chule Gaza le asunga khohojouse, Egypt vadung leh Mediterranean twikhanglen pang changei ahopmin ahi.
