tcz: Ahin Judah phungin Jerusalem ma cheng Jebu mite ana nodoh joupouvin, hijeh chun tuni chan geijin Jebu mitehi Judah te toh acheng khom jengun ahi.
en: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
text:
JOS 15:63
Thadou: Ahin Judah phungin Jerusalem ma cheng Jebu mite ana nodoh joupouvin, hijeh chun tuni chan geijin Jebu mitehi Judah te toh acheng khom jengun ahi.
English: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.

tcz: Joseph chilhah ho chanding kipehochu Jericho komma Jordan vadunga kon in ahung kilhungin, Jericho twinah solam, gamthip gam hoipen Bethel thinglhanga alutnin ahi.
en: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.
text:
JOS 16:1
Thadou: Joseph chilhah ho chanding kipehochu Jericho komma Jordan vadunga kon in ahung kilhungin, Jericho twinah solam, gamthip gam hoipen Bethel thinglhanga alutnin ahi.
English: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.

tcz: Bethel a kon in Ataroth apalgal kaijin Arki mite gamma alutnin ahi.
en: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;

tcz: Hichea konchun lhumlama akum suhin Japhlet mite gamma alutnin Beth-horon changeijin alutnin, chea kon chun Gezer lah alutnin Mediterranean twikhanglen'a alut galkaijin ahi.
en: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea.
text:
JOS 16:3
Thadou: Hichea konchun lhumlama akum suhin Japhlet mite gamma alutnin Beth-horon changeijin alutnin, chea kon chun Gezer lah alutnin Mediterranean twikhanglen'a alut galkaijin ahi.
English: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea.

tcz: Hiche hi Joseph chate Manasseh leh Ephraim insungmite gamlo dinga kipe ahi.
en: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
text:
JOS 16:4
Thadou: Hiche hi Joseph chate Manasseh leh Ephraim insungmite gamlo dinga kipe ahi.
English: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

tcz: Noija hohi Ephraim phung abahjam hojouse achandiova kipe ahi. Amaho gamloding solam gamgi chu Ataroth-addar a kipan ahi. Hichea kon chun Beth-horon sahlanga alutnin,
en: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.
text:
JOS 16:5
Thadou: Noija hohi Ephraim phung abahjam hojouse achandiova kipe ahi. Amaho gamloding solam gamgi chu Ataroth-addar a kipan ahi. Hichea kon chun Beth-horon sahlanga alutnin,
English: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.

tcz: Chujouvin Mediterranian twikhanglen'ah alutnin ahi. Micmethath sahlanga kon in, gamgi chu ahung kon in Taanath-shiloh ahopan solam Janoah ajonnin ahi.
en: The border went out westward at Michmethath on the north. The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah.
text:
JOS 16:6
Thadou: Chujouvin Mediterranian twikhanglen'ah alutnin ahi. Micmethath sahlanga kon in, gamgi chu ahung kon in Taanath-shiloh ahopan solam Janoah ajonnin ahi.
English: The border went out westward at Michmethath on the north. The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah.

tcz: Janoah a kon in lhanglang ahin jonnin Ataroth le Naarah na alutnin Jericho hopan Jordan vadunga atangin ahi.
en: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
text:
JOS 16:7
Thadou: Janoah a kon in lhanglang ahin jonnin Ataroth le Naarah na alutnin Jericho hopan Jordan vadunga atangin ahi.
English: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.

tcz: Tappuah a patnin gamgichu lhumlam ma akilhung ngin Kanah vacha a kon in Mediterranian twikhanglen na alutnin ahi. Hichehi Ephraim phung bahkai jouse gamloding chu ahi.
en: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;

tcz: Hiche banna chun khopi phabep le vella khoho Manasseh phung kehkhat chandinga ana kipe jongchu Ephraim phung dingin akikoipih tan ahi.
en: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
text:
JOS 16:9
Thadou: Hiche banna chun khopi phabep le vella khoho Manasseh phung kehkhat chandinga ana kipe jongchu Ephraim phung dingin akikoipih tan ahi.
English: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

tcz: Amahon Gezer akonnin Canaan mite chu ananodoh joupouvin ahinlah Gezer mite chu tuni chan geijin Ephraim mite sohin apang taove.
en: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.
text:
JOS 16:10
Thadou: Amahon Gezer akonnin Canaan mite chu ananodoh joupouvin ahinlah Gezer mite chu tuni chan geijin Ephraim mite sohin apang taove.
English: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.

tcz: Gamloding kihopna abannachu Joseph chillhah chamasa Manasseh phung akehkhat chu akipen ahi. Makir Manesseh chamasa chu Gilead dia apa ahi. Ama chilhah hohi galhatmi ahiyehun Jordan solam gamkaija um Gilead le Bashan chu anakipesa ahi.
en: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
text:
JOS 17:1
Thadou: Gamloding kihopna abannachu Joseph chillhah chamasa Manasseh phung akehkhat chu akipen ahi. Makir Manesseh chamasa chu Gilead dia apa ahi. Ama chilhah hohi galhatmi ahiyehun Jordan solam gamkaija um Gilead le Bashan chu anakipesa ahi.
English: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

tcz: Hitichun Jordan lhumlam gamkai Abizer, Helek, Asreil, Sechom, Hepher, chuleh Shemida hohi Manasseh phungkhai sung lah’a avatnalai insungho chan ding ahi. Hiche bahkhai hohin Joseph cha Manasseh chilhah pasalho thalheng ahiuve.
en: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
text:
JOS 17:2
Thadou: Hitichun Jordan lhumlam gamkai Abizer, Helek, Asreil, Sechom, Hepher, chuleh Shemida hohi Manasseh phungkhai sung lah’a avatnalai insungho chan ding ahi. Hiche bahkhai hohin Joseph cha Manasseh chilhah pasalho thalheng ahiuve.
English: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

tcz: Ahiyeng vang'in Manasseh chapa Makir, Makir chapa Gilead, Gilead chapa Hepher, Hepher chapa Zelophahad chu cha neilou ahin, aman chanubou aneiyin amaho minchu Malah, Noah, Haglah, Milcah chuleh Tirzah ahiuve.
en: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
text:
JOS 17:3
Thadou: Ahiyeng vang'in Manasseh chapa Makir, Makir chapa Gilead, Gilead chapa Hepher, Hepher chapa Zelophahad chu cha neilou ahin, aman chanubou aneiyin amaho minchu Malah, Noah, Haglah, Milcah chuleh Tirzah ahiuve.
English: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

tcz: Hiche numei hohi, thempupa Eleazer, Nun chapa Joshua, chuleh Israel lamkaiho kommah ahungun hitin ahungseijun ahi, “Pakaiyin, Mose jah’a eyhole kasopiteu pasalho gamlodi eipehdiovin thupeh anapen ahi” atiove. Hijeh chun Joshua’n jong ama hochu Pakai thupeh banga apa-ngahteo chan bangin gamchu anapen ahi.
en: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.
text:
JOS 17:4
Thadou: Hiche numei hohi, thempupa Eleazer, Nun chapa Joshua, chuleh Israel lamkaiho kommah ahungun hitin ahungseijun ahi, “Pakaiyin, Mose jah’a eyhole kasopiteu pasalho gamlodi eipehdiovin thupeh anapen ahi” atiove. Hijeh chun Joshua’n jong ama hochu Pakai thupeh banga apa-ngahteo chan bangin gamchu anapen ahi.
English: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.

tcz: Hijeh chun Manasseh chan apumpi chu Jordan vadung galla Gilead leh Bashan gamchan banna chu gamchan oma hung lhingtan ahi.
en: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;

tcz: Ajeh chu Manasseh chilhah numei hojong pasal chilhah chanto kibanga achanjeh’u ahi. (Gilead gamchu Manasseh chilhah pasal amoh ho kipeh ahi).
en: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
text:
JOS 17:6
Thadou: Ajeh chu Manasseh chilhah numei hojong pasal chilhah chanto kibanga achanjeh’u ahi. (Gilead gamchu Manasseh chilhah pasal amoh ho kipeh ahi).
English: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.

tcz: Manasseh phung gamgichu Asher gamgi hina kon in Secheme kom Micmethath changei jin ahung kikholutnin ahi. Hichea konchun gamgichu Micmethath’a kon in achesuhin Tappuah twinah putna komma chenna munho geijin ahung kilhung lut in ahi.
en: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.
text:
JOS 17:7
Thadou: Manasseh phung gamgichu Asher gamgi hina kon in Secheme kom Micmethath changei jin ahung kikholutnin ahi. Hichea konchun gamgichu Micmethath’a kon in achesuhin Tappuah twinah putna komma chenna munho geijin ahung kilhung lut in ahi.
English: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.

tcz: Tappuah velkolla gamho chu Manasseh chan ahi. Manasseh gamgi a um Tappuah khopi tah vang chu Ephraim phung mite chan ahi.
en: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.
text:
JOS 17:8
Thadou: Tappuah velkolla gamho chu Manasseh chan ahi. Manasseh gamgi a um Tappuah khopi tah vang chu Ephraim phung mite chan ahi.
English: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.

tcz: Tappuah twinah putna akonnin Manasseh gamgi chun Kanah vadungneo chu ajuijin Meditteranean twikhanglen'ah alutnin ahi. Hiche vadungneo lhanglanga khopi phabep chu Manasseh gamsung ahi, ahinla hiche hochu atah beh’in Ephraim phungho chan ahi.
en: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.
text:
JOS 17:9
Thadou: Tappuah twinah putna akonnin Manasseh gamgi chun Kanah vadungneo chu ajuijin Meditteranean twikhanglen'ah alutnin ahi. Hiche vadungneo lhanglanga khopi phabep chu Manasseh gamsung ahi, ahinla hiche hochu atah beh’in Ephraim phungho chan ahi.
English: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.

tcz: Alhanglhon invang, hiche vadungneo lhanglam gamchu Ephraimte chan ahi, chuleh vadungneo sahlang gamchu Manasseh te chan ahi. Manasseh gamgi vadungneo sahlang gamkai chutoh akilhonin Mediterranean nah a atangin ahi. Manasseh sahlang chu Asher gam ahin chuleh sahlang vangchu Issachar gam ahi.
en: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.
text:
JOS 17:10
Thadou: Alhanglhon invang, hiche vadungneo lhanglam gamchu Ephraimte chan ahi, chuleh vadungneo sahlang gamchu Manasseh te chan ahi. Manasseh gamgi vadungneo sahlang gamkai chutoh akilhonin Mediterranean nah a atangin ahi. Manasseh sahlang chu Asher gam ahin chuleh sahlang vangchu Issachar gam ahi.
English: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.

tcz: Ahivangin Issachar le Asher gamgi sunga um khopi ho, Beth-shan khopi, Ibleam khopi, Dor khopi (Hichu Naphoth-dor), Endor, Taanach khopi chule Megiddo khopi holeh agamsunga cheng hojouse chu Manasseh chan din anakipe tan ahi.
en: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.
text:
JOS 17:11
Thadou: Ahivangin Issachar le Asher gamgi sunga um khopi ho, Beth-shan khopi, Ibleam khopi, Dor khopi (Hichu Naphoth-dor), Endor, Taanach khopi chule Megiddo khopi holeh agamsunga cheng hojouse chu Manasseh chan din anakipe tan ahi.
English: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.

tcz: Ahinlah Manasseh chilhah chengse chun hiche khopi ho chu analalut joupou vin ahi. Amahon Canaan mite chu anadel-mang jou pouvin tuni geijin aum nalaijun hai.
en: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
text:
JOS 17:12
Thadou: Ahinlah Manasseh chilhah chengse chun hiche khopi ho chu analalut joupou vin ahi. Amahon Canaan mite chu anadel-mang jou pouvin tuni geijin aum nalaijun hai.
English: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

tcz: Ahinlah khonunga Israelte ahung hatdoh phatnuvin Canaan mite chu soh in amang taovin ahi. Ahinlah agam sunguva kon in anodoh joupouvin ahi.
en: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
text:
JOS 17:13
Thadou: Ahinlah khonunga Israelte ahung hatdoh phatnuvin Canaan mite chu soh in amang taovin ahi. Ahinlah agam sunguva kon in anodoh joupouvin ahi.
English: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

tcz: Joseph chilhahte Joshua kommah ahungun hiti hin ahung dong’ui, “Pakaiyin hibanga eipunsahuva ipi dinga kachenna dio gamhi chan khatbou neipeh ham?”
en: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because the LORD has blessed us so far?”
text:
JOS 17:14
Thadou: Joseph chilhahte Joshua kommah ahungun hiti hin ahung dong’ui, “Pakaiyin hibanga eipunsahuva ipi dinga kachenna dio gamhi chan khatbou neipeh ham?”
English: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because the LORD has blessed us so far?”

tcz: Joshua’n adonbutnin “Nangho natamlheh jengtah uva Ephraim thinglhang gam nangho dinga aneotaha ahileh hiche Periz mitele Reph mite channa gammang lahkhu nangho dingin gakisuhtheng taovin atipeh in ahi.”
en: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”
text:
JOS 17:15
Thadou: Joshua’n adonbutnin “Nangho natamlheh jengtah uva Ephraim thinglhang gam nangho dinga aneotaha ahileh hiche Periz mitele Reph mite channa gammang lahkhu nangho dingin gakisuhtheng taovin atipeh in ahi.”
English: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”

tcz: Joseph chilhahte chun adonbutnin, “Thinglhang gamhi keiho dingin alhing joupoi katiu hi atahbeh ahi. Ahinlah Canaan mite gamnomma cheng holeh Jezreel phaichamma um hohin thih sakol kangtalai aneiyun, amahohi keihon kadoudio vin ahahsa valle atiove.”
en: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”
text:
JOS 17:16
Thadou: Joseph chilhahte chun adonbutnin, “Thinglhang gamhi keiho dingin alhing joupoi katiu hi atahbeh ahi. Ahinlah Canaan mite gamnomma cheng holeh Jezreel phaichamma um hohin thih sakol kangtalai aneiyun, amahohi keihon kadoudio vin ahahsa valle atiove.”
English: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”

tcz: Hichun Joshua’n Joseph chilhahte Ephraim le Manasseh phungmi teho kommah hitin aseije “Nanghohi natammuve nahatlheh jeng taove ahileh nangho dingahi chan khatval kipeding nahiuve.
en: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;

tcz: Thinglhang gammang lahkhu nangho nachan bediu ahi. Nanghon nasuhtheng nom chanun gakisuhthengun agam lapen aningkoi changeijin galo tauvin phaichamma Canaan mite jeng jongkhu hatlheh uhenlang thih sakol kangtalai neijongleo ganodoh taovin,” ati.
en: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”
text:
JOS 17:18
Thadou: Thinglhang gammang lahkhu nangho nachan bediu ahi. Nanghon nasuhtheng nom chanun gakisuhthengun agam lapen aningkoi changeijin galo tauvin phaichamma Canaan mite jeng jongkhu hatlheh uhenlang thih sakol kangtalai neijongleo ganodoh taovin,” ati.
English: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”

tcz: Tunvang gamsung chu Israelte khut noiya uma ahitai, Israel mite chu abonchauvin Shiloh a akikhomun hichea chun kikhopna ponbuhkhat atungdohn tauve.
en: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.
text:
JOS 18:1
Thadou: Tunvang gamsung chu Israelte khut noiya uma ahitai, Israel mite chu abonchauvin Shiloh a akikhomun hichea chun kikhopna ponbuhkhat atungdohn tauve.
English: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.

tcz: Ahinlah hichea chun phung sagi hochu alodiu chennagam kipeloulai aum nalaijin ahi.
en: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.
text:
JOS 18:2
Thadou: Ahinlah hichea chun phung sagi hochu alodiu chennagam kipeloulai aum nalaijin ahi.
English: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.

tcz: Hichun Joshua’n amahochu adongin, “Napu napateu Pakai Pathennin nalodiuva napeh u gam nachandiu chu itih changei nanga diuham?” ati.
en: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?
text:
JOS 18:3
Thadou: Hichun Joshua’n amahochu adongin, “Napu napateu Pakai Pathennin nalodiuva napeh u gam nachandiu chu itih changei nanga diuham?” ati.
English: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?

tcz: “Phungkhat a mithum cheh hinlhengdoh unlang keiman amaho chu gam vetoh dingin gahsol intin, amaho cheuvin tin amaho cheh in alodiu gamchu hinvetoh untin keikoma thu ahinlhut kitdiu ahi.
en: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.
text:
JOS 18:4
Thadou: “Phungkhat a mithum cheh hinlhengdoh unlang keiman amaho chu gam vetoh dingin gahsol intin, amaho cheuvin tin amaho cheh in alodiu gamchu hinvetoh untin keikoma thu ahinlhut kitdiu ahi.
English: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.

tcz: Judahten achannu lhanglam gamleh Joseph in achennao sahlang gam panglouva amahon agamvet uchu hop sagi’a ahopdiu ahi.
en: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.
text:
JOS 18:5
Thadou: Judahten achannu lhanglam gamleh Joseph in achennao sahlang gam panglouva amahon agamvet uchu hop sagi’a ahopdiu ahi.
English: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.

tcz: Hitia chu amahon agamvet u ajihlutnao chu keikoma ahin choilutdiu, aphungdung jui'a achondiu akipehtheina dinga keiman Pakai Pathen angsung’a vang theng kasanding ahi.
en: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
text:
JOS 18:6
Thadou: Hitia chu amahon agamvet u ajihlutnao chu keikoma ahin choilutdiu, aphungdung jui'a achondiu akipehtheina dinga keiman Pakai Pathen angsung’a vang theng kasanding ahi.
English: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

tcz: “Levite chun gamchan aneiloudiu ahi. Amaho chanding chu Pathen thempu kinbol chu hiding ahi. Chuleh Gad, Reuben leh Manasseh phung kehkhat hochu gam chanbeloudiu ahitai. Ajeh chu Pakai lhacha Mose’n amahochu Jordan vadung solam gamkaija anapehsa ahitan amahon gamchan chu akimusao ahitai,” ati.
en: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.”
text:
JOS 18:7
Thadou: “Levite chun gamchan aneiloudiu ahi. Amaho chanding chu Pathen thempu kinbol chu hiding ahi. Chuleh Gad, Reuben leh Manasseh phung kehkhat hochu gam chanbeloudiu ahitai. Ajeh chu Pakai lhacha Mose’n amahochu Jordan vadung solam gamkaija anapehsa ahitan amahon gamchan chu akimusao ahitai,” ati.
English: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.”

tcz: Amaho gam gakholtoh dingleh gajihdoh dinga akipatdoh uchun Joshua’n hitin thupeh ananeijin ahi, “Cheuvinlang agamchu gakholtoh unlang kichihtah in hinjihdoh un. Chujouteng kakomma hungun, huting keiman Shiloh munna Pakai angsung’a vangsan na kaneiding chuteng aphung dungjui a agam chu kahoppehdiu nahiuve” ati.
en: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh.”
text:
JOS 18:8
Thadou: Amaho gam gakholtoh dingleh gajihdoh dinga akipatdoh uchun Joshua’n hitin thupeh ananeijin ahi, “Cheuvinlang agamchu gakholtoh unlang kichihtah in hinjihdoh un. Chujouteng kakomma hungun, huting keiman Shiloh munna Pakai angsung’a vangsan na kaneiding chuteng aphung dungjui a agam chu kahoppehdiu nahiuve” ati.
English: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh.”

tcz: Miho chun gampumpi chu agakholtoh dungjuijin ahin jihdoh un khopi dingleh khoneoding agongtoh un hopsagi in ahommun lekhabua ajihkit un Shiloh ngahmunna Joshua komma ahinpo lutnun ahi.
en: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.
text:
JOS 18:9
Thadou: Miho chun gampumpi chu agakholtoh dungjuijin ahin jihdoh un khopi dingleh khoneoding agongtoh un hopsagi in ahommun lekhabua ajihkit un Shiloh ngahmunna Joshua komma ahinpo lutnun ahi.
English: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.

tcz: Chuleh Shiloh achun Joshua'n Pakai angsung’a vangsan’na aneiyin hoilai munchu koi phungpen chang dingham ti avetan ahi.
en: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.
text:
JOS 18:10
Thadou: Chuleh Shiloh achun Joshua'n Pakai angsung’a vangsan’na aneiyin hoilai munchu koi phungpen chang dingham ti avetan ahi.
English: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

tcz: Vang kivetna-a chan masa chu Benjamin phunga alhungin ahi. Hiche chan hi Judah le Joseph gamchan kikah’a um gam chu ahi.
en: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
text:
JOS 18:11
Thadou: Vang kivetna-a chan masa chu Benjamin phunga alhungin ahi. Hiche chan hi Judah le Joseph gamchan kikah’a um gam chu ahi.
English: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

tcz: Benjamin channa sahlang gamgi chu Jordan vadunga hung kipan ahin, Jericho sahlang juilang ajonnin, hitichun lhumlama thinglhang gamleh Beth-aven ahin pal galkaijin ahi.
en: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.
text:
JOS 18:12
Thadou: Benjamin channa sahlang gamgi chu Jordan vadunga hung kipan ahin, Jericho sahlang juilang ajonnin, hitichun lhumlama thinglhang gamleh Beth-aven ahin pal galkaijin ahi.
English: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.

tcz: Hiche apatin gamhi chu Luz (Bethel tina) lhanglama achepeh in hijouchun achesuh in noinung Beth-horon lhanglam thinglhang chunga um Ataroth-addar munna alutnin ahi.
en: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.
text:
JOS 18:13
Thadou: Hiche apatin gamhi chu Luz (Bethel tina) lhanglama achepeh in hijouchun achesuh in noinung Beth-horon lhanglam thinglhang chunga um Ataroth-addar munna alutnin ahi.
English: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.

tcz: Gamgi chu ahung kileheijin lhanglang ajonsuh in Beth-horon maingat thinglhang lhumlam gei hina alutnin Kiriath-baal (Keriath-jearim tina) khokhatna atangin ahi. Hichehi Judah phung khopi khat ahi. Hichehi lhumlam gamgi chu ahi.
en: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.
text:
JOS 18:14
Thadou: Gamgi chu ahung kileheijin lhanglang ajonsuh in Beth-horon maingat thinglhang lhumlam gei hina alutnin Kiriath-baal (Keriath-jearim tina) khokhatna atangin ahi. Hichehi Judah phung khopi khat ahi. Hichehi lhumlam gamgi chu ahi.
English: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.

tcz: Lhanglam gamgi chu Kiriath-jearim khopamma konin ahung kipanne. Hiche lhumlam gamchinna konhin ahung kilhungin Naphtoah twinah put namun ahinjotpan,
en: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
text:
JOS 18:15
Thadou: Lhanglam gamgi chu Kiriath-jearim khopamma konin ahung kipanne. Hiche lhumlam gamchinna konhin ahung kilhungin Naphtoah twinah put namun ahinjotpan,
English: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

tcz: Ben-Hinnom phaicham pangmol bullah alutnin ahi. Hichehi Rephaim phaicham sahlang kichaina mun ahi. Hichea konhin Hinnom phaichamma achesuh peh-in Jebus mite chenna lhanglam suh apaltannin En-Rogel changei in achonlut peh in ahi.
en: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.
text:
JOS 18:16
Thadou: Ben-Hinnom phaicham pangmol bullah alutnin ahi. Hichehi Rephaim phaicham sahlang kichaina mun ahi. Hichea konhin Hinnom phaichamma achesuh peh-in Jebus mite chenna lhanglam suh apaltannin En-Rogel changei in achonlut peh in ahi.
English: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.

tcz: En-Rogel gamgia kon in sahlang jotna lammah alutnin En-Shemesh ahinjonin Geliloth (Adummin langa kaltouna toh kigalsai ahitai) chunga alut jellin ahi. Hichea konhin Bohan (Reuben chapa min) songphung geijin achesuh in ahi.
en: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
text:
JOS 18:17
Thadou: En-Rogel gamgia kon in sahlang jotna lammah alutnin En-Shemesh ahinjonin Geliloth (Adummin langa kaltouna toh kigalsai ahitai) chunga alut jellin ahi. Hichea konhin Bohan (Reuben chapa min) songphung geijin achesuh in ahi.
English: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

tcz: Hichea konhin Jordan phaicham hin galdotna sahlang gamkai langa achepeh in ahi. Hitichun gamgi chu phaicham lamma achesuh in ahi.
en: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.
text:
JOS 18:18
Thadou: Hichea konhin Jordan phaicham hin galdotna sahlang gamkai langa achepeh in ahi. Hitichun gamgi chu phaicham lamma achesuh in ahi.
English: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

tcz: Beth-hoglah sahlang lhang apal galkaijin Chitui-len sahlang pangah alongin ahi. Hichehi Jordan vadung lhang langa achaina ahitai. Hiche lhanglang gamgi chu ahitai.
en: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.
text:
JOS 18:19
Thadou: Beth-hoglah sahlang lhang apal galkaijin Chitui-len sahlang pangah alongin ahi. Hichehi Jordan vadung lhang langa achaina ahitai. Hiche lhanglang gamgi chu ahitai.
English: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.

tcz: Solam gamgi chu Jordan vadung ahitai. Hichehi Benjamin phung bahkai ho jouse gamlo dinga kipe gamgi chu ahi.
en: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.
text:
JOS 18:20
Thadou: Solam gamgi chu Jordan vadung ahitai. Hichehi Benjamin phung bahkai ho jouse gamlo dinga kipe gamgi chu ahi.
English: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.

tcz: Hicheho hi Benjamin phung sunga abahkai ho kipe khopichu ahi. Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,
en: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
text:
JOS 18:21
Thadou: Hicheho hi Benjamin phung sunga abahkai ho kipe khopichu ahi. Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,
English: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,

tcz: Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
en: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
text:
JOS 18:22
Thadou: Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
English: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

tcz: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
en: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
text:
JOS 18:23
Thadou: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
English: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

tcz: Kephar-ammoni, Ophni, and Geba— khopi somleni chule vella khoho ahiuve
en: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.
text:
JOS 18:24
Thadou: Kephar-ammoni, Ophni, and Geba— khopi somleni chule vella khoho ahiuve
English: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.

tcz: Chujongle Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
en: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
text:
JOS 18:25
Thadou: Chujongle Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
English: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

tcz: Mizpeh, Kephirah, Mozah,
en: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,
text:
JOS 18:26
Thadou: Mizpeh, Kephirah, Mozah,
English: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,

tcz: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
en: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
text:
JOS 18:27
Thadou: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
English: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

tcz: Zela, Haeleph, Jebus (hichu Jerusalem), Gibeah, and Kiriath-jearim — khopi somleli chule avella khoho ahiuve. Hicheng hi Benjamin phungmite le abahkai ho lodia kipe gam ho chu ahi.
en: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
text:
JOS 18:28
Thadou: Zela, Haeleph, Jebus (hichu Jerusalem), Gibeah, and Kiriath-jearim — khopi somleli chule avella khoho ahiuve. Hicheng hi Benjamin phungmite le abahkai ho lodia kipe gam ho chu ahi.
English: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

tcz: Anichanna’a alodiova gam kipechu Simeon phung sunga phung bahkaiho chu ahiuve.
en: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.
text:
JOS 19:1
Thadou: Anichanna’a alodiova gam kipechu Simeon phung sunga phung bahkaiho chu ahiuve.
English: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

tcz: Simeon gamlo dinga kipe hochu Beersheba, Sheba, Moladah,
en: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
text:
JOS 19:2
Thadou: Simeon gamlo dinga kipe hochu Beersheba, Sheba, Moladah,
English: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

tcz: Hazar-shual, Belah, Ezem,
en: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,
text:
JOS 19:3
Thadou: Hazar-shual, Belah, Ezem,
English: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

tcz: Eltolad,Belhul, Hormah,
en: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
text:
JOS 19:4
Thadou: Eltolad,Belhul, Hormah,
English: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

tcz: Ziklag, Bethmarcaboth, Hazar-susah,
en: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,
text:
JOS 19:5
Thadou: Ziklag, Bethmarcaboth, Hazar-susah,
English: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

tcz: Beth-lebaoth chuleh Sharuhon khopi somle thum toh vella khoho puma ahop ahi.
en: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;

tcz: Hichun Ain, Rimmon, Ether, chule Ashan khopi li hotoh akhoneo hojong ahopme.
en: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;

tcz: Avelluva khohop jouse toh Baalath-beer (Negev ma Ramah jong akitin ahi) changei ahi. Hiche hohi Simeon phungle abahkhai ho gamlo dinga kipea chu ahi.
en: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
text:
JOS 19:8
Thadou: Avelluva khohop jouse toh Baalath-beer (Negev ma Ramah jong akitin ahi) changei ahi. Hiche hohi Simeon phungle abahkhai ho gamlo dinga kipea chu ahi.
English: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

tcz: Amaho kipe gamhi Judah te gamphabep kikah lha a kipe ahi. Ajeh chu Judah gamchu amaho dinga analen valla ahi. Hijeh chun Judah gamsunga kon in Simeon phungin gamchan phabep aneiyin ahi.
en: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.
text:
JOS 19:9
Thadou: Amaho kipe gamhi Judah te gamphabep kikah lha a kipe ahi. Ajeh chu Judah gamchu amaho dinga analen valla ahi. Hijeh chun Judah gamsunga kon in Simeon phungin gamchan phabep aneiyin ahi.
English: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.

tcz: Athum channa gamloding chan kipe chu: Zebulun phung sunga abahkhai ho ahiuve. Zebulun chenna gamgei chu Sarid na ahung kipan ahi.
en: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.
text:
JOS 19:10
Thadou: Athum channa gamloding chan kipe chu: Zebulun phung sunga abahkhai ho ahiuve. Zebulun chenna gamgei chu Sarid na ahung kipan ahi.
English: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.

tcz: Hichea konchun lhumlamma achen Maralah ahopan Dabbeesheth akhokhellin Jokneam vadungneo lang ajonnin ahi.
en: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.
text:
JOS 19:11
Thadou: Hichea konchun lhumlamma achen Maralah ahopan Dabbeesheth akhokhellin Jokneam vadungneo lang ajonnin ahi.
English: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.

tcz: Sarid napat chun agamgihi gamchom jep'a akiheijin, Kishloth-tabor gamgi lang nisolamma nisa hungsodoh nalam ajontai. Chuin Deberath lang ajon kitnin, Japhia langa akilhung touve,
en: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.
text:
JOS 19:12
Thadou: Sarid napat chun agamgihi gamchom jep'a akiheijin, Kishloth-tabor gamgi lang nisolamma nisa hungsodoh nalam ajontai. Chuin Deberath lang ajon kitnin, Japhia langa akilhung touve,
English: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.

tcz: Japhia patchun nisolam ahin lhahin nisa hungsodoh jina Gath-hepher gal Eth-kazin geijin ahung kilhung paiyin chuin Rimmon channin akilhung doh peh in Neah lang jonin ahung kiheikon tai.
en: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.
text:
JOS 19:13
Thadou: Japhia patchun nisolam ahin lhahin nisa hungsodoh jina Gath-hepher gal Eth-kazin geijin ahung kilhung paiyin chuin Rimmon channin akilhung doh peh in Neah lang jonin ahung kiheikon tai.
English: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.

tcz: Abanin sahlamma agamgi chu Hannathon langa akiheijin Iphtah-el phaiya abeitai.
en: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;

tcz: Khopi hochu Kattath ahin, Nahalal ahin, Shimron ahin, Idalah ahin, chuleh Bethlehem toh ahi, khopi somleni toh akhoneo jousetoh ahithai.
en: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
text:
JOS 19:15
Thadou: Khopi hochu Kattath ahin, Nahalal ahin, Shimron ahin, Idalah ahin, chuleh Bethlehem toh ahi, khopi somleni toh akhoneo jousetoh ahithai.
English: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

tcz: Hichenghi Zebulun chate chan agam goulo ahin ainsung dungjui uva khopi hicheng toh akhoneo jouse toh chantha ahiuve.
en: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
text:
JOS 19:16
Thadou: Hichenghi Zebulun chate chan agam goulo ahin ainsung dungjui uva khopi hicheng toh akhoneo jouse toh chantha ahiuve.
English: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

tcz: Ali channa gamloding chan kipe chu Issachar phung mite le asunga abahkhai ho ahiuve.
en: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.
text:
JOS 19:17
Thadou: Ali channa gamloding chan kipe chu Issachar phung mite le asunga abahkhai ho ahiuve.
English: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.

tcz: Agamgi hopsunga chun Jezreel jong, Kesul’loth jong Shunem jong.
en: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
text:
JOS 19:18
Thadou: Agamgi hopsunga chun Jezreel jong, Kesul’loth jong Shunem jong.
English: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

tcz: Hapharaim jong Shion jong Anaharath jong,
en: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
text:
JOS 19:19
Thadou: Hapharaim jong Shion jong Anaharath jong,
English: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

tcz: Rabbith jong Kishion jong Ebez jong,
en: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
text:
JOS 19:20
Thadou: Rabbith jong Kishion jong Ebez jong,
English: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

tcz: Remeth, En-gannim jong En-haddah jong, Beth-pazzez jong ahopdoh tai,
en: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.
text:
JOS 19:21
Thadou: Remeth, En-gannim jong En-haddah jong, Beth-pazzez jong ahopdoh tai,
English: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.

tcz: Agamgi chun Tabor jong Shahazuman jong chle Beth-shemesh jong ahopan, Jordan vadungah chun agamgi abeitai. Khopi somlegup toh akhoneo jouse toh ahiye.
en: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
text:
JOS 19:22
Thadou: Agamgi chun Tabor jong Shahazuman jong chle Beth-shemesh jong ahopan, Jordan vadungah chun agamgi abeitai. Khopi somlegup toh akhoneo jouse toh ahiye.
English: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

tcz: Hiche hi Issachar chate phung miho goulo achandio ahin, ainsung dungjuijin khopi chujat chutoh khoneo chengse toh achantha taove.
en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.
text:
JOS 19:23
Thadou: Hiche hi Issachar chate phung miho goulo achandio ahin, ainsung dungjuijin khopi chujat chutoh khoneo chengse toh achantha taove.
English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.

tcz: Anga channa gamloding chan kipe chu Asher phung mite le asunga abahkhai ho ahiuve.
en: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
text:
JOS 19:24
Thadou: Anga channa gamloding chan kipe chu Asher phung mite le asunga abahkhai ho ahiuve.
English: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

tcz: Agam chu Helkath jong Hali jong , Beten jong, Achshaph jong,
en: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
text:
JOS 19:25
Thadou: Agam chu Helkath jong Hali jong , Beten jong, Achshaph jong,
English: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

tcz: Allammelech jong, Amad jong chule Mishal jong ahoptai, nilhum lamma Carmel le Shihor-libnath jong ahopsoh keijin,
en: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.
text:
JOS 19:26
Thadou: Allammelech jong, Amad jong chule Mishal jong ahoptai, nilhum lamma Carmel le Shihor-libnath jong ahopsoh keijin,
English: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.

tcz: Chuin agamgi’n nisolam ajotnin, Beth-dagon geijin akilhung in, Zebulun leh Iphtahel phaicham ahopan, sahlam alhah in, Beth-emek leh Neiel geijin akilhung lut in ahi, chujouvin jong agamgi chu Cabul sahlamma achen,
en: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,
text:
JOS 19:27
Thadou: Chuin agamgi’n nisolam ajotnin, Beth-dagon geijin akilhung in, Zebulun leh Iphtahel phaicham ahopan, sahlam alhah in, Beth-emek leh Neiel geijin akilhung lut in ahi, chujouvin jong agamgi chu Cabul sahlamma achen,
English: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,

tcz: Ebron lam, Rehob lam, Hammon lam, Kanah lam ajonnin, Sidon lengpa geijin akilhung lutne,
en: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.
text:
JOS 19:28
Thadou: Ebron lam, Rehob lam, Hammon lam, Kanah lam ajonnin, Sidon lengpa geijin akilhung lutne,
English: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.

tcz: Hichun Ramah lamma agamgi chu ahung kihei kitnin Tyre khopi kulpi kikai khumchu ahinpha peh in ahi, chujouvin Hosah lam jonnin akihei kitnin chule Mediterranian twilena atangtai, Mehebel jong Achzib jong,
en: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;

tcz: Ummah jong, Aphek jong chuyle Rehob jong ahin, khopi somnile nitoh akhoneo jouse jong ahi.
en: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.
text:
JOS 19:30
Thadou: Ummah jong, Aphek jong chuyle Rehob jong ahin, khopi somnile nitoh akhoneo jouse jong ahi.
English: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.

tcz: Hichehi ainsungu dungjuija Asher chate phung goulo ahin, khopi hijat leh akhoneo jousetoh ahiye.
en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
text:
JOS 19:31
Thadou: Hichehi ainsungu dungjuija Asher chate phung goulo ahin, khopi hijat leh akhoneo jousetoh ahiye.
English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

tcz: Agup channa gamloding chan kipe chu Naphtali phung mite le asunga abahkhai ho ahiuve.
en: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
text:
JOS 19:32
Thadou: Agup channa gamloding chan kipe chu Naphtali phung mite le asunga abahkhai ho ahiuve.
English: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

tcz: Agamgi chu Heleph a kipat Zaanan-nim apat chule Adami-nekeb apat, Jabneel apat Lakkum chan geijin akilhung lut peh in, chuin Jordan vadunga atangtai.
en: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.
text:
JOS 19:33
Thadou: Agamgi chu Heleph a kipat Zaanan-nim apat chule Adami-nekeb apat, Jabneel apat Lakkum chan geijin akilhung lut peh in, chuin Jordan vadunga atangtai.
English: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.

tcz: Chujouvin agamgi chu nilhum lamma akiheijin, Aznoth-tabor lam ajonnin chua kon in Hukkok lam ajonpai paijin lhanglamma Zebulun ahopan nilhum langa Asher gamgi ahopa kitnin nisolamma Jordan vadung ajuijin ahi.
en: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.
text:
JOS 19:34
Thadou: Chujouvin agamgi chu nilhum lamma akiheijin, Aznoth-tabor lam ajonnin chua kon in Hukkok lam ajonpai paijin lhanglamma Zebulun ahopan nilhum langa Asher gamgi ahopa kitnin nisolamma Jordan vadung ajuijin ahi.
English: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.

tcz: Kulpi kikaikhum hochu, Ziddim ahin, Zer ahin, Hammath ahin, Rakkath ahin, Kinnereth ahi.
en: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,
text:
JOS 19:35
Thadou: Kulpi kikaikhum hochu, Ziddim ahin, Zer ahin, Hammath ahin, Rakkath ahin, Kinnereth ahi.
English: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,

tcz: Adamah ahin, Ramah ahin, Hazor ahin,
en: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
text:
JOS 19:36
Thadou: Adamah ahin, Ramah ahin, Hazor ahin,
English: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

tcz: Kedesh ahin, Edrei ahin, En-hazor ahin,
en: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,
text:
JOS 19:37
Thadou: Kedesh ahin, Edrei ahin, En-hazor ahin,
English: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,

tcz: Yiron ahin, Migdal-el ahin, Beth-anath ahin, chule Beth-shemesh ahi, khopi somleko toh khoneo chengse toh ahiye.
en: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
text:
JOS 19:38
Thadou: Yiron ahin, Migdal-el ahin, Beth-anath ahin, chule Beth-shemesh ahi, khopi somleko toh khoneo chengse toh ahiye.
English: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

tcz: Ainsung utoh kithuh bepma hichenghi Naphtali chate phung chan agamu ahi, khopi hohi ahin khoneoho ahin akisim than ahi.
en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.
text:
JOS 19:39
Thadou: Ainsung utoh kithuh bepma hichenghi Naphtali chate phung chan agamu ahi, khopi hohi ahin khoneoho ahin akisim than ahi.
English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.

tcz: Asagi channa gamloding chan kipe chu Dan phung mite le asunga abahkhai ho ahiuve.
en: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
text:
JOS 19:40
Thadou: Asagi channa gamloding chan kipe chu Dan phung mite le asunga abahkhai ho ahiuve.
English: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

tcz: Chule Dan phung chan agoulo gamchun khopi Zorah jong, Eshtaol jong Ir-shemesh jong,
en: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,
text:
JOS 19:41
Thadou: Chule Dan phung chan agoulo gamchun khopi Zorah jong, Eshtaol jong Ir-shemesh jong,
English: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,

tcz: Shalabbin jong, Aijalon jong, Ithlah jong,
en: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,
text:
JOS 19:42
Thadou: Shalabbin jong, Aijalon jong, Ithlah jong,
English: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

tcz: Elon jong Timnath jong, Ekron jong ahin,
en: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
text:
JOS 19:43
Thadou: Elon jong Timnath jong, Ekron jong ahin,
English: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

tcz: Eltekah jong, Gibbethon jong, Baalath jong,
en: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
text:
JOS 19:44
Thadou: Eltekah jong, Gibbethon jong, Baalath jong,
English: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

tcz: Jehud jong, Bene-berak jong, Gath-rimmon jong,
en: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,
text:
JOS 19:45
Thadou: Jehud jong, Bene-berak jong, Gath-rimmon jong,
English: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

tcz: Chule Me-jarkon le Rakkon toh Joppa to kimai ngat gamsungse sejong ahopsoh keijin ahi.
en: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.
text:
JOS 19:46
Thadou: Chule Me-jarkon le Rakkon toh Joppa to kimai ngat gamsungse sejong ahopsoh keijin ahi.
English: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.

tcz: Dan chaten agamsung achanlou phat uvin akon touvun Leshem khopi agasat uvin, alah jouvun chemjammin asatgam helluvin atoupha uvin asunga acheng tauve, Leshem jong chu apu apau min aputsah uvin Dan asah taove.
en: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.
text:
JOS 19:47
Thadou: Dan chaten agamsung achanlou phat uvin akon touvun Leshem khopi agasat uvin, alah jouvun chemjammin asatgam helluvin atoupha uvin asunga acheng tauve, Leshem jong chu apu apau min aputsah uvin Dan asah taove.
English: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.

tcz: Hichenghi ainsung tohkham bepma Dan chate phunggoul achannu ahin, khopi hojong khoneo hojong ahithai.
en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
text:
JOS 19:48
Thadou: Hichenghi ainsung tohkham bepma Dan chate phunggoul achannu ahin, khopi hojong khoneo hojong ahithai.
English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

tcz: Gamsung chu abih bih a gouloa chenpha dia akihopsoh helphat uvin, Israel chaten Nun chapa Joshua jong chu alah uva goulo ding gam apeovin ahi.
en: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.
text:
JOS 19:49
Thadou: Gamsung chu abih bih a gouloa chenpha dia akihopsoh helphat uvin, Israel chaten Nun chapa Joshua jong chu alah uva goulo ding gam apeovin ahi.
English: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.

tcz: Pakai thusah in Israelten Joshua chu athumpen pen khopi Timnath-serah kiti, Ephraim thinglhang gamsunga khopi chu ape taove, amanjong akhopi chu akisah phatnin chennan aneitan ahi.
en: According to the LORD’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.
text:
JOS 19:50
Thadou: Pakai thusah in Israelten Joshua chu athumpen pen khopi Timnath-serah kiti, Ephraim thinglhang gamsunga khopi chu ape taove, amanjong akhopi chu akisah phatnin chennan aneitan ahi.
English: According to the LORD’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.

tcz: Eleazer thempupa leh Nun chapa Joshua chule Israel aphungkhai leh ainsung dungjui uva alamkai houvin Shiloh munna Pakai angsung laitah’a vang asan’uva anahopdoh peh naogam ahin, hichu Pakai chenna ponbuh kotpi phunga anahopmu ahiye, hitichun amahon agamchu ahomsoh taovin ahi.
en: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
text:
JOS 19:51
Thadou: Eleazer thempupa leh Nun chapa Joshua chule Israel aphungkhai leh ainsung dungjui uva alamkai houvin Shiloh munna Pakai angsung laitah’a vang asan’uva anahopdoh peh naogam ahin, hichu Pakai chenna ponbuh kotpi phunga anahopmu ahiye, hitichun amahon agamchu ahomsoh taovin ahi.
English: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.

tcz: Pakaiyin Joshua kommah hitihin thu ahinseije:
en: The LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,
text:
JOS 20:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Joshua kommah hitihin thu ahinseije:
English: The LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

tcz: “Tun keiman Mose kana seipeh bangin Israel techun kiselna ding khopiho chu akilhendoh diovin seipehtan
en: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Assign the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by Moses,
text:
JOS 20:2
Thadou: “Tun keiman Mose kana seipeh bangin Israel techun kiselna ding khopiho chu akilhendoh diovin seipehtan
English: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Assign the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by Moses,

tcz: ‘Koitabang hamkhat in mikhattou tupna mong umlouva ahilou leh hettoh louva ahin tha khah tah a ahileh athatpa chunga phulanom athipa sopiho khutna konna ajamlut nading kiselna khopi ho umding ahi.
en: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there. They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.
text:
JOS 20:3
Thadou: ‘Koitabang hamkhat in mikhattou tupna mong umlouva ahilou leh hettoh louva ahin tha khah tah a ahileh athatpa chunga phulanom athipa sopiho khutna konna ajamlut nading kiselna khopi ho umding ahi.
English: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there. They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.

tcz: Hiche khopiho khatpen’a hi ajamlut teng hiche mithatpahi khopi kelkot phunga upa ho masanga achungthu akiphondoh ding, amahon hichepa hi khopi sunga alutsah uva amaho komma achenthei nading agonpeh diu ahi.
en: He shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city. They shall take him into the city with them, and give him a place, that he may live among them.
text:
JOS 20:4
Thadou: Hiche khopiho khatpen’a hi ajamlut teng hiche mithatpahi khopi kelkot phunga upa ho masanga achungthu akiphondoh ding, amahon hichepa hi khopi sunga alutsah uva amaho komma achenthei nading agonpeh diu ahi.
English: He shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city. They shall take him into the city with them, and give him a place, that he may live among them.

tcz: Ijemtia athipa insung mite chu phula dinga ahungu leh lamkai hochun mithatpa chu amaho komma apehlut louding ahi, ajeh chu amapa chun tumasanga kinahna umlou chuleh tupna mong imacha umlouva khutsoiya anatha khah jeh ahi.
en: If the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him before.
text:
JOS 20:5
Thadou: Ijemtia athipa insung mite chu phula dinga ahungu leh lamkai hochun mithatpa chu amaho komma apehlut louding ahi, ajeh chu amapa chun tumasanga kinahna umlou chuleh tupna mong imacha umlouva khutsoiya anatha khah jeh ahi.
English: If the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him before.

tcz: Ahinlah mithatpa chu hiche khopia chu umden ding, khopi chun achung thu akhol toh uva athu atandiu ahi, chuleh hiche thilso petna thempu chungnung natongpa hinlai sea hiche komma chu cheng ding ahi. Hijouteng chuleh ahung jamdohna khopi sung ain munna chu kilekit thei ding ahi.
en: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days. Then the man slayer shall return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city he fled from.’”
text:
JOS 20:6
Thadou: Ahinlah mithatpa chu hiche khopia chu umden ding, khopi chun achung thu akhol toh uva athu atandiu ahi, chuleh hiche thilso petna thempu chungnung natongpa hinlai sea hiche komma chu cheng ding ahi. Hijouteng chuleh ahung jamdohna khopi sung ain munna chu kilekit thei ding ahi.
English: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days. Then the man slayer shall return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city he fled from.’”

tcz: Hicheho hi kiselna khopi hochu: Naphtali thinglhang gam'a din Galilee a um Kadesh, Ephraim thinglhang gammadin Sechem, Judah thinglhang gam'a din Kiriath-arba (Hebron tina),
en: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
text:
JOS 20:7
Thadou: Hicheho hi kiselna khopi hochu: Naphtali thinglhang gam'a din Galilee a um Kadesh, Ephraim thinglhang gammadin Sechem, Judah thinglhang gam'a din Kiriath-arba (Hebron tina),
English: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

tcz: Jericho gallang Jordan vadung solama din hiche khopiho hi alhengdoh un ahi: Reuben phung phaicham gammang langa din Bezer; Gad phung mite gamsunga din Gilead na um Ramoth, Manasseh phung mite gamsunga din Bashan’a um Golan ahiuve.
en: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
text:
JOS 20:8
Thadou: Jericho gallang Jordan vadung solama din hiche khopiho hi alhengdoh un ahi: Reuben phung phaicham gammang langa din Bezer; Gad phung mite gamsunga din Gilead na um Ramoth, Manasseh phung mite gamsunga din Bashan’a um Golan ahiuve.
English: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

tcz: Israelte hihen alah uva cheng gamchom miho hijongleh hiche khopi hohi kigonpeh a ahiuve. Hichehi amun khoppi masanga thu kikholna umman louva phulahna a kilhana dinga konna hoidohna aumtheina dinga tohgon ahi.
en: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them, that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stands trial before the congregation.
text:
JOS 20:9
Thadou: Israelte hihen alah uva cheng gamchom miho hijongleh hiche khopi hohi kigonpeh a ahiuve. Hichehi amun khoppi masanga thu kikholna umman louva phulahna a kilhana dinga konna hoidohna aumtheina dinga tohgon ahi.
English: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them, that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stands trial before the congregation.

tcz: Hiche jouchun Levi phung sunga lamkaiho chu ahungun Eleazer thempupa toh, Nun chapa Joshua toh chuleh Israel pumpi phung lamkaiho ahung kihoutoh piuvin ahi.
en: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.
text:
JOS 21:1
Thadou: Hiche jouchun Levi phung sunga lamkaiho chu ahungun Eleazer thempupa toh, Nun chapa Joshua toh chuleh Israel pumpi phung lamkaiho ahung kihoutoh piuvin ahi.
English: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.

tcz: Amaho chu Canaan gam'a Shiloh munna ahungun hiti hin aseijuve, “Keihohi kaganchateo nehding hampa phatna gamleh keiho chenna ding khopiho eipehna diuvin Pakaiyin Mose kommah anaseijin ahi,” atiuve.
en: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “The LORD commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock.”
text:
JOS 21:2
Thadou: Amaho chu Canaan gam'a Shiloh munna ahungun hiti hin aseijuve, “Keihohi kaganchateo nehding hampa phatna gamleh keiho chenna ding khopiho eipehna diuvin Pakaiyin Mose kommah anaseijin ahi,” atiuve.
English: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “The LORD commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock.”

tcz: Hitichun Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Israel mipite chun hiche khopiho le hampa phatna gamhohi amaho gamchan dingin Levite chu ana piuvin ahi.
en: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of the LORD, these cities with their pasture lands.
text:
JOS 21:3
Thadou: Hitichun Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Israel mipite chun hiche khopiho le hampa phatna gamhohi amaho gamchan dingin Levite chu ana piuvin ahi.
English: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of the LORD, these cities with their pasture lands.

tcz: Levi phungsunga konna Kohath phung bahkai insung miho Aaron chilhah hochu atil abulla Judah, Simeon leh Benjamin phungho ana kipe khopi somlethum hochu ape taovin ahi.
en: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.
text:
JOS 21:4
Thadou: Levi phungsunga konna Kohath phung bahkai insung miho Aaron chilhah hochu atil abulla Judah, Simeon leh Benjamin phungho ana kipe khopi somlethum hochu ape taovin ahi.
English: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.

tcz: Tumasang Ephraim, Dan leh Manasseh phung akehkhat anakipesa khopi somkhat chu Kohath phungkhai insungmi dangho chu anapeovin ahi.
en: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
text:
JOS 21:5
Thadou: Tumasang Ephraim, Dan leh Manasseh phung akehkhat anakipesa khopi somkhat chu Kohath phungkhai insungmi dangho chu anapeovin ahi.
English: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

tcz: Tumasang’a Issachar, Asher, Naphtali chuleh Manasseh phungkeh khat ana kipesa khopi somle thumchu Gershon phung bahkhai hochu anapeuvin ahi.
en: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
text:
JOS 21:6
Thadou: Tumasang’a Issachar, Asher, Naphtali chuleh Manasseh phungkeh khat ana kipesa khopi somle thumchu Gershon phung bahkhai hochu anapeuvin ahi.
English: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

tcz: Tumasang’a Reuben, Gad leh Zebulun phungho ana kipesa khopi somleni hochu Merari phungkhai hochu anapeovin ahi.
en: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.
text:
JOS 21:7
Thadou: Tumasang’a Reuben, Gad leh Zebulun phungho ana kipesa khopi somleni hochu Merari phungkhai hochu anapeovin ahi.
English: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.

tcz: Pakaiyin Mose anathupeh dungjuijin Israel chaten khopi hichengse hileh hamhing phatna gam hichenghi vangkisanpeh bang banga Levite anapeh u ahiye.
en: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as the LORD commanded by Moses.
text:
JOS 21:8
Thadou: Pakaiyin Mose anathupeh dungjuijin Israel chaten khopi hichengse hileh hamhing phatna gam hichenghi vangkisanpeh bang banga Levite anapeh u ahiye.
English: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as the LORD commanded by Moses.

tcz: Judah leh Simeon phunga kon in Israel chaten khopi hichengsehi anape taove.
en: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:
text:
JOS 21:9
Thadou: Judah leh Simeon phunga kon in Israel chaten khopi hichengsehi anape taove.
English: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:

tcz: Akhopi chengsehi Aaron chilhah ho Kohath chate insung leh Levi miho mama insungkhat ching taovein ahi, ajeh chu vangkisan chu amaho dia hung pha masa ahi.
en: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.
text:
JOS 21:10
Thadou: Akhopi chengsehi Aaron chilhah ho Kohath chate insung leh Levi miho mama insungkhat ching taovein ahi, ajeh chu vangkisan chu amaho dia hung pha masa ahi.
English: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.

tcz: Israel chaten amaho chu Kiriath-arba kiti, hichea Arba hi Anak pa ahin, akhopi Hebron jong kiti, Juda thinglhang gamma khopi le akimvella hamhing gamchengse chu apetaove.
en: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.
text:
JOS 21:11
Thadou: Israel chaten amaho chu Kiriath-arba kiti, hichea Arba hi Anak pa ahin, akhopi Hebron jong kiti, Juda thinglhang gamma khopi le akimvella hamhing gamchengse chu apetaove.
English: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.

tcz: Khopi loujao chengsele akhoneoho vang chu Jephunneh chapa Caleb chenna dinga kipesa ahitai.
en: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
text:
JOS 21:12
Thadou: Khopi loujao chengsele akhoneoho vang chu Jephunneh chapa Caleb chenna dinga kipesa ahitai.
English: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

tcz: Aaron thempupa chilhahte chu Israel chaten mithatho kiselna khopi Hebron le ahamhing gamsung jouse apeovin, Libnah le ahamhing gam pumpi jong anapeuve.
en: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its pasture lands,
text:
JOS 21:13
Thadou: Aaron thempupa chilhahte chu Israel chaten mithatho kiselna khopi Hebron le ahamhing gamsung jouse apeovin, Libnah le ahamhing gam pumpi jong anapeuve.
English: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its pasture lands,

tcz: Jattir khopile Eshtemoa ahamhing gamjong apeovin ahi.
en: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
text:
JOS 21:14
Thadou: Jattir khopile Eshtemoa ahamhing gamjong apeovin ahi.
English: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

tcz: Holonle ahamhing gamjouse apeovin, Debirle hamhing gamjong apeh thaovin ahi.
en: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
text:
JOS 21:15
Thadou: Holonle ahamhing gamjouse apeovin, Debirle hamhing gamjong apeh thaovin ahi.
English: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

tcz: Chule Ain khopile ahamhing gamsung apehthaovin Juttah le ahamhing gamjong apeove. Beth-shemesh le ahamhing apeh taovin, hitichun hiche phungni sunga kon hin khopi ko apedoh taove.
en: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities out of those two tribes.
text:
JOS 21:16
Thadou: Chule Ain khopile ahamhing gamsung apehthaovin Juttah le ahamhing gamjong apeove. Beth-shemesh le ahamhing apeh taovin, hitichun hiche phungni sunga kon hin khopi ko apedoh taove.
English: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities out of those two tribes.

tcz: Benjamin phunga kon in Gibeon khopile ahamhing gamjong apeovin, Giba le ahamhing gamjong apeovin,
en: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,
text:
JOS 21:17
Thadou: Benjamin phunga kon in Gibeon khopile ahamhing gamjong apeovin, Giba le ahamhing gamjong apeovin,

tcz: Anathoth khopile ahamhing gamsungsese toh apummin Almon khopile ahamhing gamsungse jong apeovin ahi.

text:
JOS 21:18
Thadou: Anathoth khopile ahamhing gamsungsese toh apummin Almon khopile ahamhing gamsungse jong apeovin ahi.
English: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.

tcz: Aaron thempupa chilhah achate chan khopi chengsechu abonchan khopi somlethum toh ahamhing gamsungse toh ahopthan ahi.
en: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

JOS 21:19
Thadou: Aaron thempupa chilhah achate chan khopi chengsechu abonchan khopi somlethum toh ahamhing gamsungse toh ahopthan ahi.
English: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

tcz: Levi mite lah a Kohath insungmi, Kohath chate amoh chengse chu Ephraim phunga konna achandio khopi akihoppeh tai.
en: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
text:
JOS 21:20
Thadou: Levi mite lah a Kohath insungmi, Kohath chate amoh chengse chu Ephraim phunga konna achandio khopi akihoppeh tai.
English: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

tcz: Hiche Kohath chate amoh chengse chu mithatho kiselna ding khopi Shechem le ahamhing gamsunga, Ephraim thinglhang gamsung chu apeovin, Gezer khopile ahamhing gamsung jong apeovin ahi.
en: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,
text:
JOS 21:21
Thadou: Hiche Kohath chate amoh chengse chu mithatho kiselna ding khopi Shechem le ahamhing gamsunga, Ephraim thinglhang gamsung chu apeovin, Gezer khopile ahamhing gamsung jong apeovin ahi.
English: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,

tcz: Kibzaim khopi le ahamhing gamjong apeove, khopi li alhingin ahi.
en: Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.
text:
JOS 21:22
Thadou: Kibzaim khopi le ahamhing gamjong apeove, khopi li alhingin ahi.
English: Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.

tcz: Chule Dan phunga kon in Eltekeh khopile ahamhing gam apeovin Gibbethon khopi le ahamhing gam apeove;
en: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,

tcz: Aijalon khopile ahamhing gamjong apeove, khopi li ma alhing in ahi.
en: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.
