tcz: Chuin leng David chu Pakai angsungah alut in chule atou in atao tan ahi, “O thaneipen Pakai, kei koi kahi a, ka insunghi epi hija hichangeija neihin puilhung ham?
en: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, Lord GOD, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?
text:
2SA 7:18
Thadou: Chuin leng David chu Pakai angsungah alut in chule atou in atao tan ahi, “O thaneipen Pakai, kei koi kahi a, ka insunghi epi hija hichangeija neihin puilhung ham?
English: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, Lord GOD, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

tcz: Chule tunjong thaneipan Pakaiyin, imajouse chung vum in nasohpa lenggam hi atonsot a peh ding natie! Hiti monga hi mijouse toh nana kitep mong hinam? O thaneipan Pakai.
en: This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord GOD, but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come; and this among men, Lord GOD!
text:
2SA 7:19
Thadou: Chule tunjong thaneipan Pakaiyin, imajouse chung vum in nasohpa lenggam hi atonsot a peh ding natie! Hiti monga hi mijouse toh nana kitep mong hinam? O thaneipan Pakai.
English: This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord GOD, but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come; and this among men, Lord GOD!

tcz: “Keiman nahenga epi kaseibe ding ham? Thaneipen Pakai, Nangman nasohpahi etabang kahi nahesoh nai.
en: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord GOD.
text:
2SA 7:20
Thadou: “Keiman nahenga epi kaseibe ding ham? Thaneipen Pakai, Nangman nasohpahi etabang kahi nahesoh nai.
English: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord GOD.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangman nakitep nabang le nangma lungdei bangin thiljousehi loupi tah in nabollin chule nasohpa neihet sah soh tai.
en: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.
text:
2SA 7:21
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangman nakitep nabang le nangma lungdei bangin thiljousehi loupi tah in nabollin chule nasohpa neihet sah soh tai.
English: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.

tcz: “Eti loupi nahitam, O thaneipen Pakai! Nangma bang koima aumpoi. Chule keimahon nang tabang Pathen dang kanaja kha hih hel uve.
en: Therefore you are great, LORD God. For there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
text:
2SA 7:22
Thadou: “Eti loupi nahitam, O thaneipen Pakai! Nangma bang koima aumpoi. Chule keimahon nang tabang Pathen dang kanaja kha hih hel uve.
English: Therefore you are great, LORD God. For there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

tcz: Leiset chungahi namdang nami Israel te tabang umkha em? Namdang hohi epi hiuham O Pathen, nangman asoh chan naova kon namite dia nahuhdoh mong em? Nangman namite Egypt akon nahuhdoh chun nangma min nasuloupin ahi. chule nangman bolmo kidang loupi tah nabollin namdangte leh apathen hou chu namite masang akon nadelmang soh helle.
en: What one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?
text:
2SA 7:23
Thadou: Leiset chungahi namdang nami Israel te tabang umkha em? Namdang hohi epi hiuham O Pathen, nangman asoh chan naova kon namite dia nahuhdoh mong em? Nangman namite Egypt akon nahuhdoh chun nangma min nasuloupin ahi. chule nangman bolmo kidang loupi tah nabollin namdangte leh apathen hou chu namite masang akon nadelmang soh helle.
English: What one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

tcz: Chule nangman Israel mite chu eimatih channa namite din nasemin, chule nangma, O Pakai a Pathen u nahi tai.
en: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.
text:
2SA 7:24
Thadou: Chule nangman Israel mite chu eimatih channa namite din nasemin, chule nangma, O Pakai a Pathen u nahi tai.
English: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.

tcz: “Chule tun, O Pakai le ka Pathen, keima nasohpa kahi; nangma nakitep na bang chun keima leh ka insung chungah bol tan. Chule atonsot a umjing din nakitep na chu phutdet tan.
en: “Now, LORD God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.
text:
2SA 7:25
Thadou: “Chule tun, O Pakai le ka Pathen, keima nasohpa kahi; nangma nakitep na bang chun keima leh ka insung chungah bol tan. Chule atonsot a umjing din nakitep na chu phutdet tan.
English: “Now, LORD God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.

tcz: Chule namin eimatih channin jaum hen khuti leh mijousen seijun tin, Pakai vanmi janel Pathen chu Israel te Pathen ahi! chule nasohpa David insung chu namasangah eimatih channin umjing hen.
en: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David will be established before you.’
text:
2SA 7:26
Thadou: Chule namin eimatih channin jaum hen khuti leh mijousen seijun tin, Pakai vanmi janel Pathen chu Israel te Pathen ahi! chule nasohpa David insung chu namasangah eimatih channin umjing hen.
English: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David will be established before you.’

tcz: O Pakai vanmi janel, Israel te Pathen, keiman hiche taona neina ding hin hansan na kanei e ajeh chu nangman hicheho jouse hi nasohpa hengah naphong doh in, hitin naseiye, ‘keiman nangma ding leng in kasah doh pih ding nahi nati!’
en: For you, LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.
text:
2SA 7:27
Thadou: O Pakai vanmi janel, Israel te Pathen, keiman hiche taona neina ding hin hansan na kanei e ajeh chu nangman hicheho jouse hi nasohpa hengah naphong doh in, hitin naseiye, ‘keiman nangma ding leng in kasah doh pih ding nahi nati!’
English: For you, LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma Pathen, Thaneipen Pakai nahi. Nathusei ho adih soh kei in, chule hitabong thilpha jouse hi nasohpa din nakitem e.
en: “Now, O Lord GOD, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.
text:
2SA 7:28
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangma Pathen, Thaneipen Pakai nahi. Nathusei ho adih soh kei in, chule hitabong thilpha jouse hi nasohpa din nakitem e.
English: “Now, O Lord GOD, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.

tcz: Chule tun, nasohpa insung phattheiboh ding hi nangma lunglhai na hihen, khuty leh atonsot a nangma angsunga kaum jing thei diu ahi. ajeh chu nangma thaneipen Pakai in nasei in, nasohpa phatthei boh ding nati chu, atonsot atonsot a phatthei na ahi.
en: Now therefore, let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord GOD, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing.”
text:
2SA 7:29
Thadou: Chule tun, nasohpa insung phattheiboh ding hi nangma lunglhai na hihen, khuty leh atonsot a nangma angsunga kaum jing thei diu ahi. ajeh chu nangma thaneipen Pakai in nasei in, nasohpa phatthei boh ding nati chu, atonsot atonsot a phatthei na ahi.
English: Now therefore, let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord GOD, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing.”

tcz: Hitichun David lengpan Philistine mite dia akhopiu len pen Gath khopi chu gal in alatan, hijeh chun Philistines mite chu aJou in chule asunemsoh tan ahi.
en: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.
text:
2SA 8:1
Thadou: Hitichun David lengpan Philistine mite dia akhopiu len pen Gath khopi chu gal in alatan, hijeh chun Philistines mite chu aJou in chule asunemsoh tan ahi.
English: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.

tcz: Chule David chun Moab mite jong gal’in akisatpin ahileh ajou kit’in, amite chu asimtoh chet in, hichun abonchan tol'a alup sah soh keiyin, hitichun line a akigol sah soh keiyin, hiche line ni chan na geiya kigol ho jouse chu tha din thu apen, ahin adangse vang chu ahing hoiyin, hiche ahinghoi ho chengse vang chu David dingin soh in apang soh kei tauve.
en: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
text:
2SA 8:2
Thadou: Chule David chun Moab mite jong gal’in akisatpin ahileh ajou kit’in, amite chu asimtoh chet in, hichun abonchan tol'a alup sah soh keiyin, hitichun line a akigol sah soh keiyin, hiche line ni chan na geiya kigol ho jouse chu tha din thu apen, ahin adangse vang chu ahing hoiyin, hiche ahinghoi ho chengse vang chu David dingin soh in apang soh kei tauve.
English: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.

tcz: David chun Euphrates vadung geija agam akeh let nom jeh in achepeh in Zobah lengpa Rehob chapa Hadadezer jong gal’in akisat pin ahileh ajou kit tai.
en: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.
text:
2SA 8:3
Thadou: David chun Euphrates vadung geija agam akeh let nom jeh in achepeh in Zobah lengpa Rehob chapa Hadadezer jong gal’in akisat pin ahileh ajou kit tai.
English: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.

tcz: Hadadezer khut’a konin David chun sakolkang sangkhat le sakol touthem mi sang sagi amanin, chule kenga galbol sepai sang som ni amane; chujongle sakol kangtalai jakhat kaiding tilou adangse chu akeng atanboh peh soh kei tan ahi.
en: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.
text:
2SA 8:4
Thadou: Hadadezer khut’a konin David chun sakolkang sangkhat le sakol touthem mi sang sagi amanin, chule kenga galbol sepai sang som ni amane; chujongle sakol kangtalai jakhat kaiding tilou adangse chu akeng atanboh peh soh kei tan ahi.
English: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.

tcz: Damascus khopia cheng Syria mite chu Hadadezer kiti Zobah lengpa kithopi dia ahunguvin ahileh, David in hiche Syria miho jong chu sangsomni le sangni ma athat kit’in ahi.
en: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.
text:
2SA 8:5
Thadou: Damascus khopia cheng Syria mite chu Hadadezer kiti Zobah lengpa kithopi dia ahunguvin ahileh, David in hiche Syria miho jong chu sangsomni le sangni ma athat kit’in ahi.
English: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.

tcz: Chujouvin David chun Ram gamsunga Damascus khopia jong sepai hon khat atousah tan ahi; hiti chun Syria mite jong chu David soh ahiuvin, don le kai ima apejiuve. Hitobang hin David chu agalkon na chan nah Pakaiyin galjona apejing in ahi.
en: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
text:
2SA 8:6
Thadou: Chujouvin David chun Ram gamsunga Damascus khopia jong sepai hon khat atousah tan ahi; hiti chun Syria mite jong chu David soh ahiuvin, don le kai ima apejiuve. Hitobang hin David chu agalkon na chan nah Pakaiyin galjona apejing in ahi.
English: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

tcz: Hadadezer sepaite manchah sana ompho jouse chu David’in alan Jerusalem a ahinpo lut soh keiyin ahi.
en: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
text:
2SA 8:7
Thadou: Hadadezer sepaite manchah sana ompho jouse chu David’in alan Jerusalem a ahinpo lut soh keiyin ahi.
English: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hichun Hadadezer khopi te ni Tebah le Berothai a konin jong David chun sum-eng tamtah jong ahin chom doh kit in ahi.
en: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.
text:
2SA 8:8
Thadou: Hichun Hadadezer khopi te ni Tebah le Berothai a konin jong David chun sum-eng tamtah jong ahin chom doh kit in ahi.
English: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

tcz: Chuin Hamath lengpa Toi kitipan jong Hadadezer sepaite abonchan David’in gal in akisat pin ahileh ajou tai, ti ajah doh phat in;
en: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,

tcz: Toi lengpan jong achapa Joram chu David lengpa koma salam bolgun set din asol tan ahi; Ipijeh-inem itileh David chun Hadadezer kitipa gal a akisatpia ajojeh ahi; ajeh chu Hadadezer hin Toi lengpa akisat pi jing jeng anahi. Joram hin dangka le sana chule sum-eng ahin poh peh in ahi.
en: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.
text:
2SA 8:10
Thadou: Toi lengpan jong achapa Joram chu David lengpa koma salam bolgun set din asol tan ahi; Ipijeh-inem itileh David chun Hadadezer kitipa gal a akisatpia ajojeh ahi; ajeh chu Hadadezer hin Toi lengpa akisat pi jing jeng anahi. Joram hin dangka le sana chule sum-eng ahin poh peh in ahi.
English: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.

tcz: Hichun David in Joram thil hinpoh chengse chu alan aman achom doh namtin vaipi a kona gal ajo tengle akilah dangka le sana jouse pumin Pakaiya athenso thatai.
en: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—
text:
2SA 8:11
Thadou: Hichun David in Joram thil hinpoh chengse chu alan aman achom doh namtin vaipi a kona gal ajo tengle akilah dangka le sana jouse pumin Pakaiya athenso thatai.
English: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—

tcz: Hiche thil ho hi Edom gam'a kona ahinlah jong aumin, Moab gam'a kona ahin lah jong aumin, Ammon mite akona ahin lah jong aumin, Philistines mite a kona ahin lah jong aumin, Amalek mitea kona ahin lah jong aumin, chule Zobah lengpa Reboh chapa Hadadezer chapa a kona achom doh chengse jong ajaovin ahi.
en: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
text:
2SA 8:12
Thadou: Hiche thil ho hi Edom gam'a kona ahinlah jong aumin, Moab gam'a kona ahin lah jong aumin, Ammon mite akona ahin lah jong aumin, Philistines mite a kona ahin lah jong aumin, Amalek mitea kona ahin lah jong aumin, chule Zobah lengpa Reboh chapa Hadadezer chapa a kona achom doh chengse jong ajaovin ahi.
English: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

tcz: Chuin ahung kile kit lamin jong chikhuh phaicham a Edom mite mihem sang som le sang get ahin that pa kit’in ahileh David chu aminthang cheh tan ahi
en: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.
text:
2SA 8:13
Thadou: Chuin ahung kile kit lamin jong chikhuh phaicham a Edom mite mihem sang som le sang get ahin that pa kit’in ahileh David chu aminthang cheh tan ahi
English: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.

tcz: David chun Edom gamsunga jong sepai atousah in, hijeh chun Edom mite jong abonchauvin David soh ahisoh tauve. Hitobang tah hin David chu gal akonna chan a Pakaiyin gal ajosah sah jeng tan ahi.
en: He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom, he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
text:
2SA 8:14
Thadou: David chun Edom gamsunga jong sepai atousah in, hijeh chun Edom mite jong abonchauvin David soh ahisoh tauve. Hitobang tah hin David chu gal akonna chan a Pakaiyin gal ajosah sah jeng tan ahi.
English: He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom, he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

tcz: David chun Israel pumpi chunga lengvai anapon, chule amite adin apha le adih jeng anabol in ahi.
en: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.
text:
2SA 8:15
Thadou: David chun Israel pumpi chunga lengvai anapon, chule amite adin apha le adih jeng anabol in ahi.
English: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

tcz: Zeru’iah chapa Jo’ab chu sepai lamkaiyin anapangin, Ahilud chapa Jehoshaphat chu leng thuchingin anapangin ahi.
en: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,
text:
2SA 8:16
Thadou: Zeru’iah chapa Jo’ab chu sepai lamkaiyin anapangin, Ahilud chapa Jehoshaphat chu leng thuchingin anapangin ahi.
English: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,

tcz: Ahitub chapa Zadok le Abiathar chapa Ahimelech chu thempun anapang lhonin ahi; chule Seraiah kitipa chu lekha sun in ana pang in ahi.
en: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe,
text:
2SA 8:17
Thadou: Ahitub chapa Zadok le Abiathar chapa Ahimelech chu thempun anapang lhonin ahi; chule Seraiah kitipa chu lekha sun in ana pang in ahi.
English: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe,

tcz: Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chu lengpa vengbitho lamkai in anapangin; chule David chapate ho chu thempu ho lamkai in apanguvin ahi.
en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.
text:
2SA 8:18
Thadou: Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chu lengpa vengbitho lamkai in anapangin; chule David chapate ho chu thempu ho lamkai in apanguvin ahi.
English: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.

tcz: “Nikhat David in adongin, Saul insung mite khat beh ahing naum nalai’u vem? Jonathan jal'a keiman khutona kamusah thei ding tin adongin ahile,
en: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”
text:
2SA 9:1
Thadou: “Nikhat David in adongin, Saul insung mite khat beh ahing naum nalai’u vem? Jonathan jal'a keiman khutona kamusah thei ding tin adongin ahile,
English: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”

tcz: Saul insunga soh natong ho lah a mi khat anaum khan ama chu amin Ziba akiti; Hichun lengpan jong amapa chu adongin, “Nang hi Ziba nahi hinam?” tin adongin ahileh. Hichun Ziba in jong adonbut in“Henge keima Ziba chu kahinai,” ati.
en: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?” He said, “I am your servant.”
text:
2SA 9:2
Thadou: Saul insunga soh natong ho lah a mi khat anaum khan ama chu amin Ziba akiti; Hichun lengpan jong amapa chu adongin, “Nang hi Ziba nahi hinam?” tin adongin ahileh. Hichun Ziba in jong adonbut in“Henge keima Ziba chu kahinai,” ati.
English: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?” He said, “I am your servant.”

tcz: Chuin lengpan adongin, “Saul insung mi khat beh ahingdoh um nalailou ham? Aum leh, keiman Pathen mi khutona chu kamusah nom uve atileh; Ziban jong lengpa ahindonbut in, henge, “Jonathan chapa khat aum nan, ama hi akengphang te ni chatmoa kibai ahi,” atipeh e.
en: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?” Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”
text:
2SA 9:3
Thadou: Chuin lengpan adongin, “Saul insung mi khat beh ahingdoh um nalailou ham? Aum leh, keiman Pathen mi khutona chu kamusah nom uve atileh; Ziban jong lengpa ahindonbut in, henge, “Jonathan chapa khat aum nan, ama hi akengphang te ni chatmoa kibai ahi,” atipeh e.
English: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?” Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”

tcz: Chuphat in lengpan jong, “Ama chu hoiya umham?” tin ahin dong tan ahileh; Ziban lengpa chu aseipeh in, “Ama chu Lodebar khoa Ammiel chapa Makir In a um ahi,” ati.
en: The king said to him, “Where is he?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”
text:
2SA 9:4
Thadou: Chuphat in lengpan jong, “Ama chu hoiya umham?” tin ahin dong tan ahileh; Ziban lengpa chu aseipeh in, “Ama chu Lodebar khoa Ammiel chapa Makir In a um ahi,” ati.
English: The king said to him, “Where is he?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”

tcz: Hichun David lengpan mi asolin, ama chu Makir In na konin agapuidoh sah tai.
en: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.
text:
2SA 9:5
Thadou: Hichun David lengpan mi asolin, ama chu Makir In na konin agapuidoh sah tai.
English: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.

tcz: Hiti hin Saul tupa Jonathan chapa Mephibosheth kitipa chu David koma ahungin alu kunin jana apen ahi. Chuin David chun ahoupin, “Mephibosheth atileh; aman jong, “keima nasohpa kahi,” tin adonbut’e.
en: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?” He answered, “Behold, your servant!”
text:
2SA 9:6
Thadou: Hiti hin Saul tupa Jonathan chapa Mephibosheth kitipa chu David koma ahungin alu kunin jana apen ahi. Chuin David chun ahoupin, “Mephibosheth atileh; aman jong, “keima nasohpa kahi,” tin adonbut’e.
English: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?” He answered, “Behold, your servant!”

tcz: Hichun David’in akoma hitin aseiye, “Kicha hih in, keiman napa Jonathan jal a nanghi kakhoto ding, chujongle khatvei napu Saul neilegou anahikhasa jouse chu aboncha nangma kapeh kit ding nahi; chule nangman hiche leng ankong phunga hi keima toh an naneh khom ding ahiye,” ati.
en: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”
text:
2SA 9:7
Thadou: Hichun David’in akoma hitin aseiye, “Kicha hih in, keiman napa Jonathan jal a nanghi kakhoto ding, chujongle khatvei napu Saul neilegou anahikhasa jouse chu aboncha nangma kapeh kit ding nahi; chule nangman hiche leng ankong phunga hi keima toh an naneh khom ding ahiye,” ati.
English: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”

tcz: Hichun Mephibosheth jong chun jana ape kit’in aseikit’e, “Nasohpa kei hi ipi kahiya nangin hiche uicha thisa tobang chunga hi khutona neimusah khoh ding ham?” atitai.
en: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”
text:
2SA 9:8
Thadou: Hichun Mephibosheth jong chun jana ape kit’in aseikit’e, “Nasohpa kei hi ipi kahiya nangin hiche uicha thisa tobang chunga hi khutona neimusah khoh ding ham?” atitai.
English: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”

tcz: David lengpan Saul sohpa Ziba chu akouvin akoma hitin aseipeh’e, “Ipi hijongle Saul thilkeo anei jouse leh ama insung mite nei jouse chu aboncha hiche napu chapa hi kapeh ahitai.
en: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.
text:
2SA 9:9
Thadou: David lengpan Saul sohpa Ziba chu akouvin akoma hitin aseipeh’e, “Ipi hijongle Saul thilkeo anei jouse leh ama insung mite nei jouse chu aboncha hiche napu chapa hi kapeh ahitai.
English: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.

tcz: Hijeh a chu napu chapa hin anneh akimu jouna dinga nangma le nachapate, chule nasohten ama dinga lou nabol peh dingu ahin, alousoh ga nahin poh pehji dingu ahi; ahin hiche Mephibosheth napu tupa vang hin keima ankong phunga an aneh jing jeng ding ahi,” tin thu apetai. Ziba kitipa hin chapa som le nga ananeiyin, soh jong som ni jen aneiyin ahi.
en: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master’s son will always eat bread at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
text:
2SA 9:10
Thadou: Hijeh a chu napu chapa hin anneh akimu jouna dinga nangma le nachapate, chule nasohten ama dinga lou nabol peh dingu ahin, alousoh ga nahin poh pehji dingu ahi; ahin hiche Mephibosheth napu tupa vang hin keima ankong phunga an aneh jing jeng ding ahi,” tin thu apetai. Ziba kitipa hin chapa som le nga ananeiyin, soh jong som ni jen aneiyin ahi.
English: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master’s son will always eat bread at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

tcz: Chuin Ziba in lengpa koma aseijin, “Kapu lengpan nasohpa keima neithupeh bang bang chun nasohpa hin gabol nange,” ati. Hiti chun hiche nikho apet chun Mephobisheth hin lengpa chate lah a khatpen bang in David ankong phunga chun an anejing jeng tan ahi.
en: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.
text:
2SA 9:11
Thadou: Chuin Ziba in lengpa koma aseijin, “Kapu lengpan nasohpa keima neithupeh bang bang chun nasohpa hin gabol nange,” ati. Hiti chun hiche nikho apet chun Mephobisheth hin lengpa chate lah a khatpen bang in David ankong phunga chun an anejing jeng tan ahi.
English: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.

tcz: Mephibosheth jong hin chapa gollhang khat aneiyin, amin jong chu Mica ahi. Chunikho apet chun Mephibosheth soh natong din Ziba insung mite abonchan apang tauvin ahi.
en: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.
text:
2SA 9:12
Thadou: Mephibosheth jong hin chapa gollhang khat aneiyin, amin jong chu Mica ahi. Chunikho apet chun Mephibosheth soh natong din Ziba insung mite abonchan apang tauvin ahi.
English: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.

tcz: Hiti hin Mephibosheth akengphang te ni kibai pachu Jerusalem a achangin, chule aniseh in leng ankong ah an anejing tan ahi.
en: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. He was lame in both his feet.
text:
2SA 9:13
Thadou: Hiti hin Mephibosheth akengphang te ni kibai pachu Jerusalem a achangin, chule aniseh in leng ankong ah an anejing tan ahi.
English: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. He was lame in both his feet.

tcz: Hiche jouphat chomkhat jouvin, Ammon mite lengpa Nahash chu athitan, hijeh chun achapa Hanun kitipan Ammon mite chungah lengvai ahinpo tan ahi.
en: After this, the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place.
text:
2SA 10:1
Thadou: Hiche jouphat chomkhat jouvin, Ammon mite lengpa Nahash chu athitan, hijeh chun achapa Hanun kitipan Ammon mite chungah lengvai ahinpo tan ahi.
English: After this, the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Hichun David’in jong aseiyin, “Nahash chapa Hanun hi apan keima jana neitah a eina bol bang banga ken jong amahi jana neitah a kabol ding ahi,” tin anaseiye. Hijeh chun David’in jong sottolle ho asol’in Hanun chu apa thi jeh a lhem mong din asol peh e. ahin David sottolle ho chu Ammon mite gamsunga aga lhun phat un,
en: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent by his servants to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.
text:
2SA 10:2
Thadou: Hichun David’in jong aseiyin, “Nahash chapa Hanun hi apan keima jana neitah a eina bol bang banga ken jong amahi jana neitah a kabol ding ahi,” tin anaseiye. Hijeh chun David’in jong sottolle ho asol’in Hanun chu apa thi jeh a lhem mong din asol peh e. ahin David sottolle ho chu Ammon mite gamsunga aga lhun phat un,
English: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent by his servants to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

tcz: Ammon mite lamkai hon apupau Hanun koma chun aseiyuvin, ‘Nangman nagelthei mong hinam hiche mihohi napa jabol dinga hichemun hung ahi tia? Ahipoi! David’in khopi hi hunga suhgam ding agot jeh a sottolle hohi khopi sung kholtoh leh velhi le dinga ahinsol ahibouve tin aseipeh tauve.
en: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Hasn’t David sent his servants to you to search the city, to spy it out, and to overthrow it?”
text:
2SA 10:3
Thadou: Ammon mite lamkai hon apupau Hanun koma chun aseiyuvin, ‘Nangman nagelthei mong hinam hiche mihohi napa jabol dinga hichemun hung ahi tia? Ahipoi! David’in khopi hi hunga suhgam ding agot jeh a sottolle hohi khopi sung kholtoh leh velhi le dinga ahinsol ahibouve tin aseipeh tauve.
English: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Hasn’t David sent his servants to you to search the city, to spy it out, and to overthrow it?”

tcz: Hijeh chun Hanun hin David sottolle ho chu abonchauvin aman in melse tah in akhamul akeh langkhat avo chaipeh soh keiyin, chule aponsilu le akivon nau akimlai tah akongbuh dontah achetan peh soh keijun jachat umtah in anungsol taovin ahi.
en: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
text:
2SA 10:4
Thadou: Hijeh chun Hanun hin David sottolle ho chu abonchauvin aman in melse tah in akhamul akeh langkhat avo chaipeh soh keiyin, chule aponsilu le akivon nau akimlai tah akongbuh dontah achetan peh soh keijun jachat umtah in anungsol taovin ahi.
English: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

tcz: Hiti chun David sohte chunga thusoh ho David in ajahdoh phat in, amiteho thu gaseipih din mi asol tan ahi “Nakhamul’u akikhan lhit kit masang sen Jericho khopia hung umden unlang akikhan lhit tengle hung kile kit tauvin,” tin thu ahiltai. Ajeh chu amahohin alimsou chu ajachatpi mong mong u ahi.
en: When they told David this, he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. The king said, “Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”
text:
2SA 10:5
Thadou: Hiti chun David sohte chunga thusoh ho David in ajahdoh phat in, amiteho thu gaseipih din mi asol tan ahi “Nakhamul’u akikhan lhit kit masang sen Jericho khopia hung umden unlang akikhan lhit tengle hung kile kit tauvin,” tin thu ahiltai. Ajeh chu amahohin alimsou chu ajachatpi mong mong u ahi.
English: When they told David this, he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. The king said, “Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

tcz: Chujouvin Ammon miten echangeija David chu asuh lunghang u akihet doh phat’uvin, Ammon mite akihou toh-uvin Bethrehob a cheng Syria mite leh Zobah a cheng Syria mite tol'a panga galsat sepai sang som ni thalah dingle, Maacah lengpa le amite sang khat thalah ding chule Tob mite sang som le sang ni thalah dingin mi asol tauve.
en: When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zobah, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Maacah with one thousand men, and the men of Tob twelve thousand men.
text:
2SA 10:6
Thadou: Chujouvin Ammon miten echangeija David chu asuh lunghang u akihet doh phat’uvin, Ammon mite akihou toh-uvin Bethrehob a cheng Syria mite leh Zobah a cheng Syria mite tol'a panga galsat sepai sang som ni thalah dingle, Maacah lengpa le amite sang khat thalah ding chule Tob mite sang som le sang ni thalah dingin mi asol tauve.
English: When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zobah, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Maacah with one thousand men, and the men of Tob twelve thousand men.

tcz: Hiche thusoh David lengpan ajah doh phat’in lamkai Joab le asepaite mihat chengse chu abonchauvin gal boldin asoltai.
en: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.
text:
2SA 10:7
Thadou: Hiche thusoh David lengpan ajah doh phat’in lamkai Joab le asepaite mihat chengse chu abonchauvin gal boldin asoltai.
English: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.

tcz: Chuin Ammon mite chu ahung kitoldoh’uvin kelkot phunga chun galsat din akigol tauve; chule Arameans mite Zobah le Rehob khoa kon leh Tob le Maacah mite chu mun onglen laiah akigol taovin ahi.
en: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the gate. The Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the field.
text:
2SA 10:8
Thadou: Chuin Ammon mite chu ahung kitoldoh’uvin kelkot phunga chun galsat din akigol tauve; chule Arameans mite Zobah le Rehob khoa kon leh Tob le Maacah mite chu mun onglen laiah akigol taovin ahi.
English: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the gate. The Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the field.

tcz: Joab chun amasanglam le anunglama gal miten ating tan to tai, ti amudoh phat’in, Israel lah a mi son um lhentum cheh phabep alhengdoh in, Arameans mite dou din mun onglai ah apansah tai.
en: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel and put them in array against the Syrians.
text:
2SA 10:9
Thadou: Joab chun amasanglam le anunglama gal miten ating tan to tai, ti amudoh phat’in, Israel lah a mi son um lhentum cheh phabep alhengdoh in, Arameans mite dou din mun onglai ah apansah tai.
English: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel and put them in array against the Syrians.

tcz: Chule mi amoh chengse chu asopipa Abishai lamkai peh din akoiyin, Abishaiyin asopite chengse chu Ammon mite toh kisat to din agol toh tai.
en: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and he put them in array against the children of Ammon.
text:
2SA 10:10
Thadou: Chule mi amoh chengse chu asopipa Abishai lamkai peh din akoiyin, Abishaiyin asopite chengse chu Ammon mite toh kisat to din agol toh tai.
English: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and he put them in array against the children of Ammon.

tcz: Chuin Joab’in aseitai, “Arameans mite hi Keima dinga ahat behseh jenguva ahileh nangman neihung kithopin lang, chule Ammon mite chu nang dinga ahatval behseh jenguva ahijongle keima hung ing ting nahung kithopi nange, ati.
en: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will come and help you.
text:
2SA 10:11
Thadou: Chuin Joab’in aseitai, “Arameans mite hi Keima dinga ahat behseh jenguva ahileh nangman neihung kithopin lang, chule Ammon mite chu nang dinga ahatval behseh jenguva ahijongle keima hung ing ting nahung kithopi nange, ati.
English: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will come and help you.

tcz: Hijeh chun hangtah in hung pang uvin lang, imiteu ding leh i-Pathen’u khopi jouse din pasal jouse chu hatah in pangu hitin; chule Pakaiyin lungdei chu guilhung tahen,”ati.
en: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God; and may the LORD do what seems good to him.”
text:
2SA 10:12
Thadou: Hijeh chun hangtah in hung pang uvin lang, imiteu ding leh i-Pathen’u khopi jouse din pasal jouse chu hatah in pangu hitin; chule Pakaiyin lungdei chu guilhung tahen,”ati.
English: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God; and may the LORD do what seems good to him.”

tcz: Hiti hin Joab le ama toh pang khom sepaiho chun Arameans mite chu asat pan un ahileh; Arameans mite chu ajamcheh gam tauvin ahi.
en: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.
text:
2SA 10:13
Thadou: Hiti hin Joab le ama toh pang khom sepaiho chun Arameans mite chu asat pan un ahileh; Arameans mite chu ajamcheh gam tauvin ahi.
English: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.

tcz: Arameans mite jam chu Ammon miten jong amudoh phat’uvin amaho jong chutobangma chun Abishai masanga ajam uvin akhopi sunga alhailut tauvin ahi. Hichun Ammon mite toh akisat nao vakon in Jo’ab jong Jerusalema ahung kile kit tan ahi.
en: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai, and entered into the city. Then Joab returned from the children of Ammon and came to Jerusalem.
text:
2SA 10:14
Thadou: Arameans mite jam chu Ammon miten jong amudoh phat’uvin amaho jong chutobangma chun Abishai masanga ajam uvin akhopi sunga alhailut tauvin ahi. Hichun Ammon mite toh akisat nao vakon in Jo’ab jong Jerusalema ahung kile kit tan ahi.
English: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai, and entered into the city. Then Joab returned from the children of Ammon and came to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hichun Arameans miten Israel chate toh kidinte joulou ding ahiu chu ahin kihetdoh phat un ahung kithah gopkhom kit uvin,
en: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they gathered themselves together.
text:
2SA 10:15
Thadou: Hichun Arameans miten Israel chate toh kidinte joulou ding ahiu chu ahin kihetdoh phat un ahung kithah gopkhom kit uvin,
English: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they gathered themselves together.

tcz: Hadadezer kitipan asol in Euphrates luipi gal a cheng Arameans mite aga kousah in ahileh, amaho jong Hadadezer sepai lamkaipa Shobach lamkai nan Helam geiyin ahung kitol’uvin Arameans mite ahinjop kit un ahi.
en: Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River; and they came to Helam, with Shobach the captain of the army of Hadadezer at their head.
text:
2SA 10:16
Thadou: Hadadezer kitipan asol in Euphrates luipi gal a cheng Arameans mite aga kousah in ahileh, amaho jong Hadadezer sepai lamkaipa Shobach lamkai nan Helam geiyin ahung kitol’uvin Arameans mite ahinjop kit un ahi.
English: Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River; and they came to Helam, with Shobach the captain of the army of Hadadezer at their head.

tcz: Chuin David in hitabang thil umchan chu ajah phat in, aman jong Israel chate pumpi akhom khom soh keiyin chule Jordan ahung galkaiyin Helam channah a sepai te ahin puilhung tan ahi. Hichun Arameans mite jong David lengpa dou din achamtah un anapang uvin akisatpi tauve.
en: David was told that; and he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, and came to Helam. The Syrians set themselves in array against David and fought with him.
text:
2SA 10:17
Thadou: Chuin David in hitabang thil umchan chu ajah phat in, aman jong Israel chate pumpi akhom khom soh keiyin chule Jordan ahung galkaiyin Helam channah a sepai te ahin puilhung tan ahi. Hichun Arameans mite jong David lengpa dou din achamtah un anapang uvin akisatpi tauve.
English: David was told that; and he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, and came to Helam. The Syrians set themselves in array against David and fought with him.

tcz: Ahinlah Arameans mite chu Israel te masanga ajam kit tauvin ahi. hichea hin David sepai ten Arameans sepai sakol them ho mi jasagi le tol'a pang sepai sangsomli chule agal lamkaipau Shobach kitipa jaonan athat taovin ahi.
en: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven hundred charioteers of the Syrians and forty thousand horsemen, and struck Shobach the captain of their army, so that he died there.
text:
2SA 10:18
Thadou: Ahinlah Arameans mite chu Israel te masanga ajam kit tauvin ahi. hichea hin David sepai ten Arameans sepai sakol them ho mi jasagi le tol'a pang sepai sangsomli chule agal lamkaipau Shobach kitipa jaonan athat taovin ahi.
English: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven hundred charioteers of the Syrians and forty thousand horsemen, and struck Shobach the captain of their army, so that he died there.

tcz: Chuin Lengte jousen Hadadezer toh akitho vang uva Israel te ajolou u amudoh phat un, Israel mite khut ah akipelut un amaho noijah aum taovin ahi. hichejou a pet chun Arameans mite chun Ammon mite kithopi ding chu akicha taovin ahi.
en: When all the kings who were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were defeated before Israel, they made peace with Israel and served them. So the Syrians were afraid to help the children of Ammon any more.
text:
2SA 10:19
Thadou: Chuin Lengte jousen Hadadezer toh akitho vang uva Israel te ajolou u amudoh phat un, Israel mite khut ah akipelut un amaho noijah aum taovin ahi. hichejou a pet chun Arameans mite chun Ammon mite kithopi ding chu akicha taovin ahi.
English: When all the kings who were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were defeated before Israel, they made peace with Israel and served them. So the Syrians were afraid to help the children of Ammon any more.

tcz: Chavang laile chonna ngai dan a anaum leng ho galkon phat laiyin David jong chun Joab le asepaite toh Israel chate abonchan galkon din asoltai; amaho jong acheuvin Ammon sepaite agasumang un, chule Rabbah kho aga umtauve. Ahin David vang chu Jerusalem khopia aumden jing nai.
en: At the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, David sent Joab and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem.
text:
2SA 11:1
Thadou: Chavang laile chonna ngai dan a anaum leng ho galkon phat laiyin David jong chun Joab le asepaite toh Israel chate abonchan galkon din asoltai; amaho jong acheuvin Ammon sepaite agasumang un, chule Rabbah kho aga umtauve. Ahin David vang chu Jerusalem khopia aumden jing nai.
English: At the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, David sent Joab and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem.

tcz: Nikhat hi nilhah lam ni kihei don hin David jong asunchol na jalkhun'a konin athou doh in leng Inpi inchunga chun avah len ahileh, inchunga kon chun numei melhoi khat akisil pet tah amun ahi.
en: At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful to look at.
text:
2SA 11:2
Thadou: Nikhat hi nilhah lam ni kihei don hin David jong asunchol na jalkhun'a konin athou doh in leng Inpi inchunga chun avah len ahileh, inchunga kon chun numei melhoi khat akisil pet tah amun ahi.
English: At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful to look at.

tcz: Hijeh chun David’in mi asol in numeinu chu koi ham, tin agadoh le sah tai. Hichea hin mi khat chun, “Hiche nu hi Eliam chanu, Hittite mipa Uriah jinu Bathsheba chu ahi” tin aseipih tai.
en: David sent and inquired after the woman. One said, “Isn’t this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite’s wife?”
text:
2SA 11:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun David’in mi asol in numeinu chu koi ham, tin agadoh le sah tai. Hichea hin mi khat chun, “Hiche nu hi Eliam chanu, Hittite mipa Uriah jinu Bathsheba chu ahi” tin aseipih tai.
English: David sent and inquired after the woman. One said, “Isn’t this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite’s wife?”

tcz: Hichun David’in mi sottol le ho asol in amanu chu aga puisah in, Bathsheba jong chu leng inpi sung ahung lut’in, chuin David chun amanu chu aluppi tan ahi. Hichepet a hi Bathsheba chu athi neijou akisuh theng jou chabou ahi; akichaiyin amanu jong a inlama achetai.
en: David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in to him, and he lay with her (for she was purified from her uncleanness); and she returned to her house.
text:
2SA 11:4
Thadou: Hichun David’in mi sottol le ho asol in amanu chu aga puisah in, Bathsheba jong chu leng inpi sung ahung lut’in, chuin David chun amanu chu aluppi tan ahi. Hichepet a hi Bathsheba chu athi neijou akisuh theng jou chabou ahi; akichaiyin amanu jong a inlama achetai.
English: David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in to him, and he lay with her (for she was purified from her uncleanness); and she returned to her house.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin Bathsheban nao avop ahin kihetdoh phat’in aman David koma hitin thu athot in, “Keiman nao kavoptai,” ati.
en: The woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, “I am with child.”
text:
2SA 11:5
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin Bathsheban nao avop ahin kihetdoh phat’in aman David koma hitin thu athot in, “Keiman nao kavoptai,” ati.
English: The woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, “I am with child.”

tcz: Hichun David in Joab chu thu athot in: “Uriah kitipa Hittite mipa chu kahenga hinsol temin,” ati. Hijeh chun Joab in jong Uriah chu David lengpa hengah ahinsol tan ahi.
en: David sent to Joab, “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” Joab sent Uriah to David.
text:
2SA 11:6
Thadou: Hichun David in Joab chu thu athot in: “Uriah kitipa Hittite mipa chu kahenga hinsol temin,” ati. Hijeh chun Joab in jong Uriah chu David lengpa hengah ahinsol tan ahi.
English: David sent to Joab, “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” Joab sent Uriah to David.

tcz: Chuin Uriah chu David kom ahung lhun phat’in, David’in jong Joab umchan chule mipi itobang banga um uva chule agal sat u machal jing hinam tin adongin ahi.
en: When Uriah had come to him, David asked him how Joab did, and how the people fared, and how the war prospered.
text:
2SA 11:7
Thadou: Chuin Uriah chu David kom ahung lhun phat’in, David’in jong Joab umchan chule mipi itobang banga um uva chule agal sat u machal jing hinam tin adongin ahi.
English: When Uriah had come to him, David asked him how Joab did, and how the people fared, and how the war prospered.

tcz: Chujouvin David in Uriah koma aseitai, ‘Na-in lama nomin chesuh tan, Hijeh chun Uriah jong leng inpi adalhan achesuh tai, chuin leng ipi adalhah chun anunga chun lengpa insunga konin thilpeh ding khat ahin choi peh pai paiyuvin ahi.
en: David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and a gift from the king was sent after him.
text:
2SA 11:8
Thadou: Chujouvin David in Uriah koma aseitai, ‘Na-in lama nomin chesuh tan, Hijeh chun Uriah jong leng inpi adalhan achesuh tai, chuin leng ipi adalhah chun anunga chun lengpa insunga konin thilpeh ding khat ahin choi peh pai paiyuvin ahi.
English: David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and a gift from the king was sent after him.

tcz: Ahivangin Uriah chu inlang achipon, lengpa kotpi phung bula kotkhah ngah ho toh chun hiche jan chun alum den tan ahi.
en: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and didn’t go down to his house.
text:
2SA 11:9
Thadou: Ahivangin Uriah chu inlang achipon, lengpa kotpi phung bula kotkhah ngah ho toh chun hiche jan chun alum den tan ahi.
English: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and didn’t go down to his house.

tcz: Hichun David in Uriah a inlam achilou ahin hetdoh phat chun, akou in epi jeh ham ti adong tan ahi, “Kholgama kona hung lhung nahilou ham, ibola na in lama chelouva naum ham?” tin aseitai.
en: When they had told David, saying, “Uriah didn’t go down to his house,” David said to Uriah, “Haven’t you come from a journey? Why didn’t you go down to your house?”
text:
2SA 11:10
Thadou: Hichun David in Uriah a inlam achilou ahin hetdoh phat chun, akou in epi jeh ham ti adong tan ahi, “Kholgama kona hung lhung nahilou ham, ibola na in lama chelouva naum ham?” tin aseitai.
English: When they had told David, saying, “Uriah didn’t go down to his house,” David said to Uriah, “Haven’t you come from a journey? Why didn’t you go down to your house?”

tcz: Hichun Uriah’in David koma aseijin, “Pathen thingkong le Israel chate chule Judah mite lhambuh jenga cheng ahiuvin, kapu sepaite kapupa Joab le asepaite jong tollhang lah a ngahmun mai maiya cheng ahiuve; ipi dinga keima in'a kachea kadu du kaneh a atui tui kadona kajinu angsunga nomtah a kalup ding ham? Nangma damlai sung le nahinkho phatlai sungsen keiman hitobang kinopsah na thil hi bol ponge,’ tin aseiye.
en: Uriah said to David, “The ark, Israel, and Judah, are staying in tents; and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are encamped in the open field. Shall I then go into my house to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? As you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing!”
text:
2SA 11:11
Thadou: Hichun Uriah’in David koma aseijin, “Pathen thingkong le Israel chate chule Judah mite lhambuh jenga cheng ahiuvin, kapu sepaite kapupa Joab le asepaite jong tollhang lah a ngahmun mai maiya cheng ahiuve; ipi dinga keima in'a kachea kadu du kaneh a atui tui kadona kajinu angsunga nomtah a kalup ding ham? Nangma damlai sung le nahinkho phatlai sungsen keiman hitobang kinopsah na thil hi bol ponge,’ tin aseiye.
English: Uriah said to David, “The ark, Israel, and Judah, are staying in tents; and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are encamped in the open field. Shall I then go into my house to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? As you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing!”

tcz: Chuphat’in David chun Uriah koma aseijin, “aphai tuni jong hikoma umtan, jing tengle navaikon doh sah nange,” atitai. Hijeh chun Uriah jong chuchi nikho le ajing nikho chun Jerusalema anichongtai ahi.
en: David said to Uriah, “Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will let you depart.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next day.
text:
2SA 11:12
Thadou: Chuphat’in David chun Uriah koma aseijin, “aphai tuni jong hikoma umtan, jing tengle navaikon doh sah nange,” atitai. Hijeh chun Uriah jong chuchi nikho le ajing nikho chun Jerusalema anichongtai ahi.
English: David said to Uriah, “Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will let you depart.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next day.

tcz: Chuin David’in Uriah chu, ama koma an ne dingle lengpitwi don dingin akou vin; chuin ama chu lengpitwi adon kham sah tai; chuchi jou jeng injong a inlam ma ajinu kom chidin asol doh jou dehpon, nilhah lamin Uriah chu kelkot ngah sepaite chutoh lumkhom din ajalkhun akijot kit tan ahi.
en: When David had called him, he ate and drank before him; and he made him drunk. At evening, he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but didn’t go down to his house.
text:
2SA 11:13
Thadou: Chuin David’in Uriah chu, ama koma an ne dingle lengpitwi don dingin akou vin; chuin ama chu lengpitwi adon kham sah tai; chuchi jou jeng injong a inlam ma ajinu kom chidin asol doh jou dehpon, nilhah lamin Uriah chu kelkot ngah sepaite chutoh lumkhom din ajalkhun akijot kit tan ahi.
English: When David had called him, he ate and drank before him; and he made him drunk. At evening, he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but didn’t go down to his house.

tcz: Chuin Ajing jingkah chun David’in Joab lekha khat athot in hichu Uriah khut’a agah thot’e.
en: In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
text:
2SA 11:14
Thadou: Chuin Ajing jingkah chun David’in Joab lekha khat athot in hichu Uriah khut’a agah thot’e.
English: In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

tcz: Lekha sunga hin David chun hitin asune, “Uriah hi gal kisatna ahah lai laiya amasan pansah uvin lang chutengle gal miten atha teitei nadin ama achangseh'in dalhauvin,” tin asune.
en: He wrote in the letter, saying, “Send Uriah to the forefront of the hottest battle, and retreat from him, that he may be struck and die.”
text:
2SA 11:15
Thadou: Lekha sunga hin David chun hitin asune, “Uriah hi gal kisatna ahah lai laiya amasan pansah uvin lang chutengle gal miten atha teitei nadin ama achangseh'in dalhauvin,” tin asune.
English: He wrote in the letter, saying, “Send Uriah to the forefront of the hottest battle, and retreat from him, that he may be struck and die.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Joab injong khopi khat aum phat’in mihat tah tah panmun ahi, tia ahetsa bangkom laitah a chun Uriah chu apansah tan ahi.
en: When Joab kept watch on the city, he assigned Uriah to the place where he knew that valiant men were.
text:
2SA 11:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun Joab injong khopi khat aum phat’in mihat tah tah panmun ahi, tia ahetsa bangkom laitah a chun Uriah chu apansah tan ahi.
English: When Joab kept watch on the city, he assigned Uriah to the place where he knew that valiant men were.

tcz: Chuin khopi sunga sepaite ahung kondoh uvin Joab chutoh akisat tauvin ahi; chule hichemun a chun Hittite mi Uriah jaonan mipi lah a David sepaite phabep jong athat tauvin ahi.
en: The men of the city went out and fought with Joab. Some of the people fell, even of David’s servants; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
text:
2SA 11:17
Thadou: Chuin khopi sunga sepaite ahung kondoh uvin Joab chutoh akisat tauvin ahi; chule hichemun a chun Hittite mi Uriah jaonan mipi lah a David sepaite phabep jong athat tauvin ahi.
English: The men of the city went out and fought with Joab. Some of the people fell, even of David’s servants; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

tcz: Hichun Joab’in jong mi asol in gal kisat umchan jouse chu David koma aga lhutsah tai.
en: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

tcz: Hichun asottolle mipa chu ahilchah masan, “Lengpa koma chu gal kisat thusim aboncha nasei soh kei ding ahi, ati.
en: and he commanded the messenger, saying, “When you have finished telling all the things concerning the war to the king,
text:
2SA 11:19
Thadou: Hichun asottolle mipa chu ahilchah masan, “Lengpa koma chu gal kisat thusim aboncha nasei soh kei ding ahi, ati.
English: and he commanded the messenger, saying, “When you have finished telling all the things concerning the war to the king,

tcz: Ahin Ijem tia lengpa alung han jeng tah a nangkoma, ‘Ibola chutobang a chu khopi nanai lut jenguva kisat pi dinga nacheuba ham? Kulpi bang dunga kona nahin kap jeng diu nahet louvu ham?
en: it shall be that, if the king’s wrath arise, and he asks you, ‘Why did you go so near to the city to fight? Didn’t you know that they would shoot from the wall?
text:
2SA 11:20
Thadou: Ahin Ijem tia lengpa alung han jeng tah a nangkoma, ‘Ibola chutobang a chu khopi nanai lut jenguva kisat pi dinga nacheuba ham? Kulpi bang dunga kona nahin kap jeng diu nahet louvu ham?
English: it shall be that, if the king’s wrath arise, and he asks you, ‘Why did you go so near to the city to fight? Didn’t you know that they would shoot from the wall?

tcz: Chule Gideon chapa Abimelech chu koi tha ham? Bangvuma kona numei khat’in sumhei song ahinlhah sah leh alhah khum khah a hijeh a chu Thebez kiti laiya chu thiden hilou ham? Ibola hitobang tah a chu bang nanai lut jengu ham?’ tia asei leh; nangman, ‘Nasohpa Hittite mi Uriah jong athi tai,’ tia na seipeh ding ahi,” tin ahil’e.
en: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Didn’t a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died at Thebez? Why did you go so near the wall?’ then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.’”
text:
2SA 11:21
Thadou: Chule Gideon chapa Abimelech chu koi tha ham? Bangvuma kona numei khat’in sumhei song ahinlhah sah leh alhah khum khah a hijeh a chu Thebez kiti laiya chu thiden hilou ham? Ibola hitobang tah a chu bang nanai lut jengu ham?’ tia asei leh; nangman, ‘Nasohpa Hittite mi Uriah jong athi tai,’ tia na seipeh ding ahi,” tin ahil’e.
English: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Didn’t a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died at Thebez? Why did you go so near the wall?’ then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.’”

tcz: Hichun sottolle pachu Jerusalem ahungin David koma Joab in asol lo na jouse chu abonchan ahilsoh kei tan ahi.
en: So the messenger went, and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for.
text:
2SA 11:22
Thadou: Hichun sottolle pachu Jerusalem ahungin David koma Joab in asol lo na jouse chu abonchan ahilsoh kei tan ahi.
English: So the messenger went, and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for.

tcz: Hichun sottolle pa chun David hengah hitin aseiye, “Gal miten keiho eihin joujo tauvin, keiho dou nan tollhanga ahung kitol doh jenguve; ahivangin keihon jong kelkot phung lam chan in kaledel lut kit’uvin ahi.
en: The messenger said to David, “The men prevailed against us, and came out to us into the field; and we were on them even to the entrance of the gate.
text:
2SA 11:23
Thadou: Hichun sottolle pa chun David hengah hitin aseiye, “Gal miten keiho eihin joujo tauvin, keiho dou nan tollhanga ahung kitol doh jenguve; ahivangin keihon jong kelkot phung lam chan in kaledel lut kit’uvin ahi.
English: The messenger said to David, “The men prevailed against us, and came out to us into the field; and we were on them even to the entrance of the gate.

tcz: Chuin galmi thalpi kap them hon banga konin nasohte lengpa sepai phabep jong ahinkap lih taovin, chule nasohpa Uriah jeng jong athitai,’ ati.
en: The shooters shot at your servants from off the wall; and some of the king’s servants are dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.”
text:
2SA 11:24
Thadou: Chuin galmi thalpi kap them hon banga konin nasohte lengpa sepai phabep jong ahinkap lih taovin, chule nasohpa Uriah jeng jong athitai,’ ati.
English: The shooters shot at your servants from off the wall; and some of the king’s servants are dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.”

tcz: Hichun David jong chun sottolle pa koma chun aseiyin, “Nangman Joab koma hitia hi nasei ding ahi; Hiche thilsoh jeh hin nangma lunglhadai hih in, ajeh chu chemjamin khat khat’a abantan tan ahitai; aban teng natha hatsah jon lang khopi chu delkhumin, tin seipeh in, hiti chun Joab chu atilkhou tan,’ ahi.
en: Then David said to the messenger, “Tell Joab, ‘Don’t let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Make your battle stronger against the city, and overthrow it.’ Encourage him.”
text:
2SA 11:25
Thadou: Hichun David jong chun sottolle pa koma chun aseiyin, “Nangman Joab koma hitia hi nasei ding ahi; Hiche thilsoh jeh hin nangma lunglhadai hih in, ajeh chu chemjamin khat khat’a abantan tan ahitai; aban teng natha hatsah jon lang khopi chu delkhumin, tin seipeh in, hiti chun Joab chu atilkhou tan,’ ahi.
English: Then David said to the messenger, “Tell Joab, ‘Don’t let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Make your battle stronger against the city, and overthrow it.’ Encourage him.”

tcz: Chuin Uriah jinun ajipa Uriah chu athitai, ti ajah doh phat in ajipa dingin akap’in apul adoutan ahi.
en: When Uriah’s wife heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.
text:
2SA 11:26
Thadou: Chuin Uriah jinun ajipa Uriah chu athitai, ti ajah doh phat in ajipa dingin akap’in apul adoutan ahi.
English: When Uriah’s wife heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.

tcz: Amanu pul douna phat akichai’in David’in mi asolin amanu chu leng inpi sungah agapui lutsah tai, chule Bathsheba in David chu chapa khat ahinpeh tai. hinla David thilbol achonna chungah Pakai alung lhai tapoi ahi.
en: When the mourning was past, David sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD.
text:
2SA 11:27
Thadou: Amanu pul douna phat akichai’in David’in mi asolin amanu chu leng inpi sungah agapui lutsah tai, chule Bathsheba in David chu chapa khat ahinpeh tai. hinla David thilbol achonna chungah Pakai alung lhai tapoi ahi.
English: When the mourning was past, David sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD.

tcz: Hiti chun Nathan themgaopa chu Pakaiyin David komah asol tan ahi: Hichun Nathanin jong David koma hitin aga seiye, “Khopi sung khat’a hin pasal ni acheng lhonin, khatpa chu mihao ahin, khat jopa vang chu mivaicha ahi.
en: The LORD sent Nathan to David. He came to him, and said to him, “There were two men in one city: the one rich, and the other poor.
text:
2SA 12:1
Thadou: Hiti chun Nathan themgaopa chu Pakaiyin David komah asol tan ahi: Hichun Nathanin jong David koma hitin aga seiye, “Khopi sung khat’a hin pasal ni acheng lhonin, khatpa chu mihao ahin, khat jopa vang chu mivaicha ahi.
English: The LORD sent Nathan to David. He came to him, and said to him, “There were two men in one city: the one rich, and the other poor.

tcz: Hichun mihaopa hin kelngoihon tamtah le bonghon tampi aneiyin ahi.
en: The rich man had very many flocks and herds,
text:
2SA 12:2
Thadou: Hichun mihaopa hin kelngoihon tamtah le bonghon tampi aneiyin ahi.
English: The rich man had very many flocks and herds,

tcz: Ahin mivaichapa vang chun imacha aneipoi, ahin aman alel lel a akichoh kelngoipi khat seh seh bou aneiye. Hijongle aman akelngoipi chu akivah vah-in achate toh phatechan avah in ahi; kelngoipi hin ama changlhah aneh ding an jong anejin, adon ding twi jong ama khon sunga konin adon ji'e; chutengle a-angsunga alum jin, achanu tobang bangin aumtan ahi.
en: but the poor man had nothing, except one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and raised. It grew up together with him and with his children. It ate of his own food, drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was like a daughter to him.
text:
2SA 12:3
Thadou: Ahin mivaichapa vang chun imacha aneipoi, ahin aman alel lel a akichoh kelngoipi khat seh seh bou aneiye. Hijongle aman akelngoipi chu akivah vah-in achate toh phatechan avah in ahi; kelngoipi hin ama changlhah aneh ding an jong anejin, adon ding twi jong ama khon sunga konin adon ji'e; chutengle a-angsunga alum jin, achanu tobang bangin aumtan ahi.
English: but the poor man had nothing, except one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and raised. It grew up together with him and with his children. It ate of his own food, drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was like a daughter to him.

tcz: Hichelai hin kholjin mikhat mihaopa koma chun ahung lhung in ahileh, hiche kholjinpa thapeh ding chun mihaopan jong ama kelngoi hon lah a khattou thapeh ding jong a-ittan, chule ama bonghon lah a kona khattou thapeh ding jong a-it tai; ahin mivaichapa kelngoipi khat sheh anei chu aman in akoma hung kholjin pa ding chun atha peh tan ahi,” ati.
en: A traveler came to the rich man, and he didn’t want to take of his own flock and of his own herd to prepare for the wayfaring man who had come to him, but took the poor man’s lamb and prepared it for the man who had come to him.”
text:
2SA 12:4
Thadou: Hichelai hin kholjin mikhat mihaopa koma chun ahung lhung in ahileh, hiche kholjinpa thapeh ding chun mihaopan jong ama kelngoi hon lah a khattou thapeh ding jong a-ittan, chule ama bonghon lah a kona khattou thapeh ding jong a-it tai; ahin mivaichapa kelngoipi khat sheh anei chu aman in akoma hung kholjin pa ding chun atha peh tan ahi,” ati.
English: A traveler came to the rich man, and he didn’t want to take of his own flock and of his own herd to prepare for the wayfaring man who had come to him, but took the poor man’s lamb and prepared it for the man who had come to him.”

tcz: Chutah chun David jong alung hangjah jengin hiche mihaopa douna chun Nathan themgao koma chun hitin aseitai, “Pakai hing jing mina kasei ahi, hitobanga kisa chonvalpa chu thi dinga kilom mong ahibouve!
en: David’s anger burned hot against the man, and he said to Nathan, “As the LORD lives, the man who has done this deserves to die!
text:
2SA 12:5
Thadou: Chutah chun David jong alung hangjah jengin hiche mihaopa douna chun Nathan themgao koma chun hitin aseitai, “Pakai hing jing mina kasei ahi, hitobanga kisa chonvalpa chu thi dinga kilom mong ahibouve!
English: David’s anger burned hot against the man, and he said to Nathan, “As the LORD lives, the man who has done this deserves to die!

tcz: Chujongle aman voujang natna beihela hitobang thilpi hi abol jeh hin aman kelngoipi chu ajat li’a asah kit ding ahi,’ atitai.
en: He must restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing and because he had no pity!”
text:
2SA 12:6
Thadou: Chujongle aman voujang natna beihela hitobang thilpi hi abol jeh hin aman kelngoipi chu ajat li’a asah kit ding ahi,’ atitai.
English: He must restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing and because he had no pity!”

tcz: Chuin Nathan themgaopan David koma aseipai jengin, “Hichea kisei mihaopa hi nangma nahi, Pakai Israel Pathenin hitin aseiye, ‘Nang hi keiman Israel chate chunga leng chang dinga thao kanusa nahin, chule Saul thaneina a kon kanahuhdoh nahiye.
en: Nathan said to David, “You are the man! This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul.
text:
2SA 12:7
Thadou: Chuin Nathan themgaopan David koma aseipai jengin, “Hichea kisei mihaopa hi nangma nahi, Pakai Israel Pathenin hitin aseiye, ‘Nang hi keiman Israel chate chunga leng chang dinga thao kanusa nahin, chule Saul thaneina a kon kanahuhdoh nahiye.
English: Nathan said to David, “You are the man! This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul.

tcz: Chujongle napupa Saul’in, ajiteu jouse chule Israel insung pumpi le Judah insung pumpi jong kapeh nahi; hicheng jong hi alhom behseh na laiya ahileh tamtah kapehbe ding nahi nalaiye.
en: I gave you your master’s house and your master’s wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that would have been too little, I would have added to you many more such things.
text:
2SA 12:8
Thadou: Chujongle napupa Saul’in, ajiteu jouse chule Israel insung pumpi le Judah insung pumpi jong kapeh nahi; hicheng jong hi alhom behseh na laiya ahileh tamtah kapehbe ding nahi nalaiye.
English: I gave you your master’s house and your master’s wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that would have been too little, I would have added to you many more such things.

tcz: Chuti ahileh epi dinga nangman Pakai thusei nanot thap a hitabang tijat umtah thil hi nabol hitam? Nangman Hittite mipa Uriah chu nadengin Ammon mite chemjamin nathat nin, chule ajinu jong naji din nakipui jeng theiye.
en: Why have you despised the LORD’s word, to do that which is evil in his sight? You have struck Uriah the Hittite with the sword, have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.
text:
2SA 12:9
Thadou: Chuti ahileh epi dinga nangman Pakai thusei nanot thap a hitabang tijat umtah thil hi nabol hitam? Nangman Hittite mipa Uriah chu nadengin Ammon mite chemjamin nathat nin, chule ajinu jong naji din nakipui jeng theiye.
English: Why have you despised the LORD’s word, to do that which is evil in his sight? You have struck Uriah the Hittite with the sword, have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

tcz: Hijeh a chu tua hi nangma insunga kona jong chemjam lang jing jeng ding ahi. ajeh chu nangin keima nahsah mon neibolin, Hittite mipa Uriah jinu chu naji din nakipuitai,’ tin aseiye.
en: Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised me and have taken Uriah the Hittite’s wife to be your wife.’
text:
2SA 12:10
Thadou: Hijeh a chu tua hi nangma insunga kona jong chemjam lang jing jeng ding ahi. ajeh chu nangin keima nahsah mon neibolin, Hittite mipa Uriah jinu chu naji din nakipuitai,’ tin aseiye.
English: Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised me and have taken Uriah the Hittite’s wife to be your wife.’

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, ajeh chu nangman nathil bol banga, keiman nangma insunga kona nadou ding thilse kahin kondoh sah ding ahi. chule namitmu changtah a najite jeng jong kalah peh a naheng nakom mite kapeh doh ding, chule amahon japi mitmu lai jenga jong najite chu aluppi dingu ahi.
en: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.
text:
2SA 12:11
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, ajeh chu nangman nathil bol banga, keiman nangma insunga kona nadou ding thilse kahin kondoh sah ding ahi. chule namitmu changtah a najite jeng jong kalah peh a naheng nakom mite kapeh doh ding, chule amahon japi mitmu lai jenga jong najite chu aluppi dingu ahi.
English: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh nangman nathil bol chu guhthima nabol ahin, keiman vang Israel chate pumpi mitmu dinga kabol ding ahi,’ tin aseiye.”
en: For you did this secretly, but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.’”
text:
2SA 12:12
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh nangman nathil bol chu guhthima nabol ahin, keiman vang Israel chate pumpi mitmu dinga kabol ding ahi,’ tin aseiye.”
English: For you did this secretly, but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.’”

tcz: Chutah chun David in jong Nathan koma hitin aseiye, “Keima Pakai dounan kachonsetai,” atin ahileh; Nathan jong chun David koma aseipaiyin, “Pakaiyin nachonset angaidam tai. hijeh a chu hiche chonset jeh in nangma thi tapon nate.
en: David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against the LORD.” Nathan said to David, “The LORD also has put away your sin. You will not die.
text:
2SA 12:13
Thadou: Chutah chun David in jong Nathan koma hitin aseiye, “Keima Pakai dounan kachonsetai,” atin ahileh; Nathan jong chun David koma aseipaiyin, “Pakaiyin nachonset angaidam tai. hijeh a chu hiche chonset jeh in nangma thi tapon nate.
English: David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against the LORD.” Nathan said to David, “The LORD also has put away your sin. You will not die.

tcz: Hijongle nangin hiche thil hi nabol a Pakai chu nahsah mo tah a nabol a nataitom ahitan, hijeh a chu ahung peng ding nacha chu thitei tei ding ahi tai,” tin aseitai.
en: However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to the LORD’s enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is born to you will surely die.”
text:
2SA 12:14
Thadou: Hijongle nangin hiche thil hi nabol a Pakai chu nahsah mo tah a nabol a nataitom ahitan, hijeh a chu ahung peng ding nacha chu thitei tei ding ahi tai,” tin aseitai.
English: However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to the LORD’s enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is born to you will surely die.”

tcz: Hichun Nathan ainlama achijou chun. Pakaiyin Uriah jinu hin David chapa chu gotna apen ahileh naosen chu apet petin adammo pai tan ahi.
en: Then Nathan departed to his house. The LORD struck the child that Uriah’s wife bore to David, and he was very sick.
text:
2SA 12:15
Thadou: Hichun Nathan ainlama achijou chun. Pakaiyin Uriah jinu hin David chapa chu gotna apen ahileh naosen chu apet petin adammo pai tan ahi.
English: Then Nathan departed to his house. The LORD struck the child that Uriah’s wife bore to David, and he was very sick.

tcz: Hijeh chun David jong naosen adamna din Pakai henga atao tao tan ahi; David chun an angolin apotdoh in, jan khovah hel chun tollhanga alumin ahi.
en: David therefore begged God for the child; and David fasted, and went in and lay all night on the ground.
text:
2SA 12:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun David jong naosen adamna din Pakai henga atao tao tan ahi; David chun an angolin apotdoh in, jan khovah hel chun tollhanga alumin ahi.
English: David therefore begged God for the child; and David fasted, and went in and lay all night on the ground.

tcz: Chuphat’in ainsung mi upa chengsen ajol jol jenguvin chule tollhanga alupnaa kona tho doh sah tei din agouve; ahinla David chu akithou doh deh pon, chule an jong aneh pi deh pouve.
en: The elders of his house arose beside him, to raise him up from the earth; but he would not, and he didn’t eat bread with them.
text:
2SA 12:17
Thadou: Chuphat’in ainsung mi upa chengsen ajol jol jenguvin chule tollhanga alupnaa kona tho doh sah tei din agouve; ahinla David chu akithou doh deh pon, chule an jong aneh pi deh pouve.
English: The elders of his house arose beside him, to raise him up from the earth; but he would not, and he didn’t eat bread with them.

tcz: Ahivangin nisagi lhin nin naosen chu athi tan ahi. Hichun naosen chu athitai’ tia David koma sei peh ding asohte chu akicha tauve; ajeh chu amaho geldola, vetan, naosen ahinlaiya bon eiho thusei angai louva ahileh, tua naosen athitai, tia iti iseidoh ngam diu ham? Amale ama kithalo mai ding ahi,” tia angaitou ahiye.
en: On the seventh day, the child died. David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, “Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spoke to him and he didn’t listen to our voice. How will he then harm himself if we tell him that the child is dead?”
text:
2SA 12:18
Thadou: Ahivangin nisagi lhin nin naosen chu athi tan ahi. Hichun naosen chu athitai’ tia David koma sei peh ding asohte chu akicha tauve; ajeh chu amaho geldola, vetan, naosen ahinlaiya bon eiho thusei angai louva ahileh, tua naosen athitai, tia iti iseidoh ngam diu ham? Amale ama kithalo mai ding ahi,” tia angaitou ahiye.
English: On the seventh day, the child died. David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, “Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spoke to him and he didn’t listen to our voice. How will he then harm himself if we tell him that the child is dead?”

tcz: Ahin David chun asohte chu akhoisa cheh tauve ti ahetdoh phat’in naosen chu athi ahitai tin David’in ahedoh pai paitan ahi; hijeh chun David chun asohte chu adong in, “Naosen chu athia hitam?” atileh amahon jong, “Athitai,’ atiuve.
en: But when David saw that his servants were whispering together, David perceived that the child was dead; and David said to his servants, “Is the child dead?” They said, “He is dead.”
text:
2SA 12:19
Thadou: Ahin David chun asohte chu akhoisa cheh tauve ti ahetdoh phat’in naosen chu athi ahitai tin David’in ahedoh pai paitan ahi; hijeh chun David chun asohte chu adong in, “Naosen chu athia hitam?” atileh amahon jong, “Athitai,’ atiuve.
English: But when David saw that his servants were whispering together, David perceived that the child was dead; and David said to his servants, “Is the child dead?” They said, “He is dead.”

tcz: Chuphat’in David jong tol'a alupna a konin ahung thou dohin akisil ngim in, thao akinun, aponsil akhel’in, Pakai houin sunga avah lut’in chibai agaboh-e; chujouvin David chu ama inlama ahung in an athum in amahon jong ankong aluipeh-uva ahileh, an anetan ahi.
en: Then David arose from the earth, and washed and anointed himself, and changed his clothing; and he came into the LORD’s house, and worshiped. Then he came to his own house; and when he requested, they set bread before him and he ate.
text:
2SA 12:20
Thadou: Chuphat’in David jong tol'a alupna a konin ahung thou dohin akisil ngim in, thao akinun, aponsil akhel’in, Pakai houin sunga avah lut’in chibai agaboh-e; chujouvin David chu ama inlama ahung in an athum in amahon jong ankong aluipeh-uva ahileh, an anetan ahi.
English: Then David arose from the earth, and washed and anointed himself, and changed his clothing; and he came into the LORD’s house, and worshiped. Then he came to his own house; and when he requested, they set bread before him and he ate.

tcz: Hichun asohten ajah a aseiyuve, “Ipibola hitia hi naum ham? naosen ahai hai pet in an nangol in nakap kap jengin, naosen athi tah bah phat in nathou doh in an nane jenge,’ atiuve.
en: Then his servants said to him, “What is this that you have done? You fasted and wept for the child while he was alive, but when the child was dead, you rose up and ate bread.”
