text:
2SA 12:21
Thadou: Hichun asohten ajah a aseiyuve, “Ipibola hitia hi naum ham? naosen ahai hai pet in an nangol in nakap kap jengin, naosen athi tah bah phat in nathou doh in an nane jenge,’ atiuve.
English: Then his servants said to him, “What is this that you have done? You fasted and wept for the child while he was alive, but when the child was dead, you rose up and ate bread.”

tcz: Hichun David in jong hitin adonbut’e, “Naosen ahinpet a chu an kangola kaka ka ahin, “Kon ija ahet thei ham, ajo le Pakaiyin eilungset a naosen hi ahin hin sah thei ahi?” tia keiman kagel jeh ahi.
en: He said, “While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept; for I said, ‘Who knows whether the LORD will not be gracious to me, that the child may live?’
text:
2SA 12:22
Thadou: Hichun David in jong hitin adonbut’e, “Naosen ahinpet a chu an kangola kaka ka ahin, “Kon ija ahet thei ham, ajo le Pakaiyin eilungset a naosen hi ahin hin sah thei ahi?” tia keiman kagel jeh ahi.
English: He said, “While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept; for I said, ‘Who knows whether the LORD will not be gracious to me, that the child may live?’

tcz: Ahin tun vang ama athia ahitan ibola an kangol ngol nah lai ding ham? ken ama chu kahinsah theiya nabol’uham? keibou ama koma nikhat le kache ding ahin, ama chu kahenga hung kile kit louhel ding ahitai,” ati.
en: But now he is dead. Why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”
text:
2SA 12:23
Thadou: Ahin tun vang ama athia ahitan ibola an kangol ngol nah lai ding ham? ken ama chu kahinsah theiya nabol’uham? keibou ama koma nikhat le kache ding ahin, ama chu kahenga hung kile kit louhel ding ahitai,” ati.
English: But now he is dead. Why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”

tcz: Hichun David’in ajinu Bathsheba alhem lung mongin akoma aga lut kit’in aluppin ahileh amanun nao ahinvop in chapa khat ahing kit’e; Chule David in amin Solomon asah in ahi. Pakaiyin amahi angailui.
en: David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in to her, and lay with her. She bore a son, and he called his name Solomon. The LORD loved him;

tcz: Hijeh chun Nathan themgaopa henga ahin hetsah in ahileh Nathanin Pakai thusei dungjuiyin ama chu amin Jedidiah tinjong aminvo kit’e, (hichu Pakaiyin angailut tina ahi).
en: and he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he named him Jedidiah, for the LORD’s sake.
text:
2SA 12:25
Thadou: Hijeh chun Nathan themgaopa henga ahin hetsah in ahileh Nathanin Pakai thusei dungjuiyin ama chu amin Jedidiah tinjong aminvo kit’e, (hichu Pakaiyin angailut tina ahi).
English: and he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he named him Jedidiah, for the LORD’s sake.

tcz: Chuin Joab chun Ammon mite khopi lanlung Rabbah chu adel khumin gal’in akisat pin ahileh ajouvin leng khopi chu alatan ahi.
en: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.
text:
2SA 12:26
Thadou: Chuin Joab chun Ammon mite khopi lanlung Rabbah chu adel khumin gal’in akisat pin ahileh ajouvin leng khopi chu alatan ahi.
English: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

tcz: Chuin Joab chun David koma sottolle miho asol’in agasei sah tai, “Keiman Rabbah kaga kisat pin, twiphai khopi chu kajoutai tin.
en: Joab sent messengers to David, and said, “I have fought against Rabbah. Yes, I have taken the city of waters.
text:
2SA 12:27
Thadou: Chuin Joab chun David koma sottolle miho asol’in agasei sah tai, “Keiman Rabbah kaga kisat pin, twiphai khopi chu kajoutai tin.
English: Joab sent messengers to David, and said, “I have fought against Rabbah. Yes, I have taken the city of waters.

tcz: Hijeh chun tun mipi amoh cheng khom tup’in lang khopi dounan ngahmun hung sem tan, chule akhopi jong hung toupha jengin, achuti louva ahileh keiman akhopi hi kalah a keima min kaputsah ding ahi tai,” ati.
en: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city and take it; lest I take the city, and it be called by my name.”
text:
2SA 12:28
Thadou: Hijeh chun tun mipi amoh cheng khom tup’in lang khopi dounan ngahmun hung sem tan, chule akhopi jong hung toupha jengin, achuti louva ahileh keiman akhopi hi kalah a keima min kaputsah ding ahi tai,” ati.
English: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city and take it; lest I take the city, and it be called by my name.”

tcz: Hijeh chun David in mipi abonchan akhom soh keiyin Rabbah khopi lama achen, chule akhopi dou nan gal abol’in akisat pin ahileh ajouvin akhopi chu alatan ahi.
en: David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, and fought against it and took it.
text:
2SA 12:29
Thadou: Hijeh chun David in mipi abonchan akhom soh keiyin Rabbah khopi lama achen, chule akhopi dou nan gal abol’in akisat pin ahileh ajouvin akhopi chu alatan ahi.
English: David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, and fought against it and took it.

tcz: Chule alengpau lallukhuh chu David in aluchanga konin alahdoh peh in chule amalu changah akikoi tan ahi. alallukhuh chu sana le songman tam a kisem chule agih dan chu pound somsagi le nga ahi. chujongle asunga chun song mantam tah akikoiyin. Chujongleh David chun Rabbah khopia thil thang tamtah ahin chom doh in ahi.
en: He took the crown of their king from off his head; and its weight was a talent of gold, and in it were precious stones; and it was set on David’s head. He brought a great quantity of plunder out of the city.
text:
2SA 12:30
Thadou: Chule alengpau lallukhuh chu David in aluchanga konin alahdoh peh in chule amalu changah akikoi tan ahi. alallukhuh chu sana le songman tam a kisem chule agih dan chu pound somsagi le nga ahi. chujongle asunga chun song mantam tah akikoiyin. Chujongleh David chun Rabbah khopia thil thang tamtah ahin chom doh in ahi.
English: He took the crown of their king from off his head; and its weight was a talent of gold, and in it were precious stones; and it was set on David’s head. He brought a great quantity of plunder out of the city.

tcz: Chujongle akhopi sunga cheng mipi jouse chu gal hing-in akaiyin, chule thing-at dingle tuphul kheng dingle, heicha kheng dingin agoiyin, chule cheh dengin apansah tai. Hitichun David chun hitobanga hi Ammon mite khopi jouse anabol ahi; chujouvin David le mipi chu abonchauvin Jerusalema ahung kile kit tauvin ahi.
en: He brought out the people who were in it, and put them to work under saws, under iron picks, under axes of iron, and made them go to the brick kiln; and he did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
text:
2SA 12:31
Thadou: Chujongle akhopi sunga cheng mipi jouse chu gal hing-in akaiyin, chule thing-at dingle tuphul kheng dingle, heicha kheng dingin agoiyin, chule cheh dengin apansah tai. Hitichun David chun hitobanga hi Ammon mite khopi jouse anabol ahi; chujouvin David le mipi chu abonchauvin Jerusalema ahung kile kit tauvin ahi.
English: He brought out the people who were in it, and put them to work under saws, under iron picks, under axes of iron, and made them go to the brick kiln; and he did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

tcz: Chuin David chapa Absalom chun sopi numei hoi tah khat aneiyin, amin chu Tamar akiti; hiti chun phat chomkhat jouvin David chapa Ammonin Tamar chu ahin deicha lheh tan ahi.
en: After this, Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.
text:
2SA 13:1
Thadou: Chuin David chapa Absalom chun sopi numei hoi tah khat aneiyin, amin chu Tamar akiti; hiti chun phat chomkhat jouvin David chapa Ammonin Tamar chu ahin deicha lheh tan ahi.
English: After this, Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

tcz: Amnon chun Tamar chu adeicha lheh jeng tan ahileh hinkho man ding dan jong ahethei tapon, hichun achainan Tamar adeichat behset jeh in adam mo lotan ahi; Ijeh inem itileh Tamar chu nungah thengsel ahina laiyin, chule Amnon in amanu chu kachan joulou ding hitam tin alungin agel tan ahi.
en: Amnon was so troubled that he became sick because of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything to her.
text:
2SA 13:2
Thadou: Amnon chun Tamar chu adeicha lheh jeng tan ahileh hinkho man ding dan jong ahethei tapon, hichun achainan Tamar adeichat behset jeh in adam mo lotan ahi; Ijeh inem itileh Tamar chu nungah thengsel ahina laiyin, chule Amnon in amanu chu kachan joulou ding hitam tin alungin agel tan ahi.
English: Amnon was so troubled that he became sick because of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything to her.

tcz: Ahivangin Amnon hin kilopi loi lungthim suhto je themtah khat anei in, amin jong Jonadab akiti; amapa hi David loipa Shimea chapa ahi.
en: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother; and Jonadab was a very subtle man.
text:
2SA 13:3
Thadou: Ahivangin Amnon hin kilopi loi lungthim suhto je themtah khat anei in, amin jong Jonadab akiti; amapa hi David loipa Shimea chapa ahi.
English: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother; and Jonadab was a very subtle man.

tcz: Nikhat Jonadab in Amnon koma aseiyin, “Ipi bola lengpa chapa jingkah seh le mi-ngol ho um banga umjing nahim? Ipi ham nabuina?” atileh; Amnon in jong asei peh tai, “Keiman kasopi pa Absalom naonu Tamar khu kadei chat jeh ahi,” tin aphong doh tan ahi.
en: He said to him, “Why, son of the king, are you so sad from day to day? Won’t you tell me?” Amnon said to him, “I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.”
text:
2SA 13:4
Thadou: Nikhat Jonadab in Amnon koma aseiyin, “Ipi bola lengpa chapa jingkah seh le mi-ngol ho um banga umjing nahim? Ipi ham nabuina?” atileh; Amnon in jong asei peh tai, “Keiman kasopi pa Absalom naonu Tamar khu kadei chat jeh ahi,” tin aphong doh tan ahi.
English: He said to him, “Why, son of the king, are you so sad from day to day? Won’t you tell me?” Amnon said to him, “I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.”

tcz: Chuphat’in Jonadab chun aphai, “keiman epi nabol ding naseipih nange ati. Nungchin lang Nalupna a khun lumin lang kinat lhem sah in. Napa chu nangma ve dinga ahung tengleh napa koma hitin seiyin, Tamar chu ahunga nangma dia an neh themkhat nahung bolpih din thum'in. chule aman namitmu a akhut tah a nahung vah'a ahileh nangma naol chom din jong seipih tan ati.”
en: Jonadab said to him, “Lay down on your bed and pretend to be sick. When your father comes to see you, tell him, ‘Please let my sister Tamar come and give me bread to eat, and prepare the food in my sight, that I may see it and eat it from her hand.’”
text:
2SA 13:5
Thadou: Chuphat’in Jonadab chun aphai, “keiman epi nabol ding naseipih nange ati. Nungchin lang Nalupna a khun lumin lang kinat lhem sah in. Napa chu nangma ve dinga ahung tengleh napa koma hitin seiyin, Tamar chu ahunga nangma dia an neh themkhat nahung bolpih din thum'in. chule aman namitmu a akhut tah a nahung vah'a ahileh nangma naol chom din jong seipih tan ati.”
English: Jonadab said to him, “Lay down on your bed and pretend to be sick. When your father comes to see you, tell him, ‘Please let my sister Tamar come and give me bread to eat, and prepare the food in my sight, that I may see it and eat it from her hand.’”

tcz: Hichun Amnon in jong asei bang bang chun alup nah a alumin akinat lhem sah tai. chuin lengpa chu ave din ahungtan ahileh Amnon chun lengpa koma chun asei tai,” Lungset tah in kanaonu Tamar chu neihin solpeh inlang keima mitmun kadutah khat nehding eihung sempih hen, chutile ken ama khutsoh mong mong chu nenge,” ati tai.
en: So Amnon lay down and faked being sick. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, “Please let my sister Tamar come and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat from her hand.”
text:
2SA 13:6
Thadou: Hichun Amnon in jong asei bang bang chun alup nah a alumin akinat lhem sah tai. chuin lengpa chu ave din ahungtan ahileh Amnon chun lengpa koma chun asei tai,” Lungset tah in kanaonu Tamar chu neihin solpeh inlang keima mitmun kadutah khat nehding eihung sempih hen, chutile ken ama khutsoh mong mong chu nenge,” ati tai.
English: So Amnon lay down and faked being sick. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, “Please let my sister Tamar come and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat from her hand.”

tcz: Hijeh chun David jong anom in Tamar chu Amnon’s in a agachi a anneh ding them khat agasem peh din asol tan ahi.
en: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, “Go now to your brother Amnon’s house, and prepare food for him.”
text:
2SA 13:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun David jong anom in Tamar chu Amnon’s in a agachi a anneh ding them khat agasem peh din asol tan ahi.
English: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, “Go now to your brother Amnon’s house, and prepare food for him.”

tcz: Chuphat’in Tamar jong Amnon in'a achen alhun phat in, alupna lang a ache lut tai. Hichun changboi goina alan changbong agoiyin, Amnon mitmu tah in changlhah chu asem’in akan peh tai.
en: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was lying down. She took dough, kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.
text:
2SA 13:8
Thadou: Chuphat’in Tamar jong Amnon in'a achen alhun phat in, alupna lang a ache lut tai. Hichun changboi goina alan changbong agoiyin, Amnon mitmu tah in changlhah chu asem’in akan peh tai.
English: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was lying down. She took dough, kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.

tcz: Ahin amanun akhangbel sunga a changlhah kansa chu Amnon ang sunga agathah lutpeh vang'in amapan ane deh tapon ahi. Hichun Amnon’in asohte kommah aseiyin, “Kakoma konin nabon un potdoh'un,” ati. Hijeh chun abonchao vin ama koma konin apotdoh soh kei tau’ve.
en: She took the pan and poured them out before him, but he refused to eat. Amnon said, “Have all men leave me.” Then every man went out from him.
text:
2SA 13:9
Thadou: Ahin amanun akhangbel sunga a changlhah kansa chu Amnon ang sunga agathah lutpeh vang'in amapan ane deh tapon ahi. Hichun Amnon’in asohte kommah aseiyin, “Kakoma konin nabon un potdoh'un,” ati. Hijeh chun abonchao vin ama koma konin apotdoh soh kei tau’ve.
English: She took the pan and poured them out before him, but he refused to eat. Amnon said, “Have all men leave me.” Then every man went out from him.

tcz: Chutah chun Amnon in Tamar koma asei in, “Tun an neh ding chu kalupna langah hinchoilut inlang chule neinehsah tan ati. Hichun Tamar injong anehh ding chu achoilut pih tan ahi.
en: Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food into the room, that I may eat from your hand.” Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the room to Amnon her brother.
text:
2SA 13:10
Thadou: Chutah chun Amnon in Tamar koma asei in, “Tun an neh ding chu kalupna langah hinchoilut inlang chule neinehsah tan ati. Hichun Tamar injong anehh ding chu achoilut pih tan ahi.
English: Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food into the room, that I may eat from your hand.” Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the room to Amnon her brother.

tcz: Ahin amanun anehsah jing lai chun, amapan ahintuh chah kheh in chule athumtan ahi, “Hungin neihung luppin kalungset kanaonu,” tin.
en: When she had brought them near to him to eat, he took hold of her and said to her, “Come, lie with me, my sister!”
text:
2SA 13:11
Thadou: Ahin amanun anehsah jing lai chun, amapan ahintuh chah kheh in chule athumtan ahi, “Hungin neihung luppin kalungset kanaonu,” tin.
English: When she had brought them near to him to eat, he took hold of her and said to her, “Come, lie with me, my sister!”

tcz: Chuin Tamar chu akap in “Ahipoi he-u, ngol hih in! hitabang pihi kema kom ah bolhih beh in! hitobang ngol hoitah thil hi Israel chate lah a kibol ngai lou ahi, ati.
en: She answered him, “No, my brother, do not force me! For no such thing ought to be done in Israel. Don’t you do this folly!
text:
2SA 13:12
Thadou: Chuin Tamar chu akap in “Ahipoi he-u, ngol hih in! hitabang pihi kema kom ah bolhih beh in! hitobang ngol hoitah thil hi Israel chate lah a kibol ngai lou ahi, ati.
English: She answered him, “No, my brother, do not force me! For no such thing ought to be done in Israel. Don’t you do this folly!

tcz: Chule keiman hoilam a jum kathoh ngam ding ham? chule nang jong Israel chate lah a michavai mi-ngol khat mong mong nahi ding hita chume. Hijeh a chu katao tho ahi, lengpa koma neiki thumle chun aman jong nang ding beh a chu ajah da louhel ding ahi nai,” ati.
en: As for me, where would I carry my shame? And as for you, you will be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, please speak to the king; for he will not withhold me from you.”
text:
2SA 13:13
Thadou: Chule keiman hoilam a jum kathoh ngam ding ham? chule nang jong Israel chate lah a michavai mi-ngol khat mong mong nahi ding hita chume. Hijeh a chu katao tho ahi, lengpa koma neiki thumle chun aman jong nang ding beh a chu ajah da louhel ding ahi nai,” ati.
English: As for me, where would I carry my shame? And as for you, you will be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, please speak to the king; for he will not withhold me from you.”

tcz: Ahin Amnon chun amanu thusei chu a ngaipeh tapon, amanu sanga athahat joh jeh chun pum hat’in aluppi tai.
en: However, he would not listen to her voice; but being stronger than she, he forced her and lay with her.
text:
2SA 13:14
Thadou: Ahin Amnon chun amanu thusei chu a ngaipeh tapon, amanu sanga athahat joh jeh chun pum hat’in aluppi tai.
English: However, he would not listen to her voice; but being stronger than she, he forced her and lay with her.

tcz: Chuin hetman louvin Amnon’s lungset nachu muda najoh ahungsoh tan, chule amuda dan chu masanga adei chat na sang in akhoh jo tai ahi. Hijeh chun Amnon chun akoma hitin asei tai, “Kithou doh loiyin lang pot doh loiyin,” tin asol doh loitan ahi.
en: Then Amnon hated her with exceedingly great hatred; for the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her. Amnon said to her, “Arise, be gone!”
text:
2SA 13:15
Thadou: Chuin hetman louvin Amnon’s lungset nachu muda najoh ahungsoh tan, chule amuda dan chu masanga adei chat na sang in akhoh jo tai ahi. Hijeh chun Amnon chun akoma hitin asei tai, “Kithou doh loiyin lang pot doh loiyin,” tin asol doh loitan ahi.
English: Then Amnon hated her with exceedingly great hatred; for the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her. Amnon said to her, “Arise, be gone!”

tcz: Chuin Tamar’in kap pummin aseiyin, “Ahipoi he-u, hitobang thildih louva neisol doh loi hi neibol masat na sanga khoh cheh jo ahi,” ativangin Amnonin angai peh deh tapon ahi.
en: She said to him, “Not so, because this great wrong in sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me!” But he would not listen to her.
text:
2SA 13:16
Thadou: Chuin Tamar’in kap pummin aseiyin, “Ahipoi he-u, hitobang thildih louva neisol doh loi hi neibol masat na sanga khoh cheh jo ahi,” ativangin Amnonin angai peh deh tapon ahi.
English: She said to him, “Not so, because this great wrong in sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me!” But he would not listen to her.

tcz: Chujouvin Amnon in alhacha ho akouvin thu apetan ahi, “Hiche nu hi kamasang a konin sol doh loiyun lang anunga kotpichu kamloi un” ati.
en: Then he called his servant who ministered to him, and said, “Now put this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.”
text:
2SA 13:17
Thadou: Chujouvin Amnon in alhacha ho akouvin thu apetan ahi, “Hiche nu hi kamasang a konin sol doh loiyun lang anunga kotpichu kamloi un” ati.
English: Then he called his servant who ministered to him, and said, “Now put this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.”

tcz: Hitichun Amnon lhachahon Tamar chu asoldoh loiyun anunga kotpi akamden tan ahi. Tamar chun sangkhol chol hoitah aki-ah ahi; ajeh chu chuchi laikhanga chon nadan dungjui a leng chanu nu-ngah theng hochu hitobanga chu ana kivonji mongu ahiye.
en: She had a garment of various colors on her, for the king’s daughters who were virgins dressed in such robes. Then his servant brought her out and bolted the door after her.
text:
2SA 13:18
Thadou: Hitichun Amnon lhachahon Tamar chu asoldoh loiyun anunga kotpi akamden tan ahi. Tamar chun sangkhol chol hoitah aki-ah ahi; ajeh chu chuchi laikhanga chon nadan dungjui a leng chanu nu-ngah theng hochu hitobanga chu ana kivonji mongu ahiye.
English: She had a garment of various colors on her, for the king’s daughters who were virgins dressed in such robes. Then his servant brought her out and bolted the door after her.

tcz: Ahinlah tun Tamar in asang khol chol chu abot tel’in chule alu jangah vutvam akiloi tan ahi. chuin akhut chu amai ah akoi in, o thong je jun akap’in achi mangtan ahi.
en: Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head and went her way, crying aloud as she went.
text:
2SA 13:19
Thadou: Ahinlah tun Tamar in asang khol chol chu abot tel’in chule alu jangah vutvam akiloi tan ahi. chuin akhut chu amai ah akoi in, o thong je jun akap’in achi mangtan ahi.
English: Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head and went her way, crying aloud as she went.

tcz: Hichun A-upa Absalom in ana dong in “Na sopipa Amnon chun naum khompi hiteiyin te ong? hijongle tun thipchat in umtan, ajeh chu ama jong na-upa ahi bouve. chule athilbol hi nalungthim a chinda tan,” ati. Hijeh chun Tamar jong a-upa Absalom in’a chun lung genthei tah in acheng den tan ahi.
en: Absalom her brother said to her, “Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now hold your peace, my sister. He is your brother. Don’t take this thing to heart.” So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.
text:
2SA 13:20
Thadou: Hichun A-upa Absalom in ana dong in “Na sopipa Amnon chun naum khompi hiteiyin te ong? hijongle tun thipchat in umtan, ajeh chu ama jong na-upa ahi bouve. chule athilbol hi nalungthim a chinda tan,” ati. Hijeh chun Tamar jong a-upa Absalom in’a chun lung genthei tah in acheng den tan ahi.
English: Absalom her brother said to her, “Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now hold your peace, my sister. He is your brother. Don’t take this thing to heart.” So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.

tcz: Chuin David lengpan hitobang thilsoh ho hi ajah doh phat’in alung hang lheh jeng tan ahi.
en: But when King David heard of all these things, he was very angry.
text:
2SA 13:21
Thadou: Chuin David lengpan hitobang thilsoh ho hi ajah doh phat’in alung hang lheh jeng tan ahi.
English: But when King David heard of all these things, he was very angry.

tcz: Chule Absalom in hitabong thilsoh hi Amnon koma aseidoh lou vang'in Amnon chu nasatah in avetda lheh jeng tan ahi ajeh chu anaonu chunga athilbol aumchan jeh chu ahi. Absalom’s in Amnon Chunga Phu Alah
en: Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
text:
2SA 13:22
Thadou: Chule Absalom in hitabong thilsoh hi Amnon koma aseidoh lou vang'in Amnon chu nasatah in avetda lheh jeng tan ahi ajeh chu anaonu chunga athilbol aumchan jeh chu ahi. Absalom’s in Amnon Chunga Phu Alah
English: Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

tcz: Hitichun kumni jouvin Absalom chun Ephriam kom a Baal-hazor khoa kelngoi mul avou in, Chule Absalom chun leng chapate jouse chu abonchan golvah a chun akou soh kei in ahi.
en: After two full years, Absalom had sheep shearers in Baal Hazor, which is beside Ephraim; and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.
text:
2SA 13:23
Thadou: Hitichun kumni jouvin Absalom chun Ephriam kom a Baal-hazor khoa kelngoi mul avou in, Chule Absalom chun leng chapate jouse chu abonchan golvah a chun akou soh kei in ahi.
English: After two full years, Absalom had sheep shearers in Baal Hazor, which is beside Ephraim; and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.

tcz: Hichun Absalom jong lengpa henga achin hitin agaseiye, “ka kelngomul vou hon tunna atong un, hijeh chun lengpa le asoh te jouse jong lungset tah a nahung uva hiche nikho hi keitoh neihung man khompi diu ham? tin agasei tai.
en: Absalom came to the king and said, “See now, your servant has sheep shearers. Please let the king and his servants go with your servant.”
text:
2SA 13:24
Thadou: Hichun Absalom jong lengpa henga achin hitin agaseiye, “ka kelngomul vou hon tunna atong un, hijeh chun lengpa le asoh te jouse jong lungset tah a nahung uva hiche nikho hi keitoh neihung man khompi diu ham? tin agasei tai.
English: Absalom came to the king and said, “See now, your servant has sheep shearers. Please let the king and his servants go with your servant.”

tcz: Ahivang in lengpan Absalom adonbut’in, “Ahipoi kacha, kabon uva kahung uleh nang dinga khanlel kahi diu ahi ati. Ahinla Absalom in aha tem cheh jeng in ahi, hiche jong hin David chu ache deh poi, Absalom chu aphat thei na aboh jeng vang'in.
en: The king said to Absalom, “No, my son, let’s not all go, lest we be burdensome to you.” He pressed him; however he would not go, but blessed him.
text:
2SA 13:25
Thadou: Ahivang in lengpan Absalom adonbut’in, “Ahipoi kacha, kabon uva kahung uleh nang dinga khanlel kahi diu ahi ati. Ahinla Absalom in aha tem cheh jeng in ahi, hiche jong hin David chu ache deh poi, Absalom chu aphat thei na aboh jeng vang'in.
English: The king said to Absalom, “No, my son, let’s not all go, lest we be burdensome to you.” He pressed him; however he would not go, but blessed him.

tcz: Chuphat’in Absalomin aphai khutia nang nahung thei lou ding leh eti nagel em kanaopa Amnon hinsol ding chu? Chuin lengpan ahin donbut in,epi jeh a Amnon hungding? ati.
en: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us.” The king said to him, “Why should he go with you?”
text:
2SA 13:26
Thadou: Chuphat’in Absalomin aphai khutia nang nahung thei lou ding leh eti nagel em kanaopa Amnon hinsol ding chu? Chuin lengpan ahin donbut in,epi jeh a Amnon hungding? ati.
English: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us.” The king said to him, “Why should he go with you?”

tcz: Ahin Absalomin asei kit in Amnon le leng chapate aboncha solpeh ding lengpa anup masang in angeh ngeh jenge tan ahi. ajeh chu Absalom kigutnahi lengte jaona dia kilomtah a kingon abol ahi.
en: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.
text:
2SA 13:27
Thadou: Ahin Absalomin asei kit in Amnon le leng chapate aboncha solpeh ding lengpa anup masang in angeh ngeh jenge tan ahi. ajeh chu Absalom kigutnahi lengte jaona dia kilomtah a kingon abol ahi.
English: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.

tcz: Chujou in Absalom chun asoh teho chu thu asei peh masat in, “Amnon chu lengpi twi ahung kham ve-lhi jing jenguvin lang, keiman najah-uva, ‘Amnon chu jep’uvin tia kahin sei tengle that jeng uvin, kicha hih hel’uvin. Ajeh chu keiman thu kapeh louva nabol u ham? Hangsan tah le thanei tah in pang uvin,” tin asei peh tai.
en: Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike Amnon,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I commanded you? Be courageous, and be valiant!”
text:
2SA 13:28
Thadou: Chujou in Absalom chun asoh teho chu thu asei peh masat in, “Amnon chu lengpi twi ahung kham ve-lhi jing jenguvin lang, keiman najah-uva, ‘Amnon chu jep’uvin tia kahin sei tengle that jeng uvin, kicha hih hel’uvin. Ajeh chu keiman thu kapeh louva nabol u ham? Hangsan tah le thanei tah in pang uvin,” tin asei peh tai.
English: Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike Amnon,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I commanded you? Be courageous, and be valiant!”

tcz: Hijeh chun Absalom soh ten jong Absalom in athupeh bang bang uvin Amnon chu athat taovin ahi. Chuin lengpa chapate adangho se abonchan akipat’uvin asakol pol cheh chunga atou doh soh keiyuvin ajam gamtauve.
en: The servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man got up on his mule and fled.
text:
2SA 13:29
Thadou: Hijeh chun Absalom soh ten jong Absalom in athupeh bang bang uvin Amnon chu athat taovin ahi. Chuin lengpa chapate adangho se abonchan akipat’uvin asakol pol cheh chunga atou doh soh keiyuvin ajam gamtauve.
English: The servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man got up on his mule and fled.

tcz: Hichun amaho lamkim lah Jerusalem ahung gei uvin David henga thu ahung kithang lut masan, “Absalomin lengpa chapate jouse athat game, khat’a khat cha jong ahing hoi ta poi,” tin ahung ki sei e.
en: While they were on the way, the news came to David, saying, “Absalom has slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left!”
text:
2SA 13:30
Thadou: Hichun amaho lamkim lah Jerusalem ahung gei uvin David henga thu ahung kithang lut masan, “Absalomin lengpa chapate jouse athat game, khat’a khat cha jong ahing hoi ta poi,” tin ahung ki sei e.
English: While they were on the way, the news came to David, saying, “Absalom has slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left!”

tcz: Chutah chun lengpa jong akipat doh paiyin aponsil jouse abottel’in tollhanga akijam tai; chuin akoma ding alhacha jousen jong tijat jeh le lungkham jeh in aponsil akibotel soh kei tao vin ahi.
en: Then the king arose, and tore his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.
text:
2SA 13:31
Thadou: Chutah chun lengpa jong akipat doh paiyin aponsil jouse abottel’in tollhanga akijam tai; chuin akoma ding alhacha jousen jong tijat jeh le lungkham jeh in aponsil akibotel soh kei tao vin ahi.
English: Then the king arose, and tore his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.

tcz: Chuin David golpa Shimea chapa Jonadab chu David kom ahung in hitin asei e, “Ahipoi tahsan hih beh in, lengpa chapate ho jouse aboncha atha ahi sam poi, Amnon chang seh kithat ahibouve; ijeh-inem itileh Absalomin hichebol ding hi masanga pet Amnonin anaonu Tamar pum hat san a abolset nikho’a pat a chu gonsa anakoi ahitai.
en: Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered, “Don’t let my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men, the king’s sons, for Amnon only is dead; for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
text:
2SA 13:32
Thadou: Chuin David golpa Shimea chapa Jonadab chu David kom ahung in hitin asei e, “Ahipoi tahsan hih beh in, lengpa chapate ho jouse aboncha atha ahi sam poi, Amnon chang seh kithat ahibouve; ijeh-inem itileh Absalomin hichebol ding hi masanga pet Amnonin anaonu Tamar pum hat san a abolset nikho’a pat a chu gonsa anakoi ahitai.
English: Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered, “Don’t let my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men, the king’s sons, for Amnon only is dead; for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

tcz: Ahipoi, kapu lengpa nachapate abonchauva thigam ahi poi! Amnon sehbou thi ahi,” ati.
en: Now therefore don’t let my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead; for only Amnon is dead.”
text:
2SA 13:33
Thadou: Ahipoi, kapu lengpa nachapate abonchauva thigam ahi poi! Amnon sehbou thi ahi,” ati.
English: Now therefore don’t let my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead; for only Amnon is dead.”

tcz: Hichephat tah chun Absalom chu ajam mang tai; chuin Jerusalem a mive lhia pangpa chun akho dah in agah vet’a ahileh, vetan, Horonaim molsang pang langa chun mihem tamtah ahung kijot’uvin ahi. tin lengpa seipih din alhai tan ahi.
en: But Absalom fled. The young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, many people were coming by way of the hillside behind him.
text:
2SA 13:34
Thadou: Hichephat tah chun Absalom chu ajam mang tai; chuin Jerusalem a mive lhia pangpa chun akho dah in agah vet’a ahileh, vetan, Horonaim molsang pang langa chun mihem tamtah ahung kijot’uvin ahi. tin lengpa seipih din alhai tan ahi.
English: But Absalom fled. The young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, many people were coming by way of the hillside behind him.

tcz: Hichun Jonadab chun lengpa jaah ven! Tun leng chapate khu ahung tauve; nalhachapa keiman kasei peh bang in ahung taove,” ati peh e.
en: Jonadab said to the king, “Behold, the king’s sons are coming! It is as your servant said.”
text:
2SA 13:35
Thadou: Hichun Jonadab chun lengpa jaah ven! Tun leng chapate khu ahung tauve; nalhachapa keiman kasei peh bang in ahung taove,” ati peh e.
English: Jonadab said to the king, “Behold, the king’s sons are coming! It is as your servant said.”

tcz: Chule Jonadab chun thu asei jou jouvin, vetan, lengpa chapate chu ahung lhung pai tauvin, chuin apeng jah’uvin akap cheh tauvin ahileh, lengpa le alhacha ho jong abonchauvin lhase tah-in akap soh kei uve.
en: As soon as he had finished speaking, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voices and wept. The king also and all his servants wept bitterly.
text:
2SA 13:36
Thadou: Chule Jonadab chun thu asei jou jouvin, vetan, lengpa chapate chu ahung lhung pai tauvin, chuin apeng jah’uvin akap cheh tauvin ahileh, lengpa le alhacha ho jong abonchauvin lhase tah-in akap soh kei uve.
English: As soon as he had finished speaking, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voices and wept. The king also and all his servants wept bitterly.

tcz: Chuin David in nisotpi achapa Amnon pul adouvin ahi. Absalom vang chu apupa Geshur lengpa Ammihud chapa Talmai koma ajam tan ahi.
en: But Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.
text:
2SA 13:37
Thadou: Chuin David in nisotpi achapa Amnon pul adouvin ahi. Absalom vang chu apupa Geshur lengpa Ammihud chapa Talmai koma ajam tan ahi.
English: But Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.

tcz: Hitichun Absalom Geshur gamah kumthum sungin aga um tan ahi.
en: So Absalom fled and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
text:
2SA 13:38
Thadou: Hitichun Absalom Geshur gamah kumthum sungin aga um tan ahi.
English: So Absalom fled and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

tcz: Chule tun leng David injong Amnon thi chung changa kicham na nei a, achapa Absalom toh kithah gopkhom kit ding chu angaicha lheh tan ahi.
en: King David longed to go out to Absalom, for he was comforted concerning Amnon, since he was dead.
text:
2SA 13:39
Thadou: Chule tun leng David injong Amnon thi chung changa kicham na nei a, achapa Absalom toh kithah gopkhom kit ding chu angaicha lheh tan ahi.
English: King David longed to go out to Absalom, for he was comforted concerning Amnon, since he was dead.

tcz: Chuin lengpan Absalom hi angai cha lheh jeng taiti Zeruiah chapa Joab hin ahin hetdoh tan ahi.
en: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.
text:
2SA 14:1
Thadou: Chuin lengpan Absalom hi angai cha lheh jeng taiti Zeruiah chapa Joab hin ahin hetdoh tan ahi.
English: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.

tcz: Joab hin mi asolin Tekoa khosunga mi numei chingtah khat aga hol doh sah in, amanu koma chun asei tai, “Nangma tun lunghem a pul dou dou jeng tobang'in kisem in, pul douna ponsil kisil’in lang, thao jeng jong kinu dan, ajeh chu phat sottah sunga thi op’a um numei pul dou dou jeng bangin um'in ati.
en: Joab sent to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on mourning clothing, please, and don’t anoint yourself with oil; but be as a woman who has mourned a long time for the dead.
text:
2SA 14:2
Thadou: Joab hin mi asolin Tekoa khosunga mi numei chingtah khat aga hol doh sah in, amanu koma chun asei tai, “Nangma tun lunghem a pul dou dou jeng tobang'in kisem in, pul douna ponsil kisil’in lang, thao jeng jong kinu dan, ajeh chu phat sottah sunga thi op’a um numei pul dou dou jeng bangin um'in ati.
English: Joab sent to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on mourning clothing, please, and don’t anoint yourself with oil; but be as a woman who has mourned a long time for the dead.

tcz: Chutengle lengpa koma ga chelut’inlang, ajah a hitin ga sei in, “ati, Joab chun asei ding thu jouse abonchan amanu chu athu mop tai.
en: Go in to the king and speak like this to him.” So Joab put the words in her mouth.
text:
2SA 14:3
Thadou: Chutengle lengpa koma ga chelut’inlang, ajah a hitin ga sei in, “ati, Joab chun asei ding thu jouse abonchan amanu chu athu mop tai.
English: Go in to the king and speak like this to him.” So Joab put the words in her mouth.

tcz: Tekoa khosunga numeinu chu lengpa koma ahung phat’in abohkhup in tol'a amai asulut in jana ape tai, chule aman aseiyin, “Vo lengpa, nei pan pin,” ati.
en: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”
text:
2SA 14:4
Thadou: Tekoa khosunga numeinu chu lengpa koma ahung phat’in abohkhup in tol'a amai asulut in jana ape tai, chule aman aseiyin, “Vo lengpa, nei pan pin,” ati.
English: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”

tcz: Hichun lengpan jong adong in, “Na gentheina ipi pen ham?” atileh, amanun adonbut’in, O kaden, keima meithainu kahi, kaji pa athia ahitai ati.
en: The king said to her, “What ails you?” She answered, “Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.
text:
2SA 14:5
Thadou: Hichun lengpan jong adong in, “Na gentheina ipi pen ham?” atileh, amanun adonbut’in, O kaden, keima meithainu kahi, kaji pa athia ahitai ati.
English: The king said to her, “What ails you?” She answered, “Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.

tcz: Chule nasoh nu kei hin chapa ni kaneiyin, amani chu lou jaova ahung kibao lhonin akina lhone; hichun amani phel khen ding mihem khat cha anaum lou jeh in khatpan khatjoh pachu ajep’in athat pai tai.
en: Your servant had two sons; and they both fought together in the field, and there was no one to part them, but the one struck the other and killed him.
text:
2SA 14:6
Thadou: Chule nasoh nu kei hin chapa ni kaneiyin, amani chu lou jaova ahung kibao lhonin akina lhone; hichun amani phel khen ding mihem khat cha anaum lou jeh in khatpan khatjoh pachu ajep’in athat pai tai.
English: Your servant had two sons; and they both fought together in the field, and there was no one to part them, but the one struck the other and killed him.

tcz: Hijeh chun tun vetan, insung pumpi ahung kon uvin nasoh nu hi eidel khum’uvin hitin asei uve, Asopipa that pachu hinlha doh loiyin, aman asopi pa athat in ahinkho khel a keihon ama katha diu ahi,’ tin aseiyuve; hitobang hin amahon ama chilhah jong asuh bei teidiu dol ahitai. Hitia hi amahon keima mei-am jeng jong achen mit uva hiche leiset chunga kaji pa min asuh mang diu, achi khai ding jong aumsah lou diu ahitai,” ati.
en: Behold, the whole family has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he killed, and so destroy the heir also.’ Thus they would quench my coal which is left, and would leave to my husband neither name nor remainder on the surface of the earth.”
text:
2SA 14:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun tun vetan, insung pumpi ahung kon uvin nasoh nu hi eidel khum’uvin hitin asei uve, Asopipa that pachu hinlha doh loiyin, aman asopi pa athat in ahinkho khel a keihon ama katha diu ahi,’ tin aseiyuve; hitobang hin amahon ama chilhah jong asuh bei teidiu dol ahitai. Hitia hi amahon keima mei-am jeng jong achen mit uva hiche leiset chunga kaji pa min asuh mang diu, achi khai ding jong aumsah lou diu ahitai,” ati.
English: Behold, the whole family has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he killed, and so destroy the heir also.’ Thus they would quench my coal which is left, and would leave to my husband neither name nor remainder on the surface of the earth.”

tcz: Chuphat’in lengpan jong numei nu koma chun hitin aseiye, “keima boldin dalhan lang, Na’in lama chen, keiman anavesui tange koiman atohkhah lou nadin,’ tin asol tai.
en: The king said to the woman, “Go to your house, and I will give a command concerning you.”
text:
2SA 14:8
Thadou: Chuphat’in lengpan jong numei nu koma chun hitin aseiye, “keima boldin dalhan lang, Na’in lama chen, keiman anavesui tange koiman atohkhah lou nadin,’ tin asol tai.
English: The king said to the woman, “Go to your house, and I will give a command concerning you.”

tcz: Chuin Tekoa khoa hung kon numeinu chun lengpa koma chun hitin asei kit’e, kakipah e, kapu lengpa chule “Kapu lengpa chu keima eikithopi jeh a nahin seiset khah uleh themmona chu keima le ka inkote chunga chujo hen, lengpa le alaltou na vang themmona beiyin umjo hen,’ tin aseiye.
en: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord, O king, may the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house; and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”
text:
2SA 14:9
Thadou: Chuin Tekoa khoa hung kon numeinu chun lengpa koma chun hitin asei kit’e, kakipah e, kapu lengpa chule “Kapu lengpa chu keima eikithopi jeh a nahin seiset khah uleh themmona chu keima le ka inkote chunga chujo hen, lengpa le alaltou na vang themmona beiyin umjo hen,’ tin aseiye.
English: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord, O king, may the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house; and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”

tcz: Chuin lengpan asei kit in, “Mihem khat touvin nakoma thu asei kit’a ahileh ama chu kei koma hin pui jeng in, ama chun nang ma natham khah kit louhel ding ahi,’ ati peh e.
en: The king said, “Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you any more.”
text:
2SA 14:10
Thadou: Chuin lengpan asei kit in, “Mihem khat touvin nakoma thu asei kit’a ahileh ama chu kei koma hin pui jeng in, ama chun nang ma natham khah kit louhel ding ahi,’ ati peh e.
English: The king said, “Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you any more.”

tcz: Hichun amanun jong asei kit in, “Lungset tah in Pakai na Pathen henga nei taopeh teitei in, chutia chu thisan phu lanom pan mi atha kit louva, kachapa atha louna din,’ atileh; lengpan jong aseipeh-in, “Pakai hing jing mina kasei ahi, nachapa chu asamjang khat jeng cha jong kisubui lou ding ahi,’ ati tai.
en: Then she said, “Please let the king remember the LORD your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they destroy my son.” He said, “As the LORD lives, not one hair of your son shall fall to the earth.”
text:
2SA 14:11
Thadou: Hichun amanun jong asei kit in, “Lungset tah in Pakai na Pathen henga nei taopeh teitei in, chutia chu thisan phu lanom pan mi atha kit louva, kachapa atha louna din,’ atileh; lengpan jong aseipeh-in, “Pakai hing jing mina kasei ahi, nachapa chu asamjang khat jeng cha jong kisubui lou ding ahi,’ ati tai.
English: Then she said, “Please let the king remember the LORD your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they destroy my son.” He said, “As the LORD lives, not one hair of your son shall fall to the earth.”

tcz: Hichun numei nun asei kit’in, “Lungset tah-in nasohnu kei hi kapu lengpa koma thu cheng khat beh neisei sah thei kit ding ham,’ atia ahileh; lengpan jong, “Seiyin seiyin,” ati.
en: Then the woman said, “Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.” He said, “Say on.”
text:
2SA 14:12
Thadou: Hichun numei nun asei kit’in, “Lungset tah-in nasohnu kei hi kapu lengpa koma thu cheng khat beh neisei sah thei kit ding ham,’ atia ahileh; lengpan jong, “Seiyin seiyin,” ati.
English: Then the woman said, “Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.” He said, “Say on.”

tcz: Hichun numei nun asei in, “Chuti ahileh ipi dinga nangman Pathen mite douna a hitobang thilgon hi nanei ham? Ijeh-inem itileh lengpan hitobanga thutanna naneiya kon hin lengpan nadel mangpa inlama napuilut loujeh-in nathu tan hi nangma chungma ma a nakitan ahi tai ati.
en: The woman said, “Why then have you devised such a thing against the people of God? For in speaking this word the king is as one who is guilty, in that the king does not bring home again his banished one.
text:
2SA 14:13
Thadou: Hichun numei nun asei in, “Chuti ahileh ipi dinga nangman Pathen mite douna a hitobang thilgon hi nanei ham? Ijeh-inem itileh lengpan hitobanga thutanna naneiya kon hin lengpan nadel mangpa inlama napuilut loujeh-in nathu tan hi nangma chungma ma a nakitan ahi tai ati.
English: The woman said, “Why then have you devised such a thing against the people of God? For in speaking this word the king is as one who is guilty, in that the king does not bring home again his banished one.

tcz: Ajeh chu eiho Ibon chauva athi cheh ding Ihiu’ve, chule Ibon chauva tol'a twi kisung lha kinung thaldoh kit thei lou tobang ihiuvin ahi, Pathen in jong mithi long damsa chu phong doh kit deh tapon te; chule lengpa chun ama toh ekikhan teng ule ama toh ihung eumkhom theikit nadiu aneiyin ahi.
en: For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can’t be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.
text:
2SA 14:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu eiho Ibon chauva athi cheh ding Ihiu’ve, chule Ibon chauva tol'a twi kisung lha kinung thaldoh kit thei lou tobang ihiuvin ahi, Pathen in jong mithi long damsa chu phong doh kit deh tapon te; chule lengpa chun ama toh ekikhan teng ule ama toh ihung eumkhom theikit nadiu aneiyin ahi.
English: For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can’t be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.

tcz: Chule keima hiche thuseiya hi kapu lengpa heng hung kahi, ipijeh-inem itileh mipi hin keima eitijat sah tauvin chuphat’a nasohnu ken jong hitia hi kagela, ‘Keiman lengpa koma gasei tange, ijem itileh lengpan asohnu kei thuseihi ngai jeng khat nan’te
en: Now therefore, seeing that I have come to speak this word to my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid. Your servant said, ‘I will now speak to the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant.’
text:
2SA 14:15
Thadou: Chule keima hiche thuseiya hi kapu lengpa heng hung kahi, ipijeh-inem itileh mipi hin keima eitijat sah tauvin chuphat’a nasohnu ken jong hitia hi kagela, ‘Keiman lengpa koma gasei tange, ijem itileh lengpan asohnu kei thuseihi ngai jeng khat nan’te
English: Now therefore, seeing that I have come to speak this word to my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid. Your servant said, ‘I will now speak to the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant.’

tcz: Chule lengpan jong eisumang ding miho khut’a eihuh doh tei ding ahi, Pathen mite lah a ei suhmang sah lou ding ahi.’
en: For the king will hear, to deliver his servant out of the hand of the man who would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.
text:
2SA 14:16
Thadou: Chule lengpan jong eisumang ding miho khut’a eihuh doh tei ding ahi, Pathen mite lah a ei suhmang sah lou ding ahi.’
English: For the king will hear, to deliver his servant out of the hand of the man who would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.

tcz: Henge, kapu lengpan lungthim chamna eihin pih kit diu ahi. chule keiman kahen nangma hi thilpha thilse hekhen dola Pathen vantil tabang nahi. Pakai na-Pathenin napanpi jing hen,” ati.
en: Then your servant said, ‘Please let the word of my lord the king bring rest; for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad. May the LORD, your God, be with you.’”
text:
2SA 14:17
Thadou: Henge, kapu lengpan lungthim chamna eihin pih kit diu ahi. chule keiman kahen nangma hi thilpha thilse hekhen dola Pathen vantil tabang nahi. Pakai na-Pathenin napanpi jing hen,” ati.
English: Then your servant said, ‘Please let the word of my lord the king bring rest; for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad. May the LORD, your God, be with you.’”

tcz: Hichun lengpan jong numeinu chu adonbut’in, “Keiman kadoh doh chu ipi hijong le imlou hellin neihin seipi in ati. Hichun numeinun jong aseiyin, “Kapu lengpan na seinom nom sei jengin,’ atitai.
en: Then the king answered the woman, “Please don’t hide anything from me that I ask you.” The woman said, “Let my lord the king now speak.”
text:
2SA 14:18
Thadou: Hichun lengpan jong numeinu chu adonbut’in, “Keiman kadoh doh chu ipi hijong le imlou hellin neihin seipi in ati. Hichun numeinun jong aseiyin, “Kapu lengpan na seinom nom sei jengin,’ atitai.
English: Then the king answered the woman, “Please don’t hide anything from me that I ask you.” The woman said, “Let my lord the king now speak.”

tcz: Hichun lengpan adong in, “Thil hijatpi nasei na a hi nangma Joab chutoh kihoutoh a kikhut jop nahim?” atileh; numeinu jong chun adonbut’in, “Kapu lengpa, eti kem kaseilep ding ham? Koima chan nangma kommah emacha sel thei ponte. Henge, Joab in eihinsol a chule thu hijat pi hi aman nasohnu keima hi eithumop’a ka kamsung'a eikhumpeh ahinai ati.
en: The king said, “Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?” The woman answered, “As your soul lives, my lord the king, no one can turn to the right hand or to the left from anything that my lord the king has spoken; for your servant Joab urged me, and he put all these words in the mouth of your servant.
text:
2SA 14:19
Thadou: Hichun lengpan adong in, “Thil hijatpi nasei na a hi nangma Joab chutoh kihoutoh a kikhut jop nahim?” atileh; numeinu jong chun adonbut’in, “Kapu lengpa, eti kem kaseilep ding ham? Koima chan nangma kommah emacha sel thei ponte. Henge, Joab in eihinsol a chule thu hijat pi hi aman nasohnu keima hi eithumop’a ka kamsung'a eikhumpeh ahinai ati.
English: The king said, “Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?” The woman answered, “As your soul lives, my lord the king, no one can turn to the right hand or to the left from anything that my lord the king has spoken; for your servant Joab urged me, and he put all these words in the mouth of your servant.

tcz: Nalhacha Joab chun nalung nakhel a thil kigon dol jouse nakhel doh ding gelkhoh na a hiche hi abol anahi. Ahoi chu hita leh kapu nangma hi leiset chunga um thil ijakai hetna dol a na chih dan mong mong Pathen Vantil chihna tobang bang a hi bou’ve,” atin ahi.
en: Your servant Joab has done this thing to change the face of the matter. My lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.”
text:
2SA 14:20
Thadou: Nalhacha Joab chun nalung nakhel a thil kigon dol jouse nakhel doh ding gelkhoh na a hiche hi abol anahi. Ahoi chu hita leh kapu nangma hi leiset chunga um thil ijakai hetna dol a na chih dan mong mong Pathen Vantil chihna tobang bang a hi bou’ve,” atin ahi.
English: Your servant Joab has done this thing to change the face of the matter. My lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.”

tcz: Chutah chun lengpan jong Joab koma asei in asol tan ahi, aphai tun chinlang golhangpa Absalom chu ga nung pui lut tan,” ati.
en: The king said to Joab, “Behold now, I have granted this thing. Go therefore, and bring the young man Absalom back.”
text:
2SA 14:21
Thadou: Chutah chun lengpan jong Joab koma asei in asol tan ahi, aphai tun chinlang golhangpa Absalom chu ga nung pui lut tan,” ati.
English: The king said to Joab, “Behold now, I have granted this thing. Go therefore, and bring the young man Absalom back.”

tcz: Chuin Joab jong chu tol'a abohkhup in, jana apen, lengpa phatthei aboh in, hiti hin Joab chun asei tai, “Tuni hin kapu lengpa mitmun lungset na kachang mong mong e, ti na soh pa thil ngeh khoh pen hi nanop peh jenge,’ ati.
en: Joab fell to the ground on his face, showed respect, and blessed the king. Joab said, “Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your sight, my lord, O king, in that the king has performed the request of his servant.”
text:
2SA 14:22
Thadou: Chuin Joab jong chu tol'a abohkhup in, jana apen, lengpa phatthei aboh in, hiti hin Joab chun asei tai, “Tuni hin kapu lengpa mitmun lungset na kachang mong mong e, ti na soh pa thil ngeh khoh pen hi nanop peh jenge,’ ati.
English: Joab fell to the ground on his face, showed respect, and blessed the king. Joab said, “Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your sight, my lord, O king, in that the king has performed the request of his servant.”

tcz: Chuin Joab jong akipat doh paiyin Geshur gam'a achen Absalom chu Jerusalem a ahin lepui tai.
en: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.
text:
2SA 14:23
Thadou: Chuin Joab jong akipat doh paiyin Geshur gam'a achen Absalom chu Jerusalem a ahin lepui tai.
English: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

tcz: Ahin lengpan hitin thupeh aneiye, “Absalom hi ama insunga chimei thei ahi, ahin keima angsunga vang hung vah lut thei louhel ding ahi,” ati. Hijeh chun Absalom in lengpa cu amutapon ahi.
en: The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house, and didn’t see the king’s face.
text:
2SA 14:24
Thadou: Ahin lengpan hitin thupeh aneiye, “Absalom hi ama insunga chimei thei ahi, ahin keima angsunga vang hung vah lut thei louhel ding ahi,” ati. Hijeh chun Absalom in lengpa cu amutapon ahi.
English: The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house, and didn’t see the king’s face.

tcz: Tun Israel chate lah a Absalom tobanga amel hoi jeh a seiphat thei dang koima cha anaum poi; Absalom hi akeng khotal juma pat alujang gei a achunga nolna ding imacha beihel ahi.
en: Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect in him.
text:
2SA 14:25
Thadou: Tun Israel chate lah a Absalom tobanga amel hoi jeh a seiphat thei dang koima cha anaum poi; Absalom hi akeng khotal juma pat alujang gei a achunga nolna ding imacha beihel ahi.
English: Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect in him.

tcz: Alujang sam chu kumkhat a khatvei bou ache ji ahi chule ajeh chu agih behseh jijeh ahi. hitia hi asam akivoa thil te naa atea ahileh, asam jeng jong chu shekel ja ni cheng agih jin ahi.
en: When he cut the hair of his head (now it was at every year’s end that he cut it; because it was heavy on him, therefore he cut it), he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels, after the king’s weight.
text:
2SA 14:26
Thadou: Alujang sam chu kumkhat a khatvei bou ache ji ahi chule ajeh chu agih behseh jijeh ahi. hitia hi asam akivoa thil te naa atea ahileh, asam jeng jong chu shekel ja ni cheng agih jin ahi.
English: When he cut the hair of his head (now it was at every year’s end that he cut it; because it was heavy on him, therefore he cut it), he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels, after the king’s weight.

tcz: Absalom hin chapa thum ahing in, chule chanu khat jong ahing in, achanu min chu Tamar akiti; Tamar jong hi numei hoi tah khatma ahi.
en: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face.
text:
2SA 14:27
Thadou: Absalom hin chapa thum ahing in, chule chanu khat jong ahing in, achanu min chu Tamar akiti; Tamar jong hi numei hoi tah khatma ahi.
English: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face.

tcz: Hiti hin Absalom hi kum ni lhingset Jerusalema acheng ahin, hijongle lengpa ang sungah khatvei cha avah lut kha hih beh in ahi.
en: Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, and he didn’t see the king’s face.
text:
2SA 14:28
Thadou: Hiti hin Absalom hi kum ni lhingset Jerusalema acheng ahin, hijongle lengpa ang sungah khatvei cha avah lut kha hih beh in ahi.
English: Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, and he didn’t see the king’s face.

tcz: Chuin Absalom chun Joab kou dingin mi asol’in, ahunga ahileh lengpa koma sol din agon; ahinla Joab chu Absalom koma ahung tapon ahi. Hichun Joab in mi asol kit’in, ahi vang'in Joab chu ahung deh kit poi.
en: Then Absalom sent for Joab, to send him to the king, but he would not come to him. Then he sent again a second time, but he would not come.
text:
2SA 14:29
Thadou: Chuin Absalom chun Joab kou dingin mi asol’in, ahunga ahileh lengpa koma sol din agon; ahinla Joab chu Absalom koma ahung tapon ahi. Hichun Joab in mi asol kit’in, ahi vang'in Joab chu ahung deh kit poi.
English: Then Absalom sent for Joab, to send him to the king, but he would not come to him. Then he sent again a second time, but he would not come.

tcz: Chuphat’in aman jong asoh te koma asei in, “Veuvin, Joab lou khu keima lou ban tah ahin, cheuvin lang alou laiya khu mei in gahal vam tauvin,” ati. Hijeh chun Absalom soh ten jong Joab lou chu meiyin agahal vam tao vin ahi.
en: Therefore he said to his servants, “Behold, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.” So Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.
text:
2SA 14:30
Thadou: Chuphat’in aman jong asoh te koma asei in, “Veuvin, Joab lou khu keima lou ban tah ahin, cheuvin lang alou laiya khu mei in gahal vam tauvin,” ati. Hijeh chun Absalom soh ten jong Joab lou chu meiyin agahal vam tao vin ahi.
English: Therefore he said to his servants, “Behold, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.” So Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.

tcz: Chuphat’in Joab jong akipat doh in Absalom koma achen akoma hitin aseiye, “Ipi dinga nasoh ten kalou meiya ahal vam jeng u hitam?” aga tie.
en: Then Joab arose and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”
text:
2SA 14:31
Thadou: Chuphat’in Joab jong akipat doh in Absalom koma achen akoma hitin aseiye, “Ipi dinga nasoh ten kalou meiya ahal vam jeng u hitam?” aga tie.
English: Then Joab arose and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”

tcz: Hichun Ab’salom jong chun Joab chu adonbut’in, “ Vetan, keiman nahenga thu kahin thot jin, ‘Hikoma hungin keiman lengpa koma nasol ing ting, “Ipi ding pen tah a keima hi Geshur gam'a kona hung khoh khoh a kahiya, kei dinga Geshur gam'a umden chu nomjo dinga?” tin aseiye, tia gadoh sah ding kati nahi. Tujengin jong lengpa angsunga neilut sah mong mong in lang keiman themmona kaneiya ahijong leh aman eithat jeng hen,’ ati tia ga sei sah ding kati ahi,” ati.
en: Absalom answered Joab, “Behold, I sent to you, saying, ‘Come here, that I may send you to the king, to say, “Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me to be there still. Now therefore, let me see the king’s face; and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”’”
text:
2SA 14:32
Thadou: Hichun Ab’salom jong chun Joab chu adonbut’in, “ Vetan, keiman nahenga thu kahin thot jin, ‘Hikoma hungin keiman lengpa koma nasol ing ting, “Ipi ding pen tah a keima hi Geshur gam'a kona hung khoh khoh a kahiya, kei dinga Geshur gam'a umden chu nomjo dinga?” tin aseiye, tia gadoh sah ding kati nahi. Tujengin jong lengpa angsunga neilut sah mong mong in lang keiman themmona kaneiya ahijong leh aman eithat jeng hen,’ ati tia ga sei sah ding kati ahi,” ati.
English: Absalom answered Joab, “Behold, I sent to you, saying, ‘Come here, that I may send you to the king, to say, “Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me to be there still. Now therefore, let me see the king’s face; and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”’”

tcz: Hijeh chun Joab jong lengpa koma achen aga seipeh tan ahileh, hichun lengpan jong Absalom chu akoutai. Chuin Absalom jong lengpa koma ahungin, lengpa angsunga chun abohkhup in amai tol'a asulut in jana apen ahi; chuin lengpan jong Absalom chu achop tai.
en: So Joab came to the king and told him; and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king; and the king kissed Absalom.
text:
2SA 14:33
Thadou: Hijeh chun Joab jong lengpa koma achen aga seipeh tan ahileh, hichun lengpan jong Absalom chu akoutai. Chuin Absalom jong lengpa koma ahungin, lengpa angsunga chun abohkhup in amai tol'a asulut in jana apen ahi; chuin lengpan jong Absalom chu achop tai.
English: So Joab came to the king and told him; and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king; and the king kissed Absalom.

tcz: Hiti ho jouse kichai nung hin Absalom chun kangtalai khat akisem’in, sakol akai ding ho jong akigot tohsoh keiyin, chule amasanga lhaidin pasal cheh mi som nga akilhen doh tai.
en: After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.
text:
2SA 15:1
Thadou: Hiti ho jouse kichai nung hin Absalom chun kangtalai khat akisem’in, sakol akai ding ho jong akigot tohsoh keiyin, chule amasanga lhaidin pasal cheh mi som nga akilhen doh tai.
English: After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.

tcz: Absalom hi jingkahseh jingpi tah in athou jin, kelkot lampi geiya chun ading jin ahi; hitichun mihem khat tou lengpa koma mi hehna ding thu aneiya, athu tan sah ding ahung teng le, hitobang miho chu Absalomin akou jin ana dong ji'e, “Hoilai khopi pen a kona hung nahim?” tia adoh le mihem pan jong, aphung min aseipih ding ahi.
en: Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate. When any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment, then Absalom called to him, and said, “What city are you from?” He said, “Your servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.”
text:
2SA 15:2
Thadou: Absalom hi jingkahseh jingpi tah in athou jin, kelkot lampi geiya chun ading jin ahi; hitichun mihem khat tou lengpa koma mi hehna ding thu aneiya, athu tan sah ding ahung teng le, hitobang miho chu Absalomin akou jin ana dong ji'e, “Hoilai khopi pen a kona hung nahim?” tia adoh le mihem pan jong, aphung min aseipih ding ahi.
English: Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate. When any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment, then Absalom called to him, and said, “What city are you from?” He said, “Your servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.”

tcz: Hiteng chule Absalom in asei peh kitjin, “nangman chungthu nasatah nahinpolut e! chule hichehi aphamo lheh jenge lengpan hichu ngaidin koima aneipon ahi.
en: Absalom said to him, “Behold, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputized by the king to hear you.”
text:
2SA 15:3
Thadou: Hiteng chule Absalom in asei peh kitjin, “nangman chungthu nasatah nahinpolut e! chule hichehi aphamo lheh jenge lengpan hichu ngaidin koima aneipon ahi.
English: Absalom said to him, “Behold, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputized by the king to hear you.”

tcz: Chujongleh Absalom chun asei kit in, “O kadeh, keima hi gamsunga thutan vaihoma pang ana hileng, mijousen achungthu u keikommatan dia ahin pohlut diu, chule keiman thudihtah a katan pih diu ahi ati.
en: Absalom said moreover, “Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man who has any suit or cause might come to me, and I would do him justice!”
text:
2SA 15:4
Thadou: Chujongleh Absalom chun asei kit in, “O kadeh, keima hi gamsunga thutan vaihoma pang ana hileng, mijousen achungthu u keikommatan dia ahin pohlut diu, chule keiman thudihtah a katan pih diu ahi ati.
English: Absalom said moreover, “Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man who has any suit or cause might come to me, and I would do him justice!”

tcz: Hitia chu ama angsunga bohkhup dia mi ahung teng le Absalom chu anomji pon hisang chun aman hitobang miho chu akhut’in atuh chah jeng jin, achop jin ahi.
en: It was so, that when any man came near to bow down to him, he stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and kissed him.
text:
2SA 15:5
Thadou: Hitia chu ama angsunga bohkhup dia mi ahung teng le Absalom chu anomji pon hisang chun aman hitobang miho chu akhut’in atuh chah jeng jin, achop jin ahi.
English: It was so, that when any man came near to bow down to him, he stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and kissed him.

tcz: Hitobang hin lengpa koma athu kikhola kitan sah dinga hung ji Israel mi tapou chu Absalomin anabol jing jin ahi; hiche a kon hin Absalomin Israel mipi jouse lungthim abonchan athu nun soh hel tai.
en: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
text:
2SA 15:6
Thadou: Hitobang hin lengpa koma athu kikhola kitan sah dinga hung ji Israel mi tapou chu Absalomin anabol jing jin ahi; hiche a kon hin Absalomin Israel mipi jouse lungthim abonchan athu nun soh hel tai.
English: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

tcz: Chule kumli alhin jouvin Absalomin lengpa koma chun aseiyin, “Lungset tah in neisol’in lang keima Hebron khopia khun cheng ting Pakaiya kilhaina gasem ingting chule keiman ama toh kitepna kasem chu gabulhit tange ati..
en: At the end of forty years, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to the LORD, in Hebron.
text:
2SA 15:7
Thadou: Chule kumli alhin jouvin Absalomin lengpa koma chun aseiyin, “Lungset tah in neisol’in lang keima Hebron khopia khun cheng ting Pakaiya kilhaina gasem ingting chule keiman ama toh kitepna kasem chu gabulhit tange ati..
English: At the end of forty years, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to the LORD, in Hebron.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh nalhachapa keima Ram gamsung Geshur a kachen lai chun kitepna khat kanabol’in hitin kana seiye, ‘Pakaiyin Jerusalema einung puilut kit poupouva ahileh keiman Pakai koma kilhaina kabola chibai kaboh ding ahi,’ tin kanaseiye,” ati.
en: For your servant vowed a vow while I stayed at Geshur in Syria, saying, ‘If the LORD shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD.’”
text:
2SA 15:8
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itileh nalhachapa keima Ram gamsung Geshur a kachen lai chun kitepna khat kanabol’in hitin kana seiye, ‘Pakaiyin Jerusalema einung puilut kit poupouva ahileh keiman Pakai koma kilhaina kabola chibai kaboh ding ahi,’ tin kanaseiye,” ati.
English: For your servant vowed a vow while I stayed at Geshur in Syria, saying, ‘If the LORD shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD.’”

tcz: Hichun lengpan jong aseipeh in,“aphai, chinlang nakitep nachu gamolso tan ati,” ati. Hijeh chun Absalom jong akipat doh pai in Hebron ache tai.
en: The king said to him, “Go in peace.” So he arose and went to Hebron.
text:
2SA 15:9
Thadou: Hichun lengpan jong aseipeh in,“aphai, chinlang nakitep nachu gamolso tan ati,” ati. Hijeh chun Absalom jong akipat doh pai in Hebron ache tai.
English: The king said to him, “Go in peace.” So he arose and went to Hebron.

tcz: Ahinla Absalom chun guhthim chan Israel phung jouse koma sot tol le miho ana sola hitia hi ana sei sa ahi, “Nang hon saki pengkul kimut ging najah poupou uva ahileh, ‘Hebron khopia Absalom aleng chang tai,’ tia na sei diu ahi,” tin ana hil masa tan ahi.
en: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, ‘Absalom is king in Hebron!’”
text:
2SA 15:10
Thadou: Ahinla Absalom chun guhthim chan Israel phung jouse koma sot tol le miho ana sola hitia hi ana sei sa ahi, “Nang hon saki pengkul kimut ging najah poupou uva ahileh, ‘Hebron khopia Absalom aleng chang tai,’ tia na sei diu ahi,” tin ana hil masa tan ahi.
English: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, ‘Absalom is king in Hebron!’”

tcz: Mihem jani Jerusalem khopia konin Absalom chutoh akilhon’uvin, ahin amaho chun Absalom lunggel ngaito emacha ahepou vin ahi.
en: Two hundred men went with Absalom out of Jerusalem, who were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they didn’t know anything.
text:
2SA 15:11
Thadou: Mihem jani Jerusalem khopia konin Absalom chutoh akilhon’uvin, ahin amaho chun Absalom lunggel ngaito emacha ahepou vin ahi.
English: Two hundred men went with Absalom out of Jerusalem, who were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they didn’t know anything.

tcz: Absalomin kilhaina gantha ima abol laiyin, Gilon mi Ahithophel kitipa, David dinga lungthima kithopi phatah mipa chun mi asol’in achenna Giloh khopia konin aga kousah tai. Chule Absaom in thilse abol'a lengpa adouna chu akhang tul tul jeng in, mipin jong Absalom ajop bebe jeng tau’ve.
en: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong, for the people increased continually with Absalom.
text:
2SA 15:12
Thadou: Absalomin kilhaina gantha ima abol laiyin, Gilon mi Ahithophel kitipa, David dinga lungthima kithopi phatah mipa chun mi asol’in achenna Giloh khopia konin aga kousah tai. Chule Absaom in thilse abol'a lengpa adouna chu akhang tul tul jeng in, mipin jong Absalom ajop bebe jeng tau’ve.
English: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong, for the people increased continually with Absalom.

tcz: Hijeh chun sot tolle mi khat chu David koma ahung in hitin ahung seiye, “Israel miten alungthim’uvin Absalom nung ajui gamtauve,” ati.
en: A messenger came to David, saying, “The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.”
text:
2SA 15:13
Thadou: Hijeh chun sot tolle mi khat chu David koma ahung in hitin ahung seiye, “Israel miten alungthim’uvin Absalom nung ajui gamtauve,” ati.
English: A messenger came to David, saying, “The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.”

tcz: Chuphat’in David jong chun Jerusalem khopia aumkhompi amite hengah hitin aseitai, “khatveijam a ebonchaova ejam diu ahitai, akhuti louleh ivaigeidiu ahitai. Kino loi ute! Absalom ahung lhun masanga khopi sunga kon epotdoh ule, eiho ehiuvin chule Jerusalem khopi sung jong toset akon huidoh thei ding ahi, ati.
en: David said to all his servants who were with him at Jerusalem, “Arise! Let’s flee, or else none of us will escape from Absalom. Hurry to depart, lest he overtake us quickly and bring down evil on us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.”
text:
2SA 15:14
Thadou: Chuphat’in David jong chun Jerusalem khopia aumkhompi amite hengah hitin aseitai, “khatveijam a ebonchaova ejam diu ahitai, akhuti louleh ivaigeidiu ahitai. Kino loi ute! Absalom ahung lhun masanga khopi sunga kon epotdoh ule, eiho ehiuvin chule Jerusalem khopi sung jong toset akon huidoh thei ding ahi, ati.
English: David said to all his servants who were with him at Jerusalem, “Arise! Let’s flee, or else none of us will escape from Absalom. Hurry to depart, lest he overtake us quickly and bring down evil on us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.”

tcz: Hichun David lengpa kithopi hon jong ama chu adonbut un, keiho nangma toh kaumjing naove, hijeh chun nangman aphapen ahi tia nagel chu bol tan atiuve.
en: The king’s servants said to the king, “Behold, your servants are ready to do whatever my lord the king chooses.”
text:
2SA 15:15
Thadou: Hichun David lengpa kithopi hon jong ama chu adonbut un, keiho nangma toh kaumjing naove, hijeh chun nangman aphapen ahi tia nagel chu bol tan atiuve.
English: The king’s servants said to the king, “Behold, your servants are ready to do whatever my lord the king chooses.”

tcz: Hijeh chun lengpa jong akipat doh pai paiyin a insung mite jouse jong anunga akitol tauve. Chule lengpan in ngah dinga thaikem numei som adalhah tilou koima cha adalha pon ahi.
en: The king went out, and all his household after him. The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house.
text:
2SA 15:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun lengpa jong akipat doh pai paiyin a insung mite jouse jong anunga akitol tauve. Chule lengpan in ngah dinga thaikem numei som adalhah tilou koima cha adalha pon ahi.
English: The king went out, and all his household after him. The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house.

tcz: Hitia lengpa apot doh jeng phat’in mipin anung ajui cheh-taovin ahi; acheu chun khopi ning langa veng pam nu nung pen tah a in khat a aki ngauvin ahi.
en: The king went out, and all the people after him; and they stayed in Beth Merhak.
text:
2SA 15:17
Thadou: Hitia lengpa apot doh jeng phat’in mipin anung ajui cheh-taovin ahi; acheu chun khopi ning langa veng pam nu nung pen tah a in khat a aki ngauvin ahi.
English: The king went out, and all the people after him; and they stayed in Beth Merhak.

tcz: Chule lengpa lhacha ho jousen ama akhelsoh kei uvin ahi. Gath khoa kipat’a David nung hinjui ho chu mi jagup ahiuvin amaho cheng chu lengpa vengbit a umho toh hung kilhon ahiu vin ahi.
en: All his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men who came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.
text:
2SA 15:18
Thadou: Chule lengpa lhacha ho jousen ama akhelsoh kei uvin ahi. Gath khoa kipat’a David nung hinjui ho chu mi jagup ahiuvin amaho cheng chu lengpa vengbit a umho toh hung kilhon ahiu vin ahi.
English: All his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men who came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

tcz: David lengpa chu akihei in Gath mite lah a lamkai Ittai kom achun asei tan ahi, “Ipi dinga nangma keiho to nakilhon ham? Chule nangma kinunglen lang Absalom lengpa kom gaumtan, ajeh chu nangma gamchom mi nahin, among monga jong na-in a kona hikoma soh changa hung khopem nahibouve.
en: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why do you also go with us? Return, and stay with the king; for you are a foreigner and also an exile. Return to your own place.
text:
2SA 15:19
Thadou: David lengpa chu akihei in Gath mite lah a lamkai Ittai kom achun asei tan ahi, “Ipi dinga nangma keiho to nakilhon ham? Chule nangma kinunglen lang Absalom lengpa kom gaumtan, ajeh chu nangma gamchom mi nahin, among monga jong na-in a kona hikoma soh changa hung khopem nahibouve.
English: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why do you also go with us? Return, and stay with the king; for you are a foreigner and also an exile. Return to your own place.

tcz: Chujongle nangma jania hung lhung bep’a hoilam kajot ding chule hoilama kache ding bon kihe louva iti tunia ken nangma keiho banga kagenthei sah ding ham? Kile kit tan, chule nasopteu kipuiyin lang kile kit mong mong tan; chule Pakai in amingailut nale akitahna namusah jing hen,” ati.
en: Whereas you came but yesterday, should I today make you go up and down with us, since I go where I may? Return, and take back your brothers. Mercy and truth be with you.”
text:
2SA 15:20
Thadou: Chujongle nangma jania hung lhung bep’a hoilam kajot ding chule hoilama kache ding bon kihe louva iti tunia ken nangma keiho banga kagenthei sah ding ham? Kile kit tan, chule nasopteu kipuiyin lang kile kit mong mong tan; chule Pakai in amingailut nale akitahna namusah jing hen,” ati.
English: Whereas you came but yesterday, should I today make you go up and down with us, since I go where I may? Return, and take back your brothers. Mercy and truth be with you.”

tcz: Ahinla Ittai chun lengpa chu adonbut’in, “Pakai hing jing min e kapu lengpa hinlai pet’a kasei ahi, kapu lengpa chuh chuh na a thina ding mun hihen, hinna ding mun hijong le, nachi chi na a chu nasohpa kei jong kahung jeng ding ahibouve,” ati.
en: Ittai answered the king and said, “As the LORD lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in what place my lord the king is, whether for death or for life, your servant will be there also.”
text:
2SA 15:21
Thadou: Ahinla Ittai chun lengpa chu adonbut’in, “Pakai hing jing min e kapu lengpa hinlai pet’a kasei ahi, kapu lengpa chuh chuh na a thina ding mun hihen, hinna ding mun hijong le, nachi chi na a chu nasohpa kei jong kahung jeng ding ahibouve,” ati.
English: Ittai answered the king and said, “As the LORD lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in what place my lord the king is, whether for death or for life, your servant will be there also.”

tcz: Chuphat’in David jong chun adonbut in, “akhuti le aphai hungun chikhom ute,” atileh; Ittai jong ache masan, amite chengse le aki lhonpi nu nao chapang jouse chutoh akitol tau’ve.
en: David said to Ittai, “Go and pass over.” Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones who were with him.
text:
2SA 15:22
Thadou: Chuphat’in David jong chun adonbut in, “akhuti le aphai hungun chikhom ute,” atileh; Ittai jong ache masan, amite chengse le aki lhonpi nu nao chapang jouse chutoh akitol tau’ve.
English: David said to Ittai, “Go and pass over.” Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones who were with him.

tcz: Mipi chutia akitol jeng phat’uvin gamsung pumpi chu o thong jejun akap tauve; chule lengpa jong achen Kidron lui agal kai tai, hiti hin mipi abonchauvin gamsung lam jon in akitol doh tauvin ahi.
en: All the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over. The king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over toward the way of the wilderness.
text:
2SA 15:23
Thadou: Mipi chutia akitol jeng phat’uvin gamsung pumpi chu o thong jejun akap tauve; chule lengpa jong achen Kidron lui agal kai tai, hiti hin mipi abonchauvin gamsung lam jon in akitol doh tauvin ahi.
English: All the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over. The king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over toward the way of the wilderness.

tcz: Chule Zadok jong Levi te se se jong ahiuvin, Pathen kitepna thingkong chu ahinpu’uvin ahi; chuin mipi aboncha khopi akhokhel kah seuvin Abiathar injong pathen hengah kilhaina abollin Pathen thingkong chu tol'a a ngau’vin ahi.
en: Behold, Zadok also came, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down God’s ark; and Abiathar went up until all the people finished passing out of the city.
text:
2SA 15:24
Thadou: Chule Zadok jong Levi te se se jong ahiuvin, Pathen kitepna thingkong chu ahinpu’uvin ahi; chuin mipi aboncha khopi akhokhel kah seuvin Abiathar injong pathen hengah kilhaina abollin Pathen thingkong chu tol'a a ngau’vin ahi.
English: Behold, Zadok also came, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down God’s ark; and Abiathar went up until all the people finished passing out of the city.
