Hichun mipi abonchauva jah dingin aseipeh tai, “Vetan, lengpa khu kelkot phungbula atou tai,” atiuva ahileh; chuphat’in mipi ho chu abomnchauvin lengpa angsunga ahung kitol lutsoh tauve, Israel chate Absalom nungjui ho vang chu ama ama inlam cheh a ajam lut soh tauve.
en: Then the king arose and sat in the gate. The people were all told, “Behold, the king is sitting in the gate.” All the people came before the king. Now Israel had fled every man to his tent.
text:
2SA 19:8
Thadou: Chuphat’in lengpa jong akipat doh jengin kelkot phunga atouna a chun atoutai. Hichun mipi abonchauva jah dingin aseipeh tai, “Vetan, lengpa khu kelkot phungbula atou tai,” atiuva ahileh; chuphat’in mipi ho chu abomnchauvin lengpa angsunga ahung kitol lutsoh tauve, Israel chate Absalom nungjui ho vang chu ama ama inlam cheh a ajam lut soh tauve.
English: Then the king arose and sat in the gate. The people were all told, “Behold, the king is sitting in the gate.” All the people came before the king. Now Israel had fled every man to his tent.

tcz: Israel phung chujat lah a chun mipi abonchan aboilah lah jenguvin, hitin aseiyuve, “Lengpa David chun imelmateu khut’a kona jong inahuhhingu uva chule Philistines te khut akon a jong eina sochat sah u ahin, hinlah Absalom agin jeh a gamsunga kona jamdoh ahitai atiuve.
en: All the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “The king delivered us out of the hand of our enemies, and he saved us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he has fled out of the land from Absalom.
text:
2SA 19:9
Thadou: Israel phung chujat lah a chun mipi abonchan aboilah lah jenguvin, hitin aseiyuve, “Lengpa David chun imelmateu khut’a kona jong inahuhhingu uva chule Philistines te khut akon a jong eina sochat sah u ahin, hinlah Absalom agin jeh a gamsunga kona jamdoh ahitai atiuve.
English: All the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “The king delivered us out of the hand of our enemies, and he saved us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he has fled out of the land from Absalom.

tcz: Chule tua ichunguva leng chang dinga thao inupau Absalom la galmu nin athitan. Chuti ahileh ibola David chu ileng diuva elekoukit dadiu ham? akitiuve.
en: Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why don’t you speak a word of bringing the king back?”
text:
2SA 19:10
Thadou: Chule tua ichunguva leng chang dinga thao inupau Absalom la galmu nin athitan. Chuti ahileh ibola David chu ileng diuva elekoukit dadiu ham? akitiuve.
English: Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why don’t you speak a word of bringing the king back?”

tcz: Hichun David lengpan jong thempu te ni Zadok le Abiathar koma thu athot’in hitin aseiye, “Judah mi upate koma seipeh lhon in lang, ‘Lengpa koma Israel dang jouse thu hung lhungsoh ta, ipi dinga nang ho hi lengpa in'a puilut kit ding thuseiya anukhahpen a pang naiuvem?
en: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, “Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, ‘Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the speech of all Israel has come to the king, to return him to his house?
text:
2SA 19:11
Thadou: Hichun David lengpan jong thempu te ni Zadok le Abiathar koma thu athot’in hitin aseiye, “Judah mi upate koma seipeh lhon in lang, ‘Lengpa koma Israel dang jouse thu hung lhungsoh ta, ipi dinga nang ho hi lengpa in'a puilut kit ding thuseiya anukhahpen a pang naiuvem?
English: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, “Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, ‘Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the speech of all Israel has come to the king, to return him to his house?

tcz: Nangho hi keima inkote mong mong, kaphe le kathisan nahiuve; ahileh ipi dinga nang ho lengpa puiding thusei nukhah a napan diu ham?’ ati tilhon'in.
en: You are my brothers. You are my bone and my flesh. Why then are you the last to bring back the king?’
text:
2SA 19:12
Thadou: Nangho hi keima inkote mong mong, kaphe le kathisan nahiuve; ahileh ipi dinga nang ho lengpa puiding thusei nukhah a napan diu ham?’ ati tilhon'in.
English: You are my brothers. You are my bone and my flesh. Why then are you the last to bring back the king?’

tcz: Chujong leh Amasa kitipa koma jong nasei peh lhon ding, ‘Nang hi keima thisan le phe mong nahi lou ham? Tua lhah nang hi Joab panmun khela sepaite lamkaiya napan lou poupouva ahileh Pathenin abolnom nomin eibol hen, akhoh cheh jon jong eibol hen, kapan sah ding nahi,’ tin a seiye, nati lhon ding ahi,” ati.
en: Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army before me continually instead of Joab.’”
text:
2SA 19:13
Thadou: Chujong leh Amasa kitipa koma jong nasei peh lhon ding, ‘Nang hi keima thisan le phe mong nahi lou ham? Tua lhah nang hi Joab panmun khela sepaite lamkaiya napan lou poupouva ahileh Pathenin abolnom nomin eibol hen, akhoh cheh jon jong eibol hen, kapan sah ding nahi,’ tin a seiye, nati lhon ding ahi,” ati.
English: Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army before me continually instead of Joab.’”

tcz: Hichun Amasa chun Judah mite chu mihem khat sheh abahsah jengin alungu kitoh del’in, athu nun’in, hijeh chun amahon thu ahin thot paiyun, lengpa henga chun, “Nang le nasepaite nabonchauvin hung kile kit jeng uvin,” atiuvin ahi.
en: He bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as one man, so that they sent to the king, saying, “Return, you and all your servants.”
text:
2SA 19:14
Thadou: Hichun Amasa chun Judah mite chu mihem khat sheh abahsah jengin alungu kitoh del’in, athu nun’in, hijeh chun amahon thu ahin thot paiyun, lengpa henga chun, “Nang le nasepaite nabonchauvin hung kile kit jeng uvin,” atiuvin ahi.
English: He bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as one man, so that they sent to the king, saying, “Return, you and all your servants.”

tcz: Hijeh chun lengpa jong Jerusalem ahung kile kit tan ahi. chule Jordan vadung ahung lhung tan ahile Judah jong chu lengpa lamtoa Jordan vadunga apui galkai din ahungun Gilgal ahung lhung taove.
en: So the king returned, and came to the Jordan. Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.
text:
2SA 19:15
Thadou: Hijeh chun lengpa jong Jerusalem ahung kile kit tan ahi. chule Jordan vadung ahung lhung tan ahile Judah jong chu lengpa lamtoa Jordan vadunga apui galkai din ahungun Gilgal ahung lhung taove.
English: So the king returned, and came to the Jordan. Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.

tcz: Gera chapa Shimei kitipa Benjamin phunga mipajong chu Bahurim khoa pat’in David lengpa lamto din kino tah in Judah mite chutoh ahung kilhon suh tai.
en: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.
text:
2SA 19:16
Thadou: Gera chapa Shimei kitipa Benjamin phunga mipajong chu Bahurim khoa pat’in David lengpa lamto din kino tah in Judah mite chutoh ahung kilhon suh tai.
English: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.

tcz: Chule midang Benjamin phunga kon misangkhat, Saul insunga dia sepai jalamkai Ziba jaonan, chule Ziba chapate somlenga le asoh somni toh ahung thaovin Jordan vadung a lengpa kimupi din ahung lhailhao vin ahi.
en: There were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of Saul’s house, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king.
text:
2SA 19:17
Thadou: Chule midang Benjamin phunga kon misangkhat, Saul insunga dia sepai jalamkai Ziba jaonan, chule Ziba chapate somlenga le asoh somni toh ahung thaovin Jordan vadung a lengpa kimupi din ahung lhailhao vin ahi.
English: There were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of Saul’s house, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king.

tcz: Hitichun lengpa leh a ingsungmite chutoh Jordan vadung ahung galkai un, kithopi nathei chan in ejakai in amachu akitho piu vin ahi. Shimei dinga David khutona lengpan Jordan vadung ahin galkai ding toh lhonin, Shimei chu ama angsungah abohkhup in ahi.
en: A ferry boat went to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king when he had come over the Jordan.
text:
2SA 19:18
Thadou: Hitichun lengpa leh a ingsungmite chutoh Jordan vadung ahung galkai un, kithopi nathei chan in ejakai in amachu akitho piu vin ahi. Shimei dinga David khutona lengpan Jordan vadung ahin galkai ding toh lhonin, Shimei chu ama angsungah abohkhup in ahi.
English: A ferry boat went to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king when he had come over the Jordan.

tcz: Shimei chu ataovin, “kapakai lengpa, lungset tah in neingaidam in,” nangman Jerusalem nadalhah a nalhachan thil phalou tah tah kabol hochu heimil inlang nalungsungah jong umsah datan ati.
en: He said to the king, “Don’t let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
text:
2SA 19:19
Thadou: Shimei chu ataovin, “kapakai lengpa, lungset tah in neingaidam in,” nangman Jerusalem nadalhah a nalhachan thil phalou tah tah kabol hochu heimil inlang nalungsungah jong umsah datan ati.
English: He said to the king, “Don’t let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

tcz: keiman kahei echan a chonse kahi hitam. Hijeh achu tunia hilai mun hung kahi, Israel te jouse lah a dinga kapakai lengpa lamto masapen a.
en: For your servant knows that I have sinned. Therefore behold, I have come today as the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.”
text:
2SA 19:20
Thadou: keiman kahei echan a chonse kahi hitam. Hijeh achu tunia hilai mun hung kahi, Israel te jouse lah a dinga kapakai lengpa lamto masapen a.
English: For your servant knows that I have sinned. Therefore behold, I have come today as the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.”

tcz: Chuin Zeruiah chapa Abishai in asei in, Shimei hi thading ahi, ajeh chu aman leng thao kinupa hi agaosap ahi.
en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?”
text:
2SA 19:21
Thadou: Chuin Zeruiah chapa Abishai in asei in, Shimei hi thading ahi, ajeh chu aman leng thao kinupa hi agaosap ahi.
English: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?”

tcz: Hichun David in ahinsei in, Zeruiah chapa kon nang nadoh beh ham ati. Epi dinga tonia nangma keima melma a pang gu nahim? Tonihi achaini ahipoi, ajeh chu tonia hi keima Avella Israel te leng kahikit ahitai ati.
en: David said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For don’t I know that I am king over Israel today?”
text:
2SA 19:22
Thadou: Hichun David in ahinsei in, Zeruiah chapa kon nang nadoh beh ham ati. Epi dinga tonia nangma keima melma a pang gu nahim? Tonihi achaini ahipoi, ajeh chu tonia hi keima Avella Israel te leng kahikit ahitai ati.
English: David said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For don’t I know that I am king over Israel today?”

tcz: Hichun Shimei lamma akihei in, David akihahsellin, nahinkho hi kahing hoi ding ahi ati.
en: The king said to Shimei, “You will not die.” The king swore to him.
text:
2SA 19:23
Thadou: Hichun Shimei lamma akihei in, David akihahsellin, nahinkho hi kahing hoi ding ahi ati.
English: The king said to Shimei, “You will not die.” The king swore to him.

tcz: Chuin Saul tupa Mephibosheth chu Jerusalem ahunsuh in lengpa ahung kimupin ahi. lengpan Jerusalem adalhah nikho apet chun akeng, akhamul chule avon sop ding emacha akhoh sah tapon ahi.
en: Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace.
text:
2SA 19:24
Thadou: Chuin Saul tupa Mephibosheth chu Jerusalem ahunsuh in lengpa ahung kimupin ahi. lengpan Jerusalem adalhah nikho apet chun akeng, akhamul chule avon sop ding emacha akhoh sah tapon ahi.
English: Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace.

tcz: Chuin lengpan adonbut in, Mephibosheth epi dinga keima toh nahung khom lou ham? ati.
en: When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”
text:
2SA 19:25
Thadou: Chuin lengpan adonbut in, Mephibosheth epi dinga keima toh nahung khom lou ham? ati.
English: When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”

tcz: Hichun Mephibosheth in adonbut in, kapakai kalengpa kasohpa Ziba in eijou lhep in ahi. keiman kaseipih in, ka sangan chu gongtoh in khuti leh lengpa toh kachi khom thei ding ahi kati ajeh chu nangman neihet banga keima hi elbai kahi.
en: He answered, “My lord, O king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said, ‘I will saddle a donkey for myself, that I may ride on it and go with the king,’ because your servant is lame.
text:
2SA 19:26
Thadou: Hichun Mephibosheth in adonbut in, kapakai kalengpa kasohpa Ziba in eijou lhep in ahi. keiman kaseipih in, ka sangan chu gongtoh in khuti leh lengpa toh kachi khom thei ding ahi kati ajeh chu nangman neihet banga keima hi elbai kahi.
English: He answered, “My lord, O king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said, ‘I will saddle a donkey for myself, that I may ride on it and go with the king,’ because your servant is lame.

tcz: keima kahungnom lou dan in Ziba in asei in eijoulhep e. ahin keiman kahe nai kapakai kalengpa hi Pathen vantil tabang nahin, hijeh chun nangman nagel a aphai nati ti chun bol tan ati.
en: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king, but my lord the king is as an angel of God. Therefore do what is good in your eyes.
text:
2SA 19:27
Thadou: keima kahungnom lou dan in Ziba in asei in eijoulhep e. ahin keiman kahe nai kapakai kalengpa hi Pathen vantil tabang nahin, hijeh chun nangman nagel a aphai nati ti chun bol tan ati.
English: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king, but my lord the king is as an angel of God. Therefore do what is good in your eyes.

tcz: Chule keima le kainsung mite jouse hi athi dinga lom kahi bou ve ka pakai, hinlah hichu hilou vin nangman neijabol in nadokhangah an neineh khompi e! hiche kalvar a chu epi kathum nahlai ding ham?
en: For all my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at your own table. What right therefore have I yet that I should appeal any more to the king?”
text:
2SA 19:28
Thadou: Chule keima le kainsung mite jouse hi athi dinga lom kahi bou ve ka pakai, hinlah hichu hilou vin nangman neijabol in nadokhangah an neineh khompi e! hiche kalvar a chu epi kathum nahlai ding ham?
English: For all my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at your own table. What right therefore have I yet that I should appeal any more to the king?”

tcz: Nangman aphatai nati, chuin David in adonbut in, nangma le Ziba hi nagam sung chu kitoh chat a nakihop lhon ding in kagel lhatai.
en: The king said to him, “Why do you speak any more of your matters? I say, you and Ziba divide the land.”
text:
2SA 19:29
Thadou: Nangman aphatai nati, chuin David in adonbut in, nangma le Ziba hi nagam sung chu kitoh chat a nakihop lhon ding in kagel lhatai.
English: The king said to him, “Why do you speak any more of your matters? I say, you and Ziba divide the land.”

tcz: Chuin Mephibosheth in aseiyin, amachan ding jouse chu petan ati. Nangma damsella nahung kile kit hi keidin aphaset tai kapakai le kalengpa ati.
en: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”
text:
2SA 19:30
Thadou: Chuin Mephibosheth in aseiyin, amachan ding jouse chu petan ati. Nangma damsella nahung kile kit hi keidin aphaset tai kapakai le kalengpa ati.
English: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”

tcz: Gilead mi Barzillai chu Rogelim akon ahungsuh in Jordan vadungah lengpa chu ahung kimupin ahi.
en: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.
text:
2SA 19:31
Thadou: Gilead mi Barzillai chu Rogelim akon ahungsuh in Jordan vadungah lengpa chu ahung kimupin ahi.
English: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.

tcz: Amahi akum ahan tan midam thei tah kum somget ahi tan ahi. chule amahi ahi lengpa Mahanaim aumlai a nehding pipa chu.
en: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man.
text:
2SA 19:32
Thadou: Amahi akum ahan tan midam thei tah kum somget ahi tan ahi. chule amahi ahi lengpa Mahanaim aumlai a nehding pipa chu.
English: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man.

tcz: Chuin lengpan Barzillai kommah asei in hung inlang keitoh Jerusalem ah hung cheng tan . keiman hilaimun ah chu nangma kavetsui ding nahi ati.
en: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”
text:
2SA 19:33
Thadou: Chuin lengpan Barzillai kommah asei in hung inlang keitoh Jerusalem ah hung cheng tan . keiman hilaimun ah chu nangma kavetsui ding nahi ati.
English: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”

tcz: Hichun Barzillai in ahin donbut in, ahipoi keima Jerusalem chan hung ding in kateh var tai ati.
en: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?
text:
2SA 19:34
Thadou: Hichun Barzillai in ahin donbut in, ahipoi keima Jerusalem chan hung ding in kateh var tai ati.
English: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?

tcz: Tun keima kum somget kahitan, chule keiman emacha kanupsah pithei aumtapoi. Ju le an jeng jong atui tapon, chule lasa them ho lasah jong kangai nom tapoi. Keimahi kapakai lengpa dia alungkham nabep kahi ding ahitai.
en: I am eighty years old, today. Can I discern between good and bad? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? Can I hear the voice of singing men and singing women any more? Why then should your servant be a burden to my lord the king?
text:
2SA 19:35
Thadou: Tun keima kum somget kahitan, chule keiman emacha kanupsah pithei aumtapoi. Ju le an jeng jong atui tapon, chule lasa them ho lasah jong kangai nom tapoi. Keimahi kapakai lengpa dia alungkham nabep kahi ding ahitai.
English: I am eighty years old, today. Can I discern between good and bad? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? Can I hear the voice of singing men and singing women any more? Why then should your servant be a burden to my lord the king?

tcz: lengpa toh Jordan lui galkai ding bou chu kangaichat thupi pen ahijoi.
en: Your servant will just go over the Jordan with the king. Why should the king repay me with such a reward?
text:
2SA 19:36
Thadou: lengpa toh Jordan lui galkai ding bou chu kangaichat thupi pen ahijoi.
English: Your servant will just go over the Jordan with the king. Why should the king repay me with such a reward?

tcz: Chuteng le keima athidia kanu le kapa kivuina gamsunga kakinung le ding ahi. ahin hichehi nasohpa Kimham kachapa ahi. amahi kapakai kalengpa toh kilhon henlang chule nangman napeh nom chan chu aman kisan hen, ati.
en: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to you.”
text:
2SA 19:37
Thadou: Chuteng le keima athidia kanu le kapa kivuina gamsunga kakinung le ding ahi. ahin hichehi nasohpa Kimham kachapa ahi. amahi kapakai kalengpa toh kilhon henlang chule nangman napeh nom chan chu aman kisan hen, ati.
English: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to you.”

tcz: Chuin lengpa jong anom tan aphai, Kimham toh kachikhom ding chule aman adei nalam chan a kakithopi ding chule adei angai chan kabolpih ding ahi ati.
en: The king answered, “Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you. Whatever you request of me, that I will do for you.”
text:
2SA 19:38
Thadou: Chuin lengpa jong anom tan aphai, Kimham toh kachikhom ding chule aman adei nalam chan a kakithopi ding chule adei angai chan kabolpih ding ahi ati.
English: The king answered, “Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you. Whatever you request of me, that I will do for you.”

tcz: Hiti chun mipi jouse chun lengpa toh Jordan chu agalkai tao vin ahi. chuin David in Barzillai chu phatthei aboh a achop jou vin, Barzillai chu a inlam akile kit tan ahi.
en: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.
text:
2SA 19:39
Thadou: Hiti chun mipi jouse chun lengpa toh Jordan chu agalkai tao vin ahi. chuin David in Barzillai chu phatthei aboh a achop jou vin, Barzillai chu a inlam akile kit tan ahi.
English: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.

tcz: Chuin lengpan Kimham alhonpin Gilgal akhokel tan ahi. Judah sepai jouse le Israel seapi kehkhat in lampi ah analam touvin ahi.
en: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him. All the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.
text:
2SA 19:40
Thadou: Chuin lengpan Kimham alhonpin Gilgal akhokel tan ahi. Judah sepai jouse le Israel seapi kehkhat in lampi ah analam touvin ahi.
English: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him. All the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.

tcz: Ahin Israel mite jouse chu lengpa chungah akiphin taovin, Judah miten lengpa chu natom chahkheh un keihon nang nahin namite ahin Jordan nahung galkai nadiu vin kithopi nading phat eipipouve atiu vin ahi.
en: Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away, and brought the king and his household, over the Jordan, and all David’s men with him?”
text:
2SA 19:41
Thadou: Ahin Israel mite jouse chu lengpa chungah akiphin taovin, Judah miten lengpa chu natom chahkheh un keihon nang nahin namite ahin Jordan nahung galkai nadiu vin kithopi nading phat eipipouve atiu vin ahi.
English: Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away, and brought the king and his household, over the Jordan, and all David’s men with him?”

tcz: CHuin Judah miten adonbut un, lengpa hi keiho son chilhah mong ahi. epi dinga hichehin nasuh lunghang uham? Keihon lengpa akon neh ding ahilou leh thilphachom ema kakisan pouve atiu vin ahi.
en: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, “Because the king is a close relative to us. Why then are you angry about this matter? Have we eaten at all at the king’s cost? Or has he given us any gift?”
text:
2SA 19:42
Thadou: CHuin Judah miten adonbut un, lengpa hi keiho son chilhah mong ahi. epi dinga hichehin nasuh lunghang uham? Keihon lengpa akon neh ding ahilou leh thilphachom ema kakisan pouve atiu vin ahi.
English: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, “Because the king is a close relative to us. Why then are you angry about this matter? Have we eaten at all at the king’s cost? Or has he given us any gift?”

tcz: Ahin adanghon ahin donbut un Israel sungah phung soma um nalai e atiuve. Hijeh chun keihon lengpa chungah somvei jen nangho bol bangin thaneina kanei uve ati. Hitabang abol nadinga hi epi tha nanei uham? Keihohi kahi lou uham amasapen a amahi leng hisah kit ute tichu? Kinel nachu anung ama ah achijom jing in chule Juda mite chu Israel mite sangin aham ngaimo lheh un ahi.
en: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, “We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more claim to David than you. Why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king?” The words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
text:
2SA 19:43
Thadou: Ahin adanghon ahin donbut un Israel sungah phung soma um nalai e atiuve. Hijeh chun keihon lengpa chungah somvei jen nangho bol bangin thaneina kanei uve ati. Hitabang abol nadinga hi epi tha nanei uham? Keihohi kahi lou uham amasapen a amahi leng hisah kit ute tichu? Kinel nachu anung ama ah achijom jing in chule Juda mite chu Israel mite sangin aham ngaimo lheh un ahi.
English: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, “We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more claim to David than you. Why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king?” The words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

tcz: Hiche phatlai hin pan nabei mikhat ana um'in amapa chu amin Sheba akiti, ama hi apa min Bicri ahin, Benjamin phunga mi ahiye; Chule Sheba kitipa hin saki pengkul amut gingin lhang asamin aseitai, “David koma eihon chan ding inei pouvin, Jesse chapa koma goulo ding inei pouve’ Vo Israel mite, nangma nangma ponbuh kijot cheh tauvin,” ati.
en: There happened to be there a wicked fellow, whose name was Sheba the son of Bichri, a Benjamite; and he blew the trumpet, and said, “We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse. Every man to his tents, Israel!”
text:
2SA 20:1
Thadou: Hiche phatlai hin pan nabei mikhat ana um'in amapa chu amin Sheba akiti, ama hi apa min Bicri ahin, Benjamin phunga mi ahiye; Chule Sheba kitipa hin saki pengkul amut gingin lhang asamin aseitai, “David koma eihon chan ding inei pouvin, Jesse chapa koma goulo ding inei pouve’ Vo Israel mite, nangma nangma ponbuh kijot cheh tauvin,” ati.
English: There happened to be there a wicked fellow, whose name was Sheba the son of Bichri, a Benjamite; and he blew the trumpet, and said, “We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse. Every man to his tents, Israel!”

tcz: Hichejeh chun Israel miten abonchauvin David adalha soh hel tauvin, Bicri chapa Sheba nung ajui cheh tauve; ahivangin Judah miten alengpao chu lunglut tah in Jordan vadunga pat Jerusalem geiyin ajui lut peh tauvin ahi.
en: So all the men of Israel went up from following David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri; but the men of Judah joined with their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.
text:
2SA 20:2
Thadou: Hichejeh chun Israel miten abonchauvin David adalha soh hel tauvin, Bicri chapa Sheba nung ajui cheh tauve; ahivangin Judah miten alengpao chu lunglut tah in Jordan vadunga pat Jerusalem geiyin ajui lut peh tauvin ahi.
English: So all the men of Israel went up from following David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri; but the men of Judah joined with their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.

tcz: David chu Jerusalema ahung in ain ahung lhungtai, chuin lengpan in ngah dinga adalhah thaikem numei som ho chu abonchan aman khom soh keiyin in khat a akoikhom in, chule hiche in chu mi angah ding sepai akoiyin, neh le chah vang apenan, amaho hi avil tapon, aluppi tapoi. Hijeh chun amaho hi athi ni geiyuvin cha hing louvin aumsohkeiyun, meithai bangin aumsoh keitauve.
en: David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in custody and provided them with sustenance, but didn’t go in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.
text:
2SA 20:3
Thadou: David chu Jerusalema ahung in ain ahung lhungtai, chuin lengpan in ngah dinga adalhah thaikem numei som ho chu abonchan aman khom soh keiyin in khat a akoikhom in, chule hiche in chu mi angah ding sepai akoiyin, neh le chah vang apenan, amaho hi avil tapon, aluppi tapoi. Hijeh chun amaho hi athi ni geiyuvin cha hing louvin aumsohkeiyun, meithai bangin aumsoh keitauve.
English: David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in custody and provided them with sustenance, but didn’t go in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.

tcz: Hichun lengpan Amasa koma aseipeh in, “Nithum sungin Judah phunga mite abonchan kou khom soh keiyin lang, nangma tah jeng jong hikoma hin hung kikhomuvin,” ati.
en: Then the king said to Amasa, “Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be here present.”
text:
2SA 20:4
Thadou: Hichun lengpan Amasa koma aseipeh in, “Nithum sungin Judah phunga mite abonchan kou khom soh keiyin lang, nangma tah jeng jong hikoma hin hung kikhomuvin,” ati.
English: Then the king said to Amasa, “Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be here present.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Amasa jong Judah mite kou dingin akondoh tai; Ahinla ama dinga aphat kitep peh sangnga tamjo ahin la tan ahi.
en: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together, but he stayed longer than the set time which had been appointed to him.
text:
2SA 20:5
Thadou: Hijeh chun Amasa jong Judah mite kou dingin akondoh tai; Ahinla ama dinga aphat kitep peh sangnga tamjo ahin la tan ahi.
English: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together, but he stayed longer than the set time which had been appointed to him.

tcz: Chuphat’in David chun Abishai koma chun aseiyin, “Tua hi Sheba kitipa Bicri chapa khun Absalomin eibol nau sanga khohjoa eibol diu ahi; nangman napu lhacha sepaite khu kipuiyin lang anung delpeh in lang, gamantan achuti louva ahileh ama in kulpi kikaikhum khopi phabep akisah doh a eiho eisuh genthei diu ahi,” ati.
en: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants and pursue after him, lest he get himself fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.”
text:
2SA 20:6
Thadou: Chuphat’in David chun Abishai koma chun aseiyin, “Tua hi Sheba kitipa Bicri chapa khun Absalomin eibol nau sanga khohjoa eibol diu ahi; nangman napu lhacha sepaite khu kipuiyin lang anung delpeh in lang, gamantan achuti louva ahileh ama in kulpi kikaikhum khopi phabep akisah doh a eiho eisuh genthei diu ahi,” ati.
English: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants and pursue after him, lest he get himself fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.”

tcz: Abishai nung juiyin Joab jong Chereth mite jong, Peleth miho jong, chule mihat jouse jong abonchan akitol soh keiyuvin ahi. Chule amaho hi Jerusalem khopia konin Bicri chapa Sheba nung del dingin akondoh tauve.
en: Joab’s men went out after him with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
text:
2SA 20:7
Thadou: Abishai nung juiyin Joab jong Chereth mite jong, Peleth miho jong, chule mihat jouse jong abonchan akitol soh keiyuvin ahi. Chule amaho hi Jerusalem khopia konin Bicri chapa Sheba nung del dingin akondoh tauve.
English: Joab’s men went out after him with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

tcz: Amaho hi Gibeon khopia songpi lentah phung ahung geiyuvin Amasa jong amaho lamto dingin ahung tai. Hichun Joab hi sepai vonin akivonin, chule akongjanga chun konggah khat hin chemjam apaiyin akipoh in ahi; amasang lam’uva Amasa chibei bol din achepheiyin, hichun ahung kibalhun achemjam chu ahungkithol doh paitan ahi.
en: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.
text:
2SA 20:8
Thadou: Amaho hi Gibeon khopia songpi lentah phung ahung geiyuvin Amasa jong amaho lamto dingin ahung tai. Hichun Joab hi sepai vonin akivonin, chule akongjanga chun konggah khat hin chemjam apaiyin akipoh in ahi; amasang lam’uva Amasa chibei bol din achepheiyin, hichun ahung kibalhun achemjam chu ahungkithol doh paitan ahi.
English: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.

tcz: Hichun Joab hin Amasa koma hitin aseiye, “Sopi nadam dam hinam? tin adongin, hiti chun Joab hin Amasa chu akhut jetlam in amanin abengmul chun atuh chah jenge abeng achop ding bangin.
en: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
text:
2SA 20:9
Thadou: Hichun Joab hin Amasa koma hitin aseiye, “Sopi nadam dam hinam? tin adongin, hiti chun Joab hin Amasa chu akhut jetlam in amanin abengmul chun atuh chah jenge abeng achop ding bangin.
English: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

tcz: Hichea hi Amasa hin Joab in akhut veilam a chemjam akidop lam chu anahet lou ahiye; hiti hin Joab chun Amasa chua oipoh asutpih in; hichun avela sat kit louhel’in khatvei she she chun ama jong athidel jengin ahi. Chujouvin Joab le asopipa Abishai chun Bicri chapa Sheba nung chu adel pai pai tauve.
en: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body and shed out his bowels to the ground, and didn’t strike him again; and he died. Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.
text:
2SA 20:10
Thadou: Hichea hi Amasa hin Joab in akhut veilam a chemjam akidop lam chu anahet lou ahiye; hiti hin Joab chun Amasa chua oipoh asutpih in; hichun avela sat kit louhel’in khatvei she she chun ama jong athidel jengin ahi. Chujouvin Joab le asopipa Abishai chun Bicri chapa Sheba nung chu adel pai pai tauve.
English: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body and shed out his bowels to the ground, and didn’t strike him again; and he died. Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.

tcz: Chule Joab sepaite lah a mi khat chu Amasa long phunga aga dingin hitin aseiye, “Koi koi hijongle Joab panpia David dinga pang jouse chun Joab nung jui cheh hen,” ati.
en: One of Joab’s young men stood by him, and said, “He who favors Joab, and he who is for David, let him follow Joab!”
text:
2SA 20:11
Thadou: Chule Joab sepaite lah a mi khat chu Amasa long phunga aga dingin hitin aseiye, “Koi koi hijongle Joab panpia David dinga pang jouse chun Joab nung jui cheh hen,” ati.
English: One of Joab’s young men stood by him, and said, “He who favors Joab, and he who is for David, let him follow Joab!”

tcz: Hichun Amasa vang chu lamlen kim laitah a athisan lah a akisai saiyin alumden tai. Lampia hung mi jouse chun amudoh tengule ading cheh jiuvin, hijeh chun alongkom a dingpa chun miho jouse agahdin ji jeh u chun Amasa long chu akaimangin gamlah a apolut in pon akhu khumtan ahi.
en: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the highway. When the man saw that all the people stood still, he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a garment over him when he saw that everyone who came by him stood still.
text:
2SA 20:12
Thadou: Hichun Amasa vang chu lamlen kim laitah a athisan lah a akisai saiyin alumden tai. Lampia hung mi jouse chun amudoh tengule ading cheh jiuvin, hijeh chun alongkom a dingpa chun miho jouse agahdin ji jeh u chun Amasa long chu akaimangin gamlah a apolut in pon akhu khumtan ahi.
English: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the highway. When the man saw that all the people stood still, he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a garment over him when he saw that everyone who came by him stood still.

tcz: Chuin Amasa chu lamlen lailunga kona akai mang phat chun mipi sepai jouse jong chu Joab nung juiya Bicri chapa Sheba nung del dingin ache pai pai jeng tauve.
en: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
text:
2SA 20:13
Thadou: Chuin Amasa chu lamlen lailunga kona akai mang phat chun mipi sepai jouse jong chu Joab nung juiya Bicri chapa Sheba nung del dingin ache pai pai jeng tauve.
English: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

tcz: Sheba hin Israel mite phung tin anakhol soh keiyin, Bethema’acah gam'a Abel chan gei anajot man in ahi; hijeh chun Bicri mite jouse akikhom’uvin ama nung ajui soh hel tauve.
en: He went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, to Beth Maacah, and all the Berites. They were gathered together, and went also after him.
text:
2SA 20:14
Thadou: Sheba hin Israel mite phung tin anakhol soh keiyin, Bethema’acah gam'a Abel chan gei anajot man in ahi; hijeh chun Bicri mite jouse akikhom’uvin ama nung ajui soh hel tauve.
English: He went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, to Beth Maacah, and all the Berites. They were gathered together, and went also after him.

tcz: Hichun Joab to pang khom mite chu abonchan ahunguvin Bethma’acah gam'a Abel khoa chun Sheba aga’um tauve. Khopi um nan pal akaiyuvin, chule khopi pal chutoh kingat ton leipal chu akikhang doh jenge; Chuin amahon khopi pal chu phetjal dingin agouvin avojal pantauve.
en: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down.
text:
2SA 20:15
Thadou: Hichun Joab to pang khom mite chu abonchan ahunguvin Bethma’acah gam'a Abel khoa chun Sheba aga’um tauve. Khopi um nan pal akaiyuvin, chule khopi pal chutoh kingat ton leipal chu akikhang doh jenge; Chuin amahon khopi pal chu phetjal dingin agouvin avojal pantauve.
English: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down.

tcz: Hichun khopi sung langa konin numei miching tah khat hinmi ahinkouvin, “Ngaiyuvin, ngaiyuvin, keiman Joab chu kaki houpithei na dingin hinsei peh’uvin lang hilai muna hin hung hen, ati hintiuvin,” ahinti.
en: Then a wise woman cried out of the city, “Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come near here, that I may speak with you.’”
text:
2SA 20:16
Thadou: Hichun khopi sung langa konin numei miching tah khat hinmi ahinkouvin, “Ngaiyuvin, ngaiyuvin, keiman Joab chu kaki houpithei na dingin hinsei peh’uvin lang hilai muna hin hung hen, ati hintiuvin,” ahinti.
English: Then a wise woman cried out of the city, “Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come near here, that I may speak with you.’”

tcz: Hiphat chun Joab jong chu amanu koma chun ahungin ahileh, numeinu chun hitin aseipeh tai, “Nangma Jo’b nahim? atia ahileh aman jong adonbutin, “Ka hinai,” ati. Hichun numeinu jong chun Joab koma chun asei kit’in, “Nasohnu keima thusei ding hohi ngai temin,” atia ahileh; Joab in jong adonbut’in, “Kangai peh nai,” ati.
en: He came near to her; and the woman said, “Are you Joab?” He answered, “I am.” Then she said to him, “Hear the words of your servant.” He answered, “I’m listening.”
text:
2SA 20:17
Thadou: Hiphat chun Joab jong chu amanu koma chun ahungin ahileh, numeinu chun hitin aseipeh tai, “Nangma Jo’b nahim? atia ahileh aman jong adonbutin, “Ka hinai,” ati. Hichun numeinu jong chun Joab koma chun asei kit’in, “Nasohnu keima thusei ding hohi ngai temin,” atia ahileh; Joab in jong adonbut’in, “Kangai peh nai,” ati.
English: He came near to her; and the woman said, “Are you Joab?” He answered, “I am.” Then she said to him, “Hear the words of your servant.” He answered, “I’m listening.”

tcz: Hichun numei nun jong aseitai, Masanga gol lui laiyin tehse hon hitin ana sei uve, Abel khoa mi bou kidong ding ahi,’ tin aseiyiuve; hiti hin ipi thu hijong leh ana seichai jiuve.
en: Then she spoke, saying, “They used to say in old times, ‘They shall surely ask counsel at Abel,’ and so they settled a matter.
text:
2SA 20:18
Thadou: Hichun numei nun jong aseitai, Masanga gol lui laiyin tehse hon hitin ana sei uve, Abel khoa mi bou kidong ding ahi,’ tin aseiyiuve; hiti hin ipi thu hijong leh ana seichai jiuve.
English: Then she spoke, saying, “They used to say in old times, ‘They shall surely ask counsel at Abel,’ and so they settled a matter.

tcz: Hitia chu keima jong hi Israel mite lah a cham na bol ji le kitah taha hinkho mangmi khat chu kahi; hijeh chun tun nangman Israel chate din penna khopikhat hi thagamdingin nahol’e; ibola nangman Pakai goulo athilkeo hi hitia hi suh mang jeng ding nati ham?” ati.
en: I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up the LORD’s inheritance?”
text:
2SA 20:19
Thadou: Hitia chu keima jong hi Israel mite lah a cham na bol ji le kitah taha hinkho mangmi khat chu kahi; hijeh chun tun nangman Israel chate din penna khopikhat hi thagamdingin nahol’e; ibola nangman Pakai goulo athilkeo hi hitia hi suh mang jeng ding nati ham?” ati.
English: I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up the LORD’s inheritance?”

tcz: Hichun Joab jong chun adonbut’in, “Keiman itih hijong leh khopi kasuh mang louhel ding ahi ai!
en: Joab answered, “Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
text:
2SA 20:20
Thadou: Hichun Joab jong chun adonbut’in, “Keiman itih hijong leh khopi kasuh mang louhel ding ahi ai!
English: Joab answered, “Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

tcz: Nasei chu adih poi, ahin Ephraim gam'a thinglhang mi Bicri kitipa chapa khat amin Sheba kitipa chun David lengpa dou nan akhut alamtai; ama chu hinpe doh jenguvin, chutileh keima khopia kona hi kaki nungle jeng ding ahi,” ati. Chuphat’in numeinu jong chun adonbut paiyin, Joab koma chun aseitai, “Vetan, naseipa chu palvuma aluchang tansa hung kileh lha ding nakoma hung chu ding ahi,” atipeh-e.
en: The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David. Just deliver him, and I will depart from the city.” The woman said to Joab, “Behold, his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”
text:
2SA 20:21
Thadou: Nasei chu adih poi, ahin Ephraim gam'a thinglhang mi Bicri kitipa chapa khat amin Sheba kitipa chun David lengpa dou nan akhut alamtai; ama chu hinpe doh jenguvin, chutileh keima khopia kona hi kaki nungle jeng ding ahi,” ati. Chuphat’in numeinu jong chun adonbut paiyin, Joab koma chun aseitai, “Vetan, naseipa chu palvuma aluchang tansa hung kileh lha ding nakoma hung chu ding ahi,” atipeh-e.
English: The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David. Just deliver him, and I will depart from the city.” The woman said to Joab, “Behold, his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”

tcz: Numeinu chu alungthima achihna bang dungjuiyin khopi sunga anung chen mipi jouse koma chun hitin aga seitai. Chuin mihon Bicri chapa Sheba chu alu atanuvin, Joab koma chun agasep lut tauve. Chuphat in Joab chun saki pengkul chu amut paiyin, khopia kon chun akikhen cheh soh keiyun, mi jouse chu ama ama in cheh a ache tauve. Joab vang chu Jerusalema lengpa koma dingin ahung kile kit tai.
en: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. He blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.
text:
2SA 20:22
Thadou: Numeinu chu alungthima achihna bang dungjuiyin khopi sunga anung chen mipi jouse koma chun hitin aga seitai. Chuin mihon Bicri chapa Sheba chu alu atanuvin, Joab koma chun agasep lut tauve. Chuphat in Joab chun saki pengkul chu amut paiyin, khopia kon chun akikhen cheh soh keiyun, mi jouse chu ama ama in cheh a ache tauve. Joab vang chu Jerusalema lengpa koma dingin ahung kile kit tai.
English: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. He blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.

tcz: Hichun Joab kitipa hi Israel chate pumpi dinga gal lamkai lenpen chule sepai jouse chunga vaipo ahin, Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chu Chereth mite leh Peleth mite sepai ho lamkai vaipon apangin;
en: Now Joab was over all the army of Israel, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites,

tcz: Chule Adoniram kitipa chu engbol a um soh natonga pangho chunga chun vaihom in apangin, Ahilud chapa Jehoshaphat kitipa chu thuching lekha koiyin apangin,
en: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,
text:
2SA 20:24
Thadou: Chule Adoniram kitipa chu engbol a um soh natonga pangho chunga chun vaihom in apangin, Ahilud chapa Jehoshaphat kitipa chu thuching lekha koiyin apangin,
English: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,

tcz: Sheva chu lekha sun in apangin, Zedok le Abiathar chu thempun apang lhonin,
en: Sheva was scribe, Zadok and Abiathar were priests,
text:
2SA 20:25
Thadou: Sheva chu lekha sun in apangin, Zedok le Abiathar chu thempun apang lhonin,
English: Sheva was scribe, Zadok and Abiathar were priests,

tcz: Chule Jair mi Ira vang chu David din thempun anapang tan ahi.
en: and Ira the Jairite was chief minister to David.
text:
2SA 20:26
Thadou: Chule Jair mi Ira vang chu David din thempun anapang tan ahi.
English: and Ira the Jairite was chief minister to David.

tcz: Hitichun leng David khanglai hin kum thum sungin kel analhan, hijeh chun David jong chun iti ding ham, tin Pakai chu adong tan ahi, chuin Pakaiyin hitin ahinseiye, “Saul chun Gibeon mite anatha jeh a Saul le a insung mite chunga thisan so jal a themmona aum jeh ahi,” ati.
en: There was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David sought the face of the LORD. The LORD said, “It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death.”
text:
2SA 21:1
Thadou: Hitichun leng David khanglai hin kum thum sungin kel analhan, hijeh chun David jong chun iti ding ham, tin Pakai chu adong tan ahi, chuin Pakaiyin hitin ahinseiye, “Saul chun Gibeon mite anatha jeh a Saul le a insung mite chunga thisan so jal a themmona aum jeh ahi,” ati.
English: There was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David sought the face of the LORD. The LORD said, “It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death.”

tcz: Hijeh chun lengpan jong Gibeon mite chu akoukhom soh tai. chule Gibeon mite hi Israel chate sung peng mi ahipouvin Amor mite chia peng athimoh ho ahibouvui; chule amaho hi Israel chaten thalou dinga anasei vanguvin, Saul chun ami Israel chate leh Judah tedinga atom ngai na jeh-a amaho hi suhgam ding anati ahi.
en: The king called the Gibeonites and said to them (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites, and the children of Israel had sworn to them; and Saul sought to kill them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah);

tcz: David’in hiche Gibeon mite koma chun hitin aseiye, “Ipi kabol peh diu ham? Itobang mongin longman nasem peh theiyu leng nanghon hiche Pakai goulo mite hi phatthei naboh thei dingu ham?” tin adong tai.
en: and David said to the Gibeonites, “What should I do for you? And with what should I make atonement, that you may bless the LORD’s inheritance?”
text:
2SA 21:3
Thadou: David’in hiche Gibeon mite koma chun hitin aseiye, “Ipi kabol peh diu ham? Itobang mongin longman nasem peh theiyu leng nanghon hiche Pakai goulo mite hi phatthei naboh thei dingu ham?” tin adong tai.
English: and David said to the Gibeonites, “What should I do for you? And with what should I make atonement, that you may bless the LORD’s inheritance?”

tcz: Hichun Gibeon miten leng David koma chun aseiyun, “Keiho le Saul chule ainsung mite kah a thuhi dangka le sana peh a kihoucham na thei ding jong ahipoi, keihon Israel mite lah a mihem khat tou ka thalo diu thujong ahi deh poi,” atiuve. Chuin David chun asei kit’in, Ahile ken nang ho dinga ipipen ba ka bolpeh diu ham? Neiseipih un khuti leh ken nang ho dia kabolpih ding nahiu ve” ati.
en: The Gibeonites said to him, “It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel.” He said, “I will do for you whatever you say.”
text:
2SA 21:4
Thadou: Hichun Gibeon miten leng David koma chun aseiyun, “Keiho le Saul chule ainsung mite kah a thuhi dangka le sana peh a kihoucham na thei ding jong ahipoi, keihon Israel mite lah a mihem khat tou ka thalo diu thujong ahi deh poi,” atiuve. Chuin David chun asei kit’in, Ahile ken nang ho dinga ipipen ba ka bolpeh diu ham? Neiseipih un khuti leh ken nang ho dia kabolpih ding nahiu ve” ati.
English: The Gibeonites said to him, “It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel.” He said, “I will do for you whatever you say.”

tcz: Hiti chun amahon jong lengpa koma chun, “Israel gamsunga chen-mun ge-mun kanei lou helna diuva keiho suhgam nadia lunggel tohgon ananei chu Saul ahi atiuve.
en: They said to the king, “The man who consumed us and who plotted against us, that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel,
text:
2SA 21:5
Thadou: Hiti chun amahon jong lengpa koma chun, “Israel gamsunga chen-mun ge-mun kanei lou helna diuva keiho suhgam nadia lunggel tohgon ananei chu Saul ahi atiuve.
English: They said to the king, “The man who consumed us and who plotted against us, that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel,

tcz: Hijeh chun Saul chate pasal sagi ho chu keiho khut a neihin peu vin lang, chule keihon jong amaho chu Gibeon khoa Pakai molsang chunga khun Pakai angsunga ga khailih jeng’uvinge,” ati tauve. Chuphat in David jong chun, “chuti ahileh amaho mi sagi chu nape nau vinge,” atipeh tai.
en: let seven men of his sons be delivered to us, and we will hang them up to the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of the LORD.” The king said, “I will give them.”
text:
2SA 21:6
Thadou: Hijeh chun Saul chate pasal sagi ho chu keiho khut a neihin peu vin lang, chule keihon jong amaho chu Gibeon khoa Pakai molsang chunga khun Pakai angsunga ga khailih jeng’uvinge,” ati tauve. Chuphat in David jong chun, “chuti ahileh amaho mi sagi chu nape nau vinge,” atipeh tai.
English: let seven men of his sons be delivered to us, and we will hang them up to the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of the LORD.” The king said, “I will give them.”

tcz: Lengpan Saul chapa Jonathan chapa Mephibosheth vang chu ahing hoiye; ijeh-inem itileh amanin Pakaiya kihahsel na ana nei lhon ahi, David le Saul chapa Jonathan in kihahsel na ananeisa lhon ahitai.
en: But the king spared Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
text:
2SA 21:7
Thadou: Lengpan Saul chapa Jonathan chapa Mephibosheth vang chu ahing hoiye; ijeh-inem itileh amanin Pakaiya kihahsel na ana nei lhon ahi, David le Saul chapa Jonathan in kihahsel na ananeisa lhon ahitai.
English: But the king spared Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

tcz: Chuin lengpan Aiah chanu Saul jinu Rizpah chapate ni Armoni le Mephibosheth amanin, Saul chanu Merab chapate mi nga jong amanin, amaho hi Merab hin Meholath mipa Barzillai chapa Adriel kitipa chutoh ahinlhon ahi;
en: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Merab the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.

tcz: David’in mi sagi hi Gibeon mite khut a apedoh tai; chuin amahon jong hiche pasal sagi ho chu molsang chunga Pakai angsunga akhaiyuvin, mi sagi jenchu athigam tauve. Amaho atha niu chu sakol chang-at kipat til ni chu anahi.
en: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites; and they hanged them on the mountain before the LORD, and all seven of them fell together. They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.
text:
2SA 21:9
Thadou: David’in mi sagi hi Gibeon mite khut a apedoh tai; chuin amahon jong hiche pasal sagi ho chu molsang chunga Pakai angsunga akhaiyuvin, mi sagi jenchu athigam tauve. Amaho atha niu chu sakol chang-at kipat til ni chu anahi.
English: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites; and they hanged them on the mountain before the LORD, and all seven of them fell together. They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.

tcz: Chuin Rizpah kitinu amin Aiah chanu hin khaodip pon akilah in, songpi chung khat’a akisil khaodip pon chu aphan, chang at kipat til a pat chun vana kona chuh go ahung juh kahsen apha pha jenge; sun teng jongle chunga leng vachate aponpha chunga chun atousahpon, chubang ma chun jan teng jongle gamsa ho chu ponpha chunga chun alutsah deh pon ahi.
en: Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water poured on them from the sky. She allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day, nor the animals of the field by night.
text:
2SA 21:10
Thadou: Chuin Rizpah kitinu amin Aiah chanu hin khaodip pon akilah in, songpi chung khat’a akisil khaodip pon chu aphan, chang at kipat til a pat chun vana kona chuh go ahung juh kahsen apha pha jenge; sun teng jongle chunga leng vachate aponpha chunga chun atousahpon, chubang ma chun jan teng jongle gamsa ho chu ponpha chunga chun alutsah deh pon ahi.
English: Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water poured on them from the sky. She allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day, nor the animals of the field by night.

tcz: Chuin Saul thaikemnu Aiah chanu Rizpah thilbol umchan chu David koma aseipeh phat’un,
en: David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
text:
2SA 21:11
Thadou: Chuin Saul thaikemnu Aiah chanu Rizpah thilbol umchan chu David koma aseipeh phat’un,
English: David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

tcz: David jong achen Saul leh achapa Jonathan gu-lheng lhon chengse beh chu Jabesh-gilead kho haosate koma agalan ahi. Chule hiche haosa hohin, hiche gu-lheng lhon ho hi Philistine miten Gilboa molsang chunga Saul ajo chung uva, Philistine mihon Saul leh achapa Jonathan Beth-shan kholai dunga akhai nauva aga guh doh-u anahi.
en: So David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh Gilead, who had stolen them from the street of Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hanged them in the day that the Philistines killed Saul in Gilboa;

tcz: David chun hiche muna kon chun Saul leh achapa Jonathan gu-lheng lhonho chu agapon, chuin mihon amani banga kikhailih jouse gubuh chengse chutoh akoikhom tauvin ahi.
en: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged.
text:
2SA 21:13
Thadou: David chun hiche muna kon chun Saul leh achapa Jonathan gu-lheng lhonho chu agapon, chuin mihon amani banga kikhailih jouse gubuh chengse chutoh akoikhom tauvin ahi.
English: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged.

tcz: Chuin lengpan gu-lheng lhon ho chu Benjamin gamsunga Zela khoa Saul pa Kish lhan khuh a avuidiu vn thupeh aneitan ahi. Chule miho hin lengpa thupeh bang bangin abolsoh keiyuvin ahi. Hiche nunghin Pathenin gamsunga kel lhah chu akichai sah tan ahi.
en: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father; and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.
text:
2SA 21:14
Thadou: Chuin lengpan gu-lheng lhon ho chu Benjamin gamsunga Zela khoa Saul pa Kish lhan khuh a avuidiu vn thupeh aneitan ahi. Chule miho hin lengpa thupeh bang bangin abolsoh keiyuvin ahi. Hiche nunghin Pathenin gamsunga kel lhah chu akichai sah tan ahi.
English: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father; and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.

tcz: Hichun Philistine mite chun Israel chate dounan gal ahinbol uvin ahileh, David lengpa jong chu asepaite toh kilhonin gal akonsuh kit’in Philistine mite dounan gal agasat tauve. Hichun David jong chu atha achol lheh jengin ahi.
en: The Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. David grew faint;

tcz: Chuti chun gal muna chun Rapha gal hatpa chilhah a mi khat amin Ishbi-benob kiti pa hi apangin, ama chu atengcha jeng jong agih dan sum-eng jeng shekel ja khat alhingin, chule amahin chemjam thah lih khat akonga akikon, David chu tha jeng dingin ahin gotan ahi.
en: and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, he being armed with a new sword, thought he would kill David.
text:
2SA 21:16
Thadou: Chuti chun gal muna chun Rapha gal hatpa chilhah a mi khat amin Ishbi-benob kiti pa hi apangin, ama chu atengcha jeng jong agih dan sum-eng jeng shekel ja khat alhingin, chule amahin chemjam thah lih khat akonga akikon, David chu tha jeng dingin ahin gotan ahi.
English: and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, he being armed with a new sword, thought he would kill David.

tcz: Ahin Zeruiah chapa Abishai chun David ahung panpin, Philistinete gal-hatpa chu adel khumin athat tan ahi. Chuphat’in David chu asepaiten ajadauvin, “Nangma tukal keiho toh gal ikon khom louhel diu ahitai, achuti loule namoh thilo ding ahin, Israel chate lah a meivah banga navah hi mit jeng thei ahi,”atiuve.
en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, “Don’t go out with us to battle any more, so that you don’t quench the lamp of Israel.”
text:
2SA 21:17
Thadou: Ahin Zeruiah chapa Abishai chun David ahung panpin, Philistinete gal-hatpa chu adel khumin athat tan ahi. Chuphat’in David chu asepaiten ajadauvin, “Nangma tukal keiho toh gal ikon khom louhel diu ahitai, achuti loule namoh thilo ding ahin, Israel chate lah a meivah banga navah hi mit jeng thei ahi,”atiuve.
English: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, “Don’t go out with us to battle any more, so that you don’t quench the lamp of Israel.”

tcz: Hiche jou nunghin Gob muna Philistinete toh gal kisat na aum kittai; hichea hin Hushah mi Sibbecai kitipa chun Philistine gal hat miho chilhahte lah a mi khat Saph kitipa chu athat kit’e.
en: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.
text:
2SA 21:18
Thadou: Hiche jou nunghin Gob muna Philistinete toh gal kisat na aum kittai; hichea hin Hushah mi Sibbecai kitipa chun Philistine gal hat miho chilhahte lah a mi khat Saph kitipa chu athat kit’e.
English: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.

tcz: Gob mun ma ma’a chun Philistinete ma ma chutoh gal kisat na ana um kit un ahi. hichea jong hin Bethlehem khoa mi Elhanan kiti Jair chapa chun Gath mi Goliath athat kit’in ahi, Goliath tenglung chu thingtum tejen aphan ahi.
en: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite’s brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
text:
2SA 21:19
Thadou: Gob mun ma ma’a chun Philistinete ma ma chutoh gal kisat na ana um kit un ahi. hichea jong hin Bethlehem khoa mi Elhanan kiti Jair chapa chun Gath mi Goliath athat kit’in ahi, Goliath tenglung chu thingtum tejen aphan ahi.
English: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite’s brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

tcz: Chujouvin Gath khoa gal ahung soh kit tai; chule galmuna chun mi adung sangtah khat ana um'in, amapa chu akhut phang lang khatcheh a chun akhutjung gup gup akeh in ahi; chule akengphang lang khat gel a jong chun akengjung gup gup cheh akeh in ahi; abonchan akhut jungle akengjung agoma som ni le li alhinge; chule ama jong hi galhat mihangte chilhah khatma anahin ahi.
en: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was born to the giant.
text:
2SA 21:20
Thadou: Chujouvin Gath khoa gal ahung soh kit tai; chule galmuna chun mi adung sangtah khat ana um'in, amapa chu akhut phang lang khatcheh a chun akhutjung gup gup akeh in ahi; chule akengphang lang khat gel a jong chun akengjung gup gup cheh akeh in ahi; abonchan akhut jungle akengjung agoma som ni le li alhinge; chule ama jong hi galhat mihangte chilhah khatma anahin ahi.
English: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was born to the giant.

tcz: Ahin aman Israel mite athu angailouva, aseiset phat chun David sopipa shimea chapa Jonathan in athat tan ahi.
en: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.
text:
2SA 21:21
Thadou: Ahin aman Israel mite athu angailouva, aseiset phat chun David sopipa shimea chapa Jonathan in athat tan ahi.
English: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.

tcz: Philistines mi hicheng li hi Gath khoa gal hang mihatte son leh chilhah ahiuve; ahin abonchauvin David le asepaite khut a ana thisoh kei tauvin ahi.
en: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
text:
2SA 21:22
Thadou: Philistines mi hicheng li hi Gath khoa gal hang mihatte son leh chilhah ahiuve; ahin abonchauvin David le asepaite khut a ana thisoh kei tauvin ahi.
English: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

tcz: Hitichun Pakaiyin amelmate jousea kon leh Saul khut’a kona ana huhhing jal in David in hichela hi Pakai henga anasan ahi.
en: David spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul,
text:
2SA 22:1
Thadou: Hitichun Pakaiyin amelmate jousea kon leh Saul khut’a kona ana huhhing jal in David in hichela hi Pakai henga anasan ahi.
English: David spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul,

tcz: Hitin lacheng aseme, “Pakai chu keima dingin Kasongpi leh kakulpi chule eihuhhingpa ahi,
en: and he said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;

tcz: Ka-Pathen leh kasongpi Kakiselna nahi; Kapho le eihuhhinga kasakhia pang, Kakulpi pal le kakisel na nahin, Eihuhhingpa nahin, pumhat’a kinona lah a jong nei huhdoh ji'e.
en: God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.
text:
2SA 22:3
Thadou: Ka-Pathen leh kasongpi Kakiselna nahi; Kapho le eihuhhinga kasakhia pang, Kakulpi pal le kakisel na nahin, Eihuhhingpa nahin, pumhat’a kinona lah a jong nei huhdoh ji'e.
English: God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.

tcz: Vahchoi dinga lomtah Pakai henga kataoyin, chule Kamelmate a konin huhhingna kachang tai.
en: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
text:
2SA 22:4
Thadou: Vahchoi dinga lomtah Pakai henga kataoyin, chule Kamelmate a konin huhhingna kachang tai.
English: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.

tcz: “Ajeh chu thina luipin eilon khuntan, Manthah na lam jousen eilon khum tai;
en: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

tcz: Noimigam khaoguiyin eihen tan, kamasanga thina ding thang akikam’e.
en: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.
text:
2SA 22:6
Thadou: Noimigam khaoguiyin eihen tan, kamasanga thina ding thang akikam’e.
English: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.

tcz: Ahin “Kagenthei pet’in Pakai henga ka taovin. Ka-Pathen koma chun kataovin ahi. Pathen houin a aman kataona asang jin, hichea chun anabenga kataona alut ji'e.
en: In my distress, I called on the LORD. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.
text:
2SA 22:7
Thadou: Ahin “Kagenthei pet’in Pakai henga ka taovin. Ka-Pathen koma chun kataovin ahi. Pathen houin a aman kataona asang jin, hichea chun anabenga kataona alut ji'e.
English: In my distress, I called on the LORD. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.

tcz: Hichun leiset akinuh nuh jin ling akihot tan ahi; Van todap khompi jouse jong akiling soh hel jenge; Pathen alung han jeh chun lingpi ahin hot jengin ahi.
en: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
text:
2SA 22:8
Thadou: Hichun leiset akinuh nuh jin ling akihot tan ahi; Van todap khompi jouse jong akiling soh hel jenge; Pathen alung han jeh chun lingpi ahin hot jengin ahi.
English: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

tcz: Chule Anah hom sung tenia konin meikhu ahung kitung doh in, chule akamsung a konin mi bahgam thei mei akonge; Meial deuje ju Pathena konin ahung kitung doh jenge.
en: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
text:
2SA 22:9
Thadou: Chule Anah hom sung tenia konin meikhu ahung kitung doh in, chule akamsung a konin mi bahgam thei mei akonge; Meial deuje ju Pathena konin ahung kitung doh jenge.
English: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

tcz: Aman van mun jouse asonkun jengin ahung kumlhai, Akengto noiya muthim lhangkhal akiheh jenge.
en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
text:
2SA 22:10
Thadou: Aman van mun jouse asonkun jengin ahung kumlhai, Akengto noiya muthim lhangkhal akiheh jenge.
English: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

tcz: Pathen Cherub chunga atouvin alenge, huipia akijap’a alen akimui.
en: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.
text:
2SA 22:11
Thadou: Pathen Cherub chunga atouvin alenge, huipia akijap’a alen akimui.
English: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.

tcz: Aman akimvela muthim lhangkhal akihehsah jin, chule Aloupi na meilhang thuh tah twipin akikhange.
en: He made darkness a shelter around himself, gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
text:
2SA 22:12
Thadou: Aman akimvela muthim lhangkhal akihehsah jin, chule Aloupi na meilhang thuh tah twipin akikhange.
English: He made darkness a shelter around himself, gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

tcz: A-angsung vahchan thethu lah a konin meikong amleng lung ahung leng doh dohjie.
en: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.
text:
2SA 22:13
Thadou: A-angsung vahchan thethu lah a konin meikong amleng lung ahung leng doh dohjie.
English: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.

tcz: Pakaiyin van'a konin van akithinsah jin Hatchungnungpen chun o-thongin thu aseiye.
en: The LORD thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.
text:
2SA 22:14
Thadou: Pakaiyin van'a konin van akithinsah jin Hatchungnungpen chun o-thongin thu aseiye.
English: The LORD thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.

tcz: Aman thalpi ahinkap doh jin adoudal te athe cheh ji'e. Kol a phen a kithe jal lah lah jenge.
en: He sent out arrows and scattered them, lightning and confused them.
text:
2SA 22:15
Thadou: Aman thalpi ahinkap doh jin adoudal te athe cheh ji'e. Kol a phen a kithe jal lah lah jenge.
English: He sent out arrows and scattered them, lightning and confused them.

tcz: Chuteng leh twikhanglen togei geiyin akimu theiyin, Vannoi bulpi khom jouse jong akimuthei ye; Pakaiyin ahinpho jia Anah homsunga ahu alha teng chuti chun aumjie.
en: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by the LORD’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
text:
2SA 22:16
Thadou: Chuteng leh twikhanglen togei geiyin akimu theiyin, Vannoi bulpi khom jouse jong akimuthei ye; Pakaiyin ahinpho jia Anah homsunga ahu alha teng chuti chun aumjie.
English: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by the LORD’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

tcz: Van chungsang langa konin aman eihin huhdoh jin jin, Twipi kinong a konin eiladoh ji'e.
en: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.
text:
2SA 22:17
Thadou: Van chungsang langa konin aman eihin huhdoh jin jin, Twipi kinong a konin eiladoh ji'e.
English: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.

tcz: Chule kamelma hattah pa akonin eihuhdoh jin, Eihotbol tea konin jong eihuhdoh ji'e; Ijeh-inem itileh hitobang miho hi kei din ahatval jiuve.
en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
text:
2SA 22:18
Thadou: Chule kamelma hattah pa akonin eihuhdoh jin, Eihotbol tea konin jong eihuhdoh ji'e; Ijeh-inem itileh hitobang miho hi kei din ahatval jiuve.
English: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.

tcz: Ka hamset ni jongle amaho hin eihin del khum jeng jiuve; Hijong leh Pakai in keima eikithopi jing nai.
en: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.
text:
2SA 22:19
Thadou: Ka hamset ni jongle amaho hin eihin del khum jeng jiuve; Hijong leh Pakai in keima eikithopi jing nai.
English: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.

tcz: Pakaiyin keima munlen tah a eipui doh jin, Eikipapi jeh in eihuhdoh jin ahi.
en: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
text:
2SA 22:20
Thadou: Pakaiyin keima munlen tah a eipui doh jin, Eikipapi jeh in eihuhdoh jin ahi.
English: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

tcz: Lamdih a kachon jing jeh in Pakaiyin kipaman eipen, Chule kakhut te nin thil dih jeng abol jing jeh in kipaman eipei.
en: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.
text:
2SA 22:21
Thadou: Lamdih a kachon jing jeh in Pakaiyin kipaman eipen, Chule kakhut te nin thil dih jeng abol jing jeh in kipaman eipei.
English: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman Pakai lamlhah na jouse kajui jingin, agilou bol’in ka Pathenchu kada lha khapoi.
en: For I have kept the LORD’s ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
text:
2SA 22:22
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman Pakai lamlhah na jouse kajui jingin, agilou bol’in ka Pathenchu kada lha khapoi.
English: For I have kept the LORD’s ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh ama chonna dan jouse chu Kamaiya aki lang jing jengin, Hijeh chun ama chon na dan jousea jong Keima kavah mang khapoi.
en: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn’t depart from them.
text:
2SA 22:23
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itileh ama chonna dan jouse chu Kamaiya aki lang jing jengin, Hijeh chun ama chon na dan jousea jong Keima kavah mang khapoi.
English: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn’t depart from them.

tcz: Ama angsunga keima nolna beiyin kaum jingin, themmo na dingah kakivengdoh jing jenge.
en: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
text:
2SA 22:24
Thadou: Ama angsunga keima nolna beiyin kaum jingin, themmo na dingah kakivengdoh jing jenge.
English: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

tcz: Hijeh chun keima dihna jeh hin Pakaiyin kipaman eipen, chule ama mitmua themmona kanei lou jeh hin kipa man eipei.
en: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.
text:
2SA 22:25
Thadou: Hijeh chun keima dihna jeh hin Pakaiyin kipaman eipen, chule ama mitmua themmona kanei lou jeh hin kipa man eipei.
English: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.

tcz: “Mi kitah ho hengah nang jong naki tahna namusah in, chule nolna bei mi hengah nang jong nolna bei mi nahina namusah jin ahi.
en: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.
text:
2SA 22:26
Thadou: “Mi kitah ho hengah nang jong naki tahna namusah in, chule nolna bei mi hengah nang jong nolna bei mi nahina namusah jin ahi.
English: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.

tcz: Milung thengho hengah nalungthen na namusah in, chule milung thim thenglou ho hengah nangma alungtheng lou bangin naumjin ahi.
en: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
text:
2SA 22:27
Thadou: Milung thengho hengah nalungthen na namusah in, chule milung thim thenglou ho hengah nangma alungtheng lou bangin naumjin ahi.
English: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

tcz: Chuti chun nangman mi kineosah techu nahuhdoh jin, mi kiletsah te vang chu suhnem din nave lhih jinge.
en: You will save the afflicted people, but your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.
text:
2SA 22:28
Thadou: Chuti chun nangman mi kineosah techu nahuhdoh jin, mi kiletsah te vang chu suhnem din nave lhih jinge.
English: You will save the afflicted people, but your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.

tcz: O Pakai nangma hi keiya din kathaomei nahin, Ka-Pathen nangin kei dia muthim jouse nasal vahe.
en: For you are my lamp, LORD. The LORD will light up my darkness.
text:
2SA 22:29
Thadou: O Pakai nangma hi keiya din kathaomei nahin, Ka-Pathen nangin kei dia muthim jouse nasal vahe.
English: For you are my lamp, LORD. The LORD will light up my darkness.

tcz: Nangma panpi najala keiman sepai hon khat jong kasuh mang ding, Chule Ka-Pathen vanga palvum jong ka chop khup ding ahi.
en: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
text:
2SA 22:30
Thadou: Nangma panpi najala keiman sepai hon khat jong kasuh mang ding, Chule Ka-Pathen vanga palvum jong ka chop khup ding ahi.
English: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

tcz: Hitichun Pathen hi alamlhah na jouse achamkim soh keiyin, Pakaiyin mi athutep jong agui lhung ji'e; Chule Ama koma kiselte dinginAma hi ompho ahijinge.
en: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
text:
2SA 22:31
Thadou: Hitichun Pathen hi alamlhah na jouse achamkim soh keiyin, Pakaiyin mi athutep jong agui lhung ji'e; Chule Ama koma kiselte dinginAma hi ompho ahijinge.
English: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh Pathen kiti chu koi dang ham? Pakai kiti chu ahin; Chujongle songpi kiti chu koipen ham? I-Pathenu amabou chu ahiye.
en: For who is God, besides the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God?
text:
2SA 22:32
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itileh Pathen kiti chu koi dang ham? Pakai kiti chu ahin; Chujongle songpi kiti chu koipen ham? I-Pathenu amabou chu ahiye.
English: For who is God, besides the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God?

tcz: Hiche Pathen hi keima kisel na dettah ahin, kalam lhah na jouse jong phatah in eisem peh tai.
en: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.
text:
2SA 22:33
Thadou: Hiche Pathen hi keima kisel na dettah ahin, kalam lhah na jouse jong phatah in eisem peh tai.
English: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.

tcz: Hichun Pathen in kakeng phang teni jong sajuhpi keng abahsah-in, gamken lah dung jenga jong det tah in eidin sah theiye.
en: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me on my high places.
text:
2SA 22:34
Thadou: Hichun Pathen in kakeng phang teni jong sajuhpi keng abahsah-in, gamken lah dung jenga jong det tah in eidin sah theiye.
English: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me on my high places.

tcz: Chule kakhut teni jong galsatje eihil them in, Hijeh chun kabanjang tenin sum-eng thalpi aheh konjin ahi.
en: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
text:
2SA 22:35
Thadou: Chule kakhut teni jong galsatje eihil them in, Hijeh chun kabanjang tenin sum-eng thalpi aheh konjin ahi.
English: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

tcz: Nangman na mi huhhingna ompho neipen, chujongle nagalvon chun keima eikhu khum jin; nakithopi nachun eisuloupi jin ahi.
