en: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.
text:
2SA 22:36
Thadou: Nangman na mi huhhingna ompho neipen, chujongle nagalvon chun keima eikhu khum jin; nakithopi nachun eisuloupi jin ahi.
English: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.

tcz: Kanoiya kapansat na ding mun lentah neihoi peh-in, hijeh chun kakengto teni kalho nal tapoi.
en: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.
text:
2SA 22:37
Thadou: Kanoiya kapansat na ding mun lentah neihoi peh-in, hijeh chun kakengto teni kalho nal tapoi.
English: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.

tcz: Ka melmate nung kadel jin kathat gam ji'e; chule aboncha kasuh gamhel masangin kahung kileji poi.
en: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.
text:
2SA 22:38
Thadou: Ka melmate nung kadel jin kathat gam ji'e; chule aboncha kasuh gamhel masangin kahung kileji poi.
English: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.

tcz: Hitichun abonchauvin kasat chap hel jin koima athoudoh aum tapoi, hitichun kakengto noiya akijam chap tauvin ahi.
en: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.
text:
2SA 22:39
Thadou: Hitichun abonchauvin kasat chap hel jin koima athoudoh aum tapoi, hitichun kakengto noiya akijam chap tauvin ahi.
English: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangin galsat din tha neipen, eihin del khumpa chu kanoiya nalupsah tai.
en: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
text:
2SA 22:40
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangin galsat din tha neipen, eihin del khumpa chu kanoiya nalupsah tai.
English: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

tcz: Hiti chun kamasanga kamel mate najam sah sah jin, eihot bolte chu keiman kathat gam ji tai.
en: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
text:
2SA 22:41
Thadou: Hiti chun kamasanga kamel mate najam sah sah jin, eihot bolte chu keiman kathat gam ji tai.
English: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

tcz: Panpi ngaiya apen pen vanguvin ahuhhing diu koima aumpon, Pakai henga atao vang uvin aman adonbut dehpoi.
en: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.
text:
2SA 22:42
Thadou: Panpi ngaiya apen pen vanguvin ahuhhing diu koima aumpon, Pakai henga atao vang uvin aman adonbut dehpoi.
English: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.

tcz: Keiman kholai dunga leivui bangin kachilngem ngemin, chule kholai dunga bonlhoh bangin kachot phan kachilgoiyie.
en: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.
text:
2SA 22:43
Thadou: Keiman kholai dunga leivui bangin kachilngem ngemin, chule kholai dunga bonlhoh bangin kachot phan kachilgoiyie.
English: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.

tcz: “Gal eibol khum mitea kon in jong nei huhdoh chun, namtin vaipi chunga alenpenin neisemin, kahet khah louhel miten jong keima kin aboltauve.
en: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.
text:
2SA 22:44
Thadou: “Gal eibol khum mitea kon in jong nei huhdoh chun, namtin vaipi chunga alenpenin neisemin, kahet khah louhel miten jong keima kin aboltauve.
English: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.

tcz: Gamdang mite jong kineosah tah-in kahenga ahungun, kathusei ajah jah ule kathun anung jiuve.
en: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me.
text:
2SA 22:45
Thadou: Gamdang mite jong kineosah tah-in kahenga ahungun, kathusei ajah jah ule kathun anung jiuve.
English: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me.

tcz: Gamdang mite chu alungu aneo jin akisel nao kulsunga konin kichatah in kithing pum pumin ahung potdoh jiuve.
en: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.
text:
2SA 22:46
Thadou: Gamdang mite chu alungu aneo jin akisel nao kulsunga konin kichatah in kithing pum pumin ahung potdoh jiuve.
English: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.

tcz: “Pakai hingjing pa, Nunnom hen kasongpi chu,; Choi-at’in umjing hen Ka-Pathen, eihuhhing na songpi chu.
en: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,
text:
2SA 22:47
Thadou: “Pakai hingjing pa, Nunnom hen kasongpi chu,; Choi-at’in umjing hen Ka-Pathen, eihuhhing na songpi chu.
English: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,

tcz: Phu eilah sah a Pathen chun, mijouse chu keima noiya asonkun soh hel in ahi.
en: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,
text:
2SA 22:48
Thadou: Phu eilah sah a Pathen chun, mijouse chu keima noiya asonkun soh hel in ahi.
English: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,

tcz: Kamelmate lah jenga jong eihuh doh jia, chule nangin kaki doupi kamelmate chunga neichoi sang ji'e; Pumhat jenga mi nokhum mite lah a konin jong nangman neihuh doh jing jin ahi.
en: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
text:
2SA 22:49
Thadou: Kamelmate lah jenga jong eihuh doh jia, chule nangin kaki doupi kamelmate chunga neichoi sang ji'e; Pumhat jenga mi nokhum mite lah a konin jong nangman neihuh doh jing jin ahi.
English: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

tcz: “Hiche jeh hin vo Pakai, namtin la ah navahchoi yinge, chule namin vahchoila sange.
en: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
text:
2SA 22:50
Thadou: “Hiche jeh hin vo Pakai, namtin la ah navahchoi yinge, chule namin vahchoila sange.
English: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

tcz: nangman Lenga natun keima hi galjona loupe tah neipin, thao anusa kei hi long louvin eingailui; David le kachilhah te din atonsot atonsot geiya dingin,” ati.
en: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”
text:
2SA 22:51
Thadou: nangman Lenga natun keima hi galjona loupe tah neipin, thao anusa kei hi long louvin eingailui; David le kachilhah te din atonsot atonsot geiya dingin,” ati.
English: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”

tcz: Hiche hohi ahi, leng David’in achaina lama anasei doh thucheng ho chu: Ajeh chu Jesse chapa David’in thusoh ding asei, choisanga umpan thusoh ding asei chu; Jacob Pathen thao nusa, Israel chate lah a lathem penpa chu.
en: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:
text:
2SA 23:1
Thadou: Hiche hohi ahi, leng David’in achaina lama anasei doh thucheng ho chu: Ajeh chu Jesse chapa David’in thusoh ding asei, choisanga umpan thusoh ding asei chu; Jacob Pathen thao nusa, Israel chate lah a lathem penpa chu.
English: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:

tcz: “Pakai Lhagaovin keiya konin thu aseiyin, ama thuho kakamsunga aum in ahi.
en: “The LORD’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.
text:
2SA 23:2
Thadou: “Pakai Lhagaovin keiya konin thu aseiyin, ama thuho kakamsunga aum in ahi.
English: “The LORD’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.

tcz: Chule Israel Pathenin thu aseiyin, chujongle Israel songpi chun kakoma thu ahin seitai; Thudih'a vaihompa chun Pathen jana neipum in vai ahom in ahi.
en: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, ‘One who rules over men righteously, who rules in the fear of God,
text:
2SA 23:3
Thadou: Chule Israel Pathenin thu aseiyin, chujongle Israel songpi chun kakoma thu ahin seitai; Thudih'a vaihompa chun Pathen jana neipum in vai ahom in ahi.
English: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, ‘One who rules over men righteously, who rules in the fear of God,

tcz: Hijeh a chu ama chu achunguva jingkah khovah bangin ahungvah jin, Twimei kailou ni jingkah a jing ninou ahungso abange; chule leiset chunga hamhing le loudong phat-thei sah gotwi hungju lha tobang ahi.
en: shall be as the light of the morning when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.’
text:
2SA 23:4
Thadou: Hijeh a chu ama chu achunguva jingkah khovah bangin ahungvah jin, Twimei kailou ni jingkah a jing ninou ahungso abange; chule leiset chunga hamhing le loudong phat-thei sah gotwi hungju lha tobang ahi.
English: shall be as the light of the morning when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.’

tcz: Hitobanga hi keima Insung jong Pathena lhan hilou ham? Ijeh-inem itileh Pathenin atonsot geiya dingin kitepna khat eisempin, thil ijakai hi abih bih chan aumsah soh keiye. Ajeh chu Pathen chun Kei deichat jouse le eipanpi thei jouse akhansah lou ding ham?
en: Isn’t my house so with God? Yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is all my salvation and all my desire. Won’t he make it grow?
text:
2SA 23:5
Thadou: Hitobanga hi keima Insung jong Pathena lhan hilou ham? Ijeh-inem itileh Pathenin atonsot geiya dingin kitepna khat eisempin, thil ijakai hi abih bih chan aumsah soh keiye. Ajeh chu Pathen chun Kei deichat jouse le eipanpi thei jouse akhansah lou ding ham?
English: Isn’t my house so with God? Yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is all my salvation and all my desire. Won’t he make it grow?

tcz: Ahin Pathen hepha lou te vang chu ling le khao kisat tan a kipai mangsa tobang ahiuve, Ijeh-inem itileh amaho hi khut’a kichom khom kit thei louhel ding ahiuve.
en: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can’t be taken with the hand.
text:
2SA 23:6
Thadou: Ahin Pathen hepha lou te vang chu ling le khao kisat tan a kipai mangsa tobang ahiuve, Ijeh-inem itileh amaho hi khut’a kichom khom kit thei louhel ding ahiuve.
English: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can’t be taken with the hand.

tcz: Hitobang miho thamkha ding jong chun thih le tengcha akipat ding ahin, abonchauva hi beihela meiya kigouvam hel ding ahiuve,” ati.
en: The man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear. They will be utterly burned with fire in their place.”
text:
2SA 23:7
Thadou: Hitobang miho thamkha ding jong chun thih le tengcha akipat ding ahin, abonchauva hi beihela meiya kigouvam hel ding ahiuve,” ati.
English: The man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear. They will be utterly burned with fire in their place.”

tcz: David lengpa sepaite lah a dinga galhat mite chu aminu hicheng hi ahiuve: Joshobeam kitipa chu Hacmonite mi ahin, amahi mi thum lah a alamkai ahi; chule ama hin mi jaget jen tengchan akisat pin abonchan khatvei yin athat gam hel’in ahi.
en: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; he was called Adino the Eznite, who killed eight hundred at one time.
text:
2SA 23:8
Thadou: David lengpa sepaite lah a dinga galhat mite chu aminu hicheng hi ahiuve: Joshobeam kitipa chu Hacmonite mi ahin, amahi mi thum lah a alamkai ahi; chule ama hin mi jaget jen tengchan akisat pin abonchan khatvei yin athat gam hel’in ahi.
English: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; he was called Adino the Eznite, who killed eight hundred at one time.

tcz: Chule ama ban a mihat mithum holah a khat kitpa chu ahile Ahoah chilhah, Dodai chapa Eleazar ahi; ama hi Philistinete galbol dia ahung kikhop’u chun David toh ana pang khomin, chuin Israel chate chu Philistinete masanga akinungtol tauve.
en: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel had gone away.
text:
2SA 23:9
Thadou: Chule ama ban a mihat mithum holah a khat kitpa chu ahile Ahoah chilhah, Dodai chapa Eleazar ahi; ama hi Philistinete galbol dia ahung kikhop’u chun David toh ana pang khomin, chuin Israel chate chu Philistinete masanga akinungtol tauve.
English: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel had gone away.

tcz: Eleazar hi akipan in abantha acholdeh kahsen Philistinete asat chap chap jengin akhut jeng jong chu achemjam chutoh thisanin atomchah jengin ahi; hiche nikho jong chun Pakaiyin Israel chate minthang tah in gal ajosah tai; chule Eleazar nunga chun sepaite thilong chom khom mai maiyin ahung kitol’uve.
en: He arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and the LORD worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take plunder.
text:
2SA 23:10
Thadou: Eleazar hi akipan in abantha acholdeh kahsen Philistinete asat chap chap jengin akhut jeng jong chu achemjam chutoh thisanin atomchah jengin ahi; hiche nikho jong chun Pakaiyin Israel chate minthang tah in gal ajosah tai; chule Eleazar nunga chun sepaite thilong chom khom mai maiyin ahung kitol’uve.
English: He arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and the LORD worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take plunder.

tcz: Chule Eleazar ban a mihat athum chan napa chu Shammah ahin, ama hi Harar mi Agee chapa ahiye. Amahi Lehi khoa chun Philistinete galbol din ahung kikhomuvin ahileh, akikhop na’u tolhang dunga chun louthul adimset’in akeh’e; Ahin chimun a chun Israel chate chu Philistinete gin nan ajamtauve.
en: After him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.
text:
2SA 23:11
Thadou: Chule Eleazar ban a mihat athum chan napa chu Shammah ahin, ama hi Harar mi Agee chapa ahiye. Amahi Lehi khoa chun Philistinete galbol din ahung kikhomuvin ahileh, akikhop na’u tolhang dunga chun louthul adimset’in akeh’e; Ahin chimun a chun Israel chate chu Philistinete gin nan ajamtauve.
English: After him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.

tcz: Ahivang in Shammah hi det tah in apangin, louthul lei laiya chun apang jinge, hiti hin hatah in apang jingin, Philistinete chu athat that jengin ahileh Pakaiyin jong loupi tah in Shammah chu gal ajosah tai.
en: But he stood in the middle of the plot and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD worked a great victory.
text:
2SA 23:12
Thadou: Ahivang in Shammah hi det tah in apangin, louthul lei laiya chun apang jinge, hiti hin hatah in apang jingin, Philistinete chu athat that jengin ahileh Pakaiyin jong loupi tah in Shammah chu gal ajosah tai.
English: But he stood in the middle of the plot and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD worked a great victory.

tcz: Haosa mi somthum lah a mithum chu achesuh uvin, chang-at phat don hin Adullam songko phunga chun David henga ahunguvin ahileh, Rephaim phaiya chun Philistine sepai hon khat’in ngah mun anasem’uve.
en: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
text:
2SA 23:13
Thadou: Haosa mi somthum lah a mithum chu achesuh uvin, chang-at phat don hin Adullam songko phunga chun David henga ahunguvin ahileh, Rephaim phaiya chun Philistine sepai hon khat’in ngah mun anasem’uve.
English: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

tcz: Hiche pet hin David chu kulpi sunga anapange; chujongle Philistine mite sepaiho chu Bethlehem khopia ana pansa uvin ahi.
en: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
text:
2SA 23:14
Thadou: Hiche pet hin David chu kulpi sunga anapange; chujongle Philistine mite sepaiho chu Bethlehem khopia ana pansa uvin ahi.
English: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.

tcz: Dangchah geovin David chun aseiyin, “Ohe, mihem khat cha behin Bethlehem khopi kulpi kelkot phunga twikula konin twi eihin dop peh hen lang don din eihung petave leh!” ati.
en: David said longingly, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
text:
2SA 23:15
Thadou: Dangchah geovin David chun aseiyin, “Ohe, mihem khat cha behin Bethlehem khopi kulpi kelkot phunga twikula konin twi eihin dop peh hen lang don din eihung petave leh!” ati.
English: David said longingly, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

tcz: Hichun hiche mihat mithumho hin Philistinete ngahmun kimlai tah chu atum keh jenguvin Bethlehem khopi kulpi kelkot phunga twikula twi chu agathal’uvin, David henga ahin dop peh tauve. Ahin David chun donjo talouvin atwi chu Pakai lhai nan tol'a asung lhan;
en: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate and took it and brought it to David; but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD.

tcz: Chulehitin asei tai, “Vo Pakai, keiman hiche twi hi don hih hel inge. Iti ahinkho phal ngam hel a hiche twi thal a che ho thisan tobang hiche hi keiman kadon ding ham?” ati. Hiche jeh chun David’in twi chu adonta poi. Thil hijatpi hi hiche mihat mihangsan mithum ho chun anabol’u ahi.
en: He said, “Be it far from me, LORD, that I should do this! Isn’t this the blood of the men who risked their lives to go?” Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
text:
2SA 23:17
Thadou: Chulehitin asei tai, “Vo Pakai, keiman hiche twi hi don hih hel inge. Iti ahinkho phal ngam hel a hiche twi thal a che ho thisan tobang hiche hi keiman kadon ding ham?” ati. Hiche jeh chun David’in twi chu adonta poi. Thil hijatpi hi hiche mihat mihangsan mithum ho chun anabol’u ahi.
English: He said, “Be it far from me, LORD, that I should do this! Isn’t this the blood of the men who risked their lives to go?” Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

tcz: Chujouvin Joab sopipa, Zeruiah chapa Abishai chu mihat som thum lah a lamkaiya anapang ahi. Chule amahin mihem jathum jen chu atengcha akipat’in akisat pin abonchau chun athat gam hel in, mithum ho tilouvin ama jong chu aminthang pen in apangtai.
en: Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. He lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
text:
2SA 23:18
Thadou: Chujouvin Joab sopipa, Zeruiah chapa Abishai chu mihat som thum lah a lamkaiya anapang ahi. Chule amahin mihem jathum jen chu atengcha akipat’in akisat pin abonchau chun athat gam hel in, mithum ho tilouvin ama jong chu aminthang pen in apangtai.
English: Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. He lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

tcz: Mihat som thum lah a jong ama hi aminthang pen tah a pang ahi. Hijeh chun ama hi amaho gal lamkaiyin jong apange; mihat thumho lah a ajaolou vang'in.
en: Wasn’t he most honorable of the three? Therefore he was made their captain. However he wasn’t included as one of the three.
text:
2SA 23:19
Thadou: Mihat som thum lah a jong ama hi aminthang pen tah a pang ahi. Hijeh chun ama hi amaho gal lamkaiyin jong apange; mihat thumho lah a ajaolou vang'in.
English: Wasn’t he most honorable of the three? Therefore he was made their captain. However he wasn’t included as one of the three.

tcz: Kabzeel khoa mi Jehoiada chapa Benaiah kitipa jong chu gal-hang tah mi ahin, chule thil nasa tah tah boldoh jeng thei ahi; amahin Moab mi sakei tobang ni athat’in, chujouvin nikhat hi buhbang lhah nin achesuh in kokhuh sung khat’a sakei bahkai khat agathat kit’e.
en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.
text:
2SA 23:20
Thadou: Kabzeel khoa mi Jehoiada chapa Benaiah kitipa jong chu gal-hang tah mi ahin, chule thil nasa tah tah boldoh jeng thei ahi; amahin Moab mi sakei tobang ni athat’in, chujouvin nikhat hi buhbang lhah nin achesuh in kokhuh sung khat’a sakei bahkai khat agathat kit’e.
English: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.

tcz: Benaiah hin Egypt mi pasal tha hattah le melhoi tah khat jong athat’e. Egypt mipa chun akhut’a tengcha khat akichoi ahin, Benaiah chun tenggol khat akichoiyin ajongsuh jengin, hichun Egypt mipa khuta konin atengcha chu alah peh in ama tengcha ma ma chun hiche Egypt mipa chu athat tai.
en: He killed a huge Egyptian, and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
text:
2SA 23:21
Thadou: Benaiah hin Egypt mi pasal tha hattah le melhoi tah khat jong athat’e. Egypt mipa chun akhut’a tengcha khat akichoi ahin, Benaiah chun tenggol khat akichoiyin ajongsuh jengin, hichun Egypt mipa khuta konin atengcha chu alah peh in ama tengcha ma ma chun hiche Egypt mipa chu athat tai.
English: He killed a huge Egyptian, and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

tcz: Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chun thil hijat hi ana bol in, mihat mi thum lah a chun aman jong minthan na aneitan ahi.
en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.
text:
2SA 23:22
Thadou: Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chun thil hijat hi ana bol in, mihat mi thum lah a chun aman jong minthan na aneitan ahi.
English: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.

tcz: Chule ama jong hi mihat somthum lah a aminthang lheh tan, ahivangin mihat thumho lah a chun ajao napoi ahivang in David chun amapa hi ama tahsa vengtup sepai lah a lamkai din apansah tai.
en: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three. David set him over his guard.
text:
2SA 23:23
Thadou: Chule ama jong hi mihat somthum lah a aminthang lheh tan, ahivangin mihat thumho lah a chun ajao napoi ahivang in David chun amapa hi ama tahsa vengtup sepai lah a lamkai din apansah tai.
English: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three. David set him over his guard.

tcz: Mihat mi somthum lah a chun Joab sopipa Asahel jong khat anahi. Elhanan ahin, ama hi Bethlehem khoa Dodo chapa ahi.
en: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty: Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
text:
2SA 23:24
Thadou: Mihat mi somthum lah a chun Joab sopipa Asahel jong khat anahi. Elhanan ahin, ama hi Bethlehem khoa Dodo chapa ahi.
English: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty: Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

tcz: Harod khoa mi Shammah ahin, Harod kho mi ma ma Elika ahin,
en: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
text:
2SA 23:25
Thadou: Harod khoa mi Shammah ahin, Harod kho mi ma ma Elika ahin,
English: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

tcz: Pelon khoa mi Helez ahin, Tekoa khoa mi Ikkesh chapa Ira ahin,
en: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
text:
2SA 23:26
Thadou: Pelon khoa mi Helez ahin, Tekoa khoa mi Ikkesh chapa Ira ahin,
English: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

tcz: Anathoth khoa mi Abiezer ahin, Hushah khoa mi Sibbecai ahin,
en: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
text:
2SA 23:27
Thadou: Anathoth khoa mi Abiezer ahin, Hushah khoa mi Sibbecai ahin,
English: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

tcz: Ahoah khoa mi Zalmon ahin, Netophah khoa mi Maharai ahin,
en: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
text:
2SA 23:28
Thadou: Ahoah khoa mi Zalmon ahin, Netophah khoa mi Maharai ahin,
English: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

tcz: Netophah khoa mi Heled chapa Baanah ahin, Benjamin mite Gibeah khoa mi Ribai chapa Ithai ahin,
en: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
text:
2SA 23:29
Thadou: Netophah khoa mi Heled chapa Baanah ahin, Benjamin mite Gibeah khoa mi Ribai chapa Ithai ahin,
English: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

tcz: Pirathon khoa mi Benaiah ahin, Nahale - Gaash luidung lama kona hung Hurai ahin,
en: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.
text:
2SA 23:30
Thadou: Pirathon khoa mi Benaiah ahin, Nahale - Gaash luidung lama kona hung Hurai ahin,
English: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.

tcz: Arabah khoa kona Abi-albon ahin, Bahurim khoa mi Azmaveth ahin,
en: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
text:
2SA 23:31
Thadou: Arabah khoa kona Abi-albon ahin, Bahurim khoa mi Azmaveth ahin,
English: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

tcz: Shaalbon khoa mi Eliahba ahin, Jashen le Jonathan chapate ahi uvin,
en: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
text:
2SA 23:32
Thadou: Shaalbon khoa mi Eliahba ahin, Jashen le Jonathan chapate ahi uvin,
English: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

tcz: Harar khoa mi Shagee ahin, Harar khoa akon mi mama Sharar chapa Ahiam ahin,
en: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,
text:
2SA 23:33
Thadou: Harar khoa mi Shagee ahin, Harar khoa akon mi mama Sharar chapa Ahiam ahin,
English: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,

tcz: Maacah khoa mi Ahasbai chapa Eliphelet ahin, Giloh khoa mi Ahithophel chapa Eliam ahin,
en: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
text:
2SA 23:34
Thadou: Maacah khoa mi Ahasbai chapa Eliphelet ahin, Giloh khoa mi Ahithophel chapa Eliam ahin,
English: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

tcz: Carmel khoa mi Hezro ahin, Arba khoa mi Paarai ahin,
en: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
text:
2SA 23:35
Thadou: Carmel khoa mi Hezro ahin, Arba khoa mi Paarai ahin,
English: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

tcz: Zobah khoa mi Nathan chapa Igal ahin Gad mi Bani ahin,
en: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
text:
2SA 23:36
Thadou: Zobah khoa mi Nathan chapa Igal ahin Gad mi Bani ahin,
English: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

tcz: Ammon mi Zelek ahin, Beeroth khoa mi Naharai ahin, Zeruiah chapa Joab galvonpoa pang pa ahin,
en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
text:
2SA 23:37
Thadou: Ammon mi Zelek ahin, Beeroth khoa mi Naharai ahin, Zeruiah chapa Joab galvonpoa pang pa ahin,
English: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

tcz: Jattir khoa mi Ira ahin, Jattir kho mi ma ma Gareb ahin,
en: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
text:
2SA 23:38
Thadou: Jattir khoa mi Ira ahin, Jattir kho mi ma ma Gareb ahin,
English: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

tcz: Hit mi Uriah ahin, abonchauvin somthum le sagi alhinguvin ahi.
en: and Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.
text:
2SA 23:39
Thadou: Hit mi Uriah ahin, abonchauvin somthum le sagi alhinguvin ahi.
English: and Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.

tcz: Israel chate chunga Pakai Pathen ahung lung hang kittan , hijeh chun aman David chu atil doh’in amaho dou nan, hitin thu aseiye, “Nangma chen lang Israel chate le Judah mite gasim toh tan,” ati.
en: Again the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”
text:
2SA 24:1
Thadou: Israel chate chunga Pakai Pathen ahung lung hang kittan , hijeh chun aman David chu atil doh’in amaho dou nan, hitin thu aseiye, “Nangma chen lang Israel chate le Judah mite gasim toh tan,” ati.
English: Again the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”

tcz: Hijeh chun lengpan Joab le apanpi sepai lamkai ho koma aseiyin, ‘Sahlam Dan apet lhanglam Beersheba chan geiya cheng Israel phung jouse gakhol toh soh keiyun lang mihem ijat mong mong hitamti kahet doh thei na dingin mihem jat gasim tauvin,” ati.
en: The king said to Joab the captain of the army, who was with him, “Now go back and forth through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and count the people, that I may know the sum of the people.”
text:
2SA 24:2
Thadou: Hijeh chun lengpan Joab le apanpi sepai lamkai ho koma aseiyin, ‘Sahlam Dan apet lhanglam Beersheba chan geiya cheng Israel phung jouse gakhol toh soh keiyun lang mihem ijat mong mong hitamti kahet doh thei na dingin mihem jat gasim tauvin,” ati.
English: The king said to Joab the captain of the army, who was with him, “Now go back and forth through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and count the people, that I may know the sum of the people.”

tcz: Ahivangin Joab chun lengpa koma chun aseiyin, “Pakai na Pathenin mipi ho chu aja ajan punsah jeng tah ta, kapu lengpan namit a namu jeng nah chu me; ipi dinga kapu lengpan hitobang pihi bol ding nagot hitam?” ati.
en: Joab said to the king, “Now may the LORD your God add to the people, however many they may be, one hundred times; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king delight in this thing?”
text:
2SA 24:3
Thadou: Ahivangin Joab chun lengpa koma chun aseiyin, “Pakai na Pathenin mipi ho chu aja ajan punsah jeng tah ta, kapu lengpan namit a namu jeng nah chu me; ipi dinga kapu lengpan hitobang pihi bol ding nagot hitam?” ati.
English: Joab said to the king, “Now may the LORD your God add to the people, however many they may be, one hundred times; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king delight in this thing?”

tcz: Ahinlah lengpan amaho chu mi agasim toh diuvin aseitan ahi, hijeh chun Joab le sepai lamkaite chu Israel mipite simtoh dingin lengpa angsunga a konin avaikon doh tauve.
en: Notwithstanding, the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army. Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel.
text:
2SA 24:4
Thadou: Ahinlah lengpan amaho chu mi agasim toh diuvin aseitan ahi, hijeh chun Joab le sepai lamkaite chu Israel mipite simtoh dingin lengpa angsunga a konin avaikon doh tauve.
English: Notwithstanding, the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army. Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel.

tcz: Chuin amahon amasapen in Jordan vadung chu apal galkaiyun lhanglam khopi phaicham, Aroer khopi Gad lam jot na ah chun aponbuh asongun,chujou vin Jazer langa achi pei taove.
en: They passed over the Jordan and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and to Jazer;

tcz: Chujouvin Hit mite gamsunga Gilead kho le Kadesh khopi ahung geitauve; chuin Dan khopia ahunguvin Dan khopia konin Sidon lang ajong kit tauve.
en: then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi; and they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon,
text:
2SA 24:6
Thadou: Chujouvin Hit mite gamsunga Gilead kho le Kadesh khopi ahung geitauve; chuin Dan khopia ahunguvin Dan khopia konin Sidon lang ajong kit tauve.
English: then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi; and they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon,

tcz: Chuin Tyre gammang lah ahinjot’uvin Hivi mite khopi jouse le Canaan mite khopi jousea ahung uvin ahi. achainan Beersheba khopi Judah gamsunga Negeb a chun anga uve.
en: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beersheba.
text:
2SA 24:7
Thadou: Chuin Tyre gammang lah ahinjot’uvin Hivi mite khopi jouse le Canaan mite khopi jousea ahung uvin ahi. achainan Beersheba khopi Judah gamsunga Negeb a chun anga uve.
English: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beersheba.

tcz: Hitia hi gamsung pumpi ahin kholsoh kei phat’uvin, lhako le ni somni alhin donin Jerusalem khopi ahung kilekit tauvin ahi.
en: So when they had gone back and forth through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
text:
2SA 24:8
Thadou: Hitia hi gamsung pumpi ahin kholsoh kei phat’uvin, lhako le ni somni alhin donin Jerusalem khopi ahung kilekit tauvin ahi.
English: So when they had gone back and forth through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

tcz: Chuin Joab chun mihem jat asim nau mijat chu lengpa henga apelut tai; hichea kisim doh Israel mijat chu pasal galsat a chemjam choithei cheh sang jaget alhingin, chule Judah mi chu sang janga alhinguvin ahi.
en: Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king; and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
text:
2SA 24:9
Thadou: Chuin Joab chun mihem jat asim nau mijat chu lengpa henga apelut tai; hichea kisim doh Israel mijat chu pasal galsat a chemjam choithei cheh sang jaget alhingin, chule Judah mi chu sang janga alhinguvin ahi.
English: Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king; and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

tcz: Hitichun mipi asim soh phat’uvin David chu alungthima akisih behseh jengin, hijeh chun David injong Pakai henga taona anei jin hitin aseitai, “Kathil bol chung changa hin keima melsa tah in ka chonse tai; hijongle tuhin vo Pakai, nahenga kahung tao ahi, nasohpa keima themmona jouse hi lamang tan; ajeh chu keiman ngol hoitah hin thil kanabol tai,” ati.
en: David’s heart struck him after he had counted the people. David said to the LORD, “I have sinned greatly in that which I have done. But now, the LORD, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.”
text:
2SA 24:10
Thadou: Hitichun mipi asim soh phat’uvin David chu alungthima akisih behseh jengin, hijeh chun David injong Pakai henga taona anei jin hitin aseitai, “Kathil bol chung changa hin keima melsa tah in ka chonse tai; hijongle tuhin vo Pakai, nahenga kahung tao ahi, nasohpa keima themmona jouse hi lamang tan; ajeh chu keiman ngol hoitah hin thil kanabol tai,” ati.
English: David’s heart struck him after he had counted the people. David said to the LORD, “I have sinned greatly in that which I have done. But now, the LORD, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.”

tcz: Chuin ajing jingkah matah in David chu ajingtho a ahileh David dinga amitva neiya pangpa Gad themgaopa henga chun Pakaiyin hitin thu ahinseiye.
en: When David rose up in the morning, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,
text:
2SA 24:11
Thadou: Chuin ajing jingkah matah in David chu ajingtho a ahileh David dinga amitva neiya pangpa Gad themgaopa henga chun Pakaiyin hitin thu ahinseiye.
English: When David rose up in the morning, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,

tcz: “Chen lang David koma hitin gaseitan tin Pakaiyin aseiye, “Keiman na chunga katoh ding thil thum ka peh ding, hiche thil thumho lah a chu nangman na ngap chat pen pen khat chu kilhen in hichu nachunga kahin lhun sah ding ahi,” tin aseiye, gatin, ati.
en: “Go and speak to David, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”
text:
2SA 24:12
Thadou: “Chen lang David koma hitin gaseitan tin Pakaiyin aseiye, “Keiman na chunga katoh ding thil thum ka peh ding, hiche thil thumho lah a chu nangman na ngap chat pen pen khat chu kilhen in hichu nachunga kahin lhun sah ding ahi,” tin aseiye, gatin, ati.
English: “Go and speak to David, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

tcz: Hijeh chun Gad jong David koma ahungin hitin aseitai, “Nagamsunga kumthum sunga kel lhah ding nanop em? Lhathum sunga nagalte masanga najamle lea amahon nadel le le diu nadei em? Ahiloule nagamsunga nithum gamna hise nasatah lansah ding nanop em? Tun geltoh soh keiyin lang eihin solpa henga kaseipeh ding chu hoiche pen ham, dindetna neiyin,” ati.
en: So Gad came to David, and told him, saying, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ pestilence in your land? Now answer, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.”
text:
2SA 24:13
Thadou: Hijeh chun Gad jong David koma ahungin hitin aseitai, “Nagamsunga kumthum sunga kel lhah ding nanop em? Lhathum sunga nagalte masanga najamle lea amahon nadel le le diu nadei em? Ahiloule nagamsunga nithum gamna hise nasatah lansah ding nanop em? Tun geltoh soh keiyin lang eihin solpa henga kaseipeh ding chu hoiche pen ham, dindetna neiyin,” ati.
English: So Gad came to David, and told him, saying, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ pestilence in your land? Now answer, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.”

tcz: Chuphat in David chun Gad koma hitin aseiye, “Kalung agim beh seh jeng tai; ami khotona lentah ahinai, hijeh chun Pakai khut’a kilehlut jeng taute; mihem khut’a vang neilhah lutsah hih hel’in,” atipeh e.
en: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let us fall now into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are great. Let me not fall into man’s hand.”
text:
2SA 24:14
Thadou: Chuphat in David chun Gad koma hitin aseiye, “Kalung agim beh seh jeng tai; ami khotona lentah ahinai, hijeh chun Pakai khut’a kilehlut jeng taute; mihem khut’a vang neilhah lutsah hih hel’in,” atipeh e.
English: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let us fall now into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are great. Let me not fall into man’s hand.”

tcz: Hijehchun Pakaiyin Israel chate chunga jingkah a pat aphat kitep sungsen gamna hise ahin lansah tai; hichea hin sahlam Dan khoa pat lhanglam Beersheba chan geiyin Israel mipi lah a mihem sang som sagi athiuvin ahi.
en: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the appointed time; and seventy thousand men died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba.
text:
2SA 24:15
Thadou: Hijehchun Pakaiyin Israel chate chunga jingkah a pat aphat kitep sungsen gamna hise ahin lansah tai; hichea hin sahlam Dan khoa pat lhanglam Beersheba chan geiyin Israel mipi lah a mihem sang som sagi athiuvin ahi.
English: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the appointed time; and seventy thousand men died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba.

tcz: Hichun Vantil chun Jerusalem jong suhgam dinga agot’a akhut alap phat chun Pakaiyin thilse abol ding chu alung akhel’in Vantil mi sugama pangpa koma chun hitin aseitai, “Aphaset tai, tun nakhut umthim sah tan,” ati. Hichepet a hi Pakai Vantil chu Jebus mipa Araunah changvohna mun changphol koma ana ding ahitai.
en: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” The LORD’s angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
text:
2SA 24:16
Thadou: Hichun Vantil chun Jerusalem jong suhgam dinga agot’a akhut alap phat chun Pakaiyin thilse abol ding chu alung akhel’in Vantil mi sugama pangpa koma chun hitin aseitai, “Aphaset tai, tun nakhut umthim sah tan,” ati. Hichepet a hi Pakai Vantil chu Jebus mipa Araunah changvohna mun changphol koma ana ding ahitai.
English: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” The LORD’s angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

tcz: Chuin David jong chun mi sugama pang Vantil chu amudoh phat in Pakai koma hitin aseiye, “Vetan, keima kachonsen, gilou tah in keiman thil kabol tai; ahinla hiche mihohi kelngoi banga emahelou ahibouve ipi abolset anei mongu ham? Nahenga katao ahiye, keima chung le ka inkote chunga nakhut hin lhah jon,” tin aseitai.
en: David spoke to the LORD when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, “Behold, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me, and against my father’s house.”
text:
2SA 24:17
Thadou: Chuin David jong chun mi sugama pang Vantil chu amudoh phat in Pakai koma hitin aseiye, “Vetan, keima kachonsen, gilou tah in keiman thil kabol tai; ahinla hiche mihohi kelngoi banga emahelou ahibouve ipi abolset anei mongu ham? Nahenga katao ahiye, keima chung le ka inkote chunga nakhut hin lhah jon,” tin aseitai.
English: David spoke to the LORD when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, “Behold, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me, and against my father’s house.”

tcz: Hiche nikho hin Gad chu David henga ahungin akoma hitin aseiye, “Chetouvin lang, Jebus mipa Araunah changphol koma khun Pakai dingin maicham khat gasemtan,” ati.
en: Gad came that day to David and said to him, “Go up, build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”
text:
2SA 24:18
Thadou: Hiche nikho hin Gad chu David henga ahungin akoma hitin aseiye, “Chetouvin lang, Jebus mipa Araunah changphol koma khun Pakai dingin maicham khat gasemtan,” ati.
English: Gad came that day to David and said to him, “Go up, build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Gad thu apeh bangin David jong chu achetou vin agabol tan ahi.
en: David went up according to the saying of Gad, as the LORD commanded.
text:
2SA 24:19
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin Gad thu apeh bangin David jong chu achetou vin agabol tan ahi.
English: David went up according to the saying of Gad, as the LORD commanded.

tcz: Chuin Araunah chu akiheijin agahven ahileh lengpa le asohte ama kom lam jona ahungu chu amun ahi; chuphat’in Araunah jong chu apotdoh pai paiyin lengpa chu agajabol’in tol'a amai asulut’tan ahi.
en: Araunah looked out, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him. Then Araunah went out and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
text:
2SA 24:20
Thadou: Chuin Araunah chu akiheijin agahven ahileh lengpa le asohte ama kom lam jona ahungu chu amun ahi; chuphat’in Araunah jong chu apotdoh pai paiyin lengpa chu agajabol’in tol'a amai asulut’tan ahi.
English: Araunah looked out, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him. Then Araunah went out and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

tcz: Chu jongle Araunah chun hitin aseiye, “Ipi ding pen tah a kapu lengpa nangma nasoh kei koma nahung jeng hitam?” atileh; David chun adonbut’in “Mipi chunga gamna hise hi akitol mangthei na dinga nangma changphol hi chohdoh a hikoma hi Pakai henga maicham khat semdoh ding kati ahi,” ati.
en: Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?” David said, “To buy your threshing floor, to build an altar to the LORD, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”
text:
2SA 24:21
Thadou: Chu jongle Araunah chun hitin aseiye, “Ipi ding pen tah a kapu lengpa nangma nasoh kei koma nahung jeng hitam?” atileh; David chun adonbut’in “Mipi chunga gamna hise hi akitol mangthei na dinga nangma changphol hi chohdoh a hikoma hi Pakai henga maicham khat semdoh ding kati ahi,” ati.
English: Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?” David said, “To buy your threshing floor, to build an altar to the LORD, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

tcz: Hichun Araunah jong chun hitin aseiye, “Kilah jengin kapu lengpa, chule nangin pha nasah lam pi a chun mang jengin; chule bongchal teni jong pumgo thiltoa naman dingin hikoma hin aum lhone; chujongle chang huina kangkui ho leh bongchal teni namkol jong hikoma hin aumnai; hiche hohi meithinga nati ding ahi.
en: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.
text:
2SA 24:22
Thadou: Hichun Araunah jong chun hitin aseiye, “Kilah jengin kapu lengpa, chule nangin pha nasah lam pi a chun mang jengin; chule bongchal teni jong pumgo thiltoa naman dingin hikoma hin aum lhone; chujongle chang huina kangkui ho leh bongchal teni namkol jong hikoma hin aumnai; hiche hohi meithinga nati ding ahi.
English: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.

tcz: Vo lengpa, Keima Araunah kitipa hin lengpa dinga thil ejakai katodoh jeng ding ahi,” ati. Chujongleh Araunah chun lengpa koma hitin jong aseiye, “Pakai na-Pathenin nataona chu nasan peh teitei hen,” ati.
en: All this, O king, does Araunah give to the king.” Araunah said to the king, “May the LORD your God accept you.”
text:
2SA 24:23
Thadou: Vo lengpa, Keima Araunah kitipa hin lengpa dinga thil ejakai katodoh jeng ding ahi,” ati. Chujongleh Araunah chun lengpa koma hitin jong aseiye, “Pakai na-Pathenin nataona chu nasan peh teitei hen,” ati.
English: All this, O king, does Araunah give to the king.” Araunah said to the king, “May the LORD your God accept you.”

tcz: Ahivang in lengpan Araunah koma chun hitin aseiye, “Ahipoi, keiman na changphol man chu kapeh a kachoh ding ahibouve; aman kapeh louhel thil chu keiman Pakai ka-Pathen henga pumgo thiltoa kato lou ding ahi,” ati. Hiti hin David chun changphol leh bongchal teni chu dangka shekel som ngan akichoh tai.
en: The king said to Araunah, “No, but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God which cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
text:
2SA 24:24
Thadou: Ahivang in lengpan Araunah koma chun hitin aseiye, “Ahipoi, keiman na changphol man chu kapeh a kachoh ding ahibouve; aman kapeh louhel thil chu keiman Pakai ka-Pathen henga pumgo thiltoa kato lou ding ahi,” ati. Hiti hin David chun changphol leh bongchal teni chu dangka shekel som ngan akichoh tai.
English: The king said to Araunah, “No, but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God which cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

tcz: Hichun lengpa David chun Pakai anga maicham khat asemin, pumgo thilto le chamna kilhaina thilto atoh tan ahi. hichun Pakaiyin jong gamsung dinga a taona chu asanpeh in Israel chate chunga konin gamna hise lang chu akitol mangsah tan ahi.
en: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was entreated for the land, and the plague was removed from Israel.
text:
2SA 24:25
Thadou: Hichun lengpa David chun Pakai anga maicham khat asemin, pumgo thilto le chamna kilhaina thilto atoh tan ahi. hichun Pakaiyin jong gamsung dinga a taona chu asanpeh in Israel chate chunga konin gamna hise lang chu akitol mangsah tan ahi.
English: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was entreated for the land, and the plague was removed from Israel.

tcz: David lengpa jong ateh lheh tan, pon lum ijat asilpeh vang un, ama chu alum jou mong mong tapon ahi.
en: Now King David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.
text:
1KI 1:1
Thadou: David lengpa jong ateh lheh tan, pon lum ijat asilpeh vang un, ama chu alum jou mong mong tapon ahi.
English: Now King David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.

tcz: Hijeh chun alhacha a pang hon David lengpa jah a, “Kapu, nang dingin nungah theng khat naumpi di le najen le dingin hol’u hite. Chutileh aman lum nasahna din naluppi le phate,” atiuve.
en: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may keep warm.”
text:
1KI 1:2
Thadou: Hijeh chun alhacha a pang hon David lengpa jah a, “Kapu, nang dingin nungah theng khat naumpi di le najen le dingin hol’u hite. Chutileh aman lum nasahna din naluppi le phate,” atiuve.
English: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may keep warm.”

tcz: Hiti chun amahon Israel gam sung pumpia nungah melhoi tah khat ahol un ahileh Shunem’a konin Abishag kitinu chu a mudoh un Lengpa kom a chun ahin puilut tauvin ahi.
en: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
text:
1KI 1:3
Thadou: Hiti chun amahon Israel gam sung pumpia nungah melhoi tah khat ahol un ahileh Shunem’a konin Abishag kitinu chu a mudoh un Lengpa kom a chun ahin puilut tauvin ahi.
English: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

tcz: Hiche nungahnu chu ahoi lheh jengin ama chun lengpa chu ave sui jin ajen le tan ahi. Ahin lah lengpa chun aki timatpi thei tapon ahi.
en: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.
text:
1KI 1:4
Thadou: Hiche nungahnu chu ahoi lheh jengin ama chun lengpa chu ave sui jin ajen le tan ahi. Ahin lah lengpa chun aki timatpi thei tapon ahi.
English: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.

tcz: Hiche phatlai chun David leh Haggith chapa Adonijah chun “Keima leng ka chan ding ahi” tin aki phongdoh tan ahi. Hichun aman sakol kangtalai tamtah aki semdoh in chu leh achung touthem ho jong akigo uvin chuleh ama masang nga lamhong a pang dingin mi-somnga a lhaisah in ahi.
en: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
text:
1KI 1:5
Thadou: Hiche phatlai chun David leh Haggith chapa Adonijah chun “Keima leng ka chan ding ahi” tin aki phongdoh tan ahi. Hichun aman sakol kangtalai tamtah aki semdoh in chu leh achung touthem ho jong akigo uvin chuleh ama masang nga lamhong a pang dingin mi-somnga a lhaisah in ahi.
English: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

tcz: Apa David Lengpan la “Ipi bol’a na him?” tin khat vei cha jong aphoh kha pon chule ahil jong ahil khapon ahi. Hiche Adonijah hi Absalom pen jouva peng’a ahin, ama jong hi mi melhoi tah khat ahi.
en: His father had not displeased him at any time in saying, “Why have you done so?” and he was also a very handsome man; and he was born after Absalom.
text:
1KI 1:6
Thadou: Apa David Lengpan la “Ipi bol’a na him?” tin khat vei cha jong aphoh kha pon chule ahil jong ahil khapon ahi. Hiche Adonijah hi Absalom pen jouva peng’a ahin, ama jong hi mi melhoi tah khat ahi.
English: His father had not displeased him at any time in saying, “Why have you done so?” and he was also a very handsome man; and he was born after Absalom.

tcz: Lengmun alogotna a hin Adonijah in Zeruiah chapa Joab le Abiathar thempu pachu ama langa pang dingin ana kijol lut in chule amanin jong anop peh tan ahi.
en: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.
text:
1KI 1:7
Thadou: Lengmun alogotna a hin Adonijah in Zeruiah chapa Joab le Abiathar thempu pachu ama langa pang dingin ana kijol lut in chule amanin jong anop peh tan ahi.
English: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.

tcz: Ahinlah Zadok thempupa leh Jehoiada chapa Benaiah, themgao Nathan, Simei, Rei chuleh David veng themma pang mihat hon vang ana panpi pouvin ahi.
en: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
text:
1KI 1:8
Thadou: Ahinlah Zadok thempupa leh Jehoiada chapa Benaiah, themgao Nathan, Simei, Rei chuleh David veng themma pang mihat hon vang ana panpi pouvin ahi.
English: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

tcz: Adonijah chun En-royal twinah komma Zoheleth song phunga chun ache in chule hilai mun ah chun kelngoiho, bongchal ho leh bongnou thaotah tah ho mangchan pumgo thilto ana boltan ahi. Hichea chun David lengpa chapate, a sopi ho chengse ho leh Judahh gamsung’a Lengpa ding’a pan mun neiho jouse jong ana koukhom in ahi.
en: Adonijah killed sheep, cattle, and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel; and he called all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants;

tcz: Ahinlah aman Nathan themgao, Beniah chule lengpa veng tup a pang ho chujongleh a sopipa Solomon ana koupon ahi.
en: but he didn’t call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.
text:
1KI 1:10
Thadou: Ahinlah aman Nathan themgao, Beniah chule lengpa veng tup a pang ho chujongleh a sopipa Solomon ana koupon ahi.
English: but he didn’t call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.

tcz: Hichun Nathan chu Solomon nu Bethsheba komma achen, hiti hin aga dong tan ahi, “Haggith chapa Adonijah chu ama leh ama leng in aki sem tan ahi ti na jahdoh lou ham? Chuleh lengpan jong ana jahdoh khah lou ham?”
en: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns, and David our lord doesn’t know it?
text:
1KI 1:11
Thadou: Hichun Nathan chu Solomon nu Bethsheba komma achen, hiti hin aga dong tan ahi, “Haggith chapa Adonijah chu ama leh ama leng in aki sem tan ahi ti na jahdoh lou ham? Chuleh lengpan jong ana jahdoh khah lou ham?”
English: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns, and David our lord doesn’t know it?

tcz: “Nang leh na chapa Solomon hinkho na hoidoh nom le keiman kaseipeh bang vang hin jui in,” atipeh tan ahi..
en: Now therefore come, please let me give you counsel, that you may save your own life and your son Solomon’s life.
text:
1KI 1:12
Thadou: “Nang leh na chapa Solomon hinkho na hoidoh nom le keiman kaseipeh bang vang hin jui in,” atipeh tan ahi..
English: Now therefore come, please let me give you counsel, that you may save your own life and your son Solomon’s life.

tcz: Tun gang tah in Lengpa komma chen lang hitin ga seitan “Kapu Lengpa, nang in na chapa Solomon hi kei banna leng hung chang ding ahi neina tipeh lou ham? tua hi i-atileh Adonijah khu leng chang hitam?” ati.
en: Go in to King David, and tell him, ‘Didn’t you, my lord the king, swear to your servant, saying, “Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne”? Why then does Adonijah reign?’
text:
1KI 1:13
Thadou: Tun gang tah in Lengpa komma chen lang hitin ga seitan “Kapu Lengpa, nang in na chapa Solomon hi kei banna leng hung chang ding ahi neina tipeh lou ham? tua hi i-atileh Adonijah khu leng chang hitam?” ati.
English: Go in to King David, and tell him, ‘Didn’t you, my lord the king, swear to your servant, saying, “Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne”? Why then does Adonijah reign?’

tcz: Chule nang in hi tia chu akomma thu na na seipeh tah leh keima hung lut in ting na thusei chu ka hung suh det ding ahi.
en: Behold, while you are still talking there with the king, I will also come in after you and confirm your words.”
text:
1KI 1:14
Thadou: Chule nang in hi tia chu akomma thu na na seipeh tah leh keima hung lut in ting na thusei chu ka hung suh det ding ahi.
English: Behold, while you are still talking there with the king, I will also come in after you and confirm your words.”

tcz: Hiti chun Bethsheba chu Lengpa lupna dan sunga chun alut in Lengpa chu ateh behseh tan Abishag chun ajen jing in ahi.
en: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room. The king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.
text:
1KI 1:15
Thadou: Hiti chun Bethsheba chu Lengpa lupna dan sunga chun alut in Lengpa chu ateh behseh tan Abishag chun ajen jing in ahi.
English: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room. The king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.

tcz: Bethsheba chu lengpa ang’a chun abohkhup in ahileh aman, “Ipi nadei ham?” ahin tin ahi.
en: Bathsheba bowed and showed respect to the king. The king said, “What would you like?”
text:
1KI 1:16
Thadou: Bethsheba chu lengpa ang’a chun abohkhup in ahileh aman, “Ipi nadei ham?” ahin tin ahi.
English: Bathsheba bowed and showed respect to the king. The king said, “What would you like?”

tcz: Amanun adonbut in, “Kapu Lengpa nang in Pakai, Pathen masang’a na kihahsel in ka kom ah hitin nana seijin ahi: na chapa Solomon hi kei banna ka laltouna munna hi leng hung chang tei ding ahi tin nana seijin ahi.
en: She said to him, “My lord, you swore by the LORD your God to your servant, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’
text:
1KI 1:17
Thadou: Amanun adonbut in, “Kapu Lengpa nang in Pakai, Pathen masang’a na kihahsel in ka kom ah hitin nana seijin ahi: na chapa Solomon hi kei banna ka laltouna munna hi leng hung chang tei ding ahi tin nana seijin ahi.
English: She said to him, “My lord, you swore by the LORD your God to your servant, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’

tcz: Ahinlah tun Adonijah hi ama leh ama Lengin akisem tan ahinlah nangin na hepha pon ahi.
en: Now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and you, my lord the king, don’t know it.
text:
1KI 1:18
Thadou: Ahinlah tun Adonijah hi ama leh ama Lengin akisem tan ahinlah nangin na hepha pon ahi.
English: Now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and you, my lord the king, don’t know it.

tcz: Aman bongchal ho, bongnou thaotah tah ho leh kelngoi ho athat in pumgo thilto aboltan, Lengpa chate dangse akouvin kei chapa Solomon akou pon chu leh aman themgao Abiathar leh sepai lamkai Joab jong akouvin ahi.
en: He has slain cattle and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the army; but he hasn’t called Solomon your servant.
text:
1KI 1:19
Thadou: Aman bongchal ho, bongnou thaotah tah ho leh kelngoi ho athat in pumgo thilto aboltan, Lengpa chate dangse akouvin kei chapa Solomon akou pon chu leh aman themgao Abiathar leh sepai lamkai Joab jong akouvin ahi.
English: He has slain cattle and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the army; but he hasn’t called Solomon your servant.

tcz: Tuhin kapu Lengpa Israel mipite jousen nang banna leng chang ding hi koi pen na hisah ding ham? tia avet cheh u ahi,” ati.
en: You, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
text:
1KI 1:20
Thadou: Tuhin kapu Lengpa Israel mipite jousen nang banna leng chang ding hi koi pen na hisah ding ham? tia avet cheh u ahi,” ati.
English: You, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

tcz: “Tua hi nang in pan nalah vahlou leh nathi nung leh ka chapa Solomon toh kei ni hi themmo nanei khat bang a eikibol lhon di ahitai,” ati.
en: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”
text:
1KI 1:21
Thadou: “Tua hi nang in pan nalah vahlou leh nathi nung leh ka chapa Solomon toh kei ni hi themmo nanei khat bang a eikibol lhon di ahitai,” ati.
English: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”

tcz: Amanun hitia thu ana sei sung in Nathan themgao chu akom aga lhung in ahi.
en: Behold, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.
text:
1KI 1:22
Thadou: Amanun hitia thu ana sei sung in Nathan themgao chu akom aga lhung in ahi.
English: Behold, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

tcz: Nathan themgao ahung in na kimupi nom’e tichu Lengpa a seipeh tauvin, hichun Nathan themgao alut in Lengpa kom achun akhup boh in achun amai tol’a a sulut jeng tan ahi.
en: They told the king, saying, “Behold, Nathan the prophet!” When he had come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
text:
1KI 1:23
Thadou: Nathan themgao ahung in na kimupi nom’e tichu Lengpa a seipeh tauvin, hichun Nathan themgao alut in Lengpa kom achun akhup boh in achun amai tol’a a sulut jeng tan ahi.
English: They told the king, saying, “Behold, Nathan the prophet!” When he had come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

tcz: Nathan in “Kapu Lengpa nangin, Adonijah hi nang banna leng changding’a nana phondoh khah em?
en: Nathan said, “My lord, King, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?
text:
1KI 1:24
Thadou: Nathan in “Kapu Lengpa nangin, Adonijah hi nang banna leng changding’a nana phondoh khah em?
English: Nathan said, “My lord, King, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?

tcz: Tu nin aman bongchal ho, bongnou thao tahtah ho leh kelngoi ho pumgo thilto abol in hiche’a chun Lengpa chate, sepai lamkai ho, Abiathar themgao pa akouvin ama hon aneuvin adon un leng Adoniah hingsot hen tin a sam un ahi.
en: For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest. Behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’
text:
1KI 1:25
Thadou: Tu nin aman bongchal ho, bongnou thao tahtah ho leh kelngoi ho pumgo thilto abol in hiche’a chun Lengpa chate, sepai lamkai ho, Abiathar themgao pa akouvin ama hon aneuvin adon un leng Adoniah hingsot hen tin a sam un ahi.
English: For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest. Behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’

tcz: Aman kei leh thempupa Zadok leh Beniah chu leh na soh Solomon jong akou pon ahi.
en: But he hasn’t called me, even me your servant, Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon.
text:
1KI 1:26
Thadou: Aman kei leh thempupa Zadok leh Beniah chu leh na soh Solomon jong akou pon ahi.
English: But he hasn’t called me, even me your servant, Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon.

tcz: Kapu Lengpa nang in hiche hi nang ding’a panmun neiho hetsah louva nang banna leng chang ding hi nalhen khat tou hitam?” ati.
en: Was this thing done by my lord the king, and you haven’t shown to your servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?”
text:
1KI 1:27
Thadou: Kapu Lengpa nang in hiche hi nang ding’a panmun neiho hetsah louva nang banna leng chang ding hi nalhen khat tou hitam?” ati.
English: Was this thing done by my lord the king, and you haven’t shown to your servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?”

tcz: David lengpan ahin donbut in ajah a, “Bethsheba chu ga kouvin,” ati. Hichun amanu ahung in Lengpa masanga ading tan ahi.
en: Then King David answered, “Call Bathsheba in to me.” She came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.
text:
1KI 1:28
Thadou: David lengpan ahin donbut in ajah a, “Bethsheba chu ga kouvin,” ati. Hichun amanu ahung in Lengpa masanga ading tan ahi.
English: Then King David answered, “Call Bathsheba in to me.” She came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.

tcz: Hichun Lengpan aki hahselna chu avel sei kit in, “Keiman hahsatna kato channa eina huhdoh hing jing Pakai minna kasei ahi.
en: The king vowed and said, “As the LORD lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
text:
1KI 1:29
Thadou: Hichun Lengpan aki hahselna chu avel sei kit in, “Keiman hahsatna kato channa eina huhdoh hing jing Pakai minna kasei ahi.
English: The king vowed and said, “As the LORD lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

tcz: Na chapa Solomon chun keima bantah a lengmun chu Pakai Israel Pathen minna ka kitepna dungjuija tuni tah a hi alo ding ahi tai,” ati.
en: most certainly as I swore to you by the LORD, the God of Israel, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place;’ I will most certainly do this today.”
text:
1KI 1:30
Thadou: Na chapa Solomon chun keima bantah a lengmun chu Pakai Israel Pathen minna ka kitepna dungjuija tuni tah a hi alo ding ahi tai,” ati.
English: most certainly as I swore to you by the LORD, the God of Israel, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place;’ I will most certainly do this today.”

tcz: Hichun Bethsheba chu akun in tol ah amai a sulut in Lengpa chu salam abol in asei tai, “Kapu Lengpa David hing sot hen!” ati.
en: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth and showed respect to the king, and said, “Let my lord King David live forever!”
text:
1KI 1:31
Thadou: Hichun Bethsheba chu akun in tol ah amai a sulut in Lengpa chu salam abol in asei tai, “Kapu Lengpa David hing sot hen!” ati.
English: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth and showed respect to the king, and said, “Let my lord King David live forever!”

tcz: Hichun David lengpan thu apen “Zadok thempupa, themgao Nathan le Jehoiada chapa Bennah ga kou un” ati. Ama ho lengpa angsung’a ahung lhunphat un,
en: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before the king.
text:
1KI 1:32
Thadou: Hichun David lengpan thu apen “Zadok thempupa, themgao Nathan le Jehoiada chapa Bennah ga kou un” ati. Ama ho lengpa angsung’a ahung lhunphat un,
English: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before the king.

tcz: Lengpan amaho kom ah asei tan ahi, “Solomon leh kei ding’a pan mun nikho nei ho chengse chu Gihon tui putna mun’a chun pui unlang chu leh Solomon chu keima sakol pol chung’a chun tousah un.
en: The king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.
text:
1KI 1:33
Thadou: Lengpan amaho kom ah asei tan ahi, “Solomon leh kei ding’a pan mun nikho nei ho chengse chu Gihon tui putna mun’a chun pui unlang chu leh Solomon chu keima sakol pol chung’a chun tousah un.
English: The king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.

tcz: Hichea chun Thempupa Zadok le Themgao pa Nathan in Israel pumpi chung a Leng chang dingin Solomon chu thao ganu lhon hen lang saki pengkul chu mut un chuleh lengpa Solomon hingsot hen tin sam un.
en: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel. Blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live King Solomon!’
text:
1KI 1:34
Thadou: Hichea chun Thempupa Zadok le Themgao pa Nathan in Israel pumpi chung a Leng chang dingin Solomon chu thao ganu lhon hen lang saki pengkul chu mut un chuleh lengpa Solomon hingsot hen tin sam un.
English: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel. Blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live King Solomon!’

tcz: Chujou teng hilanga hinle puikit un ka laltouna a tousah un. Keima Lengmun lo ding leh Israel leh Judahh chung’a vaihom dinga keiman ka pansah ahi tai,” ati.
en: Then come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne; for he shall be king in my place. I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.”
text:
1KI 1:35
Thadou: Chujou teng hilanga hinle puikit un ka laltouna a tousah un. Keima Lengmun lo ding leh Israel leh Judahh chung’a vaihom dinga keiman ka pansah ahi tai,” ati.
English: Then come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne; for he shall be king in my place. I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.”

tcz: Jehoiadah chapa Benaiah chun adonbut in “Hihen, Kapu Lengpa Pakai Pathen in jong hichu guilhun sah hen” ati.
en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, “Amen. May the LORD, the God of my lord the king, say so.
text:
1KI 1:36
Thadou: Jehoiadah chapa Benaiah chun adonbut in “Hihen, Kapu Lengpa Pakai Pathen in jong hichu guilhun sah hen” ati.
English: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, “Amen. May the LORD, the God of my lord the king, say so.

tcz: “Kapu Lengpa nangma nana umpi jing bang in Pakaiyin Solomon jong umpi hen chuleh Solomon vaihopna gamchu nanga sang in letsah jo hen!” atiuvin ahi
en: As the LORD has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David.”
text:
1KI 1:37
Thadou: “Kapu Lengpa nangma nana umpi jing bang in Pakaiyin Solomon jong umpi hen chuleh Solomon vaihopna gamchu nanga sang in letsah jo hen!” atiuvin ahi
English: As the LORD has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David.”

tcz: Hiti chun Thempupa Zadok, Themgao pa Nathan leh Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chuleh Lengpa vesui sepai hon Gihon munlang’a chun Solomon chu apui jun apa sakolpol chunga chun a tousah un ahi.
en: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
text:
1KI 1:38
Thadou: Hiti chun Thempupa Zadok, Themgao pa Nathan leh Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chuleh Lengpa vesui sepai hon Gihon munlang’a chun Solomon chu apui jun apa sakolpol chunga chun a tousah un ahi.
English: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

tcz: Hiche mun achun thempupa Zadok chun indan thenga kon in Olive thao atheija um chu alan Solomon chu anu peh in ahi. Hijou chun saki sumkon chu amut un “Leng Solomon hingsot hen,” tin asam un ahi.
en: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet; and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”
text:
1KI 1:39
Thadou: Hiche mun achun thempupa Zadok chun indan thenga kon in Olive thao atheija um chu alan Solomon chu anu peh in ahi. Hijou chun saki sumkon chu amut un “Leng Solomon hingsot hen,” tin asam un ahi.
English: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet; and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”

tcz: Hiche jou chun mipihon Solomon chu Jerusalem geijin ajui jin kuli amut’un kipahtah injong a sam un, akipanao o-gin kithong tah a a sap u chun leiset jeng jong a kithin sah leu jengin ahi.
en: All the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth shook with their sound.
text:
1KI 1:40
Thadou: Hiche jou chun mipihon Solomon chu Jerusalem geijin ajui jin kuli amut’un kipahtah injong a sam un, akipanao o-gin kithong tah a a sap u chun leiset jeng jong a kithin sah leu jengin ahi.
English: All the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth shook with their sound.

tcz: Adonijah leh aloi agolho chun golvah abol chai jouvin Solomon lengchan husa thong jejun ajauvin saki pengkul kimut gin chu Joab in ajah doh phat in, “Khopi sung khubanga choh jeju khu ipi kibolna hitan tem?” atin ahi.
en: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, “Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?”
text:
1KI 1:41
Thadou: Adonijah leh aloi agolho chun golvah abol chai jouvin Solomon lengchan husa thong jejun ajauvin saki pengkul kimut gin chu Joab in ajah doh phat in, “Khopi sung khubanga choh jeju khu ipi kibolna hitan tem?” atin ahi.
English: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, “Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?”

tcz: Hiche thu chu asei pet tah'un, Abiather Thempupa chapa Jonathan chu ahung lhung tan ahileh Adonijah in “Hunglutnin ajeh chu nanghi mipha na hin na thu poh jong thuphahi ngei inte,” atin ahi.
en: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said, “Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.”
text:
1KI 1:42
Thadou: Hiche thu chu asei pet tah'un, Abiather Thempupa chapa Jonathan chu ahung lhung tan ahileh Adonijah in “Hunglutnin ajeh chu nanghi mipha na hin na thu poh jong thuphahi ngei inte,” atin ahi.
English: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said, “Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.”

tcz: Jonathan in a donbut in ahinai saipoi David Lengpan tutah chun Solomon chu leng ahitai tin aphong doh in ahi” ati.
en: Jonathan answered Adonijah, “Most certainly our lord King David has made Solomon king.
text:
1KI 1:43
Thadou: Jonathan in a donbut in ahinai saipoi David Lengpan tutah chun Solomon chu leng ahitai tin aphong doh in ahi” ati.
English: Jonathan answered Adonijah, “Most certainly our lord King David has made Solomon king.

tcz: Lengpan ama chu Gihon geijin asol suh in, Zadok Thempu pa le Nathan Themgaopa leh Jehoiada chapa Benaiah toh Lengpa vesuija pang sepai hon ahin juijun ahi. Lengpa Sakolpol achu Solomon atousah un ahi.
en: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king’s mule.
text:
1KI 1:44
Thadou: Lengpan ama chu Gihon geijin asol suh in, Zadok Thempu pa le Nathan Themgaopa leh Jehoiada chapa Benaiah toh Lengpa vesuija pang sepai hon ahin juijun ahi. Lengpa Sakolpol achu Solomon atousah un ahi.
English: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king’s mule.

tcz: Zadok le Nathan in Gihon ah leng dingin thao anu lhon in ahi. Amaho chu tutah chun ahung kile uvin ahileh khopi pumpi chun a kipapi uva asap u ahi. Hichu ahi achoh jeju achu,
en: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon. They have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.
text:
1KI 1:45
Thadou: Zadok le Nathan in Gihon ah leng dingin thao anu lhon in ahi. Amaho chu tutah chun ahung kile uvin ahileh khopi pumpi chun a kipapi uva asap u ahi. Hichu ahi achoh jeju achu,
English: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon. They have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.

tcz: Hiche bana jong chu laltouna a Leng in a tou tan ahi.
en: Also, Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.
text:
1KI 1:46
Thadou: Hiche bana jong chu laltouna a Leng in a tou tan ahi.
English: Also, Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.

tcz: Lengpa ding’a panmun nei Lamkai ho jousen jong leng David komma acheuvin Lengpa chu aga kipapi uvin, na Pathen in Solomon hi nang sangin minthang jo hen lang nang sang in jong vaihom lenjon hung kije sal jo hen atiuve. Lengpan jong alupna mun achun Pathen jana’n akun in ahi.
en: Moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne;’ and the king bowed himself on the bed.
text:
1KI 1:47
Thadou: Lengpa ding’a panmun nei Lamkai ho jousen jong leng David komma acheuvin Lengpa chu aga kipapi uvin, na Pathen in Solomon hi nang sangin minthang jo hen lang nang sang in jong vaihom lenjon hung kije sal jo hen atiuve. Lengpan jong alupna mun achun Pathen jana’n akun in ahi.
English: Moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne;’ and the king bowed himself on the bed.

tcz: Chuleh hiti chun aman “Israel Pathen chu thangvah in umhen, aman tuni’n keima hinkho sung in kamit mutah in ka khel’a laltouna a touding ei lhenpeh tan ahi” atin ahi.
en: Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.’”
text:
1KI 1:48
Thadou: Chuleh hiti chun aman “Israel Pathen chu thangvah in umhen, aman tuni’n keima hinkho sung in kamit mutah in ka khel’a laltouna a touding ei lhenpeh tan ahi” atin ahi.
English: Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.’”

tcz: Hichun Adonijah loile golho sese chu tijatah'in anehkhom na’u dokhanga kon chun aki thecheh gam jeng un ahi.
