tcz: Houin sung a abang jouse, atol’a pat abiching geiyin cedar thingpeh in atomjol soh keijin, alhong jong chahthingpeh apha in atomjol soh keiyin ahi,
en: He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood. He covered the floor of the house with cypress boards.
text:
1KI 6:15
Thadou: Houin sung a abang jouse, atol’a pat abiching geiyin cedar thingpeh in atomjol soh keijin, alhong jong chahthingpeh apha in atomjol soh keiyin ahi,
English: He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood. He covered the floor of the house with cypress boards.

tcz: Aman insung dan, Muntheng chungnungpen kiti lai chu Houin tomlam a kisem ahin, atol’a pat abiching geiya tong somni sao, cedar thingpeh a kigentan ahi.
en: He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place.
text:
1KI 6:16
Thadou: Aman insung dan, Muntheng chungnungpen kiti lai chu Houin tomlam a kisem ahin, atol’a pat abiching geiya tong somni sao, cedar thingpeh a kigentan ahi.
English: He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place.

tcz: Muntheng chungnung masanga um, Houin inpi chu tong 40 in asaovin ahi.
en: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.
text:
1KI 6:17
Thadou: Muntheng chungnung masanga um, Houin inpi chu tong 40 in asaovin ahi.
English: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.

tcz: Insunga a song bang ho jouse chu Cedar thingpeh in phatechan akitomjol soh keijin, chule umga leng tobang leh pahcha pahlha ding kon banga ki jempol ahi.
en: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.
text:
1KI 6:18
Thadou: Insunga a song bang ho jouse chu Cedar thingpeh in phatechan akitomjol soh keijin, chule umga leng tobang leh pahcha pahlha ding kon banga ki jempol ahi.
English: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.

tcz: Aman indan sungnung lang ah chun Pakai Kitepna Thingkong koina dingin indan theng khat asembe in ahi.
en: He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within, to set the ark of the LORD’s covenant there.
text:
1KI 6:19
Thadou: Aman indan sungnung lang ah chun Pakai Kitepna Thingkong koina dingin indan theng khat asembe in ahi.
English: He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within, to set the ark of the LORD’s covenant there.

tcz: Hiche in dan theng sung chu tong somni in asauvin, tong somni ma alennin, tongsomni ma asang in ahi. Dan theng sung apumpi chu sana thengsel in atomjol sohkei jin, chuleh Cedar thing a kisem maicham phung jong chu san in atomjol soh keiyin ahi.
en: Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height. He overlaid it with pure gold. He covered the altar with cedar.
text:
1KI 6:20
Thadou: Hiche in dan theng sung chu tong somni in asauvin, tong somni ma alennin, tongsomni ma asang in ahi. Dan theng sung apumpi chu sana thengsel in atomjol sohkei jin, chuleh Cedar thing a kisem maicham phung jong chu san in atomjol soh keiyin ahi.
English: Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height. He overlaid it with pure gold. He covered the altar with cedar.

tcz: Chule Solomon in indan sung aumpi chun sana thengselin atomjol soh keiyin ahi, dan theng chungnung pen lutna maija chun sana gui teni ajam pelton, sana maman atomjol in ahi.
en: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.
text:
1KI 6:21
Thadou: Chule Solomon in indan sung aumpi chun sana thengselin atomjol soh keiyin ahi, dan theng chungnung pen lutna maija chun sana gui teni ajam pelton, sana maman atomjol in ahi.
English: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.

tcz: Hiti chun Houin sung pumpi chule Muntheng sung nunga maicham jong apumpin sana jengin atomjol in ahi.
en: He overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. He also overlaid the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold.
text:
1KI 6:22
Thadou: Hiti chun Houin sung pumpi chule Muntheng sung nunga maicham jong apumpin sana jengin atomjol in ahi.
English: He overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. He also overlaid the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold.

tcz: Muntheng chungnung laiya hin olive thing kisem Cherubim Vantil lhaving ni nei limni akisem in, khat cheh chu tong som asang in ahi.
en: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.
text:
1KI 6:23
Thadou: Muntheng chungnung laiya hin olive thing kisem Cherubim Vantil lhaving ni nei limni akisem in, khat cheh chu tong som asang in ahi.
English: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

tcz: Cherubim Vantil khatchu alha langkhat tong nga alhing in, alangkhat ma jong chuti ma man tong nga ma alhing’e. Hijeh chun alha mong lang khat apat alang khat lha mong geijin tong som a lhing’e.
en: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub. From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits.
text:
1KI 6:24
Thadou: Cherubim Vantil khatchu alha langkhat tong nga alhing in, alangkhat ma jong chuti ma man tong nga ma alhing’e. Hijeh chun alha mong lang khat apat alang khat lha mong geijin tong som a lhing’e.
English: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub. From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits.

tcz: Cherubim teni chu aletdan jong aneo dan jong akibang gel in, chule a gongsuo jong thakhat chat ahilhone.
en: The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.
text:
1KI 6:25
Thadou: Cherubim teni chu aletdan jong aneo dan jong akibang gel in, chule a gongsuo jong thakhat chat ahilhone.
English: The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.

tcz: Cherubim teni chu ani nilhon in asandan tong som alhing cheh lhon e.
en: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.
text:
1KI 6:26
Thadou: Cherubim teni chu ani nilhon in asandan tong som alhing cheh lhon e.
English: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.

tcz: Cherubim teni chu, Solomon in, indan sung lang peh a atung in, alha lhon aki jalsoh keijin Cherubim khat lhaving chun bang lang khat aphan, chutengleh alha lang khat gel lhon chu alaija alha vingle alha ving akitong kha to lhonin ahi.
en: He set the cherubim within the inner house. The wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house.
text:
1KI 6:27
Thadou: Cherubim teni chu, Solomon in, indan sung lang peh a atung in, alha lhon aki jalsoh keijin Cherubim khat lhaving chun bang lang khat aphan, chutengleh alha lang khat gel lhon chu alaija alha vingle alha ving akitong kha to lhonin ahi.
English: He set the cherubim within the inner house. The wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house.

tcz: Solomon in Cherubim vantil teni jong chu sana’n atom jolsel jengin ahi.
en: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.
text:
1KI 6:28
Thadou: Solomon in Cherubim vantil teni jong chu sana’n atom jolsel jengin ahi.
English: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

tcz: Indan lenpa bang jouse indan sungnung bang jouse chu Cherubim vantil lim le tumthing lim chule pahcha lim jengin akijempol in ahi.
en: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.
text:
1KI 6:29
Thadou: Indan lenpa bang jouse indan sungnung bang jouse chu Cherubim vantil lim le tumthing lim chule pahcha lim jengin akijempol in ahi.
English: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.

tcz: Alhong ho jeng jong chu asung apo ki bang in sana jengin atomjol in ahi.
en: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.
text:
1KI 6:30
Thadou: Alhong ho jeng jong chu asung apo ki bang in sana jengin atomjol in ahi.
English: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.

tcz: Munthng chungnung lutna dingin Solomon chun olive thing jengin kotpi asem soh keijin, kot chunga ajol pa leh akotpi khom chengse chu agom in nga jen alhinge.
en: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.
text:
1KI 6:31
Thadou: Munthng chungnung lutna dingin Solomon chun olive thing jengin kotpi asem soh keijin, kot chunga ajol pa leh akotpi khom chengse chu agom in nga jen alhinge.
English: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.

tcz: Kotpi teni chu Cherubim limle tumthing lim chule pahcha lim akisem in, Kotpi ahin chule lim kisem ho ahin abonchan sanan atom jolsoh kei jin, Cherubim vantil lim kisem hole tum thing lim kisemho chunga jong chun sanatui athe khum in ahi.
en: So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold. He spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.
text:
1KI 6:32
Thadou: Kotpi teni chu Cherubim limle tumthing lim chule pahcha lim akisem in, Kotpi ahin chule lim kisem ho ahin abonchan sanan atom jolsoh kei jin, Cherubim vantil lim kisem hole tum thing lim kisemho chunga jong chun sanatui athe khum in ahi.
English: So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold. He spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.

tcz: Houin kimlai lunga lutna ding kotpi khomho jong chu aning li noija Olive thing jeng’a kisem ahin, hitobang bang hin asemin ahi.
en: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall,
text:
1KI 6:33
Thadou: Houin kimlai lunga lutna ding kotpi khomho jong chu aning li noija Olive thing jeng’a kisem ahin, hitobang bang hin asemin ahi.
English: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall,

tcz: Chahthing a kisem kotpi ni alhing in, kotpi khatna ajet aveija kotpeh teni chu aki lhep theigel ahi, chu tobangma chun kotpi khatpa jong ajet aveija akotpi teni akilhep thei cheh in ahi.
en: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
text:
1KI 6:34
Thadou: Chahthing a kisem kotpi ni alhing in, kotpi khatna ajet aveija kotpeh teni chu aki lhep theigel ahi, chu tobangma chun kotpi khatpa jong ajet aveija akotpi teni akilhep thei cheh in ahi.
English: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

tcz: Akotpeh chung dunga chun Cherubim limle tumthing lim chule pahcha limjeng jengin ajempol sohkeije. Chuleh abonchan sana’n atom gel in, akijopna dung gei jong sana aloival sohkei jin ahi.
en: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.
text:
1KI 6:35
Thadou: Akotpeh chung dunga chun Cherubim limle tumthing lim chule pahcha limjeng jengin ajempol sohkeije. Chuleh abonchan sana’n atom gel in, akijopna dung gei jong sana aloival sohkei jin ahi.
English: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.

tcz: Houin alai lung alhong chu song khensa gol thum'in asen chule Cedar thing inkam adat nadin golkhat in ajambe na laiye.
en: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.
text:
1KI 6:36
Thadou: Houin alai lung alhong chu song khensa gol thum'in asen chule Cedar thing inkam adat nadin golkhat in ajambe na laiye.
English: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.

tcz: Solomon leng chan kumli channa Zif lhasung in Pakai houin chu akhombul ana tung doh pan tauvin ahi.
en: The foundation of the LORD’s house was laid in the fourth year, in the month Ziv.
text:
1KI 6:37
Thadou: Solomon leng chan kumli channa Zif lhasung in Pakai houin chu akhombul ana tung doh pan tauvin ahi.
English: The foundation of the LORD’s house was laid in the fourth year, in the month Ziv.

tcz: Solomon Lengchan kum somlekhat channa ‘Bul’ kiti lha sung hin Houin sahna dinga ana kigonna dung jui bang tahin ana kijou chaisoh tauvin ahi. Hiti chun hiche houin sahna ahin kum sagi ana lut in ahi.
en: In the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished throughout all its parts and according to all its specifications. So he spent seven years building it.
text:
1KI 6:38
Thadou: Solomon Lengchan kum somlekhat channa ‘Bul’ kiti lha sung hin Houin sahna dinga ana kigonna dung jui bang tahin ana kijou chaisoh tauvin ahi. Hiti chun hiche houin sahna ahin kum sagi ana lut in ahi.
English: In the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished throughout all its parts and according to all its specifications. So he spent seven years building it.

tcz: Solomon in ama in ding mong mong in leng inpi khat ana tungdoh in hiche asahna ahin kum som le thum ana lut in ahi.
en: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
text:
1KI 7:1
Thadou: Solomon in ama in ding mong mong in leng inpi khat ana tungdoh in hiche asahna ahin kum som le thum ana lut in ahi.
English: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

tcz: A in sah khat chu Lebanon gamang leng inpi tin amin ana sah in ahi. Hiche adung tong jakhat leh somnga avai tong som sagi leh nga ahin atun tong somli le nga ahi. Akisah dan chu Cedar thing khompi golli kigolla, hiche Cedar thingkhom chunga chu Cedar mama inkam a kijam cheh ahi.
en: For he built the House of the Forest of Lebanon. Its length was one hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.
text:
1KI 7:2
Thadou: A in sah khat chu Lebanon gamang leng inpi tin amin ana sah in ahi. Hiche adung tong jakhat leh somnga avai tong som sagi leh nga ahin atun tong somli le nga ahi. Akisah dan chu Cedar thing khompi golli kigolla, hiche Cedar thingkhom chunga chu Cedar mama inkam a kijam cheh ahi.
English: For he built the House of the Forest of Lebanon. Its length was one hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.

tcz: Kikhopna indan chung chu Cedar thinga kikhu ahi. Khompi ho chunga Cedar inkam kijam ho chung achun indan kijommat somli le nga aum in hicheho khat khat chun indan som le nga a kihom khen cheh kit ahi.
en: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams that were on the pillars, fifteen in a row.
text:
1KI 7:3
Thadou: Kikhopna indan chung chu Cedar thinga kikhu ahi. Khompi ho chunga Cedar inkam kijam ho chung achun indan kijommat somli le nga aum in hicheho khat khat chun indan som le nga a kihom khen cheh kit ahi.
English: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams that were on the pillars, fifteen in a row.

tcz: Golthum thum cheh a chun, bangkot chu thum cheng in khat le khat aki angngat tocheh in akigolphei jin ahi.
en: There were beams in three rows, and window was facing window in three ranks.
text:
1KI 7:4
Thadou: Golthum thum cheh a chun, bangkot chu thum cheng in khat le khat aki angngat tocheh in akigolphei jin ahi.
English: There were beams in three rows, and window was facing window in three ranks.

tcz: Kotpi ho jouse le bangkot ho jouse chun, ningli cheh anei jun bangkot thum ahi hin aki ang-ngat tocheh un ahi.
en: All the doors and posts were made square with beams; and window was facing window in three ranks.
text:
1KI 7:5
Thadou: Kotpi ho jouse le bangkot ho jouse chun, ningli cheh anei jun bangkot thum ahi hin aki ang-ngat tocheh un ahi.
English: All the doors and posts were made square with beams; and window was facing window in three ranks.

tcz: Solomon in jong khompi jeng kiphut kikhopna inkhat jong asan, hiche in asao dan chu tong somnga alhing in chule aletdan chu availam tong somthum alhing in ahi, hiche maiyah chun hongcha khat akisem in chule tumpi khat jong aki tunge.
en: He made the hall of pillars. Its length was fifty cubits and its width thirty cubits, with a porch before them, and pillars and a threshold before them.
text:
1KI 7:6
Thadou: Solomon in jong khompi jeng kiphut kikhopna inkhat jong asan, hiche in asao dan chu tong somnga alhing in chule aletdan chu availam tong somthum alhing in ahi, hiche maiyah chun hongcha khat akisem in chule tumpi khat jong aki tunge.
English: He made the hall of pillars. Its length was fifty cubits and its width thirty cubits, with a porch before them, and pillars and a threshold before them.

tcz: Solomon chun Thutanna in tia kihe vaipohna dinginkhat jong asan, hiche muna chu lenggam sunga thil soh ho chunga thutan in ana toujin ahi. Hiche in hi alhong’a pat a biching geija Cedar thing jeng’a ki kitomjol soh ahi.
en: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.
text:
1KI 7:7
Thadou: Solomon chun Thutanna in tia kihe vaipohna dinginkhat jong asan, hiche muna chu lenggam sunga thil soh ho chunga thutan in ana toujin ahi. Hiche in hi alhong’a pat a biching geija Cedar thing jeng’a ki kitomjol soh ahi.
English: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.

tcz: Hiche in a nunglama chu Solomon in ama chenna ding mong in adangho asah bang bang chun akisah in ahi. Aman in akichenpi Pharaoh chanu ding jong chu hiche in tobang khatma ana sah peh in ahi.
en: His house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the same construction. He made also a house for Pharaoh’s daughter (whom Solomon had taken as wife), like this porch.
text:
1KI 7:8
Thadou: Hiche in a nunglama chu Solomon in ama chenna ding mong in adangho asah bang bang chun akisah in ahi. Aman in akichenpi Pharaoh chanu ding jong chu hiche in tobang khatma ana sah peh in ahi.
English: His house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the same construction. He made also a house for Pharaoh’s daughter (whom Solomon had taken as wife), like this porch.

tcz: Akhombul ki tundohna pat achu kikhuna changei a hi song mantamtah tah leh lentah tah a adung avai kitoh chetna kikhen, songtholna a kitholnal cheh a aning lia ki-at tohchet ahi.
en: All these were of costly stones, even of stone cut according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court.
text:
1KI 7:9
Thadou: Akhombul ki tundohna pat achu kikhuna changei a hi song mantamtah tah leh lentah tah a adung avai kitoh chetna kikhen, songtholna a kitholnal cheh a aning lia ki-at tohchet ahi.
English: All these were of costly stones, even of stone cut according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court.

tcz: Akhombul kitunna songlentah hochu abang tong som le nga asaovin, chule abang tong som le ni in asaovin ahi.
en: The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.
text:
1KI 7:10
Thadou: Akhombul kitunna songlentah hochu abang tong som le nga asaovin, chule abang tong som le ni in asaovin ahi.
English: The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.

tcz: Abaang kisemna a kimang song manlutah tah le lentah tah hochu kitoh chet na ki-at ngen ahin, chule Cedar thingho jong ajol in akimang in ahi.
en: Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.
text:
1KI 7:11
Thadou: Abaang kisemna a kimang song manlutah tah le lentah tah hochu kitoh chet na ki-at ngen ahin, chule Cedar thingho jong ajol in akimang in ahi.
English: Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.

tcz: Indan lhonglaija chun akimvel lhumkei jin song khen tohsa gol thum'in akigolin chule Cedar thing inkam bang in golkhat in akigol in, hitobang hin Pakai indan sungnung lhong jong a inpi hong cha jong ki bolsoh kei ahi.
en: The great court around had three courses of cut stone with a course of cedar beams, like the inner court of the LORD’s house and the porch of the house.
text:
1KI 7:12
Thadou: Indan lhonglaija chun akimvel lhumkei jin song khen tohsa gol thum'in akigolin chule Cedar thing inkam bang in golkhat in akigol in, hitobang hin Pakai indan sungnung lhong jong a inpi hong cha jong ki bolsoh kei ahi.
English: The great court around had three courses of cut stone with a course of cedar beams, like the inner court of the LORD’s house and the porch of the house.

tcz: Solomon Lengpan Hiram kitipa chu Tyre a kona hung dingin ahil in ahi.
en: King Solomon sent and brought Hiram out of Tyre.
text:
1KI 7:13
Thadou: Solomon Lengpan Hiram kitipa chu Tyre a kona hung dingin ahil in ahi.
English: King Solomon sent and brought Hiram out of Tyre.

tcz: Hiram hi Israel mi Naphtali phunga kona meithai khatcha ahin, apa hi Tyre a kona sum-eng khenthem mi ahi, ama chu sum-eng khenna lama thepgilna le boltheina thilpeh chang’a ahin, ama chu ahung in Solomon lengpa dingin thihna tohna lam jouse tohpeh dingin apang tan ahi.
en: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze. He came to King Solomon and performed all his work.
text:
1KI 7:14
Thadou: Hiram hi Israel mi Naphtali phunga kona meithai khatcha ahin, apa hi Tyre a kona sum-eng khenthem mi ahi, ama chu sum-eng khenna lama thepgilna le boltheina thilpeh chang’a ahin, ama chu ahung in Solomon lengpa dingin thihna tohna lam jouse tohpeh dingin apang tan ahi.
English: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze. He came to King Solomon and performed all his work.

tcz: Hiram in sum-eng a kisem khompi ni jen aaphut in, khompi khat cheh chu asan dan tong somle get alhing’e, akhom kolkimvel chu tong som le ni ahin, ahi.
en: For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them.
text:
1KI 7:15
Thadou: Hiram in sum-eng a kisem khompi ni jen aaphut in, khompi khat cheh chu asan dan tong somle get alhing’e, akhom kolkimvel chu tong som le ni ahin, ahi.
English: For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them.

tcz: Hiche aman tong nga a sang khum lujum ni akhengin, khompi teni chunga tun dingin sum-eng kilha jol maman asem in ahi.
en: He made two capitals of molten bronze to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.
text:
1KI 7:16
Thadou: Hiche aman tong nga a sang khum lujum ni akhengin, khompi teni chunga tun dingin sum-eng kilha jol maman asem in ahi.
English: He made two capitals of molten bronze to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.

tcz: Khompi jouse luvuma jopna dingin sum-eng gui kipheh bang in ni apheh in akijem in ahi.
en: There were nets of checker work and wreaths of chain work for the capitals which were on the top of the pillars: seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.
text:
1KI 7:17
Thadou: Khompi jouse luvuma jopna dingin sum-eng gui kipheh bang in ni apheh in akijem in ahi.
English: There were nets of checker work and wreaths of chain work for the capitals which were on the top of the pillars: seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.

tcz: Chujongle aman khompi teho jep hoi nadingin, kolbuthei pah lim golni jong a semin, anajem in ahi.
en: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows of pomegranates around the one network, to cover the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; and he did so for the other capital.
text:
1KI 7:18
Thadou: Chujongle aman khompi teho jep hoi nadingin, kolbuthei pah lim golni jong a semin, anajem in ahi.
English: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows of pomegranates around the one network, to cover the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; and he did so for the other capital.

tcz: Khomlujum lutna asunglam chu lily pahcha lim tobang'in akijemin, chule asan chu tong li a sao cheh in ahi.
en: The capitals that were on the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily work, four cubits.
text:
1KI 7:19
Thadou: Khomlujum lutna asunglam chu lily pahcha lim tobang'in akijemin, chule asan chu tong li a sao cheh in ahi.
English: The capitals that were on the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily work, four cubits.

tcz: Khompi lujum ki sem teni chu chunga kolbuthei pah jani gol ni in akigol kimvellin, aning langah chun lencha pheh banga kipheh sum-eng gui kiveina komma chun akitat doh e.
en: There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two hundred pomegranates in rows around the other capital.
text:
1KI 7:20
Thadou: Khompi lujum ki sem teni chu chunga kolbuthei pah jani gol ni in akigol kimvellin, aning langah chun lencha pheh banga kipheh sum-eng gui kiveina komma chun akitat doh e.
English: There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two hundred pomegranates in rows around the other capital.

tcz: Chuin khopi chengse chu houin hongcha a atung doh pai pai jin, lhanglam ajong khompi khat aphut doh in amin Jakin asah e, chuteng le sahlamma jong khompi khatma aphut doh kit in amin Boaz asah in ahi.
en: He set up the pillars at the porch of the temple. He set up the right pillar and called its name Jachin; and he set up the left pillar and called its name Boaz.
text:
1KI 7:21
Thadou: Chuin khopi chengse chu houin hongcha a atung doh pai pai jin, lhanglam ajong khompi khat aphut doh in amin Jakin asah e, chuteng le sahlamma jong khompi khatma aphut doh kit in amin Boaz asah in ahi.
English: He set up the pillars at the porch of the temple. He set up the right pillar and called its name Jachin; and he set up the left pillar and called its name Boaz.

tcz: Khompi teni chungvum a chun lily pahcha jem akisem in, hiti hin khompi kibol chu a kichai soh tan ahi.
en: On the tops of the pillars was lily work. So the work of the pillars was finished.
text:
1KI 7:22
Thadou: Khompi teni chungvum a chun lily pahcha jem akisem in, hiti hin khompi kibol chu a kichai soh tan ahi.
English: On the tops of the pillars was lily work. So the work of the pillars was finished.

tcz: Hiramin sum-eng a kisem twikong lenpi khat alhan, agei langkhatna pat alang gei chan chu tong som alhing in, hichu twikhanglen in asah in ahi, tong nga in asangin, akollvel pumpi chu tong somthum alhing in ahi.
en: He made the molten sea ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.
text:
1KI 7:23
Thadou: Hiramin sum-eng a kisem twikong lenpi khat alhan, agei langkhatna pat alang gei chan chu tong som alhing in, hichu twikhanglen in asah in ahi, tong nga in asangin, akollvel pumpi chu tong somthum alhing in ahi.
English: He made the molten sea ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.

tcz: Akong gei noi gol’a chu, umtam lim tampi gol ni in aki jemphei peh in, chule feet khat sung in hiche umtam lim chug up tobang aum jou in ahi. Twikong aki lhajol petna hichengse chu toh kilhah tha ahi tai.
en: Under its brim around there were buds which encircled it for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The buds were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
text:
1KI 7:24
Thadou: Akong gei noi gol’a chu, umtam lim tampi gol ni in aki jemphei peh in, chule feet khat sung in hiche umtam lim chug up tobang aum jou in ahi. Twikong aki lhajol petna hichengse chu toh kilhah tha ahi tai.
English: Under its brim around there were buds which encircled it for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The buds were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

tcz: Twikong chu sum-enga kisem bongchal somleni chunga akilui jin, hiche bongchal ho jouse chun polam angat cheh u ahi. Hiti chun, bongchal thum'in sahlam anga in, bongchal thumma in lhanglam angan, bongchal thumma in lhanglam angan chuleh bongchal thum'in nisolam anga in ahi, hiche twikong chu bongchal te chung’a hi kiluija ahi.
en: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.
text:
1KI 7:25
Thadou: Twikong chu sum-enga kisem bongchal somleni chunga akilui jin, hiche bongchal ho jouse chun polam angat cheh u ahi. Hiti chun, bongchal thum'in sahlam anga in, bongchal thumma in lhanglam angan, bongchal thumma in lhanglam angan chuleh bongchal thum'in nisolam anga in ahi, hiche twikong chu bongchal te chung’a hi kiluija ahi.
English: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.

tcz: Twikong sa dan chu khutphang tejen ahin, agei jong khon gei kisempeh banga kisem ahin, pahcha pah banga kisem ahin, pahcha pah bang in akisem in atuikong chun tui tena sangni jen adol’e.
en: It was a hand width thick. Its brim was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held two thousand baths.
text:
1KI 7:26
Thadou: Twikong sa dan chu khutphang tejen ahin, agei jong khon gei kisempeh banga kisem ahin, pahcha pah banga kisem ahin, pahcha pah bang in akisem in atuikong chun tui tena sangni jen adol’e.
English: It was a hand width thick. Its brim was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held two thousand baths.

tcz: Hiram in jong sum-eng kangtalai som asemin; chule hiche kangtalai khat chu tongli asaovin, tongli ma alenin, chule tongthum in asang in ahi.
en: He made the ten bases of bronze. The length of one base was four cubits, four cubits its width, and three cubits its height.
text:
1KI 7:27
Thadou: Hiram in jong sum-eng kangtalai som asemin; chule hiche kangtalai khat chu tongli asaovin, tongli ma alenin, chule tongthum in asang in ahi.
English: He made the ten bases of bronze. The length of one base was four cubits, four cubits its width, and three cubits its height.

tcz: Hiche kangtalai ho chu kolbem a kisem ahin chule amaitom cheh aneiyun ahi, hiche amai tom cheh u chu akolsunga kitung cheh ahi.
en: The work of the bases was like this: they had panels; and there were panels between the ledges;

tcz: Hiche kangtalai kol sung dung’a kiheng lut hiche amai tom dung’a hin sakei bahkai limle bongchal lim chule Cherubim lim tampi aki sem in ahi. Akol chung le anoi dunga chun keipi bahkai le bongchal lim kisemho aki jem in ahi.
en: and on the panels that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and on the ledges there was a pedestal above; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.
text:
1KI 7:29
Thadou: Hiche kangtalai kol sung dung’a kiheng lut hiche amai tom dung’a hin sakei bahkai limle bongchal lim chule Cherubim lim tampi aki sem in ahi. Akol chung le anoi dunga chun keipi bahkai le bongchal lim kisemho aki jem in ahi.
English: and on the panels that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and on the ledges there was a pedestal above; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.

tcz: Kangtalai khat cheh chun sum-eng a kisem kang li cheh leh sum-eng jol li cheh anei uve. Aninglia chu twikong tuna ding sum-eng khom li aki phut cheh in, hiche akhom ho jong hi ajet aveija pahcha lim toh kilhah tha cheh ahiuve.
en: Every base had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze; and its four feet had supports. The supports were cast beneath the basin, with wreaths at the side of each.
text:
1KI 7:30
Thadou: Kangtalai khat cheh chun sum-eng a kisem kang li cheh leh sum-eng jol li cheh anei uve. Aninglia chu twikong tuna ding sum-eng khom li aki phut cheh in, hiche akhom ho jong hi ajet aveija pahcha lim toh kilhah tha cheh ahiuve.
English: Every base had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze; and its four feet had supports. The supports were cast beneath the basin, with wreaths at the side of each.

tcz: Kangtalai chungvuma chun kisilna kong sin ding abem khat akikoiyin, aki hondoh’a ahi leh chunglam angan, athuh dan chu tongkhat athuh e, aki hondoh na akam chu abem in, khom tunlut na ding’a kisem ahi jeh chun tongkhat athuh in ahi. Akihonna a jong chu pahcha aki sem in, amai tomna jong aning li noija kibol ahin, abem poi.
en: Its opening within the capital and above was a cubit. Its opening was round like the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also on its opening were engravings, and their panels were square, not round.
text:
1KI 7:31
Thadou: Kangtalai chungvuma chun kisilna kong sin ding abem khat akikoiyin, aki hondoh’a ahi leh chunglam angan, athuh dan chu tongkhat athuh e, aki hondoh na akam chu abem in, khom tunlut na ding’a kisem ahi jeh chun tongkhat athuh in ahi. Akihonna a jong chu pahcha aki sem in, amai tomna jong aning li noija kibol ahin, abem poi.
English: Its opening within the capital and above was a cubit. Its opening was round like the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also on its opening were engravings, and their panels were square, not round.

tcz: Akangho chu kangtalai kang tobang ahin, Sum-eng chaokol li chu amai tomna noija chun aki bat in, chuleh chaokol sunga kithilpai sum-eng jol chengse chu akhom todal chengse chutoh tikhat bang in aum uve, chaokol khat cheh chu a sandol tongkhat le tongkeh alhinge.
en: The four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axles of the wheels were in the base. The height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
text:
1KI 7:32
Thadou: Akangho chu kangtalai kang tobang ahin, Sum-eng chaokol li chu amai tomna noija chun aki bat in, chuleh chaokol sunga kithilpai sum-eng jol chengse chu akhom todal chengse chutoh tikhat bang in aum uve, chaokol khat cheh chu a sandol tongkhat le tongkeh alhinge.
English: The four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axles of the wheels were in the base. The height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

tcz: Hiche chaokol hohi kangtalai velkol ho tobang’a khu kisem cheh ahiuvin, ajolpi a pangho ahin, avel tomna ahin, ajolpi kah a kipheh thih jang ho ahin, chule alaja athih jang jouse ki suhtona avel bem ahin aboncha aki lhahjol tho jeng ahiuve.
en: The work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel. Their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all of cast metal.
text:
1KI 7:33
Thadou: Hiche chaokol hohi kangtalai velkol ho tobang’a khu kisem cheh ahiuvin, ajolpi a pangho ahin, avel tomna ahin, ajolpi kah a kipheh thih jang ho ahin, chule alaja athih jang jouse ki suhtona avel bem ahin aboncha aki lhahjol tho jeng ahiuve.
English: The work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel. Their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all of cast metal.

tcz: Khom todal khat cheh achun aning lia aki ngapna ding li cheh aum in, a kingapna chengse le akhom todal chengse jong chu tikhat tobang bang ahiuve.
en: There were four supports at the four corners of each base. Its supports were of the base itself.
text:
1KI 7:34
Thadou: Khom todal khat cheh achun aning lia aki ngapna ding li cheh aum in, a kingapna chengse le akhom todal chengse jong chu tikhat tobang bang ahiuve.
English: There were four supports at the four corners of each base. Its supports were of the base itself.

tcz: Khom todal chung chun akol a kivei khat khao tobang'in aum in, tongkeh khat ahung sang doh e, chu tengle khom todal chunga aki buna ding leh amai tomna ho jong chu likhat bang in akisem thai.
en: In the top of the base there was a round band half a cubit high; and on the top of the base its supports and its panels were the same.
text:
1KI 7:35
Thadou: Khom todal chung chun akol a kivei khat khao tobang'in aum in, tongkeh khat ahung sang doh e, chu tengle khom todal chunga aki buna ding leh amai tomna ho jong chu likhat bang in akisem thai.
English: In the top of the base there was a round band half a cubit high; and on the top of the base its supports and its panels were the same.

tcz: Akibuna ding amai dungle amai tomna dunga jong chun aman Cherubim lim holeh kei pi bahkai lim semnan chule tum thing phung limho semnan amang in, adolle adol lou dung juiyin asom in, akimvel’a chun pahcha jeng asem peh in ahi.
en: On the plates of its supports and on its panels, he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, each in its space, with wreaths all around.
text:
1KI 7:36
Thadou: Akibuna ding amai dungle amai tomna dunga jong chun aman Cherubim lim holeh kei pi bahkai lim semnan chule tum thing phung limho semnan amang in, adolle adol lou dung juiyin asom in, akimvel’a chun pahcha jeng asem peh in ahi.
English: On the plates of its supports and on its panels, he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, each in its space, with wreaths all around.

tcz: Chujou vin hitobang asem chaisoh phat in a khom todal som asem in aboncha chu kibang cheh a ki lhajol ahin, alet le aneo jong aki bang in alimle agong jong aki bang cheh e.
en: He made the ten bases in this way: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form.
text:
1KI 7:37
Thadou: Chujou vin hitobang asem chaisoh phat in a khom todal som asem in aboncha chu kibang cheh a ki lhajol ahin, alet le aneo jong aki bang in alimle agong jong aki bang cheh e.
English: He made the ten bases in this way: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form.

tcz: Kisilna ding jong sum-eng kong somkhat asem in kisilna kongkhat cheh chun tui tena somli li adolin, kisilna kongkhat cheh chu tongli alhing cheh in, khom todal khat cheh ding chun kisilna kongkhat akikoije.
en: He made ten basins of bronze. One basin contained forty baths. Every basin measured four cubits. One basin was on every one of the ten bases.
text:
1KI 7:38
Thadou: Kisilna ding jong sum-eng kong somkhat asem in kisilna kongkhat cheh chun tui tena somli li adolin, kisilna kongkhat cheh chu tongli alhing cheh in, khom todal khat cheh ding chun kisilna kongkhat akikoije.
English: He made ten basins of bronze. One basin contained forty baths. Every basin measured four cubits. One basin was on every one of the ten bases.

tcz: Chuin khom todal chengse chu atung doh sohkei jin, houin lhanglama chun khomtodal nga aphut in houin sahlam a jong khomtodal nga ma aphutdoh e, chule lhanglam nisolam houin ninga chun tuikong chu adon ahi.
en: He set the bases, five on the right side of the house and five on the left side of the house. He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward and toward the south.
text:
1KI 7:39
Thadou: Chuin khom todal chengse chu atung doh sohkei jin, houin lhanglama chun khomtodal nga aphut in houin sahlam a jong khomtodal nga ma aphutdoh e, chule lhanglam nisolam houin ninga chun tuikong chu adon ahi.
English: He set the bases, five on the right side of the house and five on the left side of the house. He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward and toward the south.

tcz: Hiram chun belho jong leilona ho jong tuibel hojong asemsoh keije,hitihin Hiramin Solomon lengpa panpina Pakai Houin sahna ding chungchanga atohpeh ding jouse chu abonchan atongsoh heltan ahi.
en: Hiram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished doing all the work that he worked for King Solomon in the LORD’s house:
text:
1KI 7:40
Thadou: Hiram chun belho jong leilona ho jong tuibel hojong asemsoh keije,hitihin Hiramin Solomon lengpa panpina Pakai Houin sahna ding chungchanga atohpeh ding jouse chu abonchan atongsoh heltan ahi.
English: Hiram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished doing all the work that he worked for King Solomon in the LORD’s house:

tcz: Khompi teni ahin, khompi teni tomna dinga alujum kisem teni ahin chule alujum leiteni tomna dinga sum-eng chaokol jilla kijil teni ahin, lenchapeh a kipheh khompi teni lutomna kimang teni jong ahin,
en: the two pillars; the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;

tcz: Lencha pheh banga kipheh teni dinga kisem kolbuthei pah tobang jali jen ahin, khompi teni lutomna ding’a kibol Lencha pheh banga ki pheh khat cheh a pang dia golni’a ding kol buthei pah kisem cheng se chu toh ahi.
en: the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars;

tcz: Khomtodal chengse ahin khomtodal chunga pang ding tuibel som jong ahi.
en: the ten bases; the ten basins on the bases;

tcz: Chujongle tuikong khat ahin, hiche tuikong kisem noija chun bongchal somleni lim akiseme.
en: the one sea; the twelve oxen under the sea;

tcz: Bel ahin leilona ho ahin, kisilna kongho ahin Pakai insunga kimang kongle bel jouse hi Hiram in Solomon lengpa dinga ana sema, sum-eng jeng’a ana lheh ahi.
en: the pots; the shovels; and the basins. All of these vessels, which Hiram made for King Solomon in the LORD’s house, were of burnished bronze.
text:
1KI 7:45
Thadou: Bel ahin leilona ho ahin, kisilna kongho ahin Pakai insunga kimang kongle bel jouse hi Hiram in Solomon lengpa dinga ana sema, sum-eng jeng’a ana lheh ahi.
English: the pots; the shovels; and the basins. All of these vessels, which Hiram made for King Solomon in the LORD’s house, were of burnished bronze.

tcz: Jordan vadung pang phaicham lah a Succoth le Zerethan kikah a bel lei kimuna dinga chu Lengpa’n ana lheh ahiye.
en: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.
text:
1KI 7:46
Thadou: Jordan vadung pang phaicham lah a Succoth le Zerethan kikah a bel lei kimuna dinga chu Lengpa’n ana lheh ahiye.
English: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.

tcz: Kongle bel atam behseh phat in Solomon in tetoh louvin aban umsah gam tan ahi, hijeh chun sum-eng chengse chu ijat monga gih hi ding ham ti hetdoh lou in aum doh lotai.
en: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.
text:
1KI 7:47
Thadou: Kongle bel atam behseh phat in Solomon in tetoh louvin aban umsah gam tan ahi, hijeh chun sum-eng chengse chu ijat monga gih hi ding ham ti hetdoh lou in aum doh lotai.
English: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.

tcz: Solomon in Pakai houin sunga manchah ding thil le lo asem chengse chu hicheng hi ahi, sana maicham ahin, kilhaina ding changlhah todoh na ding dokhang ahin,
en: Solomon made all the vessels that were in the LORD’s house: the golden altar and the table that the show bread was on, of gold;

tcz: Sana thengsella kisem thaomei khom ahin, insung dan mun theng maija akitung in lhanglam ngan abah nga akitung in, sahlam ngan bah nga ma aki tung’e, pahcha lim kisemle thaomei ho ahin, cheiche chengse chutoh ahin, sana jong ahiuve.
en: and the lamp stands, five on the right side and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary, of pure gold; and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;

tcz: Akhom chengse le thaomei jeng chengse toh, kisilna kong hole gim namtui halna cheng ahin, khangbel jong ahin, aboncha chu sana jeng’a kisema ahi, chu jongle mun theng chung nung pen kitilai houin dan sung nung penna kotpi dunga akot bil ding jong sana jeng ahin hou in lailunga kotpi kil jouse jong sana mama ahi cheh e.
en: the cups, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, of the temple, of gold.
text:
1KI 7:50
Thadou: Akhom chengse le thaomei jeng chengse toh, kisilna kong hole gim namtui halna cheng ahin, khangbel jong ahin, aboncha chu sana jeng’a kisema ahi, chu jongle mun theng chung nung pen kitilai houin dan sung nung penna kotpi dunga akot bil ding jong sana jeng ahin hou in lailunga kotpi kil jouse jong sana mama ahi cheh e.
English: the cups, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, of the temple, of gold.

tcz: Hitobang hin Pakai houin sahna chung change Solomon lengpan abol ding jouse chu aboldoh tan aki chaisoh heltai chu jong leh Solomon chun apa David nin ana kat dohsa thil jouse ahin polut pai pai jin dangka jong, kongle bel jouse jong abonchan Pakai houin sunga thil kholna insunga akhol khom sahtan ahi.
en: Thus all the work that King Solomon did in the LORD’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and put them in the treasuries of the LORD’s house.
text:
1KI 7:51
Thadou: Hitobang hin Pakai houin sahna chung change Solomon lengpan abol ding jouse chu aboldoh tan aki chaisoh heltai chu jong leh Solomon chun apa David nin ana kat dohsa thil jouse ahin polut pai pai jin dangka jong, kongle bel jouse jong abonchan Pakai houin sunga thil kholna insunga akhol khom sahtan ahi.
English: Thus all the work that King Solomon did in the LORD’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and put them in the treasuries of the LORD’s house.

tcz: Solomon Lengpan Israelte phung bahkai holeh phung jouse lamkai hole upa ho jouse Jerusalema hunga David khopi Zionna kona Pakai kitepna thingkong chu hinpu’a Houina thahlut dingin akou khom tan ahi.
en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel with all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.
text:
1KI 8:1
Thadou: Solomon Lengpan Israelte phung bahkai holeh phung jouse lamkai hole upa ho jouse Jerusalema hunga David khopi Zionna kona Pakai kitepna thingkong chu hinpu’a Houina thahlut dingin akou khom tan ahi.
English: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel with all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

tcz: Hiti chun Israelte chu lha sagi channa Ethanim lhasung in hoibitna golvah umkhom dingin ahung kikhom tauvin ahi.
en: All the men of Israel assembled themselves to King Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
text:
1KI 8:2
Thadou: Hiti chun Israelte chu lha sagi channa Ethanim lhasung in hoibitna golvah umkhom dingin ahung kikhom tauvin ahi.
English: All the men of Israel assembled themselves to King Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

tcz: Israel lamkaiho jouse ahung kikhop khom phat un thempu hon apu uvin akipat doh tauvin,
en: All the elders of Israel came, and the priests picked up the ark.
text:
1KI 8:3
Thadou: Israel lamkaiho jouse ahung kikhop khom phat un thempu hon apu uvin akipat doh tauvin,
English: All the elders of Israel came, and the priests picked up the ark.

tcz: Levite le thempu hon Pakai umpina ponbuh chuleh manchah thengho jouse chutoh Houin ah apo lut un ahi.
en: They brought up the LORD’s ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The priests and the Levites brought these up.
text:
1KI 8:4
Thadou: Levite le thempu hon Pakai umpina ponbuh chuleh manchah thengho jouse chutoh Houin ah apo lut un ahi.
English: They brought up the LORD’s ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The priests and the Levites brought these up.

tcz: Solomon Lengpa leh Israel mipiho jouse chu Pakai kitepna thingkong masanga chun aki khom un kelngoi tamtah leh bongchal tamtah athat un kilhaina pumgo thilto abol'un agancha thao hochu atam behseh jeh in simjou ahi pon ahi.
en: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were assembled to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.
text:
1KI 8:5
Thadou: Solomon Lengpa leh Israel mipiho jouse chu Pakai kitepna thingkong masanga chun aki khom un kelngoi tamtah leh bongchal tamtah athat un kilhaina pumgo thilto abol'un agancha thao hochu atam behseh jeh in simjou ahi pon ahi.
English: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were assembled to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

tcz: Hichun thempu hon Pakai kitepna thingkong chu Houin sunga apolut un Cherubimim teni lhaving noi muntheng chungnung penna chun akai tauvin ahi.
en: The priests brought in the ark of the LORD’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the cherubim’s wings.
text:
1KI 8:6
Thadou: Hichun thempu hon Pakai kitepna thingkong chu Houin sunga apolut un Cherubimim teni lhaving noi muntheng chungnung penna chun akai tauvin ahi.
English: The priests brought in the ark of the LORD’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the cherubim’s wings.

tcz: Hitichun thingkong chuleh aputna moljol teni jong chu Cherubim teni lhalim teni noija chun aum tan ahi.
en: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.
text:
1KI 8:7
Thadou: Hitichun thingkong chuleh aputna moljol teni jong chu Cherubim teni lhalim teni noija chun aum tan ahi.
English: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

tcz: Hiche aputna mol teni hi munthengpen masang’a chu idin leh jangpet in akimu thei jin, mun choma kon vang'in akimu thei pon ahi. Hiche moljol teni hi tuni geijin aum nalai je.
en: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the holy place before the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside. They are there to this day.
text:
1KI 8:8
Thadou: Hiche aputna mol teni hi munthengpen masang’a chu idin leh jangpet in akimu thei jin, mun choma kon vang'in akimu thei pon ahi. Hiche moljol teni hi tuni geijin aum nalai je.
English: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the holy place before the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside. They are there to this day.

tcz: Hiche kitepna thingkong sung’a hin thildang aum pon Israelte Egypt a kona ahung pot doh uva Pathen in Sinai mol’a Mose ana peh Israelte toh aki tepna song pheng teni bouchu a um'in ahi.
en: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
text:
1KI 8:9
Thadou: Hiche kitepna thingkong sung’a hin thildang aum pon Israelte Egypt a kona ahung pot doh uva Pathen in Sinai mol’a Mose ana peh Israelte toh aki tepna song pheng teni bouchu a um'in ahi.
English: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

tcz: Thempuho chu muntheng pena kona ahung potdoh teng uleh meilom sa-tah chun Houin chu akhu khum jeng jin ahi
en: It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the LORD’s house,
text:
1KI 8:10
Thadou: Thempuho chu muntheng pena kona ahung potdoh teng uleh meilom sa-tah chun Houin chu akhu khum jeng jin ahi
English: It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the LORD’s house,

tcz: Meilom chun Houin ahin khu teng leh Pathen loupi na chun houin alo dim ji in Thempu hon na atong jom thei ji tapouvin ahi.
en: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house.
text:
1KI 8:11
Thadou: Meilom chun Houin ahin khu teng leh Pathen loupi na chun houin alo dim ji in Thempu hon na atong jom thei ji tapouvin ahi.
English: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh Solomon in taona amang jin, “O Pakai! Meilom a khun kaum ji nana ti,
en: Then Solomon said, “The LORD has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
text:
1KI 8:12
Thadou: Hiteng chuleh Solomon in taona amang jin, “O Pakai! Meilom a khun kaum ji nana ti,
English: Then Solomon said, “The LORD has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

tcz: Pakai tuhin Tonsotna na chen na thei dingin hiche houin thupitah hi ka sahdoh peh tan ahi!” ati.
en: I have surely built you a house of habitation, a place for you to dwell in forever.”
text:
1KI 8:13
Thadou: Pakai tuhin Tonsotna na chen na thei dingin hiche houin thupitah hi ka sahdoh peh tan ahi!” ati.
English: I have surely built you a house of habitation, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

tcz: Hijou teng chu leh Lengpa chu ahung ki heijin avel’a ding mihon pi hiti hin phatthei aboh jin ahi.
en: The king turned his face around and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.
text:
1KI 8:14
Thadou: Hijou teng chu leh Lengpa chu ahung ki heijin avel’a ding mihon pi hiti hin phatthei aboh jin ahi.
English: The king turned his face around and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

tcz: “Israelte Pakai Pathen chu thangvah in umhen! Aman kapa David kom’a ana kitep na chu amolso tan ahi, ajeh chu Aman kapa kom ah,
en: He said, “Blessed is the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David your father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,
text:
1KI 8:15
Thadou: “Israelte Pakai Pathen chu thangvah in umhen! Aman kapa David kom’a ana kitep na chu amolso tan ahi, ajeh chu Aman kapa kom ah,
English: He said, “Blessed is the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David your father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

tcz: ‘Kami Israelte chu Egypt makona kahin puidoh a pat chun, keima ei kihouna ding houin aki sahna dingin Israelte chenna gam khopi khatcha jong kana lhengpon ahinlah David nangma hi kami Israelte chunga vaihom dingin kana lheng in ahi!’” anati.
en: ‘Since the day that I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house, that my name might be there; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.’
text:
1KI 8:16
Thadou: ‘Kami Israelte chu Egypt makona kahin puidoh a pat chun, keima ei kihouna ding houin aki sahna dingin Israelte chenna gam khopi khatcha jong kana lhengpon ahinlah David nangma hi kami Israelte chunga vaihom dingin kana lheng in ahi!’” anati.
English: ‘Since the day that I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house, that my name might be there; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.’

tcz: Chuin Solomon chun aseiben, “Kapa David chun Israelte Pakai Pathen min loupi dopsang na dingin houin ana sa gon ahi.
en: “Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
text:
1KI 8:17
Thadou: Chuin Solomon chun aseiben, “Kapa David chun Israelte Pakai Pathen min loupi dopsang na dingin houin ana sa gon ahi.
English: “Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

tcz: Pakaiyin Keima min Loupina ding’a Houin sah nagot nalungtup chu ahoi nai,
en: But the LORD said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.
text:
1KI 8:18
Thadou: Pakaiyin Keima min Loupina ding’a Houin sah nagot nalungtup chu ahoi nai,
English: But the LORD said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.

tcz: Hinlah hiche Houin sa ding chu nang nahipoi, keima min loupina Houin sa ding chu na chate lah a khatpen in asah ding ahi bouve!” ati.
en: Nevertheless, you shall not build the house; but your son who shall come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’
text:
1KI 8:19
Thadou: Hinlah hiche Houin sa ding chu nang nahipoi, keima min loupina Houin sa ding chu na chate lah a khatpen in asah ding ahi bouve!” ati.
English: Nevertheless, you shall not build the house; but your son who shall come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’

tcz: “Tun Pakai nang in na kitepna chu na lolhin sahtan kapa khel lin keima leng ka hung chang tan chuleh Pakai nangma nakitepna bang in Israel laltouna a chun keima ka laltoutan ahi. Tun Israel Pakai Pathen nangma min loupina dingin houin chu ka hin tungdoh tan ahi.
en: The LORD has established his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
text:
1KI 8:20
Thadou: “Tun Pakai nang in na kitepna chu na lolhin sahtan kapa khel lin keima leng ka hung chang tan chuleh Pakai nangma nakitepna bang in Israel laltouna a chun keima ka laltoutan ahi. Tun Israel Pakai Pathen nangma min loupina dingin houin chu ka hin tungdoh tan ahi.
English: The LORD has established his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

tcz: Chuleh Pakai nang in kapu kapa te’u Egypt a kona na hin pui doh hotoh nana ki tepna thingkong jong chu akei na ding kahin gong tan ahi,” ati.
en: There I have set a place for the ark, in which is the LORD’s covenant, which he made with our fathers when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.”
text:
1KI 8:21
Thadou: Chuleh Pakai nang in kapu kapa te’u Egypt a kona na hin pui doh hotoh nana ki tepna thingkong jong chu akei na ding kahin gong tan ahi,” ati.
English: There I have set a place for the ark, in which is the LORD’s covenant, which he made with our fathers when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.”

tcz: Hijou chun, Solomon chu Israel mipite jouse masang Pakai maicham noija chun adingin, vanlam’ah akhut adom sang in,
en: Solomon stood before the LORD’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven;

tcz: Hitin atao tai, “Vo Pakai Israel Pathen, hiche vannoi leiset ahin nang tobang Pathen dang aum poi, Nang ma mitmu’a alung thim pumpia kal songho chung ah na kitepna dung juiyin na ngailut na lhasam louhel in na musah jing in ahi.
en: and he said, “LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like you, in heaven above, or on earth beneath; who keeps covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

tcz: Nangin kapa David kom a nakitepna chu nalhakang pon ahi. Nangman nakam’a naphondoh na kitepna bang in na khut tah’in tunin na lolhin sah tan ahi,” ati.
en: who has kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.
text:
1KI 8:24
Thadou: Nangin kapa David kom a nakitepna chu nalhakang pon ahi. Nangman nakam’a naphondoh na kitepna bang in na khut tah’in tunin na lolhin sah tan ahi,” ati.
English: who has kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

tcz: “Tun O Pakai Israel Pathen, nang in kapa David komma nana kitepna abanjong chu subulhit tan, ajeh chu nangman ama kom’a nana seichun na chilhah ten lamdih ahin chepi uva, nang chouna banga kitahna neitah a ajui uva ahileh nachate lah’a khat pen pen chu Israel Laltouna a hung toupeh ding ahibouve na ti chu,
en: Now therefore, may LORD, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk before me as you have walked before me.’
text:
1KI 8:25
Thadou: “Tun O Pakai Israel Pathen, nang in kapa David komma nana kitepna abanjong chu subulhit tan, ajeh chu nangman ama kom’a nana seichun na chilhah ten lamdih ahin chepi uva, nang chouna banga kitahna neitah a ajui uva ahileh nachate lah’a khat pen pen chu Israel Laltouna a hung toupeh ding ahibouve na ti chu,
English: Now therefore, may LORD, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk before me as you have walked before me.’

tcz: O Israel Pathen! Nasohpa kapa David kom’a hitia nana kitepna chu tuhin subulhit tan,” ati.
en: “Now therefore, God of Israel, please let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David my father.
text:
1KI 8:26
Thadou: O Israel Pathen! Nasohpa kapa David kom’a hitia nana kitepna chu tuhin subulhit tan,” ati.
English: “Now therefore, God of Israel, please let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David my father.

tcz: “Ahinlah Pathen chu hiche leiset a hi iti chen ding ham? Ahipoi, van sangpen in jong na dol ponte chuti ahileh hiche keiman ka tundoh Houin hin iti na dol ding ham?
en: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house that I have built!
text:
1KI 8:27
Thadou: “Ahinlah Pathen chu hiche leiset a hi iti chen ding ham? Ahipoi, van sangpen in jong na dol ponte chuti ahileh hiche keiman ka tundoh Houin hin iti na dol ding ham?
English: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house that I have built!

tcz: Ahinlah, O Pakai ka Pathen kataona le kathum nahi nei ngaipeh in, na sohpa na kom’a kaka nale ka taona hi nei ngai peh tei jin,
en: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and for his supplication, LORD my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you today;

tcz: Nang in kamin umjing ding ahi, nana tina hiche Houin hi asun ajan in hin velhi jing in lang, hiche lang ngatna katao chan’in nangin kataona nei ngaipeh in.
en: that your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, ‘My name shall be there;’ to listen to the prayer which your servant prays toward this place.
text:
1KI 8:29
Thadou: Nang in kamin umjing ding ahi, nana tina hiche Houin hi asun ajan in hin velhi jing in lang, hiche lang ngatna katao chan’in nangin kataona nei ngaipeh in.
English: that your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, ‘My name shall be there;’ to listen to the prayer which your servant prays toward this place.

en: Listen to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear in heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.

en: that they may fear you all the days that they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

text:
1KI 8:41

English: (for they shall hear of your great name and of your mighty hand and of your outstretched arm), when he comes and prays toward this house,

tcz: Hiteng chule nachenna vanna konin hin ngaipeh inlang chule ataona’u chu hin sanpeh in. Hitia chu nami Israelten na hat bang uva hi Leiset chung’a mipiho jouse hin na hinna ahin hetdiu nahin gindiu ahi. Amaho jong hin namin loupi na dingin hiche Houin ka hin tundoh hi ahin hetdiu ahi.
en: hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name, to fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.
text:

text:

tcz: “Amahon nangma douna ahung chonset jeng uva ahileh koihi achonse khalou um am? Nangma jeng jong nalung hanga agalmiteu na josah thei ahilouleh agal miteuvin agam uva gal hing’a na kaimang sahthei jong ahi.
en: If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to the land of the enemy, far off or near;

1KI 8:47
Thadou: Ahinlah hiche a asoh channau migam’a chu alung’u ahin hei uva nangma kom ahinbel uva, keiho ka chonse uvin thilse tah tah bol kahi tauve atiuva ahung tao uleh,
English: yet if they repent in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of those who carried them captive, saying, ‘We have sinned and have done perversely; we have dealt wickedly,’

en: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who carried them captive, and pray to you toward their land which you gave to their fathers, the city which you have chosen and the house which I have built for your name,

en: then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, your dwelling place, and maintain their cause;

text:

en: (for they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out of Egypt, from the middle of the iron furnace);

en: that your eyes may be open to the supplication of your servant and to the supplication of your people Israel, to listen to them whenever they cry to you.
text:

English: that your eyes may be open to the supplication of your servant and to the supplication of your people Israel, to listen to them whenever they cry to you.

tcz: Ajeh chu, O Leng chungnung Pakai nang in na soh Mose kom’a chun Israelte hi leiset chunga nam dang ho lah’a kon’a nang’a dinga nami deilhen ahiuve nana tin ahi,” ati.
en: For you separated them from among all the peoples of the earth to be your inheritance, as you spoke by Moses your servant, when you brought our fathers out of Egypt, Lord GOD.”
text:
1KI 8:53
Thadou: Ajeh chu, O Leng chungnung Pakai nang in na soh Mose kom’a chun Israelte hi leiset chunga nam dang ho lah’a kon’a nang’a dinga nami deilhen ahiuve nana tin ahi,” ati.
English: For you separated them from among all the peoples of the earth to be your inheritance, as you spoke by Moses your servant, when you brought our fathers out of Egypt, Lord GOD.”

tcz: Solomon in hiche Pakai kom’a atao sunga chu akhut teni van chung langa adop sang’a ana dilsu’a ahin; taona ho leh athil thum hohi achaiphat in Pakai maicham maija chun a dingdoh in,
en: It was so, that when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to the LORD, he arose from before the LORD’s altar, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven.
text:
1KI 8:54
Thadou: Solomon in hiche Pakai kom’a atao sunga chu akhut teni van chung langa adop sang’a ana dilsu’a ahin; taona ho leh athil thum hohi achaiphat in Pakai maicham maija chun a dingdoh in,
English: It was so, that when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to the LORD, he arose from before the LORD’s altar, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven.

tcz: Israel mipi ho jouse chu phatthei aboh in ahi.
en: He stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
text:
1KI 8:55
Thadou: Israel mipi ho jouse chu phatthei aboh in ahi.
English: He stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

tcz: “Pathen chu thangvah in umhen, ajeh chu aman amite Israel tehi aman ana kitepna jouse hi einatep peh bang bang un, ki choldona phat chu eimu sah tauve. Aman alhachapa Mose akon’a ana phondohsa ana kitepna thil loupi tah ho chu khatcha athon um louvin ahin tongdoh soh kei tan ahi.
en: “Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.
text:
1KI 8:56
Thadou: “Pathen chu thangvah in umhen, ajeh chu aman amite Israel tehi aman ana kitepna jouse hi einatep peh bang bang un, ki choldona phat chu eimu sah tauve. Aman alhachapa Mose akon’a ana phondohsa ana kitepna thil loupi tah ho chu khatcha athon um louvin ahin tongdoh soh kei tan ahi.
English: “Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.

tcz: Pakai i-Pathen uvin ipu ipate’u ana umpi bang in eiho jong ei-umpi jing tauhen, aman ei dalhah da uhenlang ei-pai jong ei-pai doh hih beh u-hen!
en: May the LORD our God be with us as he was with our fathers. Let him not leave us or forsake us,
text:
1KI 8:57
Thadou: Pakai i-Pathen uvin ipu ipate’u ana umpi bang in eiho jong ei-umpi jing tauhen, aman ei dalhah da uhenlang ei-pai jong ei-pai doh hih beh u-hen!
English: May the LORD our God be with us as he was with our fathers. Let him not leave us or forsake us,

tcz: Imalam jouse’a ama deilam hinkho eimansah’u hen lang, chuleh ama thupeh leh Dan semho ei nitsah’u henlang chuleh alunglhaina lampia ipu ipate’u ana pui bang in eiho jong epui u-hen.
en: that he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.
text:
1KI 8:58
Thadou: Imalam jouse’a ama deilam hinkho eimansah’u hen lang, chuleh ama thupeh leh Dan semho ei nitsah’u henlang chuleh alunglhaina lampia ipu ipate’u ana pui bang in eiho jong epui u-hen.
English: that he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.

tcz: Chuleh Pakai anga tunia ka taona thucheng hohi asun ajan in a-angsung’a ging jing hen, hitia chu ami Israel te hi nitin i-ngaichat dung jui uva thu dih’a eipui theina diuvin.
en: Let these my words, with which I have made supplication before the LORD, be near to the LORD our God day and night, that he may maintain the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel, as every day requires;

tcz: Hiteng le chun vannoi leiset acheng mihem jousen Pakai bou hi Pathen ahi, adang aumpoi ti ahin het diu ahitai.
en: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD himself is God. There is no one else.
text:
1KI 8:60
Thadou: Hiteng le chun vannoi leiset acheng mihem jousen Pakai bou hi Pathen ahi, adang aumpoi ti ahin het diu ahitai.
English: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD himself is God. There is no one else.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh nang hon jong Pakai i-Pathen kitahna lhingsetna najui diu, chuleh a chondan holeh a thupeh ho jouse hi tuni chan geija na hinjui ahileh najui lhung kei theidi’u ahi,” ati.
en: “Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as it is today.”
text:
1KI 8:61
Thadou: Hiteng chuleh nang hon jong Pakai i-Pathen kitahna lhingsetna najui diu, chuleh a chondan holeh a thupeh ho jouse hi tuni chan geija na hinjui ahileh najui lhung kei theidi’u ahi,” ati.
English: “Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as it is today.”

tcz: Hijou chun Lengpa leh Israel mipiten kilhaina gantha abol tauvin ahi.
en: The king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.
text:
1KI 8:62
Thadou: Hijou chun Lengpa leh Israel mipiten kilhaina gantha abol tauvin ahi.
English: The king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.

tcz: Solomon in chamna thilto in a bongchal sangsomni le sangni atoh in kelngoite le kelcha sangsom le sangni atoh in ahi. Hiti hin Lengpa le Israel mipi ten Pakai hou in achun katdohna anei un ahi.
en: Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to the LORD, twenty two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the LORD’s house.
text:
1KI 8:63
Thadou: Solomon in chamna thilto in a bongchal sangsomni le sangni atoh in kelngoite le kelcha sangsom le sangni atoh in ahi. Hiti hin Lengpa le Israel mipi ten Pakai hou in achun katdohna anei un ahi.
English: Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to the LORD, twenty two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the LORD’s house.

tcz: Hiche nikho mama hin lengpan Pakai houin maiya hongcha chu athenso in ahi. Aman hikom chun pumgo thilto atoh in, lhosoh thilto jong atoh doh in chamna thil to sathao jong atoh in asuhtheng ahi, ajeh chu Pakai angsung’a kido sum-eng maicham chu pumgo thiltona, lhosoh thiltona, chamna thilto, sathaoho todoh nadinga kitung chu neo behseh tan ahi.
en: The same day the king made the middle of the court holy that was before the LORD’s house; for there he offered the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings.
text:
1KI 8:64
Thadou: Hiche nikho mama hin lengpan Pakai houin maiya hongcha chu athenso in ahi. Aman hikom chun pumgo thilto atoh in, lhosoh thilto jong atoh doh in chamna thil to sathao jong atoh in asuhtheng ahi, ajeh chu Pakai angsung’a kido sum-eng maicham chu pumgo thiltona, lhosoh thiltona, chamna thilto, sathaoho todoh nadinga kitung chu neo behseh tan ahi.
English: The same day the king made the middle of the court holy that was before the LORD’s house; for there he offered the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings.

tcz: Hijouchun Solomon leh Israel pumpin Pakai Pathen angsunga hoibitna golvah kut abol'un ahi. Sahlanga Lebo-hamath napat lhanglam Egypt twinah putna chan gei jin mipi tamtah akikhom doh un ahi. Hiche golvah hi agommin ni som le nili alut in ni sagi hi maicham katdohna ahin, ni sagi hi hoibitna golvah kut ahi.
en: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven more days, even fourteen days.
text:
1KI 8:65
Thadou: Hijouchun Solomon leh Israel pumpin Pakai Pathen angsunga hoibitna golvah kut abol'un ahi. Sahlanga Lebo-hamath napat lhanglam Egypt twinah putna chan gei jin mipi tamtah akikhom doh un ahi. Hiche golvah hi agommin ni som le nili alut in ni sagi hi maicham katdohna ahin, ni sagi hi hoibitna golvah kut ahi.
English: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven more days, even fourteen days.

tcz: Hiche golvah hi a kichaisoh phat in, Solomon in miho chu a incheh a asol tan ahi. Amahon lengpa chu phatthei aboh un kipah tahle thanom tah in ain uva a kinung le tauvin ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai hi alhacha David ding leh Israel mipite dingin apha lheh jengin ahi.
en: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went to their tents joyful and glad in their hearts for all the goodness that the LORD had shown to David his servant, and to Israel his people.
text:
1KI 8:66
Thadou: Hiche golvah hi a kichaisoh phat in, Solomon in miho chu a incheh a asol tan ahi. Amahon lengpa chu phatthei aboh un kipah tahle thanom tah in ain uva a kinung le tauvin ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai hi alhacha David ding leh Israel mipite dingin apha lheh jengin ahi.
English: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went to their tents joyful and glad in their hearts for all the goodness that the LORD had shown to David his servant, and to Israel his people.

tcz: Tun Solomon in Pakai Houin leh ama Leng inpi asa chaitan ahi. Aman toh dinga agon toh dungjuijin ijakai atongchai soh hel tan ahi.
en: When Solomon had finished the building of the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,
text:
1KI 9:1
Thadou: Tun Solomon in Pakai Houin leh ama Leng inpi asa chaitan ahi. Aman toh dinga agon toh dungjuijin ijakai atongchai soh hel tan ahi.
English: When Solomon had finished the building of the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,

tcz: Hichun Pakai chu tu masang’a Gibeon na ana kilah bang bang in, tun ani vei channa in Solomon kom ah ahung kilah kit tan ahi.
en: The LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.
text:
1KI 9:2
Thadou: Hichun Pakai chu tu masang’a Gibeon na ana kilah bang bang in, tun ani vei channa in Solomon kom ah ahung kilah kit tan ahi.
English: The LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.

tcz: Pakaiyin, “Keiman natao nale na ngaichat na hinlhut hochu kahe tai. Keiman hiche houin hi ka thenso tai. Hichehi ai-tih channa keima min kija jing na dinga nasahdoh ahitai. Hiche hi ka lungthim gil’a ka ngainat khat ahijeh'in keiman hiche hi vesui jing nang’e.
en: The LORD said to him, “I have heard your prayer and your supplication that you have made before me. I have made this house holy, which you have built, to put my name there forever; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.
text:
1KI 9:3
Thadou: Pakaiyin, “Keiman natao nale na ngaichat na hinlhut hochu kahe tai. Keiman hiche houin hi ka thenso tai. Hichehi ai-tih channa keima min kija jing na dinga nasahdoh ahitai. Hiche hi ka lungthim gil’a ka ngainat khat ahijeh'in keiman hiche hi vesui jing nang’e.
English: The LORD said to him, “I have heard your prayer and your supplication that you have made before me. I have made this house holy, which you have built, to put my name there forever; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

tcz: Chuleh nang in napa David banga kitah tahleh lungtheng tah’a neijuiya, kathupeh leh ka Dan ho nanit jing’a kachondan najui jing’a ahileh,
