en: As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, in integrity of heart and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,
text:
1KI 9:4
Thadou: Chuleh nang in napa David banga kitah tahleh lungtheng tah’a neijuiya, kathupeh leh ka Dan ho nanit jing’a kachondan najui jing’a ahileh,
English: As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, in integrity of heart and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,

tcz: Hitengle chun Israel lenggam hi tonsotna katundoh jing ding ahi. Ajeh chu napa David kom’a kana kitepna banga Israel laltouna’a hi nachilhah khat katousah jing ding ahi.
en: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I promised to David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man on the throne of Israel.’
text:
1KI 9:5
Thadou: Hitengle chun Israel lenggam hi tonsotna katundoh jing ding ahi. Ajeh chu napa David kom’a kana kitepna banga Israel laltouna’a hi nachilhah khat katousah jing ding ahi.
English: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I promised to David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man on the throne of Israel.’

tcz: Ahinla nangma ahilouleh na chilhah ten nangma kaseipeh, ka Dan sem holeh kathupeh hohi napaidoh’a, na juida-a pathen dang nahou uva na jon uleh,
en: But if you turn away from following me, you or your children, and not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,
text:
1KI 9:6
Thadou: Ahinla nangma ahilouleh na chilhah ten nangma kaseipeh, ka Dan sem holeh kathupeh hohi napaidoh’a, na juida-a pathen dang nahou uva na jon uleh,
English: But if you turn away from following me, you or your children, and not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,

tcz: Keiman hiche gam kapeh nauva Israel hi kakaidoh ding kamin loupina ding’a hiche Houin ka thensosa jong hi kapaidoh ding chule Israel jong hi nam dangte nuisat leh tot thanghoiya naum ding’u ahi.
en: then I will cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and I will cast this house, which I have made holy for my name, out of my sight; and Israel will be a proverb and a byword among all peoples.
text:
1KI 9:7
Thadou: Keiman hiche gam kapeh nauva Israel hi kakaidoh ding kamin loupina ding’a hiche Houin ka thensosa jong hi kapaidoh ding chule Israel jong hi nam dangte nuisat leh tot thanghoiya naum ding’u ahi.
English: then I will cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and I will cast this house, which I have made holy for my name, out of my sight; and Israel will be a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

tcz: Chujongle tuhin hiche houin hi thupi lheh jeng jong leh hiteng chule ahinho pa jousen alu u apei uva adatmo diu ahi. Amaho ki dong to uvintin, “Itidan na Pakaiyin hiche gamle hiche houin hi manlou aso hi tam?” ati diu ahi.
en: Though this house is so high, yet everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss; and they will say, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house?’
text:
1KI 9:8
Thadou: Chujongle tuhin hiche houin hi thupi lheh jeng jong leh hiteng chule ahinho pa jousen alu u apei uva adatmo diu ahi. Amaho ki dong to uvintin, “Itidan na Pakaiyin hiche gamle hiche houin hi manlou aso hi tam?” ati diu ahi.
English: Though this house is so high, yet everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss; and they will say, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house?’

tcz: Chule amaho chu hitia hi kidonbut todiu ahi, “Ajeh chu hiche mite hin Egypt’a kon’a apu apa teu hin puidoh’a, Pakai a Pathen’u chu adondauva Pathen dang ahou uva, achibai jeh’u ahi, hijeh’a chu Pakaiyin a chung uva hitobang hamset nahi alhunsah ahitai,” ati diu ahi.
en: and they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the LORD their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and embraced other gods, and worshiped them, and served them. Therefore the LORD has brought all this evil on them.’”
text:
1KI 9:9
Thadou: Chule amaho chu hitia hi kidonbut todiu ahi, “Ajeh chu hiche mite hin Egypt’a kon’a apu apa teu hin puidoh’a, Pakai a Pathen’u chu adondauva Pathen dang ahou uva, achibai jeh’u ahi, hijeh’a chu Pakaiyin a chung uva hitobang hamset nahi alhunsah ahitai,” ati diu ahi.
English: and they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the LORD their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and embraced other gods, and worshiped them, and served them. Therefore the LORD has brought all this evil on them.’”

tcz: Solomon in Pakai Houin asah nale ama leng inpi sahna a kum somni a sulut nung phat kichai lam in,
en: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, the LORD’s house and the king’s house
text:
1KI 9:10
Thadou: Solomon in Pakai Houin asah nale ama leng inpi sahna a kum somni a sulut nung phat kichai lam in,
English: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, the LORD’s house and the king’s house

tcz: Aman Tyre Lengpa Hiram chu Galilee gam’a khopi somni chu ana pen ahi. (Hiram hin, Solomon in anathum dungjuiya, Cedar le Cypress thing chuleh sana ana peh ahi)
en: (now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and cypress trees, and with gold, according to all his desire), King Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
text:
1KI 9:11
Thadou: Aman Tyre Lengpa Hiram chu Galilee gam’a khopi somni chu ana pen ahi. (Hiram hin, Solomon in anathum dungjuiya, Cedar le Cypress thing chuleh sana ana peh ahi)
English: (now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and cypress trees, and with gold, according to all his desire), King Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

tcz: Ahin Tyre a konin Hiram hi ahung in Solomon in apeh khopi ho chu ahung ven ahileh akipah behseh pon ahi.
en: Hiram came out of Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they didn’t please him.
text:
1KI 9:12
Thadou: Ahin Tyre a konin Hiram hi ahung in Solomon in apeh khopi ho chu ahung ven ahileh akipah behseh pon ahi.
English: Hiram came out of Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they didn’t please him.

tcz: Hijeh chun Hiram in Solomon jah’a, “Sopi, hiche khopiho pikhu ipi ding ham?” atin ahi. Hijeh chun Hiram min hiche gamchu Cabul tin amin asah’e, hichun, “pannabei” tina ahi. Tunigei hin hiti chun amin akivo den in ahi.
en: He said, “What cities are these which you have given me, my brother?” He called them the land of Cabul to this day.
text:
1KI 9:13
Thadou: Hijeh chun Hiram in Solomon jah’a, “Sopi, hiche khopiho pikhu ipi ding ham?” atin ahi. Hijeh chun Hiram min hiche gamchu Cabul tin amin asah’e, hichun, “pannabei” tina ahi. Tunigei hin hiti chun amin akivo den in ahi.
English: He said, “What cities are these which you have given me, my brother?” He called them the land of Cabul to this day.

tcz: Ahiyeng vang'in Hiram in Solomon chu sana talent jakhat le somni ana pen ahi.
en: Hiram sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold.
text:
1KI 9:14
Thadou: Ahiyeng vang'in Hiram in Solomon chu sana talent jakhat le somni ana pen ahi.
English: Hiram sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold.

tcz: Solomon lengpan soh na tong mi anagoiya anasahdoh ho chu; Pakai Houin, Leng inpi le avel ho, Jerusalem pal kikaikhum, Hazor, Megiddo leh Gezer khopi ho chu ahi.
en: This is the reason of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted: to build the LORD’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s wall, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
text:
1KI 9:15
Thadou: Solomon lengpan soh na tong mi anagoiya anasahdoh ho chu; Pakai Houin, Leng inpi le avel ho, Jerusalem pal kikaikhum, Hazor, Megiddo leh Gezer khopi ho chu ahi.
English: This is the reason of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted: to build the LORD’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s wall, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

tcz: Egypt lengpa Pharaoh in Gezer chu gal anokhum’a analah a, Canaan mite anatha gam’a meiya ahal lhah jou uva hiche khopi chu Solomon toh kicheng achanu akanpeh ahi.
en: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, taken Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it for a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
text:
1KI 9:16
Thadou: Egypt lengpa Pharaoh in Gezer chu gal anokhum’a analah a, Canaan mite anatha gam’a meiya ahal lhah jou uva hiche khopi chu Solomon toh kicheng achanu akanpeh ahi.
English: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, taken Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it for a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

tcz: Solomon in hiche Gezer khopi chu asapha kit’in, aman Beth-horon noi lang khopi ho jong chu asapha kit in ahi.
en: Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower,
text:
1KI 9:17
Thadou: Solomon in hiche Gezer khopi chu asapha kit’in, aman Beth-horon noi lang khopi ho jong chu asapha kit in ahi.
English: Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower,

tcz: Hiche gamsung’a gam mang lah’a um Baalath le Tamar jong chu ahi.
en: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness,
text:
1KI 9:18
Thadou: Hiche gamsung’a gam mang lah’a um Baalath le Tamar jong chu ahi.
English: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness,

tcz: Aman thilkholna ding leh sakol ho leh sakol kangtalai ho koina dingin jong khopi ho ana sadoh in ahi. Aman Jerusalem le Lebanon nah chu leh agam sung pumpi’a asah doh nom jouse ana sah doh sohkei ahi.
en: all the storage cities that Solomon had, the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
text:
1KI 9:19
Thadou: Aman thilkholna ding leh sakol ho leh sakol kangtalai ho koina dingin jong khopi ho ana sadoh in ahi. Aman Jerusalem le Lebanon nah chu leh agam sung pumpi’a asah doh nom jouse ana sah doh sohkei ahi.
English: all the storage cities that Solomon had, the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

tcz: Agam sung’a chun Israel mi hilou phabep jong ana cheng un ahi. Ama ho chu Amon mite, Hit mite, Perizz mite, Hiv mite leh Jebus mite ahiuve.
en: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel—
text:
1KI 9:20
Thadou: Agam sung’a chun Israel mi hilou phabep jong ana cheng un ahi. Ama ho chu Amon mite, Hit mite, Perizz mite, Hiv mite leh Jebus mite ahiuve.
English: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel—

tcz: Ama hohi Israel miten anatha moh nam mite sonle chilhah ho ahiuve. Hijeh chun Solomon nin Ama ho chu soh natong in ana pansah in hiti hin ama hon tuni geijin soh na natong in ana pang jing un ahi.
en: their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy—of them Solomon raised a levy of bondservants to this day.
text:
1KI 9:21
Thadou: Ama hohi Israel miten anatha moh nam mite sonle chilhah ho ahiuve. Hijeh chun Solomon nin Ama ho chu soh natong in ana pansah in hiti hin ama hon tuni geijin soh na natong in ana pang jing un ahi.
English: their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy—of them Solomon raised a levy of bondservants to this day.

tcz: Solomon in Israelte vang namna a natong lah’a ana pansah pon ahi. Hiti hin Israel mite chu galsat sepai leh gal lamkai jat chom chom in ana pansah in sakol kangtalai tol in jong ana pansah in ahi.
en: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no bondservants; but they were the men of war, his servants, his princes, his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.
text:
1KI 9:22
Thadou: Solomon in Israelte vang namna a natong lah’a ana pansah pon ahi. Hiti hin Israel mite chu galsat sepai leh gal lamkai jat chom chom in ana pansah in sakol kangtalai tol in jong ana pansah in ahi.
English: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no bondservants; but they were the men of war, his servants, his princes, his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

tcz: Solomon in gam sung’a kivaihomna a natoh jat chom choma a lamkai ding leh avesui dingin mi ja-nga le somnga ana pansah in ahi.
en: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon’s work, who ruled over the people who labored in the work.
text:
1KI 9:23
Thadou: Solomon in gam sung’a kivaihomna a natoh jat chom choma a lamkai ding leh avesui dingin mi ja-nga le somnga ana pansah in ahi.
English: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon’s work, who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

tcz: Solomon in Pharaoh chanu a kichenpi ajinu chu David khopi’a konin Leng inpi thah ama ding’a ana sahpeh na mun a chun achonlut in ahi. Hiche achun Solomon nin hiche inpi to kimat in dang jong asan ahi.
en: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.
text:
1KI 9:24
Thadou: Solomon in Pharaoh chanu a kichenpi ajinu chu David khopi’a konin Leng inpi thah ama ding’a ana sahpeh na mun a chun achonlut in ahi. Hiche achun Solomon nin hiche inpi to kimat in dang jong asan ahi.
English: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.

tcz: Solomon in Pakaija maicham semna dinga ana sah mun ahin pumgo thilto le chamna thilto kumkhat sung in thumvei ana bol jin ahi. Aman Pakai ah gim namtui jong ana hal nam jin ahi. Hiti hin Houin Sahdohna a natohna jouse chu ana chaisoh kei jin ahi.
en: Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he built to the LORD three times per year, burning incense with them on the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.
text:
1KI 9:25
Thadou: Solomon in Pakaija maicham semna dinga ana sah mun ahin pumgo thilto le chamna thilto kumkhat sung in thumvei ana bol jin ahi. Aman Pakai ah gim namtui jong ana hal nam jin ahi. Hiti hin Houin Sahdohna a natohna jouse chu ana chaisoh kei jin ahi.
English: Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he built to the LORD three times per year, burning incense with them on the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.

tcz: Solomon Lengpan Twikhanglen pang, Edom gam ah Elath kong kai mun kom ah kong-in-nei hon khat ana sem’e.
en: King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.
text:
1KI 9:26
Thadou: Solomon Lengpan Twikhanglen pang, Edom gam ah Elath kong kai mun kom ah kong-in-nei hon khat ana sem’e.
English: King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.

tcz: Hiram in kongtol themho Solomon mite toh kongtol khom dingin ahinsol peh in ahi.
en: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
text:
1KI 9:27
Thadou: Hiram in kongtol themho Solomon mite toh kongtol khom dingin ahinsol peh in ahi.
English: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

tcz: Ama hon Ophir munna atol un chule Solomon dingin sana talent jail le somni ahinpoh peh un ahi.
en: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to King Solomon.
text:
1KI 9:28
Thadou: Ama hon Ophir munna atol un chule Solomon dingin sana talent jail le somni ahinpoh peh un ahi.
English: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to King Solomon.

tcz: Sheba Lengnu in Solomon minthanna hi i-changeija, Pakai min loupi nahi adopsang ho thu ajah phat in thudoh hahtah tah ho doh’a patep dingin ahung kon tan ahi.
en: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the LORD’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.
text:
1KI 10:1
Thadou: Sheba Lengnu in Solomon minthanna hi i-changeija, Pakai min loupi nahi adopsang ho thu ajah phat in thudoh hahtah tah ho doh’a patep dingin ahung kon tan ahi.
English: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the LORD’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.

tcz: Ama chu anungjui tamtah toh gimnamtui tamtah tah sana le song mantam tamtah ahin po uvin sangongsao honkhat’ah ahung touvun Jerusalem ah ahung lhung tauvin ahi. Amanu in Solomon toh'a kimuto phat in aki houlimpi in thudoh ahung kigot na jouse tamtah chu adong tan ahi.
en: She came to Jerusalem with a very great caravan, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.
text:
1KI 10:2
Thadou: Ama chu anungjui tamtah toh gimnamtui tamtah tah sana le song mantam tamtah ahin po uvin sangongsao honkhat’ah ahung touvun Jerusalem ah ahung lhung tauvin ahi. Amanu in Solomon toh'a kimuto phat in aki houlimpi in thudoh ahung kigot na jouse tamtah chu adong tan ahi.
English: She came to Jerusalem with a very great caravan, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

tcz: Solomon in athudoh jouse chu bailam tah in a donbut soh keijin, khatcha jong Lengpa ding chun ahahsa aum pon ahi.
en: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from the king which he didn’t tell her.
text:
1KI 10:3
Thadou: Solomon in athudoh jouse chu bailam tah in a donbut soh keijin, khatcha jong Lengpa ding chun ahahsa aum pon ahi.
English: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from the king which he didn’t tell her.

tcz: Sheba Lengnu chun Solomon chu i-chan geija ching ham tichu amu chet jeh chuleh aleng inpi kisah danchu amudoh phat in,
en: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
text:
1KI 10:4
Thadou: Sheba Lengnu chun Solomon chu i-chan geija ching ham tichu amu chet jeh chuleh aleng inpi kisah danchu amudoh phat in,
English: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

tcz: Alungthim’ah datmona in adim lheh jing tan ahi. Amanu’n aneh achah-u dokhang chung’a umho chu amun, avaihom na noija kinpi na tohna von ho, acha donna’u khon domho chuleh Solomon nin Pakai Houin a namtui alhut nam ho chu amun ahileh,
en: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.
text:
1KI 10:5
Thadou: Alungthim’ah datmona in adim lheh jing tan ahi. Amanu’n aneh achah-u dokhang chung’a umho chu amun, avaihom na noija kinpi na tohna von ho, acha donna’u khon domho chuleh Solomon nin Pakai Houin a namtui alhut nam ho chu amun ahileh,
English: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

tcz: Amanu in asaptho jengin Lengpa jah’ah, “Na chihna le na tohdoh ho ka gamsung’a ka um’a kajah ho jouse chu adih soh keije,” ati.
en: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.
text:
1KI 10:6
Thadou: Amanu in asaptho jengin Lengpa jah’ah, “Na chihna le na tohdoh ho ka gamsung’a ka um’a kajah ho jouse chu adih soh keije,” ati.
English: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

tcz: “Ka thujah hochu keima tah ka hunga kamit tah’a ka hung muchet tokah sen kana tahsan pon ahi. Ahin tahbeh in sei leng ken kanajah hochu, akehkhat jeng jong alhing jou poi. Na chihna hole na haona ho hin kanajah ho chu gam chengin akho khal in ahi.
en: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.
text:
1KI 10:7
Thadou: “Ka thujah hochu keima tah ka hunga kamit tah’a ka hung muchet tokah sen kana tahsan pon ahi. Ahin tahbeh in sei leng ken kanajah hochu, akehkhat jeng jong alhing jou poi. Na chihna hole na haona ho hin kanajah ho chu gam chengin akho khal in ahi.
English: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.

tcz: Na mipite hin i-chan geijin nom asa tadiu vem? Na vaihom noiya nang natong na masang’a ding jing’a na chihna thungai jing hohi i-chan geija hamphatna chang hitau vem?
en: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.
text:
1KI 10:8
Thadou: Na mipite hin i-chan geijin nom asa tadiu vem? Na vaihom noiya nang natong na masang’a ding jing’a na chihna thungai jing hohi i-chan geija hamphatna chang hitau vem?
English: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.

tcz: Pakai na Pathen chu thangvah in umhen, aman lung lhaisel’a Israel Laltouna hi na losah ahi tai. Na Pakaiyin Israelte tang theilouva a ngailut jeh a kitahna le dihna a vaipo dinga nang hi aleng uva natundoh ahitai,” ati.
en: Blessed is the LORD your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because the LORD loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”
text:
1KI 10:9
Thadou: Pakai na Pathen chu thangvah in umhen, aman lung lhaisel’a Israel Laltouna hi na losah ahi tai. Na Pakaiyin Israelte tang theilouva a ngailut jeh a kitahna le dihna a vaipo dinga nang hi aleng uva natundoh ahitai,” ati.
English: Blessed is the LORD your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because the LORD loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”

tcz: Hijou chun amanu’n Lengpa chu sana talent jakhat le somni, gim namtui leh song mantam tamtah jong apen ahi. Sheba lengnun Solomon lengpa gimnamtui apeh tobang hi koiman ape khapon ahi.
en: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
text:
1KI 10:10
Thadou: Hijou chun amanu’n Lengpa chu sana talent jakhat le somni, gim namtui leh song mantam tamtah jong apen ahi. Sheba lengnun Solomon lengpa gimnamtui apeh tobang hi koiman ape khapon ahi.
English: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

tcz: Hiche banna jong hin Hiram kongtol hon Ophir a konin sana toh thing namtui a kihetna dimset toh chuleh song mantam hotoh ahinpo uvin ahi.
en: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones.
text:
1KI 10:11
Thadou: Hiche banna jong hin Hiram kongtol hon Ophir a konin sana toh thing namtui a kihetna dimset toh chuleh song mantam hotoh ahinpo uvin ahi.
English: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones.

tcz: Solomon lengpan hiche thing namtui hochu Pakai Houin douna le Lengpa in douna in amangin, lathem ho dingin semjang saithei leh selangdah din jong asempeh in ahi. Tumasang’a ahin tunung’a ahin hitobang thing namtui ahung kipolut aum kha tapon ahi.
en: The king made of the almug trees pillars for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day.
text:
1KI 10:12
Thadou: Solomon lengpan hiche thing namtui hochu Pakai Houin douna le Lengpa in douna in amangin, lathem ho dingin semjang saithei leh selangdah din jong asempeh in ahi. Tumasang’a ahin tunung’a ahin hitobang thing namtui ahung kipolut aum kha tapon ahi.
English: The king made of the almug trees pillars for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day.

tcz: Solomon lengpa chun Sheba lengnu chu athum jouse ape jengin chu leh angaichat chan chu hongphal tah in anape jeng in ahi. Hijou chun Sheba lengnu chu asohte cheng chutoh agamlang’ah ana kile kittan ahi.
en: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.
text:
1KI 10:13
Thadou: Solomon lengpa chun Sheba lengnu chu athum jouse ape jengin chu leh angaichat chan chu hongphal tah in anape jeng in ahi. Hijou chun Sheba lengnu chu asohte cheng chutoh agamlang’ah ana kile kittan ahi.
English: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

tcz: Kumseh’a Solomon lengpa henga sana hunglut hi talent jagup le somgup le gup alhingin ahi.
en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,
text:
1KI 10:14
Thadou: Kumseh’a Solomon lengpa henga sana hunglut hi talent jagup le somgup le gup alhingin ahi.
English: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

tcz: Hiche hi akivei gunset ho leh kah lah’a thil joh leho’a kona kai kila ho chuleh Arab lang’a gamvaipo ho a kona kimu ho pang nailou ahi.
en: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.
text:
1KI 10:15
Thadou: Hiche hi akivei gunset ho leh kah lah’a thil joh leho’a kona kai kila ho chuleh Arab lang’a gamvaipo ho a kona kimu ho pang nailou ahi.
English: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.

tcz: Solomon lengpan sana a kikhong Ompho lentah tah jani asem in khat cheh hi pound som le nga in agih in ahi.
en: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.
text:
1KI 10:16
Thadou: Solomon lengpan sana a kikhong Ompho lentah tah jani asem in khat cheh hi pound som le nga in agih in ahi.
English: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.

tcz: Aman sana akikhong Ompho aneo loi jathum jong asem in khat cheh chu pound li lhing deh agih in ahi. Lengpan hiche Ompho hohi Lebanon gamang kiti a leng inpi’a chun akoi in ahi.
en: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
text:
1KI 10:17
Thadou: Aman sana akikhong Ompho aneo loi jathum jong asem in khat cheh chu pound li lhing deh agih in ahi. Lengpan hiche Ompho hohi Lebanon gamang kiti a leng inpi’a chun akoi in ahi.
English: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

tcz: Solomon lengpan lal touna lentah khat jong saiha in asem in ahi. Hiche laltouna a kisem chu sana mangchan hoitah in atomjol sel in ahi.
en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.
text:
1KI 10:18
Thadou: Solomon lengpan lal touna lentah khat jong saiha in asem in ahi. Hiche laltouna a kisem chu sana mangchan hoitah in atomjol sel in ahi.
English: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.

tcz: Laltouna chu akaltou nading kalbi gup kido touva ahin, laltouna achungnung lam chu aki kol in ahi. Hiche laltouna ajet aveija chun khut ngapna aum cheh in chule alangto a chun Keipi bahkai ading limkhat khat toh asem in ahi.
en: There were six steps to the throne, and the top of the throne was round behind; and there were armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.
text:
1KI 10:19
Thadou: Laltouna chu akaltou nading kalbi gup kido touva ahin, laltouna achungnung lam chu aki kol in ahi. Hiche laltouna ajet aveija chun khut ngapna aum cheh in chule alangto a chun Keipi bahkai ading limkhat khat toh asem in ahi.
English: There were six steps to the throne, and the top of the throne was round behind; and there were armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

tcz: Hiche kalbi gup chu khat cheh pang achun Keipi bahkai khat cheh adingin ahileh abon'in Keipi bahkai lim somleni alhing in ahi. Vannoi leiset’a laltouna dang ho hiche toh tekahpi thei ding aumpon ahi.
en: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. Nothing like it was made in any kingdom.
text:
1KI 10:20
Thadou: Hiche kalbi gup chu khat cheh pang achun Keipi bahkai khat cheh adingin ahileh abon'in Keipi bahkai lim somleni alhing in ahi. Vannoi leiset’a laltouna dang ho hiche toh tekahpi thei ding aumpon ahi.
English: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. Nothing like it was made in any kingdom.

tcz: Solomon lengpa twidonna khon jouse chu sana thenga kisem ngen ahi, chuleh Lebanon gamang kiti Leng inpi sung’a manchah jouse jong chu sana a kisem ngen ahin, dangka a kisem khatcha jong aum pon ahi, ajeh chu Solomon khanglai achun dangka chu aman aneipon ahi.
en: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. None were of silver, because it was considered of little value in the days of Solomon.
text:
1KI 10:21
Thadou: Solomon lengpa twidonna khon jouse chu sana thenga kisem ngen ahi, chuleh Lebanon gamang kiti Leng inpi sung’a manchah jouse jong chu sana a kisem ngen ahin, dangka a kisem khatcha jong aum pon ahi, ajeh chu Solomon khanglai achun dangka chu aman aneipon ahi.
English: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. None were of silver, because it was considered of little value in the days of Solomon.

tcz: Lengpan kiveina a manchah ding kong innei khat jong aneiyin, hiche ho chu Hiram kong innei hotoh aki tolkhom jin ahi. Hiche kong innei hohi kum thumseh leh inlang ah ahung kile jiuvin, sana, dangka, saiha, guldu leh vahong kong dimset set in ahinpo jiuvin ahi.
en: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
text:
1KI 10:22
Thadou: Lengpan kiveina a manchah ding kong innei khat jong aneiyin, hiche ho chu Hiram kong innei hotoh aki tolkhom jin ahi. Hiche kong innei hohi kum thumseh leh inlang ah ahung kile jiuvin, sana, dangka, saiha, guldu leh vahong kong dimset set in ahinpo jiuvin ahi.
English: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

tcz: Hiti hin Solomon lengpa hi leiset chunga leng dang ho sang in ahao jon chule aching jong aching jon ahi.
en: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.
text:
1KI 10:23
Thadou: Hiti hin Solomon lengpa hi leiset chunga leng dang ho sang in ahao jon chule aching jong aching jon ahi.
English: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pathen in apeh, chihna thungai ding leh thudoh nei dingin muntinna konin mipi ahung hung jing un ahi.
en: All the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom which God had put in his heart.
text:
1KI 10:24
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pathen in apeh, chihna thungai ding leh thudoh nei dingin muntinna konin mipi ahung hung jing un ahi.
English: All the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom which God had put in his heart.

tcz: Kumseh in ama vil’a hung jousen kipa thilpeh in sana, dangka, ponsil, gal manchah, gim namtui, sakol hole sakolpol ho ahin poh peh jing un ahi.
en: Year after year, every man brought his tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules.
text:
1KI 10:25
Thadou: Kumseh in ama vil’a hung jousen kipa thilpeh in sana, dangka, ponsil, gal manchah, gim namtui, sakol hole sakolpol ho ahin poh peh jing un ahi.
English: Year after year, every man brought his tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules.

tcz: Solomon sakol holeh sakol kangtalai ho jong thanei tah in ana tung doh in ahi. Aman sakol sangsom le sangni anei jin sakol kangtalai sangkhat le jali anei jin ahi. Aman phabep chu sakol kangtalai koina khopi ho’a akoiyin phabep chu Jerusalem sung ama kom naina ah akoi jin ahi.
en: Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen. He kept them in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.
text:
1KI 10:26
Thadou: Solomon sakol holeh sakol kangtalai ho jong thanei tah in ana tung doh in ahi. Aman sakol sangsom le sangni anei jin sakol kangtalai sangkhat le jali anei jin ahi. Aman phabep chu sakol kangtalai koina khopi ho’a akoiyin phabep chu Jerusalem sung ama kom naina ah akoi jin ahi.
English: Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen. He kept them in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

tcz: Lengpan dangka aneiho vang chu songtoh ana bahsah jengin ahi. Chuleh Cedar thing mantam tah ho jong chu Judahh gam'a keh theipi thing toh abahsah jengin ahi.
en: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
text:
1KI 10:27
Thadou: Lengpan dangka aneiho vang chu songtoh ana bahsah jengin ahi. Chuleh Cedar thing mantam tah ho jong chu Judahh gam'a keh theipi thing toh abahsah jengin ahi.
English: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

tcz: Solomon in sakol hohi Egypt leh Cilicia kona achoh ji ahin, Lengpa ding’a thilcho hohin Cilicia mun ahi kiman tah’a achoh jiu ahi.
en: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.
text:
1KI 10:28
Thadou: Solomon in sakol hohi Egypt leh Cilicia kona achoh ji ahin, Lengpa ding’a thilcho hohin Cilicia mun ahi kiman tah’a achoh jiu ahi.
English: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.

tcz: Hiche phat laichun Egypt a konin sakol kangtalai khat chu dangka ja gup’a kicho ahin sakol khat chu dangka jakhat le somnga a kichoji ahi. Hijouteng chuleh Hit leh Ram lengho komma ajoh son kitjiu ahi.
en: A chariot was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty shekels; and so they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Syria.
text:
1KI 10:29
Thadou: Hiche phat laichun Egypt a konin sakol kangtalai khat chu dangka ja gup’a kicho ahin sakol khat chu dangka jakhat le somnga a kichoji ahi. Hijouteng chuleh Hit leh Ram lengho komma ajoh son kitjiu ahi.
English: A chariot was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty shekels; and so they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Syria.

tcz: Tun Solomon lengpa hin gamchom mi numei tamtah ana ngailu tan ahi. Pharaoh chanu ana kichenpi kalval in jong Moab numei, Ammon numei, Edom numei, Sidon numei leh Hit numei ho jong a kichenpi in ahi.
en: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh: women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites,
text:
1KI 11:1
Thadou: Tun Solomon lengpa hin gamchom mi numei tamtah ana ngailu tan ahi. Pharaoh chanu ana kichenpi kalval in jong Moab numei, Ammon numei, Edom numei, Sidon numei leh Hit numei ho jong a kichenpi in ahi.
English: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh: women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites,

tcz: Pakaiyin Israel mipite chu kichehtah a, “Hiche namdang mite chu nakichenpi loudiu ahi, ajeh chu amahon, a pathen ho houdia nalungthim’u ahei lut diu ahi,” tia ana hilchah ahi. Ahinlah Solomon in amaho chu ana ngailu thou thou in ahi.
en: of the nations concerning which the LORD said to the children of Israel, “You shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you, for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods.” Solomon joined to these in love.
text:
1KI 11:2
Thadou: Pakaiyin Israel mipite chu kichehtah a, “Hiche namdang mite chu nakichenpi loudiu ahi, ajeh chu amahon, a pathen ho houdia nalungthim’u ahei lut diu ahi,” tia ana hilchah ahi. Ahinlah Solomon in amaho chu ana ngailu thou thou in ahi.
English: of the nations concerning which the LORD said to the children of Israel, “You shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you, for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods.” Solomon joined to these in love.

tcz: Aman Leng Chanu te jeng jasagi ana kichenpi in chuleh thaikem jathum ana neije. Atahbeh in amaho hin alung hi Pakaiya konin ana puimang tauvin ahi.
en: He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines. His wives turned his heart away.
text:
1KI 11:3
Thadou: Aman Leng Chanu te jeng jasagi ana kichenpi in chuleh thaikem jathum ana neije. Atahbeh in amaho hin alung hi Pakaiya konin ana puimang tauvin ahi.
English: He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines. His wives turned his heart away.

tcz: Solomon hi ahung teh phat in, a lungthim hi semthu pathen dang hounan ana hei lut tauvin, apa David bangin a Pakai a Pathen ah kitah tah in pan ana la jou tapon ahi.
en: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father was.
text:
1KI 11:4
Thadou: Solomon hi ahung teh phat in, a lungthim hi semthu pathen dang hounan ana hei lut tauvin, apa David bangin a Pakai a Pathen ah kitah tah in pan ana la jou tapon ahi.
English: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father was.

tcz: Solomon in Sidon mite semthu numei-pathen Ashtoreth leh thet umtah Ammon mite semthu pathen Molech chu ana hou tan ahi.
en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
text:
1KI 11:5
Thadou: Solomon in Sidon mite semthu numei-pathen Ashtoreth leh thet umtah Ammon mite semthu pathen Molech chu ana hou tan ahi.
English: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

tcz: Hiti hin Solomon in Pakai mitmu’n thilsetah tah chu ana bol tan ahi.
en: Solomon did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and didn’t go fully after the LORD, as David his father did.
text:
1KI 11:6
Thadou: Hiti hin Solomon in Pakai mitmu’n thilsetah tah chu ana bol tan ahi.
English: Solomon did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and didn’t go fully after the LORD, as David his father did.

tcz: Jerusalem solam, Olive molchung ah, aman thet umtah Moab te semthu pathen Chemosh leh thet umtah Ammon mite semthu pathen Molech houna dingin doiphung ana tungdoh tan ahi.
en: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the mountain that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.
text:
1KI 11:7
Thadou: Jerusalem solam, Olive molchung ah, aman thet umtah Moab te semthu pathen Chemosh leh thet umtah Ammon mite semthu pathen Molech houna dingin doiphung ana tungdoh tan ahi.
English: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the mountain that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.

tcz: Solomon in gamchom numei akichenpi aji ten asemthu pathen ho komma kilhaina pumgo thilto abolna diu leh gim namtui ahalnam na diuvin doiphung ana tundoh peh in ahi.
en: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.
text:
1KI 11:8
Thadou: Solomon in gamchom numei akichenpi aji ten asemthu pathen ho komma kilhaina pumgo thilto abolna diu leh gim namtui ahalnam na diuvin doiphung ana tundoh peh in ahi.
English: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.

tcz: Pakai chu Solomon chunga ana lunghang lheh jeng tan ahi, ajeh chu Israel Pakai Pathen ahenga nivei tah hung kilah nung a, aman alungthim Pakaiya kona aheimang jeh ahi.
en: The LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,
text:
1KI 11:9
Thadou: Pakai chu Solomon chunga ana lunghang lheh jeng tan ahi, ajeh chu Israel Pakai Pathen ahenga nivei tah hung kilah nung a, aman alungthim Pakaiya kona aheimang jeh ahi.
English: The LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,

tcz: Aman Solomon hi pathen dang ahou louna dia kicheh tah’a anagihsal sa ahin, ahinla Solomon in Pakai thupeh chu ana nahsah tapon ahi.
en: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which the LORD commanded.
text:
1KI 11:10
Thadou: Aman Solomon hi pathen dang ahou louna dia kicheh tah’a anagihsal sa ahin, ahinla Solomon in Pakai thupeh chu ana nahsah tapon ahi.
English: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which the LORD commanded.

tcz: Hijeh chun tun Pakaiyin akom ah hiti hin thu asei tan ahi, “Nangin he nasasa a i-kitepna na suhkhah jeh leh ka Danthu nanit lou jeh in, keiman lenggam hi nang’a akona kalah doh’a na sohte lah’a khat kapeh ding ahitai,” ati.
en: Therefore the LORD said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.
text:
1KI 11:11
Thadou: Hijeh chun tun Pakaiyin akom ah hiti hin thu asei tan ahi, “Nangin he nasasa a i-kitepna na suhkhah jeh leh ka Danthu nanit lou jeh in, keiman lenggam hi nang’a akona kalah doh’a na sohte lah’a khat kapeh ding ahitai,” ati.
English: Therefore the LORD said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.

tcz: Ahinlah napa David jal’a nahinlai sunga hichu kabol lou ding, nachapa lengvaipoh akon a bou kalahdoh ding ahi.
en: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.
text:
1KI 11:12
Thadou: Ahinlah napa David jal’a nahinlai sunga hichu kabol lou ding, nachapa lengvaipoh akon a bou kalahdoh ding ahi.
English: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.

tcz: “Ahinlah keiman lenggam pumpi chu kalah dohlou ding, kalhachapa David jal le kalhentum khopi Jerusalem jal’a phungkhat vang kadalhah peh ding ahi,” ati.
en: However, I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.”
text:
1KI 11:13
Thadou: “Ahinlah keiman lenggam pumpi chu kalah dohlou ding, kalhachapa David jal le kalhentum khopi Jerusalem jal’a phungkhat vang kadalhah peh ding ahi,” ati.
English: However, I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Edom mite leng insung akonin, Hadad kitipa chu Solomon kidoupi dingin ana tungdoh tan ahi.
en: The LORD raised up an adversary to Solomon: Hadad the Edomite. He was one of the king’s offspring in Edom.
text:
1KI 11:14
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Edom mite leng insung akonin, Hadad kitipa chu Solomon kidoupi dingin ana tungdoh tan ahi.
English: The LORD raised up an adversary to Solomon: Hadad the Edomite. He was one of the king’s offspring in Edom.

tcz: Kum phabep masanga chu David in Edom mite hi gal anajo ahi. Asepai lamkai Joab chu Israel sepai galmun’a thiho chu avuiding’a anaum den’ah ahi. Hichea aumsung chun Edom pasal ho chu anathat gam’in ahi.
en: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain, and had struck every male in Edom
text:
1KI 11:15
Thadou: Kum phabep masanga chu David in Edom mite hi gal anajo ahi. Asepai lamkai Joab chu Israel sepai galmun’a thiho chu avuiding’a anaum den’ah ahi. Hichea aumsung chun Edom pasal ho chu anathat gam’in ahi.
English: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain, and had struck every male in Edom

tcz: Joab leh Israel sepaite chu lha gup sung ana umden u ahin, hiche sung’a chu Edom mite chu ana tha gam’u ahi.
en: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom),
text:
1KI 11:16
Thadou: Joab leh Israel sepaite chu lha gup sung ana umden u ahin, hiche sung’a chu Edom mite chu ana tha gam’u ahi.
English: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom),

tcz: Ahin hiche thilsoh lai chun, Hadad leh apa insung natong pipui ho chutoh Egypt lang’a ana jammang’u ahi. (Hiche phat laiya chu, Hadad chapang cha ahinalaiye.)
en: Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt, when Hadad was still a little child.
text:
1KI 11:17
Thadou: Ahin hiche thilsoh lai chun, Hadad leh apa insung natong pipui ho chutoh Egypt lang’a ana jammang’u ahi. (Hiche phat laiya chu, Hadad chapang cha ahinalaiye.)
English: Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt, when Hadad was still a little child.

tcz: Amaho chu Midian adalhauvin, Paran ajon’un, Paran’a hin mi phabep’in ahin be uvin ahi. Hichun Egypt geiyin akitol’un, lengpa henga acheule, aman Hadad gam le in apen, neh le chah jong anape un ahi.
en: They arose out of Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.
text:
1KI 11:18
Thadou: Amaho chu Midian adalhauvin, Paran ajon’un, Paran’a hin mi phabep’in ahin be uvin ahi. Hichun Egypt geiyin akitol’un, lengpa henga acheule, aman Hadad gam le in apen, neh le chah jong anape un ahi.
English: They arose out of Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.

tcz: Pharaoh in Hadad chu angailu lheh jengin, aman ajinu lengnu Tahpenes sopinu chu aji dingin ana pen ahi.
en: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
text:
1KI 11:19
Thadou: Pharaoh in Hadad chu angailu lheh jengin, aman ajinu lengnu Tahpenes sopinu chu aji dingin ana pen ahi.
English: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

tcz: Amanu’n chapa khat ahinpeh in amin Genubath asah tan ahi, Tahpenes lengnun Pharaoh leng inpi’ah, lengpa chate toh anavah khanglen in chule ana khoukhah in ahi.
en: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.
text:
1KI 11:20
Thadou: Amanu’n chapa khat ahinpeh in amin Genubath asah tan ahi, Tahpenes lengnun Pharaoh leng inpi’ah, lengpa chate toh anavah khanglen in chule ana khoukhah in ahi.
English: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.

tcz: David leh a sepai lamkaipa Joab chu athitai kiti thu chu Egypt alhun phat in aman Pharaoh heng’ah, “Keima ka gam lang’a kile tang’e neisol tan,” atin ahi.
en: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.”
text:
1KI 11:21
Thadou: David leh a sepai lamkaipa Joab chu athitai kiti thu chu Egypt alhun phat in aman Pharaoh heng’ah, “Keima ka gam lang’a kile tang’e neisol tan,” atin ahi.
English: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.”

tcz: Pharaoh in, “Ipi dingin em? Hiche a hi ipi lhinglel nasah’a na in lang’a na kile nom ham?” atileh aman jong, “Ima avat aumpoi, hijongle lungset tah’in kain lam’a nei kile sah tan,” ati.
en: Then Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me, that behold, you seek to go to your own country?” He answered, “Nothing, however only let me depart.”
text:
1KI 11:22
Thadou: Pharaoh in, “Ipi dingin em? Hiche a hi ipi lhinglel nasah’a na in lang’a na kile nom ham?” atileh aman jong, “Ima avat aumpoi, hijongle lungset tah’in kain lam’a nei kile sah tan,” ati.
English: Then Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me, that behold, you seek to go to your own country?” He answered, “Nothing, however only let me depart.”

tcz: Pathen in Eliada chapa Rezon jong chu Solomon dou dingin ahin til doh in ahi. Rezon chu apupa Zobah lengpa Hadadezer a kona hung jamdoh ahi.
en: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord, Hadadezer king of Zobah.
text:
1KI 11:23
Thadou: Pathen in Eliada chapa Rezon jong chu Solomon dou dingin ahin til doh in ahi. Rezon chu apupa Zobah lengpa Hadadezer a kona hung jamdoh ahi.
English: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord, Hadadezer king of Zobah.

tcz: Hijeh’a chu galbol loikhat lah’a lamkaija hung pang’a ahi. David in Hadadezer chu gal’a akisat pia ajo phat chun Rezon le amite chu Damacus lama ajam’un hiche a chun leng in ahung pang tan ahi.
en: He gathered men to himself, and became captain over a troop, when David killed them of Zobah. They went to Damascus and lived there, and reigned in Damascus.
text:
1KI 11:24
Thadou: Hijeh’a chu galbol loikhat lah’a lamkaija hung pang’a ahi. David in Hadadezer chu gal’a akisat pia ajo phat chun Rezon le amite chu Damacus lama ajam’un hiche a chun leng in ahung pang tan ahi.
English: He gathered men to himself, and became captain over a troop, when David killed them of Zobah. They went to Damascus and lived there, and reigned in Damascus.

tcz: Rezon hi Solomon vaihom achaina geijin Israel ten akidoupi akhoh pen in ahung pang peh in, Hadad bangin boina ana sem jengin ahi. Rezon hin Israelte hi ahot lheh jengin, hiti chun Syria gam sunga leng in ana pang den tan ahi.
en: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, in addition to the mischief of Hadad. He abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
text:
1KI 11:25
Thadou: Rezon hi Solomon vaihom achaina geijin Israel ten akidoupi akhoh pen in ahung pang peh in, Hadad bangin boina ana sem jengin ahi. Rezon hin Israelte hi ahot lheh jengin, hiti chun Syria gam sunga leng in ana pang den tan ahi.
English: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, in addition to the mischief of Hadad. He abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

tcz: Solomon noiya natong pipui khat Nebat chapa Jeroboam jong hi adouho lah’a lamkai khat ahi. Amahi Ephraim gam Zeredah khopi’a kon ahin anu hi Zeruah kiti meithai nu chu ahi.
en: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.
text:
1KI 11:26
Thadou: Solomon noiya natong pipui khat Nebat chapa Jeroboam jong hi adouho lah’a lamkai khat ahi. Amahi Ephraim gam Zeredah khopi’a kon ahin anu hi Zeruah kiti meithai nu chu ahi.
English: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.

tcz: Hiche hi ama doubol ho hung kipatna thusim chu ahi, Solomon hin inlen pang’a in neo chacha ho anasah phat’a chule apa David khopi pal ho chu anasem phat laijin,
en: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.
text:
1KI 11:27
Thadou: Hiche hi ama doubol ho hung kipatna thusim chu ahi, Solomon hin inlen pang’a in neo chacha ho anasah phat’a chule apa David khopi pal ho chu anasem phat laijin,
English: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.

tcz: Jeroboam chu thilbol theitah gollhang khat ahi ti ahin hedoh tan, chule a pottho danho chu Solomon’in amu doh phat’in, Joseph chate ni Ephraim leh Manasseh phung’a kona engbolna-a natong ho chung’a vaihom in ana pansah tan ahi.
en: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw the young man that he was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.
text:
1KI 11:28
Thadou: Jeroboam chu thilbol theitah gollhang khat ahi ti ahin hedoh tan, chule a pottho danho chu Solomon’in amu doh phat’in, Joseph chate ni Ephraim leh Manasseh phung’a kona engbolna-a natong ho chung’a vaihom in ana pansah tan ahi.
English: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw the young man that he was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.

tcz: Nikhat hi Jeroboam chun Jerusalem adalhah'a ahung potdoh leh Shiloh a kona hung Ahijah themgaopa chun lampi’a ahung chu amun ahi. Ahijah chun ponchol athahbeh’a ana kivon in, amani achangseh chu gam lah in ana kimuto lhon in ahi.
en: At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way. Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and the two of them were alone in the field.
text:
1KI 11:29
Thadou: Nikhat hi Jeroboam chun Jerusalem adalhah'a ahung potdoh leh Shiloh a kona hung Ahijah themgaopa chun lampi’a ahung chu amun ahi. Ahijah chun ponchol athahbeh’a ana kivon in, amani achangseh chu gam lah in ana kimuto lhon in ahi.
English: At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way. Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and the two of them were alone in the field.

tcz: Ahijah chun a sangkhol chol thahleh chu asat tel in boh somleni ason ahi.
en: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.
text:
1KI 11:30
Thadou: Ahijah chun a sangkhol chol thahleh chu asat tel in boh somleni ason ahi.
English: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.

tcz: Chuin Jeroboam jah’a, “Hiche ponhal som hi kilah in, ajeh chu Pakai Israel Pathen in, ‘Solomon khut’a kon’a Lenggam hi lah peh ing kating, phungsom hi nang ka peh ding ahi,’
en: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you
text:
1KI 11:31
Thadou: Chuin Jeroboam jah’a, “Hiche ponhal som hi kilah in, ajeh chu Pakai Israel Pathen in, ‘Solomon khut’a kon’a Lenggam hi lah peh ing kating, phungsom hi nang ka peh ding ahi,’
English: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you

tcz: Ahinla, Keiman Israel gam pumpi’a kona ka lhendoh khopi Jerusalem jeh leh ka lhachapa David jeh a Solomon hi phungkhat vang kakhen peh ding ahi.
en: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),
text:
1KI 11:32
Thadou: Ahinla, Keiman Israel gam pumpi’a kona ka lhendoh khopi Jerusalem jeh leh ka lhachapa David jeh a Solomon hi phungkhat vang kakhen peh ding ahi.
English: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),

tcz: Ajeh chu Solomon in keima ei-nungsun in Sidon mite numei pathen Ashtoreth ahouvin, Moab mite semthu pathen Chemosh ahouvin, Ammon mite semthu pathen Molech ahouvin ahi. Aman ka lampi ajui tapon chu leh ka mitmu’a ka lungdei a abol tapon chukitle apa David in eijui bangin eijuipon ka chonna Dan ho leh ka Dan sem ho jong anit tapon ahi.
en: because they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.
text:
1KI 11:33
Thadou: Ajeh chu Solomon in keima ei-nungsun in Sidon mite numei pathen Ashtoreth ahouvin, Moab mite semthu pathen Chemosh ahouvin, Ammon mite semthu pathen Molech ahouvin ahi. Aman ka lampi ajui tapon chu leh ka mitmu’a ka lungdei a abol tapon chukitle apa David in eijui bangin eijuipon ka chonna Dan ho leh ka Dan sem ho jong anit tapon ahi.
English: because they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.

tcz: Ahinlah keima tu tadi hin Solomon na konin a lengam hi abon'a ka lahdoh lou ding ahi. Keiman kana lhendoh, ka lhachapa David in kathu angaija ka Dan ho anit jeh in, ama jal in Solomon hi ahinkho lhumkeiya lamkaija kakoi jing ding ahi,” ati.
en: “‘However, I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes,
text:
1KI 11:34
Thadou: Ahinlah keima tu tadi hin Solomon na konin a lengam hi abon'a ka lahdoh lou ding ahi. Keiman kana lhendoh, ka lhachapa David in kathu angaija ka Dan ho anit jeh in, ama jal in Solomon hi ahinkho lhumkeiya lamkaija kakoi jing ding ahi,” ati.
English: “‘However, I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes,

tcz: “Ahinlah achapa a kona lenggam hi kalah doh’a phungsom hi nang khut’a ka peh doh ding ahi.
en: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes.
text:
1KI 11:35
Thadou: “Ahinlah achapa a kona lenggam hi kalah doh’a phungsom hi nang khut’a ka peh doh ding ahi.
English: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes.

tcz: Achapa hi phungkhat vang chang ding ahi. Hiti’a chu David chilhah khat vang'in ka min loupi na ding’a ka lhendoh hiche Jerusalem ahi thaomei vah bang’a vah jing ding ahi.
en: I will give one tribe to his son, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there.
text:
1KI 11:36
Thadou: Achapa hi phungkhat vang chang ding ahi. Hiti’a chu David chilhah khat vang'in ka min loupi na ding’a ka lhendoh hiche Jerusalem ahi thaomei vah bang’a vah jing ding ahi.
English: I will give one tribe to his son, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there.

tcz: Keiman nangma hi Israelte leng mun’a hi ka tousah ding chuteng nangman lungna chim’a vai nahop ding ahi.
en: I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.
text:
1KI 11:37
Thadou: Keiman nangma hi Israelte leng mun’a hi ka tousah ding chuteng nangman lungna chim’a vai nahop ding ahi.
English: I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.

tcz: Nangin kathu na ngaiya chule ka lunglhaina a neijuiya, ka lhachapa David bang’a ka Dan sem najuiya, ka thupeh nanit jing’a ahileh, Keiman kaumpi jing ding ka sohpa David kabol peh bang’a keiman nang ding’a jong nachilhah te hi amang theilou dinga ka tundoh peh ding chule Israel hi nangma kapeh ding nahi,” ati.
en: It shall be, if you will listen to all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that which is right in my eyes, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did, that I will be with you, and will build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to you.
text:
1KI 11:38
Thadou: Nangin kathu na ngaiya chule ka lunglhaina a neijuiya, ka lhachapa David bang’a ka Dan sem najuiya, ka thupeh nanit jing’a ahileh, Keiman kaumpi jing ding ka sohpa David kabol peh bang’a keiman nang ding’a jong nachilhah te hi amang theilou dinga ka tundoh peh ding chule Israel hi nangma kapeh ding nahi,” ati.
English: It shall be, if you will listen to all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that which is right in my eyes, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did, that I will be with you, and will build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to you.

tcz: “Solomon chonset jeh’a hi keiman David chilhah tehi ka engbol ding ahinlah hichu phat chomkhat’a ding bou ahi,” ati.
en: I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.’”
text:
1KI 11:39
Thadou: “Solomon chonset jeh’a hi keiman David chilhah tehi ka engbol ding ahinlah hichu phat chomkhat’a ding bou ahi,” ati.
English: I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.’”

tcz: Hijeh hin Solomon in Jeroboam chu tha ding agon ahinla Jeroboam Egypt lengpa Shishak komma ajamlut in Solomon thi kahsen aga um tan ahi.
en: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
text:
1KI 11:40
Thadou: Hijeh hin Solomon in Jeroboam chu tha ding agon ahinla Jeroboam Egypt lengpa Shishak komma ajamlut in Solomon thi kahsen aga um tan ahi.
English: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

tcz: Hiche hin Solomon vaihom sunga thil abol hole anatoh ho chule a chihna hochu Solomon tohdohho kijihlut na lekhabu’a aki jihlut soh kei jin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, aren’t they written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
text:
1KI 11:41
Thadou: Hiche hin Solomon vaihom sunga thil abol hole anatoh ho chule a chihna hochu Solomon tohdohho kijihlut na lekhabu’a aki jihlut soh kei jin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, aren’t they written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

tcz: Solomon in Jerusalem ah kum somli vai ana hom in,
en: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
text:
1KI 11:42
Thadou: Solomon in Jerusalem ah kum somli vai ana hom in,
English: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

tcz: Ama athi phat in apa minna kisah David khopi’a ana kivui tan ahi. Chu jou in achapa Rehoboam in ama khel in leng ahungchang tai.
en: Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
text:
1KI 11:43
Thadou: Ama athi phat in apa minna kisah David khopi’a ana kivui tan ahi. Chu jou in achapa Rehoboam in ama khel in leng ahungchang tai.
English: Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Rehoboam chu Shechem’ah aga chen, hichea chun Israel pumpi’n ama chu leng chansah dingin ana kikhom khom uvin ahi.
en: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.
text:
1KI 12:1
Thadou: Rehoboam chu Shechem’ah aga chen, hichea chun Israel pumpi’n ama chu leng chansah dingin ana kikhom khom uvin ahi.
English: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

tcz: Nebat chapa Jeroboam chun hichu ajah phat in Egypt’a konin ahung kile tan ahi. Ama chu Solomon lengpa a kona Egypt achu ana jamlut na ahi.
en: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;

tcz: Israel lamkai ten ama chu ana kouvun hiti chun Jeroboam chu Israel pumpi chutoh Rehoboam toh kihoulim khom dingin ana che uvin ahi.
en: and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
text:
1KI 12:3
Thadou: Israel lamkai ten ama chu ana kouvun hiti chun Jeroboam chu Israel pumpi chutoh Rehoboam toh kihoulim khom dingin ana che uvin ahi.
English: and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

tcz: Amahon ajah’a, “Napa Solomon chun eina bolgim lheh jengun ahi. Hijeh chun napa in, poh hahsa sa eikoiden un, nangin nasuh lhomjep’a, nom dom a neilhaule, naglenggam a kitah tan in pang unge,” atiuve.
en: “Your father made our yoke difficult. Now therefore make the hard service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”
text:
1KI 12:4
Thadou: Amahon ajah’a, “Napa Solomon chun eina bolgim lheh jengun ahi. Hijeh chun napa in, poh hahsa sa eikoiden un, nangin nasuh lhomjep’a, nom dom a neilhaule, naglenggam a kitah tan in pang unge,” atiuve.
English: “Your father made our yoke difficult. Now therefore make the hard service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

tcz: Rehoboam in adonbut in, “Hiche thu’a hi ki ngaito na ding nithum phat neipeuvin, chujouteng leh ka donbutna ngai dingin hung kit tauvin,” ati. Hichun mipiho jong akile tauve.
en: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.
text:
1KI 12:5
Thadou: Rehoboam in adonbut in, “Hiche thu’a hi ki ngaito na ding nithum phat neipeuvin, chujouteng leh ka donbutna ngai dingin hung kit tauvin,” ati. Hichun mipiho jong akile tauve.
English: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.

tcz: Hichun Rehoboam lengpa chun apa Solomon thumop a anapang upa ho chu ana kihou pin, “Hiche thua hi ipi na gel uvem? Iti ka donbut ding ham nei seipeh un,” ati.
en: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me to answer these people?”
text:
1KI 12:6
Thadou: Hichun Rehoboam lengpa chun apa Solomon thumop a anapang upa ho chu ana kihou pin, “Hiche thua hi ipi na gel uvem? Iti ka donbut ding ham nei seipeh un,” ati.
English: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me to answer these people?”

tcz: Hichun upa ho chun adonbut un, “Nangin amaho chungahi na vaihom nom jing’a ahile adei banguvin donbut in chuti leh amaho hi nangma midih tah hi jing diu ahi,” atipeh uve.
en: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”
text:
1KI 12:7
Thadou: Hichun upa ho chun adonbut un, “Nangin amaho chungahi na vaihom nom jing’a ahile adei banguvin donbut in chuti leh amaho hi nangma midih tah hi jing diu ahi,” atipeh uve.
English: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”

tcz: Ahinlah Rehoboam in tehseho thumop la louvin khangdong amatoh hung seilen khomho ama thumop’a hung pang hojoh chu ipi na gel uvem tin ana dong tan ahi.
en: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.
text:
1KI 12:8
Thadou: Ahinlah Rehoboam in tehseho thumop la louvin khangdong amatoh hung seilen khomho ama thumop’a hung pang hojoh chu ipi na gel uvem tin ana dong tan ahi.
English: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

tcz: Aman amaho jah’a chun, “Hiche mipi hon napan kachung uva pohgih eipoh sah uhi neisuh lhompeh un atiu hi, iti ka donbut ding ham?” tin ana dongin ahi.
en: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may answer these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”
text:
1KI 12:9
Thadou: Aman amaho jah’a chun, “Hiche mipi hon napan kachung uva pohgih eipoh sah uhi neisuh lhompeh un atiu hi, iti ka donbut ding ham?” tin ana dongin ahi.
English: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may answer these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

tcz: Hiche khangthah hochun, “Pohgih nei suhlhom peh un tia phun ho chu hitin donbut in, ‘Ka khut jung neocha hi kapa kong sang in asa jon ahi.
en: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, “Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us’—tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.
text:
1KI 12:10
Thadou: Hiche khangthah hochun, “Pohgih nei suhlhom peh un tia phun ho chu hitin donbut in, ‘Ka khut jung neocha hi kapa kong sang in asa jon ahi.
English: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, “Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us’—tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

tcz: Kapan na chung uva pohgih nana pohsah’u chu, keiman ka gihsah cheh ding ahi. Kapan khaojanga na jep’u ahi, kenvang sakol jepna a kajep diu nahiuve tipeh in,” atiuve.
en: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”
text:
1KI 12:11
Thadou: Kapan na chung uva pohgih nana pohsah’u chu, keiman ka gihsah cheh ding ahi. Kapan khaojanga na jep’u ahi, kenvang sakol jepna a kajep diu nahiuve tipeh in,” atiuve.
English: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

tcz: Jeroboam le mipi ho chu abonchauvin Rehoboam in a thupeh bang bangin nithum chanin lengpa thupeh ngai dingin ahung kit tauvin ahi.
en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”
text:
1KI 12:12
Thadou: Jeroboam le mipi ho chu abonchauvin Rehoboam in a thupeh bang bangin nithum chanin lengpa thupeh ngai dingin ahung kit tauvin ahi.
English: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

tcz: Ahin Rehoboam in amaho koma chun, upa ho thumop lalou in, ngailou tah’in thu ana sei tan ahi.
en: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,
text:
1KI 12:13
Thadou: Ahin Rehoboam in amaho koma chun, upa ho thumop lalou in, ngailou tah’in thu ana sei tan ahi.
English: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,

tcz: Aman akhangthah chanpi ho thumop joh chu ana sangin, “Kapan pohgih nana pohsah’u chu tuni ahi keiman ka gihsah cheh ding ahi. Kapan khaova najep’u ahin keiman sakol jepna a kajep diu na hiuve,” tin ana donbut tan ahi.
en: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”
text:
1KI 12:14
Thadou: Aman akhangthah chanpi ho thumop joh chu ana sangin, “Kapan pohgih nana pohsah’u chu tuni ahi keiman ka gihsah cheh ding ahi. Kapan khaova najep’u ahin keiman sakol jepna a kajep diu na hiuve,” tin ana donbut tan ahi.
English: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

tcz: Hiti chun lengpan mipite chu nasah louvin anakoi tan ahi. Hitobang thilsoh hi Pathen thilgon ahi. Ajeh chu Shiloh a kona hung Ahizah Themgao mangcha a Pakaiyin Nebat chapa Jeroboam kom’a athu hetsah chu guilhun na ding thilsoh ahi.
en: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was a thing brought about from the LORD, that he might establish his word, which the LORD spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
text:
1KI 12:15
Thadou: Hiti chun lengpan mipite chu nasah louvin anakoi tan ahi. Hitobang thilsoh hi Pathen thilgon ahi. Ajeh chu Shiloh a kona hung Ahizah Themgao mangcha a Pakaiyin Nebat chapa Jeroboam kom’a athu hetsah chu guilhun na ding thilsoh ahi.
English: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was a thing brought about from the LORD, that he might establish his word, which the LORD spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

tcz: Israel mipiten lengpa kom’a ataonau chu asanpeh tapoi ti ahet phat’un, amahon hitin adonbut tauve, “David insung mite mangthah u hen! Jesse chapa chungah lunglutna kanei tapouve, Vo Israel mite inlam kijot tauvin! Vo David! Nang in na insung bou kivet tan,” tin asam un, hiti chun Israel mipi chu ainlam cheh uva akile tauvin ahi.
en: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion have we in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So Israel departed to their tents.
text:
1KI 12:16
Thadou: Israel mipiten lengpa kom’a ataonau chu asanpeh tapoi ti ahet phat’un, amahon hitin adonbut tauve, “David insung mite mangthah u hen! Jesse chapa chungah lunglutna kanei tapouve, Vo Israel mite inlam kijot tauvin! Vo David! Nang in na insung bou kivet tan,” tin asam un, hiti chun Israel mipi chu ainlam cheh uva akile tauvin ahi.
English: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion have we in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So Israel departed to their tents.

tcz: Ahinlah Rehoboam in Judahh khopi ho cheng Israel ho chung’a chun vai ana hom nalai jin ahi.
en: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
text:
1KI 12:17
Thadou: Ahinlah Rehoboam in Judahh khopi ho cheng Israel ho chung’a chun vai ana hom nalai jin ahi.
English: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

tcz: Rehoboam in namna a natongho chunga vaihompa chu mipi thunun ding chun agah sol’in ahile ama chu mipi hon songin ana seplih tauvin ahi. Hiche thu chu Rehoboam lengpan ajahdoh phat in asakol kangtalai chung’a akaldoh loijin Jerusalem lang’a ajam tan ahi.
en: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
text:
1KI 12:18
Thadou: Rehoboam in namna a natongho chunga vaihompa chu mipi thunun ding chun agah sol’in ahile ama chu mipi hon songin ana seplih tauvin ahi. Hiche thu chu Rehoboam lengpan ajahdoh phat in asakol kangtalai chung’a akaldoh loijin Jerusalem lang’a ajam tan ahi.
English: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hiche’a pat hin sahlam gamkai’a um Israel phungho jousen David chilhah khat in achung'uva vai ahop dingu chu anom tapouvin ahi.
en: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.
text:
1KI 12:19
Thadou: Hiche’a pat hin sahlam gamkai’a um Israel phungho jousen David chilhah khat in achung'uva vai ahop dingu chu anom tapouvin ahi.
English: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.

tcz: Israel mipiten Jeroboam chu Egypt akonin ahung kilekit taiti ajahphat’un, kikhopna anei un, amachu Israel pumpi chung’a vaipo din atung tauvin ahi. Judahh phung bou chun David chilhahte apanpiuvin ahi.
en: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was no one who followed David’s house, except for the tribe of Judah only.
text:
1KI 12:20
Thadou: Israel mipiten Jeroboam chu Egypt akonin ahung kilekit taiti ajahphat’un, kikhopna anei un, amachu Israel pumpi chung’a vaipo din atung tauvin ahi. Judahh phung bou chun David chilhahte apanpiuvin ahi.
English: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was no one who followed David’s house, except for the tribe of Judah only.

tcz: Rehoboam chu Jerusalem alhung phat’in, aman Judahh le Benjamin phung’a konin a chomkhom in a lenggam tundoh kitna ding’a Israel mite sat dingin sepai sang jakhat le sangsom get alhengdoh in ahi.
en: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
text:
1KI 12:21
Thadou: Rehoboam chu Jerusalem alhung phat’in, aman Judahh le Benjamin phung’a konin a chomkhom in a lenggam tundoh kitna ding’a Israel mite sat dingin sepai sang jakhat le sangsom get alhengdoh in ahi.
English: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen in Pathen mipa Shemaiah kom’ah hitin ahin seije,
en: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
text:
1KI 12:22
Thadou: Ahinlah Pathen in Pathen mipa Shemaiah kom’ah hitin ahin seije,
English: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

tcz: “Benjamin le Judahh mipite ho jouse komle Judahh lengpa Solomon chapa Rehoboam komleh mipi adang jouse kom’ah seijin,
en: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,
text:
1KI 12:23
Thadou: “Benjamin le Judahh mipite ho jouse komle Judahh lengpa Solomon chapa Rehoboam komleh mipi adang jouse kom’ah seijin,
English: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,
