tcz: ‘Pathen in hitin aseiye, nasopi Israeltehi kisatpi hih’in, na incheh uva kile tauvin ajeh chu hiche hi keima na toh ahi!’ati. Hitichun Pakai thupeh chu ajui’un, ama ama inlang cheh’a akile tauvin ahi.
en: ‘The LORD says, “You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his house; for this thing is from me.”’” So they listened to the LORD’s word, and returned and went their way, according to the LORD’s word.
text:
1KI 12:24
Thadou: ‘Pathen in hitin aseiye, nasopi Israeltehi kisatpi hih’in, na incheh uva kile tauvin ajeh chu hiche hi keima na toh ahi!’ati. Hitichun Pakai thupeh chu ajui’un, ama ama inlang cheh’a akile tauvin ahi.
English: ‘The LORD says, “You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his house; for this thing is from me.”’” So they listened to the LORD’s word, and returned and went their way, according to the LORD’s word.

tcz: Jeroboam Ephraim thinglhang gam’ah Shechem khopi chu ana tungdoh in, hichu ama leng khopi ahung hitan ahi. Hijouchun ama achen Panuel khopi jong aga tungdoh in ahi.
en: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived in it; and he went out from there and built Penuel.
text:
1KI 12:25
Thadou: Jeroboam Ephraim thinglhang gam’ah Shechem khopi chu ana tungdoh in, hichu ama leng khopi ahung hitan ahi. Hijouchun ama achen Panuel khopi jong aga tungdoh in ahi.
English: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived in it; and he went out from there and built Penuel.

tcz: Jeroboam chu aki ngaiton, “Keima ka chih theilou leh hiche lenggam hi David chilhahte langa le lut kit thei ahi,” tin agel in ahi.
en: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to David’s house.
text:
1KI 12:26
Thadou: Jeroboam chu aki ngaiton, “Keima ka chih theilou leh hiche lenggam hi David chilhahte langa le lut kit thei ahi,” tin agel in ahi.
English: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to David’s house.

tcz: “Hiche mipite hi Jerusalema ache uva Pakai Houin a kilhaina agabol jing uva ahileh, Judahh lengpa Rehoboam noiyah avel in hunglutkit get unte, chuleh keima hi eitha uva amahi a Leng uva aki lahlut kit diu ahi,” tin ana gel in ahi.
en: If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in the LORD’s house at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn again to their lord, even to Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”
text:
1KI 12:27
Thadou: “Hiche mipite hi Jerusalema ache uva Pakai Houin a kilhaina agabol jing uva ahileh, Judahh lengpa Rehoboam noiyah avel in hunglutkit get unte, chuleh keima hi eitha uva amahi a Leng uva aki lahlut kit diu ahi,” tin ana gel in ahi.
English: If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in the LORD’s house at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn again to their lord, even to Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”

tcz: Hijeh chun amiching hole athumop ho dungjuiyin, lengpa chun sana in bongnou lim asem in amite kom’a, “Jerusalema Pathen houva nache jiuhi, ahahsa behseh’e, veuvin Israelte Egypt a kona na hinpuidoh uva chu hiche Pathen teni hi ahi,” ati peh in ahi.
en: So the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said to them, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Look and behold your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”
text:
1KI 12:28
Thadou: Hijeh chun amiching hole athumop ho dungjuiyin, lengpa chun sana in bongnou lim asem in amite kom’a, “Jerusalema Pathen houva nache jiuhi, ahahsa behseh’e, veuvin Israelte Egypt a kona na hinpuidoh uva chu hiche Pathen teni hi ahi,” ati peh in ahi.
English: So the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said to them, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Look and behold your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”

tcz: Aman hiche semthu bong nou lim pathen teni hi Bethel khopi ah khat chule Dan khopi ah khat akoiyin ahi.
en: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.
text:
1KI 12:29
Thadou: Aman hiche semthu bong nou lim pathen teni hi Bethel khopi ah khat chule Dan khopi ah khat akoiyin ahi.
English: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.

tcz: Ahinlah hiche chu amaho din chonsetna nasatah ahung hi khatai, ajeh chu mipin bongnou lim semthu chu ahou tauvin ahi chule mipi hochu Dan lang peh peh’a che touva hiche semthu pathen akikoi chu aga hou jiu ahi.
en: This thing became a sin, for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there.
text:
1KI 12:30
Thadou: Ahinlah hiche chu amaho din chonsetna nasatah ahung hi khatai, ajeh chu mipin bongnou lim semthu chu ahou tauvin ahi chule mipi hochu Dan lang peh peh’a che touva hiche semthu pathen akikoi chu aga hou jiu ahi.
English: This thing became a sin, for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there.

tcz: Jeroboam min semthu pathen houna mun’a chun doiphung phabep a tungdoh in, Levi phungmi hilou milham phabep jong thempu in a thenso tan ahi.
en: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.
text:
1KI 12:31
Thadou: Jeroboam min semthu pathen houna mun’a chun doiphung phabep a tungdoh in, Levi phungmi hilou milham phabep jong thempu in a thenso tan ahi.
English: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.

tcz: Chule Jeroboam in Bethel khopiah houthudol kut khat jong ana pandoh in, hichu lhaget channa ani somlenga nileh ana boljin ahi. Hichu Judahh ten hoidohna golvah kum khat na khatvei aboljiu tobanga ahi. Bethel muna chun amatah’in jong bongnou lim asemna achun kilhaina asemin chuleh semthu pathen houna in achun thempu phabep jong anapan sah in ahi.
en: Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.
text:
1KI 12:32
Thadou: Chule Jeroboam in Bethel khopiah houthudol kut khat jong ana pandoh in, hichu lhaget channa ani somlenga nileh ana boljin ahi. Hichu Judahh ten hoidohna golvah kum khat na khatvei aboljiu tobanga ahi. Bethel muna chun amatah’in jong bongnou lim asemna achun kilhaina asemin chuleh semthu pathen houna in achun thempu phabep jong anapan sah in ahi.
English: Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.

tcz: Hijeh chun, ama tah’in anagon nikho, lhaget lhinna ni, som le nga channa alhinteng Jeroboam amatah in Bethel kilhaina maicham gantha ama lungdei tah’in ana boljin, aman Israelte houthu dol’a kut ana phudoh’a chu ama tah in kilhaina gantha maicham chungah ana bol’in, gim namtui jong ana lhutnam jin ahi.
en: He went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up to the altar to burn incense.
text:
1KI 12:33
Thadou: Hijeh chun, ama tah’in anagon nikho, lhaget lhinna ni, som le nga channa alhinteng Jeroboam amatah in Bethel kilhaina maicham gantha ama lungdei tah’in ana boljin, aman Israelte houthu dol’a kut ana phudoh’a chu ama tah in kilhaina gantha maicham chungah ana bol’in, gim namtui jong ana lhutnam jin ahi.
English: He went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up to the altar to burn incense.

tcz: Pakai thupeh dungjuiyin, Pathen mikhat Judahh akonin Bethel’ah ahungin, Jeroboam in maicham ajot’a gimnamtui hal ding agah got laitah’in aga lhung in ahi.
en: Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by the LORD’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.
text:
1KI 13:1
Thadou: Pakai thupeh dungjuiyin, Pathen mikhat Judahh akonin Bethel’ah ahungin, Jeroboam in maicham ajot’a gimnamtui hal ding agah got laitah’in aga lhung in ahi.
English: Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by the LORD’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.

tcz: Hichun Pakai thupeh dungjuiyin, ahung apengjah jengin, “Vo maicham maicham! Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, ‘David chilhah lah’a Josiah kiti khat hung peng ding ahi. Amahin tua cheptan loute maicham a lhacha’a pang ji ho, nachunga kilhaina gan thatji thempu ho hi nangma chunga athagam ding chule na chung ahi mihem gule chang hung kilhut vam ding ahi, tin ahung seije,” ati.
en: He cried against the altar by the LORD’s word, and said, “Altar! Altar! The LORD says: ‘Behold, a son will be born to David’s house, Josiah by name. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and they will burn men’s bones on you.’”
text:
1KI 13:2
Thadou: Hichun Pakai thupeh dungjuiyin, ahung apengjah jengin, “Vo maicham maicham! Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, ‘David chilhah lah’a Josiah kiti khat hung peng ding ahi. Amahin tua cheptan loute maicham a lhacha’a pang ji ho, nachunga kilhaina gan thatji thempu ho hi nangma chunga athagam ding chule na chung ahi mihem gule chang hung kilhut vam ding ahi, tin ahung seije,” ati.
English: He cried against the altar by the LORD’s word, and said, “Altar! Altar! The LORD says: ‘Behold, a son will be born to David’s house, Josiah by name. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and they will burn men’s bones on you.’”

tcz: Hiche nikho mama chun Pathen in a Thupeh adih ahi hetthei nan, melchihna khat apen ahi. Aman ajah’a, “Pakaiyin hiche melchihna hi pe dingin kitepna aneiye; hiche maicham hi kehni hung kiso ding chule avut vam ho chu tol’a hung kithe lha ding ahi,” ati.
en: He gave a sign the same day, saying, “This is the sign which the LORD has spoken: Behold, the altar will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be poured out.”
text:
1KI 13:3
Thadou: Hiche nikho mama chun Pathen in a Thupeh adih ahi hetthei nan, melchihna khat apen ahi. Aman ajah’a, “Pakaiyin hiche melchihna hi pe dingin kitepna aneiye; hiche maicham hi kehni hung kiso ding chule avut vam ho chu tol’a hung kithe lha ding ahi,” ati.
English: He gave a sign the same day, saying, “This is the sign which the LORD has spoken: Behold, the altar will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be poured out.”

tcz: Jeroboam Lengpan Bethel maicham douna hung kisei chu ajah phat in, themgaopa chu akoh-in, “Hiche pachu man un!” tin ahinsam tan ahi. Ahinlah hiche pettah chun Lengpa khut chu ahung ngoijin adingden tan, anung lahdoh jou tapon ahi.
en: When the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” His hand, which he put out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.
text:
1KI 13:4
Thadou: Jeroboam Lengpan Bethel maicham douna hung kisei chu ajah phat in, themgaopa chu akoh-in, “Hiche pachu man un!” tin ahinsam tan ahi. Ahinlah hiche pettah chun Lengpa khut chu ahung ngoijin adingden tan, anung lahdoh jou tapon ahi.
English: When the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” His hand, which he put out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.

tcz: Hiche pettah chun maicham chu ahung lengkeh jengin, Pathen mipan aseibang bangin maicham sunga kon chun vutvam jouse chu ahung kibo lhan ahi.
en: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the LORD’s word.
text:
1KI 13:5
Thadou: Hiche pettah chun maicham chu ahung lengkeh jengin, Pathen mipan aseibang bangin maicham sunga kon chun vutvam jouse chu ahung kibo lhan ahi.
English: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the LORD’s word.

tcz: Lengpa chu Pathen mipa kom’a hung peng jah jengin, “Pakai na Pathen heng’a ka khut adamthei na dingin nei taopeh tan,” ati. Hichun Pathen mipa chu Pakai kom’a atao tan ahile Lengpa khut chu adamhel jengin achat le theitan ahi.
en: The king answered the man of God, “Now intercede for the favor of the LORD your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again.” The man of God interceded with the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored to him again, and became as it was before.
text:
1KI 13:6
Thadou: Lengpa chu Pathen mipa kom’a hung peng jah jengin, “Pakai na Pathen heng’a ka khut adamthei na dingin nei taopeh tan,” ati. Hichun Pathen mipa chu Pakai kom’a atao tan ahile Lengpa khut chu adamhel jengin achat le theitan ahi.
English: The king answered the man of God, “Now intercede for the favor of the LORD your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again.” The man of God interceded with the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored to him again, and became as it was before.

tcz: Hichun Lengpan Pathen mipa kom a chun, “Hungin ka in lang’a che hi tin, an hung nen lang kipa thilpeh jong nape ing’e,” ati.
en: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.”
text:
1KI 13:7
Thadou: Hichun Lengpan Pathen mipa kom a chun, “Hungin ka in lang’a che hi tin, an hung nen lang kipa thilpeh jong nape ing’e,” ati.
English: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.”

tcz: Pathen mipan Lengpa kom achun, “Na lenggam akeh khat neipeh ding hi jong leh nang toh kilhon khom pong’e, keiman hiche mun’a hi nehle chah kahol lou ding ahi,
en: The man of God said to the king, “Even if you gave me half of your house, I would not go in with you, neither would I eat bread nor drink water in this place;

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai Pathen in, nangman hiche munna naum laisea neh le chah nahol lou ding chuleh hiche lampi mama a hi Judah gam mun na hung kile kit ding ahi, tin athupeh einei jin ahi,” ati.
en: for so was it commanded me by the LORD’s word, saying, ‘You shall eat no bread, drink no water, and don’t return by the way that you came.’”
text:
1KI 13:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakai Pathen in, nangman hiche munna naum laisea neh le chah nahol lou ding chuleh hiche lampi mama a hi Judah gam mun na hung kile kit ding ahi, tin athupeh einei jin ahi,” ati.
English: for so was it commanded me by the LORD’s word, saying, ‘You shall eat no bread, drink no water, and don’t return by the way that you came.’”

tcz: Hijeh chun aman Bethel adalhan lam chom aho in ainlang ajon tan ahi.
en: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.
text:
1KI 13:10
Thadou: Hijeh chun aman Bethel adalhan lam chom aho in ainlang ajon tan ahi.
English: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.

tcz: Hichepet hin Bethel muna chun themgao tehse khat ana cheng in, chuin achapate chu ainmun’u ahunglhun phat in, Bethel a Pathen mipan athilbol ho chu ana seipeh tan ahi. Chuleh hiche Lengpa kom’a a thusei ho jong chu a seipeh un ahi.
en: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.
text:
1KI 13:11
Thadou: Hichepet hin Bethel muna chun themgao tehse khat ana cheng in, chuin achapate chu ainmun’u ahunglhun phat in, Bethel a Pathen mipan athilbol ho chu ana seipeh tan ahi. Chuleh hiche Lengpa kom’a a thusei ho jong chu a seipeh un ahi.
English: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.

tcz: Hichun tehsepu chun, “Hoilang che tantem?” tin adong in ahi leh, amahon Pathen mipan hoiche lang pen aho ham tichu apao chu ana seipeh un ahi.
en: Their father said to them, “Which way did he go?” Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.
text:
1KI 13:12
Thadou: Hichun tehsepu chun, “Hoilang che tantem?” tin adong in ahi leh, amahon Pathen mipan hoiche lang pen aho ham tichu apao chu ana seipeh un ahi.
English: Their father said to them, “Which way did he go?” Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.

tcz: Tehsepu chun achate kom ah, “Gangtah in sangan chung’a chun toupha nei koi loiyun,” atinle, achaten sangan chunga chu toupha chu akoi peh un, ama jong atou doh in,
en: He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.
text:
1KI 13:13
Thadou: Tehsepu chun achate kom ah, “Gangtah in sangan chung’a chun toupha nei koi loiyun,” atinle, achaten sangan chunga chu toupha chu akoi peh un, ama jong atou doh in,
English: He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.

tcz: Pathen mipa chu adeltan ahileh, ama chu thingphung lentah khat noija chun ana tou agamudoh in ahi. Tehsepun, “Judah gam’a kona hung Pathen mipa chu na him?” atileh aman jong, “Henge ama chu ka hi naiye,” ati.
en: He went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. He said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” He said, “I am.”
text:
1KI 13:14
Thadou: Pathen mipa chu adeltan ahileh, ama chu thingphung lentah khat noija chun ana tou agamudoh in ahi. Tehsepun, “Judah gam’a kona hung Pathen mipa chu na him?” atileh aman jong, “Henge ama chu ka hi naiye,” ati.
English: He went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. He said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” He said, “I am.”

tcz: Hichun aman Pathen mipa koma chun, “Hung in ka in ah bu hung nen,” ati.
en: Then he said to him, “Come home with me and eat bread.”
text:
1KI 13:15
Thadou: Hichun aman Pathen mipa koma chun, “Hung in ka in ah bu hung nen,” ati.
English: Then he said to him, “Come home with me and eat bread.”

tcz: Aman a donbut in, “Ahipoi kei hung thei pong’e, keima hiche mun’a hi anneh tuidon bol thei pong’e,
en: He said, “I may not return with you, nor go in with you. I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.
text:
1KI 13:16
Thadou: Aman a donbut in, “Ahipoi kei hung thei pong’e, keima hiche mun’a hi anneh tuidon bol thei pong’e,
English: He said, “I may not return with you, nor go in with you. I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin hiche munna naum laisen anneh tuidon nabol lou ding ahi, chu leh na hungna lampi hi mang cha a nahung kile theilou ding ahi, tin ei sei peh in ahi,” ati.
en: For it was said to me by the LORD’s word, ‘You shall eat no bread or drink water there, and don’t turn again to go by the way that you came.’”
text:
1KI 13:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin hiche munna naum laisen anneh tuidon nabol lou ding ahi, chu leh na hungna lampi hi mang cha a nahung kile theilou ding ahi, tin ei sei peh in ahi,” ati.
English: For it was said to me by the LORD’s word, ‘You shall eat no bread or drink water there, and don’t turn again to go by the way that you came.’”

tcz: Ahin tehsepun adonbut in, “Kei jong themgao khat kahi, Pakaiya konin vantil khat in hiche thupeh hi ei hinpen, ama chu na in’a pui inlang an nehsah in tui donsah in eiti,” ati. Amavang tehsepu chun ajou asei ahi.
en: He said to him, “I also am a prophet as you are; and an angel spoke to me by the LORD’s word, saying, ‘Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water.’” He lied to him.
text:
1KI 13:18
Thadou: Ahin tehsepun adonbut in, “Kei jong themgao khat kahi, Pakaiya konin vantil khat in hiche thupeh hi ei hinpen, ama chu na in’a pui inlang an nehsah in tui donsah in eiti,” ati. Amavang tehsepu chun ajou asei ahi.
English: He said to him, “I also am a prophet as you are; and an angel spoke to me by the LORD’s word, saying, ‘Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water.’” He lied to him.

tcz: Hiti chun akinungle lhontan, Pathen mipan tehsepu in achun an anen, tui adon tan ahi.
en: So he went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water.
text:
1KI 13:19
Thadou: Hiti chun akinungle lhontan, Pathen mipan tehsepu in achun an anen, tui adon tan ahi.
English: So he went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water.

tcz: Hitia chu amani atou khompet lhon chun Pakaija konin Themgao tehsepu kom achun thupeh khat ahung lhung tan ahile,
en: As they sat at the table, the LORD’s word came to the prophet who brought him back;

tcz: Ama jong Judahh a kona hung Pathen mipa koma chun apeng jah in, “Nangin Pakai thupeh chu na sukeh’in, Pakai na Pathen in thu napeh dungjui jin na chon tapoi.
en: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to the LORD’s word, and have not kept the commandment which the LORD your God commanded you,
text:
1KI 13:21
Thadou: Ama jong Judahh a kona hung Pathen mipa koma chun apeng jah in, “Nangin Pakai thupeh chu na sukeh’in, Pakai na Pathen in thu napeh dungjui jin na chon tapoi.
English: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to the LORD’s word, and have not kept the commandment which the LORD your God commanded you,

tcz: Hilai munna na hung kilen, na nen, na don in, ne hih in don hih in kati chu na sumil tai. Hiti ahiyeh chun, natahsa hi napu napate lupna a kivuilou ding ahitai,” ati.
en: but came back, and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you, “Eat no bread, and drink no water,” your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers.’”
text:
1KI 13:22
Thadou: Hilai munna na hung kilen, na nen, na don in, ne hih in don hih in kati chu na sumil tai. Hiti ahiyeh chun, natahsa hi napu napate lupna a kivuilou ding ahitai,” ati.
English: but came back, and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you, “Eat no bread, and drink no water,” your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers.’”

tcz: Pathen mipan aneh a adon jouvin Themgao tehsepu chun ama sangan chunga chun toupha apha dohpeh in,
en: After he had eaten bread and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.
text:
1KI 13:23
Thadou: Pathen mipan aneh a adon jouvin Themgao tehsepu chun ama sangan chunga chun toupha apha dohpeh in,
English: After he had eaten bread and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.

tcz: Hichun Pathen mipa chu akipatdoh tan ahi. Hitia chu inlam jona ache laitah in, humpi khat atoh khan athat tan ahi. Atahsa chu lamlen chung ah akijamin, sangan le humpi chu ana ding khom lhonin ahi.
en: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.
text:
1KI 13:24
Thadou: Hichun Pathen mipa chu akipatdoh tan ahi. Hitia chu inlam jona ache laitah in, humpi khat atoh khan athat tan ahi. Atahsa chu lamlen chung ah akijamin, sangan le humpi chu ana ding khom lhonin ahi.
English: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.

tcz: Mi phabep in along lampia kijam le akoma sakei ding atoh khauvin, hichun Themgao tehsepu umna Bethel geiyin acheuvin athilmu u chu aga seipeh tauve.
en: Behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.
text:
1KI 13:25
Thadou: Mi phabep in along lampia kijam le akoma sakei ding atoh khauvin, hichun Themgao tehsepu umna Bethel geiyin acheuvin athilmu u chu aga seipeh tauve.
English: Behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.

tcz: Themgao tehsepu chun athu ajahdoh phat’in, “Hiche Pathen mipa hin, Pathen thupeh anit lou ahin, Pakaiyin keipi chu athasah’a athusei chu asuh bulhit ahi tai,” atin ahi.
en: When the prophet who brought him back from the way heard of it, he said, “It is the man of God who was disobedient to the LORD’s word. Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, which has mauled him and slain him, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke to him.”
text:
1KI 13:26
Thadou: Themgao tehsepu chun athu ajahdoh phat’in, “Hiche Pathen mipa hin, Pathen thupeh anit lou ahin, Pakaiyin keipi chu athasah’a athusei chu asuh bulhit ahi tai,” atin ahi.
English: When the prophet who brought him back from the way heard of it, he said, “It is the man of God who was disobedient to the LORD’s word. Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, which has mauled him and slain him, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke to him.”

tcz: Themgaopa luipan chun achate kom’ah, “Sangan chung’a chun toupha hin koijun,” atin, ahin koipeh phat un,
en: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.
text:
1KI 13:27
Thadou: Themgaopa luipan chun achate kom’ah, “Sangan chung’a chun toupha hin koijun,” atin, ahin koipeh phat un,
English: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.

tcz: Ama ache in, atahsa lamlen chunga lum chu agamu’n, a sangan leh humpi akom’a ana din nah lai vang'in, humpi chun ana nedeh pon chule Sangan jong chu ima ana tipon ahi.
en: He went and found his body thrown on the path, and the donkey and the lion standing by the body. The lion had not eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.
text:
1KI 13:28
Thadou: Ama ache in, atahsa lamlen chunga lum chu agamu’n, a sangan leh humpi akom’a ana din nah lai vang'in, humpi chun ana nedeh pon chule Sangan jong chu ima ana tipon ahi.
English: He went and found his body thrown on the path, and the donkey and the lion standing by the body. The lion had not eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.

tcz: Themgaopa chun Pathen mipa tahsa chu a sangan chung’a chun akoiyin, khopi lang a chun along op dingin ahin pon ahi.
en: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn, and to bury him.
text:
1KI 13:29
Thadou: Themgaopa chun Pathen mipa tahsa chu a sangan chung’a chun akoiyin, khopi lang a chun along op dingin ahin pon ahi.
English: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn, and to bury him.

tcz: Aman lhan’ah avui in, lhase tah in akap in “Vo ka sopipa,” atin ahi.
en: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”
text:
1KI 13:30
Thadou: Aman lhan’ah avui in, lhase tah in akap in “Vo ka sopipa,” atin ahi.
English: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”

tcz: Hichejou chun Themgao pa chun achate kom’ah, “Keima ka thi teng leh Pathen mipa kivuina lhan ah hin nei hin vui uvin lang, kagu hi ama gu panga hin lupsah un,” ati.
en: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, “When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.
text:
1KI 13:31
Thadou: Hichejou chun Themgao pa chun achate kom’ah, “Keima ka thi teng leh Pathen mipa kivuina lhan ah hin nei hin vui uvin lang, kagu hi ama gu panga hin lupsah un,” ati.
English: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, “When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.

tcz: “Ajeh chu Pakaiyin Samaria khopi sung’a khopi holah a ki semdoh semthu pathen houna maicham leh Bethel maicham douna Pakaiyin ana phondohsa chu guilhung tei ding hija ahi,” ati.
en: For the saying which he cried by the LORD’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”
text:
1KI 13:32
Thadou: “Ajeh chu Pakaiyin Samaria khopi sung’a khopi holah a ki semdoh semthu pathen houna maicham leh Bethel maicham douna Pakaiyin ana phondohsa chu guilhung tei ding hija ahi,” ati.
English: For the saying which he cried by the LORD’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”

tcz: Ahivang in hitobang thilsoh nung jengin jong, Jeroboam in athilse bolna a konin akihei mangdeh pon ahi. Aman milham lah a konin Thempu ana lheng jing nalaiyin ahi. Semthu pathen houna doiphung’a thempu dingin apang nom jouse anapan sah jengin ahi.
en: After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.
text:
1KI 13:33
Thadou: Ahivang in hitobang thilsoh nung jengin jong, Jeroboam in athilse bolna a konin akihei mangdeh pon ahi. Aman milham lah a konin Thempu ana lheng jing nalaiyin ahi. Semthu pathen houna doiphung’a thempu dingin apang nom jouse anapan sah jengin ahi.
English: After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.

tcz: Hiche hi chonset nasatah ahung hitan chule Jeroboam chilhah ho leiset chunga konin suhmang in aumlo tan ahi.
en: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.
text:
1KI 13:34
Thadou: Hiche hi chonset nasatah ahung hitan chule Jeroboam chilhah ho leiset chunga konin suhmang in aumlo tan ahi.
English: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.

tcz: Hichun Jeroboam chapa Abijah ahung dammo tan ahi.
en: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.
text:
1KI 14:1
Thadou: Hichun Jeroboam chapa Abijah ahung dammo tan ahi.
English: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.

tcz: Jeroboam in ajinu kom a, “Keima ji nahi hi min nahetdoh louna dingin kisem inlang, Shiloh a themgao Ahijah kom’ah ga chen, ama chun Leng kahung chan ding hi eina seipeh ahi.
en: Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said that I would be king over this people.
text:
1KI 14:2
Thadou: Jeroboam in ajinu kom a, “Keima ji nahi hi min nahetdoh louna dingin kisem inlang, Shiloh a themgao Ahijah kom’ah ga chen, ama chun Leng kahung chan ding hi eina seipeh ahi.
English: Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said that I would be king over this people.

tcz: Changlhah pheng som toh changlhah lum themkhat, khoiju thei khat toh po inlang ichapa khankho ding hi ga dong tan,” ati.
en: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the child.”
text:
1KI 14:3
Thadou: Changlhah pheng som toh changlhah lum themkhat, khoiju thei khat toh po inlang ichapa khankho ding hi ga dong tan,” ati.
English: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the child.”

tcz: Hiti chun Jeroboam jinu chu Shiloh a Ahijah kom’ah aga chen ahi. Amachu ana teh lheh tan, kho jong amuchen thei tapoi.
en: Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh, and came to Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
text:
1KI 14:4
Thadou: Hiti chun Jeroboam jinu chu Shiloh a Ahijah kom’ah aga chen ahi. Amachu ana teh lheh tan, kho jong amuchen thei tapoi.
English: Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh, and came to Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen in Ahijah jah’ah, “Jeroboam jinu chu lim chompu a hikoma hi hung ding ahi. Aman achapa damlouna chung chang’a khu na hungdoh ding ahin adonbut nadia kahilchah bang’a nana donbut ding ahi,” ati peh in ahi.
en: The LORD said to Ahijah, “Behold, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for he is sick. Tell her such and such; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend to be another woman.”
text:
1KI 14:5
Thadou: Ahinlah Pathen in Ahijah jah’ah, “Jeroboam jinu chu lim chompu a hikoma hi hung ding ahi. Aman achapa damlouna chung chang’a khu na hungdoh ding ahin adonbut nadia kahilchah bang’a nana donbut ding ahi,” ati peh in ahi.
English: The LORD said to Ahijah, “Behold, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for he is sick. Tell her such and such; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend to be another woman.”

tcz: Ahin Jeroboam jinun Ahijah kot chu ahin phah chu ajah phat in, “Jeroboam jinu, ipi dinga midang dan’a na kilepma na hung ham? Hunglut in,” ati. Hijouchun aman, “Keiman na jah ding thungailou khat ka sei peh nom’e,” ati.
en: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, “Come in, Jeroboam’s wife! Why do you pretend to be another? For I am sent to you with heavy news.
text:
1KI 14:6
Thadou: Ahin Jeroboam jinun Ahijah kot chu ahin phah chu ajah phat in, “Jeroboam jinu, ipi dinga midang dan’a na kilepma na hung ham? Hunglut in,” ati. Hijouchun aman, “Keiman na jah ding thungailou khat ka sei peh nom’e,” ati.
English: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, “Come in, Jeroboam’s wife! Why do you pretend to be another? For I am sent to you with heavy news.

tcz: “Najipa Jeroboam chu ana seipeh in, Pakai Israel Pathen in najah sah nom chu hiche hi ahi. ‘Keiman nangma hi milham’a kona ka dopsang’a kami Israelte chunga vaihom a kapansah na hin,
en: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘The LORD, the God of Israel, says: “Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Israel,
text:
1KI 14:7
Thadou: “Najipa Jeroboam chu ana seipeh in, Pakai Israel Pathen in najah sah nom chu hiche hi ahi. ‘Keiman nangma hi milham’a kona ka dopsang’a kami Israelte chunga vaihom a kapansah na hin,
English: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘The LORD, the God of Israel, says: “Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Israel,

tcz: Keiman David insunga kon’a lenggam kahe lhah’a, nangma ka peh nahi. Ahinla nangma hi ka lhachapa David toh nabang pon ahi. Aman vang phattin in ka lungdei lam tah in ka thupeh jouse hi alungthim pumpin ajui jing in ahi.
en: and tore the kingdom away from David’s house, and gave it to you; and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in my eyes,
text:
1KI 14:8
Thadou: Keiman David insunga kon’a lenggam kahe lhah’a, nangma ka peh nahi. Ahinla nangma hi ka lhachapa David toh nabang pon ahi. Aman vang phattin in ka lungdei lam tah in ka thupeh jouse hi alungthim pumpin ajui jing in ahi.
English: and tore the kingdom away from David’s house, and gave it to you; and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in my eyes,

tcz: Nangin vang nang masanga vaihom jouse sangin thilse nabol jon ahi. Nangman nang dingin semthu pathen ho nakisem in, na sana bongnou lim sem ho hin eiphin lunghang tan ahi. Nang in nei nungsung ahi tah jeh in,
en: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back,
text:
1KI 14:9
Thadou: Nangin vang nang masanga vaihom jouse sangin thilse nabol jon ahi. Nangman nang dingin semthu pathen ho nakisem in, na sana bongnou lim sem ho hin eiphin lunghang tan ahi. Nang in nei nungsung ahi tah jeh in,
English: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back,

tcz: Keiman nachilhah ho chung’a hamsetna ka chuhsah ding chuleh na chilhah pasal jouse ka suhmang ding, soh hihen hilou hi jong leh Israel lah’a muntin’a na leng chilhah ho jouse aboncha kaban suhmang soh kei ding ahi.
en: therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on a wall, he who is shut up and he who is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweeps away dung until it is all gone.
text:
1KI 14:10
Thadou: Keiman nachilhah ho chung’a hamsetna ka chuhsah ding chuleh na chilhah pasal jouse ka suhmang ding, soh hihen hilou hi jong leh Israel lah’a muntin’a na leng chilhah ho jouse aboncha kaban suhmang soh kei ding ahi.
English: therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on a wall, he who is shut up and he who is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweeps away dung until it is all gone.

tcz: Jeroboam insung mite kholaiya thiden jouse, uichan aneh chai ding chule gam lah’a thiho jouse chu muthong in aneh soh kei ding ahi,’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye,” ati.
en: The dogs will eat he who belongs to Jeroboam who dies in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field, for the LORD has spoken it.”’
text:
1KI 14:11
Thadou: Jeroboam insung mite kholaiya thiden jouse, uichan aneh chai ding chule gam lah’a thiho jouse chu muthong in aneh soh kei ding ahi,’ tin Pakaiyin aseiye,” ati.
English: The dogs will eat he who belongs to Jeroboam who dies in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field, for the LORD has spoken it.”’

tcz: Hijouchun Ahijah’in Jeroboam jinu komah, “Na inlang’a chetan khopi chu na gah lhun lhun le nachapa chu thi ding ahi.
en: Arise therefore, and go to your house. When your feet enter into the city, the child will die.
text:
1KI 14:12
Thadou: Hijouchun Ahijah’in Jeroboam jinu komah, “Na inlang’a chetan khopi chu na gah lhun lhun le nachapa chu thi ding ahi.
English: Arise therefore, and go to your house. When your feet enter into the city, the child will die.

tcz: Israel pumpin lunghem pi uvintin avuidiu ahi, nainsung’a phatecha kivuijah amabou hung hi ding ahi. Ajeh chu Jeroboam insung pumpia hiche chapangpa bouhi Pakai Israel Pathen in alunglhaina a amu ahi bouve,” ati.
en: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.
text:
1KI 14:13
Thadou: Israel pumpin lunghem pi uvintin avuidiu ahi, nainsung’a phatecha kivuijah amabou hung hi ding ahi. Ajeh chu Jeroboam insung pumpia hiche chapangpa bouhi Pakai Israel Pathen in alunglhaina a amu ahi bouve,” ati.
English: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.

tcz: “Hiche banna hin Pakaiyin Israel akonin lengkhat hin tungdoh intin, ama chun Jeroboam insung pumpi asuhmang ding ahi.
en: Moreover the LORD will raise up a king for himself over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day! What? Even now.
text:
1KI 14:14
Thadou: “Hiche banna hin Pakaiyin Israel akonin lengkhat hin tungdoh intin, ama chun Jeroboam insung pumpi asuhmang ding ahi.
English: Moreover the LORD will raise up a king for himself over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day! What? Even now.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh Pakaiyin Israel chu luidung’a pumping killing bang’a lonle le ding ahiuve, chuleh Israelte hi apu apa te’u ana pehna gampha a kon’a abodoh ding chuteng Euphrates vadung gal lang peh’a athe cheh ding ahi. Ajeh chu ama hon semthu pathen Asherah pou ahouvin ahi.
en: For the LORD will strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water; and he will root up Israel out of this good land which he gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking the LORD to anger.
text:
1KI 14:15
Thadou: Hiteng chuleh Pakaiyin Israel chu luidung’a pumping killing bang’a lonle le ding ahiuve, chuleh Israelte hi apu apa te’u ana pehna gampha a kon’a abodoh ding chuteng Euphrates vadung gal lang peh’a athe cheh ding ahi. Ajeh chu ama hon semthu pathen Asherah pou ahouvin ahi.
English: For the LORD will strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water; and he will root up Israel out of this good land which he gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking the LORD to anger.

tcz: Jeroboam min Israel hi achonset sah jeh chun Pakai Pathen in Israel pumpi hi adalhah ding ahitai.
en: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”
text:
1KI 14:16
Thadou: Jeroboam min Israel hi achonset sah jeh chun Pakai Pathen in Israel pumpi hi adalhah ding ahitai.
English: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Jeroboam jinun Tirjah langa akile in a insung agah chot lut lut achun chapangpa chu athi tan ahi.
en: Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.
text:
1KI 14:17
Thadou: Hijeh chun Jeroboam jinun Tirjah langa akile in a insung agah chot lut lut achun chapangpa chu athi tan ahi.
English: Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.

tcz: Israel pumpin a lunghempiu vin, Pakaiyin Ahijah a phondohsah bang bangin avui tauvin ahi.
en: All Israel buried him and mourned for him, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the prophet.
text:
1KI 14:18
Thadou: Israel pumpin a lunghempiu vin, Pakaiyin Ahijah a phondohsah bang bangin avui tauvin ahi.
English: All Israel buried him and mourned for him, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the prophet.

tcz: Jeroboam vaihomlaija thilsoh dangho jouse agalsat le avaihomna pum in Israel Lengte thusim Lekhabua aki jihlut soh kei jin ahi.
en: The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
text:
1KI 14:19
Thadou: Jeroboam vaihomlaija thilsoh dangho jouse agalsat le avaihomna pum in Israel Lengte thusim Lekhabua aki jihlut soh kei jin ahi.
English: The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

tcz: Jeroboam min Israelte chunga kum somni vai ana hom in ahi. Jeroboam athi phat in achapa Nadab leng ahung changtan ahi.
en: The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.
text:
1KI 14:20
Thadou: Jeroboam min Israelte chunga kum somni vai ana hom in ahi. Jeroboam athi phat in achapa Nadab leng ahung changtan ahi.
English: The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Alangkhat’a Solomon chapa Rehoboam Judahh lengpa chu leng ahung ahungchan chun kum somli le khat anahi tai. Aman Pakai khopi Jerusalema kum som le sagi vai ana hom in ahi. Hiche khopi hi Pakaiyin ama loupina dinga Israel phung jouse lah’a kon’a ahin lhendoh ahi. Rehoboam nu chu Amon gam mi Naamah ahi.
en: Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
text:
1KI 14:21
Thadou: Alangkhat’a Solomon chapa Rehoboam Judahh lengpa chu leng ahung ahungchan chun kum somli le khat anahi tai. Aman Pakai khopi Jerusalema kum som le sagi vai ana hom in ahi. Hiche khopi hi Pakaiyin ama loupina dinga Israel phung jouse lah’a kon’a ahin lhendoh ahi. Rehoboam nu chu Amon gam mi Naamah ahi.
English: Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

tcz: Rehoboam vaihom sung hin Judahh mipiten Pakai mitmu’n thilse jing ana bol un, achonset nauvin Pakai ana lunghansah un ahi. Ajeh chu apu apate’u sang in thilse ana habol joh un ahi.
en: Judah did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, above all that their fathers had done.
text:
1KI 14:22
Thadou: Rehoboam vaihom sung hin Judahh mipiten Pakai mitmu’n thilse jing ana bol un, achonset nauvin Pakai ana lunghansah un ahi. Ajeh chu apu apate’u sang in thilse ana habol joh un ahi.
English: Judah did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, above all that their fathers had done.

tcz: Ajeh chu ama hon muntin’ah milim semthu houna doiphung ho ana semdoh un chuleh thinglim noi tinle thinglhang sang tin ah Asherah doiphung ana tungdoh un ahi.
en: For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.
text:
1KI 14:23
Thadou: Ajeh chu ama hon muntin’ah milim semthu houna doiphung ho ana semdoh un chuleh thinglim noi tinle thinglhang sang tin ah Asherah doiphung ana tungdoh un ahi.
English: For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.

tcz: Gamsung jousea pasal leh numei kijoh ho doiphung jong anasem un ahi. Pakaiyin Israelte masang’a ana nodoh sa milim hou nam mite kidah umtah'a chonnau ho anajuijun ahi.
en: There were also sodomites in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD drove out before the children of Israel.
text:
1KI 14:24
Thadou: Gamsung jousea pasal leh numei kijoh ho doiphung jong anasem un ahi. Pakaiyin Israelte masang’a ana nodoh sa milim hou nam mite kidah umtah'a chonnau ho anajuijun ahi.
English: There were also sodomites in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD drove out before the children of Israel.

tcz: Rehoboam lengpa vaihom kum nga chan in Egypt lengpa Shishak chun Jerusalem ahin nokhum in ahi.
en: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem;

tcz: Aman leng inpi sunga le Pakai Houin sunga sum khol na jouse anachom ngimsel’in, Solomon in ana sem sana Ompho ho jouse jong achom ngimsel tan ahi.
en: and he took away the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He even took away all of it, including all the gold shields which Solomon had made.
text:
1KI 14:26
Thadou: Aman leng inpi sunga le Pakai Houin sunga sum khol na jouse anachom ngimsel’in, Solomon in ana sem sana Ompho ho jouse jong achom ngimsel tan ahi.
English: and he took away the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He even took away all of it, including all the gold shields which Solomon had made.

tcz: Rehoboam Lengpan hiche Ompho chu sum-eng ana semin ana koi khel in ahi, hiche hochu Leng inpi ngah apipui hon angah tup diuvin angansen ahi.
en: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.
text:
1KI 14:27
Thadou: Rehoboam Lengpan hiche Ompho chu sum-eng ana semin ana koi khel in ahi, hiche hochu Leng inpi ngah apipui hon angah tup diuvin angansen ahi.
English: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.

tcz: Lengpa chu Pakai Houin na acheji phattengleh hiche Ompho ho chu ahin ladoh jiuvin chujouteng le in-ngah ho umna indan sunga akoijiuvin ahi.
en: It was so, that as often as the king went into the LORD’s house, the guard bore them, and brought them back into the guard room.
text:
1KI 14:28
Thadou: Lengpa chu Pakai Houin na acheji phattengleh hiche Ompho ho chu ahin ladoh jiuvin chujouteng le in-ngah ho umna indan sunga akoijiuvin ahi.
English: It was so, that as often as the king went into the LORD’s house, the guard bore them, and brought them back into the guard room.

tcz: Rehoboam vaihom sung’a thilsoh adangho jouse chu Judahh lengte thusim Lekhabua chun aki jihlut soh kei jin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
text:
1KI 14:29
Thadou: Rehoboam vaihom sung’a thilsoh adangho jouse chu Judahh lengte thusim Lekhabua chun aki jihlut soh kei jin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

tcz: Rehoboam le Jeroboam kikah a gal ana kisat machet jing in ahi.
en: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
text:
1KI 14:30
Thadou: Rehoboam le Jeroboam kikah a gal ana kisat machet jing in ahi.
English: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

tcz: Rehoboam chu athi phat in apu apate toh David khopia anavui un ahi. Rehoboam nu chu Amon gam mi Naamah ahi. Ama bannah achapa Abijah leng ahung chang tan ahi.
en: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess. Abijam his son reigned in his place.
text:
1KI 14:31
Thadou: Rehoboam chu athi phat in apu apate toh David khopia anavui un ahi. Rehoboam nu chu Amon gam mi Naamah ahi. Ama bannah achapa Abijah leng ahung chang tan ahi.
English: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess. Abijam his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Jeroboam in Israel chunga ahung vaihomna kum somle get lhin kum in, Abijah in Judahhte chung’ah vaihom in ahung pang in ahi.
en: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah.
text:
1KI 15:1
Thadou: Jeroboam in Israel chunga ahung vaihomna kum somle get lhin kum in, Abijah in Judahhte chung’ah vaihom in ahung pang in ahi.
English: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah.

tcz: Aman Jerusalem ah kum thum vai ana hom in. Anu chu Absalom chanu Maacah ahi.
en: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.
text:
1KI 15:2
Thadou: Aman Jerusalem ah kum thum vai ana hom in. Anu chu Absalom chanu Maacah ahi.
English: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

tcz: Aman jong, ama masanga leng vaihom hobang bangin, thilse jeng ana bol in, apului David kitah bang in a Pakai a Pathen ah ana kitah joupon ahi.
en: He walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.
text:
1KI 15:3
Thadou: Aman jong, ama masanga leng vaihom hobang bangin, thilse jeng ana bol in, apului David kitah bang in a Pakai a Pathen ah ana kitah joupon ahi.
English: He walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.

tcz: Ahin David jal’a, Pakai Pathen in achilhahte aban banna thaomeivah banga vah dinga vaihomna mun ahin ban losah ahin, achapa Abijah jong chu ama nunga Jerusalema vai ahin hop sah ahi.
en: Nevertheless for David’s sake, the LORD his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him and to establish Jerusalem;

tcz: Ajeh chu David in a Pakai mit mu’a apha jeng ana bol’a, Pakai thupeh hoitah’a ahinkho lhumkeiya ana jui lhung kei ahin, Hit mi Uriah chung’a ana kipal bou chu ahi.
en: because David did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
text:
1KI 15:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu David in a Pakai mit mu’a apha jeng ana bol’a, Pakai thupeh hoitah’a ahinkho lhumkeiya ana jui lhung kei ahin, Hit mi Uriah chung’a ana kipal bou chu ahi.
English: because David did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

tcz: Hiche Abijah leh Jeroboam vaihom sung hin aki kah lhon ah gal kisattona ana um mat chat jingin ahi.
en: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
text:
1KI 15:6
Thadou: Hiche Abijah leh Jeroboam vaihom sung hin aki kah lhon ah gal kisattona ana um mat chat jingin ahi.
English: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

tcz: Abijah vaihom sunga thilsoh dangho Judahh lengte thusim kijih na Lekhabu a aum soh kei jin ahi. Abijah le Jeroboam kikah a gal ana umjing in ahi.
en: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
text:
1KI 15:7
Thadou: Abijah vaihom sunga thilsoh dangho Judahh lengte thusim kijih na Lekhabu a aum soh kei jin ahi. Abijah le Jeroboam kikah a gal ana umjing in ahi.
English: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

tcz: Abijah athi phat in David khopia ana kivui jin ahi. Hijou chun achapa Asa chu leng ahung chang in ahi.
en: Abijam slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place.
text:
1KI 15:8
Thadou: Abijah athi phat in David khopia ana kivui jin ahi. Hijou chun achapa Asa chu leng ahung chang in ahi.
English: Abijam slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Jeroboam in Israel chung’a vai ana hom na kum somni ahung lhin hin, Judahh chung’a Asa in vai ahin hom pan in ahi.
en: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.
text:
1KI 15:9
Thadou: Jeroboam in Israel chung’a vai ana hom na kum somni ahung lhin hin, Judahh chung’a Asa in vai ahin hom pan in ahi.
English: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.

tcz: Aman Jerusalema kum somli le khat vai ana hom in ahi. Api chu Abshalom chanu Maacah ahi.
en: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.
text:
1KI 15:10
Thadou: Aman Jerusalema kum somli le khat vai ana hom in ahi. Api chu Abshalom chanu Maacah ahi.
English: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

tcz: Asa hin apului David bang in Pakai mit un alung lhaina ngen ana bol lin ahi.
en: Asa did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, as David his father did.
text:
1KI 15:11
Thadou: Asa hin apului David bang in Pakai mit un alung lhaina ngen ana bol lin ahi.
English: Asa did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, as David his father did.

tcz: Aman gamsunga numei pasal kijoh ho doiphung ho jouse chu anapaidoh in chuleh apu apaten ana hou’u doiho jong sumang gam’in ahi.
en: He put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
text:
1KI 15:12
Thadou: Aman gamsunga numei pasal kijoh ho doiphung ho jouse chu anapaidoh in chuleh apu apaten ana hou’u doiho jong sumang gam’in ahi.
English: He put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

tcz: Aman api Maacah jeng jong Lengnu nu ahina akonin ana haisah in ahi, ajeh chu aman thet umtah Asherah doi ana kisem jeh ahi. Aman kidah umtah adoi hochu asat lhan Kidron phaicham lamah aga hal lhan ahi.
en: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah. Asa cut down her image and burned it at the brook Kidron.
text:
1KI 15:13
Thadou: Aman api Maacah jeng jong Lengnu nu ahina akonin ana haisah in ahi, ajeh chu aman thet umtah Asherah doi ana kisem jeh ahi. Aman kidah umtah adoi hochu asat lhan Kidron phaicham lamah aga hal lhan ahi.
English: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah. Asa cut down her image and burned it at the brook Kidron.

tcz: Aman doiphung ho jouse chu ana suhmanglou vang'in, aman ahinkho lhung keijin kitah tah’in Pakai anajui lhung keijin ahi.
en: But the high places were not taken away. Nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with the LORD all his days.
text:
1KI 15:14
Thadou: Aman doiphung ho jouse chu ana suhmanglou vang'in, aman ahinkho lhung keijin kitah tah’in Pakai anajui lhung keijin ahi.
English: But the high places were not taken away. Nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with the LORD all his days.

tcz: Apaleh aman, sana le dangka chuleh thildang dangho ahin ana kat dohsa lhon hochu Pakai Houin ana polut'in ahi.
en: He brought into the LORD’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated: silver, gold, and utensils.
text:
1KI 15:15
Thadou: Apaleh aman, sana le dangka chuleh thildang dangho ahin ana kat dohsa lhon hochu Pakai Houin ana polut'in ahi.
English: He brought into the LORD’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated: silver, gold, and utensils.

tcz: Judahh lengpa Asa leh Israel lengpa Baasha teni kikah in gal anaum jingin ahi.
en: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
text:
1KI 15:16
Thadou: Judahh lengpa Asa leh Israel lengpa Baasha teni kikah in gal anaum jingin ahi.
English: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

tcz: Israel leng Baasha in Judahh gam ahinsat in, Judahhte leng Asa gamsunga mi alut le apot aumthei louna dingin Ramah chu kulpi aget khumin ahi.
en: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
text:
1KI 15:17
Thadou: Israel leng Baasha in Judahh gam ahinsat in, Judahhte leng Asa gamsunga mi alut le apot aumthei louna dingin Ramah chu kulpi aget khumin ahi.
English: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

tcz: Asa in hiche lethuh na in, Pakai Houin sungle Leng inpia sum kholna a sana dangka ho jouse chu alahdoh in, hichu Hezion tupa Benhadad, Tabrimon chapa Syria Lengpa chu aga pehsah in thu hicheng jong athot in ahi.
en: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered it into the hand of his servants. Then King Asa sent them to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,
text:
1KI 15:18
Thadou: Asa in hiche lethuh na in, Pakai Houin sungle Leng inpia sum kholna a sana dangka ho jouse chu alahdoh in, hichu Hezion tupa Benhadad, Tabrimon chapa Syria Lengpa chu aga pehsah in thu hicheng jong athot in ahi.
English: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered it into the hand of his servants. Then King Asa sent them to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

tcz: “Napa le kapa kikah a kinoptona anaum bang bang chun, tunjong nang le kei kikah ajong kinoptona nei hite. Ven keiman sana le dangka kipa thilpeh, ka hinthot in ahi. Israel Lengpa Baasha toh kinoptona naneilhon chu sukeh in, chutileh aman keima ei dalha in tin ei suboi ta ponte,” ati.
en: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, like that between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”
text:
1KI 15:19
Thadou: “Napa le kapa kikah a kinoptona anaum bang bang chun, tunjong nang le kei kikah ajong kinoptona nei hite. Ven keiman sana le dangka kipa thilpeh, ka hinthot in ahi. Israel Lengpa Baasha toh kinoptona naneilhon chu sukeh in, chutileh aman keima ei dalha in tin ei suboi ta ponte,” ati.
English: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, like that between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

tcz: Asa Lengpa tepna chu Benhadad in jong ana noppeh in, Israel khopi ho nokhum dingin asepaite asoltan ahi. Hitichun amahon Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maacah chuleh Kinnereth pumpi leh Naphtali gam pumpi ana banjo gam tauvin ahi.
en: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel Beth Maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
text:
1KI 15:20
Thadou: Asa Lengpa tepna chu Benhadad in jong ana noppeh in, Israel khopi ho nokhum dingin asepaite asoltan ahi. Hitichun amahon Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maacah chuleh Kinnereth pumpi leh Naphtali gam pumpi ana banjo gam tauvin ahi.
English: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel Beth Maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

tcz: Israel Lengpa Baasha chun thilsoh hochu ajahdoh phat in, Ramah khopi chu kulpi akaikhum na a kon chun aki nungle in Tirzah langa achetan ahi.
en: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.
text:
1KI 15:21
Thadou: Israel Lengpa Baasha chun thilsoh hochu ajahdoh phat in, Ramah khopi chu kulpi akaikhum na a kon chun aki nungle in Tirzah langa achetan ahi.
English: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.

tcz: Hichun Asa lengpa Judahh gamsung a mijousen Baasha in Ramah a umkhum kulpi semna a amanchah songle thingho chu lhoh mang dingin thu apen ahi. Asa in hiche hochu Benjamin gamsunga um Giba khopi leh Mizpah khopi pal getkhum na in amang tan ahi.
en: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
text:
1KI 15:22
Thadou: Hichun Asa lengpa Judahh gamsung a mijousen Baasha in Ramah a umkhum kulpi semna a amanchah songle thingho chu lhoh mang dingin thu apen ahi. Asa in hiche hochu Benjamin gamsunga um Giba khopi leh Mizpah khopi pal getkhum na in amang tan ahi.
English: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

tcz: Asa vaihomna sunga thilsohho leh atha neina dungjuija ana toh le thilbol ho chuleh khopi ana tundoh minho chu Judahh Lengte thusim kijih lutna Lekhabua chun aum in ahi. Ateh lang in akeng ahung natan ahi.
en: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
text:
1KI 15:23
Thadou: Asa vaihomna sunga thilsohho leh atha neina dungjuija ana toh le thilbol ho chuleh khopi ana tundoh minho chu Judahh Lengte thusim kijih lutna Lekhabua chun aum in ahi. Ateh lang in akeng ahung natan ahi.
English: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

tcz: Asa athi phat in ama chu apu apate toh David khopiah anavui tauvin ahi. Hijeh chun Asa chapa Jehosaphat chun Leng mun ahin lotan ahi.
en: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.
text:
1KI 15:24
Thadou: Asa athi phat in ama chu apu apate toh David khopiah anavui tauvin ahi. Hijeh chun Asa chapa Jehosaphat chun Leng mun ahin lotan ahi.
English: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Judahh mite lah a Asa lengpan vai ahom akum ni channa in Jeroboam chapa Nadab chun Israelte lah’a vai ana hom in ahi. Aman Israelte lah a kumni vai ahom in ahi.
en: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.
text:
1KI 15:25
Thadou: Judahh mite lah a Asa lengpan vai ahom akum ni channa in Jeroboam chapa Nadab chun Israelte lah’a vai ana hom in ahi. Aman Israelte lah a kumni vai ahom in ahi.
English: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.

tcz: Aman Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng ana bol’in, apa natoh nung anajuijin, Jeroboam in Israel te ana chonset sah chu anache jompi in ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.
text:
1KI 15:26
Thadou: Aman Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng ana bol’in, apa natoh nung anajuijin, Jeroboam in Israel te ana chonset sah chu anache jompi in ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

tcz: Hijouchun, Issachar phunga kona Ahijah chapa Baasha chun Nadab chu thading ana gon, aman asepaite toh Gibbethon kiti Philistina khopia chu ana nokhum got laitah in ana that tan ahi.
en: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.
text:
1KI 15:27
Thadou: Hijouchun, Issachar phunga kona Ahijah chapa Baasha chun Nadab chu thading ana gon, aman asepaite toh Gibbethon kiti Philistina khopia chu ana nokhum got laitah in ana that tan ahi.
English: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.

tcz: Asa lengpan Judahh mite lah a vai ana hopna kum thum channa in Baasha in Nadab ana that in Israelte leng in anapang in ahi.
en: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.
text:
1KI 15:28
Thadou: Asa lengpan Judahh mite lah a vai ana hopna kum thum channa in Baasha in Nadab ana that in Israelte leng in anapang in ahi.
English: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.

tcz: Aman Jeroboam chilhahte abonchan ana that gamin, leng insunga mite chu khatcha ana hinghoi pon ahi. Hichehi Pakaiyin Shiloh’a, Ahijah Themgaopa mangcha a Jeroboam chung chang thu ana sei chu aguilhun na ahi tai.
en: As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;

tcz: Hitobang thilsoh hi Jeroboam in Pakai Israel Pathen chu asuh lunghang jeh leh, ama chonset na chungchon na Israel mipite chu ana chonset sah jeh ahi.
en: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which he provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.
text:
1KI 15:30
Thadou: Hitobang thilsoh hi Jeroboam in Pakai Israel Pathen chu asuh lunghang jeh leh, ama chonset na chungchon na Israel mipite chu ana chonset sah jeh ahi.
English: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which he provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.

tcz: Nadab in avaihom sunga thilsoh holeh aman ana toh thilho Israel lengte thusim kijihna lekhabu a aum in ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
text:
1KI 15:31
Thadou: Nadab in avaihom sunga thilsoh holeh aman ana toh thilho Israel lengte thusim kijihna lekhabu a aum in ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

tcz: Judahh lengpa Asa leh Israel lengpa Baasha kikah a kidouna anaum jingin ahi.
en: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
text:
1KI 15:32
Thadou: Judahh lengpa Asa leh Israel lengpa Baasha kikah a kidouna anaum jingin ahi.
English: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

tcz: Judahh gam’a Asa lengpan vai ahom kum thum channa in Ahijah chapa Baasha in Israel gam pumpia vai ana hom in ahi. Baasha in Tirzah a kum somni le li vai ana hom in ahi.
en: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years.
text:
1KI 15:33
Thadou: Judahh gam’a Asa lengpan vai ahom kum thum channa in Ahijah chapa Baasha in Israel gam pumpia vai ana hom in ahi. Baasha in Tirzah a kum somni le li vai ana hom in ahi.
English: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years.

tcz: Ahin, amahon Jeroboam chonna dungjuijin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng ana bollin, Jeroboam min Israelte ana chonset sah chu aman jong ana che jom pin ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.
text:
1KI 15:34
Thadou: Ahin, amahon Jeroboam chonna dungjuijin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng ana bollin, Jeroboam min Israelte ana chonset sah chu aman jong ana che jom pin ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

tcz: Hichehi Pakaija kona Hanani chapa Jehu Themgao mangcha a Baasha Lengpa komma thupeh ahi.
en: The LORD’s word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
text:
1KI 16:1
Thadou: Hichehi Pakaija kona Hanani chapa Jehu Themgao mangcha a Baasha Lengpa komma thupeh ahi.
English: The LORD’s word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

tcz: “Keiman nangma hi vutvai lah’a kona katundoh a kami Israelte chunga vaihom’a ka pansah nahi, ahinlah nangin Jeroboam setna lampi najuijin nangin jong Israelte hi na chonset sah’in ka lung nahan sah tan ahi.
en: “Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins,
text:
1KI 16:2
Thadou: “Keiman nangma hi vutvai lah’a kona katundoh a kami Israelte chunga vaihom’a ka pansah nahi, ahinlah nangin Jeroboam setna lampi najuijin nangin jong Israelte hi na chonset sah’in ka lung nahan sah tan ahi.
English: “Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins,

tcz: Hijeh chun keiman Nebat chapa Jeroboam chilhahte ka suhmang bang’a nangle na insung mite jong ka suhmang ding ahi.
en: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
text:
1KI 16:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun keiman Nebat chapa Jeroboam chilhahte ka suhmang bang’a nangle na insung mite jong ka suhmang ding ahi.
English: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

tcz: Baasha insung mite khopi sunga thiden hochu, uicha ten aneh diu, gam lah a thiho chu muthong ten aneh diu ahi,” ati.
en: The dogs will eat Baasha’s descendants who die in the city; and he who dies of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.”
text:
1KI 16:4
Thadou: Baasha insung mite khopi sunga thiden hochu, uicha ten aneh diu, gam lah a thiho chu muthong ten aneh diu ahi,” ati.
English: The dogs will eat Baasha’s descendants who die in the city; and he who dies of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.”

tcz: Baashan vai ahom sunga thilsoh ho chu leh aman a thanei na a ana tohdoh ho Israelte thusimbu kijihna lekhabua aum in ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
text:
1KI 16:5
Thadou: Baashan vai ahom sunga thilsoh ho chu leh aman a thanei na a ana tohdoh ho Israelte thusimbu kijihna lekhabua aum in ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

tcz: Baasha athi phat chun, Tirzah munah avui tauvin ahi. Hijouchun achapa Elah chu ama khel in leng ahung changtan ahi.
en: Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his place.
text:
1KI 16:6
Thadou: Baasha athi phat chun, Tirzah munah avui tauvin ahi. Hijouchun achapa Elah chu ama khel in leng ahung changtan ahi.
English: Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Hanani chapa themgao Jehu mangchan, Pakaiyin Baasha leh a insung mite dounan thu ana seijin ahi. Baasha in Jeroboam leh a insung miten atohbang bang’a Pakai doumah ana boljeh a agihna thuhi ana peh ahin, chu leh hiche Baasha hin Jeroboam insung mite aboncha ana thagam ahi. Pakai lunghan na chu Baashan chunga ana deojah jengin ahi.
en: Moreover the LORD’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.
text:
1KI 16:7
Thadou: Hanani chapa themgao Jehu mangchan, Pakaiyin Baasha leh a insung mite dounan thu ana seijin ahi. Baasha in Jeroboam leh a insung miten atohbang bang’a Pakai doumah ana boljeh a agihna thuhi ana peh ahin, chu leh hiche Baasha hin Jeroboam insung mite aboncha ana thagam ahi. Pakai lunghan na chu Baashan chunga ana deojah jengin ahi.
English: Moreover the LORD’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.

tcz: Asa lengpan Judahh mite lah’a vai apoh kum somni le gup channan, Baasha chapa Elah hin Israel chunga vai ahin hompan tan ahi. Aman Tirzah khopia kum ni vai ana hom in ahi.
en: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years.
text:
1KI 16:8
Thadou: Asa lengpan Judahh mite lah’a vai apoh kum somni le gup channan, Baasha chapa Elah hin Israel chunga vai ahin hompan tan ahi. Aman Tirzah khopia kum ni vai ana hom in ahi.
English: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years.

tcz: Hijouchun lengte galsatna sakol kangtalai ho akehkhat chung’a lamkai Zimri chun ama chu tha ding ana gongin ahi. Tirzah khopia nikhat hi Elah chu khopi sung vaipopa Arza insung a ju ana kham in,
en: His servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was over the household in Tirzah;

tcz: Zimri chu avahlut’in asat lhun athat tai. Hiche hi Asa lengpan Judahh mite lah’a alengchan kum somni le sagi alhinna thilsoh ahi. Hichun Zimri chu leng ahung chang tan ahi.
en: and Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.
text:
1KI 16:10
Thadou: Zimri chu avahlut’in asat lhun athat tai. Hiche hi Asa lengpan Judahh mite lah’a alengchan kum somni le sagi alhinna thilsoh ahi. Hichun Zimri chu leng ahung chang tan ahi.
English: and Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.

tcz: Zimri hin Baashan insung mite jouse gangtah in ana that jou keijin pasal chapang neokhat cha jeng jong ana hinghoi tapon ahi. Aman a insung lamdol a aki naipi behseh jong hilou chuleh agol apaiho kisan ana that’in ahi.
en: When he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he attacked all the house of Baasha. He didn’t leave him a single one who urinates on a wall among his relatives or his friends.
text:
1KI 16:11
Thadou: Zimri hin Baashan insung mite jouse gangtah in ana that jou keijin pasal chapang neokhat cha jeng jong ana hinghoi tapon ahi. Aman a insung lamdol a aki naipi behseh jong hilou chuleh agol apaiho kisan ana that’in ahi.
English: When he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he attacked all the house of Baasha. He didn’t leave him a single one who urinates on a wall among his relatives or his friends.

tcz: Hiti hin Pakaiyin Jehu themgao mangcha’a ana phondohsa bangin, Zimri hin Baasha chilhah ho jouse jong ana sumang soh tan ahi.
en: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
text:
1KI 16:12
Thadou: Hiti hin Pakaiyin Jehu themgao mangcha’a ana phondohsa bangin, Zimri hin Baasha chilhah ho jouse jong ana sumang soh tan ahi.
English: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

tcz: Hiche thilsoh hi Baasha leh achapa Elah chonset jeh leh Israel achonset sah lhon jeh ahi. Hitia hi manlou semthu doilim ho jeh’a Pakai Israel Pathen chu ana suh lunghang’u ahi.
en: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and with which they made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.
text:
1KI 16:13
Thadou: Hiche thilsoh hi Baasha leh achapa Elah chonset jeh leh Israel achonset sah lhon jeh ahi. Hitia hi manlou semthu doilim ho jeh’a Pakai Israel Pathen chu ana suh lunghang’u ahi.
English: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and with which they made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

tcz: Elah vaihom sunga thilsoh ho leh ana tohdoh ho jouse chu Israel lengte thusimbu’a aki jih lut soh kei jin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
text:
1KI 16:14
Thadou: Elah vaihom sunga thilsoh ho leh ana tohdoh ho jouse chu Israel lengte thusimbu’a aki jih lut soh kei jin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
