tcz: Judahh gam'a Asa’in lengvai apohna kum somni le sagi lhinkum hin, Israel pumpia Zimri in vai ahin hom in ahinlah Tirzah khopia ni sagi bou vai ana homin ahi. Israel sepaiten Philistine khopi Gibbethon chu ana no khum un ahi.
en: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
text:
1KI 16:15
Thadou: Judahh gam'a Asa’in lengvai apohna kum somni le sagi lhinkum hin, Israel pumpia Zimri in vai ahin hom in ahinlah Tirzah khopia ni sagi bou vai ana homin ahi. Israel sepaiten Philistine khopi Gibbethon chu ana no khum un ahi.
English: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

tcz: Amahon Zimri in kitahlou tah in lengpa athat tai tithu ajah phat un, hiche nikho mama chun sepai lamkai Omri chu Israelte Leng dingin ana lhengdoh tauvin ahi.
en: The people who were encamped heard that Zimri had conspired, and had also killed the king. Therefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.
text:
1KI 16:16
Thadou: Amahon Zimri in kitahlou tah in lengpa athat tai tithu ajah phat un, hiche nikho mama chun sepai lamkai Omri chu Israelte Leng dingin ana lhengdoh tauvin ahi.
English: The people who were encamped heard that Zimri had conspired, and had also killed the king. Therefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.

tcz: Hitichun Omri in Israel galmi pumpi chu ahin lamkaijin Gibbethon na konin Tirzah ahin nokhum tauvin ahi.
en: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
text:
1KI 16:17
Thadou: Hitichun Omri in Israel galmi pumpi chu ahin lamkaijin Gibbethon na konin Tirzah ahin nokhum tauvin ahi.
English: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

tcz: Zimri chun khopi chu alatai ti ahetphat un, hiche khopia chun achen amale ama meikong akihal khumin athi tan ahi.
en: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the fortified part of the king’s house and burned the king’s house over him with fire, and died,
text:
1KI 16:18
Thadou: Zimri chun khopi chu alatai ti ahetphat un, hiche khopia chun achen amale ama meikong akihal khumin athi tan ahi.
English: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the fortified part of the king’s house and burned the king’s house over him with fire, and died,

tcz: Ajeh chu ama jong hin, Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng ana bol’in ahi. Aman jong Jeroboam in Israelte ana chonset sah tobang chun ana chepin ahi.
en: for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin.
text:
1KI 16:19
Thadou: Ajeh chu ama jong hin, Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng ana bol’in ahi. Aman jong Jeroboam in Israelte ana chonset sah tobang chun ana chepin ahi.
English: for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin.

tcz: Zimri vaihom sunga thilsoh holeh aman dan dihlou tah’a na anatoh naho jouse Israel lengte thusimbu’a aki jih lutsoh keijin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he committed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
text:
1KI 16:20
Thadou: Zimri vaihom sunga thilsoh holeh aman dan dihlou tah’a na anatoh naho jouse Israel lengte thusimbu’a aki jih lutsoh keijin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he committed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

tcz: Ahinlah tuhin Israelte kehni akiso tauvin ahi. Mipi akeh khat’in Ginath chapa Tibni chu achung'uva lenga pang din adei jun ahinlah akeh khat in Omri joh chu adei jun ahi.
en: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.
text:
1KI 16:21
Thadou: Ahinlah tuhin Israelte kehni akiso tauvin ahi. Mipi akeh khat’in Ginath chapa Tibni chu achung'uva lenga pang din adei jun ahinlah akeh khat in Omri joh chu adei jun ahi.
English: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.

tcz: Ahin Omri deiho chun Tibni deiho chu ajou tauvin ahi. Hichun Tibni chu athat tauvin Omri joh chun lengmun ahinlo tan ahi.
en: But the people who followed Omri prevailed against the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
text:
1KI 16:22
Thadou: Ahin Omri deiho chun Tibni deiho chu ajou tauvin ahi. Hichun Tibni chu athat tauvin Omri joh chun lengmun ahinlo tan ahi.
English: But the people who followed Omri prevailed against the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

tcz: Judah gam'a Asa leng chan kum somthum le khat alhin chun, Omri in Israelte lah a vai ahin hompan tan ahi. Aman kum som le ni vai ana hom in kum gup chu Tirzah a ana pansan ahi.
en: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years in Tirzah.
text:
1KI 16:23
Thadou: Judah gam'a Asa leng chan kum somthum le khat alhin chun, Omri in Israelte lah a vai ahin hompan tan ahi. Aman kum som le ni vai ana hom in kum gup chu Tirzah a ana pansan ahi.
English: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years in Tirzah.

tcz: Hijou chun Omri in tua Samaria kiti thinglhang gam chu aneipa Shemer a konin dangka sangkhat le ja nga ape in ana kichoh doh in ahi. Aman hichu khopi khat in ana semin aneipa Shemer akonin Samaria ana sah ahi.
en: He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.
text:
1KI 16:24
Thadou: Hijou chun Omri in tua Samaria kiti thinglhang gam chu aneipa Shemer a konin dangka sangkhat le ja nga ape in ana kichoh doh in ahi. Aman hichu khopi khat in ana semin aneipa Shemer akonin Samaria ana sah ahi.
English: He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.

tcz: Ahinlah Omri in ama masanga lengvaipo ho jouse sangin Pakai Pathen mitmun thilse ngen chang anabol in ahi.
en: Omri did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.
text:
1KI 16:25
Thadou: Ahinlah Omri in ama masanga lengvaipo ho jouse sangin Pakai Pathen mitmun thilse ngen chang anabol in ahi.
English: Omri did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.

tcz: Aman jong Nebat chapa Jeroboam chonsetna jousea Israelte ana chonset sah bangin ama jong hiti hin ana chonin ahi. Mipiten pannabei milim ana hou uvin Israel Pathen chu ana lunghan sah tauvin ahi.
en: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.
text:
1KI 16:26
Thadou: Aman jong Nebat chapa Jeroboam chonsetna jousea Israelte ana chonset sah bangin ama jong hiti hin ana chonin ahi. Mipiten pannabei milim ana hou uvin Israel Pathen chu ana lunghan sah tauvin ahi.
English: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

tcz: Omri vaihom sunga thilsoh dangho chuleh a thaneina chuleh ana tohdoh ho jouse chu Israel lengte thusimbu a chun aki jihlut sohkei jin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
text:
1KI 16:27
Thadou: Omri vaihom sunga thilsoh dangho chuleh a thaneina chuleh ana tohdoh ho jouse chu Israel lengte thusimbu a chun aki jihlut sohkei jin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

tcz: Omri chu athi phat in, Samaria munna ana vuijun ahi. Ama banin achapa Ahab chun lengmun ahinlo tan ahi.
en: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.
text:
1KI 16:28
Thadou: Omri chu athi phat in, Samaria munna ana vuijun ahi. Ama banin achapa Ahab chun lengmun ahinlo tan ahi.
English: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Judahh gam'a Asa leng chan kum somthum le get ahung lhin chun, Omri chu Israelte lengmun ahinlo pantan ahi. Aman Samaria mun’ah kum somni le ni sungin vai ahin hom’in ahi.
en: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.
text:
1KI 16:29
Thadou: Judahh gam'a Asa leng chan kum somthum le get ahung lhin chun, Omri chu Israelte lengmun ahinlo pantan ahi. Aman Samaria mun’ah kum somni le ni sungin vai ahin hom’in ahi.
English: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

tcz: Omri chapa Ahab hin Pakai mitmun thilse jeng ahin bol’in, ama masang’a lengho jouse sangin thilse joh ahin boldoh in ahi.
en: Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight above all that were before him.
text:
1KI 16:30
Thadou: Omri chapa Ahab hin Pakai mitmun thilse jeng ahin bol’in, ama masang’a lengho jouse sangin thilse joh ahin boldoh in ahi.
English: Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight above all that were before him.

tcz: Aman Jeroboam thilse bolchu anung ajui keu hilouvin, Sidon lengpa Ethbaal chanu Jezebel chu ana kichenpin Ba-al doi chu ana houtan ahi.
en: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.
text:
1KI 16:31
Thadou: Aman Jeroboam thilse bolchu anung ajui keu hilouvin, Sidon lengpa Ethbaal chanu Jezebel chu ana kichenpin Ba-al doi chu ana houtan ahi.
English: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.

tcz: Amasan Ahab in Samaria mun ah Ba-al doi phung leh houin ana tungdoh in ahi.
en: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
text:
1KI 16:32
Thadou: Amasan Ahab in Samaria mun ah Ba-al doi phung leh houin ana tungdoh in ahi.
English: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

tcz: Hijou chun aman Asherah doiphung ana tungdoh kit’in, hiti hin aman ama masanga leng dangho sangin Pakai Israel Pathen chu ana phin lunghang pen in ahi.
en: Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.
text:
1KI 16:33
Thadou: Hijou chun aman Asherah doiphung ana tungdoh kit’in, hiti hin aman ama masanga leng dangho sangin Pakai Israel Pathen chu ana phin lunghang pen in ahi.
English: Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.

tcz: Ahab lengvai poh laitah in, Bethel akonin Hiel kitipa in Jericho ahin sempha kittan ahi. Aman inbulkhom aphudoh nin achapa tah pen Abiram kiti pa chun a hinkho alha tan ahi. Aman asahchaija a kehkhat ahin tundoh ahin achapa lhumpenpa chun ahinkho a lha tan ahi. Hiche hi Nun chapa Joshua in Pakaiya kon’a Jericho chungchang thu ana phondoh chu guilhung’a ahitai.
en: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.
text:
1KI 16:34
Thadou: Ahab lengvai poh laitah in, Bethel akonin Hiel kitipa in Jericho ahin sempha kittan ahi. Aman inbulkhom aphudoh nin achapa tah pen Abiram kiti pa chun a hinkho alha tan ahi. Aman asahchaija a kehkhat ahin tundoh ahin achapa lhumpenpa chun ahinkho a lha tan ahi. Hiche hi Nun chapa Joshua in Pakaiya kon’a Jericho chungchang thu ana phondoh chu guilhung’a ahitai.
English: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

tcz: Gilead gamsung, Tishbe khoa akona hung Elijah in Ahab lengpa kom ah, “Akin ka toh jing, hing jing Pakai Israel Pathen min’a ka sei ahi, ‘Keiman thu kapeh to kahse’a kum phabep sunga hi gotwi leh daitwi lha lou ding ahi,” ati.
en: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”
text:
1KI 17:1
Thadou: Gilead gamsung, Tishbe khoa akona hung Elijah in Ahab lengpa kom ah, “Akin ka toh jing, hing jing Pakai Israel Pathen min’a ka sei ahi, ‘Keiman thu kapeh to kahse’a kum phabep sunga hi gotwi leh daitwi lha lou ding ahi,” ati.
English: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”

tcz: Hijou chun Pakaiyin Elijah kom ah hitin ahin sei tai,
en: Then the LORD’s word came to him, saying,
text:
1KI 17:2
Thadou: Hijou chun Pakaiyin Elijah kom ah hitin ahin sei tai,
English: Then the LORD’s word came to him, saying,

tcz: “Hiche mun hi dalhan lang, nisolam jonin Jordan luigal niso lam, Kerith vadung koma khun gakiseltan,
en: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.
text:
1KI 17:3
Thadou: “Hiche mun hi dalhan lang, nisolam jonin Jordan luigal niso lam, Kerith vadung koma khun gakiseltan,
English: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.

tcz: Hiche vadung’a twihi don inlang chuleh va-ahten ahin poh hochu nejing in, ajeh chu keiman an nahin poh peh ding’a ka nganse ahi,” ati.
en: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”
text:
1KI 17:4
Thadou: Hiche vadung’a twihi don inlang chuleh va-ahten ahin poh hochu nejing in, ajeh chu keiman an nahin poh peh ding’a ka nganse ahi,” ati.
English: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”

tcz: Elijah chun Pakaiyin aseipeh bang bangin abol in, Jordan solang Kerith vadung pang’a chun apansa tan ahi.
en: So he went and did according to the LORD’s word, for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.
text:
1KI 17:5
Thadou: Elijah chun Pakaiyin aseipeh bang bangin abol in, Jordan solang Kerith vadung pang’a chun apansa tan ahi.
English: So he went and did according to the LORD’s word, for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.

tcz: Va-ah techun jingkah nilhah in anneh ding chang lhah le sa ahin pohpeh jin chuleh vacha twi chu adonjin ahi.
en: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.
text:
1KI 17:6
Thadou: Va-ah techun jingkah nilhah in anneh ding chang lhah le sa ahin pohpeh jin chuleh vacha twi chu adonjin ahi.
English: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.

tcz: Ahin chomkhat jouvin hiche vadung jong chu akang tan ahi, ajeh chu gamsung’a go ana ju tapon ahi.
en: After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.
text:
1KI 17:7
Thadou: Ahin chomkhat jouvin hiche vadung jong chu akang tan ahi, ajeh chu gamsung’a go ana ju tapon ahi.
English: After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.

tcz: Hijou chun Pakaiyin Elijah kom’a thu hitin ahin seiye,
en: The LORD’s word came to him, saying,
text:
1KI 17:8
Thadou: Hijou chun Pakaiyin Elijah kom’a thu hitin ahin seiye,
English: The LORD’s word came to him, saying,

tcz: “Nangma chen lang Sidon khopi kom’a Zarephath khoa ga che tan,” ati.
en: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”
text:
1KI 17:9
Thadou: “Nangma chen lang Sidon khopi kom’a Zarephath khoa ga che tan,” ati.
English: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”

tcz: Ama Zarephath ah achen, akhosung kelkot phung agah lhunphat in, meithai khat in thing go ana chom amun amanu koma chun, “Lungset tah in khon khat’a twi themkhat nei hinpe thei dem?” atin ahile,
en: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”
text:
1KI 17:10
Thadou: Ama Zarephath ah achen, akhosung kelkot phung agah lhunphat in, meithai khat in thing go ana chom amun amanu koma chun, “Lungset tah in khon khat’a twi themkhat nei hinpe thei dem?” atin ahile,
English: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”

tcz: Amanu chun twi agaso got leh, aman, “Changlhah themkhat jong neihin choi peh in,” ati.
en: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand.”
text:
1KI 17:11
Thadou: Amanu chun twi agaso got leh, aman, “Changlhah themkhat jong neihin choi peh in,” ati.
English: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand.”

tcz: Ahin amanun jong ajah’a, “Pakai na Pathen mina kihahsel’a kasei ahi, insung’a changlhah hal khatcha jong ka neipoi, belsung’a changbong khut dim khatseh ka neitan, hai sunga thao themcha bou kanei tai, tua thingkang themkhat kachom jong hi hiche changbong hile thao hi ka suhto’a keile ka chapa ding’a ka kan’a, ka nehjou lhon teng ka athi dinga ka gellhah lhon ahitai,” ati.
en: She said, “As the LORD your God lives, I don’t have anything baked, but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”
text:
1KI 17:12
Thadou: Ahin amanun jong ajah’a, “Pakai na Pathen mina kihahsel’a kasei ahi, insung’a changlhah hal khatcha jong ka neipoi, belsung’a changbong khut dim khatseh ka neitan, hai sunga thao themcha bou kanei tai, tua thingkang themkhat kachom jong hi hiche changbong hile thao hi ka suhto’a keile ka chapa ding’a ka kan’a, ka nehjou lhon teng ka athi dinga ka gellhah lhon ahitai,” ati.
English: She said, “As the LORD your God lives, I don’t have anything baked, but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”

tcz: Ahinlah Elijah in amanu koma chun, “Lunggim hih in! Na seichu boljengin, ahinla changlhah themkhat kei dingin hinbol masan, chujoutengle aval chu nang le nachapa neh dingin kibol lhon nan nate,” ati.
en: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.
text:
1KI 17:13
Thadou: Ahinlah Elijah in amanu koma chun, “Lunggim hih in! Na seichu boljengin, ahinla changlhah themkhat kei dingin hinbol masan, chujoutengle aval chu nang le nachapa neh dingin kibol lhon nan nate,” ati.
English: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.

tcz: “Ajeh chu hiche hi Pakai Israel Pathen in asei ahi, belsung’a changbong chun beitih anei louhel ding, haisung’a thaotwi jong chu beitih neilouva um ding, gamsung’a Pakaiyin gotwi ahin juhsah masangsea hitia chu neng jing jeng ding ahi, tin aseiye,” ati.
en: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘The jar of meal will not run out, and the jar of oil will not fail, until the day that the LORD sends rain on the earth.’”
text:
1KI 17:14
Thadou: “Ajeh chu hiche hi Pakai Israel Pathen in asei ahi, belsung’a changbong chun beitih anei louhel ding, haisung’a thaotwi jong chu beitih neilouva um ding, gamsung’a Pakaiyin gotwi ahin juhsah masangsea hitia chu neng jing jeng ding ahi, tin aseiye,” ati.
English: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘The jar of meal will not run out, and the jar of oil will not fail, until the day that the LORD sends rain on the earth.’”

tcz: Hichun meithainu jong achen Elijah seibang bangin agabol tai, amanu ahin Elijah ahin, chuleh amanu insung mi ahiuvin an chu ni sottah aneuvin ahi.
en: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, he, and her household ate many days.
text:
1KI 17:15
Thadou: Hichun meithainu jong achen Elijah seibang bangin agabol tai, amanu ahin Elijah ahin, chuleh amanu insung mi ahiuvin an chu ni sottah aneuvin ahi.
English: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, he, and her household ate many days.

tcz: Belsung’a an jong chu abeithei tapon, hai sunga thaotwi jong chu alhasam kha tapoi, Pakaiyin Elijah jah’a aseibang bang in aum tai.
en: The jar of meal didn’t run out and the jar of oil didn’t fail, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.
text:
1KI 17:16
Thadou: Belsung’a an jong chu abeithei tapon, hai sunga thaotwi jong chu alhasam kha tapoi, Pakaiyin Elijah jah’a aseibang bang in aum tai.
English: The jar of meal didn’t run out and the jar of oil didn’t fail, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin hiche numei nu chapa chu ahung dammo tai. Ama dammo chu ahungkhoh cheh cheh jeng tan, achaina in ahung thitan ahi.
en: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.
text:
1KI 17:17
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin hiche numei nu chapa chu ahung dammo tai. Ama dammo chu ahungkhoh cheh cheh jeng tan, achaina in ahung thitan ahi.
English: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.

tcz: Hijou chun meithainun Elijah kom’ah, “Vo Pathen mipa ka chunga hi ipi nabol hitam? Hilaiya hi ka chonset ho Pathen henga phongdoh dia hikoma hunga, kachapa thilosah nahim?” ati.
en: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”
text:
1KI 17:18
Thadou: Hijou chun meithainun Elijah kom’ah, “Vo Pathen mipa ka chunga hi ipi nabol hitam? Hilaiya hi ka chonset ho Pathen henga phongdoh dia hikoma hunga, kachapa thilosah nahim?” ati.
English: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”

tcz: Ahin Elijah in adonbut in, “Nachapa chu neihin pen,” atin, anu pheichung’a akon chun akidop doh’in, indan chung’a ageji na indan a chun adom touvin alupna jalkhun na chun alup sah in ahi.
en: He said to her, “Give me your son.” He took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.
text:
1KI 17:19
Thadou: Ahin Elijah in adonbut in, “Nachapa chu neihin pen,” atin, anu pheichung’a akon chun akidop doh’in, indan chung’a ageji na indan a chun adom touvin alupna jalkhun na chun alup sah in ahi.
English: He said to her, “Give me your son.” He took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.

tcz: Hichun Elijah chun Pakai heng’a ataovin, “Vo Pakai ka Pathen keiman lhunna a kanei ji hiche meithainu chunga hi hamsetna na chuhsah’a, achapa hi nathisah ding hitam?” ati.
en: He cried to the LORD and said, “LORD my God, have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by killing her son?”
text:
1KI 17:20
Thadou: Hichun Elijah chun Pakai heng’a ataovin, “Vo Pakai ka Pathen keiman lhunna a kanei ji hiche meithainu chunga hi hamsetna na chuhsah’a, achapa hi nathisah ding hitam?” ati.
English: He cried to the LORD and said, “LORD my God, have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by killing her son?”

tcz: Hichun hiche chapangpa chunga chun thumvei alum’in, Pakai kom’ah chun apeng jah jengin, “O Pakai Pathen hiche chapang hinkho hi, hinkile dohsahtei tei jin,” ati.
en: He stretched himself on the child three times, and cried to the LORD and said, “LORD my God, please let this child’s soul come into him again.”
text:
1KI 17:21
Thadou: Hichun hiche chapangpa chunga chun thumvei alum’in, Pakai kom’ah chun apeng jah jengin, “O Pakai Pathen hiche chapang hinkho hi, hinkile dohsahtei tei jin,” ati.
English: He stretched himself on the child three times, and cried to the LORD and said, “LORD my God, please let this child’s soul come into him again.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Elijah taona chu ana ngaipeh in, hiche chapangpa hinkho chu ahin kiledoh sah in ahung hingdoh tan ahi.
en: The LORD listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
text:
1KI 17:22
Thadou: Pakaiyin Elijah taona chu ana ngaipeh in, hiche chapangpa hinkho chu ahin kiledoh sah in ahung hingdoh tan ahi.
English: The LORD listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

tcz: Hichun Elijah’in inchung akonin ahin pomsuh in anu ape in, “Ven nacha hi ahing tai,” ati.
en: Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”
text:
1KI 17:23
Thadou: Hichun Elijah’in inchung akonin ahin pomsuh in anu ape in, “Ven nacha hi ahing tai,” ati.
English: Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”

tcz: Hijou chun meithainu chun Elijah kom’ah, “Tunvang keiman nangma hi Pathen mi mong mong nahin chuleh Pakaiyin nang’a hin thu asei mong mong’e ti ka hechen tai,” ati.
en: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the LORD’s word in your mouth is truth.”
text:
1KI 17:24
Thadou: Hijou chun meithainu chun Elijah kom’ah, “Tunvang keiman nangma hi Pathen mi mong mong nahin chuleh Pakaiyin nang’a hin thu asei mong mong’e ti ka hechen tai,” ati.
English: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the LORD’s word in your mouth is truth.”

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou, gojuh louna kum thum alhin phat in, Pakajin Elijah kom’ah, “Chenlang Ahab lengpa kom’ah, ‘Pakaiyin ajuhsah vahding ahitai gatin,” ati.
en: After many days, the LORD’s word came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, “Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I will send rain on the earth.”
text:
1KI 18:1
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jou, gojuh louna kum thum alhin phat in, Pakajin Elijah kom’ah, “Chenlang Ahab lengpa kom’ah, ‘Pakaiyin ajuhsah vahding ahitai gatin,” ati.
English: After many days, the LORD’s word came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, “Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I will send rain on the earth.”

tcz: Hichun Elijah jong Ahab kom’ah achen ahi. A langkhat na Samaria khopia chun kel ana khoh lheh jing in ahi.
en: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.
text:
1KI 18:2
Thadou: Hichun Elijah jong Ahab kom’ah achen ahi. A langkhat na Samaria khopia chun kel ana khoh lheh jing in ahi.
English: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.

tcz: Hijeh chun Ahab chun khopi vesuija pang Obadiah chu ana kouvin ahi. Amachu chu Pakai nungjui dih tah ahi.
en: Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly;

tcz: Jezebel’in Pakai themgao jouse tha gam sohkei ding ana got laichun, hiche Obadiah kitipa hin songko mun nia themgao jakhat ana huhdoh in ahi. Aman songko khatna mi som nga nga in ana sellin ama ho chu an le twi ana pen ahi.
en: for when Jezebel cut off the LORD’s prophets, Obadiah took one hundred prophets, and hid them fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
text:
1KI 18:4
Thadou: Jezebel’in Pakai themgao jouse tha gam sohkei ding ana got laichun, hiche Obadiah kitipa hin songko mun nia themgao jakhat ana huhdoh in ahi. Aman songko khatna mi som nga nga in ana sellin ama ho chu an le twi ana pen ahi.
English: for when Jezebel cut off the LORD’s prophets, Obadiah took one hundred prophets, and hid them fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

tcz: Ahab in Obadiah kom’ah, “Chen lang gamsung jouse ga kholsoh kei jin twinah jouse gaven chuleh phaicham jouse jong gachon soh keijin, ijeh nem itileh ham hing pouna munkhat beh imudoh uva ka sakol holeh sakol pol phabep beh i-hinso thei khat diuham,” ati.
en: Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, that we not lose all the animals.”
text:
1KI 18:5
Thadou: Ahab in Obadiah kom’ah, “Chen lang gamsung jouse ga kholsoh kei jin twinah jouse gaven chuleh phaicham jouse jong gachon soh keijin, ijeh nem itileh ham hing pouna munkhat beh imudoh uva ka sakol holeh sakol pol phabep beh i-hinso thei khat diuham,” ati.
English: Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, that we not lose all the animals.”

tcz: Hitichun amani chu gamsung khol ding chun akihom khen lhonin, Ahab jong amatah akipan in gamkai lang khat cheh jonin aki homkhen lhon tan ahi.
en: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
text:
1KI 18:6
Thadou: Hitichun amani chu gamsung khol ding chun akihom khen lhonin, Ahab jong amatah akipan in gamkai lang khat cheh jonin aki homkhen lhon tan ahi.
English: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

tcz: Hitia chu Obadiah avale leh, photlot louvin Elijah chu ama komlang ahin jonin ahi. Obadiah chun amachu ahe peijing in, a angsung’ah abohkhup in ahi. Aman ajah’a, “Kapu Elijah na hilou haimo?” atileh,
en: As Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”
text:
1KI 18:7
Thadou: Hitia chu Obadiah avale leh, photlot louvin Elijah chu ama komlang ahin jonin ahi. Obadiah chun amachu ahe peijing in, a angsung’ah abohkhup in ahi. Aman ajah’a, “Kapu Elijah na hilou haimo?” atileh,
English: As Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”

tcz: Elijah in, “Ka hinai tun chen lang napupa kom’ah, ‘Elijah hikom’ah aum’e’ ga tin,” ati.
en: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’”
text:
1KI 18:8
Thadou: Elijah in, “Ka hinai tun chen lang napupa kom’ah, ‘Elijah hikom’ah aum’e’ ga tin,” ati.
English: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’”

tcz: Ahivangin Obadiah chun, “Ipi pen tah’a koiman chonset na kaneiya, nangman na sohpa keima hi, Ahab khutna nei peh doh’a ama thasah ding neiti ham?” ati.
en: He said, “How have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?
text:
1KI 18:9
Thadou: Ahivangin Obadiah chun, “Ipi pen tah’a koiman chonset na kaneiya, nangman na sohpa keima hi, Ahab khutna nei peh doh’a ama thasah ding neiti ham?” ati.
English: He said, “How have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?

tcz: “Hingjing Pakai na Pathen min’a kasei ahi, kapu Ahab in nangma holnan leiset chunga lenggam jouse le nam jouse hi kolkim vella ahol soh ahitai. Elijah hikom ah aumpoi tihi ama kom alhut teng ule hiche lenggam mite chu aki hahsel sahji ahi.
en: As the LORD your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he took an oath of the kingdom and nation that they didn’t find you.
text:
1KI 18:10
Thadou: “Hingjing Pakai na Pathen min’a kasei ahi, kapu Ahab in nangma holnan leiset chunga lenggam jouse le nam jouse hi kolkim vella ahol soh ahitai. Elijah hikom ah aumpoi tihi ama kom alhut teng ule hiche lenggam mite chu aki hahsel sahji ahi.
English: As the LORD your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he took an oath of the kingdom and nation that they didn’t find you.

tcz: Ahinla tun nangman napupa jah’a, ‘Elijah hikom ah aum’e’ ga tin neitin.
en: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here.”’
text:
1KI 18:11
Thadou: Ahinla tun nangman napupa jah’a, ‘Elijah hikom ah aum’e’ ga tin neitin.
English: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here.”’

tcz: Ahin nangma ka dalhah lhah teng lhagao vin nangma ka het khahlouna mun khat ah, nalhoh mang kit’in tin, Ahab in nangma na mudoh lou ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh na sohpa keima hi Pathen gingtah mi kahi vang'in Ahab chun ei thalo tei ding ahi.
en: It will happen, as soon as I leave you, that the LORD’s Spirit will carry you I don’t know where; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he can’t find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared the LORD from my youth.
text:
1KI 18:12
Thadou: Ahin nangma ka dalhah lhah teng lhagao vin nangma ka het khahlouna mun khat ah, nalhoh mang kit’in tin, Ahab in nangma na mudoh lou ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh na sohpa keima hi Pathen gingtah mi kahi vang'in Ahab chun ei thalo tei ding ahi.
English: It will happen, as soon as I leave you, that the LORD’s Spirit will carry you I don’t know where; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he can’t find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared the LORD from my youth.

tcz: Jezebel lengnun Pakai Themgao te thagam dia agot laiya, thilsoh chu koiman na jah’a aseilou ham? Keiman themgao ho jakhat chu songko nia kana seldoh’a an le twi kana peh ahi.
en: Wasn’t it told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the LORD’s prophets, how I hid one hundred men of the LORD’s prophets with fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
text:
1KI 18:13
Thadou: Jezebel lengnun Pakai Themgao te thagam dia agot laiya, thilsoh chu koiman na jah’a aseilou ham? Keiman themgao ho jakhat chu songko nia kana seldoh’a an le twi kana peh ahi.
English: Wasn’t it told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the LORD’s prophets, how I hid one hundred men of the LORD’s prophets with fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

tcz: Ahin tun nangin chenlang napupa jaha, ‘Elijah hikom ah aum’e,’ gatin nati. Hepu, hichu ka seileh Ahab in eitha teitei ding ahi,” ati.
en: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”
text:
1KI 18:14
Thadou: Ahin tun nangin chenlang napupa jaha, ‘Elijah hikom ah aum’e,’ gatin nati. Hepu, hichu ka seileh Ahab in eitha teitei ding ahi,” ati.
English: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”

tcz: Ahinlah Elijah in, “Keima a-angsung’a kadin jing, Pakai thanei pen minna kihahsel’a kasei ahi, tuni tah’a hi Ahab chu keiman ka kimupi tei ding ahi,” ati.
en: Elijah said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today.”
text:
1KI 18:15
Thadou: Ahinlah Elijah in, “Keima a-angsung’a kadin jing, Pakai thanei pen minna kihahsel’a kasei ahi, tuni tah’a hi Ahab chu keiman ka kimupi tei ding ahi,” ati.
English: Elijah said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Obadiah in Ahab kom’ah, “Elijah ahung’e,” aga tin ahileh, Ahab chu Elijah toh kimuto dingin achen ahi.
en: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
text:
1KI 18:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun Obadiah in Ahab kom’ah, “Elijah ahung’e,” aga tin ahileh, Ahab chu Elijah toh kimuto dingin achen ahi.
English: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

tcz: Ahab in amuphat in ahin samin, “Israel suboi jingpa nangma na hung hinam?” atin ahi.
en: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”
text:
1KI 18:17
Thadou: Ahab in amuphat in ahin samin, “Israel suboi jingpa nangma na hung hinam?” atin ahi.
English: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”

tcz: Elijah in adonbut in, “Keiman Israel kasuboi poi, nangma le na insung mite in na suhboi ahibouve, ajeh chu nangin Pakai thupeh nitlouvin, Baal semthu Pathen joh na hou uvin ahi.
en: He answered, “I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken the LORD’s commandments and you have followed the Baals.
text:
1KI 18:18
Thadou: Elijah in adonbut in, “Keiman Israel kasuboi poi, nangma le na insung mite in na suhboi ahibouve, ajeh chu nangin Pakai thupeh nitlouvin, Baal semthu Pathen joh na hou uvin ahi.
English: He answered, “I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken the LORD’s commandments and you have followed the Baals.

tcz: Tun Israelte jouse Carmel mol’ah khom in, Baal themgao jali le somnga toh Asherah themgao jali Jazebel in avah ho chu kouvin,” ati.
en: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel, and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal, and four hundred of the prophets of the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”
text:
1KI 18:19
Thadou: Tun Israelte jouse Carmel mol’ah khom in, Baal themgao jali le somnga toh Asherah themgao jali Jazebel in avah ho chu kouvin,” ati.
English: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel, and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal, and four hundred of the prophets of the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”

tcz: Hiti chun Ahab in Israel mipi hole themgao hochu Carmel mol ah akou khom in ahi.
en: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.
text:
1KI 18:20
Thadou: Hiti chun Ahab in Israel mipi hole themgao hochu Carmel mol ah akou khom in ahi.
English: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.

tcz: Hichun Elijah chu amaho masang ah ading doh in, “Phat i-chanpi hi lunggel khenna nei louva lungni pu’a naum jom jing nahlai diuham? Pakai hi Pathen ahi natiu leh jui jeng’un, ahinla Baal hi pathen ahi natiu leh jui jeng’un,” atin ahi. Ahinlah mipi chu athipchet jeng un ahi.
en: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If the LORD is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The people didn’t say a word.
text:
1KI 18:21
Thadou: Hichun Elijah chu amaho masang ah ading doh in, “Phat i-chanpi hi lunggel khenna nei louva lungni pu’a naum jom jing nahlai diuham? Pakai hi Pathen ahi natiu leh jui jeng’un, ahinla Baal hi pathen ahi natiu leh jui jeng’un,” atin ahi. Ahinlah mipi chu athipchet jeng un ahi.
English: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If the LORD is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The people didn’t say a word.

tcz: Hijou chun Elijah in amaho kom’ah asei tai, “Pakai themgao aki hinghoiya keima changbou kahi tai, Baal doi themgao ho vang jali le somnga alhing uve.
en: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of the LORD; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.
text:
1KI 18:22
Thadou: Hijou chun Elijah in amaho kom’ah asei tai, “Pakai themgao aki hinghoiya keima changbou kahi tai, Baal doi themgao ho vang jali le somnga alhing uve.
English: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of the LORD; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.

tcz: Tun bongchal ni hin kailut uvin lang, amahon bongchal khat kilhen masat uvintin, that’u henlang, asemtel jou teng uleh thinglom chung’a khun koi uhen, meivang ati theilou diu ahi. Kenjong bongchal khat joh chu that ing ting thinglom chunga koi jing tin ama vang mei kati lou ding ahi.
en: Let them therefore give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under; and I will dress the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under it.
text:
1KI 18:23
Thadou: Tun bongchal ni hin kailut uvin lang, amahon bongchal khat kilhen masat uvintin, that’u henlang, asemtel jou teng uleh thinglom chung’a khun koi uhen, meivang ati theilou diu ahi. Kenjong bongchal khat joh chu that ing ting thinglom chunga koi jing tin ama vang mei kati lou ding ahi.
English: Let them therefore give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under; and I will dress the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under it.

tcz: Hijou teng chuleh na pathen’u min kou un, chule keiman ka Pakai min kakou ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh mei konga hin donbut pen penchu, Pathen dih ahi ti hetna ahi jenge,” ati. Hichu mipi hon a-nop peh tauvin ahi.
en: You call on the name of your god, and I will call on the LORD’s name. The God who answers by fire, let him be God.” All the people answered, “What you say is good.”
text:
1KI 18:24
Thadou: Hijou teng chuleh na pathen’u min kou un, chule keiman ka Pakai min kakou ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh mei konga hin donbut pen penchu, Pathen dih ahi ti hetna ahi jenge,” ati. Hichu mipi hon a-nop peh tauvin ahi.
English: You call on the name of your god, and I will call on the LORD’s name. The God who answers by fire, let him be God.” All the people answered, “What you say is good.”

tcz: Hichun Elijah in Baal themgao ho kom ah, “Nangho atamjo nahiuvin, bol masauvin,” ati. Hichun bongchal khat joh chu kilhen unlang kisem un, na pathen’u chu kou’un, amavang thinglom chung’a chun mei tih hih un,” ati.
en: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull for yourselves, and dress it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under it.”
text:
1KI 18:25
Thadou: Hichun Elijah in Baal themgao ho kom ah, “Nangho atamjo nahiuvin, bol masauvin,” ati. Hichun bongchal khat joh chu kilhen unlang kisem un, na pathen’u chu kou’un, amavang thinglom chung’a chun mei tih hih un,” ati.
English: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull for yourselves, and dress it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under it.”

tcz: Hiti chun amahon bongchal khat chu alheng un, athat un, asem toh un, maicham chung achun akoiyun, jingkah’a pat sun gei jin, “O Baal neihouvun” tin apeng peng jeng tauvin ahi. Hijou chun amaho alam’un, maicham vella chun asuh chop atou chop jing un ahi.
en: They took the bull which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, “Baal, hear us!” But there was no voice, and nobody answered. They leaped about the altar which was made.
text:
1KI 18:26
Thadou: Hiti chun amahon bongchal khat chu alheng un, athat un, asem toh un, maicham chung achun akoiyun, jingkah’a pat sun gei jin, “O Baal neihouvun” tin apeng peng jeng tauvin ahi. Hijou chun amaho alam’un, maicham vella chun asuh chop atou chop jing un ahi.
English: They took the bull which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, “Baal, hear us!” But there was no voice, and nobody answered. They leaped about the altar which was made.

tcz: Sun kim ahung hi phat’in, Elijah chun amaho chu atot in, “Na hasap jep’u ngai inte ajeh chu ama pathen ahin, asun imut phat ahi loule, aki choldo phat ahilou leh akhol jin pet ahiloule, a imut pet hija suhkhah ngai himai thei ahi,” ati peh’e.
en: At noon, Elijah mocked them, and said, “Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either he is deep in thought, or he has gone somewhere, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he sleeps and must be awakened.”
text:
1KI 18:27
Thadou: Sun kim ahung hi phat’in, Elijah chun amaho chu atot in, “Na hasap jep’u ngai inte ajeh chu ama pathen ahin, asun imut phat ahi loule, aki choldo phat ahilou leh akhol jin pet ahiloule, a imut pet hija suhkhah ngai himai thei ahi,” ati peh’e.
English: At noon, Elijah mocked them, and said, “Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either he is deep in thought, or he has gone somewhere, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he sleeps and must be awakened.”

tcz: Hijeh chun amahon, ahasap cheh, aha sap cheh jeng un chuleh achon na’u dungjuijin chemcha le chamjam in athi’u ahung kikhodoh masang sen aki at-chen chen jeng un ahi.
en: They cried aloud, and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances until the blood gushed out on them.
text:
1KI 18:28
Thadou: Hijeh chun amahon, ahasap cheh, aha sap cheh jeng un chuleh achon na’u dungjuijin chemcha le chamjam in athi’u ahung kikhodoh masang sen aki at-chen chen jeng un ahi.
English: They cried aloud, and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances until the blood gushed out on them.

tcz: Hiti chun nilhah lam kilhai phatdon geiyin akap’un apengun, ahivangin, ogin ima la aja pouvin i-macha donbut na amu deh pouvin ahi.
en: When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention.
text:
1KI 18:29
Thadou: Hiti chun nilhah lam kilhai phatdon geiyin akap’un apengun, ahivangin, ogin ima la aja pouvin i-macha donbut na amu deh pouvin ahi.
English: When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention.

tcz: Chutah chun Elijah jong chun mipi jouse jah’a, “Nei hin nai lut uvin,” atileh mipi abonchauvin ahenga ahung ki khinlut soh tauve. Hichun Elijah chun Pakai maicham akivo chimsa chu asem phan ahi.
en: Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me!”; and all the people came near to him. He repaired the LORD’s altar that had been thrown down.
text:
1KI 18:30
Thadou: Chutah chun Elijah jong chun mipi jouse jah’a, “Nei hin nai lut uvin,” atileh mipi abonchauvin ahenga ahung ki khinlut soh tauve. Hichun Elijah chun Pakai maicham akivo chimsa chu asem phan ahi.
English: Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me!”; and all the people came near to him. He repaired the LORD’s altar that had been thrown down.

tcz: Hichun aman Israel phungkhat cheh thalheng dingin songtum somle ni ana lhoh khom’in ahi.
en: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the LORD’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”
text:
1KI 18:31
Thadou: Hichun aman Israel phungkhat cheh thalheng dingin songtum somle ni ana lhoh khom’in ahi.
English: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the LORD’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”

tcz: Chuleh song tumho chunga chun Pakai min in maicham anathah semin ahi.
en: With the stones he built an altar in the LORD’s name. He made a trench around the altar large enough to contain two seahs of seed.
text:
1KI 18:32
Thadou: Chuleh song tumho chunga chun Pakai min in maicham anathah semin ahi.
English: With the stones he built an altar in the LORD’s name. He made a trench around the altar large enough to contain two seahs of seed.

tcz: Elijah chun thinglom jong chu agol gol in ajamin chuin bongchal chu asemtel tel’in, thinglom chunga chun ajamtan ahi. Hichun Elijah in asei jin, “Twi dimset set bel li gadom uvin lang, pumgo thilto chung le thinglom chunga chun chap kot sohkei jun,” ati.
en: He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. He said, “Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood.”
text:
1KI 18:33
Thadou: Elijah chun thinglom jong chu agol gol in ajamin chuin bongchal chu asemtel tel’in, thinglom chunga chun ajamtan ahi. Hichun Elijah in asei jin, “Twi dimset set bel li gadom uvin lang, pumgo thilto chung le thinglom chunga chun chap kot sohkei jun,” ati.
English: He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. He said, “Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood.”

tcz: Hichu aboljou un, Elijah in, “Bol kit uvin,” atin ahileh ama hon avellin abolkit tauve. Aman asol kit’in, “Thumvei lhin nan ga bol kit uvin,” atia ahileh mihon jong athumvei lhinan abolkit tauve.
en: He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.
text:
1KI 18:34
Thadou: Hichu aboljou un, Elijah in, “Bol kit uvin,” atin ahileh ama hon avellin abolkit tauve. Aman asol kit’in, “Thumvei lhin nan ga bol kit uvin,” atia ahileh mihon jong athumvei lhinan abolkit tauve.
English: He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.

tcz: Hiti chun maicham kimvel a chun twi along dimset tan, twilam jong chu twi adimset tan ahi.
en: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.
text:
1KI 18:35
Thadou: Hiti chun maicham kimvel a chun twi along dimset tan, twilam jong chu twi adimset tan ahi.
English: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.

tcz: Nilhah lang pumgo thilto phat donin, Elijah themgao pachu maicham muna akal touvin atao tan ahi. “Vo Pakai Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, Jacob Pathen tuni nikho’a hin nangma hi Israel Pathen nahina leh keima hi nasohpa kahina hinphong doh in, hicheho jouse hi nangma thupeh’a kana bol ahi jong hi hinphong doh in.
en: At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, “LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.
text:
1KI 18:36
Thadou: Nilhah lang pumgo thilto phat donin, Elijah themgao pachu maicham muna akal touvin atao tan ahi. “Vo Pakai Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, Jacob Pathen tuni nikho’a hin nangma hi Israel Pathen nahina leh keima hi nasohpa kahina hinphong doh in, hicheho jouse hi nangma thupeh’a kana bol ahi jong hi hinphong doh in.
English: At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, “LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.

tcz: “Vo Pakai neihin donbut in! Hiche mite hin nangma hi Pakai Pathen na hin chule nang in alungthim’u hi nanga dinga nale heipeh’u ahitai tihi ahet doh diu ahi,” ati.
en: Hear me, LORD, hear me, that this people may know that you, LORD, are God, and that you have turned their heart back again.”
text:
1KI 18:37
Thadou: “Vo Pakai neihin donbut in! Hiche mite hin nangma hi Pakai Pathen na hin chule nang in alungthim’u hi nanga dinga nale heipeh’u ahitai tihi ahet doh diu ahi,” ati.
English: Hear me, LORD, hear me, that this people may know that you, LORD, are God, and that you have turned their heart back again.”

tcz: Chutah chun Pakaiya konin meikong ahung lenglhan, pumgo thilto bongchal sa chu aka vam jengin, thinglom jong akavam jeng in, leivui jong aleo go jengin, twilam’a twivei jeng jong chu ahul go hel jing in ahi.
en: Then the LORD’s fire fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.
text:
1KI 18:38
Thadou: Chutah chun Pakaiya konin meikong ahung lenglhan, pumgo thilto bongchal sa chu aka vam jengin, thinglom jong akavam jeng in, leivui jong aleo go jengin, twilam’a twivei jeng jong chu ahul go hel jing in ahi.
English: Then the LORD’s fire fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.

tcz: Mipin hiche thilsoh hi amudoh phat uvin, amai’u tol’ah asulut cheh uvin hitin aseitauve, “Pakai amahi Pathen ahi, ahiye, Pakai hi Pathen ahi,” atiuve.
en: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “The LORD, he is God! The LORD, he is God!”
text:
1KI 18:39
Thadou: Mipin hiche thilsoh hi amudoh phat uvin, amai’u tol’ah asulut cheh uvin hitin aseitauve, “Pakai amahi Pathen ahi, ahiye, Pakai hi Pathen ahi,” atiuve.
English: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “The LORD, he is God! The LORD, he is God!”

tcz: Hijou chun Elijah in mipi ho chu thu apen, “Baal themgao hochu man’un, khatcha jong lhaso hih’un,” ati. Hichun mipi hon amaho chu aman’un, Elijah in Kishon phaichama apui suh in abonchauvin athat gam tan ahi.
en: Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and killed them there.
text:
1KI 18:40
Thadou: Hijou chun Elijah in mipi ho chu thu apen, “Baal themgao hochu man’un, khatcha jong lhaso hih’un,” ati. Hichun mipi hon amaho chu aman’un, Elijah in Kishon phaichama apui suh in abonchauvin athat gam tan ahi.
English: Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and killed them there.

tcz: Chuin Elijah chun Ahab komah, “Chenlang an ga nen lang twi ga don tan ajeh chu keiman gojuh na dinga van kithin husa kajatai,” ati.
en: Elijah said to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.”
text:
1KI 18:41
Thadou: Chuin Elijah chun Ahab komah, “Chenlang an ga nen lang twi ga don tan ajeh chu keiman gojuh na dinga van kithin husa kajatai,” ati.
English: Elijah said to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.”

tcz: Hitichun Ahab jong achen an anen twi adon in ahi. Ahinla Elijah chu Carmel molchunga akaldoh in, tol achun akun chah kheh in, akhup teni kikah’a amai asulut in, akun kheh in ahi.
en: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.
text:
1KI 18:42
Thadou: Hitichun Ahab jong achen an anen twi adon in ahi. Ahinla Elijah chu Carmel molchunga akaldoh in, tol achun akun chah kheh in, akhup teni kikah’a amai asulut in, akun kheh in ahi.
English: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.

tcz: Chuin asohpa jah’a, “Chen lang twikhanglen lam khu gave tan,” ati. Hichun asohpa jong achen agaven, Elijah kom a ahung kile kit in “Ima kamupoi” ati. Sagivei jen Elijah chun achea aga vet ding'in anasollin ahi.
en: He said to his servant, “Go up now and look toward the sea.” He went up and looked, then said, “There is nothing.” He said, “Go again” seven times.
text:
1KI 18:43
Thadou: Chuin asohpa jah’a, “Chen lang twikhanglen lam khu gave tan,” ati. Hichun asohpa jong achen agaven, Elijah kom a ahung kile kit in “Ima kamupoi” ati. Sagivei jen Elijah chun achea aga vet ding'in anasollin ahi.
English: He said to his servant, “Go up now and look toward the sea.” He went up and looked, then said, “There is nothing.” He said, “Go again” seven times.

tcz: Asagi vei channa chun asoh pan hitin aseiye, “Vetan, meilhang neo cha mihem khut phang tibep khat hi twikhanglen na konin ahung ki tung doh’e,” ati. Chuphat in Elijah chun asohpa jah’a, “Ahab kom achun cheloijin lang hitin hin ga seipeh in, ‘Na sakol kangtalai ah chun kaldoh inlang na inlanga cheloijin achuti louva ahile geisang le chun gojuh in na lap ding, nache theilou ding ahi, ga tipeh in,” ati.
en: On the seventh time, he said, “Behold, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.” He said, “Go up, tell Ahab, ‘Get ready and go down, so that the rain doesn’t stop you.’”
text:
1KI 18:44
Thadou: Asagi vei channa chun asoh pan hitin aseiye, “Vetan, meilhang neo cha mihem khut phang tibep khat hi twikhanglen na konin ahung ki tung doh’e,” ati. Chuphat in Elijah chun asohpa jah’a, “Ahab kom achun cheloijin lang hitin hin ga seipeh in, ‘Na sakol kangtalai ah chun kaldoh inlang na inlanga cheloijin achuti louva ahile geisang le chun gojuh in na lap ding, nache theilou ding ahi, ga tipeh in,” ati.
English: On the seventh time, he said, “Behold, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.” He said, “Go up, tell Ahab, ‘Get ready and go down, so that the rain doesn’t stop you.’”

tcz: Hichejou jou chun, van ahung thimcheh cheh jengin, meilom ahung kikhom khom jeng tan hui ahung nungpan tai, chuin go ha juh in ahung jun ahi. Ahab chu asakol kangtalai akitol in Jezreel henglam’ah gangtah in achetan ahi.
en: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
text:
1KI 18:45
Thadou: Hichejou jou chun, van ahung thimcheh cheh jengin, meilom ahung kikhom khom jeng tan hui ahung nungpan tai, chuin go ha juh in ahung jun ahi. Ahab chu asakol kangtalai akitol in Jezreel henglam’ah gangtah in achetan ahi.
English: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Elijah chu thahatna jat chombeh apen, aman jong atai akigah in, Ahab masang’ah ana kheltan in Jezreel kot phunga a ana lam tin kittan ahi.
en: The LORD’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
text:
1KI 18:46
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin Elijah chu thahatna jat chombeh apen, aman jong atai akigah in, Ahab masang’ah ana kheltan in Jezreel kot phunga a ana lam tin kittan ahi.
English: The LORD’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

tcz: Ahab chu ain agalhun in, Elijah thilbol ho jouse, Baal themgao ho athagam hojong chu Jezebel asei peh sohkei tan ahi.
en: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
text:
1KI 19:1
Thadou: Ahab chu ain agalhun in, Elijah thilbol ho jouse, Baal themgao ho athagam hojong chu Jezebel asei peh sohkei tan ahi.
English: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

tcz: Hichun Jezebel in Elijah chu hiti hin thu athot tan ahi, “Jingle tuphat tah’a hi Baal themgao ho na thagam banga chu keiman jong nang katha ding ahi, katha lou poupouleh ka doi hohin keima eithat jeng hen,” ati.
en: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I don’t make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time!”
text:
1KI 19:2
Thadou: Hichun Jezebel in Elijah chu hiti hin thu athot tan ahi, “Jingle tuphat tah’a hi Baal themgao ho na thagam banga chu keiman jong nang katha ding ahi, katha lou poupouleh ka doi hohin keima eithat jeng hen,” ati.
English: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I don’t make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time!”

tcz: Chuin Elijah jong chu akicha lheh jengin, ahinkho kihuhdohna dingin ajamtan ahi. Judahh khopi Beersheba langa chun achen hichea chun asohpa adalhan ahi.
en: When he saw that, he arose and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.
text:
1KI 19:3
Thadou: Chuin Elijah jong chu akicha lheh jengin, ahinkho kihuhdohna dingin ajamtan ahi. Judahh khopi Beersheba langa chun achen hichea chun asohpa adalhan ahi.
English: When he saw that, he arose and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.

tcz: Hijou chun ama achangseh'in gamthip noiya nilhum keijin lam ajot’in ahi. Ama Longlao phungnoi khat ah atouvin, athina dingin ataotan ahi. “Vo Pakai ka khop lheh jeng tai, kahinkho hi la jeng tan ajeh chu kei jong kapu ka pate sangin kaphajo dehpoi,” atin ahi.
en: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested for himself that he might die, and said, “It is enough. Now, O LORD, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.”
text:
1KI 19:4
Thadou: Hijou chun ama achangseh'in gamthip noiya nilhum keijin lam ajot’in ahi. Ama Longlao phungnoi khat ah atouvin, athina dingin ataotan ahi. “Vo Pakai ka khop lheh jeng tai, kahinkho hi la jeng tan ajeh chu kei jong kapu ka pate sangin kaphajo dehpoi,” atin ahi.
English: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested for himself that he might die, and said, “It is enough. Now, O LORD, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.”

tcz: Hiche Longlao phungnoi achun akumin a ihmu tan ahi. Ahinlah hitia chu agah imutlhah leh Vantil khat in ahin tham in, hitin ahinseipeh in, “Thouvin lang an nen,” ati.
en: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”
text:
1KI 19:5
Thadou: Hiche Longlao phungnoi achun akumin a ihmu tan ahi. Ahinlah hitia chu agah imutlhah leh Vantil khat in ahin tham in, hitin ahinseipeh in, “Thouvin lang an nen,” ati.
English: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”

tcz: Elijah in jong aven ahileh alulhunna chun song el-lenglung khat ah changlhah themkhat kansa ana um'in, Elijah chun changlhah chu anen twijong chu adon in alum kit tai.
en: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.
text:
1KI 19:6
Thadou: Elijah in jong aven ahileh alulhunna chun song el-lenglung khat ah changlhah themkhat kansa ana um'in, Elijah chun changlhah chu anen twijong chu adon in alum kit tai.
English: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.

tcz: Chu jouvin Pakai vantil chun ani vei channa in ahung kit in, Elijah chu ahin tham kit in, “Thoudoh in lang an nen, achutilouleh na kholjin na ding hi nang dinga hahsa val ding ahi,” ati.
en: The LORD’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”
text:
1KI 19:7
Thadou: Chu jouvin Pakai vantil chun ani vei channa in ahung kit in, Elijah chu ahin tham kit in, “Thoudoh in lang an nen, achutilouleh na kholjin na ding hi nang dinga hahsa val ding ahi,” ati.
English: The LORD’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”

tcz: Hichun ama athoudoh in, twi adonin hiche anneh husan chun ni somli le jan somli sung in lam ajot in Horeb molsang geijin achen ahi.
en: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.
text:
1KI 19:8
Thadou: Hichun ama athoudoh in, twi adonin hiche anneh husan chun ni somli le jan somli sung in lam ajot in Horeb molsang geijin achen ahi.
English: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.

tcz: Hiche munna chun Elijah songko sung khatna alut’in khovah geijin agehtan ahi. Hichun Pakaiyin thu ahin seijin, “Elijah hikom achu ipi nabol ham?” ahinti.
en: He came to a cave there, and camped there; and behold, the LORD’s word came to him, and he said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
text:
1KI 19:9
Thadou: Hiche munna chun Elijah songko sung khatna alut’in khovah geijin agehtan ahi. Hichun Pakaiyin thu ahin seijin, “Elijah hikom achu ipi nabol ham?” ahinti.
English: He came to a cave there, and camped there; and behold, the LORD’s word came to him, and he said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

tcz: Elijah in adonbut in, “Keima hatchungnung Pakai, Pathen kin kabolna a ka lunglut behseh jengin ahi. Ahinlah Israel mipite hin namite toh na kitepna’u hi asukeh un, na maicham ho a suchip un, na Themgao te athat gam un atha moh’u keibou kaum tan, tun keijeng jong tha ding eigo tauvin ahi,” ati.
en: He said, “I have been very jealous for the LORD, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”
text:
1KI 19:10
Thadou: Elijah in adonbut in, “Keima hatchungnung Pakai, Pathen kin kabolna a ka lunglut behseh jengin ahi. Ahinlah Israel mipite hin namite toh na kitepna’u hi asukeh un, na maicham ho a suchip un, na Themgao te athat gam un atha moh’u keibou kaum tan, tun keijeng jong tha ding eigo tauvin ahi,” ati.
English: He said, “I have been very jealous for the LORD, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin, “Kipatdoh inlang molsang chungvum akhun ka masang’a ga ding tan,” ati. Hitia chu Elijah aga din leh Pakai chun ahin hopan, huipi hattah chu ahung nungin molsang chu atat kha jengin ahi. Hiche huinun chu ahat behseh jengin, songpi hochu ata leh achip lah lah jengin ahinlah huilah’a chun Pakai aumpon ahi. Huinun jou chun ling akihot in ahinlah ling kihona ah jong chun Pakai aum deh pon ahi.
en: He said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before the LORD.” Behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before the LORD; but the LORD was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake; but the LORD was not in the earthquake.
text:
1KI 19:11
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin, “Kipatdoh inlang molsang chungvum akhun ka masang’a ga ding tan,” ati. Hitia chu Elijah aga din leh Pakai chun ahin hopan, huipi hattah chu ahung nungin molsang chu atat kha jengin ahi. Hiche huinun chu ahat behseh jengin, songpi hochu ata leh achip lah lah jengin ahinlah huilah’a chun Pakai aumpon ahi. Huinun jou chun ling akihot in ahinlah ling kihona ah jong chun Pakai aum deh pon ahi.
English: He said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before the LORD.” Behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before the LORD; but the LORD was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake; but the LORD was not in the earthquake.

tcz: Ling kiho jouchun mei ahung kong in ahinlah Pakai chu meikong lah a jong aumpon ahi. Hiche meikong chu akichai jouvin onem hiuheo vin ahung ging in,
en: After the earthquake a fire passed; but the LORD was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.
text:
1KI 19:12
Thadou: Ling kiho jouchun mei ahung kong in ahinlah Pakai chu meikong lah a jong aumpon ahi. Hiche meikong chu akichai jouvin onem hiuheo vin ahung ging in,
English: After the earthquake a fire passed; but the LORD was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.

tcz: Elijah chun hichu ajah phat in, amai chu apon in akikhun, apot doh in songko koma chun aga dingin ahi. Ogin khat ahung ging in, “Elijah hi kom munahi ipi bol nahim?” ati.
en: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
text:
1KI 19:13
Thadou: Elijah chun hichu ajah phat in, amai chu apon in akikhun, apot doh in songko koma chun aga dingin ahi. Ogin khat ahung ging in, “Elijah hi kom munahi ipi bol nahim?” ati.
English: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

tcz: Aman adonbut’in, “Keiman Pakai, Pathen hatchungnung kin kabol hi ka lunglut behseh jengin, ahinlah Israel mipite hin Pakai toh akitepnau asukeh un, na maicham asu chip un na Themgao te jouse athat gam un keima bou asoh cha ka hin tun kei jong eithat go tauvin ahi,” ati.
en: He said, “I have been very jealous for the LORD, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”
text:
1KI 19:14
Thadou: Aman adonbut’in, “Keiman Pakai, Pathen hatchungnung kin kabol hi ka lunglut behseh jengin, ahinlah Israel mipite hin Pakai toh akitepnau asukeh un, na maicham asu chip un na Themgao te jouse athat gam un keima bou asoh cha ka hin tun kei jong eithat go tauvin ahi,” ati.
English: He said, “I have been very jealous for the LORD, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin, “Nahung na lang mama a nung chekit’in lang Damascus gamthip noilang khu na galhun tengleh Syria te leng dingin Hazael khu thao ganu in,” ati.
en: The LORD said to him, “Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.
text:
1KI 19:15
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin, “Nahung na lang mama a nung chekit’in lang Damascus gamthip noilang khu na galhun tengleh Syria te leng dingin Hazael khu thao ganu in,” ati.
English: The LORD said to him, “Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.

tcz: “Hichejou teng chuleh Israelte leng dingin Nimshi tupa Jehu khu thao nu in, chuleh nang khel’a ka Themgao dingin Abel-meholah khopia konin Shaphat chapa Elisha khu thao nu in,
en: Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place.
text:
1KI 19:16
Thadou: “Hichejou teng chuleh Israelte leng dingin Nimshi tupa Jehu khu thao nu in, chuleh nang khel’a ka Themgao dingin Abel-meholah khopia konin Shaphat chapa Elisha khu thao nu in,
English: Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place.

tcz: Hazael akona jamdoh chu Jehu in atha ding Jehu a kona jamdoh chu Elisha in atha ding ahi,” ati.
en: He who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and he who escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.
text:
1KI 19:17
Thadou: Hazael akona jamdoh chu Jehu in atha ding Jehu a kona jamdoh chu Elisha in atha ding ahi,” ati.
English: He who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and he who escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.

tcz: “Tujengin jong Baal masanga kun khalou leh akam ajong chop khalou hel cheh adang jasagi Israel sung ah kanei nalaije,” ati.
en: Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth which has not kissed him.”
text:
1KI 19:18
Thadou: “Tujengin jong Baal masanga kun khalou leh akam ajong chop khalou hel cheh adang jasagi Israel sung ah kanei nalaije,” ati.
English: Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth which has not kissed him.”

tcz: Hitichun Elijah chu achen, Shaphat chapa Elisha chu aloukhoi na aga mun ahi. Loulaiya chu bongchal to somleni aumin, ahin Elisha chun somleni channa chu mangchan lou ana khoijin ahi. Elija chu aganailut in apon chu achunga aga sep lhan achemang tai.
en: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.
text:
1KI 19:19
Thadou: Hitichun Elijah chu achen, Shaphat chapa Elisha chu aloukhoi na aga mun ahi. Loulaiya chu bongchal to somleni aumin, ahin Elisha chun somleni channa chu mangchan lou ana khoijin ahi. Elija chu aganailut in apon chu achunga aga sep lhan achemang tai.
English: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.

tcz: Elishan jong abongchal ading teni chu adalhan, Elijah nung adel in, “Amasan ka nule kapa a vailhah nan gabeng chop ingting nahinjui nang’e,” aga tin ahi. Elijah in adonbut in, “Kinungle jengin, amavang ken ka bol peh ipi ham gel in,” ati.
en: Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you.” He said to him, “Go back again; for what have I done to you?”
text:
1KI 19:20
Thadou: Elishan jong abongchal ading teni chu adalhan, Elijah nung adel in, “Amasan ka nule kapa a vailhah nan gabeng chop ingting nahinjui nang’e,” aga tin ahi. Elijah in adonbut in, “Kinungle jengin, amavang ken ka bol peh ipi ham gel in,” ati.
English: Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you.” He said to him, “Go back again; for what have I done to you?”

tcz: Hichun Elisha akinung le in bongchal chu athat in a loukhoi na thing chu atih in bongchal chu ahon na in amang tan ahi. Aman khopi mite akhom khomin, sa chu a nehsah soh keijin ahi. Hichejou chun Elijah nung chu ajuijin a lhachan apang tan ahi.
en: He returned from following him, and took the yoke of oxen, killed them, and boiled their meat with the oxen’s equipment, and gave to the people; and they ate. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and served him.
text:
1KI 19:21
Thadou: Hichun Elisha akinung le in bongchal chu athat in a loukhoi na thing chu atih in bongchal chu ahon na in amang tan ahi. Aman khopi mite akhom khomin, sa chu a nehsah soh keijin ahi. Hichejou chun Elijah nung chu ajuijin a lhachan apang tan ahi.
English: He returned from following him, and took the yoke of oxen, killed them, and boiled their meat with the oxen’s equipment, and gave to the people; and they ate. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and served him.

tcz: Hiche phatlai sung hin, Syria lengpa Benhadad in asepaite jouse akomin chuleh leng somthum le nin asakol holeh akangtalai jouse pumin apanhun, hiti hin Benhadad chu Samaria sat din akitol’un, Israelte khopi kulpi Samaria chu aum uvin gal in anokhum tauvin ahi.
en: Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and chariots. He went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.
text:
1KI 20:1
Thadou: Hiche phatlai sung hin, Syria lengpa Benhadad in asepaite jouse akomin chuleh leng somthum le nin asakol holeh akangtalai jouse pumin apanhun, hiti hin Benhadad chu Samaria sat din akitol’un, Israelte khopi kulpi Samaria chu aum uvin gal in anokhum tauvin ahi.
English: Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and chariots. He went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.

tcz: Benhadad in Israel lengpa Ahab hengah mi asollin, thu ana thot in, “Hiche Benhadad kiti pan kasei ahi,
en: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him, “Ben Hadad says,
text:
1KI 20:2
Thadou: Benhadad in Israel lengpa Ahab hengah mi asollin, thu ana thot in, “Hiche Benhadad kiti pan kasei ahi,
English: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him, “Ben Hadad says,

tcz: Na insunga na sana leh na dangka chuleh najite le nachate apha lai chengse chu keiya hidiu ahitai,” agatisah tai.
en: ‘Your silver and your gold are mine. Your wives also and your children, even the best, are mine.’”
text:
1KI 20:3
Thadou: Na insunga na sana leh na dangka chuleh najite le nachate apha lai chengse chu keiya hidiu ahitai,” agatisah tai.
English: ‘Your silver and your gold are mine. Your wives also and your children, even the best, are mine.’”

tcz: Chunin Israel lengpan adonbut in, “Kapu lengpan nasei ho chu adih soh keije kanei jouse hi nanga ahi,” ati.
en: The king of Israel answered, “It is according to your saying, my lord, O king. I am yours, and all that I have.”
text:
1KI 20:4
Thadou: Chunin Israel lengpan adonbut in, “Kapu lengpan nasei ho chu adih soh keije kanei jouse hi nanga ahi,” ati.
English: The king of Israel answered, “It is according to your saying, my lord, O king. I am yours, and all that I have.”

tcz: Benhadad in gangtah in adonbutna thu chu athot kit in, “Hiche Benhadad keima thuthot ahi, na sana leh na dangka chu leh naji na chate neipeh ding ahi tia, thu kapehsa nahitai.
en: The messengers came again and said, “Ben Hadad says, ‘I sent indeed to you, saying, “You shall deliver me your silver, your gold, your wives, and your children;

tcz: Ahinlah, jing nikho tuphat tah leh, naleng inpi le navaipote in jouse khol’a thil manlua agel jouseu kilah dia kavaipote kahinsol ding ahi,” agatisah kit in ahi.
en: but I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, and they will search your house and the houses of your servants. Whatever is pleasant in your eyes, they will put it in their hand, and take it away.”’”
text:
1KI 20:6
Thadou: Ahinlah, jing nikho tuphat tah leh, naleng inpi le navaipote in jouse khol’a thil manlua agel jouseu kilah dia kavaipote kahinsol ding ahi,” agatisah kit in ahi.
English: but I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, and they will search your house and the houses of your servants. Whatever is pleasant in your eyes, they will put it in their hand, and take it away.”’”

tcz: Hiche jou chun Ahab in agamsung upa chingthei ho jouse akhomin, amaho koma chun, “Veuvin hichepa hin eisuboi lheh jeng un ahi! Aman aki ngeh bangin keiman ka sana leh ka dangka chu leh kaji ka chate chu kana phalpeh tan ahi,” ati.
en: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, “Please notice how this man seeks mischief; for he sent to me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I didn’t deny him.”
text:
1KI 20:7
Thadou: Hiche jou chun Ahab in agamsung upa chingthei ho jouse akhomin, amaho koma chun, “Veuvin hichepa hin eisuboi lheh jeng un ahi! Aman aki ngeh bangin keiman ka sana leh ka dangka chu leh kaji ka chate chu kana phalpeh tan ahi,” ati.
English: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, “Please notice how this man seeks mischief; for he sent to me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I didn’t deny him.”

tcz: Amipite leh upa chingthei ho chun, “Hiche kal val chun imacha phalpeh tahih in,” atipeh un ahi.
en: All the elders and all the people said to him, “Don’t listen, and don’t consent.”
text:
1KI 20:8
Thadou: Amipite leh upa chingthei ho chun, “Hiche kal val chun imacha phalpeh tahih in,” atipeh un ahi.
English: All the elders and all the people said to him, “Don’t listen, and don’t consent.”

tcz: Hichun Ahab in Benhadad sottol le ho koma chun, “Kapu lengpa koma chun hiti hin seipeh tauvin, amasa’a nathil ngeh ho chu ka phalpeh jeng e, ahinlah tua achaina’a nathil ngeh hovang hi kasang theipoi,” ati. Hiti chun sottole ho chun hiche thu chu apo uvin Benhadad hengah akile tauvin ahi.
en: Therefore he said to the messengers of Ben Hadad, “Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you sent for to your servant at the first I will do, but this thing I cannot do.’” The messengers departed and brought him back the message.
text:
