1KI 20:9
Thadou: Hichun Ahab in Benhadad sottol le ho koma chun, “Kapu lengpa koma chun hiti hin seipeh tauvin, amasa’a nathil ngeh ho chu ka phalpeh jeng e, ahinlah tua achaina’a nathil ngeh hovang hi kasang theipoi,” ati. Hiti chun sottole ho chun hiche thu chu apo uvin Benhadad hengah akile tauvin ahi.
English: Therefore he said to the messengers of Ben Hadad, “Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you sent for to your servant at the first I will do, but this thing I cannot do.’” The messengers departed and brought him back the message.

tcz: Hichun Benhadad in Ahab chu hiti hin thu athot kit’e, “Keiman na khopi Samaria hi vogoihel’a ahalsi sia khut’a choidoh kham mihem kahin puilut ding kasuhmang ding ahi. Hichu kaboldoh lou le ka hou pathenten eithat jeng hen!” ati.
en: Ben Hadad sent to him, and said, “The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.”
text:
1KI 20:10
Thadou: Hichun Benhadad in Ahab chu hiti hin thu athot kit’e, “Keiman na khopi Samaria hi vogoihel’a ahalsi sia khut’a choidoh kham mihem kahin puilut ding kasuhmang ding ahi. Hichu kaboldoh lou le ka hou pathenten eithat jeng hen!” ati.
English: Ben Hadad sent to him, and said, “The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.”

tcz: Israel lengpa Ahab in ahin donbut in, “Galmun’a galsat dia sepai khat in a chemjam akipoh nung’a, galsat chaisa ho ham hoithoa thucheng chu bol ngai ahipoi, tin seipeh un,” ati.
en: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Don’t let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.’”
text:
1KI 20:11
Thadou: Israel lengpa Ahab in ahin donbut in, “Galmun’a galsat dia sepai khat in a chemjam akipoh nung’a, galsat chaisa ho ham hoithoa thucheng chu bol ngai ahipoi, tin seipeh un,” ati.
English: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Don’t let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.’”

tcz: Benhadad leh apanpi leng dangho toh, ponbuh sunga ju ana donlai tah'un, Ahab donbutna thucheng chu aja tauvin ahi. Hichun Benhadad chun asepaite kom’ah galsat din kigo uvintin thu ape tan ahi. Hijeh chun khopi chu nokhum dingin akigo tauvin ahi.
en: When Ben Hadad heard this message as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, he said to his servants, “Prepare to attack!” So they prepared to attack the city.
text:
1KI 20:12
Thadou: Benhadad leh apanpi leng dangho toh, ponbuh sunga ju ana donlai tah'un, Ahab donbutna thucheng chu aja tauvin ahi. Hichun Benhadad chun asepaite kom’ah galsat din kigo uvintin thu ape tan ahi. Hijeh chun khopi chu nokhum dingin akigo tauvin ahi.
English: When Ben Hadad heard this message as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, he said to his servants, “Prepare to attack!” So they prepared to attack the city.

tcz: Hiche kah lah chun, themgao khat Israel lengpa Ahab kimupi din achen, “Pakaiyin hiti hin thu aseiye, ‘Hiche galmi hon tamtah hokhu numu am? Tunia amaho khu nangma khutna ka pehdoh ding chule galjona na nei ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh nangman keima hi Pakai kitipa chu kahi nei hetdoh ding ahi,” ati.
en: Behold, a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel, and said, “The LORD says, ‘Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand today. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”
text:
1KI 20:13
Thadou: Hiche kah lah chun, themgao khat Israel lengpa Ahab kimupi din achen, “Pakaiyin hiti hin thu aseiye, ‘Hiche galmi hon tamtah hokhu numu am? Tunia amaho khu nangma khutna ka pehdoh ding chule galjona na nei ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh nangman keima hi Pakai kitipa chu kahi nei hetdoh ding ahi,” ati.
English: Behold, a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel, and said, “The LORD says, ‘Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand today. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”

tcz: Hichun Ahab in, “Ipiti ahinbol ding ham?” tin adong in ahi. Chuin themgaopa chun ahin donbut in, “Gambih vaipo ho noija khangthah hon abol diu ahi,” atin ahile, Ahab in, “Keihon kasat masat diu ham?” tin adongkit in ahile, thempupan, “Henge nanghon nasat masat diu ahi,” ati
en: Ahab said, “By whom?” He said, “The LORD says, ‘By the young men of the princes of the provinces.’” Then he said, “Who shall begin the battle?” He answered, “You.”
text:
1KI 20:14
Thadou: Hichun Ahab in, “Ipiti ahinbol ding ham?” tin adong in ahi. Chuin themgaopa chun ahin donbut in, “Gambih vaipo ho noija khangthah hon abol diu ahi,” atin ahile, Ahab in, “Keihon kasat masat diu ham?” tin adongkit in ahile, thempupan, “Henge nanghon nasat masat diu ahi,” ati
English: Ahab said, “By whom?” He said, “The LORD says, ‘By the young men of the princes of the provinces.’” Then he said, “Who shall begin the battle?” He answered, “You.”

tcz: Hichun Ahab in gambih vaipo ho chu asimtoh leh, mi jani le somthum le ni ahiuvin ahi. Chujouvin Israel sepai jouse chu asimtoh leh sang sagi alhing in ahi.
en: Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. After them, he mustered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.
text:
1KI 20:15
Thadou: Hichun Ahab in gambih vaipo ho chu asimtoh leh, mi jani le somthum le ni ahiuvin ahi. Chujouvin Israel sepai jouse chu asimtoh leh sang sagi alhing in ahi.
English: Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. After them, he mustered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

tcz: Sunkim dontah chun, Benhadad leh aki loipi Leng som le ni hochun aponbuh sung uvah ju anadon khom’un ahi.
en: They went out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings who helped him.
text:
1KI 20:16
Thadou: Sunkim dontah chun, Benhadad leh aki loipi Leng som le ni hochun aponbuh sung uvah ju anadon khom’un ahi.
English: They went out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings who helped him.

tcz: Hichun gambih lamkaiho chu khopi sunga kon chun ahung kitoldoh masapen un ahileh, Benhadad sepai ho chun akom a Samaria konin sepai phabep ahung kitol doh uve atin ahileh,
en: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”
text:
1KI 20:17
Thadou: Hichun gambih lamkaiho chu khopi sunga kon chun ahung kitoldoh masapen un ahileh, Benhadad sepai ho chun akom a Samaria konin sepai phabep ahung kitol doh uve atin ahileh,
English: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”

tcz: Benhadad in, “Amaho chu chamna a hung hiu hen lang, galsat dinga hung hi jong leu ahing in man poupouvin,” ati.
en: He said, “If they have come out for peace, take them alive; or if they have come out for war, take them alive.”
text:
1KI 20:18
Thadou: Benhadad in, “Amaho chu chamna a hung hiu hen lang, galsat dinga hung hi jong leu ahing in man poupouvin,” ati.
English: He said, “If they have come out for peace, take them alive; or if they have come out for war, take them alive.”

tcz: Ahinlah sepaite apumpi ahin, gambih lamkaiho ahin, abon’un galsat dingin ahung kondoh tauvin ahi.
en: So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them.
text:
1KI 20:19
Thadou: Ahinlah sepaite apumpi ahin, gambih lamkaiho ahin, abon’un galsat dingin ahung kondoh tauvin ahi.
English: So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them.

tcz: Israel sepaite chun Syria sepai akimaitopi cheh u athat’un ahile, Syria sepaiho chu ati’u ajan, ajam mang gam tauvin ahi. Hichun Israelten anungdel’un ahileh Benhadad lengpa leh sakol kangtalaiya touthem phabep chu anajam doh man’un ahi.
en: They each killed his man. The Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them. Ben Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen.
text:
1KI 20:20
Thadou: Israel sepaite chun Syria sepai akimaitopi cheh u athat’un ahile, Syria sepaiho chu ati’u ajan, ajam mang gam tauvin ahi. Hichun Israelten anungdel’un ahileh Benhadad lengpa leh sakol kangtalaiya touthem phabep chu anajam doh man’un ahi.
English: They each killed his man. The Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them. Ben Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen.

tcz: Ahiyeng vang'in, Israel lengpa chun Syria sakol dang holeh sakol kangtalai ho chu ana ban suhmang peh tan ahi.
en: The king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter.
text:
1KI 20:21
Thadou: Ahiyeng vang'in, Israel lengpa chun Syria sakol dang holeh sakol kangtalai ho chu ana ban suhmang peh tan ahi.
English: The king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin themgaopa chun, Ahab Lengpa kom ah, “Na hung nokhum kit di’u ahin kigingphan, Syria lengpa chun khovei chavang phatleh hung kit ding ahi hijeh chun thilho kigontoh in,” ati.
en: The prophet came near to the king of Israel and said to him, “Go, strengthen yourself, and plan what you must do, for at the return of the year, the king of Syria will come up against you.”
text:
1KI 20:22
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin themgaopa chun, Ahab Lengpa kom ah, “Na hung nokhum kit di’u ahin kigingphan, Syria lengpa chun khovei chavang phatleh hung kit ding ahi hijeh chun thilho kigontoh in,” ati.
English: The prophet came near to the king of Israel and said to him, “Go, strengthen yourself, and plan what you must do, for at the return of the year, the king of Syria will come up against you.”

tcz: Agal-lal jou nung in, agal lamkai hon Benhadad jah’a, “Israelte Pathen hi thinglhang gam Pathen ahiuve, hijeh achu thinglhanga eijo’u ahi. Phaicham a kisatpi leuhen bailamtah a gal ijo jeng diu ahi,” atiuve.
en: The servants of the king of Syria said to him, “Their god is a god of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we. But let’s fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they.
text:
1KI 20:23
Thadou: Agal-lal jou nung in, agal lamkai hon Benhadad jah’a, “Israelte Pathen hi thinglhang gam Pathen ahiuve, hijeh achu thinglhanga eijo’u ahi. Phaicham a kisatpi leuhen bailamtah a gal ijo jeng diu ahi,” atiuve.
English: The servants of the king of Syria said to him, “Their god is a god of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we. But let’s fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they.

tcz: “Hiche chung’a a bou hin leng ho athunei nauva konin haisah in lang, akhel in sepai lamkai ho pansah in,” atiuve.
en: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place.
text:
1KI 20:24
Thadou: “Hiche chung’a a bou hin leng ho athunei nauva konin haisah in lang, akhel in sepai lamkai ho pansah in,” atiuve.
English: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place.

tcz: “Sepai alhasam jat hi subulhing kit’in, sepaite sakol leh kangtalai te atil ajat maman subulhing kit in, chuteng leh phaicham ah kisatpi leu veng kajo teidiu ahi,” atiuve. Hitichun Benhadad in jong angaichat bang’un abolpeh soh tan ahi.
en: Muster an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot. We will fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they are.” He listened to their voice and did so.
text:
1KI 20:25
Thadou: “Sepai alhasam jat hi subulhing kit’in, sepaite sakol leh kangtalai te atil ajat maman subulhing kit in, chuteng leh phaicham ah kisatpi leu veng kajo teidiu ahi,” atiuve. Hitichun Benhadad in jong angaichat bang’un abolpeh soh tan ahi.
English: Muster an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot. We will fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they are.” He listened to their voice and did so.

tcz: A kumkit chavang lai ahiphat in, Syria sepaite asemtoh sohkeiyin Israelte kisatpi dingin tuchung hin Aphek lang jon tauvin ahi.
en: At the return of the year, Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.
text:
1KI 20:26
Thadou: A kumkit chavang lai ahiphat in, Syria sepaite asemtoh sohkeiyin Israelte kisatpi dingin tuchung hin Aphek lang jon tauvin ahi.
English: At the return of the year, Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.

tcz: Isrtaelte jong aki semtoh un, neh leh chah jong hoitah’in akigon toh’un, galsat dingin ahung kitol tauve in ahi. Ahinlah Israel sepaite alhomdan uchu, kelcha hon lhomcha ni kijotna toh abang un ahi. Syria sepaite vang chu gamsung pumpi adim lha jeng un ahi.
en: The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and went against them. The children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats, but the Syrians filled the country.
text:
1KI 20:27
Thadou: Isrtaelte jong aki semtoh un, neh leh chah jong hoitah’in akigon toh’un, galsat dingin ahung kitol tauve in ahi. Ahinlah Israel sepaite alhomdan uchu, kelcha hon lhomcha ni kijotna toh abang un ahi. Syria sepaite vang chu gamsung pumpi adim lha jeng un ahi.
English: The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and went against them. The children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats, but the Syrians filled the country.

tcz: Hichun Pathen mipa chun Israel lengpa kom’ah achen, “Pakaiyin hiti hin aseiye, Syria sepaiten hiti hin aseiyun ahi, a Pakai’u khu thinglhang Pathen ahin, phaicham Pathen ahipoi. Hijeh chun hiche sepai tamtah tehi kajopeh diu ahi, chutengleh nang hon Pakai kahi chu nei het doh dio ahi,” ati.
en: A man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, “The LORD says, ‘Because the Syrians have said, “The LORD is a god of the hills, but he is not a god of the valleys,” therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am the LORD.’”
text:
1KI 20:28
Thadou: Hichun Pathen mipa chun Israel lengpa kom’ah achen, “Pakaiyin hiti hin aseiye, Syria sepaiten hiti hin aseiyun ahi, a Pakai’u khu thinglhang Pathen ahin, phaicham Pathen ahipoi. Hijeh chun hiche sepai tamtah tehi kajopeh diu ahi, chutengleh nang hon Pakai kahi chu nei het doh dio ahi,” ati.
English: A man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, “The LORD says, ‘Because the Syrians have said, “The LORD is a god of the hills, but he is not a god of the valleys,” therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am the LORD.’”

tcz: Hiche galmi teni hin nisagi sungin kimai ngat ton ngahmun akisem’un, anaum un ahi. Ni sagi lhin nin akisat to pan tauvin ahi. Israelten nikhat sungin Syriate keng sepai hochu sang jakhat anathat’un ahi.
en: They encamped opposite each other for seven days. Then on the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.
text:
1KI 20:29
Thadou: Hiche galmi teni hin nisagi sungin kimai ngat ton ngahmun akisem’un, anaum un ahi. Ni sagi lhin nin akisat to pan tauvin ahi. Israelten nikhat sungin Syriate keng sepai hochu sang jakhat anathat’un ahi.
English: They encamped opposite each other for seven days. Then on the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.

tcz: Adangse chu Aphek khopi sung’ah ajamlut un ahi, ahin akulpi pal’u chu ahin chimkhum un ahile, mi sang somni le sagi jen athiuvin ahi. Benhadad chu khopi sung’a ajam lut’in, indan sung nung khat’ah akisel tan ahi.
en: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men who were left. Ben Hadad fled and came into the city, into an inner room.
text:
1KI 20:30
Thadou: Adangse chu Aphek khopi sung’ah ajamlut un ahi, ahin akulpi pal’u chu ahin chimkhum un ahile, mi sang somni le sagi jen athiuvin ahi. Benhadad chu khopi sung’a ajam lut’in, indan sung nung khat’ah akisel tan ahi.
English: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men who were left. Ben Hadad fled and came into the city, into an inner room.

tcz: Benhadad sepai lamkai hon akom’ah, “Hepu Israel lengte hi mikhoto athem un ahi, hijeh chun eihon khaodip pon i-taibuh uva kiveiju hitin, i-luchang uva khaohol kiveiju hitin chuteng leh Israel lengpa henga chun, ga lut jeng tem uhite, ajeh chu ama khun na hinghoi jeng maithei ahi,” atiuve.
en: His servants said to him, “See now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings. Please let us put sackcloth on our bodies and ropes on our heads, and go out to the king of Israel. Maybe he will save your life.”
text:
1KI 20:31
Thadou: Benhadad sepai lamkai hon akom’ah, “Hepu Israel lengte hi mikhoto athem un ahi, hijeh chun eihon khaodip pon i-taibuh uva kiveiju hitin, i-luchang uva khaohol kiveiju hitin chuteng leh Israel lengpa henga chun, ga lut jeng tem uhite, ajeh chu ama khun na hinghoi jeng maithei ahi,” atiuve.
English: His servants said to him, “See now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings. Please let us put sackcloth on our bodies and ropes on our heads, and go out to the king of Israel. Maybe he will save your life.”

tcz: Hijeh chun amahon ataibuh dung’uva khaodip pon akiveijun, aluchung uva khaohol aki khu uvin, Israel lengpa henga chun acheuvin, “Nasohpa Benhadad chun aseijin, na heng’a kahung tao ahi, neihing hoi tei teijin,” atin tin asei tauve. Hichun Ahab chun adong in, “Benhadad chu hing na lai ham? Ama chu ka sopipa ahibouve,” ati tai.
en: So they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, “Your servant Ben Hadad says, ‘Please let me live.’” He said, “Is he still alive? He is my brother.”
text:
1KI 20:32
Thadou: Hijeh chun amahon ataibuh dung’uva khaodip pon akiveijun, aluchung uva khaohol aki khu uvin, Israel lengpa henga chun acheuvin, “Nasohpa Benhadad chun aseijin, na heng’a kahung tao ahi, neihing hoi tei teijin,” atin tin asei tauve. Hichun Ahab chun adong in, “Benhadad chu hing na lai ham? Ama chu ka sopipa ahibouve,” ati tai.
English: So they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, “Your servant Ben Hadad says, ‘Please let me live.’” He said, “Is he still alive? He is my brother.”

tcz: Benhadad sepaiten Ahab’in asei chu thilpha ahi tin akilah un, gantah in, “Henge, na sopipa Benhadad ahi,” atiuvin aban ipi ahinsei em ti angah un ahile, Ahab in amaho jah’a chun, “Cheuvin lang, hinpuidoh un,” ati. Chuin Benhadad ahunglhun phat’in, Ahab in a kangtalai chung’ah akaldoh sah in ahi.
en: Now the men observed diligently and hurried to take this phrase; and they said, “Your brother Ben Hadad.” Then he said, “Go, bring him.” Then Ben Hadad came out to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.
text:
1KI 20:33
Thadou: Benhadad sepaiten Ahab’in asei chu thilpha ahi tin akilah un, gantah in, “Henge, na sopipa Benhadad ahi,” atiuvin aban ipi ahinsei em ti angah un ahile, Ahab in amaho jah’a chun, “Cheuvin lang, hinpuidoh un,” ati. Chuin Benhadad ahunglhun phat’in, Ahab in a kangtalai chung’ah akaldoh sah in ahi.
English: Now the men observed diligently and hurried to take this phrase; and they said, “Your brother Ben Hadad.” Then he said, “Go, bring him.” Then Ben Hadad came out to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

tcz: Hichun Benhadad in Ahab jah’a, “Kapan napa akona ana lahpeh khopi ho jouse chu abonchan keiman nangma nale kit tang’e, chule nangman kapa in Samaria khopi sung’a abolna bang bangin nangin jong, Damascus khopi sunga kai-lhang tampi na semdoh thei ahi,” ati. Chuin Ahab in, “Hitobang ding chun kenjong nangma nalha tang’e,” atin ahi. Hiti chun Ahab in Benhadad chutoh kitepna asem tan, ama jong alhadoh tai.
en: Ben Hadad said to him, “The cities which my father took from your father I will restore. You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria.” “I”, said Ahab, “will let you go with this covenant.” So he made a covenant with him and let him go.
text:
1KI 20:34
Thadou: Hichun Benhadad in Ahab jah’a, “Kapan napa akona ana lahpeh khopi ho jouse chu abonchan keiman nangma nale kit tang’e, chule nangman kapa in Samaria khopi sung’a abolna bang bangin nangin jong, Damascus khopi sunga kai-lhang tampi na semdoh thei ahi,” ati. Chuin Ahab in, “Hitobang ding chun kenjong nangma nalha tang’e,” atin ahi. Hiti chun Ahab in Benhadad chutoh kitepna asem tan, ama jong alhadoh tai.
English: Ben Hadad said to him, “The cities which my father took from your father I will restore. You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria.” “I”, said Ahab, “will let you go with this covenant.” So he made a covenant with him and let him go.

tcz: Pakaiyin themgao hon lah’a mikhat chu midang khat kom’ah thu aseisah in, “Nei sat’in,” ati. Ahin mipa chun themngaopa sat ding chun anompoi.
en: A certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow by the LORD’s word, “Please strike me!” The man refused to strike him.
text:
1KI 20:35
Thadou: Pakaiyin themgao hon lah’a mikhat chu midang khat kom’ah thu aseisah in, “Nei sat’in,” ati. Ahin mipa chun themngaopa sat ding chun anompoi.
English: A certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow by the LORD’s word, “Please strike me!” The man refused to strike him.

tcz: Hichun themgaopan ama komah, “Pakai Pathen thupeh nanit loujeh in, keima neidalhah lhah teng le sakeiyin natha ding ahitai,” ati. Hitichun agah dalhah leh keipi khat in athat tan ahi.
en: Then he said to him, “Because you have not obeyed the LORD’s voice, behold, as soon as you have departed from me, a lion will kill you.” As soon as he had departed from him, a lion found him and killed him.
text:
1KI 20:36
Thadou: Hichun themgaopan ama komah, “Pakai Pathen thupeh nanit loujeh in, keima neidalhah lhah teng le sakeiyin natha ding ahitai,” ati. Hitichun agah dalhah leh keipi khat in athat tan ahi.
English: Then he said to him, “Because you have not obeyed the LORD’s voice, behold, as soon as you have departed from me, a lion will kill you.” As soon as he had departed from him, a lion found him and killed him.

tcz: Hijouchun themgaopa chun midang chom khat komah, “Nei sat’in,” ati. Hichun themgaopa chu asat in, asattel jeng in ahi.
en: Then he found another man, and said, “Please strike me.” The man struck him and wounded him.
text:
1KI 20:37
Thadou: Hijouchun themgaopa chun midang chom khat komah, “Nei sat’in,” ati. Hichun themgaopa chu asat in, asattel jeng in ahi.
English: Then he found another man, and said, “Please strike me.” The man struck him and wounded him.

tcz: Hichun Themgaopan ponin mai akitom in, limput akhel’in, Israel lengpa hungna ding lampia ana ngah tan ahi.
en: So the prophet departed and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes.
text:
1KI 20:38
Thadou: Hichun Themgaopan ponin mai akitom in, limput akhel’in, Israel lengpa hungna ding lampia ana ngah tan ahi.
English: So the prophet departed and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes.

tcz: Lengpan ahung phat in themgaopan ahin kouvin, “Hepu keima gal kiha satna laitah’a chun kana jaovin, phulou helouvin mikhat in gal hing khat ahinkai jin, amapa hi phaten anaching tup’in, itiham khatna na lhaso’a ahileh nathi ding ahilouleh dangka talent khat naleu ding ahi, ahung ti,” tin aseipeh tan ahi.
en: As the king passed by, he cried to the king, and he said, “Your servant went out into the middle of the battle; and behold, a man came over and brought a man to me, and said, ‘Guard this man! If by any means he is missing, then your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.’
text:
1KI 20:39
Thadou: Lengpan ahung phat in themgaopan ahin kouvin, “Hepu keima gal kiha satna laitah’a chun kana jaovin, phulou helouvin mikhat in gal hing khat ahinkai jin, amapa hi phaten anaching tup’in, itiham khatna na lhaso’a ahileh nathi ding ahilouleh dangka talent khat naleu ding ahi, ahung ti,” tin aseipeh tan ahi.
English: As the king passed by, he cried to the king, and he said, “Your servant went out into the middle of the battle; and behold, a man came over and brought a man to me, and said, ‘Guard this man! If by any means he is missing, then your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.’

tcz: “Ahinlah keiman thilkhat bolla kakisahlal laitah in, amachu ana jamdoh tan ahi,” ati. Hichun lengpan, “Achutileh nangma thepmo hichula, nangman nachunga thutanna nakiluilut ahitai,” tin adonbut in ahi.
en: As your servant was busy here and there, he was gone.” The king of Israel said to him, “So shall your judgment be. You yourself have decided it.”
text:
1KI 20:40
Thadou: “Ahinlah keiman thilkhat bolla kakisahlal laitah in, amachu ana jamdoh tan ahi,” ati. Hichun lengpan, “Achutileh nangma thepmo hichula, nangman nachunga thutanna nakiluilut ahitai,” tin adonbut in ahi.
English: As your servant was busy here and there, he was gone.” The king of Israel said to him, “So shall your judgment be. You yourself have decided it.”

tcz: Hichun themgaopa chun amit kitom chu ahin ladoh’in ahileh, lengpan themgao ho lah’a khat ahi tichu ahedoh tan ahi.
en: He hurried, and took the headband away from his eyes; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets.
text:
1KI 20:41
Thadou: Hichun themgaopa chun amit kitom chu ahin ladoh’in ahileh, lengpan themgao ho lah’a khat ahi tichu ahedoh tan ahi.
English: He hurried, and took the headband away from his eyes; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets.

tcz: Chuin Themgaopa chun, “Pakaiyin hitihin aseiye, keiman na suhmang ding ahi kati pachu nalhaso jeh in tua hi nangma amakhel’a nathi ding ahitai chuleh ama mite khel’a nangma mite thi diu ahitai,” ati.
en: He said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have let go out of your hand the man whom I had devoted to destruction, therefore your life will take the place of his life, and your people take the place of his people.’”
text:
1KI 20:42
Thadou: Chuin Themgaopa chun, “Pakaiyin hitihin aseiye, keiman na suhmang ding ahi kati pachu nalhaso jeh in tua hi nangma amakhel’a nathi ding ahitai chuleh ama mite khel’a nangma mite thi diu ahitai,” ati.
English: He said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have let go out of your hand the man whom I had devoted to destruction, therefore your life will take the place of his life, and your people take the place of his people.’”

tcz: Hichun Israel lengpa chu lung hangtah leh maithim ketkut in a inlam ajon tan ahi.
en: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.
text:
1KI 20:43
Thadou: Hichun Israel lengpa chu lung hangtah leh maithim ketkut in a inlam ajon tan ahi.
English: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.

tcz: Jezreel akonin Naboth kiti mikhat anaum in, ama hin Samaria lengpa Ahab leng inpi toh kinaicha in, Jezreel mun na chun lengpilei khat ana neijin ahi.
en: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
text:
1KI 21:1
Thadou: Jezreel akonin Naboth kiti mikhat anaum in, ama hin Samaria lengpa Ahab leng inpi toh kinaicha in, Jezreel mun na chun lengpilei khat ana neijin ahi.
English: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

tcz: Nikhat hi Ahab min Naboth kom ah, “Na lengpilei hi ka leng inpi toh akinai jeh in, honna kanei dingin neiki chohsah tan, akhel in hiche sang’a lengpilei phajo nape ingting ahiloule na deijoh leh aman dingin sum joh peh lhon nang’e,” atipeh in ahi.
en: Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money.”
text:
1KI 21:2
Thadou: Nikhat hi Ahab min Naboth kom ah, “Na lengpilei hi ka leng inpi toh akinai jeh in, honna kanei dingin neiki chohsah tan, akhel in hiche sang’a lengpilei phajo nape ingting ahiloule na deijoh leh aman dingin sum joh peh lhon nang’e,” atipeh in ahi.
English: Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money.”

tcz: Ahin Naboth in adonbut in, “Kapu kapa khang’a pat’a kagou chin khat chu nang ka pehdoh jeng ding vang chu Pakai jahnom lou himai hen,” atipeh in ahi.
en: Naboth said to Ahab, “May the LORD forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”
text:
1KI 21:3
Thadou: Ahin Naboth in adonbut in, “Kapu kapa khang’a pat’a kagou chin khat chu nang ka pehdoh jeng ding vang chu Pakai jahnom lou himai hen,” atipeh in ahi.
English: Naboth said to Ahab, “May the LORD forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”

tcz: Hiche Naboth donbutna chun Ahab chu alunghansah lheh jengin, lungnom mo tah’in ainlang’a achetan ahi. Lengpa chun an jong ane nom tapon, bang lang angan alum tan ahi.
en: Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him, for he had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid himself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
text:
1KI 21:4
Thadou: Hiche Naboth donbutna chun Ahab chu alunghansah lheh jengin, lungnom mo tah’in ainlang’a achetan ahi. Lengpa chun an jong ane nom tapon, bang lang angan alum tan ahi.
English: Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him, for he had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid himself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

tcz: Ajinu Jezebel chun, “Ipi nati ham? Ipi dinga lungnom mo tah a anne louva na um jeng ham?” tin adong in ahi.
en: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad that you eat no bread?”
text:
1KI 21:5
Thadou: Ajinu Jezebel chun, “Ipi nati ham? Ipi dinga lungnom mo tah a anne louva na um jeng ham?” tin adong in ahi.
English: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad that you eat no bread?”

tcz: Ahab in, “Naboth komah na lengpilei nei chohsah in ahi louleh akhel nape nang’e, kati leh anom pon ahi,” ati.
en: He said to her, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I will give you another vineyard for it.’ He answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’”
text:
1KI 21:6
Thadou: Ahab in, “Naboth komah na lengpilei nei chohsah in ahi louleh akhel nape nang’e, kati leh anom pon ahi,” ati.
English: He said to her, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I will give you another vineyard for it.’ He answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’”

tcz: Jezebel in, “Nangma hi Israelte lengp nahi hilou ham? Thoudoh inlang an nen, hiche chungthua chun lungkham tah hih’in, keiman Naboth lengpilei chu nape nang’e,” atin ahi.
en: Jezebel his wife said to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be merry. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”
text:
1KI 21:7
Thadou: Jezebel in, “Nangma hi Israelte lengp nahi hilou ham? Thoudoh inlang an nen, hiche chungthua chun lungkham tah hih’in, keiman Naboth lengpilei chu nape nang’e,” atin ahi.
English: Jezebel his wife said to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be merry. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”

tcz: Hichun Jezebel in Ahab khel in ama min in lekha ajih in mohor anam khum in hichun khopi sunga lamkai holeh upa ho koma chun lekha athot in hitin anajih e,
en: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city, who lived with Naboth.
text:
1KI 21:8
Thadou: Hichun Jezebel in Ahab khel in ama min in lekha ajih in mohor anam khum in hichun khopi sunga lamkai holeh upa ho koma chun lekha athot in hitin anajih e,
English: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city, who lived with Naboth.

tcz: “Mipiho chu an-ngol a tao dingin koukhom unlang, Naboth chu mun thupi’a tou sah un,
en: She wrote in the letters, saying, “Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
text:
1KI 21:9
Thadou: “Mipiho chu an-ngol a tao dingin koukhom unlang, Naboth chu mun thupi’a tou sah un,
English: She wrote in the letters, saying, “Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

tcz: Chuleh pannabei mi ni akoma tousah unlang, amani chun lengpa le Pathen atai tom’e tin themmo chan u-hen. Chujouteng kai doh’unlang song in seplih un,” ati.
en: Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then carry him out, and stone him to death.”
text:
1KI 21:10
Thadou: Chuleh pannabei mi ni akoma tousah unlang, amani chun lengpa le Pathen atai tom’e tin themmo chan u-hen. Chujouteng kai doh’unlang song in seplih un,” ati.
English: Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then carry him out, and stone him to death.”

tcz: Hiti chun khopi sunga upa ho leh lamkai ho chun Jezebel lekha a kijih thupeh dungjui chun abol tauvin ahi.
en: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.
text:
1KI 21:11
Thadou: Hiti chun khopi sunga upa ho leh lamkai ho chun Jezebel lekha a kijih thupeh dungjui chun abol tauvin ahi.
English: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.

tcz: Amahon an ngol ding asom’un, Nabath chu mipi masanga thupitah in atousah un ahi.
en: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
text:
1KI 21:12
Thadou: Amahon an ngol ding asom’un, Nabath chu mipi masanga thupitah in atousah un ahi.
English: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

tcz: Hijouchun mi pannabei mini chu amasanga atousah un, Naboth chu mipi masanga themmo achan lhonin, “Ama hin Pathen leh lengpa asamsen ahi,” ati lhonin ahi. Hijeh chun ama chu khopi po langa akaidoh un song in aseplih tauvin ahi.
en: The two men, the wicked fellows, came in and sat before him. The wicked fellows testified against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, “Naboth cursed God and the king!” Then they carried him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones.
text:
1KI 21:13
Thadou: Hijouchun mi pannabei mini chu amasanga atousah un, Naboth chu mipi masanga themmo achan lhonin, “Ama hin Pathen leh lengpa asamsen ahi,” ati lhonin ahi. Hijeh chun ama chu khopi po langa akaidoh un song in aseplih tauvin ahi.
English: The two men, the wicked fellows, came in and sat before him. The wicked fellows testified against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, “Naboth cursed God and the king!” Then they carried him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones.

tcz: Khopi lamkai ho chun Jezebel komah thu athot un, “Nabath chu aki seplih tai,” atiuvin ahi.
en: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth has been stoned and is dead.”
text:
1KI 21:14
Thadou: Khopi lamkai ho chun Jezebel komah thu athot un, “Nabath chu aki seplih tai,” atiuvin ahi.
English: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth has been stoned and is dead.”

tcz: Chuin Jezebel in hiche thu chu ajah phat in, Ahab jah’ah, “Naboth lengpilei nang kom’a ana joh nomlou chu nahet em? Ven ama athi tai, alengpilei khu na kilah thei ahi tai,” ati.
en: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”
text:
1KI 21:15
Thadou: Chuin Jezebel in hiche thu chu ajah phat in, Ahab jah’ah, “Naboth lengpilei nang kom’a ana joh nomlou chu nahet em? Ven ama athi tai, alengpilei khu na kilah thei ahi tai,” ati.
English: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”

tcz: Hichun Ahab jong gangtah’in ache suh in Naboth lengpilei chu aga kichan tan ahi.
en: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
text:
1KI 21:16
Thadou: Hichun Ahab jong gangtah’in ache suh in Naboth lengpilei chu aga kichan tan ahi.
English: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

tcz: Ahin Pakaiyin Elijah komah thu ahin seitan ahi.
en: The LORD’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
text:
1KI 21:17
Thadou: Ahin Pakaiyin Elijah komah thu ahin seitan ahi.
English: The LORD’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

tcz: “Samaria a vaihompa Israel lengpa Ahab khu ga kimupi dingin chesuh tan, amachu Jezreel munna Naboth lengpileiya ama a ding akichan pet tah nato ding ahi,” ati.
en: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.
text:
1KI 21:18
Thadou: “Samaria a vaihompa Israel lengpa Ahab khu ga kimupi dingin chesuh tan, amachu Jezreel munna Naboth lengpileiya ama a ding akichan pet tah nato ding ahi,” ati.
English: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.

tcz: Hiche thuhi ahengah seipeh in, “Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, Naboth na tha chu phakhopset lou ham? Hitiapihi anei agou nachom kit nalaiset ding ham? Hitia hi thil nabol jeh in, ui-chaten Naboth thisan ale na’u mun achun nang thisan jong ale di’u ahi,” agatisah tai.
en: You shall speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?”’ You shall speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD says, “In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs will lick your blood, even yours.”’”
text:
1KI 21:19
Thadou: Hiche thuhi ahengah seipeh in, “Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, Naboth na tha chu phakhopset lou ham? Hitiapihi anei agou nachom kit nalaiset ding ham? Hitia hi thil nabol jeh in, ui-chaten Naboth thisan ale na’u mun achun nang thisan jong ale di’u ahi,” agatisah tai.
English: You shall speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?”’ You shall speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD says, “In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs will lick your blood, even yours.”’”

tcz: Hichun Ahab chu Elijah komah apeng jah jengin, “Tuahi kamelma pan, neihung mudoh kit hi tam?” atileh, Elijah in adonbut in, “Henge, nangman Pakai mitmu a thilse jeng bolna a nakipeh jing jeh a ka hungkit ahi tai,” ati.
en: Ahab said to Elijah, “Have you found me, my enemy?” He answered, “I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is evil in the LORD’s sight.
text:
1KI 21:20
Thadou: Hichun Ahab chu Elijah komah apeng jah jengin, “Tuahi kamelma pan, neihung mudoh kit hi tam?” atileh, Elijah in adonbut in, “Henge, nangman Pakai mitmu a thilse jeng bolna a nakipeh jing jeh a ka hungkit ahi tai,” ati.
English: Ahab said to Elijah, “Have you found me, my enemy?” He answered, “I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is evil in the LORD’s sight.

tcz: Hijeh chun tun Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Nangma naval-lhum jing thei manthahna kahin lhun khum sah ding, nangma chilhah te pasal ho chuleh nasohho chujongleh soh hilou ho jong Israel gamsung hoilai mun hijong leh kasuhmang ding ahi.
en: Behold, I will bring evil on you, and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, and him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.
text:
1KI 21:21
Thadou: Hijeh chun tun Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, “Nangma naval-lhum jing thei manthahna kahin lhun khum sah ding, nangma chilhah te pasal ho chuleh nasohho chujongleh soh hilou ho jong Israel gamsung hoilai mun hijong leh kasuhmang ding ahi.
English: Behold, I will bring evil on you, and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, and him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

tcz: Keiman Ahijah chapa Baasha insung mite le Nebat chapa Jeroboam insung mite kasuh mang hel banga, nangma insung mite jong kasuhmang ding ahitai. Ajeh chu nangman keima nei sulunghang behseh jengin chuleh nangin Israel tehi nachonset sah tan ahi,” ati
en: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”
text:
1KI 21:22
Thadou: Keiman Ahijah chapa Baasha insung mite le Nebat chapa Jeroboam insung mite kasuh mang hel banga, nangma insung mite jong kasuhmang ding ahitai. Ajeh chu nangman keima nei sulunghang behseh jengin chuleh nangin Israel tehi nachonset sah tan ahi,” ati
English: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”

tcz: “Chuleh Jezebel chungchang ahin, Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, ‘Jezreel mun’a gam behkhat chunga Jezebel tahsa chu uichan aneh ding ahi,” ati.
en: The LORD also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.
text:
1KI 21:23
Thadou: “Chuleh Jezebel chungchang ahin, Pakaiyin hitin aseiye, ‘Jezreel mun’a gam behkhat chunga Jezebel tahsa chu uichan aneh ding ahi,” ati.
English: The LORD also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.

tcz: “Ahab insung mite jouse hiche khopi sunga thiho jouse jong chu uicha hon aneh dingu chuleh gam lah’a thiho jouse chu muthong hon aneh diu ahi,” ati.
en: The dogs will eat he who dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field.”
text:
1KI 21:24
Thadou: “Ahab insung mite jouse hiche khopi sunga thiho jouse jong chu uicha hon aneh dingu chuleh gam lah’a thiho jouse chu muthong hon aneh diu ahi,” ati.
English: The dogs will eat he who dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field.”

tcz: Ajinu Jezebel in athu nun jeh'a Ahab min Pakai mitmua thilse bolna a aki pehlut banga kipehlut na koimacha dang aumpon ahi.
en: But there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.
text:
1KI 21:25
Thadou: Ajinu Jezebel in athu nun jeh'a Ahab min Pakai mitmua thilse bolna a aki pehlut banga kipehlut na koimacha dang aumpon ahi.
English: But there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

tcz: Athil bolset nasa pen chu, milim doi Amon mite ahou bang uva ahou chu ahipen’e. Amaho hi Israelte lhun masanga Pakaiyin ana deldoh masat nam mite chu ahiuve.
en: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
text:
1KI 21:26
Thadou: Athil bolset nasa pen chu, milim doi Amon mite ahou bang uva ahou chu ahipen’e. Amaho hi Israelte lhun masanga Pakaiyin ana deldoh masat nam mite chu ahiuve.
English: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

tcz: Hiche thupeh hi Ahab in ajah phat in, apon abottel in, khaodip pon akisel in, an angol in lunghem tah in khaodip pon chung ah alum in ahi.
en: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, fasted, lay in sackcloth, and went about despondently.
text:
1KI 21:27
Thadou: Hiche thupeh hi Ahab in ajah phat in, apon abottel in, khaodip pon akisel in, an angol in lunghem tah in khaodip pon chung ah alum in ahi.
English: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, fasted, lay in sackcloth, and went about despondently.

tcz: Hichun Pakaija kon’a thupeh Elijah kom’a ahung lhung kit in,
en: The LORD’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
text:
1KI 21:28
Thadou: Hichun Pakaija kon’a thupeh Elijah kom’a ahung lhung kit in,
English: The LORD’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

tcz: “Ahab khu keima masanga ichangeiya amale ama kisunem’a hitam ti namu em? Aman hichen geija aki suhnem tah jeh in, keiman ka bolgot chu ama damsung in bol taponge, achate cheng leh achilhah chunga bou ka bolding, alenggam kasuhmang ding ahi tai,” ati.
en: “See how Ahab humbles himself before me? Because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days; but I will bring the evil on his house in his son’s day.”
text:
1KI 21:29
Thadou: “Ahab khu keima masanga ichangeiya amale ama kisunem’a hitam ti namu em? Aman hichen geija aki suhnem tah jeh in, keiman ka bolgot chu ama damsung in bol taponge, achate cheng leh achilhah chunga bou ka bolding, alenggam kasuhmang ding ahi tai,” ati.
English: “See how Ahab humbles himself before me? Because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days; but I will bring the evil on his house in his son’s day.”

tcz: Kum thum sung in Israel leh Syria mite kikah’ah gal ana umpon ahi.
en: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
text:
1KI 22:1
Thadou: Kum thum sung in Israel leh Syria mite kikah’ah gal ana umpon ahi.
English: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

tcz: Hiche jou kumthum lhin in, Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat in Israel lengpa Ahab chu agavil in ahi.
en: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
text:
1KI 22:2
Thadou: Hiche jou kumthum lhin in, Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat in Israel lengpa Ahab chu agavil in ahi.
English: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

tcz: Aman avil sung hin Israel lengpan asepaite komah, “Nanghon Ramoth-gilead khopi hi eihoa ahi na het uvem? Ahinla eihon hiche khopi hi Syriate khut’a kona nunglah dohna dingin imacha inabol pouvin ahi,” ati.
en: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don’t take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”
text:
1KI 22:3
Thadou: Aman avil sung hin Israel lengpan asepaite komah, “Nanghon Ramoth-gilead khopi hi eihoa ahi na het uvem? Ahinla eihon hiche khopi hi Syriate khut’a kona nunglah dohna dingin imacha inabol pouvin ahi,” ati.
English: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don’t take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”

tcz: Chuin aman Jehoshaphat lang chu angan, “Nang in Ramoth-gilead nunglah dohna dinga galsatna a hi neipanhu nomlou ham?” atin ahile, Jehoshaphat in Israel lengpa chu a donbut in, “I-bol a ka panhu da ding ham, nangle kei thakhat ihi chula em, ka sepaite jong na sepai ahin ka sakol ho jong na sakol ahi,” ati.
en: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”
text:
1KI 22:4
Thadou: Chuin aman Jehoshaphat lang chu angan, “Nang in Ramoth-gilead nunglah dohna dinga galsatna a hi neipanhu nomlou ham?” atin ahile, Jehoshaphat in Israel lengpa chu a donbut in, “I-bol a ka panhu da ding ham, nangle kei thakhat ihi chula em, ka sepaite jong na sepai ahin ka sakol ho jong na sakol ahi,” ati.
English: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

tcz: Jehoshaphat in, “Ahinla Pakajin ipi asei jem veuhite” tin aseibe kit in ahi.
en: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the LORD’s word.”
text:
1KI 22:5
Thadou: Jehoshaphat in, “Ahinla Pakajin ipi asei jem veuhite” tin aseibe kit in ahi.
English: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the LORD’s word.”

tcz: Hichun Israelte lengpan themgao jali hochu akouvin amaho koma chun, “Ramoth-gilead douna gal ka kon ding ham ahi lou leh ka kon lou ding ham?” tin anadongin ahi. Amahon abon uvin a donbut un, “Aphai, kondoh jing in, Pakaiyin galjona napeh ding ahi,” atiuve.
en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, “Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle, or should I refrain?” They said, “Go up; for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
text:
1KI 22:6
Thadou: Hichun Israelte lengpan themgao jali hochu akouvin amaho koma chun, “Ramoth-gilead douna gal ka kon ding ham ahi lou leh ka kon lou ding ham?” tin anadongin ahi. Amahon abon uvin a donbut un, “Aphai, kondoh jing in, Pakaiyin galjona napeh ding ahi,” atiuve.
English: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, “Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle, or should I refrain?” They said, “Go up; for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

tcz: Ahinlah Jehoshaphat in, “Hiche muna hi hitobang thudoh mama hijong le idoh thei diu themgao adang umlou ham,” atin ahi.
en: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of the LORD, that we may inquire of him?”
text:
1KI 22:7
Thadou: Ahinlah Jehoshaphat in, “Hiche muna hi hitobang thudoh mama hijong le idoh thei diu themgao adang umlou ham,” atin ahi.
English: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of the LORD, that we may inquire of him?”

tcz: Israel lengpan Jehoshaphat jah’a, “Hitobanga Pakai koma eidohpeh thei diu kahet mikhat aum nalaiye, ahinlah ama hin kei dingin thilphalou ngen aseijin ahi. Ama chu Imlah chapa Micaiah ahi,” tin anadonbut in ahi. Jehoshaphat in adonbut in, “Lengkhat in hitia chu thu asei ngei ahipoi! Aman ipi asei em ngaiju hite,” ati.
en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”
text:
1KI 22:8
Thadou: Israel lengpan Jehoshaphat jah’a, “Hitobanga Pakai koma eidohpeh thei diu kahet mikhat aum nalaiye, ahinlah ama hin kei dingin thilphalou ngen aseijin ahi. Ama chu Imlah chapa Micaiah ahi,” tin anadonbut in ahi. Jehoshaphat in adonbut in, “Lengkhat in hitia chu thu asei ngei ahipoi! Aman ipi asei em ngaiju hite,” ati.
English: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Israel lengpan asepaiho khatchu akouvin, “Imlah chapa Micaiah chu gapui loijin,” ati.
en: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”
text:
1KI 22:9
Thadou: Hijeh chun Israel lengpan asepaiho khatchu akouvin, “Imlah chapa Micaiah chu gapui loijin,” ati.
English: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”

tcz: Israel lengpa Ahab leh Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chu leng vonin akivon lhon in, Samaria khopi kelkot kom changvohna phol munna chun laltouna akido lhonin atoulhon in ahi. Ahab themgaoho chun amani masanga chun gaothu aphong phong jeng un ahi.
en: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
text:
1KI 22:10
Thadou: Israel lengpa Ahab leh Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chu leng vonin akivon lhon in, Samaria khopi kelkot kom changvohna phol munna chun laltouna akido lhonin atoulhon in ahi. Ahab themgaoho chun amani masanga chun gaothu aphong phong jeng un ahi.
English: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

tcz: Amaho lah’a khatpen Kenaanah chapa Zedekiah kitipa chun, thih saki lim in asemin hiti hin asamphong in, “Hitihin Pakaiyin aseiye, Hiche thih saki hi nasutna Syriate chu najo ding ahi,” ati.
en: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, “The LORD says, ‘With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”
text:
1KI 22:11
Thadou: Amaho lah’a khatpen Kenaanah chapa Zedekiah kitipa chun, thih saki lim in asemin hiti hin asamphong in, “Hitihin Pakaiyin aseiye, Hiche thih saki hi nasutna Syriate chu najo ding ahi,” ati.
English: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, “The LORD says, ‘With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

tcz: Themgao dangho jong athusei chu anom un, hitin aseikit uve, “Ramoth-gilead’a chun kaltou unlang gal gajou’un, ajeh chu Pakaiyin lengpa chu galjona apehding ahi,” atiuve.
en: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper; for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
text:
1KI 22:12
Thadou: Themgao dangho jong athusei chu anom un, hitin aseikit uve, “Ramoth-gilead’a chun kaltou unlang gal gajou’un, ajeh chu Pakaiyin lengpa chu galjona apehding ahi,” atiuve.
English: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper; for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

tcz: Alangkhat ah, Micaiah koma che asottolpa chun ajah’a, “Ven, themgao dang ho jousen lengpa koma chun galjona ding ngen aseipeh un, nangin jong amaho bang in galjo na ding seipeh in,” ati.
en: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak good.”
text:
1KI 22:13
Thadou: Alangkhat ah, Micaiah koma che asottolpa chun ajah’a, “Ven, themgao dang ho jousen lengpa koma chun galjona ding ngen aseipeh un, nangin jong amaho bang in galjo na ding seipeh in,” ati.
English: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak good.”

tcz: Ahinlah Micaiah in adonbut in, “Hingjing Pakai min’a kasei ahi, Pakaiyin seijin ati bou ka sei ding ahi,” atipeh in ahi.
en: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, what the LORD says to me, that I will speak.”
text:
1KI 22:14
Thadou: Ahinlah Micaiah in adonbut in, “Hingjing Pakai min’a kasei ahi, Pakaiyin seijin ati bou ka sei ding ahi,” atipeh in ahi.
English: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, what the LORD says to me, that I will speak.”

tcz: Micaiah themgao chu lengpa kom alhun phat in, Ahab in jong ajah’a, “Micaiah, Ramoth-gilead douna a kache diu ham ahilouleh kachelou diu ham?” atileh Micaiah in jong jonkap tah’in, “Aphai, chetouvun lang ga jou un, Pakaiyin lengpa galjona nape naveh ta!” ati peh in ahi.
en: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He answered him, “Go up and prosper; and the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
text:
1KI 22:15
Thadou: Micaiah themgao chu lengpa kom alhun phat in, Ahab in jong ajah’a, “Micaiah, Ramoth-gilead douna a kache diu ham ahilouleh kachelou diu ham?” atileh Micaiah in jong jonkap tah’in, “Aphai, chetouvun lang ga jou un, Pakaiyin lengpa galjona nape naveh ta!” ati peh in ahi.
English: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He answered him, “Go up and prosper; and the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

tcz: Ahin lengpan gangtah in adonbut in, “Pakai thalhenga kakoma thu nasei tengleh thudih bou seijin tia i-jatvei ka ngeh hitam?” atin ahi.
en: The king said to him, “How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the LORD’s name?”
text:
1KI 22:16
Thadou: Ahin lengpan gangtah in adonbut in, “Pakai thalhenga kakoma thu nasei tengleh thudih bou seijin tia i-jatvei ka ngeh hitam?” atin ahi.
English: The king said to him, “How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the LORD’s name?”

tcz: Hichun Micaiah in, “Keiman gao’in thilkhat kamu’e, Israelte molchunga kelngoi achingbei tobanga akithe cheh kamun ahi, chule Pakaiyin, a pakaipau akithat ahitai, tun amaho chu lungmong in sol tauvin,” ati.
en: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. The LORD said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”
text:
1KI 22:17
Thadou: Hichun Micaiah in, “Keiman gao’in thilkhat kamu’e, Israelte molchunga kelngoi achingbei tobanga akithe cheh kamun ahi, chule Pakaiyin, a pakaipau akithat ahitai, tun amaho chu lungmong in sol tauvin,” ati.
English: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. The LORD said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”

tcz: Israel lengpan Jehoshaphat jah’a asaptho jengin, “Kaseipeh sa hilou ham? Amahin, kakom ah thilse tilou thilpha eisei peh khapon ahi,” ati.
en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”
text:
1KI 22:18
Thadou: Israel lengpan Jehoshaphat jah’a asaptho jengin, “Kaseipeh sa hilou ham? Amahin, kakom ah thilse tilou thilpha eisei peh khapon ahi,” ati.
English: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

tcz: Hichun Micaiah in aseiben, “Ngaijun Pakaiyin aseiye! Pakai chu avan sepaiho chengin ajet avei’ah aumkim vellun Ama alaltouna a atouve,” ati.
en: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear the LORD’s word. I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
text:
1KI 22:19
Thadou: Hichun Micaiah in aseiben, “Ngaijun Pakaiyin aseiye! Pakai chu avan sepaiho chengin ajet avei’ah aumkim vellun Ama alaltouna a atouve,” ati.
English: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear the LORD’s word. I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

tcz: Pakaiyin, ‘Ahab hi athi nadinga Ramoth-gilead douna gal kon ding’a koipen atildoh ding ache ding ham? atile, hichea chun lunggel tamtah aseikhom uvin,
en: The LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One said one thing, and another said another.
text:
1KI 22:20
Thadou: Pakaiyin, ‘Ahab hi athi nadinga Ramoth-gilead douna gal kon ding’a koipen atildoh ding ache ding ham? atile, hichea chun lunggel tamtah aseikhom uvin,
English: The LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One said one thing, and another said another.

tcz: Achaina in, lhagao khat in, Pakai komma chun keiman choudoh ing kate, ati.
en: A spirit came out and stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’
text:
1KI 22:21
Thadou: Achaina in, lhagao khat in, Pakai komma chun keiman choudoh ing kate, ati.
English: A spirit came out and stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’

tcz: “Pakaiyin i-nalo got ham?” atile, “Lhagao chun adonbut nin keima che ingting Ahab themgao ho thujou asei diuvin gatil doh ing kate” ati. Hichun Pakaiyin nalolhin ding ahi chenlang gabol tan,” ati.
en: The LORD said to him, ‘How?’ He said, ‘I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ He said, ‘You will entice him, and will also prevail. Go out and do so.’
text:
1KI 22:22
Thadou: “Pakaiyin i-nalo got ham?” atile, “Lhagao chun adonbut nin keima che ingting Ahab themgao ho thujou asei diuvin gatil doh ing kate” ati. Hichun Pakaiyin nalolhin ding ahi chenlang gabol tan,” ati.
English: The LORD said to him, ‘How?’ He said, ‘I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ He said, ‘You will entice him, and will also prevail. Go out and do so.’

tcz: “Tun vetan Pakaiyin nathemgao ho koma thujou asei sah ahitai, ajeh chu Pakaiyin na manthah na dinga aphondoh joh ahi,” atipeh tai.
en: Now therefore, behold, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and the LORD has spoken evil concerning you.”
text:
1KI 22:23
Thadou: “Tun vetan Pakaiyin nathemgao ho koma thujou asei sah ahitai, ajeh chu Pakaiyin na manthah na dinga aphondoh joh ahi,” atipeh tai.
English: Now therefore, behold, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and the LORD has spoken evil concerning you.”

tcz: Hichun Kenaanah chapa Zedekiah chun Micaiah chu ajon in angei phe abehpeh in ahi. “Hoiya patna chu Pakaiyin keima eidalhah’a, nang koma bou thu asei jeng ham,” ati.
en: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did the LORD’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”
text:
1KI 22:24
Thadou: Hichun Kenaanah chapa Zedekiah chun Micaiah chu ajon in angei phe abehpeh in ahi. “Hoiya patna chu Pakaiyin keima eidalhah’a, nang koma bou thu asei jeng ham,” ati.
English: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did the LORD’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”

tcz: Micaiah in adonbut in, “Nangma na insung dan sung khat na aguh’a kisel’a nache tengleh hedoh tan nate,” ati.
en: Micaiah said, “Behold, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”
text:
1KI 22:25
Thadou: Micaiah in adonbut in, “Nangma na insung dan sung khat na aguh’a kisel’a nache tengleh hedoh tan nate,” ati.
English: Micaiah said, “Behold, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

tcz: Chuin Ahab lengpan, “Amachu man unlang khopi gamvaipo Amon kom leh ka chapa Joash koma puilut un,” tin thu apen ahi.
en: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son.
text:
1KI 22:26
Thadou: Chuin Ahab lengpan, “Amachu man unlang khopi gamvaipo Amon kom leh ka chapa Joash koma puilut un,” tin thu apen ahi.
English: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son.

tcz: Keima damsella kahung kilekit kahsen songkul’a ana hen unlang aneh dingin changlhah leh tuibou anape un, tin seipeh un,” ati.
en: Say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.”’”
text:
1KI 22:27
Thadou: Keima damsella kahung kilekit kahsen songkul’a ana hen unlang aneh dingin changlhah leh tuibou anape un, tin seipeh un,” ati.
English: Say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.”’”

tcz: Hichun Micaiah in adonbut in, “Ven nangma damsella nahung kilepou pou leh Pakaiyin keima eimanchah lou hiding ahi,” ati, aban aseibe kit in, “Mijousen kathu seihi melchih un,” ati.
en: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, the LORD has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”
text:
1KI 22:28
Thadou: Hichun Micaiah in adonbut in, “Ven nangma damsella nahung kilepou pou leh Pakaiyin keima eimanchah lou hiding ahi,” ati, aban aseibe kit in, “Mijousen kathu seihi melchih un,” ati.
English: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, the LORD has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”

tcz: Hichun Israel lengpa Ahab leh Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat teni chu asepai jouse toh Ramoth-gilead sat dingin akon lhontan ahi.
en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.
text:
1KI 22:29
Thadou: Hichun Israel lengpa Ahab leh Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat teni chu asepai jouse toh Ramoth-gilead sat dingin akon lhontan ahi.
English: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

tcz: Israel lengpa chun Jehoshaphat jah’a, “Hitia hi gal mun’a ilut tenguleh koiman eihetdoh lou na dingin kahina khel ing kate, nangin vang naleng von chu kivon tan,” ati. Hitichun Israel lengpan ahina akhel in galmun’a alut tauve.
en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into the battle, but you put on your robes.” The king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.
text:
1KI 22:30
Thadou: Israel lengpa chun Jehoshaphat jah’a, “Hitia hi gal mun’a ilut tenguleh koiman eihetdoh lou na dingin kahina khel ing kate, nangin vang naleng von chu kivon tan,” ati. Hitichun Israel lengpan ahina akhel in galmun’a alut tauve.
English: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into the battle, but you put on your robes.” The king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.

tcz: Alang khatna Syria lengpan sakol kangtalai touthem lamkai somthum le ni ho jah’a chun, “Israel lengpa bou chu nokhum un adangho chu limsah hih un,” ati.
en: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”
text:
1KI 22:31
Thadou: Alang khatna Syria lengpan sakol kangtalai touthem lamkai somthum le ni ho jah’a chun, “Israel lengpa bou chu nokhum un adangho chu limsah hih un,” ati.
English: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

tcz: Hitichun Syria sakol kangtalai touthem hochun alengvonna kivon Jehoshaphat chu adelkhum go taovin ahi. Amahon, “Hiche khu Israelte lengpa ahi,” tin ahin sam’un ahi. Ahinlah Jehoshaphat chu ahung penjah phat’in,
en: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “Surely that is the king of Israel!” and they came over to fight against him. Jehoshaphat cried out.
text:
1KI 22:32
Thadou: Hitichun Syria sakol kangtalai touthem hochun alengvonna kivon Jehoshaphat chu adelkhum go taovin ahi. Amahon, “Hiche khu Israelte lengpa ahi,” tin ahin sam’un ahi. Ahinlah Jehoshaphat chu ahung penjah phat’in,
English: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “Surely that is the king of Israel!” and they came over to fight against him. Jehoshaphat cried out.

tcz: Sakol kangtalai touthem lamkai ho chun Israel lengpa ahilou ahetdoh phat un adel tapouvin ahi.
en: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
text:
1KI 22:33
Thadou: Sakol kangtalai touthem lamkai ho chun Israel lengpa ahilou ahetdoh phat un adel tapouvin ahi.
English: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

tcz: Ahin Syria sepai khat in Israel sepaite lah’a chu agah moh donkap leh Israel lengpa chu a Ompho kikah a chun thal chu alut kha tan ahileh Ahab chun asakol kangtalai tolpa koma chun, “Sakol chu nung tol inlang, hichea kon hin nei toldoh tan,” ati.
en: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, “Turn around, and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”
text:
1KI 22:34
Thadou: Ahin Syria sepai khat in Israel sepaite lah’a chu agah moh donkap leh Israel lengpa chu a Ompho kikah a chun thal chu alut kha tan ahileh Ahab chun asakol kangtalai tolpa koma chun, “Sakol chu nung tol inlang, hichea kon hin nei toldoh tan,” ati.
English: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, “Turn around, and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

tcz: Nilhum keijin galchu akisat in, lengpa chu Syria mite lang angan sakol kangtalai chunga chun aki jamin ahi. Athisan chu amaha akon chun tol ah avalhan nilhah lang in ahitan ahi.
en: The battle increased that day. The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.
text:
1KI 22:35
Thadou: Nilhum keijin galchu akisat in, lengpa chu Syria mite lang angan sakol kangtalai chunga chun aki jamin ahi. Athisan chu amaha akon chun tol ah avalhan nilhah lang in ahitan ahi.
English: The battle increased that day. The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.

tcz: Nisa chu ahung lhumphat in sepaiho lah a chun, “Gal i-lel taove, na kihinso thei nading cheh un jam tauvin,” tin ahung kisam tan ahi.
en: A cry went throughout the army about the going down of the sun, saying, “Every man to his city, and every man to his country!”
text:
1KI 22:36
Thadou: Nisa chu ahung lhumphat in sepaiho lah a chun, “Gal i-lel taove, na kihinso thei nading cheh un jam tauvin,” tin ahung kisam tan ahi.
English: A cry went throughout the army about the going down of the sun, saying, “Every man to his city, and every man to his country!”

tcz: Hitichun lengpa athitan atahsa chu Samaria a ahin polut’un avui taovin ahi.
en: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
text:
1KI 22:37
Thadou: Hitichun lengpa athitan atahsa chu Samaria a ahin polut’un avui taovin ahi.
English: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

tcz: Hijouchun asakol kangtalai chu Samaria twikul pang ah asop theng un ahi. Pakaiyin ana tep peh bang chun numei kijohho kisilna munna chun athisan chu uicha hon ahung lehngim un ahi.
en: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke.
text:
1KI 22:38
Thadou: Hijouchun asakol kangtalai chu Samaria twikul pang ah asop theng un ahi. Pakaiyin ana tep peh bang chun numei kijohho kisilna munna chun athisan chu uicha hon ahung lehngim un ahi.
English: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke.

tcz: Ahab vaihom sunga thilsoh holeh aman ana tohdoh ho, saiha a asahdoh leng inpi ahin khopi ana tundoh ho ahin abonchan Israel lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua chun aki jihlut in ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
text:
1KI 22:39
Thadou: Ahab vaihom sunga thilsoh holeh aman ana tohdoh ho, saiha a asahdoh leng inpi ahin khopi ana tundoh ho ahin abonchan Israel lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua chun aki jihlut in ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

tcz: Hitichun Ahab chu athitan ahileh achapa Ahaziah chun lengmun ahin lotan ahi.
en: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
text:
1KI 22:40
Thadou: Hitichun Ahab chu athitan ahileh achapa Ahaziah chun lengmun ahin lotan ahi.
English: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Ahab lengpan Israel mite lah’a vai anahop kumli lhinin, Asa chapa Jehoshaphat in Judah mite lah’a vai anahom pantan ahi.
en: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
text:
1KI 22:41
Thadou: Ahab lengpan Israel mite lah’a vai anahop kumli lhinin, Asa chapa Jehoshaphat in Judah mite lah’a vai anahom pantan ahi.
English: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

tcz: Jehoshaphat leng ahungchan chun kum somthum le nga ana lhing tan ahi. Hitichun aman Jerusalem'ah kum somnile nga vai ana hom’in ahi. Anu chu Shilhi chanu Azubah ahi.
en: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
text:
1KI 22:42
Thadou: Jehoshaphat leng ahungchan chun kum somthum le nga ana lhing tan ahi. Hitichun aman Jerusalem'ah kum somnile nga vai ana hom’in ahi. Anu chu Shilhi chanu Azubah ahi.
English: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

tcz: Jehoshaphat chu leng phatah anahi. Amahin apa Asa phat na hinkho hochu anung anajui in ahi. Aman Pathen mitmu’n thilpha jong ana bol in ahi. Ama vaihom sungin kithoi na doiphung hochu ana suhtheng sahpon ahi. Hijeh chun mipi hochun kithoina gantha ana bol nalaiyun chuleh gim namtui jong ana lhut nam jing un ahi.
en: He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in the LORD’s eyes. However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
text:
1KI 22:43
Thadou: Jehoshaphat chu leng phatah anahi. Amahin apa Asa phat na hinkho hochu anung anajui in ahi. Aman Pathen mitmu’n thilpha jong ana bol in ahi. Ama vaihom sungin kithoi na doiphung hochu ana suhtheng sahpon ahi. Hijeh chun mipi hochun kithoina gantha ana bol nalaiyun chuleh gim namtui jong ana lhut nam jing un ahi.
English: He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in the LORD’s eyes. However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

tcz: Jehoshaphat chun Israel lengpa toh kichamna anasem in ahi.
en: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
text:
1KI 22:44
Thadou: Jehoshaphat chun Israel lengpa toh kichamna anasem in ahi.
English: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

tcz: Jehoshaphat vaihom sunga thilsoh holeh a thanei naho chuleh agalsat na ho jouse Judah lengte thusim kijihlutna lekhabua aum soh keijin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he fought, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
text:
1KI 22:45
Thadou: Jehoshaphat vaihom sunga thilsoh holeh a thanei naho chuleh agalsat na ho jouse Judah lengte thusim kijihlutna lekhabua aum soh keijin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he fought, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

tcz: Apa Asa khanglaiya jong ana chejom peh pasal le numei kijoh ana umnalai chengse chu gamsunga konin ana ban suhmang in ahi.
en: The remnant of the sodomites, that remained in the days of his father Asa, he put away out of the land.
text:
1KI 22:46
Thadou: Apa Asa khanglaiya jong ana chejom peh pasal le numei kijoh ana umnalai chengse chu gamsunga konin ana ban suhmang in ahi.
English: The remnant of the sodomites, that remained in the days of his father Asa, he put away out of the land.

tcz: Hichelai khang chun Edom gam'a leng ana umpon.
en: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.
text:
1KI 22:47
Thadou: Hichelai khang chun Edom gam'a leng ana umpon.
English: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.

tcz: Jehoshaphat in Ophir munna sana podingin kiveina kong innei honkhat ana semdoh in ahi. Ahinlah hiche kong innei hochun agamsung kongkai mun’ah tosetna ana toh jeh un ana kitol masa pouvin ahi.
en: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.
text:
1KI 22:48
Thadou: Jehoshaphat in Ophir munna sana podingin kiveina kong innei honkhat ana semdoh in ahi. Ahinlah hiche kong innei hochun agamsung kongkai mun’ah tosetna ana toh jeh un ana kitol masa pouvin ahi.
English: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.

tcz: Khatvei chu Ahab chapa Ahaziah chun Jehoshaphat komah, “Keima mite leh nangma mite hon kongtol khom uhen,” ana tin ahileh Jehoshaphat ana nom pon ahi.
en: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.
text:
1KI 22:49
Thadou: Khatvei chu Ahab chapa Ahaziah chun Jehoshaphat komah, “Keima mite leh nangma mite hon kongtol khom uhen,” ana tin ahileh Jehoshaphat ana nom pon ahi.
English: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.

tcz: Jehoshaphat chu athi phat in David khopi a apu apate toh anavui khom un ahi.
en: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city. Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
text:
1KI 22:50
Thadou: Jehoshaphat chu athi phat in David khopi a apu apate toh anavui khom un ahi.
English: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city. Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat in vai ana homna kum som le sagi lhinin, Ahab chapa Ahaziah in Israel te lah’a vai anahom pan in ahi. Aman Samaria munah kum ni vai ana hom in ahi.
en: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.
text:
1KI 22:51
Thadou: Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat in vai ana homna kum som le sagi lhinin, Ahab chapa Ahaziah in Israel te lah’a vai anahom pan in ahi. Aman Samaria munah kum ni vai ana hom in ahi.
English: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.

tcz: Aman Pakai mitmu in thilse jong ana bollin ahi. Aman hichu anule apa chonchan phalou tah ana jui ahin, chuleh Israelte ana chonset sah Jeroboam chondan hoilou tah chu ana jui ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.
text:
1KI 22:52
Thadou: Aman Pakai mitmu in thilse jong ana bollin ahi. Aman hichu anule apa chonchan phalou tah ana jui ahin, chuleh Israelte ana chonset sah Jeroboam chondan hoilou tah chu ana jui ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.

tcz: Aman Baal milim doi ana houvin, apa bang in Pakai Israel Pathen chu ana chou lunghang in ahi.
en: He served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger in all the ways that his father had done so.
text:
1KI 22:53
Thadou: Aman Baal milim doi ana houvin, apa bang in Pakai Israel Pathen chu ana chou lunghang in ahi.
English: He served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger in all the ways that his father had done so.
