tcz: Ahab lengpa thijouvin Moab ten Israel dounan gal ahin sat uvin ahi.
en: Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.
text:
2KI 1:1
Thadou: Ahab lengpa thijouvin Moab ten Israel dounan gal ahin sat uvin ahi.
English: Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

tcz: Israelte leng thah Ahaziah chu Samaria khopi inchung dan kalbi’a konin ahung ki tang-lhan akiha suhkhah lheh jeng in ahi. Hijeh chun aman Ekron gam mite semthu Pathen Baalzebub houin’ah mi asollin, kadam doh jou ding hinam tin agadoh sah in ahi.
en: Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper room that was in Samaria, and was sick. So he sent messengers, and said to them, “Go, inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover of this sickness.”
text:
2KI 1:2
Thadou: Israelte leng thah Ahaziah chu Samaria khopi inchung dan kalbi’a konin ahung ki tang-lhan akiha suhkhah lheh jeng in ahi. Hijeh chun aman Ekron gam mite semthu Pathen Baalzebub houin’ah mi asollin, kadam doh jou ding hinam tin agadoh sah in ahi.
English: Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper room that was in Samaria, and was sick. So he sent messengers, and said to them, “Go, inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover of this sickness.”

tcz: Ahin Pakai vantil khat in Tishbe a kona hung Elijah kom’ah – “Chen Samaria lengpa thupole hokhu gakimaito pin lang hitin gaseipeh in, “Israel lah’a hi Pathen umlouva hitam? Nangma ipi dinga Ekronna semthu pathen Baalzebub kom’a leng damdoh dingle damdoh louding donga nache ham?” tin gaseipeh tan ati.
en: But the LORD’s angel said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and tell them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you go to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron?
text:
2KI 1:3
Thadou: Ahin Pakai vantil khat in Tishbe a kona hung Elijah kom’ah – “Chen Samaria lengpa thupole hokhu gakimaito pin lang hitin gaseipeh in, “Israel lah’a hi Pathen umlouva hitam? Nangma ipi dinga Ekronna semthu pathen Baalzebub kom’a leng damdoh dingle damdoh louding donga nache ham?” tin gaseipeh tan ati.
English: But the LORD’s angel said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and tell them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you go to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron?

tcz: Tun, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, “Nangin nalupna najalkhun nadalhah louding nathi dentei teiding ahitai,” ati. Hiti chun Elijah achen hichu aga seipeh tan ahi.
en: Now therefore the LORD says, “You will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.”’” Then Elijah departed.
text:
2KI 1:4
Thadou: Tun, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, “Nangin nalupna najalkhun nadalhah louding nathi dentei teiding ahitai,” ati. Hiti chun Elijah achen hichu aga seipeh tan ahi.
English: Now therefore the LORD says, “You will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.”’” Then Elijah departed.

tcz: Hichea thupole ho chu lengpa kom agalhun phat’un “I-atileh gang tah a nahung kilekit’u hitam?” tin nadongin ahi.
en: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them, “Why is it that you have returned?”
text:
2KI 1:5
Thadou: Hichea thupole ho chu lengpa kom agalhun phat’un “I-atileh gang tah a nahung kilekit’u hitam?” tin nadongin ahi.
English: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them, “Why is it that you have returned?”

tcz: Amahon adonbutnun, “Mikhat kakom muvah ahungin nangho kilekit uvin lang hiche thuhi lengpa kom’a seipeh un eitiuvin ahi,” chuleh Pakaiyin hitin aseije – “Israelte lah a Pathen umlou hija Ekron gam’ah semthu pathen Baalzebub kom’a nadamdoh ding le nadamdoh louding donga nache uham?” atipeh uvin ahi.
en: They said to him, “A man came up to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and tell him, “The LORD says, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you send to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”’”
text:
2KI 1:6
Thadou: Amahon adonbutnun, “Mikhat kakom muvah ahungin nangho kilekit uvin lang hiche thuhi lengpa kom’a seipeh un eitiuvin ahi,” chuleh Pakaiyin hitin aseije – “Israelte lah a Pathen umlou hija Ekron gam’ah semthu pathen Baalzebub kom’a nadamdoh ding le nadamdoh louding donga nache uham?” atipeh uvin ahi.
English: They said to him, “A man came up to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and tell him, “The LORD says, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you send to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”’”

tcz: Lengpan adongin “Amachu itobang mihem ham? Chule alim chu itobang ham?” tin ana ledoh kit in ahi.
en: He said to them, “What kind of man was he who came up to meet you and told you these words?”
text:
2KI 1:7
Thadou: Lengpan adongin “Amachu itobang mihem ham? Chule alim chu itobang ham?” tin ana ledoh kit in ahi.
English: He said to them, “What kind of man was he who came up to meet you and told you these words?”

tcz: Amahon adonbut in, “Amachu asam asaovin chuleh akongah savun kongah akigah’e,” atiuve. Hichun lengpan jong, “Tishbe akona Elijah hi chula em?” ati.
en: They answered him, “He was a hairy man, and wearing a leather belt around his waist.” He said, “It’s Elijah the Tishbite.”
text:
2KI 1:8
Thadou: Amahon adonbut in, “Amachu asam asaovin chuleh akongah savun kongah akigah’e,” atiuve. Hichun lengpan jong, “Tishbe akona Elijah hi chula em?” ati.
English: They answered him, “He was a hairy man, and wearing a leather belt around his waist.” He said, “It’s Elijah the Tishbite.”

tcz: Hijouchun aman sepai lamkai khat chu asepai somnga toh, Elijah manding chun asol tan ahi. Amahon muolchung khatna atoupet agamu uvin ahi, sepai lamkaipan ama kom’a chun, “Pathen mipa lengpa thupeh dungjuijin hung kumlhan kilhonnu hite,” ati.
en: Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him. He went up to him; and behold, he was sitting on the top of the hill. He said to him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down!’”
text:
2KI 1:9
Thadou: Hijouchun aman sepai lamkai khat chu asepai somnga toh, Elijah manding chun asol tan ahi. Amahon muolchung khatna atoupet agamu uvin ahi, sepai lamkaipan ama kom’a chun, “Pathen mipa lengpa thupeh dungjuijin hung kumlhan kilhonnu hite,” ati.
English: Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him. He went up to him; and behold, he was sitting on the top of the hill. He said to him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down!’”

tcz: Ahin Elijah in sepai lamkaipa kom’a, “ Keima Pathen mi kahileh vanna konin meikong hung lenglhan tin nangleh namite somnga chu sumang hen,” ati. Hichun vanna konin meikong ahung lenglhan amaho chu athat gamtan ahi.
en: Elijah answered to the captain of fifty, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.
text:
2KI 1:10
Thadou: Ahin Elijah in sepai lamkaipa kom’a, “ Keima Pathen mi kahileh vanna konin meikong hung lenglhan tin nangleh namite somnga chu sumang hen,” ati. Hichun vanna konin meikong ahung lenglhan amaho chu athat gamtan ahi.
English: Elijah answered to the captain of fifty, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

tcz: Hijeh chun lengpan mi som nga toh sepai lamkai khat ma asol kit in, sepai lamkaipa chun “Pathen mipa lengpan hung kumlha loihen ati,” aga tin ahi.
en: Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. He answered him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down quickly!’”
text:
2KI 1:11
Thadou: Hijeh chun lengpan mi som nga toh sepai lamkai khat ma asol kit in, sepai lamkaipa chun “Pathen mipa lengpan hung kumlha loihen ati,” aga tin ahi.
English: Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. He answered him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down quickly!’”

tcz: Hichun Elijah in adonbutin, “Keima Pathen mi kahileh vanna konin meikong hung lha henlang nangle namite som nga chu sumang hen,” ati. Chuti chun vanna konin meikong ahung lenglhan amaho chu athat gam kittan ahi.
en: Elijah answered them, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then God’s fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.
text:
2KI 1:12
Thadou: Hichun Elijah in adonbutin, “Keima Pathen mi kahileh vanna konin meikong hung lha henlang nangle namite som nga chu sumang hen,” ati. Chuti chun vanna konin meikong ahung lenglhan amaho chu athat gam kittan ahi.
English: Elijah answered them, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then God’s fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

tcz: Avellin lengpan jong athumchan na in sepai lamkai khat mi 50 toh asol kit in ahi. Ahin tuvang'in sepai lamkaipa chu molchungah akal touvin Elijah kengbul’ah akhup boh’in achun akom’a chun atao vin, “Vo Pathen mipa keileh nasohte mi 50 hohi nei hing hoitei teijun.
en: Again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. The third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, and said to him, “Man of God, please let my life and the life of these fifty of your servants be precious in your sight.
text:
2KI 1:13
Thadou: Avellin lengpan jong athumchan na in sepai lamkai khat mi 50 toh asol kit in ahi. Ahin tuvang'in sepai lamkaipa chu molchungah akal touvin Elijah kengbul’ah akhup boh’in achun akom’a chun atao vin, “Vo Pathen mipa keileh nasohte mi 50 hohi nei hing hoitei teijun.
English: Again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. The third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, and said to him, “Man of God, please let my life and the life of these fifty of your servants be precious in your sight.

tcz: Ven vanna kona meikong hung lenglha chun mi loini chu athat gamtan ahi, tunvang lungset tah in neihing hoiteijun!” atin ahi.
en: Behold, fire came down from the sky and consumed the last two captains of fifty with their fifties. But now let my life be precious in your sight.”
text:
2KI 1:14
Thadou: Ven vanna kona meikong hung lenglha chun mi loini chu athat gamtan ahi, tunvang lungset tah in neihing hoiteijun!” atin ahi.
English: Behold, fire came down from the sky and consumed the last two captains of fifty with their fifties. But now let my life be precious in your sight.”

tcz: Hichun Pakai vantil khatin Elijah kom’ah hitin aseije, “Ama hitoh kumlha khom lhonin, amahi kicha hihin” ati. Hiti chun Elijah akipatdohin ama chutoh lengpa kom’ah chun achelhon tan ahi.
en: The LORD’s angel said to Elijah, “Go down with him. Don’t be afraid of him.” Then he arose and went down with him to the king.
text:
2KI 1:15
Thadou: Hichun Pakai vantil khatin Elijah kom’ah hitin aseije, “Ama hitoh kumlha khom lhonin, amahi kicha hihin” ati. Hiti chun Elijah akipatdohin ama chutoh lengpa kom’ah chun achelhon tan ahi.
English: The LORD’s angel said to Elijah, “Go down with him. Don’t be afraid of him.” Then he arose and went down with him to the king.

tcz: Elijah in lengpa kom’a chun, “Pakaiyin hitin aseije nangin ipi bolla Ekron mite semthu pathen Baalzebub kom’a nadamdoh ding le nadamdohlou ding thu donga nasolham? Israelte lah a Pathen umlouva hitam? Hitia hi nachon jih in tua nalupna hi nada lhahlou helding ahitai chuleh nathitei teiding ahi.” ati peh tan ahi.
en: He said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”
text:
2KI 1:16
Thadou: Elijah in lengpa kom’a chun, “Pakaiyin hitin aseije nangin ipi bolla Ekron mite semthu pathen Baalzebub kom’a nadamdoh ding le nadamdohlou ding thu donga nasolham? Israelte lah a Pathen umlouva hitam? Hitia hi nachon jih in tua nalupna hi nada lhahlou helding ahitai chuleh nathitei teiding ahi.” ati peh tan ahi.
English: He said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”

tcz: Hiti chun Pakaiyin Elijah mang chan aseidohsa athutep bang bangchun Ahaziah chu athitan ahi. Ahaziah chun ama goulo ding chapa aneilou jeh chun asopipa Joram chu ama ban in leng ahung chang tan ahi. Hiche hi Judah leng Jehoshaphat chapa Jehoram leng vaihom kumni channa thilsoh ahi.
en: So he died according to the LORD’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.
text:
2KI 1:17
Thadou: Hiti chun Pakaiyin Elijah mang chan aseidohsa athutep bang bangchun Ahaziah chu athitan ahi. Ahaziah chun ama goulo ding chapa aneilou jeh chun asopipa Joram chu ama ban in leng ahung chang tan ahi. Hiche hi Judah leng Jehoshaphat chapa Jehoram leng vaihom kumni channa thilsoh ahi.
English: So he died according to the LORD’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.

tcz: Ahaziah vaihom sunga thilsoh dangho chu Israel lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua chun akisun lut’in ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
text:
2KI 1:18
Thadou: Ahaziah vaihom sunga thilsoh dangho chu Israel lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua chun akisun lut’in ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

tcz: Pakaiyin Elijah chu chimpei mangchan vanna alahtou ding kuon in Elijah leh Elisha chu Gilgal la kon’in ahung kijot lhonnin ahi.
en: When the LORD was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
text:
2KI 2:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin Elijah chu chimpei mangchan vanna alahtou ding kuon in Elijah leh Elisha chu Gilgal la kon’in ahung kijot lhonnin ahi.
English: When the LORD was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

tcz: Elijah in Elisha kom’ah “Nangma hiche mun a hin ana umtan, Pakaiyin keima Bethel chengeija cheding in eiseije,” ati. Ahin Elisha’n adonbut in, “Hing jing Pakai leh nangma hinlai sen, Keiman nangma kadalha louhel ding ahi!” ati. Hiti chun amani Bethel kho ah akijot lut lhon tai.
en: Elijah said to Elisha, “Please wait here, for the LORD has sent me as far as Bethel.” Elisha said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they went down to Bethel.
text:
2KI 2:2
Thadou: Elijah in Elisha kom’ah “Nangma hiche mun a hin ana umtan, Pakaiyin keima Bethel chengeija cheding in eiseije,” ati. Ahin Elisha’n adonbut in, “Hing jing Pakai leh nangma hinlai sen, Keiman nangma kadalha louhel ding ahi!” ati. Hiti chun amani Bethel kho ah akijot lut lhon tai.
English: Elijah said to Elisha, “Please wait here, for the LORD has sent me as far as Bethel.” Elisha said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they went down to Bethel.

tcz: Themgao kiloikhom phabep ho chu Bethel’a konin Elisha kom’ah ahungun hitin anadong tauve, “Tunia hi Pakaiyin napupa hi nanga kona alahtouding ahitai ti nahet hinam?” atiuve. Elishain adonbutin, “Kahenai, ahin, hiche thua hin thip beh’in um uvin,” atin ahi.
en: The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today?” He said, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”
text:
2KI 2:3
Thadou: Themgao kiloikhom phabep ho chu Bethel’a konin Elisha kom’ah ahungun hitin anadong tauve, “Tunia hi Pakaiyin napupa hi nanga kona alahtouding ahitai ti nahet hinam?” atiuve. Elishain adonbutin, “Kahenai, ahin, hiche thua hin thip beh’in um uvin,” atin ahi.
English: The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today?” He said, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”

tcz: Chujouvin Elijah in Elisha kom’ah, “Nangma hikom’a hin ana umtan keima vang Pakaiyin Jericho chan che dingin eideije,” ati. Ahin Elisha’n adonbutin kitin, “Hinjing Pakai leh nangma na hinjing laisen keiman nadalha ponge” ati. Hiti chun Jericho geijin achekhom kit lhontai.
en: Elijah said to him, “Elisha, please wait here, for the LORD has sent me to Jericho.” He said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they came to Jericho.
text:
2KI 2:4
Thadou: Chujouvin Elijah in Elisha kom’ah, “Nangma hikom’a hin ana umtan keima vang Pakaiyin Jericho chan che dingin eideije,” ati. Ahin Elisha’n adonbutin kitin, “Hinjing Pakai leh nangma na hinjing laisen keiman nadalha ponge” ati. Hiti chun Jericho geijin achekhom kit lhontai.
English: Elijah said to him, “Elisha, please wait here, for the LORD has sent me to Jericho.” He said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they came to Jericho.

tcz: Hijou chun Jerichoa konin themgao phabep Elisha kom’ah ahung un, “Pakaiyin napupa hi nanga kona tuni nikhoa hi alah mangding ahitai ti nahet nam?” atiuve. Elisha’n adonbut in “Kahenai, ahin thipbeh in ummun,” atin ahi.
en: The sons of the prophets who were at Jericho came near to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today?” He answered, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”
text:
2KI 2:5
Thadou: Hijou chun Jerichoa konin themgao phabep Elisha kom’ah ahung un, “Pakaiyin napupa hi nanga kona tuni nikhoa hi alah mangding ahitai ti nahet nam?” atiuve. Elisha’n adonbut in “Kahenai, ahin thipbeh in ummun,” atin ahi.
English: The sons of the prophets who were at Jericho came near to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today?” He answered, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”

tcz: Hijeh chun, Elijah in Elisha kom’ah aseijin “Hichea hin ana umtan ajeh chu keihi Pakaiyin Jordan Vadung geija che dingin aseije,” ati. Ahin Elisha’n adonbut in, “Hinjing Pakai leh nangma nahinjing laisen, Keiman nangma dalha ponge” ati. Hiti chun amani akijot kit lhon tan ahi.
en: Elijah said to him, “Please wait here, for the LORD has sent me to the Jordan.” He said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” Then they both went on.
text:
2KI 2:6
Thadou: Hijeh chun, Elijah in Elisha kom’ah aseijin “Hichea hin ana umtan ajeh chu keihi Pakaiyin Jordan Vadung geija che dingin aseije,” ati. Ahin Elisha’n adonbut in, “Hinjing Pakai leh nangma nahinjing laisen, Keiman nangma dalha ponge” ati. Hiti chun amani akijot kit lhon tan ahi.
English: Elijah said to him, “Please wait here, for the LORD has sent me to the Jordan.” He said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” Then they both went on.

tcz: Themgao honho lah’a konin mi som nga acheuvin Elijah leh Elisha Jordan vadung changei akijot lhon chu agal vet un ahi.
en: Fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood opposite them at a distance; and they both stood by the Jordan.
text:
2KI 2:7
Thadou: Themgao honho lah’a konin mi som nga acheuvin Elijah leh Elisha Jordan vadung changei akijot lhon chu agal vet un ahi.
English: Fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood opposite them at a distance; and they both stood by the Jordan.

tcz: Hichun Elijah in aponsil chu ajel tumin twi chung chu ajep a ahileh, vadung chu ahung kikhen in, anilhon chun agalkai lhon tan ahi.
en: Elijah took his mantle, and rolled it up, and struck the waters; and they were divided here and there, so that they both went over on dry ground.
text:
2KI 2:8
Thadou: Hichun Elijah in aponsil chu ajel tumin twi chung chu ajep a ahileh, vadung chu ahung kikhen in, anilhon chun agalkai lhon tan ahi.
English: Elijah took his mantle, and rolled it up, and struck the waters; and they were divided here and there, so that they both went over on dry ground.

tcz: Amani agalkai lhonphat’in Elijah in Elisha kom’ah, “Keima lahtouva kaum kah’in ipi kabolpeh theiding um am seijin,” ati. Chuin, Elisha’n adonbut in, “Nangma thalheng kahi thei na dingin nalhagao chan hi ajatnin neichan sah in,” ati.
en: When they had gone over, Elijah said to Elisha, “Ask what I shall do for you, before I am taken from you.” Elisha said, “Please let a double portion of your spirit be on me.”
text:
2KI 2:9
Thadou: Amani agalkai lhonphat’in Elijah in Elisha kom’ah, “Keima lahtouva kaum kah’in ipi kabolpeh theiding um am seijin,” ati. Chuin, Elisha’n adonbut in, “Nangma thalheng kahi thei na dingin nalhagao chan hi ajatnin neichan sah in,” ati.
English: When they had gone over, Elijah said to Elisha, “Ask what I shall do for you, before I am taken from you.” Elisha said, “Please let a double portion of your spirit be on me.”

tcz: Elijah in adonbut in, “Nathil thum hi thil hahsatah khat nathum ahi, ahin nangin keima hi nanga kona lahtouva kaum neimua ahileh nathum chu namu ding ahi,” atipeh in ahi.
en: He said, “You have asked a hard thing. If you see me when I am taken from you, it will be so for you; but if not, it will not be so.”
text:
2KI 2:10
Thadou: Elijah in adonbut in, “Nathil thum hi thil hahsatah khat nathum ahi, ahin nangin keima hi nanga kona lahtouva kaum neimua ahileh nathum chu namu ding ahi,” atipeh in ahi.
English: He said, “You have asked a hard thing. If you see me when I am taken from you, it will be so for you; but if not, it will not be so.”

tcz: Hitia chu amani kihoulim puma akijotpet lhon chun, pohphungin sakol kangtalai meikong pum in ahung kilah in, meikong lomlah’a chun sakol in ahin kaijin ahi. Amani kikah a chun atol lut in, amani chu asep khen lhon in, Elijah chu chimpaijin van langa apuitou tan ahi.
en: As they continued on and talked, behold, a chariot of fire and horses of fire separated them; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
text:
2KI 2:11
Thadou: Hitia chu amani kihoulim puma akijotpet lhon chun, pohphungin sakol kangtalai meikong pum in ahung kilah in, meikong lomlah’a chun sakol in ahin kaijin ahi. Amani kikah a chun atol lut in, amani chu asep khen lhon in, Elijah chu chimpaijin van langa apuitou tan ahi.
English: As they continued on and talked, behold, a chariot of fire and horses of fire separated them; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

tcz: Elisha’n hichu amun apengjah jengin, “Hepa! Hepa! Keiman Israelte sakol kangtalai leh sakol kangtalai tol ho kamun ahi,” ati. Chuin Elijah chu lahtouva aum a, Elisha akoma kona amuphah lou phat in Elisha’n lungkham tah in apon chu abot-tel in ahi.
en: Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.
text:
2KI 2:12
Thadou: Elisha’n hichu amun apengjah jengin, “Hepa! Hepa! Keiman Israelte sakol kangtalai leh sakol kangtalai tol ho kamun ahi,” ati. Chuin Elijah chu lahtouva aum a, Elisha akoma kona amuphah lou phat in Elisha’n lungkham tah in apon chu abot-tel in ahi.
English: Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.

tcz: Elijah lahtouva aum phat’in, ahung lenglha Elijah poncho chu Elijah in akilah tan ahi. Hijouchun Elisha chu Jordan vadung panga chun ahung kiletan ahi.
en: He also took up Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan.
text:
2KI 2:13
Thadou: Elijah lahtouva aum phat’in, ahung lenglha Elijah poncho chu Elijah in akilah tan ahi. Hijouchun Elisha chu Jordan vadung panga chun ahung kiletan ahi.
English: He also took up Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan.

tcz: Aman vadung twi chu Elijah ponchol chun ajep in hitin asamtan ahi, “Elijah Pathen Pakai chu hoiya umma ham?” ati. Hichun vadung chu akikhen in Elisha agalkai tai.
en: He took Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and struck the waters, and said, “Where is the LORD, the God of Elijah?” When he also had struck the waters, they were divided apart, and Elisha went over.
text:
2KI 2:14
Thadou: Aman vadung twi chu Elijah ponchol chun ajep in hitin asamtan ahi, “Elijah Pathen Pakai chu hoiya umma ham?” ati. Hichun vadung chu akikhen in Elisha agalkai tai.
English: He took Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and struck the waters, and said, “Where is the LORD, the God of Elijah?” When he also had struck the waters, they were divided apart, and Elisha went over.

tcz: Jericho a kona themgao kiloikhom ho chu Jericho a konin thilsoh chu agalmu uvin, hiti hin asam tauvin ahi, “Elijah lhagao chu Elisha chunga achutai,” atiuve. Amaho chu ama kimupi dingin acheuvin amasanga tol’ah abohkhup un,
en: When the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho facing him saw him, they said, “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.” They came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.
text:
2KI 2:15
Thadou: Jericho a kona themgao kiloikhom ho chu Jericho a konin thilsoh chu agalmu uvin, hiti hin asam tauvin ahi, “Elijah lhagao chu Elisha chunga achutai,” atiuve. Amaho chu ama kimupi dingin acheuvin amasanga tol’ah abohkhup un,
English: When the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho facing him saw him, they said, “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.” They came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

tcz: “Hepu – nangin thu neipe uvin lang keiho lah a ahatcheh mi somnga in gam mang lah’a hi napupa hol uvinge. Ijem atileh Pakai lhagaovin molchung ham, phaicham chungham, khatna adalhah maithei ahi.” atiuve. Elisha’n adonbut in, “Ahipoi, sol hih in,” ati.
en: They said to him, “See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master. Perhaps the LORD’s Spirit has taken him up, and put him on some mountain or into some valley.” He said, “Don’t send them.”
text:
2KI 2:16
Thadou: “Hepu – nangin thu neipe uvin lang keiho lah a ahatcheh mi somnga in gam mang lah’a hi napupa hol uvinge. Ijem atileh Pakai lhagaovin molchung ham, phaicham chungham, khatna adalhah maithei ahi.” atiuve. Elisha’n adonbut in, “Ahipoi, sol hih in,” ati.
English: They said to him, “See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master. Perhaps the LORD’s Spirit has taken him up, and put him on some mountain or into some valley.” He said, “Don’t send them.”

tcz: Ahinlah amahon aseitei tei jingun ahileh, aman anil nomlou phat in, “Aphai sol tauvin,” ati. Hichun mi somnga in nithum lhingset ahol un amupouvin ahi.
en: When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, “Send them.” Therefore they sent fifty men; and they searched for three days, but didn’t find him.
text:
2KI 2:17
Thadou: Ahinlah amahon aseitei tei jingun ahileh, aman anil nomlou phat in, “Aphai sol tauvin,” ati. Hichun mi somnga in nithum lhingset ahol un amupouvin ahi.
English: When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, “Send them.” Therefore they sent fifty men; and they searched for three days, but didn’t find him.

tcz: Elisha chu amaho hung kilekit geijin Jericho a ana um nalaijin ahi. “Che hih un kati hilou ham?” ati.
en: They came back to him while he stayed at Jericho; and he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you, ‘Don’t go’?”
text:
2KI 2:18
Thadou: Elisha chu amaho hung kilekit geijin Jericho a ana um nalaijin ahi. “Che hih un kati hilou ham?” ati.
English: They came back to him while he stayed at Jericho; and he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you, ‘Don’t go’?”

tcz: Nikhat hi Jericho khopia lamkai hon Elisha chu ahung kimupiuvin, “Keihon boina khat kaneijuve, Hepu!” ahung tiuve, “Nangin namu bangin hiche khopi nomtah le hoitah ahi. Ahinla twi ahah in chuleh agam leiset a jong hin ima aputpon ahi,” ahung tiuvin ahi.
en: The men of the city said to Elisha, “Behold, please, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the land is barren.”
text:
2KI 2:19
Thadou: Nikhat hi Jericho khopia lamkai hon Elisha chu ahung kimupiuvin, “Keihon boina khat kaneijuve, Hepu!” ahung tiuve, “Nangin namu bangin hiche khopi nomtah le hoitah ahi. Ahinla twi ahah in chuleh agam leiset a jong hin ima aputpon ahi,” ahung tiuvin ahi.
English: The men of the city said to Elisha, “Behold, please, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the land is barren.”

tcz: Elisha’n amaho kom’ah, khonthah khatna chi hinchoujun ati. Hichun amahon jong ahinchoijun ahi.
en: He said, “Bring me a new jar, and put salt in it.” Then they brought it to him.
text:
2KI 2:20
Thadou: Elisha’n amaho kom’ah, khonthah khatna chi hinchoujun ati. Hichun amahon jong ahinchoijun ahi.
English: He said, “Bring me a new jar, and put salt in it.” Then they brought it to him.

tcz: Hijou chun, aman hiche khopi sunga twi hunglonlut patna twinah'a chun chi aga seplut in hitin asei tai, “Pakaiyin hitin aseje, keiman hiche twihi kasutheng tai, hichea kon hin thi nale ga phalou um talou ding ahi,” ati.
en: He went out to the spring of the waters, and threw salt into it, and said, “The LORD says, ‘I have healed these waters. There shall not be from there any more death or barren wasteland.’”
text:
2KI 2:21
Thadou: Hijou chun, aman hiche khopi sunga twi hunglonlut patna twinah'a chun chi aga seplut in hitin asei tai, “Pakaiyin hitin aseje, keiman hiche twihi kasutheng tai, hichea kon hin thi nale ga phalou um talou ding ahi,” ati.
English: He went out to the spring of the waters, and threw salt into it, and said, “The LORD says, ‘I have healed these waters. There shall not be from there any more death or barren wasteland.’”

tcz: Hiti chun Elisha’n aseibang in hiche nikhoa pat chun twi chu atheng jengtan ahi.
en: So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha’s word which he spoke.
text:
2KI 2:22
Thadou: Hiti chun Elisha’n aseibang in hiche nikhoa pat chun twi chu atheng jengtan ahi.
English: So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha’s word which he spoke.

tcz: Elisha’n Jericho chu adalhan Bethel lam ajontan ahi. Hitia chu lamlen na achepet jing lai chun, hiche khopi sunga kona chapang phabep in atot khum’un noise tah in, “Lutolpa chedoh in, Lutolpa chedoh in atiuvin,” ahi.
en: He went up from there to Bethel. As he was going up by the way, some youths came out of the city and mocked him, and said to him, “Go up, you baldy! Go up, you baldy!”
text:
2KI 2:23
Thadou: Elisha’n Jericho chu adalhan Bethel lam ajontan ahi. Hitia chu lamlen na achepet jing lai chun, hiche khopi sunga kona chapang phabep in atot khum’un noise tah in, “Lutolpa chedoh in, Lutolpa chedoh in atiuvin,” ahi.
English: He went up from there to Bethel. As he was going up by the way, some youths came out of the city and mocked him, and said to him, “Go up, you baldy! Go up, you baldy!”

tcz: Elisha akiheijin amaho chu aven Pakai minnin asamse tan ahi. Hichun gam’ahng lah’a konin Vompi ni ahung potdoh'in chapang somli le ni chu abot tellin athat gamtan ahi.
en: He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in the LORD’s name. Then two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of those youths.
text:
2KI 2:24
Thadou: Elisha akiheijin amaho chu aven Pakai minnin asamse tan ahi. Hichun gam’ahng lah’a konin Vompi ni ahung potdoh'in chapang somli le ni chu abot tellin athat gamtan ahi.
English: He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in the LORD’s name. Then two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of those youths.

tcz: Hichea kon chun Elisha chu Carmel lhang lam chu ajonnin khonungin Samaria langa akile in ahi.
en: He went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.
text:
2KI 2:25
Thadou: Hichea kon chun Elisha chu Carmel lhang lam chu ajonnin khonungin Samaria langa akile in ahi.
English: He went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.

tcz: Judah gam’a Jehoshaphat lenggam vai poh kum somle get chan kum chun Ahab chapa Joram in Israel te chunga vai anapon ahi. Aman Samaria khopia kum somle ni vai ana pon ahi.
en: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
text:
2KI 3:1
Thadou: Judah gam’a Jehoshaphat lenggam vai poh kum somle get chan kum chun Ahab chapa Joram in Israel te chunga vai anapon ahi. Aman Samaria khopia kum somle ni vai ana pon ahi.
English: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

tcz: Amahin anule apa tobang lom in thilse ana bolpon ahinlah Pathen mitmu’n thilse jeng anabollin ahi. Amahin apan anatundoh Baal houna dia apan anatun khumpi theng teho vang anavo lhun ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, but not like his father and like his mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.
text:
2KI 3:2
Thadou: Amahin anule apa tobang lom in thilse ana bolpon ahinlah Pathen mitmu’n thilse jeng anabollin ahi. Amahin apan anatundoh Baal houna dia apan anatun khumpi theng teho vang anavo lhun ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, but not like his father and like his mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.

tcz: Ahijing vang'in Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israel mipite ana chonset sahna hiche chonsetna chu ana chejompi jingin ahi.
en: Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from them.
text:
2KI 3:3
Thadou: Ahijing vang'in Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israel mipite ana chonset sahna hiche chonsetna chu ana chejompi jingin ahi.
English: Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from them.

tcz: Moab mi Mesha lengpa chu kelngoi chi pun sahmi anahi. Amahin Israel lengpahi kumseh a kelngoi sang jakhat chuleh kelchal sang jakhat mul anapehji ahi.
en: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he supplied the king of Israel with one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.
text:
2KI 3:4
Thadou: Moab mi Mesha lengpa chu kelngoi chi pun sahmi anahi. Amahin Israel lengpahi kumseh a kelngoi sang jakhat chuleh kelchal sang jakhat mul anapehji ahi.
English: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he supplied the king of Israel with one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.

tcz: Ahinlah Ahab athi phat in Moab lengpan Israel lengpa ana doutan ahi.
en: But when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
text:
2KI 3:5
Thadou: Ahinlah Ahab athi phat in Moab lengpan Israel lengpa ana doutan ahi.
English: But when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

tcz: Hijeh chun Joram lengpan jong Samaria konin Israel sepai gangtah in ahin toldoh in,
en: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.
text:
2KI 3:6
Thadou: Hijeh chun Joram lengpan jong Samaria konin Israel sepai gangtah in ahin toldoh in,
English: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.

tcz: Lampia chun Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chu thu agah thot’in, “Moab lengpa kei dounan gal ahin boltan ahi, amaho toh kisatna ding ahi neihung panhu theiding hinam? atin ahi. Hichun Jehoshaphat in adonbut in, “Ibola kahung da ding ham? Nangle kei thakhat ihi chula am? Kei sepai hochu nang sepai ahin, kasakol hochu nang sakol ahi,” ati.
en: He went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, “The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me against Moab to battle?” He said, “I will go up. I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”
text:
2KI 3:7
Thadou: Lampia chun Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chu thu agah thot’in, “Moab lengpa kei dounan gal ahin boltan ahi, amaho toh kisatna ding ahi neihung panhu theiding hinam? atin ahi. Hichun Jehoshaphat in adonbut in, “Ibola kahung da ding ham? Nangle kei thakhat ihi chula am? Kei sepai hochu nang sepai ahin, kasakol hochu nang sakol ahi,” ati.
English: He went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, “The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me against Moab to battle?” He said, “I will go up. I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

tcz: Hijou chun Jehoshaphat in adongin, “Hoiche lampi iho ding ham?” atile Joram in adonbut in, “Edom gamthip noija kona inokhum ding ahi,” ati.
en: Then he said, “Which way shall we go up?” Jehoram answered, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”
text:
2KI 3:8
Thadou: Hijou chun Jehoshaphat in adongin, “Hoiche lampi iho ding ham?” atile Joram in adonbut in, “Edom gamthip noija kona inokhum ding ahi,” ati.
English: Then he said, “Which way shall we go up?” Jehoram answered, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”

tcz: Hichun Edom lengpan jong ahin jop in, athum’un nisagi sungin gamthip noija chun avel lam in akitollun ahi.” Ahin mihem le gancha dingin twi anei tapouvin ahi.
en: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched for seven days along a circuitous route. There was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.
text:
2KI 3:9
Thadou: Hichun Edom lengpan jong ahin jop in, athum’un nisagi sungin gamthip noija chun avel lam in akitollun ahi.” Ahin mihem le gancha dingin twi anei tapouvin ahi.
English: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched for seven days along a circuitous route. There was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.

tcz: “Ipi itidiu hitam?” tin Israel lengpa chu ahung pengjah jingin ahi, “Pakaiyin hilai mun nahi Moab lengpa jovah dinga hi eihin puilut u hita hila,” ati.
en: The king of Israel said, “Alas! For the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”
text:
2KI 3:10
Thadou: “Ipi itidiu hitam?” tin Israel lengpa chu ahung pengjah jingin ahi, “Pakaiyin hilai mun nahi Moab lengpa jovah dinga hi eihin puilut u hita hila,” ati.
English: The king of Israel said, “Alas! For the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

tcz: Ahin Judah lengpan Jehoshaphat in, “I-lah uva themgao jaolouva ham? Aumma ahileh i-iti diuham idoh theiju ahi,” ati. Joram lengpa noija lamkai khat in ahin donbut’in, “Saphat chapa Elisha chu hikom’a aume ati. Amahi Elijah noija natong ahi,” ahin tin ahi.
en: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there a prophet of the LORD here, that we may inquire of the LORD by him?” One of the king of Israel’s servants answered, “Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah, is here.”
text:
2KI 3:11
Thadou: Ahin Judah lengpan Jehoshaphat in, “I-lah uva themgao jaolouva ham? Aumma ahileh i-iti diuham idoh theiju ahi,” ati. Joram lengpa noija lamkai khat in ahin donbut’in, “Saphat chapa Elisha chu hikom’a aume ati. Amahi Elijah noija natong ahi,” ahin tin ahi.
English: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there a prophet of the LORD here, that we may inquire of the LORD by him?” One of the king of Israel’s servants answered, “Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah, is here.”

tcz: Hichun Jehoshaphat in, “Ama koma hi Pakaiyin thu aseiji ahitai,” ati. Hiti chun Israelte, Judahte chule Edom leng ho chu Elisha adong din ache tauvin ahi.
en: Jehoshaphat said, “The LORD’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
text:
2KI 3:12
Thadou: Hichun Jehoshaphat in, “Ama koma hi Pakaiyin thu aseiji ahitai,” ati. Hiti chun Israelte, Judahte chule Edom leng ho chu Elisha adong din ache tauvin ahi.
English: Jehoshaphat said, “The LORD’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

tcz: Elisha’n Israel lengpa kom’ah, “Ipi dinga kei kom’a nahung uham? Nanu le napa themgao kom’a nacheule iti ham?” ati. Hichun Israel lengpa Joram chun ahipoi, “Pakaiyin leng thum hohi Moab lengpan ajodinga eihin puilut’u ahibouve,” ati.
en: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother.” The king of Israel said to him, “No, for the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”
text:
2KI 3:13
Thadou: Elisha’n Israel lengpa kom’ah, “Ipi dinga kei kom’a nahung uham? Nanu le napa themgao kom’a nacheule iti ham?” ati. Hichun Israel lengpa Joram chun ahipoi, “Pakaiyin leng thum hohi Moab lengpan ajodinga eihin puilut’u ahibouve,” ati.
English: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother.” The king of Israel said to him, “No, for the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

tcz: Elisha’n adonbut in, “Keiman kahou Hatchungnung Pakai minna kasei ahi, Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat kaja lou hileh nanghi kadonlou ding nahi,” ati.
en: Elisha said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.
text:
2KI 3:14
Thadou: Elisha’n adonbut in, “Keiman kahou Hatchungnung Pakai minna kasei ahi, Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat kaja lou hileh nanghi kadonlou ding nahi,” ati.
English: Elisha said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.

tcz: “Koipen nahiuvem, nalah uva semjangsai them naum uvem? Ama chu kakom’a hinpuilut un,” ati. Semjang chu asai peh phat in Pakai thahatna chu Elisha chunga ahung chutan ahi leh,
en: But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, the LORD’s hand came on him.
text:
2KI 3:15
Thadou: “Koipen nahiuvem, nalah uva semjangsai them naum uvem? Ama chu kakom’a hinpuilut un,” ati. Semjang chu asai peh phat in Pakai thahatna chu Elisha chunga ahung chutan ahi leh,
English: But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, the LORD’s hand came on him.

tcz: Aman hiti hin asei peh tan ahi, “Pakaiyin aseije, Hiche phaicham hi twi dimna twikul hung hi ding ahi.
en: He said, “The LORD says, ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’
text:
2KI 3:16
Thadou: Aman hiti hin asei peh tan ahi, “Pakaiyin aseije, Hiche phaicham hi twi dimna twikul hung hi ding ahi.
English: He said, “The LORD says, ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’

tcz: Nanghon huile go gin najah loudiu ahi, ahinla hiche phaicham hi twi hung dimset ding ahi. Chutengle, nanghon nangho dingle nagancha hole ganhing dangho dinga jong nanei letset diu ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije,” ati.
en: For the LORD says, ‘You will not see wind, neither will you see rain, yet that valley will be filled with water, and you will drink, both you and your livestock and your other animals.
text:
2KI 3:17
Thadou: Nanghon huile go gin najah loudiu ahi, ahinla hiche phaicham hi twi hung dimset ding ahi. Chutengle, nanghon nangho dingle nagancha hole ganhing dangho dinga jong nanei letset diu ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije,” ati.
English: For the LORD says, ‘You will not see wind, neither will you see rain, yet that valley will be filled with water, and you will drink, both you and your livestock and your other animals.

tcz: “Ahin hiche hi Pakai dinga imacha ahipoi, ajeh chu aman Moab sepaite chunga jong gal najosah diu ahi,” ati.
en: This is an easy thing in the LORD’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
text:
2KI 3:18
Thadou: “Ahin hiche hi Pakai dinga imacha ahipoi, ajeh chu aman Moab sepaite chunga jong gal najosah diu ahi,” ati.
English: This is an easy thing in the LORD’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.

tcz: “Nanghon akhopiu phalai ho jouse jong chuleh kul kigetkhum hojong nalah diu, athingphung phalai jeng jong nalah diu, natuhchaidiu, atwikhuh hou jing jong nadip pehdiu agamphalai jouse jong song nadip sahdiu, nasuhmang pehdiu ahi,” ati.
en: You shall strike every fortified city and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’”
text:
2KI 3:19
Thadou: “Nanghon akhopiu phalai ho jouse jong chuleh kul kigetkhum hojong nalah diu, athingphung phalai jeng jong nalah diu, natuhchaidiu, atwikhuh hou jing jong nadip pehdiu agamphalai jouse jong song nadip sahdiu, nasuhmang pehdiu ahi,” ati.
English: You shall strike every fortified city and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’”

tcz: Ajing nikhon, jingkah gan kilhaina semphat don laitah in, phulou helouvin twi ahung putdoh tan ahi. Hichu Edom lang ngan ah alongin ahi.
en: In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
text:
2KI 3:20
Thadou: Ajing nikhon, jingkah gan kilhaina semphat don laitah in, phulou helouvin twi ahung putdoh tan ahi. Hichu Edom lang ngan ah alongin ahi.
English: In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

tcz: Langkhat ah galmi thum, amaho doudin ahung kitol’e tithu Moab miten ajahdoh phat’un, amahon chempai kiko theibep chan geijin gamgi dungjui chun akigol jeng un ahi.
en: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, young and old, and stood on the border.
text:
2KI 3:21
Thadou: Langkhat ah galmi thum, amaho doudin ahung kitol’e tithu Moab miten ajahdoh phat’un, amahon chempai kiko theibep chan geijin gamgi dungjui chun akigol jeng un ahi.
English: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, young and old, and stood on the border.

tcz: Ahinlah ajing jingkah in, athoudoh un ahile nisa chun twi chung chu akhon ahileh Moab mite ding chun asan in, thisan abangtan ahi.
en: They rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood.
text:
2KI 3:22
Thadou: Ahinlah ajing jingkah in, athoudoh un ahile nisa chun twi chung chu akhon ahileh Moab mite ding chun asan in, thisan abangtan ahi.
English: They rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood.

tcz: Moab miten asam’un “Hiche kho thisan ahi, galmi thumho khu amaho le amaho kithat touva ahitai - Moab mite cheu hitin athil’u gakichom uhite,” akitiuve.
en: They said, “This is blood. The kings are surely destroyed, and they have struck each other. Now therefore, Moab, to the plunder!”
text:
2KI 3:23
Thadou: Moab miten asam’un “Hiche kho thisan ahi, galmi thumho khu amaho le amaho kithat touva ahitai - Moab mite cheu hitin athil’u gakichom uhite,” akitiuve.
English: They said, “This is blood. The kings are surely destroyed, and they have struck each other. Now therefore, Moab, to the plunder!”

tcz: Ahinlah Moab mite chu Israelte ngahmun ahunglhun phat’un, Israel galmi hochu alhaidoh un amaho chu anokhum un, Moab gamgeijin ano uvin achejom’un thil jouse asubei soh jengun ahi.
en: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.
text:
2KI 3:24
Thadou: Ahinlah Moab mite chu Israelte ngahmun ahunglhun phat’un, Israel galmi hochu alhaidoh un amaho chu anokhum un, Moab gamgeijin ano uvin achejom’un thil jouse asubei soh jengun ahi.
English: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.

tcz: Amahon akhopi houchu asubei jun, agampha laiho jouse chu song in adip’un, atwikhuh hou asubing un, athingphung phajouse aphuh lhuh peh’un ahi. Ajona in Kir-hareseth leh asongpal ho bou akhen tauvin ahi, ahin song sep themhon aumkimvel un anokhum tauvin ahi.
en: They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone, and filled it. They also stopped all the springs of water and cut down all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth all they left was its stones; however the men armed with slings went around it and attacked it.
text:
2KI 3:25
Thadou: Amahon akhopi houchu asubei jun, agampha laiho jouse chu song in adip’un, atwikhuh hou asubing un, athingphung phajouse aphuh lhuh peh’un ahi. Ajona in Kir-hareseth leh asongpal ho bou akhen tauvin ahi, ahin song sep themhon aumkimvel un anokhum tauvin ahi.
English: They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone, and filled it. They also stopped all the springs of water and cut down all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth all they left was its stones; however the men armed with slings went around it and attacked it.

tcz: Moab lengpan gal alal chu amudoh phat’in chemjam lamthei cheh mi jasagi toh Edom lengpa komlang chu phutvang un jamdoh agouvin ahileh ajou tapouvin ahi.
en: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.
text:
2KI 3:26
Thadou: Moab lengpan gal alal chu amudoh phat’in chemjam lamthei cheh mi jasagi toh Edom lengpa komlang chu phutvang un jamdoh agouvin ahileh ajou tapouvin ahi.
English: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.

tcz: Hijou chun Moab lengpan achapa tahpen, ama khel a leng chang dingpa chu aman’in palchunga chun kilhaina dingin akatdoh tan ahi. Hijeh chun Israel chungah lunghanna nasatah ahung chutan ahileh Israelte akinung haijun agamlang uvah akinungle tauvin ahi.
en: Then he took his oldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great wrath against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.
text:
2KI 3:27
Thadou: Hijou chun Moab lengpan achapa tahpen, ama khel a leng chang dingpa chu aman’in palchunga chun kilhaina dingin akatdoh tan ahi. Hijeh chun Israel chungah lunghanna nasatah ahung chutan ahileh Israelte akinung haijun agamlang uvah akinungle tauvin ahi.
English: Then he took his oldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great wrath against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

tcz: Nikhat hi themgao holah a khatpen ji ana hia meithai khat hi Elisha kom’ah ahungin ahung peng jah jingin, hitin aseiye, “Nangma noija na anatong kajipa chu athitai, aman Pakai agindan chu nangin nahet ahi. Ahinla tuhin sum kabatpa ahungin kacha teni hi soh a kai ding eigo tauvin ahi,” ati.
en: Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is dead. You know that your servant feared the LORD. Now the creditor has come to take for himself my two children to be slaves.”
text:
2KI 4:1
Thadou: Nikhat hi themgao holah a khatpen ji ana hia meithai khat hi Elisha kom’ah ahungin ahung peng jah jingin, hitin aseiye, “Nangma noija na anatong kajipa chu athitai, aman Pakai agindan chu nangin nahet ahi. Ahinla tuhin sum kabatpa ahungin kacha teni hi soh a kai ding eigo tauvin ahi,” ati.
English: Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is dead. You know that your servant feared the LORD. Now the creditor has come to take for himself my two children to be slaves.”

tcz: Hichun Elisha amanu kom’a chun, “Ipi kabolpeh thei um am! Nainsung’a hi ipi naneijem neiseipeh in,” ati. Amanun jong adonbutin, “Olive thao theikhat tilou imacha adang kaneipoi,” ati.
en: Elisha said to her, “What should I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?” She said, “Your servant has nothing in the house, except a pot of oil.”
text:
2KI 4:2
Thadou: Hichun Elisha amanu kom’a chun, “Ipi kabolpeh thei um am! Nainsung’a hi ipi naneijem neiseipeh in,” ati. Amanun jong adonbutin, “Olive thao theikhat tilou imacha adang kaneipoi,” ati.
English: Elisha said to her, “What should I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?” She said, “Your servant has nothing in the house, except a pot of oil.”

tcz: Elisha’n jong achutia ahileh “Na-insah na-inlhang hokom hihen, nagol napai hokom hijongleh belkeu namuthei chanin batnin galatan,” atin ahi.
en: Then he said, “Go, borrow empty containers from all your neighbors. Don’t borrow just a few containers.
text:
2KI 4:3
Thadou: Elisha’n jong achutia ahileh “Na-insah na-inlhang hokom hihen, nagol napai hokom hijongleh belkeu namuthei chanin batnin galatan,” atin ahi.
English: Then he said, “Go, borrow empty containers from all your neighbors. Don’t borrow just a few containers.

tcz: “Chujouteng chule nachateni chutoh insungah lut unlang, kot kikha khum’un,” atin ahi. “Chutengleh Olive thaochu atheija kon chun bel keoho a chun sunglhauvin lang adim phatleh kaidohji jiuvin,” ati.
en: Go in and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour oil into all those containers; and set aside those which are full.”
text:
2KI 4:4
Thadou: “Chujouteng chule nachateni chutoh insungah lut unlang, kot kikha khum’un,” atin ahi. “Chutengleh Olive thaochu atheija kon chun bel keoho a chun sunglhauvin lang adim phatleh kaidohji jiuvin,” ati.
English: Go in and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour oil into all those containers; and set aside those which are full.”

tcz: Hichun amanun jong aseipeh bang bang chun aboltan ahi. Amanun belchu adim phat phatleh achatenin ahinpelut ji ji lhonin, hiti chun bel jouse chu adipsoh tauvin ahi.
en: So she went from him, and shut the door on herself and on her sons. They brought the containers to her, and she poured oil.
text:
2KI 4:5
Thadou: Hichun amanun jong aseipeh bang bang chun aboltan ahi. Amanun belchu adim phat phatleh achatenin ahinpelut ji ji lhonin, hiti chun bel jouse chu adipsoh tauvin ahi.
English: So she went from him, and shut the door on herself and on her sons. They brought the containers to her, and she poured oil.

tcz: Gangtah in Olive thaotwi akoina hojouse chu adim letset tan ahi! Amanun achateni kom’a chun, “Belkhat neihin pehbe lhonin,” atileh, “amanin aumtapoi!” atilhonin ahi. Hichun Olive thaojong chu abeitan ahi.
en: When the containers were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another container.” He said to her, “There isn’t another container.” Then the oil stopped flowing.
text:
2KI 4:6
Thadou: Gangtah in Olive thaotwi akoina hojouse chu adim letset tan ahi! Amanun achateni kom’a chun, “Belkhat neihin pehbe lhonin,” atileh, “amanin aumtapoi!” atilhonin ahi. Hichun Olive thaojong chu abeitan ahi.
English: When the containers were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another container.” He said to her, “There isn’t another container.” Then the oil stopped flowing.

tcz: Amanun Pathen mipa kom’a chun thilsoh chu aseijin ahileh, aman amanu kom’a chun, “Tun Olive thao chu joh unlang Nebat’u chu sadoh tauvin chuleh nangle nachateni avalla chu nakivah theidiu ahi,” ati.
en: Then she came and told the man of God. He said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest.”
text:
2KI 4:7
Thadou: Amanun Pathen mipa kom’a chun thilsoh chu aseijin ahileh, aman amanu kom’a chun, “Tun Olive thao chu joh unlang Nebat’u chu sadoh tauvin chuleh nangle nachateni avalla chu nakivah theidiu ahi,” ati.
English: Then she came and told the man of God. He said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest.”

tcz: Nikhat hi Shunem khopi sunga chu Elisha agachen ahileh numei haotah khat anachengin, amanu chun ainna anne dingin akouvin ahi. Hichejou chun hilang chu ahopa channin hilai munna chun an nedingin aki-nga jin ahi.
en: One day Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.
text:
2KI 4:8
Thadou: Nikhat hi Shunem khopi sunga chu Elisha agachen ahileh numei haotah khat anachengin, amanu chun ainna anne dingin akouvin ahi. Hichejou chun hilang chu ahopa channin hilai munna chun an nedingin aki-nga jin ahi.
English: One day Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.

tcz: Amanun ajipa kom’a chun, “Ven, hilanga ahung chanle hung kingajipa hi Pathen mitheng khat hitei din katahsan’e,
en: She said to her husband, “See now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God who passes by us continually.
text:
2KI 4:9
Thadou: Amanun ajipa kom’a chun, “Ven, hilanga ahung chanle hung kingajipa hi Pathen mitheng khat hitei din katahsan’e,
English: She said to her husband, “See now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God who passes by us continually.

tcz: Hijeh chun amading hin inchunga hin indan khat sem hitin lupna khat, dokhang khat, touna khat le thaomei khat koipeh hite,” ati. “Chutileh ahung komleh gehthei louding ahi” ati.
en: Please, let’s make a little room on the roof. Let’s set a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp stand for him there. When he comes to us, he can stay there.”
text:
2KI 4:10
Thadou: Hijeh chun amading hin inchunga hin indan khat sem hitin lupna khat, dokhang khat, touna khat le thaomei khat koipeh hite,” ati. “Chutileh ahung komleh gehthei louding ahi” ati.
English: Please, let’s make a little room on the roof. Let’s set a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp stand for him there. When he comes to us, he can stay there.”

tcz: Nikhat hi Elisha chu Shunem in na chun ahung kile kit’in, ainchung danna chun akaltouvin akicholdotan ahi.
en: One day he came there, and he went to the room and lay there.
text:
2KI 4:11
Thadou: Nikhat hi Elisha chu Shunem in na chun ahung kile kit’in, ainchung danna chun akaltouvin akicholdotan ahi.
English: One day he came there, and he went to the room and lay there.

tcz: Aman asohpa Gehazi kom’a chun, “Hiche Shunem numeinu kom’a khun thukhat kasei nom’e gatin ati,” ati. Ama ahung phat’in,
en: He said to Gehazi his servant, “Call this Shunammite.” When he had called her, she stood before him.
text:
2KI 4:12
Thadou: Aman asohpa Gehazi kom’a chun, “Hiche Shunem numeinu kom’a khun thukhat kasei nom’e gatin ati,” ati. Ama ahung phat’in,
English: He said to Gehazi his servant, “Call this Shunammite.” When he had called her, she stood before him.

tcz: Elisha’n Gehazi kom’ah “Amanu chu seipeh in hichangeija eikhohsa hi kakipah lheh jenge ipi kabolpeh ding ham? Lengpa kom’ah ahilouleh asepai lamkaipa kom’ah ipi seipeh leng adeijem?” ati. Hichun amanun adonbut in, “Ima kangai chapoi kainsung min eive tup nai,” ati.
en: He said to him, “Say now to her, ‘Behold, you have cared for us with all this care. What is to be done for you? Would you like to be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the army?’” She answered, “I dwell among my own people.”
text:
2KI 4:13
Thadou: Elisha’n Gehazi kom’ah “Amanu chu seipeh in hichangeija eikhohsa hi kakipah lheh jenge ipi kabolpeh ding ham? Lengpa kom’ah ahilouleh asepai lamkaipa kom’ah ipi seipeh leng adeijem?” ati. Hichun amanun adonbut in, “Ima kangai chapoi kainsung min eive tup nai,” ati.
English: He said to him, “Say now to her, ‘Behold, you have cared for us with all this care. What is to be done for you? Would you like to be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the army?’” She answered, “I dwell among my own people.”

tcz: Khonungin Elisha’n Gehazi chu adong in, “Amanuhi ipi ibolpeh thei ding ham?” ati. Gehazin adonbut in, “Amanu hin chapa aneipoi, ajipa jong atehsetai,” ati.
en: He said, “What then is to be done for her?” Gehazi answered, “Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.”
text:
2KI 4:14
Thadou: Khonungin Elisha’n Gehazi chu adong in, “Amanuhi ipi ibolpeh thei ding ham?” ati. Gehazin adonbut in, “Amanu hin chapa aneipoi, ajipa jong atehsetai,” ati.
English: He said, “What then is to be done for her?” Gehazi answered, “Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.”

tcz: “Ganung kou kit’in” ati. Numeinu chu ahung kinungle in kotphunga adingin ahi.
en: He said, “Call her.” When he had called her, she stood in the door.
text:
2KI 4:15
Thadou: “Ganung kou kit’in” ati. Numeinu chu ahung kinungle in kotphunga adingin ahi.
English: He said, “Call her.” When he had called her, she stood in the door.

tcz: “Khovei tuphat leh nangin na anga chapa khat nakipom ding ahi,” atipeh e. Amanun “Ahipoi kapu Pathen mipa nei joulhep hih in chuleh nei kimohnepsah hih in,” ati.
en: He said, “At this season next year, you will embrace a son.” She said, “No, my lord, you man of God, do not lie to your servant.”
text:
2KI 4:16
Thadou: “Khovei tuphat leh nangin na anga chapa khat nakipom ding ahi,” atipeh e. Amanun “Ahipoi kapu Pathen mipa nei joulhep hih in chuleh nei kimohnepsah hih in,” ati.
English: He said, “At this season next year, you will embrace a son.” She said, “No, my lord, you man of God, do not lie to your servant.”

tcz: Ahinlah hiche numeinu chun nao ahin voptan ahi. Hiti chun akum kit in Elisha seibang bang chun cha pasal khat aneitan ahi.
en: The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.
text:
2KI 4:17
Thadou: Ahinlah hiche numeinu chun nao ahin voptan ahi. Hiti chun akum kit in Elisha seibang bang chun cha pasal khat aneitan ahi.
English: The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.

tcz: Hiche chapang chu ahung len jeptan ahileh anule apa chang-at na a chun akithopi ding in agachen ahi.
en: When the child was grown, one day he went out to his father to the reapers.
text:
2KI 4:18
Thadou: Hiche chapang chu ahung len jeptan ahileh anule apa chang-at na a chun akithopi ding in agachen ahi.
English: When the child was grown, one day he went out to his father to the reapers.

tcz: Tohphung in ahung peng jah jingin, “Kaluchang anai Kaluchang anai,” ahin tin ahi. Apa chun asohte khat kom’a, “Inlang’a anu kom’a po tauvin,” ati.
en: He said to his father, “My head! My head!” He said to his servant, “Carry him to his mother.”
text:
2KI 4:19
Thadou: Tohphung in ahung peng jah jingin, “Kaluchang anai Kaluchang anai,” ahin tin ahi. Apa chun asohte khat kom’a, “Inlang’a anu kom’a po tauvin,” ati.
English: He said to his father, “My head! My head!” He said to his servant, “Carry him to his mother.”

tcz: Hichun asohpan jong in'ah apolut’in ahileh anunjong aphei chung’ah apom’in ahi. Ahinla sun ahunghi phat’in athitan ahi.
en: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.
text:
2KI 4:20
Thadou: Hichun asohpan jong in'ah apolut’in ahileh anunjong aphei chung’ah apom’in ahi. Ahinla sun ahunghi phat’in athitan ahi.
English: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.

tcz: Amanun apo touvin Pathen mipa lupna chunga chun alup sah in kot akhah in, ahin dalhatan ahi.
en: She went up and laid him on the man of God’s bed, and shut the door on him, and went out.
text:
2KI 4:21
Thadou: Amanun apo touvin Pathen mipa lupna chunga chun alup sah in kot akhah in, ahin dalhatan ahi.
English: She went up and laid him on the man of God’s bed, and shut the door on him, and went out.

tcz: Aman ajipa kom’ah thu athotnin, “Isohte hou khat pen penchu sangan khat toh hinsol’in hitia chu keima Pathen mipa kom’a chu kaga chea ka hung kilekit loina dingin” atin ahi.
en: She called to her husband and said, “Please send me one of the servants, and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the man of God and come again.”
text:
2KI 4:22
Thadou: Aman ajipa kom’ah thu athotnin, “Isohte hou khat pen penchu sangan khat toh hinsol’in hitia chu keima Pathen mipa kom’a chu kaga chea ka hung kilekit loina dingin” atin ahi.
English: She called to her husband and said, “Please send me one of the servants, and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the man of God and come again.”

tcz: Amapan, “Tuni tah’a hi ipi che ngaija ham? Tunihi lhathah nikho golvahla ahipon, chuleh cholngah nilah ahipon,” ati. Ahinla amanun, “Akhohpoi, phanan te” atin ahi.
en: He said, “Why would you want to go to him today? It is not a new moon or a Sabbath.” She said, “It’s all right.”
text:
2KI 4:23
Thadou: Amapan, “Tuni tah’a hi ipi che ngaija ham? Tunihi lhathah nikho golvahla ahipon, chuleh cholngah nilah ahipon,” ati. Ahinla amanun, “Akhohpoi, phanan te” atin ahi.
English: He said, “Why would you want to go to him today? It is not a new moon or a Sabbath.” She said, “It’s all right.”

tcz: Amanun jong sangan chungah chun apho akoidoh in, asohpa kom’a hitin seijin, “Ken thu kapeh ngallou leh gangin noloijin” ati.
en: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, “Drive, and go forward! Don’t slow down for me, unless I ask you to.”
text:
2KI 4:24
Thadou: Amanun jong sangan chungah chun apho akoidoh in, asohpa kom’a hitin seijin, “Ken thu kapeh ngallou leh gangin noloijin” ati.
English: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, “Drive, and go forward! Don’t slow down for me, unless I ask you to.”

tcz: Amanun Carmel molla um Pathen mipa chu aphah konin Elisha chun galla konin amanu chu ahin mun Gehazi kom’a chun, “Ven, Shunem ma konin numeinu ahung e,
en: So she went, and came to the man of God to Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her afar off, he said to Gehazi his servant, “Behold, there is the Shunammite.
text:
2KI 4:25
Thadou: Amanun Carmel molla um Pathen mipa chu aphah konin Elisha chun galla konin amanu chu ahin mun Gehazi kom’a chun, “Ven, Shunem ma konin numeinu ahung e,
English: So she went, and came to the man of God to Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her afar off, he said to Gehazi his servant, “Behold, there is the Shunammite.

tcz: lhaijal inlang gadongin,” “Naji na cha pha pha hinam?” tin gadongin ati. Amanun Gehazi kom’ah, “Aphanai imajouse aphanai.”
en: Please run now to meet her, and ask her, ‘Is it well with you? Is it well with your husband? Is it well with your child?’” She answered, “It is well.”
text:
2KI 4:26
Thadou: lhaijal inlang gadongin,” “Naji na cha pha pha hinam?” tin gadongin ati. Amanun Gehazi kom’ah, “Aphanai imajouse aphanai.”
English: Please run now to meet her, and ask her, ‘Is it well with you? Is it well with your husband? Is it well with your child?’” She answered, “It is well.”

tcz: Ahinlah amanu molchunga Pathen mipa kom ahung lhun phat’in amu masanga tolla abohkhup akeng chu atuhtan ahi. Gehazi chun amanu chu kaidoh agotleh Pathen mipan, “Suloh hih in, amanu hi lunggim ma ahin, Pakaiyin keima ima eiseipeh hih laiye,” ati.
en: When she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the man of God said, “Leave her alone, for her soul is troubled within her; and the LORD has hidden it from me, and has not told me.”
text:
2KI 4:27
Thadou: Ahinlah amanu molchunga Pathen mipa kom ahung lhun phat’in amu masanga tolla abohkhup akeng chu atuhtan ahi. Gehazi chun amanu chu kaidoh agotleh Pathen mipan, “Suloh hih in, amanu hi lunggim ma ahin, Pakaiyin keima ima eiseipeh hih laiye,” ati.
English: When she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the man of God said, “Leave her alone, for her soul is troubled within her; and the LORD has hidden it from me, and has not told me.”

tcz: Hichun amanun aseijin, “Hepu, nakom’a chapa dia kathum khah em?” Ken kasei louham, “Neidoha bol hihin chuleh neikimoh nepsah hihin kati hilouham?” ati.
en: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me’?”
text:
2KI 4:28
Thadou: Hichun amanun aseijin, “Hepu, nakom’a chapa dia kathum khah em?” Ken kasei louham, “Neidoha bol hihin chuleh neikimoh nepsah hihin kati hilouham?” ati.
English: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me’?”

tcz: Chuin Elisha chun Gehazi kom’ah, “Gangtahin kigon lang kamol hi choi jinlang che loijin, lampia koimacha kom’a houlimpa hih in, cheloi jinlang chapangpa mai’ah chun kamol hi gakoi loijin,” ati.
en: Then he said to Gehazi, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand, and go your way. If you meet any man, don’t greet him; and if anyone greets you, don’t answer him again. Then lay my staff on the child’s face.”
text:
2KI 4:29
Thadou: Chuin Elisha chun Gehazi kom’ah, “Gangtahin kigon lang kamol hi choi jinlang che loijin, lampia koimacha kom’a houlimpa hih in, cheloi jinlang chapangpa mai’ah chun kamol hi gakoi loijin,” ati.
English: Then he said to Gehazi, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand, and go your way. If you meet any man, don’t greet him; and if anyone greets you, don’t answer him again. Then lay my staff on the child’s face.”

tcz: Ahin chapangpa nu chun aseijin, “Hingjing Pakai leh nangma hinlaisen nangto ikilhon louding leh keima kainna cheponge,” ati. Hichun Elijah toh ahung kilhon lhon tan ahi.
en: The child’s mother said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So he arose, and followed her.
text:
2KI 4:30
Thadou: Ahin chapangpa nu chun aseijin, “Hingjing Pakai leh nangma hinlaisen nangto ikilhon louding leh keima kainna cheponge,” ati. Hichun Elijah toh ahung kilhon lhon tan ahi.
English: The child’s mother said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So he arose, and followed her.

tcz: Gehazi chu gangtahin ana che masan mol chu chapangpa chunga chun aga koiyin ahileh ima atipon ahi. Ahindoh dehloujeh chun Elisha kom’ah ahung kitan, “Chapang chu ahingdoh dehpoi,” ahung ti in ahi.
en: Gehazi went ahead of them, and laid the staff on the child’s face; but there was no voice and no hearing. Therefore he returned to meet him, and told him, “The child has not awakened.”
text:
2KI 4:31
Thadou: Gehazi chu gangtahin ana che masan mol chu chapangpa chunga chun aga koiyin ahileh ima atipon ahi. Ahindoh dehloujeh chun Elisha kom’ah ahung kitan, “Chapang chu ahingdoh dehpoi,” ahung ti in ahi.
English: Gehazi went ahead of them, and laid the staff on the child’s face; but there was no voice and no hearing. Therefore he returned to meet him, and told him, “The child has not awakened.”

tcz: Elisha chu ahung lhun phat’in chapang chu athisa in, themgaopa lupna a chun akijam nalaijin ahi.
en: When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.
text:
2KI 4:32
Thadou: Elisha chu ahung lhun phat’in chapang chu athisa in, themgaopa lupna a chun akijam nalaijin ahi.
English: When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.

tcz: Ama alutnin achangin kot akikha khum’in Pakai kom’ah atauvin ahi.
en: He went in therefore, and shut the door on them both, and prayed to the LORD.
text:
2KI 4:33
Thadou: Ama alutnin achangin kot akikha khum’in Pakai kom’ah atauvin ahi.
English: He went in therefore, and shut the door on them both, and prayed to the LORD.

tcz: Hichun chapangpa chunga chun akijam in, amuhleh chapangpa muh asuto in, amitleh amit asuto in, akhut chu chapangpa khut chunga chun akoiyin ahi. Hiti chun chapangpa chunga chun akijam in ahileh chapangpa tahsa chu ahung lumdohtan ahi.
en: He went up and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. He stretched himself on him; and the child’s flesh grew warm.
text:
2KI 4:34
Thadou: Hichun chapangpa chunga chun akijam in, amuhleh chapangpa muh asuto in, amitleh amit asuto in, akhut chu chapangpa khut chunga chun akoiyin ahi. Hiti chun chapangpa chunga chun akijam in ahileh chapangpa tahsa chu ahung lumdohtan ahi.
English: He went up and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. He stretched himself on him; and the child’s flesh grew warm.

tcz: Hichephat chun, Elisha chu akithoudoh in indansung’a chun anungchen, hijouchun chapang chunga chun alum kit’in, hichephat chun chapangpa chu sagi vei ahung chi in, chuin amit ahung hahtan ahi.
en: Then he returned, and walked in the house once back and forth, then went up and stretched himself out on him. Then the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
text:
2KI 4:35
Thadou: Hichephat chun, Elisha chu akithoudoh in indansung’a chun anungchen, hijouchun chapang chunga chun alum kit’in, hichephat chun chapangpa chu sagi vei ahung chi in, chuin amit ahung hahtan ahi.
English: Then he returned, and walked in the house once back and forth, then went up and stretched himself out on him. Then the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

tcz: Hijouchun Elisha’n Gehazi chu akouvin, “Chapangpa nuchu gakouvin” ati. Amanu ahung lutphat’in, nachapa hikom’a aum’e kilahtan ati.
en: He called Gehazi, and said, “Call this Shunammite!” So he called her. When she had come in to him, he said, “Take up your son.”
text:
2KI 4:36
Thadou: Hijouchun Elisha’n Gehazi chu akouvin, “Chapangpa nuchu gakouvin” ati. Amanu ahung lutphat’in, nachapa hikom’a aum’e kilahtan ati.
English: He called Gehazi, and said, “Call this Shunammite!” So he called her. When she had come in to him, he said, “Take up your son.”

tcz: Amanu chu akipahbehseh jingin akengkhopi muh atuh in chibai aboh jengtan ahi. Hijehchun anaochu a-anga akipom’in akum sohtan ahi.
en: Then she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and went out.
text:
2KI 4:37
Thadou: Amanu chu akipahbehseh jingin akengkhopi muh atuh in chibai aboh jengtan ahi. Hijehchun anaochu a-anga akipom’in akum sohtan ahi.
English: Then she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and went out.

tcz: Elisha chu Gilgal langa ahung kile in ahileh gamsunga chun kel analhaan ahi. Nikhat hi themgao phabep amasanga ana touvun ahileh amajong asohpa Gehazi kom’ah aseijin, “Meichunga chun bel lentah khat songin lang anchim lhah in ibonchava ineh diuvin hin hon in,” ati.
en: Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, “Get the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.”
text:
2KI 4:38
Thadou: Elisha chu Gilgal langa ahung kile in ahileh gamsunga chun kel analhaan ahi. Nikhat hi themgao phabep amasanga ana touvun ahileh amajong asohpa Gehazi kom’ah aseijin, “Meichunga chun bel lentah khat songin lang anchim lhah in ibonchava ineh diuvin hin hon in,” ati.
English: Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, “Get the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.”

tcz: Gollhang ho lah’a khatpen chu apotdoh in gamlah’a hampa hollin ache in ahileh, gam umpong dimset in ahinpon ahung kiletan ahi. Aman ahal hallin atham lhan, nehthei lou thina thei ahilam helouvin belsunga chun alhah tan ahi.
en: One went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered a lap full of wild gourds from it, and came and cut them up into the pot of stew; for they didn’t recognize them.
text:
2KI 4:39
Thadou: Gollhang ho lah’a khatpen chu apotdoh in gamlah’a hampa hollin ache in ahileh, gam umpong dimset in ahinpon ahung kiletan ahi. Aman ahal hallin atham lhan, nehthei lou thina thei ahilam helouvin belsunga chun alhah tan ahi.
English: One went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered a lap full of wild gourds from it, and came and cut them up into the pot of stew; for they didn’t recognize them.

tcz: Anchim themkhat chu ahin hom’un khatvei nivei agah tepm un ahileh ahung peng jah jengun Pathen mipa anchim mahin thina thei gu aume atiuvin anethei tapouvin ahi.
en: So they poured out for the men to eat. As they were eating some of the stew, they cried out and said, “Man of God, there is death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.
text:
2KI 4:40
Thadou: Anchim themkhat chu ahin hom’un khatvei nivei agah tepm un ahileh ahung peng jah jengun Pathen mipa anchim mahin thina thei gu aume atiuvin anethei tapouvin ahi.
English: So they poured out for the men to eat. As they were eating some of the stew, they cried out and said, “Man of God, there is death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.

tcz: Hichun Elisha’n jong “Changbong thamkhat hinchoijun,” ati. Ahin choi phat’un aman belsunga chun agah lhah in, “Tun aphatai, netauvin,” ati. Hichun imacha aphamo aumtapon ahi.
en: But he said, “Then bring meal.” He threw it into the pot; and he said, “Serve it to the people, that they may eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.
text:
2KI 4:41
Thadou: Hichun Elisha’n jong “Changbong thamkhat hinchoijun,” ati. Ahin choi phat’un aman belsunga chun agah lhah in, “Tun aphatai, netauvin,” ati. Hichun imacha aphamo aumtapon ahi.
English: But he said, “Then bring meal.” He threw it into the pot; and he said, “Serve it to the people, that they may eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.

tcz: Nikhat hi Baal-shalishah a konin mikhat ahungin Pathen mipa chu chang-hum bora khatleh changlhah pheng somni ahin poh pehin ahi. Elisha’n, “Mipi hochu peuvin nenao vinte,” ati.
en: A man from Baal Shalishah came, and brought the man of God some bread of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack. Elisha said, “Give to the people, that they may eat.”
text:
2KI 4:42
Thadou: Nikhat hi Baal-shalishah a konin mikhat ahungin Pathen mipa chu chang-hum bora khatleh changlhah pheng somni ahin poh pehin ahi. Elisha’n, “Mipi hochu peuvin nenao vinte,” ati.
English: A man from Baal Shalishah came, and brought the man of God some bread of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack. Elisha said, “Give to the people, that they may eat.”

tcz: Asohpan jong an ahinsem in, hicheng seh’a hi mihem jakhat jen iti kivah dingham atin ahileh Elisha’n ahin donbut’in mipihon aneh diuvin pedoh’un, ajeh chu Pakaiyin aseije, “Mijousen neuvintin phabep val nalai ding ahi,” ati.
en: His servant said, “What, should I set this before a hundred men?” But he said, “Give it to the people, that they may eat; for the LORD says, ‘They will eat, and will have some left over.’”
text:
2KI 4:43
Thadou: Asohpan jong an ahinsem in, hicheng seh’a hi mihem jakhat jen iti kivah dingham atin ahileh Elisha’n ahin donbut’in mipihon aneh diuvin pedoh’un, ajeh chu Pakaiyin aseije, “Mijousen neuvintin phabep val nalai ding ahi,” ati.
English: His servant said, “What, should I set this before a hundred men?” But he said, “Give it to the people, that they may eat; for the LORD says, ‘They will eat, and will have some left over.’”

tcz: Hiti chun mipi hochu apeuvin ahileh mijouse dingchun a lhingsetnin Pakai thusei dungjui jin phabep jong ane val nalaijun ahi.
en: So he set it before them and they ate and had some left over, according to the LORD’s word.
text:
2KI 4:44
Thadou: Hiti chun mipi hochu apeuvin ahileh mijouse dingchun a lhingsetnin Pakai thusei dungjui jin phabep jong ane val nalaijun ahi.
English: So he set it before them and they ate and had some left over, according to the LORD’s word.
