tcz: Syria lengpa hin asepai lamkaipa Naaman hi ajabol lheh jingin ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin amahi amang chan galjona thupi tahtah ana pejin ahi. Ahinla Naaman hi mihang galsatje themtah ana hivang in amahi miphah anahin ahi.
en: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him the LORD had given victory to Syria; he was also a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.
text:
2KI 5:1
Thadou: Syria lengpa hin asepai lamkaipa Naaman hi ajabol lheh jingin ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin amahi amang chan galjona thupi tahtah ana pejin ahi. Ahinla Naaman hi mihang galsatje themtah ana hivang in amahi miphah anahin ahi.
English: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him the LORD had given victory to Syria; he was also a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.

tcz: Amahin agalsatna a Israel gamhi ana delkhum’in galhing tamtah ahin mat lah ahin nungah chapang khat ana pang khan ahileh ajinnu jen ding in anapansah in ahi.
en: The Syrians had gone out in bands, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little girl, and she waited on Naaman’s wife.
text:
2KI 5:2
Thadou: Amahin agalsatna a Israel gamhi ana delkhum’in galhing tamtah ahin mat lah ahin nungah chapang khat ana pang khan ahileh ajinnu jen ding in anapansah in ahi.
English: The Syrians had gone out in bands, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little girl, and she waited on Naaman’s wife.

tcz: Nikhat hi hiche nungahnu hin apinu kom’a, “Kapupahi Samaria um themgaopa khu gaki mupi leh aman aphah hi aboldampeh tei ding ahi,” ati.
en: She said to her mistress, “I wish that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria! Then he would heal him of his leprosy.”
text:
2KI 5:3
Thadou: Nikhat hi hiche nungahnu hin apinu kom’a, “Kapupahi Samaria um themgaopa khu gaki mupi leh aman aphah hi aboldampeh tei ding ahi,” ati.
English: She said to her mistress, “I wish that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria! Then he would heal him of his leprosy.”

tcz: Hiche Israel a kona nungah chapangnu thusei chu Naaman hin lengpa kom’ah aga lhut tan ahi.
en: Someone went in and told his lord, saying, “The girl who is from the land of Israel said this.”
text:
2KI 5:4
Thadou: Hiche Israel a kona nungah chapangnu thusei chu Naaman hin lengpa kom’ah aga lhut tan ahi.
English: Someone went in and told his lord, saying, “The girl who is from the land of Israel said this.”

tcz: Syria lengpan, “Chenlang themgaopa chu ga kimupitan kenjong Israel lengpa kom’ah nang chung chang ngah lekha thot nange,” ati. Hichun Naaman akipatdohin kipa thilpeh dingin dangka pound jasagi le som nga, sana pound jakhat le som nga chuleh pon hoitah tah jatsom akipoh in ahi.
en: The king of Syria said, “Go now, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel.” He departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of clothing.
text:
2KI 5:5
Thadou: Syria lengpan, “Chenlang themgaopa chu ga kimupitan kenjong Israel lengpa kom’ah nang chung chang ngah lekha thot nange,” ati. Hichun Naaman akipatdohin kipa thilpeh dingin dangka pound jasagi le som nga, sana pound jakhat le som nga chuleh pon hoitah tah jatsom akipoh in ahi.
English: The king of Syria said, “Go now, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel.” He departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of clothing.

tcz: Israel lengpa dinga alekhajih chun hitin aseijin ahi, “Hiche lekhapum hin kalhachapa Naaman hi kahinsolle ahitheileh aphahna hi hinboldam peh in,” ati.
en: He brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, “Now when this letter has come to you, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to you, that you may heal him of his leprosy.”
text:
2KI 5:6
Thadou: Israel lengpa dinga alekhajih chun hitin aseijin ahi, “Hiche lekhapum hin kalhachapa Naaman hi kahinsolle ahitheileh aphahna hi hinboldam peh in,” ati.
English: He brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, “Now when this letter has come to you, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to you, that you may heal him of his leprosy.”

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Israel lengpan asimdoh phat chun avon abottel jingin, hitin aseitan ahi, “Hichepa hin kakom’a miphah khat boldam dinga ahinsol hi kei Pathen kahi beh a, ken mihem kahinsah a kathisah theibeh ding ham? Amahin kisat pidinga eichouna ahibouve,” ati tai.
en: When the king of Israel had read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, “Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man sends to me to heal a man of his leprosy? But please consider and see how he seeks a quarrel against me.”
text:
2KI 5:7
Thadou: Hiche lekhathot hi Israel lengpan asimdoh phat chun avon abottel jingin, hitin aseitan ahi, “Hichepa hin kakom’a miphah khat boldam dinga ahinsol hi kei Pathen kahi beh a, ken mihem kahinsah a kathisah theibeh ding ham? Amahin kisat pidinga eichouna ahibouve,” ati tai.
English: When the king of Israel had read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, “Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man sends to me to heal a man of his leprosy? But please consider and see how he seeks a quarrel against me.”

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen mipa Elisha chun Israel lengpan avon abotse jinge ti ajah phat chun hitin thu athot tan ahi, “Ibola lung hang’a nahim? Hiche Naaman chu keikom’ah hinsoltan chutileh aman Israelte lah ahin themgao dihtah chu aume ti henante,” ati.
en: It was so, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, “Why have you torn your clothes? Let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.”
text:
2KI 5:8
Thadou: Ahinlah Pathen mipa Elisha chun Israel lengpan avon abotse jinge ti ajah phat chun hitin thu athot tan ahi, “Ibola lung hang’a nahim? Hiche Naaman chu keikom’ah hinsoltan chutileh aman Israelte lah ahin themgao dihtah chu aume ti henante,” ati.
English: It was so, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, “Why have you torn your clothes? Let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.”

tcz: Hichun Naaman chu asakol tetoh akangtalai toh Elisha kotbullah angahtauve.
en: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
text:
2KI 5:9
Thadou: Hichun Naaman chu asakol tetoh akangtalai toh Elisha kotbullah angahtauve.
English: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

tcz: Ahinlah Elisha’n amakom’a chun thu agah thot’in, “Chenlang Jordan vadunga khun sagi vei gaki delut lechun navunchu hung kiledohin tin chuleh naphahna jong damdoh tan nate,” atin ahi.
en: Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, “Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you, and you shall be clean.”
text:
2KI 5:10
Thadou: Ahinlah Elisha’n amakom’a chun thu agah thot’in, “Chenlang Jordan vadunga khun sagi vei gaki delut lechun navunchu hung kiledohin tin chuleh naphahna jong damdoh tan nate,” atin ahi.
English: Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, “Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you, and you shall be clean.”

tcz: Ahinlah Naaman chu alunghang in, akihai mangin hitin aseije, “Keima geldannin ama hung potdoh intin, eiki mupin tin, kaphahna chungah hin akhut hin peilen tin, Pakai a Pathen min hinpan intin eidamsah ding ham kati ahi,” ati.
en: But Naaman was angry, and went away and said, “Behold, I thought, ‘He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and wave his hand over the place, and heal the leper.’
text:
2KI 5:11
Thadou: Ahinlah Naaman chu alunghang in, akihai mangin hitin aseije, “Keima geldannin ama hung potdoh intin, eiki mupin tin, kaphahna chungah hin akhut hin peilen tin, Pakai a Pathen min hinpan intin eidamsah ding ham kati ahi,” ati.
English: But Naaman was angry, and went away and said, “Behold, I thought, ‘He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and wave his hand over the place, and heal the leper.’

tcz: Hiche Israel te vadung ho jouse sanga hi Damascus ahung longlut Abana le Pharpar vadung teni hi phajo lou ding ong? Hichea chu kaki delut leh kadamjing louding ong?” atin Naaman chu akihei mangin lunghang tah’in achemang jengtan ahi.
en: Aren’t Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them and be clean?” So he turned and went away in a rage.
text:
2KI 5:12
Thadou: Hiche Israel te vadung ho jouse sanga hi Damascus ahung longlut Abana le Pharpar vadung teni hi phajo lou ding ong? Hichea chu kaki delut leh kadamjing louding ong?” atin Naaman chu akihei mangin lunghang tah’in achemang jengtan ahi.
English: Aren’t Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them and be clean?” So he turned and went away in a rage.

tcz: Ahinlah anoija asepaite hochun hetthem sah tei agouvin hitin aseijun, “Hepu themgaopa hin, thil hahsa khat tong dinga nasol leh ibola nabolda dingham? Aman chenlang gakidelut in chutileh nadamding ahi atichu naboljing leh iti ham! atiuvin ahi.
en: His servants came near and spoke to him, and said, “My father, if the prophet had asked you do some great thing, wouldn’t you have done it? How much rather then, when he says to you, ‘Wash, and be clean’?”
text:
2KI 5:13
Thadou: Ahinlah anoija asepaite hochun hetthem sah tei agouvin hitin aseijun, “Hepu themgaopa hin, thil hahsa khat tong dinga nasol leh ibola nabolda dingham? Aman chenlang gakidelut in chutileh nadamding ahi atichu naboljing leh iti ham! atiuvin ahi.
English: His servants came near and spoke to him, and said, “My father, if the prophet had asked you do some great thing, wouldn’t you have done it? How much rather then, when he says to you, ‘Wash, and be clean’?”

tcz: Hichun Naaman chu Jordan vadunga agachesuh in themgaopan aseipeh bang bang chun sagi vei aga kidelut in ahileh ahung damdoh in avou jong chapang voutoh abang jing tan ahi.
en: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
text:
2KI 5:14
Thadou: Hichun Naaman chu Jordan vadunga agachesuh in themgaopan aseipeh bang bang chun sagi vei aga kidelut in ahileh ahung damdoh in avou jong chapang voutoh abang jing tan ahi.
English: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

tcz: Hijou chun Naaman le aloi hocheng chu Pathen mipa kom’a dingin ahungkile tauvin ahi. Amaho ama sanga adingun Naaman in hitin aseije, “Israel gamtilou vannoi leiset gamdanga hin Pathen aumpoi ti kahe chentai, hijeh chun nasohpa a konin kipa thilpeh hi nei sanpehtan,” ati.
en: He returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him; and he said, “See now, I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel. Now therefore, please take a gift from your servant.”
text:
2KI 5:15
Thadou: Hijou chun Naaman le aloi hocheng chu Pathen mipa kom’a dingin ahungkile tauvin ahi. Amaho ama sanga adingun Naaman in hitin aseije, “Israel gamtilou vannoi leiset gamdanga hin Pathen aumpoi ti kahe chentai, hijeh chun nasohpa a konin kipa thilpeh hi nei sanpehtan,” ati.
English: He returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him; and he said, “See now, I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel. Now therefore, please take a gift from your servant.”

tcz: Ahin Elisha’n adonbut in, “Keiman kahoujing Pakai minna kasei ahi, keiman thilpeh imacha kilah ponge,” ati. Naaman in kilahsahtei agot vang'in Elisha anom pon ahi.
en: But he said, “As the LORD lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none.” He urged him to take it; but he refused.
text:
2KI 5:16
Thadou: Ahin Elisha’n adonbut in, “Keiman kahoujing Pakai minna kasei ahi, keiman thilpeh imacha kilah ponge,” ati. Naaman in kilahsahtei agot vang'in Elisha anom pon ahi.
English: But he said, “As the LORD lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none.” He urged him to take it; but he refused.

tcz: Hichun Naamanin, “Aphai ahileh sakol pot-ni poh khopset hiche leiset hi ka inlanga kipoh ingting tuapat’in Pakai kom tilouvin semthu Pathen dang kom’ah kilhaina gantha bol taponge,” ati.
en: Naaman said, “If not, then, please let two mules’ load of earth be given to your servant; for your servant will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods, but to the LORD.
text:
2KI 5:17
Thadou: Hichun Naamanin, “Aphai ahileh sakol pot-ni poh khopset hiche leiset hi ka inlanga kipoh ingting tuapat’in Pakai kom tilouvin semthu Pathen dang kom’ah kilhaina gantha bol taponge,” ati.
English: Naaman said, “If not, then, please let two mules’ load of earth be given to your servant; for your servant will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods, but to the LORD.

tcz: “Ahinla hiche thilkhat chunga vang hin Pakaiyin eingaidam hen. Hiche kapu lengpa hi Rimmon munna, milimdoi houva ache tengleh keima banjanga kingaiji ahin het banga keimajing jong kabokhup teng Pakaiyin nasohpa hi hiche thudolla hin eingaidam hen,” ati.
en: In this thing may the LORD pardon your servant: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon. When I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, may the LORD pardon your servant in this thing.”
text:
2KI 5:18
Thadou: “Ahinla hiche thilkhat chunga vang hin Pakaiyin eingaidam hen. Hiche kapu lengpa hi Rimmon munna, milimdoi houva ache tengleh keima banjanga kingaiji ahin het banga keimajing jong kabokhup teng Pakaiyin nasohpa hi hiche thudolla hin eingaidam hen,” ati.
English: In this thing may the LORD pardon your servant: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon. When I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, may the LORD pardon your servant in this thing.”

tcz: Hichun Elisha’n ajah a “Lungmongin chetan” atin, Naaman in jong ainlang ajontai.
en: He said to him, “Go in peace.” So he departed from him a little way.
text:
2KI 5:19
Thadou: Hichun Elisha’n ajah a “Lungmongin chetan” atin, Naaman in jong ainlang ajontai.
English: He said to him, “Go in peace.” So he departed from him a little way.

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen mipa Elisha sohpa Gehazi hi amale ama akihouvin, “Kapupan Syria mipa thilpeh khatcha lalouva asoldoh jing hi adihpoi, hingjing Pathen minna kasei ahi keiman del in kating themkhat beh kalah ding ahi,” ati.
en: But Gehazi the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, “Behold, my master has spared this Naaman the Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought. As the LORD lives, I will run after him, and take something from him.”
text:
2KI 5:20
Thadou: Ahinlah Pathen mipa Elisha sohpa Gehazi hi amale ama akihouvin, “Kapupan Syria mipa thilpeh khatcha lalouva asoldoh jing hi adihpoi, hingjing Pathen minna kasei ahi keiman del in kating themkhat beh kalah ding ahi,” ati.
English: But Gehazi the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, “Behold, my master has spared this Naaman the Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought. As the LORD lives, I will run after him, and take something from him.”

tcz: Hiti chun Gehazi hin Naaman anung deltan ahi. Naaman in Gehazi in ahin nungdel chu amu phat in, asakol kangtalaija konchun ahung kumlhan, “Imajouse pha pha a hinam?” atileh,
en: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. When Naaman saw one running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him, and said, “Is all well?”
text:
2KI 5:21
Thadou: Hiti chun Gehazi hin Naaman anung deltan ahi. Naaman in Gehazi in ahin nungdel chu amu phat in, asakol kangtalaija konchun ahung kumlhan, “Imajouse pha pha a hinam?” atileh,
English: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. When Naaman saw one running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him, and said, “Is all well?”

tcz: Gehazi in “Aphanai, Ephraim gam’ah konin themgao gollhang ni tutah chun ahung lhonnin ahileh kapupan nakom’a eihinsol ahi. Aman dangka pound som sagi le nga leh pon hoi jatni hi amani peh dingin angaichan hijeh a chu eihinsol ahi,” ati.
en: He said, “All is well. My master has sent me, saying, ‘Behold, even now two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing.’”
text:
2KI 5:22
Thadou: Gehazi in “Aphanai, Ephraim gam’ah konin themgao gollhang ni tutah chun ahung lhonnin ahileh kapupan nakom’a eihinsol ahi. Aman dangka pound som sagi le nga leh pon hoi jatni hi amani peh dingin angaichan hijeh a chu eihinsol ahi,” ati.
English: He said, “All is well. My master has sent me, saying, ‘Behold, even now two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing.’”

tcz: Naaman in jong, “Dangka nasei jatni chu kilah in” atin, ponhoi jong jatni apen sumchu sakhaoni in achun in asohte mini achoisah in ahi.
en: Naaman said, “Be pleased to take two talents.” He urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing, and laid them on two of his servants; and they carried them before him.
text:
2KI 5:23
Thadou: Naaman in jong, “Dangka nasei jatni chu kilah in” atin, ponhoi jong jatni apen sumchu sakhaoni in achun in asohte mini achoisah in ahi.
English: Naaman said, “Be pleased to take two talents.” He urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing, and laid them on two of his servants; and they carried them before him.

tcz: Khopi chu alhun phat’un Gehazin soh tenia kon chun thilchu alaan amani alesoltan ahi. Hijouchun amachan thil ho chu insunga asel tan ahi.
en: When he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and stored them in the house. Then he let the men go, and they departed.
text:
2KI 5:24
Thadou: Khopi chu alhun phat’un Gehazin soh tenia kon chun thilchu alaan amani alesoltan ahi. Hijouchun amachan thil ho chu insunga asel tan ahi.
English: When he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and stored them in the house. Then he let the men go, and they departed.

tcz: Ama a Pakaipa koma agalut chun Elisha’n, “Gehazi hoiya nacheham?” ati. Aman “Hoikoma kachepoi” ati.
en: But he went in, and stood before his master. Elisha said to him, “Where did you come from, Gehazi?” He said, “Your servant went nowhere.”
text:
2KI 5:25
Thadou: Ama a Pakaipa koma agalut chun Elisha’n, “Gehazi hoiya nacheham?” ati. Aman “Hoikoma kachepoi” ati.
English: But he went in, and stood before his master. Elisha said to him, “Where did you come from, Gehazi?” He said, “Your servant went nowhere.”

tcz: Ahinlah Elisha’n, “Naaman asakol kangtalaija kona ahung kumlhah a nakimuto lhonna chu keima lhagaova hiche kom’a chu kaum nahet louham? Hiche phat chu sumle pon kilah phat hija, Olive thingbohle lengpilei kilahphat hija, kelngoile bongchalte kisan phat, soh pasal le soh numei tampi kisanphat mong hi nam?” ati.
en: He said to him, “Didn’t my heart go with you when the man turned from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and olive groves and vineyards, and sheep and cattle, and male servants and female servants?
text:
2KI 5:26
Thadou: Ahinlah Elisha’n, “Naaman asakol kangtalaija kona ahung kumlhah a nakimuto lhonna chu keima lhagaova hiche kom’a chu kaum nahet louham? Hiche phat chu sumle pon kilah phat hija, Olive thingbohle lengpilei kilahphat hija, kelngoile bongchalte kisan phat, soh pasal le soh numei tampi kisanphat mong hi nam?” ati.
English: He said to him, “Didn’t my heart go with you when the man turned from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and olive groves and vineyards, and sheep and cattle, and male servants and female servants?

tcz: Hitobanga nachonjeh hin Naaman phahna hi nang le nason napah ho chunga atonsot geijin chuta hen ati. Gehazi chu indan sunga kona agah potdoh leh apum changin aphahin avunjong buhbang bangin abang let lutjing tan ahi.
en: Therefore the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and to your offspring forever.” He went out from his presence a leper, as white as snow.
text:
2KI 5:27
Thadou: Hitobanga nachonjeh hin Naaman phahna hi nang le nason napah ho chunga atonsot geijin chuta hen ati. Gehazi chu indan sunga kona agah potdoh leh apum changin aphahin avunjong buhbang bangin abang let lutjing tan ahi.
English: Therefore the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and to your offspring forever.” He went out from his presence a leper, as white as snow.

tcz: Nikhat hi themgao honkhat Elisha kom’a ahung nguvin hitin aseijuve, “Nangman nahet ma bang hin nangtoh ikimu to nao mun hi aneobehseh jenge.
en: The sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “See now, the place where we live and meet with you is too small for us.
text:
2KI 6:1
Thadou: Nikhat hi themgao honkhat Elisha kom’a ahung nguvin hitin aseijuve, “Nangman nahet ma bang hin nangtoh ikimu to nao mun hi aneobehseh jenge.
English: The sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “See now, the place where we live and meet with you is too small for us.

tcz: Jordan vadung langa chesuh uhitin thing gatan uhitin ikikhop khom nadiu munthah khat kisah dohu hite,” ahung tiuve. Hichun aman adonbut in, “Aphai, naseibangun bol hite,” ati.
en: Please let us go to the Jordan, and each man take a beam from there, and let’s make us a place there, where we may live.” He answered, “Go!”
text:
2KI 6:2
Thadou: Jordan vadung langa chesuh uhitin thing gatan uhitin ikikhop khom nadiu munthah khat kisah dohu hite,” ahung tiuve. Hichun aman adonbut in, “Aphai, naseibangun bol hite,” ati.
English: Please let us go to the Jordan, and each man take a beam from there, and let’s make us a place there, where we may live.” He answered, “Go!”

tcz: Amaho lah’a khat in atem’un, “Neihung kilhonpiuvin,” ati. Aman jong, “Hung nange,” atin ahi.
en: One said, “Please be pleased to go with your servants.” He answered, “I will go.”
text:
2KI 6:3
Thadou: Amaho lah’a khat in atem’un, “Neihung kilhonpiuvin,” ati. Aman jong, “Hung nange,” atin ahi.
English: One said, “Please be pleased to go with your servants.” He answered, “I will go.”

tcz: Hichun Elisha jong amaho chutoh akilhon tauvin ahi. Jordan aga lhun phat’un, amahon thing akitan tauvin ahi.
en: So he went with them. When they came to the Jordan, they cut down wood.
text:
2KI 6:4
Thadou: Hichun Elisha jong amaho chutoh akilhon tauvin ahi. Jordan aga lhun phat’un, amahon thing akitan tauvin ahi.
English: So he went with them. When they came to the Jordan, they cut down wood.

tcz: Ahin amaholah’a khat chun thing akitan pet’un aheichang chu vadunga alhahsah tan ahi. Ama jong ahung apeng jah jengin, “Vo hepu, hiche heicha chu mi’a bat ding’a kahin lah ahi,” ati.
en: But as one was cutting down a tree, the ax head fell into the water. Then he cried out and said, “Alas, my master! For it was borrowed.”
text:
2KI 6:5
Thadou: Ahin amaholah’a khat chun thing akitan pet’un aheichang chu vadunga alhahsah tan ahi. Ama jong ahung apeng jah jengin, “Vo hepu, hiche heicha chu mi’a bat ding’a kahin lah ahi,” ati.
English: But as one was cutting down a tree, the ax head fell into the water. Then he cried out and said, “Alas, my master! For it was borrowed.”

tcz: Pathen mipan ahin seijin, “Hoilai donna nalhah ham?” ati. Aman jong amun avetsah phat chun Elisha’n molkhat alan amun laitah’a chu agakholut’a ahileh heichang chu twichungah ahung kiletdohtan ahi.
en: The man of God asked, “Where did it fall?” He showed him the place. He cut down a stick, threw it in there, and made the iron float.
text:
2KI 6:6
Thadou: Pathen mipan ahin seijin, “Hoilai donna nalhah ham?” ati. Aman jong amun avetsah phat chun Elisha’n molkhat alan amun laitah’a chu agakholut’a ahileh heichang chu twichungah ahung kiletdohtan ahi.
English: The man of God asked, “Where did it fall?” He showed him the place. He cut down a stick, threw it in there, and made the iron float.

tcz: Hichun Elisha’n, “Kilah in,” ati, hichun mipan agahsangin akimat tan ahi.
en: He said, “Take it.” So he put out his hand and took it.
text:
2KI 6:7
Thadou: Hichun Elisha’n, “Kilah in,” ati, hichun mipan agahsangin akimat tan ahi.
English: He said, “Take it.” So he put out his hand and took it.

tcz: Syria lengpa chu Israelte toh akisatto laitah chun, aman asepai lamkaite toh akihoutoh un hitin asei uve, “Eihon isepaiteu chu hilai mun khat’a ngahmun kisem ute akitiuve.”
en: Now the king of Syria was at war against Israel; and he took counsel with his servants, saying, “My camp will be in such and such a place.”
text:
2KI 6:8
Thadou: Syria lengpa chu Israelte toh akisatto laitah chun, aman asepai lamkaite toh akihoutoh un hitin asei uve, “Eihon isepaiteu chu hilai mun khat’a ngahmun kisem ute akitiuve.”
English: Now the king of Syria was at war against Israel; and he took counsel with his servants, saying, “My camp will be in such and such a place.”

tcz: Ahinlah apettah chun Pathen mipa Elisha’n gangtah in Israel lengpa ana gah hilchah in, “Hichelai munna chun che hih un ajeh chu Syria ten asepaiteu chu hilai munna chu changpang a ana umdiu ahi,” atipeh tan ahi.
en: The man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, “Beware that you not pass this place, for the Syrians are coming down there.”
text:
2KI 6:9
Thadou: Ahinlah apettah chun Pathen mipa Elisha’n gangtah in Israel lengpa ana gah hilchah in, “Hichelai munna chun che hih un ajeh chu Syria ten asepaiteu chu hilai munna chu changpang a ana umdiu ahi,” atipeh tan ahi.
English: The man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, “Beware that you not pass this place, for the Syrians are coming down there.”

tcz: Hiti chun Israel lengpan Pathen mipan aseipehna mun mun’a chun asepaite asolji ahi. Kiging jing’a aum jing thei nading un, phatseh in Elisha’n Israel lengpa chu aseipeh jingin chule ana hilchah jing in ahi.
en: The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of; and he saved himself there, not once or twice.
text:
2KI 6:10
Thadou: Hiti chun Israel lengpan Pathen mipan aseipehna mun mun’a chun asepaite asolji ahi. Kiging jing’a aum jing thei nading un, phatseh in Elisha’n Israel lengpa chu aseipeh jingin chule ana hilchah jing in ahi.
English: The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of; and he saved himself there, not once or twice.

tcz: Syria lenpa chu hiche chungchang’a hin, alung ahang lheh jengtan, hijehchun aman anoija lamkai pipu hochu akoukhom’in hiti hin aseitan, “Koipen hi galmi langa pang naum uham? Koipen hin Israel lengpa hi kei tohgon ana seipeh jiuham?” ati.
en: The king of Syria’s heart was very troubled about this. He called his servants, and said to them, “Won’t you show me which of us is for the king of Israel?”
text:
2KI 6:11
Thadou: Syria lenpa chu hiche chungchang’a hin, alung ahang lheh jengtan, hijehchun aman anoija lamkai pipu hochu akoukhom’in hiti hin aseitan, “Koipen hi galmi langa pang naum uham? Koipen hin Israel lengpa hi kei tohgon ana seipeh jiuham?” ati.
English: The king of Syria’s heart was very troubled about this. He called his servants, and said to them, “Won’t you show me which of us is for the king of Israel?”

tcz: Hichun anoija lamkai pipuho khat’in ahin donbut’in, “Hepu lengpa keiho kahipouve, Israel te lah’a hin Elisha kiti themgao khat aumin, amahin lengpahi ijakai aseipehji ahi. Amahin nachanga najal khunna naumpetna na thusei jouse jong hi ahet ahi,” atipeh tan ahi.
en: One of his servants said, “No, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom.”
text:
2KI 6:12
Thadou: Hichun anoija lamkai pipuho khat’in ahin donbut’in, “Hepu lengpa keiho kahipouve, Israel te lah’a hin Elisha kiti themgao khat aumin, amahin lengpahi ijakai aseipehji ahi. Amahin nachanga najal khunna naumpetna na thusei jouse jong hi ahet ahi,” atipeh tan ahi.
English: One of his servants said, “No, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom.”

tcz: Hichun lengpan thu ahin pen, “Cheuvinlang amachu hoiya um’aham, gahe chen’unlang keiman ama manding chu kasepaite kasolding ahi,” ati. Hiti chun amahon jong agahetoh un, “Amahi Dothan na aume,” tin ahung seipeh tauvin ahi.
en: He said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him.” He was told, “Behold, he is in Dothan.”
text:
2KI 6:13
Thadou: Hichun lengpan thu ahin pen, “Cheuvinlang amachu hoiya um’aham, gahe chen’unlang keiman ama manding chu kasepaite kasolding ahi,” ati. Hiti chun amahon jong agahetoh un, “Amahi Dothan na aume,” tin ahung seipeh tauvin ahi.
English: He said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him.” He was told, “Behold, he is in Dothan.”

tcz: Hichun Syria lengpan hiche khopi sung umding’in sepai tamtah leh sakol kangtalai tamtah asoltan ahi.
en: Therefore he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. They came by night and surrounded the city.
text:
2KI 6:14
Thadou: Hichun Syria lengpan hiche khopi sung umding’in sepai tamtah leh sakol kangtalai tamtah asoltan ahi.
English: Therefore he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. They came by night and surrounded the city.

tcz: Pathen mipa sohpa chu jingpitah in ahung thouvin, pam lang agapotdoh leh sepai tamtah leh sakol kangtalai tamtah muntin’ah amutan ahileh, Elisha kom’a chun, “O hepu i-itiding hitam?” tin apeng jah jingin ahi.
en: When the servant of the man of God had risen early and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was around the city. His servant said to him, “Alas, my master! What shall we do?”
text:
2KI 6:15
Thadou: Pathen mipa sohpa chu jingpitah in ahung thouvin, pam lang agapotdoh leh sepai tamtah leh sakol kangtalai tamtah muntin’ah amutan ahileh, Elisha kom’a chun, “O hepu i-itiding hitam?” tin apeng jah jingin ahi.
English: When the servant of the man of God had risen early and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was around the city. His servant said to him, “Alas, my master! What shall we do?”

tcz: Elisha’n ama kom’ah, “Kicha hihin, amaho sangin eini panpiho atamjouve,” ati.
en: He answered, “Don’t be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
text:
2KI 6:16
Thadou: Elisha’n ama kom’ah, “Kicha hihin, amaho sangin eini panpiho atamjouve,” ati.
English: He answered, “Don’t be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”

tcz: Hijou chun Elisha jong atauvin, “O Pakai, amit hin hadohsah in lang, hin muchetsah tan,” tin atauvin ahileh, Pakaiyin gollhangpa mitchu ahadohsahtan ahileh Elisha vella molpang hochu sakolte le akangtalai ho meikongin atom anadimset in ahi.
en: Elisha prayed, and said, “LORD, please open his eyes, that he may see.” the LORD opened the young man’s eyes, and he saw; and behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha.
text:
2KI 6:17
Thadou: Hijou chun Elisha jong atauvin, “O Pakai, amit hin hadohsah in lang, hin muchetsah tan,” tin atauvin ahileh, Pakaiyin gollhangpa mitchu ahadohsahtan ahileh Elisha vella molpang hochu sakolte le akangtalai ho meikongin atom anadimset in ahi.
English: Elisha prayed, and said, “LORD, please open his eyes, that he may see.” the LORD opened the young man’s eyes, and he saw; and behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha.

tcz: Syria sepaite chu Elisha manding’a ahungsuh phat uchun, Elisha atauvin, “O Pakai amaho hi amit’u suhchot pehtan,” atin ahileh Elisha’n angeh bang bangin Pakaiyin amit’u asuhchot pehtan ahi.
en: When they came down to him, Elisha prayed to the LORD, and said, “Please strike this people with blindness.” He struck them with blindness according to Elisha’s word.
text:
2KI 6:18
Thadou: Syria sepaite chu Elisha manding’a ahungsuh phat uchun, Elisha atauvin, “O Pakai amaho hi amit’u suhchot pehtan,” atin ahileh Elisha’n angeh bang bangin Pakaiyin amit’u asuhchot pehtan ahi.
English: When they came down to him, Elisha prayed to the LORD, and said, “Please strike this people with blindness.” He struck them with blindness according to Elisha’s word.

tcz: Hichun Elisha apotdoh in amaho kom’a chun, “Nahung naohi adihtapoi hichehi nahollu khopi chu ahipoi, neihinjui jun, keiman nahol nao kom’a chun napuilut nao vinge” ati. Hiti chun amaho chu Samaria khopia chun apuilut tan ahi.
en: Elisha said to them, “This is not the way, neither is this the city. Follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek.” He led them to Samaria.
text:
2KI 6:19
Thadou: Hichun Elisha apotdoh in amaho kom’a chun, “Nahung naohi adihtapoi hichehi nahollu khopi chu ahipoi, neihinjui jun, keiman nahol nao kom’a chun napuilut nao vinge” ati. Hiti chun amaho chu Samaria khopia chun apuilut tan ahi.
English: Elisha said to them, “This is not the way, neither is this the city. Follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek.” He led them to Samaria.

tcz: Samaria khopi chu alhunphat’un, Elisha atauvin, “O Pakai tun amit’u hasah kit’in lang kho musah tan,” ati. Hiti chun Pakaiyin amit’u ahasah in ahileh amaho Samaria khopi alailunga um ahiu akimudoh tauvin ahi.
en: When they had come into Samaria, Elisha said, “LORD, open these men’s eyes, that they may see.” The LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and behold, they were in the middle of Samaria.
text:
2KI 6:20
Thadou: Samaria khopi chu alhunphat’un, Elisha atauvin, “O Pakai tun amit’u hasah kit’in lang kho musah tan,” ati. Hiti chun Pakaiyin amit’u ahasah in ahileh amaho Samaria khopi alailunga um ahiu akimudoh tauvin ahi.
English: When they had come into Samaria, Elisha said, “LORD, open these men’s eyes, that they may see.” The LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and behold, they were in the middle of Samaria.

tcz: Israel lengpan amaho chu amudoh phat’in Elisha kom’a chun ahin samjah jingin, “Hepa hiche hohi katha gamding hitam? Kathagam ding hitam?” ahintin ahi.
en: The king of Israel said to Elisha, when he saw them, “My father, shall I strike them? Shall I strike them?”
text:
2KI 6:21
Thadou: Israel lengpan amaho chu amudoh phat’in Elisha kom’a chun ahin samjah jingin, “Hepa hiche hohi katha gamding hitam? Kathagam ding hitam?” ahintin ahi.
English: The king of Israel said to Elisha, when he saw them, “My father, shall I strike them? Shall I strike them?”

tcz: Elisha’n ahin donbut’in, “Nathathei louding ahi! Gal-hing’a kiman hohi kithatji ngai em? Anehdiu le adondiu joh pen lang apu kom langa le sultan,” ati.
en: He answered, “You shall not strike them. Would you strike those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? Set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, then go to their master.”
text:
2KI 6:22
Thadou: Elisha’n ahin donbut’in, “Nathathei louding ahi! Gal-hing’a kiman hohi kithatji ngai em? Anehdiu le adondiu joh pen lang apu kom langa le sultan,” ati.
English: He answered, “You shall not strike them. Would you strike those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? Set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, then go to their master.”

tcz: Hiti chun lengpan ankong thupitah ahin sem’in, anehsah in, apupau kom langa ale soltan ahi. Hichejou chun Syria galmite Israel gam ahin nokhum tapouvin ahi.
en: He prepared a great feast for them. After they ate and drank, he sent them away and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria stopped raiding the land of Israel.
text:
2KI 6:23
Thadou: Hiti chun lengpan ankong thupitah ahin sem’in, anehsah in, apupau kom langa ale soltan ahi. Hichejou chun Syria galmite Israel gam ahin nokhum tapouvin ahi.
English: He prepared a great feast for them. After they ate and drank, he sent them away and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria stopped raiding the land of Israel.

tcz: Ahin phat chomkhat set jouhin Syria lengpa Benhadad in agalmite jouse atit khom’in Samaria khopi ahin umkhum tauvin ahi.
en: After this, Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up and besieged Samaria.
text:
2KI 6:24
Thadou: Ahin phat chomkhat set jouhin Syria lengpa Benhadad in agalmite jouse atit khom’in Samaria khopi ahin umkhum tauvin ahi.
English: After this, Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up and besieged Samaria.

tcz: Hijeh chun khopi sunga chun kel lhahna nasatah aumtan ahi. Khopi aumkhum nao chu asot lheh jingtan ahileh sangan luchang khatchu dangka somget in akijoh in, gam louthul til jing jong atena khat hoplia hopkhatna chun dangka nga in akijoh tan ahi.
en: There was a great famine in Samaria. Behold, they besieged it until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a kab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.
text:
2KI 6:25
Thadou: Hijeh chun khopi sunga chun kel lhahna nasatah aumtan ahi. Khopi aumkhum nao chu asot lheh jingtan ahileh sangan luchang khatchu dangka somget in akijoh in, gam louthul til jing jong atena khat hoplia hopkhatna chun dangka nga in akijoh tan ahi.
English: There was a great famine in Samaria. Behold, they besieged it until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a kab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.

tcz: Nikhat hi Israel lengpa chu khopi pal chunga chun avah lelen ahileh numeikhat in ahin kouvin, “Kapu lengpa neihuh in,” ahin tin ahi.
en: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, “Help, my lord, O king!”
text:
2KI 6:26
Thadou: Nikhat hi Israel lengpa chu khopi pal chunga chun avah lelen ahileh numeikhat in ahin kouvin, “Kapu lengpa neihuh in,” ahin tin ahi.
English: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, “Help, my lord, O king!”

tcz: Chuin aman adonbut in, “Pakaiyin nakithopi louleh keiman ipi kabolpeh thei ding ham? Keiman changvohna pholla konin changla kanei tapon, lengpi twijong aheh lhahna a konin kanei tapon hoiya ipi kalah’a nang kapehding ham?” ati.
en: He said, “If the LORD doesn’t help you, where could I get help for you? From the threshing floor, or from the wine press?”
text:
2KI 6:27
Thadou: Chuin aman adonbut in, “Pakaiyin nakithopi louleh keiman ipi kabolpeh thei ding ham? Keiman changvohna pholla konin changla kanei tapon, lengpi twijong aheh lhahna a konin kanei tapon hoiya ipi kalah’a nang kapehding ham?” ati.
English: He said, “If the LORD doesn’t help you, where could I get help for you? From the threshing floor, or from the wine press?”

tcz: Ahin lengpan adongin “Ipi ham nahahsatna,” tin adongin ahileh amanun adonbut, “Hiche numeinu hin kakom’ah ahungin tunin nang chapa chu nehitin jingleh keichapa nena hite atin,” ahi.
en: Then the king asked her, “What is your problem?” She answered, “This woman said to me, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow.’
text:
2KI 6:28
Thadou: Ahin lengpan adongin “Ipi ham nahahsatna,” tin adongin ahileh amanun adonbut, “Hiche numeinu hin kakom’ah ahungin tunin nang chapa chu nehitin jingleh keichapa nena hite atin,” ahi.
English: Then the king asked her, “What is your problem?” She answered, “This woman said to me, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow.’

tcz: Hijeh chun keichapa kakihon lhonin kane lhontai, ajingin ama chapa kitha hitin neta hite katileh, aman akisel mangtai,” ati.
en: So we boiled my son and ate him; and I said to her on the next day, ‘Give up your son, that we may eat him;’ and she has hidden her son.”
text:
2KI 6:29
Thadou: Hijeh chun keichapa kakihon lhonin kane lhontai, ajingin ama chapa kitha hitin neta hite katileh, aman akisel mangtai,” ati.
English: So we boiled my son and ate him; and I said to her on the next day, ‘Give up your son, that we may eat him;’ and she has hidden her son.”

tcz: Hichun Lengpan hiche thuhi ajah doh phat’in lunghangtah in apon abottel jingin ahi. Hitia chu lengpa palchunga ava lena a chun mipi hon khaodip pon akisil chu amuvin ahi.
en: When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes. Now he was passing by on the wall, and the people looked, and behold, he had sackcloth underneath on his body.
text:
2KI 6:30
Thadou: Hichun Lengpan hiche thuhi ajah doh phat’in lunghangtah in apon abottel jingin ahi. Hitia chu lengpa palchunga ava lena a chun mipi hon khaodip pon akisil chu amuvin ahi.
English: When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes. Now he was passing by on the wall, and the people looked, and behold, he had sackcloth underneath on his body.

tcz: Lengpa apengjah jingin, “Tuni tah ahi Elisha luchang katan louleh Pathen’in keima eithat jinghen” tin akihahsel jah jengtan ahi.
en: Then he said, “God do so to me, and more also, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat stays on him today.”
text:
2KI 6:31
Thadou: Lengpa apengjah jingin, “Tuni tah ahi Elisha luchang katan louleh Pathen’in keima eithat jinghen” tin akihahsel jah jengtan ahi.
English: Then he said, “God do so to me, and more also, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat stays on him today.”

tcz: Hitia chu lengpan akoudia mi asol chun, Elisha chu Israel upa hotoh ainsungah ana toukhom’un, akoupa chu ahunglhun masang in Elisha’n upahojah achun, “Hiche tolthat pakhun keilol tang dingin mikhat ahin sollin ahi. Ama ahunglhun tengleh kot kamkhum mun hin lutsah hih un, ama nunga apupan ahin juipai ding ahi,” ati.
en: But Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. Then the king sent a man from before him; but before the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, “Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? Behold, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold the door shut against him. Isn’t the sound of his master’s feet behind him?”
text:
2KI 6:32
Thadou: Hitia chu lengpan akoudia mi asol chun, Elisha chu Israel upa hotoh ainsungah ana toukhom’un, akoupa chu ahunglhun masang in Elisha’n upahojah achun, “Hiche tolthat pakhun keilol tang dingin mikhat ahin sollin ahi. Ama ahunglhun tengleh kot kamkhum mun hin lutsah hih un, ama nunga apupan ahin juipai ding ahi,” ati.
English: But Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. Then the king sent a man from before him; but before the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, “Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? Behold, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold the door shut against him. Isn’t the sound of his master’s feet behind him?”

tcz: Elisha’n hitia thu asei jinglai sung chun thupole pachu ahung lhung paitan, chule lengpa chun aseipaijin, “Hiche lungkhamna hojouse hi Pakaija kon ahi, chuti ahileh kon Pakai chu iti kanga jing nahlai ding ham?” ati.
en: While he was still talking with them, behold, the messenger came down to him. Then he said, “Behold, this evil is from the LORD. Why should I wait for the LORD any longer?”
text:
2KI 6:33
Thadou: Elisha’n hitia thu asei jinglai sung chun thupole pachu ahung lhung paitan, chule lengpa chun aseipaijin, “Hiche lungkhamna hojouse hi Pakaija kon ahi, chuti ahileh kon Pakai chu iti kanga jing nahlai ding ham?” ati.
English: While he was still talking with them, behold, the messenger came down to him. Then he said, “Behold, this evil is from the LORD. Why should I wait for the LORD any longer?”

tcz: Elisha’n adonbut in, “Pakai thupeh ngaijin! Pakaiyin hitin aseije, tuphat don jingteng le Samaria thil kijohna mun’ah antuitah chu atena khat dimchu dangka khatna kijohding, sakol chaang atena dim ni jong dangka khat dinga hung kijoh ding ahi,” ati.
en: Elisha said, “Hear the LORD’s word. The LORD says, ‘Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour will be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.’”
text:
2KI 7:1
Thadou: Elisha’n adonbut in, “Pakai thupeh ngaijin! Pakaiyin hitin aseije, tuphat don jingteng le Samaria thil kijohna mun’ah antuitah chu atena khat dimchu dangka khatna kijohding, sakol chaang atena dim ni jong dangka khat dinga hung kijoh ding ahi,” ati.
English: Elisha said, “Hear the LORD’s word. The LORD says, ‘Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour will be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.’”

tcz: Hichun lengpa kithopi jing asepai lamkaipa chun Pathen mipa jah a chun, “Pakai amatah in vanna kona van bangkot ahondoh a, hitobang thilchu abol ding hijongleh hithei mong ding hi nam?” atin ahileh Elisha’n jong adonbut in, “Athilsoh ho chu namit tah a vang namu ding ahin, khatcha naneh khah louding ahi,” atipeh tan ahi.
en: Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, “Behold, if the LORD made windows in heaven, could this thing be?” He said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”
text:
2KI 7:2
Thadou: Hichun lengpa kithopi jing asepai lamkaipa chun Pathen mipa jah a chun, “Pakai amatah in vanna kona van bangkot ahondoh a, hitobang thilchu abol ding hijongleh hithei mong ding hi nam?” atin ahileh Elisha’n jong adonbut in, “Athilsoh ho chu namit tah a vang namu ding ahin, khatcha naneh khah louding ahi,” atipeh tan ahi.
English: Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, “Behold, if the LORD made windows in heaven, could this thing be?” He said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”

tcz: Tun khopi kelkot lutna kom’ah miphah li ana um’in ahi. Amaho chu khat le khat akidongto uvin, “Eiho hi thi ngah mai maija ihiti tou thim jingdiu hitam?” akitiuvin ahi.
en: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. They said to one another, “Why do we sit here until we die?
text:
2KI 7:3
Thadou: Tun khopi kelkot lutna kom’ah miphah li ana um’in ahi. Amaho chu khat le khat akidongto uvin, “Eiho hi thi ngah mai maija ihiti tou thim jingdiu hitam?” akitiuvin ahi.
English: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. They said to one another, “Why do we sit here until we die?

tcz: “Eiho hitia hi ium uleh anngol’a ithi teidiu ahi, khopi sunga lut jong leuhen kel-khoh jeh a ithi thou thou diu ahi, hijehchun Syria sepaite kom’ahin kipelut jing leuhen eihing hoi maitheiju ahi, ijemtia eitha jingu jongleh ithi thou thoudiu ahin, hichu phajolou ham?” akitiuve.
en: If we say, ‘We will enter into the city,’ then the famine is in the city, and we will die there. If we sit still here, we also die. Now therefore come, and let’s surrender to the army of the Syrians. If they save us alive, we will live; and if they kill us, we will only die.”
text:
2KI 7:4
Thadou: “Eiho hitia hi ium uleh anngol’a ithi teidiu ahi, khopi sunga lut jong leuhen kel-khoh jeh a ithi thou thou diu ahi, hijehchun Syria sepaite kom’ahin kipelut jing leuhen eihing hoi maitheiju ahi, ijemtia eitha jingu jongleh ithi thou thoudiu ahin, hichu phajolou ham?” akitiuve.
English: If we say, ‘We will enter into the city,’ then the famine is in the city, and we will die there. If we sit still here, we also die. Now therefore come, and let’s surrender to the army of the Syrians. If they save us alive, we will live; and if they kill us, we will only die.”

tcz: Hiti chun jingpi phalvah-in amaho Syria ngahmun ah alut tauvin ahi. Hitia chu angah munna agalut uleh koimacha ana umpon ahi,
en: They rose up in the twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians. When they had come to the outermost part of the camp of the Syrians, behold, no man was there.
text:
2KI 7:5
Thadou: Hiti chun jingpi phalvah-in amaho Syria ngahmun ah alut tauvin ahi. Hitia chu angah munna agalut uleh koimacha ana umpon ahi,
English: They rose up in the twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians. When they had come to the outermost part of the camp of the Syrians, behold, no man was there.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen’in sakol lhaigin leh sakol kangtalai lhaigin chule sepai tamtah hung lhailut gin akithonsah in ahileh Israel lengpa hin, “Hit mite le Egypt mite akikou uva eihin nokhum mu ahitai,” atiuva kaple penga jammang gam'a ahitauve.
en: For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots and the sound of horses, even the noise of a great army; and they said to one another, “Behold, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack us.”
text:
2KI 7:6
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen’in sakol lhaigin leh sakol kangtalai lhaigin chule sepai tamtah hung lhailut gin akithonsah in ahileh Israel lengpa hin, “Hit mite le Egypt mite akikou uva eihin nokhum mu ahitai,” atiuva kaple penga jammang gam'a ahitauve.
English: For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots and the sound of horses, even the noise of a great army; and they said to one another, “Behold, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack us.”

tcz: Hijeh a chu kicha behseh uva aponbuh u, asakol teu, asangan teu chuleh athildang ho jouse adalhah uva ahinkhou kihuhhing nading a ana jamdoh gam’ah ahitauve.
en: Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.
text:
2KI 7:7
Thadou: Hijeh a chu kicha behseh uva aponbuh u, asakol teu, asangan teu chuleh athildang ho jouse adalhah uva ahinkhou kihuhhing nading a ana jamdoh gam’ah ahitauve.
English: Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.

tcz: Miphah hochu ponbuh sungkhatna alut’un chuleh khat’ah alut’un aneuvin adon’un, sana dangka leh ponho akichom’un akisel’un ahi.
en: When these lepers came to the outermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and ate and drank, then carried away silver, gold, and clothing and went and hid it. Then they came back, and entered into another tent and carried things from there also, and went and hid them.
text:
2KI 7:8
Thadou: Miphah hochu ponbuh sungkhatna alut’un chuleh khat’ah alut’un aneuvin adon’un, sana dangka leh ponho akichom’un akisel’un ahi.
English: When these lepers came to the outermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and ate and drank, then carried away silver, gold, and clothing and went and hid it. Then they came back, and entered into another tent and carried things from there also, and went and hid them.

tcz: Ajonan amaho akihouvun, “Ibol uhi adih tapoi, tunihi nikhopha khat ahibouve, hichehi eihon mitoh ichankhom lou uhi adihpoi, eihon hitia hi jing geija iche piuva ahileh hamsetna itotei diu ahi. Hijeh chun hung’un eiho cheu hitin lengte khopi sunga miho gahetsah uhite,” akitiuvin ahi.
en: Then they said to one another, “We aren’t doing right. Today is a day of good news, and we keep silent. If we wait until the morning light, punishment will overtake us. Now therefore come, let’s go and tell the king’s household.”
text:
2KI 7:9
Thadou: Ajonan amaho akihouvun, “Ibol uhi adih tapoi, tunihi nikhopha khat ahibouve, hichehi eihon mitoh ichankhom lou uhi adihpoi, eihon hitia hi jing geija iche piuva ahileh hamsetna itotei diu ahi. Hijeh chun hung’un eiho cheu hitin lengte khopi sunga miho gahetsah uhite,” akitiuvin ahi.
English: Then they said to one another, “We aren’t doing right. Today is a day of good news, and we keep silent. If we wait until the morning light, punishment will overtake us. Now therefore come, let’s go and tell the king’s household.”

tcz: Hiti chun amaho acheuvin khopi sunga kelkot ngah ho chu thilsoh ho agahetsah tauvin ahi. “Keiho Syria mite ngahmun na kalut’un ahile koimacha anaum tapon ahi! Sakol hole Sangan ho ana kihen nalaijin, ponbuh ho jong abang bang in ana um’in, mihem koimacha anaum tapon ahi,” atiuve.
en: So they came and called to the city gatekeepers; and they told them, “We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, not even a man’s voice, but the horses tied, and the donkeys tied, and the tents as they were.”
text:
2KI 7:10
Thadou: Hiti chun amaho acheuvin khopi sunga kelkot ngah ho chu thilsoh ho agahetsah tauvin ahi. “Keiho Syria mite ngahmun na kalut’un ahile koimacha anaum tapon ahi! Sakol hole Sangan ho ana kihen nalaijin, ponbuh ho jong abang bang in ana um’in, mihem koimacha anaum tapon ahi,” atiuve.
English: So they came and called to the city gatekeepers; and they told them, “We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, not even a man’s voice, but the horses tied, and the donkeys tied, and the tents as they were.”

tcz: Hichun kelkot ngahho chun khopi sunga mipiho lah’a chun hasap in asamphong tauvin ahi.
en: Then the gatekeepers called out and told it to the king’s household within.
text:
2KI 7:11
Thadou: Hichun kelkot ngahho chun khopi sunga mipiho lah’a chun hasap in asamphong tauvin ahi.
English: Then the gatekeepers called out and told it to the king’s household within.

tcz: Lengpa chu jan khangkim in alupna a konin ahung thoudoh in, anoija lamkai pipui ho kom’a chun hitin aseitan ahi, “Keiman thilsoh hohi kahei, Syria mite hin eiho an ngolla ium uhi ahet ahin, hijeh a chu angah mun u adalhah uva gamlah’a gakisel’ah ahiuve. Amaho hin khopi idalhah uva ipotdoh tenguleh eihohi ahinga matna khopi chu lonkhum ding atiu ahi,” ati.
en: The king arose in the night, and said to his servants, “I will now show you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we are hungry. Therefore they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, ‘When they come out of the city, we shall take them alive, and get into the city.’”
text:
2KI 7:12
Thadou: Lengpa chu jan khangkim in alupna a konin ahung thoudoh in, anoija lamkai pipui ho kom’a chun hitin aseitan ahi, “Keiman thilsoh hohi kahei, Syria mite hin eiho an ngolla ium uhi ahet ahin, hijeh a chu angah mun u adalhah uva gamlah’a gakisel’ah ahiuve. Amaho hin khopi idalhah uva ipotdoh tenguleh eihohi ahinga matna khopi chu lonkhum ding atiu ahi,” ati.
English: The king arose in the night, and said to his servants, “I will now show you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we are hungry. Therefore they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, ‘When they come out of the city, we shall take them alive, and get into the city.’”

tcz: Anoija lamkai holah’a khat chun ahin donbut’in, “Ipi hileh eihon gakholtoh poupou uhite. Sakol athimoh nga hokhu mangchao hitin akholtoh ding sol’u hite. Ijemtia achung'uva thilkhat ahungso tah jongleh, hilai mun ah umjong leu eiho chengto ithikhom thou thoudiu ahin, akhoh dehpoi,” ahin tin ahi.
en: One of his servants answered, “Please let some people take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are left in it. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are consumed. Let’s send and see.”
text:
2KI 7:13
Thadou: Anoija lamkai holah’a khat chun ahin donbut’in, “Ipi hileh eihon gakholtoh poupou uhite. Sakol athimoh nga hokhu mangchao hitin akholtoh ding sol’u hite. Ijemtia achung'uva thilkhat ahungso tah jongleh, hilai mun ah umjong leu eiho chengto ithikhom thou thoudiu ahin, akhoh dehpoi,” ahin tin ahi.
English: One of his servants answered, “Please let some people take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are left in it. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are consumed. Let’s send and see.”

tcz: Hiti chun sakol kangtalai nichu agongun lengpan Syria sepaite chunga thilsoh chu gakhol toh dingin asol tauvin ahi.
en: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, “Go and see.”
text:
2KI 7:14
Thadou: Hiti chun sakol kangtalai nichu agongun lengpan Syria sepaite chunga thilsoh chu gakhol toh dingin asol tauvin ahi.
English: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, “Go and see.”

tcz: Amaho Jordan vadung geijin acheuvin Syria sepaite ponho, manchahho ajamcheh nauva apai thanghou chu aga mu uvin ahung kile un, lengpa kom’a aseitauvin ahi.
en: They went after them to the Jordan; and behold, all the path was full of garments and equipment which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. The messengers returned and told the king.
text:
2KI 7:15
Thadou: Amaho Jordan vadung geijin acheuvin Syria sepaite ponho, manchahho ajamcheh nauva apai thanghou chu aga mu uvin ahung kile un, lengpa kom’a aseitauvin ahi.
English: They went after them to the Jordan; and behold, all the path was full of garments and equipment which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. The messengers returned and told the king.

tcz: Hijou chun Samaria khopi miho chu alhaidoh un, Syria te ngahmun chu agachom tauvin ahi. Hiti chun antuitah tah chu atena dim nga chu dangka khat aman’in chuleh sakol chang atena dim som chu dangka khat man’in, Pakaiyin ana tepbang bang chun akijoh tan ahi.
en: The people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians. So a seah of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the LORD’s word.
text:
2KI 7:16
Thadou: Hijou chun Samaria khopi miho chu alhaidoh un, Syria te ngahmun chu agachom tauvin ahi. Hiti chun antuitah tah chu atena dim nga chu dangka khat aman’in chuleh sakol chang atena dim som chu dangka khat man’in, Pakaiyin ana tepbang bang chun akijoh tan ahi.
English: The people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians. So a seah of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the LORD’s word.

tcz: Lengpan a sepai lamkaipa chu kelkot na mipi ting ding chun ana pansah in ahileh mipi hon anolhu uvin, achonlih tauvin ahi. Hiti chun Pathen mipan ain na hung lengpa kom’a ana phondoh tobang bang chun ana sohdoh tan ahi.
en: The king had appointed the captain on whose hand he leaned to be in charge of the gate; and the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died as the man of God had said, who spoke when the king came down to him.
text:
2KI 7:17
Thadou: Lengpan a sepai lamkaipa chu kelkot na mipi ting ding chun ana pansah in ahileh mipi hon anolhu uvin, achonlih tauvin ahi. Hiti chun Pathen mipan ain na hung lengpa kom’a ana phondoh tobang bang chun ana sohdoh tan ahi.
English: The king had appointed the captain on whose hand he leaned to be in charge of the gate; and the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died as the man of God had said, who spoke when the king came down to him.

tcz: Pathen mipan lengpa kom’achun, “Jing nikho tuphat dontah leh antui tah chu atena dim nga chu dangka khatna kicho ding chuleh sakol chang atena dim som chu dangka khatna kicho ding,” anati ahi.
en: It happened as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, “Two seahs of barley for a shekel, and a seah of fine flour for a shekel, shall be tomorrow about this time in the gate of Samaria;”
text:
2KI 7:18
Thadou: Pathen mipan lengpa kom’achun, “Jing nikho tuphat dontah leh antui tah chu atena dim nga chu dangka khatna kicho ding chuleh sakol chang atena dim som chu dangka khatna kicho ding,” anati ahi.
English: It happened as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, “Two seahs of barley for a shekel, and a seah of fine flour for a shekel, shall be tomorrow about this time in the gate of Samaria;”

tcz: Hiche pet tah’a chu lengpa noija sepai lamkai pachun, “Pakaiyin vanna van bangkot jouse ahon lhahding hijongleh hithei ponte ana tin,” ahileh, Pathen mipachun, “Nangin thilsoh chu na mittah a namu ding ama vang naneh mantah louding ahi,” ana tipeh chu,
en: and that captain answered the man of God, and said, “Now, behold, if the LORD made windows in heaven, might such a thing be?” and he said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”
text:
2KI 7:19
Thadou: Hiche pet tah’a chu lengpa noija sepai lamkai pachun, “Pakaiyin vanna van bangkot jouse ahon lhahding hijongleh hithei ponte ana tin,” ahileh, Pathen mipachun, “Nangin thilsoh chu na mittah a namu ding ama vang naneh mantah louding ahi,” ana tipeh chu,
English: and that captain answered the man of God, and said, “Now, behold, if the LORD made windows in heaven, might such a thing be?” and he said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”

tcz: Alollhina anahitai, ajeh chu mipihon amachu kotphung ah chun ana chonlih tauvin ahi.
en: It happened like that to him, for the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died.
text:
2KI 7:20
Thadou: Alollhina anahitai, ajeh chu mipihon amachu kotphung ah chun ana chonlih tauvin ahi.
English: It happened like that to him, for the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died.

tcz: Elisha’n achapa thisa ahindohsa peh numeinu kom’ah chun hitin anaseijin ahi, “Na insungmite kipuijin lang munchom dang khatna chetan ajeh chu Pakaiyin Israel chunga kum sagi kel alhah sahding ahi,” ati.
en: Now Elisha had spoken to the woman whose son he had restored to life, saying, “Arise, and go, you and your household, and stay for a while wherever you can; for the LORD has called for a famine. It will also come on the land for seven years.”
text:
2KI 8:1
Thadou: Elisha’n achapa thisa ahindohsa peh numeinu kom’ah chun hitin anaseijin ahi, “Na insungmite kipuijin lang munchom dang khatna chetan ajeh chu Pakaiyin Israel chunga kum sagi kel alhah sahding ahi,” ati.
English: Now Elisha had spoken to the woman whose son he had restored to life, saying, “Arise, and go, you and your household, and stay for a while wherever you can; for the LORD has called for a famine. It will also come on the land for seven years.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Pathen mipan aseibang bangin numeinu chun aboltan ahi. Amanun ainsung mite apuidohin Philistine gam’ah kum sagi aga cheng tan ahi.
en: The woman arose, and did according to the man of God’s word. She went with her household, and lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years.
text:
2KI 8:2
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pathen mipan aseibang bangin numeinu chun aboltan ahi. Amanun ainsung mite apuidohin Philistine gam’ah kum sagi aga cheng tan ahi.
English: The woman arose, and did according to the man of God’s word. She went with her household, and lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years.

tcz: Kellhah akichai jouvin Philistine gam’ah konin ainlam ah ahung kile kit tan ahi. Ain leh agam nungmu kitna dingin lengpa kom’ah achen ahi.
en: At the end of seven years, the woman returned from the land of the Philistines. Then she went out to beg the king for her house and for her land.
text:
2KI 8:3
Thadou: Kellhah akichai jouvin Philistine gam’ah konin ainlam ah ahung kile kit tan ahi. Ain leh agam nungmu kitna dingin lengpa kom’ah achen ahi.
English: At the end of seven years, the woman returned from the land of the Philistines. Then she went out to beg the king for her house and for her land.

tcz: Hitia chu amanu lengpa kom’a agalut chun, lengpa chu Pathen mipa sohpa Gehazi chutoh ana kihoulim pet ahin, lengpa chun Gehazi kom’ah chun, “Elisha thilbol kidangho phabep neiseipeh in,” anatin ahi.
en: Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, “Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.”
text:
2KI 8:4
Thadou: Hitia chu amanu lengpa kom’a agalut chun, lengpa chu Pathen mipa sohpa Gehazi chutoh ana kihoulim pet ahin, lengpa chun Gehazi kom’ah chun, “Elisha thilbol kidangho phabep neiseipeh in,” anatin ahi.
English: Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, “Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.”

tcz: Chule Gehazi chun, Elisha in chapang thisa khat ahindoh sah kit thu chu ana seipeh in ahi. Hichepet tah chun hiche chapangpa nuchu lengpa kom’ah tao dingin ahunglut in ahi.
en: As he was telling the king how he had restored to life him who was dead, behold, the woman whose son he had restored to life begged the king for her house and for her land. Gehazi said, “My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.”
text:
2KI 8:5
Thadou: Chule Gehazi chun, Elisha in chapang thisa khat ahindoh sah kit thu chu ana seipeh in ahi. Hichepet tah chun hiche chapangpa nuchu lengpa kom’ah tao dingin ahunglut in ahi.
English: As he was telling the king how he had restored to life him who was dead, behold, the woman whose son he had restored to life begged the king for her house and for her land. Gehazi said, “My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.”

tcz: Lengpan numeinu chu adongin, “Hichu dih hinam?” ati. Hichun amanun athusim chu aseipeh tai. Chuin lengpa anoija natong pipui ho khat chu akouvin numeinu thil le lo hochu ale chan kitna dinga agontoh peh dingin anganse tan ahi.
en: When the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed to her a certain officer, saying, “Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.”
text:
2KI 8:6
Thadou: Lengpan numeinu chu adongin, “Hichu dih hinam?” ati. Hichun amanun athusim chu aseipeh tai. Chuin lengpa anoija natong pipui ho khat chu akouvin numeinu thil le lo hochu ale chan kitna dinga agontoh peh dingin anganse tan ahi.
English: When the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed to her a certain officer, saying, “Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.”

tcz: Elisha chu Ben-hadad damlouva alupna Syria khopi Damascus a chun achen ahi. Mikhat in lengpa kom’ah chun Pathen mipa ahunge tia aseipeh phat chun,
en: Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick. He was told, “The man of God has come here.”
text:
2KI 8:7
Thadou: Elisha chu Ben-hadad damlouva alupna Syria khopi Damascus a chun achen ahi. Mikhat in lengpa kom’ah chun Pathen mipa ahunge tia aseipeh phat chun,
English: Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick. He was told, “The man of God has come here.”

tcz: Lengpan Hazael kom’ah chun, “Kipa thilpeh khat chu choijinlang Pathen mipa chu gapenlang, chule hiche kanat na akona hi kadamdoh ding hinam? Pakai chu eidoh pehtan,” tin asollin ahi.
en: The king said to Hazael, “Take a present in your hand, and go meet the man of God, and inquire of the LORD by him, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”
text:
2KI 8:8
Thadou: Lengpan Hazael kom’ah chun, “Kipa thilpeh khat chu choijinlang Pathen mipa chu gapenlang, chule hiche kanat na akona hi kadamdoh ding hinam? Pakai chu eidoh pehtan,” tin asollin ahi.
English: The king said to Hazael, “Take a present in your hand, and go meet the man of God, and inquire of the LORD by him, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

tcz: Hiti chun Hazael chun sangonsang somli chu Damascus a thilsoh phapen ho chutoh, Elisha kom’a achen, hitin aseitan ahi, “Nasohpa Benhadad Syria lengpan nangkom’a eihinsol ahi chule hiche kanat na akona hi kadamdoh ding hi nam? tin eiga dohpeh in atia eihinsol ahi,” atin ahileh,
en: So Hazael went to meet him and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him and said, “Your son Benhadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”
text:
2KI 8:9
Thadou: Hiti chun Hazael chun sangonsang somli chu Damascus a thilsoh phapen ho chutoh, Elisha kom’a achen, hitin aseitan ahi, “Nasohpa Benhadad Syria lengpan nangkom’a eihinsol ahi chule hiche kanat na akona hi kadamdoh ding hi nam? tin eiga dohpeh in atia eihinsol ahi,” atin ahileh,
English: So Hazael went to meet him and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him and said, “Your son Benhadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

tcz: Elishan adonbut in, “Chenlang hiti hin gasei peh tan, nangma nadamdoh teiding ahi, tihi Pakaiyin atahbeh in eimusah in ahi, ahinla amavang thitei ding ahi!” ati.
en: Elisha said to him, “Go, tell him, ‘You will surely recover;’ however the LORD has shown me that he will surely die.”
text:
2KI 8:10
Thadou: Elishan adonbut in, “Chenlang hiti hin gasei peh tan, nangma nadamdoh teiding ahi, tihi Pakaiyin atahbeh in eimusah in ahi, ahinla amavang thitei ding ahi!” ati.
English: Elisha said to him, “Go, tell him, ‘You will surely recover;’ however the LORD has shown me that he will surely die.”

tcz: Hichun Elisha’n Hazael chun nommo asah tokah sen mitlha louhellin avechang mellin, chujouvin Pathen mipa chu ahung kaplha jengtan ahi.
en: He settled his gaze steadfastly on him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept.
text:
2KI 8:11
Thadou: Hichun Elisha’n Hazael chun nommo asah tokah sen mitlha louhellin avechang mellin, chujouvin Pathen mipa chu ahung kaplha jengtan ahi.
English: He settled his gaze steadfastly on him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept.

tcz: “Ipithu hitam kapu!” tin, Hazael’in adongin ahile, Elisha in adonbut in, “Nangman Israelte chunga thil tijat um tahtah hohi nahin tohding kahen ahi. Nangin kul kiget khum akhopi hou nahin hal lhahding, agollhanghou chemjamma nahin ban satlih gamding, achapang teu toltoh nahin chotnat ding, anumei hou agailai nahin khojalding hi kahe in ahi,” ati.
en: Hazael said, “Why do you weep, my lord?” He answered, “Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel. You will set their strongholds on fire, and you will kill their young men with the sword, and will dash their little ones in pieces, and rip up their pregnant women.”
text:
2KI 8:12
Thadou: “Ipithu hitam kapu!” tin, Hazael’in adongin ahile, Elisha in adonbut in, “Nangman Israelte chunga thil tijat um tahtah hohi nahin tohding kahen ahi. Nangin kul kiget khum akhopi hou nahin hal lhahding, agollhanghou chemjamma nahin ban satlih gamding, achapang teu toltoh nahin chotnat ding, anumei hou agailai nahin khojalding hi kahe in ahi,” ati.
English: Hazael said, “Why do you weep, my lord?” He answered, “Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel. You will set their strongholds on fire, and you will kill their young men with the sword, and will dash their little ones in pieces, and rip up their pregnant women.”

tcz: Hazael lin adonbut in, “Keitobang imacha hilou khat mai maijin chutobang thil nasa chu katoh thei ding ham?” ati. Ahin Elisha’n adonbut in, “Nangma Syria leng nahung hiding ahite Pakaiyin eimusah in ahi,” ati.
en: Hazael said, “But what is your servant, who is but a dog, that he could do this great thing?” Elisha answered, “The LORD has shown me that you will be king over Syria.”
text:
2KI 8:13
Thadou: Hazael lin adonbut in, “Keitobang imacha hilou khat mai maijin chutobang thil nasa chu katoh thei ding ham?” ati. Ahin Elisha’n adonbut in, “Nangma Syria leng nahung hiding ahite Pakaiyin eimusah in ahi,” ati.
English: Hazael said, “But what is your servant, who is but a dog, that he could do this great thing?” Elisha answered, “The LORD has shown me that you will be king over Syria.”

tcz: Hazael in Elisha adalhan lengpa kom ah akile kittan ahi, hicun lengpa jong ama kom ah chun, “Elisha ipi nahin seipeh em?” tin anadongin ahi. Hazael in adonbut in, “Nangma hi nadamdoh tei ding ahi tin aman eiseipeh e.” ati.
en: Then he departed from Elisha, and came to his master, who said to him, “What did Elisha say to you?” He answered, “He told me that you would surely recover.”
text:
2KI 8:14
Thadou: Hazael in Elisha adalhan lengpa kom ah akile kittan ahi, hicun lengpa jong ama kom ah chun, “Elisha ipi nahin seipeh em?” tin anadongin ahi. Hazael in adonbut in, “Nangma hi nadamdoh tei ding ahi tin aman eiseipeh e.” ati.
English: Then he departed from Elisha, and came to his master, who said to him, “What did Elisha say to you?” He answered, “He told me that you would surely recover.”

tcz: Ahinlah ajing nikhon Hazael in ponlum twiya asu-kotin amai akhun athi tokah in amai ah akhuden pehtan ahi. Hijouchun Hazael chun Syria te leng achangin Benhadad akheltan ahi.
en: On the next day, he took a thick cloth, dipped it in water, and spread it on the king’s face, so that he died. Then Hazael reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 8:15
Thadou: Ahinlah ajing nikhon Hazael in ponlum twiya asu-kotin amai akhun athi tokah in amai ah akhuden pehtan ahi. Hijouchun Hazael chun Syria te leng achangin Benhadad akheltan ahi.
English: On the next day, he took a thick cloth, dipped it in water, and spread it on the king’s face, so that he died. Then Hazael reigned in his place.

tcz: Israel lengpa Ahab chapa Joram vaihom kum nga channa in Judah te leng Jehoshaphat chapa Jehoram min Judahte chunga vai ana homin ahi.
en: In the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being king of Judah then, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.
text:
2KI 8:16
Thadou: Israel lengpa Ahab chapa Joram vaihom kum nga channa in Judah te leng Jehoshaphat chapa Jehoram min Judahte chunga vai ana homin ahi.
English: In the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being king of Judah then, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

tcz: Jehoram hi leng ahung hichun ama kum somthum le ni ana lhingtan amahin Jerusalem mah kum get lengvai anapon ahi.
en: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
text:
2KI 8:17
Thadou: Jehoram hi leng ahung hichun ama kum somthum le ni ana lhingtan amahin Jerusalem mah kum get lengvai anapon ahi.
English: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

tcz: Jehoram hin Israel lengte chonchan ajuijin Ahab lengpa phatmo tobang'in aphamon ahi. Ajeh chu aman Ahab chanu ho lah’a khat ana kichenpin ahi. Hiti chun Jehoram hin Pakai mitmu’n thilsejing ana bollin ahi.
en: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he married Ahab’s daughter. He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.
text:
2KI 8:18
Thadou: Jehoram hin Israel lengte chonchan ajuijin Ahab lengpa phatmo tobang'in aphamon ahi. Ajeh chu aman Ahab chanu ho lah’a khat ana kichenpin ahi. Hiti chun Jehoram hin Pakai mitmu’n thilsejing ana bollin ahi.
English: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he married Ahab’s daughter. He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

tcz: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Judah mite ana sumang nompon ahi, ajeh chu aman David toh kitepna ana neijin achilhah ten vai ahopjom ding chule aitih a thaomei banga vahjing dinga anatep peh ahi.
en: However, the LORD would not destroy Judah, for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his children always.
text:
2KI 8:19
Thadou: Ahinlah Pakaiyin Judah mite ana sumang nompon ahi, ajeh chu aman David toh kitepna ana neijin achilhah ten vai ahopjom ding chule aitih a thaomei banga vahjing dinga anatep peh ahi.
English: However, the LORD would not destroy Judah, for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his children always.

tcz: Jehoram vaihom sungin, Edomten Judah dounan gal ahin bollun, leng atum’in ahin kitundoh tauvin ahi.
en: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
text:
2KI 8:20
Thadou: Jehoram vaihom sungin, Edomten Judah dounan gal ahin bollun, leng atum’in ahin kitundoh tauvin ahi.
English: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

tcz: Hichun Jehoram in asakol kangtalai chengse chutoh akon un Zair khopi aga nokhum tauvin ahi. Ahin Edom miten asakol kangtalai chule gal lamkaiho chu ahin umkhum tauvin ahileh ama jong jan noiya chun apotdohin amaho chu jan muthim noija chun adelkhum min ahi. Ahinlah Jehoram chu asepaiten ajam sannun ainlam uvah ana jam san tauvin ahi.
en: Then Joram crossed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him; and he rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him with the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.
text:
2KI 8:21
Thadou: Hichun Jehoram in asakol kangtalai chengse chutoh akon un Zair khopi aga nokhum tauvin ahi. Ahin Edom miten asakol kangtalai chule gal lamkaiho chu ahin umkhum tauvin ahileh ama jong jan noiya chun apotdohin amaho chu jan muthim noija chun adelkhum min ahi. Ahinlah Jehoram chu asepaiten ajam sannun ainlam uvah ana jam san tauvin ahi.
English: Then Joram crossed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him; and he rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him with the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.

tcz: Hitihin Edom miten tuni changeiyin Judah a konin chamlhatna ana mutauvin ahi. Libnah khopi injong hichephat sunga chun kiphinna ahin neijun ahi.
en: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
text:
2KI 8:22
Thadou: Hitihin Edom miten tuni changeiyin Judah a konin chamlhatna ana mutauvin ahi. Libnah khopi injong hichephat sunga chun kiphinna ahin neijun ahi.
English: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

tcz: Jehoram vaihom sunga thilsoh holeh natoh dohho jouse Judah lengte thusim bua akijihlut soh keijin ahi.
en: The rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
text:
2KI 8:23
Thadou: Jehoram vaihom sunga thilsoh holeh natoh dohho jouse Judah lengte thusim bua akijihlut soh keijin ahi.
English: The rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

tcz: Jehoram athi phat chun, David khopia apu apate toh akivui khom’in ahi.
en: Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 8:24
Thadou: Jehoram athi phat chun, David khopia apu apate toh akivui khom’in ahi.
English: Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Ahab chapa Joram lengvai poh kum somle ni channa a hin, Jehoram chapa Ahaziah hin Judah chungah lengvai ana po in ahi.
en: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.
text:
2KI 8:25
Thadou: Ahab chapa Joram lengvai poh kum somle ni channa a hin, Jehoram chapa Ahaziah hin Judah chungah lengvai ana po in ahi.
English: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.

tcz: Ahaziah hi leng ahung chan chun ama kum somni le ni alhingin chuleh amahin, Jerusalem ah kum khat vai ana hom’in ahi. Anuchu Israel leng Omri tunu Athaliah ahi.
en: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.
text:
2KI 8:26
Thadou: Ahaziah hi leng ahung chan chun ama kum somni le ni alhingin chuleh amahin, Jerusalem ah kum khat vai ana hom’in ahi. Anuchu Israel leng Omri tunu Athaliah ahi.
English: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

tcz: Ahaziah chun Ahab lengpa insung mite chondan dihlou chu ana juiyin ahi. Aman Pakai mitmu’n thiphalou ngen ana bollin ahi. Ajeh chu aman Ahab insung ana kichenpi in ahi.
en: He walked in the way of Ahab’s house and did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for he was the son-in-law of Ahab’s house.
text:
2KI 8:27
