Thadou: Ahaziah chun Ahab lengpa insung mite chondan dihlou chu ana juiyin ahi. Aman Pakai mitmu’n thiphalou ngen ana bollin ahi. Ajeh chu aman Ahab insung ana kichenpi in ahi.
English: He walked in the way of Ahab’s house and did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for he was the son-in-law of Ahab’s house.

tcz: Ahaziah hin Israel lengpa Ahab chapa Joram chu Ramoth-gilead munnah Syria lengpa Hazael te kisat dingin ana pan khompi in ahi. Syriaten Joram lengpa chu gal kisatna munnah ana kisuhkhah jeh chun,
en: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram.
text:
2KI 8:28
Thadou: Ahaziah hin Israel lengpa Ahab chapa Joram chu Ramoth-gilead munnah Syria lengpa Hazael te kisat dingin ana pan khompi in ahi. Syriaten Joram lengpa chu gal kisatna munnah ana kisuhkhah jeh chun,
English: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram.

tcz: Jezreel langah akisuh khahna a adamna dingin ana kinunglen, Ramoth kho ah ana lamto un ahi. Hitia chu Joram ana kisuhkhah jeh'in, Judah lengpa Ahaziah chu ama veding in Jezreel langa anachen ahi.
en: King Joram returned to be healed in Jezreel from the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
text:
2KI 8:29
Thadou: Jezreel langah akisuh khahna a adamna dingin ana kinunglen, Ramoth kho ah ana lamto un ahi. Hitia chu Joram ana kisuhkhah jeh'in, Judah lengpa Ahaziah chu ama veding in Jezreel langa anachen ahi.
English: King Joram returned to be healed in Jezreel from the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

tcz: Alangkhat’ah Elisha themgaovin thempu kiloikhom ho lah a mikhat chu akouvin ama kom’ah chun, “Kholjin din kigon” chuleh, “Olive thao bom khat kichoijinlang Ramoth Gilead langa chen,
en: Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, “Put your belt on your waist, take this vial of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth Gilead.
text:
2KI 9:1
Thadou: Alangkhat’ah Elisha themgaovin thempu kiloikhom ho lah a mikhat chu akouvin ama kom’ah chun, “Kholjin din kigon” chuleh, “Olive thao bom khat kichoijinlang Ramoth Gilead langa chen,
English: Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, “Put your belt on your waist, take this vial of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth Gilead.

tcz: Hichea chun Nimshi chapa Jehoshaphat chapa Jehu chu gaholdoh inlang aloiho lah a konin indan sungnung khatna koulut in,
en: When you come there, find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in and make him rise up from among his brothers, and take him to an inner room.
text:
2KI 9:2
Thadou: Hichea chun Nimshi chapa Jehoshaphat chapa Jehu chu gaholdoh inlang aloiho lah a konin indan sungnung khatna koulut in,
English: When you come there, find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in and make him rise up from among his brothers, and take him to an inner room.

tcz: Chule aluchungah thao nunlang, hiti hin seipeh in, ‘Pakaiyin nanghi Israelte chunga leng dia thao kanu nahitai,’ tinlang chujoutengleh kot hong inlang nahinkho huhnan jamdoh loi jingin, tin aseije,” tipeh in
en: Then take the vial of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, ‘The LORD says, “I have anointed you king over Israel.”’ Then open the door, flee, and don’t wait.”
text:
2KI 9:3
Thadou: Chule aluchungah thao nunlang, hiti hin seipeh in, ‘Pakaiyin nanghi Israelte chunga leng dia thao kanu nahitai,’ tinlang chujoutengleh kot hong inlang nahinkho huhnan jamdoh loi jingin, tin aseije,” tipeh in
English: Then take the vial of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, ‘The LORD says, “I have anointed you king over Israel.”’ Then open the door, flee, and don’t wait.”

tcz: Hiti chun themgao gollhangpa chun akiseipeh bang bangin Ramoth Gilead lam’ah achetan ahi.
en: So the young man, the young prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.
text:
2KI 9:4
Thadou: Hiti chun themgao gollhangpa chun akiseipeh bang bangin Ramoth Gilead lam’ah achetan ahi.
English: So the young man, the young prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.

tcz: Ama hiche mun agalhun chun, Jehu chu sepai lamkai dang hotoh ana toukhompet un agamudoh in ahi. Hichun aman jong, “Keiman nang dingin thupeh khat kahinpoi, atileh keiho koipen dingin em?” tin Jehu chun ahin dongin ahi. “Lamkaipu nang ding ahi,” tin adonbut in ahi.
en: When he came, behold, the captains of the army were sitting. Then he said, “I have a message for you, captain.” Jehu said, “To which one of us?” He said, “To you, O captain.”
text:
2KI 9:5
Thadou: Ama hiche mun agalhun chun, Jehu chu sepai lamkai dang hotoh ana toukhompet un agamudoh in ahi. Hichun aman jong, “Keiman nang dingin thupeh khat kahinpoi, atileh keiho koipen dingin em?” tin Jehu chun ahin dongin ahi. “Lamkaipu nang ding ahi,” tin adonbut in ahi.
English: When he came, behold, the captains of the army were sitting. Then he said, “I have a message for you, captain.” Jehu said, “To which one of us?” He said, “To you, O captain.”

tcz: Hichun Jehu’n adangho chu ahindalhan insunga chun aluttan ahi. Hichun themgao gollhangpa chun Jehu luchunga chun thao asunglhan, hiti hin aseipeh tai, “Hichehi Israel Pakai Pathen in asei ahi, keiman Pakai mite Israel chunga leng ding’a thao kanu ahi,” ati.
en: He arose, and went into the house. Then he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have anointed you king over the people of the LORD, even over Israel.
text:
2KI 9:6
Thadou: Hichun Jehu’n adangho chu ahindalhan insunga chun aluttan ahi. Hichun themgao gollhangpa chun Jehu luchunga chun thao asunglhan, hiti hin aseipeh tai, “Hichehi Israel Pakai Pathen in asei ahi, keiman Pakai mite Israel chunga leng ding’a thao kanu ahi,” ati.
English: He arose, and went into the house. Then he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have anointed you king over the people of the LORD, even over Israel.

tcz: “Nangin napupa insung mite nasuhmang ding hitia chu keiman Jezebel in kathemgao hole Pakai sohte athagam na phu chu kalah ding ahi,” ati.
en: You must strike your master Ahab’s house, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, at the hand of Jezebel.
text:
2KI 9:7
Thadou: “Nangin napupa insung mite nasuhmang ding hitia chu keiman Jezebel in kathemgao hole Pakai sohte athagam na phu chu kalah ding ahi,” ati.
English: You must strike your master Ahab’s house, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, at the hand of Jezebel.

tcz: “Ahab insung mite jouse natha gam soh helding ahi. Keiman achilhah pasal jouse, asohte le asoh hilou pasal jouse Israelte chenna muntinna kasuh mangding ahi,” ati.
en: For the whole house of Ahab will perish. I will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, both him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.
text:
2KI 9:8
Thadou: “Ahab insung mite jouse natha gam soh helding ahi. Keiman achilhah pasal jouse, asohte le asoh hilou pasal jouse Israelte chenna muntinna kasuh mangding ahi,” ati.
English: For the whole house of Ahab will perish. I will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, both him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

tcz: “Keiman Nebat chapa Jeroboam insungleh Ahijah chapa Baasha insung kasuhmang banga Ahab insung jong kasuhmang ding ahi,” ati.
en: I will make Ahab’s house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.
text:
2KI 9:9
Thadou: “Keiman Nebat chapa Jeroboam insungleh Ahijah chapa Baasha insung kasuhmang banga Ahab insung jong kasuhmang ding ahi,” ati.
English: I will make Ahab’s house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.

tcz: Jezreel munna gambeh khatna Ahab jinu Jezebel chu uicha in anehding koiman ama nuchu avui louding’u ahi,” tin aseipeh tan ahi.
en: The dogs will eat Jezebel on the plot of ground of Jezreel, and there shall be no one to bury her.’” Then he opened the door and fled.
text:
2KI 9:10
Thadou: Jezreel munna gambeh khatna Ahab jinu Jezebel chu uicha in anehding koiman ama nuchu avui louding’u ahi,” tin aseipeh tan ahi.
English: The dogs will eat Jezebel on the plot of ground of Jezreel, and there shall be no one to bury her.’” Then he opened the door and fled.

tcz: Jehu chu asepai lamkaiho kom’a ahungki nungle kit in ahile amaho lah a mikhat chun, “Hiche mingolpa chun ipi asei ham? Aphamo umlouva hinam?” atileh, Jehu’n adonbut in “Hitobang miho thusei dingchu nahetsao hichula,” atin ahile amahon,
en: When Jehu came out to the servants of his lord and one said to him, “Is all well? Why did this madman come to you?” He said to them, “You know the man and how he talks.”
text:
2KI 9:11
Thadou: Jehu chu asepai lamkaiho kom’a ahungki nungle kit in ahile amaho lah a mikhat chun, “Hiche mingolpa chun ipi asei ham? Aphamo umlouva hinam?” atileh, Jehu’n adonbut in “Hitobang miho thusei dingchu nahetsao hichula,” atin ahile amahon,
English: When Jehu came out to the servants of his lord and one said to him, “Is all well? Why did this madman come to you?” He said to them, “You know the man and how he talks.”

tcz: “Nangin thilkhat na-im e, neiseipeh un,” atiuvin ahi. Hichun Jehu’n amaho chu aseipeh tan ahi, “Aman kakom’ah Pakaiyin hitin aseije, keiman nangma hi Israelte chunga leng dinga thao kanu nahitai,” atin ahi.
en: They said, “That is a lie. Tell us now.” He said, “He said to me, ‘The LORD says, I have anointed you king over Israel.’”
text:
2KI 9:12
Thadou: “Nangin thilkhat na-im e, neiseipeh un,” atiuvin ahi. Hichun Jehu’n amaho chu aseipeh tan ahi, “Aman kakom’ah Pakaiyin hitin aseije, keiman nangma hi Israelte chunga leng dinga thao kanu nahitai,” atin ahi.
English: They said, “That is a lie. Tell us now.” He said, “He said to me, ‘The LORD says, I have anointed you king over Israel.’”

tcz: Hichun amahon akengto noi uvah pon aphaovin kelchal ki amut’un, “Jehu leng ahitai!” atiuve.
en: Then they hurried, and each man took his cloak, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew the trumpet, saying, “Jehu is king.”
text:
2KI 9:13
Thadou: Hichun amahon akengto noi uvah pon aphaovin kelchal ki amut’un, “Jehu leng ahitai!” atiuve.
English: Then they hurried, and each man took his cloak, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew the trumpet, saying, “Jehu is king.”

tcz: Nimshi chapa Jehoshaphat chapa Jehu chun Joram lengpa dounan gal aboltan ahi. Joram hi Ramoth a Gilead munna Israelte huhna dia Syria lengpa Hazael sepaite toh kidouva umma ahi.
en: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram was defending Ramoth Gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria;

tcz: Ahinlah Joram lengpa chu gal kisatna a ana kisukha in, akisuhkhah naho kijen dam dingin Jezreel la kinunglea ahi. Hichun Jehu in akinaipi ho kom’a chun, “Nanghon leng dinga neidei uleh keiman thilsoh hohi Jezreel la miho agahet sah louna diuvin hiche khopia konin koima pot sah tahih un,” atin ahi.
en: but King Joram had returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) Jehu said, “If this is your thinking, then let no one escape and go out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.”
text:
2KI 9:15
Thadou: Ahinlah Joram lengpa chu gal kisatna a ana kisukha in, akisuhkhah naho kijen dam dingin Jezreel la kinunglea ahi. Hichun Jehu in akinaipi ho kom’a chun, “Nanghon leng dinga neidei uleh keiman thilsoh hohi Jezreel la miho agahet sah louna diuvin hiche khopia konin koima pot sah tahih un,” atin ahi.
English: but King Joram had returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) Jehu said, “If this is your thinking, then let no one escape and go out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.”

tcz: Hijou chun Jehu chu asakol kangtalai achun atouvin Jezreel munna damlouva kijenna um Joram kimutopi dingin achetan ahi. Judah lengpa Ahaziah jong hiche munna chu Joram vedinga ana che ahi.
en: So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel, for Joram lay there. Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.
text:
2KI 9:16
Thadou: Hijou chun Jehu chu asakol kangtalai achun atouvin Jezreel munna damlouva kijenna um Joram kimutopi dingin achetan ahi. Judah lengpa Ahaziah jong hiche munna chu Joram vedinga ana che ahi.
English: So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel, for Joram lay there. Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.

tcz: Jezreel kulpi chunga khosatna a konin khongahpan Jehu le aloiho chu ahung’uchu agalmun, Joram kom’a chun ahin sammin, “Keiman sepai honkhat ahung kamun ahi!” ati. Hichun Joram lengpan thu apen, sakol chung toukhat soldoh inlang chamna thudol a hung hinau vem gadohsah in,” ati.
en: Now the watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, “I see a company.” Joram said, “Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, ‘Is it peace?’”
text:
2KI 9:17
Thadou: Jezreel kulpi chunga khosatna a konin khongahpan Jehu le aloiho chu ahung’uchu agalmun, Joram kom’a chun ahin sammin, “Keiman sepai honkhat ahung kamun ahi!” ati. Hichun Joram lengpan thu apen, sakol chung toukhat soldoh inlang chamna thudol a hung hinau vem gadohsah in,” ati.
English: Now the watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, “I see a company.” Joram said, “Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, ‘Is it peace?’”

tcz: Hichun sakol toukhat alhaidoh in Jehu koma chun agadongin “Lengpan iti-dolla nahung ham? Chamna thudol a nahung hinam? Ahenom’e,” agatin ahileh Jehu’n adonbut in, “Chamna chu ipi ding nati ham? Neihin juitan,” ati. Hichun kho-ngahpan Joram lengpa kom’a chun, “Sottol pa chun amaho akimupin ahung kile tapoi,” tin aseipeh tai.
en: So one went on horseback to meet him, and said, “the king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu said, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!” The watchman said, “The messenger came to them, but he isn’t coming back.”
text:
2KI 9:18
Thadou: Hichun sakol toukhat alhaidoh in Jehu koma chun agadongin “Lengpan iti-dolla nahung ham? Chamna thudol a nahung hinam? Ahenom’e,” agatin ahileh Jehu’n adonbut in, “Chamna chu ipi ding nati ham? Neihin juitan,” ati. Hichun kho-ngahpan Joram lengpa kom’a chun, “Sottol pa chun amaho akimupin ahung kile tapoi,” tin aseipeh tai.
English: So one went on horseback to meet him, and said, “the king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu said, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!” The watchman said, “The messenger came to them, but he isn’t coming back.”

tcz: Hichun lengpan sakol chunga tou anichanna asoldoh kit’in, amachun akom uva, “Lengpan chamna thudol a nahung u hinam? Ahenom e,” tia agadoh a ahileh, Jehu’n adonbut in, “Chamna ipinga nati ham? Neihin juitan,” ati.
en: Then he sent out a second on horseback, who came to them and said, “The king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu answered, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!”
text:
2KI 9:19
Thadou: Hichun lengpan sakol chunga tou anichanna asoldoh kit’in, amachun akom uva, “Lengpan chamna thudol a nahung u hinam? Ahenom e,” tia agadoh a ahileh, Jehu’n adonbut in, “Chamna ipinga nati ham? Neihin juitan,” ati.
English: Then he sent out a second on horseback, who came to them and said, “The king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu answered, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!”

tcz: Hichun kho-ngahpa chun ahin sam’in, “Sottolpa chun amaho akimupin ahinla ama ahung kile tapoi! Ahunga khu Nimshi chapa Jehu toh abange, asakol tildankhu aham vevu jinge,” ati.
en: The watchman said, “He came to them, and isn’t coming back. The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously.”
text:
2KI 9:20
Thadou: Hichun kho-ngahpa chun ahin sam’in, “Sottolpa chun amaho akimupin ahinla ama ahung kile tapoi! Ahunga khu Nimshi chapa Jehu toh abange, asakol tildankhu aham vevu jinge,” ati.
English: The watchman said, “He came to them, and isn’t coming back. The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously.”

tcz: Hichun Joram lengpan thu apen “Gangtah in kasakol kangtalai chu gotsan koiyin!” ati. Hiche jouchun Israel lengpa Joram leh Judah lengpa Ahaziah chu Jehu toh kimuto dingin asakol kangtalai chungah ahung kijot doh lhonin ahi. Ama nin Jezreel munna Neboth gam munna chun agakimupi lhon tan ahi.
en: Joram said, “Get ready!” They got his chariot ready. Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot; and they went out to meet Jehu, and found him on Naboth the Jezreelite’s land.
text:
2KI 9:21
Thadou: Hichun Joram lengpan thu apen “Gangtah in kasakol kangtalai chu gotsan koiyin!” ati. Hiche jouchun Israel lengpa Joram leh Judah lengpa Ahaziah chu Jehu toh kimuto dingin asakol kangtalai chungah ahung kijot doh lhonin ahi. Ama nin Jezreel munna Neboth gam munna chun agakimupi lhon tan ahi.
English: Joram said, “Get ready!” They got his chariot ready. Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot; and they went out to meet Jehu, and found him on Naboth the Jezreelite’s land.

tcz: Joram lengpa in adongin, “Jehu chamna thudol a nahung hinam?” tia adohleh, Jehu’n, “Nanu Jezebel semthu pathen houna hole doithu sapna in in eium kimvel laiseuva chamna iti umthei ding ham?” tin ana donbut in ahi.
en: When Joram saw Jehu, he said, “Is it peace, Jehu?” He answered, “What peace, so long as the prostitution of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft abound?”
text:
2KI 9:22
Thadou: Joram lengpa in adongin, “Jehu chamna thudol a nahung hinam?” tia adohleh, Jehu’n, “Nanu Jezebel semthu pathen houna hole doithu sapna in in eium kimvel laiseuva chamna iti umthei ding ham?” tin ana donbut in ahi.
English: When Joram saw Jehu, he said, “Is it peace, Jehu?” He answered, “What peace, so long as the prostitution of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft abound?”

tcz: Hichun Joram lengpan sakol ale haijin ajam in, Ahaziah lengpa kom’ah “Leng mun chu ahi, Ahaziah!” atin ahi.
en: Joram turned his hands and fled, and said to Ahaziah, “This is treason, Ahaziah!”
text:
2KI 9:23
Thadou: Hichun Joram lengpan sakol ale haijin ajam in, Ahaziah lengpa kom’ah “Leng mun chu ahi, Ahaziah!” atin ahi.
English: Joram turned his hands and fled, and said to Ahaziah, “This is treason, Ahaziah!”

tcz: Ahin Jehu chun, athalpi a agah kap a ahileh, athalpi chang chu Joram lengkou teni kikah a alut in, hiche thalchang chun alungchangtah akhan asakol kangtalai chung’a chun alhu lhop in, athi dentan ahi.
en: Jehu drew his bow with his full strength, and struck Joram between his arms; and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.
text:
2KI 9:24
Thadou: Ahin Jehu chun, athalpi a agah kap a ahileh, athalpi chang chu Joram lengkou teni kikah a alut in, hiche thalchang chun alungchangtah akhan asakol kangtalai chung’a chun alhu lhop in, athi dentan ahi.
English: Jehu drew his bow with his full strength, and struck Joram between his arms; and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

tcz: Chuin Jehu chun anoija pipu pa, Bidkar kom’a chun, “Atahsa chu Jezreel la Naboth gambih sunga chun lehlut tan,” ati. “Apa Ahab nunga Sakol a ina lhailai chu nagel doh em? Pakaiyin ama douna a hitia hi ana phondoh sa ahitai,” ati.
en: Then Jehu said to Bidkar his captain, “Pick him up, and throw him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember how, when you and I rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden on him:
text:
2KI 9:25
Thadou: Chuin Jehu chun anoija pipu pa, Bidkar kom’a chun, “Atahsa chu Jezreel la Naboth gambih sunga chun lehlut tan,” ati. “Apa Ahab nunga Sakol a ina lhailai chu nagel doh em? Pakaiyin ama douna a hitia hi ana phondoh sa ahitai,” ati.
English: Then Jehu said to Bidkar his captain, “Pick him up, and throw him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember how, when you and I rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden on him:

tcz: “Pakaiyin, janhia Neboth le achate atha kamitchang tah a kamu jeh a, hiche gambeh chunga hi keiman aphu kalah ding ahi tin Pakaiyin ana kihahsel in ahi. Hijeh chun Pakaiyin aseibang bangin Naboth gamsung a chun lelut tan,” ati.
en: ‘Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons,’ says the LORD; ‘and I will repay you in this plot of ground,’ says the LORD. Now therefore take and cast him onto the plot of ground, according to the LORD’s word.”
text:
2KI 9:26
Thadou: “Pakaiyin, janhia Neboth le achate atha kamitchang tah a kamu jeh a, hiche gambeh chunga hi keiman aphu kalah ding ahi tin Pakaiyin ana kihahsel in ahi. Hijeh chun Pakaiyin aseibang bangin Naboth gamsung a chun lelut tan,” ati.
English: ‘Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons,’ says the LORD; ‘and I will repay you in this plot of ground,’ says the LORD. Now therefore take and cast him onto the plot of ground, according to the LORD’s word.”

tcz: Chuin Judah lengpa Ahaziah in thilsoh amu phat in, amajong Beth-haggen lamlen langa ajamtan ahi. Ahin Jehu’n amachu adallin, “Amajong kaplih un,” ati. Hiti chun amahon jong Ahaziah chu Ibleam koma um Gur lang kaltouna laitah a chun ana kaplhu un, ahin Megiddo geijin anajam phei peh in, hikomma chun ana thiden tan ahi.
en: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. Jehu followed after him, and said, “Strike him also in the chariot!” They struck him at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo, and died there.
text:
2KI 9:27
Thadou: Chuin Judah lengpa Ahaziah in thilsoh amu phat in, amajong Beth-haggen lamlen langa ajamtan ahi. Ahin Jehu’n amachu adallin, “Amajong kaplih un,” ati. Hiti chun amahon jong Ahaziah chu Ibleam koma um Gur lang kaltouna laitah a chun ana kaplhu un, ahin Megiddo geijin anajam phei peh in, hikomma chun ana thiden tan ahi.
English: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. Jehu followed after him, and said, “Strike him also in the chariot!” They struck him at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo, and died there.

tcz: Asohten athilong chu asakol kangtalai in apouvin, Jerusalem alhut un David khopia apu apate kivuina a avui tauvin ahi.
en: His servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in David’s city.
text:
2KI 9:28
Thadou: Asohten athilong chu asakol kangtalai in apouvin, Jerusalem alhut un David khopia apu apate kivuina a avui tauvin ahi.
English: His servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in David’s city.

tcz: Ahab chapa Joram lengvaipoh kal kum somle khat lhin kum chun Ahaziah chu Judah chunga leng ana chang in ahi.
en: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.
text:
2KI 9:29
Thadou: Ahab chapa Joram lengvaipoh kal kum somle khat lhin kum chun Ahaziah chu Judah chunga leng ana chang in ahi.
English: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.

tcz: Chuin Lengpa nu Jezebel chun Jehu chu Jezreel lah ahunge tithu ajah phat chun amit teni ajem hoisel in, asam akipojolsel in, bangkot a akonin agahven ahi.
en: When Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked out at the window.
text:
2KI 9:30
Thadou: Chuin Lengpa nu Jezebel chun Jehu chu Jezreel lah ahunge tithu ajah phat chun amit teni ajem hoisel in, asam akipojolsel in, bangkot a akonin agahven ahi.
English: When Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked out at the window.

tcz: Jehu chu khopi kelkot ahunglut jouchun, amanun jong hasap in ahinsam in, “Tolthatpa chamna thudol a hung nahi hinai mo? Apupa Zimri thatpa tobang nahi,” ati.
en: As Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, “Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?”
text:
2KI 9:31
Thadou: Jehu chu khopi kelkot ahunglut jouchun, amanun jong hasap in ahinsam in, “Tolthatpa chamna thudol a hung nahi hinai mo? Apupa Zimri thatpa tobang nahi,” ati.
English: As Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, “Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?”

tcz: Jehu chun chunglang agahvet leh bangkot a chun amanu agah mun, hitin asam in ahi, “Keilam a panga koi koi nahiuvem?” tia agah sap le, nukiso mi nile thum'in ahin veuvin ahi.
en: He lifted up his face to the window, and said, “Who is on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.
text:
2KI 9:32
Thadou: Jehu chun chunglang agahvet leh bangkot a chun amanu agah mun, hitin asam in ahi, “Keilam a panga koi koi nahiuvem?” tia agah sap le, nukiso mi nile thum'in ahin veuvin ahi.
English: He lifted up his face to the window, and said, “Who is on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.

tcz: Hichun Jehu’n jong, “Amanu chu hinsep lhaovin,” atin ahileh amanu chu bangkota konin ahin sonlhauvin, athisan chu bang hole sakol chungah chun akithe tho jingin ahi. Jehu’n atouna keng’ah chun achon mat jingin ahi.
en: He said, “Throw her down!” So they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses. Then he trampled her under foot.
text:
2KI 9:33
Thadou: Hichun Jehu’n jong, “Amanu chu hinsep lhaovin,” atin ahileh amanu chu bangkota konin ahin sonlhauvin, athisan chu bang hole sakol chungah chun akithe tho jingin ahi. Jehu’n atouna keng’ah chun achon mat jingin ahi.
English: He said, “Throw her down!” So they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses. Then he trampled her under foot.

tcz: Chuin Jehu chu khopi sunga chu alut’in, anen adon’in ahi. Hiche jouchun, “Khattou cheuvin lang sapset chang hiche numei nu hi gavui tauvin, ajeh chu amahi leng chanu ahi,” ati.
en: When he had come in, he ate and drank. Then he said, “See now to this cursed woman, and bury her; for she is a king’s daughter.”
text:
2KI 9:34
Thadou: Chuin Jehu chu khopi sunga chu alut’in, anen adon’in ahi. Hiche jouchun, “Khattou cheuvin lang sapset chang hiche numei nu hi gavui tauvin, ajeh chu amahi leng chanu ahi,” ati.
English: When he had come in, he ate and drank. Then he said, “See now to this cursed woman, and bury her; for she is a king’s daughter.”

tcz: Ahin amaho chu avui ding’a achedoh uleh, amahon, alugu, akeng chuleh akhut teni tilou adang amu tapouvin ahi.
en: They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands.
text:
2KI 9:35
Thadou: Ahin amaho chu avui ding’a achedoh uleh, amahon, alugu, akeng chuleh akhut teni tilou adang amu tapouvin ahi.
English: They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands.

tcz: Chuin amaho ahung kile uvin Jehu kom’a aseijun ahileh, “Pakaiyin Tishbe khoa alhachapa Elijah kom’a anasei chu guilhung ahi tai, Jezreel khosung’a Jezebel tahsa hi uichan aneh hiding ahi,” atia ana chu ana hilchen in ahi.
en: Therefore they came back, and told him. He said, “This is the LORD’s word, which he spoke by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, ‘The dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel on the plot of Jezreel,
text:
2KI 9:36
Thadou: Chuin amaho ahung kile uvin Jehu kom’a aseijun ahileh, “Pakaiyin Tishbe khoa alhachapa Elijah kom’a anasei chu guilhung ahi tai, Jezreel khosung’a Jezebel tahsa hi uichan aneh hiding ahi,” atia ana chu ana hilchen in ahi.
English: Therefore they came back, and told him. He said, “This is the LORD’s word, which he spoke by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, ‘The dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel on the plot of Jezreel,

tcz: “Chujongle Jezebel tahsa chu Jezreel khosung’a chu jun le eh banga kithecheh ding, koimachan hiche hi Jezebel kitinu chu ahi tia ahetdoh lou ding’u ahi,” ati.
en: and the body of Jezebel will be as dung on the surface of the field on Jezreel’s land, so that they won’t say, “This is Jezebel.”’”
text:
2KI 9:37
Thadou: “Chujongle Jezebel tahsa chu Jezreel khosung’a chu jun le eh banga kithecheh ding, koimachan hiche hi Jezebel kitinu chu ahi tia ahetdoh lou ding’u ahi,” ati.
English: and the body of Jezebel will be as dung on the surface of the field on Jezreel’s land, so that they won’t say, “This is Jezebel.”’”

tcz: Ahab in cha som sagi aneiyin amaho chu Samaria khopi sunga achengun ahi. Hichun Jehu in Samaria khopi sunga upa ho le lamkai pipu hokom leh Ahab chate chingtup ho kom mah lekha anathot’in hitin aseije,
en: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, even the elders, and to those who brought up Ahab’s sons, saying,
text:
2KI 10:1
Thadou: Ahab in cha som sagi aneiyin amaho chu Samaria khopi sunga achengun ahi. Hichun Jehu in Samaria khopi sunga upa ho le lamkai pipu hokom leh Ahab chate chingtup ho kom mah lekha anathot’in hitin aseije,
English: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, even the elders, and to those who brought up Ahab’s sons, saying,

tcz: “Leng chate chu nakom uvah aum’in, chule sakol kangtalai holeh sakol ho chujongleh kul kigetkhum khopi le manchah ho jong nangho khutna aum’in ahi. Hiche lekha hi namu phat phat uleh,
en: “Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armor,
text:
2KI 10:2
Thadou: “Leng chate chu nakom uvah aum’in, chule sakol kangtalai holeh sakol ho chujongleh kul kigetkhum khopi le manchah ho jong nangho khutna aum’in ahi. Hiche lekha hi namu phat phat uleh,
English: “Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armor,

tcz: Napu chapate lah a chun alolhing pentah khat nalengpa diuvin lhengdoh uvin lang chutengle, Ahab son le pahte huhna-a galsat dingin ana kigongun,” atin ahi.
en: select the best and fittest of your master’s sons, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.”
text:
2KI 10:3
Thadou: Napu chapate lah a chun alolhing pentah khat nalengpa diuvin lhengdoh uvin lang chutengle, Ahab son le pahte huhna-a galsat dingin ana kigongun,” atin ahi.
English: select the best and fittest of your master’s sons, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.”

tcz: Ahinlah amaho kichatna adimjing tauvin, “Hichepa masanga hin lengni ana ding joupoi ti eihon iheuvin ahi! Achutia ahileh eihon ipi iboljou diu ham?” aki tiuvin ahi.
en: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, “Behold, the two kings didn’t stand before him! How then shall we stand?”
text:
2KI 10:4
Thadou: Ahinlah amaho kichatna adimjing tauvin, “Hichepa masanga hin lengni ana ding joupoi ti eihon iheuvin ahi! Achutia ahileh eihon ipi iboljou diu ham?” aki tiuvin ahi.
English: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, “Behold, the two kings didn’t stand before him! How then shall we stand?”

tcz: Hijehchun, leng inpileh khopi sunga vaihom holeh upa ho, chuleh lengpa chapate vesui’a panghon Jehu kom’ah hitin lekha ana thot’un ahi. “Keihohi nasohte kahiuvin nangin bollin nati ti chu bolding kahiuve. Keihon koima leng dingin koima lheng pouvinge. Ipi hijongleh nangin phante natiti chu bol jingin atiuvin,” ahi.
en: He who was over the household, and he who was over the city, the elders also, and those who raised the children, sent to Jehu, saying, “We are your servants, and will do all that you ask us. We will not make any man king. You do that which is good in your eyes.”
text:
2KI 10:5
Thadou: Hijehchun, leng inpileh khopi sunga vaihom holeh upa ho, chuleh lengpa chapate vesui’a panghon Jehu kom’ah hitin lekha ana thot’un ahi. “Keihohi nasohte kahiuvin nangin bollin nati ti chu bolding kahiuve. Keihon koima leng dingin koima lheng pouvinge. Ipi hijongleh nangin phante natiti chu bol jingin atiuvin,” ahi.
English: He who was over the household, and he who was over the city, the elders also, and those who raised the children, sent to Jehu, saying, “We are your servants, and will do all that you ask us. We will not make any man king. You do that which is good in your eyes.”

tcz: Jehu’n anichan na in adonbutna lekha athotnin, “Nangho keilanga napan uva, kathu nangai diuleh napupau chapate luchangho chu Jezreel mun’ah jing tuphat donleh hinpouvin,” atin ahi. Hiche leng chapate som sagi hohi aneolai uva patna Samaria lamkai hohin kahin khoukhah u ahi
en: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, “If you are on my side, and if you will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men who are your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by tomorrow this time.” Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who brought them up.
text:
2KI 10:6
Thadou: Jehu’n anichan na in adonbutna lekha athotnin, “Nangho keilanga napan uva, kathu nangai diuleh napupau chapate luchangho chu Jezreel mun’ah jing tuphat donleh hinpouvin,” atin ahi. Hiche leng chapate som sagi hohi aneolai uva patna Samaria lamkai hohin kahin khoukhah u ahi
English: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, “If you are on my side, and if you will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men who are your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by tomorrow this time.” Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who brought them up.

tcz: Hiche lekha chu ahung lhun phat in leng chapate som sagi hochu lamkai hon athat tauvin ahi. Amahon aluchangu chu pocha sunga aheng’un, Jezreel munna Jehu kom’achun ahin pelut tauvin ahi.
en: When the letter came to them, they took the king’s sons and killed them, even seventy people, and put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him to Jezreel.
text:
2KI 10:7
Thadou: Hiche lekha chu ahung lhun phat in leng chapate som sagi hochu lamkai hon athat tauvin ahi. Amahon aluchangu chu pocha sunga aheng’un, Jezreel munna Jehu kom’achun ahin pelut tauvin ahi.
English: When the letter came to them, they took the king’s sons and killed them, even seventy people, and put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him to Jezreel.

tcz: Sottole ho lah a khat chu, “Leng chapate luchang chu ahinpo tauve,” tin Jehu koma ahung seitauve. Jehu’n thu apen, lomni in se uvin lang khopi lutna kelkot achun koi unlang jingkah hunglhun tokah in hilaichun dalha tauvin,” ati.
en: A messenger came and told him, “They have brought the heads of the king’s sons.” He said, “Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning.”
text:
2KI 10:8
Thadou: Sottole ho lah a khat chu, “Leng chapate luchang chu ahinpo tauve,” tin Jehu koma ahung seitauve. Jehu’n thu apen, lomni in se uvin lang khopi lutna kelkot achun koi unlang jingkah hunglhun tokah in hilaichun dalha tauvin,” ati.
English: A messenger came and told him, “They have brought the heads of the king’s sons.” He said, “Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning.”

tcz: Ajing nikho jingkah in ama apotdohin avella hung kikhom mipiho lah’a chun ahoulim in, aman amaho kom’a chun, “Nangho koimachan thepmona nanei pouve, kapupa douna a thilgong le athat a chu keima kahi. Ahinlah ama ho cheng hi koitha hija ham?,” atin ahi.
en: In the morning, he went out and stood, and said to all the people, “You are righteous. Behold, I conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?
text:
2KI 10:9
Thadou: Ajing nikho jingkah in ama apotdohin avella hung kikhom mipiho lah’a chun ahoulim in, aman amaho kom’a chun, “Nangho koimachan thepmona nanei pouve, kapupa douna a thilgong le athat a chu keima kahi. Ahinlah ama ho cheng hi koitha hija ham?,” atin ahi.
English: In the morning, he went out and stood, and said to all the people, “You are righteous. Behold, I conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?

tcz: “Pakaiyin Ahab insungmite chung chang ana phondoh hochu guilhung teiding ahi ti nanghon naheuve. Pakaiyin asohpa Elijah mangcha a hiche thilsoh dinghi ana phondohsa ahitai,” ati.
en: Know now that nothing will fall to the earth of the LORD’s word, which the LORD spoke concerning Ahab’s house. For the LORD has done that which he spoke by his servant Elijah.”
text:
2KI 10:10
Thadou: “Pakaiyin Ahab insungmite chung chang ana phondoh hochu guilhung teiding ahi ti nanghon naheuve. Pakaiyin asohpa Elijah mangcha a hiche thilsoh dinghi ana phondohsa ahitai,” ati.
English: Know now that nothing will fall to the earth of the LORD’s word, which the LORD spoke concerning Ahab’s house. For the LORD has done that which he spoke by his servant Elijah.”

tcz: Hijou chun Jehu in Jezreel sunga cheng Ahab insung mite jouse, anoija natong lamkai pipui ho jouse, aman ana kigolngaipi leh athempu ho jouse athatgam sohkei tan ahi. Hiti chun Ahab kitipahi ason apah khatcha ahingah aum tapon ahi.
en: So Jehu struck all that remained of Ahab’s house in Jezreel, with all his great men, his familiar friends, and his priests, until he left him no one remaining.
text:
2KI 10:11
Thadou: Hijou chun Jehu in Jezreel sunga cheng Ahab insung mite jouse, anoija natong lamkai pipui ho jouse, aman ana kigolngaipi leh athempu ho jouse athatgam sohkei tan ahi. Hiti chun Ahab kitipahi ason apah khatcha ahingah aum tapon ahi.
English: So Jehu struck all that remained of Ahab’s house in Jezreel, with all his great men, his familiar friends, and his priests, until he left him no one remaining.

tcz: Hiche jou hin Jehu chun Samaria lang ana jontan ahi. Aman akalson na-ah kelngoi chingho Beth-eked munnah,
en: He arose and departed, and went to Samaria. As he was at the shearing house of the shepherds on the way,
text:
2KI 10:12
Thadou: Hiche jou hin Jehu chun Samaria lang ana jontan ahi. Aman akalson na-ah kelngoi chingho Beth-eked munnah,
English: He arose and departed, and went to Samaria. As he was at the shearing house of the shepherds on the way,

tcz: Judah lengpa Ahaziah insung mite toh akimuto uvin, aman, “Koi nahiuvem?” tia adohleh, amahon keihohi, “Leng Ahaziah sopite ho kahiuvin, Ahab lengpa chapate hole lengpa anu chapate ho villa kahung u ahi,” atiuve.
en: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, “Who are you?” They answered, “We are the brothers of Ahaziah. We are going down to greet the children of the king and the children of the queen.”
text:
2KI 10:13
Thadou: Judah lengpa Ahaziah insung mite toh akimuto uvin, aman, “Koi nahiuvem?” tia adohleh, amahon keihohi, “Leng Ahaziah sopite ho kahiuvin, Ahab lengpa chapate hole lengpa anu chapate ho villa kahung u ahi,” atiuve.
English: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, “Who are you?” They answered, “We are the brothers of Ahaziah. We are going down to greet the children of the king and the children of the queen.”

tcz: Hichun Jehu’n asepaite kom’a chun, ahing’a amat diuvin thu apen, chuin amahon mi somlile chu aman un, Beth-eked twikul munna chun athatgam tauvin, khatcha jong ana hinghoi pouvin ahi.
en: He said, “Take them alive!” They took them alive, and killed them at the pit of the shearing house, even forty-two men. He didn’t leave any of them.
text:
2KI 10:14
Thadou: Hichun Jehu’n asepaite kom’a chun, ahing’a amat diuvin thu apen, chuin amahon mi somlile chu aman un, Beth-eked twikul munna chun athatgam tauvin, khatcha jong ana hinghoi pouvin ahi.
English: He said, “Take them alive!” They took them alive, and killed them at the pit of the shearing house, even forty-two men. He didn’t leave any of them.

tcz: Jehu in hilai munchu agah dalhah phat’in, Recab chapa Jehonadab chun ahung kimupin ahi. Amani akichibai jou lhonin Jehu in akom’ah, “Keima nang kom’a kakitah banga nang jong kei kom’a nakitah hinam?” atileh, Jehonadab in jong, “Kakitahnai,” ati phat in Jehu in jong, “Chuti ahileh nakhut neihinpen,” ati ahileh, Jehonabab minjong akhut ahinpen ahileh Jehu in jong asakol kangtalai chungah agah kaidohin,
en: When he had departed from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him. He greeted him, and said to him, “Is your heart right, as my heart is with your heart?” Jehonadab answered, “It is.” “If it is, give me your hand.” He gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.
text:
2KI 10:15
Thadou: Jehu in hilai munchu agah dalhah phat’in, Recab chapa Jehonadab chun ahung kimupin ahi. Amani akichibai jou lhonin Jehu in akom’ah, “Keima nang kom’a kakitah banga nang jong kei kom’a nakitah hinam?” atileh, Jehonadab in jong, “Kakitahnai,” ati phat in Jehu in jong, “Chuti ahileh nakhut neihinpen,” ati ahileh, Jehonabab minjong akhut ahinpen ahileh Jehu in jong asakol kangtalai chungah agah kaidohin,
English: When he had departed from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him. He greeted him, and said to him, “Is your heart right, as my heart is with your heart?” Jehonadab answered, “It is.” “If it is, give me your hand.” He gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

tcz: Jehu in akom’a aseijin, “Tun hungin Pakaija katomngaina hung vetan,” ati. Hiti chun Jehonadab toh akilhonkhom lhon tai.
en: He said, “Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD.” So they made him ride in his chariot.
text:
2KI 10:16
Thadou: Jehu in akom’a aseijin, “Tun hungin Pakaija katomngaina hung vetan,” ati. Hiti chun Jehonadab toh akilhonkhom lhon tai.
English: He said, “Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD.” So they made him ride in his chariot.

tcz: Jehu Samaria agalhun phat’in Ahab insungmi amoh ana-umnalai hochu abonchan athat sohkeijin ahi. Hiche Pakaiyin Elijah themgao mangcha’a ama kitepna dungjuija chu atoh ahi.
en: When he came to Samaria, he struck all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, until he had destroyed them, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke to Elijah.
text:
2KI 10:17
Thadou: Jehu Samaria agalhun phat’in Ahab insungmi amoh ana-umnalai hochu abonchan athat sohkeijin ahi. Hiche Pakaiyin Elijah themgao mangcha’a ama kitepna dungjuija chu atoh ahi.
English: When he came to Samaria, he struck all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, until he had destroyed them, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke to Elijah.

tcz: Hijou chun khopi sunga mipiho jouse chu akou khom’in akom uvah ajah uvah, “Ahab in Baal doi ana hou chutoh keiman kahou didan chutoh kibang maiding ahipoi,” ati.
en: Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much.
text:
2KI 10:18
Thadou: Hijou chun khopi sunga mipiho jouse chu akou khom’in akom uvah ajah uvah, “Ahab in Baal doi ana hou chutoh keiman kahou didan chutoh kibang maiding ahipoi,” ati.
English: Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much.

tcz: Hijeh chun Baal doi hou holeh thempuho chuleh themgaoho akoukhom soh keijun. Baal hou jouse chu koima panda thei ponte, ahung kim sohkei nadiuvin ana chinglhi in ahi. Ajeh chu aman, “Keiman Baal doilim houna a hi kilhaina thupitah kabolding ahi,” ati. Ahinlah Jehu chun Baal doi houho jouse suhmangna dinga doha thuhtah agonjoh ahi.
en: Now therefore call to me all the prophets of Baal, all of his worshipers, and all of his priests. Let no one be absent, for I have a great sacrifice to Baal. Whoever is absent, he shall not live.” But Jehu did deceptively, intending to destroy the worshipers of Baal.
text:
2KI 10:19
Thadou: Hijeh chun Baal doi hou holeh thempuho chuleh themgaoho akoukhom soh keijun. Baal hou jouse chu koima panda thei ponte, ahung kim sohkei nadiuvin ana chinglhi in ahi. Ajeh chu aman, “Keiman Baal doilim houna a hi kilhaina thupitah kabolding ahi,” ati. Ahinlah Jehu chun Baal doi houho jouse suhmangna dinga doha thuhtah agonjoh ahi.
English: Now therefore call to me all the prophets of Baal, all of his worshipers, and all of his priests. Let no one be absent, for I have a great sacrifice to Baal. Whoever is absent, he shall not live.” But Jehu did deceptively, intending to destroy the worshipers of Baal.

tcz: Hichun Jehu in Baal doi houna dingin mipi kikhopna thupitah gong’un tin thu apen, hiti chun mipi hon jong agongun ahi.
en: Jehu said, “Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal!” So they proclaimed it.
text:
2KI 10:20
Thadou: Hichun Jehu in Baal doi houna dingin mipi kikhopna thupitah gong’un tin thu apen, hiti chun mipi hon jong agongun ahi.
English: Jehu said, “Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal!” So they proclaimed it.

tcz: Aman Israelte chenna gam pumpia Baal houho gakoukhom dingin mi asollin ahi. Hijeh chun Baal doi hou ho jong akidalha khatcha jong um louvin ahung soh keijun ahi. Hiti chun Baal doi houna hou-in chu muntin alodimsoh hel jingun ahi.
en: Jehu sent through all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that didn’t come. They came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was filled from one end to another.
text:
2KI 10:21
Thadou: Aman Israelte chenna gam pumpia Baal houho gakoukhom dingin mi asollin ahi. Hijeh chun Baal doi hou ho jong akidalha khatcha jong um louvin ahung soh keijun ahi. Hiti chun Baal doi houna hou-in chu muntin alodimsoh hel jingun ahi.
English: Jehu sent through all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that didn’t come. They came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was filled from one end to another.

tcz: Jehu in Vonchol vesuipa jah’a chun, Baal doi houva hung jousen hiche ponchol hi khatjoh joh akivon tei dingin aseipeh in ahi. Hijeh chun aman jong ponchol chu ahomdoh tan ahi.
en: He said to him who kept the wardrobe, “Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal!” So he brought robes out to them.
text:
2KI 10:22
Thadou: Jehu in Vonchol vesuipa jah’a chun, Baal doi houva hung jousen hiche ponchol hi khatjoh joh akivon tei dingin aseipeh in ahi. Hijeh chun aman jong ponchol chu ahomdoh tan ahi.
English: He said to him who kept the wardrobe, “Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal!” So he brought robes out to them.

tcz: Hijou chun Jehu chu Recab chapa Jehonadab chutoh Baal doi houna in na chun alut lhon tan ahi. Jehu in Baal doi hou ho kom’a chun, “Hiche munna hi Baal doi houho bou umding ahi, ahinla Pakai houho vang naum sahlou heldiu ahi,” ati.
en: Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal. Then he said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search, and see that none of the servants of the LORD are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal.”
text:
2KI 10:23
Thadou: Hijou chun Jehu chu Recab chapa Jehonadab chutoh Baal doi houna in na chun alut lhon tan ahi. Jehu in Baal doi hou ho kom’a chun, “Hiche munna hi Baal doi houho bou umding ahi, ahinla Pakai houho vang naum sahlou heldiu ahi,” ati.
English: Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal. Then he said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search, and see that none of the servants of the LORD are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal.”

tcz: Hiti chun amaho chu kithoina gantha dingleh hal namna boldingin houin sunga chun adimset jeng tauvin ahi. Jehuin amite som get ho chu phatah’in ahilchah in inpolang’a chun aumsah tan ahi. Chuin Jehu in ajah uvah, “Ama hohi khat nalhaso jong uleh nahinkhou kilading ahi,” atipeh tan ahi.
en: So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had appointed for himself eighty men outside, and said, “If any of the men whom I bring into your hands escape, he who lets him go, his life shall be for the life of him.”
text:
2KI 10:24
Thadou: Hiti chun amaho chu kithoina gantha dingleh hal namna boldingin houin sunga chun adimset jeng tauvin ahi. Jehuin amite som get ho chu phatah’in ahilchah in inpolang’a chun aumsah tan ahi. Chuin Jehu in ajah uvah, “Ama hohi khat nalhaso jong uleh nahinkhou kilading ahi,” atipeh tan ahi.
English: So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had appointed for himself eighty men outside, and said, “If any of the men whom I bring into your hands escape, he who lets him go, his life shall be for the life of him.”

tcz: Jehu in kilhaina gantha leh halnam chu achaiphat’in ama noija lamkai holeh sepaiho chu thu apepaijin, “Lut unlang abonchauvin thatgam tauvin khatcha jamdoh sah hihun,” ati. Hichun amaho jong alut’un, achemjam’un athat gam tauvin ahi. Lamkai holeh sepaiho chun atahsa uchu polang’a ahin kaidoh’un ahi. Hiche jouchun Jehu mite chu houin sungnung munthenga chun alut’un,
en: As soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, “Go in and kill them! Let no one escape.” So they struck them with the edge of the sword. The guard and the captains threw the bodies out, and went to the inner shrine of the house of Baal.
text:
2KI 10:25
Thadou: Jehu in kilhaina gantha leh halnam chu achaiphat’in ama noija lamkai holeh sepaiho chu thu apepaijin, “Lut unlang abonchauvin thatgam tauvin khatcha jamdoh sah hihun,” ati. Hichun amaho jong alut’un, achemjam’un athat gam tauvin ahi. Lamkai holeh sepaiho chun atahsa uchu polang’a ahin kaidoh’un ahi. Hiche jouchun Jehu mite chu houin sungnung munthenga chun alut’un,
English: As soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, “Go in and kill them! Let no one escape.” So they struck them with the edge of the sword. The guard and the captains threw the bodies out, and went to the inner shrine of the house of Baal.

tcz: Amahon Baal doi ahounau adoikhomho jouse jong ahin pudoh’un ahal lha tauvin ahi.
en: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal and burned them.
text:
2KI 10:26
Thadou: Amahon Baal doi ahounau adoikhomho jouse jong ahin pudoh’un ahal lha tauvin ahi.
English: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal and burned them.

tcz: Amahon ahin putdoh u Baal houna doikhomho jouse jong chu avochip’un Baal hou in jong avolhu uvin mipi ehbuh in amang’un tuni geijin akimang nalaijin ahi.
en: They broke down the pillar of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a latrine, to this day.
text:
2KI 10:27
Thadou: Amahon ahin putdoh u Baal houna doikhomho jouse jong chu avochip’un Baal hou in jong avolhu uvin mipi ehbuh in amang’un tuni geijin akimang nalaijin ahi.
English: They broke down the pillar of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a latrine, to this day.

tcz: Hiti hin Jehu in Israelte lah’a konin Baal doi kihouna jouse chu ana subeijin ahi.
en: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
text:
2KI 10:28
Thadou: Hiti hin Jehu in Israelte lah’a konin Baal doi kihouna jouse chu ana subeijin ahi.
English: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

tcz: Ahinlah aman Bethel leh Daan akona Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israel mite chonset na a anapuilut na sana kisem bongnou lim houna chu ana sumang tapon ahi.
en: However, Jehu didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin—the golden calves that were in Bethel and that were in Dan.
text:
2KI 10:29
Thadou: Ahinlah aman Bethel leh Daan akona Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israel mite chonset na a anapuilut na sana kisem bongnou lim houna chu ana sumang tapon ahi.
English: However, Jehu didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin—the golden calves that were in Bethel and that were in Dan.

tcz: Ahijingvang’in Pakaiyin Jehu kom’ah, “Kathupeh nanitna Ahab insung nasuhmang jeh'in nabol phalheh jinge. Hijeh chun nachilhah ten khang li geija lengmun ahinlo diu ahi,” atipeh tai.
en: The LORD said to Jehu, “Because you have done well in executing that which is right in my eyes, and have done to Ahab’s house according to all that was in my heart, your descendants shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.”
text:
2KI 10:30
Thadou: Ahijingvang’in Pakaiyin Jehu kom’ah, “Kathupeh nanitna Ahab insung nasuhmang jeh'in nabol phalheh jinge. Hijeh chun nachilhah ten khang li geija lengmun ahinlo diu ahi,” atipeh tai.
English: The LORD said to Jehu, “Because you have done well in executing that which is right in my eyes, and have done to Ahab’s house according to all that was in my heart, your descendants shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.”

tcz: Ahinlah Jehu Pakai Israel Pathen danthu chu alungthim pumpin ananitpon ahi. Jeroboam min Israelte anachonset sahna a konin kile hei sahding ana gopon ahi.
en: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin.
text:
2KI 10:31
Thadou: Ahinlah Jehu Pakai Israel Pathen danthu chu alungthim pumpin ananitpon ahi. Jeroboam min Israelte anachonset sahna a konin kile hei sahding ana gopon ahi.
English: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin.

tcz: Hiche phatlaitah chun Pakaiyin Israel lenggam chu ana lhehkeh pantan ahi. Hazael lengpan hiche gam chu mun phabep ana gal in ana kilah tan ahi.
en: In those days the LORD began to cut away parts of Israel; and Hazael struck them in all the borders of Israel
text:
2KI 10:32
Thadou: Hiche phatlaitah chun Pakaiyin Israel lenggam chu ana lhehkeh pantan ahi. Hazael lengpan hiche gam chu mun phabep ana gal in ana kilah tan ahi.
English: In those days the LORD began to cut away parts of Israel; and Hazael struck them in all the borders of Israel

tcz: Agamlah hochu solang Jordan napat Gilead gampump, Gad gam pumpi, Reuben leh Manasseh gam pumpi ahop’in ahi. Aman Aroer khopi a patnin Arnon phaicham akon’in sahlang gamkaija Gilead leh Bashan changei ana lan ahi.
en: from the Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.
text:
2KI 10:33
Thadou: Agamlah hochu solang Jordan napat Gilead gampump, Gad gam pumpi, Reuben leh Manasseh gam pumpi ahop’in ahi. Aman Aroer khopi a patnin Arnon phaicham akon’in sahlang gamkaija Gilead leh Bashan changei ana lan ahi.
English: from the Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

tcz: Hiche banna Jehu vaihom sunga thilsoh hojouse, athibol hole atohdoh ho jouse chu Israel Lengte thusim kijihlutna lekhabua akijih lut sohkei jin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
text:
2KI 10:34
Thadou: Hiche banna Jehu vaihom sunga thilsoh hojouse, athibol hole atohdoh ho jouse chu Israel Lengte thusim kijihlutna lekhabua akijih lut sohkei jin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

tcz: Jehu athi phat in, Samaria khopiah avuijun ahi. Ama jouchun achapa Jeho-ahaz chu leng ahung chang tan ahi.
en: Jehu slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria. Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 10:35
Thadou: Jehu athi phat in, Samaria khopiah avuijun ahi. Ama jouchun achapa Jeho-ahaz chu leng ahung chang tan ahi.
English: Jehu slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria. Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Jehu hin Samaria a konin Israel chunga chun kum somni le get vai anahom in ahi.
en: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.
text:
2KI 10:36
Thadou: Jehu hin Samaria a konin Israel chunga chun kum somni le get vai anahom in ahi.
English: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.

tcz: Judah lengpa Ahaziah nu Athaliah chun, achapa thi ahetdoh phat’in, aman leng insung mite jouse chu suhmanghel ding ana gotan ahi.
en: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring.
text:
2KI 11:1
Thadou: Judah lengpa Ahaziah nu Athaliah chun, achapa thi ahetdoh phat’in, aman leng insung mite jouse chu suhmanghel ding ana gotan ahi.
English: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring.

tcz: Ahinlah Ahaziah sopinu Jehosheba Jehoram lengpa chanu chun, Ahaziah chapa Joash chu chapang cha ana hi nalaijin, leng insung mite jouse thagam ding thu ajahdoh phat in Joash chu ana guhdoh’a ahin sintou nu chutoh alupna insung dan sunga chun ana sellin, Athaliah khutthah a kon chun ana huhdoh in ahi.
en: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.
text:
2KI 11:2
Thadou: Ahinlah Ahaziah sopinu Jehosheba Jehoram lengpa chanu chun, Ahaziah chapa Joash chu chapang cha ana hi nalaijin, leng insung mite jouse thagam ding thu ajahdoh phat in Joash chu ana guhdoh’a ahin sintou nu chutoh alupna insung dan sunga chun ana sellin, Athaliah khutthah a kon chun ana huhdoh in ahi.
English: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

tcz: Athaliah lengnu in kum gup sung jen leggam sunga vai ahop sungin, Joash chu Pakai hou n sunga ana kisel’ah ahi.
en: He was with her hidden in the LORD’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
text:
2KI 11:3
Thadou: Athaliah lengnu in kum gup sung jen leggam sunga vai ahop sungin, Joash chu Pakai hou n sunga ana kisel’ah ahi.
English: He was with her hidden in the LORD’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.

tcz: Athaliah vaihom kal kum gup kichai akum sagi lhin kum in, Jehoiada thempu in asepai lamkaipa, Car mite sepaite, chuleh khopi ngah apangho Pakai hou in na akoukhom tan ahi. Hichun aman amaho chutoh Pakai houin’ah amaho chutoh, khonung changeiya dettah le kitah tah a adinpina diuvin akihahsel sah in chule kitepna khat ana sempeh in, hiche jouchun aman lengpa chapa Joash chu ahin puidoh’in amaho chu avetsah tan ahi.
en: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the captains over hundreds of the Carites and of the guard, and brought them to him into the LORD’s house; and he made a covenant with them, and made a covenant with them in the LORD’s house, and showed them the king’s son.
text:
2KI 11:4
Thadou: Athaliah vaihom kal kum gup kichai akum sagi lhin kum in, Jehoiada thempu in asepai lamkaipa, Car mite sepaite, chuleh khopi ngah apangho Pakai hou in na akoukhom tan ahi. Hichun aman amaho chutoh Pakai houin’ah amaho chutoh, khonung changeiya dettah le kitah tah a adinpina diuvin akihahsel sah in chule kitepna khat ana sempeh in, hiche jouchun aman lengpa chapa Joash chu ahin puidoh’in amaho chu avetsah tan ahi.
English: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the captains over hundreds of the Carites and of the guard, and brought them to him into the LORD’s house; and he made a covenant with them, and made a covenant with them in the LORD’s house, and showed them the king’s son.

tcz: Jehoiada chun amaho kom achun, “Nangho hop thumma naki khen uva, hopkhat cholngah nileh leng inpi ngah a napandiu ahi, hiche hi nabol teidiu ahi,” atipeh tan ahi.
en: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you must do: a third of you, who come in on the Sabbath, shall be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;

tcz: “Hopthum ma hopkhat dangma chu, Sur kelkot ngah’a napandiu chuleh hopthum ma hopkhat dangma chu khopi ngah’a napandiu, akisei hichang thum laiya hi nabonchauva khopi na ngadiu ahi,” ati.
en: a third of you shall be at the gate Sur; and a third of you at the gate behind the guard. So you shall keep the watch of the house, and be a barrier.
text:
2KI 11:6
Thadou: “Hopthum ma hopkhat dangma chu, Sur kelkot ngah’a napandiu chuleh hopthum ma hopkhat dangma chu khopi ngah’a napandiu, akisei hichang thum laiya hi nabonchauva khopi na ngadiu ahi,” ati.
English: a third of you shall be at the gate Sur; and a third of you at the gate behind the guard. So you shall keep the watch of the house, and be a barrier.

tcz: “Cholngah nikhoa kinbollou loi ni chun, Pakai houin na lengpa nadinpi diu ahi.
en: The two companies of you, even all who go out on the Sabbath, shall keep the watch of the LORD’s house around the king.
text:
2KI 11:7
Thadou: “Cholngah nikhoa kinbollou loi ni chun, Pakai houin na lengpa nadinpi diu ahi.
English: The two companies of you, even all who go out on the Sabbath, shall keep the watch of the LORD’s house around the king.

tcz: Nakhut uva galmanchah nakichoi uva lengpa tahsa hoibitna dinga akimvella nadindiu, chule koi hijongleh ahung lhailut goa aumleh natha jeng diu ahi. Lengpa chu ache nachanna najui diu ahi,” ati.
en: You shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand; and he who comes within the ranks, let him be slain. Be with the king when he goes out, and when he comes in.”
text:
2KI 11:8
Thadou: Nakhut uva galmanchah nakichoi uva lengpa tahsa hoibitna dinga akimvella nadindiu, chule koi hijongleh ahung lhailut goa aumleh natha jeng diu ahi. Lengpa chu ache nachanna najui diu ahi,” ati.
English: You shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand; and he who comes within the ranks, let him be slain. Be with the king when he goes out, and when he comes in.”

tcz: Hiti chun sepai vaipo hochun Jehoiada thempun aseipeh bang bangun abollun ahi. Sepai vaipo ho chun cholngah nia panla dingho ahin alalou dingho ahin asepaite cheh uchu Jehoiada thempu pa kom ahin puijun,
en: The captains over hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded; and they each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.
text:
2KI 11:9
Thadou: Hiti chun sepai vaipo hochun Jehoiada thempun aseipeh bang bangun abollun ahi. Sepai vaipo ho chun cholngah nia panla dingho ahin alalou dingho ahin asepaite cheh uchu Jehoiada thempu pa kom ahin puijun,
English: The captains over hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded; and they each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

tcz: Chule aman amaho chu tengcha holeh ompho hochu ana ban hoppeh in ahi, hiche manchah hohi David lengpan a ahin, Pakai houin na ana kikoi jing ahi.
en: The priest delivered to the captains over hundreds the spears and shields that had been King David’s, which were in the LORD’s house.
text:
2KI 11:10
Thadou: Chule aman amaho chu tengcha holeh ompho hochu ana ban hoppeh in ahi, hiche manchah hohi David lengpan a ahin, Pakai houin na ana kikoi jing ahi.
English: The priest delivered to the captains over hundreds the spears and shields that had been King David’s, which were in the LORD’s house.

tcz: Leng inpi ngah hochun amanchah’u kigosademin akichoi uvin a lengpau chu aum kimvel un ana ngah un ahi. Amahon chun houin lhanglang ning apat sahlang ning geijin akigol lhungkei jun, maicham jong aumkimvel un ahi.
en: The guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, along by the altar and the house, around the king.
text:
2KI 11:11
Thadou: Leng inpi ngah hochun amanchah’u kigosademin akichoi uvin a lengpau chu aum kimvel un ana ngah un ahi. Amahon chun houin lhanglang ning apat sahlang ning geijin akigol lhungkei jun, maicham jong aumkimvel un ahi.
English: The guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, along by the altar and the house, around the king.

tcz: Hichun Jehoiada in lengpa chapa Joash chu ahin puidoh’in, aluchanga lallukhuh akhuh peh in Pathen danthu lekhabu khat apen, hiti chun thao anun, leng ahitai tin aphongdoh un, mijousen khut abengun, “Lengpa damsot hen,” tin asam un ahi.
en: Then he brought out the king’s son, and put the crown on him, and gave him the covenant; and they made him king and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, “Long live the king!”
text:
2KI 11:12
Thadou: Hichun Jehoiada in lengpa chapa Joash chu ahin puidoh’in, aluchanga lallukhuh akhuh peh in Pathen danthu lekhabu khat apen, hiti chun thao anun, leng ahitai tin aphongdoh un, mijousen khut abengun, “Lengpa damsot hen,” tin asam un ahi.
English: Then he brought out the king’s son, and put the crown on him, and gave him the covenant; and they made him king and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, “Long live the king!”

tcz: Athaliah in, mipi hole leng inpi ngah ho husan chu ajahdoh phat’in, ipi thilsoh hitam? tin aveding in gangchal’in houin langa chun aga lhailut tan ahi.
en: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the LORD’s house;

tcz: Amun aga lhun phat’in, lallukhuh kikhuh’a lengthah khat chonna ngaidolla thuneitah'a khompi kom’a ana din chu amutan, chule sepai lamkai holeh pengkul mut ho avella adin chule gamsung pumpia mipi hochun kipah tah a sumkon amut’u aga mudoh tan ahi. Hichun Athaliah in hiche ho jouse hi amudoh phat’in, along ana behseh jeng in aponsil abtottel in, “Lengmun chu! Lengmun chu!” tin asam tai.
en: and she looked, and behold, the king stood by the pillar, as the tradition was, with the captains and the trumpets by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, “Treason! Treason!”
text:
2KI 11:14
Thadou: Amun aga lhun phat’in, lallukhuh kikhuh’a lengthah khat chonna ngaidolla thuneitah'a khompi kom’a ana din chu amutan, chule sepai lamkai holeh pengkul mut ho avella adin chule gamsung pumpia mipi hochun kipah tah a sumkon amut’u aga mudoh tan ahi. Hichun Athaliah in hiche ho jouse hi amudoh phat’in, along ana behseh jeng in aponsil abtottel in, “Lengmun chu! Lengmun chu!” tin asam tai.
English: and she looked, and behold, the king stood by the pillar, as the tradition was, with the captains and the trumpets by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, “Treason! Treason!”

tcz: Jehoiada thempu pan asepaiho vesuija pang sepai lamkai hochu thu apen, “Amanu chu man unlang Houin maija sepai holah akhun puilut un, chuleh koihileh amanu huhna dinga hung lut aumle that jingun,” atin ahi. Ajeh chu thempu pa chun, “Amanu chu Pakai houin sunga tha louding ahi,” anati sa ahi.
en: Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks. Kill anyone who follows her with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t let her be slain in the LORD’s house.”
text:
2KI 11:15
Thadou: Jehoiada thempu pan asepaiho vesuija pang sepai lamkai hochu thu apen, “Amanu chu man unlang Houin maija sepai holah akhun puilut un, chuleh koihileh amanu huhna dinga hung lut aumle that jingun,” atin ahi. Ajeh chu thempu pa chun, “Amanu chu Pakai houin sunga tha louding ahi,” anati sa ahi.
English: Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks. Kill anyone who follows her with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t let her be slain in the LORD’s house.”

tcz: Hichun amahon, amanu chu aman un, leng inpia sakolte lutna kelkot langa chun apui amang un, hikom’a chun athat tauvin ahi.
en: So they seized her; and she went by the way of the horses’ entry to the king’s house, and she was slain there.
text:
2KI 11:16
Thadou: Hichun amahon, amanu chu aman un, leng inpia sakolte lutna kelkot langa chun apui amang un, hikom’a chun athat tauvin ahi.
English: So they seized her; and she went by the way of the horses’ entry to the king’s house, and she was slain there.

tcz: Hichun Jehoiada in mipite ho jouse chu “Pakai mite” ahina diuvin, Pakai leh lengpa kikah chuleh mipite kikah a kitepna khat asem tan ahi. Chujongleh aman lengpa leh mipi kikah a jong kitepna khat asem in ahi.
en: Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’s people; also between the king and the people.
text:
2KI 11:17
Thadou: Hichun Jehoiada in mipite ho jouse chu “Pakai mite” ahina diuvin, Pakai leh lengpa kikah chuleh mipite kikah a kitepna khat asem tan ahi. Chujongleh aman lengpa leh mipi kikah a jong kitepna khat asem in ahi.
English: Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’s people; also between the king and the people.

tcz: Hichun gamsunga mipiho jouse chu acheuvin Baal doi houna houin ho chu asulhauvin, adoiphung u, maicham leh adoilimho jouse chu akhense uvin asuchip’un chuleh Baal thempu Mattan jong chu adoiphung maicham maitah achun athat tauvin ahi. Hiche jouchun Jehoiada thempupan jong, Pakai houin vengtup dingin sepai ana koiyin ahi.
en: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. The priest appointed officers over the LORD’s house.
text:
2KI 11:18
Thadou: Hichun gamsunga mipiho jouse chu acheuvin Baal doi houna houin ho chu asulhauvin, adoiphung u, maicham leh adoilimho jouse chu akhense uvin asuchip’un chuleh Baal thempu Mattan jong chu adoiphung maicham maitah achun athat tauvin ahi. Hiche jouchun Jehoiada thempupan jong, Pakai houin vengtup dingin sepai ana koiyin ahi.
English: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. The priest appointed officers over the LORD’s house.

tcz: Hijou chun sepai lamkai holeh Car mite sepaiho chuleh leng inpi ngah sepaiho chuleh gamsung mipi ho chun Joash lengpa chu Pakai houin na konin ahinpui doh un, leng inpi ngah ho panmun kelkot a chun ahung kitollut uvin, chuin lengpa chu lengte laltouna a chun atoutai.
en: He took the captains over hundreds, and the Carites, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the LORD’s house, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. He sat on the throne of the kings.
text:
2KI 11:19
Thadou: Hijou chun sepai lamkai holeh Car mite sepaiho chuleh leng inpi ngah sepaiho chuleh gamsung mipi ho chun Joash lengpa chu Pakai houin na konin ahinpui doh un, leng inpi ngah ho panmun kelkot a chun ahung kitollut uvin, chuin lengpa chu lengte laltouna a chun atoutai.
English: He took the captains over hundreds, and the Carites, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the LORD’s house, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. He sat on the throne of the kings.

tcz: Hiti chun gamsung mipi abonchauvin akipah sohkeijun chule gamsung’a chamna ana lengpan tan ahi, ajeh chu leng inpia chu Athaliah kitinu ana tha u ahitai.
en: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword at the king’s house.
text:
2KI 11:20
Thadou: Hiti chun gamsung mipi abonchauvin akipah sohkeijun chule gamsung’a chamna ana lengpan tan ahi, ajeh chu leng inpia chu Athaliah kitinu ana tha u ahitai.
English: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword at the king’s house.

tcz: Israel lengpa Jehu lengchan kal kum sagi alhinin, Joash in Judahte leng achangin ahi. Amahin Jerusalem’ah kum somli lengvai ana po in ahi. Anu chu Zibiah ahin, Beersheba khomi ahi.
en: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
text:
2KI 12:1
Thadou: Israel lengpa Jehu lengchan kal kum sagi alhinin, Joash in Judahte leng achangin ahi. Amahin Jerusalem’ah kum somli lengvai ana po in ahi. Anu chu Zibiah ahin, Beersheba khomi ahi.
English: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.

tcz: Joash in ahinkho lhumkeijin Pakai mitmu’n thilpha jeng anabollin ahi, ajeh chu ama chu Jehoiada thempun ana khoukhah jing jeh ahi.
en: Jehoash did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
text:
2KI 12:2
Thadou: Joash in ahinkho lhumkeijin Pakai mitmu’n thilpha jeng anabollin ahi, ajeh chu ama chu Jehoiada thempun ana khoukhah jing jeh ahi.
English: Jehoash did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

tcz: Ahijing vang'in aman pathen dang kithoina doikhum ho ana sumangpon ahi, hiti chun mipihon kithoina gantha hole halnam ho anabol jingun ahi.
en: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.
text:
2KI 12:3
Thadou: Ahijing vang'in aman pathen dang kithoina doikhum ho ana sumangpon ahi, hiti chun mipihon kithoina gantha hole halnam ho anabol jingun ahi.
English: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

tcz: Nikhat hi Joash leng pan thempuho kom’ah, “Pakai houin na hung kitohdoh sum jouse ahin, mihem in amichangvala ahinto doh sum jouse ahin, mihem ama ama lungthim sung cheh a thanopna aneiya Pakai houin sunga ahinto doh sum jouse ahin abonchan khol tup un,” ati.
en: Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money of the holy things that is brought into the LORD’s house, in current money, the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated, and all the money that it comes into any man’s heart to bring into the LORD’s house,
text:
2KI 12:4
Thadou: Nikhat hi Joash leng pan thempuho kom’ah, “Pakai houin na hung kitohdoh sum jouse ahin, mihem in amichangvala ahinto doh sum jouse ahin, mihem ama ama lungthim sung cheh a thanopna aneiya Pakai houin sunga ahinto doh sum jouse ahin abonchan khol tup un,” ati.
English: Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money of the holy things that is brought into the LORD’s house, in current money, the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated, and all the money that it comes into any man’s heart to bring into the LORD’s house,

tcz: “Hiche sumho lah a kon hin phabep hi thempuhon la-u henlang, angaichat dungjuiya houin semphatna in mang u hen,” ati.
en: let the priests take it to them, each man from his donor; and they shall repair the damage to the house, wherever any damage is found.”
text:
2KI 12:5
Thadou: “Hiche sumho lah a kon hin phabep hi thempuhon la-u henlang, angaichat dungjuiya houin semphatna in mang u hen,” ati.
English: let the priests take it to them, each man from his donor; and they shall repair the damage to the house, wherever any damage is found.”

tcz: Ahinlah Joash vaipohna kum somni le thum channa geijin jong thempuhon houin semphatna natoh ima anapan polaiyun ahi.
en: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.
text:
2KI 12:6
Thadou: Ahinlah Joash vaipohna kum somni le thum channa geijin jong thempuhon houin semphatna natoh ima anapan polaiyun ahi.
English: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.

tcz: Hijeh chun Joash lengpan Jehoiada leh thempu dangho akoukhom in, “Ipi dinga houin nasemphat loulai uham? Sum hohi nangho phatchomna dingin moh manchatvai ta hih un, tuapat vang'in hiche sumho hi houin semphatna dinga aboncha naman diu ahi” ati.
en: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why aren’t you repairing the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”
text:
2KI 12:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun Joash lengpan Jehoiada leh thempu dangho akoukhom in, “Ipi dinga houin nasemphat loulai uham? Sum hohi nangho phatchomna dingin moh manchatvai ta hih un, tuapat vang'in hiche sumho hi houin semphatna dinga aboncha naman diu ahi” ati.
English: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why aren’t you repairing the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”

tcz: Hiti chun thempuhon mipiho akona sumlah tahlou dingin akilol un, chuleh houin semphatna dinga mopohna jonghi midang nganse dingin anom tauvin ahi.
en: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.
text:
2KI 12:8
Thadou: Hiti chun thempuhon mipiho akona sumlah tahlou dingin akilol un, chuleh houin semphatna dinga mopohna jonghi midang nganse dingin anom tauvin ahi.
English: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.

tcz: Hichun Jehoiada thempupan thih thingkong lentah khat asem’in, asin avitvangin hichu Pakai houin hunglutna maicham jetlang sanga chun akoiyin ahi. Hichun thempu kotngah a pangho chun, mipi sumto hochu alauvin thingkong sunga chun ahenglut jiuvin ahi.
en: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the LORD’s house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into the LORD’s house into it.
text:
2KI 12:9
Thadou: Hichun Jehoiada thempupan thih thingkong lentah khat asem’in, asin avitvangin hichu Pakai houin hunglutna maicham jetlang sanga chun akoiyin ahi. Hichun thempu kotngah a pangho chun, mipi sumto hochu alauvin thingkong sunga chun ahenglut jiuvin ahi.
English: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the LORD’s house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into the LORD’s house into it.

tcz: Hiche thingkong chu adimphat leh, leng insunga kimang cha lekhajihpa leh thempulen pa chun Pakai houin’a hung kitohdoh dangka ho chu asimtohji lhonin, chujouteng chule khaodip khatna akhumji lhon in ahi.
en: When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in the LORD’s house.
text:
2KI 12:10
Thadou: Hiche thingkong chu adimphat leh, leng insunga kimang cha lekhajihpa leh thempulen pa chun Pakai houin’a hung kitohdoh dangka ho chu asimtohji lhonin, chujouteng chule khaodip khatna akhumji lhon in ahi.
English: When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in the LORD’s house.

tcz: Chujouteng le sum chu Pakai houin semphatna a vaipo ho khutna apedohji lhonin, amahon Pakai houin semphatna a natong ho apekit jiuvin ahi. Amaho chu, thinghem bolho leh insaho,
en: They gave the money that was weighed out into the hands of those who did the work, who had the oversight of the LORD’s house; and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders who worked on the LORD’s house,
text:
2KI 12:11
