Thadou: Chujouteng le sum chu Pakai houin semphatna a vaipo ho khutna apedohji lhonin, amahon Pakai houin semphatna a natong ho apekit jiuvin ahi. Amaho chu, thinghem bolho leh insaho,
English: They gave the money that was weighed out into the hands of those who did the work, who had the oversight of the LORD’s house; and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders who worked on the LORD’s house,

tcz: Thing vaibo hole song kheng ho, apeuvin ahi. Amahon sum chu Pakai houin semphatna dia thing le song kikheng chaise ho chohnan jong amang un, chujongleh houin kisah phat nadia manna ding jousen jong ana mang Chauvin ahi.
en: and to the masons and the stone cutters, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the damage to the LORD’s house, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.
text:
2KI 12:12
Thadou: Thing vaibo hole song kheng ho, apeuvin ahi. Amahon sum chu Pakai houin semphatna dia thing le song kikheng chaise ho chohnan jong amang un, chujongleh houin kisah phat nadia manna ding jousen jong ana mang Chauvin ahi.
English: and to the masons and the stone cutters, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the damage to the LORD’s house, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.

tcz: Hiche sum, houin a hunglut hochu, houin sunga manchah ding kisilna dangka kong ahin, thaomeija manchah ding chaiche ahin, konglenho le khon ho ahin, sumkon chuleh san le dangka a kisem thil adang dang ho akisemnan khatcha akimang pon ahi.
en: But there were not made for the LORD’s house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the LORD’s house;

tcz: Sum chu Houin semphatna a natong hike manchah thil chohnan bou aki mangcha ji ahi.
en: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired the LORD’s house with it.
text:
2KI 12:14
Thadou: Sum chu Houin semphatna a natong hike manchah thil chohnan bou aki mangcha ji ahi.
English: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired the LORD’s house with it.

tcz: Hiche natohna a kimangcha ho vesuija panghohi milungtheng leh tahsan theitah ngen ahijeh un, Jehu in sum kiman chahna hochu dihnam tia kholtoh ding ngaikhoh asapon ahi.
en: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.
text:
2KI 12:15
Thadou: Hiche natohna a kimangcha ho vesuija panghohi milungtheng leh tahsan theitah ngen ahijeh un, Jehu in sum kiman chahna hochu dihnam tia kholtoh ding ngaikhoh asapon ahi.
English: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.

tcz: Ahinlah suhkhelna holeh chosetnaho thoidamna dinga hung kitohdoh hovang Pakai houin’ah ahunglut jipon, hiche hochu thempuho apeh jiuva amahon adeidan danna akiman chah jiu ahitai.
en: The money for the trespass offerings and the money for the sin offerings was not brought into the LORD’s house. It was the priests’.
text:
2KI 12:16
Thadou: Ahinlah suhkhelna holeh chosetnaho thoidamna dinga hung kitohdoh hovang Pakai houin’ah ahunglut jipon, hiche hochu thempuho apeh jiuva amahon adeidan danna akiman chah jiu ahitai.
English: The money for the trespass offerings and the money for the sin offerings was not brought into the LORD’s house. It was the priests’.

tcz: Hiche phat laitah hin, Syria lengpa Hazael chu Gath sat dingin akonin ajouvin alenggam sung ah akilahlut tan ahi. Hihe jouchun ahung kinunglen Jerusalem nokhum ding agotan ahi.
en: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
text:
2KI 12:17
Thadou: Hiche phat laitah hin, Syria lengpa Hazael chu Gath sat dingin akonin ajouvin alenggam sung ah akilahlut tan ahi. Hihe jouchun ahung kinunglen Jerusalem nokhum ding agotan ahi.
English: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hichun Joash lengpan ama masanga Judah lengho, Jehoshaphat in Pathenna anakatdoh thengho, Jehoram, Ahaziah chuleh amatah in anakatdoh thengho jouse chu achom khomin, Pakai houin leh leng inpia sumkholna muna sana ho jouse toh abonchan Hazael chu athot tan ahi. Hichun Hazael in Jerusalem anokhum got chu anokhum tapon ahi.
en: Jehoash king of Judah took all the holy things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and of the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria; and he went away from Jerusalem.
text:
2KI 12:18
Thadou: Hichun Joash lengpan ama masanga Judah lengho, Jehoshaphat in Pathenna anakatdoh thengho, Jehoram, Ahaziah chuleh amatah in anakatdoh thengho jouse chu achom khomin, Pakai houin leh leng inpia sumkholna muna sana ho jouse toh abonchan Hazael chu athot tan ahi. Hichun Hazael in Jerusalem anokhum got chu anokhum tapon ahi.
English: Jehoash king of Judah took all the holy things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and of the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria; and he went away from Jerusalem.

tcz: Joash vaihom sunga thilsoh ho jouse leh anatoh, athilbolho jouse chu Judah lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua aumsoh keijin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
text:
2KI 12:19
Thadou: Joash vaihom sunga thilsoh ho jouse leh anatoh, athilbolho jouse chu Judah lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua aumsoh keijin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

tcz: Joash chu anoija natong pipuihon ama dounan tohgon ana neijun, Silla jotna Beth-millo lamlen nah ana that tauvin ahi.
en: His servants arose and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.
text:
2KI 12:20
Thadou: Joash chu anoija natong pipuihon ama dounan tohgon ana neijun, Silla jotna Beth-millo lamlen nah ana that tauvin ahi.
English: His servants arose and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.

tcz: Ama ana that hochu Shimeath chapa Jozacar leh Shomer chapa Jehozabad ahilhone, amani hi ani lhonahi lengpa dinga tahsan umtah lengpa thumop’a pang anahi lhonin ahi. Joash chu David khopi ah apu apate kivui na a ana kivuitan ahi.
en: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 12:21
Thadou: Ama ana that hochu Shimeath chapa Jozacar leh Shomer chapa Jehozabad ahilhone, amani hi ani lhonahi lengpa dinga tahsan umtah lengpa thumop’a pang anahi lhonin ahi. Joash chu David khopi ah apu apate kivui na a ana kivuitan ahi.
English: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Judah gam’ah Joash lengpan vaihom kum somni le thum lhin kum’in, Jehu chapa Jehoahaz in Israel gam’ah lengvai ahin hompan in ahi. Amahin Samaria gamsung ah kum somel sagi vai ana hom in ahi.
en: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria for seventeen years.
text:
2KI 13:1
Thadou: Judah gam’ah Joash lengpan vaihom kum somni le thum lhin kum’in, Jehu chapa Jehoahaz in Israel gam’ah lengvai ahin hompan in ahi. Amahin Samaria gamsung ah kum somel sagi vai ana hom in ahi.
English: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria for seventeen years.

tcz: Ahinlah aman Pathen mitmu’n thilse jing anabolin ahi. Aman Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israelte ana chonset sah bang bangin Jeroboam chondan jouse chu ana juitan ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from it.
text:
2KI 13:2
Thadou: Ahinlah aman Pathen mitmu’n thilse jing anabolin ahi. Aman Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israelte ana chonset sah bang bangin Jeroboam chondan jouse chu ana juitan ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from it.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai chu Israel chunga ana lunghang lheh jingin ahi, hijehchun Syria lengpa Hazael leh achapa Benhadad chu Israelte avel vellin ana josah in ahi.
en: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, continually.
text:
2KI 13:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakai chu Israel chunga ana lunghang lheh jingin ahi, hijehchun Syria lengpa Hazael leh achapa Benhadad chu Israelte avel vellin ana josah in ahi.
English: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, continually.

tcz: Hijou chun Jehoahaz chu Pakai kom’ah ana taovin panpina anathum’in ahileh, Syria lengpan Israelte chu ana ha suhgenthei val jeh chun Pakaiyin ataona anasangin ahi.
en: Jehoahaz begged the LORD, and the LORD listened to him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, how the king of Syria oppressed them.
text:
2KI 13:4
Thadou: Hijou chun Jehoahaz chu Pakai kom’ah ana taovin panpina anathum’in ahileh, Syria lengpan Israelte chu ana ha suhgenthei val jeh chun Pakaiyin ataona anasangin ahi.
English: Jehoahaz begged the LORD, and the LORD listened to him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, how the king of Syria oppressed them.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin mikhat asollin Israelte chu Syria te suhgentheina a konin aga huhdohsah tan ahi. Hijou chun Israelte chu tumasanga bangin lungmongin ana cheng tauvin ahi.
en: (The LORD gave Israel a savior, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel lived in their tents as before.
text:
2KI 13:5
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin mikhat asollin Israelte chu Syria te suhgentheina a konin aga huhdohsah tan ahi. Hijou chun Israelte chu tumasanga bangin lungmongin ana cheng tauvin ahi.
English: (The LORD gave Israel a savior, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel lived in their tents as before.

tcz: Ahinlah Jeroboam umchan ala uvin ana chonse jom kitji uvin ahi. Amahon Samaria a um Asherah doiphung jong chu ana kitunsah jing nalai uvin ahi.
en: Nevertheless they didn’t depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin, but walked in them; and the Asherah also remained in Samaria.)
text:
2KI 13:6
Thadou: Ahinlah Jeroboam umchan ala uvin ana chonse jom kitji uvin ahi. Amahon Samaria a um Asherah doiphung jong chu ana kitunsah jing nalai uvin ahi.
English: Nevertheless they didn’t depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin, but walked in them; and the Asherah also remained in Samaria.)

tcz: Ajona in Jehoahaz sepaiho jong ahung alhomlheh tan, sakol kangtalai touthem som nga , sakol kangtalai som nga chujongleh keng sepai sangsom bou ahitan ahi. Adangse chu Syria sepaiten ana thagam’u ahitan akeng uva vutvai bang’a ana chotpha gam u ahitai.
en: For he didn’t leave to Jehoahaz of the people any more than fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria destroyed them and made them like the dust in threshing.
text:
2KI 13:7
Thadou: Ajona in Jehoahaz sepaiho jong ahung alhomlheh tan, sakol kangtalai touthem som nga , sakol kangtalai som nga chujongleh keng sepai sangsom bou ahitan ahi. Adangse chu Syria sepaiten ana thagam’u ahitan akeng uva vutvai bang’a ana chotpha gam u ahitai.
English: For he didn’t leave to Jehoahaz of the people any more than fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria destroyed them and made them like the dust in threshing.

tcz: Jehoahaz vaihom sunga thilsohho, ama natohdoh le thilbol ho chule athanei naho chu Israelte lengho thusim kijihna thusimbua aki jih lut tan ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
text:
2KI 13:8
Thadou: Jehoahaz vaihom sunga thilsohho, ama natohdoh le thilbol ho chule athanei naho chu Israelte lengho thusim kijihna thusimbua aki jih lut tan ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

tcz: Jehoahaz athiphat’in Samaria gamah avui tauvin ahi. Ama jouvin Jehoash in leng mun ahinlo tan ahi.
en: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria; and Joash his son reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 13:9
Thadou: Jehoahaz athiphat’in Samaria gamah avui tauvin ahi. Ama jouvin Jehoash in leng mun ahinlo tan ahi.
English: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria; and Joash his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Judah gam’ah Joash lengpa vaihom kum somthum le sagi lhinin, Israel gamah Jehoash in lengvai ahin hom pan tan ahi. Aman Samaria gamsung ah kum somle gup sungin lengvai ana hom in ahi.
en: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria for sixteen years.
text:
2KI 13:10
Thadou: Judah gam’ah Joash lengpa vaihom kum somthum le sagi lhinin, Israel gamah Jehoash in lengvai ahin hom pan tan ahi. Aman Samaria gamsung ah kum somle gup sungin lengvai ana hom in ahi.
English: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria for sixteen years.

tcz: Ahinlah amahin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jing ana bollin Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israelte ana chonset sahna akona chu kilehei ding ana nompon ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin; but he walked in them.
text:
2KI 13:11
Thadou: Ahinlah amahin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jing ana bollin Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israelte ana chonset sahna akona chu kilehei ding ana nompon ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin; but he walked in them.

tcz: Jehoash vaihom sunga thilsohho jouse leh aman anatohdoh holeh athaneina chengeija anatoh ho chuleh Judah lengpa Amaziah toh gal ana kisatto naho abonchan Israelte lengho thusimbu kijihna lekhabua abonchan akijih lut soh keijin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
text:
2KI 13:12
Thadou: Jehoash vaihom sunga thilsohho jouse leh aman anatohdoh holeh athaneina chengeija anatoh ho chuleh Judah lengpa Amaziah toh gal ana kisatto naho abonchan Israelte lengho thusimbu kijihna lekhabua abonchan akijih lut soh keijin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

tcz: Jehoash athiphat’in Israel lengho kivuina Samaria munah chun anavui tauvin ahi. Hiche jouchun achapa Jeroboam ni na in lengvai ahinpo pan tan ahi.
en: Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat on his throne. Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
text:
2KI 13:13
Thadou: Jehoash athiphat’in Israel lengho kivuina Samaria munah chun anavui tauvin ahi. Hiche jouchun achapa Jeroboam ni na in lengvai ahinpo pan tan ahi.
English: Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat on his throne. Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

tcz: Elisha chu athikon natna jalkhun a aumjinglai ahin, Israel lengpa Jehoash in agavil’in aga ka khum’in , “ Hepa! Hepa! Israelte kangtalai tou them holeh akangtalai hou kamun ahi!” tin akakhum in ahileh,
en: Now Elisha became sick with the illness of which he died; and Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over him, and said, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!”
text:
2KI 13:14
Thadou: Elisha chu athikon natna jalkhun a aumjinglai ahin, Israel lengpa Jehoash in agavil’in aga ka khum’in , “ Hepa! Hepa! Israelte kangtalai tou them holeh akangtalai hou kamun ahi!” tin akakhum in ahileh,
English: Now Elisha became sick with the illness of which he died; and Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over him, and said, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!”

tcz: Elisha’n ajaha, “Thalpi khat le thal chang phabep gakilah tan,” ati, hijehchun aman jong thalpi khat le thalchang phabep agakilah in ahi.
en: Elisha said to him, “Take bow and arrows;” and he took bow and arrows for himself.
text:
2KI 13:15
Thadou: Elisha’n ajaha, “Thalpi khat le thal chang phabep gakilah tan,” ati, hijehchun aman jong thalpi khat le thalchang phabep agakilah in ahi.
English: Elisha said to him, “Take bow and arrows;” and he took bow and arrows for himself.

tcz: Elisha’n ajah a, “Thalpi kisadoh tem’in,” atia ahileh amanjong akisadoh kittai. Hichun Elisha’n lengpa khut teni chunga chun ama khut tenin atuh in,
en: He said to the king of Israel, “Put your hand on the bow;” and he put his hand on it. Elisha laid his hands on the king’s hands.
text:
2KI 13:16
Thadou: Elisha’n ajah a, “Thalpi kisadoh tem’in,” atia ahileh amanjong akisadoh kittai. Hichun Elisha’n lengpa khut teni chunga chun ama khut tenin atuh in,
English: He said to the king of Israel, “Put your hand on the bow;” and he put his hand on it. Elisha laid his hands on the king’s hands.

tcz: Hitin aseitai, “Nisolam a bangkot chu hongdoh tan,” atileh amanjong ahongdoh tai. Chujouvin Elisha’n, “Kap jeng tan,” atileh aman thal changkhat akaptai. Hichun Elisha’n jong, “Hiche chu Pakai thalchang ahi, Syria mite chunga galjona thalchang ahi, ajeh chu nangin Syria mite chu Aphek munna nasuh gamhel ding ahi,” tin aphongdoh tai.
en: He said, “Open the window eastward;” and he opened it. Then Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. He said, “The LORD’s arrow of victory, even the arrow of victory over Syria; for you will strike the Syrians in Aphek until you have consumed them.”
text:
2KI 13:17
Thadou: Hitin aseitai, “Nisolam a bangkot chu hongdoh tan,” atileh amanjong ahongdoh tai. Chujouvin Elisha’n, “Kap jeng tan,” atileh aman thal changkhat akaptai. Hichun Elisha’n jong, “Hiche chu Pakai thalchang ahi, Syria mite chunga galjona thalchang ahi, ajeh chu nangin Syria mite chu Aphek munna nasuh gamhel ding ahi,” tin aphongdoh tai.
English: He said, “Open the window eastward;” and he opened it. Then Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. He said, “The LORD’s arrow of victory, even the arrow of victory over Syria; for you will strike the Syrians in Aphek until you have consumed them.”

tcz: Chuin Elisha’n jong aseikti in, “Tun nangin thalchang dangho chu kilah in lang tol chu jeptan,” ati. Hichun lengpan jong thalchang chun tol chu thumvei ajeptai.
en: He said, “Take the arrows;” and he took them. He said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground;” and he struck three times, and stopped.
text:
2KI 13:18
Thadou: Chuin Elisha’n jong aseikti in, “Tun nangin thalchang dangho chu kilah in lang tol chu jeptan,” ati. Hichun lengpan jong thalchang chun tol chu thumvei ajeptai.
English: He said, “Take the arrows;” and he took them. He said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground;” and he struck three times, and stopped.

tcz: Ahin Pathen mipa chu achung’ah alunghang lheh jing in, “Nangin tol chu nga vei ahilouleh gup vei najep ding ahi,” tin aman asamjah jeng tan ahi. “Chutileh nangin Syria mite chu nasuhmang hel ding ahi. Tunvang nangin thumvei bou najo ding ahitai,” ati.
en: The man of God was angry with him, and said, “You should have struck five or six times. Then you would have struck Syria until you had consumed it, but now you will strike Syria just three times.”
text:
2KI 13:19
Thadou: Ahin Pathen mipa chu achung’ah alunghang lheh jing in, “Nangin tol chu nga vei ahilouleh gup vei najep ding ahi,” tin aman asamjah jeng tan ahi. “Chutileh nangin Syria mite chu nasuhmang hel ding ahi. Tunvang nangin thumvei bou najo ding ahitai,” ati.
English: The man of God was angry with him, and said, “You should have struck five or six times. Then you would have struck Syria until you had consumed it, but now you will strike Syria just three times.”

tcz: Hichun Elisha athin ahileh ana vui tauvin ahi. Hichelai chun Moab sepaiten chavang lai seh leh Israelte chu gal in ahin nokhum jingkei uve.
en: Elisha died, and they buried him. Now the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.
text:
2KI 13:20
Thadou: Hichun Elisha athin ahileh ana vui tauvin ahi. Hichelai chun Moab sepaiten chavang lai seh leh Israelte chu gal in ahin nokhum jingkei uve.
English: Elisha died, and they buried him. Now the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

tcz: Khatvei hi Israelte phabep in mithi khat hi anavui un ahileh hiche minokhum sepai hochu amu uvin, amaho jong kino tah in mithipa tahsa chu Elisha kivuina lhan sung’a chun alehlut un ajamdoh tauvin ahi. Ahin mithi long chun Elisha guchu atohkhah phat’in ahung hingdoh in, akengah ahung dingdoh kit tan ahi.
en: As they were burying a man, behold, they saw a band of raiders; and they threw the man into Elisha’s tomb. As soon as the man touched Elisha’s bones, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
text:
2KI 13:21
Thadou: Khatvei hi Israelte phabep in mithi khat hi anavui un ahileh hiche minokhum sepai hochu amu uvin, amaho jong kino tah in mithipa tahsa chu Elisha kivuina lhan sung’a chun alehlut un ajamdoh tauvin ahi. Ahin mithi long chun Elisha guchu atohkhah phat’in ahung hingdoh in, akengah ahung dingdoh kit tan ahi.
English: As they were burying a man, behold, they saw a band of raiders; and they threw the man into Elisha’s tomb. As soon as the man touched Elisha’s bones, he revived, and stood up on his feet.

tcz: Jehoahaz lengpa vaihomlai sungsen Syria lengpa Hazael in Israelte hi ana ha suhgenthei lheh jengin ahi.
en: Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
text:
2KI 13:22
Thadou: Jehoahaz lengpa vaihomlai sungsen Syria lengpa Hazael in Israelte hi ana ha suhgenthei lheh jengin ahi.
English: Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

tcz: Ahin Pakai chun Israelte alungset le akhotona jeh'in, abon'in asuhmang sah deh poi. Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob toh akitepna jal chun anapanpi jing nai. Hiti chun aman tuni changeijin amaho hi abonin asumang pon chuleh ama angsunga konin jong apaimang chomdeh pon ahi.
en: But the LORD was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and favored them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them and he didn’t cast them from his presence as yet.
text:
2KI 13:23
Thadou: Ahin Pakai chun Israelte alungset le akhotona jeh'in, abon'in asuhmang sah deh poi. Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob toh akitepna jal chun anapanpi jing nai. Hiti chun aman tuni changeijin amaho hi abonin asumang pon chuleh ama angsunga konin jong apaimang chomdeh pon ahi.
English: But the LORD was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and favored them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them and he didn’t cast them from his presence as yet.

tcz: Syria lengpa Hazael athitan ahileh achapa Benhadad in ama khellin lengmun alotan ahi.
en: Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 13:24
Thadou: Syria lengpa Hazael athitan ahileh achapa Benhadad in ama khellin lengmun alotan ahi.
English: Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Jehoashpa Jehoahaz akona analah peh’u khopi hochu Jehoash in Hazael chapa Benhadad na konin akile lahdoh kittan ahi. Jehoash in Benhadad chu thum veijin anajouvin Israel khopi hochu anakile lahdoh gamtan ahi.
en: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Joash struck him three times, and recovered the cities of Israel.
text:
2KI 13:25
Thadou: Jehoashpa Jehoahaz akona analah peh’u khopi hochu Jehoash in Hazael chapa Benhadad na konin akile lahdoh kittan ahi. Jehoash in Benhadad chu thum veijin anajouvin Israel khopi hochu anakile lahdoh gamtan ahi.
English: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Joash struck him three times, and recovered the cities of Israel.

tcz: Israel lengpa Jehoash vaihom akum ni lhin in, Judah gamsunga Joash chapa Amaziah in lengvai ahin hompan tan ahi.
en: In the second year of Joash, son of Joahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.
text:
2KI 14:1
Thadou: Israel lengpa Jehoash vaihom akum ni lhin in, Judah gamsunga Joash chapa Amaziah in lengvai ahin hompan tan ahi.
English: In the second year of Joash, son of Joahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.

tcz: Amaziah chu leng ahung chanchun ama kum somni le nga analhingtan ahi, aman Jerusalem ah kum somni le ko sungin lengvai anahom in ahi. Anu min chu Jehoaddin ahin, Jerusalem kho mi ahi.
en: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.
text:
2KI 14:2
Thadou: Amaziah chu leng ahung chanchun ama kum somni le nga analhingtan ahi, aman Jerusalem ah kum somni le ko sungin lengvai anahom in ahi. Anu min chu Jehoaddin ahin, Jerusalem kho mi ahi.
English: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.

tcz: Amaziah hin Pakai mitmu’n thilpha jing abollin ahi, ahinlah apu David toh ana bang joupon ahi. Ahinlah apa Joash chondan joh ana juiyin ahi.
en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, yet not like David his father. He did according to all that Joash his father had done.
text:
2KI 14:3
Thadou: Amaziah hin Pakai mitmu’n thilpha jing abollin ahi, ahinlah apu David toh ana bang joupon ahi. Ahinlah apa Joash chondan joh ana juiyin ahi.
English: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, yet not like David his father. He did according to all that Joash his father had done.

tcz: Amaziah chun lim doiphung hochu ana suse dehpon, chule mipi hochun doiphunga chun kilhaina gantha leh gimnamtui lhutna chu abol jingun ahi.
en: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.
text:
2KI 14:4
Thadou: Amaziah chun lim doiphung hochu ana suse dehpon, chule mipi hochun doiphunga chun kilhaina gantha leh gimnamtui lhutna chu abol jingun ahi.
English: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

tcz: Amaziah chun leng ahina akisuhdet phat chun, apa ana that ho jouse chu ana khailih tan ahi.
en: As soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who had slain the king his father,
text:
2KI 14:5
Thadou: Amaziah chun leng ahina akisuhdet phat chun, apa ana that ho jouse chu ana khailih tan ahi.
English: As soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who had slain the king his father,

tcz: Ahijing vang'in, aman apa ana that ho chate ho khatcha anathat pon ahi, ajeh chu aman dan lekhabua Pakai thupeh chu anajuijin. “Achateu chonset jeh a anu apate tha-lou ding ahilouleh anu apateu chonset jeh a achateu thalouding, thidinga lomho chu ama chonset jih a bou thading,” ti ahi.
en: but the children of the murderers he didn’t put to death, according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, as the LORD commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”
text:
2KI 14:6
Thadou: Ahijing vang'in, aman apa ana that ho chate ho khatcha anathat pon ahi, ajeh chu aman dan lekhabua Pakai thupeh chu anajuijin. “Achateu chonset jeh a anu apate tha-lou ding ahilouleh anu apateu chonset jeh a achateu thalouding, thidinga lomho chu ama chonset jih a bou thading,” ti ahi.
English: but the children of the murderers he didn’t put to death, according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, as the LORD commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

tcz: Amaziah in Chikhuh phaicham’ah Edom mite sangsom anathat in ahi. Aman Sela khopi jong anajouvin, akhopi min jong Joktheel in ana khellin, tuni changeijin hitihin akisah dentai.
en: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.
text:
2KI 14:7
Thadou: Amaziah in Chikhuh phaicham’ah Edom mite sangsom anathat in ahi. Aman Sela khopi jong anajouvin, akhopi min jong Joktheel in ana khellin, tuni changeijin hitihin akisah dentai.
English: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.

tcz: Nikhat Amaziah lengpa in Jehu tupa Jehoahaz chapa Jehoash chu chounan thu athot’in, “Hungin gal kisatto hite,” ati.
en: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come, let’s look one another in the face.”
text:
2KI 14:8
Thadou: Nikhat Amaziah lengpa in Jehu tupa Jehoahaz chapa Jehoash chu chounan thu athot’in, “Hungin gal kisatto hite,” ati.
English: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come, let’s look one another in the face.”

tcz: Ahin Israel lengpa Jehoash in Judah lengpa Amaziah chu hiche thusim hi athot in, “Lebanon lhanga lingphung khat in, Lebanon molla Cedar thingphung komah thu athot’in hitin anaseije, ‘Nachanu chu kachapa ji dingin neipen,’ tin athum’in ahi. Ahin Lebanon lhanga cheng gamsa khat in lingphung chu ahin jotpan, akengin achon lhutai.”
en: Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as wife.’ Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by, and trampled down the thistle.
text:
2KI 14:9
Thadou: Ahin Israel lengpa Jehoash in Judah lengpa Amaziah chu hiche thusim hi athot in, “Lebanon lhanga lingphung khat in, Lebanon molla Cedar thingphung komah thu athot’in hitin anaseije, ‘Nachanu chu kachapa ji dingin neipen,’ tin athum’in ahi. Ahin Lebanon lhanga cheng gamsa khat in lingphung chu ahin jotpan, akengin achon lhutai.”
English: Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as wife.’ Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by, and trampled down the thistle.

tcz: “Nangin Edom mite chu najo jeh a chu nalungthim’a nangma kichoisanga nahi. Ahin naminthanna a chun lunglhai in lang, inmun nakitou thim’in, ajeh chu ipiding penna nangin naboi nading le Judah gam mipite manthah lo nadia mi naphin lunghang’a nahim?” ati.
en: You have indeed struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at home; for why should you meddle to your harm, that you fall, even you, and Judah with you?”
text:
2KI 14:10
Thadou: “Nangin Edom mite chu najo jeh a chu nalungthim’a nangma kichoisanga nahi. Ahin naminthanna a chun lunglhai in lang, inmun nakitou thim’in, ajeh chu ipiding penna nangin naboi nading le Judah gam mipite manthah lo nadia mi naphin lunghang’a nahim?” ati.
English: You have indeed struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at home; for why should you meddle to your harm, that you fall, even you, and Judah with you?”

tcz: Ahinlah Amaziah in athusei angaipeh tapon ahi, hijehchun Israel lengpa Jehoash in asepaite akigontoh in, Judah lengpa Amaziah toh kisat dingin akontai. Galsat ding hungkon sepai teni chu Judah gam Beth-Shemesh munah chun anakisatto tauvin ahi.
en: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
text:
2KI 14:11
Thadou: Ahinlah Amaziah in athusei angaipeh tapon ahi, hijehchun Israel lengpa Jehoash in asepaite akigontoh in, Judah lengpa Amaziah toh kisat dingin akontai. Galsat ding hungkon sepai teni chu Judah gam Beth-Shemesh munah chun anakisatto tauvin ahi.
English: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

tcz: Judahte chu Israel sepaiten anocheh gamtauvin, asepai teu akitheh cheh uvin ainlang cheh uvah ajam gam tauve.
en: Judah was defeated by Israel; and each man fled to his tent.
text:
2KI 14:12
Thadou: Judahte chu Israel sepaiten anocheh gamtauvin, asepai teu akitheh cheh uvin ainlang cheh uvah ajam gam tauve.
English: Judah was defeated by Israel; and each man fled to his tent.

tcz: Hichun Israel lengpa Jehoash in, Ahaziah tupa chuleh Joash chapa Judah lengpa Amaziah chu Beth-Shemesh a chun ana mantan ahi. Chujouvin Israelten Jerusalem khopi chu anopaiyun, Jerusalem kulpi pal feet jagup a sang, Ephraim kelkotna apat a Palningkoi kelkot gei asuhchim pehtan ahi.
en: Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh and came to Jerusalem, then broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
text:
2KI 14:13
Thadou: Hichun Israel lengpa Jehoash in, Ahaziah tupa chuleh Joash chapa Judah lengpa Amaziah chu Beth-Shemesh a chun ana mantan ahi. Chujouvin Israelten Jerusalem khopi chu anopaiyun, Jerusalem kulpi pal feet jagup a sang, Ephraim kelkotna apat a Palningkoi kelkot gei asuhchim pehtan ahi.
English: Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh and came to Jerusalem, then broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

tcz: Hichun aman Pakai houin’ah sana le dangka chuleh thiljouse chu aki chomdoh in, chuleh leng inpi’a konin neile gou jouse jong achom’in chuleh gal hingin mi tamtah jong akaimangin, Samaria khopi lamah akile tan ahi.
en: He took all the gold and silver and all the vessels that were found in the LORD’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.
text:
2KI 14:14
Thadou: Hichun aman Pakai houin’ah sana le dangka chuleh thiljouse chu aki chomdoh in, chuleh leng inpi’a konin neile gou jouse jong achom’in chuleh gal hingin mi tamtah jong akaimangin, Samaria khopi lamah akile tan ahi.
English: He took all the gold and silver and all the vessels that were found in the LORD’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

tcz: Jehoash vaipoh sunga thilsoh jouse leh aman ana tohdoh holeh athaneina akhon na geija anatoh ho chuleh Judah lengpa Amaziah toh gal ana kisatto naho abonchan Israel lengte thusim kijihlutna lekhabua aum sohkeijin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
text:
2KI 14:15
Thadou: Jehoash vaipoh sunga thilsoh jouse leh aman ana tohdoh holeh athaneina akhon na geija anatoh ho chuleh Judah lengpa Amaziah toh gal ana kisatto naho abonchan Israel lengte thusim kijihlutna lekhabua aum sohkeijin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

tcz: Jehoash athiphat’in Israel lengte kivuina Samaria a chun avuijun ahi. Ama thi jouchun achapa Jeroboam ni na chun lengmun ahin lotan ahi.
en: Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 14:16
Thadou: Jehoash athiphat’in Israel lengte kivuina Samaria a chun avuijun ahi. Ama thi jouchun achapa Jeroboam ni na chun lengmun ahin lotan ahi.
English: Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Israel lengpa Jehoash athi jouvin Judah lengpa Amaziah chu kum somle nga ahingbe nalaijin ahi.
en: Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years.
text:
2KI 14:17
Thadou: Israel lengpa Jehoash athi jouvin Judah lengpa Amaziah chu kum somle nga ahingbe nalaijin ahi.
English: Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years.

tcz: Amaziah vaihom sunga thilsoh hojouse chu Judah lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua aum sohkeijin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
text:
2KI 14:18
Thadou: Amaziah vaihom sunga thilsoh hojouse chu Judah lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua aum sohkeijin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

tcz: Jerusalem’ah Amaziah hinkho lahna dingin thilguh gonna anaum jeh in, ama Lachish lam’ah anajam in ahi. Ahinla adouhon athat ding mi anung nung’a ana sol’un ahile, amahon ajamna munah chun agathat un ahi.
en: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.
text:
2KI 14:19
Thadou: Jerusalem’ah Amaziah hinkho lahna dingin thilguh gonna anaum jeh in, ama Lachish lam’ah anajam in ahi. Ahinla adouhon athat ding mi anung nung’a ana sol’un ahile, amahon ajamna munah chun agathat un ahi.
English: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

tcz: Amahon atahsa chu sakol in Jerusalem ah ahin le pohlut’un David khopia apu apate kivuina munah chun avui tauvin ahi.
en: They brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in David’s city.
text:
2KI 14:20
Thadou: Amahon atahsa chu sakol in Jerusalem ah ahin le pohlut’un David khopia apu apate kivuina munah chun avui tauvin ahi.
English: They brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in David’s city.

tcz: Judah mipiten Amaziah chapa kum somle gup bep lhing, Uzziah chu apa Amaziah khellin leng ding in atung tauvin ahi.
en: All the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.
text:
2KI 14:21
Thadou: Judah mipiten Amaziah chapa kum somle gup bep lhing, Uzziah chu apa Amaziah khellin leng ding in atung tauvin ahi.
English: All the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

tcz: Apa thijou phat’in Uzziah in Elath khopi chu athah sem’in Judah a din ale lah lut kitan ahi.
en: He built Elath and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.
text:
2KI 14:22
Thadou: Apa thijou phat’in Uzziah in Elath khopi chu athah sem’in Judah a din ale lah lut kitan ahi.
English: He built Elath and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.

tcz: Judah gam'a Amaziah leng chankal kum som le nga lhinin, Jehoash chapa Jeroboam ni na in Israel chunga lengvai ahin hom pantan ahi. Jeroboam in Samaria a kum somli le khat sungin vai ana hom’in ahi.
en: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria for forty-one years.
text:
2KI 14:23
Thadou: Judah gam'a Amaziah leng chankal kum som le nga lhinin, Jehoash chapa Jeroboam ni na in Israel chunga lengvai ahin hom pantan ahi. Jeroboam in Samaria a kum somli le khat sungin vai ana hom’in ahi.
English: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria for forty-one years.

tcz: Amahin Pathen deilou lam thilse jeng ana bollin ahi. Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israelte ana chonset sahna a konin ana kihei mang nompon ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
text:
2KI 14:24
Thadou: Amahin Pathen deilou lam thilse jeng ana bollin ahi. Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israelte ana chonset sahna a konin ana kihei mang nompon ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

tcz: Jeroboam ni na in Israel gam Lebo-hamath apat lhanglam twimang dung geiyin alelahdoh gam kittan ahi. Hichehi Gath-hepher la kona themgao Amittai chapa Jonah koma Pakai Israel Pathen ana phondoh sa dungjuija thilsoh ahi.
en: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to the LORD, the God of Israel’s word, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath Hepher.
text:
2KI 14:25
Thadou: Jeroboam ni na in Israel gam Lebo-hamath apat lhanglam twimang dung geiyin alelahdoh gam kittan ahi. Hichehi Gath-hepher la kona themgao Amittai chapa Jonah koma Pakai Israel Pathen ana phondoh sa dungjuija thilsoh ahi.
English: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to the LORD, the God of Israel’s word, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath Hepher.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai jin Israelte thohgimna nasatah chu ana mun, ahinla Israelte lah’a soh hihen chamlhat hijongleh ahuhdoh diu mi ana mupon ahi.
en: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter for all, slave and free; and there was no helper for Israel.
text:
2KI 14:26
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakai jin Israelte thohgimna nasatah chu ana mun, ahinla Israelte lah’a soh hihen chamlhat hijongleh ahuhdoh diu mi ana mupon ahi.
English: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter for all, slave and free; and there was no helper for Israel.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin Israel tehi amin’u kathaimang sohkei ding ahi ana tilou jeh'in aman Jeroboam ni na chu amaho huhdoh dingin ana mangchan ahi.
en: The LORD didn’t say that he would blot out the name of Israel from under the sky; but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
text:
2KI 14:27
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin Israel tehi amin’u kathaimang sohkei ding ahi ana tilou jeh'in aman Jeroboam ni na chu amaho huhdoh dingin ana mangchan ahi.
English: The LORD didn’t say that he would blot out the name of Israel from under the sky; but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

tcz: Jeroboam ni na vaihom sunga thilsoh jouse leh anatoh ho chuleh athanei naho agalsat ho chuleh Judah gam anahi’ah Damascus leh Hamath jong Israel a dingin ana lalut’in ahi. Hicheho jouse hi Israel lengte thusimbu kijihna lekhabua aumsohkeijin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he fought, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, for Israel, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
text:
2KI 14:28
Thadou: Jeroboam ni na vaihom sunga thilsoh jouse leh anatoh ho chuleh athanei naho agalsat ho chuleh Judah gam anahi’ah Damascus leh Hamath jong Israel a dingin ana lalut’in ahi. Hicheho jouse hi Israel lengte thusimbu kijihna lekhabua aumsohkeijin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he fought, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, for Israel, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

tcz: Jeroboam ni na athiphat’in Israel lengho kivuina Samaria ah ana vui tauvin ahi. Hichejouhin achapa Zechariah ama banin leng achangtai.
en: Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zechariah his son reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 14:29
Thadou: Jeroboam ni na athiphat’in Israel lengho kivuina Samaria ah ana vui tauvin ahi. Hichejouhin achapa Zechariah ama banin leng achangtai.
English: Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zechariah his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Israel lengpa Jeroboam ni na vaihom kum somni le sagi lhin chun, Amaziah chapa Uzziah chun Judah lenggam ah vai ahinhom pantan ahi.
en: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.
text:
2KI 15:1
Thadou: Israel lengpa Jeroboam ni na vaihom kum somni le sagi lhin chun, Amaziah chapa Uzziah chun Judah lenggam ah vai ahinhom pantan ahi.
English: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.

tcz: Ama leng ahung chan kum chun, ama kum somle gup alhingtan ahi, chuleh aman Jerusalem’ah kum somle nga sungin lengvai anahom in ahi. Anu chu Jerusalem ma kon Jecoliah ahi.
en: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
text:
2KI 15:2
Thadou: Ama leng ahung chan kum chun, ama kum somle gup alhingtan ahi, chuleh aman Jerusalem’ah kum somle nga sungin lengvai anahom in ahi. Anu chu Jerusalem ma kon Jecoliah ahi.
English: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

tcz: Amahin apa bangin Pathen mitmu’n alunglhaina jeng ana bollin ahi.
en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
text:
2KI 15:3
Thadou: Amahin apa bangin Pathen mitmu’n alunglhaina jeng ana bollin ahi.
English: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

tcz: Ahinlah aman doiphung ho ana sumang dehpon chuleh mipihon kithoina gantha ana bollun hal namtui jong ana lhut’un ahi.
en: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.
text:
2KI 15:4
Thadou: Ahinlah aman doiphung ho ana sumang dehpon chuleh mipihon kithoina gantha ana bollun hal namtui jong ana lhut’un ahi.
English: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

tcz: Pakaiyin lengpa chu anaphah sah in athini khogei jin aphah in ahi. Ama chu in chom’ah atum’in achangin ana chengin ahi. Lengpa chapa Jotham chu leng inpi ngahin anapangin ahi, hiti chun aman gamsung mite lah’a vai anahom in ahi.
en: The LORD struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. Jotham, the king’s son, was over the household, judging the people of the land.
text:
2KI 15:5
Thadou: Pakaiyin lengpa chu anaphah sah in athini khogei jin aphah in ahi. Ama chu in chom’ah atum’in achangin ana chengin ahi. Lengpa chapa Jotham chu leng inpi ngahin anapangin ahi, hiti chun aman gamsung mite lah’a vai anahom in ahi.
English: The LORD struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. Jotham, the king’s son, was over the household, judging the people of the land.

tcz: Uzziah vaihom sunga thilsoh hole aman anatohdoh ho jouse chu Judah lengte thusim kijihlutna lekhabua aum in ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
text:
2KI 15:6
Thadou: Uzziah vaihom sunga thilsoh hole aman anatohdoh ho jouse chu Judah lengte thusim kijihlutna lekhabua aum in ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

tcz: Uzziah athiphat’in amachu David khopia apu apate kivuina munah ana kivuijin ahi. Achapa Jotham chun ama banin lengmun analo tan ahi.
en: Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Jotham his son reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 15:7
Thadou: Uzziah athiphat’in amachu David khopia apu apate kivuina munah ana kivuijin ahi. Achapa Jotham chun ama banin lengmun analo tan ahi.
English: Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Jotham his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Judah lengpa Uzziah in Judah gam anapoh kum somthum le get lhinin Jeroboam ni na chapa Zechariah in Israel te chunga vai ana hom’in ahi. Aman Samaria ah lha gup vai anahom in ahi.
en: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.
text:
2KI 15:8
Thadou: Judah lengpa Uzziah in Judah gam anapoh kum somthum le get lhinin Jeroboam ni na chapa Zechariah in Israel te chunga vai ana hom’in ahi. Aman Samaria ah lha gup vai anahom in ahi.
English: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.

tcz: Zechariah in apu apate bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng ana bollin, Nebat chapa Jeroboam min Israel te anachonset sah bangin ama jong hiche chonsetna ho akonin kile heiding ana nompon ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as his fathers had done. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
text:
2KI 15:9
Thadou: Zechariah in apu apate bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng ana bollin, Nebat chapa Jeroboam min Israel te anachonset sah bangin ama jong hiche chonsetna ho akonin kile heiding ana nompon ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as his fathers had done. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

tcz: Hijou chun Jabesh chapa Shallum chun Zechariah dounan lungthimse ana gongin mipi lah’a ana that in, ama leng ahung chang tan ahi.
en: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him before the people and killed him, and reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 15:10
Thadou: Hijou chun Jabesh chapa Shallum chun Zechariah dounan lungthimse ana gongin mipi lah’a ana that in, ama leng ahung chang tan ahi.
English: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him before the people and killed him, and reigned in his place.

tcz: Zechariah vaihom sunga thilsoh ho jouse chu Israel lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua chun abon'in aum’in ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
text:
2KI 15:11
Thadou: Zechariah vaihom sunga thilsoh ho jouse chu Israel lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua chun abon'in aum’in ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

tcz: Pakaiyin Jehu kom’a anasei, “Nachilhah te khang li geija leng kachansah ding ahi,” tichu guilhun na ahi.
en: This was the LORD’s word which he spoke to Jehu, saying, “Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.” So it came to pass.
text:
2KI 15:12
Thadou: Pakaiyin Jehu kom’a anasei, “Nachilhah te khang li geija leng kachansah ding ahi,” tichu guilhun na ahi.
English: This was the LORD’s word which he spoke to Jehu, saying, “Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.” So it came to pass.

tcz: Judah gam'a Uzziah in leng achan kal kum som thumle ko alhinin, Jebesh chapa Shallum hin Israel gamsung’a lengvai ana hom’in ahi.
en: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned for a month in Samaria.
text:
2KI 15:13
Thadou: Judah gam'a Uzziah in leng achan kal kum som thumle ko alhinin, Jebesh chapa Shallum hin Israel gamsung’a lengvai ana hom’in ahi.
English: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned for a month in Samaria.

tcz: Hijou chun Gadi chapa Menahem chu Tirzah a konin Samaria-ah agachen ama chu athat’in, lengmun ahin lotan ahi.
en: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, killed him, and reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 15:14
Thadou: Hijou chun Gadi chapa Menahem chu Tirzah a konin Samaria-ah agachen ama chu athat’in, lengmun ahin lotan ahi.
English: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, killed him, and reigned in his place.

tcz: Shallum vaihom sunga thilsoh ho chuleh alungthimse gonho pum chun, Israelte thusim kijih lutna lekhabua abonchan aum’in ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
text:
2KI 15:15
Thadou: Shallum vaihom sunga thilsoh ho chuleh alungthimse gonho pum chun, Israelte thusim kijih lutna lekhabua abonchan aum’in ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

tcz: Hiche pat chun Menahem in Tappuah khopi leh avella gamho jouse, Tirzah geijin asumang hel in ahi, ajeh chu akhomite le akimvela mite, akhopi ho chu akoma ahin pehlut nomlou jeh’u ahi. Aman agamsung mite jouse chu athat gam’in chule numei gailai ho jong akhedoh sohkei jin ahi.
en: Then Menahem attacked Tiphsah and all who were in it and its border areas, from Tirzah. He attacked it because they didn’t open their gates to him, and he ripped up all their women who were with child.
text:
2KI 15:16
Thadou: Hiche pat chun Menahem in Tappuah khopi leh avella gamho jouse, Tirzah geijin asumang hel in ahi, ajeh chu akhomite le akimvela mite, akhopi ho chu akoma ahin pehlut nomlou jeh’u ahi. Aman agamsung mite jouse chu athat gam’in chule numei gailai ho jong akhedoh sohkei jin ahi.
English: Then Menahem attacked Tiphsah and all who were in it and its border areas, from Tirzah. He attacked it because they didn’t open their gates to him, and he ripped up all their women who were with child.

tcz: Judah gam’ah Uzziah lengpan lengvai ana hom kal kum somthum le ko alhinin, Gadi chapa Menahem in Israel gam’ah lengvai ana hom’in ahi. Aman Samaria a hin kum som sungin lengvai ana hom’in ahi.
en: In the thirty ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi began to reign over Israel for ten years in Samaria.
text:
2KI 15:17
Thadou: Judah gam’ah Uzziah lengpan lengvai ana hom kal kum somthum le ko alhinin, Gadi chapa Menahem in Israel gam’ah lengvai ana hom’in ahi. Aman Samaria a hin kum som sungin lengvai ana hom’in ahi.
English: In the thirty ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi began to reign over Israel for ten years in Samaria.

tcz: Ahin Menahem hin Pathen mitmu’n thilse jing anabol in ahi. Avaihom sunghin Nebat chapa Jeroboam min Israelte achonset sahna a kona kile heiding ana nompon ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
text:
2KI 15:18
Thadou: Ahin Menahem hin Pathen mitmu’n thilse jing anabol in ahi. Avaihom sunghin Nebat chapa Jeroboam min Israelte achonset sahna a kona kile heiding ana nompon ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

tcz: Hijou chun Assyria mi Tiglath-pileser lengpan gamsung chu gal’in ahin nokhumtan ahi. Ahinla Menahem min athaneina a vai ahomjom jouna dingin ama chu dangka ton somthum le sagi anapen ahi.
en: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
text:
2KI 15:19
Thadou: Hijou chun Assyria mi Tiglath-pileser lengpan gamsung chu gal’in ahin nokhumtan ahi. Ahinla Menahem min athaneina a vai ahomjom jouna dingin ama chu dangka ton somthum le sagi anapen ahi.
English: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

tcz: Menahem hin Israel mite lah’a ahaoho kom’ah sum namna in ala in, mikhat cheh chun Assyria lengpa hi dangka som nga cheh apeh diuvin thu apen ahi. Hiti chun Assyria lengpa chu Israel gam'a kon chun ahung kinungle tan ahi.
en: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, even from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and didn’t stay there in the land.
text:
2KI 15:20
Thadou: Menahem hin Israel mite lah’a ahaoho kom’ah sum namna in ala in, mikhat cheh chun Assyria lengpa hi dangka som nga cheh apeh diuvin thu apen ahi. Hiti chun Assyria lengpa chu Israel gam'a kon chun ahung kinungle tan ahi.
English: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, even from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and didn’t stay there in the land.

tcz: Menahem vaihom sunga thilsoh ho chuleh aman atoh ho jouse chu Israel lengte thusim kijihlutna lekhabua aum’in ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
text:
2KI 15:21
Thadou: Menahem vaihom sunga thilsoh ho chuleh aman atoh ho jouse chu Israel lengte thusim kijihlutna lekhabua aum’in ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

tcz: Menahem athiphat’in, achapa Pekahiah in leng mun ahinlo tan ahi.
en: Menahem slept with his fathers, and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 15:22
Thadou: Menahem athiphat’in, achapa Pekahiah in leng mun ahinlo tan ahi.
English: Menahem slept with his fathers, and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Judah gam'a Uzziah in lengvai apoh kal kum som nga alhinin, Menahem chapa Pekahiah in Israel gam’ah lengvai ahin hompan in ahi.
en: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria for two years.
text:
2KI 15:23
Thadou: Judah gam'a Uzziah in lengvai apoh kal kum som nga alhinin, Menahem chapa Pekahiah in Israel gam’ah lengvai ahin hompan in ahi.
English: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria for two years.

tcz: Ahinlah Pekahiah chun Pakai mitmu’n thilse jing ana bollin, Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israel te ana chonset sahna a kon chun kiheimang ding ana nompon ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
text:
2KI 15:24
Thadou: Ahinlah Pekahiah chun Pakai mitmu’n thilse jing ana bollin, Nebat chapa Jeroboam in Israel te ana chonset sahna a kon chun kiheimang ding ana nompon ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

tcz: Hijou chun Remaliah chapa Pekah, Pekahiah sepai lamkaipa chun achung nga thilse ana gongin ahi. Aman Gilead akonin mi som nga leh Argob le Arieh toh akitho in Pekahiah chu Samria leng inpi ah chun ana that’un, hiti chun Pekah leng ahung chang tan ahi.
en: Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him and attacked him in Samaria, in the fortress of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites. He killed him, and reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 15:25
Thadou: Hijou chun Remaliah chapa Pekah, Pekahiah sepai lamkaipa chun achung nga thilse ana gongin ahi. Aman Gilead akonin mi som nga leh Argob le Arieh toh akitho in Pekahiah chu Samria leng inpi ah chun ana that’un, hiti chun Pekah leng ahung chang tan ahi.
English: Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him and attacked him in Samaria, in the fortress of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites. He killed him, and reigned in his place.

tcz: Pekahiah vaihom sunga thilsoh ho chuleh aman anatohho chu Israel lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua abonchan aum’in ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
text:
2KI 15:26
Thadou: Pekahiah vaihom sunga thilsoh ho chuleh aman anatohho chu Israel lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua abonchan aum’in ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

tcz: Judah gamsunga Uzziah lengpan alengvaipoh kum som nga le ni alhinin, Remaliah chapa Pekah in Israel te chungah lengvai ana hom panin ahi.
en: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria for twenty years.
text:
2KI 15:27
Thadou: Judah gamsunga Uzziah lengpan alengvaipoh kum som nga le ni alhinin, Remaliah chapa Pekah in Israel te chungah lengvai ana hom panin ahi.
English: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria for twenty years.

tcz: Pekah in Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng anabollin, Nebat chapa Jeroboam min Israelte ana chonset sahna a kona kinnung heiding chu ana nompon ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
text:
2KI 15:28
Thadou: Pekah in Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng anabollin, Nebat chapa Jeroboam min Israelte ana chonset sahna a kona kinnung heiding chu ana nompon ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

tcz: Pekah vaihom sungin Assyria lengpa Tiglath-pileser in Israel ahin sat in Ijon khopi, Abel-beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, leh Hazor khopi ho ana kilahtan ahi. Aman Gilead gam leh avel ho, Galilee chule Naphtali ho ajouvin chuleh mipiho chu Assyria gam’ah gal hing in ana kaimang tan ahi.
en: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried them captive to Assyria.
text:
2KI 15:29
Thadou: Pekah vaihom sungin Assyria lengpa Tiglath-pileser in Israel ahin sat in Ijon khopi, Abel-beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, leh Hazor khopi ho ana kilahtan ahi. Aman Gilead gam leh avel ho, Galilee chule Naphtali ho ajouvin chuleh mipiho chu Assyria gam’ah gal hing in ana kaimang tan ahi.
English: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried them captive to Assyria.

tcz: Hijou chun Elah chapa Hoshea chun Pekah douna lungthim phalou ana gongin, ana that dohtan ahi. Aman Uzziah chapa Jotham vaihom kal kum somni lhinin Israel chunga lengvai anahom pantan ahi.
en: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, attacked him, killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
text:
2KI 15:30
Thadou: Hijou chun Elah chapa Hoshea chun Pekah douna lungthim phalou ana gongin, ana that dohtan ahi. Aman Uzziah chapa Jotham vaihom kal kum somni lhinin Israel chunga lengvai anahom pantan ahi.
English: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, attacked him, killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

tcz: Pekah vaihom sunga thilsoh ho, aman anatoh ho chu Israel lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua aum’in ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
text:
2KI 15:31
Thadou: Pekah vaihom sunga thilsoh ho, aman anatoh ho chu Israel lengte thusim kijihna lekhabua aum’in ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

tcz: Pekah lengpan Israel gamsunga lengvai apoh kal kum ni lhinin, Uzziah chapa Jotham in Judah gam’ah lengvai anahom’in ahi.
en: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.
text:
2KI 15:32
Thadou: Pekah lengpan Israel gamsunga lengvai apoh kal kum ni lhinin, Uzziah chapa Jotham in Judah gam’ah lengvai anahom’in ahi.
English: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.

tcz: Aman lengvai ahinpoh chun ama kum somni le nga alhingtan ahi. Aman Jerusalem’ah kum somle gup sungin lengvai anahom in ahi. Anu min chu Zadok chanu Jerusha ahi.
en: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.
text:
2KI 15:33
Thadou: Aman lengvai ahinpoh chun ama kum somni le nga alhingtan ahi. Aman Jerusalem’ah kum somle gup sungin lengvai anahom in ahi. Anu min chu Zadok chanu Jerusha ahi.
English: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.

tcz: Jotham hin Pakai mitmu’n thilpha jeng ana bollin, amahin apa Uzziah in bangin thil ijakai ana tongdoh sohkeijin ahi.
en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
text:
2KI 15:34
Thadou: Jotham hin Pakai mitmu’n thilpha jeng ana bollin, amahin apa Uzziah in bangin thil ijakai ana tongdoh sohkeijin ahi.
English: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

tcz: Ahinlah aman doiphung ho chu ana sumang pon chuleh mipiho chun hikoma chu kilhaina gantha le gimnamtui jong ana lhut’un ahi. Aman Pakai houin sahlam kelkot jong chu ana semphan ahi.
en: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. He built the upper gate of the LORD’s house.
text:
2KI 15:35
Thadou: Ahinlah aman doiphung ho chu ana sumang pon chuleh mipiho chun hikoma chu kilhaina gantha le gimnamtui jong ana lhut’un ahi. Aman Pakai houin sahlam kelkot jong chu ana semphan ahi.
English: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. He built the upper gate of the LORD’s house.

tcz: Jotham vaihom sunga thilsoh jouse leh aman ana thilbol jouse Judah lengte thusimbua akijih lut soh keijin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
text:
2KI 15:36
Thadou: Jotham vaihom sunga thilsoh jouse leh aman ana thilbol jouse Judah lengte thusimbua akijih lut soh keijin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

tcz: Hiche nikholai chun, Pakaiyin Syria lengpa Rezin leh Israel lengpa Pekah chu Judah nokhum dingin ahin solpan tan ahi.
en: In those days, the LORD began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.
text:
2KI 15:37
Thadou: Hiche nikholai chun, Pakaiyin Syria lengpa Rezin leh Israel lengpa Pekah chu Judah nokhum dingin ahin solpan tan ahi.
English: In those days, the LORD began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.

tcz: Jotham athiphat’in David khopia apu apate kivuina munah ana vuikhom tauvin ahi. Akhelin achapa Ahaz chun lengvai ahinpo tan ahi.
en: Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 15:38
Thadou: Jotham athiphat’in David khopia apu apate kivuina munah ana vuikhom tauvin ahi. Akhelin achapa Ahaz chun lengvai ahinpo tan ahi.
English: Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Israel lengpa Pekah in lengvai ahop kal kum somle sagi lhinin, Jotham chapa Ahaz chun Judah gam’ah lengvai ahin hom pantan ahi.
en: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.
text:
2KI 16:1
Thadou: Israel lengpa Pekah in lengvai ahop kal kum somle sagi lhinin, Jotham chapa Ahaz chun Judah gam’ah lengvai ahin hom pantan ahi.
English: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

tcz: Ahaz chu leng achan chun kum somni alhingtan ahi. Aman Jerusalem’ah kum somle gup sungin lengvai ana hom’in ahi. Aman apu David khunung ajuijin Pathen Pakai mitmu’n thilpha jeng ana bolpon ahi.
en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in the LORD his God’s eyes, like David his father.
text:
2KI 16:2
Thadou: Ahaz chu leng achan chun kum somni alhingtan ahi. Aman Jerusalem’ah kum somle gup sungin lengvai ana hom’in ahi. Aman apu David khunung ajuijin Pathen Pakai mitmu’n thilpha jeng ana bolpon ahi.
English: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in the LORD his God’s eyes, like David his father.

tcz: Hichesang chun, Israel lengho umchan teho ana juiyin, achapatah jeng jong kilhaina dingin ana tohdoh in ahi. Hiti chun aman Pathenin Israel mite masanga ana deldoh peh’u Pathen neilou nam mite thet umtah thil anabolji houchu ana juitan ahi.
en: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and even made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.
text:
2KI 16:3
Thadou: Hichesang chun, Israel lengho umchan teho ana juiyin, achapatah jeng jong kilhaina dingin ana tohdoh in ahi. Hiti chun aman Pathenin Israel mite masanga ana deldoh peh’u Pathen neilou nam mite thet umtah thil anabolji houchu ana juitan ahi.
English: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and even made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.

tcz: Aman kilhaina gantha anabollin, doi phung leh thinglhang chunglah thingdo-eng noi tinnah gimnamtui ana lhut’in ahi.
en: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
text:
2KI 16:4
Thadou: Aman kilhaina gantha anabollin, doi phung leh thinglhang chunglah thingdo-eng noi tinnah gimnamtui ana lhut’in ahi.
English: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.

tcz: Hijou chun Syria lengpa Rezin leh Israel lengpa Pekah chu Jerusalem sat dingin ahungtou lhontan ahi. Amanin Ahaz anokhum lhonin ahinlah ana jou lhonpon ahi.
en: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.
text:
2KI 16:5
Thadou: Hijou chun Syria lengpa Rezin leh Israel lengpa Pekah chu Jerusalem sat dingin ahungtou lhontan ahi. Amanin Ahaz anokhum lhonin ahinlah ana jou lhonpon ahi.
English: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

tcz: Hichelai phat tah chun Edom lengpan Elath khopi chu Edom mite dingin agalelah kittan ahi. Aman Judah techu adeldoh in Edom mite chu-achun achen lutsah in, tuni geijin achengun ahi.
en: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath, and lived there to this day.
text:
2KI 16:6
Thadou: Hichelai phat tah chun Edom lengpan Elath khopi chu Edom mite dingin agalelah kittan ahi. Aman Judah techu adeldoh in Edom mite chu-achun achen lutsah in, tuni geijin achengun ahi.
English: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath, and lived there to this day.

tcz: Ahaz lengpan Assyria lengpa Tiglath-pileser chu thu athot in, “Keima hi nanoija um nasoh kahin, hungtou vinlang Israel lengpa le Syria lengpan eihung delkhum lhonna akon hin neihung huhdoh’in,” atin ahi.
en: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”
text:
2KI 16:7
Thadou: Ahaz lengpan Assyria lengpa Tiglath-pileser chu thu athot in, “Keima hi nanoija um nasoh kahin, hungtou vinlang Israel lengpa le Syria lengpan eihung delkhum lhonna akon hin neihung huhdoh’in,” atin ahi.
English: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”

tcz: Hijou chun Ahaz in Pakai houin’a konin sana, dangka holeh leng inpia sumlepai kholna a konin sana le dagka ho achomkhom in Assyria lengpa chu athot tan ahi.
en: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the LORD’s house, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
text:
2KI 16:8
Thadou: Hijou chun Ahaz in Pakai houin’a konin sana, dangka holeh leng inpia sumlepai kholna a konin sana le dagka ho achomkhom in Assyria lengpa chu athot tan ahi.
English: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the LORD’s house, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

tcz: Hiti chun Assyria lengpan Syria khopi Damascus chu anokhum’in amipite chu gal hingin akaijin Kir gamsungah achen sah tan ahi. Aman Rezin lengpa jong chu athat’in ahi.
en: The king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, and carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.
text:
2KI 16:9
Thadou: Hiti chun Assyria lengpan Syria khopi Damascus chu anokhum’in amipite chu gal hingin akaijin Kir gamsungah achen sah tan ahi. Aman Rezin lengpa jong chu athat’in ahi.
English: The king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, and carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.

tcz: Ahaz lengpa chu Assyria lengpa Tiglath-pileser toh kimuto dingin Damascus a achen ahi. Hilai munna aum petchun, aman maicham phung kiboldan hochu aven amelchih in, hijouchun aman alimdan hochu hoitah in ajih doh in Uriah thempupa chu athot tan ahi.
en: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.
text:
2KI 16:10
Thadou: Ahaz lengpa chu Assyria lengpa Tiglath-pileser toh kimuto dingin Damascus a achen ahi. Hilai munna aum petchun, aman maicham phung kiboldan hochu aven amelchih in, hijouchun aman alimdan hochu hoitah in ajih doh in Uriah thempupa chu athot tan ahi.
English: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.

tcz: Uriah chun lengpan ahilna ajuijin, maicham phungkhat alim ahung kithot taobang bang chun ana semdoh in, lengpa Damascus akona ahung kile tengleh avet dingin gonsan akoitan ahi.
en: Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.
text:
2KI 16:11
Thadou: Uriah chun lengpan ahilna ajuijin, maicham phungkhat alim ahung kithot taobang bang chun ana semdoh in, lengpa Damascus akona ahung kile tengleh avet dingin gonsan akoitan ahi.
English: Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.

tcz: Lengpa ahung kilephat’in, hiche maicham phung chu aga kholchil in, hichun pumgo thilto abolpai tai.
en: When the king had come from Damascus, the king saw the altar; and the king came near to the altar, and offered on it.
text:
2KI 16:12
Thadou: Lengpa ahung kilephat’in, hiche maicham phung chu aga kholchil in, hichun pumgo thilto abolpai tai.
English: When the king had come from Damascus, the king saw the altar; and the king came near to the altar, and offered on it.

tcz: Aman pumgo thilto atoh in, lhosoh thilto jong atoh in, lengpithei thilto jong achunga asunglhan chuleh maicham chunga chun chamna thilto thisan jong athe khum in ahi.
en: He burned his burnt offering and his meal offering, poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.
text:
2KI 16:13
Thadou: Aman pumgo thilto atoh in, lhosoh thilto jong atoh in, lengpithei thilto jong achunga asunglhan chuleh maicham chunga chun chamna thilto thisan jong athe khum in ahi.
English: He burned his burnt offering and his meal offering, poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.

tcz: Hijou chun Ahaz lengpan maicham thah leh lutna lampi kikah aum Pakai houin maija um sum-englui maicham chu aladoh in, maicham thahpa sahlanga chun achontan ahi.
en: The bronze altar, which was before the LORD, he brought from the front of the house, from between his altar and the LORD’s house, and put it on the north side of his altar.
text:
2KI 16:14
Thadou: Hijou chun Ahaz lengpan maicham thah leh lutna lampi kikah aum Pakai houin maija um sum-englui maicham chu aladoh in, maicham thahpa sahlanga chun achontan ahi.
English: The bronze altar, which was before the LORD, he brought from the front of the house, from between his altar and the LORD’s house, and put it on the north side of his altar.

tcz: Aman Uriah thempupa kom’ah chun, “Hiche maicham thahpa hi, jingkah a pumgo thilto kihalna dingleh, nilhah lang’a lhohsoh thilto ho to nading, lengpa pumgo thilto tonading, chuleh mipitehojouse pumgo thitona chuleh lhohso thilto leh atuija kisunglha tonading ahi. Govam thilto hole pumgo thilto jouse a kona athisan chu maicham thah chunga hi athisan nathekhum ding ahi. Sum-eng maicham vang hi keima chang maicham ding ahi,” ati.
en: King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, “On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by.”
text:
2KI 16:15
