English: His servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.

tcz: Jehoahaz chu leng ahung chan chun ama kum somni thum ana lhingtan ahi. Chuleh aman Jerusalem’ah lha thum leng ana changing ahi. Anuchu Libnah khopi akona Jeremiah chanu Hamutal ahi.
en: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
text:
2KI 23:31
Thadou: Jehoahaz chu leng ahung chan chun ama kum somni thum ana lhingtan ahi. Chuleh aman Jerusalem’ah lha thum leng ana changing ahi. Anuchu Libnah khopi akona Jeremiah chanu Hamutal ahi.
English: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

tcz: Amahin apu apateu chonna bang bangin Pathen deilou jeng ana bollin ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.
text:
2KI 23:32
Thadou: Amahin apu apateu chonna bang bangin Pathen deilou jeng ana bollin ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

tcz: Pharaoh Neco in Johoahaz chu Jerusalem’a avaihoplou nading in Hamath gam’ah Riblah mun’ah songkulla aheng in ahi. Chule aman Judah ten dangka pound sang sagi le ja nga chuleh sana pound som sagi le nga kai apeh dingin ana ngeh in ahi.
en: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
text:
2KI 23:33
Thadou: Pharaoh Neco in Johoahaz chu Jerusalem’a avaihoplou nading in Hamath gam’ah Riblah mun’ah songkulla aheng in ahi. Chule aman Judah ten dangka pound sang sagi le ja nga chuleh sana pound som sagi le nga kai apeh dingin ana ngeh in ahi.
English: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

tcz: Hichun Pharaoh Neco in Josiah chate lah’a khat Eliakim kitipa chu apa khellin leng chang ding in atung in a, amin jong akhel peh in, Jehoiakim asah tan ahi. Ahin Jehoahaz vang chu Egypt gam'a soh chang dingin apuijin hikom’a chun ahung thiden tan ahi.
en: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim; but he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.
text:
2KI 23:34
Thadou: Hichun Pharaoh Neco in Josiah chate lah’a khat Eliakim kitipa chu apa khellin leng chang ding in atung in a, amin jong akhel peh in, Jehoiakim asah tan ahi. Ahin Jehoahaz vang chu Egypt gam'a soh chang dingin apuijin hikom’a chun ahung thiden tan ahi.
English: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim; but he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.

tcz: Pharaoh Neco kom’a kai apeh jouna dingun Jehoiakm in Judah mipite lah’a konin sana le dangka ama ama neile neilou dungjuijin adongin ahi.
en: Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh. He exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, from everyone according to his assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Necoh.
text:
2KI 23:35
Thadou: Pharaoh Neco kom’a kai apeh jouna dingun Jehoiakm in Judah mipite lah’a konin sana le dangka ama ama neile neilou dungjuijin adongin ahi.
English: Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh. He exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, from everyone according to his assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Necoh.

tcz: Jehoiakim chu leng ahung chan kum chun ama kum somni le nga ana lhingtan ahi. Jerusalema chun kum som le khat sung vai anahom in ahi. Anu chu Rumah khopi akon Pedaiah chanu Zebidah ahi.
en: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
text:
2KI 23:36
Thadou: Jehoiakim chu leng ahung chan kum chun ama kum somni le nga ana lhingtan ahi. Jerusalema chun kum som le khat sung vai anahom in ahi. Anu chu Rumah khopi akon Pedaiah chanu Zebidah ahi.
English: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

tcz: Ama jong hin apu apate bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng ana bollin ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.
text:
2KI 23:37
Thadou: Ama jong hin apu apate bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng ana bollin ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

tcz: Jehoiakim vaihom laijin Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzer in Judah gam’ah gal ahin sattan ahileh, Jehoiakim in kisatpi louvin amale agamsung jouse chu Nebuchadnezzer khut’ah ana kipelut tan ahi. Aman kum thum sungin kai anapen, chuche jouvin akiphintan ahi.
en: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.
text:
2KI 24:1
Thadou: Jehoiakim vaihom laijin Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzer in Judah gam’ah gal ahin sattan ahileh, Jehoiakim in kisatpi louvin amale agamsung jouse chu Nebuchadnezzer khut’ah ana kipelut tan ahi. Aman kum thum sungin kai anapen, chuche jouvin akiphintan ahi.
English: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Babylon mite, Syria mite, Moab mite, Ammon mite ahin tildoh in Pakaiyin themgao ho kam’a ana phondoh sahbang bangin aguilhung tan ahi.
en: The LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke by his servants the prophets.
text:
2KI 24:2
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin Babylon mite, Syria mite, Moab mite, Ammon mite ahin tildoh in Pakaiyin themgao ho kam’a ana phondoh sahbang bangin aguilhung tan ahi.
English: The LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke by his servants the prophets.

tcz: Hitobang hamsetna Judah gam’ah ahunglhun hi Pakai thupeh akon ahi. Aman amitmu’a kona Judahte atolmang kigutna ajeh hi Manasseh in thilse tamtah ana boldoh jeh ahi.
en: Surely at the commandment of the LORD this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,
text:
2KI 24:3
Thadou: Hitobang hamsetna Judah gam’ah ahunglhun hi Pakai thupeh akon ahi. Aman amitmu’a kona Judahte atolmang kigutna ajeh hi Manasseh in thilse tamtah ana boldoh jeh ahi.
English: Surely at the commandment of the LORD this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,

tcz: Chule Jerusalem a themmona neilou thisan anaso’a ana hesosah jeh ahi, Pakaiyin hichu a ngaidam lou ahi.
en: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD would not pardon.
text:
2KI 24:4
Thadou: Chule Jerusalem a themmona neilou thisan anaso’a ana hesosah jeh ahi, Pakaiyin hichu a ngaidam lou ahi.
English: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD would not pardon.

tcz: Jehoiakim vaihom sunga thilsoh dangho jouse jong Judahte lengho thusim kijihna lekhabua aumin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
text:
2KI 24:5
Thadou: Jehoiakim vaihom sunga thilsoh dangho jouse jong Judahte lengho thusim kijihna lekhabua aumin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

tcz: Jehoiakim chu athi phat’in, achapa Jehoiachin lengin ahung pangtan ahi.
en: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
text:
2KI 24:6
Thadou: Jehoiakim chu athi phat’in, achapa Jehoiachin lengin ahung pangtan ahi.
English: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Egypt lengpan hichejou apat hin ahung galkondoh jou tapon ahi, ajeh chu Babylon lengpan Egypt in kagam ahi tia ahopsah chengse chu Babylon lengpan abonna alahpeh soh ahitai. Aman ana kilah lut gam hochu Egypt vadunga apat Euphrates vadung chan-gei ahi.
en: The king of Egypt didn’t come out of his land any more; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.
text:
2KI 24:7
Thadou: Egypt lengpan hichejou apat hin ahung galkondoh jou tapon ahi, ajeh chu Babylon lengpan Egypt in kagam ahi tia ahopsah chengse chu Babylon lengpan abonna alahpeh soh ahitai. Aman ana kilah lut gam hochu Egypt vadunga apat Euphrates vadung chan-gei ahi.
English: The king of Egypt didn’t come out of his land any more; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.

tcz: Jehoiachin chu alengchan kum chun ama kum somle kum get alhingtan ahi, chuleh aman Jerusalem chu lha thum bou lengvai anapon ahi. Anu chu Jerusalem makon Elnathan chanu Nehushta ahi.
en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
text:
2KI 24:8
Thadou: Jehoiachin chu alengchan kum chun ama kum somle kum get alhingtan ahi, chuleh aman Jerusalem chu lha thum bou lengvai anapon ahi. Anu chu Jerusalem makon Elnathan chanu Nehushta ahi.
English: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

tcz: Jehoiachin in apa bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng anabol in ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his father had done.
text:
2KI 24:9
Thadou: Jehoiachin in apa bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng anabol in ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his father had done.

tcz: Jehoiachin vaihom sungin, Nebuchadnezzer in Babylon akonin anoija sepai pipui ho ahinsollin Jerusalem ahung umkhum tauvin ahi.
en: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.
text:
2KI 24:10
Thadou: Jehoiachin vaihom sungin, Nebuchadnezzer in Babylon akonin anoija sepai pipui ho ahinsollin Jerusalem ahung umkhum tauvin ahi.
English: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

tcz: Hichun Nebuchadnezzer amatah jong hiche khopi aum sungu hin ahung lhungtan ahi.
en: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,
text:
2KI 24:11
Thadou: Hichun Nebuchadnezzer amatah jong hiche khopi aum sungu hin ahung lhungtan ahi.
English: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,

tcz: Hichun Jehoiachin lengpan lengnu toh ama thumop hotoh, asepai lamkaiho le pipuho Babylonte khut’ah akipelut tauvin ahi. Nebuchadnezzer lengvai ahom kum som le kum get alhin in, Jehoiachin chu aman’in soh chang dingin ana kai tauvin ahi.
en: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.
text:
2KI 24:12
Thadou: Hichun Jehoiachin lengpan lengnu toh ama thumop hotoh, asepai lamkaiho le pipuho Babylonte khut’ah akipelut tauvin ahi. Nebuchadnezzer lengvai ahom kum som le kum get alhin in, Jehoiachin chu aman’in soh chang dingin ana kai tauvin ahi.
English: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.

tcz: Pakaiyin ana phondohsa bangin Nebuchadnezzer in Pakai houin akonin chuleh leng inpia konin sumle pai, sana dangka, neile gou ho jouse le, sana akisem thil-ho jouse, Solomon’in houin a ana koiho abonchan achom theng hel tan ahi.
en: He carried out from there all the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the LORD’s temple, as the LORD had said.
text:
2KI 24:13
Thadou: Pakaiyin ana phondohsa bangin Nebuchadnezzer in Pakai houin akonin chuleh leng inpia konin sumle pai, sana dangka, neile gou ho jouse le, sana akisem thil-ho jouse, Solomon’in houin a ana koiho abonchan achom theng hel tan ahi.
English: He carried out from there all the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the LORD’s temple, as the LORD had said.

tcz: Hiti chun Nebuchadnezzer in Jerusalem khopi sung’a cheng jouse, asepai lamkai ho jouse le sepai galsat themho jouse, khut thepna neiho le thilsem themho abonchan mihem sangsom tobang Babylon gamlang’a akaijin ahi.
en: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.
text:
2KI 24:14
Thadou: Hiti chun Nebuchadnezzer in Jerusalem khopi sung’a cheng jouse, asepai lamkai ho jouse le sepai galsat themho jouse, khut thepna neiho le thilsem themho abonchan mihem sangsom tobang Babylon gamlang’a akaijin ahi.
English: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.

tcz: Nebuchadnezzer in Jehoiachin lengpa, lengnu anu, ajite ho chule apipui ho jaonan Babylon gam'a akaimang tan ahi
en: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land. He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
text:
2KI 24:15
Thadou: Nebuchadnezzer in Jehoiachin lengpa, lengnu anu, ajite ho chule apipui ho jaonan Babylon gam'a akaimang tan ahi
English: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land. He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

tcz: Chuleh aman sepai ahangsan cheh sang sagi leh khut thepna neiho abon’un mihat galsat thei cheh sangkhat ho chu gam chom’ah asoldoh tan ahi.
en: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.
text:
2KI 24:16
Thadou: Chuleh aman sepai ahangsan cheh sang sagi leh khut thepna neiho abon’un mihat galsat thei cheh sangkhat ho chu gam chom’ah asoldoh tan ahi.
English: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

tcz: Hichun Babylon lengpan Jehoiachin pa’ngah pa Mattaniah chu leng in atung in, chule amin jong akhellin, Zedakiah asahtai.
en: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
text:
2KI 24:17
Thadou: Hichun Babylon lengpan Jehoiachin pa’ngah pa Mattaniah chu leng in atung in, chule amin jong akhellin, Zedakiah asahtai.
English: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

tcz: Zedekiah leng ahung chan kum chun ama kum somni le khat ana lhingtan ahi. Aman Jerusalem’ah kum somle khat sungin lengvai ana pon ahi. Anu chu Libnah akon Jeremiah chanu Hamutal ahi.
en: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
text:
2KI 24:18
Thadou: Zedekiah leng ahung chan kum chun ama kum somni le khat ana lhingtan ahi. Aman Jerusalem’ah kum somle khat sungin lengvai ana pon ahi. Anu chu Libnah akon Jeremiah chanu Hamutal ahi.
English: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

tcz: Ahinlah Zedekiah in Jehoiakim bol bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng anabol’in ahi.
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
text:
2KI 24:19
Thadou: Ahinlah Zedekiah in Jehoiakim bol bang bangin Pakai mitmu’n thilse jeng anabol’in ahi.
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

tcz: Jerusalem leh Judah chung’ah thilsoh ho achuhna jeh hi, Pakai lunghan jeh ahi. Hijeh chun Pakaiyin, ama angsunga kona apaidoh a, hitia hi gamchom’a sohchang gam’ah ahi tauve. Zedekiah hin Babylon lengpa a konin kiphinna anei tan ahi.
en: For through the anger of the LORD, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
text:
2KI 24:20
Thadou: Jerusalem leh Judah chung’ah thilsoh ho achuhna jeh hi, Pakai lunghan jeh ahi. Hijeh chun Pakaiyin, ama angsunga kona apaidoh a, hitia hi gamchom’a sohchang gam’ah ahi tauve. Zedekiah hin Babylon lengpa a konin kiphinna anei tan ahi.
English: For through the anger of the LORD, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

tcz: Hiti chun Zedekiah lengvai ahom kal kum ko alhin kum, lha som na, chuche lha, nisom lhin nin Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzer in asepai jouse ahin puijin Jerusalem khopi chu ahin bulutan ahi. Amahon khopi chu aum’uvin pal akai khum tauvin ahi.
en: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.
text:
2KI 25:1
Thadou: Hiti chun Zedekiah lengvai ahom kal kum ko alhin kum, lha som na, chuche lha, nisom lhin nin Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzer in asepai jouse ahin puijin Jerusalem khopi chu ahin bulutan ahi. Amahon khopi chu aum’uvin pal akai khum tauvin ahi.
English: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.

tcz: Zekediah lengpa lengvai ahom kal kum somle khat alhin in, Jerusalem chu galmi ten aumkhum tan ahi.
en: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
text:
2KI 25:2
Thadou: Zekediah lengpa lengvai ahom kal kum somle khat alhin in, Jerusalem chu galmi ten aumkhum tan ahi.
English: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

tcz: Lha li lhinna, niko lhin nin khopi sunga neh ding akilhasam tan, kel ahahsa behseh tan, anneh twidon ding akinehchai gam tauvin kel athohpan tauvin ahi.
en: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
text:
2KI 25:3
Thadou: Lha li lhinna, niko lhin nin khopi sunga neh ding akilhasam tan, kel ahahsa behseh tan, anneh twidon ding akinehchai gam tauvin kel athohpan tauvin ahi.
English: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

tcz: Hijou chun khopi pal chu themkhat avutbang’un, chule sepai ho jouse chu ajam gam tauvin ahi. Ajeh chu khopi chu Babylon ten aumkhum chahkheh chule jankhovah hella achanlhih jeng vangun, pal le pal kikah a lengpa honleiya chun ajamdoh tauve. Amaho chu Arabah lang jonin ache tauvin ahi.
en: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city around it); and the king went by the way of the Arabah.
text:
2KI 25:4
Thadou: Hijou chun khopi pal chu themkhat avutbang’un, chule sepai ho jouse chu ajam gam tauvin ahi. Ajeh chu khopi chu Babylon ten aumkhum chahkheh chule jankhovah hella achanlhih jeng vangun, pal le pal kikah a lengpa honleiya chun ajamdoh tauve. Amaho chu Arabah lang jonin ache tauvin ahi.
English: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city around it); and the king went by the way of the Arabah.

tcz: Ahinlah Babylon sepaihon lengpa chu adellun Jericho phaicham’a chun aman tauve, ajeh chu asepaiten adalhah uva kithecheh gam'a ahitauve.
en: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
text:
2KI 25:5
Thadou: Ahinlah Babylon sepaihon lengpa chu adellun Jericho phaicham’a chun aman tauve, ajeh chu asepaiten adalhah uva kithecheh gam'a ahitauve.
English: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

tcz: Amahon Riblah kho muna Babylon lengpa kom alhut tauvin, hilai munah chun Zedekiah lengpa chu achungthu atan tauvin ahi.
en: Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.
text:
2KI 25:6
Thadou: Amahon Riblah kho muna Babylon lengpa kom alhut tauvin, hilai munah chun Zedekiah lengpa chu achungthu atan tauvin ahi.
English: Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.

tcz: Amahon achateu atha peh uchu avetsah’un ahi. Hijou chun amit akaldoh peh’un sum-eng khaoguija akan un Babylon lang’ah akai tauvin ahi.
en: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
text:
2KI 25:7
Thadou: Amahon achateu atha peh uchu avetsah’un ahi. Hijou chun amit akaldoh peh’un sum-eng khaoguija akan un Babylon lang’ah akai tauvin ahi.
English: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

tcz: Nebuchadnezzer lengpa lengchan kal kum somle ko lhin kum, lha nga lhin na, chuche lha, ni sagi lhin nin, Babylon lengpa sepai pipui chuleh leng vesui lah’a lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chu Jerusalem ahung lhung atan ahi.
en: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
text:
2KI 25:8
Thadou: Nebuchadnezzer lengpa lengchan kal kum somle ko lhin kum, lha nga lhin na, chuche lha, ni sagi lhin nin, Babylon lengpa sepai pipui chuleh leng vesui lah’a lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chu Jerusalem ahung lhung atan ahi.
English: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hichun aman Pakai houin, leng inpi chuleh Jerusalem a in jouse ahal lhan chuleh khopi sunga insang aphadom jouse jong asuse gam tan ahi.
en: He burned the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.
text:
2KI 25:9
Thadou: Hichun aman Pakai houin, leng inpi chuleh Jerusalem a in jouse ahal lhan chuleh khopi sunga insang aphadom jouse jong asuse gam tan ahi.
English: He burned the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.

tcz: Chujongle aman Babylon sepai hojouse chu Jerusalem pal ho avohlhuh sah in, ajet avaija umjouse jong asuhset sah sohkeijin ahi.
en: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.
text:
2KI 25:10
Thadou: Chujongle aman Babylon sepai hojouse chu Jerusalem pal ho avohlhuh sah in, ajet avaija umjouse jong asuhset sah sohkeijin ahi.
English: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

tcz: Babylon lengpa tahsa vesuija pang ho lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chun, Jerusalem khopi sunga ana kidalha mipi amoh chengse, Babylon lengpa lang’a ana pang chengse chutoh mipi ahon jamah amoh chengse chu sohchang dingin ahin toldoh tauvin ahi.
en: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.
text:
2KI 25:11
Thadou: Babylon lengpa tahsa vesuija pang ho lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chun, Jerusalem khopi sunga ana kidalha mipi amoh chengse, Babylon lengpa lang’a ana pang chengse chutoh mipi ahon jamah amoh chengse chu sohchang dingin ahin toldoh tauvin ahi.
English: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.

tcz: Hichea hin Sepai lamkaipa hin mipi holah’a avaichapen hochu lengpilei leh lou lhou dingin adalhan ahi.
en: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.
text:
2KI 25:12
Thadou: Hichea hin Sepai lamkaipa hin mipi holah’a avaichapen hochu lengpilei leh lou lhou dingin adalhan ahi.
English: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

tcz: Pakai houin maiya sum-eng khom kiphut holeh Pakai houin sunga sumeng twikonglen atunna sum-enga kisem chengse jong chu Babylon sepaiten avo chipdellun, sum-eng chengse chu Babylon lamah akipoh atove.
en: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.
text:
2KI 25:13
Thadou: Pakai houin maiya sum-eng khom kiphut holeh Pakai houin sunga sumeng twikonglen atunna sum-enga kisem chengse jong chu Babylon sepaiten avo chipdellun, sum-eng chengse chu Babylon lamah akipoh atove.
English: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.

tcz: Chujongle Babylon mite chun bel jouseu le tupheng jouse jong, chaiche ho ahin gim namtui hal namna lhengho ahin, houin kin bolna dinga kisem sum-enga kibol umle bel lhengle kong abonchan akipoh mang tauve.
en: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.
text:
2KI 25:14
Thadou: Chujongle Babylon mite chun bel jouseu le tupheng jouse jong, chaiche ho ahin gim namtui hal namna lhengho ahin, houin kin bolna dinga kisem sum-enga kibol umle bel lhengle kong abonchan akipoh mang tauve.
English: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

tcz: Sepai lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chun gim namtui kihalna le kong ho chule sana le dangka thengsel'a kisem thildang dang ho jouse jong akilah gam’in ahi.
en: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.
text:
2KI 25:15
Thadou: Sepai lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chun gim namtui kihalna le kong ho chule sana le dangka thengsel'a kisem thildang dang ho jouse jong akilah gam’in ahi.
English: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.

tcz: Sum-eng’a kisem khompi teni, twikonglen, akhom atunna tenia kimang umle bel, lheng le konga kimang sumeng chengse chu agihdan anasa behseh jengin tejou hilou ahi. Hiche thilkeo hose se hi Solomon lengpan Pakai houin na pang dinga anasem ho chu ahi.
en: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for the LORD’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.
text:
2KI 25:16
Thadou: Sum-eng’a kisem khompi teni, twikonglen, akhom atunna tenia kimang umle bel, lheng le konga kimang sumeng chengse chu agihdan anasa behseh jengin tejou hilou ahi. Hiche thilkeo hose se hi Solomon lengpan Pakai houin na pang dinga anasem ho chu ahi.
English: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for the LORD’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.

tcz: Khomkhat chu asandan tong som le tong get alhingin, aluvumma chu alutomding sum-enga kisem asandan tong thum cheh a lhingin,chule khut them lah a kijempah a kolbuthei pahcha jem banga aluvum kimvella kisem sohkei ahi.
en: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.
text:
2KI 25:17
Thadou: Khomkhat chu asandan tong som le tong get alhingin, aluvumma chu alutomding sum-enga kisem asandan tong thum cheh a lhingin,chule khut them lah a kijempah a kolbuthei pahcha jem banga aluvum kimvella kisem sohkei ahi.
English: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.

tcz: Nebuzaradan sepai lamkaipa chun thempulen Seraiah le thempu ni lhinna Zephaniah kitipa chutoh kelkot ngah apangji mithum chutoh sohchang dingin akai mangin ahi.
en: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;

tcz: Chujongleh khopi sunga akisel nalai mipi holah a konin, Judah te dia gal lamkaipa leh lengpa thumop a pang mi nga, sepaite gamsungmi simtohle apang alamkai pauvin lekhasun’a amanpa leh khopi sunga kimandoh mi somgup chutoh anakai mangthan ahi.
en: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.
text:
2KI 25:19
Thadou: Chujongleh khopi sunga akisel nalai mipi holah a konin, Judah te dia gal lamkaipa leh lengpa thumop a pang mi nga, sepaite gamsungmi simtohle apang alamkai pauvin lekhasun’a amanpa leh khopi sunga kimandoh mi somgup chutoh anakai mangthan ahi.
English: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.

tcz: Sepai lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chun, amaho jouse chu Riblah khomun ah Babylon lengpa henga ahinkai luttan ahi..
en: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
text:
2KI 25:20
Thadou: Sepai lamkaipa Nebuzaradan chun, amaho jouse chu Riblah khomun ah Babylon lengpa henga ahinkai luttan ahi..
English: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

tcz: Riblah kho Hamath gamsunga chun Babylon lengpan abonchauvin adengin athat sohtai. Chuin Judah mite chu agamsung uva konin sohchang din aki kaimang sohtauvin ahi.
en: The king of Babylon attacked them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.
text:
2KI 25:21
Thadou: Riblah kho Hamath gamsunga chun Babylon lengpan abonchauvin adengin athat sohtai. Chuin Judah mite chu agamsung uva konin sohchang din aki kaimang sohtauvin ahi.
English: The king of Babylon attacked them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

tcz: Hijou chun Nebuchadnezzer lengpan Shaphan tupa, Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chu Judah gam’ah hung kidalha mipiho chunga gamvaipo dingin ana pansah in ahi.
en: As for the people who were left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.
text:
2KI 25:22
Thadou: Hijou chun Nebuchadnezzer lengpan Shaphan tupa, Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chu Judah gam’ah hung kidalha mipiho chunga gamvaipo dingin ana pansah in ahi.
English: As for the people who were left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.

tcz: Babylon lengpa Nebucahdnezzar in Gedaliah kitipa hi gamvaipon apansah taiti Judah mi sepai holeh apipui houvin ajah phat’un, amahon Gedaliah chu Mizpah a akimupi din ana cheuvin ahi. Amahochu Nethaniah chapa Ishmael, Kereah chapa Johanan, Netophath khomi Tanhumeth chapa Seraiah, Maacath khomi chapa Jezaniah chule akho midang jouse ahiuve.
en: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.
text:
2KI 25:23
Thadou: Babylon lengpa Nebucahdnezzar in Gedaliah kitipa hi gamvaipon apansah taiti Judah mi sepai holeh apipui houvin ajah phat’un, amahon Gedaliah chu Mizpah a akimupi din ana cheuvin ahi. Amahochu Nethaniah chapa Ishmael, Kereah chapa Johanan, Netophath khomi Tanhumeth chapa Seraiah, Maacath khomi chapa Jezaniah chule akho midang jouse ahiuve.
English: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

tcz: Hichun Gedaliah chu amaho kom’achun akihahsel’in hitin aseije, “Ima kichatna le tijatna nei hih hellun, gamsunga chun lungmong in cheng un, chule Babylon lengpa thuhi ngaiyun, chutile nangho dinga imajouse phajeng ding ahi,” tin alungmon sah’un ahi.
en: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, “Don’t be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”
text:
2KI 25:24
Thadou: Hichun Gedaliah chu amaho kom’achun akihahsel’in hitin aseije, “Ima kichatna le tijatna nei hih hellun, gamsunga chun lungmong in cheng un, chule Babylon lengpa thuhi ngaiyun, chutile nangho dinga imajouse phajeng ding ahi,” tin alungmon sah’un ahi.
English: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, “Don’t be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”

tcz: Ahivangin hiche kumma lhasagi lhin phat’in leng insunga peng mi, Elishama tupa Nethaniah chapa Ishmael chu sepai somkhat toh ahung konin Mizpah khoa hin Gedaliah leh Judah mite toh Babylon mite umkhom apanpi chengse chu ahung delkhum mun athat tauve.
en: But in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring came, and ten men with him, and struck Gedaliah so that he died, with the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.
text:
2KI 25:25
Thadou: Ahivangin hiche kumma lhasagi lhin phat’in leng insunga peng mi, Elishama tupa Nethaniah chapa Ishmael chu sepai somkhat toh ahung konin Mizpah khoa hin Gedaliah leh Judah mite toh Babylon mite umkhom apanpi chengse chu ahung delkhum mun athat tauve.
English: But in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring came, and ten men with him, and struck Gedaliah so that he died, with the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.

tcz: Hiche jou chun Judah ho aneovapat alenpen geijin chujongleh asepai lamkaiho geijin kichatah’in Egypt lang’ah ajam gam tauvin ahi, ajeh chu Babylon miten i-ahinlo diu ham tichu kicha a ahiuve.
en: All the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces arose and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.
text:
2KI 25:26
Thadou: Hiche jou chun Judah ho aneovapat alenpen geijin chujongleh asepai lamkaiho geijin kichatah’in Egypt lang’ah ajam gam tauvin ahi, ajeh chu Babylon miten i-ahinlo diu ham tichu kicha a ahiuve.
English: All the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces arose and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

tcz: Judah lengpa Jehoiachin sohchanna kum somthum le sagi alhin’in, Hiche kum chuche lha, nisom ni le ni sagi lhin nin Evil-merodach chun Babylon lengmun ahinlo tan ahile, Jehoiachin chu akhoto in songkulla konin alhadoh tan ahi.
en: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,
text:
2KI 25:27
Thadou: Judah lengpa Jehoiachin sohchanna kum somthum le sagi alhin’in, Hiche kum chuche lha, nisom ni le ni sagi lhin nin Evil-merodach chun Babylon lengmun ahinlo tan ahile, Jehoiachin chu akhoto in songkulla konin alhadoh tan ahi.
English: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,

tcz: Amahin Jehoiachin chu ngailutna neitah’in akihoupi in, Babylon’a leng dang kihen ho sangin mun sang apen jana ana pen ahi.
en: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,
text:
2KI 25:28
Thadou: Amahin Jehoiachin chu ngailutna neitah’in akihoupi in, Babylon’a leng dang kihen ho sangin mun sang apen jana ana pen ahi.
English: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

tcz: Aman Jehoiachin chu songkul von khel chun vonthah anapen chuleh ahinkho lhung keija lengpatoh anneh khom dingin phalna anapen ahi.
en: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life;

tcz: Hiti chun Babylon lengpan ahinkho lhumkeiya niseh’a aneh ding an agontoh peh in, ama neh ding chan khat akisem jing jeng tan ahi.
en: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.
text:
2KI 25:30
Thadou: Hiti chun Babylon lengpan ahinkho lhumkeiya niseh’a aneh ding an agontoh peh in, ama neh ding chan khat akisem jing jeng tan ahi.
English: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.

tcz: Adam son le achilhahho Seth, Enosh;
en: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

tcz: Kenan, Mahalaleh, Jareh,
en: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
text:
1CH 1:2
Thadou: Kenan, Mahalaleh, Jareh,
English: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

tcz: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
en: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
text:
1CH 1:3
Thadou: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
English: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

tcz: Chule Noah, Noah chate ho * Shem, Ham chule Japheth.
en: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
text:
1CH 1:4
Thadou: Chule Noah, Noah chate ho * Shem, Ham chule Japheth.
English: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

tcz: Japheth chilhahho chu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, chule Tira ahiuve.
en: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
text:
1CH 1:5
Thadou: Japheth chilhahho chu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, chule Tira ahiuve.
English: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

tcz: Gomer son achilhahho chu Ashkenaz, riphath * chule Togarmah ahiuve.
en: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.
text:
1CH 1:6
Thadou: Gomer son achilhahho chu Ashkenaz, riphath * chule Togarmah ahiuve.
English: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.

tcz: Javan son achihlhahho chu Elishah, Tarshish, kikttim chule Rodanim ahiuve.
en: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
text:
1CH 1:7
Thadou: Javan son achihlhahho chu Elishah, Tarshish, kikttim chule Rodanim ahiuve.
English: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

tcz: Ham chapate chu Cush, Mizraim, *Put chule Canaan ahiuve.
en: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
text:
1CH 1:8
Thadou: Ham chapate chu Cush, Mizraim, *Put chule Canaan ahiuve.
English: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

tcz: Cush son achilhahho chu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, chule Sabteca ahiuve. Raamah chapate ni chu Sheba le Dedan ahilhone.
en: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
text:
1CH 1:9
Thadou: Cush son achilhahho chu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, chule Sabteca ahiuve. Raamah chapate ni chu Sheba le Dedan ahilhone.
English: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

tcz: Cush jong hin Nimros ahingin, Nimros hi leiset chunga galhang masapen in ahung pang tai.
en: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
text:
1CH 1:10
Thadou: Cush jong hin Nimros ahingin, Nimros hi leiset chunga galhang masapen in ahung pang tai.
English: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

tcz: Mizraim hin Ludim toh, Anamim toh, Lehabim toh, Naphtuhim toh,
en: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
text:
1CH 1:11
Thadou: Mizraim hin Ludim toh, Anamim toh, Lehabim toh, Naphtuhim toh,
English: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

tcz: Pathrusim toh, Casluhim toh, Caphtorim toh ahingin, amaho’a konna hi Philistine ho hung kondoh ahiuve.
en: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.
text:
1CH 1:12
Thadou: Pathrusim toh, Casluhim toh, Caphtorim toh ahingin, amaho’a konna hi Philistine ho hung kondoh ahiuve.
English: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.

tcz: Canaan chapa masapen/tahpen chu Sidan ahin, Sidon chu Sidon mite ahung pen nau bulpi ahung hitai. Chujouvin Canaan in Heth kitipa chu ahinge.
en: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,
text:
1CH 1:13
Thadou: Canaan chapa masapen/tahpen chu Sidan ahin, Sidon chu Sidon mite ahung pen nau bulpi ahung hitai. Chujouvin Canaan in Heth kitipa chu ahinge.
English: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,

tcz: Jebus mite, Amor mite, girgash mite,
en: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,
text:
1CH 1:14
Thadou: Jebus mite, Amor mite, girgash mite,
English: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

tcz: Hivi mite, Ark mite, Sin mite,
en: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,
text:
1CH 1:15
Thadou: Hivi mite, Ark mite, Sin mite,
English: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

tcz: Arvad mite, Zemar mite, chule Hamath mite jong ahiuve.
en: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
text:
1CH 1:16
Thadou: Arvad mite, Zemar mite, chule Hamath mite jong ahiuve.
English: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

tcz: Shem chapate chu Elam, Asshur, Aphaxad, Lud, chule Ram ahiuve.
en: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
text:
1CH 1:17
Thadou: Shem chapate chu Elam, Asshur, Aphaxad, Lud, chule Ram ahiuve.
English: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

tcz: Arphaxad kitipa hin Shelah ahingin, Shelah kitipa hin Eber ahinge.
en: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.
text:
1CH 1:18
Thadou: Arphaxad kitipa hin Shelah ahingin, Shelah kitipa hin Eber ahinge.
English: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

tcz: Eber hin chapa ni ahingin, chapa masapa chu amin Peleg akiti ( hichu kikhentel tina ahi ); ijeh-enem itileh ama khang laiya leiset mite chu pao le ham chom chom’a kikhentel anahi, chule asopipa min chu Joktan ahi.
en: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
text:
1CH 1:19
Thadou: Eber hin chapa ni ahingin, chapa masapa chu amin Peleg akiti ( hichu kikhentel tina ahi ); ijeh-enem itileh ama khang laiya leiset mite chu pao le ham chom chom’a kikhentel anahi, chule asopipa min chu Joktan ahi.
English: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

tcz: Joktan hin Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
en: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
text:
1CH 1:20
Thadou: Joktan hin Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
English: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

tcz: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
text:
1CH 1:21
Thadou: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
English: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

tcz: Obal,*Abhimael, Sheba,
en: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
text:
1CH 1:22
Thadou: Obal,*Abhimael, Sheba,
English: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,

tcz: Ophir, Havilah, chule Jobab ahingin ahi. Mi hichengse hi abonchauva Joktan son achilhah jeng ahiuve.
en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
text:
1CH 1:23
Thadou: Ophir, Havilah, chule Jobab ahingin ahi. Mi hichengse hi abonchauva Joktan son achilhah jeng ahiuve.
English: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

tcz: Shem son achilhah : Arphaxad, Shelah, *
en: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,
text:
1CH 1:24
Thadou: Shem son achilhah : Arphaxad, Shelah, *
English: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

tcz: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
en: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
text:
1CH 1:25
Thadou: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
English: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

tcz: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
en: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
text:
1CH 1:26
Thadou: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
English: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

tcz: Chule Abram, ama hi khonunga Abraham kitipa chu ahi.
en: Abram (also called Abraham).
text:
1CH 1:27
Thadou: Chule Abram, ama hi khonunga Abraham kitipa chu ahi.
English: Abram (also called Abraham).

tcz: Abraham chapa teni chu Isaac le Ishmael ahilhone.
en: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
text:
1CH 1:28
Thadou: Abraham chapa teni chu Isaac le Ishmael ahilhone.
English: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

tcz: Akhanggui kisim dan’u chu hiti hi ahiye : Ishmael chapate chu Nebaioth ( apeng masapen ), Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
en: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
text:
1CH 1:29
Thadou: Akhanggui kisim dan’u chu hiti hi ahiye : Ishmael chapate chu Nebaioth ( apeng masapen ), Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
English: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

tcz: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
en: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
text:
1CH 1:30
Thadou: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
English: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

tcz: Jetur, Naphish, chule Kedemah ahiuve. Hichengse hi Ishmael chapate ahiuve.
en: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
text:
1CH 1:31
Thadou: Jetur, Naphish, chule Kedemah ahiuve. Hichengse hi Ishmael chapate ahiuve.
English: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

tcz: Abraham thaikemnu Keturah chapate chu Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, midian, Ishbak, chule Shuah ahiuvin ahi. Jokshan chapate ni chu Sheba le Dedan ahilhone.
en: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
text:
1CH 1:32
Thadou: Abraham thaikemnu Keturah chapate chu Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, midian, Ishbak, chule Shuah ahiuvin ahi. Jokshan chapate ni chu Sheba le Dedan ahilhone.
English: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

tcz: Midian chapate chu Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, chule Eldaah ahiuve. Mi hichengse hi Abraham thaikemnu Keturah son achilhah jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
text:
1CH 1:33
Thadou: Midian chapate chu Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, chule Eldaah ahiuve. Mi hichengse hi Abraham thaikemnu Keturah son achilhah jeng ahiuvin ahi.
English: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

tcz: Abraham hin Isaac anahingin ahi. Isaac chapate ni chu Esau le Israel* ahilhone.
en: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
text:
1CH 1:34
Thadou: Abraham hin Isaac anahingin ahi. Isaac chapate ni chu Esau le Israel* ahilhone.
English: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

tcz: Esau chapate chu Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, chule Korah ahiuve.
en: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
text:
1CH 1:35
Thadou: Esau chapate chu Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, chule Korah ahiuve.
English: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

tcz: Eliphaz chapate chu Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz chule Amalek ahiuve. Amalek hi Timna sung peng ahi.
en: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
text:
1CH 1:36
Thadou: Eliphaz chapate chu Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz chule Amalek ahiuve. Amalek hi Timna sung peng ahi.
English: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

tcz: Reuel son achilhaho chu Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, chule Mizzah ahiuvin ahi.
en: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
text:
1CH 1:37
Thadou: Reuel son achilhaho chu Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, chule Mizzah ahiuvin ahi.
English: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

tcz: Seir son achilhahho chu Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Nah, Dishon, Ezer, chule Dishan ahiuve
en: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
text:
1CH 1:38
Thadou: Seir son achilhahho chu Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Nah, Dishon, Ezer, chule Dishan ahiuve
English: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

tcz: Lotan chapate ni chu Hori le Heman ahilhonin, chule Lotan sopinu min chu Timna akiti.
en: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
text:
1CH 1:39
Thadou: Lotan chapate ni chu Hori le Heman ahilhonin, chule Lotan sopinu min chu Timna akiti.
English: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

tcz: Shobal son achilhahho chu Alvan, *Manahath, Ebal, Shepho,* chule Onam ahiuve. Zibeon chapate ni chu Ariah le Anah ahilhone.
en: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
text:
1CH 1:40
Thadou: Shobal son achilhahho chu Alvan, *Manahath, Ebal, Shepho,* chule Onam ahiuve. Zibeon chapate ni chu Ariah le Anah ahilhone.
English: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

tcz: Anah chapa chu Dishon ahin; Dishon chapate chu Hemdan, * Eshban, Ithran, chule Keran ahiuve.
en: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
text:
1CH 1:41
Thadou: Anah chapa chu Dishon ahin; Dishon chapate chu Hemdan, * Eshban, Ithran, chule Keran ahiuve.
English: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

tcz: Ezer chapate chu Bilhan, Zaavan, chule Akan * ahiuve. Dishan chapate ni chu Uz le Aran ahilhone.
en: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
text:
1CH 1:42
Thadou: Ezer chapate chu Bilhan, Zaavan, chule Akan * ahiuve. Dishan chapate ni chu Uz le Aran ahilhone.
English: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

tcz: Israelte chunga mi koima lengvaipoa pang anaum masanga Edom gamsunga lengvaipoa anapang miho chu leng hichengse hi ahiuve.* Boer chapa Bela ahin, a lengvaipohna khopi min chu Dinhabah akiti.
en: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
text:
1CH 1:43
Thadou: Israelte chunga mi koima lengvaipoa pang anaum masanga Edom gamsunga lengvaipoa anapang miho chu leng hichengse hi ahiuve.* Boer chapa Bela ahin, a lengvaipohna khopi min chu Dinhabah akiti.
English: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

tcz: Bela athi phat in ama khel’in Bozrah kho’a mi Zerah chapa Jobab chun lengvai anapon ahi.
en: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
text:
1CH 1:44
Thadou: Bela athi phat in ama khel’in Bozrah kho’a mi Zerah chapa Jobab chun lengvai anapon ahi.
English: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

tcz: Jobab athi kit phat chun ama khel’in Teman mite gamsunga mi Husham kitipa chun lengvai anapon ahi
en: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
text:
1CH 1:45
Thadou: Jobab athi kit phat chun ama khel’in Teman mite gamsunga mi Husham kitipa chun lengvai anapon ahi
English: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

tcz: Husham athi phat’in ama khel’in Moab gamsunga midan sepaite kisatpia jou lengpa Bedad chapa Hadad chun akhopi min Avith kiti munna kon chun lengvai anapon ahi.
en: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
text:
1CH 1:46
Thadou: Husham athi phat’in ama khel’in Moab gamsunga midan sepaite kisatpia jou lengpa Bedad chapa Hadad chun akhopi min Avith kiti munna kon chun lengvai anapon ahi.
English: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.

tcz: Hadad athi kit phat chun Masrekah khoa mi Samlah chun ama khel’in lengvai apotai.
en: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
text:
1CH 1:47
Thadou: Hadad athi kit phat chun Masrekah khoa mi Samlah chun ama khel’in lengvai apotai.
English: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

tcz: Samlah athi phat’in ama khel’in luipi dunga cheng Rehoboth khoa mi Shaul kitipa chun lengvai apotan ahi.
en: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.
text:
1CH 1:48
Thadou: Samlah athi phat’in ama khel’in luipi dunga cheng Rehoboth khoa mi Shaul kitipa chun lengvai apotan ahi.
English: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.

tcz: Shaul thi nungin ama khel’in Acbor chapa Baal-hanan kitipa chun lengvai apon ahi.
en: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
text:
1CH 1:49
Thadou: Shaul thi nungin ama khel’in Acbor chapa Baal-hanan kitipa chun lengvai apon ahi.
English: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

tcz: Baal-hanan athi kit phat’in ama khel’in Hadad chun akhopi min Pau kiti munna kon chun lengvai anapon ahi. Ajinu min chu Mehetabel ahin, Matred chanu chule Me-zahab tunu anahi.
en: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
text:
1CH 1:50
Thadou: Baal-hanan athi kit phat’in ama khel’in Hadad chun akhopi min Pau kiti munna kon chun lengvai anapon ahi. Ajinu min chu Mehetabel ahin, Matred chanu chule Me-zahab tunu anahi.
English: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

tcz: Hadad jong athi kit tai. Edom gam'a ahung lamkai/haosa ho chu Timna, Alvah,* Jetheth,
en: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
text:
1CH 1:51
Thadou: Hadad jong athi kit tai. Edom gam'a ahung lamkai/haosa ho chu Timna, Alvah,* Jetheth,
English: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

tcz: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
en: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
text:
1CH 1:52
Thadou: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
English: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

tcz: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
en: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
text:
1CH 1:53
Thadou: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
English: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

tcz: Magdiel, chule Iram ahiuve. Mi hichengse hi Edom gam'a phung lamkai ( Haosa ) jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
text:
1CH 1:54
Thadou: Magdiel, chule Iram ahiuve. Mi hichengse hi Edom gam'a phung lamkai ( Haosa ) jeng ahiuvin ahi.
English: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

tcz: Israel chapate chu Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
en: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
text:
1CH 2:1
Thadou: Israel chapate chu Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
English: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

tcz: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, chule Asher ahiuve.
en: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
text:
1CH 2:2
Thadou: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, chule Asher ahiuve.
English: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

tcz: Judah chun Canaan numei nu Bathshua kitinu akon in chapa thum ahingin ahi. Amaho min chu Er, Onan, chule Shelah ahiuve. Achapa apeng masapa Er kitipa hi Pakai mitmun agilou behseh jengin ahileh Pakaiyin jong amapa chu athat tai.
en: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; and he killed him.
text:
1CH 2:3
Thadou: Judah chun Canaan numei nu Bathshua kitinu akon in chapa thum ahingin ahi. Amaho min chu Er, Onan, chule Shelah ahiuve. Achapa apeng masapa Er kitipa hi Pakai mitmun agilou behseh jengin ahileh Pakaiyin jong amapa chu athat tai.
English: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; and he killed him.

tcz: Judah hin amounu meithainu Tamar chu tohjong chapa pengkop ni Perez le Zerah chu ahing kit’in, hijeh chun Judah hin chapa nga jen aneiyin ahi.
en: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
text:
1CH 2:4
Thadou: Judah hin amounu meithainu Tamar chu tohjong chapa pengkop ni Perez le Zerah chu ahing kit’in, hijeh chun Judah hin chapa nga jen aneiyin ahi.
English: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

tcz: Perez chapate ni chu Hezron le Hamul ahilhone.
en: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
text:
1CH 2:5
Thadou: Perez chapate ni chu Hezron le Hamul ahilhone.
English: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

tcz: Zerah chapate chu Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, chule Darda ahiuvin mi nga jeng alhing uve.
en: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.
text:
1CH 2:6
Thadou: Zerah chapate chu Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, chule Darda ahiuvin mi nga jeng alhing uve.
English: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.

tcz: Carmi ( Zimri son achilhah ) chapa chu Achar ahin, amahin suhmang dinga kikoisa thet ho chunga Israelte anabol gim lheh jengin ahi.
en: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.
text:
1CH 2:7
Thadou: Carmi ( Zimri son achilhah ) chapa chu Achar ahin, amahin suhmang dinga kikoisa thet ho chunga Israelte anabol gim lheh jengin ahi.
English: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.

tcz: Ethan chapa chu Azariah ahi.
en: The son of Ethan: Azariah.
text:
1CH 2:8
Thadou: Ethan chapa chu Azariah ahi.
English: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

tcz: Hezron chapate chu Jerahmeel, Ram, chule Caleb* ahiuve.
en: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
text:
1CH 2:9
Thadou: Hezron chapate chu Jerahmeel, Ram, chule Caleb* ahiuve.
English: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

tcz: Ram hin Amminadab ahingin, chule Amminadab hin Judahte leng chapa Nahshon ahingin ahi.
en: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

tcz: Nahshon hin Salmon ahingin, Salmon hin Boaz ahingin,
en: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,
text:
1CH 2:11
Thadou: Nahshon hin Salmon ahingin, Salmon hin Boaz ahingin,
English: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,

tcz: Boaz chun Obed ahingin, Obed in Jesse ahinge.
en: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;

tcz: Jesse chapa apeng masapaen chu Eliab ahin, anina pa Abinadab ahin, athum lhinna pa Shimea ahin,
en: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,
text:
1CH 2:13
Thadou: Jesse chapa apeng masapaen chu Eliab ahin, anina pa Abinadab ahin, athum lhinna pa Shimea ahin,
English: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,

tcz: Ali lhin na pachu Nethanel ahin, Raddai chu nga lhinna ahi.
en: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
text:
1CH 2:14
Thadou: Ali lhin na pachu Nethanel ahin, Raddai chu nga lhinna ahi.
English: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

tcz: Ozem chu achapa gup lhinna ahin, chule asagi lhinna chu David ahitai.
en: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;

tcz: Amaho hin sopi numei ni aneiyun amin lhon jong Zeruiah leh Abigail ahilhone. Zeruiah hin chapa thum ahingin, Abishai, Joab, chule Asahel ahiuve.
en: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
text:
1CH 2:16
Thadou: Amaho hin sopi numei ni aneiyun amin lhon jong Zeruiah leh Abigail ahilhone. Zeruiah hin chapa thum ahingin, Abishai, Joab, chule Asahel ahiuve.
English: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.

tcz: Abigail hin Ishmael mi Jether kitipa chu ahing lhonne.
en: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
text:
1CH 2:17
Thadou: Abigail hin Ishmael mi Jether kitipa chu ahing lhonne.
English: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

tcz: Hezron chapa Caleb jong hin ajinu Azubah kitinu Jerioth khoa minu chu toh chapa phabep ahing lhonin ahi. Amanu chapate chu Jesher, Shobab, chule Ardon ahiuvin ahi.
en: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
text:
1CH 2:18
Thadou: Hezron chapa Caleb jong hin ajinu Azubah kitinu Jerioth khoa minu chu toh chapa phabep ahing lhonin ahi. Amanu chapate chu Jesher, Shobab, chule Ardon ahiuvin ahi.
English: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

tcz: Azubah hi athi nungin Caleb in Ephrathah akichenpi’in, chule chapa khat Hur kitipa chu ahing lhonne.
en: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
text:
1CH 2:19
Thadou: Azubah hi athi nungin Caleb in Ephrathah akichenpi’in, chule chapa khat Hur kitipa chu ahing lhonne.
English: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

tcz: Hur hin Uri ahingin, Uri in Bezalel ahinge.
en: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.
text:
1CH 2:20
Thadou: Hur hin Uri ahingin, Uri in Bezalel ahinge.
English: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

tcz: Hezron hin akum kum som gup jen alhin nungin, Gilead sopinu Makir chanu chu akichenpin ahileh, chapa khat amin Segub kitipa chu ahing lhonnin ahi.
en: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
text:
1CH 2:21
Thadou: Hezron hin akum kum som gup jen alhin nungin, Gilead sopinu Makir chanu chu akichenpin ahileh, chapa khat amin Segub kitipa chu ahing lhonnin ahi.
English: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

tcz: Segub hin Gilead gamsunga khopi somni le thum jen semdoh’a chule lengvaipoa pang Jair kitipa chu ahingin ahi.
en: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
text:
1CH 2:22
Thadou: Segub hin Gilead gamsunga khopi somni le thum jen semdoh’a chule lengvaipoa pang Jair kitipa chu ahingin ahi.
English: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

tcz: Ahin Geshur le Ram chun Jair ngahmun khopi toh Kenath khopi toh chule akhobah chengse kholen cheh somgup jen alah tha lhon tai. Mi hichengse hi Gilead hingpa Makir son achilhah jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
text:
1CH 2:23
Thadou: Ahin Geshur le Ram chun Jair ngahmun khopi toh Kenath khopi toh chule akhobah chengse kholen cheh somgup jen alah tha lhon tai. Mi hichengse hi Gilead hingpa Makir son achilhah jeng ahiuvin ahi.
English: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

tcz: Hezron chu Caleb-Ephrathah ngahmun khopia athi nungin ajinu Abijah chun chapa khat Tekoa hingpa Ashhur kitipa chu ahinpeh-in ahi.
en: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
text:
1CH 2:24
Thadou: Hezron chu Caleb-Ephrathah ngahmun khopia athi nungin ajinu Abijah chun chapa khat Tekoa hingpa Ashhur kitipa chu ahinpeh-in ahi.
English: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

tcz: Hezron chapa apeng masapen Jerahmeel chapate chu apeng masapen Ram ahin, Bunah ahin, Oren ahin, Ozem ahin, chule Ahijah ahiuve
en: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
text:
1CH 2:25
Thadou: Hezron chapa apeng masapen Jerahmeel chapate chu apeng masapen Ram ahin, Bunah ahin, Oren ahin, Ozem ahin, chule Ahijah ahiuve
English: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

tcz: Jerahmeel kitipa hin ji chom khat jong aneiyin, amin chu Atarah akiti. Amanu hin Onam chu anahinge.
en: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.
text:
1CH 2:26
Thadou: Jerahmeel kitipa hin ji chom khat jong aneiyin, amin chu Atarah akiti. Amanu hin Onam chu anahinge.
English: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

tcz: Jerahmeel chapa masapen Ram chapate chu Maaz, Jamin, chule Eker ahiuve.
en: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
text:
1CH 2:27
Thadou: Jerahmeel chapa masapen Ram chapate chu Maaz, Jamin, chule Eker ahiuve.
English: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

tcz: Onam chapate ni chu Shammai le Jada ahilhonnin, chule Shammai chapate ni chu Nadab le Abishur ahilhone.
en: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
text:
1CH 2:28
Thadou: Onam chapate ni chu Shammai le Jada ahilhonnin, chule Shammai chapate ni chu Nadab le Abishur ahilhone.
English: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

tcz: Abishur le ajinu Abihail chapate ni chu Abhan leh Molid ahilhone.
en: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
text:
1CH 2:29
Thadou: Abishur le ajinu Abihail chapate ni chu Abhan leh Molid ahilhone.
English: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

tcz: Nadab chapate ni chu Seled le Appaim ahilhone. Seled chu cha nei louvin athitan,
en: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
text:
1CH 2:30
Thadou: Nadab chapate ni chu Seled le Appaim ahilhone. Seled chu cha nei louvin athitan,
English: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

tcz: Ahin Appaim hin chapa khat amin Ishi kitipa chu aneiyin ahi. Ishi chapa chu Sheshan ahin, chule Sheshan chapa chu Ahlai ahi.
en: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
text:
1CH 2:31
Thadou: Ahin Appaim hin chapa khat amin Ishi kitipa chu aneiyin ahi. Ishi chapa chu Sheshan ahin, chule Sheshan chapa chu Ahlai ahi.
English: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

tcz: Shammai sopipa Jada chapate ni chu Jether le Jonathan ahilhone. Jether hi cha nei louvin athitan,
en: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.
text:
1CH 2:32
Thadou: Shammai sopipa Jada chapate ni chu Jether le Jonathan ahilhone. Jether hi cha nei louvin athitan,
English: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

tcz: Hinlah Jonathan hin vang chapa ni Peleth le Zaza ahinge. Mihem hijat hi Jerahmeel son achilhah ahiuve.
en: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
text:
1CH 2:33
Thadou: Hinlah Jonathan hin vang chapa ni Peleth le Zaza ahinge. Mihem hijat hi Jerahmeel son achilhah ahiuve.
English: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

tcz: Sheshan in chapate aneipon, ahin chanu tampi ahinge Sheshan hin Egypt mi pasal khat soh aneiyin, amin jong Jarha akiti.
en: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
text:
1CH 2:34
Thadou: Sheshan in chapate aneipon, ahin chanu tampi ahinge Sheshan hin Egypt mi pasal khat soh aneiyin, amin jong Jarha akiti.
English: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

tcz: Sheshan in hiche asohpa Jarha kitipa hi achanu khat toh akichensah in ahileh achanun amapa chu toh chapa khat amin Attai kitipa chu ahing lhone.
en: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.
text:
1CH 2:35
Thadou: Sheshan in hiche asohpa Jarha kitipa hi achanu khat toh akichensah in ahileh achanun amapa chu toh chapa khat amin Attai kitipa chu ahing lhone.
English: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.

tcz: Attai hin Nathan ahingin, Nathan in Zabad ahinge.
en: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,
text:
1CH 2:36
Thadou: Attai hin Nathan ahingin, Nathan in Zabad ahinge.
English: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,

tcz: Zabad hin Ephlal ahingin, Ephlal chun Obed ahingin ahi.
en: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,
text:
1CH 2:37
Thadou: Zabad hin Ephlal ahingin, Ephlal chun Obed ahingin ahi.
English: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,

tcz: Obed hin Jehu ahingin, chule Jehu hin Azariah ahinge.
en: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,
text:
1CH 2:38
Thadou: Obed hin Jehu ahingin, chule Jehu hin Azariah ahinge.
English: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,

tcz: Helez hingpa chu Azariah ahin, chule Eleasah hingpa chu Helez ahi.
en: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,
text:
1CH 2:39
Thadou: Helez hingpa chu Azariah ahin, chule Eleasah hingpa chu Helez ahi.
English: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,

tcz: Sismai hingpa chu Eleasah ahin, chule Shallum hingpa chu Sismai ahi.
en: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,
text:
1CH 2:40
Thadou: Sismai hingpa chu Eleasah ahin, chule Shallum hingpa chu Sismai ahi.
English: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,

tcz: Jekamiah hingpa chu Shallum ahin, chule Elishama hingpa chu Jekamiah ahi.
en: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.
text:
1CH 2:41
Thadou: Jekamiah hingpa chu Shallum ahin, chule Elishama hingpa chu Jekamiah ahi.
English: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.

tcz: Jerahmeel sopipa Caleb chapate lah’a apeng masapen Mesha chun Ziph ahingin, chule Mareshah hin Hebron ahinge.
en: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
text:
1CH 2:42
Thadou: Jerahmeel sopipa Caleb chapate lah’a apeng masapen Mesha chun Ziph ahingin, chule Mareshah hin Hebron ahinge.
English: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

tcz: Hebron chapate chu Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, chule Shema ahiuve.
en: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
text:
1CH 2:43
Thadou: Hebron chapate chu Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, chule Shema ahiuve.
English: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

tcz: Shema hin Raham ahingin, Raham hin Jorkeam ahinge. Chule Rekem hin Shammai anahingin ahi.
en: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.
text:
1CH 2:44
Thadou: Shema hin Raham ahingin, Raham hin Jorkeam ahinge. Chule Rekem hin Shammai anahingin ahi.
English: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

tcz: Shammai chapa chu Maon ahin, chule Maon chun Beth Zur ahingin ahi.
en: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
text:
1CH 2:45
Thadou: Shammai chapa chu Maon ahin, chule Maon chun Beth Zur ahingin ahi.
English: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.

tcz: Caleb thaikemnu chun Haran, Moza, chule Gazez ahinge; chule hichea hin Haran hin Gazez chu ahingin ahi.
en: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.
text:
1CH 2:46
Thadou: Caleb thaikemnu chun Haran, Moza, chule Gazez ahinge; chule hichea hin Haran hin Gazez chu ahingin ahi.
English: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.

tcz: Jahdai chapate chu Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, chule Shaaph ahiuvin ahi.
en: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
text:
1CH 2:47
Thadou: Jahdai chapate chu Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, chule Shaaph ahiuvin ahi.
English: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

tcz: Caleb thaikemnu achom khat Maachah kitinu jong chun Sheber le Tirhanah ahingin ahi.
en: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
text:
1CH 2:48
Thadou: Caleb thaikemnu achom khat Maachah kitinu jong chun Sheber le Tirhanah ahingin ahi.
English: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

tcz: Amanu ma ma hin jong Madmannah pa Shaaph chule Macbenah le Gibea pa Sheva anahingin ahi. Caleb hin jong chanu khat aneiyin amin Achsah akiti.
en: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
text:
1CH 2:49
Thadou: Amanu ma ma hin jong Madmannah pa Shaaph chule Macbenah le Gibea pa Sheva anahingin ahi. Caleb hin jong chanu khat aneiyin amin Achsah akiti.
English: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

tcz: Mihem hijat hi abonchauva Caleb son achilhah jeng ahiuve. Caleb jinu Ephrathah chapa masapen Hur chapate chu Kiriath-Jearim pa Shobal,
en: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
text:
1CH 2:50
Thadou: Mihem hijat hi abonchauva Caleb son achilhah jeng ahiuve. Caleb jinu Ephrathah chapa masapen Hur chapate chu Kiriath-Jearim pa Shobal,
English: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

tcz: Bethlehem pa Salma, chule Beth-Gader pa Hareph ahiuve.
en: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
text:
1CH 2:51
Thadou: Bethlehem pa Salma, chule Beth-Gader pa Hareph ahiuve.
English: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

tcz: Kiriath-Jearim pa Shobal son achilhahho chu Haroeh sung kon Manahath mi akeh khat jen toh,
en: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
text:
1CH 2:52
Thadou: Kiriath-Jearim pa Shobal son achilhahho chu Haroeh sung kon Manahath mi akeh khat jen toh,
English: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

tcz: Chule Kiriath-Jearim insung mite Ithir miho ahiuvin, Puth miho ahiuvin, Sumath miho ahiuvin, chule Mishrai miho toh ahiuve; amahoa kona hi Zorah miho le Eshtaol miho hung kondoh ahiuvin ahi.
en: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
text:
1CH 2:53
Thadou: Chule Kiriath-Jearim insung mite Ithir miho ahiuvin, Puth miho ahiuvin, Sumath miho ahiuvin, chule Mishrai miho toh ahiuve; amahoa kona hi Zorah miho le Eshtaol miho hung kondoh ahiuvin ahi.
English: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

tcz: Salma chapate chu Bethlehem miho ahiuvin, Netophath miho ahiuvin , Atroth-Beth-Joab miho ahiuvin , adang miho chu Manahath miho leh Zor miho akeh khat jen jong ahiuvin ahi.
en: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
text:
1CH 2:54
Thadou: Salma chapate chu Bethlehem miho ahiuvin, Netophath miho ahiuvin , Atroth-Beth-Joab miho ahiuvin , adang miho chu Manahath miho leh Zor miho akeh khat jen jong ahiuvin ahi.
English: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

tcz: Chule Jabez khoa cheng danthu lekha sunna pang miho insung mite jong Tirath miho ahiuvin, Shimeath miho hi Recab insung penna Hammath kitipa sung peng ngen ahiuvin, Ken mi jeng ahiuve.
en: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
text:
1CH 2:55
Thadou: Chule Jabez khoa cheng danthu lekha sunna pang miho insung mite jong Tirath miho ahiuvin, Shimeath miho hi Recab insung penna Hammath kitipa sung peng ngen ahiuvin, Ken mi jeng ahiuve.
