English: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

tcz: Hebron khopia achen laiya David in ahin achapate chu hicheng hi ahiuve: achapa apeng masapen chu Ammon ahin, apenna nu chu Ahinoam akitin Jezreel kho mi ahi. Achapa ni lhinna pachu Daniel ahin, Carmel kho numeinu Anogail toh ahinlhon ahi.
en: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;

tcz: Athum lhinna pachu Absalom ahin, anu chu Maacah akitin, Geshur lengpa Talmai chanu ahi. Li lhinna pachu Adonijah ahin, anu chu Haggith ahi.
en: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

tcz: Nga lhinna pachu Shephatiah akitin, anu chu Abital ahi. Gup lhinna pachu Ithream ahin, David in ajinu Eglah toh ahinlhon ahiye.
en: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:
text:
1CH 3:3
Thadou: Nga lhinna pachu Shephatiah akitin, anu chu Abital ahi. Gup lhinna pachu Ithream ahin, David in ajinu Eglah toh ahinlhon ahiye.
English: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

tcz: Hebron khopia kum sagi le akeh khat sunga lengvaipoa anapan sungin David chun chapa gu hi anahingin ahi. Chujouvin kum som thumle kum thum sungin Jerusalem khopia lengvaipon anapangin ahi.
en: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;

tcz: Jerusalem khopia achen laiya David in anahin achapate chu Shammua, Shobad, Nathan, chule Solomon ahiuve. Amaho penna nu chu Ammiel chanu Bathsheba ahi.
en: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;

tcz: Chujouvin David in chapa ko ahinbe’in amaho chu Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
en: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
text:
1CH 3:6
Thadou: Chujouvin David in chapa ko ahinbe’in amaho chu Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
English: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,

tcz: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
en: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
text:
1CH 3:7
Thadou: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
English: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

tcz: Elishama, Eliada chule Eliphelet ahiuve.
en: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
text:
1CH 3:8
Thadou: Elishama, Eliada chule Eliphelet ahiuve.
English: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

tcz: Athaikemho toh ahindoh ho tailouvin hichengse hi David chapate jeng ahiuve. Amahon sopi numei Tamar kitinu bouseh aneiyin ahi.
en: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
text:
1CH 3:9
Thadou: Athaikemho toh ahindoh ho tailouvin hichengse hi David chapate jeng ahiuve. Amahon sopi numei Tamar kitinu bouseh aneiyin ahi.
English: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

tcz: Solomon son achilhah ho chu Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat,
en: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
text:
1CH 3:10
Thadou: Solomon son achilhah ho chu Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat,
English: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

tcz: Jeroram, Ahaziah, Joash,
en: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
text:
1CH 3:11
Thadou: Jeroram, Ahaziah, Joash,
English: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

tcz: Amaziah,Uzziah, Jotham,
en: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
text:
1CH 3:12
Thadou: Amaziah,Uzziah, Jotham,
English: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

tcz: Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh,
en: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
text:
1CH 3:13
Thadou: Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh,
English: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

tcz: Amon, chule Josiah ahiuvin ahi.
en: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
text:
1CH 3:14
Thadou: Amon, chule Josiah ahiuvin ahi.
English: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

tcz: Josiah chapate chu apeng nasapen pa Johanan ahin, ni lhinna pa Jehoiakim ahin, athum channa pa Zedekiah ahin, li lhinna pachu Shallum ahi.
en: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.
text:
1CH 3:15
Thadou: Josiah chapate chu apeng nasapen pa Johanan ahin, ni lhinna pa Jehoiakim ahin, athum channa pa Zedekiah ahin, li lhinna pachu Shallum ahi.
English: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

tcz: Jehoiakim son achilhah ho chu achapa Jehoiachin leh asopipa Zedekiah ahilhone.
en: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.
text:
1CH 3:16
Thadou: Jehoiakim son achilhah ho chu achapa Jehoiachin leh asopipa Zedekiah ahilhone.
English: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.

tcz: Babylon miten soh-chaga anakaimangu Jehoiachin chapate chu Shealtiel,
en: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
text:
1CH 3:17
Thadou: Babylon miten soh-chaga anakaimangu Jehoiachin chapate chu Shealtiel,
English: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

tcz: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, hoshama, chule Nedabiah ahiuvin ahi.
en: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
text:
1CH 3:18
Thadou: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, hoshama, chule Nedabiah ahiuvin ahi.
English: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

tcz: Pedaiah chapate ni chu Zerubbabel le Shimei ahilhone. Zerubbabel chapate ni chu Meshullam le Hananiah ahilhonin, Amani sopinu chu Shelomith akiti.
en: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

tcz: Aman chapa adang nga jong ahingin, amaho chu Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah, chule Jushab-Hesed ahiuve.
en: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.
text:
1CH 3:20
Thadou: Aman chapa adang nga jong ahingin, amaho chu Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah, chule Jushab-Hesed ahiuve.
English: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.

tcz: Hananiah chapate ni chu Pelatiah le Jeshaiah ahilhone. Jeshaiah chapa Rephaiah ahin, Rephaiah chapa Arnan ahin, Arnan chapa Obadiah ahin, Obadiah chapa Shecaniah ahi.
en: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
text:
1CH 3:21
Thadou: Hananiah chapate ni chu Pelatiah le Jeshaiah ahilhone. Jeshaiah chapa Rephaiah ahin, Rephaiah chapa Arnan ahin, Arnan chapa Obadiah ahin, Obadiah chapa Shecaniah ahi.
English: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

tcz: Shecaniah chapa le atute chu achapa Shemaiah ahin; chule Shemaiah chapate chu Hattush ahin, Igal ahin, Bariah ahin, Neariah ahin, chule Shaphat pumin mi gup alhing uve.
en: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
text:
1CH 3:22
Thadou: Shecaniah chapa le atute chu achapa Shemaiah ahin; chule Shemaiah chapate chu Hattush ahin, Igal ahin, Bariah ahin, Neariah ahin, chule Shaphat pumin mi gup alhing uve.
English: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

tcz: Neariah chapate chu Elioenai ahin, Hizkiah ahin, chule Azrikam pumin mi thum ahiuve.
en: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
text:
1CH 3:23
Thadou: Neariah chapate chu Elioenai ahin, Hizkiah ahin, chule Azrikam pumin mi thum ahiuve.
English: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

tcz: Elioenai chapate chu Hodaviah ahin, Eliashib ahin, Pelaiah ahin, Akkub ahin, Johanan ahin, Delaiah ahin, chule Anani ahin, abonchauvin mi sagi alhing uve.
en: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
text:
1CH 3:24
Thadou: Elioenai chapate chu Hodaviah ahin, Eliashib ahin, Pelaiah ahin, Akkub ahin, Johanan ahin, Delaiah ahin, chule Anani ahin, abonchauvin mi sagi alhing uve.
English: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

tcz: Judah chapate chu Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, chule Shobal ahiuve.
en: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
text:
1CH 4:1
Thadou: Judah chapate chu Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, chule Shobal ahiuve.
English: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

tcz: Shobal chapa Reaiah kitipa hin Jahath ahingin, jahath hin Ahumai le Lahad ahingin ahi. Hichengse hi Zorath insung mite jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
text:
1CH 4:2
Thadou: Shobal chapa Reaiah kitipa hin Jahath ahingin, jahath hin Ahumai le Lahad ahingin ahi. Hichengse hi Zorath insung mite jeng ahiuvin ahi.
English: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

tcz: Atam chapate chu Jezreel, Ishma, Idbash, chule asopinu Hazzelelponi, Gedor hingpa,
en: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
text:
1CH 4:3
Thadou: Atam chapate chu Jezreel, Ishma, Idbash, chule asopinu Hazzelelponi, Gedor hingpa,
English: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.

tcz: Penuel, chule Hushah hingpa Ezer ahiuve. Mi hicheng hi Bethlehem hingpa Ephrathah chapa apeng masapen Hur son achilhah ho ahiuvin ahi.
en: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
text:
1CH 4:4
Thadou: Penuel, chule Hushah hingpa Ezer ahiuve. Mi hicheng hi Bethlehem hingpa Ephrathah chapa apeng masapen Hur son achilhah ho ahiuvin ahi.
English: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

tcz: Tekoa pa Ashur chun ji ni anei in Amani chu Helah le Naarah ahilhone.
en: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
text:
1CH 4:5
Thadou: Tekoa pa Ashur chun ji ni anei in Amani chu Helah le Naarah ahilhone.
English: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

tcz: Naarah hin Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, chule Haahashtari ahingin ahi.
en: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
text:
1CH 4:6
Thadou: Naarah hin Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, chule Haahashtari ahingin ahi.
English: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

tcz: Helah chun Zereth, Izhar, Ethnan,
en: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
text:
1CH 4:7
Thadou: Helah chun Zereth, Izhar, Ethnan,
English: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

tcz: Chule Anub pa Koz, Zobedah le Harum chapa Aharshel insung mite chengse chu ahingin ahi.
en: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
text:
1CH 4:8
Thadou: Chule Anub pa Koz, Zobedah le Harum chapa Aharshel insung mite chengse chu ahingin ahi.
English: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

tcz: Jebez kitipa ji asopite dang dang sanga agunchu jeh’in anun jong, amahi nat chung nunga kahin ahi tin amin Jabez asah’in ahi.
en: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”
text:
1CH 4:9
Thadou: Jebez kitipa ji asopite dang dang sanga agunchu jeh’in anun jong, amahi nat chung nunga kahin ahi tin amin Jabez asah’in ahi.
English: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

tcz: Jabez hi Israel Pathen henga ataovin hiti aseiye, “O Pathen, nangin keima phathei neiboh tei teiyin lang, neikaile jing jengin lang, chule hahsatna le gentheina jousea kon’in neichom khen jing jengin,” atin ahi. Hichun hiche ataona hi Pathen’in anop peh tai.
en: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.
text:
1CH 4:10
Thadou: Jabez hi Israel Pathen henga ataovin hiti aseiye, “O Pathen, nangin keima phathei neiboh tei teiyin lang, neikaile jing jengin lang, chule hahsatna le gentheina jousea kon’in neichom khen jing jengin,” atin ahi. Hichun hiche ataona hi Pathen’in anop peh tai.
English: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.

tcz: Shuhah sopipa Kelub chun Mehir anahingin, Mehir chun Eshton ahingin,
en: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
text:
1CH 4:11
Thadou: Shuhah sopipa Kelub chun Mehir anahingin, Mehir chun Eshton ahingin,
English: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

tcz: Eshton chun Bethrapha, Paseah, chule Tehinnah ahingin ahi. Tehinnah chun Irnahash ahingin ahi. mihem hichengse hi Recah son achilhah ahiuve.
en: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.
text:
1CH 4:12
Thadou: Eshton chun Bethrapha, Paseah, chule Tehinnah ahingin ahi. Tehinnah chun Irnahash ahingin ahi. mihem hichengse hi Recah son achilhah ahiuve.
English: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

tcz: Kenaz chapate ni chu Othniel le Seraiah ahilhonin ahi. Othniel chapate ni chu Hathath le Meonothai ahilhone.
en: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.
text:
1CH 4:13
Thadou: Kenaz chapate ni chu Othniel le Seraiah ahilhonin ahi. Othniel chapate ni chu Hathath le Meonothai ahilhone.
English: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.

tcz: Meonothai chun Ophrah ahingin, chule Seraiah chun Geharashim pa Joab ahingin ahi; amaho hi khut them thing thembol mi ahiuve.
en: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.
text:
1CH 4:14
Thadou: Meonothai chun Ophrah ahingin, chule Seraiah chun Geharashim pa Joab ahingin ahi; amaho hi khut them thing thembol mi ahiuve.
English: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.

tcz: Jephunneh chapa Caleb chapate chu Iru le Elah toh Naam ahiuve; chutengle Elah chapa chu Kenaz ahi.
en: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
text:
1CH 4:15
Thadou: Jephunneh chapa Caleb chapate chu Iru le Elah toh Naam ahiuve; chutengle Elah chapa chu Kenaz ahi.
English: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

tcz: Jehallelel chapate chu Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, chule Asarel ahiuvin ahi.
en: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
text:
1CH 4:16
Thadou: Jehallelel chapate chu Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, chule Asarel ahiuvin ahi.
English: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

tcz: Ezreah chapate chu Jether, Mered, Epher, chule Jalon ahiuvin. Mereh jinu ho lah’a mi khat’in Meriam le Shammai toh Eshtemoa pa Ishba ahinpeh-in ahi.
en: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
text:
1CH 4:17
Thadou: Ezreah chapate chu Jether, Mered, Epher, chule Jalon ahiuvin. Mereh jinu ho lah’a mi khat’in Meriam le Shammai toh Eshtemoa pa Ishba ahinpeh-in ahi.
English: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

tcz: Chujongle Mered hin Judah numei khat jong akichenpi’in, amanun Gedor pa Jered ahingin, Soco pa Heber ahingin, chule Zanoah pa Jekuthiel jong anahingin ahi. Mered chun Pharaoh channu Bithia kitinu jong ana kichenpi’in, chule amanun jong chapa phabep ahinpeh-in ahi.
en: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
text:
1CH 4:18
Thadou: Chujongle Mered hin Judah numei khat jong akichenpi’in, amanun Gedor pa Jered ahingin, Soco pa Heber ahingin, chule Zanoah pa Jekuthiel jong anahingin ahi. Mered chun Pharaoh channu Bithia kitinu jong ana kichenpi’in, chule amanun jong chapa phabep ahinpeh-in ahi.
English: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

tcz: Hodiah jinu chu Naham sopinu anahi. Amanu chapa lah’a khat chu keilah kho’a Garm mite pa ahin, chule khat pachu Eshtomoa mi Maacath miho pa ahi.
en: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
text:
1CH 4:19
Thadou: Hodiah jinu chu Naham sopinu anahi. Amanu chapa lah’a khat chu keilah kho’a Garm mite pa ahin, chule khat pachu Eshtomoa mi Maacath miho pa ahi.
English: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

tcz: Shimon chapate chu Amnon le Rinnah toh, Ben-hanan le Tilon ahiuve. Ishi chapte ni chu Zoheth le Ben-Zoheth ahilhone.
en: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.
text:
1CH 4:20
Thadou: Shimon chapate chu Amnon le Rinnah toh, Ben-hanan le Tilon ahiuve. Ishi chapte ni chu Zoheth le Ben-Zoheth ahilhone.
English: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.

tcz: Shelah kitipa hi Judah chapate ho lah’a mi khat anahi. Shelah son achilhah ho chu Lecah pa Er; Mareshah pa Laasah; chule Beth-Ashbea kho’a tupat pon khonga pang insung mite toh;
en: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

tcz: Jokim; Cozeba mite le Joash chule Jashubi-Lehem le Moab gamsunga vaipoa anapang Sraph ahiuvin ahi. mi hijat le abonchauva amin nu chu khanglui laipeh’a athusim mu kisutna lekhahoa ana kisunlut peh ahitai.
en: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.
text:
1CH 4:22
Thadou: Jokim; Cozeba mite le Joash chule Jashubi-Lehem le Moab gamsunga vaipoa anapang Sraph ahiuvin ahi. mi hijat le abonchauva amin nu chu khanglui laipeh’a athusim mu kisutna lekhahoa ana kisunlut peh ahitai.
English: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.

tcz: Amaho chengse hi bel denga pang ho, Netaim le Gederah kho’a cheng ahiuve. Hichea hi amaho hi cheng khom’uva lengpa natonga pang ji ahiuve.
en: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.
text:
1CH 4:23
Thadou: Amaho chengse hi bel denga pang ho, Netaim le Gederah kho’a cheng ahiuve. Hichea hi amaho hi cheng khom’uva lengpa natonga pang ji ahiuve.
English: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.

tcz: Simeon chapate chu Jemuel*, Jamin, Jarib, Zohar,* chule Shaul ahiuve.
en: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

tcz: Shaul son achilhah ho chu Shallum le Mibsam, chule Mishma toh ahiuve.
en: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.
text:
1CH 4:25
Thadou: Shaul son achilhah ho chu Shallum le Mibsam, chule Mishma toh ahiuve.
English: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.

tcz: Mishma son achilhah ho chu achapa Hammuel ahin; Hammuel chapa Zaccur ahin; chule Zaccur chapa Shimei ahi.
en: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
text:
1CH 4:26
Thadou: Mishma son achilhah ho chu achapa Hammuel ahin; Hammuel chapa Zaccur ahin; chule Zaccur chapa Shimei ahi.
English: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

tcz: Shimei hin chapa som le gup jen ahingin, chule chanu gup ahinge; ahinlah asopi pasal dang vang cha tamnei aum pouvin ahi. Hijehchun, Simeon insung mite hi Judah insung mite bangin apung thei mong mong pouve.
en: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.
text:
1CH 4:27
Thadou: Shimei hin chapa som le gup jen ahingin, chule chanu gup ahinge; ahinlah asopi pasal dang vang cha tamnei aum pouvin ahi. Hijehchun, Simeon insung mite hi Judah insung mite bangin apung thei mong mong pouve.
English: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.

tcz: Amaho hi Beersheba le moladah, Hazar-Shaul,
en: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,
text:
1CH 4:28
Thadou: Amaho hi Beersheba le moladah, Hazar-Shaul,
English: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,

tcz: Bilhah le Ezem Tolad dunga achenguvin,
en: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,
text:
1CH 4:29
Thadou: Bilhah le Ezem Tolad dunga achenguvin,
English: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,

tcz: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
en: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,
text:
1CH 4:30
Thadou: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
English: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,

tcz: Beth-Marcoboth, Hazarsusim, Beth-biri, chule Shaaraim dunga jong acheng uve.
en: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.
text:
1CH 4:31
Thadou: Beth-Marcoboth, Hazarsusim, Beth-biri, chule Shaaraim dunga jong acheng uve.
English: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

tcz: David lengvaipoa ahung pan masanga kho hijat hi amaho thuneina noiya um ngen ahiuve. Amaho son achilhah hochu Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token, chule Ashan pumin khopi nga,
en: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

tcz: Chule kimvel dunga akhobah chengse chutoh Baalath mun chan geiyin jong achenguvin ahi. Hicheng hi amaho chenna mun ahin, chuleh, hiche min chengse ho hi amaho khanggui kisimna lekhabua ana kisun lut’ah ahi.
en: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.
text:
1CH 4:33
Thadou: Chule kimvel dunga akhobah chengse chutoh Baalath mun chan geiyin jong achenguvin ahi. Hicheng hi amaho chenna mun ahin, chuleh, hiche min chengse ho hi amaho khanggui kisimna lekhabua ana kisun lut’ah ahi.
English: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.

tcz: Simeon son achilhah dang hochu Meshobab, Jamlech, chule Amaziah chapa Joshah,
en: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,
text:
1CH 4:34
Thadou: Simeon son achilhah dang hochu Meshobab, Jamlech, chule Amaziah chapa Joshah,
English: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,

tcz: Joel le Joshibiah chapa Jehu toh, Seraiah chapa ahin, Asiel chapa ahin,
en: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
text:
1CH 4:35
Thadou: Joel le Joshibiah chapa Jehu toh, Seraiah chapa ahin, Asiel chapa ahin,
English: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

tcz: Elioenai ahin, Jaakobah ahin, Jeshohaiah ahin, Asaiah ahin, Adiel ahin, Jesimiel ahin, Benaiah ahin,
en: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
text:
1CH 4:36
Thadou: Elioenai ahin, Jaakobah ahin, Jeshohaiah ahin, Asaiah ahin, Adiel ahin, Jesimiel ahin, Benaiah ahin,
English: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

tcz: Chule Shiphi chapa Ziza ahin, Allon chapa ahin, Jedaiah chapa ahin, Shimri chapa ahin, chule Shemaiah chapa ahi.
en: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—
text:
1CH 4:37
Thadou: Chule Shiphi chapa Ziza ahin, Allon chapa ahin, Jedaiah chapa ahin, Shimri chapa ahin, chule Shemaiah chapa ahi.
English: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

tcz: Tua amin cheh’a kisimdoh hohi Simeon insunga ama ama kailhah cheh’a haosa chapate cheh ahiuvin; apu apau insung dungjui cheh in jong nasatah in aphatheiyuvin akhangtou theilheh jenguve.
en: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.
text:
1CH 4:38
Thadou: Tua amin cheh’a kisimdoh hohi Simeon insunga ama ama kailhah cheh’a haosa chapate cheh ahiuvin; apu apau insung dungjui cheh in jong nasatah in aphatheiyuvin akhangtou theilheh jenguve.
English: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.

tcz: Chule amaho hi Gerar gamkai langa akitol’uvin, phaicham gam'a niso lam geiyin jong acheuvin, akelngoi hon teu din hamhing um umna ahol’uvin ahi.
en: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
text:
1CH 4:39
Thadou: Chule amaho hi Gerar gamkai langa akitol’uvin, phaicham gam'a niso lam geiyin jong acheuvin, akelngoi hon teu din hamhing um umna ahol’uvin ahi.
English: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

tcz: Hikoma chun amahon gam phatah, hamhing thalhinna gam len tah, chule chamlenna le lung mong tah’a chenna thei akimuve. Hiche gam a ana cheng masa mite chu Ham son achilhah mi phabep anahi uvin ahi.
en: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.
text:
1CH 4:40
Thadou: Hikoma chun amahon gam phatah, hamhing thalhinna gam len tah, chule chamlenna le lung mong tah’a chenna thei akimuve. Hiche gam a ana cheng masa mite chu Ham son achilhah mi phabep anahi uvin ahi.
English: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.

tcz: Hinlah, Simeon insunga ama ama kailhah cheh’a haosa chapate chu hikoma hin Judah lengpa Hezekiah lengvaipoh layin ahung lut’uvin, hikoma anachengte Ham son achilhah phabep ho chule Meun mite ponbuh ho ahin, achennau in ho ahin, amuphah phah asumanguvin ahi. Hiti hin amaho chu asuhmang phat’uvin amaho khel’in anachenguvin, tuni gei hin amahon mun chu alo nalaiyuve. Ijeh-inem itileh hiche gam'a hi akelngoiteu neh ding hamhing pha amu’u ahi.
en: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.
text:
1CH 4:41
Thadou: Hinlah, Simeon insunga ama ama kailhah cheh’a haosa chapate chu hikoma hin Judah lengpa Hezekiah lengvaipoh layin ahung lut’uvin, hikoma anachengte Ham son achilhah phabep ho chule Meun mite ponbuh ho ahin, achennau in ho ahin, amuphah phah asumanguvin ahi. Hiti hin amaho chu asuhmang phat’uvin amaho khel’in anachenguvin, tuni gei hin amahon mun chu alo nalaiyuve. Ijeh-inem itileh hiche gam'a hi akelngoiteu neh ding hamhing pha amu’u ahi.
English: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

tcz: Chuin, Simeon mite lah’a mihem ja nga tobang chu Seir molsang geiyin akitol’uvin, a lamkai diuvin Pelatiah le Neariah toh, Rephaiah, le Uzziel, abonchauva Ishi chapate chu anapansah uvin ahi.
en: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
text:
1CH 4:42
Thadou: Chuin, Simeon mite lah’a mihem ja nga tobang chu Seir molsang geiyin akitol’uvin, a lamkai diuvin Pelatiah le Neariah toh, Rephaiah, le Uzziel, abonchauva Ishi chapate chu anapansah uvin ahi.
English: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

tcz: Amaho hin Amalek mi athimoh’a jamdoh chengse jong asumanguvin, chule amaho khel’in tuni geiyin acheng den tauve.
en: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.
text:
1CH 4:43
Thadou: Amaho hin Amalek mi athimoh’a jamdoh chengse jong asumanguvin, chule amaho khel’in tuni geiyin acheng den tauve.
English: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.

tcz: Israel cha amasapen chu Reuben ahi. Ahinlah, aman apa jalou tah’a apa thaikemho lah’a khat alupkhom-pi jeh chun a upat hi asopipa Joseph chapate joh achanguvin. Hiche jeh’a chu Reuben hi khanggui kisimna lekhabua chun apen masah dung juiyin akijih lut tapoi.
en: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.
text:
1CH 5:1
Thadou: Israel cha amasapen chu Reuben ahi. Ahinlah, aman apa jalou tah’a apa thaikemho lah’a khat alupkhom-pi jeh chun a upat hi asopipa Joseph chapate joh achanguvin. Hiche jeh’a chu Reuben hi khanggui kisimna lekhabua chun apen masah dung juiyin akijih lut tapoi.
English: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.

tcz: Judah son achilhahte chu athahat pen’a ahung pan uva chule amaho phunga kona leng khat ahung kisep doh jing vang'in, upatna kiti hi Joseph bou achangin ahi.
en: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—
text:
1CH 5:2
Thadou: Judah son achilhahte chu athahat pen’a ahung pan uva chule amaho phunga kona leng khat ahung kisep doh jing vang'in, upatna kiti hi Joseph bou achangin ahi.
English: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—

tcz: Israel chapa apeng masapen Reuben chapate chu Hanoch ahin, Pallu ahin, Hezron ahin, chule Carmi ahi.
en: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
text:
1CH 5:3
Thadou: Israel chapa apeng masapen Reuben chapate chu Hanoch ahin, Pallu ahin, Hezron ahin, chule Carmi ahi.
English: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

tcz: Joel son achilhah ho chu Shemaiah ahin, Gog ahin, Shimei ahin,
en: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
text:
1CH 5:4
Thadou: Joel son achilhah ho chu Shemaiah ahin, Gog ahin, Shimei ahin,
English: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

tcz: Micah ahin, Reaiah ahin, Baal ahin,
en: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
text:
1CH 5:5
Thadou: Micah ahin, Reaiah ahin, Baal ahin,
English: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

tcz: Chule Beerah ahi. Assyria lengpa Tiglath-Pileser pachu Beerah anahi.
en: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.
text:
1CH 5:6
Thadou: Chule Beerah ahi. Assyria lengpa Tiglath-Pileser pachu Beerah anahi.
English: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.

tcz: Beerah inkote chu ama phung sunga akhangguiya akisimtoh’a akijih toh tengleh ahaosa chu Jeriel ahin, Zechariah jong ahi;
en: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

tcz: Chule Azaz chapa Bela ahin, Shema chapa ahin, chule Joel chapa jong ahi. Reuben mite ho hi Aroer apat Nebon changei, chule Baal-Meon chan geiya cheng ahiuve.
en: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;

tcz: Chule amaho hin Gilead gam'a chun gancha tamtah anei jeh’a niso lama jong achenguvin, nel gam jot nalampi lang apat Euphrates luipi gal lam geiyin acheng uvin ahi.
en: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
text:
1CH 5:9
Thadou: Chule amaho hin Gilead gam'a chun gancha tamtah anei jeh’a niso lama jong achenguvin, nel gam jot nalampi lang apat Euphrates luipi gal lam geiyin acheng uvin ahi.
English: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

tcz: Shual lengvaipoh laiyin jong Reuben mite hin Hagar mite chunga gal abol uvin ahi, hiche Hagar mite chu ajophat uvin Gilead niso lama amaho ponbuh jouse a chun alhung keiyin achen den lo tauvin ahi.
en: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
text:
1CH 5:10
Thadou: Shual lengvaipoh laiyin jong Reuben mite hin Hagar mite chunga gal abol uvin ahi, hiche Hagar mite chu ajophat uvin Gilead niso lama amaho ponbuh jouse a chun alhung keiyin achen den lo tauvin ahi.
English: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.

tcz: Gad son achilhah ho chu Reuben mite ho toh kigalsaiyin achenguvin Salecah chan geiyin alouve.
en: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
text:
1CH 5:11
Thadou: Gad son achilhah ho chu Reuben mite ho toh kigalsaiyin achenguvin Salecah chan geiyin alouve.
English: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:

tcz: Joel chu Bashan khoa haosan apangin, Shapham ama ban in apangin, ama ni ban’a Janai le Saphat apang ahilhone.
en: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
text:
1CH 5:12
Thadou: Joel chu Bashan khoa haosan apangin, Shapham ama ban in apangin, ama ni ban’a Janai le Saphat apang ahilhone.
English: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

tcz: Amaho insunga phunggui sagi haosa ho chu Michael ahin, Meshullam ahin, Shiba ahin, Jorai ahin, Jacan Zia ahin, chule Eber ahi.
en: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.
text:
1CH 5:13
Thadou: Amaho insunga phunggui sagi haosa ho chu Michael ahin, Meshullam ahin, Shiba ahin, Jorai ahin, Jacan Zia ahin, chule Eber ahi.
English: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.

tcz: Hiche ho chengse hi abonchauva Huri chapa Abihail son achilhah jeng ahiuve; Huri chu joroah chapa ahin, Joroah chu Gilead chapa ahin, Michael chu Jeshishai chapa ahin, Jeshishai chu Jahdo chapa, chule Jahdo chu Buz chapa ahi.
en: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

tcz: Ahi chu Abdiel chapa ahin, Abdiel chu Guni chapa ahin chule Guni hi amaho insung lhah’a haosa ahi.
en: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.
text:
1CH 5:15
Thadou: Ahi chu Abdiel chapa ahin, Abdiel chu Guni chapa ahin chule Guni hi amaho insung lhah’a haosa ahi.
English: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.

tcz: Hiche Gad mite hi Gilead gamsung, Bashan gamsung, chule akhobah jouse le Sharon gam hamhing phatna lai jousea achenguvin ahi.
en: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.
text:
1CH 5:16
Thadou: Hiche Gad mite hi Gilead gamsung, Bashan gamsung, chule akhobah jouse le Sharon gam hamhing phatna lai jousea achenguvin ahi.
English: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.

tcz: Mihem hijat khanggui thusim hi Judah lengpa Jotham lal lai le Israel lengpa Jeroboam lal laiya kisimtoh a kijih doh ahiye.
en: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
text:
1CH 5:17
Thadou: Mihem hijat khanggui thusim hi Judah lengpa Jotham lal lai le Israel lengpa Jeroboam lal laiya kisimtoh a kijih doh ahiye.
English: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

tcz: Reuben chapate leh Gad chapate chule Manaseh phung keh khat jong hin galhang mihat, pho le chemjam thoa gal bolthei, thalpi kap them, galsat themtah tah sepai sangsom li le sang ni le ja sagi le somgup jen gal bol dia gonsa anei jinguvin ahi.
en: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.
text:
1CH 5:18
Thadou: Reuben chapate leh Gad chapate chule Manaseh phung keh khat jong hin galhang mihat, pho le chemjam thoa gal bolthei, thalpi kap them, galsat themtah tah sepai sangsom li le sang ni le ja sagi le somgup jen gal bol dia gonsa anei jinguvin ahi.
English: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.

tcz: Amaho hin Hagar mite chung le Jetur mite chung, chule Naphish mite le Nodab mite chunga gal abol’uve.
en: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
text:
1CH 5:19
Thadou: Amaho hin Hagar mite chung le Jetur mite chung, chule Naphish mite le Nodab mite chunga gal abol’uve.
English: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

tcz: Gal lai hin amahon Pathen hengah panpina athum un, amahon Pathen tahsanna anei jeh’uvin, aman ataona chu asanpeh tai. Hijeh chun amahon Gar mite le amaho panpi chengse chu ajou soh hel tauve.
en: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.
text:
1CH 5:20
Thadou: Gal lai hin amahon Pathen hengah panpina athum un, amahon Pathen tahsanna anei jeh’uvin, aman ataona chu asanpeh tai. Hijeh chun amahon Gar mite le amaho panpi chengse chu ajou soh hel tauve.
English: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.

tcz: Amahon akisatpi Har mite thil achompeh ho chu sangongsao sangsom nga jen ahin, kelngoi le kelcha sang jani le sangsom nga jen toh ahin, chule mihem sang jakhat jen galhingin akaiyun ahi.
en: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.
text:
1CH 5:21
Thadou: Amahon akisatpi Har mite thil achompeh ho chu sangongsao sangsom nga jen ahin, kelngoi le kelcha sang jani le sangsom nga jen toh ahin, chule mihem sang jakhat jen galhingin akaiyun ahi.
English: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.

tcz: Gal kisat chu Pathen in apanpi jeh’in Har mite simsen lou akijam chap jengin ahi. Soh-changa akitol mang kah seuvin amaho gamsunga chun Reuben mite, Gad mite, chu Manaseh mite acheng tauve.
en: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.
text:
1CH 5:22
Thadou: Gal kisat chu Pathen in apanpi jeh’in Har mite simsen lou akijam chap jengin ahi. Soh-changa akitol mang kah seuvin amaho gamsunga chun Reuben mite, Gad mite, chu Manaseh mite acheng tauve.
English: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.

tcz: Manaseh phung kehkhat jong mihem atam lheh jenguvin, Bashan gam'a pat Baal-Hermon gei, Senir gei, chule Hermon molsang geiyin achengdoh peh jenguvin ahi.
en: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
text:
1CH 5:23
Thadou: Manaseh phung kehkhat jong mihem atam lheh jenguvin, Bashan gam'a pat Baal-Hermon gei, Senir gei, chule Hermon molsang geiyin achengdoh peh jenguvin ahi.
English: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

tcz: Ama ama pajang lhah ainsung cheh-uva a upa chengse chu: Epher ahin, Ishi ahin, Eliel ahin, Azriel ahin, Jeremiah ahin, Hodaviah ahin, chule Jahdiel toh ahiuve. Amaho mihat galhang ho hina lama minthanna anei uvin, chule ama ama insung pajang lhah a a upa chengse chu ahitauvin ahi.
en: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
text:
1CH 5:24
Thadou: Ama ama pajang lhah ainsung cheh-uva a upa chengse chu: Epher ahin, Ishi ahin, Eliel ahin, Azriel ahin, Jeremiah ahin, Hodaviah ahin, chule Jahdiel toh ahiuve. Amaho mihat galhang ho hina lama minthanna anei uvin, chule ama ama insung pajang lhah a a upa chengse chu ahitauvin ahi.
English: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

tcz: Ahivangin amaho hin apu apateu Pathen ahou khel’uvin, Pathenin asuhmangsa mite gam'a vaipo ho Pathen lim semthu doi ho akou tauvin ahi.
en: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.
text:
1CH 5:25
Thadou: Ahivangin amaho hin apu apateu Pathen ahou khel’uvin, Pathenin asuhmangsa mite gam'a vaipo ho Pathen lim semthu doi ho akou tauvin ahi.
English: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.

tcz: Hichejeh hin Pathenin Assyria lengpa Pul (Tiglath-Piteser jong akiti ) lungthim ahintildoh peh in, hiche Reuben mite le Gad mite toh, chule Manaseh phung akeh khat hi akaimangin ahi. Assyria ten amaho hi Halah kho le Habor kho, Hara kho, chule Gozan vadunga ahinkai lut’uvin, tuni geiyin aumden tauve.
en: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
text:
1CH 5:26
Thadou: Hichejeh hin Pathenin Assyria lengpa Pul (Tiglath-Piteser jong akiti ) lungthim ahintildoh peh in, hiche Reuben mite le Gad mite toh, chule Manaseh phung akeh khat hi akaimangin ahi. Assyria ten amaho hi Halah kho le Habor kho, Hara kho, chule Gozan vadunga ahinkai lut’uvin, tuni geiyin aumden tauve.
English: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.

tcz: Levi chapate chu Gershon ahin, Kohath ahin, chule Merari toh ahiuve.
en: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
text:
1CH 6:1
Thadou: Levi chapate chu Gershon ahin, Kohath ahin, chule Merari toh ahiuve.
English: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

tcz: Kohath son achilhah ho chu Amram ahin, Izhar ahin, Hebron ahin, chule Uzziel toh ahiuve.
en: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
text:
1CH 6:2
Thadou: Kohath son achilhah ho chu Amram ahin, Izhar ahin, Hebron ahin, chule Uzziel toh ahiuve.
English: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

tcz: Amram chapate chu Aaron ahin, Moses ahin, chule Miriam toh ahi. Aaron chapate chu Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, chule Ithamar toh hichengse hi ahiuve.
en: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
text:
1CH 6:3
Thadou: Amram chapate chu Aaron ahin, Moses ahin, chule Miriam toh ahi. Aaron chapate chu Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, chule Ithamar toh hichengse hi ahiuve.
English: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

tcz: Eleazer hin Phinehas anahingin, Phinehas hin Abishua anahinge.
en: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,
text:
1CH 6:4
Thadou: Eleazer hin Phinehas anahingin, Phinehas hin Abishua anahinge.
English: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,

tcz: Abishua hin Bukki anahingin, Bukki hin Uzzi ahinge.
en: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.
text:
1CH 6:5
Thadou: Abishua hin Bukki anahingin, Bukki hin Uzzi ahinge.
English: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.

tcz: Uzzi hin Zerahiah ahingin, Zerahiah in Meraioth ahinge.
en: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.
text:
1CH 6:6
Thadou: Uzzi hin Zerahiah ahingin, Zerahiah in Meraioth ahinge.
English: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.

tcz: Meraioth hin Amariah ahingin, Amariah hin Ahitub ahinge.
en: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
text:
1CH 6:7
Thadou: Meraioth hin Amariah ahingin, Amariah hin Ahitub ahinge.
English: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

tcz: Ahitub hin Zadok ahingin, Zadok hin Ahimaaz ahinge.
en: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.
text:
1CH 6:8
Thadou: Ahitub hin Zadok ahingin, Zadok hin Ahimaaz ahinge.
English: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.

tcz: Johanan hin Azariah chu ahingin, Azariah chun Johanan ahinge.
en: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.
text:
1CH 6:9
Thadou: Johanan hin Azariah chu ahingin, Azariah chun Johanan ahinge.
English: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.

tcz: Johanan hin Azariah chu ahingin, amahi Jerusalem khopia Solomon hou-in sahdoh sunga thempu chungnunga hung pang ahi.
en: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
text:
1CH 6:10
Thadou: Johanan hin Azariah chu ahingin, amahi Jerusalem khopia Solomon hou-in sahdoh sunga thempu chungnunga hung pang ahi.
English: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

tcz: Azariah hin Amariah ahingin, Amariah chun Ahitub ahinge.
en: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
text:
1CH 6:11
Thadou: Azariah hin Amariah ahingin, Amariah chun Ahitub ahinge.
English: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

tcz: Ahitub hin Zadok ahingin, Zadok chun Shallum ahinge.
en: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.
text:
1CH 6:12
Thadou: Ahitub hin Zadok ahingin, Zadok chun Shallum ahinge.
English: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.

tcz: Shallum hin Hilkiah ahingin, Hilkiah chun Azariah ahinge.
en: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.
text:
1CH 6:13
Thadou: Shallum hin Hilkiah ahingin, Hilkiah chun Azariah ahinge.
English: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.

tcz: Azariah hin Seraiah ahingin, Seraiah chun Jehozadak ahingin ahi.
en: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.
text:
1CH 6:14
Thadou: Azariah hin Seraiah ahingin, Seraiah chun Jehozadak ahingin ahi.
English: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.

tcz: Pakaiyin Judah mite leh Jerusalem mite soh-changa asol manga Nebuchadnezzar khut’a atolmang sah phat’in Jehozadak jong hi soh-changin achemang tan ahi.
en: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
text:
1CH 6:15
Thadou: Pakaiyin Judah mite leh Jerusalem mite soh-changa asol manga Nebuchadnezzar khut’a atolmang sah phat’in Jehozadak jong hi soh-changin achemang tan ahi.
English: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

tcz: Levi chapate chu Gershon ahin, Kohath ahin, chule Merari ahi.
en: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
text:
1CH 6:16
Thadou: Levi chapate chu Gershon ahin, Kohath ahin, chule Merari ahi.
English: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

tcz: Gershom chapate ni chu Libni leh Shimei ahilhone.
en: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
text:
1CH 6:17
Thadou: Gershom chapate ni chu Libni leh Shimei ahilhone.
English: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

tcz: Kohath son achilhah ho chu Amram ahin, Izhar ahin, Hebron ahin, chule Uzziel ahi.
en: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
text:
1CH 6:18
Thadou: Kohath son achilhah ho chu Amram ahin, Izhar ahin, Hebron ahin, chule Uzziel ahi.
English: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

tcz: Merari son achilhah teni chu Mahli le Mushi ahilhone. Anoiya mi hichengse hi apu apau kailhah cheh ama ama insung dol cheh’a Levi miho insung jeng ahiuve:
en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
text:
1CH 6:19
Thadou: Merari son achilhah teni chu Mahli le Mushi ahilhone. Anoiya mi hichengse hi apu apau kailhah cheh ama ama insung dol cheh’a Levi miho insung jeng ahiuve:
English: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

tcz: Gershon insung ahileh, Libni ahin, Jahath ahin, Zimmah ahin,
en: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
text:
1CH 6:20
Thadou: Gershon insung ahileh, Libni ahin, Jahath ahin, Zimmah ahin,
English: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

tcz: Joah ahin, Iddo ahin, Zerah ahin, chule Jeatherai ahi.
en: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
text:
1CH 6:21
Thadou: Joah ahin, Iddo ahin, Zerah ahin, chule Jeatherai ahi.
English: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.

tcz: Kohath son achilhah ho chu Amminadab ahin, Korah ahin, Assir ahin,
en: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
text:
1CH 6:22
Thadou: Kohath son achilhah ho chu Amminadab ahin, Korah ahin, Assir ahin,
English: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

tcz: Elkanah ahin, Abiasaph ahin, ahimoth ahin,
en: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
text:
1CH 6:23
Thadou: Elkanah ahin, Abiasaph ahin, ahimoth ahin,
English: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

tcz: Tahath ahin, Uriel ahin, Uzziah ahin, chule Shaul ahi.
en: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
text:
1CH 6:24
Thadou: Tahath ahin, Uriel ahin, Uzziah ahin, chule Shaul ahi.
English: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

tcz: Elkanah son chilhah ho ahileh, Amasai ahin, Ahimoth ahin,
en: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.
text:
1CH 6:25
Thadou: Elkanah son chilhah ho ahileh, Amasai ahin, Ahimoth ahin,
English: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

tcz: Elkanah ahin, Zophai ahin, Nahath ahin,
en: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
text:
1CH 6:26
Thadou: Elkanah ahin, Zophai ahin, Nahath ahin,
English: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

tcz: Eliah ahin, Jehoram ahin, Elkanah ahin, chule Samuel ahi.
en: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
text:
1CH 6:27
Thadou: Eliah ahin, Jehoram ahin, Elkanah ahin, chule Samuel ahi.
English: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.

tcz: Samuel chapate ni chu apeng masa Joel ahin, chule anni lhinna pachu Abijah ahi.
en: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.
text:
1CH 6:28
Thadou: Samuel chapate ni chu apeng masa Joel ahin, chule anni lhinna pachu Abijah ahi.
English: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

tcz: Merari son achilhah ho chu Mahli ahin, Libni ahin, Shimei ahin, Uzzah ahin,
en: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
text:
1CH 6:29
Thadou: Merari son achilhah ho chu Mahli ahin, Libni ahin, Shimei ahin, Uzzah ahin,
English: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

tcz: Shimei ahin, Haggiah ahin, chule Asaiah ahi.
en: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
text:
1CH 6:30
Thadou: Shimei ahin, Haggiah ahin, chule Asaiah ahi.
English: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

tcz: Pakai hou-in sunga Pathen thingkong ahung kitol lut nunga David’in hou-in sunga la lamkaiya pang dia anganse miho chu hicheng hi ahiuve.
en: These are they whom David set over the service of song in the LORD’s house after the ark came to rest there.
text:
1CH 6:31
Thadou: Pakai hou-in sunga Pathen thingkong ahung kitol lut nunga David’in hou-in sunga la lamkaiya pang dia anganse miho chu hicheng hi ahiuve.
English: These are they whom David set over the service of song in the LORD’s house after the ark came to rest there.

tcz: Jerusalem khopia Solomonin Pakai hou-in asah doh masangsen la lamkaiya pang ho hi mipi kikhopna ponbuh’a la lamkaiyin anapanguvin lhacha na atong jinguve. Hitobang hin amahon atoh dingdol kinse chu hoikeichan atong jing jenguve.
en: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built the LORD’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.
text:
1CH 6:32
Thadou: Jerusalem khopia Solomonin Pakai hou-in asah doh masangsen la lamkaiya pang ho hi mipi kikhopna ponbuh’a la lamkaiyin anapanguvin lhacha na atong jinguve. Hitobang hin amahon atoh dingdol kinse chu hoikeichan atong jing jenguve.
English: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built the LORD’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

tcz: Hichea la lamkaiya pang ho leh achapateu chu aban'a kisei ho hi ahi-uve: Heman tumging thempa chu Kohath chilhah miho lah’a Joel chapa ahin, Joel chu Samuel chapa ahin,
en: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
text:
1CH 6:33
Thadou: Hichea la lamkaiya pang ho leh achapateu chu aban'a kisei ho hi ahi-uve: Heman tumging thempa chu Kohath chilhah miho lah’a Joel chapa ahin, Joel chu Samuel chapa ahin,
English: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

tcz: Samuel chu Elkanah chapa ahin, Elkanah chu Jeroham chapa ahin, Jeroham chu Eliel chapa ahin, Eliel chu Toah chapa ahin,
en: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
text:
1CH 6:34
Thadou: Samuel chu Elkanah chapa ahin, Elkanah chu Jeroham chapa ahin, Jeroham chu Eliel chapa ahin, Eliel chu Toah chapa ahin,
English: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

tcz: Toah chu Zuph chapa ahin, Zuph chu Elkanah chapa ahin, Elkanah chu Mahath chapa ahin, Mahath chu Amasai chapa ahi.
en: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
text:
1CH 6:35
Thadou: Toah chu Zuph chapa ahin, Zuph chu Elkanah chapa ahin, Elkanah chu Mahath chapa ahin, Mahath chu Amasai chapa ahi.
English: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

tcz: Amasai chu Elkanah chapa ahin, Elkanah chu Joel chapa ahi, Joel chu Azariah chapa ahin, Azariah chu Zephaniah chapa ahi.
en: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
text:
1CH 6:36
Thadou: Amasai chu Elkanah chapa ahin, Elkanah chu Joel chapa ahi, Joel chu Azariah chapa ahin, Azariah chu Zephaniah chapa ahi.
English: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

tcz: Zephaniah chu Tahath chapa ahin, Tahath chu Assir chapa ahin, Assir chu Ebiasaph chapa ahin, Ebiasaph chu Korah chapa ahi.
en: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
text:
1CH 6:37
Thadou: Zephaniah chu Tahath chapa ahin, Tahath chu Assir chapa ahin, Assir chu Ebiasaph chapa ahin, Ebiasaph chu Korah chapa ahi.
English: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

tcz: Korah chu Izhar chapa ahin, Izhar chu Kohath chapa ahi; Kohath chu Levi chapa ahin, Levi chu Israel chapa ahi.
en: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
text:
1CH 6:38
Thadou: Korah chu Izhar chapa ahin, Izhar chu Kohath chapa ahi; Kohath chu Levi chapa ahin, Levi chu Israel chapa ahi.
English: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

tcz: Heman’in manchah phapenna anei masapa Gershon chilhah miho lah’a Asaph kitipa chu Berekiah chapa ahin, Berekiah chu Shimea chapa ahi;
en: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

tcz: Shimea hi Michael chapa ahin, Michael chu Baaseiah chapa ahi. Baaseiah chu Malkijah chapa ahin,
en: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
text:
1CH 6:40
Thadou: Shimea hi Michael chapa ahin, Michael chu Baaseiah chapa ahi. Baaseiah chu Malkijah chapa ahin,
English: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

tcz: Malkijah chu Ethnic chapa ahi; Ethnic chu Zerah chapa ahin, Zerah chu Adaiah chapa ahi,
en: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
text:
1CH 6:41
Thadou: Malkijah chu Ethnic chapa ahi; Ethnic chu Zerah chapa ahin, Zerah chu Adaiah chapa ahi,
English: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

tcz: Adaiah chu Ethan chapa ahin, Ethan chu Zimmah chapa ahi; Zimmah chu Shimei chapa ahin,
en: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
text:
1CH 6:42
Thadou: Adaiah chu Ethan chapa ahin, Ethan chu Zimmah chapa ahi; Zimmah chu Shimei chapa ahin,
English: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

tcz: Shimei chu Jathah chapa ahi; Jathah chu Gershom chapa ahin, Gershom chu Levi chapa ahi.
en: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
text:
1CH 6:43
Thadou: Shimei chu Jathah chapa ahi; Jathah chu Gershom chapa ahin, Gershom chu Levi chapa ahi.
English: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

tcz: Hemanin manchah phapenna anei ani channa pa Merari chilhah miho lah’a Ethan chu Kishi chapa ahin, Kishi chu Abdi chapa ahin, Abdi chu Malluch chapa ahin,
en: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
text:
1CH 6:44
Thadou: Hemanin manchah phapenna anei ani channa pa Merari chilhah miho lah’a Ethan chu Kishi chapa ahin, Kishi chu Abdi chapa ahin, Abdi chu Malluch chapa ahin,
English: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

tcz: Malluch chu Hashabiah chapa ahin, Hashabiah chu Amaziah chapa ahin, Amaziah chu Hilkiah chapa ahin,
en: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
text:
1CH 6:45
Thadou: Malluch chu Hashabiah chapa ahin, Hashabiah chu Amaziah chapa ahin, Amaziah chu Hilkiah chapa ahin,
English: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

tcz: Hilkiah chu Amzi chapa ahin, Amzi chu Bani chapa ahin, Bani chu Shemer chapa ahin,
en: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
text:
1CH 6:46
Thadou: Hilkiah chu Amzi chapa ahin, Amzi chu Bani chapa ahin, Bani chu Shemer chapa ahin,
English: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

tcz: Shemer chu Mahli chapa ahin, Mahli chu Mushi chapa ahin, Mushi chu Merari chapa ahin chule Merari chu Levi chapa ahiye.
en: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
text:
1CH 6:47
Thadou: Shemer chu Mahli chapa ahin, Mahli chu Mushi chapa ahin, Mushi chu Merari chapa ahin chule Merari chu Levi chapa ahiye.
English: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

tcz: Amaho sopite Levi phung sung mite jouse chu abonchauvin Pathen hou-in houbuh sunga natong kinbol din akipansah soh keiyuvin ahi.
en: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.
text:
1CH 6:48
Thadou: Amaho sopite Levi phung sung mite jouse chu abonchauvin Pathen hou-in houbuh sunga natong kinbol din akipansah soh keiyuvin ahi.
English: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.

tcz: Aaron le achapate jeng bouseh chu Thempu kin tongin apanguvin ahi. Amahon pumgo thilto kigona maicham chung le gimnaitui kihalvamna maicham chunga thilto ding jouse toh-soh in apanguvin, Muntheng Phunga natohna ding thil toh din apanguve, chujongleh Pathen lhachapa Mose thupeh dungyuiyin Israelte kithoina kinbol’in apang jiuve.
en: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
text:
1CH 6:49
Thadou: Aaron le achapate jeng bouseh chu Thempu kin tongin apanguvin ahi. Amahon pumgo thilto kigona maicham chung le gimnaitui kihalvamna maicham chunga thilto ding jouse toh-soh in apanguvin, Muntheng Phunga natohna ding thil toh din apanguve, chujongleh Pathen lhachapa Mose thupeh dungyuiyin Israelte kithoina kinbol’in apang jiuve.
English: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

tcz: Aaron son chilhah hochu hicheng hi ahiuve: Aaron chapa chu Eleazar ahin, Eleazar chapa chu Phinehas ahin, Phinehas chapa chu Abishua ahi.
en: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
text:
1CH 6:50
Thadou: Aaron son chilhah hochu hicheng hi ahiuve: Aaron chapa chu Eleazar ahin, Eleazar chapa chu Phinehas ahin, Phinehas chapa chu Abishua ahi.
English: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

tcz: Abishua chapa chu Bukki ahin, Bukki chapa chu Uzzi ahin, Uzzi chapa chu Zerahiah ahi.
en: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
text:
1CH 6:51
Thadou: Abishua chapa chu Bukki ahin, Bukki chapa chu Uzzi ahin, Uzzi chapa chu Zerahiah ahi.
English: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

tcz: Zerahiah chapa chu Meraioth ahin, Meraioth chapa chu Amariah ahin; Amariah chapa chu Ahitub ahi.
en: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
text:
1CH 6:52
Thadou: Zerahiah chapa chu Meraioth ahin, Meraioth chapa chu Amariah ahin; Amariah chapa chu Ahitub ahi.
English: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

tcz: Ahitub chapa chu Zadok ahin, chule Zadok chapa chu Ahimaaz ahiye.
en: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
text:
1CH 6:53
Thadou: Ahitub chapa chu Zadok ahin, chule Zadok chapa chu Ahimaaz ahiye.
English: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

tcz: Hichengse hi amaho gamgi hop sunga achenna mun chengseu chu ahiye: Aaron chapate Kohath phung sung mite dinga phun kisan chu aphat jeh’in,
en: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
text:
1CH 6:54
Thadou: Hichengse hi amaho gamgi hop sunga achenna mun chengseu chu ahiye: Aaron chapate Kohath phung sung mite dinga phun kisan chu aphat jeh’in,
English: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),

tcz: Mihon amaho chu Judah gamsunga Hebron khopi le akimvel gamse se toh chule avel’a hamhing gam gancha vahna ding jouse chutoh apeh tha taove;
en: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;

tcz: Amavang akhopi loujao lah chengse leh akhoneo dung jouse chu Caleb kitipa Jephunneh chapa chu apetauve.
en: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
text:
1CH 6:56
Thadou: Amavang akhopi loujao lah chengse leh akhoneo dung jouse chu Caleb kitipa Jephunneh chapa chu apetauve.
English: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

tcz: Aaron chapa dinga khopi anapeh’u chule ahamhing gamsunga cheh toh anakipeh tha ho chu: Hebron khopi ( kiselna khopi ), Libnah khopi, Jattir khopi, Eshtemoa khopi,
en: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
text:
1CH 6:57
Thadou: Aaron chapa dinga khopi anapeh’u chule ahamhing gamsunga cheh toh anakipeh tha ho chu: Hebron khopi ( kiselna khopi ), Libnah khopi, Jattir khopi, Eshtemoa khopi,
English: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

tcz: Holon khopi, Debir khopi,
en: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
text:
1CH 6:58
Thadou: Holon khopi, Debir khopi,
English: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

tcz: Ain khoppi, Juttah khopi, chule Beth-Shemesh khopi toh hichengse hi ahi.
en: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;

tcz: Chuleh Benjamin phunga kona alahdoh-u khopi ho chu Gibeon khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahin, Geba khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahin, Alemeth khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahin,chule Anatholh khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahi. Aaron chapate ainsung pumpiuva achan jat’u khopi chu abonchan khopi som le khopi thum alhingin ahi.
en: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
text:
1CH 6:60
Thadou: Chuleh Benjamin phunga kona alahdoh-u khopi ho chu Gibeon khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahin, Geba khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahin, Alemeth khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahin,chule Anatholh khopi le ahamhing gamsungse toh ahi. Aaron chapate ainsung pumpiuva achan jat’u khopi chu abonchan khopi som le khopi thum alhingin ahi.
English: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

tcz: Kohath chapate amoh chengse din Bamau insung dinga phum aphatna dungjuiyin, Manasseh phung keh khat, hichea phunga kon chun khopi som khat jen akipen ahi.
en: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
text:
1CH 6:61
Thadou: Kohath chapate amoh chengse din Bamau insung dinga phum aphatna dungjuiyin, Manasseh phung keh khat, hichea phunga kon chun khopi som khat jen akipen ahi.
English: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

tcz: Gershom chapate chu phun kisan aphat dungjuiyin, Issachar gam'a kon, Asher gam'a kon, Naphtali gam'a kon, chule Jordan solam’a um Bashan gam'a Manasseh phunga kona kidong khom khopi agomin khopi som le khopi thum achanguvin ahi.
en: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
text:
1CH 6:62
Thadou: Gershom chapate chu phun kisan aphat dungjuiyin, Issachar gam'a kon, Asher gam'a kon, Naphtali gam'a kon, chule Jordan solam’a um Bashan gam'a Manasseh phunga kona kidong khom khopi agomin khopi som le khopi thum achanguvin ahi.
English: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

tcz: Merari chapate jong phun kisan aphat dungjuiyin, Reuben gam'a kon, Gad gam'a kon, chule Zebulun gam'a kon kidong khom khopi som le khopi ni acheng uvin ahiye.
en: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
text:
1CH 6:63
Thadou: Merari chapate jong phun kisan aphat dungjuiyin, Reuben gam'a kon, Gad gam'a kon, chule Zebulun gam'a kon kidong khom khopi som le khopi ni acheng uvin ahiye.
English: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

tcz: Hitobang hin Israel chaten Levite chu khopi chujat chutoh ahamhing gamsese toh anapeuvin ahiye.
en: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.
text:
1CH 6:64
Thadou: Hitobang hin Israel chaten Levite chu khopi chujat chutoh ahamhing gamsese toh anapeuvin ahiye.
English: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

tcz: Hitobang hin phun phatna dungjuiyin, Judah phunga kon, Simeon phunga kon, chule Benjamin phunga konin achunga kisei khopi ho hi anapeuvin ahi.
en: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
text:
1CH 6:65
Thadou: Hitobang hin phun phatna dungjuiyin, Judah phunga kon, Simeon phunga kon, chule Benjamin phunga konin achunga kisei khopi ho hi anapeuvin ahi.
English: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

tcz: Kohath chapate insung mi phabep jong Ephraim phunga konin agamsunguva khopi phabep le ahamhing gamsungse cheh achanguvin,
en: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
text:
1CH 6:66
Thadou: Kohath chapate insung mi phabep jong Ephraim phunga konin agamsunguva khopi phabep le ahamhing gamsungse cheh achanguvin,
English: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

tcz: Issachar chapa li ho chu Tol'a, Puah, Jashub, chule Shimron ahiuve.
en: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
text:
1CH 7:1
Thadou: Issachar chapa li ho chu Tol'a, Puah, Jashub, chule Shimron ahiuve.
English: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

tcz: Tol'a chapate chu Uzzi le Rephaiah toh, Jeriel le Jahmai toh, Ibsam le Shemuel ahiuve. Amaho hi apau Tol'a insungkon mite lah’a upa cheh ahiuve. Daniel lal laiyin amaho hi gal-hang mihat jeng ahiuvin, sepai 22,600 alhinguvin ahi.
en: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
text:
1CH 7:2
Thadou: Tol'a chapate chu Uzzi le Rephaiah toh, Jeriel le Jahmai toh, Ibsam le Shemuel ahiuve. Amaho hi apau Tol'a insungkon mite lah’a upa cheh ahiuve. Daniel lal laiyin amaho hi gal-hang mihat jeng ahiuvin, sepai 22,600 alhinguvin ahi.
English: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

tcz: Uzzi chapa chu Izrahiah ahi. Izrahiah chapate chu Michael, Obadiah, Joel, chule Isshiah ahiuve. Amaho mi nga hi aphung sunguva lamkai cheh in apanguve.
en: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
text:
1CH 7:3
Thadou: Uzzi chapa chu Izrahiah ahi. Izrahiah chapate chu Michael, Obadiah, Joel, chule Isshiah ahiuve. Amaho mi nga hi aphung sunguva lamkai cheh in apanguve.
English: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

tcz: Amaho hi numei ji tampi le chapa tamtah aneiyuvin, hijehchun amaho chapate sunga galsat thei sepai hi agomin mi 36,000 alhinguve.
en: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
text:
1CH 7:4
Thadou: Amaho hi numei ji tampi le chapa tamtah aneiyuvin, hijehchun amaho chapate sunga galsat thei sepai hi agomin mi 36,000 alhinguve.
English: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

tcz: Issachar insung mite mong mong jong gal-hang mihat jeng jeng jong abonchauvin 87,000 alhinguvin ahi. Amaho cheng chu akhanggui lekhabu’va kijih lut’ah ahitai.
en: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.
text:
1CH 7:5
Thadou: Issachar insung mite mong mong jong gal-hang mihat jeng jeng jong abonchauvin 87,000 alhinguvin ahi. Amaho cheng chu akhanggui lekhabu’va kijih lut’ah ahitai.
English: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.

tcz: Benjamin chapa thum hochu Bela, Beker chule Jediael ahiuve.
en: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.
text:
1CH 7:6
Thadou: Benjamin chapa thum hochu Bela, Beker chule Jediael ahiuve.
English: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.

tcz: Bela chapa nga ho chu Ezbon le Uzzi toh, Uzziel le Jerimoth toh, chule Iri ahiuvin ahi. Amaho hi amau insung apu apau lhah’a phung upa cheh ahiuve. Chujongle akhangguiyu kisimna akisut dol chun gal-hang sepai agomin 22,034 alhinguve.
en: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
text:
1CH 7:7
Thadou: Bela chapa nga ho chu Ezbon le Uzzi toh, Uzziel le Jerimoth toh, chule Iri ahiuvin ahi. Amaho hi amau insung apu apau lhah’a phung upa cheh ahiuve. Chujongle akhangguiyu kisimna akisut dol chun gal-hang sepai agomin 22,034 alhinguve.
English: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.

tcz: Beker chapate chu Zemirah ahin, Joash ahin, Eliezer ahin, Elioenai ahin, Omri ahin, Jeremoth ahin, Abijah ahin, Anathoth ahin, chule Alemeth toh ahiuve.
en: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
text:
1CH 7:8
Thadou: Beker chapate chu Zemirah ahin, Joash ahin, Eliezer ahin, Elioenai ahin, Omri ahin, Jeremoth ahin, Abijah ahin, Anathoth ahin, chule Alemeth toh ahiuve.
English: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

tcz: Amaho hi apu apateu lhah’a insung upa cheh ahiuve. Amaho hi akhangguiya lekhabu’a kisut lut dungjuiyin mihat gal-hang sese le lamkai sese chu agomin mihem 20,200 alhinguvin ahi.
en: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.
text:
1CH 7:9
Thadou: Amaho hi apu apateu lhah’a insung upa cheh ahiuve. Amaho hi akhangguiya lekhabu’a kisut lut dungjuiyin mihat gal-hang sese le lamkai sese chu agomin mihem 20,200 alhinguvin ahi.
English: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.

tcz: Jediael chapa chu Bilhan ahi. Bilhan chapate chu Jeush le Benjamin toh, Ehud le Kenaanah toh, Zethan le Tarshish toh chule Ahishahar ahiuve.
en: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
text:
1CH 7:10
Thadou: Jediael chapa chu Bilhan ahi. Bilhan chapate chu Jeush le Benjamin toh, Ehud le Kenaanah toh, Zethan le Tarshish toh chule Ahishahar ahiuve.
English: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

tcz: Amaho cheng hi apu apateu insunga phung upa cheh ahiuve. Hichengse phung sunga hin gal-hang mihat galbol thei cheh agomin 17,200 alhinguve.
en: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.
text:
1CH 7:11
Thadou: Amaho cheng hi apu apateu insunga phung upa cheh ahiuve. Hichengse phung sunga hin gal-hang mihat galbol thei cheh agomin 17,200 alhinguve.
English: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.

tcz: Ir chapate ni chu Shuppim le Huppim ahilhone. Hushim chu apa Aker ahi.
en: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.
text:
1CH 7:12
Thadou: Ir chapate ni chu Shuppim le Huppim ahilhone. Hushim chu apa Aker ahi.
English: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.

tcz: Naphtali chapate chu Jahzeel ahin, Guni ahin, Jezer ahin, chule Shillem ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Jacob thaikemnu son achilhah jeng ahiuve.
en: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.
text:
1CH 7:13
Thadou: Naphtali chapate chu Jahzeel ahin, Guni ahin, Jezer ahin, chule Shillem ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Jacob thaikemnu son achilhah jeng ahiuve.
English: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

tcz: Manasseh son achilhah ho lah’a Aramean numeinu toh ahin chu Asriel ahi. Amanu hin Gilead hingpa Makir jong ahinge.
en: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.
text:
1CH 7:14
Thadou: Manasseh son achilhah ho lah’a Aramean numeinu toh ahin chu Asriel ahi. Amanu hin Gilead hingpa Makir jong ahinge.
English: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.

tcz: Makir hin Huppim le Shuppim jong ji apuipeh cheh’e. Makir hin sopi numei khat aneiyin amin Macaah akiti. Ason chilhah ho lah’a numei khat chu Zelophehad ahin, amanu hin chanu jeng bou ahingin ahi.
