en: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.
text:
1CH 7:15
Thadou: Makir hin Huppim le Shuppim jong ji apuipeh cheh’e. Makir hin sopi numei khat aneiyin amin Macaah akiti. Ason chilhah ho lah’a numei khat chu Zelophehad ahin, amanu hin chanu jeng bou ahingin ahi.
English: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.

tcz: Makir jinu Macaah chun chapa khat ahingin amin jong Peresh asah’e ; chule asopipa min chu Sheresh ahi. Peresh chapate ni chu Ulam le Rakem ahilhone.
en: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
text:
1CH 7:16
Thadou: Makir jinu Macaah chun chapa khat ahingin amin jong Peresh asah’e ; chule asopipa min chu Sheresh ahi. Peresh chapate ni chu Ulam le Rakem ahilhone.
English: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

tcz: Ulam chapa chu Bedan ahi. Hichengse hi Manasseh chapa Makir son chilhah ho lah’a Gilead insung mite jeng ahiuve.
en: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
text:
1CH 7:17
Thadou: Ulam chapa chu Bedan ahi. Hichengse hi Manasseh chapa Makir son chilhah ho lah’a Gilead insung mite jeng ahiuve.
English: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

tcz: Makir sopinu Hammoleketh kitinu chun Ishod, Abiezer, chule Mahlah ahingin ahi.
en: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
text:
1CH 7:18
Thadou: Makir sopinu Hammoleketh kitinu chun Ishod, Abiezer, chule Mahlah ahingin ahi.
English: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

tcz: Shemida chapate chu Ahian, Shechen, Likhi, chu Aniam ahiuvin ahi.
en: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
text:
1CH 7:19
Thadou: Shemida chapate chu Ahian, Shechen, Likhi, chu Aniam ahiuvin ahi.
English: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

tcz: Ephraim son chilhah ho chu Shuthelah ahin, Bered ahin, Tahath ahin, Eleadah ahin, Tahath ahikit’in,
en: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
text:
1CH 7:20
Thadou: Ephraim son chilhah ho chu Shuthelah ahin, Bered ahin, Tahath ahin, Eleadah ahin, Tahath ahikit’in,
English: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

tcz: Zabad ahin, Shuthelah akiti kit’in, Ezer ahin, Elead ahiye. Ezer le Elead,, ama ni hi Gath kimvella cheng loulhou mi hon anathat tauvin ahi: ijeh-inem itileh ama ni hi aganchau guhpeh dinga hung konsuh jing ahilhone.
en: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.
text:
1CH 7:21
Thadou: Zabad ahin, Shuthelah akiti kit’in, Ezer ahin, Elead ahiye. Ezer le Elead,, ama ni hi Gath kimvella cheng loulhou mi hon anathat tauvin ahi: ijeh-inem itileh ama ni hi aganchau guhpeh dinga hung konsuh jing ahilhone.
English: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.

tcz: Apau Ephraim chun nikho phabep sungin amaho pul adou jengin, alhem lung mong din asopite jong ahunguvin ahi.
en: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
text:
1CH 7:22
Thadou: Apau Ephraim chun nikho phabep sungin amaho pul adou jengin, alhem lung mong din asopite jong ahunguvin ahi.
English: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

tcz: Chujouvin Ephraim hin ajinu aluppi kit’in ahileh amanu ahung gaiyin chapa khat ahing kit’e: ainsunga chutobang vangsetna alhun jeh’in Ephraim in achapa pengthahpa chu Beriah akisah’in ahi.
en: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.
text:
1CH 7:23
Thadou: Chujouvin Ephraim hin ajinu aluppi kit’in ahileh amanu ahung gaiyin chapa khat ahing kit’e: ainsunga chutobang vangsetna alhun jeh’in Ephraim in achapa pengthahpa chu Beriah akisah’in ahi.
English: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.

tcz: Aman chanu khat ahingin amin jong Sheerah akitin ahi. Amanu hin Beth-horon chung nung le anoinung chu anasadoh’in chule Uzzer-Sheerah jong anasadoh’e.
en: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.
text:
1CH 7:24
Thadou: Aman chanu khat ahingin amin jong Sheerah akitin ahi. Amanu hin Beth-horon chung nung le anoinung chu anasadoh’in chule Uzzer-Sheerah jong anasadoh’e.
English: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.

tcz: Ephraim son chilhah ho chu Rephah ahi, Resheph ahin, Telah ahin, Tahan ahin,
en: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
text:
1CH 7:25
Thadou: Ephraim son chilhah ho chu Rephah ahi, Resheph ahin, Telah ahin, Tahan ahin,
English: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

tcz: Ladan ahin, Ammihud ahin, Elishama ahin,
en: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
text:
1CH 7:26
Thadou: Ladan ahin, Ammihud ahin, Elishama ahin,
English: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

tcz: Nun ahin, chule Joshua ahiye.
en: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
text:
1CH 7:27
Thadou: Nun ahin, chule Joshua ahiye.
English: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

tcz: Ephraim son chilhah hon gam alouva achenphana mun’u chu Bethel khopi le agamsunga kholen dom jouse toh, niso lama Naaran ahin, nilhum lama Gezer le akholen dung jouse jong ahithan, chule Shechem khopi le akholen len ho jong ahin, Ayyah khopi le akholen dung jouse changei jong ahithai.
en: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;

tcz: Chutengle Manasseh mite gamgi dunga hung kilhah ahipeh’in, Beth-Shan le akholen dung jouse ahin, Taanaeh le akholen ho toh, Megiddo khole akholen dung jouse le Dork hole le akholen dom jouse toh ahiye. Khopi hijat sunga hi Israel chapa Joseph son chilhah chengse anacheng ahiuve.
en: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.
text:
1CH 7:29
Thadou: Chutengle Manasseh mite gamgi dunga hung kilhah ahipeh’in, Beth-Shan le akholen dung jouse ahin, Taanaeh le akholen ho toh, Megiddo khole akholen dung jouse le Dork hole le akholen dom jouse toh ahiye. Khopi hijat sunga hi Israel chapa Joseph son chilhah chengse anacheng ahiuve.
English: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.

tcz: Asher chapate chu Imnah ahin, Ishvah ahin, Ishvi ahin, chule Beriah ahiuve. Amahon sopi numei khat aneiyuvin amin Serah ahi.
en: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.
text:
1CH 7:30
Thadou: Asher chapate chu Imnah ahin, Ishvah ahin, Ishvi ahin, chule Beriah ahiuve. Amahon sopi numei khat aneiyuvin amin Serah ahi.
English: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.

tcz: Beriah chapate ni chu Heber le Malkiel ahilhonin, Malkiel hi Birzaith pa ahiye.
en: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
text:
1CH 7:31
Thadou: Beriah chapate ni chu Heber le Malkiel ahilhonin, Malkiel hi Birzaith pa ahiye.
English: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

tcz: Heber chapate chu Japhlet le Shomer toh, chule Hotham ahiuve. Amaho hin sopi numei khat bou aneiyuvin amin Shua akiti.
en: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.
text:
1CH 7:32
Thadou: Heber chapate chu Japhlet le Shomer toh, chule Hotham ahiuve. Amaho hin sopi numei khat bou aneiyuvin amin Shua akiti.
English: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.

tcz: Japhlet chapate hin Pasach, Bimhal, chule Ashvath ahiuve.
en: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
text:
1CH 7:33
Thadou: Japhlet chapate hin Pasach, Bimhal, chule Ashvath ahiuve.
English: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

tcz: Shomer chapate chu Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, chule Ram ahiuve.
en: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
text:
1CH 7:34
Thadou: Shomer chapate chu Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, chule Ram ahiuve.
English: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

tcz: Shomer sopipa Helem chapate chu Zophah, Imma, Shelesh, chule Amal ahiuve.
en: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
text:
1CH 7:35
Thadou: Shomer sopipa Helem chapate chu Zophah, Imma, Shelesh, chule Amal ahiuve.
English: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

tcz: Zophah chapate chu Suah, Harnephar, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
en: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
text:
1CH 7:36
Thadou: Zophah chapate chu Suah, Harnephar, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
English: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

tcz: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, chule Beera ahiuve.
en: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
text:
1CH 7:37
Thadou: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, chule Beera ahiuve.
English: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

tcz: Jether chapate chu Arah le Hanniel toh, chule Rizia ahiuvin ahi.
en: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
text:
1CH 7:38
Thadou: Jether chapate chu Arah le Hanniel toh, chule Rizia ahiuvin ahi.
English: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

tcz: Ulla chapate chu Arah le Hanniel toh, chule Rizia ahiuve.
en: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
text:
1CH 7:39
Thadou: Ulla chapate chu Arah le Hanniel toh, chule Rizia ahiuve.
English: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

tcz: Asher son achilhah mi hichengse hi, apajang khai cheh’a phung upa jeng ahiuve. Mihat gal-hang mi jeng leh milen milal jeng ahiuve, ti phatea phot chetsa cheh ahitauve. Akhanggui lekhabua galsat’a manthei cheh mihing kisimdoh chengse chu 26,000 alhinguvin ahi.
en: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.
text:
1CH 7:40
Thadou: Asher son achilhah mi hichengse hi, apajang khai cheh’a phung upa jeng ahiuve. Mihat gal-hang mi jeng leh milen milal jeng ahiuve, ti phatea phot chetsa cheh ahitauve. Akhanggui lekhabua galsat’a manthei cheh mihing kisimdoh chengse chu 26,000 alhinguvin ahi.
English: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

tcz: Benjamin chapa apeng masapen chu Bela ahin, ni lhinna pachu Ashbel ahin, athum channa pachu Aharah ahin,
en: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
text:
1CH 8:1
Thadou: Benjamin chapa apeng masapen chu Bela ahin, ni lhinna pachu Ashbel ahin, athum channa pachu Aharah ahin,
English: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

tcz: Li lhinna pachu Nohah ahin, chule a nga channapa chu Rapha ahi.
en: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
text:
1CH 8:2
Thadou: Li lhinna pachu Nohah ahin, chule a nga channapa chu Rapha ahi.
English: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

tcz: Bela chapate chu Addar ahin, Gera ahin, Abihud ahin,
en: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
text:
1CH 8:3
Thadou: Bela chapate chu Addar ahin, Gera ahin, Abihud ahin,
English: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

tcz: Abishua ahin, Naaman ahin, Ahoah ahin,
en: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
text:
1CH 8:4
Thadou: Abishua ahin, Naaman ahin, Ahoah ahin,
English: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

tcz: Gera ahin, Shephuphan ahin, chule Huram ahiuve.
en: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
text:
1CH 8:5
Thadou: Gera ahin, Shephuphan ahin, chule Huram ahiuve.
English: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

tcz: Ehud chapate,Gam'a cheng mite dinga ainsung cheh uva mi upa jeng ho chu, abonchauvin Manahath gamsunga min soh-chang din akaimang tauve.
en: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:
text:
1CH 8:6
Thadou: Ehud chapate,Gam'a cheng mite dinga ainsung cheh uva mi upa jeng ho chu, abonchauvin Manahath gamsunga min soh-chang din akaimang tauve.
English: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:

tcz: Ehud chapate chu Naaman ahin, Ahijah ahin, chule Gera toh ahiuve. Gera hin soh-changa apuimang’u ahin, amahin Uzza le Abihud ahingin ahi.
en: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
text:
1CH 8:7
Thadou: Ehud chapate chu Naaman ahin, Ahijah ahin, chule Gera toh ahiuve. Gera hin soh-changa apuimang’u ahin, amahin Uzza le Abihud ahingin ahi.
English: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

tcz: Shaharaim hin ajite ni Hushim le Baara ada nungin jong Moab gamsunga cha tampi anei nalaiyin ahi.
en: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.
text:
1CH 8:8
Thadou: Shaharaim hin ajite ni Hushim le Baara ada nungin jong Moab gamsunga cha tampi anei nalaiyin ahi.
English: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.

tcz: Ajinu Hodesh kiti nu chuto jong chapa Jobab le Zibia toh Mesha le Malcam ahing lhonin,
en: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
text:
1CH 8:9
Thadou: Ajinu Hodesh kiti nu chuto jong chapa Jobab le Zibia toh Mesha le Malcam ahing lhonin,
English: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

tcz: Jeuz le Sakia toh, chule Mirmah ahing lhonin ahi. Hichengse hi amapa chapate ahiuvin, ainsung cheh uva mi upa cheh ahiuve.
en: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.
text:
1CH 8:10
Thadou: Jeuz le Sakia toh, chule Mirmah ahing lhonin ahi. Hichengse hi amapa chapate ahiuvin, ainsung cheh uva mi upa cheh ahiuve.
English: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

tcz: Aman ajinu Hashim tohjong chapa ni Abitub leh Elpaal ahing lhonin ahi.
en: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.
text:
1CH 8:11
Thadou: Aman ajinu Hashim tohjong chapa ni Abitub leh Elpaal ahing lhonin ahi.
English: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

tcz: Elpaal chapate chu Eber ahin, Misham ahin, chule Shemed ahi: ( Shemed hin Ono khopi le Lod khopi toh chule akholen dung jouse anasan ahin),
en: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

tcz: Beriah ahin, chule Shema jong ahilhone. Amaho hi Aijalon khopi’a cheng insung phung upa cheh ahiuvin, chule Gath’a cheng ho toh kisat’a nomanga pang ho chu ahiuve.
en: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

tcz: Chujongle Ahio le Shashak toh chule Jeremoth jong ahiuve.
en: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
text:
1CH 8:14
Thadou: Chujongle Ahio le Shashak toh chule Jeremoth jong ahiuve.
English: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

tcz: Zebadiah ahin, Arad ahin, chule Eder jong ahiuve.
en: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
text:
1CH 8:15
Thadou: Zebadiah ahin, Arad ahin, chule Eder jong ahiuve.
English: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

tcz: Michael le Ishpah toh Joha, amaho hi Beriah chapate jeng ahiuve.
en: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,
text:
1CH 8:16
Thadou: Michael le Ishpah toh Joha, amaho hi Beriah chapate jeng ahiuve.
English: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,

tcz: Zebadiah ahin, Izliah ahin, chule Jobab, amaho chengse hi Elpaal chapate jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
text:
1CH 8:17
Thadou: Zebadiah ahin, Izliah ahin, chule Jobab, amaho chengse hi Elpaal chapate jeng ahiuvin ahi.
English: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

tcz: Ishmerai ahin, Izliah ahin, chule Jobab, amaho chengse hi Elpaal chapate jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,
text:
1CH 8:18
Thadou: Ishmerai ahin, Izliah ahin, chule Jobab, amaho chengse hi Elpaal chapate jeng ahiuvin ahi.
English: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

tcz: Jakim ahin, Zicri ahin, Zabdi ahi,
en: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,
text:
1CH 8:19
Thadou: Jakim ahin, Zicri ahin, Zabdi ahi,
English: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

tcz: Elienai ahin, Zillethai ahin, Eliel ahin,
en: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
text:
1CH 8:20
Thadou: Elienai ahin, Zillethai ahin, Eliel ahin,
English: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

tcz: Adaiah ahin, Beriah ahin, chule Shimrath ahin, amaho hi Shimei chapate ahiuve.
en: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,
text:
1CH 8:21
Thadou: Adaiah ahin, Beriah ahin, chule Shimrath ahin, amaho hi Shimei chapate ahiuve.
English: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

tcz: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
en: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
text:
1CH 8:22
Thadou: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
English: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

tcz: Abdon, Zicri, Hanan,
en: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,
text:
1CH 8:23
Thadou: Abdon, Zicri, Hanan,
English: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

tcz: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
en: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
text:
1CH 8:24
Thadou: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
English: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

tcz: Iphdeiah, chule Penuel hichengse hi Shashak chapate jeng ahiuve.
en: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,
text:
1CH 8:25
Thadou: Iphdeiah, chule Penuel hichengse hi Shashak chapate jeng ahiuve.
English: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

tcz: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
en: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
text:
1CH 8:26
Thadou: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
English: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

tcz: Jaareshiah, Elijah, chule Zicri hichengse hi Jeroham chapate ahiuvin ahi.
en: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.
text:
1CH 8:27
Thadou: Jaareshiah, Elijah, chule Zicri hichengse hi Jeroham chapate ahiuvin ahi.
English: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.

tcz: Mihem hijat hi akhangguiyu lekhabua kisut dungjuiyin ama ama insunga phung upa cheh ahiuvin, chule amaho hi Jerusalem khopia anachenguvin ahiye.
en: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.
text:
1CH 8:28
Thadou: Mihem hijat hi akhangguiyu lekhabua kisut dungjuiyin ama ama insunga phung upa cheh ahiuvin, chule amaho hi Jerusalem khopia anachenguvin ahiye.
English: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.

tcz: Gibeon pa Jeiel chu Gibeon khopia anachengin ahi. Ajinu min chu Maacah ahin,
en: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon
text:
1CH 8:29
Thadou: Gibeon pa Jeiel chu Gibeon khopia anachengin ahi. Ajinu min chu Maacah ahin,
English: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon

tcz: Chule achapa apeng masapen chu Abdon akitin ahi. Jeiel chapate adangho chu Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
en: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
text:
1CH 8:30
Thadou: Chule achapa apeng masapen chu Abdon akitin ahi. Jeiel chapate adangho chu Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
English: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

tcz: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah,
en: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
text:
1CH 8:31
Thadou: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah,
English: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

tcz: Chule Shimeam hingpa Mikloth ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi ainkoteu toh kigalsai cheh’in Jerusalem khopia chun anachenguvin ahi.
en: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
text:
1CH 8:32
Thadou: Chule Shimeam hingpa Mikloth ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi ainkoteu toh kigalsai cheh’in Jerusalem khopia chun anachenguvin ahi.
English: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

tcz: Ner chun Kish ahingin, Kish chun Saul ahingin, Saul’in Jonathan, Malkishua, Abinadab, chule Eshbaal ahinge.
en: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
text:
1CH 8:33
Thadou: Ner chun Kish ahingin, Kish chun Saul ahingin, Saul’in Jonathan, Malkishua, Abinadab, chule Eshbaal ahinge.
English: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

tcz: Jonathan’in Meribaal ahingin, Meribaal in Micah ahinge.
en: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.
text:
1CH 8:34
Thadou: Jonathan’in Meribaal ahingin, Meribaal in Micah ahinge.
English: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

tcz: Micah chapate chu Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, chule Ahaz ahiuve.
en: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
text:
1CH 8:35
Thadou: Micah chapate chu Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, chule Ahaz ahiuve.
English: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

tcz: Ahaz chun Jadah ahingin, Jadah chun Alemeth, Azmaveth, chule Zimri ahinge. Zimri hin Moza ahinge.
en: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
text:
1CH 8:36
Thadou: Ahaz chun Jadah ahingin, Jadah chun Alemeth, Azmaveth, chule Zimri ahinge. Zimri hin Moza ahinge.
English: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

tcz: Moza chu Binea pa ahin, Binea chu Rephaiah pa ahin, Raphaiah chu Eleasah pa ahin, chule Eleasah chu Azel pa ahi.
en: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
text:
1CH 8:37
Thadou: Moza chu Binea pa ahin, Binea chu Rephaiah pa ahin, Raphaiah chu Eleasah pa ahin, chule Eleasah chu Azel pa ahi.
English: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

tcz: Azel hin chapa gup aneiyin, amaho chu: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, chule Hanan ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Azel chapate jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
text:
1CH 8:38
Thadou: Azel hin chapa gup aneiyin, amaho chu: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, chule Hanan ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Azel chapate jeng ahiuvin ahi.
English: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

tcz: Ezel sopipa Eshek chun chapa thum ahingin ahi: Apeng masapen chu Ulam ahin, ani lhinna pachu Jeush ahin, chule athum channa pachu Eliphelet ahi.
en: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
text:
1CH 8:39
Thadou: Ezel sopipa Eshek chun chapa thum ahingin ahi: Apeng masapen chu Ulam ahin, ani lhinna pachu Jeush ahin, chule athum channa pachu Eliphelet ahi.
English: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

tcz: Ulam chapate chu mihat gal-hang jeng, thalpi kap them jeng ahiuvin ahi. Amahon chapa tampi pi aneiyuvin chule tute jong tamtah aneiyun, abonchauvin mi 150 jen alhinguve. Mi hichengse hi Benjamin son chilhah jeng ahiuvin ahi.
en: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
text:
1CH 8:40
Thadou: Ulam chapate chu mihat gal-hang jeng, thalpi kap them jeng ahiuvin ahi. Amahon chapa tampi pi aneiyuvin chule tute jong tamtah aneiyun, abonchauvin mi 150 jen alhinguve. Mi hichengse hi Benjamin son chilhah jeng ahiuvin ahi.
English: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

tcz: Hijehchun Israelte chun abonchauvin akhangguiyu akisim soh keiyin, akisim doh jouse chu Israel Lengte thusim lekhabua akijih lut soh keiye. Judah miten Pakaiya kitah louna anei jeh-uvin Babylon gamsunga soh-changin min akaimang taove
en: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.
text:
1CH 9:1
Thadou: Hijehchun Israelte chun abonchauvin akhangguiyu akisim soh keiyin, akisim doh jouse chu Israel Lengte thusim lekhabua akijih lut soh keiye. Judah miten Pakaiya kitah louna anei jeh-uvin Babylon gamsunga soh-changin min akaimang taove
English: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

tcz: Agamsunguva hung lut kit’a akhopi dunguva hung cheng lut masaho chu thempu ho, Levi mite, houin lhacha ho, chule Israel mite adang dang ahiuve.
en: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.
text:
1CH 9:2
Thadou: Agamsunguva hung lut kit’a akhopi dunguva hung cheng lut masaho chu thempu ho, Levi mite, houin lhacha ho, chule Israel mite adang dang ahiuve.
English: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

tcz: Judah mite lah’a abang bang, Benjamin phunga ahin, Ephraim phunga ahin, chule Manasseh phunga ahiuvin, Jerusalem khopia ahung kitol lut’uvin chule achenguve.
en: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:
text:
1CH 9:3
Thadou: Judah mite lah’a abang bang, Benjamin phunga ahin, Ephraim phunga ahin, chule Manasseh phunga ahiuvin, Jerusalem khopia ahung kitol lut’uvin chule achenguve.
English: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

tcz: Judah chapa Perez chapate lah’a inko khat hung kinungle chu achapa Bani, Bani chapa Imri , Imri chapa Omri, Omri chapa Ammihud, Ammihud chapa Uthai chu ahi.
en: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.
text:
1CH 9:4
Thadou: Judah chapa Perez chapate lah’a inko khat hung kinungle chu achapa Bani, Bani chapa Imri , Imri chapa Omri, Omri chapa Ammihud, Ammihud chapa Uthai chu ahi.
English: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

tcz: Adang inko ahung kinungle ho chu Shilon mite lah’a achapa apeng masapen Asaiah le achapate ahiuve.
en: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
text:
1CH 9:5
Thadou: Adang inko ahung kinungle ho chu Shilon mite lah’a achapa apeng masapen Asaiah le achapate ahiuve.
English: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

tcz: Zerah phung sunga ahung kinungle chu Jevel le ainkote chengse ahiuve. Judah phung sunga ahung kinungle inko chu abonchauvin 690 alhinguvin ahi.
en: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
text:
1CH 9:6
Thadou: Zerah phung sunga ahung kinungle chu Jevel le ainkote chengse ahiuve. Judah phung sunga ahung kinungle inko chu abonchauvin 690 alhinguvin ahi.
English: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

tcz: Benjamin phung kon’in Meshullam chapa Sallu ahin, Sallu chapa Hodaviah ahin, Hodaviah chapa Hassenuah ahin,
en: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

tcz: Jeroham chapa Ibneiah ahin, chule Elah chu Uzzi chapa Micri chapa ahin, chule Meshullam jong chu Shephatiah chapa ahin, Shephatiah chu Reuel chapa ahin, Reuel chu Ibnijah chapa ahi.
en: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

tcz: Amaho chengse hi ama ama insung lhah’a phung upa cheh ahiuvin, chule akhanguiyu thusim lekhabua kijih lut soh kei ahiuve. Benjamin phunga kona hung kinungle agomin inko 956 alhinguve.
en: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.
text:
1CH 9:9
Thadou: Amaho chengse hi ama ama insung lhah’a phung upa cheh ahiuvin, chule akhanguiyu thusim lekhabua kijih lut soh kei ahiuve. Benjamin phunga kona hung kinungle agomin inko 956 alhinguve.
English: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

tcz: Thempuho lah’a hung kinungle ho chu Jedaiah le Jehoiarib toh Jakin ahiuve.
en: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,
text:
1CH 9:10
Thadou: Thempuho lah’a hung kinungle ho chu Jedaiah le Jehoiarib toh Jakin ahiuve.
English: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

tcz: Azariah kitipa Hilkiah chapa jong chu ahin, Hilkiah chu Meshullam chapa ahi; Meshullam chu Zadok chapa ahin, Zadok chu Meraioth chapa ahi; Meraioth chu Ahitub chapa ahi. Azariah chu Pathen hou-in’a vaibol lamkai pipua pang ahiye.
en: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

tcz: Thempu adang hung kinungle ho chu Jehoram chapa Adaiah ahin, Jehoram hi Pashhur chapa ahin, Pashhur chu Malkijah chapa ahin, chule Aiel chapa Maasai ahin, Meshullam chu Meshillemith chapa ahin, chule Meshillemith chu Immer chapa ahi.
en: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

tcz: Hicheng tilouvin jong thempu adang ahung kinungle agomin mi 1,760 ahiuve. Amaho hi apu apauva ainsung kailhah’a phung upa chengse ahiuvin, chule mi hangsan ngen jong ahiuve. Chule amaho hi Pathen houin sunga natonga mopohna nei cheh ahiuve.
en: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.
text:
1CH 9:13
Thadou: Hicheng tilouvin jong thempu adang ahung kinungle agomin mi 1,760 ahiuve. Amaho hi apu apauva ainsung kailhah’a phung upa chengse ahiuvin, chule mi hangsan ngen jong ahiuve. Chule amaho hi Pathen houin sunga natonga mopohna nei cheh ahiuve.
English: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

tcz: Levi phunga mite chu Hasshub chapa Shemaiah ahin, Hasshub chu Azrikam chapa ahi; Hazrikam chu Hashabiah chapa ahin, Hashabiah chu Merari chapate lah’a khat ahi.
en: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

tcz: Bakbakkar, Herish leh Galal jong ahiuvin, chutengle Mica chapa Mattaniah ahin, Mica chu Zicri c hapa ahin, Zicri chu Asaph chapa ahi.
en: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,
text:
1CH 9:15
Thadou: Bakbakkar, Herish leh Galal jong ahiuvin, chutengle Mica chapa Mattaniah ahin, Mica chu Zicri c hapa ahin, Zicri chu Asaph chapa ahi.
English: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

tcz: Chule Shemaiah chapa Obadiah ahin, Shemaiah chu Galal chapa ahi; Galal chu Jeduthun chapa ahin, chule Asa chapa Berekiah ahi; Berekiah chu Elkaneh chapa ahin, ama hi Netophah gamsunga cheng anahi.
en: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
text:
1CH 9:16
Thadou: Chule Shemaiah chapa Obadiah ahin, Shemaiah chu Galal chapa ahi; Galal chu Jeduthun chapa ahin, chule Asa chapa Berekiah ahi; Berekiah chu Elkaneh chapa ahin, ama hi Netophah gamsunga cheng anahi.
English: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

tcz: Kulpi kelkot ngah’a pang miho chu Shallum ahin, Akkub ahin, Talmon ahin, Ahiman ahin, chule a inkoteu toh ahiuve.
en: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),
text:
1CH 9:17
Thadou: Kulpi kelkot ngah’a pang miho chu Shallum ahin, Akkub ahin, Talmon ahin, Ahiman ahin, chule a inkoteu toh ahiuve.
English: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

tcz: Chule masang chun amaho hi niso lama lengpa kelkot ngah’in apanguve. Hiche miho hin Levi mite ngahmun kelkot jong angah’uvin ahi.
en: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.
text:
1CH 9:18
Thadou: Chule masang chun amaho hi niso lama lengpa kelkot ngah’in apanguve. Hiche miho hin Levi mite ngahmun kelkot jong angah’uvin ahi.
English: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

tcz: Kore chapa Shallum ahin, Kore chu Ebiasaph chapa ahin; Korah phunggui akon ahi. Ama le ainkote, Korah mite chengse chu houin kinbol’in apu apateu Pakai ngahmun ngah’a apan banguvin apanguve.
en: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.
text:
1CH 9:19
Thadou: Kore chapa Shallum ahin, Kore chu Ebiasaph chapa ahin; Korah phunggui akon ahi. Ama le ainkote, Korah mite chengse chu houin kinbol’in apu apateu Pakai ngahmun ngah’a apan banguvin apanguve.
English: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.

tcz: Masanglaiya chu Eleazar chapa Phinehas kitipa hi amaho kulpi kelkot mopoa anapang ji ahi; hijeh chun Pakaiyin jong amapa chu ana umpi jing jenge.
en: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.
text:
1CH 9:20
Thadou: Masanglaiya chu Eleazar chapa Phinehas kitipa hi amaho kulpi kelkot mopoa anapang ji ahi; hijeh chun Pakaiyin jong amapa chu ana umpi jing jenge.
English: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.

tcz: Chule hiche jou chun Zechariah kitipa Meshelemiah chapa chu kikhopna ponbuh kotphunga kot ngah’in anapang jin ahi.
en: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.
text:
1CH 9:21
Thadou: Chule hiche jou chun Zechariah kitipa Meshelemiah chapa chu kikhopna ponbuh kotphunga kot ngah’in anapang jin ahi.
English: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

tcz: Chuche laichun hongcha kelkot dung ngah dinga kilhengdoh miho mong mong chu mihem 212 alhinguvin ahi; chule amaho hi akhangguiyu kisimna’a akho kho uva kisim soh kei ahiuve. David le mitva neipa Samuel chun amaho hi akitah jeh’uva apu apateu ho chu hitobang apan mun’uva hi apansah lhon ahiuve.
en: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.
text:
1CH 9:22
Thadou: Chuche laichun hongcha kelkot dung ngah dinga kilhengdoh miho mong mong chu mihem 212 alhinguvin ahi; chule amaho hi akhangguiyu kisimna’a akho kho uva kisim soh kei ahiuve. David le mitva neipa Samuel chun amaho hi akitah jeh’uva apu apateu ho chu hitobang apan mun’uva hi apansah lhon ahiuve.
English: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

tcz: Hijeh’a chu amaho le son chilhahho chu Pakai hou-in, ponbuh’a hou-in kelkot phung dung ngah’a in-ngah’a apansah’u ahiye.
en: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the LORD’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.
text:
1CH 9:23
Thadou: Hijeh’a chu amaho le son chilhahho chu Pakai hou-in, ponbuh’a hou-in kelkot phung dung ngah’a in-ngah’a apansah’u ahiye.
English: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the LORD’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.

tcz: Hiche kelkot dunga kot ngah’a pang ho chu niso lam, nilhum lam, Sahlam le lhang lam’a pang soh keiyuva, mun lia pang ahiuvin ahi.
en: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.
text:
1CH 9:24
Thadou: Hiche kelkot dunga kot ngah’a pang ho chu niso lam, nilhum lam, Sahlam le lhang lam’a pang soh keiyuva, mun lia pang ahiuvin ahi.
English: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

tcz: Amaho kithopi din ainkoteu, akho mun cheh’a hunguva ni sagi gia amaho hi ahung panhu jing jenguvah ahi.
en: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,
text:
1CH 9:25
Thadou: Amaho kithopi din ainkoteu, akho mun cheh’a hunguva ni sagi gia amaho hi ahung panhu jing jenguvah ahi.
English: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,

tcz: Kelkot ngah’a pang lamkai cheh Levi mi li ho chu indan jouse leh Pathen hou-in sunga thil kibol jouse ngah’a jong pang ahiuve.
en: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.
text:
1CH 9:26
Thadou: Kelkot ngah’a pang lamkai cheh Levi mi li ho chu indan jouse leh Pathen hou-in sunga thil kibol jouse ngah’a jong pang ahiuve.
English: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.

tcz: Amaho hi Pathen hou-in kimvel a geh jiuva, hitia hi amaho chunga in-nga kiti mong mong chu kikoiya, jingkah seh leh kot ahon jiu ahi.
en: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.
text:
1CH 9:27
Thadou: Amaho hi Pathen hou-in kimvel a geh jiuva, hitia hi amaho chunga in-nga kiti mong mong chu kikoiya, jingkah seh leh kot ahon jiu ahi.
English: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.

tcz: Kelkot ngah’a pang mi phabep khat chu hou-in kinbolna kimangji manchah thil le lo simtoh’in apang jiuvin ahi; ijeh-inem itileh hitobang thilkeo ho chu akilah doh le akikoi lut chan’a amanlouna dinga simtoh ji ji ngai monga ahi.
en: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.
text:
1CH 9:28
Thadou: Kelkot ngah’a pang mi phabep khat chu hou-in kinbolna kimangji manchah thil le lo simtoh’in apang jiuvin ahi; ijeh-inem itileh hitobang thilkeo ho chu akilah doh le akikoi lut chan’a amanlouna dinga simtoh ji ji ngai monga ahi.
English: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.

tcz: Midang ho jong chu thilkeo dang le manchah thil thengho, changbong ding le lengpitwi, thaotwi, gimnamtuui le adang dang lhutnam ding anamtuui ho vetup din apansah’uvin ahi.
en: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.
text:
1CH 9:29
Thadou: Midang ho jong chu thilkeo dang le manchah thil thengho, changbong ding le lengpitwi, thaotwi, gimnamtuui le adang dang lhutnam ding anamtuui ho vetup din apansah’uvin ahi.
English: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

tcz: Hinlah thempuho chu lhutnam ding gimnamtwi chohhal din apansah’uve.
en: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.
text:
1CH 9:30
Thadou: Hinlah thempuho chu lhutnam ding gimnamtwi chohhal din apansah’uve.
English: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.

tcz: Levi mi Mattithiah kitipa leh Korah insung kon Shallum chapa apeng masapen pachu changlhah pheng semna din avaibol’in apangin ahi.
en: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.
text:
1CH 9:31
Thadou: Levi mi Mattithiah kitipa leh Korah insung kon Shallum chapa apeng masapen pachu changlhah pheng semna din avaibol’in apangin ahi.
English: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

tcz: Chujongle Kohath phunga kon mi phabep jong chu cholngah nikho seh leh todoh ding changlhah semin apanguvin ahi.
en: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.
text:
1CH 9:32
Thadou: Chujongle Kohath phunga kon mi phabep jong chu cholngah nikho seh leh todoh ding changlhah semin apanguvin ahi.
English: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.

tcz: Levi miho lah’a tumging/lathem tah tah ho chu hou-in sung dan’a acheng den jenguvin ahi. Amaho hi hou-in kinbolna ho’a ongthol’in aum theiyuve;ijeh-inem itileh amaho hi asun ajan a lasa pang pang jengji ahiuvin ahi.
en: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.
text:
1CH 9:33
Thadou: Levi miho lah’a tumging/lathem tah tah ho chu hou-in sung dan’a acheng den jenguvin ahi. Amaho hi hou-in kinbolna ho’a ongthol’in aum theiyuve;ijeh-inem itileh amaho hi asun ajan a lasa pang pang jengji ahiuvin ahi.
English: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

tcz: Mi hichengse hi Jerusalem Levi miho apu apauva ainsung lhah cheh’a phung upa jeng ahiuve.
en: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.
text:
1CH 9:34
Thadou: Mi hichengse hi Jerusalem Levi miho apu apauva ainsung lhah cheh’a phung upa jeng ahiuve.
English: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.

tcz: Gibeon pa Jeiel chu Gibeon khopi anachengin ahi. Ajinu min chu Maacah ahin,
en: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.
text:
1CH 9:35
Thadou: Gibeon pa Jeiel chu Gibeon khopi anachengin ahi. Ajinu min chu Maacah ahin,
English: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.

tcz: Chule achapa apeng masapen chu Abdon ahiye. Jeiel chapate adangho chu Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
en: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
text:
1CH 9:36
Thadou: Chule achapa apeng masapen chu Abdon ahiye. Jeiel chapate adangho chu Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
English: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

tcz: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, chule Mikloth ahiuve.
en: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
text:
1CH 9:37
Thadou: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, chule Mikloth ahiuve.
English: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

tcz: Mikloth hi Shimeam pa ahiye. Inko hijat hi Jerusalem khopia ki-inmai ngatto cheh’in anachenguve.
en: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
text:
1CH 9:38
Thadou: Mikloth hi Shimeam pa ahiye. Inko hijat hi Jerusalem khopia ki-inmai ngatto cheh’in anachenguve.
English: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

tcz: Ner hin Kish ahingin, Kish in Saul ahinge. Saul’in Jonathan, Malkishua, Abinadab, chule Eshbaal ahinge.
en: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
text:
1CH 9:39
Thadou: Ner hin Kish ahingin, Kish in Saul ahinge. Saul’in Jonathan, Malkishua, Abinadab, chule Eshbaal ahinge.
English: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

tcz: Jonathan chu Merib-Baal pa ahin, chule Merib-Baal chu Micah pa ahiye.
en: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.
text:
1CH 9:40
Thadou: Jonathan chu Merib-Baal pa ahin, chule Merib-Baal chu Micah pa ahiye.
English: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

tcz: Micah chapate chu Pithon ahin, Melech ahin, Tahrea ahin, chule Ahaz ahiye.
en: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
text:
1CH 9:41
Thadou: Micah chapate chu Pithon ahin, Melech ahin, Tahrea ahin, chule Ahaz ahiye.
English: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

tcz: Ahaz hi Jadah pa ahi. Jadah chu Alemeth, Azmaveth, chule Zimri pa ahi. Zimri chu Moza pa ahi.
en: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
text:
1CH 9:42
Thadou: Ahaz hi Jadah pa ahi. Jadah chu Alemeth, Azmaveth, chule Zimri pa ahi. Zimri chu Moza pa ahi.
English: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

tcz: Moza chu Binea pa ahi. Binea chapa chu Rephaiah ahin, Rephaiah chapa chu Eleasah ahin, chule Eleasah chapa chu Azel ahiye.
en: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
text:
1CH 9:43
Thadou: Moza chu Binea pa ahi. Binea chapa chu Rephaiah ahin, Rephaiah chapa chu Eleasah ahin, chule Eleasah chapa chu Azel ahiye.
English: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

tcz: Azel hin chapa gup ahingin, aminu chu Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheriah, Obadiah, chule Hanan ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Azel chapate jeng ahiuve.
en: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
text:
1CH 9:44
Thadou: Azel hin chapa gup ahingin, aminu chu Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheriah, Obadiah, chule Hanan ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Azel chapate jeng ahiuve.
English: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

tcz: Philistineten Israel chunga gal ahin bol tauve; chule Philistinete masanga Israelte ajam gam tauvin ahi. Gilboa molsang chunga gal alel’uvin akijam chap jeng tauvin ahi.
en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
text:
1CH 10:1
Thadou: Philistineten Israel chunga gal ahin bol tauve; chule Philistinete masanga Israelte ajam gam tauvin ahi. Gilboa molsang chunga gal alel’uvin akijam chap jeng tauvin ahi.
English: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

tcz: Philishtineten Saul le achapate ajamnauva apha uvin, hichun achapa thum-Jonathan, Abinadab, chule Malkishua ho chu athat tauve.
en: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
text:
1CH 10:2
Thadou: Philishtineten Saul le achapate ajamnauva apha uvin, hichun achapa thum-Jonathan, Abinadab, chule Malkishua ho chu athat tauve.
English: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

tcz: Saul din gal kisat chu adou hah cheh cheh jeng tan, chuin Philistine thalpi kapthem mihon ma Saul chu amudoh’uvin chule melse tah’in amavouvin ahi.
en: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.
text:
1CH 10:3
Thadou: Saul din gal kisat chu adou hah cheh cheh jeng tan, chuin Philistine thalpi kapthem mihon ma Saul chu amudoh’uvin chule melse tah’in amavouvin ahi.
English: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

tcz: Hichun Saul’in jong agalvonpopa jah’a aseiyin, “Nachemjam satdoh jengin lang neithat pai jengin, achuti louva ahileh hiche cheptanlou Philistine mite khu hung uvin tin kichepna einei diu ahitai,” ati. Ahivanginla agalvonpopan chutia bol jeng ding chu atijat behseh jeh’in anompon aboldeh tapoi. Hiche jehchun Saul’in jong achemjam akisadoh jengin, achunga alhun akibah lut jenge.
en: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.
text:
1CH 10:4
Thadou: Hichun Saul’in jong agalvonpopa jah’a aseiyin, “Nachemjam satdoh jengin lang neithat pai jengin, achuti louva ahileh hiche cheptanlou Philistine mite khu hung uvin tin kichepna einei diu ahitai,” ati. Ahivanginla agalvonpopan chutia bol jeng ding chu atijat behseh jeh’in anompon aboldeh tapoi. Hiche jehchun Saul’in jong achemjam akisadoh jengin, achunga alhun akibah lut jenge.
English: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

tcz: Hichea hi agalvon popanjong Saul thi amudoh phat’in ama jong achemjam chunga akibah lut pai jengin athi pai pai tai.
en: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.
text:
1CH 10:5
Thadou: Hichea hi agalvon popanjong Saul thi amudoh phat’in ama jong achemjam chunga akibah lut pai jengin athi pai pai tai.
English: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

tcz: Hitobang hin Saul le achapa mi thum hochu chumun’a chun abonchan athi khom cheh tauvin, alenggam vaihomna phat sungu jong ahung kichai tai.
en: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.
text:
1CH 10:6
Thadou: Hitobang hin Saul le achapa mi thum hochu chumun’a chun abonchan athi khom cheh tauvin, alenggam vaihomna phat sungu jong ahung kichai tai.
English: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.

tcz: Hichun Jezreel Phaichama cheng Israel mite leh asepai teu ajam gamtauvin, Saul le achapate jong athitauve, ti amudoh phat’uvin achennau khopi jouse adalhauvin ajam gamtauve. Chuin Philistinete ahung kitol lut’uvin akhopi ho chu alotauve.
en: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
text:
1CH 10:7
Thadou: Hichun Jezreel Phaichama cheng Israel mite leh asepai teu ajam gamtauvin, Saul le achapate jong athitauve, ti amudoh phat’uvin achennau khopi jouse adalhauvin ajam gamtauve. Chuin Philistinete ahung kitol lut’uvin akhopi ho chu alotauve.
English: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

tcz: Ajing nikho’a Philistine mite chu mithi long chomdoh’a ahunguva ahileh, Saul le achapate long chu Gilboa molsanga amudoh tauve.
en: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
text:
1CH 10:8
Thadou: Ajing nikho’a Philistine mite chu mithi long chomdoh’a ahunguva ahileh, Saul le achapate long chu Gilboa molsanga amudoh tauve.
English: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

tcz: Hijeh chun amahon jong Saul galvon chu ahoh lhauvin, chule alu jong akitan lhah tauve. Chuin amahon ami lim doi houvu leh Philistia gamsung pumpia mitin henga Saul athi kipana thu alhangsam lele tauvin ahi.
en: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.
text:
1CH 10:9
Thadou: Hijeh chun amahon jong Saul galvon chu ahoh lhauvin, chule alu jong akitan lhah tauve. Chuin amahon ami lim doi houvu leh Philistia gamsung pumpia mitin henga Saul athi kipana thu alhangsam lele tauvin ahi.
English: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.

tcz: Amahon Saul galvon chu a Pathen lim semthu ho hou-in sunga akoiyun, chule alu jong chu Dagon hou-in sunga atah’uvin ahi.
en: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
text:
1CH 10:10
Thadou: Amahon Saul galvon chu a Pathen lim semthu ho hou-in sunga akoiyun, chule alu jong chu Dagon hou-in sunga atah’uvin ahi.
English: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

tcz: Hinlah Jabesh- Gilead khoa cheng mitakip’in Philistineten Saul abolnau ajah doh phat’uvin,
en: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
text:
1CH 10:11
Thadou: Hinlah Jabesh- Gilead khoa cheng mitakip’in Philistineten Saul abolnau ajah doh phat’uvin,
English: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

tcz: Agal-hang lai jouse akipat’uvin Saul tahsa along le achapate long jouse chu abonchauvin Jabesh khoa ahinpo lut soh keiyuvin ahi. Chujongle agubuh jouseu chu Jabesh khopia gangpi phung noiya avuiyun, ni sagi sungin an angol’uvin ahi.
en: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
text:
1CH 10:12
Thadou: Agal-hang lai jouse akipat’uvin Saul tahsa along le achapate long jouse chu abonchauvin Jabesh khoa ahinpo lut soh keiyuvin ahi. Chujongle agubuh jouseu chu Jabesh khopia gangpi phung noiya avuiyun, ni sagi sungin an angol’uvin ahi.
English: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

tcz: Hitobang tah hin Saul chun Pakai thupeh anit pon, chule gaochang mi pou adong len, iti chon ding ham, ti doh ding agopon ahi. Hichejeh’a chu Pakaiyin ama chu athadoh’a, lenggam chu Jesse chapa David joh apeh ahitai.
en: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against the LORD, because of the LORD’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,
text:
1CH 10:13
Thadou: Hitobang tah hin Saul chun Pakai thupeh anit pon, chule gaochang mi pou adong len, iti chon ding ham, ti doh ding agopon ahi. Hichejeh’a chu Pakaiyin ama chu athadoh’a, lenggam chu Jesse chapa David joh apeh ahitai.
English: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against the LORD, because of the LORD’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,

tcz: Hichun Israel mipite chu Hebron khopia David heng ah chun ahung uvin, keiho hi nangma tahsa tahle thisan kahiuve atiu vin ahi.
en: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
text:
1CH 11:1
Thadou: Hichun Israel mipite chu Hebron khopia David heng ah chun ahung uvin, keiho hi nangma tahsa tahle thisan kahiuve atiu vin ahi.
English: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

tcz: Masang Saul leng ana hi laia jong nangma hi Israel te gal lamkai ana hijing jeng nahi, chule Pakai na Pathen in nasei pih banga nangma hi Israel mipi kelngoi chingpha le lamkai dia lhendoh nahi.
en: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. The LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”
text:
1CH 11:2
Thadou: Masang Saul leng ana hi laia jong nangma hi Israel te gal lamkai ana hijing jeng nahi, chule Pakai na Pathen in nasei pih banga nangma hi Israel mipi kelngoi chingpha le lamkai dia lhendoh nahi.
English: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. The LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”

tcz: Hiti chun Hebron mun’a chun David in Pakai le Israel upa ho masang ah kitepna theng ana sem in ahi. Hichea Pakai in Samuel kom’a anasei bang chun David chu Israel te dia leng ding in thaonu ana hin ahi.
en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.
text:
1CH 11:3
Thadou: Hiti chun Hebron mun’a chun David in Pakai le Israel upa ho masang ah kitepna theng ana sem in ahi. Hichea Pakai in Samuel kom’a anasei bang chun David chu Israel te dia leng ding in thaonu ana hin ahi.
English: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.

tcz: Chujouvin David le Israel mipi techun Jerusalem chulai phat’a jebus tiajong ana kihe mun chu ana nokhum un anasat uve. Hilai chu Jebus mite gamnei dihtah te chen na gam ahi.
en: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
text:
1CH 11:4
Thadou: Chujouvin David le Israel mipi techun Jerusalem chulai phat’a jebus tiajong ana kihe mun chu ana nokhum un anasat uve. Hilai chu Jebus mite gamnei dihtah te chen na gam ahi.
English: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.

tcz: Chule Jebus miten David chu akhopi sung’u alut ding ana nom povin ahi. Ahivang inla David in Zion kulpi tua David khopi tia kihe mun lai chu ana lotan ahi.
en: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.
text:
1CH 11:5
Thadou: Chule Jebus miten David chu akhopi sung’u alut ding ana nom povin ahi. Ahivang inla David in Zion kulpi tua David khopi tia kihe mun lai chu ana lotan ahi.
English: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.

tcz: David in asepai miho kom’a hitin asei e. Koi hijong leh Jebus mite kisat pia hinthat masa pen aumleh ka sepai jalamkai luboh’a pang ding ahi ati. Hichun Jebus mite hinsat’a that masapen in Joab kitipa David sopinu Zuriah chapa chu ahung hitoh kilhon in, David gal lamkai panmun masapen chu ana chang tan ahi.
en: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
text:
1CH 11:6
Thadou: David in asepai miho kom’a hitin asei e. Koi hijong leh Jebus mite kisat pia hinthat masa pen aumleh ka sepai jalamkai luboh’a pang ding ahi ati. Hichun Jebus mite hinsat’a that masapen in Joab kitipa David sopinu Zuriah chapa chu ahung hitoh kilhon in, David gal lamkai panmun masapen chu ana chang tan ahi.
English: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.

tcz: David in kulpi chu chenna in, amang in hichu David khopi tin akikou e.
en: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.
text:
1CH 11:7
Thadou: David in kulpi chu chenna in, amang in hichu David khopi tin akikou e.
English: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.

tcz: David in akhopi chu nisolam’a pat avel dung jouse chu akehlet be in ana semtoh in ahi. Chule Joab in amoh chengse chu ana semphan ahi.
en: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
text:
1CH 11:8
Thadou: David in akhopi chu nisolam’a pat avel dung jouse chu akehlet be in ana semtoh in ahi. Chule Joab in amoh chengse chu ana semphan ahi.
English: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

tcz: Hatchung nung Pakaiyin apan pi jih’in David thaneina chu ahung hatdoh cheh cheh jeng in ahi.
en: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD of Armies was with him.
text:
1CH 11:9
Thadou: Hatchung nung Pakaiyin apan pi jih’in David thaneina chu ahung hatdoh cheh cheh jeng in ahi.
English: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD of Armies was with him.

tcz: Amaho hi David galhang lamkai’a pang Israel mipi toh kitho khom a Pakaiyin ana kitep na banga David aleng diuva hin tungdoh ding ho chu ahiuve.
en: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the LORD’s word concerning Israel.
text:
1CH 11:10
Thadou: Amaho hi David galhang lamkai’a pang Israel mipi toh kitho khom a Pakaiyin ana kitep na banga David aleng diuva hin tungdoh ding ho chu ahiuve.
English: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the LORD’s word concerning Israel.

tcz: David gal-hang lamkai minthang ho chu hiche ho hi ahiuve. Amasapen chu ahile Jashobeam kitipa Hachmon mi David gal hat mi thumho lah’a lamkai ahi. Amapa hin achemjam mangcha in akidoupi galmi mi jathum chu khatvei in ana that jou in ahi.
en: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.
text:
1CH 11:11
Thadou: David gal-hang lamkai minthang ho chu hiche ho hi ahiuve. Amasapen chu ahile Jashobeam kitipa Hachmon mi David gal hat mi thumho lah’a lamkai ahi. Amapa hin achemjam mangcha in akidoupi galmi mi jathum chu khatvei in ana that jou in ahi.
English: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.

tcz: Anina pen chu ahileh Ahoah son chilhah Dodai chapa Eleazar ahi.
en: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
text:
1CH 11:12
Thadou: Anina pen chu ahileh Ahoah son chilhah Dodai chapa Eleazar ahi.
English: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.

tcz: Amapa hi Pas-dam'mim a Philistine te ana kisat lai’u chun galmun’a hi David toh ana kitho khom lhon ahi. Chule hiche galmun hi sakol chang dimset ana ke khah jeh chun Israel mite chu anajam tauve.
en: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
text:
1CH 11:13
Thadou: Amapa hi Pas-dam'mim a Philistine te ana kisat lai’u chun galmun’a hi David toh ana kitho khom lhon ahi. Chule hiche galmun hi sakol chang dimset ana ke khah jeh chun Israel mite chu anajam tauve.
English: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

tcz: Ahivang in Eleazar le David hi galmun’a kon nung chon louvin Philistine mite chu anasat lhon in ahi. Chule Pakaiyin amani ana huhdoh in minthang tah in galjona sangtah jong ana chang lhon e.
en: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great victory.
text:
1CH 11:14
Thadou: Ahivang in Eleazar le David hi galmun’a kon nung chon louvin Philistine mite chu anasat lhon in ahi. Chule Pakaiyin amani ana huhdoh in minthang tah in galjona sangtah jong ana chang lhon e.
English: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great victory.

tcz: Sepai lamkai minthang somthum lah a thum hochu David Adulam songkoa anaum lai chun Raphiam phaicham a Philistine sepai ho toh ana kimu touvin ahi.
en: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
text:
1CH 11:15
Thadou: Sepai lamkai minthang somthum lah a thum hochu David Adulam songkoa anaum lai chun Raphiam phaicham a Philistine sepai ho toh ana kimu touvin ahi.
English: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

tcz: David hi chuche phatlai chun akulpi sunga ana um'in ahi. Chule Philistine miten Bethlehem khopi anatou phaovin ahi.
en: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.
text:
1CH 11:16
Thadou: David hi chuche phatlai chun akulpi sunga ana um'in ahi. Chule Philistine miten Bethlehem khopi anatou phaovin ahi.
English: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.

tcz: David in amite jah’a chun hitin aseije, Ohe koitabang eingailu toukhat aum a hiche Bethlehem kelkot phunga twitheng khu eigathal peh thei hile tin aseije .
en: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
text:
1CH 11:17
Thadou: David in amite jah’a chun hitin aseije, Ohe koitabang eingailu toukhat aum a hiche Bethlehem kelkot phunga twitheng khu eigathal peh thei hile tin aseije .
English: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

tcz: Hichun galhat lamkai thumho chun Philistine bang chu apal keh un, Bethlehem kulpia um twi chu David don ding in ahinle choi pih uve. Ahivang in David in hiche twi chu don louvin Pakai a ding joh in ana kat doh in ahi.
en: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to the LORD,
text:
1CH 11:18
Thadou: Hichun galhat lamkai thumho chun Philistine bang chu apal keh un, Bethlehem kulpia um twi chu David don ding in ahinle choi pih uve. Ahivang in David in hiche twi chu don louvin Pakai a ding joh in ana kat doh in ahi.
English: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to the LORD,

tcz: Pathen in hiche twi hi kadon lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche twi hi ahinkho phal ngam’a twi thal a che ho thisan mantam tah toh kibang ahi tin aseijin, David in twi chu anadon pon ahi. Hichu galhang mithum ho natoh lolhin na vetsahna ahi.
en: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
text:
1CH 11:19
Thadou: Pathen in hiche twi hi kadon lou ding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche twi hi ahinkho phal ngam’a twi thal a che ho thisan mantam tah toh kibang ahi tin aseijin, David in twi chu anadon pon ahi. Hichu galhang mithum ho natoh lolhin na vetsahna ahi.
English: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

tcz: Abi'shai hi Joab sopipa lamkai somthum ho lah a pang ahi. Amapa hin achem jam keoseh mangchan akidoupi agalmi mi jathum jen chu ana that jouvin ahi. Hichea kon chun galhat mithum ho bang in ahung minthang tan ahi.
en: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
text:
1CH 11:20
Thadou: Abi'shai hi Joab sopipa lamkai somthum ho lah a pang ahi. Amapa hin achem jam keoseh mangchan akidoupi agalmi mi jathum jen chu ana that jouvin ahi. Hichea kon chun galhat mithum ho bang in ahung minthang tan ahi.
English: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

tcz: Abi'shai hi galhat mithum ho lah a apan jou lou vang'in mi somthum ho lah a hin lamkai minthang tah khat ahi.
en: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.
text:
1CH 11:21
Thadou: Abi'shai hi galhat mithum ho lah a apan jou lou vang'in mi somthum ho lah a hin lamkai minthang tah khat ahi.
English: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.

tcz: Jehoiada chapa Benaiah kiti galhang tah Kabzeel kho a kon mi khat jong ana um e, Amapa hin mihat tah ho natoh jong aboldoh in ahi hiche lah’a chu Moab mite galhang mini jong ana that in; chule buhbang lhah lai ni jingkah in jong Keipi bahkai khat jong ana that e.
en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.
text:
1CH 11:22
Thadou: Jehoiada chapa Benaiah kiti galhang tah Kabzeel kho a kon mi khat jong ana um e, Amapa hin mihat tah ho natoh jong aboldoh in ahi hiche lah’a chu Moab mite galhang mini jong ana that in; chule buhbang lhah lai ni jingkah in jong Keipi bahkai khat jong ana that e.
English: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.

tcz: Aman achang seh in khetbuh mai mangchan Egypt galhang milentah asan dan feet sagi le akeh khat’a sang tengcha lentah kichoija galvon lhingset’a kivon pachu ana that in ahi. Benneah in Egypt mipa tengcha chu alah peh in, ama thanan anei e.
en: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
text:
1CH 11:23
Thadou: Aman achang seh in khetbuh mai mangchan Egypt galhang milentah asan dan feet sagi le akeh khat’a sang tengcha lentah kichoija galvon lhingset’a kivon pachu ana that in ahi. Benneah in Egypt mipa tengcha chu alah peh in, ama thanan anei e.
English: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

tcz: Hitobang thil nasatah ahinbol doh’a kon hin mi minthang galhang thumho bang in ahung loupi doh e.
en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.
text:
1CH 11:24
Thadou: Hitobang thil nasatah ahinbol doh’a kon hin mi minthang galhang thumho bang in ahung loupi doh e.
English: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.

tcz: Hiti chun amahi mi thumho lah a apan lou vang'in somthum ho sang in, jana sangtah ana chang in chule David in ama vengtup a lamkai din apan sah tan ahi.
en: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.
text:
1CH 11:25
Thadou: Hiti chun amahi mi thumho lah a apan lou vang'in somthum ho sang in, jana sangtah ana chang in chule David in ama vengtup a lamkai din apan sah tan ahi.
English: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.

tcz: David sepai mihat ho chu ahileh Joab sopipa Asahel toh Bethlehem kho a kon Dodo chapa Elha'nan toh ahiuve.
en: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
text:
1CH 11:26
Thadou: David sepai mihat ho chu ahileh Joab sopipa Asahel toh Bethlehem kho a kon Dodo chapa Elha'nan toh ahiuve.
English: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

tcz: Harod kho kon Shammoth le Pelon mi Helez jong ahi.
en: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
text:
1CH 11:27
Thadou: Harod kho kon Shammoth le Pelon mi Helez jong ahi.
English: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

tcz: Teko'a khoa Ikkesh chapa Ira jong ahin, Anathoth kho a mi Abi-zer jong ahi.
en: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
text:
1CH 11:28
Thadou: Teko'a khoa Ikkesh chapa Ira jong ahin, Anathoth kho a mi Abi-zer jong ahi.
English: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

tcz: Hushath mi Sibbecai ahin Ahoh kho a kon Ilai jong ahi.
en: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
text:
1CH 11:29
Thadou: Hushath mi Sibbecai ahin Ahoh kho a kon Ilai jong ahi.
English: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

tcz: Netoph'ah mi Ma'harai ahin, Netophiah mi Ba'anah chapa Heled jong ahi.
en: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
text:
1CH 11:30
Thadou: Netoph'ah mi Ma'harai ahin, Netophiah mi Ba'anah chapa Heled jong ahi.
English: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

tcz: Benjamin chate gamsung Gib'eah kho a Ribai chapa Ithai jong ahin, chule Pirathon kho a kon Bena'iah jong ahi.
en: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
text:
1CH 11:31
Thadou: Benjamin chate gamsung Gib'eah kho a Ribai chapa Ithai jong ahin, chule Pirathon kho a kon Bena'iah jong ahi.
English: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

tcz: Gash luidung a kon Hurai jong ahin, Ar'bath kho a kon Abi'el jong ahi.
en: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
text:
1CH 11:32
Thadou: Gash luidung a kon Hurai jong ahin, Ar'bath kho a kon Abi'el jong ahi.
English: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

tcz: Baha'rum khoa mi Az'maveth jong ahin, Sha'al'bon kho a mi Eli'ahba jong ahi;
en: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

tcz: Gizon kho a kon Hashem ahin, Harar khoa mi Shagee chapa Jonathan jong ahi,
en: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,
text:
1CH 11:34
Thadou: Gizon kho a kon Hashem ahin, Harar khoa mi Shagee chapa Jonathan jong ahi,
English: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,

tcz: Harar khoa mi mama Sachar chapa Ahi'am ahin, Ur chapa Eli'phal jong ahi;
en: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

tcz: Mecherath kho a mi Hepher ahin, Pelon mi Ahi'jah jong ahi,
en: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
text:
1CH 11:36
Thadou: Mecherath kho a mi Hepher ahin, Pelon mi Ahi'jah jong ahi,
English: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

tcz: Carmel kho a Hezro ahin,Ezbai chapa Na'arai ahi,
en: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
text:
1CH 11:37
Thadou: Carmel kho a Hezro ahin,Ezbai chapa Na'arai ahi,
English: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

tcz: Nathan sopipa Jo'el ahin,Hagri chapa Mibhar ahi,
en: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
text:
1CH 11:38
Thadou: Nathan sopipa Jo'el ahin,Hagri chapa Mibhar ahi,
English: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

tcz: Ammon mi Zelek ahin, Be'eroth kho mi Na'harai ahi, amahi Zeru'iah chapa galvonpoa pang ahi,
en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),
text:
1CH 11:39
Thadou: Ammon mi Zelek ahin, Be'eroth kho mi Na'harai ahi, amahi Zeru'iah chapa galvonpoa pang ahi,
English: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),

tcz: Ithir kho kon Ira ahin, Ithir kho a mi ma ma Gareb ahi;
en: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

tcz: Hit mi Uri'ah ahin, Ahlai chapa Zabad jong ahi ,
en: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
text:
1CH 11:41
Thadou: Hit mi Uri'ah ahin, Ahlai chapa Zabad jong ahi ,
English: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

tcz: Reuben phung a kon Shiza chapa Ad'ina ahin, ama jong hi Reuben chate lah a lamkai khat ahin, Sepai som thum apui ye,
en: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,
text:
1CH 11:42
Thadou: Reuben phung a kon Shiza chapa Ad'ina ahin, ama jong hi Reuben chate lah a lamkai khat ahin, Sepai som thum apui ye,
English: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,

tcz: Maacah chapa Hanan ahin,Mathan mi Josh'aphat ahi,
en: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,
text:
1CH 11:43
Thadou: Maacah chapa Hanan ahin,Mathan mi Josh'aphat ahi,
English: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

tcz: Asterath kho a mi Uzzi'a ahin Aro'er mi Shama le Je-i-el ahilhon e,
en: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
text:
1CH 11:44
Thadou: Asterath kho a mi Uzzi'a ahin Aro'er mi Shama le Je-i-el ahilhon e,
English: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

tcz: Shimri chapa Jedi'a-el le asopipa Joha ahilhon in, Tiz kho mi ahi cheh lhon e,
en: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
text:
1CH 11:45
Thadou: Shimri chapa Jedi'a-el le asopipa Joha ahilhon in, Tiz kho mi ahi cheh lhon e,
English: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

tcz: Mahav mi Eli'el ahin, chule El'na-am chapa teni Jer'ibai le Joshavi'ah ahilhon e, chule Moab mi Ithmah jong ahi,
en: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
text:
1CH 11:46
Thadou: Mahav mi Eli'el ahin, chule El'na-am chapa teni Jer'ibai le Joshavi'ah ahilhon e, chule Moab mi Ithmah jong ahi,
English: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

tcz: Chujongle Mezoba kho mi Eli'el le Obed toh chule Ja-asi'el ahiuve.
en: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
text:
1CH 11:47
Thadou: Chujongle Mezoba kho mi Eli'el le Obed toh chule Ja-asi'el ahiuve.
English: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

tcz: Kish chapa Saul kom Ziklag mun a ana kisel lai a David toh ana umkhom ho chu galhang mi David toh gal anasat khom ho chu ahiuve.
