en: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
text:
1CH 12:1
Thadou: Kish chapa Saul kom Ziklag mun a ana kisel lai a David toh ana umkhom ho chu galhang mi David toh gal anasat khom ho chu ahiuve.
English: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.

tcz: Hiche miho hi Benjamin phung a kon Saul sopite ahiuvin thalpi kap them cheh chule akhut jetle vei mangcha thei a songchang bom kap them cheh mi ahiu ve.
en: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.
text:
1CH 12:2
Thadou: Hiche miho hi Benjamin phung a kon Saul sopite ahiuvin thalpi kap them cheh chule akhut jetle vei mangcha thei a songchang bom kap them cheh mi ahiu ve.
English: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.

tcz: Gabiah mi Shemah chapa Ahiezar hi amaho dia lamkai pipu pen ahin amanoi bantah a lamkai chu Joash ahi. Chule Azmaoth chapateni Pelet le Jeziel, Bareah le Anathoth kho a kon Jehu jong ahi.
en: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

tcz: Gebeon a kon Ishmiah kitipa hi galhang somthum ho lah a lamkai le kinthang pen ahi. Chule Gederah kho a kon Jerrmiah, Jahaziel, Johanan le Jozabad ahiuve.
en: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;

tcz: Haruph kho a kon Eluzai, Jeremoth, Beliah, Shemariah le Sephatiah ahiuve.
en: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;

tcz: Korahites phung a kon Elkanah , Issiah, Azarel, Joezor le Jashobeam ahi.
en: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;

tcz: Gedor a kon Jeroham chapateni Joelah le Zebediah ahi.
en: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
text:
1CH 12:7
Thadou: Gedor a kon Jeroham chapateni Joelah le Zebediah ahi.
English: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

tcz: David gamthip noi kulpi a anaum laiyin Gad nammite galhang galbol them cheh ho chun ana pan piu vin ahi. Amaho chu lumchoije le tengcha kho themcheh Keipi bahkai bang a gin umtah chule sakhi golpai bang a chom jangkhai jeng ahiuve.
en: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:
text:
1CH 12:8
Thadou: David gamthip noi kulpi a anaum laiyin Gad nammite galhang galbol them cheh ho chun ana pan piu vin ahi. Amaho chu lumchoije le tengcha kho themcheh Keipi bahkai bang a gin umtah chule sakhi golpai bang a chom jangkhai jeng ahiuve.
English: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:

tcz: Ezer chu lamkai pipu pen ahin anichan na chu Obadiah ahin, athum chan na chu Eliab ahi.
en: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
text:
1CH 12:9
Thadou: Ezer chu lamkai pipu pen ahin anichan na chu Obadiah ahin, athum chan na chu Eliab ahi.
English: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

tcz: Mishmamnah chu ali chan na ahin chule Jeremiah chu angana ahi.
en: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
text:
1CH 12:10
Thadou: Mishmamnah chu ali chan na ahin chule Jeremiah chu angana ahi.
English: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

tcz: Agup channa chu Attai ahin, chule sagi chan na chu Eliel ahi.
en: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
text:
1CH 12:11
Thadou: Agup channa chu Attai ahin, chule sagi chan na chu Eliel ahi.
English: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

tcz: Aget channa chu Johanan ahin chule ako channa chu Elzabed ahi.
en: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
text:
1CH 12:12
Thadou: Aget channa chu Johanan ahin chule ako channa chu Elzabed ahi.
English: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

tcz: Jeremiah chu asom channa ahin, Macbannai chu somle khat chan na ahi.
en: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.
text:
1CH 12:13
Thadou: Jeremiah chu asom channa ahin, Macbannai chu somle khat chan na ahi.
English: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.

tcz: Amaho hi Gad mite galhang lamkai pipu cheh ngen ahiuvin ahi. Chule anem nung pen chu sepai jakhat ahiuvin asang jo pen ho chu sangkhat vel ahiuve .
en: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.
text:
1CH 12:14
Thadou: Amaho hi Gad mite galhang lamkai pipu cheh ngen ahiuvin ahi. Chule anem nung pen chu sepai jakhat ahiuvin asang jo pen ho chu sangkhat vel ahiuve .
English: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.

tcz: Hiche mite ho chu kum kihei kumbul a Jordan vadung letlha hel la twi hunglon chun vapam achen nao mun a kon in solam le lhumlam gam a ana homkhen uvin ahi.
en: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.
text:
1CH 12:15
Thadou: Hiche mite ho chu kum kihei kumbul a Jordan vadung letlha hel la twi hunglon chun vapam achen nao mun a kon in solam le lhumlam gam a ana homkhen uvin ahi.
English: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.

tcz: Chule adangho Benjamin le Judah phung mite chu David kulpi a chun ahung un ahi.
en: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.
text:
1CH 12:16
Thadou: Chule adangho Benjamin le Judah phung mite chu David kulpi a chun ahung un ahi.
English: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

tcz: Chuin David jong amaho kimu pin ahung pot in, hitin asei e. Kipah tah a keima kithopi dia hung nahiu le eiho loikhat ihiuve. Amavang kagal mite angsung a keima pedoh ding a hung nahiule vang kapului-u Pathen in nangho chunga gotna napeh diu ahi.
en: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”
text:
1CH 12:17
Thadou: Chuin David jong amaho kimu pin ahung pot in, hitin asei e. Kipah tah a keima kithopi dia hung nahiu le eiho loikhat ihiuve. Amavang kagal mite angsung a keima pedoh ding a hung nahiule vang kapului-u Pathen in nangho chunga gotna napeh diu ahi.
English: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”

tcz: Chuin Amasai kitipa somthum ho lah a lamkai pachu lhagao houpi na achangin hitin asei e, “Jesse chapa David keiho nang a kahiuve, nagma lam a pang ding kahiuve, chamnale phatthei nan najui jing hen chule nangma nakithopi jouse jong lolhing uhen ajehchu Pathen in nangma napanpi ahi.” Hitichun David in amaho chu akiloipin asepaite chung a lamkai ding in jong apansah tan ahi.
en: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.
text:
1CH 12:18
Thadou: Chuin Amasai kitipa somthum ho lah a lamkai pachu lhagao houpi na achangin hitin asei e, “Jesse chapa David keiho nang a kahiuve, nagma lam a pang ding kahiuve, chamnale phatthei nan najui jing hen chule nangma nakithopi jouse jong lolhing uhen ajehchu Pathen in nangma napanpi ahi.” Hitichun David in amaho chu akiloipin asepaite chung a lamkai ding in jong apansah tan ahi.
English: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

tcz: David Philistine te toh kithokhom a gal ana konlai chun Manasseh chate Israel sepai ten jong ana pan piu vin ahi. Ahivang in Philistine sepai lamkai ho chun David hi nikhokhat le Saul lang joh a hung pang a eiho suh gam le elol u tan a hung pang thei ahi atiuvin David toh kilhon khom jing chu ana nom tapouvin anasol mang tauve.
en: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”
text:
1CH 12:19
Thadou: David Philistine te toh kithokhom a gal ana konlai chun Manasseh chate Israel sepai ten jong ana pan piu vin ahi. Ahivang in Philistine sepai lamkai ho chun David hi nikhokhat le Saul lang joh a hung pang a eiho suh gam le elol u tan a hung pang thei ahi atiuvin David toh kilhon khom jing chu ana nom tapouvin anasol mang tauve.
English: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”

tcz: David ziglak a ana kile Manasseh chaten David anajop ho chu ahile Adnah , Jozbed, Jedial, Michael Jozabed , Elihu le Zillethai ahiuve. Amaho lamkai nanoi a Manasseh phung a kon sepai mi sangkhat ahiuve.
en: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.
text:
1CH 12:20
Thadou: David ziglak a ana kile Manasseh chaten David anajop ho chu ahile Adnah , Jozbed, Jedial, Michael Jozabed , Elihu le Zillethai ahiuve. Amaho lamkai nanoi a Manasseh phung a kon sepai mi sangkhat ahiuve.
English: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.

tcz: Hiti chun amaho hin David chung a gal hinbol gamho jouse chu hatah in ana dou un ana kisat piuvin ahi. Chule amahohi mihangsan tah galhang lamkai thei cheh ahiuvin ahi.
en: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.
text:
1CH 12:21
Thadou: Hiti chun amaho hin David chung a gal hinbol gamho jouse chu hatah in ana dou un ana kisat piuvin ahi. Chule amahohi mihangsan tah galhang lamkai thei cheh ahiuvin ahi.
English: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.

tcz: Chule aniseh in David lang a pang ding le akithopi ding sepai akibe jing in, Pathen sepai tampi bang a ahung umdoh kahsen mi ahung kikhom jing e.
en: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.
text:
1CH 12:22
Thadou: Chule aniseh in David lang a pang ding le akithopi ding sepai akibe jing in, Pathen sepai tampi bang a ahung umdoh kahsen mi ahung kikhom jing e.
English: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.

tcz: Pakai thupeh dungjui a saul lenggam vaipohna pumpi David chansah ding a Hebron khopia hung kikhom doh sepai ami mong monga akihop jat-u hicheng hi ana hiuve.
en: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the LORD’s word.
text:
1CH 12:23
Thadou: Pakai thupeh dungjui a saul lenggam vaipohna pumpi David chansah ding a Hebron khopia hung kikhom doh sepai ami mong monga akihop jat-u hicheng hi ana hiuve.
English: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the LORD’s word.

tcz: Juda phung sung a kon galvon le tengcha thothei cheh mi sang gup le jaget alhing e.
en: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.
text:
1CH 12:24
Thadou: Juda phung sung a kon galvon le tengcha thothei cheh mi sang gup le jaget alhing e.
English: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.

tcz: Chule Simeon phung a galhang galsat thei cheh agom a mi sang sagi le jakhat alhing e.
en: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.
text:
1CH 12:25
Thadou: Chule Simeon phung a galhang galsat thei cheh agom a mi sang sagi le jakhat alhing e.
English: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.

tcz: Levi phung a kon galhang mi sangli le jagup alhing in ahi.
en: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.
text:
1CH 12:26
Thadou: Levi phung a kon galhang mi sangli le jagup alhing in ahi.
English: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.

tcz: Hichea hin Aaron insung a kon Jehoaida lamkai nanoi a mi sangthum le jasagi alhing e.
en: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,
text:
1CH 12:27
Thadou: Hichea hin Aaron insung a kon Jehoaida lamkai nanoi a mi sangthum le jasagi alhing e.
English: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,

tcz: Chule Zadok kiti galbol mihang santah insung a kon in jong gallamkai cheh mi somni le ni alhing e.
en: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.
text:
1CH 12:28
Thadou: Chule Zadok kiti galbol mihang santah insung a kon in jong gallamkai cheh mi somni le ni alhing e.
English: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.

tcz: Benjamin phung a kon a Saul inkote galsat sepai mi sangthum ahiuvin chule amaho lah a atam jo hi Benjamin insungmi a kon Saul lam a pang ana hi jing uve.
en: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.
text:
1CH 12:29
Thadou: Benjamin phung a kon a Saul inkote galsat sepai mi sangthum ahiuvin chule amaho lah a atam jo hi Benjamin insungmi a kon Saul lam a pang ana hi jing uve.
English: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.

tcz: Ephriam phung a kon in jong galsat hangsan tah mi sang somnile get alhing in chule ama hung kondoh na phunggui sung a dia jong jaum tah le mi minthang cheh ahiuve.
en: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.
text:
1CH 12:30
Thadou: Ephriam phung a kon in jong galsat hangsan tah mi sang somnile get alhing in chule ama hung kondoh na phunggui sung a dia jong jaum tah le mi minthang cheh ahiuve.
English: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.

tcz: Manasseh namkeh khat Jordan lhumlam a kon sepai sang somle sang get umho chun David leng ahung hi nading in ana kitho piu vin ahi.
en: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
text:
1CH 12:31
Thadou: Manasseh namkeh khat Jordan lhumlam a kon sepai sang somle sang get umho chun David leng ahung hi nading in ana kitho piu vin ahi.
English: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.

tcz: Issachar mite le a insungmi a kon in jong lamkai mi jani ana lhing e. Hiche miho jouse hi Israel te chung a thil hunglhung ding le phat kihei dan ho hetthem nanei cheh mi ahiuve.
en: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.
text:
1CH 12:32
Thadou: Issachar mite le a insungmi a kon in jong lamkai mi jani ana lhing e. Hiche miho jouse hi Israel te chung a thil hunglhung ding le phat kihei dan ho hetthem nanei cheh mi ahiuve.
English: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.

tcz: Zebulun phung a kon in jong galbol a them tah galhang sepai mi sang nga alhing e. Amaho hi David toh kitho khom a galsat dia galman chah toh kigo sa cheh ahiu vin ahi.
en: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.
text:
1CH 12:33
Thadou: Zebulun phung a kon in jong galbol a them tah galhang sepai mi sang nga alhing e. Amaho hi David toh kitho khom a galsat dia galman chah toh kigo sa cheh ahiu vin ahi.
English: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.

tcz: Naphtali phung a kon in jong galhang cheh galman chah lhingset a lumpho le tengcha mangcha thei sepai lamkai mi sangkhat le galsat sepai mi sangthum le jasagi alhing uve.
en: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.
text:
1CH 12:34
Thadou: Naphtali phung a kon in jong galhang cheh galman chah lhingset a lumpho le tengcha mangcha thei sepai lamkai mi sangkhat le galsat sepai mi sangthum le jasagi alhing uve.
English: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.

tcz: Dan phung sung a kon in jong galmun a dia kigo sadem a galsat ding mi sang somni le sang get le jagup alhing uve.
en: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.
text:
1CH 12:35
Thadou: Dan phung sung a kon in jong galmun a dia kigo sadem a galsat ding mi sang somni le sang get le jagup alhing uve.
English: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

tcz: Asher phung a kon in jong galbol dan kichuh sepai sang somli jong galsat dia kigo sa ahiuve.
en: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.
text:
1CH 12:36
Thadou: Asher phung a kon in jong galbol dan kichuh sepai sang somli jong galsat dia kigo sa ahiuve.
English: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.

tcz: Chule Jordan vadung nisolam a kon in jong Gad mite le Reuben phung mite chule Manasseh nam kehkhat chu galsat dia manchah chom cheh kichoi lhingset sepai mi sang jakhat le sang somni alhing uve.
en: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.
text:
1CH 12:37
Thadou: Chule Jordan vadung nisolam a kon in jong Gad mite le Reuben phung mite chule Manasseh nam kehkhat chu galsat dia manchah chom cheh kichoi lhingset sepai mi sang jakhat le sang somni alhing uve.
English: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.

tcz: Hebron mun hinjon a galsat dia kigosadem a um sepai tampi ho ahiuvin chule Isareal mipi jousen jong David chu Isareal pumpia a leng ding in adeisah soh kei uve.
en: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
text:
1CH 12:38
Thadou: Hebron mun hinjon a galsat dia kigosadem a um sepai tampi ho ahiuvin chule Isareal mipi jousen jong David chu Isareal pumpia a leng ding in adeisah soh kei uve.
English: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

tcz: Chuin ainsungmi asopiten David chu vailhun na ding thil ijakai agong toh uvin nithum sung in David toh ann nehkhom le lengpitwi donkhom na anei uve.
en: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.
text:
1CH 12:39
Thadou: Chuin ainsungmi asopiten David chu vailhun na ding thil ijakai agong toh uvin nithum sung in David toh ann nehkhom le lengpitwi donkhom na anei uve.
English: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.

tcz: Avel a um Isachar, Zebulun le Naphtali ho cheng in jong sangan le sangongsao chule sakol pol le bongchal ho chu neh ding poh nan amang chaovin ahi. Chule nehding don ding changlhah hihen theichang ga changlhah, bongchal, kelngoi le kelcha ho geiyin golnop bol nadin ahinpolut uvin ahi. Hichu Israel pumpia ding a kipa golnop loupi tah ana hin ahi.
en: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.
text:
1CH 12:40
Thadou: Avel a um Isachar, Zebulun le Naphtali ho cheng in jong sangan le sangongsao chule sakol pol le bongchal ho chu neh ding poh nan amang chaovin ahi. Chule nehding don ding changlhah hihen theichang ga changlhah, bongchal, kelngoi le kelcha ho geiyin golnop bol nadin ahinpolut uvin ahi. Hichu Israel pumpia ding a kipa golnop loupi tah ana hin ahi.
English: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.

tcz: David in asepai sangkhat chung a lamkai hole jakhat chung a lamkai ho chu thu adong toh soh kei in ahi.
en: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.
text:
1CH 13:1
Thadou: David in asepai sangkhat chung a lamkai hole jakhat chung a lamkai ho chu thu adong toh soh kei in ahi.
English: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.

tcz: Chuin aman Israel mite jouse kom a chun hitin asei e, “Nangho le Pakai Pathen lunglam ahile Israel mite chenna jouse a Thempu ho le levi mite jaona a ibon chaova iki-khop khom soh theina diu vin thu lhangsapna nei u hite,” ati.
en: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of the LORD our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.
text:
1CH 13:2
Thadou: Chuin aman Israel mite jouse kom a chun hitin asei e, “Nangho le Pakai Pathen lunglam ahile Israel mite chenna jouse a Thempu ho le levi mite jaona a ibon chaova iki-khop khom soh theina diu vin thu lhangsapna nei u hite,” ati.
English: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of the LORD our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.

tcz: Saul lengvai poh lai in Pathen kitepna thingkong chu nahsah mon ana umjongleh tuhi anung lahphat tah chu ahi.
en: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”
text:
1CH 13:3
Thadou: Saul lengvai poh lai in Pathen kitepna thingkong chu nahsah mon ana umjongleh tuhi anung lahphat tah chu ahi.
English: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

tcz: Akihoukhom mipi jousen hichu pha asah utoh kilhon in abon chaovin boldin kinopto na anei taove.
en: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
text:
1CH 13:4
Thadou: Akihoukhom mipi jousen hichu pha asah utoh kilhon in abon chaovin boldin kinopto na anei taove.
English: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

tcz: Hitichun David in Pathen thingkong chu nung put lut kit na ding in Kiriath Jeriam mun a kon in muntin a Israel mite aumnao Egypt lhanglam gam shehor vadung a pat chule sahlam gam Lebohamath khopi vel dung a kon abon'uva ahung kikhop khom nadiu vin kouna anei in ahi.
en: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.
text:
1CH 13:5
Thadou: Hitichun David in Pathen thingkong chu nung put lut kit na ding in Kiriath Jeriam mun a kon in muntin a Israel mite aumnao Egypt lhanglam gam shehor vadung a pat chule sahlam gam Lebohamath khopi vel dung a kon abon'uva ahung kikhop khom nadiu vin kouna anei in ahi.
English: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.

tcz: Pathen thingkong nunglah kit nading in David le Israel mite chun Judah gam Baalah Kiriath jeriam tiajong kikou mun a chun ana cheu vin ahi.
en: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.
text:
1CH 13:6
Thadou: Pathen thingkong nunglah kit nading in David le Israel mite chun Judah gam Baalah Kiriath jeriam tiajong kikou mun a chun ana cheu vin ahi.
English: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

tcz: Chuin amahon Pathen thingkong chu Abinadab insung a kon in ahin la doh un bongkang thah leh a akoi uve. Chule hiche bongkang chu Uzzah le Ahio tenin ahin tol lhon in ahi.
en: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
text:
1CH 13:7
Thadou: Chuin amahon Pathen thingkong chu Abinadab insung a kon in ahin la doh un bongkang thah leh a akoi uve. Chule hiche bongkang chu Uzzah le Ahio tenin ahin tol lhon in ahi.
English: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

tcz: Hichun David le Israel mipite chun Pathen ang ah kipah le thanom tah in la asauvin, selangdah le semjang asaiyun, khongle dah chule kipa khutbeh toh thon saki pengkul ana mut uvin ahi.
en: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.
text:
1CH 13:8
Thadou: Hichun David le Israel mipite chun Pathen ang ah kipah le thanom tah in la asauvin, selangdah le semjang asaiyun, khongle dah chule kipa khutbeh toh thon saki pengkul ana mut uvin ahi.
English: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.

tcz: Ahivang in amahon Nacon changphol lai ahin phah u chun bongchal chu ahung kipal lhun Uzzah in Pathen thingkong chu tuh ding in akhut ana lhang in ahi.
en: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
text:
1CH 13:9
Thadou: Ahivang in amahon Nacon changphol lai ahin phah u chun bongchal chu ahung kipal lhun Uzzah in Pathen thingkong chu tuh ding in akhut ana lhang in ahi.
English: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

tcz: Uzzah in Pathen thingkong chung a akhut ajah a pat in achung a Pakai lunghan na ana chutan hijeh chun Pathen in Uzzah adeng in ama angsung a ana thiden tan ahi.
en: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
text:
1CH 13:10
Thadou: Uzzah in Pathen thingkong chung a akhut ajah a pat in achung a Pakai lunghan na ana chutan hijeh chun Pathen in Uzzah adeng in ama angsung a ana thiden tan ahi.
English: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

tcz: Pakai in Uzzah chung a alunghan na aphon jal jeh chun David jong analung nalheh jeng in ahi. Hijeh chun David in hilai mun chu Perez- Uzzah asah in ahi, hichu Uzzah kisuh gep namun tin tuni gei in akikou in ahi.
en: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
text:
1CH 13:11
Thadou: Pakai in Uzzah chung a alunghan na aphon jal jeh chun David jong analung nalheh jeng in ahi. Hijeh chun David in hilai mun chu Perez- Uzzah asah in ahi, hichu Uzzah kisuh gep namun tin tuni gei in akikou in ahi.
English: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

tcz: Chule David kicha tah a aumphat chun Pathen adong in aseitai. Pathen thing kong chu eti keiman kaga nunglah kit a kakom a kakoi ngam ding ham ati.
en: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”
text:
1CH 13:12
Thadou: Chule David kicha tah a aumphat chun Pathen adong in aseitai. Pathen thing kong chu eti keiman kaga nunglah kit a kakom a kakoi ngam ding ham ati.
English: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”

tcz: Hijeh chun David injong Pathen thingkong chu David khopia poh lut joh sangin Gath mipa Obed-edom insung a analhut jotan ahi.
en: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
text:
1CH 13:13
Thadou: Hijeh chun David injong Pathen thingkong chu David khopia poh lut joh sangin Gath mipa Obed-edom insung a analhut jotan ahi.
English: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen thingkong chu lhathum Obed-edom insung a ana umden in hiche sung chun Pakai in Obed-edom insung mite chu anatoh nalam cheh uva phatthei anaboh in ahi.
en: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.
text:
1CH 13:14
Thadou: Hiti chun Pathen thingkong chu lhathum Obed-edom insung a ana umden in hiche sung chun Pakai in Obed-edom insung mite chu anatoh nalam cheh uva phatthei anaboh in ahi.
English: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.

tcz: Tyre gam a leng Hiram in asottole a pang thingthem bol le songkhen them ho chu Cedar thing ho a David inpi sah pih ding in ana sol in ahi.
en: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
text:
1CH 14:1
Thadou: Tyre gam a leng Hiram in asottole a pang thingthem bol le songkhen them ho chu Cedar thing ho a David inpi sah pih ding in ana sol in ahi.
English: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

tcz: Chule Pakai in israel pumpi a lengdia atun a amite Israelte ding a aleng gam phatthei na aboh chu David in jong ana geldoh tan ahi.
en: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.
text:
1CH 14:2
Thadou: Chule Pakai in israel pumpi a lengdia atun a amite Israelte ding a aleng gam phatthei na aboh chu David in jong ana geldoh tan ahi.
English: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.

tcz: Chujouvin David in Jerusalem a chun ji akipui be in chanu le chapa jong tampi anei kit in ahi.
en: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.
text:
1CH 14:3
Thadou: Chujouvin David in Jerusalem a chun ji akipui be in chanu le chapa jong tampi anei kit in ahi.
English: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.

tcz: Amaho hi David in Jerusalem’a anahinsa achapate chu ahiuve: Shammu, Sobad, Nathan, Solomon
en: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
text:
1CH 14:4
Thadou: Amaho hi David in Jerusalem’a anahinsa achapate chu ahiuve: Shammu, Sobad, Nathan, Solomon
English: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

tcz: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet
en: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
text:
1CH 14:5
Thadou: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet
English: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

tcz: Noqah, Nepheg, Japhia
en: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
text:
1CH 14:6
Thadou: Noqah, Nepheg, Japhia
English: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

tcz: Elishma, Beeliada chule Eliphelet ahiuve.
en: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
text:
1CH 14:7
Thadou: Elishma, Beeliada chule Eliphelet ahiuve.
English: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

tcz: David Israel pumpia a leng chan ding chu Philistine miten ajah phat uvin Philistine sepai ho chu David man ding in ahung kon uvin ahi, David in jong hiche thu ajah phat chun ama ho kimaito pi din akondoh pai kit in ahi.
en: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.
text:
1CH 14:8
Thadou: David Israel pumpia a leng chan ding chu Philistine miten ajah phat uvin Philistine sepai ho chu David man ding in ahung kon uvin ahi, David in jong hiche thu ajah phat chun ama ho kimaito pi din akondoh pai kit in ahi.
English: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.

tcz: Hiti chun philistine sepai ho chun gang tah in Raphiam phaicham chu ahin nokhum pai jeng un ahi.
en: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
text:
1CH 14:9
Thadou: Hiti chun philistine sepai ho chun gang tah in Raphiam phaicham chu ahin nokhum pai jeng un ahi.
English: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

tcz: Hichun David in Pathen adong in, “Hiche Philistine te khu gasat leng achung'uva galjona neichan sah ding ham?” ati. Chuin Pakai in adonbut in, “Chenlang gasat in achung'uva galjo na nachan ding ahi,” ati.
en: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”
text:
1CH 14:10
Thadou: Hichun David in Pathen adong in, “Hiche Philistine te khu gasat leng achung'uva galjona neichan sah ding ham?” ati. Chuin Pakai in adonbut in, “Chenlang gasat in achung'uva galjo na nachan ding ahi,” ati.
English: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”

tcz: Hichun David le asepai techu Baal-Perazim lam jon in akitol uvin Philistine techu agasat uvin ana jou tauve. Chuin David in hitin asei e, “Pathen in kamelmate chung a twisuh long bang a kalonkhum na din eina mang chai,” ati. Hijehchun hichelai mun hi Baal-perazam ana kisah in ahi.
en: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
text:
1CH 14:11
Thadou: Hichun David le asepai techu Baal-Perazim lam jon in akitol uvin Philistine techu agasat uvin ana jou tauve. Chuin David in hitin asei e, “Pathen in kamelmate chung a twisuh long bang a kalonkhum na din eina mang chai,” ati. Hijehchun hichelai mun hi Baal-perazam ana kisah in ahi.
English: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

tcz: Chuin Philistine te anajam uvin milim doi Pathen semthu ana dalhah hou chu David in ana hal vam sah in ahi.
en: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.
text:
1CH 14:12
Thadou: Chuin Philistine te anajam uvin milim doi Pathen semthu ana dalhah hou chu David in ana hal vam sah in ahi.
English: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.

tcz: Ahivang in Philistine techun hetman lou kah in phaicham chu ahin nokhum paikit uvin ahi.
en: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.
text:
1CH 14:13
Thadou: Ahivang in Philistine techun hetman lou kah in phaicham chu ahin nokhum paikit uvin ahi.
English: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

tcz: Hijeh chun David injong ipi bol ding hitam tin Pathen adong kit in ahile Pathen in amaho nungjui kit lou in amasang lam uva kon a ahinle del khum a balsom thingphung a hinno khum un tin asei e.
en: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.
text:
1CH 14:14
Thadou: Hijeh chun David injong ipi bol ding hitam tin Pathen adong kit in ahile Pathen in amaho nungjui kit lou in amasang lam uva kon a ahinle del khum a balsom thingphung a hinno khum un tin asei e.
English: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.

tcz: Nangman thingleh vum lang a pat mitampi kijot kengto gin najah teng pot inlang galsat pan jeng in ajeh chu Pathen in Philistine sepaite satgam nadia nangma nahin panpi ding chu avetsah ahi.
en: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”
text:
1CH 14:15
Thadou: Nangman thingleh vum lang a pat mitampi kijot kengto gin najah teng pot inlang galsat pan jeng in ajeh chu Pathen in Philistine sepaite satgam nadia nangma nahin panpi ding chu avetsah ahi.
English: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

tcz: Hitichun David in jong Pathen thupeh bang in abollin ahile Philistine sepaite chu Gibeon a kipat in Gezer chan in ana del jam suh in ahi.
en: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
text:
1CH 14:16
Thadou: Hitichun David in jong Pathen thupeh bang in abollin ahile Philistine sepaite chu Gibeon a kipat in Gezer chan in ana del jam suh in ahi.
English: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

tcz: Chuin muntin jousea David ahung minthan phat in Pakai in David chu namjouse te ginle ja in aum sah tan ahi.
en: The fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.
text:
1CH 14:17
Thadou: Chuin muntin jousea David ahung minthan phat in Pakai in David chu namjouse te ginle ja in aum sah tan ahi.
English: The fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.

tcz: David in akhopi a chun injong tampi anasa in chule Pathen thingkong koi nading jong ponbuh phatah ana song in ahi.
en: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.
text:
1CH 15:1
Thadou: David in akhopi a chun injong tampi anasa in chule Pathen thingkong koi nading jong ponbuh phatah ana song in ahi.
English: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.

tcz: Hichun David in hitin asei e Pathen thingkong pudia chu Pakai deilhen Levi mite tailou chu akin bol a pangthei lou ding ahi ati.
en: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For the LORD has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”
text:
1CH 15:2
Thadou: Hichun David in hitin asei e Pathen thingkong pudia chu Pakai deilhen Levi mite tailou chu akin bol a pangthei lou ding ahi ati.
English: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For the LORD has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”

tcz: Hichun David in Pakai thingkong koina dingmun semna a pulut ding in Jerusalem khopi a um Israel mite chu ana kou in ahi.
en: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the LORD’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
text:
1CH 15:3
Thadou: Hichun David in Pakai thingkong koina dingmun semna a pulut ding in Jerusalem khopi a um Israel mite chu ana kou in ahi.
English: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the LORD’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.

tcz: Hiche a anakikou miho chu ahile Aaron thempu le Levi chate ho ahiuve.
en: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
text:
1CH 15:4
Thadou: Hiche a anakikou miho chu ahile Aaron thempu le Levi chate ho ahiuve.
English: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:

tcz: Uriel lamkai na akon in Kohath nambah ami jakhat le somni ahin ,
en: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;

tcz: Asaiah lamkai na a Meraei nambah akon mi janile somni ahi,
en: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;

tcz: Joel lamkai na akon Gerahon nambah mi jale somthum alhing uve,
en: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;

tcz: Elizaphan son chilhah akon Shemaiah lamkaina mi jani alhing e,
en: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;

tcz: Hebron son chilhah a kon Eliel lamkai na in mi somget alhing uve,
en: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;

tcz: Aminadab lamkai na in Uzziel chilhah techu mi jale somleni ma alhing uve.
en: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.
text:
1CH 15:10
Thadou: Aminadab lamkai na in Uzziel chilhah techu mi jale somleni ma alhing uve.
English: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.

tcz: Chuin David in thempu ho Zadok le Abiathar chule Levi mite lah a kon in Uriel, Asaiah, Joel ahin Shemaiah ahin Eliel le Aminadab ho chu akou khom soh keiyin ahi.
en: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,
text:
1CH 15:11
Thadou: Chuin David in thempu ho Zadok le Abiathar chule Levi mite lah a kon in Uriel, Asaiah, Joel ahin Shemaiah ahin Eliel le Aminadab ho chu akou khom soh keiyin ahi.
English: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,

tcz: David in amaho kom a chun hitin asei e; “Nangho Levi insung mite dia lamkai pipui nahiu ve. Hijeh chun Israel Pathen pakai thingkong chu akoina ding a kagotna mun a nahin nungput kit nadiu vin nang ho ahin chule nainsungmite cheng nabon un kisutheng un,” ati.
en: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.
text:
1CH 15:12
Thadou: David in amaho kom a chun hitin asei e; “Nangho Levi insung mite dia lamkai pipui nahiu ve. Hijeh chun Israel Pathen pakai thingkong chu akoina ding a kagotna mun a nahin nungput kit nadiu vin nang ho ahin chule nainsungmite cheng nabon un kisutheng un,” ati.
English: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.

tcz: Pakai ina-doh lou jeh’u chun Pakai vantil Pathen lunghan na ichung uva ana chu’in Levi mite chun thingkong chu nana pohlut thei lou-u ahi.
en: For because you didn’t carry it at first, the LORD our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”
text:
1CH 15:13
Thadou: Pakai ina-doh lou jeh’u chun Pakai vantil Pathen lunghan na ichung uva ana chu’in Levi mite chun thingkong chu nana pohlut thei lou-u ahi.
English: For because you didn’t carry it at first, the LORD our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”

tcz: Hijeh chun thempu ho le Levi mite jouse chun Israel Pathen Pakai thingkong Jerusalem mun’a putdoh nadin kilhai na ana nei uvin ahi.
en: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
text:
1CH 15:14
Thadou: Hijeh chun thempu ho le Levi mite jouse chun Israel Pathen Pakai thingkong Jerusalem mun’a putdoh nadin kilhai na ana nei uvin ahi.
English: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.

tcz: Chuin Pakai in Mose athuhil bang chun Levi miten Pathen thingkong chu moljol in alengkou un ahin pu uvin ahi.
en: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD’s word.
text:
1CH 15:15
Thadou: Chuin Pakai in Mose athuhil bang chun Levi miten Pathen thingkong chu moljol in alengkou un ahin pu uvin ahi.
English: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD’s word.

tcz: Hichun David in jong lamkai ho chu thu apen Levi mite lasathem le tumging them hon kipa lasah a tumging le semjang sai a khutbeh gintho ding in asei e.
en: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.
text:
1CH 15:16
Thadou: Hichun David in jong lamkai ho chu thu apen Levi mite lasathem le tumging them hon kipa lasah a tumging le semjang sai a khutbeh gintho ding in asei e.
English: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.

tcz: Chuin Levi hon jong Joel chapa Heman Levi tetoh sopi Merari nambah sung a kon Berekiah chapa ahin, Kushaiah chapa Ethan ho cheng ana pan sah uvin ahi.
en: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

tcz: Chule amaho noi bantah a ding in Zacharaiah, Zaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehid, Unni, Eliab, Bennaiah, Massaiah, Mattithiah, Eliphileh, Mikniah le kotkhah ngah a pang Obed-edom le Jeiel ho chu ana pansah uvin ahi.
en: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.
text:
1CH 15:18
Thadou: Chule amaho noi bantah a ding in Zacharaiah, Zaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehid, Unni, Eliab, Bennaiah, Massaiah, Mattithiah, Eliphileh, Mikniah le kotkhah ngah a pang Obed-edom le Jeiel ho chu ana pansah uvin ahi.
English: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.

tcz: Tumging them lah a Heman , Asaph le Ethan ho chu sumeng semjang sai ding in ana lheng uvin,
en: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;

tcz: Chule Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Measaiah le Benaiah ho cheng chu selang dah sai din ana lheng doh uvin ahi.
en: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;

tcz: Chule Mittithiah, Elipelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel chule Azaziah ho chu la aw lhingsetna sahna kimang semjang saidin apan sah uve.
en: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.
text:
1CH 15:21
Thadou: Chule Mittithiah, Elipelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel chule Azaziah ho chu la aw lhingsetna sahna kimang semjang saidin apan sah uve.
English: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.

tcz: Chuin Levite lah a lamkai Kenaiah hi lasah lambolthei tah ahijeh chun la lamkai din apan sah uve.
en: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.
text:
1CH 15:22
Thadou: Chuin Levite lah a lamkai Kenaiah hi lasah lambolthei tah ahijeh chun la lamkai din apan sah uve.
English: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.

tcz: Chule Pathen thingkong vengtup ding in Berekaiah le Elkanah chu ana pansah uve.
en: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
text:
1CH 15:23
Thadou: Chule Pathen thingkong vengtup ding in Berekaiah le Elkanah chu ana pansah uve.
English: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

tcz: Shebanaiah, Joshephat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zecharaiah, Beniah le Eliezer ho cheng hin Pathen thingkong mai a kitol uva saki a kisem pengkul amut diu ahi, chule Obed-edom le Jehiah chu Pathen thingkong kotngah in apan sah uve.
en: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
text:
1CH 15:24
Thadou: Shebanaiah, Joshephat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zecharaiah, Beniah le Eliezer ho cheng hin Pathen thingkong mai a kitol uva saki a kisem pengkul amut diu ahi, chule Obed-edom le Jehiah chu Pathen thingkong kotngah in apan sah uve.
English: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

tcz: David le Israel upate chule sepai lamkai pipuho chun Pakai kitepna thingkong chu Jerusalem a ahin pohlut a loupi tah a kipa pi ding in Obed-edom inpia chun ana cheuve.
en: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
text:
1CH 15:25
Thadou: David le Israel upate chule sepai lamkai pipuho chun Pakai kitepna thingkong chu Jerusalem a ahin pohlut a loupi tah a kipa pi ding in Obed-edom inpia chun ana cheuve.
English: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.

tcz: Chule Pathen in Levi mite akithopi a, amahon Pakai kitepna thingkong ahin pohlut jeh u chun bongchal sagi le kelngoi sagi kilhai nan anathat uve.
en: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
text:
1CH 15:26
Thadou: Chule Pathen in Levi mite akithopi a, amahon Pakai kitepna thingkong ahin pohlut jeh u chun bongchal sagi le kelngoi sagi kilhai nan anathat uve.
English: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

tcz: David le Levi mite Pakai thingkong pua pang ahin, lasa a pang ho le la lamkai Kenaniah ho chu tupat ponnem in ana kivon uve. David jong chun thempu ho lengban khat jong ana kiban in ahi.
en: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.
text:
1CH 15:27
Thadou: David le Levi mite Pakai thingkong pua pang ahin, lasa a pang ho le la lamkai Kenaniah ho chu tupat ponnem in ana kivon uve. David jong chun thempu ho lengban khat jong ana kiban in ahi.
English: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.

tcz: Hiti chun Israel mite chun kipana aw thong’a sampum le sumkon gin le saki mutgin chule khutbeh beng ginle semjang saiging tho in Pakai kitepna thingkong chu ahin pulut uvin ahi.
en: Thus all Israel brought the ark of the LORD’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.
text:
1CH 15:28
Thadou: Hiti chun Israel mite chun kipana aw thong’a sampum le sumkon gin le saki mutgin chule khutbeh beng ginle semjang saiging tho in Pakai kitepna thingkong chu ahin pulut uvin ahi.
English: Thus all Israel brought the ark of the LORD’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.

tcz: Pakai kitepna thingkong David khopia ahin pohlut u chun, Saul chanu Michal in in bang kot apat ahin vetsuh le leng David kipa thanop thoa achop le chu amun ana japi in ahi.
en: As the ark of the LORD’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
text:
1CH 15:29
Thadou: Pakai kitepna thingkong David khopia ahin pohlut u chun, Saul chanu Michal in in bang kot apat ahin vetsuh le leng David kipa thanop thoa achop le chu amun ana japi in ahi.
English: As the ark of the LORD’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.

tcz: Hichun amahon Pathen thingkong chu David in akoina dia ponbuh hoitah ason namun a chun ahin polut uvin ahi. Chua chun amahon Pathen a kilhai na pumgo thilto jong ana kat uvin ahi.
en: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
text:
1CH 16:1
Thadou: Hichun amahon Pathen thingkong chu David in akoina dia ponbuh hoitah ason namun a chun ahin polut uvin ahi. Chua chun amahon Pathen a kilhai na pumgo thilto jong ana kat uvin ahi.
English: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

tcz: David in kilhaina kin aneijou in amite chu Pakai min in phatthei aboh in ahi.
en: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.
text:
1CH 16:2
Thadou: David in kilhaina kin aneijou in amite chu Pakai min in phatthei aboh in ahi.
English: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.

tcz: Chujouvin aman ami Israel te numei pasal abonchauvin changlhah alhang a kisem ahin, lengpithei ga’a kisem nehthei ana peh ahi.
en: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
text:
1CH 16:3
Thadou: Chujouvin aman ami Israel te numei pasal abonchauvin changlhah alhang a kisem ahin, lengpithei ga’a kisem nehthei ana peh ahi.
English: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.

tcz: David in Levi mite chu Pakai thingkong maiya Israel Pathen Pakai phattheina sima, a vahchoi lasah le thangvah ding in mipi jouse lamkai din ana pansah e.
en: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:
text:
1CH 16:4
Thadou: David in Levi mite chu Pakai thingkong maiya Israel Pathen Pakai phattheina sima, a vahchoi lasah le thangvah ding in mipi jouse lamkai din ana pansah e.
English: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:

tcz: Asaph chu amaho lah a lamkai ahin, amahin lasah na a kimang tumging sumeng kivo ging asai yin ahi. Amaban tah’a chu Zechariah ahin chule ama kithopi ding in Jeiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom le Jeiel ahiuve. Amaho hi semjang le selangdah sai a pang ahiuve.
en: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

tcz: Chule Pathen thingkong kitepna masang a chun thempu Benaiah le Jahaziel chun tanglouvin sumkon ana mut lhon in ahi.
en: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
text:
1CH 16:6
Thadou: Chule Pathen thingkong kitepna masang a chun thempu Benaiah le Jahaziel chun tanglouvin sumkon ana mut lhon in ahi.
English: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

tcz: David in hiche nikho chun Asaph le ami Levite chutoh Pakai a kipa na thangvah na lasah na ana peu vin ahi.
en: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.
text:
1CH 16:7
Thadou: David in hiche nikho chun Asaph le ami Levite chutoh Pakai a kipa na thangvah na lasah na ana peu vin ahi.
English: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.

tcz: Pakai chu thangvah na peuvin chule aloupina seiphong uvin vannoi leiset pumpin athibol jouse hecheh hen,
en: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.
text:
1CH 16:8
Thadou: Pakai chu thangvah na peuvin chule aloupina seiphong uvin vannoi leiset pumpin athibol jouse hecheh hen,
English: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.

tcz: Thangvah toh thon ama vahchoi un chule namtin jouse chung a athilbol kidang ho hillhang uvin,
en: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.
text:
1CH 16:9
Thadou: Thangvah toh thon ama vahchoi un chule namtin jouse chung a athilbol kidang ho hillhang uvin,
English: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.

tcz: Amintheng chu hapah in kipapi un, eiho Pakai mite ehiuve,
en: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
text:
1CH 16:10
Thadou: Amintheng chu hapah in kipapi un, eiho Pakai mite ehiuve,
English: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

tcz: Tantih neilouvin Pakai thahatna chu holjing unlang hou uvin,
en: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
text:
1CH 16:11
Thadou: Tantih neilouvin Pakai thahatna chu holjing unlang hou uvin,
English: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

tcz: Thil kidang tampi le datmo umtah aboldoh hole athu tan naho geldoh jing un,
en: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
text:
1CH 16:12
Thadou: Thil kidang tampi le datmo umtah aboldoh hole athu tan naho geldoh jing un,
English: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

tcz: Nangho alhacha Israel chate ho chule Jacob son chilhah anam deilhen mite ho,
en: you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
text:
1CH 16:13
Thadou: Nangho alhacha Israel chate ho chule Jacob son chilhah anam deilhen mite ho,
English: you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

tcz: Amahi eiho Pakai Pathen ahi, Ama thupeh dihtah hi vannoi jousen amu ding ahi.
en: He is the LORD our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
text:
1CH 16:14
Thadou: Amahi eiho Pakai Pathen ahi, Ama thupeh dihtah hi vannoi jousen amu ding ahi.
English: He is the LORD our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

tcz: Aman aitih khang chan in jong akitepna agel doh jing in ahi,
en: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
text:
1CH 16:15
Thadou: Aman aitih khang chan in jong akitepna agel doh jing in ahi,
English: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

tcz: Hiche hi aman Abraham toh kitepna asem chu ahin chule Isaac heng a kitepna ana neichu ahi,
en: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.
text:
1CH 16:16
Thadou: Hiche hi aman Abraham toh kitepna asem chu ahin chule Isaac heng a kitepna ana neichu ahi,
English: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.

tcz: Aman hichu Jacob heng a Israel mite toh aitih khang gei a tonsot'a dia kitep na thulhuh le suhdetna ana nei ahi.
en: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
text:
1CH 16:17
Thadou: Aman hichu Jacob heng a Israel mite toh aitih khang gei a tonsot'a dia kitep na thulhuh le suhdetna ana nei ahi.
English: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

tcz: “Nangma chan ding goulo nading Canaan gam chu kapeh ding nahi,” ati.
en: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”
text:
1CH 16:18
Thadou: “Nangma chan ding goulo nading Canaan gam chu kapeh ding nahi,” ati.
English: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”

tcz: Aman hiche aseilai chun nangmaho Canaan gam'a hon lhomcha a khopem bang a nana umlai u ahi, ati.
en: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
text:
1CH 16:19
Thadou: Aman hiche aseilai chun nangmaho Canaan gam'a hon lhomcha a khopem bang a nana umlai u ahi, ati.
English: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

tcz: Hiti chun amaho chu namkhat apat namkhat in anavah uvin chule lenggam khat apat gamdang a ana vah leu ve,
en: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
text:
1CH 16:20
Thadou: Hiti chun amaho chu namkhat apat namkhat in anavah uvin chule lenggam khat apat gamdang a ana vah leu ve,
English: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

tcz: Chujongle aman amaho chu koima suhgentheina le bolgimna ana neisah pon, amaho jeh in leng dang ho joh thugah na ananei jon ahi,
en: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
text:
1CH 16:21
Thadou: Chujongle aman amaho chu koima suhgentheina le bolgimna ana neisah pon, amaho jeh in leng dang ho joh thugah na ananei jon ahi,
English: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

tcz: Kami lhenchomte natohkhah thei loudiu chule kathemgao ho jong nasuh genthei loudiu ahi,
en: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
text:
1CH 16:22
Thadou: Kami lhenchomte natohkhah thei loudiu chule kathemgao ho jong nasuh genthei loudiu ahi,
English: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

tcz: Leiset pumpin Pakai chu vahchoi hen chule aniseh in ami huh hingna thupha chu seiphong leuvin,
en: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.
text:
1CH 16:23
Thadou: Leiset pumpin Pakai chu vahchoi hen chule aniseh in ami huh hingna thupha chu seiphong leuvin,
English: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.

tcz: Namtin vaipi lah a athilbol loupi ho phongjal un, chule athilbol kidang ho mitin vaipi hetsah un,
en: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.
text:
1CH 16:24
Thadou: Namtin vaipi lah a athilbol loupi ho phongjal un, chule athilbol kidang ho mitin vaipi hetsah un,
English: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.

tcz: Pakai chu thunei pen ahin amin loupi vahchoi dia lomtah ahi. Chule Pathen dang jouse sang a gin le jadia lom ahi,
en: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
text:
1CH 16:25
Thadou: Pakai chu thunei pen ahin amin loupi vahchoi dia lomtah ahi. Chule Pathen dang jouse sang a gin le jadia lom ahi,
English: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.

tcz: Namtin vaipi dang ho hou hi semthu milim doi Pathen ahi, eiho Pakai vang hi vanlaijol sempa ahi,
en: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
text:
1CH 16:26
Thadou: Namtin vaipi dang ho hou hi semthu milim doi Pathen ahi, eiho Pakai vang hi vanlaijol sempa ahi,
English: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

tcz: Jana le lalna jouse le thahatna chule kipana Pakai ama kom a um ahi,
en: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.
text:
1CH 16:27
Thadou: Jana le lalna jouse le thahatna chule kipana Pakai ama kom a um ahi,
English: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.

tcz: Vannoi namtin vaipin Pakai thahat nale aloupi je chu hecheh hen,
en: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!
text:
1CH 16:28
Thadou: Vannoi namtin vaipin Pakai thahat nale aloupi je chu hecheh hen,
English: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!

tcz: Pakai chu loupina jouse chang dia lom ahi, amuntheng dung jousea Pakai chu thilpeh toh thon houvun,
en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.
text:
1CH 16:29
Thadou: Pakai chu loupina jouse chang dia lom ahi, amuntheng dung jousea Pakai chu thilpeh toh thon houvun,
English: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.

tcz: Leiset mite jouse Pakai masang a tijan kithing jeng hen, leiset jong linglouhel in dettah in ding jing hen,
en: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.
text:
1CH 16:30
Thadou: Leiset mite jouse Pakai masang a tijan kithing jeng hen, leiset jong linglouhel in dettah in ding jing hen,
English: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.

tcz: Vanna le leiya kipa thanop nan lodim soh hen chule Pakai vaihomna namtin vaipi jousea seiphong leuvin,
en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”
text:
1CH 16:31
Thadou: Vanna le leiya kipa thanop nan lodim soh hen chule Pakai vaihomna namtin vaipi jousea seiphong leuvin,
English: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”

tcz: Twikhanglen le asung a cheng jousen jong avah choina sam u hen chule loulai dungle mimle chang ho jong kipah thanom in hung pohjal jeng uhen,
en: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!
text:
1CH 16:32
Thadou: Twikhanglen le asung a cheng jousen jong avah choina sam u hen chule loulai dungle mimle chang ho jong kipah thanom in hung pohjal jeng uhen,
English: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!

tcz: Gammang thingphung jouse jong kipah lasah in kilingdoh soh hen, Pakai chu leiset na thutan’a ahung teng,
en: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.
text:
1CH 16:33
Thadou: Gammang thingphung jouse jong kipah lasah in kilingdoh soh hen, Pakai chu leiset na thutan’a ahung teng,
English: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.

tcz: Pakai chu aphatna jallin thangvah na peuvin, ama a um tahsan umtah mingailutna chun tonsot'in athoh jing e,
en: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
text:
1CH 16:34
Thadou: Pakai chu aphatna jallin thangvah na peuvin, ama a um tahsan umtah mingailutna chun tonsot'in athoh jing e,
English: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

tcz: “O Pathen eihuh hing paovin namtin vaipi lah a kon in neipui khom uvin lang neihuh doh uvin, chuteng nangma mintheng chu kakipa piuva kavah choi diu ahi.
en: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”
text:
1CH 16:35
Thadou: “O Pathen eihuh hing paovin namtin vaipi lah a kon in neipui khom uvin lang neihuh doh uvin, chuteng nangma mintheng chu kakipa piuva kavah choi diu ahi.
English: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”

tcz: Pakai Israel Pathen chu vahchoiyun amachu tonsot tonsot gei a hingjing ahi chule amite jousen Pakai chu vahchoi in sam uhen,” Amen.
en: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.
text:
1CH 16:36
Thadou: Pakai Israel Pathen chu vahchoiyun amachu tonsot tonsot gei a hingjing ahi chule amite jousen Pakai chu vahchoi in sam uhen,” Amen.
English: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.

tcz: Hitichun David in Pakai kitepna thingkong a aniseh a angaichat najouse a natong le ding in Asaph le ama mi Levi mite chu ana pansah in ahi.
en: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

tcz: Hiche holah a chun Jeduthun chapa Obed-edom, Hosah le Levi mite misom gup le get chu kotkhah ngah in ana pang uve.
en: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

tcz: Chule David in Zadok thempu le Levi mite chu Gibeon gamsung a Pakai Pathen houbuh a kimang cha din ana koi in ahi.
en: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,
text:
1CH 16:39
Thadou: Chule David in Zadok thempu le Levi mite chu Gibeon gamsung a Pakai Pathen houbuh a kimang cha din ana koi in ahi.
English: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,

tcz: Pakai in Israel te chung a dan thupeh juidia ana nei bang in amahon Pakai a jingkah nilhah in kilhaina thilpeh maicham jong ana nei uve,
en: to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the LORD’s law, which he commanded to Israel;

tcz: Pakai akitah nale mingailut na tonsot na athoh hat na jallin ama thang vah na pe ding in David in Heman le Jeduthun ana lhengdoh un chule midang ana minphah chan jong ana pang uvin ahi.
en: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Hitichun amahon sumkon mut ginle khutbeh ginle tumging theijat tampi ho mang chan Pathen anavah choi uve, chule Jeduthun chapa chu kotkhah ngah in ana pansah uve.
en: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.
text:
1CH 16:42
Thadou: Hitichun amahon sumkon mut ginle khutbeh ginle tumging theijat tampi ho mang chan Pathen anavah choi uve, chule Jeduthun chapa chu kotkhah ngah in ana pansah uve.
English: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.

tcz: Chujouvin mipi jouse chu ama inlam cheh a ana kileu vin David jong ama inlam a ainsung mite phattheiboh ding in ana che tan ahi.
en: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.
text:
1CH 16:43
Thadou: Chujouvin mipi jouse chu ama inlam cheh a ana kileu vin David jong ama inlam a ainsung mite phattheiboh ding in ana che tan ahi.
English: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.

tcz: David chu ama inpia ana umlai in Themgao Nathan chu akou in akom a hitin asei e, “Keimala Cedar thing a kisa innom tah a kacheng in, ahivang in Pakai kitepna thingkong vang chu ponbuh a kisa mai mai noi a ana kikoi in ahi.”
en: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of the LORD’s covenant is in a tent.”
text:
1CH 17:1
Thadou: David chu ama inpia ana umlai in Themgao Nathan chu akou in akom a hitin asei e, “Keimala Cedar thing a kisa innom tah a kacheng in, ahivang in Pakai kitepna thingkong vang chu ponbuh a kisa mai mai noi a ana kikoi in ahi.”
English: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of the LORD’s covenant is in a tent.”

tcz: Nathan in adonbut in, “Nalung a um nagel chan chu bollin ajeh chu Pathen in naumpi nai.”
en: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”
text:
1CH 17:2
Thadou: Nathan in adonbut in, “Nalung a um nagel chan chu bollin ajeh chu Pathen in naumpi nai.”
English: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”

tcz: Ahivang in, hicheni jantah chun Pathen in Nathan kom a anasei e,
en: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
text:
1CH 17:3
Thadou: Ahivang in, hicheni jantah chun Pathen in Nathan kom a anasei e,
English: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

tcz: “Chenlang kasohpa David kom a gahiltan nangma hi keima umna ding munsem ding chu nahipoi’tin ana sei e.”
en: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘The LORD says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;

tcz: Keiman Egypt gam a kon Israel te kahin pui doh nikho apat tunigei in ka insung a kacheng kha hih laiye, Hiti chun ponbuh a kisong houbuh munkhat a kon mun chom chom a kana ki chon le jin ahi.
en: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.
text:
1CH 17:5
Thadou: Keiman Egypt gam a kon Israel te kahin pui doh nikho apat tunigei in ka insung a kacheng kha hih laiye, Hiti chun ponbuh a kisong houbuh munkhat a kon mun chom chom a kana ki chon le jin ahi.
English: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.

tcz: Keiman Israel mite toh kilhon khom ding le kamite kelngoi ching a pang lamkai ho kom a jong Cedar thing a kisa in eisah pih diu in jong kana sei kha hyh e.
en: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’
text:
1CH 17:6
Thadou: Keiman Israel mite toh kilhon khom ding le kamite kelngoi ching a pang lamkai ho kom a jong Cedar thing a kisa in eisah pih diu in jong kana sei kha hyh e.
English: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

tcz: Tun nangma chen lang kalhachapa David kom a hitin gasei tan, “Van Pakai thanei chungnung in hitin aphong doh e,keiman nangma hi hamhing lah a kelngoi ching a napan na’a kon kapuidoh a kami Israel te chung a lamkai dia kapan sah ding nahi, ati.
en: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.
text:
1CH 17:7
Thadou: Tun nangma chen lang kalhachapa David kom a hitin gasei tan, “Van Pakai thanei chungnung in hitin aphong doh e,keiman nangma hi hamhing lah a kelngoi ching a napan na’a kon kapuidoh a kami Israel te chung a lamkai dia kapan sah ding nahi, ati.
English: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.

tcz: Chule keiman nangma nache namun jousea kalhonpi jing a, nangma masang a namelmate jouse jong kasuh gam jeng ding leiset chung a mi minthang ho bang a namin kakithan sah ding ahi.
en: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.
text:
1CH 17:8
Thadou: Chule keiman nangma nache namun jousea kalhonpi jing a, nangma masang a namelmate jouse jong kasuh gam jeng ding leiset chung a mi minthang ho bang a namin kakithan sah ding ahi.
English: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.

tcz: Chule kamite Israel te ding a achen nadiu munjong kapeh ding dettah a lungmongsel a cheng uva koiman jong asuh ling thei loudiu ahi. Namdang ten jong masang a banga asuh mang kit loudiu ahi.
en: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,
text:
1CH 17:9
Thadou: Chule kamite Israel te ding a achen nadiu munjong kapeh ding dettah a lungmongsel a cheng uva koiman jong asuh ling thei loudiu ahi. Namdang ten jong masang a banga asuh mang kit loudiu ahi.
English: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,

tcz: Keiman aphat dungjui a kamite Israel te chung a Lamkai vaihom ding kapan sah jing ding chule namel mateu aboncha kasuh gam ding chuche kal a jong Pakai in naleng gam sung u phatthei aboh ding ahi.
en: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that the LORD will build you a house.
text:
1CH 17:10
Thadou: Keiman aphat dungjui a kamite Israel te chung a Lamkai vaihom ding kapan sah jing ding chule namel mateu aboncha kasuh gam ding chuche kal a jong Pakai in naleng gam sung u phatthei aboh ding ahi.
English: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that the LORD will build you a house.

tcz: Nahinkho abei nung a napu napate kom a dia nache nungteng jong le keiman nadalhah nason nachilhah te lah a nachapate khat pen kadopsang ding ahi chule aleng gam jong lentah a kaphudoh peh ding ahi.
en: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
text:
1CH 17:11
