Thadou: Nahinkho abei nung a napu napate kom a dia nache nungteng jong le keiman nadalhah nason nachilhah te lah a nachapate khat pen kadopsang ding ahi chule aleng gam jong lentah a kaphudoh peh ding ahi.
English: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

tcz: Amapa chun keima ding a houin khat eisah peh ding chule keiman alenggam laltouna chu aitih chan a kaphudet jing ding ahi.
en: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
text:
1CH 17:12
Thadou: Amapa chun keima ding a houin khat eisah peh ding chule keiman alenggam laltouna chu aitih chan a kaphudet jing ding ahi.
English: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

tcz: Hiche mipa ding a chu keima hi apa kahi a ama chu kachapa hiding ahi. Nangma masang a mipa chung a kangailutna kana lahdoh bang a, ama chung a hi kanung lah doh lou ding ahi.
en: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;

tcz: Keiman ama kainsung a le kagamsung a leng a kapan sah ding chule alenggam laltou na chu atonsot geiya kaphudet pih a longlouva umjing ding ahi,” ati.
en: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”
text:
1CH 17:14
Thadou: Keiman ama kainsung a le kagamsung a leng a kapan sah ding chule alenggam laltou na chu atonsot geiya kaphudet pih a longlouva umjing ding ahi,” ati.
English: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”

tcz: Hiti chun Nathan ahung kile in Pakai in amusah thil hojouse chu David kom a ahung seipeh tan ahi.
en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
text:
1CH 17:15
Thadou: Hiti chun Nathan ahung kile in Pakai in amusah thil hojouse chu David kom a ahung seipeh tan ahi.
English: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

tcz: Chuin David alut in Pakai angsung a atao vin hitin asei e, “O Pakai Pathen keima hi koi kahi a chule kainsung mite hi ipi hija hichan gei a neihin pui peh jing u ham?
en: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, LORD God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?
text:
1CH 17:16
Thadou: Chuin David alut in Pakai angsung a atao vin hitin asei e, “O Pakai Pathen keima hi koi kahi a chule kainsung mite hi ipi hija hichan gei a neihin pui peh jing u ham?
English: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, LORD God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

tcz: Tun thil hicheng jouse kal val in jong O Pathen, nalhachapa keima khunung a insung thudol khanggui sotpi hunglhung ding jong neisei doh pih in ahi.
en: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, LORD God.
text:
1CH 17:17
Thadou: Tun thil hicheng jouse kal val in jong O Pathen, nalhachapa keima khunung a insung thudol khanggui sotpi hunglhung ding jong neisei doh pih in ahi.
English: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, LORD God.

tcz: Hitabang a nalhachapa neijabol na hi nangma kom a ipi kasei be nahlai ding ham, nalhachapa keima itobang kahi la neihet soh kei ahitai.
en: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.
text:
1CH 17:18
Thadou: Hitabang a nalhachapa neijabol na hi nangma kom a ipi kasei be nahlai ding ham, nalhachapa keima itobang kahi la neihet soh kei ahitai.
English: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.

tcz: Nalhachapa keima neigel khoh najal le nalungel lam tah bang in kachung a thil loupi tampi mite muthei jin nabol doh in ahi,
en: LORD, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.
text:
1CH 17:19
Thadou: Nalhachapa keima neigel khoh najal le nalungel lam tah bang in kachung a thil loupi tampi mite muthei jin nabol doh in ahi,
English: LORD, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

tcz: O Pakai, nang tabang koima dang aumpoi, nangma tabang Pathen dang jong kanei pouve,
en: LORD, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
text:
1CH 17:20
Thadou: O Pakai, nang tabang koima dang aumpoi, nangma tabang Pathen dang jong kanei pouve,
English: LORD, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

tcz: Nami Israel nam mite tabang leisetna koidang um am? O Pathen, nangma tah in namite asoh chan nagam a kon in nana huhdoh jeh in namin akithang in ahi, nangman thil kidang tah nabol in namite masang a ding ho jong nana del jam in ahi.
en: What one nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?
text:
1CH 17:21
Thadou: Nami Israel nam mite tabang leisetna koidang um am? O Pathen, nangma tah in namite asoh chan nagam a kon in nana huhdoh jeh in namin akithang in ahi, nangman thil kidang tah nabol in namite masang a ding ho jong nana del jam in ahi.
English: What one nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?

tcz: Nangman Israel mite chu nangma mite dih tah mong in nana lheng doh in Pakai nangma chu a Pathen u nahitan ahi,
en: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.
text:
1CH 17:22
Thadou: Nangman Israel mite chu nangma mite dih tah mong in nana lheng doh in Pakai nangma chu a Pathen u nahitan ahi,
English: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.

tcz: O Pakai tunvang keima nalhacha kahitai, keima le ka insungmi chung chang thua nakitepna bang in bol jeng tan chule hiche kitepna hi aitih chan a ding hita hen.
en: Now, LORD, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.
text:
1CH 17:23
Thadou: O Pakai tunvang keima nalhacha kahitai, keima le ka insungmi chung chang thua nakitepna bang in bol jeng tan chule hiche kitepna hi aitih chan a ding hita hen.
English: Now, LORD, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.

tcz: Nangma min kiphut doh henlang mijousen tonsot'in jana pecheh hen chule Pakai thanei chungnung pen Israel Pathen chu Israel Pathen ahi mong e tia kisei ding, nalhachapa David insung jeng jong nangma angsung a phudet a um ding ahi.
en: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’
text:
1CH 17:24
Thadou: Nangma min kiphut doh henlang mijousen tonsot'in jana pecheh hen chule Pakai thanei chungnung pen Israel Pathen chu Israel Pathen ahi mong e tia kisei ding, nalhachapa David insung jeng jong nangma angsung a phudet a um ding ahi.
English: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’

tcz: O ka Pathen keima hi nangma ang a ngamtah a hungtao a kahi, ajeh chu nalhachapa keima hi ka in ding neisah peh a lenggam khat neitundoh peh ding chu kicheh tah in neimu sah tai.
en: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.
text:
1CH 17:25
Thadou: O ka Pathen keima hi nangma ang a ngamtah a hungtao a kahi, ajeh chu nalhachapa keima hi ka in ding neisah peh a lenggam khat neitundoh peh ding chu kicheh tah in neimu sah tai.
English: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.

tcz: O Pakai nangma bou Pathen nahi chule hitabang thilpha tampihi nalhachapa kei ding in kitepna nanei e.
en: Now, LORD, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.
text:
1CH 17:26
Thadou: O Pakai nangma bou Pathen nahi chule hitabang thilpha tampihi nalhachapa kei ding in kitepna nanei e.
English: Now, LORD, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.

tcz: Tunjong nalhachapa insung phatthei naboh a hichu nalhachapa a ding a aitih gei a nangma masang a umjing ding ahi. Ajeh chu O Pakai nangma phathei boh chu ipi hijong le phattheiboh chang jing ding ahi.
en: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, LORD, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”
text:
1CH 17:27
Thadou: Tunjong nalhachapa insung phatthei naboh a hichu nalhachapa a ding a aitih gei a nangma masang a umjing ding ahi. Ajeh chu O Pakai nangma phathei boh chu ipi hijong le phattheiboh chang jing ding ahi.
English: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, LORD, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”

tcz: Chule David in Philistine te ana kisat pin anajou vin Gath khopi le avel a kho umho jong chu analo in ahi.
en: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
text:
1CH 18:1
Thadou: Chule David in Philistine te ana kisat pin anajou vin Gath khopi le avel a kho umho jong chu analo in ahi.
English: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

tcz: Chuin David in Moab mite chu ana kisat pin ana joukit in ama khutnoi in aum uvin sum donle kai jong David ana peuvin ahi.
en: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.
text:
1CH 18:2
Thadou: Chuin David in Moab mite chu ana kisat pin ana joukit in ama khutnoi in aum uvin sum donle kai jong David ana peuvin ahi.
English: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.

tcz: David in jong Euphrates luipang a kon thahattah'a ahung kon toulai uvin Zobah lengpa Hadadezer sepai techu Hemanath chan in anasat in ajouvin ahi.
en: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
text:
1CH 18:3
Thadou: David in jong Euphrates luipang a kon thahattah'a ahung kon toulai uvin Zobah lengpa Hadadezer sepai techu Hemanath chan in anasat in ajouvin ahi.
English: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

tcz: Hitichun David in kangtalai sangkhat anaman in chule kangtalai tol'a pang mi sang sagi ma aman in keng lamjot sepai sang somni ahin chule kangtalai kai a pang sakol jouse akeng atanpih in kangtalai jakhat kaikham bou akhen in ahi.
en: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.
text:
1CH 18:4
Thadou: Hitichun David in kangtalai sangkhat anaman in chule kangtalai tol'a pang mi sang sagi ma aman in keng lamjot sepai sang somni ahin chule kangtalai kai a pang sakol jouse akeng atanpih in kangtalai jakhat kaikham bou akhen in ahi.
English: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.

tcz: Chule Aramean mite Damascus khopi a kon a Hadadezer lengpa kithopi dia hung kon ho chu David in mi sang som nile sangni jen ana that in ahi.
en: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.
text:
1CH 18:5
Thadou: Chule Aramean mite Damascus khopi a kon a Hadadezer lengpa kithopi dia hung kon ho chu David in mi sang som nile sangni jen ana that in ahi.
English: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.

tcz: Hichun David in Aramean gam a Damascus khopi a chun sepai tampi atou sah in, Aramean mite chu David khutnoi in anaum uvin donlekai jong ana peuvin ahi, chule Pakaiyin David chu agal kon nalam jouse a galjona apejing e.
en: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
text:
1CH 18:6
Thadou: Hichun David in Aramean gam a Damascus khopi a chun sepai tampi atou sah in, Aramean mite chu David khutnoi in anaum uvin donlekai jong ana peuvin ahi, chule Pakaiyin David chu agal kon nalam jouse a galjona apejing e.
English: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

tcz: David in Hedadezer sepai lamkai ho kipoh sana lum ho jouse chu Jerusalem ah ahin polut'in ahi.
en: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
text:
1CH 18:7
Thadou: David in Hedadezer sepai lamkai ho kipoh sana lum ho jouse chu Jerusalem ah ahin polut'in ahi.
English: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hadadezer khopi Tebah le Cun a chun David in sumeng tampi ahin kilah in chule Solomon in hiche sum-eng ho chu kisilna twi kong le sum-eng khompi le Pathen houna in a manchah ding thil dang sem nan anei in ahi.
en: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.
text:
1CH 18:8
Thadou: Hadadezer khopi Tebah le Cun a chun David in sumeng tampi ahin kilah in chule Solomon in hiche sum-eng ho chu kisilna twi kong le sum-eng khompi le Pathen houna in a manchah ding thil dang sem nan anei in ahi.
English: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.

tcz: Hamath lengpa Toi in Zobah lengpa Hadadezer sepaite jouse David in abonchan ajoutai tithu anajan,
en: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
text:
1CH 18:9
Thadou: Hamath lengpa Toi in Zobah lengpa Hadadezer sepaite jouse David in abonchan ajoutai tithu anajan,
English: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

tcz: hichun amapan achapa Joram chu David galjona kipapi dingin anasol in ahi. Ajeh chu Hadadezer hin Toi ana kisat pi jing lai ahi, Joram chun David chu thilpeh tampi sana, sumeng le dangka ho anapen ahi.
en: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.
text:
1CH 18:10
Thadou: hichun amapan achapa Joram chu David galjona kipapi dingin anasol in ahi. Ajeh chu Hadadezer hin Toi ana kisat pi jing lai ahi, Joram chun David chu thilpeh tampi sana, sumeng le dangka ho anapen ahi.
English: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.

tcz: Leng David in hiche thilpeh hung jouse ahin sumeng le sana namdang mite Edom, Moab, le Amaleke mite kom a ahinlah doh jouse chu abonchan Pakai ading in ana katdoh in ahi.
en: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
text:
1CH 18:11
Thadou: Leng David in hiche thilpeh hung jouse ahin sumeng le sana namdang mite Edom, Moab, le Amaleke mite kom a ahinlah doh jouse chu abonchan Pakai ading in ana katdoh in ahi.
English: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

tcz: Zeruiah chapa Abishai kitipa chun chikhuh phaicham a chun Edom mite mi sangsom le get jen ana that in ahi.
en: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
text:
1CH 18:12
Thadou: Zeruiah chapa Abishai kitipa chun chikhuh phaicham a chun Edom mite mi sangsom le get jen ana that in ahi.
English: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

tcz: Chuin aman Edom gamsung a chun sepai atousah in chule Edom mite chu David khutnoi in ana um uve, Hitichun David chu ache nachan a Pakaiyin galjona apejing in ahi.
en: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
text:
1CH 18:13
Thadou: Chuin aman Edom gamsung a chun sepai atousah in chule Edom mite chu David khutnoi in ana um uve, Hitichun David chu ache nachan a Pakaiyin galjona apejing in ahi.
English: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

tcz: Chujouvin David chu Israel pumpia lengvai pon apang in ama natoh thilbol ho jouse chu ami Isareal te a ding a thilpha le adih jeng ahi e,
en: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.
text:
1CH 18:14
Thadou: Chujouvin David chu Israel pumpia lengvai pon apang in ama natoh thilbol ho jouse chu ami Isareal te a ding a thilpha le adih jeng ahi e,
English: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

tcz: Zeruiah chapa Joab chu sepai lamkai in apang in chule Ahilud chapa Jehosaphet chu thuching le lekha sun in ana pang in ahi.
en: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

tcz: Ahitub chapa Zadok le Abiathar chapa Ahimeleche chu thempun apang lhon in chule Seraiah kitipa chu thutanna mun a lekha sun in apang e.
en: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;

tcz: Jehoiada chapa Beniah chu lengpa veng a pangho chunga vaipon ana pang e, chule David chapate chu lengpa kinbol na a vaihom pipun ana pang uve.
en: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.
text:
1CH 18:17
Thadou: Jehoiada chapa Beniah chu lengpa veng a pangho chunga vaipon ana pang e, chule David chapate chu lengpa kinbol na a vaihom pipun ana pang uve.
English: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jou a Ammon mite Lengpa Nahash ahung thi chun achapa Hanun chu leng in ahung pang tai.
en: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.
text:
1CH 19:1
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jou a Ammon mite Lengpa Nahash ahung thi chun achapa Hanun chu leng in ahung pang tai.
English: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.

tcz: David in, “Keiman Hanun chung a hi kakitah na kapoh doh ding ahi, ajeh chu apa Nahash hi keima chung a akitah jing in ahi,” tin asei e. Hiti chun David in Hanun pa thina jeh a lunghem na akon lungmon sah nading in asottol le ho asol in ahivang in David sottolle ho Ammon gam ahung lhun phat in,
en: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.
text:
1CH 19:2
Thadou: David in, “Keiman Hanun chung a hi kakitah na kapoh doh ding ahi, ajeh chu apa Nahash hi keima chung a akitah jing in ahi,” tin asei e. Hiti chun David in Hanun pa thina jeh a lunghem na akon lungmon sah nading in asottol le ho asol in ahivang in David sottolle ho Ammon gam ahung lhun phat in,
English: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.

tcz: Ammon mite lamkai pa chun Hanun kom ah chun, “Nangman hiche mipite hohi napa jabolna jal'a hung a nagel mong ham? Hichu hilou a David in amaho hi agam umdan ho vetoh le a chujouteng le hung kon uva agamsung mite jouse hi nokhum ding lung agot joh ahi,” tin asei e.
en: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”
text:
1CH 19:3
Thadou: Ammon mite lamkai pa chun Hanun kom ah chun, “Nangman hiche mipite hohi napa jabolna jal'a hung a nagel mong ham? Hichu hilou a David in amaho hi agam umdan ho vetoh le a chujouteng le hung kon uva agamsung mite jouse hi nokhum ding lung agot joh ahi,” tin asei e.
English: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”

tcz: Chuin Hanun in David sottolle ho chu aman in asam u avo peh un chule aponsil hou jong akongjang atobuh dung uva achetan peh in abon chaovin David heng a anung sol tauve.
en: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.
text:
1CH 19:4
Thadou: Chuin Hanun in David sottolle ho chu aman in asam u avo peh un chule aponsil hou jong akongjang atobuh dung uva achetan peh in abon chaovin David heng a anung sol tauve.
English: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.

tcz: David in amite chunga hitobng thilsoh umchan le asottolle ho ajachat naho thu ajah jeh chun Jericho khopi ah chun akhamul u ahung khandoh kah uva tham den uva chujouteng hung kile ding in asei e.
en: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”
text:
1CH 19:5
Thadou: David in amite chunga hitobng thilsoh umchan le asottolle ho ajachat naho thu ajah jeh chun Jericho khopi ah chun akhamul u ahung khandoh kah uva tham den uva chujouteng hung kile ding in asei e.
English: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

tcz: Ammon mite chun, David lungdou na athilbol u ahetdoh phat u chun Hanun le Ammon mite chun Zoab le Aramaacah chule Ram-naharaim gam a kon sakol touthem sepai le kangtalai tampi thalah nadin dangka talent sangsom sagi le sang nga jen ana thot in ahi.
en: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.
text:
1CH 19:6
Thadou: Ammon mite chun, David lungdou na athilbol u ahetdoh phat u chun Hanun le Ammon mite chun Zoab le Aramaacah chule Ram-naharaim gam a kon sakol touthem sepai le kangtalai tampi thalah nadin dangka talent sangsom sagi le sang nga jen ana thot in ahi.
English: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.

tcz: Chujongle amahon kangtalai sang somthum le ni jong athalah uvin, Maacah le asepai te jong ana kitho piu ve. Chule hiche sepai ho chu Medaba mun a Hanun in amakhopi tah a anapan sah sepai ho toh chun ana umkhom uvin ahi.
en: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
text:
1CH 19:7
Thadou: Chujongle amahon kangtalai sang somthum le ni jong athalah uvin, Maacah le asepai te jong ana kitho piu ve. Chule hiche sepai ho chu Medaba mun a Hanun in amakhopi tah a anapan sah sepai ho toh chun ana umkhom uvin ahi.
English: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

tcz: David in hichu ajah phat in Joab le asepai gal hang ho chu ama kisat pi din ana sol pai in ahi.
en: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.
text:
1CH 19:8
Thadou: David in hichu ajah phat in Joab le asepai gal hang ho chu ama kisat pi din ana sol pai in ahi.
English: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.

tcz: Hichun Ammon mite jong ahung kon doh un khopi kelkot phung ah chun galsat ding in ahung kigol doh tauve, chule galsat dia hung kon leng ho jong chun ama hinathei cheh in galsat dia kigot na panmun akisem uvin ahi.
en: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.
text:
1CH 19:9
Thadou: Hichun Ammon mite jong ahung kon doh un khopi kelkot phung ah chun galsat ding in ahung kigol doh tauve, chule galsat dia hung kon leng ho jong chun ama hinathei cheh in galsat dia kigot na panmun akisem uvin ahi.
English: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.

tcz: Joab in amelmaten anung ama a ahin nokhum amu doh phat in Israel te sepai hatlai ho chu Aramean sepai te kisat pi ding in alhengdoh in ahi.
en: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
text:
1CH 19:10
Thadou: Joab in amelmaten anung ama a ahin nokhum amu doh phat in Israel te sepai hatlai ho chu Aramean sepai te kisat pi ding in alhengdoh in ahi.
English: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

tcz: Chule aman sepai dang adalhah chengse chu asopipa Abishai lamkai nanoi a Ammon mite kisat pi ding in apan sah e.
en: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
text:
1CH 19:11
Thadou: Chule aman sepai dang adalhah chengse chu asopipa Abishai lamkai nanoi a Ammon mite kisat pi ding in apan sah e.
English: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

tcz: Joab in asopipa jah a chun, “Aramean mite chu kahin jolal le neihung kithopi ding chule nang in jong Ammon mite nanjolal le kahung kithopi ding nahi,” ati.
en: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.
text:
1CH 19:12
Thadou: Joab in asopipa jah a chun, “Aramean mite chu kahin jolal le neihung kithopi ding chule nang in jong Ammon mite nanjolal le kahung kithopi ding nahi,” ati.
English: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

tcz: Hat unlang hangsan tahin pang un e Pathen khopi ule emiteu va ding in gal isat diu ahi. Pakai in ama deilam in hinbol jeng tahen.
en: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do that which seems good to him.”
text:
1CH 19:13
Thadou: Hat unlang hangsan tahin pang un e Pathen khopi ule emiteu va ding in gal isat diu ahi. Pakai in ama deilam in hinbol jeng tahen.
English: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do that which seems good to him.”

tcz: Joab le asepaiten Aramean mite àsat un anadel jam tauve.
en: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.
text:
1CH 19:14
Thadou: Joab le asepaiten Aramean mite àsat un anadel jam tauve.
English: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

tcz: Chule Ammon miten Aramean mite jam amu doh phat u chun Abishai a kon in anajam un akhopiuva ana kile tauve.
en: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
text:
1CH 19:15
Thadou: Chule Ammon miten Aramean mite jam amu doh phat u chun Abishai a kon in anajam un akhopiuva ana kile tauve.
English: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

tcz: Aramean miten Israel te ajolel u ahetdoh phat uchun Euphrates luipang le avel dung a kon in Aramean sepaite akoukhom in amaho chu abon'un Hadadezer sepai jalamkai pa thunoi in ana um sah uvin ahi.
en: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.
text:
1CH 19:16
Thadou: Aramean miten Israel te ajolel u ahetdoh phat uchun Euphrates luipang le avel dung a kon in Aramean sepaite akoukhom in amaho chu abon'un Hadadezer sepai jalamkai pa thunoi in ana um sah uvin ahi.
English: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.

tcz: David in hitobng thilumchan ho ahet doh phat in jordan vadung vel dung a kon jousea Israel sepaite chu galsat din ana kou khom in Aramean mite toh ana kisat tauvin ahi.
en: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
text:
1CH 19:17
Thadou: David in hitobng thilumchan ho ahet doh phat in jordan vadung vel dung a kon jousea Israel sepaite chu galsat din ana kou khom in Aramean mite toh ana kisat tauvin ahi.
English: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

tcz: Chule Aramean mite chu Israel te a kon in anagal lel un, anajam kit tauvin ahi. Hichea chun David sepai ten Aramean sepai lamkai pipu Shobah pum in sepai kangtalai tol mi sang sagi le kenglam sepai mi sang somli jen ana that uvin ahi.
en: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.
text:
1CH 19:18
Thadou: Chule Aramean mite chu Israel te a kon in anagal lel un, anajam kit tauvin ahi. Hichea chun David sepai ten Aramean sepai lamkai pipu Shobah pum in sepai kangtalai tol mi sang sagi le kenglam sepai mi sang somli jen ana that uvin ahi.
English: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.

tcz: Hadadezer thunoi a leng umhon jong Israelten gal ajo amudoh phat uvin, David angsung a akipelut uvin ama thunoi in aum tauve, chule Aramean miten aitih a jong Ammon mite akitho pi kit diu anom tapouve.
en: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.
text:
1CH 19:19
Thadou: Hadadezer thunoi a leng umhon jong Israelten gal ajo amudoh phat uvin, David angsung a akipelut uvin ama thunoi in aum tauve, chule Aramean miten aitih a jong Ammon mite akitho pi kit diu anom tapouve.
English: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.

tcz: Chuche kum chavang lai a lengpa galbol dia ahung chun Israel mite chun Job lamkai na noi in Ammon mite anasat uvin ahi. Hichun aman Rabbah khopi chu ana umkhom in ahi. Hinlah David chu Jerusalem ah chun ana umden in ahi.
en: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.
text:
1CH 20:1
Thadou: Chuche kum chavang lai a lengpa galbol dia ahung chun Israel mite chun Job lamkai na noi in Ammon mite anasat uvin ahi. Hichun aman Rabbah khopi chu ana umkhom in ahi. Hinlah David chu Jerusalem ah chun ana umden in ahi.
English: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.

tcz: David Rabbah khopi ahung lhun in lengpa lallukhuh chu aladoh in aman akikhuh in ahi. Hiche lal lukhuh chu sana pah jem a kisem chule agih dan jong pound som sagi le nga ahi. David in jong thilman tampi khopia chun ahin kipoh in ahi.
en: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.
text:
1CH 20:2
Thadou: David Rabbah khopi ahung lhun in lengpa lallukhuh chu aladoh in aman akikhuh in ahi. Hiche lal lukhuh chu sana pah jem a kisem chule agih dan jong pound som sagi le nga ahi. David in jong thilman tampi khopia chun ahin kipoh in ahi.
English: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.

tcz: Aman Rabbah kho mite chu soh in ana mang in, amaho chu thingat, thih khenchi a leilai le heicha’a thing chan in anapan sah in, Ammon mite chu engbolna ana pen ahi. Chujouvin David le asepaite chu Jerusalem a anache tauve.
en: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
text:
1CH 20:3
Thadou: Aman Rabbah kho mite chu soh in ana mang in, amaho chu thingat, thih khenchi a leilai le heicha’a thing chan in anapan sah in, Ammon mite chu engbolna ana pen ahi. Chujouvin David le asepaite chu Jerusalem a anache tauve.
English: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

tcz: Chujouvin jong Israel te le Philistine techu Gazer mun a gal in ana kisat kit in ahi. Hiche akisat nau va hin, Hushah kho a Sebbecai jin milen galhat minthang ho chilhah a kon Saph kitipa ana that in chule Philistine ten gal analel tauvin ahi.
en: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.
text:
1CH 20:4
Thadou: Chujouvin jong Israel te le Philistine techu Gazer mun a gal in ana kisat kit in ahi. Hiche akisat nau va hin, Hushah kho a Sebbecai jin milen galhat minthang ho chilhah a kon Saph kitipa ana that in chule Philistine ten gal analel tauvin ahi.
English: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

tcz: Philistine te toh gal kisat na mun khat ma ana um kit in, hichea chun Elhanan chapa Jair chun Gath khoa kon Goliath sopipa Lahmi chu anathat in ahi. Chule Lahmi tenglum chu lentah ahi.
en: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
text:
1CH 20:5
Thadou: Philistine te toh gal kisat na mun khat ma ana um kit in, hichea chun Elhanan chapa Jair chun Gath khoa kon Goliath sopipa Lahmi chu anathat in ahi. Chule Lahmi tenglum chu lentah ahi.
English: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

tcz: Philistine tetoh Gath khopia gal ana kisat namun uva jong chun milentah galhat mi khut jung gup le keng jung gup nei abon'a somni le li nei khat ana pang e, amahi gollui lai galhang minthang ho son chilhah a kon ahi.
en: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.
text:
1CH 20:6
Thadou: Philistine tetoh Gath khopia gal ana kisat namun uva jong chun milentah galhat mi khut jung gup le keng jung gup nei abon'a somni le li nei khat ana pang e, amahi gollui lai galhang minthang ho son chilhah a kon ahi.
English: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.

tcz: Chule aman Israel mite totnop nale noise tah a anabol jeh chun David sopipa Shimea chapa Jonathan in’a anathat tai.
en: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.
text:
1CH 20:7
Thadou: Chule aman Israel mite totnop nale noise tah a anabol jeh chun David sopipa Shimea chapa Jonathan in’a anathat tai.
English: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

tcz: David in anatha Philistine galhang mite hi Gath kho akon milui galhang ho son chilhah jeng anahiu ve.
en: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
text:
1CH 20:8
Thadou: David in anatha Philistine galhang mite hi Gath kho akon milui galhang ho son chilhah jeng anahiu ve.
English: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

tcz: Israel douna din, Satan’in Israel chate mijat simdin David lengpa atildoh tai.
en: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.
text:
1CH 21:1
Thadou: Israel douna din, Satan’in Israel chate mijat simdin David lengpa atildoh tai.
English: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.

tcz: Hijeh hin David nin Joab le a sepai lamkai ho jah ah, “Sahlam gamkai Bersheba apat lhumlam gamkai Dan chan gei Israel mijat gasim uvin lang, nasimdoh jat u chu kaheng’a hinchoi’un, keiman kahet nom’e.
en: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”
text:
1CH 21:2
Thadou: Hijeh hin David nin Joab le a sepai lamkai ho jah ah, “Sahlam gamkai Bersheba apat lhumlam gamkai Dan chan gei Israel mijat gasim uvin lang, nasimdoh jat u chu kaheng’a hinchoi’un, keiman kahet nom’e.
English: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”

tcz: Ahin Joab’in adonbut’in, “Pakaiyin Israel chate ajat ja’n hin punsah hen. Ahin ka Pakai le ka Lengpa, amaho khu namite hilou ham? Iding’a ka Pakaipa’n hiche nabol nom ham? Iding’a Israelte chung’a themmona lhunsah ding nagot ham?” ati.
en: Joab said, “May the LORD make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”
text:
1CH 21:3
Thadou: Ahin Joab’in adonbut’in, “Pakaiyin Israel chate ajat ja’n hin punsah hen. Ahin ka Pakai le ka Lengpa, amaho khu namite hilou ham? Iding’a ka Pakaipa’n hiche nabol nom ham? Iding’a Israelte chung’a themmona lhunsah ding nagot ham?” ati.
English: Joab said, “May the LORD make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”

tcz: Ahivang’in, lengpan athusei chu apetchah in, hijehchun Joab jong lengpa thupeh nit’in Israel chate chenna gam jousea mijat agasim in Jerusalem ahung kile tai.
en: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.
text:
1CH 21:4
Thadou: Ahivang’in, lengpan athusei chu apetchah in, hijehchun Joab jong lengpa thupeh nit’in Israel chate chenna gam jousea mijat agasim in Jerusalem ahung kile tai.
English: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hichun ajatsimdoh jat chu David heng’a ahetsah tai. Gaalhang chemjam lamthei cheh chu mi nel khat le sang jakhat alhingin, Judah mite jong Sang jali le sang somsagi alhing uve.
en: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.
text:
1CH 21:5
Thadou: Hichun ajatsimdoh jat chu David heng’a ahetsah tai. Gaalhang chemjam lamthei cheh chu mi nel khat le sang jakhat alhingin, Judah mite jong Sang jali le sang somsagi alhing uve.
English: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.

tcz: Hiche jatsim ahin Joab in Levi mite le Benjamin mite vang asimtha pon ahi ajehchu, lengpa thupeh chu Joab in ama boldia adeimo behseh jeng ahi.
en: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
text:
1CH 21:6
Thadou: Hiche jatsim ahin Joab in Levi mite le Benjamin mite vang asimtha pon ahi ajehchu, lengpa thupeh chu Joab in ama boldia adeimo behseh jeng ahi.
English: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

tcz: Hichun, Pathen in mijatsim kibolchu alunghanpi jeh in ami Israelte chu gotna achantan ahi.
en: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.
text:
1CH 21:7
Thadou: Hichun, Pathen in mijatsim kibolchu alunghanpi jeh in ami Israelte chu gotna achantan ahi.
English: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.

tcz: Chuphat’in David in Pathen jah a hitin aseitai, “Vo Kapathen, keiman nangma doumahtah kaboldoh tai, ngolhoitah hijongle neingaidam kit in,” ati.
en: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”
text:
1CH 21:8
Thadou: Chuphat’in David in Pathen jah a hitin aseitai, “Vo Kapathen, keiman nangma doumahtah kaboldoh tai, ngolhoitah hijongle neingaidam kit in,” ati.
English: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”

tcz: Chuphatchun, Pathenin David ding’a mitva neiya pangpa Gad heng’a hitin aseitai,
en: The LORD spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,
text:
1CH 21:9
Thadou: Chuphatchun, Pathenin David ding’a mitva neiya pangpa Gad heng’a hitin aseitai,
English: The LORD spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

tcz: “David heng’a gache’n lang Pathen in hitin aseiye tin gaseipeh tan”, gimbolna thum lah a hin khat kilhen inlang, hichu keiman ka guilhun sah teiding ahi”, ati.
en: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”
text:
1CH 21:10
Thadou: “David heng’a gache’n lang Pathen in hitin aseiye tin gaseipeh tan”, gimbolna thum lah a hin khat kilhen inlang, hichu keiman ka guilhun sah teiding ahi”, ati.
English: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

tcz: Hijeh chun David heng’a Gad ahung’in hitin aseitai, “Pathenin hicheng thum hi nagon pehtai,”
en: So Gad came to David and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Take your choice:
text:
1CH 21:11
Thadou: Hijeh chun David heng’a Gad ahung’in hitin aseitai, “Pathenin hicheng thum hi nagon pehtai,”
English: So Gad came to David and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Take your choice:

tcz: “Kum thum sung’a kel lhah ding nadei’am, na galmiten chemjam a lhathum sungsea nasuhgam ding nalhen ding ham ahiloule, ni thum sung a gamna hise nasatah a lhung’a nalenggam sung pumpia pakai vantil in namite asuhgam ding hoichi nalhen joh ding ham?” “Eihin solpa Pathen heng’a iti kalhut ding nalhen joh hitam?” ati.
en: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of the LORD, even pestilence in the land, and the LORD’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”
text:
1CH 21:12
Thadou: “Kum thum sung’a kel lhah ding nadei’am, na galmiten chemjam a lhathum sungsea nasuhgam ding nalhen ding ham ahiloule, ni thum sung a gamna hise nasatah a lhung’a nalenggam sung pumpia pakai vantil in namite asuhgam ding hoichi nalhen joh ding ham?” “Eihin solpa Pathen heng’a iti kalhut ding nalhen joh hitam?” ati.
English: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of the LORD, even pestilence in the land, and the LORD’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”

tcz: “Kadinmun ahahsa valtai” tin David in Gad jah a aseitai. “iti nama jongle mihem khut a kipeh sang’in Ka Pakai, Ka Pathen khut joh’in kipelut tang’e. Ajehchu, amihepina kidangtahchu kakinem nalaiye” ati.
en: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”
text:
1CH 21:13
Thadou: “Kadinmun ahahsa valtai” tin David in Gad jah a aseitai. “iti nama jongle mihem khut a kipeh sang’in Ka Pakai, Ka Pathen khut joh’in kipelut tang’e. Ajehchu, amihepina kidangtahchu kakinem nalaiye” ati.
English: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”

tcz: Hichun, Pathenin Israelte lah a gamna hise alan sah tan, mi sangsom sagi jen in thina atoh tai.
en: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.
text:
1CH 21:14
Thadou: Hichun, Pathenin Israelte lah a gamna hise alan sah tan, mi sangsom sagi jen in thina atoh tai.
English: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.

tcz: Chuban’a jong, Pathenin Jerusalem sugamhel din mithat vantil ahinsoltan ahileh, akigotjinglai un, Pathenin alung ahin heiyin, vantil jah’a, “Aphaset tai, ngatan” tin aseitai. Chupettah chun, mithat vantil chu Jerusalem chungvum’a ana pansa tan ahi. Hichu Jebus mipa Araunah changphol ahitai.
en: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, the LORD saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” the LORD’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
text:
1CH 21:15
Thadou: Chuban’a jong, Pathenin Jerusalem sugamhel din mithat vantil ahinsoltan ahileh, akigotjinglai un, Pathenin alung ahin heiyin, vantil jah’a, “Aphaset tai, ngatan” tin aseitai. Chupettah chun, mithat vantil chu Jerusalem chungvum’a ana pansa tan ahi. Hichu Jebus mipa Araunah changphol ahitai.
English: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, the LORD saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” the LORD’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

tcz: David in vanlang a Pakai vantil ten chemjam pum a Jerusalem suhgam ding agot u amu phat’in. Israel lamkai pipuho toh kisih pumin tol lang ngan, khaodip ponsil pum’in.
en: David lifted up his eyes, and saw the LORD’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.
text:
1CH 21:16
Thadou: David in vanlang a Pakai vantil ten chemjam pum a Jerusalem suhgam ding agot u amu phat’in. Israel lamkai pipuho toh kisih pumin tol lang ngan, khaodip ponsil pum’in.
English: David lifted up his eyes, and saw the LORD’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

tcz: Chuin, David in Pathen jah’a aseitai, “Israelte mijatsim ding’a thupeh nei chu keima kahi, abolkhel le achonse chu keima kahi, kamite vang kelngoi bang’a themmona ipi aboldoh u hitam? O ka Pakai le ka Pathen’u, nalunghanna kei le ka insung mite chung’a chuhsah tan, namite vang sugam hih hel in.
en: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O LORD my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”
text:
1CH 21:17
Thadou: Chuin, David in Pathen jah’a aseitai, “Israelte mijatsim ding’a thupeh nei chu keima kahi, abolkhel le achonse chu keima kahi, kamite vang kelngoi bang’a themmona ipi aboldoh u hitam? O ka Pakai le ka Pathen’u, nalunghanna kei le ka insung mite chung’a chuhsah tan, namite vang sugam hih hel in.
English: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O LORD my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”

tcz: Hichun, Pakai vantil’in Gad jah a David achetou a Jebus mipa Araunah changphol a maichamphung asah din thupeh aneitai.
en: Then the LORD’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
text:
1CH 21:18
Thadou: Hichun, Pakai vantil’in Gad jah a David achetou a Jebus mipa Araunah changphol a maichamphung asah din thupeh aneitai.
English: Then the LORD’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

tcz: Hijeh chun David in Gad thulhut bangin Pathen thupeh chu boldin achetou tai.
en: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the LORD’s name.
text:
1CH 21:19
Thadou: Hijeh chun David in Gad thulhut bangin Pathen thupeh chu boldin achetou tai.
English: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the LORD’s name.

tcz: Araunah le achapate mi li chun suhlou chang ana den pettah in Vantil chu amu uvin ahileh, achapate chu akichat jeh un ajam uvin akisel gam taove.
en: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
text:
1CH 21:20
Thadou: Araunah le achapate mi li chun suhlou chang ana den pettah in Vantil chu amu uvin ahileh, achapate chu akichat jeh un ajam uvin akisel gam taove.
English: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

tcz: Araunah in David chu changphol ahinphah amu phat’in, a bolban dalhan Lengpa chu ana bohkhup tai.
en: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
text:
1CH 21:21
Thadou: Araunah in David chu changphol ahinphah amu phat’in, a bolban dalhan Lengpa chu ana bohkhup tai.
English: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

tcz: David in Araunah jah a hitin aseitai, “Na Changphol mun hi aman lhingsel keiman nape’ng ting, Pakai maicham phungkhat satang’e, chuteng Pakai lunghan na hiche gimna hise jong thip tante”.
en: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”
text:
1CH 21:22
Thadou: David in Araunah jah a hitin aseitai, “Na Changphol mun hi aman lhingsel keiman nape’ng ting, Pakai maicham phungkhat satang’e, chuteng Pakai lunghan na hiche gimna hise jong thip tante”.
English: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

tcz: “Kilah inlang nadei bangtah in mangcha tan Kapu, chujongleh keiman Pumgo thilto a manchah din Bongchalte, maicham mei ti nadin changsuh thing chule, thilto din suhlou chang jong pehtha nge” tin Araunah in David jah a aseitai.
en: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”
text:
1CH 21:23
Thadou: “Kilah inlang nadei bangtah in mangcha tan Kapu, chujongleh keiman Pumgo thilto a manchah din Bongchalte, maicham mei ti nadin changsuh thing chule, thilto din suhlou chang jong pehtha nge” tin Araunah in David jah a aseitai.
English: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”

tcz: Ahivangin Leng David in Araunah adonbut in, “keiman aman lhingset napeng ting, nangma thil vang maicham thilto din kilah tha pong’e”.
en: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for the LORD, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”
text:
1CH 21:24
Thadou: Ahivangin Leng David in Araunah adonbut in, “keiman aman lhingset napeng ting, nangma thil vang maicham thilto din kilah tha pong’e”.
English: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for the LORD, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”

tcz: Chuin, David in Araunah chu sana pheng jagup chu changphol man dingin apetai.
en: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.
text:
1CH 21:25
Thadou: Chuin, David in Araunah chu sana pheng jagup chu changphol man dingin apetai.
English: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.

tcz: Hilaimun hin David in maicham phungkhat asan, pumgo thilto le kichamna maicham asemin, taona amang tan ahile, Pathenin asanpeh hetna din van'a kon meikou ahin sol lhan pumgo thilto jouse akavam hel tai.
en: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on the LORD; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.
text:
1CH 21:26
Thadou: Hilaimun hin David in maicham phungkhat asan, pumgo thilto le kichamna maicham asemin, taona amang tan ahile, Pathenin asanpeh hetna din van'a kon meikou ahin sol lhan pumgo thilto jouse akavam hel tai.
English: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on the LORD; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pathenin Chemjam ana lam’a kigo vantil chu a chempai a anungkoi din thu ape tai.
en: Then the LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.
text:
1CH 21:27
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pathenin Chemjam ana lam’a kigo vantil chu a chempai a anungkoi din thu ape tai.
English: Then the LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

tcz: Pathen in amaicham sem asanpeh ahet phat’in David in jong Araunah changphol mun chun kilhaina maicham asemtai.
en: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
text:
1CH 21:28
Thadou: Pathen in amaicham sem asanpeh ahet phat’in David in jong Araunah changphol mun chun kilhaina maicham asemtai.
English: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

tcz: Hiche phat laiya hi, Pakai houbuh maicham le pumgo thilto maicham phung, Mose in gammang laiya anasem chu Gibeon mun a aumpet ahi.
en: For the LORD’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.
text:
1CH 21:29
Thadou: Hiche phat laiya hi, Pakai houbuh maicham le pumgo thilto maicham phung, Mose in gammang laiya anasem chu Gibeon mun a aumpet ahi.
English: For the LORD’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

tcz: Ahivangin David chun hiche laimun a chu Pathen lung gahol a gache ding chu agel le mithat vantil chemjam toh gotsa dem a anaum jeh chun angapcha pon ahi.
en: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of the LORD’s angel.
text:
1CH 21:30
Thadou: Ahivangin David chun hiche laimun a chu Pathen lung gahol a gache ding chu agel le mithat vantil chemjam toh gotsa dem a anaum jeh chun angapcha pon ahi.
English: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of the LORD’s angel.

tcz: Chuin David in aseitai, “Hilai mun hi Pathen Houin mun chu hiding ahitai, chule kilhaina, pumgo thilto namun jong hiding ahi.”
en: Then David said, “This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”
text:
1CH 22:1
Thadou: Chuin David in aseitai, “Hilai mun hi Pathen Houin mun chu hiding ahitai, chule kilhaina, pumgo thilto namun jong hiding ahi.”
English: Then David said, “This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Leng David in gamsung a kholjin mi jouse akoutup in, aboltheina cheh un Houin sah nading song khengjol loi apansah tai.
en: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.
text:
1CH 22:2
Thadou: Hijeh chun Leng David in gamsung a kholjin mi jouse akoutup in, aboltheina cheh un Houin sah nading song khengjol loi apansah tai.
English: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.

tcz: David in Kelkot a man ding thingkil semna din thih tampi leh sum eng te khopset apen ahi.
en: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,
text:
1CH 22:3
Thadou: David in Kelkot a man ding thingkil semna din thih tampi leh sum eng te khopset apen ahi.
English: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

tcz: Tyre le Sidon miten Leng David ana peh Cedar thingtum ho jongchu tampi ana peh thai.
en: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.
text:
1CH 22:4
Thadou: Tyre le Sidon miten Leng David ana peh Cedar thingtum ho jongchu tampi ana peh thai.
English: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

tcz: David in aseitai, “Kachapa Solomon hi achapang nalaiyin, jilna le hetna jong neibeh nailou hijongle, Pathenin anganse a Houin sahdoh ding hi loupi ding, minthang ding chuleh leiset pumpia dia jong nasatah hiding ahin, hijeh a chu tuahi kagonpeh pan ding ahitai.” Hijeh a hi David in athi masang a Houin sah nadia thil le lo tampi akoitup ahitai.
en: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.
text:
1CH 22:5
Thadou: David in aseitai, “Kachapa Solomon hi achapang nalaiyin, jilna le hetna jong neibeh nailou hijongle, Pathenin anganse a Houin sahdoh ding hi loupi ding, minthang ding chuleh leiset pumpia dia jong nasatah hiding ahin, hijeh a chu tuahi kagonpeh pan ding ahitai.” Hijeh a hi David in athi masang a Houin sah nadia thil le lo tampi akoitup ahitai.
English: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.

tcz: Hichun, David in achapa Solomon jah a Israelte Pathen chenna ding Houin theng asahdoh natei din athumop tai.
en: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
text:
1CH 22:6
Thadou: Hichun, David in achapa Solomon jah a Israelte Pathen chenna ding Houin theng asahdoh natei din athumop tai.
English: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.

tcz: “Kachapa, keiman ka Pathen jabol nadin a Houin theng khat kasadoh nom’e.” David in aseipeh in,
en: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.
text:
1CH 22:7
Thadou: “Kachapa, keiman ka Pathen jabol nadin a Houin theng khat kasadoh nom’e.” David in aseipeh in,
English: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.

tcz: “Ahivangin Pathenin kajah a aseiye, nangman nagalbolna munna mi tampi nathat tan”. “Chuleh, keima mitmua thisan tampi naso tah jeh a, nangman keima jabol nadia ka Houin theng nasah theilou ding ahitai”.
en: But the LORD’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.
text:
1CH 22:8
Thadou: “Ahivangin Pathenin kajah a aseiye, nangman nagalbolna munna mi tampi nathat tan”. “Chuleh, keima mitmua thisan tampi naso tah jeh a, nangman keima jabol nadia ka Houin theng nasah theilou ding ahitai”.
English: But the LORD’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

tcz: “Ahivang’a, Chamnasem chapa khat nahin ding ahi, aman Lengvai apoh sungsea Israel gam leh akimvel a agalmite kisan geiya chamdel a kalhat sah ding ahi. Amin Solomon kiti ding chuleh ama lengvai poh sung’a hi Israel cham kalensah ding ahi.”
en: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.
text:
1CH 22:9
Thadou: “Ahivang’a, Chamnasem chapa khat nahin ding ahi, aman Lengvai apoh sungsea Israel gam leh akimvel a agalmite kisan geiya chamdel a kalhat sah ding ahi. Amin Solomon kiti ding chuleh ama lengvai poh sung’a hi Israel cham kalensah ding ahi.”
English: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

tcz: “Ama hi ahi keima jabol nadia Houin theng sadoh ding chu. Kachapa deitah hintin, keima apa kahi ding ahi. Chuleh keiman a itih a alenggam sung’a chamna le lungmonna kapeh ding ahi.”
en: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
text:
1CH 22:10
Thadou: “Ama hi ahi keima jabol nadia Houin theng sadoh ding chu. Kachapa deitah hintin, keima apa kahi ding ahi. Chuleh keiman a itih a alenggam sung’a chamna le lungmonna kapeh ding ahi.”
English: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

tcz: Kacha tuhin, Pakaiyin nakithopi intin; aman nangma chungchang thudol’a asei tobang'in, nangman jong Pakai, Pathen houin nahinsah doh tei ding ahi.
en: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and prosper you, and build the house of the LORD your God, as he has spoken concerning you.
text:
1CH 22:11
Thadou: Kacha tuhin, Pakaiyin nakithopi intin; aman nangma chungchang thudol’a asei tobang'in, nangman jong Pakai, Pathen houin nahinsah doh tei ding ahi.
English: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and prosper you, and build the house of the LORD your God, as he has spoken concerning you.

tcz: Pakajin thil hetkhen themna le datkhenji dan napeh ding, Israel chunga vaihom a natun ding, ngansena nahin peh teng jongleh Pakai, na Pathen danthu nanit jingna dingin nabol peh tahen.
en: May the LORD give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.
text:
1CH 22:12
Thadou: Pakajin thil hetkhen themna le datkhenji dan napeh ding, Israel chunga vaihom a natun ding, ngansena nahin peh teng jongleh Pakai, na Pathen danthu nanit jingna dingin nabol peh tahen.
English: May the LORD give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.

tcz: Israelte dinga Pakaiyin Mose athupeh chonna dan ahin, chondan jouse chu nanit jing ding chule ching thei tah’a nakhan toupi thei ding ahi. Hijeh chun hat inlang, hang in, kicha hih hel in chule lungthoina jong nanei lou ding ahi.
en: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.
text:
1CH 22:13
Thadou: Israelte dinga Pakaiyin Mose athupeh chonna dan ahin, chondan jouse chu nanit jing ding chule ching thei tah’a nakhan toupi thei ding ahi. Hijeh chun hat inlang, hang in, kicha hih hel in chule lungthoina jong nanei lou ding ahi.
English: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.

tcz: Genthei hesohna tothon keiman Pakai houin sahdohna ding in, sana talent sang jakhat kakhol khom in ahi. Chule dangka talent nelkhat jong kakhol khom in, sum eng le thih jong ajat’a tekham valset kakhol khom e, ijeh-inem itileh atam in, in thil le lo jong kakhol khom soh keijin, hiche ho jouse hi nangman nabolbe ding ahina laiye.
en: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the LORD’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.
text:
1CH 22:14
Thadou: Genthei hesohna tothon keiman Pakai houin sahdohna ding in, sana talent sang jakhat kakhol khom in ahi. Chule dangka talent nelkhat jong kakhol khom in, sum eng le thih jong ajat’a tekham valset kakhol khom e, ijeh-inem itileh atam in, in thil le lo jong kakhol khom soh keijin, hiche ho jouse hi nangman nabolbe ding ahina laiye.
English: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the LORD’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.

tcz: Natong ding mihem tampi semdoh in: song kheng them miho, thing thembol miho, thing vaibol miho, aloi loija mihem simjou lou mihem khutthemna neiho nakoi ding, khut themna neitah beh,
en: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;

tcz: mi sana lha-them, dangka kheng them, sum-eng lha them, thih kheng them chule adang mitampi nakoi ding ahi. Tun kipat in na-tong tan, Pakaiyin napanpi jing tahen! ati.
en: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may the LORD be with you.”
text:
1CH 22:16
Thadou: mi sana lha-them, dangka kheng them, sum-eng lha them, thih kheng them chule adang mitampi nakoi ding ahi. Tun kipat in na-tong tan, Pakaiyin napanpi jing tahen! ati.
English: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may the LORD be with you.”

tcz: Chuin David in Israel mite sunga lamkai chengse thupeh aneiyin, achapa Solomon akithopi diuvin thu aseijin ahi.
en: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
text:
1CH 22:17
Thadou: Chuin David in Israel mite sunga lamkai chengse thupeh aneiyin, achapa Solomon akithopi diuvin thu aseijin ahi.
English: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

tcz: “Pakai, na Pathen uvin nangho napanpi jingo hilou ham? Amatah in na jet le naveiju hungkon nagal miteu asuh thip’a chamna naneiju hilou ham? Ajeh chu Pakai, amatah in agamsunga cheng mite chu keima khut’a apedoh in, hijeh chun agamsung jouse hi Pakai ansung leh amite masanga suh-nem’a uma, mite noija kikunsah ahitai.
en: “Isn’t the LORD your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD and before his people.
text:
1CH 22:18
Thadou: “Pakai, na Pathen uvin nangho napanpi jingo hilou ham? Amatah in na jet le naveiju hungkon nagal miteu asuh thip’a chamna naneiju hilou ham? Ajeh chu Pakai, amatah in agamsunga cheng mite chu keima khut’a apedoh in, hijeh chun agamsung jouse hi Pakai ansung leh amite masanga suh-nem’a uma, mite noija kikunsah ahitai.
English: “Isn’t the LORD your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD and before his people.

tcz: Tun nang hon na lungthim pumpiu Pakai, na Pathen-u hol tauvin. Kipat un Pakai, Pathen muntheng houin satauvin; chutileh Pakai kitepna thingkong le Pathen houin a manchah bel le um chule thilkeo atheng jouse hiche Pakai dinga houin kisadoh sunga chu pohlut’a umding ahitai,” ati.
en: Now set your heart and your soul to follow the LORD your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for the LORD’s name.”
text:
1CH 22:19
Thadou: Tun nang hon na lungthim pumpiu Pakai, na Pathen-u hol tauvin. Kipat un Pakai, Pathen muntheng houin satauvin; chutileh Pakai kitepna thingkong le Pathen houin a manchah bel le um chule thilkeo atheng jouse hiche Pakai dinga houin kisadoh sunga chu pohlut’a umding ahitai,” ati.
English: Now set your heart and your soul to follow the LORD your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for the LORD’s name.”

tcz: Chuin David ahung teh in, akum atamphat in achapa Solomon chu Isrealte lengpan apansah tai
en: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
text:
1CH 23:1
Thadou: Chuin David ahung teh in, akum atamphat in achapa Solomon chu Isrealte lengpan apansah tai
English: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

tcz: Aman Isreal gam a lengte, thempuho chule Levi mite akhom in ahi
en: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
text:
1CH 23:2
Thadou: Aman Isreal gam a lengte, thempuho chule Levi mite akhom in ahi
English: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

tcz: Levite chu kum somthum apat chunglam se chu khat khat in akisim un, pasal mi sangsom thumle get alhing ui.
en: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.
text:
1CH 23:3
Thadou: Levite chu kum somthum apat chunglam se chu khat khat in akisim un, pasal mi sangsom thumle get alhing ui.
English: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

tcz: Hinlah mi sang somni le sang li chu Pathen houin sunga naa atoh sah in, chule mi sang gup chu alamkai le thutan vaihom dingin apansah tai.
en: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the LORD’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,
text:
1CH 23:4
Thadou: Hinlah mi sang somni le sang li chu Pathen houin sunga naa atoh sah in, chule mi sang gup chu alamkai le thutan vaihom dingin apansah tai.
English: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the LORD’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,

tcz: Chukitle mi sangli chu kot ngah din akoi in, mi sangli ma chu aman apeh tumging ho mangchan Pathen vahchoi jing dingin umhen tin David in aseije.
en: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”
text:
1CH 23:5
Thadou: Chukitle mi sangli chu kot ngah din akoi in, mi sangli ma chu aman apeh tumging ho mangchan Pathen vahchoi jing dingin umhen tin David in aseije.
English: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”

tcz: Chuin David chu Levi chate Gershon, kohath le Merari min in akhen kit in ahi.
en: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
text:
1CH 23:6
Thadou: Chuin David chu Levi chate Gershon, kohath le Merari min in akhen kit in ahi.
English: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

tcz: Gershon mite hochu Laaadan le Shimei ahi
en: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
text:
1CH 23:7
Thadou: Gershon mite hochu Laaadan le Shimei ahi
English: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

tcz: Laadan chate chu Jehiel le Zatham le Joel agom a thum
en: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.
text:
1CH 23:8
Thadou: Laadan chate chu Jehiel le Zatham le Joel agom a thum
English: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.

tcz: Shimei chate chu Shelomith leh Heziel le Haran ahi. Amaho hi Laadan insunga mi upa ho ahiuve
en: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.
text:
1CH 23:9
Thadou: Shimei chate chu Shelomith leh Heziel le Haran ahi. Amaho hi Laadan insunga mi upa ho ahiuve
English: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

tcz: Chule Shimei chate chu Jahath, Ziza, Zeush chule Beriah. Amaho li hi Shimei chate ahiuve.
en: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
text:
1CH 23:10
Thadou: Chule Shimei chate chu Jahath, Ziza, Zeush chule Beriah. Amaho li hi Shimei chate ahiuve.
English: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

tcz: Chule Jahath chu Haosa lamkai ana hin, Zizah chu ani channa anahi, amavang Jeush chule Beriah teni hin chapa tampi ana hing lhon lou jeh in pakhat insung in akisim tai.
en: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
text:
1CH 23:11
Thadou: Chule Jahath chu Haosa lamkai ana hin, Zizah chu ani channa anahi, amavang Jeush chule Beriah teni hin chapa tampi ana hing lhon lou jeh in pakhat insung in akisim tai.
English: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.

tcz: Kohath hin chapa li ana hingin amahochu; Amran, Izahar, Hebron chule Uzziel ana hiuve.
en: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
text:
1CH 23:12
Thadou: Kohath hin chapa li ana hingin amahochu; Amran, Izahar, Hebron chule Uzziel ana hiuve.
English: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

tcz: Amaram cha Pasal teni chu Aaron chule Mose ana hi. Aaron hin Pathen a dingin pumgo thilto ana lhantheng jing thei nadia chule ama achapaten atonsot a Pathen anga thilto gimnamtwi ana hal jing uva; ama lenggam a dinga akipehdoh jing uva, chule ama minna phatthei achan jing thei nadiuvin, asopipa toh ana ki sukhen in ahi.
en: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.
text:
1CH 23:13
Thadou: Amaram cha Pasal teni chu Aaron chule Mose ana hi. Aaron hin Pathen a dingin pumgo thilto ana lhantheng jing thei nadia chule ama achapaten atonsot a Pathen anga thilto gimnamtwi ana hal jing uva; ama lenggam a dinga akipehdoh jing uva, chule ama minna phatthei achan jing thei nadiuvin, asopipa toh ana ki sukhen in ahi.
English: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.

tcz: Mose hi Pathen mipan ana kisim in ahi. Achapa techu Levi chilhah noiya ana ki minvon ahi.
en: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
text:
1CH 23:14
Thadou: Mose hi Pathen mipan ana kisim in ahi. Achapa techu Levi chilhah noiya ana ki minvon ahi.
English: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

tcz: Mose chapa techu Gershom chule Eleizer ana hi hone.
en: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
text:
1CH 23:15
Thadou: Mose chapa techu Gershom chule Eleizer ana hi hone.
English: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

tcz: Gershom chapa telah a chun Shebul chu ana haosa lamkaiyin ahi,
