en: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
text:
1CH 23:16
Thadou: Gershom chapa telah a chun Shebul chu ana haosa lamkaiyin ahi,
English: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

tcz: Chule Eleizer chapate lah a Rehabiah chu ana Haosa lamkaiyin ahi. Eleizer hin chapa dang ana hingpon ahi, amavang Rehabia hin chapa tampi ana hing in ahi.
en: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
text:
1CH 23:17
Thadou: Chule Eleizer chapate lah a Rehabiah chu ana Haosa lamkaiyin ahi. Eleizer hin chapa dang ana hingpon ahi, amavang Rehabia hin chapa tampi ana hing in ahi.
English: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

tcz: Izhar chapa te lah a Shalomith chu ana haosa lamkaiyin ahi.
en: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
text:
1CH 23:18
Thadou: Izhar chapa te lah a Shalomith chu ana haosa lamkaiyin ahi.
English: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

tcz: Hebron chapate lah a Jeriah chu ana tah pen in ahi, Amariah chu anina an hin, Jahaziel chu athumna chule Jekameam chu ali channa ana hi.
en: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
text:
1CH 23:19
Thadou: Hebron chapate lah a Jeriah chu ana tah pen in ahi, Amariah chu anina an hin, Jahaziel chu athumna chule Jekameam chu ali channa ana hi.
English: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

tcz: Uzziel chapate lah a Micah chu atahpen in chule Issiah chu ani channa ana hi.
en: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.
text:
1CH 23:20
Thadou: Uzziel chapate lah a Micah chu atahpen in chule Issiah chu ani channa ana hi.
English: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.

tcz: Merari Chate ho chu Mahli le Mushi ahin Mahli chapate chu Mahli, Eleazer le Kish ahiuve.
en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
text:
1CH 23:21
Thadou: Merari Chate ho chu Mahli le Mushi ahin Mahli chapate chu Mahli, Eleazer le Kish ahiuve.
English: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

tcz: Chapa neilouva Eleazar thi chule chanu bou anei in ahi. Chule asopi Kish chapaten achanu te akichen pin ahi.
en: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.
text:
1CH 23:22
Thadou: Chapa neilouva Eleazar thi chule chanu bou anei in ahi. Chule asopi Kish chapaten achanu te akichen pin ahi.
English: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

tcz: Mushi Chateho chu Athum uvin- Mahli, Eder chule Jeremoth ho ahiuve
en: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
text:
1CH 23:23
Thadou: Mushi Chateho chu Athum uvin- Mahli, Eder chule Jeremoth ho ahiuve
English: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

tcz: Hichengse hi Levi insungmi le ason apah ho chengse ahiuve- amin kikhumlut dungjui in insung lamkai ho chengse jong achangseh'in akisim in ahi
en: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the LORD’s house, from twenty years old and upward.
text:
1CH 23:24
Thadou: Hichengse hi Levi insungmi le ason apah ho chengse ahiuve- amin kikhumlut dungjui in insung lamkai ho chengse jong achangseh'in akisim in ahi
English: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the LORD’s house, from twenty years old and upward.

tcz: Chuin David in, Isreal Pathen chun amite cholngah sah in chule atonsot a Jerusalem a cheng ding ahi.
en: For David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.
text:
1CH 23:25
Thadou: Chuin David in, Isreal Pathen chun amite cholngah sah in chule atonsot a Jerusalem a cheng ding ahi.
English: For David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.

tcz: Pathen houbuh a kimang le athil ho chengse jong Levi ten anungpoh kit lou diu ahitai.
en: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”
text:
1CH 23:26
Thadou: Pathen houbuh a kimang le athil ho chengse jong Levi ten anungpoh kit lou diu ahitai.
English: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”

tcz: David hilchah na achainapen dungjui in, Levi techu kum somni a tah le achunglam apat kisim pan ahi.
en: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.
text:
1CH 23:27
Thadou: David hilchah na achainapen dungjui in, Levi techu kum somni a tah le achunglam apat kisim pan ahi.
English: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.

tcz: Levi techun Pathen houbuh a Aaron chapate akithopiuva, indan ho sutheng le ding, thil thengho koitup ding chule Pathen houbuh a natoh chengse vetup ding ahiuve.
en: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the LORD’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;

tcz: Dokhanga changlhah luidoh ding, todoh ding changbong ho chule ajat alet aneo dungjui a haltoh ding chengse jong avettup diu ahi.
en: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;

tcz: Jingkah seh le ding uva Pathena vahchoi dingu ahi. Nilhah le angaima banga abol kit diu ahi.
en: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise in the evening;

tcz: Chule amahon Sabbath nikho le Lhathah nikho a Pakai anga thilto abol teng ule amijat ana ngaichat dungjui a abol diu ahi.
en: and to offer all burnt offerings to the LORD on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before the LORD;

tcz: Hiti chun Leviten ten ponbuh a kinbol hihen muntheng kibol hihen, asopiu Aaron chapate chu Pakai kibol na’a akithopi jing diu ahi.
en: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of the LORD’s house.
text:
1CH 23:32
Thadou: Hiti chun Leviten ten ponbuh a kinbol hihen muntheng kibol hihen, asopiu Aaron chapate chu Pakai kibol na’a akithopi jing diu ahi.
English: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of the LORD’s house.

tcz: Aaron chapate kihop khen dan chu hiti hi ahi: Nadab ahin, Abihu ahin, Eleazer leh Ethamar amaho cheng hi ahiuve.
en: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
text:
1CH 24:1
Thadou: Aaron chapate kihop khen dan chu hiti hi ahi: Nadab ahin, Abihu ahin, Eleazer leh Ethamar amaho cheng hi ahiuve.
English: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

tcz: Nadab le Abihu hi apa sang in athimasa lhon in, chajong aneiman lhon tapoi; chuin Eleazer leh Ithamar chu thempu ahung hilhon tai.
en: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
text:
1CH 24:2
Thadou: Nadab le Abihu hi apa sang in athimasa lhon in, chajong aneiman lhon tapoi; chuin Eleazer leh Ithamar chu thempu ahung hilhon tai.
English: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

tcz: Eleazar chapate lah'a kon’le Zadok le Ithamar chapate lah’a kon Ahimelech panpina jal’in David chun ama ama natoh ding toh kisaijin agoltoh sohkeijun ahi.
en: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.
text:
1CH 24:3
Thadou: Eleazar chapate lah'a kon’le Zadok le Ithamar chapate lah’a kon Ahimelech panpina jal’in David chun ama ama natoh ding toh kisaijin agoltoh sohkeijun ahi.
English: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.

tcz: Ithamar chapate sang in, Eleazar chapate sunga chun miupa atam un, hijeh chun Eleazar chapate lah’a chun apu apateu insung lhahdol cheh in, lamkai somle gup alhengdoh un, amaho lamkai nan aum un ahi. Chule Ithamar chapte ding in lamkai miget bou ana lhengdoh un ahi.
en: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.
text:
1CH 24:4
Thadou: Ithamar chapate sang in, Eleazar chapate sunga chun miupa atam un, hijeh chun Eleazar chapate lah’a chun apu apateu insung lhahdol cheh in, lamkai somle gup alhengdoh un, amaho lamkai nan aum un ahi. Chule Ithamar chapte ding in lamkai miget bou ana lhengdoh un ahi.
English: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.

tcz: Akilhengdoh le lamkaija kipansah hohi kibang chetna vang kisansah ahiuvin, hitia akibolnaa kon chun Eleazar leh Ithamar chapate lah’a kon in, muntheng a natong vaihom dingleh Pathen natohna vaibol ding tampi kisepdoh ahi.
en: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
text:
1CH 24:5
Thadou: Akilhengdoh le lamkaija kipansah hohi kibang chetna vang kisansah ahiuvin, hitia akibolnaa kon chun Eleazar leh Ithamar chapate lah’a kon in, muntheng a natong vaihom dingleh Pathen natohna vaibol ding tampi kisepdoh ahi.
English: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

tcz: Nathanel kiti Levi mi Shemiah hi danthu them ahin, amaho chengse chu lengpa le milen milalte angsung, Zadok thempupa angsung le Abiathar chapa Ahimelech angsung le thempu ho chule Levi miho, apu apateuva pat phung upa chengse lekha in ajihlut tan ahi; ajeh chu pa khang khat lhahse chu Eleazar insunga kon kilhengdoh ahin, chule pa khang khat lhah chengse ma chu Ithamar insunga dia kilhengdoh ahi.
en: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
text:
1CH 24:6
Thadou: Nathanel kiti Levi mi Shemiah hi danthu them ahin, amaho chengse chu lengpa le milen milalte angsung, Zadok thempupa angsung le Abiathar chapa Ahimelech angsung le thempu ho chule Levi miho, apu apateuva pat phung upa chengse lekha in ajihlut tan ahi; ajeh chu pa khang khat lhahse chu Eleazar insunga kon kilhengdoh ahin, chule pa khang khat lhah chengse ma chu Ithamar insunga dia kilhengdoh ahi.
English: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

tcz: Vang kisan masapen chu Jehoiarib chunga achun, chuin ani na chu Jedaiah chunga achun,
en: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
text:
1CH 24:7
Thadou: Vang kisan masapen chu Jehoiarib chunga achun, chuin ani na chu Jedaiah chunga achun,
English: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

tcz: athumna chu Harim chunga achun; alina chu Seorim chunga achun,
en: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
text:
1CH 24:8
Thadou: athumna chu Harim chunga achun; alina chu Seorim chunga achun,
English: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

tcz: angana chu Malchijah chunga achun, agupna Mijamin chunga achun,
en: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
text:
1CH 24:9
Thadou: angana chu Malchijah chunga achun, agupna Mijamin chunga achun,
English: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

tcz: asagina chu Hakkoz chunga achun, agetna chu Abijah chunga achun,
en: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
text:
1CH 24:10
Thadou: asagina chu Hakkoz chunga achun, agetna chu Abijah chunga achun,
English: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

tcz: akonan Jeshua chunga achun, asomna Shecaniah chunga achun,
en: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
text:
1CH 24:11
Thadou: akonan Jeshua chunga achun, asomna Shecaniah chunga achun,
English: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

tcz: asom le khatna Eliashib chunga achun, asomle nina chu Jakim chunga achun,
en: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
text:
1CH 24:12
Thadou: asom le khatna Eliashib chunga achun, asomle nina chu Jakim chunga achun,
English: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

tcz: asomle thumna chu Huppah chunga achun, asomle li na chu Jeshebeab chunga achun,
en: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
text:
1CH 24:13
Thadou: asomle thumna chu Huppah chunga achun, asomle li na chu Jeshebeab chunga achun,
English: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

tcz: asomle nga na chu Bilgah chunga achun, asomle gup na chu Immer chunga achun,
en: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
text:
1CH 24:14
Thadou: asomle nga na chu Bilgah chunga achun, asomle gup na chu Immer chunga achun,
English: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

tcz: asom le sagi na chu Hezir chunga achun, asomle get na chu Happizzer chunga achun,
en: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
text:
1CH 24:15
Thadou: asom le sagi na chu Hezir chunga achun, asomle get na chu Happizzer chunga achun,
English: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

tcz: asomle ko na chu Pethahiah chunga achun, somni na chu Jehezkel chunga achun,
en: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
text:
1CH 24:16
Thadou: asomle ko na chu Pethahiah chunga achun, somni na chu Jehezkel chunga achun,
English: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

tcz: asomni le khat na chu Jachin chunga achun, asomni le ni na chu Gamul chunga achun,
en: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
text:
1CH 24:17
Thadou: asomni le khat na chu Jachin chunga achun, asomni le ni na chu Gamul chunga achun,
English: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

tcz: asomni le thumna chu Delaiah chunga achun, asomni le li nah cu Maaziah chunga achun ahi.
en: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
text:
1CH 24:18
Thadou: asomni le thumna chu Delaiah chunga achun, asomni le li nah cu Maaziah chunga achun ahi.
English: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

tcz: Amaho chengse hi akipansahna cheh uvin, natoh ding anei cheh un, Pathen houin sung ahung lut phat uleh, Pakai, Israel Pathen in Apupau Aaron thu anapeh bang leh, Aaron in amaho chengse tohding agontoh bang in atohdiuva kilom cheng chu atong jiuvin ahi.
en: This was their ordering in their service, to come into the LORD’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
text:
1CH 24:19
Thadou: Amaho chengse hi akipansahna cheh uvin, natoh ding anei cheh un, Pathen houin sung ahung lut phat uleh, Pakai, Israel Pathen in Apupau Aaron thu anapeh bang leh, Aaron in amaho chengse tohding agontoh bang in atohdiuva kilom cheng chu atong jiuvin ahi.
English: This was their ordering in their service, to come into the LORD’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.

tcz: Levi chapate adangse chu: Amran chapatea kon Shubael, chule Shubael chapatea kon Jehdeiah ahi.
en: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
text:
1CH 24:20
Thadou: Levi chapate adangse chu: Amran chapatea kon Shubael, chule Shubael chapatea kon Jehdeiah ahi.
English: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

tcz: Rehabiah chapate chu: Rehabiah chapatea kon Isshiah chu aupa pen ahi.
en: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
text:
1CH 24:21
Thadou: Rehabiah chapate chu: Rehabiah chapatea kon Isshiah chu aupa pen ahi.
English: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

tcz: Izhar chapatea kon Shelomoth ahin, Shelomoth chapatea kon Jahath ahi.
en: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
text:
1CH 24:22
Thadou: Izhar chapatea kon Shelomoth ahin, Shelomoth chapatea kon Jahath ahi.
English: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

tcz: Hebron chapate chu: Jeriah chu aupapen ahin, ani channapa chu Amariah ahin, athum channapa chu Jahaziel ahin, ali channapa chu Jekameam ahi.
en: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
text:
1CH 24:23
Thadou: Hebron chapate chu: Jeriah chu aupapen ahin, ani channapa chu Amariah ahin, athum channapa chu Jahaziel ahin, ali channapa chu Jekameam ahi.
English: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

tcz: Uzziel chapatea kon Micah ahin, Micah chapatea kon Shamir ahi.
en: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
text:
1CH 24:24
Thadou: Uzziel chapatea kon Micah ahin, Micah chapatea kon Shamir ahi.
English: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

tcz: Micah sopipa chu Isshiah ahin, Isshiah chapatea kon Zechariah ahi.
en: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
text:
1CH 24:25
Thadou: Micah sopipa chu Isshiah ahin, Isshiah chapatea kon Zechariah ahi.
English: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

tcz: Merari chapate ni chu Jaaziah Mahli le Mushi ahilhon e. Jaaziah chapatea kon Beno ahi.
en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
text:
1CH 24:26
Thadou: Merari chapate ni chu Jaaziah Mahli le Mushi ahilhon e. Jaaziah chapatea kon Beno ahi.
English: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

tcz: Merari chapate chu Jaaziah chapatea kon Beno le Shoham, Zaccur le Ibri ahiuve.
en: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
text:
1CH 24:27
Thadou: Merari chapate chu Jaaziah chapatea kon Beno le Shoham, Zaccur le Ibri ahiuve.
English: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

tcz: Mahil chapa chu: Eleazar ahin, amapa hin chapa ana hing tapoi.
en: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
text:
1CH 24:28
Thadou: Mahil chapa chu: Eleazar ahin, amapa hin chapa ana hing tapoi.
English: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

tcz: Kish akon Kish chapatea kon Jerahmeel ahi.
en: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.
text:
1CH 24:29
Thadou: Kish akon Kish chapatea kon Jerahmeel ahi.
English: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.

tcz: Mushi chapate chu Mahli le Eder chule Jerimoth ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Levi mitea kon chapa, apu apateu lhah’a ama insung cheh’a kon kisimdoh ahiuve.
en: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.
text:
1CH 24:30
Thadou: Mushi chapate chu Mahli le Eder chule Jerimoth ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi Levi mitea kon chapa, apu apateu lhah’a ama insung cheh’a kon kisimdoh ahiuve.
English: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.

tcz: Amaho chengse hin apa jang lhah insung cheh in, asopiteu umchan bang in Aaron chapate nunle khan athouvin ahi. David lengpa angsung le Zadok angsung, Ahimelech chule thempu ho apu apateu insung cheh’a kon chule Levi miho masanga chun vang akisan cheh tauve.
en: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
text:
1CH 24:31
Thadou: Amaho chengse hin apa jang lhah insung cheh in, asopiteu umchan bang in Aaron chapate nunle khan athouvin ahi. David lengpa angsung le Zadok angsung, Ahimelech chule thempu ho apu apateu insung cheh’a kon chule Levi miho masanga chun vang akisan cheh tauve.
English: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.

tcz: David le a sepai jalamkaiten Asaph, Heman chule Jeduthun insungmi chu Kipana thupha sapphong tohthoa semjang gin ngei, tumging chule Khutbeh la lamkai din alhengdoh taove.
en: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:
text:
1CH 25:1
Thadou: David le a sepai jalamkaiten Asaph, Heman chule Jeduthun insungmi chu Kipana thupha sapphong tohthoa semjang gin ngei, tumging chule Khutbeh la lamkai din alhengdoh taove.
English: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:

tcz: Asaph chapate Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah chule Asarelah in jong a pau maikainan lengpa thupeh dungjuiyin kipana thupha chu alhangsap uve.
en: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.
text:
1CH 25:2
Thadou: Asaph chapate Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah chule Asarelah in jong a pau maikainan lengpa thupeh dungjuiyin kipana thupha chu alhangsap uve.
English: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.

tcz: Heduthun chapate, Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshiah, Shimei, Hashabiah chule Mattithah mi gup cheng hin jong a pau makainan semjang gin ngei, thangvah le vahchoi toh thon kipana thupha sapphong toh thon Pathen athangvah uve.
en: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp.
text:
1CH 25:3
Thadou: Heduthun chapate, Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshiah, Shimei, Hashabiah chule Mattithah mi gup cheng hin jong a pau makainan semjang gin ngei, thangvah le vahchoi toh thon kipana thupha sapphong toh thon Pathen athangvah uve.
English: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp.

tcz: Heman chapate chu Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romam’ti-e’zer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir chule Mahazioth cheng hi ahiuve.
en: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
text:
1CH 25:4
Thadou: Heman chapate chu Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romam’ti-e’zer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir chule Mahazioth cheng hi ahiuve.
English: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

tcz: Lengpa Themgao a pang Heman hin Pakaiya a konin chapa Somle li le chanu thum ahing e.
en: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
text:
1CH 25:5
Thadou: Lengpa Themgao a pang Heman hin Pakaiya a konin chapa Somle li le chanu thum ahing e.
English: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

tcz: Heman le achapate chu Houin sunga tumging thei, Selangdah gin ngei, Semjang sai chule khutbeh a Pakai vahchoina lamkaiya pang ahiuve. Chule ijakaiyin, Asaph, Jeduthun chule Heman jong lengpa toh aki thukop jing uve.
en: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the LORD’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.
text:
1CH 25:6
Thadou: Heman le achapate chu Houin sunga tumging thei, Selangdah gin ngei, Semjang sai chule khutbeh a Pakai vahchoina lamkaiya pang ahiuve. Chule ijakaiyin, Asaph, Jeduthun chule Heman jong lengpa toh aki thukop jing uve.
English: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the LORD’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

tcz: Amaho insung hi Pakai vahchoi na mun a tumging sai ding mong a hung kitillu ahi. Abonchauvin tumging sai thei cheh mi Jani somget le get alhing uve.
en: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to the LORD, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.
text:
1CH 25:7
Thadou: Amaho insung hi Pakai vahchoi na mun a tumging sai ding mong a hung kitillu ahi. Abonchauvin tumging sai thei cheh mi Jani somget le get alhing uve.
English: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to the LORD, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.

tcz: Mi hichengse hi teh le khang hihen jilkung le simlai umlouvin athepna cheh uva apang un chuleh vang kibang in akisan cheh uve.
en: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.
text:
1CH 25:8
Thadou: Mi hichengse hi teh le khang hihen jilkung le simlai umlouvin athepna cheh uva apang un chuleh vang kibang in akisan cheh uve.
English: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.

tcz: Mi jani somget le get ho hin, chapa somle ni cheh in asauvin, hichengse ho hi hop somni le li in aki homson uvin asopite cheng to vang akisan uve.Vang kisan masapen chu Asaph chilhah lah a Joseph le asopite ahiuvin. Anina a vang kisan chu Gedaliah le asopite ahi,
en: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;

tcz: a somle sagi na Joshbekashah,
en: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

tcz: a somni le thumna Mahazioth,
en: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

tcz: a somni le li na Romamti-ezer.
en: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
text:
1CH 25:31
Thadou: a somni le li na Romamti-ezer.
English: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

tcz: Kelkotbul ngah ho kivaihop dan chu hiti ahi: Korah chilhah a konna Kore chapa Meshelemiah kitipa hi Abiasaph insung a kon ahi.
en: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
text:
1CH 26:1
Thadou: Kelkotbul ngah ho kivaihop dan chu hiti ahi: Korah chilhah a konna Kore chapa Meshelemiah kitipa hi Abiasaph insung a kon ahi.
English: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

tcz: Meshelemiah in chapa sagi ahin chu atahpen Zechariah ahin, abanna Jediael, Zebadiah, Jathniel,
en: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
text:
1CH 26:2
Thadou: Meshelemiah in chapa sagi ahin chu atahpen Zechariah ahin, abanna Jediael, Zebadiah, Jathniel,
English: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

tcz: Elam, Jehohanan chuleh Eliehoenai ahiuve.
en: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.
text:
1CH 26:3
Thadou: Elam, Jehohanan chuleh Eliehoenai ahiuve.
English: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

tcz: Kelkot ngahpa Obed-edom chu Pathenin chapa get jenin phattheina dimset aboh in, amaho cheng chu atahpen Shemaiah, Jehozabad, Joah, Sacar, Nethanel,
en: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
text:
1CH 26:4
Thadou: Kelkot ngahpa Obed-edom chu Pathenin chapa get jenin phattheina dimset aboh in, amaho cheng chu atahpen Shemaiah, Jehozabad, Joah, Sacar, Nethanel,
English: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

tcz: Ammiel, Issachar chule Peullethai ahiuve.
en: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
text:
1CH 26:5
Thadou: Ammiel, Issachar chule Peullethai ahiuve.
English: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

tcz: Obed-edom chapa Shemaiah chun chapa miboltheicheh ahing’in a phungsung u vaihom na a panmun nasatah alo cheh uve.
en: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.
text:
1CH 26:6
Thadou: Obed-edom chapa Shemaiah chun chapa miboltheicheh ahing’in a phungsung u vaihom na a panmun nasatah alo cheh uve.
English: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

tcz: Amaho chengse chu ahile, Othni, Rephael, Obed chule Elzabad ahiuve. Chubanle, asopiteniu Elihu le Semakiah jongchu miboltheitah ma ahi lhon e.
en: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
text:
1CH 26:7
Thadou: Amaho chengse chu ahile, Othni, Rephael, Obed chule Elzabad ahiuve. Chubanle, asopiteniu Elihu le Semakiah jongchu miboltheitah ma ahi lhon e.
English: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

tcz: Obed-edom chilhah, achapate le a tute mi somgup le ni chengse hi natohna a feltah le bolthei cheh ahiuve.
en: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.
text:
1CH 26:8
Thadou: Obed-edom chilhah, achapate le a tute mi somgup le ni chengse hi natohna a feltah le bolthei cheh ahiuve.
English: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

tcz: Meshelemiah chapate mi somle get le asopite chengse hi miboltheitah ahicheh uve.
en: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.
text:
1CH 26:9
Thadou: Meshelemiah chapate mi somle get le asopite chengse hi miboltheitah ahicheh uve.
English: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

tcz: Merari phungsung a konin Hosah chun Shimri chu achapate lah a atahpen ahilouvangin lamkai din alhengdoh tai.
en: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),
text:
1CH 26:10
Thadou: Merari phungsung a konin Hosah chun Shimri chu achapate lah a atahpen ahilouvangin lamkai din alhengdoh tai.
English: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

tcz: Achapate chu aninapa Hilkiah, Tebaliah, Zechariah jong ahiuvin. Hosah chapate le asopite mi somle thum chengse chu kelkot ngah in apang uve.
en: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.
text:
1CH 26:11
Thadou: Achapate chu aninapa Hilkiah, Tebaliah, Zechariah jong ahiuvin. Hosah chapate le asopite mi somle thum chengse chu kelkot ngah in apang uve.
English: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

tcz: Hitobanga kelkot ngah ho kivaihop danhi Levi dangho banga a insungmi cheh in Pakai na chu atoh u ahi.
en: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in the LORD’s house.
text:
1CH 26:12
Thadou: Hitobanga kelkot ngah ho kivaihop danhi Levi dangho banga a insungmi cheh in Pakai na chu atoh u ahi.
English: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in the LORD’s house.

tcz: Kelkot ngah dia kelkot tin a insungmiten ahin deilhen hi kumle lha hihen, theple theplou man a kive hilouin a vang kisan dungjui a pang ji ahiuve.
en: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.
text:
1CH 26:13
Thadou: Kelkot ngah dia kelkot tin a insungmiten ahin deilhen hi kumle lha hihen, theple theplou man a kive hilouin a vang kisan dungjui a pang ji ahiuve.
English: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

tcz: Solam kelkot ngah a pang din Meshelemiah le aloite nganse ahitaovin, sahlam chu michingtah a kihepa Zechariah,
en: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
text:
1CH 26:14
Thadou: Solam kelkot ngah a pang din Meshelemiah le aloite nganse ahitaovin, sahlam chu michingtah a kihepa Zechariah,
English: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

tcz: Lhanglam kelkot chu Obed-edom nganse ahin, achapate chu thilkholna kelkot ngah in apang uve.
en: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.
text:
1CH 26:15
Thadou: Lhanglam kelkot chu Obed-edom nganse ahin, achapate chu thilkholna kelkot ngah in apang uve.
English: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

tcz: Shuppim le Hosah chu lhumlam kelkot apat a Shallecheth kelkot changei ngah din lamkai a apang lhonin, anga pi hochu akimaingat sah in limgeh in apang uve.
en: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.
text:
1CH 26:16
Thadou: Shuppim le Hosah chu lhumlam kelkot apat a Shallecheth kelkot changei ngah din lamkai a apang lhonin, anga pi hochu akimaingat sah in limgeh in apang uve.
English: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

tcz: Solam kelkot phung chun niseh in mi gup, sahlam a mi li, lhanglam a mi li ma chuleh mi li kingato cheh in thilkhol na kelkot phung in apang jing’ui.
en: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.
text:
1CH 26:17
Thadou: Solam kelkot phung chun niseh in mi gup, sahlam a mi li, lhanglam a mi li ma chuleh mi li kingato cheh in thilkhol na kelkot phung in apang jing’ui.
English: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

tcz: Lhumlam kelkot phunga mi gup chuleh mi li chu kotpi a kon a Shallecheth chan apang un, mi ni ma avel lah chun apang’e.
en: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
text:
1CH 26:18
Thadou: Lhumlam kelkot phunga mi gup chuleh mi li chu kotpi a kon a Shallecheth chan apang un, mi ni ma avel lah chun apang’e.
English: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

tcz: Korah le Merari phungsung a kelkot ngah ho kivaihopdan hiti chu ahi.
en: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.
text:
1CH 26:19
Thadou: Korah le Merari phungsung a kelkot ngah ho kivaihopdan hiti chu ahi.
English: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

tcz: Ahijah lamkainan maicham thilkhol namun le houin gou ho khol namun avetup uve.
en: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
text:
1CH 26:20
Thadou: Ahijah lamkainan maicham thilkhol namun le houin gou ho khol namun avetup uve.
English: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

tcz: Gershon phungkhai, Libni insung’a konin Jehiel chu lamkai khat in apang’e.
en: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
text:
1CH 26:21
Thadou: Gershon phungkhai, Libni insung’a konin Jehiel chu lamkai khat in apang’e.
English: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

tcz: Jehiel, Zetham chule Joel chapate jong Pathen maicham thilkhol namun chu ngah din nganse na achang taove.
en: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the LORD’s house.
text:
1CH 26:22
Thadou: Jehiel, Zetham chule Joel chapate jong Pathen maicham thilkhol namun chu ngah din nganse na achang taove.
English: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the LORD’s house.

tcz: Hiche lamkai a pang cheng hi Amram, Izhar, Hebron chuleh Uzziel chilhah ahiuve.
en: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
text:
1CH 26:23
Thadou: Hiche lamkai a pang cheng hi Amram, Izhar, Hebron chuleh Uzziel chilhah ahiuve.
English: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

tcz: Amram phungsung a dia, Shebuel chu Mose chapa, Gershom chilhah ahin.
en: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.
text:
1CH 26:24
Thadou: Amram phungsung a dia, Shebuel chu Mose chapa, Gershom chilhah ahin.
English: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.

tcz: Asopite Eliezer in ahin ho chu, Rehabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zocri chule Shelomoth ahiuve.
en: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
text:
1CH 26:25
Thadou: Asopite Eliezer in ahin ho chu, Rehabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zocri chule Shelomoth ahiuve.
English: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

tcz: Shelomoth le asopite hi Leng David, insung lamkai pipu, sepai jalamkai chuleh mi thupi hon Pakaiya dia maicham thilto a ahin peh hou anga u ahi.
en: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.
text:
1CH 26:26
Thadou: Shelomoth le asopite hi Leng David, insung lamkai pipu, sepai jalamkai chuleh mi thupi hon Pakaiya dia maicham thilto a ahin peh hou anga u ahi.
English: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.

tcz: Galmun a kon a kichomkhom thilhoi lai2 ho jong Pakai Houin sunga manchah le din ahin lhandoh jiuve.
en: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair the LORD’s house.
text:
1CH 26:27
Thadou: Galmun a kon a kichomkhom thilhoi lai2 ho jong Pakai Houin sunga manchah le din ahin lhandoh jiuve.
English: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair the LORD’s house.

tcz: Chujongle, Shelomoth le asopiten Themgao Samuel, kish chapa Saul, Ner chapa Abner le Zeruiah chapa Joab thilto ho jong achingtup jing uve.
en: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.
text:
1CH 26:28
Thadou: Chujongle, Shelomoth le asopiten Themgao Samuel, kish chapa Saul, Ner chapa Abner le Zeruiah chapa Joab thilto ho jong achingtup jing uve.
English: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.

tcz: Izhar phung a konin Kenaniah ahung pengdoh in, a chapate toh Israel sung a vaibol le thutan in apang uve.
en: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
text:
1CH 26:29
Thadou: Izhar phung a konin Kenaniah ahung pengdoh in, a chapate toh Israel sung a vaibol le thutan in apang uve.
English: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

tcz: Hebron phung a konin Hashabiah ahung pengdoh in, asopite thil bolthei cheh sang le ja sagi toh Jordan vadung a patna lhumlam a um Israel te gambeh sunga, Pathen thulam hihen lang Lenggam thu hijongle nganse na lentah achang taove.
en: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.
text:
1CH 26:30
Thadou: Hebron phung a konin Hashabiah ahung pengdoh in, asopite thil bolthei cheh sang le ja sagi toh Jordan vadung a patna lhumlam a um Israel te gambeh sunga, Pathen thulam hihen lang Lenggam thu hijongle nganse na lentah achang taove.
English: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.

tcz: Chujongle, Hebron phung a konin Jeriah ahung pengdoh in, amahi Hebronte phunggui kisut dan a lamkai le khat anahi. David lengpa kum somli alhin a akhouldoh dungjui uva, Hebron te lah a mibolthei tampi Gilead gam Jazer khopi a amudoh u ahi.
en: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.
text:
1CH 26:31
Thadou: Chujongle, Hebron phung a konin Jeriah ahung pengdoh in, amahi Hebronte phunggui kisut dan a lamkai le khat anahi. David lengpa kum somli alhin a akhouldoh dungjui uva, Hebron te lah a mibolthei tampi Gilead gam Jazer khopi a amudoh u ahi.
English: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.

tcz: Miboltheitah mi ho chu mi sangni le ja sagi chengse chu Jeriah sopite ngen jeng ahiuve. Amaho hi Leng David in Jordan vadung a pat a solam a asol a Reuben leh Gad chule Mannaseh chilhah akehkhat langpi vekol ding a ejakai a Pathen thulam hihen, Lenggam thu hijongle nganse na lhingset chang ahiuve.
en: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
text:
1CH 26:32
Thadou: Miboltheitah mi ho chu mi sangni le ja sagi chengse chu Jeriah sopite ngen jeng ahiuve. Amaho hi Leng David in Jordan vadung a pat a solam a asol a Reuben leh Gad chule Mannaseh chilhah akehkhat langpi vekol ding a ejakai a Pathen thulam hihen, Lenggam thu hijongle nganse na lhingset chang ahiuve.
English: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

tcz: Israel sepai jalamkaite le a vaibol teuvin lengpa hongbit dia a sepaite ahon hon a aki vaihop dan u chu hiti ahi. Sepai hon khat a mi sangsomni le li alhing uvin, kum khat le lhakhat cheh pan ala teiyun ahi.
en: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.
text:
1CH 27:1
Thadou: Israel sepai jalamkaite le a vaibol teuvin lengpa hongbit dia a sepaite ahon hon a aki vaihop dan u chu hiti ahi. Sepai hon khat a mi sangsomni le li alhing uvin, kum khat le lhakhat cheh pan ala teiyun ahi.
English: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: Sepai hon ho panmun la masapen a lamkai chu Zabdiel chapa Jashobeam ahi,
en: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
text:
1CH 27:2
Thadou: Sepai hon ho panmun la masapen a lamkai chu Zabdiel chapa Jashobeam ahi,
English: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: Ama hi Perez insung a kon sepai vaihom ho jouse lah a jong thaneipen ahi.
en: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.
text:
1CH 27:3
Thadou: Ama hi Perez insung a kon sepai vaihom ho jouse lah a jong thaneipen ahi.
English: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.

tcz: Sepaihon lhanina a pan la a lamkai chu Ahoah insungmi Dodai kitipa ahin, anoidou a thanei vaihom din Mikloth kitipa akikoi e.
en: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
text:
1CH 27:4
Thadou: Sepaihon lhanina a pan la a lamkai chu Ahoah insungmi Dodai kitipa ahin, anoidou a thanei vaihom din Mikloth kitipa akikoi e.
English: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: A lhathum channa a pan la sepaihon lamkai chu Jehoiada chapa Benaiah ahi.
en: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
text:
1CH 27:5
Thadou: A lhathum channa a pan la sepaihon lamkai chu Jehoiada chapa Benaiah ahi.
English: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: Beniah kitipa hi David sepai hangsan, mihat somthum ho lamkai a jong ana pang ahi. Achapa Ammizabad chu anoidou din apansah e.
en: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.
text:
1CH 27:6
Thadou: Beniah kitipa hi David sepai hangsan, mihat somthum ho lamkai a jong ana pang ahi. Achapa Ammizabad chu anoidou din apansah e.
English: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.

tcz: Joab naopa Asahel in a lhali channa sepai hon te alamkaiyin ahi. Amahi achapa Zebadiah in athijouin apanmun akhel tai.
en: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
text:
1CH 27:7
Thadou: Joab naopa Asahel in a lhali channa sepai hon te alamkaiyin ahi. Amahi achapa Zebadiah in athijouin apanmun akhel tai.
English: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: A lhanga channa sepaihon lamkai chu Shammah ahin, amahi Izrahite tinjong aki hei.
en: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
text:
1CH 27:8
Thadou: A lhanga channa sepaihon lamkai chu Shammah ahin, amahi Izrahite tinjong aki hei.
English: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: A lhagup channa din Tekoa vangkhoa kon, Ikkesh chapa Ira chu lamkai in apang’e.
en: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
text:
1CH 27:9
Thadou: A lhagup channa din Tekoa vangkhoa kon, Ikkesh chapa Ira chu lamkai in apang’e.
English: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: A lhasagi channan Pelon akon a Ephraim insungmi Helez a lamkai e.
en: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
text:
1CH 27:10
Thadou: A lhasagi channan Pelon akon a Ephraim insungmi Helez a lamkai e.
English: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: A lhaget channan Hushah a kon Zerah insungmi Sibbecai a lamkaiyin.
en: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
text:
1CH 27:11
Thadou: A lhaget channan Hushah a kon Zerah insungmi Sibbecai a lamkaiyin.
English: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: A lhako channan Benjamin gamsung, Anathoth a kon Abiezer a lamkai in.
en: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
text:
1CH 27:12
Thadou: A lhako channan Benjamin gamsung, Anathoth a kon Abiezer a lamkai in.
English: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: A lhasom nan Netophah a kon Zerah insungmi Maharai in a lamkaiye.
en: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
text:
1CH 27:13
Thadou: A lhasom nan Netophah a kon Zerah insungmi Maharai in a lamkaiye.
English: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: A lhasom le khat nan Epharaim, Pirathon a kon Benaiah a lamkaiyin.
en: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
text:
1CH 27:14
Thadou: A lhasom le khat nan Epharaim, Pirathon a kon Benaiah a lamkaiyin.
English: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: A lhasom le ni na in Netophah a kon Othniel insungmi Heled in a lamkaiye.
en: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
text:
1CH 27:15
Thadou: A lhasom le ni na in Netophah a kon Othniel insungmi Heled in a lamkaiye.
English: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

tcz: Reuben phung lamkai chu Zicri, Eliezer chapa ahi. Simeon phung lamkai chu Maacah chapa, Shephatiah ahi.
en: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;

tcz: Levi Phung lamkai, Kemuel chapa Hashabiah ahin, Aaron themgaote phung lamkai chu Zadok ahi.
en: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;

tcz: Judah te lamkai chu David sopipa Elihu ahin, Issachar lamkai chu Michael chapa Omri ahi.
en: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;

tcz: Zebulun lamkai in Obadiah chapa Ishmaiah apangin, Naphtali lamkai chu Azriel chapa Jeremoth ahi.
en: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;

tcz: Ephraim Phung lamkai chu Azaziah chapa Hoshea ahin, Lhumlam Manasseh lamkai chu Pedaiah chapa Joel ahi.
en: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

tcz: Solam Gilead a Manasseh lamkai chu Zechariah chapa Iddo ahi. Benjamin lamkai a Abner chapa Jaasiel apang in.
en: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;

tcz: Dan lamkaiyin Jeroham chapa Azarel apang’e.
en: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.
text:
1CH 27:22
Thadou: Dan lamkaiyin Jeroham chapa Azarel apang’e.
English: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.

tcz: Leng David in mijatsim abolna achun kum somni a pat anoilam ho asimtha pon ahi. Ajehchu, Pathenin Israel chate chu van'a ahsi jat a phatthei aboh dia akitepna akoisa ahitai.
en: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.
text:
1CH 27:23
Thadou: Leng David in mijatsim abolna achun kum somni a pat anoilam ho asimtha pon ahi. Ajehchu, Pathenin Israel chate chu van'a ahsi jat a phatthei aboh dia akitepna akoisa ahitai.
English: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.

tcz: Zeruiah chapa Joab chun mijatsim ejat a aboldoh kigot vang'in alosap jing’e. Ajehchu Pathen lunghan na chang a, Leng David khang a Israel mijatsim chu lolhing lou ahitai.
en: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.
text:
1CH 27:24
Thadou: Zeruiah chapa Joab chun mijatsim ejat a aboldoh kigot vang'in alosap jing’e. Ajehchu Pathen lunghan na chang a, Leng David khang a Israel mijatsim chu lolhing lou ahitai.
English: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.

tcz: Adiel chapa Azmaveth chu lengpa thilkholna ngahtup din nganse ahin, Uzziah chapa Jonathan chu khopi thilkholna mun jouse ngahtup din nganse ahitai.
en: Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. Over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;

tcz: Kelub chapa Ezri chun Lengpa loubol ho vetup din Loumun angah in,
en: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.
text:
1CH 27:26
Thadou: Kelub chapa Ezri chun Lengpa loubol ho vetup din Loumun angah in,
English: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.

tcz: Ramah a kon Shimei chu Lengpa lengpi lei ngahtup in apang in, Sepham a kon Zabdi chu Lengpa Ju le Lengpi twi thah a apang’e.
en: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.
text:
1CH 27:27
Thadou: Ramah a kon Shimei chu Lengpa lengpi lei ngahtup in apang in, Sepham a kon Zabdi chu Lengpa Ju le Lengpi twi thah a apang’e.
English: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.

tcz: Geder a kon a Baal-Hanan chun Judah te moul bul a um Lengpa Olive honsung chule theichang, theiba lei chu angahtup in ahi. Lengpa heng’a Olive thao thah jing din Joash ngansena achang’e.
en: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.
text:
1CH 27:28
Thadou: Geder a kon a Baal-Hanan chun Judah te moul bul a um Lengpa Olive honsung chule theichang, theiba lei chu angahtup in ahi. Lengpa heng’a Olive thao thah jing din Joash ngansena achang’e.
English: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.

tcz: Sharon a kon Shitrai chu Sharon munjang lang’a Bong ching in apangin. Adlai chapa Shaphat chu phaicham lang’a apang e.
en: Over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. Over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.
text:
1CH 27:29
Thadou: Sharon a kon Shitrai chu Sharon munjang lang’a Bong ching in apangin. Adlai chapa Shaphat chu phaicham lang’a apang e.
English: Over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. Over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.

tcz: Ishamel chilhah Obil in Sangong saote aching in. Meronoth a kon Jehdeiah in Sangaan aching e.
en: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.
text:
1CH 27:30
Thadou: Ishamel chilhah Obil in Sangong saote aching in. Meronoth a kon Jehdeiah in Sangaan aching e.
English: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.

tcz: Hagrite mi Jaziz in Lengpa kelngoi le kelcha aching in. Amaho chengse hi Lengpa gou ching jeng ahiuve.
en: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.
text:
1CH 27:31
Thadou: Hagrite mi Jaziz in Lengpa kelngoi le kelcha aching in. Amaho chengse hi Lengpa gou ching jeng ahiuve.
English: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.

tcz: David pa-ngahpa Jonathan chu michingtah le thil hethei tah chule lengpa semang khat ahin. Hachmoni chapa Jehiel chu lengpa chapa jilkung in apang’e.
en: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.
text:
1CH 27:32
Thadou: David pa-ngahpa Jonathan chu michingtah le thil hethei tah chule lengpa semang khat ahin. Hachmoni chapa Jehiel chu lengpa chapa jilkung in apang’e.
English: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.

tcz: Ahithophel kitipa hi Leng insung a thumop themtah ahin. Ark kho a Hushai kitipa hi Lengpa dia agol khat ahi.
en: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
text:
1CH 27:33
Thadou: Ahithophel kitipa hi Leng insung a thumop themtah ahin. Ark kho a Hushai kitipa hi Lengpa dia agol khat ahi.
English: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.

tcz: Benaiah leh Abiathar chapa Jehoiada in Ahithophel athi jouvin a panmun ahin khel in, Joab chu Lengpa sepai jalamkai a apangtai.
en: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.
text:
1CH 27:34
Thadou: Benaiah leh Abiathar chapa Jehoiada in Ahithophel athi jouvin a panmun ahin khel in, Joab chu Lengpa sepai jalamkai a apangtai.
English: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.

tcz: David in alenggam sung’a sepai jalamkai, vaipo le vaibol jouse, phung lamkai hihen gou ching hihen, hetthei a panmun la jouse chuleh gaalhang jouse Jerusalem a akou sohkei un.
en: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.
text:
1CH 28:1
Thadou: David in alenggam sung’a sepai jalamkai, vaipo le vaibol jouse, phung lamkai hihen gou ching hihen, hetthei a panmun la jouse chuleh gaalhang jouse Jerusalem a akou sohkei un.
English: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.

tcz: Akipatdoh in hity hin aseitai, “Ka sopi le Ka miteho, keiman Pathen kitepna thingkong a itih a aum jing nading, Pathen houin theng sahdoh ding ka ngaiton, kigotnan thil le lo angaicha tampi jong kakoitai.
en: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.
text:
1CH 28:2
Thadou: Akipatdoh in hity hin aseitai, “Ka sopi le Ka miteho, keiman Pathen kitepna thingkong a itih a aum jing nading, Pathen houin theng sahdoh ding ka ngaiton, kigotnan thil le lo angaicha tampi jong kakoitai.
English: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.

tcz: Ahinlah, Pakai Pathenin keima gaal-hat tah chuleh mi tampi that kahi jeh in eiphal pon ahi.
en: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’
text:
1CH 28:3
Thadou: Ahinlah, Pakai Pathenin keima gaal-hat tah chuleh mi tampi that kahi jeh in eiphal pon ahi.
English: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’

tcz: Hijeng jongle, Israel Pathenin Judahte lah a konna, ka insung uva pat keimatah, a itih hijongle Israel leng dia ei thaonu ahitai.
en: However the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.
text:
1CH 28:4
Thadou: Hijeng jongle, Israel Pathenin Judahte lah a konna, ka insung uva pat keimatah, a itih hijongle Israel leng dia ei thaonu ahitai.
English: However the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.

tcz: Chutahle, chapa tamtah phatthei eiboh ho lah a konna ka chapa Solomon in ka lengtou namun ei khel ding ahi” ati.
en: Of all my sons (for the LORD has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the LORD’s kingdom over Israel.
text:
1CH 28:5
Thadou: Chutahle, chapa tamtah phatthei eiboh ho lah a konna ka chapa Solomon in ka lengtou namun ei khel ding ahi” ati.
English: Of all my sons (for the LORD has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the LORD’s kingdom over Israel.

tcz: Pathenin kajah a aseiye, “Nachapa Solomon in Ka houin theng le akimvel asahdoh dia kalhendoh ahitan, keiman angaichat ijakai kapeh jing ding ahi” ati.
en: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
text:
1CH 28:6
Thadou: Pathenin kajah a aseiye, “Nachapa Solomon in Ka houin theng le akimvel asahdoh dia kalhendoh ahitan, keiman angaichat ijakai kapeh jing ding ahi” ati.
English: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

tcz: Chutahle, “Ka thupeh chengse anit jing’a ahile, Keiman a lenggam a itih a ka umpi jing ding ahi” ati.
en: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’
text:
1CH 28:7
Thadou: Chutahle, “Ka thupeh chengse anit jing’a ahile, Keiman a lenggam a itih a ka umpi jing ding ahi” ati.
English: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’

tcz: “Hijeh chun, Pakai le houbung pumpi angsung chuleh, Israel mite mitmun chingtheiyun lang na pakai na Pathen thupeh chengse nit jing un, chutileh lungmong a gampha lai na lo uva, nachateu le na tuteu khang geiya Pakai phatthei na nachan jing diu ahi,” ati.
en: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the LORD’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.
text:
1CH 28:8
Thadou: “Hijeh chun, Pakai le houbung pumpi angsung chuleh, Israel mite mitmun chingtheiyun lang na pakai na Pathen thupeh chengse nit jing un, chutileh lungmong a gampha lai na lo uva, nachateu le na tuteu khang geiya Pakai phatthei na nachan jing diu ahi,” ati.
English: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the LORD’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.

tcz: “Chujongle, Solomon kachapa, na Pu le na Pa phattheiboh jing na Pathen chu haimil lou jen’in. Nalungthim pumpin choi’an jing inlang athun umjingin, ajehchu thil ijakai amun, ahe sohkeiyin, bel jing lechun, na lhaso lou ding ahi,” ati.
en: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for the LORD searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.
text:
1CH 28:9
Thadou: “Chujongle, Solomon kachapa, na Pu le na Pa phattheiboh jing na Pathen chu haimil lou jen’in. Nalungthim pumpin choi’an jing inlang athun umjingin, ajehchu thil ijakai amun, ahe sohkeiyin, bel jing lechun, na lhaso lou ding ahi,” ati.
English: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for the LORD searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.

tcz: “Hijeh chun, nalung gil in ngaiton. Pakai Pathen in a houin theng sa dia nalhendoh ahitan. Hat jing in lang natohdoh tei ding ahi,” ati.
en: Take heed now, for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”
text:
1CH 28:10
Thadou: “Hijeh chun, nalung gil in ngaiton. Pakai Pathen in a houin theng sa dia nalhendoh ahitan. Hat jing in lang natohdoh tei ding ahi,” ati.
English: Take heed now, for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”

tcz: Chuin, David in athilgon ejakai, thil kholna indan ho chule chonset kingaidam na munho umdol jouse Solomon apetan ahi.
en: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;

tcz: David in alunggil a agontohsa, Houin lim asung apo, indan dang dang chule Maicham kibolna Muntheng dia agon ho jouse achapa Solomon aseipeh tai.
en: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of the LORD’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;

tcz: Chujongle, Houin sunga Themgao hole Levi mite panmun hihen, Pathen hou nadia thil le lo kimang ding jouse jong ahiltan ahi.
en: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of the LORD’s house, and for all the vessels of service in the LORD’s house—
text:
1CH 28:13
Thadou: Chujongle, Houin sunga Themgao hole Levi mite panmun hihen, Pathen hou nadia thil le lo kimang ding jouse jong ahiltan ahi.
English: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of the LORD’s house, and for all the vessels of service in the LORD’s house—

tcz: David in Pathen Hou na a Sana le Sum eng man dia lom jat jong ahiltoh in,
en: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;

tcz: Solomon jah a Sana thaomei semna ding le sum eng thaomei semna ding chuleh sana le sum eng alut ding jat jong ahilthem in ahi.
en: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;

tcz: Changlhah hung kitohdoh ho koina ding Sana theng a kisem Dokhang chule, sum eng a kisem dokhang ho jong akisem na a sana angaicha ding jat jong ahilthem e.
en: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;

tcz: Thih-khe sana thengsel ijat a sem a, khon, Kong, Sil kong ho jouse sana ijat cheh a sem ding aboncha a atetoh peh soh e.
en: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;

tcz: Chujongle, gim namtwi hal nading maicham phung semna dia sana thengsel man ding jat, chule Kangtalai sung a Cherubium vantil in a lhaving teni a akhu khum, Pakai kitepna thingkong sem ding dan jong ahiltan ahi.
en: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of the LORD’s covenant.
text:
1CH 28:18
Thadou: Chujongle, gim namtwi hal nading maicham phung semna dia sana thengsel man ding jat, chule Kangtalai sung a Cherubium vantil in a lhaving teni a akhu khum, Pakai kitepna thingkong sem ding dan jong ahiltan ahi.
English: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of the LORD’s covenant.

tcz: “Thilgon hichengse hi”, tin David in Solomon jah a, “Pathenin akhut tah a asut eimudohsah akon kahet ahi” ati.
en: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from the LORD’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”
text:
1CH 28:19
Thadou: “Thilgon hichengse hi”, tin David in Solomon jah a, “Pathenin akhut tah a asut eimudohsah akon kahet ahi” ati.
English: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from the LORD’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”

tcz: David in abanjom in, “hat in lang hang jingin, natohdoh ding ahi. Kichat le lunglhah daina neihih hel in. Pakai Pathenin na umpi jing’e. Nanganse nabang’a nachai theng tokah a Pakai Pathen in na lhonpi jing ding ahi”.
en: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of the LORD’s house is finished.
text:
1CH 28:20
Thadou: David in abanjom in, “hat in lang hang jingin, natohdoh ding ahi. Kichat le lunglhah daina neihih hel in. Pakai Pathenin na umpi jing’e. Nanganse nabang’a nachai theng tokah a Pakai Pathen in na lhonpi jing ding ahi”.
English: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of the LORD’s house is finished.

tcz: “Themgao ho le Levi mite akinganse na banga pakai kin abol diu, adangse injong akipeh nathei chan uva pan alah uva, gamsung vaipo ho jouse le thuneina aboncha a nangma thunoi a umding ahi” ati.
en: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”
text:
1CH 28:21
Thadou: “Themgao ho le Levi mite akinganse na banga pakai kin abol diu, adangse injong akipeh nathei chan uva pan alah uva, gamsung vaipo ho jouse le thuneina aboncha a nangma thunoi a umding ahi” ati.
English: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”

tcz: Hichun, leng David in houin sung’a mipiho lam chu angan hitin aseiye, “Kachapa Solomon hi Pathenin ka lengmun khel dia athaonusa chu ahin, ama chapang nalai intin, jilna neibeh nailou hijongle, atoh dia lom Pathenin angansena, a houin sah dikhu mihem mai maiyin ajo chi vang ahipoi.
en: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
text:
1CH 29:1
Thadou: Hichun, leng David in houin sung’a mipiho lam chu angan hitin aseiye, “Kachapa Solomon hi Pathenin ka lengmun khel dia athaonusa chu ahin, ama chapang nalai intin, jilna neibeh nailou hijongle, atoh dia lom Pathenin angansena, a houin sah dikhu mihem mai maiyin ajo chi vang ahipoi.
English: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.

tcz: Manchah theichan mangchan keiman ka Pathen Houin sah nadin sana, songmantam, thing le song ijakai angaicha jouse kakoitup peh tai. Hiho chu alhingset a dia, Sana, Sum eng, thih, thing chujongle, Onyx tampi seh hilouin, Songmantam, Songval, Songpol, Marble song jong alhingset din kakoitup peh tai.
en: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, also onyx stones, stones to be set, stones for inlaid work of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
text:
1CH 29:2
Thadou: Manchah theichan mangchan keiman ka Pathen Houin sah nadin sana, songmantam, thing le song ijakai angaicha jouse kakoitup peh tai. Hiho chu alhingset a dia, Sana, Sum eng, thih, thing chujongle, Onyx tampi seh hilouin, Songmantam, Songval, Songpol, Marble song jong alhingset din kakoitup peh tai.
English: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, also onyx stones, stones to be set, stones for inlaid work of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

tcz: Tunjong, keiman ka Pakaiya dia kakipehdoh nan ka Sana le sum eng jouse jong a Houin sah nadia kagotpeh ho ban’in kapedoh tai.
en: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:
text:
1CH 29:3
Thadou: Tunjong, keiman ka Pakaiya dia kakipehdoh nan ka Sana le sum eng jouse jong a Houin sah nadia kagotpeh ho ban’in kapedoh tai.
English: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:

tcz: Chuleh, keiman Houin bang dung ho sah nadin, Ophir a kon Sana talent jakhat somleni chuleh, sum eng thengsel talent jani somgup le ni jong kapedoh tai.
en: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;

tcz: Chuban a, Khutthem ho tham ding Sana le Sum eng avat ding chengse ho hi, koi tobang ka Pakai ka Pathen a dia keijong kakipehdoh nom’e ti e um uvem?
en: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to the LORD?”
text:
1CH 29:5
Thadou: Chuban a, Khutthem ho tham ding Sana le Sum eng avat ding chengse ho hi, koi tobang ka Pakai ka Pathen a dia keijong kakipehdoh nom’e ti e um uvem?
English: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to the LORD?”

tcz: Hichun, mi upa ho le Israel phung lamkai ho ahin, sepai jalamkaiho, gouching ho chuleh, lengpa vaibolho jouse jong kiphaltheng tah in akipedohsoh taove.
en: Then the princes of the fathers’ households, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;

tcz: Pathen Houin theng sah nadia akipehdoh nao abonchauva apehdoh jat uchu, Sana talent jakhat somget le get, Dangka talent sangsom, sum eng talent jathum somsagi le nga, thih lhe talent jagup somsagi le nga chuleh, thih talent sangthum jasagi le somnga alhing’e.
en: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand talents, and of iron one hundred thousand talents.
text:
1CH 29:7
Thadou: Pathen Houin theng sah nadia akipehdoh nao abonchauva apehdoh jat uchu, Sana talent jakhat somget le get, Dangka talent sangsom, sum eng talent jathum somsagi le nga, thih lhe talent jagup somsagi le nga chuleh, thih talent sangthum jasagi le somnga alhing’e.
English: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand talents, and of iron one hundred thousand talents.

tcz: Chujongle, Gershon chilhah a kon Jehiel in maicham thilkhol namun avetsui din anganse un, songmantam tampi jong atoh be cheh uve.
en: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the LORD’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
text:
1CH 29:8
Thadou: Chujongle, Gershon chilhah a kon Jehiel in maicham thilkhol namun avetsui din anganse un, songmantam tampi jong atoh be cheh uve.
English: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the LORD’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
