tcz: Maicham thiltho ho jouse mipi ten hongphal tah le kiphaltheng tah a to jeh uvin akipah cheh uvin ahi. Chujongle Lengpa David jong kipa leh thanop nan adim’e.
en: Then the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
text:
1CH 29:9
Thadou: Maicham thiltho ho jouse mipi ten hongphal tah le kiphaltheng tah a to jeh uvin akipah cheh uvin ahi. Chujongle Lengpa David jong kipa leh thanop nan adim’e.
English: Then the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

tcz: Chuphat chun, Lengpa David in mipi jouse masang’in Pathen athangvah’e. “Kahung kondoh nao Vo ka Pathen’u, atonsot tonsot'in nun nom in, namin kithangvah jinghen.
en: Therefore David blessed the LORD before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, LORD, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.
text:
1CH 29:10
Thadou: Chuphat chun, Lengpa David in mipi jouse masang’in Pathen athangvah’e. “Kahung kondoh nao Vo ka Pathen’u, atonsot tonsot'in nun nom in, namin kithangvah jinghen.
English: Therefore David blessed the LORD before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, LORD, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.

tcz: Vo ka Pathen’u, minthanna jouse, loupi na jouse, thaneina jouse, jabol na jouse, ijakai nang’a hijing hen. Leiset pumpi le Vanthamjol abonna nang’a ahi. Vo Kapathen’u thil ijakai nangma lenggam thaneina ahi.
en: Yours, LORD, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, LORD, and you are exalted as head above all.
text:
1CH 29:11
Thadou: Vo ka Pathen’u, minthanna jouse, loupi na jouse, thaneina jouse, jabol na jouse, ijakai nang’a hijing hen. Leiset pumpi le Vanthamjol abonna nang’a ahi. Vo Kapathen’u thil ijakai nangma lenggam thaneina ahi.
English: Yours, LORD, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, LORD, and you are exalted as head above all.

tcz: Houna le Jabolna nang’a kon bou ahi. Ajehchu, emajouse nangma thunoi a umjeng ahi. Thaneina le loupina nangma khut a aum’in. Nangma khut’in minthanna le thaneina aboncha aum’e.
en: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!
text:
1CH 29:12
Thadou: Houna le Jabolna nang’a kon bou ahi. Ajehchu, emajouse nangma thunoi a umjeng ahi. Thaneina le loupina nangma khut a aum’in. Nangma khut’in minthanna le thaneina aboncha aum’e.
English: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!

tcz: Vo ka Pathen’u, namin thangvah le choi’ann na kahin peuve.
en: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.
text:
1CH 29:13
Thadou: Vo ka Pathen’u, namin thangvah le choi’ann na kahin peuve.
English: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.

tcz: Ahinlah, keima Koi kahiya, ka mite chu ipi hiuvam, nangma angsung a kipah le thanomtah a ipi hijongle kapeh jing thei uham? Kanei, kagou jouseu nangma a konna kamu jeng u ahin, kapeh hou jouse nangman neipehsao ngen jeng ahi.
en: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.
text:
1CH 29:14
Thadou: Ahinlah, keima Koi kahiya, ka mite chu ipi hiuvam, nangma angsung a kipah le thanomtah a ipi hijongle kapeh jing thei uham? Kanei, kagou jouseu nangma a konna kamu jeng u ahin, kapeh hou jouse nangman neipehsao ngen jeng ahi.
English: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.

tcz: Chuleh, kapu kapateu bang’a, Hiche leiset a hi khopem le maljin maimai kahiuvin, kahinkhou jong nilim kihei bang’in agei na akihepha ji tapoi.
en: For we are strangers before you and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining.
text:
1CH 29:15
Thadou: Chuleh, kapu kapateu bang’a, Hiche leiset a hi khopem le maljin maimai kahiuvin, kahinkhou jong nilim kihei bang’in agei na akihepha ji tapoi.
English: For we are strangers before you and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining.

tcz: “Ka Pakai le ka Pathen’u, nangma jabol na, na Houin theng sah nadia kahin to khom u ijakai hi nang’a ahin, nangman neipeh jeng u ahi.
en: LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and is all your own.
text:
1CH 29:16
Thadou: “Ka Pakai le ka Pathen’u, nangma jabol na, na Houin theng sah nadia kahin to khom u ijakai hi nang’a ahin, nangman neipeh jeng u ahi.
English: LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and is all your own.

tcz: Ka Pathen, nangman kalung’u nakholchilsoh jin, nalunglhai na chung’a nakipapi ji’e ti keima neihetsah in, chule lunggil tah a keiman thil hicheng kabol jong nahen ahi. Kamiten jong kipah le thanom tah thilto, thilpeh nangma houin theng sahdoh nadia ahin choi u jong neimusah jing’e.
en: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.
text:
1CH 29:17
Thadou: Ka Pathen, nangman kalung’u nakholchilsoh jin, nalunglhai na chung’a nakipapi ji’e ti keima neihetsah in, chule lunggil tah a keiman thil hicheng kabol jong nahen ahi. Kamiten jong kipah le thanom tah thilto, thilpeh nangma houin theng sahdoh nadia ahin choi u jong neimusah jing’e.
English: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.

tcz: Vo thaneipen Pathen, Kapu’u Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, Israelte Pathen, namiten nathu angai jing ding uvin kahung tao’e. Nangma na jabol le na hepi nao jong mu jing’in.
en: LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;

tcz: Kachapa Solomon’in alungthim pumpia nathupeh chengse anit a, na danthu le na hettohsah hihen, ejakai ajui jing’a, keiman kagontup pehsa na Houin theng kisahdoh kahsen lungvul na pejing o.
en: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”
text:
1CH 29:19
Thadou: Kachapa Solomon’in alungthim pumpia nathupeh chengse anit a, na danthu le na hettohsah hihen, ejakai ajui jing’a, keiman kagontup pehsa na Houin theng kisahdoh kahsen lungvul na pejing o.
English: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”

tcz: Chuphat’in, David in mipi ho jah a, “Na Pakai, na Pathen’u thangvah un” ati. Hichun, mipi jousen Pathen athangvah un, Apu apateu Pathen masang’in abohkhup un, chibai abol uvin, lengpa jong jabolna apeuvin ahi.
en: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless the LORD your God!” All the assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before the LORD and the king.
text:
1CH 29:20
Thadou: Chuphat’in, David in mipi ho jah a, “Na Pakai, na Pathen’u thangvah un” ati. Hichun, mipi jousen Pathen athangvah un, Apu apateu Pathen masang’in abohkhup un, chibai abol uvin, lengpa jong jabolna apeuvin ahi.
English: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless the LORD your God!” All the assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before the LORD and the king.

tcz: Ajing nikhon, mipiten Pakaiya kilhainan Bongchal sangkhat, Kelngoi sangkhat le kelngoichal sangkhat ahin choijun, pumgo thilton atoh uve. Chujongle, Israel pumpi min’in lengpitwi le kilhaina tampi jong ahin choi uvin ahi.
en: They sacrificed sacrifices to the LORD and offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,
text:
1CH 29:21
Thadou: Ajing nikhon, mipiten Pakaiya kilhainan Bongchal sangkhat, Kelngoi sangkhat le kelngoichal sangkhat ahin choijun, pumgo thilton atoh uve. Chujongle, Israel pumpi min’in lengpitwi le kilhaina tampi jong ahin choi uvin ahi.
English: They sacrificed sacrifices to the LORD and offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,

tcz: Ann nehkhom abol’un, lengpitwi adon’un, Kipah le thanomtah in Pathen athangvah uve. Chujongle, Leng David chapa Solomon chu mipi ho masang’in leng hung chang din thao anu un, Zadok jong chu thempu din thaonuna achangtai.
en: and ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before the LORD to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.
text:
1CH 29:22
Thadou: Ann nehkhom abol’un, lengpitwi adon’un, Kipah le thanomtah in Pathen athangvah uve. Chujongle, Leng David chapa Solomon chu mipi ho masang’in leng hung chang din thao anu un, Zadok jong chu thempu din thaonuna achangtai.
English: and ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before the LORD to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.

tcz: Chuin, Solomon in apa Leng David laltouna mun chu ahin khel tan, imalam jousea apa athakhel jou in, Israel pumpin jong ajabol sohkei taove.
en: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
text:
1CH 29:23
Thadou: Chuin, Solomon in apa Leng David laltouna mun chu ahin khel tan, imalam jousea apa athakhel jou in, Israel pumpin jong ajabol sohkei taove.
English: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

tcz: Mi thupiho, Gaalhang ho chuleh Leng David chapate jousen jong Lengpa Solomon adin kitepna le kipehdohna anei taove.
en: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.
text:
1CH 29:24
Thadou: Mi thupiho, Gaalhang ho chuleh Leng David chapate jousen jong Lengpa Solomon adin kitepna le kipehdohna anei taove.
English: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

tcz: Chuban’a Pathenin Leng Solomon chu Israel pumpi masang a adomsang’in, a itih a Israel lengten jong ana chan phahlou, minthanna, loupi nale jabolna sangpenin Pathenin phatthei abohtai.
en: The LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
text:
1CH 29:25
Thadou: Chuban’a Pathenin Leng Solomon chu Israel pumpi masang a adomsang’in, a itih a Israel lengten jong ana chan phahlou, minthanna, loupi nale jabolna sangpenin Pathenin phatthei abohtai.
English: The LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

tcz: Hitobanga hi, Jesse chapa Leng David hin jong Israel pumpin Lengvai ana pon ahi.
en: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
text:
1CH 29:26
Thadou: Hitobanga hi, Jesse chapa Leng David hin jong Israel pumpin Lengvai ana pon ahi.
English: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

tcz: A Lengvai poh chu kum somli alhing’in, kum sagi sung Hebron chuleh, kum somthum le thum sung chu Jerusalem a lengvai ana po’i.
en: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
text:
1CH 29:27
Thadou: A Lengvai poh chu kum somli alhing’in, kum sagi sung Hebron chuleh, kum somthum le thum sung chu Jerusalem a lengvai ana po’i.
English: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

tcz: Ahinkhon haona, jabolna achang’in, kum sottah hinkho kipah le thanom in amang in, atehset a ahinkho lhin mong’in athin, chuphat’in achapa Solomon in a Lengmun ahin khel e.
en: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
text:
1CH 29:28
Thadou: Ahinkhon haona, jabolna achang’in, kum sottah hinkho kipah le thanom in amang in, atehset a ahinkho lhin mong’in athin, chuphat’in achapa Solomon in a Lengmun ahin khel e.
English: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Leng David vaipoh sungsea thil ejakai kijihlut ho jouse chu, a mitvaneipa Samuel thusimbu, Nathan themgaopa thusimle lekhabu, mitvaneipa Gad thusimbu a akijihlut soh in ahi.
en: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,
text:
1CH 29:29
Thadou: Leng David vaipoh sungsea thil ejakai kijihlut ho jouse chu, a mitvaneipa Samuel thusimbu, Nathan themgaopa thusimle lekhabu, mitvaneipa Gad thusimbu a akijihlut soh in ahi.
English: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,

tcz: Hiche thilsoh ho jouse hin Leng David loupi na aphochen uvin, chuleh a lengvaipoh sung’a Israel le akimvel lenggam hoa thilsoh jouse jong ajao cheh e.
en: with all his reign and his might, and the events that involved him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.
text:
1CH 29:30
Thadou: Hiche thilsoh ho jouse hin Leng David loupi na aphochen uvin, chuleh a lengvaipoh sung’a Israel le akimvel lenggam hoa thilsoh jouse jong ajao cheh e.
English: with all his reign and his might, and the events that involved him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.

tcz: David chapa Solomon chun alenggam dettah in atungdohtai; Ijeh inem itihleh Pakai a Pathen chun aumpia chuleh sangtah'a athaneisah ahitai.
en: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and made him exceedingly great.
text:
2CH 1:1
Thadou: David chapa Solomon chun alenggam dettah in atungdohtai; Ijeh inem itihleh Pakai a Pathen chun aumpia chuleh sangtah'a athaneisah ahitai.
English: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and made him exceedingly great.

tcz: Solomon chun Israel lamkaiho galsat sepai asang, aja chunga luboh ho thutan vaihom ho, gamsung lamkai hojouse chule phung lamkai ho akoukhomin ahi.
en: Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to every prince in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’ households.
text:
2CH 1:2
Thadou: Solomon chun Israel lamkaiho galsat sepai asang, aja chunga luboh ho thutan vaihom ho, gamsung lamkai hojouse chule phung lamkai ho akoukhomin ahi.
English: Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to every prince in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’ households.

tcz: Chuin Solomon chun houbung mipi chu Gibeon kho’a chu Pathen houkhom dingin a lamkai in a chetaove ; Ijeh inem etileh hiche kho’a Pathen houbuh chu umma ahi(Hiche laimuna hi Pakai Lhacha Mose’n gamthip laiya Pathen houbuh asemna munchu ahi).
en: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God’s Tent of Meeting was there, which the LORD’s servant Moses had made in the wilderness.
text:
2CH 1:3
Thadou: Chuin Solomon chun houbung mipi chu Gibeon kho’a chu Pathen houkhom dingin a lamkai in a chetaove ; Ijeh inem etileh hiche kho’a Pathen houbuh chu umma ahi(Hiche laimuna hi Pakai Lhacha Mose’n gamthip laiya Pathen houbuh asemna munchu ahi).
English: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God’s Tent of Meeting was there, which the LORD’s servant Moses had made in the wilderness.

tcz: Ahinlah, David chun Jerusalem munna atunna dinga asemna Pathen Houbuh’a chu Pathen Thingkong chu Kiriath-Jearim akona ana pohlutsa ahitai.
en: But David had brought God’s ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 1:4
Thadou: Ahinlah, David chun Jerusalem munna atunna dinga asemna Pathen Houbuh’a chu Pathen Thingkong chu Kiriath-Jearim akona ana pohlutsa ahitai.
English: But David had brought God’s ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

tcz: Ahinlah Uri Chapa, Hur tupa Betzalel kitipan asem sum-eng maicham chu Gibeon muna Pakai houbuh mai’a chun aum nalaijin ahi. Chuti chun Solomon le mipi chu houbuh masanga chun akikhom un Pakai chu ahoutaovin ahi.
en: Moreover the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before the LORD’s tabernacle; and Solomon and the assembly were seeking counsel there.
text:
2CH 1:5
Thadou: Ahinlah Uri Chapa, Hur tupa Betzalel kitipan asem sum-eng maicham chu Gibeon muna Pakai houbuh mai’a chun aum nalaijin ahi. Chuti chun Solomon le mipi chu houbuh masanga chun akikhom un Pakai chu ahoutaovin ahi.
English: Moreover the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before the LORD’s tabernacle; and Solomon and the assembly were seeking counsel there.

tcz: Chulkomma Houbuh masanga chun Solomon chu sum-eng maicham umna'a chun akaltaovin Pakai angsungah pumgo thilto sangkhat jen agalhandohtan ahi.
en: Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before the LORD, which was at the Tent of Meeting, and offered one thousand burnt offerings on it.
text:
2CH 1:6
Thadou: Chulkomma Houbuh masanga chun Solomon chu sum-eng maicham umna'a chun akaltaovin Pakai angsungah pumgo thilto sangkhat jen agalhandohtan ahi.
English: Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before the LORD, which was at the Tent of Meeting, and offered one thousand burnt offerings on it.

tcz: Chuche jan chun Solomon henga Pathen ahungkilah’in hitin ati “Epi pentah nadeijem ,Thummin , chuleh Keiman nangma kapeh ding nahi .”
en: That night, God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for what you want me to give you.”
text:
2CH 1:7
Thadou: Chuche jan chun Solomon henga Pathen ahungkilah’in hitin ati “Epi pentah nadeijem ,Thummin , chuleh Keiman nangma kapeh ding nahi .”
English: That night, God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for what you want me to give you.”

tcz: Solomon in Pathen chu adonbutnin, Nangman kapa David chu lungsetna longlou hel nachanin,tun keima amakhellin lengin neipan sahtai,
en: Solomon said to God, “You have shown great loving kindness to David my father, and have made me king in his place.
text:
2CH 1:8
Thadou: Solomon in Pathen chu adonbutnin, Nangman kapa David chu lungsetna longlou hel nachanin,tun keima amakhellin lengin neipan sahtai,
English: Solomon said to God, “You have shown great loving kindness to David my father, and have made me king in his place.

tcz: O Pakai Pathen lungset tah in kapa David toh nakitepna koijinginlang Mihem hijat chunga hin lengin neipan sahtai.
en: Now, LORD God, let your promise to David my father be established; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
text:
2CH 1:9
Thadou: O Pakai Pathen lungset tah in kapa David toh nakitepna koijinginlang Mihem hijat chunga hin lengin neipan sahtai.
English: Now, LORD God, let your promise to David my father be established; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

tcz: Mipi hijat chunga kituptah a kalam kai thei’a namite chunga vai kahom themtheina dingin chih na le hetna neipen,
en: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people of yours?”
text:
2CH 1:10
Thadou: Mipi hijat chunga kituptah a kalam kai thei’a namite chunga vai kahom themtheina dingin chih na le hetna neipen,
English: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people of yours?”

tcz: Pathen chun Solomon jah a hitin aseijin, Neile gou, haona , loupina ahiloule nagal mite thina ding ahiloule nahinkho sotna joh thumlouva nangaichat sangpen namite kithopi thei nadingle achunguva vaihom them theina nathum tah jeh hin,
en: God said to Solomon, “Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, honor, or the life of those who hate you, nor yet have you asked for long life; but have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king,
text:
2CH 1:11
Thadou: Pathen chun Solomon jah a hitin aseijin, Neile gou, haona , loupina ahiloule nagal mite thina ding ahiloule nahinkho sotna joh thumlouva nangaichat sangpen namite kithopi thei nadingle achunguva vaihom them theina nathum tah jeh hin,
English: God said to Solomon, “Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, honor, or the life of those who hate you, nor yet have you asked for long life; but have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king,

tcz: Keiman nathumpen chihna le hetna chu kapeh ding; Chujongleh neile gou, haosatna le minthanna jong kapehtha ding, hitobang thil hi nama sangleh khonunga leng hungchang ding hon jong aneilou diu ahitai.
en: therefore wisdom and knowledge is granted to you. I will give you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had who have been before you, and none after you will have.”
text:
2CH 1:12
Thadou: Keiman nathumpen chihna le hetna chu kapeh ding; Chujongleh neile gou, haosatna le minthanna jong kapehtha ding, hitobang thil hi nama sangleh khonunga leng hungchang ding hon jong aneilou diu ahitai.
English: therefore wisdom and knowledge is granted to you. I will give you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had who have been before you, and none after you will have.”

tcz: Hitichun Solomon chu Gibeon kho’a Pathen Houbuh’a kon chun Jerusalem lama ahung kinunglen Israelte chunga lengvai ana potan ahi.
en: So Solomon came from the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the Tent of Meeting, to Jerusalem; and he reigned over Israel.
text:
2CH 1:13
Thadou: Hitichun Solomon chu Gibeon kho’a Pathen Houbuh’a kon chun Jerusalem lama ahung kinunglen Israelte chunga lengvai ana potan ahi.
English: So Solomon came from the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the Tent of Meeting, to Jerusalem; and he reigned over Israel.

tcz: Solomon chun Kangtalai le sakol touthem ho chu akoukhom in ahileh kangtalai sangkhat le jali leh sakol touthem sang somle sangni aneiyin ahi. Aman hichengse chu phabepkhat Kangtalai kikoina khopiho chule amakomnai sangsom le sangni nai’a Jerusalem khopi sunga chun atousah taove.
en: Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen that he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 1:14
Thadou: Solomon chun Kangtalai le sakol touthem ho chu akoukhom in ahileh kangtalai sangkhat le jali leh sakol touthem sang somle sangni aneiyin ahi. Aman hichengse chu phabepkhat Kangtalai kikoina khopiho chule amakomnai sangsom le sangni nai’a Jerusalem khopi sunga chun atousah taove.
English: Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen that he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

tcz: Lengpa chun Sana le Dangka jong Jerusalem sunga chun songlheu lah abahsah jengin chuleh Cedar thing mantam jengjong Judah phaichama Theipi thinglah abahsah jengin ahi.
en: The king made silver and gold to be as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars to be as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
text:
2CH 1:15
Thadou: Lengpa chun Sana le Dangka jong Jerusalem sunga chun songlheu lah abahsah jengin chuleh Cedar thing mantam jengjong Judah phaichama Theipi thinglah abahsah jengin ahi.
English: The king made silver and gold to be as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars to be as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

tcz: Solomon sakol ho chu ama dinga thilcho’a panghon Egypt gam le Celicia gam'a kona mantamtah’a agachoh uva ahin pohdoh’u ahi.
en: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt and from Kue. The king’s merchants purchased them from Kue.
text:
2CH 1:16
Thadou: Solomon sakol ho chu ama dinga thilcho’a panghon Egypt gam le Celicia gam'a kona mantamtah’a agachoh uva ahin pohdoh’u ahi.
English: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt and from Kue. The king’s merchants purchased them from Kue.

tcz: Chuche phatlai chun Egypt gamma kangtalai ho chu, dangka shekel jagup chule sakol ho chu dangka Shekel Jakhat le somnga manna ana kichojouvin ahi. Hiti chun Thilho chu Hittite lengte le Ram lengte koma ana kitol lut jin ahi.
en: They imported from Egypt then exported a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver and a horse for one hundred fifty. They also exported them to the Hittite kings and the Syrian kings.
text:
2CH 1:17
Thadou: Chuche phatlai chun Egypt gamma kangtalai ho chu, dangka shekel jagup chule sakol ho chu dangka Shekel Jakhat le somnga manna ana kichojouvin ahi. Hiti chun Thilho chu Hittite lengte le Ram lengte koma ana kitol lut jin ahi.
English: They imported from Egypt then exported a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver and a horse for one hundred fifty. They also exported them to the Hittite kings and the Syrian kings.

tcz: Solomon chun Pakai min jabolna dingin Houin khat le ama chenna ding mong mong Leng Inpi khat sadoh dingin kigel lhuhna aneitan ahi.
en: Now Solomon decided to build a house for the LORD’s name, and a house for his kingdom.
text:
2CH 2:1
Thadou: Solomon chun Pakai min jabolna dingin Houin khat le ama chenna ding mong mong Leng Inpi khat sadoh dingin kigel lhuhna aneitan ahi.
English: Now Solomon decided to build a house for the LORD’s name, and a house for his kingdom.

tcz: Hichea dingchun natong ding mi sangsom sagi thinglhang gam'a songkhoh ding mi sangsomget chule natongho vesuiding mi sangthum le Jagup alhengdoh tan ahi.
en: Solomon counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, eighty thousand men who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred to oversee them.
text:
2CH 2:2
Thadou: Hichea dingchun natong ding mi sangsom sagi thinglhang gam'a songkhoh ding mi sangsomget chule natongho vesuiding mi sangthum le Jagup alhengdoh tan ahi.
English: Solomon counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, eighty thousand men who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred to oversee them.

tcz: Solomon chun Tyre Lengpa Hiram henga dingin thu hiti hin athot in “Kapa David in a chenna ding leng inpi asahna dinga, Cedar thing nana bolpeh ji bangchun keima jong neihin bolpeh in;
en: Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, “As you dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell, so deal with me.

tcz: Keiman jong Pakai ka Pathen jabolna dinga houin kasah ding ahi. Hiche mun chu atumbeh a ama angsunga gimnamtwi halnam na’a changlhah agol gola koina’a , beitih neilou’a kitohdoh thiltona’a chule jingkah –nilhah le cholngah nikho a pumgo thilto tona ding, lhahthah nikho she’a manding; chule Pakai Kapathen’u angsunga, aphat kitep peh kut hoa manna ding mun hiding ahi.
en: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn before him incense of sweet spices, for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.
text:
2CH 2:4
Thadou: Keiman jong Pakai ka Pathen jabolna dinga houin kasah ding ahi. Hiche mun chu atumbeh a ama angsunga gimnamtwi halnam na’a changlhah agol gola koina’a , beitih neilou’a kitohdoh thiltona’a chule jingkah –nilhah le cholngah nikho a pumgo thilto tona ding, lhahthah nikho she’a manding; chule Pakai Kapathen’u angsunga, aphat kitep peh kut hoa manna ding mun hiding ahi.
English: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn before him incense of sweet spices, for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.

tcz: Hiche Houin hi Inlen Thupitah hiding ahi, ajeh chu ka Pathen’u hi Pathen dang jouse sanga lenjo thupijo ahi.
en: “The house which I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.
text:
2CH 2:5
Thadou: Hiche Houin hi Inlen Thupitah hiding ahi, ajeh chu ka Pathen’u hi Pathen dang jouse sanga lenjo thupijo ahi.
English: “The house which I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.

tcz: Hijeng jongleh Koiham Pathen chenna ding inlentah akilomtah sadoh jou ding chu, Ijeh-inem itileh amachu vanho jousen jong adol lou ding ahi. Hiti ahijeh chun, Pumgo thilto ho halnam nading tilou chu; Keima koi kahija Pathen chenna ding in chu kasah jou ding ham?
en: But who is able to build him a house, since heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain him? Who am I then, that I should build him a house, except just to burn incense before him?
text:
2CH 2:6
Thadou: Hijeng jongleh Koiham Pathen chenna ding inlentah akilomtah sadoh jou ding chu, Ijeh-inem itileh amachu vanho jousen jong adol lou ding ahi. Hiti ahijeh chun, Pumgo thilto ho halnam nading tilou chu; Keima koi kahija Pathen chenna ding in chu kasah jou ding ham?
English: But who is able to build him a house, since heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain him? Who am I then, that I should build him a house, except just to burn incense before him?

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun sana dangka, sum-eng le thih khengthem ho ponsandup, asan-ao le pondum khongthem ho; chule song khengthem ho neihin solpeh in, amaho chun kapa David in analhen dohsa Judah le Jerusalem a natoh thilbol themho tochun atoh khom diu ahi.
en: “Now therefore send me a man skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, and in purple, crimson, and blue, and who knows how to engrave engravings, to be with the skillful men who are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.
text:
2CH 2:7
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun sana dangka, sum-eng le thih khengthem ho ponsandup, asan-ao le pondum khongthem ho; chule song khengthem ho neihin solpeh in, amaho chun kapa David in analhen dohsa Judah le Jerusalem a natoh thilbol themho tochun atoh khom diu ahi.
English: “Now therefore send me a man skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, and in purple, crimson, and blue, and who knows how to engrave engravings, to be with the skillful men who are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.

tcz: Lebanon gam'a um Cedar thing, Chah thing le Algum thing jong chu inthing dingin neihin tolpeh in, ajeh chu Lebanon’a um namite chu thingsui, thing-at lama amaho phajou ding aumpoi. Amaho kithopi dinga chu kamite kahin solpeh diu ahi.
en: “Send me also cedar trees, cypress trees, and algum trees out of Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut timber in Lebanon. Behold, my servants will be with your servants,
text:
2CH 2:8
Thadou: Lebanon gam'a um Cedar thing, Chah thing le Algum thing jong chu inthing dingin neihin tolpeh in, ajeh chu Lebanon’a um namite chu thingsui, thing-at lama amaho phajou ding aumpoi. Amaho kithopi dinga chu kamite kahin solpeh diu ahi.
English: “Send me also cedar trees, cypress trees, and algum trees out of Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut timber in Lebanon. Behold, my servants will be with your servants,

tcz: Keiman kasah ding Houin hi inlentah le thupitah ahiding jeh hin, inthing tamtah lut ding ahi.
en: even to prepare me timber in abundance; for the house which I am about to build will be great and wonderful.
text:
2CH 2:9
Thadou: Keiman kasah ding Houin hi inlentah le thupitah ahiding jeh hin, inthing tamtah lut ding ahi.
English: even to prepare me timber in abundance; for the house which I am about to build will be great and wonderful.

tcz: Nathingsui, nathing at miho dinga chu atoh man diu suhlou changbong atena dim sang somni; sakol chang atena dim sangsomni, lengpithei twi atena sangsomni le Olive thaotwi atena dim sang somni kapeh ding ahi.
en: Behold, I will give to your servants, the cutters who cut timber, twenty thousand cors of beaten wheat, twenty thousand baths of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.”
text:
2CH 2:10
Thadou: Nathingsui, nathing at miho dinga chu atoh man diu suhlou changbong atena dim sang somni; sakol chang atena dim sangsomni, lengpithei twi atena sangsomni le Olive thaotwi atena dim sang somni kapeh ding ahi.
English: Behold, I will give to your servants, the cutters who cut timber, twenty thousand cors of beaten wheat, twenty thousand baths of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.”

tcz: Tyre Lengpa Hiram chun Solomon lekha thot donbutnan hitihin asunin alethot kit tan, “Pakaiyin amite alungsetnin, hijeh chun Aman alengpau vin napansahtai.
en: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, “Because the LORD loves his people, he has made you king over them.”
text:
2CH 2:11
Thadou: Tyre Lengpa Hiram chun Solomon lekha thot donbutnan hitihin asunin alethot kit tan, “Pakaiyin amite alungsetnin, hijeh chun Aman alengpau vin napansahtai.
English: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, “Because the LORD loves his people, he has made you king over them.”

tcz: Vahchoiyun Pakai Israel Pathen chu, Amachun Leng David chu chapa chingtah khat thepna le thil hethemna toh apeh than; amachun Pakai Houin le Leng inpi asahdoh ding ahi.
en: Huram continued, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who would build a house for the LORD and a house for his kingdom.
text:
2CH 2:12
Thadou: Vahchoiyun Pakai Israel Pathen chu, Amachun Leng David chu chapa chingtah khat thepna le thil hethemna toh apeh than; amachun Pakai Houin le Leng inpi asahdoh ding ahi.
English: Huram continued, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who would build a house for the LORD and a house for his kingdom.

tcz: Keiman natong themtah, Khutthemna sangtah nei Huram-abi kitipa chu kahin solpeh e.
en: Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram-abi,
text:
2CH 2:13
Thadou: Keiman natong themtah, Khutthemna sangtah nei Huram-abi kitipa chu kahin solpeh e.
English: Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram-abi,

tcz: Amahi anu Israel nam mi Dan phunga kon ahin, apa hi Tyre gam mi ahi. Amahi Sana dangka sum-eng le thih a kona thil sem themtah chule thingle songa kona jong thilsem themtah ahi. Ponsandup, ponsan-ao, pondum le tupat ponnem khongthem, thiljem semthem jong ahin, itobang jem hijongle akinganse na jouse chu boldoh jengthei ahi. Hitia chu amahin napa kapu David in analhendoh natong themsa ho tochun atoh khom diu ahi.
en: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre. He is skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, in timber, in purple, in blue, in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device, that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.
text:
2CH 2:14
Thadou: Amahi anu Israel nam mi Dan phunga kon ahin, apa hi Tyre gam mi ahi. Amahi Sana dangka sum-eng le thih a kona thil sem themtah chule thingle songa kona jong thilsem themtah ahi. Ponsandup, ponsan-ao, pondum le tupat ponnem khongthem, thiljem semthem jong ahin, itobang jem hijongle akinganse na jouse chu boldoh jengthei ahi. Hitia chu amahin napa kapu David in analhendoh natong themsa ho tochun atoh khom diu ahi.
English: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre. He is skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, in timber, in purple, in blue, in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device, that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun tun Kapun naseisaho suhlou changbong, sakol chang, lengpithei twi le olive thao twi chu neihin thot jengtan,” ati.
en: “Now therefore, the wheat, the barley, the oil, and the wine which my lord has spoken of, let him send to his servants;

tcz: Keihon itobang thing hijongle nadei dei uchu Lebanon lhanga hin sui uvin ting, Mediterranean dillen panga konin pum chungah Joppa chan hintol pehtaovinge. Hiche lai munna kon chun nanghon thing hochu Jerusalem chan nakitol lut thei u ahitai.
en: and we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as you need. We will bring it to you in rafts by sea to Joppa; then you shall carry it up to Jerusalem.”
text:
2CH 2:16
Thadou: Keihon itobang thing hijongle nadei dei uchu Lebanon lhanga hin sui uvin ting, Mediterranean dillen panga konin pum chungah Joppa chan hintol pehtaovinge. Hiche lai munna kon chun nanghon thing hochu Jerusalem chan nakitol lut thei u ahitai.
English: and we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as you need. We will bring it to you in rafts by sea to Joppa; then you shall carry it up to Jerusalem.”

tcz: Solomon chun apan anabol bangin Israel gamsunga cheng gampam miho simna aneiyin ahile agomin mi sangjakhat le sang somnga le thum aphan ahi.
en: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, after the census with which David his father had counted them; and they found one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.
text:
2CH 2:17
Thadou: Solomon chun apan anabol bangin Israel gamsunga cheng gampam miho simna aneiyin ahile agomin mi sangjakhat le sang somnga le thum aphan ahi.
English: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, after the census with which David his father had counted them; and they found one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.

tcz: Hitichun Solomon chun Pakai houin chu Jerusalemma Moriah mola chun asapan tai, hiche laimun hi apa David henga ana kilahna mun chu ahi, Houin kisahna chu Jebus Mipa Araunah kitipa changphol David in ana deilhen munchu ahi.
en: Then Solomon began to build the LORD’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
text:
2CH 3:1
Thadou: Hitichun Solomon chun Pakai houin chu Jerusalemma Moriah mola chun asapan tai, hiche laimun hi apa David henga ana kilahna mun chu ahi, Houin kisahna chu Jebus Mipa Araunah kitipa changphol David in ana deilhen munchu ahi.
English: Then Solomon began to build the LORD’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

tcz: Houin kisahpan chu Solomon lengchan kal kum li lhinna chan ni anahin ahi.
en: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
text:
2CH 3:2
Thadou: Houin kisahpan chu Solomon lengchan kal kum li lhinna chan ni anahin ahi.
English: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

tcz: Pathen Houin kibulphuna dinga Solomon in agonchu adung tong somgup avai tong somni a len ahi.
en: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house: the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.
text:
2CH 3:3
Thadou: Pathen Houin kibulphuna dinga Solomon in agonchu adung tong somgup avai tong somni a len ahi.
English: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house: the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.

tcz: Houin mai’a avaitannaa kisa Hongcha chu adung tong somni chule asandan tong somni ahi. Lut na indan a chu Houin vai lhung kei chan tong somni chule tong somni ma sang ahi, Aman asunglang chu sana thengsellin aloi jin ahi.
en: The porch that was in front, its length, across the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
text:
2CH 3:4
Thadou: Houin mai’a avaitannaa kisa Hongcha chu adung tong somni chule asandan tong somni ahi. Lut na indan a chu Houin vai lhung kei chan tong somni chule tong somni ma sang ahi, Aman asunglang chu sana thengsellin aloi jin ahi.
English: The porch that was in front, its length, across the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

tcz: Houin kimlai dan-lenpen chu chahthingin achunga sana thengsellin athopsah in chule tum-thing le khao kipheh limmin ajemhoi sellin ahi.
en: He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.
text:
2CH 3:5
Thadou: Houin kimlai dan-lenpen chu chahthingin achunga sana thengsellin athopsah in chule tum-thing le khao kipheh limmin ajemhoi sellin ahi.
English: He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.

tcz: Houin Bangchu songmantam hoitah chule Parvaim gam'a hungkon Sana in ajem hoisellin ahi.
en: He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim.
text:
2CH 3:6
Thadou: Houin Bangchu songmantam hoitah chule Parvaim gam'a hungkon Sana in ajem hoisellin ahi.
English: He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim.

tcz: Hitihin Houin inkam jouse, akotjol hole ajol ho, abang hole akot ho jouse chu Sana in atomin, chule bang dunga chun Cherubim lim ageidoh soh keijin ahi.
en: He also overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors with gold, and engraved cherubim on the walls.
text:
2CH 3:7
Thadou: Hitihin Houin inkam jouse, akotjol hole ajol ho, abang hole akot ho jouse chu Sana in atomin, chule bang dunga chun Cherubim lim ageidoh soh keijin ahi.
English: He also overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors with gold, and engraved cherubim on the walls.

tcz: Chule muntheng chungnung pen tong somni in Houin vaitoh kikotnin asemin, chule athuhlam tong somni ma alhinge. Asunglam chu Sana thengsel agih tena sang somnile ja get le somgup le khat lut in alhajollin, atomlhah sah in ahi.
en: He made the most holy place. Its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
text:
2CH 3:8
Thadou: Chule muntheng chungnung pen tong somni in Houin vaitoh kikotnin asemin, chule athuhlam tong somni ma alhinge. Asunglam chu Sana thengsel agih tena sang somnile ja get le somgup le khat lut in alhajollin, atomlhah sah in ahi.
English: He made the most holy place. Its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

tcz: Sana hongcha sahna kimang sana thingkil jong chu, Shekel somnga cheh agih in ahi. Achunglam dan ho jong chu Sanan atomjol sah soh keijin ahi.
en: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.
text:
2CH 3:9
Thadou: Sana hongcha sahna kimang sana thingkil jong chu, Shekel somnga cheh agih in ahi. Achunglam dan ho jong chu Sanan atomjol sah soh keijin ahi.
English: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.

tcz: Aman Cherubim lim tobang ni asemin, hiche teni chu Sanan atomin; muntheng chungnunga chun akoiyin ahi.
en: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving, and they overlaid them with gold.
text:
2CH 3:10
Thadou: Aman Cherubim lim tobang ni asemin, hiche teni chu Sanan atomin; muntheng chungnunga chun akoiyin ahi.
English: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving, and they overlaid them with gold.

tcz: Apangtoa kikai Cherubim teni lha mong asemsa chu tong ngaa asaovin, hiche lhaving chun nilah’a amasapa tong nga asaovin; hiche lhaving chun Houin bang aphai. Cherubim nina pajong chu tong nga ma, asaovin lhaving langkhat chu aphan ahi.
en: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
text:
2CH 3:11
Thadou: Apangtoa kikai Cherubim teni lha mong asemsa chu tong ngaa asaovin, hiche lhaving chun nilah’a amasapa tong nga asaovin; hiche lhaving chun Houin bang aphai. Cherubim nina pajong chu tong nga ma, asaovin lhaving langkhat chu aphan ahi.
English: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

tcz: Chutobang machun Cherubim lim nina pa jong chun tong ngaa sao lhaving aneiyin, hiche chun Houin bang lang khat chu aphai; Alhaving nina pa jong chu tong nga asaovin Cherubim lim masa pa lhaving chu aphan ahi.
en: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
text:
2CH 3:12
Thadou: Chutobang machun Cherubim lim nina pa jong chun tong ngaa sao lhaving aneiyin, hiche chun Houin bang lang khat chu aphai; Alhaving nina pa jong chu tong nga asaovin Cherubim lim masa pa lhaving chu aphan ahi.
English: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

tcz: Hitichun alangtoa Cherubim teni lhamong chu tong somni ahi. Amani Chu akeng lhon’in ading gel lhon in, Houin inkim lamchu anga lhon in ahi.
en: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.
text:
2CH 3:13
Thadou: Hitichun alangtoa Cherubim teni lhamong chu tong somni ahi. Amani Chu akeng lhon’in ading gel lhon in, Houin inkim lamchu anga lhon in ahi.
English: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.

tcz: Muntheng chungnung lutna laitah achun tupat ponnemma kisem adum asandup le asan-ao patna, kijem chule cherubim a lim kikhuibeh pondal khat aki dallin ahi.
en: He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.
text:
2CH 3:14
Thadou: Muntheng chungnung lutna laitah achun tupat ponnemma kisem adum asandup le asan-ao patna, kijem chule cherubim a lim kikhuibeh pondal khat aki dallin ahi.
English: He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.

tcz: Houin mailanga ding chun Solomon in Khompi ni tong somle get a sang aphutnin, anigellin khom alu kisemhoi tong nga in akijop saotou in ahi.
en: Also he made before the house two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
text:
2CH 3:15
Thadou: Houin mailanga ding chun Solomon in Khompi ni tong somle get a sang aphutnin, anigellin khom alu kisemhoi tong nga in akijop saotou in ahi.
English: Also he made before the house two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

tcz: Solomon in khivui tobang'in Sumkol asemin, khompi teni alehvum chu jephoina in amangin ahi. Chujongleh kolbuthei lim jakhat asem in sumkol ho achun ajemhoi din abeh in ahi, chule Houin mai’a lutna lama khompi teni chu khat lhang lamma, chule khatpa joh chu asah lamma aphut in ahi. Lhanglamma kiphut khompi chu Jakin asah in Sahlama pachu Boaz asahtai.
en: He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
text:
2CH 3:16
Thadou: Solomon in khivui tobang'in Sumkol asemin, khompi teni alehvum chu jephoina in amangin ahi. Chujongleh kolbuthei lim jakhat asem in sumkol ho achun ajemhoi din abeh in ahi, chule Houin mai’a lutna lama khompi teni chu khat lhang lamma, chule khatpa joh chu asah lamma aphut in ahi. Lhanglamma kiphut khompi chu Jakin asah in Sahlama pachu Boaz asahtai.
English: He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

tcz: Aman adungavai tong somni chule tong somma sang, sum eng maicham phungkhat asemmin ahi.
en: Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.
text:
2CH 4:1
Thadou: Aman adungavai tong somni chule tong somma sang, sum eng maicham phungkhat asemmin ahi.
English: Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

tcz: Chujouvin twitunna kongtong lentah khat asemin, agei langkhatna pat langkhat chan chu tong som ahin, hichu twipi tin aki minsah in; hiche kongtong bellen chu tong nga’n athuh in, tong somthum in akollin ahi.
en: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.
text:
2CH 4:2
Thadou: Chujouvin twitunna kongtong lentah khat asemin, agei langkhatna pat langkhat chan chu tong som ahin, hichu twipi tin aki minsah in; hiche kongtong bellen chu tong nga’n athuh in, tong somthum in akollin ahi.
English: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.

tcz: Hiche kongtong agei noitah’a chun bongchal lim tobanga kisem golnin akim vellin a kongtong kol lhungkeichun bongchal lim kengkhatna gup gupmin akigolhung keijin chule hiche hochu kongtong kisema chu kisemtha ahitai.
en: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
text:
2CH 4:3
Thadou: Hiche kongtong agei noitah’a chun bongchal lim tobanga kisem golnin akim vellin a kongtong kol lhungkeichun bongchal lim kengkhatna gup gupmin akigolhung keijin chule hiche hochu kongtong kisema chu kisemtha ahitai.
English: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

tcz: Twipi kisah kongtong lentah chu sum eng bongchal somleni chunga chun akikoi yin, abonchauvin apamlam angaove. Bongchal thum chun solam angai, chule amaho chunga chun kongtong lentah twipi kisah chu akingam in ahi.
en: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, three looking toward the west, three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.
text:
2CH 4:4
Thadou: Twipi kisah kongtong lentah chu sum eng bongchal somleni chunga chun akikoi yin, abonchauvin apamlam angaove. Bongchal thum chun solam angai, chule amaho chunga chun kongtong lentah twipi kisah chu akingam in ahi.
English: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, three looking toward the west, three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.

tcz: Twipi kisah kongtong chu khut phang toh kibang in asa’in , ageichin chu khon bangin apaltou in, twikoh pahcha pah tobang ahi. Hiche kongton chun twi tena sangsom sagi le li toh Jani le somnga adollin ahi.
en: It was a handbreadth thick. Its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It received and held three thousand baths.
text:
2CH 4:5
Thadou: Twipi kisah kongtong chu khut phang toh kibang in asa’in , ageichin chu khon bangin apaltou in, twikoh pahcha pah tobang ahi. Hiche kongton chun twi tena sangsom sagi le li toh Jani le somnga adollin ahi.
English: It was a handbreadth thick. Its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It received and held three thousand baths.

tcz: Chujongleh aman pumgo thiltonaa kimang umle bel ho sopna dingin jong kongtong som asem in, kongtong nga chu lhanglama akoiyin nga ma chu sahlama akoiyin ahi. Ahinlah thempuho chun kongtong twipi kiti a chun akisop jiuvin ahi.
en: He also made ten basins, and put five on the right hand and five on the left, to wash in them. The things that belonged to the burnt offering were washed in them, but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
text:
2CH 4:6
Thadou: Chujongleh aman pumgo thiltonaa kimang umle bel ho sopna dingin jong kongtong som asem in, kongtong nga chu lhanglama akoiyin nga ma chu sahlama akoiyin ahi. Ahinlah thempuho chun kongtong twipi kiti a chun akisop jiuvin ahi.
English: He also made ten basins, and put five on the right hand and five on the left, to wash in them. The things that belonged to the burnt offering were washed in them, but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

tcz: Chule aman sana thaomei khom som akiseipeh bang chun, asem in abonchan houin sunga chun atungtai. Thaomei khom nga chu Houin bang jet langa akoi in, nga chu veilanga chun atungin ahi.
en: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand and five on the left.
text:
2CH 4:7
Thadou: Chule aman sana thaomei khom som akiseipeh bang chun, asem in abonchan houin sunga chun atungtai. Thaomei khom nga chu Houin bang jet langa akoi in, nga chu veilanga chun atungin ahi.
English: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand and five on the left.

tcz: Chujongleh aman dokhang som asemin, hichelah’a chun dokhang nga chu bang jetlam'a adon, nga ma chu availam achun adotan ahi, chule sana kong jakhat jong asemin ahi.
en: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.
text:
2CH 4:8
Thadou: Chujongleh aman dokhang som asemin, hichelah’a chun dokhang nga chu bang jetlam'a adon, nga ma chu availam achun adotan ahi, chule sana kong jakhat jong asemin ahi.
English: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.

tcz: Ama chun thempu ho veilama thutana ding hongcha, chule indan inchu hongcha asahpeh in ahi. Hongcha hoa lutle potle nading in akotjong atopeh in chule sum eng in atom khumpeh in ahi.
en: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with bronze.
text:
2CH 4:9
Thadou: Ama chun thempu ho veilama thutana ding hongcha, chule indan inchu hongcha asahpeh in ahi. Hongcha hoa lutle potle nading in akotjong atopeh in chule sum eng in atom khumpeh in ahi.
English: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with bronze.

tcz: Sum eng kongtong lentah twipi kitipen chu, houin lhunna solam anunga chun akoiyin ahi.
en: He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.
text:
2CH 4:10
Thadou: Sum eng kongtong lentah twipi kitipen chu, houin lhunna solam anunga chun akoiyin ahi.
English: He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.

tcz: Chujongleh Hiram-abi chun Pathen houna dinga angaicha khoh thil ho sopna kongtong, vutlo chule chakong jong asemin ahi.
en: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in God’s house:
text:
2CH 4:11
Thadou: Chujongleh Hiram-abi chun Pathen houna dinga angaicha khoh thil ho sopna kongtong, vutlo chule chakong jong asemin ahi.
English: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in God’s house:

tcz: Hitichun Huram-abi chun Lengpa Solomonin Pathen Houin a dinga ngaicha thilho jouse anganse bangchun asem jouse asemjou soh kei tan ahi. Khompi teni luvuma kijopson konglim kisem alukhuh teni, khon lukhuh teni jephoina dinga kisem lencha pheh banga kipheh ho,
en: the two pillars, the bowls, the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars,
text:
2CH 4:12
Thadou: Hitichun Huram-abi chun Lengpa Solomonin Pathen Houin a dinga ngaicha thilho jouse anganse bangchun asem jouse asemjou soh kei tan ahi. Khompi teni luvuma kijopson konglim kisem alukhuh teni, khon lukhuh teni jephoina dinga kisem lencha pheh banga kipheh ho,
English: the two pillars, the bowls, the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars,

tcz: khom lukhuh chunga kito lencha chunga kikhai kolbuthei jaliho (Kolbu thei golni cheh chu khompi chunga kitoson khom kiphut jephoina ding chu asemjoutan ahi).
en: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks—two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.
text:
2CH 4:13
Thadou: khom lukhuh chunga kito lencha chunga kikhai kolbuthei jaliho (Kolbu thei golni cheh chu khompi chunga kitoson khom kiphut jephoina ding chu asemjoutan ahi).
English: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks—two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.

tcz: Kongtong to kitomat kangtalai ho,
en: He also made the bases, and he made the basins on the bases—
text:
2CH 4:14
Thadou: Kongtong to kitomat kangtalai ho,
English: He also made the bases, and he made the basins on the bases—

tcz: Twipi kiti kongtong le anoija bongchal ho;
en: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.

tcz: Vut koina kong ho, vutlo ho; satul ho; chule Houin toh kisamkai thil ho, Haram-abi chun chuche thilho jouse chu sum eng jenga asem ahi. Pakai Houin a dinga Lengpa Solomon in athupeh banga,
en: Huram-abi also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for King Solomon, for the LORD’s house, of bright bronze.
text:
2CH 4:16
Thadou: Vut koina kong ho, vutlo ho; satul ho; chule Houin toh kisamkai thil ho, Haram-abi chun chuche thilho jouse chu sum eng jenga asem ahi. Pakai Houin a dinga Lengpa Solomon in athupeh banga,
English: Huram-abi also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for King Solomon, for the LORD’s house, of bright bronze.

tcz: lengpa chun thilho jouse chu Jordan phaicham Succoth le Zarethan kikah’a chu alhah jolsoh kei ahi.
en: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
text:
2CH 4:17
Thadou: lengpa chun thilho jouse chu Jordan phaicham Succoth le Zarethan kikah’a chu alhah jolsoh kei ahi.
English: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.

tcz: Solomon chun chutobang tah’a mantam sum-eng chu amanchah ahin, ageh danjong seijou hoi ahipoi.
en: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance, so that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.
text:
2CH 4:18
Thadou: Solomon chun chutobang tah’a mantam sum-eng chu amanchah ahin, ageh danjong seijou hoi ahipoi.
English: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance, so that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.

tcz: Chujongleh Solomon chun Pathen Houin a dinga manchah jouse asemin; Sana maicham, changlhah agol golla koina ding dokhang asem in ahi.
en: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house: the golden altar, the tables with the show bread on them,
text:
2CH 4:19
Thadou: Chujongleh Solomon chun Pathen Houin a dinga manchah jouse asemin; Sana maicham, changlhah agol golla koina ding dokhang asem in ahi.
English: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house: the golden altar, the tables with the show bread on them,

tcz: Akisemdoh akisei banga muntheng chungnunga vahding, sana thengsella kisem sana thaomei le thaomei khom ho;
en: and the lamp stands with their lamps to burn according to the ordinance before the inner sanctuary, of pure gold;

tcz: Pahcha kijemhoi ho, thaomei chule chaiche ho chu aboncha sana thengsella kisemcheh ahiuve.
en: and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of gold that was purest gold;

tcz: Thaomei thamitna ho, kongtong ho bukong ho chule thilnamtui halkhutna ho, jong aboncha sana thengsella kisem ahi; houin a muntheng chungnung lut le potle na kotcha hole, kotpi ho jong chu sana thengsella kito ahisoh keijin ahi.
en: and the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans of pure gold. As for the entry of the house, its inner doors for the most holy place and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold.
text:
2CH 4:22
Thadou: Thaomei thamitna ho, kongtong ho bukong ho chule thilnamtui halkhutna ho, jong aboncha sana thengsella kisem ahi; houin a muntheng chungnung lut le potle na kotcha hole, kotpi ho jong chu sana thengsella kito ahisoh keijin ahi.
English: and the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans of pure gold. As for the entry of the house, its inner doors for the most holy place and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold.

tcz: Hiti chun Solomon chun Pakai Houin a anatoh ding jouse atongchaitai. Chuin Aman apa David in ana lhandohsa thilto ho-sana, dangka thil jatchom chom tamtah chu Pathen Houin na chun ahinpolutnin gou thilkoinaa chun akoitai.
en: Thus all the work that Solomon did for the LORD’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, even the silver, the gold, and all the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of God’s house.
text:
2CH 5:1
Thadou: Hiti chun Solomon chun Pakai Houin a anatoh ding jouse atongchaitai. Chuin Aman apa David in ana lhandohsa thilto ho-sana, dangka thil jatchom chom tamtah chu Pathen Houin na chun ahinpolutnin gou thilkoinaa chun akoitai.
English: Thus all the work that Solomon did for the LORD’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, even the silver, the gold, and all the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of God’s house.

tcz: Chuin Solomon chun Israel upa ho, aphung khaiya aluboh ho, Israelte pule pa lhah’a insung lamkai ho akoukhomin ahi. Amaho chun Pathen thingkong chu aumna mun Zion tia kihe David khopia kona Houin a chu ahin putlut diu ahi.
en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.
text:
2CH 5:2
Thadou: Chuin Solomon chun Israel upa ho, aphung khaiya aluboh ho, Israelte pule pa lhah’a insung lamkai ho akoukhomin ahi. Amaho chun Pathen thingkong chu aumna mun Zion tia kihe David khopia kona Houin a chu ahin putlut diu ahi.
English: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

tcz: Chuti chun Israel pasal ho chu kumseh’a chavang laiya kimangji, lhambuh kut kimanna munna lengpa angsunga chun akikhom tauvin ahi.
en: So all the men of Israel assembled themselves to the king at the feast, which was in the seventh month.
text:
2CH 5:3
Thadou: Chuti chun Israel pasal ho chu kumseh’a chavang laiya kimangji, lhambuh kut kimanna munna lengpa angsunga chun akikhom tauvin ahi.
English: So all the men of Israel assembled themselves to the king at the feast, which was in the seventh month.

tcz: Israel upa ho jouse ahunglhun phat uchun Levi techun thingkong chu adomdoh-un;
en: All the elders of Israel came. The Levites took up the ark.

tcz: Chuin thempu hole Levi techun thingkong le ponbuh chule atilla-patna asunga ana umsa thil theng hochu ahin polut tauve.
en: They brought up the ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The Levitical priests brought these up.
text:
2CH 5:5
Thadou: Chuin thempu hole Levi techun thingkong le ponbuh chule atilla-patna asunga ana umsa thil theng hochu ahin polut tauve.
English: They brought up the ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The Levitical priests brought these up.

tcz: Hichun thingkong masanga leng Solomon le Israel mipi chun kelngoi ho, kelchaho chule bong atama tam, simjou hilou chu Pathen adin alhandoh tauve.
en: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel who were assembled to him were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.
text:
2CH 5:6
Thadou: Hichun thingkong masanga leng Solomon le Israel mipi chun kelngoi ho, kelchaho chule bong atama tam, simjou hilou chu Pathen adin alhandoh tauve.
English: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel who were assembled to him were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

tcz: Hichun thempu ho chun Pakai thingkong chu Houin theng dan sungnung muntheng chungnung pen, Cherubim lhaving teni noiya chun akoi tauvin ahi,
en: The priests brought in the ark of the LORD’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.
text:
2CH 5:7
Thadou: Hichun thempu ho chun Pakai thingkong chu Houin theng dan sungnung muntheng chungnung pen, Cherubim lhaving teni noiya chun akoi tauvin ahi,
English: The priests brought in the ark of the LORD’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.

tcz: Cherubim chun thingkong chunga chu alhavingteni ajallin ahile, thingkong le akiputna moljol teni ding chun abuh-khu’in apang jeng in ahi.
en: For the cherubim spread out their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.
text:
2CH 5:8
Thadou: Cherubim chun thingkong chunga chu alhavingteni ajallin ahile, thingkong le akiputna moljol teni ding chun abuh-khu’in apang jeng in ahi.
English: For the cherubim spread out their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

tcz: Hiche akiputna moljol teni chu asaobeh set jeh chun, Houin a indan sungnung muntheng chungnung pena konin; amongval chu akimu theijin ahi. Ahinlah Houin pama konin vang akimu theipoi, hichu tuni chan in hichelai muna chun aum nalaiyin ahi.
en: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the ark in front of the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside; and it is there to this day.
text:
2CH 5:9
Thadou: Hiche akiputna moljol teni chu asaobeh set jeh chun, Houin a indan sungnung muntheng chungnung pena konin; amongval chu akimu theijin ahi. Ahinlah Houin pama konin vang akimu theipoi, hichu tuni chan in hichelai muna chun aum nalaiyin ahi.
English: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the ark in front of the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside; and it is there to this day.

tcz: Pathen thingkong sunga chun Sinai molchunga Mose in anakoi songpeh teni tilou thildang emacha aumpoi, hiche lai mun hi Israel ten Egypt gam ahin dalhah nungu va Pakai toh Israel ten kitepna anasem nau mun chu ahi.
en: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.
text:
2CH 5:10
Thadou: Pathen thingkong sunga chun Sinai molchunga Mose in anakoi songpeh teni tilou thildang emacha aumpoi, hiche lai mun hi Israel ten Egypt gam ahin dalhah nungu va Pakai toh Israel ten kitepna anasem nau mun chu ahi.
English: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

tcz: Chuin thempuho chun muntheng chu adalha tauve . Thempuho chu hiche nikho kin; kibolnaa panghen lang panghih jongle abon chaovin akisutheng soh keiyun ahi.
en: When the priests had come out of the holy place (for all the priests who were present had sanctified themselves, and didn’t keep their divisions;

tcz: Chule Levite lasa themho Asaph, Heman Jeduthun chule asopiho le achateu chu tupat pon nemin akivon nun, maicham solama chun adingun; semjang pehkhong le selangdah atum un ahi. Amaho chu thempuho jakhat le somni chun sumkon mutnin akitho piuvin ahi.
en: also the Levites who were the singers, all of them, even Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, arrayed in fine linen, with cymbals and stringed instruments and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests sounding with trumpets);

tcz: Sumkon mutho le lasa themho chun thakhat tah in Pakai chu choi-at nale thangvahna apeuvin ahi. Sumkon , Sumlheng chule suhgingthei jatchom chom toh thon Pakai chu hiti hin avah choiyun, “Pakai chu anunnome, Ami lungset na long lou chu atonsot na umjing ahi . Hiche pet tah chun meilhang lom khatnin Pakai Houin chu ahin lodim jengin ahi.
en: when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and praised the LORD, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!” then the house was filled with a cloud, even the LORD’s house,
text:
2CH 5:13
Thadou: Sumkon mutho le lasa themho chun thakhat tah in Pakai chu choi-at nale thangvahna apeuvin ahi. Sumkon , Sumlheng chule suhgingthei jatchom chom toh thon Pakai chu hiti hin avah choiyun, “Pakai chu anunnome, Ami lungset na long lou chu atonsot na umjing ahi . Hiche pet tah chun meilhang lom khatnin Pakai Houin chu ahin lodim jengin ahi.
English: when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and praised the LORD, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!” then the house was filled with a cloud, even the LORD’s house,

tcz: Hiche meilhang jeh chun thempu ho chun anatoh u ajom thei tapouve, ijeh inem itile Pakai loupina chun Pathen Houin chu alo dimset ahitai.”
en: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the LORD’s glory filled God’s house.
text:
2CH 5:14
Thadou: Hiche meilhang jeh chun thempu ho chun anatoh u ajom thei tapouve, ijeh inem itile Pakai loupina chun Pathen Houin chu alo dimset ahitai.”
English: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the LORD’s glory filled God’s house.

tcz: Chuin Solomon chu ataovin, “O Pakai nangin muthim lhangkhal kiheh lah’a kachenge nanatin,
en: Then Solomon said, “The LORD has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
text:
2CH 6:1
Thadou: Chuin Solomon chu ataovin, “O Pakai nangin muthim lhangkhal kiheh lah’a kachenge nanatin,
English: Then Solomon said, “The LORD has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

tcz: Tun keiman tonsotna nachen nading Houin loupitah khat kasahpeh tai,” ati.
en: But I have built you a house and home, a place for you to dwell in forever.”
text:
2CH 6:2
Thadou: Tun keiman tonsotna nachen nading Houin loupitah khat kasahpeh tai,” ati.
English: But I have built you a house and home, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

tcz: Chuin lengpa chun amasanga ding-Israel mipi lam chu angan ahung kiheidoh in, hitichun Pathen phatheina athumpeh in ahi.
en: The king turned his face, and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.
text:
2CH 6:3
Thadou: Chuin lengpa chun amasanga ding-Israel mipi lam chu angan ahung kiheidoh in, hitichun Pathen phatheina athumpeh in ahi.
English: The king turned his face, and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

tcz: “Vahchoiyun Pakai Israel Pathen chu, aman kapa koma akamcheng tah’a akitepna chu asuhbulhit ahitai, kapa jah’a anaseiyin,
en: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David my father, and has with his hands fulfilled it, saying,
text:
2CH 6:4
Thadou: “Vahchoiyun Pakai Israel Pathen chu, aman kapa koma akamcheng tah’a akitepna chu asuhbulhit ahitai, kapa jah’a anaseiyin,
English: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David my father, and has with his hands fulfilled it, saying,

tcz: “Kami Israelte Egypt gam'a kahin puidoh nikhoa pat chun, Kamin ki jana ding Houin sahna ding in; Israel phung sunga khopi dang kalhengpoi chule kami Israelte chunga vaihom ding in koima dang kalhengpoi.
en: ‘Since the day that I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house in, that my name might be there, and I chose no man to be prince over my people Israel;

tcz: Ahinlah tun Keiman Jerusalem hi kamin kijabolna Houin mun dingin kalheng in, chule kami Israelte chunga leng ding in David hi kalhengtai,” ati.
en: but now I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.’
text:
2CH 6:6
Thadou: Ahinlah tun Keiman Jerusalem hi kamin kijabolna Houin mun dingin kalheng in, chule kami Israelte chunga leng ding in David hi kalhengtai,” ati.
English: but now I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.’

tcz: Chuin Solomon chun, “Kapa David lungthimma Pakai Israel Pathen min jabolna ding Houin khat sahdoh nom na aum jing in ahi,” ati.
en: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
text:
2CH 6:7
Thadou: Chuin Solomon chun, “Kapa David lungthimma Pakai Israel Pathen min jabolna ding Houin khat sahdoh nom na aum jing in ahi,” ati.
English: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

tcz: “Ahinlah Pakai chun kapa jah’a kamin jabolna ding Houin khat sahdinga nagel chu apha lheh’e atin ahi.
en: But the LORD said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart;

tcz: Hijongleh nangma hi Houin sading chu nahipoi, ahinlah natahsa le nathisana pengdoh nachapa tah chun, Kamin kijabol na ding Houin chu asahdoh joh ding ahi,” ati.
en: nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who will come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’
text:
2CH 6:9
Thadou: Hijongleh nangma hi Houin sading chu nahipoi, ahinlah natahsa le nathisana pengdoh nachapa tah chun, Kamin kijabol na ding Houin chu asahdoh joh ding ahi,” ati.
English: nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who will come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’

tcz: “Chule tun Pakai chun ana kitepna chu asubulhitnin kapa khellin lengpa kahung hitai, chule Pakai kitepna bangchun Israel laltouna a katoutai. Pakai Israel Pathen min jabolna dingin Houin khat kasadohtai.
en: “The LORD has performed his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
text:
2CH 6:10
Thadou: “Chule tun Pakai chun ana kitepna chu asubulhitnin kapa khellin lengpa kahung hitai, chule Pakai kitepna bangchun Israel laltouna a katoutai. Pakai Israel Pathen min jabolna dingin Houin khat kasadohtai.
English: “The LORD has performed his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

tcz: Hiche laimuna chun Pakai in ami Israelte toh akitepna kikoina Pathen thingkong chu kakoitai,” ati.
en: There I have set the ark, in which is the LORD’s covenant, which he made with the children of Israel.”
text:
2CH 6:11
Thadou: Hiche laimuna chun Pakai in ami Israelte toh akitepna kikoina Pathen thingkong chu kakoitai,” ati.
English: There I have set the ark, in which is the LORD’s covenant, which he made with the children of Israel.”

tcz: Chuin Solomon chu Israel pumpi masang Pakai maicham masanga chun ading doh in, akhut teni ajah in ataotan ahi.
en: He stood before the LORD’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands
text:
2CH 6:12
Thadou: Chuin Solomon chu Israel pumpi masang Pakai maicham masanga chun ading doh in, akhut teni ajah in ataotan ahi.
English: He stood before the LORD’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands

tcz: Tun Solomon chun Sum-enga kisem thuseina munkhat adung-avai tong nga, chule asan lam tong thum asemmin Houin leitol lailunga chun adotan ahi.
en: (for Solomon had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the middle of the court; and he stood on it, and knelt down on his knees before all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven).
text:
2CH 6:13
Thadou: Tun Solomon chun Sum-enga kisem thuseina munkhat adung-avai tong nga, chule asan lam tong thum asemmin Houin leitol lailunga chun adotan ahi.
English: (for Solomon had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the middle of the court; and he stood on it, and knelt down on his knees before all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven).

tcz: Vo Pakai, Israel Pathen van le leiya nangma tobang Pathen dang aumpoi, nangman nakitepna nanit jing in, alungthim pumpia nangma kom hinjonna kipedohte nalungsetna longlou chu nachan jinge.
en: Then he said, “LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth—you who keep covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

tcz: Nangman nalhachapa kapa David komma nakitepna nanit jinge, “Tun nangman nakam chengtah’a kitepna nasem chu nangma khut tah in nasubulhit tai,” tin Solomon chu ataovin ahi.
en: who have kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.
text:
2CH 6:15
