Thadou: Nangman nalhachapa kapa David komma nakitepna nanit jinge, “Tun nangman nakam chengtah’a kitepna nasem chu nangma khut tah in nasubulhit tai,” tin Solomon chu ataovin ahi.
English: who have kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

tcz: Hijeh chun, “Vo Pakai Israel Pathen tun nalhacha kapa David komma kitepna adang nasem ho chu nitjing tan, nangman nabol bang banga na chilhah te jong lamdih’a achonnuva kadan thupeh ho kitahna neitah’a ajuidiu le amaho lah’a khat pen pen chu Israel laltouna a toujing ding ahi,” nati.
en: “Now therefore, LORD, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk in my law as you have walked before me.’
text:
2CH 6:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun, “Vo Pakai Israel Pathen tun nalhacha kapa David komma kitepna adang nasem ho chu nitjing tan, nangman nabol bang banga na chilhah te jong lamdih’a achonnuva kadan thupeh ho kitahna neitah’a ajuidiu le amaho lah’a khat pen pen chu Israel laltouna a toujing ding ahi,” nati.
English: “Now therefore, LORD, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk in my law as you have walked before me.’

tcz: “Vo Pakai, Israel Pathen tuhin nalhacha, David koma nakitepna chu subulhit jengtan,” ati.
en: Now therefore, LORD, the God of Israel, let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David.
text:
2CH 6:17
Thadou: “Vo Pakai, Israel Pathen tuhin nalhacha, David koma nakitepna chu subulhit jengtan,” ati.
English: Now therefore, LORD, the God of Israel, let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David.

tcz: Ahinlah, Pathen chu leiset mihemte lah’a hi chengmong ding hinam? Ijeh-inem itileh vanchung sangpen hon jong nangma hi nadol lou ding ahi, chutileh keiman kasah Houin hi iti neova neo ding hitam?
en: “But will God indeed dwell with men on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house which I have built!
text:
2CH 6:18
Thadou: Ahinlah, Pathen chu leiset mihemte lah’a hi chengmong ding hinam? Ijeh-inem itileh vanchung sangpen hon jong nangma hi nadol lou ding ahi, chutileh keiman kasah Houin hi iti neova neo ding hitam?
English: “But will God indeed dwell with men on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house which I have built!

tcz: asun ajanin hiche Houin a namin kijabolna dinga naseina mun hi nahin vetjing thei’a, chule nalhachate le namiten hiche mun lam nga-a taona ahin man tengule nahin ngai na din;
en: that your eyes may be open toward this house day and night, even toward the place where you have said that you would put your name, to listen to the prayer which your servant will pray toward this place.

tcz: keima le nami Israel ten kineosahtah le ngaicha tah’a hiche langmun ngatna kahin ngeh tengule nahin ngaipeh theina dingun, nachenna mun vanna kon in hingaiyin lang najah tengle hin ngaidam in.
en: Listen to the petitions of your servant and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear from your dwelling place, even from heaven; and when you hear, forgive.
text:
2CH 6:21
Thadou: keima le nami Israel ten kineosahtah le ngaicha tah’a hiche langmun ngatna kahin ngeh tengule nahin ngaipeh theina dingun, nachenna mun vanna kon in hingaiyin lang najah tengle hin ngaidam in.
English: Listen to the petitions of your servant and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear from your dwelling place, even from heaven; and when you hear, forgive.

tcz: Koitobang hamkhatnin aheng akom chunga suhkhel neija themmo akichanteng kathemoe tia akihahselna dinga, hiche Houin maicham masanga ahung tengule,
en: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,
text:
2CH 6:22
Thadou: Koitobang hamkhatnin aheng akom chunga suhkhel neija themmo akichanteng kathemoe tia akihahselna dinga, hiche Houin maicham masanga ahung tengule,
English: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,

tcz: vanna konin hinngai inlang, thu hin tanpeh jengin; asukhel athemmopa chu achan dinga lom chansah inlang, mona neiloupa chu lhadoh jeng in.
en: then hear from heaven, act, and judge your servants, bringing retribution to the wicked, to bring his way on his own head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
text:
2CH 6:23
Thadou: vanna konin hinngai inlang, thu hin tanpeh jengin; asukhel athemmopa chu achan dinga lom chansah inlang, mona neiloupa chu lhadoh jeng in.
English: then hear from heaven, act, and judge your servants, bringing retribution to the wicked, to bring his way on his own head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

tcz: Namite Israelte chun nangma dounaa achonset jeh uva, gal aleluva achonset nau akona ahung kiheikit uva; chule nangma angsunga ahung kineosah uva, nangma nahin koukituva ahungtao kit ule;
en: “If your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, and they turn again and confess your name, and pray and make supplication before you in this house,

tcz: Vanna konin hin ngaiyin lang, nami Israelte chonsetna chu hin ngaidam in, chule amaho le apu apateu napehsa gam chu lepeh kit tan.
en: then hear from heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.
text:
2CH 6:25
Thadou: Vanna konin hin ngaiyin lang, nami Israelte chonsetna chu hin ngaidam in, chule amaho le apu apateu napehsa gam chu lepeh kit tan.
English: then hear from heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.

tcz: Namite chu nangma dounaa achonset jeh uva vankot akikhaa gotwi ajuh louva chule achonset jeh uva nabol gim teng le, iham tia a chonset nauva konna ahung kinung heikit uva nangma min pan’a hiche Houin lam ngatna ahung tao tengule,
en: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,
text:
2CH 6:26
Thadou: Namite chu nangma dounaa achonset jeh uva vankot akikhaa gotwi ajuh louva chule achonset jeh uva nabol gim teng le, iham tia a chonset nauva konna ahung kinung heikit uva nangma min pan’a hiche Houin lam ngatna ahung tao tengule,
English: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,

tcz: vanna konin hin ngaiyin lang nalhachate nami Israelte chonsetna chu ngaidam in, lamdih ajot thei nadiuvin hil inlang, chule nangman namite chan dinga napehsa gamma chun gotwi chu juhsah kittan.
en: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk, and send rain on your land, which you have given to your people for an inheritance.
text:
2CH 6:27
Thadou: vanna konin hin ngaiyin lang nalhachate nami Israelte chonsetna chu ngaidam in, lamdih ajot thei nadiuvin hil inlang, chule nangman namite chan dinga napehsa gamma chun gotwi chu juhsah kittan.
English: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk, and send rain on your land, which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

tcz: Iham tia gamsunga kel alhah’a pul alanna, muchi-chivo ho chunga natna achuh a, namite chu galmiten gamsunga ahindel khum uva; akhopihou ahin umkimvel uva amat gotuva chule itobang vangsetna le natpi umjongle,
en: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight or mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemies besiege them in the land of their cities; whatever plague or whatever sickness there is—
text:
2CH 6:28
Thadou: Iham tia gamsunga kel alhah’a pul alanna, muchi-chivo ho chunga natna achuh a, namite chu galmiten gamsunga ahindel khum uva; akhopihou ahin umkimvel uva amat gotuva chule itobang vangsetna le natpi umjongle,
English: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight or mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemies besiege them in the land of their cities; whatever plague or whatever sickness there is—

tcz: nami Israel techun hitobang genthei hahsatna chunga hi akhut ajah uva, Houin lang ngatna ahung tao ule,
en: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who will each know his own plague and his own sorrow, and shall spread out his hands toward this house,
text:
2CH 6:29
Thadou: nami Israel techun hitobang genthei hahsatna chunga hi akhut ajah uva, Houin lang ngatna ahung tao ule,
English: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who will each know his own plague and his own sorrow, and shall spread out his hands toward this house,

tcz: Van naumnaa konin hin ngaiyin lang ngaidam in, namite chu athilbol aumchan toh kilomin bolpeh in, ajeh chu nangbouseh in mihem khatcheh lungsung hi nahet ahi.
en: then hear from heaven your dwelling place and forgive, and render to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of the children of men),
text:
2CH 6:30
Thadou: Van naumnaa konin hin ngaiyin lang ngaidam in, namite chu athilbol aumchan toh kilomin bolpeh in, ajeh chu nangbouseh in mihem khatcheh lungsung hi nahet ahi.
English: then hear from heaven your dwelling place and forgive, and render to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of the children of men),

tcz: Chutileh nangman apu-apateu nana pehsa gamsunga achen laiseuva, nangma hi nagin jing diu nangma lampi chu ajot jing diu ahi.
en: that they may fear you, to walk in your ways as long as they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.
text:
2CH 6:31
Thadou: Chutileh nangman apu-apateu nana pehsa gamsunga achen laiseuva, nangma hi nagin jing diu nangma lampi chu ajot jing diu ahi.
English: that they may fear you, to walk in your ways as long as they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

tcz: Khonung tengle gampam miho nami Israel hilou ho chun, nangma hina chu ahinjah doh uva nagin diu ahi. Ama hochun naloupina, nathahatna le naban thahat thilbol theina ho chu ahin jahdohuva, gamlatah gamho akonna hungdiu ahi. Chutengle amaho chun hiche Houin lang ngatna ahungtao tengule,
en: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes from a far country for your great name’s sake and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm, when they come and pray toward this house,
text:
2CH 6:32
Thadou: Khonung tengle gampam miho nami Israel hilou ho chun, nangma hina chu ahinjah doh uva nagin diu ahi. Ama hochun naloupina, nathahatna le naban thahat thilbol theina ho chu ahin jahdohuva, gamlatah gamho akonna hungdiu ahi. Chutengle amaho chun hiche Houin lang ngatna ahungtao tengule,
English: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes from a far country for your great name’s sake and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm, when they come and pray toward this house,

tcz: vana naumna mun akon in ataonau hin ngaipeh inlang, athil thum uchu hinsan pehtan; hitia chu nami Israelte banga chu leiset mihem te jousen nangma hi nahin hetdoh diu ahi. Amaho jong chun hiche Houin hi nangma min kijabolna dinga kisadoh ahichu ahin hetdoh diu ahi.
en: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.
text:
2CH 6:33
Thadou: vana naumna mun akon in ataonau hin ngaipeh inlang, athil thum uchu hinsan pehtan; hitia chu nami Israelte banga chu leiset mihem te jousen nangma hi nahin hetdoh diu ahi. Amaho jong chun hiche Houin hi nangma min kijabolna dinga kisadoh ahichu ahin hetdoh diu ahi.
English: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

tcz: Namite chu galsat dinga nasol dohnauva kona chu nangman nadeilhen khopi lam ngatna, chule nangma min kijabolna dinga kasadoh Houin lam ngatna ahungtao teng ule,
en: “If your people go out to battle against their enemies, by whatever way you send them, and they pray to you toward this city which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name;

tcz: vana konin hin ngaipeh inlang, athum pen uchu hin kithopi tan.
en: then hear from heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
text:
2CH 6:35
Thadou: vana konin hin ngaipeh inlang, athum pen uchu hin kithopi tan.
English: then hear from heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

tcz: Aitih’a chonse ngailou nangma dounaa achonset tengule, nangman amaho chunga nalung hanna; chutengle amaho chu agalmiten jou uvintin, gampam mi anai hijongle agamla hijongle sohchangin kaimang tauhen.
en: “If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to a land far off or near;

tcz: Ahinlah chuche asohchan nau gam achun kisih tah in hung kinung hei kit uhenlang, tao uhenlang eiho ichonse tauve, thilse iboltauve atiuva,
en: yet if they come to their senses in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned, we have done perversely, and have dealt wickedly;’
text:
2CH 6:37
Thadou: Ahinlah chuche asohchan nau gam achun kisih tah in hung kinung hei kit uhenlang, tao uhenlang eiho ichonse tauve, thilse iboltauve atiuva,
English: yet if they come to their senses in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned, we have done perversely, and have dealt wickedly;’

tcz: asoh channau gamma chu alungthim pumpiu le alhagao pumpia ahung kinung heikit uva, apu apateu nana pehsa gam lam ngatna chule nangman nalhentum khopi lam ahin ngat uva, namin jabolna'a kisadoh Houin lam nga-a ahungtao tengule,
en: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they have been taken captive, and pray toward their land which you gave to their fathers, and the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name;

tcz: van na umna munna konin ataonau le athumnao hin ngaipeh inlang, athum lo na pen bang uchun hin panpi tan.
en: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, their prayer and their petitions, and maintain their cause, and forgive your people who have sinned against you.
text:
2CH 6:39
Thadou: van na umna munna konin ataonau le athumnao hin ngaipeh inlang, athum lo na pen bang uchun hin panpi tan.
English: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, their prayer and their petitions, and maintain their cause, and forgive your people who have sinned against you.

tcz: O Pathen hiche lai munna konna taona hung kimang jouse hi hin venlang, na nakol hin sung tem in.
en: “Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.
text:
2CH 6:40
Thadou: O Pathen hiche lai munna konna taona hung kimang jouse hi hin venlang, na nakol hin sung tem in.
English: “Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.

tcz: Chule vo Pakai, Pathen hung kithoudoh inlang nakichol nading mun nathahatni mel thingkonga hin hunglut temin, vo Pakai Pathen na thempuho chun sochat na ponsil kisil uhen; thudih’a chonna chate chu nangma phatna jallin kipah thanom uhen.
en: “Now therefore arise, LORD God, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. Let your priests, LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in goodness.
text:
2CH 6:41
Thadou: Chule vo Pakai, Pathen hung kithoudoh inlang nakichol nading mun nathahatni mel thingkonga hin hunglut temin, vo Pakai Pathen na thempuho chun sochat na ponsil kisil uhen; thudih’a chonna chate chu nangma phatna jallin kipah thanom uhen.
English: “Now therefore arise, LORD God, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. Let your priests, LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in goodness.

tcz: Vo Pakai, Pathen thao nanusa Lengpa chu nodoh dan, nalhacha David long louva nalungsetna chu hin geldoh jing jeng in.
en: “LORD God, don’t turn away the face of your anointed. Remember your loving kindnesses to David your servant.”
text:
2CH 6:42
Thadou: Vo Pakai, Pathen thao nanusa Lengpa chu nodoh dan, nalhacha David long louva nalungsetna chu hin geldoh jing jeng in.
English: “LORD God, don’t turn away the face of your anointed. Remember your loving kindnesses to David your servant.”

tcz: Solomon in ataona ahin chai chai chun, vana konin meikong ahungkikho lhan; pumgo thilto hole kilhaina ho Chu akavam soh keiyin, chuin Pakai loupina chun Houin sung chu alo dim soh jengin ahi.
en: Now when Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the LORD’s glory filled the house.
text:
2CH 7:1
Thadou: Solomon in ataona ahin chai chai chun, vana konin meikong ahungkikho lhan; pumgo thilto hole kilhaina ho Chu akavam soh keiyin, chuin Pakai loupina chun Houin sung chu alo dim soh jengin ahi.
English: Now when Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the LORD’s glory filled the house.

tcz: Pakai loupinan Houin sung alodim tah jeh chun, thempu ho chu Houin sunga chun alut thei tapouvin ahi.
en: The priests could not enter into the LORD’s house, because the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 7:2
Thadou: Pakai loupinan Houin sung alodim tah jeh chun, thempu ho chu Houin sunga chun alut thei tapouvin ahi.
English: The priests could not enter into the LORD’s house, because the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house.

tcz: Israel mipi ho chun meikong ahung kikholhah’a Houin sung alo dimset chu amuphat un, Pakai chu ahou un avahchoi tauve. Pakai hi aphai, Ami lungsetna long lou chun atonsotnin aumjinge atiuvin ahi.
en: All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and the LORD’s glory was on the house. They bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement, worshiped, and gave thanks to the LORD, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!”
text:
2CH 7:3
Thadou: Israel mipi ho chun meikong ahung kikholhah’a Houin sung alo dimset chu amuphat un, Pakai chu ahou un avahchoi tauve. Pakai hi aphai, Ami lungsetna long lou chun atonsotnin aumjinge atiuvin ahi.
English: All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and the LORD’s glory was on the house. They bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement, worshiped, and gave thanks to the LORD, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!”

tcz: Chuin Lengpa le mipi ho chun, Pakai dingin kilhaina thilto abolluvin ahi.
en: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.
text:
2CH 7:4
Thadou: Chuin Lengpa le mipi ho chun, Pakai dingin kilhaina thilto abolluvin ahi.
English: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.

tcz: Lengpa Solomon chun kilhaina man ding in, bong sang som le ni kelngoi le kelcha sang jakhat le sang somni atoh doh in ahi. Chuin Lengpa le mipi ho chun Pathen Houin chu akatdoh tauvin ahi.
en: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated God’s house.
text:
2CH 7:5
Thadou: Lengpa Solomon chun kilhaina man ding in, bong sang som le ni kelngoi le kelcha sang jakhat le sang somni atoh doh in ahi. Chuin Lengpa le mipi ho chun Pathen Houin chu akatdoh tauvin ahi.
English: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated God’s house.

tcz: Thempu ho chun akinganse nau panmun cheh chu alo-uvin, chule chutobang ma chun Levi techun, “Ami lungsetna longlouvin atonsotnin aum jinge tin lan asaove, amaho chun Lengpa David in Pakai vahchoina dinga anasem la chu tumging tothon asaovin ahi. Israel mipi ho adin sungu chun Levite maidon tah’a chun thempu hon sumkon amut uvin ahi.”
en: The priests stood, according to their positions; the Levites also with instruments of music of the LORD, which David the king had made to give thanks to the LORD, when David praised by their ministry, saying “For his loving kindness endures forever.” The priests sounded trumpets before them; and all Israel stood.
text:
2CH 7:6
Thadou: Thempu ho chun akinganse nau panmun cheh chu alo-uvin, chule chutobang ma chun Levi techun, “Ami lungsetna longlouvin atonsotnin aum jinge tin lan asaove, amaho chun Lengpa David in Pakai vahchoina dinga anasem la chu tumging tothon asaovin ahi. Israel mipi ho adin sungu chun Levite maidon tah’a chun thempu hon sumkon amut uvin ahi.”
English: The priests stood, according to their positions; the Levites also with instruments of music of the LORD, which David the king had made to give thanks to the LORD, when David praised by their ministry, saying “For his loving kindness endures forever.” The priests sounded trumpets before them; and all Israel stood.

tcz: Chuin Solomon chun Pakai Houin leitol lailung tah chu athenson, pumgo thilto le sathao chamna thilto ho chu hilai munna chun alhan doh in ahi; ijeh-inem itileh sum eng maicham chun pumgo thilto ho, lhosoh gasoh thilto chule sathao chamna thilto chu adollou ahitai.
en: Moreover Solomon made the middle of the court that was before the LORD’s house holy; for there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat.
text:
2CH 7:7
Thadou: Chuin Solomon chun Pakai Houin leitol lailung tah chu athenson, pumgo thilto le sathao chamna thilto ho chu hilai munna chun alhan doh in ahi; ijeh-inem itileh sum eng maicham chun pumgo thilto ho, lhosoh gasoh thilto chule sathao chamna thilto chu adollou ahitai.
English: Moreover Solomon made the middle of the court that was before the LORD’s house holy; for there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat.

tcz: Solomon le Israel mipi chun nisagi sungin lhambuh kut amangun ahi. Agamla penna seidingin sahlama Lebohanath chule lhanglama Egypt gamgi changei mi atama tam akikhomdoh un ahi.
en: So Solomon held the feast at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt.
text:
2CH 7:8
Thadou: Solomon le Israel mipi chun nisagi sungin lhambuh kut amangun ahi. Agamla penna seidingin sahlama Lebohanath chule lhanglama Egypt gamgi changei mi atama tam akikhomdoh un ahi.
English: So Solomon held the feast at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt.

tcz: Amahon maicham mun katdohna din ni sagi amangun, lhanbuh kut bolnan ni sagi ma amangun ahi. Chuin aniget lhin nin akhum khana kin abollun ahi.
en: On the eighth day, they held a solemn assembly; for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.
text:
2CH 7:9
Thadou: Amahon maicham mun katdohna din ni sagi amangun, lhanbuh kut bolnan ni sagi ma amangun ahi. Chuin aniget lhin nin akhum khana kin abollun ahi.
English: On the eighth day, they held a solemn assembly; for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

tcz: Kin bol kichai chun Solomon in miho chu ama ama incheh’a asol tan ahi. Amaho chu akipah thanom theilheh jeng uve. Ijeh-inem itileh Pakai chu David le Solomon chule ami Israelte dingin ana phajing jeng in ahi.
en: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month, he sent the people away to their tents, joyful and glad of heart for the goodness that the LORD had shown to David, to Solomon, and to Israel his people.
text:
2CH 7:10
Thadou: Kin bol kichai chun Solomon in miho chu ama ama incheh’a asol tan ahi. Amaho chu akipah thanom theilheh jeng uve. Ijeh-inem itileh Pakai chu David le Solomon chule ami Israelte dingin ana phajing jeng in ahi.
English: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month, he sent the people away to their tents, joyful and glad of heart for the goodness that the LORD had shown to David, to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

tcz: Chuti chun Solomon chun Pakai Houin le leng inpi asah jong chu ajousoh tai, chule atohgon bang chun Houin le leng inpi sahna dinga thil jouse chu achai tan ahi.
en: Thus Solomon finished the LORD’s house and the king’s house; and he successfully completed all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in the LORD’s house and in his own house.
text:
2CH 7:11
Thadou: Chuti chun Solomon chun Pakai Houin le leng inpi asah jong chu ajousoh tai, chule atohgon bang chun Houin le leng inpi sahna dinga thil jouse chu achai tan ahi.
English: Thus Solomon finished the LORD’s house and the king’s house; and he successfully completed all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in the LORD’s house and in his own house.

tcz: Chuin jankhat chu Pakai, Solomon henga ahungkilah in nataona kasanpeh in, chule hiche Houin hi kilhaina ho lhandohna mun dingin kalhengtai ati.
en: Then the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him, “I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place for myself for a house of sacrifice.
text:
2CH 7:12
Thadou: Chuin jankhat chu Pakai, Solomon henga ahungkilah in nataona kasanpeh in, chule hiche Houin hi kilhaina ho lhandohna mun dingin kalhengtai ati.
English: Then the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him, “I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place for myself for a house of sacrifice.

tcz: Iti hamkhatna vankot kakha’a gotwi ajuhlou ham, khaokho ho thu kapeh’a nalhosoh gahou chunga achuh ham, natna hise pul nalah’uva kalansah ham tengle,
en: “If I shut up the sky so that there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people,
text:
2CH 7:13
Thadou: Iti hamkhatna vankot kakha’a gotwi ajuhlou ham, khaokho ho thu kapeh’a nalhosoh gahou chunga achuh ham, natna hise pul nalah’uva kalansah ham tengle,
English: “If I shut up the sky so that there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people,

tcz: hichea chu kamite kaminna kikousate chu ahung kineosah-uva agitlou nau lampi hoa kona ahung kinung heikit uva, kamai ahin holluva ahung tao tengule; keiman vanna konna ataonau kangaipeh’a achonset gitlou nau kangai damma chule agammu kakile dohsah kitding ahi.
en: if my people who are called by my name will humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
text:
2CH 7:14
Thadou: hichea chu kamite kaminna kikousate chu ahung kineosah-uva agitlou nau lampi hoa kona ahung kinung heikit uva, kamai ahin holluva ahung tao tengule; keiman vanna konna ataonau kangaipeh’a achonset gitlou nau kangai damma chule agammu kakile dohsah kitding ahi.
English: if my people who are called by my name will humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

tcz: Hiche Houin munna konna taona kimang jouse kahin vetna, kanakol kahin sun ding ahi.
en: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to prayer that is made in this place.
text:
2CH 7:15
Thadou: Hiche Houin munna konna taona kimang jouse kahin vetna, kanakol kahin sun ding ahi.
English: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to prayer that is made in this place.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itihleh hiche laimun hi atumbeh’a atheng dinga ka lhendoh ahitan, hiche laimun hi aitih’a kamin kijabolna hijing ding ahitai. Keiman hiche laimun hi phatseh’a kavet tup jing ding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche laimun hi, kalungthim in angailut pen chu ahi.
en: For now I have chosen and made this house holy, that my name may be there forever; and my eyes and my heart will be there perpetually.
text:
2CH 7:16
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itihleh hiche laimun hi atumbeh’a atheng dinga ka lhendoh ahitan, hiche laimun hi aitih’a kamin kijabolna hijing ding ahitai. Keiman hiche laimun hi phatseh’a kavet tup jing ding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche laimun hi, kalungthim in angailut pen chu ahi.
English: For now I have chosen and made this house holy, that my name may be there forever; and my eyes and my heart will be there perpetually.

tcz: Nangma jengin jong napa David banga kathupeh hole chondan ho le dan ho jouse hi, kitahna neitah’a najui leh,
en: “As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,
text:
2CH 7:17
Thadou: Nangma jengin jong napa David banga kathupeh hole chondan ho le dan ho jouse hi, kitahna neitah’a najui leh,
English: “As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,

tcz: nangma phungui’a laltouna katundoh ding ahi; hiche na dinga chu keiman napa David toh kitepna kana semma chu hiti hi ahi. “Nangma chilhah holah’a khatpen hin Israel chunga vai ahop jing ding ahi,” ati.
en: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom, according as I covenanted with David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man to be ruler in Israel.’
text:
2CH 7:18
Thadou: nangma phungui’a laltouna katundoh ding ahi; hiche na dinga chu keiman napa David toh kitepna kana semma chu hiti hi ahi. “Nangma chilhah holah’a khatpen hin Israel chunga vai ahop jing ding ahi,” ati.
English: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom, according as I covenanted with David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man to be ruler in Israel.’

tcz: Ahinlah ihamtia nachihlhah ten einungsun uva, chule nangma kapeh chonna dan hole kapeh thu hohi angailou uva nangma jengin jong Pathen dang ho najen lea na hou leh,
en: But if you turn away and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,
text:
2CH 7:19
Thadou: Ahinlah ihamtia nachihlhah ten einungsun uva, chule nangma kapeh chonna dan hole kapeh thu hohi angailou uva nangma jengin jong Pathen dang ho najen lea na hou leh,
English: But if you turn away and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,

tcz: Keiman hiche mite chu amaho kana pehsa hiche gam’a kona chu abul, abala kabodoh ding ahi. Chuleh hiche Houin kamin jabol nadingle atheng dinga kisa jonghi kapaidoh ding chule namdang mi holah’a hichelai munhi nuisat le japi limbep bou kaso ding ahi.
en: then I will pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for my name, I will cast out of my sight, and I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.
text:
2CH 7:20
Thadou: Keiman hiche mite chu amaho kana pehsa hiche gam’a kona chu abul, abala kabodoh ding ahi. Chuleh hiche Houin kamin jabol nadingle atheng dinga kisa jonghi kapaidoh ding chule namdang mi holah’a hichelai munhi nuisat le japi limbep bou kaso ding ahi.
English: then I will pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for my name, I will cast out of my sight, and I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

tcz: Chule tuhin hiche Houin hi akijabol lhehnai, ahinlah hiche teng chuleh ahinjotpa hon adatmo diu amaho chu kidongtouva ipijeh’a iti danna Pakai in hitobang loma thil melse hi hiche gam le Houin chunga hi aboljeng ahitadem, atidiu ahi.
en: This house, which is so high, everyone who passes by it will be astonished and say, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house?’
text:
2CH 7:21
Thadou: Chule tuhin hiche Houin hi akijabol lhehnai, ahinlah hiche teng chuleh ahinjotpa hon adatmo diu amaho chu kidongtouva ipijeh’a iti danna Pakai in hitobang loma thil melse hi hiche gam le Houin chunga hi aboljeng ahitadem, atidiu ahi.
English: This house, which is so high, everyone who passes by it will be astonished and say, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house?’

tcz: Chutengleh adonbutna achu, “Amiten apu apateu Pakai Pathen, Egypt gamma konna ahinpuidoh pau chu anungsun uva, ama khella chu Pathen dang ahou uva amasanga abohkhup jeh uva, Pathen in hitobang vangset naho hi achung'uva alhunsah ahitai,” ati dingu ahi.
en: They shall answer, ‘Because they abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and took other gods, worshiped them, and served them. Therefore he has brought all this evil on them.’”
text:
2CH 7:22
Thadou: Chutengleh adonbutna achu, “Amiten apu apateu Pakai Pathen, Egypt gamma konna ahinpuidoh pau chu anungsun uva, ama khella chu Pathen dang ahou uva amasanga abohkhup jeh uva, Pathen in hitobang vangset naho hi achung'uva alhunsah ahitai,” ati dingu ahi.
English: They shall answer, ‘Because they abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and took other gods, worshiped them, and served them. Therefore he has brought all this evil on them.’”

tcz: Solomon chun Pakai Houin leh ama leng inpi sahna in kum somni asulutnin ahi. Hiche phat ho ahung kichai lang chun,
en: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the LORD’s house and his own house,
text:
2CH 8:1
Thadou: Solomon chun Pakai Houin leh ama leng inpi sahna in kum somni asulutnin ahi. Hiche phat ho ahung kichai lang chun,
English: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the LORD’s house and his own house,

tcz: Solomon chun Hiram lengpan anapeh khopi ho chu thahsah kit dingin, lunglutna ahin neikitnin chule hiche khopi hoa chun Israelte chu achensah in ahi.
en: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
text:
2CH 8:2
Thadou: Solomon chun Hiram lengpan anapeh khopi ho chu thahsah kit dingin, lunglutna ahin neikitnin chule hiche khopi hoa chun Israelte chu achensah in ahi.
English: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

tcz: Chujongleh Solomon chun Hamath Zoba khopi chu gallin akisatpin, akhopi chu alatan ahi.
en: Solomon went to Hamath Zobah, and prevailed against it.
text:
2CH 8:3
Thadou: Chujongleh Solomon chun Hamath Zoba khopi chu gallin akisatpin, akhopi chu alatan ahi.
English: Solomon went to Hamath Zobah, and prevailed against it.

tcz: Gamthip gamsunga um Tadmor chule Hamath gamkaija um khopi ho chu athahsah kitnin, thilkhol namun in amangin ahi.
en: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.
text:
2CH 8:4
Thadou: Gamthip gamsunga um Tadmor chule Hamath gamkaija um khopi ho chu athahsah kitnin, thilkhol namun in amangin ahi.
English: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.

tcz: Chunglam Beth-Horon le noilam Beth-Horon khopi ho chu kulpi akai in, abang ho athah sah kitnin chule thihkot aton ahi.
en: Also he built Beth Horon the upper and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars;

tcz: Chujongleh Baalath le thilkhol na munpi adang dang ho asapha kitnin chule sakol kangtalai hole sakol ho koina thei ding khopi ho jong asadoh in ahi. Jerusalem le Lebanon chule alenggam pumpia aman angaichat jouse chu asadoh tan ahi.
en: and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
text:
2CH 8:6
Thadou: Chujongleh Baalath le thilkhol na munpi adang dang ho asapha kitnin chule sakol kangtalai hole sakol ho koina thei ding khopi ho jong asadoh in ahi. Jerusalem le Lebanon chule alenggam pumpia aman angaichat jouse chu asadoh tan ahi.
English: and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

tcz: Gamsunga chun Israel mi hilou Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite le Jebus mite jaonan mi phabep khat aching jing nalai un ahi.
en: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel—
text:
2CH 8:7
Thadou: Gamsunga chun Israel mi hilou Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite le Jebus mite jaonan mi phabep khat aching jing nalai un ahi.
English: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel—

tcz: Amaho hi chidang namdang ho chilhah Israel miten ana suhmang lou ho ahiuve. Hiti chun Solomon chun amaho chu ada achamlouva thaguma natongin apansah in, chule tuni geiyin ama ho chu thaguma natong in apang jing nalai uve.
en: of their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel didn’t consume—of them Solomon conscripted forced labor to this day.
text:
2CH 8:8
Thadou: Amaho hi chidang namdang ho chilhah Israel miten ana suhmang lou ho ahiuve. Hiti chun Solomon chun amaho chu ada achamlouva thaguma natongin apansah in, chule tuni geiyin ama ho chu thaguma natong in apang jing nalai uve.
English: of their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel didn’t consume—of them Solomon conscripted forced labor to this day.

tcz: Ahinlah Solomon chun Israel mite chu koima cha ada achamlouvin thagum natongin apansah poi. Hiche khel chun amaho chu galsat sepai ding sepai sunga lamkai ding, sakol kangtalai ho lamkai ding chule sakol kangtalai ho tolding in anganse tan ahi.
en: But of the children of Israel, Solomon made no servants for his work, but they were men of war, chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.
text:
2CH 8:9
Thadou: Ahinlah Solomon chun Israel mite chu koima cha ada achamlouvin thagum natongin apansah poi. Hiche khel chun amaho chu galsat sepai ding sepai sunga lamkai ding, sakol kangtalai ho lamkai ding chule sakol kangtalai ho tolding in anganse tan ahi.
English: But of the children of Israel, Solomon made no servants for his work, but they were men of war, chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

tcz: Leng Solomon chun amaho lah’a mi jani le somnga chu, mipi ho natoh vetup dingin apansah un ahi.
en: These were the chief officers of King Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.
text:
2CH 8:10
Thadou: Leng Solomon chun amaho lah’a mi jani le somnga chu, mipi ho natoh vetup dingin apansah un ahi.
English: These were the chief officers of King Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.

tcz: Solomon chun ajinu Pharaoh chanu chu David khopia kon chun amanu dinga athah’a asah leng inpi achun aumsah tan ahi. Chuin Solomon in aseiyin, “Kajinu hi Lengpa David inpia hi umthei mong lou ding ahi, ajeh chu Pakai thingkong chu khuche laimunna ana uma ahin, chule hiche lai mun hi muntheng ahi,” ati.
en: Solomon brought up Pharaoh’s daughter out of David’s city to the house that he had built for her; for he said, “My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places where the LORD’s ark has come are holy.”
text:
2CH 8:11
Thadou: Solomon chun ajinu Pharaoh chanu chu David khopia kon chun amanu dinga athah’a asah leng inpi achun aumsah tan ahi. Chuin Solomon in aseiyin, “Kajinu hi Lengpa David inpia hi umthei mong lou ding ahi, ajeh chu Pakai thingkong chu khuche laimunna ana uma ahin, chule hiche lai mun hi muntheng ahi,” ati.
English: Solomon brought up Pharaoh’s daughter out of David’s city to the house that he had built for her; for he said, “My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places where the LORD’s ark has come are holy.”

tcz: Chuin Solomon chun Houin lutna indan maiya aman anasemsa maicham chunga chun, Pakaiya din pumgo thilto ho chu alhandoh tan ahi.
en: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the LORD’s altar which he had built before the porch,
text:
2CH 8:12
Thadou: Chuin Solomon chun Houin lutna indan maiya aman anasemsa maicham chunga chun, Pakaiya din pumgo thilto ho chu alhandoh tan ahi.
English: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the LORD’s altar which he had built before the porch,

tcz: Hitihin Solomon chun Mose in athupeh bang chun cholngah niseh, lhathah kut ho chule akum lhah’a kimang kut thupi thumho-kalchuh kut, lholhun kut chule lhambuh kut adingin maicham thilto ho chu alhandoh tan ahi.
en: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times per year, during the feast of unleavened bread, during the feast of weeks, and during the feast of booths.
text:
2CH 8:13
Thadou: Hitihin Solomon chun Mose in athupeh bang chun cholngah niseh, lhathah kut ho chule akum lhah’a kimang kut thupi thumho-kalchuh kut, lholhun kut chule lhambuh kut adingin maicham thilto ho chu alhandoh tan ahi.
English: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times per year, during the feast of unleavened bread, during the feast of weeks, and during the feast of booths.

tcz: Thempu ho tohding ngansena kipehna lama hin Solomon chun apa David dan semho chu ajuiyin ahi.Chuleh Solomon chun Levite chu Pathen vahchoina lama mipi hoa lamkai diu chule thempuhon niseh’a atoh diu natohna chu akithopi diuvin angansen ahi, chule Pathen mipa David thupeh ho dungjuiya kot ngahho chun ama ama kot anga tup diuvin anganse tan ahi.
en: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required, the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate, for David the man of God had so commanded.
text:
2CH 8:14
Thadou: Thempu ho tohding ngansena kipehna lama hin Solomon chun apa David dan semho chu ajuiyin ahi.Chuleh Solomon chun Levite chu Pathen vahchoina lama mipi hoa lamkai diu chule thempuhon niseh’a atoh diu natohna chu akithopi diuvin angansen ahi, chule Pathen mipa David thupeh ho dungjuiya kot ngahho chun ama ama kot anga tup diuvin anganse tan ahi.
English: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required, the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate, for David the man of God had so commanded.

tcz: Solomon chun thempu hole Levi te chule gou thilho chung chang thua hin, David dan thupeh ho chu neocha jong alamlou’a achepi-pon ahi.
en: They didn’t depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures.
text:
2CH 8:15
Thadou: Solomon chun thempu hole Levi te chule gou thilho chung chang thua hin, David dan thupeh ho chu neocha jong alamlou’a achepi-pon ahi.
English: They didn’t depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures.

tcz: Hitobang hin Solomon chun anatoh ding jouse, Pakai Houin akisah tilla pat akisah chai nikho changei chu atongchai tan ahi.
en: Now all the work of Solomon was accomplished from the day of the foundation of the LORD’s house until it was finished. So the LORD’s house was completed.
text:
2CH 8:16
Thadou: Hitobang hin Solomon chun anatoh ding jouse, Pakai Houin akisah tilla pat akisah chai nikho changei chu atongchai tan ahi.
English: Now all the work of Solomon was accomplished from the day of the foundation of the LORD’s house until it was finished. So the LORD’s house was completed.

tcz: Chujou chun Edom twikhanglen panga Ezion–Geber le Elath munhoa agache in ahi.
en: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.
text:
2CH 8:17
Thadou: Chujou chun Edom twikhanglen panga Ezion–Geber le Elath munhoa agache in ahi.
English: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.

tcz: Chuin Hiram chun ama kong tol lamkai hole thepna sangtah nei kongtol ho chu Solomon dingin kong innei ho chu asolpeh in ahi. Hiche kong innei ho chu Solomon miho tochun Opher chan atol uvin, chuleh ahinpoh-u sana talent jali le som nga lhing dihcheh chu Lengpa Solomon ape tauvin ahi.
en: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.
text:
2CH 8:18
Thadou: Chuin Hiram chun ama kong tol lamkai hole thepna sangtah nei kongtol ho chu Solomon dingin kong innei ho chu asolpeh in ahi. Hiche kong innei ho chu Solomon miho tochun Opher chan atol uvin, chuleh ahinpoh-u sana talent jali le som nga lhing dihcheh chu Lengpa Solomon ape tauvin ahi.
English: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.

tcz: Sheba lengnun Solomon minthan naho thu ajahdoh phat chun, apatep mong mong dingin thudoh hahsa tampi dong dingin Jerusalem a ahungtan ahi. Amanu chu akilhonpi tamtah toh gimnamtui, sana le songmantam tampi sangong sao ahinpoh sah in, thupitah in Solomon kom ahunglhung tan ahi.
en: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.
text:
2CH 9:1
Thadou: Sheba lengnun Solomon minthan naho thu ajahdoh phat chun, apatep mong mong dingin thudoh hahsa tampi dong dingin Jerusalem a ahungtan ahi. Amanu chu akilhonpi tamtah toh gimnamtui, sana le songmantam tampi sangong sao ahinpoh sah in, thupitah in Solomon kom ahunglhung tan ahi.
English: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

tcz: Solomon chun amanu thudoh jouse abonchan adonbut in, chule bailam tah in ahilchenin ahi.
en: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.
text:
2CH 9:2
Thadou: Solomon chun amanu thudoh jouse abonchan adonbut in, chule bailam tah in ahilchenin ahi.
English: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.

tcz: Sheba lengnun Solomon chihna ho, chule a leng inpi sah,
en: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
text:
2CH 9:3
Thadou: Sheba lengnun Solomon chihna ho, chule a leng inpi sah,
English: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

tcz: Adokhang chunga an le twi ho, amilen milal ho touna, ajen lea pang ho kivonna, akhon doma pangho kivonna le Pakai Houin a pumgo thilto abolho amudoh chun kidang asavallin athia abang jengin ahi.
en: the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers and their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.
text:
2CH 9:4
Thadou: Adokhang chunga an le twi ho, amilen milal ho touna, ajen lea pang ho kivonna, akhon doma pangho kivonna le Pakai Houin a pumgo thilto abolho amudoh chun kidang asavallin athia abang jengin ahi.
English: the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers and their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

tcz: Chuin Sheba lengnun lengpa komma aseiyin, “Keima gamsunga kana jah na chih na le na natoh thilbol hohi atah mong ahi.
en: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.
text:
2CH 9:5
Thadou: Chuin Sheba lengnun lengpa komma aseiyin, “Keima gamsunga kana jah na chih na le na natoh thilbol hohi atah mong ahi.
English: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

tcz: Ahinlah kamit tah’a kana musanga chun miho thusei chu atah hidingin kana gelpon ahi. Tahbeh a seidingin nathupi naho hi akehkhat bepbou eina kiseipeh ahibouve, hiche ei kiseipeh kajah ho sangin gam chengin nakho khellin ahi,” ati.
en: However I didn’t believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn’t told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!
text:
2CH 9:6
Thadou: Ahinlah kamit tah’a kana musanga chun miho thusei chu atah hidingin kana gelpon ahi. Tahbeh a seidingin nathupi naho hi akehkhat bepbou eina kiseipeh ahibouve, hiche ei kiseipeh kajah ho sangin gam chengin nakho khellin ahi,” ati.
English: However I didn’t believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn’t told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!

tcz: Namite iti pan akipah ta diuvem! Namilen-milalte ho, na angsunga adin jinguva nachih na thu ajah jengu hi iti pan akipah tadiu vem! Na Pakai, Pathen chu vahchoiyin umtahen, Amachu nachunga lunglhai tangei unte chule,
en: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.
text:
2CH 9:7
Thadou: Namite iti pan akipah ta diuvem! Namilen-milalte ho, na angsunga adin jinguva nachih na thu ajah jengu hi iti pan akipah tadiu vem! Na Pakai, Pathen chu vahchoiyin umtahen, Amachu nachunga lunglhai tangei unte chule,
English: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.

tcz: Pakai na Pathen in vaihom dinga laltouna natousah’a Lenga napansah ahitai. Ijeh-inem itileh na Pathen chun amite Israelte alungsetna atonsotna adop sang nom jeh chule thutahle thudih’a ama ho chunga vai nahop theina dinga Lenga napansah ahitai.
en: Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”
text:
2CH 9:8
Thadou: Pakai na Pathen in vaihom dinga laltouna natousah’a Lenga napansah ahitai. Ijeh-inem itileh na Pathen chun amite Israelte alungsetna atonsotna adop sang nom jeh chule thutahle thudih’a ama ho chunga vai nahop theina dinga Lenga napansah ahitai.
English: Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”

tcz: Chuin Sheba Lengnu chun Solomon Lengpa chu sana talent jakhat le somni chule gimnamtui le songmantam tamtah apen ahi. Amanun Solomon Lengpa apeh tobang gimnamtui chu tumasangin ana um kha hih laijin ahi.
en: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
text:
2CH 9:9
Thadou: Chuin Sheba Lengnu chun Solomon Lengpa chu sana talent jakhat le somni chule gimnamtui le songmantam tamtah apen ahi. Amanun Solomon Lengpa apeh tobang gimnamtui chu tumasangin ana um kha hih laijin ahi.
English: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

tcz: Hiram Lengpa soh hole Solomon Lengpa soh ho chun Ophir akonin Sana ahinpouvin, chule algumthing le Songmantam jong ahinpouve.
en: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.
text:
2CH 9:10
Thadou: Hiram Lengpa soh hole Solomon Lengpa soh ho chun Ophir akonin Sana ahinpouvin, chule algumthing le Songmantam jong ahinpouve.
English: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

tcz: Lengpa chun Algum thingho chu Pakai Houin le Leng inpi kalbi ho semnan amangin chule lasathem ho dingin selangdah le pehkhong semnan amangin ahi. Hiti ho tobang hi tumasangin Judah gamsunga ana kimukha hih laijin ahi.
en: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.
text:
2CH 9:11
Thadou: Lengpa chun Algum thingho chu Pakai Houin le Leng inpi kalbi ho semnan amangin chule lasathem ho dingin selangdah le pehkhong semnan amangin ahi. Hiti ho tobang hi tumasangin Judah gamsunga ana kimukha hih laijin ahi.
English: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.

tcz: Solomon Lengpa chun Sheba Lengnu angaichat le athum jouse chu apen, aman ahinpoh sanga tamjo chu ale peh kitnin ahi. Chuin amilal ho tochun agamlanguva akinungle kit tauvin ahi.
en: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, more than that which she had brought to the king. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.
text:
2CH 9:12
Thadou: Solomon Lengpa chun Sheba Lengnu angaichat le athum jouse chu apen, aman ahinpoh sanga tamjo chu ale peh kitnin ahi. Chuin amilal ho tochun agamlanguva akinungle kit tauvin ahi.
English: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, more than that which she had brought to the king. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

tcz: Kumseh’a Solomon in sana amujat chu talent jaguple somgup le gup aphan,
en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,
text:
2CH 9:13
Thadou: Kumseh’a Solomon in sana amujat chu talent jaguple somgup le gup aphan,
English: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

tcz: Hiche lah’a hi thilcho-thil joh hole kivei mihon anpeh-u pangloulai ahi. Chujongleh Arabia gam'a Lengho le gamvaipo honjong Solomon chu sana le dangka ahin pohpeh un ahi.
en: in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
text:
2CH 9:14
Thadou: Hiche lah’a hi thilcho-thil joh hole kivei mihon anpeh-u pangloulai ahi. Chujongleh Arabia gam'a Lengho le gamvaipo honjong Solomon chu sana le dangka ahin pohpeh un ahi.
English: in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

tcz: Solomon Lengpa chun sana’a kikheng kidalna pho asemin, kidalna pho khat chun sana shekel som gup alutnin ahi.
en: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one large shield.
text:
2CH 9:15
Thadou: Solomon Lengpa chun sana’a kikheng kidalna pho asemin, kidalna pho khat chun sana shekel som gup alutnin ahi.
English: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one large shield.

tcz: Aman sana’a kikheng kidalna pho aneo jathum jong asemin, kidalna pho khatna chun sana shekhel jathum cheh alut nin ahi. hiche ho sese chu lengpan Lebanon’a gammang inpia chun akoitai.
en: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
text:
2CH 9:16
Thadou: Aman sana’a kikheng kidalna pho aneo jathum jong asemin, kidalna pho khatna chun sana shekhel jathum cheh alut nin ahi. hiche ho sese chu lengpan Lebanon’a gammang inpia chun akoitai.
English: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

tcz: Chuin Lengpan Saiha’a laltouna khat asemin sana thengsellin atomjollin ahi.
en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
text:
2CH 9:17
Thadou: Chuin Lengpan Saiha’a laltouna khat asemin sana thengsellin atomjollin ahi.
English: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

tcz: Laltouna chun kalbi gup aneiyin chule sana touna keng ngapna toh akibuto in ahi. Touna teni jetle veiya chun Sakei bahkai lim ni adingin ahi.
en: There were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.
text:
2CH 9:18
Thadou: Laltouna chun kalbi gup aneiyin chule sana touna keng ngapna toh akibuto in ahi. Touna teni jetle veiya chun Sakei bahkai lim ni adingin ahi.
English: There were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

tcz: Kalbi mong teni achung chu Sakei bahkai lim Som le ni aumin, kalbi dan gup ma aning cheh a chun sakei bahkai lim khat cheh akikoijin ahi,
en: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. There was nothing like it made in any other kingdom.
text:
2CH 9:19
Thadou: Kalbi mong teni achung chu Sakei bahkai lim Som le ni aumin, kalbi dan gup ma aning cheh a chun sakei bahkai lim khat cheh akikoijin ahi,
English: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. There was nothing like it made in any other kingdom.

tcz: Solomon twi don'a khon ho jouse chu sana lhanga kisem ahin chule Lebanon’a gammang sana thengsella kisem ngen ahi. Thilho jouse chu dangka kisem khatcha aumpoi, ijen-inem itileh Solomon khang lai chun dangka chu manlhom jepdanin anaki hen ahi.
en: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.
text:
2CH 9:20
Thadou: Solomon twi don'a khon ho jouse chu sana lhanga kisem ahin chule Lebanon’a gammang sana thengsella kisem ngen ahi. Thilho jouse chu dangka kisem khatcha aumpoi, ijen-inem itileh Solomon khang lai chun dangka chu manlhom jepdanin anaki hen ahi.
English: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.

tcz: Lengpa chun kiveina kong innei tampi jong aneiyin ahi, kumthum lhunseh leh kong innei ho chun khatvei sana dangka le saiha chule guldute le vahong ho ahin pojiuvin ahi.
en: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants. Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
text:
2CH 9:21
Thadou: Lengpa chun kiveina kong innei tampi jong aneiyin ahi, kumthum lhunseh leh kong innei ho chun khatvei sana dangka le saiha chule guldute le vahong ho ahin pojiuvin ahi.
English: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants. Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

tcz: Lengpa Solomon chu leng dang ho jouse sangin haona le chih nan achungnung jon ahi.
en: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
text:
2CH 9:22
Thadou: Lengpa Solomon chu leng dang ho jouse sangin haona le chih nan achungnung jon ahi.
English: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

tcz: Nam jousea Leng ho chu Pathen in apeh achihna ho thu ngainom leh, houlim pi dingin ahung jiuvin ahi.
en: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
text:
2CH 9:23
Thadou: Nam jousea Leng ho chu Pathen in apeh achihna ho thu ngainom leh, houlim pi dingin ahung jiuvin ahi.
English: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

tcz: Akum kumin ama hungvil jouse chun sana le dangka sangkholchol, gimnamtui galmanchah sakol le sangan ho kipa thilpeh adin ahinpoh peh jiuvin ahi.
en: They each brought tribute: vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year.
text:
2CH 9:24
Thadou: Akum kumin ama hungvil jouse chun sana le dangka sangkholchol, gimnamtui galmanchah sakol le sangan ho kipa thilpeh adin ahinpoh peh jiuvin ahi.
English: They each brought tribute: vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year.

tcz: Solomon chun sakolbuh le sakol kangtalai koina indan sangli aneiyin chule sakol jong sang som le ni aneiyin ahi. Hiche ho chu sakol kangtalai koina khopiho le Jersusalema ama kom naiyah akoi in ahi.
en: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen that he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 9:25
Thadou: Solomon chun sakolbuh le sakol kangtalai koina indan sangli aneiyin chule sakol jong sang som le ni aneiyin ahi. Hiche ho chu sakol kangtalai koina khopiho le Jersusalema ama kom naiyah akoi in ahi.
English: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen that he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

tcz: Solomon chun sahlama Euphrate vadung apat Philestine te gam chan chule lhanglama Egypt gamgi sunga lengho chunga vai ana homin ahi.
en: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
text:
2CH 9:26
Thadou: Solomon chun sahlama Euphrate vadung apat Philestine te gam chan chule lhanglama Egypt gamgi sunga lengho chunga vai ana homin ahi.
English: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

tcz: Lengpa chun Jerusalem khopi sunga dangka nengjeng jungin abolllin song lheo lah abahsah jinge, chule thing mantam jong Judah phaichamma theipi thingkeh ning lhing tah a muntinna akimu jeng thei bangin abollin ahi.
en: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
text:
2CH 9:27
Thadou: Lengpa chun Jerusalem khopi sunga dangka nengjeng jungin abolllin song lheo lah abahsah jinge, chule thing mantam jong Judah phaichamma theipi thingkeh ning lhing tah a muntinna akimu jeng thei bangin abollin ahi.
English: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

tcz: Solomon sakol ho chu Egypt gam le gam chom chomma konna hung kipolut ahiuve.
en: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands.
text:
2CH 9:28
Thadou: Solomon sakol ho chu Egypt gam le gam chom chomma konna hung kipolut ahiuve.
English: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands.

tcz: Solomon vaipoh abulla kipan achaina changei’a thilsoh adangho chu, themgao Nathan Lekhabu chule Sheloh a um, Ahijah gaothuseina chule Nebat chapa Jerobaom chung changa muneipa Iddo Mitva neipa gaomu thusimma akijih lut soh keijin ahi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, aren’t they written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
text:
2CH 9:29
Thadou: Solomon vaipoh abulla kipan achaina changei’a thilsoh adangho chu, themgao Nathan Lekhabu chule Sheloh a um, Ahijah gaothuseina chule Nebat chapa Jerobaom chung changa muneipa Iddo Mitva neipa gaomu thusimma akijih lut soh keijin ahi.
English: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, aren’t they written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

tcz: Solomon chun Jerusalem a Israel pumpi chunga, kum somli vai ana pon ahi.
en: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
text:
2CH 9:30
Thadou: Solomon chun Jerusalem a Israel pumpi chunga, kum somli vai ana pon ahi.
English: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

tcz: Ama athi chun apa David khopia chun akivuitai.Chuin achapa Rehoboam chu ama banin lengin ahungpang tan ahi.
en: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
text:
2CH 9:31
Thadou: Ama athi chun apa David khopia chun akivuitai.Chuin achapa Rehoboam chu ama banin lengin ahungpang tan ahi.
English: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Rehoboam chu Shachem muna achetan ahi, ajeh chu hichelai munna chu Israel mipi chu hung kikhom uva ama chu Lengpa’a pansah ding atiu ahi.
en: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.
text:
2CH 10:1
Thadou: Rehoboam chu Shachem muna achetan ahi, ajeh chu hichelai munna chu Israel mipi chu hung kikhom uva ama chu Lengpa’a pansah ding atiu ahi.
English: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

tcz: Hiche thu chu Nebat chapa Jeroboam in ajadoh phat chun, Lengpa Solomon akonna sochatna ding deina jal'a Egypt gamma ana jammang na munna (Egypt muna), kon chun ahung kile kit tan ahi.
en: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
text:
2CH 10:2
Thadou: Hiche thu chu Nebat chapa Jeroboam in ajadoh phat chun, Lengpa Solomon akonna sochatna ding deina jal'a Egypt gamma ana jammang na munna (Egypt muna), kon chun ahung kile kit tan ahi.
English: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

tcz: Israel lamkai ho chun ama chu akou uvin, chuin Jeroboam le Israel mipi chu Rehoboam kihoupi ding chun acheuvin ama koma chun hitin aseijiuvin ahi.
en: They sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
text:
2CH 10:3
Thadou: Israel lamkai ho chun ama chu akou uvin, chuin Jeroboam le Israel mipi chu Rehoboam kihoupi ding chun acheuvin ama koma chun hitin aseijiuvin ahi.
English: They sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

tcz: “Napan kachung uva akoi namkol jon hi agih valle, hiche natoh hahsa le kachung uva kikoi namkol jon gihtah hi nei suh jang peh uvin,” atiuvin ahi.
en: “Your father made our yoke grievous. Now therefore make the grievous service of your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”
text:
2CH 10:4
Thadou: “Napan kachung uva akoi namkol jon hi agih valle, hiche natoh hahsa le kachung uva kikoi namkol jon gihtah hi nei suh jang peh uvin,” atiuvin ahi.
English: “Your father made our yoke grievous. Now therefore make the grievous service of your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

tcz: Rehoboam in adonbut in, “Nithum joule kahenga hung kile kitnun,” ati. Hiti chun mipiho chu achemang tauvin ahi.
en: He said to them, “Come again to me after three days.” So the people departed.
text:
2CH 10:5
Thadou: Rehoboam in adonbut in, “Nithum joule kahenga hung kile kitnun,” ati. Hiti chun mipiho chu achemang tauvin ahi.
English: He said to them, “Come again to me after three days.” So the people departed.

tcz: Chuin Rehoboam lengpa chun apa Solomon damlai’a alhachaa anapang upa ho ahoulim pin, hiche miho hi iti donbut leng natiu vem? tin aman adong tan ahi.
en: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me about how to answer these people?”
text:
2CH 10:6
Thadou: Chuin Rehoboam lengpa chun apa Solomon damlai’a alhachaa anapang upa ho ahoulim pin, hiche miho hi iti donbut leng natiu vem? tin aman adong tan ahi.
English: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me about how to answer these people?”

tcz: Amahon adonbut’un hiche miho chu nakhotoa ahile amaho chu lunglhai sah in, lang angaichat bang bang u chun donbut tan; chutileh amaho chu nalhachan pangjing tauvinte , atiuvin ahi.
en: They spoke to him, saying, “If you are kind to these people, please them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.”
text:
2CH 10:7
Thadou: Amahon adonbut’un hiche miho chu nakhotoa ahile amaho chu lunglhai sah in, lang angaichat bang bang u chun donbut tan; chutileh amaho chu nalhachan pangjing tauvinte , atiuvin ahi.
English: They spoke to him, saying, “If you are kind to these people, please them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.”

tcz: Ahinlah Rehoboam chun upa hon thumop apeh uchu anoppeh tapon, chuin amatoh thakhatna hungseilen le ama jenle khangthah ho chu ahoulim pin ahi.
en: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.
text:
2CH 10:8
Thadou: Ahinlah Rehoboam chun upa hon thumop apeh uchu anoppeh tapon, chuin amatoh thakhatna hungseilen le ama jenle khangthah ho chu ahoulim pin ahi.
English: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

tcz: Aman ama ho chu adongin, “Nangho thumop ipi hiding ham? Itilama hiche mihon kakoma aseiju napan kachung uva akoi namkol jon hi neisuh jang peh un, tia asei uhi iti lama adonbutna ipeh diu ham?”
en: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may give an answer to these people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”
text:
2CH 10:9
Thadou: Aman ama ho chu adongin, “Nangho thumop ipi hiding ham? Itilama hiche mihon kakoma aseiju napan kachung uva akoi namkol jon hi neisuh jang peh un, tia asei uhi iti lama adonbutna ipeh diu ham?”
English: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may give an answer to these people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

tcz: Amatoh hungseilen khom khangthah hochun adonbut nun, mipihon nakoma aseiyu, “Napan kachung uva eikoipeh’u namkol jon hi agih valle, hijongleh nangman neisuh jang peh un atiuchu kakhut jung mecha hi kapa kong sanga lenjo ahi,” tin seipeh tan atiuve.
en: The young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, “Thus you shall tell the people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter on us;’ thus you shall say to them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.
text:
2CH 10:10
Thadou: Amatoh hungseilen khom khangthah hochun adonbut nun, mipihon nakoma aseiyu, “Napan kachung uva eikoipeh’u namkol jon hi agih valle, hijongleh nangman neisuh jang peh un atiuchu kakhut jung mecha hi kapa kong sanga lenjo ahi,” tin seipeh tan atiuve.
English: The young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, “Thus you shall tell the people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter on us;’ thus you shall say to them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

tcz: “Kapan namkol jon gih chu keiman agih jep'a kabol ding ahi,” tin seipehtan atiuve. “Kapan savun khaohola najep’u ahin, keiman tenggol pah mun’a kajep ding nahiuve,” tin seipeh un atiuve.
en: Now whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”
text:
2CH 10:11
Thadou: “Kapan namkol jon gih chu keiman agih jep'a kabol ding ahi,” tin seipehtan atiuve. “Kapan savun khaohola najep’u ahin, keiman tenggol pah mun’a kajep ding nahiuve,” tin seipeh un atiuve.
English: Now whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

tcz: Lengpan, “Nithum sungin kakoma hungkit nun,” atibang bang chun Jeroboam le mipi ho jouse chu nithum jouvin Rehoboam koma ahungkit taovin ahi.
en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”
text:
2CH 10:12
Thadou: Lengpan, “Nithum sungin kakoma hungkit nun,” atibang bang chun Jeroboam le mipi ho jouse chu nithum jouvin Rehoboam koma ahungkit taovin ahi.
English: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

tcz: Lengpan upa ho thumop chu anotthap min, engse tah’in amaho chu ana donbut in.
en: The king answered them roughly; and King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men,
text:
2CH 10:13
Thadou: Lengpan upa ho thumop chu anotthap min, engse tah’in amaho chu ana donbut in.
English: The king answered them roughly; and King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men,

tcz: “Khangthah ho thumop ajuijin, kapan na namkol’jon gihtah in asemin , keiman agihjo cheh’a kasempeh ding nahive , kapan savun khao holla najep u ahin, keiman sakol jepna a kajep ding nahiuve,” atin ahi.
en: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”
text:
2CH 10:14
Thadou: “Khangthah ho thumop ajuijin, kapan na namkol’jon gihtah in asemin , keiman agihjo cheh’a kasempeh ding nahive , kapan savun khao holla najep u ahin, keiman sakol jepna a kajep ding nahiuve,” atin ahi.
English: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

tcz: Hiti chun Lengpa chun mipiho thu chu angaipeh tapou vin ahi. Ajeh chu hiche thilsoh ho jouse hi Pathen a kona Sheloh mipa Ahijah in Nebat chapa Jeroboam koma, Pakai in anaseidohsa thu chu guilhung ahi.
en: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was brought about by God, that the LORD might establish his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
text:
2CH 10:15
Thadou: Hiti chun Lengpa chun mipiho thu chu angaipeh tapou vin ahi. Ajeh chu hiche thilsoh ho jouse hi Pathen a kona Sheloh mipa Ahijah in Nebat chapa Jeroboam koma, Pakai in anaseidohsa thu chu guilhung ahi.
English: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was brought about by God, that the LORD might establish his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

tcz: Israel mipi ho chun lengpan athu sei angaipeh louphat uchun lengpa chu adonbut nun, “Jesse chapa David koma keihon ipi chan, ipi mun kanei diu ham? Israel! Naponbuh achun David in na insung bou vesuitan,” atiuvin ahi, hitichun Israel mipi jouse chu ain lam uvah ache tauvin ahi.
en: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion do we have in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So all Israel departed to their tents.
text:
2CH 10:16
Thadou: Israel mipi ho chun lengpan athu sei angaipeh louphat uchun lengpa chu adonbut nun, “Jesse chapa David koma keihon ipi chan, ipi mun kanei diu ham? Israel! Naponbuh achun David in na insung bou vesuitan,” atiuvin ahi, hitichun Israel mipi jouse chu ain lam uvah ache tauvin ahi.
English: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion do we have in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So all Israel departed to their tents.

tcz: Ahinlah Judah khopi hoa cheng jing nalai Israel mite ding chun, Rehoboam in vai ahom nalaijin ahi.
en: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
text:
2CH 10:17
Thadou: Ahinlah Judah khopi hoa cheng jing nalai Israel mite ding chun, Rehoboam in vai ahom nalaijin ahi.
English: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

tcz: Lengpa Rehoboam chun Adoniram kitipa ada achamlouva nakitohsah ho chunga mopopa chu asoldoh in, ahinlah ama chu Israel mipi hon song a anaseplih tauvin ahi. Hijeng jongleh Lengpa Rehoboam chu a sakol kangtalai achun anakaldoh man in, Jerusalem lama ana jamdoh in ahi.
en: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 10:18
Thadou: Lengpa Rehoboam chun Adoniram kitipa ada achamlouva nakitohsah ho chunga mopopa chu asoldoh in, ahinlah ama chu Israel mipi hon song a anaseplih tauvin ahi. Hijeng jongleh Lengpa Rehoboam chu a sakol kangtalai achun anakaldoh man in, Jerusalem lama ana jamdoh in ahi.
English: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hiti chun Israel mite chun tuni chanin, David insung chu adou jing nalai un ahi.
en: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.
text:
2CH 10:19
Thadou: Hiti chun Israel mite chun tuni chanin, David insung chu adou jing nalai un ahi.
English: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.
