Thadou: Kum phabep jouhin Samaria Ahab villin aga che suhin ahileh, Ahab in bongchal leh kelngoi athat nin ama leh ahin kilhon piho nehding chun nengtah in anagon peh in; chuleh Ramoth Gilead langa chetou dingin ana tem in ahi.
English: After some years, he went down to Ahab to Samaria. Ahab killed sheep and cattle for him in abundance, and for the people who were with him, and moved him to go up with him to Ramoth Gilead.

tcz: Ahab lengpa chun Jehoshaphat jah’a chun Ramoth Gilead toh kidouna dinga hi neihung kitho pi ding ham anatin ahi. Jehoshaphat chun adonbut in, “Keile nang thakhat ihin, keimite jong nang mite ahin hiche galla chun nahung kithopi nange,” ati.
en: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me to Ramoth Gilead?” He answered him, “I am as you are, and my people as your people. We will be with you in the war.”
text:
2CH 18:3
Thadou: Ahab lengpa chun Jehoshaphat jah’a chun Ramoth Gilead toh kidouna dinga hi neihung kitho pi ding ham anatin ahi. Jehoshaphat chun adonbut in, “Keile nang thakhat ihin, keimite jong nang mite ahin hiche galla chun nahung kithopi nange,” ati.
English: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me to Ramoth Gilead?” He answered him, “I am as you are, and my people as your people. We will be with you in the war.”

tcz: Chujongleh Jehoshaphat chun Israel lengpa komma chun aseijin, “Tunin Pathenin epi asei jem veohite ati”
en: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the LORD’s word.”
text:
2CH 18:4
Thadou: Chujongleh Jehoshaphat chun Israel lengpa komma chun aseijin, “Tunin Pathenin epi asei jem veohite ati”
English: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the LORD’s word.”

tcz: Hichun Israel lengpan themgao jali akou khommin amaho chu adongin, “Keiho hi Ramoth – Gilead satna galkon na kachediu ham ahilouleh kacheda diuham?” ati. Hichun amaho chun, “Chetou jengun amaho chu Pathen in lengpa nangkhut a ahin pehdoh ding ahi,” atiuve.
en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said to them, “Shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” They said, “Go up, for God will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
text:
2CH 18:5
Thadou: Hichun Israel lengpan themgao jali akou khommin amaho chu adongin, “Keiho hi Ramoth – Gilead satna galkon na kachediu ham ahilouleh kacheda diuham?” ati. Hichun amaho chun, “Chetou jengun amaho chu Pathen in lengpa nangkhut a ahin pehdoh ding ahi,” atiuve.
English: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said to them, “Shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” They said, “Go up, for God will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

tcz: Ahinlah Jehoshaphat in, “Tua hi eihon idoh theiju themgao adang umlou hitam?” ati.
en: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we may inquire of him?”
text:
2CH 18:6
Thadou: Ahinlah Jehoshaphat in, “Tua hi eihon idoh theiju themgao adang umlou hitam?” ati.
English: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we may inquire of him?”

tcz: Israel lengpa chun Jehoshaphat kom’a, “Eihon idoh theiju Pakai themgao khatvang aumme, ahinlah keiman amahi kavetnom poi; ajeh chu amahin keidinga thilpha aseingai jipon, thilphalou ngen eisei peh ji ahi. Amachu Imla chapa Micaiah kitipa chu ahi. Hichun Jehoshaphat in, “Lengpa hiti chun thu seihih in,” ati.
en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD; but I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil. He is Micaiah the son of Imla.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”
text:
2CH 18:7
Thadou: Israel lengpa chun Jehoshaphat kom’a, “Eihon idoh theiju Pakai themgao khatvang aumme, ahinlah keiman amahi kavetnom poi; ajeh chu amahin keidinga thilpha aseingai jipon, thilphalou ngen eisei peh ji ahi. Amachu Imla chapa Micaiah kitipa chu ahi. Hichun Jehoshaphat in, “Lengpa hiti chun thu seihih in,” ati.
English: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD; but I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil. He is Micaiah the son of Imla.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

tcz: Hiche phat chun Israel lengpan a sepai lamkai khat chu akouvin, Imla chapa Micaiah chu gangtah in gapuijin ati.
en: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Get Micaiah the son of Imla quickly.”
text:
2CH 18:8
Thadou: Hiche phat chun Israel lengpan a sepai lamkai khat chu akouvin, Imla chapa Micaiah chu gangtah in gapuijin ati.
English: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Get Micaiah the son of Imla quickly.”

tcz: Israel lengpaleh Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chu aleng von lhon cheh a akivon lhonin, Samaria khopi lutna kelkot lutna tollhang achun atou lhonin amasang lhonna themgao hochun gaothu aseijun ahi
en: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah each sat on his throne, arrayed in their robes, and they were sitting in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
text:
2CH 18:9
Thadou: Israel lengpaleh Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chu aleng von lhon cheh a akivon lhonin, Samaria khopi lutna kelkot lutna tollhang achun atou lhonin amasang lhonna themgao hochun gaothu aseijun ahi
English: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah each sat on his throne, arrayed in their robes, and they were sitting in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

tcz: Zedekiah chun thih alan saki limin asemmin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, “Nangman hiche saki hi namanna Syria mite chu nasuhmang ding ahi,” ati.
en: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said, “The LORD says, ‘With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”
text:
2CH 18:10
Thadou: Zedekiah chun thih alan saki limin asemmin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, “Nangman hiche saki hi namanna Syria mite chu nasuhmang ding ahi,” ati.
English: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said, “The LORD says, ‘With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

tcz: Hitichun themgao ho jouse chun gaothu aseisoh keijun, Ramoth Gilead jonin chetouvun nalolhin diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin amaho chu lengpa khutna ahin pehlut ding ahi atiuve
en: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead, and prosper; for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
text:
2CH 18:11
Thadou: Hitichun themgao ho jouse chun gaothu aseisoh keijun, Ramoth Gilead jonin chetouvun nalolhin diu ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin amaho chu lengpa khutna ahin pehlut ding ahi atiuve
English: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead, and prosper; for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

tcz: Micaiah kouva kisol pachun akom’a hitin aseijin, “Ven, themgao ho jouse chun lengpan gal ajo dingin aseisoh keijun ahi, nangman jong hitimachun seile chun phading ahi,” atipeh e.
en: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Let your word therefore, please be like one of theirs, and speak good.”
text:
2CH 18:12
Thadou: Micaiah kouva kisol pachun akom’a hitin aseijin, “Ven, themgao ho jouse chun lengpan gal ajo dingin aseisoh keijun ahi, nangman jong hitimachun seile chun phading ahi,” atipeh e.
English: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Let your word therefore, please be like one of theirs, and speak good.”

tcz: Hichu Micaiah in adonbut in, “Hingjing Pakai minna kasei ahi, ka Pathen in asei seibou kaseiding ahi,” ati.
en: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, I will say what my God says.”
text:
2CH 18:13
Thadou: Hichu Micaiah in adonbut in, “Hingjing Pakai minna kasei ahi, ka Pathen in asei seibou kaseiding ahi,” ati.
English: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, I will say what my God says.”

tcz: Micaiah chu lengpa kom ahung lhun phat in, lengpan, “Micaiah Ramoth – Gilead na hi galsatna kache diuham ahilouleh kache dauva pha ham? tin adongin ahileh aman, “Cheovin galolhing tauvin amaho chun nangma khut-a pehdoh in umnante,” atipeh in ahi.
en: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” He said, “Go up, and prosper. They shall be delivered into your hand.”
text:
2CH 18:14
Thadou: Micaiah chu lengpa kom ahung lhun phat in, lengpan, “Micaiah Ramoth – Gilead na hi galsatna kache diuham ahilouleh kache dauva pha ham? tin adongin ahileh aman, “Cheovin galolhing tauvin amaho chun nangma khut-a pehdoh in umnante,” atipeh in ahi.
English: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” He said, “Go up, and prosper. They shall be delivered into your hand.”

tcz: Hichun lengpan hitin aseije, “Micaiah nangkom mahi ijatvei Pakai minnin thudih seijin tia kangeh ding nahim?” atin ahi.
en: The king said to him, “How many times shall I adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the LORD’s name?”
text:
2CH 18:15
Thadou: Hichun lengpan hitin aseije, “Micaiah nangkom mahi ijatvei Pakai minnin thudih seijin tia kangeh ding nahim?” atin ahi.
English: The king said to him, “How many times shall I adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the LORD’s name?”

tcz: Hichun Micaiah in aseijin, “Keiman Israel tehi achingbei kelngoi banga molchung dunga akithe cheh-u kamui,” chuleh Pakaiyin hitin aseijin “Amaho hi lungmongin a incheh uva kileu hen,” ati.
en: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. The LORD said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”
text:
2CH 18:16
Thadou: Hichun Micaiah in aseijin, “Keiman Israel tehi achingbei kelngoi banga molchung dunga akithe cheh-u kamui,” chuleh Pakaiyin hitin aseijin “Amaho hi lungmongin a incheh uva kileu hen,” ati.
English: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. The LORD said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”

tcz: Israel lengpa chun Jehoshaphat komma hitin aseije, “Amahin kakomma thilpha asei khapon, thilse jeng aseije kati hilouham?” atin ahi.
en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”
text:
2CH 18:17
Thadou: Israel lengpa chun Jehoshaphat komma hitin aseije, “Amahin kakomma thilpha asei khapon, thilse jeng aseije kati hilouham?” atin ahi.
English: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

tcz: Hichun Micaiah in aseijin Pakaiyin hitin aseije, “Ngaijun Pakai chu alal touna – a atouvin van mite chu ajet aveijah adingun ahi.”
en: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear the LORD’s word: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.
text:
2CH 18:18
Thadou: Hichun Micaiah in aseijin Pakaiyin hitin aseije, “Ngaijun Pakai chu alal touna – a atouvin van mite chu ajet aveijah adingun ahi.”
English: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear the LORD’s word: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.

tcz: “Pakai chun hitin aseijin, “Koipenin Ahab komma nacheova Ramoth – Gilead nakhu aga lhuhkam nadinga naga seipeh diu ham? Hichun vantil khatchun hitin aseijin achom khat nin thilchom aseijin ahi.
en: The LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One spoke saying in this way, and another saying in that way.
text:
2CH 18:19
Thadou: “Pakai chun hitin aseijin, “Koipenin Ahab komma nacheova Ramoth – Gilead nakhu aga lhuhkam nadinga naga seipeh diu ham? Hichun vantil khatchun hitin aseijin achom khat nin thilchom aseijin ahi.
English: The LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One spoke saying in this way, and another saying in that way.

tcz: Hichun lhagao khat nin Pakai angsung ahin nailut nin keima chengtin galhem lhange ati, Pakaiyin i-nagalo ding ham? ati.
en: A spirit came out, stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’ “The LORD said to him, ‘How?’
text:
2CH 18:20
Thadou: Hichun lhagao khat nin Pakai angsung ahin nailut nin keima chengtin galhem lhange ati, Pakaiyin i-nagalo ding ham? ati.
English: A spirit came out, stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’ “The LORD said to him, ‘How?’

tcz: “Hichun aman keima chengting Ahab themgao jouse chu jou gaseisah ingkate ati, Pakaiyin chenlang hiti chun gabollin lang hung lolhing tan,” ati.
en: “He said, ‘I will go, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ “He said, ‘You will entice him, and will prevail also. Go and do so.’
text:
2CH 18:21
Thadou: “Hichun aman keima chengting Ahab themgao jouse chu jou gaseisah ingkate ati, Pakaiyin chenlang hiti chun gabollin lang hung lolhing tan,” ati.
English: “He said, ‘I will go, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ “He said, ‘You will entice him, and will prevail also. Go and do so.’

tcz: Hijeh chun veovin! “Pakaiyin a themgao jouse chu jou aseisah ahin, Pakaiyin naman thah nadinga asei sah ahibouve,” ati.
en: “Now therefore, behold, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets; and the LORD has spoken evil concerning you.”
text:
2CH 18:22
Thadou: Hijeh chun veovin! “Pakaiyin a themgao jouse chu jou aseisah ahin, Pakaiyin naman thah nadinga asei sah ahibouve,” ati.
English: “Now therefore, behold, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets; and the LORD has spoken evil concerning you.”

tcz: Hichun Chenaanah chapa Zedekiah chun anailut nin angeiphe abeh pih in, itih a chu Pakai lhagaovin keima eidalhah a nangkomma thu asei ham?” ati.
en: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did the LORD’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”
text:
2CH 18:23
Thadou: Hichun Chenaanah chapa Zedekiah chun anailut nin angeiphe abeh pih in, itih a chu Pakai lhagaovin keima eidalhah a nangkomma thu asei ham?” ati.
English: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did the LORD’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”

tcz: Micaiah chun adonbut in “Tomlam a nalhailut’a naga kisel teng hetannate!” atipehin ahi.
en: Micaiah said, “Behold, you shall see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”
text:
2CH 18:24
Thadou: Micaiah chun adonbut in “Tomlam a nalhailut’a naga kisel teng hetannate!” atipehin ahi.
English: Micaiah said, “Behold, you shall see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

tcz: Hichun Israel lengpan a sepai lamkai komma chun, man inlang khopi vaihompa leh leng chapa Joash kommah ga pelut tan ati.
en: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

tcz: Amani komma chun songkulla akoilhon ding keima damsella kahung kilekit kahsen anehding changlhah themkhat toh twi themkhat anapeo vin ati.
en: and say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.”’”
text:
2CH 18:26
Thadou: Amani komma chun songkulla akoilhon ding keima damsella kahung kilekit kahsen anehding changlhah themkhat toh twi themkhat anapeo vin ati.
English: and say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.”’”

tcz: Micaiah in asamjah jengin, nangma nahung kile poupouleh Pathen in keikomma thu aseilou hiding ahi! ati. “Chuleh aman Avella umho kommachun hiche kasei hi jasoh keijun,” ati.
en: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, the LORD has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, you people, all of you!”
text:
2CH 18:27
Thadou: Micaiah in asamjah jengin, nangma nahung kile poupouleh Pathen in keikomma thu aseilou hiding ahi! ati. “Chuleh aman Avella umho kommachun hiche kasei hi jasoh keijun,” ati.
English: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, the LORD has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, you people, all of you!”

tcz: Hiche jouchun Israel lengpan Ahab leh Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chu, Ramoth – Gilead khopi chu abulu dingin akondoh lhontai.
en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.
text:
2CH 18:28
Thadou: Hiche jouchun Israel lengpan Ahab leh Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chu, Ramoth – Gilead khopi chu abulu dingin akondoh lhontai.
English: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

tcz: Ahab chun Jehoshaphat kommah hitin aseijin, “Galmunna ilut tengleh nangin lengvon kivon nin lang, ken vonchom kivon inge,” ati. Hichun Israel lengpa chun vonchom aki vonnin gal munnah aluttan ahi.
en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on your robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went into the battle.
text:
2CH 18:29
Thadou: Ahab chun Jehoshaphat kommah hitin aseijin, “Galmunna ilut tengleh nangin lengvon kivon nin lang, ken vonchom kivon inge,” ati. Hichun Israel lengpa chun vonchom aki vonnin gal munnah aluttan ahi.
English: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on your robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went into the battle.

tcz: Syria lengpa chun sakol kangchunga tou gallam kai hochu Israel lengpa bou atup diuvin thu apen ahi.
en: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”
text:
2CH 18:30
Thadou: Syria lengpa chun sakol kangchunga tou gallam kai hochu Israel lengpa bou atup diuvin thu apen ahi.
English: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Jehoshaphat lengpa chu amu phatnun Israel lengpa ahisah sohkeijun, anokhum tauvin ahi. Ahinlah Jehoshaphat chu apeng jah in ahileh, Pakaiyin ahuhdoh in ama nokhumho chu adalhah sah tan ahi.
en: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel!” Therefore they turned around to fight against him. But Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.
text:
2CH 18:31
Thadou: Hijeh chun Jehoshaphat lengpa chu amu phatnun Israel lengpa ahisah sohkeijun, anokhum tauvin ahi. Ahinlah Jehoshaphat chu apeng jah in ahileh, Pakaiyin ahuhdoh in ama nokhumho chu adalhah sah tan ahi.
English: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel!” Therefore they turned around to fight against him. But Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.

tcz: Sakol kangchunga tou lamkai hochun ama chu Israel lengpa ahilou ahedoh tauvin adalha tauve.
en: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
text:
2CH 18:32
Thadou: Sakol kangchunga tou lamkai hochun ama chu Israel lengpa ahilou ahedoh tauvin adalha tauve.
English: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

tcz: Ahinlah Syria sepai khatnin thalchang khatchu agah donkapmin ahileh, Israel lengpa galvon kikah – a chun akaplut khatan ahi, hichun asakol kangtalai tolpa komma chun kakitong khatai galmunna kon in neitol doh tan atin ahi.
en: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of the chariot, “Turn around and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”
text:
2CH 18:33
Thadou: Ahinlah Syria sepai khatnin thalchang khatchu agah donkapmin ahileh, Israel lengpa galvon kikah – a chun akaplut khatan ahi, hichun asakol kangtalai tolpa komma chun kakitong khatai galmunna kon in neitol doh tan atin ahi.
English: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of the chariot, “Turn around and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

tcz: Hiche ni chun galkisat chu akhoh cheh jengin, Israel lengpa vangchu sakol kangtalai chunga aoplhatan, nilhah lang geijin Syria te lang chu angan nilhum kon in athitai.
en: The battle increased that day. However, the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the evening; and at about sunset, he died.
text:
2CH 18:34
Thadou: Hiche ni chun galkisat chu akhoh cheh jengin, Israel lengpa vangchu sakol kangtalai chunga aoplhatan, nilhah lang geijin Syria te lang chu angan nilhum kon in athitai.
English: The battle increased that day. However, the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the evening; and at about sunset, he died.

tcz: Hiche jouhin Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat hi, Jerusalem ain mun langa damsellin akinung letan ahi.
en: Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 19:1
Thadou: Hiche jouhin Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat hi, Jerusalem ain mun langa damsellin akinung letan ahi.
English: Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hanani chapa themgao Jehu chu lengpatoh kimuton achen hitin agaseijin ahi, “Miphalou panpileh Pakai doujing ho langa pan lah hi dih nasah hinam?” Hijeh chun nachunga Pakai alunghangtan ahi.
en: Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked, and love those who hate the LORD? Because of this, wrath is on you from before the LORD.
text:
2CH 19:2
Thadou: Hanani chapa themgao Jehu chu lengpatoh kimuton achen hitin agaseijin ahi, “Miphalou panpileh Pakai doujing ho langa pan lah hi dih nasah hinam?” Hijeh chun nachunga Pakai alunghangtan ahi.
English: Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked, and love those who hate the LORD? Because of this, wrath is on you from before the LORD.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in nachunga hin naphat na phabep akimudoh in ahi, ajeh chu nangin mipihon anahou’u Asherah doilim thinga kisem ho napaidoh in; chuleh nalung thim in Pathen lungdeilam holnomna naneijin ahi.
en: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set your heart to seek God.”
text:
2CH 19:3
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in nachunga hin naphat na phabep akimudoh in ahi, ajeh chu nangin mipihon anahou’u Asherah doilim thinga kisem ho napaidoh in; chuleh nalung thim in Pathen lungdeilam holnomna naneijin ahi.
English: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set your heart to seek God.”

tcz: Hiti hin Jehoshaphat hi Jerusalem a apansan, chule amahi akipatdoh in Beersheba’a kon in Ephraim lhang geijin aga cheovin; hitichun mipiho chu apu apa teu Pathen henga apuilut kit in ahi.
en: Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem; and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, and brought them back to the LORD, the God of their fathers.
text:
2CH 19:4
Thadou: Hiti hin Jehoshaphat hi Jerusalem a apansan, chule amahi akipatdoh in Beersheba’a kon in Ephraim lhang geijin aga cheovin; hitichun mipiho chu apu apa teu Pathen henga apuilut kit in ahi.
English: Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem; and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, and brought them back to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

tcz: Hichejou chun Jehoshaphat in kul kikai khum kho piho jousea chun, thutan vaihom ho akoisoh keijin ahi.
en: He set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,
text:
2CH 19:5
Thadou: Hichejou chun Jehoshaphat in kul kikai khum kho piho jousea chun, thutan vaihom ho akoisoh keijin ahi.
English: He set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,

tcz: Aman thutan vaihom hochu ahilchah in, “Nakin natoh nauvahin chingtheijun, ajeh chu nangho mihem adia thutan nahi pouve, Pathen dinga joh thutan nahiu ahi.”
en: and said to the judges, “Consider what you do, for you don’t judge for man, but for the LORD; and he is with you in the judgment.
text:
2CH 19:6
Thadou: Aman thutan vaihom hochu ahilchah in, “Nakin natoh nauvahin chingtheijun, ajeh chu nangho mihem adia thutan nahi pouve, Pathen dinga joh thutan nahiu ahi.”
English: and said to the judges, “Consider what you do, for you don’t judge for man, but for the LORD; and he is with you in the judgment.

tcz: “Pathen jana neitah le chingthei tahin tongun, ajeh chu i-Pathen uhin joulhepna, langneina chule nehguh bol hi athet ahi,” ati.
en: Now therefore let the fear of the LORD be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of bribes.”
text:
2CH 19:7
Thadou: “Pathen jana neitah le chingthei tahin tongun, ajeh chu i-Pathen uhin joulhepna, langneina chule nehguh bol hi athet ahi,” ati.
English: Now therefore let the fear of the LORD be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of bribes.”

tcz: Hichechung chonchun aman Jerusalem Pakai dan sukeh ho chunga thutan dingin, Jehoshaphat in Levi hole thempu ho chule Israel mipa holah a athupicheh Jerusalem a hung kile hochu apansah in ahi.
en: Moreover in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed certain Levites, priests, and heads of the fathers’ households of Israel to give judgment for the LORD and for controversies. They returned to Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 19:8
Thadou: Hichechung chonchun aman Jerusalem Pakai dan sukeh ho chunga thutan dingin, Jehoshaphat in Levi hole thempu ho chule Israel mipa holah a athupicheh Jerusalem a hung kile hochu apansah in ahi.
English: Moreover in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed certain Levites, priests, and heads of the fathers’ households of Israel to give judgment for the LORD and for controversies. They returned to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hitichun aman thupeh aneiyin, “Nanghon Pathen jana neitah leh lungthim kitahna neija thu natandiu ahi,” ati.
en: He commanded them, saying, “You shall do this in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
text:
2CH 19:9
Thadou: Hitichun aman thupeh aneiyin, “Nanghon Pathen jana neitah leh lungthim kitahna neija thu natandiu ahi,” ati.
English: He commanded them, saying, “You shall do this in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

tcz: “Khopi mi nachen khompi khopi khat a kona tolthat thu hihen lang dan khat touleh thupeh khat tou sukeh hijongleh, Pathen dounaa chonset abol louna dinga chingthei tah a pan alahna ding in thupeh aneiyin ahi. Hitia chu nabol louva ahileh, nachung uva Pathen lunghanna chuding ahi. Amavang natoh diudol phatah a natohuva ahileh themmo nachan loudiu ahi,” atipeh e.
en: Whenever any controversy comes to you from your brothers who dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and ordinances, you must warn them, that they not be guilty toward the LORD, and so wrath come on you and on your brothers. Do this, and you will not be guilty.
text:
2CH 19:10
Thadou: “Khopi mi nachen khompi khopi khat a kona tolthat thu hihen lang dan khat touleh thupeh khat tou sukeh hijongleh, Pathen dounaa chonset abol louna dinga chingthei tah a pan alahna ding in thupeh aneiyin ahi. Hitia chu nabol louva ahileh, nachung uva Pathen lunghanna chuding ahi. Amavang natoh diudol phatah a natohuva ahileh themmo nachan loudiu ahi,” atipeh e.
English: Whenever any controversy comes to you from your brothers who dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and ordinances, you must warn them, that they not be guilty toward the LORD, and so wrath come on you and on your brothers. Do this, and you will not be guilty.

tcz: Houlam thudol jousea thempulen Amariah hi thaneipen hiding, chuleh Judah gam vaipo Ishmeal chapa Zedekiah hi mipiholah a thutan dia; athaneipen hiding ahi. Levite hin thu kitanna jouse hi iti chelhahnam ti avetsuiding, hangsan tah in thu kapeh hi tong doh un, Pakaiyin thudih'a thu kitanna jouse apanpi ding ahi! ati.
en: Behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all the king’s matters. Also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and may the LORD be with the good.”
text:
2CH 19:11
Thadou: Houlam thudol jousea thempulen Amariah hi thaneipen hiding, chuleh Judah gam vaipo Ishmeal chapa Zedekiah hi mipiholah a thutan dia; athaneipen hiding ahi. Levite hin thu kitanna jouse hi iti chelhahnam ti avetsuiding, hangsan tah in thu kapeh hi tong doh un, Pakaiyin thudih'a thu kitanna jouse apanpi ding ahi! ati.
English: Behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all the king’s matters. Also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and may the LORD be with the good.”

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouhin Moab mite leh Ammon mite chuleh apanpi Meun mite chu Jehoshaphat doudingin ahung kon taovin ahi
en: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
text:
2CH 20:1
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouhin Moab mite leh Ammon mite chuleh apanpi Meun mite chu Jehoshaphat doudingin ahung kon taovin ahi
English: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

tcz: Thupole hon jong Jehoshaphat lengpa komma chun “Twikhanglen gal lang Edom ma kon in galmi alei limmin nang ma douding ngin ahung kitol uve” tin ahung seipeh taovin ahi, amahon Hazazon Tamar jong atou pha taovin ahi (Hichehi Engedy tina ahi).
en: Then some came who told Jehoshaphat, saying, “A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria. Behold, they are in Hazazon Tamar” (that is, En Gedi).
text:
2CH 20:2
Thadou: Thupole hon jong Jehoshaphat lengpa komma chun “Twikhanglen gal lang Edom ma kon in galmi alei limmin nang ma douding ngin ahung kitol uve” tin ahung seipeh taovin ahi, amahon Hazazon Tamar jong atou pha taovin ahi (Hichehi Engedy tina ahi).
English: Then some came who told Jehoshaphat, saying, “A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria. Behold, they are in Hazazon Tamar” (that is, En Gedi).

tcz: Jehoshaphat chu akicha lheh jengtan Pakai kommah ataovin ikati ding hitam tin adong tan ahi. hijou chun aman gamsung pumpin an ngoldingin thu ape tan ahi
en: Jehoshaphat was alarmed, and set himself to seek the LORD. He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
text:
2CH 20:3
Thadou: Jehoshaphat chu akicha lheh jengtan Pakai kommah ataovin ikati ding hitam tin adong tan ahi. hijou chun aman gamsung pumpin an ngoldingin thu ape tan ahi
English: Jehoshaphat was alarmed, and set himself to seek the LORD. He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

tcz: Judah khopiho jousea kon in mijouse chu Jerusalem mah Pakai komma taodingin ahung taovin ahi.
en: Judah gathered themselves together to seek help from the LORD. They came out of all the cities of Judah to seek the LORD.
text:
2CH 20:4
Thadou: Judah khopiho jousea kon in mijouse chu Jerusalem mah Pakai komma taodingin ahung taovin ahi.
English: Judah gathered themselves together to seek help from the LORD. They came out of all the cities of Judah to seek the LORD.

tcz: Hitichun Jerusalem ma Judah mipite jousechu Pakai houinsung indan thah kisem maija chun akikhom mun, Jehoshaphat lengpa jong achen amasang uvah adingin ahi
en: Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in the LORD’s house, before the new court;

tcz: Amaho okithong leovin ataovun, “Vo Kapu Kapa teo Pathen vanna konin vannoi leiset chitin namtin chungah vai nahommin ahi, nangma hi thanei tahleh thahattah nahin koiman na ki dou pi joupon ahi.
en: and he said, “LORD, the God of our fathers, aren’t you God in heaven? Aren’t you ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in your hand, so that no one is able to withstand you.
text:
2CH 20:6
Thadou: Amaho okithong leovin ataovun, “Vo Kapu Kapa teo Pathen vanna konin vannoi leiset chitin namtin chungah vai nahommin ahi, nangma hi thanei tahleh thahattah nahin koiman na ki dou pi joupon ahi.
English: and he said, “LORD, the God of our fathers, aren’t you God in heaven? Aren’t you ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in your hand, so that no one is able to withstand you.

tcz: Nangma hi ka Pathennu nahin, namite Israel te hiche gamsunga ahunglut phatnun nangin hiche gamma anacheng hochu nanodoh in nagolpa Abraham chilhah te atonsot na achen nadiuvin nanapen ahi
en: Didn’t you, our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel, and give it to the offspring of Abraham your friend forever?
text:
2CH 20:7
Thadou: Nangma hi ka Pathennu nahin, namite Israel te hiche gamsunga ahunglut phatnun nangin hiche gamma anacheng hochu nanodoh in nagolpa Abraham chilhah te atonsot na achen nadiuvin nanapen ahi
English: Didn’t you, our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel, and give it to the offspring of Abraham your friend forever?

tcz: Amaho anachenglut nun nangma janan houin khat anatung doh un chuleh hitin ana seijun,
en: They lived in it, and have built you a sanctuary in it for your name, saying,
text:
2CH 20:8
Thadou: Amaho anachenglut nun nangma janan houin khat anatung doh un chuleh hitin ana seijun,
English: They lived in it, and have built you a sanctuary in it for your name, saying,

tcz: “ijemtia amaho chungahi engbol na a hise – nat ahilouleh kel lhahna ahung chuh a ahileh keihon nangma angsunga hi Houin maija kadindiu (Ajeh chu namin jaum hi hiche houin nahi umma ahi) chuleh hamset na kato teng ujongleh kahung pendiu nangin neihin ngaipehdiu neihin huhdoh diu ahi.
en: ‘If evil comes on us—the sword, judgment, pestilence, or famine—we will stand before this house, and before you (for your name is in this house), and cry to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.’
text:
2CH 20:9
Thadou: “ijemtia amaho chungahi engbol na a hise – nat ahilouleh kel lhahna ahung chuh a ahileh keihon nangma angsunga hi Houin maija kadindiu (Ajeh chu namin jaum hi hiche houin nahi umma ahi) chuleh hamset na kato teng ujongleh kahung pendiu nangin neihin ngaipehdiu neihin huhdoh diu ahi.
English: ‘If evil comes on us—the sword, judgment, pestilence, or famine—we will stand before this house, and before you (for your name is in this house), and cry to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.’

tcz: Chuleh tuhin Ammon mite, Moab mite, chuleh molchunga um Seir mite aummun ahi, amahohi Egyptma konna Israel tea hung dohuva chu amato kisatding neina phalpeh lou ahi hijeha chu amahochu sumang louva ana otdohu ahi.
en: Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned away from them, and didn’t destroy them;

tcz: “Tuhin amahohin nangin katoupha diuva neinapehu gamma konna paidoh ding eigotnu ahitai.”
en: behold, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.
text:
2CH 20:11
Thadou: “Tuhin amahohin nangin katoupha diuva neinapehu gamma konna paidoh ding eigotnu ahitai.”
English: behold, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.

tcz: “Vo ka Pathennu nangman amaho chunga hi thu natan louding hitam? Ajeh chu eidoudiuva hunghohi atambehseh jengun keihon amaho douna dingin tha kanei jou pouve, tuhin etiding hitam kahatapouve hitia chu nangma jengbou kavetnu ahitaan ahi.”
en: Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no might against this great company that comes against us. We don’t know what to do, but our eyes are on you.”
text:
2CH 20:12
Thadou: “Vo ka Pathennu nangman amaho chunga hi thu natan louding hitam? Ajeh chu eidoudiuva hunghohi atambehseh jengun keihon amaho douna dingin tha kanei jou pouve, tuhin etiding hitam kahatapouve hitia chu nangma jengbou kavetnu ahitaan ahi.”
English: Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no might against this great company that comes against us. We don’t know what to do, but our eyes are on you.”

tcz: Tuhin Judah te jouse chu chapang senholeh aji achateo toh Pakai angsungah ading taovin ahi.
en: All Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
text:
2CH 20:13
Thadou: Tuhin Judah te jouse chu chapang senholeh aji achateo toh Pakai angsungah ading taovin ahi.
English: All Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.

tcz: Hichun Pakai lhagao chu khoppilah achun Asaph chatelaha konna Levi mipa Mattaniah chapa, Jeiel chapa Benaiah chapa Zechariah chapa Jahaziel chunga Pakai lhagao ahung chun,
en: Then the LORD’s Spirit came on Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, the Levite, of the sons of Asaph, in the middle of the assembly;

tcz: Hiti hin ahinseije “Judah mipite holeh Jerusalemma cheng jousen chuleh Jehoshaphat lengpa nangman jong ngaijin! Pakaiyin nangho komah hitin aseije: Hiche mihonpi jehkhun kicha hih un tijatna jong neihihun ajeh chu hiche galhi nanghoa ahipoi Pathenna joh ahibouve.
en: and he said, “Listen, all Judah, and you inhabitants of Jerusalem, and you, King Jehoshaphat. The LORD says to you, ‘Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed because of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.
text:
2CH 20:15
Thadou: Hiti hin ahinseije “Judah mipite holeh Jerusalemma cheng jousen chuleh Jehoshaphat lengpa nangman jong ngaijin! Pakaiyin nangho komah hitin aseije: Hiche mihonpi jehkhun kicha hih un tijatna jong neihihun ajeh chu hiche galhi nanghoa ahipoi Pathenna joh ahibouve.
English: and he said, “Listen, all Judah, and you inhabitants of Jerusalem, and you, King Jehoshaphat. The LORD says to you, ‘Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed because of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.

tcz: Jing nikho tengleh amahotoh kidou dingin konsuh jengun, amahohi Ziz lhangpanga hung kitol suhdiu ahi, chuteng leh nanghon amahochu Jeruel kom gammang gal paicham monga naki maito pidiu ahi.
en: Tomorrow, go down against them. Behold, they are coming up by the ascent of Ziz. You will find them at the end of the valley, before the wilderness of Jeruel.
text:
2CH 20:16
Thadou: Jing nikho tengleh amahotoh kidou dingin konsuh jengun, amahohi Ziz lhangpanga hung kitol suhdiu ahi, chuteng leh nanghon amahochu Jeruel kom gammang gal paicham monga naki maito pidiu ahi.
English: Tomorrow, go down against them. Behold, they are coming up by the ascent of Ziz. You will find them at the end of the valley, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

tcz: Nanghon hiche kisatna – a hi napan khel khel loudiu ahi, napan muncheh un kigol toh unlang dingdetnun chutileh nalahuva umjing Pakai mihuhdohna chu namu diu ahi, Vo Judah leh Jerusalem mite ho! Kicha hihbeh un lungkham najong neihih beh un, jingleh ama hotoh kidou dingin kondoh jengun ajeh chu Pakaiyin naum piovin ahi.
en: You will not need to fight this battle. Set yourselves, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Go out against them tomorrow, for the LORD is with you.’”
text:
2CH 20:17
Thadou: Nanghon hiche kisatna – a hi napan khel khel loudiu ahi, napan muncheh un kigol toh unlang dingdetnun chutileh nalahuva umjing Pakai mihuhdohna chu namu diu ahi, Vo Judah leh Jerusalem mite ho! Kicha hihbeh un lungkham najong neihih beh un, jingleh ama hotoh kidou dingin kondoh jengun ajeh chu Pakaiyin naum piovin ahi.
English: You will not need to fight this battle. Set yourselves, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Go out against them tomorrow, for the LORD is with you.’”

tcz: Hichun Jehoshaphat tollah abohkhupmin, chuleh Judah hole Jerusalem ma cheng jouse aboh khupmun Pakai achibai taovin ahi
en: Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before the LORD, worshiping the LORD.
text:
2CH 20:18
Thadou: Hichun Jehoshaphat tollah abohkhupmin, chuleh Judah hole Jerusalem ma cheng jouse aboh khupmun Pakai achibai taovin ahi
English: Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before the LORD, worshiping the LORD.

tcz: HichunKohat chateleh Korahit chate adding dohun a o neicha sunsunnun Pakai avahchoi taovin ahi.
en: The Levites, of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites, stood up to praise the LORD, the God of Israel, with an exceedingly loud voice.
text:
2CH 20:19
Thadou: HichunKohat chateleh Korahit chate adding dohun a o neicha sunsunnun Pakai avahchoi taovin ahi.
English: The Levites, of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites, stood up to praise the LORD, the God of Israel, with an exceedingly loud voice.

tcz: Hitichun Jingpi tahin athouvun Tekoa gammangah alut taove, hitachu ahung potdoh phatnun, Jehoshaphat adingin aseitai, Vo Judahteleh Jerusalemma chengten ngaijuvin, Pakai napathen chunguvah natahsannao ngamlhaovin chutileh nakiphudetdiu ahi. Athemgaoten nasei peh uchu tahsannun chutileh nalolhindiu ahi.”
en: They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. As they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Listen to me, Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in the LORD your God, so you will be established! Believe his prophets, so you will prosper.”
text:
2CH 20:20
Thadou: Hitichun Jingpi tahin athouvun Tekoa gammangah alut taove, hitachu ahung potdoh phatnun, Jehoshaphat adingin aseitai, Vo Judahteleh Jerusalemma chengten ngaijuvin, Pakai napathen chunguvah natahsannao ngamlhaovin chutileh nakiphudetdiu ahi. Athemgaoten nasei peh uchu tahsannun chutileh nalolhindiu ahi.”
English: They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. As they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Listen to me, Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in the LORD your God, so you will be established! Believe his prophets, so you will prosper.”

tcz: Aman mipihotoh akihoutoh jouvin, Lengpan lasa themhochu kinthenga akimanchah tenguleh avonngai houchu akivonsahin chuleh amahochu sepai ho masanga chun akijot sahin “Pakai chu vahchoi un, ajeh chu amingailutnahi tonsot ading ahi! atiove .
en: When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to the LORD and give praise in holy array as they go out before the army, and say, “Give thanks to the LORD, for his loving kindness endures forever.”
text:
2CH 20:21
Thadou: Aman mipihotoh akihoutoh jouvin, Lengpan lasa themhochu kinthenga akimanchah tenguleh avonngai houchu akivonsahin chuleh amahochu sepai ho masanga chun akijot sahin “Pakai chu vahchoi un, ajeh chu amingailutnahi tonsot ading ahi! atiove .
English: When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to the LORD and give praise in holy array as they go out before the army, and say, “Give thanks to the LORD, for his loving kindness endures forever.”

tcz: Amahon hiche lachu asahphatnun Pakaiyin galmi hochu athehchehtaan ahi
en: When they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah; and they were struck.
text:
2CH 20:22
Thadou: Amahon hiche lachu asahphatnun Pakaiyin galmi hochu athehchehtaan ahi
English: When they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah; and they were struck.

tcz: Ammon galmite le Moab galmiten Edom galmihochu akisatpiovin asumang hel taovin ahi, hijoucun amaholeh amaho akisattouvin akithat gamtaovin ahi.
en: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy each other.
text:
2CH 20:23
Thadou: Ammon galmite le Moab galmiten Edom galmihochu akisatpiovin asumang hel taovin ahi, hijoucun amaholeh amaho akisattouvin akithat gamtaovin ahi.
English: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy each other.

tcz: Judah galmitechu neldigamma insang kisa – a – chu akaldoh uva avetnuva ahileh galmi hochu tolla achap jengun koimacha ahoidoha aumpouvin ahi.
en: When Judah came to the place overlooking the wilderness, they looked at the multitude; and behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and there were none who escaped.
text:
2CH 20:24
Thadou: Judah galmitechu neldigamma insang kisa – a – chu akaldoh uva avetnuva ahileh galmi hochu tolla achap jengun koimacha ahoidoha aumpouvin ahi.
English: When Judah came to the place overlooking the wilderness, they looked at the multitude; and behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and there were none who escaped.

tcz: Jehoshaphat leh amite chu galmite thilkeo hochu chomma ahunguleh mithi hochunga chun thil mantamtah tah leh thil manlutah tah songmantam jeng jong amu vin amahon apohlel setnin achomdoh un nithum jen achom chomjengun ahi.
en: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their plunder, they found among them in abundance both riches and dead bodies with precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away. They took plunder for three days, it was so much.
text:
2CH 20:25
Thadou: Jehoshaphat leh amite chu galmite thilkeo hochu chomma ahunguleh mithi hochunga chun thil mantamtah tah leh thil manlutah tah songmantam jeng jong amu vin amahon apohlel setnin achomdoh un nithum jen achom chomjengun ahi.
English: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their plunder, they found among them in abundance both riches and dead bodies with precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away. They took plunder for three days, it was so much.

tcz: Nilichan nan Berachah phaichammah akikhommuvin Pathen athangvahun ahi; hijehachu hiche phaicham lahchu tunigeijin Berachah akisahtaan ahi.
en: On the fourth day, they assembled themselves in Beracah Valley, for there they blessed the LORD. Therefore the name of that place was called “Beracah Valley” to this day.
text:
2CH 20:26
Thadou: Nilichan nan Berachah phaichammah akikhommuvin Pathen athangvahun ahi; hijehachu hiche phaicham lahchu tunigeijin Berachah akisahtaan ahi.
English: On the fourth day, they assembled themselves in Beracah Valley, for there they blessed the LORD. Therefore the name of that place was called “Beracah Valley” to this day.

tcz: Jehoshaphat nin a sepai techu Jerusalem langah kipah tah in alepui tan ahi
en: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat in front of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
text:
2CH 20:27
Thadou: Jehoshaphat nin a sepai techu Jerusalem langah kipah tah in alepui tan ahi
English: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat in front of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

tcz: Amahohi Jerusalem khopi lamah ahungun selangdah leh semjang ahin saijuvin sumkon amutnun Pakai houin lang ajontaove.
en: They came to Jerusalem with stringed instruments, harps, and trumpets to the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 20:28
Thadou: Amahohi Jerusalem khopi lamah ahungun selangdah leh semjang ahin saijuvin sumkon amutnun Pakai houin lang ajontaove.
English: They came to Jerusalem with stringed instruments, harps, and trumpets to the LORD’s house.

tcz: Hichegamsungleh nammite hohin Pakaiyin Israel te galmiho jouse ajopeh taove ti ajahdoh phatnun kichatnan adimtaovin ahi
en: The fear of God was on all the kingdoms of the countries when they heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.
text:
2CH 20:29
Thadou: Hichegamsungleh nammite hohin Pakaiyin Israel te galmiho jouse ajopeh taove ti ajahdoh phatnun kichatnan adimtaovin ahi
English: The fear of God was on all the kingdoms of the countries when they heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.

tcz: Hitichun Jehoshaphat nin lungmong tahin vai ahommin Pathennin akimvel mitea kon in lung olna apetai.
en: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet, for his God gave him rest all around.
text:
2CH 20:30
Thadou: Hitichun Jehoshaphat nin lungmong tahin vai ahommin Pathennin akimvel mitea kon in lung olna apetai.
English: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet, for his God gave him rest all around.

tcz: Jehoshaphat hi Judah te lenga ahung panchun akum 35 alhingtaan ahi, Amahi Jerusalem man apansan kum 25 sungin vai anahommin ahi, anuhi Shilhi chanu Azubah ahi.
en: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he began to reign. He reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
text:
2CH 20:31
Thadou: Jehoshaphat hi Judah te lenga ahung panchun akum 35 alhingtaan ahi, Amahi Jerusalem man apansan kum 25 sungin vai anahommin ahi, anuhi Shilhi chanu Azubah ahi.
English: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he began to reign. He reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

tcz: Amahin apa Asa chenadung juiyin achen apampet pon ahi, chuleh Pakai mitmun dihtahin anachonnin ahi
en: He walked in the way of Asa his father, and didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in the LORD’s eyes.
text:
2CH 20:32
Thadou: Amahin apa Asa chenadung juiyin achen apampet pon ahi, chuleh Pakai mitmun dihtahin anachonnin ahi
English: He walked in the way of Asa his father, and didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in the LORD’s eyes.

tcz: Ahinlah doihouna mun hochu asumang dehpon ahi, chuleh mipi honjong apu apateo Pathen houna – a alungthimmu aheilut hih laijuve.
en: However the high places were not taken away, and the people had still not set their hearts on the God of their fathers.
text:
2CH 20:33
Thadou: Ahinlah doihouna mun hochu asumang dehpon ahi, chuleh mipi honjong apu apateo Pathen houna – a alungthimmu aheilut hih laijuve.
English: However the high places were not taken away, and the people had still not set their hearts on the God of their fathers.

tcz: Jehoshaphat thilbol dangho jouse chu, akipatnapat achaina gei Hanani chapa Jehu thusim bu jihna – a chun akijihlut nin, hichehi Israel lengte thusim bu kijih lutna ahi
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Jehu the son of Hanani, which is included in the book of the kings of Israel.
text:
2CH 20:34
Thadou: Jehoshaphat thilbol dangho jouse chu, akipatnapat achaina gei Hanani chapa Jehu thusim bu jihna – a chun akijihlut nin, hichehi Israel lengte thusim bu kijih lutna ahi
English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Jehu the son of Hanani, which is included in the book of the kings of Israel.

tcz: Hichejouhin Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat hin Israel lengpa thildihlou boljing Ahaziah toh anakivop min ahi
en: After this, Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel. The same did very wickedly.
text:
2CH 20:35
Thadou: Hichejouhin Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat hin Israel lengpa thildihlou boljing Ahaziah toh anakivop min ahi
English: After this, Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel. The same did very wickedly.

tcz: Amahitoh ana kivop lhonnin Tarshish cheding kong ana semlhonnin Ezion Geber munnah ana koi lhonin ahi
en: He joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish. They made the ships in Ezion Geber.
text:
2CH 20:36
Thadou: Amahitoh ana kivop lhonnin Tarshish cheding kong ana semlhonnin Ezion Geber munnah ana koi lhonin ahi
English: He joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish. They made the ships in Ezion Geber.

tcz: Ahinlah Mareshah a um Dodavah chapa Eliezer in Jehoshaphat chung changah gaothu anaseijin nangman Ahaziah toh nakivop jeh'in nanatoh chu asubei sohtai ati. Hijouchun kongho jousejong Tarshish lammah achethei tapon ahi
en: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, “Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah, the LORD has destroyed your works.” The ships were wrecked, so that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
text:
2CH 20:37
Thadou: Ahinlah Mareshah a um Dodavah chapa Eliezer in Jehoshaphat chung changah gaothu anaseijin nangman Ahaziah toh nakivop jeh'in nanatoh chu asubei sohtai ati. Hijouchun kongho jousejong Tarshish lammah achethei tapon ahi
English: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, “Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah, the LORD has destroyed your works.” The ships were wrecked, so that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

tcz: Jehoshaphat chu apu apate toh akicholdo khom taovin David khopiah ana kivuitaan ahi, hijouchun achapa Jehoram min vai ahin hom tan ahi
en: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
text:
2CH 21:1
Thadou: Jehoshaphat chu apu apate toh akicholdo khom taovin David khopiah ana kivuitaan ahi, hijouchun achapa Jehoram min vai ahin hom tan ahi
English: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Aman Jehoshaphat chate sopi phabep ananeijin ahi: Azariah, Jehiel, Zachariah, Azariahu, Michael, chuleh Shephatiah ahiovin amaho jousechu Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chate ahiove
en: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah. All these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
text:
2CH 21:2
Thadou: Aman Jehoshaphat chate sopi phabep ananeijin ahi: Azariah, Jehiel, Zachariah, Azariahu, Michael, chuleh Shephatiah ahiovin amaho jousechu Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chate ahiove
English: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah. All these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

tcz: Amahochu apaovin Sana dangka chuleh thilman tamtah tah hi anapeovin chuleh kul kikai khum Judah khopi ho khat chehtoh anape chehin ahinla lenggam vangchu Jehoram anapei ajeh chu amahi acha masapen ahi
en: Their father gave them great gifts of silver, of gold, and of precious things, with fortified cities in Judah; but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.
text:
2CH 21:3
Thadou: Amahochu apaovin Sana dangka chuleh thilman tamtah tah hi anapeovin chuleh kul kikai khum Judah khopi ho khat chehtoh anape chehin ahinla lenggam vangchu Jehoram anapei ajeh chu amahi acha masapen ahi
English: Their father gave them great gifts of silver, of gold, and of precious things, with fortified cities in Judah; but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.

tcz: Jehoram chu aleng gam akisuhdet phatnin athahat becheh nadingin asopiho jouseleh Israel leng chahojong athat gamsohhellin ahi
en: Now when Jehoram had risen up over the kingdom of his father, and had strengthened himself, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and also some of the princes of Israel.
text:
2CH 21:4
Thadou: Jehoram chu aleng gam akisuhdet phatnin athahat becheh nadingin asopiho jouseleh Israel leng chahojong athat gamsohhellin ahi
English: Now when Jehoram had risen up over the kingdom of his father, and had strengthened himself, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and also some of the princes of Israel.

tcz: Jehoram leng ahung chanhin akum 32 alhingtaan ahi, chuleh Jerusalem mahin kum 8 bou aleng changin ahi
en: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 21:5
Thadou: Jehoram leng ahung chanhin akum 32 alhingtaan ahi, chuleh Jerusalem mahin kum 8 bou aleng changin ahi
English: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

tcz: Amahi Israel lengte chonnin achonnin Ahab tobang'in atongin ahi, ajeh chu aman Ahab chanu akichenpin Pakai deilou lamjengin akimangchan ahi
en: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he had Ahab’s daughter as his wife. He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.
text:
2CH 21:6
Thadou: Amahi Israel lengte chonnin achonnin Ahab tobang'in atongin ahi, ajeh chu aman Ahab chanu akichenpin Pakai deilou lamjengin akimangchan ahi
English: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he had Ahab’s daughter as his wife. He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

tcz: Ahivangin David toh kitep na aneidung juiyin Davip chilhah hohi asumang nompon ahi, ajeh chu David lengmun alojing diuva Pakaiyin kitepna ananeisa ahi
en: However the LORD would not destroy David’s house, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a lamp to him and to his children always.
text:
2CH 21:7
Thadou: Ahivangin David toh kitep na aneidung juiyin Davip chilhah hohi asumang nompon ahi, ajeh chu David lengmun alojing diuva Pakaiyin kitepna ananeisa ahi
English: However the LORD would not destroy David’s house, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a lamp to him and to his children always.

tcz: Jehoram vaihom sungin Edommin gal ahin bollin lenggam atummin ahin kitundoh taovin ahi
en: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
text:
2CH 21:8
Thadou: Jehoram vaihom sungin Edommin gal ahin bollin lenggam atummin ahin kitundoh taovin ahi
English: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

tcz: Ahin Jehoram leh agal lamkaiho chu Sakolkang talai chungah atouvun Edom ana nokhum mun ahi, ahinlah Edom sepaiten akol khummin ahin amaho jannin ajamdoh un ahi
en: Then Jehoram went there with his captains and all his chariots with him. He rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, along with the captains of the chariots.
text:
2CH 21:9
Thadou: Ahin Jehoram leh agal lamkaiho chu Sakolkang talai chungah atouvun Edom ana nokhum mun ahi, ahinlah Edom sepaiten akol khummin ahin amaho jannin ajamdoh un ahi
English: Then Jehoram went there with his captains and all his chariots with him. He rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, along with the captains of the chariots.

tcz: Hichea patnin Edom ten Judaha kon in chamlhat na ahinnei taovin ahi, Hichesunga hin Libnah khopi injong kiphin na ahinneitaan ahi, ajeh chu Jehoram hin apu apa te Pathen apaidohtaan ahi
en: So Edom has been in revolt from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand, because he had forsaken the LORD, the God of his fathers.
text:
2CH 21:10
Thadou: Hichea patnin Edom ten Judaha kon in chamlhat na ahinnei taovin ahi, Hichesunga hin Libnah khopi injong kiphin na ahinneitaan ahi, ajeh chu Jehoram hin apu apa te Pathen apaidohtaan ahi
English: So Edom has been in revolt from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand, because he had forsaken the LORD, the God of his fathers.

tcz: Amahin doihouna munho anatung doh in Judah leh Jerusalem mipi ho hi Pathen dounan anachonset sahgamtaan ahi
en: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and made the inhabitants of Jerusalem play the prostitute, and led Judah astray.
text:
2CH 21:11
Thadou: Amahin doihouna munho anatung doh in Judah leh Jerusalem mipi ho hi Pathen dounan anachonset sahgamtaan ahi
English: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and made the inhabitants of Jerusalem play the prostitute, and led Judah astray.

tcz: Elijah themgaovin Jehoram chu lekha ahin thotnin, “Pakai napu napa David Pathen chun nangmahi napaidohtaan ahi, ajeh chu nangin napu Asa lengpa napa Jehoshaphat chonbangin nachon tapon,
en: A letter came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, “the LORD, the God of David your father, says, ‘Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
text:
2CH 21:12
Thadou: Elijah themgaovin Jehoram chu lekha ahin thotnin, “Pakai napu napa David Pathen chun nangmahi napaidohtaan ahi, ajeh chu nangin napu Asa lengpa napa Jehoshaphat chonbangin nachon tapon,
English: A letter came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, “the LORD, the God of David your father, says, ‘Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

tcz: Amavang Israel lengho chonin nahung chonnin Judah le Jerusalem mipite hi Pathen doumah nabolsahin Ahab leh Israel lengho bangin na chontan chuleh nangsanga phajo nasopiho jong nahinthat gamhellin ahi
en: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to play the prostitute like Ahab’s house did, and also have slain your brothers of your father’s house, who were better than yourself,
text:
2CH 21:13
Thadou: Amavang Israel lengho chonin nahung chonnin Judah le Jerusalem mipite hi Pathen doumah nabolsahin Ahab leh Israel lengho bangin na chontan chuleh nangsanga phajo nasopiho jong nahinthat gamhellin ahi
English: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to play the prostitute like Ahab’s house did, and also have slain your brothers of your father’s house, who were better than yourself,

tcz: Hichejeha hi Pakaiyin na mipite leh nacha nanao teleh najite asuhgenthei ding chuleh naneinagou hojong asuhmang ding ahi
en: behold, the LORD will strike your people with a great plague, including your children, your wives, and all your possessions;

tcz: Nangmatah jeng jong nagil sunga thoh lel umtah hivei nakhumpeh a niseh a khoh cheh cheh ding ahi
en: and you will have great sickness with a disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness, day by day.’”
text:
2CH 21:15
Thadou: Nangmatah jeng jong nagil sunga thoh lel umtah hivei nakhumpeh a niseh a khoh cheh cheh ding ahi
English: and you will have great sickness with a disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness, day by day.’”

tcz: Hiche chung chon hin Pakaiyin Philistine teleh Ethopia komma cheng Arabiate Jehoram doudingin ahin choudoh tan ahi
en: The LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines and of the Arabians who are beside the Ethiopians;

tcz: Amahohi Judah gamma ahunglutnun Judah te akisatpiovin leng inpia neilegou umjouse achommun hiche tilou vinjong aji achate se akaimangun, achate laha aneopen Jehoahaz bou akhenpehin ahi
en: and they came up against Judah, broke into it, and carried away all the possessions that were found in the king’s house, including his sons and his wives, so that there was no son left to him except Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
text:
2CH 21:17
Thadou: Amahohi Judah gamma ahunglutnun Judah te akisatpiovin leng inpia neilegou umjouse achommun hiche tilou vinjong aji achate se akaimangun, achate laha aneopen Jehoahaz bou akhenpehin ahi
English: and they came up against Judah, broke into it, and carried away all the possessions that were found in the king’s house, including his sons and his wives, so that there was no son left to him except Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

tcz: Hiche jouhin Pakaiyin lengpa gilsunga chun thohlel umtah hivei anatdohsah taan ahi
en: After all this the LORD struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
text:
2CH 21:18
Thadou: Hiche jouhin Pakaiyin lengpa gilsunga chun thohlel umtah hivei anatdohsah taan ahi
English: After all this the LORD struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

tcz: Kumni sungin lengpa natna chu athohlel cheh chehin ajona in gentheitahin athipi taan ahi. Amipiten jong apu apateo athiteng alung hempinao vetsahna a mei atijio chu atih tapouvin ahi
en: In process of time, at the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness, and he died of severe diseases. His people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
text:
2CH 21:19
Thadou: Kumni sungin lengpa natna chu athohlel cheh chehin ajona in gentheitahin athipi taan ahi. Amipiten jong apu apateo athiteng alung hempinao vetsahna a mei atijio chu atih tapouvin ahi
English: In process of time, at the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness, and he died of severe diseases. His people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

tcz: Jehoram min kum 32 (Somthum le ni) alhinna lengmun alo pat ahin kum 8 sungin bou vai ahommin ahi. Athichun koimacha alhase alunghem aumpon ahi. Amachu lengte kivuina –a avui pouvin David khopi sunga vang anavui naovin ahi
en: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He departed with no one’s regret. They buried him in David’s city, but not in the tombs of the kings.
text:
2CH 21:20
Thadou: Jehoram min kum 32 (Somthum le ni) alhinna lengmun alo pat ahin kum 8 sungin bou vai ahommin ahi. Athichun koimacha alhase alunghem aumpon ahi. Amachu lengte kivuina –a avui pouvin David khopi sunga vang anavui naovin ahi
English: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He departed with no one’s regret. They buried him in David’s city, but not in the tombs of the kings.

tcz: Hichejouhin Jerusalemma chengten lengpa chapa aneopen Ahaziah chu amakhellin leng achansah taove, ajeh chu Arab miten ahin delkhumma achate ama chunga sechu athagam mu ahitai. Hijeh a chu Juda lengpa Jehoram chapa chun vai ahom ahi.
en: The inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place, because the band of men who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the oldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
text:
2CH 22:1
Thadou: Hichejouhin Jerusalemma chengten lengpa chapa aneopen Ahaziah chu amakhellin leng achansah taove, ajeh chu Arab miten ahin delkhumma achate ama chunga sechu athagam mu ahitai. Hijeh a chu Juda lengpa Jehoram chapa chun vai ahom ahi.
English: The inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place, because the band of men who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the oldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

tcz: Ahaziah chu leng ahung channachu kum 42 lhinga ahitai, amahin Jerusalem mah apansan kumkhat vai ana hommin ahi. Anu chu Omri tunu Athaliah ahi
en: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
text:
2CH 22:2
Thadou: Ahaziah chu leng ahung channachu kum 42 lhinga ahitai, amahin Jerusalem mah apansan kumkhat vai ana hommin ahi. Anu chu Omri tunu Athaliah ahi
English: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

tcz: Amajonghin Ahab chonbang bangin achonnin anu thupeh dung juiyin thilse jeng ana bollin ahi
en: He also walked in the ways of Ahab’s house, because his mother was his counselor in acting wickedly.
text:
2CH 22:3
Thadou: Amajonghin Ahab chonbang bangin achonnin anu thupeh dung juiyin thilse jeng ana bollin ahi
English: He also walked in the ways of Ahab’s house, because his mother was his counselor in acting wickedly.

tcz: Apa thijouvin Ahab insung mite thumob dungjuija achon jeh'in Pathen mitmun thilse jeng abollin amanthah lotaan ahi
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.
text:
2CH 22:4
Thadou: Apa thijouvin Ahab insung mite thumob dungjuija achon jeh'in Pathen mitmun thilse jeng abollin amanthah lotaan ahi
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.

tcz: Amaho thumob dungjuijin Israel lengpa Ahab chapa Jehoram toh Syri lengpa Hazeal toh kisatto dingin Ramoth Gilead na akon lhonin hichea chun Syria ten Jehoram chu asukhao vin ahi
en: He also followed their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.
text:
2CH 22:5
Thadou: Amaho thumob dungjuijin Israel lengpa Ahab chapa Jehoram toh Syri lengpa Hazeal toh kisatto dingin Ramoth Gilead na akon lhonin hichea chun Syria ten Jehoram chu asukhao vin ahi
English: He also followed their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

tcz: Syria lengpa Hazeal toh kisatna Ramah ajot lhonchun Jehoram akisukhan amaha damdoh nadingin Jezreel khopia akinung letaan ahi. Juda lengpa chapa Azariah chu adamona vedingin achesuh in ahi
en: He returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which they had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Azariah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
text:
2CH 22:6
Thadou: Syria lengpa Hazeal toh kisatna Ramah ajot lhonchun Jehoram akisukhan amaha damdoh nadingin Jezreel khopia akinung letaan ahi. Juda lengpa chapa Azariah chu adamona vedingin achesuh in ahi
English: He returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which they had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Azariah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

tcz: Joram vedinga achesuh chu Pathenin alhuhna akalsonsah ana hikhatai ajeh chu ama agalhun phatnin Nimsi chapa Jehu toh'a kisat ton alhuh kam lotaan ahi. Ajeh chu Jehu Ahab insung mite sugam dinga Pakaiyin thao ananusa ahitaan ahi
en: Now the destruction of Ahaziah was of God, in that he went to Joram; for when he had come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off Ahab’s house.
text:
2CH 22:7
Thadou: Joram vedinga achesuh chu Pathenin alhuhna akalsonsah ana hikhatai ajeh chu ama agalhun phatnin Nimsi chapa Jehu toh'a kisat ton alhuh kam lotaan ahi. Ajeh chu Jehu Ahab insung mite sugam dinga Pakaiyin thao ananusa ahitaan ahi
English: Now the destruction of Ahaziah was of God, in that he went to Joram; for when he had come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off Ahab’s house.

tcz: Jehu chun Pathen thupeh dungjuija Ahab insung mite sugam dinga ahung kipat laitah hin aman Judah leng chate leh Ahaziah sipiho chate chu amudoh in athat gamtan ahi
en: When Jehu was executing judgment on Ahab’s house, he found the princes of Judah and the sons of the brothers of Ahaziah serving Ahaziah, and killed them.
text:
2CH 22:8
Thadou: Jehu chun Pathen thupeh dungjuija Ahab insung mite sugam dinga ahung kipat laitah hin aman Judah leng chate leh Ahaziah sipiho chate chu amudoh in athat gamtan ahi
English: When Jehu was executing judgment on Ahab’s house, he found the princes of Judah and the sons of the brothers of Ahaziah serving Ahaziah, and killed them.

tcz: Hijouchun aman Ahaziah chu ahollin ahileh amantaovin (Samaria a ana kisel ahi) Jehu kommah ahin puilutnun ahi. Amahon athatnun avuitaovin ahi, ajeh chu amahon avuiju chun amaho akihouvun amahi alung thimpum pia Pathen holla Jehoshaphat chapa ahi atiova, janna apeh u ahi. Hichejou chun Ahaziah insunga leng gam vaipo ding aum tapon ahi
en: He sought Ahaziah, and they caught him (now he was hiding in Samaria), and they brought him to Jehu and killed him; and they buried him, for they said, “He is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart.” The house of Ahaziah had no power to hold the kingdom.
text:
2CH 22:9
Thadou: Hijouchun aman Ahaziah chu ahollin ahileh amantaovin (Samaria a ana kisel ahi) Jehu kommah ahin puilutnun ahi. Amahon athatnun avuitaovin ahi, ajeh chu amahon avuiju chun amaho akihouvun amahi alung thimpum pia Pathen holla Jehoshaphat chapa ahi atiova, janna apeh u ahi. Hichejou chun Ahaziah insunga leng gam vaipo ding aum tapon ahi
English: He sought Ahaziah, and they caught him (now he was hiding in Samaria), and they brought him to Jehu and killed him; and they buried him, for they said, “He is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart.” The house of Ahaziah had no power to hold the kingdom.

tcz: Ahaziah nu Athaliah hin achapa athitai tihi ahet dohphatnin ama ahung kipatnin Judah gam'a lengmun hinchuthei jousechu asumang gamtaan ahi
en: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.
text:
2CH 22:10
Thadou: Ahaziah nu Athaliah hin achapa athitai tihi ahet dohphatnin ama ahung kipatnin Judah gam'a lengmun hinchuthei jousechu asumang gamtaan ahi
English: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.

tcz: Ahinlah Jehosheba lengpa sopinuchun Ahazial chapa Joash chu lengpa chate ana thagam holah a konchun ana seldohin lupna khatna analupsah in ana khoukhah in ahi, hitichun Jehoram lengpa chanu Jehoiada thempu pan ana kichenpi Jehosheba (Ahaziah sopinu) chun Athaliah in athagam na dinga konchun anaseldoh in ahi
en: But Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stealthily rescued him from among the king’s sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she didn’t kill him.
text:
2CH 22:11
Thadou: Ahinlah Jehosheba lengpa sopinuchun Ahazial chapa Joash chu lengpa chate ana thagam holah a konchun ana seldohin lupna khatna analupsah in ana khoukhah in ahi, hitichun Jehoram lengpa chanu Jehoiada thempu pan ana kichenpi Jehosheba (Ahaziah sopinu) chun Athaliah in athagam na dinga konchun anaseldoh in ahi
English: But Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stealthily rescued him from among the king’s sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she didn’t kill him.

tcz: Hitichun Athaliah in gamsunga vai ahom kum 6 sung se achun Pathen houin nah ana seldoh in ahi
en: He was with them hidden in God’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
text:
2CH 22:12
Thadou: Hitichun Athaliah in gamsunga vai ahom kum 6 sung se achun Pathen houin nah ana seldoh in ahi
English: He was with them hidden in God’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.

tcz: kum sagi channa a chun Jehoiada in adinmun akisuhdet nin sepai jakhat toh lamkai hochutoh akinoptouvin amahochu Jehoram chapa Azariah, Jehohanan chapa Ishmael, Obed chapa Azariah, Adaizah chapa Maaseiah chuleh Zikri chapa Elishaphat ahiove
en: In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds—Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri—into a covenant with him.
text:
2CH 23:1
Thadou: kum sagi channa a chun Jehoiada in adinmun akisuhdet nin sepai jakhat toh lamkai hochutoh akinoptouvin amahochu Jehoram chapa Azariah, Jehohanan chapa Ishmael, Obed chapa Azariah, Adaizah chapa Maaseiah chuleh Zikri chapa Elishaphat ahiove
English: In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds—Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri—into a covenant with him.

tcz: Amahohi Judah khopi ho jousea acheovin Levite phung nga phung upacheh Jerusalemma ahin puilutnun ahi
en: They went around in Judah and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the heads of fathers’ households of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 23:2
Thadou: Amahohi Judah khopi ho jousea acheovin Levite phung nga phung upacheh Jerusalemma ahin puilutnun ahi
English: They went around in Judah and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the heads of fathers’ households of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

tcz: Amaho houin nachun akikhom mun lengpa chapa Joash chutoh kitepna ana semmun ahi. Jehoiada chun amaho kommah anaseijin: “Ilahuva hin lengpan athingel chapa chu aummin ahi! amahi Pakai thutep dung jui'a David chilhah ahi dung jui'a leng ichan sah diu ahi.
en: All the assembly made a covenant with the king in God’s house. Jehoiada said to them, “Behold, the king’s son must reign, as the LORD has spoken concerning the sons of David.
text:
2CH 23:3
Thadou: Amaho houin nachun akikhom mun lengpa chapa Joash chutoh kitepna ana semmun ahi. Jehoiada chun amaho kommah anaseijin: “Ilahuva hin lengpan athingel chapa chu aummin ahi! amahi Pakai thutep dung jui'a David chilhah ahi dung jui'a leng ichan sah diu ahi.
English: All the assembly made a covenant with the king in God’s house. Jehoiada said to them, “Behold, the king’s son must reign, as the LORD has spoken concerning the sons of David.

tcz: Hitia hi iboldiu ahi, thempu holeh Levi techu choldonia akinnu tonga ahung tenguleh hopthumma hopkhatnin houin kelkot ho angadiu ahi,
en: This is the thing that you must do: a third part of you, who come in on the Sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be gatekeepers of the thresholds.
text:
2CH 23:4
Thadou: Hitia hi iboldiu ahi, thempu holeh Levi techu choldonia akinnu tonga ahung tenguleh hopthumma hopkhatnin houin kelkot ho angadiu ahi,
English: This is the thing that you must do: a third part of you, who come in on the Sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be gatekeepers of the thresholds.

tcz: Adang hopthumma hopkhat chun leng inpi angading, chuleh hopthumma hopkhatman kulpi bul kelkot phung nangadiu, chutengleh mipi abonchaova Pakai houin mai hong cha –a chu kikhom ding ahiove
en: A third part shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation. All the people will be in the courts of the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 23:5
Thadou: Adang hopthumma hopkhat chun leng inpi angading, chuleh hopthumma hopkhatman kulpi bul kelkot phung nangadiu, chutengleh mipi abonchaova Pakai houin mai hong cha –a chu kikhom ding ahiove
English: A third part shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation. All the people will be in the courts of the LORD’s house.

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen insunga chu Pakai kinbol Levite toh thempu akiseiho tailou adang hunglut thei louding ahi, amahochu houinsung nga luttheidiu ahi ajeh chu ama hochu atheng ahiove, ahinla adanghose chun Pathen thupeh ngah a apamma dingdiu ahiove
