en: But let no one come into the LORD’s house except the priests and those who minister of the Levites. They shall come in, for they are holy, but all the people shall follow the LORD’s instructions.
text:
2CH 23:6
Thadou: Ahinlah Pathen insunga chu Pakai kinbol Levite toh thempu akiseiho tailou adang hunglut thei louding ahi, amahochu houinsung nga luttheidiu ahi ajeh chu ama hochu atheng ahiove, ahinla adanghose chun Pathen thupeh ngah a apamma dingdiu ahiove
English: But let no one come into the LORD’s house except the priests and those who minister of the Levites. They shall come in, for they are holy, but all the people shall follow the LORD’s instructions.

tcz: Chuleh Levitechun lengpa chu aum kimveldiu akhutnuvah manchah akichoi chehdiu ahin insung hunglut jouse chu athadiu ahi. nanghon lengpa ahung lut hihen apotdoh hijongleh nakilhon pidingu ahi
en: The Levites shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand. Whoever comes into the house, let him be slain. Be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out.”
text:
2CH 23:7
Thadou: Chuleh Levitechun lengpa chu aum kimveldiu akhutnuvah manchah akichoi chehdiu ahin insung hunglut jouse chu athadiu ahi. nanghon lengpa ahung lut hihen apotdoh hijongleh nakilhon pidingu ahi
English: The Levites shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand. Whoever comes into the house, let him be slain. Be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out.”

tcz: Hitichun Levite leh Juda ten thempupa Jehoiada thupeh bang bang chun achontaovin ahi. Lamkai khatcheh chun anoija hochu akipuijun cholngah nileh akinnuva akimanchah petnu hihenlang aonpetnu hijongleh aumpi jingun ahi, ajeh chu thempupa Jehoiada in sepai hochu alha ongpon ahi.
en: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded. They each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath, with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, for Jehoiada the priest didn’t dismiss the shift.
text:
2CH 23:8
Thadou: Hitichun Levite leh Juda ten thempupa Jehoiada thupeh bang bang chun achontaovin ahi. Lamkai khatcheh chun anoija hochu akipuijun cholngah nileh akinnuva akimanchah petnu hihenlang aonpetnu hijongleh aumpi jingun ahi, ajeh chu thempupa Jehoiada in sepai hochu alha ongpon ahi.
English: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded. They each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath, with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, for Jehoiada the priest didn’t dismiss the shift.

tcz: Chuleh Jehoiada thempupa chun sepai aja ajalah a lamkai hochu Pathen houinna um ompho holeh tengcha hochu ahop pehin ahi
en: Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, bucklers, and shields that had been king David’s, which were in God’s house.
text:
2CH 23:9
Thadou: Chuleh Jehoiada thempupa chun sepai aja ajalah a lamkai hochu Pathen houinna um ompho holeh tengcha hochu ahop pehin ahi
English: Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, bucklers, and shields that had been king David’s, which were in God’s house.

tcz: Hitichun aman sepai hochu Houin kotmai vella chun chemjam dodohsan akichoisah in lengpa hoibitna dinga chun phasademmin pan alahsahin ahi
en: He set all the people, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, near the altar and the house, around the king.
text:
2CH 23:10
Thadou: Hitichun aman sepai hochu Houin kotmai vella chun chemjam dodohsan akichoisah in lengpa hoibitna dinga chun phasademmin pan alahsahin ahi
English: He set all the people, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, near the altar and the house, around the king.

tcz: Hijou chun Jehoiada in Joash chu ahin puidoh in aluchung nga lallukhuh akhuhpeh in lengte kivaihom na danbuchu apen hiti chun leng achansahtan ahi. Thempupa Jehoiada leh achaten Joash chu thao anu vin chuleh mijouse chun “Lengpa hingsothen” tin asammun ahi
en: Then they brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, gave him the covenant, and made him king. Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and they said, “Long live the king!”
text:
2CH 23:11
Thadou: Hijou chun Jehoiada in Joash chu ahin puidoh in aluchung nga lallukhuh akhuhpeh in lengte kivaihom na danbuchu apen hiti chun leng achansahtan ahi. Thempupa Jehoiada leh achaten Joash chu thao anu vin chuleh mijouse chun “Lengpa hingsothen” tin asammun ahi
English: Then they brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, gave him the covenant, and made him king. Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and they said, “Long live the king!”

tcz: Athaliah chun lengpa thangvahna a kisam mipi Ogin husan chu ajah phatnin mipi dimsetna akikhopnao houinna chun ahung lhailutnin ahi.
en: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 23:12
Thadou: Athaliah chun lengpa thangvahna a kisam mipi Ogin husan chu ajah phatnin mipi dimsetna akikhopnao houinna chun ahung lhailutnin ahi.
English: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the LORD’s house.

tcz: Amanun agahven ahileh lengthah pachu Houin lutna khombul panga sepai lamkai holeh sumkon muthon ana umkimvel chu amun ahi. Ama lengchanna –a alopnaoleh akipapinao ogin chuleh semjang saipumma lasaholeh sumkon mutho ogin chu akithong jeju jengin ahi, hichun amanun asangkhol abot eh jengin, hiche hi “Lengmun chuna ahi, Lengmun chuna ahi” tin asamtaan ahi
en: Then she looked, and behold, the king stood by his pillar at the entrance, with the captains and the trumpeters by the king. All the people of the land rejoiced and blew trumpets. The singers also played musical instruments, and led the singing of praise. Then Athaliah tore her clothes, and said, “Treason! treason!”
text:
2CH 23:13
Thadou: Amanun agahven ahileh lengthah pachu Houin lutna khombul panga sepai lamkai holeh sumkon muthon ana umkimvel chu amun ahi. Ama lengchanna –a alopnaoleh akipapinao ogin chuleh semjang saipumma lasaholeh sumkon mutho ogin chu akithong jeju jengin ahi, hichun amanun asangkhol abot eh jengin, hiche hi “Lengmun chuna ahi, Lengmun chuna ahi” tin asamtaan ahi
English: Then she looked, and behold, the king stood by his pillar at the entrance, with the captains and the trumpeters by the king. All the people of the land rejoiced and blew trumpets. The singers also played musical instruments, and led the singing of praise. Then Athaliah tore her clothes, and said, “Treason! treason!”

tcz: Hichun Jehoiada thempupan amanuchu Houin sunga akitha ding chu adeipon hijeh chun sepai lamkai hochu aseipeh in “Amanu chu polanga kaidoh unlang koi hijongleh ama chu huhdoh go a umleh that jengun ati”
en: Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks; and whoever follows her, let him be slain with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t kill her in the LORD’s house.”
text:
2CH 23:14
Thadou: Hichun Jehoiada thempupan amanuchu Houin sunga akitha ding chu adeipon hijeh chun sepai lamkai hochu aseipeh in “Amanu chu polanga kaidoh unlang koi hijongleh ama chu huhdoh go a umleh that jengun ati”
English: Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks; and whoever follows her, let him be slain with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t kill her in the LORD’s house.”

tcz: Amahon amanuchu aman nun leng inpia apuijun sakol kelkot komma chun athat taovin ahi
en: So they made way for her. She went to the entrance of the horse gate to the king’s house; and they killed her there.
text:
2CH 23:15
Thadou: Amahon amanuchu aman nun leng inpia apuijun sakol kelkot komma chun athat taovin ahi
English: So they made way for her. She went to the entrance of the horse gate to the king’s house; and they killed her there.

tcz: Jehoiada thempupan Joash lengpa leh mipite chu akoukhomin Pakai mite ahijing nadiuvin kitepnakhat anei pitaan ahi
en: Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they should be the LORD’s people.
text:
2CH 23:16
Thadou: Jehoiada thempupan Joash lengpa leh mipite chu akoukhomin Pakai mite ahijing nadiuvin kitepnakhat anei pitaan ahi
English: Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they should be the LORD’s people.

tcz: Hijouchun Baal houinnah acheovin ajeplhu gamtaovin ahi. Amahon semthu Pathen holeh amaichamho jong avochip gamun Baal thempupa Mattan jong amaicham maijachun athat taovin ahi
en: All the people went to the house of Baal, broke it down, broke his altars and his images in pieces, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
text:
2CH 23:17
Thadou: Hijouchun Baal houinnah acheovin ajeplhu gamtaovin ahi. Amahon semthu Pathen holeh amaichamho jong avochip gamun Baal thempupa Mattan jong amaicham maijachun athat taovin ahi
English: All the people went to the house of Baal, broke it down, broke his altars and his images in pieces, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

tcz: Jehoiada in thempu holeh Levi techu Pakai houin na natoh na –a mopohna apen ahi. Amahohin Leng David nin angansenao kinhochu atohdiu Mose daan semtoh kitoh a Pakaiyin pumgo thilto gimnamtwi halnamna kin jong atohdiu ahi. amahohin tumging tothon golnop bolnajong mopohna alahdiu ahi
en: Jehoiada appointed the officers of the LORD’s house under the hand of the Levitical priests, whom David had distributed in the LORD’s house, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as David had ordered.
text:
2CH 23:18
Thadou: Jehoiada in thempu holeh Levi techu Pakai houin na natoh na –a mopohna apen ahi. Amahohin Leng David nin angansenao kinhochu atohdiu Mose daan semtoh kitoh a Pakaiyin pumgo thilto gimnamtwi halnamna kin jong atohdiu ahi. amahohin tumging tothon golnop bolnajong mopohna alahdiu ahi
English: Jehoiada appointed the officers of the LORD’s house under the hand of the Levitical priests, whom David had distributed in the LORD’s house, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as David had ordered.

tcz: Jehoiada in houin sunga hi miboh ho ahung lut louna ding avesuidingin houin kelkotna angahding akoiyin ahi
en: He set the gatekeepers at the gates of the LORD’s house, that no one who was unclean in anything should enter in.
text:
2CH 23:19
Thadou: Jehoiada in houin sunga hi miboh ho ahung lut louna ding avesuidingin houin kelkotna angahding akoiyin ahi
English: He set the gatekeepers at the gates of the LORD’s house, that no one who was unclean in anything should enter in.

tcz: Hitichun Jehoiada in sepai lamkaiho leh gamsunga mithupiho, gamvaipoholeh mihonpi ahinpuijin, chuin houinna kon in lengpachu ahinpuidohin kelkkot sahlang pa achun alut un leng in chu ajonlutnin, lengpa chu aleng gam laltouna a atousah taovin ahi
en: He took the captains of hundreds, the nobles, the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought the king down from the LORD’s house. They came through the upper gate to the king’s house, and set the king on the throne of the kingdom.
text:
2CH 23:20
Thadou: Hitichun Jehoiada in sepai lamkaiho leh gamsunga mithupiho, gamvaipoholeh mihonpi ahinpuijin, chuin houinna kon in lengpachu ahinpuidohin kelkkot sahlang pa achun alut un leng in chu ajonlutnin, lengpa chu aleng gam laltouna a atousah taovin ahi
English: He took the captains of hundreds, the nobles, the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought the king down from the LORD’s house. They came through the upper gate to the king’s house, and set the king on the throne of the kingdom.

tcz: Hichun gamsung mipite chu kipana leh thanop na – a adimsetnun chuleh khopi jong alung mong mongtaan ahi
en: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword.
text:
2CH 23:21
Thadou: Hichun gamsung mipite chu kipana leh thanop na – a adimsetnun chuleh khopi jong alung mong mongtaan ahi
English: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword.

tcz: Joash leng ahung chanchun kum 7 ahibepmin ahi, chuleh Jerusalemma chun kum somli vai anahomme, anuchu Beersheba khopia konna Zibiah kitinu chu ahi
en: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah, of Beersheba.
text:
2CH 24:1
Thadou: Joash leng ahung chanchun kum 7 ahibepmin ahi, chuleh Jerusalemma chun kum somli vai anahomme, anuchu Beersheba khopia konna Zibiah kitinu chu ahi
English: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah, of Beersheba.

tcz: Aman Jehoiada thempupa ahin laisen Pakai lungdei lam ngen ana bollin ahi
en: Joash did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
text:
2CH 24:2
Thadou: Aman Jehoiada thempupa ahin laisen Pakai lungdei lam ngen ana bollin ahi
English: Joash did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

tcz: Jehoiada in Joash lengpa chu ji ni apuipeh in ama nin chapa le chanuho ahinpeh lhonin ahi
en: Jehoiada took for him two wives, and he became the father of sons and daughters.
text:
2CH 24:3
Thadou: Jehoiada in Joash lengpa chu ji ni apuipeh in ama nin chapa le chanuho ahinpeh lhonin ahi
English: Jehoiada took for him two wives, and he became the father of sons and daughters.

tcz: Ama leng ahung chan phatchomkhat jouin Pathen Houin chu semphat ding ahin gotaan ahi
en: After this, Joash intended to restore the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 24:4
Thadou: Ama leng ahung chan phatchomkhat jouin Pathen Houin chu semphat ding ahin gotaan ahi
English: After this, Joash intended to restore the LORD’s house.

tcz: Aman thempu holeh Levite chu Judah khopihoa hi cheleova kumlhun seh a houin semphatna dinga mipi hojouse laha sum gadong dingin thupeh aneitaan ahi. Aman gang tah a tohpat jengdiuvin thu anapen ahi, ahivangin Levi miten gangtah in anatong panthei tapouvin ahi
en: He gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, “Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather money to repair the house of your God from all Israel from year to year. See that you expedite this matter.” However the Levites didn’t do it right away.
text:
2CH 24:5
Thadou: Aman thempu holeh Levite chu Judah khopihoa hi cheleova kumlhun seh a houin semphatna dinga mipi hojouse laha sum gadong dingin thupeh aneitaan ahi. Aman gang tah a tohpat jengdiuvin thu anapen ahi, ahivangin Levi miten gangtah in anatong panthei tapouvin ahi
English: He gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, “Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather money to repair the house of your God from all Israel from year to year. See that you expedite this matter.” However the Levites didn’t do it right away.

tcz: Hijechun Joash lengpan thempulen Jehoiada chu akouvin adongtan ahi, “Ipi dinga kumseh a houin semphatna dinga Pakai lhachapa Mosen mipiholah a sum dong dinga daan anasem dungjui ja thupeh kanei chu Levi ten Judah leh Jerusalemma agadon louvu ham? atin ahi
en: The king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said to him, “Why haven’t you required of the Levites to bring in the tax of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the assembly of Israel, out of Judah and out of Jerusalem, for the Tent of the Testimony?”
text:
2CH 24:6
Thadou: Hijechun Joash lengpan thempulen Jehoiada chu akouvin adongtan ahi, “Ipi dinga kumseh a houin semphatna dinga Pakai lhachapa Mosen mipiholah a sum dong dinga daan anasem dungjui ja thupeh kanei chu Levi ten Judah leh Jerusalemma agadon louvu ham? atin ahi
English: The king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said to him, “Why haven’t you required of the Levites to bring in the tax of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the assembly of Israel, out of Judah and out of Jerusalem, for the Tent of the Testimony?”

tcz: Ajeh chu miphalou numeinu Athaliah chaten houin chu avohsetnuva Pakai houin sunga thil theng hochu Baal doi houna – ana manna asuhboh ahi
en: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up God’s house; and they also gave all the dedicated things of the LORD’s house to the Baals.
text:
2CH 24:7
Thadou: Ajeh chu miphalou numeinu Athaliah chaten houin chu avohsetnuva Pakai houin sunga thil theng hochu Baal doi houna – ana manna asuhboh ahi
English: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up God’s house; and they also gave all the dedicated things of the LORD’s house to the Baals.

tcz: Hichun lengpa thupeh dungjuijin thingkhong khatchu Pakai Houin kelkot polanga chun akhaijun ahi
en: So the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it outside at the gate of the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 24:8
Thadou: Hichun lengpa thupeh dungjuijin thingkhong khatchu Pakai Houin kelkot polanga chun akhaijun ahi
English: So the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it outside at the gate of the LORD’s house.

tcz: Amahon Juda gamleh Jerusalem gampumpia thu athotnun Pathen lhacha pa Mose Pathenin gamthipma thu anapeh bang banga apehding chule atohdoh chehdiu ahi
en: They made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in for the LORD the tax that Moses the servant of God laid on Israel in the wilderness.
text:
2CH 24:9
Thadou: Amahon Juda gamleh Jerusalem gampumpia thu athotnun Pathen lhacha pa Mose Pathenin gamthipma thu anapeh bang banga apehding chule atohdoh chehdiu ahi
English: They made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in for the LORD the tax that Moses the servant of God laid on Israel in the wilderness.

tcz: Hijouchun lamkai hojouseleh mipi hojouse chun kipahleh thanom tah chehin atohdohdiu hochhu thingkhonga chun aga hong dimset jiovin ahi
en: All the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had filled it.
text:
2CH 24:10
Thadou: Hijouchun lamkai hojouseleh mipi hojouse chun kipahleh thanom tah chehin atohdohdiu hochhu thingkhonga chun aga hong dimset jiovin ahi
English: All the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had filled it.

tcz: Nisehleh Levi ten thingkhong chu hiche kinna amanchah lamkai ho khutna chun agapelut jiovin ahi. thingkhong chu adimphat phatleh lengpa secretary leh thempulen thaleng khatnin sum chu alahdoh lhonna thingkhong chu aum na – a alekoikit ji lhon ahi. hitichun amahon sumtamtah akholdoh taovin ahi
en: Whenever the chest was brought to the king’s officers by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king’s scribe and the chief priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to its place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
text:
2CH 24:11
Thadou: Nisehleh Levi ten thingkhong chu hiche kinna amanchah lamkai ho khutna chun agapelut jiovin ahi. thingkhong chu adimphat phatleh lengpa secretary leh thempulen thaleng khatnin sum chu alahdoh lhonna thingkhong chu aum na – a alekoikit ji lhon ahi. hitichun amahon sumtamtah akholdoh taovin ahi
English: Whenever the chest was brought to the king’s officers by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king’s scribe and the chief priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to its place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

tcz: Lengpaleh Jehoiada chun houin semphatnadinga mopohna neiho kommachun apelut jilhonin ahi. amaho chun houin semphatna dinga songkheng them holeh thingthem bolho chuleh thihkheng themho komma apehlutjiuvin ahi
en: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who did the work of the service of the LORD’s house. They hired masons and carpenters to restore the LORD’s house, and also those who worked iron and bronze to repair the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 24:12
Thadou: Lengpaleh Jehoiada chun houin semphatnadinga mopohna neiho kommachun apelut jilhonin ahi. amaho chun houin semphatna dinga songkheng them holeh thingthem bolho chuleh thihkheng themho komma apehlutjiuvin ahi
English: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who did the work of the service of the LORD’s house. They hired masons and carpenters to restore the LORD’s house, and also those who worked iron and bronze to repair the LORD’s house.

tcz: Natongho chun hatahin atongun houin chu dettah in akisah tilla tobang asodoh sahtaovin ahi
en: So the workmen worked, and the work of repairing went forward in their hands. They set up God’s house as it was designed, and strengthened it.
text:
2CH 24:13
Thadou: Natongho chun hatahin atongun houin chu dettah in akisah tilla tobang asodoh sahtaovin ahi
English: So the workmen worked, and the work of repairing went forward in their hands. They set up God’s house as it was designed, and strengthened it.

tcz: Asemphat chaiphatnun Sana leh Dangka avalhochu lengpaleh Jehoiada khutna apelutnun amanin Pakai houin na manchahding sana le dangka chu kong le bel semna in amang lhonnin ahi, Jehoiada hin laisen Pakai houin nah pumgo thilto tanglouvin aboljingun ahi
en: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, from which were made vessels for the LORD’s house, even vessels with which to minister and to offer, including spoons and vessels of gold and silver. They offered burnt offerings in the LORD’s house continually all the days of Jehoiada.
text:
2CH 24:14
Thadou: Asemphat chaiphatnun Sana leh Dangka avalhochu lengpaleh Jehoiada khutna apelutnun amanin Pakai houin na manchahding sana le dangka chu kong le bel semna in amang lhonnin ahi, Jehoiada hin laisen Pakai houin nah pumgo thilto tanglouvin aboljingun ahi
English: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, from which were made vessels for the LORD’s house, even vessels with which to minister and to offer, including spoons and vessels of gold and silver. They offered burnt offerings in the LORD’s house continually all the days of Jehoiada.

tcz: Jehoiada chu atehcheh tan kum jakhat le som thum alhingin athitan ahi
en: But Jehoiada grew old and was full of days, and he died. He was one hundred thirty years old when he died.
text:
2CH 24:15
Thadou: Jehoiada chu atehcheh tan kum jakhat le som thum alhingin athitan ahi
English: But Jehoiada grew old and was full of days, and he died. He was one hundred thirty years old when he died.

tcz: Amachu athiphatnin David khopia lengte kivuina – a avui taovin ahi, ajeh chu amahin Pakai Houin le Pathen dingin chuleh Israel mipite dingin thilpha anabollin ahi
en: They buried him in David’s city among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.
text:
2CH 24:16
Thadou: Amachu athiphatnin David khopia lengte kivuina – a avui taovin ahi, ajeh chu amahin Pakai Houin le Pathen dingin chuleh Israel mipite dingin thilpha anabollin ahi
English: They buried him in David’s city among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.

tcz: Jehoiada thinunghin Juda lamkaite ahungun lengpa komah chibai ahung bohun ahileh lengpan jong amaho thu angaitaan ahi
en: Now after the death of Jehoiada, the princes of Judah came and bowed down to the king. Then the king listened to them.
text:
2CH 24:17
Thadou: Jehoiada thinunghin Juda lamkaite ahungun lengpa komah chibai ahung bohun ahileh lengpan jong amaho thu angaitaan ahi
English: Now after the death of Jehoiada, the princes of Judah came and bowed down to the king. Then the king listened to them.

tcz: Hitichun amahon apu apateo Pakai Pathen chu adalhaovin semthu pathen leh doiho ahouvun hitia hi asuhkhel jeh'un Pathen lunghanna Judah le Jerusalem mite chunga ahung chutaan ahi
en: They abandoned the house of the LORD, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and the idols, so wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem for this their guiltiness.
text:
2CH 24:18
Thadou: Hitichun amahon apu apateo Pakai Pathen chu adalhaovin semthu pathen leh doiho ahouvun hitia hi asuhkhel jeh'un Pathen lunghanna Judah le Jerusalem mite chunga ahung chutaan ahi
English: They abandoned the house of the LORD, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and the idols, so wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem for this their guiltiness.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in Pakaiyin athemgao ho asollin amakom langa ahung kile kitnadiuvin gihnathu agasei sah in ahinla amaho ahung kilehei nompon ahi
en: Yet he sent prophets to them to bring them again to the LORD, and they testified against them; but they would not listen.
text:
2CH 24:19
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in Pakaiyin athemgao ho asollin amakom langa ahung kile kitnadiuvin gihnathu agasei sah in ahinla amaho ahung kilehei nompon ahi
English: Yet he sent prophets to them to bring them again to the LORD, and they testified against them; but they would not listen.

tcz: Hijouchun Pathen lhagaochu Jehoiada thempupa chapa Zechariah chungah ahung pansan ahileh amajong munsanga adingin hitihin ahin samtaan ahi: Pakai Pathenin hitihin aseije “Pakaiyin hitin aseije, “Nanghon ipi dinga thupeh hi nangai daova nachunguva hamsetna nakiloilut khummuham! nanghon Pathen nada lhahtao vin ahileh amanjong nadalha taove!” ati
en: The Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said to them, “God says, ‘Why do you disobey the LORD’s commandments, so that you can’t prosper? Because you have forsaken the LORD, he has also forsaken you.’”
text:
2CH 24:20
Thadou: Hijouchun Pathen lhagaochu Jehoiada thempupa chapa Zechariah chungah ahung pansan ahileh amajong munsanga adingin hitihin ahin samtaan ahi: Pakai Pathenin hitihin aseije “Pakaiyin hitin aseije, “Nanghon ipi dinga thupeh hi nangai daova nachunguva hamsetna nakiloilut khummuham! nanghon Pathen nada lhahtao vin ahileh amanjong nadalha taove!” ati
English: The Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said to them, “God says, ‘Why do you disobey the LORD’s commandments, so that you can’t prosper? Because you have forsaken the LORD, he has also forsaken you.’”

tcz: Lengpa Joash hin Zechariah dounan mipitoh akihoutohun, hitichun lengpa thupeh dungjuijin mipihon Pakai houin hongcha – a songin aseptaovin ahi
en: They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 24:21
Thadou: Lengpa Joash hin Zechariah dounan mipitoh akihoutohun, hitichun lengpa thupeh dungjuijin mipihon Pakai houin hongcha – a songin aseptaovin ahi
English: They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the LORD’s house.

tcz: Joash lengpan apa Jehoiada in itobang thilpha abolpeh tichu asumilhel jengin achapa chu athat tan ahi, Zechariah chun athikonnin “Pakai eibolnaohohi hinvenlang kaphu neihin lahpeh teijin” atin ahi
en: Thus Joash the king didn’t remember the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but killed his son. When he died, he said, “May the LORD look at it, and repay it.”
text:
2CH 24:22
Thadou: Joash lengpan apa Jehoiada in itobang thilpha abolpeh tichu asumilhel jengin achapa chu athat tan ahi, Zechariah chun athikonnin “Pakai eibolnaohohi hinvenlang kaphu neihin lahpeh teijin” atin ahi
English: Thus Joash the king didn’t remember the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but killed his son. When he died, he said, “May the LORD look at it, and repay it.”

tcz: Hiche kumchun nipi laijin Syria sepaiten Judah leh Jerusalem mite ahindel khummun alamkai hou athat gammun thiltamtah achomdohun Damascus lengpa agah thotnun ahi
en: At the end of the year, the army of the Syrians came up against him. They came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all their plunder to the king of Damascus.
text:
2CH 24:23
Thadou: Hiche kumchun nipi laijin Syria sepaiten Judah leh Jerusalem mite ahindel khummun alamkai hou athat gammun thiltamtah achomdohun Damascus lengpa agah thotnun ahi
English: At the end of the year, the army of the Syrians came up against him. They came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all their plunder to the king of Damascus.

tcz: Syria galmichu lhomcha bou ahi, ahinla Pakaiyin amaho sanga gamchenga tamjo Judahte chu ajosahin ahi ajeh chu amipi ten apu apa tao Pakai apathennu chu donlouvin anakoitaovin ahi. Hitichun Joash lengpa chunga chun Pathen thutanna analhung taan ahi
en: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men; and the LORD delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers. So they executed judgment on Joash.
text:
2CH 24:24
Thadou: Syria galmichu lhomcha bou ahi, ahinla Pakaiyin amaho sanga gamchenga tamjo Judahte chu ajosahin ahi ajeh chu amipi ten apu apa tao Pakai apathennu chu donlouvin anakoitaovin ahi. Hitichun Joash lengpa chunga chun Pathen thutanna analhung taan ahi
English: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men; and the LORD delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers. So they executed judgment on Joash.

tcz: Ama chu nasatah in akisuhkha tan chuleh agalmiten adalhah phat chun asepai lamkai teni akihoutoh lhonin alupna – a agathat lhon taan ahi. Jehoiada thempupa chapa anatha jeh a aphu ana lah lhon ahitai. amachu David khopia anavuijun ahi, ahinlah lengte kivuina mun ana hitapoi
en: When they had departed from him (for they left him seriously wounded), his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and killed him on his bed, and he died. They buried him in David’s city, but they didn’t bury him in the tombs of the kings.
text:
2CH 24:25
Thadou: Ama chu nasatah in akisuhkha tan chuleh agalmiten adalhah phat chun asepai lamkai teni akihoutoh lhonin alupna – a agathat lhon taan ahi. Jehoiada thempupa chapa anatha jeh a aphu ana lah lhon ahitai. amachu David khopia anavuijun ahi, ahinlah lengte kivuina mun ana hitapoi
English: When they had departed from him (for they left him seriously wounded), his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and killed him on his bed, and he died. They buried him in David’s city, but they didn’t bury him in the tombs of the kings.

tcz: Ama douna –a ana kihoutoh teni chu Ammon mi Shimeath chapa Zabad leh Moab mi Shimrith chapa Jehozabad ahi lhonne
en: These are those who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.
text:
2CH 24:26
Thadou: Ama douna –a ana kihoutoh teni chu Ammon mi Shimeath chapa Zabad leh Moab mi Shimrith chapa Jehozabad ahi lhonne
English: These are those who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.

tcz: Lengte lekhabu ah Joash chate thusim leh ama douna chung changa themgao thusei dohho chuleh houin ana sahphat thuho thusim ana kijih lut in ahi, ama khellin achapa Amaziah in vai ahin homtaan ahi
en: Now concerning his sons, the greatness of the burdens laid on him, and the rebuilding of God’s house, behold, they are written in the commentary of the book of the kings. Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
text:
2CH 24:27
Thadou: Lengte lekhabu ah Joash chate thusim leh ama douna chung changa themgao thusei dohho chuleh houin ana sahphat thuho thusim ana kijih lut in ahi, ama khellin achapa Amaziah in vai ahin homtaan ahi
English: Now concerning his sons, the greatness of the burdens laid on him, and the rebuilding of God’s house, behold, they are written in the commentary of the book of the kings. Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Amaziah hi leng ahung chan chun kum somni le nga alhingtaan ahi, amahin Jerusalemma kum somni le ko sungin vai anahomme. Anu chu Jerusalemma konna Jehoaddan ahi
en: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan, of Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 25:1
Thadou: Amaziah hi leng ahung chan chun kum somni le nga alhingtaan ahi, amahin Jerusalemma kum somni le ko sungin vai anahomme. Anu chu Jerusalemma konna Jehoaddan ahi
English: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan, of Jerusalem.

tcz: Amahin Pathen lunglhai na lamjeng anabollin ahinlah alungthim pumpi anapepon ahi
en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, but not with a perfect heart.
text:
2CH 25:2
Thadou: Amahin Pathen lunglhai na lamjeng anabollin ahinlah alungthim pumpi anapepon ahi
English: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, but not with a perfect heart.

tcz: Amahin athaneina ahin kisuhdet phatnin apa anathat sepai lamkai teni chu anathat nin ahi
en: Now when the kingdom was established to him, he killed his servants who had killed his father the king.
text:
2CH 25:3
Thadou: Amahin athaneina ahin kisuhdet phatnin apa anathat sepai lamkai teni chu anathat nin ahi
English: Now when the kingdom was established to him, he killed his servants who had killed his father the king.

tcz: Ahinlah achateo ana thapehpoi, aman Mose daanna kisei Pathenin Mose daanna kiseichu anajuijin ahi. Hicheachun achate thilse boljeh a apate kithat louding chuleh pate thilse boljeh a achate kithat louding daan chu anajui ahi, michu amatahin thilse abol jeh a bou kithat ding ahi
en: But he didn’t put their children to death, but did according to that which is written in the law in the book of Moses, as the LORD commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”
text:
2CH 25:4
Thadou: Ahinlah achateo ana thapehpoi, aman Mose daanna kisei Pathenin Mose daanna kiseichu anajuijin ahi. Hicheachun achate thilse boljeh a apate kithat louding chuleh pate thilse boljeh a achate kithat louding daan chu anajui ahi, michu amatahin thilse abol jeh a bou kithat ding ahi
English: But he didn’t put their children to death, but did according to that which is written in the law in the book of Moses, as the LORD commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

tcz: Lengpa Amaziah in Judah leh Benjamin phungsung asemtoh in aphung dungjuijin galsat thei sepai hochu sangkhat chunga vaihom jakhat chunga vaihom akoi jin ana gongtoh in ahi. Hiche hochu kum somni leh achung langho abonchaovin sang jathum (Lakh thum) alhing un ahi. Hiche hochu tengcha leh ompho mangcha – a galsatje themcheh lhentum hochu ahiove.
en: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together and ordered them according to their fathers’ houses, under captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, even all Judah and Benjamin. He counted them from twenty years old and upward, and found that there were three hundred thousand chosen men, able to go out to war, who could handle spear and shield.
text:
2CH 25:5
Thadou: Lengpa Amaziah in Judah leh Benjamin phungsung asemtoh in aphung dungjuijin galsat thei sepai hochu sangkhat chunga vaihom jakhat chunga vaihom akoi jin ana gongtoh in ahi. Hiche hochu kum somni leh achung langho abonchaovin sang jathum (Lakh thum) alhing un ahi. Hiche hochu tengcha leh ompho mangcha – a galsatje themcheh lhentum hochu ahiove.
English: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together and ordered them according to their fathers’ houses, under captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, even all Judah and Benjamin. He counted them from twenty years old and upward, and found that there were three hundred thousand chosen men, able to go out to war, who could handle spear and shield.

tcz: Hiche chungchon chun aman sepai sang jakhat (Lakh khat), dangka K.g 3400 (Sangthum le Jali) in Israel sepaiho achodoh in ahi.
en: He also hired one hundred thousand mighty men of valor out of Israel for one hundred talents of silver.
text:
2CH 25:6
Thadou: Hiche chungchon chun aman sepai sang jakhat (Lakh khat), dangka K.g 3400 (Sangthum le Jali) in Israel sepaiho achodoh in ahi.
English: He also hired one hundred thousand mighty men of valor out of Israel for one hundred talents of silver.

tcz: Ahinlah themgaokhat ache in lengpa kommah “Hiche Israel sepai hohi kilhonpi hihin agatin ahi. Sahlam leng gamma konna hunghohi Pathenin amangcha pouve agatin ahi.
en: A man of God came to him, saying, “O king, don’t let the army of Israel go with you, for the LORD is not with Israel, with all the children of Ephraim.
text:
2CH 25:7
Thadou: Ahinlah themgaokhat ache in lengpa kommah “Hiche Israel sepai hohi kilhonpi hihin agatin ahi. Sahlam leng gamma konna hunghohi Pathenin amangcha pouve agatin ahi.
English: A man of God came to him, saying, “O king, don’t let the army of Israel go with you, for the LORD is not with Israel, with all the children of Ephraim.

tcz: Nangin amahochu kimangcha leh galla kihatjepmin te nati ding ahin, ahinlah galjo leh gallel nahi Pathen khutna um ahibouvin aman nagalmite najopeh ding ahinai” atipeh in ahi.
en: But if you will go, take action, and be strong for the battle. God will overthrow you before the enemy; for God has power to help, and to overthrow.”
text:
2CH 25:8
Thadou: Nangin amahochu kimangcha leh galla kihatjepmin te nati ding ahin, ahinlah galjo leh gallel nahi Pathen khutna um ahibouvin aman nagalmite najopeh ding ahinai” atipeh in ahi.
English: But if you will go, take action, and be strong for the battle. God will overthrow you before the enemy; for God has power to help, and to overthrow.”

tcz: Amaziah chun themgaopa kommachun ‘Ahileh kasumpeh hochu itiding hitam?” atin ahileh Pakaiyin hiche sanga tamjo chu nahin lepehthei ahinai!” atipeh e.
en: Amaziah said to the man of God, “But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel?” The man of God answered, “The LORD is able to give you much more than this.”
text:
2CH 25:9
Thadou: Amaziah chun themgaopa kommachun ‘Ahileh kasumpeh hochu itiding hitam?” atin ahileh Pakaiyin hiche sanga tamjo chu nahin lepehthei ahinai!” atipeh e.
English: Amaziah said to the man of God, “But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel?” The man of God answered, “The LORD is able to give you much more than this.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Amaziah in a sepai chohsah hochu a inlang uva alesoltan ahileh amaho Juda mipiho chungah lunghang tahin a inlang nguvah akile taovin ahi.
en: Then Amaziah separated them, the army that had come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again. Therefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in fierce anger.
text:
2CH 25:10
Thadou: Hijeh chun Amaziah in a sepai chohsah hochu a inlang uva alesoltan ahileh amaho Juda mipiho chungah lunghang tahin a inlang nguvah akile taovin ahi.
English: Then Amaziah separated them, the army that had come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again. Therefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in fierce anger.

tcz: Amaziah amale ama akihan lhon Chikhuh phaicham machun a sepaite apuilutnin Edom sepaite chu akisatpin sangsom athatnin ahi.
en: Amaziah took courage, and led his people out and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the children of Seir.
text:
2CH 25:11
Thadou: Amaziah amale ama akihan lhon Chikhuh phaicham machun a sepaite apuilutnin Edom sepaite chu akisatpin sangsom athatnin ahi.
English: Amaziah took courage, and led his people out and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the children of Seir.

tcz: Chuleh adang sangsom jong galhingin amannin ahi. Agal hing amatnu chu Sela khopi kaldoh na – a apuitouvin aseplhaovin ahileh abonchaovin anoilanga song pi chunga achuovin abonnun athigam taovin ahi.
en: The children of Judah carried away ten thousand alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down from the top of the rock, so that they all were broken in pieces.
text:
2CH 25:12
Thadou: Chuleh adang sangsom jong galhingin amannin ahi. Agal hing amatnu chu Sela khopi kaldoh na – a apuitouvin aseplhaovin ahileh abonchaovin anoilanga song pi chunga achuovin abonnun athigam taovin ahi.
English: The children of Judah carried away ten thousand alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down from the top of the rock, so that they all were broken in pieces.

tcz: Alangkhatnah Israel sepaite Amaziah in galla akonpi nomlou anungsol houchun Samaria leh Ben Horon kikah a um Judah khopi hochu adekhummun mi 3000 lang athatnun thiltamtah jong achomdoh un ahi
en: But the men of the army whom Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell on the cities of Judah from Samaria even to Beth Horon, and struck of them three thousand, and took much plunder.
text:
2CH 25:13
Thadou: Alangkhatnah Israel sepaite Amaziah in galla akonpi nomlou anungsol houchun Samaria leh Ben Horon kikah a um Judah khopi hochu adekhummun mi 3000 lang athatnun thiltamtah jong achomdoh un ahi
English: But the men of the army whom Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell on the cities of Judah from Samaria even to Beth Horon, and struck of them three thousand, and took much plunder.

tcz: Amaziah in Edom mite agajo a ahung kileochun adoibom houchu ahin polutnun akitunun gim namtwi alhutnammun Pathen houvin ahou taovin ahi.
en: Now after Amaziah had come from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them and burned incense to them.
text:
2CH 25:14
Thadou: Amaziah in Edom mite agajo a ahung kileochun adoibom houchu ahin polutnun akitunun gim namtwi alhutnammun Pathen houvin ahou taovin ahi.
English: Now after Amaziah had come from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them and burned incense to them.

tcz: Hiche athilbol hin Pathen asulung hanglheh tan hijeh chun aman a themgaopao chu Amaziah kommah asollin hitin agaseije “Nang thaneina a kon jengajong amite huhdoh joulou pathen ho chu nangin ibola nahou ham?” agatisah in ahi
en: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against Amaziah, and he sent to him a prophet who said to him, “Why have you sought after the gods of the people, which have not delivered their own people out of your hand?”
text:
2CH 25:15
Thadou: Hiche athilbol hin Pathen asulung hanglheh tan hijeh chun aman a themgaopao chu Amaziah kommah asollin hitin agaseije “Nang thaneina a kon jengajong amite huhdoh joulou pathen ho chu nangin ibola nahou ham?” agatisah in ahi
English: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against Amaziah, and he sent to him a prophet who said to him, “Why have you sought after the gods of the people, which have not delivered their own people out of your hand?”

tcz: Amaziah chun themgaopa thusei chu asutangin lunghantah in ahin donbutnin “Nanghi itih a chu lengpa thuhil dinga naki pansah be hem?” thipmin achuti louleh nanghi kahin thatei ding nahi! atin ahi. Hichun themgaopa chu athiptai, ahinlah gihna thuhohi aseidoh mannin ahi, “Nangin kahilna ho jouse chu na nahsah loujeh in Pathenin nanghi nasuhmang got ahitai tihi kahetai” ati
en: As he talked with him, the king said to him, “Have we made you one of the king’s counselors? Stop! Why should you be struck down?” Then the prophet stopped, and said, “I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel.”
text:
2CH 25:16
Thadou: Amaziah chun themgaopa thusei chu asutangin lunghantah in ahin donbutnin “Nanghi itih a chu lengpa thuhil dinga naki pansah be hem?” thipmin achuti louleh nanghi kahin thatei ding nahi! atin ahi. Hichun themgaopa chu athiptai, ahinlah gihna thuhohi aseidoh mannin ahi, “Nangin kahilna ho jouse chu na nahsah loujeh in Pathenin nanghi nasuhmang got ahitai tihi kahetai” ati
English: As he talked with him, the king said to him, “Have we made you one of the king’s counselors? Stop! Why should you be struck down?” Then the prophet stopped, and said, “I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel.”

tcz: Judahte lengpa Amaziah in ama thuhilla pangho thu chu alaan Israel tetoh kisat dingin tohgon ahin neitai. hitichun, aman Israel lengpa Jehoahaz chapa chuleh Jehu tupa Jehoash komma chun thu ahin thottan kisat tou hite tin ahin chouvin ahi
en: Then Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come! Let’s look one another in the face.”
text:
2CH 25:17
Thadou: Judahte lengpa Amaziah in ama thuhilla pangho thu chu alaan Israel tetoh kisat dingin tohgon ahin neitai. hitichun, aman Israel lengpa Jehoahaz chapa chuleh Jehu tupa Jehoash komma chun thu ahin thottan kisat tou hite tin ahin chouvin ahi
English: Then Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come! Let’s look one another in the face.”

tcz: Jehoash chun Amaziah kommah adonbutnin alethotnin “Khatvei hi Lebanon Molhoa kon in lingthing phung khatnin Cedar thingphung kommah “Kachapa jidingin nachanu chu neihin pen atin ahileh gamsakhat ahungvah len lingphung chu ahung pal bongtaan ahi
en: Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as his wife. Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled down the thistle.
text:
2CH 25:18
Thadou: Jehoash chun Amaziah kommah adonbutnin alethotnin “Khatvei hi Lebanon Molhoa kon in lingthing phung khatnin Cedar thingphung kommah “Kachapa jidingin nachanu chu neihin pen atin ahileh gamsakhat ahungvah len lingphung chu ahung pal bongtaan ahi
English: Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as his wife. Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled down the thistle.

tcz: Tun Amaziah nangin Edom mite najomannin nakilet sah tai ahinlah na in na nakitou thimbeh dinga kaseipeh nahi. nangman na mite manthahna dingbep ma mi nachouham?
en: You say to yourself that you have struck Edom; and your heart lifts you up to boast. Now stay at home. Why should you meddle with trouble, that you should fall, even you and Judah with you?’”
text:
2CH 25:19
Thadou: Tun Amaziah nangin Edom mite najomannin nakilet sah tai ahinlah na in na nakitou thimbeh dinga kaseipeh nahi. nangman na mite manthahna dingbep ma mi nachouham?
English: You say to yourself that you have struck Edom; and your heart lifts you up to boast. Now stay at home. Why should you meddle with trouble, that you should fall, even you and Judah with you?’”

tcz: Ahinlah Amaziah chun mithusei angaipon ahi Edom mite doihou hochu aman jong ahin houphat na Pathenin amachu gal alelsah got ahi
en: But Amaziah would not listen; for it was of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they had sought after the gods of Edom.
text:
2CH 25:20
Thadou: Ahinlah Amaziah chun mithusei angaipon ahi Edom mite doihou hochu aman jong ahin houphat na Pathenin amachu gal alelsah got ahi
English: But Amaziah would not listen; for it was of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they had sought after the gods of Edom.

tcz: Hitichun Israel lengpa Jehoash chu Judah lengpa Amaziah toh kisat dingin ahung kondoh tan ahi. Amaho chu Judah gamma Beth – Shemesh munnah akimai touvin ahi
en: So Joash king of Israel went up, and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
text:
2CH 25:21
Thadou: Hitichun Israel lengpa Jehoash chu Judah lengpa Amaziah toh kisat dingin ahung kondoh tan ahi. Amaho chu Judah gamma Beth – Shemesh munnah akimai touvin ahi
English: So Joash king of Israel went up, and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

tcz: Judah Sepaiten alellun a inlanguvah ajam gamtaovin ahi
en: Judah was defeated by Israel; so every man fled to his tent.
text:
2CH 25:22
Thadou: Judah Sepaiten alellun a inlanguvah ajam gamtaovin ahi
English: Judah was defeated by Israel; so every man fled to his tent.

tcz: Jehoash in Amaziah chu amannin Jerusalem langah akaitaan ahi. Hichun aman Jerusalem kulpi palchu Ephraim kelkot phunga pat kulpi ning kelkot phung geijin tong jali jen avochimtai
en: Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
text:
2CH 25:23
Thadou: Jehoash in Amaziah chu amannin Jerusalem langah akaitaan ahi. Hichun aman Jerusalem kulpi palchu Ephraim kelkot phunga pat kulpi ning kelkot phung geijin tong jali jen avochimtai
English: Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

tcz: Aman Pathen Houin sunga kon in Sana le dangka chuleh thiljouse chu abonchan akichomdoh in, angahpa Obed – Edom jongchu amat than chuleh lengpa in na thilgun hojouse jong achommin chuleh ahingin miphabep jong Samaria langah akai taovin ahi
en: He took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in God’s house with Obed-Edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.
text:
2CH 25:24
Thadou: Aman Pathen Houin sunga kon in Sana le dangka chuleh thiljouse chu abonchan akichomdoh in, angahpa Obed – Edom jongchu amat than chuleh lengpa in na thilgun hojouse jong achommin chuleh ahingin miphabep jong Samaria langah akai taovin ahi
English: He took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in God’s house with Obed-Edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.

tcz: Judah lengpa Joash chapa Amaziah Israel lengpa Jehoahaz chapa Joash thijouvin kum 15 ahing nalaijjin ahi
en: Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived for fifteen years after the death of Joash, son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.
text:
2CH 25:25
Thadou: Judah lengpa Joash chapa Amaziah Israel lengpa Jehoahaz chapa Joash thijouvin kum 15 ahing nalaijjin ahi
English: Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived for fifteen years after the death of Joash, son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.

tcz: Amaziah vaihom akipatna pat akichai geija anatoh athilbol hojouse chu Judah le Israel lengte thusim kijih lutna lekha bua chun aumsoh keijin ahi
en: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, aren’t they written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?
text:
2CH 25:26
Thadou: Amaziah vaihom akipatna pat akichai geija anatoh athilbol hojouse chu Judah le Israel lengte thusim kijih lutna lekha bua chun aumsoh keijin ahi
English: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, aren’t they written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

tcz: Amaziah Pakaija konna ahung kiheimanga kon in Jerusalem ama dounan tohgon ahung umtaan ahileh ama Lachish lamma ajam taan ahi ahinlah amahon Lachish lamma mi asollun hichea chun ahin that taovin ahi
en: Now from the time that Amaziah turned away from following the LORD, they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem. He fled to Lachish, but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.
text:
2CH 25:27
Thadou: Amaziah Pakaija konna ahung kiheimanga kon in Jerusalem ama dounan tohgon ahung umtaan ahileh ama Lachish lamma ajam taan ahi ahinlah amahon Lachish lamma mi asollun hichea chun ahin that taovin ahi
English: Now from the time that Amaziah turned away from following the LORD, they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem. He fled to Lachish, but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

tcz: Hichun amahon sakol lah ahin pouvin Judah khopi ah apu apa te kivuina – a avui taove
en: They brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.
text:
2CH 25:28
Thadou: Hichun amahon sakol lah ahin pouvin Judah khopi ah apu apa te kivuina – a avui taove
English: They brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.

tcz: Judah mipiten Amaziah chapa Uzziah chu kum 16 alhin kummin apakhellin leng achan sahtaovin ahi
en: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.
text:
2CH 26:1
Thadou: Judah mipiten Amaziah chapa Uzziah chu kum 16 alhin kummin apakhellin leng achan sahtaovin ahi
English: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

tcz: Apa Amaziah athijou chun Uzziah in Elath anung lahpeh kitnin akhopi chu asempha kitnin ahi
en: He built Eloth and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.
text:
2CH 26:2
Thadou: Apa Amaziah athijou chun Uzziah in Elath anung lahpeh kitnin akhopi chu asempha kitnin ahi
English: He built Eloth and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.

tcz: Uzziah leng ahung chanchun kum 16 alhingtan ahi chuleh aman Jerusalem machun kum 52 sungin vai anahommin ahi. Anuchu Jerusalemma konna Jecoliah kitinu chu ahi
en: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jechiliah, of Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 26:3
Thadou: Uzziah leng ahung chanchun kum 16 alhingtan ahi chuleh aman Jerusalem machun kum 52 sungin vai anahommin ahi. Anuchu Jerusalemma konna Jecoliah kitinu chu ahi
English: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jechiliah, of Jerusalem.

tcz: Apa umdaan chu anachepi in Pathen deilam jong ana bollin ahi
en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
text:
2CH 26:4
Thadou: Apa umdaan chu anachepi in Pathen deilam jong ana bollin ahi
English: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

tcz: Houlanga ana puihoijah Zechariah anahin leisen Pakai chu kitahna neitah in anajuijin ahileh Pathenin jong phatthei ana bohin ahi
en: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him prosper.
text:
2CH 26:5
Thadou: Houlanga ana puihoijah Zechariah anahin leisen Pakai chu kitahna neitah in anajuijin ahileh Pathenin jong phatthei ana bohin ahi
English: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him prosper.

tcz: Uzziah in Philistine te dounan gal anasatnin ahi. Aman Gath, Jemniah leh Ashdod khopi kulpi hochu ana volhun hijouchun
en: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
text:
2CH 26:6
Thadou: Uzziah in Philistine te dounan gal anasatnin ahi. Aman Gath, Jemniah leh Ashdod khopi kulpi hochu ana volhun hijouchun
English: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

tcz: Pathen panpi najallin Philistine te Gur – Baal a cheng Arabians Mehunins mite ana jouvin ahi
en: God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and the Meunim.
text:
2CH 26:7
Thadou: Pathen panpi najallin Philistine te Gur – Baal a cheng Arabians Mehunins mite ana jouvin ahi
English: God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and the Meunim.

tcz: Amon miten jong Uzziah kommah kai anapeovin hitichun amahi ahung hatdoh lheh jengtaan ahileh Egypt gamsung geijin ana minthang pehin ahi
en: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah. His name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt, for he grew exceedingly strong.
text:
2CH 26:8
Thadou: Amon miten jong Uzziah kommah kai anapeovin hitichun amahi ahung hatdoh lheh jengtaan ahileh Egypt gamsung geijin ana minthang pehin ahi
English: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah. His name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt, for he grew exceedingly strong.

tcz: Uzziah in Jerusalem ninglang kelkot leh phaicham lang kelkot chuleh kulpi pal kihei konna munho jouse chunga chun insang asadohin hitihin khopi kulpi chu anasudet soh keijin ahi
en: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.
text:
2CH 26:9
Thadou: Uzziah in Jerusalem ninglang kelkot leh phaicham lang kelkot chuleh kulpi pal kihei konna munho jouse chunga chun insang asadohin hitihin khopi kulpi chu anasudet soh keijin ahi
English: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.

tcz: Aman gam ong lah a jenga jong kulpi dingin insang ho anasan chuleh twiputna dingin mun tamtah analaijin, lhumlam molpang holeh phaicham mah gancha tamtah ana vah'in ahi. aman mipi hojong lengpilei boldingin atilkhouvin thinglhang louphat na hoa jong lou abolsah in ahi
en: He built towers in the wilderness, and dug out many cisterns, for he had much livestock, both in the lowlands and in the plains. He had farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fruitful fields, for he loved farming.
text:
2CH 26:10
Thadou: Aman gam ong lah a jenga jong kulpi dingin insang ho anasan chuleh twiputna dingin mun tamtah analaijin, lhumlam molpang holeh phaicham mah gancha tamtah ana vah'in ahi. aman mipi hojong lengpilei boldingin atilkhouvin thinglhang louphat na hoa jong lou abolsah in ahi
English: He built towers in the wilderness, and dug out many cisterns, for he had much livestock, both in the lowlands and in the plains. He had farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fruitful fields, for he loved farming.

tcz: Aman galmi tamtah galsat dinga kigosadem ho aneiyin, ama ho record chu leng insungmi sepai lamkai Hananiah vetsui nanoija thuching teni Jeiel leh Maaseiah in ajihlut lhonin ahi
en: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.
text:
2CH 26:11
Thadou: Aman galmi tamtah galsat dinga kigosadem ho aneiyin, ama ho record chu leng insungmi sepai lamkai Hananiah vetsui nanoija thuching teni Jeiel leh Maaseiah in ajihlut lhonin ahi
English: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.

tcz: A sepai techu sepai lamkai 2600 (Sangni le jagup) ho thupeh nanoija um ahiove
en: The whole number of the heads of fathers’ households, even the mighty men of valor, was two thousand six hundred.
text:
2CH 26:12
Thadou: A sepai techu sepai lamkai 2600 (Sangni le jagup) ho thupeh nanoija um ahiove
English: The whole number of the heads of fathers’ households, even the mighty men of valor, was two thousand six hundred.

tcz: Amaho noija lengpa huhna dinga thanei tah a galsat thei sepai 307500 (Lakh thumle sang sagi le ja nga) aneiyin ahi
en: Under their hand was an army, three hundred seven thousand five hundred, who made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
text:
2CH 26:13
Thadou: Amaho noija lengpa huhna dinga thanei tah a galsat thei sepai 307500 (Lakh thumle sang sagi le ja nga) aneiyin ahi
English: Under their hand was an army, three hundred seven thousand five hundred, who made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

tcz: Uzziah sepai hijat dingin ompho, tengcha thihlukhuh asempeh in, thalpi jong asempeh in song sena bomjong asem peh in achang ding jong alokhom peh in ahi
en: Uzziah prepared for them, even for all the army, shields, spears, helmets, coats of mail, bows, and stones for slinging.
text:
2CH 26:14
Thadou: Uzziah sepai hijat dingin ompho, tengcha thihlukhuh asempeh in, thalpi jong asempeh in song sena bomjong asem peh in achang ding jong alokhom peh in ahi
English: Uzziah prepared for them, even for all the army, shields, spears, helmets, coats of mail, bows, and stones for slinging.

tcz: Jerusalem khopiah khopi pal chunga konna songlentah tah sedoh thei nading leh thal kapdoh theinading manchah semthemho agoijin ahi. Aman Pathenna konna panpina amujeh in athahat na akijesallin gamtinnah amin thang lheh jengtaan ahi
en: In Jerusalem, he made devices, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the battlements, with which to shoot arrows and great stones. His name spread far abroad, because he was marvelously helped until he was strong.
text:
2CH 26:15
Thadou: Jerusalem khopiah khopi pal chunga konna songlentah tah sedoh thei nading leh thal kapdoh theinading manchah semthemho agoijin ahi. Aman Pathenna konna panpina amujeh in athahat na akijesallin gamtinnah amin thang lheh jengtaan ahi
English: In Jerusalem, he made devices, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the battlements, with which to shoot arrows and great stones. His name spread far abroad, because he was marvelously helped until he was strong.

tcz: Uzziah lengpa hi ahung hatdoh phatnin ahung kiletsah taan hiche hin a lhuhnading lampi ahin gongdoh taan ahi. Aman a Pakai a Pathen dou na in houin nah alutnin maicham muntheng ngachun gimnamtwi ahal gotaan ahi
en: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly and he trespassed against the LORD his God, for he went into the LORD’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.
text:
2CH 26:16
Thadou: Uzziah lengpa hi ahung hatdoh phatnin ahung kiletsah taan hiche hin a lhuhnading lampi ahin gongdoh taan ahi. Aman a Pakai a Pathen dou na in houin nah alutnin maicham muntheng ngachun gimnamtwi ahal gotaan ahi
English: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly and he trespassed against the LORD his God, for he went into the LORD’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.

tcz: Thempupa Azariah chu mithahat lehmihang san cheh thempu hotoh akilhon nin lengpa chu ajui taovin
en: Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him eighty priests of the LORD, who were valiant men.
text:
2CH 26:17
Thadou: Thempupa Azariah chu mithahat lehmihang san cheh thempu hotoh akilhon nin lengpa chu ajui taovin
English: Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him eighty priests of the LORD, who were valiant men.

tcz: Ama suhtang nading chun hitin aphoh un ahi “Uzziah! nangin Pakai dinga gimnam twi nahal nading tha nanei poi, Aaron chilhah hitobang boldinga kisutheng thempu honbou abol diu ahi hiche munthenga konhin potdoh'in nangin Pakai Pathen doumah nabol jeh a hi a malsomna nachan jou louding ahitai” atiovin ahi.
en: They resisted Uzziah the king, and said to him, “It isn’t for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the LORD, but for the priests the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to burn incense. Go out of the sanctuary, for you have trespassed. It will not be for your honor from the LORD God.”
text:
2CH 26:18
Thadou: Ama suhtang nading chun hitin aphoh un ahi “Uzziah! nangin Pakai dinga gimnam twi nahal nading tha nanei poi, Aaron chilhah hitobang boldinga kisutheng thempu honbou abol diu ahi hiche munthenga konhin potdoh'in nangin Pakai Pathen doumah nabol jeh a hi a malsomna nachan jou louding ahitai” atiovin ahi.
English: They resisted Uzziah the king, and said to him, “It isn’t for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the LORD, but for the priests the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to burn incense. Go out of the sanctuary, for you have trespassed. It will not be for your honor from the LORD God.”

tcz: Uzziah chun gimnamtwi halnachu achoijin houin sunga maicham panga chun adingin ahi. Ama thempu ho chunga ahung lunghang jahjeng phat chun tiphah khohtah chu adeh panga ahung chutaan ahi
en: Then Uzziah was angry. He had a censer in his hand to burn incense, and while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy broke out on his forehead before the priests in the LORD’s house, beside the altar of incense.
text:
2CH 26:19
Thadou: Uzziah chun gimnamtwi halnachu achoijin houin sunga maicham panga chun adingin ahi. Ama thempu ho chunga ahung lunghang jahjeng phat chun tiphah khohtah chu adeh panga ahung chutaan ahi
English: Then Uzziah was angry. He had a censer in his hand to burn incense, and while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy broke out on his forehead before the priests in the LORD’s house, beside the altar of incense.

tcz: Azariah leh thempu dang hochun lengpa dehpang chu tijatah'in aveovin ahi, hijouchun amachu houinna kon in anodoh tho taovin ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin ama chu ajep ahi tai
en: Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him, and behold, he was leprous in his forehead; and they thrust him out quickly from there. Indeed, he himself also hurried to go out, because the LORD had struck him.
text:
2CH 26:20
Thadou: Azariah leh thempu dang hochun lengpa dehpang chu tijatah'in aveovin ahi, hijouchun amachu houinna kon in anodoh tho taovin ahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin ama chu ajep ahi tai
English: Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him, and behold, he was leprous in his forehead; and they thrust him out quickly from there. Indeed, he himself also hurried to go out, because the LORD had struck him.

tcz: Uzziah lengpachu hiche phahna jehhin ahinkho lhung keijin dandung juiyin thenglou vin aumtaan ahi. Houin sung lelut kit thei louvin aleng hi na a akin tongthei talouvin a in'ah achuti umtaan achapa Jotham min ama khellin agam sunga vai ahomtaan ahi
en: Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the LORD’s house. Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.
text:
2CH 26:21
Thadou: Uzziah lengpachu hiche phahna jehhin ahinkho lhung keijin dandung juiyin thenglou vin aumtaan ahi. Houin sung lelut kit thei louvin aleng hi na a akin tongthei talouvin a in'ah achuti umtaan achapa Jotham min ama khellin agam sunga vai ahomtaan ahi
English: Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the LORD’s house. Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

tcz: Uzziah avaihom sunga atoh ho jouse chu Amoz chapa themgao Isaiah in ajihlut soh keijin ahi
en: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.
text:
2CH 26:22
Thadou: Uzziah avaihom sunga atoh ho jouse chu Amoz chapa themgao Isaiah in ajihlut soh keijin ahi
English: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.

tcz: Uzziah athi phatnin lengte kivuina gamsunga avuijun ahinlah aphah jeh chun lengte kivui na lhan navang avui tapouve. Achapa Jotham min aleng mun chu alo taan ahi
en: So Uzziah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings, for they said, “He is a leper.” Jotham his son reigned in his place.
text:
2CH 26:23
Thadou: Uzziah athi phatnin lengte kivuina gamsunga avuijun ahinlah aphah jeh chun lengte kivui na lhan navang avui tapouve. Achapa Jotham min aleng mun chu alo taan ahi
English: So Uzziah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings, for they said, “He is a leper.” Jotham his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Jotham chu kum 25 alhinin leng ahung changing Jerusalem mah kum 16 sungin vai ahom min ahi. Anuchu Zadok chanu Jerushah ahi
en: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.
text:
2CH 27:1
Thadou: Jotham chu kum 25 alhinin leng ahung changing Jerusalem mah kum 16 sungin vai ahom min ahi. Anuchu Zadok chanu Jerushah ahi
English: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.

tcz: Ahin apa bang bangin Pakai deilam jeng anabollin ahi, ahinlah apa bangin Hou –in sunga gim namtwi ana halpon ahi. Ahijeng vang'in mipi hochun chonset bol anache lha jingun ahi
en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that his father Uzziah had done. However he didn’t enter into the LORD’s temple. The people still acted corruptly.
text:
2CH 27:2
Thadou: Ahin apa bang bangin Pakai deilam jeng anabollin ahi, ahinlah apa bangin Hou –in sunga gim namtwi ana halpon ahi. Ahijeng vang'in mipi hochun chonset bol anache lha jingun ahi
English: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that his father Uzziah had done. However he didn’t enter into the LORD’s temple. The people still acted corruptly.

tcz: Jotham hin houin kelkotsah lang chu anasemphan chuleh Ophel kiti khopi bang chunga thil lentah anatong doh in ahi
en: He built the upper gate of the LORD’s house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.
text:
2CH 27:3
Thadou: Jotham hin houin kelkotsah lang chu anasemphan chuleh Ophel kiti khopi bang chunga thil lentah anatong doh in ahi
English: He built the upper gate of the LORD’s house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.

tcz: Hiche bannajong chun aman Judah molchunga jong khopi tamtah ana sadoh in ahi, chuleh gammang lammajong kulpi leh insang tamtah anasadoh in ahi
en: Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.
text:
2CH 27:4
Thadou: Hiche bannajong chun aman Judah molchunga jong khopi tamtah ana sadoh in ahi, chuleh gammang lammajong kulpi leh insang tamtah anasadoh in ahi
English: Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.

tcz: Amahin Amon mite lengpa ana kisat pin anajouvin ahi, hichea kon in Ammon miten kumthum sungin kai hohi ana peovin ahi: Dangka k.g 3400 (Sang thumle jail), suhlou chang Matricton 100, Sakol chang 100
en: He also fought with the king of the children of Ammon, and prevailed against them. The children of Ammon gave him the same year one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat, and ten thousand cors of barley. The children of Ammon also gave that much to him in the second year, and in the third.
text:
2CH 27:5
Thadou: Amahin Amon mite lengpa ana kisat pin anajouvin ahi, hichea kon in Ammon miten kumthum sungin kai hohi ana peovin ahi: Dangka k.g 3400 (Sang thumle jail), suhlou chang Matricton 100, Sakol chang 100
English: He also fought with the king of the children of Ammon, and prevailed against them. The children of Ammon gave him the same year one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat, and ten thousand cors of barley. The children of Ammon also gave that much to him in the second year, and in the third.

tcz: Jotham min kitahna neitah in Pakai Pathen thu ana ngaijin ahung hatdoh cheh jengtaan ahi
en: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God.
text:
2CH 27:6
Thadou: Jotham min kitahna neitah in Pakai Pathen thu ana ngaijin ahung hatdoh cheh jengtaan ahi
English: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God.

tcz: Jotham min avaihom sunga agalsatna, avaihom ahinkho sunga thilsoh jouse Israel leh Judah thusim bua kijihlutsoh keijin ahi
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
text:
2CH 27:7
Thadou: Jotham min avaihom sunga agalsatna, avaihom ahinkho sunga thilsoh jouse Israel leh Judah thusim bua kijihlutsoh keijin ahi
English: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

tcz: Jotham chu leng ahung chanchun kum 25 alhingtaan ahi, aman kum 6 sungin vai anahomin ahi
en: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 27:8
Thadou: Jotham chu leng ahung chanchun kum 25 alhingtaan ahi, aman kum 6 sungin vai anahomin ahi
English: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

tcz: Ama athiphatnin David khopi a avuijun achapa Ahaz apa khellin leng achangin ahi
en: Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
text:
2CH 27:9
Thadou: Ama athiphatnin David khopi a avuijun achapa Ahaz apa khellin leng achangin ahi
English: Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Ahaz hi leng ahungchan chun kum 20 alhingtaan ahi, amahin kum 16 sungin Jerusalemma vai anahomin ahi. Amahin apa Davidnin ana bolbangin Pakai mitmun thildih anabol pon ahi
en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, like David his father,
text:
2CH 28:1
Thadou: Ahaz hi leng ahungchan chun kum 20 alhingtaan ahi, amahin kum 16 sungin Jerusalemma vai anahomin ahi. Amahin apa Davidnin ana bolbangin Pakai mitmun thildih anabol pon ahi
English: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, like David his father,

tcz: Amahin Israel lengte chondaan nin anachonin Baal doi lim ho anasemdoh in ahi
en: but he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molten images for the Baals.
text:
2CH 28:2
Thadou: Amahin Israel lengte chondaan nin anachonin Baal doi lim ho anasemdoh in ahi
English: but he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molten images for the Baals.

tcz: Amahin hinnom chapa phaigamma chun gimnamtwi meiya analhut nammin, achate meijah anagouvin doi houna in pumgo thiltonan anamangin, Israel te hung kijotna gamma konna Pakaiin ana nodoh nam mite chonna kidah umtah chonnin ana chonnin ahi
en: Moreover he burned incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burned his children in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
text:
2CH 28:3
Thadou: Amahin hinnom chapa phaigamma chun gimnamtwi meiya analhut nammin, achate meijah anagouvin doi houna in pumgo thiltonan anamangin, Israel te hung kijotna gamma konna Pakaiin ana nodoh nam mite chonna kidah umtah chonnin ana chonnin ahi
English: Moreover he burned incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burned his children in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

tcz: Aman munsang dungleh, molchung dungah chuleh thingphung noi tinnah pumgo thilto ana bollin gimnamtwi analhut nammin ahi
en: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
text:
2CH 28:4
Thadou: Aman munsang dungleh, molchung dungah chuleh thingphung noi tinnah pumgo thilto ana bollin gimnamtwi analhut nammin ahi
English: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

tcz: Hitobanga achonphat ahin Pakai Pathennin Syria lengpa khutnah anapeh dohtaan ahi. Amahon ajophatnin mitamtah gal hingin ahin kaijun Damascas lang alhut taove hiche jouchun amachu Israel lengpa khutna pehlut nin aummin Ahaz in gal alaltaan mitamtah jong athiovin ahi
en: Therefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. They struck him, and carried away from him a great multitude of captives, and brought them to Damascus. He was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.
text:
2CH 28:5
Thadou: Hitobanga achonphat ahin Pakai Pathennin Syria lengpa khutnah anapeh dohtaan ahi. Amahon ajophatnin mitamtah gal hingin ahin kaijun Damascas lang alhut taove hiche jouchun amachu Israel lengpa khutna pehlut nin aummin Ahaz in gal alaltaan mitamtah jong athiovin ahi
English: Therefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. They struck him, and carried away from him a great multitude of captives, and brought them to Damascus. He was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.

tcz: Ramaliah chapa Pekah chun Judah techu nikhat sungin mihangsan cheh 120,000 athat nin ahi, ajeh chu amahon apu apateo Pakai Pathen chu anasuh mil jeh u ahi
en: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed in Judah one hundred twenty thousand in one day, all of them valiant men, because they had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers.
text:
2CH 28:6
Thadou: Ramaliah chapa Pekah chun Judah techu nikhat sungin mihangsan cheh 120,000 athat nin ahi, ajeh chu amahon apu apateo Pakai Pathen chu anasuh mil jeh u ahi
English: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed in Judah one hundred twenty thousand in one day, all of them valiant men, because they had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers.

tcz: Mi mihattah Zichri kitipa chun lengpa chapa Maaseiah chu athatnin, khopi sunga vaihomma pang Azrikam leh lengpa dinga sepai lamkai anichanna Elkanah jong athatnin ahi
en: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.
text:
2CH 28:7
Thadou: Mi mihattah Zichri kitipa chun lengpa chapa Maaseiah chu athatnin, khopi sunga vaihomma pang Azrikam leh lengpa dinga sepai lamkai anichanna Elkanah jong athatnin ahi
English: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.

tcz: Israel tedinga Judah techu asopi teo ahivangin Israel sepaiten numei chapang 200,000 galhingn amannun achomdoh u thil keo tamtah toh Samaria gammah galhingin akaijun ahi
en: The children of Israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand women, sons, and daughters, and also took away much plunder from them, and brought the plunder to Samaria.
text:
2CH 28:8
Thadou: Israel tedinga Judah techu asopi teo ahivangin Israel sepaiten numei chapang 200,000 galhingn amannun achomdoh u thil keo tamtah toh Samaria gammah galhingin akaijun ahi
English: The children of Israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand women, sons, and daughters, and also took away much plunder from them, and brought the plunder to Samaria.

tcz: Ahin Oded kiti Pakai themgao pachu Samaria sepaiho komma chun achen hitin agaseije: “Veovin napu napateo Pa Pathen chu Judah te chunga alunghan jeh a amahochu nangho khutna ahin pehlut ahi, ahinlah nanghon lungkhen louhellin nathatnun apen ginnu kakom ahung lhungpeh in ahi
en: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name was Oded; and he went out to meet the army that came to Samaria, and said to them, “Behold, because the LORD, the God of your fathers, was angry with Judah, he has delivered them into your hand, and you have slain them in a rage which has reached up to heaven.
text:
2CH 28:9
