Thadou: Ahin Oded kiti Pakai themgao pachu Samaria sepaiho komma chun achen hitin agaseije: “Veovin napu napateo Pa Pathen chu Judah te chunga alunghan jeh a amahochu nangho khutna ahin pehlut ahi, ahinlah nanghon lungkhen louhellin nathatnun apen ginnu kakom ahung lhungpeh in ahi
English: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name was Oded; and he went out to meet the army that came to Samaria, and said to them, “Behold, because the LORD, the God of your fathers, was angry with Judah, he has delivered them into your hand, and you have slain them in a rage which has reached up to heaven.

tcz: Tunjong nanghon Judah leh Jerusalem mite chu pasal ahin numei ahiovin nasohun napansah gotaovin ahinlah nanghojong hi Pakai na Pathennu maija chonse nahilou uham?
en: Now you intend to degrade the children of Judah and Jerusalem as male and female slaves for yourselves. Aren’t there even with you trespasses of your own against the LORD your God?
text:
2CH 28:10
Thadou: Tunjong nanghon Judah leh Jerusalem mite chu pasal ahin numei ahiovin nasohun napansah gotaovin ahinlah nanghojong hi Pakai na Pathennu maija chonse nahilou uham?
English: Now you intend to degrade the children of Judah and Jerusalem as male and female slaves for yourselves. Aren’t there even with you trespasses of your own against the LORD your God?

tcz: “Tun kaseihi ngaijun nasopi tehochu galhinga namat houchu nungsolkit taovin ajeh chu nachunguvah Pakai alunghang taan ahi.
en: Now hear me therefore, and send back the captives that you have taken captive from your brothers, for the fierce wrath of the LORD is on you.”
text:
2CH 28:11
Thadou: “Tun kaseihi ngaijun nasopi tehochu galhinga namat houchu nungsolkit taovin ajeh chu nachunguvah Pakai alunghang taan ahi.
English: Now hear me therefore, and send back the captives that you have taken captive from your brothers, for the fierce wrath of the LORD is on you.”

tcz: Hichun Ephraim chate lah a miupa phabep hochu adingdoh un, Jehohanan chapa Azariah, Meshillemoth chapa Berekiah, Shallum chapa Jehizkiah, Hadlai chapa Amasa chu adingdoh un galsat hungkile hochu akimai to piovin hitin aseijun ahi
en: Then some of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against those who came from the war,
text:
2CH 28:12
Thadou: Hichun Ephraim chate lah a miupa phabep hochu adingdoh un, Jehohanan chapa Azariah, Meshillemoth chapa Berekiah, Shallum chapa Jehizkiah, Hadlai chapa Amasa chu adingdoh un galsat hungkile hochu akimai to piovin hitin aseijun ahi
English: Then some of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against those who came from the war,

tcz: Nanghon galhinga mi nahin kailutlou diu ahi: “Nanghon ichonsetnao nabelapmun galhingin mi nahin kaitaovin ahi, eihon nasatah in Pathen Israel chungah Ilunghan sah jeng taovin ahi” atiove
en: and said to them, “You must not bring in the captives here, for you intend that which will bring on us a trespass against the LORD, to add to our sins and to our guilt; for our guilt is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.”
text:
2CH 28:13
Thadou: Nanghon galhinga mi nahin kailutlou diu ahi: “Nanghon ichonsetnao nabelapmun galhingin mi nahin kaitaovin ahi, eihon nasatah in Pathen Israel chungah Ilunghan sah jeng taovin ahi” atiove
English: and said to them, “You must not bring in the captives here, for you intend that which will bring on us a trespass against the LORD, to add to our sins and to our guilt; for our guilt is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.”

tcz: Hichun thalchoi sepai hochun amimat houleh athil chomdoh hochu khopi lamkaiho masanga chun ahin koitaovin ahi
en: So the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the princes and all the assembly.
text:
2CH 28:14
Thadou: Hichun thalchoi sepai hochun amimat houleh athil chomdoh hochu khopi lamkaiho masanga chun ahin koitaovin ahi
English: So the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the princes and all the assembly.

tcz: Amincheh a kipanna kinganse hochu ahungding dohun thilkeo kichomdoh holeh galhinga kiman hochu ahin puidoh un akeova umhochu von avonpehun sandel asepehun anneh twidon apeovin thaojong anupehun ahi. Alhasam hochu sangan chungah atousah un hitichun jubiphung khopi Jericho – a asopihou kom geichu ahungthah un ahi. Hichea konchun Samaria a akile taove
en: The men who have been mentioned by name rose up and took the captives, and with the plunder clothed all who were naked among them, dressed them, gave them sandals, gave them something to eat and to drink, anointed them, carried all the feeble of them on donkeys, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brothers. Then they returned to Samaria.
text:
2CH 28:15
Thadou: Amincheh a kipanna kinganse hochu ahungding dohun thilkeo kichomdoh holeh galhinga kiman hochu ahin puidoh un akeova umhochu von avonpehun sandel asepehun anneh twidon apeovin thaojong anupehun ahi. Alhasam hochu sangan chungah atousah un hitichun jubiphung khopi Jericho – a asopihou kom geichu ahungthah un ahi. Hichea konchun Samaria a akile taove
English: The men who have been mentioned by name rose up and took the captives, and with the plunder clothed all who were naked among them, dressed them, gave them sandals, gave them something to eat and to drink, anointed them, carried all the feeble of them on donkeys, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brothers. Then they returned to Samaria.

tcz: Hichephat laichun Ahaz lengpan Assyriah lengpa chu akitho pidingin atemmin ahileh anompon ahi
en: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.
text:
2CH 28:16
Thadou: Hichephat laichun Ahaz lengpan Assyriah lengpa chu akitho pidingin atemmin ahileh anompon ahi
English: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.

tcz: Ajeh chu Edom mite ahungun Judah chu ahinbulu uvin galhingin amannun akaitaovin ahi
en: For again the Edomites had come and struck Judah, and carried away captives.
text:
2CH 28:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu Edom mite ahungun Judah chu ahinbulu uvin galhingin amannun akaitaovin ahi
English: For again the Edomites had come and struck Judah, and carried away captives.

tcz: Philistine tejong ahungun Judah phaicham leh lhanglam ahin bulu uvin, Beth Shemesh, Ajalon, Gederoth, Shocho thinglhang khoho chuleh Gimzo leh thinglhang kho hochu alonvuh un achenkhum taove
en: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland and of the South of Judah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and also Gimzo and its villages; and they lived there.
text:
2CH 28:18
Thadou: Philistine tejong ahungun Judah phaicham leh lhanglam ahin bulu uvin, Beth Shemesh, Ajalon, Gederoth, Shocho thinglhang khoho chuleh Gimzo leh thinglhang kho hochu alonvuh un achenkhum taove
English: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland and of the South of Judah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and also Gimzo and its villages; and they lived there.

tcz: Ajeh chu Judah lengpa Ahaz in a mite chan asuhboipeh a Pakai douna na atohjeh a Pakaiyin Judah tehi a engbol ahi
en: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, because he acted without restraint in Judah and trespassed severely against the LORD.
text:
2CH 28:19
Thadou: Ajeh chu Judah lengpa Ahaz in a mite chan asuhboipeh a Pakai douna na atohjeh a Pakaiyin Judah tehi a engbol ahi
English: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, because he acted without restraint in Judah and trespassed severely against the LORD.

tcz: Assyria lengpan Ahaz hi kithopi tahsangin adouvin apangjon asugim jon ahi
en: Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came to him and gave him trouble, but didn’t strengthen him.
text:
2CH 28:20
Thadou: Assyria lengpan Ahaz hi kithopi tahsangin adouvin apangjon asugim jon ahi
English: Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came to him and gave him trouble, but didn’t strengthen him.

tcz: Hijehcun Ahaz hin houin na kon leh, khopia kon in chuleh mipi lamkai ho kon in Sana ana chomkhom min Assyria lengpa chu anapen, ahivangin aman ana kithopi dehpoi
en: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the LORD’s house, and out of the house of the king and of the princes, and gave it to the king of Assyria; but it didn’t help him.
text:
2CH 28:21
Thadou: Hijehcun Ahaz hin houin na kon leh, khopia kon in chuleh mipi lamkai ho kon in Sana ana chomkhom min Assyria lengpa chu anapen, ahivangin aman ana kithopi dehpoi
English: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the LORD’s house, and out of the house of the king and of the princes, and gave it to the king of Assyria; but it didn’t help him.

tcz: Hahsat na akhon geija atotah vang'in Ahaz hin Pakai doumah abolbe jingin ahi
en: In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against the LORD, this same King Ahaz.
text:
2CH 28:22
Thadou: Hahsat na akhon geija atotah vang'in Ahaz hin Pakai doumah abolbe jingin ahi
English: In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against the LORD, this same King Ahaz.

tcz: Amahin achunga galhin bolla ahinjou chuleh ahin sugenthei Assyria mite semthu pathen ho kommah pumgo thilto abollin kilhaina asemmin ahi, aman aseijin “Syria pathen hon Syria lengho akithopin ahi, hijeh chun kenjong hiche pathen ho kommahin kilhaina semleng keijong eikithopi diu ahi” ati. Ahinlah hichehin ama le amite chungah hahsatna alhunbe jon ahi
en: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus which had defeated him. He said, “Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, I will sacrifice to them, that they may help me.” But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.
text:
2CH 28:23
Thadou: Amahin achunga galhin bolla ahinjou chuleh ahin sugenthei Assyria mite semthu pathen ho kommah pumgo thilto abollin kilhaina asemmin ahi, aman aseijin “Syria pathen hon Syria lengho akithopin ahi, hijeh chun kenjong hiche pathen ho kommahin kilhaina semleng keijong eikithopi diu ahi” ati. Ahinlah hichehin ama le amite chungah hahsatna alhunbe jon ahi
English: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus which had defeated him. He said, “Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, I will sacrifice to them, that they may help me.” But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.

tcz: Hiche bannahjong hin aman Pathen in na thilkeo ho jouse achu alaan asugoi sohkeijin chuin houin kotchu akhah in Jerusalem khopi muntinah doiphung atungdoh in ahi
en: Ahaz gathered together the vessels of God’s house, cut the vessels of God’s house in pieces, and shut up the doors of the LORD’s house; and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 28:24
Thadou: Hiche bannahjong hin aman Pathen in na thilkeo ho jouse achu alaan asugoi sohkeijin chuin houin kotchu akhah in Jerusalem khopi muntinah doiphung atungdoh in ahi
English: Ahaz gathered together the vessels of God’s house, cut the vessels of God’s house in pieces, and shut up the doors of the LORD’s house; and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

tcz: Judah gamma khopi leh khopi neo ho munjousea semthu pathen houna atungdoh in gimnamtwi ho ahalnammin gamdanga pathen hochu ahou taan ahi, hitichun aman apu apate Pakai Pathen lung hanna chu akiloilut khum taan ahi
en: In every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked the LORD, the God of his fathers, to anger.
text:
2CH 28:25
Thadou: Judah gamma khopi leh khopi neo ho munjousea semthu pathen houna atungdoh in gimnamtwi ho ahalnammin gamdanga pathen hochu ahou taan ahi, hitichun aman apu apate Pakai Pathen lung hanna chu akiloilut khum taan ahi
English: In every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked the LORD, the God of his fathers, to anger.

tcz: Hitichun avaihom sunga anatoh athilbol jouse chu apatna patna ajona gei Judah leh Israel lengho thusim bua akijih lutsoh keijin ahi
en: Now the rest of his acts, and all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
text:
2CH 28:26
Thadou: Hitichun avaihom sunga anatoh athilbol jouse chu apatna patna ajona gei Judah leh Israel lengho thusim bua akijih lutsoh keijin ahi
English: Now the rest of his acts, and all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

tcz: Hitia Ahaz lengpahi athitaan ahileh lengte lhanna vuilouvin Jerusalem khopi sunga anavuitaove. Achapa Hezekiah chu apa khellin leng achangtaan ahi
en: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem, because they didn’t bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
text:
2CH 28:27
Thadou: Hitia Ahaz lengpahi athitaan ahileh lengte lhanna vuilouvin Jerusalem khopi sunga anavuitaove. Achapa Hezekiah chu apa khellin leng achangtaan ahi
English: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem, because they didn’t bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Hezekiah hi kum 25 alhinkum chun leng ahung changin kum 29 suingin Jerusalem mah vai anahomme, anu hi Zachariah chanu Abijah anahi
en: Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
text:
2CH 29:1
Thadou: Hezekiah hi kum 25 alhinkum chun leng ahung changin kum 29 suingin Jerusalem mah vai anahomme, anu hi Zachariah chanu Abijah anahi
English: Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

tcz: Amahin apa David nin ana bolbang bangin Pathen deilam ngen anabollin ahi
en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.
text:
2CH 29:2
Thadou: Amahin apa David nin ana bolbang bangin Pathen deilam ngen anabollin ahi
English: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.

tcz: Avaihom kum amasapen leh lha masapennin aman Pakai inchu akot ho jouse ahongin abonin asemphan ahi
en: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the LORD’s house and repaired them.
text:
2CH 29:3
Thadou: Avaihom kum amasapen leh lha masapennin aman Pakai inchu akot ho jouse ahongin abonin asemphan ahi
English: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the LORD’s house and repaired them.

tcz: Abannin aman thempu holeh Levi ho jouse chu Houin solang hongcha – a chun akhommin
en: He brought in the priests and the Levites and gathered them together into the wide place on the east,
text:
2CH 29:4
Thadou: Abannin aman thempu holeh Levi ho jouse chu Houin solang hongcha – a chun akhommin
English: He brought in the priests and the Levites and gathered them together into the wide place on the east,

tcz: Amaho komma chun hitin aseije: “kasei hi ngaijun Levi te tun nangho le nangho kisuthengun chujouleh napu napateo Pakai Pathen houin suthengun, chujouleh, thil thenglou jouse chu houinna kon in paidoh un.
en: and said to them, “Listen to me, you Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD, the God of your fathers, and carry the filthiness out of the holy place.
text:
2CH 29:5
Thadou: Amaho komma chun hitin aseije: “kasei hi ngaijun Levi te tun nangho le nangho kisuthengun chujouleh napu napateo Pakai Pathen houin suthengun, chujouleh, thil thenglou jouse chu houinna kon in paidoh un.
English: and said to them, “Listen to me, you Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD, the God of your fathers, and carry the filthiness out of the holy place.

tcz: Ajeh chu Ipu ipateovin Pakai Pathen mitmun thilse jeng anabollun achonkhel taovin ahi, Pathen anungsunnun Pathen chenna a kon in amai aheimang taovin ahi
en: For our fathers were unfaithful, and have done that which was evil in the LORD our God’s sight, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned their backs.
text:
2CH 29:6
Thadou: Ajeh chu Ipu ipateovin Pakai Pathen mitmun thilse jeng anabollun achonkhel taovin ahi, Pathen anungsunnun Pathen chenna a kon in amai aheimang taovin ahi
English: For our fathers were unfaithful, and have done that which was evil in the LORD our God’s sight, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned their backs.

tcz: Amahon Houin kot akhah un thaomeiho amutlih un chuleh Israel Pathen houin nah pumgo thilto abol tapouvin gimnamtwi jong ahal tapouvin ahi
en: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.
text:
2CH 29:7
Thadou: Amahon Houin kot akhah un thaomeiho amutlih un chuleh Israel Pathen houin nah pumgo thilto abol tapouvin gimnamtwi jong ahal tapouvin ahi
English: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.

tcz: Hitia hi anachon tahjehun Pakai hi Judah nam leh Jerusalem chungah analung hangin achunguva ichangeiya na anatoh hitam, hichehin mijouse ana lungdon sah in akichat sahtaan ahi. Hiche hi nanghon nahe soh keijuve
en: Therefore the LORD’s wrath was on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an astonishment and a hissing, as you see with your eyes.
text:
2CH 29:8
Thadou: Hitia hi anachon tahjehun Pakai hi Judah nam leh Jerusalem chungah analung hangin achunguva ichangeiya na anatoh hitam, hichehin mijouse ana lungdon sah in akichat sahtaan ahi. Hiche hi nanghon nahe soh keijuve
English: Therefore the LORD’s wrath was on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an astonishment and a hissing, as you see with your eyes.

tcz: Ipateo galla anathat nun ijiteo leh ichateo gal hingin ana kaimangun ahi
en: For behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
text:
2CH 29:9
Thadou: Ipateo galla anathat nun ijiteo leh ichateo gal hingin ana kaimangun ahi
English: For behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

tcz: Tuhin keiman Israel Pathen ipakaiyu komma hin kitep nakhat kasem nomme chutileh ama eiho chungah lunghang taponte
en: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD, the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us.
text:
2CH 29:10
Thadou: Tuhin keiman Israel Pathen ipakaiyu komma hin kitep nakhat kasem nomme chutileh ama eiho chungah lunghang taponte
English: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD, the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us.

tcz: “Kachate ho heche hi nahsah mon koihih un, ajeh chu Pakaiyin nanghohi a anga ding jinga ama lungdeilam bolding leh akin tong dinga chuleh gimnamtwi hal namdinga nalhen u ahi” ati
en: My sons, don’t be negligent now; for the LORD has chosen you to stand before him, to minister to him, and that you should be his ministers and burn incense.”
text:
2CH 29:11
Thadou: “Kachate ho heche hi nahsah mon koihih un, ajeh chu Pakaiyin nanghohi a anga ding jinga ama lungdeilam bolding leh akin tong dinga chuleh gimnamtwi hal namdinga nalhen u ahi” ati
English: My sons, don’t be negligent now; for the LORD has chosen you to stand before him, to minister to him, and that you should be his ministers and burn incense.”

tcz: Hichun Levi te ahung kipatdoh taove: Amasai chapa Mahath chuleh Azariah chapa Joel, Kohathites chateho Merari chateho, Abdi chapa Kish chuleh Jehallelel chapa Azariah, Gershon chateho Zimmah chapa Joash chuleh Joash chapa Eden
en: Then the Levites arose: Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;

tcz: Elizaphan chate chu Shimri leh Jeiel ahin, Asaph chate chu Zechariah leh Mattaniah ahin,
en: and of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeuel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;

tcz: Heman chate chu Jehiel leh Shimei ahin, Jeduthun chate chu Shemaiah leh Uzziel ahi
en: and of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
text:
2CH 29:14
Thadou: Heman chate chu Jehiel leh Shimei ahin, Jeduthun chate chu Shemaiah leh Uzziel ahi
English: and of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.

tcz: Hitichun amaho insung chu akikhomun amahole amaho akisuthengun lengpa thupeh leh Pakai dei dung juiyin achonnun Pakai houin chu asuthengun ahi
en: They gathered their brothers, sanctified themselves, and went in, according to the commandment of the king by the LORD’s words, to cleanse the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 29:15
Thadou: Hitichun amaho insung chu akikhomun amahole amaho akisuthengun lengpa thupeh leh Pakai dei dung juiyin achonnun Pakai houin chu asuthengun ahi
English: They gathered their brothers, sanctified themselves, and went in, according to the commandment of the king by the LORD’s words, to cleanse the LORD’s house.

tcz: Hichun thempu hochu Pakai Houin sunglanga chun alut un asuthengun chuleh Pakai houin Pakai hongcha changei jin ahin pou – vin chuleh Levi ten apodoh un Kidron phaichammah aga pailhaovin ahi
en: The priests went into the inner part of the LORD’s house to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the LORD’s temple into the court of the LORD’s house. The Levites took it from there to carry it out to the brook Kidron.
text:
2CH 29:16
Thadou: Hichun thempu hochu Pakai Houin sunglanga chun alut un asuthengun chuleh Pakai houin Pakai hongcha changei jin ahin pou – vin chuleh Levi ten apodoh un Kidron phaichammah aga pailhaovin ahi
English: The priests went into the inner part of the LORD’s house to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the LORD’s temple into the court of the LORD’s house. The Levites took it from there to carry it out to the brook Kidron.

tcz: Natoh chu lhamasa – a nikho maspenni chu anapatnu ahi niget channin ana tongchai sohkeijun ahi, hichea hin houinna lutna dansung jong achai taovin hichejou chun niget abol beovin hiche lha sung ni 16 changeijin abollun houin chu houkhom na thei aso taovin ahi
en: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the LORD’s porch. They sanctified the LORD’s house in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.
text:
2CH 29:17
Thadou: Natoh chu lhamasa – a nikho maspenni chu anapatnu ahi niget channin ana tongchai sohkeijun ahi, hichea hin houinna lutna dansung jong achai taovin hichejou chun niget abol beovin hiche lha sung ni 16 changeijin abollun houin chu houkhom na thei aso taovin ahi
English: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the LORD’s porch. They sanctified the LORD’s house in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.

tcz: Levi techun lengpa Hezekiah kommah hitin thu alhut nun ahi: “Keihon hou dan dungjuija thenna kinchu houin pumpi ahin pumgo thilto na maicham phung geijin chuleh changlhah kisemna table leh aman chahho pummin kahin sutheng taove”atiovin ahi
en: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king within the palace and said, “We have cleansed all the LORD’s house, including the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, and the table of show bread with all its vessels.
text:
2CH 29:18
Thadou: Levi techun lengpa Hezekiah kommah hitin thu alhut nun ahi: “Keihon hou dan dungjuija thenna kinchu houin pumpi ahin pumgo thilto na maicham phung geijin chuleh changlhah kisemna table leh aman chahho pummin kahin sutheng taove”atiovin ahi
English: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king within the palace and said, “We have cleansed all the LORD’s house, including the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, and the table of show bread with all its vessels.

tcz: Hiche chung chonchun Ahaz lengpa Pathen doumah abolsunga anapaidoh thilkeo hojong chu kahin chomkhommun kasuthengun Pakai maicham masangah kakoi taove”
en: Moreover, we have prepared and sanctified all the vessels which King Ahaz threw away in his reign when he was unfaithful. Behold, they are before the LORD’s altar.”
text:
2CH 29:19
Thadou: Hiche chung chonchun Ahaz lengpa Pathen doumah abolsunga anapaidoh thilkeo hojong chu kahin chomkhommun kasuthengun Pakai maicham masangah kakoi taove”
English: Moreover, we have prepared and sanctified all the vessels which King Ahaz threw away in his reign when he was unfaithful. Behold, they are before the LORD’s altar.”

tcz: Jingpi tah in lengpa Hezekiah in khopi sunga lamkaiho jouse akoukhom min houin langa ache taove
en: Then Hezekiah the king arose early, gathered the princes of the city, and went up to the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 29:20
Thadou: Jingpi tah in lengpa Hezekiah in khopi sunga lamkaiho jouse akoukhom min houin langa ache taove
English: Then Hezekiah the king arose early, gathered the princes of the city, and went up to the LORD’s house.

tcz: Lengte insung leh Judah mipite chonset na suhtheng nadingleh houin suhtheng na dingin amahon bongchal 7, kelngoi 7 chuleh kelchal 7 hicheng hi Aaron chilhah te thempuhon maichamma pumgo thilto a akatdoh diuvin aseipeh in ahi
en: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. He commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the LORD’s altar.
text:
2CH 29:21
Thadou: Lengte insung leh Judah mipite chonset na suhtheng nadingleh houin suhtheng na dingin amahon bongchal 7, kelngoi 7 chuleh kelchal 7 hicheng hi Aaron chilhah te thempuhon maichamma pumgo thilto a akatdoh diuvin aseipeh in ahi
English: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. He commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the LORD’s altar.

tcz: Thempuhon bongchal chu athat masaovin abannin kelngoi chal ho abannin kelngoi ho athat nun akikatdoh gancha thisan hochu maicham chunga atheovin ahi
en: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it on the altar. They killed the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar.
text:
2CH 29:22
Thadou: Thempuhon bongchal chu athat masaovin abannin kelngoi chal ho abannin kelngoi ho athat nun akikatdoh gancha thisan hochu maicham chunga atheovin ahi
English: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it on the altar. They killed the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar.

tcz: Achaina in kelchal chu lengpa kom leh taona mangho komma chun akailutnun amahon gancha ho chunga chun akhut angam mun ahi
en: They brought near the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands on them.
text:
2CH 29:23
Thadou: Achaina in kelchal chu lengpa kom leh taona mangho komma chun akailutnun amahon gancha ho chunga chun akhut angam mun ahi
English: They brought near the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands on them.

tcz: Hijou chun thempuhon kelchal hochu athatnun athisan chun mipite chonsetna apohmang na dinga kikatdoh hidingin maicham chunga chun atheovin ahi
en: Then the priests killed them, and they made a sin offering with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel; for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.
text:
2CH 29:24
Thadou: Hijou chun thempuhon kelchal hochu athatnun athisan chun mipite chonsetna apohmang na dinga kikatdoh hidingin maicham chunga chun atheovin ahi
English: Then the priests killed them, and they made a sin offering with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel; for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.

tcz: Nathan themgao leh lengpa themgao Gad nin Pathenna konna leng David thu ana pohchu Hezekiah lengpa hin phatah in ana juiyin ahi. Aman Levi techu selangdah leh tumging anakichoi sah in houinnah pan analah sah in ahi
en: He set the Levites in the LORD’s house with cymbals, with stringed instruments, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet; for the commandment was from the LORD by his prophets.
text:
2CH 29:25
Thadou: Nathan themgao leh lengpa themgao Gad nin Pathenna konna leng David thu ana pohchu Hezekiah lengpa hin phatah in ana juiyin ahi. Aman Levi techu selangdah leh tumging anakichoi sah in houinnah pan analah sah in ahi
English: He set the Levites in the LORD’s house with cymbals, with stringed instruments, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet; for the commandment was from the LORD by his prophets.

tcz: Hiche atumgingu manchah chu leng David nin ana choi tobang bang chu ahi, thempu hojong sumkon kichoi pummin adingun ahi
en: The Levites stood with David’s instruments, and the priests with the trumpets.
text:
2CH 29:26
Thadou: Hiche atumgingu manchah chu leng David nin ana choi tobang bang chu ahi, thempu hojong sumkon kichoi pummin adingun ahi
English: The Levites stood with David’s instruments, and the priests with the trumpets.

tcz: Hezekiah in pumgo thilto chu patdinga thu ahinpeh phatnin thilpeh chu ahung kipan tan chuleh mipichun Pakai thangvah na la asaovin, tumging saithem hochun sumkon mut toh agingthei jouse ahin sugingun ahi
en: Hezekiah commanded them to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, the LORD’s song also began, along with the trumpets and instruments of David king of Israel.
text:
2CH 29:27
Thadou: Hezekiah in pumgo thilto chu patdinga thu ahinpeh phatnin thilpeh chu ahung kipan tan chuleh mipichun Pakai thangvah na la asaovin, tumging saithem hochun sumkon mut toh agingthei jouse ahin sugingun ahi
English: Hezekiah commanded them to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, the LORD’s song also began, along with the trumpets and instruments of David king of Israel.

tcz: Mipi aum jouse chu Pathen houna – a chun apangun ahi; chuleh pumgo thilto hochu akahlhah jou kahsen tumging leh la kisa hochu achelhah jingin ahi
en: All the assembly worshiped, the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded. All this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
text:
2CH 29:28
Thadou: Mipi aum jouse chu Pathen houna – a chun apangun ahi; chuleh pumgo thilto hochu akahlhah jou kahsen tumging leh la kisa hochu achelhah jingin ahi
English: All the assembly worshiped, the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded. All this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

tcz: Hijou teng chuleh Hezekiah lengpa leh mipi jouse chun adilsuo vin Pathen chibai abohun ahi
en: When they had finished offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped.
text:
2CH 29:29
Thadou: Hijou teng chuleh Hezekiah lengpa leh mipi jouse chun adilsuo vin Pathen chibai abohun ahi
English: When they had finished offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped.

tcz: Lengpa Hezekiah leh nampi lamkaihon themgao Asaph leh David nin anasem thangvah na lachu Levi ten asahdiuvin thu anapeovin ahi, amaho adilsuo vin Pathen chibai abohun thangvah lachu kipah tah in asaovin ahi
en: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises to the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. They sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.
text:
2CH 29:30
Thadou: Lengpa Hezekiah leh nampi lamkaihon themgao Asaph leh David nin anasem thangvah na lachu Levi ten asahdiuvin thu anapeovin ahi, amaho adilsuo vin Pathen chibai abohun thangvah lachu kipah tah in asaovin ahi
English: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises to the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. They sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.

tcz: Hezekiah chun mipi kommah aseijin “Tuahi nangho dan dungjuija thenga nahitaovin, hijeh chun Pakai thangvah na in pumgo thilto dinghi tohdoh taovin atin ahi. amahon sei angaijun miphabep chun acham chammin pumgo thilto dingin aganchao ahin kaijun ahi
en: Then Hezekiah answered, “Now you have consecrated yourselves to the LORD. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the LORD’s house.” The assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings, and as many as were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings.
text:
2CH 29:31
Thadou: Hezekiah chun mipi kommah aseijin “Tuahi nangho dan dungjuija thenga nahitaovin, hijeh chun Pakai thangvah na in pumgo thilto dinghi tohdoh taovin atin ahi. amahon sei angaijun miphabep chun acham chammin pumgo thilto dingin aganchao ahin kaijun ahi
English: Then Hezekiah answered, “Now you have consecrated yourselves to the LORD. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the LORD’s house.” The assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings, and as many as were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings.

tcz: Amahon bongchal 70,000 (Sang som sagi) kelngoichal 100 leh kelngoi 200 Pakaija pumgo thilto a dingin ahin tohdoh un ahi
en: The number of the burnt offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, and two hundred lambs. All these were for a burnt offering to the LORD.
text:
2CH 29:32
Thadou: Amahon bongchal 70,000 (Sang som sagi) kelngoichal 100 leh kelngoi 200 Pakaija pumgo thilto a dingin ahin tohdoh un ahi
English: The number of the burnt offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, and two hundred lambs. All these were for a burnt offering to the LORD.

tcz: Amahon Bongchal 600 leh kelngoichal 3000 (Sangthum) mipi ho nehdigin akatdoh un ahi
en: The consecrated things were six hundred head of cattle and three thousand sheep.
text:
2CH 29:33
Thadou: Amahon Bongchal 600 leh kelngoichal 3000 (Sangthum) mipi ho nehdigin akatdoh un ahi
English: The consecrated things were six hundred head of cattle and three thousand sheep.

tcz: Hiche gancha ho hi that dingin thempuho alhahsam jeh in natoh chu akichai tokah in Levi ten ana kitho piovin ahi. Hijouchun thempuho chu ana kithenso beovin ahi. Levi hochu thempuho sangin kisuhtheng nalam ma chun anagun chujo uvin ahi
en: But the priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings. Therefore their brothers the Levites helped them until the work was ended, and until the priests had sanctified themselves, for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.
text:
2CH 29:34
Thadou: Hiche gancha ho hi that dingin thempuho alhahsam jeh in natoh chu akichai tokah in Levi ten ana kitho piovin ahi. Hijouchun thempuho chu ana kithenso beovin ahi. Levi hochu thempuho sangin kisuhtheng nalam ma chun anagun chujo uvin ahi
English: But the priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings. Therefore their brothers the Levites helped them until the work was ended, and until the priests had sanctified themselves, for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

tcz: Pumgo thilto hijat banna jonghin chamna thilto sathao jong ahinalai jin, chuleh donthei thilto ho pumgo thilto a manchah ding jong ahinalai jin ahi. Hiti hin Pakai houin sunga akin bol ding jouse chu akisutoh sohkeitan ahi
en: Also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and with the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the LORD’s house was set in order.
text:
2CH 29:35
Thadou: Pumgo thilto hijat banna jonghin chamna thilto sathao jong ahinalai jin, chuleh donthei thilto ho pumgo thilto a manchah ding jong ahinalai jin ahi. Hiti hin Pakai houin sunga akin bol ding jouse chu akisutoh sohkeitan ahi
English: Also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and with the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the LORD’s house was set in order.

tcz: Hitichun Hezekiah lengpa leh amitechu akipah lheh jengun ahi, ajeh chu Pathen kithopina jallin tohding jouse chu gangtah in achai taovin ahi
en: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because of that which God had prepared for the people; for the thing was done suddenly.
text:
2CH 29:36
Thadou: Hitichun Hezekiah lengpa leh amitechu akipah lheh jengun ahi, ajeh chu Pathen kithopina jallin tohding jouse chu gangtah in achai taovin ahi
English: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because of that which God had prepared for the people; for the thing was done suddenly.

tcz: Hezekiah in Israel leh Judah te jouse chu thu athotnin chuleh Ephraim leh Manasseh tejong lekha athotnin Jerusalem ma Pakai houin na hung na dingleh Israel te Pakai kalchuh kut mang dingin akouvin ahi
en: Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the LORD’s house at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to the LORD, the God of Israel.
text:
2CH 30:1
Thadou: Hezekiah in Israel leh Judah te jouse chu thu athotnin chuleh Ephraim leh Manasseh tejong lekha athotnin Jerusalem ma Pakai houin na hung na dingleh Israel te Pakai kalchuh kut mang dingin akouvin ahi
English: Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the LORD’s house at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to the LORD, the God of Israel.

tcz: Ajeh chu lengpaleh alamkai ho jouse chuleh Jerusalem ma khop pi – a mipiho jouse chu lhani channa tengleh kalchuh kut manding in akinop to taovin ahi
en: For the king had taken counsel with his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second month.
text:
2CH 30:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu lengpaleh alamkai ho jouse chuleh Jerusalem ma khop pi – a mipiho jouse chu lhani channa tengleh kalchuh kut manding in akinop to taovin ahi
English: For the king had taken counsel with his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second month.

tcz: Amahon ahi ding bangin anamang thei pouvin ahi, chuleh thempu hojong amale ama kithenso na – a ana lhing jou pouvin ahi. Chuleh mipijong Jerusalem mah ana kikhom kim thei pouvin ahi
en: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves in sufficient number, and the people had not gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 30:3
Thadou: Amahon ahi ding bangin anamang thei pouvin ahi, chuleh thempu hojong amale ama kithenso na – a ana lhing jou pouvin ahi. Chuleh mipijong Jerusalem mah ana kikhom kim thei pouvin ahi
English: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves in sufficient number, and the people had not gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hiche thuhin lengpa leh khoppi chu akipa sah lheh jengun ahi
en: The thing was right in the eyes of the king and of all the assembly.
text:
2CH 30:4
Thadou: Hiche thuhin lengpa leh khoppi chu akipa sah lheh jengun ahi
English: The thing was right in the eyes of the king and of all the assembly.

tcz: Hitichun amahon Bersheba a patna Dan geija Israel pumpi Jerusalem ma ahung kikhopmu va Israel Pakai Pathen anga sottah ahi ding banga ana manjou tah louvu kalchuh kut man nadingin aphongdoh taovin ahi
en: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to the LORD, the God of Israel, at Jerusalem, for they had not kept it in great numbers in the way it is written.
text:
2CH 30:5
Thadou: Hitichun amahon Bersheba a patna Dan geija Israel pumpi Jerusalem ma ahung kikhopmu va Israel Pakai Pathen anga sottah ahi ding banga ana manjou tah louvu kalchuh kut man nadingin aphongdoh taovin ahi
English: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to the LORD, the God of Israel, at Jerusalem, for they had not kept it in great numbers in the way it is written.

tcz: Hijou chun Judah leh Israel gampumpi a mikouding asollun leng pa le lamkai ho a kon in lekhathot achoijun lengpa thupeh chu asimphongun “Israel chateho Abraham Isaac le Israel Pakai Pathen na hung kile kittaovin chuteng leh Assyria lenghoa konna hungjamdoh amohcheng nangho komma Pakai jong hung kile kit ding ahi
en: So the couriers went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, according to the commandment of the king, saying, “You children of Israel, turn again to the LORD, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, that he may return to the remnant of you that have escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.
text:
2CH 30:6
Thadou: Hijou chun Judah leh Israel gampumpi a mikouding asollun leng pa le lamkai ho a kon in lekhathot achoijun lengpa thupeh chu asimphongun “Israel chateho Abraham Isaac le Israel Pakai Pathen na hung kile kittaovin chuteng leh Assyria lenghoa konna hungjamdoh amohcheng nangho komma Pakai jong hung kile kit ding ahi
English: So the couriers went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, according to the commandment of the king, saying, “You children of Israel, turn again to the LORD, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, that he may return to the remnant of you that have escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

tcz: Pakai Pathen doumah a chon napu napateo bangin chon hih un nanghon nahet bangun Pathen nin ama ho chu nasahtah in a engbollun ahi
en: Don’t be like your fathers and like your brothers, who trespassed against the LORD, the God of their fathers, so that he gave them up to desolation, as you see.
text:
2CH 30:7
Thadou: Pakai Pathen doumah a chon napu napateo bangin chon hih un nanghon nahet bangun Pathen nin ama ho chu nasahtah in a engbollun ahi
English: Don’t be like your fathers and like your brothers, who trespassed against the LORD, the God of their fathers, so that he gave them up to desolation, as you see.

tcz: Amaho bangin louchal hih un, Pakai thuchu nitjouvin. Jerusalem ma Pakai houinna hungun, hichu na Pakai na Pathennun a imatih channa dinga asuhtheng ahi, hungunlang chibai hungboh un chutileh nachunguvah lung hang taponte
en: Now don’t be stiff-necked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves to the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he has sanctified forever, and serve the LORD your God, that his fierce anger may turn away from you.
text:
2CH 30:8
Thadou: Amaho bangin louchal hih un, Pakai thuchu nitjouvin. Jerusalem ma Pakai houinna hungun, hichu na Pakai na Pathennun a imatih channa dinga asuhtheng ahi, hungunlang chibai hungboh un chutileh nachunguvah lung hang taponte
English: Now don’t be stiff-necked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves to the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he has sanctified forever, and serve the LORD your God, that his fierce anger may turn away from you.

tcz: Pakai komma nahung kileova ahileh na sopite hou galhinga man hochun lungset nale khotona hinnei juntin a in lang uva ahin kile sah diu ahi. Pakai na Pathennu hi mikhoto them ahi nahung kinung leoleh aman nahinsah diu ahi
en: For if you turn again to the LORD, your brothers and your children will find compassion with those who led them captive, and will come again into this land, because the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you if you return to him.”
text:
2CH 30:9
Thadou: Pakai komma nahung kileova ahileh na sopite hou galhinga man hochun lungset nale khotona hinnei juntin a in lang uva ahin kile sah diu ahi. Pakai na Pathennu hi mikhoto them ahi nahung kinung leoleh aman nahinsah diu ahi
English: For if you turn again to the LORD, your brothers and your children will find compassion with those who led them captive, and will come again into this land, because the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you if you return to him.”

tcz: Hiche thupo poleho chu Ephraim leh Manasseh phungho chen na gamhoa acheovin chuleh sahlang Zebulun phungho chenna gamgeijin acheovin ahin la amahon ana nuisatnun ana houseovin ahi
en: So the couriers passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun, but people ridiculed them and mocked them.
text:
2CH 30:10
Thadou: Hiche thupo poleho chu Ephraim leh Manasseh phungho chen na gamhoa acheovin chuleh sahlang Zebulun phungho chenna gamgeijin acheovin ahin la amahon ana nuisatnun ana houseovin ahi
English: So the couriers passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun, but people ridiculed them and mocked them.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in Asher, Manasseh le Zebulun phunghoa kon in mi phabep Jerusalem mah ahungun ahi
en: Nevertheless some men of Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 30:11
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in Asher, Manasseh le Zebulun phunghoa kon in mi phabep Jerusalem mah ahungun ahi
English: Nevertheless some men of Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.

tcz: Pathenin Judah mite lah a na anatongin ana kipumkhat sahun ahi. Ajeh chu amahon lengpe leh anoija lamkaiho thu angaijun Pathen lungdei boldingin lunggel dettah in aneiyun ahi
en: Also the hand of God came on Judah to give them one heart, to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by the LORD’s word.
text:
2CH 30:12
Thadou: Pathenin Judah mite lah a na anatongin ana kipumkhat sahun ahi. Ajeh chu amahon lengpe leh anoija lamkaiho thu angaijun Pathen lungdei boldingin lunggel dettah in aneiyun ahi
English: Also the hand of God came on Judah to give them one heart, to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by the LORD’s word.

tcz: Lhani chan na in mitamtah Jerusalem mah ahung kikhom mun cholsolou changlhah kutchu amangun ahi
en: Many people assembled at Jerusalem to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great assembly.
text:
2CH 30:13
Thadou: Lhani chan na in mitamtah Jerusalem mah ahung kikhom mun cholsolou changlhah kutchu amangun ahi
English: Many people assembled at Jerusalem to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great assembly.

tcz: Amahon Jerusalem pumgo thiltona le gimnamtwi lhutnam – a ana kimang maicham ho chu aladoh un Kidron phaicham mah aga lehmangun ahi
en: They arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and they took away all the altars for incense and threw them into the brook Kidron.
text:
2CH 30:14
Thadou: Amahon Jerusalem pumgo thiltona le gimnamtwi lhutnam – a ana kimang maicham ho chu aladoh un Kidron phaicham mah aga lehmangun ahi
English: They arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and they took away all the altars for incense and threw them into the brook Kidron.

tcz: Hijouchun lhani channa a ni 14 nikhochun kalchuh kut na dingin kelngoi athatnun ahi. Thempu holeh Levi techu daan dung jui'a ana kisuhtheng lou jeh'un ajahchao vin hijeh chun Pakai jah amaho le amaho aga kisutheng un ahileh houinna pumgo thilto kibolna – a akimangcha thei taovin ahi
en: Then they killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought burnt offerings into the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 30:15
Thadou: Hijouchun lhani channa a ni 14 nikhochun kalchuh kut na dingin kelngoi athatnun ahi. Thempu holeh Levi techu daan dung jui'a ana kisuhtheng lou jeh'un ajahchao vin hijeh chun Pakai jah amaho le amaho aga kisutheng un ahileh houinna pumgo thilto kibolna – a akimangcha thei taovin ahi
English: Then they killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought burnt offerings into the LORD’s house.

tcz: Aman Pathen mipa Mose daan thupeh dung juiyin ama ama panmuncheh akilo taovin ahi. Levi ten gancha kitohdoh thisan chu thempuho khutna apeovin amahon hichu maicham chungah atheovin ahi
en: They stood in their place after their order, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood which they received of the hand of the Levites.
text:
2CH 30:16
Thadou: Aman Pathen mipa Mose daan thupeh dung juiyin ama ama panmuncheh akilo taovin ahi. Levi ten gancha kitohdoh thisan chu thempuho khutna apeovin amahon hichu maicham chungah atheovin ahi
English: They stood in their place after their order, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood which they received of the hand of the Levites.

tcz: Mi atamjo chu daan jungjui ja athen lou jeh un kalchuh kutna chun kelngoi athat thei pouvin ahi. Hijeh chun Levi ten amaho khellin athapeh un kelngoi ho chu Pakai jah akatdoh un ahi
en: For there were many in the assembly who had not sanctified themselves; therefore the Levites were in charge of killing the Passovers for everyone who was not clean, to sanctify them to the LORD.
text:
2CH 30:17
Thadou: Mi atamjo chu daan jungjui ja athen lou jeh un kalchuh kutna chun kelngoi athat thei pouvin ahi. Hijeh chun Levi ten amaho khellin athapeh un kelngoi ho chu Pakai jah akatdoh un ahi
English: For there were many in the assembly who had not sanctified themselves; therefore the Levites were in charge of killing the Passovers for everyone who was not clean, to sanctify them to the LORD.

tcz: Hiche chung chonchun Ephraim Manasseh, Issachar leh Zebulun phunghoa konna hungho chun daan dungjuija kisuhtheng nachu abolpouvin hijeh chun amahon kalchuh kutchu kiphalam tah in amangun ahi. Hezekiah lengpan amaho ding chun taona amanpeh in ahi
en: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet they ate the Passover other than the way it is written. For Hezekiah had prayed for them, saying, “May the good LORD pardon everyone
text:
2CH 30:18
Thadou: Hiche chung chonchun Ephraim Manasseh, Issachar leh Zebulun phunghoa konna hungho chun daan dungjuija kisuhtheng nachu abolpouvin hijeh chun amahon kalchuh kutchu kiphalam tah in amangun ahi. Hezekiah lengpan amaho ding chun taona amanpeh in ahi
English: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet they ate the Passover other than the way it is written. For Hezekiah had prayed for them, saying, “May the good LORD pardon everyone

tcz: “Vo Pakai kapu kapateo Pathen naphatna jal in alung thimpum pia nakomma taohohi, daandungjuijin thengjou hih jong leo ataonao sanpeh in” ati
en: who sets his heart to seek God, the LORD, the God of his fathers, even if they aren’t clean according to the purification of the sanctuary.”
text:
2CH 30:19
Thadou: “Vo Pakai kapu kapateo Pathen naphatna jal in alung thimpum pia nakomma taohohi, daandungjuijin thengjou hih jong leo ataonao sanpeh in” ati
English: who sets his heart to seek God, the LORD, the God of his fathers, even if they aren’t clean according to the purification of the sanctuary.”

tcz: Pakaiyin Hezekiah taona asangin mipi hochu angaidammin achunguva thilse abol tapon ahi
en: The LORD listened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.
text:
2CH 30:20
Thadou: Pakaiyin Hezekiah taona asangin mipi hochu angaidammin achunguva thilse abol tapon ahi
English: The LORD listened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

tcz: Nisagi sungin mipi ho chu Jerusalem mah akikhomun cholsolou changlhah kutchu kipahtah le thanom tah in abollun ani anin Levi te le thempu hochun lungnachim tah in Pakai athangvah un ahi
en: The children of Israel who were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness. The Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day, singing with loud instruments to the LORD.
text:
2CH 30:21
Thadou: Nisagi sungin mipi ho chu Jerusalem mah akikhomun cholsolou changlhah kutchu kipahtah le thanom tah in abollun ani anin Levi te le thempu hochun lungnachim tah in Pakai athangvah un ahi
English: The children of Israel who were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness. The Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day, singing with loud instruments to the LORD.

tcz: Hezekiah in Levi techu Pakai chibai bohna – a alamkai thepjeh un apahchan ahi. Nisagi sunga apu apateo Pakai Pathen thangvah na kikatdoh na maicham apeovin ahi
en: Hezekiah spoke encouragingly to all the Levites who had good understanding in the service of the LORD. So they ate throughout the feast for the seven days, offering sacrifices of peace offerings and making confession to the LORD, the God of their fathers.
text:
2CH 30:22
Thadou: Hezekiah in Levi techu Pakai chibai bohna – a alamkai thepjeh un apahchan ahi. Nisagi sunga apu apateo Pakai Pathen thangvah na kikatdoh na maicham apeovin ahi
English: Hezekiah spoke encouragingly to all the Levites who had good understanding in the service of the LORD. So they ate throughout the feast for the seven days, offering sacrifices of peace offerings and making confession to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

tcz: Amahon abonchaovin ni sagi lopbe kitdingin anomsoh keijun, hitichun kipahtah in alopbe kit nun ahi
en: The whole assembly took counsel to keep another seven days, and they kept another seven days with gladness.
text:
2CH 30:23
Thadou: Amahon abonchaovin ni sagi lopbe kitdingin anomsoh keijun, hitichun kipahtah in alopbe kit nun ahi
English: The whole assembly took counsel to keep another seven days, and they kept another seven days with gladness.

tcz: Hezekiah lengpan bongchal 1000 (sangkhat) kelngoichal 7000 (Sang sagi) mipihon akithaova anehdiuvin atohdoh in, chuleh lamkai hon bongchal 1000 (sangkhat) leh kelngoichal 10,000 (sang som) mipiho din atohdoh un, hitichun thempuho tamtah'in daan dungjuija kithensona aneiyun ahi
en: For Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the assembly for offerings one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the assembly a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep; and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.
text:
2CH 30:24
Thadou: Hezekiah lengpan bongchal 1000 (sangkhat) kelngoichal 7000 (Sang sagi) mipihon akithaova anehdiuvin atohdoh in, chuleh lamkai hon bongchal 1000 (sangkhat) leh kelngoichal 10,000 (sang som) mipiho din atohdoh un, hitichun thempuho tamtah'in daan dungjuija kithensona aneiyun ahi
English: For Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the assembly for offerings one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the assembly a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep; and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

tcz: Hitichun Judah mipite leh thempu ho Levi te leh sahlanga konna hung mipite leh gamdang miho Israel te leh Judah te lah a anacheng denjing ho abonchaovin akipah sohkeijun
en: All the assembly of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the assembly who came out of Israel, and the foreigners who came out of the land of Israel and who lived in Judah, rejoiced.
text:
2CH 30:25
Thadou: Hitichun Judah mipite leh thempu ho Levi te leh sahlanga konna hung mipite leh gamdang miho Israel te leh Judah te lah a anacheng denjing ho abonchaovin akipah sohkeijun
English: All the assembly of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the assembly who came out of Israel, and the foreigners who came out of the land of Israel and who lived in Judah, rejoiced.

tcz: Jerusalem khopi chu kipana adimset jengin ahi, Ajeh chu David chapa Solomon lengpa nikho apatnin hitobang hi ana shoh khah hih laijin ahi
en: So there was great joy in Jerusalem; for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was nothing like this in Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 30:26
Thadou: Jerusalem khopi chu kipana adimset jengin ahi, Ajeh chu David chapa Solomon lengpa nikho apatnin hitobang hi ana shoh khah hih laijin ahi
English: So there was great joy in Jerusalem; for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was nothing like this in Jerusalem.

tcz: Thempu hole Leve techun mipi phatthei achan na dingun Pakai kommah ataopeh un ahi leh Pathenin atao naochu asanpeh in ahi
en: Then the Levitical priests arose and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, even to heaven.
text:
2CH 30:27
Thadou: Thempu hole Leve techun mipi phatthei achan na dingun Pakai kommah ataopeh un ahi leh Pathenin atao naochu asanpeh in ahi
English: Then the Levitical priests arose and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, even to heaven.

tcz: Hiche kut hi akichai jouvin Israel mipite chu Judah khopi jousea acheuvin song khomho, Asherah semthu Pathen limho akhen se uvin chuleh namdang Pathen houna maicham ho jouse asusesoh keijun ahi. Amahon Judah gamsung jouseleh, Benjamin, Ephraim chuleh Manesseh gamsung jousea hitichun abolsoh keijun ahi
en: Now when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah and broke the pillars in pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and broke down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, also in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.
text:
2CH 31:1
Thadou: Hiche kut hi akichai jouvin Israel mipite chu Judah khopi jousea acheuvin song khomho, Asherah semthu Pathen limho akhen se uvin chuleh namdang Pathen houna maicham ho jouse asusesoh keijun ahi. Amahon Judah gamsung jouseleh, Benjamin, Ephraim chuleh Manesseh gamsung jousea hitichun abolsoh keijun ahi
English: Now when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah and broke the pillars in pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and broke down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, also in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

tcz: Hezekiah lengpan thempu holeh Levi te kimanchah ding daan athahsem kitnin hichea hi apanmunu dungjui cheh a atohdiu toh umtha cheh ahi. Thempu holeh Levi hon pumgo thilto atodiu, chamna thilto a tohdiu, houinna Pathen houkhom na – a pan alahdiu dan leh, kipanale thangvah chuleh houin'a jatchom chomma atohding daanhou aboncha ahopsoh ahi
en: Hezekiah appointed the divisions of the priests and the Levites after their divisions, every man according to his service, both the priests and the Levites, for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the LORD’s camp.
text:
2CH 31:2
Thadou: Hezekiah lengpan thempu holeh Levi te kimanchah ding daan athahsem kitnin hichea hi apanmunu dungjui cheh a atohdiu toh umtha cheh ahi. Thempu holeh Levi hon pumgo thilto atodiu, chamna thilto a tohdiu, houinna Pathen houkhom na – a pan alahdiu dan leh, kipanale thangvah chuleh houin'a jatchom chomma atohding daanhou aboncha ahopsoh ahi
English: Hezekiah appointed the divisions of the priests and the Levites after their divisions, every man according to his service, both the priests and the Levites, for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the LORD’s camp.

tcz: Lengpan ama neile ama thilho a konna kipehna, pumgo thilto ding a apehdoh dingho, jingkah nilhah a pumgo thiltoding ahin, cholngah nikho ho a pumgo thilto atoding ahin, lhathah nikho a toding ahin, aphat tepsa kut dinga thilto – a toding ahin, hitia hi Pakai daan thu lekhabu kisun banga chu toding jouse chu atodoh jeng ahi
en: He also appointed the king’s portion of his possessions for the burnt offerings: for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the LORD’s law.
text:
2CH 31:3
Thadou: Lengpan ama neile ama thilho a konna kipehna, pumgo thilto ding a apehdoh dingho, jingkah nilhah a pumgo thiltoding ahin, cholngah nikho ho a pumgo thilto atoding ahin, lhathah nikho a toding ahin, aphat tepsa kut dinga thilto – a toding ahin, hitia hi Pakai daan thu lekhabu kisun banga chu toding jouse chu atodoh jeng ahi
English: He also appointed the king’s portion of his possessions for the burnt offerings: for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the LORD’s law.

tcz: Hiche ban nahin lengpan Jerusalem ma chengho kommah thempu hole Levi hon daan dung jui'a Pakai kin toh na – a akipumpeh theina diuva panhu na thilpeh apehdiuvin thupeh anei jin ahi
en: Moreover he commanded the people who lived in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might give themselves to the LORD’s law.
text:
2CH 31:4
Thadou: Hiche ban nahin lengpan Jerusalem ma chengho kommah thempu hole Levi hon daan dung jui'a Pakai kin toh na – a akipumpeh theina diuva panhu na thilpeh apehdiuvin thupeh anei jin ahi
English: Moreover he commanded the people who lived in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might give themselves to the LORD’s law.

tcz: Hiche thupeh hi akiphondoh jouvin Israel chaten chaang gamasa lengpithei ju leh khoiju chuleh alousoh jouseo thiljousea konna hopsom toh bulhingset nin ahin choijun ahi
en: As soon as the commandment went out, the children of Israel gave in abundance the first fruits of grain, new wine, oil, honey, and of all the increase of the field; and they brought in the tithe of all things abundantly.
text:
2CH 31:5
Thadou: Hiche thupeh hi akiphondoh jouvin Israel chaten chaang gamasa lengpithei ju leh khoiju chuleh alousoh jouseo thiljousea konna hopsom toh bulhingset nin ahin choijun ahi
English: As soon as the commandment went out, the children of Israel gave in abundance the first fruits of grain, new wine, oil, honey, and of all the increase of the field; and they brought in the tithe of all things abundantly.

tcz: Israel teleh Judah te Judah khopiho – a cheng hon bongchal holeh kelngoichal ho hopsom chuleh Pakai a Pathen diuva thil thenga akatdoh hou atamma tam ahin choijun ahi
en: The children of Israel and Judah, who lived in the cities of Judah, also brought in the tithe of cattle and sheep, and the tithe of dedicated things which were consecrated to the LORD their God, and laid them in heaps.
text:
2CH 31:6
Thadou: Israel teleh Judah te Judah khopiho – a cheng hon bongchal holeh kelngoichal ho hopsom chuleh Pakai a Pathen diuva thil thenga akatdoh hou atamma tam ahin choijun ahi
English: The children of Israel and Judah, who lived in the cities of Judah, also brought in the tithe of cattle and sheep, and the tithe of dedicated things which were consecrated to the LORD their God, and laid them in heaps.

tcz: Kipehna a thilpeh ho lhathum channa – a patnin ahung lutpan nin akit lha li channa geijin ahung lutbe jing jenge tamtah akiset tho jengin ahi
en: In the third month, they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.
text:
2CH 31:7
Thadou: Kipehna a thilpeh ho lhathum channa – a patnin ahung lutpan nin akit lha li channa geijin ahung lutbe jing jenge tamtah akiset tho jengin ahi
English: In the third month, they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.

tcz: Hezekiah lengpa leh anoija natong lamkaihon ijatgei hunglut ham ti amuchen nun ahileh Pakai athangvah un chuleh amipi teo jong apahchaovin ahi
en: When Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD and his people Israel.
text:
2CH 31:8
Thadou: Hezekiah lengpa leh anoija natong lamkaihon ijatgei hunglut ham ti amuchen nun ahileh Pakai athangvah un chuleh amipi teo jong apahchaovin ahi
English: When Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD and his people Israel.

tcz: Lengpan thempu hole Levi te komma chun hiche kiphal dohna thilpeh ho thuhi anaseijin ahi
en: Then Hezekiah questioned the priests and the Levites about the heaps.
text:
2CH 31:9
Thadou: Lengpan thempu hole Levi te komma chun hiche kiphal dohna thilpeh ho thuhi anaseijin ahi
English: Then Hezekiah questioned the priests and the Levites about the heaps.

tcz: Chuleh Thempulen Azariah leh Zadok chilhah hochun ama kommah anaseijun “Mipi hon hitobang a kiphal dohna thilpeh ho houinna ahinpeh lutjeh un nehle chah anengin avalleovin ahi. Hiti hohi Pakaiyin amipite phatthei aboh jeh u ahi” atiove
en: Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok, answered him and said, “Since people began to bring the offerings into the LORD’s house, we have eaten and had enough, and have plenty left over, for the LORD has blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.”
text:
2CH 31:10
Thadou: Chuleh Thempulen Azariah leh Zadok chilhah hochun ama kommah anaseijun “Mipi hon hitobang a kiphal dohna thilpeh ho houinna ahinpeh lutjeh un nehle chah anengin avalleovin ahi. Hiti hohi Pakaiyin amipite phatthei aboh jeh u ahi” atiove
English: Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok, answered him and said, “Since people began to bring the offerings into the LORD’s house, we have eaten and had enough, and have plenty left over, for the LORD has blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.”

tcz: Lengpa thupeh dung juiyin amahon houinnah thil koina anagong toh un ahi
en: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare rooms in the LORD’s house, and they prepared them.
text:
2CH 31:11
Thadou: Lengpa thupeh dung juiyin amahon houinnah thil koina anagong toh un ahi
English: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare rooms in the LORD’s house, and they prepared them.

tcz: Hitichun amahon kipeh na thilhole hopsom hochu abitkeina ding munnah anakoitup mun ahi. Amahon Levi mi Cononiah chu hiche vesui dingin ana nganseovin asopipa hi ama kithopidin apansah un ahi
en: They brought in the offerings, the tithes, and the dedicated things faithfully. Conaniah the Levite was ruler over them, and Shimei his brother was second.
text:
2CH 31:12
Thadou: Hitichun amahon kipeh na thilhole hopsom hochu abitkeina ding munnah anakoitup mun ahi. Amahon Levi mi Cononiah chu hiche vesui dingin ana nganseovin asopipa hi ama kithopidin apansah un ahi
English: They brought in the offerings, the tithes, and the dedicated things faithfully. Conaniah the Levite was ruler over them, and Shimei his brother was second.

tcz: Levi te mi 10 (Som) amani noija natong dingin apansah un ahi, Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath leh Benaiah ahiove. Hitobang tohgon hohi lengpa Hezekiah leh thempulen Azariah thaneina noija kitungdoh ahi
en: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of God’s house.
text:
2CH 31:13
Thadou: Levi te mi 10 (Som) amani noija natong dingin apansah un ahi, Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath leh Benaiah ahiove. Hitobang tohgon hohi lengpa Hezekiah leh thempulen Azariah thaneina noija kitungdoh ahi
English: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of God’s house.

tcz: Levi mi Imnah chapa Kore chu houin kelkot solang panga vengtup pipuipen ahin, amahin kipehna thipeh Pakaija kipeh hochu alatup leh ahomdoh a pang ahi
en: Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper at the east gate, was over the free will offerings of God, to distribute the LORD’s offerings and the most holy things.
text:
2CH 31:14
Thadou: Levi mi Imnah chapa Kore chu houin kelkot solang panga vengtup pipuipen ahin, amahin kipehna thipeh Pakaija kipeh hochu alatup leh ahomdoh a pang ahi
English: Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper at the east gate, was over the free will offerings of God, to distribute the LORD’s offerings and the most holy things.

tcz: Thempuho chenna khopi dung ho a chun, ama chu Levi mi hicheng hin ana kithopiovin ahi; Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemiah, Amariah leh Shecaniah ahiove. Amaho hin asopio Levi hochu anatoh u dungjui cheh in kibang cheh in anahom doh jiovin ahi
en: Under him were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their office of trust, to give to their brothers by divisions, to the great as well as to the small;

tcz: Phung le chang dungjuija hilouvin, amahon pasal ho chu kum 30 lhingle achunga hochu houinna amoppoh nao apanmunnu dungjuijin achandiu ahoppeh un ahi
en: in addition to those who were listed by genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even everyone who entered into the LORD’s house, as the duty of every day required, for their service in their offices according to their divisions;

tcz: Thempu hochun aphung dung juiyin tohding apeovin chuleh Levi hochu kum 20 lhingleh atahjo hochu anatoh dungjuijin nganse na aneiyun ahi
en: and those who were listed by genealogy of the priests by their fathers’ houses, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their offices by their divisions;

tcz: Amahochu ajiteo leh achateo chuleh aincheng houdung juiyin aminnu akijihlut nin ahi – ajeh chu amahohin itihphat hijongleh a kinthengu tohna akimanchah theina diuva tohgon hija ahi
en: and those who were listed by genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation; for in their office of trust they sanctified themselves in holiness.
text:
2CH 31:18
Thadou: Amahochu ajiteo leh achateo chuleh aincheng houdung juiyin aminnu akijihlut nin ahi – ajeh chu amahohin itihphat hijongleh a kinthengu tohna akimanchah theina diuva tohgon hija ahi
English: and those who were listed by genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation; for in their office of trust they sanctified themselves in holiness.

tcz: Khopi a cheng thempu ho lah a kinganse Aaron chilhah ho ahoilouleh hiche khopia chengho thinglhang gamma umho ahin hiche holah a mopohna neihohin thempu insunga pasalho leh Levi phungmi amin kijihlut ho jouse kommah nehle chah hommin apangun ahi
en: Also for the sons of Aaron the priests, who were in the fields of the pasture lands of their cities, in every city, there were men who were mentioned by name to give portions to all the males among the priests and to all who were listed by genealogy among the Levites.
text:
2CH 31:19
Thadou: Khopi a cheng thempu ho lah a kinganse Aaron chilhah ho ahoilouleh hiche khopia chengho thinglhang gamma umho ahin hiche holah a mopohna neihohin thempu insunga pasalho leh Levi phungmi amin kijihlut ho jouse kommah nehle chah hommin apangun ahi
English: Also for the sons of Aaron the priests, who were in the fields of the pasture lands of their cities, in every city, there were men who were mentioned by name to give portions to all the males among the priests and to all who were listed by genealogy among the Levites.

tcz: Hezekiah lengpan Judah ho jouse kommah Pakai Pathen mitmua adihjeng abollin Pathen alung lhaisah in ahi
en: Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before the LORD his God.
text:
2CH 31:20
Thadou: Hezekiah lengpan Judah ho jouse kommah Pakai Pathen mitmua adihjeng abollin Pathen alung lhaisah in ahi
English: Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before the LORD his God.

tcz: Amahi atohna jouse alolhingin ahi. Ajeh chu aman houin chung changa atoh ahin chuleh mipin daan ajuija na diuva atoh ahin Pathenna kitah nanei tah a atoh jeh ahi
en: In every work that he began in the service of God’s house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart and prospered.
text:
2CH 31:21
Thadou: Amahi atohna jouse alolhingin ahi. Ajeh chu aman houin chung changa atoh ahin chuleh mipin daan ajuija na diuva atoh ahin Pathenna kitah nanei tah a atoh jeh ahi
English: In every work that he began in the service of God’s house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart and prospered.

tcz: Hezekiah lengpa hin kitahna neitah a Pakai lungdeilam ahollai tah in Assyria lengpa Sennacherib hin Judah gam sung ahin bulutan ahi. Aman kulkikai khum khopiho ahin lonvuhtan chuleh asepaite chu kulpi palhochu vochipma khopi sunga lutdingin thu apen ahi
en: After these things and this faithfulness, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, entered into Judah, encamped against the fortified cities, and intended to win them for himself.
text:
2CH 32:1
Thadou: Hezekiah lengpa hin kitahna neitah a Pakai lungdeilam ahollai tah in Assyria lengpa Sennacherib hin Judah gam sung ahin bulutan ahi. Aman kulkikai khum khopiho ahin lonvuhtan chuleh asepaite chu kulpi palhochu vochipma khopi sunga lutdingin thu apen ahi
English: After these things and this faithfulness, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, entered into Judah, encamped against the fortified cities, and intended to win them for himself.

tcz: Sennacherib min Jerusalem khopi ahin nokhumtai ti amu phatnin,
en: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come, and that he was planning to fight against Jerusalem,
text:
2CH 32:2
Thadou: Sennacherib min Jerusalem khopi ahin nokhumtai ti amu phatnin,
English: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come, and that he was planning to fight against Jerusalem,

tcz: Amanam a noija lamkai holeh sepai lamkai hotoh akihoutoh in khopi polamma longdoh twi chu sutang ding tin aki loltaove
en: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the springs which were outside of the city, and they helped him.
text:
2CH 32:3
Thadou: Amanam a noija lamkai holeh sepai lamkai hotoh akihoutoh in khopi polamma longdoh twi chu sutang ding tin aki loltaove
English: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the springs which were outside of the city, and they helped him.

tcz: Hitichun mitamtah akikhom doh un twi gamsunga long lutjouse chu asutang gammun hitin aseijuve: “Ipi dinga Assyria lengpa chu hunga twi neng jeng junga amuthei diu ham?” atiove
en: Then many people gathered together and they stopped all the springs and the brook that flowed through the middle of the land, saying, “Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find abundant water?”
text:
2CH 32:4
Thadou: Hitichun mitamtah akikhom doh un twi gamsunga long lutjouse chu asutang gammun hitin aseijuve: “Ipi dinga Assyria lengpa chu hunga twi neng jeng junga amuthei diu ham?” atiove
English: Then many people gathered together and they stopped all the springs and the brook that flowed through the middle of the land, saying, “Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find abundant water?”

tcz: Hitichun aman khopi chim hochu asemphan khopi sunga panmun akisem toh'in akisuh hatnin pal chunga insang hojong atungdoh in chuleh polanga palchom jong asemben, galmanchah holeh ompho hojong neng chetnin asemmin ahi
en: He took courage, built up all the wall that was broken down, and raised it up to the towers, with the other wall outside, and strengthened Millo in David’s city, and made weapons and shields in abundance.
text:
2CH 32:5
Thadou: Hitichun aman khopi chim hochu asemphan khopi sunga panmun akisem toh'in akisuh hatnin pal chunga insang hojong atungdoh in chuleh polanga palchom jong asemben, galmanchah holeh ompho hojong neng chetnin asemmin ahi
English: He took courage, built up all the wall that was broken down, and raised it up to the towers, with the other wall outside, and strengthened Millo in David’s city, and made weapons and shields in abundance.

tcz: Hiche banna chun aman aman khopi sunga mipi hochu sepai lamkaiho noija akoiyin amahochun khopi kelkot kom mun onglai jachun akhommin hitihin ajah uva chun tilkhou na thu aseijin ahi
en: He set captains of war over the people, gathered them together to him in the wide place at the gate of the city, and spoke encouragingly to them, saying,
text:
2CH 32:6
Thadou: Hiche banna chun aman aman khopi sunga mipi hochu sepai lamkaiho noija akoiyin amahochun khopi kelkot kom mun onglai jachun akhommin hitihin ajah uva chun tilkhou na thu aseijin ahi
English: He set captains of war over the people, gathered them together to him in the wide place at the gate of the city, and spoke encouragingly to them, saying,

tcz: ”Hatnunglang hangun Assyria lengpa leh ahinkilhon pi mihonpi jehkhun kicha hih un, ajeh chu ama umpiho sangin eiho umpi ho atamjouve” ati
en: “Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or dismayed because of the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude who is with him; for there is a greater one with us than with him.
text:
2CH 32:7
Thadou: ”Hatnunglang hangun Assyria lengpa leh ahinkilhon pi mihonpi jehkhun kicha hih un, ajeh chu ama umpiho sangin eiho umpi ho atamjouve” ati
English: “Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or dismayed because of the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude who is with him; for there is a greater one with us than with him.

tcz: Ajeh chu ama umpi hohi tahsaphe muthei sepaiho ahiove amavang eiho ei umpiova chu Pakai Pathen ahin amatah in igallu hi eisat hu pehdiu ahi” ati. Hiti hin Judah lengpa Hezekiah thucheng hohin mipi hochu alung ngamsah in ahan sansah lheh jengtan ahi
en: An arm of flesh is with him, but the LORD our God is with us to help us and to fight our battles.” The people rested themselves on the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
text:
2CH 32:8
Thadou: Ajeh chu ama umpi hohi tahsaphe muthei sepaiho ahiove amavang eiho ei umpiova chu Pakai Pathen ahin amatah in igallu hi eisat hu pehdiu ahi” ati. Hiti hin Judah lengpa Hezekiah thucheng hohin mipi hochu alung ngamsah in ahan sansah lheh jengtan ahi
English: An arm of flesh is with him, but the LORD our God is with us to help us and to fight our battles.” The people rested themselves on the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

tcz: Hiche jouhin Assyria lengpa Sennacherib chun asoh teho chu Jerusalem langah asollin , Judah lengpa Hezekiah leh Jerusalem ma um Judah te jouse komma chun aseisah in:
en: After this, Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem, (now he was attacking Lachish, and all his forces were with him), to Hezekiah king of Judah, and to all Judah who were at Jerusalem, saying,
text:
2CH 32:9
Thadou: Hiche jouhin Assyria lengpa Sennacherib chun asoh teho chu Jerusalem langah asollin , Judah lengpa Hezekiah leh Jerusalem ma um Judah te jouse komma chun aseisah in:
English: After this, Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem, (now he was attacking Lachish, and all his forces were with him), to Hezekiah king of Judah, and to all Judah who were at Jerusalem, saying,

tcz: Assyria lengpa Sennacherib min hitin aseije ipi kisonpi nanei juva kalonvuh khumsa Jerusalem mahi nahiti um ngamu ham?
en: Sennacherib king of Assyria says, “In whom do you trust, that you remain under siege in Jerusalem?
text:
2CH 32:10
