Thadou: Assyria lengpa Sennacherib min hitin aseije ipi kisonpi nanei juva kalonvuh khumsa Jerusalem mahi nahiti um ngamu ham?
English: Sennacherib king of Assyria says, “In whom do you trust, that you remain under siege in Jerusalem?

tcz: Nalengpao Hezekiah in Pakai na Pathenun keiho lengpa a konna nahuh diuva asei chu najou lhepmu ahin, gilkel le dangchah a nathisah gamgot nu ahibouve
en: Doesn’t Hezekiah persuade you to give you over to die by famine and by thirst, saying, ‘The LORD our God will deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria’?
text:
2CH 32:11
Thadou: Nalengpao Hezekiah in Pakai na Pathenun keiho lengpa a konna nahuh diuva asei chu najou lhepmu ahin, gilkel le dangchah a nathisah gamgot nu ahibouve
English: Doesn’t Hezekiah persuade you to give you over to die by famine and by thirst, saying, ‘The LORD our God will deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria’?

tcz: Ama hilouham houdang maicham leh halnam ho susea Judah te Jerusalem mipi te jah a houkhat seh leh maicham khatsehbou neiding tia chu Hezekiah hilouham?
en: Hasn’t the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You shall worship before one altar, and you shall burn incense on it’?
text:
2CH 32:12
Thadou: Ama hilouham houdang maicham leh halnam ho susea Judah te Jerusalem mipi te jah a houkhat seh leh maicham khatsehbou neiding tia chu Hezekiah hilouham?
English: Hasn’t the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You shall worship before one altar, and you shall burn incense on it’?

tcz: Kapu kapateo leh keiman nam dang ho chunga katohnaohi nahet lou uham? Namdnagho pathen hon Assyria lengpa – a konna amite ahuhhing jou mong mong ngam?
en: Don’t you know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands? Were the gods of the nations of those lands in any way able to deliver their land out of my hand?
text:
2CH 32:13
Thadou: Kapu kapateo leh keiman nam dang ho chunga katohnaohi nahet lou uham? Namdnagho pathen hon Assyria lengpa – a konna amite ahuhhing jou mong mong ngam?
English: Don’t you know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands? Were the gods of the nations of those lands in any way able to deliver their land out of my hand?

tcz: Itih monga gamdang pathen nin agammi keihoa konna ahuhdoh jou beh am? Ahileh tua chu iti nangai touva na Pathennu chun keihoa konna nahuhdoh joudiuva chu ipin nakinepsah uham?
en: Who was there among all the gods of those nations which my fathers utterly destroyed that could deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?
text:
2CH 32:14
Thadou: Itih monga gamdang pathen nin agammi keihoa konna ahuhdoh jou beh am? Ahileh tua chu iti nangai touva na Pathennu chun keihoa konna nahuhdoh joudiuva chu ipin nakinepsah uham?
English: Who was there among all the gods of those nations which my fathers utterly destroyed that could deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?

tcz: Phatah in kingai touvin Hezekiah chu hitichun ki lheplhah sah hih un, Tahsan hih un koimacha nam pathen nin Assyria lengpa – a kon in amite ahuhdoh jou pon ahi. Tahbeh in nangho Pathen nin jong kei hoa konna nang ho nahuhdoh joubeh dingham?
en: Now therefore don’t let Hezekiah deceive you nor persuade you in this way. Don’t believe him, for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers. How much less will your God deliver you out of my hand?”
text:
2CH 32:15
Thadou: Phatah in kingai touvin Hezekiah chu hitichun ki lheplhah sah hih un, Tahsan hih un koimacha nam pathen nin Assyria lengpa – a kon in amite ahuhdoh jou pon ahi. Tahbeh in nangho Pathen nin jong kei hoa konna nang ho nahuhdoh joubeh dingham?
English: Now therefore don’t let Hezekiah deceive you nor persuade you in this way. Don’t believe him, for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers. How much less will your God deliver you out of my hand?”

tcz: Assyria lamkai hochun Pakai Pathen leh Pathen sohpa Hezekiah demna chu thilthang hoi tah tahjong aseijun ahi
en: His servants spoke yet more against the LORD God and against his servant Hezekiah.
text:
2CH 32:16
Thadou: Assyria lamkai hochun Pakai Pathen leh Pathen sohpa Hezekiah demna chu thilthang hoi tah tahjong aseijun ahi
English: His servants spoke yet more against the LORD God and against his servant Hezekiah.

tcz: Assyria lengpan athot lekha chun Israel Pakai Pathen chu aha dem lheh jengin ahi. Hichun aseije: “Namdnag ho pathenin katha nein a – a kon in amiteo ahuhdoh jou pouvin ahi, Hezekiah Pathennin jong keija kon in amite huhdoh joupon te” atin ahi
en: He also wrote letters insulting the LORD, the God of Israel, and speaking against him, saying, “As the gods of the nations of the lands, which have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall the God of Hezekiah not deliver his people out of my hand.”
text:
2CH 32:17
Thadou: Assyria lengpan athot lekha chun Israel Pakai Pathen chu aha dem lheh jengin ahi. Hichun aseije: “Namdnag ho pathenin katha nein a – a kon in amiteo ahuhdoh jou pouvin ahi, Hezekiah Pathennin jong keija kon in amite huhdoh joupon te” atin ahi
English: He also wrote letters insulting the LORD, the God of Israel, and speaking against him, saying, “As the gods of the nations of the lands, which have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall the God of Hezekiah not deliver his people out of my hand.”

tcz: Amahon mipi hetding chun Hebrew paovin Jerusalem mipiho leh palchunga umho jahdinga ahet thei dingu chuleh lungneosah ding hitia chu bailamtah a jothei nading atio ahi
en: They called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to frighten them and to trouble them, that they might take the city.
text:
2CH 32:18
Thadou: Amahon mipi hetding chun Hebrew paovin Jerusalem mipiho leh palchunga umho jahdinga ahet thei dingu chuleh lungneosah ding hitia chu bailamtah a jothei nading atio ahi
English: They called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to frighten them and to trouble them, that they might take the city.

tcz: Judate Pathen chu nam dang dangho semthu pathen toh kibanga aseikhum jengu ahi
en: They spoke of the God of Jerusalem as of the gods of the peoples of the earth, which are the work of men’s hands.
text:
2CH 32:19
Thadou: Judate Pathen chu nam dang dangho semthu pathen toh kibanga aseikhum jengu ahi
English: They spoke of the God of Jerusalem as of the gods of the peoples of the earth, which are the work of men’s hands.

tcz: Tun Hezekiah lengpa leh Isaiah Amoz chapa chu Pathen hengah kaple pengin ataolhon tan ahi
en: Hezekiah the king and Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, prayed because of this, and cried to heaven.
text:
2CH 32:20
Thadou: Tun Hezekiah lengpa leh Isaiah Amoz chapa chu Pathen hengah kaple pengin ataolhon tan ahi
English: Hezekiah the king and Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, prayed because of this, and cried to heaven.

tcz: Hijouchun avantil khat ahin sollin hiche vantil chun mihang mihat, lamkai Assyria lengpa sepai hojouse chu athat gamhel tan ahi. Hichun ama jahchatah leh jumtah in agamma akile tan ahi. Hichun aman asemthu Pathen houinna aum sungin achate alut un chemjam min asat lih taovin ahi
en: The LORD sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valor, the leaders, and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. When he had come into the house of his god, those who came out of his own body killed him there with the sword.
text:
2CH 32:21
Thadou: Hijouchun avantil khat ahin sollin hiche vantil chun mihang mihat, lamkai Assyria lengpa sepai hojouse chu athat gamhel tan ahi. Hichun ama jahchatah leh jumtah in agamma akile tan ahi. Hichun aman asemthu Pathen houinna aum sungin achate alut un chemjam min asat lih taovin ahi
English: The LORD sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valor, the leaders, and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. When he had come into the house of his god, those who came out of his own body killed him there with the sword.

tcz: Hitichun Pakaiyin Hezekiah lengpa leh Jerusalem mipi techu Assyria lengpa leh galmi danghoa kon in ahuhdoh tan ahi. Hitichun Pathenin amite chu avelluva cheng gamsung mihoa kon in jong chamna alensah taan ahi
en: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria and from the hand of all others, and guided them on every side.
text:
2CH 32:22
Thadou: Hitichun Pakaiyin Hezekiah lengpa leh Jerusalem mipi techu Assyria lengpa leh galmi danghoa kon in ahuhdoh tan ahi. Hitichun Pathenin amite chu avelluva cheng gamsung mihoa kon in jong chamna alensah taan ahi
English: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria and from the hand of all others, and guided them on every side.

tcz: Mitamtah in Jerusalem Pakai jadingin kiphaldohna thilpeh ahin choijun chuleh Judah lengpa Hezekiah dingin kipa thilpeh ahung peovin hichea konhin Hezekiah chu namtin lah a choisangin a um taan ahi
en: Many brought gifts to the LORD to Jerusalem, and precious things to Hezekiah king of Judah, so that he was exalted in the sight of all nations from then on.
text:
2CH 32:23
Thadou: Mitamtah in Jerusalem Pakai jadingin kiphaldohna thilpeh ahin choijun chuleh Judah lengpa Hezekiah dingin kipa thilpeh ahung peovin hichea konhin Hezekiah chu namtin lah a choisangin a um taan ahi
English: Many brought gifts to the LORD to Jerusalem, and precious things to Hezekiah king of Judah, so that he was exalted in the sight of all nations from then on.

tcz: Hichephat laisung hin Hezekiah chu ahung dammotan athi kon ahitaan, Pathen komma ataovin ahileh Pathenin nadamdoh ding ahinai atin melchih nakhat apen ahi
en: In those days Hezekiah was terminally ill, and he prayed to the LORD; and he spoke to him, and gave him a sign.
text:
2CH 32:24
Thadou: Hichephat laisung hin Hezekiah chu ahung dammotan athi kon ahitaan, Pathen komma ataovin ahileh Pathenin nadamdoh ding ahinai atin melchih nakhat apen ahi
English: In those days Hezekiah was terminally ill, and he prayed to the LORD; and he spoke to him, and gave him a sign.

tcz: Ahinlah Hezekiah chu Pakaiyin Judah leh Jerusalem chuleh amachunga thilpha abolpeh ho chunga kipathu seithei loukhop min ahung kiletsah taan hijechun amachung leh Judah le Jerusalem chunga chun Pathen lunghan na ahung chu tan ahi.
en: But Hezekiah didn’t reciprocate appropriate to the benefit done for him, because his heart was lifted up. Therefore there was wrath on him, Judah, and Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 32:25
Thadou: Ahinlah Hezekiah chu Pakaiyin Judah leh Jerusalem chuleh amachunga thilpha abolpeh ho chunga kipathu seithei loukhop min ahung kiletsah taan hijechun amachung leh Judah le Jerusalem chunga chun Pathen lunghan na ahung chu tan ahi.
English: But Hezekiah didn’t reciprocate appropriate to the benefit done for him, because his heart was lifted up. Therefore there was wrath on him, Judah, and Jerusalem.

tcz: Hiphat chun amaleh Judah te leh Jerusalem miteho nasatah in akisunem mun ahileh Hezekiah hinlai sungin achung'uva hunglhung ding hochu asoh tapon ahi
en: However, Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the LORD’s wrath didn’t come on them in the days of Hezekiah.
text:
2CH 32:26
Thadou: Hiphat chun amaleh Judah te leh Jerusalem miteho nasatah in akisunem mun ahileh Hezekiah hinlai sungin achung'uva hunglhung ding hochu asoh tapon ahi
English: However, Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the LORD’s wrath didn’t come on them in the days of Hezekiah.

tcz: Hezekiah chun neilegou ahaolheh jengtaan jana lentah jong achangin ahi. Aman sana le dangka chuleh song mantam, namtwi ho, ompho holeh thilman tamtah ho koinading dankhat jong asaovin ahi
en: Hezekiah had exceedingly great riches and honor. He provided himself with treasuries for silver, for gold, for precious stones, for spices, for shields, and for all kinds of valuable vessels;

tcz: Hiche chung chonnin jong chang le mim, lengpitwi chuleh Olive thao le ganchaho koitup na ding chuleh kelngoi chalho inding akikolkhum agetpeh in ahi
en: also storehouses for the increase of grain, new wine, and oil; and stalls for all kinds of animals, and flocks in folds.
text:
2CH 32:28
Thadou: Hiche chung chonnin jong chang le mim, lengpitwi chuleh Olive thao le ganchaho koitup na ding chuleh kelngoi chalho inding akikolkhum agetpeh in ahi
English: also storehouses for the increase of grain, new wine, and oil; and stalls for all kinds of animals, and flocks in folds.

tcz: Hicheho banna hin Pathennin kelngoi gancha jatchom chom tamtah leh neile gou tamtah anapen khopi tamtah jong anatun dohsah in ahi
en: Moreover he provided for himself cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance; for God had given him abundant possessions.
text:
2CH 32:29
Thadou: Hicheho banna hin Pathennin kelngoi gancha jatchom chom tamtah leh neile gou tamtah anapen khopi tamtah jong anatun dohsah in ahi
English: Moreover he provided for himself cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance; for God had given him abundant possessions.

tcz: Hichu Hezekiah hin Gihon vadung twilondoh na achungnungjo jongchu ana ting tangin David khopi nilhum lang ngin asuh lonsah in ahi. Hiche Hezekiah hi atoh na lam lammah akhangtou lheh jengin ahi
en: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper spring of the waters of Gihon, and brought them straight down on the west side of David’s city. Hezekiah prospered in all his works.
text:
2CH 32:30
Thadou: Hichu Hezekiah hin Gihon vadung twilondoh na achungnungjo jongchu ana ting tangin David khopi nilhum lang ngin asuh lonsah in ahi. Hiche Hezekiah hi atoh na lam lammah akhangtou lheh jengin ahi
English: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper spring of the waters of Gihon, and brought them straight down on the west side of David’s city. Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

tcz: Babylon khopi lhalheng hon hiche gamsunga thil kidang tah tah sohdoh ho kholtoh dinga ahung u chun Pathennin apatepmin achanglha tan ahi
en: However, concerning the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent to him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him to test him, that he might know all that was in his heart.
text:
2CH 32:31
Thadou: Babylon khopi lhalheng hon hiche gamsunga thil kidang tah tah sohdoh ho kholtoh dinga ahung u chun Pathennin apatepmin achanglha tan ahi
English: However, concerning the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent to him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him to test him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

tcz: Hezekiah lengpan athil bol jouse leh Pakaija akipeh na ho jouse chu Amos chapa Isaiah gaothilmu hotoh Judah leh Israel lengte thusim kijih na lekhabu a akijih lutsoh keijin ahi
en: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah and his good deeds, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
text:
2CH 32:32
Thadou: Hezekiah lengpan athil bol jouse leh Pakaija akipeh na ho jouse chu Amos chapa Isaiah gaothilmu hotoh Judah leh Israel lengte thusim kijih na lekhabu a akijih lutsoh keijin ahi
English: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah and his good deeds, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

tcz: Hezekiah athiphatnin lengte kivuina na lhaan achungnung pa achun avuijun ahi. Judah holeh Jerusalem mipiten athichun jana nasatah anapeovin ahi, Hitichun achapa Manasseh in lengmun alo taan ahi
en: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the ascent to the tombs of the sons of David. All Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem honored him at his death. Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
text:
2CH 32:33
Thadou: Hezekiah athiphatnin lengte kivuina na lhaan achungnung pa achun avuijun ahi. Judah holeh Jerusalem mipiten athichun jana nasatah anapeovin ahi, Hitichun achapa Manasseh in lengmun alo taan ahi
English: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the ascent to the tombs of the sons of David. All Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem honored him at his death. Manasseh his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Manasseh leng ahung chanchun kum 12 bep anahin aman Jerusalem mah kum 55 geijin vai ana hommin ahi
en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 33:1
Thadou: Manasseh leng ahung chanchun kum 12 bep anahin aman Jerusalem mah kum 55 geijin vai ana hommin ahi
English: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

tcz: Amahin Pakaiyin Israel chate masanga anano doh namdangho chonna kidah umtah ho chonna chu anache pi in Pakai mitmun thilse ngen abollin ahi
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
text:
2CH 33:2
Thadou: Amahin Pakaiyin Israel chate masanga anano doh namdangho chonna kidah umtah ho chonna chu anache pi in Pakai mitmun thilse ngen abollin ahi
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

tcz: Amahin apa Hezekiah in ana vohlhuh munsang hochu anasapha kitnin, Baal doihouna anatung doh kitnin pathen lim semthu Asherah doi hochu ana tungdoh kitnin ahi
en: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down; and he raised up altars for the Baals, made Asheroth, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.
text:
2CH 33:3
Thadou: Amahin apa Hezekiah in ana vohlhuh munsang hochu anasapha kitnin, Baal doihouna anatung doh kitnin pathen lim semthu Asherah doi hochu ana tungdoh kitnin ahi
English: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down; and he raised up altars for the Baals, made Asheroth, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.

tcz: Aman Pakai houinmai leh amiten ama ahin houna ding mun atiova chun semthu pathen houna maicham atungdoh kitnin ahi
en: He built altars in the LORD’s house, of which the LORD said, “My name shall be in Jerusalem forever.”
text:
2CH 33:4
Thadou: Aman Pakai houinmai leh amiten ama ahin houna ding mun atiova chun semthu pathen houna maicham atungdoh kitnin ahi
English: He built altars in the LORD’s house, of which the LORD said, “My name shall be in Jerusalem forever.”

tcz: Pakai houin na hongcha teni a chun ahsi ho houna maicham anatung doh in ahi
en: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 33:5
Thadou: Pakai houin na hongcha teni a chun ahsi ho houna maicham anatung doh in ahi
English: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of the LORD’s house.

tcz: Hinnom phaicham mah achate pumgo thilto in anakatdoh in ahi. Themka pou anadongin, ailhimjong jong, phunsan jong anachepin, thillha gaochang mijong ana tahsannin mitphel doithem hojong anamangin. Hiti hin Pakai mitmun thet um tahtah anabol doh in Pathen ana phin lung hangin ahi
en: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom. He practiced sorcery, divination, and witchcraft, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.
text:
2CH 33:6
Thadou: Hinnom phaicham mah achate pumgo thilto in anakatdoh in ahi. Themka pou anadongin, ailhimjong jong, phunsan jong anachepin, thillha gaochang mijong ana tahsannin mitphel doithem hojong anamangin. Hiti hin Pakai mitmun thet um tahtah anabol doh in Pathen ana phin lung hangin ahi
English: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom. He practiced sorcery, divination, and witchcraft, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

tcz: Hiti in Manasseh hin milim doihou najong Pathen houin sungah anatungdoh in ahi hiche houin chung changa Pathennin David le achapa Solomon jah a anasei, “Hiche houin sung le keiman Israel phung hijat laha kalhen dohsa Jerusalem khopi sunga hi a itihchan na jong keima eiki houjing nading munna kalhen doh ahi
en: He set the engraved image of the idol, which he had made, in God’s house, of which God said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.
text:
2CH 33:7
Thadou: Hiti in Manasseh hin milim doihou najong Pathen houin sungah anatungdoh in ahi hiche houin chung changa Pathennin David le achapa Solomon jah a anasei, “Hiche houin sung le keiman Israel phung hijat laha kalhen dohsa Jerusalem khopi sunga hi a itihchan na jong keima eiki houjing nading munna kalhen doh ahi
English: He set the engraved image of the idol, which he had made, in God’s house, of which God said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.

tcz: “Chuleh Israel mipiten kathupeh hi ajuijuva chuleh kalhacha pa Mosen anapeh u daanchu anit uva ahileh apu apateo kanapeh gam ma konna koima kakaidoh sah louhelding ahi”
en: I will not any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law, the statutes, and the ordinances given by Moses.”
text:
2CH 33:8
Thadou: “Chuleh Israel mipiten kathupeh hi ajuijuva chuleh kalhacha pa Mosen anapeh u daanchu anit uva ahileh apu apateo kanapeh gam ma konna koima kakaidoh sah louhelding ahi”
English: I will not any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law, the statutes, and the ordinances given by Moses.”

tcz: Manasseh in Judah mipi te achonset sah hi keiman kamite ahung kitolluva kana nodoh peh namdang ho chonset sangin agimnei jon ahi.
en: Manasseh seduced Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that they did more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.
text:
2CH 33:9
Thadou: Manasseh in Judah mipi te achonset sah hi keiman kamite ahung kitolluva kana nodoh peh namdang ho chonset sangin agimnei jon ahi.
English: Manasseh seduced Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that they did more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.

tcz: Pakaiyin Manasseh leh amipi te anagih vang'in amahon ana nahsah pouvin ahi
en: The LORD spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they didn’t listen.
text:
2CH 33:10
Thadou: Pakaiyin Manasseh leh amipi te anagih vang'in amahon ana nahsah pouvin ahi
English: The LORD spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they didn’t listen.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Assyria sepaite atildoh in Judahte chungah gal abolsah in, amahon Manasseh chu aman nun thihkol toh abutaovin thih khaovin akan nun Babylon nah akailut nun ahi
en: Therefore the LORD brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
text:
2CH 33:11
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Assyria sepaite atildoh in Judahte chungah gal abolsah in, amahon Manasseh chu aman nun thihkol toh abutaovin thih khaovin akan nun Babylon nah akailut nun ahi
English: Therefore the LORD brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

tcz: Ahahsat phatnin ahung kineosah in a Pakai a Pathen nah ahung kiheilut nin kithopi athummin ahi
en: When he was in distress, he begged the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
text:
2CH 33:12
Thadou: Ahahsat phatnin ahung kineosah in a Pakai a Pathen nah ahung kiheilut nin kithopi athummin ahi
English: When he was in distress, he begged the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

tcz: Pathen nin Manasseh taona asangin Jerusalemma ale sollin avaihom sahkitnin ahi. Hiche phat chun Manasseh in Pakai chu Pathen tahbeh ahi ahechen taan ahi
en: He prayed to him; and he was entreated by him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD was God.
text:
2CH 33:13
Thadou: Pathen nin Manasseh taona asangin Jerusalemma ale sollin avaihom sahkitnin ahi. Hiche phat chun Manasseh in Pakai chu Pathen tahbeh ahi ahechen taan ahi
English: He prayed to him; and he was entreated by him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD was God.

tcz: Hiche jouhin Manasseh chun David khopi solang panga chun polang pal chu asesangin, nga kelkot sahleng Gihon twiphul kom phaicham ma kon in Ophel kiti khopi kom geijin pal chu asesangin ahi. Kul kiget khum Judah khopi ho khatcheh a chun sepai aloi loijin lamkai khatnoija akoiyin ahi
en: Now after this, he built an outer wall to David’s city on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance at the fish gate. He encircled Ophel with it, and raised it up to a very great height; and he put valiant captains in all the fortified cities of Judah.
text:
2CH 33:14
Thadou: Hiche jouhin Manasseh chun David khopi solang panga chun polang pal chu asesangin, nga kelkot sahleng Gihon twiphul kom phaicham ma kon in Ophel kiti khopi kom geijin pal chu asesangin ahi. Kul kiget khum Judah khopi ho khatcheh a chun sepai aloi loijin lamkai khatnoija akoiyin ahi
English: Now after this, he built an outer wall to David’s city on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance at the fish gate. He encircled Ophel with it, and raised it up to a very great height; and he put valiant captains in all the fortified cities of Judah.

tcz: Houin na konchun gamdang pathen holeh milim semthu aman anakoi holeh, namdang maicham thinglhanga atundoh nao ahouin houleh Jerusalem mundang danga umho chu aladoh sohkeijin aga paimang jengin ahi
en: He took away the foreign gods and the idol out of the LORD’s house, and all the altars that he had built in the mountain of the LORD’s house and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.
text:
2CH 33:15
Thadou: Houin na konchun gamdang pathen holeh milim semthu aman anakoi holeh, namdang maicham thinglhanga atundoh nao ahouin houleh Jerusalem mundang danga umho chu aladoh sohkeijin aga paimang jengin ahi
English: He took away the foreign gods and the idol out of the LORD’s house, and all the altars that he had built in the mountain of the LORD’s house and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.

tcz: Aman Pakai ahounao maicham jongchu asemphan ahi, hiche chunga chun chamna thilto leh thangvah na thilto abollin ahi, aman Judah mipi techu Israel Pathen Pakai chu nahou diu ahitin thu apen ahi
en: He built up the LORD’s altar, and offered sacrifices of peace offerings and of thanksgiving on it, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD, the God of Israel.
text:
2CH 33:16
Thadou: Aman Pakai ahounao maicham jongchu asemphan ahi, hiche chunga chun chamna thilto leh thangvah na thilto abollin ahi, aman Judah mipi techu Israel Pathen Pakai chu nahou diu ahitin thu apen ahi
English: He built up the LORD’s altar, and offered sacrifices of peace offerings and of thanksgiving on it, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD, the God of Israel.

tcz: Ahin lah mipi hochun munsang dunga pumgo thilto chu achepi jing nalaijun ahi, ahivangin Pakai Pathen komma bou abol taovin ahi
en: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed in the high places, but only to the LORD their God.
text:
2CH 33:17
Thadou: Ahin lah mipi hochun munsang dunga pumgo thilto chu achepi jing nalaijun ahi, ahivangin Pakai Pathen komma bou abol taovin ahi
English: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed in the high places, but only to the LORD their God.

tcz: Manasseh in anabol jouse, Pathen henga ataona, themgao hon Pathen minna akom ma thu aseihou abonchan Israel lengte thusim bua abonchan akijhlut sohkei jin ahi
en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, behold, they are written among the acts of the kings of Israel.
text:
2CH 33:18
Thadou: Manasseh in anabol jouse, Pathen henga ataona, themgao hon Pathen minna akom ma thu aseihou abonchan Israel lengte thusim bua abonchan akijhlut sohkei jin ahi
English: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, behold, they are written among the acts of the kings of Israel.

tcz: Lengpa taonaleh Pathennin adonbutna alung ahin hei masanga achonset na ho jouse le thilse abolho, namdnag pathen houna le adoihou munchom chomma atundoh ho jouse chu themgao ho thusim bua akijih lut nin ahi
en: His prayer also, and how God listened to his request, and all his sin and his trespass, and the places in which he built high places and set up the Asherah poles and the engraved images before he humbled himself: behold, they are written in the history of Hozai.
text:
2CH 33:19
Thadou: Lengpa taonaleh Pathennin adonbutna alung ahin hei masanga achonset na ho jouse le thilse abolho, namdnag pathen houna le adoihou munchom chomma atundoh ho jouse chu themgao ho thusim bua akijih lut nin ahi
English: His prayer also, and how God listened to his request, and all his sin and his trespass, and the places in which he built high places and set up the Asherah poles and the engraved images before he humbled himself: behold, they are written in the history of Hozai.

tcz: Manasseh athiphat nin khopi sungah avuijun achapa Amon nin lengmun alotan ahi
en: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house; and Amon his son reigned in his place.
text:
2CH 33:20
Thadou: Manasseh athiphat nin khopi sungah avuijun achapa Amon nin lengmun alotan ahi
English: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house; and Amon his son reigned in his place.

tcz: Amon chu Juda gamma leng ahung chanchun kum 22 alhingtan ahi, amahin Jerusalema kum ni aleng chang ngin ahi
en: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 33:21
Thadou: Amon chu Juda gamma leng ahung chanchun kum 22 alhingtan ahi, amahin Jerusalema kum ni aleng chang ngin ahi
English: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.

tcz: Ama apa Manasseh bangin Pakai dounan achonse tan ahi aman apan anahou doiho chu ana houvin ahi
en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as did Manasseh his father; and Amon sacrificed to all the engraved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them.
text:
2CH 33:22
Thadou: Ama apa Manasseh bangin Pakai dounan achonse tan ahi aman apan anahou doiho chu ana houvin ahi
English: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as did Manasseh his father; and Amon sacrificed to all the engraved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them.

tcz: Ahinlah apa banhgin Pakai anga kisuhnem na anabol pon apa sangin chonset ana ha boljon ahi
en: He didn’t humble himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more and more.
text:
2CH 33:23
Thadou: Ahinlah apa banhgin Pakai anga kisuhnem na anabol pon apa sangin chonset ana ha boljon ahi
English: He didn’t humble himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more and more.

tcz: Amon noija natong lamkai ho chu ana kihoutoh un leng inpi sunga chun ana that taovin ahi
en: His servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.
text:
2CH 33:24
Thadou: Amon noija natong lamkai ho chu ana kihoutoh un leng inpi sunga chun ana that taovin ahi
English: His servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.

tcz: Judah mipiten Amon that hochu ana thatdoh un achapa Josiah chu leng anachan sah un ahi
en: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.
text:
2CH 33:25
Thadou: Judah mipiten Amon that hochu ana thatdoh un achapa Josiah chu leng anachan sah un ahi
English: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.

tcz: Josiah Judah gamma leng ahung chan chun kum 5 bou anahi nalaijin ahi, chuleh Jerusalem ma chun kum31 vai anahom min ahi
en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 34:1
Thadou: Josiah Judah gamma leng ahung chan chun kum 5 bou anahi nalaijin ahi, chuleh Jerusalem ma chun kum31 vai anahom min ahi
English: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

tcz: Amahi Pakai lunglam tah in anachon nin ahi. Amahin a pului leng David chonna anajuijin Pathen daan ho jouse ana jui bukim min ahi
en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, and walked in the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.
text:
2CH 34:2
Thadou: Amahi Pakai lunglam tah in anachon nin ahi. Amahin a pului leng David chonna anajuijin Pathen daan ho jouse ana jui bukim min ahi
English: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, and walked in the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.

tcz: Josiah chu khangdong cha in kum 8 ahi kummin leng ana changin, aman apului leng David Pathen chu ana houvin, kum 4 jouvin Asherah pathen lim kisemthu namdang te pathen houna mun jouse doi phungho jouse chu ana suse soh keijin ahi
en: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images.
text:
2CH 34:3
Thadou: Josiah chu khangdong cha in kum 8 ahi kummin leng ana changin, aman apului leng David Pathen chu ana houvin, kum 4 jouvin Asherah pathen lim kisemthu namdang te pathen houna mun jouse doi phungho jouse chu ana suse soh keijin ahi
English: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images.

tcz: Ama thupeh dung juiyin Baal kihouna jouse leh ahalnam na maicham jouse amiten anaban suhsetnun, Asherah houna limsemthu holeh doiphung ho jouse asugoi sellin hiche ho anahou ho lhan chungah ana theovin ahi
en: They broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence; and he cut down the incense altars that were on high above them. He broke the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images in pieces, made dust of them, and scattered it on the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
text:
2CH 34:4
Thadou: Ama thupeh dung juiyin Baal kihouna jouse leh ahalnam na maicham jouse amiten anaban suhsetnun, Asherah houna limsemthu holeh doiphung ho jouse asugoi sellin hiche ho anahou ho lhan chungah ana theovin ahi
English: They broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence; and he cut down the incense altars that were on high above them. He broke the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images in pieces, made dust of them, and scattered it on the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

tcz: Aman hiche semthu pathen leh doihou na thempu ho guchu adoi hounao chunga chun meiyin anahallun ahi. Hitia hi ana boljeh in Judah leh Jerusalem mipite chu houthu lamdollin ana sutheng kit nin ahi
en: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 34:5
Thadou: Aman hiche semthu pathen leh doihou na thempu ho guchu adoi hounao chunga chun meiyin anahallun ahi. Hitia hi ana boljeh in Judah leh Jerusalem mipite chu houthu lamdollin ana sutheng kit nin ahi
English: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem.

tcz: Aman hitimachun Manasseh, Ephraim leh Simion leh sahlanga Nephtali gamgei jin ana ban suh thengin ahi
en: He did this in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, around in their ruins.
text:
2CH 34:6
Thadou: Aman hitimachun Manasseh, Ephraim leh Simion leh sahlanga Nephtali gamgei jin ana ban suh thengin ahi
English: He did this in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, around in their ruins.

tcz: Aleng gam sahlang gamho geijin Asherah semthu pathen houna maicham phungho geijin adoi hounao leh gimnamtwi ahalnamnao maicham geijin avochipmin asubong sellin ahi. Hiche jouchun Jerusalem langa akile bepmin ahi
en: He broke down the altars, beat the Asherah poles and the engraved images into powder, and cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel, then returned to Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 34:7
Thadou: Aleng gam sahlang gamho geijin Asherah semthu pathen houna maicham phungho geijin adoi hounao leh gimnamtwi ahalnamnao maicham geijin avochipmin asubong sellin ahi. Hiche jouchun Jerusalem langa akile bepmin ahi
English: He broke down the altars, beat the Asherah poles and the engraved images into powder, and cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel, then returned to Jerusalem.

tcz: Aman hiti a hi gamdang pathen houna asuhbeija gamsung leh houin sung asuhtheng jouvin Josiah lengpan Pakai Pathen houin semphadingin mi 3 asollin ahi: amahochu Azaliah chapa Shaphan, Jerusalem Governor Maaseiah leh lamkai lenkhat Joahaz chapa Joah ahi
en: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder to repair the house of the LORD his God.
text:
2CH 34:8
Thadou: Aman hiti a hi gamdang pathen houna asuhbeija gamsung leh houin sung asuhtheng jouvin Josiah lengpan Pakai Pathen houin semphadingin mi 3 asollin ahi: amahochu Azaliah chapa Shaphan, Jerusalem Governor Maaseiah leh lamkai lenkhat Joahaz chapa Joah ahi
English: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder to repair the house of the LORD his God.

tcz: Levi te houin ngah a panghon sum ahin dondoh houchu thempulen Hilkiah henga apelutnun ahi. (Hiche sumchu Ephraim leh Manasseh chuleh sahlam leng gam jouse Judah, Benjamin leh Jerusalem mipite ho jouse – a konna kidongdoh sum ahi
en: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money that was brought into God’s house, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had gathered from the hands of Manasseh, Ephraim, of all the remnant of Israel, of all Judah and Benjamin, and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 34:9
Thadou: Levi te houin ngah a panghon sum ahin dondoh houchu thempulen Hilkiah henga apelutnun ahi. (Hiche sumchu Ephraim leh Manasseh chuleh sahlam leng gam jouse Judah, Benjamin leh Jerusalem mipite ho jouse – a konna kidongdoh sum ahi
English: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money that was brought into God’s house, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had gathered from the hands of Manasseh, Ephraim, of all the remnant of Israel, of all Judah and Benjamin, and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

tcz: Hiche sumchu houin sempha dinga kinganse mi 3 ho komma chun apelutnun ahi, chuleh amahon thingthem bol chuleh insa ho chu songleh thing achoh uva Judah lengpan anamon lhahsah ho semphat nan amangun ahi
en: They delivered it into the hands of the workmen who had the oversight of the LORD’s house; and the workmen who labored in the LORD’s house gave it to mend and repair the house.
text:
2CH 34:10
Thadou: Hiche sumchu houin sempha dinga kinganse mi 3 ho komma chun apelutnun ahi, chuleh amahon thingthem bol chuleh insa ho chu songleh thing achoh uva Judah lengpan anamon lhahsah ho semphat nan amangun ahi
English: They delivered it into the hands of the workmen who had the oversight of the LORD’s house; and the workmen who labored in the LORD’s house gave it to mend and repair the house.

tcz: Hiche kintong ho chu lungtheng tah ahiove, amahon chu Levi te mi 4 Merari phunga konna Jahath le Obadiah chuleh Kohath phunga kon Zechariah leh Meshullam, amaho hi nana lamkaijun ahi (Hiche Levi ho hi tumging saithem cheh ahiove)
en: The men did the work faithfully. Their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to give direction; and others of the Levites, who were all skillful with musical instruments.
text:
2CH 34:12
Thadou: Hiche kintong ho chu lungtheng tah ahiove, amahon chu Levi te mi 4 Merari phunga konna Jahath le Obadiah chuleh Kohath phunga kon Zechariah leh Meshullam, amaho hi nana lamkaijun ahi (Hiche Levi ho hi tumging saithem cheh ahiove)
English: The men did the work faithfully. Their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to give direction; and others of the Levites, who were all skillful with musical instruments.

tcz: Levi dangho chu thil thah le leh natoh jatchom chomma natongho chunga vaihom min apangun chuleh adanghon thuching leh miveng bitnin apangun ahi
en: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and directed all who did the work in every kind of service. Of the Levites, there were scribes, officials, and gatekeepers.
text:
2CH 34:13
Thadou: Levi dangho chu thil thah le leh natoh jatchom chomma natongho chunga vaihom min apangun chuleh adanghon thuching leh miveng bitnin apangun ahi
English: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and directed all who did the work in every kind of service. Of the Levites, there were scribes, officials, and gatekeepers.

tcz: Sumchu akoina konna akilah doh chun, Pathen nin Mose anapeh Pakai daan buchu Hilkiah in ahin mudoh in ahi
en: When they brought out the money that was brought into the LORD’s house, Hilkiah the priest found the book of the LORD’s law given by Moses.
text:
2CH 34:14
Thadou: Sumchu akoina konna akilah doh chun, Pathen nin Mose anapeh Pakai daan buchu Hilkiah in ahin mudoh in ahi
English: When they brought out the money that was brought into the LORD’s house, Hilkiah the priest found the book of the LORD’s law given by Moses.

tcz: Aman Shaphan jeh a “Keiman houin sungah daan bu chu kamudoh tai” ati. Aman lekhabu chu Shaphan apen ahi
en: Hilkiah answered Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in the LORD’s house.” So Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.
text:
2CH 34:15
Thadou: Aman Shaphan jeh a “Keiman houin sungah daan bu chu kamudoh tai” ati. Aman lekhabu chu Shaphan apen ahi
English: Hilkiah answered Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in the LORD’s house.” So Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

tcz: Shaphan chun lekhabu chu achoijin lengpa kommah hiti hin thu agalhut ne: Keihon nangma thupeh bang bangin katongun ahi.
en: Shaphan carried the book to the king, and moreover brought back word to the king, saying, “All that was committed to your servants, they are doing.
text:
2CH 34:16
Thadou: Shaphan chun lekhabu chu achoijin lengpa kommah hiti hin thu agalhut ne: Keihon nangma thupeh bang bangin katongun ahi.
English: Shaphan carried the book to the king, and moreover brought back word to the king, saying, “All that was committed to your servants, they are doing.

tcz: Keihon houinna kikoi sumchu kalaovin natong holeh avesui ja pang ho kapeovin ahi
en: They have emptied out the money that was found in the LORD’s house, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers and into the hand of the workmen.”
text:
2CH 34:17
Thadou: Keihon houinna kikoi sumchu kalaovin natong holeh avesui ja pang ho kapeovin ahi
English: They have emptied out the money that was found in the LORD’s house, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers and into the hand of the workmen.”

tcz: Hijou chun aman “Hilkiah in eipeh lekhabu chu kahin choije” atin lekhabu chu lengpa jahdin ahin simphongin ahi
en: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered me a book.” Shaphan read from it to the king.
text:
2CH 34:18
Thadou: Hijou chun aman “Hilkiah in eipeh lekhabu chu kahin choije” atin lekhabu chu lengpa jahdin ahin simphongin ahi
English: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered me a book.” Shaphan read from it to the king.

tcz: Lengpan lekhabu kisim chu ajah phat nin kicha tah in apon abotkeh in ahi
en: When the king had heard the words of the law, he tore his clothes.
text:
2CH 34:19
Thadou: Lengpan lekhabu kisim chu ajah phat nin kicha tah in apon abotkeh in ahi
English: When the king had heard the words of the law, he tore his clothes.

tcz: Hichun Hilkiah leh Shaphan chapa Ahikam chuleh Micaiah chapa Abdon chuleh Shaphan athutan na munna lekha jihpa chuleh lengpa kithopi a pang Isaiah ama ho cheng komma chun thu apen:
en: The king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,
text:
2CH 34:20
Thadou: Hichun Hilkiah leh Shaphan chapa Ahikam chuleh Micaiah chapa Abdon chuleh Shaphan athutan na munna lekha jihpa chuleh lengpa kithopi a pang Isaiah ama ho cheng komma chun thu apen:
English: The king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,

tcz: “Nangho cheovinlang keima dingleh tunigeija Israel teleh Judah te gamsunga chengnalai mipi ho dingin Pakai chu eigadoh peh un. Hiche lekhabu thuhil hojong gahechen nun. Ipu ipateovin Pakai thupeh anajuilou jeh uleh hiche lekha hin asei dung jui'a anatoh loujeh un Pakai ichunguvah alung hangtan ahi” ati
en: “Go inquire of the LORD for me, and for those who are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found; for great is the LORD’s wrath that is poured out on us, because our fathers have not kept the LORD’s word, to do according to all that is written in this book.”
text:
2CH 34:21
Thadou: “Nangho cheovinlang keima dingleh tunigeija Israel teleh Judah te gamsunga chengnalai mipi ho dingin Pakai chu eigadoh peh un. Hiche lekhabu thuhil hojong gahechen nun. Ipu ipateovin Pakai thupeh anajuilou jeh uleh hiche lekha hin asei dung jui'a anatoh loujeh un Pakai ichunguvah alung hangtan ahi” ati
English: “Go inquire of the LORD for me, and for those who are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found; for great is the LORD’s wrath that is poured out on us, because our fathers have not kept the LORD’s word, to do according to all that is written in this book.”

tcz: Lengpa thupeh dung juiyin Hilkiah leh aloiho acheovin Jerusalem munthah langa cheng themgao numei Huldah chu gadong dingin acheovin ahi. (Ajipa Shallum chu Tikvah chapa, Hasrah tupa chu houin von ho vesuija panga ahi) Themgaonu kommah thilsoh hochu asei peh un ahi
en: So Hilkiah and those whom the king had commanded went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter), and they spoke to her to that effect.
text:
2CH 34:22
Thadou: Lengpa thupeh dung juiyin Hilkiah leh aloiho acheovin Jerusalem munthah langa cheng themgao numei Huldah chu gadong dingin acheovin ahi. (Ajipa Shallum chu Tikvah chapa, Hasrah tupa chu houin von ho vesuija panga ahi) Themgaonu kommah thilsoh hochu asei peh un ahi
English: So Hilkiah and those whom the king had commanded went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter), and they spoke to her to that effect.

tcz: Amanun amaho chu lengpa komma kinung leovin lang
en: She said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,
text:
2CH 34:23
Thadou: Amanun amaho chu lengpa komma kinung leovin lang
English: She said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,

tcz: Pakai jakonna thuthot hi seipeh un, “Keiman Jerusalem leh amipiho jouse chunga lengpa komma hiche lekhabu kijih nasim doh u sapset nachu nachung uva kagui lhunsah ding ahi
en: “The LORD says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on this place and on its inhabitants, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah.
text:
2CH 34:24
Thadou: Pakai jakonna thuthot hi seipeh un, “Keiman Jerusalem leh amipiho jouse chunga lengpa komma hiche lekhabu kijih nasim doh u sapset nachu nachung uva kagui lhunsah ding ahi
English: “The LORD says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on this place and on its inhabitants, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah.

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon keima eipai dohun Jerusalem chungah kalung hanna akoudoh sahtaovin ahi, Hiche hi mit theilou ding ahi atipeh in ahi
en: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands, therefore my wrath is poured out on this place, and it will not be quenched.’”’
text:
2CH 34:25
Thadou: Ajeh chu amahon keima eipai dohun Jerusalem chungah kalung hanna akoudoh sahtaovin ahi, Hiche hi mit theilou ding ahi atipeh in ahi
English: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands, therefore my wrath is poured out on this place, and it will not be quenched.’”’

tcz: lengpa dinga chu keima Israel Pakai Pathennin asei ahi: Nangin hiche lekhabu a kisei hi nangaijin ahi,
en: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, you shall tell him this, ‘The LORD, the God of Israel says: “About the words which you have heard,
text:
2CH 34:26
Thadou: lengpa dinga chu keima Israel Pakai Pathennin asei ahi: Nangin hiche lekhabu a kisei hi nangaijin ahi,
English: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, you shall tell him this, ‘The LORD, the God of Israel says: “About the words which you have heard,

tcz: Chuleh nangman Jerusalem leh amipite Kagih naho najah phatnin nalung naheijin ka angah naki sumnemmin navon nasat tellin nakap jengin ahileh keiman nataona kangai peh tan ahi
en: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this place and against its inhabitants, and have humbled yourself before me, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,” says the LORD.
text:
2CH 34:27
Thadou: Chuleh nangman Jerusalem leh amipite Kagih naho najah phatnin nalung naheijin ka angah naki sumnemmin navon nasat tellin nakap jengin ahileh keiman nataona kangai peh tan ahi
English: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this place and against its inhabitants, and have humbled yourself before me, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,” says the LORD.

tcz: Hijeh chun Jerusalem chunga ka engbol nading nangma thijou teng le bou kaguilhun sah ding ahi. Keiman nangvang lung monga kathisah ding ahi” ati. Hichun amahon hiche thuthot chu apouvin Josiah lengpa kommah akiletaove
en: “Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes won’t see all the evil that I will bring on this place and on its inhabitants.”’” They brought back this message to the king.
text:
2CH 34:28
Thadou: Hijeh chun Jerusalem chunga ka engbol nading nangma thijou teng le bou kaguilhun sah ding ahi. Keiman nangvang lung monga kathisah ding ahi” ati. Hichun amahon hiche thuthot chu apouvin Josiah lengpa kommah akiletaove
English: “Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes won’t see all the evil that I will bring on this place and on its inhabitants.”’” They brought back this message to the king.

tcz: Josiah lengpan Judah leh Jerusalem ma lamkai ho jouse chu akou khommin,
en: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 34:29
Thadou: Josiah lengpan Judah leh Jerusalem ma lamkai ho jouse chu akou khommin,
English: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

tcz: Abonnin houinnah achekhommun ahi. Amahochu thempu holeh Levi ten chuleh mipi ho jouse mihao leh mivaicha hon abonnun kitepna lekhabu chu ahin simdoh sahtaan ahi
en: The king went up to the LORD’s house with all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem—the priests, the Levites, and all the people, both great and small—and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 34:30
Thadou: Abonnin houinnah achekhommun ahi. Amahochu thempu holeh Levi ten chuleh mipi ho jouse mihao leh mivaicha hon abonnun kitepna lekhabu chu ahin simdoh sahtaan ahi
English: The king went up to the LORD’s house with all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem—the priests, the Levites, and all the people, both great and small—and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the LORD’s house.

tcz: Amachu lengte dinna munnachun Pakai toh kitepna abollin ahi. Pakai thu dung jui'a athupeh nitding dol hochu nitding chun Pakai toh kitepna ananei khommun ahi
en: The king stood in his place and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.
text:
2CH 34:31
Thadou: Amachu lengte dinna munnachun Pakai toh kitepna abollin ahi. Pakai thu dung jui'a athupeh nitding dol hochu nitding chun Pakai toh kitepna ananei khommun ahi
English: The king stood in his place and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.

tcz: Aman Benjamin mipiteleh chuche petna Jerusalem ma umjouse chu hiche kitepna juidingin anopsah taan ahi. Hitichun Jerusalem ma mipite chun apu apateo Pathen toh kitepna ana neitaovin ahi
en: He caused all who were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand. The inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
text:
2CH 34:32
Thadou: Aman Benjamin mipiteleh chuche petna Jerusalem ma umjouse chu hiche kitepna juidingin anopsah taan ahi. Hitichun Jerusalem ma mipite chun apu apateo Pathen toh kitepna ana neitaovin ahi
English: He caused all who were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand. The inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

tcz: Josiah lengpachun Israel mipite gamsunga um kidah umtah doiphung ho jouse chu ana sumang soh in ama hinlai sung chun mipiten apu apateo Pathen, Pakai kinbou anahou sah in ahi
en: Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that belonged to the children of Israel, and made all who were found in Israel to serve, even to serve the LORD their God. All his days they didn’t depart from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.
text:
2CH 34:33
Thadou: Josiah lengpachun Israel mipite gamsunga um kidah umtah doiphung ho jouse chu ana sumang soh in ama hinlai sung chun mipiten apu apateo Pathen, Pakai kinbou anahou sah in ahi
English: Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that belonged to the children of Israel, and made all who were found in Israel to serve, even to serve the LORD their God. All his days they didn’t depart from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.

tcz: Lengpa Josiah in Jerusalem khopiah Passover kut chu Pakai loupi nadingin ana mangin ahi. Lhamasa ni 14 channa in hiche kutna dingin gancha ana thatnun ahi
en: Josiah kept a Passover to the LORD in Jerusalem. They killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
text:
2CH 35:1
Thadou: Lengpa Josiah in Jerusalem khopiah Passover kut chu Pakai loupi nadingin ana mangin ahi. Lhamasa ni 14 channa in hiche kutna dingin gancha ana thatnun ahi
English: Josiah kept a Passover to the LORD in Jerusalem. They killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

tcz: Aman thempu hochu houinna akinnu atoh nadiuvin ngansenna ana neijin chuleh ning lhing tah a atohdiuvin ana tilkhouvin ahi
en: He set the priests in their offices and encouraged them in the service of the LORD’s house.
text:
2CH 35:2
Thadou: Aman thempu hochu houinna akinnu atoh nadiuvin ngansenna ana neijin chuleh ning lhing tah a atohdiuvin ana tilkhouvin ahi
English: He set the priests in their offices and encouraged them in the service of the LORD’s house.

tcz: Aman Levi te ahin Israel te lah a Zilkung hochu ahin Pakai kin tong dinga kipedoh ho kommah hitin anaseije: “Kitepna thengtah thingkhong hi David chapa Solomon lengpan ana sah houinna chun koijun, tua patna hiche thingkhong hi napoh lele tahloudiu amavang na Pakai na Pathen leh amite Israel mipite kinjeng bou naboldiu ahi ati
en: He said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to the LORD, “Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built. It will no longer be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve the LORD your God and his people Israel.
text:
2CH 35:3
Thadou: Aman Levi te ahin Israel te lah a Zilkung hochu ahin Pakai kin tong dinga kipedoh ho kommah hitin anaseije: “Kitepna thengtah thingkhong hi David chapa Solomon lengpan ana sah houinna chun koijun, tua patna hiche thingkhong hi napoh lele tahloudiu amavang na Pakai na Pathen leh amite Israel mipite kinjeng bou naboldiu ahi ati
English: He said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to the LORD, “Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built. It will no longer be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve the LORD your God and his people Israel.

tcz: Hitichun naphung dung juijun David lengpa leh achapa Solomon lengpan mopohna napeh dung juiyin panlao vin
en: Prepare yourselves after your fathers’ houses by your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.
text:
2CH 35:4
Thadou: Hitichun naphung dung juijun David lengpa leh achapa Solomon lengpan mopohna napeh dung juiyin panlao vin
English: Prepare yourselves after your fathers’ houses by your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

tcz: Chuleh mi phabep min Israel mipite a insung dung juicheh a napan huthei nadiuvin kihomtoh un
en: Stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of your brothers the children of the people, and let there be for each a portion of a fathers’ house of the Levites.
text:
2CH 35:5
Thadou: Chuleh mi phabep min Israel mipite a insung dung juicheh a napan huthei nadiuvin kihomtoh un
English: Stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of your brothers the children of the people, and let there be for each a portion of a fathers’ house of the Levites.

tcz: Nanghon kelngoi leh kelcha ho nathadiu ahi. Tun nang ho houdaan dung juiyin kisuthengun chuleh pumgo thilto ding kigontoh un Pakaiyin alhacha Mose mangcha – a Pakaiyin napeh u thuhil chu nasopihou Israel chaten jong ajuithei nadiuvin” ati
en: Kill the Passover lamb, sanctify yourselves, and prepare for your brothers, to do according to the LORD’s word by Moses.”
text:
2CH 35:6
Thadou: Nanghon kelngoi leh kelcha ho nathadiu ahi. Tun nang ho houdaan dung juiyin kisuthengun chuleh pumgo thilto ding kigontoh un Pakaiyin alhacha Mose mangcha – a Pakaiyin napeh u thuhil chu nasopihou Israel chaten jong ajuithei nadiuvin” ati
English: Kill the Passover lamb, sanctify yourselves, and prepare for your brothers, to do according to the LORD’s word by Moses.”

tcz: Kalchuh kut teng mipihon amanchah theina diuvin Josiah lengpan gancha ho lah a kon in, kelngoi chal, kelngoi, keltahnou 30000 (sang somthum) leh bongchal 300 (Sangthum) atohdoh in ahi
en: Josiah gave to the children of the people, of the flock, lambs and young goats, all of them for the Passover offerings, to all who were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bulls. These were of the king’s substance.
text:
2CH 35:7
Thadou: Kalchuh kut teng mipihon amanchah theina diuvin Josiah lengpan gancha ho lah a kon in, kelngoi chal, kelngoi, keltahnou 30000 (sang somthum) leh bongchal 300 (Sangthum) atohdoh in ahi
English: Josiah gave to the children of the people, of the flock, lambs and young goats, all of them for the Passover offerings, to all who were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bulls. These were of the king’s substance.

tcz: Lengpa noija natong lamkai honjong mipiho leh thempuho Levi ho manchah dingin kipehna anei cheh un ahi. Houin vesuiding a lamkai ho Hilkiah, thempulen, Zechariah leh Jehiel ama hohin thempu hodingin kelngoi leh kelcha dangho 2600 (Sangni le jagup) chuleh bongchal 300 (Jathum) kut sunga pumgo thilto dingin apeovin ahi
en: His princes gave a free will offering to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the rulers of God’s house, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand six hundred small livestock, and three hundred head of cattle.
text:
2CH 35:8
Thadou: Lengpa noija natong lamkai honjong mipiho leh thempuho Levi ho manchah dingin kipehna anei cheh un ahi. Houin vesuiding a lamkai ho Hilkiah, thempulen, Zechariah leh Jehiel ama hohin thempu hodingin kelngoi leh kelcha dangho 2600 (Sangni le jagup) chuleh bongchal 300 (Jathum) kut sunga pumgo thilto dingin apeovin ahi
English: His princes gave a free will offering to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the rulers of God’s house, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand six hundred small livestock, and three hundred head of cattle.

tcz: Levi lamkai ho – Conaniah, Shemaiah chuleh asopipa Nathanel Hashibiah, Jeiel Jozabad – amaho hin kelngoi kelchal dongho 5000 (Sang nga) ahintohdoh un chuleh bongchal 500 (ja nga) Levi ten pumgo thiltoa dingin ahintoh doh un ahi
en: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand small livestock and five hundred head of cattle.
text:
2CH 35:9
Thadou: Levi lamkai ho – Conaniah, Shemaiah chuleh asopipa Nathanel Hashibiah, Jeiel Jozabad – amaho hin kelngoi kelchal dongho 5000 (Sang nga) ahintohdoh un chuleh bongchal 500 (ja nga) Levi ten pumgo thiltoa dingin ahintoh doh un ahi
English: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand small livestock and five hundred head of cattle.

tcz: Kalchuh kutna dinga thiljouse akigon toh phatnin thempu holeh Levi ten lengpa thupeh bangin amuncheh u ahin kilo taovin ahi
en: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the king’s commandment.
text:
2CH 35:10
Thadou: Kalchuh kutna dinga thiljouse akigon toh phatnin thempu holeh Levi ten lengpa thupeh bangin amuncheh u ahin kilo taovin ahi
English: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the king’s commandment.

tcz: Kelngoi athajou teng uleh, Leviten avunnu alipding chujou teng thempu hon thisan chu maichamma athediu ahi
en: They killed the Passover lambs, and the priests sprinkled the blood which they received from their hands, and the Levites skinned them.
text:
2CH 35:11
Thadou: Kelngoi athajou teng uleh, Leviten avunnu alipding chujou teng thempu hon thisan chu maichamma athediu ahi
English: They killed the Passover lambs, and the priests sprinkled the blood which they received from their hands, and the Levites skinned them.

tcz: Chu teng leh amahon a insonna atum atumma ahopkhendiu pumgo thilto dinga gancha chu ahoppeh diu hitia chu Mose daan dungjuija atohdingdaan kisei chu ajuidiu ahi
en: They removed the burnt offerings, that they might give them according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of the children of the people, to offer to the LORD, as it is written in the book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.
text:
2CH 35:12
Thadou: Chu teng leh amahon a insonna atum atumma ahopkhendiu pumgo thilto dinga gancha chu ahoppeh diu hitia chu Mose daan dungjuija atohdingdaan kisei chu ajuidiu ahi
English: They removed the burnt offerings, that they might give them according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of the children of the people, to offer to the LORD, as it is written in the book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.

tcz: Levi ten atohding daan kihilna dung jui'a pumgo thilto hochu meichunga ago diu chuleh akikatdoh atheng hochu, khangbel, bel bilnei ja ahonhuldiu chuleh sa hochu gangtah a mipilah a ahopdoh diu ahi
en: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance. They boiled the holy offerings in pots, in cauldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people.
text:
2CH 35:13
Thadou: Levi ten atohding daan kihilna dung jui'a pumgo thilto hochu meichunga ago diu chuleh akikatdoh atheng hochu, khangbel, bel bilnei ja ahonhuldiu chuleh sa hochu gangtah a mipilah a ahopdoh diu ahi
English: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance. They boiled the holy offerings in pots, in cauldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people.

tcz: Hiche jouteng lehin, Leviten amaho dingleh Aaron son toh achan chehdiuva akigon tohdiu ahi, ajeh chu thempuho hi asa godiu chuleh akikatdoh ho apumpileh asathao ho chu ago diu jangeija aboipi diu ahi
en: Afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aaron were busy with offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night. Therefore the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
text:
2CH 35:14
Thadou: Hiche jouteng lehin, Leviten amaho dingleh Aaron son toh achan chehdiuva akigon tohdiu ahi, ajeh chu thempuho hi asa godiu chuleh akikatdoh ho apumpileh asathao ho chu ago diu jangeija aboipi diu ahi
English: Afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aaron were busy with offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night. Therefore the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

tcz: Levi phunga Asaph son tumging saithem hochu leng David in anagon toh'a kilhilna banga tumging saithem ho: Asaph, Heman le Jeduthun chuleh lengpa themgaohon ama ama muncheh akilodiu ahi. Houin kelkot vengho adinnao muncheh chu alha kanglou diu ahi, Ajeh chu Leviten amaho dinga kalchuh kutchu agonpehdiu ahi
en: The singers, the sons of Asaph, were in their place, according to the commandment of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the gatekeepers were at every gate. They didn’t need to depart from their service, because their brothers the Levites prepared for them.
text:
2CH 35:15
Thadou: Levi phunga Asaph son tumging saithem hochu leng David in anagon toh'a kilhilna banga tumging saithem ho: Asaph, Heman le Jeduthun chuleh lengpa themgaohon ama ama muncheh akilodiu ahi. Houin kelkot vengho adinnao muncheh chu alha kanglou diu ahi, Ajeh chu Leviten amaho dinga kalchuh kutchu agonpehdiu ahi
English: The singers, the sons of Asaph, were in their place, according to the commandment of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the gatekeepers were at every gate. They didn’t need to depart from their service, because their brothers the Levites prepared for them.

tcz: Hitia chu Josiah lengpan athupeh bang banga chu hiche nikhoa Pakai houkhom nale kalchuh kut leh maicham a pumgo thilto hochu chelhading ahi
en: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the Passover, and to offer burnt offerings on the LORD’s altar, according to the commandment of King Josiah.
text:
2CH 35:16
Thadou: Hitia chu Josiah lengpan athupeh bang banga chu hiche nikhoa Pakai houkhom nale kalchuh kut leh maicham a pumgo thilto hochu chelhading ahi
English: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the Passover, and to offer burnt offerings on the LORD’s altar, according to the commandment of King Josiah.

tcz: Hiche nikhoa um Israel mipi hochun ni 7 (Sagi) sungin kalchuh kutleh cholsolou changlhah kut chu amangun ahi
en: The children of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.
text:
2CH 35:17
Thadou: Hiche nikhoa um Israel mipi hochun ni 7 (Sagi) sungin kalchuh kutleh cholsolou changlhah kut chu amangun ahi
English: The children of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

tcz: Samuel themgaopa khanga patnin kalchuh kut chu Josiah lengpa, thempuho, Levi te leh Judah Israel leh Jerusalem mipiten aman banguva hi kimang khalou ahi
en: There was no Passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet, nor did any of the kings of Israel keep such a Passover as Josiah kept—with the priests, the Levites, and all Judah and Israel who were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 35:18
Thadou: Samuel themgaopa khanga patnin kalchuh kut chu Josiah lengpa, thempuho, Levi te leh Judah Israel leh Jerusalem mipiten aman banguva hi kimang khalou ahi
English: There was no Passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet, nor did any of the kings of Israel keep such a Passover as Josiah kept—with the priests, the Levites, and all Judah and Israel who were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

tcz: Hichehi Josiah vaihom sung kum 18 (Som le get) lhinna thilsoh ahi
en: This Passover was kept in the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah.
text:
2CH 35:19
Thadou: Hichehi Josiah vaihom sung kum 18 (Som le get) lhinna thilsoh ahi
English: This Passover was kept in the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah.

tcz: Josiah lengpan hicheho jousehi houinna atohchai phatnin, Egypt lengpa Neco Eupharates vadung chung lang Carchemish ah galsat din ahungin ahileh Josiah in suhtang ding ana gon ahi
en: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Neco king of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out against him.
text:
2CH 35:20
Thadou: Josiah lengpan hicheho jousehi houinna atohchai phatnin, Egypt lengpa Neco Eupharates vadung chung lang Carchemish ah galsat din ahungin ahileh Josiah in suhtang ding ana gon ahi
English: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Neco king of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out against him.

tcz: Ahinlah Neco in Josiah chu hiche thuhi agahthot nin, “Judah lengpa galsat dinga kahung konhi nangdou na ahipoi nangtoh kisat dinga kahung ahipoi, kagalmi tetoh kisat dinga kahung ahi. Pathen nin gangtah a cheloi dinga eihin sol ahin, Pathen hi kei langa apange nei dou hih in, aman nasuhmang ding ahi ati.
en: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, “What have I to do with you, you king of Judah? I come not against you today, but against the house with which I have war. God has commanded me to make haste. Beware that it is God who is with me, that he not destroy you.”
text:
2CH 35:21
Thadou: Ahinlah Neco in Josiah chu hiche thuhi agahthot nin, “Judah lengpa galsat dinga kahung konhi nangdou na ahipoi nangtoh kisat dinga kahung ahipoi, kagalmi tetoh kisat dinga kahung ahi. Pathen nin gangtah a cheloi dinga eihin sol ahin, Pathen hi kei langa apange nei dou hih in, aman nasuhmang ding ahi ati.
English: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, “What have I to do with you, you king of Judah? I come not against you today, but against the house with which I have war. God has commanded me to make haste. Beware that it is God who is with me, that he not destroy you.”

tcz: Ahinlah Josiah chun kisatpi tei dingin pan alatan ahi. Aman Neco lengpa akonna Pathen thusei chu anahsah tapon hiti chun aman vonchom akivon nin Megiddo phaija galsat din alut nin ahi
en: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and didn’t listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.
text:
2CH 35:22
Thadou: Ahinlah Josiah chun kisatpi tei dingin pan alatan ahi. Aman Neco lengpa akonna Pathen thusei chu anahsah tapon hiti chun aman vonchom akivon nin Megiddo phaija galsat din alut nin ahi
English: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and didn’t listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

tcz: Gal akisat taovin lengpa Josiah chu thal chang khatnin ahin khatan ahileh asohpa komma chun eipodoh taan keima kaki sukha tai” ati
en: The archers shot at King Josiah; and the king said to his servants, “Take me away, because I am seriously wounded!”
text:
2CH 35:23
Thadou: Gal akisat taovin lengpa Josiah chu thal chang khatnin ahin khatan ahileh asohpa komma chun eipodoh taan keima kaki sukha tai” ati
English: The archers shot at King Josiah; and the king said to his servants, “Take me away, because I am seriously wounded!”

tcz: Amahon asakol kangtalai ja konchun apomdoh un Sakol kangtalai achom khatnah ahengun Jerusalem langa apolut taovin ahi. Hichea chun ama athitaan lengte lhannah avuitaovin ahi. Juda mipum pi ama thi chu alunghem piovin ahi
en: So his servants took him out of the chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had, and brought him to Jerusalem; and he died, and was buried in the tombs of his fathers. All Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.
text:
2CH 35:24
Thadou: Amahon asakol kangtalai ja konchun apomdoh un Sakol kangtalai achom khatnah ahengun Jerusalem langa apolut taovin ahi. Hichea chun ama athitaan lengte lhannah avuitaovin ahi. Juda mipum pi ama thi chu alunghem piovin ahi
English: So his servants took him out of the chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had, and brought him to Jerusalem; and he died, and was buried in the tombs of his fathers. All Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

tcz: Themgao Jeremiah in Josiah chung changa lunghem na la anasemmin ahi. Israel gamsunga lasathem numei pasal hon ama chunga lung hem pina aneiteng chuleh hiche la hi asajiovin ahi. Hiche la hi lung hempina la kikhol khom holah a akoijun ahi
en: Jeremiah lamented for Josiah, and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations to this day; and they made them an ordinance in Israel. Behold, they are written in the lamentations.
text:
2CH 35:25
Thadou: Themgao Jeremiah in Josiah chung changa lunghem na la anasemmin ahi. Israel gamsunga lasathem numei pasal hon ama chunga lung hem pina aneiteng chuleh hiche la hi asajiovin ahi. Hiche la hi lung hempina la kikhol khom holah a akoijun ahi
English: Jeremiah lamented for Josiah, and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations to this day; and they made them an ordinance in Israel. Behold, they are written in the lamentations.

tcz: Josiah in abol jouse Pakaija dinga kiphong dohho, Daan juiding akhoh sah naho
en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and his good deeds, according to that which is written in the LORD’s law,
text:
2CH 35:26
Thadou: Josiah in abol jouse Pakaija dinga kiphong dohho, Daan juiding akhoh sah naho
English: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and his good deeds, according to that which is written in the LORD’s law,

tcz: Athusim abulla patna achaina gei Israel leh Judah thusim buah akijih lut in ahi
en: and his acts, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
text:
2CH 35:27
Thadou: Athusim abulla patna achaina gei Israel leh Judah thusim buah akijih lut in ahi
English: and his acts, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

tcz: Judah mipiten Josiah chapa Joahaz chu Jerusalem mah leng changdin thao anu taove
en: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s place in Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 36:1
Thadou: Judah mipiten Josiah chapa Joahaz chu Jerusalem mah leng changdin thao anu taove
English: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s place in Jerusalem.

tcz: Joahaz hi Judah te lengmun ahinlochun kum 23 (Somni le thum) alhing taan ahi. Amahin Jeruselam mah lhathum bou vai anahomme
en: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.
text:
2CH 36:2
Thadou: Joahaz hi Judah te lengmun ahinlochun kum 23 (Somni le thum) alhing taan ahi. Amahin Jeruselam mah lhathum bou vai anahomme
English: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

tcz: Egypt lengpa Neco in galhingin ana man in chuleh Judahten dangka K.g 3400 (Sangthum le Ja li) chuleh Sana K.g 34 kai apeh diuvin thu apen ahi
en: The king of Egypt removed him from office at Jerusalem, and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
text:
2CH 36:3
Thadou: Egypt lengpa Neco in galhingin ana man in chuleh Judahten dangka K.g 3400 (Sangthum le Ja li) chuleh Sana K.g 34 kai apeh diuvin thu apen ahi
English: The king of Egypt removed him from office at Jerusalem, and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

tcz: Neco chun Joahaz sopipa Eliakim chu amin khelpeh in Jehoiakim asah in Judah te lengin apansah tan ahi. Joahaz vangchu Egypt lang apuitaan ahi
en: The king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Joahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.
text:
2CH 36:4
Thadou: Neco chun Joahaz sopipa Eliakim chu amin khelpeh in Jehoiakim asah in Judah te lengin apansah tan ahi. Joahaz vangchu Egypt lang apuitaan ahi
English: The king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Joahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

tcz: Jehoiakim chu Judah te lengpa ahung panchun kum 25 (Som ni le nga) alhingtaan ahi, aman Jerusalem mah kum 11 geijin vai apon ahi. Amahin Pakai pathen dounaan chonset anabollin ahi
en: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in the LORD his God’s sight.
text:
2CH 36:5
Thadou: Jehoiakim chu Judah te lengpa ahung panchun kum 25 (Som ni le nga) alhingtaan ahi, aman Jerusalem mah kum 11 geijin vai apon ahi. Amahin Pakai pathen dounaan chonset anabollin ahi
