en: Then the king said to me, “What is your request?” So I prayed to the God of heaven.

tcz: Hitin kadonbut tai, “Lengpa nasohpa keima chunga khoto na naneiya nalunglhaina ahi dingle Judah gam'a neisol’in lang kapu kapate kivuina khopi chu gasa phange” kati.
en: I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, I ask that you would send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ tombs, that I may build it.”
text:
NEH 2:5
Thadou: Hitin kadonbut tai, “Lengpa nasohpa keima chunga khoto na naneiya nalunglhaina ahi dingle Judah gam'a neisol’in lang kapu kapate kivuina khopi chu gasa phange” kati.
English: I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, I ask that you would send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ tombs, that I may build it.”

tcz: Hiche pet’a chu lengnu toh toukhom lhon ahin, lengpan phat itih chan naga sulut dem? itih donleh nahung kile thei dem?” eiti, Keiman phat itih chan kaga suh lut ding ham ti kahetsah jou chun aman eiphat sah peh tai.
en: The king said to me (the queen was also sitting by him), “How long will your journey be? When will you return?” So it pleased the king to send me, and I set a time for him.
text:
NEH 2:6
Thadou: Hiche pet’a chu lengnu toh toukhom lhon ahin, lengpan phat itih chan naga sulut dem? itih donleh nahung kile thei dem?” eiti, Keiman phat itih chan kaga suh lut ding ham ti kahetsah jou chun aman eiphat sah peh tai.
English: The king said to me (the queen was also sitting by him), “How long will your journey be? When will you return?” So it pleased the king to send me, and I set a time for him.

tcz: Lengpa koma chun keiman kaseibe kitin, “Lengpa nalung alhai dinga ahile, Eupharates vadung gal lhanglam gamkaiya gam vaipo ho koma lekha eijih peh in lang Judah gam kajot na a agamsungu boilouhel a kajot galkai theina dingin thupeh neithot peh in,” kati.
en: Moreover I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the River, that they may let me pass through until I come to Judah;

tcz: “Chule lengpa thing gampo pa Asaph koma lekha neijih peh in lang, Houin kulpi khopi kulbang sah na dingle keima chen na ding in sahna a Kaman chah ding thing eipeh thei na dingin thupeh neithot peh in,” kati. Hichun Pathenin kachunga khotona anei jal'in lengpan kathum jouse eiphal pehin ahi.
en: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple, for the wall of the city, and for the house that I will occupy.” The king granted my requests, because of the good hand of my God on me.
text:
NEH 2:8
Thadou: “Chule lengpa thing gampo pa Asaph koma lekha neijih peh in lang, Houin kulpi khopi kulbang sah na dingle keima chen na ding in sahna a Kaman chah ding thing eipeh thei na dingin thupeh neithot peh in,” kati. Hichun Pathenin kachunga khotona anei jal'in lengpan kathum jouse eiphal pehin ahi.
English: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple, for the wall of the city, and for the house that I will occupy.” The king granted my requests, because of the good hand of my God on me.

tcz: Eupharates vadung lhumlam gamkaiya gamvaipo ho kom kalhun phat in lengpa lekha jih ho chu kape lutin ahi. Gahseibe ding chun lengpan sakol sepai hole vaipo ho keima eiveng dingin eihin solpeh in ahi.
en: Then I came to the governors beyond the River, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.
text:
NEH 2:9
Thadou: Eupharates vadung lhumlam gamkaiya gamvaipo ho kom kalhun phat in lengpa lekha jih ho chu kape lutin ahi. Gahseibe ding chun lengpan sakol sepai hole vaipo ho keima eiveng dingin eihin solpeh in ahi.
English: Then I came to the governors beyond the River, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.

tcz: Ahin Horon mi Samballat leh Ammon mi Tobiah leng lhacha a pang teni hin kavai lhun ahetdoh lhon phatin Israel chate panpi ding mikhat ahungtai tin alung nom mo lheh jeng lhonin ahi.
en: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, because a man had come to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
text:
NEH 2:10
Thadou: Ahin Horon mi Samballat leh Ammon mi Tobiah leng lhacha a pang teni hin kavai lhun ahetdoh lhon phatin Israel chate panpi ding mikhat ahungtai tin alung nom mo lheh jeng lhonin ahi.
English: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, because a man had come to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

tcz: Hiti hin nithum jouvin Jerusalem kaga lhung tai.
en: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
text:
NEH 2:11
Thadou: Hiti hin nithum jouvin Jerusalem kaga lhung tai.
English: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

tcz: Jankhangin aguh in kathoudoh in mi phabep toh kahin, Pathenin Jerusalem a eitoh sah nom ho chu koima cha kasei peh pon ahi. Katouna sa-ngan tailou gancha dang khat cha kapui pouvin ahi.
en: I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. I didn’t tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem. There wasn’t any animal with me except the animal that I rode on.
text:
NEH 2:12
Thadou: Jankhangin aguh in kathoudoh in mi phabep toh kahin, Pathenin Jerusalem a eitoh sah nom ho chu koima cha kasei peh pon ahi. Katouna sa-ngan tailou gancha dang khat cha kapui pouvin ahi.
English: I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. I didn’t tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem. There wasn’t any animal with me except the animal that I rode on.

tcz: Hiti chun jan khang kim in kapot doh’un phaicham kelkot langa kacheuvin, Sial twikul chu kaho pauvin, ehbohna kelkot geiyin kacheuvin akivo chimsa pal hole akihal lha kakhol toh soh keiyun ahi.
en: I went out by night by the valley gate toward the jackal’s well, then to the dung gate; and I inspected the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates were consumed with fire.
text:
NEH 2:13
Thadou: Hiti chun jan khang kim in kapot doh’un phaicham kelkot langa kacheuvin, Sial twikul chu kaho pauvin, ehbohna kelkot geiyin kacheuvin akivo chimsa pal hole akihal lha kakhol toh soh keiyun ahi.
English: I went out by night by the valley gate toward the jackal’s well, then to the dung gate; and I inspected the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates were consumed with fire.

tcz: Chujouvin, twisam putna kelkot le lengpa twikul geiyin kacheuvin ahileh katounau sa-ngan chu songchip ho lah a chun athol tapoi.
en: Then I went on to the spring gate and to the king’s pool, but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass.
text:
NEH 2:14
Thadou: Chujouvin, twisam putna kelkot le lengpa twikul geiyin kacheuvin ahileh katounau sa-ngan chu songchip ho lah a chun athol tapoi.
English: Then I went on to the spring gate and to the king’s pool, but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass.

tcz: Hiti chun jan khanglai chun Kidron phaicham geiyin kachen, palchu kahin kholpeh in, chujouvin kahung kilen phaicham kelkot langa kahung lut tai.
en: Then I went up in the night by the brook and inspected the wall; and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate, and so returned.
text:
NEH 2:15
Thadou: Hiti chun jan khanglai chun Kidron phaicham geiyin kachen, palchu kahin kholpeh in, chujouvin kahung kilen phaicham kelkot langa kahung lut tai.
English: Then I went up in the night by the brook and inspected the wall; and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate, and so returned.

tcz: Hiti chun khopi vaihom hon itih a kapot doh a ipi kaga bol ham ti ahepouve; ajeh chu keiman katoh gon chu koima cha kana hetsah pon ahi. Judah lamkai hole thempu ho, chule mithupi hole vaihom ho ahilou leh vaihom na muna umho khat cha kana hetsahpon ahi.
en: The rulers didn’t know where I went, or what I did. I had not as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest who did the work.
text:
NEH 2:16
Thadou: Hiti chun khopi vaihom hon itih a kapot doh a ipi kaga bol ham ti ahepouve; ajeh chu keiman katoh gon chu koima cha kana hetsah pon ahi. Judah lamkai hole thempu ho, chule mithupi hole vaihom ho ahilou leh vaihom na muna umho khat cha kana hetsahpon ahi.
English: The rulers didn’t know where I went, or what I did. I had not as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest who did the work.

tcz: Tun vang keiman amaho chu kahet sah tan ahi, “Itobang hahsat na itou hitam Jerusalem hi khopigem ahitan, akelkot ho jousela maiyin akavam soh tai tihi nanghon nahe soh kei’uve; tun eihon Jerusalem kulpi pal hi sapha kitnu hitin ijum nao hi subei tao hite,” katin ahi.
en: Then I said to them, “You see the bad situation that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, let’s build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we won’t be disgraced.”
text:
NEH 2:17
Thadou: Tun vang keiman amaho chu kahet sah tan ahi, “Itobang hahsat na itou hitam Jerusalem hi khopigem ahitan, akelkot ho jousela maiyin akavam soh tai tihi nanghon nahe soh kei’uve; tun eihon Jerusalem kulpi pal hi sapha kitnu hitin ijum nao hi subei tao hite,” katin ahi.
English: Then I said to them, “You see the bad situation that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, let’s build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we won’t be disgraced.”

tcz: Hiche jou chun keiman itibang Pathen kaihoi kachan ham chuleh lengpa toh iti kahung kihou lim lhon ham ti kasei peh tan ahi.
en: I told them about the hand of my God which was good on me, and also about the king’s words that he had spoken to me. They said, “Let’s rise up and build.” So they strengthened their hands for the good work.
text:
NEH 2:18
Thadou: Hiche jou chun keiman itibang Pathen kaihoi kachan ham chuleh lengpa toh iti kahung kihou lim lhon ham ti kasei peh tan ahi.
English: I told them about the hand of my God which was good on me, and also about the king’s words that he had spoken to me. They said, “Let’s rise up and build.” So they strengthened their hands for the good work.

tcz: Ahin lah Samballat, Tobiah le Arab mi Geshem te hon katoh gon’u chu ahet doh phat’un noise tah in eina houvun ahi. “Ipi nabol’u ham? Lengpa douna a na natoh u ham?” tin eidongun ahi.
en: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite servant, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they ridiculed us and despised us, and said, “What is this thing that you are doing? Will you rebel against the king?”
text:
NEH 2:19
Thadou: Ahin lah Samballat, Tobiah le Arab mi Geshem te hon katoh gon’u chu ahet doh phat’un noise tah in eina houvun ahi. “Ipi nabol’u ham? Lengpa douna a na natoh u ham?” tin eidongun ahi.
English: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite servant, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they ridiculed us and despised us, and said, “What is this thing that you are doing? Will you rebel against the king?”

tcz: Hichun keiman kadonbut’in, “Van Pathenin eipan hu’uva eitoh chai sah diu ahi. chule keiho ama lhachaten khopi pal hi kasah phat diu ahi; amavang nanghon hiche ahin chan anei pouve, thanei na jong nanei pouve, Jerusalem khopi ahin nachan diu goujong nanei pouvin ahi,” kati.
en: Then I answered them, and said to them, “The God of heaven will prosper us. Therefore we, his servants, will arise and build; but you have no portion, nor right, nor memorial in Jerusalem.”
text:
NEH 2:20
Thadou: Hichun keiman kadonbut’in, “Van Pathenin eipan hu’uva eitoh chai sah diu ahi. chule keiho ama lhachaten khopi pal hi kasah phat diu ahi; amavang nanghon hiche ahin chan anei pouve, thanei na jong nanei pouve, Jerusalem khopi ahin nachan diu goujong nanei pouvin ahi,” kati.
English: Then I answered them, and said to them, “The God of heaven will prosper us. Therefore we, his servants, will arise and build; but you have no portion, nor right, nor memorial in Jerusalem.”

tcz: Hiche jou chun thempulen Eliashib leh thempu dangho chun Kelngoi Kelkot chu asemphauvin ahi; hitichun asemjou phat’un athensouvin, chuleh akot jouse jong asutoh un, Jakhat Insang kiti chan geiyin asa phauvin, achaisoh phat’un athenso’vin chuin Hananel Insung geipeh in asa phauvin ahi.
en: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests, and they built the sheep gate. They sanctified it, and set up its doors. They sanctified it even to the tower of Hammeah, to the tower of Hananel.
text:
NEH 3:1
Thadou: Hiche jou chun thempulen Eliashib leh thempu dangho chun Kelngoi Kelkot chu asemphauvin ahi; hitichun asemjou phat’un athensouvin, chuleh akot jouse jong asutoh un, Jakhat Insang kiti chan geiyin asa phauvin, achaisoh phat’un athenso’vin chuin Hananel Insung geipeh in asa phauvin ahi.
English: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests, and they built the sheep gate. They sanctified it, and set up its doors. They sanctified it even to the tower of Hammeah, to the tower of Hananel.

tcz: Jericho khopi a konna hung mipiten amaho bang chun na atongun chuban’in Imri chapa Zakkur in atongin ahi.
en: Next to him the men of Jericho built. Next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.
text:
NEH 3:2
Thadou: Jericho khopi a konna hung mipiten amaho bang chun na atongun chuban’in Imri chapa Zakkur in atongin ahi.
English: Next to him the men of Jericho built. Next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.

tcz: Hassenaah chapaten Ngapi Kelkot geiyin asauvin ahi; Chule amahon ajol jong ajam’un, akot jouse jong asuto’uvin, chule kopja le thih jol ho jong asutoh un ahi.
en: The sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
text:
NEH 3:3
Thadou: Hassenaah chapaten Ngapi Kelkot geiyin asauvin ahi; Chule amahon ajol jong ajam’un, akot jouse jong asuto’uvin, chule kopja le thih jol ho jong asutoh un ahi.
English: The sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

tcz: Hiche banna pal chu Hakkoz tupa Uriah chapa Meremoth in asemphan ahi. Chule ama ban’a hin Meshezabel tupa Berekiah chapa Meshullam in asempha in ahi. Chujongle ama banin Baana chapa Zadok in asemin ahi.
en: Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel made repairs. Next to them, Zadok the son of Baana made repairs.
text:
NEH 3:4
Thadou: Hiche banna pal chu Hakkoz tupa Uriah chapa Meremoth in asemphan ahi. Chule ama ban’a hin Meshezabel tupa Berekiah chapa Meshullam in asempha in ahi. Chujongle ama banin Baana chapa Zadok in asemin ahi.
English: Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel made repairs. Next to them, Zadok the son of Baana made repairs.

tcz: Hiche ban in Tekoa kona hung mipite hin alamkai houvin hiche natoh na a vaihom hotoh atoh khom nomlou vangun ahung semphauvin ahi.
en: Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the Lord’s work.
text:
NEH 3:5
Thadou: Hiche ban in Tekoa kona hung mipite hin alamkai houvin hiche natoh na a vaihom hotoh atoh khom nomlou vangun ahung semphauvin ahi.
English: Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the Lord’s work.

tcz: Chule Khopi Kelkot luichu Paseah chapa Joiada leh Besodeiah chapa Meshullam in asempha lhon in ahi. Chule amahon ajol ajam’un, akot ho atungdoh’un, chule kopja ho le thih jol ho jouse jong asutoh un ahi.
en: Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the old gate. They laid its beams and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
text:
NEH 3:6
Thadou: Chule Khopi Kelkot luichu Paseah chapa Joiada leh Besodeiah chapa Meshullam in asempha lhon in ahi. Chule amahon ajol ajam’un, akot ho atungdoh’un, chule kopja ho le thih jol ho jouse jong asutoh un ahi.
English: Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the old gate. They laid its beams and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

tcz: Amaho banin Gibeon a kon in Milatiah, Meronoth a konin Jadon, chule Gibeon mipite Mizpah a kon a hung mipiten Eupharates lhum lam gamvaipo pa chenna mun gei asemphauvin ahi.
en: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, repaired the residence of the governor beyond the River.
text:
NEH 3:7
Thadou: Amaho banin Gibeon a kon in Milatiah, Meronoth a konin Jadon, chule Gibeon mipite Mizpah a kon a hung mipiten Eupharates lhum lam gamvaipo pa chenna mun gei asemphauvin ahi.
English: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, repaired the residence of the governor beyond the River.

tcz: Chule hiche bana hin sanakhenga pang Harhai’ah chapa Uzziel in ana semphan ahi; chule ama ban a hin thaonam twi sema pang Hananiah in ana semphan, chule amaho hin Jerusalem kulpi pal lenpa geiyin anasem phauvin ahi.
en: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs, and they fortified Jerusalem even to the wide wall.
text:
NEH 3:8
Thadou: Chule hiche bana hin sanakhenga pang Harhai’ah chapa Uzziel in ana semphan ahi; chule ama ban a hin thaonam twi sema pang Hananiah in ana semphan, chule amaho hin Jerusalem kulpi pal lenpa geiyin anasem phauvin ahi.
English: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs, and they fortified Jerusalem even to the wide wall.

tcz: Chule amaho bana pal sempha a panga chu Jerusalem gamkai akehkhat chunga lamkaiya pang Hur chapa Rephai’ah ana hi.
en: Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.
text:
NEH 3:9
Thadou: Chule amaho bana pal sempha a panga chu Jerusalem gamkai akehkhat chunga lamkaiya pang Hur chapa Rephai’ah ana hi.
English: Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.

tcz: Amaho bana hin Harumaph chapa Jedai’ah kitipa hin in kotmai lam chu ana semphan; chuleh ama bana chun Hashabneiah chapa Hattush chun asemphan ahi.
en: Next to them, Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house. Next to him, Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.
text:
NEH 3:10
Thadou: Amaho bana hin Harumaph chapa Jedai’ah kitipa hin in kotmai lam chu ana semphan; chuleh ama bana chun Hashabneiah chapa Hattush chun asemphan ahi.
English: Next to them, Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house. Next to him, Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.

tcz: Hiche bana hin Harim chapa Malkijah leh Pahath-moab chapa Hasshub in munchom banglai khat toh meilhum chung insang chung geiyin asempha lhonin ahi.
en: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab repaired another portion and the tower of the furnaces.
text:
NEH 3:11
Thadou: Hiche bana hin Harim chapa Malkijah leh Pahath-moab chapa Hasshub in munchom banglai khat toh meilhum chung insang chung geiyin asempha lhonin ahi.
English: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab repaired another portion and the tower of the furnaces.

tcz: Hallohesh chapa Shallum leh achanuten abanchu asem phauvin ahi; chule amahi Jerusalem gamkai akeh khat chunga lamkai ahiye.
en: Next to him, Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters made repairs.
text:
NEH 3:12
Thadou: Hallohesh chapa Shallum leh achanuten abanchu asem phauvin ahi; chule amahi Jerusalem gamkai akeh khat chunga lamkai ahiye.
English: Next to him, Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters made repairs.

tcz: Chule phaicham kelkot chu Hannun lamkai na in Zanoah mipiten ana semphauvin ahi, chule amahon akot ho atung doh’un, chujongle kopja ho le thih jol ho geiyin asutoh’un ahi. Chuleh palchu tong sangkhat le ja-nga gei Ehkul Kelkot chan geiyin ana semphauvin ahi.
en: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the valley gate. They built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and one thousand cubits of the wall to the dung gate.
text:
NEH 3:13
Thadou: Chule phaicham kelkot chu Hannun lamkai na in Zanoah mipiten ana semphauvin ahi, chule amahon akot ho atung doh’un, chujongle kopja ho le thih jol ho geiyin asutoh’un ahi. Chuleh palchu tong sangkhat le ja-nga gei Ehkul Kelkot chan geiyin ana semphauvin ahi.
English: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the valley gate. They built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and one thousand cubits of the wall to the dung gate.

tcz: Chule Ehkul Kelkot chu Beth-hakkerem gamkaiya lamkaiya pang Recab chapa Malkijah in asem phan; chule aman akotho atung doh in kopja ho le thih ho geiyin asutoh in ahi.
en: Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem, repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
text:
NEH 3:14
Thadou: Chule Ehkul Kelkot chu Beth-hakkerem gamkaiya lamkaiya pang Recab chapa Malkijah in asem phan; chule aman akotho atung doh in kopja ho le thih ho geiyin asutoh in ahi.
English: Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem, repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

tcz: Mizpah gamkaiya lamkai Kol-hozeh chapa Shallum chun Twisam putna kelkot chu asemphan, chule aman achung akhun, akot ho jong atungdoh in chuleh kopja ho le thih ho geiyin asutoh in ahi. Hiche bana chun lengpa hon kom Siloam twikul pal chu asemphan chule apal chu David khopia kona kidosuh kalbi geichun asemphan ahi.
en: Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the spring gate. He built it, covered it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars; and he repaired the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king’s garden, even to the stairs that go down from David’s city.
text:
NEH 3:15
Thadou: Mizpah gamkaiya lamkai Kol-hozeh chapa Shallum chun Twisam putna kelkot chu asemphan, chule aman achung akhun, akot ho jong atungdoh in chuleh kopja ho le thih ho geiyin asutoh in ahi. Hiche bana chun lengpa hon kom Siloam twikul pal chu asemphan chule apal chu David khopia kona kidosuh kalbi geichun asemphan ahi.
English: Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the spring gate. He built it, covered it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars; and he repaired the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king’s garden, even to the stairs that go down from David’s city.

tcz: Hiche banna hin Bethzur gamkai akeh khat chunga lamkaiya pang Azbuk chapa Nehemiah in asemphan ahi; chule aman David insung mite lhantoh kigalsai twikul chuleh galhat ho inmun chan geiyin asemphan ahi.
en: After him, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs to the place opposite the tombs of David, and to the pool that was made, and to the house of the mighty men.
text:
NEH 3:16
Thadou: Hiche banna hin Bethzur gamkai akeh khat chunga lamkaiya pang Azbuk chapa Nehemiah in asemphan ahi; chule aman David insung mite lhantoh kigalsai twikul chuleh galhat ho inmun chan geiyin asemphan ahi.
English: After him, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs to the place opposite the tombs of David, and to the pool that was made, and to the house of the mighty men.

tcz: Chule hiche banna hin Bani chapa Rehum lamkai nan Levite phabep khat in ana semphauvin; chule hiche banna hin Keilah gamkai akeh khat chunga lamkaipa Hashabi’ah lamkai nan ana semphauvin ahi.
en: After him, the Levites—Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.
text:
NEH 3:17
Thadou: Chule hiche banna hin Bani chapa Rehum lamkai nan Levite phabep khat in ana semphauvin; chule hiche banna hin Keilah gamkai akeh khat chunga lamkaipa Hashabi’ah lamkai nan ana semphauvin ahi.
English: After him, the Levites—Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.

tcz: Hiche banna hin Keilah gamkai akeh khat chunga lamkaiya pang Henadad chapa Binnui lamkai nan agamsung mite nana semphauvin ahi.
en: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.
text:
NEH 3:18
Thadou: Hiche banna hin Keilah gamkai akeh khat chunga lamkaiya pang Henadad chapa Binnui lamkai nan agamsung mite nana semphauvin ahi.
English: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.

tcz: Amaho banna Mizpah lamkai, Jeshua chapa Ezer hin pal ningkoi kom, manchah ho kikoina lang se se chu asem phan ahi.
en: Next to him, Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another portion across from the ascent to the armory at the turning of the wall.
text:
NEH 3:19
Thadou: Amaho banna Mizpah lamkai, Jeshua chapa Ezer hin pal ningkoi kom, manchah ho kikoina lang se se chu asem phan ahi.
English: Next to him, Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another portion across from the ascent to the armory at the turning of the wall.

tcz: Ama banna Zabbai chapa Baruch in thempulen Eliashib in kot ninga pat’in aninglang khat geiyin asemphan ahi.
en: After him, Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
text:
NEH 3:20
Thadou: Ama banna Zabbai chapa Baruch in thempulen Eliashib in kot ninga pat’in aninglang khat geiyin asemphan ahi.
English: After him, Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

tcz: Chule ama nunga hin Hakkoz chapa Uriah chapa Meremoth chun Eliashib in kot na konin aninglang khat geiyin asem phan ahi.
en: After him, Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
text:
NEH 3:21
Thadou: Chule ama nunga hin Hakkoz chapa Uriah chapa Meremoth chun Eliashib in kot na konin aninglang khat geiyin asem phan ahi.
English: After him, Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

tcz: Ama banna hin thempu hole phaicham a cheng hon asem phauvin ahi.
en: After him, the priests, the men of the surrounding area made repairs.
text:
NEH 3:22
Thadou: Ama banna hin thempu hole phaicham a cheng hon asem phauvin ahi.
English: After him, the priests, the men of the surrounding area made repairs.

tcz: Amaho ban ah hin Benjamin leh Hesshub amani toh kigalsai ja um chu asempha lhonin ahi; chule amani banna chun Ananiah chapoa Maasei’ah chapa Azariah chun ama inkom chu asemphan ahi.
en: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house. After them, Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah made repairs beside his own house.
text:
NEH 3:23
Thadou: Amaho ban ah hin Benjamin leh Hesshub amani toh kigalsai ja um chu asempha lhonin ahi; chule amani banna chun Ananiah chapoa Maasei’ah chapa Azariah chun ama inkom chu asemphan ahi.
English: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house. After them, Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah made repairs beside his own house.

tcz: Ama banna hin Henadad chapa Binnui chun Azariah inkoma pat aningkoi gei palgol chom khat chu asemphan ahi.
en: After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, and to the corner.
text:
NEH 3:24
Thadou: Ama banna hin Henadad chapa Binnui chun Azariah inkoma pat aningkoi gei palgol chom khat chu asemphan ahi.
English: After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, and to the corner.

tcz: Uzai chapa Palal chun agal langkhat in ningkoi lai chule insang laitah toh kigalsai lai, chule lengpa indan chung nung, in vengtup ho panna indan laitah chu asemphan ahi; chule ama bantah a hin Parosh chapa Pedai’ah leh;
en: Palal the son of Uzai made repairs opposite the turning of the wall, and the tower that stands out from the upper house of the king, which is by the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh made repairs.

tcz: Ophel vum'a cheng houin lhacha a pang hotoh twi kelkot gal nisolam insang toh kimai ngat laichu asemphauvin ahi.
en: (Now the temple servants lived in Ophel, to the place opposite the water gate toward the east, and the tower that stands out.)
text:
NEH 3:26
Thadou: Ophel vum'a cheng houin lhacha a pang hotoh twi kelkot gal nisolam insang toh kimai ngat laichu asemphauvin ahi.
English: (Now the temple servants lived in Ophel, to the place opposite the water gate toward the east, and the tower that stands out.)

tcz: Hiche jouchun Tekoah mipiho ahung’uvin insang thupitah a kitung doh gal Ophel pal geiyin mun chom khat ahung semphauvin ahi.
en: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, opposite the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel.
text:
NEH 3:27
Thadou: Hiche jouchun Tekoah mipiho ahung’uvin insang thupitah a kitung doh gal Ophel pal geiyin mun chom khat ahung semphauvin ahi.
English: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, opposite the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel.

tcz: Chule Sakol Kelkot chung chu thempu hon asem phauvin ahi; chule amaho khat cheh chun ama in toh kigal sai cheh chu asem phauvin ahi.
en: Above the horse gate, the priests made repairs, everyone across from his own house.
text:
NEH 3:28
Thadou: Chule Sakol Kelkot chung chu thempu hon asem phauvin ahi; chule amaho khat cheh chun ama in toh kigal sai cheh chu asem phauvin ahi.
English: Above the horse gate, the priests made repairs, everyone across from his own house.

tcz: Abanchu Immer chapa Zadok chun ama in toh kigalsai akotmai laitah mun phabep chu asemphan, chule ama banchun solang kelkot ngahpa Shecaniah chapa Shemai’ah chun asemphan ahi.
en: After them, Zadok the son of Immer made repairs across from his own house. After him, Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate, made repairs.
text:
NEH 3:29
Thadou: Abanchu Immer chapa Zadok chun ama in toh kigalsai akotmai laitah mun phabep chu asemphan, chule ama banchun solang kelkot ngahpa Shecaniah chapa Shemai’ah chun asemphan ahi.
English: After them, Zadok the son of Immer made repairs across from his own house. After him, Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate, made repairs.

tcz: Hiche banchu Shelemiah chapa Hananiah leh Zalaph chapa agup channa Hanun chun munchom lai khat asempha lhonin, alangkhat a Berekiah chapa Meshullam in ama chenna inmun gal a palchu asemphan ahi.
en: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.
text:
NEH 3:30
Thadou: Hiche banchu Shelemiah chapa Hananiah leh Zalaph chapa agup channa Hanun chun munchom lai khat asempha lhonin, alangkhat a Berekiah chapa Meshullam in ama chenna inmun gal a palchu asemphan ahi.
English: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.

tcz: Sana kheng ho lah a mikhat Malkijah kitipa chun Houin lhacha hole kivei ho umna in changei kelkot ngah ho gal lang changei a pal chu agenphan ahi; hiche ban jongchun anunglam indan chung geiyin asembe in ahi.
en: After him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths to the house of the temple servants, and of the merchants, made repairs opposite the gate of Hammiphkad and to the ascent of the corner.
text:
NEH 3:31
Thadou: Sana kheng ho lah a mikhat Malkijah kitipa chun Houin lhacha hole kivei ho umna in changei kelkot ngah ho gal lang changei a pal chu agenphan ahi; hiche ban jongchun anunglam indan chung geiyin asembe in ahi.
English: After him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths to the house of the temple servants, and of the merchants, made repairs opposite the gate of Hammiphkad and to the ascent of the corner.

tcz: Sana khenga pang adang hole kivei miho chun kelngoi kotpi ningkoiya konchun pal chu ahin semphauvin ahi.
en: Between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs.
text:
NEH 3:32
Thadou: Sana khenga pang adang hole kivei miho chun kelngoi kotpi ningkoiya konchun pal chu ahin semphauvin ahi.
English: Between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs.

tcz: Keihon pal kasah phat nauva kana toh’u hi Sanballat in ahin hetdoh phat’in alunghang lheh jengin ahi; ahin ama alunghan behseh jeh in Judate chu i-sahloutah in ahousen ahi.
en: But when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and was very indignant, and mocked the Jews.
text:
NEH 4:1
Thadou: Keihon pal kasah phat nauva kana toh’u hi Sanballat in ahin hetdoh phat’in alunghang lheh jengin ahi; ahin ama alunghan behseh jeh in Judate chu i-sahloutah in ahousen ahi.
English: But when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and was very indignant, and mocked the Jews.

tcz: Hitihin aloi agolho masangle Samaria sepai lamkai ho masanga hiti hin aseiye, “Hiche Israel mimote le tah lalte hin ipi bola kingaito hiuvaham? Gan kilhaina maicham gahbol mai maiya kona hi nikhat sunga hiche pal hi agah tundoh joujeng diuva angaitou ham? Chule hiche meiyin akahsa song hole bohse nong nai hohi mangcha a tohdoh ding agotnu hintem?” ati.
en: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?”
text:
NEH 4:2
Thadou: Hitihin aloi agolho masangle Samaria sepai lamkai ho masanga hiti hin aseiye, “Hiche Israel mimote le tah lalte hin ipi bola kingaito hiuvaham? Gan kilhaina maicham gahbol mai maiya kona hi nikhat sunga hiche pal hi agah tundoh joujeng diuva angaitou ham? Chule hiche meiyin akahsa song hole bohse nong nai hohi mangcha a tohdoh ding agotnu hintem?” ati.
English: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?”

tcz: Chule akomuva um Ammon mi Tobiah chun hitin ana seiye, “Itobangin kasaphai tijongleu, achunga khun sial khat galhai jongleh chonchim tante,” ati.
en: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”
text:
NEH 4:3
Thadou: Chule akomuva um Ammon mi Tobiah chun hitin ana seiye, “Itobangin kasaphai tijongleu, achunga khun sial khat galhai jongleh chonchim tante,” ati.
English: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”

tcz: Hichun keima hiti hin kataove, “Vo Kapa Pathen kataonao hi neihin ngaipeh’un, keiho hi noise tah in eikihouse tauve, hijeh chun eihouset nauhi amaho chunga chuh sah inlang; chule amaho joh migam a sohchangin umsah jotan:
en: “Hear, our God, for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land of captivity.
text:
NEH 4:4
Thadou: Hichun keima hiti hin kataove, “Vo Kapa Pathen kataonao hi neihin ngaipeh’un, keiho hi noise tah in eikihouse tauve, hijeh chun eihouset nauhi amaho chunga chuh sah inlang; chule amaho joh migam a sohchangin umsah jotan:
English: “Hear, our God, for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land of captivity.

tcz: Asuhkhel nau hi nahsah mon koi hih beh in, chule achonset naohi geldao hih beh in, ajeh chu amahohin natongho masang laitah a hin nangma naphin lunghang tauvin ahi,” kati.
en: Don’t cover their iniquity. Don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”
text:
NEH 4:5
Thadou: Asuhkhel nau hi nahsah mon koi hih beh in, chule achonset naohi geldao hih beh in, ajeh chu amahohin natongho masang laitah a hin nangma naphin lunghang tauvin ahi,” kati.
English: Don’t cover their iniquity. Don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”

tcz: Hitihin keihon khopi pumpi kimvel chu kagen jom toupeh un hiti chun akim kalhut tauvin ahi, ajeh chu mipiten thanom tah in na atongun ahi.
en: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.
text:
NEH 4:6
Thadou: Hitihin keihon khopi pumpi kimvel chu kagen jom toupeh un hiti chun akim kalhut tauvin ahi, ajeh chu mipiten thanom tah in na atongun ahi.
English: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.

tcz: Ahinla hitobang tah a hi natoh achal a Jerusalem pal achimsa lai jouse akisemphat hi Sanballat le Tobiah chuleh Arab mite, Amon mite le Ashdod miten ajahdoh phat’un alunghang lheh jeng tauvin ahi.
en: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be filled, they were very angry;

tcz: Hijeh chun amaho hin Jerusalem hindel khuma kisatpia suhboi dingin agong tauvin ahi.
en: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion among us.
text:
NEH 4:8
Thadou: Hijeh chun amaho hin Jerusalem hindel khuma kisatpia suhboi dingin agong tauvin ahi.
English: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion among us.

tcz: Ahinlah keiho Pathen hengah kataovun khopi chu kangah’un asun ajan in keiho le keiho kaki veng tauvin ahi.
en: But we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night because of them.
text:
NEH 4:9
Thadou: Ahinlah keiho Pathen hengah kataovun khopi chu kangah’un asun ajan in keiho le keiho kaki veng tauvin ahi.
English: But we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night because of them.

tcz: Hichejou hin Juda mipite natongho la athachol lheh tan, song lhoh dingla atamlheh nalaiyin ahi. Hijeh chun eiho changseh in pal hi saphajou pouhite tin aphun tauvin ahi.
en: Judah said, “The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading and there is much rubble, so that we are not able to build the wall.”
text:
NEH 4:10
Thadou: Hichejou hin Juda mipite natongho la athachol lheh tan, song lhoh dingla atamlheh nalaiyin ahi. Hijeh chun eiho changseh in pal hi saphajou pouhite tin aphun tauvin ahi.
English: Judah said, “The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading and there is much rubble, so that we are not able to build the wall.”

tcz: Alangkhatna kamelma teuvin jong, “Ipi thil soha ham ti ahetdoh kah’uvin, eihon delkhum’u hitin ithagam’uva anatohu hi isuhtang diu ahi,” tin aseiyun ahi.
en: Our adversaries said, “They will not know or see, until we come in among them and kill them, and cause the work to cease.”
text:
NEH 4:11
Thadou: Alangkhatna kamelma teuvin jong, “Ipi thil soha ham ti ahetdoh kah’uvin, eihon delkhum’u hitin ithagam’uva anatohu hi isuhtang diu ahi,” tin aseiyun ahi.
English: Our adversaries said, “They will not know or see, until we come in among them and kill them, and cause the work to cease.”

tcz: Hitia melmate toh cheng khom Judah ho ahungun avel vel in ahung seiyun, “Muntin a kona hunguva eihung delkhum diu ahi,” atiuve.
en: When the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten times from all places, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”
text:
NEH 4:12
Thadou: Hitia melmate toh cheng khom Judah ho ahungun avel vel in ahung seiyun, “Muntin a kona hunguva eihung delkhum diu ahi,” atiuve.
English: When the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten times from all places, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”

tcz: Hijeh chun keiman paltom mun nemlang akilang dom mun hoa chun thalchoi angah ding kakoiyin ahi. Chule keiman ama ama insung dungjuiyin chem, tengcha leh moltum kichoiya angah ding jong kaban goltoh in ahi.
en: Therefore I set guards in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places. I set the people by family groups with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
text:
NEH 4:13
Thadou: Hijeh chun keiman paltom mun nemlang akilang dom mun hoa chun thalchoi angah ding kakoiyin ahi. Chule keiman ama ama insung dungjuiyin chem, tengcha leh moltum kichoiya angah ding jong kaban goltoh in ahi.
English: Therefore I set guards in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places. I set the people by family groups with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

tcz: Hiche joujin keiman thil umdan chu kavetoh in, mithupi hole vaihom ho chule mipi dang hochu kakou khomin akomuvah hitin kaseiye, “Melmate jeh khun kicha hih behun! loupitah le thaneitah Pakai chu geldoh un chuleh nasopite, najiteu, nachateu leh na insungu huhnan galsat din pangun,” katin ahi.
en: I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, “Don’t be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.”
text:
NEH 4:14
Thadou: Hiche joujin keiman thil umdan chu kavetoh in, mithupi hole vaihom ho chule mipi dang hochu kakou khomin akomuvah hitin kaseiye, “Melmate jeh khun kicha hih behun! loupitah le thaneitah Pakai chu geldoh un chuleh nasopite, najiteu, nachateu leh na insungu huhnan galsat din pangun,” katin ahi.
English: I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, “Don’t be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.”

tcz: Kamelmateu chun athilse gon’u kahehdoh’u chu ajadoh tauvin chuleh Pathenin athilse gon’u chu asuhboipeh phat un, keiho palmuna kana toh nao mun cheh a kakile kit tauve.
en: When our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nothing, all of us returned to the wall, everyone to his work.
text:
NEH 4:15
Thadou: Kamelmateu chun athilse gon’u kahehdoh’u chu ajadoh tauvin chuleh Pathenin athilse gon’u chu asuhboipeh phat un, keiho palmuna kana toh nao mun cheh a kakile kit tauve.
English: When our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nothing, all of us returned to the wall, everyone to his work.

tcz: Ahinlah hichea konchun kamite akeh khatin bou na atongun, adangsen tengcha akidop’un, lum akichoi’un, chule thalpi akipat’un, thih sangkhol aki’ah sohkei tauve. Chuleh lamkai ho jouse chu Judah mipiho atilkhou in apang jingun ahi.
en: From that time forth, half of my servants did the work, and half of them held the spears, the shields, the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.
text:
NEH 4:16
Thadou: Ahinlah hichea konchun kamite akeh khatin bou na atongun, adangsen tengcha akidop’un, lum akichoi’un, chule thalpi akipat’un, thih sangkhol aki’ah sohkei tauve. Chuleh lamkai ho jouse chu Judah mipiho atilkhou in apang jingun ahi.
English: From that time forth, half of my servants did the work, and half of them held the spears, the shields, the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.

tcz: Chule natong hochun akhut langkhat in athilpoh’u chu atuh’un, chuleh akhut langkhat in manchah akichoi’un ahi.
en: Those who built the wall, and those who bore burdens loaded themselves; everyone with one of his hands did the work, and with the other held his weapon.
text:
NEH 4:17
Thadou: Chule natong hochun akhut langkhat in athilpoh’u chu atuh’un, chuleh akhut langkhat in manchah akichoi’un ahi.
English: Those who built the wall, and those who bore burdens loaded themselves; everyone with one of his hands did the work, and with the other held his weapon.

tcz: Hiche phat laitah hin pasal phabep leh ajiteuvin a Judah chanpi ho dounan kiphin na thu ahin samphong tauvin ahi.
en: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.
text:
NEH 5:1
Thadou: Hiche phat laitah hin pasal phabep leh ajiteuvin a Judah chanpi ho dounan kiphin na thu ahin samphong tauvin ahi.
English: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.

tcz: Amahon hitin aseiyun ahi, “Keiho hi insung mi tamte kahiuve, hijeh chun kaki hinso nadiuvin neh le chah kangaicha be uvin ahi,” atiuve.
en: For there were some who said, “We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.”
text:
NEH 5:2
Thadou: Amahon hitin aseiyun ahi, “Keiho hi insung mi tamte kahiuve, hijeh chun kaki hinso nadiuvin neh le chah kangaicha be uvin ahi,” atiuve.
English: For there were some who said, “We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.”

tcz: Adanghon aseiyun, keihon kel lhah sunga anneh kakimu na diuvin ka in ule kalouvu chuleh ka lengpileiyu katungdoh tauvin ahi.
en: There were also some who said, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses. Let us get grain, because of the famine.”
text:
NEH 5:3
Thadou: Adanghon aseiyun, keihon kel lhah sunga anneh kakimu na diuvin ka in ule kalouvu chuleh ka lengpileiyu katungdoh tauvin ahi.
English: There were also some who said, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses. Let us get grain, because of the famine.”

tcz: Chuleh adangin aseikit’un, “Keihon kai pehna dingin kalouvu leh kalengpileiyu sumpa lah na in katung gam tauvin ahi.
en: There were also some who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral.
text:
NEH 5:4
Thadou: Chuleh adangin aseikit’un, “Keihon kai pehna dingin kalouvu leh kalengpileiyu sumpa lah na in katung gam tauvin ahi.
English: There were also some who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral.

tcz: Keiho hi ahao ho insung mi mama kahiuvin, kachateu jong amaho chate tobang ahiuvin, ahinla kaki hinso thei nadiuva hi kachateu hi sohchang dinga suma kaki joh gam diu ahitai. Chule keihon kachanuteu hi kada kachamlou’uva kajoh gammu ahitan alonaje kahe tapouvin ahi, ajeh chu kalou’u leh ka lengpilei houhi mi koma katundoh gamu ahitai,” atiuvin ahi.
en: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers, our children as their children. Behold, we bring our sons and our daughters into bondage to be servants, and some of our daughters have been brought into bondage. It is also not in our power to help it, because other men have our fields and our vineyards.”
text:
NEH 5:5
Thadou: Keiho hi ahao ho insung mi mama kahiuvin, kachateu jong amaho chate tobang ahiuvin, ahinla kaki hinso thei nadiuva hi kachateu hi sohchang dinga suma kaki joh gam diu ahitai. Chule keihon kachanuteu hi kada kachamlou’uva kajoh gammu ahitan alonaje kahe tapouvin ahi, ajeh chu kalou’u leh ka lengpilei houhi mi koma katundoh gamu ahitai,” atiuvin ahi.
English: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers, our children as their children. Behold, we bring our sons and our daughters into bondage to be servants, and some of our daughters have been brought into bondage. It is also not in our power to help it, because other men have our fields and our vineyards.”

tcz: Hiche alunglhai lou nau thulhuh hi kajah doh phat in kalung ahanglheh jengin ahi.
en: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
text:
NEH 5:6
Thadou: Hiche alunglhai lou nau thulhuh hi kajah doh phat in kalung ahanglheh jengin ahi.
English: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

tcz: Giltah a lunggel kanei jouvin, mithupi hole vaihom hochu kaphoh’in, “Nanghon nasopi houvin sumpa alahnauva sumthoi nalah’uhi nasuh gentheiyu ahi,” katin ahi. Hitichun keiman hiche thu suhtohna dinga hin mipi kikhopna khat kana gongin ahi.
en: Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury, everyone of his brother.” I held a great assembly against them.
text:
NEH 5:7
Thadou: Giltah a lunggel kanei jouvin, mithupi hole vaihom hochu kaphoh’in, “Nanghon nasopi houvin sumpa alahnauva sumthoi nalah’uhi nasuh gentheiyu ahi,” katin ahi. Hitichun keiman hiche thu suhtohna dinga hin mipi kikhopna khat kana gongin ahi.
English: Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury, everyone of his brother.” I held a great assembly against them.

tcz: Hiche kikhopna a hin keiman hitin kana seiye, “Eihon isopi Judahte namdang ho koma amahole amaho ana kijohdoh hohi nung lhatdoh kitna dinga lung aki ngaito lai tah in nanghon amaho hi sohchang dingin nale joh doh kit tauvin ahi. Chule amaho hi i-jatvei lom i-lhadoh diu ham?” kati. Chujongle amahon akihon na diuvin ima sei ding ahepouvin ahi.
en: I said to them, “We, after our ability, have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations; and would you even sell your brothers, and should they be sold to us?” Then they held their peace, and found not a word to say.
text:
NEH 5:8
Thadou: Hiche kikhopna a hin keiman hitin kana seiye, “Eihon isopi Judahte namdang ho koma amahole amaho ana kijohdoh hohi nung lhatdoh kitna dinga lung aki ngaito lai tah in nanghon amaho hi sohchang dingin nale joh doh kit tauvin ahi. Chule amaho hi i-jatvei lom i-lhadoh diu ham?” kati. Chujongle amahon akihon na diuvin ima sei ding ahepouvin ahi.
English: I said to them, “We, after our ability, have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations; and would you even sell your brothers, and should they be sold to us?” Then they held their peace, and found not a word to say.

tcz: Chuin keiman kaseibe kitin, “Nathil bol’u hi adihpoi! I-melma nam hohin einoise louna diuvin I-Pathen’u ginna a hi ikimanchah lou diu ham?
en: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?
text:
NEH 5:9
Thadou: Chuin keiman kaseibe kitin, “Nathil bol’u hi adihpoi! I-melma nam hohin einoise louna diuvin I-Pathen’u ginna a hi ikimanchah lou diu ham?
English: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?

tcz: Keimatah le kasopi ho chule kana tonghon mipi ho koma hi sum le pai chule chang leh mim ho kana hom un ahi, ahinla tubeh hin sumthoi hi lah dau hite.
en: I likewise, my brothers and my servants, lend them money and grain. Please let us stop this usury.
text:
NEH 5:10
Thadou: Keimatah le kasopi ho chule kana tonghon mipi ho koma hi sum le pai chule chang leh mim ho kana hom un ahi, ahinla tubeh hin sumthoi hi lah dau hite.
English: I likewise, my brothers and my servants, lend them money and grain. Please let us stop this usury.

tcz: Nanghon alou hou le alengpilei hou, le Olive thinglei jouseu chule a in hou chu, tuni tah hin lepeh tauvin. Chule bat dinga sum, changle mim, lengpitwi le Olive thaova kona athoi nalah hou chu nale peh teitei diu ahi,” katin ahi.
en: Please restore to them, even today, their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, that you are charging them.”
text:
NEH 5:11
Thadou: Nanghon alou hou le alengpilei hou, le Olive thinglei jouseu chule a in hou chu, tuni tah hin lepeh tauvin. Chule bat dinga sum, changle mim, lengpitwi le Olive thaova kona athoi nalah hou chu nale peh teitei diu ahi,” katin ahi.
English: Please restore to them, even today, their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, that you are charging them.”

tcz: Chule amahon eidon but’un, “Keihon mipiho chu lepeh soh keijuving ting chule amahoa konin imacha ngeh tapou vinge, keihon nasei bang bang’a chu kabol diu ahitai,” atiuve. Hijou chun keiman thempuho le mithupi ho chule vaihom ho chu kakouvin akitepnau banga atohdoh tei na diuvin kakihahsel sah in ahi.
en: Then they said, “We will restore them, and will require nothing of them. We will do so, even as you say.” Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they would do according to this promise.
text:
NEH 5:12
Thadou: Chule amahon eidon but’un, “Keihon mipiho chu lepeh soh keijuving ting chule amahoa konin imacha ngeh tapou vinge, keihon nasei bang bang’a chu kabol diu ahitai,” atiuve. Hijou chun keiman thempuho le mithupi ho chule vaihom ho chu kakouvin akitepnau banga atohdoh tei na diuvin kakihahsel sah in ahi.
English: Then they said, “We will restore them, and will require nothing of them. We will do so, even as you say.” Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they would do according to this promise.

tcz: Chuphat in keiman kaponchol chu kathingin kaseitai, “Nakitepnau dungjuija chu nabol louvu leh na insung’u leh na thilkeu houva konin nathing lhauhen kati,” Chule khoppi pumpin eidonbut’uvin, “Amen,” atiuvin Pakai athangvah’un ahi. Chule mipi ho chun akitepnau bang bangin atongdoh tauvin ahi.
en: Also I shook out my lap, and said, “So may God shake out every man from his house, and from his labor, that doesn’t perform this promise; even may he be shaken out and emptied like this.” All the assembly said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD. The people did according to this promise.
text:
NEH 5:13
Thadou: Chuphat in keiman kaponchol chu kathingin kaseitai, “Nakitepnau dungjuija chu nabol louvu leh na insung’u leh na thilkeu houva konin nathing lhauhen kati,” Chule khoppi pumpin eidonbut’uvin, “Amen,” atiuvin Pakai athangvah’un ahi. Chule mipi ho chun akitepnau bang bangin atongdoh tauvin ahi.
English: Also I shook out my lap, and said, “So may God shake out every man from his house, and from his labor, that doesn’t perform this promise; even may he be shaken out and emptied like this.” All the assembly said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD. The people did according to this promise.

tcz: Hitihin kum som le ni sung in Judah gamvaipo in kapangin chule Artexerxes lengchan kal kum somni a pat kum som thumle ni changei, kei kahin kanoiya vaipo ho ahin katoh nau dinmun dungjuiya kachan ding dol’u chanvou chu kalapouve.
en: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brothers have not eaten the bread of the governor.
text:
NEH 5:14
Thadou: Hitihin kum som le ni sung in Judah gamvaipo in kapangin chule Artexerxes lengchan kal kum somni a pat kum som thumle ni changei, kei kahin kanoiya vaipo ho ahin katoh nau dinmun dungjuiya kachan ding dol’u chanvou chu kalapouve.
English: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brothers have not eaten the bread of the governor.

tcz: Gamvaipo masa hon vang mipiho pohgih nasa tah anapoh sah un, dangka shekel som li kalval in mipi lah a neh le chah chule lengpitwi ana kidon jiuvin ahi. Chule alhachauva pangte ho jengin jong mipi chunga ana kinomsah jiuvin ahinlah keiman Pathen kagin jeh'in hiti chun kanabol pon ahi.
en: But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty shekels of silver; yes, even their servants ruled over the people, but I didn’t do so, because of the fear of God.
text:
NEH 5:15
Thadou: Gamvaipo masa hon vang mipiho pohgih nasa tah anapoh sah un, dangka shekel som li kalval in mipi lah a neh le chah chule lengpitwi ana kidon jiuvin ahi. Chule alhachauva pangte ho jengin jong mipi chunga ana kinomsah jiuvin ahinlah keiman Pathen kagin jeh'in hiti chun kanabol pon ahi.
English: But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty shekels of silver; yes, even their servants ruled over the people, but I didn’t do so, because of the fear of God.

tcz: Keima tah jengin jong pal sem na a hin lunglut tah in na katongin chule gam leiset lamdoh ding jong kana gelpoi. Chule kalhacha ho jeng jong hiche pal semna ahin kana mangcha soh keiyin ahi.
en: Yes, I also continued in the work of this wall. We didn’t buy any land. All my servants were gathered there to the work.
text:
NEH 5:16
Thadou: Keima tah jengin jong pal sem na a hin lunglut tah in na katongin chule gam leiset lamdoh ding jong kana gelpoi. Chule kalhacha ho jeng jong hiche pal semna ahin kana mangcha soh keiyin ahi.
English: Yes, I also continued in the work of this wall. We didn’t buy any land. All my servants were gathered there to the work.

tcz: Gam chom choma kona kholjin hungji ho tilou vin jong Judah miho vaihom ho mi ja nga le som nga hi thonlou vin an neh kakhang jingjin ahivangin keiman ima kana ngeh pon ahi.
en: Moreover there were at my table, of the Jews and the rulers, one hundred fifty men, in addition to those who came to us from among the nations that were around us.
text:
NEH 5:17
Thadou: Gam chom choma kona kholjin hungji ho tilou vin jong Judah miho vaihom ho mi ja nga le som nga hi thonlou vin an neh kakhang jingjin ahivangin keiman ima kana ngeh pon ahi.
English: Moreover there were at my table, of the Jews and the rulers, one hundred fifty men, in addition to those who came to us from among the nations that were around us.

tcz: Niseh a keiman neh le chah a kato doh jing chu bongchal khat, kelngoi ahilou le kelcha gup ahcha tampi ahijinge. Chule nisom seh leh donding lengpitwi suhneng jing angaiyin ahi. Ahiyeng vang'in keiman gamvaipo kahina a eikipe nehle chah kachan ding dol chu kangeh deh poi, ajeh chu mipihon pohgih apohkhop set sau ahi.
en: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep. Also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine. Yet for all this, I didn’t demand the governor’s pay, because the bondage was heavy on this people.
text:
NEH 5:18
Thadou: Niseh a keiman neh le chah a kato doh jing chu bongchal khat, kelngoi ahilou le kelcha gup ahcha tampi ahijinge. Chule nisom seh leh donding lengpitwi suhneng jing angaiyin ahi. Ahiyeng vang'in keiman gamvaipo kahina a eikipe nehle chah kachan ding dol chu kangeh deh poi, ajeh chu mipihon pohgih apohkhop set sau ahi.
English: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep. Also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine. Yet for all this, I didn’t demand the governor’s pay, because the bondage was heavy on this people.

tcz: Vo ka Pathen keima hiche mite dinga thil hijat kabol hi neigeldoh peh in lang hiche jeh hin phatthei neiboh in.
en: Remember me, my God, for all the good that I have done for this people.
text:
NEH 5:19
Thadou: Vo ka Pathen keima hiche mite dinga thil hijat kabol hi neigeldoh peh in lang hiche jeh hin phatthei neiboh in.
English: Remember me, my God, for all the good that I have done for this people.

tcz: Kamelmateu Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem kiti Arab mipale midang hon, kotpi chengse le kelkot dunga katundoh loulai vangun, Jerusalem pal chu akigen chaiyin avanglai mun khatcha aum tapoi ti amudoh phat’un;
en: Now when it was reported to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arabian, and to the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it (though even to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),

tcz: Sanballat le Geshem in Ono phaicham Hakkephirim kho ah kimutou hite tin thu eihin thot in ahi. Ahinlah amani hin keima chunga thilse agon lhon ahichu keiman kahen ahi.
en: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come! Let’s meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.
text:
NEH 6:2
Thadou: Sanballat le Geshem in Ono phaicham Hakkephirim kho ah kimutou hite tin thu eihin thot in ahi. Ahinlah amani hin keima chunga thilse agon lhon ahichu keiman kahen ahi.
English: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come! Let’s meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.

tcz: Hijeh chun keiman adonbutna in thu hiti hin kathot in ahi, “Keiman natoh lentah khat katoh ahi, hijeh hin hungthei ponge, nangni toh kimuto ding gunsetna iti kanatoh ka ngah thei ding ham?
en: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you?”
text:
NEH 6:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun keiman adonbutna in thu hiti hin kathot in ahi, “Keiman natoh lentah khat katoh ahi, hijeh hin hungthei ponge, nangni toh kimuto ding gunsetna iti kanatoh ka ngah thei ding ham?
English: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you?”

tcz: Hitobang hin amanin livei jen thu eihin thot lhonin kenjong kadonbut ngai ngaiyin kadonbut in ahi.
en: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way.
text:
NEH 6:4
Thadou: Hitobang hin amanin livei jen thu eihin thot lhonin kenjong kadonbut ngai ngaiyin kadonbut in ahi.
English: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way.

tcz: Anga-vei channan Sanballat in alhachapa kakomah ahin sol in akhut’ah hondohsa lekhathot khat ahinchoiye.
en: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand,
text:
NEH 6:5
Thadou: Anga-vei channan Sanballat in alhachapa kakomah ahin sol in akhut’ah hondohsa lekhathot khat ahinchoiye.
English: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand,

tcz: Hiche chun hitin aseiye, “Hiche vella um nam mite lah a hin thu kithang khat akijan, Geshem in jong hichu adih ahi ati, hichu ahileh nangleh Judah tehin lengpa dounan galbol ding agon ahi, hiche jeh'a hi pal nasemphat’u ahi tithu kithang dungjuiya nanghi leng chang dinga kigong nahi,” akiti.
en: in which was written, “It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel. Because of that, you are building the wall. You would be their king, according to these words.
text:
NEH 6:6
Thadou: Hiche chun hitin aseiye, “Hiche vella um nam mite lah a hin thu kithang khat akijan, Geshem in jong hichu adih ahi ati, hichu ahileh nangleh Judah tehin lengpa dounan galbol ding agon ahi, hiche jeh'a hi pal nasemphat’u ahi tithu kithang dungjuiya nanghi leng chang dinga kigong nahi,” akiti.
English: in which was written, “It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel. Because of that, you are building the wall. You would be their king, according to these words.

tcz: Aman athupoh dungjuiyin nanghin Jerusalem a nangma chung chang phongdoh dingin thempu ho jong apansah e akiti, veuvin Judah gammah lengkhat aumtai; Hiche thu kithang hi lengpa kom a athu hi gale lhun teiding ahi ti nahet ding doltah ahi, hijeh chun hungin lang hiche thuhi seikhom hite.”
en: You have also appointed prophets to proclaim of you at Jerusalem, saying, ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now it will be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let’s take counsel together.”
text:
NEH 6:7
Thadou: Aman athupoh dungjuiyin nanghin Jerusalem a nangma chung chang phongdoh dingin thempu ho jong apansah e akiti, veuvin Judah gammah lengkhat aumtai; Hiche thu kithang hi lengpa kom a athu hi gale lhun teiding ahi ti nahet ding doltah ahi, hijeh chun hungin lang hiche thuhi seikhom hite.”
English: You have also appointed prophets to proclaim of you at Jerusalem, saying, ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now it will be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let’s take counsel together.”

tcz: Hichun keiman thu lethuh na kapen, “Nahin thusei chu khatcha adih aumpoi, aboncha chu nangin nabol thu ngen ahibouve,” kati.
en: Then I sent to him, saying, “There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.”
text:
NEH 6:8
Thadou: Hichun keiman thu lethuh na kapen, “Nahin thusei chu khatcha adih aumpoi, aboncha chu nangin nabol thu ngen ahibouve,” kati.
English: Then I sent to him, saying, “There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.”

tcz: Amaho hin suh kichat a chule keiho hi lunglhah sah ding chule anatoh’u hi suhtang ding atiu ahi. Hijeh chun keiman natoh chu gut tah in kamano jon ahi.
en: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But now, strengthen my hands.
text:
NEH 6:9
Thadou: Amaho hin suh kichat a chule keiho hi lunglhah sah ding chule anatoh’u hi suhtang ding atiu ahi. Hijeh chun keiman natoh chu gut tah in kamano jon ahi.
English: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But now, strengthen my hands.

tcz: Khonungin, Mehetabal tupa Delaiah chapa Shemai’ah chu a in muna aum na a kaga chen kaga kimupi in ahi, hichun aman hitin aseiye, “Eiho Pathen houin sunga kimu tou hitin kot kikha khumu hite, chule namelmaten tujan na hi nahung thadiu ahi.”
en: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home; and he said, “Let us meet together in God’s house, within the temple, and let’s shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you. Yes, in the night they will come to kill you.”
text:
NEH 6:10
Thadou: Khonungin, Mehetabal tupa Delaiah chapa Shemai’ah chu a in muna aum na a kaga chen kaga kimupi in ahi, hichun aman hitin aseiye, “Eiho Pathen houin sunga kimu tou hitin kot kikha khumu hite, chule namelmaten tujan na hi nahung thadiu ahi.”
English: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home; and he said, “Let us meet together in God’s house, within the temple, and let’s shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you. Yes, in the night they will come to kill you.”

tcz: Ahinla keiman kadonbut’in, “Koiham kei din muna dinga kichat jeh a jam ding ngah? Chule koiham kei dinmuna dinga ahinkho kihuhdoh na dinga houin sunga kisel ding ngah? Ahipoi hitia chu ka umlou ding ahi,” kati.
en: I said, “Should a man like me flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.”
text:
NEH 6:11
Thadou: Ahinla keiman kadonbut’in, “Koiham kei din muna dinga kichat jeh a jam ding ngah? Chule koiham kei dinmuna dinga ahinkho kihuhdoh na dinga houin sunga kisel ding ngah? Ahipoi hitia chu ka umlou ding ahi,” kati.
English: I said, “Should a man like me flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.”

tcz: Pathenin ama koma chun thu aseipoi ti kahei, aman hiche gaothu chu Tobiah leh Sanballat in achohdoh lhon na aseisah lhon ahibouve ti kahet ahi.
en: I discerned, and behold, God had not sent him, but he pronounced this prophecy against me. Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
text:
NEH 6:12
Thadou: Pathenin ama koma chun thu aseipoi ti kahei, aman hiche gaothu chu Tobiah leh Sanballat in achohdoh lhon na aseisah lhon ahibouve ti kahet ahi.
English: I discerned, and behold, God had not sent him, but he pronounced this prophecy against me. Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

tcz: Amahon kichat sah a chule chonset sah ding eigot lhon ahibouve. Hiteng chuleh oimoa thepmo sah ding eigot lhon ahi.
en: He was hired so that I would be afraid, do so, and sin, and that they might have material for an evil report, that they might reproach me.
text:
NEH 6:13
Thadou: Amahon kichat sah a chule chonset sah ding eigot lhon ahibouve. Hiteng chuleh oimoa thepmo sah ding eigot lhon ahi.
English: He was hired so that I would be afraid, do so, and sin, and that they might have material for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

tcz: Vo Ka-Pathen Tobiah leh Sanballat thilse bol ho pihi hingel doh in, chuleh keima kichatsah tei ding eigoa themgaonu Noadiah le themgao dangho jouse jonghi hingel doh in.
en: “Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear.”
text:
NEH 6:14
Thadou: Vo Ka-Pathen Tobiah leh Sanballat thilse bol ho pihi hingel doh in, chuleh keima kichatsah tei ding eigoa themgaonu Noadiah le themgao dangho jouse jonghi hingel doh in.
English: “Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear.”

tcz: Hiti chun ‘Elul’ lha nileh som ni le nga chan ni kasah pat niuva pat ni som nga le ni ni channin pal chu kagen chai tauvin ahi.
en: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.
text:
NEH 6:15
Thadou: Hiti chun ‘Elul’ lha nileh som ni le nga chan ni kasah pat niuva pat ni som nga le ni ni channin pal chu kagen chai tauvin ahi.
English: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.

tcz: Kamel ma hou le avel a cheng mite hon ajahdoh phat’un akicha lheh jengun jum akisa lheh jengun ahi. Hiche hi Pathen panpina jal a atohdoh jouvu ahi ti amahon ahedoh tauvin ahi.
en: When all our enemies heard of it, all the nations that were around us were afraid, and they lost their confidence; for they perceived that this work was done by our God.
text:
NEH 6:16
Thadou: Kamel ma hou le avel a cheng mite hon ajahdoh phat’un akicha lheh jengun jum akisa lheh jengun ahi. Hiche hi Pathen panpina jal a atohdoh jouvu ahi ti amahon ahedoh tauvin ahi.
English: When all our enemies heard of it, all the nations that were around us were afraid, and they lost their confidence; for they perceived that this work was done by our God.

tcz: Hiche ni som nga le ni ni sung hin Tobiah leh Judah mithupi ho kikah a hin lekha thot tamtah akithot to le le jengun ahi.
en: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.
text:
NEH 6:17
Thadou: Hiche ni som nga le ni ni sung hin Tobiah leh Judah mithupi ho kikah a hin lekha thot tamtah akithot to le le jengun ahi.
English: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.

tcz: Ajeh chu Judah gam'a mitam tah in ama koma hi kihahsel a kihen ohna ananeiju ahi. Ipijeh inen itileh amahi Arab chapa Secaniah tupa ahin, chujongleh achapa Jehohanan chun Berekiah chapa Meshullam chanu chu akipuiya akichen pi ahi.
en: For there were many in Judah sworn to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.
text:
NEH 6:18
Thadou: Ajeh chu Judah gam'a mitam tah in ama koma hi kihahsel a kihen ohna ananeiju ahi. Ipijeh inen itileh amahi Arab chapa Secaniah tupa ahin, chujongleh achapa Jehohanan chun Berekiah chapa Meshullam chanu chu akipuiya akichen pi ahi.
English: For there were many in Judah sworn to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.

tcz: Hijeh chun mihon keikoma ama thilpha bol jeng aseiyun; kei thusei jouse jong ama henga alhut jiuvin ahi. Chule Tobiah hin keima suh kichat teina dingin lekha eihin thot jingin ahi.
en: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
text:
NEH 6:19
Thadou: Hijeh chun mihon keikoma ama thilpha bol jeng aseiyun; kei thusei jouse jong ama henga alhut jiuvin ahi. Chule Tobiah hin keima suh kichat teina dingin lekha eihin thot jingin ahi.
English: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

tcz: Pal kaget chai phat’un keiman kotpi ho chu katungdoh in chule kelkot ngah ho le lasathem ho chule Levi ho chu atoh mun che’uva kapansah in ahi.
en: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
text:
NEH 7:1
Thadou: Pal kaget chai phat’un keiman kotpi ho chu katungdoh in chule kelkot ngah ho le lasathem ho chule Levi ho chu atoh mun che’uva kapansah in ahi.
English: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

tcz: Keiman Jerusalem khopi sunga vaihom dingin kasopipa Hanani kapansah in, Hananiah chu khopi kulpi vaipon kapansah in ahi; ajeh chu amahi tahsan umtah le midang sanga Pathen jana neitah mi ahi.
en: I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many.
text:
NEH 7:2
Thadou: Keiman Jerusalem khopi sunga vaihom dingin kasopipa Hanani kapansah in, Hananiah chu khopi kulpi vaipon kapansah in ahi; ajeh chu amahi tahsan umtah le midang sanga Pathen jana neitah mi ahi.
English: I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many.

tcz: Chule amaho koma chun keiman kaseiyin, “Nikhat sungin ni ahasat laisen kelkot chu honsan koi hih un, chuleh kelkot ngah hochun kot anga lai sung seuvin khah’unlang kotchu kamchah un. Chule Jerusalema cheng ho chu kot ngah dingin pan mun peuvin, chule phattin in nga sah jouvin, chule loikhat chu apan mun’uva umden’u hen lang loikhat chu ama cheh inmaiya ngasah un,” katin ahi.
en: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”
text:
NEH 7:3
Thadou: Chule amaho koma chun keiman kaseiyin, “Nikhat sungin ni ahasat laisen kelkot chu honsan koi hih un, chuleh kelkot ngah hochun kot anga lai sung seuvin khah’unlang kotchu kamchah un. Chule Jerusalema cheng ho chu kot ngah dingin pan mun peuvin, chule phattin in nga sah jouvin, chule loikhat chu apan mun’uva umden’u hen lang loikhat chu ama cheh inmaiya ngasah un,” katin ahi.
English: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”

tcz: Hichepet chun khopi chu alen in akijal in ahi, ahinla asunga cheng mite chu alhomin ahi. Chule achen nau in ho jong chu sahphat lou ahi.
en: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.
text:
NEH 7:4
Thadou: Hichepet chun khopi chu alen in akijal in ahi, ahinla asunga cheng mite chu alhomin ahi. Chule achen nau in ho jong chu sahphat lou ahi.
English: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.

tcz: Hitichun Pathenin eihetsah dungjuiyin, khopi sunga lamkai hole mithupi ho chu khosunga cheng milhom ho chutoh kakou khomun aminu kajih lut sah in ahi. Chule keiman Judah gamma ana kile masaho min kijihlut na lekhabu chu kana mudoh in ahi, hichea kamu chu hiche ho hi ahi:
en: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:
text:
NEH 7:5
Thadou: Hitichun Pathenin eihetsah dungjuiyin, khopi sunga lamkai hole mithupi ho chu khosunga cheng milhom ho chutoh kakou khomun aminu kajih lut sah in ahi. Chule keiman Judah gamma ana kile masaho min kijihlut na lekhabu chu kana mudoh in ahi, hichea kamu chu hiche ho hi ahi:
English: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:

tcz: Hiche Judahte asohchan nauva hungkile doh a gamchom choma ana kithe-thang hochu ahiuve. Chule leng Nebuchednezzer in Babylona ana puilut ana chenna ngaisau Jerusalem le Judah khopi chom choma tua lelut kit ho chu ahiuve.
en: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,
text:
NEH 7:6
Thadou: Hiche Judahte asohchan nauva hungkile doh a gamchom choma ana kithe-thang hochu ahiuve. Chule leng Nebuchednezzer in Babylona ana puilut ana chenna ngaisau Jerusalem le Judah khopi chom choma tua lelut kit ho chu ahiuve.
English: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,

tcz: Alamkai houchu, Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, chuleh Baanah ahiuve. Hiche Israel chate akithe thang nauva kona hung kile kit hochu ahiuve:
en: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
text:
NEH 7:7
Thadou: Alamkai houchu, Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, chuleh Baanah ahiuve. Hiche Israel chate akithe thang nauva kona hung kile kit hochu ahiuve:
English: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

tcz: Parosh insung mite mihem sangni le ja khat le som sagi le ni ahiuve.
en: The children of Parosh: two thousand one hundred seventy-two.
text:
NEH 7:8
Thadou: Parosh insung mite mihem sangni le ja khat le som sagi le ni ahiuve.
English: The children of Parosh: two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

tcz: Shephatiah insung mite chu mihem jathum le som sagi le ni ahiuve.
en: The children of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy-two.
text:
NEH 7:9
Thadou: Shephatiah insung mite chu mihem jathum le som sagi le ni ahiuve.
English: The children of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy-two.

tcz: Arah insung mite chu mihem jagup le som nga le ni ahiuve.
en: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.
text:
NEH 7:10
Thadou: Arah insung mite chu mihem jagup le som nga le ni ahiuve.
English: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.

tcz: Pahath Moab insung mite chu mihem(Jeshua le Joab chilhah ho) sangni le ja get le som le get ahiuve.
en: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred eighteen.
text:
NEH 7:11
Thadou: Pahath Moab insung mite chu mihem(Jeshua le Joab chilhah ho) sangni le ja get le som le get ahiuve.
English: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred eighteen.

tcz: Elam insung mite chu mihem sang khat le jani toh som nga le li ahiuve.
en: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
text:
NEH 7:12
