Thadou: Keima hi twikhanglen'a kichat chat um ganhing len ahilouleh gullui kahia nahonbit nanoija chu neikoi jeng ding ham?
English: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?

tcz: Keima kalupna in eilhamon intin, chule ka imut teng kanat genthei na ho olsah tante tin kagelle.
en: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’
text:
JOB 7:13
Thadou: Keima kalupna in eilhamon intin, chule ka imut teng kanat genthei na ho olsah tante tin kagelle.
English: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’

tcz: Ahinlah nangin mangse neimatsah jin, chule gaothil mu in nei kichat sah ji'e.
en: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,
text:
JOB 7:14
Thadou: Ahinlah nangin mangse neimatsah jin, chule gaothil mu in nei kichat sah ji'e.
English: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,

tcz: Hitia genthei thoh sang hin, eikimeh lih jeng hen lang thileng pha kasa joi.
en: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
text:
JOB 7:15
Thadou: Hitia genthei thoh sang hin, eikimeh lih jeng hen lang thileng pha kasa joi.
English: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.

tcz: Kahinkho kadei mon hitia hin hin ding hi kadei tapoi, O nikho lhomcha kanei sung hin kachangin nei dalha jengin.
en: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
text:
JOB 7:16
Thadou: Kahinkho kadei mon hitia hin hin ding hi kadei tapoi, O nikho lhomcha kanei sung hin kachangin nei dalha jengin.
English: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.

tcz: Mihem hohi ipi hiuva, nangin hibanga hi na khohsah a chule nagel jing jeng ham?
en: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,
text:
JOB 7:17
Thadou: Mihem hohi ipi hiuva, nangin hibanga hi na khohsah a chule nagel jing jeng ham?
English: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,

tcz: Ajeh chu nangin jingkah seh le nakhol chil soh in, chule phat jousen na patep jinge.
en: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?
text:
JOB 7:18
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangin jingkah seh le nakhol chil soh in, chule phat jousen na patep jinge.
English: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?

tcz: Kachil valna ding phatsung beh a ipi dinga nei dalhah lou ham?
en: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?
text:
JOB 7:19
Thadou: Kachil valna ding phatsung beh a ipi dinga nei dalhah lou ham?
English: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?

tcz: Chonset kanei ahilehnang chunga ipi kabol khah ham? O mihem te vejing pa, keihi nanga dinga pohgih kahija, natup penna neisem ham?
en: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?
text:
JOB 7:20
Thadou: Chonset kanei ahilehnang chunga ipi kabol khah ham? O mihem te vejing pa, keihi nanga dinga pohgih kahija, natup penna neisem ham?
English: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?

tcz: Kachonsetna hi ngaidam jengin lang chule kathemmona ho nei lahmang peh tan, ajeh chu leivui lah a kijam a thivah ding kahitan, nangin hin ven natin chemang tange.
en: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”
text:
JOB 7:21
Thadou: Kachonsetna hi ngaidam jengin lang chule kathemmona ho nei lahmang peh tan, ajeh chu leivui lah a kijam a thivah ding kahitan, nangin hin ven natin chemang tange.
English: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”

tcz: Hichun Shuh mi Bildad in Job chu adonbut e:
en: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
text:
JOB 8:1
Thadou: Hichun Shuh mi Bildad in Job chu adonbut e:
English: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

tcz: Hitia hi itih chan naum nah lai ding ham? Nathusei chu kichat umtah huinung gin abange.
en: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?
text:
JOB 8:2
Thadou: Hitia hi itih chan naum nah lai ding ham? Nathusei chu kichat umtah huinung gin abange.
English: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?

tcz: Pathenin thutah chu aletun ding ham? Hatchungnung pa chun adih chu aletun khah em?
en: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?
text:
JOB 8:3
Thadou: Pathenin thutah chu aletun ding ham? Hatchungnung pa chun adih chu aletun khah em?
English: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

tcz: Nachate chun ama douna a chonset anabollu hitei ding ahi, hiijeh a chu ahibep seuva ki engbollu ahi.
en: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.
text:
JOB 8:4
Thadou: Nachate chun ama douna a chonset anabollu hitei ding ahi, hiijeh a chu ahibep seuva ki engbollu ahi.
English: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen koma taova chule Hatchungnung pa lunglhaina naholla ahileh
en: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.
text:
JOB 8:5
Thadou: Ahinlah Pathen koma taova chule Hatchungnung pa lunglhaina naholla ahileh
English: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.

tcz: Chule atheng nahija, lung thengsella nahin leh aman atahbeh a nakai thouva na inchen kipana a nasem phat peh ding ahi.
en: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.
text:
JOB 8:6
Thadou: Chule atheng nahija, lung thengsella nahin leh aman atahbeh a nakai thouva na inchen kipana a nasem phat peh ding ahi.
English: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

tcz: Chule lhomchan kipan jongle chun tamtah'a nachai ding ahi.
en: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.
text:
JOB 8:7
Thadou: Chule lhomchan kipan jongle chun tamtah'a nachai ding ahi.
English: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.

tcz: Khang masalai chu dongin lang pule paten ana mudoh sao hug ah ngaiton,
en: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
text:
JOB 8:8
Thadou: Khang masalai chu dongin lang pule paten ana mudoh sao hug ah ngaiton,
English: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile eiho janhi bepma peng ihiuvin imacha ihepouve. Leisetna ihin nikho u jong nilim cheloi loi tobangbep ahi.
en: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
text:
JOB 8:9
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile eiho janhi bepma peng ihiuvin imacha ihepouve. Leisetna ihin nikho u jong nilim cheloi loi tobangbep ahi.
English: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)

tcz: Ahin eiho masanga hunghon nahil uvintin, amahon gollui lai thu nahil diu ahi.
en: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?
text:
JOB 8:10
Thadou: Ahin eiho masanga hunghon nahil uvintin, amahon gollui lai thu nahil diu ahi.
English: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?

tcz: Doplah hilouva umping sangtah'a khang theija, doplah hampa chu twibeija khang theijem?
en: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?
text:
JOB 8:11
Thadou: Doplah hilouva umping sangtah'a khang theija, doplah hampa chu twibeija khang theijem?
English: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?

tcz: Satlhah phat lou laiya apah jing laijun jong hampa ho sanga gang jon agoplha ji tauve.
en: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.
text:
JOB 8:12
Thadou: Satlhah phat lou laiya apah jing laijun jong hampa ho sanga gang jon agoplha ji tauve.
English: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.

tcz: Chutobang chu Pathen sumil te chunga jong chu ji ahin, Pathen neiloute kinepna chu twihu banga mang ji ahi.
en: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,
text:
JOB 8:13
Thadou: Chutobang chu Pathen sumil te chunga jong chu ji ahin, Pathen neiloute kinepna chu twihu banga mang ji ahi.
English: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,

tcz: Atahsan nao jong patjanga kikhai ahin, amachu maimom panna kingai ahiuve.
en: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.
text:
JOB 8:14
Thadou: Atahsan nao jong patjanga kikhai ahin, amachu maimom panna kingai ahiuve.
English: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.

tcz: Amahon ahoidoh nadiuvin ainnu atuh un ahinlah dding joupoi, amahon hatuh a tuh ding agot vangun adou jou deh poi.
en: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.
text:
JOB 8:15
Thadou: Amahon ahoidoh nadiuvin ainnu atuh un ahinlah dding joupoi, amahon hatuh a tuh ding agot vangun adou jou deh poi.
English: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.

tcz: Pathen neilou khu nisa noija khangdoh hampa abah ho honsung jamdoh a tobang ahiuve.
en: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.
text:
JOB 8:16
Thadou: Pathen neilou khu nisa noija khangdoh hampa abah ho honsung jamdoh a tobang ahiuve.
English: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.

tcz: Song kise thom lah a ajung kholutna, songho kah a hing ahi.
en: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.
text:
JOB 8:17
Thadou: Song kise thom lah a ajung kholutna, songho kah a hing ahi.
English: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

tcz: Ahinlah akibodoh tengleh anaum khalou bangin te.
en: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
text:
JOB 8:18
Thadou: Ahinlah akibodoh tengleh anaum khalou bangin te.
English: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

tcz: Hichu ahinkho kichaina ahitan, chule amun lo khel dingin adang hung kehdoh tante.
en: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.
text:
JOB 8:19
Thadou: Hichu ahinkho kichaina ahitan, chule amun lo khel dingin adang hung kehdoh tante.
English: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.

tcz: Ahin ven Pathen in milung thengho apaidoh lou ding, migilou dinga jong akhut alhan doh lou ding ahi.
en: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.
text:
JOB 8:20
Thadou: Ahin ven Pathen in milung thengho apaidoh lou ding, migilou dinga jong akhut alhan doh lou ding ahi.
English: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.

tcz: Aman khatvei kipah tah a nanuisah kitna, chule nane tenia kipathu nasap doh ding ahi.
en: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.
text:
JOB 8:21
Thadou: Aman khatvei kipah tah a nanuisah kitna, chule nane tenia kipathu nasap doh ding ahi.
English: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.

tcz: Nangma vetda ho chun jachatna ponsilla akisilluva chule migiloute chenna in chu kisumang ding ahi.
en: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”
text:
JOB 8:22
Thadou: Nangma vetda ho chun jachatna ponsilla akisilluva chule migiloute chenna in chu kisumang ding ahi.
English: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”

tcz: Hichun job in asieikit in :
en: Then Job answered,
text:
JOB 9:1
Thadou: Hichun job in asieikit in :
English: Then Job answered,

tcz: Henge, keiman alhangpin hiche hi adih e ti kahei. Ahinlah Pathen mitmua mihem khat chu themmona neilou ahitai tia kiphong doh thei ding ham?
en: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?
text:
JOB 9:2
Thadou: Henge, keiman alhangpin hiche hi adih e ti kahei. Ahinlah Pathen mitmua mihem khat chu themmona neilou ahitai tia kiphong doh thei ding ham?
English: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?

tcz: Mikhat touvin Pathen chu kiheh pi ding nom taleh ama chu khatveija sang khat vei kidonbut jou thei ding hinam?
en: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.
text:
JOB 9:3
Thadou: Mikhat touvin Pathen chu kiheh pi ding nom taleh ama chu khatveija sang khat vei kidonbut jou thei ding hinam?
English: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen chu ha chih a chinga, chule thahattah ahi. Koipen in ama chu aphin doh a anel jou ding ham?
en: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
text:
JOB 9:4
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile Pathen chu ha chih a chinga, chule thahattah ahi. Koipen in ama chu aphin doh a anel jou ding ham?
English: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?

tcz: Aman hetsahna masat beijin molsang ho achon mang jin, alunghan teng leh aleh khup jin ahi.
en: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.
text:
JOB 9:5
Thadou: Aman hetsahna masat beijin molsang ho achon mang jin, alunghan teng leh aleh khup jin ahi.
English: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.

tcz: Aman aumna munna konin leiset ahot ling jin chule abul akithing ji'e.
en: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.
text:
JOB 9:6
Thadou: Aman aumna munna konin leiset ahot ling jin chule abul akithing ji'e.
English: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.

tcz: Aman thu apeh a ahile, nisa soh tapontin chule lha jong vah taponte.
en: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.
text:
JOB 9:7
Thadou: Aman thu apeh a ahile, nisa soh tapontin chule lha jong vah taponte.
English: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.

tcz: Vanho jong aman achanga apha jal'a chule twikhanglen kinong jong gamgi asem peh ji ahi.
en: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.
text:
JOB 9:8
Thadou: Vanho jong aman achanga apha jal'a chule twikhanglen kinong jong gamgi asem peh ji ahi.
English: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.

tcz: Ahsi somleng, Bombiel leh juhei suhtum, vantham jol lhanglang kaija ahsi ho jouse abonna aman asem ahi.
en: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.
text:
JOB 9:9
Thadou: Ahsi somleng, Bombiel leh juhei suhtum, vantham jol lhanglang kaija ahsi ho jouse abonna aman asem ahi.
English: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.

tcz: Aman hetphah hoi hilou thil oupe tah tah ho asem in, sim senglou thil kidang aboldoh e.
en: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.
text:
JOB 9:10
Thadou: Aman hetphah hoi hilou thil oupe tah tah ho asem in, sim senglou thil kidang aboldoh e.
English: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.

tcz: Ahivangin, ahung naiji teng, kamu theipon, ache teng jongle ache kamu deh poi.
en: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.
text:
JOB 9:11
Thadou: Ahivangin, ahung naiji teng, kamu theipon, ache teng jongle ache kamu deh poi.
English: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.

tcz: Mikhat chu ahinna alah peh a ahileh kon a suhtang thei ding ham? Ipi bolla nahim tin adong ngam dem?
en: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’
text:
JOB 9:12
Thadou: Mikhat chu ahinna alah peh a ahileh kon a suhtang thei ding ham? Ipi bolla nahim tin adong ngam dem?
English: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’

tcz: Chutia chu Pathen in alung hanna chu atuhtang lou hileh twikhanglen'a ganhing tamtah tah ho jong akeng tonoija achilngim ding ahi.
en: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.
text:
JOB 9:13
Thadou: Chutia chu Pathen in alung hanna chu atuhtang lou hileh twikhanglen'a ganhing tamtah tah ho jong akeng tonoija achilngim ding ahi.
English: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.

tcz: Hijeh a chu kei koi kahija, Pathen chu donbut dia kagot ding ham? Ahilouleh kaki nelpi jeng ding ham?
en: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?
text:
JOB 9:14
Thadou: Hijeh a chu kei koi kahija, Pathen chu donbut dia kagot ding ham? Ahilouleh kaki nelpi jeng ding ham?
English: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?

tcz: Keima ana dih kha jeng jongleng kihonna ding kanei lou ding ahi. Eihepi nadinga bou katao thei ding ahi.
en: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.
text:
JOB 9:15
Thadou: Keima ana dih kha jeng jongleng kihonna ding kanei lou ding ahi. Eihepi nadinga bou katao thei ding ahi.
English: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.

tcz: Chule keiman ama chu kouving lang, chule aman eihou nama jongleh aman kathusei angai ding kaging chapoi.
en: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.
text:
JOB 9:16
Thadou: Chule keiman ama chu kouving lang, chule aman eihou nama jongleh aman kathusei angai ding kaging chapoi.
English: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.

tcz: Ajeh chu aman huipi gopi a eino khuma chule ajeh beija tang louhella eisuh nat ding ahi.
en: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.
text:
JOB 9:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu aman huipi gopi a eino khuma chule ajeh beija tang louhella eisuh nat ding ahi.
English: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.

tcz: Aman ei haijom sah theipon ahinlah gentheina khaveng vungin eisun dim khume.
en: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.
text:
JOB 9:18
Thadou: Aman ei haijom sah theipon ahinlah gentheina khaveng vungin eisun dim khume.
English: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.

tcz: Thahat sanna no ding hijeng jong leh, ama chu thahattah ahin thudih'a tanding kiti jongleh koipen in ama chu thutanna munna dinga akou ngam ding ham?
en: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’
text:
JOB 9:19
Thadou: Thahat sanna no ding hijeng jong leh, ama chu thahattah ahin thudih'a tanding kiti jongleh koipen in ama chu thutanna munna dinga akou ngam ding ham?
English: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’

tcz: Keima hijeng jong leng, keima kamtah in themmo eichansah ding ahibouve, themmona neilou hijong leng chonse a eiki sim nalai ding ahi.
en: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.
text:
JOB 9:20
Thadou: Keima hijeng jong leng, keima kamtah in themmo eichansah ding ahibouve, themmona neilou hijong leng chonse a eiki sim nalai ding ahi.
English: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.

tcz: Keima nolna bei kahi, ahinla hichun keija dingin kikhelna eibolpeh deh pon, kahinna jong kadei tapoi.
en: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.
text:
JOB 9:21
Thadou: Keima nolna bei kahi, ahinla hichun keija dingin kikhelna eibolpeh deh pon, kahinna jong kadei tapoi.
English: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.

tcz: Nolna bei mi hihen michonse hijong leng Pathen dingin abonchan akibang cheh in hijeh a chu themmona neilou le michonse ania asuhmang cheh ahi, kati.
en: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.
text:
JOB 9:22
Thadou: Nolna bei mi hihen michonse hijong leng Pathen dingin abonchan akibang cheh in hijeh a chu themmona neilou le michonse ania asuhmang cheh ahi, kati.
English: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.

tcz: Vangsetnan ahin lhun khuma nolna bei mi thina chu aman anuisat bepme.
en: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.
text:
JOB 9:23
Thadou: Vangsetnan ahin lhun khuma nolna bei mi thina chu aman anuisat bepme.
English: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.

tcz: Leiset pumpi hi migiloute khutna um ahin, chule Pathen in thutanho mit asuh chotji ahi. Ama bol ahiloule koibol ba hiding ham?
en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?
text:
JOB 9:24
Thadou: Leiset pumpi hi migiloute khutna um ahin, chule Pathen in thutanho mit asuh chotji ahi. Ama bol ahiloule koibol ba hiding ham?
English: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?

tcz: Milhai hat pa sangin kahinkho achegang jon kipana mukhalou hellin aleng mang jitai.
en: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.
text:
JOB 9:25
Thadou: Milhai hat pa sangin kahinkho achegang jon kipana mukhalou hellin aleng mang jitai.
English: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.

tcz: Pumpenga kisem kong bangin akitol mang jitai, muvanlai aneh ding kimat dinga gangtah a hung lenglha abange.
en: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.
text:
JOB 9:26
Thadou: Pumpenga kisem kong bangin akitol mang jitai, muvanlai aneh ding kimat dinga gangtah a hung lenglha abange.
English: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.

tcz: Keiman kakiphin naho sumil ingting, kalung gimna maiso pailhang ting, chule thanom tah in um inge tia kaki gelji vang'in,
en: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,’
text:
JOB 9:27
Thadou: Keiman kakiphin naho sumil ingting, kalung gimna maiso pailhang ting, chule thanom tah in um inge tia kaki gelji vang'in,
English: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,’

tcz: Kanat thoh genthei naho hi nasatah a kichatna leh lunggimna kaneije, ajeh chu O Pathen, nolna beija neimu lou ding kahei.
en: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent.
text:
JOB 9:28
Thadou: Kanat thoh genthei naho hi nasatah a kichatna leh lunggimna kaneije, ajeh chu O Pathen, nolna beija neimu lou ding kahei.
English: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent.

tcz: Ipi iti henlang hijong leh themmo hange eikimu ding ahileh ipi phachom dinga ei kibol gim gim ham?
en: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?
text:
JOB 9:29
Thadou: Ipi iti henlang hijong leh themmo hange eikimu ding ahileh ipi phachom dinga ei kibol gim gim ham?
English: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?

tcz: Kei le kei sabon in kisil ngim jeng jong leng chang-al in kakhut sop theng jong leng,
en: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,
text:
JOB 9:30
Thadou: Kei le kei sabon in kisil ngim jeng jong leng chang-al in kakhut sop theng jong leng,
English: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,

tcz: Nangin bon lhoh umna kotong sunga nei sonlut in natin chule keima vonnen hon jong eideimo diu ahi.
en: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.
text:
JOB 9:31
Thadou: Nangin bon lhoh umna kotong sunga nei sonlut in natin chule keima vonnen hon jong eideimo diu ahi.
English: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.

tcz: Pathen chu kei banga thibai hilou ahin, hijeh chun ama to kakinel theipoi, ahilou jongle thutanna munna kapuilut theipoi.
en: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.
text:
JOB 9:32
Thadou: Pathen chu kei banga thibai hilou ahin, hijeh chun ama to kakinel theipoi, ahilou jongle thutanna munna kapuilut theipoi.
English: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.

tcz: Keini eisucham theilhon khat anaum hihen lang, mikhat touvin thakhatna eipui khom thei lhon hihen,
en: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.
text:
JOB 9:33
Thadou: Keini eisucham theilhon khat anaum hihen lang, mikhat touvin thakhatna eipui khom thei lhon hihen,
English: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.

tcz: Misuchampa chun Pathen chun eijep a asuhtang thei hileh ama bolgenthei kichatna chu kanei lou ding ahi.
en: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;

tcz: Chutileh kichatna beihel a ama koma thu kasei thei ding ahin, ahinlah keiman keima thahat in hichu kabol theipoi.
en: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.
text:
JOB 9:35
Thadou: Chutileh kichatna beihel a ama koma thu kasei thei ding ahin, ahinlah keiman keima thahat in hichu kabol theipoi.
English: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.

tcz: Kahinkho hi kahechen tai, lhangphong tah in kiphin inge, kahin gentheina jeh a hi kiphin ding ahi.
en: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
text:
JOB 10:1
Thadou: Kahinkho hi kahechen tai, lhangphong tah in kiphin inge, kahin gentheina jeh a hi kiphin ding ahi.
English: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

tcz: Pathen koma ima hilouvin nei themmo sah hih in kati ding ahi. Keidouna mona eihin lhut khum peh ding chu nei seipeh in.
en: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
text:
JOB 10:2
Thadou: Pathen koma ima hilouvin nei themmo sah hih in kati ding ahi. Keidouna mona eihin lhut khum peh ding chu nei seipeh in.
English: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.

tcz: Kei nei suhgenthei na chu ipi phatchomna naneijem? Nakhut monga nasemsa keihi ibola nei paidoh ham? Migilou thilgon chunga meheuva naumpet nahi.
en: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?
text:
JOB 10:3
Thadou: Kei nei suhgenthei na chu ipi phatchomna naneijem? Nakhut monga nasemsa keihi ibola nei paidoh ham? Migilou thilgon chunga meheuva naumpet nahi.
English: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

tcz: Namit teni hi mihemte mit tobang hija, mihem hon amuthei hou bou hi namu thei ham?
en: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?
text:
JOB 10:4
Thadou: Namit teni hi mihemte mit tobang hija, mihem hon amuthei hou bou hi namu thei ham?
English: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?

tcz: Nahinkho hi mihem hinkho chanbep bou saova ham? Nahinkho hi chomlheh jenga ham?
en: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,
text:
JOB 10:5
Thadou: Nahinkho hi mihem hinkho chanbep bou saova ham? Nahinkho hi chomlheh jenga ham?
English: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,

tcz: Hijeh chun kathemmo naho kintah in neikhol chil peh in lang chule kachonsetna nahol hol jeng ding ham?
en: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?
text:
JOB 10:6
Thadou: Hijeh chun kathemmo naho kintah in neikhol chil peh in lang chule kachonsetna nahol hol jeng ding ham?
English: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

tcz: Themmona bei kahi nahet jeng vang'in nakhut teni a konin koiman eihuhdoh jou ponte.
en: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
text:
JOB 10:7
Thadou: Themmona bei kahi nahet jeng vang'in nakhut teni a konin koiman eihuhdoh jou ponte.
English: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

tcz: Nakhut tenia neigonna neisem ahijeng vang'in tun nei sumang hel tai.
en: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.
text:
JOB 10:8
Thadou: Nakhut tenia neigonna neisem ahijeng vang'in tun nei sumang hel tai.
English: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.

tcz: Leivuija konna neisem ahi, neigeldoh in lang, leivui nei nungso sah loi kit ding ham?
en: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
text:
JOB 10:9
Thadou: Leivuija konna neisem ahi, neigeldoh in lang, leivui nei nungso sah loi kit ding ham?
English: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

tcz: Nangin kathilgon hoa neipui hoijin, chule naobu a neigong in ahi.
en: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?
text:
JOB 10:10
Thadou: Nangin kathilgon hoa neipui hoijin, chule naobu a neigong in ahi.
English: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

tcz: Katahsa leh kavunin neitomin, kagu le kachang ho neijop mat peh in,
en: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
text:
JOB 10:11
Thadou: Katahsa leh kavunin neitomin, kagu le kachang ho neijop mat peh in,
English: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

tcz: Nangin hinkho neipen chule nangailutna thonlou neimu sah in; ame hoidamna noija kahinkho neihoitup peh e.
en: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.
text:
JOB 10:12
Thadou: Nangin hinkho neipen chule nangailutna thonlou neimu sah in; ame hoidamna noija kahinkho neihoitup peh e.
English: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in nachaloh dan adih tah, nathilgon dihtah ho,
en: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:
text:
JOB 10:13
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in nachaloh dan adih tah, nathilgon dihtah ho,
English: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

tcz: Nangin neivet lhih jinga chule kachonsetna ahileh kachonsetna chu nei ngaidam pon nate.
en: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.
text:
JOB 10:14
Thadou: Nangin neivet lhih jinga chule kachonsetna ahileh kachonsetna chu nei ngaidam pon nate.
English: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

tcz: Kachonset khah a ahileh keija dinga phamo lheh jeng ahin, chule nolna bei hijeng jong leng kalu kadomsang theipoi. Ajeh chu jachatna leh gentheinan eikidip letset e.
en: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.
text:
JOB 10:15
Thadou: Kachonset khah a ahileh keija dinga phamo lheh jeng ahin, chule nolna bei hijeng jong leng kalu kadomsang theipoi. Ajeh chu jachatna leh gentheinan eikidip letset e.
English: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.

tcz: Ijem tin kalu domsang taleng, nangin keipi bahkai sadel bangin neidellin natin, keidouna a kichat tijat naumna nathanei nachuneimu sah bep ding ahi.
en: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
text:
JOB 10:16
Thadou: Ijem tin kalu domsang taleng, nangin keipi bahkai sadel bangin neidellin natin, keidouna a kichat tijat naumna nathanei nachuneimu sah bep ding ahi.
English: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

tcz: Kei douna a nanatoh chu avel vellin nahet tohsah jin, nalung hanna khang toujing chun kachunga neisun khumin chule kei dou dingin sepai hon thah thah nahin puilut ji'e.
en: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.
text:
JOB 10:17
Thadou: Kei douna a nanatoh chu avel vellin nahet tohsah jin, nalung hanna khang toujing chun kachunga neisun khumin chule kei dou dingin sepai hon thah thah nahin puilut ji'e.
English: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.

tcz: Chuti chu ahileh ipi dinga kanu naobua konna nei lahdoh ham? Kapenna chu ipi dinga nei thiden sah lou ham?
en: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.
text:
JOB 10:18
Thadou: Chuti chu ahileh ipi dinga kanu naobua konna nei lahdoh ham? Kapenna chu ipi dinga nei thiden sah lou ham?
English: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

tcz: Chutile ahung peng khalou hel kabah a naobua konna jangkeija lhahkhuh anache tadinga,
en: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
text:
JOB 10:19
Thadou: Chutile ahung peng khalou hel kabah a naobua konna jangkeija lhahkhuh anache tadinga,
English: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

tcz: Keiman nikho lhomcha bou kanei ahitan hijeh chun kachangin nei dalha tan phat chomcha khat beh nopsahna phat kanei nadingin,
en: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,
text:
JOB 10:20
Thadou: Keiman nikho lhomcha bou kanei ahitan hijeh chun kachangin nei dalha tan phat chomcha khat beh nopsahna phat kanei nadingin,
English: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,

tcz: Kile kit lou dinga kadalhah a khojin le muthim lhangkhal kiheh nagam kajot masangin,
en: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

tcz: Jan khangkim lai banga khojin nagam muthim leh nohphah nagam, khovah jeng jong jan khang kim lai khojin toh abah nagam chu!
en: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”
text:
JOB 10:22
Thadou: Jan khangkim lai banga khojin nagam muthim leh nohphah nagam, khovah jeng jong jan khang kim lai khojin toh abah nagam chu!
English: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”

tcz: Hichun Naamath mi Zophar chun Job adonbut in,
en: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,
text:
JOB 11:1
Thadou: Hichun Naamath mi Zophar chun Job adonbut in,
English: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,

tcz: Twilon banga long thucheng hi mikhat beh in adonbut lou ding ham? Thu tamtah kisei hin mi khat chu nolna bei ahi ti aphotchet ding ham?
en: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
text:
JOB 11:2
Thadou: Twilon banga long thucheng hi mikhat beh in adonbut lou ding ham? Thu tamtah kisei hin mi khat chu nolna bei ahi ti aphotchet ding ham?
English: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?

tcz: Nasei sei laijahi kei kamoh umthim jeng ding ham?
en: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
text:
JOB 11:3
Thadou: Nasei sei laijahi kei kamoh umthim jeng ding ham?
English: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?

tcz: “Katahsan athenge, chule Pathen mitmun keima kangime,” tin naseije.
en: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’
text:
JOB 11:4
Thadou: “Katahsan athenge, chule Pathen mitmun keima kangime,” tin naseije.
English: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’

tcz: Pathen m among mongin seihen, m among mongin alunggel naseipeh ding hileh,
en: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,
text:
JOB 11:5
Thadou: Pathen m among mongin seihen, m among mongin alunggel naseipeh ding hileh,
English: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,

tcz: Ama mong mongin chihna thuguh ho chu naseipeh ding hihen, ajeh chu chihna dihtah chu thumai mai hilou ahi, ngaijin “Pathen in nathemmona sanga lhomjoa nabol genthei joh nahlai ahibouve.”
en: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.
text:
JOB 11:6
Thadou: Ama mong mongin chihna thuguh ho chu naseipeh ding hihen, ajeh chu chihna dihtah chu thumai mai hilou ahi, ngaijin “Pathen in nathemmona sanga lhomjoa nabol genthei joh nahlai ahibouve.”
English: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.

tcz: Pathen chihna thutah'a kisel guh chu naholdoh jou ding ham? Hat chungung ahina ho jouse chu naholdoh jou mong ding hinam?
en: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
text:
JOB 11:7
Thadou: Pathen chihna thutah'a kisel guh chu naholdoh jou ding ham? Hat chungung ahina ho jouse chu naholdoh jou mong ding hinam?
English: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

tcz: Hiche tobang chihna hetna hi van sanga sangjo ahin chule nang koi nahija hiche hinoimigam sanga jong thuhjo ahi, nangin ipi nahet em?
en: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?
text:
JOB 11:8
Thadou: Hiche tobang chihna hetna hi van sanga sangjo ahin chule nang koi nahija hiche hinoimigam sanga jong thuhjo ahi, nangin ipi nahet em?
English: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?

tcz: Hiche hi leiset sangin alenjon, chule twikhanglen sangin alenjoi.
en: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
text:
JOB 11:9
Thadou: Hiche hi leiset sangin alenjon, chule twikhanglen sangin alenjoi.
English: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

tcz: Pathen chu hunga mihem khat songkul'a koihen ahiloule thutanna munna kou taleh ama chu kon apho tang thei ding ham?
en: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?
text:
JOB 11:10
Thadou: Pathen chu hunga mihem khat songkul'a koihen ahiloule thutanna munna kou taleh ama chu kon apho tang thei ding ham?
English: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?

tcz: Ajeh chu aman midihlou ho chu ahet ahin chule achonsetna hou aboncha amelchih ji ahi.
en: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.
text:
JOB 11:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu aman midihlou ho chu ahet ahin chule achonsetna hou aboncha amelchih ji ahi.
English: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.

tcz: Milhoh bei chu hung ching lou ding hicheng jouse chunga chu gamlah sangan in anou ahin thei joh ding ahi.
en: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.
text:
JOB 11:12
Thadou: Milhoh bei chu hung ching lou ding hicheng jouse chunga chu gamlah sangan in anou ahin thei joh ding ahi.
English: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.

tcz: Ijemtia nangma tah in nalung nagel phatna, chule taona'a nakhut tenia amalam nasanna ahileh,
en: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.
text:
JOB 11:13
Thadou: Ijemtia nangma tah in nalung nagel phatna, chule taona'a nakhut tenia amalam nasanna ahileh,
English: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.

tcz: Pathenin nachonsetna abonna na onthol sah a, chule themmona jouse nanunga nadalhah sah ding ahi.
en: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.
text:
JOB 11:14
Thadou: Pathenin nachonsetna abonna na onthol sah a, chule themmona jouse nanunga nadalhah sah ding ahi.
English: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.

tcz: Chutengle nolna beija namai hung vahdoh ding ahin hung hatdoh in natin chule gin nanei tahlou ding ahi.
en: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,
text:
JOB 11:15
Thadou: Chutengle nolna beija namai hung vahdoh ding ahin hung hatdoh in natin chule gin nanei tahlou ding ahi.
English: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,

tcz: Nalung gentheina jouse sumil tan natin, twilong mang tobangbep hiding ahi.
en: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.
text:
JOB 11:16
Thadou: Nalung gentheina jouse sumil tan natin, twilong mang tobangbep hiding ahi.
English: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.

tcz: Nahinkho chu sunlai nisa sangin hung vah hoijon tin, muthim jeng jong jingkah sangin vah hoi jonte.
en: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.
text:
JOB 11:17
Thadou: Nahinkho chu sunlai nisa sangin hung vah hoijon tin, muthim jeng jong jingkah sangin vah hoi jonte.
English: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.

tcz: Kinepna nanei chun hansanna napen tin nahuhdoh a chule lhamong tah a nekicholdo ding ahi.
en: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.
text:
JOB 11:18
Thadou: Kinepna nanei chun hansanna napen tin nahuhdoh a chule lhamong tah a nekicholdo ding ahi.
English: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.

tcz: Kichatna neilouvin umen natin chule mitam tah in kithopi noma navet diu ahi.
en: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.
text:
JOB 11:19
Thadou: Kichatna neilouvin umen natin chule mitam tah in kithopi noma navet diu ahi.
English: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.

tcz: Ahinla migiloute vang amitnu kisucho a, amahon jamdohna anei lou diu, amaho akinep nau chu thina bou chu hiding ahitai.
en: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
text:
JOB 11:20
Thadou: Ahinla migiloute vang amitnu kisucho a, amahon jamdohna anei lou diu, amaho akinep nau chu thina bou chu hiding ahitai.
English: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”

tcz: Chujou chun Job in aseikit in,
en: Then Job answered,
text:
JOB 12:1
Thadou: Chujou chun Job in aseikit in,
English: Then Job answered,

tcz: Nangho mihem te hin thil ijakai nahet soh keiju hilou ham? Chule nathi teng uleh chihna jong nangma toh thitha ding ahi.
en: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.
text:
JOB 12:2
Thadou: Nangho mihem te hin thil ijakai nahet soh keiju hilou ham? Chule nathi teng uleh chihna jong nangma toh thitha ding ahi.
English: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

tcz: Aphai, kei matah in thil themkhat hetna kaneije, chule kei sangin nang naphajo deh poi; hitobang thilho hethei lou nangin thu nasei sei jeng ding ham?
en: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
text:
JOB 12:3
Thadou: Aphai, kei matah in thil themkhat hetna kaneije, chule kei sangin nang naphajo deh poi; hitobang thilho hethei lou nangin thu nasei sei jeng ding ham?
English: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

tcz: Kagol kapai ten einuisat un, eidonbut ding kinema Pathen kakou jeh chun, keima hi midih nolnabei kahin; ahijeng vang'in einuisat uve.
en: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.
text:
JOB 12:4
Thadou: Kagol kapai ten einuisat un, eidonbut ding kinema Pathen kakou jeh chun, keima hi midih nolnabei kahin; ahijeng vang'in einuisat uve.
English: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.

tcz: Anop nopma um mihon, hahsat natoh ho chu ija selou tah in anuisat jiuvin, amaho chun akipal ho chu ason opden jiuve.
en: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.
text:
JOB 12:5
Thadou: Anop nopma um mihon, hahsat natoh ho chu ija selou tah in anuisat jiuvin, amaho chun akipal ho chu ason opden jiuve.
English: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

tcz: Ahinlah michom ho chu mong tah in aki dalhan, chule Pathen sulung hang ho bitsel in achengui.
en: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.
text:
JOB 12:6
Thadou: Ahinlah michom ho chu mong tah in aki dalhan, chule Pathen sulung hang ho bitsel in achengui.
English: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.

tcz: Ganhing ho chudong jong le chun amahon nahil dingu ahi; van lai jolla vachate chu dong le chun amahon naseipeh unte.
en: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.
text:
JOB 12:7
Thadou: Ganhing ho chudong jong le chun amahon nahil dingu ahi; van lai jolla vachate chu dong le chun amahon naseipeh unte.
English: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.

tcz: Leiset chu kihoupi le chun abol ding dan nahil ding ahi, twikhanglen'a nga hon nakoma thu seijuhen.
en: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.
text:
JOB 12:8
Thadou: Leiset chu kihoupi le chun abol ding dan nahil ding ahi, twikhanglen'a nga hon nakoma thu seijuhen.
English: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.

tcz: Kamanthah nachu Pakai khutna hung kon ahi ti ahet sohkeiju ahi.
en: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this,
text:
JOB 12:9
Thadou: Kamanthah nachu Pakai khutna hung kon ahi ti ahet sohkeiju ahi.
English: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this,

tcz: Ajeh chu thil ahing thei jouse hinkho leh mihem jouse haina hi ama khut a um ahibouve.
en: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
text:
JOB 12:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu thil ahing thei jouse hinkho leh mihem jouse haina hi ama khut a um ahibouve.
English: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

tcz: Kam in anneh ho atui a-al ahetkhen banga nakol in jong ajah ho hi apatep ji ahi.
en: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
text:
JOB 12:11
Thadou: Kam in anneh ho atui a-al ahetkhen banga nakol in jong ajah ho hi apatep ji ahi.
English: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

tcz: Chihna hi upa ho a ahin, chule thil hetkhenna hi tehseho a ahi.
en: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
text:
JOB 12:12
Thadou: Chihna hi upa ho a ahin, chule thil hetkhenna hi tehseho a ahi.
English: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.

tcz: Ahinlah chihna tahbeh leh thahatna chu Pathen koma bou kimu ahin, thumop themna le thil hetkhen thei nahi ama a ahi.
en: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
text:
JOB 12:13
Thadou: Ahinlah chihna tahbeh leh thahatna chu Pathen koma bou kimu ahin, thumop themna le thil hetkhen thei nahi ama a ahi.
English: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.

tcz: Ipi hijongleh aman asuh mangsa chu kisapha kit theilou hel ahi; aman mi khat chu songkul'a akhum teng jamdoh nading umthei lou ahi.
en: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.
text:
JOB 12:14
Thadou: Ipi hijongleh aman asuh mangsa chu kisapha kit theilou hel ahi; aman mi khat chu songkul'a akhum teng jamdoh nading umthei lou ahi.
English: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.

tcz: Aman go chu atuhtang teng leiset chu nelgam asohji tai, twi chu ahin lhadoh teng leiset chung ahin chup soh jitai.
en: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.
text:
JOB 12:15
Thadou: Aman go chu atuhtang teng leiset chu nelgam asohji tai, twi chu ahin lhadoh teng leiset chung ahin chup soh jitai.
English: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

tcz: Henge, thahatna leh chihna chu ama a ahin, milhem lhaho leh akilhem lhaho chu ania athaneina um lhon ahi.
en: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.
text:
JOB 12:16
Thadou: Henge, thahatna leh chihna chu ama a ahin, milhem lhaho leh akilhem lhaho chu ania athaneina um lhon ahi.
English: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.

tcz: Thumopma pangho ho apui mangin, athutan phatnao alah mang peh jin, thutan chingtah ho ahung ngol ji tauve.
en: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.
text:
JOB 12:17
Thadou: Thumopma pangho ho apui mangin, athutan phatnao alah mang peh jin, thutan chingtah ho ahung ngol ji tauve.
English: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.

tcz: Aman lengpa sangkhol chol asutlhah peh in, akong buh uva khao akiveijin puimangin aumji tauve.
en: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.
text:
JOB 12:18
Thadou: Aman lengpa sangkhol chol asutlhah peh in, akong buh uva khao akiveijin puimangin aumji tauve.
English: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.

tcz: Aman thempu ho apui mangjin, adinmun u alahmang peh in, kum tamtah thahatna pang ho chu aleh khup jin ahi.
en: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.
text:
JOB 12:19
Thadou: Aman thempu ho apui mangjin, adinmun u alahmang peh in, kum tamtah thahatna pang ho chu aleh khup jin ahi.
English: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

tcz: Tahsan umtah thumopma pang ho asuthip in, upa ho thil hetkhen theina alahmang peh jitai.
en: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
text:
JOB 12:20
Thadou: Tahsan umtah thumopma pang ho asuthip in, upa ho thil hetkhen theina alahmang peh jitai.
English: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.

tcz: Leng chapate chunga minsetna asunlhah khumin, mithahat manchah beijin akoije.
en: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.
text:
JOB 12:21
Thadou: Leng chapate chunga minsetna asunlhah khumin, mithahat manchah beijin akoije.
English: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.

tcz: Muthim lah a kisel thil kidang ho ahohdoh jin khojin mang keina mun ahin salvah jin ahi.
en: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.
text:
JOB 12:22
Thadou: Muthim lah a kisel thil kidang ho ahohdoh jin khojin mang keina mun ahin salvah jin ahi.
English: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

tcz: Namtin vaipi atungdoh jin chule aman ama ho chu asu mang jin, namtin vaipi ho chu akikehjal sah jin chule don louvin akoi ji'e.
en: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.
text:
JOB 12:23
Thadou: Namtin vaipi atungdoh jin chule aman ama ho chu asu mang jin, namtin vaipi ho chu akikehjal sah jin chule don louvin akoi ji'e.
English: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

tcz: Leng ho thil hetkhenna alahmang peh jin, lampi umlouna gam phalou lah a vahle din adalha jitai.
en: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
text:
JOB 12:24
Thadou: Leng ho thil hetkhenna alahmang peh jin, lampi umlouna gam phalou lah a vahle din adalha jitai.
English: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

tcz: Khovah beijin muthim lah a akimai leleuvin, jukhamma londang dang ho bangin aseme.
en: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
text:
JOB 12:25
Thadou: Khovah beijin muthim lah a akimai leleuvin, jukhamma londang dang ho bangin aseme.
English: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.

tcz: Ven keiman hiche ho jouse hi kamit tah in kamun chule kanakol tah in kajan tun keiman kahetai.
en: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.
text:
JOB 13:1
Thadou: Ven keiman hiche ho jouse hi kamit tah in kamun chule kanakol tah in kajan tun keiman kahetai.
English: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

tcz: Ken nathil boldoh jouseu kahenai, kei sangin nangho naphajo deh pouve.
en: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.
text:
JOB 13:2
Thadou: Ken nathil boldoh jouseu kahenai, kei sangin nangho naphajo deh pouve.
English: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

tcz: Hatchungnung pa koma keija ding seh seh a jang keija thu kaseija kachung chang thua keiman Pathen ama tah chu kaki nelpi nom ahi.
en: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.
text:
JOB 13:3
Thadou: Hatchungnung pa koma keija ding seh seh a jang keija thu kaseija kachung chang thua keiman Pathen ama tah chu kaki nelpi nom ahi.
English: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

tcz: Nanghon vang, jou le nallin kahinkho nei suhset peh un, thempu banga nangho hi pannabei kithemput sah nahiuve.
en: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
text:
JOB 13:4
Thadou: Nanghon vang, jou le nallin kahinkho nei suhset peh un, thempu banga nangho hi pannabei kithemput sah nahiuve.
English: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

tcz: Thipbeh chan umthim thei leuchun, hichu nangho dinga nachih napen uva nabolthei sun u chu hiding ahi.
en: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
text:
JOB 13:5
Thadou: Thipbeh chan umthim thei leuchun, hichu nangho dinga nachih napen uva nabolthei sun u chu hiding ahi.
English: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

tcz: Mo kachansah nau hi ngaijuvin, kanelna hohi phaten ngaijuvin.
en: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
text:
JOB 13:6
Thadou: Mo kachansah nau hi ngaijuvin, kanelna hohi phaten ngaijuvin.
English: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

tcz: Pathen chu jouva nahonbit diu ham? Ama jeh a chu lungtheng lou puma nanel diu ham?
en: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
text:
JOB 13:7
Thadou: Pathen chu jouva nahonbit diu ham? Ama jeh a chu lungtheng lou puma nanel diu ham?
English: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

tcz: Naum chan hou chu ama nadei sah nau jeh a langnei nadeiju ham? Pathen chung chang thu a nanghon ama dinga nanel peh diu ham?
en: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?
text:
JOB 13:8
Thadou: Naum chan hou chu ama nadei sah nau jeh a langnei nadeiju ham? Pathen chung chang thu a nanghon ama dinga nanel peh diu ham?
English: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

tcz: Nathil bol hou ahin mudoh tenguleh ipi iti ding hinam? Bailam tah a mihem ho nangol bol banguva ama chu nangol bol theidiu ham?
en: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?
text:
JOB 13:9
Thadou: Nathil bol hou ahin mudoh tenguleh ipi iti ding hinam? Bailam tah a mihem ho nangol bol banguva ama chu nangol bol theidiu ham?
English: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

tcz: Ahipoi, guhthima ama langa lang neina naneijuva ahileh ama toh naboi dingu ahi.
en: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.
text:
JOB 13:10
Thadou: Ahipoi, guhthima ama langa lang neina naneijuva ahileh ama toh naboi dingu ahi.
English: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

tcz: Aloupina hin nakichat sah louvu ham? Nakichat nau chun nasun khum louvu ham?
en: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?
text:
JOB 13:11
Thadou: Aloupina hin nakichat sah louvu ham? Nakichat nau chun nasun khum louvu ham?
English: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?

tcz: Nathil geldoh theikit nau jong vutvai bep bou ahin, ami huhdoh nau jong leibel tobanga keh bai bep ahi.
en: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.
text:
JOB 13:12
Thadou: Nathil geldoh theikit nau jong vutvai bep bou ahin, ami huhdoh nau jong leibel tobanga keh bai bep ahi.
English: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.

tcz: Tun umthim unlang chule kachangseh in nei dalha tauvin, thu seijing ting, chule thil hung soh jouse kimaito pi tange.
en: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.
text:
JOB 13:13
Thadou: Tun umthim unlang chule kachangseh in nei dalha tauvin, thu seijing ting, chule thil hung soh jouse kimaito pi tange.
English: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

tcz: Henge, ken kahin kho chu kakhut in kilah ing ting, chule kalunggel mong mong sei tange.
en: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?
text:
JOB 13:14
Thadou: Henge, ken kahin kho chu kakhut in kilah ing ting, chule kalunggel mong mong sei tange.
English: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

tcz: Pathen in eitha maithei ahin, ahinlah kinepna ding dang kanei poi. Ken kachung thua ama kakinelpi ding ahi.
en: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
text:
JOB 13:15
Thadou: Pathen in eitha maithei ahin, ahinlah kinepna ding dang kanei poi. Ken kachung thua ama kakinelpi ding ahi.
English: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

tcz: Ahinla hiche hi eihuhdoh dinga chu ahin keima Pathen neilou kahipoi. Achuti loule ama masanga kadin jou lou ding ahi.
en: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.
text:
JOB 13:16
Thadou: Ahinla hiche hi eihuhdoh dinga chu ahin keima Pathen neilou kahipoi. Achuti loule ama masanga kadin jou lou ding ahi.
English: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.

tcz: Kasei ding jouse hi naichan ngaiju vin, kasei hi ngaijun.
en: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.
text:
JOB 13:17
Thadou: Kasei ding jouse hi naichan ngaiju vin, kasei hi ngaijun.
English: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

tcz: Kachung chang thu kaki gontoh soh in, nolna bei kahi ti eiki photchen peh ding ahi.
en: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
text:
JOB 13:18
Thadou: Kachung chang thu kaki gontoh soh in, nolna bei kahi ti eiki photchen peh ding ahi.
English: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

tcz: Hicheng ho chunga hi kon eikinelpi thei ding ham? Kathep mona naphotchen theijuva ahileh thipbeh chan um ingting thi tange.
en: Who is he who will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.
text:
JOB 13:19
Thadou: Hicheng ho chunga hi kon eikinelpi thei ding ham? Kathep mona naphotchen theijuva ahileh thipbeh chan um ingting thi tange.
English: Who is he who will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.

tcz: O Pathen! Thilni seh seh neiphal peh in, chutile nangma toh kimaito dinga kadin jou thei ding ahi.
en: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:
text:
JOB 13:20
Thadou: O Pathen! Thilni seh seh neiphal peh in, chutile nangma toh kimaito dinga kadin jou thei ding ahi.
English: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:

tcz: Kachunga konin nakhut ham tah chu neilah doh peh in, chule ame umpina kichat umtah chun nei kichat sah tahih in.
en: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
text:
JOB 13:21
Thadou: Kachunga konin nakhut ham tah chu neilah doh peh in, chule ame umpina kichat umtah chun nei kichat sah tahih in.
English: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

tcz: Tun neihin kouvin keiman nadonbut inge, ahiloule ken thu seijing ting chule nei donbut in,
en: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.
text:
JOB 13:22
Thadou: Tun neihin kouvin keiman nadonbut inge, ahiloule ken thu seijing ting chule nei donbut in,
English: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.

tcz: Ipi themmona kanei ham? Neiseipeh in, kachonsetna leh nang kadouna nei vetsah temin.
en: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
text:
JOB 13:23
Thadou: Ipi themmona kanei ham? Neiseipeh in, kachonsetna leh nang kadouna nei vetsah temin.
English: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

tcz: Ipi dinga keija konna naki heimang ham? Ibola namelma khat banga nei bol ham?
en: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?
text:
JOB 13:24
Thadou: Ipi dinga keija konna naki heimang ham? Ibola namelma khat banga nei bol ham?
English: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

tcz: Huimut lonle thingna banga nei kichat sah kit ding ham? Changpol gosa nadel ding ham?
en: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
text:
JOB 13:25
Thadou: Huimut lonle thingna banga nei kichat sah kit ding ham? Changpol gosa nadel ding ham?
English: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

tcz: Nangin keidou nan themmona thilse tah tah najihdoh in, chule kakhangdon laiya kachonsetna jouse nahin sulange.
en: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.
text:
JOB 13:26
Thadou: Nangin keidou nan themmona thilse tah tah najihdoh in, chule kakhangdon laiya kachonsetna jouse nahin sulange.
English: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

tcz: Nangin kakeng teni nakoi khomin chule kalam lhah jouse navelhi jinge, kakhonung jouse naholdoh in namelchih jinge.
en: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
text:
JOB 13:27
Thadou: Nangin kakeng teni nakoi khomin chule kalam lhah jouse navelhi jinge, kakhonung jouse naholdoh in namelchih jinge.
English: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

tcz: Pannabei thingmotsa tobang apin anehchai sa to kabange.
en: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
text:
JOB 13:28
Thadou: Pannabei thingmotsa tobang apin anehchai sa to kabange.
English: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.

tcz: Mihem hinkho hi ichan a lhasam a hitam? Hinkho hi ichanna choma ichanna gentheina dimsetna hitam?
en: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
text:
JOB 14:1
Thadou: Mihem hinkho hi ichan a lhasam a hitam? Hinkho hi ichanna choma ichanna gentheina dimsetna hitam?
English: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

tcz: Pahcha bangin ahung pah doh un chule agop lhaji tai, nilim kihei banginamang loi jitai.
en: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
text:
JOB 14:2
Thadou: Pahcha bangin ahung pah doh un chule agop lhaji tai, nilim kihei banginamang loi jitai.
English: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

tcz: Hitobang bep hinkho lhasam tah thilsem hi namitna navet jing ding hija chule keija konna kahin nikho jat sutoh dinga nei ngeh ham?
en: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?
text:
JOB 14:3
Thadou: Hitobang bep hinkho lhasam tah thilsem hi namitna navet jing ding hija chule keija konna kahin nikho jat sutoh dinga nei ngeh ham?
English: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?

tcz: Miboh a konna thenna kon apohdoh jou ding ham? Khat chan jong podoh thei ponte.
en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
text:
JOB 14:4
Thadou: Miboh a konna thenna kon apohdoh jou ding ham? Khat chan jong podoh thei ponte.
English: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

tcz: Kahin khou jong achom asau teptohsa nakoi ahin, lha ijat kahin diu ham tijong nahetsa ahi. Chule mitphet kah khat hin be ding jong neiphal peh pouve.
en: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.
text:
JOB 14:5
Thadou: Kahin khou jong achom asau teptohsa nakoi ahin, lha ijat kahin diu ham tijong nahetsa ahi. Chule mitphet kah khat hin be ding jong neiphal peh pouve.
English: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.

tcz: Hijeh chun kachangun nei dalhauvin chule kicholdo tauvinge. Keiho khut thalah tobang kahiuvin hijeh chun lung mongin kana toh u neitoh jou sah un.
en: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.
text:
JOB 14:6
Thadou: Hijeh chun kachangun nei dalhauvin chule kicholdo tauvinge. Keiho khut thalah tobang kahiuvin hijeh chun lung mongin kana toh u neitoh jou sah un.
English: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.

tcz: Thingphung jengin jong keinepna tam jo aneiyin kisatlhu jeng ta jong leh hung don thah kit intin, chule abah tamtah hung dondoh kit inte.
en: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.
text:
JOB 14:7
Thadou: Thingphung jengin jong keinepna tam jo aneiyin kisatlhu jeng ta jong leh hung don thah kit intin, chule abah tamtah hung dondoh kit inte.
English: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

tcz: Leinoiya ajung ho chu kikhan lhit henlang thi tajongle, chule aphung chu mot tajong leh,
en: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,
text:
JOB 14:8
Thadou: Leinoiya ajung ho chu kikhan lhit henlang thi tajongle, chule aphung chu mot tajong leh,
English: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

tcz: Twi thalhin jallin hungdonthah kit intin akeh thah bangin hung itt hah inte.
en: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.
text:
JOB 14:9
Thadou: Twi thalhin jallin hungdonthah kit intin akeh thah bangin hung itt hah inte.
English: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.

tcz: Ahinlah mihem ho athi teng vangleh athahat nau chemang ji ahitan, ahainau akichai teng leh hoiya umjiu hitam?
en: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?
text:
JOB 14:10
Thadou: Ahinlah mihem ho athi teng vangleh athahat nau chemang ji ahitan, ahainau akichai teng leh hoiya umjiu hitam?
English: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

tcz: Dilla konna twi ahua alen bangin, vadung jong nichangsat teng abeimang jitai.
en: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,
text:
JOB 14:11
Thadou: Dilla konna twi ahua alen bangin, vadung jong nichangsat teng abeimang jitai.
English: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,

tcz: Mihem hohi thoukit talou dingin choldo din akilup sah ji'e. Vanho abeihel kah sea amaho thoukit lou ding ahiuve.
en: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
text:
JOB 14:12
Thadou: Mihem hohi thoukit talou dingin choldo din akilup sah ji'e. Vanho abeihel kah sea amaho thoukit lou ding ahiuve.
English: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

tcz: Nangin lhankhuh a neisol mang ding kanome, chule nalung hanna achemang soh kahsen nei sumil hel jengin, ahinlah nei geldoh kit nadingin nikhosim na a namelchih in,
en: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!
text:
JOB 14:13
Thadou: Nangin lhankhuh a neisol mang ding kanome, chule nalung hanna achemang soh kahsen nei sumil hel jengin, ahinlah nei geldoh kit nadingin nikhosim na a namelchih in,
English: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!

tcz: Mithi chu hing thei kit ding ham? Chuti ahileh hahsat gentheina kadouna kum ho a hi kinepna nei peh ding ahi. Chule ken thina a kilhadoh ding chu kanga jing ding ahi.
en: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
text:
JOB 14:14
Thadou: Mithi chu hing thei kit ding ham? Chuti ahileh hahsat gentheina kadouna kum ho a hi kinepna nei peh ding ahi. Chule ken thina a kilhadoh ding chu kanga jing ding ahi.
English: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.

tcz: Nangin nei kouvin natin chule ken kadonbut ding nahi. Chule nakhut semsa keima neimu nom ding ahi.
en: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.
text:
JOB 14:15
Thadou: Nangin nei kouvin natin chule ken kadonbut ding nahi. Chule nakhut semsa keima neimu nom ding ahi.
English: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.

tcz: Kachonsetna ho jouse navet khella nangin kakal son jousea neihonbit ding ahi.
en: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
text:
JOB 14:16
Thadou: Kachonsetna ho jouse navet khella nangin kakal son jousea neihonbit ding ahi.
English: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?

tcz: Ka chonsetna jouse sakhao sunga nakhum tup a chule kathemmo na nakhu khum ding ahi.
en: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.
text:
JOB 14:17
Thadou: Ka chonsetna jouse sakhao sunga nakhum tup a chule kathemmo na nakhu khum ding ahi.
English: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

tcz: Ahinlah molsang ho ahal halla akelhah a akitol lhah khella chule songho kola akitahlhah banga,
en: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.
text:
JOB 14:18
Thadou: Ahinlah molsang ho ahal halla akelhah a akitol lhah khella chule songho kola akitahlhah banga,
English: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.

tcz: Twijin songho alhoh lhah a chule twisoh in leiset alhoh mang banga chu nangin mihemte kinepna nasuhmang pehji ahi.
en: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.
text:
JOB 14:19
Thadou: Twijin songho alhoh lhah a chule twisoh in leiset alhoh mang banga chu nangin mihemte kinepna nasuhmang pehji ahi.
English: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

tcz: Nangin amaho chu hunam in nabol in, chule amun adalha jitauve. Nangin amaho chu thina in nasu melsen chule nasol mang jitai.
en: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.
text:
JOB 14:20
Thadou: Nangin amaho chu hunam in nabol in, chule amun adalha jitauve. Nangin amaho chu thina in nasu melsen chule nasol mang jitai.
English: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.

tcz: Achateu atuteu jabol theija khangdoh hinauvem ti amahon ahepha naisai pouvin ahilouleh hetkham louvin a lhum mang jitauve.
en: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.
text:
JOB 14:21
Thadou: Achateu atuteu jabol theija khangdoh hinauvem ti amahon ahepha naisai pouvin ahilouleh hetkham louvin a lhum mang jitauve.
English: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

tcz: Amahon natna nasatah athoh un ahinkhou chu gentheina adimset e.
en: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”
text:
JOB 14:22
Thadou: Amahon natna nasatah athoh un ahinkhou chu gentheina adimset e.
English: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”

tcz: Hichun Teman mipa Eliphaz in adonbut in;
en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

tcz: Michingin hitobang thu hom keu chu donbut ponte. Nang hi imacha hilou nahin chule khohui hungnung bep nahi.
en: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
text:
JOB 15:2
Thadou: Michingin hitobang thu hom keu chu donbut ponte. Nang hi imacha hilou nahin chule khohui hungnung bep nahi.
English: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

tcz: Michingin tang louva thu homkeu sei din akigo jipon, hitobang thu a chu ipi phatchomna um'em?
en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?
text:
JOB 15:3
Thadou: Michingin tang louva thu homkeu sei din akigo jipon, hitobang thu a chu ipi phatchomna um'em?
English: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

tcz: Pathen ginna neilou nahim, ama dinga jana neilou nahi.
en: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
text:
JOB 15:4
Thadou: Pathen ginna neilou nahim, ama dinga jana neilou nahi.
English: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

tcz: Nachonsetna ho chun nakama ipi seiding ham ti naseipeh untin, nathucheng hohi joulhep themtah chunga kingam ahi.
en: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
text:
JOB 15:5
Thadou: Nachonsetna ho chun nakama ipi seiding ham ti naseipeh untin, nathucheng hohi joulhep themtah chunga kingam ahi.
English: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

tcz: Nangma kam tah chun themmo nachan sah ahin, kei kahipoi; namuh mama chun nang douna a thu asei ahi.
en: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
text:
JOB 15:6
Thadou: Nangma kam tah chun themmo nachan sah ahin, kei kahipoi; namuh mama chun nang douna a thu asei ahi.
English: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

tcz: Nanghi apeng masapen nahim? Molle lhang ho kisem masanga peng nahim?
en: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?
text:
JOB 15:7
Thadou: Nanghi apeng masapen nahim? Molle lhang ho kisem masanga peng nahim?
English: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

tcz: Pathen in guhthima nahilna ho nangai hinam? Chihna chu nangma tum dinga nanei hinam?
en: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
text:
JOB 15:8
Thadou: Pathen in guhthima nahilna ho nangai hinam? Chihna chu nangma tum dinga nanei hinam?
English: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

tcz: Keihon kahet louvu ipi nahetna, keihon kahet khen theilouvu nangin nahet khen thei um'em?
en: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?
text:
JOB 15:9
Thadou: Keihon kahet louvu ipi nahetna, keihon kahet khen theilouvu nangin nahet khen thei um'em?
English: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?

tcz: Keiho langa hin upa tah tah samkangsa apangun amaho chu napa sanga hatah a tahjo ahiuve.
en: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.
text:
JOB 15:10
Thadou: Keiho langa hin upa tah tah samkangsa apangun amaho chu napa sanga hatah a tahjo ahiuve.
English: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.

tcz: Pathen in nalhamon chu nang dinga neo behseh a ham? Nemma athusei chu lhing joulou ham?
en: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?
text:
JOB 15:11
Thadou: Pathen in nalhamon chu nang dinga neo behseh a ham? Nemma athusei chu lhing joulou ham?
English: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

tcz: Naki gellhah na chu ipin nalah mang peh ham? Na khomu theina chu ipin alhahsam sah ham?
en: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,
text:
JOB 15:12
Thadou: Naki gellhah na chu ipin nalah mang peh ham? Na khomu theina chu ipin alhahsam sah ham?
English: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen dounan nakihei mangin, chule hitobang thuphalou hi naseije.
en: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?
text:
JOB 15:13
Thadou: Hiti chun Pathen dounan nakihei mangin, chule hitobang thuphalou hi naseije.
English: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

tcz: Thithei khat tou chu theng theijem? Numeija pengdoh mihem chu adih a umthei ding ham?
en: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
text:
JOB 15:14
Thadou: Thithei khat tou chu theng theijem? Numeija pengdoh mihem chu adih a umthei ding ham?
English: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

tcz: Ven Pathen in vantil ho jeng jong atahsan joupoi, ama mitmu in vanho jeng jong athengsel poi.
en: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

tcz: Chonsetna dimho leh lheplhahna dimho leh gitlouna a dangchah ho chu ichan geijin thenna alhasam tadem?
en: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
text:
JOB 15:16
Thadou: Chonsetna dimho leh lheplhahna dimho leh gitlouna a dangchah ho chu ichan geijin thenna alhasam tadem?
English: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

tcz: Kathusei nangai dingle keiman navet sah inge, ken katahsa tah a kahet ho a kon in nadonbut inge.
en: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare
text:
JOB 15:17
Thadou: Kathusei nangai dingle keiman navet sah inge, ken katahsa tah a kahet ho a kon in nadonbut inge.
English: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare

tcz: Apa teuva konna hiche thu mama hi ajah uva, michingho hetsah dungjuija hiche hi kisudet ahi.
en: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

tcz: Gamdang miho hunglhun masang sot laipeh a chu koiham khat hitobang ho a konna gamkhat ana kipe ahi.
