en: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):
text:
JOB 15:19
Thadou: Gamdang miho hunglhun masang sot laipeh a chu koiham khat hitobang ho a konna gamkhat ana kipe ahi.
English: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

tcz: Migiloupa chu ahinkho lhum keijin nat gim genthei thoh in akipeh peh in lungsetna neilou ho dingin hahsat gentheina kum jat tamtah kikhol ahi.
en: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
text:
JOB 15:20
Thadou: Migiloupa chu ahinkho lhum keijin nat gim genthei thoh in akipeh peh in lungsetna neilou ho dingin hahsat gentheina kum jat tamtah kikhol ahi.
English: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

tcz: Ama banga kichat tijatna O aging jingin chule nikho phaho jeng jong misumang hon ahin delkhum dio kichatnan aneiye.
en: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
text:
JOB 15:21
Thadou: Ama banga kichat tijatna O aging jingin chule nikho phaho jeng jong misumang hon ahin delkhum dio kichatnan aneiye.
English: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.

tcz: Muthim lah a chedoh ding amahon angapcha pouve, kichatna jeh a amahon tol atha dingu ahi.
en: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
text:
JOB 15:22
Thadou: Muthim lah a chedoh ding amahon angapcha pouve, kichatna jeh a amahon tol atha dingu ahi.
English: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

tcz: Gamtinah avahle leuvin changlhah hoiya kakimu ding ham tin aseijuve. Amahon amanthah nadiu nikho anaije ti aheuve.
en: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
text:
JOB 15:23
Thadou: Gamtinah avahle leuvin changlhah hoiya kakimu ding ham tin aseijuve. Amahon amanthah nadiu nikho anaije ti aheuve.
English: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

tcz: Muthim nikhon amaho chu akichatsah uvin, galkon dinga kigong lengpa bangin lung gentheina leh lung natna dimset in ahing uve.
en: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
text:
JOB 15:24
Thadou: Muthim nikhon amaho chu akichatsah uvin, galkon dinga kigong lengpa bangin lung gentheina leh lung natna dimset in ahing uve.
English: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

tcz: Hatchungnung pa asuhboh uva Pathen akhut u athin khum jeh u chun,
en: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
text:
JOB 15:25
Thadou: Hatchungnung pa asuhboh uva Pathen akhut u athin khum jeh u chun,
English: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,

tcz: Alummu hattah chu akichoijun amadou nan isah loutah in anokhum jiuve.
en: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
text:
JOB 15:26
Thadou: Alummu hattah chu akichoijun amadou nan isah loutah in anokhum jiuve.
English: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,

tcz: Migiloute chu athaovun chule sumle paijin akhangtou cheh cheh un akongu jong athaovin apom doh sah uve.
en: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
text:
JOB 15:27
Thadou: Migiloute chu athaovun chule sumle paijin akhangtou cheh cheh un akongu jong athaovin apom doh sah uve.
English: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

tcz: Ahinlah akhopi hou hi kisumang thah ding ahin, amaho chu dalhahsa ingemma hung chenguva; sotlhuh ding sa a um cheh ahiuve.
en: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
text:
JOB 15:28
Thadou: Ahinlah akhopi hou hi kisumang thah ding ahin, amaho chu dalhahsa ingemma hung chenguva; sotlhuh ding sa a um cheh ahiuve.
English: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

tcz: Ahaosat nau jong sot tapontin, anei agou hou sot ponte; anei agouho jong kolmong geijin hung kikho khong soh taponte.
en: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.
text:
JOB 15:29
Thadou: Ahaosat nau jong sot tapontin, anei agou hou sot ponte; anei agouho jong kolmong geijin hung kikho khong soh taponte.
English: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.

tcz: Muthim lah a konin jamdoh thei pouvin tin, ajih hung dondoh ho jong nisan halgop intin chule Pathen hu haikhum chun amaho asuhmang ding ahi.
en: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.
text:
JOB 15:30
Thadou: Muthim lah a konin jamdoh thei pouvin tin, ajih hung dondoh ho jong nisan halgop intin chule Pathen hu haikhum chun amaho asuhmang ding ahi.
English: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.

tcz: Haosatna homkeu tahsanna chun amaho leh amaho kilhem lha sot tapou vintin, amaho dinga akipaman u chu ahomsa hiding ahi.
en: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.
text:
JOB 15:31
Thadou: Haosatna homkeu tahsanna chun amaho leh amaho kilhem lha sot tapou vintin, amaho dinga akipaman u chu ahomsa hiding ahi.
English: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.

tcz: Ahinkhou hoilai tah le thingbah kilhamlha bangin kisat lhauvin tin abah hou jong avellin hung engdoh kit tapou vinte.
en: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.
text:
JOB 15:32
Thadou: Ahinkhou hoilai tah le thingbah kilhamlha bangin kisat lhauvin tin abah hou jong avellin hung engdoh kit tapou vinte.
English: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.

tcz: Amaho chu lengpi phung aga matah a kilou lha bangle Olive thingphung aga kisem masanga apah pullha bang diu ahi.
en: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.
text:
JOB 15:33
Thadou: Amaho chu lengpi phung aga matah a kilou lha bangle Olive thingphung aga kisem masanga apah pullha bang diu ahi.
English: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen neiloute chu ahomkeu ahiuvin, nehguh chahguh a haosa ho in chu kavam ding ahi.
en: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
text:
JOB 15:34
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile Pathen neiloute chu ahomkeu ahiuvin, nehguh chahguh a haosa ho in chu kavam ding ahi.
English: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

tcz: Amahon boina naovop bangin avop un chule gitlouna ahing doh jiuve. Anaobu houvin joule nal asodoh uve.
en: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
text:
JOB 15:35
Thadou: Amahon boina naovop bangin avop un chule gitlouna ahing doh jiuve. Anaobu houvin joule nal asodoh uve.
English: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”

tcz: Chuin Job apaodoh kit in;
en: Then Job answered,

tcz: Hicheng ho jouse hi masanga kanajah sa ahitai, itobang genthei um milham nahiu hitam?
en: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!
text:
JOB 16:2
Thadou: Hicheng ho jouse hi masanga kanajah sa ahitai, itobang genthei um milham nahiu hitam?
English: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!

tcz: Hui sathethu nung hi nasuh tang theilouvu ham? Ipi hin tang louhella thu nasei sah sah jengu ham?
en: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
text:
JOB 16:3
Thadou: Hui sathethu nung hi nasuh tang theilouvu ham? Ipi hin tang louhella thu nasei sah sah jengu ham?
English: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?

tcz: Keiumna munna hi um hileu chun ken jong hitobang hi kaseithei ding ahi. Ken vang douna thu twilon banga kalon doh sah a chule kalu kathin khum ding nahi.
en: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,
text:
JOB 16:4
Thadou: Keiumna munna hi um hileu chun ken jong hitobang hi kaseithei ding ahi. Ken vang douna thu twilon banga kalon doh sah a chule kalu kathin khum ding nahi.
English: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,

tcz: Ahinlah kei chu ana hileng katil khouva nalengvai naho lahmang peh ding kagot ding ahi.
en: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.
text:
JOB 16:5
Thadou: Ahinlah kei chu ana hileng katil khouva nalengvai naho lahmang peh ding kagot ding ahi.
English: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.

tcz: Hiche ho khel hin kathoh gimna in kei le kei kaki vengbit in chule thusei ding kada jongleh kathoh natna alhom chom deh poi.
en: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?
text:
JOB 16:6
Thadou: Hiche ho khel hin kathoh gimna in kei le kei kaki vengbit in chule thusei ding kada jongleh kathoh natna alhom chom deh poi.
English: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?

tcz: O Pathen nangin tollhanga nei koilhan chule kachilhah nasugam tai.
en: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.
text:
JOB 16:7
Thadou: O Pathen nangin tollhanga nei koilhan chule kachilhah nasugam tai.
English: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.

tcz: Kana chonsetna ho photchet peh ding bang in, nangin kavun le kagu keuseh in neikoitai. Katahsa gong lhenglhung hin kei dounan aphochen tai.
en: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.
text:
JOB 16:8
Thadou: Kana chonsetna ho photchet peh ding bang in, nangin kavun le kagu keuseh in neikoitai. Katahsa gong lhenglhung hin kei dounan aphochen tai.
English: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.

tcz: Pathen in eivet dan chule lunghang tah in ahal hal in eibot tellin, aha eigel khum khume, chule amitchang sal tenin eihin vei.
en: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.
text:
JOB 16:9
Thadou: Pathen in eivet dan chule lunghang tah in ahal hal in eibot tellin, aha eigel khum khume, chule amitchang sal tenin eihin vei.
English: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.

tcz: Mihon eija piuvin chule einuisat uve, amahon isah loutah in kabengphe eibeh peh un kei dou dingin mipi ahung kikhom uve.
en: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.
text:
JOB 16:10
Thadou: Mihon eija piuvin chule einuisat uve, amahon isah loutah in kabengphe eibeh peh un kei dou dingin mipi ahung kikhom uve.
English: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.

tcz: Pathen in michonse ho khutna eipedoh in, aman migiloute khutna eiseplut tai.
en: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.
text:
JOB 16:11
Thadou: Pathen in michonse ho khutna eipedoh in, aman migiloute khutna eiseplut tai.
English: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.

tcz: Aman eisat teldeh kahsen thipbeh in kaum in, kalol in eiman in ahal hal in eisuchip jengin chuti chun abidoi dingin eitung doh e.
en: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.
text:
JOB 16:12
Thadou: Aman eisat teldeh kahsen thipbeh in kaum in, kalol in eiman in ahal hal in eisuchip jengin chuti chun abidoi dingin eitung doh e.
English: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.

tcz: Chule tun athalkap them hon eium kimvel un, athal chang uvin lungsetna beihel in eisun uvin tollhanga kathisan avei jenge.
en: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.
text:
JOB 16:13
Thadou: Chule tun athalkap them hon eium kimvel un, athal chang uvin lungsetna beihel in eisun uvin tollhanga kathisan avei jenge.
English: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.

tcz: Keidou nan avel vel in eisu teldeh jengin, gal hatpa mibolna bangin eino khume.
en: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.
text:
JOB 16:14
Thadou: Keidou nan avel vel in eisu teldeh jengin, gal hatpa mibolna bangin eino khume.
English: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.

tcz: Kagenthei vetsahnan khaodip pon kakisil in kaki letsahna leivui lah a akijam tai.
en: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.
text:
JOB 16:15
Thadou: Kagenthei vetsahnan khaodip pon kakisil in kaki letsahna leivui lah a akijam tai.
English: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.

tcz: Kaka kanan kamit asan lhatan, kamit teni athim sohtai.
en: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,
text:
JOB 16:16
Thadou: Kaka kanan kamit asan lhatan, kamit teni athim sohtai.
English: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in thil dihlou kabolpon chule kataona athenge.
en: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
text:
JOB 16:17
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in thil dihlou kabolpon chule kataona athenge.
English: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

tcz: O leiset kathisan selmang hihbeh in, keikhellin hung kapdoh uhen.
en: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.
text:
JOB 16:18
Thadou: O leiset kathisan selmang hihbeh in, keikhellin hung kapdoh uhen.
English: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.

tcz: Tu jengin jong eihetdoh sah ding vanna aume, kachung thu eiseipeh ding chu chung sanga aume.
en: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.
text:
JOB 16:19
Thadou: Tu jengin jong eihetdoh sah ding vanna aume, kachung thu eiseipeh ding chu chung sanga aume.
English: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.

tcz: Kagol kapai ten eideimo uvin ahinlah ken kamitlhi Pathen a kasung lhai.
en: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,
text:
JOB 16:20
Thadou: Kagol kapai ten eideimo uvin ahinlah ken kamitlhi Pathen a kasung lhai.
English: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,

tcz: Gollepaiho sucham theipa banga Pathen le kei kikah eikicham sah thei ding mi khattou kangai chai.
en: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!
text:
JOB 16:21
Thadou: Gollepaiho sucham theipa banga Pathen le kei kikah eikicham sah thei ding mi khattou kangai chai.
English: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!

tcz: Kahung kinung lekit tahlou nading lamlenna chu chesuh vahding kahitai.
en: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.
text:
JOB 16:22
Thadou: Kahung kinung lekit tahlou nading lamlenna chu chesuh vahding kahitai.
English: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.

tcz: Kalhagao akisuchip in, kahinkho haisam pai ding ahitan lhankhuh jong keima ngah a gotsa uma ahitai.
en: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.
text:
JOB 17:1
Thadou: Kalhagao akisuchip in, kahinkho haisam pai ding ahitan lhankhuh jong keima ngah a gotsa uma ahitai.
English: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.

tcz: Mi nuisat nom hon eium kimvellun ichan geija gilouva eiphin lunghang uvem tia kavet vet jeng ahi.
en: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.
text:
JOB 17:2
Thadou: Mi nuisat nom hon eium kimvellun ichan geija gilouva eiphin lunghang uvem tia kavet vet jeng ahi.
English: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

tcz: O Pathen nangin nolnabei kahin neihon bit peh in koimacha keima dinga hung dingdoh ding umlou hel ahi.
en: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?
text:
JOB 17:3
Thadou: O Pathen nangin nolnabei kahin neihon bit peh in koimacha keima dinga hung dingdoh ding umlou hel ahi.
English: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?

tcz: Nangin amaho hi ima ahetkhen theilou nading uva alung mit u nakha peh ahin, ahinlah amaho hi lunglhaina pehih in.
en: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.
text:
JOB 17:4
Thadou: Nangin amaho hi ima ahetkhen theilou nading uva alung mit u nakha peh ahin, ahinlah amaho hi lunglhaina pehih in.
English: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.

tcz: Amaho phatchomna dingin aloi agol hou chu apedoh jiuvin hijeh chun achateu gilkel thoh in kho helouvin umsah in.
en: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.
text:
JOB 17:5
Thadou: Amaho phatchomna dingin aloi agol hou chu apedoh jiuvin hijeh chun achateu gilkel thoh in kho helouvin umsah in.
English: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.

tcz: Aman mipi ho lah a konna einuisat ding chu asem ahin, kamaija chil eiset khumuve.
en: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.
text:
JOB 17:6
Thadou: Aman mipi ho lah a konna einuisat ding chu asem ahin, kamaija chil eiset khumuve.
English: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.

tcz: Kaka ka nan kamit apom doh joutai. Keima hi kana hinasa alie maimai bou chu kahi.
en: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
text:
JOB 17:7
Thadou: Kaka ka nan kamit apom doh joutai. Keima hi kana hinasa alie maimai bou chu kahi.
English: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.

tcz: Michonpha hon eimu teng uleh atija soh ji tauve, nolna bei miho chu Pathen neilou miho dounan ahung kipat doh jiuve.
en: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.
text:
JOB 17:8
Thadou: Michonpha hon eimu teng uleh atija soh ji tauve, nolna bei miho chu Pathen neilou miho dounan ahung kipat doh jiuve.
English: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

tcz: Michonpha ho chu malam jonin akitol jing uve. Chule akhut teni thengsel'a umho chu ahat cheh ahat cheh jiuve.
en: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
text:
JOB 17:9
Thadou: Michonpha ho chu malam jonin akitol jing uve. Chule akhut teni thengsel'a umho chu ahat cheh ahat cheh jiuve.
English: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

tcz: Nangho nabon Chauvin kinelna a phajep in hung kile kit uvin, nangho lah a miching khat beh kamu doh lou vang'in
en: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.
text:
JOB 17:10
Thadou: Nangho nabon Chauvin kinelna a phajep in hung kile kit uvin, nangho lah a miching khat beh kamu doh lou vang'in
English: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.

tcz: Keima hin nikho aki chaitan, kakinepna amangthah tai. Kalung ngaichat jouse akeh gam tai.
en: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
text:
JOB 17:11
Thadou: Keima hin nikho aki chaitan, kakinepna amangthah tai. Kalung ngaichat jouse akeh gam tai.
English: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.

tcz: Hiche miho hin jan hi sun ahi tin asei uvin, amahon muthim chu khovah ahi tin asei jiuve.
en: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.
text:
JOB 17:12
Thadou: Hiche miho hin jan hi sun ahi tin asei uvin, amahon muthim chu khovah ahi tin asei jiuve.
English: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

tcz: Lhankhuh a chu che taleng ipi itin tem? Chule muthim lah a chun lupna kisem leng?
en: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
text:
JOB 17:13
Thadou: Lhankhuh a chu che taleng ipi itin tem? Chule muthim lah a chun lupna kisem leng?
English: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

tcz: Lhankhuh chu kappa nahi tin kou leng, ipi itin tem? Chule than chu kanu ahi loule kasopinu tileng;
en: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’

tcz: Kakinepna hoilamba hita a mikhat touvin amu dem?
en: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?
text:
JOB 17:15
Thadou: Kakinepna hoilamba hita a mikhat touvin amu dem?
English: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?

tcz: Ahipoi kakinepna chu keima toh lhankhuh a kumlha suh khom ding kahi lhone. Leivui lah a kaki choldo khom ding ahi.
en: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
text:
JOB 17:16
Thadou: Ahipoi kakinepna chu keima toh lhankhuh a kumlha suh khom ding kahi lhone. Leivui lah a kaki choldo khom ding ahi.
English: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”

tcz: Hichun Shuh mi Bildad chun adonbut in:
en: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
text:
JOB 18:1
Thadou: Hichun Shuh mi Bildad chun adonbut in:
English: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

tcz: Nathusei nangah masang a ichan sauva nasei nahlai ding ham? Ka donbut diu nadeija ahile chihna thu seijin.
en: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
text:
JOB 18:2
Thadou: Nathusei nangah masang a ichan sauva nasei nahlai ding ham? Ka donbut diu nadeija ahile chihna thu seijin.
English: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

tcz: Nangin keiho gamsa ho sanga phajo maimaija neigel uham? Nangin keiho hi mingol a nei ngai tou ham?
en: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
text:
JOB 18:3
Thadou: Nangin keiho gamsa ho sanga phajo maimaija neigel uham? Nangin keiho hi mingol a nei ngai tou ham?
English: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?

tcz: Nalung han man in nalu jang sam chu botchai theijin nate, ahinlah hichun leiset asuhmang thei ding ham? Songpi ho akithin sah theiding ham?
en: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?
text:
JOB 18:4
Thadou: Nalung han man in nalu jang sam chu botchai theijin nate, ahinlah hichun leiset asuhmang thei ding ham? Songpi ho akithin sah theiding ham?
English: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?

tcz: Tahbeh in migilou te thaomei kimut mit peh intin ameikong jeng u jong vahdoh lou ding ahi.
en: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
text:
JOB 18:5
Thadou: Tahbeh in migilou te thaomei kimut mit peh intin ameikong jeng u jong vahdoh lou ding ahi.
English: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.

tcz: Aponbuh uva athaomei jengu jong hung thim ding ahi, achung lang uva kikhai thaomei jong kimutmit ding ahi.
en: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
text:
JOB 18:6
Thadou: Aponbuh uva athaomei jengu jong hung thim ding ahi, achung lang uva kikhai thaomei jong kimutmit ding ahi.
English: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.

tcz: Migilouvin ama kam'a kitahsan tah a akalson nau kisuhchom peh ding, amaho thilgon mama a chu kipal lhu diu ahi.
en: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.
text:
JOB 18:7
Thadou: Migilouvin ama kam'a kitahsan tah a akalson nau kisuhchom peh ding, amaho thilgon mama a chu kipal lhu diu ahi.
English: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.

tcz: Migilou chu lenna a ohin kokhuh sunga alhalut jiuve.
en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.
text:
JOB 18:8
Thadou: Migilou chu lenna a ohin kokhuh sunga alhalut jiuve.
English: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.

tcz: Thang kikam chun akhotal jum u akhit khan thang chun akhit chah kheh e.
en: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.
text:
JOB 18:9
Thadou: Thang kikam chun akhotal jum u akhit khan thang chun akhit chah kheh e.
English: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

tcz: Khaokol chu tolla akisel den nalaijin, alampiuva khao akijung galkai peh e.
en: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.
text:
JOB 18:10
Thadou: Khaokol chu tolla akisel den nalaijin, alampiuva khao akijung galkai peh e.
English: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.

tcz: Migiloute chu kichat tijatnan aum kimvel un chule akalson jouse asuboi ji'e.
en: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.
text:
JOB 18:11
Thadou: Migiloute chu kichat tijatnan aum kimvel un chule akalson jouse asuboi ji'e.
English: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.

tcz: Akelthoh u chun athao asulhom in chuleh vangset nachun amaho kipal lhuh ding chu anga ahi.
en: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.
text:
JOB 18:12
Thadou: Akelthoh u chun athao asulhom in chuleh vangset nachun amaho kipal lhuh ding chu anga ahi.
English: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.

tcz: Natna in ativun u anen, thinan atibah u aval lhum tai.
en: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.
text:
JOB 18:13
Thadou: Natna in ativun u anen, thinan atibah u aval lhum tai.
English: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.

tcz: Ahoidoh nau ainuva konna kibotkhen uva, chule kichat umtah lengpa henga chun akipui lha tauve.
en: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.
text:
JOB 18:14
Thadou: Ahoidoh nau ainuva konna kibotkhen uva, chule kichat umtah lengpa henga chun akipui lha tauve.
English: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.

tcz: Migiloute in chu kihal lha a ain chung uva kath meikong akijuh lhah sah e.
en: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.
text:
JOB 18:15
Thadou: Migiloute in chu kihal lha a ain chung uva kath meikong akijuh lhah sah e.
English: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.

tcz: Ajungu golha a abah u jong goplha ding ahi.
en: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.
text:
JOB 18:16
Thadou: Ajungu golha a abah u jong goplha ding ahi.
English: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.

tcz: Aum ingo kihetna ho jouse leisetna konna mangthah ding ahin koima chan amaho min chu ageldoh kit lou ding ahi.
en: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.
text:
JOB 18:17
Thadou: Aum ingo kihetna ho jouse leisetna konna mangthah ding ahin koima chan amaho min chu ageldoh kit lou ding ahi.
English: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.

tcz: Khovah a konna muthim lah a kisep lut ding ahiuvin vannoi leiset a konna kidel manga ahi tauve.
en: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
text:
JOB 18:18
Thadou: Khovah a konna muthim lah a kisep lut ding ahiuvin vannoi leiset a konna kidel manga ahi tauve.
English: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

tcz: Amahon chate hihen tute hijongle anei tahlou ding u ahi, achennau gamsung a hung cheng ding son leh pah hung beihel ding ahi.
en: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.
text:
JOB 18:19
Thadou: Amahon chate hihen tute hijongle anei tahlou ding u ahi, achennau gamsung a hung cheng ding son leh pah hung beihel ding ahi.
English: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.

tcz: Nilhum lam miten avangset diu akichat peh un, solam amite akichauve.
en: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.
text:
JOB 18:20
Thadou: Nilhum lam miten avangset diu akichat peh un, solam amite akichauve.
English: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.

tcz: Hichehi migilou Pathen neiloute chenna mun ahi tin hin seiju vinte.
en: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
text:
JOB 18:21
Thadou: Hichehi migilou Pathen neiloute chenna mun ahi tin hin seiju vinte.
English: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”

tcz: Hiti hin Job in asei kit e:
en: Then Job answered,
text:
JOB 19:1
Thadou: Hiti hin Job in asei kit e:
English: Then Job answered,

tcz: Itih chan nei suhgenthei nahlai dingu ham? Itih chan nathu sei uva chu suhchip ding neigot nahlai diu ham?
en: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
text:
JOB 19:2
Thadou: Itih chan nei suhgenthei nahlai dingu ham? Itih chan nathu sei uva chu suhchip ding neigot nahlai diu ham?
English: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

tcz: Nanghon somvei jen neijumsou ahitai, aphalouva neibol u hi najachat pi louvu ham?
en: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.
text:
JOB 19:3
Thadou: Nanghon somvei jen neijumsou ahitai, aphalouva neibol u hi najachat pi louvu ham?
English: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

tcz: Keiman chonsetna nei jeng jong leng hichu keija bou ahin nangho a ahipoi.
en: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
text:
JOB 19:4
Thadou: Keiman chonsetna nei jeng jong leng hichu keija bou ahin nangho a ahipoi.
English: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

tcz: Kei sanga phajo a nakigel u ham? Nei suh jachat nau hi kachonset hettohsahna a man ding natiu ham?
en: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,
text:
JOB 19:5
Thadou: Kei sanga phajo a nakigel u ham? Nei suh jachat nau hi kachonset hettohsahna a man ding natiu ham?
English: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,

tcz: Themmo eichanna chu Pathen ahin, alenna eimat ahi.
en: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
text:
JOB 19:6
Thadou: Themmo eichanna chu Pathen ahin, alenna eimat ahi.
English: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

tcz: Nei kithopiuvin tia kapen jah vang'in koima chan ei donbut poi, kanel kal in ahinlah thudih'a thu kitanna aum deh poi.
en: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
text:
JOB 19:7
Thadou: Nei kithopiuvin tia kapen jah vang'in koima chan ei donbut poi, kanel kal in ahinlah thudih'a thu kitanna aum deh poi.
English: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

tcz: Pathen in kalampi akhotan jeh in kachat thei poi, kalampi muthim lah a eilhun lut peh e.
en: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
text:
JOB 19:8
Thadou: Pathen in kalampi akhotan jeh in kachat thei poi, kalampi muthim lah a eilhun lut peh e.
English: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

tcz: Aman kaloupina eilah mang peh in chule kalu chunga konin kalal lukhuuh eilahdoh peh tai.
en: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
text:
JOB 19:9
Thadou: Aman kaloupina eilah mang peh in chule kalu chunga konin kalal lukhuuh eilahdoh peh tai.
English: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

tcz: Aman kasih lang jousea eikai lhun chuleh abeipai kahitai. Thingphung lhusa bangin kahinna jung jouse eibodoh peh tai.
en: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.
text:
JOB 19:10
Thadou: Aman kasih lang jousea eikai lhun chuleh abeipai kahitai. Thingphung lhusa bangin kahinna jung jouse eibodoh peh tai.
English: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

tcz: Alunghanna chu kachunga ahung deujah jengin amelma khat bangin eisem e.
en: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
text:
JOB 19:11
Thadou: Alunghanna chu kachunga ahung deujah jengin amelma khat bangin eisem e.
English: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.

tcz: Asepai honpi amasan amahon kei bulu nading lampi asem uvin kaponbuh kimvella ngahmun asauve.
en: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.
text:
JOB 19:12
Thadou: Asepai honpi amasan amahon kei bulu nading lampi asem uvin kaponbuh kimvella ngahmun asauve.
English: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

tcz: Kasopi jouse kakomma konin gamla tah a aum uvin chule kaloi kagol te jong kei doudin akihei gam tauve.
en: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
text:
JOB 19:13
Thadou: Kasopi jouse kakomma konin gamla tah a aum uvin chule kaloi kagol te jong kei doudin akihei gam tauve.
English: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

tcz: Ka inkote akichai soh tai, chule kakinai pi kagol ten jong eisumil tauve.
en: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
text:
JOB 19:14
Thadou: Ka inkote akichai soh tai, chule kakinai pi kagol ten jong eisumil tauve.
English: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

tcz: Kasohte le kasoh numei ten hetkhah lou mi danin eigel tauvin, keihi amaho dinga gamchom mi toh kabang tai.
en: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
text:
JOB 19:15
Thadou: Kasohte le kasoh numei ten hetkhah lou mi danin eigel tauvin, keihi amaho dinga gamchom mi toh kabang tai.
English: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

tcz: Kasohpa kakou chun ama ahung tapoi, amapa koma katao ding angaije.
en: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
text:
JOB 19:16
Thadou: Kasohpa kakou chun ama ahung tapoi, amapa koma katao ding angaije.
English: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

tcz: Kahai jong kajinu dinga theida um ahin, keihi kain koten eile mang u ahitai.
en: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.
text:
JOB 19:17
Thadou: Kahai jong kajinu dinga theida um ahin, keihi kain koten eile mang u ahitai.
English: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

tcz: Chapang neucha cha ho jengin jong ija se louvin eibol uvin, thusei dinga kadin doh chun amahon anunglam eingat uve.
en: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.
text:
JOB 19:18
Thadou: Chapang neucha cha ho jengin jong ija se louvin eibol uvin, thusei dinga kadin doh chun amahon anunglam eingat uve.
English: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

tcz: Kakinaipi kagolten eikidah uvin kangai tah tah hon jong eidou tauve.
en: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.
text:
JOB 19:19
Thadou: Kakinaipi kagolten eikidah uvin kangai tah tah hon jong eidou tauve.
English: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

tcz: Kavun leh kagu kachang bouseh a eikikoi ahitan, chule kanevun teni khu apang kaven maimai jeh a thina a kona jamdoh kahi.
en: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
text:
JOB 19:20
Thadou: Kavun leh kagu kachang bouseh a eikikoi ahitan, chule kanevun teni khu apang kaven maimai jeh a thina a kona jamdoh kahi.
English: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

tcz: Nei khotouvin, kagol kapai ho, nei khotuvin, ijeh inem itile Pathen khut in eitham khah ahi.
en: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.
text:
JOB 19:21
Thadou: Nei khotouvin, kagol kapai ho, nei khotuvin, ijeh inem itile Pathen khut in eitham khah ahi.
English: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.

tcz: Pathen in eibolna banga nangin jong nei bolgim ding ham? Nei lhaingem lou jeh a hi chimlou nahim?
en: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
text:
JOB 19:22
Thadou: Pathen in eibolna banga nangin jong nei bolgim ding ham? Nei lhaingem lou jeh a hi chimlou nahim?
English: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

tcz: O kathusei hohi sahlut thei hihen, O hiche hohi hetjing nathei khat a kimin chon sah hile,
en: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
text:
JOB 19:23
Thadou: O kathusei hohi sahlut thei hihen, O hiche hohi hetjing nathei khat a kimin chon sah hile,
English: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

tcz: Thih paicha in kikhen doh hen lang chuleh ngen twi kisunkhum hen lang a itih a umjing ding songpi chunga kikhen doh hen.
en: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
text:
JOB 19:24
Thadou: Thih paicha in kikhen doh hen lang chuleh ngen twi kisunkhum hen lang a itih a umjing ding songpi chunga kikhen doh hen.
English: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

tcz: Ahinlah keija dingin vang eilhandampu ahinge ti keiman kahei. Akhon naleh leiset chunga hung ding ding ahi.
en: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
text:
JOB 19:25
Thadou: Ahinlah keija dingin vang eilhandampu ahinge ti keiman kahei. Akhon naleh leiset chunga hung ding ding ahi.
English: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

tcz: Chule katahsa akemsuh jou nung hihen, hijeng jongle katahsa tah a Pathen kamu ding ahi.
en: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,
text:
JOB 19:26
Thadou: Chule katahsa akemsuh jou nung hihen, hijeng jongle katahsa tah a Pathen kamu ding ahi.
English: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

tcz: Keima gimbolna dinga ichan geija hangsan nahim? Hiche hi ama thepmo ahi natijiu ham?
en: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,
text:
JOB 19:28
Thadou: Keima gimbolna dinga ichan geija hangsan nahim? Hiche hi ama thepmo ahi natijiu ham?
English: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

tcz: Nang chunga chu ding gimbolna chu naki chat ding ahi. Na chonna toh kitoh bep a gimbolna nachan kihet in.
en: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
text:
JOB 19:29
Thadou: Nang chunga chu ding gimbolna chu naki chat ding ahi. Na chonna toh kitoh bep a gimbolna nachan kihet in.
English: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”

tcz: Hichun Naamath mi Zophar chun adonbut in:
en: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,
text:
JOB 20:1
Thadou: Hichun Naamath mi Zophar chun adonbut in:
English: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

tcz: Kadonbut tei ding ahi, ijeh inem itile keima nasatah in eiki sunoh phah e.
en: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
text:
JOB 20:2
Thadou: Kadonbut tei ding ahi, ijeh inem itile keima nasatah in eiki sunoh phah e.
English: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

tcz: Nami phosal nahi kahin thoh joulou ahitan, ahinlah ka lhagaovin donbut nomna eihin neisah ahitai.
en: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.
text:
JOB 20:3
Thadou: Nami phosal nahi kahin thoh joulou ahitan, ahinlah ka lhagaovin donbut nomna eihin neisah ahitai.
English: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

tcz: Phat kipat tillai leiset chunga mihem te ana um masat pen laiju chu geldoh in,
en: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,
text:
JOB 20:4
Thadou: Phat kipat tillai leiset chunga mihem te ana um masat pen laiju chu geldoh in,
English: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

tcz: Migilou te kichoisang nahi phat chomcha bou ahin, chule Pathen neiloute kipana jong chomkhat a ding bou ahi.
en: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
text:
JOB 20:5
Thadou: Migilou te kichoisang nahi phat chomcha bou ahin, chule Pathen neiloute kipana jong chomkhat a ding bou ahi.
English: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

tcz: Pathen neiloute kiletsah nan van pha hen lang, chuleh alu uvin meibol ga tong kha jongleh,
en: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,
text:
JOB 20:6
Thadou: Pathen neiloute kiletsah nan van pha hen lang, chuleh alu uvin meibol ga tong kha jongleh,
English: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

tcz: Amaho chu tonsot'a mangthah ding ahiuvin, a eh u kipaimang banga amaho jong kipai mang ding ahiuve. Koi hijongle ahepha jousen dong uvin te.
en: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
text:
JOB 20:7
Thadou: Amaho chu tonsot'a mangthah ding ahiuvin, a eh u kipaimang banga amaho jong kipai mang ding ahiuve. Koi hijongle ahepha jousen dong uvin te.
English: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

tcz: Amahohi janmang bangin mangun tin chule kinung mukit lou diu ahin, amahohi jan a thil kimu aman bangin mangthah tauvinte.
en: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.
text:
JOB 20:8
Thadou: Amahohi janmang bangin mangun tin chule kinung mukit lou diu ahin, amahohi jan a thil kimu aman bangin mangthah tauvinte.
English: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

tcz: Amaho chu amukha sa hon anungmu kit lou diu ahitan, ainkoten anungmu kit louhel diu ahi.
en: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.
text:
JOB 20:9
Thadou: Amaho chu amukha sa hon anungmu kit lou diu ahitan, ainkoten anungmu kit louhel diu ahi.
English: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

tcz: Achate houvin mivaichate komma akhut do uvinte, ijeh inem itile amahon aguh u haosat naho chu anung peh kit diu ahi.
en: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.
text:
JOB 20:10
Thadou: Achate houvin mivaichate komma akhut do uvinte, ijeh inem itile amahon aguh u haosat naho chu anung peh kit diu ahi.
English: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.

tcz: Khangdong hijong leu agubuh u leivui lah a kijam ding ahi.
en: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.
text:
JOB 20:11
Thadou: Khangdong hijong leu agubuh u leivui lah a kijam ding ahi.
English: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

tcz: Amahon agitlou nau chu kipana ana neiju ahin, alei noi uva hung junlha ding ahi.
en: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,
text:
JOB 20:12
Thadou: Amahon agitlou nau chu kipana ana neiju ahin, alei noi uva hung junlha ding ahi.
English: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

tcz: Amahon twi asauvin akamsung uva sottah akoi uve.
en: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,
text:
JOB 20:13
Thadou: Amahon twi asauvin akamsung uva sottah akoi uve.
English: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,

tcz: Ahinlah hetman louhel in a oisung uva a anneh u chu athuh jitai, a oisung uva thina thei gu aum jeh chun,
en: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.
text:
JOB 20:14
Thadou: Ahinlah hetman louhel in a oisung uva a anneh u chu athuh jitai, a oisung uva thina thei gu aum jeh chun,
English: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.

tcz: Amahon aval lhum sau anei agou hou chu alodoh un ahin Pathen in akoi lhahsah lou diu ahi.
en: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.
text:
JOB 20:15
Thadou: Amahon aval lhum sau anei agou hou chu alodoh un ahin Pathen in akoi lhahsah lou diu ahi.
English: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

tcz: Amahon gulsoh gu hin chop untin gulsen amaho ahintha dingu ahi.
en: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.
text:
JOB 20:16
Thadou: Amahon gulsoh gu hin chop untin gulsen amaho ahintha dingu ahi.
English: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.

tcz: Amahon olive thao twidung banga long ahiloule khoiju leh bongnoi vadung banga long amukhah kit louhel diu ahi.
en: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.
text:
JOB 20:17
Thadou: Amahon olive thao twidung banga long ahiloule khoiju leh bongnoi vadung banga long amukhah kit louhel diu ahi.
English: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

tcz: Amahon atohman uva amu thil jouse anungpeh uva anei agou jouseuvin nopsahna hin lhut peh pouvin te.
en: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.
text:
JOB 20:18
Thadou: Amahon atohman uva amu thil jouse anungpeh uva anei agou jouseuvin nopsahna hin lhut peh pouvin te.
English: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile amahon vaichaho asu genthei un chule genthei lengvai jin adalhau vin amahon asah u hilou hel inho akilah uve.
en: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.
text:
JOB 20:19
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile amahon vaichaho asu genthei un chule genthei lengvai jin adalhau vin amahon asah u hilou hel inho akilah uve.
English: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.

tcz: Amaho akilose uvin chuleh lung nachimna anei pouve, aval beihella thil jouse nei cham kim ding bou agel gel uve.
en: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.
text:
JOB 20:20
Thadou: Amaho akilose uvin chuleh lung nachimna anei pouve, aval beihella thil jouse nei cham kim ding bou agel gel uve.
English: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.

tcz: Imacha khen neilou hellin amaho changseh in anei jou hel uvin hijeh a chu ahaosat nau jong umsot lou hel ding ahi.
en: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.
text:
JOB 20:21
Thadou: Imacha khen neilou hellin amaho changseh in anei jou hel uvin hijeh a chu ahaosat nau jong umsot lou hel ding ahi.
English: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.

tcz: Neng tah a aumlai tah ule hahsatnan ahin lhunkhum in hahsat gentheina achung'uva hunglhung ding ahi.
en: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.
text:
JOB 20:22
Thadou: Neng tah a aumlai tah ule hahsatnan ahin lhunkhum in hahsat gentheina achung'uva hunglhung ding ahi.
English: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.

tcz: Pathen in amaho chu hahsat gentheina a a oisung dimset uvin peuhen Pathen in alunghanna achung'uva hin juhlhah sah hen.
en: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.
text:
JOB 20:23
Thadou: Pathen in amaho chu hahsat gentheina a a oisung dimset uvin peuhen Pathen in alunghanna achung'uva hin juhlhah sah hen.
English: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

tcz: Thih hemma konna jamdoh ding go jongle sum-eng a kisem thalchang in adot pai ding ahi.
en: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.
text:
JOB 20:24
Thadou: Thih hemma konna jamdoh ding go jongle sum-eng a kisem thalchang in adot pai ding ahi.
English: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.

tcz: Thalchang chun atungtun langa konna ki botdoh ding chule athalchang muh chu thisan nat dehduh a thina kichat umtah chu achung'uva chu ding ahi.
en: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.
text:
JOB 20:25
Thadou: Thalchang chun atungtun langa konna ki botdoh ding chule athalchang muh chu thisan nat dehduh a thina kichat umtah chu achung'uva chu ding ahi.
English: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

tcz: Agou jouse muthim lhangkal kiheh lah a kisep lut ding, athil keu jouseu akidalha beihel a gamlah meiyin akahvam gam hel ding ahi.
en: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.
text:
JOB 20:26
Thadou: Agou jouse muthim lhangkal kiheh lah a kisep lut ding, athil keu jouseu akidalha beihel a gamlah meiyin akahvam gam hel ding ahi.
English: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.

tcz: Vanho jousen athemmo nau ahin phon jal ding chule leiset in jong ama douna ahin phot chet ding ahi.
en: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.
text:
JOB 20:27
Thadou: Vanho jousen athemmo nau ahin phon jal ding chule leiset in jong ama douna ahin phot chet ding ahi.
English: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.

tcz: Ain jouseu twisoh in alhoh manga Pathen lung hanna chu twi hattah long banga hung longlha ding ahi.
en: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.
text:
JOB 20:28
Thadou: Ain jouseu twisoh in alhoh manga Pathen lung hanna chu twi hattah long banga hung longlha ding ahi.
English: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

tcz: Pathen in migilou apeh ding tohman hiche hi ahin, Pathen in achan diuva ateppeh sau chu ahi.
en: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
text:
JOB 20:29
Thadou: Pathen in migilou apeh ding tohman hiche hi ahin, Pathen in achan diuva ateppeh sau chu ahi.
English: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”

tcz: Chuphat in Job in asei kit in:
en: Then Job answered,
text:
JOB 21:1
Thadou: Chuphat in Job in asei kit in:
English: Then Job answered,

tcz: Kathusei hohi ipi ham ti naichan hin ngai uvin, hichu kilhamonna neipeh thei sun u chu ahi.
en: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
text:
JOB 21:2
Thadou: Kathusei hohi ipi ham ti naichan hin ngai uvin, hichu kilhamonna neipeh thei sun u chu ahi.
English: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

tcz: Neithoh piuvin chule ken thu sei inge, keiman thu kasei jou teng leh nanghon nei nuisat pan kit nauvin nate.
en: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.
text:
JOB 21:3
Thadou: Neithoh piuvin chule ken thu sei inge, keiman thu kasei jou teng leh nanghon nei nuisat pan kit nauvin nate.
English: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.

tcz: Pathen koma kiphin kahin, mihem ho koma ahipoi, kanga sot joulou nau ajeh hoitah kaneije.
en: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
text:
JOB 21:4
Thadou: Pathen koma kiphin kahin, mihem ho koma ahipoi, kanga sot joulou nau ajeh hoitah kaneije.
English: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

tcz: Nei veuvin chule thipchet in um un, nakhut uvin nakam kisip cheh uvin,
en: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.
text:
JOB 21:5
Thadou: Nei veuvin chule thipchet in um un, nakhut uvin nakam kisip cheh uvin,
English: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

tcz: Ken ipi kasei ding ham tia kagel teng, kaki thing tuntun in katahsa akihot hot e.
en: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
text:
JOB 21:6
Thadou: Ken ipi kasei ding ham tia kagel teng, kaki thing tuntun in katahsa akihot hot e.
English: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

tcz: Ipi dinga migiloute hi khang tou touva ateh gei uva khang uva chule thahat hiuvem?
en: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
text:
JOB 21:7
Thadou: Ipi dinga migiloute hi khang tou touva ateh gei uva khang uva chule thahat hiuvem?
English: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

tcz: Chule amahohi achateu khantou leh a inchen uve dinga hing ahiuvin chule atuteu chunga akipah uve.
en: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
text:
JOB 21:8
Thadou: Chule amahohi achateu khantou leh a inchen uve dinga hing ahiuvin chule atuteu chunga akipah uve.
English: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

tcz: A in hou jong kichat tijat na a konin a ongdoh un chule Pathen in agimbol poi.
en: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
text:
JOB 21:9
Thadou: A in hou jong kichat tijat na a konin a ongdoh un chule Pathen in agimbol poi.
English: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

tcz: Abongchal hou jong nou neilou vin aum pouvin, abongpi houvin nou aneiyun athollha jong aumpoi.
en: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
text:
JOB 21:10
Thadou: Abongchal hou jong nou neilou vin aum pouvin, abongpi houvin nou aneiyun athollha jong aumpoi.
English: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

tcz: Kelngoite bangin achateu akichop le sah uvin, achapang hou chu akichom un chule alam lam uve.
en: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
text:
JOB 21:11
Thadou: Kelngoite bangin achateu akichop le sah uvin, achapang hou chu akichom un chule alam lam uve.
English: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

tcz: Amahon semjang saigin leh selang dah toh lhonin la a asauvin, theile kimut gin in kipa golnop abol'uve.
en: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
text:
JOB 21:12
Thadou: Amahon semjang saigin leh selang dah toh lhonin la a asauvin, theile kimut gin in kipa golnop abol'uve.
English: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

tcz: Amahon ahin nikho hou nopsah nan amangun, chuti chun lungmong tah in lhankhuh ajon ji tauve.
en: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
text:
JOB 21:13
Thadou: Amahon ahin nikho hou nopsah nan amangun, chuti chun lungmong tah in lhankhuh ajon ji tauve.
English: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.

tcz: Amahon chemangin nathil imacha kadei pouvin, nalam lhah jong kadei pouve tin PAthen koma aseijuve.
en: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
text:
JOB 21:14
Thadou: Amahon chemangin nathil imacha kadei pouvin, nalam lhah jong kadei pouve tin PAthen koma aseijuve.
English: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

tcz: Hatchungnung kitipa chu koi hija chule ipi dinga athu kangai diu ham?
en: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
text:
JOB 21:15
Thadou: Hatchungnung kitipa chu koi hija chule ipi dinga athu kangai diu ham?
English: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

tcz: Amahon ahausat najouseu hi amaho thahat a kilam doh danin agel un, ahinlah hitobang lunggel na a chu keiman imacha bol ding kanei lou ding ahi.
en: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
text:
JOB 21:16
Thadou: Amahon ahausat najouseu hi amaho thahat a kilam doh danin agel un, ahinlah hitobang lunggel na a chu keiman imacha bol ding kanei lou ding ahi.
English: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in migilou thaomei jong akimumit peh khapoi. Amaho hin hahsatna anei khah uvem? Pathen in lunghang tah a lung genthei nahi amaho ana hoppeh khah em?
en: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?
text:
JOB 21:17
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in migilou thaomei jong akimumit peh khapoi. Amaho hin hahsatna anei khah uvem? Pathen in lunghang tah a lung genthei nahi amaho ana hoppeh khah em?
English: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

tcz: Changpol banga amaho huijin amasang amutmang khah hitam? Huipi hat in changvai alhohmang banga alhoh mang khah hitam?
en: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
text:
JOB 21:18
Thadou: Changpol banga amaho huijin amasang amutmang khah hitam? Huipi hat in changvai alhohmang banga alhoh mang khah hitam?
English: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

tcz: Aphai Pathen in achateu beh agimbol ding ahi tin nasei juvin ahinlah chonset bol pen pen vang chu agim bol ding ahi tin kaseije. Chutile ama thutanna chu ahet thei diu ahi.
en: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
text:
JOB 21:19
Thadou: Aphai Pathen in achateu beh agimbol ding ahi tin nasei juvin ahinlah chonset bol pen pen vang chu agim bol ding ahi tin kaseije. Chutile ama thutanna chu ahet thei diu ahi.
English: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

tcz: Amanthah nau amahon amit tah uvin veu hen hatchungnung pa lunghanna thuhtah chu twidon in don uhen.
en: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
text:
JOB 21:20
Thadou: Amanthah nau amahon amit tah uvin veu hen hatchungnung pa lunghanna thuhtah chu twidon in don uhen.
English: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile ama athi nung teng le ainkoteu iti dingu ham ti angaito pouve.
en: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
text:
JOB 21:21
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile ama athi nung teng le ainkoteu iti dingu ham ti angaito pouve.
English: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

tcz: Ahinlah koipen in Pathen chu ahil thei ding ham? Mithahat chung thu jeng jong atan ji ahi.
en: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
text:
JOB 21:22
Thadou: Ahinlah koipen in Pathen chu ahil thei ding ham? Mithahat chung thu jeng jong atan ji ahi.
English: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

tcz: Mikhat chu hausa tah le lungmong tah hin boina beihel in athi jin ahi.
en: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
text:
JOB 21:23
Thadou: Mikhat chu hausa tah le lungmong tah hin boina beihel in athi jin ahi.
English: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

tcz: Mithahat misalhing hole tahsa damthei ho lim chu ahi.
en: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
text:
JOB 21:24
Thadou: Mithahat misalhing hole tahsa damthei ho lim chu ahi.
English: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

tcz: Mikhat kit chu nopsahna hepha louhel in vaichatna khonteh in athi jin ahi.
en: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
text:
JOB 21:25
Thadou: Mikhat kit chu nopsahna hepha louhel in vaichatna khonteh in athi jin ahi.
English: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

tcz: Ahinlah ani honna chu leivui lah a kivui cheh ahi lhonin, ani lhonna than hon aneh cheh lhon ding ahi.
en: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
text:
JOB 21:26
Thadou: Ahinlah ani honna chu leivui lah a kivui cheh ahi lhonin, ani lhonna than hon aneh cheh lhon ding ahi.
English: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

tcz: Ven nangin ipi nagel kahen nangin kei douna a nathilgon kahen ahi.
en: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
text:
JOB 21:27
Thadou: Ven nangin ipi nagel kahen nangin kei douna a nathilgon kahen ahi.
English: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.

tcz: Achonset jeh uva ain u mang hella migilou leh mihausatah thu neihin seipeh ding ahi.
en: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
text:
JOB 21:28
Thadou: Achonset jeh uva ain u mang hella migilou leh mihausatah thu neihin seipeh ding ahi.
English: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

tcz: Ahinlah akimvella um hohi dong le chun amahon adihtah chu naseipeh dingu ahi.
en: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
text:
JOB 21:29
Thadou: Ahinlah akimvella um hohi dong le chun amahon adihtah chu naseipeh dingu ahi.
English: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

tcz: Vangset phat laileh amaho chu aki hing hoijin chule manthah na a konna ajamdoh diu jong akiphal peh e.
en: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?
text:
JOB 21:30
Thadou: Vangset phat laileh amaho chu aki hing hoijin chule manthah na a konna ajamdoh diu jong akiphal peh e.
English: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?

tcz: Koima chan amaho hi lhangphong tah in aseise ngam pouvin ahiloule anatoh athilbol hou jeh in jong lethuhna akipe pouve.
en: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?
text:
JOB 21:31
Thadou: Koima chan amaho hi lhangphong tah in aseise ngam pouvin ahiloule anatoh athilbol hou jeh in jong lethuhna akipe pouve.
English: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?

tcz: Lhankhuh jonna amaho akiput tengu le alhan u chu mihon nidan kah khat bep bou anga peh jiuve.
en: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.
text:
JOB 21:32
Thadou: Lhankhuh jonna amaho akiput tengu le alhan u chu mihon nidan kah khat bep bou anga peh jiuve.
English: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.

tcz: Lhanmol a chun mithi kivuina kin akimang in atahsa choldo dinga akilupsah namun a chun mihon ajanau apeuve, chule leiset in kicholdo na nomtah in apei.
en: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
text:
JOB 21:33
Thadou: Lhanmol a chun mithi kivuina kin akimang in atahsa choldo dinga akilupsah namun a chun mihon ajanau apeuve, chule leiset in kicholdo na nomtah in apei.
English: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

tcz: Nanghon keihi iti dan a thu hom keuva nei lhamon diu ham? Nahil chet najouseu jong jou ahi.
en: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
text:
JOB 21:34
Thadou: Nanghon keihi iti dan a thu hom keuva nei lhamon diu ham? Nahil chet najouseu jong jou ahi.
English: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”

tcz: Hichun Teman mi Eliphaz in adonbut in:
en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
text:
JOB 22:1
Thadou: Hichun Teman mi Eliphaz in adonbut in:
English: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

tcz: Pathen kithopina dinga mikhat in abol thei ding um'em? Miching khat jeng jong chu Pathen ding a kithopi pha hithei ding ham?
en: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
text:
JOB 22:2
Thadou: Pathen kithopina dinga mikhat in abol thei ding um'em? Miching khat jeng jong chu Pathen ding a kithopi pha hithei ding ham?
English: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

tcz: Michonpha ana hile chun Hatchungnung pa a dinga phachom nana hikha dem? Mipha chamkim hile chun Hatchungnungpa a dinga phachom nahidem?
en: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?
text:
JOB 22:3
Thadou: Michonpha ana hile chun Hatchungnung pa a dinga phachom nana hikha dem? Mipha chamkim hile chun Hatchungnungpa a dinga phachom nahidem?
English: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

tcz: Pathen thengtah a nahou jeh a ama chun themmona chansah ham? Chule nang douna a thutan ahin pohlut ding ham?
en: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?
text:
JOB 22:4
Thadou: Pathen thengtah a nahou jeh a ama chun themmona chansah ham? Chule nang douna a thutan ahin pohlut ding ham?
English: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

tcz: Ahipoi nagitlou na jeh ahibouve. Nachonsetna angahna umlou ahi.
en: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
text:
JOB 22:5
Thadou: Ahipoi nagitlou na jeh ahibouve. Nachonsetna angahna umlou ahi.
English: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

tcz: Vetsahnan nagolpa chu sumbat din pen lang nabat man dingin aponsil ho chu neipen tin lang henge agu achang geijin lahpeh jengin.
en: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
text:
JOB 22:6
Thadou: Vetsahnan nagolpa chu sumbat din pen lang nabat man dingin aponsil ho chu neipen tin lang henge agu achang geijin lahpeh jengin.
English: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

tcz: Nangin adangchah ho twi peh ding nom hih in lang chule agilkel an peh ding nom hih le chun,
en: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.
text:
JOB 22:7
Thadou: Nangin adangchah ho twi peh ding nom hih in lang chule agilkel an peh ding nom hih le chun,
English: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

tcz: Nangin gam chu athahatpa a ahi timai theijin natin ahinlah hiche a chu mikhat bouvin thaneina anei ding ahi.
en: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.
text:
JOB 22:8
Thadou: Nangin gam chu athahatpa a ahi timai theijin natin ahinlah hiche a chu mikhat bouvin thaneina anei ding ahi.
English: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

tcz: Meithai khat tou chu khutgoh keuva nasol mang hikhat inte chule chagate kinepna jong nasuhkeh thei ahi.
en: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
text:
JOB 22:9
Thadou: Meithai khat tou chu khutgoh keuva nasol mang hikhat inte chule chagate kinepna jong nasuhkeh thei ahi.
English: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

tcz: Hiche ho jeh a chu thang’a naki umkimvel ahi, chule hetman louva kichat najeh a kitihot hot nahi.
en: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,
text:
JOB 22:10
Thadou: Hiche ho jeh a chu thang’a naki umkimvel ahi, chule hetman louva kichat najeh a kitihot hot nahi.
English: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

tcz: Hiche ho jeh a chu muthim lah a namu theiji lou ahi. Chule twi kinong in achup ji ahi.
en: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.
text:
JOB 22:11
Thadou: Hiche ho jeh a chu muthim lah a namu theiji lou ahi. Chule twi kinong in achup ji ahi.
English: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

tcz: Pathen chu alen behseh in vanho sangin jong alen joi. Ahsite lah a agamla pen sangin jong agamla joi.
en: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
text:
JOB 22:12
Thadou: Pathen chu alen behseh in vanho sangin jong alen joi. Ahsite lah a agamla pen sangin jong agamla joi.
English: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu Pathen in kanatoh hohi amuthei jilou ahin, muthim jing lah a hi iti thu atan ding ham tin nadonbut e.
en: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
text:
JOB 22:13
Thadou: Hiche jeh a chu Pathen in kanatoh hohi amuthei jilou ahin, muthim jing lah a hi iti thu atan ding ham tin nadonbut e.
English: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

tcz: Ajeh chu meibol satah chun ana velkol lele a hiche jeh a chu aman eimu theilouvu ahi. Ama chung sangpeh a khun aumin vanna thilkholna mun ho a chu vahle ahi.
en: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’
text:
JOB 22:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu meibol satah chun ana velkol lele a hiche jeh a chu aman eimu theilouvu ahi. Ama chung sangpeh a khun aumin vanna thilkholna mun ho a chu vahle ahi.
English: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

tcz: Migiloute lamlhahna lampi lui chu najot nahlai ding ham?
en: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,
text:
JOB 22:15
Thadou: Migiloute lamlhahna lampi lui chu najot nahlai ding ham?
English: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

tcz: Ahinkho kibul patna twijin alhoh manga ahinkhou it um laitah le asalhah peh ji ahi.
en: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,
text:
JOB 22:16
Thadou: Ahinkho kibul patna twijin alhoh manga ahinkhou it um laitah le asalhah peh ji ahi.
English: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

tcz: Hatchungnungpachun kachung uva ipi abolthei ding ham? Kachangin nei dalhauvin tia Pathen koma asei jeh u chun,
en: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’
text:
JOB 22:17
Thadou: Hatchungnungpachun kachung uva ipi abolthei ding ham? Kachangin nei dalhauvin tia Pathen koma asei jeh u chun,
English: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

tcz: Henge ama chu a insung uva thilpha tamtah dipset a chu ama ahi, hijeh a chu keiman hiche tobang lunggel a bolthei ding imacha kaneipoi.
en: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
text:
JOB 22:18
Thadou: Henge ama chu a insung uva thilpha tamtah dipset a chu ama ahi, hijeh a chu keiman hiche tobang lunggel a bolthei ding imacha kaneipoi.
English: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

tcz: Michonpha ho chun migiloute manthah na chu amuteng uleh kipah unte, chule nolna bei miho chun isah loutah a anuisat dingu ahi.
en: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
text:
JOB 22:19
Thadou: Michonpha ho chun migiloute manthah na chu amuteng uleh kipah unte, chule nolna bei miho chun isah loutah a anuisat dingu ahi.
English: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

tcz: Veuvin melmate iti kisuhmang hija anukhah pen chu meiyin akavam tai tin sei uvinte.
en: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’
text:
JOB 22:20
Thadou: Veuvin melmate iti kisuhmang hija anukhah pen chu meiyin akavam tai tin sei uvinte.
English: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

tcz: Pathen a kipelut in chutile lungmong a naum ding ahi, chuteng leh nanga dinga ijakai phasoh kei ding ahi.
en: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.
text:
JOB 22:21
Thadou: Pathen a kipelut in chutile lungmong a naum ding ahi, chuteng leh nanga dinga ijakai phasoh kei ding ahi.
English: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

tcz: Ngaijuvin athuhil hi chuleh nalung chang ah khollin.
en: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
text:
JOB 22:22
Thadou: Ngaijuvin athuhil hi chuleh nalung chang ah khollin.
English: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

tcz: Hatchungnung pa komma nakile kitna ahile nakilepeh kit ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile nahinkho chu sutheng in.
en: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
text:
JOB 22:23
Thadou: Hatchungnung pa komma nakile kitna ahile nakilepeh kit ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile nahinkho chu sutheng in.
English: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

tcz: Sum ngailutna napeh doh a ahile, chule nasana mantam tah chu vadunga naselut a ahile,
en: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
text:
JOB 22:24
Thadou: Sum ngailutna napeh doh a ahile, chule nasana mantam tah chu vadunga naselut a ahile,
English: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

tcz: Hatchungnungpa amatah chu nagou hijeng ding ahin, ama tah chu nanga dinga dangka manlu tah hiding ahi.
en: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.
text:
JOB 22:25
Thadou: Hatchungnungpa amatah chu nagou hijeng ding ahin, ama tah chu nanga dinga dangka manlu tah hiding ahi.
English: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

tcz: Chutile Hatchungnungpa koma konin nomsahna kilah in natin, hiteng chule Pathen chu ven.
en: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.
text:
JOB 22:26
Thadou: Chutile Hatchungnungpa koma konin nomsahna kilah in natin, hiteng chule Pathen chu ven.
English: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

tcz: Amakoma taovin natin chule aman na taona najah peh ding ahi. Chule nangin ama koma nakitepna chu namolso ding ahi.
en: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.
text:
JOB 22:27
Thadou: Amakoma taovin natin chule aman na taona najah peh ding ahi. Chule nangin ama koma nakitepna chu namolso ding ahi.
English: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

tcz: Ipi hijongle bol dinga nagot chan namolso ding ahi. Chuleh namasanga lamlen chu vah'in hinsal vah peh tan nate.
en: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.
text:
JOB 22:28
Thadou: Ipi hijongle bol dinga nagot chan namolso ding ahi. Chuleh namasanga lamlen chu vah'in hinsal vah peh tan nate.
English: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.

tcz: Mihemte chun hahsatna ahin nei teng ule kithopiu vin tin seijin natin, chule Pathen in ahuhdoh diu ahi.
en: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
text:
JOB 22:29
Thadou: Mihemte chun hahsatna ahin nei teng ule kithopiu vin tin seijin natin, chule Pathen in ahuhdoh diu ahi.
English: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

tcz: Michonse ho jeng jong, huhdoh in um unte, nakhut thenna jeh a chu huhdoh a umdiu ahi.
en: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
text:
JOB 22:30
Thadou: Michonse ho jeng jong, huhdoh in um unte, nakhut thenna jeh a chu huhdoh a umdiu ahi.
English: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”

tcz: Hichun Job in aseikit in:
en: Then Job answered,
text:
JOB 23:1
Thadou: Hichun Job in aseikit in:
English: Then Job answered,

tcz: Kakiphinna tuni chan geijin akhoh cheh cheh in chule pendoh lou ding hatah in kagoi.
en: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.
text:
JOB 23:2
Thadou: Kakiphinna tuni chan geijin akhoh cheh cheh in chule pendoh lou ding hatah in kagoi.
English: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

tcz: Keiman Pathen ama umna bouseh kahol doh thei hileh keima athutanna munna kache ding ahi.
en: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
text:
JOB 23:3
Thadou: Keiman Pathen ama umna bouseh kahol doh thei hileh keima athutanna munna kache ding ahi.
English: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

tcz: Kachung chang thuhi kaluidoh a chuleh kaki phin a thu kasei ding ahi.
en: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
text:
JOB 23:4
Thadou: Kachung chang thuhi kaluidoh a chuleh kaki phin a thu kasei ding ahi.
English: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

tcz: Chuteng leh keiman eidonbutna kangaija chuleh kakoma ipi asei ham ti kahetdoh ding ahi.
en: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.
text:
JOB 23:5
Thadou: Chuteng leh keiman eidonbutna kangaija chuleh kakoma ipi asei ham ti kahetdoh ding ahi.
English: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

tcz: Athahatna jousea chu keima einel ding ham? Ahipoi aman ngainom umtah'a eidonbut ding ahi.
en: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.
text:
JOB 23:6
