Thadou: Athahatna jousea chu keima einel ding ham? Ahipoi aman ngainom umtah'a eidonbut ding ahi.
English: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

tcz: Milungtheng ho chun amatoh ngaito khom theijun tin hijeh a chu keima thutanna'a konna a itih a dinga lhadoh a kaum ding ahitai.
en: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.
text:
JOB 23:7
Thadou: Milungtheng ho chun amatoh ngaito khom theijun tin hijeh a chu keima thutanna'a konna a itih a dinga lhadoh a kaum ding ahitai.
English: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

tcz: Solama kachen ahin hiche mun a chun ama anaumpon, lhumlam a kachen ahinlah ama kaga mu poi.
en: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.
text:
JOB 23:8
Thadou: Solama kachen ahin hiche mun a chun ama anaumpon, lhumlam a kachen ahinlah ama kaga mu poi.
English: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.

tcz: Sahlang gam kahol in kaga mu joupoi, ijeh inem itile ama kisel ah ahi. Keiman lhanglang gam kaven ahinlah ama akisel mangah ahitai.
en: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
text:
JOB 23:9
Thadou: Sahlang gam kahol in kaga mu joupoi, ijeh inem itile ama kisel ah ahi. Keiman lhanglang gam kaven ahinlah ama akisel mangah ahitai.
English: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

tcz: Ahin aman hoiya kache ahen ahi, chuleh aman ei patep tengle sana thengsel banga kahung doh ding ahi.
en: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.
text:
JOB 23:10
Thadou: Ahin aman hoiya kache ahen ahi, chuleh aman ei patep tengle sana thengsel banga kahung doh ding ahi.
English: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen lampi a um kahin kihei mang louhel a alampi chu kajui ahi.
en: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
text:
JOB 23:11
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile Pathen lampi a um kahin kihei mang louhel a alampi chu kajui ahi.
English: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

tcz: Athupeh a kon in kapotdoh khapon ahinlah niseh anneh twidon sangin athusei ho gou khol in kaki khol e.
en: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
text:
JOB 23:12
Thadou: Athupeh a kon in kapotdoh khapon ahinlah niseh anneh twidon sangin athusei ho gou khol in kaki khol e.
English: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

tcz: Ahinlah aman khatvei kigel lhahna anei tengleh koipen in alungthim akhelsah thei ding ham? Aman abol nomchan chu ipi hijongle abol jing ding ahi.
en: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
text:
JOB 23:13
Thadou: Ahinlah aman khatvei kigel lhahna anei tengleh koipen in alungthim akhelsah thei ding ham? Aman abol nomchan chu ipi hijongle abol jing ding ahi.
English: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

tcz: Hijeh a chu ipi hijongle kachunga kathilgon jouse chu eibol doh peh a kavanga ana umsa chu aman athuneina noija akoi ding ahi.
en: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.
text:
JOB 23:14
Thadou: Hijeh a chu ipi hijongle kachunga kathilgon jouse chu eibol doh peh a kavanga ana umsa chu aman athuneina noija akoi ding ahi.
English: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

tcz: Datmo louhel in ama aum tengle kaki cha behseh jin hiche ho kagel tengle kaki cha behseh ji e.
en: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
text:
JOB 23:15
Thadou: Datmo louhel in ama aum tengle kaki cha behseh jin hiche ho kagel tengle kaki cha behseh ji e.
English: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

tcz: Pathen in kalung anat sah in lungchang nan eisem in Hatchungnung pa chun ei tijat sah e.
en: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
text:
JOB 23:16
Thadou: Pathen in kalung anat sah in lungchang nan eisem in Hatchungnung pa chun ei tijat sah e.
English: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

tcz: Muthim in ei umkim vellin athimdan seijou lou chu muntin a aume.
en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
text:
JOB 23:17
Thadou: Muthim in ei umkim vellin athimdan seijou lou chu muntin a aume.
English: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

tcz: Ipi dinga Hatchungung pan migiloute khu thutanna munna dinga ahin pui lou ham? Ipi dinga Pathen ging ten panna beija ama anga nga diu ham?
en: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?
text:
JOB 24:1
Thadou: Ipi dinga Hatchungung pan migiloute khu thutanna munna dinga ahin pui lou ham? Ipi dinga Pathen ging ten panna beija ama anga nga diu ham?
English: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?

tcz: Miphalou ten gamgi melchihna achonun gam leiset agu jiuve. Amahon gancha akiguh uvin chuleh amaho gamsunga hamhing lah a alhalut uve.
en: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
text:
JOB 24:2
Thadou: Miphalou ten gamgi melchihna achonun gam leiset agu jiuve. Amahon gancha akiguh uvin chuleh amaho gamsunga hamhing lah a alhalut uve.
English: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

tcz: Amahon chagate sangan akilah un meithai ho bangchal bat man na apeh diuvin angeh jiuve.
en: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
text:
JOB 24:3
Thadou: Amahon chagate sangan akilah un meithai ho bangchal bat man na apeh diuvin angeh jiuve.
English: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

tcz: Mivaichate chu lampam ah asondoh un migiloute chu ahoidoh nadiuvin akisel khom jiuve.
en: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.
text:
JOB 24:4
Thadou: Mivaichate chu lampam ah asondoh un migiloute chu ahoidoh nadiuvin akisel khom jiuve.
English: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

tcz: Gamlah sangan ho gammang lah a aum bangin mivaichaten aphat jouseu neh ding holnan amangun achateu neh ding nelgam sanna aga hol uve.
en: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.
text:
JOB 24:5
Thadou: Gamlah sangan ho gammang lah a aum bangin mivaichaten aphat jouseu neh ding holnan amangun achateu neh ding nelgam sanna aga hol uve.
English: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.

tcz: Amaho a hilou loujau lah a chang a-at jiuvin chule migiloute lengpilei lah a akhai achomkhom uve.
en: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.
text:
JOB 24:6
Thadou: Amaho a hilou loujau lah a chang a-at jiuvin chule migiloute lengpilei lah a akhai achomkhom uve.
English: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.

tcz: Jan khovah vah'in daplah ah akeuvun ponbeijin ahiloule kikhukhum ding neilouvin alum jiuve.
en: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.
text:
JOB 24:7
Thadou: Jan khovah vah'in daplah ah akeuvun ponbeijin ahiloule kikhukhum ding neilouvin alum jiuve.
English: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

tcz: Amaho chun molla konna hung phinlha gotwijin akot soh jiuvin chule chenna in ngaichan songpi bel din alhai khom jiuve.
en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.
text:
JOB 24:8
Thadou: Amaho chun molla konna hung phinlha gotwijin akot soh jiuvin chule chenna in ngaichan songpi bel din alhai khom jiuve.
English: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.

tcz: Migilou ten meithai ho chasen chu anu oplhanga konin aloilhah peh un nausen ho chu thil manna tun din alahpeh jiuve.
en: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,
text:
JOB 24:9
Thadou: Migilou ten meithai ho chasen chu anu oplhanga konin aloilhah peh un nausen ho chu thil manna tun din alahpeh jiuve.
English: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

tcz: Mivaichate chu ponsil beijin akeuvun acheleuvin amaho tah anngol pumin midang ding chang a atkhom peh uve.
en: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.
text:
JOB 24:10
Thadou: Mivaichate chu ponsil beijin akeuvun acheleuvin amaho tah anngol pumin midang ding chang a atkhom peh uve.
English: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.

tcz: Amahon Olive thau achil lhauvin ahinlah atep diu jong akiphal peh pouve, chule dangchah thohpum pumin lengpi thei hehna khol ah na atohsah uve.
en: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.
text:
JOB 24:11
Thadou: Amahon Olive thau achil lhauvin ahinlah atep diu jong akiphal peh pouve, chule dangchah thohpum pumin lengpi thei hehna khol ah na atohsah uve.
English: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

tcz: Khopi a konin mithi ding kon ho ahung pengdoh uvin chule maha pu hon kithopi ngaichan akap uve. Ahivangin Pathen in ataonau imachan agelpeh poi.
en: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.
text:
JOB 24:12
Thadou: Khopi a konin mithi ding kon ho ahung pengdoh uvin chule maha pu hon kithopi ngaichan akap uve. Ahivangin Pathen in ataonau imachan agelpeh poi.
English: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.

tcz: Migiloute chun khovah adouvun, amahon alampi hetpeh ding anom pouvin ahiloule alampi a jong aum pouve.
en: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.
text:
JOB 24:13
Thadou: Migiloute chun khovah adouvun, amahon alampi hetpeh ding anom pouvin ahiloule alampi a jong aum pouve.
English: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.

tcz: Mivaicha ho leh mi genthei ho that dingin tolthat ho chu jingpi phal vah'in athou jiuvin jan teng amapa chu guchan apang jin ahi.
en: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.
text:
JOB 24:14
Thadou: Mivaicha ho leh mi genthei ho that dingin tolthat ho chu jingpi phal vah'in athou jiuvin jan teng amapa chu guchan apang jin ahi.
English: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.

tcz: Numei jon pipan khomut chip chep angah jin hiche phat chuleh koiman eimu taponte atin koiman ahetdoh louna dingin amai asel jin ahi.
en: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.
text:
JOB 24:15
Thadou: Numei jon pipan khomut chip chep angah jin hiche phat chuleh koiman eimu taponte atin koiman ahetdoh louna dingin amai asel jin ahi.
English: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.

tcz: Migucha ho chun jan tengle mi in asuse jiuvin chuleh sun leh a ihmu jiuve. Amaho chu khovah toh kihekha lou ahiuve.
en: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.
text:
JOB 24:16
Thadou: Migucha ho chun jan tengle mi in asuse jiuvin chuleh sun leh a ihmu jiuve. Amaho chu khovah toh kihekha lou ahiuve.
English: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.

tcz: Jan muthim chu amaho din jingkah ahin amaho tah hi khojin kichatna toh kijopmat ahiuve.
en: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.
text:
JOB 24:17
Thadou: Jan muthim chu amaho din jingkah ahin amaho tah hi khojin kichatna toh kijopmat ahiuve.
English: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

tcz: Ahinlah amaho hi twinoi langa twihu bangin amang ji tauve, athilnei jouseu hi gaosapna ahi chule amaho alengpi lei uva alut diu jong akichauve.
en: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed in the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.
text:
JOB 24:18
Thadou: Ahinlah amaho hi twinoi langa twihu bangin amang ji tauve, athilnei jouseu hi gaosapna ahi chule amaho alengpi lei uva alut diu jong akichauve.
English: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed in the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.

tcz: Nichangsat leh sat in buhbang twi amanchah banga lhankhuh in jong michonse ho amanchah ahi.
en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.
text:
JOB 24:19
Thadou: Nichangsat leh sat in buhbang twi amanchah banga lhankhuh in jong michonse ho amanchah ahi.
English: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.

tcz: Ahingnu tah'un jong hin sumil untin than hon amaho chu twitah in hin neuvin tin, koima chan amaho chu geldoh tapouvin te. Migiloute chu huipi gopin thingphung amutlhuh tobang hiuvinte.
en: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.
text:
JOB 24:20
Thadou: Ahingnu tah'un jong hin sumil untin than hon amaho chu twitah in hin neuvin tin, koima chan amaho chu geldoh tapouvin te. Migiloute chu huipi gopin thingphung amutlhuh tobang hiuvinte.
English: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.

tcz: Kithopi ding chapa neilou meithai ho alhemlha jiuvin meithai gentheiho kithopi ding amaho anom pouve.
en: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.
text:
JOB 24:21
Thadou: Kithopi ding chapa neilou meithai ho alhemlha jiuvin meithai gentheiho kithopi ding amaho anom pouve.
English: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.

tcz: Pathen thanei nan miho chu akaimang jin amaho chu kichoisang maithei unte, ahinlah ahinkhou iti ding ham ti hetchetna anei pouve.
en: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.
text:
JOB 24:22
Thadou: Pathen thanei nan miho chu akaimang jin amaho chu kichoisang maithei unte, ahinlah ahinkhou iti ding ham ti hetchetna anei pouve.
English: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.

tcz: Amahohi lungmong tah a ahin diu kiphal peh jeng jongleh Pathen in amaho chu avelhi jing jenge.
en: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.
text:
JOB 24:23
Thadou: Amahohi lungmong tah a ahin diu kiphal peh jeng jongleh Pathen in amaho chu avelhi jing jenge.
English: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.

tcz: Chuleh tuhin amaho hi oupe lheh jong leu mitphet kah louvin adangho bangin che mang tauvin tin, changvui bangin satlhah in um uvinte.
en: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.
text:
JOB 24:24
Thadou: Chuleh tuhin amaho hi oupe lheh jong leu mitphet kah louvin adangho bangin che mang tauvin tin, changvui bangin satlhah in um uvinte.
English: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

tcz: Ahilou jongleh khat touvin achu thei ham? Koipen in kadih louna aphotchet thei ding ham?
en: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”
text:
JOB 24:25
Thadou: Ahilou jongleh khat touvin achu thei ham? Koipen in kadih louna aphotchet thei ding ham?
English: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”

tcz: Hiti chun Shuh mi Bildad in adonbut in:
en: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
text:
JOB 25:1
Thadou: Hiti chun Shuh mi Bildad in adonbut in:
English: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

tcz: Pathen hi thahattah le kichat umtah ahin, vanho a lungmon athaneina aumsah ahi.
en: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.
text:
JOB 25:2
Thadou: Pathen hi thahattah le kichat umtah ahin, vanho a lungmon athaneina aumsah ahi.
English: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

tcz: Koipen in avan sepai ho asim thei dingham? Akhovah chun leiset chung pumpi asalvah hilou ham?
en: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?
text:
JOB 25:3
Thadou: Koipen in avan sepai ho asim thei dingham? Akhovah chun leiset chung pumpi asalvah hilou ham?
English: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

tcz: Thithei mihem hi Pathen masanga nolna bei a um thei ding ham? Numeija konna pengdoh mihem hi thengsel thei ding ham?
en: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?
text:
JOB 25:4
Thadou: Thithei mihem hi Pathen masanga nolna bei a um thei ding ham? Numeija konna pengdoh mihem hi thengsel thei ding ham?
English: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

tcz: Pathen hi lhathah sanga loupijo ahin ahshi ho sangin jong aha vah joi.
en: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

tcz: Tekah pi dingin mihem tehi than tobangbep ahi. Eihohi than ho sanga lhasam jo ihiuve.
en: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”
text:
JOB 25:6
Thadou: Tekah pi dingin mihem tehi than tobangbep ahi. Eihohi than ho sanga lhasam jo ihiuve.
English: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”

tcz: Hichun Job in thu aseikit in:
en: Then Job answered,
text:
JOB 26:1
Thadou: Hichun Job in thu aseikit in:
English: Then Job answered,

tcz: Thabei chu nangin iti nana kithopi ham? Atha lhasam chu iti naki thopi ham?
en: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!
text:
JOB 26:2
Thadou: Thabei chu nangin iti nana kithopi ham? Atha lhasam chu iti naki thopi ham?
English: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

tcz: Kangolna hi iti nahetdoh sah thei ding ham? Ipi chihna chu neihil khah em?
en: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!
text:
JOB 26:3
Thadou: Kangolna hi iti nahetdoh sah thei ding ham? Ipi chihna chu neihil khah em?
English: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

tcz: Hitobang chihna thusei hohi hoiya nakilah ham? Koi lhagauvin nanga konna thu asei ham?
en: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?
text:
JOB 26:4
Thadou: Hitobang chihna thusei hohi hoiya nakilah ham? Koi lhagauvin nanga konna thu asei ham?
English: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?

tcz: Athisa twitonoija umho chu akithinge.
en: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.
text:
JOB 26:5
Thadou: Athisa twitonoija umho chu akithinge.
English: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

tcz: Pathen masanga chun noimigam jong akeu ahi, manthahna mun chu akihol doh tai.
en: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
text:
JOB 26:6
Thadou: Pathen masanga chun noimigam jong akeu ahi, manthahna mun chu akihol doh tai.
English: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

tcz: Pathen in van sahlang kai chu onghom laiya ahin khang doh in chule leiset chu imacha umlouna ah akhaije.
en: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.
text:
JOB 26:7
Thadou: Pathen in van sahlang kai chu onghom laiya ahin khang doh in chule leiset chu imacha umlouna ah akhaije.
English: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

tcz: Aman go chu meilhang satah in atom in chule agih a chun apohkeh dehpoi.
en: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.
text:
JOB 26:8
Thadou: Aman go chu meilhang satah in atom in chule agih a chun apohkeh dehpoi.
English: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

tcz: Aman lha chu amai atompeh in ameilhang ho a chun akhumin ahi.
en: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.
text:
JOB 26:9
Thadou: Aman lha chu amai atompeh in ameilhang ho a chun akhumin ahi.
English: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

tcz: Aman leisetna konna twi achom khenna chu kolmong ana semdoh ahi. Sunle jan gamgi asempeh ahi.
en: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
text:
JOB 26:10
Thadou: Aman leisetna konna twi achom khenna chu kolmong ana semdoh ahi. Sunle jan gamgi asempeh ahi.
English: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

tcz: Van khombul ho akiling in aman asapset teng akithing tuntun jin ahi.
en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.
text:
JOB 26:11
Thadou: Van khombul ho akiling in aman asapset teng akithing tuntun jin ahi.
English: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

tcz: Ama thahat in twikhang len thipchet in aumin athilbol theina in twikhanglen'a ganhing len chu asuhchip ahi.
en: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.
text:
JOB 26:12
Thadou: Ama thahat in twikhang len thipchet in aumin athilbol theina in twikhanglen'a ganhing len chu asuhchip ahi.
English: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

tcz: Alhagauva vanho hoitah a asem ahi. Athaneina a gulpi kilap lele chu asutpai ahi.
en: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
text:
JOB 26:13
Thadou: Alhagauva vanho hoitah a asem ahi. Athaneina a gulpi kilap lele chu asutpai ahi.
English: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

tcz: Athilbol ho lah a hicheho hi akipatna mai mai bou ahi nalaije. Athilboltheina husa mai mai bou ahin kon hitia chu van kithin thahatna chu ahet thei ding ham?
en: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
text:
JOB 26:14
Thadou: Athilbol ho lah a hicheho hi akipatna mai mai bou ahi nalaije. Athilboltheina husa mai mai bou ahin kon hitia chu van kithin thahatna chu ahet thei ding ham?
English: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”

tcz: Job in athusei ajom kit in:
en: Job again took up his parable, and said,
text:
JOB 27:1
Thadou: Job in athusei ajom kit in:
English: Job again took up his parable, and said,

tcz: Kathaneina eilah mang peh pa Pathen a kihahselna kaneijin kalhagao eisuhnatpeh Hatchungnung pachu,
en: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
text:
JOB 27:2
Thadou: Kathaneina eilah mang peh pa Pathen a kihahselna kaneijin kalhagao eisuhnatpeh Hatchungnung pachu,
English: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

tcz: Pathen a konna haina hu kaneija kahai laisung sea,
en: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

tcz: Kakama thuse kasei lou ding chuleh kalei jin jong thujou sei ponge.
en: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.
text:
JOB 27:4
Thadou: Kakama thuse kasei lou ding chuleh kalei jin jong thujou sei ponge.
English: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

tcz: Keiman nadihna kapom peh louhel ding ahi, kathi chan geija lung thengsel'a kaum na hi kahuh jing ding ahi.
en: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
text:
JOB 27:5
Thadou: Keiman nadihna kapom peh louhel ding ahi, kathi chan geija lung thengsel'a kaum na hi kahuh jing ding ahi.
English: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

tcz: Keiman nolnabei kahina hi lhaso louhela katuhchah jing ding kahin lai sung sea ka selepha hetna hi thengsel ah ahi.
en: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.
text:
JOB 27:6
Thadou: Keiman nolnabei kahina hi lhaso louhela katuhchah jing ding kahin lai sung sea ka selepha hetna hi thengsel ah ahi.
English: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

tcz: Kamelma pachu migiloupa bangin kigim bolhen, kamelma te jong miphalou ho tobang hiuhen.
en: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
text:
JOB 27:7
Thadou: Kamelma pachu migiloupa bangin kigim bolhen, kamelma te jong miphalou ho tobang hiuhen.
English: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

tcz: Pathen in asatlhah tengule Pathen neilou ten ipi kinepna anei nahlai diu ham? Chuleh ahinkhou akilah mang teng leh,
en: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
text:
JOB 27:8
Thadou: Pathen in asatlhah tengule Pathen neilou ten ipi kinepna anei nahlai diu ham? Chuleh ahinkhou akilah mang teng leh,
English: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

tcz: Hahsatna achung'uva ahunglhun tengle Pathen in akanau angai peh dem?
en: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
text:
JOB 27:9
Thadou: Hahsatna achung'uva ahunglhun tengle Pathen in akanau angai peh dem?
English: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

tcz: Hatchungnung pa komma kipana akimu diu hinam? Itih phat hijongle Pathen ahou thei diu ham?
en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
text:
JOB 27:10
Thadou: Hatchungnung pa komma kipana akimu diu hinam? Itih phat hijongle Pathen ahou thei diu ham?
English: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

tcz: Pathen thahatna chu keiman kahil ding nahi. Keiman Hatchungnung pa chungchang thu imacha im kanei lou ding ahi.
en: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.
text:
JOB 27:11
Thadou: Pathen thahatna chu keiman kahil ding nahi. Keiman Hatchungnung pa chungchang thu imacha im kanei lou ding ahi.
English: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

tcz: Hicheng ho jouse hi namusoh ahitan ahivangin pannabei thu jeng kakomah nasei nalaije.
en: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
text:
JOB 27:12
Thadou: Hicheng ho jouse hi namusoh ahitan ahivangin pannabei thu jeng kakomah nasei nalaije.
English: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

tcz: Migilouvin Pathen komma konna amu ding chu hiche hi ahi, Hatchungnung pa a konna agou chan diu chu hiche hi ahi.
en: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
text:
JOB 27:13
Thadou: Migilouvin Pathen komma konna amu ding chu hiche hi ahi, Hatchungnung pa a konna agou chan diu chu hiche hi ahi.
English: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

tcz: Chate tamtah nei maithei unte, ahinlah achateu chu gal kidouna ahiloule an ngolla thidiu ahi.
en: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
text:
JOB 27:14
Thadou: Chate tamtah nei maithei unte, ahinlah achateu chu gal kidouna ahiloule an ngolla thidiu ahi.
English: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

tcz: Ahingdoh nalai ho chu gamna hise a thidiu, chule ameithai hou jeng in jong apul u adou lou diu ahi.
en: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.
text:
JOB 27:15
Thadou: Ahingdoh nalai ho chu gamna hise a thidiu, chule ameithai hou jeng in jong apul u adou lou diu ahi.
English: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.

tcz: Miphalou ten sum alom lomin nei maithei untin chule ponsil lhemlhung bangin sevum maithei unte.
en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

tcz: Ahinlah hiche ponsil ho chu michonpha hon akivon diu chule nolna bei miho hiche sum chu kihom diu ahi.
en: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
text:
JOB 27:17
Thadou: Ahinlah hiche ponsil ho chu michonpha hon akivon diu chule nolna bei miho hiche sum chu kihom diu ahi.
English: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

tcz: Migilou hon mompan banga se baijin in kisah untin, thingbah kanga kisa bangin paset in kisah unte.
en: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
text:
JOB 27:18
Thadou: Migilou hon mompan banga se baijin in kisah untin, thingbah kanga kisa bangin paset in kisah unte.
English: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

tcz: Migiloupa chu alupna ah hausa tah in chen tin ahin ahung khah doh teng anei jouse ana beisoh amu ding ahi.
en: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
text:
JOB 27:19
Thadou: Migiloupa chu alupna ah hausa tah in chen tin ahin ahung khah doh teng anei jouse ana beisoh amu ding ahi.
English: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

tcz: Kichat nan twisoh bangin vuh khum untin chuleh amaho chu janna khopi hui nung chun amut mang tauve.
en: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
text:
JOB 27:20
Thadou: Kichat nan twisoh bangin vuh khum untin chuleh amaho chu janna khopi hui nung chun amut mang tauve.
English: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

tcz: Solam hui chun amaho apomang un chule amaho chu achemang a kitheh anga hi tauve.
en: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
text:
JOB 27:21
Thadou: Solam hui chun amaho apomang un chule amaho chu achemang a kitheh anga hi tauve.
English: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

tcz: Dipdapna neilouvin apei lhu uvin, hiche thaneina a konna jamdohna ding akiha bol uve.
en: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.
text:
JOB 27:22
Thadou: Dipdapna neilouvin apei lhu uvin, hiche thaneina a konna jamdohna ding akiha bol uve.
English: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

tcz: Ahinlah mijousen anuisat u chu iman agel pouve.
en: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.
text:
JOB 27:23
Thadou: Ahinlah mijousen anuisat u chu iman agel pouve.
English: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.

tcz: Mihem ten dangka kilaidohna aheuvin, chule iti kilhit theng ding ham ti aheuve.
en: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
text:
JOB 28:1
Thadou: Mihem ten dangka kilaidohna aheuvin, chule iti kilhit theng ding ham ti aheuve.
English: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

tcz: Leisetna konna thih kilaidohna ding mun aheuvin, songpi a konna sum eng sontwi je aheuve.
en: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
text:
JOB 28:2
Thadou: Leisetna konna thih kilaidohna ding mun aheuvin, songpi a konna sum eng sontwi je aheuve.
English: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

tcz: Chule leiset a gambeh gamla pen pen jong akhol doh uvin, thih ahol nau muthim lah a khovah sah je aheuve.
en: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
text:
JOB 28:3
Thadou: Chule leiset a gambeh gamla pen pen jong akhol doh uvin, thih ahol nau muthim lah a khovah sah je aheuve.
English: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

tcz: Mihem ho chenna a kon gamla tah a leiset a kokhuh avut un, khaovin akumsuh uvin anung leh ama ah akivol leuve.
en: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
text:
JOB 28:4
Thadou: Mihem ho chenna a kon gamla tah a leiset a kokhuh avut un, khaovin akumsuh uvin anung leh ama ah akivol leuve.
English: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

tcz: Neh le chah hi leiset chunga kitu ahin, ahinlah anoi langa leiset hi meiya kihal jun ji ahi.
en: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
text:
JOB 28:5
Thadou: Neh le chah hi leiset chunga kitu ahin, ahinlah anoi langa leiset hi meiya kihal jun ji ahi.
English: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

tcz: Hiche a songho lah a chu songval mantam tah um ahin, chuleh leivui lah a chu sana umah ahi.
en: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
text:
JOB 28:6
Thadou: Hiche a songho lah a chu songval mantam tah um ahin, chuleh leivui lah a chu sana umah ahi.
English: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

tcz: Hiche gou hohi chunga leng hingne hon jong amu theilou, chule vacha neo mit in jong amutheilou ahi.
en: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.
text:
JOB 28:7
Thadou: Hiche gou hohi chunga leng hingne hon jong amu theilou, chule vacha neo mit in jong amutheilou ahi.
English: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

tcz: Hiche gou ho chunga hi gamsa ho jengin jong ajot khah louhel ahin, keipi bahkai jengin jong atin a akhoi khah louhel ahi.
en: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
text:
JOB 28:8
Thadou: Hiche gou ho chunga hi gamsa ho jengin jong ajot khah louhel ahin, keipi bahkai jengin jong atin a akhoi khah louhel ahi.
English: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

tcz: Mihem in songgel song keh soje aheuvin chuleh mol lekhup je jong aheuve.
en: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
text:
JOB 28:9
Thadou: Mihem in songgel song keh soje aheuvin chuleh mol lekhup je jong aheuve.
English: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

tcz: Amahon songpi lah a kohom avut un chuleh song mantam manlu tah tah ho chu aladoh uve.
en: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
text:
JOB 28:10
Thadou: Amahon songpi lah a kohom avut un chuleh song mantam manlu tah tah ho chu aladoh uve.
English: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

tcz: Valha chet chut a long luidung ating tan jiuvin chuleh akiselguh gou jouse khovah a ahin polut jiuve.
en: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
text:
JOB 28:11
Thadou: Valha chet chut a long luidung ating tan jiuvin chuleh akiselguh gou jouse khovah a ahin polut jiuve.
English: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

tcz: Ahinlah mihem ten chihna hi hoiya kimudoh ding ham ti ahet uvem? Thilhet khen theina hi hoiya amu thei diuvem?
en: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
text:
JOB 28:12
Thadou: Ahinlah mihem ten chihna hi hoiya kimudoh ding ham ti ahet uvem? Thilhet khen theina hi hoiya amu thei diuvem?
English: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

tcz: Hoiya kimu ham ti koima chan ahepoi, ijeh inem itile hichehi mihing gamsunga kimulou ahi.
en: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.
text:
JOB 28:13
Thadou: Hoiya kimu ham ti koima chan ahepoi, ijeh inem itile hichehi mihing gamsunga kimulou ahi.
English: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.

tcz: Hiche ah aumpoi tin twikhanglen in aseijin Twipi thuhtah in jong keikomma aumpoi ati.
en: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
text:
JOB 28:14
Thadou: Hiche ah aumpoi tin twikhanglen in aseijin Twipi thuhtah in jong keikomma aumpoi ati.
English: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

tcz: Chihna chu sana a choh thei ahipon, dangka a choh thei jong ahipoi.
en: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.
text:
JOB 28:15
Thadou: Chihna chu sana a choh thei ahipon, dangka a choh thei jong ahipoi.
English: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.

tcz: Ophir am asana jouse sanga jong manlu jo ahin, manlu tah onyx leh songval sanga jong thupi jo nalai ahi.
en: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
text:
JOB 28:16
Thadou: Ophir am asana jouse sanga jong manlu jo ahin, manlu tah onyx leh songval sanga jong thupi jo nalai ahi.
English: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

tcz: Chihna hi sana leh songval sanga mantam jo ahin, song mantam kijepna chung sana hoitah chonga jong choh thei hilou ahi.
en: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
text:
JOB 28:17
Thadou: Chihna hi sana leh songval sanga mantam jo ahin, song mantam kijepna chung sana hoitah chonga jong choh thei hilou ahi.
English: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

tcz: Chihna chohna dingin coral leh jesper songmantam teni jong hi phachom lou ahin, chihna man ding chu hiche song mantam sang sanga jong sangjo nalai ahi.
en: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
text:
JOB 28:18
Thadou: Chihna chohna dingin coral leh jesper songmantam teni jong hi phachom lou ahin, chihna man ding chu hiche song mantam sang sanga jong sangjo nalai ahi.
English: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

tcz: Ethopia gam'a song mantam Peridot tojong lhet thei hilou ahin, sana theng pen pen sanga jong manlu jo ahi.
en: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.
text:
JOB 28:19
Thadou: Ethopia gam'a song mantam Peridot tojong lhet thei hilou ahin, sana theng pen pen sanga jong manlu jo ahi.
English: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.

tcz: Ahinlah mihem ten chihna hi hoiya konna kimuthei ding ham ti ahe thei diuvem? Thil hettheina hi hoiya amu diu ham?
en: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
text:
JOB 28:20
Thadou: Ahinlah mihem ten chihna hi hoiya konna kimuthei ding ham ti ahe thei diuvem? Thil hettheina hi hoiya amu diu ham?
English: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

tcz: Mihem te mitmu a konin akisel tan chung leng vacha mit hat pen in jong amu doh joulou ahi.
en: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
text:
JOB 28:21
Thadou: Mihem te mitmu a konin akisel tan chung leng vacha mit hat pen in jong amu doh joulou ahi.
English: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

tcz: Manthah nale thinan asei lhonin keinin jong chihna hi hoiya kimu ding ham tithu kithang bou kaja lhone.
en: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
text:
JOB 28:22
Thadou: Manthah nale thinan asei lhonin keinin jong chihna hi hoiya kimu ding ham tithu kithang bou kaja lhone.
English: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

tcz: Pathen ama changseh in bou chihna lampi hoiya kimu ding ham ti ahet ahi.
en: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
text:
JOB 28:23
Thadou: Pathen ama changseh in bou chihna lampi hoiya kimu ding ham ti ahet ahi.
English: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile aman leiset chung hi apumpia avet ji ahin, vannoija thil umjouse hi amusoh kei ahi.
en: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
text:
JOB 28:24
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile aman leiset chung hi apumpia avet ji ahin, vannoija thil umjouse hi amusoh kei ahi.
English: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

tcz: Aman hui ichan hat a nunsah ding chule go ichan a juhsah ding ti agel lhuh sa ahi.
en: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
text:
JOB 28:25
Thadou: Aman hui ichan hat a nunsah ding chule go ichan a juhsah ding ti agel lhuh sa ahi.
English: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

tcz: Aman gojuh ding dan asempeh in chule kolphe vahna ding lampi asempeh e.
en: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,
text:
JOB 28:26
Thadou: Aman gojuh ding dan asempeh in chule kolphe vahna ding lampi asempeh e.
English: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,

tcz: Hiti chun aman chihna chu ana mun chule manlu tah ahi, ahin munkhat ah akoiyin hoitah in akhol chiljin ahi.
en: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
text:
JOB 28:27
Thadou: Hiti chun aman chihna chu ana mun chule manlu tah ahi, ahin munkhat ah akoiyin hoitah in akhol chiljin ahi.
English: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

tcz: Chule aman mihem te jah a asei chu hiche hi ahi. Pakai gin kiti hi chihna chu ahin, thilse a konna kiheidoh kiti hi thil hetkhen theina chu ahi.
en: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
text:
JOB 28:28
Thadou: Chule aman mihem te jah a asei chu hiche hi ahi. Pakai gin kiti hi chihna chu ahin, thilse a konna kiheidoh kiti hi thil hetkhen theina chu ahi.
English: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”

tcz: Job in athusei ajom kit in:
en: Job again took up his parable, and said,
text:
JOB 29:1
Thadou: Job in athusei ajom kit in:
English: Job again took up his parable, and said,

tcz: Pathen in eina chin hoi jing lai kum chemangsa ho kagel doh kit e.
en: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

tcz: Kamasang lampi eivah peh a muthim lah a bitsel a kana vale lai.
en: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,
text:
JOB 29:3
Thadou: Kamasang lampi eivah peh a muthim lah a bitsel a kana vale lai.
English: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

tcz: Pathen toh golcha a ka in a apansah lai, aluboh pen a kapan lai chu hileh.
en: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,
text:
JOB 29:4
Thadou: Pathen toh golcha a ka in a apansah lai, aluboh pen a kapan lai chu hileh.
English: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

tcz: Hatchungnung pachu kakoma aum jing lai, chuleh kachate kakimvel a anaum laijin,
en: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,
text:
JOB 29:5
Thadou: Hatchungnung pachu kakoma aum jing lai, chuleh kachate kakimvel a anaum laijin,
English: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

tcz: Kabongpi ten bongnoi ninglhing set a asosah thei laiju chuleh kahon na keh hon olive thao alondoh sah laiju chu hileh.
en: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,
text:
JOB 29:6
Thadou: Kabongpi ten bongnoi ninglhing set a asosah thei laiju chuleh kahon na keh hon olive thao alondoh sah laiju chu hileh.
English: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

tcz: Khopi kelkot phung kajot a ja um tahtah le lamkai len leh lalte ho toh katou khomle lai nikho ho chu hileh,
en: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
text:
JOB 29:7
Thadou: Khopi kelkot phung kajot a ja um tahtah le lamkai len leh lalte ho toh katou khomle lai nikho ho chu hileh,
English: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

tcz: Khangdong hon eimu teng ule eipel doh jiuva upa tehseho jengin jong akoma kahung tengle jana neitah a adindoh ji laiju.
en: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.
text:
JOB 29:8
Thadou: Khangdong hon eimu teng ule eipel doh jiuva upa tehseho jengin jong akoma kahung tengle jana neitah a adindoh ji laiju.
English: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

tcz: Leng chapate jong thipbeh a aum uva chule akam uva akhut u akoi uva.
en: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
text:
JOB 29:9
Thadou: Leng chapate jong thipbeh a aum uva chule akam uva akhut u akoi uva.
English: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

tcz: Khopi sung vaipo lenpen pen ho thipchet a adin uva jabolna a adin uva aleiju atuh chahkheh uva.
en: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.
text:
JOB 29:10
Thadou: Khopi sung vaipo lenpen pen ho thipchet a adin uva jabolna a adin uva aleiju atuh chahkheh uva.
English: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

tcz: Kathu japha ho jousen eipahcha uvin, eimu kha jousen phatechan eihoupi jiuve.
en: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,
text:
JOB 29:11
Thadou: Kathu japha ho jousen eipahcha uvin, eimu kha jousen phatechan eihoupi jiuve.
English: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,

tcz: Ijeh inem itile mivaicha ten angaichat nau leh chagate kithopina ngaicha ho chu kakithopi jin ahi.
en: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
text:
JOB 29:12
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile mivaicha ten angaichat nau leh chagate kithopina ngaicha ho chu kakithopi jin ahi.
English: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

tcz: Keiman kinepna beimi ho chu kaki thopin ahile amahon phatthei eiboh jiuve, chule meithai ho lungthim kakipa doh sah jin, chuteng amahon la asajiuve.
en: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
text:
JOB 29:13
Thadou: Keiman kinepna beimi ho chu kaki thopin ahile amahon phatthei eiboh jiuve, chule meithai ho lungthim kakipa doh sah jin, chuteng amahon la asajiuve.
English: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

tcz: Kabol jouse chu lungtheng sellin kabol in chonphat nan sangkhol chol bangin eikhu khume, chule thutan dihna chu lukop bangin kakikop e.
en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
text:
JOB 29:14
Thadou: Kabol jouse chu lungtheng sellin kabol in chonphat nan sangkhol chol bangin eikhu khume, chule thutan dihna chu lukop bangin kakikop e.
English: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

tcz: Mitcho ho din mitchang tenin kapang in, chule elbai ho din akeng tenin kapange.
en: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.
text:
JOB 29:15
Thadou: Mitcho ho din mitchang tenin kapang in, chule elbai ho din akeng tenin kapange.
English: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

tcz: Chaga pabeite din mipan kapang in chuleh het khahlou hel miho jong kithopi angaichat nau vah kapanpi ji e.
en: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.
text:
JOB 29:16
Thadou: Chaga pabeite din mipan kapang in chuleh het khahlou hel miho jong kithopi angaichat nau vah kapanpi ji e.
English: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.

tcz: Keiman Pathen neilou mi engse ho ha kasuhbal peh jin, chuleh gimbol a um chu aha a konin kasalhah peh ji'e.
en: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
text:
JOB 29:17
Thadou: Keiman Pathen neilou mi engse ho ha kasuhbal peh jin, chuleh gimbol a um chu aha a konin kasalhah peh ji'e.
English: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

tcz: Hinkho pha sautah kahin man nung hin tahbeh mongin kathi tengle kainko ten eikimvel unte tin kana gel’e.
en: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.
text:
JOB 29:18
Thadou: Hinkho pha sautah kahin man nung hin tahbeh mongin kathi tengle kainko ten eikimvel unte tin kana gel’e.
English: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile, thingphung ajung hon twi lah aphah a abah ho daitwi in achap nou jing tobang kahi.
en: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.
text:
JOB 29:19
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile, thingphung ajung hon twi lah aphah a abah ho daitwi in achap nou jing tobang kahi.
English: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

tcz: Jabolna thah thah kachunga kilong louhel in eikipe jing jin, chuleh kathahatna jong tang louhel in akibelap jinge.
en: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’
text:
JOB 29:20
Thadou: Jabolna thah thah kachunga kilong louhel in eikipe jing jin, chuleh kathahatna jong tang louhel in akibelap jinge.
English: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

tcz: Amichang cheh in kathumopna angaijun kathusei ding hi amahon thipchet in angah uve.
en: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.
text:
JOB 29:21
Thadou: Amichang cheh in kathumopna angaijun kathusei ding hi amahon thipchet in angah uve.
English: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

tcz: Chuleh kasei chai tengle amahon belap ding anei ji pouve, Kathumop chun amaho alung lhai sah jeh u chun.
en: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.
text:
JOB 29:22
Thadou: Chuleh kasei chai tengle amahon belap ding anei ji pouve, Kathumop chun amaho alung lhai sah jeh u chun.
English: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

tcz: Mihem ten gojuh ding kinem tah a anga jing bangun amahon kathusei ding kinem tah in angah jiuvin, kathusei ho chu chavang gotwi bangin adon uve.
en: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.
text:
JOB 29:23
Thadou: Mihem ten gojuh ding kinem tah a anga jing bangun amahon kathusei ding kinem tah in angah jiuvin, kathusei ho chu chavang gotwi bangin adon uve.
English: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

tcz: Amaho alunglhah teng uleh ken amaho chu nuiseuvin kave jin ahileh mailhai sel a kavet chu amaho a din manlu tah ahiji.
en: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.
text:
JOB 29:24
Thadou: Amaho alunglhah teng uleh ken amaho chu nuiseuvin kave jin ahileh mailhai sel a kavet chu amaho a din manlu tah ahiji.
English: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

tcz: Haosapu bangin amahon atoh diu kaseipeh in sepai hon lah a chun lengpa bangin kacheng in chuleh lengvai ho kalhamon jin ahi.
en: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
text:
JOB 29:25
Thadou: Haosapu bangin amahon atoh diu kaseipeh in sepai hon lah a chun lengpa bangin kacheng in chuleh lengvai ho kalhamon jin ahi.
English: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

tcz: Ahinlah tun vang apateu kelngoi chinga pang kauicha ho toh lhaikhom dinga jong lhing joulou mihem, kasanga dong jo golhang khangdong ho nuisat bep in kaum doh tai.
en: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.
text:
JOB 30:1
Thadou: Ahinlah tun vang apateu kelngoi chinga pang kauicha ho toh lhaikhom dinga jong lhing joulou mihem, kasanga dong jo golhang khangdong ho nuisat bep in kaum doh tai.
English: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

tcz: Amaho khu keija dinga tamtah'a pha ahiuvin, hiche ho chu von sesa lungset um ahiuve.
en: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?
text:
JOB 30:2
Thadou: Amaho khu keija dinga tamtah'a pha ahiuvin, hiche ho chu von sesa lungset um ahiuve.
English: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

tcz: Amaho chu akel thoh jeh uva gong ahiuvin, chuleh nel phai gam mihem chen louna leh gaso talou leiset muthim gam'a chu jam ah ahiuve.
en: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
text:
JOB 30:3
Thadou: Amaho chu akel thoh jeh uva gong ahiuvin, chuleh nel phai gam mihem chen louna leh gaso talou leiset muthim gam'a chu jam ah ahiuve.
English: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

tcz: Hiti chun amahon hamboh lah a konin gamlah a na eng ho chu akilo uvin chuleh muntheh phung jung ho chu akilah un anejiuve.
en: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.
text:
JOB 30:4
Thadou: Hiti chun amahon hamboh lah a konin gamlah a na eng ho chu akilo uvin chuleh muntheh phung jung ho chu akilah un anejiuve.
English: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

tcz: Amaho chu mihem kiloikhom na a konna kidel mangah ahiuvin, chuleh gucha ahijeh uvin mihem ten amaho chu asamse jiuvin ahi.
en: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,
text:
JOB 30:5
Thadou: Amaho chu mihem kiloikhom na a konna kidel mangah ahiuvin, chuleh gucha ahijeh uvin mihem ten amaho chu asamse jiuvin ahi.
English: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,

tcz: Hiti chun gom kokhuh thuhtah tah lah a timul thou pumin leiko lah leh songpi ho lah a chun ching uve.
en: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
text:
JOB 30:6
Thadou: Hiti chun gom kokhuh thuhtah tah lah a timul thou pumin leiko lah leh songpi ho lah a chun ching uve.
English: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

tcz: Amaho chu hamboh lah a sa loupitah a aum bangun a ao chehchuh jiuvin thahpi ho noija chun alhaikhom jiuve.
en: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.
text:
JOB 30:7
Thadou: Amaho chu hamboh lah a sa loupitah a aum bangun a ao chehchuh jiuvin thahpi ho noija chun alhaikhom jiuve.
English: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.

tcz: Amaho chu kiloikhomna a kon kipaidoh mingol minbeiho ahiuve.
en: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.
text:
JOB 30:8
Thadou: Amaho chu kiloikhomna a kon kipaidoh mingol minbeiho ahiuve.
English: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.

tcz: Chuleh tun amahon pao ngeilou louvin isah loutah in einuisat jiuvin eiphin phin jiuve.
en: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
text:
JOB 30:9
Thadou: Chuleh tun amahon pao ngeilou louvin isah loutah in einuisat jiuvin eiphin phin jiuve.
English: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

tcz: Amahon iman eisep pouvin chuleh kamaija chil set khumpeh ding tailouvin kakomah ahung pouve.
en: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.
text:
JOB 30:10
Thadou: Amahon iman eisep pouvin chuleh kamaija chil set khumpeh ding tailouvin kakomah ahung pouve.
English: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen in kathal khao eisattan peh in aman eisuhnem ahin, hijeh a chu thuneina umnaho jouse chu apaimang u ahi.
en: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
text:
JOB 30:11
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile Pathen in kathal khao eisattan peh in aman eisuhnem ahin, hijeh a chu thuneina umnaho jouse chu apaimang u ahi.
English: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

tcz: Hiche akideldoh ho chun kamaichang tah a eidoudal un, kilhon changnam pet dingin eisol un chuleh kalampi ah thang eikampeh uve.
en: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.
text:
JOB 30:12
Thadou: Hiche akideldoh ho chun kamaichang tah a eidoudal un, kilhon changnam pet dingin eisol un chuleh kalampi ah thang eikampeh uve.
English: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.

tcz: Amahon kalamlhah jouse eikha peh un chule keiman eikithopi ding koimacha kaneilou ahet jeh uvin eisuhmang nathei diuvin abolthei jouseu abol'un ahi.
en: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.
text:
JOB 30:13
Thadou: Amahon kalamlhah jouse eikha peh un chule keiman eikithopi ding koimacha kaneilou ahet jeh uvin eisuhmang nathei diuvin abolthei jouseu abol'un ahi.
English: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.

tcz: Amaho muntinna konin kakomah ahungun keima kalhah suh pet in amaho kachungah akichom uve.
en: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.
text:
JOB 30:14
Thadou: Amaho muntinna konin kakomah ahungun keima kalhah suh pet in amaho kachungah akichom uve.
English: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

tcz: Tun vang kicha tah in kahingin eikijabol najouse huilah a akithe mangin kanei leh kagou jouse meilhang kitol mang bangin amangthah soh tai.
en: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.
text:
JOB 30:15
Thadou: Tun vang kicha tah in kahingin eikijabol najouse huilah a akithe mangin kanei leh kagou jouse meilhang kitol mang bangin amangthah soh tai.
English: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

tcz: Chuleh tua hi kahinkho along mang ahitan, kanikho ho jong genthei hesoh nan eihen den tai.
en: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.
text:
JOB 30:16
Thadou: Chuleh tua hi kahinkho along mang ahitan, kanikho ho jong genthei hesoh nan eihen den tai.
English: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

tcz: Jan teng kagu kachang ho natnan alodim jin hichun tang louhel in eichip eichip ji'e.
en: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
text:
JOB 30:17
Thadou: Jan teng kagu kachang ho natnan alodim jin hichun tang louhel in eichip eichip ji'e.
English: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

tcz: Khuthat tah in Pathen in ka sangkhol eilah peh in ka sangkhol ngong ah eimanchah kheh in ahi.
en: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.
text:
JOB 30:18
Thadou: Khuthat tah in Pathen in ka sangkhol eilah peh in ka sangkhol ngong ah eimanchah kheh in ahi.
English: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

tcz: Aman bonlhoh lah a eisep lut in keima hi leivui leh vutvam sanga jong panna beijo kahi.
en: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.
text:
JOB 30:19
Thadou: Aman bonlhoh lah a eisep lut in keima hi leivui leh vutvam sanga jong panna beijo kahi.
English: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

tcz: Nahenga hung tao kahi O Pathen, ahinlah nangin nei donbut pon, namasang a ding kahin, ahin nangin vet ding'in jong neigo poi.
en: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.
text:
JOB 30:20
Thadou: Nahenga hung tao kahi O Pathen, ahinlah nangin nei donbut pon, namasang a ding kahin, ahin nangin vet ding'in jong neigo poi.
English: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

tcz: Keija dinga lungsetna beihel nahung hitai. Nathahat na chu kei engbol nan namange.
en: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.
text:
JOB 30:21
Thadou: Keija dinga lungsetna beihel nahung hitai. Nathahat na chu kei engbol nan namange.
English: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

tcz: Nangin chimpei lah a neisep lut in chuleh huipi kinong in nei sumange.
en: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.
text:
JOB 30:22
Thadou: Nangin chimpei lah a neisep lut in chuleh huipi kinong in nei sumange.
English: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

tcz: Chuleh nangin mihing jouse lhunna kathina ding munna chu neisol ahi ti kahei.
en: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.
text:
JOB 30:23
Thadou: Chuleh nangin mihing jouse lhunna kathina ding munna chu neisol ahi ti kahei.
English: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.

tcz: Tahbeh mongin genthei hahsatna a kithopi ngaicha ahung tao tengule koima cha hiche genthei thoh ho lang ngan kihei pouvinte.
en: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?
text:
JOB 30:24
Thadou: Tahbeh mongin genthei hahsatna a kithopi ngaicha ahung tao tengule koima cha hiche genthei thoh ho lang ngan kihei pouvinte.
English: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

tcz: Hahsatna toh ho dinga kapji kahi lou ham? Vaicha genthei tedinga nasatah a ka genthei pi ji hilou ham?
en: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?
text:
JOB 30:25
Thadou: Hahsatna toh ho dinga kapji kahi lou ham? Vaicha genthei tedinga nasatah a ka genthei pi ji hilou ham?
English: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

tcz: Hijeh chun thilpha kave jin ahinlah hiche sang chun thilphalou joh chu ahung jin ahi.
en: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.
text:
JOB 30:26
Thadou: Hijeh chun thilpha kave jin ahinlah hiche sang chun thilphalou joh chu ahung jin ahi.
English: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.

tcz: Kalungthim agentheijin chuleh cholngahna kanei theipoi. Kagentheina nikho te hin eisu genthei lheh e.
en: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.
text:
JOB 30:27
Thadou: Kalungthim agentheijin chuleh cholngahna kanei theipoi. Kagentheina nikho te hin eisu genthei lheh e.
English: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

tcz: Nisavah umlouna muthim lah a kavah len mipi kigol toh chet lah a kadingin kithopi ngaichan kakap e.
en: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.
text:
JOB 30:28
Thadou: Nisavah umlouna muthim lah a kavah len mipi kigol toh chet lah a kadingin kithopi ngaichan kakap e.
English: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

tcz: Hiche ho khellin keima gam-ui sopipa simbupi toh kikoppan eiki ngaiton ahi.
en: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.
text:
JOB 30:29
Thadou: Hiche ho khellin keima gam-ui sopipa simbupi toh kikoppan eiki ngaiton ahi.
English: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

tcz: Kavun ho aduplha soh tan chule kagu kachang ho jouse khosih in kati apeh henhun e.
en: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
text:
JOB 30:30
Thadou: Kavun ho aduplha soh tan chule kagu kachang ho jouse khosih in kati apeh henhun e.
English: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

tcz: Ka selangdah gin in jong lungkham la ahin sa in katheile gin jong kana ogin in aginge.
en: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
text:
JOB 30:31
Thadou: Ka selangdah gin in jong lungkham la ahin sa in katheile gin jong kana ogin in aginge.
English: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

tcz: Keiman kamit teni toh kigahna kasem in khangdong numei chu jon lunga vet lou dingin,
en: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
text:
JOB 31:1
Thadou: Keiman kamit teni toh kigahna kasem in khangdong numei chu jon lunga vet lou dingin,
English: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

tcz: Ijeh inem itile chunga Pathen chun eiho ipi dinga eilhen u ham? Chungsang a um hatchungnung pa a konna goulo ding chu ipi ham?
en: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?
text:
JOB 31:2
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile chunga Pathen chun eiho ipi dinga eilhen u ham? Chungsang a um hatchungnung pa a konna goulo ding chu ipi ham?
English: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?

tcz: Migiloute dinga vangsetna hilou hija chule thilphalou bolte dinga vangset umtah dinmun chu hilou ham?
en: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?
text:
JOB 31:3
Thadou: Migiloute dinga vangsetna hilou hija chule thilphalou bolte dinga vangset umtah dinmun chu hilou ham?
English: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

tcz: Pathen in kabol katoh jouse amulou hija chuleh kakalse jat jong ahet hilou ham?
en: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?
text:
JOB 31:4
Thadou: Pathen in kabol katoh jouse amulou hija chuleh kakalse jat jong ahet hilou ham?
English: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?

tcz: Mikhat tou koma jou kasei khah a chuleh mikhat tou kalhep khah em?
en: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit
text:
JOB 31:5
Thadou: Mikhat tou koma jou kasei khah a chuleh mikhat tou kalhep khah em?
English: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit

tcz: Thudih kitena chun Pathen in eitetoh hen, ijeh inem itile aman kalung thenna hi ahet ahi.
en: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

tcz: Alamlhah a konna ahilouva ijem tia kamu ji ho a kalungthim jon lung ngaichatna kanei khah a ahiloule chonsetna dang khat a themmona kanei khah a ahile,
en: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,
text:
JOB 31:7
Thadou: Alamlhah a konna ahilouva ijem tia kamu ji ho a kalungthim jon lung ngaichatna kanei khah a ahiloule chonsetna dang khat a themmona kanei khah a ahile,
English: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,

tcz: Hiti chun mikhat touvin hange mim kaphu na ana nejeng hen, kaphu doh chengse abonchan kibotdoh soh jeng hen.
en: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.
text:
JOB 31:8
Thadou: Hiti chun mikhat touvin hange mim kaphu na ana nejeng hen, kaphu doh chengse abonchan kibotdoh soh jeng hen.
English: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

tcz: Ijem tia kalungthim in numei khat tou alheplhah a ahiloule ka inheng pa jinu jon lunga kavet khah a ahile,
en: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,
text:
JOB 31:9
Thadou: Ijem tia kalungthim in numei khat tou alheplhah a ahiloule ka inheng pa jinu jon lunga kavet khah a ahile,
English: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,

tcz: Chuti chun kajinu jong pasal dang ji hijeng hen, pasal dang khat in luppi jeng hen.
en: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.
text:
JOB 31:10
Thadou: Chuti chun kajinu jong pasal dang ji hijeng hen, pasal dang khat in luppi jeng hen.
English: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile jon lung put hi jachat umtah chonset ahi, hiche dandih louva chon ho chu gimbol dinga lha ahi.
en: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,
text:
JOB 31:11
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile jon lung put hi jachat umtah chonset ahi, hiche dandih louva chon ho chu gimbol dinga lha ahi.
English: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,

tcz: Hichu damun lampi lhung keija meiyin akah tobang ahin, kanei jouse kamang hel ding ahi.
en: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.
text:
JOB 31:12
Thadou: Hichu damun lampi lhung keija meiyin akah tobang ahin, kanei jouse kamang hel ding ahi.
English: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

tcz: Ijemtia kasohpa ham kasoh numei adih louva kabolla ahileh amahon akiphin nau kakoma ahinlhut teng uleh,
en: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,
text:
JOB 31:13
Thadou: Ijemtia kasohpa ham kasoh numei adih louva kabolla ahileh amahon akiphin nau kakoma ahinlhut teng uleh,
English: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,

tcz: Pathen chu iti kakimaito pi ding hitam? Aman thu eihin doh teng ipi kasei tadem?
en: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?
text:
JOB 31:14
Thadou: Pathen chu iti kakimaito pi ding hitam? Aman thu eihin doh teng ipi kasei tadem?
English: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in kei leh kasoh te kaniuva eisem kop u ahi.
en: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?
text:
JOB 31:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen in kei leh kasoh te kaniuva eisem kop u ahi.
English: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

tcz: Vaichate panpi ding kada khah a ahiloule meithai ho kinepna kasuh keh peh khah em?
en: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
text:
JOB 31:16
Thadou: Vaichate panpi ding kada khah a ahiloule meithai ho kinepna kasuh keh peh khah em?
English: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

tcz: Ka anneh chunga kachip khah a chaga pabeite toh nehkhom ding kada khah em?
en: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it
text:
JOB 31:17
Thadou: Ka anneh chunga kachip khah a chaga pabeite toh nehkhom ding kada khah em?
English: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it

tcz: Ahipoi, mipa khat bangin, kaneo laiya pat in chagate kahin hoitup in chule kahinkho lhumin meithaite hoitup nan kahin mange.
en: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);

tcz: Itih lai hijongle chenna ding neilou ponbeija umho chule von ding neilou gentheiho kamu tengle
en: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

tcz: Akisillum diuva samul pon kapeh ji jeh a eipachat jiu hilou ham?
en: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;

tcz: Thutanpa kalanga apan nadinga chaga khat douna a kakhut kadop khah a ahile,
en: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;

tcz: Hiti chun kalengkou aumna a konin kisatlha jeng hen, kaban jang jong akisuhto na a konin kisatlha jeng hen.
en: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.
text:
JOB 31:22
Thadou: Hiti chun kalengkou aumna a konin kisatlha jeng hen, kaban jang jong akisuhto na a konin kisatlha jeng hen.
English: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

tcz: Hichu Pathen thutanna kimaitopi sangin phajonte, ijemtia oupe Pathen chun einan chahkheh a ahile kinepna ipi kanei ding ham?
en: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.
text:
JOB 31:23
Thadou: Hichu Pathen thutanna kimaitopi sangin phajonte, ijemtia oupe Pathen chun einan chahkheh a ahile kinepna ipi kanei ding ham?
English: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.

tcz: Keiman katahsanna summa kakoi khah a ahile, ahiloule kasana a hi kakison khah a ahile,
en: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’
text:
JOB 31:24
Thadou: Keiman katahsanna summa kakoi khah a ahile, ahiloule kasana a hi kakison khah a ahile,
English: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’

tcz: Kanei kagou jouse leh kakhol khom jouse jeh a kipah a kahile,
en: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

tcz: Vantham jol ho a vahpel a vah nisa leh lha alampia chesuh khu kavet a,
en: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,
text:
JOB 31:26
Thadou: Vantham jol ho a vahpel a vah nisa leh lha alampia chesuh khu kavet a,
English: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

tcz: Chuleh aguh a kalungthim kalheplhah a amaho houna kaga galchop khah a ahile,
en: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;

tcz: Achuti tah a ahile thutan vaihom hon eigim bol uhen, chuti chu ahi tah leh van Pathen thusei kangaipeh lou hiding tina ahi.
en: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.
text:
JOB 31:28
Thadou: Achuti tah a ahile thutan vaihom hon eigim bol uhen, chuti chu ahi tah leh van Pathen thusei kangaipeh lou hiding tina ahi.
English: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.

tcz: Kamelma techu manthah nan ahin phah tenga ahiloule alampiuva hahsatna ahung tengle, hetnom ten tena aum jeh uva kipah kahile,
en: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him
text:
JOB 31:29
Thadou: Kamelma techu manthah nan ahin phah tenga ahiloule alampiuva hahsatna ahung tengle, hetnom ten tena aum jeh uva kipah kahile,
English: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him

tcz: Ahipoi, keiman mikhat tou kaspset a, ahiloule phulah ding kasei kha pon, hitobang chonsetna hi kabol khapoi.
en: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

tcz: Kasoh pan jong adangho chu gilkel in kachesah tai tin asei khapoi.
en: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’
text:
JOB 31:31
Thadou: Kasoh pan jong adangho chu gilkel in kachesah tai tin asei khapoi.
English: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’

tcz: Hetkhah lou mi jong kakihei mangsan kha pon, ahinlah mijouse din kot kahonpeh ji bouve.
en: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);

tcz: Midangho banga ken kachonsetna selmang ding kagot a, kasuhkhel kalung thima ka imden khah ham?
en: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,
text:
JOB 31:33
Thadou: Midangho banga ken kachonsetna selmang ding kagot a, kasuhkhel kalung thima ka imden khah ham?
English: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

tcz: Mipiho kakichatna ahiloule kikhop khom naho kadeimo a hiche ho jeh a chu thipbeh a insunga kaum den khah ham?
en: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—
text:
JOB 31:34
Thadou: Mipiho kakichatna ahiloule kikhop khom naho kadeimo a hiche ho jeh a chu thipbeh a insunga kaum den khah ham?
English: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—

tcz: Mikhat tou beh in kathusei eingai peh hen lang hileh ven kakihonna dinga kamin soi kakai ding ahi. Hatchungnungpa chun eidonbut hen lang eiheh pan kei douna thu sundoh hen.
en: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!
text:
JOB 31:35
Thadou: Mikhat tou beh in kathusei eingai peh hen lang hileh ven kakihonna dinga kamin soi kakai ding ahi. Hatchungnungpa chun eidonbut hen lang eiheh pan kei douna thu sundoh hen.
English: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!

tcz: Keiman themmo eichan sah nau chu kiloupi sah tah a kaki maitopi ding lallukhuh banga kakikhuh ding ahi.
en: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.
text:
JOB 31:36
Thadou: Keiman themmo eichan sah nau chu kiloupi sah tah a kaki maitopi ding lallukhuh banga kakikhuh ding ahi.
English: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile keiman kathilbol adihtah chu kaseipeh ding ahin, ama masanga chu leng chapate banga kahung ding ahi.
en: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.
text:
JOB 31:37
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile keiman kathilbol adihtah chu kaseipeh ding ahin, ama masanga chu leng chapate banga kahung ding ahi.
English: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.

tcz: Kagam in themmo eichansah khah tah a tucha maha jouse kitoh tah a ahung ka soh keijuva,
en: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

tcz: Ahilouva achang leh mim kana guh khah a ahiloule anei ho kana tha khah tah a ahile,
en: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,
text:
JOB 31:39
Thadou: Ahilouva achang leh mim kana guh khah a ahiloule anei ho kana tha khah tah a ahile,
English: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

tcz: Chuti chun gehu khellin ling leh khau agama chun keh henlang, chang khellin hampa keh hen. Job thusei ho akichaitai.
