en: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.
text:
JOB 31:40
Thadou: Chuti chun gehu khellin ling leh khau agama chun keh henlang, chang khellin hampa keh hen. Job thusei ho akichaitai.
English: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.

tcz: Job in nolna bei kahi tia apanchah kheh phat in aloi agolte thumho chun donbut be ding anom tapouve.
en: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
text:
JOB 32:1
Thadou: Job in nolna bei kahi tia apanchah kheh phat in aloi agolte thumho chun donbut be ding anom tapouve.
English: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

tcz: Hichun Ram phunga Buz mi Barakel chapa Elihu chu ahung lunghang tai. Job in chonset kana bol nai chuleh Pathen in eigim bolna hi adih e ti ding anop lou jeh a lunghangah ahi.
en: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.
text:
JOB 32:2
Thadou: Hichun Ram phunga Buz mi Barakel chapa Elihu chu ahung lunghang tai. Job in chonset kana bol nai chuleh Pathen in eigim bolna hi adih e ti ding anop lou jeh a lunghangah ahi.
English: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

tcz: Job in anel nau adonbut thei uva Pathen joh chu dihmo dinga akilah jeh uva Job loile golte thum chunga jong kinga ahi.
en: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
text:
JOB 32:3
Thadou: Job in anel nau adonbut thei uva Pathen joh chu dihmo dinga akilah jeh uva Job loile golte thum chunga jong kinga ahi.
English: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

tcz: Elihun adangho Job koma thu asei diu chu anga nga jeng ahi. Ijeh inem itile amaho chu ama sanga upajo ahiuve.
en: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.
text:
JOB 32:4
Thadou: Elihun adangho Job koma thu asei diu chu anga nga jeng ahi. Ijeh inem itile amaho chu ama sanga upajo ahiuve.
English: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.

tcz: Ahinlah amahon adonbut be tahlou u amu phat in lunghang tah in ahung paodoh e.
en: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.
text:
JOB 32:5
Thadou: Ahinlah amahon adonbut be tahlou u amu phat in lunghang tah in ahung paodoh e.
English: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

tcz: Buz mi Barakel chapa Elihun aseitai. Keima khangdong kahin nangho upa nahiuve. Hijeh a chu nangho komma kalunggel kasei ding chu kakhongai ahi.
en: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.
text:
JOB 32:6
Thadou: Buz mi Barakel chapa Elihun aseitai. Keima khangdong kahin nangho upa nahiuve. Hijeh a chu nangho komma kalunggel kasei ding chu kakhongai ahi.
English: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.

tcz: Keigel in ateh jep hon thu seiju hen, ijeh inem itile upa ho a hi chihna hung ahi.
en: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
text:
JOB 32:7
Thadou: Keigel in ateh jep hon thu seiju hen, ijeh inem itile upa ho a hi chihna hung ahi.
English: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

tcz: Ahin mihem te sunga chu lhagao um ahi. Hatchungnungpa hu haikhuma amaho sunga um hiche chun achihsah u ahi.
en: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.
text:
JOB 32:8
Thadou: Ahin mihem te sunga chu lhagao um ahi. Hatchungnungpa hu haikhuma amaho sunga um hiche chun achihsah u ahi.
English: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

tcz: Phatkhat tengle upa ho jong aching ji pouve. Khatvei vei teng thutan dihje ahe pouve.
en: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
text:
JOB 32:9
Thadou: Phatkhat tengle upa ho jong aching ji pouve. Khatvei vei teng thutan dihje ahe pouve.
English: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

tcz: Hijeh chun kasei ngaijun chuleh kalunggel seipeh uvinge.
en: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
text:
JOB 32:10
Thadou: Hijeh chun kasei ngaijun chuleh kalunggel seipeh uvinge.
English: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’

tcz: Keiman nang thusei phat hitih chan sung hin kahin ngah in nakinel nahou lunglut tah in kahin ngaijin, khomulouva nathusei doh hou kangaije.
en: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
text:
JOB 32:11
Thadou: Keiman nang thusei phat hitih chan sung hin kahin ngah in nakinel nahou lunglut tah in kahin ngaijin, khomulouva nathusei doh hou kangaije.
English: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

tcz: Nathusei hou kangaije, ahin khat chan jong nanel thei pouve. Ahiloule aminelna nadonbut thei pouve.
en: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
text:
JOB 32:12
Thadou: Nathusei hou kangaije, ahin khat chan jong nanel thei pouve. Ahiloule aminelna nadonbut thei pouve.
English: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

tcz: Amapa hi eiho dingin aching beh seh e, Pathen bouvin ama ajo ding ahi tin kakoma sei hih un.
en: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’
text:
JOB 32:13
Thadou: Amapa hi eiho dingin aching beh seh e, Pathen bouvin ama ajo ding ahi tin kakoma sei hih un.
English: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’

tcz: Job chun keima einel hihen hileh nanghon namanchah u hettheina bangin donbut ponge.
en: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.
text:
JOB 32:14
Thadou: Job chun keima einel hihen hileh nanghon namanchah u hettheina bangin donbut ponge.
English: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

tcz: Seibe ding helouva lunggimma tou nahiuve.
en: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
text:
JOB 32:15
Thadou: Seibe ding helouva lunggimma tou nahiuve.
English: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.

tcz: Tua nangho thipbeh a naum bang uva hi ken kanga nga nahlai dingu ham? Keijong thipbeh a kaum jing ding ham?
en: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
text:
JOB 32:16
Thadou: Tua nangho thipbeh a naum bang uva hi ken kanga nga nahlai dingu ham? Keijong thipbeh a kaum jing ding ham?
English: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

tcz: Ahipoi halkhat beh kaseija kalunggel kasei ding ahi.
en: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
text:
JOB 32:17
Thadou: Ahipoi halkhat beh kaseija kalunggel kasei ding ahi.
English: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile, kalung in adol joulou thu cheng tampi ho seidoh hi kasunga ka lhagaovin seidoh dingin eino tuntun e.
en: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
text:
JOB 32:18
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile, kalung in adol joulou thu cheng tampi ho seidoh hi kasunga ka lhagaovin seidoh dingin eino tuntun e.
English: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

tcz: Keima ahom umlou jubom tobang kahin, jupohna thah pohkeh ding sa tobang kahi.
en: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.
text:
JOB 32:19
Thadou: Keima ahom umlou jubom tobang kahin, jupohna thah pohkeh ding sa tobang kahi.
English: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

tcz: Kalung ol theina dinga kasei ding ahi. Hijeh chun ka donbutna penge.
en: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.
text:
JOB 32:20
Thadou: Kalung ol theina dinga kasei ding ahi. Hijeh chun ka donbutna penge.
English: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

tcz: Kadei tah in jong kichem ponge, ahiloule koimacha pachat lhem bol ponge.
en: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
text:
JOB 32:21
Thadou: Kadei tah in jong kichem ponge, ahiloule koimacha pachat lhem bol ponge.
English: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

tcz: Keiman joulhep ding kagot a ahile eisempan gangtah in eisumang jeng hen.
en: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.
text:
JOB 32:22
Thadou: Keiman joulhep ding kagot a ahile eisempan gangtah in eisumang jeng hen.
English: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.

tcz: Job kathusei hohi ngaijin, kathusei dingho hi lunglut in ngaijin.
en: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
text:
JOB 33:1
Thadou: Job kathusei hohi ngaijin, kathusei dingho hi lunglut in ngaijin.
English: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

tcz: Tun kathusei hitihin pan kit ing ting banjom tange.
en: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
text:
JOB 33:2
Thadou: Tun kathusei hitihin pan kit ing ting banjom tange.
English: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

tcz: Kasei jouse hi lung thengsel'a kasei ahin, thutah kasei ahi.
en: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.
text:
JOB 33:3
Thadou: Kasei jouse hi lung thengsel'a kasei ahin, thutah kasei ahi.
English: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen lhagauvin eina sem ahi. Chuleh Hatchungnung pa hu haikhumin kahinna hi eipeh ahi.
en: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
text:
JOB 33:4
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile Pathen lhagauvin eina sem ahi. Chuleh Hatchungnung pa hu haikhumin kahinna hi eipeh ahi.
English: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

tcz: Naki ngachat leh nei donbut in, nachung chang thu kisem toh'in, chuleh nadin namun ah dingin.
en: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
text:
JOB 33:5
Thadou: Naki ngachat leh nei donbut in, nachung chang thu kisem toh'in, chuleh nadin namun ah dingin.
English: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

tcz: Ven nang leh kei inia Pathen a ihicheh e. Keijong leingan a ana kisem ah kahi.
en: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.
text:
JOB 33:6
Thadou: Ven nang leh kei inia Pathen a ihicheh e. Keijong leingan a ana kisem ah kahi.
English: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

tcz: Hijeh a chu kei neikichat nading aumpoi, huham tah a kahung kumsuh lou ding ahi.
en: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.
text:
JOB 33:7
Thadou: Hijeh a chu kei neikichat nading aumpoi, huham tah a kahung kumsuh lou ding ahi.
English: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.

tcz: Nangin kajah ding thu naseisa ahitan, chule nathusei ho achang cheh a kajah ahi.
en: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
text:
JOB 33:8
Thadou: Nangin kajah ding thu naseisa ahitan, chule nathusei ho achang cheh a kajah ahi.
English: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

tcz: Nangin keima kathengin, kei chonsetna bei kahi, kei nolna bei themmona kaneipoi tin naseije.
en: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
text:
JOB 33:9
Thadou: Nangin keima kathengin, kei chonsetna bei kahi, kei nolna bei themmona kaneipoi tin naseije.
English: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

tcz: Pathen in eikinah pin chuleh amelma in eingaito e.
en: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.
text:
JOB 33:10
Thadou: Pathen in eikinah pin chuleh amelma in eingaito e.
English: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.

tcz: Kakeng teni khaokol sung ei chotlut sah in chuleh kakholhahna jouse amelchih e.
en: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
text:
JOB 33:11
Thadou: Kakeng teni khaokol sung ei chotlut sah in chuleh kakholhahna jouse amelchih e.
English: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’

tcz: Ahinlah nang nadih poi, chuleh ipi jeh ham ti navet sah inge. Ijeh inem itile miching ho sanga oupe jo ahi.
en: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
text:
JOB 33:12
Thadou: Ahinlah nang nadih poi, chuleh ipi jeh ham ti navet sah inge. Ijeh inem itile miching ho sanga oupe jo ahi.
English: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile ipi dinga nadouna a nanokhum ham? Ipi dinga aman mihem te kiphinna adonbut poi nati ham?
en: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
text:
JOB 33:13
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile ipi dinga nadouna a nanokhum ham? Ipi dinga aman mihem te kiphinna adonbut poi nati ham?
English: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?

tcz: Ijeh inem itile mihem ten ahet theilou vanga Pathen in avel vel'a asei ahitai.
en: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
text:
JOB 33:14
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile mihem ten ahet theilou vanga Pathen in avel vel'a asei ahitai.
English: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.

tcz: Janmanga ahim, muneina ahim a mihemte ha imut a aimut pet u, ajalkhun chunga alup pet uva aman aseipeh u ahi.
en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,
text:
JOB 33:15
Thadou: Janmanga ahim, muneina ahim a mihemte ha imut a aimut pet u, ajalkhun chunga alup pet uva aman aseipeh u ahi.
English: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,

tcz: Aman anabeng tenia ol chakhat in aseije, chule kichat tijatna a agih ji ahi.
en: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
text:
JOB 33:16
Thadou: Aman anabeng tenia ol chakhat in aseije, chule kichat tijatna a agih ji ahi.
English: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,

tcz: Athilse bolnau va konna akinungle sah ji a, akiletsah nau alahmang ji ahi.
en: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
text:
JOB 33:17
Thadou: Athilse bolnau va konna akinungle sah ji a, akiletsah nau alahmang ji ahi.
English: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

tcz: Lhankhuh a konna ahuhdoh a thina lui agal kai diuva jong ahuhdoh jiu ahi.
en: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
text:
JOB 33:18
Thadou: Lhankhuh a konna ahuhdoh a thina lui agal kai diuva jong ahuhdoh jiu ahi.
English: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

tcz: Ahiloule Pathen in mihem tehi dammona jalkhun chunga natle sat toh tang louhel a agu achangin achi a hitia hi asuhdih ji ahi.
en: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
text:
JOB 33:19
Thadou: Ahiloule Pathen in mihem tehi dammona jalkhun chunga natle sat toh tang louhel a agu achangin achi a hitia hi asuhdih ji ahi.
English: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,

tcz: Chuteng leh amahon anneh twipen pen jong aduchatna mang ji ahitai.
en: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.
text:
JOB 33:20
Thadou: Chuteng leh amahon anneh twipen pen jong aduchatna mang ji ahitai.
English: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

tcz: Amaho tahsa agongsuh tan chule agu achang aki langdoh soh tai.
en: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
text:
JOB 33:21
Thadou: Amaho tahsa agongsuh tan chule agu achang aki langdoh soh tai.
English: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.

tcz: Amaho chu thina kotkhah gei ahitauvin, thina vantil chun amaho ana nga jiu ahitai.
en: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
text:
JOB 33:22
Thadou: Amaho chu thina kotkhah gei ahitauvin, thina vantil chun amaho ana nga jiu ahitai.
English: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

tcz: Ahinlah vantil khat vanna kon in hung kilang hen, thupole chombeh khat chun mikhat dingin tao peh hen, chuleh amapa hi lungthengsel ahina phongdoh henlang,
en: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,
text:
JOB 33:23
Thadou: Ahinlah vantil khat vanna kon in hung kilang hen, thupole chombeh khat chun mikhat dingin tao peh hen, chuleh amapa hi lungthengsel ahina phongdoh henlang,
English: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,

tcz: Amapa chu milungset them hihen lang, lhankhuh a konin huhdoh tauvin, ijeh inem itile keiman ahinkhou kilhatdoh na man ding chu kamutai tin seihen hileh,
en: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
text:
JOB 33:24
Thadou: Amapa chu milungset them hihen lang, lhankhuh a konin huhdoh tauvin, ijeh inem itile keiman ahinkhou kilhatdoh na man ding chu kamutai tin seihen hileh,
English: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

tcz: Chutileh atahsa chu chapang tahsa dehchet leh khangdong lai phat bangin hung damthei kit inte.
en: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.
text:
JOB 33:25
Thadou: Chutileh atahsa chu chapang tahsa dehchet leh khangdong lai phat bangin hung damthei kit inte.
English: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.

tcz: Pathen komma atau tengleh amachu kisan peh ding ahi. Chule Pathen in kipah in sang intin, chule adinmun hoitah in koi kit inte.
en: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
text:
JOB 33:26
Thadou: Pathen komma atau tengleh amachu kisan peh ding ahi. Chule Pathen in kipah in sang intin, chule adinmun hoitah in koi kit inte.
English: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.

tcz: Amapan aloi agolte komma phongdoh intin keima kachonse tai chule thutah adihlou lamin kaheijin ahinlah hichu phatchomna bei ahi.
en: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
text:
JOB 33:27
Thadou: Amapan aloi agolte komma phongdoh intin keima kachonse tai chule thutah adihlou lamin kaheijin ahinlah hichu phatchomna bei ahi.
English: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.

tcz: Pathen in lhankhuh a konin eihuhdoh in chule tun kahinkho hi avahdoh tai.
en: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’
text:
JOB 33:28
Thadou: Pathen in lhankhuh a konin eihuhdoh in chule tun kahinkho hi avahdoh tai.
English: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’

tcz: Henge, Pathen in hitobang thil hohi avel vella mihem tedinga abolji ahi.
en: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,
text:
JOB 33:29
Thadou: Henge, Pathen in hitobang thil hohi avel vella mihem tedinga abolji ahi.
English: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,

tcz: Aman amaho chu lhankhuh a konin ahuhdoh in hijeh chun amaho chu hinna khovah a chun kipah tauvinte.
en: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
text:
JOB 33:30
Thadou: Aman amaho chu lhankhuh a konin ahuhdoh in hijeh chun amaho chu hinna khovah a chun kipah tauvinte.
English: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

tcz: Job hiche hi phatechan melchih in, kathusei hi ngaijin. Ijeh inem itile keiman seiding kahaove.
en: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
text:
JOB 33:31
Thadou: Job hiche hi phatechan melchih in, kathusei hi ngaijin. Ijeh inem itile keiman seiding kahaove.
English: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.

tcz: Ahinlah seibe ding nanei nahlaija ahile seiben, seijin, ijeh inem itile keiman nathem channa chu mukal ngahlel a um kahi.
en: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.
text:
JOB 33:32
Thadou: Ahinlah seibe ding nanei nahlaija ahile seiben, seijin, ijeh inem itile keiman nathem channa chu mukal ngahlel a um kahi.
English: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

tcz: Chuti chu ahilouva ahile kathusei ngaijin, thipbeh chan um jingin, keiman chihna thu nahil inge.
en: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
text:
JOB 33:33
Thadou: Chuti chu ahilouva ahile kathusei ngaijin, thipbeh chan um jingin, keiman chihna thu nahil inge.
English: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”

tcz: Hiti chun Elihu in aseijin:
en: Moreover Elihu answered,
text:
JOB 34:1
Thadou: Hiti chun Elihu in aseijin:
English: Moreover Elihu answered,

tcz: Miching hon kathusei hi ngai uvin, chihna themna neihon phatechan hin ngai uvin.
en: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
text:
JOB 34:2
Thadou: Miching hon kathusei hi ngai uvin, chihna themna neihon phatechan hin ngai uvin.
English: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

tcz: Ngaijuvin kam’in antwi leh twilou ahet khen bangin bilkol in jong thucheng ajah jouse hi apatep jin ahi, tin Job in aseije.
en: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
text:
JOB 34:3
Thadou: Ngaijuvin kam’in antwi leh twilou ahet khen bangin bilkol in jong thucheng ajah jouse hi apatep jin ahi, tin Job in aseije.
English: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

tcz: Ipihi adih ham ti eima cheh a din hekhen u hitin, ipi hi thilpha ham ti kihilkhom sohkei uhite.
en: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.
text:
JOB 34:4
Thadou: Ipihi adih ham ti eima cheh a din hekhen u hitin, ipi hi thilpha ham ti kihilkhom sohkei uhite.
English: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

tcz: Hijeh chun Job in jong aseijin keima hi nolna bei kahin ahinlah Pathen in kathusei eilah mang peh tai.
en: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.
text:
JOB 34:5
Thadou: Hijeh chun Job in jong aseijin keima hi nolna bei kahin ahinlah Pathen in kathusei eilah mang peh tai.
English: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.

tcz: Keima nolnabei kahin ahinlah amahon mijou eitiuve. Kachonset lou vang'in kathoh gimna hi jendam thei ahipoi.
en: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’
text:
JOB 34:6
Thadou: Keima nolnabei kahin ahinlah amahon mijou eitiuve. Kachonset lou vang'in kathoh gimna hi jendam thei ahipoi.
English: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’

tcz: Dang goleuva daichat vaina leh nuisatna thoh jing Job tobang mi aum kha dem? Neiseipeh tem uvin.
en: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,
text:
JOB 34:7
Thadou: Dang goleuva daichat vaina leh nuisatna thoh jing Job tobang mi aum kha dem? Neiseipeh tem uvin.
English: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

tcz: Amapan kalhat khompi dingin thilse bolte alhengin aphat ho jouse migiloute toh amang khom e.
en: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?
text:
JOB 34:8
Thadou: Amapan kalhat khompi dingin thilse bolte alhengin aphat ho jouse migiloute toh amang khom e.
English: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

tcz: Ipi dinga Pathen lunghol na a phat jouse namoh manchai ding ham ti chanin amapan aseije.
en: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
text:
JOB 34:9
Thadou: Ipi dinga Pathen lunghol na a phat jouse namoh manchai ding ham ti chanin amapan aseije.
English: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’

tcz: Thilhet khen themna neihon ngaijuvin kathusei hi, Pathen in chonset abolpoi ti mi jousen ahet ahin, hatchungnungpa chun thil dihlou aboltheipoi.
en: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
text:
JOB 34:10
Thadou: Thilhet khen themna neihon ngaijuvin kathusei hi, Pathen in chonset abolpoi ti mi jousen ahet ahin, hatchungnungpa chun thil dihlou aboltheipoi.
English: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

tcz: Aman mihem hi atoh dungjui cheh a lethuhna apeh ji ahin, aman mihemte hi achonna dungjui a alethuh ji ahi.
en: For the work of a man he will render to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
text:
JOB 34:11
Thadou: Aman mihem hi atoh dungjui cheh a lethuhna apeh ji ahin, aman mihemte hi achonna dungjui a alethuh ji ahi.
English: For the work of a man he will render to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

tcz: Tahbeh mongin Pathen in thil dihlou abol louhel ding ahi. Hatchungnung pa chun thudoh chu aheimang lou ding ahi.
en: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
text:
JOB 34:12
Thadou: Tahbeh mongin Pathen in thil dihlou abol louhel ding ahi. Hatchungnung pa chun thudoh chu aheimang lou ding ahi.
English: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

tcz: Mihem khat touvin leiset pumpi hi athu noija akoi khah em? Leiset pumpi hi kitup chetna koipen in akoi ham?
en: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?
text:
JOB 34:13
Thadou: Mihem khat touvin leiset pumpi hi athu noija akoi khah em? Leiset pumpi hi kitup chetna koipen in akoi ham?
English: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?

tcz: Pathen chun alhagao ana kinunglah khat tou hihen chuleh ahaina hu chu akinung lah hitaleh,
en: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,
text:
JOB 34:14
Thadou: Pathen chun alhagao ana kinunglah khat tou hihen chuleh ahaina hu chu akinung lah hitaleh,
English: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

tcz: Hinkho jouse kichai ding ahitan, chule mihingte jouse hi leivui soh kit ding ahitai.
en: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.
text:
JOB 34:15
Thadou: Hinkho jouse kichai ding ahitan, chule mihingte jouse hi leivui soh kit ding ahitai.
English: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

tcz: Tun miching hon kathusei hi ngai uvin, ipi kasei lunglut tah in ngai uvin.
en: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.
text:
JOB 34:16
Thadou: Tun miching hon kathusei hi ngai uvin, ipi kasei lunglut tah in ngai uvin.
English: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

tcz: Thudih deilouva Pathen in vai ahom ding ham? Hatchungnungpa thutan hum o nachan ding ham?
en: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,
text:
JOB 34:17
Thadou: Thudih deilouva Pathen in vai ahom ding ham? Hatchungnungpa thutan hum o nachan ding ham?
English: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,

tcz: Ijeh inem itile aman leng ho jah a nang hi migilou nahin chuleh milen milal pa komah nanghi langnei nahi tin aseije.
en: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?
text:
JOB 34:18
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile aman leng ho jah a nang hi migilou nahin chuleh milen milal pa komah nanghi langnei nahi tin aseije.
English: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?

tcz: Aman mihem chu itobangin oupe jongle iman agelpon chuleh mivaichapa sangin mihausa pachu akhohsah chompoi, aboncha ama khutsem ahi cheh e.
en: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.
text:
JOB 34:19
Thadou: Aman mihem chu itobangin oupe jongle iman agelpon chuleh mivaichapa sangin mihausa pachu akhohsah chompoi, aboncha ama khutsem ahi cheh e.
English: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.

tcz: Mitphet kah louvin athi theijin, jankim lai teng jongle amangthah jiuvin, mithat hatpa jong chu mihem khat pang louvin akisumang jitai.
en: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
text:
JOB 34:20
Thadou: Mitphet kah louvin athi theijin, jankim lai teng jongle amangthah jiuvin, mithat hatpa jong chu mihem khat pang louvin akisumang jitai.
English: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen in mihem tehi iti hin ham ti ave jingin, athilbolu amusoh keije.
en: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.
text:
JOB 34:21
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile Pathen in mihem tehi iti hin ham ti ave jingin, athilbolu amusoh keije.
English: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

tcz: Migiloupa kiselna ding chun muthim jong ama mitmun kiselna din alhing joupoi.
en: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
text:
JOB 34:22
Thadou: Migiloupa kiselna ding chun muthim jong ama mitmun kiselna din alhing joupoi.
English: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

tcz: Pathen thutanna'a itih le idin diu ham ti eihon, gonsan ikoi pouve.
en: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.
text:
JOB 34:23
Thadou: Pathen thutanna'a itih le idin diu ham ti eihon, gonsan ikoi pouve.
English: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.

tcz: Aman mihat pachu koimacha dong louhel in asumang jin, chule ama munna chu adang khat atung doh ji'e.
en: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.
text:
JOB 34:24
Thadou: Aman mihat pachu koimacha dong louhel in asumang jin, chule ama munna chu adang khat atung doh ji'e.
English: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

tcz: Aman ipi abol'u ahet ahin, chuleh jan tengle alehkhup in chuleh asumang jitai.
en: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
text:
JOB 34:25
Thadou: Aman ipi abol'u ahet ahin, chuleh jan tengle alehkhup in chuleh asumang jitai.
English: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

tcz: Aman agitlou jeh uvin ajeplhu jin mijouse mu thei dingle ima jousen amu theidin abol ji'e.
en: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

tcz: Ijeh inem itile, ama nung ajui nauva konin akihei mangun alampi jeng jong donlouvin akoi tauve.
en: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,
text:
JOB 34:27
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile, ama nung ajui nauva konin akihei mangun alampi jeng jong donlouvin akoi tauve.
English: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,

tcz: Amahon mivaichate chu aka sah un, akanau chu Pathen koma alhunge. Pathen in mi gentheite kana ho ajahpeh jin ahi.
en: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.
text:
JOB 34:28
Thadou: Amahon mivaichate chu aka sah un, akanau chu Pathen koma alhunge. Pathen in mi gentheite kana ho ajahpeh jin ahi.
English: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

tcz: Ahinlah ama chun thipbeh a um ding chu lheng jo tahen lang hileh kon amachu themmo achan thei ding ham? Aman amai aselmang teng mikhat ham ahiloule namkhat hijeng jongle koiman aholdoh joupoi.
en: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,
text:
JOB 34:29
Thadou: Ahinlah ama chun thipbeh a um ding chu lheng jo tahen lang hileh kon amachu themmo achan thei ding ham? Aman amai aselmang teng mikhat ham ahiloule namkhat hijeng jongle koiman aholdoh joupoi.
English: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,

tcz: Mihemte thanga a o louna diuvin aman Pathen neiloute vaihomin apansah jipoi.
en: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.
text:
JOB 34:30
Thadou: Mihemte thanga a o louna diuvin aman Pathen neiloute vaihomin apansah jipoi.
English: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

tcz: Kachonse tai, ahin chonset bolkit taponge tia mihem ten ipi dinga Pathen koma aseikit jilou u ham?
en: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.
text:
JOB 34:31
Thadou: Kachonse tai, ahin chonset bolkit taponge tia mihem ten ipi dinga Pathen koma aseikit jilou u ham?
English: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

tcz: Ahiloule ipi thilse kabol kahekha poi neisei peh in thilse kabol aum khah leh tutah hin ngai jeng inge.
en: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
text:
JOB 34:32
Thadou: Ahiloule ipi thilse kabol kahekha poi neisei peh in thilse kabol aum khah leh tutah hin ngai jeng inge.
English: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

tcz: Nathum najeh a chu Pathen in athudih nachu asemphat ding ham? Ijeh inem itile nangin ama chu napaidoh sa ahin, akilhen ding chu nang nahin, kei kahipoi, sei jomin lang nachihna chu keiho komma phong doh in.
en: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.
text:
JOB 34:33
Thadou: Nathum najeh a chu Pathen in athudih nachu asemphat ding ham? Ijeh inem itile nangin ama chu napaidoh sa ahin, akilhen ding chu nang nahin, kei kahipoi, sei jomin lang nachihna chu keiho komma phong doh in.
English: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

tcz: Hicheng jou nungin milungval hon eiseipeh untin chuleh miching hon kathusei ngai uvinte.
en: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:
text:
JOB 34:34
Thadou: Hicheng jou nungin milungval hon eiseipeh untin chuleh miching hon kathusei ngai uvinte.
English: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

tcz: Job in hetoh louva asei ahin, athucheng ho chu agilpoi.
en: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’
text:
JOB 34:35
Thadou: Job in hetoh louva asei ahin, athucheng ho chu agilpoi.
English: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’

tcz: Job migilou thuseija nathusei jeh a akhonna leh nachung thu kitan ding nakikhol khom ahi.
en: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.
text:
JOB 34:36
Thadou: Job migilou thuseija nathusei jeh a akhonna leh nachung thu kitan ding nakikhol khom ahi.
English: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile nangin nachonset na chunga doumah nabol ben, nangin Pathen dounan lunghanna thu nasei lelen, jabolna nanei tapoi.
en: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”
text:
JOB 34:37
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile nangin nachonset na chunga doumah nabol ben, nangin Pathen dounan lunghanna thu nasei lelen, jabolna nanei tapoi.
English: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”

tcz: Hichun Elihun aseijin:
en: Moreover Elihu answered,
text:
JOB 35:1
Thadou: Hichun Elihun aseijin:
English: Moreover Elihu answered,

tcz: Pathen masanga keima hi chonpha kahi tia sei ding hi dih nakisah ham?
en: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’
text:
JOB 35:2
Thadou: Pathen masanga keima hi chonpha kahi tia sei ding hi dih nakisah ham?
English: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

tcz: Ijeh inem itile, chonphatna a hinkho aman hi ipi phatchomna kaneijem? Keija dinga phachom ipi um'em? tinjong nasei ji'e.
en: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’
text:
JOB 35:3
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile, chonphatna a hinkho aman hi ipi phatchomna kaneijem? Keija dinga phachom ipi um'em? tinjong nasei ji'e.
English: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’

tcz: Ken nadonbut ing ting chuleh naloi nagolho jousen jong na donbut uhen.
en: I will answer you, and your companions with you.
text:
JOB 35:4
Thadou: Ken nadonbut ing ting chuleh naloi nagolho jousen jong na donbut uhen.
English: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

tcz: Van thamjol khu ven lang, chule nachung langa meilhang ho khu ven.
en: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.
text:
JOB 35:5
Thadou: Van thamjol khu ven lang, chule nachung langa meilhang ho khu ven.
English: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.

tcz: Chonset bol ta le chun Pathen ichan geijin asuna dem? Avel vel in chonse ta le chun ama lungthim ichan gei asukha dem?
en: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?
text:
JOB 35:6
Thadou: Chonset bol ta le chun Pathen ichan geijin asuna dem? Avel vel in chonse ta le chun ama lungthim ichan gei asukha dem?
English: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

tcz: Chonphat bol hile chun ama a dinga thilpeh loupi khat ahidem? Ama chu ipi nape tadem?
en: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
text:
JOB 35:7
Thadou: Chonphat bol hile chun ama a dinga thilpeh loupi khat ahidem? Ama chu ipi nape tadem?
English: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

tcz: Ahipoi nang chonset chun nangma tobang mihem ho chun adoulel ahin, chule nathilpha bol jong chun mihem mama aphatchom pi sah ahi.
en: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.
text:
JOB 35:8
Thadou: Ahipoi nang chonset chun nangma tobang mihem ho chun adoulel ahin, chule nathilpha bol jong chun mihem mama aphatchom pi sah ahi.
English: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

tcz: Mihem techu bol gentheija aum teng ule apeng jah jeng jiuvin, mithahat thaneina noija chun apeng peng jiuve.
en: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.
text:
JOB 35:9
Thadou: Mihem techu bol gentheija aum teng ule apeng jah jeng jiuvin, mithahat thaneina noija chun apeng peng jiuve.
English: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

tcz: Jan laileh la a hin saji pa eisempau Pathen chun hoiya umham ti jeng jong nadong kha pouve.
en: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
text:
JOB 35:10
Thadou: Jan laileh la a hin saji pa eisempau Pathen chun hoiya umham ti jeng jong nadong kha pouve.
English: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

tcz: Ganchate sanga hoijo a eisem pau leh chunga leng vachate sanga chingjo a eisem pau chu hoiya umham?
en: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’
text:
JOB 35:11
Thadou: Ganchate sanga hoijo a eisem pau leh chunga leng vachate sanga chingjo a eisem pau chu hoiya umham?
English: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

tcz: Chule mihemte chu akiletsah jeh uvin aka teng uleh Pathen in adonbut jipoi.
en: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.
text:
JOB 35:12
Thadou: Chule mihemte chu akiletsah jeh uvin aka teng uleh Pathen in adonbut jipoi.
English: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen in ajah peh pouvin hatchungnung pa chun ngaisah in aneipoi tia seiding chu dihlou ahi.
en: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.
text:
JOB 35:13
Thadou: Ahinlah Pathen in ajah peh pouvin hatchungnung pa chun ngaisah in aneipoi tia seiding chu dihlou ahi.
English: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.

tcz: Nangin kamu theipoi tin naseije, ahinlah nanga hat le bou thudih chu hungdoh ding ahi.
en: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!
text:
JOB 35:14
Thadou: Nangin kamu theipoi tin naseije, ahinlah nanga hat le bou thudih chu hungdoh ding ahi.
English: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

tcz: Nangin michonse ho chu lunghang in alethuhpoi natin chule migiloute ngaisah in aneipoi tin naseije.
en: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,
text:
JOB 35:15
Thadou: Nangin michonse ho chu lunghang in alethuhpoi natin chule migiloute ngaisah in aneipoi tin naseije.
English: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,

tcz: Ahinlah Job nangin thu homkeu jeng naseiyin, mingol khat bangin thu naseije.
en: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
text:
JOB 35:16
Thadou: Ahinlah Job nangin thu homkeu jeng naseiyin, mingol khat bangin thu naseije.
English: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”

tcz: Elihu in athusei ajom nalaijin:
en: Elihu also continued, and said,
text:
JOB 36:1
Thadou: Elihu in athusei ajom nalaijin:
English: Elihu also continued, and said,

tcz: Thutah muchet sah ding kanei nahlai jeh in seibe kit nalai inge, ijeh inem itile Pathen thalhenga seiding kanei nalaije.
en: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
text:
JOB 36:2
Thadou: Thutah muchet sah ding kanei nahlai jeh in seibe kit nalai inge, ijeh inem itile Pathen thalhenga seiding kanei nalaije.
English: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

tcz: Keiman eisempa chonphatna thu giltah a nelna kapeh ding ahi.
en: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
text:
JOB 36:3
Thadou: Keiman eisempa chonphatna thu giltah a nelna kapeh ding ahi.
English: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

tcz: Keima hetna bukim nei kahi jeh in thutah tailou thudang imacha keiman kaseipoi.
en: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
text:
JOB 36:4
Thadou: Keima hetna bukim nei kahi jeh in thutah tailou thudang imacha keiman kaseipoi.
English: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

tcz: Pathen chu hatchungnung pa ahin, ahinlah aman koima isah louvin abolpoi. Ama chu thanei naleh thil hetkhen themna akopto a hatchungnung pa ahi.
en: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
text:
JOB 36:5
Thadou: Pathen chu hatchungnung pa ahin, ahinlah aman koima isah louvin abolpoi. Ama chu thanei naleh thil hetkhen themna akopto a hatchungnung pa ahi.
English: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

tcz: Aman migilou ahinghoi jipon, ahinlah suhgentheija umho chu them achan ji'e.
en: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.
text:
JOB 36:6
Thadou: Aman migilou ahinghoi jipon, ahinlah suhgentheija umho chu them achan ji'e.
English: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.

tcz: Aman nolna bei miho a konin amit ahei mang ngaipoi, ahinlah laltouna a leng ho toh atoukhom sah jin chuleh aimatih channa din achoisang ji'e.
en: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
text:
JOB 36:7
Thadou: Aman nolna bei miho a konin amit ahei mang ngaipoi, ahinlah laltouna a leng ho toh atoukhom sah jin chuleh aimatih channa din achoisang ji'e.
English: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

tcz: Thihkol a ana kihen hihen lang chuleh gentheina a chu kha ana hijong leu,
en: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
text:
JOB 36:8
Thadou: Thihkol a ana kihen hihen lang chuleh gentheina a chu kha ana hijong leu,
English: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

tcz: Aman akiletsah nau amuchet sah jin, chuleh achonset nau avetsah ji'e.
en: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
text:
JOB 36:9
Thadou: Aman akiletsah nau amuchet sah jin, chuleh achonset nau avetsah ji'e.
English: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

tcz: Alungthim u alahmang peh in, chule thilse a konna akilehei nadiu thupeh apejin ahi.
en: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
text:
JOB 36:10
Thadou: Alungthim u alahmang peh in, chule thilse a konna akilehei nadiu thupeh apejin ahi.
English: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

tcz: Amahon thu ngaiju hen, chuleh athusei ngaipeh ule ahinkho lhum kei uva khantouna jousea phatthei kiboh diu ahi.
en: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
text:
JOB 36:11
Thadou: Amahon thu ngaiju hen, chuleh athusei ngaipeh ule ahinkho lhum kei uva khantouna jousea phatthei kiboh diu ahi.
English: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

tcz: Ahinlah athusei ngai ding anoplou uleh amaho chemjam a kithat ding ahin, chuleh hetna lhahsam jeh a thidiu ahi.
en: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.
text:
JOB 36:12
Thadou: Ahinlah athusei ngai ding anoplou uleh amaho chemjam a kithat ding ahin, chuleh hetna lhahsam jeh a thidiu ahi.
English: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pathen neiloute chu lunghan nan adimset un, aman a engbol teng u jongle nei kithopiuvin tia kou ding chu anom ji pouve.
en: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.
text:
JOB 36:13
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile Pathen neiloute chu lunghan nan adimset un, aman a engbol teng u jongle nei kithopiuvin tia kou ding chu anom ji pouve.
English: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

tcz: Ahinkhou chonchatvai na a aman jou nung uleh khangdong cha chan athijiuvin ahi.
en: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.
text:
JOB 36:14
Thadou: Ahinkhou chonchatvai na a aman jou nung uleh khangdong cha chan athijiuvin ahi.
English: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

tcz: Ahinlah agenthei thoh jeh u chun aman ahuhdoh jiuvin ahi. Ijeh inem itile agenthei nauva kon thungaije ahiljin ahi.
en: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
text:
JOB 36:15
Thadou: Ahinlah agenthei thoh jeh u chun aman ahuhdoh jiuvin ahi. Ijeh inem itile agenthei nauva kon thungaije ahiljin ahi.
English: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

tcz: Job Pathen in vangsetna ho a konin napui doh in lungnat naho a konin ongthol tah in nahoijin, nadokhang chungah anpha pha nalui doh peh e.
en: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.
text:
JOB 36:16
Thadou: Job Pathen in vangsetna ho a konin napui doh in lungnat naho a konin ongthol tah in nahoijin, nadokhang chungah anpha pha nalui doh peh e.
English: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

tcz: Ahinlah nangin Pathen neiloute thu kitan ding kichat nan nadim in, lungkham hih in thutanna leh thudih'a thutanna chu machal jing ding ahi.
en: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.
text:
JOB 36:17
Thadou: Ahinlah nangin Pathen neiloute thu kitan ding kichat nan nadim in, lungkham hih in thutanna leh thudih'a thutanna chu machal jing ding ahi.
English: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

tcz: Ahin kivephan, achuti louleh nei le gou vin nalhem lha khantin nehguh kilah jeh in nang leh nang chonse hih in.
en: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
text:
JOB 36:18
Thadou: Ahin kivephan, achuti louleh nei le gou vin nalhem lha khantin nehguh kilah jeh in nang leh nang chonse hih in.
English: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

tcz: Nanei leh nagou ahiloule thahattah'a nakihabol naho chun lung gentheina jouse a konna nahoidoh jou ding hinam?
en: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?
text:
JOB 36:19
Thadou: Nanei leh nagou ahiloule thahattah'a nakihabol naho chun lung gentheina jouse a konna nahoidoh jou ding hinam?
English: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

tcz: Jan hunglhun kal ngahlel hih in, ijeh inem itile hichu mihem te kisuhmang nading jan ahibouve.
en: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.
text:
JOB 36:20
Thadou: Jan hunglhun kal ngahlel hih in, ijeh inem itile hichu mihem te kisuhmang nading jan ahibouve.
English: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

tcz: Kiging phan thilse a konin kileheijin, chonsetna hinkho a konna nahoidoh nadinga Pathen in hiche gentheina hohi ahin lhunsah ahi.
en: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
text:
JOB 36:21
Thadou: Kiging phan thilse a konin kileheijin, chonsetna hinkho a konna nahoidoh nadinga Pathen in hiche gentheina hohi ahin lhunsah ahi.
English: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

tcz: Ven Pathen hi thahat chungnung ahin ama tobang mihil thei ding koi um'em?
en: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
text:
JOB 36:22
Thadou: Ven Pathen hi thahat chungnung ahin ama tobang mihil thei ding koi um'em?
English: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

tcz: Koima chan hichehi nabol ding ahi atitheipon, ahilouleh nabolkhel tai tia seithei ding chu,
en: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?
text:
JOB 36:23
Thadou: Koima chan hichehi nabol ding ahi atitheipon, ahilouleh nabolkhel tai tia seithei ding chu,
English: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

tcz: Hiche ho khel chun athil bolthei thahatna chu achoian un, vahchoina la ho asauve.
en: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.
text:
JOB 36:24
Thadou: Hiche ho khel chun athil bolthei thahatna chu achoian un, vahchoina la ho asauve.
English: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.

tcz: Gamla tah ahijeng vang'in hiche ho chu mijousen amucheh uve.
en: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
text:
JOB 36:25
Thadou: Gamla tah ahijeng vang'in hiche ho chu mijousen amucheh uve.
English: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.

tcz: Ven Pathen hi eihon ihet sang uvin aloupi jon amakum ho chu sim jou hilou ahi.
en: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
text:
JOB 36:26
Thadou: Ven Pathen hi eihon ihet sang uvin aloupi jon amakum ho chu sim jou hilou ahi.
English: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

tcz: Aman twi chu ahu in achop touvin chuleh chuti chun alhitheng in go asosah kit e.
en: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
text:
JOB 36:27
Thadou: Aman twi chu ahu in achop touvin chuleh chuti chun alhitheng in go asosah kit e.
English: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

tcz: Meilah a konin go ahin sung lhan, chuleh mi jousen aphatchom pi ji'e.
en: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
text:
JOB 36:28
Thadou: Meilah a konin go ahin sung lhan, chuleh mi jousen aphatchom pi ji'e.
English: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

tcz: Meilom hung kijel ji khu kon ahet theija chule vanna vanging kithong jeju a akitol lele khu kon ahetdoh jou ding ham?
en: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?
text:
JOB 36:29
Thadou: Meilom hung kijel ji khu kon ahet theija chule vanna vanging kithong jeju a akitol lele khu kon ahetdoh jou ding ham?
English: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?

tcz: Ven ama kimvel a kolphe khu iti avahsah ji a, chule twikhanglen to geija avahsah khu iti ham?
en: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
text:
JOB 36:30
Thadou: Ven ama kimvel a kolphe khu iti avahsah ji a, chule twikhanglen to geija avahsah khu iti ham?
English: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.

tcz: Hiche athahat athil boltheina ho a hi mihem te avah khang ji a nehle chah neng jeng junga apeh ji ahi.
en: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.
text:
JOB 36:31
Thadou: Hiche athahat athil boltheina ho a hi mihem te avah khang ji a nehle chah neng jeng junga apeh ji ahi.
English: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

tcz: Aman akhut in keh chang aki choijin chuleh adoina laitah a chudin aseplha jin ahi.
en: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
text:
JOB 36:32
Thadou: Aman akhut in keh chang aki choijin chuleh adoina laitah a chudin aseplha jin ahi.
English: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

tcz: Hiche van gin chun ahina aphondoh a huipi gopi chun alunghan alungsatna chu aphondoh ahi.
en: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.
text:
JOB 36:33
Thadou: Hiche van gin chun ahina aphondoh a huipi gopi chun alunghan alungsatna chu aphondoh ahi.
English: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.

tcz: Hicheng hohi kagel ji teng ka lungchang aphudot dot jeng jin, kasung a hin akithing thing jin ahi.
en: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.
text:
JOB 37:1
Thadou: Hicheng hohi kagel ji teng ka lungchang aphudot dot jeng jin, kasung a hin akithing thing jin ahi.
English: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

tcz: Pathen kamsung'a konna hung doh a ogin thong khu phaten ngai uvin.
en: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.
text:
JOB 37:2
Thadou: Pathen kamsung'a konna hung doh a ogin thong khu phaten ngai uvin.
English: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

tcz: Van dung lhungin agin akitol in chuleh kolphe vah'in ningtin asalvah phan ahi.
en: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.
text:
JOB 37:3
Thadou: Van dung lhungin agin akitol in chuleh kolphe vah'in ningtin asalvah phan ahi.
English: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

tcz: Chuti chun huipi gopi kitum gin in alal loupina ogin nasatah in ahung in thu asei teng jongle akituh tang deh poi.
en: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.
text:
JOB 37:4
Thadou: Chuti chun huipi gopi kitum gin in alal loupina ogin nasatah in ahung in thu asei teng jongle akituh tang deh poi.
English: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

tcz: Pathen Ogin chu van gin in aloupisah in athahat aloupina chu eigel phah hoi ahipoi.
en: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.
text:
JOB 37:5
Thadou: Pathen Ogin chu van gin in aloupisah in athahat aloupina chu eigel phah hoi ahipoi.
English: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

tcz: Aman buhbang leisetna longlha din thu apejin, go jong leiset chunga longlha din thu apeji e.
en: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.
text:
JOB 37:6
Thadou: Aman buhbang leisetna longlha din thu apejin, go jong leiset chunga longlha din thu apeji e.
English: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

tcz: Chuteng leh mijousen anatoh u angan hiti chun athaneina chu ave jiuve.
en: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.
text:
JOB 37:7
Thadou: Chuteng leh mijousen anatoh u angan hiti chun athaneina chu ave jiuve.
English: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

tcz: Gam'a gamsa ho akikhu khum un chuleh akosung uvah aum den ji tauve.
en: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.
text:
JOB 37:8
Thadou: Gam'a gamsa ho akikhu khum un chuleh akosung uvah aum den ji tauve.
English: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

tcz: A indan sunga kon in huipi gopi ahungin chuleh hiche a kon chun huidap ahung nunge.
en: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.
text:
JOB 37:9
Thadou: A indan sunga kon in huipi gopi ahungin chuleh hiche a kon chun huidap ahung nunge.
English: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

tcz: Pathen hu haikhum chun buhbang lhang asosah in chuin twi chu atebep bep chun akan den sah jin ahi.
en: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.
text:
JOB 37:10
Thadou: Pathen hu haikhum chun buhbang lhang asosah in chuin twi chu atebep bep chun akan den sah jin ahi.
English: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

tcz: Meiho chu twi akhumdim jin chule kolphen avahsah ji'e.
en: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
text:
JOB 37:11
Thadou: Meiho chu twi akhumdim jin chule kolphen avahsah ji'e.
English: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

tcz: Ama thusah a meilhang hohi kitol leleuva, leiset chunga hi aman thu apeh jouse aboljiu ahi.
en: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,
text:
JOB 37:12
Thadou: Ama thusah a meilhang hohi kitol leleuva, leiset chunga hi aman thu apeh jouse aboljiu ahi.
English: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

tcz: Hicheng ho jouse hi mihem engbolna ham ahiloule tang theilou ngailutna vetsahna a abolji ahi.
en: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.
text:
JOB 37:13
Thadou: Hicheng ho jouse hi mihem engbolna ham ahiloule tang theilou ngailutna vetsahna a abolji ahi.
English: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

tcz: Job hiche hi phaten ngaijin, Pathen natoh thilbol kidang tah tah ho ngaito din khongaijin.
en: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
text:
JOB 37:14
Thadou: Job hiche hi phaten ngaijin, Pathen natoh thilbol kidang tah tah ho ngaito din khongaijin.
English: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

tcz: Itobang tah a Pathen in huipi gopi athua anunsah a chule meilah a konna kolphe ahung vahdoh sah ji hi nahet em?
en: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
text:
JOB 37:15
Thadou: Itobang tah a Pathen in huipi gopi athua anunsah a chule meilah a konna kolphe ahung vahdoh sah ji hi nahet em?
English: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

tcz: Akhut themna leh akidanna chamkim keija meilhang ho atolle le ji hi iti dan ham ti nahet doh jou ding ham?
en: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
text:
JOB 37:16
Thadou: Akhut themna leh akidanna chamkim keija meilhang ho atolle le ji hi iti dan ham ti nahet doh jou ding ham?
English: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

tcz: Nangin na-ul naponna nakitheh tengle lhanglam hui hung nung intin chule thil ijakai thipchet in aum jitai.
en: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?
text:
JOB 37:17
Thadou: Nangin na-ul naponna nakitheh tengle lhanglam hui hung nung intin chule thil ijakai thipchet in aum jitai.
English: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

tcz: Sum-eng phatvet bangin van thamjolla konin asa chu akikhodoh sah jin ahi, hichu nangin nabol the idem?
en: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?
text:
JOB 37:18
Thadou: Sum-eng phatvet bangin van thamjolla konin asa chu akikhodoh sah jin ahi, hichu nangin nabol the idem?
English: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

tcz: Hijeh chun Pathen komma ipi kasei diu ham? Keihon imacha hetna kanei pouve.
en: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.
text:
JOB 37:19
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pathen komma ipi kasei diu ham? Keihon imacha hetna kanei pouve.
English: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

tcz: Pathen in akomma thu kasei nom hi eihet peh dem? Mihem te jengin jong thil ahetkhen theilou teng ule thu akisei thei diu ham?
en: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?
text:
JOB 37:20
Thadou: Pathen in akomma thu kasei nom hi eihet peh dem? Mihem te jengin jong thil ahetkhen theilou teng ule thu akisei thei diu ham?
English: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

tcz: Huijin meibolho amut theng soh tengleh vantham jol'a nisa khu avah behseh jeh in eihon ive thei ji pouve.
en: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.
text:
JOB 37:21
Thadou: Huijin meibolho amut theng soh tengleh vantham jol'a nisa khu avah behseh jeh in eihon ive thei ji pouve.
English: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

tcz: Pathen hi molsang a konna sana lal loupina a kijemma hung'ah ahin ama chu alal loupina leh ahoina jousea kijemma ahi.
en: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.
text:
JOB 37:22
Thadou: Pathen hi molsang a konna sana lal loupina a kijemma hung'ah ahin ama chu alal loupina leh ahoina jousea kijemma ahi.
English: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

tcz: Hatchungnungpa thahat naho chu ei ngaito phah hoi hilou ahi. Ahijeng vang'in athudih in chuleh achonpha jinge. Aman eiho eisumang pouve.
en: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
text:
JOB 37:23
Thadou: Hatchungnungpa thahat naho chu ei ngaito phah hoi hilou ahi. Ahijeng vang'in athudih in chuleh achonpha jinge. Aman eiho eisumang pouve.
English: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

tcz: Datmo umtah in muntinna mihem ten ama aging uvin, miching ho jouse ajanau avetsah uve.
en: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
text:
JOB 37:24
Thadou: Datmo umtah in muntinna mihem ten ama aging uvin, miching ho jouse ajanau avetsah uve.
English: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”

tcz: Chuti chun chimpei kipei lah a konin Pakaiyin Job chu ahin donbut tai:
en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind,
text:
JOB 38:1
Thadou: Chuti chun chimpei kipei lah a konin Pakaiyin Job chu ahin donbut tai:
English: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind,

tcz: Koi hiya hitobang hetna neilou chu chenga kachihna thu hin donga chu?
en: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
text:
JOB 38:2
Thadou: Koi hiya hitobang hetna neilou chu chenga kachihna thu hin donga chu?
English: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

tcz: Pasal pha bangin nakong kigah in, ijeh inem itile keiman nangma thu kadoh ding nangin hiche ho chu nei donbut ding ahi.
en: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
text:
JOB 38:3
Thadou: Pasal pha bangin nakong kigah in, ijeh inem itile keiman nangma thu kadoh ding nangin hiche ho chu nei donbut ding ahi.
English: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

tcz: Leiset bul kaphu a chu hoiya nana um'em? Nahet leh nei seipeh in.
en: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
text:
JOB 38:4
Thadou: Leiset bul kaphu a chu hoiya nana um'em? Nahet leh nei seipeh in.
English: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

tcz: Kon alet aneu dan aga te a chuleh ageigol hohi akaitoh ham?
en: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?
text:
JOB 38:5
Thadou: Kon alet aneu dan aga te a chuleh ageigol hohi akaitoh ham?
English: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?

tcz: Abul hi ipin atheh ham? Aninga songpi chu koi koiham?
en: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,
text:
JOB 38:6
Thadou: Abul hi ipin atheh ham? Aninga songpi chu koi koiham?
English: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,

tcz: Jingvalpa ten la asahkhom uva chuleh vantil jouse kipah a hung pengdoh diu ham?
en: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
text:
JOB 38:7
Thadou: Jingvalpa ten la asahkhom uva chuleh vantil jouse kipah a hung pengdoh diu ham?
English: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

tcz: Naobu sunga hung pengdoh banga twipihi gamgi chin kah khat sunga kon akoija?
en: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
text:
JOB 38:8
Thadou: Naobu sunga hung pengdoh banga twipihi gamgi chin kah khat sunga kon akoija?
English: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,

tcz: Chuleh meibol ponsilla kakisil a chuleh muthim lhangkhal a kakitoma,
en: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,
text:
JOB 38:9
Thadou: Chuleh meibol ponsilla kakisil a chuleh muthim lhangkhal a kakitoma,
English: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,

tcz: Ajeh chu vapam kasem peh a, anunga kotpi akhel louna dinga kakam khum ahi.
en: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
text:
JOB 38:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu vapam kasem peh a, anunga kotpi akhel louna dinga kakam khum ahi.
English: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

tcz: Hichan a gamla chule hisanga gamlajo a nahung louna dinga hiche mun a hi kiloupi sah tah a nakinon nangah ding ahi tin kaseije.
en: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?
text:
JOB 38:11
Thadou: Hichan a gamla chule hisanga gamlajo a nahung louna dinga hiche mun a hi kiloupi sah tah a nakinon nangah ding ahi tin kaseije.
English: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?

tcz: Jingkah khovah nadinga thu napeh khah a khovah jong solama konna hung kipan dinga nahil khah em?
en: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
text:
JOB 38:12
Thadou: Jingkah khovah nadinga thu napeh khah a khovah jong solama konna hung kipan dinga nahil khah em?
English: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,

tcz: Khovah hin leiset kolmang geija asalvah nadinga nasema, gitlouna jan muthim changei bou vah dinga nasem khah em?
en: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
text:
JOB 38:13
Thadou: Khovah hin leiset kolmang geija asalvah nadinga nasema, gitlouna jan muthim changei bou vah dinga nasem khah em?
English: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

tcz: Khovah ahung nai tengle leingan chunga mahor kinam bangin leiset jong agong ahung kilang doh jitai.
en: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.
text:
JOB 38:14
Thadou: Khovah ahung nai tengle leingan chunga mahor kinam bangin leiset jong agong ahung kilang doh jitai.
English: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.

tcz: Khovah hin migiloute asunoh phah in chuleh kihat sah tah a kidom sang ban lhang jong asuhai tai.
en: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
text:
JOB 38:15
Thadou: Khovah hin migiloute asunoh phah in chuleh kihat sah tah a kidom sang ban lhang jong asuhai tai.
English: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.

tcz: Twipi hung lon doh patna twinah phung nagahol doh khah a hem? athuh dan nakhol doh khah hitam?
en: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?
text:
JOB 38:16
Thadou: Twipi hung lon doh patna twinah phung nagahol doh khah a hem? athuh dan nakhol doh khah hitam?
English: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

tcz: Thina kelkot hoiya um'em ti nahet khah ta hem? Muthim lhangkhal kihehna kelkot namu khah ta hem?
en: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
text:
JOB 38:17
Thadou: Thina kelkot hoiya um'em ti nahet khah ta hem? Muthim lhangkhal kihehna kelkot namu khah ta hem?
English: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

tcz: Leiset letdan nagel doh khah a hicheng chu nahet leh nei seipeh in.
en: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.
text:
JOB 38:18
Thadou: Leiset letdan nagel doh khah a hicheng chu nahet leh nei seipeh in.
English: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.

tcz: Khovah hoiya konna hung kipan doh ham? Chuleh muthim hoilanga cheji hitam?
en: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,
text:
JOB 38:19
Thadou: Khovah hoiya konna hung kipan doh ham? Chuleh muthim hoilanga cheji hitam?
English: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,

tcz: Khat cheng chenga a in na napuilut theija chuleh amun lhunje chu nahet em?
en: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?
text:
JOB 38:20
Thadou: Khat cheng chenga a in na napuilut theija chuleh amun lhunje chu nahet em?
English: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

tcz: Ahinlah hicheng chu nahet maithei ahi, ijeh inem itile thil ijakai kisem masanga penga nahi tan, hijeh a chu ijakai nahet themsoh ahitai.
en: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
text:
JOB 38:21
Thadou: Ahinlah hicheng chu nahet maithei ahi, ijeh inem itile thil ijakai kisem masanga penga nahi tan, hijeh a chu ijakai nahet themsoh ahitai.
English: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

tcz: Buhbang kikhol khomna mun naga chelut khah ta hem? ahiloule gelchang kikhol khomna mun naga mu khah ta hem?
en: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,
text:
JOB 38:22
Thadou: Buhbang kikhol khomna mun naga chelut khah ta hem? ahiloule gelchang kikhol khomna mun naga mu khah ta hem?
English: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

tcz: Genthei hesoh nikho a gal manchah dinga kakhol ahin, kidou nikho leh kisat nikho a dinga kakhol khom ahi.
en: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
text:
JOB 38:23
Thadou: Genthei hesoh nikho a gal manchah dinga kakhol ahin, kidou nikho leh kisat nikho a dinga kakhol khom ahi.
English: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

tcz: Khovah hung kondohna lampi chu hoilai hija, solam hui chenna chu hoilai ham?
en: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
text:
JOB 38:24
Thadou: Khovah hung kondohna lampi chu hoilai hija, solam hui chenna chu hoilai ham?
English: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?

tcz: Go hattah a hung long jung jung twilam chu kon asemma kolphevahna lampi kon adopeh ham?
en: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,
text:
JOB 38:25
Thadou: Go hattah a hung long jung jung twilam chu kon asemma kolphevahna lampi kon adopeh ham?
English: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,

tcz: Hampa ke louna gamgo lah leh nelgam mihem chenlouna gam'a chu kon go ajuhsah ham?
en: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,
text:
JOB 38:26
Thadou: Hampa ke louna gamgo lah leh nelgam mihem chenlouna gam'a chu kon go ajuhsah ham?
English: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,

tcz: Tolgo lah sunouva dangchim sah dinga go juh sah chu koi hija chule hampa louhing kedohsah a koiham?
en: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
text:
JOB 38:27
Thadou: Tolgo lah sunouva dangchim sah dinga go juh sah chu koi hija chule hampa louhing kedohsah a koiham?
English: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?

tcz: Go in pa aneijem? Daitwi kon ahin pen doh sah ham?
en: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
text:
JOB 38:28
Thadou: Go in pa aneijem? Daitwi kon ahin pen doh sah ham?
English: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?

tcz: Buhbang lhang hingnu chu koiham? Vanna hung kon buhbang twihi kon ahin ham?
en: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?
text:
JOB 38:29
Thadou: Buhbang lhang hingnu chu koiham? Vanna hung kon buhbang twihi kon ahin ham?
English: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?

tcz: Ijeh inem itile twi chu song banga tah in akisoh jin chuleh twi chung chu akan den jin ahi.
en: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.
text:
JOB 38:30
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile twi chu song banga tah in akisoh jin chuleh twi chung chu akan den jin ahi.
English: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

tcz: Ahshi ho kitol ding dan khu nahil theija bombiel akoi ho khu alomma nakan theija, ahiloule juhei suhtum khu akhau nalhap kang thei ngaijem?
en: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?
text:
JOB 38:31
Thadou: Ahshi ho kitol ding dan khu nahil theija bombiel akoi ho khu alomma nakan theija, ahiloule juhei suhtum khu akhau nalhap kang thei ngaijem?
English: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

tcz: Kum kiheichin hohi aban ban cha che dinga nahil theija ahiloule ahsi somleng chu anoute toh van jotpai dinga napuile theijem?
en: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?
text:
JOB 38:32
Thadou: Kum kiheichin hohi aban ban cha che dinga nahil theija ahiloule ahsi somleng chu anoute toh van jotpai dinga napuile theijem?
English: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

tcz: Thilsem jouse chondan hi nahet soh keija, leiset hi dan dungjuija naman chah thei ding ham?
en: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?
text:
JOB 38:33
Thadou: Thilsem jouse chondan hi nahet soh keija, leiset hi dan dungjuija naman chah thei ding ham?
English: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?

tcz: Meibang lom chu nakouva chule go nasosah theijem?
en: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?
text:
JOB 38:34
Thadou: Meibang lom chu nakouva chule go nasosah theijem?
English: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?

tcz: Kolphe chu nakilah sah theija chule naseina mun chu navah sah thei ding ham?
en: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?
text:
JOB 38:35
Thadou: Kolphe chu nakilah sah theija chule naseina mun chu navah sah thei ding ham?
English: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

tcz: Lungchang thil het jeng theina pea chu koi hija chule lungthim angaina a khohetna pe a chu koiham?
en: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?
text:
JOB 38:36
Thadou: Lungchang thil het jeng theina pea chu koi hija chule lungthim angaina a khohetna pe a chu koiham?
