English: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

tcz: Meilhang ho sim jouna dinga chihna lhingsetna neikoi hija, vanna twi kikholna mun loukhoija khoilet jou ding koiham?
en: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,
text:
JOB 38:37
Thadou: Meilhang ho sim jouna dinga chihna lhingsetna neikoi hija, vanna twi kikholna mun loukhoija khoilet jou ding koiham?
English: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,

tcz: Tolla leiset hi akikoi got setna chule leiset chu leilhanga atahsah thei ding ham?
en: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?
text:
JOB 38:38
Thadou: Tolla leiset hi akikoi got setna chule leiset chu leilhanga atahsah thei ding ham?
English: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?

tcz: Keipi dinga neh ding namat khom peh a chule keipi bahkai noute gilkel chu alung nachim a navahva jouva,
en: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
text:
JOB 38:39
Thadou: Keipi dinga neh ding namat khom peh a chule keipi bahkai noute gilkel chu alung nachim a navahva jouva,
English: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

tcz: Akosung uva alupnauva ahiloule nang noija abohmat pet tengule,
en: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?
text:
JOB 38:40
Thadou: Akosung uva alupnauva ahiloule nang noija abohmat pet tengule,
English: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?

tcz: Vavomte khu kon an apeh a anoute khu Pathen jah dinga apenna chule gilkella amoh toilele tenguleh kon an apeh jiu ham?
en: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
text:
JOB 38:41
Thadou: Vavomte khu kon an apeh a anoute khu Pathen jah dinga apenna chule gilkella amoh toilele tenguleh kon an apeh jiu ham?
English: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?

tcz: Gamkel ho khun itih phat le nou anei jiuvem ti nahet em? sajuh ho gam lah a aso u khu namu khah tah em?
en: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?
text:
JOB 39:1
Thadou: Gamkel ho khun itih phat le nou anei jiuvem ti nahet em? sajuh ho gam lah a aso u khu namu khah tah em?
English: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?

tcz: Lha ijat gai uvem ti nahet khah em? itih phat le soh diu ham ti nahet em?
en: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?
text:
JOB 39:2
Thadou: Lha ijat gai uvem ti nahet khah em? itih phat le soh diu ham ti nahet em?
English: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?

tcz: Anou neina dingin tolla aboh mat jiuvin chule ason chu ahing doh jiuve.
en: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.
text:
JOB 39:3
Thadou: Anou neina dingin tolla aboh mat jiuvin chule ason chu ahing doh jiuve.
English: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.

tcz: Anou ho chu tollhanga akivah khang jiuvin chuti chun achennau adalhah teng ahung kinungle ji tapouve.
en: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.
text:
JOB 39:4
Thadou: Anou ho chu tollhanga akivah khang jiuvin chuti chun achennau adalhah teng ahung kinungle ji tapouve.
English: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.

tcz: Gamlah sangan khu kon chamlhatna apeh a chule akihenna khao kon alhap peh ham?
en: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,
text:
JOB 39:5
Thadou: Gamlah sangan khu kon chamlhatna apeh a chule akihenna khao kon alhap peh ham?
English: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,

tcz: Gamthip lah hi amaho umna dinga kapeh ahin achenna diuvin hamhing ke louna gam kepei.
en: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?
text:
JOB 39:6
Thadou: Gamthip lah hi amaho umna dinga kapeh ahin achenna diuvin hamhing ke louna gam kepei.
English: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?

tcz: Khopi sung husa atheinom pon chuleh ahohsal diu kangtalai tol jong aumpoi.
en: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.
text:
JOB 39:7
Thadou: Khopi sung husa atheinom pon chuleh ahohsal diu kangtalai tol jong aumpoi.
English: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.

tcz: Molsang lah chu akivahnau mun ahin, hamhing don thah jouse ahol lelei.
en: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.
text:
JOB 39:8
Thadou: Molsang lah chu akivahnau mun ahin, hamhing don thah jouse ahol lelei.
English: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.

tcz: Gamlah bongchal chu vahngoi din anop peh dem? Nagancha an koina huong sunga chun jan khat beh aum nadem?
en: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?
text:
JOB 39:9
Thadou: Gamlah bongchal chu vahngoi din anop peh dem? Nagancha an koina huong sunga chun jan khat beh aum nadem?
English: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?

tcz: Gam bong chu naloukhoi nalang konna chu nakhum theija nalou nakhoipeh ding hinam?
en: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?
text:
JOB 39:10
Thadou: Gam bong chu naloukhoi nalang konna chu nakhum theija nalou nakhoipeh ding hinam?
English: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?

tcz: Athahat na chu eipente ti natahsan em? nadalhah a chule nana natoh peh ding chu natahsan em?
en: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?
text:
JOB 39:11
Thadou: Athahat na chu eipente ti natahsan em? nadalhah a chule nana natoh peh ding chu natahsan em?
English: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?

tcz: Nachang in langa po dinga nanganse ding ham? Chuleh na changphol a konna chang nahin pohpeh ding hinam?
en: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?
text:
JOB 39:12
Thadou: Nachang in langa po dinga nanganse ding ham? Chuleh na changphol a konna chang nahin pohpeh ding hinam?
English: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?

tcz: Vangongchai jin alha ahin jap jin ahinlah nachakang toh tekah thei ahipoi.
en: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?
text:
JOB 39:13
Thadou: Vangongchai jin alha ahin jap jin ahinlah nachakang toh tekah thei ahipoi.
English: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?

tcz: Vangongchaijin atwi leiset chunga atha jin leivui khun akahlum dinga akoiji ahi.
en: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,
text:
JOB 39:14
Thadou: Vangongchaijin atwi leiset chunga atha jin leivui khun akahlum dinga akoiji ahi.
English: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,

tcz: Thilkhat touvin akengin chonkeh inte ahiloule gamsa khattouvin sumathah inte tijong agelpoi.
en: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.
text:
JOB 39:15
Thadou: Thilkhat touvin akengin chonkeh inte ahiloule gamsa khattouvin sumathah inte tijong agelpoi.
English: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.

tcz: Anoute chunga jong a engse lheh jengin ama a hilou bang bangin athi diu jong khoh asapoi.
en: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,
text:
JOB 39:16
Thadou: Anoute chunga jong a engse lheh jengin ama a hilou bang bangin athi diu jong khoh asapoi.
English: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in ama a konna chihna alahdoh peh a, thil hetkhen theina apehlou ahi.
en: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.
text:
JOB 39:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen in ama a konna chihna alahdoh peh a, thil hetkhen theina apehlou ahi.
English: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.

tcz: Ahinlah itih phat hijongle lhai dinga ahung chopdoh phat phat uleh sakol lhaihat pen pen jong achunga toupa toh adalha tha jitai.
en: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.
text:
JOB 39:18
Thadou: Ahinlah itih phat hijongle lhai dinga ahung chopdoh phat phat uleh sakol lhaihat pen pen jong achunga toupa toh adalha tha jitai.
English: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.

tcz: Sakol thahat khu nangin napeh hija ahiloule angonga amul bahkai khu nangin nakesah ham?
en: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?
text:
JOB 39:19
Thadou: Sakol thahat khu nangin napeh hija ahiloule angonga amul bahkai khu nangin nakesah ham?
English: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?

tcz: Khaokhopi kichop thei banga akichop theina khu nangin napeh ham? Anah khon gin khu tijat jat aum jenge.
en: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.
text:
JOB 39:20
Thadou: Khaokhopi kichop thei banga akichop theina khu nangin napeh ham? Anah khon gin khu tijat jat aum jenge.
English: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.

tcz: Galsat dinga ahung kipatdoh tengle atin in leiset akhot in athahat in akipah jin ahi.
en: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.
text:
JOB 39:21
Thadou: Galsat dinga ahung kipatdoh tengle atin in leiset akhot in athahat in akipah jin ahi.
English: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.

tcz: Chemjam masanga ajam pon, kichat kiti chu anuisat in chuleh kichatna aneipoi.
en: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.
text:
JOB 39:22
Thadou: Chemjam masanga ajam pon, kichat kiti chu anuisat in chuleh kichatna aneipoi.
English: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.

tcz: Thalchang amalam ngan aleng jeng jung in, chuleh tengcha leh tenglung aval lah lah jenge.
en: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.
text:
JOB 39:23
Thadou: Thalchang amalam ngan aleng jeng jung in, chuleh tengcha leh tenglung aval lah lah jenge.
English: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.

tcz: Lunghang tah in akengtin in tol akhot jal lah lah in chule kelngoi ki ahung kimut ging phat in galmun manon alhaikit jitai.
en: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.
text:
JOB 39:24
Thadou: Lunghang tah in akengtin in tol akhot jal lah lah in chule kelngoi ki ahung kimut ging phat in galmun manon alhaikit jitai.
English: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.

tcz: Saki kimut gin chun anah akhongin gamla tah a konin gal gimnam ajan, gal kisat gin thong leh captian pa thupeh ngah in akinuh nuh jenge.
en: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
text:
JOB 39:25
Thadou: Saki kimut gin chun anah akhongin gamla tah a konin gal gimnam ajan, gal kisat gin thong leh captian pa thupeh ngah in akinuh nuh jenge.
English: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

tcz: Mu khu nangin nachihna a nahilla vanlama sangtah'a lengle le a chule alhaving teni khu lhanglam nga ajah ji ham?
en: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?
text:
JOB 39:26
Thadou: Mu khu nangin nachihna a nahilla vanlama sangtah'a lengle le a chule alhaving teni khu lhanglam nga ajah ji ham?
English: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?

tcz: Muvanlai sangtah'a alentouva chunglang peh a buh asah khu nangin nepeh ham?
en: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?
text:
JOB 39:27
Thadou: Muvanlai sangtah'a alentouva chunglang peh a buh asah khu nangin nepeh ham?
English: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?

tcz: Kolsong chunga achengin gamlatah songkuo hoa chenna in akiseme.
en: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.
text:
JOB 39:28
Thadou: Kolsong chunga achengin gamlatah songkuo hoa chenna in akiseme.
English: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.

tcz: Hiche a konhin aneh ding sahing akihol in mitchim keuvin avelhi jingin ahi.
en: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.
text:
JOB 39:29
Thadou: Hiche a konhin aneh ding sahing akihol in mitchim keuvin avelhi jingin ahi.
English: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.

tcz: Anouten thisan achop chop un gancha thikam umna hiche munna chu ama namu ding ahi.
en: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”
text:
JOB 39:30
Thadou: Anouten thisan achop chop un gancha thikam umna hiche munna chu ama namu ding ahi.
English: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin Job komma aseijin:
en: Moreover the LORD answered Job,
text:
JOB 40:1
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin Job komma aseijin:
English: Moreover the LORD answered Job,

tcz: Hatchungnungpa chu nakinelpi nom nah laijam? Pathen thutan dihlouna podohpa nahin, ahileh donbutna ding nanei nahlai em?
en: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
text:
JOB 40:2
Thadou: Hatchungnungpa chu nakinelpi nom nah laijam? Pathen thutan dihlouna podohpa nahin, ahileh donbutna ding nanei nahlai em?
English: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”

tcz: Hichun Job in Pakai chu adonbut in,
en: Then Job answered the LORD,
text:
JOB 40:3
Thadou: Hichun Job in Pakai chu adonbut in,
English: Then Job answered the LORD,

tcz: Keima ima hilou kahi, adonbutna ding chu iti kaholdoh jou ding ham? Kakhut in kamuh kisip ing katin,
en: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
text:
JOB 40:4
Thadou: Keima ima hilou kahi, adonbutna ding chu iti kaholdoh jou ding ham? Kakhut in kamuh kisip ing katin,
English: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.

tcz: Thu tamtah kaseidoh ahitan, seibe ding kanei tapoi.
en: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
text:
JOB 40:5
Thadou: Thu tamtah kaseidoh ahitan, seibe ding kanei tapoi.
English: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

tcz: Hiti chun Pakaiyin chimpei lah a kon in Job ahin donbut in,
en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind:
text:
JOB 40:6
Thadou: Hiti chun Pakaiyin chimpei lah a kon in Job ahin donbut in,
English: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind:

tcz: Pasal phatah bangin nakong kigah in, keiman nangma doh ding thudoh themkhat kaneijin, chuleh nangin hiche ho chu nadonbut ding ahi.
en: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
text:
JOB 40:7
Thadou: Pasal phatah bangin nakong kigah in, keiman nangma doh ding thudoh themkhat kaneijin, chuleh nangin hiche ho chu nadonbut ding ahi.
English: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

tcz: Kathutan dihna hi tahsan louva nakoija, chule nangma dihna photchetna dinga kei themmo neichan joh ding ham?
en: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
text:
JOB 40:8
Thadou: Kathutan dihna hi tahsan louva nakoija, chule nangma dihna photchetna dinga kei themmo neichan joh ding ham?
English: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

tcz: Pathen banga thahat nahin, Pathen ogin banga nangin van nagin sah thei ding ham?
en: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
text:
JOB 40:9
Thadou: Pathen banga thahat nahin, Pathen ogin banga nangin van nagin sah thei ding ham?
English: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?

tcz: Aphai naloupina leh nagun chenan kivon in lang, ja naumna leh aming than nan kivon temin.
en: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
text:
JOB 40:10
Thadou: Aphai naloupina leh nagun chenan kivon in lang, ja naumna leh aming than nan kivon temin.
English: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

tcz: Nalung hanna ngoh ding hol in lang, mikiletsah teho jouse chunga chuhen.
en: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
text:
JOB 40:11
Thadou: Nalung hanna ngoh ding hol in lang, mikiletsah teho jouse chunga chuhen.
English: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

tcz: Mikiletsah techu namit hei chun jachat sah in lang, migiloute chu adin nauva chun chot phan.
en: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
text:
JOB 40:12
Thadou: Mikiletsah techu namit hei chun jachat sah in lang, migiloute chu adin nauva chun chot phan.
English: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

tcz: Leivui lah a chun vui in lang, amaho chu mithigam songkul'a hunk hum den tan.
en: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.
text:
JOB 40:13
Thadou: Leivui lah a chun vui in lang, amaho chu mithigam songkul'a hunk hum den tan.
English: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.

tcz: Chutia chu kei jengin jong kapachat ding nahi, ijeh inem itile nabangol thahat chun nahuhuhdoh ahitai.
en: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
text:
JOB 40:14
Thadou: Chutia chu kei jengin jong kapachat ding nahi, ijeh inem itile nabangol thahat chun nahuhuhdoh ahitai.
English: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

tcz: Behemoth khu vetemin, nang kasem banga kasem ahin, bongchal bangin hampa ane e.
en: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
text:
JOB 40:15
Thadou: Behemoth khu vetemin, nang kasem banga kasem ahin, bongchal bangin hampa ane e.
English: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

tcz: Akengphang athahat nale, a oipoh a aphe ho khu ven.
en: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.
text:
JOB 40:16
Thadou: Akengphang athahat nale, a oipoh a aphe ho khu ven.
English: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

tcz: Amei jong khu Cedar thing bangin atah in, akhel teni a aphe ho khu detchet a kipheh khomahi.
en: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
text:
JOB 40:17
Thadou: Amei jong khu Cedar thing bangin atah in, akhel teni a aphe ho khu detchet a kipheh khomahi.
English: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

tcz: Agu ho jong sum-eng long abangin atibah ho jong thihjol tobang ahi.
en: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.
text:
JOB 40:18
Thadou: Agu ho jong sum-eng long abangin atibah ho jong thihjol tobang ahi.
English: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.

tcz: Pathen khutsem ho lah a vetkah theipen ahin, chuleh asempa bouvin agihsal thei ahi.
en: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
text:
JOB 40:19
Thadou: Pathen khutsem ho lah a vetkah theipen ahin, chuleh asempa bouvin agihsal thei ahi.
English: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

tcz: Gam'a gamsa jouse lhatle namun hiche molsang hohin amaho dinga anneh phapen pen chu apeh nom u ahi.
en: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
text:
JOB 40:20
Thadou: Gam'a gamsa jouse lhatle namun hiche molsang hohin amaho dinga anneh phapen pen chu apeh nom u ahi.
English: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.

tcz: Thambal pahcha phung noija chun akol jin, pengphung boh lah a akisel jin ahi.
en: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.
text:
JOB 40:21
Thadou: Thambal pahcha phung noija chun akol jin, pengphung boh lah a akisel jin ahi.
English: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

tcz: Vadung pang thingnem ho lah a pahcha phungho chu amadin lim in apange.
en: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.
text:
JOB 40:22
Thadou: Vadung pang thingnem ho lah a pahcha phungho chu amadin lim in apange.
English: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.

tcz: Vadung twisoh in ama asunoh phah pon, Jordan vadung soh hen lang chup jongle alungkham deh poi.
en: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.
text:
JOB 40:23
Thadou: Vadung twisoh in ama asunoh phah pon, Jordan vadung soh hen lang chup jongle alungkham deh poi.
English: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

tcz: Koima chan amandoh joupoi, ahiloule anah avu a, thihkol abu peh a chuleh akaimang theilou ahi.
en: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
text:
JOB 40:24
Thadou: Koima chan amandoh joupoi, ahiloule anah avu a, thihkol abu peh a chuleh akaimang theilou ahi.
English: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?

tcz: Ngakoija Leviathan namat thei ding ham? Ahiloule aha a khaokol nabu peh thei ding ham?
en: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?
text:
JOB 41:1
Thadou: Ngakoija Leviathan namat thei ding ham? Ahiloule aha a khaokol nabu peh thei ding ham?
English: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

tcz: Anahhom sunga khao nathil lut theija, ahiloule akhalhang thihhem a nasut vang thei ding ham?
en: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?
text:
JOB 41:2
Thadou: Anahhom sunga khao nathil lut theija, ahiloule akhalhang thihhem a nasut vang thei ding ham?
English: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

tcz: Nakhoto ding ngeh na a, hung taova ahiloule nalainat pi dinga hung tao tuntun nam?
en: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?
text:
JOB 41:3
Thadou: Nakhoto ding ngeh na a, hung taova ahiloule nalainat pi dinga hung tao tuntun nam?
English: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?

tcz: Ahinkho a nasoh a panga nanatong dinga nanop peh ding hinam?
en: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?
text:
JOB 41:4
Thadou: Ahinkho a nasoh a panga nanatong dinga nanop peh ding hinam?
English: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

tcz: Nangin hiche khu vacha banga nangailut bol thei hiya, ahiloule nachapang neunu kichepna dinga napeh thei ding ham?
en: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?
text:
JOB 41:5
Thadou: Nangin hiche khu vacha banga nangailut bol thei hiya, ahiloule nachapang neunu kichepna dinga napeh thei ding ham?
English: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?

tcz: Kivei mihon athiljoh nau mun ho a joh dinga ahung kichoh diu hinam?
en: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?
text:
JOB 41:6
Thadou: Kivei mihon athiljoh nau mun ho a joh dinga ahung kichoh diu hinam?
English: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?

tcz: Avun khu tengcha a nasut khah theija, ahiloule aluchang ngathal a nakap khah thei ding ham?
en: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?
text:
JOB 41:7
Thadou: Avun khu tengcha a nasut khah theija, ahiloule aluchang ngathal a nakap khah thei ding ham?
English: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?

tcz: Achunga nakhut ngam in lang hile chun kidounan ahin jui ding khu geldoh in natin, avel a nabol patep kit lou hel ding ahitai.
en: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.
text:
JOB 41:8
Thadou: Achunga nakhut ngam in lang hile chun kidounan ahin jui ding khu geldoh in natin, avel a nabol patep kit lou hel ding ahitai.
English: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.

tcz: Ahipoi hiche mat ding got chu phatchomna bei ahin, sadel hatpa thiltup jong chu kisuhnem peh ding ahi.
en: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?
text:
JOB 41:9
Thadou: Ahipoi hiche mat ding got chu phatchomna bei ahin, sadel hatpa thiltup jong chu kisuhnem peh ding ahi.
English: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?

tcz: Chuleh a itih a koima chan asuhnoh phah ngamlou ahin, koiham kamasanga ding ngam ding chu.
en: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?
text:
JOB 41:10
Thadou: Chuleh a itih a koima chan asuhnoh phah ngamlou ahin, koiham kamasanga ding ngam ding chu.
English: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?

tcz: Kangaichat pet tah a kalepeh kit ding thil eipe chu koi ham? Vannoija thil umjouse hi keija ahi.
en: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.
text:
JOB 41:11
Thadou: Kangaichat pet tah a kalepeh kit ding thil eipe chu koi ham? Vannoija thil umjouse hi keija ahi.
English: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

tcz: Leviathan tibah ho hoidan chuleh athahat oupe dan chule agongso hoidan ho kasei nomme.
en: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.
text:
JOB 41:12
Thadou: Leviathan tibah ho hoidan chuleh athahat oupe dan chule agongso hoidan ho kasei nomme.
English: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

tcz: Avun khu kon alahdoh peh theija chule athoa um agalvon khu kon amulet pai thei ding ham?
en: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?
text:
JOB 41:13
Thadou: Avun khu kon alahdoh peh theija chule athoa um agalvon khu kon amulet pai thei ding ham?
English: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?

tcz: Akhalhang khu kon akal keh a ahondoh ding ham? Ajeh chu aha khu tijat jat um behseh jeng ahi.
en: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.
text:
JOB 41:14
Thadou: Akhalhang khu kon akal keh a ahondoh ding ham? Ajeh chu aha khu tijat jat um behseh jeng ahi.
English: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

tcz: Alip ho chu pho banga agol gol a detchet a mahor kinam banga thakhat'a kinam detchet ahi.
en: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.
text:
JOB 41:15
Thadou: Alip ho chu pho banga agol gol a detchet a mahor kinam banga thakhat'a kinam detchet ahi.
English: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.

tcz: Kimatchet a umkhom ahijeh chun akah a hui jangkhat cha jong alut theipoi.
en: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
text:
JOB 41:16
Thadou: Kimatchet a umkhom ahijeh chun akah a hui jangkhat cha jong alut theipoi.
English: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

tcz: Alip khat chu aban'a alip chunga hub eh detchet a, khat leh khat kikam toa kimulet pai theilou ahi.
en: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.
text:
JOB 41:17
Thadou: Alip khat chu aban'a alip chunga hub eh detchet a, khat leh khat kikam toa kimulet pai theilou ahi.
English: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

tcz: Anah akhon tengle avahlap lap jengin, amitchang teni jong jingkah nichangsat pet toh abange.
en: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
text:
JOB 41:18
Thadou: Anah akhon tengle avahlap lap jengin, amitchang teni jong jingkah nichangsat pet toh abange.
English: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

tcz: Akamsunga konin meisi apahlah lah jin, meikou ahung vahdoh ji'e.
en: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.
text:
JOB 41:19
Thadou: Akamsunga konin meisi apahlah lah jin, meikou ahung vahdoh ji'e.
English: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.

tcz: Meichunga twibel kisonga, twihu pot bangin anahhomma konin meikhu ahung kitung doh ji'e.
en: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.
text:
JOB 41:20
Thadou: Meichunga twibel kisonga, twihu pot bangin anahhomma konin meikhu ahung kitung doh ji'e.
English: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

tcz: Akamsunga konna meikou alendoh ji jeh chun, ahai husa chun meihol ahal kou jeng jin ahi.
en: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.
text:
JOB 41:21
Thadou: Akamsunga konna meikou alendoh ji jeh chun, ahai husa chun meihol ahal kou jeng jin ahi.
English: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.

tcz: Leviathan ngongchang thahatna chun chene jouse a kichat tijatna asosah e.
en: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.
text:
JOB 41:22
Thadou: Leviathan ngongchang thahatna chun chene jouse a kichat tijatna asosah e.
English: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

tcz: Aphe ho chu atah in chuleh adetchet in, akimulet thei poi.
en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.
text:
JOB 41:23
Thadou: Aphe ho chu atah in chuleh adetchet in, akimulet thei poi.
English: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

tcz: Alungchang chu song bangin atah in sumhei song bangin atah e.
en: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.
text:
JOB 41:24
Thadou: Alungchang chu song bangin atah in sumhei song bangin atah e.
English: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

tcz: Ahung kithodoh tengle thahat chungnung ho akicha jiuvin, kichat tijatnan amanchah kheh jin ahi.
en: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.
text:
JOB 41:25
Thadou: Ahung kithodoh tengle thahat chungnung ho akicha jiuvin, kichat tijatnan amanchah kheh jin ahi.
English: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

tcz: Chemjam, tengcha, thalchang ahiloule tengcha neoho khat chan asutang joupoi.
en: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.
text:
JOB 41:26
Thadou: Chemjam, tengcha, thalchang ahiloule tengcha neoho khat chan asutang joupoi.
English: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

tcz: Chutah chun Job in Pakai chu adonbut tai.
en: Then Job answered the LORD:
text:
JOB 42:1
Thadou: Chutah chun Job in Pakai chu adonbut tai.
English: Then Job answered the LORD:

tcz: Thil ijakai bolthei nahi naleh, nanatoh koiman nasuh tang theilou chu keiman kahei.
en: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
text:
JOB 42:2
Thadou: Thil ijakai bolthei nahi naleh, nanatoh koiman nasuh tang theilou chu keiman kahei.
English: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

tcz: Thil hetkhen theina beija kathil hetkhen theina dongpa chu koiham? Tin nei donge. Hichepa chu kei kahi. Chule keiman kahet khah louhel thu kana sei kha tai.
en: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.
text:
JOB 42:3
Thadou: Thil hetkhen theina beija kathil hetkhen theina dongpa chu koiham? Tin nei donge. Hichepa chu kei kahi. Chule keiman kahet khah louhel thu kana sei kha tai.
English: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.

tcz: Ngaijin keiman nasei peh inge. Keiman nangma thu kadoh a chuleh nangin nei donbut ding ahi.
en: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’
text:
JOB 42:4
Thadou: Ngaijin keiman nasei peh inge. Keiman nangma thu kadoh a chuleh nangin nei donbut ding ahi.
English: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’

tcz: Masanga chu nangma hi athu a bou kana jah tho ahin, ahinlah tun vang kamit tah in kamutai.
en: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.
text:
JOB 42:5
Thadou: Masanga chu nangma hi athu a bou kana jah tho ahin, ahinlah tun vang kamit tah in kamutai.
English: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.

tcz: Kana thusei jouse kageldoh sohkei tai. Chuleh keima kakisih taiti vetsahnan, leivui leh vutvam lah a hin katouve.
en: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”
text:
JOB 42:6
Thadou: Kana thusei jouse kageldoh sohkei tai. Chuleh keima kakisih taiti vetsahnan, leivui leh vutvam lah a hin katouve.
English: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

tcz: Pakaiyin thu hijatpi hi Job koma asei nungin Teman mipa Eliphaz komah aseitai. Nangma leh nagol teni chunga kalung ahange. Kasohpa Job sei bangin kachungchang thu adihchet in nanghon nasei pouve.
en: It was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.
text:
JOB 42:7
Thadou: Pakaiyin thu hijatpi hi Job koma asei nungin Teman mipa Eliphaz komah aseitai. Nangma leh nagol teni chunga kalung ahange. Kasohpa Job sei bangin kachungchang thu adihchet in nanghon nasei pouve.
English: It was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.

tcz: Hijeh chun bongchal sagi leh kelngoichal sagi ma kikai unlang kasohpa Job koma cheuvin, chuleh nangma ho a dingin kilhaina govam thilto gabol un. Kasohpan nangho dingin nataopeh untin chuleh keiman taona chu nangho minna kasan peh a, natoh dungjui uva kalethuh tahlou ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile nanghon kasohpa Job bangin kachungchang thu adihchet in nasei pouve ati.
en: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”
text:
JOB 42:8
Thadou: Hijeh chun bongchal sagi leh kelngoichal sagi ma kikai unlang kasohpa Job koma cheuvin, chuleh nangma ho a dingin kilhaina govam thilto gabol un. Kasohpan nangho dingin nataopeh untin chuleh keiman taona chu nangho minna kasan peh a, natoh dungjui uva kalethuh tahlou ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile nanghon kasohpa Job bangin kachungchang thu adihchet in nasei pouve ati.
English: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”

tcz: Hiti chun Teman mipa Eliphaz, Shuh mipa Bildad chule Naamat mi Zophar chun Pakai thupeh bangin agabol un chuleh Pakaiyin Job taona asanpeh tai.
en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what the LORD commanded them, and the LORD accepted Job.
text:
JOB 42:9
Thadou: Hiti chun Teman mipa Eliphaz, Shuh mipa Bildad chule Naamat mi Zophar chun Pakai thupeh bangin agabol un chuleh Pakaiyin Job taona asanpeh tai.
English: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what the LORD commanded them, and the LORD accepted Job.

tcz: Job chun aloi agolte dinga ataopeh phat in Pakaiyin vangphat nan akile sah in, tahbeh in Pakaiyin masanga aneijat sanga ajatni a tamjon apetai.
en: The LORD restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. The LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
text:
JOB 42:10
Thadou: Job chun aloi agolte dinga ataopeh phat in Pakaiyin vangphat nan akile sah in, tahbeh in Pakaiyin masanga aneijat sanga ajatni a tamjon apetai.
English: The LORD restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. The LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

tcz: Chutah chun asopi pasal holeh numeiho chuleh masanga akihetpi aloi agolte ahungun a in'ah an anehkhompi uvin ahi. Pakaiyin ama douna a achung hange thilse analhunsah ho jouse jal chun amapa chu alhem un chuleh alhamon un ahi. Chuleh amaho khat cheh chun amapa din thilpeh sum le sana khutjem ahin choipeh uve.
en: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that the LORD had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.
text:
JOB 42:11
Thadou: Chutah chun asopi pasal holeh numeiho chuleh masanga akihetpi aloi agolte ahungun a in'ah an anehkhompi uvin ahi. Pakaiyin ama douna a achung hange thilse analhunsah ho jouse jal chun amapa chu alhem un chuleh alhamon un ahi. Chuleh amaho khat cheh chun amapa din thilpeh sum le sana khutjem ahin choipeh uve.
English: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that the LORD had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Job hinkho anukhat lang chu akipat tillai sangin phatthei aha boh jon, hijeh chun tun kelngoi sangsom le sangli aneiyin, sangong sao sang gup aneiyin, bongchal kop sangkhat aneiyin, chule sanganpi sangkhat aneitai.
en: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.
text:
JOB 42:12
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Job hinkho anukhat lang chu akipat tillai sangin phatthei aha boh jon, hijeh chun tun kelngoi sangsom le sangli aneiyin, sangong sao sang gup aneiyin, bongchal kop sangkhat aneiyin, chule sanganpi sangkhat aneitai.
English: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.

tcz: Aman jong Job chu chapa sagi apeh ben, chule numei jong thum jen apeh bei.
en: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
text:
JOB 42:13
Thadou: Aman jong Job chu chapa sagi apeh ben, chule numei jong thum jen apeh bei.
English: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

tcz: Amapan achanu masapen chu Jemiah asah in, anina Keziah asah in, chule athumna Keremhappuch asah e.
en: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.
text:
JOB 42:14
Thadou: Amapan achanu masapen chu Jemiah asah in, anina Keziah asah in, chule athumna Keremhappuch asah e.
English: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.

tcz: Gamsung jouse a numei lah a Job Chanute banga melhoi dang aumpoi. Chuleh apaovin amaho chu asopi pasal ho toh alunglhaina bang tah in asem khomin ahi.
en: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
text:
JOB 42:15
Thadou: Gamsung jouse a numei lah a Job Chanute banga melhoi dang aumpoi. Chuleh apaovin amaho chu asopi pasal ho toh alunglhaina bang tah in asem khomin ahi.
English: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.

tcz: Hicheng nung hin Job chu kum jakhat le somli ahingin, achate leh atute khangli chan geijin amun ahi.
en: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.
text:
JOB 42:16
Thadou: Hicheng nung hin Job chu kum jakhat le somli ahingin, achate leh atute khangli chan geijin amun ahi.
English: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.

tcz: Chutah chun Job chu hinkho bulhingset in ahingin, tehse mong monga hingin atehthi tai.
en: So Job died, being old and full of days.
text:
JOB 42:17
Thadou: Chutah chun Job chu hinkho bulhingset in ahingin, tehse mong monga hingin atehthi tai.
English: So Job died, being old and full of days.

tcz: Migiloute thuhil jom louva, michonse ho lamlhah dunga jong dingle lou; chule Elohim Pathen ginglou ho kikhop na dunga jong tou khompi lou mi chu anun nom ahi.
en: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

tcz: Hitobang mihochun Yahweh Pakai Dan thu a bou lunglhai na aneiyun, Yahweh Pakai Dan thu chu sun le jan in angaito jing jeng ui.
en: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
text:
PSA 1:2
Thadou: Hitobang mihochun Yahweh Pakai Dan thu a bou lunglhai na aneiyun, Yahweh Pakai Dan thu chu sun le jan in angaito jing jeng ui.
English: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

tcz: Hitobang mi hochu twi lonna luipanga kiphut, aphat cha hung gaji adojong gopjilou thingphung tobang ahi; hitobang miho jong chu atohna lam lam'uva alolhing jiuve.
en: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
text:
PSA 1:3
Thadou: Hitobang mi hochu twi lonna luipanga kiphut, aphat cha hung gaji adojong gopjilou thingphung tobang ahi; hitobang miho jong chu atohna lam lam'uva alolhing jiuve.
English: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ginglouho vang chutobang ahipoi: huilhoh mangle changvai tobangbep ahiuve.
en: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
text:
PSA 1:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ginglouho vang chutobang ahipoi: huilhoh mangle changvai tobangbep ahiuve.
English: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Yahweh Pakai gingloute chu thutan nikho tengleh themmo changdiu, michonse hon jong mikitah ho lah'a mun aneiloudiu ahi.
en: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
text:
PSA 1:5
Thadou: Hijeh a chu Yahweh Pakai gingloute chu thutan nikho tengleh themmo changdiu, michonse hon jong mikitah ho lah'a mun aneiloudiu ahi.
English: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in michonpha ho lamlhah ahetpeh jing in, Yahweh Pakai ginglou ho lampi vang manthahna'a lut diu ahi.
en: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
text:
PSA 1:6
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in michonpha ho lamlhah ahetpeh jing in, Yahweh Pakai ginglou ho lampi vang manthahna'a lut diu ahi.
English: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

tcz: Ipi dinga chitin namtin kitohmoa, thilphachomlou ngaito na a aphat'u amoh man chatvei u hitam?
en: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
text:
PSA 2:1
Thadou: Ipi dinga chitin namtin kitohmoa, thilphachomlou ngaito na a aphat'u amoh man chatvei u hitam?
English: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in lengdinga athaonupa dounan leiset lengte akikhom un, chule vaihom thunei hon jong thulhuh asem un, hitin asei ui.
en: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,
text:
PSA 2:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in lengdinga athaonupa dounan leiset lengte akikhom un, chule vaihom thunei hon jong thulhuh asem un, hitin asei ui.
English: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,

tcz: “Ei-kihennauva kon ahin kilhamlhao hitin, Elohim Pathen thaneina'a kon'in kilha ong-u hite” atiuve.
en: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”
text:
PSA 2:3
Thadou: “Ei-kihennauva kon ahin kilhamlhao hitin, Elohim Pathen thaneina'a kon'in kilha ong-u hite” atiuve.
English: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

tcz: Hinlah Yahweh Pakai in avan laltouna'a kon'in amaho chu ahin nuisat in, Yahweh Pakai a din nuijat umtah ahitauve.
en: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.
text:
PSA 2:4
Thadou: Hinlah Yahweh Pakai in avan laltouna'a kon'in amaho chu ahin nuisat in, Yahweh Pakai a din nuijat umtah ahitauve.
English: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

tcz: Chuin Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu lunghang tah'in aphoh in, alunghan jah jeng chun amaho atijatsah tai.
en: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
text:
PSA 2:5
Thadou: Chuin Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu lunghang tah'in aphoh in, alunghan jah jeng chun amaho atijatsah tai.
English: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

tcz: Chutah in “Keiman kalhendoh lengchu kalhang theng Zion molvum a katousah'e,” ati.
en: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
text:
PSA 2:6
Thadou: Chutah in “Keiman kalhendoh lengchu kalhang theng Zion molvum a katousah'e,” ati.
English: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

tcz: Keiman thugahna chu phongdoh inge; Yahweh Pakai in kahengah hitin asei e, “Nangma hi kachapa nahi, Keiman tunia nangma hi kahin nahi tai.”
en: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
text:
PSA 2:7
Thadou: Keiman thugahna chu phongdoh inge; Yahweh Pakai in kahengah hitin asei e, “Nangma hi kachapa nahi, Keiman tunia nangma hi kahin nahi tai.”
English: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

tcz: Kahenga nathum pouleh chitin namtin hi nagoulo dinga kapeh ding, vannoi leiset pumpi geija nagou kahisahding ahi.
en: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
text:
PSA 2:8
Thadou: Kahenga nathum pouleh chitin namtin hi nagoulo dinga kapeh ding, vannoi leiset pumpi geija nagou kahisahding ahi.
English: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

tcz: Nangman amahohi thihjolla najep boh'a; belkhengpa bel kivoh chip banga ahal hal a nakoi ding ahi.
en: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
text:
PSA 2:9
Thadou: Nangman amahohi thihjolla najep boh'a; belkhengpa bel kivoh chip banga ahal hal a nakoi ding ahi.
English: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Vo leiset lengte kichih theiyun; Chule leiset thutan ho nanghon thuhil ngaiphaovin.
en: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
text:
PSA 2:10
Thadou: Hijeh chun Vo leiset lengte kichih theiyun; Chule leiset thutan ho nanghon thuhil ngaiphaovin.
English: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu ging tah in akin bol un, chule kithing pum in Ama chu houvun.
en: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
text:
PSA 2:11
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu ging tah in akin bol un, chule kithing pum in Ama chu houvun.
English: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai lungsatna nachung uva achuh a namanthah masangun akengphang kolchah in chop un, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai lungsat na neocha jong eihodia deojah ahi. Atahsan nau Yahweh Pakai a koi jing ho chu anun nom ahiuve.
en: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
text:
PSA 2:12
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai lungsatna nachung uva achuh a namanthah masangun akengphang kolchah in chop un, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai lungsat na neocha jong eihodia deojah ahi. Atahsan nau Yahweh Pakai a koi jing ho chu anun nom ahiuve.
English: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, idia eisulam vaiding mi pung jing hitam! eidou din mitamtah akipandoh taove.
en: LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
text:
PSA 3:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, idia eisulam vaiding mi pung jing hitam! eidou din mitamtah akipandoh taove.
English: LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

tcz: Ama kihuh doh na hi Elohim Pathen a aumpoi tin kalungthim in mitamtah'in aseijui. Selah.
en: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.
text:
PSA 3:2
Thadou: Ama kihuh doh na hi Elohim Pathen a aumpoi tin kalungthim in mitamtah'in aseijui. Selah.
English: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai, nanghi eiveng tup, kalum'a kisoung nahi; Ka loupina le khodah ngam-a, gal jona eipeh jing nahi.
en: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
text:
PSA 3:3
Thadou: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai, nanghi eiveng tup, kalum'a kisoung nahi; Ka loupina le khodah ngam-a, gal jona eipeh jing nahi.
English: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

tcz: Keima O sangtah in Yahweh Pakai henga kataovin, Aman alhang thenga kon'in eihin donbut tai. Selah.
en: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.
text:
PSA 3:4
Thadou: Keima O sangtah in Yahweh Pakai henga kataovin, Aman alhang thenga kon'in eihin donbut tai. Selah.
English: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

tcz: Keima kalum'in ka-imu jin; Yahweh Pakai in eichin tup'a eihoidam jeh'in, kajing-thou kit tai.
en: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.
text:
PSA 3:5
Thadou: Keima kalum'in ka-imu jin; Yahweh Pakai in eichin tup'a eihoidam jeh'in, kajing-thou kit tai.
English: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.

tcz: Keima doudin mihem sangsom sangjan ei umkimvel jongle kichakit taponge.
en: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
text:
PSA 3:6
Thadou: Keima doudin mihem sangsom sangjan ei umkimvel jongle kichakit taponge.
English: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

tcz: Hung thoudoh in O Yahweh Pakai; neihuhdoh'in, Elohim ka Pathen: Eidou hojouse khagu eivohchipeh in; nangma migilou ho hahemtah jong vopul soh ji nahi.
en: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
text:
PSA 3:7
Thadou: Hung thoudoh in O Yahweh Pakai; neihuhdoh'in, Elohim ka Pathen: Eidou hojouse khagu eivohchipeh in; nangma migilou ho hahemtah jong vopul soh ji nahi.
English: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

tcz: Huh hingna hi Yahweh Pakai a kon bou ahi: Na phattheina jong namite chunga aume.
en: Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.
text:
PSA 3:8
Thadou: Huh hingna hi Yahweh Pakai a kon bou ahi: Na phattheina jong namite chunga aume.
English: Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.

tcz: Kakou teng neidon but'in, them eichan sah a O Yahweh Pakai; ka lhahsam nikho teng jong le nangman lunglet neipe ji; neikhoton lang kataona neingai peh tei in.
en: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
text:
PSA 4:1
Thadou: Kakou teng neidon but'in, them eichan sah a O Yahweh Pakai; ka lhahsam nikho teng jong le nangman lunglet neipe ji; neikhoton lang kataona neingai peh tei in.
English: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

tcz: Vo mihem chapate, nanghohin itihchanpi neisuh jum diu hitam? Itihchan ajehbei a nei thepmosah uva, itihchan pihi jouthu nachepi diu hitam?
en: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.
text:
PSA 4:2
Thadou: Vo mihem chapate, nanghohin itihchanpi neisuh jum diu hitam? Itihchan ajehbei a nei thepmosah uva, itihchan pihi jouthu nachepi diu hitam?
English: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

tcz: Ahin nanghon heuvin, Yahweh Pakai in ama gingho Ama ding'in atum'in alhengdoh'e. Yahweh Pakai kakou tengleh Aman ei-donbut teijin ahi.
en: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.
text:
PSA 4:3
Thadou: Ahin nanghon heuvin, Yahweh Pakai in ama gingho Ama ding'in atum'in alhengdoh'e. Yahweh Pakai kakou tengleh Aman ei-donbut teijin ahi.
English: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.

tcz: Ki sonlelnan kithing pumin umun, ahin chonset boldaovin; hichu nalupnao muna jong nalungthimu toh gelkhom jinguvin lang umdet jingun.
en: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.
text:
PSA 4:4
Thadou: Ki sonlelnan kithing pumin umun, ahin chonset boldaovin; hichu nalupnao muna jong nalungthimu toh gelkhom jinguvin lang umdet jingun.
English: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

tcz: Lungthengsel a kilhai naho boljingun chule natahsan nao Yahweh Pakai a koi jingun.
en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.
text:
PSA 4:5
Thadou: Lungthengsel a kilhai naho boljingun chule natahsan nao Yahweh Pakai a koi jingun.
English: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.

tcz: Hiho sanga phajo eimusah thei diu koi ham? tin mitamtah'in seiunte, Yahweh Pakai namaivah achun keiho neihinsu emsel un.
en: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.
text:
PSA 4:6
Thadou: Hiho sanga phajo eimusah thei diu koi ham? tin mitamtah'in seiunte, Yahweh Pakai namaivah achun keiho neihinsu emsel un.
English: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.

tcz: Nangman lengpitwi leh changle mim nengchat'a kilamdoh ho kipani sangin, kalungthim nakipasah tai.
en: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
text:
PSA 4:7
Thadou: Nangman lengpitwi leh changle mim nengchat'a kilamdoh ho kipani sangin, kalungthim nakipasah tai.
English: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

tcz: Keima Nanga dia lungmonga kalup a ka-ihmut ding ahi, Yahweh Pakai nei hoidoh inlang neivengtup in.
en: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.
text:
PSA 4:8
Thadou: Keima Nanga dia lungmonga kalup a ka-ihmut ding ahi, Yahweh Pakai nei hoidoh inlang neivengtup in.
English: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, ka ocheng ho neingaipeh'in, Kalungthim a kataona jong neigelkhoh peh'in.
en: Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.
text:
PSA 5:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, ka ocheng ho neingaipeh'in, Kalungthim a kataona jong neigelkhoh peh'in.
English: Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.

tcz: Panpi ngaija kakana neigelkhohpeh'in, ka lengpa le Elohim ka Pathen; ajeh chu nangma kom'a bou taovakahi.
en: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.
text:
PSA 5:2
Thadou: Panpi ngaija kakana neigelkhohpeh'in, ka lengpa le Elohim ka Pathen; ajeh chu nangma kom'a bou taovakahi.
English: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, jingkah teng kataona nei ngaipeh'in, jingkah seh leh nangma lam sang ingting kangai chat jouse nakom kahinlhut a kinemtah a ngah jingding kahi.
en: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
text:
PSA 5:3
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, jingkah teng kataona nei ngaipeh'in, jingkah seh leh nangma lam sang ingting kangai chat jouse nakom kahinlhut a kinemtah a ngah jingding kahi.
English: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

tcz: Nangma thil phalouho chunga kipah ji pathen nahipon, migilou ho jong na angsuna aumthei ji pouve.
en: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
text:
PSA 5:4
Thadou: Nangma thil phalouho chunga kipah ji pathen nahipon, migilou ho jong na angsuna aumthei ji pouve.
English: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

tcz: Nangma angsunga mikiletsah ho a dingjou jipon; Yahweh Pakai nang man gitlou nale chonset bol jouse nathet soh hel e.
en: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
text:
PSA 5:5
Thadou: Nangma angsunga mikiletsah ho a dingjou jipon; Yahweh Pakai nang man gitlou nale chonset bol jouse nathet soh hel e.
English: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

tcz: Nangin jouthu sei ho nasuh mang ding ahi; Yahweh Pakai in mijoulhep holeh tolthat ho athet ahi.
en: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
text:
PSA 5:6
Thadou: Nangin jouthu sei ho nasuh mang ding ahi; Yahweh Pakai in mijoulhep holeh tolthat ho athet ahi.
English: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

tcz: Keima din vang, Nangailut na bulhingsetjal chun na hongsung hunglut nange; Chule nangma ginle jana a nahouin theng mai a bohkhup a chibai kabohding nahi.
en: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.
text:
PSA 5:7
Thadou: Keima din vang, Nangailut na bulhingsetjal chun na hongsung hunglut nange; Chule nangma ginle jana a nahouin theng mai a bohkhup a chibai kabohding nahi.
English: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, kamelma ten eijo lounadin nalamdih a neipui in. Kamasanga um lampi hi kajuidih nadin neihin lhun jang peh in.
en: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
text:
PSA 5:8
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, kamelma ten eijo lounadin nalamdih a neipui in. Kamasanga um lampi hi kajuidih nadin neihin lhun jang peh in.
English: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

tcz: Ajeh chu kamelmate kamsunga thutah apotthei tapon, asunglam'u jong setnajeng ahitai; Alol sung ujong lhankhuh abangin, alei ujong chuchi a kilhunglut kalbi abang e.
en: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.
text:
PSA 5:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu kamelmate kamsunga thutah apotthei tapon, asunglam'u jong setnajeng ahitai; Alol sung ujong lhankhuh abangin, alei ujong chuchi a kilhunglut kalbi abang e.
English: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai ama ho khu gotna petan. Aduhabol nauhi amaho lhuh na hihen! Achonsetnao ho jeh'in delmang jeng'in, ajeh chu amahohin nangma dounan na atong'un ahi.
en: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.
text:
PSA 5:10
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai ama ho khu gotna petan. Aduhabol nauhi amaho lhuh na hihen! Achonsetnao ho jeh'in delmang jeng'in, ajeh chu amahohin nangma dounan na atong'un ahi.
English: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

tcz: Ahin koihileh nangma lhalim noi'a umho chu thanom'u hen! Nangma thangvahna lachu kipah tah'in sajingu hen! Amaho chunga nalhajah in hoidoh jing in lang, Nangma min ngailu jing ho jong kipa na lodim jing'u hen.
en: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.
text:
PSA 5:11
Thadou: Ahin koihileh nangma lhalim noi'a umho chu thanom'u hen! Nangma thangvahna lachu kipah tah'in sajingu hen! Amaho chunga nalhajah in hoidoh jing in lang, Nangma min ngailu jing ho jong kipa na lodim jing'u hen.
English: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, nang'in michonpha ho phatthei naboh tei in. Nalungtoh te ngailut na ompho phatah achun nahoibit jing e.
en: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
text:
PSA 5:12
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, nang'in michonpha ho phatthei naboh tei in. Nalungtoh te ngailut na ompho phatah achun nahoibit jing e.
English: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, nei lung han san loujen in! Lungsat namoljol a chun neikhoukhah hih helin.
en: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
text:
PSA 6:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, nei lung han san loujen in! Lungsat namoljol a chun neikhoukhah hih helin.
English: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

tcz: Neikhoto teijin lhasam le hatlou kahi Yahweh Pakai, neidam sah in kagu kachang jousen eichip ui.
en: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
text:
PSA 6:2
Thadou: Neikhoto teijin lhasam le hatlou kahi Yahweh Pakai, neidam sah in kagu kachang jousen eichip ui.
English: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

tcz: Kalhagao alengvai lheh jeng tai, O Yahweh Pakai itihchan pi hitia hi kaum ding hitam?
en: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?
text:
PSA 6:3
Thadou: Kalhagao alengvai lheh jeng tai, O Yahweh Pakai itihchan pi hitia hi kaum ding hitam?
English: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?

tcz: Hungkilen O Yahweh Pakai, kalhagao huh doh in. Namingailutna longlou jeh chun neihin huhdoh tei in.
en: Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
text:
PSA 6:4
Thadou: Hungkilen O Yahweh Pakai, kalhagao huh doh in. Namingailutna longlou jeh chun neihin huhdoh tei in.
English: Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

tcz: Ajeh chu thina ahin nangma geldoh na aumpoi: lhankhuh a kona jong koiham nahin thangvah ding?
en: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
text:
PSA 6:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu thina ahin nangma geldoh na aumpoi: lhankhuh a kona jong koiham nahin thangvah ding?
English: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

tcz: Ka ka kamao nan kachao lhatai; janseh a kakanan kajalkhun achin in, kaka na mitlhi hon kalupna jalkhun akotsah sohtai.
en: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
text:
PSA 6:6
Thadou: Ka ka kamao nan kachao lhatai; janseh a kakanan kajalkhun achin in, kaka na mitlhi hon kalupna jalkhun akotsah sohtai.
English: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

tcz: Genthei a kaka nan kamit athimtan; kagalmiten eisuh genthei jeh'uvin apomhel jengtai.
en: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
text:
PSA 6:7
Thadou: Genthei a kaka nan kamit athimtan; kagalmiten eisuh genthei jeh'uvin apomhel jengtai.
English: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

tcz: Gitlouna bolho jouse kakoma kon'in potdoh tauvin; Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in kakana eijahpeh tai.
en: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.
text:
PSA 6:8
Thadou: Gitlouna bolho jouse kakoma kon'in potdoh tauvin; Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in kakana eijahpeh tai.
English: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in kangaichat a kathum na ho eihetpeh tan; kataona hi eidonbut ding ahitai.
en: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.
text:
PSA 6:9
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in kangaichat a kathum na ho eihetpeh tan; kataona hi eidonbut ding ahitai.
English: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.

tcz: Kagalmite jouse kijumsou henlang kithing pumin um uhen: Jum le ja pumin gangtah in kinungle taohen.
en: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
text:
PSA 6:10
Thadou: Kagalmite jouse kijumsou henlang kithing pumin um uhen: Jum le ja pumin gangtah in kinungle taohen.
English: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen eihoidam din nangma kahin belle. Eipedoh a pang hoa kon'in neihoidohsah'in, neihuhdoh'in.
en: LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
text:
PSA 7:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen eihoidam din nangma kahin belle. Eipedoh a pang hoa kon'in neihoidohsah'in, neihuhdoh'in.
English: LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

tcz: Achuti loule panpi ding bei a kaum a, keipi bahkai-jin mi abolset banga eiboset uva, ahal halla eibotel diu ahi.
en: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.
text:
PSA 7:2
Thadou: Achuti loule panpi ding bei a kaum a, keipi bahkai-jin mi abolset banga eiboset uva, ahal halla eibotel diu ahi.
English: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, ka-Pathen keiman thil suhkhel kaneija, thildihlou kana tohdoh khah'a,
en: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
text:
PSA 7:3
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, ka-Pathen keiman thil suhkhel kaneija, thildihlou kana tohdoh khah'a,
English: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

tcz: Lungmonga kachenkhom pi khat chonphatlouna kalethuh a, ajehbeija kagalmi kanchom khah'a ahileh,
en: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),
text:
PSA 7:4
Thadou: Lungmonga kachenkhom pi khat chonphatlouna kalethuh a, ajehbeija kagalmi kanchom khah'a ahileh,
English: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

tcz: Kagal mite khut-ah neipedoh jeng in lang kahin na lajengu hen, amahon tolla eichotpha jeng uhen chule kaloupi najouse bon lah'a kaithang jeng-u hen. Selah
en: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.
text:
PSA 7:5
Thadou: Kagal mite khut-ah neipedoh jeng in lang kahin na lajengu hen, amahon tolla eichotpha jeng uhen chule kaloupi najouse bon lah'a kaithang jeng-u hen. Selah
English: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, lunghan in hungthoudoh'in, Doumit melpu kagalmite jeh in nang hung kichoisang in; Chule hung kipatdoh'in Elohim ka Pathen nathutan dihtah chu hinpolut in.
en: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.
text:
PSA 7:6
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, lunghan in hungthoudoh'in, Doumit melpu kagalmite jeh in nang hung kichoisang in; Chule hung kipatdoh'in Elohim ka Pathen nathutan dihtah chu hinpolut in.
English: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

tcz: Namasangah chitin namtin kikhom soh hen: Ama ho chunga namun dih tah chu hin kimusah kit in.
en: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
text:
PSA 7:7
Thadou: Namasangah chitin namtin kikhom soh hen: Ama ho chunga namun dih tah chu hin kimusah kit in.
English: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu chitin namtin ho thu atan ahi: Kachondih naho nei phondoh peh tan, O Yahweh Pakai, ajeh chu keiman them mo na kanei poi O hatchung nung.
en: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
text:
PSA 7:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu chitin namtin ho thu atan ahi: Kachondih naho nei phondoh peh tan, O Yahweh Pakai, ajeh chu keiman them mo na kanei poi O hatchung nung.
English: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

tcz: Mi phalouho thil dihlou bolna kichai sah tan, chule michonpha ho chu domsangin. Ajeh chu nangman mihem lungthim gilsung ve Pathen dihtah chu nahi.
en: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
text:
PSA 7:9
Thadou: Mi phalouho thil dihlou bolna kichai sah tan, chule michonpha ho chu domsangin. Ajeh chu nangman mihem lungthim gilsung ve Pathen dihtah chu nahi.
English: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

tcz: Elohim ka Pathen hi kalum'a pang ahin, alungthim dih le akitah ho chu ahuhhing jin ahi.
en: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
text:
PSA 7:10
Thadou: Elohim ka Pathen hi kalum'a pang ahin, alungthim dih le akitah ho chu ahuhhing jin ahi.
English: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

tcz: Elohim ka Pathen hi thutan dihtah ahin, niseh'in miphalou chunga alung hangjingin ahi.
en: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.
text:
PSA 7:11
Thadou: Elohim ka Pathen hi thutan dihtah ahin, niseh'in miphalou chunga alung hangjingin ahi.
English: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

tcz: Mihemkhat chu akisih louva ahileh, Elohim ka Pathen in achemjam kinol hem intin, athalpi kaosa akoijing ahi.
en: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
text:
PSA 7:12
Thadou: Mihemkhat chu akisih louva ahileh, Elohim ka Pathen in achemjam kinol hem intin, athalpi kaosa akoijing ahi.
English: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

tcz: Aman thina manchah gimneitah chu kigot intin athalpi meikou chu akapding ahi.
en: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
text:
PSA 7:13
Thadou: Aman thina manchah gimneitah chu kigot intin athalpi meikou chu akapding ahi.
English: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

tcz: Miphalou hon setna avop un, umhelna le thilphalou va agaiun, jouthu ho ahinpen doh sah jiu ve.
en: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
text:
PSA 7:14
Thadou: Miphalou hon setna avop un, umhelna le thilphalou va agaiun, jouthu ho ahinpen doh sah jiu ve.
English: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

tcz: Amahon mi lhahlutna dingin kotong thuhtah alaijiuvin, ahinlah amaho joh alhalut jiuvin ahi.
en: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
text:
PSA 7:15
Thadou: Amahon mi lhahlutna dingin kotong thuhtah alaijiuvin, ahinlah amaho joh alhalut jiuvin ahi.
English: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

tcz: Midia set na abol hou chu amaho angsung joh in achuhjin ahi. Michunga chudinga thilse agon houchu amaho luchunga joh achujin ahi.
en: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
text:
PSA 7:16
Thadou: Midia set na abol hou chu amaho angsung joh in achuhjin ahi. Michunga chudinga thilse agon houchu amaho luchunga joh achujin ahi.
English: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu akitahna jeh'in thangvah ing-ting, keiman Yahweh Pakai hat chung nung min chu ka thangvah ding ahi.
en: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
text:
PSA 7:17
Thadou: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu akitahna jeh'in thangvah ing-ting, keiman Yahweh Pakai hat chung nung min chu ka thangvah ding ahi.
English: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, ka-Pakai u, leiset chunga hi itilom loma naming loupi hitam! naloupi nahi vanho sangin asangjon ahi.
en: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
text:
PSA 8:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, ka-Pakai u, leiset chunga hi itilom loma naming loupi hitam! naloupi nahi vanho sangin asangjon ahi.
English: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

tcz: Nangin chapang hole naosen ho kamsunga nathahat naho nahil in, hiti chun nagalmi hole nangma douho nasuthipjin ahi.
en: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.
text:
PSA 8:2
Thadou: Nangin chapang hole naosen ho kamsunga nathahat naho nahil in, hiti chun nagalmi hole nangma douho nasuthipjin ahi.
English: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

tcz: Keiman janteng vanthamjol kavet akangaito jiteng, nakhut jung ho natoh in lhathah le ahsi ho agongtoh sel ui.
en: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,
text:
PSA 8:3
Thadou: Keiman janteng vanthamjol kavet akangaito jiteng, nakhut jung ho natoh in lhathah le ahsi ho agongtoh sel ui.
English: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

tcz: Mihem hi ipi hija hibanga nagelkhoh'a, Mihem Chapa hi ipi dinga hibanga hi nakhohsah ham?
en: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
text:
PSA 8:4
Thadou: Mihem hi ipi hija hibanga nagelkhoh'a, Mihem Chapa hi ipi dinga hibanga hi nakhohsah ham?
English: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

tcz: Nang'in amaho hi Vantil sanga themchabou nemjep in nakoi jin, loupina le jana dimset in lallukhuh nakhuhpeh e.
en: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.
text:
PSA 8:5
Thadou: Nang'in amaho hi Vantil sanga themchabou nemjep in nakoi jin, loupina le jana dimset in lallukhuh nakhuhpeh e.
English: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

tcz: Nangin nathilsemsaho jouse chunga vaihop na napen, thiljouse akhutnoija nakoitan ahi:
en: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
text:
PSA 8:6
Thadou: Nangin nathilsemsaho jouse chunga vaihop na napen, thiljouse akhutnoija nakoitan ahi:
English: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

tcz: Kelngoiho le bong ho chule gamsahang ho jouse,
en: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,
text:
PSA 8:7
Thadou: Kelngoiho le bong ho chule gamsahang ho jouse,
English: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,

tcz: Vantham jol'a vachate, twikhang len'a nga-ho chule twikhang len'a kijap jouse ahiuve.
en: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
text:
PSA 8:8
Thadou: Vantham jol'a vachate, twikhang len'a nga-ho chule twikhang len'a kijap jouse ahiuve.
English: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, ka-Pakai u, leiset chunga hi itilom loma naming loupi hitam!
en: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
text:
PSA 8:9
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, ka-Pakai u, leiset chunga hi itilom loma naming loupi hitam!
English: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kalungthim pumpin nangma thangvah ing-kate. Thil loupi nabol ho hi seiphongle-inge.
en: I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
text:
PSA 9:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai kalungthim pumpin nangma thangvah ing-kate. Thil loupi nabol ho hi seiphongle-inge.
English: I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

tcz: Nangma jal a kipana a kadimset ding ahi. Namin in vahchoi la sang e, O Yahweh Pakai Hatchungnung.
en: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
text:
PSA 9:2
Thadou: Nangma jal a kipana a kadimset ding ahi. Namin in vahchoi la sang e, O Yahweh Pakai Hatchungnung.
