English: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

tcz: Nang nahung dindoh teng kagal mite anungjam jiuvin, akiseplhu vin na angsunga athiden jitaove.
en: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
text:
PSA 9:3
Thadou: Nang nahung dindoh teng kagal mite anungjam jiuvin, akiseplhu vin na angsunga athiden jitaove.
English: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangin kadih nalam a thu neitan pehin, navan laltouna'a kon'in thu adih'in nahin tan e.
en: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
text:
PSA 9:4
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangin kadih nalam a thu neitan pehin, navan laltouna'a kon'in thu adih'in nahin tan e.
English: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

tcz: Nangman namtin vaipi nalethuh in migiloute nasu-mang'in, amin'u tonsot'a din nathai mangtai.
en: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
text:
PSA 9:5
Thadou: Nangman namtin vaipi nalethuh in migiloute nasu-mang'in, amin'u tonsot'a din nathai mangtai.
English: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

tcz: Melmate chu nangin a-itih'a dingin nasumang in, khopi nasuh mang ho jong tun suhmil'in aumgam-tauve.
en: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.
text:
PSA 9:6
Thadou: Melmate chu nangin a-itih'a dingin nasumang in, khopi nasuh mang ho jong tun suhmil'in aumgam-tauve.
English: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai hi tonsot leng ahin, thutanna dingin alaltouna atungdoh'in ahi.
en: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
text:
PSA 9:7
Thadou: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai hi tonsot leng ahin, thutanna dingin alaltouna atungdoh'in ahi.
English: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

tcz: Aman leiset hi thudih'a achungthu atan a, namtin vaipi chunga hi dihtah'a vai ahop ding ahi.
en: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
text:
PSA 9:8
Thadou: Aman leiset hi thudih'a achungthu atan a, namtin vaipi chunga hi dihtah'a vai ahop ding ahi.
English: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

tcz: Yahweh Pakaihi bolgentheija umho dinga hoidohna ahin, hahsatna nikho hoa dinga kicholdona kulpi ahi.
en: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
text:
PSA 9:9
Thadou: Yahweh Pakaihi bolgentheija umho dinga hoidohna ahin, hahsatna nikho hoa dinga kicholdona kulpi ahi.
English: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

tcz: Namin heho jousen nahin tahsan ui, ajeh chu, O Yahweh Pakai nangin nangma holte chu nadalha ngaipoi.
en: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.
text:
PSA 9:10
Thadou: Namin heho jousen nahin tahsan ui, ajeh chu, O Yahweh Pakai nangin nangma holte chu nadalha ngaipoi.
English: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.

tcz: Jerusalem'a vaihom Yahweh Pakai vahchoinan lasauvin. Suhmil theilou atohdoh ho namtin jah a seiphongun.
en: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
text:
PSA 9:11
Thadou: Jerusalem'a vaihom Yahweh Pakai vahchoinan lasauvin. Suhmil theilou atohdoh ho namtin jah a seiphongun.
English: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

tcz: Ajeh chu aman tolthat ho aphu alahjin, panpi beiho apanpin ji. Aman migentheiho kana jong nahsah mon akoijipoi.
en: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
text:
PSA 9:12
Thadou: Ajeh chu aman tolthat ho aphu alahjin, panpi beiho apanpin ji. Aman migentheiho kana jong nahsah mon akoijipoi.
English: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

tcz: Neikho to teijin O Yahweh Pakai; eibose teuvin ichan a eisuh genthei u hitam, thina kokhuh a kon'in neiloidoh'in.
en: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
text:
PSA 9:13
Thadou: Neikho to teijin O Yahweh Pakai; eibose teuvin ichan a eisuh genthei u hitam, thina kokhuh a kon'in neiloidoh'in.
English: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

tcz: Zion chanu kelkot phunghoa lhangphong tah'a kathangvah theina dingin neihuhdoh'in, chutengleh neihuh doh jal a kakipa thanom ding ahi.
en: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
text:
PSA 9:14
Thadou: Zion chanu kelkot phunghoa lhangphong tah'a kathangvah theina dingin neihuhdoh'in, chutengleh neihuh doh jal a kakipa thanom ding ahi.
English: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

tcz: Midangho lhahlut nadia asem u kokhuh a chun Namtin vaipi alhalut un, athang kam uva chun amaho keng joh a ohtai.
en: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
text:
PSA 9:15
Thadou: Midangho lhahlut nadia asem u kokhuh a chun Namtin vaipi alhalut un, athang kam uva chun amaho keng joh a ohtai.
English: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi athutan dihna'a kon'in akilangdoh jin: Migilouho vang amaho thang-kamna'a a-ohden jiuvin ahi. Selah
en: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.
text:
PSA 9:16
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi athutan dihna'a kon'in akilangdoh jin: Migilouho vang amaho thang-kamna'a a-ohden jiuvin ahi. Selah
English: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

tcz: Migilouho vang lhankhuh a lhalut untin, hichu Elohim Pathen nahsah lou namtin vaipiho chunga got na jong ahi.
en: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
text:
PSA 9:17
Thadou: Migilouho vang lhankhuh a lhalut untin, hichu Elohim Pathen nahsah lou namtin vaipiho chunga got na jong ahi.
English: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

tcz: Ahinlah panpi ngaichaho chu nahsahmoa umjom jing loudiu: chule migenthei te kinepna jong tonsot a suhmil-a um louding ahi.
en: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
text:
PSA 9:18
Thadou: Ahinlah panpi ngaichaho chu nahsahmoa umjom jing loudiu: chule migenthei te kinepna jong tonsot a suhmil-a um louding ahi.
English: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

tcz: Hungthou vin, O Yahweh Pakai! Mihemho kinoise sah-hih beh'in! Nangma ginglou namtin vaipi ho chungthu hi tanin!
en: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
text:
PSA 9:19
Thadou: Hungthou vin, O Yahweh Pakai! Mihemho kinoise sah-hih beh'in! Nangma ginglou namtin vaipi ho chungthu hi tanin!
English: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

tcz: amahohi tijatnan lungkhamsah'in, O Yahweh Pakai. Namtin vaipi hi mihem maimai ahiu kihetdoh sah'in.
en: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.
text:
PSA 9:20
Thadou: amahohi tijatnan lungkhamsah'in, O Yahweh Pakai. Namtin vaipi hi mihem maimai ahiu kihetdoh sah'in.
English: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, idia gam lhatah'a ding nahim? Genthei kathoh jiteng ibol'a kisel jia nahim?
en: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
text:
PSA 10:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, idia gam lhatah'a ding nahim? Genthei kathoh jiteng ibol'a kisel jia nahim?
English: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

tcz: Migilouten noise tah'in migentheite adel mangjiu vin, mi-o nadinga asem'u thang a chun amahojoh hin-o sah'in.
en: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
text:
PSA 10:2
Thadou: Migilouten noise tah'in migentheite adel mangjiu vin, mi-o nadinga asem'u thang a chun amahojoh hin-o sah'in.
English: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

tcz: Ajeh chu amhon thilselam a alung ngaichat hou akiletsah piuvin, mikilose ho apah chauvin, Yahweh Pakai chu ataitom-un ahi.
en: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.
text:
PSA 10:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu amhon thilselam a alung ngaichat hou akiletsah piuvin, mikilose ho apah chauvin, Yahweh Pakai chu ataitom-un ahi.
English: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.

tcz: Migilou te vang Elohim Pathen holdin akiletsah val un, alungthim pumpiu vin jong Elohim Pathen aum poi atiuve.
en: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
text:
PSA 10:4
Thadou: Migilou te vang Elohim Pathen holdin akiletsah val un, alungthim pumpiu vin jong Elohim Pathen aum poi atiuve.
English: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

tcz: Ahinlah amaho hi abol-lam lam uvah alolhing'un ahi. Achung uva hunglhung ding eng-bolna ho jonghi amupha jipouve. Amahon agal-mihou jouse chu ataitom-un ahi.
en: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.
text:
PSA 10:5
Thadou: Ahinlah amaho hi abol-lam lam uvah alolhing'un ahi. Achung uva hunglhung ding eng-bolna ho jonghi amupha jipouve. Amahon agal-mihou jouse chu ataitom-un ahi.
English: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

tcz: Amahon, kachung'uva thilse kiti chulouding ahi tin atahsan un; boina hoa kona aitih a ongthol ding kahitaove atiuve.
en: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”
text:
PSA 10:6
Thadou: Amahon, kachung'uva thilse kiti chulouding ahi tin atahsan un; boina hoa kona aitih a ongthol ding kahitaove atiuve.
English: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

tcz: Akam-uvah sapsetna, joule nal, chule gihsalna adimset ui. Alei muh uva jong thilse le thilphalou jeng aum e.
en: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
text:
PSA 10:7
Thadou: Akam-uvah sapsetna, joule nal, chule gihsalna adimset ui. Alei muh uva jong thilse le thilphalou jeng aum e.
English: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

tcz: Amahon khopam lam gamthip lah hoa mi achanglhi jiuvin, them-mona neilouho thading agojiuve. Amit un alhasam te umna aching lhi jingun ahi.
en: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.
text:
PSA 10:8
Thadou: Amahon khopam lam gamthip lah hoa mi achanglhi jiuvin, them-mona neilouho thading agojiuve. Amit un alhasam te umna aching lhi jingun ahi.
English: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

tcz: Keipi bahkaiho bang'in akisel'un lhasam le hatloute mat jeng dingin angahun ahi. Sachangho bang'in tah-lelte chu len akhu khum un amandoh jitaove.
en: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.
text:
PSA 10:9
Thadou: Keipi bahkaiho bang'in akisel'un lhasam le hatloute mat jeng dingin angahun ahi. Sachangho bang'in tah-lelte chu len akhu khum un amandoh jitaove.
English: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.

tcz: Lhasam a bolsetna toh te chu asugep jiuvin; miphalouho thahatna noi a chun alhalut jitaove.
en: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
text:
PSA 10:10
Thadou: Lhasam a bolsetna toh te chu asugep jiuvin; miphalouho thahatna noi a chun alhalut jitaove.
English: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

tcz: Migilou ten Elohim Pathen in eimupha pouve atiuve! Aman amit sing intin, “Eihon ibol uhi mu hih beh inte” atiuve!
en: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
text:
PSA 10:11
Thadou: Migilou ten Elohim Pathen in eimupha pouve atiuve! Aman amit sing intin, “Eihon ibol uhi mu hih beh inte” atiuve!
English: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

tcz: Hung kipat tan O Yahweh Pakai, migiloute hi gotna petan, O Elohim Pathen! Hatlou lhasam te hin sumil hih beh in.
en: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
text:
PSA 10:12
Thadou: Hung kipat tan O Yahweh Pakai, migiloute hi gotna petan, O Elohim Pathen! Hatlou lhasam te hin sumil hih beh in.
English: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.

tcz: Migiloute Elohim Pathen sam se pum puma iti ongthol diu ham? Amahon Elohim Pathen in eithemmosah pouvinte tin angai touve.
en: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?
text:
PSA 10:13
Thadou: Migiloute Elohim Pathen sam se pum puma iti ongthol diu ham? Amahon Elohim Pathen in eithemmosah pouvinte tin angai touve.
English: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai nangin athilse bol-houhi namusoh keije. Nangin hicheho hi melchih inlang amahohi gotna pen. Hatlou lhasam ten atahsan nao nanga akoi un, nulou palou te jong nangin vengbit in.
en: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
text:
PSA 10:14
Thadou: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai nangin athilse bol-houhi namusoh keije. Nangin hicheho hi melchih inlang amahohi gotna pen. Hatlou lhasam ten atahsan nao nanga akoi un, nulou palou te jong nangin vengbit in.
English: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

tcz: Hiche migilou mi-engseho hi abanjang-u heh bongin! abon-uva nasuhmang kahsen anung u deljingin.
en: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
text:
PSA 10:15
Thadou: Hiche migilou mi-engseho hi abanjang-u heh bongin! abon-uva nasuhmang kahsen anung u deljingin.
English: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

tcz: Yahweh Pakaihi atonsot tonsot leng ahi! Elohim Pathen neilou nam mitechu gamsung akon a mangthah ding ahiuve.
en: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
text:
PSA 10:16
Thadou: Yahweh Pakaihi atonsot tonsot leng ahi! Elohim Pathen neilou nam mitechu gamsung akon a mangthah ding ahiuve.
English: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin tah-lelte kinepna hi nahetsa ahi, nangin thon louva akana-u najahpeh'a nahin lhamon ding ahi.
en: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
text:
PSA 10:17
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nangin tah-lelte kinepna hi nahetsa ahi, nangin thon louva akana-u najahpeh'a nahin lhamon ding ahi.
English: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

tcz: Nangin nulou palou te leh bolgentheija umho chungthu adih'a natanpeh ding, chuteng athi thei mihem in amaho hi asuh lengvai theilou diu ahitai.
en: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
text:
PSA 10:18
Thadou: Nangin nulou palou te leh bolgentheija umho chungthu adih'a natanpeh ding, chuteng athi thei mihem in amaho hi asuh lengvai theilou diu ahitai.
English: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

tcz: Keiman eiveng tup din Yahweh Pakai katahsan e. Hijeh achu, nangin ipi dia, “vacha bang'in nahoibitna dingin hiche molchunga khun galeng tan” natiham!
en: In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
text:
PSA 11:1
Thadou: Keiman eiveng tup din Yahweh Pakai katahsan e. Hijeh achu, nangin ipi dia, “vacha bang'in nahoibitna dingin hiche molchunga khun galeng tan” natiham!
English: In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

tcz: Migilouhon athalchangu akhaoto suhtoh san akoi un aloisal tauvin ahi. Amahon munthip a kon-in milungdih ho ahinkap'un ahi.
en: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
text:
PSA 11:2
Thadou: Migilouhon athalchangu akhaoto suhtoh san akoi un aloisal tauvin ahi. Amahon munthip a kon-in milungdih ho ahinkap'un ahi.
English: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

tcz: Dan leh thupehho akisuhset teng, michonphapa chun ipi abolthei nahlai dingham?
en: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
text:
PSA 11:3
Thadou: Dan leh thupehho akisuhset teng, michonphapa chun ipi abolthei nahlai dingham?
English: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai chu a-houin munthenga chun aum e; Yahweh Pakai chun vanna kon'in vai ahinhom nalaije. Aman mijouse ahin vechilsoh keijin, leiset chunga mitin ahinkholtoh e.
en: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
text:
PSA 11:4
Thadou: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai chu a-houin munthenga chun aum e; Yahweh Pakai chun vanna kon'in vai ahinhom nalaije. Aman mijouse ahin vechilsoh keijin, leiset chunga mitin ahinkholtoh e.
English: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in michonpha le migilou anigelin ahinkhol toh e. Aman thunoh baotam bol ho athen ahi.
en: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.
text:
PSA 11:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in michonpha le migilou anigelin ahinkhol toh e. Aman thunoh baotam bol ho athen ahi.
English: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

tcz: Aman migiloute chunga mei-am lenglung leh katsong meikong gojuh'a ajuhsah ding hui savetvut pumma gotna apeh ding ahi.
en: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
text:
PSA 11:6
Thadou: Aman migiloute chunga mei-am lenglung leh katsong meikong gojuh'a ajuhsah ding hui savetvut pumma gotna apeh ding ahi.
English: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai dihnahin thu adih'a kitan achepin, hijeh'a chu thudih chepi hochun Yahweh Pakai mai amudiu ahi.
en: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
text:
PSA 11:7
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai dihnahin thu adih'a kitan achepin, hijeh'a chu thudih chepi hochun Yahweh Pakai mai amudiu ahi.
English: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

tcz: Huhhing in, O Yahweh Pakai, michonpha mangthah ding ahitai! Leiset mihem te lah a mikitah jong abeitai!
en: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
text:
PSA 12:1
Thadou: Huhhing in, O Yahweh Pakai, michonpha mangthah ding ahitai! Leiset mihem te lah a mikitah jong abeitai!
English: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

tcz: Heng le kom jengjong jouthu jengin akilhemtouvin, muhnal a lungthima kilhep lhahding jeng thu asei ui.
en: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
text:
PSA 12:2
Thadou: Heng le kom jengjong jouthu jengin akilhemtouvin, muhnal a lungthima kilhep lhahding jeng thu asei ui.
English: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in dangnal tah a thukisei ho hi asuh bei ding, kiletsahna thuchengho jonghi asuthip ding ahitai.
en: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
text:
PSA 12:3
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in dangnal tah a thukisei ho hi asuh bei ding, kiletsahna thuchengho jonghi asuthip ding ahitai.
English: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

tcz: Amahon aseijun, eihon lungna chim set'in jouthu seiju hite, ajeh chu i-lei ikam'u eihoa hilouham, kon eisuh tang jou diuham? atiuve.
en: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
text:
PSA 12:4
Thadou: Amahon aseijun, eihon lungna chim set'in jouthu seiju hite, ajeh chu i-lei ikam'u eihoa hilouham, kon eisuh tang jou diuham? atiuve.
English: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in adonbut in, “Keiman hatlou lhasamte chunga bolgenthei naho kamudohtai chule migenthei ho ka lemao jong kajatai. Tun keima kipan inting huhdoh dia eingaichat bangu va kahuh doh diu ahitai.”
en: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”
text:
PSA 12:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in adonbut in, “Keiman hatlou lhasamte chunga bolgenthei naho kamudohtai chule migenthei ho ka lemao jong kajatai. Tun keima kipan inting huhdoh dia eingaichat bangu va kahuh doh diu ahitai.”
English: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kitepna hi thengsel'a ahin, dangka mei chunga sagivei kilhit theng tobang ahi.
en: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
text:
PSA 12:6
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai kitepna hi thengsel'a ahin, dangka mei chunga sagivei kilhit theng tobang ahi.
English: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

tcz: Hijeh chun, Yahweh Pakai nangin bol-hesoh'a umho nahuhdoh ding ahi, ti kaheuve, chule hiche kitahlou khang mitea kon'a tonsot geija dinga nahoidoh ding ahi,
en: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
text:
PSA 12:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun, Yahweh Pakai nangin bol-hesoh'a umho nahuhdoh ding ahi, ti kaheuve, chule hiche kitahlou khang mitea kon'a tonsot geija dinga nahoidoh ding ahi,
English: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

tcz: migilou te muntina vahle henlang migilou pen ho jong gamsung a kidomsang u jong le.
en: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
text:
PSA 12:8
Thadou: migilou te muntina vahle henlang migilou pen ho jong gamsung a kidomsang u jong le.
English: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, phat itihchan geihi neisuhmil ding hitam? Itih chan keija kon'a nakiselmang ding nahim?
en: How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
text:
PSA 13:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, phat itihchan geihi neisuhmil ding hitam? Itih chan keija kon'a nakiselmang ding nahim?
English: How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

tcz: Itihchan gei hiche hahsatna hi kathoh ding ham? Itih chan asun ajan'a lungkhamna dimset'a kaum ding ham? Itih chan kagalmiten hanla eisap khum diu hitam?
en: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
text:
PSA 13:2
Thadou: Itihchan gei hiche hahsatna hi kathoh ding ham? Itih chan asun ajan'a lungkhamna dimset'a kaum ding ham? Itih chan kagalmiten hanla eisap khum diu hitam?
English: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen hung kiheiyin, neihin donbut tan! Katha kile dohsah'in, neithisah hih'in.
en: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

tcz: “Ama hi kajou tai!” tin kamelma te hi ka lhuh nin kipasah hih beh in.
en: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
text:
PSA 13:4
Thadou: “Ama hi kajou tai!” tin kamelma te hi ka lhuh nin kipasah hih beh in.
English: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

tcz: Amavang namingailutna longlouvachu kingai jing kahi. Neihuhdoh jeh a keima kipa jing ding kahi.
en: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
text:
PSA 13:5
Thadou: Amavang namingailutna longlouvachu kingai jing kahi. Neihuhdoh jeh a keima kipa jing ding kahi.
English: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai vahchoi lan sang e ajeh chu Ama keidin thilpha tah eibol peh ati.
en: I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.
text:
PSA 13:6
Thadou: Keiman Yahweh Pakai vahchoi lan sang e ajeh chu Ama keidin thilpha tah eibol peh ati.
English: I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.

tcz: Mingol'in bou alungthim in “Pathen aumpoi” ati. Amaho hi lepche ngen ahiuvin, chule athilbol ujong adihlou jeng ahin, khatcha jong thilphabol aumpouve.
en: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.
text:
PSA 14:1
Thadou: Mingol'in bou alungthim in “Pathen aumpoi” ati. Amaho hi lepche ngen ahiuvin, chule athilbol ujong adihlou jeng ahin, khatcha jong thilphabol aumpouve.
English: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in vanna kon'in lei mihemte jouse ahinven, mikhattou aching tahbeh um-em, chule Elohim Pathen ngaicha'a hol-a um-em atin ahi.
en: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
text:
PSA 14:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in vanna kon'in lei mihemte jouse ahinven, mikhattou aching tahbeh um-em, chule Elohim Pathen ngaicha'a hol-a um-em atin ahi.
English: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

tcz: Hinlah aumpoi, abon'un aki-heimang gamtauve, abonchauva lepche ngen ahiuvin, koimacha apha aumpoi khatcha jong aumpoi.
en: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
text:
PSA 14:3
Thadou: Hinlah aumpoi, abon'un aki-heimang gamtauve, abonchauva lepche ngen ahiuvin, koimacha apha aumpoi khatcha jong aumpoi.
English: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

tcz: Setna bolten hetna anei lou u hintem? Amahohin kamite changlhah bang'in aneuvin, Yahweh Pakai komin la taoding agelpouve.
en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?
text:
PSA 14:4
Thadou: Setna bolten hetna anei lou u hintem? Amahohin kamite changlhah bang'in aneuvin, Yahweh Pakai komin la taoding agelpouve.
English: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?

tcz: Amahohi tijatnan alodim diuahi, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in athua nung ho aumpin ahi.
en: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
text:
PSA 14:5
Thadou: Amahohi tijatnan alodim diuahi, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in athua nung ho aumpin ahi.
English: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

tcz: Migilou ten bolgentheija umho tohgon asuhsetpeh jiuvin, ahin Yahweh Pakai in amite ahuhdoh jingin ahi.
en: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
text:
PSA 14:6
Thadou: Migilou ten bolgentheija umho tohgon asuhsetpeh jiuvin, ahin Yahweh Pakai in amite ahuhdoh jingin ahi.
English: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

tcz: Zion molsang a kon a Israel huhdoh dinga koi hungding ham? Yahweh Pakai in amite aki-ledohsah kit teng, Jacob in kipana asap phon a, Israel in Elohim Pathen athangvah ding ahi.
en: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
text:
PSA 14:7
Thadou: Zion molsang a kon a Israel huhdoh dinga koi hungding ham? Yahweh Pakai in amite aki-ledohsah kit teng, Jacob in kipana asap phon a, Israel in Elohim Pathen athangvah ding ahi.
English: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai na intheng sunga, kon nangma nahou ding hitam? Koiham nalhang thenga na angsunga hunglut ding?
en: LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
text:
PSA 15:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai na intheng sunga, kon nangma nahou ding hitam? Koiham nalhang thenga na angsunga hunglut ding?
English: LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

tcz: Hitobang mi themmona bei, thil dihjeng bol, lungthim theng pumma thudih jeng seiho.
en: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

tcz: Akam a miseiset ding nomlou chule aheng akom chunga thilse bollou, ahiloule aloi agol chunga thilse seinomlou.
en: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

tcz: Chonset kithang-atpiho theinomlou va, Yahweh Pakai dihtah a juiho ngaisanga, chuleh itobangin hahsa jongleh akitepna nitjingho.
en: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

tcz: Athoi lalouva sumpa homho chuleh setna neilouho, ahethemlou ho lhemlha a phatchomna sum hol lou. Hitobang miho chu ahinkhouva dingdet jingding ahiuve.
en: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
text:
PSA 15:5
Thadou: Athoi lalouva sumpa homho chuleh setna neilouho, ahethemlou ho lhemlha a phatchomna sum hol lou. Hitobang miho chu ahinkhouva dingdet jingding ahiuve.
English: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.

tcz: Neihoibitnin O Elohim Pathen: ajeh chu nangahi kinem jing kahi.
en: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
text:
PSA 16:1
Thadou: Neihoibitnin O Elohim Pathen: ajeh chu nangahi kinem jing kahi.
English: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

tcz: O Kalhagao, nangman Yahweh Pakai koma Nanghi ka Pakai nahi nati, thilpha kaneijouse hi nanga kon bou ahi;
en: My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

tcz: Leiset a Elohim Pathen lhentumte hi pachat umtah ahiuvin, amahohi keidinga kagal lamkai le kakipa thanop napen ahiuve.
en: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
text:
PSA 16:3
Thadou: Leiset a Elohim Pathen lhentumte hi pachat umtah ahiuvin, amahohi keidinga kagal lamkai le kakipa thanop napen ahiuve.
English: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

tcz: Pathen dangho nung jui a delle ho chu alung khamnao kibejing ding ahi. Amaho thisan a kilhaina ganthat a pang ka hilou ding, a pathen nu jong kahoupeh loudiu ahi.
en: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
text:
PSA 16:4
Thadou: Pathen dangho nung jui a delle ho chu alung khamnao kibejing ding ahi. Amaho thisan a kilhaina ganthat a pang ka hilou ding, a pathen nu jong kahoupeh loudiu ahi.
English: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi ka chanding gou le ka phatthei channa khon chu ahi. Yahweh Pakai in ka ijakai eichintup peh e.
en: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
text:
PSA 16:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi ka chanding gou le ka phatthei channa khon chu ahi. Yahweh Pakai in ka ijakai eichintup peh e.
English: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

tcz: Nangin neipeh gam jonghi gamphapen ahi, itobanga goupha kidang neipeh hitam!
en: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
text:
PSA 16:6
Thadou: Nangin neipeh gam jonghi gamphapen ahi, itobanga goupha kidang neipeh hitam!
English: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

tcz: Ijakai eihilla ka Yahweh Pakai chu keiman thangvah inge; janteng jong le avel in eigeldoh sah jin eihil jie.
en: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
text:
PSA 16:7
Thadou: Ijakai eihilla ka Yahweh Pakai chu keiman thangvah inge; janteng jong le avel in eigeldoh sah jin eihil jie.
English: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in eiumpi danhi keiman hetna kanei jinge. Amahi kakomma naichakhatna um ahi ti kahen hijeh chun keima lungthomhao ponge.
en: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
text:
PSA 16:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in eiumpi danhi keiman hetna kanei jinge. Amahi kakomma naichakhatna um ahi ti kahen hijeh chun keima lungthomhao ponge.
English: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

tcz: Hijeh hin keima kalung amongsellin chuleh kipanan kadimmin Elohim Pathen kathangvah e.
en: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
text:
PSA 16:9
Thadou: Hijeh hin keima kalung amongsellin chuleh kipanan kadimmin Elohim Pathen kathangvah e.
English: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangin thina mun a neidalha pon natin namitheng te jong lhankhuh a lhahlutsah pon nate.
en: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
text:
PSA 16:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangin thina mun a neidalha pon natin namitheng te jong lhankhuh a lhahlutsah pon nate.
English: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

tcz: Nangin hinnalampi chu neimusah'in natin, neiumpi jal a kipana le nei umpina tonsot nopna chu nei pen nate.
en: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
text:
PSA 16:11
Thadou: Nangin hinnalampi chu neimusah'in natin, neiumpi jal a kipana le nei umpina tonsot nopna chu nei pen nate.
English: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai adih thumna a kaka ogin hi nei jahpeh in, katao nahi nei ngaipeh in, lungthengsel le dih tah katao ahi.
en: Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
text:
PSA 17:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai adih thumna a kaka ogin hi nei jahpeh in, katao nahi nei ngaipeh in, lungthengsel le dih tah katao ahi.
English: Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.

tcz: Kathem chan na neiphondoh peh'in, ajeh chu nangin thudih a natong namuchet ahi.
en: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.
text:
PSA 17:2
Thadou: Kathem chan na neiphondoh peh'in, ajeh chu nangin thudih a natong namuchet ahi.
English: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

tcz: Nangin kalunggel ho napatep jin, janteng jongle kalungsung navelhaji. Nangin kapum changin neivechillin kathepmo na namupoi; kakamsung jenga jong set na potlou ding ahitai.
en: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.
text:
PSA 17:3
Thadou: Nangin kalunggel ho napatep jin, janteng jongle kalungsung navelhaji. Nangin kapum changin neivechillin kathepmo na namupoi; kakamsung jenga jong set na potlou ding ahitai.
English: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.

tcz: Keiman nathupeh Dan dungjuiin, migilou ho le mi-engseho ho khonung kajui ji poi.
en: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
text:
PSA 17:4
Thadou: Keiman nathupeh Dan dungjuiin, migilou ho le mi-engseho ho khonung kajui ji poi.
English: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

tcz: Kakalson dan hin nalampi kajui jingin nangma lampia konnin kapotdoh pon ahi.
en: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
text:
PSA 17:5
Thadou: Kakalson dan hin nalampi kajui jingin nangma lampia konnin kapotdoh pon ahi.
English: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.

tcz: Keima nangma komma taova kahi ajeh chu O Elohim Pathen nangin neisanpeh teiding kahei. Kataona hi lunglut tah'in neingaipeh in.
en: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
text:
PSA 17:6
Thadou: Keima nangma komma taova kahi ajeh chu O Elohim Pathen nangin neisanpeh teiding kahei. Kataona hi lunglut tah'in neingaipeh in.
English: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

tcz: Nami ngailutna longlou chu kidangtah in neimusah'in, agalmitea konna hoidohna ngaichaho chu nathahatna gimneitah chun nahuh doh ji e.
en: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
text:
PSA 17:7
Thadou: Nami ngailutna longlou chu kidangtah in neimusah'in, agalmitea konna hoidohna ngaichaho chu nathahatna gimneitah chun nahuh doh ji e.
English: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

tcz: Nangman namit teni na chintup jing bangin keima jong nei vesuijin. Nalhaving limnoija chun neisellin.
en: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
text:
PSA 17:8
Thadou: Nangman namit teni na chintup jing bangin keima jong nei vesuijin. Nalhaving limnoija chun neisellin.
English: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

tcz: Kavel a eidoujing migilouho a kon in eivengtup in, eithatgo kamelma hoa konnin nei huhdoh in.
en: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
text:
PSA 17:9
Thadou: Kavel a eidoujing migilouho a kon in eivengtup in, eithatgo kamelma hoa konnin nei huhdoh in.
English: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.

tcz: Amahohi mi khotona bei ahiuvin akiletsah nao thucheng chu ngaitan!
en: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
text:
PSA 17:10
Thadou: Amahohi mi khotona bei ahiuvin akiletsah nao thucheng chu ngaitan!
English: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

tcz: Amahon eihin juilutnun eiumkimvel uvin tola selhuh dingin agomkom ahol un ahi.
en: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
text:
PSA 17:11
Thadou: Amahon eihin juilutnun eiumkimvel uvin tola selhuh dingin agomkom ahol un ahi.
English: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

tcz: Anehding changlhih le keipi bahkai hangtah bang le keipinou vin gamthip lai matding avetlhih le tobang ahiuve.
en: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
text:
PSA 17:12
Thadou: Anehding changlhih le keipi bahkai hangtah bang le keipinou vin gamthip lai matding avetlhih le tobang ahiuve.
English: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

tcz: Hung kipat tan O Yahweh Pakai kidintepin lang seplhu jengin! Nachemjammin migilouhoa konnin neihuhdoh in.
en: Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,
text:
PSA 17:13
Thadou: Hung kipat tan O Yahweh Pakai kidintepin lang seplhu jengin! Nachemjammin migilouhoa konnin neihuhdoh in.
English: Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai naban thathatnin vannoia ama phatchomna ngaito hohi sumangin. Amavang nangma goulu hohi nangman vah va jing in. Achateu neijong suhnengpeh inlang ason apahteu goulo ding geija adalhah peh theina diuvin gontoh peh'in.
en: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.
text:
PSA 17:14
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai naban thathatnin vannoia ama phatchomna ngaito hohi sumangin. Amavang nangma goulu hohi nangman vah va jing in. Achateu neijong suhnengpeh inlang ason apahteu goulo ding geija adalhah peh theina diuvin gontoh peh'in.
English: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

tcz: Monabeija hinkho Kaman jeh a namel kamu teiding ahi. Kathodoh tengleh nangma toh kimaitoa ikimuto ding chule kalungnachim tante.
en: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
text:
PSA 17:15
Thadou: Monabeija hinkho Kaman jeh a namel kamu teiding ahi. Kathodoh tengleh nangma toh kimaitoa ikimuto ding chule kalungnachim tante.
English: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.

tcz: Keiman nangma kangailui Yahweh Pakai; Nangma hi kathahatna nahi.
en: I love you, LORD, my strength.
text:
PSA 18:1
Thadou: Keiman nangma kangailui Yahweh Pakai; Nangma hi kathahatna nahi.
English: I love you, LORD, my strength.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi kasongpi, kakulpi, chuleh eihuhhingpu ahin, Elohim ka Pathen hi kasongpi ahin eiveng tup jing ahi. Amahi kalumdal, eihuhhinga thahat chu ahin, chuleh kahoidohna munpi chu ahi.
en: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
text:
PSA 18:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi kasongpi, kakulpi, chuleh eihuhhingpu ahin, Elohim ka Pathen hi kasongpi ahin eiveng tup jing ahi. Amahi kalumdal, eihuhhinga thahat chu ahin, chuleh kahoidohna munpi chu ahi.
English: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

tcz: Keiman thangvah dinga lomtah Yahweh Pakai chu kakouvin, aman kamelmatea konnin eihuhdoh'in ahi.
en: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
text:
PSA 18:3
Thadou: Keiman thangvah dinga lomtah Yahweh Pakai chu kakouvin, aman kamelmatea konnin eihuhdoh'in ahi.
English: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

tcz: Thina khoisatna chun eiumkimvel tan, manthahna twipi chun eichup tan ahi.
en: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
text:
PSA 18:4
Thadou: Thina khoisatna chun eiumkimvel tan, manthahna twipi chun eichup tan ahi.
English: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

tcz: Damun lungkhamna chun eiumkimvelin, kalampi a thinan thang akam e.
en: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
text:
PSA 18:5
Thadou: Damun lungkhamna chun eiumkimvelin, kalampi a thinan thang akam e.
English: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

tcz: Ka lungkham val phatnin Yahweh Pakai chu kakouvin, Elohim ka Pathen komma chun panpi ngaichan kataovin Aman ahouin thenga konnin kataona asangin ahi.
en: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
text:
PSA 18:6
Thadou: Ka lungkham val phatnin Yahweh Pakai chu kakouvin, Elohim ka Pathen komma chun panpi ngaichan kataovin Aman ahouin thenga konnin kataona asangin ahi.
English: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

tcz: Hi jouchun leiset akilingin akihot e. Molbul ho jeng jong kihot e ajeh chu Elohim Pathen lunghang a ahi.
en: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
text:
PSA 18:7
Thadou: Hi jouchun leiset akilingin akihot e. Molbul ho jeng jong kihot e ajeh chu Elohim Pathen lunghang a ahi.
English: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nah hom a meikhu ahung potdoh in, meikou gimneitah akam a konnin ahungkou doh'in chuleh Mei-am al lenglung Ama-a konnin ahung koudoh'in ahi.
en: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
text:
PSA 18:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nah hom a meikhu ahung potdoh in, meikou gimneitah akam a konnin ahungkou doh'in chuleh Mei-am al lenglung Ama-a konnin ahung koudoh'in ahi.
English: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

tcz: Aman vanho chu ahongdoh'in meilom thimletlut chu ahin chotphan ahung kumsuh in,
en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
text:
PSA 18:9
Thadou: Aman vanho chu ahongdoh'in meilom thimletlut chu ahin chotphan ahung kumsuh in,
English: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu vantil pipui khat chunga atouvin, huipi chu alhavingin amangin alengin ahi.
en: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
text:
PSA 18:10
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu vantil pipui khat chunga atouvin, huipi chu alhavingin amangin alengin ahi.
English: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu muthim in ahung kitom in, meilom twi jingletlut pumin ahung lhungin ahi.
en: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
text:
PSA 18:11
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu muthim in ahung kitom in, meilom twi jingletlut pumin ahung lhungin ahi.
English: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai vah'in ahintom chu meilom satah'in ahinkhu khum in gelchang le mei-am chu gojuh'in ahung julhan ahi.
en: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
text:
PSA 18:12
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai vah'in ahintom chu meilom satah'in ahinkhu khum in gelchang le mei-am chu gojuh'in ahung julhan ahi.
English: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu vanna konnin ahung kisen in hatchungnung ogin chu gelchang leh mei-am koulah achun akithongin ahi.
en: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
text:
PSA 18:13
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu vanna konnin ahung kisen in hatchungnung ogin chu gelchang leh mei-am koulah achun akithongin ahi.
English: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

tcz: Aman athalpi ahin kapmin agalmiho chu athe cheh'in, avah em lahlah chun amaho chu asuboi gamtan ahi.
en: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.
text:
PSA 18:14
Thadou: Aman athalpi ahin kapmin agalmiho chu athe cheh'in, avah em lahlah chun amaho chu asuboi gamtan ahi.
English: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangin nagalmi ho napho a lunghangtah a nakisen chun twikhanglen ato geijin akikangin, leiset bulpi jouse jong akeuvin aumjie.
en: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
text:
PSA 18:15
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangin nagalmi ho napho a lunghangtah a nakisen chun twikhanglen ato geijin akikangin, leiset bulpi jouse jong akeuvin aumjie.
English: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

tcz: Aman vanna konnin akhut ahin lhangin eihin kaidoh'in, twipi thuh lah'a kon in jong eikaidoh'in ahi.
en: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
text:
PSA 18:16
Thadou: Aman vanna konnin akhut ahin lhangin eihin kaidoh'in, twipi thuh lah'a kon in jong eikaidoh'in ahi.
English: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

tcz: Aman kagalmi hattah tah ho a konin eihuh doh in, kasang a hatjo ka dougal hoa kon in eihuhdoh'in ahi.
en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
text:
PSA 18:17
Thadou: Aman kagalmi hattah tah ho a konin eihuh doh in, kasang a hatjo ka dougal hoa kon in eihuhdoh'in ahi.
English: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

tcz: Hahsatna kato pettah'in amahon eihin delkhum un ahinlah Yahweh Pakai in eipanpin ahi.
en: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.
text:
PSA 18:18
Thadou: Hahsatna kato pettah'in amahon eihin delkhum un ahinlah Yahweh Pakai in eipanpin ahi.
English: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.

tcz: Aman kahoidohna mun nah eipuilut in eihuhdoh tai ajeh chu ama kipana kahi.
en: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
text:
PSA 18:19
Thadou: Aman kahoidohna mun nah eipuilut in eihuhdoh tai ajeh chu ama kipana kahi.
English: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thildih kaboljeh in kipaman eipen mona kaneilou jeh'in eikiledohsah tai.
en: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
text:
PSA 18:20
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in thildih kaboljeh in kipaman eipen mona kaneilou jeh'in eikiledohsah tai.
English: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai lampi kajui in, thilse lam jon'in Elohim Pathen'a kon'in kakiheimang poi.
en: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
text:
PSA 18:21
Thadou: Keiman Yahweh Pakai lampi kajui in, thilse lam jon'in Elohim Pathen'a kon'in kakiheimang poi.
English: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chonphatna lampi kajui jingin, a Dan thupeh ho kapaidoh khapoi.
en: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.
text:
PSA 18:22
Thadou: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chonphatna lampi kajui jingin, a Dan thupeh ho kapaidoh khapoi.
English: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

tcz: Elohim Pathen masangah nolnabei kahin, chonsetna kon'in kaki kangse jing e.
en: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
text:
PSA 18:23
Thadou: Elohim Pathen masangah nolnabei kahin, chonsetna kon'in kaki kangse jing e.
English: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thildih kaboljeh in Aman kipaman eipejin ahi. Aman themmonabei kahi amui.
en: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
text:
PSA 18:24
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in thildih kaboljeh in Aman kipaman eipejin ahi. Aman themmonabei kahi amui.
English: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

tcz: Mikitah kom'ah nangmatah jong nakitah'in, monabei ho kom'ah monabei nahi.
en: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
text:
PSA 18:25
Thadou: Mikitah kom'ah nangmatah jong nakitah'in, monabei ho kom'ah monabei nahi.
English: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

tcz: Milungtheng ho kom'ah nalungtheng in ahinlah miphalouho kom'ah nakhohjin ahi.
en: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
text:
PSA 18:26
Thadou: Milungtheng ho kom'ah nalungtheng in ahinlah miphalouho kom'ah nakhohjin ahi.
English: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

tcz: Nangin mikineosah ho nahuhdohjin ahinla mikiletsah ho nasujumjin ahi.
en: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.
text:
PSA 18:27
Thadou: Nangin mikineosah ho nahuhdohjin ahinla mikiletsah ho nasujumjin ahi.
English: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

tcz: Nangin thaomei neidetpeh'in, Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen'in kamuthim jong neisalvah peh e.
en: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.
text:
PSA 18:28
Thadou: Nangin thaomei neidetpeh'in, Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen'in kamuthim jong neisalvah peh e.
English: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.

tcz: Nangma hatna chun kagalmi hi neisuhchip peh'in Elohim ka Pathen toh kapankhom poupou leh itobang bang sang hijongleh kakal ngapchan ahi.
en: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
text:
PSA 18:29
Thadou: Nangma hatna chun kagalmi hi neisuhchip peh'in Elohim ka Pathen toh kapankhom poupou leh itobang bang sang hijongleh kakal ngapchan ahi.
English: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

tcz: Elohim Pathen lampi chu nolnabei ahi! Yahweh Pakai kitepna jouse alolhing jinge. Amahi ahuhdoh ding ngaicha jouse dinga lum le pho ahi.
en: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
text:
PSA 18:30
Thadou: Elohim Pathen lampi chu nolnabei ahi! Yahweh Pakai kitepna jouse alolhing jinge. Amahi ahuhdoh ding ngaicha jouse dinga lum le pho ahi.
English: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai tailou pathen dang um'am? Elohim Pathen tailou songpi det dang um'am?
en: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God,
text:
PSA 18:31
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai tailou pathen dang um'am? Elohim Pathen tailou songpi det dang um'am?
English: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God,

tcz: Hiche Elohim Pathen hin eihatdoh sah'in kalampi jong hoibitnapen ahisah ahi.
en: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
text:
PSA 18:32
Thadou: Hiche Elohim Pathen hin eihatdoh sah'in kalampi jong hoibitnapen ahisah ahi.
English: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

tcz: Aman molsang hahsa chung dunga kadindet theina din kakeng jong sakhi keng bang'in atah sah e.
en: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.
text:
PSA 18:33
Thadou: Aman molsang hahsa chung dunga kadindet theina din kakeng jong sakhi keng bang'in atah sah e.
English: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.

tcz: Aman kakhut teni jong galsatna a manthei dingin agongin, kabanjang jong sum-eng thalpi loithei dingin ahatsah'in ahi.
en: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
text:
PSA 18:34
Thadou: Aman kakhut teni jong galsatna a manthei dingin agongin, kabanjang jong sum-eng thalpi loithei dingin ahatsah'in ahi.
English: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

tcz: Nangman nagaljona lum chu neipetan nabanjetnin neipanhun ahi. Neikithopina hin eithupi sah'in ahi.
en: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
text:
PSA 18:35
Thadou: Nangman nagaljona lum chu neipetan nabanjetnin neipanhun ahi. Neikithopina hin eithupi sah'in ahi.
English: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

tcz: Nang man kakeng phang tenin alhonal louna dingin kalampi neikehlet peh'in ahi.
en: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
text:
PSA 18:36
Thadou: Nang man kakeng phang tenin alhonal louna dingin kalampi neikehlet peh'in ahi.
English: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

tcz: Keiman kagalmite kadel'in kaman'in ahi; amahohi kajo kahsen katangpon ahi.
en: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
text:
PSA 18:37
Thadou: Keiman kagalmite kadel'in kaman'in ahi; amahohi kajo kahsen katangpon ahi.
English: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

tcz: Amahohi ahung ki thodoh jou louna diuvin kasat lhun kakeng noijah akijammun ahi.
en: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
text:
PSA 18:38
Thadou: Amahohi ahung ki thodoh jou louna diuvin kasat lhun kakeng noijah akijammun ahi.
English: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

tcz: Nangin kagalsatna dingin thahatnan neivon in; Nangman kagalmite chu kakengphang noi a neikoipeh e.
en: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
text:
PSA 18:39
Thadou: Nangin kagalsatna dingin thahatnan neivon in; Nangman kagalmite chu kakengphang noi a neikoipeh e.
English: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

tcz: Nangin angongchang'u neichotpha sah'in eivetda ho jouse chu kasumang sohtan ahi.
en: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
text:
PSA 18:40
Thadou: Nangin angongchang'u neichotpha sah'in eivetda ho jouse chu kasumang sohtan ahi.
English: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

tcz: Amahon panpi athummun koiman ahung huhdoh pouve. Amahon Yahweh Pakai akouvun ahinla Aman adonbut pon ahi.
en: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.
text:
PSA 18:41
Thadou: Amahon panpi athummun koiman ahung huhdoh pouve. Amahon Yahweh Pakai akouvun ahinla Aman adonbut pon ahi.
English: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.

tcz: Keiman amaho chu huilah a vutvai kithethang bangin tol ah kagoibong sel'in, bonlhoh lah'a kasunat gamatai.
en: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
text:
PSA 18:42
Thadou: Keiman amaho chu huilah a vutvai kithethang bangin tol ah kagoibong sel'in, bonlhoh lah'a kasunat gamatai.
English: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

tcz: Nangin eihouse jing ho chungah galjona neipetan ahi. Nangin namtin vaipi chungah vaihom'in neipansah tan ahi. Kanahet phahlou miho jeng jong kalhachan ahungpang tauvin ahi.
en: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
text:
PSA 18:43
Thadou: Nangin eihouse jing ho chungah galjona neipetan ahi. Nangin namtin vaipi chungah vaihom'in neipansah tan ahi. Kanahet phahlou miho jeng jong kalhachan ahungpang tauvin ahi.
English: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

tcz: Kamin ajah jah'un kanoijah alut un gamchommi hojeng jong ka-anga akisunem gamtauvin ahi.
en: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
text:
PSA 18:44
Thadou: Kamin ajah jah'un kanoijah alut un gamchommi hojeng jong ka-anga akisunem gamtauvin ahi.
English: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

tcz: Hansanna aneijou tapouvin kithing pumpum'in ka-ang ahinbel tauvin ahi.
en: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.
text:
PSA 18:45
Thadou: Hansanna aneijou tapouvin kithing pumpum'in ka-ang ahinbel tauvin ahi.
English: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ahing jinge, kasongpia apanjeh'in kathangvah e! Ka sochatna Elohim ka Pathen chu loupi jing tahen!
en: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
text:
PSA 18:46
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ahing jinge, kasongpia apanjeh'in kathangvah e! Ka sochatna Elohim ka Pathen chu loupi jing tahen!
English: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,

tcz: Amahi eibolse ho lethuh jinga Elohim ka Pathen chu ahin, aman namtin vaipi hi eisuhnem peh'in kanoijah eikoipeh tai.
en: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.
text:
PSA 18:47
Thadou: Amahi eibolse ho lethuh jinga Elohim ka Pathen chu ahin, aman namtin vaipi hi eisuhnem peh'in kanoijah eikoipeh tai.
English: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

tcz: Chuleh kagalmitea konnin eihuhdoh'in nangman kagalmiten aphah joulouna munnah neikoijin, eidouva mi-engse hoa konnin neihoidohsah tan ahi.
en: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
text:
PSA 18:48
Thadou: Chuleh kagalmitea konnin eihuhdoh'in nangman kagalmiten aphah joulouna munnah neikoijin, eidouva mi-engse hoa konnin neihoidohsah tan ahi.
English: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

tcz: Hichejeh hin O Yahweh Pakai namtin vaipi lah'a nathangvah ingkate, na min vahchoinan la sang nge.
en: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
text:
PSA 18:49
Thadou: Hichejeh hin O Yahweh Pakai namtin vaipi lah'a nathangvah ingkate, na min vahchoinan la sang nge.
English: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

tcz: Nangin leng a natun pa din goljona loupitah chu napetai; Chuleh nathaonupa David leh achilhahte chunga nalungset longlou namusah e.
en: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.
text:
PSA 18:50
Thadou: Nangin leng a natun pa din goljona loupitah chu napetai; Chuleh nathaonupa David leh achilhahte chunga nalungset longlou namusah e.
English: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.

tcz: Vanho'n Elohim Pathen loupina aphongdoh un ahi. Vanthamjol hon jong akhut thepna atahlangui.
en: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
text:
PSA 19:1
Thadou: Vanho'n Elohim Pathen loupina aphongdoh un ahi. Vanthamjol hon jong akhut thepna atahlangui.
English: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

tcz: Anitin in aphongdoh jing jeng un; jansim janseh le amachu aseiphong jingui.
en: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
text:
PSA 19:2
Thadou: Anitin in aphongdoh jing jeng un; jansim janseh le amachu aseiphong jingui.
English: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

tcz: Ocheng soh lou vin thu asei un; a ocheng'u hi akijakha ngaipoi.
en: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.
text:
PSA 19:3
Thadou: Ocheng soh lou vin thu asei un; a ocheng'u hi akijakha ngaipoi.
English: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

tcz: Ahinlah athu chun vainoi alodim in, thucheng jong chun vannoi leiset athechansoh in ahi. Vanthamjol hoa Elohim Pathen in nisa chenna ding asem peh e.
en: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
text:
PSA 19:4
Thadou: Ahinlah athu chun vainoi alodim in, thucheng jong chun vannoi leiset athechansoh in ahi. Vanthamjol hoa Elohim Pathen in nisa chenna ding asem peh e.
English: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

tcz: Hihchu kichen jouva moulang emsel a ahung potdoh bangin avahchan jengin ahi. Kisongtah a lhaitet golseh a pango bang in haltah le kipah tah in aum e.
en: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
text:
PSA 19:5
Thadou: Hihchu kichen jouva moulang emsel a ahung potdoh bangin avahchan jengin ahi. Kisongtah a lhaitet golseh a pango bang in haltah le kipah tah in aum e.
English: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

tcz: Vanmong langkhatna konnin nisa ahung sohdoh jin ajotna ding vanmong lang khat gei in ajui peh jie. Hiche asat a kon chun imacha ahoidoh ji poi.
en: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
text:
PSA 19:6
Thadou: Vanmong langkhatna konnin nisa ahung sohdoh jin ajotna ding vanmong lang khat gei in ajui peh jie. Hiche asat a kon chun imacha ahoidoh ji poi.
English: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thuhil hohi achamkim in, lhagaova asuhhal jing in ahi. Yahweh Pakai Dan thu hohi tahsanthei tah ahin milham jong chihsah jengthei ahi.
en: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
text:
PSA 19:7
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai thuhil hohi achamkim in, lhagaova asuhhal jing in ahi. Yahweh Pakai Dan thu hohi tahsanthei tah ahin milham jong chihsah jengthei ahi.
English: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thupeh hohi adih'in, lungthim kipasah ji e. Yahweh Pakai thupeh hohi akicheh'in lungsunga hetthem theina eipeuvin ahi.
en: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
text:
PSA 19:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai thupeh hohi adih'in, lungthim kipasah ji e. Yahweh Pakai thupeh hohi akicheh'in lungsunga hetthem theina eipeuvin ahi.
English: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ginle jana neihi athengin ahi, hichehi tonsotna ding ahitai. Yahweh Pakai thutan hi adih'e; a etih a dih jing jeng ahi.
en: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
text:
PSA 19:9
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ginle jana neihi athengin ahi, hichehi tonsotna ding ahitai. Yahweh Pakai thutan hi adih'e; a etih a dih jing jeng ahi.
English: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

tcz: Hicheho chu sana sanga deiumjo ahin, sana thengpen sanga jong deiumjo ahi. Khoiju sangin jong alhumjon, akhoiphang dunga kilhoh lhatil sangin jong alhumjoi.
en: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
text:
PSA 19:10
Thadou: Hicheho chu sana sanga deiumjo ahin, sana thengpen sanga jong deiumjo ahi. Khoiju sangin jong alhumjon, akhoiphang dunga kilhoh lhatil sangin jong alhumjoi.
English: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

tcz: Hicheho hi nasohpa dinga gihsal na ahin, nathu nung hoa dia kipana chanvou lentah ahi.
en: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
text:
PSA 19:11
Thadou: Hicheho hi nasohpa dinga gihsal na ahin, nathu nung hoa dia kipana chanvou lentah ahi.
English: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

tcz: Kalungsunga chonset kisel guh jouse hi itikahetdoh jouding ham? Hitobanga kiselgua setna hoa konhin neisilthengin.
en: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
text:
PSA 19:12
Thadou: Kalungsunga chonset kisel guh jouse hi itikahetdoh jouding ham? Hitobanga kiselgua setna hoa konhin neisilthengin.
English: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

tcz: Nasoh hi henasasa chonset bolna a konnin neihuhdoh'in! Hicheho hi kachunga vaihomsah hihbeh'in, chuteng keima chonsetna a konna kahoidoh ding ahi.
en: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
text:
PSA 19:13
Thadou: Nasoh hi henasasa chonset bolna a konnin neihuhdoh'in! Hicheho hi kachunga vaihomsah hihbeh'in, chuteng keima chonsetna a konna kahoidoh ding ahi.
English: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

tcz: Kakam a kon'a hung potdoh thucheng holeh kalungsunga kalunggel ho nalunglhaina hihen, O Yahweh Pakai kasongpi leh eihuhhingpu.
en: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.
text:
PSA 19:14
Thadou: Kakam a kon'a hung potdoh thucheng holeh kalungsunga kalunggel ho nalunglhaina hihen, O Yahweh Pakai kasongpi leh eihuhhingpu.
English: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.

tcz: Na hahsat nikhon Yahweh Pakai'in nakana taona nadonbut hen. Jacob Pathen Elohim min chun thilse jousea kon in nahoidoh hen.
en: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
text:
PSA 20:1
Thadou: Na hahsat nikhon Yahweh Pakai'in nakana taona nadonbut hen. Jacob Pathen Elohim min chun thilse jousea kon in nahoidoh hen.
English: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

tcz: Aman ahouintheng a kon'in kithopina nahin pejing henlang Jerusalem a kon in nahin hatsah jinghen.
en: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
text:
PSA 20:2
Thadou: Aman ahouintheng a kon'in kithopina nahin pejing henlang Jerusalem a kon in nahin hatsah jinghen.
English: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

tcz: Elohim Pathen'in namaicham thilto ho hingeldoh jinghen lang chuleh napumgo thiltoho jong khotona in nahin vetpeh jinghen.
en: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.
text:
PSA 20:3
Thadou: Elohim Pathen'in namaicham thilto ho hingeldoh jinghen lang chuleh napumgo thiltoho jong khotona in nahin vetpeh jinghen.
English: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

tcz: Elohim Pathen'in nalunga nangaichat nape henlang nathilgon jouse nalolhinsah soh keihen.
en: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
text:
PSA 20:4
Thadou: Elohim Pathen'in nalunga nangaichat nape henlang nathilgon jouse nalolhinsah soh keihen.
English: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

tcz: Nagaljona thu kajah tenguleh kipah'a kasapdiu ahi, chuleh Elohim ka Pathen u minna galjona ponlop kadopsangdiu ahi. Yahweh Pakai in natao na jouse donbut jing hen.
en: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.
text:
PSA 20:5
Thadou: Nagaljona thu kajah tenguleh kipah'a kasapdiu ahi, chuleh Elohim ka Pathen u minna galjona ponlop kadopsangdiu ahi. Yahweh Pakai in natao na jouse donbut jing hen.
English: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.

tcz: Tun keiman athaonu lengpa chu Yahweh Pakai in ahuhdohji ti ka hetai. Aman avan mun thenga kon a ahin donbut ding, chuleh athahatna nasatah a chu ahuhdoh ding ahi.
en: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
text:
PSA 20:6
Thadou: Tun keiman athaonu lengpa chu Yahweh Pakai in ahuhdohji ti ka hetai. Aman avan mun thenga kon a ahin donbut ding, chuleh athahatna nasatah a chu ahuhdoh ding ahi.
English: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

tcz: Namtin vaipi abankhat chun a sakol u leh sakol kangtalai hou akiletsah piuvin, ahin eihonvang Yahweh Pakai, eihon Elohim Pathen u minbou ikiletsahpi diu ahi.
en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
text:
PSA 20:7
Thadou: Namtin vaipi abankhat chun a sakol u leh sakol kangtalai hou akiletsah piuvin, ahin eihonvang Yahweh Pakai, eihon Elohim Pathen u minbou ikiletsahpi diu ahi.
English: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

tcz: Namtin vaipi hohi hunglhu'u vintin chip lhadiu ahi, ahinla eihovang idindoh diu chule dehtah a idin diu ahi.
en: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
text:
PSA 20:8
Thadou: Namtin vaipi hohi hunglhu'u vintin chip lhadiu ahi, ahinla eihovang idindoh diu chule dehtah a idin diu ahi.
English: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

tcz: Kalengpau chu galjona pe'n, O Yahweh Pakai! Panpi ngai a kakana neidonbut tei in.
en: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!
text:
PSA 20:9
Thadou: Kalengpau chu galjona pe'n, O Yahweh Pakai! Panpi ngai a kakana neidonbut tei in.
English: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!

tcz: Nathahatna ahi lengpa iti kipah hitam O Yahweh Pakai! Galjona napehjeh'in aman kipah'in kho asam e.
en: The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
text:
PSA 21:1
Thadou: Nathahatna ahi lengpa iti kipah hitam O Yahweh Pakai! Galjona napehjeh'in aman kipah'in kho asam e.
English: The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

tcz: Ajeh chu nangin alungthim'a angaichan napen aman athumho khatcha jong nadapeh poi.
en: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
text:
PSA 21:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangin alungthim'a angaichan napen aman athumho khatcha jong nadapeh poi.
English: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

tcz: Nangin lolhin naleh houtheinan nalamto jin, aluchungah sana hoipen lallukhuh nakhuhsah'in ahi.
en: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
text:
PSA 21:3
Thadou: Nangin lolhin naleh houtheinan nalamto jin, aluchungah sana hoipen lallukhuh nakhuhsah'in ahi.
English: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

tcz: Aman ahinkho nahoitup peh din athumjin, chule nangin ataona nasanpeh jie. Ahin nikho jong tonsot a din nasuh saopeh ji e.
en: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
text:
PSA 21:4
Thadou: Aman ahinkho nahoitup peh din athumjin, chule nangin ataona nasanpeh jie. Ahin nikho jong tonsot a din nasuh saopeh ji e.
English: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

tcz: Nagaljona chun jabolna lentah achansah in, thupina le loupinan najemhoijin ahi.
en: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
text:
PSA 21:5
Thadou: Nagaljona chun jabolna lentah achansah in, thupina le loupinan najemhoijin ahi.
English: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

tcz: Nangin tonsot malsomnan naphungvuh in chuleh nangtoh umkhom a nopna kipana achun naphung vuh e.
en: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
text:
PSA 21:6
Thadou: Nangin tonsot malsomnan naphungvuh in chuleh nangtoh umkhom a nopna kipana achun naphung vuh e.
English: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

tcz: Ajeh chu lengpa'n Yahweh Pakai atahsan e. Hat chungnung ngailutna longlou chun alhuhna dinga konnin na hoidoh sah jingin ahi.
en: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
text:
PSA 21:7
Thadou: Ajeh chu lengpa'n Yahweh Pakai atahsan e. Hat chungnung ngailutna longlou chun alhuhna dinga konnin na hoidoh sah jingin ahi.
English: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

tcz: Nangin nagalmiho chu namattup sohkei ding, nangma nadouho jouse chu thahattah na banjetna chu na mattup ding ahi.
en: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
text:
PSA 21:8
Thadou: Nangin nagalmiho chu namattup sohkei ding, nangma nadouho jouse chu thahattah na banjetna chu na mattup ding ahi.
English: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

tcz: Nangma nahung teng amaho chu meikong lah'a naselut ding ahi. Yahweh Pakai in alunghanna a asuhgam ding meikonga ahalgam ding ahi.
en: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.
text:
PSA 21:9
Thadou: Nangma nahung teng amaho chu meikong lah'a naselut ding ahi. Yahweh Pakai in alunghanna a asuhgam ding meikonga ahalgam ding ahi.
English: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

tcz: Achateu leiset chunga kon a nathaimang ding; amahon sonlepah aneikitlou diu ahi.
en: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
text:
PSA 21:10
Thadou: Achateu leiset chunga kon a nathaimang ding; amahon sonlepah aneikitlou diu ahi.
English: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

tcz: Amahon nangdounan thil gong jongleu, athilse gonhou chu lolhing louding ahi.
