en: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
text:
PSA 21:11
Thadou: Amahon nangdounan thil gong jongleu, athilse gonhou chu lolhing louding ahi.
English: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon nathalchang amaho kapna dinga nadoi chu amutenguleh kiheimang untin jammang diu ahitai.
en: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
text:
PSA 21:12
Thadou: Ajeh chu amahon nathalchang amaho kapna dinga nadoi chu amutenguleh kiheimang untin jammang diu ahitai.
English: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai na thahat na nasatah a chun hungthou doh tan. Tumgin le lasah to thoa nahat na natoh chu kakipa pi diu ahi.
en: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
text:
PSA 21:13
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai na thahat na nasatah a chun hungthou doh tan. Tumgin le lasah to thoa nahat na natoh chu kakipa pi diu ahi.
English: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

tcz: Ka Pathen Elohim, ka Pathen idia neidalhah hitam? Panpi ngai a kamao teng idia gamlha tah a um ji nahim?
en: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
text:
PSA 22:1
Thadou: Ka Pathen Elohim, ka Pathen idia neidalhah hitam? Panpi ngai a kamao teng idia gamlha tah a um ji nahim?
English: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

tcz: Niseh in nangma kakoujie, Elohim ka Pathen, hinlah nangin nei donbut poi. Janseh jongleh kakou ogin naja jin, hinlah lungmon na kanei jipoi.
en: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
text:
PSA 22:2
Thadou: Niseh in nangma kakoujie, Elohim ka Pathen, hinlah nangin nei donbut poi. Janseh jongleh kakou ogin naja jin, hinlah lungmon na kanei jipoi.
English: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.

tcz: Israel'in athangvah jing laltouna-a tou nangmahi Atheng nahi.
en: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.
text:
PSA 22:3
Thadou: Israel'in athangvah jing laltouna-a tou nangmahi Atheng nahi.
English: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

tcz: Kapu kapa teovin nangma natahsan un, nangman amaho nahuh hing tai.
en: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.
text:
PSA 22:4
Thadou: Kapu kapa teovin nangma natahsan un, nangman amaho nahuh hing tai.
English: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.

tcz: Naheng a akap un huhhing in a umtaove. Amahon nangma natahsan un nang man amaho nasujum poi.
en: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.
text:
PSA 22:5
Thadou: Naheng a akap un huhhing in a umtaove. Amahon nangma natahsan un nang man amaho nasujum poi.
English: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.

tcz: Hinlah keima hi mihem a dia lhing joulou lungtol bang bep kahi. Mijouse dia thet umle musit umchu kahitai!
en: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
text:
PSA 22:6
Thadou: Hinlah keima hi mihem a dia lhing joulou lungtol bang bep kahi. Mijouse dia thet umle musit umchu kahitai!
English: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

tcz: Eimu jousen eihouseovin, aleiju adosah un, alu apeijun asei uve,
en: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
text:
PSA 22:7
Thadou: Eimu jousen eihouseovin, aleiju adosah un, alu apeijun asei uve,
English: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,

tcz: “Ama pa hi Elohim Pathena ki ngai pa chu hilou ham? Achuti le a Pathen Elohim chu kihuhdoh sah hen! Yahweh Pakai in amahi angailut a ahileh aYahweh Pakai in huh doh hen!”
en: “He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
text:
PSA 22:8
Thadou: “Ama pa hi Elohim Pathena ki ngai pa chu hilou ham? Achuti le a Pathen Elohim chu kihuhdoh sah hen! Yahweh Pakai in amahi angailut a ahileh aYahweh Pakai in huh doh hen!”
English: “He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”

tcz: Nangin kanu naobusunga konin neina hoidamin nei pui galkai in, kanu a-anglum laija patna nangma tahsanje neina hil ahitai.
en: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.
text:
PSA 22:9
Thadou: Nangin kanu naobusunga konin neina hoidamin nei pui galkai in, kanu a-anglum laija patna nangma tahsanje neina hil ahitai.
English: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.

tcz: Kahung pen a patna nangma ban thahatna a eikipelut a ahitai. Kahung penlhah a patna ka Pathen chu nangma nahi jing e.
en: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
text:
PSA 22:10
Thadou: Kahung pen a patna nangma ban thahatna a eikipelut a ahitai. Kahung penlhah a patna ka Pathen chu nangma nahi jing e.
English: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.

tcz: Keija kon in gamla loujen in ajeh chu boina ahungnai in, koima dang eikithopi thei aumpoi.
en: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
text:
PSA 22:11
Thadou: Keija kon in gamla loujen in ajeh chu boina ahungnai in, koima dang eikithopi thei aumpoi.
English: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.

tcz: Bongchal ho'n aum kimvel bangin kagal miten eihin um kimvel taovin, Bashan bongchal khohlai hon eium kimvel taove!
en: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
text:
PSA 22:12
Thadou: Bongchal ho'n aum kimvel bangin kagal miten eihin um kimvel taovin, Bashan bongchal khohlai hon eium kimvel taove!
English: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

tcz: Hang tah le kisong tah Keipi bahkai in aneh ding aboltel bangin keima val lhum dingin akamkau ve.
en: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
text:
PSA 22:13
Thadou: Hang tah le kisong tah Keipi bahkai in aneh ding aboltel bangin keima val lhum dingin akamkau ve.
English: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

tcz: Kahinkho hi twi banga kisunglha ahitai, kagu kachang hojong akilhep gamtan, kalungchang jong khoilu bangin ajunlha gamtai.
en: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
text:
PSA 22:14
Thadou: Kahinkho hi twi banga kisunglha ahitai, kagu kachang hojong akilhep gamtan, kalungchang jong khoilu bangin ajunlha gamtai.
English: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.

tcz: Nisan asah gep leilhang bangin katha akanghel jengtai. Kaleijong kadang chungah akikamat tai. Nangin vutvai lah a neijam in athidin neida lhatan ahi.
en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.
text:
PSA 22:15
Thadou: Nisan asah gep leilhang bangin katha akanghel jengtai. Kaleijong kadang chungah akikamat tai. Nangin vutvai lah a neijam in athidin neida lhatan ahi.
English: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

tcz: Kagalmiten uichahon bangin eium kimvel taovin. Migilou honkhat in eium kimvel taovin ahi.
en: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
text:
PSA 22:16
Thadou: Kagalmiten uichahon bangin eium kimvel taovin. Migilou honkhat in eium kimvel taovin ahi.
English: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

tcz: Kagu kachang hojong simthei ahisoh tan. Kagal miten eiveovin eivesalteh jengun ahi.
en: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.
text:
PSA 22:17
Thadou: Kagu kachang hojong simthei ahisoh tan. Kagal miten eiveovin eivesalteh jengun ahi.
English: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

tcz: Kavon hojong vang asan un akihom gamtaovin ahi.
en: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.
text:
PSA 22:18
Thadou: Kavon hojong vang asan un akihom gamtaovin ahi.
English: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai keija konin umgamla hih behin! Nangma kathahatna nahi neihung kithopi loijin.
en: But don’t be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me!
text:
PSA 22:19
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai keija konin umgamla hih behin! Nangma kathahatna nahi neihung kithopi loijin.
English: But don’t be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me!

tcz: Nachemjam chun neihuhdoh in, kahinkho manlutah hi hiche uicha hoa kon in neihuhdoh peh in.
en: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
text:
PSA 22:20
Thadou: Nachemjam chun neihuhdoh in, kahinkho manlutah hi hiche uicha hoa kon in neihuhdoh peh in.
English: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

tcz: Keipi bahkai kam a kon in neiloidoh peh in lang hiche gambongchal hang kiteni ki a kon in neihuhdoh in.
en: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
text:
PSA 22:21
Thadou: Keipi bahkai kam a kon in neiloidoh peh in lang hiche gambongchal hang kiteni ki a kon in neihuhdoh in.
English: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.

tcz: Kasopi pasal holeh numeiho kom a naminhi phongjal leng katin, Houbung kikhom holah a nangma kathangvah ding ahi.
en: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
text:
PSA 22:22
Thadou: Kasopi pasal holeh numeiho kom a naminhi phongjal leng katin, Houbung kikhom holah a nangma kathangvah ding ahi.
English: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

tcz: Ama gingho jousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah hen! Jacob chilhahte jousen amachu ging uvin! Israel chate jousen amachu jana peohen!
en: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
text:
PSA 22:23
Thadou: Ama gingho jousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah hen! Jacob chilhahte jousen amachu ging uvin! Israel chate jousen amachu jana peohen!
English: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!

tcz: Ajeh chu aman migentheite thohgimna jouse chu anungsun pon, panpi ngaichatna a taona neiho angaipeh in ahi.
en: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
text:
PSA 22:24
Thadou: Ajeh chu aman migentheite thohgimna jouse chu anungsun pon, panpi ngaichatna a taona neiho angaipeh in ahi.
English: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

tcz: Keiman Houbung kikhopna lah a nangma kathang vahding ahi. Nangma chibai boh ho angsunga kakitepna kasuh bulhit ding ahi.
en: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
text:
PSA 22:25
Thadou: Keiman Houbung kikhopna lah a nangma kathang vahding ahi. Nangma chibai boh ho angsunga kakitepna kasuh bulhit ding ahi.
English: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

tcz: Mivaichaten neovintin vaset diu ahi. Yahweh Pakai holte jousen amachu athangvah diu ahi. Alung thim u tonsotna kipah jingding ahiuve.
en: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
text:
PSA 22:26
Thadou: Mivaichaten neovintin vaset diu ahi. Yahweh Pakai holte jousen amachu athangvah diu ahi. Alung thim u tonsotna kipah jingding ahiuve.
English: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

tcz: Vannoi leiset miten Yahweh Pakai chu ahin hetdoh diu chuleh akom a hung kilediu ahi. Chutengleh namtin vaipi insung jousen a anga hungkun cheh diu ahi.
en: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
text:
PSA 22:27
Thadou: Vannoi leiset miten Yahweh Pakai chu ahin hetdoh diu chuleh akom a hung kilediu ahi. Chutengleh namtin vaipi insung jousen a anga hungkun cheh diu ahi.
English: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

tcz: Ajeh chu leng thaneina chu Yahweh Pakai ama a bou ahi. Aman namtin vaipi chunga vai ahom ahi.
en: For the kingdom is the LORD’s. He is the ruler over the nations.
text:
PSA 22:28
Thadou: Ajeh chu leng thaneina chu Yahweh Pakai ama a bou ahi. Aman namtin vaipi chunga vai ahom ahi.
English: For the kingdom is the LORD’s. He is the ruler over the nations.

tcz: Leiset chunga mihaohon ankong sem untin chibai aboh diu ahi. Ahinkho kichai a leivui sohding athithei mihem jouse a anga kun cheh hen.
en: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.
text:
PSA 22:29
Thadou: Leiset chunga mihaohon ankong sem untin chibai aboh diu ahi. Ahinkho kichai a leivui sohding athithei mihem jouse a anga kun cheh hen.
English: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.

tcz: Ichate jouseuvin jong Ama kin ahinbol diu ahi. Ahung lhungding khang miten jong Yahweh Pakai kidanje chu ahin jahpeh diu ahi.
en: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
text:
PSA 22:30
Thadou: Ichate jouseuvin jong Ama kin ahinbol diu ahi. Ahung lhungding khang miten jong Yahweh Pakai kidanje chu ahin jahpeh diu ahi.
English: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.

tcz: Tua penglou laiho komma jong thudih a anatoh naho jouse hung kiseipeh ding ahi. Amahon athilbol natoh naho jouse ahin jahdiu ahi.
en: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
text:
PSA 22:31
Thadou: Tua penglou laiho komma jong thudih a anatoh naho jouse hung kiseipeh ding ahi. Amahon athilbol natoh naho jouse ahin jahdiu ahi.
English: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu akelngoi keima eiching pa ahi, keiman lhah samna neiponge.
en: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
text:
PSA 23:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu akelngoi keima eiching pa ahi, keiman lhah samna neiponge.
English: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

tcz: Aman hamhing dumlah lah a kelngoi bangin eikicholdo sahjin, kilinglou hel twiveina pang dungah eipuilei.
en: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
text:
PSA 23:2
Thadou: Aman hamhing dumlah lah a kelngoi bangin eikicholdo sahjin, kilinglou hel twiveina pang dungah eipuilei.
English: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in katha akiledoh ji. Amintheng khohsahna jalin lamdih lang jenga eipuilen ahi.
en: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
text:
PSA 23:3
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in katha akiledoh ji. Amintheng khohsahna jalin lamdih lang jenga eipuilen ahi.
English: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

tcz: Thim jin napen phaicham palgalkai jongleng keima kichaponge, ajeh chu nangman naum jing in nateng gol le namoljol chun neihongin neilhamon jinge.
en: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
text:
PSA 23:4
Thadou: Thim jin napen phaicham palgalkai jongleng keima kichaponge, ajeh chu nangman naum jing in nateng gol le namoljol chun neihongin neilhamon jinge.
English: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

tcz: Ka melmate masangtah jenga jong nangin kaneh ding ankong neiluipeh in, naphat theina thao ka lujangah neinupeh in kadon ding khonjong phatthei na aletset in ahi.
en: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
text:
PSA 23:5
Thadou: Ka melmate masangtah jenga jong nangin kaneh ding ankong neiluipeh in, naphat theina thao ka lujangah neinupeh in kadon ding khonjong phatthei na aletset in ahi.
English: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

tcz: Tahbeh in phatnale hepinan kahinkho lhung keiya eijui jingding ahi, chuleh keijong tonsot na Yahweh Pakai inn sunga kachenjing ding ahi.
en: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.
text:
PSA 23:6
Thadou: Tahbeh in phatnale hepinan kahinkho lhung keiya eijui jingding ahi, chuleh keijong tonsot na Yahweh Pakai inn sunga kachenjing ding ahi.
English: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.

tcz: vannoi leiset le asunga umjouse hi Yahweh Pakai a ahi. Vannoi pumpi le asunga cheng mihemte jousehi Ama a jeng ahi.
en: The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
text:
PSA 24:1
Thadou: vannoi leiset le asunga umjouse hi Yahweh Pakai a ahi. Vannoi pumpi le asunga cheng mihemte jousehi Ama a jeng ahi.
English: The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman leiset khombul hi twikhanglen chunga atun ahin, twipi thuhlah a aphudet ahi.
en: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
text:
PSA 24:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu Aman leiset khombul hi twikhanglen chunga atun ahin, twipi thuhlah a aphudet ahi.
English: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

tcz: Koiham Yahweh Pakai moul chunga kaldoh jouding? Koiham amunthenga dingthei ding?
en: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
text:
PSA 24:3
Thadou: Koiham Yahweh Pakai moul chunga kaldoh jouding? Koiham amunthenga dingthei ding?
English: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

tcz: Akhut le Alungthim thengho bou, chuleh milim semthu houlou le jou seilouho bou hidiu ahi.
en: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
text:
PSA 24:4
Thadou: Akhut le Alungthim thengho bou, chuleh milim semthu houlou le jou seilouho bou hidiu ahi.
English: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

tcz: Amahon bou Yahweh Pakai malsomna amudiu ahin, chuleh ahuh hingpao Elohim Pathen toh ki guijop na dihtah aneitheidiu ahi.
en: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
text:
PSA 24:5
Thadou: Amahon bou Yahweh Pakai malsomna amudiu ahin, chuleh ahuh hingpao Elohim Pathen toh ki guijop na dihtah aneitheidiu ahi.
English: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

tcz: Hitobang miho hinbou nangma naholthei diu chuleh Jacob Elohim Pathen nangma nachibai theidiu ahi.
en: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.
text:
PSA 24:6
Thadou: Hitobang miho hinbou nangma naholthei diu chuleh Jacob Elohim Pathen nangma nachibai theidiu ahi.
English: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

tcz: Khanglui kelkot ho kihonglen un! Khanglui kotpiho kihong len un lang leng loupi chu lutsah un.
en: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
text:
PSA 24:7
Thadou: Khanglui kelkot ho kihonglen un! Khanglui kotpiho kihong len un lang leng loupi chu lutsah un.
English: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

tcz: Koiham lengloupi chu? Yahweh Pakai hattah leh thupi tah, Yahweh Pakai koiman ajojou lou galhattah chu ahi.
en: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
text:
PSA 24:8
Thadou: Koiham lengloupi chu? Yahweh Pakai hattah leh thupi tah, Yahweh Pakai koiman ajojou lou galhattah chu ahi.
English: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

tcz: Khanglui kelkot ho kihong lennun, khanglui kotpiho kihong lennun, loupina leng chu lutsah un
en: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
text:
PSA 24:9
Thadou: Khanglui kelkot ho kihong lennun, khanglui kotpiho kihong lennun, loupina leng chu lutsah un
English: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

tcz: Koiham lengloupi chu? Van Elohim Pathen sepai, Ama hi leng loupi chu ahi.
en: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
text:
PSA 24:10
Thadou: Koiham lengloupi chu? Van Elohim Pathen sepai, Ama hi leng loupi chu ahi.
English: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, kahinkho hi nang kapetai.
en: To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.
text:
PSA 25:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, kahinkho hi nang kapetai.
English: To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.

tcz: Nang katahsan e Elohim ka Pathen! Nei jumso hihbeh in, chule kalel na a hin ka melmate kichoisang sah hihbeh in.
en: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
text:
PSA 25:2
Thadou: Nang katahsan e Elohim ka Pathen! Nei jumso hihbeh in, chule kalel na a hin ka melmate kichoisang sah hihbeh in.
English: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

tcz: Nangma tahsan koimachan jumna ato loudiu ahi, amavang mijoulhep gojing honvang jumna ato diu ahi.
en: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
text:
PSA 25:3
Thadou: Nangma tahsan koimachan jumna ato loudiu ahi, amavang mijoulhep gojing honvang jumna ato diu ahi.
English: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai lamdih chu neihil in; kajuiding lampi chu neiko peh in.
en: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.
text:
PSA 25:4
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai lamdih chu neihil in; kajuiding lampi chu neiko peh in.
English: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.

tcz: Nathutah chu neihil in hichea chun neipui in ajeh chu nangmahi eihuh hinga Elohim ka Pathen chu nahi. Nilhum kei keijin nanga hin kinepna kanei jinge.
en: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
text:
PSA 25:5
Thadou: Nathutah chu neihil in hichea chun neipui in ajeh chu nangmahi eihuh hinga Elohim ka Pathen chu nahi. Nilhum kei keijin nanga hin kinepna kanei jinge.
English: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai gol lui a patna neihin puinao nami khoto nale na mingailutna longlou hingeldoh in.
en: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
text:
PSA 25:6
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai gol lui a patna neihin puinao nami khoto nale na mingailutna longlou hingeldoh in.
English: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

tcz: Ka khangdon lai a kachonset gitlou naho neigeldoh peh hih inlang nami ngailutna longlouva neipuina johchu galdoh in, ajeh chu nangma milungset them nahi, O Yahweh Pakai.
en: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.
text:
PSA 25:7
Thadou: Ka khangdon lai a kachonset gitlou naho neigeldoh peh hih inlang nami ngailutna longlouva neipuina johchu galdoh in, ajeh chu nangma milungset them nahi, O Yahweh Pakai.
English: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.

tcz: Yahweh Pakaihi apha ahin adih jengbou abol'e, aman lamdihlou vache ho jeng jong lamdih akopeh jinge.
en: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
text:
PSA 25:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakaihi apha ahin adih jengbou abol'e, aman lamdihlou vache ho jeng jong lamdih akopeh jinge.
English: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

tcz: Aman mi kineosah hochu lamdih a apuijin, ama dei lampi chu ahil jinge.
en: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
text:
PSA 25:9
Thadou: Aman mi kineosah hochu lamdih a apuijin, ama dei lampi chu ahil jinge.
English: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kitepna nitjing holeh ama deipeh dungjuija chonho chu ami ngailutna longlou leh akitahna in apuihoi jinge.
en: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
text:
PSA 25:10
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai kitepna nitjing holeh ama deipeh dungjuija chonho chu ami ngailutna longlou leh akitahna in apuihoi jinge.
English: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

tcz: Namin loupina dingin O Yahweh Pakai, ka chonsetna simjoulou neingai dam in.
en: For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
text:
PSA 25:11
Thadou: Namin loupina dingin O Yahweh Pakai, ka chonsetna simjoulou neingai dam in.
English: For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ging ho chu koi ho hiuvam? Amaho che nading lampi chu Yahweh Pakai in avetsah ding ahi.
en: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
text:
PSA 25:12
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ging ho chu koi ho hiuvam? Amaho che nading lampi chu Yahweh Pakai in avetsah ding ahi.
English: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

tcz: Amaho chu khangtou untin achateovin jong gamsung alodingu ahi.
en: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
text:
PSA 25:13
Thadou: Amaho chu khangtou untin achateovin jong gamsung alodingu ahi.
English: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi ama gingjing tedinga golphapen ahin, Aman hitobang miho chu akitepna ahiljing e.
en: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
text:
PSA 25:14
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi ama gingjing tedinga golphapen ahin, Aman hitobang miho chu akitepna ahiljing e.
English: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

tcz: Kamit tenin Yahweh Pakaichu avejingin, aman kagalmite thangkol a kon in eihuhdoh jinging e.
en: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
text:
PSA 25:15
Thadou: Kamit tenin Yahweh Pakaichu avejingin, aman kagalmite thangkol a kon in eihuhdoh jinging e.
English: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

tcz: Neihin ang-ngatnin lang neikho ton, ajeh chu keima kachangseh a lungthom haotah a um a kahi.
en: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
text:
PSA 25:16
Thadou: Neihin ang-ngatnin lang neikho ton, ajeh chu keima kachangseh a lungthom haotah a um a kahi.
English: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

tcz: Kaboi na ho akhoh se cheh un. Oh hichehoa konhin neihuhdoh in.
en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
text:
PSA 25:17
Thadou: Kaboi na ho akhoh se cheh un. Oh hichehoa konhin neihuhdoh in.
English: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

tcz: Kalung gimnahi neihet pehin chuleh kahah satna hohi neivet peh inlang kachonset naho ngaidam in.
en: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
text:
PSA 25:18
Thadou: Kalung gimnahi neihet pehin chuleh kahah satna hohi neivet peh inlang kachonset naho ngaidam in.
English: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

tcz: Ven galmi ijat mong kanei hitam chule ama hohin ichan geija eihotnu hitam!
en: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
text:
PSA 25:19
Thadou: Ven galmi ijat mong kanei hitam chule ama hohin ichan geija eihotnu hitam!
English: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

tcz: Neivengbit in! amaho akona hin kahinkho huhdoh in! nangma a kisel kahi neijumso hihbeh in.
en: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
text:
PSA 25:20
Thadou: Neivengbit in! amaho akona hin kahinkho huhdoh in! nangma a kisel kahi neijumso hihbeh in.
English: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

tcz: Kitah nale thenna in eivengbit hen ajeh chu nanga hin kakinepna aum jinge.
en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
text:
PSA 25:21
Thadou: Kitah nale thenna in eivengbit hen ajeh chu nanga hin kakinepna aum jinge.
English: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

tcz: Vo Elohim Pathen Israelte hi aboi najouseu va kon in lhatdoh tan.
en: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.
text:
PSA 25:22
Thadou: Vo Elohim Pathen Israelte hi aboi najouseu va kon in lhatdoh tan.
English: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai themmo na bei kahihi phongdoh tan, ajeh chu keiman kitah na neitah in hinkho kamang in nungchonlou hel in Yahweh Pakai a tahsan na dettah kaneije.
en: Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.
text:
PSA 26:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai themmo na bei kahihi phongdoh tan, ajeh chu keiman kitah na neitah in hinkho kamang in nungchonlou hel in Yahweh Pakai a tahsan na dettah kaneije.
English: Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai neipatep inlang neikhol chil in, kachondan leh kalungthim hi vechen mongin!
en: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
text:
PSA 26:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai neipatep inlang neikhol chil in, kachondan leh kalungthim hi vechen mongin!
English: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

tcz: Ajeh chu neingailutna longlouhi keiman kahejing e, chuleh keiman nathudih dung jui in hinkho kamange.
en: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
text:
PSA 26:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu neingailutna longlouhi keiman kahejing e, chuleh keiman nathudih dung jui in hinkho kamange.
English: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

tcz: Keima mijouho tojong kakivop khompon, miphalhem ho deilam jong kachepipon ahi.
en: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
text:
PSA 26:4
Thadou: Keima mijouho tojong kakivop khompon, miphalhem ho deilam jong kachepipon ahi.
English: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

tcz: Keiman migiloute kikhop na kathet in thilphalou hojong kanuse ji e.
en: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
text:
PSA 26:5
Thadou: Keiman migiloute kikhop na kathet in thilphalou hojong kanuse ji e.
English: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

tcz: Themmona kaneilou vetsahna in kakhut kasil in namaicham kahin jon e O Yahweh Pakai,
en: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,
text:
PSA 26:6
Thadou: Themmona kaneilou vetsahna in kakhut kasil in namaicham kahin jon e O Yahweh Pakai,
English: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,

tcz: Thangvah la sapum in nakidan na ho kaphong doh e.
en: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.
text:
PSA 26:7
Thadou: Thangvah la sapum in nakidan na ho kaphong doh e.
English: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

tcz: Na houin theng kangailui, Yahweh Pakai, naum pi na loipi tah kilan doh na mun chu.
en: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
text:
PSA 26:8
Thadou: Na houin theng kangailui, Yahweh Pakai, naum pi na loipi tah kilan doh na mun chu.
English: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

tcz: Michonse ho thoh ding neithoh sah hih in, tolthat hoto kibang in neithep mo sah hih in.
en: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men
text:
PSA 26:9
Thadou: Michonse ho thoh ding neithoh sah hih in, tolthat hoto kibang in neithep mo sah hih in.
English: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men

tcz: Set bolnom nan akhutnu asuboh un, chuleh amahon phatseh in nehguh akilah un ahi.
en: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.
text:
PSA 26:10
Thadou: Set bolnom nan akhutnu asuboh un, chuleh amahon phatseh in nehguh akilah un ahi.
English: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.

tcz: Keiman hitobang hinkho chu kamangpon, kitahna hinkhoa kading jinge. Hijeh chun neilhat doh inlang nami hepina chun neipuijin.
en: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
text:
PSA 26:11
Thadou: Keiman hitobang hinkho chu kamangpon, kitahna hinkhoa kading jinge. Hijeh chun neilhat doh inlang nami hepina chun neipuijin.
English: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

tcz: Tun keima tolgo lai a dettah in kadinge chuleh keiman lhangphong tah a Yahweh Pakai kathang vahding ahi.
en: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.
text:
PSA 26:12
Thadou: Tun keima tolgo lai a dettah in kadinge chuleh keiman lhangphong tah a Yahweh Pakai kathang vahding ahi.
English: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.

tcz: Yahweh Pakaihi keidin vah leh huhhingna ahi. Chuti ahileh idia kakichat ding ham? Yahweh Pakaihi kakulpi, hahsatna a eihuhdoh pa ahi. Chuti ahileh ken idia kakithin ding ham?
en: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
text:
PSA 27:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakaihi keidin vah leh huhhingna ahi. Chuti ahileh idia kakichat ding ham? Yahweh Pakaihi kakulpi, hahsatna a eihuhdoh pa ahi. Chuti ahileh ken idia kakithin ding ham?
English: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

tcz: Migilou ten suhgamdia eihindel khum uva, kagalmite leh eidou teovin eihin nokhumteng uleh kipal lhuvintin chuleh lhugam diu ahi.
en: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
text:
PSA 27:2
Thadou: Migilou ten suhgamdia eihindel khum uva, kagalmite leh eidou teovin eihin nokhumteng uleh kipal lhuvintin chuleh lhugam diu ahi.
English: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

tcz: Galmi tamtah in eium kimvel jeng jongleh kalung linglao ponte, ijemtin thagam dingin eihin delkhum jongleo Elohim ka Pathen a lung mongtah a kaum ding ahi.
en: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
text:
PSA 27:3
Thadou: Galmi tamtah in eium kimvel jeng jongleh kalung linglao ponte, ijemtin thagam dingin eihin delkhum jongleo Elohim ka Pathen a lung mongtah a kaum ding ahi.
English: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

tcz: Hiche thilkhat Yahweh Pakai henga kathum kadei pipen chu kahinkho lhumkeija Yahweh Pakai in na umding, Yahweh Pakai lolhinna a chu lunglhaisel a um a ahouin na aphatnaho geljinga hinkho manding hi ahi.
en: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
text:
PSA 27:4
Thadou: Hiche thilkhat Yahweh Pakai henga kathum kadei pipen chu kahinkho lhumkeija Yahweh Pakai in na umding, Yahweh Pakai lolhinna a chu lunglhaisel a um a ahouin na aphatnaho geljinga hinkho manding hi ahi.
English: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

tcz: Ajeh chu aman hahsatna a konna eihoidoh sahding a Houin thenga chu eihoibit ding Aman mi maiphah louva songpi chunga eiselding ahi.
en: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.
text:
PSA 27:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu aman hahsatna a konna eihoidoh sahding a Houin thenga chu eihoibit ding Aman mi maiphah louva songpi chunga eiselding ahi.
English: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

tcz: Ajeh chu boina hon eihin lonkhum jong le Aman eihoi dam ding ahi. Ama houintheng sunga kipah le thanom tah a pumgo thilto kabolding semjang saipum a Yahweh Pakai thangvah la kasah ding ahi.
en: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.
text:
PSA 27:6
Thadou: Ajeh chu boina hon eihin lonkhum jong le Aman eihoi dam ding ahi. Ama houintheng sunga kipah le thanom tah a pumgo thilto kabolding semjang saipum a Yahweh Pakai thangvah la kasah ding ahi.
English: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.

tcz: Kahung taove neingai peh in O Yahweh Pakai. Namikhoto na pum in neidonbut in.
en: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
text:
PSA 27:7
Thadou: Kahung taove neingai peh in O Yahweh Pakai. Namikhoto na pum in neidonbut in.
English: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

tcz: “Hungin lang neihoulim pin” nati chu kalungthim in ajan hitin adonbutne, “Yahweh Pakai kahunge”
en: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”
text:
PSA 27:8
Thadou: “Hungin lang neihoulim pin” nati chu kalungthim in ajan hitin adonbutne, “Yahweh Pakai kahunge”
English: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”

tcz: Yahweh Pakai neinung ngat hihbeh in. Na lunghan nan nasoh hi paidoh hihbeh in. Nangmahi eikithopi phapen chu nahijenge. Tun neipaidoh hih in; neidalha hih in, O Elohim Pathen ka huhing pu.
en: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
text:
PSA 27:9
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai neinung ngat hihbeh in. Na lunghan nan nasoh hi paidoh hihbeh in. Nangmahi eikithopi phapen chu nahijenge. Tun neipaidoh hih in; neidalha hih in, O Elohim Pathen ka huhing pu.
English: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

tcz: Kanu le kapan eipaidoh jeng jongleh Yahweh Pakai in eikolchah jing ding ahi.
en: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
text:
PSA 27:10
Thadou: Kanu le kapan eipaidoh jeng jongleh Yahweh Pakai in eikolchah jing ding ahi.
English: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kahinkho manding Dan neihil in lamdih jenga neipuiin, ajeh chu kagal miten eichang lhijingun ahi.
en: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
text:
PSA 27:11
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai kahinkho manding Dan neihil in lamdih jenga neipuiin, ajeh chu kagal miten eichang lhijingun ahi.
English: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

tcz: Amaho khut a neilhah lutsah hih in, ajeh chu amahon kabol louhel thil a themo eichan un, phatin in kachungah thilse abolgo jingun ahi.
en: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.
text:
PSA 27:12
Thadou: Amaho khut a neilhah lutsah hih in, ajeh chu amahon kabol louhel thil a themo eichan un, phatin in kachungah thilse abolgo jingun ahi.
English: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

tcz: Ahijeng vangin, hiche mihing gam a kaum laisen Yahweh Pakai phatna kamu jing jeng ding kakinem e.
en: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
text:
PSA 27:13
Thadou: Ahijeng vangin, hiche mihing gam a kaum laisen Yahweh Pakai phatna kamu jing jeng ding kakinem e.
English: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu lungneng tahin ngah jingin, Hanginlang hatnin, Henge, Yahweh Pakai chu lungneng tah in ngah jingin.
en: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
text:
PSA 27:14
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu lungneng tahin ngah jingin, Hanginlang hatnin, Henge, Yahweh Pakai chu lungneng tah in ngah jingin.
English: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kasongpi nakom a kataove, Ngaipeh lou in neikoi hih beh in. Ajeh chu nangin neithip sanleh keijong lhadah ing kating kathi ding ahitai.
en: To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
text:
PSA 28:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai kasongpi nakom a kataove, Ngaipeh lou in neikoi hih beh in. Ajeh chu nangin neithip sanleh keijong lhadah ing kating kathi ding ahitai.
English: To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

tcz: Hepina ngeh a neipanpi dia katao teng nei ngaipeh tei in, kakhut kahin domsang in namun theng lam kahinsan e.
en: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
text:
PSA 28:2
Thadou: Hepina ngeh a neipanpi dia katao teng nei ngaipeh tei in, kakhut kahin domsang in namun theng lam kahinsan e.
English: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

tcz: Thilse bolnom jing a, akam uva thungei ngei seija alung sunguva thilse jeng gonle ho to nei sumang tha hih beh in.
en: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.
text:
PSA 28:3
Thadou: Thilse bolnom jing a, akam uva thungei ngei seija alung sunguva thilse jeng gonle ho to nei sumang tha hih beh in.
English: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

tcz: Amahon achanding dol u athilse bolu toh kitoh in got na pejengin! Athilse bolu dungjui chetnin lethuh jengin! Michunga athilse bol gu'utoh kitoh in amaho chungah chuhsah in.
en: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.
text:
PSA 28:4
Thadou: Amahon achanding dol u athilse bolu toh kitoh in got na pejengin! Athilse bolu dungjui chetnin lethuh jengin! Michunga athilse bol gu'utoh kitoh in amaho chungah chuhsah in.
English: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in ipi abolham ti amahon anahsah pouve, Elohim Pathen khut sem ipi jeh a umham agel pouve, hijeh a chu aman abotel a tonsot gei a kitung doh lou diu ahitai.
en: Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.
text:
PSA 28:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in ipi abolham ti amahon anahsah pouve, Elohim Pathen khut sem ipi jeh a umham agel pouve, hijeh a chu aman abotel a tonsot gei a kitung doh lou diu ahitai.
English: Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umhen! Ajeh chu khotona kangaicha a kataona chu eijah pehtai.
en: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.
text:
PSA 28:6
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umhen! Ajeh chu khotona kangaicha a kataona chu eijah pehtai.
English: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi kahat nale kalum ahi. Kalungthim pumpin amachu katah san e. Aman eikithopin kalungthim kipanan adim e. Thangvahna la'n keiman kasam phonge.
en: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
text:
PSA 28:7
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi kahat nale kalum ahi. Kalungthim pumpin amachu katah san e. Aman eikithopin kalungthim kipanan adim e. Thangvahna la'n keiman kasam phonge.
English: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in amite thahat apei, amahi athaonu lengpa dinga ahoidohna kulpi ahi
en: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
text:
PSA 28:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in amite thahat apei, amahi athaonu lengpa dinga ahoidohna kulpi ahi
English: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

tcz: Namite huhhing in! Kelngoi chingpha bangin nagoulu Israel chu phatthei bohtan, chule tonsot in amahohi nabanjetnin puitan.
en: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
text:
PSA 28:9
Thadou: Namite huhhing in! Kelngoi chingpha bangin nagoulu Israel chu phatthei bohtan, chule tonsot in amahohi nabanjetnin puitan.
English: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

tcz: Nangho vanmi hon Yahweh Pakaichu jana peuvin; Aloupi nale athahatna jeh in Yahweh Pakaichu jana pecheh un.
en: Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
text:
PSA 29:1
Thadou: Nangho vanmi hon Yahweh Pakaichu jana peuvin; Aloupi nale athahatna jeh in Yahweh Pakaichu jana pecheh un.
English: Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

tcz: Amin loupinajeh in Yahweh Pakai chu jabolcheh un. Athenna thupitah jehchun Yahweh Pakaichu chibai bohun.
en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.
text:
PSA 29:2
Thadou: Amin loupinajeh in Yahweh Pakai chu jabolcheh un. Athenna thupitah jehchun Yahweh Pakaichu chibai bohun.
English: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.

tcz: Twipi chungah Yahweh Pakai ogin athong doh e. Vanthamjol ginbang in Elohim Pathen loupina akithonge. Yahweh Pakaihi twikhanglen chungah akithonge.
en: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.
text:
PSA 29:3
Thadou: Twipi chungah Yahweh Pakai ogin athong doh e. Vanthamjol ginbang in Elohim Pathen loupina akithonge. Yahweh Pakaihi twikhanglen chungah akithonge.
English: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ogin hi thaneitah ahi, Yahweh Pakai ogin hi thupitah ahi.
en: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.
text:
PSA 29:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ogin hi thaneitah ahi, Yahweh Pakai ogin hi thupitah ahi.
English: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai Ogin hin Cedar thing thupitah hojong aban tumboh gam e; Yahweh Pakai thupinan Lebanon Cedar thingho jong asubong soh gamtai.
en: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
text:
PSA 29:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai Ogin hin Cedar thing thupitah hojong aban tumboh gam e; Yahweh Pakai thupinan Lebanon Cedar thingho jong asubong soh gamtai.
English: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

tcz: Aman Lebanon moljeng jong bongnou bangin akichop sah e, Aman Hermon moljeng jong gambong bangin akichop sah e.
en: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
text:
PSA 29:6
Thadou: Aman Lebanon moljeng jong bongnou bangin akichop sah e, Aman Hermon moljeng jong gambong bangin akichop sah e.
English: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai oginhi kolphe meivah gimneitah banga ginga ahi.
en: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
text:
PSA 29:7
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai oginhi kolphe meivah gimneitah banga ginga ahi.
English: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai Ogin chun gamthip gamgolai jeng jong akilinsah e; Kadesh gamgolai jong Elohim Pathen in akilin sah e.
en: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
text:
PSA 29:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai Ogin chun gamthip gamgolai jeng jong akilinsah e; Kadesh gamgolai jong Elohim Pathen in akilin sah e.
English: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai Ogin hin gangpi phung phatah hojong ahot ling in, gammang jong asuchai hel e. Ahou in theng sungah mijousen “Aloupi” tin asam uve.
en: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
text:
PSA 29:9
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai Ogin hin gangpi phung phatah hojong ahot ling in, gammang jong asuchai hel e. Ahou in theng sungah mijousen “Aloupi” tin asam uve.
English: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu twipi chunga chun atouvin vai ahom e.
en: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.
text:
PSA 29:10
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu twipi chunga chun atouvin vai ahom e.
English: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in amite thahat apen, Yahweh Pakai in amite chamna apen phatthei aboh'e.
en: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
text:
PSA 29:11
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in amite thahat apen, Yahweh Pakai in amite chamna apen phatthei aboh'e.
English: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin neihuhdoh tahjeh in kahin thangvah e. Nangin kagalmite kachunga nakithang at sahpon ahi.
en: I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
text:
PSA 30:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nangin neihuhdoh tahjeh in kahin thangvah e. Nangin kagalmite kachunga nakithang at sahpon ahi.
English: I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen panpi ngaichan kahin kouvin nangman ka tahsa nakiledoh sah tai.
en: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
text:
PSA 30:2
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen panpi ngaichan kahin kouvin nangman ka tahsa nakiledoh sah tai.
English: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangin lhankhuh a kon in neihin puidoh in, thina kokhuh a ka lhahlut na dinga kon in jong neihoidoh sah e.
en: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
text:
PSA 30:3
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangin lhankhuh a kon in neihin puidoh in, thina kokhuh a ka lhahlut na dinga kon in jong neihoidoh sah e.
English: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

tcz: Nangho Elohim Pathen mite jousen Yahweh Pakai thangvahna lasaovin! Amintheng chu choi an'un.
en: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
text:
PSA 30:4
Thadou: Nangho Elohim Pathen mite jousen Yahweh Pakai thangvahna lasaovin! Amintheng chu choi an'un.
English: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

tcz: Ajeh chu alunghan hi phat chomcha bou ahijin, ami hepina vang hinkhoa ding ahi. Ka na nikho ho jong kipanin ajui pai jitai.
en: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
text:
PSA 30:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu alunghan hi phat chomcha bou ahijin, ami hepina vang hinkhoa ding ahi. Ka na nikho ho jong kipanin ajui pai jitai.
English: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

tcz: Keiman ka phatthei nikhon, “Imachan eisutang jouponte!” kanati.
en: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
text:
PSA 30:6
Thadou: Keiman ka phatthei nikhon, “Imachan eisutang jouponte!” kanati.
English: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nami hepinahin muol bangin eisudettai. Keija kon a nakiheimang jiteng leh keima kading jou jipoi.
en: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
text:
PSA 30:7
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nami hepinahin muol bangin eisudettai. Keija kon a nakiheimang jiteng leh keima kading jou jipoi.
English: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nahenga kahung tao ahi. Nami hepina chu kathum in hitin kaseije,
en: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:
text:
PSA 30:8
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nahenga kahung tao ahi. Nami hepina chu kathum in hitin kaseije,
English: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:

tcz: “Keima kathi alhankhuh a ka lhalut teng nangdinga ipi phachom dingham? Katahsa leivui in nang navah choi thei dingham? Nakitah na thu chu hiche hin aphondoh thei ding ham?
en: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?
text:
PSA 30:9
Thadou: “Keima kathi alhankhuh a ka lhalut teng nangdinga ipi phachom dingham? Katahsa leivui in nang navah choi thei dingham? Nakitah na thu chu hiche hin aphondoh thei ding ham?
English: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

tcz: Neihin ngaipeh in Yahweh Pakai neihin khoto in. O Yahweh Pakai neihin kithopin”
en: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”
text:
PSA 30:10
Thadou: Neihin ngaipeh in Yahweh Pakai neihin khoto in. O Yahweh Pakai neihin kithopin”
English: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”

tcz: Nangin kalung khamnahi kipah tah a lam nan neiheidoh pehtai. Nangin kalung khamna silpon neilahdoh pehin kipana silpon joh neisilpehtan ahi.
en: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
text:
PSA 30:11
Thadou: Nangin kalung khamnahi kipah tah a lam nan neiheidoh pehtai. Nangin kalung khamna silpon neilahdoh pehin kipana silpon joh neisilpehtan ahi.
English: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

tcz: Hitiachu thipsan louva thangvahna la kasah jing theina dingin. O Yahweh Pakai Elohim ka Pathen, keiman nangma tonsot in thangvah jing tange.
en: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
text:
PSA 30:12
Thadou: Hitiachu thipsan louva thangvahna la kasah jing theina dingin. O Yahweh Pakai Elohim ka Pathen, keiman nangma tonsot in thangvah jing tange.
English: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai neihuhdoh ding ngaichan nakom kahin bel e; Jumna neimusah hih behin. Neihuh dohin ajeh chu nangma chondihtah Elohim Pathen nahi.
en: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
text:
PSA 31:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai neihuhdoh ding ngaichan nakom kahin bel e; Jumna neimusah hih behin. Neihuh dohin ajeh chu nangma chondihtah Elohim Pathen nahi.
English: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

tcz: Kataona najah nadin neingai peh tei in; neihung huhdoh loi in. Kakiselna songpin pang jing inlang, kahoidohna kulpi hijing in.
en: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
text:
PSA 31:2
Thadou: Kataona najah nadin neingai peh tei in; neihung huhdoh loi in. Kakiselna songpin pang jing inlang, kahoidohna kulpi hijing in.
English: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

tcz: Nangmahi kasongpile kakulpi nahi namin loupina dingin kahahsatna a konnin neihuh doh in.
en: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
text:
PSA 31:3
Thadou: Nangmahi kasongpile kakulpi nahi namin loupina dingin kahahsatna a konnin neihuh doh in.
English: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

tcz: Kadougal hon kalhuhna dinga thang eikampeh naova kon in neihuhdoh in, ajeh chu kahoidoh nahi nangma a bou aum e.
en: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
text:
PSA 31:4
Thadou: Kadougal hon kalhuhna dinga thang eikampeh naova kon in neihuhdoh in, ajeh chu kahoidoh nahi nangma a bou aum e.
English: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

tcz: Kalhagao nangma khut a ka pedoh tai. Neihuhdoh in Yahweh Pakai ajeh chu nangmahi kitah jing Elohim Pathen nahi.
en: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.
text:
PSA 31:5
Thadou: Kalhagao nangma khut a ka pedoh tai. Neihuhdoh in Yahweh Pakai ajeh chu nangmahi kitah jing Elohim Pathen nahi.
English: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.

tcz: Phatchom nabei semthu pathen hou hokhu keiman kathet ahi. Kenvang Yahweh Pakai katahsan jing e.
en: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.
text:
PSA 31:6
Thadou: Phatchom nabei semthu pathen hou hokhu keiman kathet ahi. Kenvang Yahweh Pakai katahsan jing e.
English: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.

tcz: Nami ngailutna longlou jeh in keima kipah thanom jing inge, ajeh chu nangin kaboina ho neihet peh jingin chuleh kalung gimna jouse nangin neihet thempeh jingin ahi.
en: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
text:
PSA 31:7
Thadou: Nami ngailutna longlou jeh in keima kipah thanom jing inge, ajeh chu nangin kaboina ho neihet peh jingin chuleh kalung gimna jouse nangin neihet thempeh jingin ahi.
English: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

tcz: Nangin kadougal ho khutnah neipelutpon, lungmon na munjoh a neikoi jin ahi.
en: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
text:
PSA 31:8
Thadou: Nangin kadougal ho khutnah neipelutpon, lungmon na munjoh a neikoi jin ahi.
English: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

tcz: Neikhoton Yahweh Pakai ajeh chu keima hahsatna a um kahin kamitlhin kamit akhutan ahi. Kahinnale katahsa abeipaiding ahitai.
en: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
text:
PSA 31:9
Thadou: Neikhoton Yahweh Pakai ajeh chu keima hahsatna a um kahin kamitlhin kamit akhutan ahi. Kahinnale katahsa abeipaiding ahitai.
English: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

tcz: Lungkham a thipaiding kahitai, gentheinan kahinkho asuhchom tai. Chonset in kajaitha anem sah in asung langa beipai ding kahitai.
en: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.
text:
PSA 31:10
Thadou: Lungkham a thipaiding kahitai, gentheinan kahinkho asuhchom tai. Chonset in kajaitha anem sah in asung langa beipai ding kahitai.
English: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

tcz: Kamelma ten eisamseovin, kaheng kakom ten eitheuvin ahi. Kagol kapaite jeng jongin eihin naingam tapouvin ahi. Lampi dunga eimu jongleh ajam mang gamji taove.
en: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.
text:
PSA 31:11
Thadou: Kamelma ten eisamseovin, kaheng kakom ten eitheuvin ahi. Kagol kapaite jeng jongin eihin naingam tapouvin ahi. Lampi dunga eimu jongleh ajam mang gamji taove.
English: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

tcz: Keima mithisa bang leh bel kehsa bangin notthap in kaumtai.
en: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
text:
PSA 31:12
Thadou: Keima mithisa bang leh bel kehsa bangin notthap in kaumtai.
English: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

tcz: Keima chung changhi thujoungen eikisei khum in tijatnan eium kimvel tan, kadougal ten keidounan thilse agong un kahinkho hi suhmang ding agouve.
en: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.
text:
PSA 31:13
Thadou: Keima chung changhi thujoungen eikisei khum in tijatnan eium kimvel tan, kadougal ten keidounan thilse agong un kahinkho hi suhmang ding agouve.
English: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai keima nanga kingai jing kahin, “Nangma Elohim ka Pathen nahi!” kati.
en: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”
text:
PSA 31:14
Thadou: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai keima nanga kingai jing kahin, “Nangma Elohim ka Pathen nahi!” kati.
English: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”

tcz: Khonung kakhankho hi nangkhut a um ahin hitia tanglouva eidelle jinghoa konin neihuhdoh in.
en: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
text:
PSA 31:15
Thadou: Khonung kakhankho hi nangkhut a um ahin hitia tanglouva eidelle jinghoa konin neihuhdoh in.
English: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

tcz: Nami khotona chun nasohpa hi hinsalvah in, namingailutna longlou chun neihin huhdoh tan.
en: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
text:
PSA 31:16
Thadou: Nami khotona chun nasohpa hi hinsalvah in, namingailutna longlou chun neihin huhdoh tan.
English: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai neijumso hihbeh in, ajeh chu panpi ngaichan nangma kakou jinge, miphalou hochu jumsah jon, amaho chu alhankhuh uvah thipsan sahtan.
en: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.
text:
PSA 31:17
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai neijumso hihbeh in, ajeh chu panpi ngaichan nangma kakou jinge, miphalou hochu jumsah jon, amaho chu alhankhuh uvah thipsan sahtan.
English: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

tcz: Jouthu pot na alei u suthip in, ami noise nao le Elohim Pathen mite a houset nao leichu suthip jengin.
en: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
text:
PSA 31:18
Thadou: Jouthu pot na alei u suthip in, ami noise nao le Elohim Pathen mite a houset nao leichu suthip jengin.
English: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

tcz: Vo Yahweh Pakai nangma gingte dingin nangin ijakai nasuh nengpeh hi iti phat apha hitam. Panpi ngaicha a nakom a hungte nangman naphat thei in, vannoi mite mitmu changtah in nangman phatthei nabohjin ahi.
en: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
text:
PSA 31:19
Thadou: Vo Yahweh Pakai nangma gingte dingin nangin ijakai nasuh nengpeh hi iti phat apha hitam. Panpi ngaicha a nakom a hungte nangman naphat thei in, vannoi mite mitmu changtah in nangman phatthei nabohjin ahi.
English: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

tcz: Nangin amahochu suhsetding gohoa kon in na angsunga nahoi bitjin, chuleh ahousetnao leile danga kon in jong na angsungah nahoibit jinge.
en: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.
text:
PSA 31:20
Thadou: Nangin amahochu suhsetding gohoa kon in na angsunga nahoi bitjin, chuleh ahousetnao leile danga kon in jong na angsungah nahoibit jinge.
English: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahin umhen, ajeh chu Aman angailutna longlou kidangtah chu eimusah jingin, kachen na khopi gal akinokhum a kon in jong eihoidoh sahtan ahi.
en: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.
text:
PSA 31:21
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahin umhen, ajeh chu Aman angailutna longlou kidangtah chu eimusah jingin, kachen na khopi gal akinokhum a kon in jong eihoidoh sahtan ahi.
English: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

tcz: Lunglinglao pum in keima kapengjah in, “Yahweh Pakai toh eiki sukhentai!” kati. Hinla Yahweh Pakai nangin nei kho to dia ka ka na neijahpeh in panpi ngaicha a kakouna neidonbut tai.
en: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
text:
PSA 31:22
Thadou: Lunglinglao pum in keima kapengjah in, “Yahweh Pakai toh eiki sukhentai!” kati. Hinla Yahweh Pakai nangin nei kho to dia ka ka na neijahpeh in panpi ngaicha a kakouna neidonbut tai.
English: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

tcz: Nangho Elohim Pathen miteho Yahweh Pakai chu ngailu vin! Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in ama a kingai jingho chu ahuhdoh jingin ahi. Ahinlah mi noiseho chu engbolna nasatah apejin ahi.
en: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
text:
PSA 31:23
Thadou: Nangho Elohim Pathen miteho Yahweh Pakai chu ngailu vin! Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in ama a kingai jingho chu ahuhdoh jingin ahi. Ahinlah mi noiseho chu engbolna nasatah apejin ahi.
English: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

tcz: Hijeh chun Yahweh Pakaija kinepna neiho jouse hatnunlang hangun!
en: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
text:
PSA 31:24
Thadou: Hijeh chun Yahweh Pakaija kinepna neiho jouse hatnunlang hangun!
English: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.

tcz: Oh, asei ngailou nahou ki angaidam a achon set nahou kisuhmang peh ho iti thanop um hitam.
en: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
text:
PSA 32:1
Thadou: Oh, asei ngailou nahou ki angaidam a achon set nahou kisuhmang peh ho iti thanop um hitam.
English: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in ajihlutsa achonset nao athaimang peh a ahinkhou jongkitah tah a mangho chu iti kipa um a hitam!
en: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
text:
PSA 32:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in ajihlutsa achonset nao athaimang peh a ahinkhou jongkitah tah a mangho chu iti kipa um a hitam!
English: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

tcz: Keiman kachonset kaphon nomlou chun katahsa chu amangthah anahin, niseh in kapeng in kamao jinge.
en: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
text:
PSA 32:3
Thadou: Keiman kachonset kaphon nomlou chun katahsa chu amangthah anahin, niseh in kapeng in kamao jinge.
English: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

tcz: Sun le jan in kipui dih na nakhujol chun eidou ve. Nipilai a nichangsat in asuhkang twihu bangin katha asukang hel jengin ahi.
en: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.
text:
PSA 32:4
Thadou: Sun le jan in kipui dih na nakhujol chun eidou ve. Nipilai a nichangsat in asuhkang twihu bangin katha asukang hel jengin ahi.
English: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

tcz: Akhon nan kachon setna nahenga kaphong in, kamo najouse selguh ding golou vin kasei tai “Kalouchal kasetna jouse Yahweh Pakai kom a phongdoh tang e” kati. Hiti chun Yahweh Pakai nangin neingaidam e! Kachonsetna jouse abeisoh tai.
en: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
text:
PSA 32:5
Thadou: Akhon nan kachon setna nahenga kaphong in, kamo najouse selguh ding golou vin kasei tai “Kalouchal kasetna jouse Yahweh Pakai kom a phongdoh tang e” kati. Hiti chun Yahweh Pakai nangin neingaidam e! Kachonsetna jouse abeisoh tai.
English: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

tcz: Hijeh chun, phatpha umlai hin Elohim Pathen mite jouse naheng a taocheh uhen, hiche thutanna twilen lah a alhahlut lou nadiuvin.
en: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
text:
PSA 32:6
Thadou: Hijeh chun, phatpha umlai hin Elohim Pathen mite jouse naheng a taocheh uhen, hiche thutanna twilen lah a alhahlut lou nadiuvin.
English: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma hi kakiselna kulpi nahin; nangin boinana a kon in neihuh doh e. Galjona lan neiumkimvel tai.
en: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
text:
PSA 32:7
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangma hi kakiselna kulpi nahin; nangin boinana a kon in neihuh doh e. Galjona lan neiumkimvel tai.
English: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in aseije, “Nahinkho a lampi phapen achu kapui le ding ahi. Keiman kathu mop a kavetsui jing ding nahi.
en: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
text:
PSA 32:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in aseije, “Nahinkho a lampi phapen achu kapui le ding ahi. Keiman kathu mop a kavetsui jing ding nahi.
English: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

tcz: Sakol le Sangan bangin hetna beiyin um hih in, ajo leh kamdal le thihkol bupeh a thunoiya ki koi nabah loding ahi.”
en: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
text:
PSA 32:9
Thadou: Sakol le Sangan bangin hetna beiyin um hih in, ajo leh kamdal le thihkol bupeh a thunoiya ki koi nabah loding ahi.”
English: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

tcz: Miphalou hohi lungkhamna tamtah in abomjin, ahinla Yahweh Pakai tahsan hovang angailutna longlouvin aum kimvel jingin ahi.
en: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.
text:
PSA 32:10
Thadou: Miphalou hohi lungkhamna tamtah in abomjin, ahinla Yahweh Pakai tahsan hovang angailutna longlouvin aum kimvel jingin ahi.
English: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.

tcz: Hijeh chun ama lungdei a chon ho Yahweh Pakai a kipah thanom jingun! Milung thengho jouse thanom tah in khosam un!
en: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
text:
PSA 32:11
Thadou: Hijeh chun ama lungdei a chon ho Yahweh Pakai a kipah thanom jingun! Milung thengho jouse thanom tah in khosam un!
English: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

tcz: Elohim Pathen mite jousen Yahweh Pakai thangvahna la kipah tahin saohen; milung thenghon Ama athangvah diuhi lomtah ahi.
en: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
text:
PSA 33:1
Thadou: Elohim Pathen mite jousen Yahweh Pakai thangvahna la kipah tahin saohen; milung thenghon Ama athangvah diuhi lomtah ahi.
English: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

tcz: Semjang gin ngaitah in Yahweh Pakai thangvah un, tumgin jangsom ngaitah saijin nguiheo vin saovin.
en: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
text:
PSA 33:2
Thadou: Semjang gin ngaitah in Yahweh Pakai thangvah un, tumgin jangsom ngaitah saijin nguiheo vin saovin.
English: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thangvahnan lathah saovin; thepna neitah in selangdah saijun lang kipah tah in la saovin.
en: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
text:
PSA 33:3
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai thangvahnan lathah saovin; thepna neitah in selangdah saijun lang kipah tah in la saovin.
English: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thusei jouse chu atah ahin chuleh anatoh athilbol jouse chu tahsan thei cheh ahi.
en: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
text:
PSA 33:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai thusei jouse chu atah ahin chuleh anatoh athilbol jouse chu tahsan thei cheh ahi.
English: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

tcz: Adihleh apha kiti jouse chu Yahweh Pakai deilam ahin, Amingailutna longlou chun vannoi leiset hi adimin ahi.
en: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.
text:
PSA 33:5
Thadou: Adihleh apha kiti jouse chu Yahweh Pakai deilam ahin, Amingailutna longlou chun vannoi leiset hi adimin ahi.
English: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thucheng hin bou vanmun hi asem doh in, Ama thucheng haikhum chun ahsi jouse apendoh sah tai.
en: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
text:
PSA 33:6
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai thucheng hin bou vanmun hi asem doh in, Ama thucheng haikhum chun ahsi jouse apendoh sah tai.
English: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

tcz: Aman twikhanglen jong agamgi asempeh in chule twikhanglen jouse hi munkhat a aveikhom sah in akoidet in ahi.
en: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
text:
PSA 33:7
Thadou: Aman twikhanglen jong agamgi asempeh in chule twikhanglen jouse hi munkhat a aveikhom sah in akoidet in ahi.
English: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

tcz: Vannoi leiset pumpin Yahweh Pakaihi jana peohen, chuleh mijouse a-angsung a kichatah in dingu hen.
en: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
text:
PSA 33:8
Thadou: Vannoi leiset pumpin Yahweh Pakaihi jana peohen, chuleh mijouse a-angsung a kichatah in dingu hen.
English: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

tcz: Ajeh chu ama thucheng khat in leiset khang akipatsah ahi! Ama thupeh a kitungdoh jeng ahi.
en: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
text:
PSA 33:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu ama thucheng khat in leiset khang akipatsah ahi! Ama thupeh a kitungdoh jeng ahi.
English: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in namtin vaipi thil gon houchu asuhboi peh in, chuleh atohgon hou jouse chu asuhmo peh in ahi.
en: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
text:
PSA 33:10
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in namtin vaipi thil gon houchu asuhboi peh in, chuleh atohgon hou jouse chu asuhmo peh in ahi.
English: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai thilgon vang tonsot in adet jing e, ama tohgot hochu itih a jong killing lou ahi.
en: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
text:
PSA 33:11
Thadou: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai thilgon vang tonsot in adet jing e, ama tohgot hochu itih a jong killing lou ahi.
English: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

tcz: A pakaiju Elohim Pathen hikha nammite chu anunnom ahiuve, Yahweh Pakai in agoulo dinga alhen nammite chu anun nom ahiuve.
en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
text:
PSA 33:12
Thadou: A pakaiju Elohim Pathen hikha nammite chu anunnom ahiuve, Yahweh Pakai in agoulo dinga alhen nammite chu anun nom ahiuve.
English: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in vanna konnin mihemte jouse ahin ven musoh kei e.
en: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
text:
PSA 33:13
