Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in vanna konnin mihemte jouse ahin ven musoh kei e.
English: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

tcz: Alaltouna a konin ahin ven leiset chunga cheng jouse hindan ahesoh keijin ahi.
en: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
text:
PSA 33:14
Thadou: Alaltouna a konin ahin ven leiset chunga cheng jouse hindan ahesoh keijin ahi.
English: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

tcz: Alung thim u sempa ama ahijeh'in alung gellu le athilbol jouseo ahesoh kei e.
en: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
text:
PSA 33:15
Thadou: Alung thim u sempa ama ahijeh'in alung gellu le athilbol jouseo ahesoh kei e.
English: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

tcz: Gal manchah phapen in lengpa huhdoh jou pontin, hangta le hansan nan jong gal hat pa ahuh doh jou poi.
en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
text:
PSA 33:16
Thadou: Gal manchah phapen in lengpa huhdoh jou pontin, hangta le hansan nan jong gal hat pa ahuh doh jou poi.
English: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

tcz: Gal satna sakol khatnin jong gal na josah jouding ahipon, thahatna jousen jong nang nahuhdoh jouponte.
en: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
text:
PSA 33:17
Thadou: Gal satna sakol khatnin jong gal na josah jouding ahipon, thahatna jousen jong nang nahuhdoh jouponte.
English: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

tcz: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai in ama gingte, angailut na longlou va ki ngaijing ho avelhi jing e.
en: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
text:
PSA 33:18
Thadou: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai in ama gingte, angailut na longlou va ki ngaijing ho avelhi jing e.
English: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu athina diuva kon in ahuhdoh jin athigam nadiuva kon in ahuh dohjin ahi.
en: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
text:
PSA 33:19
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu athina diuva kon in ahuhdoh jin athigam nadiuva kon in ahuh dohjin ahi.
English: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

tcz: Keihon Yahweh Pakaijah kinepna kakoi ui. Ajeh chu amahi eiki thopiu leh eilum uva pang ahi.
en: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.
text:
PSA 33:20
Thadou: Keihon Yahweh Pakaijah kinepna kakoi ui. Ajeh chu amahi eiki thopiu leh eilum uva pang ahi.
English: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.

tcz: Ama a hin ilungthimu akipah in, ajeh chu eihon amin thenga tahsan na dettah inei un ahi.
en: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
text:
PSA 33:21
Thadou: Ama a hin ilungthimu akipah in, ajeh chu eihon amin thenga tahsan na dettah inei un ahi.
English: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

tcz: Vo Yahweh Pakai nami ngailutna longlou achun eium kimvel u hen, ajeh chu nang jenga bou ka kinepnao aum e.
en: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.
text:
PSA 33:22
Thadou: Vo Yahweh Pakai nami ngailutna longlou achun eium kimvel u hen, ajeh chu nang jenga bou ka kinepnao aum e.
English: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu phat tin in thang vah in kate. Yahweh Pakai thagvah nahi kakam sunga gingdoh jingding ahi.
en: I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
text:
PSA 34:1
Thadou: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu phat tin in thang vah in kate. Yahweh Pakai thagvah nahi kakam sunga gingdoh jingding ahi.
English: I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

tcz: Keima Yahweh Pakaiya bou kithang at jing ding kahin; Panpi beite jouse lunglut cheh uhen.
en: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
text:
PSA 34:2
Thadou: Keima Yahweh Pakaiya bou kithang at jing ding kahin; Panpi beite jouse lunglut cheh uhen.
English: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

tcz: Hungun Yahweh Pakai loupi nahi seiphong khom u hitin amin hi choi-an khom u hite.
en: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
text:
PSA 34:3
Thadou: Hungun Yahweh Pakai loupi nahi seiphong khom u hitin amin hi choi-an khom u hite.
English: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

tcz: Keima Yahweh Pakai kom a kataovin aman kataona eisanpeh tai. Aman kakichatna jousea jong eilhat doh tai.
en: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
text:
PSA 34:4
Thadou: Keima Yahweh Pakai kom a kataovin aman kataona eisanpeh tai. Aman kakichatna jousea jong eilhat doh tai.
English: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

tcz: Ama panpi ding ngaicha jouse vah bangin hungvah doh untin, amai uva jachatna muthim jinglou helding ahi.
en: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
text:
PSA 34:5
Thadou: Ama panpi ding ngaicha jouse vah bangin hungvah doh untin, amai uva jachatna muthim jinglou helding ahi.
English: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

tcz: Kahahsat behseh phat in kataovin Yahweh Pakai in eingai peh e; aman kaboina jouse eisuh lhap peh tai.
en: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
text:
PSA 34:6
Thadou: Kahahsat behseh phat in kataovin Yahweh Pakai in eingai peh e; aman kaboina jouse eisuh lhap peh tai.
English: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai vantil chu hoidamna ahin; ama ging te aman aumkimvel in ahuhdoh jinge.
en: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
text:
PSA 34:7
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai vantil chu hoidamna ahin; ama ging te aman aumkimvel in ahuhdoh jinge.
English: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai phatje chu patepmun lang veovin, Yahweh Pakaija kisel jing mite chu iti kipa hitaovem!
en: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
text:
PSA 34:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai phatje chu patepmun lang veovin, Yahweh Pakaija kisel jing mite chu iti kipa hitaovem!
English: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

tcz: Nangho Elohim Pathen mite ho Yahweh Pakai chu ging jingun ajeh chu ama ging jingten angai chat jouse amudiu ahi.
en: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
text:
PSA 34:9
Thadou: Nangho Elohim Pathen mite ho Yahweh Pakai chu ging jingun ajeh chu ama ging jingten angai chat jouse amudiu ahi.
English: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

tcz: Keipi bahkai gol hat laitah jong agilkel jin, ahin Yahweh Pakai tahsandet jing hovang thilpha alhasam ngaipouve.
en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.
text:
PSA 34:10
Thadou: Keipi bahkai gol hat laitah jong agilkel jin, ahin Yahweh Pakai tahsandet jing hovang thilpha alhasam ngaipouve.
English: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.

tcz: Kachate ho hunguvin kaseihi kingai phaovin, chuleh keiman Elohim Pathen ginje kahilding nahiu ve.
en: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
text:
PSA 34:11
Thadou: Kachate ho hunguvin kaseihi kingai phaovin, chuleh keiman Elohim Pathen ginje kahilding nahiu ve.
English: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

tcz: Hinkho sottah leh phatthei na lhingset a hingnom umkha em?
en: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
text:
PSA 34:12
Thadou: Hinkho sottah leh phatthei na lhingset a hingnom umkha em?
English: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

tcz: Thuse seinan nalei tuhtangin lang chuleh nakam jong jouseinan mang hih in!
en: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
text:
PSA 34:13
Thadou: Thuse seinan nalei tuhtangin lang chuleh nakam jong jouseinan mang hih in!
English: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

tcz: Thilse a kon in kihai mangin lang thilpha bol in, chamna hol in lang hichu chepin.
en: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
text:
PSA 34:14
Thadou: Thilse a kon in kihai mangin lang thilpha bol in, chamna hol in lang hichu chepin.
English: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai mitin thilpha boljingho avesui jingin; panpi ngai a koute din akol tenin jong akihong jing e.
en: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
text:
PSA 34:15
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai mitin thilpha boljingho avesui jingin; panpi ngai a koute din akol tenin jong akihong jing e.
English: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

tcz: Hinla thilse bolte chu dou mit nin aven, aman amin u leiset akon athaimang ding ahi.
en: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
text:
PSA 34:16
Thadou: Hinla thilse bolte chu dou mit nin aven, aman amin u leiset akon athaimang ding ahi.
English: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in panpi ngaichaho kouna angaipeh in. Aboi naova kon in ahuhdoh jin ahi.
en: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
text:
PSA 34:17
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in panpi ngaichaho kouna angaipeh in. Aboi naova kon in ahuhdoh jin ahi.
English: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

tcz: Lungthim kisuchipte kom a Yahweh Pakai chu anai in; Alhagao kisu gimte ahuhdoh jin ahi.
en: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
text:
PSA 34:18
Thadou: Lungthim kisuchipte kom a Yahweh Pakai chu anai in; Alhagao kisu gimte ahuhdoh jin ahi.
English: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

tcz: Michonpha hon boina tampi atohjiuvin, hinla Yahweh Pakai in phat tinin ahung huhdoh jin ahi.
en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.
text:
PSA 34:19
Thadou: Michonpha hon boina tampi atohjiuvin, hinla Yahweh Pakai in phat tinin ahung huhdoh jin ahi.
English: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in michonpha ho gule chang ahoibit pehjin; khatchajong abohsah pon ahi!
en: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
text:
PSA 34:20
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in michonpha ho gule chang ahoibit pehjin; khatchajong abohsah pon ahi!
English: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

tcz: Hamset nan migiloute hinkho alah teiding, michonpha ho hotbol tejong got na chang tei diu ahi.
en: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
text:
PSA 34:21
Thadou: Hamset nan migiloute hinkho alah teiding, michonpha ho hotbol tejong got na chang tei diu ahi.
English: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

tcz: Hinla Yahweh Pakai in ama kin bolho vang alhatdoh ding, ama a kisel jing honjong themmo changlou diu ahi.
en: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
text:
PSA 34:22
Thadou: Hinla Yahweh Pakai in ama kin bolho vang alhatdoh ding, ama a kisel jing honjong themmo changlou diu ahi.
English: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, eidou ho hi nangin kidoupin, ei kisatpi ho jong nangin kisatpin.
en: Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
text:
PSA 35:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai, eidou ho hi nangin kidoupin, ei kisatpi ho jong nangin kisatpin.
English: Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

tcz: Nalum leh naumpho hin kipat in. Galmun a din kigon lang neihung kithopin.
en: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
text:
PSA 35:2
Thadou: Nalum leh naumpho hin kipat in. Galmun a din kigon lang neihung kithopin.
English: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

tcz: Eihin delkhum ho dounan natengcha leh nateng muh chu hin lam tan. “Keiman gal kajopeh ding nahi!” ti neijah sah tan.
en: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”
text:
PSA 35:3
Thadou: Eihin delkhum ho dounan natengcha leh nateng muh chu hin lam tan. “Keiman gal kajopeh ding nahi!” ti neijah sah tan.
English: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

tcz: Eithat goho chunga hin jumnale jachatna lhun sah in, eigimbol a eisumang go hohi jumson lang nungno jeng tan.
en: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.
text:
PSA 35:4
Thadou: Eithat goho chunga hin jumnale jachatna lhun sah in, eigimbol a eisumang go hohi jumson lang nungno jeng tan.
English: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

tcz: Huilah a changvai alenmang bangin lenmang sah in, Yahweh Pakaija kon a vantil banga hung chu semmang sah in.
en: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.
text:
PSA 35:5
Thadou: Huilah a changvai alenmang bangin lenmang sah in, Yahweh Pakaija kon a vantil banga hung chu semmang sah in.
English: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.

tcz: A lam lhah nao thimsah inlang lhonalsah in, Yahweh Pakai vantil chun nungdel peh u hen.
en: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.
text:
PSA 35:6
Thadou: A lam lhah nao thimsah inlang lhonalsah in, Yahweh Pakai vantil chun nungdel peh u hen.
English: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.

tcz: Keiman amaho kabol sepoi, ahin amahon kei matna dingin kotong eilai khum un ahi! Ken amaho kabol sepoi ahin amahon keimat nadin kotong alai uve.
en: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
text:
PSA 35:7
Thadou: Keiman amaho kabol sepoi, ahin amahon kei matna dingin kotong eilai khum un ahi! Ken amaho kabol sepoi ahin amahon keimat nadin kotong alai uve.
English: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

tcz: Hijeh chun amaho chunga hetman louvin mathahna hunglhung hen! Kei ona dia asem u kotong chu amaho manthahna hijo tahen.
en: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
text:
PSA 35:8
Thadou: Hijeh chun amaho chunga hetman louvin mathahna hunglhung hen! Kei ona dia asem u kotong chu amaho manthahna hijo tahen.
English: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

tcz: Chuteng keima Yahweh Pakai akakipa ding ahi. Eilhatdoh jeh a keima kipa thanom ding kahi.
en: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
text:
PSA 35:9
Thadou: Chuteng keima Yahweh Pakai akakipa ding ahi. Eilhatdoh jeh a keima kipa thanom ding kahi.
English: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

tcz: Katahsa chunga kagu kachang jouse pum a Yahweh Pakai kathangvah ding ahi: “Yahweh Pakai koiham nangtoh kitekah theiding? Koidang ba ham mihatpa thaneina a kona panpi beipa huhdoh a chu?”
en: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”
text:
PSA 35:10
Thadou: Katahsa chunga kagu kachang jouse pum a Yahweh Pakai kathangvah ding ahi: “Yahweh Pakai koiham nangtoh kitekah theiding? Koidang ba ham mihatpa thaneina a kona panpi beipa huhdoh a chu?”
English: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

tcz: Engbolna dih louvin eithemmo sah un. Kahetphahlou jouthu a monna eikichan e.
en: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.
text:
PSA 35:11
Thadou: Engbolna dih louvin eithemmo sah un. Kahetphahlou jouthu a monna eikichan e.
English: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

tcz: Amahon kathil phabol jengjong thilsen eile thuh un lung lhahnan kangui heltai.
en: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
text:
PSA 35:12
Thadou: Amahon kathil phabol jengjong thilsen eile thuh un lung lhahnan kangui heltai.
English: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

tcz: Ahijeng vangin amahon anat tenguleh keiman amaho kalainatpi jin khaodip pon kakisil in anngol in amaho kataopeh jin ahi. Hinla kataona donbut louvin ahung kinung le jitai.
en: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.
text:
PSA 35:13
Thadou: Ahijeng vangin amahon anat tenguleh keiman amaho kalainatpi jin khaodip pon kakisil in anngol in amaho kataopeh jin ahi. Hinla kataona donbut louvin ahung kinung le jitai.
English: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

tcz: Ka golpha le insung mi monga kagel jeh in kalungkham pin, eihinga kanu kalainatpi bang bangin kalainat pi jin ahi.
en: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
text:
PSA 35:14
Thadou: Ka golpha le insung mi monga kagel jeh in kalungkham pin, eihinga kanu kalainatpi bang bangin kalainat pi jin ahi.
English: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

tcz: Hinlah ken tunia boina katophat in amaho akipah un keidounan thanom tah in akiloi khomun, hiti chun kahetkhahlou miho kisan in tujeng in jong eino khum un; phat tin in eihouse jing jengun ahi.
en: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.
text:
PSA 35:15
Thadou: Hinlah ken tunia boina katophat in amaho akipah un keidounan thanom tah in akiloi khomun, hiti chun kahetkhahlou miho kisan in tujeng in jong eino khum un; phat tin in eihouse jing jengun ahi.
English: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

tcz: Amahon einuisat un eitam seovin noise tah in eihagel khum un ahi.
en: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
text:
PSA 35:16
Thadou: Amahon einuisat un eitam seovin noise tah in eihagel khum un ahi.
English: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai itih changei pi neivet a donlouva neikoi ding hitam?
en: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.
text:
PSA 35:17
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai itih changei pi neivet a donlouva neikoi ding hitam?
English: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

tcz: Chutengleh mipi tamtah ki khom te lah a kipathu kahin seiding ahi. Mipi ho jouse masanga nangma kahin thangvah ding ahi.
en: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.
text:
PSA 35:18
Thadou: Chutengleh mipi tamtah ki khom te lah a kipathu kahin seiding ahi. Mipi ho jouse masanga nangma kahin thangvah ding ahi.
English: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

tcz: Kajolel nachung a hin eidou te kipa thanop sah hih beh in. Kamuiset nachung in jong ajeh bei a eivetda ho kitai sah hih beh in.
en: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.
text:
PSA 35:19
Thadou: Kajolel nachung a hin eidou te kipa thanop sah hih beh in. Kamuiset nachung in jong ajeh bei a eivetda ho kitai sah hih beh in.
English: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

tcz: Amahon chamna thu aseipouvin, amahon thepmona neilou atoh dingdol bep tongho dounan thilse agong jingun ahi.
en: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
text:
PSA 35:20
Thadou: Amahon chamna thu aseipouvin, amahon thepmona neilou atoh dingdol bep tongho dounan thilse agong jingun ahi.
English: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

tcz: “Aha! Aha! ipi bol kigo nahi kamit tah un kamudoh taove!” tin asam uve.
en: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
text:
PSA 35:21
Thadou: “Aha! Aha! ipi bol kigo nahi kamit tah un kamudoh taove!” tin asam uve.
English: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangin hicheghi namusoh kei in nahesoh e, donlouvin koihih beh in O Yahweh Pakai. neidalha hihbeh in O Yahweh Pakai.
en: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.
text:
PSA 35:22
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangin hicheghi namusoh kei in nahesoh e, donlouvin koihih beh in O Yahweh Pakai. neidalha hihbeh in O Yahweh Pakai.
English: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

tcz: Hungthoudoh in! eihuhdoh dingin hung dingdoh jengtan! Yahweh ka Pakai le Elohim ka Pathen kachung thuhi neitan peh in.
en: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
text:
PSA 35:23
Thadou: Hungthoudoh in! eihuhdoh dingin hung dingdoh jengtan! Yahweh ka Pakai le Elohim ka Pathen kachung thuhi neitan peh in.
English: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai ka Pathen Elohim, kamo louna neiphon doh peh tan, ajeh chu nangma thudih a thutan nahi. Kaboina chung chon a kadougal te nuisat in neium sah hih beh in.
en: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
text:
PSA 35:24
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai ka Pathen Elohim, kamo louna neiphon doh peh tan, ajeh chu nangma thudih a thutan nahi. Kaboina chung chon a kadougal te nuisat in neium sah hih beh in.
English: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.

tcz: “Veovin itup uchu imutaove! Tua hi ahingsan a inehchai diu ahitai!” tisah hihbeb in.
en: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
text:
PSA 35:25
Thadou: “Veovin itup uchu imutaove! Tua hi ahingsan a inehchai diu ahitai!” tisah hihbeb in.
English: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

tcz: Kahahsatna nikhoa kipah ho sujum inlang jachat sah in. Kachunga hanla samhohi jumnaleh minsetnan lhuh khumin.
en: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.
text:
PSA 35:26
Thadou: Kahahsatna nikhoa kipah ho sujum inlang jachat sah in. Kachunga hanla samhohi jumnaleh minsetnan lhuh khumin.
English: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

tcz: Ahin koi hileh keima ei huhdia hung ho jouse chu kipanalentah pen. “Yahweh Pakai aloupi e aman asoh hi lunglhai tah in phatthei aboh in lungmon na apei!” tin tanglouvin samjingu hen.
en: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”
text:
PSA 35:27
Thadou: Ahin koi hileh keima ei huhdia hung ho jouse chu kipanalentah pen. “Yahweh Pakai aloupi e aman asoh hi lunglhai tah in phatthei aboh in lungmon na apei!” tin tanglouvin samjingu hen.
English: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

tcz: Chuteng keiman nathutan adihji samphong ingting niseh a nangma kavahchoi ding ahi.
en: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
text:
PSA 35:28
Thadou: Chuteng keiman nathutan adihji samphong ingting niseh a nangma kavahchoi ding ahi.
English: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

tcz: Chonsetnin miphalou ho lungthim gilsungah thu aseijin ahi. Amahon Elohim Pathen ginna him him aneipouve.
en: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
text:
PSA 36:1
Thadou: Chonsetnin miphalou ho lungthim gilsungah thu aseijin ahi. Amahon Elohim Pathen ginna him him aneipouve.
English: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

tcz: Akihisah naovin amaho le amaho akijou lhepmun ichan geija gilouleh phamo hiuvam ti akihet pouve.
en: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.
text:
PSA 36:2
Thadou: Akihisah naovin amaho le amaho akijou lhepmun ichan geija gilouleh phamo hiuvam ti akihet pouve.
English: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

tcz: Athusei anatohna hou jousehi adihlou leh kijou lhepna ngen ahi. Chingthei tah a natoh leh thilpha bol dinghi adatthei pouve.
en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
text:
PSA 36:3
Thadou: Athusei anatohna hou jousehi adihlou leh kijou lhepna ngen ahi. Chingthei tah a natoh leh thilpha bol dinghi adatthei pouve.
English: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

tcz: Jankhosot in ahah un thildihlou tohgon tamtah agong jiuvin ahi. Atohdoh uhi apha khatcha aum poi. Thilsea konna kiheidoh ding angaito mong mong pouve.
en: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
text:
PSA 36:4
Thadou: Jankhosot in ahah un thildihlou tohgon tamtah agong jiuvin ahi. Atohdoh uhi apha khatcha aum poi. Thilsea konna kiheidoh ding angaito mong mong pouve.
English: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nami ngailutna longlouhi van bangin aki hohjale, nakitahna hin meilom kaina mun hohi akho khel e.
en: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
text:
PSA 36:5
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nami ngailutna longlouhi van bangin aki hohjale, nakitahna hin meilom kaina mun hohi akho khel e.
English: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

tcz: Nadih na jong muolsang vum tobang ahi. Nathutan dihdan jong twikhanglen thuhtah abang e. Nangin mihemleh ganhing hojong kibanga nangailut ahi.
en: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.
text:
PSA 36:6
Thadou: Nadih na jong muolsang vum tobang ahi. Nathutan dihdan jong twikhanglen thuhtah abang e. Nangin mihemleh ganhing hojong kibanga nangailut ahi.
English: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nami ngailutna longlou hi eti mamtam hitam! Mihem jousen nami ngailutna lhaving limnoija chun choldo na anei ui.
en: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
text:
PSA 36:7
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nami ngailutna longlou hi eti mamtam hitam! Mihem jousen nami ngailutna lhaving limnoija chun choldo na anei ui.
English: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

tcz: Nainsunga nehkemlou ann a chun navah van, kanglou nalui a twi chun nadon sah e.
en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
text:
PSA 36:8
Thadou: Nainsunga nehkemlou ann a chun navah van, kanglou nalui a twi chun nadon sah e.
English: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma mihem hung kondohna twinah nahin, keihon kamu u vahjonghi nanga kon ahi.
en: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
text:
PSA 36:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangma mihem hung kondohna twinah nahin, keihon kamu u vahjonghi nanga kon ahi.
English: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangma ngailuho chung a nami ngailutna longlou chu londoh sah in, milung thengho chunga thu adih in tanpeh in.
en: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
text:
PSA 36:10
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nangma ngailuho chung a nami ngailutna longlou chu londoh sah in, milung thengho chunga thu adih in tanpeh in.
English: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

tcz: Mi kiletsah ho neichotpha sah hih in, ahilouleh miphalouho sot tol le neihisah hih in.
en: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
text:
PSA 36:11
Thadou: Mi kiletsah ho neichotpha sah hih in, ahilouleh miphalouho sot tol le neihisah hih in.
English: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

tcz: Ven! Thildihlou bolteho alhugam taove! Amahochu kithoudoh kit loudinga sot lhuh ahitaove.
en: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
text:
PSA 36:12
Thadou: Ven! Thildihlou bolteho alhugam taove! Amahochu kithoudoh kit loudinga sot lhuh ahitaove.
English: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

tcz: Mikitahlou te chung a lungkham dan, thildihlou bolte jong thangse hih in.
en: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
text:
PSA 37:1
Thadou: Mikitahlou te chung a lungkham dan, thildihlou bolte jong thangse hih in.
English: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho khu hamhing banga molloi diu, nipilai pahchaho banga goplha loidiu ahi.
en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
text:
PSA 37:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu amaho khu hamhing banga molloi diu, nipilai pahchaho banga goplha loidiu ahi.
English: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu tahsa inlang thilpha bollin. Chutileh gamsunga lungmongin chengin natin nakhan touding ahi.
en: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
text:
PSA 37:3
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu tahsa inlang thilpha bollin. Chutileh gamsunga lungmongin chengin natin nakhan touding ahi.
English: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai a kipah jingin, chutileh aman nalung sunga nangai chatchan napehding ahi.
en: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
text:
PSA 37:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai a kipah jingin, chutileh aman nalung sunga nangai chatchan napehding ahi.
English: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

tcz: Nabol natoh jouse Yahweh Pakai a pelut jengin, ama chu tahsanin chutileh aman nakithopi ding ahi.
en: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
text:
PSA 37:5
Thadou: Nabol natoh jouse Yahweh Pakai a pelut jengin, ama chu tahsanin chutileh aman nakithopi ding ahi.
English: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

tcz: Aman nathem na chu khovah banga muthimlah a avahdoh sahding ahi. Chuleh nachanchin jong sunlai nisa banga avahdoh sahding ahi.
en: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
text:
PSA 37:6
Thadou: Aman nathem na chu khovah banga muthimlah a avahdoh sahding ahi. Chuleh nachanchin jong sunlai nisa banga avahdoh sahding ahi.
English: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai masangah lungneng chan ngahhat in Aman ahintoh ding chu ngah hat in. Mi giloute ahaotheiukhu lungkhampi hih un, athilse gon ujong lunghimo peh hih in.
en: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
text:
PSA 37:7
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai masangah lungneng chan ngahhat in Aman ahintoh ding chu ngah hat in. Mi giloute ahaotheiukhu lungkhampi hih un, athilse gon ujong lunghimo peh hih in.
English: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

tcz: Lungchom lunghan bolhih in! Lung sat a kon in jong kihei mangin. Nalung lhaso hih in hichun thilse lamma bou napui lut ding ahi.
en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
text:
PSA 37:8
Thadou: Lungchom lunghan bolhih in! Lung sat a kon in jong kihei mangin. Nalung lhaso hih in hichun thilse lamma bou napui lut ding ahi.
English: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

tcz: Ajeh chu migiloute kisumang ding ahin, amavang Yahweh Pakai tahsan a dingdet ho chun gamsung alodiu ahi.
en: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.
text:
PSA 37:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu migiloute kisumang ding ahin, amavang Yahweh Pakai tahsan a dingdet ho chun gamsung alodiu ahi.
English: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.

tcz: Migilou hohi gangtah a mangthah diu ahin, amaho chu hol le jonglechun mangthai ding ahitaove.
en: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
text:
PSA 37:10
Thadou: Migilou hohi gangtah a mangthah diu ahin, amaho chu hol le jonglechun mangthai ding ahitaove.
English: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

tcz: Kisunem tah a umhon gamsung alodiu ahin, lungmong tah leh ninglhing tah a inchengdiu ahi.
en: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
text:
PSA 37:11
Thadou: Kisunem tah a umhon gamsung alodiu ahin, lungmong tah leh ninglhing tah a inchengdiu ahi.
English: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

tcz: Mi gilouten Elohim Pathen ngaisah miho douna ahinbol diu; Amahon engset sanna ahin nelpehdiu ahi.
en: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
text:
PSA 37:12
Thadou: Mi gilouten Elohim Pathen ngaisah miho douna ahinbol diu; Amahon engset sanna ahin nelpehdiu ahi.
English: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

tcz: Hinlah Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu ahin nuisat in, ajeh chu aman achung thu kitanna ding nikhou ahunglhun chu amui.
en: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
text:
PSA 37:13
Thadou: Hinlah Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu ahin nuisat in, ajeh chu aman achung thu kitanna ding nikhou ahunglhun chu amui.
English: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

tcz: Mi-engsen hon mivaicha ho leh suhgam theija umte that dingin achemjam u hin asatdoh un, athalpiu hin loisal uvintin, thilpha bolte chu ahin suhmang gotdiu ahi.
en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
text:
PSA 37:14
Thadou: Mi-engsen hon mivaicha ho leh suhgam theija umte that dingin achemjam u hin asatdoh un, athalpiu hin loisal uvintin, thilpha bolte chu ahin suhmang gotdiu ahi.
English: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

tcz: Hinlah achemjam un amaho lungchang asutpai johding chuleh athalpiu chu bong ding ahi.
en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
text:
PSA 37:15
Thadou: Hinlah achemjam un amaho lungchang asutpai johding chuleh athalpiu chu bong ding ahi.
English: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

tcz: Ase bola thil tampi neisangin Elohim Pathen mite hia lhomcha nei aphachomjoi.
en: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
text:
PSA 37:16
Thadou: Ase bola thil tampi neisangin Elohim Pathen mite hia lhomcha nei aphachomjoi.
English: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

tcz: Ajeh chu migiloute hatna chu kisumang ding, Pahen mite vang Yahweh Pakai in avenbit jing ding ahi.
en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
text:
PSA 37:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu migiloute hatna chu kisumang ding, Pahen mite vang Yahweh Pakai in avenbit jing ding ahi.
English: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

tcz: Ani ania Yahweh Pakai in themmona neilou hochu avetsui ding, chule amahon tonsotna mang louding gou chu alodiu ahi.
en: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
text:
PSA 37:18
Thadou: Ani ania Yahweh Pakai in themmona neilou hochu avetsui ding, chule amahon tonsotna mang louding gou chu alodiu ahi.
English: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

tcz: Amahochu hahsat nikho jongleh kijumso loudiu kel lhah nikho jong leh angaichat ho anei teidiu ahi.
en: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
text:
PSA 37:19
Thadou: Amahochu hahsat nikho jongleh kijumso loudiu kel lhah nikho jong leh angaichat ho anei teidiu ahi.
English: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

tcz: Migiloute mangthai diu ahi, Yahweh Pakai dougal miho jong loulaija pahcha tobang ahiuve-mei banga hung mang loi diu ahi.
en: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
text:
PSA 37:20
Thadou: Migiloute mangthai diu ahi, Yahweh Pakai dougal miho jong loulaija pahcha tobang ahiuve-mei banga hung mang loi diu ahi.
English: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

tcz: Migilouten asumpa lah u anungsah ngaipouvin, Elohim Pathen mite vang hongphal tah a peh jeng ahiuve.
en: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
text:
PSA 37:21
Thadou: Migilouten asumpa lah u anungsah ngaipouvin, Elohim Pathen mite vang hongphal tah a peh jeng ahiuve.
English: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai phatthei changhon gamsung alodiu ahin, aman asapset ho vang mangthah diu ahi.
en: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
text:
PSA 37:22
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai phatthei changhon gamsung alodiu ahin, aman asapset ho vang mangthah diu ahi.
English: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

tcz: Elohim Pathen mite, Yahweh Pakai in akalsondan avetpeh in, ahinkho mandan jouse aman akipapin ahi.
en: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.
text:
PSA 37:23
Thadou: Elohim Pathen mite, Yahweh Pakai in akalsondan avetpeh in, ahinkho mandan jouse aman akipapin ahi.
English: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.

tcz: Amaho chu kipal jongleu lhupai loudiu, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in akhut in atuh jing ui.
en: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.
text:
PSA 37:24
Thadou: Amaho chu kipal jongleu lhupai loudiu, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in akhut in atuh jing ui.
English: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.

tcz: Phat khat lai chun khangdong kahin tun kateh tai, ahin Elohim Pathen mite paidoh a aumlam kahepon, achateo jong khutdon apangkhapouve.
en: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
text:
PSA 37:25
Thadou: Phat khat lai chun khangdong kahin tun kateh tai, ahin Elohim Pathen mite paidoh a aumlam kahepon, achateo jong khutdon apangkhapouve.
English: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

tcz: Elohim Pathen miten khotona neitah in sumpa ahomjiuvin, chuleh achateojong phatthei achang jiuve.
en: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
text:
PSA 37:26
Thadou: Elohim Pathen miten khotona neitah in sumpa ahomjiuvin, chuleh achateojong phatthei achang jiuve.
English: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

tcz: Thilse akonin kiheidoh in thilpha bol in, chutileh tonsot a gamsunga nachen ding ahi.
en: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
text:
PSA 37:27
Thadou: Thilse akonin kiheidoh in thilpha bol in, chutileh tonsot a gamsunga nachen ding ahi.
English: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in thudih bou adei in, Elohim Pathen in acha teu jong donlou a akoi louhel ding ahi. Aman ahoibit jing ding, Gitlou bol chate vang mangthah diu ahi.
en: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
text:
PSA 37:28
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in thudih bou adei in, Elohim Pathen in acha teu jong donlou a akoi louhel ding ahi. Aman ahoibit jing ding, Gitlou bol chate vang mangthah diu ahi.
English: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

tcz: Elohim Pathen chaten gamsung alodiu ahin, tonsotna cheng jingdiu ahi.
en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
text:
PSA 37:29
Thadou: Elohim Pathen chaten gamsung alodiu ahin, tonsotna cheng jingdiu ahi.
English: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

tcz: Elohim Pathen mite kamsunga thudih apotjin adihle adihlou ahilthem jiuve.
en: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
text:
PSA 37:30
Thadou: Elohim Pathen mite kamsunga thudih apotjin adihle adihlou ahilthem jiuve.
English: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

tcz: Elohim Pathen Dan chu amaho changval din akisan un, hijeh a chu Ama lampi a konna vah lonle loudiu ahi.
en: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
text:
PSA 37:31
Thadou: Elohim Pathen Dan chu amaho changval din akisan un, hijeh a chu Ama lampi a konna vah lonle loudiu ahi.
English: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

tcz: Migilou ten Elohim Pathen mite achanglhi leuvin, suhmang nading lampi ahol jiuve.
en: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
text:
PSA 37:32
Thadou: Migilou ten Elohim Pathen mite achanglhi leuvin, suhmang nading lampi ahol jiuve.
English: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

tcz: Hinlah Yahweh Pakai in migiloute alolhin sah louhel ding Elohim Pathen in mikitah te patepna a aum tengu le themmo achan louhel ding ahi.
en: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
text:
PSA 37:33
Thadou: Hinlah Yahweh Pakai in migiloute alolhin sah louhel ding Elohim Pathen in mikitah te patepna a aum tengu le themmo achan louhel ding ahi.
English: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ah kinem jingin. Alamlhong achun ching thei tah in lamjot in. Aman nadopsang a agam leiset nalosah ding ahi. Migilou te manthahvang namu ding ahi.
en: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
text:
PSA 37:34
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ah kinem jingin. Alamlhong achun ching thei tah in lamjot in. Aman nadopsang a agam leiset nalosah ding ahi. Migilou te manthahvang namu ding ahi.
English: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

tcz: Keiman migilou le khotonabei te Lebanon gama Ceder thingphung phatah banga akhantouvu kamui.
en: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
text:
PSA 37:35
Thadou: Keiman migilou le khotonabei te Lebanon gama Ceder thingphung phatah banga akhantouvu kamui.
English: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

tcz: Ahin kanungvet kitle, ana beisoh taove! Ken kahol le vang in kamudoh joutapoi!
en: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
text:
PSA 37:36
Thadou: Ahin kanungvet kitle, ana beisoh taove! Ken kahol le vang in kamudoh joutapoi!
English: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

tcz: Milungtheng holeh miphaho khu veovin, chamna adei hochu amakhouva thilphatah in angah jing ui.
en: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
text:
PSA 37:37
Thadou: Milungtheng holeh miphaho khu veovin, chamna adei hochu amakhouva thilphatah in angah jing ui.
English: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

tcz: Hinla thilse bolte suhmanga umdiu ahi; amahon khonung hinkho aneipouve.
en: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
text:
PSA 37:38
Thadou: Hinla thilse bolte suhmanga umdiu ahi; amahon khonung hinkho aneipouve.
English: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mikitah te chu ahuhdoh jin; boina nikho hoa jong Amahi akulpiu ahi.
en: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
text:
PSA 37:39
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in mikitah te chu ahuhdoh jin; boina nikho hoa jong Amahi akulpiu ahi.
English: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

tcz: Aman amaho chu akithopin, migiloutea kon in ahuhdohjin ahi. Aman amahochu ahuhdoh in, amahon ama a lungmon na anei un ahi.
en: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
text:
PSA 37:40
Thadou: Aman amaho chu akithopin, migiloutea kon in ahuhdohjin ahi. Aman amahochu ahuhdoh in, amahon ama a lungmon na anei un ahi.
English: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai lung phatmo nan neilethuh hih in, nalunghan jeh in jong neijep hih in!
en: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
text:
PSA 38:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai lung phatmo nan neilethuh hih in, nalunghan jeh in jong neijep hih in!
English: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

tcz: Nathal changho kasunga akikam dentan, nakhuttum in neivo lhutan ahi.
en: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
text:
PSA 38:2
Thadou: Nathal changho kasunga akikam dentan, nakhuttum in neivo lhutan ahi.
English: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

tcz: Neilunghan khum jeh in katahsa pumpi hi anan, kachonset naho jeh in katahsa achip soh tai.
en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
text:
PSA 38:3
Thadou: Neilunghan khum jeh in katahsa pumpi hi anan, kachonset naho jeh in katahsa achip soh tai.
English: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

tcz: Kathepmo nan eilon khum in, agihdan poh jouhoi ahitapoi.
en: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
text:
PSA 38:4
Thadou: Kathepmo nan eilon khum in, agihdan poh jouhoi ahitapoi.
English: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

tcz: Ngolhoi tah a kana chonset jehin, kamaha anasetan auidoh leotai.
en: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.
text:
PSA 38:5
Thadou: Ngolhoi tah a kana chonset jehin, kamaha anasetan auidoh leotai.
English: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.

tcz: Kathoh gimna hin ei kong konsah tai, lung gim tah in nilhum kei in kavah len ahi.
en: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
text:
PSA 38:6
Thadou: Kathoh gimna hin ei kong konsah tai, lung gim tah in nilhum kei in kavah len ahi.
English: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

tcz: Khosih pi kasunga meikong bangin a allin, eidammo sahtai.
en: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
text:
PSA 38:7
Thadou: Khosih pi kasunga meikong bangin a allin, eidammo sahtai.
English: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

tcz: Keima kalhasam in kapum in kagoi lhatai. Kalungthim natna a kon in kapeng pengin ahi.
en: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
text:
PSA 38:8
Thadou: Keima kalhasam in kapum in kagoi lhatai. Kalungthim natna a kon in kapeng pengin ahi.
English: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin ipi kangai chat ham nahei, nangin ka khoisatna jouse najai.
en: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
text:
PSA 38:9
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nangin ipi kangai chat ham nahei, nangin ka khoisatna jouse najai.
English: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

tcz: Kahaina hu alhasam tan katha beitai, chule kamit in jong kho amu tapoi.
en: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
text:
PSA 38:10
Thadou: Kahaina hu alhasam tan katha beitai, chule kamit in jong kho amu tapoi.
English: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

tcz: Kangailut chengle kagol kapaiten kahivei hi akichaovin eidalha taove. Ka insung mite jengjong achomin aumtaovin ahi.
en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
text:
PSA 38:11
Thadou: Kangailut chengle kagol kapaiten kahivei hi akichaovin eidalha taove. Ka insung mite jengjong achomin aumtaovin ahi.
English: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

tcz: Hiche jeng a jong chun kagalmi ten kathi nading thang akam nalai uve. Kaman thahna ding toh gon anei un, nilhum keijin kathi nading agong taovin ahi.
en: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
text:
PSA 38:12
Thadou: Hiche jeng a jong chun kagalmi ten kathi nading thang akam nalai uve. Kaman thahna ding toh gon anei un, nilhum keijin kathi nading agong taovin ahi.
English: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

tcz: Hinlah ken eikigih naho jouse chu kakijah mosah in, chuleh amasang uvah apaomo bangin thipbeh in kaumtai.
en: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
text:
PSA 38:13
Thadou: Hinlah ken eikigih naho jouse chu kakijah mosah in, chuleh amasang uvah apaomo bangin thipbeh in kaumtai.
English: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

tcz: Imacha jahlouding kanom in chuleh donbutna jong donbutlou ding kanom e.
en: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
text:
PSA 38:14
Thadou: Imacha jahlouding kanom in chuleh donbutna jong donbutlou ding kanom e.
English: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

tcz: Ajeh chu O Yahweh Pakai nangma ngah jinga um a kahi. Nangin kataona neidonbut tei ding ahi O Yahweh Pakai Elohim ka Pathen.
en: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.
text:
PSA 38:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu O Yahweh Pakai nangma ngah jinga um a kahi. Nangin kataona neidonbut tei ding ahi O Yahweh Pakai Elohim ka Pathen.
English: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.

tcz: Keima katao in, “kadougalte noise tah in eivetsah dan, kalhuhna a jong kitaisah dan.”
en: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
text:
PSA 38:16
Thadou: Keima katao in, “kadougalte noise tah in eivetsah dan, kalhuhna a jong kitaisah dan.”
English: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

tcz: Keima tanglouva kathohgim na-ah akichaipai ding kahitai.
en: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
text:
PSA 38:17
Thadou: Keima tanglouva kathohgim na-ah akichaipai ding kahitai.
English: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

tcz: Hinlah kachonset naho kaphong-doh in, ka nachonna ho chu kakisih behseh jenge.
en: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
text:
PSA 38:18
Thadou: Hinlah kachonset naho kaphong-doh in, ka nachonna ho chu kakisih behseh jenge.
English: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

tcz: Keiman dougal khohtah tah ho kanei e; amahon ajeh beihel in eidou ui.
en: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
text:
PSA 38:19
Thadou: Keiman dougal khohtah tah ho kanei e; amahon ajeh beihel in eidou ui.
English: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

tcz: Amahon thilpha kabol chu thilsen eilethuh un, chuleh thilpha kachepi jing jeh in eidouvun ahi.
en: They who render evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
text:
PSA 38:20
Thadou: Amahon thilpha kabol chu thilsen eilethuh un, chuleh thilpha kachepi jing jeh in eidouvun ahi.
English: They who render evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai neidalhahih in Elohim ka Pathen kei a kon in um gamla hih behin,
en: Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.
text:
PSA 38:21
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai neidalhahih in Elohim ka Pathen kei a kon in um gamla hih behin,
English: Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai eihuh hingpa hungloi in lang nei kithopin.
en: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
text:
PSA 38:22
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai eihuh hingpa hungloi in lang nei kithopin.
English: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

tcz: “Katohna chunga chingthei tah in thil bol ing kating, kathusei doh chenga chonseponge. Kavel a Elohim Pathen ginglou ho aumteng kalei kakituh tang ding ahi” tin kei le kei kakihou ve.
en: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”
text:
PSA 39:1
Thadou: “Katohna chunga chingthei tah in thil bol ing kating, kathusei doh chenga chonseponge. Kavel a Elohim Pathen ginglou ho aumteng kalei kakituh tang ding ahi” tin kei le kei kakihou ve.
English: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

tcz: Hinla hitia thipbeh a kaum a thupha jeng jong changkhat cha seilouva kaum chun kalung sunga lung gimna akhoh secheh in ahi.
en: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
text:
PSA 39:2
Thadou: Hinla hitia thipbeh a kaum a thupha jeng jong changkhat cha seilouva kaum chun kalung sunga lung gimna akhoh secheh in ahi.
English: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

tcz: Kalunga kagelbe chan in kalung gimna akhoh cheh in, hiti chun seilou in kaum theipon ahi:
en: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
text:
PSA 39:3
Thadou: Kalunga kagelbe chan in kalung gimna akhoh cheh in, hiti chun seilou in kaum theipon ahi:
English: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

tcz: “Yahweh Pakai leiset a kahinkhohi ichan a chom hitam neihin hetsah jing in, kahin nikhohi akisim jinghi neigeldoh sah in, kahin kho iti chom hitam?
en: “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
text:
PSA 39:4
Thadou: “Yahweh Pakai leiset a kahinkhohi ichan a chom hitam neihin hetsah jing in, kahin nikhohi akisim jinghi neigeldoh sah in, kahin kho iti chom hitam?
English: “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

tcz: Nangin kahinkhov hi ichangeija chom a nasem hitam kakhut phang sangin jong asaojo poi. Nang dingin kahinkho lhum kei jong hi haikhat bou ahi soh tan, Mihem hinkho khat cheh jong hi haikhat cheh bou ahi.”
en: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.
text:
PSA 39:5
Thadou: Nangin kahinkhov hi ichangeija chom a nasem hitam kakhut phang sangin jong asaojo poi. Nang dingin kahinkho lhum kei jong hi haikhat bou ahi soh tan, Mihem hinkho khat cheh jong hi haikhat cheh bou ahi.”
English: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

tcz: Mihem hinkho hi milom kitol bang bep bou ahin, kisah lunggim naho jong hetman lou kah in akichai loi ji tai. Gou ikhol khom un, kon ahin manding ham jong ihe doh ji pouve.
en: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.
text:
PSA 39:6
Thadou: Mihem hinkho hi milom kitol bang bep bou ahin, kisah lunggim naho jong hetman lou kah in akichai loi ji tai. Gou ikhol khom un, kon ahin manding ham jong ihe doh ji pouve.
English: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

tcz: Hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai hoi a kinep na kakoi ding ham? Nanga bou kakinep na aum e.
en: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
text:
PSA 39:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai hoi a kinep na kakoi ding ham? Nanga bou kakinep na aum e.
English: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

tcz: Kaset bolnom na a kon in neihuh doh in, mingol ho neinoise sah hih in.
en: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
text:
PSA 39:8
Thadou: Kaset bolnom na a kon in neihuh doh in, mingol ho neinoise sah hih in.
English: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

tcz: Keima na ansung a thipchet in kaum e; imacha jong kasei louding ahi.
en: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
text:
PSA 39:9
Thadou: Keima na ansung a thipchet in kaum e; imacha jong kasei louding ahi.
English: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

tcz: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai nei engbol hih in! Nakhut gu dounan kachao lhagam tai.
en: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
text:
PSA 39:10
Thadou: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai nei engbol hih in! Nakhut gu dounan kachao lhagam tai.
English: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

tcz: Kachonset u suhdih na dia neijep tengu le, kasah lut u chonsetna chu nget in aneh bang in ajun lhaji tan ahi. Tahbeh in mihem khat cheh hi haikhat bou ahi.
en: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.
text:
PSA 39:11
Thadou: Kachonset u suhdih na dia neijep tengu le, kasah lut u chonsetna chu nget in aneh bang in ajun lhaji tan ahi. Tahbeh in mihem khat cheh hi haikhat bou ahi.
English: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kataona ngai in lang panpi ngaija kataona neingai pih in! kamit lhi lon nah sah mon koi hih in, ajeh chu keima hi namaljin bou kahin, kema masang a kapu kapa teu bang a kholjin vahle kahi bouve.
en: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.
text:
PSA 39:12
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai kataona ngai in lang panpi ngaija kataona neingai pih in! kamit lhi lon nah sah mon koi hih in, ajeh chu keima hi namaljin bou kahin, kema masang a kapu kapa teu bang a kholjin vahle kahi bouve.
English: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

tcz: Hiche leiset hinkho hi kadalhah a kahin kho abei masang kakipa a kanui kit na din nalung han na, nagim bol na ho toh neichom khen in.
en: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
text:
PSA 39:13
Thadou: Hiche leiset hinkho hi kadalhah a kahin kho abei masang kakipa a kanui kit na din nalung han na, nagim bol na ho toh neichom khen in.
English: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”

tcz: Panpi ding ngai in Yahweh Pakai chu lungneng tah in kangah jing e, aman kahenglam ahin ngan kataona eisanpih tai.
en: I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
text:
PSA 40:1
Thadou: Panpi ding ngai in Yahweh Pakai chu lungneng tah in kangah jing e, aman kahenglam ahin ngan kataona eisanpih tai.
English: I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

tcz: Aman lunglhah nathei kotong a kon in eikai doh in, buol sung a buon ngan lah a kon in eikai doh in tolgo chung a eidin sah in kakal sonna jong eisuh dih pih e.
en: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
text:
PSA 40:2
Thadou: Aman lunglhah nathei kotong a kon in eikai doh in, buol sung a buon ngan lah a kon in eikai doh in tolgo chung a eidin sah in kakal sonna jong eisuh dih pih e.
English: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

tcz: Kasah ding lathah khat eipen, I Pathen u Elohim vahchoi na ding la khat eipen ahi. Mitamtah in ana toh hin mu un tin adatmo ding u ahi. Hitia chu amahon Yahweh Pakai chu atah san diu ahi.
en: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
text:
PSA 40:3
Thadou: Kasah ding lathah khat eipen, I Pathen u Elohim vahchoi na ding la khat eipen ahi. Mitamtah in ana toh hin mu un tin adatmo ding u ahi. Hitia chu amahon Yahweh Pakai chu atah san diu ahi.
English: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai tahsan na a ding det ho iti akipah tadiuvem, amahon mikiletsah ho chung a tahsan na anei pouvin ahilouleh semthu pathen limhou ho jong atahsan pouve.
en: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
text:
PSA 40:4
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai tahsan na a ding det ho iti akipah tadiuvem, amahon mikiletsah ho chung a tahsan na anei pouvin ahilouleh semthu pathen limhou ho jong atahsan pouve.
English: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen, nangin keiho ding in thil kidang tah tah neibolpeh taove. Neigon peh u thilho hi simjou sutjou hoi ahipoi. Nangto kibang ding koima cha aum poi. Na kidang natoh doh ho hi sim ding kagon, achaina gei kalhun lou ding kahei.
en: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.
text:
PSA 40:5
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen, nangin keiho ding in thil kidang tah tah neibolpeh taove. Neigon peh u thilho hi simjou sutjou hoi ahipoi. Nangto kibang ding koima cha aum poi. Na kidang natoh doh ho hi sim ding kagon, achaina gei kalhun lou ding kahei.
English: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

tcz: Nangman pumgo thilto ho a hin kipana nanei poi. Nei ngaisah thu ho chu tun kahechen tai, nangin chonset thoidam na thilto leh pumgo thilto jong nangeh poi.
en: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
text:
PSA 40:6
Thadou: Nangman pumgo thilto ho a hin kipana nanei poi. Nei ngaisah thu ho chu tun kahechen tai, nangin chonset thoidam na thilto leh pumgo thilto jong nangeh poi.
English: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

tcz: Hichun keiman kaseijin, “Ven keima kahung e. Elohim Pathen lekhabu a kisun bang in:
en: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
text:
PSA 40:7
Thadou: Hichun keiman kaseijin, “Ven keima kahung e. Elohim Pathen lekhabu a kisun bang in:
English: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

tcz: Nangma lungdei lam bolding hi katha anop na ahi, O Elohim Pathen, ajeh chu kalung sung a nangma Danthu hohi akisun lut tai.”
en: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
text:
PSA 40:8
Thadou: Nangma lungdei lam bolding hi katha anop na ahi, O Elohim Pathen, ajeh chu kalung sung a nangma Danthu hohi akisun lut tai.”
English: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

tcz: Namite jouse lah a nathutan dih je hi kaphongdoh tai. O het themna nei Yahweh Pakai, nangma bang in kichaloubeh in kasei doh tai.
en: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.
text:
PSA 40:9
Thadou: Namite jouse lah a nathutan dih je hi kaphongdoh tai. O het themna nei Yahweh Pakai, nangma bang in kichaloubeh in kasei doh tai.
English: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.

tcz: Nadih jedan kipana thupha hi keiman kachang a din kalungthim a selguh in kakoi poi; Nakitah na le nami huhhing na thu kasei e. Nahoubung mithengte lah a namingai lut na long lou le nakitah na chu tanglou in kasei phong jinge.
en: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
text:
PSA 40:10
Thadou: Nadih jedan kipana thupha hi keiman kachang a din kalungthim a selguh in kakoi poi; Nakitah na le nami huhhing na thu kasei e. Nahoubung mithengte lah a namingai lut na long lou le nakitah na chu tanglou in kasei phong jinge.
English: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin tanglou vin neingailu jing jeng in. Nangailut nale nakitahna chu neihoi bit jing sah in.
en: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
text:
PSA 40:11
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nangin tanglou vin neingailu jing jeng in. Nangailut nale nakitahna chu neihoi bit jing sah in.
English: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

tcz: Boinan eibom in sim a simjou hoi ahipoi! Kachonsetna akikhol sang in kalampi jong kamu thei tapoi. Kalujang a kasam sangin atamjo tan hansan na him him kanei jou tapoi.
en: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
text:
PSA 40:12
Thadou: Boinan eibom in sim a simjou hoi ahipoi! Kachonsetna akikhol sang in kalampi jong kamu thei tapoi. Kalujang a kasam sangin atamjo tan hansan na him him kanei jou tapoi.
English: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai lungsettah in neihuhdoh in! hung vah in Yahweh Pakai neipanpin.
en: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.
text:
PSA 40:13
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai lungsettah in neihuhdoh in! hung vah in Yahweh Pakai neipanpin.
English: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.

tcz: Eisumang gohohi jumson lang kisuhboi sah in, kahahsat nikho a kipah ho lungdong in nungjam sah in.
en: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.
text:
PSA 40:14
Thadou: Eisumang gohohi jumson lang kisuhboi sah in, kahahsat nikho a kipah ho lungdong in nungjam sah in.
English: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

tcz: “Aha tun akimaikhah tai” ti a asei jeh un, jum nan kichao hen.
en: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
text:
PSA 40:15
Thadou: “Aha tun akimaikhah tai” ti a asei jeh un, jum nan kichao hen.
English: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

tcz: Nangkom hinbel jouse kipa nale thanop nan dimset uhen. Nami huhhing na kipapi hochun “Yahweh Pakai chu aloupi e” tin sam jing u hen.
en: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”
text:
PSA 40:16
Thadou: Nangkom hinbel jouse kipa nale thanop nan dimset uhen. Nami huhhing na kipapi hochun “Yahweh Pakai chu aloupi e” tin sam jing u hen.
English: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”

tcz: Keidin vang gentheile vaicha kahi jeh in, Yahweh Pakai in alung sung a eihoi jing hen. Yahweh Pakai nang chu eikithopi le eihuhhingpu nahi. O ka Pathen Elohim khongai sot hih in.
en: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
text:
PSA 40:17
Thadou: Keidin vang gentheile vaicha kahi jeh in, Yahweh Pakai in alung sung a eihoi jing hen. Yahweh Pakai nang chu eikithopi le eihuhhingpu nahi. O ka Pathen Elohim khongai sot hih in.
English: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.

tcz: Mivaichate khoto ho chu anunnom ahi! Amaho chu Yahweh Pakai in boina ato nao a kon a ahuhdoh diu ahi.
en: Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.
text:
PSA 41:1
Thadou: Mivaichate khoto ho chu anunnom ahi! Amaho chu Yahweh Pakai in boina ato nao a kon a ahuhdoh diu ahi.
English: Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu ahoibit in ahinghoi jiu ve. Aman amaho chu gamsung ah phatthei aboh in galmiho akon na ahuhdoh ji e.
en: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
text:
PSA 41:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu ahoibit in ahinghoi jiu ve. Aman amaho chu gamsung ah phatthei aboh in galmiho akon na ahuhdoh ji e.
English: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in adam mo naova panpin tin adamdoh sahding ahi.
en: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
text:
PSA 41:3
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in adam mo naova panpin tin adamdoh sahding ahi.
English: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

tcz: “O Yahweh Pakai”, katao ahi “eilungset in, neidamdoh sah in ajeh chu nangma dounan kachonsetai.”
en: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
text:
PSA 41:4
Thadou: “O Yahweh Pakai”, katao ahi “eilungset in, neidamdoh sah in ajeh chu nangma dounan kachonsetai.”
English: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

tcz: Ahinla kadougal ten keima dounan thilse jeng asei un ahi. “Itih tah le athin suhmil in aum tadem?” atiu ve.
en: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
text:
PSA 41:5
Thadou: Ahinla kadougal ten keima dounan thilse jeng asei un ahi. “Itih tah le athin suhmil in aum tadem?” atiu ve.
English: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

tcz: Kagol kapai bang in eihung vil jiuvin, hinla chomloukah in kachungchang guhthim thu asei khom leuvin, eidalhah tengu le muntin in aphonjal ji taove.
en: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
text:
PSA 41:6
Thadou: Kagol kapai bang in eihung vil jiuvin, hinla chomloukah in kachungchang guhthim thu asei khom leuvin, eidalhah tengu le muntin in aphonjal ji taove.
English: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

tcz: Eihot bolten keichung chang a thilphalou ngan aseijun, kachung a thilse ahung lhun dingbou adei un ahi.
en: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
text:
PSA 41:7
Thadou: Eihot bolten keichung chang a thilphalou ngan aseijun, kachung a thilse ahung lhun dingbou adei un ahi.
English: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

tcz: “Amahi thina thei hiveija na ahi” atiuve. “Amahi damdoh joulou ding ahitai!” atiuve.
en: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
text:
PSA 41:8
Thadou: “Amahi thina thei hiveija na ahi” atiuve. “Amahi damdoh joulou ding ahitai!” atiuve.
English: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

tcz: Katahsan pen kagol phapen, an kaneh khom pipa jeng jong keima eidouvin apang tai.
en: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
text:
PSA 41:9
Thadou: Katahsan pen kagol phapen, an kaneh khom pipa jeng jong keima eidouvin apang tai.
English: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai neilungset in. Neidamdoh sah kitin amahohi kalethuh jou nadin!
en: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
text:
PSA 41:10
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai neilungset in. Neidamdoh sah kitin amahohi kalethuh jou nadin!
English: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangma kachunga nalung lhaije ti kahei ajeh chu nangin kamelmate kachungah gal nalel sahtai.
en: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
text:
PSA 41:11
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nangma kachunga nalung lhaije ti kahei ajeh chu nangin kamelmate kachungah gal nalel sahtai.
English: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

tcz: Nangin kahinkho neihing hoipeh tai, ajeh chu keiman lhamonna kaneipoi, chuleh nangin atonsot a din na-angsung a neipui luttai.
en: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
text:
PSA 41:12
Thadou: Nangin kahinkho neihing hoipeh tai, ajeh chu keiman lhamonna kaneipoi, chuleh nangin atonsot a din na-angsung a neipui luttai.
English: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

tcz: Israel Elohim Pathen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umhen, Tonsot tonsot a hingjing pa chu. Amen chule Amen!
en: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
text:
PSA 41:13
Thadou: Israel Elohim Pathen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umhen, Tonsot tonsot a hingjing pa chu. Amen chule Amen!
English: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

tcz: Sakhi sitwi chimset ngaichat dangchah bangin, kahin ngaicha e O Pathen Elohim.
en: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
text:
PSA 42:1
Thadou: Sakhi sitwi chimset ngaichat dangchah bangin, kahin ngaicha e O Pathen Elohim.
English: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

tcz: Hingjing Elohim Pathen chu dangchah in kalha ngai e. Itih tahle kache a a-anga kachibai theiding ham?
en: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
text:
PSA 42:2
Thadou: Hingjing Elohim Pathen chu dangchah in kalha ngai e. Itih tahle kache a a-anga kachibai theiding ham?
English: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

tcz: Sunle jan in lonlhi bou ann in kanei tai, kagal miten phat tin in ei enghouvun “Na Elohim Pathen hoija umham atiuve?”
en: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
text:
PSA 42:3
Thadou: Sunle jan in lonlhi bou ann in kanei tai, kagal miten phat tin in ei enghouvun “Na Elohim Pathen hoija umham atiuve?”
English: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

tcz: Kalung thim analheh ji e thil umdan hochu kageldoh ji teng: Elohim Pathen houin a mihonpi chutoh kilhon a, tanggol a Elohim Pathen inlam jon a kitol a thangvah la kisa a mihonpin golvah kibolji hochu!
en: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.
text:
PSA 42:4
Thadou: Kalung thim analheh ji e thil umdan hochu kageldoh ji teng: Elohim Pathen houin a mihonpi chutoh kilhon a, tanggol a Elohim Pathen inlam jon a kitol a thangvah la kisa a mihonpin golvah kibolji hochu!
English: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.
