tcz: Ibol a kei lunglha dah kahim? Ibol a kalung hibanga hesoh a ham? Keiman Elohim Pathen a kinepna giltah kanei in! Ken ama kathang vah kit ding ahi ka huhhing pu Elohim ka Pathen.
en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
text:
PSA 42:5
Thadou: Ibol a kei lunglha dah kahim? Ibol a kalung hibanga hesoh a ham? Keiman Elohim Pathen a kinepna giltah kanei in! Ken ama kathang vah kit ding ahi ka huhhing pu Elohim ka Pathen.
English: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

tcz: Tun keima kalung alhadah lheh jengtai, hinlah Jordan hung kondoh na, Hermon molsang lang hijong le kahin gel doh jing ding nahi.
en: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.
text:
PSA 42:6
Thadou: Tun keima kalung alhadah lheh jengtai, hinlah Jordan hung kondoh na, Hermon molsang lang hijong le kahin gel doh jing ding nahi.
English: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

tcz: Nang man twipibang nakinon a naki ho twikhanglen gin chu kajai, nangma twipi kidilleh twipi kitol chun eihin lonvuh in ahi.
en: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
text:
PSA 42:7
Thadou: Nang man twipibang nakinon a naki ho twikhanglen gin chu kajai, nangma twipi kidilleh twipi kitol chun eihin lonvuh in ahi.
English: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

tcz: Ahinlah niseh in Yahweh Pakai in angailutna longlou chun eiphung vuh jingin, chuleh janseh leh ama vahchoila kasajin hinkho eipe a Yahweh Pakai komma chun kataojin ahi.
en: GOD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
text:
PSA 42:8
Thadou: Ahinlah niseh in Yahweh Pakai in angailutna longlou chun eiphung vuh jingin, chuleh janseh leh ama vahchoila kasajin hinkho eipe a Yahweh Pakai komma chun kataojin ahi.
English: GOD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kasongpi keima kakapme, ipi dinga neisuhmil hitam? Ipidinga kadougal te bol hesoh jeh a lunggima kavale jingding ham?
en: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
text:
PSA 42:9
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai kasongpi keima kakapme, ipi dinga neisuhmil hitam? Ipidinga kadougal te bol hesoh jeh a lunggima kavale jingding ham?
English: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

tcz: Eihou setnao hin kagep lhatan ahi, “Na Pathen hoija umham,” tin eidong jingun ahi.
en: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
text:
PSA 42:10
Thadou: Eihou setnao hin kagep lhatan ahi, “Na Pathen hoija umham,” tin eidong jingun ahi.
English: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

tcz: Ipi dinga keima hiti lungkham kahin, epidinga hiti lungboi kahim? Keiman Elohim Pathen nah kakinepna koijing ting chuleh eihuhhing paleh ka Pathen chu avellin thangvah kit inge.
en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
text:
PSA 42:11
Thadou: Ipi dinga keima hiti lungkham kahin, epidinga hiti lungboi kahim? Keiman Elohim Pathen nah kakinepna koijing ting chuleh eihuhhing paleh ka Pathen chu avellin thangvah kit inge.
English: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen themmona bei kahi neiphongdoh in! Elohim Pathen ginglou hoa kon in nei vengdoh in, chutengleh mikitah lou holeh joupan hoa kon in neihuhdoh in.
en: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
text:
PSA 43:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen themmona bei kahi neiphongdoh in! Elohim Pathen ginglou hoa kon in nei vengdoh in, chutengleh mikitah lou holeh joupan hoa kon in neihuhdoh in.
English: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

tcz: Ajeh chu nanghi kakiselna Pathen Elohim nahi, ibol a neipaidoh hitam? Ibol a keima kadougal ten eibolset jeh a lunggim a kava lele dingham?
en: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
text:
PSA 43:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu nanghi kakiselna Pathen Elohim nahi, ibol a neipaidoh hitam? Ibol a keima kadougal ten eibolset jeh a lunggim a kava lele dingham?
English: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

tcz: Nadih na le navah na chu neihinsol peh in, hichun eilamhil hen. Hihochun nangma chenna muol theng chu eilhut hen.
en: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
text:
PSA 43:3
Thadou: Nadih na le navah na chu neihinsol peh in, hichun eilamhil hen. Hihochun nangma chenna muol theng chu eilhut hen.
English: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.

tcz: Hikomma chun keima Elohim Pathen maicham achu kasemjang puma kathang vahding ahi, O Pathen Elohim.
en: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
text:
PSA 43:4
Thadou: Hikomma chun keima Elohim Pathen maicham achu kasemjang puma kathang vahding ahi, O Pathen Elohim.
English: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

tcz: Idia lungkham kahim? Ipidinga kalung lhadah ham? Keiman kakinepna Elohim Pathen a koi inge! Eihuhhingpa le Elohim ka Pathen keiman nangma thangvah kit inge!
en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.
text:
PSA 43:5
Thadou: Idia lungkham kahim? Ipidinga kalung lhadah ham? Keiman kakinepna Elohim Pathen a koi inge! Eihuhhingpa le Elohim ka Pathen keiman nangma thangvah kit inge!
English: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, phat sottah masanga kapu kapateo khanglai a nanatoh nathil bolho eina seipeh u chu keiho tah in kanakol un kanajaove:
en: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
text:
PSA 44:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen, phat sottah masanga kapu kapateo khanglai a nanatoh nathil bolho eina seipeh u chu keiho tah in kanakol un kanajaove:
English: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

tcz: Nangin nangma helou namtin vaipi ho naban thahat in nana deljam in agam leiset uchu kapu kapateo nanapen ahi. Nangin agalmiteo nana suhlhuh peh in kapu kapateo chu nana chamlhat sah in ahi.
en: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
text:
PSA 44:2
Thadou: Nangin nangma helou namtin vaipi ho naban thahat in nana deljam in agam leiset uchu kapu kapateo nanapen ahi. Nangin agalmiteo nana suhlhuh peh in kapu kapateo chu nana chamlhat sah in ahi.
English: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

tcz: Amahon achemjam uva gal anajouva gam analah u ahipoi; aban thahat uva jong gal anajou ahipoi. Amavang nangma ban thahat leh namaivah chun gal nana jopeh ahibouve ajeh chu nangin amaho chu nana ngailun ahi.
en: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
text:
PSA 44:3
Thadou: Amahon achemjam uva gal anajouva gam analah u ahipoi; aban thahat uva jong gal anajou ahipoi. Amavang nangma ban thahat leh namaivah chun gal nana jopeh ahibouve ajeh chu nangin amaho chu nana ngailun ahi.
English: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

tcz: Nangma kalengpa le Elohim ka Pathen nahin nangin Israel te dingin gal nana jo peh tai.
en: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!
text:
PSA 44:4
Thadou: Nangma kalengpa le Elohim ka Pathen nahin nangin Israel te dingin gal nana jo peh tai.
English: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!

tcz: Nangma thahatna jal a bou kagal miteo kanungno jouvu ahin naming a bou keihon eidouhou kachotphao ahibouve.
en: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.
text:
PSA 44:5
Thadou: Nangma thahatna jal a bou kagal miteo kanungno jouvu ahin naming a bou keihon eidouhou kachotphao ahibouve.
English: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

tcz: Keiman kathalpi kasongpoi, kachemjamin eihuhdoh dingjong kakinempoi.
en: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.
text:
PSA 44:6
Thadou: Keiman kathalpi kasongpoi, kachemjamin eihuhdoh dingjong kakinempoi.
English: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.

tcz: Nangma bouvin kagalmi teo chunga galjona neipeh u ahibouve, hitihin nangin eihotbol teo chu jumna napejin ahi.
en: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
text:
PSA 44:7
Thadou: Nangma bouvin kagalmi teo chunga galjona neipeh u ahibouve, hitihin nangin eihotbol teo chu jumna napejin ahi.
English: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen naloupina ho hi tantih neilou va ka samphon jing diu, chule a kumkho a ka thangvah jing diu ahi.
en: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.
text:
PSA 44:8
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen naloupina ho hi tantih neilou va ka samphon jing diu, chule a kumkho a ka thangvah jing diu ahi.
English: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

tcz: Ahinla tunvang nangin jumthetna neipaidoh u ahitai. Nangin ka sepia hou jengjong neilamkai peh tapouve.
en: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
text:
PSA 44:9
Thadou: Ahinla tunvang nangin jumthetna neipaidoh u ahitai. Nangin ka sepia hou jengjong neilamkai peh tapouve.
English: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

tcz: Nangin kagalmi teu va kon in neinung jamsah un chuleh eidou houchu kagamsung u nalosah tai.
en: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
text:
PSA 44:10
Thadou: Nangin kagalmi teu va kon in neinung jamsah un chuleh eidou houchu kagamsung u nalosah tai.
English: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

tcz: Nangin kelngoiho bangin eikisat chen chen sah gamtaovin chitin vaipi lah a neithe thang gamtaove.
en: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
text:
PSA 44:11
Thadou: Nangin kelngoiho bangin eikisat chen chen sah gamtaovin chitin vaipi lah a neithe thang gamtaove.
English: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

tcz: Nangin nasahlut namitehi manbai tah in najohdoh in man neilouhel toh nabah sahtai.
en: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
text:
PSA 44:12
Thadou: Nangin nasahlut namitehi manbai tah in najohdoh in man neilouhel toh nabah sahtai.
English: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

tcz: Nangin kaheng kakomhou noise neichansah taovin kavelluva mite taitom le houset dingbep in neikoitaove.
en: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
text:
PSA 44:13
Thadou: Nangin kaheng kakomhou noise neichansah taovin kavelluva mite taitom le houset dingbep in neikoitaove.
English: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

tcz: Nangin amaho totthang hoina bepseo neihisah taovin isahlou tah in alu eihih khum taovin ahi.
en: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
text:
PSA 44:14
Thadou: Nangin amaho totthang hoina bepseo neihisah taovin isahlou tah in alu eihih khum taovin ahi.
English: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

tcz: Ki taitom jingna a konhin kakile doh jouta pouvin kamai uva jumleh jachat mel kapu den taove.
en: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
text:
PSA 44:15
Thadou: Ki taitom jingna a konhin kakile doh jouta pouvin kamai uva jumleh jachat mel kapu den taove.
English: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

tcz: Kajah uhi eitaitomteo housetna thucheng ngen ahin, kamit uva kamu houhi ahileh kachunguva phula nom dougal mite ngen ahiuve.
en: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
text:
PSA 44:16
Thadou: Kajah uhi eitaitomteo housetna thucheng ngen ahin, kamit uva kamu houhi ahileh kachunguva phula nom dougal mite ngen ahiuve.
English: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

tcz: Hichenghi kathoh jeng vangun keihon nangma kasumil deh pouvin ahi. Kitepna thuchengho jong kasukeh deh pouve.
en: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.
text:
PSA 44:17
Thadou: Hichenghi kathoh jeng vangun keihon nangma kasumil deh pouvin ahi. Kitepna thuchengho jong kasukeh deh pouve.
English: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.

tcz: Kalung thim un nangma kanuse deh pouvin nalampia konin jong kajam mangdeh pouve.
en: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
text:
PSA 44:18
Thadou: Kalung thim un nangma kanuse deh pouvin nalampia konin jong kajam mangdeh pouve.
English: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

tcz: Hinlah nangin sial chenna neldi gam anei suchipden taove, nangin thina le muthim neikhu khum taove.
en: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
text:
PSA 44:19
Thadou: Hinlah nangin sial chenna neldi gam anei suchipden taove, nangin thina le muthim neikhu khum taove.
English: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

tcz: I jemtia keihon Elohim ka Pathen u min kasuh mil uva ahilouleh gamdang semthu pathen houna a kakhut u kalhandoh khah uva ahileh,
en: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
text:
PSA 44:20
Thadou: I jemtia keihon Elohim ka Pathen u min kasuh mil uva ahilouleh gamdang semthu pathen houna a kakhut u kalhandoh khah uva ahileh,
English: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

tcz: Elohim Pathen in ahet teiding ahi ajeh chu Aman mihem lungthim a thuguh jouse ahet ahi.
en: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
text:
PSA 44:21
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in ahet teiding ahi ajeh chu Aman mihem lungthim a thuguh jouse ahet ahi.
English: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

tcz: Ahin, nangma jal in niseh in eiki thatnun; kelngoi bangin eiki that taove.
en: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
text:
PSA 44:22
Thadou: Ahin, nangma jal in niseh in eiki thatnun; kelngoi bangin eiki that taove.
English: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai hung thoudoh in ibol a na imut ham? Hung thoudoh in! neipaidoh pai pai hihbeh un.
en: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
text:
PSA 44:23
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai hung thoudoh in ibol a na imut ham? Hung thoudoh in! neipaidoh pai pai hihbeh un.
English: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

tcz: Ipidinga namai naheimang ham? Kathohgim naoleh eibolset naohi nanahsah lou hitam?
en: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
text:
PSA 44:24
Thadou: Ipidinga namai naheimang ham? Kathohgim naoleh eibolset naohi nanahsah lou hitam?
English: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

tcz: Keiho leivui lah a kalhumat gam taove, bonlhoh lah a akhupbon kakijam taove.
en: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
text:
PSA 44:25
Thadou: Keiho leivui lah a kalhumat gam taove, bonlhoh lah a akhupbon kakijam taove.
English: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

tcz: Hung kipatdoh inlang! Neikithopiuvin! Nami ngailutna longlou chun neihung lhatdoh taovin.
en: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
text:
PSA 44:26
Thadou: Hung kipatdoh inlang! Neikithopiuvin! Nami ngailutna longlou chun neihung lhatdoh taovin.
English: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.

tcz: Kalungthim in thu hoi tah ahung kilang e. Keiman lengpa chungchang hiche jaila ngeitah hi lungchin in sei inge, ajeh chu kalei hi jaila themtah pa mol jap tobang ahi.
en: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
text:
PSA 45:1
Thadou: Kalungthim in thu hoi tah ahung kilang e. Keiman lengpa chungchang hiche jaila ngeitah hi lungchin in sei inge, ajeh chu kalei hi jaila themtah pa mol jap tobang ahi.
English: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

tcz: Nanghi mihem jouselah a ahoipen nahi, nalei a thungei tamtah ahung potdoh e. Elohim Pathen amatah in tonsotna din phatthei naboh tan ahi.
en: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
text:
PSA 45:2
Thadou: Nanghi mihem jouselah a ahoipen nahi, nalei a thungei tamtah ahung potdoh e. Elohim Pathen amatah in tonsotna din phatthei naboh tan ahi.
English: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

tcz: O galhatpa! nachemjam chu hin kipoh in! nangmahi naloupi in nathupi e!
en: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.
text:
PSA 45:3
Thadou: O galhatpa! nachemjam chu hin kipoh in! nangmahi naloupi in nathupi e!
English: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.

tcz: Nathupina a chun hung kivon in lang galjou dingin hung kondoh tem in, thutah leh thudih chuleh kisuhnemna hohi chejom sahdingin kondoh inlang datmo umtah tah thilho chu hung tongdoh tan!
en: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.
text:
PSA 45:4
Thadou: Nathupina a chun hung kivon in lang galjou dingin hung kondoh tem in, thutah leh thudih chuleh kisuhnemna hohi chejom sahdingin kondoh inlang datmo umtah tah thilho chu hung tongdoh tan!
English: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

tcz: Nathal muh hochu ahem in nagal mite lungsung asunvang jeng tai. Namtin vaipi nakengto noija aumtaive.
en: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.
text:
PSA 45:5
Thadou: Nathal muh hochu ahem in nagal mite lungsung asunvang jeng tai. Namtin vaipi nakengto noija aumtaive.
English: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

tcz: Vo Elohim Pathen nalal touna hi tonsot tonsot a chejom jing ding ahi. Naleng tengol a chu thudih tah a vai nahomding ahi.
en: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
text:
PSA 45:6
Thadou: Vo Elohim Pathen nalal touna hi tonsot tonsot a chejom jing ding ahi. Naleng tengol a chu thudih tah a vai nahomding ahi.
English: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

tcz: Nangin thudih tah a thutan nadeijin thilse nathet ahi. Hijeh chun Elohim Pathen, nangma Pathen Elohim chun thao nanu ahitai, lengdang sanga nang chungahi kipale thanopna thaotwi chu nasunlhah khum ahitai.
en: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
text:
PSA 45:7
Thadou: Nangin thudih tah a thutan nadeijin thilse nathet ahi. Hijeh chun Elohim Pathen, nangma Pathen Elohim chun thao nanu ahitai, lengdang sanga nang chungahi kipale thanopna thaotwi chu nasunlhah khum ahitai.
English: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

tcz: Myrrh, aloes, chuleh cassia hon navon anamtui sel e. Saiha a kisem khopia chu tumging ngaitah a nakilamto ding ahi.
en: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.
text:
PSA 45:8
Thadou: Myrrh, aloes, chuleh cassia hon navon anamtui sel e. Saiha a kisem khopia chu tumging ngaitah a nakilamto ding ahi.
English: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

tcz: Leng Chanute chu na numei nunnem te lah a aum un. Najet langa ophir sana hoipen ho a kijem lengnu ading e.
en: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
text:
PSA 45:9
Thadou: Leng Chanute chu na numei nunnem te lah a aum un. Najet langa ophir sana hoipen ho a kijem lengnu ading e.
English: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

tcz: O leng chanu te kathusei ngai un; amapa hi jabol un ajeh chu ama hi na Yahweh Pakai pau ahi.
en: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
text:
PSA 45:10
Thadou: O leng chanu te kathusei ngai un; amapa hi jabol un ajeh chu ama hi na Yahweh Pakai pau ahi.
English: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

tcz: Ajeh chu sahlut tah naji hi namel hoinan alunglhai sel e; jabol in, ajeh chu amapa hi na Pakai pa ahi.
en: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
text:
PSA 45:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu sahlut tah naji hi namel hoinan alunglhai sel e; jabol in, ajeh chu amapa hi na Pakai pa ahi.
English: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

tcz: Tyre lengpa chanuten jong kipa thilpeh tampi nahung pehdiu ahi. Mihaoten nalung lhaina ding ahin holdiu ahi.
en: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
text:
PSA 45:12
Thadou: Tyre lengpa chanuten jong kipa thilpeh tampi nahung pehdiu ahi. Mihaoten nalung lhaina ding ahin holdiu ahi.
English: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

tcz: Mounu, leng chanu, chu kivon na sana a kisem sangkholchol a chu iti vet loupia hitam.
en: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
text:
PSA 45:13
Thadou: Mounu, leng chanu, chu kivon na sana a kisem sangkholchol a chu iti vet loupia hitam.
English: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

tcz: Hiche avon loupi tah kivon in lengpa kom lam a ahin pui un, anunjui nungah hochutoh apuilut un ahi.
en: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.
text:
PSA 45:14
Thadou: Hiche avon loupi tah kivon in lengpa kom lam a ahin pui un, anunjui nungah hochutoh apuilut un ahi.
English: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

tcz: Kipah tahle thanom tah a leng inpi sunga ahung akijot lut uchu iti lou a loupi hitam!
en: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.
text:
PSA 45:15
Thadou: Kipah tahle thanom tah a leng inpi sunga ahung akijot lut uchu iti lou a loupi hitam!
English: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

tcz: Nachate jong apa tobang a leng hung hicheh ding ahiuve. Nangin amaho chu gam tamtah a lenga napan sah ding ahi.
en: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
text:
PSA 45:16
Thadou: Nachate jong apa tobang a leng hung hicheh ding ahiuve. Nangin amaho chu gam tamtah a lenga napan sah ding ahi.
English: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

tcz: Khang jousea na min thanna kahin pohlut pehding ahi. Hijeh achu namtin vaipin tonsot a nahin thangvah ding ahi.
en: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
text:
PSA 45:17
Thadou: Khang jousea na min thanna kahin pohlut pehding ahi. Hijeh achu namtin vaipin tonsot a nahin thangvah ding ahi.
English: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

tcz: Elohim Pathenhi ikiselnao leh isongpiu ahi, boina nikho hoa eipanhu diuva kigosa ahi.
en: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
text:
PSA 46:1
Thadou: Elohim Pathenhi ikiselnao leh isongpiu ahi, boina nikho hoa eipanhu diuva kigosa ahi.
English: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

tcz: Hijeh achu ling kihot henlang molle lhang chim henlang twikhanglen a kilehlut jongleh kicha tapouvinge.
en: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

tcz: Twikhanglen hi kinong henlang kitum jeng hen. Twikhanglen kinong a ahung letdoh jeng bang in muolle lhang jong kihot chimlha jeng hen.
en: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
text:
PSA 46:3
Thadou: Twikhanglen hi kinong henlang kitum jeng hen. Twikhanglen kinong a ahung letdoh jeng bang in muolle lhang jong kihot chimlha jeng hen.
English: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

tcz: Vadung khat in iPathen u khopia chun kipa thanopna ahin polut e.
en: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
text:
PSA 46:4
Thadou: Vadung khat in iPathen u khopia chun kipa thanopna ahin polut e.
English: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

tcz: Hiche khopi achun Elohim Pathen achengin kisumang thei lou ding ahi. Nikho kipat a pat Elohim Pathen in avenbit jingding ahi.
en: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
text:
PSA 46:5
Thadou: Hiche khopi achun Elohim Pathen achengin kisumang thei lou ding ahi. Nikho kipat a pat Elohim Pathen in avenbit jingding ahi.
English: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

tcz: Leiset chung namtin vaipihi aboitan lenggam hojong akiling sohtan ahi! Elohim Pathen ahung kisen in ahileh leiset ajunlha gamtan ahi!
en: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.
text:
PSA 46:6
Thadou: Leiset chung namtin vaipihi aboitan lenggam hojong akiling sohtan ahi! Elohim Pathen ahung kisen in ahileh leiset ajunlha gamtan ahi!
English: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung hi ilah uva aum in, Israel Pathen Elohim hi ikulpiu ahi.
en: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
text:
PSA 46:7
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung hi ilah uva aum in, Israel Pathen Elohim hi ikulpiu ahi.
English: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

tcz: Hungin Yahweh Pakai thil loupi bolhi hungvetan, Hunginlang aman vannoi leiset asuhmang hi hungve tan.
en: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.
text:
PSA 46:8
Thadou: Hungin Yahweh Pakai thil loupi bolhi hungvetan, Hunginlang aman vannoi leiset asuhmang hi hungve tan.
English: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.

tcz: Aman vannoi leiset pumpia galho hi atuhtang in athalpiu leh ateng chau heboh peh gamtan ahi.
en: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
text:
PSA 46:9
Thadou: Aman vannoi leiset pumpia galho hi atuhtang in athalpiu leh ateng chau heboh peh gamtan ahi.
English: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

tcz: “Thipchet un, chule Elohim Pathen kahi hi heovin! Vannoi leiset pumin eijabol cheh diu ahi. Leiset pumpia a hi dopsanga kaum ding ahi.”
en: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
text:
PSA 46:10
Thadou: “Thipchet un, chule Elohim Pathen kahi hi heovin! Vannoi leiset pumin eijabol cheh diu ahi. Leiset pumpia a hi dopsanga kaum ding ahi.”
English: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”

tcz: Hatchungnung Elohim Pathenhi ilah uva aumme; Israel Pathen Elohim hi ikulpiu ahi.
en: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
text:
PSA 46:11
Thadou: Hatchungnung Elohim Pathenhi ilah uva aumme; Israel Pathen Elohim hi ikulpiu ahi.
English: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

tcz: Mijouse hungun! Nakhut benguvin! Elohim Pathen kom a kipah tah in thangvahna sam un!
en: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
text:
PSA 47:1
Thadou: Mijouse hungun! Nakhut benguvin! Elohim Pathen kom a kipah tah in thangvahna sam un!
English: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai Hatchungnung chu gimneitah ahi. Amahi leiset chunga leng thupitah ahi.
en: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
text:
PSA 47:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai Hatchungnung chu gimneitah ahi. Amahi leiset chunga leng thupitah ahi.
English: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

tcz: Aman imasang uvah namtin vaipi hi asonkun in eidougalteo jong ikengto noi uvah eikoipeh taove.
en: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
text:
PSA 47:3
Thadou: Aman imasang uvah namtin vaipi hi asonkun in eidougalteo jong ikengto noi uvah eikoipeh taove.
English: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

tcz: Gamtep gam chu, angailut Jacob chilhahate, kithang at tah a kijot eiho lodinga alhen ahi.
en: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
text:
PSA 47:4
Thadou: Gamtep gam chu, angailut Jacob chilhahate, kithang at tah a kijot eiho lodinga alhen ahi.
English: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

tcz: Elohim Pathen chu gimnei tah in akal tou in, Yahweh Pakai chu sumkon gin kithong pum'in akal tou in ahi.
en: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
text:
PSA 47:5
Thadou: Elohim Pathen chu gimnei tah in akal tou in, Yahweh Pakai chu sumkon gin kithong pum'in akal tou in ahi.
English: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

tcz: Elohim Pathen thangvah la sauvin, thangvah la sauvin; ilengpau thangvah la sauvin, thangvah la sauvin!
en: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
text:
PSA 47:6
Thadou: Elohim Pathen thangvah la sauvin, thangvah la sauvin; ilengpau thangvah la sauvin, thangvah la sauvin!
English: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

tcz: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen hi leiset chung pumpi chunga leng ahi lasah pum'in thangvah un.
en: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
text:
PSA 47:7
Thadou: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen hi leiset chung pumpi chunga leng ahi lasah pum'in thangvah un.
English: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

tcz: Elohim Pathen alaltouna theng chunga atou in namtin vaipi lah'a vai ahom'e.
en: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
text:
PSA 47:8
Thadou: Elohim Pathen alaltouna theng chunga atou in namtin vaipi lah'a vai ahom'e.
English: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

tcz: Vannoi leiset vaihomte Abraham Pathen Elohim mitetoh atoukhom'un ahi, ajeh chu leiset chunga leng jouse hi Elohim Pathen'a ahi. Amahi vannoi leiset chung muntin a jana achang'in ahi.
en: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
text:
PSA 47:9
Thadou: Vannoi leiset vaihomte Abraham Pathen Elohim mitetoh atoukhom'un ahi, ajeh chu leiset chunga leng jouse hi Elohim Pathen'a ahi. Amahi vannoi leiset chung muntin a jana achang'in ahi.
English: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi iti loupia hitam, ichangei a pachat dinga lom hitam, i Pathen'u Elohim chu akhopia acheng'in alhangtheng'a atou in ahi!
en: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
text:
PSA 48:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi iti loupia hitam, ichangei a pachat dinga lom hitam, i Pathen'u Elohim chu akhopia acheng'in alhangtheng'a atou in ahi!
English: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

tcz: Hichehi asang'in ahoilamdang'e. Leiset pumpi'n mu ding atup un athanom cheh ui. Lhangtheng Zion molhoi hi leng thupipa chenna khopi ahi!
en: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
text:
PSA 48:2
Thadou: Hichehi asang'in ahoilamdang'e. Leiset pumpi'n mu ding atup un athanom cheh ui. Lhangtheng Zion molhoi hi leng thupipa chenna khopi ahi!
English: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

tcz: Elohim Pathen amatah chu Jerusalem indan sung'a chun acheng'in ahi Amatah hi avengbit'a pang ahi akilang doh e.
en: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
text:
PSA 48:3
Thadou: Elohim Pathen amatah chu Jerusalem indan sung'a chun acheng'in ahi Amatah hi avengbit'a pang ahi akilang doh e.
English: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

tcz: Vannoi mite lengho akigom'un hiche khopi dounan ahin nokhum'un ahi.
en: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
text:
PSA 48:4
Thadou: Vannoi mite lengho akigom'un hiche khopi dounan ahin nokhum'un ahi.
English: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

tcz: Ahinla amahon amuchet phat'un atangchot jeng'un atijauvin ajammang gamtauve.
en: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
text:
PSA 48:5
Thadou: Ahinla amahon amuchet phat'un atangchot jeng'un atijauvin ajammang gamtauve.
English: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

tcz: Amaho chu tijatnan numei naonei hon hahsatna atobang'in akithingleu jeng'un ahi.
en: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
text:
PSA 48:6
Thadou: Amaho chu tijatnan numei naonei hon hahsatna atobang'in akithingleu jeng'un ahi.
English: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

tcz: Ahin nang'in Tarshishte kong thupitah ho solam huijin asuhset bang'in nasuse tan ahi.
en: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
text:
PSA 48:7
Thadou: Ahin nang'in Tarshishte kong thupitah ho solam huijin asuhset bang'in nasuse tan ahi.
English: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

tcz: Keihon hiche khopi loupina chu kanajaovin tunvang Elohim Pathen hatchungnung khopi chu keiho tah'in kamuchen tauvin ahi. Hiche hi iPathen'u Elohim khopi ahi; Aman tonsot a ahoi doh ding ahi.
en: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.
text:
PSA 48:8
Thadou: Keihon hiche khopi loupina chu kanajaovin tunvang Elohim Pathen hatchungnung khopi chu keiho tah'in kamuchen tauvin ahi. Hiche hi iPathen'u Elohim khopi ahi; Aman tonsot a ahoi doh ding ahi.
English: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, na houin theng sunga nangma kavahchoi lai un nami ngailut na longlou chu kagel jing ui.
en: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
text:
PSA 48:9
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen, na houin theng sunga nangma kavahchoi lai un nami ngailut na longlou chu kagel jing ui.
English: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen namin ja dia kilom tah ahibang in leiset kolmong geija vahchoiya naum ding ahi. Najet lam ban thahat chu galjona a dimset ahi.
en: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
text:
PSA 48:10
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen namin ja dia kilom tah ahibang in leiset kolmong geija vahchoiya naum ding ahi. Najet lam ban thahat chu galjona a dimset ahi.
English: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

tcz: Zion mol'a mipiho kipah uhen. Judah khopiho nathutan dihjeh hin kipah uhen.
en: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
text:
PSA 48:11
Thadou: Zion mol'a mipiho kipah uhen. Judah khopiho nathutan dihjeh hin kipah uhen.
English: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

tcz: Vo Elohim Pathen mite cheuvin Zion khopi gakholchen'un akimvel'a kijot uvin ainsangho jong gasim'un.
en: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
text:
PSA 48:12
Thadou: Vo Elohim Pathen mite cheuvin Zion khopi gakholchen'un akimvel'a kijot uvin ainsangho jong gasim'un.
English: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

tcz: Akhopi jouse jong gachon uvin lang akulpi bang nasa tah ho jong melchih'un, chule nang hon nason nachilhah teu naseipeh thei diu ahi.
en: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.
text:
PSA 48:13
Thadou: Akhopi jouse jong gachon uvin lang akulpi bang nasa tah ho jong melchih'un, chule nang hon nason nachilhah teu naseipeh thei diu ahi.
English: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

tcz: Ajeh chu Amahi hitobang mong Pathen ahi. Amahi tonsot tonsot geija dinga iPathen'u Elohim ahin Aman ithi tokah uva eipui hoi diu ahi.
en: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
text:
PSA 48:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu Amahi hitobang mong Pathen ahi. Amahi tonsot tonsot geija dinga iPathen'u Elohim ahin Aman ithi tokah uva eipui hoi diu ahi.
English: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

tcz: Nangho mipite'n hichehi ngaijuvin! Nangho vannoi mite jouse'n ngaicheh uvin!
en: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
text:
PSA 49:1
Thadou: Nangho mipite'n hichehi ngaijuvin! Nangho vannoi mite jouse'n ngaicheh uvin!
English: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

tcz: Milen le mineo, ahao avai in ngaisoh keijun!
en: both low and high, rich and poor together.
text:
PSA 49:2
Thadou: Milen le mineo, ahao avai in ngaisoh keijun!
English: both low and high, rich and poor together.

tcz: Ajeh chu kathuseiho hi chihna thu ahin, chuleh kalung'a kagel jong hi hetgilna dimset ahi.
en: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.
text:
PSA 49:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu kathuseiho hi chihna thu ahin, chuleh kalung'a kagel jong hi hetgilna dimset ahi.
English: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.

tcz: Keiman thuchih kaseiho chu giltah'in kagel'in hiti chun semjang sai a kitilkhou in thulem kaseiho suhlhap na kanei jie.
en: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.
text:
PSA 49:4
Thadou: Keiman thuchih kaseiho chu giltah'in kagel'in hiti chun semjang sai a kitilkhou in thulem kaseiho suhlhap na kanei jie.
English: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

tcz: Kagalmite'n eihin umkimvel'uva boinan eihin lhunkhum teng idia kakichat ding ham?
en: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
text:
PSA 49:5
Thadou: Kagalmite'n eihin umkimvel'uva boinan eihin lhunkhum teng idia kakichat ding ham?
English: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

tcz: Amahon anei agouhou atahsan un ahaotheinau a akiletsah ui.
en: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
text:
PSA 49:6
Thadou: Amahon anei agouhou atahsan un ahaotheinau a akiletsah ui.
English: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in athina diuva kon'in amaho le amaho akihuhdoh joupouvin Elohim Pathen henga sum in ahinkhou akichoh thei pouve.
en: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
text:
PSA 49:7
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in athina diuva kon'in amaho le amaho akihuhdoh joupouvin Elohim Pathen henga sum in ahinkhou akichoh thei pouve.
English: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

tcz: Lhatdamna kitihi bailam tah a um ahipoi, ajeh chu koiman alhingset'in apejou poi;
en: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

tcz: tonsot'a hingjing a lhanmun'a chelou hel nading chu.
en: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.
text:
PSA 49:9
Thadou: tonsot'a hingjing a lhanmun'a chelou hel nading chu.
English: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

tcz: Michingho chu nikhat thitei diu ahi, hiche mingol le lungel neilou ho banga anei agouhou chu adalhah cheh di'u ahi.
en: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
text:
PSA 49:10
Thadou: Michingho chu nikhat thitei diu ahi, hiche mingol le lungel neilou ho banga anei agouhou chu adalhah cheh di'u ahi.
English: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

tcz: Lhanmol chu atonsot inn'u ahitan achen jingna di'u mun chu ahitai. Anei agouho'u chu amaho min putsah jong leu.
en: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.
text:
PSA 49:11
Thadou: Lhanmol chu atonsot inn'u ahitan achen jingna di'u mun chu ahitai. Anei agouho'u chu amaho min putsah jong leu.
English: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

tcz: Aminthan nao chu sotlou ding ganhing ho bang'a thithou thou diu ahi.
en: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
text:
PSA 49:12
Thadou: Aminthan nao chu sotlou ding ganhing ho bang'a thithou thou diu ahi.
English: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

tcz: Amaho hi min miching dan'in geljong leu mingol bang'a thina ato thou thou di'u ahi.
en: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.
text:
PSA 49:13
Thadou: Amaho hi min miching dan'in geljong leu mingol bang'a thina ato thou thou di'u ahi.
English: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

tcz: Kelngoiho bang'a lhanmun lhung thou thou di'u thina chu akelngoi chingpa'u hiding, anei agouhou a kon'a gamlatah'a lhanmun khat'a monlha thou thou diu ahi.
en: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.
text:
PSA 49:14
Thadou: Kelngoiho bang'a lhanmun lhung thou thou di'u thina chu akelngoi chingpa'u hiding, anei agouhou a kon'a gamlatah'a lhanmun khat'a monlha thou thou diu ahi.
English: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

tcz: Ahin keivang Elohim Pathen'in kahinkho eilhatdoh peh'in tin, Aman lhanmun'a kon'in eihuhdoh nante.
en: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.
text:
PSA 49:15
Thadou: Ahin keivang Elohim Pathen'in kahinkho eilhatdoh peh'in tin, Aman lhanmun'a kon'in eihuhdoh nante.
English: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

tcz: Hijeh chun migilou ho ahung hao uva, a in chen ujong ahung hoibe cheh tengu le lunglhadah hih in.
en: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho athiteng uleh imacha akipoh di'u aumpoi anei agou'un lhan sung'ah juilut thei pouvinte.
en: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.
text:
PSA 49:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu amaho athiteng uleh imacha akipoh di'u aumpoi anei agou'un lhan sung'ah juilut thei pouvinte.
English: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

tcz: Hiche lei hinkho'a hin alolhin jeh'un vangpha le ochat um'in kigel jong leu,
en: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—
text:
PSA 49:18
Thadou: Hiche lei hinkho'a hin alolhin jeh'un vangpha le ochat um'in kigel jong leu,
English: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

tcz: Chemasa ho bang bang'a thidiu khovah amukit louhel di'u ahitai.
en: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.
text:
PSA 49:19
Thadou: Chemasa ho bang bang'a thidiu khovah amukit louhel di'u ahitai.
English: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

tcz: Anei agou'u kiletsahpi ho chun amaho jong ganhing bang'a phat khatleh thithou thou diu ahilam akihetdoh lou'u ahi.
en: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
text:
PSA 49:20
Thadou: Anei agou'u kiletsahpi ho chun amaho jong ganhing bang'a phat khatleh thithou thou diu ahilam akihetdoh lou'u ahi.
English: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai loupipen ama chu Elohim Pathen ahin, chuleh Aman thu asei e; Niso namun apat nilhumna munho gei in mihem te akou jing e.
en: The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
text:
PSA 50:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai loupipen ama chu Elohim Pathen ahin, chuleh Aman thu asei e; Niso namun apat nilhumna munho gei in mihem te akou jing e.
English: The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

tcz: Zion mol'a kon'in Amelhoina bulhingset'in Elohim Pathen loupina chun ahinsalvah'in ahi.
en: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
text:
PSA 50:2
Thadou: Zion mol'a kon'in Amelhoina bulhingset'in Elohim Pathen loupina chun ahinsalvah'in ahi.
English: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

tcz: Pathen Elohim ahung lhung tai Ama thipbeh'in aumpoi, alamlhahna a thiljouse mei in akavam gamtai, chuleh avel'ah huipi nasatah anung'in ahi.
en: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
text:
PSA 50:3
Thadou: Pathen Elohim ahung lhung tai Ama thipbeh'in aumpoi, alamlhahna a thiljouse mei in akavam gamtai, chuleh avel'ah huipi nasatah anung'in ahi.
English: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

tcz: Aman a mite chung'a athutanna ve ding'in chunglang'a van ho le leiset akou in ahi.
en: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:
text:
PSA 50:4
Thadou: Aman a mite chung'a athutanna ve ding'in chunglang'a van ho le leiset akou in ahi.
English: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

tcz: “Kahenga kilhaina bol'a kitepna kasemkhom pi tahsan umtah kamite chu kaheng a hin pui lut uvin.”
en: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”
text:
PSA 50:5
Thadou: “Kahenga kilhaina bol'a kitepna kasemkhom pi tahsan umtah kamite chu kaheng a hin pui lut uvin.”
English: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

tcz: Chuleh vanho jouse'n athudihna phongdoh uhen, ajeh chu Elohim Pathen amatah thutan'a pang ding ahi.
en: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.
text:
PSA 50:6
Thadou: Chuleh vanho jouse'n athudihna phongdoh uhen, ajeh chu Elohim Pathen amatah thutan'a pang ding ahi.
English: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

tcz: “Vo kamite kathuseihi ngai uvin, Vo Israel nangma douna kathilgon aum'e, keima hi na Elohim Pathen chu kahi!
en: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
text:
PSA 50:7
Thadou: “Vo kamite kathuseihi ngai uvin, Vo Israel nangma douna kathilgon aum'e, keima hi na Elohim Pathen chu kahi!
English: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

tcz: Kilhaina nabolna ho leh pumgo thilto nabol ho chuleh tang lou a nathilpeh jingho chung'a hin keiman lungphatmo na kaneipoi.
en: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
text:
PSA 50:8
Thadou: Kilhaina nabolna ho leh pumgo thilto nabol ho chuleh tang lou a nathilpeh jingho chung'a hin keiman lungphatmo na kaneipoi.
English: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

tcz: Ahin keiman nabong hon lah'a kon'a hiche bongchal ahin, nakel hon lah'a kon kelcha jongchu kangaicha dehpoi.
en: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.
text:
PSA 50:9
Thadou: Ahin keiman nabong hon lah'a kon'a hiche bongchal ahin, nakel hon lah'a kon kelcha jongchu kangaicha dehpoi.
English: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

tcz: Ajeh chu gammang lah'a ganhing jouse kei a ahin, chuleh mol le lhang jouse'a bong ho jouse jong kei a ahi.
en: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
text:
PSA 50:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu gammang lah'a ganhing jouse kei a ahin, chuleh mol le lhang jouse'a bong ho jouse jong kei a ahi.
English: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

tcz: Keiman mol jouse chung'a vacha jouse kahen, chuleh gamlah'a ganhing ho jouse jong keija ahi.
en: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.
text:
PSA 50:11
Thadou: Keiman mol jouse chung'a vacha jouse kahen, chuleh gamlah'a ganhing ho jouse jong keija ahi.
English: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

tcz: Keima hi gilkel thei anahi jeng tajong leng nangma kom'a kasei angaipoi, ajeh chu vannoi leiset chung'a thil ijakai aumho jouse hi kei a ahi.
en: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
text:
PSA 50:12
Thadou: Keima hi gilkel thei anahi jeng tajong leng nangma kom'a kasei angaipoi, ajeh chu vannoi leiset chung'a thil ijakai aumho jouse hi kei a ahi.
English: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

tcz: Keiman bongchal ho sa kaneh a, kelcha ho thisan kadon khah em?
en: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
text:
PSA 50:13
Thadou: Keiman bongchal ho sa kaneh a, kelcha ho thisan kadon khah em?
English: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

tcz: Nang'in thangvahna hi kilhaina in mang'in, chuleh Hatchungnung kom'a nakitepna chu nit in.
en: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.
text:
PSA 50:14
Thadou: Nang'in thangvahna hi kilhaina in mang'in, chuleh Hatchungnung kom'a nakitepna chu nit in.
English: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

tcz: Chule genthei nikho'n keima neihin kouvin, keiman nahuhdoh ingting nang'in neichoi-at ding ahi.”
en: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
text:
PSA 50:15
Thadou: Chule genthei nikho'n keima neihin kouvin, keiman nahuhdoh ingting nang'in neichoi-at ding ahi.”
English: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

tcz: Ahinlah miphaloute kom'a Elohim Pathen'in hitihin asei e: “nang'in ka Dan thu kakitepna chu naboi pi khoh ham?
en: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,
text:
PSA 50:16
Thadou: Ahinlah miphaloute kom'a Elohim Pathen'in hitihin asei e: “nang'in ka Dan thu kakitepna chu naboi pi khoh ham?
English: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

tcz: Ajeh chu kahilna na la najuipon kathumop jong lahlou in nakoi e.
en: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?
text:
PSA 50:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu kahilna na la najuipon kathumop jong lahlou in nakoi e.
English: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

tcz: Nang'in guchaho namu teng napahcha in chuleh jonthanghoi bol te nakivop pi jie.
en: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
text:
PSA 50:18
Thadou: Nang'in guchaho namu teng napahcha in chuleh jonthanghoi bol te nakivop pi jie.
English: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

tcz: Nakam sunga thujou adimset'in, nalei chu thujou jengseh seinan namang'in ahi.
en: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
text:
PSA 50:19
Thadou: Nakam sunga thujou adimset'in, nalei chu thujou jengseh seinan namang'in ahi.
English: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

tcz: Muntin in natou len nanu a kona napenpi nasopipa jengjong jouthun naheh se lei.
en: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.
text:
PSA 50:20
Thadou: Muntin in natou len nanu a kona napenpi nasopipa jengjong jouthun naheh se lei.
English: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

tcz: Nangma hitobang'a nakimanchah sung'in thipbeh in kaum'in ahileh keiman kanahsah lou dan'in nagel'in, tuvanghin nachung'a themmo kahinchan'a hichengse pum'a hi kahingih nahitai, nangma douna kahin lhunsah diho hi kagollha tai.
en: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.
text:
PSA 50:21
Thadou: Nangma hitobang'a nakimanchah sung'in thipbeh in kaum'in ahileh keiman kanahsah lou dan'in nagel'in, tuvanghin nachung'a themmo kahinchan'a hichengse pum'a hi kahingih nahitai, nangma douna kahin lhunsah diho hi kagollha tai.
English: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

tcz: Ei sumilho jouse kisih un, achuti loule Keiman kabotel ding nahiuve, chule koiman nakithopi loudiu ahi.
en: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
text:
PSA 50:22
Thadou: Ei sumilho jouse kisih un, achuti loule Keiman kabotel ding nahiuve, chule koiman nakithopi loudiu ahi.
English: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

tcz: Ahinlah kilhaina thilto khel'a thangvahna eipe'a chun eichoisang tahbeh ahi. Kalamlhahna a naumjingleh Elohim Pathen mihuhhingna chu kamusah ding nahi”
en: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”
text:
PSA 50:23
Thadou: Ahinlah kilhaina thilto khel'a thangvahna eipe'a chun eichoisang tahbeh ahi. Kalamlhahna a naumjingleh Elohim Pathen mihuhhingna chu kamusah ding nahi”
English: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”

tcz: O Pathen Elohim, na mingailutna longlou jeh'in na mi khotona chu neimusah in. Na mi hepina kidangtah jeh chun ka chonset nenbeh jouse neisuhbei peh in.
en: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
text:
PSA 51:1
Thadou: O Pathen Elohim, na mingailutna longlou jeh'in na mi khotona chu neimusah in. Na mi hepina kidangtah jeh chun ka chonset nenbeh jouse neisuhbei peh in.
English: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

tcz: Kathemmona ho jouse'a kon'in neisutheng in lang neisoptheng in, ka chonsetna a kon'in neisuthengsel in.
en: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.
text:
PSA 51:2
Thadou: Kathemmona ho jouse'a kon'in neisutheng in lang neisoptheng in, ka chonsetna a kon'in neisuthengsel in.
English: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

tcz: Ajeh chu ka phatlouna ka kihet'in sun le jan'in eijui jing'in ahi.
en: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.
text:
PSA 51:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu ka phatlouna ka kihet'in sun le jan'in eijui jing'in ahi.
English: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

tcz: Nangma douna mong'a chonse ka hi, Nangma mitmun thilse chu ka na bol tai. Na thusei in nadihna aphondoh ding ahi, chuleh ka chung'a nathutan jong adih'in ahi.
en: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
text:
PSA 51:4
Thadou: Nangma douna mong'a chonse ka hi, Nangma mitmun thilse chu ka na bol tai. Na thusei in nadihna aphondoh ding ahi, chuleh ka chung'a nathutan jong adih'in ahi.
English: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

tcz: Ajeh chu ka nu oisung'a ka ki jil'a pat'a chonset pum'a kijil ka hin chonsesa hung peng a ka hi.
en: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.
text:
PSA 51:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu ka nu oisung'a ka ki jil'a pat'a chonset pum'a kijil ka hin chonsesa hung peng a ka hi.
English: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

tcz: Hinla nang'in ka nu oisung'a pat'in jong atheng a ka um ding nana ngaichat ahin hiche mun jeng'a jong chu chihna lungthim neina hilpat ahitai.
en: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
text:
PSA 51:6
Thadou: Hinla nang'in ka nu oisung'a pat'in jong atheng a ka um ding nana ngaichat ahin hiche mun jeng'a jong chu chihna lungthim neina hilpat ahitai.
English: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

tcz: Ka chonsetna a kon'in neisutheng lechun ka then ding ahitai, neisoptheng lechun buhbang sang'in theng tang'e.
en: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
text:
PSA 51:7
Thadou: Ka chonsetna a kon'in neisutheng lechun ka then ding ahitai, neisoptheng lechun buhbang sang'in theng tang'e.
English: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

tcz: Oh! Ka kipana neipekit in, nang'in nei hesoh sah ahin tun neikipasah kit tan.
en: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
text:
PSA 51:8
Thadou: Oh! Ka kipana neipekit in, nang'in nei hesoh sah ahin tun neikipasah kit tan.
English: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

tcz: Ka chonsetna ho neivet peh jing hih in, ka setna nenbeh ho sumang in.
en: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
text:
PSA 51:9
Thadou: Ka chonsetna ho neivet peh jing hih in, ka setna nenbeh ho sumang in.
English: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

tcz: Lungthimthah neisem peh in O Yahweh Pakai. Kasunga um lhagao hi nei thah sempeh in.
en: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
text:
PSA 51:10
Thadou: Lungthimthah neisem peh in O Yahweh Pakai. Kasunga um lhagao hi nei thah sempeh in.
English: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

tcz: Na angsung'a kon'in neipaidoh hih'in, chuleh keija kon'in na Lhagao Theng chu lamang hih'in.
en: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.
text:
PSA 51:11
Thadou: Na angsung'a kon'in neipaidoh hih'in, chuleh keija kon'in na Lhagao Theng chu lamang hih'in.
English: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

tcz: Nei huhhing nikho'a ka kipana chu avel'in neipe kit in lang chuleh nathu'a nung jing mi neihisah in,
en: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
text:
PSA 51:12
Thadou: Nei huhhing nikho'a ka kipana chu avel'in neipe kit in lang chuleh nathu'a nung jing mi neihisah in,
English: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

tcz: Chuteng na thua nunglou ho jong nangma deilam'a ahung chonna di'uva ka hil ding chutengleh amaho nangma kom lang'a hung kile kit ding ahi'uve.
en: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.
text:
PSA 51:13
Thadou: Chuteng na thua nunglou ho jong nangma deilam'a ahung chonna di'uva ka hil ding chutengleh amaho nangma kom lang'a hung kile kit ding ahi'uve.
English: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

tcz: O Pathen Elohim mi huhhingpu, keiman thisan kaso tahjeh in neingaidam'in chutileh neingaidamna chu kipah tah'a vahchoila a ka sah ding ahi.
en: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.
text:
PSA 51:14
Thadou: O Pathen Elohim mi huhhingpu, keiman thisan kaso tahjeh in neingaidam'in chutileh neingaidamna chu kipah tah'a vahchoila a ka sah ding ahi.
English: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai lungnachim'a nangma ka vahchoi theina ding'in ka lei neilhap peh'in.
en: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.
text:
PSA 51:15
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai lungnachim'a nangma ka vahchoi theina ding'in ka lei neilhap peh'in.
English: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

tcz: Nangman kilhaina thilpeh na ngaicha pon, pumgo thilto ding khat jong na ngaicha pon ahi.
en: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.
text:
PSA 51:16
Thadou: Nangman kilhaina thilpeh na ngaicha pon, pumgo thilto ding khat jong na ngaicha pon ahi.
English: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

tcz: Nang in na ngaichat kilhaina chu-Lhagaova kisuh gep ahin, nang'in lung kisuchip pum'a kisihna neiho napaidoh poi o Yahweh Pakai.
en: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
text:
PSA 51:17
Thadou: Nang in na ngaichat kilhaina chu-Lhagaova kisuh gep ahin, nang'in lung kisuchip pum'a kisihna neiho napaidoh poi o Yahweh Pakai.
English: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.

tcz: Zion hi lungsetna mitvet in venlang hin kithopin, Jerusalem pal hinsem phan.
en: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.
text:
PSA 51:18
Thadou: Zion hi lungsetna mitvet in venlang hin kithopin, Jerusalem pal hinsem phan.
English: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

tcz: Chutengleh kilhaina lungtheng sel a kipe pumgo thilto hon lunglhai in natin chule pumgo thil to pum bongchal ho avel'in hung kikatdoh tante.
en: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.
text:
PSA 51:19
Thadou: Chutengleh kilhaina lungtheng sel a kipe pumgo thilto hon lunglhai in natin chule pumgo thil to pum bongchal ho avel'in hung kikatdoh tante.
English: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

tcz: Galhang nangman idia na thilse bol ho kiletsahpi nahim? Elohim Pathen thutan dihje hi tonsotna aum jing helou nahim?
en: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
text:
PSA 52:1
Thadou: Galhang nangman idia na thilse bol ho kiletsahpi nahim? Elohim Pathen thutan dihje hi tonsotna aum jing helou nahim?
English: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

tcz: Nilhum kei keijin nangman manthahna ding jeng na gong e. Na leigui in jong chem hemtah in mi a-at abang'in; jouthu sei in nangma nathem lheh e.
en: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
text:
PSA 52:2
Thadou: Nilhum kei keijin nangman manthahna ding jeng na gong e. Na leigui in jong chem hemtah in mi a-at abang'in; jouthu sei in nangma nathem lheh e.
English: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

tcz: Nang'in thilpha sang'in thilse na deijon, thutah sangin jong jou nadeijoi.
en: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.
text:
PSA 52:3
Thadou: Nang'in thilpha sang'in thilse na deijon, thutah sangin jong jou nadeijoi.
English: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

tcz: Nathu jou hoa chun nangman mi suhmang ding nadei e!
en: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.
text:
PSA 52:4
Thadou: Nathu jou hoa chun nangman mi suhmang ding nadei e!
English: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

tcz: Hinlah Elohim Pathen'in nangma na hin suhmanghel ding ahi. Aman na in'a kon a nahin kaidoh ding chuleh mihing chenna gam'a kon'a na hin bodoh ding ahi.
en: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.
text:
PSA 52:5
Thadou: Hinlah Elohim Pathen'in nangma na hin suhmanghel ding ahi. Aman na in'a kon a nahin kaidoh ding chuleh mihing chenna gam'a kon'a na hin bodoh ding ahi.
English: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

tcz: Mi chonpha hon hichu hin muvintin ahin datmo di'u ahi. Amahon hin nuisat intin aseidi'u ahi,
en: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,
text:
PSA 52:6
Thadou: Mi chonpha hon hichu hin muvintin ahin datmo di'u ahi. Amahon hin nuisat intin aseidi'u ahi,
English: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

tcz: “Veuvin Elohim Pathen tahsanlou galhat ho chung'a hi ipi thil soh'a hitam? Amaho ahao nao a akisong'un, athilse bol nao a akhangtou cheh cheh un ahi.”
en: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”
text:
PSA 52:7
Thadou: “Veuvin Elohim Pathen tahsanlou galhat ho chung'a hi ipi thil soh'a hitam? Amaho ahao nao a akisong'un, athilse bol nao a akhangtou cheh cheh un ahi.”
English: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”

tcz: Hinlah, keima vang Elohim Pathen houin sung'a keh Olive thing hing hoitah tobang kahin, keiman phat tin'a Elohim Pathen mi ngailutna long lou chu katahsan jing ding ahi.
en: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.
text:
PSA 52:8
Thadou: Hinlah, keima vang Elohim Pathen houin sung'a keh Olive thing hing hoitah tobang kahin, keiman phat tin'a Elohim Pathen mi ngailutna long lou chu katahsan jing ding ahi.
English: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen na thilpha bol jeh hin nangma thangvah jing ingting na mithengte masang'a na min ngeitah chu tahsan jing tang'e.
en: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.
text:
PSA 52:9
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen na thilpha bol jeh hin nangma thangvah jing ingting na mithengte masang'a na min ngeitah chu tahsan jing tang'e.
English: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

tcz: Mingol honbou alungsung uva kon'in “Elohim Pathen aumpoi” ati'uve. Amaho chu mi kitahlou ahi'uvin, thilphalou jeng bol ahi'uvin khatchan jong thilpha abol pouvin ahi.
en: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.
text:
PSA 53:1
Thadou: Mingol honbou alungsung uva kon'in “Elohim Pathen aumpoi” ati'uve. Amaho chu mi kitahlou ahi'uvin, thilphalou jeng bol ahi'uvin khatchan jong thilpha abol pouvin ahi.
English: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

tcz: Elohim Pathen'in van'a kon'in mihemte jouse hi ahinven, Aman mikhattou aching tahbeh um am, khat touvin Elohim Pathen ahol am tin ahinven ahi.
en: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.
text:
PSA 53:2
Thadou: Elohim Pathen'in van'a kon'in mihemte jouse hi ahinven, Aman mikhattou aching tahbeh um am, khat touvin Elohim Pathen ahol am tin ahinven ahi.
English: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

tcz: Ahinlah khatcha amupon, abonchaovin akihei mangsoh hel ta'uvin, aboncha'uvin akitahlou ngen ahi'uvin, koimacha thilpha bol aumpouvin khatcha jong aumpoi.
en: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
text:
PSA 53:3
Thadou: Ahinlah khatcha amupon, abonchaovin akihei mangsoh hel ta'uvin, aboncha'uvin akitahlou ngen ahi'uvin, koimacha thilpha bol aumpouvin khatcha jong aumpoi.
English: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

tcz: Hitobang'a thilphalou bol ho hin ahetdohlou hel di'u ham? Amaho hin kamite hi changlhah bang'a anehchai di'u ahitan Elohim Pathen kom'a tao ding jong agelpha pouve.
en: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?
text:
PSA 53:4
Thadou: Hitobang'a thilphalou bol ho hin ahetdohlou hel di'u ham? Amaho hin kamite hi changlhah bang'a anehchai di'u ahitan Elohim Pathen kom'a tao ding jong agelpha pouve.
English: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?

tcz: Amaho hi, tu masang'a anahetphah louhel u tijatnan ahin lokhum ding ahi'uve. Elohim Pathen'in na galmite'u gu le chang ahin thejal ding, nang'in amaho hi na ahin suhjum ding ahi, ajeh chu Elohim Pathen'in amaho hi apaidoh ahi'uve.
en: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.
text:
PSA 53:5
Thadou: Amaho hi, tu masang'a anahetphah louhel u tijatnan ahin lokhum ding ahi'uve. Elohim Pathen'in na galmite'u gu le chang ahin thejal ding, nang'in amaho hi na ahin suhjum ding ahi, ajeh chu Elohim Pathen'in amaho hi apaidoh ahi'uve.
English: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

tcz: Zion mol'a kon'a Israelte huhdoh dia koi hung ding ham? Elohim Pathen in amite akiledohsah tengleh, Jacob in kipah a kho asap ding Israelte kipah ding ahi'uve.
en: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
text:
PSA 53:6
Thadou: Zion mol'a kon'a Israelte huhdoh dia koi hung ding ham? Elohim Pathen in amite akiledohsah tengleh, Jacob in kipah a kho asap ding Israelte kipah ding ahi'uve.
English: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen thaneitah in hung'in lang neihuhdoh in! Na thahatnan nei veng'in.
en: Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
text:
PSA 54:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen thaneitah in hung'in lang neihuhdoh in! Na thahatnan nei veng'in.
English: Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen ka taona ngaijin, ka thumna hi neihin gelkhoh peh'in,
en: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
text:
PSA 54:2
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen ka taona ngaijin, ka thumna hi neihin gelkhoh peh'in,
English: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

tcz: Ajeh chu gamdang mite'n eihin delkhum uvin, mi engse ten tha ding'in eihol'un ahi, amahon Elohim Pathen imachan agel pouve.
en: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.
text:
PSA 54:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu gamdang mite'n eihin delkhum uvin, mi engse ten tha ding'in eihol'un ahi, amahon Elohim Pathen imachan agel pouve.
English: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

tcz: Ahinlah kei ding'in Elohim Pathen hi eipanpi ahin, Yahweh Pakai hin eihinghoi ahi.
en: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
text:
PSA 54:4
Thadou: Ahinlah kei ding'in Elohim Pathen hi eipanpi ahin, Yahweh Pakai hin eihinghoi ahi.
English: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

tcz: Ka galmi ten thilse agon jouse'u hi amaho chunga le chuh hen! Na dei dan tah in achung uva na tong'in lang amaho khu subei in.
en: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
text:
PSA 54:5
Thadou: Ka galmi ten thilse agon jouse'u hi amaho chunga le chuh hen! Na dei dan tah in achung uva na tong'in lang amaho khu subei in.
English: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

tcz: Keiman naheng a kiphal tah in thilpeh hinchoi ing e; Keiman namin hinthang vah ing kate Yahweh Pakai, ajeh chu hichu apha ahi.
en: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.
text:
PSA 54:6
Thadou: Keiman naheng a kiphal tah in thilpeh hinchoi ing e; Keiman namin hinthang vah ing kate Yahweh Pakai, ajeh chu hichu apha ahi.
English: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai nang'in ka hesohna a kon'in neihuhdoh tan, ka galmite chung'a jong galjona neimusah tan ahi.
en: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
text:
PSA 54:7
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai nang'in ka hesohna a kon'in neihuhdoh tan, ka galmite chung'a jong galjona neimusah tan ahi.
English: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.

tcz: Vo Elohim Pathen ka taona neingaipeh in, panpi ngehna ka taona neigelkhoh peh'in!
en: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
text:
PSA 55:1
Thadou: Vo Elohim Pathen ka taona neingaipeh in, panpi ngehna ka taona neigelkhoh peh'in!
English: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

tcz: Lungset tah in ka taona neingaipeh in lang neihin donbut teijin, ajeh chu kagimnan eihin lonvuh tan ahi.
en: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan
text:
PSA 55:2
Thadou: Lungset tah in ka taona neingaipeh in lang neihin donbut teijin, ajeh chu kagimnan eihin lonvuh tan ahi.
English: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

tcz: Ka galmite'n eisamseu vin, eigihna'u hi akithong le'u jeng'in ahi. Aman boi na eilhunkhum sah un lunghang tah'in eihin delkhum taove.
en: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.
text:
PSA 55:3
Thadou: Ka galmite'n eisamseu vin, eigihna'u hi akithong le'u jeng'in ahi. Aman boi na eilhunkhum sah un lunghang tah'in eihin delkhum taove.
English: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

tcz: Ka lung aphul lap jeng'in thina gimneitah hin eihin nokhum tan ahi.
en: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
text:
PSA 55:4
Thadou: Ka lung aphul lap jeng'in thina gimneitah hin eihin nokhum tan ahi.
English: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

tcz: Tijatna le lunggimna'n eilonvuh tan kithing louvin ka umthei poi.
en: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
text:
PSA 55:5
Thadou: Tijatna le lunggimna'n eilonvuh tan kithing louvin ka umthei poi.
English: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

tcz: Oh, vakhu bang'a lhaving nei hitave leng o keima lengdoh ingting ga kicholdo tang'e!
en: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
text:
PSA 55:6
Thadou: Oh, vakhu bang'a lhaving nei hitave leng o keima lengdoh ingting ga kicholdo tang'e!
English: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

tcz: Keima gamlatah in lengdoh ingting gamthip noi olnamun gabel tang'e.
en: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.
text:
PSA 55:7
Thadou: Keima gamlatah in lengdoh ingting gamthip noi olnamun gabel tang'e.
English: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.

tcz: Hitobang kivetdatona huipi kinunglah a konhin gangtah in gamlatah a jammang tang'e.
en: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”
text:
PSA 55:8
