Thadou: Hitobang kivetdatona huipi kinunglah a konhin gangtah in gamlatah a jammang tang'e.
English: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

tcz: Yahweh Pakai amaho hi kisuhmosah in lang athilse gon'u jong hi suhmopeh jeng tan, ajeh chu athilgon'u hin khopi sung'a thilse tamtah asodoh sah ding ahi.
en: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
text:
PSA 55:9
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai amaho hi kisuhmosah in lang athilse gon'u jong hi suhmopeh jeng tan, ajeh chu athilgon'u hin khopi sung'a thilse tamtah asodoh sah ding ahi.
English: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

tcz: Akulpi bang'u jong galmi'a kon'a hoidohna ding'a asun ajan a anga'u ahi, ahinla akhohpentah chu khopi sung'a chonsetna ho hi ahi.
en: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.
text:
PSA 55:10
Thadou: Akulpi bang'u jong galmi'a kon'a hoidohna ding'a asun ajan a anga'u ahi, ahinla akhohpentah chu khopi sung'a chonsetna ho hi ahi.
English: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

tcz: Thil jouse hi asegam'a ahitai, kailhang jeng'a jong kigihna le ki joubol na adimlha tan ahi.
en: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.
text:
PSA 55:11
Thadou: Thil jouse hi asegam'a ahitai, kailhang jeng'a jong kigihna le ki joubol na adimlha tan ahi.
English: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

tcz: Ka dougal'in eitai tomna jong ahipoi hichu ka doujou thouve, kiletsah tah'a eijumso jing'a ka kidoupipa jong ahipoi, amaho a kon chun ka ki seldoh theinan ahi.
en: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.
text:
PSA 55:12
Thadou: Ka dougal'in eitai tomna jong ahipoi hichu ka doujou thouve, kiletsah tah'a eijumso jing'a ka kidoupipa jong ahipoi, amaho a kon chun ka ki seldoh theinan ahi.
English: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

tcz: Amavang hiche ho chu hilouvin, ka kibahpi, ka kivoppi, ka golngai nangma chu na hi.
en: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.
text:
PSA 55:13
Thadou: Amavang hiche ho chu hilouvin, ka kibahpi, ka kivoppi, ka golngai nangma chu na hi.
English: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

tcz: Phat khatna chu ichan geija ina kingailut hitam Elohim Pathen houin jeng'a jong ina kijotlutji ahie!
en: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
text:
PSA 55:14
Thadou: Phat khatna chu ichan geija ina kingailut hitam Elohim Pathen houin jeng'a jong ina kijotlutji ahie!
English: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

tcz: Ka dougalte hi thina'n lhunkhum hen, lhankhuh in ahing'in vallhum jeng'u hen, ajeh chu setna'n alungsung'u chen nan aneitan ahi.
en: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.
text:
PSA 55:15
Thadou: Ka dougalte hi thina'n lhunkhum hen, lhankhuh in ahing'in vallhum jeng'u hen, ajeh chu setna'n alungsung'u chen nan aneitan ahi.
English: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

tcz: Ahinlah keiman Elohim ka Pathen ka kou ding chuleh Yahweh ka Pakai in eihuhdoh ding ahi.
en: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.
text:
PSA 55:16
Thadou: Ahinlah keiman Elohim ka Pathen ka kou ding chuleh Yahweh ka Pakai in eihuhdoh ding ahi.
English: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.

tcz: Jingkah, sun, nilhah in ka lung hesoh jeh'in ka kap'in ahileh Yahweh Pakai in ka-o eijahpeh tai.
en: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
text:
PSA 55:17
Thadou: Jingkah, sun, nilhah in ka lung hesoh jeh'in ka kap'in ahileh Yahweh Pakai in ka-o eijahpeh tai.
English: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

tcz: Mi tamtah in eidou jing hen lang, kei douna'n gal kisat chohjeju jeng jongleh Yahweh Pakai in eilhatdoh'in ol-heuvin eiumsah tai.
en: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
text:
PSA 55:18
Thadou: Mi tamtah in eidou jing hen lang, kei douna'n gal kisat chohjeju jeng jongleh Yahweh Pakai in eilhatdoh'in ol-heuvin eiumsah tai.
English: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

tcz: Tonsot a vaihom jing Elohim Pathen chun ka taona sang intin ka dougalte asuhnem ding ahi. Ajeh chu amahon achondan'u akhelnom pouvin Elohim Pathen jong aging pouve;
en: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.

tcz: Keima kiloipipan vang, aloihi alhem lhan akitepna asukeh'in ahi.
en: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.
text:
PSA 55:20
Thadou: Keima kiloipipan vang, aloihi alhem lhan akitepna asukeh'in ahi.
English: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

tcz: Athu cheng chu thaotwi bang'in analjet in hinlah asung uvin gal lungthim apu'uve. Athu cheng'u thaotwi nang abang'in hinlah asunglang uvah chemjam ngen aum'e.
en: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
text:
PSA 55:21
Thadou: Athu cheng chu thaotwi bang'in analjet in hinlah asung uvin gal lungthim apu'uve. Athu cheng'u thaotwi nang abang'in hinlah asunglang uvah chemjam ngen aum'e.
English: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

tcz: Na pohgih chu Yahweh Pakai chung'a seplha tan Aman na ngai jangpeh nante. Aman mi chonpha ho chu akipalsah lou ding lhuh jong alhuhsah lou ding ahi.
en: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
text:
PSA 55:22
Thadou: Na pohgih chu Yahweh Pakai chung'a seplha tan Aman na ngai jangpeh nante. Aman mi chonpha ho chu akipalsah lou ding lhuh jong alhuhsah lou ding ahi.
English: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

tcz: Nangvang O Elohim Pathen mi gilou ho chu lhuh na kokhuh a nasotlhah ding ahi. Tolthat ho le jonpan ho jong khangdong cha na thisah ding ahi, hinla keimanvang eihuhing din nang jeng katahsan e.
en: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.
text:
PSA 55:23
Thadou: Nangvang O Elohim Pathen mi gilou ho chu lhuh na kokhuh a nasotlhah ding ahi. Tolthat ho le jonpan ho jong khangdong cha na thisah ding ahi, hinla keimanvang eihuhing din nang jeng katahsan e.
English: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, na mi khotonan neipui jing'in, ajeh chu mipite'n eidel jing'uvin eidouhon nilhumkei kei'in eidelkhum jing'un ahi.
en: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
text:
PSA 56:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen, na mi khotonan neipui jing'in, ajeh chu mipite'n eidel jing'uvin eidouhon nilhumkei kei'in eidelkhum jing'un ahi.
English: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

tcz: Eihousehon jong phattin in eidel jing'un chuleh mitamtah'in eidelkhum jing'un ahi.
en: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
text:
PSA 56:2
Thadou: Eihousehon jong phattin in eidel jing'un chuleh mitamtah'in eidelkhum jing'un ahi.
English: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

tcz: Ahinlah ka kichat teng nangma tahsanna a chun ka lut ji tan ahi.
en: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
text:
PSA 56:3
Thadou: Ahinlah ka kichat teng nangma tahsanna a chun ka lut ji tan ahi.
English: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

tcz: Aman kahenga kitepna anei jeh'in Yahweh Pakai chu ka thangvah e. Elohim Pathen tahsana a ka dindet jingle kei ipi ding'a ka kichat ding ham? Hi chi mihem chun i eilo thei ding ham?
en: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
text:
PSA 56:4
Thadou: Aman kahenga kitepna anei jeh'in Yahweh Pakai chu ka thangvah e. Elohim Pathen tahsana a ka dindet jingle kei ipi ding'a ka kichat ding ham? Hi chi mihem chun i eilo thei ding ham?
English: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

tcz: Amahon ka thusei jouse ahilou lam in alao vin; kei suhsetna ding'in anikho ho'u jong amang jing ui.
en: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
text:
PSA 56:5
Thadou: Amahon ka thusei jouse ahilou lam in alao vin; kei suhsetna ding'in anikho ho'u jong amang jing ui.
English: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

tcz: Amaho ahung'un eihung velhi'uvin, keima eithatheina diuvin ka chaloh ka sinsah avelhi jing'un ahi.
en: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
text:
PSA 56:6
Thadou: Amaho ahung'un eihung velhi'uvin, keima eithatheina diuvin ka chaloh ka sinsah avelhi jing'un ahi.
English: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

tcz: Achonset pum'un jammang sah hihbeh in; na lungsah na achun O Yahweh Pakai amaho chu sumang jeng'in.
en: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.
text:
PSA 56:7
Thadou: Achonset pum'un jammang sah hihbeh in; na lungsah na achun O Yahweh Pakai amaho chu sumang jeng'in.
English: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

tcz: Nang'in ka thoh gimna neihetpeh jingnan ahi, nang'in ka lengvaina mitlhi hi khon a nakhol khom in, chuleh abonchan na lekhabu'a najihlut e.
en: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
text:
PSA 56:8
Thadou: Nang'in ka thoh gimna neihetpeh jingnan ahi, nang'in ka lengvaina mitlhi hi khon a nakhol khom in, chuleh abonchan na lekhabu'a najihlut e.
English: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

tcz: Keiman nangma eikithopi ding'a ka kou tengleh ka galmite jammang taovin te. Hijeh'a chu keiman Elohim Pathen hi keima lang'a pang ahi ti ka het jingna ahi!
en: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.
text:
PSA 56:9
Thadou: Keiman nangma eikithopi ding'a ka kou tengleh ka galmite jammang taovin te. Hijeh'a chu keiman Elohim Pathen hi keima lang'a pang ahi ti ka het jingna ahi!
English: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.

tcz: Elohim Pathen'in kakoma kitep na anei jeh in keiman Elohim Pathen ka thangvah e; henge, Elohim Pathen in kahenga kitepna anei jeh in Yahweh Pakai ka thangvah ahi.
en: In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.
text:
PSA 56:10
Thadou: Elohim Pathen'in kakoma kitep na anei jeh in keiman Elohim Pathen ka thangvah e; henge, Elohim Pathen in kahenga kitepna anei jeh in Yahweh Pakai ka thangvah ahi.
English: In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.

tcz: Keiman Elohim Pathen ka tahsan na ahi ka din jingle ipi ding'a ka kichat ding ham? Mihem mai hon i eilo di'u ham?
en: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
text:
PSA 56:11
Thadou: Keiman Elohim Pathen ka tahsan na ahi ka din jingle ipi ding'a ka kichat ding ham? Mihem mai hon i eilo di'u ham?
English: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nang kom'a ka kitepna keiman subulhit ingting chutengleh kilhaina in thangvah na peng ka te.
en: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
text:
PSA 56:12
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nang kom'a ka kitepna keiman subulhit ingting chutengleh kilhaina in thangvah na peng ka te.
English: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

tcz: Ajeh chu nang'in ka thina ding'a kon'in neihuhdoh tan kakiselhuh louna din nang in ka keng neituh peh tai. Hijeh chun O Elohim Pathen tun na angsunga hinna vah napeh na mun a chun hung lut thei tange.
en: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
text:
PSA 56:13
Thadou: Ajeh chu nang'in ka thina ding'a kon'in neihuhdoh tan kakiselhuh louna din nang in ka keng neituh peh tai. Hijeh chun O Elohim Pathen tun na angsunga hinna vah napeh na mun a chun hung lut thei tange.
English: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

tcz: Neilungset in O Elohim Pathen, nei khoton! Neivenbit jingna ding'in nang malam ka hin sang'e. Hahsatna ho abeito kahsen na lhaving lim noi a ka kisel jing ding ahi.
en: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
text:
PSA 57:1
Thadou: Neilungset in O Elohim Pathen, nei khoton! Neivenbit jingna ding'in nang malam ka hin sang'e. Hahsatna ho abeito kahsen na lhaving lim noi a ka kisel jing ding ahi.
English: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

tcz: Ka chung'a athilgon eisuhbulhing pehna ding'in Elohim Pathen hat chungnung chu ka kouve.
en: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.
text:
PSA 57:2
Thadou: Ka chung'a athilgon eisuhbulhing pehna ding'in Elohim Pathen hat chungnung chu ka kouve.
English: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

tcz: Aman eihuhdoh ding chuleh eidel lele ho jumsahna ding'a van'a kon'a panpina eihinpeh ding ahi. Elohim ka Pathen'in angailutna longlou leh akitahna a chu eihung vil ding ahi.
en: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.
text:
PSA 57:3
Thadou: Aman eihuhdoh ding chuleh eidel lele ho jumsahna ding'a van'a kon'a panpina eihinpeh ding ahi. Elohim ka Pathen'in angailutna longlou leh akitahna a chu eihung vil ding ahi.
English: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

tcz: Keipi bahkai hangtah hon mihem te a anchah dia achanlhih le banin galmite'n eiumkimvel'uvin, aha uhin tengcha leh thalchang bangin asunvangthei in, alei'u jong chemjam hemset tobang in asat tan thei uve.
en: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
text:
PSA 57:4
Thadou: Keipi bahkai hangtah hon mihem te a anchah dia achanlhih le banin galmite'n eiumkimvel'uvin, aha uhin tengcha leh thalchang bangin asunvangthei in, alei'u jong chemjam hemset tobang in asat tan thei uve.
English: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nangma hi vanmun jouse chungvum sang'in hung kichoisang'in! Na loupina hin leiset chung mun jouse hi salvah hen!
en: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
text:
PSA 57:5
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nangma hi vanmun jouse chungvum sang'in hung kichoisang'in! Na loupina hin leiset chung mun jouse hi salvah hen!
English: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

tcz: Ka galmite'n thang eikampeh uvin, keima lung gim leh lunglengvai in kaum'e. Amahon ka lampi'a kotong thuhtah alai un ahinlah amaho ma alhalut jiuvin ahi.
en: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.
text:
PSA 57:6
Thadou: Ka galmite'n thang eikampeh uvin, keima lung gim leh lunglengvai in kaum'e. Amahon ka lampi'a kotong thuhtah alai un ahinlah amaho ma alhalut jiuvin ahi.
English: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nang a lungmon na kanei e; nang a kalung among e. Nangma thangvah la ka sahthei hi thil kidang ahipoi.
en: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
text:
PSA 57:7
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nang a lungmon na kanei e; nang a kalung among e. Nangma thangvah la ka sahthei hi thil kidang ahipoi.
English: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

tcz: Thou in kalung! Thou in, o Semjang le tumging! Ka vahchoila'n jingninou hi thoudoh ing e.
en: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
text:
PSA 57:8
Thadou: Thou in kalung! Thou in, o Semjang le tumging! Ka vahchoila'n jingninou hi thoudoh ing e.
English: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai mipi ho jouse lah'a na thangvah ing'e. Namtin vaipi jouse lah'a nangma na thangvah ing kate.
en: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.
text:
PSA 57:9
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai mipi ho jouse lah'a na thangvah ing'e. Namtin vaipi jouse lah'a nangma na thangvah ing kate.
English: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

tcz: Ajeh chu na mingailutna longlou hi vanho bang'in asang e. Na kitahna in meilomlah apha'n ahi.
en: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
text:
PSA 57:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu na mingailutna longlou hi vanho bang'in asang e. Na kitahna in meilomlah apha'n ahi.
English: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

tcz: Hung kichoi sang in O Elohim Pathen, van mun sangpen ho sang'in na min hi dopsang'in umjo hen. Na loupina in leiset chung pumpi hi salvah hen.
en: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
text:
PSA 57:11
Thadou: Hung kichoi sang in O Elohim Pathen, van mun sangpen ho sang'in na min hi dopsang'in umjo hen. Na loupina in leiset chung pumpi hi salvah hen.
English: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.

tcz: Vaihom ho nanghon thutah kiti hi ipi kisei na ahi nahet u hinam? Nang hon thu adih'a natan'u hinam?
en: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
text:
PSA 58:1
Thadou: Vaihom ho nanghon thutah kiti hi ipi kisei na ahi nahet u hinam? Nang hon thu adih'a natan'u hinam?
English: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

tcz: Ahipoi! Nang ho'n na lungsung un thudihlou na gong'un gamsung a hunam a natohna ngen na chelheh sah un ahi.
en: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
text:
PSA 58:2
Thadou: Ahipoi! Nang ho'n na lungsung un thudihlou na gong'un gamsung a hunam a natohna ngen na chelheh sah un ahi.
English: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.

tcz: Miphalou ho hi chonsesa peng'a ahiuvin, ahung pen'uva pat'in jou apan'un ama deidan cheh'in achon'un ahi.
en: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
text:
PSA 58:3
Thadou: Miphalou ho hi chonsesa peng'a ahiuvin, ahung pen'uva pat'in jou apan'un ama deidan cheh'in achon'un ahi.
English: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

tcz: Ama hon gul bangin gu hat tah alhao vin; gulsoh bang in thuhil angainom pouve.
en: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
text:
PSA 58:4
Thadou: Ama hon gul bangin gu hat tah alhao vin; gulsoh bang in thuhil angainom pouve.
English: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

tcz: Gul lam sahhon atheile'u ichan geija amut ngeisel vang un akihetmosah un ahi.
en: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.
text:
PSA 58:5
Thadou: Gul lam sahhon atheile'u ichan geija amut ngeisel vang un akihetmosah un ahi.
English: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen a-ha uhi suhbong jeng'in, O Yahweh Pakai hiche keipi bahkai ho hi a-ha'u suhgoi peh jeng'in.
en: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, LORD.
text:
PSA 58:6
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen a-ha uhi suhbong jeng'in, O Yahweh Pakai hiche keipi bahkai ho hi a-ha'u suhgoi peh jeng'in.
English: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, LORD.

tcz: Tolgo'a twi isunlhah a agotloiji bang'in mangthah loi jeng'u hen. Akhut uva achoi u agal manchah'u chu manmo sosah jeng'in.
en: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.
text:
PSA 58:7
Thadou: Tolgo'a twi isunlhah a agotloiji bang'in mangthah loi jeng'u hen. Akhut uva achoi u agal manchah'u chu manmo sosah jeng'in.
English: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

tcz: Dahdeng amacham'a ajunlhah ji bang'in junlhahsah'in, naosen athisa hung peng nisa mumanlou bah sah in.
en: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
text:
PSA 58:8
Thadou: Dahdeng amacham'a ajunlhah ji bang'in junlhahsah'in, naosen athisa hung peng nisa mumanlou bah sah in.
English: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

tcz: Hampa kisatlha bang in ateh akhang Elohim Pathen in lhamlha jeng uhen, leibel meikou lah a ling le khao kigouvam sang a gang jo jeng u hen.
en: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.
text:
PSA 58:9
Thadou: Hampa kisatlha bang in ateh akhang Elohim Pathen in lhamlha jeng uhen, leibel meikou lah a ling le khao kigouvam sang a gang jo jeng u hen.
English: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

tcz: Thildih lou ho akilethuh teng mi chonpha ho kipah di'u ahi.
en: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
text:
PSA 58:10
Thadou: Thildih lou ho akilethuh teng mi chonpha ho kipah di'u ahi.
English: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

tcz: Chuteng achaina le mijousen asei diu ahi, “Elohim Pathen a dia hing ho dihtheina chu kipa thilpeh ahin; leiset a jong thudih a thutan Elohim Pathen aum mong e.”
en: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
text:
PSA 58:11
Thadou: Chuteng achaina le mijousen asei diu ahi, “Elohim Pathen a dia hing ho dihtheina chu kipa thilpeh ahin; leiset a jong thudih a thutan Elohim Pathen aum mong e.”
English: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, ka galmite a kon'in neihuhdoh in, keima eisumang ding'a hungho a kon'in neihuhdoh in.
en: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
text:
PSA 59:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen, ka galmite a kon'in neihuhdoh in, keima eisumang ding'a hungho a kon'in neihuhdoh in.
English: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

tcz: Mi sugentheiho a kon'in neihuhdoh in lang tolthat ho'a kon'in neihuhdoh in.
en: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
text:
PSA 59:2
Thadou: Mi sugentheiho a kon'in neihuhdoh in lang tolthat ho'a kon'in neihuhdoh in.
English: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

tcz: Amahon eichanglhiuvin, Yahweh Pakai melma engsetahte hon eingah un ahi, keiman amaho dounan imacha thilse ka bol poi.
en: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.
text:
PSA 59:3
Thadou: Amahon eichanglhiuvin, Yahweh Pakai melma engsetahte hon eingah un ahi, keiman amaho dounan imacha thilse ka bol poi.
English: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.

tcz: Keiman imacha thilse kabol pon hinla keima eidelkhum ding'in akigo jing'un ahi. Hung thoudoh in thilsohho hi hung ven lang neikithopi'n!
en: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!
text:
PSA 59:4
Thadou: Keiman imacha thilse kabol pon hinla keima eidelkhum ding'in akigo jing'un ahi. Hung thoudoh in thilsohho hi hung ven lang neikithopi'n!
English: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen hatchungnung Israelte Pathen Elohim, ei hung thoudoh in lang mi phalou namtin vaipiho hi gimbolna hung petan kitahna neilou mi phaloute chung'a hin khotona neihihbeh in.
en: You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.
text:
PSA 59:5
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen hatchungnung Israelte Pathen Elohim, ei hung thoudoh in lang mi phalou namtin vaipiho hi gimbolna hung petan kitahna neilou mi phaloute chung'a hin khotona neihihbeh in.
English: You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

tcz: Amaho janteng leh ahungdoh jiuvin, uingol hon mi angih bang'in lamlen'a akijot'un apeng le jiuvin ahi.
en: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.
text:
PSA 59:6
Thadou: Amaho janteng leh ahungdoh jiuvin, uingol hon mi angih bang'in lamlen'a akijot'un apeng le jiuvin ahi.
English: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

tcz: Akamsunguva thu thanghoi hung potdoh khu ngai in chemjam a kisat bang'a ngaithada umtah ahi. Hitobang'a ngai thaset umtah hi kon angai ngam ding ham?
en: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
text:
PSA 59:7
Thadou: Akamsunguva thu thanghoi hung potdoh khu ngai in chemjam a kisat bang'a ngaithada umtah ahi. Hitobang'a ngai thaset umtah hi kon angai ngam ding ham?
English: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

tcz: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai nang'in amaho chu na nuisat'in, mi phalou namtin vaipiho chu na hohdal'in ahi.
en: But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.
text:
PSA 59:8
Thadou: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai nang'in amaho chu na nuisat'in, mi phalou namtin vaipiho chu na hohdal'in ahi.
English: But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

tcz: Nang hi kahatna nahi; eihuhdoh din nang kangah jing e, ajeh chu nang hi ka ki venbitna kulpi nahi.
en: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.
text:
PSA 59:9
Thadou: Nang hi kahatna nahi; eihuhdoh din nang kangah jing e, ajeh chu nang hi ka ki venbitna kulpi nahi.
English: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

tcz: Ka Pathen Elohim in, ami ngailut na longlou achu eidinpi ding ahi. Aman ka melmate jouse chung'a agaljona a eimusah ding ahi.
en: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
text:
PSA 59:10
Thadou: Ka Pathen Elohim in, ami ngailut na longlou achu eidinpi ding ahi. Aman ka melmate jouse chung'a agaljona a eimusah ding ahi.
English: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen amaho chu thatgam jeng hih'in ajole ka mite'n kihil na aman u hi sumil loi get'unte; eipanpi o Yahweh Pakai amaho khu thethang'in lang akhuboh uva dilsuh sah jeng tan.
en: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.
text:
PSA 59:11
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen amaho chu thatgam jeng hih'in ajole ka mite'n kihil na aman u hi sumil loi get'unte; eipanpi o Yahweh Pakai amaho khu thethang'in lang akhuboh uva dilsuh sah jeng tan.
English: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

tcz: Akam'uva chonset thu ngen aseidoh jeh uleh, alei uva thilse ngen aseidoh jeh'un, akiletsahna'u, ahansetna'u chuleh ajouseina'u vin manchah jeng uhen.
en: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.
text:
PSA 59:12
Thadou: Akam'uva chonset thu ngen aseidoh jeh uleh, alei uva thilse ngen aseidoh jeh'un, akiletsahna'u, ahansetna'u chuleh ajouseina'u vin manchah jeng uhen.
English: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

tcz: Na lunghan nan amaho chu sumang'in lang abonchauvin sumang jeng'in! chutengleh vannoi leiset pumpin Israel chung'a vaihom Elohim Pathen na hi chu ahetdi'u ahi.
en: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.
text:
PSA 59:13
Thadou: Na lunghan nan amaho chu sumang'in lang abonchauvin sumang jeng'in! chutengleh vannoi leiset pumpin Israel chung'a vaihom Elohim Pathen na hi chu ahetdi'u ahi.
English: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

tcz: Ka melmate jan leh hungdoh'un tin uichangol hon mi angih bang'in akisen le leuvin ahi.
en: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.
text:
PSA 59:14
Thadou: Ka melmate jan leh hungdoh'un tin uichangol hon mi angih bang'in akisen le leuvin ahi.
English: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

tcz: Amaho neh ding an holna'n avahle leuvin oivana kham amulou jeh'un gilkel pum'in alum jiuvin ahi.
en: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.
text:
PSA 59:15
Thadou: Amaho neh ding an holna'n avahle leuvin oivana kham amulou jeh'un gilkel pum'in alum jiuvin ahi.
English: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

tcz: Hinla keiman vang na thaneina chu vahchoila'n sangnge. Na mi ngailutna longlou chu jingkha she leh kipah tah'in vahchoila'n sangnge. Ajeh chu nangma ka kulpi, ka hahsat teng leh ka kiselna na hi.
en: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
text:
PSA 59:16
Thadou: Hinla keiman vang na thaneina chu vahchoila'n sangnge. Na mi ngailutna longlou chu jingkha she leh kipah tah'in vahchoila'n sangnge. Ajeh chu nangma ka kulpi, ka hahsat teng leh ka kiselna na hi.
English: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

tcz: O ka hatna Yahweh Pakai, nangma thangvahna'n la'n sangnge, O Elohim Pathen nangma ka kiselna na hin, na mi ngailutna longlou chu neimusah jing'e.
en: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
text:
PSA 59:17
Thadou: O ka hatna Yahweh Pakai, nangma thangvahna'n la'n sangnge, O Elohim Pathen nangma ka kiselna na hin, na mi ngailutna longlou chu neimusah jing'e.
English: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nang'in keiho hi neipaidoh tauvin ka kiselna'u jouse jong neisuh chimpeh tauve, nangma keiho chung'a analunghang jong leh chun na lungsetna neimusah tauvin.
en: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
text:
PSA 60:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nang'in keiho hi neipaidoh tauvin ka kiselna'u jouse jong neisuh chimpeh tauve, nangma keiho chung'a analunghang jong leh chun na lungsetna neimusah tauvin.
English: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

tcz: Ka gamsung'u na hotling in chuleh na pokehsah ji'n ahi, tun vang akehlai mehbit tan, ajeh chu gamleiset akithing'in ahi.
en: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
text:
PSA 60:2
Thadou: Ka gamsung'u na hotling in chuleh na pokehsah ji'n ahi, tun vang akehlai mehbit tan, ajeh chu gamleiset akithing'in ahi.
English: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

tcz: Keiho hasatnatah nahin pen, jukham a lon lele ho nei sodoh jeng u ve.
en: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
text:
PSA 60:3
Thadou: Keiho hasatnatah nahin pen, jukham a lon lele ho nei sodoh jeng u ve.
English: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

tcz: Ahinla nang'in nangma ginna neiho ding'in ponlap khat neina dopsang peh'un, hichu min eihin nokhum teng'uleh eikipunkhom sah'in anapang'in ahi.
en: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
text:
PSA 60:4
Thadou: Ahinla nang'in nangma ginna neiho ding'in ponlap khat neina dopsang peh'un, hichu min eihin nokhum teng'uleh eikipunkhom sah'in anapang'in ahi.
English: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

tcz: Tun na ngailut na mite hi huhdoh tan, ka taona ngai in lang na ban thahat'in neihuhdoh tauvin.
en: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
text:
PSA 60:5
Thadou: Tun na ngailut na mite hi huhdoh tan, ka taona ngai in lang na ban thahat'in neihuhdoh tauvin.
English: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

tcz: Aloupi na in Elohim Pathen in, “keima kichoisangna a hiche kitep nahi ahin sem tai. Shechem hi kipa na a kakehso ding ahi. Sukkoth phaicham hi ka mite ka hoppeh ding ahi.
en: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
text:
PSA 60:6
Thadou: Aloupi na in Elohim Pathen in, “keima kichoisangna a hiche kitep nahi ahin sem tai. Shechem hi kipa na a kakehso ding ahi. Sukkoth phaicham hi ka mite ka hoppeh ding ahi.
English: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

tcz: Gilead hi keija ahin, chuleh Manasseh jong ahi. Ephraim ka thih lukhuh hin galhat miho ahinsep doh ding, chue Juda ka leng tenggol hin leng tamtah hinsepdoh ding ahi.
en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.
text:
PSA 60:7
Thadou: Gilead hi keija ahin, chuleh Manasseh jong ahi. Ephraim ka thih lukhuh hin galhat miho ahinsep doh ding, chue Juda ka leng tenggol hin leng tamtah hinsepdoh ding ahi.
English: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

tcz: Ahin Moab vang hi ka kisilna kong ahin ka sohna ahin toh ding ahi chuleh Edom a hi ka kengto kathehngim ding chutengleh Philistia chung a ka galjona ka hin sapdoh ding ahi.”
en: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”
text:
PSA 60:8
Thadou: Ahin Moab vang hi ka kisilna kong ahin ka sohna ahin toh ding ahi chuleh Edom a hi ka kengto kathehngim ding chutengleh Philistia chung a ka galjona ka hin sapdoh ding ahi.”
English: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

tcz: Koi pen'in kul kigetkhum khoipi'a hi eipuilut ding ham? Koi pen in Edom chung'a hi galjona eihin pohlut peh ding ham?
en: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?
text:
PSA 60:9
Thadou: Koi pen'in kul kigetkhum khoipi'a hi eipuilut ding ham? Koi pen in Edom chung'a hi galjona eihin pohlut peh ding ham?
English: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nang'in neipaidoh'u hitam? Nang'in ka sepaite toh galsatna a neihung lhonpi lou ding hitam?
en: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
text:
PSA 60:10
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nang'in neipaidoh'u hitam? Nang'in ka sepaite toh galsatna a neihung lhonpi lou ding hitam?
English: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

tcz: O lungset tah in ka galmiteuva konin neipanpin, ajeh chu mihem panpina hi aphachom aumpoi.
en: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
text:
PSA 60:11
Thadou: O lungset tah in ka galmiteuva konin neipanpin, ajeh chu mihem panpina hi aphachom aumpoi.
English: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

tcz: Elohim Pathen panpina jal'a hi thil loupi tah tah tohdoh'a um ding ahi, ajeh chu Aman imelmate'u achotpha ding ahi.
en: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
text:
PSA 60:12
Thadou: Elohim Pathen panpina jal'a hi thil loupi tah tah tohdoh'a um ding ahi, ajeh chu Aman imelmate'u achotpha ding ahi.
English: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen ka kana neingaipeh in! Ka taona hi ngai in!
en: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
text:
PSA 61:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen ka kana neingaipeh in! Ka taona hi ngai in!
English: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

tcz: Lungsung lunghemnan eilonkhum teng leiset kol kimvel a kon'in panpi ngaichan ka hin kou e. Hoidoh na songpi sang chung'ah neipuitou in,
en: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
text:
PSA 61:2
Thadou: Lungsung lunghemnan eilonkhum teng leiset kol kimvel a kon'in panpi ngaichan ka hin kou e. Hoidoh na songpi sang chung'ah neipuitou in,
English: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

tcz: ajeh chu nangma hi ka kiselna mun olna pen chu na hi, ka melmate'n ahin phahjoulouna kulpi chu nangma na hi.
en: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
text:
PSA 61:3
Thadou: ajeh chu nangma hi ka kiselna mun olna pen chu na hi, ka melmate'n ahin phahjoulouna kulpi chu nangma na hi.
English: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

tcz: Na mun theng'a tonsot'in neichensah in hilai chu na lha limnoi kiselna chu ahi.
en: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
text:
PSA 61:4
Thadou: Na mun theng'a tonsot'in neichensah in hilai chu na lha limnoi kiselna chu ahi.
English: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen ka kitepna chu nei jahpehtai, nangma gingte chan dia na gonpeh na goulona mun chu neipeh ahitai.
en: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
text:
PSA 61:5
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen ka kitepna chu nei jahpehtai, nangma gingte chan dia na gonpeh na goulona mun chu neipeh ahitai.
English: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

tcz: Lengpa hinkho hi kum tamtah pehben! Khangkit geiin jong hinghoi in!
en: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.
text:
PSA 61:6
Thadou: Lengpa hinkho hi kum tamtah pehben! Khangkit geiin jong hinghoi in!
English: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.

tcz: Elohim Pathen hoidam na achun vai hom jing hen. Na mi ngailutna longlou le na kitahna chun kaihoi jing hen.
en: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
text:
PSA 61:7
Thadou: Elohim Pathen hoidam na achun vai hom jing hen. Na mi ngailutna longlou le na kitahna chun kaihoi jing hen.
English: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh nitina ka kitepna suh bulhit ingkating tonsot'in na min thangvah jing tang e.
en: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
text:
PSA 61:8
Thadou: Hiteng chuleh nitina ka kitepna suh bulhit ingkating tonsot'in na min thangvah jing tang e.
English: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.

tcz: Elohim Pathen ang a thipbeh chan ka ngah e, ajeh chu Ama a kon a ka galjona hung kipan ji ahi.
en: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
text:
PSA 62:1
Thadou: Elohim Pathen ang a thipbeh chan ka ngah e, ajeh chu Ama a kon a ka galjona hung kipan ji ahi.
English: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

tcz: Ama bou hi kasongpi le kakihuhhing na ahin, longlou hel a kaum thei kakingai na kulpi ahi.
en: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
text:
PSA 62:2
Thadou: Ama bou hi kasongpi le kakihuhhing na ahin, longlou hel a kaum thei kakingai na kulpi ahi.
English: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

tcz: Mi khatseh douding melma tamtah ahiuvin-abon'un keima eithat gouve. Amaho ding hin keima hi bang chimsa le tho kigen achimsa tobang ka hi bouve.
en: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
text:
PSA 62:3
Thadou: Mi khatseh douding melma tamtah ahiuvin-abon'un keima eithat gouve. Amaho ding hin keima hi bang chimsa le tho kigen achimsa tobang ka hi bouve.
English: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

tcz: Amahon munsang a kon a sotlhah di eigouve. Ka chung chang a jouthu sei athanom un ahi. Amahon kamasanga eipahchao vin alungsung uvah eigaosap un ahi.
en: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
text:
PSA 62:4
Thadou: Amahon munsang a kon a sotlhah di eigouve. Ka chung chang a jouthu sei athanom un ahi. Amahon kamasanga eipahchao vin alungsung uvah eigaosap un ahi.
English: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

tcz: Keiman ka hina jouse pum in Elohim Pathen angsung a thipbehchan ka ngah e, ajeh chu ama a hin ka kinepna aumjing e.
en: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
text:
PSA 62:5
Thadou: Keiman ka hina jouse pum in Elohim Pathen angsung a thipbehchan ka ngah e, ajeh chu ama a hin ka kinepna aumjing e.
English: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

tcz: Ama bou hi ka sochatna leh ka kulpi chuleh ka songpi ahin keima sotlinghoi ka hi tahlou ding ahitai.
en: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
text:
PSA 62:6
Thadou: Ama bou hi ka sochatna leh ka kulpi chuleh ka songpi ahin keima sotlinghoi ka hi tahlou ding ahitai.
English: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

tcz: Ka galjona leh ka minphatna Elohim Pathen a kon jeng bou ahi. Ama hi ka kiselna le ka songpi ahin, ka melma hon eihin maiphah lou diu ahi.
en: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
text:
PSA 62:7
Thadou: Ka galjona leh ka minphatna Elohim Pathen a kon jeng bou ahi. Ama hi ka kiselna le ka songpi ahin, ka melma hon eihin maiphah lou diu ahi.
English: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

tcz: O ka mite phat tinin Ama bou tahsan jingin na lungthim a na pohgih ama chuga sung lhan, ajeh chu Ama hi ikiselna u ahi.
en: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
text:
PSA 62:8
Thadou: O ka mite phat tinin Ama bou tahsan jingin na lungthim a na pohgih ama chuga sung lhan, ajeh chu Ama hi ikiselna u ahi.
English: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

tcz: Milham ho hi hainahu khat hui bap a phachom lou ahibou uve, chule mithahat ho jong alim u va amelsou toh akibang deh pouve. Amahokhu lepton lang vele chun hainahu khat sanga jong jangjo ahibou uve.
en: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
text:
PSA 62:9
Thadou: Milham ho hi hainahu khat hui bap a phachom lou ahibou uve, chule mithahat ho jong alim u va amelsou toh akibang deh pouve. Amahokhu lepton lang vele chun hainahu khat sanga jong jangjo ahibou uve.
English: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

tcz: Nang in na inchen na hinkho hi hunam a lah le guhchat in kivah hih in. Na nei na gou ahung punbe a ahijongleh hiche a chun kisong hih in.
en: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
text:
PSA 62:10
Thadou: Nang in na inchen na hinkho hi hunam a lah le guhchat in kivah hih in. Na nei na gou ahung punbe a ahijongleh hiche a chun kisong hih in.
English: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in ol heuvin thu asei in hichu keiman phat tin in ka na jajin ahi. O Elohim Pathen thaneina jouse hi nang a ahi.
en: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
text:
PSA 62:11
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in ol heuvin thu asei in hichu keiman phat tin in ka na jajin ahi. O Elohim Pathen thaneina jouse hi nang a ahi.
English: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai ngailutna longlou hi nang a ahi, tahbeh in nang in mijouse hi atoh dungjui cheh a na lethuh ahi.
en: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
text:
PSA 62:12
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai ngailutna longlou hi nang a ahi, tahbeh in nang in mijouse hi atoh dungjui cheh a na lethuh ahi.
English: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nang bou ka Pathen na hi; ken lungil tah in nang kahol e. Kalhagao in nadangchah in; twi veilouna mun gotna gamgo ahin ka tahsa pumpin nang ka hin lhangai e.
en: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
text:
PSA 63:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nang bou ka Pathen na hi; ken lungil tah in nang kahol e. Kalhagao in nadangchah in; twi veilouna mun gotna gamgo ahin ka tahsa pumpin nang ka hin lhangai e.
English: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

tcz: Na mun theng'a kon'in ka hin mun na loupina leh na thaneina chu ka hin mun ahi.
en: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
text:
PSA 63:2
Thadou: Na mun theng'a kon'in ka hin mun na loupina leh na thaneina chu ka hin mun ahi.
English: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

tcz: Na mi ngailutna longlou chu mihem hinkhoma ma sang a phajo ahi; nang ka hin thangvah chim theipoi.
en: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
text:
PSA 63:3
Thadou: Na mi ngailutna longlou chu mihem hinkhoma ma sang a phajo ahi; nang ka hin thangvah chim theipoi.
English: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

tcz: Hinkho ka nei laisen nangma thangvah ing kating, nahenga taonan ka khut teni hin domsang ing kate.
en: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
text:
PSA 63:4
Thadou: Hinkho ka nei laisen nangma thangvah ing kating, nahenga taonan ka khut teni hin domsang ing kate.
English: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

tcz: An twipen ka neh sang'in nang'in neihin lunglhaisah jon. Kipah tah in nangma thangvahnan la sangnge.
en: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
text:
PSA 63:5
Thadou: An twipen ka neh sang'in nang'in neihin lunglhaisah jon. Kipah tah in nangma thangvahnan la sangnge.
English: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

tcz: Kalupna mun a limgeh chan nang kagel gel jin, janteng jongle nangma lungel ho kangaito ji e.
en: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
text:
PSA 63:6
Thadou: Kalupna mun a limgeh chan nang kagel gel jin, janteng jongle nangma lungel ho kangaito ji e.
English: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

tcz: Nangma eikithopi nahijeh in, na lhaving lim noi ah kipah tah in vahchoila ka san ahi.
en: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
text:
PSA 63:7
Thadou: Nangma eikithopi nahijeh in, na lhaving lim noi ah kipah tah in vahchoila ka san ahi.
English: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

tcz: Na ban thahat tah jet lang in det tah in neituh in ahileh keiman nang ka tuhchah in ahi.
en: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
text:
PSA 63:8
Thadou: Na ban thahat tah jet lang in det tah in neituh in ahileh keiman nang ka tuhchah in ahi.
English: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

tcz: Keima eisumang goho chu hung mangthah diu ahi. Amaho chu leikotong athuhlai pena chu lhalut ding ahiuve.
en: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
text:
PSA 63:9
Thadou: Keima eisumang goho chu hung mangthah diu ahi. Amaho chu leikotong athuhlai pena chu lhalut ding ahiuve.
English: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

tcz: Amaho chu chemjam a thidiu sial ho anchah a pang diu ahi.
en: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.
text:
PSA 63:10
Thadou: Amaho chu chemjam a thidiu sial ho anchah a pang diu ahi.
English: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

tcz: Ahinla lengpa chu Elohim Pathen a kipah ding ahi. Koi hileh Ama tahsan chan chun athangvah ding, mijouho vang suhthip a umdiu ahi.
en: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
text:
PSA 63:11
Thadou: Ahinla lengpa chu Elohim Pathen a kipah ding ahi. Koi hileh Ama tahsan chan chun athangvah ding, mijouho vang suhthip a umdiu ahi.
English: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, ka kiphinna hi neingaipeh tei in. Ka melmaten eigihnauva kon hin neihuh doh in.
en: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
text:
PSA 64:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen, ka kiphinna hi neingaipeh tei in. Ka melmaten eigihnauva kon hin neihuh doh in.
English: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

tcz: Hiche engset lungput a tohgon nei mipiho a kon'in neiselmang in, hiche thilse bol hon hoa kon in.
en: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

tcz: Amahon chemjam kinolhem bang'in alei'u anolhem'un thalchang kikap doh bang'in thucheng ngaimo tah tah in mi adoi leleu ve.
en: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
text:
PSA 64:3
Thadou: Amahon chemjam kinolhem bang'in alei'u anolhem'un thalchang kikap doh bang'in thucheng ngaimo tah tah in mi adoi leleu ve.
English: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

tcz: Themmona neilou miho chu akiselnauva kon in ahin kap un kichatna neilouvin gangtah in anokhum jiuvin ahi.
en: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.
text:
PSA 64:4
Thadou: Themmona neilou miho chu akiselnauva kon in ahin kap un kichatna neilouvin gangtah in anokhum jiuvin ahi.
English: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

tcz: Thilse bol ding in amaho le amaho akitilkhou un chujongle aguh a iti thang kam ding ham, tichu agong'un ahi. “Hiche hi kon amudoh ding ham?” atiuve.
en: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”
text:
PSA 64:5
Thadou: Thilse bol ding in amaho le amaho akitilkhou un chujongle aguh a iti thang kam ding ham, tichu agong'un ahi. “Hiche hi kon amudoh ding ham?” atiuve.
English: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”

tcz: Athilse gonpat'u chun hitin aseijun, “Hiche hi thilgon hoipen ahitai!” atiuve. Henge mihem lunggel le lungthim vang hi aphalou mong ahi.
en: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.
text:
PSA 64:6
Thadou: Athilse gonpat'u chun hitin aseijun, “Hiche hi thilgon hoipen ahitai!” atiuve. Henge mihem lunggel le lungthim vang hi aphalou mong ahi.
English: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

tcz: Ahinla Elohim Pathen amatah'in athalchang ahin kap ding gangtah a akaplhuh diu ahi.
en: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
text:
PSA 64:7
Thadou: Ahinla Elohim Pathen amatah'in athalchang ahin kap ding gangtah a akaplhuh diu ahi.
English: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

tcz: Amaho tah kampao in ahin thagam diu ahi, koi hileh amaho muchan chun alunghan khum uva alu ahihdiu ahi.
en: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
text:
PSA 64:8
Thadou: Amaho tah kampao in ahin thagam diu ahi, koi hileh amaho muchan chun alunghan khum uva alu ahihdiu ahi.
English: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

tcz: Chujouteng mijouse kicha diu, Elohim Pathen thil boltheina kidangtah chu aphondoh diu, chuleh athilbol datmo umtahho chu ahin hetchen diu ahi.
en: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
text:
PSA 64:9
Thadou: Chujouteng mijouse kicha diu, Elohim Pathen thil boltheina kidangtah chu aphondoh diu, chuleh athilbol datmo umtahho chu ahin hetchen diu ahi.
English: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

tcz: Mi chonphaho Yahweh Pakai a kipah thanom diu chuleh Ama chu kiselna ahin neidiu ahi. Koi hileh thilpha bolho jousen Elohim Pathen ahin vahchoidiu ahi.
en: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
text:
PSA 64:10
Thadou: Mi chonphaho Yahweh Pakai a kipah thanom diu chuleh Ama chu kiselna ahin neidiu ahi. Koi hileh thilpha bolho jousen Elohim Pathen ahin vahchoidiu ahi.
English: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, vahchoina thupitah chu Zion'a um nang'a dinga ahi. Keihon nang kom a ka kitepnau chu ka molso diu ahi.
en: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.
text:
PSA 65:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen, vahchoina thupitah chu Zion'a um nang'a dinga ahi. Keihon nang kom a ka kitepnau chu ka molso diu ahi.
English: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.

tcz: Ajeh chu nang'in ka taona'u na sang'in, ka bonchauva nang kom'a ka hung di'u ahi.
en: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.
text:
PSA 65:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu nang'in ka taona'u na sang'in, ka bonchauva nang kom'a ka hung di'u ahi.
English: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

tcz: Ka chonsetnauvin eilonvuh jong le'u nang'in abonchan na ngaidam sohkei tan ahi.
en: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.
text:
PSA 65:3
Thadou: Ka chonsetnauvin eilonvuh jong le'u nang'in abonchan na ngaidam sohkei tan ahi.
English: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, na muntheng a um nangkom naiding go ho iti akipa tadiuvem. Na houintheng sung a chu itobang kipana golnop in eingau hitam!
en: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
text:
PSA 65:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai, na muntheng a um nangkom naiding go ho iti akipa tadiuvem. Na houintheng sung a chu itobang kipana golnop in eingau hitam!
English: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

tcz: Kataona hou natoh hoitah in neidonbut peh uve, O Elohim Pathen eihuhingpau. Nangma hi leiset mite jouse kinepna nahin, gamlatah twikhanglen chung'a kongtolho geiyin nang chung a kinepna anei u ahi.
en: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.
text:
PSA 65:5
Thadou: Kataona hou natoh hoitah in neidonbut peh uve, O Elohim Pathen eihuhingpau. Nangma hi leiset mite jouse kinepna nahin, gamlatah twikhanglen chung'a kongtolho geiyin nang chung a kinepna anei u ahi.
English: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.

tcz: Thahatna thupitah a na kivon a, na thahatna a mol le lhang jong hi na sem ahi.
en: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.
text:
PSA 65:6
Thadou: Thahatna thupitah a na kivon a, na thahatna a mol le lhang jong hi na sem ahi.
English: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.

tcz: Twikhanglen kinong le kitum jong hi nasuthip in chuleh namtin vaipi kithong lellul jong na suthip tan ahi.
en: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
text:
PSA 65:7
Thadou: Twikhanglen kinong le kitum jong hi nasuthip in chuleh namtin vaipi kithong lellul jong na suthip tan ahi.
English: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

tcz: Leiset chung kolmong gei a chenghon jong na kidanna hi adatmovin ahi. Nisa sona langa pat nilhum na mun geiya umho jong kipah a asaple diuva na tildoh ahitai.
en: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.
text:
PSA 65:8
Thadou: Leiset chung kolmong gei a chenghon jong na kidanna hi adatmovin ahi. Nisa sona langa pat nilhum na mun geiya umho jong kipah a asaple diuva na tildoh ahitai.
English: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

tcz: Leiset hi na gelkhoh in gon nachapnou in, leithao leh leipha na sodoh sah in ahi. Elohim Pathen vadung a chun twi nengchet in aum in; hichun louga chang le mim aput sah e, ajeh chu hiti dinga nangman natep sah ahitai.
en: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.
text:
PSA 65:9
Thadou: Leiset hi na gelkhoh in gon nachapnou in, leithao leh leipha na sodoh sah in ahi. Elohim Pathen vadung a chun twi nengchet in aum in; hichun louga chang le mim aput sah e, ajeh chu hiti dinga nangman natep sah ahitai.
English: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

tcz: Lou kikhoiho gotwi in na chap kot jin, leilhangho na su nang in, changkongho jong na kibah sah in, gotwi in leiset na noudoh sah in hiti chun chang le mim nengchet a aumnadin phatthei na boh in ahi.
en: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
text:
PSA 65:10
Thadou: Lou kikhoiho gotwi in na chap kot jin, leilhangho na su nang in, changkongho jong na kibah sah in, gotwi in leiset na noudoh sah in hiti chun chang le mim nengchet a aumnadin phatthei na boh in ahi.
English: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

tcz: Kumlhung keiya neh le chah ding nengchet in na gongtoh in leitah lah jeng jong leiphatah na so sah tai.
en: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
text:
PSA 65:11
Thadou: Kumlhung keiya neh le chah ding nengchet in na gongtoh in leitah lah jeng jong leiphatah na so sah tai.
English: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

tcz: Gam golai gammang jeng jong hamhing dongset lah a sohdoh in, molpang jeng jong kipah tah in apahlha jengin ahi.
en: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
text:
PSA 65:12
Thadou: Gam golai gammang jeng jong hamhing dongset lah a sohdoh in, molpang jeng jong kipah tah in apahlha jengin ahi.
English: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

tcz: Hamhing lah a kelngoihon adimset un chule phaichamho jong chang le mim adimlha jeng tai. Hi hojousen thong jejun asam un kipa la asaove.
en: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
text:
PSA 65:13
Thadou: Hamhing lah a kelngoihon adimset un chule phaichamho jong chang le mim adimlha jeng tai. Hi hojousen thong jejun asam un kipa la asaove.
English: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

tcz: Leiset mite jousen Elohim Pathen vahchoi cheh uhen!
en: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
text:
PSA 66:1
Thadou: Leiset mite jousen Elohim Pathen vahchoi cheh uhen!
English: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

tcz: Amin loupi chu vahchoilan saohen! Aloupina ji vannoi a sei leu vin.
en: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
text:
PSA 66:2
Thadou: Amin loupi chu vahchoilan saohen! Aloupina ji vannoi a sei leu vin.
English: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

tcz: Elohim Pathen henga sei in, “Na thilbol ho hi iti hoia lamdang hitam! Na melmate jeng jong na thaneina thupitah masang a akun jeng uve.
en: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
text:
PSA 66:3
Thadou: Elohim Pathen henga sei in, “Na thilbol ho hi iti hoia lamdang hitam! Na melmate jeng jong na thaneina thupitah masang a akun jeng uve.
English: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

tcz: Leiset chung thil jouse jong na angsung a dilsu cheh untin, nathangvahna la asahdiu, naming hi thongjenju a asahdiu ahi.”
en: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.
text:
PSA 66:4
Thadou: Leiset chung thil jouse jong na angsung a dilsu cheh untin, nathangvahna la asahdiu, naming hi thongjenju a asahdiu ahi.”
English: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.

tcz: Hung in lang ven Elohim Pathen in ipi atohdoh hitam, mipite dia itobang thil kidang atohdoh hitam!
en: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
text:
PSA 66:5
Thadou: Hung in lang ven Elohim Pathen in ipi atohdoh hitam, mipite dia itobang thil kidang atohdoh hitam!
English: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

tcz: Aman twipisan a jong lamgolai asem in, chule amite chu akeng'uva ache galkai ui. Hea chun eiho Ama ah ikipah un ahi.
en: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
text:
PSA 66:6
Thadou: Aman twipisan a jong lamgolai asem in, chule amite chu akeng'uva ache galkai ui. Hea chun eiho Ama ah ikipah un ahi.
English: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman athahatna thupitah a chun tonsot in vai ahom e. Aman namtin vaipi chaloh sinsah aboncha ave lhisohkei in; koimacha Ama dounan hung kon da jeng hen.
en: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.
text:
PSA 66:7
Thadou: Ajeh chu Aman athahatna thupitah a chun tonsot in vai ahom e. Aman namtin vaipi chaloh sinsah aboncha ave lhisohkei in; koimacha Ama dounan hung kon da jeng hen.
English: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

tcz: Vannoi leiset mihemte jousen iPathen u Elohim thangvah cheh u henlang avahchoina la choh jejun sauhen.
en: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
text:
PSA 66:8
Thadou: Vannoi leiset mihemte jousen iPathen u Elohim thangvah cheh u henlang avahchoina la choh jejun sauhen.
English: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,

tcz: I hinkhou hi Ama khut a um ahin, Aman ikipallouna diuva ikeng u eituhpeh u ahi.
en: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
text:
PSA 66:9
Thadou: I hinkhou hi Ama khut a um ahin, Aman ikipallouna diuva ikeng u eituhpeh u ahi.
English: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen neipatep tauve; dangka bang in neisuhtheng taovin ahi.
en: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
text:
PSA 66:10
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen neipatep tauve; dangka bang in neisuhtheng taovin ahi.
English: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

tcz: Na thangkol a neimat u ahitan chuleh ka tungtun uva sohchanna pohgih chu neipoh sah u ahitai.
en: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
text:
PSA 66:11
Thadou: Na thangkol a neimat u ahitan chuleh ka tungtun uva sohchanna pohgih chu neipoh sah u ahitai.
English: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

tcz: Ka chunguvah midangho lam na jotsah in hiti chun keiho meilhum leh twisohlah neipal galkaisah uvin, hinla nehding nenna mun a neipuilut tauvin ahi.
en: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.
text:
PSA 66:12
Thadou: Ka chunguvah midangho lam na jotsah in hiti chun keiho meilhum leh twisohlah neipal galkaisah uvin, hinla nehding nenna mun a neipuilut tauvin ahi.
English: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

tcz: Tun nahenga kakitepna subulhit din pumgo thilto pum in na houin ka hinjon e.
en: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
text:
PSA 66:13
Thadou: Tun nahenga kakitepna subulhit din pumgo thilto pum in na houin ka hinjon e.
English: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

tcz: Henge, lunggim le kakhoisat nikho hoa nakoma kitepna ka na nei chu ahi.
en: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
text:
PSA 66:14
Thadou: Henge, lunggim le kakhoisat nikho hoa nakoma kitepna ka na nei chu ahi.
English: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

tcz: Hijeh a chu keiman kanei ho lah ka kelngoichalho hi namtwi pen ding le, ka bongchalho le ka keltahchalho hi pumgo thilto a ka hin katdoh ahitai.
en: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.
text:
PSA 66:15
Thadou: Hijeh a chu keiman kanei ho lah ka kelngoichalho hi namtwi pen ding le, ka bongchalho le ka keltahchalho hi pumgo thilto a ka hin katdoh ahitai.
English: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

tcz: Elohim Pathen gin le jana neijouse hung un lang ngai un, Yahweh Pakai in ipi eibolpeh am na seipeh ung ka te.
en: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
text:
PSA 66:16
Thadou: Elohim Pathen gin le jana neijouse hung un lang ngai un, Yahweh Pakai in ipi eibolpeh am na seipeh ung ka te.
English: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman Ama thangvah pum in panpi thumnan ka tao in ahi.
en: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
text:
PSA 66:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman Ama thangvah pum in panpi thumnan ka tao in ahi.
English: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

tcz: Keiman ka lunsunga um ka chonset phongdoh lou hile Yahweh Pakai in ka taona eingaipeh louding ahi.
en: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
text:
PSA 66:18
Thadou: Keiman ka lunsunga um ka chonset phongdoh lou hile Yahweh Pakai in ka taona eingaipeh louding ahi.
English: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

tcz: Hinla Elohim Pathen in eingaipeh e! Aman khohsah tah in ka taona eingaipeh in ahi.
en: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
text:
PSA 66:19
Thadou: Hinla Elohim Pathen in eingaipeh e! Aman khohsah tah in ka taona eingaipeh in ahi.
English: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

tcz: Ka taona eigelkhohpehjeh le amingailutna longlou kei a kon a eilahdohpeh lou jeh in Elohim Pathen chu thangvah in um hen!
en: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
text:
PSA 66:20
Thadou: Ka taona eigelkhohpehjeh le amingailutna longlou kei a kon a eilahdohpeh lou jeh in Elohim Pathen chu thangvah in um hen!
English: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

tcz: Elohim Pathen lungsetthem hihen lang phatthei eiboh u hen. Amaivah chun eisalvah u hen.
en: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.
text:
PSA 67:1
Thadou: Elohim Pathen lungsetthem hihen lang phatthei eiboh u hen. Amaivah chun eisalvah u hen.
English: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

tcz: Leiset pumpi a nadeilam kilang hen, muntin a mihemten na mihuhhingna thahat chu heuhen!
en: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
text:
PSA 67:2
Thadou: Leiset pumpi a nadeilam kilang hen, muntin a mihemten na mihuhhingna thahat chu heuhen!
English: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

tcz: O Elohim Pathen namtin vaipin na thangvah u hen. Henge, namtin vaipin na thangvah u hen.
en: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
text:
PSA 67:3
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen namtin vaipin na thangvah u hen. Henge, namtin vaipin na thangvah u hen.
English: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

tcz: Vannoi leiset pumpin nangma thangvah la sauhen, ajeh chu namtin vaipi chung a hi thudih a vai hom nahin vannoi leiset pumpi hi na puihoi hoi le jinge.
en: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.
text:
PSA 67:4
Thadou: Vannoi leiset pumpin nangma thangvah la sauhen, ajeh chu namtin vaipi chung a hi thudih a vai hom nahin vannoi leiset pumpi hi na puihoi hoi le jinge.
English: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

tcz: Namtin vaipin na thangvah u hen O Elohim Pathen. Henge, namtin vaipin thangvah u hen!
en: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
text:
PSA 67:5
Thadou: Namtin vaipin na thangvah u hen O Elohim Pathen. Henge, namtin vaipin thangvah u hen!
English: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh leiset in chang le mim gasosah intin chuleh Elohim Pathen, iPathen'un nengchet a phatthei eibohdiu ahi.
en: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
text:
PSA 67:6
Thadou: Hiteng chuleh leiset in chang le mim gasosah intin chuleh Elohim Pathen, iPathen'un nengchet a phatthei eibohdiu ahi.
English: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

tcz: Henge, Elohim Pathen in phatthei eiboh un tin, chule vannoi leiset mihemte jousen Ama chu agindiu ahi.
en: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
text:
PSA 67:7
Thadou: Henge, Elohim Pathen in phatthei eiboh un tin, chule vannoi leiset mihemte jousen Ama chu agindiu ahi.
English: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen hung kipat inlang namelmate hi thethang jeng in, Elohim Pathen doumah bolte jouse akihuhdohna diuvin jam uhen.
en: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
text:
PSA 68:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen hung kipat inlang namelmate hi thethang jeng in, Elohim Pathen doumah bolte jouse akihuhdohna diuvin jam uhen.
English: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

tcz: Amaho khu meikhu bang in mut mang in, meisalah a khoilu ajollhah bang in jollhahsah in, Elohim Pathen ansung a kon in migiloute mangthah jeng uhen.
en: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
text:
PSA 68:2
Thadou: Amaho khu meikhu bang in mut mang in, meisalah a khoilu ajollhah bang in jollhahsah in, Elohim Pathen ansung a kon in migiloute mangthah jeng uhen.
English: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

tcz: Hinla miphaho chu kipah u hen. Amaho chu Elohim Pathen angsung'ah kipah u hen. Kipa thanopnan dimset u hen.
en: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
text:
PSA 68:3
Thadou: Hinla miphaho chu kipah u hen. Amaho chu Elohim Pathen angsung'ah kipah u hen. Kipa thanopnan dimset u hen.
English: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

tcz: Elohim Pathen le amin thang vah la saovin! Meibanglom puile pa thangvahla chohthet in sauvin. Amin chu Yahweh Pakai kiti ahi–a angsung a kipah un.
en: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!
text:
PSA 68:4
Thadou: Elohim Pathen le amin thang vah la saovin! Meibanglom puile pa thangvahla chohthet in sauvin. Amin chu Yahweh Pakai kiti ahi–a angsung a kipah un.
English: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!

tcz: Pa neilou te dia Pa nahin, meithaiho hoidam jing nahi-hiche hi Elohim Pathen ahin aumna chu muntheng ahi.
en: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
text:
PSA 68:5
Thadou: Pa neilou te dia Pa nahin, meithaiho hoidam jing nahi-hiche hi Elohim Pathen ahin aumna chu muntheng ahi.
English: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in changkhatpu hinkho chu insungmi lhingtah in akoi in; Songkul a tangho chamlhat na apen akipa sah tai. Ahinlah thuanunglou ho chu nisan akahgepna neldigama achensah e.
en: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
text:
PSA 68:6
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in changkhatpu hinkho chu insungmi lhingtah in akoi in; Songkul a tangho chamlhat na apen akipa sah tai. Ahinlah thuanunglou ho chu nisan akahgepna neldigama achensah e.
English: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai na mite Egypt gama kon a na hin puidoh a chun, gamgo lah'a na hin puigalkai chun,
en: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.
text:
PSA 68:7
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai na mite Egypt gama kon a na hin puidoh a chun, gamgo lah'a na hin puigalkai chun,
English: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

tcz: Israel Pathen Elohim, Sinai Pathen Elohim nangma masang'ah leiset akithing in vanhon go ahin juhlhahsah in ahi.
en: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
text:
PSA 68:8
Thadou: Israel Pathen Elohim, Sinai Pathen Elohim nangma masang'ah leiset akithing in vanhon go ahin juhlhahsah in ahi.
English: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nang man leigo chapnousah din go nengchet in neihin peuvin ahi.
en: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
text:
PSA 68:9
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nang man leigo chapnousah din go nengchet in neihin peuvin ahi.
English: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

tcz: Akhon nan hichea chun na mite na chensah in, neh le chah nengchetnin na pen, na mite ngaichat jouse jong na pe tai.
en: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
text:
PSA 68:10
Thadou: Akhon nan hichea chun na mite na chensah in, neh le chah nengchetnin na pen, na mite ngaichat jouse jong na pe tai.
English: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thu chengkhat agahseileh mitamtah in hiche kipana thu chu apoleuvin ahi.
en: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
text:
PSA 68:11
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in thu chengkhat agahseileh mitamtah in hiche kipana thu chu apoleuvin ahi.
English: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

tcz: Melmate lengho le asepaite ajamgam tauvin Israel numeiten athilkeo u achomgam peh taove.
en: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,
text:
PSA 68:12
Thadou: Melmate lengho le asepaite ajamgam tauvin Israel numeiten athilkeo u achomgam peh taove.
English: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

tcz: Kelngoi hong a chengho jeng in jong nei le gou tamtah-alhaving teni dangka le amul sana a kisem vapal akimu uvin.
en: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.
text:
PSA 68:13
Thadou: Kelngoi hong a chengho jeng in jong nei le gou tamtah-alhaving teni dangka le amul sana a kisem vapal akimu uvin.
