English: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

tcz: Hatchungnung chun Zalmon molchung'a buhbang kithejal bang'in melma lengho chu athejal gamtan ahi.
en: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.
text:
PSA 68:14
Thadou: Hatchungnung chun Zalmon molchung'a buhbang kithejal bang'in melma lengho chu athejal gamtan ahi.
English: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

tcz: Bashan a molho hi athupi thei lheh jeng uve, mol monghem tamtah'in vanthamjol a kilhungdoh jenge.
en: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
text:
PSA 68:15
Thadou: Bashan a molho hi athupi thei lheh jeng uve, mol monghem tamtah'in vanthamjol a kilhungdoh jenge.
English: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

tcz: O molsang gumtahho ibolba thangthip tah a navet uham, Zion molsang Elohim Pathen in alhen na mun, tonsot a achen nading chu?
en: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.
text:
PSA 68:16
Thadou: O molsang gumtahho ibolba thangthip tah a navet uham, Zion molsang Elohim Pathen in alhen na mun, tonsot a achen nading chu?
English: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.

tcz: Sakol-kangtalai simjoulou hon akolkhum Sinai mol a kon a hung'a amuntheng a lut ding ahi.
en: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.
text:
PSA 68:17
Thadou: Sakol-kangtalai simjoulou hon akolkhum Sinai mol a kon a hung'a amuntheng a lut ding ahi.
English: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

tcz: Nangma achung sang a na kaltou tengleh galhing a kiman tamtah na puitou ding, mipiho'a kon'a kipaman tamtah na san ding, nangma na douho a kon'a jong na san ding ahi. Hiche'a chu Yahweh Pakai eiho lah a cheng ding ahi.
en: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.
text:
PSA 68:18
Thadou: Nangma achung sang a na kaltou tengleh galhing a kiman tamtah na puitou ding, mipiho'a kon'a kipaman tamtah na san ding, nangma na douho a kon'a jong na san ding ahi. Hiche'a chu Yahweh Pakai eiho lah a cheng ding ahi.
English: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umhen; eihuh hingpau Elohim Pathen chu thangvah in umhen! Niseh a aman abanjang a eikai u ahi.
en: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
text:
PSA 68:19
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umhen; eihuh hingpau Elohim Pathen chu thangvah in umhen! Niseh a aman abanjang a eikai u ahi.
English: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

tcz: Eiho Pathen hi mihuhhing Elohim Pathen ahi. Yahweh Pakai lengchungnung hin thina a kon a eihuhdoh u ahi.
en: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
text:
PSA 68:20
Thadou: Eiho Pathen hi mihuhhing Elohim Pathen ahi. Yahweh Pakai lengchungnung hin thina a kon a eihuhdoh u ahi.
English: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in amelmate luchangho asuhchip ding ahi, thilse jeng bolna a kipeho chu alugu u asuhchip ding ahi.
en: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
text:
PSA 68:21
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in amelmate luchangho asuhchip ding ahi, thilse jeng bolna a kipeho chu alugu u asuhchip ding ahi.
English: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in asei e, “Bashan a kon'a ka melmate ka hinpui lhah ding ahi; twikhanglen lailung a kon'a ka hin puidoh ding ahi.
en: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,
text:
PSA 68:22
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in asei e, “Bashan a kon'a ka melmate ka hinpui lhah ding ahi; twikhanglen lailung a kon'a ka hin puidoh ding ahi.
English: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,

tcz: Ka mite, nanghon athisan uva chu na keng u na kisoptheng diu, chuleh na uichahou jengin jong chan aneidiu ahi.”
en: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
text:
PSA 68:23
Thadou: Ka mite, nanghon athisan uva chu na keng u na kisoptheng diu, chuleh na uichahou jengin jong chan aneidiu ahi.”
English: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

tcz: O Elohim Pathen gal nahin jaova na hung kijot u chu muthei in ahung kilangdoh tai, Elohim ka Pathen le ka lengpa muntheng a na kijotlut u chu.
en: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
text:
PSA 68:24
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen gal nahin jaova na hung kijot u chu muthei in ahung kilangdoh tai, Elohim ka Pathen le ka lengpa muntheng a na kijotlut u chu.
English: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

tcz: La saho amasang a aum un, tumging saiho a nung a aum ui; alai lunga chun nungah hon vohging theiho avouve.
en: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
text:
PSA 68:25
Thadou: La saho amasang a aum un, tumging saiho a nung a aum ui; alai lunga chun nungah hon vohging theiho avouve.
English: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,

tcz: Israel mipite Elohim Pathen thangvah un; Israel hinkho hungkondoh naho Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un.
en: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”
text:
PSA 68:26
Thadou: Israel mipite Elohim Pathen thangvah un; Israel hinkho hungkondoh naho Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un.
English: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”

tcz: Ven phung neocha Benjamin in ahin lamkai e. aban'ah Judah a kon a vaihomho, chule Zebulun le Naphtali a kon in vaihom tamtah ahung uve.
en: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
text:
PSA 68:27
Thadou: Ven phung neocha Benjamin in ahin lamkai e. aban'ah Judah a kon a vaihomho, chule Zebulun le Naphtali a kon in vaihom tamtah ahung uve.
English: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, na ban thahat chu jedoh in. Achesa nikho ho bang chun na ban thahat chu nahat na hung kilangdoh hen.
en: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
text:
PSA 68:28
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen, na ban thahat chu jedoh in. Achesa nikho ho bang chun na ban thahat chu nahat na hung kilangdoh hen.
English: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

tcz: Jerusalem a na houintheng ah leiset lenghon na hunglutna u thilho ahinchoijuve.
en: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.
text:
PSA 68:29
Thadou: Jerusalem a na houintheng ah leiset lenghon na hunglutna u thilho ahinchoijuve.
English: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.

tcz: Na melma namtin vaipiho, pang lah'a kisel gamsaho, ahatmo bongnouho lah a bongchalho hi phohsal in. Kisunem tah a ahunglutnau thil in sumlhonho hinchoisah in. Galbol'a thanom namtin vaipiho thethang in.
en: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
text:
PSA 68:30
Thadou: Na melma namtin vaipiho, pang lah'a kisel gamsaho, ahatmo bongnouho lah a bongchalho hi phohsal in. Kisunem tah a ahunglutnau thil in sumlhonho hinchoisah in. Galbol'a thanom namtin vaipiho thethang in.
English: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

tcz: Egypt a kon'in kipa thilpeh ding'in thil mantamho hinchoi u hen, Ethiopia mite Elohim Pathen a akipehlutna uvin bohkhup uhen!
en: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
text:
PSA 68:31
Thadou: Egypt a kon'in kipa thilpeh ding'in thil mantamho hinchoi u hen, Ethiopia mite Elohim Pathen a akipehlutna uvin bohkhup uhen!
English: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

tcz: Leiset gam lengho'n Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen kom'ah vahchoila sauhen.
en: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord—Selah—
text:
PSA 68:32
Thadou: Leiset gam lengho'n Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen kom'ah vahchoila sauhen.
English: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord—Selah—

tcz: Vanlaijol'a kon'a ogin hat tah hung kithongdoh a, masanglai vanho lah a ki tollepa vahchoila'n la sauvin.
en: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
text:
PSA 68:33
Thadou: Vanlaijol'a kon'a ogin hat tah hung kithongdoh a, masanglai vanho lah a ki tollepa vahchoila'n la sauvin.
English: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

tcz: Elohim Pathen thuneina hi mijouse hetsah un, aloupina chun Israelte ahinsalvah in athahatna hi vanho chung'ah akilang jing'e.
en: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
text:
PSA 68:34
Thadou: Elohim Pathen thuneina hi mijouse hetsah un, aloupina chun Israelte ahinsalvah in athahatna hi vanho chung'ah akilang jing'e.
English: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

tcz: Elohim Pathen hi amuntheng'ah gimneitah in aumjing'e. Israel Pathen Elohim'in amite chu thuneina le thahatna ape'n ahi. Elohim Pathen chu thangvah in umhen!
en: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
text:
PSA 68:35
Thadou: Elohim Pathen hi amuntheng'ah gimneitah in aumjing'e. Israel Pathen Elohim'in amite chu thuneina le thahatna ape'n ahi. Elohim Pathen chu thangvah in umhen!
English: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!

tcz: Eihuhdoh in, O Elohim Pathen, twisoh hin ka ngong gei achuptai.
en: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
text:
PSA 69:1
Thadou: Eihuhdoh in, O Elohim Pathen, twisoh hin ka ngong gei achuptai.
English: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

tcz: Bonlhoh lah a hin ka lhalut cheh cheh tai; pansatna ding ka mujou tapoi. Keima twithuh lah a ka lhalut tan twisoh hin eichup tai.
en: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
text:
PSA 69:2
Thadou: Bonlhoh lah a hin ka lhalut cheh cheh tai; pansatna ding ka mujou tapoi. Keima twithuh lah a ka lhalut tan twisoh hin eichup tai.
English: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

tcz: Panpi ngai a kaka na katha achollha tai; ka lolhomsung jong agolha tai. Ka ka kanan ka mit jong apomtan, Elohim Pathen in eipan pi ding kangah e.
en: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
text:
PSA 69:3
Thadou: Panpi ngai a kaka na katha achollha tai; ka lolhomsung jong agolha tai. Ka ka kanan ka mit jong apomtan, Elohim Pathen in eipan pi ding kangah e.
English: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.

tcz: Ajehbei hel a eivetdaho hi ka lujang a ka samjang sang'in atamjouve. Ka melmate hin jou thu jeng a suhmang ding eigouvin, hitihin ka guh louhel thil chu kanung peh din athum uve.
en: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.
text:
PSA 69:4
Thadou: Ajehbei hel a eivetdaho hi ka lujang a ka samjang sang'in atamjouve. Ka melmate hin jou thu jeng a suhmang ding eigouvin, hitihin ka guh louhel thil chu kanung peh din athum uve.
English: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen ichangei a ngol kahi nahenai; Ka chonsetnaho hi nang'a kon'in akiselmang theipoi.
en: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.
text:
PSA 69:5
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen ichangei a ngol kahi nahenai; Ka chonsetnaho hi nang'a kon'in akiselmang theipoi.
English: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.

tcz: Keijeh in, nangma tahsan ho chu jumsah hih beh in, O van a lengchungnung Yahweh Pakai, kei jeh in nang ma houmi tehi kisuh jum na nei hisah hihbeh in, O Israel Pathen Elohim.
en: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.
text:
PSA 69:6
Thadou: Keijeh in, nangma tahsan ho chu jumsah hih beh in, O van a lengchungnung Yahweh Pakai, kei jeh in nang ma houmi tehi kisuh jum na nei hisah hihbeh in, O Israel Pathen Elohim.
English: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma jal a housetna ka thoh ahi; jumna le jachatna kamai a adimset tai.
en: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
text:
PSA 69:7
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangma jal a housetna ka thoh ahi; jumna le jachatna kamai a adimset tai.
English: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

tcz: Ka sopiho tah jeng'in jong eikihetmosah tauvin gamchommi bangin eibol tauvin ahi.
en: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.
text:
PSA 69:8
Thadou: Ka sopiho tah jeng'in jong eikihetmosah tauvin gamchommi bangin eibol tauvin ahi.
English: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.

tcz: Na houin a ding a ka tompan jeh in eichaideh tan ahi, nangman na housetnau jouse chu ka chunga achu tan ahi.
en: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
text:
PSA 69:9
Thadou: Na houin a ding a ka tompan jeh in eichaideh tan ahi, nangman na housetnau jouse chu ka chunga achu tan ahi.
English: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

tcz: Kappum a an kangol a chun, noisetah in eihou un ahi.
en: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
text:
PSA 69:10
Thadou: Kappum a an kangol a chun, noisetah in eihou un ahi.
English: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

tcz: Ka genthei phondohna a khaodippon ka kisil'a ahileh einuisat un ahi.
en: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
text:
PSA 69:11
Thadou: Ka genthei phondohna a khaodippon ka kisil'a ahileh einuisat un ahi.
English: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

tcz: Keima hi khopi sung a jalhang a kihoulim nopna bep ka hitan jukhamhon kei chungchang thu totnopnan anei tauve.
en: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
text:
PSA 69:12
Thadou: Keima hi khopi sung a jalhang a kihoulim nopna bep ka hitan jukhamhon kei chungchang thu totnopnan anei tauve.
English: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

tcz: Hinla Yahweh Pakai naheng a katao jingin, tuchung beh neihin khoto ding kakinem e. O Yahweh Pakai na mingailut longlou chun katao nahi huhing na tahbeh a chun nei donbut in.
en: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.
text:
PSA 69:13
Thadou: Hinla Yahweh Pakai naheng a katao jingin, tuchung beh neihin khoto ding kakinem e. O Yahweh Pakai na mingailut longlou chun katao nahi huhing na tahbeh a chun nei donbut in.
English: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

tcz: Bonlhoh lah a kon hin neihuhdoh in; athuh jep a neilhahlutsah hihbeh in, eivetdaho lah a kon'in neihuhdoh in lang hiche twithuh lah'a kon hin neikaidoh in.
en: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.
text:
PSA 69:14
Thadou: Bonlhoh lah a kon hin neihuhdoh in; athuh jep a neilhahlutsah hihbeh in, eivetdaho lah a kon'in neihuhdoh in lang hiche twithuh lah'a kon hin neikaidoh in.
English: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

tcz: Twisohhat lai neichupsah hih in, ahilouleh twithuh gillai jong nei vallhum sah hih in, ahilouleh thina lhan kotong jong nei nehmang sah hih in.
en: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
text:
PSA 69:15
Thadou: Twisohhat lai neichupsah hih in, ahilouleh twithuh gillai jong nei vallhum sah hih in, ahilouleh thina lhan kotong jong nei nehmang sah hih in.
English: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai ka taona neingaipeh in, ajeh chu na mingailutna longlou hi kidangtah ahin, neikaihoi jing in, ajeh chu na mikhotona hi lolhingtah ahi.
en: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
text:
PSA 69:16
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai ka taona neingaipeh in, ajeh chu na mingailutna longlou hi kidangtah ahin, neikaihoi jing in, ajeh chu na mikhotona hi lolhingtah ahi.
English: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

tcz: Na sohpa a kon hin kisel mang hih in; gangtah in neidonbut in ajeh chu keiman boina nasatah ka toh tai.
en: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
text:
PSA 69:17
Thadou: Na sohpa a kon hin kisel mang hih in; gangtah in neidonbut in ajeh chu keiman boina nasatah ka toh tai.
English: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

tcz: Hung'in lang neihung lhatdoh tan; ka melmat a kon'in neilha-ong tan.
en: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.
text:
PSA 69:18
Thadou: Hung'in lang neihung lhatdoh tan; ka melmat a kon'in neilha-ong tan.
English: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.

tcz: Nang'in eiki houset na eikijum bolna le ei kijachat sah naho jouse na hesohkei in ahi. Ka melmaten abol jouseu na hesohkei e.
en: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.
text:
PSA 69:19
Thadou: Nang'in eiki houset na eikijum bolna le ei kijachat sah naho jouse na hesohkei in ahi. Ka melmaten abol jouseu na hesohkei e.
English: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

tcz: Ami taitomnauvin ka lungthim asukeh in, kadailheh jeng tai. Mikhat seh hijong le lungset na eimusah um hen lang; Khattou hung kiheihen lang eihin lungmonsah le kanom e.
en: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.
text:
PSA 69:20
Thadou: Ami taitomnauvin ka lungthim asukeh in, kadailheh jeng tai. Mikhat seh hijong le lungset na eimusah um hen lang; Khattou hung kiheihen lang eihin lungmonsah le kanom e.
English: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

tcz: Ahinla chutimalah in amahon ka nehdin gu eipeuvin amahon ka don ding'in juthuh eipeuve.
en: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
text:
PSA 69:21
Thadou: Ahinla chutimalah in amahon ka nehdin gu eipeuvin amahon ka don ding'in juthuh eipeuve.
English: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

tcz: Amasang uva neh-le-chah dimset dokhang chu akipal nao soh henlang, ahaonau chu amaho ding'in thangkol hisah jeng tan.
en: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
text:
PSA 69:22
Thadou: Amasang uva neh-le-chah dimset dokhang chu akipal nao soh henlang, ahaonau chu amaho ding'in thangkol hisah jeng tan.
English: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

tcz: Kho amutheilouna diuvin amit u chojeng henlang atahsao kithing thing in umsah jeng in.
en: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.
text:
PSA 69:23
Thadou: Kho amutheilouna diuvin amit u chojeng henlang atahsao kithing thing in umsah jeng in.
English: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.

tcz: Na lunghanna chu achung uvah sunglha jeng'in; na lunghanna meikong achun amaho chu kavam jeng in.
en: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.
text:
PSA 69:24
Thadou: Na lunghanna chu achung uvah sunglha jeng'in; na lunghanna meikong achun amaho chu kavam jeng in.
English: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

tcz: A-in'u chu ahomkeo soh doh jeng henlang aponbuh u jong kihoh doh jeng hen.
en: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.
text:
PSA 69:25
Thadou: A-in'u chu ahomkeo soh doh jeng henlang aponbuh u jong kihoh doh jeng hen.
English: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

tcz: Gotna napeh mi chun, akisuhkhah na chung uva jumbol na akoibe uve; akisukha ho chu natna abelap peh uve.
en: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.
text:
PSA 69:26
Thadou: Gotna napeh mi chun, akisuhkhah na chung uva jumbol na akoibe uve; akisukha ho chu natna abelap peh uve.
English: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

tcz: Achonsetnau setvum peh unlang, khatcha ongthol'in lha hihbeh in.
en: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.
text:
PSA 69:27
Thadou: Achonsetnau setvum peh unlang, khatcha ongthol'in lha hihbeh in.
English: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.

tcz: Amin u chu hinna lekhabu a konin thaimangpeh in; michonpha ho lah a kisimtha sah hihbeh un.
en: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.
text:
PSA 69:28
Thadou: Amin u chu hinna lekhabu a konin thaimangpeh in; michonpha ho lah a kisimtha sah hihbeh un.
English: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

tcz: Keima natna thohgim in ka um e, O Elohim Pathen, na mihuhhingna thahat chun neihuhdoh in.
en: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
text:
PSA 69:29
Thadou: Keima natna thohgim in ka um e, O Elohim Pathen, na mihuhhingna thahat chun neihuhdoh in.
English: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh keiman na min pachatna la'n sangting chule thangvahna pum'a jana ka peh ding ahi.
en: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
text:
PSA 69:30
Thadou: Hiteng chuleh keiman na min pachatna la'n sangting chule thangvahna pum'a jana ka peh ding ahi.
English: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

tcz: Ajeh chu hichun kilhaina bongchal ki katdoh sang'a Yahweh Pakai chu alunglhaisah ding ahin, bongchal thaotah le akeng tin hoitah thilpeh kipe sang in jong aphajoi.
en: It will please the LORD better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.
text:
PSA 69:31
Thadou: Ajeh chu hichun kilhaina bongchal ki katdoh sang'a Yahweh Pakai chu alunglhaisah ding ahin, bongchal thaotah le akeng tin hoitah thilpeh kipe sang in jong aphajoi.
English: It will please the LORD better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

tcz: Mi kineosah ten a Elohim Pathen'u natoh muo vintin kipahdiu ahi. Apanpi dia Elohim Pathen holte jousen kitilkhouna neicheh uhen.
en: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.
text:
PSA 69:32
Thadou: Mi kineosah ten a Elohim Pathen'u natoh muo vintin kipahdiu ahi. Apanpi dia Elohim Pathen holte jousen kitilkhouna neicheh uhen.
English: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

tcz: Ajeh chu Paka in ngaichageova umte taona angai in; Aman sohchang'a umho donlouvin akoi jipoi.
en: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.
text:
PSA 69:33
Thadou: Ajeh chu Paka in ngaichageova umte taona angai in; Aman sohchang'a umho donlouvin akoi jipoi.
English: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

tcz: O van-le-lei in Elohim Pathen vahchoi u henlang twikhanglen le asung a cheng jousen jong vahchoi u hen.
en: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!
text:
PSA 69:34
Thadou: O van-le-lei in Elohim Pathen vahchoi u henlang twikhanglen le asung a cheng jousen jong vahchoi u hen.
English: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

tcz: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen in Jerusalem ahuhdoh ding Judah khopiho asemphat ding ahi. Hiche'a chun amite cheng untin gamsung chu alodiu ahi.
en: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.
text:
PSA 69:35
Thadou: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen in Jerusalem ahuhdoh ding Judah khopiho asemphat ding ahi. Hiche'a chun amite cheng untin gamsung chu alodiu ahi.
English: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

tcz: Ama thu nitjing chaten gamsung chu louvin tin, chule ama ngailuho jouse hiche mun a chu lungmong a cheng diu ahi.
en: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.
text:
PSA 69:36
Thadou: Ama thu nitjing chaten gamsung chu louvin tin, chule ama ngailuho jouse hiche mun a chu lungmong a cheng diu ahi.
English: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.

tcz: Elohim Pathen lungsettah in neihuhdoh in! Yahweh Pakai, gangtah in hung in lang neihung kithopin.
en: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.
text:
PSA 70:1
Thadou: Elohim Pathen lungsettah in neihuhdoh in! Yahweh Pakai, gangtah in hung in lang neihung kithopin.
English: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.

tcz: Tha dia eiholten jumna toh uhenlang jachatsah in. Ka gentheipet a kipahho jachat thohpum in kinunglesah tan.
en: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
text:
PSA 70:2
Thadou: Tha dia eiholten jumna toh uhenlang jachatsah in. Ka gentheipet a kipahho jachat thohpum in kinunglesah tan.
English: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

tcz: Amaho chu tijat le jachat thohsah in, ajeh chu amahon “aphai tun ama ikhut uvah aumtai” atiuve.
en: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”
text:
PSA 70:3
Thadou: Amaho chu tijat le jachat thohsah in, ajeh chu amahon “aphai tun ama ikhut uvah aumtai” atiuve.
English: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

tcz: Hinlah koi hileh nangma holte jousen nang a kipa-le-thanopna dimset muo hen. Koi hileh na mihuhhingna ngaichaho jouse chun “Elohim Pathen hi aloupi e!” tin samging'u hen.
en: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”
text:
PSA 70:4
Thadou: Hinlah koi hileh nangma holte jousen nang a kipa-le-thanopna dimset muo hen. Koi hileh na mihuhhingna ngaichaho jouse chun “Elohim Pathen hi aloupi e!” tin samging'u hen.
English: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

tcz: Hinla keidin vang vaicha le lhasam ka hi; O Elohim Pathen lungset tah in eipanpi din hung loi in. Nanghi eipanpi le eihuhhingpa na hi; O Yahweh Pakai geisang hih in.
en: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.
text:
PSA 70:5
Thadou: Hinla keidin vang vaicha le lhasam ka hi; O Elohim Pathen lungset tah in eipanpi din hung loi in. Nanghi eipanpi le eihuhhingpa na hi; O Yahweh Pakai geisang hih in.
English: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai eihuhdoh ding ngaichan na kom kahinbel e.
en: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
text:
PSA 71:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai eihuhdoh ding ngaichan na kom kahinbel e.
English: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

tcz: Neihuhhing in lang neihuhdoh in, ajeh chu nangma adih na hi, na kol hinsung'in lang ka sei neingaipeh in, chule neichamlhatsah in.
en: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
text:
PSA 71:2
Thadou: Neihuhhing in lang neihuhdoh in, ajeh chu nangma adih na hi, na kol hinsung'in lang ka sei neingaipeh in, chule neichamlhatsah in.
English: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

tcz: Ka kisel jing theina din kahoidam na songpi hijing in. Keima huhhing ka chan theina ding'in thu peh chu pen, nangma ka songpi le ka kiselna na hi.
en: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
text:
PSA 71:3
Thadou: Ka kisel jing theina din kahoidam na songpi hijing in. Keima huhhing ka chan theina ding'in thu peh chu pen, nangma ka songpi le ka kiselna na hi.
English: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

tcz: Ka Pathen Elohim, miphalouho thaneina a kon'in neihuhdoh in, eibolse a mi engbolseho'a kon'in neihuhdoh in.
en: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
text:
PSA 71:4
Thadou: Ka Pathen Elohim, miphalouho thaneina a kon'in neihuhdoh in, eibolse a mi engbolseho'a kon'in neihuhdoh in.
English: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangbou ka kinepna na hi, O Yahweh Pakai nangma hi ka chapan laiya pat'a ka hin tahsan na hi tai.
en: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
text:
PSA 71:5
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangbou ka kinepna na hi, O Yahweh Pakai nangma hi ka chapan laiya pat'a ka hin tahsan na hi tai.
English: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.

tcz: Henge, ka pen'a pat nang'in neina umpi jing in, ka nu naobu sung'a ka kijil'a pat'a neina chintuppat ahitai, hijeh a nangma ka thangvah jing hi datmo ding ahipoi.
en: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
text:
PSA 71:6
Thadou: Henge, ka pen'a pat nang'in neina umpi jing in, ka nu naobu sung'a ka kijil'a pat'a neina chintuppat ahitai, hijeh a nangma ka thangvah jing hi datmo ding ahipoi.
English: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

tcz: Ka hinkho hi mitamtah din kihilna thei ahi, ajeh chu nangma hi ka thahatna le ka kiselna na hi.
en: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
text:
PSA 71:7
Thadou: Ka hinkho hi mitamtah din kihilna thei ahi, ajeh chu nangma hi ka thahatna le ka kiselna na hi.
English: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

tcz: Hijeh a chu nangma ka thangvah chim theilou na hi; Nilhum kei kei a hi na loupina ka phondoh jing ahi.
en: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.
text:
PSA 71:8
Thadou: Hijeh a chu nangma ka thangvah chim theilou na hi; Nilhum kei kei a hi na loupina ka phondoh jing ahi.
English: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.

tcz: Tua, ka tehphat hin neipaidpoh hih in. Ka tha'n ajolou teng neinungsun hih in.
en: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
text:
PSA 71:9
Thadou: Tua, ka tehphat hin neipaidpoh hih in. Ka tha'n ajolou teng neinungsun hih in.
English: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

tcz: Ka melmate hi keima douna di'n akihoutoh tauve. Amaho hin thadoh ding eigo tauvin ahi.
en: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
text:
PSA 71:10
Thadou: Ka melmate hi keima douna di'n akihoutoh tauve. Amaho hin thadoh ding eigo tauvin ahi.
English: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

tcz: Amahon, “Elohim Pathen in anungsun tai che'u hitin gaman'u hite ajeh chu tuahi koiman apanpi lou ding ahi” atiuve.
en: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
text:
PSA 71:11
Thadou: Amahon, “Elohim Pathen in anungsun tai che'u hitin gaman'u hite ajeh chu tuahi koiman apanpi lou ding ahi” atiuve.
English: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, munchom a potdoh hih in, Pathen ka Elohim neihung panpi loi in.
en: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
text:
PSA 71:12
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen, munchom a potdoh hih in, Pathen ka Elohim neihung panpi loi in.
English: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

tcz: Keima eihehseho hi sunem'in lang sumang jeng in, keima eibolsenomho hi sujum'in lang jachatsah in.
en: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
text:
PSA 71:13
Thadou: Keima eihehseho hi sunem'in lang sumang jeng in, keima eibolsenomho hi sujum'in lang jachatsah in.
English: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

tcz: Keima vang neikithopi ding'a kinem jing ding ka hi; Keiman nangma ka thangvahbe jing ding na hi.
en: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
text:
PSA 71:14
Thadou: Keima vang neikithopi ding'a kinem jing ding ka hi; Keiman nangma ka thangvahbe jing ding na hi.
English: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

tcz: Keiman nangma chonphatnaho hi mijouse ka seipeh ding ahi. Keima thusei them hihih jong leng na mihuhhingna thahatna hi nilhumkei kei a ka phondoh jing ding ahi.
en: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
text:
PSA 71:15
Thadou: Keiman nangma chonphatnaho hi mijouse ka seipeh ding ahi. Keima thusei them hihih jong leng na mihuhhingna thahatna hi nilhumkei kei a ka phondoh jing ding ahi.
English: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai thaneichungnung, keiman na thilbol nasatah tahho jeh a ka thangvah ding na hi. Thudih choija nangma bou na hi hi keiman mijouse ka seipeh ding ahi.
en: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
text:
PSA 71:16
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai thaneichungnung, keiman na thilbol nasatah tahho jeh a ka thangvah ding na hi. Thudih choija nangma bou na hi hi keiman mijouse ka seipeh ding ahi.
English: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nang'in ka chapanlai a pat'a neinahil ahitai. Ken jong na thilbol kidangho hi midangho ka seipeh jing ding ahi.
en: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
text:
PSA 71:17
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nang'in ka chapanlai a pat'a neinahil ahitai. Ken jong na thilbol kidangho hi midangho ka seipeh jing ding ahi.
English: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

tcz: Tunvang keima ka tehtan ka sam akang tai neinungsun hih in. Tu khangthahte lah a hin na thaneina hi samphong lengnge. Kei nung'a hung ding miho lah a jong na thilbol datmo umtahho jong phongdoh ing kate.
en: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
text:
PSA 71:18
Thadou: Tunvang keima ka tehtan ka sam akang tai neinungsun hih in. Tu khangthahte lah a hin na thaneina hi samphong lengnge. Kei nung'a hung ding miho lah a jong na thilbol datmo umtahho jong phongdoh ing kate.
English: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen na chonphatna hi van sangpenho lah jong aphapeh e. O Elohim Pathen na thilbol kidangtahho hi koitoh na kitekahpi thei ding ham?
en: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?
text:
PSA 71:19
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen na chonphatna hi van sangpenho lah jong aphapeh e. O Elohim Pathen na thilbol kidangtahho hi koitoh na kitekahpi thei ding ham?
English: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?

tcz: Hahsatna nasatah tah neithohsah in ahinlah nang'in ka hinkho na kiledohsah ding ahi'n chule lhan lah a kon'in jong neikaidoh in.
en: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
text:
PSA 71:20
Thadou: Hahsatna nasatah tah neithohsah in ahinlah nang'in ka hinkho na kiledohsah ding ahi'n chule lhan lah a kon'in jong neikaidoh in.
English: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

tcz: Nang'in lolhinna sangjo cheh a jong neikiledohsah ding avel'a neihin lhamon ding ahi.
en: Increase my honor and comfort me again.
text:
PSA 71:21
Thadou: Nang'in lolhinna sangjo cheh a jong neikiledohsah ding avel'a neihin lhamon ding ahi.
English: Increase my honor and comfort me again.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh keiman semjangsaito tho'a nangma ka thangvah ding ahi, ajeh chu O Elohim Pathen nangma na kitepna a na thon ngaipoi.
en: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
text:
PSA 71:22
Thadou: Hiteng chuleh keiman semjangsaito tho'a nangma ka thangvah ding ahi, ajeh chu O Elohim Pathen nangma na kitepna a na thon ngaipoi.
English: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

tcz: Keiman nangma thangvahna la hi kipah tah'a thongleuva ka sah ding ahi, ajeh chu nang in neihunglhatdoh tan ahi.
en: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
text:
PSA 71:23
Thadou: Keiman nangma thangvahna la hi kipah tah'a thongleuva ka sah ding ahi, ajeh chu nang in neihunglhatdoh tan ahi.
English: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

tcz: Keiman nangma thilphabolho hi sun nilhum a ka seiphongle ding ahi, ajeh chu keima eibolsego chun jachatna le jumna atoh tauvin ahi.
en: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
text:
PSA 71:24
Thadou: Keiman nangma thilphabolho hi sun nilhum a ka seiphongle ding ahi, ajeh chu keima eibolsego chun jachatna le jumna atoh tauvin ahi.
English: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nang'in na ngaisang thutan dihna chu lengpa hinpe jing'in, chule na chonphatna chu lengpa chapa hinpe tan.
en: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
text:
PSA 72:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nang'in na ngaisang thutan dihna chu lengpa hinpe jing'in, chule na chonphatna chu lengpa chapa hinpe tan.
English: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

tcz: Na mite chung'a thu adih in tansah in; genthei lengvaite jong aphalam achan dingdol chang jing u hen.
en: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
text:
PSA 72:2
Thadou: Na mite chung'a thu adih in tansah in; genthei lengvaite jong aphalam achan dingdol chang jing u hen.
English: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

tcz: Molsang dung hon jong mijouse ding'in haodohna sodohsah hen chule thinglhang in jong gapha sodohsah hen.
en: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
text:
PSA 72:3
Thadou: Molsang dung hon jong mijouse ding'in haodohna sodohsah hen chule thinglhang in jong gapha sodohsah hen.
English: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

tcz: Genthei lengvaite panhusah in lang alhasamho chate huhdoh hen chule misugentheite chu sumang jeng hen.
en: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
text:
PSA 72:4
Thadou: Genthei lengvaite panhusah in lang alhasamho chate huhdoh hen chule misugentheite chu sumang jeng hen.
English: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

tcz: Vanlai jol'a nisa le lha avahjing laise'n tonsot in amahon nangma naging jing'u hen.
en: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
text:
PSA 72:5
Thadou: Vanlai jol'a nisa le lha avahjing laise'n tonsot in amahon nangma naging jing'u hen.
English: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

tcz: Lengpa chu amite lah a go'n leiset chung achapnou bang'in hamdongho tobang amite chapnou hen.
en: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
text:
PSA 72:6
Thadou: Lengpa chu amite lah a go'n leiset chung achapnou bang'in hamdongho tobang amite chapnou hen.
English: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

tcz: Ahinkho lhumkeijin chonphatna hinkho chepi jing hen. Chule lha'n vah aneilaisen khangtou jing hen.
en: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
text:
PSA 72:7
Thadou: Ahinkho lhumkeijin chonphatna hinkho chepi jing hen. Chule lha'n vah aneilaisen khangtou jing hen.
English: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

tcz: Alenggam in twikhanglen khat a kon'in twikhanglen langkhat hoppha hen lang chule Euphrate vadung'a kon'in leiset mong langkhat gei hop hen.
en: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
text:
PSA 72:8
Thadou: Alenggam in twikhanglen khat a kon'in twikhanglen langkhat hoppha hen lang chule Euphrate vadung'a kon'in leiset mong langkhat gei hop hen.
English: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

tcz: Neldigam a ganchaching mite'n chibai aboh diu ahi; amelmate jong amasang a um nen le boh lah a chun lhu cheh unte.
en: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
text:
PSA 72:9
Thadou: Neldigam a ganchaching mite'n chibai aboh diu ahi; amelmate jong amasang a um nen le boh lah a chun lhu cheh unte.
English: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

tcz: Tarshish le gamlatah a cheng lhumlam lengte'n kai hin peuhen. Sheba le Seba a kon solam lengte'n kipa thilpeh hinchoiju hen.
en: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
text:
PSA 72:10
Thadou: Tarshish le gamlatah a cheng lhumlam lengte'n kai hin peuhen. Sheba le Seba a kon solam lengte'n kipa thilpeh hinchoiju hen.
English: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

tcz: Leng jouse a ang'a kun'untin namtin vaipi alhacha hung pang di'u ahi.
en: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
text:
PSA 72:11
Thadou: Leng jouse a ang'a kun'untin namtin vaipi alhacha hung pang di'u ahi.
English: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

tcz: Aman genthei lengvaite chu akom'a atao teng'uleh hin huhdoh intin, min abol genthei panpibeiho chu ahinpanhu ding ahi.
en: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
text:
PSA 72:12
Thadou: Aman genthei lengvaite chu akom'a atao teng'uleh hin huhdoh intin, min abol genthei panpibeiho chu ahinpanhu ding ahi.
English: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

tcz: Aman milhasamte neiloute akhoto'a ahin huhdoh ding ahi.
en: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
text:
PSA 72:13
Thadou: Aman milhasamte neiloute akhoto'a ahin huhdoh ding ahi.
English: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

tcz: Pumhat a kibol thohgimna noija umho chu alhatdoh ding ahi, ajeh chu Aman amaho chu alainatpi ding ahi.
en: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
text:
PSA 72:14
Thadou: Pumhat a kibol thohgimna noija umho chu alhatdoh ding ahi, ajeh chu Aman amaho chu alainatpi ding ahi.
English: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

tcz: Lengpa chu hingsot hen! Sheba sana chu ama kipe hen, amite'n taopeh jing'u hen chule nilhumkei in phatthei boh uhen.
en: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.
text:
PSA 72:15
Thadou: Lengpa chu hingsot hen! Sheba sana chu ama kipe hen, amite'n taopeh jing'u hen chule nilhumkei in phatthei boh uhen.
English: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.

tcz: Agamsung'uva chang-le-mim nengchet hen, thinglhangvum geiyin chang-le-mim kehdoh hen. Thei gana thingphungho jong Lebanon thingphungho bang'in keh dimset'u hen. Chule mipite jong hamphung phat bang'in hinhoi u hen.
en: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.
text:
PSA 72:16
Thadou: Agamsung'uva chang-le-mim nengchet hen, thinglhangvum geiyin chang-le-mim kehdoh hen. Thei gana thingphungho jong Lebanon thingphungho bang'in keh dimset'u hen. Chule mipite jong hamphung phat bang'in hinhoi u hen.
English: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

tcz: Tonsot in lengpa minthang hen, nisa asat laisen chejom jing hen. Namtin vaipi amajeh in phatthei chang'u hen.
en: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
text:
PSA 72:17
Thadou: Tonsot in lengpa minthang hen, nisa asat laisen chejom jing hen. Namtin vaipi amajeh in phatthei chang'u hen.
English: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, Israel Pathen Elohim chu thangvah in um hen, Amabouvin thil kidang aboldoh thei ahi.
en: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
text:
PSA 72:18
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai, Israel Pathen Elohim chu thangvah in um hen, Amabouvin thil kidang aboldoh thei ahi.
English: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

tcz: Amin loupi chu tonsot in thangvah in umhen! Vannoi leiset hi Ama loupina dimset hen, Amen, Amen!
en: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
text:
PSA 72:19
Thadou: Amin loupi chu tonsot in thangvah in umhen! Vannoi leiset hi Ama loupina dimset hen, Amen, Amen!
English: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

tcz: (Hiche hi Jesse chapa David taona achaina ahi).
en: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
text:
PSA 72:20
Thadou: (Hiche hi Jesse chapa David taona achaina ahi).
English: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu Isreal te din aphai, hitobanga lungthimtheng ho dinga chun.
en: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
text:
PSA 73:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu Isreal te din aphai, hitobanga lungthimtheng ho dinga chun.
English: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

tcz: Keima din vang, kalamjotna beikoncha bou ahitai. Kalamlhong anal in lhulham pai ding kahitai.
en: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
text:
PSA 73:2
Thadou: Keima din vang, kalamjotna beikoncha bou ahitai. Kalamlhong anal in lhulham pai ding kahitai.
English: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman mikiletsahho gitlou bol pum hijong leu akhangtou u kamuteng ka otchalheh jin ahi.
en: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
text:
PSA 73:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman mikiletsahho gitlou bol pum hijong leu akhangtou u kamuteng ka otchalheh jin ahi.
English: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

tcz: Amaho hi atahsa'u aphatheiyin, adamthei un, ahattheiyun lungkhamna imacha neilou dan'in aum jiuve.
en: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
text:
PSA 73:4
Thadou: Amaho hi atahsa'u aphatheiyin, adamthei un, ahattheiyun lungkhamna imacha neilou dan'in aum jiuve.
English: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

tcz: Amaho hin midang bang'in boina imacha aneipouvin midangho'n aneiyu lunggimna amahon imacha aneipouve.
en: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
text:
PSA 73:5
Thadou: Amaho hin midang bang'in boina imacha aneipouvin midangho'n aneiyu lunggimna amahon imacha aneipouve.
English: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

tcz: Amahon kiletsahna songmantam a kisem khivui bang'in aki ouvin, gitlouna chu pon bang'in akisil'un ahi.
en: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
text:
PSA 73:6
Thadou: Amahon kiletsahna songmantam a kisem khivui bang'in aki ouvin, gitlouna chu pon bang'in akisil'un ahi.
English: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

tcz: Hiche miboltheiho hin alungsung uva angaichat chan'u anei un ahi.
en: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
text:
PSA 73:7
Thadou: Hiche miboltheiho hin alungsung uva angaichat chan'u anei un ahi.
English: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

tcz: Amahon mi jahda dingngen aseijun kiletsah tah in midang chu suhmang ding ago uvin ahi.
en: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
text:
PSA 73:8
Thadou: Amahon mi jahda dingngen aseijun kiletsah tah in midang chu suhmang ding ago uvin ahi.
English: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

tcz: Amahon van douna'n thu asei uvin a-o cheng'un leiset pumpi asamsesoh jeng'un ahi.
en: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
text:
PSA 73:9
Thadou: Amahon van douna'n thu asei uvin a-o cheng'un leiset pumpi asamsesoh jeng'un ahi.
English: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

tcz: Hiti chun mipiho'n athusei u hi ajah uleh akicha uvin akisulungdong gam tauvin ahi.
en: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
text:
PSA 73:10
Thadou: Hiti chun mipiho'n athusei u hi ajah uleh akicha uvin akisulungdong gam tauvin ahi.
English: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

tcz: Elohim Pathen'in ipi ahet am? “Hatchungnung in thilsohho hi ahena dem?” atiuve.
en: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
text:
PSA 73:11
Thadou: Elohim Pathen'in ipi ahet am? “Hatchungnung in thilsohho hi ahena dem?” atiuve.
English: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

tcz: Hiche migilouho hi veuvin hinkhonom amang un ahao tultul jeng'un ahi.
en: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
text:
PSA 73:12
Thadou: Hiche migilouho hi veuvin hinkhonom amang un ahao tultul jeng'un ahi.
English: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

tcz: Imacha phachomlou ding'a lungthim theng ka put ham? Themmona beihel'a hinkho ka man hi mohseh ham?
en: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
text:
PSA 73:13
Thadou: Imacha phachomlou ding'a lungthim theng ka put ham? Themmona beihel'a hinkho ka man hi mohseh ham?
English: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,

tcz: Nilhumkei in imacha phatchomna ka mupon hahsatna ngen ka mu jo'n ahi, jingkah seh in lunggimna ngen in eilonvuh in ahi.
en: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.
text:
PSA 73:14
Thadou: Nilhumkei in imacha phatchomna ka mupon hahsatna ngen ka mu jo'n ahi, jingkah seh in lunggimna ngen in eilonvuh in ahi.
English: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.

tcz: Keiman hitiahi ka seikhah a ahileh na mi ka hilou hijeng inte.
en: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
text:
PSA 73:15
Thadou: Keiman hitiahi ka seikhah a ahileh na mi ka hilou hijeng inte.
English: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

tcz: Hijeh chun keiman miphalouho hi i-atileh khangtou cheh cheh u ham ti hetchet ding'in ka khol'in ahi. Ahinla iti hahsat hitam?
en: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—
text:
PSA 73:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun keiman miphalouho hi i-atileh khangtou cheh cheh u ham ti hetchet ding'in ka khol'in ahi. Ahinla iti hahsat hitam?
English: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—

tcz: Hichun O Pathen Elohim, nangma muntheng'a ka lut'in ahileh ajona in migiloute akhankho diu chu kahin hedoh tan ahi.
en: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
text:
PSA 73:17
Thadou: Hichun O Pathen Elohim, nangma muntheng'a ka lut'in ahileh ajona in migiloute akhankho diu chu kahin hedoh tan ahi.
English: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

tcz: Tahbeh in nang'in amaho hi lhuh nathei munjeng a nakoi ahin alhuh gam nadiu a kiling gih geh songpi chung a nakoi joh ahi.
en: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
text:
PSA 73:18
Thadou: Tahbeh in nang'in amaho hi lhuh nathei munjeng a nakoi ahin alhuh gam nadiu a kiling gih geh songpi chung a nakoi joh ahi.
English: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

tcz: Chomkah lou in amaho amahthahgam tauvin ahi, tijatna'n alhohmang gam tauve.
en: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
text:
PSA 73:19
Thadou: Chomkah lou in amaho amahthahgam tauvin ahi, tijatna'n alhohmang gam tauve.
English: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma na hung kipatdoh tengleh nang'in amaho ngolna chu na nuisat ding ahi, mikhat in jingkah lang'a amang anuisat tobang bou ahi.
en: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
text:
PSA 73:20
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangma na hung kipatdoh tengleh nang'in amaho ngolna chu na nuisat ding ahi, mikhat in jingkah lang'a amang anuisat tobang bou ahi.
English: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

tcz: Hijouchun ka lungsung analheh jeng'in, hiti chun ka sunggil lang achiplha jeng'in ahi.
en: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
text:
PSA 73:21
Thadou: Hijouchun ka lungsung analheh jeng'in, hiti chun ka sunggil lang achiplha jeng'in ahi.
English: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

tcz: Keima vang mingol le thilhethemlou kana hi-Nang a ding chun khohephalou gamsa tobang bep ka na hi bouve.
en: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
text:
PSA 73:22
Thadou: Keima vang mingol le thilhethemlou kana hi-Nang a ding chun khohephalou gamsa tobang bep ka na hi bouve.
English: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

tcz: Henge keima nang'a ka hi jing'e, nang man ka jetlang na tuh jingnai.
en: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
text:
PSA 73:23
Thadou: Henge keima nang'a ka hi jing'e, nang man ka jetlang na tuh jingnai.
English: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

tcz: Na chihna'n eikaihoi jing in, munloupi tah chu neilhut ding ahi.
en: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
text:
PSA 73:24
Thadou: Na chihna'n eikaihoi jing in, munloupi tah chu neilhut ding ahi.
English: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

tcz: Van a nang tailou koidangba ka nei ding ham? Leiset chung'a thildang jouse sang'in jong kalung in na ngaicha joi.
en: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
text:
PSA 73:25
Thadou: Van a nang tailou koidangba ka nei ding ham? Leiset chung'a thildang jouse sang'in jong kalung in na ngaicha joi.
English: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

tcz: Ka tahsa bei henlang ka lhagao lhadai jongleh, Elohim Pathen chu ka lungthim'a ka hatna ahijing'in Amahi tonsot a kei a ahijing'e.
en: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
text:
PSA 73:26
Thadou: Ka tahsa bei henlang ka lhagao lhadai jongleh, Elohim Pathen chu ka lungthim'a ka hatna ahijing'in Amahi tonsot a kei a ahijing'e.
English: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

tcz: Ama dalhaho jouse chu mahthah ding ahiuve, ajeh chu nangma dalhaho jouse chu nangman na sumang jin ahi.
en: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
text:
PSA 73:27
Thadou: Ama dalhaho jouse chu mahthah ding ahiuve, ajeh chu nangma dalhaho jouse chu nangman na sumang jin ahi.
English: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

tcz: Ahinla keima ding'in Elohim Pathen kom nai hi iti phat a hitam! Keiman vang Yahweh Pakai Lengchungnung chu ka kiselna ahijing e, chule keiman na thilbol kidangho hi mijouse ka seipeh ding ahi.
en: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
text:
PSA 73:28
Thadou: Ahinla keima ding'in Elohim Pathen kom nai hi iti phat a hitam! Keiman vang Yahweh Pakai Lengchungnung chu ka kiselna ahijing e, chule keiman na thilbol kidangho hi mijouse ka seipeh ding ahi.
English: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, idia hitihchan pi neipaidoh u hitam? Ipi ding'a na kelngoite douna a hichangeihi na lunghan ham?
en: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
text:
PSA 74:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen, idia hitihchan pi neipaidoh u hitam? Ipi ding'a na kelngoite douna a hichangeihi na lunghan ham?
English: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

tcz: Khang masalai peh a nalhentum chate kahiu neisumil hih beh un, hiche nam nagoulu tum dia na ngeh jing chu kahiuve! chule hiche lei a na inn Jerusalem jong sumil hih beh in.
en: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.
text:
PSA 74:2
Thadou: Khang masalai peh a nalhentum chate kahiu neisumil hih beh un, hiche nam nagoulu tum dia na ngeh jing chu kahiuve! chule hiche lei a na inn Jerusalem jong sumil hih beh in.
English: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

tcz: Hiche khopi kisumangsa a hin hungvahlen lang, na melmate'n na houin hi ichanggei a asuhset'u hitam hinven.
en: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
text:
PSA 74:3
Thadou: Hiche khopi kisumangsa a hin hungvahlen lang, na melmate'n na houin hi ichanggei a asuhset'u hitam hinven.
English: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

tcz: Hiche mun a hi na melmate'n haan la anasap u hitam, hiche mun a hi aponlap u ana khaisang'u ahi.
en: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.
text:
PSA 74:4
Thadou: Hiche mun a hi na melmate'n haan la anasap u hitam, hiche mun a hi aponlap u ana khaisang'u ahi.
English: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

tcz: Amahon gammang lah a thingtuhna a heicha analap u bang'in,
en: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
text:
PSA 74:5
Thadou: Amahon gammang lah a thingtuhna a heicha analap u bang'in,
English: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

tcz: Heicha le chempong toh tho'n anakhenchip'un ahi.
en: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
text:
PSA 74:6
Thadou: Heicha le chempong toh tho'n anakhenchip'un ahi.
English: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

tcz: Amahon namuntheng a na mintheng kitahdohho chu asuboh un,
en: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.
text:
PSA 74:7
Thadou: Amahon namuntheng a na mintheng kitahdohho chu asuboh un,
English: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

tcz: Chuban in jong “abonchan suseu hite” akitikit uvin, Elohim Pathen houna mun jouse jong anahallhah u ahitai.
en: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
text:
PSA 74:8
Thadou: Chuban in jong “abonchan suseu hite” akitikit uvin, Elohim Pathen houna mun jouse jong anahallhah u ahitai.
English: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

tcz: Keihon melchihna thil kidangtahho chu ka mudohjou tapouvin ahi. Themgaoho jouse la aumgam tapouvin, chule hiche hi itihleh kichai ding ti chu koimacha ahe aumpon ahi.
en: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
text:
PSA 74:9
Thadou: Keihon melchihna thil kidangtahho chu ka mudohjou tapouvin ahi. Themgaoho jouse la aumgam tapouvin, chule hiche hi itihleh kichai ding ti chu koimacha ahe aumpon ahi.
English: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

tcz: O Pathen Elohim ka melmate'u hi itihchanggei na kihousetsah ding ham? Namin theng hi tonsot a nasuh molphou sah ding hitam?
en: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
text:
PSA 74:10
Thadou: O Pathen Elohim ka melmate'u hi itihchanggei na kihousetsah ding ham? Namin theng hi tonsot a nasuh molphou sah ding hitam?
English: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

tcz: Ipi dia na banjet thahatna hi na chalohsah lou ham? Na khut thahattah chu mangcha'n lang amaho khu sugam tan.
en: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
text:
PSA 74:11
Thadou: Ipi dia na banjet thahatna hi na chalohsah lou ham? Na khut thahattah chu mangcha'n lang amaho khu sugam tan.
English: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nangma hi khangluilai a pat a leiset chung'a huhhingna hinpolut a ka lengpa na hi.
en: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.
text:
PSA 74:12
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nangma hi khangluilai a pat a leiset chung'a huhhingna hinpolut a ka lengpa na hi.
English: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.

tcz: Nang man na ban thahat'in twikhanglen jong na lhehkhen in, twikhanglen a cheng sahemho luchang jong navohchip soh hel e.
en: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
text:
PSA 74:13
Thadou: Nang man na ban thahat'in twikhanglen jong na lhehkhen in, twikhanglen a cheng sahemho luchang jong navohchip soh hel e.
English: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

tcz: Nangman Leviathan luchang jong nasuchip in atahsa neldigam a um ganhingho vahnan na mangtai.
en: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
text:
PSA 74:14
Thadou: Nangman Leviathan luchang jong nasuchip in atahsa neldigam a um ganhingho vahnan na mangtai.
English: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

tcz: Nang man leiset a kum nakihei sah in leiset a kon'in twi tamtah na putdohsah in chule a-itih a kang khalou vadungho jong na sukang jin ahi.
en: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
text:
PSA 74:15
Thadou: Nang man leiset a kum nakihei sah in leiset a kon'in twi tamtah na putdohsah in chule a-itih a kang khalou vadungho jong na sukang jin ahi.
English: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

tcz: Sun le jan jong nang'a ahin: nangman vanlai jol'a avahho jouse le nisa jong na sem in ahi.
en: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
text:
PSA 74:16
Thadou: Sun le jan jong nang'a ahin: nangman vanlai jol'a avahho jouse le nisa jong na sem in ahi.
English: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

tcz: Nangman leiset gamgiho jouse jong na lhehkhen in chule nipilai le phalbilai jong na gongtoh in ahi.
en: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
text:
PSA 74:17
Thadou: Nangman leiset gamgiho jouse jong na lhehkhen in chule nipilai le phalbilai jong na gongtoh in ahi.
English: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

tcz: Ven Yahweh Pakai hiche melmaho hin ichangei a nangma hi na houset'u hitam, ima hetkhenna neilou nam miten na min hi asuminseuvin ahi.
en: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
text:
PSA 74:18
Thadou: Ven Yahweh Pakai hiche melmaho hin ichangei a nangma hi na houset'u hitam, ima hetkhenna neilou nam miten na min hi asuminseuvin ahi.
English: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

tcz: Hiche gamsa tobang miphalouho hi vapal tobang miphaho hi suhmangsah hihbeh in, na mite gentheina hi itihchan'in jong sumil hihbeh in.
en: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
text:
PSA 74:19
Thadou: Hiche gamsa tobang miphalouho hi vapal tobang miphaho hi suhmangsah hihbeh in, na mite gentheina hi itihchan'in jong sumil hihbeh in.
English: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.

tcz: Na kitepna kinep umtahho chu sumil hihbeh in, ajeh chu gamsung hi muthim le pumhat a natohna adimset e!
en: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
text:
PSA 74:20
Thadou: Na kitepna kinep umtahho chu sumil hihbeh in, ajeh chu gamsung hi muthim le pumhat a natohna adimset e!
English: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

tcz: Noise le chotpha a umte hi jumna tosah kit hihbeh in, amavang mivaicha le tahlelte na min choi-at sah in.
en: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
text:
PSA 74:21
Thadou: Noise le chotpha a umte hi jumna tosah kit hihbeh in, amavang mivaicha le tahlelte na min choi-at sah in.
English: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

tcz: Na melmate'n na housetnaho le na doumah mah asap a saptho jenghou hi nahsahmon koihihbeh in.
en: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
text:
PSA 74:22
Thadou: Na melmate'n na housetnaho le na doumah mah asap a saptho jenghou hi nahsahmon koihihbeh in.
English: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

tcz: Namel ten aseidoh uchu nungvet kit hih in ahiloule amaho phunchel jing na chu.
en: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
text:
PSA 74:23
Thadou: Namel ten aseidoh uchu nungvet kit hih in ahiloule amaho phunchel jing na chu.
English: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nangma kahin thangvah e! Yahweh Pakai nangma nailama naumjeh in kahin thangvah uve. Muntin a um mipiten nathilbol kidangtah ho aphongdoh un ahi.
en: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
text:
PSA 75:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nangma kahin thangvah e! Yahweh Pakai nangma nailama naumjeh in kahin thangvah uve. Muntin a um mipiten nathilbol kidangtah ho aphongdoh un ahi.
English: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

tcz: Elohim Pathennin asei e, keiman thutanna phatkhat kagong e, keiman dihtah a thu katanding ahi.
en: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.
text:
PSA 75:2
Thadou: Elohim Pathennin asei e, keiman thutanna phatkhat kagong e, keiman dihtah a thu katanding ahi.
English: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

tcz: Leiset hi kihot linghenlang mihemte tija jongleu leiset bulpi tuhchah jingding chu kahi.
en: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.
text:
PSA 75:3
Thadou: Leiset hi kihot linghenlang mihemte tija jongleu leiset bulpi tuhchah jingding chu kahi.
English: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

tcz: “Keiman mikiletsah ho kagih-in ‘kiletsah datan!’ Migiloulou ho komachun, ‘nakhut tumjel hihin!’
en: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.
text:
PSA 75:4
Thadou: “Keiman mikiletsah ho kagih-in ‘kiletsah datan!’ Migiloulou ho komachun, ‘nakhut tumjel hihin!’
English: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

tcz: Vanho dounan nakhut tum jel hihin, ahilouleh nahsah loutah in thu seihih in” kati.
en: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”
text:
PSA 75:5
Thadou: Vanho dounan nakhut tum jel hihin, ahilouleh nahsah loutah in thu seihih in” kati.
English: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

tcz: Ajeh chu, leiset chunga koimacha solam a kon hihen lhumlam-a kon hijongleh chuleh gamthip noi a kon hijongleh kihisah tah a akhuttum ajel louding aphai.
en: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.
text:
PSA 75:6
Thadou: Ajeh chu, leiset chunga koimacha solam a kon hihen lhumlam-a kon hijongleh chuleh gamthip noi a kon hijongleh kihisah tah a akhuttum ajel louding aphai.
English: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

tcz: Ajeh chu thutan vaihom-a hi Elohim Pathen Amabou ahin, Amahin koipen ding doh ding ham ahi louleh koipen lhuding ham gonga Amabou ahi.
en: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
text:
PSA 75:7
Thadou: Ajeh chu thutan vaihom-a hi Elohim Pathen Amabou ahin, Amahin koipen ding doh ding ham ahi louleh koipen lhuding ham gonga Amabou ahi.
English: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in juphon gimnam twitoh kihal chu akhutna khonkhat in achoiye. Aman hiche ju chu thutan na mun a sunglut in, hichu migilou cheng in adon teitei diu adontheng heldiu ahi.
en: For in the LORD’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.
text:
PSA 75:8
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in juphon gimnam twitoh kihal chu akhutna khonkhat in achoiye. Aman hiche ju chu thutan na mun a sunglut in, hichu migilou cheng in adon teitei diu adontheng heldiu ahi.
English: For in the LORD’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

tcz: Hinla keima vangin, Elohim Pathen thil bol ho hi kaphondoh jengding; Jacob Elohim Pathen henga vahchoila kasha jingding ahi.
en: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
text:
PSA 75:9
Thadou: Hinla keima vangin, Elohim Pathen thil bol ho hi kaphondoh jengding; Jacob Elohim Pathen henga vahchoila kasha jingding ahi.
English: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

tcz: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen in asei e “Keiman miphalouho thahatna laichu kasuhchip ding ahinla michonphaho thahatna kahatsah beding ahi” ati.
en: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
text:
PSA 75:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen in asei e “Keiman miphalouho thahatna laichu kasuhchip ding ahinla michonphaho thahatna kahatsah beding ahi” ati.
English: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

tcz: Judah a Pathen Elohim hi akijabol in, Israel a Amin hi aloupin ahi.
en: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
text:
PSA 76:1
Thadou: Judah a Pathen Elohim hi akijabol in, Israel a Amin hi aloupin ahi.
English: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

tcz: Jerusalem hi achenna ahin; Zion molchu a inn ahi.
en: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.
text:
PSA 76:2
Thadou: Jerusalem hi achenna ahin; Zion molchu a inn ahi.
English: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

tcz: Hicheachun agalmite meikong tobang thalchang chu asubong in, a umphou le achemjamhou chuleh agalmachah houjouse jong asuhchip pehin ahi.
en: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.
text:
PSA 76:3
Thadou: Hicheachun agalmite meikong tobang thalchang chu asubong in, a umphou le achemjamhou chuleh agalmachah houjouse jong asuhchip pehin ahi.
English: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

tcz: Nangma hi tonsot a umjing mol ho sang in jong naloupi in nalamdang deh e.
en: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
text:
PSA 76:4
Thadou: Nangma hi tonsot a umjing mol ho sang in jong naloupi in nalamdang deh e.
English: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

tcz: Eidou u galmi hangpenho jouse jong akisugep gam tauve. A imumil bang in kamasang uvah akijamdel tauve. Galmi koiman kamasang uvah akhutnu alamp ngapchat lou diu ahitai.
en: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
text:
PSA 76:5
Thadou: Eidou u galmi hangpenho jouse jong akisugep gam tauve. A imumil bang in kamasang uvah akijamdel tauve. Galmi koiman kamasang uvah akhutnu alamp ngapchat lou diu ahitai.
English: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

tcz: O Jacob Elohim Pathen nakam sunga nahaina hu chu ahung gindoh chun asakol jouse leh akangtalai jouseu akolchah sah soh jengin ahi.
en: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
text:
PSA 76:6
Thadou: O Jacob Elohim Pathen nakam sunga nahaina hu chu ahung gindoh chun asakol jouse leh akangtalai jouseu akolchah sah soh jengin ahi.
English: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

tcz: Nangma hitobang tah-a ginle ja naumhi datmo ding ahipoi. Ajeh chu nalunghan ahung deujah leh koiham na-anga ding ngam dingah?
en: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
text:
PSA 76:7
Thadou: Nangma hitobang tah-a ginle ja naumhi datmo ding ahipoi. Ajeh chu nalunghan ahung deujah leh koiham na-anga ding ngam dingah?
English: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

tcz: Vanna konin nagalmite chunga thu nahin tan in, leiset hi akithingin na-ang sungah adingin ahi.
en: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
text:
PSA 76:8
Thadou: Vanna konin nagalmite chunga thu nahin tan in, leiset hi akithingin na-ang sungah adingin ahi.
English: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma nadingdoh-in mi engsete thu natan in leiset abol genthei a umte nahuhdohjin ahi.
en: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.
text:
PSA 76:9
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangma nadingdoh-in mi engsete thu natan in leiset abol genthei a umte nahuhdohjin ahi.
English: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

tcz: Mihemte hi nangma doumah a achonteng hichu naloupina kilandohna ahijon ahi, ajeh chu hiche chu nangma manchah-a pangbep ji ahi.
en: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
text:
PSA 76:10
Thadou: Mihemte hi nangma doumah a achonteng hichu naloupina kilandohna ahijon ahi, ajeh chu hiche chu nangma manchah-a pangbep ji ahi.
English: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

tcz: Na Pakai Yahweh, na Pathen Elohim heng a kitepna neiyin lang hichu nit'in, mijousen kichat umtah Elohim Pathen kom a pehdingdol hinpecheh hen.
en: Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
text:
PSA 76:11
