Thadou: Na Pakai Yahweh, na Pathen Elohim heng a kitepna neiyin lang hichu nit'in, mijousen kichat umtah Elohim Pathen kom a pehdingdol hinpecheh hen.
English: Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman leng chate kiletsahna avochip in, lengten jong Ama ginle jana aneiyun ahi.
en: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
text:
PSA 76:12
Thadou: Ajeh chu Aman leng chate kiletsahna avochip in, lengten jong Ama ginle jana aneiyun ahi.
English: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai kakouvin; henge, kasaptho jengin ahi. Oh, Elohim Pathen in eingaipeh tei inte!
en: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
text:
PSA 77:1
Thadou: Keiman Yahweh Pakai kakouvin; henge, kasaptho jengin ahi. Oh, Elohim Pathen in eingaipeh tei inte!
English: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

tcz: Keiman hahsatna kato teng Yahweh Pakai chu kaholjin ahi. Jankhovah in vanlang sangin kakhut katungin kataojin ahi. Ahinla kalhagao in olna amujoupoi.
en: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.
text:
PSA 77:2
Thadou: Keiman hahsatna kato teng Yahweh Pakai chu kaholjin ahi. Jankhovah in vanlang sangin kakhut katungin kataojin ahi. Ahinla kalhagao in olna amujoupoi.
English: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

tcz: Keiman Elohim Pathen kagelin apanpina ngaichatnan eilonvuh-in kamaojin ahi.
en: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.
text:
PSA 77:3
Thadou: Keiman Elohim Pathen kagelin apanpina ngaichatnan eilonvuh-in kamaojin ahi.
English: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

tcz: Nangman jankhovah in nei imutsahpon ahi, ajeh chu keima kalung ahesoh behsehin kataotheipoi!
en: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
text:
PSA 77:4
Thadou: Nangman jankhovah in nei imutsahpon ahi, ajeh chu keima kalung ahesoh behsehin kataotheipoi!
English: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

tcz: Keiman phat sottah chetasa hinkholui nopsahna chengchu kageldohjin,
en: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
text:
PSA 77:5
Thadou: Keiman phat sottah chetasa hinkholui nopsahna chengchu kageldohjin,
English: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

tcz: kipana dimsetna vahchoina la ana kisahna janhochu kalhagao lungthim a kakholchil tengleh tuhin masangtoh akibah louna kageldohjin ahi.
en: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
text:
PSA 77:6
Thadou: kipana dimsetna vahchoina la ana kisahna janhochu kalhagao lungthim a kakholchil tengleh tuhin masangtoh akibah louna kageldohjin ahi.
English: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hin aitih a dia eipaidoh mong hitantem? Amahin khotona eimulou mong mong ding hitam?
en: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
text:
PSA 77:7
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hin aitih a dia eipaidoh mong hitantem? Amahin khotona eimulou mong mong ding hitam?
English: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

tcz: Angailutna longlouchu chemang monga hitam? Akitepna hochu lolhing lou mong ding hitam?
en: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?
text:
PSA 77:8
Thadou: Angailutna longlouchu chemang monga hitam? Akitepna hochu lolhing lou mong ding hitam?
English: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

tcz: Elohim Pathen in eihepina chu asuhmil mong hitam? Eihepina kotchu akha mong hitam?
en: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.
text:
PSA 77:9
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in eihepina chu asuhmil mong hitam? Eihepina kotchu akha mong hitam?
English: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

tcz: Hitihin keiman kaseijin, “hichehi kachanding mongchu ahi, chungnungpen'in ei engbol ahi,” kati.
en: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
text:
PSA 77:10
Thadou: Hitihin keiman kaseijin, “hichehi kachanding mongchu ahi, chungnungpen'in ei engbol ahi,” kati.
English: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

tcz: Ahinla O Yahweh Pakai nanatoh hohi kahin geldohin, tuma sang peh-a nanatoh kidangtah hochu kageldohin ahi.
en: I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
text:
PSA 77:11
Thadou: Ahinla O Yahweh Pakai nanatoh hohi kahin geldohin, tuma sang peh-a nanatoh kidangtah hochu kageldohin ahi.
English: I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

tcz: Hicheho chu kalung sunga amil theipon ahi. Nanatoh loupitah hochu gellouvin kaumthei jipon ahi.
en: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
text:
PSA 77:12
Thadou: Hicheho chu kalung sunga amil theipon ahi. Nanatoh loupitah hochu gellouvin kaumthei jipon ahi.
English: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nalampi hi atheng e. Nangma tobang patheng dang um mong nantem?
en: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
text:
PSA 77:13
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nalampi hi atheng e. Nangma tobang patheng dang um mong nantem?
English: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

tcz: Nanghi datmo kidangtah Elohim Pathen chu nahi ahi! Nangin chidang namdangte lah-a nabol theina gimneitah chu nakilandohsah ahitai.
en: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
text:
PSA 77:14
Thadou: Nanghi datmo kidangtah Elohim Pathen chu nahi ahi! Nangin chidang namdangte lah-a nabol theina gimneitah chu nakilandohsah ahitai.
English: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

tcz: Naban thahatna a nami Jacob leh Joseph chilhahte chu nahuhdoh ahitai.
en: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
text:
PSA 77:15
Thadou: Naban thahatna a nami Jacob leh Joseph chilhahte chu nahuhdoh ahitai.
English: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai twikhanglensan chun namuphat in twichun nahinven akithingtan ahi! Twikhanglen chu asunglang ho ngeiyin akithingin ahi.
en: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
text:
PSA 77:16
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai twikhanglensan chun namuphat in twichun nahinven akithingtan ahi! Twikhanglen chu asunglang ho ngeiyin akithingin ahi.
English: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

tcz: Meilhang in go ahin juhlhahsah in, van gin kithong chun vanthamjol chu agin akithonsah in ahi. Nakolphe thalchang chun ahin salvah in ahi.
en: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
text:
PSA 77:17
Thadou: Meilhang in go ahin juhlhahsah in, van gin kithong chun vanthamjol chu agin akithonsah in ahi. Nakolphe thalchang chun ahin salvah in ahi.
English: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

tcz: Chimpei lah-a kon chun van gin ahung kithongin kolphe chun vannoi leiset ahin salvah in ahi! Leiset chu akithingin akihot-e.
en: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
text:
PSA 77:18
Thadou: Chimpei lah-a kon chun van gin ahung kithongin kolphe chun vannoi leiset ahin salvah in ahi! Leiset chu akithingin akihot-e.
English: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

tcz: Nalampi chu twikhanglen'ah akilhunglutnin ahi, Nakeng nung twilah ajong akigollut e, ahinlah nakhonung koimachan amudoh joupoi!
en: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
text:
PSA 77:19
Thadou: Nalampi chu twikhanglen'ah akilhunglutnin ahi, Nakeng nung twilah ajong akigollut e, ahinlah nakhonung koimachan amudoh joupoi!
English: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

tcz: Nangin kelngoi chingpa hina in Mose le Aaron mangcha in namite hi kelngoi honbangin napuilen ahi.
en: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
text:
PSA 77:20
Thadou: Nangin kelngoi chingpa hina in Mose le Aaron mangcha in namite hi kelngoi honbangin napuilen ahi.
English: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

tcz: O kamite ho, kathuhil hi ngaiyun. Kathusei a hin nakol'u hinsungun,
en: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
text:
PSA 78:1
Thadou: O kamite ho, kathuhil hi ngaiyun. Kathusei a hin nakol'u hinsungun,
English: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

tcz: ajeh chu keiman thulem a nahenga thu kaseiding ahi, keiman achesa thilsoh ho-a kon a kahin hilding nahi,
en: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
text:
PSA 78:2
Thadou: ajeh chu keiman thulem a nahenga thu kaseiding ahi, keiman achesa thilsoh ho-a kon a kahin hilding nahi,
English: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

tcz: eihon thusim ijahsa houleh ihetsahou, thusim ipu ipateuva kon a hung kiseilhapeh ho ahi.
en: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
text:
PSA 78:3
Thadou: eihon thusim ijahsa houleh ihetsahou, thusim ipu ipateuva kon a hung kiseilhapeh ho ahi.
English: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

tcz: Eihon hiche thutah hohi icha inaoteu i-impeh loudiu, Yahweh Pakai natoh loupi tahtah hohi, athaneinale akidanna hohi ikhangthah houhi iseipehdiu ahi.
en: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.
text:
PSA 78:4
Thadou: Eihon hiche thutah hohi icha inaoteu i-impeh loudiu, Yahweh Pakai natoh loupi tahtah hohi, athaneinale akidanna hohi ikhangthah houhi iseipehdiu ahi.
English: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman Jocob kom a Dan anapeh-a, Israel kom a thuhil ho anapeh ahi. Aman ipu ipateu atu achateu ahil diuva thupeh anapeh ahin,
en: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

tcz: hitiachu ahunglhung ding khangthah ten ahet nadiuleh ahung pengloulai chapang ho dinga, chuleh aman amaho chapangte ahilsonna diuva ahi.
en: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
text:
PSA 78:6
Thadou: hitiachu ahunglhung ding khangthah ten ahet nadiuleh ahung pengloulai chapang ho dinga, chuleh aman amaho chapangte ahilsonna diuva ahi.
English: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

tcz: Hitiachu khangthah ahunglhun channa Elohim Pathen a kinepna thah aneisah nadiu, Yahweh Pakai natoh kidang thil loupi hochu asuhmillou nadiu chuleh athupehho anitjing nadiuva ahiljing diu ahi.
en: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,
text:
PSA 78:7
Thadou: Hitiachu khangthah ahunglhun channa Elohim Pathen a kinepna thah aneisah nadiu, Yahweh Pakai natoh kidang thil loupi hochu asuhmillou nadiu chuleh athupehho anitjing nadiuva ahiljing diu ahi.
English: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,

tcz: Hiteng chuleh ipi iputeu tobang talou a lungtahna, kiphinna, kitah louna Elohim Pathen a alungthim'u pehnom louna anei lou diu ahitai.
en: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
text:
PSA 78:8
Thadou: Hiteng chuleh ipi iputeu tobang talou a lungtahna, kiphinna, kitah louna Elohim Pathen a alungthim'u pehnom louna anei lou diu ahitai.
English: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

tcz: Ephraim galsat hon thalchang akipoh vangun akinung hei un galmun a konin ajam tauve.
en: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
text:
PSA 78:9
Thadou: Ephraim galsat hon thalchang akipoh vangun akinung hei un galmun a konin ajam tauve.
English: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

tcz: Amahon Elohim Pathen toh akitepnau ajuitapouvin ama thuhil dinpi ding anom tapouvin ahi.
en: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
text:
PSA 78:10
Thadou: Amahon Elohim Pathen toh akitepnau ajuitapouvin ama thuhil dinpi ding anom tapouvin ahi.
English: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in ipi abolpeh uham thil kidangtah tah anabol hochu,
en: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.
text:
PSA 78:11
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in ipi abolpeh uham thil kidangtah tah anabol hochu,
English: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

tcz: napu napateu dinga thil kidang anatohdoh ho, Egypt gamsungle Zoan phaicham chunga, atohdohho asumil tauvin ahi.
en: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
text:
PSA 78:12
Thadou: napu napateu dinga thil kidang anatohdoh ho, Egypt gamsungle Zoan phaicham chunga, atohdohho asumil tauvin ahi.
English: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman twikhanglen ana homkhen in twichu bang bangin aki khen in amaho anapui galkaiyun ahi.
en: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
text:
PSA 78:13
Thadou: Ajeh chu Aman twikhanglen ana homkhen in twichu bang bangin aki khen in amaho anapui galkaiyun ahi.
English: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

tcz: Sunleh meilhang in anapuijin, janleh meikong in anapuijin ahi.
en: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
text:
PSA 78:14
Thadou: Sunleh meilhang in anapuijin, janleh meikong in anapuijin ahi.
English: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

tcz: Aman gamthip gamm a songpia kon in adondiu twi anaputdoh sah-in ahi.
en: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
text:
PSA 78:15
Thadou: Aman gamthip gamm a songpia kon in adondiu twi anaputdoh sah-in ahi.
English: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

tcz: Aman songpia konna twichu vadung bangin analondohsah in ahi.
en: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
text:
PSA 78:16
Thadou: Aman songpia konna twichu vadung bangin analondohsah in ahi.
English: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

tcz: Ahijeng vangin neldi gam achun amahon chonset anabol'un hatchungnung dounan ana kiphin'un ahi.
en: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
text:
PSA 78:17
Thadou: Ahijeng vangin neldi gam achun amahon chonset anabol'un hatchungnung dounan ana kiphin'un ahi.
English: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

tcz: Amahon alungsung uchu lungtahna neipumin Elohim Pathen ana patep un nehding anathumun ahi.
en: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
text:
PSA 78:18
Thadou: Amahon alungsung uchu lungtahna neipumin Elohim Pathen ana patep un nehding anathumun ahi.
English: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

tcz: Amahon Elohim Pathen Amatah dounan thu anaseiyun “Elohim Pathen in gamthip gammah an eipejou pouve” atiuve.
en: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
text:
PSA 78:19
Thadou: Amahon Elohim Pathen Amatah dounan thu anaseiyun “Elohim Pathen in gamthip gammah an eipejou pouve” atiuve.
English: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

tcz: “Henge, songchu ajep'un twichu aputdoh nai, ahinla amite changlhah le sa me eipejou pouve” atiuve.
en: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”
text:
PSA 78:20
Thadou: “Henge, songchu ajep'un twichu aputdoh nai, ahinla amite changlhah le sa me eipejou pouve” atiuve.
English: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”

tcz: Elohim Pathen in hichehi ajahdoh phatnin alunghang lheh jengin, Jacob dounan alunghan na mei akoudoh jengin ahi! Hitihin Israel douna alung hanna ahung koudoh jengin ahi,
en: Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,
text:
PSA 78:21
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in hichehi ajahdoh phatnin alunghang lheh jengin, Jacob dounan alunghan na mei akoudoh jengin ahi! Hitihin Israel douna alung hanna ahung koudoh jengin ahi,
English: Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

tcz: ajeh chu amahon Elohim Pathen atahsan pouvin chuleh amaho akhoukhah diuvin jong ana tahsan pouvin ahi.
en: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.
text:
PSA 78:22
Thadou: ajeh chu amahon Elohim Pathen atahsan pouvin chuleh amaho akhoukhah diuvin jong ana tahsan pouvin ahi.
English: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in chungleng vanthamjol thu apen vankot jouse jong ahongdoh in,
en: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
text:
PSA 78:23
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in chungleng vanthamjol thu apen vankot jouse jong ahongdoh in,
English: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

tcz: Aman aneh dingun van a konin Mana gojuh in ahin juhlhah sah in van changlhah chu ahinpen ahi.
en: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
text:
PSA 78:24
Thadou: Aman aneh dingun van a konin Mana gojuh in ahin juhlhah sah in van changlhah chu ahinpen ahi.
English: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

tcz: Amahon vantil buchu aneuvin, Elohim Pathen in alungna chimsetnun apen ahi.
en: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.
text:
PSA 78:25
Thadou: Amahon vantil buchu aneuvin, Elohim Pathen in alungna chimsetnun apen ahi.
English: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

tcz: Aman solam huichu ahin nunsah in, Athahatnan lhanglang huijong anunsah in ahi.
en: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
text:
PSA 78:26
Thadou: Aman solam huichu ahin nunsah in, Athahatnan lhanglang huijong anunsah in ahi.
English: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

tcz: Aman aneh dingun sachu vutdi jat ahin juhlhah sahin, vachaho chu twikhanglen panga neldi jat ahin,
en: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.
text:
PSA 78:27
Thadou: Aman aneh dingun sachu vutdi jat ahin juhlhah sahin, vachaho chu twikhanglen panga neldi jat ahin,
English: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.

tcz: Aman vachaho chu aponbuh sungu leh avel uvah ahin lenlhah sah in ahi.
en: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
text:
PSA 78:28
Thadou: Aman vachaho chu aponbuh sungu leh avel uvah ahin lenlhah sah in ahi.
English: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.

tcz: Amahon oivasetin aneuvin ahi. Angaichat dungjuitah in apen ahi.
en: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
text:
PSA 78:29
Thadou: Amahon oivasetin aneuvin ahi. Angaichat dungjuitah in apen ahi.
English: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

tcz: Hinla amahon angaichat dungjuija anehva masangu, akam sung uva sa aumpet jeng jong chun,
en: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,
text:
PSA 78:30
Thadou: Hinla amahon angaichat dungjuija anehva masangu, akam sung uva sa aumpet jeng jong chun,
English: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

tcz: Elohim Pathen lunghana achung uvah ahung lhungtan ahileh Aman alah uva ahatpen pen hochu athat tan ahi. Israel khangthah anasapen hochu athat gamtan ahi.
en: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
text:
PSA 78:31
Thadou: Elohim Pathen lunghana achung uvah ahung lhungtan ahileh Aman alah uva ahatpen pen hochu athat tan ahi. Israel khangthah anasapen hochu athat gamtan ahi.
English: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

tcz: Ahijeng vangin mipiho chun chonset aboljom jingun ahi, thilkidang ijat abol vangin atahsan dehpouvin ahi.
en: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.
text:
PSA 78:32
Thadou: Ahijeng vangin mipiho chun chonset aboljom jingun ahi, thilkidang ijat abol vangin atahsan dehpouvin ahi.
English: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

tcz: Hiti chun ahinkhou chu lhuhgam na ahitan akum khouchu kichatnan adimtai.
en: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
text:
PSA 78:33
Thadou: Hiti chun ahinkhou chu lhuhgam na ahitan akum khouchu kichatnan adimtai.
English: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in amaho ahin thapat phatnun amahon ajona langin Amachu ahin holtauvin ahi. Kisihna ahin neitauvin Elohim Pathen ahin holtauvin ahi.
en: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
text:
PSA 78:34
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in amaho ahin thapat phatnun amahon ajona langin Amachu ahin holtauvin ahi. Kisihna ahin neitauvin Elohim Pathen ahin holtauvin ahi.
English: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

tcz: Hiti chun Elohim Pathen chu asongpiu ahi chuleh Elohim Pathen chu hat chungnung le ahuhhing pao ahi ahin geldoh tauvin ahi.
en: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.
text:
PSA 78:35
Thadou: Hiti chun Elohim Pathen chu asongpiu ahi chuleh Elohim Pathen chu hat chungnung le ahuhhing pao ahi ahin geldoh tauvin ahi.
English: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

tcz: Ahijeng vangin hichu kamnal a anaseijiu ahibouvin alei u mangchan jou anaseiyun ahi.
en: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
text:
PSA 78:36
Thadou: Ahijeng vangin hichu kamnal a anaseijiu ahibouvin alei u mangchan jou anaseiyun ahi.
English: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

tcz: Alung sungu chu Elohim Pathen a ana petheng pouvin Elohim Pathen toh anakitep nauva jong ana dingdet pouvin ahi.
en: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
text:
PSA 78:37
Thadou: Alung sungu chu Elohim Pathen a ana petheng pouvin Elohim Pathen toh anakitep nauva jong ana dingdet pouvin ahi.
English: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

tcz: Hinla lungsetna dim Elohim Pathen chun achonsetnau anangai damun amahochu ana sumang deh pouvin ahi. Phat atamjon alunghan na anatuh tangin hiche bangchun ima ana tongdoh pon ahi.
en: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.
text:
PSA 78:38
Thadou: Hinla lungsetna dim Elohim Pathen chun achonsetnau anangai damun amahochu ana sumang deh pouvin ahi. Phat atamjon alunghan na anatuh tangin hiche bangchun ima ana tongdoh pon ahi.
English: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

tcz: Tahsa mihembep ahiuve ti ahejingin, hui anun leh heikhat kahbou ahin ahung kiletapoi ti ageldoh in ahi.
en: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.
text:
PSA 78:39
Thadou: Tahsa mihembep ahiuve ti ahejingin, hui anun leh heikhat kahbou ahin ahung kiletapoi ti ageldoh in ahi.
English: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

tcz: Gamthip sunga ijatvei Ama douna ana kiphin jengu chuleh alungsung anatsah vangin,
en: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
text:
PSA 78:40
Thadou: Gamthip sunga ijatvei Ama douna ana kiphin jengu chuleh alungsung anatsah vangin,
English: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

tcz: Avel vel in Elohim Pathen thohhat nachu apatep jiuvin Israel Pathen Elohim chu asulunghang jiuvin ahi.
en: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
text:
PSA 78:41
Thadou: Avel vel in Elohim Pathen thohhat nachu apatep jiuvin Israel Pathen Elohim chu asulunghang jiuvin ahi.
English: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

tcz: Amahon athahatna in agalmi houva kon a anahuhdoh u hi ageldoh joutapouve.
en: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

tcz: Egypt gamsunga thil kidang ijat abolu hitam chuleh Zoan phaicham a athil kidang bol hochu ageldoh tapouvin ahi.
en: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
text:
PSA 78:43
Thadou: Egypt gamsunga thil kidang ijat abolu hitam chuleh Zoan phaicham a athil kidang bol hochu ageldoh tapouvin ahi.
English: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

tcz: Vadungho thisan asosah a don mohella alha, vadung twi donmo hella alha jengchu.
en: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.
text:
PSA 78:44
Thadou: Vadungho thisan asosah a don mohella alha, vadung twi donmo hella alha jengchu.
English: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in amaho lah a thousi vaibong alansah a, uphohte alansah a agam ujong a suh set peh chu ahepha tapouve.
en: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
text:
PSA 78:45
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in amaho lah a thousi vaibong alansah a, uphohte alansah a agam ujong a suh set peh chu ahepha tapouve.
English: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

tcz: Aman achang jouseu khongbai aneh gamsah in alousoh jouseu jong khaokhopi anehgam sah e.
en: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.
text:
PSA 78:46
Thadou: Aman achang jouseu khongbai aneh gamsah in alousoh jouseu jong khaokhopi anehgam sah e.
English: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

tcz: Alengpithei jouseu gel avohlhah sah sohkei in, atheipiu phung jouseu jong daibang athagamsah in ahi.
en: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
text:
PSA 78:47
Thadou: Alengpithei jouseu gel avohlhah sah sohkei in, atheipiu phung jouseu jong daibang athagamsah in ahi.
English: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

tcz: Agancha jouseu gel lah a dalhah in aumsah in, akelngoi houjong keh alhah lihsah sohtai.
en: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
text:
PSA 78:48
Thadou: Agancha jouseu gel lah a dalhah in aumsah in, akelngoi houjong keh alhah lihsah sohtai.
English: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

tcz: Achung uva nasatah in alunghangin, alung dammona alung hanna, mi sumang vantil hon tamtah alhahkhum tan ahi.
en: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
text:
PSA 78:49
Thadou: Achung uva nasatah in alunghangin, alung dammona alung hanna, mi sumang vantil hon tamtah alhahkhum tan ahi.
English: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

tcz: Aman alunghanna achung uvah achuh sahtan, Egypt mite hinkho anahing hoipon, amangthah gamtan ahi,
en: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
text:
PSA 78:50
Thadou: Aman alunghanna achung uvah achuh sahtan, Egypt mite hinkho anahing hoipon, amangthah gamtan ahi,
English: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

tcz: Egypt insunga achapa tahpen cheh athat in Egypt gamsung pumpia khangdongte pahcha amolsahtai.
en: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
text:
PSA 78:51
Thadou: Egypt insunga achapa tahpen cheh athat in Egypt gamsung pumpia khangdongte pahcha amolsahtai.
English: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

tcz: Hinla Aman amite chu kelngoi honbangin apuiyin gamthip noija bitkei in apui galkai tan ahi.
en: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
text:
PSA 78:52
Thadou: Hinla Aman amite chu kelngoi honbangin apuiyin gamthip noija bitkei in apui galkai tan ahi.
English: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

tcz: Aman mongtahin apuilen hijeh chun amahon kichatna aneipouve, chujongleh twikhanglen in agalteu alhoh mangpeh gamtai.
en: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
text:
PSA 78:53
Thadou: Aman mongtahin apuilen hijeh chun amahon kichatna aneipouve, chujongleh twikhanglen in agalteu alhoh mangpeh gamtai.
English: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

tcz: Amaho chu Elohim Pathen in agamtheng abanjetna atundoh, molsang vum achun ahin puilut in,
en: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
text:
PSA 78:54
Thadou: Amaho chu Elohim Pathen in agamtheng abanjetna atundoh, molsang vum achun ahin puilut in,
English: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

tcz: Amaho masangah namtin vaipi adelmang peh sohkeiyin, abonchauvin achan dingu gam ahoppeh chehin, Israel phung namtin abonchauvin ama ama ponbuh cheh a achensah tai.
en: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
text:
PSA 78:55
Thadou: Amaho masangah namtin vaipi adelmang peh sohkeiyin, abonchauvin achan dingu gam ahoppeh chehin, Israel phung namtin abonchauvin ama ama ponbuh cheh a achensah tai.
English: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

tcz: Ahijeng vangin amahon hatchungnung Elohim Pathen dounan thil abol jingun athupeh ho khatcha anitpeh pouvin ahi.
en: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,
text:
PSA 78:56
Thadou: Ahijeng vangin amahon hatchungnung Elohim Pathen dounan thil abol jingun athupeh ho khatcha anitpeh pouvin ahi.
English: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

tcz: Apu apateu bangin avah mang-uvin jou jengin na atonguvin ahi. Amaho chu thalpi janglou bangin akitah pouvin ahi.
en: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.
text:
PSA 78:57
Thadou: Apu apateu bangin avah mang-uvin jou jengin na atonguvin ahi. Amaho chu thalpi janglou bangin akitah pouvin ahi.
English: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

tcz: Amahon pathen dangho doiphung aphutdoh un Elohim Pathen alunghan sah uvin, chuleh semthu pathen ahoujeh-un Elohim Pathen athangthip sahtauvin ahi.
en: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.
text:
PSA 78:58
Thadou: Amahon pathen dangho doiphung aphutdoh un Elohim Pathen alunghan sah uvin, chuleh semthu pathen ahoujeh-un Elohim Pathen athangthip sahtauvin ahi.
English: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in ajahdoh phat in hatah'in alunghangin Israel chu pumpai in apaimangtan ahi.
en: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,
text:
PSA 78:59
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in ajahdoh phat in hatah'in alunghangin Israel chu pumpai in apaimangtan ahi.
English: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,

tcz: Elohim Pathen in Shiloh achenna mun adalhan mihemte lah a aumna ponbuh chu adalhatai.
en: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,
text:
PSA 78:60
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in Shiloh achenna mun adalhan mihemte lah a aumna ponbuh chu adalhatai.
English: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,

tcz: Aman aloupina le athaneina hetna kitepna thingkong chu galmiho khutna apehdohtan ahi.
en: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
text:
PSA 78:61
Thadou: Aman aloupina le athaneina hetna kitepna thingkong chu galmiho khutna apehdohtan ahi.
English: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

tcz: Ama amite chunga alunghan jeh-in agalmiteu athasah gamtan ahi.
en: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
text:
PSA 78:62
Thadou: Ama amite chunga alunghan jeh-in agalmiteu athasah gamtan ahi.
English: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

tcz: Gollhangho galah athigam tauvin, nungah ho akichenpidiu aumtapon ahi.
en: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
text:
PSA 78:63
Thadou: Gollhangho galah athigam tauvin, nungah ho akichenpidiu aumtapon ahi.
English: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

tcz: Thempute athat gamtauvin ameithai houvin alhasetpi thei tapouvin ahi.
en: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
text:
PSA 78:64
Thadou: Thempute athat gamtauvin ameithai houvin alhasetpi thei tapouvin ahi.
English: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

tcz: Ajonan Yahweh Pakai chu a-ihmua ahung khangdoh bangin ahung thoudoh in mihatpa hung kiltildoh bangin ahung kitildohin,
en: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
text:
PSA 78:65
Thadou: Ajonan Yahweh Pakai chu a-ihmua ahung khangdoh bangin ahung thoudoh in mihatpa hung kiltildoh bangin ahung kitildohin,
English: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

tcz: Galmi hochu anungno in a-itih a ding jumna atosah tan ahi.
en: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.
text:
PSA 78:66
Thadou: Galmi hochu anungno in a-itih a ding jumna atosah tan ahi.
English: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

tcz: Ahinla Joseph chilhah hochu apaidohin, chuleh Ephraim phungchu alheng tapon ahi.
en: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,
text:
PSA 78:67
Thadou: Ahinla Joseph chilhah hochu apaidohin, chuleh Ephraim phungchu alheng tapon ahi.
English: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

tcz: Aman akhellin Judah leh angailut Zion molchu alhengin,
en: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
text:
PSA 78:68
Thadou: Aman akhellin Judah leh angailut Zion molchu alhengin,
English: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

tcz: hichea chun vanho san banga sang, leiset banga chah a-itih a umjing dingin houin khat atungdoh tan ahi.
en: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
text:
PSA 78:69
Thadou: hichea chun vanho san banga sang, leiset banga chah a-itih a umjing dingin houin khat atungdoh tan ahi.
English: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

tcz: Aman asohpa David chu akelngoi chinna a konnin anakoudoh'in analheng tan ahi.
en: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

tcz: Aman kelngoipi le anou achin laijin akoudoh'in amite Israel Jacob chilhah hochu kelngoi chinna ching dingin anapansah tan ahi.
en: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
text:
PSA 78:71
Thadou: Aman kelngoipi le anou achin laijin akoudoh'in amite Israel Jacob chilhah hochu kelngoi chinna ching dingin anapansah tan ahi.
English: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

tcz: David in amaho chu lungtheng tah leh chingtheitah in analamkaiyin ahi.
en: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
text:
PSA 78:72
Thadou: David in amaho chu lungtheng tah leh chingtheitah in analamkaiyin ahi.
English: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen chiding namdangten nanga dinga nanakilhendoh nagamchu ahinlo tauvin, na Houin theng asuboh'un chuleh Jerusalem chu khogemsa abahsah tauvin ahi.
en: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
text:
PSA 79:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen chiding namdangten nanga dinga nanakilhendoh nagamchu ahinlo tauvin, na Houin theng asuboh'un chuleh Jerusalem chu khogemsa abahsah tauvin ahi.
English: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

tcz: Amahon nasohte tahsa chu vantham jolla lengle vachate adalhahpeh tauvin, pathen mi thengte tahsaphe chu gamlah a ganhingho an le chahin apangtan ahi.
en: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.
text:
PSA 79:2
Thadou: Amahon nasohte tahsa chu vantham jolla lengle vachate adalhahpeh tauvin, pathen mi thengte tahsaphe chu gamlah a ganhingho an le chahin apangtan ahi.
English: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

tcz: Jerusalem kimvellah thisan hi twilon in along jengin mithi vuiding koimacha aumpoi.
en: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.
text:
PSA 79:3
Thadou: Jerusalem kimvellah thisan hi twilon in along jengin mithi vuiding koimacha aumpoi.
English: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

tcz: Kaheng kakomho noise dingleh kajet kavei a umho dingin noise le taitomin kaumtauve.
en: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
text:
PSA 79:4
Thadou: Kaheng kakomho noise dingleh kajet kavei a umho dingin noise le taitomin kaumtauve.
English: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai phat ichangeija kachung uva nalunghan ding hitam? Tonsot geijin em? Phat ichan geija nathangthipna chu meikong banga aljeng dingham?
en: How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
text:
PSA 79:5
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai phat ichangeija kachung uva nalunghan ding hitam? Tonsot geijin em? Phat ichan geija nathangthipna chu meikong banga aljeng dingham?
English: How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nalunghanna chu nang na donnom loute chidang namdang holeh naminpan nomloute lenggam hochungah bunglhatan.
en: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,
text:
PSA 79:6
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nalunghanna chu nang na donnom loute chidang namdang holeh naminpan nomloute lenggam hochungah bunglhatan.
English: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon namite Israelte hi avallhum gamtauvin chuleh gamsung hi gamgem asodohsah tauvin ahi.
en: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
text:
PSA 79:7
Thadou: Ajeh chu amahon namite Israelte hi avallhum gamtauvin chuleh gamsung hi gamgem asodohsah tauvin ahi.
English: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

tcz: Kapu kapateu chonset jehin keiho neithep mosah hihbeh un! Nami khotonan gangtah'in kangaichatnu neisuh bulhitpeh un, achutilouleh kakinepnau beiding ahitai.
en: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.
text:
PSA 79:8
Thadou: Kapu kapateu chonset jehin keiho neithep mosah hihbeh un! Nami khotonan gangtah'in kangaichatnu neisuh bulhitpeh un, achutilouleh kakinepnau beiding ahitai.
English: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

tcz: O Pathen Elohim kasochatnau, neipanhu loiyun! namin loupina dingin neipanhuvin, kachonsetnau ngaidam inlang neihuh doh'un namin loupina dingin.
en: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
text:
PSA 79:9
Thadou: O Pathen Elohim kasochatnau, neipanhu loiyun! namin loupina dingin neipanhuvin, kachonsetnau ngaidam inlang neihuh doh'un namin loupina dingin.
English: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

tcz: Ipi dinga chiding namdangte hin eihouset uva “A Pathen u Elohim hoilai a umham?” natisah nahlai dingham? Hiche chiding namdangho chunga naphulahna chu neimusahih in, ajeh chu amahohin nasohte thisan aso u ahi.
en: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.
text:
PSA 79:10
Thadou: Ipi dinga chiding namdangte hin eihouset uva “A Pathen u Elohim hoilai a umham?” natisah nahlai dingham? Hiche chiding namdangho chunga naphulahna chu neimusahih in, ajeh chu amahohin nasohte thisan aso u ahi.
English: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

tcz: Sohchangho lhasetna hi ngaipehin, thidinga athu kitansa hohi huhdoh inlang nathaneina chu neivet sah'un.
en: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.
text:
PSA 79:11
Thadou: Sohchangho lhasetna hi ngaipehin, thidinga athu kitansa hohi huhdoh inlang nathaneina chu neivet sah'un.
English: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kaheng kakom hon noise tah a nahousetnao hi ajat sagin lethuh tei in.
en: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
text:
PSA 79:12
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai kaheng kakom hon noise tah a nahousetnao hi ajat sagin lethuh tei in.
English: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh keiho namite nangailutna ankonga kivah nakelngoiten akhang khangin nang vahchoi ungting, vahchoijing taovinge.
en: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.
text:
PSA 79:13
Thadou: Hiteng chuleh keiho namite nangailutna ankonga kivah nakelngoiten akhang khangin nang vahchoi ungting, vahchoijing taovinge.
English: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.

tcz: O Israel neingaipehun, nangma Joseph chilhahte gancha hon ho banga puihoija kelngoi chin a chingpa. O Elohim Pathen Cherubim chunga laltouna a toupan naloupinavah hoi chu hin kimudoh sah in.
en: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
text:
PSA 80:1
Thadou: O Israel neingaipehun, nangma Joseph chilhahte gancha hon ho banga puihoija kelngoi chin a chingpa. O Elohim Pathen Cherubim chunga laltouna a toupan naloupinavah hoi chu hin kimudoh sah in.
English: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

tcz: Ephraim, Benjamin leh Mannaseh chungah hintah langin, nathahatna gimneitah chu neimusah unlang neihung huhdoh tauvin.
en: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
text:
PSA 80:2
Thadou: Ephraim, Benjamin leh Mannaseh chungah hintah langin, nathahatna gimneitah chu neimusah unlang neihung huhdoh tauvin.
English: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nangma komah neihoilutnun, namaivah chun neihin salvah un, chuteng boule huhhing kachandiu ahi.
en: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
text:
PSA 80:3
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nangma komah neihoilutnun, namaivah chun neihin salvah un, chuteng boule huhhing kachandiu ahi.
English: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen, phat itihchan gei a kataona sanlou a nakoi dingham?
en: LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
text:
PSA 80:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen, phat itihchan gei a kataona sanlou a nakoi dingham?
English: LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

tcz: Nangin lungkhamna a ichan gei a neivah uva chuleh khondimset a mitlhi neilonsah diuham?
en: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
text:
PSA 80:5
Thadou: Nangin lungkhamna a ichan gei a neivah uva chuleh khondimset a mitlhi neilonsah diuham?
English: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

tcz: Nangin hengle kom chiding namdangte taitomna neichansah tauvin kagalmi teuvin totnan einei tauve.
en: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.
text:
PSA 80:6
Thadou: Nangin hengle kom chiding namdangte taitomna neichansah tauvin kagalmi teuvin totnan einei tauve.
English: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen hatchungnung nangma kom neingatsah un, namaivah chun neisalvah'un chuteng lebou huhhing kachandiu ahi.
en: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
text:
PSA 80:7
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen hatchungnung nangma kom neingatsah un, namaivah chun neisalvah'un chuteng lebou huhhing kachandiu ahi.
English: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

tcz: Nangin lengpiga twi bangin Egyptma kon in neihin puidohun, nangin chiding namdangho nadel mangna nagamsunga neipuilutnu ahi.
en: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
text:
PSA 80:8
Thadou: Nangin lengpiga twi bangin Egyptma kon in neihin puidohun, nangin chiding namdangho nadel mangna nagamsunga neipuilutnu ahi.
English: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

tcz: Nangman keiho ding amun neisuhtheng pehun chuleh hichea chun keiho kajung khouvin gamsung chu kadimset tauve.
en: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.
text:
PSA 80:9
Thadou: Nangman keiho ding amun neisuhtheng pehun chuleh hichea chun keiho kajung khouvin gamsung chu kadimset tauve.
English: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

tcz: keiho len molsangho atomjouvin, kabah houvin Cedar thingphung lentah tahho atomjouvin,
en: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.
text:
PSA 80:10
Thadou: keiho len molsangho atomjouvin, kabah houvin Cedar thingphung lentah tahho atomjouvin,
English: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

tcz: keihon kabah hou lhumlam Mediterranean twikhanglen gei in kathejalun chuleh kajungun Euphrate vadung gei ka thejallun ahi.
en: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.
text:
PSA 80:11
Thadou: keihon kabah hou lhumlam Mediterranean twikhanglen gei in kathejalun chuleh kajungun Euphrate vadung gei ka thejallun ahi.
English: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

tcz: Hinla tunvang, kabangu ipi dinga neivoh lhahpeh uva, hilang lampia hinhopa jousen kagao akiguh u hitam?
en: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
text:
PSA 80:12
Thadou: Hinla tunvang, kabangu ipi dinga neivoh lhahpeh uva, hilang lampia hinhopa jousen kagao akiguh u hitam?
English: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

tcz: Gammanga kon in ngalchang hangin avallhum in, gamlah ganchahon kivahnan anei un ahi.
en: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
text:
PSA 80:13
Thadou: Gammanga kon in ngalchang hangin avallhum in, gamlah ganchahon kivahnan anei un ahi.
English: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

tcz: Hungkile kit in O Elohim Pathen hatchungnung, kahung tao un ahi. Van a konnin neihin veuvin kahahsatnau neihin vetpeh un, hiche lengpigui hi hin khoukhah'in.
en: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
text:
PSA 80:14
Thadou: Hungkile kit in O Elohim Pathen hatchungnung, kahung tao un ahi. Van a konnin neihin veuvin kahahsatnau neihin vetpeh un, hiche lengpigui hi hin khoukhah'in.
English: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

tcz: Nangma tahin nanatu ahi. Hiche chapa hi nangma tahin nangma dinga nahin khoukhah ahi.
en: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
text:
PSA 80:15
Thadou: Nangma tahin nanatu ahi. Hiche chapa hi nangma tahin nangma dinga nahin khoukhah ahi.
English: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

tcz: Ajeh chu keihohi thing banga eikitan bong bonga kagal miteuvin eihal lhah'u ahitai. Nangman navetsah chu amuteng uleh manthahnan juiju hen.
en: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
text:
PSA 80:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu keihohi thing banga eikitan bong bonga kagal miteuvin eihal lhah'u ahitai. Nangman navetsah chu amuteng uleh manthahnan juiju hen.
English: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

tcz: Mihem nangailut nacha nadeilhen chu hatsah-in,
en: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
text:
PSA 80:17
Thadou: Mihem nangailut nacha nadeilhen chu hatsah-in,
English: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

tcz: Chutengleh keihon itihchan injong nanungsun pouvinge. Nei suhal kit un chutileh namin avella kahin koukit theidiu ahi.
en: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
text:
PSA 80:18
Thadou: Chutengleh keihon itihchan injong nanungsun pouvinge. Nei suhal kit un chutileh namin avella kahin koukit theidiu ahi.
English: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

tcz: Nangma komlang nei ngatsah kitnun, O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen hatchungnung namaivah chun neihin salvah'un, chuteng lebou huhhing kachandiu ahi.
en: Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
text:
PSA 80:19
Thadou: Nangma komlang nei ngatsah kitnun, O Yahweh Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen hatchungnung namaivah chun neihin salvah'un, chuteng lebou huhhing kachandiu ahi.
English: Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

tcz: Ei thahatsah u Elohim Pathen thangvahnan la sauvin, Jacob Pathen Elohim vahchoinan la sauvin.
en: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!
text:
PSA 81:1
Thadou: Ei thahatsah u Elohim Pathen thangvahnan la sauvin, Jacob Pathen Elohim vahchoinan la sauvin.
English: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

tcz: Sauvin! tumging tothon avahchoila sauvin voh gingthei vouvin, semjang kisai ginleh selangdah gin to thouvin,
en: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
text:
PSA 81:2
Thadou: Sauvin! tumging tothon avahchoila sauvin voh gingthei vouvin, semjang kisai ginleh selangdah gin to thouvin,
English: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

tcz: Lhathah janle sumkon mut-uvin lang, lhalih janle lhalih nikhoa golvah bolteng sumkon mut uvin.
en: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
text:
PSA 81:3
Thadou: Lhathah janle sumkon mut-uvin lang, lhalih janle lhalih nikhoa golvah bolteng sumkon mut uvin.
English: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

tcz: Ajeh chu hichehi Israel dinga chondan thupeh ahin Jacob Elohim Pathen thugahsa ahi.
en: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
text:
PSA 81:4
Thadou: Ajeh chu hichehi Israel dinga chondan thupeh ahin Jacob Elohim Pathen thugahsa ahi.
English: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

tcz: Egypt gam a kon a ahungdoh uchun Aman Joseph komma hettohsah khat anaphutdoh tai. Keiman kahetchetlou thukhat kajan,
en: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.
text:
PSA 81:5
Thadou: Egypt gam a kon a ahungdoh uchun Aman Joseph komma hettohsah khat anaphutdoh tai. Keiman kahetchetlou thukhat kajan,
English: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.

tcz: Keiman apohgih kangai jangin akhut a jong thilgih kangai jangin akhut a jong thilgih hahsa kathamsah tapoi.
en: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.
text:
PSA 81:6
Thadou: Keiman apohgih kangai jangin akhut a jong thilgih kangai jangin akhut a jong thilgih hahsa kathamsah tapoi.
English: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

tcz: Nagimna a kon in neihin kouvin keiman kahuhdohtai. Meivom lhangkhat kiheh chetchut laha kahin houjin, Meribah a twi umloupet in natahsah kapatepjin ahi.
en: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.
text:
PSA 81:7
Thadou: Nagimna a kon in neihin kouvin keiman kahuhdohtai. Meivom lhangkhat kiheh chetchut laha kahin houjin, Meribah a twi umloupet in natahsah kapatepjin ahi.
English: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.

tcz: Ngai uvin O kamite, nangho gihna nasatah kapeh pet-hin, Vo Israel kaseihi nangai poupou uleh,
en: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
text:
PSA 81:8
Thadou: Ngai uvin O kamite, nangho gihna nasatah kapeh pet-hin, Vo Israel kaseihi nangai poupou uleh,
English: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

tcz: Nanghon imatihchan ajong gamchom mit pathen koipouvin nate, pathen lhem masanga kun pouvin nate.
en: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.
text:
PSA 81:9
Thadou: Nanghon imatihchan ajong gamchom mit pathen koipouvin nate, pathen lhem masanga kun pouvin nate.
English: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

tcz: Ajeh chu Egypt-a kon a nahin puidoh uva Yahweh Pakai na Pathen'u Elohim keima kahi. Nakam hakatnin ka-in keiman thilpha tamtah adimsetna kahin sunlut pehding ahi.
en: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
text:
PSA 81:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu Egypt-a kon a nahin puidoh uva Yahweh Pakai na Pathen'u Elohim keima kahi. Nakam hakatnin ka-in keiman thilpha tamtah adimsetna kahin sunlut pehding ahi.
English: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

tcz: Ahinla kamiten angainom pouvin, Israel'in Keima eingaicha pouve.
en: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
text:
PSA 81:11
Thadou: Ahinla kamiten angainom pouvin, Israel'in Keima eingaicha pouve.
English: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

tcz: Hijeh chun Keiman alouchallu dungjuijin amaho deilam lam a chondin kalha kangtai.
en: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
text:
PSA 81:12
Thadou: Hijeh chun Keiman alouchallu dungjuijin amaho deilam lam a chondin kalha kangtai.
English: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

tcz: O kamiten kaseihi ngaipou pouleu, O Kamite Israelte hin eijuiju henlang kalampia hin chenom poupouleu!
en: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
text:
PSA 81:13
Thadou: O kamiten kaseihi ngaipou pouleu, O Kamite Israelte hin eijuiju henlang kalampia hin chenom poupouleu!
English: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

tcz: Ichan geija gang in agalmiteu kajopeh tadiuvem! Ichan geija gangtah'in akidoupiteu chunga kakhut kalha tadem!
en: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.
text:
PSA 81:14
Thadou: Ichan geija gang in agalmiteu kajopeh tadiuvem! Ichan geija gangtah'in akidoupiteu chunga kakhut kalha tadem!
English: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

tcz: Koi hile Yahweh Pakai nahsah loute chu a-ang sunga kisuchipdiu atonsotna mahthahdiu ahi.
en: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
text:
PSA 81:15
Thadou: Koi hile Yahweh Pakai nahsah loute chu a-ang sunga kisuchipdiu atonsotna mahthahdiu ahi.
English: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

tcz: Ahinla keiman nehthei aphapen a kavahding nahin, keiman songpia kon a kimu khoijua kavahdiu nahi.
en: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
text:
PSA 81:16
Thadou: Ahinla keiman nehthei aphapen a kavahding nahin, keiman songpia kon a kimu khoijua kavahdiu nahi.
English: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”

tcz: Van a thutan na chunga Elohim Pathen in vai ahomin Van mite chunga athutan na aphondoh e.
en: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
text:
PSA 82:1
Thadou: Van a thutan na chunga Elohim Pathen in vai ahomin Van mite chunga athutan na aphondoh e.
English: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

tcz: Nangman itihchan hi miphalouho napanpia thudihlou ho nachelhah sah dingham?
en: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.
text:
PSA 82:2
Thadou: Nangman itihchan hi miphalouho napanpia thudihlou ho nachelhah sah dingham?
English: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

tcz: “Chaga leh vaichate chungah thudih chepin lang; tahlel tele engbolla umte chungah thudih phongdoh in.
en: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
text:
PSA 82:3
Thadou: “Chaga leh vaichate chungah thudih chepin lang; tahlel tele engbolla umte chungah thudih phongdoh in.
English: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

tcz: Panpi bei tele engbolla umte huhdoh in, miphalouho khut a konin huhdoh-in.
en: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
text:
PSA 82:4
Thadou: Panpi bei tele engbolla umte huhdoh in, miphalouho khut a konin huhdoh-in.
English: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

tcz: Hinla mibolse ten imacha ahepouve; ama hokhu hetna lhasam ahiuve. Muthim noi a avah leuvin, leiset sungil lamgei in ahotling tai.
en: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
text:
PSA 82:5
Thadou: Hinla mibolse ten imacha ahepouve; ama hokhu hetna lhasam ahiuve. Muthim noi a avah leuvin, leiset sungil lamgei in ahotling tai.
English: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

tcz: Keiman kasei in, ‘Nang ho Pathen nahiuve; nangho hatchungnung chilhah te nahiu ve.
en: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
text:
PSA 82:6
Thadou: Keiman kasei in, ‘Nang ho Pathen nahiuve; nangho hatchungnung chilhah te nahiu ve.
English: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

tcz: Hinlah nangho mihem tabang bep a nathi diu, thunei vaihom dang ho banga nalhuh tei diu ahi.’”
en: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
text:
PSA 82:7
Thadou: Hinlah nangho mihem tabang bep a nathi diu, thunei vaihom dang ho banga nalhuh tei diu ahi.’”
English: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”

tcz: Hung kipatin, O Elohim Pathen vannoi leiset hi athu tannin, ajeh chu chiding namdangho jouse jonghi aboncha nanga ahi.
en: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
text:
PSA 82:8
Thadou: Hung kipatin, O Elohim Pathen vannoi leiset hi athu tannin, ajeh chu chiding namdangho jouse jonghi aboncha nanga ahi.
English: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen, thipbeh in umhih'in! Na-ngong in umhih'in. O Pathen Elohim thipsan jeng hih in.
en: God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
text:
PSA 83:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen, thipbeh in umhih'in! Na-ngong in umhih'in. O Pathen Elohim thipsan jeng hih in.
English: God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

tcz: Nagalmite cho leng lung khu najahlou ham? Kiletsah tah nagalmiho ahung kipatdoh khu nahet louham?
en: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
text:
PSA 83:2
Thadou: Nagalmite cho leng lung khu najahlou ham? Kiletsah tah nagalmiho ahung kipatdoh khu nahet louham?
English: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

tcz: Amahon namite douna dingin aguh in thil agong uvin, nangin napanhu mite dounan thilphalou agong uvin ahi.
en: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
text:
PSA 83:3
Thadou: Amahon namite douna dingin aguh in thil agong uvin, nangin napanhu mite dounan thilphalou agong uvin ahi.
English: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

tcz: Amahon aseijun “Hungun hiche nam mite hi sumang uhite akitiuve, chutileh Israel hi isuhmit heldiu ahi” atiuve.
en: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
text:
PSA 83:4
Thadou: Amahon aseijun “Hungun hiche nam mite hi sumang uhite akitiuve, chutileh Israel hi isuhmit heldiu ahi” atiuve.
English: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

tcz: Hiche tohgon ahi amaho akinop to uvin nang dounan kiloikhomna khat anei taove.
en: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.
text:
PSA 83:5
Thadou: Hiche tohgon ahi amaho akinop to uvin nang dounan kiloikhomna khat anei taove.
English: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

tcz: Ama hohi Edom mite, Ishmael mite, Moab mite, Hagrit mite,
en: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

tcz: Gebal mite, Ammon mite, Amelek mite chuleh Philistine leh Tyre akon mipiho ahiuve.
en: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

tcz: Assyria miten jong ajopmun ahin, Lot chilhah hoto jong kiloikhom ahiuve.
en: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.
text:
PSA 83:8
Thadou: Assyria miten jong ajopmun ahin, Lot chilhah hoto jong kiloikhom ahiuve.
English: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

tcz: Amahohi Midian, Sisera, Jabin mite Kishion vadunga nabol bang bangin boljengin.
en: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

tcz: Amaho chu Endor lah nasumang in chuleh atahsa'u monlha chu leiset leipha sosahnan akimang in ahi.
en: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.
text:
PSA 83:10
Thadou: Amaho chu Endor lah nasumang in chuleh atahsa'u monlha chu leiset leipha sosahnan akimang in ahi.
English: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

tcz: Nang in alamkai hochu Oreb le Zoab nabolna bang in sumang in lang chuleh avaipo ho chu Zebah le Zalmunna nabolna bang in thatdoh tan,
en: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
text:
PSA 83:11
Thadou: Nang in alamkai hochu Oreb le Zoab nabolna bang in sumang in lang chuleh avaipo ho chu Zebah le Zalmunna nabolna bang in thatdoh tan,
English: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

tcz: ajeh chu amahon hitin aseijuve, “eihon hiche Elohim Pathen gam hohi eiho phatchom na dingin lahpeh-u hite” akitiuve.
en: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
text:
PSA 83:12
Thadou: ajeh chu amahon hitin aseijuve, “eihon hiche Elohim Pathen gam hohi eiho phatchom na dingin lahpeh-u hite” akitiuve.
English: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

tcz: O Elohim Pathen amahohi huilah a changvai akithejal bangin thejaltan!
en: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.
text:
PSA 83:13
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen amahohi huilah a changvai akithejal bangin thejaltan!
English: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.

tcz: Meijin gammang ahal bang in chuleh meikong in molle lhang ahal lhah bang in hallha jengin,
en: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,
text:
PSA 83:14
Thadou: Meijin gammang ahal bang in chuleh meikong in molle lhang ahal lhah bang in hallha jengin,
English: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

tcz: Huile gon melse tah a adelmang bang in delmang'in, nakhopi huijin kichat sah in,
en: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.
text:
PSA 83:15
Thadou: Huile gon melse tah a adelmang bang in delmang'in, nakhopi huijin kichat sah in,
English: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

tcz: Nasatah in sujumm in O Yahweh Pakai, namin a ahung kipehlut tokah un.
en: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.
text:
PSA 83:16
Thadou: Nasatah in sujumm in O Yahweh Pakai, namin a ahung kipehlut tokah un.
English: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.

tcz: Amaho hi tonsotna jum ding leh kicha jing dingin melsetah'in thisah tan.
en: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

tcz: Hiteng chuleh amahon nangbou hi Hatchungnung leiset chunga thunei chungnung nahi hi hin hetau vinte.
en: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.
text:
PSA 83:18
Thadou: Hiteng chuleh amahon nangbou hi Hatchungnung leiset chunga thunei chungnung nahi hi hin hetau vinte.
English: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung nahou in hi iti kangailut hitam?
en: How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!
text:
PSA 84:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung nahou in hi iti kangailut hitam?
English: How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!

tcz: Hiche a chu iti kaum nom hitam! Yahweh Pakai Hou inn chu kangaicha lheh jenge, kahina apumpin hingjing Elohim Pathen ah kakipana lan sange.
en: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
text:
PSA 84:2
Thadou: Hiche a chu iti kaum nom hitam! Yahweh Pakai Hou inn chu kangaicha lheh jenge, kahina apumpin hingjing Elohim Pathen ah kakipana lan sange.
English: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

tcz: Inva jengin jong abuh akisah in, chuleh pengpalep injong intum akison e. Vo Yahweh Pakai hat chungnung, kalengpa le ka Pathen Elohim! Vachan jong namaicham kom a anou kicholdo nading abuh akisem ahi.
en: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.
text:
PSA 84:3
Thadou: Inva jengin jong abuh akisah in, chuleh pengpalep injong intum akison e. Vo Yahweh Pakai hat chungnung, kalengpa le ka Pathen Elohim! Vachan jong namaicham kom a anou kicholdo nading abuh akisem ahi.
English: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.

tcz: Nahou inn'a chenghon ichangei a hinkho nopna anei'u hitam phat tin in nangma vahchoila asauve.
en: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.
text:
PSA 84:4
Thadou: Nahou inn'a chenghon ichangei a hinkho nopna anei'u hitam phat tin in nangma vahchoila asauve.
English: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

tcz: Athahatna Yahweh Pakai a kon a kimuho hinkho iti nop a hitam, alungsungun Jerusalem'ah akholjing jengun ahi.
en: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
text:
PSA 84:5
Thadou: Athahatna Yahweh Pakai a kon a kimuho hinkho iti nop a hitam, alungsungun Jerusalem'ah akholjing jengun ahi.
English: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

tcz: Beca phaicham ajot tengu jongle, twisam putna twinah tampi umna bangin abol'un, gotwi hunglha masapen in jong twikul tampi ahinsemdoh pehjiuve.
en: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
text:
PSA 84:6
Thadou: Beca phaicham ajot tengu jongle, twisam putna twinah tampi umna bangin abol'un, gotwi hunglha masapen in jong twikul tampi ahinsemdoh pehjiuve.
English: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

tcz: Amaho akalson chan uva ahetbe cheh chehjingdiu ahin, amahon Jerusalem a Yahweh Pakai chu amudiu ahi.
en: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
text:
PSA 84:7
Thadou: Amaho akalson chan uva ahetbe cheh chehjingdiu ahin, amahon Jerusalem a Yahweh Pakai chu amudiu ahi.
English: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, Ka Pathen Elohim hatchungnung kataona neingaipeh'in, O Jacob Elohim Pathen.
en: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
text:
PSA 84:8
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, Ka Pathen Elohim hatchungnung kataona neingaipeh'in, O Jacob Elohim Pathen.
English: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen kalengpauhi phatthei boh'in, amahi kaluum u ahi, nathaonusa nalhen pahi khotona musah jingin.
en: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
text:
PSA 84:9
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen kalengpauhi phatthei boh'in, amahi kaluum u ahi, nathaonusa nalhen pahi khotona musah jingin.
English: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

tcz: Munchom a ni sangkhat umsangin na Houin a nikhat um aphajoi. Miphalou inna chen sangin ka Pathen Elohim inn'a kotngah a pan aphajoi.
en: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
text:
PSA 84:10
Thadou: Munchom a ni sangkhat umsangin na Houin a nikhat um aphajoi. Miphalou inna chen sangin ka Pathen Elohim inn'a kotngah a pan aphajoi.
English: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen hi eiho dia nisa le umpho ahi. Aman khoto nale loupina eipeuvin ahi. Yahweh Pakai in thildih jeng bol mihoa kon in thilpha alamang pon ahi.
en: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
text:
PSA 84:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen hi eiho dia nisa le umpho ahi. Aman khoto nale loupina eipeuvin ahi. Yahweh Pakai in thildih jeng bol mihoa kon in thilpha alamang pon ahi.
English: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung nangma tahsan mihohi iti kipa um a hitam?
en: LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
text:
PSA 84:12
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung nangma tahsan mihohi iti kipa um a hitam?
English: LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin nagamsung'ah phatthei bohna nasunglhan ahi! Hiti chun nangin Israel phatthei naboh'in ahi.
en: LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
text:
PSA 85:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nangin nagamsung'ah phatthei bohna nasunglhan ahi! Hiti chun nangin Israel phatthei naboh'in ahi.
English: LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

tcz: Nangman namite chonsetna nangaidam in hichun achonsetnau jouse nalekhu peh e.
en: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.
text:
PSA 85:2
Thadou: Nangman namite chonsetna nangaidam in hichun achonsetnau jouse nalekhu peh e.
English: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

tcz: Nangin na lunghan na natuh tang'in, nalung hanna deujah jengchu naki kham jie.
en: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.
text:
PSA 85:3
Thadou: Nangin na lunghan na natuh tang'in, nalung hanna deujah jengchu naki kham jie.
English: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

tcz: Ei suhal kit uvin, eihuhhingpau O Pathen Elohim! kachung uva nalunghan na tolmang kittan.
en: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
text:
PSA 85:4
Thadou: Ei suhal kit uvin, eihuhhingpau O Pathen Elohim! kachung uva nalunghan na tolmang kittan.
English: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

tcz: Kachung uva nalunghan jing jeng dingham? Nalung hanna khang jouse chung naumsah jing jengding hitam?
en: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
text:
PSA 85:5
Thadou: Kachung uva nalunghan jing jeng dingham? Nalung hanna khang jouse chung naumsah jing jengding hitam?
English: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

tcz: Nei suhhal kit loudiu hitam? Namite kipa le thanom a aumjing thei nading a.
en: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
text:
PSA 85:6
Thadou: Nei suhhal kit loudiu hitam? Namite kipa le thanom a aumjing thei nading a.
English: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

tcz: Vo Elohim Pathen nami ngailutna longlou chu neimu sah'in nami huhhing najong neipe uvin.
en: Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation.
text:
PSA 85:7
Thadou: Vo Elohim Pathen nami ngailutna longlou chu neimu sah'in nami huhhing najong neipe uvin.
English: Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation.

tcz: Elohim na Pathen chun ipi asei am, chingthei tah'in ngai in ajeh chu Aman mi kitah ho kom ah chamna thu asei e. Ahinla amaho angolna lampi uvah kilekit dahen.
en: I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
text:
PSA 85:8
Thadou: Elohim na Pathen chun ipi asei am, chingthei tah'in ngai in ajeh chu Aman mi kitah ho kom ah chamna thu asei e. Ahinla amaho angolna lampi uvah kilekit dahen.
English: I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

tcz: Tahbeh'in Ama gingte dingin huhing na naicha um a ahi. Chuti leh igamsung u jong aloupina dimding ahi.
en: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
text:
PSA 85:9
Thadou: Tahbeh'in Ama gingte dingin huhing na naicha um a ahi. Chuti leh igamsung u jong aloupina dimding ahi.
English: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

tcz: Ngailutna longlou leh thutah akimuto'in chonphat nale chamna akichopto lhon e.
en: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
text:
PSA 85:10
Thadou: Ngailutna longlou leh thutah akimuto'in chonphat nale chamna akichopto lhon e.
English: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

tcz: Kitah nahi leiset a kon a hungdoh ahi. Chuleh chonphatna chu van'a kon a mai lhaisel'a hung kumlha ahi.
en: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
text:
PSA 85:11
Thadou: Kitah nahi leiset a kon a hungdoh ahi. Chuleh chonphatna chu van'a kon a mai lhaisel'a hung kumlha ahi.
English: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

tcz: Adih'e, Yahweh Pakai in phatthei boh hi ahin lonlhahsah ahin gam leiset a hi ninglhing tah'a ahin gadoh sah'a ikisan ji u ahi.
en: Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
text:
PSA 85:12
