Thadou: Adih'e, Yahweh Pakai in phatthei boh hi ahin lonlhahsah ahin gam leiset a hi ninglhing tah'a ahin gadoh sah'a ikisan ji u ahi.
English: Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

tcz: Chonphat nahin Yahweh Pakai hung nading semtoh nading nikho asap masat ji ahi.
en: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.
text:
PSA 85:13
Thadou: Chonphat nahin Yahweh Pakai hung nading semtoh nading nikho asap masat ji ahi.
English: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai hung kisunem'in lang kataona neingai peh'in, neidonbut in ajeh chu napanpi ngaicha jing kahi.
en: Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
text:
PSA 86:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai hung kisunem'in lang kataona neingai peh'in, neidonbut in ajeh chu napanpi ngaicha jing kahi.
English: Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nanga dinga kiphaldoh jing kahi neihuhdoh'in ajeh chu nangma hi ka Pathen Elohim nahin, keima hi nakinbol kahin chuleh nangma hi katansan jingin ahi.
en: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.
text:
PSA 86:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nanga dinga kiphaldoh jing kahi neihuhdoh'in ajeh chu nangma hi ka Pathen Elohim nahin, keima hi nakinbol kahin chuleh nangma hi katansan jingin ahi.
English: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nami khotona neimusah jingin ajeh chu keiman Nangmahi ka koujing nahi.
en: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
text:
PSA 86:3
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nami khotona neimusah jingin ajeh chu keiman Nangmahi ka koujing nahi.
English: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kipana neimusah jingin ajeh chu keimahi Nangkoma kiphaldoh jing kahi.
en: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
text:
PSA 86:4
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai kipana neimusah jingin ajeh chu keimahi Nangkoma kiphaldoh jing kahi.
English: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma hi naphatna jalla eingaidam jing nahi, nakomma panpi ngaichaho dinga longlou ngailutna dimsah nahi.
en: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
text:
PSA 86:5
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangma hi naphatna jalla eingaidam jing nahi, nakomma panpi ngaichaho dinga longlou ngailutna dimsah nahi.
English: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kataonahi khotonan neingaipeh'in gangtah a kap kahi neingaipehin.
en: Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
text:
PSA 86:6
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai kataonahi khotonan neingaipeh'in gangtah a kap kahi neingaipehin.
English: Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

tcz: Kahahsat channa nangma kakouding ahin nangin neidonbut jingding ahi.
en: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
text:
PSA 86:7
Thadou: Kahahsat channa nangma kakouding ahin nangin neidonbut jingding ahi.
English: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen! Semthu pathen ho nang tobang khatcha aumpoi, nabolthei ho bolthei jong aumpoi.
en: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
text:
PSA 86:8
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen! Semthu pathen ho nang tobang khatcha aumpoi, nabolthei ho bolthei jong aumpoi.
English: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

tcz: Naemsa chitin namtin ho jong na ang a hungdiu chibai naboh cheh diu ahi Yahweh Pakai; amahon na mintheng avahchoi diu ahi.
en: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
text:
PSA 86:9
Thadou: Naemsa chitin namtin ho jong na ang a hungdiu chibai naboh cheh diu ahi Yahweh Pakai; amahon na mintheng avahchoi diu ahi.
English: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma bou Elohim Pathen nahin naloupin, nangin bou thil loupiho naboldoh jin ahi.
en: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
text:
PSA 86:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangma bou Elohim Pathen nahin naloupin, nangin bou thil loupiho naboldoh jin ahi.
English: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, na lampiho neihil in, nathudih dung jui a hinkho kaman theina dingin, nangma loupina kadopsang jingna dingin lungtheng neipen.
en: Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
text:
PSA 86:11
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, na lampiho neihil in, nathudih dung jui a hinkho kaman theina dingin, nangma loupina kadopsang jingna dingin lungtheng neipen.
English: Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

tcz: O Yahweh ka Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen! kalungthim pumpin nangma nathangvah ingkate, phattin'in naloupina domsang jing tange.
en: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
text:
PSA 86:12
Thadou: O Yahweh ka Pakai, Elohim ka Pathen! kalungthim pumpin nangma nathangvah ingkate, phattin'in naloupina domsang jing tange.
English: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.

tcz: Ajeh chu nei ngailut na hi akidange. Nangman thina kulkhuh a kon in nei huhdoh tai
en: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
text:
PSA 86:13
Thadou: Ajeh chu nei ngailut na hi akidange. Nangman thina kulkhuh a kon in nei huhdoh tai
English: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai mijumso hatho keima dounan ahung ding doh un; misunoh phah a pang hon thading eigouve. Amahon nangma hi imachan nagel pouve.
en: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.
text:
PSA 86:14
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai mijumso hatho keima dounan ahung ding doh un; misunoh phah a pang hon thading eigouve. Amahon nangma hi imachan nagel pouve.
English: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

tcz: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai Nangma hi khoto naleh ngailutna nei Elohim Pathen nahin lunghang vahlou chuleh kitahna leh tang theilou lungsetna dim a nahi.
en: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
text:
PSA 86:15
Thadou: Ahinlah Yahweh Pakai Nangma hi khoto naleh ngailutna nei Elohim Pathen nahin lunghang vahlou chuleh kitahna leh tang theilou lungsetna dim a nahi.
English: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

tcz: Nami lungsetna chun noilang hinven lang nasoh hi tha neipen, nasohpa chapa kahi neihuhdoh'in.
en: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
text:
PSA 86:16
Thadou: Nami lungsetna chun noilang hinven lang nasoh hi tha neipen, nasohpa chapa kahi neihuhdoh'in.
English: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.

tcz: Nei hepina melchih na chu hin tahlang'in chutileh eivetda hohin jumna amudiu ahi. O Yahweh Pakai neipanpin nei lungmonsah jingin.
en: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.
text:
PSA 86:17
Thadou: Nei hepina melchih na chu hin tahlang'in chutileh eivetda hohin jumna amudiu ahi. O Yahweh Pakai neipanpin nei lungmonsah jingin.
English: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.

tcz: Moltheng chunga chun Yahweh Pakai tundohsa khopi chu aum e.
en: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
text:
PSA 87:1
Thadou: Moltheng chunga chun Yahweh Pakai tundohsa khopi chu aum e.
English: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

tcz: Aman Jerusalem khopi hi Israel khopi dangho sangin angailu joi.
en: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
text:
PSA 87:2
Thadou: Aman Jerusalem khopi hi Israel khopi dangho sangin angailu joi.
English: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen khopi, nangma chungchang ahi itibang thuloupi tahtah kisei a hitam!
en: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.
text:
PSA 87:3
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen khopi, nangma chungchang ahi itibang thuloupi tahtah kisei a hitam!
English: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

tcz: Keima eiheho lah'a hin, Egypt le Babylon chule Philistine leh Tyre chuleh gamlha tah Ethiopia jong kasimtha e. Amaho hi Jerusalem khomite ahitaove.
en: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”
text:
PSA 87:4
Thadou: Keima eiheho lah'a hin, Egypt le Babylon chule Philistine leh Tyre chuleh gamlha tah Ethiopia jong kasimtha e. Amaho hi Jerusalem khomite ahitaove.
English: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”

tcz: Jerusalem chungchang a hitiahi kisei ding ahi, “amijousen nammi hina a thaneina chu akipapi cheh uve”, chule hatchungnung ama tah in khopi chu phatthei aboh ding ahi.
en: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.
text:
PSA 87:5
Thadou: Jerusalem chungchang a hitiahi kisei ding ahi, “amijousen nammi hina a thaneina chu akipapi cheh uve”, chule hatchungnung ama tah in khopi chu phatthei aboh ding ahi.
English: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in chitin namtin hi ajihlut teng, aseiding, “amaho jouse hi Jerusalem khomite ahitaove” atiding ahi.
en: The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
text:
PSA 87:6
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in chitin namtin hi ajihlut teng, aseiding, “amaho jouse hi Jerusalem khomite ahitaove” atiding ahi.
English: The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

tcz: Mipi hochun theile amut'uva la asahdiu, “Kahinkho hung kipat nahi Jerusalem ahi” atidiu ahi.
en: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
text:
PSA 87:7
Thadou: Mipi hochun theile amut'uva la asahdiu, “Kahinkho hung kipat nahi Jerusalem ahi” atidiu ahi.
English: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, eihuhhing'a ka Pathen Elohim, sunleh nangma kakou in, jan leh nakom kahin nailut ji e.
en: LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
text:
PSA 88:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, eihuhhing'a ka Pathen Elohim, sunleh nangma kakou in, jan leh nakom kahin nailut ji e.
English: LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

tcz: Tun kakouna neijah peh'in lang katona neisan peh'in.
en: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
text:
PSA 88:2
Thadou: Tun kakouna neijah peh'in lang katona neisan peh'in.
English: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

tcz: Ajeh chu kahin khohi boina adim in, thinan eikainai chehcheh e.
en: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
text:
PSA 88:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu kahin khohi boina adim in, thinan eikainai chehcheh e.
English: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

tcz: Athisa bang bep kahitai, mithahat tah khat athahat na bei nungsang bep kahitai.
en: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,
text:
PSA 88:4
Thadou: Athisa bang bep kahitai, mithahat tah khat athahat na bei nungsang bep kahitai.
English: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

tcz: Amahon mithi lah'a eidalha uvin lhan ah mithi lup'in kalum e. Keima hi suhmil in kaum tai, nami kaihoina a kon in eiki lamang tai.
en: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.
text:
PSA 88:5
Thadou: Amahon mithi lah'a eidalha uvin lhan ah mithi lup'in kalum e. Keima hi suhmil in kaum tai, nami kaihoina a kon in eiki lamang tai.
English: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

tcz: Nang in kotong noinung pen athim pen ah neison lha e.
en: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
text:
PSA 88:6
Thadou: Nang in kotong noinung pen athim pen ah neison lha e.
English: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

tcz: Nalung han na gihtah chun eidelphan, hichu twi kinong bangin akinong'in eichup tai.
en: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.
text:
PSA 88:7
Thadou: Nalung han na gihtah chun eidelphan, hichu twi kinong bangin akinong'in eichup tai.
English: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

tcz: Keima hi doumah in neisem in kagol kapai ho neidelmang peh gamtai. Keima hi thang'ah ka-oh in kitoldoh theilouvin kaum e.
en: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
text:
PSA 88:8
Thadou: Keima hi doumah in neisem in kagol kapai ho neidelmang peh gamtai. Keima hi thang'ah ka-oh in kitoldoh theilouvin kaum e.
English: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

tcz: Kamit lhin kamit achupmin kho muthei louvin kaum e. O Yahweh Pakai niseh'in na panpina kathum in nami lungsetna ngaichan kakhut teni kahin sange.
en: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.
text:
PSA 88:9
Thadou: Kamit lhin kamit achupmin kho muthei louvin kaum e. O Yahweh Pakai niseh'in na panpina kathum in nami lungsetna ngaichan kakhut teni kahin sange.
English: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.

tcz: Nathil kidang bol hohi mithi dinga phachom ding hinam? Mithi hungthodoh a nathangvah theiding hinam?
en: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.
text:
PSA 88:10
Thadou: Nathil kidang bol hohi mithi dinga phachom ding hinam? Mithi hungthodoh a nathangvah theiding hinam?
English: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

tcz: Lhankhuh a kon in amahon nami ngailutna longlou hi ahin phongdoh theina diuvem? Suhmangna mun'a umhon nakitah nahi aphongdoh theina diuvem?
en: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
text:
PSA 88:11
Thadou: Lhankhuh a kon in amahon nami ngailutna longlou hi ahin phongdoh theina diuvem? Suhmangna mun'a umhon nakitah nahi aphongdoh theina diuvem?
English: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

tcz: Muthim'in nathilbol kidang hohi aseiphong nadiuvem? Thil suhmil delna gama umhon na chonphat na hochu aseiphong theina diuvem?
en: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
text:
PSA 88:12
Thadou: Muthim'in nathilbol kidang hohi aseiphong nadiuvem? Thil suhmil delna gama umhon na chonphat na hochu aseiphong theina diuvem?
English: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma kakouve, niseh-a nakom a katao jingding ahi.
en: But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
text:
PSA 88:13
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangma kakouve, niseh-a nakom a katao jingding ahi.
English: But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, ibolla kei nei paidoh hitam? Ibol a kei a kon a naki heimang hitam?
en: LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
text:
PSA 88:14
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, ibolla kei nei paidoh hitam? Ibol a kei a kon a naki heimang hitam?
English: LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

tcz: Kakhang don lai a pat a, kanatna hin thina komcha eina lhutsa ahitan, nagim neina masanga hin thabei leh lungkham tah'in kading e.
en: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
text:
PSA 88:15
Thadou: Kakhang don lai a pat a, kanatna hin thina komcha eina lhutsa ahitan, nagim neina masanga hin thabei leh lungkham tah'in kading e.
English: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

tcz: Nalunghan na tijat umtah chun eilonvuh'in, tijat naumna chun eithabei sah e.
en: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
text:
PSA 88:16
Thadou: Nalunghan na tijat umtah chun eilonvuh'in, tijat naumna chun eithabei sah e.
English: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

tcz: Hiche hochun sun nilhum in twisoh bangin kavel a eilon khum un ahi. Muthimhi kakinai pipen kagol in apang un ahi.
en: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.
text:
PSA 88:17
Thadou: Hiche hochun sun nilhum in twisoh bangin kavel a eilon khum un ahi. Muthimhi kakinai pipen kagol in apang un ahi.
English: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

tcz: Nang man ka mite le ka ngailut cheng neilahpeh tai, Thimjing hi kaki naipi pen ka loi chu ahi tai.
en: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
text:
PSA 88:18
Thadou: Nang man ka mite le ka ngailut cheng neilahpeh tai, Thimjing hi kaki naipi pen ka loi chu ahi tai.
English: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai mingailutna longlou thuhi vahchoilan sajing tange, khangdong hole tehse hon nakitahna hi ajauvin ahi.
en: I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
text:
PSA 89:1
Thadou: Keiman Yahweh Pakai mingailutna longlou thuhi vahchoilan sajing tange, khangdong hole tehse hon nakitahna hi ajauvin ahi.
English: I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

tcz: Nami ngailutna longlou hi itih hijongleh umjing ding ahi. Nakitah nahi vanho bangin aumjinge.
en: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
text:
PSA 89:2
Thadou: Nami ngailutna longlou hi itih hijongleh umjing ding ahi. Nakitah nahi vanho bangin aumjinge.
English: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in hitin asei e “kalhendoh kasohpa David toh kitepna kanabol ahi. Hiche kitepna a hi kana kihahsel ahi.
en: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
text:
PSA 89:3
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in hitin asei e “kalhendoh kasohpa David toh kitepna kanabol ahi. Hiche kitepna a hi kana kihahsel ahi.
English: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

tcz: Keiman nachilhahte chu lenga katun jingding ahi. Amaho nalaltouna a chu tuapat tonsot gei a toujingdiu ahi.”
en: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.
text:
PSA 89:4
Thadou: Keiman nachilhahte chu lenga katun jingding ahi. Amaho nalaltouna a chu tuapat tonsot gei a toujingdiu ahi.”
English: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai van mite jousen nakidan nahohi navahchoi diu ahi. Nakitahna ho jeh'a hi simjoulou vantilten navahchoi diu ahi.
en: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
text:
PSA 89:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai van mite jousen nakidan nahohi navahchoi diu ahi. Nakitahna ho jeh'a hi simjoulou vantilten navahchoi diu ahi.
English: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

tcz: Ajeh chu van gam a umho jouse koipen tah hi Yahweh Pakai toh tekah thei umbeh am? Vantil thupipen ho jengjong Yahweh Pakai toh tekah pithei um'am?
en: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,
text:
PSA 89:6
Thadou: Ajeh chu van gam a umho jouse koipen tah hi Yahweh Pakai toh tekah thei umbeh am? Vantil thupipen ho jengjong Yahweh Pakai toh tekah pithei um'am?
English: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,

tcz: Vantil thaneipen hojong Elohim Pathen ang'a kithing thinga ahibouve. Amahi alaltouna vel a dingho jousen jong agimnei na aphapouve.
en: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
text:
PSA 89:7
Thadou: Vantil thaneipen hojong Elohim Pathen ang'a kithing thinga ahibouve. Amahi alaltouna vel a dingho jousen jong agimnei na aphapouve.
English: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung sepai ho! Hoilai mun a nang tobanga thanei a umbeh am Yahweh Pakai? Nanghi kitahna lhingset nahi.
en: LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.
text:
PSA 89:8
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung sepai ho! Hoilai mun a nang tobanga thanei a umbeh am Yahweh Pakai? Nanghi kitahna lhingset nahi.
English: LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.

tcz: Twikhanglen jong nathanei na noia umma ahi. Nangin huipi le twipi kithoa twi kinong jong nasutang'in,
en: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
text:
PSA 89:9
Thadou: Twikhanglen jong nathanei na noia umma ahi. Nangin huipi le twipi kithoa twi kinong jong nasutang'in,
English: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

tcz: twikhanglen'a um sa lenpen hojong na sugep in, Naban thahat in nagal mite jong nahocheh jitai.
en: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
text:
PSA 89:10
Thadou: twikhanglen'a um sa lenpen hojong na sugep in, Naban thahat in nagal mite jong nahocheh jitai.
English: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

tcz: Vanho jouse jong nanga ahin, leiset jong nanga ahi, vannoi a um thiljouse jong aboncha nanga ahin nangin nasem ahi.
en: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
text:
PSA 89:11
Thadou: Vanho jouse jong nanga ahin, leiset jong nanga ahi, vannoi a um thiljouse jong aboncha nanga ahin nangin nasem ahi.
English: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

tcz: Nangin sahlang lhanglang jong nasem ahin, Tabor Mol leh Hermon mol'in jong naming athangvah ahi.
en: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
text:
PSA 89:12
Thadou: Nangin sahlang lhanglang jong nasem ahin, Tabor Mol leh Hermon mol'in jong naming athangvah ahi.
English: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

tcz: Nabantha hi iti hat hitam! Nakhut hi iti hat hitam! Najetlang jonghi nathahat loupitah'in adomsange.
en: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
text:
PSA 89:13
Thadou: Nabantha hi iti hat hitam! Nakhut hi iti hat hitam! Najetlang jonghi nathahat loupitah'in adomsange.
English: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

tcz: Chonphat nale thudih chu nalaltouna khombul ahi. Longlou ngailutna le kitahna chu nalhachate bangin na ang sungah avahlen ahi.
en: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
text:
PSA 89:14
Thadou: Chonphat nale thudih chu nalaltouna khombul ahi. Longlou ngailutna le kitahna chu nalhachate bangin na ang sungah avahlen ahi.
English: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

tcz: Elohim Pathen houna dinga kipa umtah kouna jaho chu anunnom ahiuve, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai amahohi na umpina vah a chu lhalediu ahi.
en: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.
text:
PSA 89:15
Thadou: Elohim Pathen houna dinga kipa umtah kouna jaho chu anunnom ahiuve, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai amahohi na umpina vah a chu lhalediu ahi.
English: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.

tcz: Naminthan na kidangtah hohi amahon nilhum kei keija akipapi diu ahi. Amahon nachon phatna hi akithang atpiu vin ahi.
en: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
text:
PSA 89:16
Thadou: Naminthan na kidangtah hohi amahon nilhum kei keija akipapi diu ahi. Amahon nachon phatna hi akithang atpiu vin ahi.
English: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

tcz: Nangma hi amaho dinga thahatna loupitah chu nahi. Keiho thahat sah dinghi nangma kipana ahi.
en: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
text:
PSA 89:17
Thadou: Nangma hi amaho dinga thahatna loupitah chu nahi. Keiho thahat sah dinghi nangma kipana ahi.
English: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

tcz: Ahi, keiho hoidohna hi Yahweh Pakai a kon ahi. Chuleh Israel Elohim Pathen hin lengjong eipeh u ahi.
en: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.
text:
PSA 89:18
Thadou: Ahi, keiho hoidohna hi Yahweh Pakai a kon ahi. Chuleh Israel Elohim Pathen hin lengjong eipeh u ahi.
English: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

tcz: Masang lai in kitah tah a nangma jui namipite lah-a gaothu nana seijin ahi. Nangin nasei in, Keiman galsat ding kanalhengdoh'in keiman milhamho lah a kona lengding jong kanalhendoh ahi.
en: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
text:
PSA 89:19
Thadou: Masang lai in kitah tah a nangma jui namipite lah-a gaothu nana seijin ahi. Nangin nasei in, Keiman galsat ding kanalhengdoh'in keiman milhamho lah a kona lengding jong kanalhendoh ahi.
English: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

tcz: Keiman kasoh David kana mudoh'in chuleh kathaotheng kana nun ahi.
en: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
text:
PSA 89:20
Thadou: Keiman kasoh David kana mudoh'in chuleh kathaotheng kana nun ahi.
English: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

tcz: Keiman kakhut a kana dindoh sah a, kaban thahatna kahatdoh sahding ahi.
en: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
text:
PSA 89:21
Thadou: Keiman kakhut a kana dindoh sah a, kaban thahatna kahatdoh sahding ahi.
English: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

tcz: Agal miten ajoloudiu ahilouleh miphalou honjong athajou loudiu ahi.
en: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
text:
PSA 89:22
Thadou: Agal miten ajoloudiu ahilouleh miphalou honjong athajou loudiu ahi.
English: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

tcz: Keiman akidoupi hohi amasang tah a kasuhlhuh ding ahin chuleh ama douho jouse jong kasuhmang ding ahi.
en: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
text:
PSA 89:23
Thadou: Keiman akidoupi hohi amasang tah a kasuhlhuh ding ahin chuleh ama douho jouse jong kasuhmang ding ahi.
English: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

tcz: Kakitahna leh kangailutna longlou hin aumpi jingding kathuneina jalla amahi atha kahatsah jingding ahi.
en: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
text:
PSA 89:24
Thadou: Kakitahna leh kangailutna longlou hin aumpi jingding kathuneina jalla amahi atha kahatsah jingding ahi.
English: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

tcz: Keiman twikhanglen chunga jong athaneina kalhunlut ding vadungho chung jenga jong vai ahomding ahi.
en: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
text:
PSA 89:25
Thadou: Keiman twikhanglen chunga jong athaneina kalhunlut ding vadungho chung jenga jong vai ahomding ahi.
English: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

tcz: Chutengleh aman eihin kou intin, “Nangma kapa nahin ka Pathen Elohim, kasongpi le kasochatna nahi” atiding ahi.
en: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
text:
PSA 89:26
Thadou: Chutengleh aman eihin kou intin, “Nangma kapa nahin ka Pathen Elohim, kasongpi le kasochatna nahi” atiding ahi.
English: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

tcz: Keiman Amahi kachapa masapen, leiset chunga leng thaneipen kahisah ding,
en: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
text:
PSA 89:27
Thadou: Keiman Amahi kachapa masapen, leiset chunga leng thaneipen kahisah ding,
English: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

tcz: Kangailut ding chuleh tonsot gei a kakhoto ding, amatoh kaki tepna hi angahtih umlouding ahi.
en: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
text:
PSA 89:28
Thadou: Kangailut ding chuleh tonsot gei a kakhoto ding, amatoh kaki tepna hi angahtih umlouding ahi.
English: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

tcz: Keiman ama dinga ason apah ho kahoibit pehding, vangam'a nikhon beitih aneilou banga alaltounan jong beitih aneilouding ahi.
en: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
text:
PSA 89:29
Thadou: Keiman ama dinga ason apah ho kahoibit pehding, vangam'a nikhon beitih aneilou banga alaltounan jong beitih aneilouding ahi.
English: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

tcz: Ahinlah achilhahten kathuhil hohi apaidoh uva, kachedan hi ajuilou uva,
en: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

tcz: ka Dan semhohi anit lou uva chuleh kathupeh hi angailou uleh,
en: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

tcz: keiman achonsetnao chunga gambol na mol kalap ding, chuleh athungailou naojeh-a kavoh diu ahi.
en: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
text:
PSA 89:32
Thadou: keiman achonsetnao chunga gambol na mol kalap ding, chuleh athungailou naojeh-a kavoh diu ahi.
English: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

tcz: Hijeng jongle kangailutna chu beideh louding kakitepna jong achunga kasuhmil deh louding ahi.
en: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
text:
PSA 89:33
Thadou: Hijeng jongle kangailutna chu beideh louding kakitepna jong achunga kasuhmil deh louding ahi.
English: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

tcz: Ahipoi, kakitepna chu kasuhkeh louding ahi; keiman kana seidoh saho chu changkhat jong kanung lahdoh louding ahi.
en: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
text:
PSA 89:34
Thadou: Ahipoi, kakitepna chu kasuhkeh louding ahi; keiman kana seidoh saho chu changkhat jong kanung lahdoh louding ahi.
English: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

tcz: Keiman David kommah kihahselna khat kana nei in chule atheng kahi jeh in jou seiponge.
en: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
text:
PSA 89:35
Thadou: Keiman David kommah kihahselna khat kana nei in chule atheng kahi jeh in jou seiponge.
English: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

tcz: Ama chilhahte itihchan hijongleh chelha jingding alenggam jong nisa banga chelhumding ahi.
en: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
text:
PSA 89:36
Thadou: Ama chilhahte itihchan hijongleh chelha jingding alenggam jong nisa banga chelhumding ahi.
English: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

tcz: Vantham jolla kahettohsah nachu lhavah banga kikheltih aneitah louding ahi.
en: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
text:
PSA 89:37
Thadou: Vantham jolla kahettohsah nachu lhavah banga kikheltih aneitah louding ahi.
English: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.

tcz: Ahinlah nangin tuhin amachu nakahdoh tan chuleh napaidoh tai. Tuhin Nangma nathaonu lengpa chungah nalunghang tan,
en: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
text:
PSA 89:38
Thadou: Ahinlah nangin tuhin amachu nakahdoh tan chuleh napaidoh tai. Tuhin Nangma nathaonu lengpa chungah nalunghang tan,
English: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

tcz: nangin Ama toh nakitepna napaidohtan, nangin alal lukhuh jong vutvai lah-a nasep lhatai.
en: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
text:
PSA 89:39
Thadou: nangin Ama toh nakitepna napaidohtan, nangin alal lukhuh jong vutvai lah-a nasep lhatai.
English: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

tcz: Nangin akhopiu bangho navohlhah pehtan chuleh akulpiu jong khogem nasodohsah ahitai.
en: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
text:
PSA 89:40
Thadou: Nangin akhopiu bangho navohlhah pehtan chuleh akulpiu jong khogem nasodohsah ahitai.
English: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

tcz: Koi hileh ahin hopa jousen athilkeu u akichomgam hellun aheng akomho jousen anuisat'un ahi.
en: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
text:
PSA 89:41
Thadou: Koi hileh ahin hopa jousen athilkeu u akichomgam hellun aheng akomho jousen anuisat'un ahi.
English: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

tcz: Nangin agal miteu galjona namusahin, abonchauvin nakipasah'in ahi.
en: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
text:
PSA 89:42
Thadou: Nangin agal miteu galjona namusahin, abonchauvin nakipasah'in ahi.
English: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

tcz: Nangin agal manchah u manmo naso'in chuleh galmunnah gal nalelsah'in ahi.
en: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
text:
PSA 89:43
Thadou: Nangin agal manchah u manmo naso'in chuleh galmunnah gal nalelsah'in ahi.
English: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

tcz: Nangin aleng tenggol nalahpehin chuleh alaltouna tolsenan naneipeh in ahi.
en: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
text:
PSA 89:44
Thadou: Nangin aleng tenggol nalahpehin chuleh alaltouna tolsenan naneipeh in ahi.
English: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

tcz: Nangin aphat achang louvin natehset sah'in chuleh jumthet in nalhan ahi.
en: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
text:
PSA 89:45
Thadou: Nangin aphat achang louvin natehset sah'in chuleh jumthet in nalhan ahi.
English: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangma hi hitiahi kisel jing jingding nahi hitam? Ichangei nalunghanna meikong jing jeng dingham?
en: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
text:
PSA 89:46
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nangma hi hitiahi kisel jing jingding nahi hitam? Ichangei nalunghanna meikong jing jeng dingham?
English: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

tcz: Kahinkho hi itihchom a hitam geldoh'in, keihohi thitei dinga neisem'u ahi ti geldoh'in!
en: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
text:
PSA 89:47
Thadou: Kahinkho hi itihchom a hitam geldoh'in, keihohi thitei dinga neisem'u ahi ti geldoh'in!
English: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

tcz: Mihing koihi athi theilou ding um'am? Mihem koipen ham lhan a kon a ahoidohthei dingah?
en: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
text:
PSA 89:48
Thadou: Mihing koihi athi theilou ding um'am? Mihem koipen ham lhan a kon a ahoidohthei dingah?
English: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai tumasanga neingailutnau chu ahet theina mudohthei ipi umam? David komma nakitepna hohi hoilang geija hitam?
en: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
text:
PSA 89:49
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai tumasanga neingailutnau chu ahet theina mudohthei ipi umam? David komma nakitepna hohi hoilang geija hitam?
English: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

tcz: Nasohpa keimahi ichan gei a jumna kato hitam? Hiche nangma hedohlou mitehin eisapsetnau ichan gei a kathoh hitam?
en: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
text:
PSA 89:50
Thadou: Nasohpa keimahi ichan gei a jumna kato hitam? Hiche nangma hedohlou mitehin eisapsetnau ichan gei a kathoh hitam?
English: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nadeilhen nalengpa hi nangma dou miten nahsah loutah'in abollun ahi! Achena chan a asujum un ahi.
en: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
text:
PSA 89:51
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nadeilhen nalengpa hi nangma dou miten nahsah loutah'in abollun ahi! Achena chan a asujum un ahi.
English: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umjing jenghen! Amen, Amen!
en: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.
text:
PSA 89:52
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah in umjing jenghen! Amen, Amen!
English: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, akhang khanga nangmahi kachennao inn nahijenge!
en: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
text:
PSA 90:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai, akhang khanga nangmahi kachennao inn nahijenge!
English: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

tcz: Moul le lhang ho pen masang, vannoi le leiset hi natundoh masangin, thiljoue kipat a pat ajo na chen in jong, nang ma Elohim Pathen nahijing e.
en: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
text:
PSA 90:2
Thadou: Moul le lhang ho pen masang, vannoi le leiset hi natundoh masangin, thiljoue kipat a pat ajo na chen in jong, nang ma Elohim Pathen nahijing e.
English: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

tcz: Nangin mihemhi anahina masa-a kile kitding'in nasollin leivui nalesosah kitjin ahi.
en: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
text:
PSA 90:3
Thadou: Nangin mihemhi anahina masa-a kile kitding'in nasollin leivui nalesosah kitjin ahi.
English: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”

tcz: Nangdin Kum sangkhat jeng jonghi achejing tunikho bangbep ahin, jan phat chomcha tobang bou ahi.
en: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
text:
PSA 90:4
Thadou: Nangdin Kum sangkhat jeng jonghi achejing tunikho bangbep ahin, jan phat chomcha tobang bou ahi.
English: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

tcz: Nangin twisoh bangin neilhohmang jiuvin mang sangin asot jodeh poi. Keihohi hampa jingkah langa hung pahdoh tobang bou kahiuve.
en: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
text:
PSA 90:5
Thadou: Nangin twisoh bangin neilhohmang jiuvin mang sangin asot jodeh poi. Keihohi hampa jingkah langa hung pahdoh tobang bou kahiuve.
English: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

tcz: Hichu akhangdoh loijin ahinla nilhah langle agop lhajin athijitai.
en: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
text:
PSA 90:6
Thadou: Hichu akhangdoh loijin ahinla nilhah langle agop lhajin athijitai.
English: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

tcz: Keihohi nangma lunghan nan eisumang jitauvin chuleh nalung satnan eikichatsah'un ahi.
en: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
text:
PSA 90:7
Thadou: Keihohi nangma lunghan nan eisumang jitauvin chuleh nalung satnan eikichatsah'un ahi.
English: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

tcz: Nangin kachonsetnao namasangah natahlang jin ahi, aguh a kachonset nauhi nakilandoh sahjin ahi.
en: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
text:
PSA 90:8
Thadou: Nangin kachonsetnao namasangah natahlang jin ahi, aguh a kachonset nauhi nakilandoh sahjin ahi.
English: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

tcz: Nalungsat na noi a higjing kahinkhou ahin, kakumkhou jong lungsat nan abeiloi jitai.
en: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
text:
PSA 90:9
Thadou: Nalungsat na noi a higjing kahinkhou ahin, kakumkhou jong lungsat nan abeiloi jitai.
English: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

tcz: Kei hohi kum 70 hingding bep kahiuvin, kahat tah'uleh kum 80 bep hingding kahiuve, ahinla hiche sunga chun natna le boina bou ahin; amang loiji taovin, chule keiho kaleng mang taove.
en: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
text:
PSA 90:10
Thadou: Kei hohi kum 70 hingding bep kahiuvin, kahat tah'uleh kum 80 bep hingding kahiuve, ahinla hiche sunga chun natna le boina bou ahin; amang loiji taovin, chule keiho kaleng mang taove.
English: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

tcz: Nalunghanna thahat koiham ahe thei dingah? Naging a nalungsat khohje gelkhoh a koi ham?
en: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
text:
PSA 90:11
Thadou: Nalunghanna thahat koiham ahe thei dingah? Naging a nalungsat khohje gelkhoh a koi ham?
English: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

tcz: Kachih theina diuvin kahinkhou chomdan hi neihetsah taovin.
en: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
text:
PSA 90:12
Thadou: Kachih theina diuvin kahinkhou chomdan hi neihetsah taovin.
English: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, kaheng lam uva hung kile kit tan! Itihchan neikho ngai diu hitam?
en: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
text:
PSA 90:13
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, kaheng lam uva hung kile kit tan! Itihchan neikho ngai diu hitam?
English: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

tcz: Jingkah seh le nalungset longlou chun kalungthim kipasah in, chutile kahinkhou lhumkei a navah choi la kasha jing diu ahi.
en: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
text:
PSA 90:14
Thadou: Jingkah seh le nalungset longlou chun kalungthim kipasah in, chutile kahinkhou lhumkei a navah choi la kasha jing diu ahi.
English: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

tcz: Hesoh genthei kana thoh hou chuga kon in lunglhai na themkhat beh nei peu vin! Kakhoisat nao kumho jong kipana neisoh doh peh un.
en: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
text:
PSA 90:15
Thadou: Hesoh genthei kana thoh hou chuga kon in lunglhai na themkhat beh nei peu vin! Kakhoisat nao kumho jong kipana neisoh doh peh un.
English: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

tcz: Nasohte hi nathilbol kidangtah hochu neimusah'un; kachilhah teuvin nathaneina loupitah chu mu uhen.
en: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.
text:
PSA 90:16
Thadou: Nasohte hi nathilbol kidangtah hochu neimusah'un; kachilhah teuvin nathaneina loupitah chu mu uhen.
English: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.

tcz: Chuteng Yahweh Pakai ka Pathen Elohim un namalsom nauchu eimu sah uhen lang katohna jouseuvah lolhinna eipetao hen. Henge, katoh gao neiso peh un.
en: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
text:
PSA 90:17
Thadou: Chuteng Yahweh Pakai ka Pathen Elohim un namalsom nauchu eimu sah uhen lang katohna jouseuvah lolhinna eipetao hen. Henge, katoh gao neiso peh un.
English: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.

tcz: Chungnungpen cholngah na noi a um chan chun hatchungnung lhalim noi a choldo na amu ding ahi.
en: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
text:
PSA 91:1
Thadou: Chungnungpen cholngah na noi a um chan chun hatchungnung lhalim noi a choldo na amu ding ahi.
English: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chungchang a hiche hi kaphong e: Ama bou eivengbit ahin, kahoidam na mun ahi; Amachu ka Pathen Elohim ahin, keiman ama katah san e.
en: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
text:
PSA 91:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chungchang a hiche hi kaphong e: Ama bou eivengbit ahin, kahoidam na mun ahi; Amachu ka Pathen Elohim ahin, keiman ama katah san e.
English: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

tcz: Ajeh chu aman thangkol jouse a kon in nahuh doh intin thinathei hivei hoa kon a nahuhdohding ahi.
en: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
text:
PSA 91:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu aman thangkol jouse a kon in nahuh doh intin thinathei hivei hoa kon a nahuhdohding ahi.
English: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

tcz: Aman alhavinga nale khu ding ahi. A lhalim noi a nahoidoh ding ahi. Kitah tah a akihahsel naho chu nading a galvon le ompho ahi.
en: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
text:
PSA 91:4
Thadou: Aman alhavinga nale khu ding ahi. A lhalim noi a nahoidoh ding ahi. Kitah tah a akihahsel naho chu nading a galvon le ompho ahi.
English: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

tcz: Jan a misu lung linglao ho kichat dan, sun lai a thalchang leng le ho jong kichat dan.
en: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,
text:
PSA 91:5
Thadou: Jan a misu lung linglao ho kichat dan, sun lai a thalchang leng le ho jong kichat dan.
English: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,

tcz: Jan noi a donthah nantna hivei gimnei tah ho kichat dan, sun lai a nadelkhum hesoh na jong kicha hih in.
en: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
text:
PSA 91:6
Thadou: Jan noi a donthah nantna hivei gimnei tah ho kichat dan, sun lai a nadelkhum hesoh na jong kicha hih in.
English: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

tcz: Nasih langa sangkhat lhu henlang, navel a sangsom thijongle, hiche boina hon nangma natoh khah lou ding ahi.
en: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
text:
PSA 91:7
Thadou: Nasih langa sangkhat lhu henlang, navel a sangsom thijongle, hiche boina hon nangma natoh khah lou ding ahi.
English: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

tcz: Namit hah in lang vejeng in, itilom a migilou te chung a got na lhung hitam?
en: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
text:
PSA 91:8
Thadou: Namit hah in lang vejeng in, itilom a migilou te chung a got na lhung hitam?
English: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

tcz: Nangin Yahweh Pakai chu napanpi ding a nakisem le, Yahweh Pakai chu nahuhdoh ding a nakigon ahi le,
en: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
text:
PSA 91:9
Thadou: Nangin Yahweh Pakai chu napanpi ding a nakisem le, Yahweh Pakai chu nahuhdoh ding a nakigon ahi le,
English: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

tcz: Setna imachan najo lou ding ahi; natna hivei khatchan jong na inn ahinphah louding ahi.
en: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
text:
PSA 91:10
Thadou: Setna imachan najo lou ding ahi; natna hivei khatchan jong na inn ahinphah louding ahi.
English: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

tcz: Chuteng le Elohim Pathen in navale nachan a navengbit din avantilte thu pen tai.
en: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
text:
PSA 91:11
Thadou: Chuteng le Elohim Pathen in navale nachan a navengbit din avantilte thu pen tai.
English: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

tcz: Nakeng chu songa nakisuhkhah louna dinga vantilten akhut uva nadopdiu ahi.
en: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
text:
PSA 91:12
Thadou: Nakeng chu songa nakisuhkhah louna dinga vantilten akhut uva nadopdiu ahi.
English: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

tcz: Nangin keipi bahkai ho nasuh goi a; gul hang ho chuleh gunei gul ho nalhonat gamding ahi.
en: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
text:
PSA 91:13
Thadou: Nangin keipi bahkai ho nasuh goi a; gul hang ho chuleh gunei gul ho nalhonat gamding ahi.
English: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in hitin ati, “keima eingailu ho kahuh hing ding ahi. Kamin a tahsan na nei ho chu kahoi dam ding ahi.
en: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
text:
PSA 91:14
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in hitin ati, “keima eingailu ho kahuh hing ding ahi. Kamin a tahsan na nei ho chu kahoi dam ding ahi.
English: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

tcz: Amahon eihin kouteng uleh keiman kadonbut ding chuleh hahsatna ato tengu leh keiman kaumpi ding ahi, keiman amaho chu kahuhdoh a jabolna kachan sah ding ahi.
en: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
text:
PSA 91:15
Thadou: Amahon eihin kouteng uleh keiman kadonbut ding chuleh hahsatna ato tengu leh keiman kaumpi ding ahi, keiman amaho chu kahuhdoh a jabolna kachan sah ding ahi.
English: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

tcz: Keiman hinkho sotna kapehding chuleh kavenbit jingdiu ahi” ati.
en: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
text:
PSA 91:16
Thadou: Keiman hinkho sotna kapehding chuleh kavenbit jingdiu ahi” ati.
English: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”

tcz: Thangvah na Yahweh Pakai peh a, chung nungpen vah choi ding hi thil pha ahi.
en: It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
text:
PSA 92:1
Thadou: Thangvah na Yahweh Pakai peh a, chung nungpen vah choi ding hi thil pha ahi.
English: It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,

tcz: Jingkah le nami ngailut na longlou sap phong a, nilhah le nakitah na sap phong hi thil pha ahi.
en: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
text:
PSA 92:2
Thadou: Jingkah le nami ngailut na longlou sap phong a, nilhah le nakitah na sap phong hi thil pha ahi.
English: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

tcz: Tumging jangsom to tho a lyre gin ngai tah to tho dia pha tah ahi.
en: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
text:
PSA 92:3
Thadou: Tumging jangsom to tho a lyre gin ngai tah to tho dia pha tah ahi.
English: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nei bol peh thil loupitah hochun kalung lai atong kha in, natohdoh ho jehchun keiman kipa la kasan ahi.
en: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
text:
PSA 92:4
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nei bol peh thil loupitah hochun kalung lai atong kha in, natohdoh ho jehchun keiman kipa la kasan ahi.
English: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nanatohdoh hohi iti loupi hitam! nalunggel ngeito ho jong iti gil a gil jeng hitam.
en: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.
text:
PSA 92:5
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nanatohdoh hohi iti loupi hitam! nalunggel ngeito ho jong iti gil a gil jeng hitam.
English: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.

tcz: Mihem mai mai het jou hoi ahipon, chih na a lhasam hon jong hedoh jou pouvin te.
en: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
text:
PSA 92:6
Thadou: Mihem mai mai het jou hoi ahipon, chih na a lhasam hon jong hedoh jou pouvin te.
English: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:

tcz: Migilou hochu hamhing bangin khangtou'un tin, thilse bolho chu pungthei jong leu, tonsot a suhmanga umdiu ahi.
en: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
text:
PSA 92:7
Thadou: Migilou hochu hamhing bangin khangtou'un tin, thilse bolho chu pungthei jong leu, tonsot a suhmanga umdiu ahi.
English: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

tcz: Hinla Yahweh Pakai, nangma vang, tonsot a dopsang a naum jing ding ahi.
en: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.
text:
PSA 92:8
Thadou: Hinla Yahweh Pakai, nangma vang, tonsot a dopsang a naum jing ding ahi.
English: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.

tcz: Namel ma te jouse mangthah tei diu ahi; chule gitlou na bol jouse suh chat vai a um diu ahi.
en: For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
text:
PSA 92:9
Thadou: Namel ma te jouse mangthah tei diu ahi; chule gitlou na bol jouse suh chat vai a um diu ahi.
English: For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

tcz: Nangin keimahi bongchal bangin neihatdoh sahtan, chuleh nangin kipanan neimalsom tan ahi.
en: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
text:
PSA 92:10
Thadou: Nangin keimahi bongchal bangin neihatdoh sahtan, chuleh nangin kipanan neimalsom tan ahi.
English: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

tcz: Kamit hin kagal mite lhuh amun; kana kol in jong eidou a migiloute gallel na thu ajai.
en: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
text:
PSA 92:11
Thadou: Kamit hin kagal mite lhuh amun; kana kol in jong eidou a migiloute gallel na thu ajai.
English: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

tcz: Michonphate chu chahthing bangin khangtou untin, Lebanon a Cedar thing banga hat tah khangtoudiu ahi.
en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
text:
PSA 92:12
Thadou: Michonphate chu chahthing bangin khangtou untin, Lebanon a Cedar thing banga hat tah khangtoudiu ahi.
English: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

tcz: Amahohi Yahweh Pakai inn a kehdoh thingphung likeh ahiuvin, iPathen'u Elohim angsung a khangtouva ahiuve,
en: They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
text:
PSA 92:13
Thadou: Amahohi Yahweh Pakai inn a kehdoh thingphung likeh ahiuvin, iPathen'u Elohim angsung a khangtouva ahiuve,
English: They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.

tcz: Teh nung jeng a jong ga aso nalai diu; chuleh phattin'a noujingleh hatjing diu ahi.
en: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
text:
PSA 92:14
Thadou: Teh nung jeng a jong ga aso nalai diu; chuleh phattin'a noujingleh hatjing diu ahi.
English: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

tcz: Amahon aphon doh uva hitia hi asei diu ahi, “Yahweh Pakai chu adih jingin! Amachu kasong pi ahi! Ama a chun set na aumpoi!”
en: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
text:
PSA 92:15
Thadou: Amahon aphon doh uva hitia hi asei diu ahi, “Yahweh Pakai chu adih jingin! Amachu kasong pi ahi! Ama a chun set na aumpoi!”
English: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi lengpa ahi! Ama loupi na in a kivon e. Hiti chun Yahweh Pakai chu loupi na le hat nan akivon e. Leiset hi ading det in suh ling hoi ahipoi.
en: The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.
text:
PSA 93:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi lengpa ahi! Ama loupi na in a kivon e. Hiti chun Yahweh Pakai chu loupi na le hat nan akivon e. Leiset hi ading det in suh ling hoi ahipoi.
English: The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nalaltouna chu phat kisim masang a pat a umsa ahitai. Nangma jeng jong phat kipat masanga aumjingsa nahitai.
en: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
text:
PSA 93:2
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nalaltouna chu phat kisim masang a pat a umsa ahitai. Nangma jeng jong phat kipat masanga aumjingsa nahitai.
English: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai twikhanglen akikhan tou e. Twisoh hi van gin abang tai; twisoh in gih tah in akinon sah e.
en: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
text:
PSA 93:3
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai twikhanglen akikhan tou e. Twisoh hi van gin abang tai; twisoh in gih tah in akinon sah e.
English: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

tcz: Hinlah twikhanglen kinong ging dem dum sang a nasa jo le, twipi pang a twinong kivoging sang in jong Yahweh Pakai thilbol thei na anasa joi.
en: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.
text:
PSA 93:4
Thadou: Hinlah twikhanglen kinong ging dem dum sang a nasa jo le, twipi pang a twinong kivoging sang in jong Yahweh Pakai thilbol thei na anasa joi.
English: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai na Dan thu sem hohin kikhel tih anei poi. Navai hop na jong Yahweh Pakai, tonsot a theng jing jeng ding ahi.
en: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.
text:
PSA 93:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai na Dan thu sem hohin kikhel tih anei poi. Navai hop na jong Yahweh Pakai, tonsot a theng jing jeng ding ahi.
English: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, phulaji Elohim Pathen, O phula ji Elohim Pathen nathutanna dihtah chu loupitah chu hung kilang doh hen.
en: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
text:
PSA 94:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, phulaji Elohim Pathen, O phula ji Elohim Pathen nathutanna dihtah chu loupitah chu hung kilang doh hen.
English: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

tcz: Hungthou doh in, vainoi thutan pa. Mi kiletsah hochu achanding dol u chansah in!
en: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
text:
PSA 94:2
Thadou: Hungthou doh in, vainoi thutan pa. Mi kiletsah hochu achanding dol u chansah in!
English: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

tcz: Miphalou hohi itih chanpi kipah diuham, ichan gei in em Yahweh Pakai?
en: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
text:
PSA 94:3
Thadou: Miphalou hohi itih chanpi kipah diuham, ichan gei in em Yahweh Pakai?
English: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

tcz: Itih chan kiletsah tah a thu asei diu ham? Hiche migilou hohi itih chanpi kihatsah diu ham?
en: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
text:
PSA 94:4
Thadou: Itih chan kiletsah tah a thu asei diu ham? Hiche migilou hohi itih chanpi kihatsah diu ham?
English: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai amahon namite asuchip gamtauve. Nangma mite hohi amahon asugenthei'un ahi.
en: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.
text:
PSA 94:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai amahon namite asuchip gamtauve. Nangma mite hohi amahon asugenthei'un ahi.
English: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.

tcz: Amahon meithai hole gamdang mi chule chaga ho athat gam un ahi.
en: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
text:
PSA 94:6
Thadou: Amahon meithai hole gamdang mi chule chaga ho athat gam un ahi.
English: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

tcz: Amahon asei un, “Yahweh Pakai in eive pouve chule, Israel Elohim Pathen in anasah poi.”
en: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
text:
PSA 94:7
Thadou: Amahon asei un, “Yahweh Pakai in eive pouve chule, Israel Elohim Pathen in anasah poi.”
English: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

tcz: Kigel pha kit un, mingol ho! Itihleh tahle nahin hethei diuvem?
en: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
text:
PSA 94:8
Thadou: Kigel pha kit un, mingol ho! Itihleh tahle nahin hethei diuvem?
English: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

tcz: Na nakol sempa chu a nangong ham? Namit sempau chu amitcho a ham?
en: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
text:
PSA 94:9
Thadou: Na nakol sempa chu a nangong ham? Namit sempau chu amitcho a ham?
English: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

tcz: Aman chitin namtinte ana engbol in ahi, nangjong na engbol louding ham? Aman imajouse ahesoh kei in ahi, nangin ipi naboljong ahetsohkei louding ham?
en: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
text:
PSA 94:10
Thadou: Aman chitin namtinte ana engbol in ahi, nangjong na engbol louding ham? Aman imajouse ahesoh kei in ahi, nangin ipi naboljong ahetsohkei louding ham?
English: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mitin lunggel ahesoh kei e, imacha phatchomna neilou ahi ahesoh kei e.
en: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
text:
PSA 94:11
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in mitin lunggel ahesoh kei e, imacha phatchomna neilou ahi ahesoh kei e.
English: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, nadanthu a nahil hole nasuhdih ho chu iti kipah u hitam?
en: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,
text:
PSA 94:12
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai, nadanthu a nahil hole nasuhdih ho chu iti kipah u hitam?
English: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,

tcz: Migilou te kimat nading leiko tong akilai kah sen nangman amaho chu boina akon in lung ol na nape e.
en: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
text:
PSA 94:13
Thadou: Migilou te kimat nading leiko tong akilai kah sen nangman amaho chu boina akon in lung ol na nape e.
English: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in amite nungsun ponte; Aman ami deitumte donlou in koi ponte.
en: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
text:
PSA 94:14
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in amite nungsun ponte; Aman ami deitumte donlou in koi ponte.
English: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

tcz: Thutan na mun a thudih kimu ding chuleh michonpha ho jousen apanhu diu ahi.
en: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
text:
PSA 94:15
Thadou: Thutan na mun a thudih kimu ding chuleh michonpha ho jousen apanhu diu ahi.
English: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

tcz: Gitlou na akon a koiham eidal ding? Miphalou ho masang a ei din peh ding koi ham?
en: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
text:
PSA 94:16
Thadou: Gitlou na akon a koiham eidal ding? Miphalou ho masang a ei din peh ding koi ham?
English: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in eina kithopi lou hile, keima thina lhankhuh mun a thipchet a ana kicholdo tading kahi.
en: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
text:
PSA 94:17
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in eina kithopi lou hile, keima thina lhankhuh mun a thipchet a ana kicholdo tading kahi.
English: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

tcz: “Keima kalhutai” tin kakap jah in, O Yahweh Pakai nami ngailutna longlou chun eiphong dingin ahi.
en: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.
text:
PSA 94:18
Thadou: “Keima kalhutai” tin kakap jah in, O Yahweh Pakai nami ngailutna longlou chun eiphong dingin ahi.
English: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.

tcz: Keima lungdon na a kadim teng, nami lungmon nachun kinep nale kipa na eipe ji e.
en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
text:
PSA 94:19
Thadou: Keima lungdon na a kadim teng, nami lungmon nachun kinep nale kipa na eipe ji e.
English: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

tcz: Dandih lou a natong lamkai ho chun Yahweh Pakai kalang a pangding hi ati ngam nadiu vem?
en: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
text:
PSA 94:20
Thadou: Dandih lou a natong lamkai ho chun Yahweh Pakai kalang a pangding hi ati ngam nadiu vem?
English: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

tcz: Themmo nabei ho dou din amaho akipun khom un mona neilou chungah thina chan in athepmo sah uve.
en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
text:
PSA 94:21
Thadou: Themmo nabei ho dou din amaho akipun khom un mona neilou chungah thina chan in athepmo sah uve.
English: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

tcz: Ahin Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen Elohim hi kakisel na songpi kakulpi chu ahi.
en: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
text:
PSA 94:22
Thadou: Ahin Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen Elohim hi kakisel na songpi kakulpi chu ahi.
English: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in migiloute achonset nau chu ale thuh ding ahi. Achonset nau jeh a asuh gam ding ahi. Yahweh Pakai, iPathen uvin asuh gam ding u ahi.
en: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.
text:
PSA 94:23
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in migiloute achonset nau chu ale thuh ding ahi. Achonset nau jeh a asuh gam ding ahi. Yahweh Pakai, iPathen uvin asuh gam ding u ahi.
English: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.

tcz: Hungun, Yahweh Pakai vahchoiyu te! Eihuhdoh uva Elohim Pathen ah kipah tah'in vahchoila sau te!
en: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
text:
PSA 95:1
Thadou: Hungun, Yahweh Pakai vahchoiyu te! Eihuhdoh uva Elohim Pathen ah kipah tah'in vahchoila sau te!
English: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

tcz: Thangvah pum in a angsung jon u hite. Avahchoina la sau te.
en: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
text:
PSA 95:2
Thadou: Thangvah pum in a angsung jon u hite. Avahchoina la sau te.
English: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai chu loupitah Pathen Elohim ahin, pathen dang chung a leng loupi ahi.
en: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
text:
PSA 95:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai chu loupitah Pathen Elohim ahin, pathen dang chung a leng loupi ahi.
English: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.

tcz: Mollen penle leiset laigil athuhlai abon'a Aman akhut a atuhchah ahi.
en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.
text:
PSA 95:4
Thadou: Mollen penle leiset laigil athuhlai abon'a Aman akhut a atuhchah ahi.
English: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

tcz: Twikhanglen hi Ama a ahi, ajeh chu Ama sem ahi. Ama khut in leigo jonghi asem ahi.
en: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
text:
PSA 95:5
Thadou: Twikhanglen hi Ama a ahi, ajeh chu Ama sem ahi. Ama khut in leigo jonghi asem ahi.
English: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

tcz: Hungun, eisempau Yahweh Pakai angsungah dilsu-u hitin ama hou u te,
en: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,
text:
PSA 95:6
Thadou: Hungun, eisempau Yahweh Pakai angsungah dilsu-u hitin ama hou u te,
English: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,

tcz: ajeh chu Ama iPathen'u ahin, eihohi aman achinjing amite ihiuvin akaihoijing akelngoihon ihiuve.
en: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
text:
PSA 95:7
Thadou: ajeh chu Ama iPathen'u ahin, eihohi aman achinjing amite ihiuvin akaihoijing akelngoihon ihiuve.
English: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in asei e, “Israelten gamthipnoi masah a abol bangu leh Meribah a alungtah bang bangun nalung tahsah hih'un.
en: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
text:
PSA 95:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in asei e, “Israelten gamthipnoi masah a abol bangu leh Meribah a alungtah bang bangun nalung tahsah hih'un.
English: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

tcz: Ajeh chu hilai munna chun napu napateuvin kathilbol ho chengse hi amu uvin chule eipatep'un ahi.
en: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
text:
PSA 95:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu hilai munna chun napu napateuvin kathilbol ho chengse hi amu uvin chule eipatep'un ahi.
English: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

tcz: Kum somli sunga hin keima achung uva kana lunghang'in chuleh Keiman kasei in ahi, ‘amahohi keija kon a kinung heidoh mipi chu ahiuvin, keiman kasei dungjui a chon nomlou ahiuve.’
en: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
text:
PSA 95:10
Thadou: Kum somli sunga hin keima achung uva kana lunghang'in chuleh Keiman kasei in ahi, ‘amahohi keija kon a kinung heidoh mipi chu ahiuvin, keiman kasei dungjui a chon nomlou ahiuve.’
English: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”

tcz: Hijeh chun kalunghan jehin kana kihahsel'in: ‘amahohi kachol ngahna munna hunglut theilou heldiu ahi!’”
en: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
text:
PSA 95:11
Thadou: Hijeh chun kalunghan jehin kana kihahsel'in: ‘amahohi kachol ngahna munna hunglut theilou heldiu ahi!’”
English: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kom ah lathah sauvin! Leiset pumpin Yahweh Pakai vahchoila sauvin!
en: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.
text:
PSA 96:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai kom ah lathah sauvin! Leiset pumpin Yahweh Pakai vahchoila sauvin!
English: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai vahchoila sauvin amin thangvah un. Ami huhhingna kipa umtah chu niseh'in samphongin.
en: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
text:
PSA 96:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai vahchoila sauvin amin thangvah un. Ami huhhingna kipa umtah chu niseh'in samphongin.
English: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

tcz: Chitin namtin holah a athilbol kidangtah hohi samphong'in, Aman thil loupi tahtah abol hohi mijouse seipeh'un.
en: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
text:
PSA 96:3
Thadou: Chitin namtin holah a athilbol kidangtah hohi samphong'in, Aman thil loupi tahtah abol hohi mijouse seipeh'un.
English: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi aloupi e! Amahi vahchoi dinga lompen ahi! Amahi pathen jouse sanga kichat umpentah ahi.
en: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
text:
PSA 96:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi aloupi e! Amahi vahchoi dinga lompen ahi! Amahi pathen jouse sanga kichat umpentah ahi.
English: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

tcz: Chidang namdang ho pathen hohi semthu pathen ngen ahiuve hinla Yahweh Pakai hin vanho asem ahi!
en: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
text:
PSA 96:5
Thadou: Chidang namdang ho pathen hohi semthu pathen ngen ahiuve hinla Yahweh Pakai hin vanho asem ahi!
English: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

tcz: Gin na le jana-in aumkimvel ahi, thahatna le melhoina hin muntheng alosoh ahi.
en: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
text:
PSA 96:6
Thadou: Gin na le jana-in aumkimvel ahi, thahatna le melhoina hin muntheng alosoh ahi.
English: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

tcz: O chitin namtin vannoi mite ho, Yahweh Pakai hethem un Yahweh Pakai ahat nale aloupina hohi hethem un.
en: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
text:
PSA 96:7
Thadou: O chitin namtin vannoi mite ho, Yahweh Pakai hethem un Yahweh Pakai ahat nale aloupina hohi hethem un.
English: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu achan dinga lomtah loupi nale jana chan sah'un! Nathilpeh ding kichoiyin lang a-angsunga lut in.
en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
text:
PSA 96:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu achan dinga lomtah loupi nale jana chan sah'un! Nathilpeh ding kichoiyin lang a-angsunga lut in.
English: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu athenna loupina vah chutoh kitohin chibai boh'un. Vannoi leiset pumpi hi a-angsungah kithing jenghen.
en: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
text:
PSA 96:9
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu athenna loupina vah chutoh kitohin chibai boh'un. Vannoi leiset pumpi hi a-angsungah kithing jenghen.
English: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

tcz: Chitin namtin hi seipeh un, “Yahweh Pakai in vai ahom e!” Vannoi hi adingdetna ahitan holingbut ahitapon ahi.
en: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
text:
PSA 96:10
Thadou: Chitin namtin hi seipeh un, “Yahweh Pakai in vai ahom e!” Vannoi hi adingdetna ahitan holingbut ahitapon ahi.
English: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

tcz: Vanho kipah hen chuleh vannoi leiset kipah-u hen! Twikhanglen leh asunga um jousen thangvah'un.
en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
text:
PSA 96:11
Thadou: Vanho kipah hen chuleh vannoi leiset kipah-u hen! Twikhanglen leh asunga um jousen thangvah'un.
English: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

tcz: Loujao holeh asunga kehho jouse jong kipahtah in hung gadoh sohkei uhen, gammang sunga thingphungho jousen jong
en: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
text:
PSA 96:12
Thadou: Loujao holeh asunga kehho jouse jong kipahtah in hung gadoh sohkei uhen, gammang sunga thingphungho jousen jong
