English: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

tcz: Yahweh Pakai angsungah thangvah la sauhen, ajeh chu Ama ahungtai! Leiset chungthu tan dingin ahunge. Aman vannoi mite le chitin namtinhi kitahna-a achungthu atanding ahi.
en: before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
text:
PSA 96:13
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai angsungah thangvah la sauhen, ajeh chu Ama ahungtai! Leiset chungthu tan dingin ahunge. Aman vannoi mite le chitin namtinhi kitahna-a achungthu atanding ahi.
English: before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi leng ahi! Vannoi mite kipah hen! Twikhanglen akimvelle agamla penna um miho jong kipah uhen.
en: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
text:
PSA 97:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi leng ahi! Vannoi mite kipah hen! Twikhanglen akimvelle agamla penna um miho jong kipah uhen.
English: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

tcz: Amahi meilhang thim in atomin, chonphatna le thudih chu alaltouna khombul ahi.
en: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
text:
PSA 97:2
Thadou: Amahi meilhang thim in atomin, chonphatna le thudih chu alaltouna khombul ahi.
English: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

tcz: Amasang ah meikong aleng'in akidoupi ho ahallih gamin ahi.
en: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
text:
PSA 97:3
Thadou: Amasang ah meikong aleng'in akidoupi ho ahallih gamin ahi.
English: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

tcz: Akolphe vah in vannoi leiset asalvah'in ahi. Leiset in amun akithing thingin ahi.
en: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
text:
PSA 97:4
Thadou: Akolphe vah in vannoi leiset asalvah'in ahi. Leiset in amun akithing thingin ahi.
English: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

tcz: Molle lhangjong Yahweh Pakai masanga khoilu bangin ajunlha jengin ahi. Leiset pumpi Yahweh Pakai masanga hitiahi thil soh-a ahi.
en: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
text:
PSA 97:5
Thadou: Molle lhangjong Yahweh Pakai masanga khoilu bangin ajunlha jengin ahi. Leiset pumpi Yahweh Pakai masanga hitiahi thil soh-a ahi.
English: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

tcz: Vanhon adih nale akitahna aphongdoh'in namtin'in aloupina amu'uvin ahi.
en: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
text:
PSA 97:6
Thadou: Vanhon adih nale akitahna aphongdoh'in namtin'in aloupina amu'uvin ahi.
English: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

tcz: Milim semthu doihou ho jouse, pannabei semthu pathen kiletsahpi hojouse jumle jachat athoh'un ahi, ajeh chu semthu pathen hojouse a-anga kun teidiu ahi.
en: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
text:
PSA 97:7
Thadou: Milim semthu doihou ho jouse, pannabei semthu pathen kiletsahpi hojouse jumle jachat athoh'un ahi, ajeh chu semthu pathen hojouse a-anga kun teidiu ahi.
English: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

tcz: Jerusalem in ajauvin akipah un chuleh Judah khopiho jouse jong athanom'un ahi. Ajeh chu O Yahweh Pakai nangma thudih nahi.
en: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.
text:
PSA 97:8
Thadou: Jerusalem in ajauvin akipah un chuleh Judah khopiho jouse jong athanom'un ahi. Ajeh chu O Yahweh Pakai nangma thudih nahi.
English: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.

tcz: Nangma hi O Yahweh Pakai vannoi leisetna athupipen nahin, semthu pathen ho jouse chunga dopsang'in naumin ahi.
en: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
text:
PSA 97:9
Thadou: Nangma hi O Yahweh Pakai vannoi leisetna athupipen nahin, semthu pathen ho jouse chunga dopsang'in naumin ahi.
English: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

tcz: Nangho Yahweh Pakai ngailuhon thilse nahot bollun ahi. Aman ami chonphate ahinkho-u ahuhdohjin ahi, chuleh miphalouho thaneina a konnin ahuhdohjin ahi.
en: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
text:
PSA 97:10
Thadou: Nangho Yahweh Pakai ngailuhon thilse nahot bollun ahi. Aman ami chonphate ahinkho-u ahuhdohjin ahi, chuleh miphalouho thaneina a konnin ahuhdohjin ahi.
English: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

tcz: Michonpha ho vah-in asalvah'in, chuleh milungdih ho akipah jiuvin ahi.
en: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
text:
PSA 97:11
Thadou: Michonpha ho vah-in asalvah'in, chuleh milungdih ho akipah jiuvin ahi.
English: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

tcz: Koi hileh michonpha ho jouse kipah henlang amintheng chu thangvah'u hen!
en: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
text:
PSA 97:12
Thadou: Koi hileh michonpha ho jouse kipah henlang amintheng chu thangvah'u hen!
English: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ah lathah sauvin, ajeh chu Aman thil kidangtah tah aboldoh tai. Aban jet in gal nasatah ajou tai; Aban thengin huhhingna thahat amusah e.
en: Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
text:
PSA 98:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ah lathah sauvin, ajeh chu Aman thil kidangtah tah aboldoh tai. Aban jet in gal nasatah ajou tai; Aban thengin huhhingna thahat amusah e.
English: Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in galjona aphongdoh tai, chuleh adihna leh akitahna chitin namtin lah a aphongjal tai.
en: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
text:
PSA 98:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in galjona aphongdoh tai, chuleh adihna leh akitahna chitin namtin lah a aphongjal tai.
English: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

tcz: Aman Israelte dinga ngailutna le kitahna nei a akitep nachu ageldoh'in ahi. Leiset kolmang gei in jong iPathen'u Elohim galjona hi amudoh tauve.
en: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
text:
PSA 98:3
Thadou: Aman Israelte dinga ngailutna le kitahna nei a akitep nachu ageldoh'in ahi. Leiset kolmang gei in jong iPathen'u Elohim galjona hi amudoh tauve.
English: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

tcz: Leiset mihemten Yahweh Pakai ah kho sam'un; thangvahna bunglhauvin kipah tah'in thangvah la sauvin!
en: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
text:
PSA 98:4
Thadou: Leiset mihemten Yahweh Pakai ah kho sam'un; thangvahna bunglhauvin kipah tah'in thangvah la sauvin!
English: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

tcz: Tumging toh thon Yahweh Pakai vahchoi la sauvin, tumging tothon langai chu sauvin.
en: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
text:
PSA 98:5
Thadou: Tumging toh thon Yahweh Pakai vahchoi la sauvin, tumging tothon langai chu sauvin.
English: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

tcz: Sumkon toh kelngoi ki gin kithong tohthon iPakai u Yahweh le ilengpau masanga chohjejun la sauvin.
en: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.
text:
PSA 98:6
Thadou: Sumkon toh kelngoi ki gin kithong tohthon iPakai u Yahweh le ilengpau masanga chohjejun la sauvin.
English: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.

tcz: Twikhanglen leh asunga um jousen athangvahna samphongun! Leiset chunga hinna nei jousen jom un.
en: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
text:
PSA 98:7
Thadou: Twikhanglen leh asunga um jousen athangvahna samphongun! Leiset chunga hinna nei jousen jom un.
English: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

tcz: Vadung jousen kipah'in akhut beng uhen! Thinglhang gam jousen kipah'in la sauhen,
en: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
text:
PSA 98:8
Thadou: Vadung jousen kipah'in akhut beng uhen! Thinglhang gam jousen kipah'in la sauhen,
English: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai masangah. Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai chu leiset chung thu tandinga hungding ahi. Vannoi hi thudih a athu atanding chitin namtin thuhi dihtah a atanding ahi.
en: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
text:
PSA 98:9
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai masangah. Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai chu leiset chung thu tandinga hungding ahi. Vannoi hi thudih a athu atanding chitin namtin thuhi dihtah a atanding ahi.
English: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi leng ahi! Chitin namtin kithing thingjeng hen! Ama Cherubim teni kikah a laltouna a atouvin ahi. Vannoi leiset pumpi kithing hen.
en: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
text:
PSA 99:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi leng ahi! Chitin namtin kithing thingjeng hen! Ama Cherubim teni kikah a laltouna a atouvin ahi. Vannoi leiset pumpi kithing hen.
English: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu Jerusalem ah loupitah'in atouvin ahi. Chitin namtin ho jouse chung vum a dopsang'in aum e.
en: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
text:
PSA 99:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu Jerusalem ah loupitah'in atouvin ahi. Chitin namtin ho jouse chung vum a dopsang'in aum e.
English: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

tcz: Amahon namin gimneitah chu thangvah uhen, naminhi athenge!
en: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
text:
PSA 99:3
Thadou: Amahon namin gimneitah chu thangvah uhen, naminhi athenge!
English: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

tcz: Lengloupi thudih ngailua, nangin thildih hi nadomsang'in, thudih in kal nasong'in Israel lah-a thudih nachelhah sah'in ahi.
en: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
text:
PSA 99:4
Thadou: Lengloupi thudih ngailua, nangin thildih hi nadomsang'in, thudih in kal nasong'in Israel lah-a thudih nachelhah sah'in ahi.
English: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai iPathen'u Elohim hi dopsangin umhen! A-ang sungah bohkhup un, ajeh chu Amahi atheng ahi.
en: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
text:
PSA 99:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai iPathen'u Elohim hi dopsangin umhen! A-ang sungah bohkhup un, ajeh chu Amahi atheng ahi.
English: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

tcz: Mose le Aaron jongchu thempu ahilhon e, Samuel injong Amin anakouve. Amahon Yahweh Pakai kom ah panpi ngaichan anakouvun ahi, chuleh Aman anahouvin ahi.
en: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.
text:
PSA 99:6
Thadou: Mose le Aaron jongchu thempu ahilhon e, Samuel injong Amin anakouve. Amahon Yahweh Pakai kom ah panpi ngaichan anakouvun ahi, chuleh Aman anahouvin ahi.
English: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.

tcz: Aman meilom lah a kon in Israel ho lah-a thu anasei in, amahon Yahweh Pakai in apeh-u Dan le thupeh hochu anajui un ahi.
en: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
text:
PSA 99:7
Thadou: Aman meilom lah a kon in Israel ho lah-a thu anasei in, amahon Yahweh Pakai in apeh-u Dan le thupeh hochu anajui un ahi.
English: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai ka Pathen'u Elohim! nangin amaho nana donbut in ahi. Nangma hi amaho ding a mi ngaidam jing Elohim Pathen nahi, ahinla amaho achekhel teng uleh nagim boljin ahi.
en: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
text:
PSA 99:8
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai ka Pathen'u Elohim! nangin amaho nana donbut in ahi. Nangma hi amaho ding a mi ngaidam jing Elohim Pathen nahi, ahinla amaho achekhel teng uleh nagim boljin ahi.
English: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim hi domsang'un chuleh Jerusalem a moltheng achun chibai boh'un ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim hi atheng ahi.
en: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!
text:
PSA 99:9
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim hi domsang'un chuleh Jerusalem a moltheng achun chibai boh'un ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim hi atheng ahi.
English: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!

tcz: Leiset pumpin Yahweh Pakai a kipana samphong'un,
en: Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!
text:
PSA 100:1
Thadou: Leiset pumpin Yahweh Pakai a kipana samphong'un,
English: Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!

tcz: kipah tah'in Yahweh Pakai chu chibai boh'un vahchoila sapum pumin a-angah hungun
en: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
text:
PSA 100:2
Thadou: kipah tah'in Yahweh Pakai chu chibai boh'un vahchoila sapum pumin a-angah hungun
English: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen ahi tin hettohna phongdohun, Aman eisem uva eiho Ama a ihiu ahi. Eiho Ama mite ihiu vin a-an a kivah akelngoite ihiuve.
en: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
text:
PSA 100:3
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen ahi tin hettohna phongdohun, Aman eisem uva eiho Ama a ihiu ahi. Eiho Ama mite ihiu vin a-an a kivah akelngoite ihiuve.
English: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

tcz: Thangvah pum in akulpi sungah lut un, vahchoi pum in ainsungah lut in, Akom a kipa thu sei un, amin thangvah'un.
en: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
text:
PSA 100:4
Thadou: Thangvah pum in akulpi sungah lut un, vahchoi pum in ainsungah lut in, Akom a kipa thu sei un, amin thangvah'un.
English: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai phatna jehchun, ami ngailutna longlou hi tonsot in aumjinge, chuleh akitah nahi akhang khangin aumjinge
en: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
text:
PSA 100:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai phatna jehchun, ami ngailutna longlou hi tonsot in aumjinge, chuleh akitah nahi akhang khangin aumjinge
English: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai keiman nami ngailutnale nathudihna lan sange. Keiman nangma thangvah nahi lan sange.
en: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.
text:
PSA 101:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai keiman nami ngailutnale nathudihna lan sange. Keiman nangma thangvah nahi lan sange.
English: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.

tcz: Keiman monabei hinkho kaman theina dingin chingthei tah in um inge, itihleh eipanpi dinga nahungding hitam? Keiman ka insungah kitahna hinkho kaman jingding ahi.
en: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
text:
PSA 101:2
Thadou: Keiman monabei hinkho kaman theina dingin chingthei tah in um inge, itihleh eipanpi dinga nahungding hitam? Keiman ka insungah kitahna hinkho kaman jingding ahi.
English: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

tcz: Keiman ipi hijongleh athenglou chuleh vet hoilou ho veponge. Thil adihlouva kitongho jouse kathet ahi, hichengse hitoh kaki timat louhel ding ahi.
en: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
text:
PSA 101:3
Thadou: Keiman ipi hijongleh athenglou chuleh vet hoilou ho veponge. Thil adihlouva kitongho jouse kathet ahi, hichengse hitoh kaki timat louhel ding ahi.
English: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

tcz: Keiman dei umlou thil ho jouse hi kapaidoh sohkei ding thilgilou hojousea kon a kakidalse ding ahi.
en: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
text:
PSA 101:4
Thadou: Keiman dei umlou thil ho jouse hi kapaidoh sohkei ding thilgilou hojousea kon a kakidalse ding ahi.
English: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

tcz: Aheng akom aseiseho jouse kadeplou helding ahi. Keiman akiphatsei leh akiletsah ho kadeplou ding ahi.
en: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
text:
PSA 101:5
Thadou: Aheng akom aseiseho jouse kadeplou helding ahi. Keiman akiphatsei leh akiletsah ho kadeplou ding ahi.
English: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

tcz: Keiman tahsan um miho kaholdoh ding amaho chu kakivoppi ding ahi. Koi hileh oimothei hilou miho bouchu kakivoppi ding ahi.
en: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.
text:
PSA 101:6
Thadou: Keiman tahsan um miho kaholdoh ding amaho chu kakivoppi ding ahi. Koi hileh oimothei hilou miho bouchu kakivoppi ding ahi.
English: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

tcz: Keiman milepche ho ka insunga kamanchah louding ahi.
en: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
text:
PSA 101:7
Thadou: Keiman milepche ho ka insunga kamanchah louding ahi.
English: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

tcz: Aniseh'a katohding chu mi jonchih ho deldohding chuleh khopi hi hitiho tobanga konna hoidoh sahding hi kakin ahi.
en: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.
text:
PSA 101:8
Thadou: Aniseh'a katohding chu mi jonchih ho deldohding chuleh khopi hi hitiho tobanga konna hoidoh sahding hi kakin ahi.
English: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kataona ngai in! Ka ngeh nahi neisanpeh in.
en: Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.
text:
PSA 102:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai kataona ngai in! Ka ngeh nahi neisanpeh in.
English: Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.

tcz: Kei a kon in kiheimang hih'in, kahahsat phatleh khohsah tah'in neingaipeh in, kangaichat phatleh neihin gelkhoh in,
en: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
text:
PSA 102:2
Thadou: Kei a kon in kiheimang hih'in, kahahsat phatleh khohsah tah'in neingaipeh in, kangaichat phatleh neihin gelkhoh in,
English: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

tcz: Ajeh chu kahinkho hi meikhu bangin abeipai jitai, kagu kachang hi asadohji tai.
en: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
text:
PSA 102:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu kahinkho hi meikhu bangin abeipai jitai, kagu kachang hi asadohji tai.
English: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

tcz: Kalungsung hi anadohjin hamhing bangin agolha jitai, chutengle chun kagilkel jong abeipaiji tai.
en: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
text:
PSA 102:4
Thadou: Kalungsung hi anadohjin hamhing bangin agolha jitai, chutengle chun kagilkel jong abeipaiji tai.
English: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

tcz: Ajeh chu lunggim a kakhoisat sat jeh'in kavun le kagu hobou kahitai.
en: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
text:
PSA 102:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu lunggim a kakhoisat sat jeh'in kavun le kagu hobou kahitai.
English: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

tcz: Keima neldi gam a sumbupi toh kabangtai, gamlatah gamthip gam a sumbupi noutoh kabangtai.
en: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
text:
PSA 102:6
Thadou: Keima neldi gam a sumbupi toh kabangtai, gamlatah gamthip gam a sumbupi noutoh kabangtai.
English: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

tcz: Keima kahah khovahjin, inting vumma vacha changkhat seh lunghel tah-a um kabange.
en: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
text:
PSA 102:7
Thadou: Keima kahah khovahjin, inting vumma vacha changkhat seh lunghel tah-a um kabange.
English: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

tcz: Kagal miten sun nilhum in eitaitom jingun, amahon eisamseuvin eitaitom jingun ahi.
en: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
text:
PSA 102:8
Thadou: Kagal miten sun nilhum in eitaitom jingun, amahon eisamseuvin eitaitom jingun ahi.
English: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

tcz: Keima buneh jong vutvai jeng ahitai. Kadon na sunga jong kamitlhi alonglut tai.
en: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
text:
PSA 102:9
Thadou: Keima buneh jong vutvai jeng ahitai. Kadon na sunga jong kamitlhi alonglut tai.
English: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

tcz: Nalunghan na le nagimbol nachun eidom sang in eipaidoh tai.
en: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
text:
PSA 102:10
Thadou: Nalunghan na le nagimbol nachun eidom sang in eipaidoh tai.
English: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

tcz: Kahinkho hi nilhah lang nilep bangin achemang loijitai. Keima hampa bangin kagop lhaloi jitai.
en: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
text:
PSA 102:11
Thadou: Kahinkho hi nilhah lang nilep bangin achemang loijitai. Keima hampa bangin kagop lhaloi jitai.
English: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

tcz: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai nangvang nalaltouna a natoujing ding ahi. Naminthan na akhang khanga chelhajing ding ahi.
en: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
text:
PSA 102:12
Thadou: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai nangvang nalaltouna a natoujing ding ahi. Naminthan na akhang khanga chelhajing ding ahi.
English: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

tcz: Nangma hung kipat in natin Jerusalem hi nahin khoto ding ahi. Tuahi nangnam na khohsah phat ahin, tuhi na kitepna dungjui a mi kithopi phat ahi.
en: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
text:
PSA 102:13
Thadou: Nangma hung kipat in natin Jerusalem hi nahin khoto ding ahi. Tuahi nangnam na khohsah phat ahin, tuhi na kitepna dungjui a mi kithopi phat ahi.
English: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

tcz: Ajeh chu namiten bang'a song jouse angailu uvin chuleh lamlenna vutvai hojeng jong angaisang'un ahi.
en: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
text:
PSA 102:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu namiten bang'a song jouse angailu uvin chuleh lamlenna vutvai hojeng jong angaisang'un ahi.
English: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

tcz: Chujouteng leh chitin namtin ten Yahweh Pakai ang-a kithing thingding ahi,
en: So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
text:
PSA 102:15
Thadou: Chujouteng leh chitin namtin ten Yahweh Pakai ang-a kithing thingding ahi,
English: So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in Jerusalem ahin thahsem kitding chutengle Ama aloupina-a hung kilang ding,
en: For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
text:
PSA 102:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in Jerusalem ahin thahsem kitding chutengle Ama aloupina-a hung kilang ding,
English: For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

tcz: Aman tahlelte taona ahin sanding Aman angaichat hou asanpehding ahi.
en: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
text:
PSA 102:17
Thadou: Aman tahlelte taona ahin sanding Aman angaichat hou asanpehding ahi.
English: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

tcz: Khonunga khangthahho dinga kijihlut pehding hitiachu tua pengloulai hon Yahweh Pakai chu ahin thangvah dingu ahi.
en: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,
text:
PSA 102:18
Thadou: Khonunga khangthahho dinga kijihlut pehding hitiachu tua pengloulai hon Yahweh Pakai chu ahin thangvah dingu ahi.
English: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in van muntheng a kon a ahin vetsuh ding, Aman van a kon a leiset hi ahin vetsuh ding
en: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,
text:
PSA 102:19
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in van muntheng a kon a ahin vetsuh ding, Aman van a kon a leiset hi ahin vetsuh ding
English: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,

tcz: songkul tangte khoisatna ajahding thidinga themmo kichanho alha doh dinga,
en: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,
text:
PSA 102:20
Thadou: songkul tangte khoisatna ajahding thidinga themmo kichanho alha doh dinga,
English: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,

tcz: hiteng chuleh Yahweh Pakai minthanna chu Zion a lopna umding, chule Jerusalem a kithangvah ding ahi.
en: that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,
text:
PSA 102:21
Thadou: hiteng chuleh Yahweh Pakai minthanna chu Zion a lopna umding, chule Jerusalem a kithangvah ding ahi.
English: that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

tcz: Mihonpi tamtah chu ahung ki khopkhom teng leh leng gam hojouse chu Yahweh Pakai chibai boh a hungdiu ahi.
en: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
text:
PSA 102:22
Thadou: Mihonpi tamtah chu ahung ki khopkhom teng leh leng gam hojouse chu Yahweh Pakai chibai boh a hungdiu ahi.
English: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

tcz: Aman kaban thahat akim laitah avolhun kahinkho asuchomtai.
en: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
text:
PSA 102:23
Thadou: Aman kaban thahat akim laitah avolhun kahinkho asuchomtai.
English: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

tcz: Hinla keiman Ama kakouvin, Oh Yahweh Pakai tonsot a hingjing kakhandon laitah ahin kahinkho lahih'in.
en: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
text:
PSA 102:24
Thadou: Hinla keiman Ama kakouvin, Oh Yahweh Pakai tonsot a hingjing kakhandon laitah ahin kahinkho lahih'in.
English: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

tcz: Kum tamtah achetai, nangin hiche leiset leibul nana lhungdoh'in, vanhohi nakhut tah'in nanasemdoh in,
en: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
text:
PSA 102:25
Thadou: Kum tamtah achetai, nangin hiche leiset leibul nana lhungdoh'in, vanhohi nakhut tah'in nanasemdoh in,
English: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

tcz: hihojouse hung mangthah ding ahinlah nang tonsotna nahinjing ding ahi, amaho ponlui bangin hungvui lhantin, Nangin amaho chu von banga nakhelding chujouteng napai mangdiu ahi.
en: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
text:
PSA 102:26
Thadou: hihojouse hung mangthah ding ahinlah nang tonsotna nahinjing ding ahi, amaho ponlui bangin hungvui lhantin, Nangin amaho chu von banga nakhelding chujouteng napai mangdiu ahi.
English: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

tcz: Hinla Yahweh Pakai nangvang abang chu nahijingin ahi.
en: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
text:
PSA 102:27
Thadou: Hinla Yahweh Pakai nangvang abang chu nahijingin ahi.
English: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

tcz: Nangma mite chate jouse lungmong a umdiu ahi. Achate chateho chu na-anga hung khanglen diu ahi.
en: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
text:
PSA 102:28
Thadou: Nangma mite chate jouse lungmong a umdiu ahi. Achate chateho chu na-anga hung khanglen diu ahi.
English: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”

tcz: Kahinaho jouse pum'in Yahweh Pakai chu thagvah ingkate. Kalungthim pumpin amintheng choian inge.
en: Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
text:
PSA 103:1
Thadou: Kahinaho jouse pum'in Yahweh Pakai chu thagvah ingkate. Kalungthim pumpin amintheng choian inge.
English: Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

tcz: Kahinaho jouse pum'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah ingkate. Keidinga thilpha eibolpeh ho itihchan hijongleh sumil ponge.
en: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
text:
PSA 103:2
Thadou: Kahinaho jouse pum'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah ingkate. Keidinga thilpha eibolpeh ho itihchan hijongleh sumil ponge.
English: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

tcz: Aman kachonsetna jouse angaidam tai, chuleh kadam mona hojouse le kahivei hojouse eiboldam pehtai.
en: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
text:
PSA 103:3
Thadou: Aman kachonsetna jouse angaidam tai, chuleh kadam mona hojouse le kahivei hojouse eiboldam pehtai.
English: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,

tcz: Aman kathina dinga kon in eihuhdohtai chuleh ngailutna leh khotona dimset in eiphungvuh tai.
en: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
text:
PSA 103:4
Thadou: Aman kathina dinga kon in eihuhdohtai chuleh ngailutna leh khotona dimset in eiphungvuh tai.
English: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

tcz: Aman kahinkho hi thilpha dimset in eiphungvuh tai, Muvanlai bangin kakhandon hinkho akiledohsah tai!
en: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
text:
PSA 103:5
Thadou: Aman kahinkho hi thilpha dimset in eiphungvuh tai, Muvanlai bangin kakhandon hinkho akiledohsah tai!
English: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in chonphatna leh dihna chu suhgenthei a umte chu amusah ding ahi.
en: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
text:
PSA 103:6
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in chonphatna leh dihna chu suhgenthei a umte chu amusah ding ahi.
English: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

tcz: Aman ahina tahbeh chu Mose kom ah anatahlang'in chuleh anatoh hochu Israel mipite lah-a anaphongdoh'in ahi.
en: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
text:
PSA 103:7
Thadou: Aman ahina tahbeh chu Mose kom ah anatahlang'in chuleh anatoh hochu Israel mipite lah-a anaphongdoh'in ahi.
English: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi mikhoto them tahleh mihepi themtah lunghang vahlou chuleh longlou ngailutna a dimset ahi.
en: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
text:
PSA 103:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi mikhoto them tahleh mihepi themtah lunghang vahlou chuleh longlou ngailutna a dimset ahi.
English: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

tcz: Amahin phat tinnin eithepmosah pouvintin ahilouleh lunghang jingjeng ponte.
en: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
text:
PSA 103:9
Thadou: Amahin phat tinnin eithepmosah pouvintin ahilouleh lunghang jingjeng ponte.
English: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

tcz: Aman ichonset nauva jong ei engbol pouvintin chuleh Aman eiho chanding dol hotbolna jong einei pouvinte.
en: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
text:
PSA 103:10
Thadou: Aman ichonset nauva jong ei engbol pouvintin chuleh Aman eiho chanding dol hotbolna jong einei pouvinte.
English: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

tcz: Ama gingte chunga angailutna tanglou hi leiset chunga van asan banga hi sanga ahi.
en: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
text:
PSA 103:11
Thadou: Ama gingte chunga angailutna tanglou hi leiset chunga van asan banga hi sanga ahi.
English: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

tcz: Aman eiho chonset nahi, solam le lhumlam akigam lhat bangin gamlatah in atolmang tai.
en: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
text:
PSA 103:12
Thadou: Aman eiho chonset nahi, solam le lhumlam akigam lhat bangin gamlatah in atolmang tai.
English: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi chapangte dinga apauva panga ahin, ama gingte dinga khoto them tahle ngailutna dimset ahijing e.
en: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
text:
PSA 103:13
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi chapangte dinga apauva panga ahin, ama gingte dinga khoto them tahle ngailutna dimset ahijing e.
English: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman ihatmonau eihet thempeh'un chuleh eihohi vutvai tobang bou ihiu ageldoh jingin ahi.
en: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
text:
PSA 103:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu Aman ihatmonau eihet thempeh'un chuleh eihohi vutvai tobang bou ihiu ageldoh jingin ahi.
English: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

tcz: Leiset chunga ihinkho hou jong hampa bangbep ahin, gam pahcha tobangin ipahdoh'un athi loikitji tai.
en: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
text:
PSA 103:15
Thadou: Leiset chunga ihinkho hou jong hampa bangbep ahin, gam pahcha tobangin ipahdoh'un athi loikitji tai.
English: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

tcz: Hui ahung nung jin aitih a aumkhlou bang in bep in eimut mang ji taove.
en: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
text:
PSA 103:16
Thadou: Hui ahung nung jin aitih a aumkhlou bang in bep in eimut mang ji taove.
English: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

tcz: Hinla Yahweh Pakai gingte din vang amingailutna nitin in aumjinge. Ami huhhing nanjong achate chateho gei in,
en: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,
text:
PSA 103:17
Thadou: Hinla Yahweh Pakai gingte din vang amingailutna nitin in aumjinge. Ami huhhing nanjong achate chateho gei in,
English: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,

tcz: hitobanga aDan thua kitahna nei ho le, athupeh jui jing ho din aumpeh jing e.
en: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
text:
PSA 103:18
Thadou: hitobanga aDan thua kitahna nei ho le, athupeh jui jing ho din aumpeh jing e.
English: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in vanmun hohi alaltouna in asemin; hichea kon in muntin chunga vai ahom e.
en: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
text:
PSA 103:19
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in vanmun hohi alaltouna in asemin; hichea kon in muntin chunga vai ahom e.
English: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

tcz: Nangho vantilte ho, nangho mithupitahte ho, ana tongdoh a pangho Yahweh Pakai hi thangvah un.
en: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
text:
PSA 103:20
Thadou: Nangho vantilte ho, nangho mithupitahte ho, ana tongdoh a pangho Yahweh Pakai hi thangvah un.
English: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

tcz: Ahi, nangho vantil sepaite ho alungdeilam boljinga Ama janlea pangjing ho Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un.
en: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
text:
PSA 103:21
Thadou: Ahi, nangho vantil sepaite ho alungdeilam boljinga Ama janlea pangjing ho Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un.
English: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

tcz: Asemsa ho jousen, chuleh alengam a umjousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un. Keima kahina jouse pum in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah jing ing kate.
en: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!
text:
PSA 103:22
Thadou: Asemsa ho jousen, chuleh alengam a umjousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un. Keima kahina jouse pum in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah jing ing kate.
English: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!

tcz: Kahina jouse pum in Yahweh Pakai thangvah inge. O Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen Elohim, iti lom a nathupi hitam! Nangma, naloupina le nathupina toh nakivon e.
en: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
text:
PSA 104:1
Thadou: Kahina jouse pum in Yahweh Pakai thangvah inge. O Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen Elohim, iti lom a nathupi hitam! Nangma, naloupina le nathupina toh nakivon e.
English: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

tcz: Nangman khovah chu ponsil bangin nakisil in, Nangin vanho ahin ahsi hohi pondal bangin nadahdoh in;
en: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

tcz: twimei chunga na iin natungdoh in, meilom chu sakol kangtalai in namangin, huihi nalhavingin namangin nalenglen ahi.
en: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
text:
PSA 104:3
Thadou: twimei chunga na iin natungdoh in, meilom chu sakol kangtalai in namangin, huihi nalhavingin namangin nalenglen ahi.
English: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

tcz: Huihi sottol len namangin, meile meikong jong nasoh'in namangin ahi.
en: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.
text:
PSA 104:4
Thadou: Huihi sottol len namangin, meile meikong jong nasoh'in namangin ahi.
English: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.

tcz: Nangin, itihchan hijongleh kil ling louhel dingin nangman vannoi leiset bul naphutdoh tai.
en: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
text:
PSA 104:5
Thadou: Nangin, itihchan hijongleh kil ling louhel dingin nangman vannoi leiset bul naphutdoh tai.
English: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

tcz: Nangin twipi veihi leiset dingin ponsil in nasilpeh'in molsangho jong nachupsah soh hel in ahi.
en: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
text:
PSA 104:6
Thadou: Nangin twipi veihi leiset dingin ponsil in nasilpeh'in molsangho jong nachupsah soh hel in ahi.
English: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

tcz: Nangin thu napehleh twipi chu alengmang jingin, na ogin ajahleh ajammang hel jenge.
en: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
text:
PSA 104:7
Thadou: Nangin thu napehleh twipi chu alengmang jingin, na ogin ajahleh ajammang hel jenge.
English: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

tcz: Mol ho adingdoh in phaicham atonglha jengin nangin nathupeh bang bangin akijam jengin ahi.
en: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
text:
PSA 104:8
Thadou: Mol ho adingdoh in phaicham atonglha jengin nangin nathupeh bang bangin akijam jengin ahi.
English: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

tcz: Chujouvin nangin twikhanglen hochu aphah nadiu chanbep naphahsah'in, hitiachu leiset hi avella achupkit louna diuvin nasemtoh tan ahi.
en: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
text:
PSA 104:9
Thadou: Chujouvin nangin twikhanglen hochu aphah nadiu chanbep naphahsah'in, hitiachu leiset hi avella achupkit louna diuvin nasemtoh tan ahi.
English: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

tcz: Nangin twisamho naphuldoh sah'in kotong dunga nalonlutsah'in, vachaho chu molle lhanga konnin ahung lengsuh'in,
en: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
text:
PSA 104:10
Thadou: Nangin twisamho naphuldoh sah'in kotong dunga nalonlutsah'in, vachaho chu molle lhanga konnin ahung lengsuh'in,
English: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

tcz: ganhingho jouse dingin twi nasuhmang peh'in ahi, chuleh sangan honjong dangnou nan anei un ahi.
en: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
text:
PSA 104:11
Thadou: ganhingho jouse dingin twi nasuhmang peh'in ahi, chuleh sangan honjong dangnou nan anei un ahi.
English: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

tcz: Vacha hon va pang dunga buh akisem un thingbah lah'a la asajiuvin ahi.
en: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
text:
PSA 104:12
Thadou: Vacha hon va pang dunga buh akisem un thingbah lah'a la asajiuvin ahi.
English: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

tcz: Nangin navan inmun a kon in molle lhang chunga go nahinjuhsah in chuteng nakhutsoh gachun leiset nasudimjin ahi.
en: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
text:
PSA 104:13
Thadou: Nangin navan inmun a kon in molle lhang chunga go nahinjuhsah in chuteng nakhutsoh gachun leiset nasudimjin ahi.
English: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

tcz: Nangin hampa ho nakhandohsah in ganchaho, thingphungho le mihemho manchah pha nasodoh sah'in ahi. Chujongleh nangman leiset chunga amaho dingin nehpha nasodohsah'in ahi.
en: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
text:
PSA 104:14
Thadou: Nangin hampa ho nakhandohsah in ganchaho, thingphungho le mihemho manchah pha nasodoh sah'in ahi. Chujongleh nangman leiset chunga amaho dingin nehpha nasodohsah'in ahi.
English: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

tcz: Akipana diuvin adondiu lengpitwi nagonpeh in atahsauva akinu diuvin Olive thao nasosah'in, chule athaneina diuva nehding changlhah napen ahi.
en: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
text:
PSA 104:15
Thadou: Akipana diuvin adondiu lengpitwi nagonpeh in atahsauva akinu diuvin Olive thao nasosah'in, chule athaneina diuva nehding changlhah napen ahi.
English: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in athingphung hohi phatah'in akhoukhah in, Lebanon ah Cedar thingphung ho akedohsah'in,
en: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,
text:
PSA 104:16
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in athingphung hohi phatah'in akhoukhah in, Lebanon ah Cedar thingphung ho akedohsah'in,
English: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,

tcz: hichea chun vachaten abu-u akison un chuleh vakang ten Cypress thing chunga inn akise un ahi.
en: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.
text:
PSA 104:17
Thadou: hichea chun vachaten abu-u akison un chuleh vakang ten Cypress thing chunga inn akise un ahi.
English: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

tcz: Molsang chungvum langa gamlah kelho achengun chuleh songpi hochu kollah saho dingin na phatah'in apangin ahi.
en: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
text:
PSA 104:18
Thadou: Molsang chungvum langa gamlah kelho achengun chuleh songpi hochu kollah saho dingin na phatah'in apangin ahi.
English: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

tcz: Nangin lha nasemmin kum kiheichin aphongdoh e, chule nisan alhumding phatjong akihetne.
en: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
text:
PSA 104:19
Thadou: Nangin lha nasemmin kum kiheichin aphongdoh e, chule nisan alhumding phatjong akihetne.
English: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

tcz: Nangin janjong nasem in, jan ahunglhung jin ahi, gammang ganchaho anunkho jiuvin ahi.
en: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
text:
PSA 104:20
Thadou: Nangin janjong nasem in, jan ahunglhung jin ahi, gammang ganchaho anunkho jiuvin ahi.
English: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

tcz: Keipi nouhon amatdiu hochu angihjiuvin, Elohim Pathen in apeh'u amaho anchah hochu matdingin agemjiuvin ahi.
en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
text:
PSA 104:21
Thadou: Keipi nouhon amatdiu hochu angihjiuvin, Elohim Pathen in apeh'u amaho anchah hochu matdingin agemjiuvin ahi.
English: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

tcz: Jingpitah leh abusung uva kicholdo dingin anungche jiuvin ahi.
en: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.
text:
PSA 104:22
Thadou: Jingpitah leh abusung uva kicholdo dingin anungche jiuvin ahi.
English: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.

tcz: Hichejou tengle chun mipiho chu ama ama natohna dingcheh ajon un hicheachun nilhah gei in na atong ji tao ve.
en: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
text:
PSA 104:23
Thadou: Hichejou tengle chun mipiho chu ama ama natohna dingcheh ajon un hicheachun nilhah gei in na atong ji tao ve.
English: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangin thilho hi jatchom chom in nasem jinge! Nachihna a hiche hohi nasemdoh ahije. Leiset hi nathilsemsa ho adimset e.
en: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
text:
PSA 104:24
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangin thilho hi jatchom chom in nasem jinge! Nachihna a hiche hohi nasemdoh ahije. Leiset hi nathilsemsa ho adimset e.
English: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

tcz: Hiti chun twikhanglen lentah leh kiphahjal tah nasem in, asunga ganhing achatthei alen aneo nasem in ahi.
en: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
text:
PSA 104:25
Thadou: Hiti chun twikhanglen lentah leh kiphahjal tah nasem in, asunga ganhing achatthei alen aneo nasem in ahi.
English: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

tcz: Ven, kong inneiho akitol un, Leviathan jong twikhanglen'a kichem din nasem e.
en: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
text:
PSA 104:26
Thadou: Ven, kong inneiho akitol un, Leviathan jong twikhanglen'a kichem din nasem e.
English: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

tcz: Amaho jousen angaichat'u an amunadiu hi ngang chunga kingaicheh ahiuve.
en: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
text:
PSA 104:27
Thadou: Amaho jousen angaichat'u an amunadiu hi ngang chunga kingaicheh ahiuve.
English: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

tcz: Anehdiu nangin napehteng uleh amahon achomkhom jiuvin nangin nakhut a nalhangdoh in namop jin hiti chun amaho lungna chimset'in navah jin ahi.
en: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
text:
PSA 104:28
Thadou: Anehdiu nangin napehteng uleh amahon achomkhom jiuvin nangin nakhut a nalhangdoh in namop jin hiti chun amaho lungna chimset'in navah jin ahi.
English: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

tcz: Ahinla Nang, amahoa konna nakinunghei tengleh amaho kichadiu ahi. Nangin ahinna hu'u nalahdoh tengleh amaho thiding vutvai sohding ahitauve.
en: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
text:
PSA 104:29
Thadou: Ahinla Nang, amahoa konna nakinunghei tengleh amaho kichadiu ahi. Nangin ahinna hu'u nalahdoh tengleh amaho thiding vutvai sohding ahitauve.
English: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.

tcz: Nangin nahu napeh tengleh hinna nasemdohji a, hiteng chuleh leiset maihi akithahsem kitjin ahi.
en: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
text:
PSA 104:30
Thadou: Nangin nahu napeh tengleh hinna nasemdohji a, hiteng chuleh leiset maihi akithahsem kitjin ahi.
English: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai loupina hi tonsotnin umjing jenghen. Yahweh Pakai in athilsem jousea hin kipana aneiyin ahi.
en: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.
text:
PSA 104:31
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai loupina hi tonsotnin umjing jenghen. Yahweh Pakai in athilsem jousea hin kipana aneiyin ahi.
English: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.

tcz: Leiset hi avetleh akithing jengin molho jonghi akhoi khahleh meikhu alengdoh jengjin ahi.
en: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
text:
PSA 104:32
Thadou: Leiset hi avetleh akithing jengin molho jonghi akhoi khahleh meikhu alengdoh jengjin ahi.
English: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

tcz: Hinkho kanei laisen Yahweh Pakai vahchoi la sange, kahai hu bei chan geijin jong ka Pathen Elohim thangvah ingkate.
en: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
text:
PSA 104:33
Thadou: Hinkho kanei laisen Yahweh Pakai vahchoi la sange, kahai hu bei chan geijin jong ka Pathen Elohim thangvah ingkate.
English: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

tcz: Kalunggel ngaito jouse jonghi Ama lunglhaina hihen, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi kakipana ahi.
en: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.
text:
PSA 104:34
Thadou: Kalunggel ngaito jouse jonghi Ama lunglhaina hihen, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi kakipana ahi.
English: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.

tcz: Hiche leisetna konhin michonsete jouse mangthah gam jengu hen, miphalou ho jouse mangthah jengu hen. Kahina ho jouse pummin Yahweh Pakai thangvah ingkate, Yahweh Pakai loupina ding hitahen!
en: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 104:35
Thadou: Hiche leisetna konhin michonsete jouse mangthah gam jengu hen, miphalou ho jouse mangthah jengu hen. Kahina ho jouse pummin Yahweh Pakai thangvah ingkate, Yahweh Pakai loupina ding hitahen!
English: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kom a kipathu sei in aloupina samphong'un. Vannoi leiset mihemte jousen ipi abol ham heuhen,
en: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
text:
PSA 105:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai kom a kipathu sei in aloupina samphong'un. Vannoi leiset mihemte jousen ipi abol ham heuhen,
English: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

tcz: Aheng a la sauvin; henge avahchoila saovin. Athilbol kidangho hi mijouse seipeh'un,
en: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
text:
PSA 105:2
Thadou: Aheng a la sauvin; henge avahchoila saovin. Athilbol kidangho hi mijouse seipeh'un,
English: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

tcz: Amintheng hi domsang'un, nangho Yahweh Pakai chibai bohte jouse kipah'un,
en: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
text:
PSA 105:3
Thadou: Amintheng hi domsang'un, nangho Yahweh Pakai chibai bohte jouse kipah'un,
English: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai athahatna chu kholchil in phattin'in amachu hol'un,
en: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
text:
PSA 105:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai athahatna chu kholchil in phattin'in amachu hol'un,
English: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

tcz: datmo umtah tah atohdoh ho chuleh thilkidang abolho, athupeh eipeh hou,
en: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
text:
PSA 105:5
Thadou: datmo umtah tah atohdoh ho chuleh thilkidang abolho, athupeh eipeh hou,
English: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

tcz: nangho asoh Abraham chate ho, Jacob chilhah ho alhendoh sate ho, geldoh'un.
en: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
text:
PSA 105:6
Thadou: nangho asoh Abraham chate ho, Jacob chilhah ho alhendoh sate ho, geldoh'un.
English: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

tcz: Amahi Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim ahin, Ama thudih nahi gamsung jousea akimudoh sohkeijin
en: He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
text:
PSA 105:7
Thadou: Amahi Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim ahin, Ama thudih nahi gamsung jousea akimudoh sohkeijin
English: He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

tcz: Amahi akitepna itihchan hijongleh dingjing ahin, khang sangkhat dinga ana kipehdoh na,
en: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
text:
PSA 105:8
Thadou: Amahi akitepna itihchan hijongleh dingjing ahin, khang sangkhat dinga ana kipehdoh na,
English: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

tcz: Abraham toh anasem kitepna chuleh Issac kom a ana kihahselna,
en: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
text:
PSA 105:9
Thadou: Abraham toh anasem kitepna chuleh Issac kom a ana kihahselna,
English: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

tcz: Aman Jacob kom ah Dan khat apen anasuhdet in, chuleh Israel mipite dinga beithei lou kitepna ana sem in:
en: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
text:
PSA 105:10
Thadou: Aman Jacob kom ah Dan khat apen anasuhdet in, chuleh Israel mipite dinga beithei lou kitepna ana sem in:
English: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

tcz: “Keiman Canaan gam kapehding nahi, nang dinga jatchombeh'a kapeh natouphadiu gamchu ahi” anati.
en: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”
text:
PSA 105:11
Thadou: “Keiman Canaan gam kapehding nahi, nang dinga jatchombeh'a kapeh natouphadiu gamchu ahi” anati.
English: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

tcz: Aman hichehi hon lhomcha ahipet'uva, Canaan gama kholjin hon lhomcha ahipet uva anasei ahi.
en: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
text:
PSA 105:12
Thadou: Aman hichehi hon lhomcha ahipet'uva, Canaan gama kholjin hon lhomcha ahipet uva anasei ahi.
English: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

tcz: Amaho namkhat a kon a namkhat, leng gam khatna kona leng gam khat a akholjin pet'uva asei ahi.
en: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
text:
PSA 105:13
Thadou: Amaho namkhat a kon a namkhat, leng gam khatna kona leng gam khat a akholjin pet'uva asei ahi.
English: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

tcz: Aman koimacha anasuh genthei sahpon ahi. Aman amaho huhnan namdang lengho chu anagih'in ahi.
en: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
text:
PSA 105:14
Thadou: Aman koimacha anasuh genthei sahpon ahi. Aman amaho huhnan namdang lengho chu anagih'in ahi.
English: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

tcz: “Kami lhentum hochu tongkha hih'un, chuleh kathemgao hojong tongkhahih'un,” anati.
en: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
text:
PSA 105:15
Thadou: “Kami lhentum hochu tongkha hih'un, chuleh kathemgao hojong tongkhahih'un,” anati.
English: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

tcz: Aman nehle chah hochu akhahtan'in Canaan gamah kel analhahsah'in ahi,
en: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
text:
PSA 105:16
Thadou: Aman nehle chah hochu akhahtan'in Canaan gamah kel analhahsah'in ahi,
English: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

tcz: hiti chun amaho masanga Egypt gammachun mikhat anasol masan ahi, amaho soh a anajoh Joseph chu ahi.
en: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
text:
PSA 105:17
Thadou: hiti chun amaho masanga Egypt gammachun mikhat anasol masan ahi, amaho soh a anajoh Joseph chu ahi.
English: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

tcz: Amachu akengphang tenia thihkhao avouvin, angongchang'a thihkol a-opeh uve.
en: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
text:
PSA 105:18
Thadou: Amachu akengphang tenia thihkhao avouvin, angongchang'a thihkol a-opeh uve.
English: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

tcz: Amang lolhinna dinga thil ahung sodoh tokah'in Yahweh Pakai in Joseph chu ahina tahbeh hetdohna dingin ana patepmin ahi.
en: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.
text:
PSA 105:19
Thadou: Amang lolhinna dinga thil ahung sodoh tokah'in Yahweh Pakai in Joseph chu ahina tahbeh hetdohna dingin ana patepmin ahi.
English: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.

tcz: Hichejou chun Pharoah'in amachu agakousah'in alhadohtai; Gamsung vaipopan songkul kotchu ahonpeh tai.
en: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
text:
PSA 105:20
Thadou: Hichejou chun Pharoah'in amachu agakousah'in alhadohtai; Gamsung vaipopan songkul kotchu ahonpeh tai.
English: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

tcz: Joseph chu lengpa insunga thil jouse chunga vaihom dingin apansahtan ahi. Hiti chun lengpa thil ho jouse chungah vaipon ahung pangtai.
en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,
text:
PSA 105:21
Thadou: Joseph chu lengpa insunga thil jouse chunga vaihom dingin apansahtan ahi. Hiti chun lengpa thil ho jouse chungah vaipon ahung pangtai.
English: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

tcz: Hiti chun aman adei bang tah in lengpa noi a vaihom pipuiho chu avaihop in chule lengpa thumop lea pang ho chu ahil ji tai.
en: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
text:
PSA 105:22
Thadou: Hiti chun aman adei bang tah in lengpa noi a vaihom pipuiho chu avaihop in chule lengpa thumop lea pang ho chu ahil ji tai.
English: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

tcz: Hi jouchun Israel chu Egypt gam alhungtan, Jacob chu Ham gamsunga chun gamchom mi hinan ana chengtan ahi.
en: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
text:
PSA 105:23
Thadou: Hi jouchun Israel chu Egypt gam alhungtan, Jacob chu Ham gamsunga chun gamchom mi hinan ana chengtan ahi.
English: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in Israel mipite chu hapun'in apunsah tan hiti chun agalmite diuvin kichat aumleu tauvin ahi.
en: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
text:
PSA 105:24
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in Israel mipite chu hapun'in apunsah tan hiti chun agalmite diuvin kichat aumleu tauvin ahi.
English: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

tcz: Hichun Egypt te chu Israelte vetda dingin atildoh tan hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai mite dounan tohgon aneitauvin ahi.
en: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
text:
PSA 105:25
Thadou: Hichun Egypt te chu Israelte vetda dingin atildoh tan hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai mite dounan tohgon aneitauvin ahi.
English: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

tcz: Ahin Elohim Pathen nin asoh Mose chu ahinsol'in aman ana lhendoh Aaron chutoh asolthan ahi.
en: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
text:
PSA 105:26
Thadou: Ahin Elohim Pathen nin asoh Mose chu ahinsol'in aman ana lhendoh Aaron chutoh asolthan ahi.
English: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

tcz: Amanin Egypt mite dounan melchihna kidangtah chuleh datmo umtah tah Ham gamsunga anatongdoh lhonnin ahi.
en: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
text:
PSA 105:27
Thadou: Amanin Egypt mite dounan melchihna kidangtah chuleh datmo umtah tah Ham gamsunga anatongdoh lhonnin ahi.
English: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in Egypt chu mu anathimsah tan ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Yahweh Pakai thupeh Israelte soldoh dingchu ananom pouvin ahi.
en: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
text:
PSA 105:28
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in Egypt chu mu anathimsah tan ahi. Ajeh chu amahon Yahweh Pakai thupeh Israelte soldoh dingchu ananom pouvin ahi.
English: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

tcz: Aman twi thisan anasosah'in, ngaho dingin thina thei gu ahitan ahi.
en: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
text:
PSA 105:29
Thadou: Aman twi thisan anasosah'in, ngaho dingin thina thei gu ahitan ahi.
English: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

tcz: Uphoh honjong agamsung'u alonvuh jengin lengpa lupna dansang jenga jong alhailut jengun ahi.
en: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
text:
PSA 105:30
Thadou: Uphoh honjong agamsung'u alonvuh jengin lengpa lupna dansang jenga jong alhailut jengun ahi.
English: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thu aseileh thousiho Egypt mite chunga ahung chu'uvin, Egypt gam pumpi thousi vaibong'in alo jengin ahi.
en: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
text:
PSA 105:31
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in thu aseileh thousiho Egypt mite chunga ahung chu'uvin, Egypt gam pumpi thousi vaibong'in alo jengin ahi.
English: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

tcz: Aman go khel in gel anajuhsah'in, keh in agamsung'u anasepchap jengin ahi.
en: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
text:
PSA 105:32
Thadou: Aman go khel in gel anajuhsah'in, keh in agamsung'u anasepchap jengin ahi.
English: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

tcz: Aman alengpithei uleh atheichang ujong asuhmangpeh'in athingphung houjong asatchap jengin ahi.
en: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
text:
PSA 105:33
Thadou: Aman alengpithei uleh atheichang ujong asuhmangpeh'in athingphung houjong asatchap jengin ahi.
English: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

tcz: Aman thu aseileh khaokhote ahung kitollutnun khaokho noute jong simsenlou ahung kitollut tauvin ahi.
en: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.
text:
PSA 105:34
Thadou: Aman thu aseileh khaokhote ahung kitollutnun khaokho noute jong simsenlou ahung kitollut tauvin ahi.
English: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.

tcz: Amahon gamsunga ado eng jouse anechai jengun, loulai a anche louhing jouse jong achaidoh jengun ahi.
en: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.
text:
PSA 105:35
Thadou: Amahon gamsunga ado eng jouse anechai jengun, loulai a anche louhing jouse jong achaidoh jengun ahi.
English: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

tcz: Hiche jouchun Aman Egypt te insung jousea chapa tahpen ho aban thapeh'in ahi. Hiti chun aki letsah pipen ule aki panapen hou asuhbei peh'in ahi.
en: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
text:
PSA 105:36
Thadou: Hiche jouchun Aman Egypt te insung jousea chapa tahpen ho aban thapeh'in ahi. Hiti chun aki letsah pipen ule aki panapen hou asuhbei peh'in ahi.
English: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in amite chu sana le dangka dimset pum in Egypt'a kon in ahin puidoh'in, Israel phungho lah'a khat chajong akipallhua aumpouvin ahi.
en: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
text:
PSA 105:37
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in amite chu sana le dangka dimset pum in Egypt'a kon in ahin puidoh'in, Israel phungho lah'a khat chajong akipallhua aumpouvin ahi.
English: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

tcz: Egypt miten nana kichat behseh jeh'un apotdoh uchu ana kipapi lheh jengun ahi.
en: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
text:
PSA 105:38
Thadou: Egypt miten nana kichat behseh jeh'un apotdoh uchu ana kipapi lheh jengun ahi.
English: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in sunleh meilom akhu khum sah'in janleh meikong in asalvah peh'in ahi.
en: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
text:
PSA 105:39
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in sunleh meilom akhu khum sah'in janleh meikong in asalvah peh'in ahi.
English: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

tcz: Amahon sa athum uleh vamim alhalutpeh'in a-oivana diuvin van changlhah mama chu anapen ahi.
en: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
text:
PSA 105:40
Thadou: Amahon sa athum uleh vamim alhalutpeh'in a-oivana diuvin van changlhah mama chu anapen ahi.
English: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

tcz: Aman songpi chu ahomsah'in twi ahung kiphidoh sah'in gamchai lah'a vadung bangin alondonsah'un ahi.
en: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
text:
PSA 105:41
Thadou: Aman songpi chu ahomsah'in twi ahung kiphidoh sah'in gamchai lah'a vadung bangin alondonsah'un ahi.
English: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman asohpa Abraham kom a akitepna atheng chu ageldoh'in,
en: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
text:
PSA 105:42
Thadou: Ajeh chu Aman asohpa Abraham kom a akitepna atheng chu ageldoh'in,
English: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

tcz: hijeh chun amite Egypt'a kon in amilhendoh chu kipah tah'in ahin puidoh'in ahi.
en: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
text:
PSA 105:43
Thadou: hijeh chun amite Egypt'a kon in amilhendoh chu kipah tah'in ahin puidoh'in ahi.
English: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

tcz: Aman gamsung mite Elohim Pathen helou chitin namtinte chenna chu alahpeh'in Ama mite hochu apen, hiti chun amahon mi tusa chang ga hochu aki-at'un ahi.
en: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
text:
PSA 105:44
Thadou: Aman gamsung mite Elohim Pathen helou chitin namtinte chenna chu alahpeh'in Ama mite hochu apen, hiti chun amahon mi tusa chang ga hochu aki-at'un ahi.
English: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

tcz: Hitiho jouse anachelhah sahchu amahon a Dan thupeh leh athuhil ho dungjui a achon nadiu adeijeh ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 105:45
Thadou: Hitiho jouse anachelhah sahchu amahon a Dan thupeh leh athuhil ho dungjui a achon nadiu adeijeh ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
English: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen! Elohim Pathen chu aphatna jeh'in thangvahna peuvin.
en: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
text:
PSA 106:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen! Elohim Pathen chu aphatna jeh'in thangvahna peuvin.
English: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thil loupi kidangtah atohdoh hohi kon asim jou ding ham? Kon Amahi ahina bangtah'in athangvah joudem?
en: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?
text:
PSA 106:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in thil loupi kidangtah atohdoh hohi kon asim jou ding ham? Kon Amahi ahina bangtah'in athangvah joudem?
English: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?

tcz: Mi ahina bangtah a pachatna pethei holeh phat tin a adih jeng bol hon kipana aneithei jengun ahi.
en: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.
text:
PSA 106:3
Thadou: Mi ahina bangtah a pachatna pethei holeh phat tin a adih jeng bol hon kipana aneithei jengun ahi.
English: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin namite khotona namusah tengleh neihin geldoh'in lang neihin nai in neihuhdoh'in.
en: Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
text:
PSA 106:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nangin namite khotona namusah tengleh neihin geldoh'in lang neihin nai in neihuhdoh'in.
English: Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

tcz: Nalhendoh namite phatthei naboh nahoa keijong chan neineisah'in. Namite kipana a keijong neikipa sah'in. Nagou chang toh nangma thangvah khom kanom e.
en: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
text:
PSA 106:5
Thadou: Nalhendoh namite phatthei naboh nahoa keijong chan neineisah'in. Namite kipana a keijong neikipa sah'in. Nagou chang toh nangma thangvah khom kanom e.
English: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

tcz: Kapu kapateu bangin keiho jong kachonse tauve, keihon kabolkhel tauve, keiho phaloutah'in kanachon tauve,
en: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.
text:
PSA 106:6
Thadou: Kapu kapateu bangin keiho jong kachonse tauve, keihon kabolkhel tauve, keiho phaloutah'in kanachon tauve,
English: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.

tcz: Egypt gam a ana um kapu kapateu chu Yahweh Pakai in thil kidang aboldoh ho chun atilkhou pouve. Amahon adinguva Yahweh Pakai phatna hochu ana sumil loiji tauve. Amahon twikhanglen san mun nachun Yahweh Pakai dounan ahung phunchel tauvin ahi.
en: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
text:
PSA 106:7
Thadou: Egypt gam a ana um kapu kapateu chu Yahweh Pakai in thil kidang aboldoh ho chun atilkhou pouve. Amahon adinguva Yahweh Pakai phatna hochu ana sumil loiji tauve. Amahon twikhanglen san mun nachun Yahweh Pakai dounan ahung phunchel tauvin ahi.
English: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

tcz: Achuti jeng vangun, Amin loupe dopsangna dingleh athaneina thupitah chu akilandohna dingin amaho chu ana huhdoh thouthou jin ahi.
en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
text:
PSA 106:8
Thadou: Achuti jeng vangun, Amin loupe dopsangna dingleh athaneina thupitah chu akilandohna dingin amaho chu ana huhdoh thouthou jin ahi.
English: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

tcz: Aman twikhanglen sanchu akan-na dingin thu apen, Aman twikhanglen chu neldigam abahsah'in Israelte chu ahinpui galkai in ahi.
en: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
text:
PSA 106:9
Thadou: Aman twikhanglen sanchu akan-na dingin thu apen, Aman twikhanglen chu neldigam abahsah'in Israelte chu ahinpui galkai in ahi.
English: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

tcz: Hiti chun agalmiteuva kon in anahuhdoh jin, chuleh akidoupihoa kon in ana hoidohsah'in ahi.
en: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
text:
PSA 106:10
Thadou: Hiti chun agalmiteuva kon in anahuhdoh jin, chuleh akidoupihoa kon in ana hoidohsah'in ahi.
English: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

tcz: Twichu akinung ledoh sah'in agalmiteu akhukhum jin khatcha jong anahingdoh pouvin ahi.
en: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.
text:
PSA 106:11
Thadou: Twichu akinung ledoh sah'in agalmiteu akhukhum jin khatcha jong anahingdoh pouvin ahi.
English: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.

tcz: Hitengle chun amiten akitepna chu atahsan jiuvin Ama vahchoina la chu asajiuvin ahi.
en: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
text:
PSA 106:12
Thadou: Hitengle chun amiten akitepna chu atahsan jiuvin Ama vahchoina la chu asajiuvin ahi.
English: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

tcz: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai in abolpeh houchu gangtah'in asumilji tauvin, Ama thuhil angahji pouvin ahi.
en: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
text:
PSA 106:13
Thadou: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai in abolpeh houchu gangtah'in asumilji tauvin, Ama thuhil angahji pouvin ahi.
English: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,

tcz: Gamthip noi achun amaho tahsa ngaichat thilngen anathum'un hiche gamchai lah'a chun Elohim Pathen chu anapatep'un,
en: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
text:
PSA 106:14
Thadou: Gamthip noi achun amaho tahsa ngaichat thilngen anathum'un hiche gamchai lah'a chun Elohim Pathen chu anapatep'un,
English: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.

tcz: hijeh chun Aman angaichat'u chu anapen ahinlah nat na toh apehthan ahi.
en: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
text:
PSA 106:15
Thadou: hijeh chun Aman angaichat'u chu anapen ahinlah nat na toh apehthan ahi.
English: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

tcz: Camp sunga umhochu Mose chungah athangthipmun chuleh Yahweh Pakai thempu theng Aaron a-ot'un ahi.
en: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.
text:
PSA 106:16
Thadou: Camp sunga umhochu Mose chungah athangthipmun chuleh Yahweh Pakai thempu theng Aaron a-ot'un ahi.
English: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.

tcz: Hichejeh chun leiset chu ahung kamkan, Dathan, Abiram leh akiphinho jouse chu anavallhum'in avuimangtan ahi.
en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
text:
PSA 106:17
Thadou: Hichejeh chun leiset chu ahung kamkan, Dathan, Abiram leh akiphinho jouse chu anavallhum'in avuimangtan ahi.
English: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

tcz: Anungjui ho chungah meikong achun miphalou ho jouse chu meikong'in ahalgam tan ahi.
en: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
text:
PSA 106:18
