Thadou: Anungjui ho chungah meikong achun miphalou ho jouse chu meikong'in ahalgam tan ahi.
English: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

tcz: Sinai mol'a sana a kisem bongnou chu chibai aboh'un,
en: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
text:
PSA 106:19
Thadou: Sinai mol'a sana a kisem bongnou chu chibai aboh'un,
English: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

tcz: Loupitah Elohim Pathen chu hampane bonglim toh analheh tauve.
en: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
text:
PSA 106:20
Thadou: Loupitah Elohim Pathen chu hampane bonglim toh analheh tauve.
English: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

tcz: Amahon ahuhingpau, Egypt gamma konna ahinpuidoh pau,
en: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
text:
PSA 106:21
Thadou: Amahon ahuhingpau, Egypt gamma konna ahinpuidoh pau,
English: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,

tcz: Ham gam sunga thil kidang tamtah ahin boldohpeh pau, twikhanglen san na gimneitah thil ana tongdohpa a Pathen'u Elohim chu anasumil tauvin ahi.
en: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.
text:
PSA 106:22
Thadou: Ham gam sunga thil kidang tamtah ahin boldohpeh pau, twikhanglen san na gimneitah thil ana tongdohpa a Pathen'u Elohim chu anasumil tauvin ahi.
English: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.

tcz: Hijeh chun Aman kasuhmang ding ahi tin anaphongdoh tan ahi. Ahinlah Mose, lhendoh mipa chu Yahweh Pakai leh amipite kikah'a anadingtan, aman Yahweh Pakai kommachun alunghanna'a konna kile heija amipite chu asuhmang louna dingin ataotai.
en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.
text:
PSA 106:23
Thadou: Hijeh chun Aman kasuhmang ding ahi tin anaphongdoh tan ahi. Ahinlah Mose, lhendoh mipa chu Yahweh Pakai leh amipite kikah'a anadingtan, aman Yahweh Pakai kommachun alunghanna'a konna kile heija amipite chu asuhmang louna dingin ataotai.
English: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.

tcz: Mipite chu gam nom lutding chu ana nom tapouvin ahi, ajeh chu Elohim Pathen in ana kitepna banga apuihoi dingchu ana nom tapouvin ahi.
en: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
text:
PSA 106:24
Thadou: Mipite chu gam nom lutding chu ana nom tapouvin ahi, ajeh chu Elohim Pathen in ana kitepna banga apuihoi dingchu ana nom tapouvin ahi.
English: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,

tcz: Ajeh chu akaleh langin achon un, aponbuh sung uvah ana phunchel gam un, Yahweh Pakai thu anangainom pouvin,
en: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice.
text:
PSA 106:25
Thadou: Ajeh chu akaleh langin achon un, aponbuh sung uvah ana phunchel gam un, Yahweh Pakai thu anangainom pouvin,
English: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice.

tcz: hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai chu lunghemtah'in ana kihahsel'in amahohi hiche gamthip noi a kathagam ding ahiuve anatitai.
en: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
text:
PSA 106:26
Thadou: hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai chu lunghemtah'in ana kihahsel'in amahohi hiche gamthip noi a kathagam ding ahiuve anatitai.
English: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

tcz: Chutengleh ason apahteu chu chitin namtin lah'a kathejal sohding, chuleh gamla tah tah'a kaimang'a umdiu ahi ati.
en: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.
text:
PSA 106:27
Thadou: Chutengleh ason apahteu chu chitin namtin lah'a kathejal sohding, chuleh gamla tah tah'a kaimang'a umdiu ahi ati.
English: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

tcz: Hiti chun, ipu apateu chu Baal leh Peor chibai bohna a anapang'un, mithi dinga kikatdoh sa jengjong ananeuvin ahi.
en: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
text:
PSA 106:28
Thadou: Hiti chun, ipu apateu chu Baal leh Peor chibai bohna a anapang'un, mithi dinga kikatdoh sa jengjong ananeuvin ahi.
English: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

tcz: Hitiho jehhin amahon Yahweh Pakai chu ana sulang hangun hijeh chun alah uva natset analangtan ahi.
en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.
text:
PSA 106:29
Thadou: Hitiho jehhin amahon Yahweh Pakai chu ana sulang hangun hijeh chun alah uva natset analangtan ahi.
English: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

tcz: Ahinla Phenehas kitipa chun hangsantah'in nat se chu ana tingtan'in ahileh natset chu atangtai.
en: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
text:
PSA 106:30
Thadou: Ahinla Phenehas kitipa chun hangsantah'in nat se chu ana tingtan'in ahileh natset chu atangtai.
English: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.

tcz: Hijeh chun hichea patchun michonpha tin jana anapetauvin ahi.
en: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.
text:
PSA 106:31
Thadou: Hijeh chun hichea patchun michonpha tin jana anapetauvin ahi.
English: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.

tcz: Meribah-a jong Yahweh Pakai chu ana lunghansah'un hichun Mose chu anasuboi lheh'in ahi.
en: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;

tcz: Amahon Mose chu analunghan sah'un ahileh aman ngolkaitah'in thu anaseilo tan ahi
en: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.
text:
PSA 106:33
Thadou: Amahon Mose chu analunghan sah'un ahileh aman ngolkaitah'in thu anaseilo tan ahi
English: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

tcz: Israelten chidang namdang hochu Yahweh Pakai in thu anapeh dungjui in anasohjou pouvin,
en: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,
text:
PSA 106:34
Thadou: Israelten chidang namdang hochu Yahweh Pakai in thu anapeh dungjui in anasohjou pouvin,
English: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,

tcz: hichu hilouvin agamsung mite lah'a chun ana chenghal un achonnao phaloutah hochu ana joptauvin,
en: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
text:
PSA 106:35
Thadou: hichu hilouvin agamsung mite lah'a chun ana chenghal un achonnao phaloutah hochu ana joptauvin,
English: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

tcz: amilim doi houvu chu anahou un hichun alhuhnao asodohsahtan ahi.
en: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
text:
PSA 106:36
Thadou: amilim doi houvu chu anahou un hichun alhuhnao asodohsahtan ahi.
English: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

tcz: Amahon achateu kisan chu anakatdoh'un chuleh achanuteu jengjong thillha hounan anapedoh'un,
en: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
text:
PSA 106:37
Thadou: Amahon achateu kisan chu anakatdoh'un chuleh achanuteu jengjong thillha hounan anapedoh'un,
English: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

tcz: amahon themmona neilou thisan anasouvin, achapateu leh achanuteu thisan chu Canaan mite doi hounan anamang'un tolthanan gamsung chu anasuboh'un,
en: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.
text:
PSA 106:38
Thadou: amahon themmona neilou thisan anasouvin, achapateu leh achanuteu thisan chu Canaan mite doi hounan anamang'un tolthanan gamsung chu anasuboh'un,
English: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.

tcz: amahole amaho jong thilgilou bolnan anakisuboh'un adoihou thanopnau chu Yahweh Pakai mitmun jonthanhoi ana hidohtan ahi.
en: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.
text:
PSA 106:39
Thadou: amahole amaho jong thilgilou bolnan anakisuboh'un adoihou thanopnau chu Yahweh Pakai mitmun jonthanhoi ana hidohtan ahi.
English: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.

tcz: Hichejeh chun Yahweh Pakai lunghanna chu amite chungah anakoudoh jengin ahileh Yahweh Pakai in ama-a tum hochu ana kidah lotan ahi.
en: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
text:
PSA 106:40
Thadou: Hichejeh chun Yahweh Pakai lunghanna chu amite chungah anakoudoh jengin ahileh Yahweh Pakai in ama-a tum hochu ana kidah lotan ahi.
English: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

tcz: Hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu agamsung nammite lah'a chun ana pedoh'in chuleh athet nammiteu chun amaho chungah vai anahomji tauvin ahi.
en: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.
text:
PSA 106:41
Thadou: Hijeh chun Yahweh Pakai in amaho chu agamsung nammite lah'a chun ana pedoh'in chuleh athet nammiteu chun amaho chungah vai anahomji tauvin ahi.
English: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.

tcz: Agalmi houchun asugep jiuvin chuleh abolgimnao khut thahatna noi a anakoiji tauvin ahi.
en: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.
text:
PSA 106:42
Thadou: Agalmi houchun asugep jiuvin chuleh abolgimnao khut thahatna noi a anakoiji tauvin ahi.
English: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

tcz: Avel vellin Aman ahuhdohjin, ahinlah amahon Ama dounan akipedohji tauvin ahi, chutengleh amaho chu achonset jeh'un suhmangin aumji tauvin ahi.
en: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.
text:
PSA 106:43
Thadou: Avel vellin Aman ahuhdohjin, ahinlah amahon Ama dounan akipedohji tauvin ahi, chutengleh amaho chu achonset jeh'un suhmangin aumji tauvin ahi.
English: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

tcz: Ahijeng vangin ahahsat tenguleh Aman akhotokit jiuvin akanao angaipeh kitjitan ahi.
en: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
text:
PSA 106:44
Thadou: Ahijeng vangin ahahsat tenguleh Aman akhotokit jiuvin akanao angaipeh kitjitan ahi.
English: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.

tcz: Aman amaho toh akitepnao ahin geldoh kitji in angailutna chultheilou jeh in alung ahinhei kitji in,
en: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
text:
PSA 106:45
Thadou: Aman amaho toh akitepnao ahin geldoh kitji in angailutna chultheilou jeh in alung ahinhei kitji in,
English: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

tcz: Aman ganhing a amanteu khutnah khotona amusah kitji nalaijin ahi.
en: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
text:
PSA 106:46
Thadou: Aman ganhing a amanteu khutnah khotona amusah kitji nalaijin ahi.
English: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen'u Elohim neihuhdoh'un! Chitin namtin lah'a konhin neichomkhom kitnun hitiachu namintheng kathangvah theina diuvin chuleh kipah a nangma kathangvah theina diuvin.
en: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!
text:
PSA 106:47
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen'u Elohim neihuhdoh'un! Chitin namtin lah'a konhin neichomkhom kitnun hitiachu namintheng kathangvah theina diuvin chuleh kipah a nangma kathangvah theina diuvin.
English: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

tcz: Israel Pathen Elohim, Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un, Amahi tonsot'a pat tonsot geija hingjing Elohim Pathen ahi! Mi jousen “Amen” tiuhen. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 106:48
Thadou: Israel Pathen Elohim, Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un, Amahi tonsot'a pat tonsot geija hingjing Elohim Pathen ahi! Mi jousen “Amen” tiuhen. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
English: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi aphatjeh'in thangvahna peuvin, Ami ngailutna dihtah hi tonsot'a dettou jing ahi.
en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
text:
PSA 107:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi aphatjeh'in thangvahna peuvin, Ami ngailutna dihtah hi tonsot'a dettou jing ahi.
English: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in nalhatdoh hitam? Achutileh phongdoh'in! Aman namelma holah'a kon a nahoidohsahhi miho seipeh'in.
en: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
text:
PSA 107:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in nalhatdoh hitam? Achutileh phongdoh'in! Aman namelma holah'a kon a nahoidohsahhi miho seipeh'in.
English: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman gam tamtah a kon in solamle lhumlam'a kon in, sahlam le lhanglam a kon in sohchangho ahin puikhom'in ahi.
en: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
text:
PSA 107:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu Aman gam tamtah a kon in solamle lhumlam'a kon in, sahlam le lhanglam a kon in sohchangho ahin puikhom'in ahi.
English: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

tcz: Miloi khat hi gamthip gam mah avah mang'un, in le lou beijin avah mang'un,
en: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
text:
PSA 107:4
Thadou: Miloi khat hi gamthip gam mah avah mang'un, in le lou beijin avah mang'un,
English: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

tcz: Gilkil leh dangchah geovin a thiding konchan aum mun,
en: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
text:
PSA 107:5
Thadou: Gilkil leh dangchah geovin a thiding konchan aum mun,
English: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

tcz: “Yahweh Pakai neipanpin” tin ahahsat nauva Pakai Yahweh akouvun, chuteng Aman agenthei nauva konnin ahuhdoh jin ahi.
en: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
text:
PSA 107:6
Thadou: “Yahweh Pakai neipanpin” tin ahahsat nauva Pakai Yahweh akouvun, chuteng Aman agenthei nauva konnin ahuhdoh jin ahi.
English: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

tcz: Aman amaho chu bitkei chan apuijin achenna theiju khopi khatna akoiyin ahi.
en: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
text:
PSA 107:7
Thadou: Aman amaho chu bitkei chan apuijin achenna theiju khopi khatna akoiyin ahi.
English: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu angailutna thupi tah jehleh thil kidang tahtah abolpeh jeh'un thangvahna peuhen.
en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
text:
PSA 107:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu angailutna thupi tah jehleh thil kidang tahtah abolpeh jeh'un thangvahna peuhen.
English: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman adangchah ho adangnou sah'in, agilkil'ho thilpha tamtah tothon a-oiva sahjin ahi.
en: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
text:
PSA 107:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu Aman adangchah ho adangnou sah'in, agilkil'ho thilpha tamtah tothon a-oiva sahjin ahi.
English: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

tcz: Miloikhat muthim lah athimlah pen a atouvin, lung gimna thihkhao vin ahen oh'in ahi.
en: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
text:
PSA 107:10
Thadou: Miloikhat muthim lah athimlah pen a atouvin, lung gimna thihkhao vin ahen oh'in ahi.
English: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

tcz: Amaho Elohim Pathen thu dounan akiphin un, Elohim Pathen thumop chu anelpeh'un ahi.
en: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
text:
PSA 107:11
Thadou: Amaho Elohim Pathen thu dounan akiphin un, Elohim Pathen thumop chu anelpeh'un ahi.
English: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

tcz: Hijeh chun Aman amaho chu akhut hamtah in avo lhun, amaho alhuh phatnun koima akithopidiu aumpon ahi.
en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
text:
PSA 107:12
Thadou: Hijeh chun Aman amaho chu akhut hamtah in avo lhun, amaho alhuh phatnun koima akithopidiu aumpon ahi.
English: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

tcz: Ahahsat tenguleh Yahweh Pakai akoujiuvin “Yahweh Pakai neipanpin” atiuve. Hitengle chun Aman athohgim nauva kon in ahuhdohjin ahi.
en: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
text:
PSA 107:13
Thadou: Ahahsat tenguleh Yahweh Pakai akoujiuvin “Yahweh Pakai neipanpin” atiuve. Hitengle chun Aman athohgim nauva kon in ahuhdohjin ahi.
English: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

tcz: Aman amaho chu muthimleh ahahsatnau thimjin banga thimlah a kon in apui galkaijin akihennao asutlhappeh'in ahi.
en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
text:
PSA 107:14
Thadou: Aman amaho chu muthimleh ahahsatnau thimjin banga thimlah a kon in apui galkaijin akihennao asutlhappeh'in ahi.
English: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu ami ngailutna thupitah jehleh thil kidangtah tah abolpeh jeh'in thangvah uhen,
en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
text:
PSA 107:15
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu ami ngailutna thupitah jehleh thil kidangtah tah abolpeh jeh'in thangvah uhen,
English: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

tcz: ajeh chu Aman sum-eng songkul kotpi avohlhahpeh'in chuleh akihennao thihkhao avohtan pehtan ahi.
en: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.
text:
PSA 107:16
Thadou: ajeh chu Aman sum-eng songkul kotpi avohlhahpeh'in chuleh akihennao thihkhao avohtan pehtan ahi.
English: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

tcz: Mingol themkhat chun boina asemuvin achonset jeh'un thohgimna atoh'un ahi.
en: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
text:
PSA 107:17
Thadou: Mingol themkhat chun boina asemuvin achonset jeh'un thohgimna atoh'un ahi.
English: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

tcz: An le twi ngaichatnan athohlel lheh'un hiti chun amaho chu athiding kon ahiuve.
en: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
text:
PSA 107:18
Thadou: An le twi ngaichatnan athohlel lheh'un hiti chun amaho chu athiding kon ahiuve.
English: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

tcz: “Yahweh Pakai neikithopin” tin ahahsat tenguleh Yahweh Pakai akoujiuvin Aman athohgim nauva kon in ahuhdohjin ahi.
en: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.
text:
PSA 107:19
Thadou: “Yahweh Pakai neikithopin” tin ahahsat tenguleh Yahweh Pakai akoujiuvin Aman athohgim nauva kon in ahuhdohjin ahi.
English: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

tcz: Aman thu changkhat agahseijin aboldamjin, thina kotbul a kon in aloidohtan ahi.
en: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
text:
PSA 107:20
Thadou: Aman thu changkhat agahseijin aboldamjin, thina kotbul a kon in aloidohtan ahi.
English: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

tcz: Ami lungsetna thupi tah jehleh amaho dinga thil kidang tamtah anabolpeh jeh'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuhen.
en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
text:
PSA 107:21
Thadou: Ami lungsetna thupi tah jehleh amaho dinga thil kidang tamtah anabolpeh jeh'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuhen.
English: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

tcz: Kilhaina gantha pummin thangvahna peuhen, chuleh athilbol kidangtah ho jeh'in thangvahna peuhen.
en: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
text:
PSA 107:22
Thadou: Kilhaina gantha pummin thangvahna peuhen, chuleh athilbol kidangtah ho jeh'in thangvahna peuhen.
English: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

tcz: Mi phabep chu kong innei mangchan twikhanglen'ah vannoi leiset kiveina lampi ajot un akitollun ahi.
en: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,
text:
PSA 107:23
Thadou: Mi phabep chu kong innei mangchan twikhanglen'ah vannoi leiset kiveina lampi ajot un akitollun ahi.
English: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

tcz: Amaho jonghin twikhanglen athuhlang tah'a Yahweh Pakai thuneitah'a anatoh naleh thil thupi tahtah abolna ho amu'vin ahi.
en: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
text:
PSA 107:24
Thadou: Amaho jonghin twikhanglen athuhlang tah'a Yahweh Pakai thuneitah'a anatoh naleh thil thupi tahtah abolna ho amu'vin ahi.
English: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

tcz: Aman thu aseijin hui ahungnung doh'in twikhanglen ahin kinongsah'in ahi.
en: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
text:
PSA 107:25
Thadou: Aman thu aseijin hui ahungnung doh'in twikhanglen ahin kinongsah'in ahi.
English: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

tcz: Kong innei hochu vanlanga anuh touvin chule twi thuhlah'a ahung kilehlut kitjin kongtol hochu kichatnan akileh leuvin ahi.
en: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
text:
PSA 107:26
Thadou: Kong innei hochu vanlanga anuh touvin chule twi thuhlah'a ahung kilehlut kitjin kongtol hochu kichatnan akileh leuvin ahi.
English: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

tcz: Amaho jukham ho bangin a-onle leuvin kichat tijat nan adim'un ahi.
en: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
text:
PSA 107:27
Thadou: Amaho jukham ho bangin a-onle leuvin kichat tijat nan adim'un ahi.
English: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

tcz: “Yahweh Pakai neihuh'un” tin ahahsat phatnun Yahweh Pakai akouvun, Amanjong agimnauva kon in ahuhdohjin ahi.
en: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
text:
PSA 107:28
Thadou: “Yahweh Pakai neihuh'un” tin ahahsat phatnun Yahweh Pakai akouvun, Amanjong agimnauva kon in ahuhdohjin ahi.
English: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

tcz: A-o neochakhat'in hui le guo kithochu athipsah'in chuleh twi kinong jong asutang'in ahi.
en: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
text:
PSA 107:29
Thadou: A-o neochakhat'in hui le guo kithochu athipsah'in chuleh twi kinong jong asutang'in ahi.
English: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

tcz: Hiche athip theina chu ichan gei a pha a phatthei bohna hitam? Kongchu kong mun'ah bitkeichan apuilut in ahi.
en: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
text:
PSA 107:30
Thadou: Hiche athip theina chu ichan gei a pha a phatthei bohna hitam? Kongchu kong mun'ah bitkeichan apuilut in ahi.
English: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu angailutna thupitah jehleh thilkidang tamtah abolpeh jeh'un thangvahna peuhen.
en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
text:
PSA 107:31
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu angailutna thupitah jehleh thilkidang tamtah abolpeh jeh'un thangvahna peuhen.
English: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

tcz: Nam lamkaiho masangleh, mipi kikhomho masangah japi hetthei doltah'in thangvahna peuhen.
en: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
text:
PSA 107:32
Thadou: Nam lamkaiho masangleh, mipi kikhomho masangah japi hetthei doltah'in thangvahna peuhen.
English: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

tcz: Aman vadung jong neldigam aso sahjin, twisam putna munho jong gamgo leh adang chahna aso sahjin ahi.
en: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
text:
PSA 107:33
Thadou: Aman vadung jong neldigam aso sahjin, twisam putna munho jong gamgo leh adang chahna aso sahjin ahi.
English: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

tcz: Aman ga phatah sona gam phatah jong ima sodoh louna chitwi-al gamgo asosah thei in ahi, agam sunga cheng mipite phatmo jeh'a hitiachu abolji ahi.
en: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
text:
PSA 107:34
Thadou: Aman ga phatah sona gam phatah jong ima sodoh louna chitwi-al gamgo asosah thei in ahi, agam sunga cheng mipite phatmo jeh'a hitiachu abolji ahi.
English: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

tcz: Ahinlah Aman neldigam chu twikul asosah'in, chuleh gamgo jong twi putna mun aso sahjin ahi.
en: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
text:
PSA 107:35
Thadou: Ahinlah Aman neldigam chu twikul asosah'in, chuleh gamgo jong twi putna mun aso sahjin ahi.
English: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

tcz: Aman gilkel dangchah techu khopi semdoh dinga hiche mun a chu achensah ding ahi.
en: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
text:
PSA 107:36
Thadou: Aman gilkel dangchah techu khopi semdoh dinga hiche mun a chu achensah ding ahi.
English: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

tcz: Amahon aloulai uva muchi kitheuvin tin lengpigui tu uvintin ga lhingsetna akilodiu ahi.
en: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
text:
PSA 107:37
Thadou: Amahon aloulai uva muchi kitheuvin tin lengpigui tu uvintin ga lhingsetna akilodiu ahi.
English: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

tcz: Aman ichan gei a phatthei aboh hitam? Amahon insungmi tamtah atungdoh'un chuleh aganchahou ninglhingset ding ahi.
en: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
text:
PSA 107:38
Thadou: Aman ichan gei a phatthei aboh hitam? Amahon insungmi tamtah atungdoh'un chuleh aganchahou ninglhingset ding ahi.
English: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

tcz: Ijemtia bolgentheina jalle, boina le hahsatna jalla umho mihem a akemsuh uva avaichat phatnuleh,
en: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
text:
PSA 107:39
Thadou: Ijemtia bolgentheina jalle, boina le hahsatna jalla umho mihem a akemsuh uva avaichat phatnuleh,
English: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in alengteu hinpaidoh intin amaho gamgo laija pannabei in umsah leleu vintin,
en: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
text:
PSA 107:40
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in alengteu hinpaidoh intin amaho gamgo laija pannabei in umsah leleu vintin,
English: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

tcz: hinla Yahweh Pakai in mivaichaho ahahsat nauva kon in kelngoihon phatah bangin ainsunga hinpunsah intin,
en: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
text:
PSA 107:41
Thadou: hinla Yahweh Pakai in mivaichaho ahahsat nauva kon in kelngoihon phatah bangin ainsunga hinpunsah intin,
English: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

tcz: Miphahon hiche thilsoh hohi hinveu vintin kipahdiu ahinla miphalou hochu suhthipma umdiu ahi.
en: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
text:
PSA 107:42
Thadou: Miphahon hiche thilsoh hohi hinveu vintin kipahdiu ahinla miphalou hochu suhthipma umdiu ahi.
English: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

tcz: Michingho jousen hitia thilsoh hohi lunggiltah'in hinheu vintin, amahon hitobang ikhankhouva kon a hi Yahweh Pakai mingailutna dihtah chu ahin mudohdiu ahi.
en: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.
text:
PSA 107:43
Thadou: Michingho jousen hitia thilsoh hohi lunggiltah'in hinheu vintin, amahon hitobang ikhankhouva kon a hi Yahweh Pakai mingailutna dihtah chu ahin mudohdiu ahi.
English: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.

tcz: O Pathen Elohim kalungthim hi nang ah akinem jinge, ahijeh chun kalungthim pumpia nangma thangvah la kasha theihi datmo ding ahipoi.
en: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.
text:
PSA 108:1
Thadou: O Pathen Elohim kalungthim hi nang ah akinem jinge, ahijeh chun kalungthim pumpia nangma thangvah la kasha theihi datmo ding ahipoi.
English: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

tcz: Hungthouvin, katheile leh kasemjang, jingpi ihmuhi kavahchoilan sukhang'ing kate.
en: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
text:
PSA 108:2
Thadou: Hungthouvin, katheile leh kasemjang, jingpi ihmuhi kavahchoilan sukhang'ing kate.
English: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai mitinlah'a hin nangma hin thangvah ingkate. Keiman chitin namtin lah a hin nangma vahchoila sange.
en: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
text:
PSA 108:3
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai mitinlah'a hin nangma hin thangvah ingkate. Keiman chitin namtin lah a hin nangma vahchoila sange.
English: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

tcz: Nami ngailutna longlouhi vanho sangin asangjon ahi. Nakitahna hin meilomlah ho aphan ahi.
en: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
text:
PSA 108:4
Thadou: Nami ngailutna longlouhi vanho sangin asangjon ahi. Nakitahna hin meilomlah ho aphan ahi.
English: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen vanho lah'a asangpen sangin namin hi dopsangin umjo hen. Naloupina leiset pumpi chung vumma hin vahdoh hen.
en: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
text:
PSA 108:5
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen vanho lah'a asangpen sangin namin hi dopsangin umjo hen. Naloupina leiset pumpi chung vumma hin vahdoh hen.
English: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

tcz: Tuhin name ngailut tehi huhdoh tan. Naban thahatnan neidonbutnun lang neihuhdoh tauvin,
en: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
text:
PSA 108:6
Thadou: Tuhin name ngailut tehi huhdoh tan. Naban thahatnan neidonbutnun lang neihuhdoh tauvin,
English: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

tcz: Elohim Pathen'in athenna a chu hichehi akitepna ahi. “Keiman kipahtah a Sechemhi kabokhen ding, Keiman Succoth phaicham hi katetoh ding ahi.
en: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
text:
PSA 108:7
Thadou: Elohim Pathen'in athenna a chu hichehi akitepna ahi. “Keiman kipahtah a Sechemhi kabokhen ding, Keiman Succoth phaicham hi katetoh ding ahi.
English: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

tcz: Gilead hi kei a ahin, Manasseh jong kei a ahi, Ephraim kathih lukhuh ahin, ama a kon a hi kagalsat dingho hungkondoh diu ahi, chuleh Judah hi kaleng tenggol ahin ama a kon a hi kalengte hung kondoh diu ahi.
en: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
text:
PSA 108:8
Thadou: Gilead hi kei a ahin, Manasseh jong kei a ahi, Ephraim kathih lukhuh ahin, ama a kon a hi kagalsat dingho hungkondoh diu ahi, chuleh Judah hi kaleng tenggol ahin ama a kon a hi kalengte hung kondoh diu ahi.
English: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

tcz: Hinla Moab hi kakeng silna kong ahin ama a kon a hi kasohte hungkondoh diu ahi, chuleh Keiman Edom chunga hi kakeng kasilding ahi. Philistia chunga galjona kasapkhum ding ahi.”
en: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”
text:
PSA 108:9
Thadou: Hinla Moab hi kakeng silna kong ahin ama a kon a hi kasohte hungkondoh diu ahi, chuleh Keiman Edom chunga hi kakeng kasilding ahi. Philistia chunga galjona kasapkhum ding ahi.”
English: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

tcz: Koipenham kulpi kikaikhum khopi sunga eipuilut ding ah? Koiham Edom chunga galjona a eipuilut ding ah?
en: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
text:
PSA 108:10
Thadou: Koipenham kulpi kikaikhum khopi sunga eipuilut ding ah? Koiham Edom chunga galjona a eipuilut ding ah?
English: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

tcz: O Elohim Pathen nangin neipaidoh hitam? Nangin kasepaite toh galsat'a nakonkhom louding hitam?
en: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
text:
PSA 108:11
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen nangin neipaidoh hitam? Nangin kasepaite toh galsat'a nakonkhom louding hitam?
English: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kagalmite toh kidouna a hi neipanhu louding hitam, ajeh chu mihem kithopina hi aphachom aumpoi.
en: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
text:
PSA 108:12
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai kagalmite toh kidouna a hi neipanhu louding hitam, ajeh chu mihem kithopina hi aphachom aumpoi.
English: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

tcz: Elohim Pathen toh pankhom hi thil loupi tahtah tohdoh theina ahi, ajeh chu Aman eikidoupi ho chu akengtoa alhopha ding ahi.
en: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.
text:
PSA 108:13
Thadou: Elohim Pathen toh pankhom hi thil loupi tahtah tohdoh theina ahi, ajeh chu Aman eikidoupi ho chu akengtoa alhopha ding ahi.
English: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.

tcz: O Elohim Pathen koiham kathangvah ding, kei a kon in thipbeh leh gamla tah in umdan lang,
en: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
text:
PSA 109:1
Thadou: O Elohim Pathen koiham kathangvah ding, kei a kon in thipbeh leh gamla tah in umdan lang,
English: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

tcz: miphalouten eihousetna thujou eiseikhum teng u jong le thipbeh in umdan.
en: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
text:
PSA 109:2
Thadou: miphalouten eihousetna thujou eiseikhum teng u jong le thipbeh in umdan.
English: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

tcz: Thet umtah thucheng ho pum in eiumkim vel un, ajeh beihel'in eikisat piuvin ahi.
en: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
text:
PSA 109:3
Thadou: Thet umtah thucheng ho pum in eiumkim vel un, ajeh beihel'in eikisat piuvin ahi.
English: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

tcz: Keiman amaho hi kangailui amaho dinga kataolai hin amahon thepmosah teiding leh suhmang dingin eigong jingun ahi.
en: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
text:
PSA 109:4
Thadou: Keiman amaho hi kangailui amaho dinga kataolai hin amahon thepmosah teiding leh suhmang dingin eigong jingun ahi.
English: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

tcz: Amahon thilpha kabol ho thilse jengin eilethuh'un, kangailutna hi vetda nan eithuh'un ahi.
en: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
text:
PSA 109:5
Thadou: Amahon thilpha kabol ho thilse jengin eilethuh'un, kangailutna hi vetda nan eithuh'un ahi.
English: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

tcz: Amahon asei un, “Ama doudin miphalou khat hintungdoh un, achungthu kitan theina dinga athepmo sahding hinsol'un” atiuve.
en: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
text:
PSA 109:6
Thadou: Amahon asei un, “Ama doudin miphalou khat hintungdoh un, achungthu kitan theina dinga athepmo sahding hinsol'un” atiuve.
English: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

tcz: Achungthu akitan teng amahi thepmosah uhitin, ataona chu chonsetnin simmu hite,
en: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
text:
PSA 109:7
Thadou: Achungthu akitan teng amahi thepmosah uhitin, ataona chu chonsetnin simmu hite,
English: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

tcz: Akum lhomsah uhite, michomkhat ama munna dinsah'u hite,
en: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
text:
PSA 109:8
Thadou: Akum lhomsah uhite, michomkhat ama munna dinsah'u hite,
English: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

tcz: achate paneilou hisah uhitin aji meithai hisah'u hite,
en: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
text:
PSA 109:9
Thadou: achate paneilou hisah uhitin aji meithai hisah'u hite,
English: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

tcz: achate khutdo a moh vahlele hiu henlang, inn gem in vah mang jeng uhen.
en: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
text:
PSA 109:10
Thadou: achate khutdo a moh vahlele hiu henlang, inn gem in vah mang jeng uhen.
English: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

tcz: Bat le tham houvin a in alou chuleh anei agou kichom u hen, kholgam mihon asum lodoh jouse lahpeh uhen,
en: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
text:
PSA 109:11
Thadou: Bat le tham houvin a in alou chuleh anei agou kichom u hen, kholgam mihon asum lodoh jouse lahpeh uhen,
English: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

tcz: koimachan lungset dauhen; koimachan paneilouva um achate chu khoto dauhen.
en: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
text:
PSA 109:12
Thadou: koimachan lungset dauhen; koimachan paneilouva um achate chu khoto dauhen.
English: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

tcz: Ason apah jouse thisoh hen. A inn sung pumpiu min jong akhang cheh a din lah doh in um mai hen.
en: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
text:
PSA 109:13
Thadou: Ason apah jouse thisoh hen. A inn sung pumpiu min jong akhang cheh a din lah doh in um mai hen.
English: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in apateu chonsetna ngaidam hihbeh hen, anu-u chonsetna jong lekhabua kon in kikahdoh hihbeh hen,
en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
text:
PSA 109:14
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in apateu chonsetna ngaidam hihbeh hen, anu-u chonsetna jong lekhabua kon in kikahdoh hihbeh hen,
English: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in achonsetnau geldoh jinghen, chuleh aminjong mihemten geldoh hihbeh hen.
en: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

tcz: Ajeh chu mi koima ngailut aneipoi, aman mivaichaho leh tahlelte abol genthei e, chuleh lung gentheite thina a adellut e.
en: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
text:
PSA 109:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu mi koima ngailut aneipoi, aman mivaichaho leh tahlelte abol genthei e, chuleh lung gentheite thina a adellut e.
English: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

tcz: Ama mi samset athanom in; tun nang ama sugoi tan. Aman midang phatthei aboh khapoi; tun nangman ama jong phatthei boh hih in.
en: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
text:
PSA 109:17
Thadou: Ama mi samset athanom in; tun nang ama sugoi tan. Aman midang phatthei aboh khapoi; tun nangman ama jong phatthei boh hih in.
English: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

tcz: Mi sapset hi amadinga aponsil, atwidon, abuneh tobang a angaito ahitai.
en: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
text:
PSA 109:18
Thadou: Mi sapset hi amadinga aponsil, atwidon, abuneh tobang a angaito ahitai.
English: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

tcz: Tun amisapsetna chu hung kile henlang ama chunga pon bangin behdoh henlang angonga kong gah bangin kikhit chah hen,
en: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
text:
PSA 109:19
Thadou: Tun amisapsetna chu hung kile henlang ama chunga pon bangin behdoh henlang angonga kong gah bangin kikhit chah hen,
English: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

tcz: Tun hiche sapsetna hochu eiseise hole eidem demho chungah Yahweh Pakai engbolna chujohen.
en: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.
text:
PSA 109:20
Thadou: Tun hiche sapsetna hochu eiseise hole eidem demho chungah Yahweh Pakai engbolna chujohen.
English: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.

tcz: Hinla O thaneipen Yahweh Pakai neidin pi in, nangma min khoto najal chun! Neihuh doh in ajeh chu nangma hi chutobangtah a pha le kitah nahi.
en: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

tcz: Ajeh chu keimahi mivaicha le tahlel tah kahin kalungthim hi ana behseh jenge.
en: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
text:
PSA 109:22
Thadou: Ajeh chu keimahi mivaicha le tahlel tah kahin kalungthim hi ana behseh jenge.
English: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

tcz: Nilhah langa nisa lim achemang bang a mangthah ding kahi, min khaokhopi apaidoh banga eikipaidoh ahitai,
en: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
text:
PSA 109:23
Thadou: Nilhah langa nisa lim achemang bang a mangthah ding kahi, min khaokhopi apaidoh banga eikipaidoh ahitai,
English: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

tcz: Ka ann ngol na-a kon in kakengpah ho kisan atha aumtapon kavunleh kagu keubou kahitai.
en: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
text:
PSA 109:24
Thadou: Ka ann ngol na-a kon in kakengpah ho kisan atha aumtapon kavunleh kagu keubou kahitai.
English: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

tcz: Keima hi muntin a mi totnopna bep kahitan amahon eimu tenguleh noisena'in alu-u eiheikhum jiuvin ahi.
en: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
text:
PSA 109:25
Thadou: Keima hi muntin a mi totnopna bep kahitan amahon eimu tenguleh noisena'in alu-u eiheikhum jiuvin ahi.
English: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

tcz: Nei kithopin O Yahweh Pakai, ka Pathen Elohim! Nami ngailutna longlou chun neihuhdoh'in.
en: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin ka chung ahi nangma natoh mong ahiti ahetchet nadiuvin musah'in.
en: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.
text:
PSA 109:27
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nangin ka chung ahi nangma natoh mong ahiti ahetchet nadiuvin musah'in.
English: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh amahon eisapset nom u jongleh eisamseuhen ajeh chu nangman phatthei neiboh ding ahinai. Amahon eihin delkhum tenguleh jumna akimudiu ahi. Ahinla nasoh keimavang kipah a kagalkai ding ahi.
en: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
text:
PSA 109:28
Thadou: Hiteng chuleh amahon eisapset nom u jongleh eisamseuhen ajeh chu nangman phatthei neiboh ding ahinai. Amahon eihin delkhum tenguleh jumna akimudiu ahi. Ahinla nasoh keimavang kipah a kagalkai ding ahi.
English: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

tcz: Eitaitom jingho vang jumna ponbanga akikhu khumdiu ahin, suhnem a aum nao chun ponbanga atomkhudiu ahi.
en: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
text:
PSA 109:29
Thadou: Eitaitom jingho vang jumna ponbanga akikhu khumdiu ahin, suhnem a aum nao chun ponbanga atomkhudiu ahi.
English: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

tcz: Ahinla kenvang Yahweh Pakai kom a kipathu kasei jingding mijouse kom a kasei choile ding ahi.
en: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
text:
PSA 109:30
Thadou: Ahinla kenvang Yahweh Pakai kom a kipathu kasei jingding mijouse kom a kasei choile ding ahi.
English: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman tahlelte adinpi jingin suhmang ding gohoa kon in ahuhdoh jingin ahi.
en: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
text:
PSA 109:31
Thadou: Ajeh chu Aman tahlelte adinpi jingin suhmang ding gohoa kon in ahuhdoh jingin ahi.
English: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in ka leng pakai kom ah, “nagal mite kasuhnem a, nakengtoa kachotpha sah tokahsen kakhut jetlam naloupina mun tou jengin” ati.
en: The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
text:
PSA 110:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in ka leng pakai kom ah, “nagal mite kasuhnem a, nakengtoa kachotpha sah tokahsen kakhut jetlam naloupina mun tou jengin” ati.
English: The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in naleng gam thaneitah chu Jerusalem a kon a ahin lhundoh ding, nangin nagalmite chunga vai na homding ahi.
en: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
text:
PSA 110:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in naleng gam thaneitah chu Jerusalem a kon a ahin lhundoh ding, nangin nagalmite chunga vai na homding ahi.
English: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

tcz: Galsat'a nacheteng namiten thanomtah'a najuidiu ahi, nangma vonthenga nakivon ding chutengleh jingkah daitwi banga nisehleh natha kidodoh jingding ahi.
en: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.
text:
PSA 110:3
Thadou: Galsat'a nacheteng namiten thanomtah'a najuidiu ahi, nangma vonthenga nakivon ding chutengleh jingkah daitwi banga nisehleh natha kidodoh jingding ahi.
English: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in kihahselna anei ahin akitepna chu asuhkeh louding ahi. “Nangma Melchizedek hina banga tonsot thempu nahiding ahi” ati.
en: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
text:
PSA 110:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in kihahselna anei ahin akitepna chu asuhkeh louding ahi. “Nangma Melchizedek hina banga tonsot thempu nahiding ahi” ati.
English: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu najet langa dinga napuihoi jing ahi. Ama alunghanna ahung koudoh leh lengle lalho tamtah asuhlhuh ding ahi.
en: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
text:
PSA 110:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu najet langa dinga napuihoi jing ahi. Ama alunghanna ahung koudoh leh lengle lalho tamtah asuhlhuh ding ahi.
English: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

tcz: Aman chitin namtin ajepding agamsunga thilong dimset ding, aman leiset pumpia lengle lalte aban vohlhuh ding ahi.
en: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
text:
PSA 110:6
Thadou: Aman chitin namtin ajepding agamsunga thilong dimset ding, aman leiset pumpia lengle lalte aban vohlhuh ding ahi.
English: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

tcz: Ahinlah amavang lampi pang dunga long twi adon a hatdoh jingding ahi. Hitiachu amahi galjoupa hijengding ahi.
en: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
text:
PSA 110:7
Thadou: Ahinlah amavang lampi pang dunga long twi adon a hatdoh jingding ahi. Hitiachu amahi galjoupa hijengding ahi.
English: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen! Michonpha hotoh kikhop khomna chan ah keiman kalungthim apumpin Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah ingkate.
en: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
text:
PSA 111:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen! Michonpha hotoh kikhop khomna chan ah keiman kalungthim apumpin Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah ingkate.
English: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai natoh hi iti kidan a hitam! Koi hileh ama a lunglhaina neijousen giltah a agel angaije.
en: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
text:
PSA 111:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai natoh hi iti kidan a hitam! Koi hileh ama a lunglhaina neijousen giltah a agel angaije.
English: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

tcz: Athilbol ho jouse hin aloupina leh aja ngaina aphongdoh'in ahi. Athu adih nahi athon ngaipon ahi.
en: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
text:
PSA 111:3
Thadou: Athilbol ho jouse hin aloupina leh aja ngaina aphongdoh'in ahi. Athu adih nahi athon ngaipon ahi.
English: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

tcz: IYahweh Pakaiju mi ngailutna le amikhotona hi iti kidan hitam tihi aman eigeldoh sahjiuvin ahi.
en: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.
text:
PSA 111:4
Thadou: IYahweh Pakaiju mi ngailutna le amikhotona hi iti kidan hitam tihi aman eigeldoh sahjiuvin ahi.
English: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.

tcz: Aman akitepna hi ageldoh jingin ama gingte chu nehle chah apejingin ahi.
en: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
text:
PSA 111:5
Thadou: Aman akitepna hi ageldoh jingin ama gingte chu nehle chah apejingin ahi.
English: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

tcz: Aman amite chu chidang namdangho gam alahpeh a amaho apeh achun athaneina thupitah chu akilandoh sah'in ahi.
en: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
text:
PSA 111:6
Thadou: Aman amite chu chidang namdangho gam alahpeh a amaho apeh achun athaneina thupitah chu akilandoh sah'in ahi.
English: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

tcz: Athilbol ho jouse hi adih'in aphan ahi, chuleh athupeh ho jouse hi tahsan theicheh ahi.
en: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
text:
PSA 111:7
Thadou: Athilbol ho jouse hi adih'in aphan ahi, chuleh athupeh ho jouse hi tahsan theicheh ahi.
English: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

tcz: Hicheho hi tonsotna dihjing jeng ahin tahsan tahleh kitahna neitah a juiding ahi.
en: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
text:
PSA 111:8
Thadou: Hicheho hi tonsotna dihjing jeng ahin tahsan tahleh kitahna neitah a juiding ahi.
English: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

tcz: Aman amite Manchu lhingsetna anapeh ahitai. Aman a mite toh akitepna chu tonsotna dinga asuhdet ahi. O ichan geija gimnei leh minthang hitam!
en: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
text:
PSA 111:9
Thadou: Aman amite Manchu lhingsetna anapeh ahitai. Aman a mite toh akitepna chu tonsotna dinga asuhdet ahi. O ichan geija gimnei leh minthang hitam!
English: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ginhi chihna dihtah kiphudohna khombul ahi. Athupeh hoitah a nit ho dingin chihna a khangtou cheh chehding ahi. Atonsotnin thangvah'in umjing tahen.
en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
text:
PSA 111:10
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ginhi chihna dihtah kiphudohna khombul ahi. Athupeh hoitah a nit ho dingin chihna a khangtou cheh chehding ahi. Atonsotnin thangvah'in umjing tahen.
English: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un! Yahweh Pakai ginna neija athupeh ho lunglhai tah'a juiho dinga iti kipa um a hitam.
en: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.
text:
PSA 112:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un! Yahweh Pakai ginna neija athupeh ho lunglhai tah'a juiho dinga iti kipa um a hitam.
English: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.

tcz: Achaten muntin a lolhinna aneiding ahi. Khangkhat lhingset a mipha ngen hina phatthei changdiu ahi.
en: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
text:
PSA 112:2
Thadou: Achaten muntin a lolhinna aneiding ahi. Khangkhat lhingset a mipha ngen hina phatthei changdiu ahi.
English: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

tcz: Amaho hung haodoh ding ahiuve chuleh athilpha bol u umjing jingding ahi.
en: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
text:
PSA 112:3
Thadou: Amaho hung haodoh ding ahiuve chuleh athilpha bol u umjing jingding ahi.
English: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

tcz: Michonpha ho dingin jan jengjong avah'in ahi. Amahohi ahongphal un, khotona aneiyun chuleh thudih achepiuvin ahi.
en: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
text:
PSA 112:4
Thadou: Michonpha ho dingin jan jengjong avah'in ahi. Amahohi ahongphal un, khotona aneiyun chuleh thudih achepiuvin ahi.
English: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

tcz: Hongphal tah a sumpa hom hole thengtah'a akiveina chepiho phatthei changdiu ahi.
en: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
text:
PSA 112:5
Thadou: Hongphal tah a sumpa hom hole thengtah'a akiveina chepiho phatthei changdiu ahi.
English: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

tcz: Hitobang miho chu thilsen asuhmo joulou ding ahi. Mikitah hohi min asumil theipon ahi.
en: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
text:
PSA 112:6
Thadou: Hitobang miho chu thilsen asuhmo joulou ding ahi. Mikitah hohi min asumil theipon ahi.
English: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

tcz: Amahohin thuse hung kithangho jengjong akichapon amahon Yahweh Pakai in ahoibit diuvin tahsan na dettah aneiyun ahi.
en: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
text:
PSA 112:7
Thadou: Amahohin thuse hung kithangho jengjong akichapon amahon Yahweh Pakai in ahoibit diuvin tahsan na dettah aneiyun ahi.
English: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

tcz: Amahohin tahsanna dettah aneiyun kichatna aneipouvin ahi, chuleh akidoupi hojeng jong joteiding tahsan nan akimai topiuvin ahi.
en: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
text:
PSA 112:8
Thadou: Amahohin tahsanna dettah aneiyun kichatna aneipouvin ahi, chuleh akidoupi hojeng jong joteiding tahsan nan akimai topiuvin ahi.
English: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

tcz: Hitobang hohin panpi ngaichaho hongphal tah'in apeuvin kiphaltah'in mitoh chan aching khomji nom un ahi. Atohphat nahou geldoh'in aumjingin ahi. Amahohin mi thujona leh jana achang'un ahi.
en: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
text:
PSA 112:9
Thadou: Hitobang hohin panpi ngaichaho hongphal tah'in apeuvin kiphaltah'in mitoh chan aching khomji nom un ahi. Atohphat nahou geldoh'in aumjingin ahi. Amahohin mi thujona leh jana achang'un ahi.
English: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

tcz: Milungdihlou hon hichehi mu uvintin alung hanpi diu ahi. Amahon lunghang tah'in aha gel unte, chuleh akinepnau thonjeh'in jumthet in kilapdoh tauvin te.
en: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
text:
PSA 112:10
Thadou: Milungdihlou hon hichehi mu uvintin alung hanpi diu ahi. Amahon lunghang tah'in aha gel unte, chuleh akinepnau thonjeh'in jumthet in kilapdoh tauvin te.
English: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thangvah'in umhen! Yahweh Pakai sohte ho thangvahna peuvin, Yahweh Pakai minchu choian un!
en: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.
text:
PSA 113:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai thangvah'in umhen! Yahweh Pakai sohte ho thangvahna peuvin, Yahweh Pakai minchu choian un!
English: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai minchu nunnom hen, tuleh tonsot gei a dingin.
en: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
text:
PSA 113:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai minchu nunnom hen, tuleh tonsot gei a dingin.
English: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.

tcz: Muntin a solam le lhanglam a kon in Yahweh Pakai minchu choiat in umhen.
en: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.
text:
PSA 113:3
Thadou: Muntin a solam le lhanglam a kon in Yahweh Pakai minchu choiat in umhen.
English: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi chitin namtin jouse sangin asangjon aloupina hi vanho jouse sangin jong asangjon ahi.
en: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
text:
PSA 113:4
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi chitin namtin jouse sangin asangjon aloupina hi vanho jouse sangin jong asangjon ahi.
English: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

tcz: Koi hintem Yahweh Pakai iPathen'u Elohim toh tekahpi thei chu, Amahi choisanga alaltouna a touva ahi.
en: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,
text:
PSA 113:5
Thadou: Koi hintem Yahweh Pakai iPathen'u Elohim toh tekahpi thei chu, Amahi choisanga alaltouna a touva ahi.
English: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,

tcz: Aman kisunemtah'in van leh leiset ahinven ahi.
en: who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
text:
PSA 113:6
Thadou: Aman kisunemtah'in van leh leiset ahinven ahi.
English: who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?

tcz: Aman mivaichate vutvai lah'a kon in aphongdingin chuleh tahlelte munnom pen a kon in akaidingin,
en: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
text:
PSA 113:7
Thadou: Aman mivaichate vutvai lah'a kon in aphongdingin chuleh tahlelte munnom pen a kon in akaidingin,
English: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,

tcz: leng chate toh atoukhomsah'in Ama mite leng chapate jengto jong atoukhomsah'in ahi.
en: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
text:
PSA 113:8
Thadou: leng chate toh atoukhomsah'in Ama mite leng chapate jengto jong atoukhomsah'in ahi.
English: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

tcz: Aman chaneilou numeiho cha le nao apen minu nomsatah in asemdohjin ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 113:9
Thadou: Aman chaneilou numeiho cha le nao apen minu nomsatah in asemdohjin ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
English: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!

tcz: Israelte Egyptma kon a ajamdoh jouvun, Jacob insung miten hiche midangho gamchu adalhah phatnun
en: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,
text:
PSA 114:1
Thadou: Israelte Egyptma kon a ajamdoh jouvun, Jacob insung miten hiche midangho gamchu adalhah phatnun
English: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,

tcz: Judah gamchu Elohim Pathen muntheng a sohdoh tan Israel chu aleng gam asoh doh tan ahi.
en: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
text:
PSA 114:2
Thadou: Judah gamchu Elohim Pathen muntheng a sohdoh tan Israel chu aleng gam asoh doh tan ahi.
English: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

tcz: Twikhanglen san chun ahungu amun ajam mangtan Jordan vadunga twi hojong ana kiheimang'in,
en: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
text:
PSA 114:3
Thadou: Twikhanglen san chun ahungu amun ajam mangtan Jordan vadunga twi hojong ana kiheimang'in,
English: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

tcz: Mol ho jong kelngoichal ho bangin akichom un thinglhang hochu kelngoinou bangin akichom leuvin ahi.
en: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
text:
PSA 114:4
Thadou: Mol ho jong kelngoichal ho bangin akichom un thinglhang hochu kelngoinou bangin akichom leuvin ahi.
English: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

tcz: Twikhanglen san ipibol a na lhaimang loijeng ham? Jordan vadung ipibol a na lhaimang jengham?
en: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
text:
PSA 114:5
Thadou: Twikhanglen san ipibol a na lhaimang loijeng ham? Jordan vadung ipibol a na lhaimang jengham?
English: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

tcz: Mol ho nangho ipidinga kelngoichal banga nakichop uham? Thinglhang ho ipi dinga kelngoinou banga nakichop uham?
en: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?
text:
PSA 114:6
Thadou: Mol ho nangho ipidinga kelngoichal banga nakichop uham? Thinglhang ho ipi dinga kelngoinou banga nakichop uham?
English: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?

tcz: O leiset, Yahweh Pakai angsung'leh Jacob Elohim Pathen masangah kithing thingin um in.
en: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
text:
PSA 114:7
Thadou: O leiset, Yahweh Pakai angsung'leh Jacob Elohim Pathen masangah kithing thingin um in.
English: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in songpi chu twi veina twikul asosah'in, songpi tahbetna kon in twisam alondoh sahjin ahi.
en: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
text:
PSA 114:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in songpi chu twi veina twikul asosah'in, songpi tahbetna kon in twisam alondoh sahjin ahi.
English: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.

tcz: Keiho a ahipoi, O Yahweh Pakai keiho a ahipoi, amavang loupina jouse hi namingailut na longlou jeh a chun nang ding jingbou ahi.
en: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
text:
PSA 115:1
Thadou: Keiho a ahipoi, O Yahweh Pakai keiho a ahipoi, amavang loupina jouse hi namingailut na longlou jeh a chun nang ding jingbou ahi.
English: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

tcz: Chitin namtin hohin a Pathen'u Elohim hoi a umham tia aseidingu ham?
en: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
text:
PSA 115:2
Thadou: Chitin namtin hohin a Pathen'u Elohim hoi a umham tia aseidingu ham?
English: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”

tcz: Ka Pathen'u Elohim hi vanho chunga aum in thil adeidan dana abolji ahi.
en: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
text:
PSA 115:3
Thadou: Ka Pathen'u Elohim hi vanho chunga aum in thil adeidan dana abolji ahi.
English: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

tcz: Amaho semthu doihon vang sana le dangka a kisem ngenchang bou ahiuvin mihem khut in asemthu jeng ahiuve.
en: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
text:
PSA 115:4
Thadou: Amaho semthu doihon vang sana le dangka a kisem ngenchang bou ahiuvin mihem khut in asemthu jeng ahiuve.
English: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

tcz: Amahon kam anei un ahinla apaotheipon, chuleh mit anei un kho amuthei pouvin,
en: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
text:
PSA 115:5
Thadou: Amahon kam anei un ahinla apaotheipon, chuleh mit anei un kho amuthei pouvin,
English: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.

tcz: kol aneiyun ajathei pouvin, nahkui anei un anahthei pouvin,
en: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
text:
PSA 115:6
Thadou: kol aneiyun ajathei pouvin, nahkui anei un anahthei pouvin,
English: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

tcz: khut anei un ima tohnan amangthei pouvin chuleh keng anei un achele theipouvin, lolhom anei un ahin thucheng ahungdoh theipon ahi.
en: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
text:
PSA 115:7
Thadou: khut anei un ima tohnan amangthei pouvin chuleh keng anei un achele theipouvin, lolhom anei un ahin thucheng ahungdoh theipon ahi.
English: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

tcz: Hitiachu doilim semthu hohi hiche tobang ahiuve, hicheho tahsan hojong hitobang machu ahiuve.
en: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
text:
PSA 115:8
Thadou: Hitiachu doilim semthu hohi hiche tobang ahiuve, hicheho tahsan hojong hitobang machu ahiuve.
English: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

tcz: O Israel Yahweh Pakai chu tahsan un! Amachu napanhu na lum a pang ahi.
en: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
text:
PSA 115:9
Thadou: O Israel Yahweh Pakai chu tahsan un! Amachu napanhu na lum a pang ahi.
English: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

tcz: O thempuho Aaron ho Yahweh Pakai chu tahsan un! Amahi napanpia leh na lumdel a pang'a ahi.
en: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
text:
PSA 115:10
Thadou: O thempuho Aaron ho Yahweh Pakai chu tahsan un! Amahi napanpia leh na lumdel a pang'a ahi.
English: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

tcz: Nangho Yahweh Pakai gingjing ho Yahweh Pakai chu tahsan un! Amachu napanpi le nalumdal ahi.
en: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
text:
PSA 115:11
Thadou: Nangho Yahweh Pakai gingjing ho Yahweh Pakai chu tahsan un! Amachu napanpi le nalumdal ahi.
English: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in nahin geldoh jingin phatthei nabohjing ding ahi. Aman Israel mipite hi phatthei aboh ding ahi, chuleh thempuho le Aaron chilhah ho jong phatthei aboh ding ahi.
en: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
text:
PSA 115:12
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in nahin geldoh jingin phatthei nabohjing ding ahi. Aman Israel mipite hi phatthei aboh ding ahi, chuleh thempuho le Aaron chilhah ho jong phatthei aboh ding ahi.
English: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

tcz: Mithupi hihenlang milham hijongleh Yahweh Pakai ging hochu Aman phatthei aboh ding ahi.
en: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.
text:
PSA 115:13
Thadou: Mithupi hihenlang milham hijongleh Yahweh Pakai ging hochu Aman phatthei aboh ding ahi.
English: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in nangma nahin nachate ahin phattheina lhingset in napehen,
en: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.
text:
PSA 115:14
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in nangma nahin nachate ahin phattheina lhingset in napehen,
English: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.

tcz: Van le lei sem a Yahweh Pakai chun phatthei naboh hen,
en: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
text:
PSA 115:15
Thadou: Van le lei sem a Yahweh Pakai chun phatthei naboh hen,
English: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

tcz: Vanhohi Yahweh Pakai a ahin, leiset vanghi mihemte apeh ahi.
en: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
text:
PSA 115:16
Thadou: Vanhohi Yahweh Pakai a ahin, leiset vanghi mihemte apeh ahi.
English: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

tcz: Mithin Yahweh Pakai thangvah la asatheipoi, ajeh chu amaho chu lhan munthip gam a che ahiuve.
en: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,
text:
PSA 115:17
Thadou: Mithin Yahweh Pakai thangvah la asatheipoi, ajeh chu amaho chu lhan munthip gam a che ahiuve.
English: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,

tcz: Ahinlah eihon tu le tonsot geija Yahweh Pakai ithangvah theiju ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 115:18
Thadou: Ahinlah eihon tu le tonsot geija Yahweh Pakai ithangvah theiju ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
English: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in ka o eingai peh eikhoto dia katao na eisan peh jeh in keiman Yahweh Pakai kangailui.
en: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
text:
PSA 116:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in ka o eingai peh eikhoto dia katao na eisan peh jeh in keiman Yahweh Pakai kangailui.
English: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

tcz: Aman eihin ang ngat a kataona eingaipeh'in kahaithei laisea keima katao jing jingding ahi.
en: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
text:
PSA 116:2
Thadou: Aman eihin ang ngat a kataona eingaipeh'in kahaithei laisea keima katao jing jingding ahi.
English: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

tcz: Thinan apon in eihin tomkhum e; lhankhuh gimneitah chun eihin lonvuh e. Keiman lungkhamna leh lunggimna ngen kamu e.
en: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
text:
PSA 116:3
Thadou: Thinan apon in eihin tomkhum e; lhankhuh gimneitah chun eihin lonvuh e. Keiman lungkhamna leh lunggimna ngen kamu e.
English: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

tcz: hiteng chuleh keiman Yahweh Pakai min kakoujin, “Yahweh Pakai lungset'in neihuhdoh'in!” katijin ahi.
en: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
text:
PSA 116:4
Thadou: hiteng chuleh keiman Yahweh Pakai min kakoujin, “Yahweh Pakai lungset'in neihuhdoh'in!” katijin ahi.
English: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi itobang tah'a milungsetthem hitam! Chuleh itobang tah'a pha a hitam! iPathen'u Elohim hi ichangei a mikhoto them hitam!
en: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
text:
PSA 116:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi itobang tah'a milungsetthem hitam! Chuleh itobang tah'a pha a hitam! iPathen'u Elohim hi ichangei a mikhoto them hitam!
English: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in chapang lungthengtah atahsanna neijachu ahahsatna'a ahoidoh jin ahi. Keima thina toh kimaitoa kaum laitah'in aman eihuhdoh'in ahi.
en: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
text:
PSA 116:6
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in chapang lungthengtah atahsanna neijachu ahahsatna'a ahoidoh jin ahi. Keima thina toh kimaitoa kaum laitah'in aman eihuhdoh'in ahi.
English: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

tcz: Kalhagao, nacholdo namun hinjon kittan ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi keidingin aphalheh jenge.
en: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
text:
PSA 116:7
Thadou: Kalhagao, nacholdo namun hinjon kittan ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi keidingin aphalheh jenge.
English: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.

tcz: Aman kathina dinga kon in eihuhdoh'in kamitna mitlhi lonlouna dingle kakeng hi kakiselhuh louna dingin eiveng jenge.
en: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
text:
PSA 116:8
Thadou: Aman kathina dinga kon in eihuhdoh'in kamitna mitlhi lonlouna dingle kakeng hi kakiselhuh louna dingin eiveng jenge.
English: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

tcz: Hiche leisetna kahin laisen Yahweh Pakai masanga kavahle jengin ahi.
en: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
text:
PSA 116:9
Thadou: Hiche leisetna kahin laisen Yahweh Pakai masanga kavahle jengin ahi.
English: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai keima kagenthei behseh jengtai katiteng jongleh nangma katahsan jing nalai e.
en: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
text:
PSA 116:10
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai keima kagenthei behseh jengtai katiteng jongleh nangma katahsan jing nalai e.
English: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”

tcz: Kahahsat teng jongleh nangma kahin koujin ahi, ajeh chu hiche mitehi tahsan thei ahipouve.
en: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
text:
PSA 116:11
Thadou: Kahahsat teng jongleh nangma kahin koujin ahi, ajeh chu hiche mitehi tahsan thei ahipouve.
English: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”

tcz: Thilpha simjoulou eibolpeh jeh'a hi Yahweh Pakai chu ipi kapehding ham?
en: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
text:
PSA 116:12
Thadou: Thilpha simjoulou eibolpeh jeh'a hi Yahweh Pakai chu ipi kapehding ham?
English: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

tcz: Keiman huhhingna khon hi domsang'ing ting eihuhhing jeh'a amin kathangvah ding ahi.
en: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.
text:
PSA 116:13
Thadou: Keiman huhhingna khon hi domsang'ing ting eihuhhing jeh'a amin kathangvah ding ahi.
English: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.

tcz: Keiman amite ho jouse masangah Yahweh Pakai ah kakitepna nitjing ing kate.
en: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.
text:
PSA 116:14
Thadou: Keiman amite ho jouse masangah Yahweh Pakai ah kakitepna nitjing ing kate.
English: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in angailut mite athiteng leh alainatpi lheh jengjin ahi.
en: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.
text:
PSA 116:15
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in angailut mite athiteng leh alainatpi lheh jengjin ahi.
English: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai keima nasoh kahi, nangin kasoh channa'a kon in neihuhdoh tai.
en: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
text:
PSA 116:16
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai keima nasoh kahi, nangin kasoh channa'a kon in neihuhdoh tai.
English: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

tcz: Keiman thangvahna hi kilhaina gantha napengting Yahweh Pakai min'in taovinge.
en: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.
text:
PSA 116:17
