Thadou: Keiman thangvahna hi kilhaina gantha napengting Yahweh Pakai min'in taovinge.
English: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai a kakitepna chu amite jouse masangah pengtin,
en: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,
text:
PSA 116:18
Thadou: Keiman Yahweh Pakai a kakitepna chu amite jouse masangah pengtin,
English: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,

tcz: Yahweh Pakai houin ah Jerusalem lailungah subulhit'ing kate. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 116:19
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai houin ah Jerusalem lailungah subulhit'ing kate. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
English: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

tcz: Chitin namtin in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuhen, leiset chungcheng jousen thangvah cheh hen,
en: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
text:
PSA 117:1
Thadou: Chitin namtin in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuhen, leiset chungcheng jousen thangvah cheh hen,
English: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

tcz: Amahi tonsot a kitahjing Yahweh Pakai ahin eingailutnao hi longlou ahijeh'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen.
en: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 117:2
Thadou: Amahi tonsot a kitahjing Yahweh Pakai ahin eingailutnao hi longlou ahijeh'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen.
English: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu aphatna jeh'in thangvah'un! Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tanglouvin aumjinge.
en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
text:
PSA 118:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu aphatna jeh'in thangvah'un! Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tanglouvin aumjinge.
English: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

tcz: Israel pumpin avel in seikit hen. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tanglouvin aumjinge.
en: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
text:
PSA 118:2
Thadou: Israel pumpin avel in seikit hen. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tanglouvin aumjinge.
English: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

tcz: Aaron chilhah holeh thempuhon avel in seikitnu hen. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tanglouvin aumjinge.
en: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
text:
PSA 118:3
Thadou: Aaron chilhah holeh thempuhon avel in seikitnu hen. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tanglouvin aumjinge.
English: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ging jousen seikit uhen agailut thutah chun tonsot in athoh jing e.
en: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.
text:
PSA 118:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ging jousen seikit uhen agailut thutah chun tonsot in athoh jing e.
English: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.

tcz: Kagenthei pet in Yahweh Pakai kom ah kataovin ahileh Yahweh Pakai in kataona asangin eilhadoh tai.
en: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.
text:
PSA 118:5
Thadou: Kagenthei pet in Yahweh Pakai kom ah kataovin ahileh Yahweh Pakai in kataona asangin eilhadoh tai.
English: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai keilanga apanleh ipi kakichat ding ham? kon I-eilothei dingham?
en: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
text:
PSA 118:6
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai keilanga apanleh ipi kakichat ding ham? kon I-eilothei dingham?
English: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

tcz: Yahweh Pakai keilanga apanleh Aman eipapin tin, eidou hochu kajosa tobanga kavetding ahi.
en: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
text:
PSA 118:7
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai keilanga apanleh Aman eipapin tin, eidou hochu kajosa tobanga kavetding ahi.
English: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

tcz: Mihem a kingai sangin, Yahweh Pakai kiselna a nei aphajoi.
en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.
text:
PSA 118:8
Thadou: Mihem a kingai sangin, Yahweh Pakai kiselna a nei aphajoi.
English: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.

tcz: Leng chapate a kingai sangin, Yahweh Pakai a kisel aphajoi.
en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.
text:
PSA 118:9
Thadou: Leng chapate a kingai sangin, Yahweh Pakai a kisel aphajoi.
English: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.

tcz: Eidouva chidang namdangten eiumkimvel jongleh keiman amaho chu Yahweh Pakai thahatna jalla kasuhmang ding ahi.
en: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.
text:
PSA 118:10
Thadou: Eidouva chidang namdangten eiumkimvel jongleh keiman amaho chu Yahweh Pakai thahatna jalla kasuhmang ding ahi.
English: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.

tcz: Amahon eiumkimvellun eidelkhummun ahi, ahinla ken amaho chu Yahweh Pakai hanta jallin kasumang gamtan ahi.
en: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.
text:
PSA 118:11
Thadou: Amahon eiumkimvellun eidelkhummun ahi, ahinla ken amaho chu Yahweh Pakai hanta jallin kasumang gamtan ahi.
English: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.

tcz: Amahon khoi bangin eiumkimvellun eitommun, meikong a-al leng lungngin eileo tobangin eibolseuvin ahinla keiman Yahweh Pakai thahatna jallin amaho chu kasumangtan ahi.
en: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
text:
PSA 118:12
Thadou: Amahon khoi bangin eiumkimvellun eitommun, meikong a-al leng lungngin eileo tobangin eibolseuvin ahinla keiman Yahweh Pakai thahatna jallin amaho chu kasumangtan ahi.
English: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.

tcz: Kagal miten tha tei ding eigouvin ahin Yahweh Pakai in eihuhdoh tai.
en: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.
text:
PSA 118:13
Thadou: Kagal miten tha tei ding eigouvin ahin Yahweh Pakai in eihuhdoh tai.
English: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi kathahatna leh kala ahin Aman galjona eipetan ahi.
en: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
text:
PSA 118:14
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi kathahatna leh kala ahin Aman galjona eipetan ahi.
English: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

tcz: Kipana le galjona lahi michonphate ponbuh sungah akisan, Yahweh Pakai thahatna banjet in thil loupitah atongdohtan ahi!
en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.
text:
PSA 118:15
Thadou: Kipana le galjona lahi michonphate ponbuh sungah akisan, Yahweh Pakai thahatna banjet in thil loupitah atongdohtan ahi!
English: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thahatna banjetchun thil loupitah atongdohtan ahi.
en: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”
text:
PSA 118:16
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai thahatna banjetchun thil loupitah atongdohtan ahi.
English: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”

tcz: Keima thilouding kahin, Yahweh Pakai in eibolpeh thilho phongdoh dinga kahinjoh ding ahi.
en: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.
text:
PSA 118:17
Thadou: Keima thilouding kahin, Yahweh Pakai in eibolpeh thilho phongdoh dinga kahinjoh ding ahi.
English: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in nasatah'in eijepmin, ahinlah eithisah pon ahi.
en: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
text:
PSA 118:18
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in nasatah'in eijepmin, ahinlah eithisah pon ahi.
English: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

tcz: Mikitah ho lutna kot chu neihondoh peh'in keima lut ing ting Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna kapehding ahi.
en: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.
text:
PSA 118:19
Thadou: Mikitah ho lutna kot chu neihondoh peh'in keima lut ing ting Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna kapehding ahi.
English: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.

tcz: Hiche kelkot hohi Yahweh Pakai kom lhuntheina ahin michonpha hojong hicheahi lutji ahiuve.
en: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.
text:
PSA 118:20
Thadou: Hiche kelkot hohi Yahweh Pakai kom lhuntheina ahin michonpha hojong hicheahi lutji ahiuve.
English: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.

tcz: Kataona neisanpeh jehleh galjona neipeh jeh'in nangma kathangvah e!
en: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
text:
PSA 118:21
Thadou: Kataona neisanpeh jehleh galjona neipeh jeh'in nangma kathangvah e!
English: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

tcz: Insahon adeimova apaimangu inning'a songpi khomdet pennin apangtai.
en: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
text:
PSA 118:22
Thadou: Insahon adeimova apaimangu inning'a songpi khomdet pennin apangtai.
English: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

tcz: Hichehi Yahweh Pakai natoh ahin mitvet dinga thilkidang tah ahi.
en: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
text:
PSA 118:23
Thadou: Hichehi Yahweh Pakai natoh ahin mitvet dinga thilkidang tah ahi.
English: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

tcz: Hiche nikho hi Yahweh Pakai in asem ahin, eihon kipahtah leh thanomtah'a imandiu ahi.
en: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
text:
PSA 118:24
Thadou: Hiche nikho hi Yahweh Pakai in asem ahin, eihon kipahtah leh thanomtah'a imandiu ahi.
English: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai lungsettah'in neihuhdoh'un, O Yahweh Pakai lungset tah'in neilolhin sahtei teijun.
en: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.
text:
PSA 118:25
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai lungsettah'in neihuhdoh'un, O Yahweh Pakai lungset tah'in neilolhin sahtei teijun.
English: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai minna hungpa chu anunnomme. Yahweh Pakai houinna kon in nangho phatthei kahinboh'un ahi.
en: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.
text:
PSA 118:26
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai minna hungpa chu anunnomme. Yahweh Pakai houinna kon in nangho phatthei kahinboh'un ahi.
English: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu Elohim Pathen, ichunguva hi vahjinga um a ahi. Kilhaina sa chu khaovin khitninlang maicham ki ho chutoh khitbeh'in
en: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
text:
PSA 118:27
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu Elohim Pathen, ichunguva hi vahjinga um a ahi. Kilhaina sa chu khaovin khitninlang maicham ki ho chutoh khitbeh'in
English: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

tcz: Nangma ka Pathen Elohim nahin keiman kavahchoi ding nahi! Nangma ka Pathen Elohim nahin keiman kachoisang ding ahi.
en: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
text:
PSA 118:28
Thadou: Nangma ka Pathen Elohim nahin keiman kavahchoi ding nahi! Nangma ka Pathen Elohim nahin keiman kachoisang ding ahi.
English: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu aphatna ho jeh'in thangvah'un! Ajeh chu amingailutna dihtah chu tonsot a umjing ahi.
en: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
text:
PSA 118:29
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu aphatna ho jeh'in thangvah'un! Ajeh chu amingailutna dihtah chu tonsot a umjing ahi.
English: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thupeh dungjui a chonho leh kitahna neiho chu kipah uhen.
en: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.
text:
PSA 119:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai thupeh dungjui a chonho leh kitahna neiho chu kipah uhen.
English: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.

tcz: Koi hileh a Dan thu nit a alungthim pumpia Ama holjing hochu kipah'u hen.
en: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
text:
PSA 119:2
Thadou: Koi hileh a Dan thu nit a alungthim pumpia Ama holjing hochu kipah'u hen.
English: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

tcz: Amahochun thilphalou achepi pouvin Yahweh Pakai deilampi joh ajui un ahi.
en: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.
text:
PSA 119:3
Thadou: Amahochun thilphalou achepi pouvin Yahweh Pakai deilampi joh ajui un ahi.
English: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin nathupeh hochu phatah'a kanit diuvin neiseipeh'un ahi.
en: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
text:
PSA 119:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nangin nathupeh hochu phatah'a kanit diuvin neiseipeh'un ahi.
English: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kanitin hinkho Mandan ahin nangman neideipeh hinkho hi kilangdoh jengle kati e.
en: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
text:
PSA 119:5
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai kanitin hinkho Mandan ahin nangman neideipeh hinkho hi kilangdoh jengle kati e.
English: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

tcz: Chuleh nathupeh leh ka chondan kavetkah teng kajum louding ahi.
en: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
text:
PSA 119:6
Thadou: Chuleh nathupeh leh ka chondan kavetkah teng kajum louding ahi.
English: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

tcz: Keiman nei thuhilna dihtah hochu kahet dungjui a kakimanding dol a kakimanchah theijeh'a nangma chu kathangvah ding ahi.
en: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
text:
PSA 119:7
Thadou: Keiman nei thuhilna dihtah hochu kahet dungjui a kakimanding dol a kakimanchah theijeh'a nangma chu kathangvah ding ahi.
English: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

tcz: Neidalha hihbeh'in, keiman na Dan chu kanitjing ding ahi.
en: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH
text:
PSA 119:8
Thadou: Neidalha hihbeh'in, keiman na Dan chu kanitjing ding ahi.
English: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH

tcz: Khangthah khatchu itileh ahinkho atheng theidem? Nangma thu angaileh hitheiding ahi.
en: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
text:
PSA 119:9
Thadou: Khangthah khatchu itileh ahinkho atheng theidem? Nangma thu angaileh hitheiding ahi.
English: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

tcz: Keiman nangma mudoh teiding kagelkhoh'in ahi, nangma thupeh'a kon in neilam vai sahhih'in.
en: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
text:
PSA 119:10
Thadou: Keiman nangma mudoh teiding kagelkhoh'in ahi, nangma thupeh'a kon in neilam vai sahhih'in.
English: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

tcz: Nangma douna kachonset louna dingin kalungsung ah nathu chu kachensah jingin ahi.
en: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
text:
PSA 119:11
Thadou: Nangma douna kachonset louna dingin kalungsung ah nathu chu kachensah jingin ahi.
English: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma kathangvah'e nathupeh nitji dan neihil in.
en: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:12
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangma kathangvah'e nathupeh nitji dan neihil in.
English: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.

tcz: Ka chonding dan nangin neipeh hochu keiman kasimphongjin ahi.
en: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
text:
PSA 119:13
Thadou: Ka chonding dan nangin neipeh hochu keiman kasimphongjin ahi.
English: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

tcz: Nei le gouva housangin na Dan thu chu juiding katha anomjoi.
en: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
text:
PSA 119:14
Thadou: Nei le gouva housangin na Dan thu chu juiding katha anomjoi.
English: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

tcz: Neithupeh na Dan hochu keiman simjing ingting nei deipeh lampia chejing dingin kingaito jing nange.
en: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
text:
PSA 119:15
Thadou: Neithupeh na Dan hochu keiman simjing ingting nei deipeh lampia chejing dingin kingaito jing nange.
English: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

tcz: Na Dan thu hohi kakipapin, juidinga neithupeh hojong sumil ponge.
en: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL
text:
PSA 119:16
Thadou: Na Dan thu hohi kakipapin, juidinga neithupeh hojong sumil ponge.
English: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL

tcz: Nasohpa keima hi thilpha neibolpen kahinkhoa hi nathupeh kanit jingna dingin.
en: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
text:
PSA 119:17
Thadou: Nasohpa keima hi thilpha neibolpen kahinkhoa hi nathupeh kanit jingna dingin.
English: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

tcz: Nathupeh hoa thudih kidangtah hohi kamuchet theina dingin kamit hi hadohsah'in.
en: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
text:
PSA 119:18
Thadou: Nathupeh hoa thudih kidangtah hohi kamuchet theina dingin kamit hi hadohsah'in.
English: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

tcz: Keima hiche leisetna hi kholjin bep kahibouve nathupeh hochu keima nei impeh hihbeh'in.
en: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
text:
PSA 119:19
Thadou: Keima hiche leisetna hi kholjin bep kahibouve nathupeh hochu keima nei impeh hihbeh'in.
English: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.

tcz: Phatin in keiman nachondan juiding ngaichatna hin eilonvuhtan ahi.
en: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
text:
PSA 119:20
Thadou: Phatin in keiman nachondan juiding ngaichatna hin eilonvuhtan ahi.
English: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

tcz: Nangin mikiletsah hochu nahousejin, nathupeh a kon a pampet hochu nasamsejin ahi.
en: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
text:
PSA 119:21
Thadou: Nangin mikiletsah hochu nahousejin, nathupeh a kon a pampet hochu nasamsejin ahi.
English: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

tcz: Na Dan sem hohi kajui jingnai amahohi neinoise sahhih beh'in.
en: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:22
Thadou: Na Dan sem hohi kajui jingnai amahohi neinoise sahhih beh'in.
English: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

tcz: Leng chapate ho toukhom u henlang keima dounan thu seijongleu keivangin na Dan semhohi juiding geljing nange.
en: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:23
Thadou: Leng chapate ho toukhom u henlang keima dounan thu seijongleu keivangin na Dan semhohi juiding geljing nange.
English: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

tcz: Na Dan semho hi kakipapi lheh jenge ajeh chu hiche hohin chihna thu eihil jingin ahi.
en: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH
text:
PSA 119:24
Thadou: Na Dan semho hi kakipapi lheh jenge ajeh chu hiche hohin chihna thu eihil jingin ahi.
English: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH

tcz: Keima leivui lah'a kijama kahitai nathu chun neisuhal kittan.
en: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
text:
PSA 119:25
Thadou: Keima leivui lah'a kijama kahitai nathu chun neisuhal kittan.
English: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

tcz: Ka chondan, kaumchan nakom ah kaphongdoh tai, tun nadan semchu neisei pehtan.
en: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:26
Thadou: Ka chondan, kaumchan nakom ah kaphongdoh tai, tun nadan semchu neisei pehtan.
English: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

tcz: Na Dan thupeh chu neithem sah'in, chutengleh keiman natohdoh datmo umtah hochu kalungin geljing nange.
en: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
text:
PSA 119:27
Thadou: Na Dan thupeh chu neithem sah'in, chutengleh keiman natohdoh datmo umtah hochu kalungin geljing nange.
English: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

tcz: Lungkhamnan eibom in kakaptai, nakam changing neihaldoh sahkit tan.
en: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
text:
PSA 119:28
Thadou: Lungkhamnan eibom in kakaptai, nakam changing neihaldoh sahkit tan.
English: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

tcz: Mijou milepche hotoh neichom khen in, nathuhil kahetthem theinading thuguh chu neipen.
en: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
text:
PSA 119:29
Thadou: Mijou milepche hotoh neichom khen in, nathuhil kahetthem theinading thuguh chu neipen.
English: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

tcz: Kitah tah'a hinkho manding hi kakilhen ahitai, nathuhil dungjui a hinkho mandinghi kadinpi ahitai.
en: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
text:
PSA 119:30
Thadou: Kitah tah'a hinkho manding hi kakilhen ahitai, nathuhil dungjui a hinkho mandinghi kadinpi ahitai.
English: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

tcz: Na Dan semhi katuhchah ahitai, O Yahweh Pakai neijumso hihbeh'in!
en: I cling to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me be disappointed.
text:
PSA 119:31
Thadou: Na Dan semhi katuhchah ahitai, O Yahweh Pakai neijumso hihbeh'in!
English: I cling to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me be disappointed.

tcz: Nathupeh hohi kajui jingding ahi, ajeh chu nangin hetthem theina neipeh jingding jehin.
en: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE
text:
PSA 119:32
Thadou: Nathupeh hohi kajui jingding ahi, ajeh chu nangin hetthem theina neipeh jingding jehin.
English: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nathupeh chu neihillin, keiman achaina gei in juijing ing kate.
en: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
text:
PSA 119:33
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nathupeh chu neihillin, keiman achaina gei in juijing ing kate.
English: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

tcz: Nathuhil kajuijing theina dingin hetthem theina neipen. Kalungthim pumpin hichu natohman podoh ingkate.
en: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
text:
PSA 119:34
Thadou: Nathuhil kajuijing theina dingin hetthem theina neipen. Kalungthim pumpin hichu natohman podoh ingkate.
English: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

tcz: Nathupeh dungjui in neikalson sah'in hichu kakipanapen ahi.
en: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
text:
PSA 119:35
Thadou: Nathupeh dungjui in neikalson sah'in hichu kakipanapen ahi.
English: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

tcz: Sum ngaichatna sangin na Dan thu hetthemding ngaichat theina neipejon.
en: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
text:
PSA 119:36
Thadou: Sum ngaichatna sangin na Dan thu hetthemding ngaichat theina neipejon.
English: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

tcz: Thil phachomlou hoa kon in kamit heimangin lang nathuchengin neihindoh sah'in.
en: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
text:
PSA 119:37
Thadou: Thil phachomlou hoa kon in kamit heimangin lang nathuchengin neihindoh sah'in.
English: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

tcz: Nangma ginle jana neiho napeh kitepna chu keima kom ah neisuhdetpeh'in.
en: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
text:
PSA 119:38
Thadou: Nangma ginle jana neiho napeh kitepna chu keima kom ah neisuhdetpeh'in.
English: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

tcz: Kajumna hinkho hi neipailhah sah'in ajeh chu na Dan semho hi aphalheh jengin ahi.
en: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
text:
PSA 119:39
Thadou: Kajumna hinkho hi neipailhah sah'in ajeh chu na Dan semho hi aphalheh jengin ahi.
English: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

tcz: Nathupeh hohi kajuinomlheh jenge naphatna'in kahinkho hi neithah sempeh kittan.
en: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV
text:
PSA 119:40
Thadou: Nathupeh hohi kajuinomlheh jenge naphatna'in kahinkho hi neithah sempeh kittan.
English: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV

tcz: Yahweh Pakai namingailutna longlou tonsot hinna neiteppeh chu neipetan,
en: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.
text:
PSA 119:41
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai namingailutna longlou tonsot hinna neiteppeh chu neipetan,
English: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.

tcz: Chutileh eitaitom ho donbutje kahetding ahi ajeh chu keiman nathutep chu katahsan in ahi.
en: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
text:
PSA 119:42
Thadou: Chutileh eitaitom ho donbutje kahetding ahi ajeh chu keiman nathutep chu katahsan in ahi.
English: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

tcz: Phat tin in thutah jeng neisei sah'in ajeh chu nangma chondan thupeh a bouhin kinepna kanei in ahi.
en: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
text:
PSA 119:43
Thadou: Phat tin in thutah jeng neisei sah'in ajeh chu nangma chondan thupeh a bouhin kinepna kanei in ahi.
English: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

tcz: Keiman nathupeh hochu itihchan hijongleh kanit jingding ahi.
en: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
text:
PSA 119:44
Thadou: Keiman nathupeh hochu itihchan hijongleh kanit jingding ahi.
English: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

tcz: Keiman chamlhatna tahbeh chu kaneitai, ajeh chu nangma thuhil juidinga kigo kahitai.
en: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
text:
PSA 119:45
Thadou: Keiman chamlhatna tahbeh chu kaneitai, ajeh chu nangma thuhil juidinga kigo kahitai.
English: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

tcz: Keiman nathupehho hi jahchalou hella lengte masanga jong kaphondoh ding ahi.
en: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
text:
PSA 119:46
Thadou: Keiman nathupehho hi jahchalou hella lengte masanga jong kaphondoh ding ahi.
English: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

tcz: Keiman nang thupeh juidinghi kakipanapen ahitai ajeh chu hicheho hi keiman kadeilheh jengin ahi.
en: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
text:
PSA 119:47
Thadou: Keiman nang thupeh juidinghi kakipanapen ahitai ajeh chu hicheho hi keiman kadeilheh jengin ahi.
English: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

tcz: Keiman na thupeh ho hi kadeilheh jengin chuleh jana jong kaneijin ahi, na Dan thu hohi giltah'in kagellin ahi.
en: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN
text:
PSA 119:48
Thadou: Keiman na thupeh ho hi kadeilheh jengin chuleh jana jong kaneijin ahi, na Dan thu hohi giltah'in kagellin ahi.
English: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN

tcz: Kakom a na kitepna chu geldoh'in hiche bouchu ahi kakinepna.
en: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
text:
PSA 119:49
Thadou: Kakom a na kitepna chu geldoh'in hiche bouchu ahi kakinepna.
English: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

tcz: Hiche nakitepna hin kahinkho akiledohsah kit'in kalungthim boina hoa kon in jong lungmon na eipen ahi.
en: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
text:
PSA 119:50
Thadou: Hiche nakitepna hin kahinkho akiledohsah kit'in kalungthim boina hoa kon in jong lungmon na eipen ahi.
English: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

tcz: Mikiletsah hon noise tah'in eibol jongleu keivang nangma thuhilhoa kon in kapotdoh pon ahi.
en: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
text:
PSA 119:51
Thadou: Mikiletsah hon noise tah'in eibol jongleu keivang nangma thuhilhoa kon in kapotdoh pon ahi.
English: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.

tcz: Masanglai peh'a na Dan sem nachepi hochu kangaito leh O Yahweh Pakai hichechun eilhamon sahlheh jenge.
en: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.
text:
PSA 119:52
Thadou: Masanglai peh'a na Dan sem nachepi hochu kangaito leh O Yahweh Pakai hichechun eilhamon sahlheh jenge.
English: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.

tcz: Keima miphalou ho chunga kalung ahang'in ahi, ajeh chu amahon nathuhil apompouve.
en: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
text:
PSA 119:53
Thadou: Keima miphalou ho chunga kalung ahang'in ahi, ajeh chu amahon nathuhil apompouve.
English: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

tcz: Hiche kakholjinna munhi hoilai hijongleh na Dan thu semho hi kala ngeipen ahijinge.
en: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.
text:
PSA 119:54
Thadou: Hiche kakholjinna munhi hoilai hijongleh na Dan thu semho hi kala ngeipen ahijinge.
English: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai jantengleh nangma nahina hi kalungsung ah akilangjin, hijeh chun nathuhil hohi kajui jingin ahi.
en: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law.
text:
PSA 119:55
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai jantengleh nangma nahina hi kalungsung ah akilangjin, hijeh chun nathuhil hohi kajui jingin ahi.
English: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law.

tcz: Nathupeh juijinghi kahinkho mandan hitoh kilhon khoma ahitai.
en: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH
text:
PSA 119:56
Thadou: Nathupeh juijinghi kahinkho mandan hitoh kilhon khoma ahitai.
English: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, kachanding gouchu nangma nahi! Nathupeh juidingin kakiphaldoh jinge!
en: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
text:
PSA 119:57
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, kachanding gouchu nangma nahi! Nathupeh juidingin kakiphaldoh jinge!
English: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

tcz: Kalungthim pumpi hi namalsomna ngaichajing kahi, Nakitepna bangin neihepi jingtan.
en: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
text:
PSA 119:58
Thadou: Kalungthim pumpi hi namalsomna ngaichajing kahi, Nakitepna bangin neihepi jingtan.
English: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

tcz: Kahinkho ka lam lhahdan hi kanung gel jin chutengleh na Dan thu juina dingahin ka lutkit ji tai.
en: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:59
Thadou: Kahinkho ka lam lhahdan hi kanung gel jin chutengleh na Dan thu juina dingahin ka lutkit ji tai.
English: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

tcz: Nathupeh juina dingahin gangtah'in kipelut jing nange.
en: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
text:
PSA 119:60
Thadou: Nathupeh juina dingahin gangtah'in kipelut jing nange.
English: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

tcz: Miphalou hon chonsetna a lhohlut teiding eigo jiuvin ahinla keima vang na Dan thuhilna a hin dettah'in kading jingin ahi.
en: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
text:
PSA 119:61
Thadou: Miphalou hon chonsetna a lhohlut teiding eigo jiuvin ahinla keima vang na Dan thuhilna a hin dettah'in kading jingin ahi.
English: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

tcz: Na Dan thupeh hohi adih jeh'in jankhang jongleh kathoudoh'in nangma ka thangvah jin ahi.
en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
text:
PSA 119:62
Thadou: Na Dan thupeh hohi adih jeh'in jankhang jongleh kathoudoh'in nangma ka thangvah jin ahi.
English: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

tcz: Nangma thupeh juijing holeh nangma ging jingho dingin agolphao kahijinge.
en: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
text:
PSA 119:63
Thadou: Nangma thupeh juijing holeh nangma ging jingho dingin agolphao kahijinge.
English: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai namingailutna tanglou hin leiset chunghi adipmin, na Dan thuhi neihil jingin.
en: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH
text:
PSA 119:64
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai namingailutna tanglou hin leiset chunghi adipmin, na Dan thuhi neihil jingin.
English: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin nakitepna dungjuijin thilpha tamtah neibolpeh tai.
en: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, LORD.
text:
PSA 119:65
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nangin nakitepna dungjuijin thilpha tamtah neibolpeh tai.
English: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, LORD.

tcz: Nathupeh hoachun kading jinge, hetna thepna leh thu adih'a tantheina thuguh chu neihil in,
en: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
text:
PSA 119:66
Thadou: Nathupeh hoachun kading jinge, hetna thepna leh thu adih'a tantheina thuguh chu neihil in,
English: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

tcz: Nangin neihilchah masang chun kana lamvaijin, tunvang nathu thun kanungtai.
en: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
text:
PSA 119:67
Thadou: Nangin neihilchah masang chun kana lamvaijin, tunvang nathu thun kanungtai.
English: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

tcz: Nangman naphatna'in thilpha bou na bol jie, na Dan thuchu neihil in.
en: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:68
Thadou: Nangman naphatna'in thilpha bou na bol jie, na Dan thuchu neihil in.
English: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

tcz: Miphalou ho jouthu eisei khum jiuvin, ahinla kenvang kalungthim pumpin nathupeh ho dihtah'in kajuijing nai.
en: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
text:
PSA 119:69
Thadou: Miphalou ho jouthu eisei khum jiuvin, ahinla kenvang kalungthim pumpin nathupeh ho dihtah'in kajuijing nai.
English: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

tcz: Alungthim u ngol hoitah ahin; keivang nangma thupehho juijing hi kakipana ahijinge.
en: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
text:
PSA 119:70
Thadou: Alungthim u ngol hoitah ahin; keivang nangma thupehho juijing hi kakipana ahijinge.
English: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

tcz: Ka thohgimna chu keidinga thilphajo anahi, ajeh chu hichehin nathupeh juina ding langa lunglutna eipethei jin ahi.
en: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:71
Thadou: Ka thohgimna chu keidinga thilphajo anahi, ajeh chu hichehin nathupeh juina ding langa lunglutna eipethei jin ahi.
English: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

tcz: Nathuhil ho juiding hi sana le dangka simsenlou sangin aman atamjon ahi.
en: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH
text:
PSA 119:72
Thadou: Nathuhil ho juiding hi sana le dangka simsenlou sangin aman atamjon ahi.
English: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH

tcz: Nangin neina gon a neinasemdoh ahin, tunvang nathupeh juina dinga hin hetthem theina neipen.
en: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
text:
PSA 119:73
Thadou: Nangin neina gon a neinasemdoh ahin, tunvang nathupeh juina dinga hin hetthem theina neipen.
English: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

tcz: Nangma ging ho jousen kei a konna hin kipa na mu u heuhen, ajeh chu keiman nathupeh ahin kinepna dihtah kanei in ahi.
en: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
text:
PSA 119:74
Thadou: Nangma ging ho jousen kei a konna hin kipa na mu u heuhen, ajeh chu keiman nathupeh ahin kinepna dihtah kanei in ahi.
English: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai keiman na Dan semho adihdan hi kahethem tai, neisuhgim ji ding hi keidia thil phachom ahi.
en: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
text:
PSA 119:75
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai keiman na Dan semho adihdan hi kahethem tai, neisuhgim ji ding hi keidia thil phachom ahi.
English: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

tcz: Tuhin nasohpa neiteppeh bangin namingailutna longlou chun eilungmonsah jin ahi.
en: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
text:
PSA 119:76
Thadou: Tuhin nasohpa neiteppeh bangin namingailutna longlou chun eilungmonsah jin ahi.
English: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

tcz: Kahintheina dingin namihepina chun neiumkimvel jingin ajeh chu neithuhilna hohi keidinga kipana leh lunglhaina ahi.
en: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
text:
PSA 119:77
Thadou: Kahintheina dingin namihepina chun neiumkimvel jingin ajeh chu neithuhilna hohi keidinga kipana leh lunglhaina ahi.
English: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

tcz: Keichung changa thujou seiho miphalou hochu jumle jachatna penlang, keivangin nangma thupehho chu kangai jingding ahinai.
en: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
text:
PSA 119:78
Thadou: Keichung changa thujou seiho miphalou hochu jumle jachatna penlang, keivangin nangma thupehho chu kangai jingding ahinai.
English: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

tcz: Nangma Dan he themho leh nangma ging jingho chutoh nei ki vopkhom sah jingin.
en: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:79
Thadou: Nangma Dan he themho leh nangma ging jingho chutoh nei ki vopkhom sah jingin.
English: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

tcz: Na Dan thu kajuina ahin bolkhel kaneilouna dingin neivengin, chutileh jumna leh jachatna kaneilou ding ahi.
en: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF
text:
PSA 119:80
Thadou: Na Dan thu kajuina ahin bolkhel kaneilouna dingin neivengin, chutileh jumna leh jachatna kaneilou ding ahi.
English: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF

tcz: Nangma huhdohna ding kangana lamma hin abeipaiding kahitai, ahinlah nathupeh ahin kakinepna adetjinge.
en: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
text:
PSA 119:81
Thadou: Nangma huhdohna ding kangana lamma hin abeipaiding kahitai, ahinlah nathupeh ahin kakinepna adetjinge.
English: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

tcz: Nakitepna ahung gulhunna ding vetnan kamit achahleutai, itih tahleh neilhamon dingham?
en: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
text:
PSA 119:82
Thadou: Nakitepna ahung gulhunna ding vetnan kamit achahleutai, itih tahleh neilhamon dingham?
English: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

tcz: Lengpi twipai savun ahun ahulgot bangin kagolhatai ahinlah na Dan thu juiding kasumil dehpon ahi.
en: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:83
Thadou: Lengpi twipai savun ahun ahulgot bangin kagolhatai ahinlah na Dan thu juiding kasumil dehpon ahi.
English: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

tcz: Itihchanpi hi kanga jingding hitam? Keima eibolse hohi itihleh aphu nalah dingham?
en: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
text:
PSA 119:84
Thadou: Itihchanpi hi kanga jingding hitam? Keima eibolse hohi itihleh aphu nalah dingham?
English: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

tcz: Nangma thuhil nahsahlou mi kiletsah hohin keima kipalna ding ko thuhtah alaijun ahi.
en: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
text:
PSA 119:85
Thadou: Nangma thuhil nahsahlou mi kiletsah hohin keima kipalna ding ko thuhtah alaijun ahi.
English: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

tcz: Nathupeh jouse hi tahsan dinga lomtah cheh ahi. Ajeh bei a eidel lele hoa konhin neihuhdoh'in.
en: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
text:
PSA 119:86
Thadou: Nathupeh jouse hi tahsan dinga lomtah cheh ahi. Ajeh bei a eidel lele hoa konhin neihuhdoh'in.
English: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

tcz: Amaho hin eichaidohpai got u ahitai, ahinla keiman nathupeh hohi kajuida dehpoi.
en: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.
text:
PSA 119:87
Thadou: Amaho hin eichaidohpai got u ahitai, ahinla keiman nathupeh hohi kajuida dehpoi.
English: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.

tcz: Na mi ngailutna longlou chun kahinkho hi huhdoh'in, chutileh na Dan thu kajui theiding ahi.
en: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH
text:
PSA 119:88
Thadou: Na mi ngailutna longlou chun kahinkho hi huhdoh'in, chutileh na Dan thu kajui theiding ahi.
English: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai tonsot a dinga nakitepna chu van a dettah'in aumjinge.
en: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.
text:
PSA 119:89
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai tonsot a dinga nakitepna chu van a dettah'in aumjinge.
English: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.

tcz: Nangin nanatundoh hiche leiset hi aumjing bangin nakitahna jong akhang khanga umjing ahi.
en: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
text:
PSA 119:90
Thadou: Nangin nanatundoh hiche leiset hi aumjing bangin nakitahna jong akhang khanga umjing ahi.
English: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

tcz: Nathilgon jouse hi nathupeh dungjui in tuni chan geihin aumsohkei un ahi, ajeh chu amahohi aboncha nalhacha ahisoh kei un ahi.
en: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
text:
PSA 119:91
Thadou: Nathilgon jouse hi nathupeh dungjui in tuni chan geihin aumsohkei un ahi, ajeh chu amahohi aboncha nalhacha ahisoh kei un ahi.
English: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

tcz: Na Dan thupeh hin kipana hinkho'ah eihin khoukhah hihleh kagenthei lengvaina a kana mol lem ding ahitai.
en: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
text:
PSA 119:92
Thadou: Na Dan thupeh hin kipana hinkho'ah eihin khoukhah hihleh kagenthei lengvaina a kana mol lem ding ahitai.
English: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

tcz: Na thupeh Dan hohi itihchan hijongleh ka suhmillou helding ahi, ajeh chu hicheho hin eihinghoi ahi.
en: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

tcz: Mi phalouhon suhmang dingin lampi dungah eichanglhi le jonguleh kei man vang na Dan thuhi kalung sungah thipbeh chan geljing nange.
en: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

tcz: Thiljouse hin akhonna aneisoh keije ahinlah na Dan thupeh hin akhonna aneipoi.

tcz: Na Dan thuhi phattin a ka geljing jeh'in eihilho sangin jong hetgilna ka neijotai.

en: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
text:
PSA 119:100
Thadou: Na thupeh Dan ho kanitjing jeh'in kachunga upa tehse ho sangin jong kachingjo tai.
English: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

tcz: Nathupeh dettah a kajuijing theina dingin thilse bolna a cheding kanompon ahi.
en: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
text:
PSA 119:101
Thadou: Nathupeh dettah a kajuijing theina dingin thilse bolna a cheding kanompon ahi.
English: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

tcz: Nangin phate keicha neihil ahitah jeh'in na Dan thu juina a konnin ka ki heimang nompon ahi.
en: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
text:
PSA 119:102
Thadou: Nangin phate keicha neihil ahitah jeh'in na Dan thu juina a konnin ka ki heimang nompon ahi.
English: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

tcz: Na thupeh hi kapatep leh alhum lheh jenge, khoiju sangin alhumjon ahi.
en: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
text:
PSA 119:103
Thadou: Na thupeh hi kapatep leh alhum lheh jenge, khoiju sangin alhumjon ahi.
English: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

tcz: Na Dan thupeh hohin hetthemna eipen; hiti chun hinkho adihlou lam a cheding hi kathet lheh ji e.
en: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN
text:
PSA 119:104
Thadou: Na Dan thupeh hohin hetthemna eipen; hiti chun hinkho adihlou lam a cheding hi kathet lheh ji e.
English: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN

tcz: Nathupeh hi kakalsonna a eipuiding thaomei jin apangin, kalampi salvah ding vah'in apangin ahi.
en: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
text:
PSA 119:105
Thadou: Nathupeh hi kakalsonna a eipuiding thaomei jin apangin, kalampi salvah ding vah'in apangin ahi.
English: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

tcz: Na Dan thupeh dihtah hohi kajuijing ding ahin, hiche dinga hi kitepna kananei ahitan avel a kakitep kitding ahi.
en: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
text:
PSA 119:106
Thadou: Na Dan thupeh dihtah hohi kajuijing ding ahin, hiche dinga hi kitepna kananei ahitan avel a kakitep kitding ahi.
English: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nathutep dungjui in ka hinkho hoidoh sah'in ajeh chu kathohlel behseh jenge.
en: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, LORD, according to your word.
text:
PSA 119:107
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nathutep dungjui in ka hinkho hoidoh sah'in ajeh chu kathohlel behseh jenge.
English: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, LORD, according to your word.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai ka thangvah nahi kilhaina thilto bangin neisanpeh'in lang chuleh na Dan thupeh ho neihil in.
en: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances.
text:
PSA 119:108
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai ka thangvah nahi kilhaina thilto bangin neisanpeh'in lang chuleh na Dan thupeh ho neihil in.
English: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances.

tcz: Keima ka hinkho hi kilep ditdet in aum e, ahinlah na thuhil hi ka juidadeh pong e.
en: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
text:
PSA 119:109
Thadou: Keima ka hinkho hi kilep ditdet in aum e, ahinlah na thuhil hi ka juidadeh pong e.
English: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.

tcz: Mi phalou hon ka kipalna dingin thang akam jingun ahi, ahi vangin nathupeh'a kon a ka ki heimang doh louding ahi.
en: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
text:
PSA 119:110
Thadou: Mi phalou hon ka kipalna dingin thang akam jingun ahi, ahi vangin nathupeh'a kon a ka ki heimang doh louding ahi.
English: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

tcz: Na Dan thu hi keidinga gou ahi, hicheho hin ka lungthim akipasah'in ahi.
en: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
text:
PSA 119:111
Thadou: Na Dan thu hi keidinga gou ahi, hicheho hin ka lungthim akipasah'in ahi.
English: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

tcz: Ka thini changei a na Dan thu nitding hi ka dinpi ahitai.
en: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH
text:
PSA 119:112
Thadou: Ka thini changei a na Dan thu nitding hi ka dinpi ahitai.
English: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH

tcz: Kitahna neiloute hi kathet ahin keivang na thuhil ho jui dinghi katha nopna ahi.
en: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
text:
PSA 119:113
Thadou: Kitahna neiloute hi kathet ahin keivang na thuhil ho jui dinghi katha nopna ahi.
English: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

tcz: Nangma hi kakiselna leh kalumdal nahi, nathupeh hi kakinepna bulpi ahijinge.
en: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
text:
PSA 119:114
Thadou: Nangma hi kakiselna leh kalumdal nahi, nathupeh hi kakinepna bulpi ahijinge.
English: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

tcz: Milung gilouho keija kon in potdoh'un, ajeh chu keiman ka Yahweh Pakai thupeh hohi kajuinom e.
en: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
text:
PSA 119:115
Thadou: Milung gilouho keija kon in potdoh'un, ajeh chu keiman ka Yahweh Pakai thupeh hohi kajuinom e.
English: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, nakitepna bangin kahinjouna dingin tha neipen kakinepna hi neijumso hihbeh'in,
en: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
text:
PSA 119:116
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai, nakitepna bangin kahinjouna dingin tha neipen kakinepna hi neijumso hihbeh'in,
English: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

tcz: Nathahatnan neituh'in chutileh kahoidohding ahi, chutengleh nathupeh hi kachepi jingding ahi.
en: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
text:
PSA 119:117
Thadou: Nathahatnan neituh'in chutileh kahoidohding ahi, chutengleh nathupeh hi kachepi jingding ahi.
English: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

tcz: Nathupeh a kon a potdoh hohi nangin napaidoh gamheltan ahi. Amahohi amahole amaho kijoulhep ahibouve.
en: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
text:
PSA 119:118
Thadou: Nathupeh a kon a potdoh hohi nangin napaidoh gamheltan ahi. Amahohi amahole amaho kijoulhep ahibouve.
English: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

tcz: Nangin mi-engse hochu leiset chunga konnin bohse bangin napaidoh jitan ahi, hijeh chun kei vangin na Dan thuho hi kajui nom e.
en: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.
text:
PSA 119:119
Thadou: Nangin mi-engse hochu leiset chunga konnin bohse bangin napaidoh jitan ahi, hijeh chun kei vangin na Dan thuho hi kajui nom e.
English: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

tcz: Nangma ginnan ka kithinge, na thutan dihtah ho jeh'in ki chatnan kadim e.
en: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN
text:
PSA 119:120
Thadou: Nangma ginnan ka kithinge, na thutan dihtah ho jeh'in ki chatnan kadim e.
English: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN

tcz: Keiman thudih tahleh kitahna neitah'in na katonge, kagal mite khut a neidalhahih'in.
en: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.
text:
PSA 119:121
Thadou: Keiman thudih tahleh kitahna neitah'in na katonge, kagal mite khut a neidalhahih'in.
English: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.

tcz: Phatthei neibohding kinepna neipen, mi kiletsahho neibolsetsah hihbeh'in.
en: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
text:
PSA 119:122
Thadou: Phatthei neibohding kinepna neipen, mi kiletsahho neibolsetsah hihbeh'in.
English: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.

tcz: Nathutep dihtah chu asuh bulhit nadinga neihuhdohna dingchu kavet vetnan kamit achah leutan ahi.
en: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
text:
PSA 119:123
Thadou: Nathutep dihtah chu asuh bulhit nadinga neihuhdohna dingchu kavet vetnan kamit achah leutan ahi.
English: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

tcz: Nami ngailutna longlou chun nasoh hi neibolpha jingin, chuleh na Dan thuho chu neihil in.
en: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:124
Thadou: Nami ngailutna longlou chun nasoh hi neibolpha jingin, chuleh na Dan thuho chu neihil in.
English: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

tcz: Na Dan thuhohi kahettheina dingin nasohhi hetthem theina neipen.
en: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
text:
PSA 119:125
Thadou: Na Dan thuhohi kahettheina dingin nasohhi hetthem theina neipen.
English: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai tu hi nakipatna na tohphat ahitai, ajeh chu miphalouhon na Dan thu apal kehgam tauve.
en: It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.
text:
PSA 119:126
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai tu hi nakipatna na tohphat ahitai, ajeh chu miphalouhon na Dan thu apal kehgam tauve.
English: It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.

tcz: Tahbeh'in nathupeh hohi sana mantampen sangin kadeijon ahi.
en: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
text:
PSA 119:127
Thadou: Tahbeh'in nathupeh hohi sana mantampen sangin kadeijon ahi.
English: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

tcz: Na thupeh hohi adihsoh kei in, hijeh'a chu lamdihlou hohi kathet ahi.
en: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE
text:
PSA 119:128
Thadou: Na thupeh hohi adihsoh kei in, hijeh'a chu lamdihlou hohi kathet ahi.
English: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE

tcz: Na Dan semhohi akidang theilheh jengin hijeh'a chu kalungthim pumpia kajui ahi!
en: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
text:
PSA 119:129
Thadou: Na Dan semhohi akidang theilheh jengin hijeh'a chu kalungthim pumpia kajui ahi!
English: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

tcz: Na Dan thuhil'a hin vah akilangin hijeh chun milham minjong ahetheijin ahi.
en: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
text:
PSA 119:130
Thadou: Na Dan thuhil'a hin vah akilangin hijeh chun milham minjong ahetheijin ahi.
English: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

tcz: Nathupeh ho kangaichat behseh jeh'in kaki gon chule kakam kah in kangah jinge.
en: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
text:
PSA 119:131
Thadou: Nathupeh ho kangaichat behseh jeh'in kaki gon chule kakam kah in kangah jinge.
English: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

PSA 119:132
Thadou: Nangma ngailuho nabolna bangin hung kihei in lang nami khotona neimusah'in.
English: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

tcz: Nakitepna dungjuijin kalhuh louna dingin neituh'in, thilse eijosah hihbeh'in.
en: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
text:
PSA 119:133
Thadou: Nakitepna dungjuijin kalhuh louna dingin neituh'in, thilse eijosah hihbeh'in.
English: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

tcz: Eisugenthei hoa kon in neihuhdoh'in, hitiachu nathupehho hoitah'a kajuijing theina dingin.
en: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
text:
PSA 119:134
Thadou: Eisugenthei hoa kon in neihuhdoh'in, hitiachu nathupehho hoitah'a kajuijing theina dingin.
English: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

tcz: Nasohpa kei ahin namaivah chu hin kilan dohsah'in chutengleh na Dan thuchu neihil in.
en: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:135
Thadou: Nasohpa kei ahin namaivah chu hin kilan dohsah'in chutengleh na Dan thuchu neihil in.
English: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

tcz: Mi hemten na thuhil ajuitah lou jeh'un kamit na hin mitlhi twi vadung bangin along'e.
en: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE
text:
PSA 119:136
Thadou: Mi hemten na thuhil ajuitah lou jeh'un kamit na hin mitlhi twi vadung bangin along'e.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma thudihtah nahi, na Dan semho jong adih'e.
en: You are righteous, LORD. Your judgments are upright.
text:
PSA 119:137
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangma thudihtah nahi, na Dan semho jong adih'e.

tcz: Na Dan semhohi nolnabei ahin chuleh tahsanthei mong mong ahi.
en: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
text:
PSA 119:138
Thadou: Na Dan semhohi nolnabei ahin chuleh tahsanthei mong mong ahi.
English: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

en: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

PSA 119:139

PSA 119:140
Thadou: Na thutep hohi kapatep sohkei ahitan adih lheh jeng in keiman ka deilheh jenge.
English: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

tcz: Keima hi hetkhamlou leh notthap ka hivang in nathupeh hohi ka sumil dehpoi.

text:
PSA 119:141
Thadou: Keima hi hetkhamlou leh notthap ka hivang in nathupeh hohi ka sumil dehpoi.
English: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.

en: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
text:
PSA 119:142
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nanga hin tonsotna thudih na aum e, chuleh na thuhil dihtah ho jonghi nolnabei ahi.
English: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

tcz: Hahsat na le lung khamna in eilonvuh jeng jongleh nathupeh hohi keidinga kipana tahbeh ahijinge.
en: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

PSA 119:143
Thadou: Hahsat na le lung khamna in eilonvuh jeng jongleh nathupeh hohi keidinga kipana tahbeh ahijinge.
English: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

tcz: Na Dan semho jouse jonghi adihjing jenge, hinna ka neitheina dingin neihet them sah'in.

text:
PSA 119:144
Thadou: Na Dan semho jouse jonghi adihjing jenge, hinna ka neitheina dingin neihet them sah'in.

tcz: Kalungthim pumpin kataove O Yahweh Pakai neihouvin, keiman na Dan thuho chu kanit jingding ahi.
en: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:145
Thadou: Kalungthim pumpin kataove O Yahweh Pakai neihouvin, keiman na Dan thuho chu kanit jingding ahi.
English: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes.

en: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:146
Thadou: Nangma kahin kouve Yahweh Pakai neihuh doh'in, na Dan thuho chu ka juijing thei nadin.
English: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

tcz: Khovah masangin matah'in kathouvin, nathutep na chun kakinem in panpi kathum e.
en: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
text:
PSA 119:147
Thadou: Khovah masangin matah'in kathouvin, nathutep na chun kakinem in panpi kathum e.
English: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

tcz: Jan khovah'in kahah'in nathutep chu kagel jinge.
en: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
text:
PSA 119:148
Thadou: Jan khovah'in kahah'in nathutep chu kagel jinge.
English: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

tcz: Nami ngailutna dihtah'a konchun O Yahweh Pakai kataona ngai in lang na Dan thu juina ahin neichoh hing kittan.
en: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, LORD, according to your ordinances.
text:
PSA 119:149
Thadou: Nami ngailutna dihtah'a konchun O Yahweh Pakai kataona ngai in lang na Dan thu juina ahin neichoh hing kittan.
English: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, LORD, according to your ordinances.

tcz: Dan neilou miten eihung delkhum un ahi, amahohi nangma thuhilla kon in agamlha lheh'un ahi.
en: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
text:
PSA 119:150
Thadou: Dan neilou miten eihung delkhum un ahi, amahohi nangma thuhilla kon in agamlha lheh'un ahi.
English: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

tcz: Ahinlah O Yahweh Pakai nangma naichan naum in ahi, chuleh nangma thupehho jouse adih'in ahi.
en: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth.
text:
PSA 119:151
Thadou: Ahinlah O Yahweh Pakai nangma naichan naum in ahi, chuleh nangma thupehho jouse adih'in ahi.
English: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth.

tcz: Na Dan semhohi tonsot a ding ahije tihi kaneolai a patna kanahetsa ahitai.
en: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH
text:
PSA 119:152
Thadou: Na Dan semhohi tonsot a ding ahije tihi kaneolai a patna kanahetsa ahitai.
English: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH

tcz: Kathoh gimna hi venlang neihuhdoh'in, ajeh chu keiman na thuhil hochu ka sumil khapoi.
en: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
text:
PSA 119:153
Thadou: Kathoh gimna hi venlang neihuhdoh'in, ajeh chu keiman na thuhil hochu ka sumil khapoi.
English: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.

tcz: Keima langa pangin lang ka chung chang thu neiseipeh'in nakitepna bangin neihuh doh'in.
en: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
text:
PSA 119:154
Thadou: Keima langa pangin lang ka chung chang thu neiseipeh'in nakitepna bangin neihuh doh'in.
English: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

tcz: Mi phalou hovang ki huhdoh louding ahiuve. Ajeh chu amahon na Dan thu hi anahsah pouve.
en: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:155
Thadou: Mi phalou hovang ki huhdoh louding ahiuve. Ajeh chu amahon na Dan thu hi anahsah pouve.
English: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai namihe pina hi anasalheh jenge, na Dan semhohi jui ing kating ka hinkho hi neikile dohsah tan.
en: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.
text:
PSA 119:156
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai namihe pina hi anasalheh jenge, na Dan semhohi jui ing kating ka hinkho hi neikile dohsah tan.
English: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.

tcz: Mitamtah'in asugenthei jin eisuboijin ahi, ahinlah na Dan thu juina a kon in kakiheimang dehpoi.
en: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
text:
PSA 119:157
Thadou: Mitamtah'in asugenthei jin eisuboijin ahi, ahinlah na Dan thu juina a kon in kakiheimang dehpoi.
English: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

tcz: Hitobanga mikitahlou hohi ka muting leh ka lungnatpi lhehjin ahi, ajeh chu amaho hin na Dan thu hi anahsah pouvin ahi.
en: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
text:
PSA 119:158
Thadou: Hitobanga mikitahlou hohi ka muting leh ka lungnatpi lhehjin ahi, ajeh chu amaho hin na Dan thu hi anahsah pouvin ahi.
English: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ven na thupeh hi ichangei a ka gelkhoh hitam, na mingailut na longlou jal in ka hinkho hi neilepeh kit in.
en: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness.
text:
PSA 119:159
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ven na thupeh hi ichangei a ka gelkhoh hitam, na mingailut na longlou jal in ka hinkho hi neilepeh kit in.
English: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness.

tcz: Na Dan hung kipatna thuguh chu thutah ahi, na Dan thu dihtah hohi tonsot a dingjing ding ahi.
en: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN
text:
PSA 119:160
Thadou: Na Dan hung kipatna thuguh chu thutah ahi, na Dan thu dihtah hohi tonsot a dingjing ding ahi.
English: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN

tcz: Mi thanei hon dihloutah'in eibol seuve, ahinlah keiman nathupeh hi ka lungthim in ginna kanei jinge.
en: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
text:
PSA 119:161
Thadou: Mi thanei hon dihloutah'in eibol seuve, ahinlah keiman nathupeh hi ka lungthim in ginna kanei jinge.
English: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

tcz: Khat touvin gou nasatah akimudoh bangin nathupeh ahin kakipah'in ahi.
en: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
text:
PSA 119:162
Thadou: Khat touvin gou nasatah akimudoh bangin nathupeh ahin kakipah'in ahi.
English: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.

tcz: Keiman jou le nal kitihi kathetnin ahinlah nathupeh hohi kagelkhoh'e.
en: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
text:
PSA 119:163
Thadou: Keiman jou le nal kitihi kathetnin ahinlah nathupeh hohi kagelkhoh'e.
English: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

tcz: Na Dan thu hohi adihjeh'in nikhat in sagivei thangvah na penge.
en: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
text:
PSA 119:164
Thadou: Na Dan thu hohi adihjeh'in nikhat in sagivei thangvah na penge.
English: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

tcz: Nang ma Dan thu ho gelkhoh na neiho jousen thahatna anei un ahi chuleh kipalna aneipou vin ahi.
en: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
text:
PSA 119:165
Thadou: Nang ma Dan thu ho gelkhoh na neiho jousen thahatna anei un ahi chuleh kipalna aneipou vin ahi.
English: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nangin neihuhdoh dinghi ka ngaicha lheh jengin ahi, hijeh'a chu nathupeh ho hi ka juijing ahi.
en: I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.
text:
PSA 119:166
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nangin neihuhdoh dinghi ka ngaicha lheh jengin ahi, hijeh'a chu nathupeh ho hi ka juijing ahi.
English: I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.

tcz: Na Dan semhohi kahinjui jinge ajeh chu hicheho hi deium ka salheh jenge.
en: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
text:
PSA 119:167
Thadou: Na Dan semhohi kahinjui jinge ajeh chu hicheho hi deium ka salheh jenge.
English: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

tcz: Ahi, keiman nathupeh hole na Dan semhohi kajui jinge ajeh chu nangin ka kiman chahna jouse nahen ahi.
en: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV
text:
PSA 119:168
Thadou: Ahi, keiman nathupeh hole na Dan semhohi kajui jinge ajeh chu nangin ka kiman chahna jouse nahen ahi.
English: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kahin kou nahi ngai in nangin neitep pehna bangin het them theina lungthim neipen.
en: Let my cry come before you, LORD. Give me understanding according to your word.
text:
PSA 119:169
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai kahin kou nahi ngai in nangin neitep pehna bangin het them theina lungthim neipen.
English: Let my cry come before you, LORD. Give me understanding according to your word.

tcz: Ka taona hi ngai in, nathutep na bangin nei huhdoh tei in.
en: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
text:
PSA 119:170
Thadou: Ka taona hi ngai in, nathutep na bangin nei huhdoh tei in.
English: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

tcz: Kakam a kon in thangvahna hi hung lengdoh jenghen ajeh chu nangman na Dan thu hohi neihil themtan ahi.
en: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
text:
PSA 119:171
Thadou: Kakam a kon in thangvahna hi hung lengdoh jenghen ajeh chu nangman na Dan thu hohi neihil themtan ahi.
English: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

tcz: Kalei in nathupeh hohi thangvah lan sa hen, ajeh chu nathupeh jouse hi adih'in ahi.
en: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
text:
PSA 119:172
Thadou: Kalei in nathupeh hohi thangvah lan sa hen, ajeh chu nathupeh jouse hi adih'in ahi.
English: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

tcz: Nei kithopina khutchu hin lhangdoh'in ajeh chu na thupeh ho juidinga kigotna kanei ahitai.
en: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
text:
PSA 119:173
Thadou: Nei kithopina khutchu hin lhangdoh'in ajeh chu na thupeh ho juidinga kigotna kanei ahitai.
English: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangin neihuhdoh dinghi ka ngaichat jing ahi, ajeh chu nangma thuhil hohi kakipana ahijinge.
en: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.
text:
PSA 119:174
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangin neihuhdoh dinghi ka ngaichat jing ahi, ajeh chu nangma thuhil hohi kakipana ahijinge.
English: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.

tcz: Nangma ka thangvah jing theina dingin nei hing hoi in, chuleh nathupeh hohi eikithopin pangjing hen.
en: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
text:
PSA 119:175
Thadou: Nangma ka thangvah jing theina dingin nei hing hoi in, chuleh nathupeh hohi eikithopin pangjing hen.
English: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

tcz: Kelngoi banga vahmanga kahitai hungin lang neihung holdoh tan ajeh chu nathupeh hohi keiman kasumil theipoi.
en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
text:
PSA 119:176
Thadou: Kelngoi banga vahmanga kahitai hungin lang neihung holdoh tan ajeh chu nathupeh hohi keiman kasumil theipoi.
English: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.

tcz: Lungkham na leh lung gim na kato tengleh Yahweh Pakai kom kalhutjin ahileh Aman kataona asangjin ahi.
en: In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.
text:
PSA 120:1
Thadou: Lungkham na leh lung gim na kato tengleh Yahweh Pakai kom kalhutjin ahileh Aman kataona asangjin ahi.
English: In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai in mijoubol ho a konleh milepche ho a kon in neihuhdoh'in.
en: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
text:
PSA 120:2
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai in mijoubol ho a konleh milepche ho a kon in neihuhdoh'in.
English: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

tcz: Oh lepchena leigui mangcha ho, Elohim Pathen in nangho ipi na louvin tem? Aman nachunga engbolna ichan gei in apunsahbe dem?
en: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
text:
PSA 120:3
Thadou: Oh lepchena leigui mangcha ho, Elohim Pathen in nangho ipi na louvin tem? Aman nachunga engbolna ichan gei in apunsahbe dem?
English: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

tcz: Nangma thalchang hemtah a naki sunding chuleh meihol sapehpoh naki desah ding ahi.
en: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
text:
PSA 120:4
Thadou: Nangma thalchang hemtah a naki sunding chuleh meihol sapehpoh naki desah ding ahi.
English: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

tcz: Gamlatah Meshach lah'a ka chenchu kadanave, gamlatah Kedar ponbuh a ka chenchu ka thohlel ngeije,
en: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
text:
PSA 120:5
Thadou: Gamlatah Meshach lah'a ka chenchu kadanave, gamlatah Kedar ponbuh a ka chenchu ka thohlel ngeije,
English: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

tcz: Keima chamna deilah'a kachenhi kakhoplheh jengtai,
en: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
text:
PSA 120:6
Thadou: Keima chamna deilah'a kachenhi kakhoplheh jengtai,
English: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

tcz: Keiman chamna kahol in, ahinlah keiman chamna thu kaseipou pouleh amahon gal bou adeijiu ve.
en: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
text:
PSA 120:7
Thadou: Keiman chamna kahol in, ahinlah keiman chamna thu kaseipou pouleh amahon gal bou adeijiu ve.
English: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

tcz: Keima kadah'in thinglhanglam kavei, hichea kon a khu eipanpi hung hintem?
en: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
text:
PSA 121:1
Thadou: Keima kadah'in thinglhanglam kavei, hichea kon a khu eipanpi hung hintem?
English: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

tcz: Vanle lei sem pa Paka a kon a eipanpi hung ahi.
en: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
text:
PSA 121:2
Thadou: Vanle lei sem pa Paka a kon a eipanpi hung ahi.
English: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

tcz: Aman nangma nakipalsah louding; nachingpa chu ihmu louding ahi.
en: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
text:
PSA 121:3
Thadou: Aman nangma nakipalsah louding; nachingpa chu ihmu louding ahi.
English: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

tcz: Tahbeh'in Israel chingpa chu itihchan hijongleh ihmu lhulou ding ahilouleh ihmu louding ahi.
en: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
text:
PSA 121:4
Thadou: Tahbeh'in Israel chingpa chu itihchan hijongleh ihmu lhulou ding ahilouleh ihmu louding ahi.
English: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai amatah chu nachingpa ahi! Ama nakom a ading jingin nahoidohna lim in apang jinge.
en: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.
text:
PSA 121:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai amatah chu nachingpa ahi! Ama nakom a ading jingin nahoidohna lim in apang jinge.
English: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.

tcz: Sun leh nisan nasangpeh pontin, janleh lhavah injong nasubeipon te.
en: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
text:
PSA 121:6
Thadou: Sun leh nisan nasangpeh pontin, janleh lhavah injong nasubeipon te.
English: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thilse jousea nahoidohsah in tin nahinkho chingjing nante.
en: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
text:
PSA 121:7
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in thilse jousea nahoidohsah in tin nahinkho chingjing nante.
English: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in tuapat tonsot gei in navai kondoh leh nahung vailhun in nachingjing tahen.
en: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
text:
PSA 121:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in tuapat tonsot gei in navai kondoh leh nahung vailhun in nachingjing tahen.
English: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hou inn ah cheuhite tia kakom a asei u chun keima kakipahlheh jengin ahi.
en: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”
text:
PSA 122:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hou inn ah cheuhite tia kakom a asei u chun keima kakipahlheh jengin ahi.
English: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”

tcz: Vo Jerusalem tuhin keiho nakelkot sung langah kadingtao ve.
en: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!
text:
PSA 122:2
Thadou: Vo Jerusalem tuhin keiho nakelkot sung langah kadingtao ve.
English: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!

tcz: Jerusalem hi dettah'a kisa khopi ahin apal jonghi detchetna kigenbitna ahi.
en: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,
text:
PSA 122:3
Thadou: Jerusalem hi dettah'a kisa khopi ahin apal jonghi detchetna kigenbitna ahi.
English: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,

tcz: Yahweh Pakai mite Israel phungho jousen hicheahi kintheng bolla ahungnao ahi. Israelte chonna dan dungjui a Yahweh Pakai kom a thangvahna pedinga ahungnao ahi.
en: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.
text:
PSA 122:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai mite Israel phungho jousen hicheahi kintheng bolla ahungnao ahi. Israelte chonna dan dungjui a Yahweh Pakai kom a thangvahna pedinga ahungnao ahi.
