English: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.

tcz: Hichea hin lengte thutanna laltouna hochu aum in David chilhah ho laltouna ahi.
en: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
text:
PSA 122:5
Thadou: Hichea hin lengte thutanna laltouna hochu aum in David chilhah ho laltouna ahi.
English: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.

tcz: Jerusalem a cham lenna din taovun, hiche khopi ngailu jouse khangtouhen.
en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
text:
PSA 122:6
Thadou: Jerusalem a cham lenna din taovun, hiche khopi ngailu jouse khangtouhen.
English: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

tcz: Vo Jerusalem, nakulpi sunga chamleng hen chuleh nakhopi sung khangtou hen.
en: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
text:
PSA 122:7
Thadou: Vo Jerusalem, nakulpi sunga chamleng hen chuleh nakhopi sung khangtou hen.
English: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

tcz: Kainsung mite leh kagol kapaite khohsahna in keiman Jerusalem ah “Nanga chamna umhen” kati.
en: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
text:
PSA 122:8
Thadou: Kainsung mite leh kagol kapaite khohsahna in keiman Jerusalem ah “Nanga chamna umhen” kati.
English: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u insung khohsah na'in, O Jerusalem nang dinga aphapen chu kahol ahi.
en: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
text:
PSA 122:9
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u insung khohsah na'in, O Jerusalem nang dinga aphapen chu kahol ahi.
English: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.

tcz: Van a alaltouna a tou O ka Pathen Elohim nangma munomna in kadah'in kahinvei.
en: I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
text:
PSA 123:1
Thadou: Van a alaltouna a tou O ka Pathen Elohim nangma munomna in kadah'in kahinvei.
English: I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.

tcz: Sohten amit uva apupao avetjing bangun Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim khotona ngaichan keihon kahin vejing ui. Hiti hin soh nungah honjong api'u chaloh akivetgeu jingun ahi.
en: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.
text:
PSA 123:2
Thadou: Sohten amit uva apupao avetjing bangun Yahweh Pakai, iPathen'u Elohim khotona ngaichan keihon kahin vejing ui. Hiti hin soh nungah honjong api'u chaloh akivetgeu jingun ahi.
English: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ka chung u vah khotona neipeuvin ajeh chu keiho hi vetda changsa ka hiuve.
en: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
text:
PSA 123:3
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ka chung u vah khotona neipeuvin ajeh chu keiho hi vetda changsa ka hiuve.
English: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

tcz: Ajeh chu keihohi mi kiletsahho housetna leh mikhoh ho tai tomnan eichupmu ahitai.
en: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
text:
PSA 123:4
Thadou: Ajeh chu keihohi mi kiletsahho housetna leh mikhoh ho tai tomnan eichupmu ahitai.
English: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi eiho langa anapanglou hikhataleh? Israelte jousen velseikit hen.
en: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,
text:
PSA 124:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi eiho langa anapanglou hikhataleh? Israelte jousen velseikit hen.
English: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,

tcz: Min eina delkhum pettah'un Yahweh Pakai hi eiho langa anapanglou hikhataleh,
en: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,
text:
PSA 124:2
Thadou: Min eina delkhum pettah'un Yahweh Pakai hi eiho langa anapanglou hikhataleh,
English: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,

tcz: amahon alunghan u deojah pum in ahingin eina vallhum tauvinte.
en: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,
text:
PSA 124:3
Thadou: amahon alunghan u deojah pum in ahingin eina vallhum tauvinte.
English: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

tcz: Twi chun einachup uvintin, twikhanglen chun einalhohmang diu ahitai.
en: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.
text:
PSA 124:4
Thadou: Twi chun einachup uvintin, twikhanglen chun einalhohmang diu ahitai.
English: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.

tcz: Hitiachu ichunguva twipi kitoltol ding ahiuve.
en: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
text:
PSA 124:5
Thadou: Hitiachu ichunguva twipi kitoltol ding ahiuve.
English: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

tcz: Igalmiteu einasuhmang sah louva Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuhite.
en: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
text:
PSA 124:6
Thadou: Igalmiteu einasuhmang sah louva Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuhite.
English: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

tcz: Eiho thang kampa a kon a vacha ahoidoh banga hoidoh ihiuve. Thangpou chu akivobong tan eiho ihoidoh tauve.
en: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
text:
PSA 124:7
Thadou: Eiho thang kampa a kon a vacha ahoidoh banga hoidoh ihiuve. Thangpou chu akivobong tan eiho ihoidoh tauve.
English: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

tcz: Hitobanga kithopina chu vanle lei sem ah Yahweh Pakai a kon a imu'u ahi.
en: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.
text:
PSA 124:8
Thadou: Hitobanga kithopina chu vanle lei sem ah Yahweh Pakai a kon a imu'u ahi.
English: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai a tahsanna dettah neiho chu Zion mol tobag ahiuve. Amaho chu suhlinghoi hiloudiu a-itih'a detjing ding ahiuve.
en: Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
text:
PSA 125:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai a tahsanna dettah neiho chu Zion mol tobag ahiuve. Amaho chu suhlinghoi hiloudiu a-itih'a detjing ding ahiuve.
English: Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

tcz: Jerusalem mol'in aumkimvel bangin, tuleh tua dingin Yahweh Pakai chu amite kimvel a akisung jinge.
en: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
text:
PSA 125:2
Thadou: Jerusalem mol'in aumkimvel bangin, tuleh tua dingin Yahweh Pakai chu amite kimvel a akisung jinge.
English: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

tcz: Michonphate gam a chu miphalou te vaihomna leng teng gol in chan aneilou ding ahi. Achuti louleh michonpha ho jengin jong thilse ahinbol maithei ahi.
en: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
text:
PSA 125:3
Thadou: Michonphate gam a chu miphalou te vaihomna leng teng gol in chan aneilou ding ahi. Achuti louleh michonpha ho jengin jong thilse ahinbol maithei ahi.
English: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai miphaho lungthim nangma toh chekhom theiho chu nangin thilpha bolpeh jingin.
en: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
text:
PSA 125:4
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai miphaho lungthim nangma toh chekhom theiho chu nangin thilpha bolpeh jingin.
English: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

tcz: Ahinlah O Yahweh Pakai lamdihlouva chete chu thildihlou bolte toh paidohtha jengin. Israelte lah'a cham lenghen!
en: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
text:
PSA 125:5
Thadou: Ahinlah O Yahweh Pakai lamdihlouva chete chu thildihlou bolte toh paidohtha jengin. Israelte lah'a cham lenghen!
English: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in sohchang hochu Jerusalem a ahinlepuilut kitphatchun, hichu mangtoh abang jengin ahi!
en: When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
text:
PSA 126:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in sohchang hochu Jerusalem a ahinlepuilut kitphatchun, hichu mangtoh abang jengin ahi!
English: When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

tcz: Keiho lungna chim tah'a nuinan ka dimset jingun, ki pahtah'in la kasauve. Hichun chidang namdang hon asei un, “Yahweh Pakai in thil loupi kidangtah chu aboldoh peh tauve” atiuve.
en: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
text:
PSA 126:2
Thadou: Keiho lungna chim tah'a nuinan ka dimset jingun, ki pahtah'in la kasauve. Hichun chidang namdang hon asei un, “Yahweh Pakai in thil loupi kidangtah chu aboldoh peh tauve” atiuve.
English: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”

tcz: Adih'e, Yahweh Pakai in thil loupi kidangtah chu eiboldoh pehtauve! Iti kipa um a hitam!
en: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.
text:
PSA 126:3
Thadou: Adih'e, Yahweh Pakai in thil loupi kidangtah chu eiboldoh pehtauve! Iti kipa um a hitam!
English: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.

tcz: Neldi gam a twilonglut hon athah semkit bangin O Yahweh Pakai kanei kagouhou hin kiledoh sah kittan.
en: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.
text:
PSA 126:4
Thadou: Neldi gam a twilonglut hon athah semkit bangin O Yahweh Pakai kanei kagouhou hin kiledoh sah kittan.
English: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.

tcz: Mitlhi long pum pum a muchi tuten, kipah thanom tah'a aga akilodiu ahi.
en: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
text:
PSA 126:5
Thadou: Mitlhi long pum pum a muchi tuten, kipah thanom tah'a aga akilodiu ahi.
English: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

tcz: Kapjing pum a atuding muchi kipoh'a vaikonten, aga hinkipoh puma inmun kipahle thanomtah'in hung kileuhen.
en: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
text:
PSA 126:6
Thadou: Kapjing pum a atuding muchi kipoh'a vaikonten, aga hinkipoh puma inmun kipahle thanomtah'in hung kileuhen.
English: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

tcz: Insa-a hi Yahweh Pakai apan louleh, asahon mohseh'a asah'u ahi. Khopi ngah'a hi Yahweh Pakai ajao louleh, khongah ho pannabei a hahkhovah ahiuve.
en: Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
text:
PSA 127:1
Thadou: Insa-a hi Yahweh Pakai apan louleh, asahon mohseh'a asah'u ahi. Khopi ngah'a hi Yahweh Pakai ajao louleh, khongah ho pannabei a hahkhovah ahiuve.
English: Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

tcz: Jingkah matah'a nakipat uva jankhang gei a nehding an holna a na natoh'u pan nabei ahi, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in angailut achate hi a-ihmut sunguva hi ijakai agontohpeh ahibouve.
en: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
text:
PSA 127:2
Thadou: Jingkah matah'a nakipat uva jankhang gei a nehding an holna a na natoh'u pan nabei ahi, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in angailut achate hi a-ihmut sunguva hi ijakai agontohpeh ahibouve.
English: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

tcz: Veuvin, chatehi Yahweh Pakaija kon a gou ahin, naobu sunga kona aga kimu jonghi kipa thilpeh ahi.
en: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
text:
PSA 127:3
Thadou: Veuvin, chatehi Yahweh Pakaija kon a gou ahin, naobu sunga kona aga kimu jonghi kipa thilpeh ahi.
English: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

tcz: Khang don laija cha kineiho hi galsatpan akhutna thal changho akichoi tobang ahi.
en: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
text:
PSA 127:4
Thadou: Khang don laija cha kineiho hi galsatpan akhutna thal changho akichoi tobang ahi.
English: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

tcz: Thal chang abom dimsetna kipohpa anun nom ahi. Amachu agalmite toh thutan na munna akimuto teng gal lel hilouhel ding ahi.
en: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
text:
PSA 127:5
Thadou: Thal chang abom dimsetna kipohpa anun nom ahi. Amachu agalmite toh thutan na munna akimuto teng gal lel hilouhel ding ahi.
English: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

tcz: Koi hileh Yahweh Pakai ging geh'a um a Ama lunglhaina lampia kalsongho chu anunnom ahiuve.
en: Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.
text:
PSA 128:1
Thadou: Koi hileh Yahweh Pakai ging geh'a um a Ama lunglhaina lampia kalsongho chu anunnom ahiuve.
English: Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.

tcz: Nangin nakhutsoh natohga naneh ding ahin, iti nakipading hitam na hinkho kiledoh ding ahitai.
en: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
text:
PSA 128:2
Thadou: Nangin nakhutsoh natohga naneh ding ahin, iti nakipading hitam na hinkho kiledoh ding ahitai.
English: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

tcz: Nainsunga najinu jong lengpigui ga phatah banga phatthei punna hiding, ankong phunga an naneh khompi nachate melhoitah tah Olive thingbah lhoutah bangdiu ahi.
en: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.
text:
PSA 128:3
Thadou: Nainsunga najinu jong lengpigui ga phatah banga phatthei punna hiding, ankong phunga an naneh khompi nachate melhoitah tah Olive thingbah lhoutah bangdiu ahi.
English: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

tcz: Veuvin, Yahweh Pakai gingte phatthei achandingu chu hitobang hi hiding ahi.
en: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.
text:
PSA 128:4
Thadou: Veuvin, Yahweh Pakai gingte phatthei achandingu chu hitobang hi hiding ahi.
English: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in Zion a kon in phatthei nabohjing jinghen, nahinkho lhumkei in Jerusalem machalna mujing jingin.
en: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
text:
PSA 128:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in Zion a kon in phatthei nabohjing jinghen, nahinkho lhumkei in Jerusalem machalna mujing jingin.
English: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

tcz: Natuson gei in jong hin munlang, Israel chungah chamleng hen!
en: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
text:
PSA 128:6
Thadou: Natuson gei in jong hin munlang, Israel chungah chamleng hen!
English: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

tcz: Kakhangdonlai a pat in kagalmiten eihin bolseuvin ahi. Israel pumpin hichehi velsei uhen.
en: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:
text:
PSA 129:1
Thadou: Kakhangdonlai a pat in kagalmiten eihin bolseuvin ahi. Israel pumpin hichehi velsei uhen.
English: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:

tcz: Kakhangdonlai a pat in kagalmiten eihin bolseuvin ahi, ahinla amahon khatveicha eijoukha pouvin ahi.
en: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
text:
PSA 129:2
Thadou: Kakhangdonlai a pat in kagalmiten eihin bolseuvin ahi, ahinla amahon khatveicha eijoukha pouvin ahi.
English: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.

tcz: Katungtun hi maha adiptauvin, loukhoipan lou akhoi chehlah lahtoh abahsah jengun ahi.
en: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
text:
PSA 129:3
Thadou: Katungtun hi maha adiptauvin, loukhoipan lou akhoi chehlah lahtoh abahsah jengun ahi.
English: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

tcz: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai chu aphatjeh'in miphalouhon khaova eikan nao eisutlhap peh tan ahi.
en: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
text:
PSA 129:4
Thadou: Ahinla Yahweh Pakai chu aphatjeh'in miphalouhon khaova eikan nao eisutlhap peh tan ahi.
English: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

tcz: Koi hileh Jerusalem hot leh deimoa bolho jouse chu jumthet in ki nunglekit'u henlang lhuhpiu hen.
en: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
text:
PSA 129:5
Thadou: Koi hileh Jerusalem hot leh deimoa bolho jouse chu jumthet in ki nunglekit'u henlang lhuhpiu hen.
English: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.

tcz: Amahohi pannabei inchung vum a hampa kehtobang, akhan kilhit masanga goplha tobang hiuhen.
en: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,
text:
PSA 129:6
Thadou: Amahohi pannabei inchung vum a hampa kehtobang, akhan kilhit masanga goplha tobang hiuhen.
English: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,

tcz: Chang-at hon anotthap'u, chuleh chang kanhon adeimou hihen, chuleh hichelang hopa jousen, “Nachunguva Yahweh Pakai phattheiboh umhen keihon Yahweh Pakai mi in phatthei kahinboh uve” tin seihihbeh'u hen.
en: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
text:
PSA 129:7
Thadou: Chang-at hon anotthap'u, chuleh chang kanhon adeimou hihen, chuleh hichelang hopa jousen, “Nachunguva Yahweh Pakai phattheiboh umhen keihon Yahweh Pakai mi in phatthei kahinboh uve” tin seihihbeh'u hen.
English: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in phatthei na boh hen, Yahweh Pakai min in nang ma phatthei ka boh uve, chule nang man na lam jot na chun hichi mi ho chun phatthei na chu sutang jou pou vin te.
en: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”
text:
PSA 129:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in phatthei na boh hen, Yahweh Pakai min in nang ma phatthei ka boh uve, chule nang man na lam jot na chun hichi mi ho chun phatthei na chu sutang jou pou vin te.
English: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai lunglhahna kotong sunga kon in nangma panpina kahinthum e.
en: Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.
text:
PSA 130:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai lunglhahna kotong sunga kon in nangma panpina kahinthum e.
English: Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kakanahi ngai in, kataona hi neingaipeh'in.
en: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
text:
PSA 130:2
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai kakanahi ngai in, kataona hi neingaipeh'in.
English: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kachonset nauhi hoitah'a namelchih ding hileh, koiham O Yahweh Pakai ahingdoh ding?
en: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
text:
PSA 130:3
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai kachonset nauhi hoitah'a namelchih ding hileh, koiham O Yahweh Pakai ahingdoh ding?
English: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

tcz: Ahinla Nangin nangma ginje kahetthem theina diuvin ngaidamna neipejiuvin ahi.
en: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
text:
PSA 130:4
Thadou: Ahinla Nangin nangma ginje kahetthem theina diuvin ngaidamna neipejiuvin ahi.
English: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh ka Pakai nangma panpina kinem tah'in kangah'e. Henge, keima nangma a ki ngaijing kahi. Keiman athusei katahsan'in hichea kinem a ngahjing kahi.
en: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
text:
PSA 130:5
Thadou: Keiman Yahweh ka Pakai nangma panpina kinem tah'in kangah'e. Henge, keima nangma a ki ngaijing kahi. Keiman athusei katahsan'in hichea kinem a ngahjing kahi.
English: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu ka ngahlel ngei e, kho ngahpan khovah ding angalel sangin kangahlel joi.
en: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
text:
PSA 130:6
Thadou: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu ka ngahlel ngei e, kho ngahpan khovah ding angalel sangin kangahlel joi.
English: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

tcz: Vo Israel, Yahweh Pakaija kinem in, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai ahin longlou ngailutna umma ahin chuleh ama a hin lhatdamna lhingset in aum in ahi.
en: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.
text:
PSA 130:7
Thadou: Vo Israel, Yahweh Pakaija kinem in, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai ahin longlou ngailutna umma ahin chuleh ama a hin lhatdamna lhingset in aum in ahi.
English: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.

tcz: Amatah'in Israel chu achonsetna jouse a konna ahuhdoh ding ahi.
en: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
text:
PSA 130:8
Thadou: Amatah'in Israel chu achonsetna jouse a konna ahuhdoh ding ahi.
English: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, kalungthim akiletsah poi; kamit ha dan jong kihi sahna aumpoi. Keima hi thil thupitah in jong kakigel pon keimat phah din jong aloupi behseh e.
en: LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
text:
PSA 131:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai, kalungthim akiletsah poi; kamit ha dan jong kihi sahna aumpoi. Keima hi thil thupitah in jong kakigel pon keimat phah din jong aloupi behseh e.
English: LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.

tcz: Hiche sang chun keima kahina kalung lhaipen lung ol heuvin kaum in ahi. Naosen anu noitwi ngaicha talou bang in lung ollin kaum in, naosen lungmonga aum bangin keijong kalhagao lungmong in aum e.
en: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
text:
PSA 131:2
Thadou: Hiche sang chun keima kahina kalung lhaipen lung ol heuvin kaum in ahi. Naosen anu noitwi ngaicha talou bang in lung ollin kaum in, naosen lungmonga aum bangin keijong kalhagao lungmong in aum e.
English: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

tcz: O Israel tule tonsotnin Yahweh Pakaijah lungmong'in ummin.
en: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.
text:
PSA 131:3
Thadou: O Israel tule tonsotnin Yahweh Pakaijah lungmong'in ummin.
English: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai David hi athohgim na jouse pum in hin geldoh'in.
en: LORD, remember David and all his affliction,
text:
PSA 132:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai David hi athohgim na jouse pum in hin geldoh'in.
English: LORD, remember David and all his affliction,

tcz: Aman Yahweh Pakai ah kitepna gimneitah'in anase in ahi. Aman Israel Pathen Elohim ah kitepna ananei in ahi.
en: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
text:
PSA 132:2
Thadou: Aman Yahweh Pakai ah kitepna gimneitah'in anase in ahi. Aman Israel Pathen Elohim ah kitepna ananei in ahi.
English: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

tcz: “Keima kain ah cheponge, keima kicholdo ponge,
en: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;

tcz: keiman kamit kicholdo sah ponge ahilou leh kamit imutsah ponge,
en: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
text:
PSA 132:4
Thadou: keiman kamit kicholdo sah ponge ahilou leh kamit imutsah ponge,
English: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,

tcz: Keiman ka Yahweh Pakai dinga inkhat sahna ding mun kamu kahsen, Israel Pathen Elohim a dingin muntheng kamu kahsen!”
en: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
text:
PSA 132:5
Thadou: Keiman ka Yahweh Pakai dinga inkhat sahna ding mun kamu kahsen, Israel Pathen Elohim a dingin muntheng kamu kahsen!”
English: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

tcz: Vetan hiche thing kong dinghi Ephrathah a aume ti kajaovin Jaar loujao dunga hiche mun hi kana mudoh tauve.
en: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.
text:
PSA 132:6
Thadou: Vetan hiche thing kong dinghi Ephrathah a aume ti kajaovin Jaar loujao dunga hiche mun hi kana mudoh tauve.
English: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chenna mun a cheu hitin akengphang bul ah chibai boh'u hite.
en: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”
text:
PSA 132:7
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chenna mun a cheu hitin akengphang bul ah chibai boh'u hite.
English: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai thouvin nacholdona mun a chun luttan nathahat melchihna thingkong chutoh lutthatan.
en: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
text:
PSA 132:8
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai thouvin nacholdona mun a chun luttan nathahat melchihna thingkong chutoh lutthatan.
English: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.

tcz: Nathempuhon chonphatna ponsil chu kisil uhen; nalhacha dihtah hon kipa la sauhen.
en: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!
text:
PSA 132:9
Thadou: Nathempuhon chonphatna ponsil chu kisil uhen; nalhacha dihtah hon kipa la sauhen.
English: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!

tcz: Nalhacha David khohsahna jal in, nathao nusa lengpa chu paidoh hih'in.
en: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
text:
PSA 132:10
Thadou: Nalhacha David khohsahna jal in, nathao nusa lengpa chu paidoh hih'in.
English: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu David kom ah akihahsel in, kitepna nunglah doh kit louhel dingin: “Keiman nachilhah khat nalaltouna a katousah ding ahi.
en: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
text:
PSA 132:11
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu David kom ah akihahsel in, kitepna nunglah doh kit louhel dingin: “Keiman nachilhah khat nalaltouna a katousah ding ahi.
English: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.

tcz: Nachilhah ten nangtoh kakitepna leh ka Dan sem holeh kathuhil hohi anit uva ahileh nalal touna hi chejom peh ding ahi,” ati.
en: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”
text:
PSA 132:12
Thadou: Nachilhah ten nangtoh kakitepna leh ka Dan sem holeh kathuhil hohi anit uva ahileh nalal touna hi chejom peh ding ahi,” ati.
English: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in Jerusalem hi a inn chenna mun dinga adeilhen ahi.
en: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
text:
PSA 132:13
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in Jerusalem hi a inn chenna mun dinga adeilhen ahi.
English: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.

tcz: “Hichehi tonsot a kacholngah na munding ahi” anati. Keima hiche mun a hi kachending ahi, ajeh chu hiche hi kadeilhen inn chu ahi,
en: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.
text:
PSA 132:14
Thadou: “Hichehi tonsot a kacholngah na munding ahi” anati. Keima hiche mun a hi kachending ahi, ajeh chu hiche hi kadeilhen inn chu ahi,
English: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.

tcz: Keiman hiche khopi hi phatthei kaboh ding chuleh ijakai kasuhmang pehding ahi, keiman asunga um vaichate an kapehding,
en: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
text:
PSA 132:15
Thadou: Keiman hiche khopi hi phatthei kaboh ding chuleh ijakai kasuhmang pehding ahi, keiman asunga um vaichate an kapehding,
English: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.

tcz: athemputeu chonphatna pon kasilpeh ding, asoh dihtah hon kipa la asahdiu ahi,
en: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
text:
PSA 132:16
Thadou: athemputeu chonphatna pon kasilpeh ding, asoh dihtah hon kipa la asahdiu ahi,
English: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

tcz: Hiche mun a hi David thaneina khantousah ding, hiche kathaonupa hi kamite dinga thaomeivah hiding,
en: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
text:
PSA 132:17
Thadou: Hiche mun a hi David thaneina khantousah ding, hiche kathaonupa hi kamite dinga thaomeivah hiding,
English: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

tcz: chuleh agalmite chu jumna le jachatna pon kasilpeh ding amavang leng loupitah kasosah ding ahi.
en: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
text:
PSA 132:18
Thadou: chuleh agalmite chu jumna le jachatna pon kasilpeh ding amavang leng loupitah kasosah ding ahi.
English: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”

tcz: Veuvin, insungkhat hi kilungkhat tah'a achenkhom teng iti phat'a pha lunglhai um a hitam?
en: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
text:
PSA 133:1
Thadou: Veuvin, insungkhat hi kilungkhat tah'a achenkhom teng iti phat'a pha lunglhai um a hitam?
English: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

tcz: Hichehi Aaron chunga thao mantam kisungah aluchanga kon a akhamul lah'a longlha a avon mong chan a longlha suhpeh tobang ahi.
en: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
text:
PSA 133:2
Thadou: Hichehi Aaron chunga thao mantam kisungah aluchanga kon a akhamul lah'a longlha a avon mong chan a longlha suhpeh tobang ahi.
English: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

tcz: Kitohdel a Hermon mol chunga kon a longlha daitwi theng tobang a Zion mol a hung longlha chu ahi. Hichea kon a chu Yahweh Pakai in malsomna chu ahin phondoh'a hichu tonsot hinkhoa ding ahitai.
en: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.
text:
PSA 133:3
Thadou: Kitohdel a Hermon mol chunga kon a longlha daitwi theng tobang a Zion mol a hung longlha chu ahi. Hichea kon a chu Yahweh Pakai in malsomna chu ahin phondoh'a hichu tonsot hinkhoa ding ahitai.
English: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.

tcz: Oh Yahweh Pakai sohte jousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un, nangho Yahweh Pakai inn a jankhovah'a asohkin na tongten.
en: Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!
text:
PSA 134:1
Thadou: Oh Yahweh Pakai sohte jousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un, nangho Yahweh Pakai inn a jankhovah'a asohkin na tongten.
English: Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!

tcz: Nakhut theng'u chu taona in domsang uvin lang Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un.
en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 134:2
Thadou: Nakhut theng'u chu taona in domsang uvin lang Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un.
English: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!

tcz: Van le leiset sempa Elohim Pathen chun, Jerusalem a kon in phatthei naboh tao hen.
en: May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
text:
PSA 134:3
Thadou: Van le leiset sempa Elohim Pathen chun, Jerusalem a kon in phatthei naboh tao hen.
English: May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un! Yahweh Pakai min chu thangvah un! Yahweh Pakai lhacha ten Ama chu thang vah un,
en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,
text:
PSA 135:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah un! Yahweh Pakai min chu thangvah un! Yahweh Pakai lhacha ten Ama chu thang vah un,
English: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,

tcz: Nangho Yahweh Pakai lhacha na tong, Elohim Pathen, houin sung a natong ten.
en: you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
text:
PSA 135:2
Thadou: Nangho Yahweh Pakai lhacha na tong, Elohim Pathen, houin sung a natong ten.
English: you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu aphatna jeh'in thangvah'un; amin ngaitah chu vahchoilan domsangun.
en: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
text:
PSA 135:3
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu aphatna jeh'in thangvah'un; amin ngaitah chu vahchoilan domsangun.
English: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in Jacob chu Ama a dingmong monga alhen ahin, Israel chu atumbeh'a amagou dinga agon ahi.
en: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
text:
PSA 135:4
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in Jacob chu Ama a dingmong monga alhen ahin, Israel chu atumbeh'a amagou dinga agon ahi.
English: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai aletna leh aloupina chu kahen, iPakai u Yahweh hi pathen dang sanga lenjo le loupijo ahi.
en: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
text:
PSA 135:5
Thadou: Keiman Yahweh Pakai aletna leh aloupina chu kahen, iPakai u Yahweh hi pathen dang sanga lenjo le loupijo ahi.
English: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in van le leiset chunga hin, twikanglen thuh sunga hin Aman along lhaina a adeidei abol ahi.
en: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.
text:
PSA 135:6
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in van le leiset chunga hin, twikanglen thuh sunga hin Aman along lhaina a adeidei abol ahi.
English: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

tcz: Aman meiho jonghi leiset chunga kon a alentousah ahin, Aman gojuh pet in koljong aphetsah'in, huijong hi athilkholna a kon in ahin lhadohjin ahi.
en: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.
text:
PSA 135:7
Thadou: Aman meiho jonghi leiset chunga kon a alentousah ahin, Aman gojuh pet in koljong aphetsah'in, huijong hi athilkholna a kon in ahin lhadohjin ahi.
English: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

tcz: Aman Egypt te insunga chun ainson in mihemle ganhing jong apeng masa jouse ana sugam in ahi.
en: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.
text:
PSA 135:8
Thadou: Aman Egypt te insunga chun ainson in mihemle ganhing jong apeng masa jouse ana sugam in ahi.
English: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.

tcz: Aman Egypt a chun Pharoah le amipi jouse douna in datmo umtah thil kidangho ana tongdoh'in ahi.
en: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
text:
PSA 135:9
Thadou: Aman Egypt a chun Pharoah le amipi jouse douna in datmo umtah thil kidangho ana tongdoh'in ahi.
English: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

tcz: Aman namlentah tah ho anavolhun leng thupi tahtah hojong ana satchap e.
en: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—
text:
PSA 135:10
Thadou: Aman namlentah tah ho anavolhun leng thupi tahtah hojong ana satchap e.
English: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—

tcz: Amor lengpa Sihon, Bashan lengpa Og chuleh Caanan lengho jouse anathat gam in ahi.
en: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—
text:
PSA 135:11
Thadou: Amor lengpa Sihon, Bashan lengpa Og chuleh Caanan lengho jouse anathat gam in ahi.
English: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—

tcz: Aman agam u chu Ama goulo Israelte gamtum dingin anapen ahi.
en: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
text:
PSA 135:12
Thadou: Aman agam u chu Ama goulo Israelte gamtum dingin anapen ahi.
English: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai namin hi tonsot a umjing ding ahi.
en: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.
text:
PSA 135:13
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai namin hi tonsot a umjing ding ahi.
English: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in amite chunga thutah'a vaihom ding asohte chunga khotona aneiding ahi.
en: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
text:
PSA 135:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in amite chunga thutah'a vaihom ding asohte chunga khotona aneiding ahi.
English: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

tcz: Chitin namtinte doilim hohi sana le dangka maimai mihem in asemthubou ahi.
en: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
text:
PSA 135:15
Thadou: Chitin namtinte doilim hohi sana le dangka maimai mihem in asemthubou ahi.
English: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

tcz: Amahon kam anei un ima aseithei pouvin, mit anei un ima amuthei pouvin,
en: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.
text:
PSA 135:16
Thadou: Amahon kam anei un ima aseithei pouvin, mit anei un ima amuthei pouvin,
English: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.

tcz: kol anei un ima ajathei pouvin nahkui anei un ima anahthei pouvin ahi.
en: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.
text:
PSA 135:17
Thadou: kol anei un ima ajathei pouvin nahkui anei un ima anahthei pouvin ahi.
English: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.

tcz: Doilim semthu ho jouse le hiche tahsanho jouse chu hitobang ngen ahiuve.
en: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.
text:
PSA 135:18
Thadou: Doilim semthu ho jouse le hiche tahsanho jouse chu hitobang ngen ahiuve.
English: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.

tcz: Vo Israel Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! O thempu Aaron chilhahho, Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un,
en: House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 135:19
Thadou: Vo Israel Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! O thempu Aaron chilhahho, Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un,
English: House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!

tcz: O Levite Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Nangho Yahweh Pakai ginna neijouse Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un!
en: House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 135:20
Thadou: O Levite Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Nangho Yahweh Pakai ginna neijouse Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un!
English: House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!

tcz: Zion'a kon in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un ajeh chu Ama Jerusalema hin achengin ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un!
en: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 135:21
Thadou: Zion'a kon in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un ajeh chu Ama Jerusalema hin achengin ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un!
English: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu aphat na ho jouse jeh in thangvah'un! Ajeh chu ami ngailut na dihtah hi tonsot gei a longlou ahi
en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
text:
PSA 136:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu aphat na ho jouse jeh in thangvah'un! Ajeh chu ami ngailut na dihtah hi tonsot gei a longlou ahi
English: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

tcz: Semthu pathen ho, Elohim Pathen chu thangvahna peuvin. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot gei a longlou ahi.
en: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.
text:
PSA 136:2
Thadou: Semthu pathen ho, Elohim Pathen chu thangvahna peuvin. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot gei a longlou ahi.
English: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.

tcz: Pakai ho Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah na peuvin. Ajeh chu Ami ngailut na dihtah chu tonsot geija longlou ahi.
en: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Ama bou hin thil loupi ki dangtah chu abolji ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot gei a longlou ahi.
en: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Thepna giltah'a vanho hinsemdoh'a Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah na peuvin. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot geija longlou ahi.
en: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Twilah'a leiset umsah pa chu thangvahna peuvin. Ami ngailut na dihtah chu tonsot gei a longlou ahi.
en: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Van a kon a vah semdohpa chu thangvah'un. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsotna longlou ahi.
en: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Nisan sun a vai ahom in ahi, Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Chuleh lha leh ahsi hon jan ah vai ahom un ahi.
en: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Egypt gam a apeng masapen ho anathagam jeh'in Amachu thangvahna peuvin. Ama mi ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot na longlou ahi.
en: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Aman Egypt ma kon in Israel ana puidoh'e, Ami ngailutna chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Aman akhut thahatna leh aban thaneina pum in na atongin ahi. Amingailutna dihtah chu tonsotna longlou ahi.
en: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Twikhanglen san sukhen a chu Ama ahi, thangvah na peuvin. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsotna longlou ahi.
en: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Aman Israel chu anapui galkai e, Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsotna longlou ahi.
en: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Aman Pharaoh leh asepaite twikhanglen sanlah'a analehlut in ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Gamthip noi a amite apuigalkai jeh'in thangvah na peuvin, Am ingailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Leng thupitah tahho anajeplhuh jeh'in thangvahna peuvin, Amingailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Aman leng thahat tah tah ho anathat gam in ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Sihon Amor lengpa; Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Og Bashaan lengpa, Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Elohim Pathen in hiche lengho gamchu agoulo din amite anapen ahi. Ami ngailut na chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Asohte Israelten gam tumbeh'a alodiuva anapeh ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Aman ihatmo nauvah eihin geldohjiu vin ahi. Amibngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Aman igalmihou va kon in eihuhdoh jiuvin ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;

tcz: Aman hinkho neiho jouse dingin aneh achahdiu apejingin ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.
text:
PSA 136:25
Thadou: Aman hinkho neiho jouse dingin aneh achahdiu apejingin ahi. Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
English: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.

tcz: Van Elohim Pathen chu thangvahna peuvin, Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
en: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.
text:
PSA 136:26
Thadou: Van Elohim Pathen chu thangvahna peuvin, Ami ngailutna dihtah chu tonsot a longlou ahi.
English: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.

tcz: Jerusalem kageldoh phatnun Babylon vadungpang a chun katou un kakapgam tauve.
en: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
text:
PSA 137:1
Thadou: Jerusalem kageldoh phatnun Babylon vadungpang a chun katou un kakapgam tauve.
English: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

tcz: Keihon kasemjang houchu mong thingbah chung dunga chun kakhai un ahi.
en: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.
text:
PSA 137:2
Thadou: Keihon kasemjang houchu mong thingbah chung dunga chun kakhai un ahi.
English: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.

tcz: Hikom a chun soh a eihente houchun la sah sahding eigouvin, chuleh eisugenthei houchun kipahtah'a la sahsahtei ding eigouvin, “Jerusalem la ho chu khatpen beh neisahpeh'un” atiuve.
en: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
text:
PSA 137:3
Thadou: Hikom a chun soh a eihente houchun la sah sahding eigouvin, chuleh eisugenthei houchun kipahtah'a la sahsahtei ding eigouvin, “Jerusalem la ho chu khatpen beh neisahpeh'un” atiuve.
English: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

tcz: Ahinlah keihon hetkhahlou mi gam sunga hi Yahweh Pakai la hochu iti kasahdiuham?
en: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?
text:
PSA 137:4
Thadou: Ahinlah keihon hetkhahlou mi gam sunga hi Yahweh Pakai la hochu iti kasahdiuham?
English: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?

tcz: Vo Jerusalem nangma kasuhmil uleh kakhut jetlam hin semjang pehdan sumil jenghen.
en: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
text:
PSA 137:5
Thadou: Vo Jerusalem nangma kasuhmil uleh kakhut jetlam hin semjang pehdan sumil jenghen.
English: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

tcz: Nangma kageldoh louva, Jerusalem chu kakipana sangpen sang a thupi a kagel lou le, ka leihi kadang chungah behden jenghen.
en: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
text:
PSA 137:6
Thadou: Nangma kageldoh louva, Jerusalem chu kakipana sangpen sang a thupi a kagel lou le, ka leihi kadang chungah behden jenghen.
English: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai Babylon sepaiten Jerusalem alonkhum niuva Edom mite thilbol chu geldoh tei in, “Sumang jengin,” “Toltoh sumat jengun” tin asam un ahi.
en: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”
text:
PSA 137:7
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai Babylon sepaiten Jerusalem alonkhum niuva Edom mite thilbol chu geldoh tei in, “Sumang jengin,” “Toltoh sumat jengun” tin asam un ahi.
English: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”

tcz: O Babylon, nangma nakisu mang ding ahi. Nangin neibol nao bang banga nalethuh penpen chu anunnom ahi.
en: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
text:
PSA 137:8
Thadou: O Babylon, nangma nakisu mang ding ahi. Nangin neibol nao bang banga nalethuh penpen chu anunnom ahi.
English: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

tcz: Nachapangteu puimang a songpi chunga sepgoiho chu nunnom hen!
en: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
text:
PSA 137:9
Thadou: Nachapangteu puimang a songpi chunga sepgoiho chu nunnom hen!
English: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.

tcz: Ka Pathen Elohim kalungthim pumpin nangma thangvah ingkate, pathen dangho masanga nang vahchoinan la sange.
en: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
text:
PSA 138:1
Thadou: Ka Pathen Elohim kalungthim pumpin nangma thangvah ingkate, pathen dangho masanga nang vahchoinan la sange.
English: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

tcz: Nahou inn theng lang nga'ing ting nami ngailutna tanglou jehleh nakitahna jeh'in namin vahchoi ing kate, ajeh chu nakitepna hi namin loupinan asuhdet ahi.
en: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
text:
PSA 138:2
Thadou: Nahou inn theng lang nga'ing ting nami ngailutna tanglou jehleh nakitahna jeh'in namin vahchoi ing kate, ajeh chu nakitepna hi namin loupinan asuhdet ahi.
English: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

tcz: Kataopet petleh nangin neidonbut in nangin thahatna neipen neitilkhou vin ahi.
en: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
text:
PSA 138:3
Thadou: Kataopet petleh nangin neidonbut in nangin thahatna neipen neitilkhou vin ahi.
English: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

tcz: Leiset chunga leng jousen nangma nathangvah diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon nathupeh ajauvin ahi.
en: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
text:
PSA 138:4
Thadou: Leiset chunga leng jousen nangma nathangvah diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon nathupeh ajauvin ahi.
English: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

tcz: Amahon nathilbolho jehleh naloupi behseh jeh'a nangma thangvah la asahdiu ahi.
en: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!
text:
PSA 138:5
Thadou: Amahon nathilbolho jehleh naloupi behseh jeh'a nangma thangvah la asahdiu ahi.
English: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!

tcz: Vo Yahweh Pakai nangma nalet lheh jeng vangin milham jong nakhohsah thouvin, ahinlah mikiletsah hoa kon in vang nakikhin gamlhan ahi.
en: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
text:
PSA 138:6
Thadou: Vo Yahweh Pakai nangma nalet lheh jeng vangin milham jong nakhohsah thouvin, ahinlah mikiletsah hoa kon in vang nakikhin gamlhan ahi.
English: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

tcz: Keima lungkhamnan eiumkimvel jeng jongleh nangin kagalmite khutna konna neihoidoh ding ahinai. Nangin nakhut hinlhangdoh'in natin nabanjetlang thahatna a neihuhdoh ding ahi.
en: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
text:
PSA 138:7
Thadou: Keima lungkhamnan eiumkimvel jeng jongleh nangin kagalmite khutna konna neihoidoh ding ahinai. Nangin nakhut hinlhangdoh'in natin nabanjetlang thahatna a neihuhdoh ding ahi.
English: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in keima hinkhoa athilgon achelhahsah ding ahi, ajeh chu O Yahweh Pakai na mi ngailutna dihtah chu atonsotna longlou ahi. Kachunga na natoh nahinpat hi subulhit tan.
en: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
text:
PSA 138:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in keima hinkhoa athilgon achelhahsah ding ahi, ajeh chu O Yahweh Pakai na mi ngailutna dihtah chu atonsotna longlou ahi. Kachunga na natoh nahinpat hi subulhit tan.
English: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangin kalungthim nakholchil in neihechen sohkeitan ahi.
en: LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.
text:
PSA 139:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangin kalungthim nakholchil in neihechen sohkeitan ahi.
English: LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.

tcz: Nangin katouthimpet hihen, kadindoh pet hijongle nahei. Gamlhatah a kaum jeng vangin nangin kalung gel ngaito jouse nahei.
en: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
text:
PSA 139:2
Thadou: Nangin katouthimpet hihen, kadindoh pet hijongle nahei. Gamlhatah a kaum jeng vangin nangin kalung gel ngaito jouse nahei.
English: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

tcz: Kakholjinpet hihen, inna katouthimpet hijongleh nangin neimun ahi, chuleh kabol jouse nahesoh kei e.
en: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
text:
PSA 139:3
Thadou: Kakholjinpet hihen, inna katouthimpet hijongleh nangin neimun ahi, chuleh kabol jouse nahesoh kei e.
English: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai kathusei got jonghi kasei masangin nahejitai.
en: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.
text:
PSA 139:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai kathusei got jonghi kasei masangin nahejitai.
English: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.

tcz: Kamasanga nachen, kanunga jong neijuijin ahi, naphatthei bohna khutchu kaluchungah nangam'in ahi.
en: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
text:
PSA 139:5
Thadou: Kamasanga nachen, kanunga jong neijuijin ahi, naphatthei bohna khutchu kaluchungah nangam'in ahi.
English: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

tcz: Hitobang hetna hi keidingin aki dang val in, chuleh hitobang hetchet dinghi keidingin ahahsaval e.
en: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
text:
PSA 139:6
Thadou: Hitobang hetna hi keidingin aki dang val in, chuleh hitobang hetchet dinghi keidingin ahahsaval e.
English: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

tcz: Nalhagaova kon a iti kajam mang thei dingham? Nanga kon a keima iti kajam mang theiding ham?
en: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
text:
PSA 139:7
Thadou: Nalhagaova kon a iti kajam mang thei dingham? Nanga kon a keima iti kajam mang theiding ham?
English: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

tcz: Keima van a kaltou jongleng nangma naum in, mithigam ah lutjong leng nangma naum e.
en: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
text:
PSA 139:8
Thadou: Keima van a kaltou jongleng nangma naum in, mithigam ah lutjong leng nangma naum e.
English: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

tcz: Keima jingkah lhaving in lengdoh ingting twikhanglen gallang peh'a gacheng jong leng,
en: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
text:
PSA 139:9
Thadou: Keima jingkah lhaving in lengdoh ingting twikhanglen gallang peh'a gacheng jong leng,
English: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

tcz: hichemun jenga jong chun nakhut in neikai hoi in natin, nathahat na in nei vengbit in nate.
en: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
text:
PSA 139:10
Thadou: hichemun jenga jong chun nakhut in neikai hoi in natin, nathahat na in nei vengbit in nate.
English: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

tcz: Keiman muthim jah'a neisel in tijongleng chuleh kavel a vahjeng jong muthim sosah jongleng,
en: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
text:
PSA 139:11
Thadou: Keiman muthim jah'a neisel in tijongleng chuleh kavel a vahjeng jong muthim sosah jongleng,
English: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”

tcz: muthimlah'a kisel jing jongleng nanga kon a kakisel mangthei louding ahi. Ajeh chu nang dingin ajing jongchu sun banga vahding ahi. Muthimleh vah jong nangdingin thakhat ahibouve.
en: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
text:
PSA 139:12
Thadou: muthimlah'a kisel jing jongleng nanga kon a kakisel mangthei louding ahi. Ajeh chu nang dingin ajing jongchu sun banga vahding ahi. Muthimleh vah jong nangdingin thakhat ahibouve.
English: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

tcz: Nangin ka oisung a thil umjuse jong najopmat mat a kanu naobu sunga neigontoh ahi.
en: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
text:
PSA 139:13
Thadou: Nangin ka oisung a thil umjuse jong najopmat mat a kanu naobu sunga neigontoh ahi.
English: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

tcz: Hitobanga thil kidangtah'a neina gontoh jeh'in kathangvah'e! Na natoh nathil bol danhi datmo umtah ahi ti kalung thim apumpin kahe them e.
en: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
text:
PSA 139:14
Thadou: Hitobanga thil kidangtah'a neina gontoh jeh'in kathangvah'e! Na natoh nathil bol danhi datmo umtah ahi ti kalung thim apumpin kahe them e.
English: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

tcz: Keima jatchombeh'a kanu naobu muthimlah'a eina kigontoh jeng jongchun nangman neinavesui jingin ahi.
en: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
text:
PSA 139:15
Thadou: Keima jatchombeh'a kanu naobu muthimlah'a eina kigontoh jeng jongchun nangman neinavesui jingin ahi.
English: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

tcz: Kapen lhah masang a nang man nei namusa ahitai, nitin ka hinkhoa ka ki manchah na ding dan, phatche dungjui a ana kigongtoh chu nikhatcha jengjong achelhah masanga nalekhabua ana kigoltohsa ahitai.
en: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
text:
PSA 139:16
Thadou: Kapen lhah masang a nang man nei namusa ahitai, nitin ka hinkhoa ka ki manchah na ding dan, phatche dungjui a ana kigongtoh chu nikhatcha jengjong achelhah masanga nalekhabua ana kigoltohsa ahitai.
English: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai kachung changa nalung gel nathilgon tohsaho chu iti mantama hitam simjou jai ahipoi!
en: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
text:
PSA 139:17
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai kachung changa nalung gel nathilgon tohsaho chu iti mantama hitam simjou jai ahipoi!
English: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

tcz: Asim jengjong keijo chi ahipoi, neldi halsiho sang in jong atamjoi. Kahung khahdoh gei injong nangin neina umpi jing nalai e!
en: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
text:
PSA 139:18
Thadou: Asim jengjong keijo chi ahipoi, neldi halsiho sang in jong atamjoi. Kahung khahdoh gei injong nangin neina umpi jing nalai e!
English: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

tcz: O ka Pathen Elohim miphalouho hi nasuhmang hitavele ong! Tolthat ho kahinkhoa kon in potdoh'un.
en: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
text:
PSA 139:19
Thadou: O ka Pathen Elohim miphalouho hi nasuhmang hitavele ong! Tolthat ho kahinkhoa kon in potdoh'un.
English: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

tcz: Amahohin na suminseu ve, nagalmi hohin namin hi asamseu ve.
en: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.
text:
PSA 139:20
Thadou: Amahohin na suminseu ve, nagalmi hohin namin hi asamseu ve.
English: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai nangma nahotbolte hohi keiman jong kahot louding ham? Nangma nadouho hi kenjong kathet louding ham?
en: LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
text:
PSA 139:21
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai nangma nahotbolte hohi keiman jong kahot louding ham? Nangma nadouho hi kenjong kathet louding ham?
English: LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

tcz: Ahinai, nangman nathetho hi keiman pumthetna kathet ding ahi, ajeh chu nangma galmi ho chu keima galmi ho ahiuve.
en: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
text:
PSA 139:22
Thadou: Ahinai, nangman nathetho hi keiman pumthetna kathet ding ahi, ajeh chu nangma galmi ho chu keima galmi ho ahiuve.
English: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai neikhol chil in kalung neihet peh in; neipatep inlang kahina hi kilang doh sah in.
en: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
text:
PSA 139:23
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai neikhol chil in kalung neihet peh in; neipatep inlang kahina hi kilang doh sah in.
English: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

tcz: Kasunga hi nangma douva thilse umnalai am nei nodoh peh inlang tonsot lampi a neipui tan.
en: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
text:
PSA 139:24
Thadou: Kasunga hi nangma douva thilse umnalai am nei nodoh peh inlang tonsot lampi a neipui tan.
English: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, miphalou hoa kon'in neihuhdoh in, pumhat-a natong hoa kon'in neihoidohsah'in,
en: Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:
text:
PSA 140:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, miphalou hoa kon'in neihuhdoh in, pumhat-a natong hoa kon'in neihoidohsah'in,
English: Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:

tcz: ajeh chu alung sung'uva thilse jeng agong un, beitih um louvin gal abol jiuvin ahi.
en: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
text:
PSA 140:2
Thadou: ajeh chu alung sung'uva thilse jeng agong un, beitih um louvin gal abol jiuvin ahi.
English: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

tcz: Alei gui-u gul in mi achuh bang in amang chauvin, athuseidoh jouseu jong gul-gu tobang ahi.
en: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.
text:
PSA 140:3
Thadou: Alei gui-u gul in mi achuh bang in amang chauvin, athuseidoh jouseu jong gul-gu tobang ahi.
English: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, miphalou ho khutna kon hin neihoidoh in, pumhatna natong hoa kon'in neihuhdoh in; ajeh chu kakipal lhuhna din thisle jeng agong un ahi.
en: LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
text:
PSA 140:4
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, miphalou ho khutna kon hin neihoidoh in, pumhatna natong hoa kon'in neihuhdoh in; ajeh chu kakipal lhuhna din thisle jeng agong un ahi.
English: LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

tcz: Mi kiletsah hon kei matna din thang akam un, khao ajan-doh'un lampi dunga thang ei-kampeh'un ahi.
en: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.
text:
PSA 140:5
Thadou: Mi kiletsah hon kei matna din thang akam un, khao ajan-doh'un lampi dunga thang ei-kampeh'un ahi.
English: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai kom'a, “Nangma hi ka Pathen Elohim nahi!” O Yahweh Pakai, khotona dinga kataona nei sanpeh tan.
en: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.
text:
PSA 140:6
Thadou: Keiman Yahweh Pakai kom'a, “Nangma hi ka Pathen Elohim nahi!” O Yahweh Pakai, khotona dinga kataona nei sanpeh tan.
English: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung, athahat pan-a eihuhdoh pa; nangman gal kisat nikhoa nei huhdoh ahi.
en: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
text:
PSA 140:7
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung, athahat pan-a eihuhdoh pa; nangman gal kisat nikhoa nei huhdoh ahi.
English: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai, migilouho adei bang'in chesah hih'in, athilse gonhou chu lolhin sahhih'in; achuti louva ahileh kiletsahna dim diu ahi.
en: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
text:
PSA 140:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai, migilouho adei bang'in chesah hih'in, athilse gonhou chu lolhin sahhih'in; achuti louva ahileh kiletsahna dim diu ahi.
English: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

tcz: Kagal miten kachunga thil phalou tohgon anei jal un, manthah nan lhung u-hen.
en: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
text:
PSA 140:9
Thadou: Kagal miten kachunga thil phalou tohgon anei jal un, manthah nan lhung u-hen.
English: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

tcz: Meiam kong chu alu chunguvah chuhsah'in, meilah'a seplut in; ahilouleh ajamdoh louna diu twiveina kotong'ah lhalut jeng u-hen.
en: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
text:
PSA 140:10
Thadou: Meiam kong chu alu chunguvah chuhsah'in, meilah'a seplut in; ahilouleh ajamdoh louna diu twiveina kotong'ah lhalut jeng u-hen.
English: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

tcz: Ka gamsung uva hin ajou jouva mihehse ho khantousah hihbeh'in, pumhat'a natong ho achunguva thilse chuhsah'in lang sumang in.
en: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
text:
PSA 140:11
Thadou: Ka gamsung uva hin ajou jouva mihehse ho khantousah hihbeh'in, pumhat'a natong ho achunguva thilse chuhsah'in lang sumang in.
English: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

tcz: Hinlah suhgentheija umte Yahweh Pakai in asumil poi, ti kahen; Aman vaichate thu adih'a atanpeh ding ahi, ti kahei.
en: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
text:
PSA 140:12
Thadou: Hinlah suhgentheija umte Yahweh Pakai in asumil poi, ti kahen; Aman vaichate thu adih'a atanpeh ding ahi, ti kahei.
English: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

tcz: Tahbeh'in mi kitah hon namin athangvah diu, chule michonpha ho na kom'a cheng diu ahi.
en: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
text:
PSA 140:13
Thadou: Tahbeh'in mi kitah hon namin athangvah diu, chule michonpha ho na kom'a cheng diu ahi.
English: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, nangma kakouve, Panpi ngehna katao hi nei ngaipeh loijin!
en: LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
text:
PSA 141:1
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, nangma kakouve, Panpi ngehna katao hi nei ngaipeh loijin!
English: LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

tcz: Kataona hi nahenga gimnamtwi kilhut bang'in chule kakhut teni kadopsang hi nilhah lang kilhaina gantha bang'in neisanpeh tan.
en: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
text:
PSA 141:2
Thadou: Kataona hi nahenga gimnamtwi kilhut bang'in chule kakhut teni kadopsang hi nilhah lang kilhaina gantha bang'in neisanpeh tan.
English: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, kakam'a hin kamdal neikoipeh'in. Kakam sung nei vetpeh jing in.
en: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
text:
PSA 141:3
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, kakam'a hin kamdal neikoipeh'in. Kakam sung nei vetpeh jing in.
English: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

tcz: Thilse bolna din kalungthim aselam-a kon'in neihoidah sah in, thil dihlou bolna'a neipansah hih'in. Thildihlou bol hon aphat chompiu thangset umtah thil hoa chan nei neisah hih'in.
en: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.
text:
PSA 141:4
Thadou: Thilse bolna din kalungthim aselam-a kon'in neihoidah sah in, thil dihlou bolna'a neipansah hih'in. Thildihlou bol hon aphat chompiu thangset umtah thil hoa chan nei neisah hih'in.
English: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.

tcz: Miphan eiphoh hen hichu ngailutna joh ahi! Amahon eisuhdihna chu damna ahipoi, Miphalou hon thilse abol dounan katao jinge.
en: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
text:
PSA 141:5
Thadou: Miphan eiphoh hen hichu ngailutna joh ahi! Amahon eisuhdihna chu damna ahipoi, Miphalou hon thilse abol dounan katao jinge.
English: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

tcz: Alamkaiteu kol'a akisot lhah tengleh, miphalou hon kathusei angaidiu chuteng dih ahinsah diu ahi.
en: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
text:
PSA 141:6
Thadou: Alamkaiteu kol'a akisot lhah tengleh, miphalou hon kathusei angaidiu chuteng dih ahinsah diu ahi.
English: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

tcz: Songpi akikhet keh teng tol'a akitakeh bang in, miphalou ho gule chang ho jong vui louva kithe jal ding ahi.
en: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
text:
PSA 141:7
Thadou: Songpi akikhet keh teng tol'a akitakeh bang in, miphalou ho gule chang ho jong vui louva kithe jal ding ahi.
English: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung, panpi ngaijin na henga kataove. Nangma kakiselna kulpi nahi; amaho khut-a thina neitosah hih in.
en: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
text:
PSA 141:8
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai hatchungnung, panpi ngaijin na henga kataove. Nangma kakiselna kulpi nahi; amaho khut-a thina neitosah hih in.
English: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.

tcz: Kei ona dinga thang akam-uva kon in neihuhdoh in, thilpha lou jenga chon ho thangkol'a nei o-sah hih in.
en: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
text:
PSA 141:9
Thadou: Kei ona dinga thang akam-uva kon in neihuhdoh in, thilpha lou jenga chon ho thangkol'a nei o-sah hih in.
English: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

tcz: Miphalou ho chu amaho thang kam-a chun oh uhen, kijam chap tauhen; keivang nei hoidoh sah'in.
en: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.
text:
PSA 141:10
Thadou: Miphalou ho chu amaho thang kam-a chun oh uhen, kijam chap tauhen; keivang nei hoidoh sah'in.
English: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.

tcz: Keima Yahweh Pakai henga kataovin, Yahweh Pakai henga khotona kathum in ahi.
en: I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.
text:
PSA 142:1
Thadou: Keima Yahweh Pakai henga kataovin, Yahweh Pakai henga khotona kathum in ahi.
English: I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.

tcz: Keima Yahweh Pakai ang-sunga kakiphin in, kahahsatna jouse jong kaphongdoh'in.
en: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
text:
PSA 142:2
Thadou: Keima Yahweh Pakai ang-sunga kakiphin in, kahahsatna jouse jong kaphongdoh'in.
English: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

tcz: Kalhagao alam vai jitan, hinlah Yahweh Pakai nangbou nahi kachena ding lampi ei-hil ji. Kajotna lam'a chun ei-douten thang eikam peh jiuvin ahi.
en: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
text:
PSA 142:3
Thadou: Kalhagao alam vai jitan, hinlah Yahweh Pakai nangbou nahi kachena ding lampi ei-hil ji. Kajotna lam'a chun ei-douten thang eikam peh jiuvin ahi.
English: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

tcz: Keiman mikhat tou hunga eipanpi ding kangaichat lai jin, koiman amitsih jenga jong eive poi! Koimacha eikithopi ding aumpoi, kachunga thilsoh koiman imachan eigelpeh poi.
en: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
text:
PSA 142:4
Thadou: Keiman mikhat tou hunga eipanpi ding kangaichat lai jin, koiman amitsih jenga jong eive poi! Koimacha eikithopi ding aumpoi, kachunga thilsoh koiman imachan eigelpeh poi.
English: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, keima na henga kataovin, “Nangma hi kakiselna nahi, kahinkhoa kangaichat pen nang bou nahi,” kati.
en: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
text:
PSA 142:5
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, keima na henga kataovin, “Nangma hi kakiselna nahi, kahinkhoa kangaichat pen nang bou nahi,” kati.
English: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

tcz: Kataona hi nei ngaipeh teijin, ei-kisunem behseh jeng tai! Ei-bolgenthei hoa kon'in neihuhdoh tan, ajeh chu amaho keisang in ahatval jeng tauve.
en: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
text:
PSA 142:6
Thadou: Kataona hi nei ngaipeh teijin, ei-kisunem behseh jeng tai! Ei-bolgenthei hoa kon'in neihuhdoh tan, ajeh chu amaho keisang in ahatval jeng tauve.
English: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

tcz: Songkul'a kon'in neihuhdoh loijin, chutileh nangma kathangvah thei ding ahi. Lolhing tah'a neibol jeh'a kajet le kaveija mikitah dim lha diu ahi.
en: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
text:
PSA 142:7
Thadou: Songkul'a kon'in neihuhdoh loijin, chutileh nangma kathangvah thei ding ahi. Lolhing tah'a neibol jeh'a kajet le kaveija mikitah dim lha diu ahi.
English: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.

tcz: Vo Yahweh Pakai, kataona ngaijin. Kangeh hi nei ngaipeh teijin! Nangma kitahna le dihna bang in, neidonbut in.
en: Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
text:
PSA 143:1
