Thadou: Vo Yahweh Pakai, kataona ngaijin. Kangeh hi nei ngaipeh teijin! Nangma kitahna le dihna bang in, neidonbut in.
English: Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.

tcz: Nalhacha hi nei patep hih in chule kachung thu jong tan hihbeh in, ajeh chu koima na ang-sunga adih aumpoi.
en: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
text:
PSA 143:2
Thadou: Nalhacha hi nei patep hih in chule kachung thu jong tan hihbeh in, ajeh chu koima na ang-sunga adih aumpoi.
English: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

tcz: Ajeh chu kagal miten eihin del peh in, kahing chang in tolgoi nan ineijin, lhan khuh-a athisa umho bangin, kada kacham louvin muthim lah'a eiumsah tai.
en: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
text:
PSA 143:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu kagal miten eihin del peh in, kahing chang in tolgoi nan ineijin, lhan khuh-a athisa umho bangin, kada kacham louvin muthim lah'a eiumsah tai.
English: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

tcz: Hijeh chun keiman kinepna ding kanei tapon, kalung sung kichatnan adim e.
en: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
text:
PSA 143:4
Thadou: Hijeh chun keiman kinepna ding kanei tapon, kalung sung kichatnan adim e.
English: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

tcz: Keiman khanglui nikho chesa ho kageldoh'in, nakhut tenia natohdohsa thil thupi ho kagel jing in ahi.
en: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
text:
PSA 143:5
Thadou: Keiman khanglui nikho chesa ho kageldoh'in, nakhut tenia natohdohsa thil thupi ho kagel jing in ahi.
English: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

tcz: Kakhut tenin nahenglam kasang'in kataovin, Gamgo-in sadoh leuva twi angaichat bang in; keiman nangma kangaichan ahi.
en: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.
text:
PSA 143:6
Thadou: Kakhut tenin nahenglam kasang'in kataovin, Gamgo-in sadoh leuva twi angaichat bang in; keiman nangma kangaichan ahi.
English: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, nei donbut loijin, ajeh chu kahin kho bei pai ding ahitai. Keija kon'in kihei mang hih in, ijeh-inem itileh lhan khuh-a lhalut ho kabah ding ahi.
en: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.
text:
PSA 143:7
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, nei donbut loijin, ajeh chu kahin kho bei pai ding ahitai. Keija kon'in kihei mang hih in, ijeh-inem itileh lhan khuh-a lhalut ho kabah ding ahi.
English: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.

tcz: Jingkah sehleh nalungsetna longlou neijahsah in, ajeh chu keima kingaina nangbou nahi. Kalam lhahna jouse neihil them in, kahin kho hi nangma dia kaphal theng ahi.
en: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
text:
PSA 143:8
Thadou: Jingkah sehleh nalungsetna longlou neijahsah in, ajeh chu keima kingaina nangbou nahi. Kalam lhahna jouse neihil them in, kahin kho hi nangma dia kaphal theng ahi.
English: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, kagal mitea kon'in neihuhdoh in, nahenga kisel dinga hung jamlut kahi bouve.
en: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.
text:
PSA 143:9
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, kagal mitea kon'in neihuhdoh in, nahenga kisel dinga hung jamlut kahi bouve.
English: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

tcz: Ka Pathen Elohim nahi, nadeilam bolje neihil in, name khotona lhagao chun dettah'a pan kalah jingna din neipui jing in.
en: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
text:
PSA 143:10
Thadou: Ka Pathen Elohim nahi, nadeilam bolje neihil in, name khotona lhagao chun dettah'a pan kalah jingna din neipui jing in.
English: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, namin loupina ding in kahinkho hinghoi teijin. Ajeh chu nakitahna jal'in kahahsatna'a kon in nei puidoh tan.
en: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
text:
PSA 143:11
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, namin loupina ding in kahinkho hinghoi teijin. Ajeh chu nakitahna jal'in kahahsatna'a kon in nei puidoh tan.
English: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

tcz: Nami ngailutna longlou chun, kagal mite manthahsan in! Chule nalhacha kahi, eidou ho jouse sumang hel in.
en: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.
text:
PSA 143:12
Thadou: Nami ngailutna longlou chun, kagal mite manthahsan in! Chule nalhacha kahi, eidou ho jouse sumang hel in.
English: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un Amachu kasongpi ahi. Aman kakhut teni hi galsatje dan eihil in, chule kakhut jung hohi galsatna'a manchahje dan eihil ahi.
en: Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—
text:
PSA 144:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un Amachu kasongpi ahi. Aman kakhut teni hi galsatje dan eihil in, chule kakhut jung hohi galsatna'a manchahje dan eihil ahi.
English: Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—

tcz: Amahi eipanpi phapen leh kakulpi ahin, kahoidohna pal leh eihuhdohpa ahi. Chitin namtin anoijah akunsahji ahi.
en: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
text:
PSA 144:2
Thadou: Amahi eipanpi phapen leh kakulpi ahin, kahoidohna pal leh eihuhdohpa ahi. Chitin namtin anoijah akunsahji ahi.
English: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, mihem hi ipi hija hibanga nagel-lut'a, mihem chapa jeng jong ipi hija hibanga nakhohsah hitam?
en: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
text:
PSA 144:3
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, mihem hi ipi hija hibanga nagel-lut'a, mihem chapa jeng jong ipi hija hibanga nakhohsah hitam?
English: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

tcz: Ajeh chu mihem hi hai khatseh'a hing ahibouvin, ahin-nikho jong nisa-lep tobanga mangpai thei ahibouve.
en: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
text:
PSA 144:4
Thadou: Ajeh chu mihem hi hai khatseh'a hing ahibouvin, ahin-nikho jong nisa-lep tobanga mangpai thei ahibouve.
English: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai vanho hinhong in hung kum lhan, molsang hohi tham'in lang meikhun len mangsah in.
en: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
text:
PSA 144:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai vanho hinhong in hung kum lhan, molsang hohi tham'in lang meikhun len mangsah in.
English: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

tcz: Kehchang len-dohsah inlang galmite thejalsah in! Nathalchang kap inlang jamsah soh hel in.
en: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
text:
PSA 144:6
Thadou: Kehchang len-dohsah inlang galmite thejalsah in! Nathalchang kap inlang jamsah soh hel in.
English: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

tcz: Vanna kon'in nakhut hin lhang in, twithuh lah'a konleh kagalmite thaneina'a kon in nei huhdoh in.
en: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
text:
PSA 144:7
Thadou: Vanna kon'in nakhut hin lhang in, twithuh lah'a konleh kagalmite thaneina'a kon in nei huhdoh in.
English: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,

tcz: Akam'un jou jeng aseijun, thudih kaseije atiuvin akihahsel un, hinlah jou jeng aseijun ahi.
en: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
text:
PSA 144:8
Thadou: Akam'un jou jeng aseijun, thudih kaseije atiuvin akihahsel un, hinlah jou jeng aseijun ahi.
English: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

tcz: O ka Pathen Elohim, na henga lathah khat sange; selangdah jangsom kibut chu mangchan na vahchoila sange.
en: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
text:
PSA 144:9
Thadou: O ka Pathen Elohim, na henga lathah khat sange; selangdah jangsom kibut chu mangchan na vahchoila sange.
English: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangman lengho galjona napen! Nalhacha David jong athi nading chemjam'a kon in nahuhdoh jin ahi.
en: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
text:
PSA 144:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangman lengho galjona napen! Nalhacha David jong athi nading chemjam'a kon in nahuhdoh jin ahi.
English: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

tcz: Neihuhdoh'in! Kagalmite thaneina'a kon'in neihuhdoh'in, akam un jou jeng aseijun; thutah kaseiding ahi tin akihahsel-un, hinlah jou jengseh aseijun ahi.
en: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
text:
PSA 144:11
Thadou: Neihuhdoh'in! Kagalmite thaneina'a kon'in neihuhdoh'in, akam un jou jeng aseijun; thutah kaseiding ahi tin akihahsel-un, hinlah jou jengseh aseijun ahi.
English: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

tcz: Kachapateu akhandon laijun thingphung phatah bang in khanlhit sah in, ka chanuteu jong leng inpi jemhoi dinga kisem khompi hoitah ho bang u-hen.
en: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
text:
PSA 144:12
Thadou: Kachapateu akhandon laijun thingphung phatah bang in khanlhit sah in, ka chanuteu jong leng inpi jemhoi dinga kisem khompi hoitah ho bang u-hen.
English: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

tcz: Ka chang pang jouseu jong lousoh jouse pum'in dimsoh hen, kalou jaova kagan chateu asang sang in, sangsom som chan geijin pung hen.
en: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
text:
PSA 144:13
Thadou: Ka chang pang jouseu jong lousoh jouse pum'in dimsoh hen, kalou jaova kagan chateu asang sang in, sangsom som chan geijin pung hen.
English: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

tcz: Kagancha teu gai pha hen, veiset le apengsol um hih hel hen! Ka khopi sung jenguva jong lung gim khoisat beihel hen.
en: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
text:
PSA 144:14
Thadou: Kagancha teu gai pha hen, veiset le apengsol um hih hel hen! Ka khopi sung jenguva jong lung gim khoisat beihel hen.
English: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

tcz: Hitobang thilpha achunga lhung ho kipah uhen! chule a Pathen'u Elohim, Yahweh Pakai hikha nam mite chu kipah cheh'u hen!
en: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.
text:
PSA 144:15
Thadou: Hitobang thilpha achunga lhung ho kipah uhen! chule a Pathen'u Elohim, Yahweh Pakai hikha nam mite chu kipah cheh'u hen!
English: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.

tcz: Ka Pathen leh kalengpa Elohim nangma choi at inge, chule itih chan hijong leh nangma thangvah jing ing kate.
en: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
text:
PSA 145:1
Thadou: Ka Pathen leh kalengpa Elohim nangma choi at inge, chule itih chan hijong leh nangma thangvah jing ing kate.
English: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

tcz: Niseh'a nangma ka thangvah jing ding, itihchan hijongleh nangma kavahchoi ding ahi.
en: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
text:
PSA 145:2
Thadou: Niseh'a nangma ka thangvah jing ding, itihchan hijongleh nangma kavahchoi ding ahi.
English: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi athupin, Amabou thangvah dinga lom ahi; koiman athupina tejou ponte.
en: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
text:
PSA 145:3
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi athupin, Amabou thangvah dinga lom ahi; koiman athupina tejou ponte.
English: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

tcz: Akhang khanga mihem ten Yahweh Pakai natoh apachat jing diu, thil kidangtah tah nabol ho aphonjal diu ahi.
en: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
text:
PSA 145:4
Thadou: Akhang khanga mihem ten Yahweh Pakai natoh apachat jing diu, thil kidangtah tah nabol ho aphonjal diu ahi.
English: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai nalal loupina kidang leh nathilbol datmo umtah ho giltah'a kagel jing ding ahi.
en: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
text:
PSA 145:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai nalal loupina kidang leh nathilbol datmo umtah ho giltah'a kagel jing ding ahi.
English: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

tcz: Nathilbol gimnei hohi mijouse kam'a kijadoh ding, keiman nathupi na ho kaphondoh ding ahi.
en: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
text:
PSA 145:6
Thadou: Nathilbol gimnei hohi mijouse kam'a kijadoh ding, keiman nathupi na ho kaphondoh ding ahi.
English: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

tcz: Kidangtah'a naphatna thusim hi mijousen aseiphong diu, keiman jong nadihna thu hi kipahtah'a vahchoila kasah ding ahi.
en: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
text:
PSA 145:7
Thadou: Kidangtah'a naphatna thusim hi mijousen aseiphong diu, keiman jong nadihna thu hi kipahtah'a vahchoila kasah ding ahi.
English: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi milungset them leh hepina'a dim, lunghang vahlou; lungsetna long lou ahi.
en: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
text:
PSA 145:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi milungset them leh hepina'a dim, lunghang vahlou; lungsetna long lou ahi.
English: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi mijouse din aphai, Aman athilsem saho jouse chungah khotona lhingset apen ahi.
en: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
text:
PSA 145:9
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi mijouse din aphai, Aman athilsem saho jouse chungah khotona lhingset apen ahi.
English: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai, nasemsa jousen na henga kipathu asei diu, chule nanungjui dihtah jousen nathangvah diu ahi.
en: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.
text:
PSA 145:10
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai, nasemsa jousen na henga kipathu asei diu, chule nanungjui dihtah jousen nathangvah diu ahi.
English: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.

tcz: Amahon nalenggam loupina asap phong diu, nathahatna atah-lang diu ahi.
en: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
text:
PSA 145:11
Thadou: Amahon nalenggam loupina asap phong diu, nathahatna atah-lang diu ahi.
English: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,

tcz: Amahon natohdoh thil loupi ho mihem chate aseipeh diu, navaihomna lenggam loupi leh anatsat dan aphondoh peh diu ahi.
en: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
text:
PSA 145:12
Thadou: Amahon natohdoh thil loupi ho mihem chate aseipeh diu, navaihomna lenggam loupi leh anatsat dan aphondoh peh diu ahi.
English: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

tcz: Ajeh chu nalenggam hi tonsot lenggam ahin, nangin akhang khanga vai nahop ding ahi.
en: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
text:
PSA 145:13
Thadou: Ajeh chu nalenggam hi tonsot lenggam ahin, nangin akhang khanga vai nahop ding ahi.
English: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in alhuho athoudoh'in apohgih'in adelpha ho aphong dingin ahi. Aseidoh chan a kitah Yahweh Pakai ahin, atohna jousea lungset them ahi.
en: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
text:
PSA 145:14
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in alhuho athoudoh'in apohgih'in adelpha ho aphong dingin ahi. Aseidoh chan a kitah Yahweh Pakai ahin, atohna jousea lungset them ahi.
English: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

tcz: Mit jousen kinem tah'in nangma lam ahin ven, nangman amaho ngaichat dung juijin aneh diu napejin ahi.
en: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
text:
PSA 145:15
Thadou: Mit jousen kinem tah'in nangma lam ahin ven, nangman amaho ngaichat dung juijin aneh diu napejin ahi.
English: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

tcz: Nangman nakhut namang chan, hinkho neijouse hi agilkel adangchah nau nasuh bulhinpeh jin ahi.
en: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
text:
PSA 145:16
Thadou: Nangman nakhut namang chan, hinkho neijouse hi agilkel adangchah nau nasuh bulhinpeh jin ahi.
English: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai hi atohna jousea kitahnan ajuijin, atohna chan'a ngailutna dim ahi.
en: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
text:
PSA 145:17
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai hi atohna jousea kitahnan ajuijin, atohna chan'a ngailutna dim ahi.
English: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai henga taote Aman anailut jing in, tahbeh'a taote aumpi jing in ahi.
en: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
text:
PSA 145:18
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai henga taote Aman anailut jing in, tahbeh'a taote aumpi jing in ahi.
English: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

tcz: Aman gimna le jana neipumma ngaichatna neiho alolhinsah in, panpi ngaicha'a akanao angaipeh'in ahuhdoh jin ahi.
en: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
text:
PSA 145:19
Thadou: Aman gimna le jana neipumma ngaichatna neiho alolhinsah in, panpi ngaicha'a akanao angaipeh'in ahuhdoh jin ahi.
English: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in Ama ngailuho ahuhdoh jin, hinlah miphalou ho vang asumang jin ahi.
en: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.
text:
PSA 145:20
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in Ama ngailuho ahuhdoh jin, hinlah miphalou ho vang asumang jin ahi.
English: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

tcz: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu kathangvah jing ding, vannoi leisetna cheng jousen tonsot tonsot in Amin thangvah jing tauhen.
en: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
text:
PSA 145:21
Thadou: Keiman Yahweh Pakai chu kathangvah jing ding, vannoi leisetna cheng jousen tonsot tonsot in Amin thangvah jing tauhen.
English: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai vahchoijun! O kalhagao Yahweh Pakai vahchoi jin!
en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.
text:
PSA 146:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai vahchoijun! O kalhagao Yahweh Pakai vahchoi jin!
English: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.

tcz: Kahin laisea Yahweh Pakai kavahchoi ding, hinna hu kanei laisen ka Pathen Elohim vahchoi la sange.
en: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
text:
PSA 146:2
Thadou: Kahin laisea Yahweh Pakai kavahchoi ding, hinna hu kanei laisen ka Pathen Elohim vahchoi la sange.
English: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

tcz: Leng chapate chunga natahsan koi hih'in, hichu panpi bei ahibouve.
en: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
text:
PSA 146:3
Thadou: Leng chapate chunga natahsan koi hih'in, hichu panpi bei ahibouve.
English: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.

tcz: Mihem chate hu abei teng leisetna akilekit-un leivui akisoh jin, hiche nikho lechun athilgon chengseu toh thi thading ahitauve.
en: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
text:
PSA 146:4
Thadou: Mihem chate hu abei teng leisetna akilekit-un leivui akisoh jin, hiche nikho lechun athilgon chengseu toh thi thading ahitauve.
English: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.

tcz: Hinlah apanpi dinga Israel Pathen Elohim neiho, chule Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen a kinepna neiho anunnom ahi.
en: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,
text:
PSA 146:5
Thadou: Hinlah apanpi dinga Israel Pathen Elohim neiho, chule Yahweh Pakai, Elohim Pathen a kinepna neiho anunnom ahi.
English: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,

tcz: Aman van le leiset twikhanglen leh asunga um jouse anasem in, Aman imatih chan'a akitepna achepi jing ahi.
en: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

tcz: Aman suhgentheija umho thudih'in achungthu atanpeh in, chule agilkel te an apen ahi. Yahweh Pakai in songkul tangho alhadoh'in, achamlhat sah jin ahi.
en: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.
text:
PSA 146:7
Thadou: Aman suhgentheija umho thudih'in achungthu atanpeh in, chule agilkel te an apen ahi. Yahweh Pakai in songkul tangho alhadoh'in, achamlhat sah jin ahi.
English: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mitchoho kho amusah'in, alhu ho aphong ding in, michonpha Yahweh Pakai in angailun ahi.
en: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.
text:
PSA 146:8
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in mitchoho kho amusah'in, alhu ho aphong ding in, michonpha Yahweh Pakai in angailun ahi.
English: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in gamdang miho ahuhdoh in, Aman meithaiho leh chaga ho akhoton, amavang miphalou ho thilgon asuhbei peh'in ahi.
en: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
text:
PSA 146:9
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in gamdang miho ahuhdoh in, Aman meithaiho leh chaga ho akhoton, amavang miphalou ho thilgon asuhbei peh'in ahi.
English: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in tonsotna vai ahomding ahi. O Jerusalem, Amahi akhang akhanga na Pathen hiding ahi. Yahweh Pakai vahchoijun!
en: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 146:10
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in tonsotna vai ahomding ahi. O Jerusalem, Amahi akhang akhanga na Pathen hiding ahi. Yahweh Pakai vahchoijun!
English: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai vahchoijin umhen! iPathen'u Elohim vahchoi lasah ding hi iti phat-a pha hitam! Ijeh-inem itileh Ama lungset nan adimn in, vahchoi dia lomtah ahi.
en: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
text:
PSA 147:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai vahchoijin umhen! iPathen'u Elohim vahchoi lasah ding hi iti phat-a pha hitam! Ijeh-inem itileh Ama lungset nan adimn in, vahchoi dia lomtah ahi.
English: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in Jerusalem aki ledohsah in, amangtasa Israelte ahin lepui kit in ahi.
en: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
text:
PSA 147:2
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in Jerusalem aki ledohsah in, amangtasa Israelte ahin lepui kit in ahi.
English: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

tcz: Aman lungthimna jong aboldam in, amaha jeng-u jong adamsah'in ahi.
en: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
text:
PSA 147:3
Thadou: Aman lungthimna jong aboldam in, amaha jeng-u jong adamsah'in ahi.
English: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

tcz: Aman ahsi ho asim toh in, amin cheh'in akouvin ahi.
en: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
text:
PSA 147:4
Thadou: Aman ahsi ho asim toh in, amin cheh'in akouvin ahi.
English: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.

tcz: I-Yahweh Pakaiju hi iti loupi hitam! Athaneina hi akhonna gei ahi! Athil hetthem theina jong mihem hetphah hoi ahipoi.
en: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
text:
PSA 147:5
Thadou: I-Yahweh Pakaiju hi iti loupi hitam! Athaneina hi akhonna gei ahi! Athil hetthem theina jong mihem hetphah hoi ahipoi.
English: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mikineosah ho adomsang'in, ahin miphalouho vang toltoh alhobeh'in ahi.
en: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
text:
PSA 147:6
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in mikineosah ho adomsang'in, ahin miphalouho vang toltoh alhobeh'in ahi.
English: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thangvahna la sauvin, semjangto thon Elohim Pathen vahchoila sauvin.
en: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
text:
PSA 147:7
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai thangvahna la sauvin, semjangto thon Elohim Pathen vahchoila sauvin.
English: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,

tcz: Aman vanho meilom'in akhun, leiset'a go ajuh lhahsah in, chule molchunga hampa louhing akedohsah'in ahi.
en: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
text:
PSA 147:8
Thadou: Aman vanho meilom'in akhun, leiset'a go ajuh lhahsah in, chule molchunga hampa louhing akedohsah'in ahi.
English: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.

tcz: Aman gamsa ho neh ding apen chule va-ah nou ho apenteng aneh diu apejin ahi.
en: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
text:
PSA 147:9
Thadou: Aman gamsa ho neh ding apen chule va-ah nou ho apenteng aneh diu apejin ahi.
English: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

tcz: Aman sakol thahatna leh mihem thahatna'a akison-jiu akipapi poi.
en: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
text:
PSA 147:10
Thadou: Aman sakol thahatna leh mihem thahatna'a akison-jiu akipapi poi.
English: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu Ama ging jing hole ami ngailutna longlou chunga kinepna neiho akipa pin ahi.
en: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
text:
PSA 147:11
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu Ama ging jing hole ami ngailutna longlou chunga kinepna neiho akipa pin ahi.
English: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

tcz: Vo Jerusalem, Yahweh Pakai loupina vahchoijun! O Zion, na Pathen Elohim vahchoijun.
en: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
text:
PSA 147:12
Thadou: Vo Jerusalem, Yahweh Pakai loupina vahchoijun! O Zion, na Pathen Elohim vahchoijun.
English: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

tcz: Ajeh chu Aman nakelkot jol ho alhousah in, chule nakul sunga nachate phatthei aboh in ahi.
en: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.
text:
PSA 147:13
Thadou: Ajeh chu Aman nakelkot jol ho alhousah in, chule nakul sunga nachate phatthei aboh in ahi.
English: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

tcz: Aman nagamgi tin-uva chamna alensah in, chule nagilkel nauvah an twitah'in navah uvin ahi.
en: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
text:
PSA 147:14
Thadou: Aman nagamgi tin-uva chamna alensah in, chule nagilkel nauvah an twitah'in navah uvin ahi.
English: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.

tcz: Vannoi leiset chunga thu-apeh teng jongleh aman gang in ahi.
en: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
text:
PSA 147:15
Thadou: Vannoi leiset chunga thu-apeh teng jongleh aman gang in ahi.
English: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

tcz: Aman buhbang jeng jong samul abahsah jin, chule dai-kai jong vutvam kithejal abahsah jin ahi.
en: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
text:
PSA 147:16
Thadou: Aman buhbang jeng jong samul abahsah jin, chule dai-kai jong vutvam kithejal abahsah jin ahi.
English: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

tcz: Gel-chang jong song kisunglha abahsah jin, adapsah teng jong ama-anga ding jou ding koiham?
en: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
text:
PSA 147:17
Thadou: Gel-chang jong song kisunglha abahsah jin, adapsah teng jong ama-anga ding jou ding koiham?
English: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?

tcz: Chujouteng Aman thu apen ahileh ajunlha gamji tan, Aman hui chu asol'in ahileh buhbangho chu twijin alongji tai.
en: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
text:
PSA 147:18
Thadou: Chujouteng Aman thu apen ahileh ajunlha gamji tan, Aman hui chu asol'in ahileh buhbangho chu twijin alongji tai.
English: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

tcz: Aman Jacob henga thu aseipeh in, Israel kom'a a Dan thupeh hole athuhil hochu ahilchen in ahi.
en: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
text:
PSA 147:19
Thadou: Aman Jacob henga thu aseipeh in, Israel kom'a a Dan thupeh hole athuhil hochu ahilchen in ahi.
English: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

tcz: Hitobang hi namdang ho jah'a aseipeh pon, amahon athuhil jong ahepouvin ahi. Yahweh Pakai vahchoijin umhen!
en: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 147:20
Thadou: Hitobang hi namdang ho jah'a aseipeh pon, amahon athuhil jong ahepouvin ahi. Yahweh Pakai vahchoijin umhen!
English: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Vanhoa kon'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Vanthamjol-a kon'in Amachu thangvah'un!
en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
text:
PSA 148:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Vanhoa kon'in Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Vanthamjol-a kon'in Amachu thangvah'un!
English: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!

tcz: Avantilte jousen thangvah'un! Van sepaite jousen thangvah'un!
en: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!
text:
PSA 148:2
Thadou: Avantilte jousen thangvah'un! Van sepaite jousen thangvah'un!
English: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!

tcz: Nisa le lha-in amachu thangvah'un! Aphelhet lhet ahsi hon Amachu thangvah'un!
en: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
text:
PSA 148:3
Thadou: Nisa le lha-in amachu thangvah'un! Aphelhet lhet ahsi hon Amachu thangvah'un!
English: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!

tcz: Achungsang lam'a um vantham jol'in thangvah'un! Meilom chung sangpeh'a um meitwi hon Amachu thangvah'un!
en: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.
text:
PSA 148:4
Thadou: Achungsang lam'a um vantham jol'in thangvah'un! Meilom chung sangpeh'a um meitwi hon Amachu thangvah'un!
English: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.

tcz: Thilsemho jousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuvin, ajeh chu Aman thu apen ahileh amaho chu ahung kisemdoh jengun ahi.
en: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.
text:
PSA 148:5
Thadou: Thilsemho jousen Yahweh Pakai chu thangvahna peuvin, ajeh chu Aman thu apen ahileh amaho chu ahung kisemdoh jengun ahi.
English: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.

tcz: Aman tonsot geija dinga anagontohsoh ahitai. Ama Dan semchu itih hijongleh ki khokhel louding ahi.
en: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.
text:
PSA 148:6
Thadou: Aman tonsot geija dinga anagontohsoh ahitai. Ama Dan semchu itih hijongleh ki khokhel louding ahi.
English: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

tcz: Leisetna konnin thangvah'un, twikhanglen lailunga thilsemhon thangvah'un,
en: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,
text:
PSA 148:7
Thadou: Leisetna konnin thangvah'un, twikhanglen lailunga thilsemhon thangvah'un,
English: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,

tcz: meileh gel hon, buhbang leh meilom hon thangvah'un, huileh adap asatnin Ama thu chu ngaijun.
en: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,
text:
PSA 148:8
Thadou: meileh gel hon, buhbang leh meilom hon thangvah'un, huileh adap asatnin Ama thu chu ngaijun.
English: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,

tcz: Mol leh lhangho, aga nei thingphung ho le Cedar thinghon,
en: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
text:
PSA 148:9
Thadou: Mol leh lhangho, aga nei thingphung ho le Cedar thinghon,
English: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

tcz: gamsa ho le ganhingho jousen, ganhing neochacha ho le vachahon,
en: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,
text:
PSA 148:10
Thadou: gamsa ho le ganhingho jousen, ganhing neochacha ho le vachahon,
English: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,

tcz: leiset chunga lengho le mipite jousen, leiset chunga vaihom hole thutanho jousen,
en: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,
text:
PSA 148:11
Thadou: leiset chunga lengho le mipite jousen, leiset chunga vaihom hole thutanho jousen,
English: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,

tcz: pasal khangthah ho le numei khangthah hon, tehse hole chapanghon,
en: both young men and maidens, old men and children.
text:
PSA 148:12
Thadou: pasal khangthah ho le numei khangthah hon, tehse hole chapanghon,
English: both young men and maidens, old men and children.

tcz: abonchauvin Yahweh Pakai min thangvah'u hen! Ajeh chu Aminhi aloupi lheh jenge, hiche Amin loupina hi leiset le vanho jouse sanga sangjo ahi.
en: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
text:
PSA 148:13
Thadou: abonchauvin Yahweh Pakai min thangvah'u hen! Ajeh chu Aminhi aloupi lheh jenge, hiche Amin loupina hi leiset le vanho jouse sanga sangjo ahi.
English: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

tcz: Aman amite chu ki khat atundohpeh tan ahi, amadinga kitahna neijouse Aman angailut Israel mipite chu jana apetan ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 148:14
Thadou: Aman amite chu ki khat atundohpeh tan ahi, amadinga kitahna neijouse Aman angailut Israel mipite chu jana apetan ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
English: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Yahweh Pakai vahchoina lathah sauvin. Tahsan chate kikhopna ah avahchoila sauvin.
en: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
text:
PSA 149:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'un! Yahweh Pakai vahchoina lathah sauvin. Tahsan chate kikhopna ah avahchoila sauvin.
English: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

tcz: O Israel nasempa chunga kipah'in, O Jerusalem mipite, na lengpau chungah kipah'un.
en: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
text:
PSA 149:2
Thadou: O Israel nasempa chunga kipah'in, O Jerusalem mipite, na lengpau chungah kipah'un.
English: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

tcz: Khongpi gintoh semjang saito thon lampum pum'in Aminchu vahchoijun,
en: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
text:
PSA 149:3
Thadou: Khongpi gintoh semjang saito thon lampum pum'in Aminchu vahchoijun,
English: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

tcz: Ajeh chu amite chungah akipah'in, mi nun nem te chu jana lallukhuh akhupeh tai.
en: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
text:
PSA 149:4
Thadou: Ajeh chu amite chungah akipah'in, mi nun nem te chu jana lallukhuh akhupeh tai.
English: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

tcz: Elohim Pathen chate chu hitobang jana achanjeh'un, jankhovah'in avahchoila sauhen,
en: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
text:
PSA 149:5
Thadou: Elohim Pathen chate chu hitobang jana achanjeh'un, jankhovah'in avahchoila sauhen,
English: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

tcz: Akhut'in chemjam hemtah kichoiyu henlang, akamsunguuvah kipah tah'in Elohim Pathen thangvah la sauhen.
en: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
text:
PSA 149:6
Thadou: Akhut'in chemjam hemtah kichoiyu henlang, akamsunguuvah kipah tah'in Elohim Pathen thangvah la sauhen.
English: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

tcz: Chitin namtin ho chunga aphulah theina diuleh, namtin chunga engbolna apehtheina diuvin,
en: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

tcz: alengteu thihkhao kola akihen'uva, chuleh alamkaiteu thihkhaova akikan theina diuvin,
en: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

tcz: achunguva thu kitanna dungjuija akitohdohna dingin. Hichehi Elohim Pathen chate chan loupitah achannao chu ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 149:9
Thadou: achunguva thu kitanna dungjuija akitohdohna dingin. Hichehi Elohim Pathen chate chan loupitah achannao chu ahi. Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
English: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!

tcz: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah na peuvin! Elohim Pathen chu Houin'ah thangvah'un, Avan chung thahatna mun nah thangvah'un!
en: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
text:
PSA 150:1
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah na peuvin! Elohim Pathen chu Houin'ah thangvah'un, Avan chung thahatna mun nah thangvah'un!
English: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

tcz: Athilbol thahatna kidangtah jeh'in amachu thangvah'un, aletna seijoulou jeh'in thangvah'un!
en: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
text:
PSA 150:2
Thadou: Athilbol thahatna kidangtah jeh'in amachu thangvah'un, aletna seijoulou jeh'in thangvah'un!
English: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

tcz: Sumkon gin kithong pum'in vahchoijun, theile mut selangdah saito thon thangvah'un!
en: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
text:
PSA 150:3
Thadou: Sumkon gin kithong pum'in vahchoijun, theile mut selangdah saito thon thangvah'un!
English: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

tcz: Khopi ginleh lam pummin vahchoijun, kuli leh tumging theito thon thangvah'un!
en: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
text:
PSA 150:4
Thadou: Khopi ginleh lam pummin vahchoijun, kuli leh tumging theito thon thangvah'un!
English: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

tcz: Khong gintoh thon thangvah'un, Khong gin kithong gimneitah chuto thon vahchoi jun,
en: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!
text:
PSA 150:5
Thadou: Khong gintoh thon thangvah'un, Khong gin kithong gimneitah chuto thon vahchoi jun,
English: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

tcz: Haina hu neijousen Yahweh Pakai thangvah na la sauvin! Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
en: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
text:
PSA 150:6
Thadou: Haina hu neijousen Yahweh Pakai thangvah na la sauvin! Yahweh Pakai chu thangvah'in umhen!
English: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!

tcz: Hiche hi Israel leng David chapa Solomon thuchih ho ahi.
en: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
text:
PRO 1:1
Thadou: Hiche hi Israel leng David chapa Solomon thuchih ho ahi.
English: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

tcz: Hiche hi mihemten chihna le kigah chahna, thuchih kiseiho hi ipi kiseina ham, ti ahetdoh theina diu ahi.
en: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

tcz: Chule ahoi-apha adihlam'a kihilna kisan them'a adih le thudih agom'a kisanlut ding,
en: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

tcz: Chuteng milham ho dinga lunglim-geh'a hinna, chule khangdong hon hetna le thil detkhen themna anei diu ahi.
en: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—
text:
PRO 1:4
Thadou: Chuteng milham ho dinga lunglim-geh'a hinna, chule khangdong hon hetna le thil detkhen themna anei diu ahi.
English: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—

tcz: Miching jeng jong khodah'a thepna alambe ding, hetkhenna nei mihem in jong kihilchahna alambe ding ahi.
en: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

tcz: Hiche thuchih kiseiho le thil umdan hetthemna anei ding, miching hon thu asei teng, thulem aseidoh jouseu hettheina tha anei ding ahi.
en: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
text:
PRO 1:6
Thadou: Hiche thuchih kiseiho le thil umdan hetthemna anei ding, miching hon thu asei teng, thulem aseidoh jouseu hettheina tha anei ding ahi.
English: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ginna hi hetna dinga abulpi ahin, mingol hon vang chihna le hilchah nan asang thei poi.
en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
text:
PRO 1:7
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ginna hi hetna dinga abulpi ahin, mingol hon vang chihna le hilchah nan asang thei poi.
English: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

tcz: Kachapa, napan nahilna ngaijin lang, nanun nahilna jong sang teijin,
en: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh, amanin nahilna jouse khotona lallukhuh'a nakikhuh ding, chule jana na ngong changa khivui oa naki'o ding ahi.
en: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
text:
PRO 1:9
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh, amanin nahilna jouse khotona lallukhuh'a nakikhuh ding, chule jana na ngong changa khivui oa naki'o ding ahi.
English: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

tcz: Kachapa michonseten jol lhah ding nago jong leu, athu'u nangai lou hel ding ahi.
en: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
text:
PRO 1:10
Thadou: Kachapa michonseten jol lhah ding nago jong leu, athu'u nangai lou hel ding ahi.
English: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

tcz: Amahon na henga ahin seidiu, “Hung'in cheu hitin mihem thadin ngah-ute; suhkhel neilou ho jong chu inop chabep uva ibol diuvin nga lhih tau hite.
en: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
text:
PRO 1:11
Thadou: Amahon na henga ahin seidiu, “Hung'in cheu hitin mihem thadin ngah-ute; suhkhel neilou ho jong chu inop chabep uva ibol diuvin nga lhih tau hite.
English: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

tcz: Ahing changa lhankhuh in aval lhum'a abah gam bang in, eihon jong ahing in bahgam-u hitin, thina kokhuh'a lhalutsa bang in, apum chang in val lhum gam tau hite.
en: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
text:
PRO 1:12
Thadou: Ahing changa lhankhuh in aval lhum'a abah gam bang in, eihon jong ahing in bahgam-u hitin, thina kokhuh'a lhalutsa bang in, apum chang in val lhum gam tau hite.
English: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

tcz: Chuteng thil thupi tahtah imu diu, mi thil lelo ichomdoh hou chu in dimset'a isit diu ahi.
en: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
text:
PRO 1:13
Thadou: Chuteng thil thupi tahtah imu diu, mi thil lelo ichomdoh hou chu in dimset'a isit diu ahi.
English: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

tcz: Keiho kom'a chan hung neijin lang, sumdip kikhong in sum khol khom u-hite, tia ahinsei diu ahi.”
en: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—
text:
PRO 1:14
Thadou: Keiho kom'a chan hung neijin lang, sumdip kikhong in sum khol khom u-hite, tia ahinsei diu ahi.”
English: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—

tcz: Hinlah kachapa, amaho toh kilhon khom hih hel'in, amaho lam lhahna akon chun kidalse jon,
en: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
text:
PRO 1:15
Thadou: Hinlah kachapa, amaho toh kilhon khom hih hel'in, amaho lam lhahna akon chun kidalse jon,
English: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho thilpha lou bolnan akeng-u ajangkhai in, gangtah in thisan aso jiuve.
en: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
text:
PRO 1:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu amaho thilpha lou bolnan akeng-u ajangkhai in, gangtah in thisan aso jiuve.
English: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

tcz: Hijeh chun vachan ao nading thang kikam amu teng, pannabei asoh jitai.
en: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

tcz: Hitobang miho hin ama hole amaho thisan sodohna dinga midang achan lhih jiu ahin, amaho thina ding jenga bou mi achan jiu ahi.
en: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
text:
PRO 1:18
Thadou: Hitobang miho hin ama hole amaho thisan sodohna dinga midang achan lhih jiu ahin, amaho thina ding jenga bou mi achan jiu ahi.
English: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

tcz: Koi hileh hitobang pumtho changa ama phatchomna ding ngaito bang bep ahiuvin, thil lelo neipa ahivang in thina atoh jitan ahi.
en: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
text:
PRO 1:19
Thadou: Koi hileh hitobang pumtho changa ama phatchomna ding ngaito bang bep ahiuvin, thil lelo neipa ahivang in thina atoh jitan ahi.
English: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

tcz: Chihna hin lamlen lah'a kho asamjin, japi lah jenga jong ogin kithong tah'in apeng jin ahi.
en: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
text:
PRO 1:20
Thadou: Chihna hin lamlen lah'a kho asamjin, japi lah jenga jong ogin kithong tah'in apeng jin ahi.
English: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

tcz: Chihna hi lamlen dunga jong apeng jah jeng in, khopi kelkot mai'a jong thu aphong doh jin ahi.
en: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
text:
PRO 1:21
Thadou: Chihna hi lamlen dunga jong apeng jah jeng in, khopi kelkot mai'a jong thu aphong doh jin ahi.
English: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

tcz: “Vo mihemte, itih chanpi mihem mei meija hin ding nagot u-ham, anop nop'a paohon itih chanpi michunga nanop pao diu ham? Angol hon itih chanpi hetna nathet diu hitam?
en: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
text:
PRO 1:22
Thadou: “Vo mihemte, itih chanpi mihem mei meija hin ding nagot u-ham, anop nop'a paohon itih chanpi michunga nanop pao diu ham? Angol hon itih chanpi hetna nathet diu hitam?
English: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

tcz: Kathumop nahi ngai phau vin, ajeh chu keiman nangho dinga kalunggel ngaito kasei ding, chuteng kathuseija kon chihna nalam doh diu ahi.
en: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
text:
PRO 1:23
Thadou: Kathumop nahi ngai phau vin, ajeh chu keiman nangho dinga kalunggel ngaito kasei ding, chuteng kathuseija kon chihna nalam doh diu ahi.
English: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh keiman nang ho kakou un, nang hon nei donbut deh pouve. Kakhut ban in kahin sang uvin, iman jong nagel deh pouvin ahi.
en: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

tcz: Kahilna abonchan nadonse pouvin, kagihsal na jouse jong khatcha nadonse pouvin ahi.
en: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

tcz: Hijeh chun hahsatna dinmun nalhun teng uleh kanuisat diu, manthah nan nalhun den tengu jong leh kanuisat ding nahiuve.
en: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,
text:
PRO 1:26
Thadou: Hijeh chun hahsatna dinmun nalhun teng uleh kanuisat diu, manthah nan nalhun den tengu jong leh kanuisat ding nahiuve.
English: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

tcz: Huipi hattah banga manthahnan nahin lhun khum diu, chimpei banga hahsatna nahin to diu, chule gim le hesoh hoise tah in nalhun dendiu hijongleh ka khohsah louhel ding nahi tauve.
en: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.
text:
PRO 1:27
Thadou: Huipi hattah banga manthahnan nahin lhun khum diu, chimpei banga hahsatna nahin to diu, chule gim le hesoh hoise tah in nalhun dendiu hijongleh ka khohsah louhel ding nahi tauve.
English: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

tcz: Hinlah amahon panpi ngaija eihin kou-diu, keiman kadonbut dehlou diu, gil tah'a eihol jing diu, ahin eihol doh jou deh lou diu ahi.
en: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,
text:
PRO 1:28
Thadou: Hinlah amahon panpi ngaija eihin kou-diu, keiman kadonbut dehlou diu, gil tah'a eihol jing diu, ahin eihol doh jou deh lou diu ahi.
English: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon hetna athet uvin, Yahweh Pakai gin ding jong alheng deh pouvin ahi.
en: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.
text:
PRO 1:29
Thadou: Ajeh chu amahon hetna athet uvin, Yahweh Pakai gin ding jong alheng deh pouvin ahi.
English: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.

tcz: Amahon kahilna asang pouvin, kagih salna jouse jong pannabei aso tauvin ahi.
en: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
text:
PRO 1:30
Thadou: Amahon kahilna asang pouvin, kagih salna jouse jong pannabei aso tauvin ahi.
English: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

tcz: Chule amahon anop chabep uva atoh-gau aneh diu, thilpha lou angaito jouseu thao twi banga jol lha diu ahi.
en: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
text:
PRO 1:31
Thadou: Chule amahon anop chabep uva atoh-gau aneh diu, thilpha lou angaito jouseu thao twi banga jol lha diu ahi.
English: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon lamdih jot louvin, milham ho chunga thina alhung lo jitan, lungthim beiho kiletsahna chu amaho manthahna asoh jin ahi.
en: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
text:
PRO 1:32
Thadou: Ajeh chu amahon lamdih jot louvin, milham ho chunga thina alhung lo jitan, lungthim beiho kiletsahna chu amaho manthahna asoh jin ahi.
English: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

tcz: Koi hileh kasei phatah'a ngaija chun lungmonna anei ding, gin ding neiloua lungmong sel'a cheng jing ding ahi.”
en: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
text:
PRO 1:33
Thadou: Koi hileh kasei phatah'a ngaija chun lungmonna anei ding, gin ding neiloua lungmong sel'a cheng jing ding ahi.”
English: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”

tcz: Kachapa, kathusei ho na-ngaija, chule kathupeh ho gou banga na chintup jing ding,
en: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
text:
PRO 2:1
Thadou: Kachapa, kathusei ho na-ngaija, chule kathupeh ho gou banga na chintup jing ding,
English: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,

tcz: Chihna thu nakhoh sah jing ding, chule lunggil tah'a thil hetkhen themna nanei ding ahi.
en: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

tcz: Hetgilna dingin peng jah-in, thil hetkhenna nanei thei nadin othong in peng jah in,
en: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

tcz: Dangka banga na hol ding; thil lutah kisel banga nahol ding ahi.
en: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;

tcz: Chuteng Yahweh Pakai gin kiti nahetdoh ding, Elohim Pathen hetna jong nanei ding ahi.
en: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
text:
PRO 2:5
Thadou: Chuteng Yahweh Pakai gin kiti nahetdoh ding, Elohim Pathen hetna jong nanei ding ahi.
English: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

tcz: Ajeh chu chihna hi Elohim Pathen thilpeh ahin, Amakam sunga kon hetkhenna hung konji ahi.
en: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
text:
PRO 2:6
Thadou: Ajeh chu chihna hi Elohim Pathen thilpeh ahin, Amakam sunga kon hetkhenna hung konji ahi.
English: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

tcz: Milungtheng hodin hetkhen themna apejin, lung limgeh cha lamlha te chunga lum-in apang jitai.
en: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
text:
PRO 2:7
Thadou: Milungtheng hodin hetkhen themna apejin, lung limgeh cha lamlha te chunga lum-in apang jitai.
English: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

tcz: Mikitah ho lampi avetsuipeh in, amakoma kitah ho avengbit jing e.
en: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
text:
PRO 2:8
Thadou: Mikitah ho lampi avetsuipeh in, amakoma kitah ho avengbit jing e.
English: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

tcz: Chuteng nang in chonphat na le thudih chu nahin hetdoh ding, chule lamdih'a cheje dan nahin kimu dohding ahi.
en: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
text:
PRO 2:9
Thadou: Chuteng nang in chonphat na le thudih chu nahin hetdoh ding, chule lamdih'a cheje dan nahin kimu dohding ahi.
English: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

tcz: Ajeh chu nalung sunga chihna hunglut intin, chule hetna lhingset nahin nei ding, hichun nakipa sah ding ahi.
en: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
text:
PRO 2:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu nalung sunga chihna hunglut intin, chule hetna lhingset nahin nei ding, hichun nakipa sah ding ahi.
English: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

tcz: Hetkhan them chihna chun nahin venbit ding, hetthemna chun nahoibit ding ahi.
en: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
text:
PRO 2:11
Thadou: Hetkhan them chihna chun nahin venbit ding, hetthemna chun nahoibit ding ahi.
English: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

tcz: Hichun aphalou lampia kon navenbit jing ding, miphalou le milhem chavei hoa kon nahuhdoh ding ahi.
en: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
text:
PRO 2:12
Thadou: Hichun aphalou lampia kon navenbit jing ding, miphalou le milhem chavei hoa kon nahuhdoh ding ahi.
English: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

tcz: Hitobang miho chu lamdih'a kon lamvaija, lamdih lou ajot diu ahi.
en: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,
text:
PRO 2:13
Thadou: Hitobang miho chu lamdih'a kon lamvaija, lamdih lou ajot diu ahi.
English: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

tcz: Amaho thil dihlou jeng bol ding athanom un, chule thil phalou jenga kiman chah athanop piuvin ahi.
en: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,
text:
PRO 2:14
Thadou: Amaho thil dihlou jeng bol ding athanom un, chule thil phalou jenga kiman chah athanop piuvin ahi.
English: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,

tcz: Amahon atohdoh jouseu aphalou ngan ahin, chule achonnau lamlhah jouse damun jeng ahi.
en: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,
text:
PRO 2:15
Thadou: Amahon atohdoh jouseu aphalou ngan ahin, chule achonnau lamlhah jouse damun jeng ahi.
English: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,

tcz: Chihna hin numei phalou akon nahoidoh sah ding, joulhep toh tho a tuhchah ding nagot uva kon nahoidoh thei ding ahi.
en: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
text:
PRO 2:16
Thadou: Chihna hin numei phalou akon nahoidoh sah ding, joulhep toh tho a tuhchah ding nagot uva kon nahoidoh thei ding ahi.
English: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

tcz: Hitobang numei hin ajipa adalhah'a chule Elohim Pathen henga akitepna jong aheimil ahitai.
en: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

tcz: Hiche numeinu hin a-insunga thina chan alhut ahin, alam lhahna jouse jong damun lam jeng ahi.
en: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
text:
PRO 2:18
Thadou: Hiche numeinu hin a-insunga thina chan alhut ahin, alam lhahna jouse jong damun lam jeng ahi.
English: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

tcz: Ama henga lut pasal tapou mahthah ding, hinna lampi langa lutlou hel ding ahi tauve.
en: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
text:
PRO 2:19
Thadou: Ama henga lut pasal tapou mahthah ding, hinna lampi langa lutlou hel ding ahi tauve.
English: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangman mipha ho lampi najui jing ding, michonpha ho lampi jeng bou najot ding ahi.
en: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
text:
PRO 2:20
Thadou: Hijeh chun nangman mipha ho lampi najui jing ding, michonpha ho lampi jeng bou najot ding ahi.
English: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

tcz: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen ging hon bou gam sung alo diu, chule mikitah hobou gam sunga cheng diu ahi.
en: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
text:
PRO 2:21
Thadou: Ajeh chu Elohim Pathen ging hon bou gam sung alo diu, chule mikitah hobou gam sunga cheng diu ahi.
English: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

tcz: Amavang mi lungdih lou ho gam sunga kon kikai doh diu, chule lungthim dihlou ho chu gam sunga kon kipei doh jeng diu ahi.
en: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
text:
PRO 2:22
Thadou: Amavang mi lungdih lou ho gam sunga kon kikai doh diu, chule lungthim dihlou ho chu gam sunga kon kipei doh jeng diu ahi.
English: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

tcz: Kachapa kahilna ho sumil hih beh in, Kathupeh ho na lung sunga chen sah jing in,
en: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,
text:
PRO 3:1
Thadou: Kachapa kahilna ho sumil hih beh in, Kathupeh ho na lung sunga chen sah jing in,
English: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,

tcz: Hichengsea kon hin, nakum ajop sau thei ding, chule phatheina bukim nachan theina ding ahi.
en: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
text:
PRO 3:2
Thadou: Hichengsea kon hin, nakum ajop sau thei ding, chule phatheina bukim nachan theina ding ahi.
English: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

tcz: Itih chan hi jong leh kitah nale khotona nalha-kang lou ding, hiche teni hi na ngonga khivui oa naki o-ding, hichengse hi na lungthim sunga lekhajem banga naki-jih lut ding ahi.
en: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
text:
PRO 3:3
Thadou: Itih chan hi jong leh kitah nale khotona nalha-kang lou ding, hiche teni hi na ngonga khivui oa naki o-ding, hichengse hi na lungthim sunga lekhajem banga naki-jih lut ding ahi.
English: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

tcz: Chuteng Elohim Pathen le mipi lungdei lam nahung hi thei ding, minphatna naki-lam doh thei ding ahi.
en: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
text:
PRO 3:4
Thadou: Chuteng Elohim Pathen le mipi lungdei lam nahung hi thei ding, minphatna naki-lam doh thei ding ahi.
English: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

tcz: Nalungthim pumpin Yahweh Pakai bou tahsan in, nangma hetna jenga kisong hih in.
en: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
text:
PRO 3:5
Thadou: Nalungthim pumpin Yahweh Pakai bou tahsan in, nangma hetna jenga kisong hih in.
English: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

tcz: Nalam lhah natin chenga Yahweh Pakai jeng naphondoh ding, chuteng Aman na lampi nakomu peh ding ahi.
en: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
text:
PRO 3:6
Thadou: Nalam lhah natin chenga Yahweh Pakai jeng naphondoh ding, chuteng Aman na lampi nakomu peh ding ahi.
English: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

tcz: Nangma mitvet jenga kichang chihsah boldan, Yahweh Pakai ging pum-in thilse dalhan.
en: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
text:
PRO 3:7
Thadou: Nangma mitvet jenga kichang chihsah boldan, Yahweh Pakai ging pum-in thilse dalhan.
English: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.

tcz: Chutileh natahsa dinga damna hiding, chule nagu na chang dinga hatdohna hiding ahi.
en: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
text:
PRO 3:8
Thadou: Chutileh natahsa dinga damna hiding, chule nagu na chang dinga hatdohna hiding ahi.
English: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

tcz: Nanei nagou chule ga masa jouse Yahweh Pakai jabol pum'in tohdoh in,
en: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

tcz: Chutileh Aman nachang pang nasuh dimpeh a, nalengpi twi kholna jong aletset'a nasun dim peh ding ahi.
en: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
text:
PRO 3:10
Thadou: Chutileh Aman nachang pang nasuh dimpeh a, nalengpi twi kholna jong aletset'a nasun dim peh ding ahi.
English: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

tcz: Kachapa, Yahweh Pakai in nasuhgim nachu nahsah mon koi dan, chule Aman nasuh dihna chu lungnop mo peh hih in.
en: My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in asuhdih hohi angailut jeh ahin, mipan acha dihtah asuhdihji banga aphosalji ahi.
en: for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
text:
PRO 3:12
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in asuhdih hohi angailut jeh ahin, mipan acha dihtah asuhdihji banga aphosalji ahi.
English: for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

tcz: Chihna le hetthem theina kimu chu lungmonga kipah ding ahi.
en: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
text:
PRO 3:13
Thadou: Chihna le hetthem theina kimu chu lungmonga kipah ding ahi.
English: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

tcz: Ajeh chu chihna kitihi dangka sanga phachomjo ahin, chule aga chu sana sanga jong phachomjo ahi.
en: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
text:
PRO 3:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu chihna kitihi dangka sanga phachomjo ahin, chule aga chu sana sanga jong phachomjo ahi.
English: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

tcz: Chihna hi songmantam sanga mantamjo ahin, nangaichat thil ho jeng to jong tekah thei ahipoi.
en: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
text:
PRO 3:15
Thadou: Chihna hi songmantam sanga mantamjo ahin, nangaichat thil ho jeng to jong tekah thei ahipoi.
English: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

tcz: Hinkho sausah thei jong chihna hin akhut jet lam'a atuh chah ahin, haosatna le jabolna jeng jong akhutvei lam'a akituh chah ahi.
en: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
text:
PRO 3:16
Thadou: Hinkho sausah thei jong chihna hin akhut jet lam'a atuh chah ahin, haosatna le jabolna jeng jong akhutvei lam'a akituh chah ahi.
English: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

tcz: Chihna hin kipa thanop na lampia napui ding, alampi jouse chu lung chamna jeng ahibouve.
en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
text:
PRO 3:17
Thadou: Chihna hin kipa thanop na lampia napui ding, alampi jouse chu lung chamna jeng ahibouve.
English: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

tcz: Chihna kisanlut chan dinga hinna thingphung ahin, chihna tuh chah jing ho chu anunnom ahiuve.
en: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
text:
PRO 3:18
Thadou: Chihna kisanlut chan dinga hinna thingphung ahin, chihna tuh chah jing ho chu anunnom ahiuve.
English: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

tcz: Chihna mangchan Yahweh Pakai in vannoi leiset ana tungdoh in, thil hetthemna jal'a vanmun ho asem doh ahitai.
en: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
text:
PRO 3:19
Thadou: Chihna mangchan Yahweh Pakai in vannoi leiset ana tungdoh in, thil hetthemna jal'a vanmun ho asem doh ahitai.
English: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

tcz: Ama thil hetkhenna jal'a komtong ho kisemdoh a, meilhang pumpi jong gotwi a julhaji ahi.
en: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
text:
PRO 3:20
Thadou: Ama thil hetkhenna jal'a komtong ho kisemdoh a, meilhang pumpi jong gotwi a julhaji ahi.
English: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

tcz: Kachapa, chihna tothon, thil datkhenji dan them in, namit vet in hiche ho jouse hi pannabei sosah hih in.
en: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,
text:
PRO 3:21
Thadou: Kachapa, chihna tothon, thil datkhenji dan them in, namit vet in hiche ho jouse hi pannabei sosah hih in.
English: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche hohin nalhagao asuhnou jing a, nangong chang jenga jong khivui banga kijep thei ahi.
en: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
text:
PRO 3:22
Thadou: Ajeh chu hiche hohin nalhagao asuhnou jing a, nangong chang jenga jong khivui banga kijep thei ahi.
English: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

tcz: Chuteng lungmonga nalam lhah le ding, nakeng jong kipal talou ding ahi.
en: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
text:
PRO 3:23
Thadou: Chuteng lungmonga nalam lhah le ding, nakeng jong kipal talou ding ahi.
English: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

tcz: Kichatna beihel'a jalkhun najot ding, na imut teng jong leh lungmong tah'a na-imut ding ahi.
en: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
text:
PRO 3:24
Thadou: Kichatna beihel'a jalkhun najot ding, na imut teng jong leh lungmong tah'a na-imut ding ahi.
English: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

tcz: Kiging man louva thiding kicha hihbeh in, migilou hoa kon manthahna hung lhung ding jong nagin louhel ding ahi.
en: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai bou na kulpi ahin, Aman nakeng jeng jong thanga ao-sah louhel ding ahi.
en: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
text:
PRO 3:26
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai bou na kulpi ahin, Aman nakeng jeng jong thanga ao-sah louhel ding ahi.
English: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

tcz: Nathahat laisen na kithopi thei chan ding in, thilpha nabol peh ding ahi.
en: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
text:
PRO 3:27
Thadou: Nathahat laisen na kithopi thei chan ding in, thilpha nabol peh ding ahi.
English: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

tcz: Naheng nakom jenga jong chen lang hung kilen, jing le nale peh nanga tin, hinlah neinasan bol hihbeh in.
en: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
text:
PRO 3:28
Thadou: Naheng nakom jenga jong chen lang hung kilen, jing le nale peh nanga tin, hinlah neinasan bol hihbeh in.
English: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

tcz: Naheng nakom dounan thil gong hih beh in, ajeh chu amahon nakison piuva nakom'a cheng ahiuve.
en: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
text:
PRO 3:29
Thadou: Naheng nakom dounan thil gong hih beh in, ajeh chu amahon nakison piuva nakom'a cheng ahiuve.
English: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

tcz: Nachunga thilse bol-lou chu ajehbei in kinahpi dan,
en: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
text:
PRO 3:30
Thadou: Nachunga thilse bol-lou chu ajehbei in kinahpi dan,
English: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

tcz: Chule pumthoa natong mihem chu thangsetpi hih in, alam lhahna tinchenga kon chu nakiven joh ding ahi.
en: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
text:
PRO 3:31
Thadou: Chule pumthoa natong mihem chu thangsetpi hih in, alam lhahna tinchenga kon chu nakiven joh ding ahi.
English: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

tcz: Hitobang milung dihlou chu Yahweh Pakai in athet ahin, milungtheng vang chu Yahweh Pakaija kingai jing ahi.
en: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.
text:
PRO 3:32
Thadou: Hitobang milung dihlou chu Yahweh Pakai in athet ahin, milungtheng vang chu Yahweh Pakaija kingai jing ahi.
English: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in asapsetna chu miphalou ho inchunga alhung jin, mikitah ho chenna in chu Yahweh Pakai in phatthei aboh ding ahi.
en: The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
text:
PRO 3:33
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in asapsetna chu miphalou ho inchunga alhung jin, mikitah ho chenna in chu Yahweh Pakai in phatthei aboh ding ahi.
English: The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in minoise ho chunga noisena alhunsah jin, akineosahte chunga lunglhaina aneiyin ahi.
en: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
text:
PRO 3:34
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in minoise ho chunga noisena alhunsah jin, akineosahte chunga lunglhaina aneiyin ahi.
English: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

tcz: Miching chun mite a kon jana akimu ding, mingol ho vang muda chang diu ahitai.
en: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
text:
PRO 3:35
Thadou: Miching chun mite a kon jana akimu ding, mingol ho vang muda chang diu ahitai.
English: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.

tcz: Chapate, napauvin nahil chah nau ngai phauvin, giltah'a nahet them uva aphachom nasohdoh theina diuvin lunglut tah'in ngaijun.
en: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;

tcz: Ajeh chu Keiman Dan phatah kapeh nahiuve. Hiche kathuhil chengse hi pelkeh hihbeh un.
en: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
text:
PRO 4:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu Keiman Dan phatah kapeh nahiuve. Hiche kathuhil chengse hi pelkeh hihbeh un.
English: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

tcz: Keima kapa dinga chapa khatseh kahin, kanu mitvet jenga jong ngailut umtah chapa changkhat kahi.
en: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
text:
PRO 4:3
Thadou: Keima kapa dinga chapa khatseh kahin, kanu mitvet jenga jong ngailut umtah chapa changkhat kahi.
English: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

tcz: Kapan hitin eina hil in, “Kathusei ho nalung in chensah jing in, ka thupeh jouse jong tuhdet jing in, hinna'a nanei ding ahi.
en: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
text:
PRO 4:4
Thadou: Kapan hitin eina hil in, “Kathusei ho nalung in chensah jing in, ka thupeh jouse jong tuhdet jing in, hinna'a nanei ding ahi.
English: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

tcz: Kakam sunga kon potdoh thuchang ho sumil hih in, dalha hih hel in, chule chihna kisan in giltah in hetna neijin.
en: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
text:
PRO 4:5
Thadou: Kakam sunga kon potdoh thuchang ho sumil hih in, dalha hih hel in, chule chihna kisan in giltah in hetna neijin.
English: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

tcz: Chihna hi nungsun hih beh in, chihna hi ngaisang in, chutileh chihna hin nangma na umpi jing ding ahi.
en: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
text:
PRO 4:6
Thadou: Chihna hi nungsun hih beh in, chihna hi ngaisang in, chutileh chihna hin nangma na umpi jing ding ahi.
English: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

tcz: Hitobanga hi chihna bulpi hung kipan ahi. Chihna mutei ding gon, namu chan chu giltah'a hetdoh ding ngaiton.
en: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
text:
PRO 4:7
Thadou: Hitobanga hi chihna bulpi hung kipan ahi. Chihna mutei ding gon, namu chan chu giltah'a hetdoh ding ngaiton.
English: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

tcz: Chihna hi mutheijin domsang in, chuteng chihna chu nangma domsanga pang ding ahi. Chihna hi natuh chah jing poule, chihna chun jabolna namusah ding ahi.
