en: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.
text:
PRO 4:8
Thadou: Chihna hi mutheijin domsang in, chuteng chihna chu nangma domsanga pang ding ahi. Chihna hi natuh chah jing poule, chihna chun jabolna namusah ding ahi.
English: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

tcz: Chihna hi nalu-changa delkop phatah'a pang ding, Lal-lukhuh hoitah khuh tobang nahi ding ahi.”
en: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
text:
PRO 4:9
Thadou: Chihna hi nalu-changa delkop phatah'a pang ding, Lal-lukhuh hoitah khuh tobang nahi ding ahi.”
English: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

tcz: Kachapa kasei ngaijin lang, kathua nung in, chutileh na hinkho kijop sau thei ding ahi.
en: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
text:
PRO 4:10
Thadou: Kachapa kasei ngaijin lang, kathua nung in, chutileh na hinkho kijop sau thei ding ahi.
English: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

tcz: Keiman chihna lampi kahilsoh tan, chule chondihna lampi chengsea jong kapui tan ahi.
en: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
text:
PRO 4:11
Thadou: Keiman chihna lampi kahilsoh tan, chule chondihna lampi chengsea jong kapui tan ahi.
English: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

tcz: Nakal son-le teng jongleh nakipal lou ding, nalhai-le teng jongleh nakipal lhuh lou ding ahitai.
en: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
text:
PRO 4:12
Thadou: Nakal son-le teng jongleh nakipal lou ding, nalhai-le teng jongleh nakipal lhuh lou ding ahitai.
English: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

tcz: Ka thuhilna kisan in tuhchah jing in, hichu chingtup in, nang dinga hinna ahi.
en: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
text:
PRO 4:13
Thadou: Ka thuhilna kisan in tuhchah jing in, hichu chingtup in, nang dinga hinna ahi.
English: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

tcz: Milungthim phalou lam lhahna'a che dan, mipapse te lam lhahna'a jong vah-le hih in.
en: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
text:
PRO 4:14
Thadou: Milungthim phalou lam lhahna'a che dan, mipapse te lam lhahna'a jong vah-le hih in.
English: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

tcz: Hitobang lampia kon chun kihei mang in, vah-lut louvin jotpai jeng in.
en: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
text:
PRO 4:15
Thadou: Hitobang lampia kon chun kihei mang in, vah-lut louvin jotpai jeng in.
English: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

tcz: Ajeh chu thilse bol masa louvin ajan choldo jipouvin, mikhat tou akipalsah kahseu-vin, mu jong a-imu theiji pouvin ahi.
en: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
text:
PRO 4:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu thilse bol masa louvin ajan choldo jipouvin, mikhat tou akipalsah kahseu-vin, mu jong a-imu theiji pouvin ahi.
English: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

tcz: Amahon phatlouna ga-a bou akivah un, pumtho chang'a anatoh uchu judon banga adon jiu ahi.
en: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
text:
PRO 4:17
Thadou: Amahon phatlouna ga-a bou akivah un, pumtho chang'a anatoh uchu judon banga adon jiu ahi.
English: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

tcz: Mi chonpha ho lam lhahna vang chu jing ninou bang in asoh jin, sunlai nisa asat bang in, avah cheh cheh jin ahi.
en: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
text:
PRO 4:18
Thadou: Mi chonpha ho lam lhahna vang chu jing ninou bang in asoh jin, sunlai nisa asat bang in, avah cheh cheh jin ahi.
English: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

tcz: Amavang miphalou ho lam lhah chu muthim lah bang bep ahin, hoilaija kipal diu ham jong ahephaji pouvin ahi.
en: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
text:
PRO 4:19
Thadou: Amavang miphalou ho lam lhah chu muthim lah bang bep ahin, hoilaija kipal diu ham jong ahephaji pouvin ahi.
English: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

tcz: Kachapa, kathuhil ho ngaiphan, kasei jouse lunglut tah'in ngaijin
en: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
text:
PRO 4:20
Thadou: Kachapa, kathuhil ho ngaiphan, kasei jouse lunglut tah'in ngaijin
English: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

tcz: Hichengse hi namit mun mansah hih hel in, nalungthim sunga chensah jing tan.
en: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.
text:
PRO 4:21
Thadou: Hichengse hi namit mun mansah hih hel in, nalungthim sunga chensah jing tan.
English: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche kimu chan chun hinna'a anei ding, atahsa jeng jong adamsah ding ahi.
en: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
text:
PRO 4:22
Thadou: Ajeh chu hiche kimu chan chun hinna'a anei ding, atahsa jeng jong adamsah ding ahi.
English: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

tcz: Khodah in limgeh chan um in, ajeh chu hinna gui hung konna asohjin ahi.
en: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
text:
PRO 4:23
Thadou: Khodah in limgeh chan um in, ajeh chu hinna gui hung konna asohjin ahi.
English: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

tcz: Thudihlou nasei pai lhan, thuchavei kihoulimna nanei jong dalha tan.
en: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
text:
PRO 4:24
Thadou: Thudihlou nasei pai lhan, thuchavei kihoulimna nanei jong dalha tan.
English: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

tcz: Na mitte-nin ching geh in mive phan, namai changa nathilmu jeng jong adih hiding ahi.
en: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
text:
PRO 4:25
Thadou: Na mitte-nin ching geh in mive phan, namai changa nathilmu jeng jong adih hiding ahi.
English: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

tcz: Nakeng phang tenia nachotna ding vephan, ajeh chu nalam lhahna jouse kicheh ding ahi.
en: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
text:
PRO 4:26
Thadou: Nakeng phang tenia nachotna ding vephan, ajeh chu nalam lhahna jouse kicheh ding ahi.
English: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

tcz: Jetle vei-a jong kiheile dan, thil dihlou lampia kon chun nakeng phang sepdoh in, kihei mang jeng tan.
en: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
text:
PRO 4:27
Thadou: Jetle vei-a jong kiheile dan, thil dihlou lampia kon chun nakeng phang sepdoh in, kihei mang jeng tan.
English: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

tcz: Kachapa, kachihna hi khohsah inlang ka thumop hi phaten ngaijin. Kathil hetkhen theina hi phatea nakol sunga nangai ding ahi.
en: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
text:
PRO 5:1
Thadou: Kachapa, kachihna hi khohsah inlang ka thumop hi phaten ngaijin. Kathil hetkhen theina hi phatea nakol sunga nangai ding ahi.
English: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,

tcz: Ajeh chu thil hetkhen theina neijin natin, nakam sung jenga jong hetthemna um jing ding ahi.
en: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
text:
PRO 5:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu thil hetkhen theina neijin natin, nakam sung jenga jong hetthemna um jing ding ahi.
English: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.

tcz: Numei jong ho lei-chu khoiju lhumma lhum ding, athusei chan-u thao kinu sanga jolji ahi.
en: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
text:
PRO 5:3
Thadou: Numei jong ho lei-chu khoiju lhumma lhum ding, athusei chan-u thao kinu sanga jolji ahi.
English: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

tcz: Hinlah achaina chu guu-banga kha jia, chule hemto chemjam banga hemji ahi.
en: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
text:
PRO 5:4
Thadou: Hinlah achaina chu guu-banga kha jia, chule hemto chemjam banga hemji ahi.
English: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

tcz: Akeng tenin thina'a apui lutjia, noimi gam chan'a chelut ding ahi.
en: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
text:
PRO 5:5
Thadou: Akeng tenin thina'a apui lutjia, noimi gam chan'a chelut ding ahi.
English: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

tcz: Hitobang numei hin hinna lampi anahsah jipon, achena tincheng anoh phah jin, amanun-la akihet doh jipon ahi.
en: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
text:
PRO 5:6
Thadou: Hitobang numei hin hinna lampi anahsah jipon, achena tincheng anoh phah jin, amanun-la akihet doh jipon ahi.
English: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

tcz: Hijeh chun tun kachapa teho kasei ngaijun, kahilna thuchang hoakon hin jammang ding go hih beh un.
en: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
text:
PRO 5:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun tun kachapa teho kasei ngaijun, kahilna thuchang hoakon hin jammang ding go hih beh un.
English: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

tcz: Hiche numeinua kon khun kidalseu vin, akotpi phung lam'a jong chenai ding go hih beh un.
en: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
text:
PRO 5:8
Thadou: Hiche numeinua kon khun kidalseu vin, akotpi phung lam'a jong chenai ding go hih beh un.
English: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

tcz: Hitia chu nabol lou ule, mihoa kon jabolna nachan lou ding, nahin kho sunga min nakhoto thei lou ding ahi.
en: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;

tcz: Hetkhah lou mihon nahatna le nahaona aboncha a-luo diu, natohga jouse jong michom beh in a-luo ding ahi.
en: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
text:
PRO 5:10
Thadou: Hetkhah lou mihon nahatna le nahaona aboncha a-luo diu, natohga jouse jong michom beh in a-luo ding ahi.
English: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

tcz: Na hinkho ajona lam teng gim hesoh nato ding, natahsa pumpi manthahna aso diu ahi.
en: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
text:
PRO 5:11
Thadou: Na hinkho ajona lam teng gim hesoh nato ding, natahsa pumpi manthahna aso diu ahi.
English: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

tcz: Chuteng nangin seijin natin, “Kigah chahna hi ichan-a kana thet a, phosalna hi iti kana thet hitam?
en: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.
text:
PRO 5:12
Thadou: Chuteng nangin seijin natin, “Kigah chahna hi ichan-a kana thet a, phosalna hi iti kana thet hitam?
English: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.

tcz: Keiman eihil ho thu kana donse pon, ka dinga thusei ho jeng jong kana donse tapoi.
en: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
text:
PRO 5:13
Thadou: Keiman eihil ho thu kana donse pon, ka dinga thusei ho jeng jong kana donse tapoi.
English: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

tcz: Tuhin mipi kikhopna'a kon keima mah thahna mun kalhun kon ahitai, tia nasei ding ahi.”
en: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”
text:
PRO 5:14
Thadou: Tuhin mipi kikhopna'a kon keima mah thahna mun kalhun kon ahitai, tia nasei ding ahi.”
English: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”

tcz: Nangma twikhuh'a kon hung potdoh twi chu kidon jeng tan.
en: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.
text:
PRO 5:15
Thadou: Nangma twikhuh'a kon hung potdoh twi chu kidon jeng tan.
English: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.

tcz: Na twikhuh dunga twi put chu muntin'a hetdoh-a um'a chule kholai tinchanga um mong ding hinam?
en: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?
text:
PRO 5:16
Thadou: Na twikhuh dunga twi put chu muntin'a hetdoh-a um'a chule kholai tinchanga um mong ding hinam?
English: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?

tcz: Hichu nanga ding bouvin koiyin, nakom'a hung maljin vang nachan sah lou ding ahi.
en: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.
text:
PRO 5:17
Thadou: Hichu nanga ding bouvin koiyin, nakom'a hung maljin vang nachan sah lou ding ahi.
English: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

tcz: Na twikhuh chu phatthei chang tahen, nangma tah jong nasenji chunga kipah tan.
en: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
text:
PRO 5:18
Thadou: Na twikhuh chu phatthei chang tahen, nangma tah jong nasenji chunga kipah tan.
English: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

tcz: Na deitah na jinu sajuh golpai hoitah le sajuh chal hoitah bang in, phat tin in aman nahebolna nachunga lhung jing hen, amanu anglum jal'a kipah jing nahin, aman natuh chah jing hi nalungset phot chetna ahi.
en: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
text:
PRO 5:19
Thadou: Na deitah na jinu sajuh golpai hoitah le sajuh chal hoitah bang in, phat tin in aman nahebolna nachunga lhung jing hen, amanu anglum jal'a kipah jing nahin, aman natuh chah jing hi nalungset phot chetna ahi.
English: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

tcz: Kachapa, i-atileh numei chon chavei chu naki ngaipi jing a, hitobang numei kampao phalou chu a-anglum'a um ding nagot jing ham?
en: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
text:
PRO 5:20
Thadou: Kachapa, i-atileh numei chon chavei chu naki ngaipi jing a, hitobang numei kampao phalou chu a-anglum'a um ding nagot jing ham?
English: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi mihem lam lhah jouse ve-jing ahin, alam lhah na jouse avet-jing ahi.
en: For the ways of man are before the LORD’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
text:
PRO 5:21
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi mihem lam lhah jouse ve-jing ahin, alam lhah na jouse avet-jing ahi.
English: For the ways of man are before the LORD’s eyes. He examines all his paths.

tcz: Miphalou chu a chondih lounan akipalsah teijin, a chonsetna chun atuh chahji ahitai.
en: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
text:
PRO 5:22
Thadou: Miphalou chu a chondih lounan akipalsah teijin, a chonsetna chun atuh chahji ahitai.
English: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

tcz: Ama chu kigah chana beija thina chang ding, a ngol-ga chun manthahna asoji ahi.
en: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
text:
PRO 5:23
Thadou: Ama chu kigah chana beija thina chang ding, a ngol-ga chun manthahna asoji ahi.
English: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.

tcz: Kachapa, naheng nakom dinga batsahna dinga kitung nahim, hetkhah lou mikhat tou batsahna dinga naum khah a,
en: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
text:
PRO 6:1
Thadou: Kachapa, naheng nakom dinga batsahna dinga kitung nahim, hetkhah lou mikhat tou batsahna dinga naum khah a,
English: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

tcz: Nangma thuseija kon kipalna naneija, nakama kon'a phondohsa thu chun nakipalsah khah leh,
en: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
text:
PRO 6:2
Thadou: Nangma thuseija kon kipalna naneija, nakama kon'a phondohsa thu chun nakipalsah khah leh,
English: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

tcz: Kachapa, ka thuhil hi ngaijin lang bol ding gon, ajeh chu naheng nakom'in na chunga thu anei tah jeh in, chen lang naheng nakompa ang-sunga taovin.
en: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.
text:
PRO 6:3
Thadou: Kachapa, ka thuhil hi ngaijin lang bol ding gon, ajeh chu naheng nakom'in na chunga thu anei tah jeh in, chen lang naheng nakompa ang-sunga taovin.
English: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

tcz: Jan choldo louvin, namit teni jeng jong sing-hih in, namit geija keh mitmul ho jong kichol da hen.
en: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
text:
PRO 6:4
Thadou: Jan choldo louvin, namit teni jeng jong sing-hih in, namit geija keh mitmul ho jong kichol da hen.
English: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

tcz: Sadelpa masanga sakhigol ajammang bang in, nangma tah kihuh hing ding gotan, vacha thangkol-a kitoldoh bang in nangma tah kihuh hing loijin.
en: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
text:
PRO 6:5
Thadou: Sadelpa masanga sakhigol ajammang bang in, nangma tah kihuh hing ding gotan, vacha thangkol-a kitoldoh bang in nangma tah kihuh hing loijin.
English: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

tcz: Vo mi thase ho, cheuvin sihmi khu gave tim un, aum chan u-khun kihil un lang chingdoh tauvin.
en: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

tcz: Amahon natonga agoi diu lengle gamvaipo, vaihom aneilou vang un,
en: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
text:
PRO 6:7
Thadou: Amahon natonga agoi diu lengle gamvaipo, vaihom aneilou vang un,
English: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

tcz: Amahon nipi laija neh ding aki-khol khom un, khokhal teng nehding aki-khol khom theijun ahi.
en: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
text:
PRO 6:8
Thadou: Amahon nipi laija neh ding aki-khol khom un, khokhal teng nehding aki-khol khom theijun ahi.
English: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

tcz: Hinlah vo mithase hiche mun'a hi itih chan na-imut ding hitam? Nalup mun'a kon itih phat'a thoding nagot hitam?
en: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
text:
PRO 6:9
Thadou: Hinlah vo mithase hiche mun'a hi itih chan na-imut ding hitam? Nalup mun'a kon itih phat'a thoding nagot hitam?
English: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

tcz: Na i-mut a, namoh kijam jeng a, nakhut chalo-sah louva namoh um jenga ahileh,
en: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—
text:
PRO 6:10
Thadou: Na i-mut a, namoh kijam jeng a, nakhut chalo-sah louva namoh um jenga ahileh,
English: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—

tcz: Chule vaichat na chun gucha banga na hin lhunkhum ding, lhinlel na chun gal manchah choipa banga nahin lhunkhum ding ahi.
en: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
text:
PRO 6:11
Thadou: Chule vaichat na chun gucha banga na hin lhunkhum ding, lhinlel na chun gal manchah choipa banga nahin lhunkhum ding ahi.
English: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

tcz: Mi pannabei le mikitah lou chu thudihlou sei phong in ache leuvin ahi.
en: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
text:
PRO 6:12
Thadou: Mi pannabei le mikitah lou chu thudihlou sei phong in ache leuvin ahi.
English: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

tcz: Ajon chihnau amit lhap uva akilang jin, akhut jung uvin hichu akoh jiuvin ahi.
en: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,
text:
PRO 6:13
Thadou: Ajon chihnau amit lhap uva akilang jin, akhut jung uvin hichu akoh jiuvin ahi.
English: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

tcz: Alungthim phatlou nauvin thilse agong un, tantih neilouvin kitomana ding jeng abol jiuvin ahi.
en: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
text:
PRO 6:14
Thadou: Alungthim phatlou nauvin thilse agong un, tantih neilouvin kitomana ding jeng abol jiuvin ahi.
English: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

tcz: Hiche ho jeh chun, amaho chunga gangtah in manthahna achujin, damdoh vah thei loua um diu ahi.
en: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
text:
PRO 6:15
Thadou: Hiche ho jeh chun, amaho chunga gangtah in manthahna achujin, damdoh vah thei loua um diu ahi.
English: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in athet tah thil gup aum in, Ama ding in thil sagima adei lou aum in ahi.
en: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
text:
PRO 6:16
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in athet tah thil gup aum in, Ama ding in thil sagima adei lou aum in ahi.
English: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

tcz: Kiletsah mitvet, jou seina leigui, mona beija thisansoa panla khut teni,
en: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
text:
PRO 6:17
Thadou: Kiletsah mitvet, jou seina leigui, mona beija thisansoa panla khut teni,
English: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

tcz: Thilse gonna lungthim, thilse bol dinga lhai keng teni,
en: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
text:
PRO 6:18
Thadou: Thilse gonna lungthim, thilse bol dinga lhai keng teni,
English: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

tcz: Thujouseina-a jou sakhia pang, chule asopi lah-a kitomona muchi thea pangpa ahi.
en: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
text:
PRO 6:19
Thadou: Thujouseina-a jou sakhia pang, chule asopi lah-a kitomona muchi thea pangpa ahi.
English: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

tcz: Kachapa, napa thupeh hohi jui jing in, chule nanun nahilna jong don louvin koi hih in.
en: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
text:
PRO 6:20
Thadou: Kachapa, napa thupeh hohi jui jing in, chule nanun nahilna jong don louvin koi hih in.
English: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

tcz: Hichu nalung sunga chingtup jing in, na ngonga khivui on ki-o jing in.
en: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
text:
PRO 6:21
Thadou: Hichu nalung sunga chingtup jing in, na ngonga khivui on ki-o jing in.
English: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

tcz: Hiche hochun nakal sonna jousea napui hoi ding, na-imut teng jongleh nachin tup diu, nahung khahdoh teng jongleh nahil'a pang kit ding ahi.
en: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
text:
PRO 6:22
Thadou: Hiche hochun nakal sonna jousea napui hoi ding, na-imut teng jongleh nachin tup diu, nahung khahdoh teng jongleh nahil'a pang kit ding ahi.
English: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

tcz: Ajeh chu thupeh chengse hi thaomeia pang ahin, kihilna jeng jong thaomei vah tobang, chule kiphosalna le kigah chahna jouse jong hinna lampia pang ahibouve.
en: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
text:
PRO 6:23
Thadou: Ajeh chu thupeh chengse hi thaomeia pang ahin, kihilna jeng jong thaomei vah tobang, chule kiphosalna le kigah chahna jouse jong hinna lampia pang ahibouve.
English: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

tcz: Hichun numei phalouva kon navenbit ding, akam them jehju numeia kon chu nahoidoh thei ding ahi.
en: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
text:
PRO 6:24
Thadou: Hichun numei phalouva kon navenbit ding, akam them jehju numeia kon chu nahoidoh thei ding ahi.
English: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

tcz: Melhoinu khu nalung in deicha hih beh in, amit vetdan akon in jong kilhep lhahsah hih hel in.
en: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
text:
PRO 6:25
Thadou: Melhoinu khu nalung in deicha hih beh in, amit vetdan akon in jong kilhep lhahsah hih hel in.
English: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

tcz: Ajeh chu numei kijohnu chu changlhah khat jengseh a jong muthei ahin, hitobang numei pasaltoh jongji chun pasal hinkho chu manthahna asoji ahitai.
en: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
text:
PRO 6:26
Thadou: Ajeh chu numei kijohnu chu changlhah khat jengseh a jong muthei ahin, hitobang numei pasaltoh jongji chun pasal hinkho chu manthahna asoji ahitai.
English: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

tcz: Mihem khat chun adip-a mei-al apoh theijem? Chule aponsil jeng jong kavam louva akoi thei lou ahi.
en: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
text:
PRO 6:27
Thadou: Mihem khat chun adip-a mei-al apoh theijem? Chule aponsil jeng jong kavam louva akoi thei lou ahi.
English: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

tcz: Mihem khat chu mei-al chunga vahle theijem? Akengto phang teni jong kalouva akoi thei lou ahi.
en: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
text:
PRO 6:28
Thadou: Mihem khat chu mei-al chunga vahle theijem? Akengto phang teni jong kalouva akoi thei lou ahi.
English: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

tcz: Aheng akompa jinu jonpi jong hiche tobang bep chu hiding, aheng akompa jinu lup khompi tapou chu Dan in amat tei ding ahi.
en: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
text:
PRO 6:29
Thadou: Aheng akompa jinu jonpi jong hiche tobang bep chu hiding, aheng akompa jinu lup khompi tapou chu Dan in amat tei ding ahi.
English: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

tcz: Gilkel khat chun neh ding deija thil aguh tah-a ahileh, hichepa chu mihemte muda chang cheh ahi.
en: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,
text:
PRO 6:30
Thadou: Gilkel khat chun neh ding deija thil aguh tah-a ahileh, hichepa chu mihemte muda chang cheh ahi.
English: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

tcz: Hinlah gucha chu akimat khah tahleh, aguhdoh jat chu jat sagi jen'a ale ding, anei le agou jouse aguchat jeh'a asahna'a anei ding ahitai
en: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
text:
PRO 6:31
Thadou: Hinlah gucha chu akimat khah tahleh, aguhdoh jat chu jat sagi jen'a ale ding, anei le agou jouse aguchat jeh'a asahna'a anei ding ahitai
English: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

tcz: Chule mitoh jon thanhoi bolpa chu lungthim neilou ahin, thildihlou abolna chun manthahna alhun den ding ahi.
en: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
text:
PRO 6:32
Thadou: Chule mitoh jon thanhoi bolpa chu lungthim neilou ahin, thildihlou abolna chun manthahna alhun den ding ahi.
English: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

tcz: Amapa chun jumna maha aput ding, min amuda na jong beitih um lou ding ahi.
en: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
text:
PRO 6:33
Thadou: Amapa chun jumna maha aput ding, min amuda na jong beitih um lou ding ahi.
English: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

tcz: Ajeh chu thangset kiti hin mihem alung sousah jin, datkhen um louva phulahna aneiji ahi.
en: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
text:
PRO 6:34
Thadou: Ajeh chu thangset kiti hin mihem alung sousah jin, datkhen um louva phulahna aneiji ahi.
English: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

tcz: Amapa chun leona man akilah nom lou ding, thil ijat pebe jong lechun asan thei lou ding ahi.
en: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
text:
PRO 6:35
Thadou: Amapa chun leona man akilah nom lou ding, thil ijat pebe jong lechun asan thei lou ding ahi.
English: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

tcz: Kachapa, kathumop hi juijin, kathupeh chengse jong gou chin in ching jing-in.
en: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
text:
PRO 7:1
Thadou: Kachapa, kathumop hi juijin, kathupeh chengse jong gou chin in ching jing-in.
English: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

tcz: Kathupeh chengse hinna nanei thei nadin nit jing in, kathuhil chengse namit chang naki chintup bang in chingtup in.
en: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
text:
PRO 7:2
Thadou: Kathupeh chengse hinna nanei thei nadin nit jing in, kathuhil chengse namit chang naki chintup bang in chingtup in.
English: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

tcz: Hichengse chu nasuhmil lou nadin khutjem bun kibun lang, nalungthim gil sunga lekhajem bang in kijih lut in.
en: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
text:
PRO 7:3
Thadou: Hichengse chu nasuhmil lou nadin khutjem bun kibun lang, nalungthim gil sunga lekhajem bang in kijih lut in.
English: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

tcz: Chihna hi naso pinu bang in ngailun, chule nagol ngaitah banga nakisem ding ahi.
en: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
text:
PRO 7:4
Thadou: Chihna hi naso pinu bang in ngailun, chule nagol ngaitah banga nakisem ding ahi.
English: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

tcz: Hichun numei jong hoa kon navendoh ding, pasal toh jonthanhoi bol numeia kon chu nahoidoh ding ahi.
en: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
text:
PRO 7:5
Thadou: Hichun numei jong hoa kon navendoh ding, pasal toh jonthanhoi bol numeia kon chu nahoidoh ding ahi.
English: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

tcz: Kain bang-kot akon kagal vet'a, polam kavet a hileh,
en: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.
text:
PRO 7:6
Thadou: Kain bang-kot akon kagal vet'a, polam kavet a hileh,
English: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

tcz: Japi lah'a jong kamun, gollhang ho kititna mun'a jong kamun, lungthim bei gollhang khat aum in ahi.
en: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,
text:
PRO 7:7
Thadou: Japi lah'a jong kamun, gollhang ho kititna mun'a jong kamun, lungthim bei gollhang khat aum in ahi.
English: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

tcz: Amapa chu, numei jong-nu inlam achun avah lejin, hiche numeinu in-jotna lam chu ajon jitai.
en: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,
text:
PRO 7:8
Thadou: Amapa chu, numei jong-nu inlam achun avah lejin, hiche numeinu in-jotna lam chu ajon jitai.
English: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

tcz: Jingkah khovah then then in jong, nilhah lam in jong, jan muthim lah'a jong, hiche lam'a chun ache jitan ahi.
en: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.
text:
PRO 7:9
Thadou: Jingkah khovah then then in jong, nilhah lam in jong, jan muthim lah'a jong, hiche lam'a chun ache jitan ahi.
English: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

tcz: Chuin numei khat in amudoh tan, amanu chu noti-von a kivon, a-lua pon akikhuh in ahi.
en: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
text:
PRO 7:10
Thadou: Chuin numei khat in amudoh tan, amanu chu noti-von a kivon, a-lua pon akikhuh in ahi.
English: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

tcz: Hiche nuchu thunung lou khop in, jum le ja jong helouvin, in-a um thim thei louva keng javelvul a um ahi.
en: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.
text:
PRO 7:11
Thadou: Hiche nuchu thunung lou khop in, jum le ja jong helouvin, in-a um thim thei louva keng javelvul a um ahi.
English: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

tcz: Kholaija um'a igel laijin, kailhanga akimun, munthip ningkoi lah jenga mi achang lhih jin ahi.
en: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
text:
PRO 7:12
Thadou: Kholaija um'a igel laijin, kailhanga akimun, munthip ningkoi lah jenga mi achang lhih jin ahi.
English: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

tcz: Gollhangpa chu amu teng angong koi pai ji-in, achop jitan, jum lou tah'in gollhangpa henga chun aseijin
en: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
text:
PRO 7:13
Thadou: Gollhangpa chu amu teng angong koi pai ji-in, achop jitan, jum lou tah'in gollhangpa henga chun aseijin
English: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

tcz: “Keiman chamna maicham sem ding tampi kaneijin, tuni hin kakitepna jouse pe tange,
en: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.
text:
PRO 7:14
Thadou: “Keiman chamna maicham sem ding tampi kaneijin, tuni hin kakitepna jouse pe tange,
English: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma velhih-a hung potdoh kahin, lunglhai sel'a nangma hol'a kahung chu, hikom-a kamutai.
en: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.
text:
PRO 7:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangma velhih-a hung potdoh kahin, lunglhai sel'a nangma hol'a kahung chu, hikom-a kamutai.
English: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

tcz: Kajalkhun jong Egypt gam'a ponnem jemhoi tah'a kapha jolsel ahi.
en: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
text:
PRO 7:16
Thadou: Kajalkhun jong Egypt gam'a ponnem jemhoi tah'a kapha jolsel ahi.
English: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

tcz: Kajalkhun chunga myrrh namtui kathe in, aloes namtui le thingthal namtui tah kahin the ahi.
en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
text:
PRO 7:17
Thadou: Kajalkhun chunga myrrh namtui kathe in, aloes namtui le thingthal namtui tah kahin the ahi.
English: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

tcz: Hungin, jankhovah geijin lungna chimtah in kinou ta hitin, kilungset hitin, jankhovah in kideito hite.
en: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
text:
PRO 7:18
Thadou: Hungin, jankhovah geijin lungna chimtah in kinou ta hitin, kilungset hitin, jankhovah in kideito hite.
English: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

tcz: Ajeh chu kajipa inn-a aumpon, kholjin in mun gamla tah'a achen ahi.
en: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
text:
PRO 7:19
Thadou: Ajeh chu kajipa inn-a aumpon, kholjin in mun gamla tah'a achen ahi.
English: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

tcz: Asum bom a sum dimset'in akipoh in, lha kichai lam teng hung kile din achetai.”
en: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”
text:
PRO 7:20
Thadou: Asum bom a sum dimset'in akipoh in, lha kichai lam teng hung kile din achetai.”
English: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

tcz: Hitichun numeinun thungai tah tah aseijin ajol tan, ajonan athunun in, kamnal hiu hiu cha akihoupi tahjeh in gollhangpa jong anom tan ahi.
en: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
text:
PRO 7:21
Thadou: Hitichun numeinun thungai tah tah aseijin ajol tan, ajonan athunun in, kamnal hiu hiu cha akihoupi tahjeh in gollhangpa jong anom tan ahi.
English: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

tcz: Alungthou jah'in hichenu chu ajui tan, Bongchal in aki tha nading mun ajot bang le thang a-ohsa sakhi bang in numeinu nung chu ajuitai.
en: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
text:
PRO 7:22
Thadou: Alungthou jah'in hichenu chu ajui tan, Bongchal in aki tha nading mun ajot bang le thang a-ohsa sakhi bang in numeinu nung chu ajuitai.
English: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

tcz: Sakhi golpai thalpin alungchang athil pai bang leh, vacha banga ahinkho beina ding akihet phah tapon ahi.
en: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
text:
PRO 7:23
Thadou: Sakhi golpai thalpin alungchang athil pai bang leh, vacha banga ahinkho beina ding akihet phah tapon ahi.
English: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

tcz: Hijeh chun ka chapate ho kathusei hohi lunglut tah in ngaijun, chule kakam sunga kon thu kisei hohi ngai phauvin.
en: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
text:
PRO 7:24
Thadou: Hijeh chun ka chapate ho kathusei hohi lunglut tah in ngaijun, chule kakam sunga kon thu kisei hohi ngai phauvin.
English: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

tcz: Hiche numeinu lam akhun nalungthim lamvai sah hih in, amanu lam lhahna tinchanga jong nache lou hel ding ahi.
en: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
text:
PRO 7:25
Thadou: Hiche numeinu lam akhun nalungthim lamvai sah hih in, amanu lam lhahna tinchanga jong nache lou hel ding ahi.
English: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

tcz: Ajeh chu amanu hin pasal tampi manthahna aso-ahitan, sepai thahat lai jong asuhgam ahitai.
en: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
text:
PRO 7:26
Thadou: Ajeh chu amanu hin pasal tampi manthahna aso-ahitan, sepai thahat lai jong asuhgam ahitai.
English: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

tcz: Amanu in jotna lampi hi noimi gam lampi ahin, thina lhankhuh sunga kilhung lut lampi ahi.
en: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
text:
PRO 7:27
Thadou: Amanu in jotna lampi hi noimi gam lampi ahin, thina lhankhuh sunga kilhung lut lampi ahi.
English: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

tcz: Chihnan kho ahin sap teng jatei ding gon, chule thil hetkhen nan lhang asap teng ngaijin.
en: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
text:
PRO 8:1
Thadou: Chihnan kho ahin sap teng jatei ding gon, chule thil hetkhen nan lhang asap teng ngaijin.
English: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

tcz: Lampi pam le lhangvum dung a, chihna chu ading le'in ahi.
en: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
text:
PRO 8:2
Thadou: Lampi pam le lhangvum dung a, chihna chu ading le'in ahi.
English: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

tcz: Khopi lutna kelkot phung dung a, kholen tinchang maija, chule kotjum lutna thei jousea lhang asam in ahi.
en: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:
text:
PRO 8:3
Thadou: Khopi lutna kelkot phung dung a, kholen tinchang maija, chule kotjum lutna thei jousea lhang asam in ahi.
English: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

tcz: “Mijouse jah-a kakou ahin, mihem chapa jouse kakou ahi.
en: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
text:
PRO 8:4
Thadou: “Mijouse jah-a kakou ahin, mihem chapa jouse kakou ahi.
English: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

tcz: Milham ho nahiu vin, lunggel them hina din kihil un, mingol ho jeng in jong lunglut in ngaijun.
en: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
text:
PRO 8:5
Thadou: Milham ho nahiu vin, lunggel them hina din kihil un, mingol ho jeng in jong lunglut in ngaijun.
English: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!

tcz: Ngaitem un, keiman thil phachom tah nahil uvinge, kakam sunga kon thudih jengbou pot ding ahi.
en: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
text:
PRO 8:6
Thadou: Ngaitem un, keiman thil phachom tah nahil uvinge, kakam sunga kon thudih jengbou pot ding ahi.
English: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

tcz: Ajeh chu kakam in thudih bou aseiji ding, adihlou sei kiti hi kakam in ajahda ahi.
en: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
text:
PRO 8:7
Thadou: Ajeh chu kakam in thudih bou aseiji ding, adihlou sei kiti hi kakam in ajahda ahi.
English: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

tcz: Kakam akon thu kisei jouse adih ahin, akikal le ache khel ding ima um lou ahi.
en: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
text:
PRO 8:8
Thadou: Kakam akon thu kisei jouse adih ahin, akikal le ache khel ding ima um lou ahi.
English: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

tcz: Kathu hil hekhen theipa chun adih akisan ding, hetthemna neipa dinga chu adih bou ahi.
en: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
text:
PRO 8:9
Thadou: Kathu hil hekhen theipa chun adih akisan ding, hetthemna neipa dinga chu adih bou ahi.
English: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

tcz: Sumlepai sang in kathu hil kilhen un, Sana thengsel sanga jong hetna naki lhen joh diu ahi.
en: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
text:
PRO 8:10
Thadou: Sumlepai sang in kathu hil kilhen un, Sana thengsel sanga jong hetna naki lhen joh diu ahi.
English: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

tcz: Ajeh chu sana kijem pah sanga chihna hi thupi ahin, na lungdei chan toh kitekah thei ahipoi.
en: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
text:
PRO 8:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu sana kijem pah sanga chihna hi thupi ahin, na lungdei chan toh kitekah thei ahipoi.
English: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

tcz: Chihna hi keima kahin chingthei tah'a um kahi, hetna le thil hetkhen themna nei kahi.
en: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
text:
PRO 8:12
Thadou: Chihna hi keima kahin chingthei tah'a um kahi, hetna le thil hetkhen themna nei kahi.
English: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ginna chun thilse ahotbol in, hijeh chun keiman kiletsahna le hoithona, thil aphalou, ahilou louva thu kisei chan chu kathet ahi.
en: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
text:
PRO 8:13
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ginna chun thilse ahotbol in, hijeh chun keiman kiletsahna le hoithona, thil aphalou, ahilou louva thu kisei chan chu kathet ahi.
English: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

tcz: Keima'a kon hin, chihna giltah le phachom tah'a kihilna aum in, asung thua hetna le thahat chu keija bou um ahi.
en: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
text:
PRO 8:14
Thadou: Keima'a kon hin, chihna giltah le phachom tah'a kihilna aum in, asung thua hetna le thahat chu keija bou um ahi.
English: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

tcz: Keijal'a lenghon vai-apoh ahin, keijal'a bou vaihom ten adih'a thu tanna anei ahi.
en: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
text:
PRO 8:15
Thadou: Keijal'a lenghon vai-apoh ahin, keijal'a bou vaihom ten adih'a thu tanna anei ahi.
English: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

tcz: Keijal'a alen alal ten vai ahop jiu, chule keijal'a bou alal ten vai apoh theiyu ahi.
en: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
text:
PRO 8:16
Thadou: Keijal'a alen alal ten vai ahop jiu, chule keijal'a bou alal ten vai apoh theiyu ahi.
English: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

tcz: Keima eingailu ho kangailun, giltah'a eihol ten eimu tei jiuvin ahi.
en: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
text:
PRO 8:17
Thadou: Keima eingailu ho kangailun, giltah'a eihol ten eimu tei jiuvin ahi.
English: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

tcz: Keima haona le jabolna jousen eijui in, phattheina le haona chun eidalha jipoi.
en: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
text:
PRO 8:18
Thadou: Keima haona le jabolna jousen eijui in, phattheina le haona chun eidalha jipoi.
English: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

tcz: Ka thilpeh hohi sana sanga phachom ahin, sana thengsel sanga jong hoijoa, chule kanatoh jong sum le pai sanga phajo ahi.
en: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.
text:
PRO 8:19
Thadou: Ka thilpeh hohi sana sanga phachom ahin, sana thengsel sanga jong hoijoa, chule kanatoh jong sum le pai sanga phajo ahi.
English: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

tcz: Keima thudih tah'a lamlha jing kahin, thutanna adih lam jeng chu kaho-ji ahi.
en: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
text:
PRO 8:20
Thadou: Keima thudih tah'a lamlha jing kahin, thutanna adih lam jeng chu kaho-ji ahi.
English: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

tcz: Keima eingailu hon gou alo diu kasem peh in, agou kholnau jouse kasuh dimpeh-jin ahi.
en: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
text:
PRO 8:21
Thadou: Keima eingailu hon gou alo diu kasem peh in, agou kholnau jouse kasuh dimpeh-jin ahi.
English: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in atil abulla athilsem apat ei-umsah ahin, khanglui apat athilsem masapen kahitai.
en: “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
text:
PRO 8:22
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in atil abulla athilsem apat ei-umsah ahin, khanglui apat athilsem masapen kahitai.
English: “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

tcz: Atil-a leiset kisem masang, kum asang sang masanga pat keima tundohsa chu kahi tai.
en: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
text:
PRO 8:23
Thadou: Atil-a leiset kisem masang, kum asang sang masanga pat keima tundohsa chu kahi tai.
English: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

tcz: Kapen chun anem, atong lai jong ana um pon, twi putna jouse jong khatcha ana um poi.
en: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.
text:
PRO 8:24
Thadou: Kapen chun anem, atong lai jong ana um pon, twi putna jouse jong khatcha ana um poi.
English: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

tcz: Mol le lhang kigol toh masang, chule thinglhang jouse kisemtoh masanga pat ana um kahitai.
en: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

tcz: Elohim Pathen in leiset le tollhang asem masang, vannoija leigum kisemdoh masanga pat um kahi.
en: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
text:
PRO 8:26
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in leiset le tollhang asem masang, vannoija leigum kisemdoh masanga pat um kahi.
English: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in vanho atundoh masanga um kahin, twikhanglen kuol khum vanthamjol alhundoh masanga jong um kahitai.
en: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,
text:
PRO 8:27
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in vanho atundoh masanga um kahin, twikhanglen kuol khum vanthamjol alhundoh masanga jong um kahitai.
English: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

tcz: Elohim Pathen in chunglam'a vanthamjol ho atundoh ahin, leinoija pat twi aput dohsah masanga jong um kahin,
en: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
text:
PRO 8:28
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in chunglam'a vanthamjol ho atundoh ahin, leinoija pat twi aput dohsah masanga jong um kahin,
English: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

tcz: Twikhanglen geilah jong alet lhahna lou dinga asem toh, twipi jeng in jong athu angaina dinga asem toh, leiset khompi jouse jong atundoh masanga pat um kahi.
en: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
text:
PRO 8:29
Thadou: Twikhanglen geilah jong alet lhahna lou dinga asem toh, twipi jeng in jong athu angaina dinga asem toh, leiset khompi jouse jong atundoh masanga pat um kahi.
English: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

tcz: Keima tah jong akom-cha'a khut them bang um kahin, nitin le phat tin in akom-a kapansan kipatah in kaum jing in ahi.
en: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,
text:
PRO 8:30
Thadou: Keima tah jong akom-cha'a khut them bang um kahin, nitin le phat tin in akom-a kapansan kipatah in kaum jing in ahi.
English: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

tcz: Elohim Pathen in mihemte chenna dia leiset atundoh ahin, keima jong kipah tah-in kaum in, mihemte lah'a thanopnan kadim e.
en: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.
text:
PRO 8:31
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in mihemte chenna dia leiset atundoh ahin, keima jong kipah tah-in kaum in, mihemte lah'a thanopnan kadim e.
English: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

tcz: Hijeh chun kachate ho kasei ngaijun, kathu ngaija ka lampia che jing ho kipah ding'u ahi.
en: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
text:
PRO 8:32
Thadou: Hijeh chun kachate ho kasei ngaijun, kathu ngaija ka lampia che jing ho kipah ding'u ahi.
English: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

tcz: Kathuhil ho ngaijun lang ching theijun, kahilchah-nau hi tuh chah jing un.
en: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
text:
PRO 8:33
Thadou: Kathuhil ho ngaijun lang ching theijun, kahilchah-nau hi tuh chah jing un.
English: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

tcz: Ka thusei ngaija mihem chu anunnom hi ding, amachun nitin'a kakot phunga anga jing ding, ka kotpi phunga tatlouvin ading in ahi
en: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
text:
PRO 8:34
Thadou: Ka thusei ngaija mihem chu anunnom hi ding, amachun nitin'a kakot phunga anga jing ding, ka kotpi phunga tatlouvin ading in ahi
English: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima eimudoh chan chun hinna akimu tan, chule Yahweh Pakaija kon in hepina achang'un ahi.
en: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.
text:
PRO 8:35
Thadou: Ajeh chu keima eimudoh chan chun hinna akimu tan, chule Yahweh Pakaija kon in hepina achang'un ahi.
English: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.

tcz: Amavang keima eidonlou chan chun, ama le aman gimna akimu jin, keima ei hot chan chun, thina jeng angai chat ahibouve.”
en: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
text:
PRO 8:36
Thadou: Amavang keima eidonlou chan chun, ama le aman gimna akimu jin, keima ei hot chan chun, thina jeng angai chat ahibouve.”
English: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”

tcz: Chihna kiti hin a-in akisahdoh in, khompi sagi jen atungdoh tan ahi.
en: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
text:
PRO 9:1
Thadou: Chihna kiti hin a-in akisahdoh in, khompi sagi jen atungdoh tan ahi.
English: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

tcz: Chihna kiti hin, neh le chah ding gancha phabep akitha jin, lengpi twi jong lhumkeijin ahel-in, chule chihna kiti hin an-nehna ding dokhang jeng jong atungdoh tan ahi.
en: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
text:
PRO 9:2
Thadou: Chihna kiti hin, neh le chah ding gancha phabep akitha jin, lengpi twi jong lhumkeijin ahel-in, chule chihna kiti hin an-nehna ding dokhang jeng jong atungdoh tan ahi.
English: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

tcz: Munsang laija kon'in khopi sung mihoa kon chun, mikou din asohte asol in ahi.
en: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
text:
PRO 9:3
Thadou: Munsang laija kon'in khopi sung mihoa kon chun, mikou din asohte asol in ahi.
English: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

tcz: Koi hileh milham a um jouse, “Kakom'a hung hen,” tin akousah in ahi. Chule koi hileh alungthim bei tapou chu, kou-un, ati.
en: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
text:
PRO 9:4
Thadou: Koi hileh milham a um jouse, “Kakom'a hung hen,” tin akousah in ahi. Chule koi hileh alungthim bei tapou chu, kou-un, ati.
English: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

tcz: “Hung un, kaneh ding khel in neuvin, kadon ding khel in lengpitwi don un.
en: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
text:
PRO 9:5
Thadou: “Hung un, kaneh ding khel in neuvin, kadon ding khel in lengpitwi don un.
English: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

tcz: Milham in um hih un, giltah in hetkhenna neijin hinkho mang un,” ati.
en: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
text:
PRO 9:6
Thadou: Milham in um hih un, giltah in hetkhenna neijin hinkho mang un,” ati.
English: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

tcz: Mi munem'a noisea, adih bolsah teiding gopan jong kisuh khahna aneilo-bep ahi.
en: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
text:
PRO 9:7
Thadou: Mi munem'a noisea, adih bolsah teiding gopan jong kisuh khahna aneilo-bep ahi.
English: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

tcz: Hijeh chun mi munem pum-a adih bolsah teiding go-hih in, ajeh chu nahin mudalo thei ahi. Hinlah miching chu hil lechun nangailua pang jo-ding ahi.
en: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
text:
PRO 9:8
Thadou: Hijeh chun mi munem pum-a adih bolsah teiding go-hih in, ajeh chu nahin mudalo thei ahi. Hinlah miching chu hil lechun nangailua pang jo-ding ahi.
English: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

tcz: Miching chu nahil chan'a ching cheh cheh ding, hibang chun mikitah jong nahil chan'a ching cheh ding ahi.
en: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
text:
PRO 9:9
Thadou: Miching chu nahil chan'a ching cheh cheh ding, hibang chun mikitah jong nahil chan'a ching cheh ding ahi.
English: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai ginna hi chihna bulpi ahin, mithengpa hetna nei chan chun giltah'a thu ahetdoh ahi.
en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
text:
PRO 9:10
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai ginna hi chihna bulpi ahin, mithengpa hetna nei chan chun giltah'a thu ahetdoh ahi.
English: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima jal'a na hinkho sao chom ding, na hinkho sunga nakum jong kibe tei ding ahi.
en: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
text:
PRO 9:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu keima jal'a na hinkho sao chom ding, na hinkho sunga nakum jong kibe tei ding ahi.
English: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

tcz: Na chihna chu nangma goh-keuseh ding ahin, midang noisena nanei le mona chu na changseh a nakipoh ding ahi.
en: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
text:
PRO 9:12
Thadou: Na chihna chu nangma goh-keuseh ding ahin, midang noisena nanei le mona chu na changseh a nakipoh ding ahi.
English: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

tcz: Numei ngol kiti chu akam tam in, amanu chu pannabei le jum helou ahi.
en: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
text:
PRO 9:13
Thadou: Numei ngol kiti chu akam tam in, amanu chu pannabei le jum helou ahi.
English: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

tcz: Amanu chu a-in kot phunga atoujin, kholai jenga jong mundoh lai a bou atoujin ahi.
en: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
text:
PRO 9:14
Thadou: Amanu chu a-in kot phunga atoujin, kholai jenga jong mundoh lai a bou atoujin ahi.
English: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

tcz: Amanun mi ama kincheh a kisalel akom'a hung kijot hochu “akou jin,”
en: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,
text:
PRO 9:15
Thadou: Amanun mi ama kincheh a kisalel akom'a hung kijot hochu “akou jin,”
English: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

tcz: Chule milham ho koma chun kakom'a hung un tin, akouvin, lungthim beija um jouse tin akoujin ahi.
en: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
text:
PRO 9:16
Thadou: Chule milham ho koma chun kakom'a hung un tin, akouvin, lungthim beija um jouse tin akoujin ahi.
English: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

tcz: “Aguh'a kidon twi hi alhum in, aguh a kineji changlhah jong lungkim umtah ahi,” ati.
en: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
text:
PRO 9:17
Thadou: “Aguh'a kidon twi hi alhum in, aguh a kineji changlhah jong lungkim umtah ahi,” ati.
English: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

tcz: Hinlah golhangpa chun hiche mun hi thina ahi ti, aheji pon, numeinu insunga lhung jinhon jong noimi-gam mithi kholna'a lhalut ahilam-u, akihet phahji tapouve.
en: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
text:
PRO 9:18
Thadou: Hinlah golhangpa chun hiche mun hi thina ahi ti, aheji pon, numeinu insunga lhung jinhon jong noimi-gam mithi kholna'a lhalut ahilam-u, akihet phahji tapouve.
English: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

tcz: Solomon thuchih ho: Chapa chingin apa aki pasah jin; Chapa ngol vang anu ding in lungkham na bep ahi.
en: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
text:
PRO 10:1
Thadou: Solomon thuchih ho: Chapa chingin apa aki pasah jin; Chapa ngol vang anu ding in lungkham na bep ahi.
English: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

tcz: Gitlouna le engset jeh'a kilamdoh gouchu phat chompi thei ahipon, hinlah chondih nahin hinkho jeng jong ahuhdoh jin ahi.
en: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
text:
PRO 10:2
Thadou: Gitlouna le engset jeh'a kilamdoh gouchu phat chompi thei ahipon, hinlah chondih nahin hinkho jeng jong ahuhdoh jin ahi.
English: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in michonpha chu kelthoh in akoi jipon, chule milungthim phalou ho ngaichat akhohsah jipoi.
en: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
text:
PRO 10:3
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in michonpha chu kelthoh in akoi jipon, chule milungthim phalou ho ngaichat akhohsah jipoi.
English: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

tcz: Khut chaloh sah nomlou thase chun vaichatna alhut ding, khut umthim thei lou chun haosatna amu ding ahi.
en: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
text:
PRO 10:4
Thadou: Khut chaloh sah nomlou thase chun vaichatna alhut ding, khut umthim thei lou chun haosatna amu ding ahi.
English: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

tcz: Chapa ching in nipi laileh neh akikhol khomin, neh kikhol khom laija kinomsah chapa vang chun jumna amu tei ding ahi.
en: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
text:
PRO 10:5
Thadou: Chapa ching in nipi laileh neh akikhol khomin, neh kikhol khom laija kinomsah chapa vang chun jumna amu tei ding ahi.
English: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

tcz: Michonpha luchanga phattheina gobang in ajun, mikitah ho kamsunga vang pumtho changa thuseina jeng apot in ahi.
en: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
text:
PRO 10:6
Thadou: Michonpha luchanga phattheina gobang in ajun, mikitah ho kamsunga vang pumtho changa thuseina jeng apot in ahi.
English: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

tcz: Mikitah chu akisumil thei jipon, mikitah lou ho min vang chomlou kah'a kisumil ding ahi.
en: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
text:
PRO 10:7
Thadou: Mikitah chu akisumil thei jipon, mikitah lou ho min vang chomlou kah'a kisumil ding ahi.
English: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

tcz: Miching in thu kisei chan asanje ahen, amoh a thusei vang chu mangthah ding ahi.
en: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
text:
PRO 10:8
Thadou: Miching in thu kisei chan asanje ahen, amoh a thusei vang chu mangthah ding ahi.
English: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

tcz: Lungthim kitah a kalsonna chu monna ahin, achena tinchang kisuh boi-achu matdoh a um tei ding ahi.
en: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
text:
PRO 10:9
Thadou: Lungthim kitah a kalsonna chu monna ahin, achena tinchang kisuh boi-achu matdoh a um tei ding ahi.
English: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

tcz: Aphalou lam galdot chun gimna asodoh jin, hangsan tah'a mi phohsal a sudih chun chamna asemdoh jin ahi.
en: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
text:
PRO 10:10
Thadou: Aphalou lam galdot chun gimna asodoh jin, hangsan tah'a mi phohsal a sudih chun chamna asemdoh jin ahi.
English: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

tcz: Michonpha kamsung chu hinna twinah tobang ahin, miphalou ho kamsunga vang ki nah na ding thuseina jeng apot in ahi.
en: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
text:
PRO 10:11
Thadou: Michonpha kamsung chu hinna twinah tobang ahin, miphalou ho kamsunga vang ki nah na ding thuseina jeng apot in ahi.
English: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

tcz: Kivetda nahin kinahna asodoh sah jin, ngailut na vang chun thilse jouse asel mang jitai.
en: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
text:
PRO 10:12
Thadou: Kivetda nahin kinahna asodoh sah jin, ngailut na vang chun thilse jouse asel mang jitai.
English: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

tcz: Thil hetthemna neipa vang chun akamsunga kon thu aseidoh chan le chihna amu jin, lungthim beipa vang chun aphahsam a moltum adou jing ding ahi.
en: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
text:
PRO 10:13
Thadou: Thil hetthemna neipa vang chun akamsunga kon thu aseidoh chan le chihna amu jin, lungthim beipa vang chun aphahsam a moltum adou jing ding ahi.
English: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

tcz: Miching hon hetna akhol chen un, mingol kamtam hon hamset na akiloilut jiuvin ahi.
en: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
text:
PRO 10:14
Thadou: Miching hon hetna akhol chen un, mingol kamtam hon hamset na akiloilut jiuvin ahi.
English: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

tcz: Mihaoho nei leh gou hi akulpia apang jin, vaichate neilal na vang chun manthahna asojin ahi.
en: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
text:
PRO 10:15
Thadou: Mihaoho nei leh gou hi akulpia apang jin, vaichate neilal na vang chun manthahna asojin ahi.
English: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

tcz: Michonpha chun atohga dungjui'a hinna alhut jin, migilou ho phatchomna vang chun chonsetna alhut jitan ahi.
en: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
text:
PRO 10:16
Thadou: Michonpha chun atohga dungjui'a hinna alhut jin, migilou ho phatchomna vang chun chonsetna alhut jitan ahi.
English: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

tcz: Min ahilna ngaipha chun hinna lam ajot jin, min aphona ngaimahpa vang chu avah mang jitai.
en: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
text:
PRO 10:17
Thadou: Min ahilna ngaipha chun hinna lam ajot jin, min aphona ngaimahpa vang chu avah mang jitai.
English: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

tcz: Alungthim'a mudana neipa chun jouthu jeng asei jin, mi enghotna thuseipa vang angol ahi.
en: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
text:
PRO 10:18
Thadou: Alungthim'a mudana neipa chun jouthu jeng asei jin, mi enghotna thuseipa vang angol ahi.
English: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

tcz: Thu tamseina hin seikhel aumsah teijin, hinlah akam kihup them mi chu mi ching ahi.
en: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
text:
PRO 10:19
Thadou: Thu tamseina hin seikhel aumsah teijin, hinlah akam kihup them mi chu mi ching ahi.
English: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

tcz: Mikitah pa kamcheng hi dangka manlu tobang ahin, mikitah lou ho lungthim vang pannabei jeng ahi.
en: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
text:
PRO 10:20
Thadou: Mikitah pa kamcheng hi dangka manlu tobang ahin, mikitah lou ho lungthim vang pannabei jeng ahi.
English: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

tcz: Mikitah pa kamsunga kon in mitampi vah va na ding thu apot jin, mingol ho vang lungthim beijin amang thah jitauve.
en: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
text:
PRO 10:21
Thadou: Mikitah pa kamsunga kon in mitampi vah va na ding thu apot jin, mingol ho vang lungthim beijin amang thah jitauve.
English: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai phattheina chan hi haodohna ahin, hichun lungkhamna asodoh sah jipon ahi.
en: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
text:
PRO 10:22
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai phattheina chan hi haodohna ahin, hichun lungkhamna asodoh sah jipon ahi.
English: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

tcz: Thilse bol hi mingol ding in kichep golnop abang jin, thil hetthemna neipa ding in limgeh a chon hi lungkimna ahi.
en: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
text:
PRO 10:23
Thadou: Thilse bol hi mingol ding in kichep golnop abang jin, thil hetthemna neipa ding in limgeh a chon hi lungkimna ahi.
English: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

tcz: Miphalou in mi akichat sahna chu ama chunga ale-lhun jin, mikitah ding in angaichat chan Elohim Pathen in apeh tei ding ahi.
en: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
text:
PRO 10:24
Thadou: Miphalou in mi akichat sahna chu ama chunga ale-lhun jin, mikitah ding in angaichat chan Elohim Pathen in apeh tei ding ahi.
English: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

tcz: Khopi hui alan a gopi ajuh teng, miphalou chu atol tha jitan, hinlah mikitah vang tonsot geija tundoh ahitai.
en: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
text:
PRO 10:25
Thadou: Khopi hui alan a gopi ajuh teng, miphalou chu atol tha jitan, hinlah mikitah vang tonsot geija tundoh ahitai.
English: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

tcz: Juthuh hin ha ajatsah bang le, meikhun mit athipsah bang in, mithase jong agolpa ding in doujou ahipoi.
en: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
text:
PRO 10:26
Thadou: Juthuh hin ha ajatsah bang le, meikhun mit athipsah bang in, mithase jong agolpa ding in doujou ahipoi.
English: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

tcz: Elohim Pathen ginna hi hinkho sotna ahin, miphalou ho hinkho vang kisuchom ding ahi.
en: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
text:
PRO 10:27
Thadou: Elohim Pathen ginna hi hinkho sotna ahin, miphalou ho hinkho vang kisuchom ding ahi.
English: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

tcz: Mikitah ho kinepna chu kipana ahin, miphalou ho kinepna vang pannabei ahi.
en: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
text:
PRO 10:28
Thadou: Mikitah ho kinepna chu kipana ahin, miphalou ho kinepna vang pannabei ahi.
English: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

tcz: Mikitah ding in Yahweh Pakai hi bitna ahin, thil phalou bolte dinga vang manthahna ahi.
en: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
text:
PRO 10:29
Thadou: Mikitah ding in Yahweh Pakai hi bitna ahin, thil phalou bolte dinga vang manthahna ahi.
English: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

tcz: Mikitah chu kisuloh lou hel ding, miphalou ho vang gamsunga kon'a kichon mang ding'u ahi.
en: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
text:
PRO 10:30
Thadou: Mikitah chu kisuloh lou hel ding, miphalou ho vang gamsunga kon'a kichon mang ding'u ahi.
English: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

tcz: Mikitah kamsunga kon in chihna apot jin, aphalouva thu motsei vang chu aleigui kitan ding ahi.
en: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
text:
PRO 10:31
Thadou: Mikitah kamsunga kon in chihna apot jin, aphalouva thu motsei vang chu aleigui kitan ding ahi.
English: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

tcz: Mikitah chun akam sunga kon in lahthei aseidoh jin, miphalou ho kamsunga kon in vang thu chavei jeng apot jin ahi.
en: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
text:
PRO 10:32
Thadou: Mikitah chun akam sunga kon in lahthei aseidoh jin, miphalou ho kamsunga kon in vang thu chavei jeng apot jin ahi.
English: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

tcz: Thil adihlouva kite hi Yahweh Pakai in athet ahin, dihta a akilep-toa akite teng Yahweh Pakai ding in kipa aum-jie.
en: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.
text:
PRO 11:1
Thadou: Thil adihlouva kite hi Yahweh Pakai in athet ahin, dihta a akilep-toa akite teng Yahweh Pakai ding in kipa aum-jie.
English: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.

tcz: Kiletsahnan ahin phah teng, muda nan ahin lhut paijin, milung neng ho ding in vang chihna aum jing e.
en: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
text:
PRO 11:2
Thadou: Kiletsahnan ahin phah teng, muda nan ahin lhut paijin, milung neng ho ding in vang chihna aum jing e.
English: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

tcz: Mikitah ho kamkeh loubeh a aum jiu hi, amasang-diuva lamhil a pang ahin, jou le nal'a thuseija lungthim dihlou hin, ajona leh manthahna aso-sah jitauvin ahi.
en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
text:
PRO 11:3
Thadou: Mikitah ho kamkeh loubeh a aum jiu hi, amasang-diuva lamhil a pang ahin, jou le nal'a thuseija lungthim dihlou hin, ajona leh manthahna aso-sah jitauvin ahi.
English: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

tcz: Elohim Pathen lunghan niteng, nei le gou iman apang pon, dihna kiti hi thina dinmun a jong hoidohna a pang ahi.
en: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
text:
PRO 11:4
Thadou: Elohim Pathen lunghan niteng, nei le gou iman apang pon, dihna kiti hi thina dinmun a jong hoidohna a pang ahi.
English: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

tcz: Chamdel a um mikitah chu alampi a-jang in, mikitahlou vang chu aphatlouna in alhup denji ahi.
en: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
text:
PRO 11:5
Thadou: Chamdel a um mikitah chu alampi a-jang in, mikitahlou vang chu aphatlouna in alhup denji ahi.
English: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

tcz: Mikitah te chu adihna in ahuhdoh jin, jou le nal a thuseina vang chun soh-a apanlo sah ahibouve.
en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
text:
PRO 11:6
Thadou: Mikitah te chu adihna in ahuhdoh jin, jou le nal a thuseina vang chun soh-a apanlo sah ahibouve.
English: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

tcz: Miphalou chu athiteng akinepna jong pannabei ahin, Elohim Pathen sumilte dinga kinepna jong pannabei ahi.
en: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
text:
PRO 11:7
Thadou: Miphalou chu athiteng akinepna jong pannabei ahin, Elohim Pathen sumilte dinga kinepna jong pannabei ahi.
English: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

tcz: Mikitah chu gim le hesohna kon in akihuhdoh jin, miphalou vang chu gim le hesohna'a alhalut jitai.
en: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.
text:
PRO 11:8
Thadou: Mikitah chu gim le hesohna kon in akihuhdoh jin, miphalou vang chu gim le hesohna'a alhalut jitai.
English: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

tcz: Elohim Pathen sumil mi chun aheng akom manthana ding jeng asei jin, hinlah hetkhen na thahat nei jeh in mikitah te huhdoh in aum-jin ahi.
en: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
text:
PRO 11:9
Thadou: Elohim Pathen sumil mi chun aheng akom manthana ding jeng asei jin, hinlah hetkhen na thahat nei jeh in mikitah te huhdoh in aum-jin ahi.
English: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

tcz: Mikitah hon aphalam amano teng, khopi sunga mihemte akipah un, mikitah lou ho chunga manthahna alhun teng, mi akipah jin ahi.
en: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
text:
PRO 11:10
Thadou: Mikitah hon aphalam amano teng, khopi sunga mihemte akipah un, mikitah lou ho chunga manthahna alhun teng, mi akipah jin ahi.
English: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
