tcz: Mikitah ho chunga phattheina jal in, khopi sung mite dopsang in aum un, hinlah mikitah lou ho thumot sei jeh'in khopi amangthah bep jin ahi.
en: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
text:
PRO 11:11
Thadou: Mikitah ho chunga phattheina jal in, khopi sung mite dopsang in aum un, hinlah mikitah lou ho thumot sei jeh'in khopi amangthah bep jin ahi.
English: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

tcz: Aheng akom hebol lou-pa chu milungthim bei ahin, thil hetkhenna neipa vang chu thipbeh chan aum jin ahi.
en: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
text:
PRO 11:12
Thadou: Aheng akom hebol lou-pa chu milungthim bei ahin, thil hetkhenna neipa vang chu thipbeh chan aum jin ahi.
English: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

tcz: Muntinna thu seilepa chun thuguh jeng jong aseidoh jin, hinlah tahsan theitah mi vang chun thuguh kiti a-im jon ahi.
en: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
text:
PRO 11:13
Thadou: Muntinna thu seilepa chun thuguh jeng jong aseidoh jin, hinlah tahsan theitah mi vang chun thuguh kiti a-im jon ahi.
English: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

tcz: Kilamhilna aum louteng mipi kipal tei ding, guhthim cha kithuhilna achun bitna aum teijin ahi.
en: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
text:
PRO 11:14
Thadou: Kilamhilna aum louteng mipi kipal tei ding, guhthim cha kithuhilna achun bitna aum teijin ahi.
English: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

tcz: Hetlou miho batsah na dia athil tung chun atohga amu tei ding, thil tun ding deiloupa vang chu hoidoh tei ding ahi.
en: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
text:
PRO 11:15
Thadou: Hetlou miho batsah na dia athil tung chun atohga amu tei ding, thil tun ding deiloupa vang chu hoidoh tei ding ahi.
English: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

tcz: Mi ngailuthem numei chu jana chang tei ding, gitlouna vang chun noisena dimset akimu ding ahi.
en: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
text:
PRO 11:16
Thadou: Mi ngailuthem numei chu jana chang tei ding, gitlouna vang chun noisena dimset akimu ding ahi.
English: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

tcz: Mi ngailuthem chun phatchomna atoh doh ahin, mi kilose vang chun maha akilam doh-ji ahi.
en: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
text:
PRO 11:17
Thadou: Mi ngailuthem chun phatchomna atoh doh ahin, mi kilose vang chun maha akilam doh-ji ahi.
English: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

tcz: Miphalou in jou le nal in tohman amujin, mikitah vang chun muchi pha atun aga alou jitan ahi.
en: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
text:
PRO 11:18
Thadou: Miphalou in jou le nal in tohman amujin, mikitah vang chun muchi pha atun aga alou jitan ahi.
English: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

tcz: Thildih tuhchah a ngailu chun hinna anei tei ding, aphalou lam jenga chepa chu thi tei ding ahi.
en: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
text:
PRO 11:19
Thadou: Thildih tuhchah a ngailu chun hinna anei tei ding, aphalou lam jenga chepa chu thi tei ding ahi.
English: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

tcz: Alungthim a thildih lou puho Yahweh Pakai in athet in, achena lam lam'a chamdel'a umte chunga Yahweh Pakai akipah jing in ahi.
en: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
text:
PRO 11:20
Thadou: Alungthim a thildih lou puho Yahweh Pakai in athet in, achena lam lam'a chamdel'a umte chunga Yahweh Pakai akipah jing in ahi.
English: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

tcz: Hechen soh keijun, mi koihile engsetna nei chun talen amat ding, mikitah te vang huhdoh-a um tei diu ahi.
en: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
text:
PRO 11:21
Thadou: Hechen soh keijun, mi koihile engsetna nei chun talen amat ding, mikitah te vang huhdoh-a um tei diu ahi.
English: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

tcz: Limgeh a um lou numei kitihi vohpi nahko sunga sana chao kiba bep kheh ahi.
en: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
text:
PRO 11:22
Thadou: Limgeh a um lou numei kitihi vohpi nahko sunga sana chao kiba bep kheh ahi.
English: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

tcz: Mikitah ho dei le ngai chu, apha cha cha jeng ahin, mikitah lou ho kinepna vang chu lungsatna jeng ahibouve.
en: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
text:
PRO 11:23
Thadou: Mikitah ho dei le ngai chu, apha cha cha jeng ahin, mikitah lou ho kinepna vang chu lungsatna jeng ahibouve.
English: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

tcz: Itcha louhel'a hongphal mi chu ahao cheh cheh jin, mihem koi hileh apeh ding kisan nunglah achu lhasam cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.
text:
PRO 11:24
Thadou: Itcha louhel'a hongphal mi chu ahao cheh cheh jin, mihem koi hileh apeh ding kisan nunglah achu lhasam cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

tcz: Mi hongphal chun anei be cheh cheh ding, mi dang dinga twi chap chan chu ama chunga jong kichap ding ahi.
en: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
text:
PRO 11:25
Thadou: Mi hongphal chun anei be cheh cheh ding, mi dang dinga twi chap chan chu ama chunga jong kichap ding ahi.
English: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

tcz: Chang hom-lou a koitup chah khehpa chu mipi sapset chang ding, hinlah kiphal tah'a chang homdohpa chunga vang phattheina lhung ding ahi.
en: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
text:
PRO 11:26
Thadou: Chang hom-lou a koitup chah khehpa chu mipi sapset chang ding, hinlah kiphal tah'a chang homdohpa chunga vang phattheina lhung ding ahi.
English: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

tcz: Giltah'a thilpha ngaito pan, lungkimna aneiyin, thilpha lou jong chu aphaloupa chunga aga chu-jitan ahi.
en: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.
text:
PRO 11:27
Thadou: Giltah'a thilpha ngaito pan, lungkimna aneiyin, thilpha lou jong chu aphaloupa chunga aga chu-jitan ahi.
English: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

tcz: Nei le gou'a kisongpa chu ahomkeuva um tei ding, mikitah te vang thingna banga nou jing diu ahi.
en: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
text:
PRO 11:28
Thadou: Nei le gou'a kisongpa chu ahomkeuva um tei ding, mikitah te vang thingna banga nou jing diu ahi.
English: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

tcz: Mi koi hileh a-insung vai hom tup lou chu huija leng le tobang bep ahin, chule mingol chun miching ho jenlea pang tei ding ahi.
en: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
text:
PRO 11:29
Thadou: Mi koi hileh a-insung vai hom tup lou chu huija leng le tobang bep ahin, chule mingol chun miching ho jenlea pang tei ding ahi.
English: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

tcz: Mikitah natoh chu hinna thingphung ga tobang asoh jin, pannabeija kichih sahna hin hinkho manthahna alhut jin ahi.
en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
text:
PRO 11:30
Thadou: Mikitah natoh chu hinna thingphung ga tobang asoh jin, pannabeija kichih sahna hin hinkho manthahna alhut jin ahi.
English: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

tcz: Leiset'a mikitah jeng bon akile thuh theileh, miphalou chunga ichan geija lhung ding hitam chule achonsete chunga ichan gei lhung ding hitam!
en: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
text:
PRO 11:31
Thadou: Leiset'a mikitah jeng bon akile thuh theileh, miphalou chunga ichan geija lhung ding hitam chule achonsete chunga ichan gei lhung ding hitam!
English: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

tcz: Koi hileh kigahna thet lou chun, hetna jong adeijin, min akhou khah ding deiloupa vang chu miching ahipoi.
en: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
text:
PRO 12:1
Thadou: Koi hileh kigahna thet lou chun, hetna jong adeijin, min akhou khah ding deiloupa vang chu miching ahipoi.
English: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

tcz: Mipha chun Yahweh Pakai lunglam atong jin, setna jeng tohgon neipa vang Yahweh Pakai in athetbol jin ahi.
en: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.
text:
PRO 12:2
Thadou: Mipha chun Yahweh Pakai lunglam atong jin, setna jeng tohgon neipa vang Yahweh Pakai in athetbol jin ahi.
English: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

tcz: Phatlouna a kon in inchen amangthah jin, mi chondih ho vang chu koiman asuh-ling jou lou ding ahi.
en: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
text:
PRO 12:3
Thadou: Phatlouna a kon in inchen amangthah jin, mi chondih ho vang chu koiman asuh-ling jou lou ding ahi.
English: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

tcz: Numei pha chu ajipa dinga lallukhuh ahin, jumna le jachatna'a um numei vang ajipa dinga agu achang chip tobang ahi.
en: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
text:
PRO 12:4
Thadou: Numei pha chu ajipa dinga lallukhuh ahin, jumna le jachatna'a um numei vang ajipa dinga agu achang chip tobang ahi.
English: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

tcz: Mikitah te tohgon chu adih a tanpeh ding, hinlah, lungthim dihloute thumop vang chu kijoulhepna jeng ahi.
en: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
text:
PRO 12:5
Thadou: Mikitah te tohgon chu adih a tanpeh ding, hinlah, lungthim dihloute thumop vang chu kijoulhepna jeng ahi.
English: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

tcz: Mikitah loute kamcheng chu thisan sona ding jeng ahin, mikitah ho kamcheng vang kihinsona jeng ahi.
en: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
text:
PRO 12:6
Thadou: Mikitah loute kamcheng chu thisan sona ding jeng ahin, mikitah ho kamcheng vang kihinsona jeng ahi.
English: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

tcz: Mikitah loute chu manthahnan alhut loiji tan, mikitah ho vang chu ding det cheh cheh diu ahi.
en: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
text:
PRO 12:7
Thadou: Mikitah loute chu manthahnan alhut loiji tan, mikitah ho vang chu ding det cheh cheh diu ahi.
English: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

tcz: Mihem hi alungdih jal'a pachat changji ahin, mihem lungphalou chu thetbolna achang-jin ahi.
en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
text:
PRO 12:8
Thadou: Mihem hi alungdih jal'a pachat changji ahin, mihem lungphalou chu thetbolna achang-jin ahi.
English: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

tcz: Mi thupi tah banga chon a, neh le chah lhahsam sang in, lung lhaisel'a ana-kitohpa aphajon ahi.
en: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.
text:
PRO 12:9
Thadou: Mi thupi tah banga chon a, neh le chah lhahsam sang in, lung lhaisel'a ana-kitohpa aphajon ahi.
English: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.

tcz: Mikitah hon agancha jengu jong khohsahna aneiyun, mikitah loutea kon ngailutna vang chu thangsetna ahi.
en: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
text:
PRO 12:10
Thadou: Mikitah hon agancha jengu jong khohsahna aneiyun, mikitah loutea kon ngailutna vang chu thangsetna ahi.
English: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

tcz: Mipontho chun agam leiset akhot-a neh ding aki khol ahin, pannabeija thil ngaitoa lhailepan vang ima aneiji pon ahi.
en: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
text:
PRO 12:11
Thadou: Mipontho chun agam leiset akhot-a neh ding aki khol ahin, pannabeija thil ngaitoa lhailepan vang ima aneiji pon ahi.
English: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

tcz: Mikitah lou in chu mangthah loi ding, mikitah ho vang chu thingphung phatah in ajung akhodet tobang ahi.
en: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
text:
PRO 12:12
Thadou: Mikitah lou in chu mangthah loi ding, mikitah ho vang chu thingphung phatah in ajung akhodet tobang ahi.
English: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

tcz: Mikitah lou chu akamsung sohsa aseikhel thucheng achun akipal jin, mikitah ding in vang gim hesoh akon in ajamdoh jitai.
en: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
text:
PRO 12:13
Thadou: Mikitah lou chu akamsung sohsa aseikhel thucheng achun akipal jin, mikitah ding in vang gim hesoh akon in ajamdoh jitai.
English: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

tcz: Mihem khat chun akam thep-ga anen alungkim jitan, hijeh achu mihem khat in na atoh teng achunga lelhun-ji ahi.
en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
text:
PRO 12:14
Thadou: Mihem khat chun akam thep-ga anen alungkim jitan, hijeh achu mihem khat in na atoh teng achunga lelhun-ji ahi.
English: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

tcz: Mingol hon achena chan-u adih jeng in amu-jiuvin, mikitah vang chun min ahilna angaijin, lam dihlou apeldoh jin ahi.
en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
text:
PRO 12:15
Thadou: Mingol hon achena chan-u adih jeng in amu-jiuvin, mikitah vang chun min ahilna angaijin, lam dihlou apeldoh jin ahi.
English: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

tcz: Mingol in alunga adeilou chu aphongdoh paijin, mikitah vang chun min ahilouva athet bolna jong iman agel jipoi.
en: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
text:
PRO 12:16
Thadou: Mingol in alunga adeilou chu aphongdoh paijin, mikitah vang chun min ahilouva athet bolna jong iman agel jipoi.
English: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

tcz: Mikitah chun thudih aseiteng kicheh sel'in vetsahna aumjin, jou le nal-a thuseipa vang chun amacham cham in thu aseidoh-jin ahi.
en: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
text:
PRO 12:17
Thadou: Mikitah chun thudih aseiteng kicheh sel'in vetsahna aumjin, jou le nal-a thuseipa vang chun amacham cham in thu aseidoh-jin ahi.
English: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

tcz: Thu kiti hi, nasatah chemjam banga akidoulel jong aum jin, miching thusei vang chun mihem adamsah-jin ahi.
en: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
text:
PRO 12:18
Thadou: Thu kiti hi, nasatah chemjam banga akidoulel jong aum jin, miching thusei vang chun mihem adamsah-jin ahi.
English: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

tcz: Thutah beh seite kamsunga kon in, thudih jeng apot in, thujou seite kamsunga kon vang chu hetman louva manthahna sohji ahi.
en: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
text:
PRO 12:19
Thadou: Thutah beh seite kamsunga kon in, thudih jeng apot in, thujou seite kamsunga kon vang chu hetman louva manthahna sohji ahi.
English: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

tcz: Thilphalou gong ho lung sunga thilse jeng dimset in achengin, thilpha jeng ngaito teding in kipana jeng ahi.
en: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
text:
PRO 12:20
Thadou: Thilphalou gong ho lung sunga thilse jeng dimset in achengin, thilpha jeng ngaito teding in kipana jeng ahi.
English: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

tcz: Mikitah chunga thilse alhung jipon, miphalou te chunga vang gim le hesohna jeng alhung jin ahi.
en: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
text:
PRO 12:21
Thadou: Mikitah chunga thilse alhung jipon, miphalou te chunga vang gim le hesohna jeng alhung jin ahi.
English: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

tcz: Jou le nal jeng seiji leigui chu Yahweh Pakai in athet in, thudih a natong te chunga vang Yahweh Pakai akipah-jin ahi.
en: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.
text:
PRO 12:22
Thadou: Jou le nal jeng seiji leigui chu Yahweh Pakai in athet in, thudih a natong te chunga vang Yahweh Pakai akipah-jin ahi.
English: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.

tcz: Miching hon achih-nau kiletsahpi louvin aum jiuvin, mingol hon vang angolnau chu aphongjal le-jitauve.
en: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
text:
PRO 12:23
Thadou: Miching hon achih-nau kiletsahpi louvin aum jiuvin, mingol hon vang angolnau chu aphongjal le-jitauve.
English: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

tcz: Lungdih pu-hon akhut'un vai ahom jiuvin, khut chalosah nom lou mihem chu soh-a pang tei ding ahi.
en: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
text:
PRO 12:24
Thadou: Lungdih pu-hon akhut'un vai ahom jiuvin, khut chalosah nom lou mihem chu soh-a pang tei ding ahi.
English: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

tcz: Lunggim a umpa chu atahsa agep liu jin, ngailutna thu ajah teng ama chu kipanan adim jitai.
en: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
text:
PRO 12:25
Thadou: Lunggim a umpa chu atahsa agep liu jin, ngailutna thu ajah teng ama chu kipanan adim jitai.
English: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

tcz: Sihnei lang-neina nei lou mihem chun aloi agol ding in thupha jeng aseijin, mikitah loute vang chu abonchauvin amangthah jitauve.
en: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
text:
PRO 12:26
Thadou: Sihnei lang-neina nei lou mihem chun aloi agol ding in thupha jeng aseijin, mikitah loute vang chu abonchauvin amangthah jitauve.
English: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

tcz: Natong nom lou chu nehding beija um ding, miching in vang nei le gou nengsel-a aset ding ahi.
en: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
text:
PRO 12:27
Thadou: Natong nom lou chu nehding beija um ding, miching in vang nei le gou nengsel-a aset ding ahi.
English: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

tcz: Mikitah lamlhahna chu hinna lampi ahin, lamdih lou chun thina alhut ding ahi.
en: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
text:
PRO 12:28
Thadou: Mikitah lamlhahna chu hinna lampi ahin, lamdih lou chun thina alhut ding ahi.
English: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

tcz: Chapa ching chun anu le apan ahilna angaijin, miduhdah lou vang chu min aphona jong iman-agel jipoi.
en: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
text:
PRO 13:1
Thadou: Chapa ching chun anu le apan ahilna angaijin, miduhdah lou vang chu min aphona jong iman-agel jipoi.
English: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

tcz: Chihna kamcheng in an-pha akimu thei jin, jou le nal jenga thuseipan vang pumthoa mu ding bou agel in ahi.
en: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.
text:
PRO 13:2
Thadou: Chihna kamcheng in an-pha akimu thei jin, jou le nal jenga thuseipan vang pumthoa mu ding bou agel in ahi.
English: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

tcz: Alei kituh tang joupa chu kihinso tei ding, koi hileh alei tuhtang thei lou chu mangthah tei ding ahi.
en: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
text:
PRO 13:3
Thadou: Alei kituh tang joupa chu kihinso tei ding, koi hileh alei tuhtang thei lou chu mangthah tei ding ahi.
English: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

tcz: Mithase hon nehding tampi angaicha jiuvin, hinlah miching in nehding lungkim sel-in amujin ahi.
en: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
text:
PRO 13:4
Thadou: Mithase hon nehding tampi angaicha jiuvin, hinlah miching in nehding lungkim sel-in amujin ahi.
English: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

tcz: Mikitah in jousei abol ngaipon, mikitah lou vang chun jumna le ngailutna beijin na-atongdoh jin ahi.
en: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
text:
PRO 13:5
Thadou: Mikitah in jousei abol ngaipon, mikitah lou vang chun jumna le ngailutna beijin na-atongdoh jin ahi.
English: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

tcz: Mikitah chu adihna jal in ahoidoh jin, miphalou vang chu chonsetnan apui mangthah jitai.
en: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
text:
PRO 13:6
Thadou: Mikitah chu adihna jal in ahoidoh jin, miphalou vang chu chonsetnan apui mangthah jitai.
English: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

tcz: Mi kimkhat chu hao akisah lheh jin, hinlah ima aneideh poi. Mi kimkhatma chu akivai chatsah lheh jin, hinlah nei le gou kimsel-in aneiyin ahi.
en: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
text:
PRO 13:7
Thadou: Mi kimkhat chu hao akisah lheh jin, hinlah ima aneideh poi. Mi kimkhatma chu akivai chatsah lheh jin, hinlah nei le gou kimsel-in aneiyin ahi.
English: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

tcz: Mihem khat chun anei le agou jal'a ahinkho akilhatdoh ahin, hinlah mivaicha ding in kilhatdoh jouna aum jipoi.
en: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
text:
PRO 13:8
Thadou: Mihem khat chun anei le agou jal'a ahinkho akilhatdoh ahin, hinlah mivaicha ding in kilhatdoh jouna aum jipoi.
English: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

tcz: Mikitah chu thaomei bang in avah jing in, miphaloute thaomei vang hetman louva mit ding ahi.
en: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
text:
PRO 13:9
Thadou: Mikitah chu thaomei bang in avah jing in, miphaloute thaomei vang hetman louva mit ding ahi.
English: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

tcz: Kiletsahna jeh'in thungai loute akitoh thei jipon, kineosah a min ahilna kisante ding in vang chihna ahi.
en: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.
text:
PRO 13:10
Thadou: Kiletsahna jeh'in thungai loute akitoh thei jipon, kineosah a min ahilna kisante ding in vang chihna ahi.
English: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

tcz: Gangtah'a kimu nei le gou chu hetman louva bei ding, nei le gou kholkhom lelepa-a vang chu tam cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.
text:
PRO 13:11
Thadou: Gangtah'a kimu nei le gou chu hetman louva bei ding, nei le gou kholkhom lelepa-a vang chu tam cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

tcz: Kinepna bang aso-lou teng, mihem lungthim atongkha jin, hinlah lungtup molsona chu hin-thingphung banga hing jing ding ahi.
en: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
text:
PRO 13:12
Thadou: Kinepna bang aso-lou teng, mihem lungthim atongkha jin, hinlah lungtup molsona chu hin-thingphung banga hing jing ding ahi.
English: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

tcz: Min ahilna ngainom loupa chunga manthahna lhung ding, koi hileh thupeh ngaisanga chu kipaman chang tei ding ahi.
en: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
text:
PRO 13:13
Thadou: Min ahilna ngainom loupa chunga manthahna lhung ding, koi hileh thupeh ngaisanga chu kipaman chang tei ding ahi.
English: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

tcz: Miching mihilna chu hinna twinah tobang ahin, hitobang kihilna sang chan chun thina apeldoh teidiu ahi.
en: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
text:
PRO 13:14
Thadou: Miching mihilna chu hinna twinah tobang ahin, hitobang kihilna sang chan chun thina apeldoh teidiu ahi.
English: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

tcz: Lungdih kiti hin thilpha atongdoh jin, kitahna beihel mi vang chu mangthah ding ahi.
en: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
text:
PRO 13:15
Thadou: Lungdih kiti hin thilpha atongdoh jin, kitahna beihel mi vang chu mangthah ding ahi.
English: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

tcz: Miching ho chun akalson masang in ageltoh masa jin, mingol hon vang geltoh masa louvin, angolnau atah lang jiuvin ahi.
en: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
text:
PRO 13:16
Thadou: Miching ho chun akalson masang in ageltoh masa jin, mingol hon vang geltoh masa louvin, angolnau atah lang jiuvin ahi.
English: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

tcz: Thupole miphalou chun miho lunggim hesoh alhut peh jin, ngansena chang tahsan um mi vang chun lungdamna jeng alhut jin ahi.
en: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
text:
PRO 13:17
Thadou: Thupole miphalou chun miho lunggim hesoh alhut peh jin, ngansena chang tahsan um mi vang chun lungdamna jeng alhut jin ahi.
English: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

tcz: Seingai loupa chunga chun gentheina le vetsetna alhung jin, min ahilna chan ngaipa vang chu jabolna chang tei ding ahi.
en: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
text:
PRO 13:18
Thadou: Seingai loupa chunga chun gentheina le vetsetna alhung jin, min ahilna chan ngaipa vang chu jabolna chang tei ding ahi.
English: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

tcz: Ngaichat khat toh molso nahi hinkhoa dinga lungkimna ahin, hinlah thilse jamsan ding hi mingol hon athet jiuvin ahi.
en: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
text:
PRO 13:19
Thadou: Ngaichat khat toh molso nahi hinkhoa dinga lungkimna ahin, hinlah thilse jamsan ding hi mingol hon athet jiuvin ahi.
English: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

tcz: Miching toh kivop chu aching in, mingol toh kivoppan vang setna ato tei ding ahi.
en: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
text:
PRO 13:20
Thadou: Miching toh kivop chu aching in, mingol toh kivoppan vang setna ato tei ding ahi.
English: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

tcz: Chonseho chu setna ajui jiuvin, mikitah te vang chu phatthei nan ajui jing un ahi.
en: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
text:
PRO 13:21
Thadou: Chonseho chu setna ajui jiuvin, mikitah te vang chu phatthei nan ajui jing un ahi.
English: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

tcz: Mipha chun atute khang geija din gou adalhah peh jin, chonseten akhol nei le gou vang chu michonpha ho ding ahibouve.
en: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
text:
PRO 13:22
Thadou: Mipha chun atute khang geija din gou adalhah peh jin, chonseten akhol nei le gou vang chu michonpha ho ding ahibouve.
English: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

tcz: Vaichaten lou alho teng, neh ding nengchat in akhol khom un, hinlah adihlouva thutan ten achom peh jitauve.
en: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
text:
PRO 13:23
Thadou: Vaichaten lou alho teng, neh ding nengchat in akhol khom un, hinlah adihlouva thutan ten achom peh jitauve.
English: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

tcz: Achate mol'a jep loupa chun, mol aboh ding nom lou ahin, hinlah achate ngailutna neipa chun lungthim phatah mangchan ahil-jin ahi.
en: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
text:
PRO 13:24
Thadou: Achate mol'a jep loupa chun, mol aboh ding nom lou ahin, hinlah achate ngailutna neipa chun lungthim phatah mangchan ahil-jin ahi.
English: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

tcz: Mikitah chun lung nachim tah'a neh ding anei jing in, hinlah miphalou ho chu gelkel'a oi-thep ding ahiuve.
en: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
text:
PRO 13:25
Thadou: Mikitah chun lung nachim tah'a neh ding anei jing in, hinlah miphalou ho chu gelkel'a oi-thep ding ahiuve.
English: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

tcz: Numeiching in ain-chen akisemtup in, numei ngol in vang amatah ain-chen sukeh in apangin ahi.
en: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
text:
PRO 14:1
Thadou: Numeiching in ain-chen akisemtup in, numei ngol in vang amatah ain-chen sukeh in apangin ahi.
English: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

tcz: Lungdih'a lam jot chun Yahweh Pakai a ging in, hinlah achena jousea thilphalou gelpan Yahweh Pakai anahsah jipon ahi.
en: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
text:
PRO 14:2
Thadou: Lungdih'a lam jot chun Yahweh Pakai a ging in, hinlah achena jousea thilphalou gelpan Yahweh Pakai anahsah jipon ahi.
English: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

tcz: Mingol in akijepna ding akiseidoh bep jin, miching hon vang ahoidoh nadiu akiseidoh jiuvin ahi.
en: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
text:
PRO 14:3
Thadou: Mingol in akijepna ding akiseidoh bep jin, miching hon vang ahoidoh nadiu akiseidoh jiuvin ahi.
English: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

tcz: Bongchal loukai ding umlou na-a chang akilamdoh ngai pon, ajeh chu bongchal thahat akon chang tampi kilam-ji ahi.
en: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
text:
PRO 14:4
Thadou: Bongchal loukai ding umlou na-a chang akilamdoh ngai pon, ajeh chu bongchal thahat akon chang tampi kilam-ji ahi.
English: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

tcz: Mi kitah hettoh sah-a apan teng jouthu asei ngai pon, mikitah lou hettoh sah-a apan teng jou le nal in thu aseijin ahi.
en: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
text:
PRO 14:5
Thadou: Mi kitah hettoh sah-a apan teng jouthu asei ngai pon, mikitah lou hettoh sah-a apan teng jou le nal in thu aseijin ahi.
English: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

tcz: Michavai hon chihna ahol-un amu jou deh pouvin, hinlah thil hetthemna neipa ding in chihna hi nailam cha ahibouve.
en: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
text:
PRO 14:6
Thadou: Michavai hon chihna ahol-un amu jou deh pouvin, hinlah thil hetthemna neipa ding in chihna hi nailam cha ahibouve.
English: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

tcz: Mingol hoa kon'in kikhin mang in, ajeh chu amaho kamsunga kon'in chihna thu kisei japon nate.
en: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
text:
PRO 14:7
Thadou: Mingol hoa kon'in kikhin mang in, ajeh chu amaho kamsunga kon'in chihna thu kisei japon nate.
English: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

tcz: Milungthim ching hon ajot nadiu lampi akihet-un, mingol ho vang joulhepna jeng ahi.
en: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
text:
PRO 14:8
Thadou: Milungthim ching hon ajot nadiu lampi akihet-un, mingol ho vang joulhepna jeng ahi.
English: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in miphalou aphohsal jin, michonpha hon vang Elohim Pathen lunglhaina akimu jiuve.
en: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
text:
PRO 14:9
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in miphalou aphohsal jin, michonpha hon vang Elohim Pathen lunglhaina akimu jiuve.
English: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

tcz: Mihem lungthim hin gim le hesoh ahen, midang in akipanau chu ahetthem peh-un ahi.
en: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
text:
PRO 14:10
Thadou: Mihem lungthim hin gim le hesoh ahen, midang in akipanau chu ahetthem peh-un ahi.
English: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

tcz: Migilou ho inchu kiphet lhah peh ding, mikitah ho ponbuh vang dettah a kisong jing ding ahi.
en: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
text:
PRO 14:11
Thadou: Migilou ho inchu kiphet lhah peh ding, mikitah ho ponbuh vang dettah a kisong jing ding ahi.
English: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

tcz: Mihem khat'in achena lampi chu dih-in agel jin, hinlah alampi chu ajonaleh thina ahi.
en: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
text:
PRO 14:12
Thadou: Mihem khat'in achena lampi chu dih-in agel jin, hinlah alampi chu ajonaleh thina ahi.
English: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

tcz: Nuijat pat jeng in jong mihem alung kham jin, kipana jeng jong gimnan akichai-ji tai.
en: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
text:
PRO 14:13
Thadou: Nuijat pat jeng in jong mihem alung kham jin, kipana jeng jong gimnan akichai-ji tai.
English: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

tcz: Mikitah lou chu achena chan'a atohga aneh ding, hitobanga chu miphan jong atohga aneh ding ahi.
en: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
text:
PRO 14:14
Thadou: Mikitah lou chu achena chan'a atohga aneh ding, hitobanga chu miphan jong atohga aneh ding ahi.
English: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

tcz: Mihem meimeija um chun akisei jouse atahsan jin, miching in vang achena ding akivet phet in ahi.
en: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
text:
PRO 14:15
Thadou: Mihem meimeija um chun akisei jouse atahsan jin, miching in vang achena ding akivet phet in ahi.
English: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

tcz: Miching hon chingthei tah'in thilse apeldoh jiuvin, mingol hon vang ngol han pum'in na atong jiuve.
en: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
text:
PRO 14:16
Thadou: Miching hon chingthei tah'in thilse apeldoh jiuvin, mingol hon vang ngol han pum'in na atong jiuve.
English: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

tcz: Milungchom hon ngol hoitah in thil abol jiuvin, hinlah thil hethem mivang chu atomngai ahi.
en: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
text:
PRO 14:17
Thadou: Milungchom hon ngol hoitah in thil abol jiuvin, hinlah thil hethem mivang chu atomngai ahi.
English: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

tcz: Mihem meimeija um chu ngolna ahin, miching hon hetna kiti hi lallukhuh a aneiyu ahi.
en: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
text:
PRO 14:18
Thadou: Mihem meimeija um chu ngolna ahin, miching hon hetna kiti hi lallukhuh a aneiyu ahi.
English: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

tcz: Thilse kiti phot chu thilpha masanga dilsu ding, miphalou ho jong mikitah ho kelkot phunga dilsu diu ahi.
en: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
text:
PRO 14:19
Thadou: Thilse kiti phot chu thilpha masanga dilsu ding, miphalou ho jong mikitah ho kelkot phunga dilsu diu ahi.
English: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

tcz: Mivaicha hohi ain-heng ho kisan in athet bol jiuvin, mihao ding in vang golpha atam jin ahi.
en: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
text:
PRO 14:20
Thadou: Mivaicha hohi ain-heng ho kisan in athet bol jiuvin, mihao ding in vang golpha atam jin ahi.
English: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

tcz: Aheng akom ngailu lou mihem chu achonse ahin, mivaicha ho ngailua chu anunnom ahi.
en: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.
text:
PRO 14:21
Thadou: Aheng akom ngailu lou mihem chu achonse ahin, mivaicha ho ngailua chu anunnom ahi.
English: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

tcz: Thilse jeng gel hon suhkhel anei tei jiuvin, thilpha jeng ngaito hon vang tahsanna le kitahna akimu jiuvin ahi.
en: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
text:
PRO 14:22
Thadou: Thilse jeng gel hon suhkhel anei tei jiuvin, thilpha jeng ngaito hon vang tahsanna le kitahna akimu jiuvin ahi.
English: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

tcz: Natoh hahsa kiti chun aphachom asoh tei ding, natoh beija thumot seina hin vaichat asoji ahi.
en: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
text:
PRO 14:23
Thadou: Natoh hahsa kiti chun aphachom asoh tei ding, natoh beija thumot seina hin vaichat asoji ahi.
English: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

tcz: Miching ho ding in chihna hi lallukhuh in apang jin, mingol ho ding in vang ngolna hi pahvui banga aki-o jiu ahi.
en: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
text:
PRO 14:24
Thadou: Miching ho ding in chihna hi lallukhuh in apang jin, mingol ho ding in vang ngolna hi pahvui banga aki-o jiu ahi.
English: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

tcz: Mikitah hettohsah a apan teng mi tampi huhdoh jin, hinlah thujou seina hin mihem amanthah sahji ahi.
en: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
text:
PRO 14:25
Thadou: Mikitah hettohsah a apan teng mi tampi huhdoh jin, hinlah thujou seina hin mihem amanthah sahji ahi.
English: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

tcz: Elohim Pathen ging kiti hi mihem dinga kisonna ahin, achate jeng jong ama'a kisel diu ahi.
en: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
text:
PRO 14:26
Thadou: Elohim Pathen ging kiti hi mihem dinga kisonna ahin, achate jeng jong ama'a kisel diu ahi.
English: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai gin kitihi hinna twinah tobang ahin, ajeh chu mihem in thina jeng jong apeldoh-ji ahi.
en: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
text:
PRO 14:27
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai gin kitihi hinna twinah tobang ahin, ajeh chu mihem in thina jeng jong apeldoh-ji ahi.
English: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

tcz: Gamsunga cheng mipite apunbe teng lengpa loupina ahin, hinlah mihem lhomcha ahiteng milen milal dinga pannabei ahibouve.
en: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
text:
PRO 14:28
Thadou: Gamsunga cheng mipite apunbe teng lengpa loupina ahin, hinlah mihem lhomcha ahiteng milen milal dinga pannabei ahibouve.
English: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

tcz: Koi hileh lunghang vahlou chun thil hetthemna anei ahin, kino thethua lungchomna vang chun ngol-hoitah atoh doh ding ahi.
en: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
text:
PRO 14:29
Thadou: Koi hileh lunghang vahlou chun thil hetthemna anei ahin, kino thethua lungchomna vang chun ngol-hoitah atoh doh ding ahi.
English: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

tcz: Lungneng tah'a um hi tahsa damna ahin, hinlah thangthipna kiti hi gu le chang in adoulel ahi.
en: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
text:
PRO 14:30
Thadou: Lungneng tah'a um hi tahsa damna ahin, hinlah thangthipna kiti hi gu le chang in adoulel ahi.
English: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

tcz: Mivaicha sugenthei hon asempau Elohim Pathen ataitom nau ahin, amavang nei lou genthei khoto them chun asempa Elohim Pathen agin ahi.
en: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
text:
PRO 14:31
Thadou: Mivaicha sugenthei hon asempau Elohim Pathen ataitom nau ahin, amavang nei lou genthei khoto them chun asempa Elohim Pathen agin ahi.
English: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

tcz: Miphalou chu toset atosah in alehkhup jin, mikitah ding in vang bitna aum jing in ahi.
en: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
text:
PRO 14:32
Thadou: Miphalou chu toset atosah in alehkhup jin, mikitah ding in vang bitna aum jing in ahi.
English: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

tcz: Thil detkhen them mi chun chihna anei jing in, mingolte lungthim sunga vang chihna in mun aneipoi.
en: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
text:
PRO 14:33
Thadou: Thil detkhen them mi chun chihna anei jing in, mingolte lungthim sunga vang chihna in mun aneipoi.
English: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

tcz: Thudih hin mihem namkhat adom sang in, hinlah chonsetna hin mihem nam pumpi muda achansah ahi.
en: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
text:
PRO 14:34
Thadou: Thudih hin mihem namkhat adom sang in, hinlah chonsetna hin mihem nam pumpi muda achansah ahi.
English: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

tcz: Lhacha chingtah'a natong hin, lengpa lunglam aboldoh jin, jachatna natongpa chunga lengpa alungkim jipoi.
en: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
text:
PRO 14:35
Thadou: Lhacha chingtah'a natong hin, lengpa lunglam aboldoh jin, jachatna natongpa chunga lengpa alungkim jipoi.
English: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.

tcz: O nem heova mi akidonbut teng alunghang jong alungdam theijin, ahinlah O ngailou tah'a thu kisei vang hin mi aphin lunghang jin ahi.
en: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
text:
PRO 15:1
Thadou: O nem heova mi akidonbut teng alunghang jong alungdam theijin, ahinlah O ngailou tah'a thu kisei vang hin mi aphin lunghang jin ahi.
English: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

tcz: Miching ho leigui hin hetna le thepna thu jeng aphongdoh in, mingol ho kamsung invang ngolna thu jeng aphongdoh jin ahi.
en: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.
text:
PRO 15:2
Thadou: Miching ho leigui hin hetna le thepna thu jeng aphongdoh in, mingol ho kamsung invang ngolna thu jeng aphongdoh jin ahi.
English: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in muntin hi amit tenin avelhih jing in, thilse le thilpha kibol jouse jong ahesoh keijin ahi.
en: The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
text:
PRO 15:3
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in muntin hi amit tenin avelhih jing in, thilse le thilpha kibol jouse jong ahesoh keijin ahi.
English: The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

tcz: O nem heova thu kiseihi hinna thingphung tobang ahin, thu gilou seina leigui hinvang, mihem lungthim asusen ahi.
en: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
text:
PRO 15:4
Thadou: O nem heova thu kiseihi hinna thingphung tobang ahin, thu gilou seina leigui hinvang, mihem lungthim asusen ahi.
English: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

tcz: Apan ahilna jahda mihem chu a ngol ahin, asuhkhel na chunga apan ahilna sang nga chu miching ahi.
en: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
text:
PRO 15:5
Thadou: Apan ahilna jahda mihem chu a ngol ahin, asuhkhel na chunga apan ahilna sang nga chu miching ahi.
English: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

tcz: Mikitahte insunga nei le gou tampi aum jin, miphalou din akilamdoh jeng jong chu gimna bep ahi.
en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.
text:
PRO 15:6
Thadou: Mikitahte insunga nei le gou tampi aum jin, miphalou din akilamdoh jeng jong chu gimna bep ahi.
English: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

tcz: Miching kamcheng akon'in thupha jeng apot in, mingol lungsunga kon in vang hiche hi thil-hahsa ahi
en: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
text:
PRO 15:7
Thadou: Miching kamcheng akon'in thupha jeng apot in, mingol lungsunga kon in vang hiche hi thil-hahsa ahi
English: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.

tcz: Miphaloute kilhaina gantha hi Yahweh Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, mikitah ho taona vang Yahweh Pakai ding in lunglhai umtah ahi.
en: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
text:
PRO 15:8
Thadou: Miphaloute kilhaina gantha hi Yahweh Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, mikitah ho taona vang Yahweh Pakai ding in lunglhai umtah ahi.
English: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

tcz: Miphalou chena lampi chu Yahweh Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, thildih lam jenga chepa vang Yahweh Pakai hepina achangin ahi.
en: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
text:
PRO 15:9
Thadou: Miphalou chena lampi chu Yahweh Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, thildih lam jenga chepa vang Yahweh Pakai hepina achangin ahi.
English: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

tcz: Koi hileh lamdih jot nomlou chu engbolna achansah jin, min aphona sangnom lou hon athipi teidiu ahi.
en: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.
text:
PRO 15:10
Thadou: Koi hileh lamdih jot nomlou chu engbolna achansah jin, min aphona sangnom lou hon athipi teidiu ahi.
English: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thilhet thei na hin mithi gam a um ahet dia lom ho jong ahet thei in, achutile mihem lungthim chu ichan geijin ahechen tadem!
en: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
text:
PRO 15:11
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai thilhet thei na hin mithi gam a um ahet dia lom ho jong ahet thei in, achutile mihem lungthim chu ichan geijin ahechen tadem!
English: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

tcz: Adihlou a chonpan, min aphondoh ding anom pon, hichepa chu miching ho henga jong ache poi.
en: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
text:
PRO 15:12
Thadou: Adihlou a chonpan, min aphondoh ding anom pon, hichepa chu miching ho henga jong ache poi.
English: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.

tcz: Lungthim kipanan mai alhaisah in, lungthim ahesoh teng lhagao jong angui jitai.
en: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
text:
PRO 15:13
Thadou: Lungthim kipanan mai alhaisah in, lungthim ahesoh teng lhagao jong angui jitai.
English: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

tcz: Hetthemna neipan alunggil in hetna ahol jing in, mingol kamsunga kon in vang ngolna thu jeng apot e.
en: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
text:
PRO 15:14
Thadou: Hetthemna neipan alunggil in hetna ahol jing in, mingol kamsunga kon in vang ngolna thu jeng apot e.
English: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

tcz: Gim le hesoh'a um ho hinkho hi nitin'a thilsen abop ahin, lungthim kipah tah'a um hoding in golvah abang jing in ahi.
en: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
text:
PRO 15:15
Thadou: Gim le hesoh'a um ho hinkho hi nitin'a thilsen abop ahin, lungthim kipah tah'a um hoding in golvah abang jing in ahi.
English: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

tcz: Nei le gou tampi neija, gentheipi sang in, themcha bou neija Yahweh Pakai gin ding athupi joi.
en: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.
text:
PRO 15:16
Thadou: Nei le gou tampi neija, gentheipi sang in, themcha bou neija Yahweh Pakai gin ding athupi joi.
English: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.

tcz: Bongchal thaotah kitha'a kitomona aso-bep sang in, kingailutah-a ancheme neh khom aphajoi.
en: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
text:
PRO 15:17
Thadou: Bongchal thaotah kitha'a kitomona aso-bep sang in, kingailutah-a ancheme neh khom aphajoi.
English: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

tcz: Milungkhoh in kinahna apunsah in, mi lungneng lunghang vahlou in kitomona jong akichamsah in ahi.
en: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
text:
PRO 15:18
Thadou: Milungkhoh in kinahna apunsah in, mi lungneng lunghang vahlou in kitomona jong akichamsah in ahi.
English: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

tcz: Mithase ho lamlhahna jouse lingle khao'in abap in, mikitah ho lampi vang lamlen kilhong peh-ji ahi.
en: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
text:
PRO 15:19
Thadou: Mithase ho lamlhahna jouse lingle khao'in abap in, mikitah ho lampi vang lamlen kilhong peh-ji ahi.
English: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

tcz: Chapa ching in apa akipa sah jin, chapa ngol in vang anu jeng jong iman agel-ji poi.
en: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
text:
PRO 15:20
Thadou: Chapa ching in apa akipa sah jin, chapa ngol in vang anu jeng jong iman agel-ji poi.
English: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.

tcz: Lungthim beipa din ngolna chu lunglhaina ahin, thil hethempa vang ama chal peh jitai.
en: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
text:
PRO 15:21
Thadou: Lungthim beipa din ngolna chu lunglhaina ahin, thil hethempa vang ama chal peh jitai.
English: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

tcz: Kithumopna alhahsam teng, tohgon ache khel jin, mi akithumop to teng lolhinna ahi.
en: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
text:
PRO 15:22
Thadou: Kithumopna alhahsam teng, tohgon ache khel jin, mi akithumop to teng lolhinna ahi.
English: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

tcz: Phatah a kidonbut hi mijouse lunglhaina ahin, hijeh chun aphat toh kitoh a thu kisei hi aphat a pha ahi.
en: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
text:
PRO 15:23
Thadou: Phatah a kidonbut hi mijouse lunglhaina ahin, hijeh chun aphat toh kitoh a thu kisei hi aphat a pha ahi.
English: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

tcz: Michingpa lamlhahna chu hinna lampia akilhung tou in, aman gotmun apeldoh jin ahi.
en: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
text:
PRO 15:24
Thadou: Michingpa lamlhahna chu hinna lampia akilhung tou in, aman gotmun apeldoh jin ahi.
English: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mi kiletsahho inn aphet lha jin, meithai ho gamgi vang aphet peh jipoi.
en: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
text:
PRO 15:25
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in mi kiletsahho inn aphet lha jin, meithai ho gamgi vang aphet peh jipoi.
English: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

tcz: Miphalou lunggel jouse Yahweh Pakai in athet in, Mi lungdih ho kamcheng soh vang Yahweh Pakai dinga lunglhai um ahi.
en: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.
text:
PRO 15:26
Thadou: Miphalou lunggel jouse Yahweh Pakai in athet in, Mi lungdih ho kamcheng soh vang Yahweh Pakai dinga lunglhai um ahi.
English: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

tcz: Koi hileh lamdih louva mutei ding gochan chun, a-insung dinga gimna alhut ahin, ajeh chu neh guh thetbol chan chun hinna amu ding ahi.
en: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
text:
PRO 15:27
Thadou: Koi hileh lamdih louva mutei ding gochan chun, a-insung dinga gimna alhut ahin, ajeh chu neh guh thetbol chan chun hinna amu ding ahi.
English: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

tcz: Mikitah hon min thu asei teng, lunggil in adonbut ding dan angaito jin, hinlah mingol te kamcheng soh jouse thilphalou jeng twi kisung lha abang jin ahi.
en: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
text:
PRO 15:28
Thadou: Mikitah hon min thu asei teng, lunggil in adonbut ding dan angaito jin, hinlah mingol te kamcheng soh jouse thilphalou jeng twi kisung lha abang jin ahi.
English: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

tcz: Miphalou hoa kon in Yahweh Pakai akidalsen, mikitah ho taona vang angai peh jin ahi.
en: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
text:
PRO 15:29
Thadou: Miphalou hoa kon in Yahweh Pakai akidalsen, mikitah ho taona vang angai peh jin ahi.
English: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

tcz: Mit-ha hoisel'a mi akivet teng midinga lungthim kipana ahin, thupha kiseidoh jousen mihem gu le chang adamsah ahi.
en: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
text:
PRO 15:30
Thadou: Mit-ha hoisel'a mi akivet teng midinga lungthim kipana ahin, thupha kiseidoh jousen mihem gu le chang adamsah ahi.
English: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

tcz: Min ahilna ngainom mi chu, miching ho lah'a lha thei ding ahi.
en: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
text:
PRO 15:31
Thadou: Min ahilna ngainom mi chu, miching ho lah'a lha thei ding ahi.
English: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.

tcz: Koi hileh min ahilna sang thei loupa chun ahinkho agimsah ahin, ajehhcu min ahilna ngainom mi chun hetthemna anei tei ding ahi.
en: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
text:
PRO 15:32
Thadou: Koi hileh min ahilna sang thei loupa chun ahinkho agimsah ahin, ajehhcu min ahilna ngainom mi chun hetthemna anei tei ding ahi.
English: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai gin hi chihna dinga kihilna ahin, chule kisuhnemna hi jabolna'a pang ahi.
en: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
text:
PRO 15:33
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai gin hi chihna dinga kihilna ahin, chule kisuhnemna hi jabolna'a pang ahi.
English: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.

tcz: Mihem in alung sunga tohgon anei jin, kam kilhang sel'a thu kisei jong Yahweh Pakai in adonbut teijin ahi.
en: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.
text:
PRO 16:1
Thadou: Mihem in alung sunga tohgon anei jin, kam kilhang sel'a thu kisei jong Yahweh Pakai in adonbut teijin ahi.
English: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.

tcz: Mihem in angatna lampi chu amit-tenin aven adih jeng in agel in, hinlah Yahweh Pakai in alunggel ngaito jouse akhol chil jin ahi.
en: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.
text:
PRO 16:2
Thadou: Mihem in angatna lampi chu amit-tenin aven adih jeng in agel in, hinlah Yahweh Pakai in alunggel ngaito jouse akhol chil jin ahi.
English: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.

tcz: Nabol natoh abonchan Yahweh Pakaija pedoh jeng in, chutileh nathilgon aboncha lolhing ding ahi.
en: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.
text:
PRO 16:3
Thadou: Nabol natoh abonchan Yahweh Pakaija pedoh jeng in, chutileh nathilgon aboncha lolhing ding ahi.
English: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thil jouse akiman chahna ding dol cheh'a aumsah ahin, migilou jeng jong hahsat nikhoa dinga aumsah ahi.
en: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
text:
PRO 16:4
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in thil jouse akiman chahna ding dol cheh'a aumsah ahin, migilou jeng jong hahsat nikhoa dinga aumsah ahi.
English: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mikiletsah kiti athet in, hijeh chun hethem un, amaho chu gotna chang tei diu ahi.
en: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.
text:
PRO 16:5
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in mikiletsah kiti athet in, hijeh chun hethem un, amaho chu gotna chang tei diu ahi.
English: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.

tcz: Tahsan theija chonna le kitahna hin, themmona jeng jong adihsah in, Yahweh Pakai ginna jeh'in mihem in thilphalou apeldoh thei jin ahi.
en: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
text:
PRO 16:6
Thadou: Tahsan theija chonna le kitahna hin, themmona jeng jong adihsah in, Yahweh Pakai ginna jeh'in mihem in thilphalou apeldoh thei jin ahi.
English: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

tcz: Mihem chu achena lam jouse Yahweh Pakai lungdei ahitengleh, Yahweh Pakai in ama chu amelmate toh jong akichamsah jitai.
en: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
text:
PRO 16:7
Thadou: Mihem chu achena lam jouse Yahweh Pakai lungdei ahitengleh, Yahweh Pakai in ama chu amelmate toh jong akichamsah jitai.
English: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

tcz: Thildihlou pum'a kai-tampi kidon khom sang in, thildih'a lhomcha nei ding aphajoi.
en: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
text:
PRO 16:8
Thadou: Thildihlou pum'a kai-tampi kidon khom sang in, thildih'a lhomcha nei ding aphajoi.
English: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

tcz: Mihem in alung in chena ding lampi akisem in, Yahweh Pakai in achena ding lam ako-peh jin ahi.
en: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.
text:
PRO 16:9
Thadou: Mihem in alung in chena ding lampi akisem in, Yahweh Pakai in achena ding lam ako-peh jin ahi.
English: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.

tcz: Lengpa kamsunga kon'in Elohim Pathen thusei ahung gingdoh jin, hijeh chun lengpan thu a tankhel jipon ahi.
en: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
text:
PRO 16:10
Thadou: Lengpa kamsunga kon'in Elohim Pathen thusei ahung gingdoh jin, hijeh chun lengpan thu a tankhel jipon ahi.
English: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in thil adih in atetoh jin, hijeh chun thil ijakai Yahweh Pakai in atetohsa jeng ahi.
en: Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
text:
PRO 16:11
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in thil adih in atetoh jin, hijeh chun thil ijakai Yahweh Pakai in atetohsa jeng ahi.
English: Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

tcz: Leng ho din thil adihlouva bol hi thet umtah ahin, ajeh chu Ama vaihomna hi thudih a kingam ahi.
en: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
text:
PRO 16:12
Thadou: Leng ho din thil adihlouva bol hi thet umtah ahin, ajeh chu Ama vaihomna hi thudih a kingam ahi.
English: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

tcz: Leiguia kon thudih kiseidoh hi lengpa din lunglhai aum in, ajeh chu lengpan thu adih'a sei chu angailun ahi.
en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
text:
PRO 16:13
Thadou: Leiguia kon thudih kiseidoh hi lengpa din lunglhai aum in, ajeh chu lengpan thu adih'a sei chu angailun ahi.
English: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

tcz: Lengpa lunghan nahi gihsalna ahin, hinlah miching chun lengpa lunghanna adamsah jin ahi.
en: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
text:
PRO 16:14
Thadou: Lengpa lunghan nahi gihsalna ahin, hinlah miching chun lengpa lunghanna adamsah jin ahi.
English: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

tcz: Lengpa mailhai sel'a aum teng, damna akibe jin, lengpa lunglhaina jong hi, go hung phin lhaji meilhang tobang ahi.
en: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
text:
PRO 16:15
Thadou: Lengpa mailhai sel'a aum teng, damna akibe jin, lengpa lunglhaina jong hi, go hung phin lhaji meilhang tobang ahi.
English: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

tcz: Sana sang in chihna kimu dei aum jon, dangka sang'a jong thil hetthemna kisan ding ahi.
en: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
text:
PRO 16:16
Thadou: Sana sang in chihna kimu dei aum jon, dangka sang'a jong thil hetthemna kisan ding ahi.
English: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

tcz: Michondih chu thilse lam'a kon'in akiheidoh jin, achena tinchenga limgehpa chu kihinso teiding ahi.
en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
text:
PRO 16:17
Thadou: Michondih chu thilse lam'a kon'in akiheidoh jin, achena tinchenga limgehpa chu kihinso teiding ahi.
English: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

tcz: Manthah ding kon le kiletsahna ahung lhung loi jin, kipal lhuh ding konleh, lhagaova hoithana ahung um loi jitai.
en: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
text:
PRO 16:18
Thadou: Manthah ding kon le kiletsahna ahung lhung loi jin, kipal lhuh ding konleh, lhagaova hoithana ahung um loi jitai.
English: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

tcz: Mikiletsah hotoh thil kichomdoh kihop sang in, kineosah a vaichate toh lhat khom anom e.
en: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
text:
PRO 16:19
Thadou: Mikiletsah hotoh thil kichomdoh kihop sang in, kineosah a vaichate toh lhat khom anom e.
English: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

tcz: Min ahilna ngaija chu khangtou jing ding, chule Yahweh Pakaija kisong chan chu anunnom ahi.
en: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.
text:
PRO 16:20
Thadou: Min ahilna ngaija chu khangtou jing ding, chule Yahweh Pakaija kisong chan chu anunnom ahi.
English: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.

tcz: Mi-lungchingpa chu thil hethemmi kiti ding, chule lunglhaina'a thuseipan mi athujo tei ding ahi.
en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
text:
PRO 16:21
Thadou: Mi-lungchingpa chu thil hethemmi kiti ding, chule lunglhaina'a thuseipan mi athujo tei ding ahi.
English: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

tcz: Chihna nei mi chu hinna twinah tobang ahin, mingol ho ngolna hi talen matna bep ahi.
en: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
text:
PRO 16:22
Thadou: Chihna nei mi chu hinna twinah tobang ahin, mingol ho ngolna hi talen matna bep ahi.
English: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

tcz: Miching lung sunga kon chihna thucheng hungpot chan chu, Dan toh akikal jipon, akamcheng soh jouse chu mi thununna ahibouve.
en: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
text:
PRO 16:23
Thadou: Miching lung sunga kon chihna thucheng hungpot chan chu, Dan toh akikal jipon, akamcheng soh jouse chu mi thununna ahibouve.
English: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

tcz: Ngailutna'a thu kisei hi khoiju tobang ahin, lhagao le tahsa ding in antuitah damna ahi.
en: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
text:
PRO 16:24
Thadou: Ngailutna'a thu kisei hi khoiju tobang ahin, lhagao le tahsa ding in antuitah damna ahi.
English: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

tcz: Mikhat ding in lampi khat chu lamdih jeng in akimun, hinlah alampi chu ajona thina ahi.
en: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
text:
PRO 16:25
Thadou: Mikhat ding in lampi khat chu lamdih jeng in akimun, hinlah alampi chu ajona thina ahi.
English: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

tcz: Natong gimpa hin, aneh ding gelna'a atoh ahin, ajeh chu aneh nomna alol chun achama atohsah ahitai.
en: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.
text:
PRO 16:26
Thadou: Natong gimpa hin, aneh ding gelna'a atoh ahin, ajeh chu aneh nomna alol chun achama atohsah ahitai.
English: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.

tcz: Mihem pannabei chun thilphalou jeng agel in, akamcheng soh jong melkah gin tobang ahi.
en: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
text:
PRO 16:27
Thadou: Mihem pannabei chun thilphalou jeng agel in, akamcheng soh jong melkah gin tobang ahi.
English: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

tcz: Thilphalou bolpan, baotamna aso-sah jin, aguh a thuphong lepan golcha kingaitah jong asukhen in ahi.
en: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
text:
PRO 16:28
Thadou: Thilphalou bolpan, baotamna aso-sah jin, aguh a thuphong lepan golcha kingaitah jong asukhen in ahi.
English: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

tcz: Pumthoa natong hon aheng akom jeng jong atilseu-vin, chuting aheng akompa jong lamdih-lou alhung jitai.
en: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
text:
PRO 16:29
Thadou: Pumthoa natong hon aheng akom jeng jong atilseu-vin, chuting aheng akompa jong lamdih-lou alhung jitai.
English: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

tcz: Koi hileh mit teni-singa phetsah jichun, thilpha lou jeng angaiton, muh phunsah sah pan jong thilphalou abolsoh ahita bouve.
en: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
text:
PRO 16:30
Thadou: Koi hileh mit teni-singa phetsah jichun, thilpha lou jeng angaiton, muh phunsah sah pan jong thilphalou abolsoh ahita bouve.
English: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

tcz: Sam-kang liuva hinna hi, loupina lallukhuh ahin, adih jenga hinkho akiman teng, hitobanga hi hinkhosot thei ahibouve.
en: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
text:
PRO 16:31
Thadou: Sam-kang liuva hinna hi, loupina lallukhuh ahin, adih jenga hinkho akiman teng, hitobanga hi hinkhosot thei ahibouve.
English: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

tcz: Ki hatsah sang in thohhat tah'a lungneng apha jon, alungput athua nunsah joupa chu, khopi khat nokhum'a kilah sang in aphachom joi.
en: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
text:
PRO 16:32
Thadou: Ki hatsah sang in thohhat tah'a lungneng apha jon, alungput athua nunsah joupa chu, khopi khat nokhum'a kilah sang in aphachom joi.
English: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

tcz: Khutphang sunga vang akive jin, hinlah vang phatna leh phatlouna chu Yahweh Pakaija hung kon bou ahi.
en: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.
text:
PRO 16:33
Thadou: Khutphang sunga vang akive jin, hinlah vang phatna leh phatlouna chu Yahweh Pakaija hung kon bou ahi.
English: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.

tcz: Insunga kiboina pum'a golvah bolsang in, an-keoseh kineh a lungmonga um aphajoi.
en: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
text:
PRO 17:1
Thadou: Insunga kiboina pum'a golvah bolsang in, an-keoseh kineh a lungmonga um aphajoi.
English: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

tcz: Soh chingtah chu apupa chapa ahin, chule adihlouva chonpa chunga jong vaihom in apang jin, hiche sohpa chu apupa nei le gou aboncha achapate toh sopi khat banga kihom ding ahi.
en: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.
text:
PRO 17:2
Thadou: Soh chingtah chu apupa chapa ahin, chule adihlouva chonpa chunga jong vaihom in apang jin, hiche sohpa chu apupa nei le gou aboncha achapate toh sopi khat banga kihom ding ahi.
English: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

tcz: Thil solna bel chu dangka solna kimang ahin, mei-khuh sung hi sana solna ahi. Hinlah Yahweh Pakai hi lungput aboncha patepna ahi.
en: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the hearts.
text:
PRO 17:3
Thadou: Thil solna bel chu dangka solna kimang ahin, mei-khuh sung hi sana solna ahi. Hinlah Yahweh Pakai hi lungput aboncha patepna ahi.
English: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the hearts.

tcz: Miphalou in akamsunga thilphalou seipa thusei bou angai nom in, chule mijou in jong jou le nal thoa leigui kilehpel chu angai nom in ahi.
en: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
text:
PRO 17:4
Thadou: Miphalou in akamsunga thilphalou seipa thusei bou angai nom in, chule mijou in jong jou le nal thoa leigui kilehpel chu angai nom in ahi.
English: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

tcz: Vaicha noisea tot chaveipa chun asempa Elohim Pathen ataitom ahin, mi vangset pat'a kipah chun gimbolna ato tei ding ahi.
en: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
text:
PRO 17:5
Thadou: Vaicha noisea tot chaveipa chun asempa Elohim Pathen ataitom ahin, mi vangset pat'a kipah chun gimbolna ato tei ding ahi.
English: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

tcz: Tehse ho ding in atute hi alallukhuh-u ahin, chapate loupina hi apateu ahi.
en: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.
text:
PRO 17:6
Thadou: Tehse ho ding in atute hi alallukhuh-u ahin, chapate loupina hi apateu ahi.
English: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.

tcz: Mingol ho din thu ngaitah'a kisei hi pannabei ahin, milen milal te ang sunga jou le nal'a thu kisei jong pannabei ahibouve.
en: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.
text:
PRO 17:7
Thadou: Mingol ho din thu ngaitah'a kisei hi pannabei ahin, milen milal te ang sunga jou le nal'a thu kisei jong pannabei ahibouve.
English: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.

tcz: Aguh'a thilpeh kiti hi apepa din vangbohna tobang ahin, hijeh chun achena jousea khang ding ahi.
en: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
text:
PRO 17:8
Thadou: Aguh'a thilpeh kiti hi apepa din vangbohna tobang ahin, hijeh chun achena jousea khang ding ahi.
English: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

tcz: Koi hileh suhkhelna ngaidam thei chun, ngailutna angaichat jing ahin, hinlah miphul phul pan vang gol le pai akikhenpi jin ahi.
en: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
text:
PRO 17:9
Thadou: Koi hileh suhkhelna ngaidam thei chun, ngailutna angaichat jing ahin, hinlah miphul phul pan vang gol le pai akikhenpi jin ahi.
English: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

tcz: Mingol jakhat vei akichup sang in, thil hetthemna neipa ding in akihilna jeng jong asanji ahei.
en: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
text:
PRO 17:10
Thadou: Mingol jakhat vei akichup sang in, thil hetthemna neipa ding in akihilna jeng jong asanji ahei.
English: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.

tcz: Engsetna nei mi chun doumah jeng ahol le jin, amatoh kitoh ding in sottol engse ahung lo jitai.
en: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
text:
PRO 17:11
Thadou: Engsetna nei mi chun doumah jeng ahol le jin, amatoh kitoh ding in sottol engse ahung lo jitai.
English: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

tcz: Mikhat in mingol khat angol pet'a akimaitopi sang in, vompi nou akilo-doh nungsanga api kimaitopi aphajoi.
en: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
text:
PRO 17:12
Thadou: Mikhat in mingol khat angol pet'a akimaitopi sang in, vompi nou akilo-doh nungsanga api kimaitopi aphajoi.
English: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

tcz: Mihem in thilpha khat thilsea alethuh teng, a-insunga thilse cheng jing ding ahi.
en: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
text:
PRO 17:13
