Thadou: Mihem in thilpha khat thilsea alethuh teng, a-insunga thilse cheng jing ding ahi.
English: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

tcz: Kitoma ahung um teng twiput tobang in ahung pot jin, ajeh chu kitomona aso masanga kikhen tel aphajoi.
en: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
text:
PRO 17:14
Thadou: Kitoma ahung um teng twiput tobang in ahung pot jin, ajeh chu kitomona aso masanga kikhen tel aphajoi.
English: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

tcz: Athemmo lha kanga athem-jo mo chansahna hileh, Yahweh Pakai dinga anitah lhonna dei um lou ahi.
en: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.
text:
PRO 17:15
Thadou: Athemmo lha kanga athem-jo mo chansahna hileh, Yahweh Pakai dinga anitah lhonna dei um lou ahi.
English: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

tcz: Lungthimbei mingol in chihna kichohna ding sum akhol ngei poi.
en: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
text:
PRO 17:16
Thadou: Lungthimbei mingol in chihna kichohna ding sum akhol ngei poi.
English: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

tcz: Golngai chun phat tin in mi alungset in, sopi kiti hi hahsat petna kithokhom dinga hung peng ahibouve.
en: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
text:
PRO 17:17
Thadou: Golngai chun phat tin in mi alungset in, sopi kiti hi hahsat petna kithokhom dinga hung peng ahibouve.
English: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

tcz: Lungthim neilou mihem chu bat-san apang jin, hitichun aheng akom hoa batsah nan apang bep e.
en: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
text:
PRO 17:18
Thadou: Lungthim neilou mihem chu bat-san apang jin, hitichun aheng akom hoa batsah nan apang bep e.
English: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.

tcz: Suhkhel ding ging lou mihem chun kinah baotam adei ahin, ain kotpi paopia kiletsah pan manthahna jeng agon ahibouve.
en: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
text:
PRO 17:19
Thadou: Suhkhel ding ging lou mihem chun kinah baotam adei ahin, ain kotpi paopia kiletsah pan manthahna jeng agon ahibouve.
English: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

tcz: Mihem lungput dihlou kiti chu akhang thei pon, jou le nal seija pang kamsung jong vangsetna'a lhalut teiji ahi.
en: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.
text:
PRO 17:20
Thadou: Mihem lungput dihlou kiti chu akhang thei pon, jou le nal seija pang kamsung jong vangsetna'a lhalut teiji ahi.
English: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

tcz: Chapa ngol hi ahingpa dinga gimna bep ahin, hiche mingolpa hing chu akipah thei poi.
en: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
text:
PRO 17:21
Thadou: Chapa ngol hi ahingpa dinga gimna bep ahin, hiche mingolpa hing chu akipah thei poi.
English: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.

tcz: Lung kipana hi damna pipen ahin, lamvaija um chu gu le chang dinga doulal um ahi.
en: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
text:
PRO 17:22
Thadou: Lung kipana hi damna pipen ahin, lamvaija um chu gu le chang dinga doulal um ahi.
English: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

tcz: Thu adih a tan sang in, miphalou hon sum-guh ane jiuvin, thudih chu achekhel sah jitauve.
en: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
text:
PRO 17:23
Thadou: Thu adih a tan sang in, miphalou hon sum-guh ane jiuvin, thudih chu achekhel sah jitauve.
English: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.

tcz: Thil jouse hetthemna nei mi chun chihna lam jeng aven, ajon in, hinlah mingol chun leiset kol mang avelen ahi.
en: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
text:
PRO 17:24
Thadou: Thil jouse hetthemna nei mi chun chihna lam jeng aven, ajon in, hinlah mingol chun leiset kol mang avelen ahi.
English: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

tcz: Chapa in apa lunggimna asodoh peh in, anu dinga gimna tah ahi.
en: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
text:
PRO 17:25
Thadou: Chapa in apa lunggimna asodoh peh in, anu dinga gimna tah ahi.
English: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

tcz: Mikitah ahilou lam'a leosah kiti apha pon, vaihom milen milal jep ding jong thildih ahipoi.
en: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
text:
PRO 17:26
Thadou: Mikitah ahilou lam'a leosah kiti apha pon, vaihom milen milal jep ding jong thildih ahipoi.
English: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.

tcz: Thu kisei ngaija chu hetna anei jin, chule lungneng tah'a thusei mi chun hetkhenna anei ahi.
en: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
text:
PRO 17:27
Thadou: Thu kisei ngaija chu hetna anei jin, chule lungneng tah'a thusei mi chun hetkhenna anei ahi.
English: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

tcz: Mingol jeng jong thipbeh cha aum teng, miching bang in akigel jin, hitobang michun akam akeh lou teng, miching tah bang in akigel-ji bouve.
en: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
text:
PRO 17:28
Thadou: Mingol jeng jong thipbeh cha aum teng, miching bang in akigel jin, hitobang michun akam akeh lou teng, miching tah bang in akigel-ji bouve.
English: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.

tcz: Mihem ama changseh kikhoh sahpa chu ama dei lam jeng-ah akisalal jin, thildih lam ki manchahna jouse adoudal jin ahi.
en: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
text:
PRO 18:1
Thadou: Mihem ama changseh kikhoh sahpa chu ama dei lam jeng-ah akisalal jin, thildih lam ki manchahna jouse adoudal jin ahi.
English: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

tcz: Mingol in thil hetthem'a lunglhai ding kiti anahsah pon, ama lung ngaichat jeng bou akhoh sah-jin ahi.
en: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
text:
PRO 18:2
Thadou: Mingol in thil hetthem'a lunglhai ding kiti anahsah pon, ama lung ngaichat jeng bou akhoh sah-jin ahi.
English: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

tcz: Phatlouna ahung um teng, thangset nan ahin jui in, kijatona abei teng kimudana aum paijin ahi.
en: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.
text:
PRO 18:3
Thadou: Phatlouna ahung um teng, thangset nan ahin jui in, kijatona abei teng kimudana aum paijin ahi.
English: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.

tcz: Miching kamsunga kon hung potdoh thuchang hohi twithuh tobang ahin, chihna jong hi vadung tehliu'a twilong tobang ahi.
en: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
text:
PRO 18:4
Thadou: Miching kamsunga kon hung potdoh thuchang hohi twithuh tobang ahin, chihna jong hi vadung tehliu'a twilong tobang ahi.
English: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

tcz: Miphalou maija langnei hi angaina ahipon, mikitah chungthu adih'a tan ding jong suh-noh phah lou ding ahi.
en: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
text:
PRO 18:5
Thadou: Miphalou maija langnei hi angaina ahipon, mikitah chungthu adih'a tan ding jong suh-noh phah lou ding ahi.
English: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

tcz: Mingol thucheng hin mitoh kinahna ason, akamchenga kon in mol akisei doh bep jitai.
en: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
text:
PRO 18:6
Thadou: Mingol thucheng hin mitoh kinahna ason, akamchenga kon in mol akisei doh bep jitai.
English: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

tcz: Mingol kamcheng hi ama dinga amanthahna bep ahin, aleigui in ama le ama thangkol'a o-na ding akisemdoh bep ahi.
en: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
text:
PRO 18:7
Thadou: Mingol kamcheng hi ama dinga amanthahna bep ahin, aleigui in ama le ama thangkol'a o-na ding akisemdoh bep ahi.
English: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

tcz: Aguh a thu poa pangpa thusei jihi, anneh tuitah tobang ahin, akamcheng sohdoh jouse jong mihem lungsunga alhalut paijin ahi.
en: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
text:
PRO 18:8
Thadou: Aguh a thu poa pangpa thusei jihi, anneh tuitah tobang ahin, akamcheng sohdoh jouse jong mihem lungsunga alhalut paijin ahi.
English: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

tcz: Atohna chunga mithase hi, mi manthah sahpa toh sopi ahi.
en: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
text:
PRO 18:9
Thadou: Atohna chunga mithase hi, mi manthah sahpa toh sopi ahi.
English: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai minhi kulpi nasatah tobang ahin, hijeh chun mikitah in abel-jin hoidohnan aneiye.
en: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
text:
PRO 18:10
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai minhi kulpi nasatah tobang ahin, hijeh chun mikitah in abel-jin hoidohnan aneiye.
English: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

tcz: Mihaopa nei le gou chu ama din kulpi dettah tobang ahin, akihuh hingna dinga pal kikai bep bep ahi.
en: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
text:
PRO 18:11
Thadou: Mihaopa nei le gou chu ama din kulpi dettah tobang ahin, akihuh hingna dinga pal kikai bep bep ahi.
English: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

tcz: Mihem amanthah kon leh, kiletsah nan adim jin, koi hileh akineosa masa chan chu jabolna chang ding ahi.
en: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
text:
PRO 18:12
Thadou: Mihem amanthah kon leh, kiletsah nan adim jin, koi hileh akineosa masa chan chu jabolna chang ding ahi.
English: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

tcz: Thil hetchet masanga donbut jeng chun, ngol-houi tah jumna ato tei ding ahi.
en: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
text:
PRO 18:13
Thadou: Thil hetchet masanga donbut jeng chun, ngol-houi tah jumna ato tei ding ahi.
English: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

tcz: Mihem lhagao in dam-mona athoh jou in, hinlah lhagao adamlou teng thoh hahsa ding ahi.
en: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
text:
PRO 18:14
Thadou: Mihem lhagao in dam-mona athoh jou in, hinlah lhagao adamlou teng thoh hahsa ding ahi.
English: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

tcz: Chihna lungthim neihon phat tin'in hetbe ding adei-jun, hijeh chun miching hon hetna mube ding ago jing un ahi.
en: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
text:
PRO 18:15
Thadou: Chihna lungthim neihon phat tin'in hetbe ding adei-jun, hijeh chun miching hon hetna mube ding ago jing un ahi.
English: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

tcz: Mihem kiti hi athilpeh chun lampi agonpeh-ji ahin, hijeh chun milen milal henga jong apuilut jin ahi.
en: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
text:
PRO 18:16
Thadou: Mihem kiti hi athilpeh chun lampi agonpeh-ji ahin, hijeh chun milen milal henga jong apuilut jin ahi.
English: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

tcz: Mihem khat'in achung thu akikhol masah teng, adih in akimu nan, akihehpi dingpa ahung lhun'a akikhol chaisoh teng, achung thu kiseipan bep ahi.
en: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.
text:
PRO 18:17
Thadou: Mihem khat'in achung thu akikhol masah teng, adih in akimu nan, akihehpi dingpa ahung lhun'a akikhol chaisoh teng, achung thu kiseipan bep ahi.
English: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.

tcz: Vang vetna kiti hin baotamna abeisah jin, akidou teni kah'a jong thutan in apang e.
en: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
text:
PRO 18:18
Thadou: Vang vetna kiti hin baotamna abeisah jin, akidou teni kah'a jong thutan in apang e.
English: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

tcz: Sopi khat in asopi khat apanpi hi, kulpi dettah tobang ahin, hinlah kinahna aso teng khopi kelkot kikam chah kheh tobang ahi.
en: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.
text:
PRO 18:19
Thadou: Sopi khat in asopi khat apanpi hi, kulpi dettah tobang ahin, hinlah kinahna aso teng khopi kelkot kikam chah kheh tobang ahi.
English: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

tcz: Mihem in kamngai vang in an-neh ding akimun, koi hileh akamcheng tohga ne chan chu alungkim in ahi.
en: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
text:
PRO 18:20
Thadou: Mihem in kamngai vang in an-neh ding akimun, koi hileh akamcheng tohga ne chan chu alungkim in ahi.
English: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

tcz: Kampao le leiguia kon in thi le hin akingam in, koi hileh adihlou'a thusei chan chun atohga aneh tei ding ahi.
en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
text:
PRO 18:21
Thadou: Kampao le leiguia kon in thi le hin akingam in, koi hileh adihlou'a thusei chan chun atohga aneh tei ding ahi.
English: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

tcz: Pasal in numei ji-ding akimu teng, amapa chu anunnom ahin, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaija kon lung lhaina chang ding ahitai.
en: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.
text:
PRO 18:22
Thadou: Pasal in numei ji-ding akimu teng, amapa chu anunnom ahin, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaija kon lung lhaina chang ding ahitai.
English: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.

tcz: Mivaichan khotona angaichat teng atao jin, hinlah mihao'in kiletsah to thon thu asei-jin ahi.
en: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
text:
PRO 18:23
Thadou: Mivaichan khotona angaichat teng atao jin, hinlah mihao'in kiletsah to thon thu asei-jin ahi.
English: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

tcz: Gol le pai kiti hi apha-lhem manthahna thei jong aum in, hinlah gol le pai abang chu penpi tahbeh sopi sanga kinaipi jong aum in ahi.
en: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
text:
PRO 18:24
Thadou: Gol le pai kiti hi apha-lhem manthahna thei jong aum in, hinlah gol le pai abang chu penpi tahbeh sopi sanga kinaipi jong aum in ahi.
English: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

tcz: Mingol thu motsei seipa sang in, hinkho mandan them'a vaichat aphajoi.
en: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
text:
PRO 19:1
Thadou: Mingol thu motsei seipa sang in, hinkho mandan them'a vaichat aphajoi.
English: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

tcz: Mihem khat hetna beija hin hi apha pon, kin le donga chena lampi anoh phah thei-jin ahi.
en: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.
text:
PRO 19:2
Thadou: Mihem khat hetna beija hin hi apha pon, kin le donga chena lampi anoh phah thei-jin ahi.
English: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.

tcz: Mingol chu manthah nan apui mang teng, Yahweh Pakai mo achansah kit-jin ahi.
en: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.
text:
PRO 19:3
Thadou: Mingol chu manthah nan apui mang teng, Yahweh Pakai mo achansah kit-jin ahi.
English: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.

tcz: Mihao ding in gol le pai thah thah asem jin, mivaichapa vang chu agol apai in jong adalha laloi jie.
en: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
text:
PRO 19:4
Thadou: Mihao ding in gol le pai thah thah asem jin, mivaichapa vang chu agol apai in jong adalha laloi jie.
English: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

tcz: Hettosah'a pang jou le nal seipa chun, engbolna ato tei ding ahi.
en: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
text:
PRO 19:5
Thadou: Hettosah'a pang jou le nal seipa chun, engbolna ato tei ding ahi.
English: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

tcz: Mihem ahongphal chun ahin-khohsah thei mi tampi anei ding, jou le nal'a thuseipa vang ong-doh lou ding ahi.
en: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
text:
PRO 19:6
Thadou: Mihem ahongphal chun ahin-khohsah thei mi tampi anei ding, jou le nal'a thuseipa vang ong-doh lou ding ahi.
English: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

tcz: Mivaicha hi asopi ho jeng in jong athet bol jiuvin, achutileh agol apaiho chun ichan geijin athet tadiu vem? Vaichapan asam sam in hinlah adalha-ji tauve.
en: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.
text:
PRO 19:7
Thadou: Mivaicha hi asopi ho jeng in jong athet bol jiuvin, achutileh agol apaiho chun ichan geijin athet tadiu vem? Vaichapan asam sam in hinlah adalha-ji tauve.
English: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

tcz: Chihna kimupa chun hinkho manlut dan ahet ahin, thil hethem mi chu machal tei ding ahi.
en: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
text:
PRO 19:8
Thadou: Chihna kimupa chun hinkho manlut dan ahet ahin, thil hethem mi chu machal tei ding ahi.
English: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.

tcz: Hettohsah jou le nal seija pang pan, engbolna ato tei ding, koi hileh thujou seichan chun thina apeldoh lou ding ahi.
en: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
text:
PRO 19:9
Thadou: Hettohsah jou le nal seija pang pan, engbolna ato tei ding, koi hileh thujou seichan chun thina apeldoh lou ding ahi.
English: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

tcz: Mingol khat'in nomsatah'a hinkho aman ding adih thei pon, soh khat dinga milen milal chunga vaihompa hi ding jong dih thei him him lou ahi.
en: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
text:
PRO 19:10
Thadou: Mingol khat'in nomsatah'a hinkho aman ding adih thei pon, soh khat dinga milen milal chunga vaihompa hi ding jong dih thei him him lou ahi.
English: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

tcz: Lungput dihtah kiti hin, mi lunghanna asosah jipon, min ahilou lam'a abolna donse lou chu ama dia loupina ahi.
en: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
text:
PRO 19:11
Thadou: Lungput dihtah kiti hin, mi lunghanna asosah jipon, min ahilou lam'a abolna donse lou chu ama dia loupina ahi.
English: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

tcz: Lengpa lunghanna hi keipi ngih tobang ahin, alunglhaina vang hamhing lah daitwi in achap tobang ahi.
en: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
text:
PRO 19:12
Thadou: Lengpa lunghanna hi keipi ngih tobang ahin, alunglhaina vang hamhing lah daitwi in achap tobang ahi.
English: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

tcz: Chapa ngol hi apa dinga hamsetna ahin, numei ajipa toh kicham thei lou chu, gotwi julha tobang ahi.
en: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
text:
PRO 19:13
Thadou: Chapa ngol hi apa dinga hamsetna ahin, numei ajipa toh kicham thei lou chu, gotwi julha tobang ahi.
English: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

tcz: Nei le gou kiti hi pute patea kon kilo son-ji ahin, numei chingtah jia kimu hi Yahweh Pakaija kon ahi.
en: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.
text:
PRO 19:14
Thadou: Nei le gou kiti hi pute patea kon kilo son-ji ahin, numei chingtah jia kimu hi Yahweh Pakaija kon ahi.
English: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.

tcz: Thasetna hin mi alhim i-mujin, Koi hileh athase chan chun kel athoh ding ahi.
en: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
text:
PRO 19:15
Thadou: Thasetna hin mi alhim i-mujin, Koi hileh athase chan chun kel athoh ding ahi.
English: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

tcz: Thupeh nit chan kihinso tei ding, amavang thu kisei ija-sep lou chu thina ato ding ahi.
en: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
text:
PRO 19:16
Thadou: Thupeh nit chan kihinso tei ding, amavang thu kisei ija-sep lou chu thina ato ding ahi.
English: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

tcz: Mivaicha kithopi chun Yahweh Pakai akithopi ahin, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in atohman alethuh tei ding ahi.
en: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.
text:
PRO 19:17
Thadou: Mivaicha kithopi chun Yahweh Pakai akithopi ahin, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in atohman alethuh tei ding ahi.
English: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.

tcz: Semphat thei le kinepna aum pat hin, na chapa phohsal jeng in, moh manthah sah ding vang gel hih hel in.
en: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
text:
PRO 19:18
Thadou: Semphat thei le kinepna aum pat hin, na chapa phohsal jeng in, moh manthah sah ding vang gel hih hel in.
English: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.

tcz: Milung chom chun gimna ato tei ding ahin, dalha jeng tan, ajeh chu nangma chunga jong gimna lhun lo ding ahi.
en: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
text:
PRO 19:19
Thadou: Milung chom chun gimna ato tei ding ahin, dalha jeng tan, ajeh chu nangma chunga jong gimna lhun lo ding ahi.
English: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

tcz: Min nahilna le nathumopna ngaiphan lang asanji them in, ajeh chu khonung teng chihna nanei theina ding ahi.
en: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
text:
PRO 19:20
Thadou: Min nahilna le nathumopna ngaiphan lang asanji them in, ajeh chu khonung teng chihna nanei theina ding ahi.
English: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

tcz: Nangman tohgon ijat nei jong lechun, Yahweh Pakai lungdei banga nagon ding bou athupin ahi.
en: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.
text:
PRO 19:21
Thadou: Nangman tohgon ijat nei jong lechun, Yahweh Pakai lungdei banga nagon ding bou athupin ahi.
English: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.

tcz: Mihem akon kitahna hi deisah pipen ahin, lungput dihlou sang in vaichat aphajon ahi.
en: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
text:
PRO 19:22
Thadou: Mihem akon kitahna hi deisah pipen ahin, lungput dihlou sang in vaichat aphajon ahi.
English: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai gin hi kihin sona ahin, chule Yahweh Pakai gingmi chu alungkim jin, ama chu hamset nan alhun den lou hel ding ahi.
en: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
text:
PRO 19:23
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai gin hi kihin sona ahin, chule Yahweh Pakai gingmi chu alungkim jin, ama chu hamset nan alhun den lou hel ding ahi.
English: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

tcz: Mithase hon bukong asoh jiuvin, chule akamsung uva het ding jong angapcha jipouve.
en: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
text:
PRO 19:24
Thadou: Mithase hon bukong asoh jiuvin, chule akamsung uva het ding jong angapcha jipouve.
English: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

tcz: Mitot chavei ho chu gotna pi-lechun, chihna'a min anei thei ding; thil hethem mi chu gihsal le chun ahetna kibelap ding ahi.
en: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
text:
PRO 19:25
Thadou: Mitot chavei ho chu gotna pi-lechun, chihna'a min anei thei ding; thil hethem mi chu gihsal le chun ahetna kibelap ding ahi.
English: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

tcz: Apa pumthoa del le anu del mangpa chu, jum le jachat hung konna chapa tia seiset chang ding ahi.
en: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
text:
PRO 19:26
Thadou: Apa pumthoa del le anu del mangpa chu, jum le jachat hung konna chapa tia seiset chang ding ahi.
English: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

tcz: Kachapa, min na hilna ngai datan, chule chihnan jong donse da jeng tan.
en: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
text:
PRO 19:27
Thadou: Kachapa, min na hilna ngai datan, chule chihnan jong donse da jeng tan.
English: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.

tcz: Hettohsah duhdah loupa chun, thudih jong adoudal jin, hitichun mingol in, akam sunga themmona aki loilut jitai.
en: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
text:
PRO 19:28
Thadou: Hettohsah duhdah loupa chun, thudih jong adoudal jin, hitichun mingol in, akam sunga themmona aki loilut jitai.
English: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

tcz: Kijepna ding mol hi miphalou dinga kisem ahin, tungtun kijep jong hi mingol ho ding bou ahi.
en: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
text:
PRO 19:29
Thadou: Kijepna ding mol hi miphalou dinga kisem ahin, tungtun kijep jong hi mingol ho ding bou ahi.
English: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

tcz: Ju kiti hi nuijat le chatvei sosah ahin, khamna thei kiti jong hi kanah le baotamna jeng ahi. Khamna theija lop chu miching ahipoi.
en: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
text:
PRO 20:1
Thadou: Ju kiti hi nuijat le chatvei sosah ahin, khamna thei kiti jong hi kanah le baotamna jeng ahi. Khamna theija lop chu miching ahipoi.
English: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

tcz: Lengpa lunghan kigin nahi keipi bahkai ngih tobang ahin, koi hileh lengpa phin lung hang chan chu ahinkhoa tijat umtah ahi.
en: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
text:
PRO 20:2
Thadou: Lengpa lunghan kigin nahi keipi bahkai ngih tobang ahin, koi hileh lengpa phin lung hang chan chu ahinkhoa tijat umtah ahi.
English: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

tcz: Kinah baotamna'a kon kidalse ding hi mijabolna ahin, mingol kiti chu mitoh kina'a baotamji ahi.
en: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.
text:
PRO 20:3
Thadou: Kinah baotamna'a kon kidalse ding hi mijabolna ahin, mingol kiti chu mitoh kina'a baotamji ahi.
English: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.

tcz: Koi hileh nipi laija natong nom lou chun, thaset jeh'a chang-at ding amujou lou ding ahi.
en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
text:
PRO 20:4
Thadou: Koi hileh nipi laija natong nom lou chun, thaset jeh'a chang-at ding amujou lou ding ahi.
English: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

tcz: Mihem khat in alunggil'a angaito hi twi thuh tah tobang ahin, hinlah thil hetkhen themna nei mihem dingin; hitobang thuh tah chu twi thal'a athal ding ahi.
en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
text:
PRO 20:5
Thadou: Mihem khat in alunggil'a angaito hi twi thuh tah tobang ahin, hinlah thil hetkhen themna nei mihem dingin; hitobang thuh tah chu twi thal'a athal ding ahi.
English: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

tcz: Mihem tampin ama ama kitahna cheh aphon ding, hinlah mihem kitah mong koiyin amudoh tadem?
en: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
text:
PRO 20:6
Thadou: Mihem tampin ama ama kitahna cheh aphon ding, hinlah mihem kitah mong koiyin amudoh tadem?
English: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?

tcz: Hitobang mi chu lungthim dihtah'a lamlha pa ahin, anungjui-ah achapa te jeng jong phatthei chang ding ahi.
en: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
text:
PRO 20:7
Thadou: Hitobang mi chu lungthim dihtah'a lamlha pa ahin, anungjui-ah achapa te jeng jong phatthei chang ding ahi.
English: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.

tcz: Athuthanna laltouna'a tou lengpan, ijakai amit tenin aven ase le apha atetoh jin ahi.
en: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
text:
PRO 20:8
Thadou: Athuthanna laltouna'a tou lengpan, ijakai amit tenin aven ase le apha atetoh jin ahi.
English: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

tcz: Mihem koiham, “Kalung thim kasutheng in; kachonsetna kon in katheng tai,” tia sei ngam ding?
en: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?
text:
PRO 20:9
Thadou: Mihem koiham, “Kalung thim kasutheng in; kachonsetna kon in katheng tai,” tia sei ngam ding?
English: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?

tcz: Thil tena dihlou le thil tena kitoh lou chu, Yahweh Pakai dinga thet umtah ahi cheh lhon e.
en: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.
text:
PRO 20:10
Thadou: Thil tena dihlou le thil tena kitoh lou chu, Yahweh Pakai dinga thet umtah ahi cheh lhon e.
English: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

tcz: Naosen jeng jong achaloh aum chan in, itobang mi ahi aphongdoh in; hijeh chun athilbol chu adih ham athenga ham ti aseidoh theijin ahi.
en: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.
text:
PRO 20:11
Thadou: Naosen jeng jong achaloh aum chan in, itobang mi ahi aphongdoh in; hijeh chun athilbol chu adih ham athenga ham ti aseidoh theijin ahi.
English: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.

tcz: Kho jahna bikol hihen chule kho muna mit hijongleh, anitah'a Yahweh Pakai in asem ahi.
en: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.
text:
PRO 20:12
Thadou: Kho jahna bikol hihen chule kho muna mit hijongleh, anitah'a Yahweh Pakai in asem ahi.
English: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.

tcz: Imut ding bou gel hih hel'in, ajeh chu vaichatnan nahin phah lo ding ahi; na mit teni hasah inlang vetan, chutileh an neh ding neng jeng junga nanei ding ahi.
en: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
text:
PRO 20:13
Thadou: Imut ding bou gel hih hel'in, ajeh chu vaichatnan nahin phah lo ding ahi; na mit teni hasah inlang vetan, chutileh an neh ding neng jeng junga nanei ding ahi.
English: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

tcz: Thilchoa pang pan, “Man bei ahibouve,” atin, hinlah ama chu ache mang teng hoitho nan adim jitai.
en: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
text:
PRO 20:14
Thadou: Thilchoa pang pan, “Man bei ahibouve,” atin, hinlah ama chu ache mang teng hoitho nan adim jitai.
English: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

tcz: Chihna le hetna kamsunga kon thucheng hohi, sana le song mantam sang in aman tamjon ahi.
en: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
text:
PRO 20:15
Thadou: Chihna le hetna kamsunga kon thucheng hohi, sana le song mantam sang in aman tamjon ahi.
English: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

tcz: Hetkhah louhel mi kom'a thilman a kitungsa mipa chu, aponsil aboncha kichom peh a; chule hetphah louhel mite dinga hitobang mihem chu kiman jeng thei ahidem?
en: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
text:
PRO 20:16
Thadou: Hetkhah louhel mi kom'a thilman a kitungsa mipa chu, aponsil aboncha kichom peh a; chule hetphah louhel mite dinga hitobang mihem chu kiman jeng thei ahidem?
English: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.

tcz: Koitobang khat dingin changlhah kigua kine hi atui chomdan'in angaito in, hinlah phat chomkhat jouteng akamsunga song chang tobang adim jin ahi.
en: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
text:
PRO 20:17
Thadou: Koitobang khat dingin changlhah kigua kine hi atui chomdan'in angaito in, hinlah phat chomkhat jouteng akamsunga song chang tobang adim jin ahi.
English: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

tcz: Ki-thu mopto them na jeh'in thilgon ho alolhing thei jin, chingthei tah'a kilam kaina jeh'a galsat'a kikonji ahi.
en: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
text:
PRO 20:18
Thadou: Ki-thu mopto them na jeh'in thilgon ho alolhing thei jin, chingthei tah'a kilam kaina jeh'a galsat'a kikonji ahi.
English: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

tcz: Akam tam le seiding hol'a chun thuguh jouse aseidoh jin, hijeh chun ngol the thua thuseipa chutoh kivop hih in.
en: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
text:
PRO 20:19
Thadou: Akam tam le seiding hol'a chun thuguh jouse aseidoh jin, hijeh chun ngol the thua thuseipa chutoh kivop hih in.
English: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.

tcz: Koi hileh anu le apa gaosap chan chu, muthim lah'a athao mei kimut mit peh tei ding ahi.
en: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
text:
PRO 20:20
Thadou: Koi hileh anu le apa gaosap chan chu, muthim lah'a athao mei kimut mit peh tei ding ahi.
English: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

tcz: Apatna kino chenga kimuji nei le gou chu, achaina lam tengleh phattheina bei ding ahitai.
en: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.
text:
PRO 20:21
Thadou: Apatna kino chenga kimuji nei le gou chu, achaina lam tengleh phattheina bei ding ahitai.
English: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.

tcz: “Keiman thilse ka lethuh ding ahi,” tin jong seihih in; Yahweh Pakai ngah in chule Aman na kithopi tei ding ahi.
en: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.
text:
PRO 20:22
Thadou: “Keiman thilse ka lethuh ding ahi,” tin jong seihih in; Yahweh Pakai ngah in chule Aman na kithopi tei ding ahi.
English: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.

tcz: Thil tena adihlouva kimangcha chu, Yahweh Pakai dinga dei-umlou tah ahi; chule thil asao le achom tena adihlou jong chu aphapoi.
en: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
text:
PRO 20:23
Thadou: Thil tena adihlouva kimangcha chu, Yahweh Pakai dinga dei-umlou tah ahi; chule thil asao le achom tena adihlou jong chu aphapoi.
English: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai thusah jal'a bou mihem in akal asonji ahin, achutileh mihem in amacham tah'a akalsonna ding iti ahetkhen thei ding ham?
en: A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?
text:
PRO 20:24
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai thusah jal'a bou mihem in akal asonji ahin, achutileh mihem in amacham tah'a akalsonna ding iti ahetkhen thei ding ham?
English: A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?

tcz: Ama deidan tah a, “Hiche hi thil theng ahibouve,” tia sei chu; kipal lhuhna dinga thangkol kisong ahin, hiche hin Yahweh Pakaija kitepna le kigahna chu amin mai maija aphondoh ahi.
en: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
text:
PRO 20:25
Thadou: Ama deidan tah a, “Hiche hi thil theng ahibouve,” tia sei chu; kipal lhuhna dinga thangkol kisong ahin, hiche hin Yahweh Pakaija kitepna le kigahna chu amin mai maija aphondoh ahi.
English: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.

tcz: Lengpa ching thei tah chun migilouho pum'a kijap bangin ajapdoh jin, achunga akol-in akipei lele sah jin ahi.
en: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
text:
PRO 20:26
Thadou: Lengpa ching thei tah chun migilouho pum'a kijap bangin ajapdoh jin, achunga akol-in akipei lele sah jin ahi.
English: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.

tcz: Mihem lhagao kiti hi Yahweh Pakai thaomei vah ahin, hijeh chun mihem lunggil hi ahesoh keijin ahi.
en: The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
text:
PRO 20:27
Thadou: Mihem lhagao kiti hi Yahweh Pakai thaomei vah ahin, hijeh chun mihem lunggil hi ahesoh keijin ahi.
English: The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.

tcz: Kitahna le tantih neilouva ngailutna chun lengpa ahinso ahin, Alaltouna jeng jong ngailutnan ahendet ahibouve.
en: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
text:
PRO 20:28
Thadou: Kitahna le tantih neilouva ngailutna chun lengpa ahinso ahin, Alaltouna jeng jong ngailutnan ahendet ahibouve.
English: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.

tcz: Gollhang ho loupina hi athahat jal-u ahin, tehse ho melhoina vang hi asam kan'u hi ahi.
en: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
text:
PRO 20:29
Thadou: Gollhang ho loupina hi athahat jal-u ahin, tehse ho melhoina vang hi asam kan'u hi ahi.
English: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.

tcz: Thilse doudalna'a tahsa kijepna maha chu damdoi phatah ahin, hitobang kijepna chun mihem lung laigil geija asuhtheng ahi.
en: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
text:
PRO 20:30
Thadou: Thilse doudalna'a tahsa kijepna maha chu damdoi phatah ahin, hitobang kijepna chun mihem lung laigil geija asuhtheng ahi.
English: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.

tcz: Elohim Pathen in vadung twi alon sahna nom nom'a alonsah banga, lengpa lungthim jong ahei lele thei ahi.
en: The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
text:
PRO 21:1
Thadou: Elohim Pathen in vadung twi alon sahna nom nom'a alonsah banga, lengpa lungthim jong ahei lele thei ahi.
English: The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

tcz: Mihem in achonna jouse chu amit mun dih asa-jin, hinlah Yahweh Pakai in mihem lungthim akhol chil jin ahi.
en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.
text:
PRO 21:2
Thadou: Mihem in achonna jouse chu amit mun dih asa-jin, hinlah Yahweh Pakai in mihem lungthim akhol chil jin ahi.
English: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.

tcz: Kilhaina gantha sang in, thildih bol'a thu adih a tan ding hi, Yahweh Pakai lunglhaina ahijoi.
en: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
text:
PRO 21:3
Thadou: Kilhaina gantha sang in, thildih bol'a thu adih a tan ding hi, Yahweh Pakai lunglhaina ahijoi.
English: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

tcz: Kiletsahna lungthim pua mitha chule miphalou ho natoh aboncha chonset jeng ahi.
en: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
text:
PRO 21:4
Thadou: Kiletsahna lungthim pua mitha chule miphalou ho natoh aboncha chonset jeng ahi.
English: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

tcz: Miching hon gunchutah'a tohgon anei jouseu abulhing thei jin, amavang amin mei meija natong ho alhasam teijin ahi.
en: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
text:
PRO 21:5
Thadou: Miching hon gunchutah'a tohgon anei jouseu abulhing thei jin, amavang amin mei meija natong ho alhasam teijin ahi.
English: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

tcz: Jou le nal thoa nei le gou kichom khom jouse amangthah ding bep ahin, thina thang kisong tobang ahibouve.
en: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
text:
PRO 21:6
Thadou: Jou le nal thoa nei le gou kichom khom jouse amangthah ding bep ahin, thina thang kisong tobang ahibouve.
English: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

tcz: Thu adih'a tan ding mihon anahsah lou jeh un, miphalou pumthoa natong hon pannabei jin asumang jitauve.
en: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
text:
PRO 21:7
Thadou: Thu adih'a tan ding mihon anahsah lou jeh un, miphalou pumthoa natong hon pannabei jin asumang jitauve.
English: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

tcz: Themmona neipan lamdih ajot jipon, lungthim thengpa lam lhahna adih jing in ahi.
en: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
text:
PRO 21:8
Thadou: Themmona neipan lamdih ajot jipon, lungthim thengpa lam lhahna adih jing in ahi.
English: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

tcz: Numei hanse khat toh in nom khat'a chenkhom sang in, chungden in-vum'a chen ding aphajoi.
en: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
text:
PRO 21:9
Thadou: Numei hanse khat toh in nom khat'a chenkhom sang in, chungden in-vum'a chen ding aphajoi.
English: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

tcz: Miphalou lhagao'in thilse jeng bou angai chan, aheng akom in jong ama'a kon'in khotona amu jipoi.
en: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
text:
PRO 21:10
Thadou: Miphalou lhagao'in thilse jeng bou angai chan, aheng akom in jong ama'a kon'in khotona amu jipoi.
English: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

tcz: Panna beija mi tot chaveipa gotna akipeh teng, milham in chih-nan anei theijin chule miching ho akihil chan in hetna akibelep jie.
en: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
text:
PRO 21:11
Thadou: Panna beija mi tot chaveipa gotna akipeh teng, milham in chih-nan anei theijin chule miching ho akihil chan in hetna akibelep jie.
English: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

tcz: Mikitah chu miphalou in amelchih jing in, miphalou vang chu achunga hamsetna lhung tei ding ahi.
en: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
text:
PRO 21:12
Thadou: Mikitah chu miphalou in amelchih jing in, miphalou vang chu achunga hamsetna lhung tei ding ahi.
English: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.

tcz: Koi hileh migenthei akateng kijahmosah chu, ama kana ahung lhun teng koiman ajah phah peh lou ding ahi.
en: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
text:
PRO 21:13
Thadou: Koi hileh migenthei akateng kijahmosah chu, ama kana ahung lhun teng koiman ajah phah peh lou ding ahi.
English: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

tcz: Aguh'a kipa thilpeh hin alunghang jong adamsah thei jin, koima hetlouva nehguh kipe hin lungsat jong adaisah jitai.
en: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
text:
PRO 21:14
Thadou: Aguh'a kipa thilpeh hin alunghang jong adamsah thei jin, koima hetlouva nehguh kipe hin lungsat jong adaisah jitai.
English: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

tcz: Thu adih'a kitan hin mikitah akipasah in, hinlah miphalou ho ding in tijat umtah ahi.
en: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
text:
PRO 21:15
Thadou: Thu adih'a kitan hin mikitah akipasah in, hinlah miphalou ho ding in tijat umtah ahi.
English: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

tcz: Mi koi hileh hetkhen themna'a kon lamvaija vahmang chan chu, mithi hotoh kivop khomna ding mun ajot ahitai.
en: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
text:
PRO 21:16
Thadou: Mi koi hileh hetkhen themna'a kon lamvaija vahmang chan chu, mithi hotoh kivop khomna ding mun ajot ahitai.
English: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.

tcz: Tahsa nopsahna lamjeng lhangai hochun vaichatna akimudiu ahin, koi hijongleh jule noplenna-a kipe hochu itihchan hijongleh haodoh loudiu ahi.
en: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.
text:
PRO 21:17
Thadou: Tahsa nopsahna lamjeng lhangai hochun vaichatna akimudiu ahin, koi hijongleh jule noplenna-a kipe hochu itihchan hijongleh haodoh loudiu ahi.
English: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.

tcz: Koi hileh min akhoto ding jeng ngaicha a chu, vaicha pum'a um jing ding, chule ju-a lop jong haodoh thei lou ding ahi.
en: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.
text:
PRO 21:18
Thadou: Koi hileh min akhoto ding jeng ngaicha a chu, vaicha pum'a um jing ding, chule ju-a lop jong haodoh thei lou ding ahi.
English: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.

tcz: Numei lungkhoh le lungsa jing, jia neija chen khom sang in, het phahlou neldi gam'a chen aphajoi.
en: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
text:
PRO 21:19
Thadou: Numei lungkhoh le lungsa jing, jia neija chen khom sang in, het phahlou neldi gam'a chen aphajoi.
English: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

tcz: Miching chenna in-ah nei le gou lutah tah aum in, hinlah mingol in abonchan ane-mang jitai.
en: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.
text:
PRO 21:20
Thadou: Miching chenna in-ah nei le gou lutah tah aum in, hinlah mingol in abonchan ane-mang jitai.
English: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.

tcz: Koi hileh chonphatna lam khohsah a, chule mi khotona neipa chun jabolna amu tei ding ahi.
en: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
text:
PRO 21:21
Thadou: Koi hileh chonphatna lam khohsah a, chule mi khotona neipa chun jabolna amu tei ding ahi.
English: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

tcz: Miching mihatpa chenna khopi jong akholchil soh keijin, chule akisonpi pen-u kulpi jong alekhup'a asuhchim hel ding ahi.
en: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
text:
PRO 21:22
Thadou: Miching mihatpa chenna khopi jong akholchil soh keijin, chule akisonpi pen-u kulpi jong alekhup'a asuhchim hel ding ahi.
English: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.

tcz: Koi hileh thipkhen cha um'a lei kituh tang chu, gim le hesohna'a jong kivengdoh ding ahi.
en: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
text:
PRO 21:23
Thadou: Koi hileh thipkhen cha um'a lei kituh tang chu, gim le hesohna'a jong kivengdoh ding ahi.
English: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

tcz: Mi noise le kiletsahna jong hi, pannabeija tot chaveipa kiseina ahibouve.
en: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
text:
PRO 21:24
Thadou: Mi noise le kiletsahna jong hi, pannabeija tot chaveipa kiseina ahibouve.
English: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.

tcz: Mi thase ho chu aduchat uvin acham lou'a thina alhut ahi. Ajeh chu amahon akhut-u mangcha'a natoh ding anom pouve.
en: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
text:
PRO 21:25
Thadou: Mi thase ho chu aduchat uvin acham lou'a thina alhut ahi. Ajeh chu amahon akhut-u mangcha'a natoh ding anom pouve.
English: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

tcz: Miphalou hon nitin in anei asit jing un, miching in anei ahom in, akile lah ngai poi.
en: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
text:
PRO 21:26
Thadou: Miphalou hon nitin in anei asit jing un, miching in anei ahom in, akile lah ngai poi.
English: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

tcz: Miphalou ho kilhaina gantha chu thet umtah ahina chungchon in, phatlouna lungpun hin phaldoh taleu, ichan geija thet um cheh ding hitam!
en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
text:
PRO 21:27
Thadou: Miphalou ho kilhaina gantha chu thet umtah ahina chungchon in, phatlouna lungpun hin phaldoh taleu, ichan geija thet um cheh ding hitam!
English: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!

tcz: Jou le nal seija hettohsah'a pang ho suhbeija um ding, hinlah adih'a hettohsah'a pangpa thusei min angaipeh jing ding ahi.
en: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.
text:
PRO 21:28
Thadou: Jou le nal seija hettohsah'a pang ho suhbeija um ding, hinlah adih'a hettohsah'a pangpa thusei min angaipeh jing ding ahi.
English: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.

tcz: Miphalou chu adihlou'in aki ngamsah jin, hinlah mikitah chun atoh masang in ageltoh masa jin ahi.
en: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
text:
PRO 21:29
Thadou: Miphalou chu adihlou'in aki ngamsah jin, hinlah mikitah chun atoh masang in ageltoh masa jin ahi.
English: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

tcz: Mihem chihna le hetkhen themna chule aguh a kithumop themna chengsea kon hin, Yahweh Pakai deh-jou ding aum poi.
en: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
text:
PRO 21:30
Thadou: Mihem chihna le hetkhen themna chule aguh a kithumop themna chengsea kon hin, Yahweh Pakai deh-jou ding aum poi.
English: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.

tcz: Galsat nikhoa manchah din sakol gonsan aum in, hinlah gal-jona hi Yahweh Pakaija kon bou ahi.
en: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.
text:
PRO 21:31
Thadou: Galsat nikhoa manchah din sakol gonsan aum in, hinlah gal-jona hi Yahweh Pakaija kon bou ahi.
English: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.

tcz: Haosatna sanga minphat kilhen ding apha jon, sana le dangka sanga jong, mihem lunglhaina um ding aphajoi.
en: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
text:
PRO 22:1
Thadou: Haosatna sanga minphat kilhen ding apha jon, sana le dangka sanga jong, mihem lunglhaina um ding aphajoi.
English: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

tcz: Mihao hihen mivaicha hijongleh akisu-khen thei aum poi, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in anitah lhon'a asem ahi.
en: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is the maker of them all.
text:
PRO 22:2
Thadou: Mihao hihen mivaicha hijongleh akisu-khen thei aum poi, ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in anitah lhon'a asem ahi.
English: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is the maker of them all.

tcz: Miching chun alungthim in hahsatna hung lhung ding avephan, ama le ama akivengdoh jin ahi. Hinlah mi lungthim bei le ima kholtoh louva machalpi chun gimna ato tei ding ahi.
en: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
text:
PRO 22:3
Thadou: Miching chun alungthim in hahsatna hung lhung ding avephan, ama le ama akivengdoh jin ahi. Hinlah mi lungthim bei le ima kholtoh louva machalpi chun gimna ato tei ding ahi.
English: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

tcz: Kineosah pum le Elohim Pathen gin jeh'a kipaman chu haosatna jouse, jabolna chule hinna ahi.
en: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life.
text:
PRO 22:4
Thadou: Kineosah pum le Elohim Pathen gin jeh'a kipaman chu haosatna jouse, jabolna chule hinna ahi.
English: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life.

tcz: Phatlouna jenga chonpa lam lhahna chu ling le khaovin abom jin, koi hileh ling le khao lah'a kiveng thempa chu hoidoh tei ding ahi.
en: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.
text:
PRO 22:5
Thadou: Phatlouna jenga chonpa lam lhahna chu ling le khaovin abom jin, koi hileh ling le khao lah'a kiveng thempa chu hoidoh tei ding ahi.
English: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.

tcz: Chapang chu lamdih jenga khoukhah in, chutileh akhanlhit geija asuhmil lou ding aki lhonpi jing ding ahi.
en: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
text:
PRO 22:6
Thadou: Chapang chu lamdih jenga khoukhah in, chutileh akhanlhit geija asuhmil lou ding aki lhonpi jing ding ahi.
English: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

tcz: Mihao in mivaichate chunga vai ahom in, chule sum bapa jong abatsah napa soh'in apang e.
en: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
text:
PRO 22:7
Thadou: Mihao in mivaichate chunga vai ahom in, chule sum bapa jong abatsah napa soh'in apang e.
English: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.

tcz: Koi hileh thu adihlou'a tan chun hamsetna ato tei ding, amapa chu lunghang henlang mol-a pansa jongleh, apansahna mol chu atahsa chunga lechuh ding ahibouve.
en: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
text:
PRO 22:8
Thadou: Koi hileh thu adihlou'a tan chun hamsetna ato tei ding, amapa chu lunghang henlang mol-a pansa jongleh, apansahna mol chu atahsa chunga lechuh ding ahibouve.
English: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

tcz: Koi hileh midang mit-ha phatah'a vepa chu phatthei chang ding, ajeh chu aman aneh ding an chu vaicha ho apejin ahi.
en: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.
text:
PRO 22:9
Thadou: Koi hileh midang mit-ha phatah'a vepa chu phatthei chang ding, ajeh chu aman aneh ding an chu vaicha ho apejin ahi.
English: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.

tcz: Miphalou chon chavei ho chu no-mang un, chutileh kinahna jong beiyin tin, baotamna jouse jong thip hel ding ahi.
en: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
text:
PRO 22:10
Thadou: Miphalou chon chavei ho chu no-mang un, chutileh kinahna jong beiyin tin, baotamna jouse jong thip hel ding ahi.
English: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in mi lungtheng chu angailun, Koi hileh O ngei sel'a thusei chun lengpa jeng jong gol le paija akisem thei ahi.
en: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
text:
PRO 22:11
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in mi lungtheng chu angailun, Koi hileh O ngei sel'a thusei chun lengpa jeng jong gol le paija akisem thei ahi.
English: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.

tcz: Yahweh Pakai in hetna kiti hi Amit tenin ave-jing in, chule kitahna bei mi chu apaidoh jin ahi.
en: The LORD’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
text:
PRO 22:12
Thadou: Yahweh Pakai in hetna kiti hi Amit tenin ave-jing in, chule kitahna bei mi chu apaidoh jin ahi.
English: The LORD’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

tcz: Mithasen aseijin, “hichea khun keipi bahkai aum in, potdoh leng kholai dunga ei-tha ding ahi” ati.
en: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”
text:
PRO 22:13
Thadou: Mithasen aseijin, “hichea khun keipi bahkai aum in, potdoh leng kholai dunga ei-tha ding ahi” ati.
English: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”

tcz: Jonlungpu numeinu kamsung hi, kokhuh thuh tah ahin, Yahweh Pakai lung hansah chan chu hiche kokhuh sunga hi lhalut tei ding ahi.
en: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under the LORD’s wrath will fall into it.
text:
PRO 22:14
Thadou: Jonlungpu numeinu kamsung hi, kokhuh thuh tah ahin, Yahweh Pakai lung hansah chan chu hiche kokhuh sunga hi lhalut tei ding ahi.
English: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under the LORD’s wrath will fall into it.

tcz: Chapang lungthim sunga hi ngolna dimset ahin, hinlah achunga hilchahna aum teng, ngolna chu bei tei ding ahi.
en: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
text:
PRO 22:15
Thadou: Chapang lungthim sunga hi ngolna dimset ahin, hinlah achunga hilchahna aum teng, ngolna chu bei tei ding ahi.
English: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

tcz: Hao ding deija mivaicha sugentheija chule ahaopa pehbe mi chu vaichat nan aphah ding ahi.
en: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
text:
PRO 22:16
Thadou: Hao ding deija mivaicha sugentheija chule ahaopa pehbe mi chu vaichat nan aphah ding ahi.
English: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.

tcz: Nana hong phan lang miching ho thumop ngaiphan, chule kahetna hi nalung sunga het tei ding gon lang kisanlut in;
en: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche ho jouse hi nalung sunga nachin leh, nangma dinga lung nopna'a pang ding, chule aboncha nakam'a na phondoh thei teng, nalung lhai ding ahi.
en: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
text:
PRO 22:18
Thadou: Ajeh chu hiche ho jouse hi nalung sunga nachin leh, nangma dinga lung nopna'a pang ding, chule aboncha nakam'a na phondoh thei teng, nalung lhai ding ahi.
English: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaija nakison theina dinga, tunia hi keiman nangma jah-tah'a kaseipeh nahi.
en: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in the LORD.
text:
PRO 22:19
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakaija nakison theina dinga, tunia hi keiman nangma jah-tah'a kaseipeh nahi.
English: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in the LORD.

tcz: Keiman nakom'a thumopna le hetthemna thucheng phatah tah kasutdoh peh nahi lou ham?
en: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
text:
PRO 22:20
Thadou: Keiman nakom'a thumopna le hetthemna thucheng phatah tah kasutdoh peh nahi lou ham?
English: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,

tcz: Hitiahi nangman thutah hochu nahet them'a, chutengleh nahinsol ho ang-a thu adih'a na donbut theina dinga kahil nahi.
en: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
text:
PRO 22:21
Thadou: Hitiahi nangman thutah hochu nahet them'a, chutengleh nahinsol ho ang-a thu adih'a na donbut theina dinga kahil nahi.
English: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?

tcz: Najotho man'in mivaicha ho chom hih in, ama chu vaicha tahbeh ahi.
en: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi amaho vengtup a pang ahin, koi hileh amaho sumang achu Aman asuhmang ding ahi.
en: for the LORD will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
text:
PRO 22:23
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai hi amaho vengtup a pang ahin, koi hileh amaho sumang achu Aman asuhmang ding ahi.
English: for the LORD will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.

tcz: Milung chom le lunghang jing hotoh kivop dan, chule mi lungsa jing hoto jong chekhom hih in.
en: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,
text:
PRO 22:24
Thadou: Milung chom le lunghang jing hotoh kivop dan, chule mi lungsa jing hoto jong chekhom hih in.
English: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,

tcz: Hitia chu naum louleh ama tobanga nachon ding, chepaina'a nanei loa nahinkho lamvai ding ahi.
en: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.
text:
PRO 22:25
Thadou: Hitia chu naum louleh ama tobanga nachon ding, chepaina'a nanei loa nahinkho lamvai ding ahi.
English: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.

tcz: Bat lahna'a batman a kitung doh ho bang in, batsah nan kimoh tun hih in.
en: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
text:
PRO 22:26
Thadou: Bat lahna'a batman a kitung doh ho bang in, batsah nan kimoh tun hih in.
English: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.

tcz: Asahna ding ima naneitah lou jongleh, nalupna jalkhun geijin pedoh jeng tan.
en: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
text:
PRO 22:27
Thadou: Asahna ding ima naneitah lou jongleh, nalupna jalkhun geijin pedoh jeng tan.
English: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

tcz: Napu Napa khang apat gamgi melchihna song chu, nangman na chondoh lou ding ahi.
en: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.
text:
PRO 22:28
Thadou: Napu Napa khang apat gamgi melchihna song chu, nangman na chondoh lou ding ahi.
English: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.

tcz: Lolhingtah'a natong khut them namudoh lou ham? Amachu lengpa ang-sunga bou ding ding, michavei masanga vang ding thei lou ding ahi.
en: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
text:
PRO 22:29
Thadou: Lolhingtah'a natong khut them namudoh lou ham? Amachu lengpa ang-sunga bou ding ding, michavei masanga vang ding thei lou ding ahi.
English: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.

tcz: Thunei vaihom khat toh ankong sohkhom dinga naum tengleh, na ang-sunga kiloi chengse chu melchih in.
en: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;

tcz: Milop nahileh nalol chutoh chemcha kanbeh jeng in.
en: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.
text:
PRO 23:2
Thadou: Milop nahileh nalol chutoh chemcha kanbeh jeng in.
English: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

tcz: Vaihompa neh ding anho chu ducha hih in, ajeh chu nangma lhep lhahna ding an jeng ahi.
en: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.
text:
PRO 23:3
Thadou: Vaihompa neh ding anho chu ducha hih in, ajeh chu nangma lhep lhahna ding an jeng ahi.
English: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.

tcz: Haodoh ding ngaito na boujeh in na-tong hih in, chule jou le phatlou a kon in haodoh ding jong ngaito hih in.
en: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
text:
PRO 23:4
Thadou: Haodoh ding ngaito na boujeh in na-tong hih in, chule jou le phatlou a kon in haodoh ding jong ngaito hih in.
English: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.

tcz: Hitia haodohna dia namu chan chu miphetkah louva mang ding ahi. Ajeh chu chomlou kah'in muvanlai bang in vanlam angan aleng mang jitai.
en: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
text:
PRO 23:5
Thadou: Hitia haodohna dia namu chan chu miphetkah louva mang ding ahi. Ajeh chu chomlou kah'in muvanlai bang in vanlam angan aleng mang jitai.
English: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

tcz: Muda sasa'a navepa toh an nekhom hih in, aneh chu tuitah hijongleh ducha hih in.
en: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,
text:
PRO 23:6
Thadou: Muda sasa'a navepa toh an nekhom hih in, aneh chu tuitah hijongleh ducha hih in.
English: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,

tcz: Amapa chu alung thim in aphun in, nangma jah din, “Haneh in lang, hadon in don in” tia asei vang chun alung thim in nathet bouve.
en: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
text:
PRO 23:7
Thadou: Amapa chu alung thim in aphun in, nangma jah din, “Haneh in lang, hadon in don in” tia asei vang chun alung thim in nathet bouve.
English: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

tcz: Nangman themcha naneh jong chu naloh lhah ding, chule lunglhai nathu nasei jouse jong pannabei soh ding ahi.
en: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.
text:
PRO 23:8
Thadou: Nangman themcha naneh jong chu naloh lhah ding, chule lunglhai nathu nasei jouse jong pannabei soh ding ahi.
English: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.

tcz: Mingol ho jah ding in houlim boldan, ajeh chu chihna thu nasei jouse imalouvin gel khaget inte.
en: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
text:
PRO 23:9
Thadou: Mingol ho jah ding in houlim boldan, ajeh chu chihna thu nasei jouse imalouvin gel khaget inte.
English: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

tcz: Gol lui laija pat umsa gamgi song chu nabodoh lou hel ding, chule nu le pa neilou chagate lou-laia jong chelut hih in.
en: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
text:
PRO 23:10
Thadou: Gol lui laija pat umsa gamgi song chu nabodoh lou hel ding, chule nu le pa neilou chagate lou-laia jong chelut hih in.
English: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho lhatdohpa chu mihat tah ahin, alhatdohpa tah uvin amaho athumop a apanhu ding ahi.
en: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
text:
PRO 23:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu amaho lhatdohpa chu mihat tah ahin, alhatdohpa tah uvin amaho athumop a apanhu ding ahi.
English: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

tcz: Nalung thim in nakihilna ngaisang in lang, hetthemna thu kisei chengse jong ngai phan.
en: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
text:
PRO 23:12
Thadou: Nalung thim in nakihilna ngaisang in lang, hetthemna thu kisei chengse jong ngai phan.
English: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

tcz: Na chate chu gahna beijin koihih in, nangman mol-lam jong le chun thilou diu;
en: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

tcz: Chule nangman achunga mol nalap-a ahileh, thina lampia kon nahuhdoh ding joh ahibouve.
en: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.
text:
PRO 23:14
Thadou: Chule nangman achunga mol nalap-a ahileh, thina lampia kon nahuhdoh ding joh ahibouve.
English: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

tcz: Kachapa, nangman chihna lungthim nanei poule, keima jong kipah ding kahi.
en: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.
text:
PRO 23:15
Thadou: Kachapa, nangman chihna lungthim nanei poule, keima jong kipah ding kahi.
English: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

tcz: Thudih chu nakam sunga kon nasei teng, keima lhagao jong kipah lheh ding ahi.
en: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
text:
PRO 23:16
Thadou: Thudih chu nakam sunga kon nasei teng, keima lhagao jong kipah lheh ding ahi.
English: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

tcz: Nalung thim in mi chonsete thang thip-pi dan, amavang nitin a Yahweh Pakai nagin ding ahi.
en: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.
text:
PRO 23:17
Thadou: Nalung thim in mi chonsete thang thip-pi dan, amavang nitin a Yahweh Pakai nagin ding ahi.
English: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.

tcz: Adih tah in nikho hung lhung dinga kinepna khat aum jing e, nangma kinepna jong mangthah lou hel ding ahi.
en: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
text:
PRO 23:18
Thadou: Adih tah in nikho hung lhung dinga kinepna khat aum jing e, nangma kinepna jong mangthah lou hel ding ahi.
English: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.

tcz: Kachapa ngai tem in, chule chingthei tah in um in, nalung thim in lamdih jenga lam lhah ding ngaiton.
en: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
text:
PRO 23:19
Thadou: Kachapa ngai tem in, chule chingthei tah in um in, nalung thim in lamdih jenga lam lhah ding ngaiton.
English: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!

tcz: Ju-kham holah a lha-hih beh in, sane holah jenga jong jao ding geldan.
en: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;

tcz: Ajeh chu ju le sa'a lop chan chu vaichat nan alhun khum diu, chule emut so nan atom u va ponse tobang diu ahi.
en: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
text:
PRO 23:21
Thadou: Ajeh chu ju le sa'a lop chan chu vaichat nan alhun khum diu, chule emut so nan atom u va ponse tobang diu ahi.
English: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

tcz: Nahinga napa thumop ngai jing in, nanu jong ateh teng thetbol hih hel in.
en: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
text:
PRO 23:22
Thadou: Nahinga napa thumop ngai jing in, nanu jong ateh teng thetbol hih hel in.
English: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

tcz: Thutah chu kisan lut in lang pedoh hih in, chihna le kigah chahna chule hetthemna jong nakisan lut ding ahi.
en: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
text:
PRO 23:23
Thadou: Thutah chu kisan lut in lang pedoh hih in, chihna le kigah chahna chule hetthemna jong nakisan lut ding ahi.
English: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.

tcz: Chate adih teng apa athanom in akipah jin, chapa chingtah hingpa jong achapa chunga kipah lheh ding ahi.
en: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.
text:
PRO 23:24
Thadou: Chate adih teng apa athanom in akipah jin, chapa chingtah hingpa jong achapa chunga kipah lheh ding ahi.
English: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.

tcz: Hijeh chun nanu le napa kipah thanom in umsah jing in, chule nahing nu nanu jong kipah tah'in umsah jing in.
en: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!
text:
PRO 23:25
Thadou: Hijeh chun nanu le napa kipah thanom in umsah jing in, chule nahing nu nanu jong kipah tah'in umsah jing in.
English: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!

tcz: O Kachapa, nalung thim neipen lang, kanun le khan abonchan namit tenin vepha tan.
en: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
text:
PRO 23:26
Thadou: O Kachapa, nalung thim neipen lang, kanun le khan abonchan namit tenin vepha tan.
English: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.

tcz: Numei kijoh hohi tijat um kokhuh tobang ahin, numei hija jonva le jong twikul tobang ahi.
en: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
text:
PRO 23:27
Thadou: Numei kijoh hohi tijat um kokhuh tobang ahin, numei hija jonva le jong twikul tobang ahi.
English: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

tcz: Amanu chun gucha michom tobang in mi achang lhih le jin, chule pasal tamtah akipal sah in asuchavei jitai.
en: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.
text:
PRO 23:28
Thadou: Amanu chun gucha michom tobang in mi achang lhih le jin, chule pasal tamtah akipal sah in asuchavei jitai.
English: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.

tcz: Koiham avangse a pang? Koiham genthei thoh a pang? Koiham mitoh kiphun? Chule Koiham aki-engsah?
en: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
text:
PRO 23:29
Thadou: Koiham avangse a pang? Koiham genthei thoh a pang? Koiham mitoh kiphun? Chule Koiham aki-engsah?
English: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

tcz: Hitobang miho chu ju-phung dalha louva tou chule jua lop ho ahiuve.
en: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.
text:
PRO 23:30
Thadou: Hitobang miho chu ju-phung dalha louva tou chule jua lop ho ahiuve.
English: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.

tcz: Ju chu asan keikui teng vehih beh in, chule khon na vetnom umtah hihen lang; bailam tah a gah don thei di hi jong le, vetding jong go-hih hel in.
en: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
text:
PRO 23:31
Thadou: Ju chu asan keikui teng vehih beh in, chule khon na vetnom umtah hihen lang; bailam tah a gah don thei di hi jong le, vetding jong go-hih hel in.
English: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.

tcz: Ajeh chu achaina teng gul gunei in mi achuh banga nachuh lo ding ahi.
en: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.
text:
PRO 23:32
Thadou: Ajeh chu achaina teng gul gunei in mi achuh banga nachuh lo ding ahi.
English: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.

tcz: Namit tenin thil kidang tahtah amu ding, nalunggel jeng jong kikalah lah ding ahi.
en: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
text:
PRO 23:33
Thadou: Namit tenin thil kidang tahtah amu ding, nalunggel jeng jong kikalah lah ding ahi.
English: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.

tcz: Chule twikhanglen lailunga lum den banga nalup den ding, konga kitungdoh khom chunga umpa banga naum'a nalup den ding ahi.
en: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
text:
PRO 23:34
Thadou: Chule twikhanglen lailunga lum den banga nalup den ding, konga kitungdoh khom chunga umpa banga naum'a nalup den ding ahi.
English: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:

tcz: Chutengleh “amaho hin eivo tauve,” tia nasei ding, hinlah “eivoh nau maha ima kamupoi,” amahon eivo nauvin, ahinlah kathoh lal poi. Kakhahdoh teng aban kahol nah lai ding ahi, tia nasei ding ahi.
en: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”
text:
PRO 23:35
Thadou: Chutengleh “amaho hin eivo tauve,” tia nasei ding, hinlah “eivoh nau maha ima kamupoi,” amahon eivo nauvin, ahinlah kathoh lal poi. Kakhahdoh teng aban kahol nah lai ding ahi, tia nasei ding ahi.
English: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”
