tcz: Miphalou ho umchan thangse hih in, chule hitobang miho chu kiloipi din jong ngaicha hih-in.
en: Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;

tcz: Ajeh chu alung thim un thilse jeng agong un, akamdung uva jou le nal jeng aseijun ahi.
en: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief.
text:
PRO 24:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu alung thim un thilse jeng agong un, akamdung uva jou le nal jeng aseijun ahi.
English: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief.

tcz: Chihna jeh chun in akisadoh jin, chule hetkhen themna jal-a kitungdet ji ahi.
en: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;

tcz: Hetkhen themna akon insung dann jousea, thil manlutah tah le; lung lhaina thilpha chom haona dimset-ji ahi.
en: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
text:
PRO 24:4
Thadou: Hetkhen themna akon insung dann jousea, thil manlutah tah le; lung lhaina thilpha chom haona dimset-ji ahi.
English: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.

tcz: Miching chu mi thahat sang in ahat jon, hetna nei mi jong atha hatpa sang in ahat cheh jin ahi.
en: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,
text:
PRO 24:5
Thadou: Miching chu mi thahat sang in ahat jon, hetna nei mi jong atha hatpa sang in ahat cheh jin ahi.
English: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh lungthim thepna jal-a gal kisatji ahin, chule gal jona jong thumop them hoa kingam ahi.
en: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.
text:
PRO 24:6
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itileh lungthim thepna jal-a gal kisatji ahin, chule gal jona jong thumop them hoa kingam ahi.
English: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.

tcz: Chihna hi mingol ho din meiphah ahipon, thutanna kotpi mai lah'in jong seiding aneiji tapouve.
en: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.
text:
PRO 24:7
Thadou: Chihna hi mingol ho din meiphah ahipon, thutanna kotpi mai lah'in jong seiding aneiji tapouve.
English: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.

tcz: Koi hileh thilse bol ding ngaito chan chu, jou le nal-a natongpa tia kikou ding ahi.
en: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.
text:
PRO 24:8
Thadou: Koi hileh thilse bol ding ngaito chan chu, jou le nal-a natongpa tia kikou ding ahi.
English: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.

tcz: Mingol ho thilse gonhi chonset ahin, mi ahilou lam'a tot chaveipa jong mi jousen athet ahibouve.
en: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.
text:
PRO 24:9
Thadou: Mingol ho thilse gonhi chonset ahin, mi ahilou lam'a tot chaveipa jong mi jousen athet ahibouve.
English: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.

tcz: Kidoupin nahin phah nikho teng jongleh lung lhadai hih in, ajeh chu lhahsamna'a nanei cheh ding ahibouve.
en: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.
text:
PRO 24:10
Thadou: Kidoupin nahin phah nikho teng jongleh lung lhadai hih in, ajeh chu lhahsamna'a nanei cheh ding ahibouve.
English: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.

tcz: Thina lam jon-a kijot hokhu huhhing loijin, chule min athagamna dinga kipal-lhu ho jong huhdoh loijin.
en: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
text:
PRO 24:11
Thadou: Thina lam jon-a kijot hokhu huhhing loijin, chule min athagamna dinga kipal-lhu ho jong huhdoh loijin.
English: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!

tcz: Nangman, “vetem in, keihon hiche hi kahe phapouve,” tin nasei in, Ama bouvin mihem lungthim akholchil-a ahet chin ji hilou ham? Nalhagao vea ching jing pan hitobang hi amelchih jing hilou ham? Aman mihem koi hileh atoh dungjui cheh-a lethuhna anei ding hilou ham?
en: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not render to every man according to his work?
text:
PRO 24:12
Thadou: Nangman, “vetem in, keihon hiche hi kahe phapouve,” tin nasei in, Ama bouvin mihem lungthim akholchil-a ahet chin ji hilou ham? Nalhagao vea ching jing pan hitobang hi amelchih jing hilou ham? Aman mihem koi hileh atoh dungjui cheh-a lethuhna anei ding hilou ham?
English: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not render to every man according to his work?

tcz: Kachapa, khoiju hi don in atui lheh jeng e, khoi-phanga apat hung pot khoiju hi nele chun alhum'a lhum ahi.
en: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;

tcz: Chihna kiti hi nalhagao dinga hiche tobang chu ahi. Chule chihna hi namu jouva ahileh khonung dinga phachom tah ahi.
en: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.
text:
PRO 24:14
Thadou: Chihna kiti hi nalhagao dinga hiche tobang chu ahi. Chule chihna hi namu jouva ahileh khonung dinga phachom tah ahi.
English: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.

tcz: Miphalou bang in mikitah pa chu a-in pang dunga ga chang lhih hih in, mikitah pa in jong chomding gohih hel in.
en: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh mikitah kiti hi vel sagi jen lhu jongleh, athoudoh thei jin, hinlah miphalou ho chunga hamsetna ahung lhun teng akhup athal in aleh jitai.
en: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
text:
PRO 24:16
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itileh mikitah kiti hi vel sagi jen lhu jongleh, athoudoh thei jin, hinlah miphalou ho chunga hamsetna ahung lhun teng akhup athal in aleh jitai.
English: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

tcz: Namelma akipal lhuh teng kipanan neihih hel in, aman kipal lhuhna ato khah jongleh kipa thanopna'a nanei lou ding ahi.
en: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,
text:
PRO 24:17
Thadou: Namelma akipal lhuh teng kipanan neihih hel in, aman kipal lhuhna ato khah jongleh kipa thanopna'a nanei lou ding ahi.
English: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,

tcz: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in hin mudoh leh, lunghanna'a anei loding ahi. Hijeh chun ama kon chun Yahweh Pakai lunghanna peldoh in.
en: lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
text:
PRO 24:18
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yahweh Pakai in hin mudoh leh, lunghanna'a anei loding ahi. Hijeh chun ama kon chun Yahweh Pakai lunghanna peldoh in.
English: lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

tcz: Thilse bol ho jeh in nang le nang kisih hih in, chule achon chan-u jong thangsetpi dan.
en: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;

tcz: Ajeh chu miphalou ding in khonung thua kinepna abeiyin, chule migilou ho thaomei kimut mit peh tei ding ahi.
en: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.
text:
PRO 24:20
Thadou: Ajeh chu miphalou ding in khonung thua kinepna abeiyin, chule migilou ho thaomei kimut mit peh tei ding ahi.
English: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

tcz: Kachapa, Yahweh Pakai le lengpa ging in lang, Anitah lhon-a athua nanun ding ahi.
en: My son, fear the LORD and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,
text:
PRO 24:21
Thadou: Kachapa, Yahweh Pakai le lengpa ging in lang, Anitah lhon-a athua nanun ding ahi.
English: My son, fear the LORD and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,

tcz: Ajeh chu Amania kon hetman louva hamsetna hung lhung ding, Yahweh Pakai le lengpa'a kon hung lhung ding manthahna chu koiman ahe thei poi.
en: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both?
text:
PRO 24:22
Thadou: Ajeh chu Amania kon hetman louva hamsetna hung lhung ding, Yahweh Pakai le lengpa'a kon hung lhung ding manthahna chu koiman ahe thei poi.
English: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both?

tcz: Hicheho jouse jong hi miching ho thusei ahisoh keijin: Thutan-a langneina nei kiti jong hi thildih ahipoi.
en: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.
text:
PRO 24:23
Thadou: Hicheho jouse jong hi miching ho thusei ahisoh keijin: Thutan-a langneina nei kiti jong hi thildih ahipoi.
English: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.

tcz: Migiloupa kom'a, “Nangman themmona nanei poi,” tia sei chu, mitin vaipi gaosap chang ding, namtin in athet ding ahi.
en: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—
text:
PRO 24:24
Thadou: Migiloupa kom'a, “Nangman themmona nanei poi,” tia sei chu, mitin vaipi gaosap chang ding, namtin in athet ding ahi.
English: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—

tcz: Miphalou phohsal pa chu kipah thanom'a um ding, chule hitobang mi chunga chu phattheina lhung ding ahi.
en: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.
text:
PRO 24:25
Thadou: Miphalou phohsal pa chu kipah thanom'a um ding, chule hitobang mi chunga chu phattheina lhung ding ahi.
English: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.

tcz: Thu kitohdel-a donbutna chu kigolngai kibeng chop avetsah ahi.
en: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
text:
PRO 24:26
Thadou: Thu kitohdel-a donbutna chu kigolngai kibeng chop avetsah ahi.
English: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

tcz: Polam'a natoh ding abonchan kigontoh in lang, chule lou laija natohna ding aboncha naki gonsoh keija; chujou tengleh na chenna ding in sapan tan.
en: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.
text:
PRO 24:27
Thadou: Polam'a natoh ding abonchan kigontoh in lang, chule lou laija natohna ding aboncha naki gonsoh keija; chujou tengleh na chenna ding in sapan tan.
English: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.

tcz: Ajeh beijin naheng nakom dounan hettohsah in pang hih in, nakam sunga jouthu jong seitahih in.
en: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.
text:
PRO 24:28
Thadou: Ajeh beijin naheng nakom dounan hettohsah in pang hih in, nakam sunga jouthu jong seitahih in.
English: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.

tcz: Mi kom'a “Kachunga anatoh bang banga keiman jong achunga katoh ding ahi; chule anatoh bang banga kalethuh tei ding ahi,” tin jong seidan.
en: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”
text:
PRO 24:29
Thadou: Mi kom'a “Kachunga anatoh bang banga keiman jong achunga katoh ding ahi; chule anatoh bang banga kalethuh tei ding ahi,” tin jong seidan.
English: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”

tcz: Keiman mithase khat loulai kahin jot pan, lungthimbei mikhat lengpilei kaho pan ahi.
en: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding.
text:
PRO 24:30
Thadou: Keiman mithase khat loulai kahin jot pan, lungthimbei mikhat lengpilei kaho pan ahi.
English: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding.

tcz: Hiche loulai chu apum chang in lingle khao akhul lha jeng in, atollham jenga jong ling adimset in, apal jong achimsoh tan ahi.
en: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.
text:
PRO 24:31
Thadou: Hiche loulai chu apum chang in lingle khao akhul lha jeng in, atollham jenga jong ling adimset in, apal jong achimsoh tan ahi.
English: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.

tcz: Hichun keiman kaven kagel in, hichea kon hin kihilna khat kaki mudoh in ahi.
en: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:
text:
PRO 24:32
Thadou: Hichun keiman kaven kagel in, hichea kon hin kihilna khat kaki mudoh in ahi.
English: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:

tcz: Jalkhun a imut jengseh, kichol ding bouseh, chule khut teni umthim sah-a kichol ding kati tai.
en: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,
text:
PRO 24:33
Thadou: Jalkhun a imut jengseh, kichol ding bouseh, chule khut teni umthim sah-a kichol ding kati tai.
English: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,

tcz: Gucha le michom in mi abulhu banga vaichat nan nahin lhun den ding, nahin delkhumpa bang banga kel thoa um ding nahitai.
en: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.
text:
PRO 24:34
Thadou: Gucha le michom in mi abulhu banga vaichat nan nahin lhun den ding, nahin delkhumpa bang banga kel thoa um ding nahitai.
English: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.

tcz: Hiche ho jong hi Solomon thuchih jeng ahina nalai jin, Judah lengpa Hezekiah phat laija mihon ana jihdoh ahi.
en: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
text:
PRO 25:1
Thadou: Hiche ho jong hi Solomon thuchih jeng ahina nalai jin, Judah lengpa Hezekiah phat laija mihon ana jihdoh ahi.
English: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

tcz: Thugil chintup nahi Elohim Pathen loupina ahin, chule thil kholdoh kiti jong hi lengte loupina ahi.
en: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
text:
PRO 25:2
Thadou: Thugil chintup nahi Elohim Pathen loupina ahin, chule thil kholdoh kiti jong hi lengte loupina ahi.
English: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

tcz: Vanmun jouse asandan le leiset athuh bang hin, lengte lungthim sung jeng jong koiman ahedoh joupoi.
en: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.
text:
PRO 25:3
Thadou: Vanmun jouse asandan le leiset athuh bang hin, lengte lungthim sung jeng jong koiman ahedoh joupoi.
English: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

tcz: Dangka'a kon in atheng lou jouse ladoh jeng in, thih khengpan bel-a khen ding atah chu aneinai.
en: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.
text:
PRO 25:4
Thadou: Dangka'a kon in atheng lou jouse ladoh jeng in, thih khengpan bel-a khen ding atah chu aneinai.
English: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.

tcz: Lengpa thutanna mun'a kon chun migilou chu potdoh sah jeng in, chutileh lengpa laltouna mun'a chu thudih kiphut det thei ding ahi.
en: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.
text:
PRO 25:5
Thadou: Lengpa thutanna mun'a kon chun migilou chu potdoh sah jeng in, chutileh lengpa laltouna mun'a chu thudih kiphut det thei ding ahi.
English: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.

tcz: Lengpa angsunga nama cham in chelut dan, chule milen ang-sunga jong kikum lut jeng hih in.
en: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;

tcz: Hitia hi, “Hiche mun'a hin hung kal touvin,” tia min nahin kou masat ding chu thilpha ahi. Chule milen milal umna imacham tah'a lut jeng chu thilpha ahipoi.
en: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.
text:
PRO 25:7
Thadou: Hitia hi, “Hiche mun'a hin hung kal touvin,” tia min nahin kou masat ding chu thilpha ahi. Chule milen milal umna imacham tah'a lut jeng chu thilpha ahipoi.
English: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.

tcz: Nangman thilkhat namu jeng man in, kihehna-in achun lhut jeng hih in, ajeh chu nahehpa chun najou henlang jumtale chun achaina ipi nabol ding hitam?
en: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?
text:
PRO 25:8
Thadou: Nangman thilkhat namu jeng man in, kihehna-in achun lhut jeng hih in, ajeh chu nahehpa chun najou henlang jumtale chun achaina ipi nabol ding hitam?
English: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?

tcz: Hiche sang chun, naheng nakompa toh chun nachung chang thu seikhom lhon in lang, thuguh kiti phot midang hetsah hih in.
en: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,
text:
PRO 25:9
Thadou: Hiche sang chun, naheng nakompa toh chun nachung chang thu seikhom lhon in lang, thuguh kiti phot midang hetsah hih in.
English: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,

tcz: Ajeh chu naseidoh'a midang khattou in jataleh aja khat chun, nahinle jumso nabep ding, chuteng namin setna chu beita lou ding ahi.
en: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.
text:
PRO 25:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu naseidoh'a midang khattou in jataleh aja khat chun, nahinle jumso nabep ding, chuteng namin setna chu beita lou ding ahi.
English: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.

tcz: Aphatcha ki hil na chu deium tah ahi, dangka bomma kikoi sana tabang ahi.
en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
text:
PRO 25:11
Thadou: Aphatcha ki hil na chu deium tah ahi, dangka bomma kikoi sana tabang ahi.
English: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

tcz: Mithusei phatah'a ngaipa ding in, adih a kiphona hi sanakol le sana pah-jem tobang ahi.
en: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
text:
PRO 25:12
Thadou: Mithusei phatah'a ngaipa ding in, adih a kiphona hi sanakol le sana pah-jem tobang ahi.
English: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

tcz: Tahsan thei tah sottole sol khapa ding in, hiche sottole chu chang-at laija buhbang votjen tobang ahin; hitobang sottole hi apupa lhagao lungthim sung kido jing na ahi.
en: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.
text:
PRO 25:13
Thadou: Tahsan thei tah sottole sol khapa ding in, hiche sottole chu chang-at laija buhbang votjen tobang ahin; hitobang sottole hi apupa lhagao lungthim sung kido jing na ahi.
English: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.

tcz: Thilpeh khat pe-dinga kitepna neija peloupa chu, huijin apohle meilom goa julha lou tobang ahi.
en: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.
text:
PRO 25:14
Thadou: Thilpeh khat pe-dinga kitepna neija peloupa chu, huijin apohle meilom goa julha lou tobang ahi.
English: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.

tcz: Thoh hattah'a natoh jeh'in vaihom khat jong akithu nun jou in, o nem heova thu kiseijin gu le chang jeng jong anemsah e.
en: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.
text:
PRO 25:15
Thadou: Thoh hattah'a natoh jeh'in vaihom khat jong akithu nun jou in, o nem heova thu kiseijin gu le chang jeng jong anemsah e.
English: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

tcz: Khoiju naneh teng aphabep don in, ajeh chu nachim behseh ding; achaina leh naloh lhah lo ding ahi.
en: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.
text:
PRO 25:16
Thadou: Khoiju naneh teng aphabep don in, ajeh chu nachim behseh ding; achaina leh naloh lhah lo ding ahi.
English: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.

tcz: Naheng nakom in-sunga che behseh hih in, ajeh chu nahin thei chim lo ding ahi.
en: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.
text:
PRO 25:17
Thadou: Naheng nakom in-sunga che behseh hih in, ajeh chu nahin thei chim lo ding ahi.
English: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.

tcz: Koi hileh aheng akom hehsea panga chu, galsat dinga mi koukhom le chemjam hemtah chule thalchanga kikap tobang ahi.
en: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.
text:
PRO 25:18
Thadou: Koi hileh aheng akom hehsea panga chu, galsat dinga mi koukhom le chemjam hemtah chule thalchanga kikap tobang ahi.
English: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.

tcz: Gim le hesoh pet'a tahsan thei lou mikhat ngansena nei hi, habeija thilkhat kipet le keng phalou tollham chon-nal tobang bep ahibouve.
en: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.
text:
PRO 25:19
Thadou: Gim le hesoh pet'a tahsan thei lou mikhat ngansena nei hi, habeija thilkhat kipet le keng phalou tollham chon-nal tobang bep ahibouve.
English: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.

tcz: Mi gim hesoh pet'a lasa'a chu, phalbi dap laija mi ponsil lahpeh tobang ahi.
en: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
text:
PRO 25:20
Thadou: Mi gim hesoh pet'a lasa'a chu, phalbi dap laija mi ponsil lahpeh tobang ahi.
English: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

tcz: Nagalmi chu agil akel teng nehding changlhah pen, chule adang achah leh don ding twi pen.
en: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;

tcz: Hitia nabol pehchu alujang dim a mei-al sunpeh nahin, natoh-ga Yahweh Pakai in kipaman napeh tei ding ahi.
en: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you.
text:
PRO 25:22
Thadou: Hitia nabol pehchu alujang dim a mei-al sunpeh nahin, natoh-ga Yahweh Pakai in kipaman napeh tei ding ahi.
English: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you.

tcz: Sahlam khohui'in go ajuhsah jin, min adalhah nunga seisea chun lungphamo pua mi avetji ahi.
en: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.
text:
PRO 25:23
Thadou: Sahlam khohui'in go ajuhsah jin, min adalhah nunga seisea chun lungphamo pua mi avetji ahi.
English: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.

tcz: Numei phunsi khat toh in khat'a chen khom sang in, inting vum ningkoi khat'a ichangseh a chen aphajoi.
en: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
text:
PRO 25:24
Thadou: Numei phunsi khat toh in khat'a chen khom sang in, inting vum ningkoi khat'a ichangseh a chen aphajoi.
English: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

tcz: Gam latah'a pet thupha kija chu, dangchah pet'a twi votjen kidon tobang ahi.
en: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
text:
PRO 25:25
Thadou: Gam latah'a pet thupha kija chu, dangchah pet'a twi votjen kidon tobang ahi.
English: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

tcz: Mikitah khat in migilou khat pansatna ding lampi asempeh kiti chu, twisam putna le bonsan londohna twikun tobang ahi.
en: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.
text:
PRO 25:26
Thadou: Mikitah khat in migilou khat pansatna ding lampi asempeh kiti chu, twisam putna le bonsan londohna twikun tobang ahi.
English: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.

tcz: Khoiju tamtah don jong aphapon, chule thuphalou tampi sei jong apha ahipoi.
en: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.
text:
PRO 25:27
Thadou: Khoiju tamtah don jong aphapon, chule thuphalou tampi sei jong apha ahipoi.
English: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.

tcz: Ama le ama kitim joulou michu, khopi chimsa apal jouse kivo lhua kidalha bep ahi.
en: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
text:
PRO 25:28
Thadou: Ama le ama kitim joulou michu, khopi chimsa apal jouse kivo lhua kidalha bep ahi.
English: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.

tcz: Nipi laija buhbang kheh ding le chang-at laija gojuh ding akilom pon, hijeh chun mingol jana peh hi thil hahsa ahi.
en: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.
text:
PRO 26:1
Thadou: Nipi laija buhbang kheh ding le chang-at laija gojuh ding akilom pon, hijeh chun mingol jana peh hi thil hahsa ahi.
English: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.

tcz: Inva kichao hat le pelpalep lengle banga, ajeh beija kigaosapna chu gui lhung lou helding ahi.
en: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.
text:
PRO 26:2
Thadou: Inva kichao hat le pelpalep lengle banga, ajeh beija kigaosapna chu gui lhung lou helding ahi.
English: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.

tcz: Sakol dinga ajepna akisem peh'a, sangan akamdal akisempeh bang in, mingol jong chu ajepna dinga mol kisem ahi.
en: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!
text:
PRO 26:3
Thadou: Sakol dinga ajepna akisem peh'a, sangan akamdal akisempeh bang in, mingol jong chu ajepna dinga mol kisem ahi.
English: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!

tcz: Mingol chu angolna totoh in lethuh jeng dan, chutibol lechun koiman nahetkhen thei lou ding ahi.
en: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.
text:
PRO 26:4
Thadou: Mingol chu angolna totoh in lethuh jeng dan, chutibol lechun koiman nahetkhen thei lou ding ahi.
English: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.

tcz: Mingol chu angolna dungjui in donbut'in, achuti louva ahileh ama mitmua ching kisa ding ahi.
en: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.
text:
PRO 26:5
Thadou: Mingol chu angolna dungjui in donbut'in, achuti louva ahileh ama mitmua ching kisa ding ahi.
English: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.

tcz: Mingol khat chu thupolea naman chahle, nakeng kitanboh tobang chule thina gudon tobang nahi ding ahi.
en: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.
text:
PRO 26:6
Thadou: Mingol khat chu thupolea naman chahle, nakeng kitanboh tobang chule thina gudon tobang nahi ding ahi.
English: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.

tcz: Mingol kom'a thuchih kisei chu alangngoi panna bei tobang ahi.
en: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
text:
PRO 26:7
Thadou: Mingol kom'a thuchih kisei chu alangngoi panna bei tobang ahi.
English: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

tcz: Mingol jana kipe chu songsena bom'a, song chang ohden tobang bep ahi.
en: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.
text:
PRO 26:8
Thadou: Mingol jana kipe chu songsena bom'a, song chang ohden tobang bep ahi.
English: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.

tcz: Mingol kam'a thuchih kiphongdoh jihi, jukham khut ling in asut vangpai tobang ahi.
en: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
text:
PRO 26:9
Thadou: Mingol kam'a thuchih kiphongdoh jihi, jukham khut ling in asut vangpai tobang ahi.
English: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

tcz: Migoi pan mingol ham ahilouleh jukham hamkhat goikha achu, mi lah-a thal mohkap kappa tobang ahi.
en: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.
text:
PRO 26:10
Thadou: Migoi pan mingol ham ahilouleh jukham hamkhat goikha achu, mi lah-a thal mohkap kappa tobang ahi.
English: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.

tcz: Mingol in angol thu avelsei sei hi, aloh dohsa avel'a jonkit uicha tobang ahi.
en: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.
text:
PRO 26:11
Thadou: Mingol in angol thu avelsei sei hi, aloh dohsa avel'a jonkit uicha tobang ahi.
English: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.

tcz: Mihem ama le ama achinga kigel ho sang in, mingol din kinepna aum joi.
en: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
text:
PRO 26:12
Thadou: Mihem ama le ama achinga kigel ho sang in, mingol din kinepna aum joi.
English: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

tcz: Mithase pan asam'in “Lamlen'a keipi bahkai aum e, khulai dunga jong keipi bahkai aum'e kahei!” ati.
en: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”
text:
PRO 26:13
Thadou: Mithase pan asam'in “Lamlen'a keipi bahkai aum e, khulai dunga jong keipi bahkai aum'e kahei!” ati.
English: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”

tcz: Kotpi akol hom sunga akipei leji bang in, mithase jong ajalkhun chunga akihei le ji bouchu ahi jenge.
en: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.
text:
PRO 26:14
Thadou: Kotpi akol hom sunga akipei leji bang in, mithase jong ajalkhun chunga akihei le ji bouchu ahi jenge.
English: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.

tcz: Mithase chun akhut in bukong asoh jinan, hinlah akam geija akhut ledop ding athan ajou jitapoi.
en: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.
text:
PRO 26:15
Thadou: Mithase chun akhut in bukong asoh jinan, hinlah akam geija akhut ledop ding athan ajou jitapoi.
English: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

tcz: Miching thumop them sagi sang in, mingol chu ama changseh mitvet in akichihsah jin ahi.
en: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.
text:
PRO 26:16
Thadou: Miching thumop them sagi sang in, mingol chu ama changseh mitvet in akichihsah jin ahi.
English: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.

tcz: Akin louhel'a mi kinahna'a gaki kumpa chu, uicha lhaile abilkol'a matding go tobang ahi.
en: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.
text:
PRO 26:17
Thadou: Akin louhel'a mi kinahna'a gaki kumpa chu, uicha lhaile abilkol'a matding go tobang ahi.
English: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.

tcz: Mingol chon banga chon-jia aheng akom meise kaikhum a, chule thina thei thalpia kap jenga chu,
en: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,
text:
PRO 26:18
Thadou: Mingol chon banga chon-jia aheng akom meise kaikhum a, chule thina thei thalpia kap jenga chu,
English: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,

tcz: Aheng akom jou'a lhemlha ahin, “Katot ahipoi,” tin aseije.
en: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”
text:
PRO 26:19
Thadou: Aheng akom jou'a lhemlha ahin, “Katot ahipoi,” tin aseije.
English: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”

tcz: Meija man ding thing abei teng mei akon-theilou bang in, kiseiset tona abei teng kinahna jong athipdel jin ahi.
en: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.
text:
PRO 26:20
Thadou: Meija man ding thing abei teng mei akon-theilou bang in, kiseiset tona abei teng kinahna jong athipdel jin ahi.
English: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.

tcz: Vutsa lah'a hol akonbei bangle, thinggo meija akonbai bang in; mitoh kina jingpa chun, kinahna beilamtah in asodohsah jing in ahi.
en: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.
text:
PRO 26:21
Thadou: Vutsa lah'a hol akonbei bangle, thinggo meija akonbai bang in; mitoh kina jingpa chun, kinahna beilamtah in asodohsah jing in ahi.
English: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.

tcz: Thu kihou lhihna thei hol jing achu, an tuitah bang in aki ngaiton, mihem laigil sunga alut lhum mangjel jin ahi.
en: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.
text:
PRO 26:22
Thadou: Thu kihou lhihna thei hol jing achu, an tuitah bang in aki ngaiton, mihem laigil sunga alut lhum mangjel jin ahi.
English: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.

tcz: Gitlou lungpua muh tuisel'a thu kisei chu, phatvet maija leibel kitomjol sel tobang bep ahi.
en: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.
text:
PRO 26:23
Thadou: Gitlou lungpua muh tuisel'a thu kisei chu, phatvet maija leibel kitomjol sel tobang bep ahi.
English: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.

tcz: Mi thet jinga akamsunga phatmona selpa, alungthim a lhep lhahna jeng toh kivop,
en: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
text:
PRO 26:24
Thadou: Mi thet jinga akamsunga phatmona selpa, alungthim a lhep lhahna jeng toh kivop,
English: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.

tcz: Khotona neitah banga thu asei teng jongleh, hitobang mihem chu tahsan hih hel in; ajeh chu ama tobang mihem lung sunga hin deium loutah thil sagi achengin ahi.
en: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.
text:
PRO 26:25
Thadou: Khotona neitah banga thu asei teng jongleh, hitobang mihem chu tahsan hih hel in; ajeh chu ama tobang mihem lung sunga hin deium loutah thil sagi achengin ahi.
English: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.

tcz: Mi ajoubolna chu jonchih tah in kisel doh jong le, mipi maija aphatlouna kiphong jah tei ding ahi.
en: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.
text:
PRO 26:26
Thadou: Mi ajoubolna chu jonchih tah in kisel doh jong le, mipi maija aphatlouna kiphong jah tei ding ahi.
English: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

tcz: Koi hileh mi lhah lutna dinga khuh laija chu, amajoh lhalut ding chule michunga chu dia songtum tanga chu, asongtum tah chu ama chunga hung kiletah lut ding ahibouve.
en: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.
text:
PRO 26:27
Thadou: Koi hileh mi lhah lutna dinga khuh laija chu, amajoh lhalut ding chule michunga chu dia songtum tanga chu, asongtum tah chu ama chunga hung kiletah lut ding ahibouve.
English: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.

tcz: Thujou seina leigui hin mi asuh genthei ho chu ahot bol cheh jin, chule thujou jeng seija leigui hin manthahna jeng atongdoh in ahi.
en: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.
text:
PRO 26:28
Thadou: Thujou seina leigui hin mi asuh genthei ho chu ahot bol cheh jin, chule thujou jeng seija leigui hin manthahna jeng atongdoh in ahi.
English: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.

tcz: Jing nikhoa dingin kiletsah tothon thu seihih in, ajeh chu itobang nikho ahung lhun ding nahepoi.
en: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.
text:
PRO 27:1
Thadou: Jing nikhoa dingin kiletsah tothon thu seihih in, ajeh chu itobang nikho ahung lhun ding nahepoi.
English: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.

tcz: Nakamsunga nakipachat sangin, midang kipachat sah jon, chule nangle nang nakam sunga naki vahchoi sangin, hetkhahlou kholgam mi kivahchoi sah in.
en: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.
text:
PRO 27:2
Thadou: Nakamsunga nakipachat sangin, midang kipachat sah jon, chule nangle nang nakam sunga naki vahchoi sangin, hetkhahlou kholgam mi kivahchoi sah in.
English: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.

tcz: Songhi agih lheh in, neldi jong gihtah ahi. Hinlah mingol lunghanna hi neldi sanga jong gihjo nalai ahi.
en: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.
text:
PRO 27:3
Thadou: Songhi agih lheh in, neldi jong gihtah ahi. Hinlah mingol lunghanna hi neldi sanga jong gihjo nalai ahi.
English: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

tcz: Lunghan hi giloutah ahin, lungsat in jong mi achup jin; hinlah thangthipna hi akhoh jon ahi.
en: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
text:
PRO 27:4
Thadou: Lunghan hi giloutah ahin, lungsat in jong mi achup jin; hinlah thangthipna hi akhoh jon ahi.
English: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?

tcz: Aguh a kingailut sangin, lhang phonga kiphosal aphajoi.
en: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
text:
PRO 27:5
Thadou: Aguh a kingailut sangin, lhang phonga kiphosal aphajoi.
English: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.

tcz: Gol phatah'a kon kimavona chu kitah jal ahin, melman eibeng chop vang kilhep lhahna ahibouve.
en: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
text:
PRO 27:6
Thadou: Gol phatah'a kon kimavona chu kitah jal ahin, melman eibeng chop vang kilhep lhahna ahibouve.
English: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.

tcz: Mihem aoi-vasa dingin khoiju jeng jong lohso nabep ahin, agilkilpa din vang an tuimopen jong alhum tobang ahi.
en: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.
text:
PRO 27:7
Thadou: Mihem aoi-vasa dingin khoiju jeng jong lohso nabep ahin, agilkilpa din vang an tuimopen jong alhum tobang ahi.
English: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.

tcz: Ain'a kon vahmangpa chu, abusunga kon lengmang vahcha tobang ahi.
en: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.
text:
PRO 27:8
Thadou: Ain'a kon vahmangpa chu, abusunga kon lengmang vahcha tobang ahi.
English: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.

tcz: Thao le gimnamtui in mihem lungthim akipahsah jin, gim hesohna vang hin mihem lhagao athohlal sah jin ahi.
en: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
text:
PRO 27:9
Thadou: Thao le gimnamtui in mihem lungthim akipahsah jin, gim hesohna vang hin mihem lhagao athohlal sah jin ahi.
English: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.

tcz: Nagol hihen napagol hijongle nung sun hih in, hahsatnan nahin phah nikhon jong nasopipa in-a sunglha hih in; ajeh chu gam latah a um penpi sopi sang in, naicha um hengle kom aphachom joi.
en: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.
text:
PRO 27:10
Thadou: Nagol hihen napagol hijongle nung sun hih in, hahsatnan nahin phah nikhon jong nasopipa in-a sunglha hih in; ajeh chu gam latah a um penpi sopi sang in, naicha um hengle kom aphachom joi.
English: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.

tcz: Kachapa, chingthei jin kalungthim kipa sah jing in, chutileh eidoupa jeng jong kadonbut thei ding ahi.
en: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.
text:
PRO 27:11
Thadou: Kachapa, chingthei jin kalungthim kipa sah jing in, chutileh eidoupa jeng jong kadonbut thei ding ahi.
English: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.

tcz: Milung ching in thilphalou hung lhung ding ahethem masan, ama le ama ahoidoh theije, hinlah milham vang chu kho hephalou tah in aum in, gim hesoh atoh jin ahi.
en: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
text:
PRO 27:12
Thadou: Milung ching in thilphalou hung lhung ding ahethem masan, ama le ama ahoidoh theije, hinlah milham vang chu kho hephalou tah in aum in, gim hesoh atoh jin ahi.
English: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

tcz: Hetkhah lou mikhat batsah nadinga kitung pa chu, aponsil kichom peh jenga! Hetphalou mi dinga, hitobang mihem chu akipehdoh jeng thei nadem!
en: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!
text:
PRO 27:13
Thadou: Hetkhah lou mikhat batsah nadinga kitung pa chu, aponsil kichom peh jenga! Hetphalou mi dinga, hitobang mihem chu akipehdoh jeng thei nadem!
English: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!

tcz: Jingkah matah-a thouva othong jejua, phatthei osam chun aheng akom agaosap joh ahibouve.
en: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.
text:
PRO 27:14
Thadou: Jingkah matah-a thouva othong jejua, phatthei osam chun aheng akom agaosap joh ahibouve.
English: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.

tcz: Tanglouva nilhum keija gojuh hi, numei phunse tohbang bep ahi.
en: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:
text:
PRO 27:15
Thadou: Tanglouva nilhum keija gojuh hi, numei phunse tohbang bep ahi.
English: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:

tcz: Hitobang numei phohtang theija chun, khohui geija aphotang jou ding ahin; akhutphang jet lam'a jong, thaotui akihamdoh thei ding ahi.
en: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.
text:
PRO 27:16
Thadou: Hitobang numei phohtang theija chun, khohui geija aphotang jou ding ahin; akhutphang jet lam'a jong, thaotui akihamdoh thei ding ahi.
English: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.

tcz: Thihchun thih mama anol hemthei bangin, mihem jong khat in khat akikhelsah thei ahi.
en: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
text:
PRO 27:17
Thadou: Thihchun thih mama anol hemthei bangin, mihem jong khat in khat akikhelsah thei ahi.
English: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

tcz: Koi hileh theiphung phut chan in aga aneh bangin, koi hileh apupa ngaichat jouse hethem chu, mi jabolna achang teijin ahi.
en: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.
text:
PRO 27:18
Thadou: Koi hileh theiphung phut chan in aga aneh bangin, koi hileh apupa ngaichat jouse hethem chu, mi jabolna achang teijin ahi.
English: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.

tcz: Twichung ivet teng mihem eima mai akilahdoh ji bangin, mihem kiti jong hi alungthim in aphondohji ahi.
en: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.
text:
PRO 27:19
Thadou: Twichung ivet teng mihem eima mai akilahdoh ji bangin, mihem kiti jong hi alungthim in aphondohji ahi.
English: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.

tcz: Thina le thilse in bei tih aneilou bang chun mihem mit teni jeng jong thil vet achim joupoi.
en: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.
text:
PRO 27:20
Thadou: Thina le thilse in bei tih aneilou bang chun mihem mit teni jeng jong thil vet achim joupoi.
English: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.

tcz: Khangbel hi dangka lhahtheng na ding ahin, thuh khuh jong hi sana sonjolna'a kimang ahi; hijeh achu mihem jeng jong pachatna dinmun'a aum laitah a bou patepna changji ahi.
en: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.
text:
PRO 27:21
Thadou: Khangbel hi dangka lhahtheng na ding ahin, thuh khuh jong hi sana sonjolna'a kimang ahi; hijeh achu mihem jeng jong pachatna dinmun'a aum laitah a bou patepna changji ahi.
English: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.

tcz: Mingol chu lhengkong sunga suhdun changbong toh goitha jongleh chun, angolna laitah chu amatahsa'a kon potdoh dehlou ding ahi.
en: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
text:
PRO 27:22
Thadou: Mingol chu lhengkong sunga suhdun changbong toh goitha jongleh chun, angolna laitah chu amatahsa'a kon potdoh dehlou ding ahi.
English: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.

tcz: Nakelngoi honte umchan hethem jingin, chule nabong honte jeng jong phaten vephan;
en: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,

tcz: Ajeh chu haona hi tonsotna ding ahipon, lallukhuh jong hi akhang khang ding um hinam?
en: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.
text:
PRO 27:24
Thadou: Ajeh chu haona hi tonsotna ding ahipon, lallukhuh jong hi akhang khang ding um hinam?
English: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.

tcz: Hampa apul chaisoh tengleh ana ahung noudoh kit jin, chule molchunga hampa louhing jouse jong kichom khomji ahi.
en: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.
text:
PRO 27:25
Thadou: Hampa apul chaisoh tengleh ana ahung noudoh kit jin, chule molchunga hampa louhing jouse jong kichom khomji ahi.
English: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.

tcz: Nakelngoi teovin ponsil ding natopeh diu, chule nakelchateu vin jong loumun khat man natopeh diu ahi.
en: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.
text:
PRO 27:26
Thadou: Nakelngoi teovin ponsil ding natopeh diu, chule nakelchateu vin jong loumun khat man natopeh diu ahi.
English: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.

tcz: Nadon khopset kelcha noitwi tatlouva um jing ding, chule na in-sung vahna dingle nalhacha nungah ho vahna dia jong lhingset ding ahi.
en: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
text:
PRO 27:27
Thadou: Nadon khopset kelcha noitwi tatlouva um jing ding, chule na in-sung vahna dingle nalhacha nungah ho vahna dia jong lhingset ding ahi.
English: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.

tcz: Migilou chu koima dellou in ajam jin, mikitah vang chu keipi bahkai bang in hangtah in apang jin ahi.
en: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
text:
PRO 28:1
Thadou: Migilou chu koima dellou in ajam jin, mikitah vang chu keipi bahkai bang in hangtah in apang jin ahi.
English: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

tcz: Namkhat in suhkhel anei tengleh achunga thunei ding atam jin, hinlah namsung dinsotna ding hin, miching hetkhen themna nei angaije.
en: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.
text:
PRO 28:2
Thadou: Namkhat in suhkhel anei tengleh achunga thunei ding atam jin, hinlah namsung dinsotna ding hin, miching hetkhen themna nei angaije.
English: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.

tcz: Miphalou vaichate gim le hesoh thohsahpa chu, gobah julha tobang ahin, khenchom aneiji poi.
en: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.
text:
PRO 28:3
Thadou: Miphalou vaichate gim le hesoh thohsahpa chu, gobah julha tobang ahin, khenchom aneiji poi.
English: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.

tcz: Kivaipohna Dan thu nit te chun migilou ho adou jing ahi.
en: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.
text:
PRO 28:4
Thadou: Kivaipohna Dan thu nit te chun migilou ho adou jing ahi.
English: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.

tcz: Mi-engsen thu adih a kitan kitihi ahethem thei pon, amavang Yahweh Pakai holten phatah in ahethem un ahi.
en: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.
text:
PRO 28:5
Thadou: Mi-engsen thu adih a kitan kitihi ahethem thei pon, amavang Yahweh Pakai holten phatah in ahethem un ahi.
English: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.

tcz: Mihao lungdihlou hisang in, mivaicha lungtheng hi aphajoi.
en: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
text:
PRO 28:6
Thadou: Mihao lungdihlou hisang in, mivaicha lungtheng hi aphajoi.
English: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

tcz: Chapa chingtah kiti chu Dan thu kitup tah'a juipa ahin, milungsel to kivop pan anu le apa jumna apohlut peh jin ahi.
en: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.
text:
PRO 28:7
Thadou: Chapa chingtah kiti chu Dan thu kitup tah'a juipa ahin, milungsel to kivop pan anu le apa jumna apohlut peh jin ahi.
English: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.

tcz: Thil veikan dinga lha'a punbe sah pa chun, vaichate khotopa sakhao sung adip peh ahibouve.
en: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
text:
PRO 28:8
Thadou: Thil veikan dinga lha'a punbe sah pa chun, vaichate khotopa sakhao sung adip peh ahibouve.
English: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.

tcz: Koi hileh Dan thu jahda jeh'a akol heimang achu, atao na jeng jong Elohim Pathen dinga thet um ahi.
en: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
text:
PRO 28:9
Thadou: Koi hileh Dan thu jahda jeh'a akol heimang achu, atao na jeng jong Elohim Pathen dinga thet um ahi.
English: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

tcz: Milungdih lamsea pui achu, amatah jong ama kokhuh sunga lhalut ding, hinlah milungdih vang chun gou phatah alo ding ahi.
en: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.
text:
PRO 28:10
Thadou: Milungdih lamsea pui achu, amatah jong ama kokhuh sunga lhalut ding, hinlah milungdih vang chun gou phatah alo ding ahi.
English: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.

tcz: Mihao kiti chu ama mitmun aching dan in akigel jin, hinlah hetthemna nei mivaichan achih louna amatdoh tei ding ahi.
en: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.
text:
PRO 28:11
Thadou: Mihao kiti chu ama mitmun aching dan in akigel jin, hinlah hetthemna nei mivaichan achih louna amatdoh tei ding ahi.
English: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

tcz: Mikitah ten goljona anei teng kipa loupina ahin, miphaloute ahung seilet tengleh mipi akidalse jin ahi.
en: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
text:
PRO 28:12
Thadou: Mikitah ten goljona anei teng kipa loupina ahin, miphaloute ahung seilet tengleh mipi akidalse jin ahi.
English: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

tcz: Asuhkhel selmang chan chu khangtou louhel ding, chule hitobang hi chonset ahipoi ti seipa jong, mi manthah sahpa ahibouve.
en: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
text:
PRO 28:13
Thadou: Asuhkhel selmang chan chu khangtou louhel ding, chule hitobang hi chonset ahipoi ti seipa jong, mi manthah sahpa ahibouve.
English: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

tcz: Phattin a Yahweh Pakai gingpa chu anunnom ahin, amavang milungtah pa vang chu manthahna chu tei ding ahi.
en: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
text:
PRO 28:14
Thadou: Phattin a Yahweh Pakai gingpa chu anunnom ahin, amavang milungtah pa vang chu manthahna chu tei ding ahi.
English: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

tcz: Migilou vaicha chunga vaihompa chu, keipi bahkai kitumlet lut le vompi midel hamthe thu tobang ahi.
en: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
text:
PRO 28:15
Thadou: Migilou vaicha chunga vaihompa chu, keipi bahkai kitumlet lut le vompi midel hamthe thu tobang ahi.
English: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.

tcz: Thil hetthemna neilou vaihompa chu, migenthei te engse tah a sugimpa ahin; amavang thildihlou thetpa vang chu ahinkho sotding ahi.
en: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
text:
PRO 28:16
Thadou: Thil hetthemna neilou vaihompa chu, migenthei te engse tah a sugimpa ahin; amavang thildihlou thetpa vang chu ahinkho sotding ahi.
English: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.

tcz: Tol thatpa chonset chung gihna chu, athi kahsea kichou mahthah ding, chule koiman adonlou ding ahi.
en: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.
text:
PRO 28:17
Thadou: Tol thatpa chonset chung gihna chu, athi kahsea kichou mahthah ding, chule koiman adonlou ding ahi.
English: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.

tcz: Lung dettah'a lampi jotpa chu huhdoh a um tei ding, hinlah achena jousea akaleh akalouva chonpa vang chu hetman louva kisumang ding ahi.
en: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
text:
PRO 28:18
Thadou: Lung dettah'a lampi jotpa chu huhdoh a um tei ding, hinlah achena jousea akaleh akalouva chonpa vang chu hetman louva kisumang ding ahi.
English: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.

tcz: Koi hileh ama gam leiset lhoupa chun, neh le chah kimsel a anei ding; hinlah phatchomna beija donva lepa vang chu vaicha tei ding ahi.
en: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
text:
PRO 28:19
Thadou: Koi hileh ama gam leiset lhoupa chun, neh le chah kimsel a anei ding; hinlah phatchomna beija donva lepa vang chu vaicha tei ding ahi.
English: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

tcz: Tahsan umtah pa chu phattheina chang jing ding, hinlah gangtah'a haodoh ding ngaito pan gimna ato lo ding ahi.
en: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
text:
PRO 28:20
Thadou: Tahsan umtah pa chu phattheina chang jing ding, hinlah gangtah'a haodoh ding ngaito pan gimna ato lo ding ahi.
English: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.

tcz: Langneina kiti hi apha ahipoi, hinlah mihem in thil neochan jong adihlou abol jeng theije.
en: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
text:
PRO 28:21
Thadou: Langneina kiti hi apha ahipoi, hinlah mihem in thil neochan jong adihlou abol jeng theije.
English: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

tcz: Mi kikhit them chu gangtah'a haoding mano ahin, hinlah hetman louva vaichatnan ahin lhun den ding ahepha jipoi.
en: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
text:
PRO 28:22
Thadou: Mi kikhit them chu gangtah'a haoding mano ahin, hinlah hetman louva vaichatnan ahin lhun den ding ahepha jipoi.
English: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.

tcz: Lei kileh pil'a thu alhem-a sei sang in, lung thengsel'a miphoh pan lung lhaina ahin mujoh ding ahi.
en: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.
text:
PRO 28:23
Thadou: Lei kileh pil'a thu alhem-a sei sang in, lung thengsel'a miphoh pan lung lhaina ahin mujoh ding ahi.
English: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.

tcz: Koi hileh anu le apa thilgua “Hiche hi chon dihlou akitipoi,” tia seija chu mi manthah sahpa ahibouve.
en: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.
text:
PRO 28:24
Thadou: Koi hileh anu le apa thilgua “Hiche hi chon dihlou akitipoi,” tia seija chu mi manthah sahpa ahibouve.
English: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.

tcz: Neipap kiloset hin kinahna asodoh sahjin, hinlah Yahweh Pakaija kingaipa vang chu haodoh tei ding ahi.
en: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper.
text:
PRO 28:25
Thadou: Neipap kiloset hin kinahna asodoh sahjin, hinlah Yahweh Pakaija kingaipa vang chu haodoh tei ding ahi.
English: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper.

tcz: Ama lungthim jenga kisongpa chu angol ahin, hinlah chihna thua lamlha jingpa vang hoidoh ding ahi.
en: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
text:
PRO 28:26
Thadou: Ama lungthim jenga kisongpa chu angol ahin, hinlah chihna thua lamlha jingpa vang hoidoh ding ahi.
English: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

tcz: Koi hileh vaicha khotona'a dimpa chu lhasam louhel ding, amavang mivaichate khoto lou chu sapset chang ding ahi.
en: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.
text:
PRO 28:27
Thadou: Koi hileh vaicha khotona'a dimpa chu lhasam louhel ding, amavang mivaichate khoto lou chu sapset chang ding ahi.
English: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.

tcz: Migilouten vai ahomteng, mihem amacham cham in akidalse jin, hinlah hitobang miho chu abei teng; adih akhang in apung jitai.
en: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
text:
PRO 28:28
Thadou: Migilouten vai ahomteng, mihem amacham cham in akidalse jin, hinlah hitobang miho chu abei teng; adih akhang in apung jitai.
English: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.

tcz: Akiphona sangnom loupa chu, hetman louva huhdoh lel'a kisumang ding ahi.
en: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
text:
PRO 29:1
Thadou: Akiphona sangnom loupa chu, hetman louva huhdoh lel'a kisumang ding ahi.
English: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.

tcz: Mikitah ho vaihom le thaneija apan teng, mipi akipah in athanom jin; hinlah miphalou in vai ahom tengle, mipi chunga gim hesoh alhung jitai.
en: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
text:
PRO 29:2
Thadou: Mikitah ho vaihom le thaneija apan teng, mipi akipah in athanom jin; hinlah miphalou in vai ahom tengle, mipi chunga gim hesoh alhung jitai.
English: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.

tcz: Chihna ngaisang pa din apa akipah jin, hinlah noti hotoh kivop jingpan vang anei le agou amangchai bep e.
en: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
text:
PRO 29:3
Thadou: Chihna ngaisang pa din apa akipah jin, hinlah noti hotoh kivop jingpan vang anei le agou amangchai bep e.
English: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

tcz: Thu dihtah'a atan jeh chun lengpan, gamsunga chen detna aphutdoh jin; hinlah nehguh kilah pan vang, gamsung amanthahsah jin ahi.
en: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.
text:
PRO 29:4
Thadou: Thu dihtah'a atan jeh chun lengpan, gamsunga chen detna aphutdoh jin; hinlah nehguh kilah pan vang, gamsung amanthahsah jin ahi.
English: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.

tcz: Aheng akom lhem a pang pan, akeng tenia akipal lhuhna ding thang akido ahibouve.
en: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
text:
PRO 29:5
Thadou: Aheng akom lhem a pang pan, akeng tenia akipal lhuhna ding thang akido ahibouve.
English: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

tcz: Migilou chu ama le ama athangkam achun a-oh jin, mikitah vang chun la-asan akipah thanom jitai.
en: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.
text:
PRO 29:6
Thadou: Migilou chu ama le ama athangkam achun a-oh jin, mikitah vang chun la-asan akipah thanom jitai.
English: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.

tcz: Mikitah in vaichate dihna chu asuhmil peh ngaipon, migilou ding in vang hitobang thil hi het ahahsai.
en: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.
text:
PRO 29:7
Thadou: Mikitah in vaichate dihna chu asuhmil peh ngaipon, migilou ding in vang hitobang thil hi het ahahsai.
English: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.

tcz: Mi tot chavei hon khopi jeng jong meijin ahal lha jiuvin, miching hon vang lunghanna jeng jong apeldoh theijun ahi.
en: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.
text:
PRO 29:8
Thadou: Mi tot chavei hon khopi jeng jong meijin ahal lha jiuvin, miching hon vang lunghanna jeng jong apeldoh theijun ahi.
English: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.

tcz: Michingin mingol akinahpia ahileh, mingol chu alung hangin anuisat bep jin, hinlah lungkim na aum poi.
en: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
text:
PRO 29:9
Thadou: Michingin mingol akinahpia ahileh, mingol chu alung hangin anuisat bep jin, hinlah lungkim na aum poi.
English: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

tcz: Mi thisan sohat hon nolnabei ho athet uvin, chule migilou in nolnabei mi chu thisan sodin ahol lejin ahi.
en: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.
text:
PRO 29:10
Thadou: Mi thisan sohat hon nolnabei ho athet uvin, chule migilou in nolnabei mi chu thisan sodin ahol lejin ahi.
English: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.

tcz: Mingol alunghan pet leh im neilou in aum jin, miching vang chu ima seilouvin aim mang jitai.
en: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.
text:
PRO 29:11
Thadou: Mingol alunghan pet leh im neilou in aum jin, miching vang chu ima seilouvin aim mang jitai.
English: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

tcz: Vaihom pan thujou sei akhohsah'a ahileh, ama thumop ho jouse chu migilou ngen soh diu ahi.
en: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.
text:
PRO 29:12
Thadou: Vaihom pan thujou sei akhohsah'a ahileh, ama thumop ho jouse chu migilou ngen soh diu ahi.
English: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.

tcz: Vaichapa le asugentheipa jong kimuto ding, ijehinem itileh amit teni lhon hasah jong Yahweh Pakai ahi.
en: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.
text:
PRO 29:13
Thadou: Vaichapa le asugentheipa jong kimuto ding, ijehinem itileh amit teni lhon hasah jong Yahweh Pakai ahi.
English: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.

tcz: Lengpan vaichate chu akitoh toa thu atanpeh a ahileh, alaltouna imatih chan a kiphut det ding ahi.
en: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.
text:
PRO 29:14
Thadou: Lengpan vaichate chu akitoh toa thu atanpeh a ahileh, alaltouna imatih chan a kiphut det ding ahi.
English: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.

tcz: Mol thoa kiphona hin chihna atah lang in, ama chamtah'a lhaji chapang chun anu ajumso teije.
en: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
text:
PRO 29:15
Thadou: Mol thoa kiphona hin chihna atah lang in, ama chamtah'a lhaji chapang chun anu ajumso teije.
English: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.

tcz: Migilouhon vai ahom'uva thaneija apan tenguleh, bolkhelna atam cheh jin; hinlah mikitah hon migilou ho lhuhpet amu diu ahi.
en: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
text:
PRO 29:16
Thadou: Migilouhon vai ahom'uva thaneija apan tenguleh, bolkhelna atam cheh jin; hinlah mikitah hon migilou ho lhuhpet amu diu ahi.
English: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.

tcz: Nachapa nahil chah le tha ol-na nanei thei ding, chuteng ama jal'a nakipa ding ahi.
en: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
text:
PRO 29:17
Thadou: Nachapa nahil chah le tha ol-na nanei thei ding, chuteng ama jal'a nakipa ding ahi.
English: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.

tcz: Gaothu kisei louna mun achun mipi alamvai jin, hinlah Dan thu nit chan chu anun nom ahiye.
en: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.
text:
PRO 29:18
Thadou: Gaothu kisei louna mun achun mipi alamvai jin, hinlah Dan thu nit chan chu anun nom ahiye.
English: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.

tcz: Thu cheng jengseh in soh chu athunun joupon, aman ahet vang in khohsahna anei thei jipoi.
en: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.
text:
PRO 29:19
Thadou: Thu cheng jengseh in soh chu athunun joupon, aman ahet vang in khohsahna anei thei jipoi.
English: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.

tcz: Geltoh louva thusei namu khah em? Hitobang mihem sang chun mingol chunga kinepna aum joi.
en: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
text:
PRO 29:20
Thadou: Geltoh louva thusei namu khah em? Hitobang mihem sang chun mingol chunga kinepna aum joi.
English: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

tcz: Sohkhat aneova pat hoithona'a hin khou khah achun, achaina teng ama nei le gou loa apan akimudoh jin ahi.
en: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
text:
PRO 29:21
Thadou: Sohkhat aneova pat hoithona'a hin khou khah achun, achaina teng ama nei le gou loa apan akimudoh jin ahi.
English: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.

tcz: Mi alungsa jenga chun kinahna asodoh jin, chule lunghanna'a dim jing michun bolkhel tampi anei lojie.
en: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
text:
PRO 29:22
Thadou: Mi alungsa jenga chun kinahna asodoh jin, chule lunghanna'a dim jing michun bolkhel tampi anei lojie.
English: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.

tcz: Mihem kiti hi kiletsah nan ahinsuh nemji ahin, koi hileh alungthim a kineosah chan chu mi jabolna chang ding ahi.
en: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.
text:
PRO 29:23
Thadou: Mihem kiti hi kiletsah nan ahinsuh nemji ahin, koi hileh alungthim a kineosah chan chu mi jabolna chang ding ahi.
English: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.

tcz: Gucha kithopia pang chun ama hinkho tahbah jong adei pon, gaosapna thu ajah jeng vang in imacha aphongdoh jipoi.
en: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.
text:
PRO 29:24
Thadou: Gucha kithopia pang chun ama hinkho tahbah jong adei pon, gaosapna thu ajah jeng vang in imacha aphongdoh jipoi.
English: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.

tcz: Mihem a kingaina kiti hi kipalna ahin, Yahweh Pakaija kisongpa vang chu hoidoh tei ding ahi.
en: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.
text:
PRO 29:25
Thadou: Mihem a kingaina kiti hi kipalna ahin, Yahweh Pakaija kisongpa vang chu hoidoh tei ding ahi.
English: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.

tcz: Mi tamtah in vaihompa lung lhaisah ding angaito uvin, hinlah thudih tanna hi Yahweh Pakaija hung konbou ahi.
en: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from the LORD.
text:
PRO 29:26
Thadou: Mi tamtah in vaihompa lung lhaisah ding angaito uvin, hinlah thudih tanna hi Yahweh Pakaija hung konbou ahi.
English: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from the LORD.

tcz: Mikitah ho din thu adih louva tanpa hi thet umtah ahin, chule migilou ding in jong adih jenga lamjotpa chu thet umtah ahi.
en: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
text:
PRO 29:27
Thadou: Mikitah ho din thu adih louva tanpa hi thet umtah ahin, chule migilou ding in jong adih jenga lamjotpa chu thet umtah ahi.
English: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.

tcz: Jakeh chapa Agur thuseidoh ho hichea hi kiphong doh ahi. O Yahweh Pakai keima kachol in kalhasam lheh tai.
en: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:
text:
PRO 30:1
Thadou: Jakeh chapa Agur thuseidoh ho hichea hi kiphong doh ahi. O Yahweh Pakai keima kachol in kalhasam lheh tai.
English: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:

tcz: Keima mihem khat hina angol-a kahi, chule mihem thil hetkhen themna bang in hetkhenna kainei tapoi.
en: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
text:
PRO 30:2
Thadou: Keima mihem khat hina angol-a kahi, chule mihem thil hetkhen themna bang in hetkhenna kainei tapoi.
English: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.

tcz: Keiman chihna thucheng kaja kha hih laijin, mithengpa kiti jong kaphongdoh kha naipoi.
en: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.
text:
PRO 30:3
Thadou: Keiman chihna thucheng kaja kha hih laijin, mithengpa kiti jong kaphongdoh kha naipoi.
English: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.

tcz: Elohim Pathen tailou koiham vanna kal touva hung kumsuh kit? Koiham akhut tum'a huituh theija? Koiham aponsil a twi chun thei? Koiham vannoi pumpi sem? Ama chu amin ipi ham chule achapa min ipiham? Nang in vang nahet chetset ahi.
en: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?
text:
PRO 30:4
Thadou: Elohim Pathen tailou koiham vanna kal touva hung kumsuh kit? Koiham akhut tum'a huituh theija? Koiham aponsil a twi chun thei? Koiham vannoi pumpi sem? Ama chu amin ipi ham chule achapa min ipiham? Nang in vang nahet chetset ahi.
English: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?

tcz: Elohim Pathen thucheng jouse hi adihsoh keijin, Ama henga kiselte ding in lim-in apang e.
en: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
text:
PRO 30:5
Thadou: Elohim Pathen thucheng jouse hi adihsoh keijin, Ama henga kiselte ding in lim-in apang e.
English: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

tcz: Elohim Pathen seidohsa thucheng belap hih hel in, achuti louva ahileh aman naphosal ding; mijou nahi lo ding ahi.
en: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.
text:
PRO 30:6
Thadou: Elohim Pathen seidohsa thucheng belap hih hel in, achuti louva ahileh aman naphosal ding; mijou nahi lo ding ahi.
English: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.

tcz: O Yahweh Pakai thilni kangai chae, kathi kahsen hiche thilni hi nei-it peh hihbeh in.
en: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.
text:
PRO 30:7
Thadou: O Yahweh Pakai thilni kangai chae, kathi kahsen hiche thilni hi nei-it peh hihbeh in.
English: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.

tcz: Amasan jouthu kaseilouna dingin neipan pin, aninan vaichatna le haona neipe hih in; keima nehkhop bep ding in neivah jing tan.
en: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,
text:
PRO 30:8
Thadou: Amasan jouthu kaseilouna dingin neipan pin, aninan vaichatna le haona neipe hih in; keima nehkhop bep ding in neivah jing tan.
English: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,

tcz: Ajeh chu keima hung haobeh seh leng, “Yahweh Pakai chu koiham?” tia nangma douna thu kasei lo ding; vaicha behseh kit leng kaguchat lo kit ding, Elohim, ka Pathen mintheng kasuh thang bep ding ahi.
en: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.
text:
PRO 30:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu keima hung haobeh seh leng, “Yahweh Pakai chu koiham?” tia nangma douna thu kasei lo ding; vaicha behseh kit leng kaguchat lo kit ding, Elohim, ka Pathen mintheng kasuh thang bep ding ahi.
English: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

tcz: Soh chu apupa kom'a heh hih beh in, ajeh chu aman nahin sapset a naje lo thei ahi.
en: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.
text:
PRO 30:10
Thadou: Soh chu apupa kom'a heh hih beh in, ajeh chu aman nahin sapset a naje lo thei ahi.
English: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.

tcz: Mi kimkhat chu apute apate gaosap ngam jong aum in, hijeh chun apite anute chan geijin phatthei achang pouve.
en: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.
text:
PRO 30:11
Thadou: Mi kimkhat chu apute apate gaosap ngam jong aum in, hijeh chun apite anute chan geijin phatthei achang pouve.
English: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.

tcz: Amaho mitmu jenga theng kisa jong aum uvin, hinlah athen lounauva kon in khatcha angim deh pouve.
en: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.
text:
PRO 30:12
Thadou: Amaho mitmu jenga theng kisa jong aum uvin, hinlah athen lounauva kon in khatcha angim deh pouve.
English: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.

tcz: Kimkhat machu amitmu uvin akichoi sang un, amit dang-chung uva chunglam ve jong aum un ahi.
en: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.
text:
PRO 30:13
Thadou: Kimkhat machu amitmu uvin akichoi sang un, amit dang-chung uva chunglam ve jong aum un ahi.
English: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.

tcz: Amahon chemjam tobang ha hemtah anei jun, chule aha jouseu jong chemcha hemtah tobang ahin; leiset chunga vaichate bahgam ding angaito uvin, mihem lah'a neilalte bah gam din akigo uve.
en: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.
text:
PRO 30:14
Thadou: Amahon chemjam tobang ha hemtah anei jun, chule aha jouseu jong chemcha hemtah tobang ahin; leiset chunga vaichate bahgam ding angaito uvin, mihem lah'a neilalte bah gam din akigo uve.
English: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.

tcz: Vot'in nou ni anei jin, “Neipeh ben, neipeh ben,” ati lhon e. Chule chim louhel a thil thum aum in; thil in jong, “Alhingsel tai,” atideh pon ahi.
en: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:
text:
PRO 30:15
Thadou: Vot'in nou ni anei jin, “Neipeh ben, neipeh ben,” ati lhon e. Chule chim louhel a thil thum aum in; thil in jong, “Alhingsel tai,” atideh pon ahi.
English: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:

tcz: Noimigam achinga naobu ahin, leiset inla twi ducha jinga um, meika diuje jun la “Alhingsel tai,” atideh poi.
en: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’
text:
PRO 30:16
Thadou: Noimigam achinga naobu ahin, leiset inla twi ducha jinga um, meika diuje jun la “Alhingsel tai,” atideh poi.
English: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’

tcz: Koi hileh apa mitche keh dan a, chule anu thua nung lou chu phaicham'a um va-ah ten akilo diu, mu-thong hon along aneh diu ahi.
