en: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.
text:
PRO 30:17
Thadou: Koi hileh apa mitche keh dan a, chule anu thua nung lou chu phaicham'a um va-ah ten akilo diu, mu-thong hon along aneh diu ahi.
English: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.

tcz: Kei ding in thil thum hi datmah umtah ahin, chule kahet khen thei lou thil Li aum in ahi.
en: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:
text:
PRO 30:18
Thadou: Kei ding in thil thum hi datmah umtah ahin, chule kahet khen thei lou thil Li aum in ahi.
English: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:

tcz: Vanlaijol'a muvanlai lenna lampi, Songpi chunga gul kitholna lampi, Twikhanglen lailunga touna-kong kitolna lampi, chule pasal khat in nungah khat alungset jidan.
en: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.
text:
PRO 30:19
Thadou: Vanlaijol'a muvanlai lenna lampi, Songpi chunga gul kitholna lampi, Twikhanglen lailunga touna-kong kitolna lampi, chule pasal khat in nungah khat alungset jidan.
English: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.

tcz: Numei-jong chondan hi hiti ahi: an anen, amuh akitheh jol loijin, “Keiman thil dihlou ima kabolpoi,” tin aseije.
en: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
text:
PRO 30:20
Thadou: Numei-jong chondan hi hiti ahi: an anen, amuh akitheh jol loijin, “Keiman thil dihlou ima kabolpoi,” tin aseije.
English: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’

tcz: Thil thum hin leiset ahot-ling jin, thil Li vang leiset in athoh joupoi.
en: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:
text:
PRO 30:21
Thadou: Thil thum hin leiset ahot-ling jin, thil Li vang leiset in athoh joupoi.
English: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:

tcz: Soh chu hung leng changa, chule mingol in a-oi vaset'a an anehji ahi.
en: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,
text:
PRO 30:22
Thadou: Soh chu hung leng changa, chule mingol in a-oi vaset'a an anehji ahi.
English: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

tcz: Min adeilou numei chun jiding pasal akimudoh jia, soh numei jin apinu akhel jiteng,
en: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.
text:
PRO 30:23
Thadou: Min adeilou numei chun jiding pasal akimudoh jia, soh numei jin apinu akhel jiteng,
English: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.

tcz: Leiset chunga thilneo li aum in, hiche thil Li hohi achinga ching thei ahiuve.
en: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:
text:
PRO 30:24
Thadou: Leiset chunga thilneo li aum in, hiche thil Li hohi achinga ching thei ahiuve.
English: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

tcz: Sihmi tehi mihem ahilou vang un ahat thei lheh jeng un, nipilai sung sen neh ding akikhol khom jiuvin ahi.
en: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.
text:
PRO 30:25
Thadou: Sihmi tehi mihem ahilou vang un ahat thei lheh jeng un, nipilai sung sen neh ding akikhol khom jiuvin ahi.
English: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.

tcz: Boi ho jong hi mihem banga hat ahipouvin, hinlah songpi lah jenga jong ko akivu jiuvin ahi.
en: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.
text:
PRO 30:26
Thadou: Boi ho jong hi mihem banga hat ahipouvin, hinlah songpi lah jenga jong ko akivu jiuvin ahi.
English: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.

tcz: Khaokho ten jong leng aneipouvin, hinlah agol gol chan akitol jiuve.
en: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.
text:
PRO 30:27
Thadou: Khaokho ten jong leng aneipouvin, hinlah agol gol chan akitol jiuve.
English: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.

tcz: Daidep jong khu bailam tah'a nakhut a namat thei ahin, hiche jeng jong hi lengpa insunga cheng jing ahi.
en: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.
text:
PRO 30:28
Thadou: Daidep jong khu bailam tah'a nakhut a namat thei ahin, hiche jeng jong hi lengpa insunga cheng jing ahi.
English: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.

tcz: Thil thum phatah'a kijot del aum un, chule thil li jong chu akalseu akitoh del in ahi.
en: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:
text:
PRO 30:29
Thadou: Thil thum phatah'a kijot del aum un, chule thil li jong chu akalseu akitoh del in ahi.
English: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

tcz: Sa jouse lah'a keipi bahkai hi ahat pen ahin, imacha masanga anung chon ngaipoi.
en: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;

tcz: Ahpi lah ahiteng ahchal in agep lele ahin, kelchal ahin, kel-hon lamkaijin apang in, lengpan amite henga thu aseija ahin lamkaiji ahi.
en: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.
text:
PRO 30:31
Thadou: Ahpi lah ahiteng ahchal in agep lele ahin, kelchal ahin, kel-hon lamkaijin apang in, lengpan amite henga thu aseija ahin lamkaiji ahi.
English: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.

tcz: Nangma mingol nahia, nang le nang kichoi sanga nahim, thilphalou khattou nangaitoa ahileh nakhut in nakam kisip chah jeng in.
en: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.
text:
PRO 30:32
Thadou: Nangma mingol nahia, nang le nang kichoi sanga nahim, thilphalou khattou nangaitoa ahileh nakhut in nakam kisip chah jeng in.
English: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh bongnoi imeh leh bongnoi ha asodoh jin, chule nah hom isip sip teng thisan apotdoh jin, ilung ahan jinga ahileh kinahna jeng asohsah jin ahi.
en: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”
text:
PRO 30:33
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itileh bongnoi imeh leh bongnoi ha asodoh jin, chule nah hom isip sip teng thisan apotdoh jin, ilung ahan jinga ahileh kinahna jeng asohsah jin ahi.
English: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”

tcz: Lengpa Lemuel anun anahilna thucheng ho aphondoh.
en: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:
text:
PRO 31:1
Thadou: Lengpa Lemuel anun anahilna thucheng ho aphondoh.
English: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:

tcz: “O kachapa, kanaobua kon'a kahin kachapa, ipi mong ham, kitepna vanga kahinsa kachapa?
en: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
text:
PRO 31:2
Thadou: “O kachapa, kanaobua kon'a kahin kachapa, ipi mong ham, kitepna vanga kahinsa kachapa?
English: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!

tcz: Nathahatna chu numei pedoh hih beh in, chule lengho sumanga pang ho chu lampi na ot louhel ding ahi.
en: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
text:
PRO 31:3
Thadou: Nathahatna chu numei pedoh hih beh in, chule lengho sumanga pang ho chu lampi na ot louhel ding ahi.
English: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

tcz: O Lemuel, lengho dinga judon kiti hi angai ahipoi, vaihom'a pang ho dinga khamna theija lop hi angai ahipoi.
en: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
text:
PRO 31:4
Thadou: O Lemuel, lengho dinga judon kiti hi angai ahipoi, vaihom'a pang ho dinga khamna theija lop hi angai ahipoi.
English: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

tcz: Ajeh chu ju adon tenguleh, thu adih'a kitansa le akiseisa chu aheimil diu; chutengleh gim hesoh changte dinga, adihnau chu asuhmil peh diu ahi.
en: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
text:
PRO 31:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu ju adon tenguleh, thu adih'a kitansa le akiseisa chu aheimil diu; chutengleh gim hesoh changte dinga, adihnau chu asuhmil peh diu ahi.
English: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

tcz: Manthah nan aphah dingpa chu khamna thei donsah hih beh in, amavang alung hesoh val ho bou ju donsah tan.
en: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.
text:
PRO 31:6
Thadou: Manthah nan aphah dingpa chu khamna thei donsah hih beh in, amavang alung hesoh val ho bou ju donsah tan.
English: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.

tcz: Hitichun amaho cheng chu donsah inlang, avaichat nau asuhmil nadiu le agenthei nau tincheng asuhmil nadiu ahi.
en: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
text:
PRO 31:7
Thadou: Hitichun amaho cheng chu donsah inlang, avaichat nau asuhmil nadiu le agenthei nau tincheng asuhmil nadiu ahi.
English: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

tcz: Ama ding kisei thei lou ho dingin seipeh in, chule achung uva thu adih in tanpeh in.
en: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
text:
PRO 31:8
Thadou: Ama ding kisei thei lou ho dingin seipeh in, chule achung uva thu adih in tanpeh in.
English: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

tcz: Nakam kah inlang thu adih'in tan in, vaichate le angaichate chunga thu adih'a tanna chu umsah jing in.” ati.
en: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
text:
PRO 31:9
Thadou: Nakam kah inlang thu adih'in tan in, vaichate le angaichate chunga thu adih'a tanna chu umsah jing in.” ati.
English: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

tcz: Numei jipha tah kimu jou ding koiham? Amanu chu sana pah jem jouse sang in jong ahoi joi.
en: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.
text:
PRO 31:10
Thadou: Numei jipha tah kimu jou ding koiham? Amanu chu sana pah jem jouse sang in jong ahoi joi.
English: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.

tcz: Ajipan alungthim akison pi lheh in, ajeh chu amanun ajipa hinkhoa ijakai abulhinsah ding ahi.
en: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
text:
PRO 31:11
Thadou: Ajipan alungthim akison pi lheh in, ajeh chu amanun ajipa hinkhoa ijakai abulhinsah ding ahi.
English: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.

tcz: Amanu chun ajipa chunga thilpha chom atongdoh jin, ahinkho sung in ajipa setna atongdoh ngaipoi.
en: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
text:
PRO 31:12
Thadou: Amanu chun ajipa chunga thilpha chom atongdoh jin, ahinkho sung in ajipa setna atongdoh ngaipoi.
English: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.

tcz: Sa mul le tupat abolpeh jin, pontho tah in pat abol jin ahi.
en: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.
text:
PRO 31:13
Thadou: Sa mul le tupat abolpeh jin, pontho tah in pat abol jin ahi.
English: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.

tcz: Hitobang numei hi kiveina kong innei tobang ahin, nehle chah jong gamla tah tah a kon'in ahinpo jie.
en: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
text:
PRO 31:14
Thadou: Hitobang numei hi kiveina kong innei tobang ahin, nehle chah jong gamla tah tah a kon'in ahinpo jie.
English: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.

tcz: Jingkah khovah masangin athouvin ain-sung mite dingin neh le chah agong jin, chule asoh nungah ho nikhat sunga atohdiu agontoh peh jin ahi.
en: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
text:
PRO 31:15
Thadou: Jingkah khovah masangin athouvin ain-sung mite dingin neh le chah agong jin, chule asoh nungah ho nikhat sunga atohdiu agontoh peh jin ahi.
English: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.

tcz: Amanu achen loumun agaven acho pai jin, amanu khutsoh mong in lengpilei abol in ahi.
en: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.
text:
PRO 31:16
Thadou: Amanu achen loumun agaven acho pai jin, amanu khutsoh mong in lengpilei abol in ahi.
English: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.

tcz: Amanu hin atai akigah in thanei tah in apang jin, aban thahat ajedoh jing in ahi.
en: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
text:
PRO 31:17
Thadou: Amanu hin atai akigah in thanei tah in apang jin, aban thahat ajedoh jing in ahi.
English: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.

tcz: Amanu hin akiveina a natoh athilbol jouse thil phachom ahi, ti asumil ngaipon; jan khovah kahsen athaomei amit khapoi.
en: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.
text:
PRO 31:18
Thadou: Amanu hin akiveina a natoh athilbol jouse thil phachom ahi, ti asumil ngaipon; jan khovah kahsen athaomei amit khapoi.
English: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.

tcz: Akhut teni le muikung akisip lhop jingin, chule akhut tenin patkong kung atuh jing jinge.
en: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
text:
PRO 31:19
Thadou: Akhut teni le muikung akisip lhop jingin, chule akhut tenin patkong kung atuh jing jinge.
English: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

tcz: Migentheite huhnan akhut alhang jingin, chujongleh alhasamte dingin akhut alhang jing in ahi.
en: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.
text:
PRO 31:20
Thadou: Migentheite huhnan akhut alhang jingin, chujongleh alhasamte dingin akhut alhang jing in ahi.
English: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.

tcz: Hitobang numei hin ain chen buhbang hunglhah ding jong aging pon, ainsung mite abonchan ponlum in atom in hijeh chun alung monge.
en: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
text:
PRO 31:21
Thadou: Hitobang numei hin ain chen buhbang hunglhah ding jong aging pon, ainsung mite abonchan ponlum in atom in hijeh chun alung monge.
English: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

tcz: Hiche numei hin ama le ama din jong ponsil akikhon in, aponsil jong tupat ponnem le ponsandup jeng ahi.
en: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
text:
PRO 31:22
Thadou: Hiche numei hin ama le ama din jong ponsil akikhon in, aponsil jong tupat ponnem le ponsandup jeng ahi.
English: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

tcz: Khopi kelkot phung jousea ajipa akilang doh jingin, gamsung upaho lah a atouteng jongle min ahesoh keije.
en: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
text:
PRO 31:23
Thadou: Khopi kelkot phung jousea ajipa akilang doh jingin, gamsung upaho lah a atouteng jongle min ahesoh keije.
English: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

tcz: Hitobang numei hin tupat ponnem akhongin akhonjou tengle akijoh jin, kivei miho henga jong konggah khao ajoh jin ahi.
en: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.
text:
PRO 31:24
Thadou: Hitobang numei hin tupat ponnem akhongin akhonjou tengle akijoh jin, kivei miho henga jong konggah khao ajoh jin ahi.
English: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.

tcz: Thahat le gunchuna hi hiche numeinu dinga hi aponsil tobang ahin, khonunga phat hung lhung ding jong lungkhamna beijin agaldot theijin ahi.
en: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
text:
PRO 31:25
Thadou: Thahat le gunchuna hi hiche numeinu dinga hi aponsil tobang ahin, khonunga phat hung lhung ding jong lungkhamna beijin agaldot theijin ahi.
English: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

tcz: Chingthei tah in thu aseijin, khoto tah a mihilna jong aneiyin ahi.
en: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.
text:
PRO 31:26
Thadou: Chingthei tah in thu aseijin, khoto tah a mihilna jong aneiyin ahi.
English: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.

tcz: Insunga um thil jouse avetup sohkei jin, thaset jeh'a don louva akoi khatcha aumpoi.
en: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
text:
PRO 31:27
Thadou: Insunga um thil jouse avetup sohkei jin, thaset jeh'a don louva akoi khatcha aumpoi.
English: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

tcz: Hitobang numei hi achate ahung kipat doh jiuvin, numei nunnom nu tin asejun ahi; chule ajipa jeng in jong amanu hi apahcha lheh jie.
en: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
text:
PRO 31:28
Thadou: Hitobang numei hi achate ahung kipat doh jiuvin, numei nunnom nu tin asejun ahi; chule ajipa jeng in jong amanu hi apahcha lheh jie.
English: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:

tcz: “Vannoi leisetna numei kitahleh numei lolhing tamtah aumme, hinlah nangin amaho nakhel sohkeije” ati.
en: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
text:
PRO 31:29
Thadou: “Vannoi leisetna numei kitahleh numei lolhing tamtah aumme, hinlah nangin amaho nakhel sohkeije” ati.
English: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”

tcz: Kijep hoisel nahi lhep lhahna bep ahin, melhoi jong hi chomcha ding bou ahi; hinlah Yahweh Pakai ging jing numei hi pachat dinga lomtah ahi.
en: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.
text:
PRO 31:30
Thadou: Kijep hoisel nahi lhep lhahna bep ahin, melhoi jong hi chomcha ding bou ahi; hinlah Yahweh Pakai ging jing numei hi pachat dinga lomtah ahi.
English: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.

tcz: Hitobang numei chu atohdoh jouse jal'in kipaman peuvin, chule khopi kot phung tinchenga anatohdoh jousen; lhang phong in vahchoi cheh tahen.
en: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
text:
PRO 31:31
Thadou: Hitobang numei chu atohdoh jouse jal'in kipaman peuvin, chule khopi kot phung tinchenga anatohdoh jousen; lhang phong in vahchoi cheh tahen.
English: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!

tcz: Hiche hi Thuhilpa, Jerusalem’a vaipoa pang, Leng David chapa thuseidoh ho ahi.
en: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:
text:
ECC 1:1
Thadou: Hiche hi Thuhilpa, Jerusalem’a vaipoa pang, Leng David chapa thuseidoh ho ahi.
English: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:

tcz: Thuhilpa chun, “Ijakai ajehbei tobang ngen ahi, ajeh bei tobang ngensen ahi sohkeije,” ati.
en: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”
text:
ECC 1:2
Thadou: Thuhilpa chun, “Ijakai ajehbei tobang ngen ahi, ajeh bei tobang ngensen ahi sohkeije,” ati.
English: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”

tcz: Nipi noija hi mihon atoh gim jeh’uva hi ipi aki mudoh uvem?
en: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?
text:
ECC 1:3
Thadou: Nipi noija hi mihon atoh gim jeh’uva hi ipi aki mudoh uvem?
English: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?

tcz: Khang achemang in, khang ahung lhung kit in, hinlah leiset hin kikhelna aneikha hih laiye.
en: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.
text:
ECC 1:4
Thadou: Khang achemang in, khang ahung lhung kit in, hinlah leiset hin kikhelna aneikha hih laiye.
English: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.

tcz: Nisa ahung sohdoh in chule alhum kit jin, chule kinotah’a kipandoh kit ding in akigopai jin ahi.
en: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.
text:
ECC 1:5
Thadou: Nisa ahung sohdoh in chule alhum kit jin, chule kinotah’a kipandoh kit ding in akigopai jin ahi.
English: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.

tcz: Hui chu lhang lama anung in, chule sah lama ahung kihei jin ahi. Avel kol avelkol in, ahui nun chun akollin ahi.
en: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.
text:
ECC 1:6
Thadou: Hui chu lhang lama anung in, chule sah lama ahung kihei jin ahi. Avel kol avelkol in, ahui nun chun akollin ahi.
English: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.

tcz: Vadung ho tuikhanglenna alonglut’uvin, hinlah twikhanglen adim thei deh poi. Chuti chun twi ho chu vadunga ahung kile kit jiuvin chule ahung longdoh un twikhanglenna chun alut kit jiuve.
en: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.
text:
ECC 1:7
Thadou: Vadung ho tuikhanglenna alonglut’uvin, hinlah twikhanglen adim thei deh poi. Chuti chun twi ho chu vadunga ahung kile kit jiuvin chule ahung longdoh un twikhanglenna chun alut kit jiuve.
English: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.

tcz: Thil ijakai hi seithei lou hellin thachol chol a um'in ahi. Ijat imit uva imu vang un ilungnau achim poi. Ijat ina khang uva ijah jeng vang un ilunglhai jou pouve.
en: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
text:
ECC 1:8
Thadou: Thil ijakai hi seithei lou hellin thachol chol a um'in ahi. Ijat imit uva imu vang un ilungnau achim poi. Ijat ina khang uva ijah jeng vang un ilunglhai jou pouve.
English: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

tcz: Achesa thusim kivelso kitna ahibouve. Masang peh’a ana kibol chaisa ngensen ahiuve. Nisa noija imacha thil athah tahbeh aum poi.
en: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.
text:
ECC 1:9
Thadou: Achesa thusim kivelso kitna ahibouve. Masang peh’a ana kibol chaisa ngensen ahiuve. Nisa noija imacha thil athah tahbeh aum poi.
English: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.

tcz: Khatvei veileh mihon aseijun, “Imacha athah kiti aum poi,” atiuve. Hinlah tahbeh mong in alui ahi bouvin, imacha athah kiti hi aum poi.
en: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.
text:
ECC 1:10
Thadou: Khatvei veileh mihon aseijun, “Imacha athah kiti aum poi,” atiuve. Hinlah tahbeh mong in alui ahi bouvin, imacha athah kiti hi aum poi.
English: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.

tcz: Achesa phatna ipi anasoh em ti igeldoh pouve, chule khang ahung lhung ding hoa jong tua i-thilbol houhi koiman ahetdoh lou ding ahitai.
en: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.
text:
ECC 1:11
Thadou: Achesa phatna ipi anasoh em ti igeldoh pouve, chule khang ahung lhung ding hoa jong tua i-thilbol houhi koiman ahetdoh lou ding ahitai.
English: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.

tcz: Keima, Thuhilpa hi Israelte leng kahin, chule Jerusalema chenga kahi.
en: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
text:
ECC 1:12
Thadou: Keima, Thuhilpa hi Israelte leng kahin, chule Jerusalema chenga kahi.
English: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

tcz: Hetkhen themna holdoh theina ding in keima ka kipum pehdoh jeng in, chule nisa noija na kitongdoh ho chengse hi chihna’a kholdoh ding in ka gel’e. Keiman kahin mudoh chu Pathen in mihemte henga aumna akiphondoh hi ahi.
en: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
text:
ECC 1:13
Thadou: Hetkhen themna holdoh theina ding in keima ka kipum pehdoh jeng in, chule nisa noija na kitongdoh ho chengse hi chihna’a kholdoh ding in ka gel’e. Keiman kahin mudoh chu Pathen in mihemte henga aumna akiphondoh hi ahi.
English: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

tcz: Keiman nisa noija thil ache jomho ijakai hi kavetna ahileh atahbeh in, abonchan ajeh bei aphachom lou ding tobangbep ahije.
en: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
text:
ECC 1:14
Thadou: Keiman nisa noija thil ache jomho ijakai hi kavetna ahileh atahbeh in, abonchan ajeh bei aphachom lou ding tobangbep ahije.
English: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

tcz: Adih lou chu aki sudih tahbeh joupon, chule amangsa jong chu akinung mukit tapoi.
en: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.
text:
ECC 1:15
Thadou: Adih lou chu aki sudih tahbeh joupon, chule amangsa jong chu akinung mukit tapoi.
English: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.

tcz: Keima ka lungthima ka kihoulim in, ka seijin, “Ven, kamasanga Jerusalema leng changho vaihomlai sangin jong ka ching joi. Keima amaho khatpen sangin jong chih john a le hetjohna kaneije ,” kati.
en: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”
text:
ECC 1:16
Thadou: Keima ka lungthima ka kihoulim in, ka seijin, “Ven, kamasanga Jerusalema leng changho vaihomlai sangin jong ka ching joi. Keima amaho khatpen sangin jong chih john a le hetjohna kaneije ,” kati.
English: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”

tcz: Hiti chun keima ijakai chihna’a konna ngolna chule kingol sahna geija hetdohna ding in ka kalsong doh in ahi. Hinlah keima tah in kahetdoh chu hiche ho jouse hi pannabei thil tobangbep ahije.
en: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.
text:
ECC 1:17
Thadou: Hiti chun keima ijakai chihna’a konna ngolna chule kingol sahna geija hetdohna ding in ka kalsong doh in ahi. Hinlah keima tah in kahetdoh chu hiche ho jouse hi pannabei thil tobangbep ahije.
English: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.

tcz: Ka chihna akibe cheh le ka gimna akibe cheh in, hetna akalbe cheh le lunggim na akibe cheh bepmin ahi.
en: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.
text:
ECC 1:18
Thadou: Ka chihna akibe cheh le ka gimna akibe cheh in, hetna akalbe cheh le lunggim na akibe cheh bepmin ahi.
English: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.

tcz: Keile kei ka kihouvin, “Hung in nopsahna patep hitin, hinkhoa thilpha phaho vehite,” kati ahi. Hinlah hiche jong hi ajeh-beihel tobangbep ahiti, keiman kamu doh in ahi.
en: I said in my heart, “Come now, I will test you with mirth; therefore enjoy pleasure;” and behold, this also was vanity.
text:
ECC 2:1
Thadou: Keile kei ka kihouvin, “Hung in nopsahna patep hitin, hinkhoa thilpha phaho vehite,” kati ahi. Hinlah hiche jong hi ajeh-beihel tobangbep ahiti, keiman kamu doh in ahi.
English: I said in my heart, “Come now, I will test you with mirth; therefore enjoy pleasure;” and behold, this also was vanity.

tcz: Hiti chun keiman, “Nui jong hi ngolhoi ahi bouvin, nopsahna hol jong hin ipi phatna ahinsodoh em,” kati.
en: I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”
text:
ECC 2:2
Thadou: Hiti chun keiman, “Nui jong hi ngolhoi ahi bouvin, nopsahna hol jong hin ipi phatna ahinsodoh em,” kati.
English: I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”

tcz: Lunggel tampi gel jouvin, keiman judonna lungthim kipasah ding in kagel in ahi. Chule chihna ka holhol laijin, ngolhoithu jong kagel in ahi. Hiti hin keiman hiche vannoija hi chomcha ahinsunguva, mi atamjon kipana tah ahol hol-u chu kahetdoh nom in ahi.
en: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of folly, until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives.
text:
ECC 2:3
Thadou: Lunggel tampi gel jouvin, keiman judonna lungthim kipasah ding in kagel in ahi. Chule chihna ka holhol laijin, ngolhoithu jong kagel in ahi. Hiti hin keiman hiche vannoija hi chomcha ahinsunguva, mi atamjon kipana tah ahol hol-u chu kahetdoh nom in ahi.
English: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of folly, until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives.

tcz: Hiti hin keiman chenna ding in-len tahtah sah’a chule lengpilei hoi tahtah ho semdoh a kon hin, hinlona jeh hidiham tin kanagel in ahi.
en: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.
text:
ECC 2:4
Thadou: Hiti hin keiman chenna ding in-len tahtah sah’a chule lengpilei hoi tahtah ho semdoh a kon hin, hinlona jeh hidiham tin kanagel in ahi.
English: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.

tcz: Keiman hon tampi le kicholdona mun tampi kasem in, theiphung jat tintang kaphut dimin ahi.
en: I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.
text:
ECC 2:5
Thadou: Keiman hon tampi le kicholdona mun tampi kasem in, theiphung jat tintang kaphut dimin ahi.
English: I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.

tcz: Keiman thingphung mang keikoija ahung um doh theinan twichapna ding in twikhol khomna ding tampi jong kasem in ahi.
en: I made myself pools of water, to water the forest where trees were grown.
text:
ECC 2:6
Thadou: Keiman thingphung mang keikoija ahung um doh theinan twichapna ding in twikhol khomna ding tampi jong kasem in ahi.
English: I made myself pools of water, to water the forest where trees were grown.

tcz: Keiman soh pasal hole soh numeiho jong ka chon chule ka-in muna pengden soh phabep jong ka neijin ahi. Chule keiman masanga Jerusalema ana cheng leng ana umsa ho sang in jong, gancha hole gan lentah tah ho geijin jong kanei tam jon ahi.
en: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.
text:
ECC 2:7
Thadou: Keiman soh pasal hole soh numeiho jong ka chon chule ka-in muna pengden soh phabep jong ka neijin ahi. Chule keiman masanga Jerusalema ana cheng leng ana umsa ho sang in jong, gancha hole gan lentah tah ho geijin jong kanei tam jon ahi.
English: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.

tcz: Keiman lengtampi ho le agam sung uva dangka tamtah le sana tamtah ho ka kholkhom in ahi. Keiman numei hole pasal ho lah’a lasathem kidangtah tah kaki thalah in chule melhoitah tah thaikem ho jong ka neijin, pasal khat in alung’a adeichat chan chu ka neisoh kei jin ahi.
en: I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces. I got myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men: musical instruments of all sorts.
text:
ECC 2:8
Thadou: Keiman lengtampi ho le agam sung uva dangka tamtah le sana tamtah ho ka kholkhom in ahi. Keiman numei hole pasal ho lah’a lasathem kidangtah tah kaki thalah in chule melhoitah tah thaikem ho jong ka neijin, pasal khat in alung’a adeichat chan chu ka neisoh kei jin ahi.
English: I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces. I got myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men: musical instruments of all sorts.

tcz: Hiti chun keima ka masanga Jerusalema ana cheng ho jouse sang in ka loupi jon, chule ka chihna’n keima eidalha pon ahi.
en: So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My wisdom also remained with me.
text:
ECC 2:9
Thadou: Hiti chun keima ka masanga Jerusalema ana cheng ho jouse sang in ka loupi jon, chule ka chihna’n keima eidalha pon ahi.
English: So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My wisdom also remained with me.

tcz: Kalunga ka ngaichat chan kakilah ji'e. Nopsahna kiti pouva chun ka noplou na aum poi. Na hahsa toh jeng’a jong ka tha nom lheh in, katoh gimna jousea tohman ka kimu cheh in ahi.
en: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor.
text:
ECC 2:10
Thadou: Kalunga ka ngaichat chan kakilah ji'e. Nopsahna kiti pouva chun ka noplou na aum poi. Na hahsa toh jeng’a jong ka tha nom lheh in, katoh gimna jousea tohman ka kimu cheh in ahi.
English: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor.

tcz: Hinlah kana tohna jouse hi kavetna ahileh bulhit molso kiti hi ahahlheh in, ajeh bei ngensen ahi-huinung gahdel tobangbep ahi. Hoilai mun hijong leh aphachom dihtah kiti hi aum deh poi.
en: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.
text:
ECC 2:11
Thadou: Hinlah kana tohna jouse hi kavetna ahileh bulhit molso kiti hi ahahlheh in, ajeh bei ngensen ahi-huinung gahdel tobangbep ahi. Hoilai mun hijong leh aphachom dihtah kiti hi aum deh poi.
English: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.

tcz: Hitia hi keiman chihna hitoh ki ngolsah nale ngolna hi ka tekah in ahileh (ajeh chu keima Lengpa tah ’in kabol banga hi koiyin abolthei ding ham?)
en: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been done long ago.
text:
ECC 2:12
Thadou: Hitia hi keiman chihna hitoh ki ngolsah nale ngolna hi ka tekah in ahileh (ajeh chu keima Lengpa tah ’in kabol banga hi koiyin abolthei ding ham?)
English: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been done long ago.

tcz: “Khovah hi muthim sanga aphatjoh bang in, chihna hi ngolna sang in apha joi, tin ka gel in ahi.
en: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as light excels darkness.
text:
ECC 2:13
Thadou: “Khovah hi muthim sanga aphatjoh bang in, chihna hi ngolna sang in apha joi, tin ka gel in ahi.
English: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as light excels darkness.

tcz: Ajeh chu miching hon achena ding aki muchet masat un, hinlah angol chu muthima avah lei. Hinlah miching le mingol jong achanding’u aki banggel in ahi.”
en: The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all.
text:
ECC 2:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu miching hon achena ding aki muchet masat un, hinlah angol chu muthima avah lei. Hinlah miching le mingol jong achanding’u aki banggel in ahi.”
English: The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all.

tcz: Keima lunggel’a, “Aniuva thigel ding ahi. Keima mingol banga kichai ding kahijeh in, kachihna jouse hi amanlutna ipi hintem? Hiche hi aboncha ajehbei hisohkei ahije!” kati.
en: Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity.
text:
ECC 2:15
Thadou: Keima lunggel’a, “Aniuva thigel ding ahi. Keima mingol banga kichai ding kahijeh in, kachihna jouse hi amanlutna ipi hintem? Hiche hi aboncha ajehbei hisohkei ahije!” kati.
English: Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity.

tcz: Ajeh chu miching le mingol aniuva athigellin ahi. Miching chu mingol sanga aki geldoh ding aumbe dehpoi. Ahung lhung ding nikhohoa aniuva ki geldoh lou ding ahi tauve.
en: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!
text:
ECC 2:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu miching le mingol aniuva athigellin ahi. Miching chu mingol sanga aki geldoh ding aumbe dehpoi. Ahung lhung ding nikhohoa aniuva ki geldoh lou ding ahi tauve.
English: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!

tcz: Hitia keiman lei hinkho kahotna ajeh chu, hiche nisa noija kibol doh jouse hi lungboina bep ahije. Ijakai hi ajehbei tobang ahi-huinung gahdel tobangbep ahije.
en: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
text:
ECC 2:17
Thadou: Hitia keiman lei hinkho kahotna ajeh chu, hiche nisa noija kibol doh jouse hi lungboina bep ahije. Ijakai hi ajehbei tobang ahi-huinung gahdel tobangbep ahije.
English: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

tcz: Keiman hiche leiset chunga kana toh gimna jouse hi kahin thei chim ahitai, ijeh- iham itileh keiman ka lodoh jouse hi midang ka dalhah peh ding ahije.
en: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.
text:
ECC 2:18
Thadou: Keiman hiche leiset chunga kana toh gimna jouse hi kahin thei chim ahitai, ijeh- iham itileh keiman ka lodoh jouse hi midang ka dalhah peh ding ahije.
English: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.

tcz: Chule keima panmun hinlo dingho chu ching diuha ahilouleh ngoldiu ha kon asei thei ding ham? Hinlah nipi noija keima boltheina le tohgimna jal'a phatchom pina kanei hohi, amahon ahin kimanchah diu ahitai. Itia ajeh bei soh hin tem!
en: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored, and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.
text:
ECC 2:19
Thadou: Chule keima panmun hinlo dingho chu ching diuha ahilouleh ngoldiu ha kon asei thei ding ham? Hinlah nipi noija keima boltheina le tohgimna jal'a phatchom pina kanei hohi, amahon ahin kimanchah diu ahitai. Itia ajeh bei soh hin tem!
English: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored, and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.

tcz: Hitia hi keima, hiche vannoija hi ka tohgimna jouse hi aphatchomna ipi um'em tia lung lha tah’a uma kahi.
en: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.
text:
ECC 2:20
Thadou: Hitia hi keima, hiche vannoija hi ka tohgimna jouse hi aphatchomna ipi um'em tia lung lha tah’a uma kahi.
English: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.

tcz: Mi phabep chun chingtheile hetna neijin, chule themtah in atongun, amaho chun chutia atohgimgau chu atong louhel khat dinga chu adalhah teidiu ahi. Hiche jong hi ajeh kihe lou ahin, lungnat umtah ahi.
en: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom, with knowledge, and with skillfulness; yet he shall leave it for his portion to a man who has not labored for it. This also is vanity and a great evil.
text:
ECC 2:21
Thadou: Mi phabep chun chingtheile hetna neijin, chule themtah in atongun, amaho chun chutia atohgimgau chu atong louhel khat dinga chu adalhah teidiu ahi. Hiche jong hi ajeh kihe lou ahin, lungnat umtah ahi.
English: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom, with knowledge, and with skillfulness; yet he shall leave it for his portion to a man who has not labored for it. This also is vanity and a great evil.

tcz: Hitia hi mihon hiche hinkhoa hi atohgim nau jouse le alung gim nau jouseuva hi ipi akimu’u hinam?
en: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?
text:
ECC 2:22
Thadou: Hitia hi mihon hiche hinkhoa hi atohgim nau jouse le alung gim nau jouseuva hi ipi akimu’u hinam?
English: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?

tcz: Atoh gimnau nikhoho chu thohgimna le lungnat nan adim un, jan ahi teng jongleh alung thim-u akicholdo theipoi. Chehi ajehbei tobangbep ahisoh keije.
en: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.
text:
ECC 2:23
Thadou: Atoh gimnau nikhoho chu thohgimna le lungnat nan adim un, jan ahi teng jongleh alung thim-u akicholdo theipoi. Chehi ajehbei tobangbep ahisoh keije.
English: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.

tcz: Hiti hin keiman ka gellin mihem in aneh’a chule adonna, anatoh’a lungkimna anei ding sanga phajo aum poi kati. Hiti hin, hiche nopsahna hohi Pathen khutna hungkon ahi, ti keiman ka geldoh in ahi.
en: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.
text:
ECC 2:24
Thadou: Hiti hin keiman ka gellin mihem in aneh’a chule adonna, anatoh’a lungkimna anei ding sanga phajo aum poi kati. Hiti hin, hiche nopsahna hohi Pathen khutna hungkon ahi, ti keiman ka geldoh in ahi.
English: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.

tcz: Ajeh chu Amalouva kon aneh’a, ahilou leh nop asah ding hiya ham?
en: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?
text:
ECC 2:25
Thadou: Ajeh chu Amalouva kon aneh’a, ahilou leh nop asah ding hiya ham?
English: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?

tcz: Pathen in chihna, hetna chule thanopna Ana lunglhaiho apeh ahi. Hinlah michonse khat chu neile gou ahaova ahileh hiche ahaona chu Pathen in alahmanga, ama lunglhaiho apeh ding ahi. Hiche jong hi ajeh beihel aphachom lou ding ahibouve.
en: For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him who pleases God. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
text:
ECC 2:26
Thadou: Pathen in chihna, hetna chule thanopna Ana lunglhaiho apeh ahi. Hinlah michonse khat chu neile gou ahaova ahileh hiche ahaona chu Pathen in alahmanga, ama lunglhaiho apeh ding ahi. Hiche jong hi ajeh beihel aphachom lou ding ahibouve.
English: For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him who pleases God. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

tcz: Ijakai dingin aphat aumcheh in, vannoija hin ijakai achat loh thei ding in phat aum cheh’e.
en: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
text:
ECC 3:1
Thadou: Ijakai dingin aphat aumcheh in, vannoija hin ijakai achat loh thei ding in phat aum cheh’e.
English: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

tcz: Penna ding phat aum in chule thiphat aum’e. Aphu phat aum in chule a‘at phat aum’e.
en: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

tcz: Atha’phat aum in chule asuhdam phat aum’e. Aphet lhah phat aum in chule asahdoh phat aum’e.
en: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

tcz: Ka phat aumin chule nui phat aume. Lunghem phat aum in chule lam phat aume.
en: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

tcz: Song sethang phat aum in chule song khopkhom phat aum’e. Ki-angkol phat aum in chule kihei mang phat aum’e.
en: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

tcz: Thil holphat aum in chule thilhol ngah phat aum’e. Akholkhom phat aumin chule athe cheh phat aum’e.
en: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

tcz: Abo-eh phat aumnin chule akhui bit phat aum’e. Thipbeh’a umphat aumin chule thusei phat aume.
en: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

tcz: Kingailut phat aumin chule kivetda phat aume. Kinah phat aum in chule kicham phat aum’e.
en: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.
text:
ECC 3:8
Thadou: Kingailut phat aumin chule kivetda phat aume. Kinah phat aum in chule kicham phat aum’e.
English: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.

tcz: Ana tohhat man uva miho hin ipi akimu mong mong uvem?
en: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?
text:
ECC 3:9
Thadou: Ana tohhat man uva miho hin ipi akimu mong mong uvem?
English: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?

tcz: Pathen’in i-bonchau chunga pohgih eikoipeh cheh’u kamu doh tai.
en: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
text:
ECC 3:10
Thadou: Pathen’in i-bonchau chunga pohgih eikoipeh cheh’u kamu doh tai.
English: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in, Pathen’in ijakai amachang cheh dingin hoisel in asem in ahi. Aman mihemte lungsunga tonsot akhum lut peh in, hinlah chuti ahijeng vang'in, mihem in Pathen tohgon apatna pat achaina geijin amu phapoi.
en: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
text:
ECC 3:11
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in, Pathen’in ijakai amachang cheh dingin hoisel in asem in ahi. Aman mihemte lungsunga tonsot akhum lut peh in, hinlah chuti ahijeng vang'in, mihem in Pathen tohgon apatna pat achaina geijin amu phapoi.
English: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

tcz: Hijeh’a hi keiman, mihem chu akipa’a chule ijochan geijuva thanopna inei dingu sanga phajo dang aumpoi, tia ka gel lhah ahi tai.
en: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.
text:
ECC 3:12
Thadou: Hijeh’a hi keiman, mihem chu akipa’a chule ijochan geijuva thanopna inei dingu sanga phajo dang aumpoi, tia ka gel lhah ahi tai.
English: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

tcz: Chule miho hin aneh’uva chule adon’uva chule atohgim gahou, athanoppi diu hi Pathen’in manbeiya athil peh-u chu ahi.
en: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.
text:
ECC 3:13
Thadou: Chule miho hin aneh’uva chule adon’uva chule atohgim gahou, athanoppi diu hi Pathen’in manbeiya athil peh-u chu ahi.
English: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.

tcz: Chule ipi hijongleh Pathen in athilbol chan chu achaina ahi jenge. Imacha gah koibe ding ahilouleh gah lahdoh ding aum poi. Pathen in alung gon chu mihem ten Ama agin ding’u hi ahi.
en: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.
text:
ECC 3:14
Thadou: Chule ipi hijongleh Pathen in athilbol chan chu achaina ahi jenge. Imacha gah koibe ding ahilouleh gah lahdoh ding aum poi. Pathen in alung gon chu mihem ten Ama agin ding’u hi ahi.
English: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

tcz: Tua hung sohdoh hohi tumasanga ana sohdohsa ahitai, chule khonunga hung soh ding ho chu tuma’a ana sohdoh sa ahitai, ajeh chu Pathen in hiho chu avel vella ahin um dohsah kitji ahije.
en: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.
text:
ECC 3:15
Thadou: Tua hung sohdoh hohi tumasanga ana sohdohsa ahitai, chule khonunga hung soh ding ho chu tuma’a ana sohdoh sa ahitai, ajeh chu Pathen in hiho chu avel vella ahin um dohsah kitji ahije.
English: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.

tcz: Nisa noija keiman ka mudoh kit chu, thutanna dan aphalou um ka hedoh’e. Tahbeh in , Dan Thutanna mun chu thudih aum poi.
en: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.
text:
ECC 3:16
Thadou: Nisa noija keiman ka mudoh kit chu, thutanna dan aphalou um ka hedoh’e. Tahbeh in , Dan Thutanna mun chu thudih aum poi.
English: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

tcz: Keimatah in ka lungthima, “Aphatcha Pathen in apha hileh ase hileh amichang cheh chu anatoh hou jouse jal'a achungthu’u atan ding ahi,” kati.
en: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”
text:
ECC 3:17
Thadou: Keimatah in ka lungthima, “Aphatcha Pathen in apha hileh ase hileh amichang cheh chu anatoh hou jouse jal'a achungthu’u atan ding ahi,” kati.
English: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”

tcz: Keiman mihemte dinmun thua kagel lin-Pathen’in mihemte henga amaho jong gancha hole gamsaho tobangbep ahiuve, ti aphochen in ahi.
en: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.
text:
ECC 3:18
Thadou: Keiman mihemte dinmun thua kagel lin-Pathen’in mihemte henga amaho jong gancha hole gamsaho tobangbep ahiuve, ti aphochen in ahi.
English: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.

tcz: Ajeh chu gamsaho le mihemte chan kibang ahinau aume-haitheina anei gel uvin chule thithei gel ahiuve. Hitia hi mihemin gamsa ho sanga phatchom john a tahbeh anei deh pouve. Ajeh bei iti hi’a hitam!
en: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.
text:
ECC 3:19
Thadou: Ajeh chu gamsaho le mihemte chan kibang ahinau aume-haitheina anei gel uvin chule thithei gel ahiuve. Hitia hi mihemin gamsa ho sanga phatchom john a tahbeh anei deh pouve. Ajeh bei iti hi’a hitam!
English: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.

tcz: Ania munkhatna chekhoma ahi-vutna kona hung kondoh’uva ahin, aniuva vut kisohkit diu ahi.
en: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.
text:
ECC 3:20
Thadou: Ania munkhatna chekhoma ahi-vutna kona hung kondoh’uva ahin, aniuva vut kisohkit diu ahi.
English: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.

tcz: Ajeh chu koiham mihem lhagao akaltouvin chule gamsaho lhagao leisetna akumsuh’e ti, koi jin aphotchet thei jem?
en: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”
text:
ECC 3:21
Thadou: Ajeh chu koiham mihem lhagao akaltouvin chule gamsaho lhagao leisetna akumsuh’e ti, koi jin aphotchet thei jem?
English: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”

tcz: Hitia hi keiman mihem dinga anatoh chunga akipa diu sanga phajo kamupoi. Eiho hi koiman ithi jou tenguleh nopsahna dinga thina’a konna eihin lepui ding’u ahi tapoi.
en: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?
text:
ECC 3:22
Thadou: Hitia hi keiman mihem dinga anatoh chunga akipa diu sanga phajo kamupoi. Eiho hi koiman ithi jou tenguleh nopsahna dinga thina’a konna eihin lepui ding’u ahi tapoi.
English: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?

tcz: Avel in, keiman nipi noija kibol hesohna jouse ka mun ahi. Keiman akibol hesohho mitlhi lon kamun, alhamon ding’u koima aum poi. Agimbol hou chun thuneina lentah anei juvin, chule amaho khutnoija umho chun ima thuneina aneipouve.
en: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
text:
ECC 4:1
Thadou: Avel in, keiman nipi noija kibol hesohna jouse ka mun ahi. Keiman akibol hesohho mitlhi lon kamun, alhamon ding’u koima aum poi. Agimbol hou chun thuneina lentah anei juvin, chule amaho khutnoija umho chun ima thuneina aneipouve.
English: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

tcz: Hiti hin keiman kangel lhah chu, mithisa hohi mihingho sangin aphat johnau aum’e, kati.
en: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.
text:
ECC 4:2
Thadou: Hiti hin keiman kangel lhah chu, mithisa hohi mihingho sangin aphat johnau aum’e, kati.
English: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.

tcz: Ahinlah apeng lou laiho ding in gam cheng in apha chom jo nalaije. Ajeh chu nipi noija thilse kibol hohi amahon amukhah louvu ahi.
en: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
text:
ECC 4:3
Thadou: Ahinlah apeng lou laiho ding in gam cheng in apha chom jo nalaije. Ajeh chu nipi noija thilse kibol hohi amahon amukhah louvu ahi.
English: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

tcz: Chutah in keiman kamu doh chu mi atamjo hi lolhinna ding in akitilkhou uve, ajeh chu amaho aheng le akom-u mihou jeng ahi. Hinlah hiche jong hi ajeh bei tobang aum den lou ding hija ahi.
en: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.
text:
ECC 4:4
Thadou: Chutah in keiman kamu doh chu mi atamjo hi lolhinna ding in akitilkhou uve, ajeh chu amaho aheng le akom-u mihou jeng ahi. Hinlah hiche jong hi ajeh bei tobang aum den lou ding hija ahi.
English: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.

tcz: ‘‘Mingol hon athasetnau khut akisip chah’u chu amahthahna ding’u ahi.’’
en: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.
text:
ECC 4:5
Thadou: ‘‘Mingol hon athasetnau khut akisip chah’u chu amahthahna ding’u ahi.’’
English: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in, “Khut khat dim thip khen cha nei ding hi khutni dimset aum den lou ding, tongimma nei sang in aphajoi.”
en: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.
text:
ECC 4:6
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in, “Khut khat dim thip khen cha nei ding hi khutni dimset aum den lou ding, tongimma nei sang in aphajoi.”
English: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.

tcz: Keiman nipi noija vetsahna jat chom beh khat kavet be kit in ahi.
en: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.
text:
ECC 4:7
Thadou: Keiman nipi noija vetsahna jat chom beh khat kavet be kit in ahi.
English: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

tcz: Hiche hi mikhat ama changseh’a khosapa thudol ahin, cha khat jong neilou, sopi pasal jong neilou ahia, ajo channa tong gimma neile nga khol khoma ahi. Hiti chun amale ama aki dong in, “Koi dinga tonggima ka him? Tua hi ibola keiman nopsahna donse louva kahi hitam?” ati. Hiche ho jouse hi ajeh apol beihel le lung lhahna thei tah ahibouve.
en: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.
text:
ECC 4:8
Thadou: Hiche hi mikhat ama changseh’a khosapa thudol ahin, cha khat jong neilou, sopi pasal jong neilou ahia, ajo channa tong gimma neile nga khol khoma ahi. Hiti chun amale ama aki dong in, “Koi dinga tonggima ka him? Tua hi ibola keiman nopsahna donse louva kahi hitam?” ati. Hiche ho jouse hi ajeh apol beihel le lung lhahna thei tah ahibouve.
English: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

tcz: Mini hi mikhat sang in aphachom joi, ajeh chu amani chu kihuto thei gel hilhonna lolhing thei ding ahi lhon’e.
en: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
text:
ECC 4:9
Thadou: Mini hi mikhat sang in aphachom joi, ajeh chu amani chu kihuto thei gel hilhonna lolhing thei ding ahi lhon’e.
English: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

tcz: Mikhat chu alhuh’a ahi leh, khat joh chun akhut alhan doh’a akithopi thei ahi. Hinlah koiham khat chu achangin lhu taleh boimong mong ding ahi tai.
en: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
text:
ECC 4:10
Thadou: Mikhat chu alhuh’a ahi leh, khat joh chun akhut alhan doh’a akithopi thei ahi. Hinlah koiham khat chu achangin lhu taleh boimong mong ding ahi tai.
English: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

tcz: Hitobangma chun, mini chu alup khom lhonna ahileh aki sang lum to gel lhon thei je. Hinlah mikhat chu iti lum doh jou ding hitam?
en: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?
text:
ECC 4:11
Thadou: Hitobangma chun, mini chu alup khom lhonna ahileh aki sang lum to gel lhon thei je. Hinlah mikhat chu iti lum doh jou ding hitam?
English: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

tcz: Mikhat achanga ding chu midang in adelkhuma chule ajo paithei ahin, hijongleh mini vang chu kinung thopto lhonna chule ajothei lhon ding ahi. Thumchu pha cheh’a ahi, ajeh chu khaohol thum'a kihal lhop chu bailam tah’a kibot tanlou ding ahi.
en: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
text:
ECC 4:12
Thadou: Mikhat achanga ding chu midang in adelkhuma chule ajo paithei ahin, hijongleh mini vang chu kinung thopto lhonna chule ajothei lhon ding ahi. Thumchu pha cheh’a ahi, ajeh chu khaohol thum'a kihal lhop chu bailam tah’a kibot tanlou ding ahi.
English: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

tcz: Khangthah mivaicha le chingtah pachu tehse le lungngol koimahil lalou Lengpa sang in apha chom joi.
en: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.
text:
ECC 4:13
Thadou: Khangthah mivaicha le chingtah pachu tehse le lungngol koimahil lalou Lengpa sang in apha chom joi.
English: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.

tcz: Chutobang khangdongpa chu vaichatna a konna hung kithou dohtheija chule lolhing thei ahije. Ama chu songkulla umjong leh ama chu leng hung chang thei jong ahi nalaije.
en: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.
text:
ECC 4:14
Thadou: Chutobang khangdongpa chu vaichatna a konna hung kithou dohtheija chule lolhing thei ahije. Ama chu songkulla umjong leh ama chu leng hung chang thei jong ahi nalaije.
English: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.

tcz: Hinlah amitakip chu athalhenga pangpa, khangdong chomdangpa koma chun aga lhailut jo jiuvin ahi.
en: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.
text:
ECC 4:15
Thadou: Hinlah amitakip chu athalhenga pangpa, khangdong chomdangpa koma chun aga lhailut jo jiuvin ahi.
English: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.

tcz: Mihonpi chu kichai tih um louvin akoma chun ahung ding khom’uvin, hinlah khang ahung kikhel phat chun ama jong chu adeimo bolkittauvin ahi. Hijeh chun hiche ho jouse hi ajeh beile phatchomna bei ahi sohkeije.
en: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
text:
ECC 4:16
Thadou: Mihonpi chu kichai tih um louvin akoma chun ahung ding khom’uvin, hinlah khang ahung kikhel phat chun ama jong chu adeimo bolkittauvin ahi. Hijeh chun hiche ho jouse hi ajeh beile phatchomna bei ahi sohkeije.
English: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

tcz: Pathen houna in na nalut tengleh, nakol sung in lang chule na kam kihup in. Geltoh louva Pathenna kilhaina sem chu pha louva ahi.
en: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.
text:
ECC 5:1
Thadou: Pathen houna in na nalut tengleh, nakol sung in lang chule na kam kihup in. Geltoh louva Pathenna kilhaina sem chu pha louva ahi.
English: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.

tcz: Kitepna geltoh louvin mohsem sem hih in, chule Pathen angsunga thil hinlhut loi ding kino hih beh in. Pathen chu vanna uma ahin, nangma hiche leisetna hi uma na hije. Hijeh chun na thusei chom hen.
en: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.
text:
ECC 5:2
Thadou: Kitepna geltoh louvin mohsem sem hih in, chule Pathen angsunga thil hinlhut loi ding kino hih beh in. Pathen chu vanna uma ahin, nangma hiche leisetna hi uma na hije. Hijeh chun na thusei chom hen.
English: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.

tcz: Naha chaloh behset naho hin kichol dothei louna mang namat sah ding, thu na tam seival hin mingol nasosah bep ding ahi.
en: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.
text:
ECC 5:3
Thadou: Naha chaloh behset naho hin kichol dothei louna mang namat sah ding, thu na tam seival hin mingol nasosah bep ding ahi.
English: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.

tcz: Nangman Pathenna kitepna nanei tengleh, hichu jui lhung ding khongai sot hih in, ijeh inem itileh Pathen’in mingol ho chunga lunglhai na anei poi. Ama henga na kitepna jouse chu bulhit molson.
en: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.
text:
ECC 5:4
Thadou: Nangman Pathenna kitepna nanei tengleh, hichu jui lhung ding khongai sot hih in, ijeh inem itileh Pathen’in mingol ho chunga lunglhai na anei poi. Ama henga na kitepna jouse chu bulhit molson.
English: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.

tcz: Kitepna neija ahiala suhbulhit louva um sang in, imacha sei lou beh chu pha joa ahi.
en: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.
text:
ECC 5:5
Thadou: Kitepna neija ahiala suhbulhit louva um sang in, imacha sei lou beh chu pha joa ahi.
English: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

tcz: Nakam in na chonset sah hih beh hen. Nangman hou-in lhacha pa jah’a chun kitepna ka nanei chu ka seikhel ahitai tin nangle nang kihonnan sei hih in. Hichun Pathen a lunghan sah joh ding, chule aman natohdoh umsa chengse chu su-mang loget inte.
en: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?
text:
ECC 5:6
Thadou: Nakam in na chonset sah hih beh hen. Nangman hou-in lhacha pa jah’a chun kitepna ka nanei chu ka seikhel ahitai tin nangle nang kihonnan sei hih in. Hichun Pathen a lunghan sah joh ding, chule aman natohdoh umsa chengse chu su-mang loget inte.
English: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?

tcz: Mangmat le pannabei thilbol apunbe tobang'in, thu sei doh jong abai lam in ahi. Hinlah nangman Pathen ging jon.
en: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.
text:
ECC 5:7
Thadou: Mangmat le pannabei thilbol apunbe tobang'in, thu sei doh jong abai lam in ahi. Hinlah nangman Pathen ging jon.
English: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.

tcz: Thanei tah khat in mivaicha chu agimbol hesoh namua chule gamsung pumpia thutahle chonphatna chu alamlouva akiheikoija ahiltah jongleh hichu datmo hih in. Ajeh chu achungnung penna thuneipa sanga chung nungjo chun agel khoh ahin, chule amaho sanga sangjo ho aum uve.
en: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.
text:
ECC 5:8
Thadou: Thanei tah khat in mivaicha chu agimbol hesoh namua chule gamsung pumpia thutahle chonphatna chu alamlouva akiheikoija ahiltah jongleh hichu datmo hih in. Ajeh chu achungnung penna thuneipa sanga chung nungjo chun agel khoh ahin, chule amaho sanga sangjo ho aum uve.
English: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.

tcz: Chu kal val in, leiset hi mi jouse phatchomna ding ahi; hitia chu lengpa alouma’a kihinso ahi.
en: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.
text:
ECC 5:9
Thadou: Chu kal val in, leiset hi mi jouse phatchomna ding ahi; hitia chu lengpa alouma’a kihinso ahi.
English: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.

tcz: Sum ngailu ho chun suma ning lhin tih anei lou diu. neile gouvin kipana dihtah apeh ding gel’a chun phatchompi ponte.
en: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.
text:
ECC 5:10
Thadou: Sum ngailu ho chun suma ning lhin tih anei lou diu. neile gouvin kipana dihtah apeh ding gel’a chun phatchompi ponte.
English: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.

tcz: Natamnei channa chu na suhmang huding mi tamcheh hung um ding ahi. Hijeh chun neile gou hi na khuttah’a konna aki toldoh navet tilou ipi aphat chomna nahet em?
en: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?
text:
ECC 5:11
Thadou: Natamnei channa chu na suhmang huding mi tamcheh hung um ding ahi. Hijeh chun neile gou hi na khuttah’a konna aki toldoh navet tilou ipi aphat chomna nahet em?
English: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?

tcz: Na tonggimho chun tamneh henlang, lhom neh jong leh a-ihmut’u anom’e. Hinlah mihao chun ih-mut nopna amu joupoi.
en: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.
text:
ECC 5:12
Thadou: Na tonggimho chun tamneh henlang, lhom neh jong leh a-ihmut’u anom’e. Hinlah mihao chun ih-mut nopna amu joupoi.
English: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.

tcz: Nipi noija aboitah khat kamu doh kit aum ben ahi. Neile gou kikhol khom hi aneipa ding in aphat mona aum e.
en: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.
text:
ECC 5:13
Thadou: Nipi noija aboitah khat kamu doh kit aum ben ahi. Neile gou kikhol khom hi aneipa ding in aphat mona aum e.
English: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.

tcz: Sum hi apung dinga kikhol khom jong hi hahsatna ahinle sodoh jin, chule hiche jeh hin ijakai amanlo jibep’e. Achaina tengleh achate dinga ima pehson ding nei louvin aum jitai.
en: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.
text:
ECC 5:14
Thadou: Sum hi apung dinga kikhol khom jong hi hahsatna ahinle sodoh jin, chule hiche jeh hin ijakai amanlo jibep’e. Achaina tengleh achate dinga ima pehson ding nei louvin aum jitai.
English: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.

tcz: Eiho jouse hi i-hungpen uva banga sagohkeu le khut gohkeuva i-hinkho’u hi hung kichai ding ahi. Nei le gou inei hou kipoh thei ihi pouve.
en: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.
text:
ECC 5:15
Thadou: Eiho jouse hi i-hungpen uva banga sagohkeu le khut gohkeuva i-hinkho’u hi hung kichai ding ahi. Nei le gou inei hou kipoh thei ihi pouve.
English: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.

tcz: Chule hiche jong hi boi-umtah ahi. Mihon hiche vannoi adalhah’uhi ahungpen sanguva aphat john a aumpoi. Atohgim nau jouse hi amang thah bep ding ahibouve.
en: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?
text:
ECC 5:16
Thadou: Chule hiche jong hi boi-umtah ahi. Mihon hiche vannoi adalhah’uhi ahungpen sanguva aphat john a aumpoi. Atohgim nau jouse hi amang thah bep ding ahibouve.
English: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?

tcz: Ahinkho lhung keijuva lungkim louna, lunglhahna chule lunghanna meipi noija uma ahiuve.
en: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.
text:
ECC 5:17
Thadou: Ahinkho lhung keijuva lungkim louna, lunglhahna chule lunghanna meipi noija uma ahiuve.
English: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.

tcz: Hiti chu ahi vang'in, thilpha khat keiman kahin mudoh in ahi. Hichu mihem in nipi noija Pathen in apeh hinkho chomcha um sunga aneh’a, adon’a, chule anatoh chunga akipa thanop pia chule achan chunga alung lhai ding hi ahi.
en: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.
text:
ECC 5:18
Thadou: Hiti chu ahi vang'in, thilpha khat keiman kahin mudoh in ahi. Hichu mihem in nipi noija Pathen in apeh hinkho chomcha um sunga aneh’a, adon’a, chule anatoh chunga akipa thanop pia chule achan chunga alung lhai ding hi ahi.
English: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.

tcz: Chule Pathenna konna neile gou chule damtheina anei kipapina anei dinghi thilpha ahi. Nanatoh nathanoppia chule nahinkhoa nachan chu nalung oipia ahileh hiche hi Pathen thilpeh chu ahije.
en: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.
text:
ECC 5:19
Thadou: Chule Pathenna konna neile gou chule damtheina anei kipapina anei dinghi thilpha ahi. Nanatoh nathanoppia chule nahinkhoa nachan chu nalung oipia ahileh hiche hi Pathen thilpeh chu ahije.
English: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.

tcz: Keiman nipi noija thil chombeh aphamo tah khat kamudoh aum in, hichu mihemte lah’a aum jing in ahi.
en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men:
text:
ECC 6:1
Thadou: Keiman nipi noija thil chombeh aphamo tah khat kamudoh aum in, hichu mihemte lah’a aum jing in ahi.
English: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men:

tcz: Pathen’in mi phabep chu haona bulhingset le jabolna chule angai chatbe chan diu geijin apen, hinlah hicheho chu nopsah pina neithei manlouva koi-mi aumin ahi. Amaho chu athiuvin, chule midang hetphah loubeh mi khatnin anei le gou, thil lamdoh chu anopsahpi lheh jin ahi! Hiche hi hamsetna nat pithei leu pannabei ahibouve.
en: a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
text:
ECC 6:2
Thadou: Pathen’in mi phabep chu haona bulhingset le jabolna chule angai chatbe chan diu geijin apen, hinlah hicheho chu nopsah pina neithei manlouva koi-mi aumin ahi. Amaho chu athiuvin, chule midang hetphah loubeh mi khatnin anei le gou, thil lamdoh chu anopsahpi lheh jin ahi! Hiche hi hamsetna nat pithei leu pannabei ahibouve.
English: a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.

tcz: Mi khat in cha jakhat jen nei theijinte chule atehset geijin hingkhat nante. Hinlah amachun hinkhoa lungkimna neihih henlang, chule kivuina pha neita hihleh, ama dinga chu ahungpena athisa ana-hitaleh phajo ding ahi.
en: If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not filled with good, and moreover he has no burial, I say that a stillborn child is better than he;

tcz: Ama chu kum sangkhat val, nivei geijin hing ding hijongleh lungkimna aneitah lou ding ahi. Chule ama chun midang khat tobanga thina atoding, hichun ipi aphat chomsah ding ham?
en: Yes, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet fails to enjoy good, don’t all go to one place?
text:
ECC 6:6
Thadou: Ama chu kum sangkhat val, nivei geijin hing ding hijongleh lungkimna aneitah lou ding ahi. Chule ama chun midang khat tobanga thina atoding, hichun ipi aphat chomsah ding ham?
English: Yes, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet fails to enjoy good, don’t all go to one place?

tcz: Mijousen ahinkhou apum pia anholna’n kimai jun tin, hinlah anei lhingset diu ginchat aum poi.
en: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
text:
ECC 6:7
Thadou: Mijousen ahinkhou apum pia anholna’n kimai jun tin, hinlah anei lhingset diu ginchat aum poi.
English: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

tcz: Hitia hi miching hohi mingolho sanga phachom jouva hilou ham? Mivaicha hon achih jeh’uva ipi phatchomna akimuva chule midang masanga iti chon ding akihet’uvem?
en: For what advantage has the wise more than the fool? What has the poor man, that knows how to walk before the living?
text:
ECC 6:8
Thadou: Hitia hi miching hohi mingolho sanga phachom jouva hilou ham? Mivaicha hon achih jeh’uva ipi phatchomna akimuva chule midang masanga iti chon ding akihet’uvem?
English: For what advantage has the wise more than the fool? What has the poor man, that knows how to walk before the living?

tcz: Na nei lou na ngaichat sang in, nanei chunga lunglhaijon. Thilpha thilhoi nei nomna lunggel kiti hi aphat chomna bei kidel tobang ahi.
