en: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
text:
ECC 6:9
Thadou: Na nei lou na ngaichat sang in, nanei chunga lunglhaijon. Thilpha thilhoi nei nomna lunggel kiti hi aphat chomna bei kidel tobang ahi.
English: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

tcz: Thil ijakai hohi kigong tupsa ngen ahiuve. Mi khat cheh hi ipi ahi ding’u tona kigong sapeh ahi tauve. Hijeh chun natonsot khankho ding chung chang thua jong Pathen nanel kallou ding ahi.
en: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.
text:
ECC 6:10
Thadou: Thil ijakai hohi kigong tupsa ngen ahiuve. Mi khat cheh hi ipi ahi ding’u tona kigong sapeh ahi tauve. Hijeh chun natonsot khankho ding chung chang thua jong Pathen nanel kallou ding ahi.
English: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.

tcz: Thu naha seitam chan-a ima phachomlou ahi. Ahileh hiche ho chu ipi phachom em?
en: For there are many words that create vanity. What does that profit man?
text:
ECC 6:11
Thadou: Thu naha seitam chan-a ima phachomlou ahi. Ahileh hiche ho chu ipi phachom em?
English: For there are many words that create vanity. What does that profit man?

tcz: I-hinlonau pannabei nikho phabep sunga hi, i-hin nikhou hi iti kimang hoi thei pen ding ham ti koiyin ahet nem? I-hinkhou hi lelim tobangbep ahi. I-che nung tenguleh hiche leisetna hi ipi ahung lhung ding koiyin aseithei jem?
en: For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun?
text:
ECC 6:12
Thadou: I-hinlonau pannabei nikho phabep sunga hi, i-hin nikhou hi iti kimang hoi thei pen ding ham ti koiyin ahet nem? I-hinkhou hi lelim tobangbep ahi. I-che nung tenguleh hiche leisetna hi ipi ahung lhung ding koiyin aseithei jem?
English: For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun?

tcz: Minphatna kimu hi gimnam tuipen sang in jong amanlu joi. Chule napen nikho sang in jong nathi nikho phajoa ahi.
en: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.
text:
ECC 7:1
Thadou: Minphatna kimu hi gimnam tuipen sang in jong amanlu joi. Chule napen nikho sang in jong nathi nikho phajoa ahi.
English: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.

tcz: Thina kin’a kimanchah hi golnop bolna mun’a gache sangin aphajoi. Ahimongin, mitin kithi ding ahijeh'in, mihingin hiche hi alunga agel ding doltah ahi.
en: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.
text:
ECC 7:2
Thadou: Thina kin’a kimanchah hi golnop bolna mun’a gache sangin aphajoi. Ahimongin, mitin kithi ding ahijeh'in, mihingin hiche hi alunga agel ding doltah ahi.
English: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.

tcz: Lungkham hi muilhah sangin aphajoi, ajeh chu lungkham na hin i-chunga kisuhthengna ahin sodohji ahi.
en: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.
text:
ECC 7:3
Thadou: Lungkham hi muilhah sangin aphajoi, ajeh chu lungkham na hin i-chunga kisuhthengna ahin sodohji ahi.
English: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.

tcz: Miching khat chun thina chung chang hi aha gel’in ahi, hinlah mingol vang chun phatpha muding bou ageljin ahi.
en: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
text:
ECC 7:4
Thadou: Miching khat chun thina chung chang hi aha gel’in ahi, hinlah mingol vang chun phatpha muding bou ageljin ahi.
English: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

tcz: Mi ngol khat in apachat hisang in, miching khat oimo chan apha joi.
en: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.
text:
ECC 7:5
Thadou: Mi ngol khat in apachat hisang in, miching khat oimo chan apha joi.
English: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.

tcz: Mi ngol nuijatna chu lingphung meiyin akah gin kija tobang ahin, imacha kah louvin aki chai jitai.
en: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.
text:
ECC 7:6
Thadou: Mi ngol nuijatna chu lingphung meiyin akah gin kija tobang ahin, imacha kah louvin aki chai jitai.
English: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.

tcz: Miching chu aki-engbol teng angol lojin, chule guhthim thilpeh hin lungthim asuhmo bepji ahi.
en: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.
text:
ECC 7:7
Thadou: Miching chu aki-engbol teng angol lojin, chule guhthim thilpeh hin lungthim asuhmo bepji ahi.
English: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.

tcz: Achaina hi apatna sang in apha jon chule kiletsah sang in, thohhat aphachom joi.
en: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
text:
ECC 7:8
Thadou: Achaina hi apatna sang in apha jon chule kiletsah sang in, thohhat aphachom joi.
English: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

tcz: Lunghan kitim them in, ajeh chu lunghan hin angoltoh kibang bep naso ding ahi.
en: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.
text:
ECC 7:9
Thadou: Lunghan kitim them in, ajeh chu lunghan hin angoltoh kibang bep naso ding ahi.
English: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.

tcz: “Achesa nikho phaho chu ngaicha gunset hih in, hichu mi chinga ahi poi.”
en: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.
text:
ECC 7:10
Thadou: “Achesa nikho phaho chu ngaicha gunset hih in, hichu mi chinga ahi poi.”
English: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.

tcz: Sum nanei teng leh chihna hi phachom cheh ahi. Hinkhoa kho-sahna dinga ania phachom tah ahi.
en: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.
text:
ECC 7:11
Thadou: Sum nanei teng leh chihna hi phachom cheh ahi. Hinkhoa kho-sahna dinga ania phachom tah ahi.
English: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.

tcz: Chihna le sum hin ipi hijongleh nanei sah jeng thei ahinai. Hinlah chihna kiti bouhin na hinkho ahuhhing jou ding ahije.
en: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.
text:
ECC 7:12
Thadou: Chihna le sum hin ipi hijongleh nanei sah jeng thei ahinai. Hinlah chihna kiti bouhin na hinkho ahuhhing jou ding ahije.
English: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.

tcz: Pathen thilbol ho chu janom jeng in, ajeh chu aman ahe konsa chu koiyin asuh-jang jou ding ham?
en: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?
text:
ECC 7:13
Thadou: Pathen thilbol ho chu janom jeng in, ajeh chu aman ahe konsa chu koiyin asuh-jang jou ding ham?
English: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?

tcz: Ning lhinga naum laisen kipah’in, hinlah hahsatnan nahinphah teng jongleh, ania Pathenna hungkon ahiti tahsan in. Hiche lei hinkhoa hin ima hiti mong ding ahiti, akisei thei poi kiti hi geldoh jing in.
en: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.
text:
ECC 7:14
Thadou: Ning lhinga naum laisen kipah’in, hinlah hahsatnan nahinphah teng jongleh, ania Pathenna hungkon ahiti tahsan in. Hiche lei hinkhoa hin ima hiti mong ding ahiti, akisei thei poi kiti hi geldoh jing in.
English: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.

tcz: Keiman hinlona ajeh umlou tobangbep leiset hinkhoa hin, khangdong phatah tah ho athia chule migilou ho hinkho asot’uhi kamu doh in ahi.
en: All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing.
text:
ECC 7:15
Thadou: Keiman hinlona ajeh umlou tobangbep leiset hinkhoa hin, khangdong phatah tah ho athia chule migilou ho hinkho asot’uhi kamu doh in ahi.
English: All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing.

tcz: Hijeh chun mohphat behset hih in, ahilouva ahileh chingval behset hih in! Idia nangmatah kisumang ding nahi ham?
en: Don’t be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?
text:
ECC 7:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun mohphat behset hih in, ahilouva ahileh chingval behset hih in! Idia nangmatah kisumang ding nahi ham?
English: Don’t be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?

tcz: Chutima chun gilou behset jong bol hih in. Ngol hih beh in! Ipi dinga naphat lhin masanga thi ding nahim?
en: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?
text:
ECC 7:17
Thadou: Chutima chun gilou behset jong bol hih in. Ngol hih beh in! Ipi dinga naphat lhin masanga thi ding nahim?
English: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?

tcz: Hiche kihil naho hi lunggut in gel in, ajeh chu koi hitaleh Pathen ging mi chun; hitobang che valna hi ania hintoh ponte.
en: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.
text:
ECC 7:18
Thadou: Hiche kihil naho hi lunggut in gel in, ajeh chu koi hitaleh Pathen ging mi chun; hitobang che valna hi ania hintoh ponte.
English: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.

tcz: Khopi sunga lamkai mi som sangin, miching khat chu gamcheng in ahat joi.
en: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.
text:
ECC 7:19
Thadou: Khopi sunga lamkai mi som sangin, miching khat chu gamcheng in ahat joi.
English: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.

tcz: Leiset chunga hin mihem khatcha aphajeng bol chonse kha louhel aumpoi.
en: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.
text:
ECC 7:20
Thadou: Leiset chunga hin mihem khatcha aphajeng bol chonse kha louhel aumpoi.
English: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.

tcz: Mi thusei jouse het ding go hih in, nasoh jeng in jong na gaosap get in nate.
en: Also don’t take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear your servant curse you;

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma tah jeng in jong midang na gaosap ji chu na henai.
en: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.
text:
ECC 7:22
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangma tah jeng in jong midang na gaosap ji chu na henai.
English: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.

tcz: Keiman kajo channa chihna in kalunggel le kachonna eilamkai jing na ding in ka ngai ton ahi. Keimatah in kaseijin, “Keima chingthei ding in ka kigel lha tai.” Hinlah ka chuti theijou hihbeh in ahi.
en: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.
text:
ECC 7:23
Thadou: Keiman kajo channa chihna in kalunggel le kachonna eilamkai jing na ding in ka ngai ton ahi. Keimatah in kaseijin, “Keima chingthei ding in ka kigel lha tai.” Hinlah ka chuti theijou hihbeh in ahi.
English: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.

tcz: Chihna hi gamlatah’a aum jing in chule holdoh jong ahah sai.
en: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?
text:
ECC 7:24
Thadou: Chihna hi gamlatah’a aum jing in chule holdoh jong ahah sai.
English: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?

tcz: Keiman muntina chun, chihna le hetkhenna chu iti hung umhija ham tin ajeh kahol in ahi. Keima tah in kholchilna neija konin gitlouna hi ngol jeh ahin, chule ngol kitihi lung chavai kiseina ahije, tiphot chenna kanei ahi tai.
en: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.
text:
ECC 7:25
Thadou: Keiman muntina chun, chihna le hetkhenna chu iti hung umhija ham tin ajeh kahol in ahi. Keima tah in kholchilna neija konin gitlouna hi ngol jeh ahin, chule ngol kitihi lung chavai kiseina ahije, tiphot chenna kanei ahi tai.
English: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.

tcz: Keiman kavet chil’a ahileh, duha-thuhtah numei chu thitheina thangkol sanga khohse joa ahichu ka kholdoh ahitai. Ami hebol jong kipalna thangkol bep ahi, chule akhut nemtah jong chu kihenna thihkol ahibouve. Pathen lunglhaina’a umho chu amanua kon’a hoidoh ding, hinlah chonse ho chu amanu thanga ga-oh ding ahiuve.
en: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.
text:
ECC 7:26
Thadou: Keiman kavet chil’a ahileh, duha-thuhtah numei chu thitheina thangkol sanga khohse joa ahichu ka kholdoh ahitai. Ami hebol jong kipalna thangkol bep ahi, chule akhut nemtah jong chu kihenna thihkol ahibouve. Pathen lunglhaina’a umho chu amanua kon’a hoidoh ding, hinlah chonse ho chu amanu thanga ga-oh ding ahiuve.
English: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.

tcz: Thuhilpa chun, “Hiche hi keiman hoima lamjouse ahitheina ding kavet toh lea konna achaina kasem chu hiche hi ahi.
en: “Behold, I have found this,” says the Preacher, “to one another, to find an explanation
text:
ECC 7:27
Thadou: Thuhilpa chun, “Hiche hi keiman hoima lamjouse ahitheina ding kavet toh lea konna achaina kasem chu hiche hi ahi.
English: “Behold, I have found this,” says the Preacher, “to one another, to find an explanation

tcz: Keiman kavel hol hol jeng vang'in, ka hol lona pentah chu kamu joupoi. Mi sangkhat lah’a khatbou gunchena nei pasal khat ahijouvin, hinlah numei khat jong akimu joupoi.
en: which my soul still seeks, but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.
text:
ECC 7:28
Thadou: Keiman kavel hol hol jeng vang'in, ka hol lona pentah chu kamu joupoi. Mi sangkhat lah’a khatbou gunchena nei pasal khat ahijouvin, hinlah numei khat jong akimu joupoi.
English: which my soul still seeks, but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.

tcz: Chule keiman hiche hi kamui: Pathen’in miho hi gun chena neija asem ahin, hinlah amahon achang cheh-uva aphalou akilam doh-u ahibouve.
en: Behold, I have only found this: that God made mankind upright; but they search for many inventions.”
text:
ECC 7:29
Thadou: Chule keiman hiche hi kamui: Pathen’in miho hi gun chena neija asem ahin, hinlah amahon achang cheh-uva aphalou akilam doh-u ahibouve.
English: Behold, I have only found this: that God made mankind upright; but they search for many inventions.”

tcz: Chihna neihi iti kidan hitam, thil ho geltohna neija chule ipi kiseina ahi phongdoh chihna hin, mihem amai avahsah in lungkhohna asunem theije.
en: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.
text:
ECC 8:1
Thadou: Chihna neihi iti kidan hitam, thil ho geltohna neija chule ipi kiseina ahi phongdoh chihna hin, mihem amai avahsah in lungkhohna asunem theije.
English: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.

tcz: Nangman Pathen thua nung dinga nakitepna dung jui chun lengpa thu thun nung in.
en: I say, “Keep the king’s command!” because of the oath to God.
text:
ECC 8:2
Thadou: Nangman Pathen thua nung dinga nakitepna dung jui chun lengpa thu thun nung in.
English: I say, “Keep the king’s command!” because of the oath to God.

tcz: Natoh ding kin bollou ding in kigo hih in, chule lungthim phalou gongho tojong pan lakhom hih beh-in, ajeh chu lengpan abolnom nom abolthei ahije.
en: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,
text:
ECC 8:3
Thadou: Natoh ding kin bollou ding in kigo hih in, chule lungthim phalou gongho tojong pan lakhom hih beh-in, ajeh chu lengpan abolnom nom abolthei ahije.
English: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,

tcz: Athupeh chu thaneina in ajuijin, koima ananjou dingleh ipi dinga hitia nabol ham tia seithei ding aum poi.
en: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”
text:
ECC 8:4
Thadou: Athupeh chu thaneina in ajuijin, koima ananjou dingleh ipi dinga hitia nabol ham tia seithei ding aum poi.
English: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”

tcz: Athua nungho chun talen man pouvinte. Miching ho chun adih bolna ding phat ahaimil pouvin chule abolje ahet tei ding’u ahi.
en: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.
text:
ECC 8:5
Thadou: Athua nungho chun talen man pouvinte. Miching ho chun adih bolna ding phat ahaimil pouvin chule abolje ahet tei ding’u ahi.
English: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.

tcz: Ajeh chu thil ijakai bolna ding phat le bolje hetna phat mikhat chun hahsatna ato teng jongleh amuji ahi.
en: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.
text:
ECC 8:6
Thadou: Ajeh chu thil ijakai bolna ding phat le bolje hetna phat mikhat chun hahsatna ato teng jongleh amuji ahi.
English: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.

tcz: Ahimong in, ipi hunglhung ding ahi hephalou mipi chun iti hichu apel thei diu hitam?
en: For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?
text:
ECC 8:7
Thadou: Ahimong in, ipi hunglhung ding ahi hephalou mipi chun iti hichu apel thei diu hitam?
English: For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?

tcz: I-lah’uva ithi diu nikho atuhtang thei ium pouve. Hiche muthim galsatna, ito diu hi ahoidohna ding aum poi.
en: There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death. There is no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it.
text:
ECC 8:8
Thadou: I-lah’uva ithi diu nikho atuhtang thei ium pouve. Hiche muthim galsatna, ito diu hi ahoidohna ding aum poi.
English: There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death. There is no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it.

tcz: Hiche nipi noija che jinga, chal jinga um miho chun khat le khat kisuh khah tona aneiyu hi lunggil tah in kangaiton ahi.
en: All this I have seen, and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun. There is a time in which one man has power over another to his hurt.
text:
ECC 8:9
Thadou: Hiche nipi noija che jinga, chal jinga um miho chun khat le khat kisuh khah tona aneiyu hi lunggil tah in kangaiton ahi.
English: All this I have seen, and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun. There is a time in which one man has power over another to his hurt.

tcz: Keiman migilou ho jabol tah’a akivui kamui. Hinlah amaho hi houin sunga chu kijomtah’a athilbol phalouvu umna mun ma’a chun jabolna achanguve! Hiche jong hi ajeh bei tobangbep ahi kit’e.
en: So I saw the wicked buried. Indeed they came also from holiness. They went and were forgotten in the city where they did this. This also is vanity.
text:
ECC 8:10
Thadou: Keiman migilou ho jabol tah’a akivui kamui. Hinlah amaho hi houin sunga chu kijomtah’a athilbol phalouvu umna mun ma’a chun jabolna achanguve! Hiche jong hi ajeh bei tobangbep ahi kit’e.
English: So I saw the wicked buried. Indeed they came also from holiness. They went and were forgotten in the city where they did this. This also is vanity.

tcz: Asukhel chu gimbolna akipeh paiji louva ahileh, miho chun thilse bol ding in ahung kitil khou doh jiuvin ahi.
en: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
text:
ECC 8:11
Thadou: Asukhel chu gimbolna akipeh paiji louva ahileh, miho chun thilse bol ding in ahung kitil khou doh jiuvin ahi.
English: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

tcz: Hinlah mikhat chun chonset javei jen bol hen lang chule sotpi hing nalai henlang hijongleh, Pathen gingho dingin aphajo cheh ahiti, keiman kahei.
en: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.
text:
ECC 8:12
Thadou: Hinlah mikhat chun chonset javei jen bol hen lang chule sotpi hing nalai henlang hijongleh, Pathen gingho dingin aphajo cheh ahiti, keiman kahei.
English: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.

tcz: Migilouho chu lolhing lou diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon Pathen ginna anei pouve. Nilhah lam lim tobangbep’in ahinkhou sotponte.
en: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.
text:
ECC 8:13
Thadou: Migilouho chu lolhing lou diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon Pathen ginna anei pouve. Nilhah lam lim tobangbep’in ahinkhou sotponte.
English: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.

tcz: Chule hiche hi i-chen nau vannoi leisetna ajehbeija ahideh poi. Hiche lei hinkhoa hin miphaho jong chu migilouho bolla akibol kom aum jiuvin, chule migilouho hi miphatah bolla akibol nau jong aumjie. Hiche jong hi ajehbei tobangbep chu ahi.
en: There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked. Again, there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.
text:
ECC 8:14
Thadou: Chule hiche hi i-chen nau vannoi leisetna ajehbeija ahideh poi. Hiche lei hinkhoa hin miphaho jong chu migilouho bolla akibol kom aum jiuvin, chule migilouho hi miphatah bolla akibol nau jong aumjie. Hiche jong hi ajehbei tobangbep chu ahi.
English: There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked. Again, there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.

tcz: Hiti chun keiman nuijat’umna chu ka phatsah’in ahi, ajeh chu mihon aneh uva, adon uva chule hinkho akipa thanoppi diu hi kaphat sahpeh ahi. Hitia chu Pathen’in amaho chu nipi noija ana tohgim nauva kon kipana khat anei theina diu ahi.
en: Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat, to drink, and to be joyful: for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.
text:
ECC 8:15
Thadou: Hiti chun keiman nuijat’umna chu ka phatsah’in ahi, ajeh chu mihon aneh uva, adon uva chule hinkho akipa thanoppi diu hi kaphat sahpeh ahi. Hitia chu Pathen’in amaho chu nipi noija ana tohgim nauva kon kipana khat anei theina diu ahi.
English: Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat, to drink, and to be joyful: for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.

tcz: Keiman chihna kaholna’a hin, chule hiche vannoi leiset chunga miho pohgih poh kavet jingna’a hin, keiman kakholdoh chu sunle janna kichol tih um louva kho-sahna ka mudoh in ahi.
en: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no sleep day or night),
text:
ECC 8:16
Thadou: Keiman chihna kaholna’a hin, chule hiche vannoi leiset chunga miho pohgih poh kavet jingna’a hin, keiman kakholdoh chu sunle janna kichol tih um louva kho-sahna ka mudoh in ahi.
English: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no sleep day or night),

tcz: Keiman kahetdoh chu mihem koimachan Pathen’in nipi noija anatohdoh chu akholdoh joulou ding ahi, tihi ahi. Mihem koima chan ipi seijong leh miching penho jengin jong ijakai akholdoh joulou diu ahi.
en: then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man labors to seek it out, yet he won’t find it. Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won’t be able to find it.
text:
ECC 8:17
Thadou: Keiman kahetdoh chu mihem koimachan Pathen’in nipi noija anatohdoh chu akholdoh joulou ding ahi, tihi ahi. Mihem koima chan ipi seijong leh miching penho jengin jong ijakai akholdoh joulou diu ahi.
English: then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man labors to seek it out, yet he won’t find it. Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won’t be able to find it.

tcz: Hiche jonghi keiman chingthei tah in ka khol in: Pathen ngaisah hole miching ho jong Pathen khutna uma ahiuvin, amaho hi Pathen’in ahepi ding hinauvem ti koima ahetoh’a aumpoi.
en: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.
text:
ECC 9:1
Thadou: Hiche jonghi keiman chingthei tah in ka khol in: Pathen ngaisah hole miching ho jong Pathen khutna uma ahiuvin, amaho hi Pathen’in ahepi ding hinauvem ti koima ahetoh’a aumpoi.
English: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.

tcz: Mi tinin atonsot mun diu ngah jinga uma ahiuve, michonpha hihen, migilou hijong leh, mipha hihen, miphalou hijongleh, athenga kigel ho hiuhen, athenglou hijongleu, hou ngaisah hihen, hou ngaisahlou hijongleh, mipha hon jong michonse ho bangma’a Pathen’a kitepna neiho jong kitepna neilouho toh kithakhatma ahije.
en: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.
text:
ECC 9:2
Thadou: Mi tinin atonsot mun diu ngah jinga uma ahiuve, michonpha hihen, migilou hijong leh, mipha hihen, miphalou hijongleh, athenga kigel ho hiuhen, athenglou hijongleu, hou ngaisah hihen, hou ngaisahlou hijongleh, mipha hon jong michonse ho bangma’a Pathen’a kitepna neiho jong kitepna neilouho toh kithakhatma ahije.
English: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.

tcz: Amitakip nipi noija umho jouse chan kibanga athiltou hi lungdon umtah ahi. Hitobang hohin thilpha bolbe nadinga ching thei lou’uva ahi. Chusang in amahon angol nau joh chu aki deilhen uve, ajeh chu amaho kinepna neilou ahiuve. Amasang uva imacha dang umlou thina bou chu uma ahi.
en: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
text:
ECC 9:3
Thadou: Amitakip nipi noija umho jouse chan kibanga athiltou hi lungdon umtah ahi. Hitobang hohin thilpha bolbe nadinga ching thei lou’uva ahi. Chusang in amahon angol nau joh chu aki deilhen uve, ajeh chu amaho kinepna neilou ahiuve. Amasang uva imacha dang umlou thina bou chu uma ahi.
English: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.

tcz: Mihing ding in kinepna bou aum’e. Ama hon asei uvin, “Uicha hing chu keipi thisa sangin aphachom joi.”
en: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
text:
ECC 9:4
Thadou: Mihing ding in kinepna bou aum’e. Ama hon asei uvin, “Uicha hing chu keipi thisa sangin aphachom joi.”
English: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

tcz: Mihngho chun athi diu beh akihet’uvin, hinlah athisa hon imacha ahe tapouve.
en: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.
text:
ECC 9:5
Thadou: Mihngho chun athi diu beh akihet’uvin, hinlah athisa hon imacha ahe tapouve.
English: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.

tcz: Amahon ahinkhouva ipi hijongleh abholchanu chu ki-ngailut, ki-thet, ki-mitthip abonna achemangsa ahitai. Amahon hiche leiset chunga hin bolbe ding anei tapouve.
en: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.
text:
ECC 9:6
Thadou: Amahon ahinkhouva ipi hijongleh abholchanu chu ki-ngailut, ki-thet, ki-mitthip abonna achemangsa ahitai. Amahon hiche leiset chunga hin bolbe ding anei tapouve.
English: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.

tcz: Hijeh chun na-an chu kipah thanomtah in nen, chule na-lengpitwi chu lung kipah pum in don in, ajeh chu Pathen’in hichu aphatsah ahi.
en: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
text:
ECC 9:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun na-an chu kipah thanomtah in nen, chule na-lengpitwi chu lung kipah pum in don in, ajeh chu Pathen’in hichu aphatsah ahi.
English: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.

tcz: Von hoipen chun kivon in, chule lou namtui chu kinu-in.
en: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.
text:
ECC 9:8
Thadou: Von hoipen chun kivon in, chule lou namtui chu kinu-in.
English: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.

tcz: Numei nangailutnu chuto nipi noija Pathen’in napeh nahinkho umpet chun kipahtah in hing khom in. Najia nanei chuto phaten hingkhom lhon in.
en: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.
text:
ECC 9:9
Thadou: Numei nangailutnu chuto nipi noija Pathen’in napeh nahinkho umpet chun kipahtah in hing khom in. Najia nanei chuto phaten hingkhom lhon in.
English: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.

tcz: Nabol chan chu hoitah’in bol tan. Ajeh chu nangma lhankhuh’a na chetengleh natoh ding um talou ding, tohgon jong um talou ding, hetna jeng jong umta pontin, chihna geija bei ding ahitai.
en: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.
text:
ECC 9:10
Thadou: Nabol chan chu hoitah’in bol tan. Ajeh chu nangma lhankhuh’a na chetengleh natoh ding um talou ding, tohgon jong um talou ding, hetna jeng jong umta pontin, chihna geija bei ding ahitai.
English: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.

tcz: Keiman nipi noija adang chom khat jong ka mudoh’e. Lhaija hat penpan jong kipaman amu jing ahipoi, chule galsatna hatpenpa jeng jong chu galjona chang jing ahipoi. Miching jong chu kelthoh’a avale jipet aum in, chule khut them hon jong lungkimna amudeh pouve. Chule lekhathem tahho jong chu lolhinna hinkho mang jinga ahipouve. Hiche ho jouse hi vang'in apohji ahin, hitia chu aphatcha amuna gatoh kha kiti ahi.
en: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.
text:
ECC 9:11
Thadou: Keiman nipi noija adang chom khat jong ka mudoh’e. Lhaija hat penpan jong kipaman amu jing ahipoi, chule galsatna hatpenpa jeng jong chu galjona chang jing ahipoi. Miching jong chu kelthoh’a avale jipet aum in, chule khut them hon jong lungkimna amudeh pouve. Chule lekhathem tahho jong chu lolhinna hinkho mang jinga ahipouve. Hiche ho jouse hi vang'in apohji ahin, hitia chu aphatcha amuna gatoh kha kiti ahi.
English: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.

tcz: Itobang phat hahsa hunglhung ding ahi koima asei theija aum poi. Ngalen sung’a um vacha athangkol sunga um tobang'in miho chu phulou helouvin hamset nan apha jiuve.
en: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.
text:
ECC 9:12
Thadou: Itobang phat hahsa hunglhung ding ahi koima asei theija aum poi. Ngalen sung’a um vacha athangkol sunga um tobang'in miho chu phulou helouvin hamset nan apha jiuve.
English: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.

tcz: Hichea hin chihna themkhat keima vannoi khosah dan hin eilung lut sah aume.
en: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.
text:
ECC 9:13
Thadou: Hichea hin chihna themkhat keima vannoi khosah dan hin eilung lut sah aume.
English: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.

tcz: Khopi neocha khat asunga cheng mijong themkhat bou ahiuve, chule leng lentah khat chu asepai hotoh ahung un, khopi chu aum kimvel tauve.
en: There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.
text:
ECC 9:14
Thadou: Khopi neocha khat asunga cheng mijong themkhat bou ahiuve, chule leng lentah khat chu asepai hotoh ahung un, khopi chu aum kimvel tauve.
English: There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.

tcz: Mivaicha, michingtah khat chun hiche khopi chu iti huhdoh ding ahi ahen, chule hitichun huhdoh in aumtai. Hinlah hiche jou chun koima chan akoma kipa thu aseipouve.
en: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
text:
ECC 9:15
Thadou: Mivaicha, michingtah khat chun hiche khopi chu iti huhdoh ding ahi ahen, chule hitichun huhdoh in aumtai. Hinlah hiche jou chun koima chan akoma kipa thu aseipouve.
English: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

tcz: Hiti chun, chihna hi thahat sanga aphatjoh vang'in, miching chu avaichatleh mi nahsahmo achang e. Athuseidoh ho chu kipapi sotna koiman anei poi.
en: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
text:
ECC 9:16
Thadou: Hiti chun, chihna hi thahat sanga aphatjoh vang'in, miching chu avaichatleh mi nahsahmo achang e. Athuseidoh ho chu kipapi sotna koiman anei poi.
English: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

tcz: Leng ngolpa kisen aw jahsang in michingpan olcha thu asei jah nom aum joi.
en: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.
text:
ECC 9:17
Thadou: Leng ngolpa kisen aw jahsang in michingpan olcha thu asei jah nom aum joi.
English: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.

tcz: Galman chah hoa kivon kichei sang in chih thujah apha joi. Hinlah michonse khat chun apha tampi asuh mang thei joh ahi.
en: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.
text:
ECC 9:18
Thadou: Galman chah hoa kivon kichei sang in chih thujah apha joi. Hinlah michonse khat chun apha tampi asuh mang thei joh ahi.
English: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.

tcz: Gimnamtui bom chu thoulhe thisa ho uijin anamset sah jeng theijin, chuto bangma chun kingolsahna mai maijin chihna le jabolna sangtah chu mohseh asosah theije.
en: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor; so does a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor.
text:
ECC 10:1
Thadou: Gimnamtui bom chu thoulhe thisa ho uijin anamset sah jeng theijin, chuto bangma chun kingolsahna mai maijin chihna le jabolna sangtah chu mohseh asosah theije.
English: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor; so does a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor.

tcz: Miching theijin lamdih akilhen in, angol in adihlou chu aki lhen’e.
en: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand, but a fool’s heart at his left.
text:
ECC 10:2
Thadou: Miching theijin lamdih akilhen in, angol in adihlou chu aki lhen’e.
English: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand, but a fool’s heart at his left.

tcz: Nangman mingol ho chu lamsuh akijot nauva nahetdoh jeng thei ahi.
en: Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.
text:
ECC 10:3
Thadou: Nangman mingol ho chu lamsuh akijot nauva nahetdoh jeng thei ahi.
English: Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.

tcz: Na vaihompa chu na chunga alunglhai louva ahileh mohthip san hih in! Thipkhen cha kitohpa chun asuhkhel lentah jong asem hoi thei ahi.
en: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.
text:
ECC 10:4
Thadou: Na vaihompa chu na chunga alunglhai louva ahileh mohthip san hih in! Thipkhen cha kitohpa chun asuhkhel lentah jong asem hoi thei ahi.
English: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.

tcz: Keiman nipi noija aphalou chombeh khat ka mudoh in ahi. Lengho le vaihom hon suhkhelna hoise tah aboldoh jiuve.
en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.
text:
ECC 10:5
Thadou: Keiman nipi noija aphalou chombeh khat ka mudoh in ahi. Lengho le vaihom hon suhkhelna hoise tah aboldoh jiuve.
English: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.

tcz: Amahon mingol ho thuneina len apeh doh’uva chule athunei dinga kilom tah ho asuhnem jiuhi ahi.
en: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place.
text:
ECC 10:6
Thadou: Amahon mingol ho thuneina len apeh doh’uva chule athunei dinga kilom tah ho asuhnem jiuhi ahi.
English: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place.

tcz: Keiman soh ho jeng jong chu sakol chunga leng chapate tobanga atoudoh’u, chule leng chapate ho chu sohho tobanga lam ajotnu kamu tai.
en: I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth.
text:
ECC 10:7
Thadou: Keiman soh ho jeng jong chu sakol chunga leng chapate tobanga atoudoh’u, chule leng chapate ho chu sohho tobanga lam ajotnu kamu tai.
English: I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth.

tcz: Twikul nalai tengleh na lhahlut thei ahi. Chule banglui chu nang in naphetlhah teng leh gul-in jong na chuh thei ahi.
en: He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.
text:
ECC 10:8
Thadou: Twikul nalai tengleh na lhahlut thei ahi. Chule banglui chu nang in naphetlhah teng leh gul-in jong na chuh thei ahi.
English: He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.

tcz: Song ima laiya nakon tengleh, song hungchima nalhuh khum thei ahi. Nang in thing natan tengleh, na heiga chun thing phata atan thei lou ding ahi.
en: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.
text:
ECC 10:9
Thadou: Song ima laiya nakon tengleh, song hungchima nalhuh khum thei ahi. Nang in thing natan tengleh, na heiga chun thing phata atan thei lou ding ahi.
English: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.

tcz: Heicha hemlou mang mi chun tha tamtah asuhmang ding ahi, hijeh chun na hei chang kinol phat in. Hiche hi chihna amanlutna ahin, na lolhin sah ding ahi.
en: If the ax is blunt, and one doesn’t sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success.
text:
ECC 10:10
Thadou: Heicha hemlou mang mi chun tha tamtah asuhmang ding ahi, hijeh chun na hei chang kinol phat in. Hiche hi chihna amanlutna ahin, na lolhin sah ding ahi.
English: If the ax is blunt, and one doesn’t sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success.

tcz: Gul chu na kingai sah kah’a na hin chuh man tahleh ipi phatsah’a gulchu na kingai sah ki got ham?
en: If the snake bites before it is charmed, then is there no profit for the charmer’s tongue.
text:
ECC 10:11
Thadou: Gul chu na kingai sah kah’a na hin chuh man tahleh ipi phatsah’a gulchu na kingai sah ki got ham?
English: If the snake bites before it is charmed, then is there no profit for the charmer’s tongue.

tcz: Chih thusei ho pachat achanguve, hinlah ngolna thuseiho athusei-uva akipal jiuve.
en: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.
text:
ECC 10:12
Thadou: Chih thusei ho pachat achanguve, hinlah ngolna thuseiho athusei-uva akipal jiuve.
English: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.

tcz: Mingol ho lunggel chu ngolhoi thua akipanin, hiti chun athungah lhahnau jong chu gitlouna tah ngolna hung hiding ahi.
en: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.
text:
ECC 10:13
Thadou: Mingol ho lunggel chu ngolhoi thua akipanin, hiti chun athungah lhahnau jong chu gitlouna tah ngolna hung hiding ahi.
English: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.

tcz: Mingol hon thu aseibe beuvin, khonunga ipi hunglhung ding ahi koiman ahepon, asei chenthei pouvin ahi.
en: A fool also multiplies words. Man doesn’t know what will be; and that which will be after him, who can tell him?
text:
ECC 10:14
Thadou: Mingol hon thu aseibe beuvin, khonunga ipi hunglhung ding ahi koiman ahepon, asei chenthei pouvin ahi.
English: A fool also multiplies words. Man doesn’t know what will be; and that which will be after him, who can tell him?

tcz: Mingol hon neocha atoh nauva chun athangui pai uvin, in iti hunglhun ding ham tijong akihetji pouve.
en: The labor of fools wearies every one of them; for he doesn’t know how to go to the city.
text:
ECC 10:15
Thadou: Mingol hon neocha atoh nauva chun athangui pai uvin, in iti hunglhun ding ham tijong akihetji pouve.
English: The labor of fools wearies every one of them; for he doesn’t know how to go to the city.

tcz: Gamsunga vaihom hon jingpia golvah abolluva, gamsung vaihomma pang soh chu lunghem umtah ahi.
en: Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning!
text:
ECC 10:16
Thadou: Gamsunga vaihom hon jingpia golvah abolluva, gamsung vaihomma pang soh chu lunghem umtah ahi.
English: Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning!

tcz: Lenga pang milunglen lamkai nei gamsung chule aphatcha golvahbol vaipi popa chu pachat umtah ahi.
en: Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles, and your princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!
text:
ECC 10:17
Thadou: Lenga pang milunglen lamkai nei gamsung chule aphatcha golvahbol vaipi popa chu pachat umtah ahi.
English: Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles, and your princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!

tcz: Mithase inchung chu govatna theijin anem lha suh jin, thaset jeh’a inchung vangchet chut jia ahi.
en: By slothfulness the roof sinks in; and through idleness of the hands the house leaks.
text:
ECC 10:18
Thadou: Mithase inchung chu govatna theijin anem lha suh jin, thaset jeh’a inchung vangchet chut jia ahi.
English: By slothfulness the roof sinks in; and through idleness of the hands the house leaks.

tcz: Golnop bol hin nuipohlahna asodohjin, lengpitwi jin kipana apei, chule sum in ijakai achojin ahi.
en: A feast is made for laughter, and wine makes the life glad; and money is the answer for all things.
text:
ECC 10:19
Thadou: Golnop bol hin nuipohlahna asodohjin, lengpitwi jin kipana apei, chule sum in ijakai achojin ahi.
English: A feast is made for laughter, and wine makes the life glad; and money is the answer for all things.

tcz: Lengpa chu imacha louvin gel-hihbeh in, chule athuneipa chu nalupna jenga jong nuisat hih in. Ajeh chu vacha neocha chun nathusei chu agalhutna naseiho chu aseipeh ding ahi.
en: Don’t curse the king, no, not in your thoughts; and don’t curse the rich in your bedroom, for a bird of the sky may carry your voice, and that which has wings may tell the matter.
text:
ECC 10:20
Thadou: Lengpa chu imacha louvin gel-hihbeh in, chule athuneipa chu nalupna jenga jong nuisat hih in. Ajeh chu vacha neocha chun nathusei chu agalhutna naseiho chu aseipeh ding ahi.
English: Don’t curse the king, no, not in your thoughts; and don’t curse the rich in your bedroom, for a bird of the sky may carry your voice, and that which has wings may tell the matter.

tcz: Nangman na muchi chu twipi gallam geijin thotdoh in, chule aphatcha a-pungdoh chu nahenga hung le lhun kit ding ahi.
en: Cast your bread on the waters; for you shall find it after many days.
text:
ECC 11:1
Thadou: Nangman na muchi chu twipi gallam geijin thotdoh in, chule aphatcha a-pungdoh chu nahenga hung le lhun kit ding ahi.
English: Cast your bread on the waters; for you shall find it after many days.

tcz: Hinlah nangman na sumkhol ho chu mun tampia homjal in, ajeh chu ipi hahsatna in ahinphah ding nangin nahepoi.
en: Give a portion to seven, yes, even to eight; for you don’t know what evil will be on the earth.
text:
ECC 11:2
Thadou: Hinlah nangman na sumkhol ho chu mun tampia homjal in, ajeh chu ipi hahsatna in ahinphah ding nangin nahepoi.
English: Give a portion to seven, yes, even to eight; for you don’t know what evil will be on the earth.

tcz: Meibol kitol atam tengleh, go ahung julha jin ahi. Thingphung chu sahlam hihen lhanglam hijongleh alhuhna’a chun aum den jeng’e.
en: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth; and if a tree falls toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falls, there shall it be.
text:
ECC 11:3
Thadou: Meibol kitol atam tengleh, go ahung julha jin ahi. Thingphung chu sahlam hihen lhanglam hijongleh alhuhna’a chun aum den jeng’e.
English: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth; and if a tree falls toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falls, there shall it be.

tcz: Loubol mi chun gophat pet anga leh chang phutdoh ponte. Meibol kitol avetsui jing uleh , itih in jong chang at pouvinte.
en: He who observes the wind won’t sow; and he who regards the clouds won’t reap.
text:
ECC 11:4
Thadou: Loubol mi chun gophat pet anga leh chang phutdoh ponte. Meibol kitol avetsui jing uleh , itih in jong chang at pouvinte.
English: He who observes the wind won’t sow; and he who regards the clouds won’t reap.

tcz: Nangman huinun na chu alampi na hetdoh theilou tobang'in, ahilouleh naocha anu oisunga kijil chu iti hungkhan let ham ti na het thei lou tobang'in, nangman hiche ho jouse hinbol’a Pathen chaloh dan nahet thei lou ding ahi.
en: As you don’t know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you don’t know the work of God who does all.
text:
ECC 11:5
Thadou: Nangman huinun na chu alampi na hetdoh theilou tobang'in, ahilouleh naocha anu oisunga kijil chu iti hungkhan let ham ti na het thei lou tobang'in, nangman hiche ho jouse hinbol’a Pathen chaloh dan nahet thei lou ding ahi.
English: As you don’t know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you don’t know the work of God who does all.

tcz: Jingkah tengleh na muchi kitun lang, ni lhangkai jongleh gunchun ponpan in, ijeh inem itileh hoipenna chu apung ding pen chu hung sohdoh ding ham ti nangman nahe poi.
en: In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don’t withhold your hand; for you don’t know which will prosper, whether this or that, or whether they both will be equally good.
text:
ECC 11:6
Thadou: Jingkah tengleh na muchi kitun lang, ni lhangkai jongleh gunchun ponpan in, ijeh inem itileh hoipenna chu apung ding pen chu hung sohdoh ding ham ti nangman nahe poi.
English: In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don’t withhold your hand; for you don’t know which will prosper, whether this or that, or whether they both will be equally good.

tcz: Vah hi anom’e! Khovah thah hunglhun vet hi iti lunglhai um hitam?
en: Truly the light is sweet, and it is a pleasant thing for the eyes to see the sun.
text:
ECC 11:7
Thadou: Vah hi anom’e! Khovah thah hunglhun vet hi iti lunglhai um hitam?
English: Truly the light is sweet, and it is a pleasant thing for the eyes to see the sun.

tcz: Mi chu ateh geija ahinna ahileh, anitin hinkhoa kipah hen. Chujongleh hinkhoa gimna nikho jong tampi hunglhung ding ahiti jong geldoh uhen. Thil ahung lhungbe dingho hi ajeh bei tobangbep hung hi theija ahi.
en: Yes, if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all; but let him remember the days of darkness, for they shall be many. All that comes is vanity.
text:
ECC 11:8
Thadou: Mi chu ateh geija ahinna ahileh, anitin hinkhoa kipah hen. Chujongleh hinkhoa gimna nikho jong tampi hunglhung ding ahiti jong geldoh uhen. Thil ahung lhungbe dingho hi ajeh bei tobangbep hung hi theija ahi.
English: Yes, if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all; but let him remember the days of darkness, for they shall be many. All that comes is vanity.

tcz: Khangdong ho, khandonlai hi iti kidan hitam! Kipana tothon nalunggil in kihilna nei jing in, na bolnom chan bol lin; nalunggot nalam jousea chelen, chule namit tenin avetthei chan vehen. Ahinlah nathilbol chan chu Pathen henga namopohna hiding ahi, ti geldoh in.
en: Rejoice, young man, in your youth, and let your heart cheer you in the days of your youth, and walk in the ways of your heart, and in the sight of your eyes; but know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment.
text:
ECC 11:9
Thadou: Khangdong ho, khandonlai hi iti kidan hitam! Kipana tothon nalunggil in kihilna nei jing in, na bolnom chan bol lin; nalunggot nalam jousea chelen, chule namit tenin avetthei chan vehen. Ahinlah nathilbol chan chu Pathen henga namopohna hiding ahi, ti geldoh in.
English: Rejoice, young man, in your youth, and let your heart cheer you in the days of your youth, and walk in the ways of your heart, and in the sight of your eyes; but know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment.

tcz: Hijeh chun lungkhamna kiti bol hih in, chule natahsa damtheina din kichin tup in; chule hiche hi geldoh jing in, khandonlai na masanga na hinkho umsun hi ajehbei tobangbep ahibouve.
en: Therefore remove sorrow from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh; for youth and the dawn of life are vanity.
text:
ECC 11:10
Thadou: Hijeh chun lungkhamna kiti bol hih in, chule natahsa damtheina din kichin tup in; chule hiche hi geldoh jing in, khandonlai na masanga na hinkho umsun hi ajehbei tobangbep ahibouve.
English: Therefore remove sorrow from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh; for youth and the dawn of life are vanity.

tcz: Nakhangdonlai thanopna chun na Sempa suhmilna sodoh hih hen. Natehset masang nakhangdon laihin, Ama chu jabollin chule “Hinkho hi anomtapoi,” tin seijin.
en: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them;”
text:
ECC 12:1
Thadou: Nakhangdonlai thanopna chun na Sempa suhmilna sodoh hih hen. Natehset masang nakhangdon laihin, Ama chu jabollin chule “Hinkho hi anomtapoi,” tin seijin.
English: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them;”

tcz: Nateh’a namit tenin nisa lha le ahsiho vah avetna athim masang in, chule meibol’a kona go hung ju lha ding van chu athim masangin Ama chu geldoh in.
en: Before the sun, the light, the moon, and the stars are darkened, and the clouds return after the rain;

tcz: Na in ngah’a pang nakengho chu ahung kithin masang in, na mihat ho alhahsuh uva chule na lengkou teni ahung bon masang in, na Sempa geldoh in. Nasoh um amoh chengse le naha hon ima alhai theilou masang in; chule namit tenin amutheina bangkot, numei hon avetna chu ahung thim masang in, Ama chu geldoh in.
en: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those who look out of the windows are darkened,
text:
ECC 12:3
Thadou: Na in ngah’a pang nakengho chu ahung kithin masang in, na mihat ho alhahsuh uva chule na lengkou teni ahung bon masang in, na Sempa geldoh in. Nasoh um amoh chengse le naha hon ima alhai theilou masang in; chule namit tenin amutheina bangkot, numei hon avetna chu ahung thim masang in, Ama chu geldoh in.
English: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those who look out of the windows are darkened,

tcz: Hinkhoa phat kijen naneipat ahung kichai masang in chule natohgim phat ahung kichai masang in, Ama chu geldoh in. Husat ginho ahung thipma chule vacha hamgin najah masat tengleh nangma nahung kithodoh ding ahi.
en: and the doors shall be shut in the street; when the sound of the grinding is low, and one shall rise up at the voice of a bird, and all the daughters of music shall be brought low;

tcz: Nangma lhuh ding nahung kichat tijatna, chule lamlen jotna’a jong setto ding nalung khama, vaopah banga nasam ho ahung kana, chule khaokhopi tobanga nakhupboh’a lam nahin jot masang in, chule jitoh kingaina imacha nei talouva nahung um masang in, Ama chu geldoh in. Nangman na tonsot mun na jot masanga, lhankhuh nanai tul tul’a, na kivuina muna lunghem ho aka phat’u hung lhun masang in, Ama chu geldoh in.
en: yes, they shall be afraid of heights, and terrors will be on the way; and the almond tree shall blossom, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail; because man goes to his everlasting home, and the mourners go about the streets;

tcz: Nangma nakhandon pat hin dangka khaogui akibotan masang, sana khon aki vohkeh masang, twinah phunga twibel aki tachip masang, twibel phunga kangtalai aki vohbal masang in, na Sempa geldoh in.
en: before the silver cord is severed, or the golden bowl is broken, or the pitcher is broken at the spring, or the wheel broken at the cistern,
text:
ECC 12:6
Thadou: Nangma nakhandon pat hin dangka khaogui akibotan masang, sana khon aki vohkeh masang, twinah phunga twibel aki tachip masang, twibel phunga kangtalai aki vohbal masang in, na Sempa geldoh in.
English: before the silver cord is severed, or the golden bowl is broken, or the pitcher is broken at the spring, or the wheel broken at the cistern,

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh hiche phat chu ahung lhunteng, vut leiset kisoh kit intin; chule lhagao chu apepa Pathen henga kile kit ding ahi.
en: and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
text:
ECC 12:7
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh hiche phat chu ahung lhunteng, vut leiset kisoh kit intin; chule lhagao chu apepa Pathen henga kile kit ding ahi.
English: and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.

tcz: Thuhilpa chun, “Ijakai ajehbei tobangbep ahi, ajeh bei ahisoh keije,” ati.
en: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”
text:
ECC 12:8
Thadou: Thuhilpa chun, “Ijakai ajehbei tobangbep ahi, ajeh bei ahisoh keije,” ati.
English: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”

tcz: Hiche hi nalung in ching jing in: Thuhilpa chu miching ahin, chule amachun ahetchan chu miho ahilji ahi. Ama chun thuchih tampi chingthetah’a angaitoa, agel-a chule ahop khen tohle ahi.
en: Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in order many proverbs.
text:
ECC 12:9
Thadou: Hiche hi nalung in ching jing in: Thuhilpa chu miching ahin, chule amachun ahetchan chu miho ahilji ahi. Ama chun thuchih tampi chingthetah’a angaitoa, agel-a chule ahop khen tohle ahi.
English: Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in order many proverbs.

tcz: Thuhilpa chun, thudihtah chu mudoh dinga ahol-a thutah chu kichehtah’a aphondoh nom ahi.
en: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.
text:
ECC 12:10
Thadou: Thuhilpa chun, thudihtah chu mudoh dinga ahol-a thutah chu kichehtah’a aphondoh nom ahi.
English: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.

tcz: Miching thusei hochu tengcha hemtah tobanga ahin, najongleh phachoma ahi. Athuseiju kilakhom hohi thingkil kikil matchet tobang leuva kelngoi chingpan akelngoi ho huikhomna’a amanchah ji tobang ahi.
en: The words of the wise are like goads; and like nails well fastened are words from the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
text:
ECC 12:11
Thadou: Miching thusei hochu tengcha hemtah tobanga ahin, najongleh phachoma ahi. Athuseiju kilakhom hohi thingkil kikil matchet tobang leuva kelngoi chingpan akelngoi ho huikhomna’a amanchah ji tobang ahi.
English: The words of the wise are like goads; and like nails well fastened are words from the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.

tcz: Hinlah kacha, Keiman thuhilna naneibe kit inge: Chingthei jin, ajeh chu lekhabu ho jihdoh kitia kichai tih aumpoi, chule lekha hasim hin na cholsah ahije.
en: Furthermore, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
text:
ECC 12:12
Thadou: Hinlah kacha, Keiman thuhilna naneibe kit inge: Chingthei jin, ajeh chu lekhabu ho jihdoh kitia kichai tih aumpoi, chule lekha hasim hin na cholsah ahije.
English: Furthermore, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.

tcz: Hiche hi aboncha thu kaigom ahi. Tun keiman thukhumkhana kanei hi ngai phan: Pathen ginna neijin chule athupeh ho jui jin, ajeh chu hiche hi amitakip tohding kin ahi.
en: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.
text:
ECC 12:13
Thadou: Hiche hi aboncha thu kaigom ahi. Tun keiman thukhumkhana kanei hi ngai phan: Pathen ginna neijin chule athupeh ho jui jin, ajeh chu hiche hi amitakip tohding kin ahi.
English: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.

tcz: Ijakai chung changa, guhthim thudol- apha hihen ase hijongleh, Pathen in eiho thilbol dungjui cheh’a thutanna anei ding ahi.
en: For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.
text:
ECC 12:14
Thadou: Ijakai chung changa, guhthim thudol- apha hihen ase hijongleh, Pathen in eiho thilbol dungjui cheh’a thutanna anei ding ahi.
English: For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.

tcz: Zailom: Hiche hi Solomon la ho lah’a apipen, adang jouse sanga thupi ahi.
en: The Song of songs, which is Solomon’s.
text:
SNG 1:1
Thadou: Zailom: Hiche hi Solomon la ho lah’a apipen, adang jouse sanga thupi ahi.
English: The Song of songs, which is Solomon’s.

tcz: Mounu: Neichop in lang, avel in neichop in, ajeh chu nei deibolna chu lengpitwi sang in jong alhumjoi.
en: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; for your love is better than wine.
text:
SNG 1:2
Thadou: Mounu: Neichop in lang, avel in neichop in, ajeh chu nei deibolna chu lengpitwi sang in jong alhumjoi.
English: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; for your love is better than wine.

tcz: Gimnamtwi nakinu chu iti namtwija hitam, namin ngei hi agim namtwi kitungdoh tobang ahi. Akidang poi, khangdong nungah jousen hibang loma nahin deiju hi!
en: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.
text:
SNG 1:3
Thadou: Gimnamtwi nakinu chu iti namtwija hitam, namin ngei hi agim namtwi kitungdoh tobang ahi. Akidang poi, khangdong nungah jousen hibang loma nahin deiju hi!
English: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.

tcz: Kei jong neipuijin, hung in; kijam ta hite! Lengpan ajalna pindan’ah ei puilut hen. Zailom: Iti kahin kipapiu hitam, O Lengpa. Na milungset dan hi lengpitwi sang in ka ngaisang jouve. Mounu: Nahin ngaisangnau hi adih tangeiye!
en: Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will praise your love more than wine! They are right to love you.
text:
SNG 1:4
Thadou: Kei jong neipuijin, hung in; kijam ta hite! Lengpan ajalna pindan’ah ei puilut hen. Zailom: Iti kahin kipapiu hitam, O Lengpa. Na milungset dan hi lengpitwi sang in ka ngaisang jouve. Mounu: Nahin ngaisangnau hi adih tangeiye!
English: Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will praise your love more than wine! They are right to love you.

tcz: Keima ka vouso avom vang'in kamelhoi nai, Vo Jerusalem Chanute-Cedar phaiya ponbuh kisongho banga vom, Solomon pondal banga vom chu ka hinai.
en: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.
text:
SNG 1:5
Thadou: Keima ka vouso avom vang'in kamelhoi nai, Vo Jerusalem Chanute-Cedar phaiya ponbuh kisongho banga vom, Solomon pondal banga vom chu ka hinai.
English: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.

tcz: Kavouso avom jeh-in, Neihin vehih-uvin-nisan ei kahdup jeh ahibouve. Ka sopi pasal ho ka chung ah alunghang uve, alengpi leiju vekol ding in eino uvin, hijeh chun kei le kei ka kijen joupoi; keima lengpilei ka kivet kol man poi.
en: Don’t stare at me because I am dark, because the sun has scorched me. My mother’s sons were angry with me. They made me keeper of the vineyards. I haven’t kept my own vineyard.
text:
SNG 1:6
Thadou: Kavouso avom jeh-in, Neihin vehih-uvin-nisan ei kahdup jeh ahibouve. Ka sopi pasal ho ka chung ah alunghang uve, alengpi leiju vekol ding in eino uvin, hijeh chun kei le kei ka kijen joupoi; keima lengpilei ka kivet kol man poi.
English: Don’t stare at me because I am dark, because the sun has scorched me. My mother’s sons were angry with me. They made me keeper of the vineyards. I haven’t kept my own vineyard.

tcz: Nei seipeh-in, O goldei, tuni na kelngoi honho hoilama na puiding ham? Sun teng hoikoma na kol sah ding ham? Ajeh chu keima hi noti banga naloi-napaiho chule kelngoite lah’a iti ka vavai le jeng thei ding ham?
en: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; for why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions?
text:
SNG 1:7
Thadou: Nei seipeh-in, O goldei, tuni na kelngoi honho hoilama na puiding ham? Sun teng hoikoma na kol sah ding ham? Ajeh chu keima hi noti banga naloi-napaiho chule kelngoite lah’a iti ka vavai le jeng thei ding ham?
English: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; for why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions?

tcz: Moulang: Na het loule, O nungah melhoipen nu; ka kelngoi ho kikaina nung juiyin lang, kelngoi chingho ponbuh vel’a chun na kelchate vah-in.
en: If you don’t know, most beautiful among women, follow the tracks of the sheep. Graze your young goats beside the shepherds’ tents.
text:
SNG 1:8
Thadou: Moulang: Na het loule, O nungah melhoipen nu; ka kelngoi ho kikaina nung juiyin lang, kelngoi chingho ponbuh vel’a chun na kelchate vah-in.
English: If you don’t know, most beautiful among women, follow the tracks of the sheep. Graze your young goats beside the shepherds’ tents.

tcz: O ka deinu, na nunnop dan hi Pharaoh sakol lagol lah-a khat toh nabang’e.
en: I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.
text:
SNG 1:9
Thadou: O ka deinu, na nunnop dan hi Pharaoh sakol lagol lah-a khat toh nabang’e.
English: I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.

tcz: Na bengmai alangtoa hi iti deium hitam! Na bilba tenin asal emsel jeng’e! Nangong jong iti dei um hitam, na sana bilba hung kailha chun ajem hoi be cheh-e.
en: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.
text:
SNG 1:10
Thadou: Na bengmai alangtoa hi iti deium hitam! Na bilba tenin asal emsel jeng’e! Nangong jong iti dei um hitam, na sana bilba hung kailha chun ajem hoi be cheh-e.
English: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.

tcz: Zailom: Sanavui sempeh-ungting, kicheina ding dangkavui toh thosah-unge.
en: We will make you earrings of gold, with studs of silver.
text:
SNG 1:11
Thadou: Zailom: Sanavui sempeh-ungting, kicheina ding dangkavui toh thosah-unge.
English: We will make you earrings of gold, with studs of silver.

tcz: Mounu: Lengpa jalkhun chung ah alum in, gimnamtwi ka kinu gimnam hi aki tunglut jel jeng’e.
en: While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.
text:
SNG 1:12
Thadou: Mounu: Lengpa jalkhun chung ah alum in, gimnamtwi ka kinu gimnam hi aki tunglut jel jeng’e.
English: While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.

tcz: Ka goldeipa hi ka ang-a Myrrh gim namtwi theineo kikhai abangin ahi.
en: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.
text:
SNG 1:13
Thadou: Ka goldeipa hi ka ang-a Myrrh gim namtwi theineo kikhai abangin ahi.
English: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.

tcz: Ama hi En-gedi lengpileiya henna pahcha-boh toh abange.
en: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.
text:
SNG 1:14
Thadou: Ama hi En-gedi lengpileiya henna pahcha-boh toh abange.
English: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.

tcz: Moulang: Iti hoiya hoi nahi hitam, O ka goldei nu! Namit teni hi vakho te abang jeng’e.
en: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves.
text:
SNG 1:15
Thadou: Moulang: Iti hoiya hoi nahi hitam, O ka goldei nu! Namit teni hi vakho te abang jeng’e.
English: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves.

tcz: Mounu: Nangma jong na hoi ngeije, O goldei, kam’a seidoh jou hoi hilouvin dei na um nalom’e! Hampa dong nem hiuheo khu i-jalkhun lhon ding in alom e.
en: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.
text:
SNG 1:16
Thadou: Mounu: Nangma jong na hoi ngeije, O goldei, kam’a seidoh jou hoi hilouvin dei na um nalom’e! Hampa dong nem hiuheo khu i-jalkhun lhon ding in alom e.
English: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.

tcz: Namtwi tah Cedar thingbah ho jeng jong i-inkam lhon ding in apang uvin, chahthing ho jeng jong i-insun lhon ding in apang’uve.
en: The beams of our house are cedars. Our rafters are firs.
text:
SNG 1:17
Thadou: Namtwi tah Cedar thingbah ho jeng jong i-inkam lhon ding in apang uvin, chahthing ho jeng jong i-insun lhon ding in apang’uve.
English: The beams of our house are cedars. Our rafters are firs.

tcz: Mounu: Kei hi Sharon phaichama pahcha chule phaichama lily pah kahi.
en: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.
text:
SNG 2:1
Thadou: Mounu: Kei hi Sharon phaichama pahcha chule phaichama lily pah kahi.
English: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.

tcz: Moulang: Ahi ngeije, lingnang lah-a lily aum bang in, nungah khangdong ho lah-a kadei nu aum e.
en: As a lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
text:
SNG 2:2
Thadou: Moulang: Ahi ngeije, lingnang lah-a lily aum bang in, nungah khangdong ho lah-a kadei nu aum e.
English: As a lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.

tcz: Mounu: Thei-hon sunga theithup twipen aum bang in, gollhang khangdong lah-in ka dongma pa aum’e. Alimdam noija keima ka touvin, atheiga twitah chu kane’e.
en: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste.
text:
SNG 2:3
Thadou: Mounu: Thei-hon sunga theithup twipen aum bang in, gollhang khangdong lah-in ka dongma pa aum’e. Alimdam noija keima ka touvin, atheiga twitah chu kane’e.
English: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste.

tcz: Aman golvahna in dan sung ah ei kilhon lutpin, eikhohsah dan hi akichen lheh jeng’e.
en: He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love.
text:
SNG 2:4
Thadou: Aman golvahna in dan sung ah ei kilhon lutpin, eikhohsah dan hi akichen lheh jeng’e.
English: He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love.

tcz: Lengpi theigan nei thahatsah-in lang, theithup gan nei kidodoh sah-in, ijeh-inem itileh keima nangma ngaija haisam pai ding kahi.
en: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples; for I am faint with love.
text:
SNG 2:5
Thadou: Lengpi theigan nei thahatsah-in lang, theithup gan nei kidodoh sah-in, ijeh-inem itileh keima nangma ngaija haisam pai ding kahi.
English: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples; for I am faint with love.

tcz: Aban veilam ka kikhap in, aban jet in eijut lelei.
en: His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me.
text:
SNG 2:6
Thadou: Aban veilam ka kikhap in, aban jet in eijut lelei.
English: His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me.

tcz: Vo Jerusalem chanute, lou jaova sapeng le sakhi min pan’a katem nahiuve; achama ahung kipatdoh ngal lou leh kideina hi nanghon tildoh tho ahilouleh suh-khahtho din got dauvin.
en: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
text:
SNG 2:7
Thadou: Vo Jerusalem chanute, lou jaova sapeng le sakhi min pan’a katem nahiuve; achama ahung kipatdoh ngal lou leh kideina hi nanghon tildoh tho ahilouleh suh-khahtho din got dauvin.
English: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.

tcz: O, kangai penpa ahung phei gin kajai! Molsang sang ahinlhah-in, alhang alhang ahin lhah-e.
en: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.
text:
SNG 2:8
Thadou: O, kangai penpa ahung phei gin kajai! Molsang sang ahinlhah-in, alhang alhang ahin lhah-e.
English: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.

tcz: Kangaipa hi man-gangtah sapeng gol tobang le sakhi chalgol tobang ahi. Veuvin, bangtom ah khun ama ading in; bangkot vangkah-a kon in ahin ven, pindan sung ahin velhin ahi.
en: My beloved is like a roe or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall! He looks in at the windows. He glances through the lattice.
text:
SNG 2:9
Thadou: Kangaipa hi man-gangtah sapeng gol tobang le sakhi chalgol tobang ahi. Veuvin, bangtom ah khun ama ading in; bangkot vangkah-a kon in ahin ven, pindan sung ahin velhin ahi.
English: My beloved is like a roe or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall! He looks in at the windows. He glances through the lattice.

tcz: Kangaipan aseije, “Kithouvin, ngainu! Hiti hin kijot mang ta hite, O melhoi!
en: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.
text:
SNG 2:10
Thadou: Kangaipan aseije, “Kithouvin, ngainu! Hiti hin kijot mang ta hite, O melhoi!
English: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.

tcz: Ven, phalbi a kichai tai; chule gojuh jong atang tai.
en: For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.
text:
SNG 2:11
Thadou: Ven, phalbi a kichai tai; chule gojuh jong atang tai.
English: For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.

tcz: Pahchate ahung jamdoh tauvin, vachate mao jinjen lai phat kum kihei ahung lhung tan, vahui hamgin in ikom-ivel khohui alodim tai.
en: The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
text:
SNG 2:12
Thadou: Pahchate ahung jamdoh tauvin, vachate mao jinjen lai phat kum kihei ahung lhung tan, vahui hamgin in ikom-ivel khohui alodim tai.
English: The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.

tcz: Theichang aga pantan, chule lengpipah gimvui akitung tai. Thouvin, ngainu! Hung in gavahdoh hite, O melhoi!”
en: The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.”
text:
SNG 2:13
Thadou: Theichang aga pantan, chule lengpipah gimvui akitung tai. Thouvin, ngainu! Hung in gavahdoh hite, O melhoi!”
English: The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.”

tcz: Moulang: Kol song panga songpi khi kah-ah kavakhu akiselle. Na somai nei musah-in, na awgin nei jahsah in. Ajeh chu na awgin angeiyin, na somai ahoi ngeije.
en: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places of the mountainside, let me see your face. Let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your face is lovely.
text:
SNG 2:14
Thadou: Moulang: Kol song panga songpi khi kah-ah kavakhu akiselle. Na somai nei musah-in, na awgin nei jahsah in. Ajeh chu na awgin angeiyin, na somai ahoi ngeije.
English: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places of the mountainside, let me see your face. Let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your face is lovely.

tcz: Zailom: Sealte khu man uvin, khuche sealneo ho khun kingailutna lengpilei laidung ahin chilthang masang uvin, man uvin, ijeh-inem itileh lengpithei pahlai ahitai!
en: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards; for our vineyards are in blossom.
text:
SNG 2:15
Thadou: Zailom: Sealte khu man uvin, khuche sealneo ho khun kingailutna lengpilei laidung ahin chilthang masang uvin, man uvin, ijeh-inem itileh lengpithei pahlai ahitai!
English: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards; for our vineyards are in blossom.

tcz: Mounu: Ka ngailutpa hi keija ahi in, keima ama-a kahi. Aman kelngoite Lily pahho lah-in alhajin, avahva ji’e.
en: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.
text:
SNG 2:16
Thadou: Mounu: Ka ngailutpa hi keija ahi in, keima ama-a kahi. Aman kelngoite Lily pahho lah-in alhajin, avahva ji’e.
English: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.

tcz: Khovahkon huilhi ahung nun masang, chule jan muthim lim jong akihei mang masang in, ka heng hin jon kit in; O ka ngai goldei, Bether lhangdunga sa peng gol ahilouleh sakhi chalgol hunglhai bangchan hung kit teijin.
en: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains of Bether.
text:
SNG 2:17
Thadou: Khovahkon huilhi ahung nun masang, chule jan muthim lim jong akihei mang masang in, ka heng hin jon kit in; O ka ngai goldei, Bether lhangdunga sa peng gol ahilouleh sakhi chalgol hunglhai bangchan hung kit teijin.
English: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains of Bether.

tcz: Mounu: Jan khat khun chunga sa-mang kajal laijin, ka goldeipa ka lhangai lheh-e. Kalhangai lheh jeng in, hinlah ama ahung poi.
en: By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
text:
SNG 3:1
Thadou: Mounu: Jan khat khun chunga sa-mang kajal laijin, ka goldeipa ka lhangai lheh-e. Kalhangai lheh jeng in, hinlah ama ahung poi.
English: By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.

tcz: Hijeh chun, “Keima kithoudoh-ing katin khopi tolsungah vahle in, lamlen-lamkah ningkoi jouse ah ka goldeipa gahol le inge,” tin ka kigel tai. Hiti chun ka gahol le in, hinlah ka gamu joupoi.
