tcz: Amahon migentheiho chungah kithutandihna alhunsah pouvin, kamite lah-a alhasamhon angaichat achandiu dol chanvou jong aphalpeh pouve. Meithaiho agem’un, naochagaho lhahsamna chungah phatchomna akiholuve.
en: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!
text:
ISA 10:2
Thadou: Amahon migentheiho chungah kithutandihna alhunsah pouvin, kamite lah-a alhasamhon angaichat achandiu dol chanvou jong aphalpeh pouve. Meithaiho agem’un, naochagaho lhahsamna chungah phatchomna akiholuve.
English: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!

tcz: Gamlatah-a kon hahsatna kahin lhunsah-a gotna kahin chansah tengule ipi nabol diu ham? Koi kom nangatnuva panpina nathum diu hitam?
en: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?
text:
ISA 10:3
Thadou: Gamlatah-a kon hahsatna kahin lhunsah-a gotna kahin chansah tengule ipi nabol diu ham? Koi kom nangatnuva panpina nathum diu hitam?
English: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?

tcz: Galmun’a nathilouvujongle soh-a dinga mi’n nakaimang diu ahitai. Hiche geiya jong Pakai lungdam dehlou ding, talen matsahbe dia khut alap jing nahlai ding ahi.
en: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
text:
ISA 10:4
Thadou: Galmun’a nathilouvujongle soh-a dinga mi’n nakaimang diu ahitai. Hiche geiya jong Pakai lungdam dehlou ding, talen matsahbe dia khut alap jing nahlai ding ahi.
English: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

tcz: “Ohe! Itobang vangsetnan ahinlamto tadem—Keiman kalunghanna mite jepna tenggol banga kamanji Assyria chu.
en: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
text:
ISA 10:5
Thadou: “Ohe! Itobang vangsetnan ahinlamto tadem—Keiman kalunghanna mite jepna tenggol banga kamanji Assyria chu.
English: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!

tcz: Keiman Assyria hi eilunghansah mite kadelkhumsah-in, anei agou jouseu kachomgamsahin, tolbol laha amite kachilthangsah-e.
en: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
text:
ISA 10:6
Thadou: Keiman Assyria hi eilunghansah mite kadelkhumsah-in, anei agou jouseu kachomgamsahin, tolbol laha amite kachilthangsah-e.
English: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

tcz: Ahinlah Assyria Lengpan ama chu kamanchah, kakhetbuh ahilam akihetpon; alungin angaito phapoi. Ama lunglam chu bailamtaha nam khat a pat nam khat suhmang jeng ding ti bou chu ahi.
en: However, he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.
text:
ISA 10:7
Thadou: Ahinlah Assyria Lengpan ama chu kamanchah, kakhetbuh ahilam akihetpon; alungin angaito phapoi. Ama lunglam chu bailamtaha nam khat a pat nam khat suhmang jeng ding ti bou chu ahi.
English: However, he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.

tcz: Ama’n seiyinte: ‘Kagal lamkai jouse jong hi lenga hungpang loi diu ahi.
en: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?
text:
ISA 10:8
Thadou: Ama’n seiyinte: ‘Kagal lamkai jouse jong hi lenga hungpang loi diu ahi.
English: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?

tcz: Calno kasumangui, Carchemish kabol bangun. Hamath jong Arpad bangin kamasanguva abohkhup tauve. Chuleh Samaria jong Damascus bangin kasumang tauve.
en: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”
text:
ISA 10:9
Thadou: Calno kasumangui, Carchemish kabol bangun. Hamath jong Arpad bangin kamasanguva abohkhup tauve. Chuleh Samaria jong Damascus bangin kasumang tauve.
English: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”

tcz: Henge, lenggam tamtah, apathen’u Jerusalem le Samariatea sanga loupijoho jeng jong abonuvin kajousoh tauve.
en: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria,
text:
ISA 10:10
Thadou: Henge, lenggam tamtah, apathen’u Jerusalem le Samariatea sanga loupijoho jeng jong abonuvin kajousoh tauve.
English: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria,

tcz: Chuti ahijeh-a chu Jerusalem le apathen’u chu kasuhmang diu ahitai, Samaria le apathen kasuhmangtha banguva,” tiin.
en: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
text:
ISA 10:11
Thadou: Chuti ahijeh-a chu Jerusalem le apathen’u chu kasuhmang diu ahitai, Samaria le apathen kasuhmangtha banguva,” tiin.
English: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

tcz: Pakaiyin atohgon Zion molsang le Jerusalem’a asuhbulhitna dinga Assyria lengpa amanchah banga, Ama’n Assyria lengpa chung ngeiya jong gotna alhunsah ding ahi—ijeh-inem itileh ama chu akiletsah-in ahamhoitho ta’n ahi.
en: Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his arrogant looks.
text:
ISA 10:12
Thadou: Pakaiyin atohgon Zion molsang le Jerusalem’a asuhbulhitna dinga Assyria lengpa amanchah banga, Ama’n Assyria lengpa chung ngeiya jong gotna alhunsah ding ahi—ijeh-inem itileh ama chu akiletsah-in ahamhoitho ta’n ahi.
English: Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his arrogant looks.

tcz: Ama chun, “Keima banthahat vanga bou hichan hi kaboldoh ahitai. Keima chihna le themna dungjuiya thilgon kabol ahi. Chitin namtin galkul kaphutvangin anei-agouvu kachomngim tai. Alengteu jong bongchal kikailhu bangin kasulhugamtai.
en: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.
text:
ISA 10:13
Thadou: Ama chun, “Keima banthahat vanga bou hichan hi kaboldoh ahitai. Keima chihna le themna dungjuiya thilgon kabol ahi. Chitin namtin galkul kaphutvangin anei-agouvu kachomngim tai. Alengteu jong bongchal kikailhu bangin kasulhugamtai.
English: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.

tcz: Loubolpa’n ahtui alokhom bangin agoubom’u le alenggam jouseu kalohkhom sohhel tai. Koiman keima douna-a alha ajap ngam tahlou ding chuleh keima douna kamcheng khat jeng jong aphondoh ngamlou ding ahitai,” tiin aseiye.
en: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”
text:
ISA 10:14
Thadou: Loubolpa’n ahtui alokhom bangin agoubom’u le alenggam jouseu kalohkhom sohhel tai. Koiman keima douna-a alha ajap ngam tahlou ding chuleh keima douna kamcheng khat jeng jong aphondoh ngamlou ding ahitai,” tiin aseiye.
English: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”

tcz: Ahileh, heicha’n athingtanpa sanga thupijoa kiseithei mong ding hinam? Thing-at chu athing-atpa sanga thupijoam? Thing tenggolin achanga lam ajotthei ding hinam?
en: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.
text:
ISA 10:15
Thadou: Ahileh, heicha’n athingtanpa sanga thupijoa kiseithei mong ding hinam? Thing-at chu athing-atpa sanga thupijoam? Thing tenggolin achanga lam ajotthei ding hinam?
English: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.

tcz: Hijeh-a chu, Pakai, Van galsatte Pakai chun Assyriate galsat hamhoithoho laha chu hise alhunsah ding, akiloupisahnau chu meikongin ahallhum ding ahi.
en: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.
text:
ISA 10:16
Thadou: Hijeh-a chu, Pakai, Van galsatte Pakai chun Assyriate galsat hamhoithoho laha chu hise alhunsah ding, akiloupisahnau chu meikongin ahallhum ding ahi.
English: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.

tcz: Pakai, Israelte salvah chu meikongin pangintin, Athengpa chu ameikou hiding ahi. Ama’n ling le khao jouse le melmate chu jan khat kah-a meikonga ahallhum ding ahi.
en: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.
text:
ISA 10:17
Thadou: Pakai, Israelte salvah chu meikongin pangintin, Athengpa chu ameikou hiding ahi. Ama’n ling le khao jouse le melmate chu jan khat kah-a meikonga ahallhum ding ahi.
English: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.

tcz: Pakaiyin Assyria loupina chu theiga phatna gam'a gammang meikah banga meiya aleochaisoh ding; hichu nat-hise la’n jeh'a hiveiho amahthahgam banga manthaina umding ahi.
en: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.
text:
ISA 10:18
Thadou: Pakaiyin Assyria loupina chu theiga phatna gam'a gammang meikah banga meiya aleochaisoh ding; hichu nat-hise la’n jeh'a hiveiho amahthahgam banga manthaina umding ahi.
English: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.

tcz: Hiche gammang thupitah sunga thingphung lhomcha sohcha ding—alhom dan chu chapang jengin jong ajat asimthei khambep hiding ahi.
en: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.
text:
ISA 10:19
Thadou: Hiche gammang thupitah sunga thingphung lhomcha sohcha ding—alhom dan chu chapang jengin jong ajat asimthei khambep hiding ahi.
English: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.

tcz: Chuniteng chuleh Israel gam'a akidalha ahingdoh chengse chun Van galsatte Pakai, Israelte Athengpa chu kitahtah-a atahsan diu ahitai.
en: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
text:
ISA 10:20
Thadou: Chuniteng chuleh Israel gam'a akidalha ahingdoh chengse chun Van galsatte Pakai, Israelte Athengpa chu kitahtah-a atahsan diu ahitai.
English: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

tcz: Hiche akidalha ahingdohho, Jacob chilhahte chu Pathen Hatchungnung hengah kiletauvinte.
en: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
text:
ISA 10:21
Thadou: Hiche akidalha ahingdohho, Jacob chilhahte chu Pathen Hatchungnung hengah kiletauvinte.
English: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

tcz: Israelte chu twipi panga neldi jat phajongleu, alahuva ahingdohho bou chu Pakai koma kile ding ahiuve. Pakai chun amite chu asuhmang dinga thulhuhna dihtaha abol ahitai.
en: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.
text:
ISA 10:22
Thadou: Israelte chu twipi panga neldi jat phajongleu, alahuva ahingdohho bou chu Pakai koma kile ding ahiuve. Pakai chun amite chu asuhmang dinga thulhuhna dihtaha abol ahitai.
English: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.

tcz: Henge, Pakai, Van gatsatte Pakai chun agamsung pumpi chu suhmang dinga anagotsa ahitai.
en: For the Lord, GOD of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth.
text:
ISA 10:23
Thadou: Henge, Pakai, Van gatsatte Pakai chun agamsung pumpi chu suhmang dinga anagotsa ahitai.
English: For the Lord, GOD of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth.

tcz: Hijehchun Pakai, Van galsatte Pakai chun hitin aseiye: “O Zion’a um kamite, Masanglaiya Egypt gam'a suhgentheiya naum lai banguva Assyriaten mollhon le hem’a nahin sat tengule kichahihun.
en: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, says, “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.
text:
ISA 10:24
Thadou: Hijehchun Pakai, Van galsatte Pakai chun hitin aseiye: “O Zion’a um kamite, Masanglaiya Egypt gam'a suhgentheiya naum lai banguva Assyriaten mollhon le hem’a nahin sat tengule kichahihun.
English: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, says, “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.

tcz: Chomkhat joule nachunguva kalunghanna hung beiyintin, chuteng kalunghanna chu namelmateu suhchimitna dingin kileheitante.
en: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”
text:
ISA 10:25
Thadou: Chomkhat joule nachunguva kalunghanna hung beiyintin, chuteng kalunghanna chu namelmateu suhchimitna dingin kileheitante.
English: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”

tcz: Keiman Oreb songpi chunga Midian mite kakhaoguiya kajep’a Gideon galjona kapeh-a, chuleh kamoljol akidopsanga Egypt galsatte twipin alhohmanggam banga Assyriate jong kasuhmanggam ding ahi.
en: The LORD of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.
text:
ISA 10:26
Thadou: Keiman Oreb songpi chunga Midian mite kakhaoguiya kajep’a Gideon galjona kapeh-a, chuleh kamoljol akidopsanga Egypt galsatte twipin alhohmanggam banga Assyriate jong kasuhmanggam ding ahi.
English: The LORD of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.

tcz: Chuniteng chuleh Pakaiyin amite sohchanna phat akichaisah ding, alengkou-uva kon’a soh namkol asutlhahpeh ding ahi.
en: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.
text:
ISA 10:27
Thadou: Chuniteng chuleh Pakaiyin amite sohchanna phat akichaisah ding, alengkou-uva kon’a soh namkol asutlhahpeh ding ahi.
English: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.

tcz: Veuvin, tuhin Assyriate Aiath ah aumtauve. Migron ajotpauvin amanchah thilkeohou Micmash munah akoikhomuve.
en: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.
text:
ISA 10:28
Thadou: Veuvin, tuhin Assyriate Aiath ah aumtauve. Migron ajotpauvin amanchah thilkeohou Micmash munah akoikhomuve.
English: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.

tcz: Agallangkhat ahung galkaiyun, Geba munah ajan-geh tauve. Ramah khopi kichatnan akithingtai. Saul khopi, Gibeah mite jong ajam gamtauve.
en: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.
text:
ISA 10:29
Thadou: Agallangkhat ahung galkaiyun, Geba munah ajan-geh tauve. Ramah khopi kichatnan akithingtai. Saul khopi, Gibeah mite jong ajam gamtauve.
English: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.

tcz: Tijatnan kholhang akisam’e: Vo Gallim mite! Laishah mite ngaiyun! Khoto naum ngeiyui, O Anathoth mite!
en: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!
text:
ISA 10:30
Thadou: Tijatnan kholhang akisam’e: Vo Gallim mite! Laishah mite ngaiyun! Khoto naum ngeiyui, O Anathoth mite!
English: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!

tcz: Madmenah mite jong ajamcheh gamtauve. Gebim khomiten kiselna ding mun aholtauve.
en: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.
text:
ISA 10:31
Thadou: Madmenah mite jong ajamcheh gamtauve. Gebim khomiten kiselna ding mun aholtauve.
English: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.

tcz: Tu’n jong Nob khomunah nilhumin melmate akicholdovin, Jerusalem lhanga Zion Molsang hoitah chu agaldotnun akhuttum ajelkhumui.
en: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
text:
ISA 10:32
Thadou: Tu’n jong Nob khomunah nilhumin melmate akicholdovin, Jerusalem lhanga Zion Molsang hoitah chu agaldotnun akhuttum ajelkhumui.
English: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

tcz: Hinla veuvin! Pakai, Van galsatte Pakaiyin Assyriate thingphung lentahpa chu thahattaha aphuhlhuh ding ahi! Akiloupisahna chu asatlhuh ding ahi. Hiche thingphung sangtahpa chu kiloilhu ding ahi.
en: Behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.
text:
ISA 10:33
Thadou: Hinla veuvin! Pakai, Van galsatte Pakaiyin Assyriate thingphung lentahpa chu thahattaha aphuhlhuh ding ahi! Akiloupisahna chu asatlhuh ding ahi. Hiche thingphung sangtahpa chu kiloilhu ding ahi.
English: Behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.

tcz: Gammang thingphungho banga heicha-a kitulhugam diu ahi. Lebanon chu Hatchungnungpa masanga lhuding ahi.
en: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
text:
ISA 10:34
Thadou: Gammang thingphungho banga heicha-a kitulhugam diu ahi. Lebanon chu Hatchungnungpa masanga lhuding ahi.
English: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.

tcz: David insunga kon ajih khat hungdon doh intin aga nei abahkhat thinggui lui akona hung kehdoh ding ahi.
en: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
text:
ISA 11:1
Thadou: David insunga kon ajih khat hungdon doh intin aga nei abahkhat thinggui lui akona hung kehdoh ding ahi.
English: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.

tcz: Chuleh Pakai Lhagao achunga hung kicholdo intin chihna leh hettheina Lhagao, hilchahna leh hatna Lhagao, thepna leh Pakai ginna Lhagao, achunga hung chudi ahi.
en: The LORD’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD.
text:
ISA 11:2
Thadou: Chuleh Pakai Lhagao achunga hung kicholdo intin chihna leh hettheina Lhagao, hilchahna leh hatna Lhagao, thepna leh Pakai ginna Lhagao, achunga hung chudi ahi.
English: The LORD’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD.

tcz: Pakai thu nunna a ama kipah thanom intin, lim le gong velouva thu tanin tin, thu kithang a konin jong thulhuhna aneilouding ahi.
en: His delight will be in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;

tcz: Gentheite jong adih bangtah a thu atan pehding,mi kineosah sah hochunga jong dihtah a thulhuhna aneipeh ding ahi. Athu hat nan leiset chung hotling thei ahin, akama kona khatvei hu alha jong leh migiloute asuh mang jeng thei ahi.
en: but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.
text:
ISA 11:4
Thadou: Gentheite jong adih bangtah a thu atan pehding,mi kineosah sah hochunga jong dihtah a thulhuhna aneipeh ding ahi. Athu hat nan leiset chung hotling thei ahin, akama kona khatvei hu alha jong leh migiloute asuh mang jeng thei ahi.
English: but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.

tcz: Chonphatna konggah kigah bangin kigah intin, chuleh kivonna sungnung bangin thutah aki ah ding ahi.
en: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.
text:
ISA 11:5
Thadou: Chonphatna konggah kigah bangin kigah intin, chuleh kivonna sungnung bangin thutah aki ah ding ahi.
English: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.

tcz: Hiche nikho teng chuleh ngei leh kelngoinou umkhom ding; lutnu leh kelcha nou kijam khomding ahi. Bongnou kum khat kumni hi gancha jong keipi bahkai koma nomin lhaovin tin, chuleh chapang neo khat nin achin tup ding ahi.
en: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.
text:
ISA 11:6
Thadou: Hiche nikho teng chuleh ngei leh kelngoinou umkhom ding; lutnu leh kelcha nou kijam khomding ahi. Bongnou kum khat kumni hi gancha jong keipi bahkai koma nomin lhaovin tin, chuleh chapang neo khat nin achin tup ding ahi.
English: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.

tcz: Bongpi jong vompi lhatna a ham hing aneh ding ahi. Humpi nouleh bongnou mun khatna gehkhom diu, Keipi bahkai injong bong banga hamhing aneh ding ahi.
en: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.
text:
ISA 11:7
Thadou: Bongpi jong vompi lhatna a ham hing aneh ding ahi. Humpi nouleh bongnou mun khatna gehkhom diu, Keipi bahkai injong bong banga hamhing aneh ding ahi.
English: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.

tcz: Gulsoh kodunga naosen bitkei a kichemding ahi. Thina thei gul chenna ho a chapangin akhut asolut jong leh imacha kisuh khah na umlou ding ahi.
en: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.
text:
ISA 11:8
Thadou: Gulsoh kodunga naosen bitkei a kichemding ahi. Thina thei gul chenna ho a chapangin akhut asolut jong leh imacha kisuh khah na umlou ding ahi.
English: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.

tcz: Kachenna muntheng lhangho jong iman asuhboi theilou ding, suh jong a suh mang theilou ding ahi. Twi jin twikhanglen asuhdim banga leiset chung jong Pakai tahsan hon alodim diu ahi.
en: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
text:
ISA 11:9
Thadou: Kachenna muntheng lhangho jong iman asuhboi theilou ding, suh jong a suh mang theilou ding ahi. Twi jin twikhanglen asuhdim banga leiset chung jong Pakai tahsan hon alodim diu ahi.
English: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

tcz: Hiche niteng chuleh David laltouna lodingin huhhingna ponlap dopsangin hung umintin vannoi chitin ama koma kikhom lut diu, hiche munchu loupina mun hiding ahi.
en: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.
text:
ISA 11:10
Thadou: Hiche niteng chuleh David laltouna lodingin huhhingna ponlap dopsangin hung umintin vannoi chitin ama koma kikhom lut diu, hiche munchu loupina mun hiding ahi.
English: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.

tcz: Pakai jin hiche niteng chuleh aniveinan a khut hin lhangin tin amite anakipui moh ho ahungpui ding ahi. Assyria gam'a umna laiho, sahlam Egypt a umna laiho; noilam Egypt, Ethiopia, chule Elam; Babylonia a um, Hamath, chuleh twikhanglen panga umna laiho.
en: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
text:
ISA 11:11
Thadou: Pakai jin hiche niteng chuleh aniveinan a khut hin lhangin tin amite anakipui moh ho ahungpui ding ahi. Assyria gam'a umna laiho, sahlam Egypt a umna laiho; noilam Egypt, Ethiopia, chule Elam; Babylonia a um, Hamath, chuleh twikhanglen panga umna laiho.
English: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

tcz: Namtin lah a ponlap ahin khaisang ding, Israel nodoh a ana umho akhop tup ding ahi. Judah leiset kolmong geija vah cheh ho akhoptup ding ahi.
en: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
text:
ISA 11:12
Thadou: Namtin lah a ponlap ahin khaisang ding, Israel nodoh a ana umho akhop tup ding ahi. Judah leiset kolmong geija vah cheh ho akhoptup ding ahi.
English: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

tcz: Chuteng tah leh achaina keija Israel leh Judah kithangset tona hungbei ding ahitai. Amani kah a chungnun kichuna kisei kitlou ding ahitai.
en: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won’t envy Judah, and Judah won’t persecute Ephraim.
text:
ISA 11:13
Thadou: Chuteng tah leh achaina keija Israel leh Judah kithangset tona hungbei ding ahitai. Amani kah a chungnun kichuna kisei kitlou ding ahitai.
English: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won’t envy Judah, and Judah won’t persecute Ephraim.

tcz: Thakhat na thahattah'a hung pangkhom lhon ding, gang chella Philistian te lhumlam lang geija anosuh diu ahi. Thakhat taha chile nam gamdang ho solam geija gal'a ano khum diu ahi. Edom leh Moab gamsung ho alo khumdiu ahi, chuleh Ammon miten amaho thusei angai diu ahi.
en: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.
text:
ISA 11:14
Thadou: Thakhat na thahattah'a hung pangkhom lhon ding, gang chella Philistian te lhumlam lang geija anosuh diu ahi. Thakhat taha chile nam gamdang ho solam geija gal'a ano khum diu ahi. Edom leh Moab gamsung ho alo khumdiu ahi, chuleh Ammon miten amaho thusei angai diu ahi.
English: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.

tcz: Pakai in twikhanglen halkhat, gothet na chena thei lampi ahinsemding ahi. Euphrates vadung gallang'a kon, akhut ahin japding, huipi nasatah khat ahin nunsah ding, vadung sagi a ahin hop khenna, hia chu bailam tah a kenga galkai thei hiding ahi.
en: The LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.
text:
ISA 11:15
Thadou: Pakai in twikhanglen halkhat, gothet na chena thei lampi ahinsemding ahi. Euphrates vadung gallang'a kon, akhut ahin japding, huipi nasatah khat ahin nunsah ding, vadung sagi a ahin hop khenna, hia chu bailam tah a kenga galkai thei hiding ahi.
English: The LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.

tcz: Amite amoh’a aum nao a kona lampi len ahung nadiu khat asempeh ding, Assyria a kona hung hodinga ahi. Hitobanga chu Israel te jong Egypt gam'a kona ahung naova ana sempeh anahi.
en: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
text:
ISA 11:16
Thadou: Amite amoh’a aum nao a kona lampi len ahung nadiu khat asempeh ding, Assyria a kona hung hodinga ahi. Hitobanga chu Israel te jong Egypt gam'a kona ahung naova ana sempeh anahi.
English: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

tcz: Hiche nikho teng chuleh la a nana sah ding: “Aw Pakai, keiman nangma kavahchoi ding! Ka chunga nalung hangin, ahin tunna lung hanna aum tapoi. Tun nei lhamon tan ahi.
en: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, the LORD; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.
text:
ISA 12:1
Thadou: Hiche nikho teng chuleh la a nana sah ding: “Aw Pakai, keiman nangma kavahchoi ding! Ka chunga nalung hangin, ahin tunna lung hanna aum tapoi. Tun nei lhamon tan ahi.
English: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, the LORD; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.

tcz: Ven, Pathen chu keima huhhing din ahunge. Keima ama tahsan in katin, chuleh ka kichat tah lou ding ahi. Pakai Pathen chu kathahat naleh ka la ahin; aman galjo na eipen ahi.”
en: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”
text:
ISA 12:2
Thadou: Ven, Pathen chu keima huhhing din ahunge. Keima ama tahsan in katin, chuleh ka kichat tah lou ding ahi. Pakai Pathen chu kathahat naleh ka la ahin; aman galjo na eipen ahi.”
English: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”

tcz: Huhhing na twibul a kipah tah a twi nana don ding ahitai!
en: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.
text:
ISA 12:3
Thadou: Huhhing na twibul a kipah tah a twi nana don ding ahitai!
English: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.

tcz: Hiche kidang tah nikho nile chun la nanasah ding:” Kakipah e Pakai! Amin chu vahchoi jin umhen! Chitin namtin lah a athilbol seiphong len. Thahat chungnung ahi heo hen!
en: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Declare his doings among the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!
text:
ISA 12:4
Thadou: Hiche kidang tah nikho nile chun la nanasah ding:” Kakipah e Pakai! Amin chu vahchoi jin umhen! Chitin namtin lah a athilbol seiphong len. Thahat chungnung ahi heo hen!
English: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Declare his doings among the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!

tcz: Thil kidang tahtah aboldoh jeh in Pakai la saovin. Ama thangvahna vannoi pumpi hetsah un.
en: Sing to the LORD, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
text:
ISA 12:5
Thadou: Thil kidang tahtah aboldoh jeh in Pakai la saovin. Ama thangvahna vannoi pumpi hetsah un.
English: Sing to the LORD, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!

tcz: Jerusalem khopi acheng mijousen ama thangvahna leh kipanan lhang sam uhen! Ajehchu nalah uva chengpa chu Israel te lah a mitheng khat leh milen ahi.”
en: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
text:
ISA 12:6
Thadou: Jerusalem khopi acheng mijousen ama thangvahna leh kipanan lhang sam uhen! Ajehchu nalah uva chengpa chu Israel te lah a mitheng khat leh milen ahi.”
English: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”

tcz: Amoz chapa Isaiah in Babylon kisuh mang nading chunga thuhil khat anamun:
en: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.
text:
ISA 13:1
Thadou: Amoz chapa Isaiah in Babylon kisuh mang nading chunga thuhil khat anamun:
English: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.

tcz: “Kihetsahna ponlap thinglhang vum'a khaisangin Babylon kimai topi din galsat dingho kou khomin thahattah leh thaneitah leng inpi ajotteng uleh amaho tilkhounan nakhut lhangin.
en: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
text:
ISA 13:2
Thadou: “Kihetsahna ponlap thinglhang vum'a khaisangin Babylon kimai topi din galsat dingho kou khomin thahattah leh thaneitah leng inpi ajotteng uleh amaho tilkhounan nakhut lhangin.
English: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

tcz: Pakai, keiman, hiche natoh tonglha dinga galsat ho kapehdoh ahi. Ahin, ka lung hanna phondoh nadinga gal hang ho kakouva, choisanga kaum teng amaho jong kipah thanom diu ahi.”
en: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.
text:
ISA 13:3
Thadou: Pakai, keiman, hiche natoh tonglha dinga galsat ho kapehdoh ahi. Ahin, ka lung hanna phondoh nadinga gal hang ho kakouva, choisanga kaum teng amaho jong kipah thanom diu ahi.”
English: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.

tcz: Mol le lhanga husa khu ngaijun! Sepai tamtah kijot husa khu ngaijun! Namtin husa len pen ahi. Van Janel Pakai in hiche galsat sepai hohi akou khom ahi.
en: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! The LORD of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.
text:
ISA 13:4
Thadou: Mol le lhanga husa khu ngaijun! Sepai tamtah kijot husa khu ngaijun! Namtin husa len pen ahi. Van Janel Pakai in hiche galsat sepai hohi akou khom ahi.
English: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! The LORD of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.

tcz: Amaho hi gam latah a kona hunguva, kolning khel lama kona jong hung ahiuve. Pakai lungsatna podoh dinga amaho hi Pakai manchah ahiuve. Pakai in ama hotoh gam abonna asuhmang ding ahi.
en: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
text:
ISA 13:5
Thadou: Amaho hi gam latah a kona hunguva, kolning khel lama kona jong hung ahiuve. Pakai lungsatna podoh dinga amaho hi Pakai manchah ahiuve. Pakai in ama hotoh gam abonna asuhmang ding ahi.
English: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

tcz: Kichat tijat pumin a eo vun ajehchu Pakai nikho chu ahung lhungtai- Hatchung nung in asuhmang ding phat chu.
en: Wail, for the LORD’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.
text:
ISA 13:6
Thadou: Kichat tijat pumin a eo vun ajehchu Pakai nikho chu ahung lhungtai- Hatchung nung in asuhmang ding phat chu.
English: Wail, for the LORD’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.

tcz: Ban jouse ki chat pumin chatthei louvin aumin, lung jouse ajunlha gamin,
en: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.
text:
ISA 13:7
Thadou: Ban jouse ki chat pumin chatthei louvin aumin, lung jouse ajunlha gamin,
English: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.

tcz: Chuleh mipi suh tijat in a ume. Lung genthei nan aman chah kheh un, numei naosonat thoh abangu ve. Kipanpi leh kihuto thei lou vin khat le khat akive to un, tijatnan amai u atom jenguve.
en: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.
text:
ISA 13:8
Thadou: Chuleh mipi suh tijat in a ume. Lung genthei nan aman chah kheh un, numei naosonat thoh abangu ve. Kipanpi leh kihuto thei lou vin khat le khat akive to un, tijatnan amai u atom jenguve.
English: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.

tcz: Ajehchu ven, Pakai nikho chu ahung lhunge a lungsat a lunghan tijat umtah nikho. Agam jong mi chen khahlou na gam asoding, chuleh michonse ho jong suhmanga um tha dingu ahi.
en: Behold, the day of the LORD comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.
text:
ISA 13:9
Thadou: Ajehchu ven, Pakai nikho chu ahung lhunge a lungsat a lunghan tijat umtah nikho. Agam jong mi chen khahlou na gam asoding, chuleh michonse ho jong suhmanga um tha dingu ahi.
English: Behold, the day of the LORD comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.

tcz: Vanlaijol ho jong hung vom lha intin, ahsi hon jong vah ahinpeh loudiu ahi. Nisa aso teng thimpi jingding, chuleh lhathah in vah apeh tah louding ahi.
en: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.
text:
ISA 13:10
Thadou: Vanlaijol ho jong hung vom lha intin, ahsi hon jong vah ahinpeh loudiu ahi. Nisa aso teng thimpi jingding, chuleh lhathah in vah apeh tah louding ahi.
English: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.

tcz: Pakai, keiman, vannoi phatlou jeh leh migiloute chonset jeh a gotna kapeh ding ahi. Mi kiletsah ho ahoithonao kasuhchip ding, a thahat nao kiletsah piho kasuh nem ding ahi.
en: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the arrogance of the terrible.
text:
ISA 13:11
Thadou: Pakai, keiman, vannoi phatlou jeh leh migiloute chonset jeh a gotna kapeh ding ahi. Mi kiletsah ho ahoithonao kasuhchip ding, a thahat nao kiletsah piho kasuh nem ding ahi.
English: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the arrogance of the terrible.

tcz: Keiman mihemte hi sana sanga manlujo a kasemding. Ophir sana theng sanga lujodiu ahi.
en: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.
text:
ISA 13:12
Thadou: Keiman mihemte hi sana sanga manlujo a kasemding. Ophir sana theng sanga lujodiu ahi.
English: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.

tcz: Ajehchu keiman vanho kaloling ding ahi. Pakai lungsatna Pakai van sepai hon ahin vetsah tengu leh leiset jong a umna akona kichondoh ding ahi.
en: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in the LORD of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.
text:
ISA 13:13
Thadou: Ajehchu keiman vanho kaloling ding ahi. Pakai lungsatna Pakai van sepai hon ahin vetsah tengu leh leiset jong a umna akona kichondoh ding ahi.
English: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in the LORD of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.

tcz: Gamleng ho akona sakhineo ajammang banga Babylon a cheng mipi jong jam mang diu, kelngoi aching umlou bang diu ahi. Ami u’ akihol diu chule agam languva jam diu ahi.
en: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.
text:
ISA 13:14
Thadou: Gamleng ho akona sakhineo ajammang banga Babylon a cheng mipi jong jam mang diu, kelngoi aching umlou bang diu ahi. Ami u’ akihol diu chule agam languva jam diu ahi.
English: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.

tcz: Koihileh akiman tapou chu satan’a umding-chemjam hemset na lhailut bang ding ahi.
en: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.
text:
ISA 13:15
Thadou: Koihileh akiman tapou chu satan’a umding-chemjam hemset na lhailut bang ding ahi.
English: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.

tcz: Amitmu tah uva achateu cheng talih a umdiu ahi. A innu kibulu ding,chuleh ajiteu suhsetna umdiu ahi.
en: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.
text:
ISA 13:16
Thadou: Amitmu tah uva achateu cheng talih a umdiu ahi. A innu kibulu ding,chuleh ajiteu suhsetna umdiu ahi.
English: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.

tcz: “Ven, keiman Medes te kachoudoh a Babylon te kaki maito sahding ahi. Dangka in jong lhem lha jou pouvin tin, sana a jong a jollhah joulou diu ahi.
en: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.
text:
ISA 13:17
Thadou: “Ven, keiman Medes te kachoudoh a Babylon te kaki maito sahding ahi. Dangka in jong lhem lha jou pouvin tin, sana a jong a jollhah joulou diu ahi.
English: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.

tcz: Galsat sepai hon khangthah ho thalpi a akaplhuh diu ahi. Panpibei naosen ho chunga hepina anei lou diu, chuleh chapang ho chunga jong khotona anei lou diu ahi.”
en: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.
text:
ISA 13:18
Thadou: Galsat sepai hon khangthah ho thalpi a akaplhuh diu ahi. Panpibei naosen ho chunga hepina anei lou diu, chuleh chapang ho chunga jong khotona anei lou diu ahi.”
English: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.

tcz: Babylon lenggam adia loupipen, Chaldean ten Pahcha banga akithang at piu hi Pathenin Sodom leh Gomorrah asuhmang banga asuhgam ding ahi.
en: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
text:
ISA 13:19
Thadou: Babylon lenggam adia loupipen, Chaldean ten Pahcha banga akithang at piu hi Pathenin Sodom leh Gomorrah asuhmang banga asuhgam ding ahi.
English: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

tcz: Babylon hi koiman a lo kittah louding ahi. Akhang akhanga akeoseh a umding ahitai. Umdetna neilouva chao lele jat hon ngahmun dinga jong adeilou diu ahi, chuleh kelngoi chinghon akelngoi u agepi nomlou diu ahi.
en: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.
text:
ISA 13:20
Thadou: Babylon hi koiman a lo kittah louding ahi. Akhang akhanga akeoseh a umding ahitai. Umdetna neilouva chao lele jat hon ngahmun dinga jong adeilou diu ahi, chuleh kelngoi chinghon akelngoi u agepi nomlou diu ahi.
English: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.

tcz: Neldi gam’a gancha ho jong mangthai khopi sunga kichonlut un tin, chuleh Si al ham banga ham gancha hon insung jouse alodim diu ahi. Sumbu changlit hon umnan neijun tin, chuleh gamkelcha ho hilai munna chu galha diu ahi.
en: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.
text:
ISA 13:21
Thadou: Neldi gam’a gancha ho jong mangthai khopi sunga kichonlut un tin, chuleh Si al ham banga ham gancha hon insung jouse alodim diu ahi. Sumbu changlit hon umnan neijun tin, chuleh gamkelcha ho hilai munna chu galha diu ahi.
English: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.

tcz: Akulpi sunga ngeiho peng le le diu, chuleh leng inpi nomtah sunga si al hon ko akisem diu ahi. Babylon kem suh nading jat nikho akisim pan tai: aman thah nading phat hung lhung ding ahitai.
en: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.
text:
ISA 13:22
Thadou: Akulpi sunga ngeiho peng le le diu, chuleh leng inpi nomtah sunga si al hon ko akisem diu ahi. Babylon kem suh nading jat nikho akisim pan tai: aman thah nading phat hung lhung ding ahitai.
English: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.

tcz: Ahin Pakaijin Jacob son le pah ho chunga hepina aneiding ahi. Israel mite chu a mite hidia a tumbeh a alhen doh thah kit ding ahi. Agam sunguva chengdia ahin lepui kit ding ahi. Chuleh mipi gamtin namtin akona hung diu, Israel mite toh hung kigom khom diu ahi.
en: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.
text:
ISA 14:1
Thadou: Ahin Pakaijin Jacob son le pah ho chunga hepina aneiding ahi. Israel mite chu a mite hidia a tumbeh a alhen doh thah kit ding ahi. Agam sunguva chengdia ahin lepui kit ding ahi. Chuleh mipi gamtin namtin akona hung diu, Israel mite toh hung kigom khom diu ahi.
English: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.

tcz: Vannoi namtin in Pakai mite ahung kile nadiu va ana panpi soh keidiu, agam uva hung cheng hon Israel te jenle a pangdiu ahi. Israel manna’a anapang hon amaho leh amaho hung kiman tup untin, chuleh Israel in agal miteu chunga vai ahop dingu ahi.
en: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in the LORD’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
text:
ISA 14:2
Thadou: Vannoi namtin in Pakai mite ahung kile nadiu va ana panpi soh keidiu, agam uva hung cheng hon Israel te jenle a pangdiu ahi. Israel manna’a anapang hon amaho leh amaho hung kiman tup untin, chuleh Israel in agal miteu chunga vai ahop dingu ahi.
English: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in the LORD’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

tcz: Hiche kidangtah nikho le chun, Pakai jin amite lunghem naleh kichatna akon, soh hina leh aki hennao akon choldona apeh diu ahi.
en: It will happen in the day that the LORD will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,
text:
ISA 14:3
Thadou: Hiche kidangtah nikho le chun, Pakai jin amite lunghem naleh kichatna akon, soh hina leh aki hennao akon choldona apeh diu ahi.
English: It will happen in the day that the LORD will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,

tcz: Babylon lengpa douna a thu nasei ding, “Mi thahatpa akisumang tai.Henge, na kiletsahna chu akichai tai.
en: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”
text:
ISA 14:4
Thadou: Babylon lengpa douna a thu nasei ding, “Mi thahatpa akisumang tai.Henge, na kiletsahna chu akichai tai.
English: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai jin nagit louna hattah chu asuchip in, navaihom dihlou chu asukeh in ahi.
en: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,
text:
ISA 14:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakai jin nagit louna hattah chu asuchip in, navaihom dihlou chu asukeh in ahi.
English: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,

tcz: Lunghang in mipi chu akhonna umlou vin na von, chuleh chi le nam ho lunghangin naman chah kheh in, khotona neilou tah in mite nabol genthei e.
en: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.
text:
ISA 14:6
Thadou: Lunghang in mipi chu akhonna umlou vin na von, chuleh chi le nam ho lunghangin naman chah kheh in, khotona neilou tah in mite nabol genthei e.
English: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.

tcz: Ahin achainan, leiset akicholdon athip chetne. Tun la sa kit thei tante!
en: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song.
text:
ISA 14:7
Thadou: Ahin achainan, leiset akicholdon athip chetne. Tun la sa kit thei tante!
English: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song.

tcz: Gammanga thingphung ho jengin jong-Cypress thingphung ho leh Lebanon a um Cedar thingphung ho-hiche kipana la hi asadoh uvin: “Nahung phuh lhuh a patnin, eiphuh lhudiu koima hung taponte!”
en: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”
text:
ISA 14:8
Thadou: Gammanga thingphung ho jengin jong-Cypress thingphung ho leh Lebanon a um Cedar thingphung ho-hiche kipana la hi asadoh uvin: “Nahung phuh lhuh a patnin, eiphuh lhudiu koima hung taponte!”
English: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”

tcz: “Thi umna munna” nahung lhun nin lung kicho thouna aumin ahi. Vannoi lamkai holeh leng len tah ho lhagao chun athinao sottah nungin nangma mu din ading doh sohkei juve.
en: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
text:
ISA 14:9
Thadou: “Thi umna munna” nahung lhun nin lung kicho thouna aumin ahi. Vannoi lamkai holeh leng len tah ho lhagao chun athinao sottah nungin nangma mu din ading doh sohkei juve.
English: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

tcz: Aw khat tah in ahung peng doh un, “Tun keiho hatlou bangin nang jong nahat jou tapoi!
en: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”
text:
ISA 14:10
Thadou: Aw khat tah in ahung peng doh un, “Tun keiho hatlou bangin nang jong nahat jou tapoi!
English: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”

tcz: Nahat naleh nathil bol theina toh kivuitha a nahitai, naleng inpi a selangdah gin atan tai. Lung hohi nangdinga ponpha hintin, chuleh lungmul hohi nadinga samul pon ahi.”
en: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.
text:
ISA 14:11
Thadou: Nahat naleh nathil bol theina toh kivuitha a nahitai, naleng inpi a selangdah gin atan tai. Lung hohi nangdinga ponpha hintin, chuleh lungmul hohi nadinga samul pon ahi.”
English: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.

tcz: “ Vanna kon a iti nahung lhah ham, O valpa ahsi, jingkah chapa! Vannoi a chitin namtin sumangpa, leiset chunga din nolhah in na umtai.
en: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!
text:
ISA 14:12
Thadou: “ Vanna kon a iti nahung lhah ham, O valpa ahsi, jingkah chapa! Vannoi a chitin namtin sumangpa, leiset chunga din nolhah in na umtai.
English: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!

tcz: Ajeh chu nang le nang na kihou vin, vanna kaltou ving katin, Pathen ahsi ho chung vum'a ka laltouna ki dong kate. Chuleh mol le lhang apat sah lang gamkai gamla tah a avaipon pang inge nati
en: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!
text:
ISA 14:13
Thadou: Ajeh chu nang le nang na kihou vin, vanna kaltou ving katin, Pathen ahsi ho chung vum'a ka laltouna ki dong kate. Chuleh mol le lhang apat sah lang gamkai gamla tah a avaipon pang inge nati
English: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!

tcz: Vanchung sang penna kakal touding, chungnung penpa toh kabah ding ahi nati.
en: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”
text:
ISA 14:14
Thadou: Vanchung sang penna kakal touding, chungnung penpa toh kabah ding ahi nati.
English: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”

tcz: Chusangin, thi umna munna nakipui lhan tin,leiset kotong thuhtah geija nakipui suh ding nahi.
en: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.
text:
ISA 14:15
Thadou: Chusangin, thi umna munna nakipui lhan tin,leiset kotong thuhtah geija nakipui suh ding nahi.
English: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.

tcz: Amitakip in naven tin, adoh diu ahi 'Hichepa hi hilouham leiset hotlinga leh vannoi lenggam jouse kithinga lha achu?
en: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms,
text:
ISA 14:16
Thadou: Amitakip in naven tin, adoh diu ahi 'Hichepa hi hilouham leiset hotlinga leh vannoi lenggam jouse kithinga lha achu?
English: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms,

tcz: Amahi hilouham vannoi susea leh agam leiset moh sumang'a chu? Hiche lengpa hilou ham vannoi khopi len tah tah suchim a leh a songkul'a tangho hepina beija bol a chu?
en: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”
text:
ISA 14:17
Thadou: Amahi hilouham vannoi susea leh agam leiset moh sumang'a chu? Hiche lengpa hilou ham vannoi khopi len tah tah suchim a leh a songkul'a tangho hepina beija bol a chu?
English: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”

tcz: “namtin lengho loupi tah in ama ama kivui na khuh a alum uvin ahi,
en: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.
text:
ISA 14:18
Thadou: “namtin lengho loupi tah in ama ama kivui na khuh a alum uvin ahi,
English: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.

tcz: ahin nangma lhan akonna nahung kinodoh ding, pannabei thingbah nabah ding ahi. Mithi long kenga akilho khah banga japi lhan sunga na kileh lhantin, gal a kithat hotoh umkhom ding nahi. Kokhuh sunga nakum suh ding ahi.
en: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.
text:
ISA 14:19
Thadou: ahin nangma lhan akonna nahung kinodoh ding, pannabei thingbah nabah ding ahi. Mithi long kenga akilho khah banga japi lhan sunga na kileh lhantin, gal a kithat hotoh umkhom ding nahi. Kokhuh sunga nakum suh ding ahi.
English: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.

tcz: Ahiding dol’n vui jong kivuipon nate, ajeh chu chitin namtin nasumangin chuleh namite jong tamtah nathat in ahi. Hitobang migilou son le pah hon jana leh choisangna amulou hel diu ahitai.
en: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.
text:
ISA 14:20
Thadou: Ahiding dol’n vui jong kivuipon nate, ajeh chu chitin namtin nasumangin chuleh namite jong tamtah nathat in ahi. Hitobang migilou son le pah hon jana leh choisangna amulou hel diu ahitai.
English: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.

tcz: Hiche mipa chate hohi thatdoh gamin! Apa u chonset jeh in thidoh uhen! Amaho kipat doh a vannoi leiset gal asat naova lolhing lou hel diu ahitai. Vannoi khopi len hon jong alo khum joulou hel diu ahitai.
en: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.
text:
ISA 14:21
Thadou: Hiche mipa chate hohi thatdoh gamin! Apa u chonset jeh in thidoh uhen! Amaho kipat doh a vannoi leiset gal asat naova lolhing lou hel diu ahitai. Vannoi khopi len hon jong alo khum joulou hel diu ahitai.
English: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.

tcz: Hichehi vanmi janel Pakai chun aseije: “ Keima tah Babylon dou nan kana kipat doh e! Achate le atu achate kasuh mang ding ahi, “ tin Pakai jin aseijin ahi.
en: “I will rise up against them,” says the LORD of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says the LORD.
text:
ISA 14:22
Thadou: Hichehi vanmi janel Pakai chun aseije: “ Keima tah Babylon dou nan kana kipat doh e! Achate le atu achate kasuh mang ding ahi, “ tin Pakai jin aseijin ahi.
English: “I will rise up against them,” says the LORD of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says the LORD.

tcz: “Keiman Babylon hi koima umlouna mun kaso a, sumbuchanglit umna mun kasoding ahi. Agam jong chu doplah ngen hiding ahi. Suhgam na muntheh'a agam katheh ngim hel ding ahi. Keima, janel Pakai jin kasei ahi.”
en: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says the LORD of Armies.
text:
ISA 14:23
Thadou: “Keiman Babylon hi koima umlouna mun kaso a, sumbuchanglit umna mun kasoding ahi. Agam jong chu doplah ngen hiding ahi. Suhgam na muntheh'a agam katheh ngim hel ding ahi. Keima, janel Pakai jin kasei ahi.”
English: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says the LORD of Armies.

tcz: Thaneipen Pakai hiti hin akitep in ahi: “Kathil gon banga hungsoh doh ding ahi. Ka thulhuh banga hung um ding ahi.
en: The LORD of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
text:
ISA 14:24
Thadou: Thaneipen Pakai hiti hin akitep in ahi: “Kathil gon banga hungsoh doh ding ahi. Ka thulhuh banga hung um ding ahi.
English: The LORD of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

tcz: Assyria te Israel a aumteng u leh kasuh keh ding; ka mol le lhanga aum teng u leh kachot pha soh kei diu ahi. Ka mite chu amaho soh hita loudiu, anoi uva jong kun talou diu ahi.
en: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.
text:
ISA 14:25
Thadou: Assyria te Israel a aumteng u leh kasuh keh ding; ka mol le lhanga aum teng u leh kachot pha soh kei diu ahi. Ka mite chu amaho soh hita loudiu, anoi uva jong kun talou diu ahi.
English: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.

tcz: Vannoi leiset adin thilgon khat kaneijin, chitin namtin chunga thutanna umding ahi.
en: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
text:
ISA 14:26
Thadou: Vannoi leiset adin thilgon khat kaneijin, chitin namtin chunga thutanna umding ahi.
English: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.

tcz: Van janel Pakai chun aphongdoh tai- koi ham athilgon khel theidinga? Akhut ajahteng koiham a sutang jou dinga ?”
en: For the LORD of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”
text:
ISA 14:27
Thadou: Van janel Pakai chun aphongdoh tai- koi ham athilgon khel theidinga? Akhut ajahteng koiham a sutang jou dinga ?”
English: For the LORD of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”

tcz: Hiche thuhil hi leng Ahaz thikum in kahenga ahungin:
en: This burden was in the year that King Ahaz died.
text:
ISA 14:28
Thadou: Hiche thuhil hi leng Ahaz thikum in kahenga ahungin:
English: This burden was in the year that King Ahaz died.

tcz: Kipah thanom hih uvin, nangho Philistine te, naki jepnao mol lhon chu abongtai tin-gal eisatpao leng chu athitai. Ajehchu hiche gul a kona chu guhat tah nei gul hung pengdoh kitding, na sumang diu gul hang tah hung umding ahi.
en: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.
text:
ISA 14:29
Thadou: Kipah thanom hih uvin, nangho Philistine te, naki jepnao mol lhon chu abongtai tin-gal eisatpao leng chu athitai. Ajehchu hiche gul a kona chu guhat tah nei gul hung pengdoh kitding, na sumang diu gul hang tah hung umding ahi.
English: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.

tcz: Migenthei te keiman kavah ding; genthei vaichaho lungmonga kicholdo diu ahi. Ahin nangvang nelou chalouva katheh dohding chule amoh cheng jong kasuhmang ding ahi.
en: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.
text:
ISA 14:30
Thadou: Migenthei te keiman kavah ding; genthei vaichaho lungmonga kicholdo diu ahi. Ahin nangvang nelou chalouva katheh dohding chule amoh cheng jong kasuhmang ding ahi.
English: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.

tcz: Kotpi achun puldou in kap in! Khopi sunga chun lhasetah in kap in! Kichatah in umun, nangho Philistines te! Thanei tah galsat ho sahlang meikhu banga hung kitol diu ahi. Sepai ho khat cheh ahi galsat lungvil a phut ngen ahiuve.
en: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
text:
ISA 14:31
Thadou: Kotpi achun puldou in kap in! Khopi sunga chun lhasetah in kap in! Kichatah in umun, nangho Philistines te! Thanei tah galsat ho sahlang meikhu banga hung kitol diu ahi. Sepai ho khat cheh ahi galsat lungvil a phut ngen ahiuve.
English: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.

tcz: Philistine palai ho ipi iseipeh diu ham? Seipeh un, “Pakai in Jerusalem asa doh tai bol gimma umten abang pang dungu kichol do na a ahinnei dingu ahi.
en: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.
text:
ISA 14:32
Thadou: Philistine palai ho ipi iseipeh diu ham? Seipeh un, “Pakai in Jerusalem asa doh tai bol gimma umten abang pang dungu kichol do na a ahinnei dingu ahi.
English: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.

tcz: Moab chung changa thuhil hitihin ahungin ahi: Jankhat sunga Ar khosung kisuchim ding, chule Kir khopi kisumang ding ahi.
en: The burden of Moab. For in a night, Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing. For in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing.
text:
ISA 15:1
Thadou: Moab chung changa thuhil hitihin ahungin ahi: Jankhat sunga Ar khosung kisuchim ding, chule Kir khopi kisumang ding ahi.
English: The burden of Moab. For in a night, Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing. For in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing.

tcz: Na mite ahouin u Dibon munna puldouva chediu ahi. Ahouin theng uva lhase tah a kap dinga chediu ahi. Nebo leh Medeba adinga kap loi loi diu, lung genthei tah alu u akivomui diu chuleh akhamul u jong akivo diu ahi.
en: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.
text:
ISA 15:2
Thadou: Na mite ahouin u Dibon munna puldouva chediu ahi. Ahouin theng uva lhase tah a kap dinga chediu ahi. Nebo leh Medeba adinga kap loi loi diu, lung genthei tah alu u akivomui diu chuleh akhamul u jong akivo diu ahi.
English: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.

tcz: Khaodip pon akigah uva lamlen dunga vah lediu ahi. In jouse a kon leh japi umna mun ho akona ka le mao aw kijading ahi.
en: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly.
text:
ISA 15:3
Thadou: Khaodip pon akigah uva lamlen dunga vah lediu ahi. In jouse a kon leh japi umna mun ho akona ka le mao aw kijading ahi.
English: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly.

tcz: Heshbon leh Elea mite hung peng doh diu; a awgin u gamla tah Jahaz geija kijading ahi! Moab gal hang tah ho jong nasatah a kicha a peng diu ahi. Panpi beija kichatah a umdiu ahi.
en: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.
text:
ISA 15:4
Thadou: Heshbon leh Elea mite hung peng doh diu; a awgin u gamla tah Jahaz geija kijading ahi! Moab gal hang tah ho jong nasatah a kicha a peng diu ahi. Panpi beija kichatah a umdiu ahi.
English: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.

tcz: Kalung sung Moab adin akap e. Amite Zoar leh Eglath-shehshiyah a ajam uvin, kap pumin Luhith jon lamlen a akal tou vun ahi. Lunggenthei a akanao Horonaim lamlen lang geijin a kijaphan ahi.
en: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.
text:
ISA 15:5
Thadou: Kalung sung Moab adin akap e. Amite Zoar leh Eglath-shehshiyah a ajam uvin, kap pumin Luhith jon lamlen a akal tou vun ahi. Lunggenthei a akanao Horonaim lamlen lang geijin a kijaphan ahi.
English: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.

tcz: Nimrim twi ho jeng jong akang gam tan ahi! Vapanga hamhing ho nisan akagop gamtai. Hamdong ho jong abeitan; Thingna louna eng kiti a umtapon ahi.
en: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.
text:
ISA 15:6
Thadou: Nimrim twi ho jeng jong akang gam tan ahi! Vapanga hamhing ho nisan akagop gamtai. Hamdong ho jong abeitan; Thingna louna eng kiti a umtapon ahi.
English: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.

tcz: Miten anei agou u akimat un, thingphung umna dam kotong langa akipohphei tao vin ahi.
en: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.
text:
ISA 15:7
Thadou: Miten anei agou u akimat un, thingphung umna dam kotong langa akipohphei tao vin ahi.
English: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.

tcz: Genthei tah a akanao chu Moab gamlang geijin aki thongin, Eglaim apat Beer-Elim gei akithong in ahi.
en: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.
text:
ISA 15:8
Thadou: Genthei tah a akanao chu Moab gamlang geijin aki thongin, Eglaim apat Beer-Elim gei akithong in ahi.
English: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.

tcz: Dibon gal’a vadung jong thisan sanin a long ngin, ahin Dibon toh kakichai hih laiye! Humpi bahkai in asohcha ho hin holin tin-jamdoh ding kigo holeh a umden ho.
en: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.
text:
ISA 15:9
Thadou: Dibon gal’a vadung jong thisan sanin a long ngin, ahin Dibon toh kakichai hih laiye! Humpi bahkai in asohcha ho hin holin tin-jamdoh ding kigo holeh a umden ho.
English: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.

tcz: Gamsung vaipo kai pehdin kelngoinou ho chu hin sol’un sela akonin.Nelgam akon zion molsang gei adin hin solun.
en: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.
text:
ISA 16:1
Thadou: Gamsung vaipo kai pehdin kelngoinou ho chu hin sol’un sela akonin.Nelgam akon zion molsang gei adin hin solun.
English: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

tcz: Moab numei ho chu Arnon vadung palgal kaina adong lai achun vacha buh neilou bangin dalhah in aumun ahi.
en: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.
text:
ISA 16:2
Thadou: Moab numei ho chu Arnon vadung palgal kaina adong lai achun vacha buh neilou bangin dalhah in aumun ahi.
English: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.

tcz: “Nei panpiu vin,” tin apengun ahi.” Neihuhdoh un kagal mi teu akonin. Lungsetna beija gal eisat hoa konin nei vengbit un.Kapel doh tah jeh un tun nei lhem tahih un.
en: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!
text:
ISA 16:3
Thadou: “Nei panpiu vin,” tin apengun ahi.” Neihuhdoh un kagal mi teu akonin. Lungsetna beija gal eisat hoa konin nei vengbit un.Kapel doh tah jeh un tun nei lhem tahih un.
English: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!

tcz: Ka mite galjam ho chu nalah uva umuhen kichat tijat beikah in galmi ho akonin anasel tup un.” Kibolgim naleh manthahna ahung kichai teng, galmi mibulu ho a manthah teng uleh,
en: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.
text:
ISA 16:4
Thadou: Ka mite galjam ho chu nalah uva umuhen kichat tijat beikah in galmi ho akonin anasel tup un.” Kibolgim naleh manthahna ahung kichai teng, galmi mibulu ho a manthah teng uleh,
English: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.

tcz: Pathenin David khanggui akona leng khat ahin tun doh ding ahi. Amachun hepinaleh thutah'a vai ahom ding ahi. Adih chu ipiham aman abol jing ding, chuleh thilpha bolding alungvil ten ding ahi.
en: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.
text:
ISA 16:5
Thadou: Pathenin David khanggui akona leng khat ahin tun doh ding ahi. Amachun hepinaleh thutah'a vai ahom ding ahi. Adih chu ipiham aman abol jing ding, chuleh thilpha bolding alungvil ten ding ahi.
English: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

tcz: Moab kiletsah dan chu kana jaove- akiletsah nao, ahoithonao leh angolnao. Ahin akisonnao jouse amang gam tan ahi.
en: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.
text:
ISA 16:6
Thadou: Moab kiletsah dan chu kana jaove- akiletsah nao, ahoithonao leh angolnao. Ahin akisonnao jouse amang gam tan ahi.
English: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.

tcz: Moab gamsung mijouse akap un ahi. Ahin, Moab a cheng mijousen a puldou uve, Kir-hareseth akon lengpithei agop tan ahi.Tuhin a umgam tapouve.
en: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.
text:
ISA 16:7
Thadou: Moab gamsung mijouse akap un ahi. Ahin, Moab a cheng mijousen a puldou uve, Kir-hareseth akon lengpithei agop tan ahi.Tuhin a umgam tapouve.
English: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.

tcz: Heshbon a louho dalhah in a umtan; Sibmah a lengpilei hojong dalhah in a umtai chitin namtin chunga vaihom hon Moab asukeh taove-hoitah tah lengpithei gui ho chu.Akhaogui sah langa patnin Jazer khosung gei jin akiphan, solam gamthip gamgei jin a kikhai lha in ahi. Ajihdon lhumlam gei aphan, twikhanglen gal a ajam gal kai tao ve.
en: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.
text:
ISA 16:8
Thadou: Heshbon a louho dalhah in a umtan; Sibmah a lengpilei hojong dalhah in a umtai chitin namtin chunga vaihom hon Moab asukeh taove-hoitah tah lengpithei gui ho chu.Akhaogui sah langa patnin Jazer khosung gei jin akiphan, solam gamthip gamgei jin a kikhai lha in ahi. Ajihdon lhumlam gei aphan, twikhanglen gal a ajam gal kai tao ve.
English: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.

tcz: Hijeh chun tun keiman Jazer leh Sibmah lengpilei kaka pitai; ka mitlhi twi Heshbon leh Eleahleh a din along'e.Nipi laiya honga louga khoptup jeh a kipana lhangsap jong aum tapoi.
en: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.
text:
ISA 16:9
Thadou: Hijeh chun tun keiman Jazer leh Sibmah lengpilei kaka pitai; ka mitlhi twi Heshbon leh Eleahleh a din along'e.Nipi laiya honga louga khoptup jeh a kipana lhangsap jong aum tapoi.
English: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.

tcz: Kipana chu tun a umtapoi, neh khoptup jeh a kipana aumtapoi. Lengpilei sunga lasah jong umtapon tin, kipana lhangsap jong um taponte, lengpitwi’a akipanao jouse kasuh hai peh ahitai.
en: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.
text:
ISA 16:10
Thadou: Kipana chu tun a umtapoi, neh khoptup jeh a kipana aumtapoi. Lengpilei sunga lasah jong umtapon tin, kipana lhangsap jong um taponte, lengpitwi’a akipanao jouse kasuh hai peh ahitai.
English: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.

tcz: Selangdah tuma puldou va akimao banga Moab adinga ka lungsung kap ahi.Kir-hareseth adin lunggenthei in kadimin ahi.
