en: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
text:
ISA 24:15
Thadou: Solam gamkaija umhon Pakai loupina apeuve. Twikhanglen gal langpeh a umhon Israel Pathen, Pakai minchu avahchoi un ahi.
English: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

tcz: Leiset kolning lang peh a konin vahchoila kisa kajaovin, chonpha Pa loupina kipe la ahi! Ahin kalung sung hi lung genthei nan adim e. Nei kapiu vin, ajehchu agolhapai ding kahi tai. Jouva kibolna ache nalaije, chuleh leptholna hi muntina a um nalaije.
en: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.
text:
ISA 24:16
Thadou: Leiset kolning lang peh a konin vahchoila kisa kajaovin, chonpha Pa loupina kipe la ahi! Ahin kalung sung hi lung genthei nan adim e. Nei kapiu vin, ajehchu agolhapai ding kahi tai. Jouva kibolna ache nalaije, chuleh leptholna hi muntina a um nalaije.
English: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

tcz: Leiset aum miten, kichat tijatna, kokhuh chuleh thang tamtah nakimai topi diu ahi.
en: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.
text:
ISA 24:17
Thadou: Leiset aum miten, kichat tijatna, kokhuh chuleh thang tamtah nakimai topi diu ahi.
English: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.

tcz: Tijat na a jamhon kokhuh sunga lhalut untin, kokhuh sunga kona sohcha hon, thang nga hung oh diu ahi. Manthah na hi vanna konna go julha banga hung julha ding ahi; leiset bulpi ho hung kihot ding ahije.
en: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
text:
ISA 24:18
Thadou: Tijat na a jamhon kokhuh sunga lhalut untin, kokhuh sunga kona sohcha hon, thang nga hung oh diu ahi. Manthah na hi vanna konna go julha banga hung julha ding ahi; leiset bulpi ho hung kihot ding ahije.
English: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

tcz: Leiset hi akisu keh tai. Nasatah a chimlha ahitai; Nasatah in akihot in ahi.
en: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.
text:
ISA 24:19
Thadou: Leiset hi akisu keh tai. Nasatah a chimlha ahitai; Nasatah in akihot in ahi.
English: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.

tcz: Leiset hi jukham bangin alon dong dong in ahi. Hui lego in ponbuh asem bangin leiset akithingin, lhu intin thoudoh lou ding ahitai. Ajeh chu dougal asatnao gitlouna chu sangval a ahitai.
en: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.
text:
ISA 24:20
Thadou: Leiset hi jukham bangin alon dong dong in ahi. Hui lego in ponbuh asem bangin leiset akithingin, lhu intin thoudoh lou ding ahitai. Ajeh chu dougal asatnao gitlouna chu sangval a ahitai.
English: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.

tcz: Hiche nikho teng chuleh Pakai in van munhoa um van miho gotna apeh ding chuleh leiset namtin chunga kiletsah tah a vaihom ho gotna apeh ding ahi.
en: It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.
text:
ISA 24:21
Thadou: Hiche nikho teng chuleh Pakai in van munhoa um van miho gotna apeh ding chuleh leiset namtin chunga kiletsah tah a vaihom ho gotna apeh ding ahi.
English: It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

tcz: Amaho chu ki umkhum a, songkul'a kikoitup diu ahi. Songkul'a kikam tup chet diu, chule achaina leh gotna sangtah kipe diu ahi.
en: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.
text:
ISA 24:22
Thadou: Amaho chu ki umkhum a, songkul'a kikoitup diu ahi. Songkul'a kikam tup chet diu, chule achaina leh gotna sangtah kipe diu ahi.
English: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.

tcz: Chuteng lha loupina chu hung mang suh cheh intin, nisa vah jong hung nol lha ding ahi, ajehchu vanmi janel Pakai chun Zion lhanga vai ahin hom ding ahi.
en: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.
text:
ISA 24:23
Thadou: Chuteng lha loupina chu hung mang suh cheh intin, nisa vah jong hung nol lha ding ahi, ajehchu vanmi janel Pakai chun Zion lhanga vai ahin hom ding ahi.
English: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.

tcz: Aw Pakai namin kaja a kathangvah ding ahi ajehchu nangma hi ka Pathen nahi. Masang laipeh a nathilgon na sucham kimin ahi.
en: The LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.
text:
ISA 25:1
Thadou: Aw Pakai namin kaja a kathangvah ding ahi ajehchu nangma hi ka Pathen nahi. Masang laipeh a nathilgon na sucham kimin ahi.
English: The LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

tcz: Khopi hat tahtah ho ase abalin naselomin, khopi bang hattah ho jong songbong na sotan ahi. Leng inpi hoitah tah ho gamchom a umho na manthah sahtan, aitih a jong kile sahdoh joulou ding ahitai.
en: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.
text:
ISA 25:2
Thadou: Khopi hat tahtah ho ase abalin naselomin, khopi bang hattah ho jong songbong na sotan ahi. Leng inpi hoitah tah ho gamchom a umho na manthah sahtan, aitih a jong kile sahdoh joulou ding ahitai.
English: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.

tcz: Hijeh achu, gamsung hat tah hon naloupina aphon doh diu; lungsetna neilou chitin namtin in nagin ding ahi.
en: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.
text:
ISA 25:3
Thadou: Hijeh achu, gamsung hat tah hon naloupina aphon doh diu; lungsetna neilou chitin namtin in nagin ding ahi.
English: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.

tcz: ahin, Aw Pakai, genthei ten kicholdona'a aneiyu insang chu nahin, vaicha gentheite adia akiselnao mun chu nahi. Huile go kitho na a kon hoidohna nahin, meisa banga satna a kon hoidoh na nahi. Ajehchu hui le go in nasatah a bangho anun khum banga hepina neilou ten mipi asuh genthei un ahi.
en: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.
text:
ISA 25:4
Thadou: ahin, Aw Pakai, genthei ten kicholdona'a aneiyu insang chu nahin, vaicha gentheite adia akiselnao mun chu nahi. Huile go kitho na a kon hoidohna nahin, meisa banga satna a kon hoidoh na nahi. Ajehchu hui le go in nasatah a bangho anun khum banga hepina neilou ten mipi asuh genthei un ahi.
English: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.

tcz: Ahilou leh nelgam sat adailhah bang ding ahi. Gamchom ho gin lullul a aham u, na su thip tan ahi. Meibol lep in asat adailhah sah bangin, lungsetna neilou ten kiletsah tah a asah u jong athip hel tai.
en: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.
text:
ISA 25:5
Thadou: Ahilou leh nelgam sat adailhah bang ding ahi. Gamchom ho gin lullul a aham u, na su thip tan ahi. Meibol lep in asat adailhah sah bangin, lungsetna neilou ten kiletsah tah a asah u jong athip hel tai.
English: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.

tcz: Vannoi a mite jouse din, van janel Pakai chun Jerusalem'a ankong thupitah ahin luiding ahi. A tui a tui nehkhom na hiding ahin, lengpi twi kilhi thengsel leh sa hoi kilheng chil set hiding ahi.
en: In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.
text:
ISA 25:6
Thadou: Vannoi a mite jouse din, van janel Pakai chun Jerusalem'a ankong thupitah ahin luiding ahi. A tui a tui nehkhom na hiding ahin, lengpi twi kilhi thengsel leh sa hoi kilheng chil set hiding ahi.
English: In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.

tcz: Hilaija chu lungjinna alahdoh ding, leiset chunga thinan alekhum jong ahodoh ding ahi.
en: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
text:
ISA 25:7
Thadou: Hilaija chu lungjinna alahdoh ding, leiset chunga thinan alekhum jong ahodoh ding ahi.
English: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

tcz: Thina chu tonsot'a dinga vallhum ding ahitai ! Thaneipen Pakai in mitlhi jouse a thehhul ding ahi. Agam le a mite jumna le jachatna a itih adinga alahdoh ding ahitai.
en: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.
text:
ISA 25:8
Thadou: Thina chu tonsot'a dinga vallhum ding ahitai ! Thaneipen Pakai in mitlhi jouse a thehhul ding ahi. Agam le a mite jumna le jachatna a itih adinga alahdoh ding ahitai.
English: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.

tcz: Hiche nikho le chun mipi in ahin seiphong diu ahi, “ Hiche hi ka Pathen u ahi! Katahsan un, ei huhhing taove! Hiche hi katahsan jingu Pakai chu ahi. Kipah thanom ute huhhingna ahin pohlut jal'in!”
en: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”
text:
ISA 25:9
Thadou: Hiche nikho le chun mipi in ahin seiphong diu ahi, “ Hiche hi ka Pathen u ahi! Katahsan un, ei huhhing taove! Hiche hi katahsan jingu Pakai chu ahi. Kipah thanom ute huhhingna ahin pohlut jal'in!”
English: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”

tcz: Ajehchu Pakai phatthei bohna khut chu Jerusalem a umding ahi. Ahin, Moab chu suhmang a hung umding ahi. Changpol kichot pha a, amonlha dinga kikoi tobang hiding ahi.
en: For the LORD’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.
text:
ISA 25:10
Thadou: Ajehchu Pakai phatthei bohna khut chu Jerusalem a umding ahi. Ahin, Moab chu suhmang a hung umding ahi. Changpol kichot pha a, amonlha dinga kikoi tobang hiding ahi.
English: For the LORD’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.

tcz: Tuijap hon tui akhutnu va asotlhah bangu va, Pathen in Moab mite asot lhah ding ahi. Akiletsah nao leh agitlounao natoh jouse a suhbei ding ahi.
en: He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.
text:
ISA 25:11
Thadou: Tuijap hon tui akhutnu va asotlhah bangu va, Pathen in Moab mite asot lhah ding ahi. Akiletsah nao leh agitlounao natoh jouse a suhbei ding ahi.
English: He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.

tcz: Moab bang sangtah ho phetlhah a umding ahi. Tol'a kikhailha a, vutvai kisosah ding ahi.
en: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
text:
ISA 25:12
Thadou: Moab bang sangtah ho phetlhah a umding ahi. Tol'a kikhailha a, vutvai kisosah ding ahi.
English: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.

tcz: Hiche nikho teng leh Judah gamsung cheng mijousen hiche la hi asah diu ahi: Ka khopiu hi dettah ahi! Pathen mi huhhingna banghon eium kim velun ahi.
en: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
text:
ISA 26:1
Thadou: Hiche nikho teng leh Judah gamsung cheng mijousen hiche la hi asah diu ahi: Ka khopiu hi dettah ahi! Pathen mi huhhingna banghon eium kim velun ahi.
English: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.

tcz: Michonpha hodin kotpi hon peh un; tahsan umtah ho chu lut sah un.
en: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
text:
ISA 26:2
Thadou: Michonpha hodin kotpi hon peh un; tahsan umtah ho chu lut sah un.
English: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.

tcz: Nangma tahsan ho jouse, lungmong sel'a nakoiding ahin, alunggel jouse nachunga koidet ho chu.
en: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
text:
ISA 26:3
Thadou: Nangma tahsan ho jouse, lungmong sel'a nakoiding ahin, alunggel jouse nachunga koidet ho chu.
English: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

tcz: Pakai chu tahsan jing jengun, ajehchu Pakai Pathen chu tonsot songpi ahi.
en: Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock.
text:
ISA 26:4
Thadou: Pakai chu tahsan jing jengun, ajehchu Pakai Pathen chu tonsot songpi ahi.
English: Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock.

tcz: Mi kiletsah ho chu asunem jin, khopi kiletsah chu asu lhujin, leivui asojin ahi.
en: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.
text:
ISA 26:5
Thadou: Mi kiletsah ho chu asunem jin, khopi kiletsah chu asu lhujin, leivui asojin ahi.
English: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.

tcz: Mivaicha leh suh genthei a umhon akengtou vin achot phaovin, genthei vaichaho achunga avah leu vin ahi.
en: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.”
text:
ISA 26:6
Thadou: Mivaicha leh suh genthei a umhon akengtou vin achot phaovin, genthei vaichaho achunga avah leu vin ahi.
English: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.”

tcz: Ahin, michonpha hodin lampi chu aken pon, ajot hahpoije. Thildih jengbol Pathen chu nahin, amalam u lampi nam pet in nalhai.
en: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
text:
ISA 26:7
Thadou: Ahin, michonpha hodin lampi chu aken pon, ajot hahpoije. Thildih jengbol Pathen chu nahin, amalam u lampi nam pet in nalhai.
English: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.

tcz: Pakai, na danthu ho kanit uhin katahsan nao aphongdoh in, namin loupi ding hi kalung ngaichat pennu ahi.
en: Yes, in the way of your judgments, LORD, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
text:
ISA 26:8
Thadou: Pakai, na danthu ho kanit uhin katahsan nao aphongdoh in, namin loupi ding hi kalung ngaichat pennu ahi.
English: Yes, in the way of your judgments, LORD, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.

tcz: Jan khovah in nangma kaholjin; jingkah teng gunchu tah in Pathen kahol ji. Ajehchu leiset thutanna nahung teng lebou, miten adih chu ahet diu ahi.
en: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
text:
ISA 26:9
Thadou: Jan khovah in nangma kaholjin; jingkah teng gunchu tah in Pathen kahol ji. Ajehchu leiset thutanna nahung teng lebou, miten adih chu ahet diu ahi.
English: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

tcz: Migiloute nangai lut nan thilpha aboldoh deh pouve. Midangin thilpha abol vang'in, migilouten thildih lou abol jingu vin, Pakai loupina chu hetphah in aneipouve.
en: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see the LORD’s majesty.
text:
ISA 26:10
Thadou: Migiloute nangai lut nan thilpha aboldoh deh pouve. Midangin thilpha abol vang'in, migilouten thildih lou abol jingu vin, Pakai loupina chu hetphah in aneipouve.
English: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see the LORD’s majesty.

tcz: Aw Pakai na khuttum dopsang eman agel pou ve. Na mite na huhdoh nomdan chu musah in, chuteng amaho chu jachatna dimdiu ahitai. Na meikong chun nagalmi ho sumang jeng hen
en: LORD, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.
text:
ISA 26:11
Thadou: Aw Pakai na khuttum dopsang eman agel pou ve. Na mite na huhdoh nomdan chu musah in, chuteng amaho chu jachatna dimdiu ahitai. Na meikong chun nagalmi ho sumang jeng hen
English: LORD, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.

tcz: Pakai chamna neipeh diu ahi; kabol ka suh bulhit jouseu hi nang jal'a bou ahi.
en: LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
text:
ISA 26:12
Thadou: Pakai chamna neipeh diu ahi; kabol ka suh bulhit jouseu hi nang jal'a bou ahi.
English: LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.

tcz: Aw Pakai ka Pathen u, midang hon kachung uva vai ahin hom uve, ahin nangma bou nahi keima hon ka hou uchu.
en: LORD our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.
text:
ISA 26:13
Thadou: Aw Pakai ka Pathen u, midang hon kachung uva vai ahin hom uve, ahin nangma bou nahi keima hon ka hou uchu.
English: LORD our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.

tcz: Kana jen leuho chu athiuvin, aum gam tapouve. A lhagao dalhah hou hung kile talou hel ding ahi! Nangman nasat nin, na sumang gamtai. Amaho chu sottahpi gelphah louvin aumtauve.
en: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.
text:
ISA 26:14
Thadou: Kana jen leuho chu athiuvin, aum gam tapouve. A lhagao dalhah hou hung kile talou hel ding ahi! Nangman nasat nin, na sumang gamtai. Amaho chu sottahpi gelphah louvin aumtauve.
English: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.

tcz: Aw Pakai, kanam u nei semlet peh taove; lentah nei so tao vin ahi. Ka gamgi hou jong nei kehlet peh un, loupina nangma kahin peuvin ahi !
en: You have increased the nation, O LORD. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.
text:
ISA 26:15
Thadou: Aw Pakai, kanam u nei semlet peh taove; lentah nei so tao vin ahi. Ka gamgi hou jong nei kehlet peh un, loupina nangma kahin peuvin ahi !
English: You have increased the nation, O LORD. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.

tcz: Pakai, lung genthei in nangma kana hol ui. Na thunun pohgihna nanoija kahungtao uve.
en: LORD, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
text:
ISA 26:16
Thadou: Pakai, lung genthei in nangma kana hol ui. Na thunun pohgihna nanoija kahungtao uve.
English: LORD, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.

tcz: Numei naovop in nao anei na'a na asah a, apenchoi choi banga, Pakai, na umna'a kaum tenguleh kachuti jiu ve.
en: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have been before you, LORD.
text:
ISA 26:17
Thadou: Numei naovop in nao anei na'a na asah a, apenchoi choi banga, Pakai, na umna'a kaum tenguleh kachuti jiu ve.
English: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have been before you, LORD.

tcz: Keiho jong lungna in kijel chot chot in ka umun, ahin kagenthei thoh ujong mohseh ahi. Leiset adin huhhingna kape thei pouve,hinna jong vannoi a kapolut thei pouvin ahi.
en: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
text:
ISA 26:18
Thadou: Keiho jong lungna in kijel chot chot in ka umun, ahin kagenthei thoh ujong mohseh ahi. Leiset adin huhhingna kape thei pouve,hinna jong vannoi a kapolut thei pouvin ahi.
English: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

tcz: Ahin Pakai a thiho chu hung hing diu, atahsau hung thoudoh kit ding ahi ! Leiset a imu hochu hungthoudoh diu chuleh kipa jal'a la asah diu ahi. Ajeh chu na hinna-vah kipa chu jingkah daitwi alhah banga namite thi umna munna hunglha ding ahi.
en: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.
text:
ISA 26:19
Thadou: Ahin Pakai a thiho chu hung hing diu, atahsau hung thoudoh kit ding ahi ! Leiset a imu hochu hungthoudoh diu chuleh kipa jal'a la asah diu ahi. Ajeh chu na hinna-vah kipa chu jingkah daitwi alhah banga namite thi umna munna hunglha ding ahi.
English: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.

tcz: In na cheuvin, kamite, na kot hou kam tup un! Chomkhat adin kisel mangun, Pakai lunghanna akichai masang sen.
en: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.
text:
ISA 26:20
Thadou: In na cheuvin, kamite, na kot hou kam tup un! Chomkhat adin kisel mangun, Pakai lunghanna akichai masang sen.
English: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.

tcz: Ven! Leiset mite a chonset jeh un, gotna pedin Pakai chu van'a konin ahungin ahi. Leiset in akithat ho asel jou tah lou ding, mijouse mudinga hung kipuidoh diu ahi.
en: For, behold, the LORD comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.
text:
ISA 26:21
Thadou: Ven! Leiset mite a chonset jeh un, gotna pedin Pakai chu van'a konin ahungin ahi. Leiset in akithat ho asel jou tah lou ding, mijouse mudinga hung kipuidoh diu ahi.
English: For, behold, the LORD comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.

tcz: Hiche nikho teng chule Pakai in tijat umtah man gang tah in achemjam satdoh intin, Leviathan, gang chella kithol gul, kinchuh chuh a kithol gul chu gotna apeh ding ahi. Twi khanglen aum dragon chu atha ding ahi.
en: In that day, the LORD with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.
text:
ISA 27:1
Thadou: Hiche nikho teng chule Pakai in tijat umtah man gang tah in achemjam satdoh intin, Leviathan, gang chella kithol gul, kinchuh chuh a kithol gul chu gotna apeh ding ahi. Twi khanglen aum dragon chu atha ding ahi.
English: In that day, the LORD with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.

tcz: “Hiche niteng chule lengpi leija aga tam jeh in la a saovin.
en: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!
text:
ISA 27:2
Thadou: “Hiche niteng chule lengpi leija aga tam jeh in la a saovin.
English: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!

tcz: Keima Pakai in, kana nga tup ding,phatecha tui kana chap khum ding ahi. Sun le jan'a ka ngatup ding, koiman a suhset thei lou ding ahi.
en: I, the LORD, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.
text:
ISA 27:3
Thadou: Keima Pakai in, kana nga tup ding,phatecha tui kana chap khum ding ahi. Sun le jan'a ka ngatup ding, koiman a suhset thei lou ding ahi.
English: I, the LORD, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.

tcz: Ka lunghan nachu anabei ding ahitai. Ling holeh khao gui ho akhan kahet leh kasat ding ahi; Ka halgop ding ahi-
en: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.
text:
ISA 27:4
Thadou: Ka lunghan nachu anabei ding ahitai. Ling holeh khao gui ho akhan kahet leh kasat ding ahi; Ka halgop ding ahi-
English: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.

tcz: Etiham khatna kaki thopina angaichat lou uleh. Keima toh kichamna sem uhen; ahi, keima toh chamna sem uhen.”
en: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”
text:
ISA 27:5
Thadou: Etiham khatna kaki thopina angaichat lou uleh. Keima toh kichamna sem uhen; ahi, keima toh chamna sem uhen.”
English: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”

tcz: Jacob son le pah ten ajung ahin kho nadingu phat a hung lhunge. Israel ajih hung don doh intin, hung pah lhadiu ahi. Chuleh agam leiset chung jouse alodim diu ahi.
en: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.
text:
ISA 27:6
Thadou: Jacob son le pah ten ajung ahin kho nadingu phat a hung lhunge. Israel ajih hung don doh intin, hung pah lhadiu ahi. Chuleh agam leiset chung jouse alodim diu ahi.
English: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

tcz: Pakai in agalmi ho ajep banga, Israel ajep khah ham? Agal mite gotna apeh banga, Israel te gotna apeh khah ham ?
en: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?
text:
ISA 27:7
Thadou: Pakai in agalmi ho ajep banga, Israel ajep khah ham? Agal mite gotna apeh banga, Israel te gotna apeh khah ham ?
English: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?

tcz: Ahipoi, tetoh din Israel chu nano mangin ahi. Solam akona huipin ahin mutmang bangin, Israel jong agam'akonin nodoh in aumin ahi.
en: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.
text:
ISA 27:8
Thadou: Ahipoi, tetoh din Israel chu nano mangin ahi. Solam akona huipin ahin mutmang bangin, Israel jong agam'akonin nodoh in aumin ahi.
English: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.

tcz: Pakai in hiche abol hi Israel te agit lounao vakon suhthenga a chonsetnao jouse lah mang peh ding ati ahi. Hichun semthu pathen maicham kisem namun jouse kisuchip a, leivui kiso ding ahi. Asherah hihen semthu milim houna mun hijong leh khatcha kitung den louding ahitai.
en: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.
text:
ISA 27:9
Thadou: Pakai in hiche abol hi Israel te agit lounao vakon suhthenga a chonsetnao jouse lah mang peh ding ati ahi. Hichun semthu pathen maicham kisem namun jouse kisuchip a, leivui kiso ding ahi. Asherah hihen semthu milim houna mun hijong leh khatcha kitung den louding ahitai.
English: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.

tcz: Khopi kikulkhum ho ana thipchet nin tin, akeoseh hiding, michenna inho ana kidalhan tin, lampiho a hampa ana khul dimset ding ahi. Hilaija chu bongnou hon hampa a naneh diu, hampa mitdoh thah holeh abah ho alhaidiu ahi.
en: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.
text:
ISA 27:10
Thadou: Khopi kikulkhum ho ana thipchet nin tin, akeoseh hiding, michenna inho ana kidalhan tin, lampiho a hampa ana khul dimset ding ahi. Hilaija chu bongnou hon hampa a naneh diu, hampa mitdoh thah holeh abah ho alhaidiu ahi.
English: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.

tcz: Miho chu thingbah goplhaho bang diu, ki eh keh a, an hon nadinga meikitih kong tobang diu ahi. Israel hi mingol leh lungthim bei nam ahi, ajehchu amite Pathen akonin akihei mangui. Hijeh achu asem paovin hepina leh lungsetna amusah louhel ding ahi.
en: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.
text:
ISA 27:11
Thadou: Miho chu thingbah goplhaho bang diu, ki eh keh a, an hon nadinga meikitih kong tobang diu ahi. Israel hi mingol leh lungthim bei nam ahi, ajehchu amite Pathen akonin akihei mangui. Hijeh achu asem paovin hepina leh lungsetna amusah louhel ding ahi.
English: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.

tcz: Ahin phat hung lhung ding ahi Pakai in khutna chang le mim akilotup banga thakhat na ahin chom khom ding, khat khatna ahin chomkhom'a-Euphrates luipi solam apatna lhumlam'a vacha neo Egypt gei a ahin chomkhom ding ahi.
en: It will happen in that day that the LORD will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.
text:
ISA 27:12
Thadou: Ahin phat hung lhung ding ahi Pakai in khutna chang le mim akilotup banga thakhat na ahin chom khom ding, khat khatna ahin chomkhom'a-Euphrates luipi solam apatna lhumlam'a vacha neo Egypt gei a ahin chomkhom ding ahi.
English: It will happen in that day that the LORD will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.

tcz: Hiche niteng chule sumkon lentah hung kimut ding ahi. Mitam tah Assyria leh Egypt gam'a dinga ana kinodoh, thi ding kon ho chu Jerusalem'a hung kile uva Pakai chu alhang theng chunga ahou diu ahi.
en: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship the LORD in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
text:
ISA 27:13
Thadou: Hiche niteng chule sumkon lentah hung kimut ding ahi. Mitam tah Assyria leh Egypt gam'a dinga ana kinodoh, thi ding kon ho chu Jerusalem'a hung kile uva Pakai chu alhang theng chunga ahou diu ahi.
English: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship the LORD in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

tcz: Ipi lung gentheinan anga hitam Samaria khopi kiletsahna adim chun-Israel jukham ho loupina lal lukhuh chu. Phaicham leipha laiya chun atouvin ahin, ahoi aloupina chu pahcha banga mollha ding ahi. Mite kiletsahna chu ju’n apuilhah ding ahi.
en: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!
text:
ISA 28:1
Thadou: Ipi lung gentheinan anga hitam Samaria khopi kiletsahna adim chun-Israel jukham ho loupina lal lukhuh chu. Phaicham leipha laiya chun atouvin ahin, ahoi aloupina chu pahcha banga mollha ding ahi. Mite kiletsahna chu ju’n apuilhah ding ahi.
English: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!

tcz: Ajehchu Pakai in adou dinga galsat hattah ho asol ding ahi. Hui leh gel hattah ahung juh lhah banga huipin twikhanglen asemdil jeng banga, tol jep na anei ding ahi.
en: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.
text:
ISA 28:2
Thadou: Ajehchu Pakai in adou dinga galsat hattah ho asol ding ahi. Hui leh gel hattah ahung juh lhah banga huipin twikhanglen asemdil jeng banga, tol jep na anei ding ahi.
English: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.

tcz: Samaria kihoitho sahna khopi-Israel jukham ho loupina lal lukhuh gal mite kengto noija chotpha umding ahi.
en: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.
text:
ISA 28:3
Thadou: Samaria kihoitho sahna khopi-Israel jukham ho loupina lal lukhuh gal mite kengto noija chotpha umding ahi.
English: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.

tcz: Phaicham lei phalai achun atouvin, ahin ahoina loupi chu pahcha banga mollha ding ahi. Koi hijongleh amu achun asalhah ding, theichang ga masa kiloulha a, kinepai bang ding ahi.
en: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer, which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.
text:
ISA 28:4
Thadou: Phaicham lei phalai achun atouvin, ahin ahoina loupi chu pahcha banga mollha ding ahi. Koi hijongleh amu achun asalhah ding, theichang ga masa kiloulha a, kinepai bang ding ahi.
English: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer, which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.

tcz: Achaina leh van Janel Pakai, amatah chu Israel loupina lallukhuh hung hiding ahi. Amite amoh cheng sedinga akipanao leh aki choi at nao hung hiding ahi.
en: In that day, the LORD of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,
text:
ISA 28:5
Thadou: Achaina leh van Janel Pakai, amatah chu Israel loupina lallukhuh hung hiding ahi. Amite amoh cheng sedinga akipanao leh aki choi at nao hung hiding ahi.
English: In that day, the LORD of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,

tcz: Thutandih a tan nom na lungthim a thutan vaihom ho apeh ding ahi. Kotpi ngah a um gal hang ho han sanna apeh ding ahi.
en: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.
text:
ISA 28:6
Thadou: Thutandih a tan nom na lungthim a thutan vaihom ho apeh ding ahi. Kotpi ngah a um gal hang ho han sanna apeh ding ahi.
English: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in tun, Israel chu ju kham in alon dong dong in ahi. Thempu holeh themgao ho jong jukham in alon le leuvin, ju in bou akisalel taovin ahi. Mu anei naova jong amuchen tapouvin, akham jeh un thulhuhna jong apethei tapouve.
en: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.
text:
ISA 28:7
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in tun, Israel chu ju kham in alon dong dong in ahi. Thempu holeh themgao ho jong jukham in alon le leuvin, ju in bou akisalel taovin ahi. Mu anei naova jong amuchen tapouvin, akham jeh un thulhuhna jong apethei tapouve.
English: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.

tcz: A dokhang chung’u jong loh in atom dim in; muntin anen soh keitai.
en: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.
text:
ISA 28:8
Thadou: A dokhang chung’u jong loh in atom dim in; muntin anen soh keitai.
English: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.

tcz: “Pakai in eiho koi ihiu a gel em?” tin adong uve. “Aman ipi dinga hitia hi eihou u ham? Naonoi chep haitil chapang neo ihiu ham?
en: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?
text:
ISA 28:9
Thadou: “Pakai in eiho koi ihiu a gel em?” tin adong uve. “Aman ipi dinga hitia hi eihou u ham? Naonoi chep haitil chapang neo ihiu ham?
English: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?

tcz: Aman avel avel in eiseipeh uvin-phat khatna thugol khat, phat khatna thugol khat , hilai a themkhat, khulanga chu them khat,” ati ding ahi.
en: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.
text:
ISA 28:10
Thadou: Aman avel avel in eiseipeh uvin-phat khatna thugol khat, phat khatna thugol khat , hilai a themkhat, khulanga chu them khat,” ati ding ahi.
English: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.

tcz: Hijeh a chu tua hi Pakai in amite henga, gamchom mi sugenthei hon pao kidang atho banguva, ahoulim pidiu ahi !
en: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language,
text:
ISA 28:11
Thadou: Hijeh a chu tua hi Pakai in amite henga, gamchom mi sugenthei hon pao kidang atho banguva, ahoulim pidiu ahi !
English: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language,

tcz: Pathen’in amite henga hitin aseije, “Hilai ahin kicholngah na mun a ume; thachol ho hilai ahin kichol uhen. Hilai mun hi thipchetna kichol na ahi.” Ahin amahon ana ngai pouve.
en: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to the weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.
text:
ISA 28:12
Thadou: Pathen’in amite henga hitin aseije, “Hilai ahin kicholngah na mun a ume; thachol ho hilai ahin kichol uhen. Hilai mun hi thipchetna kichol na ahi.” Ahin amahon ana ngai pouve.
English: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to the weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Pakai in thuhil amite ahin peh kitding, thugol chunga thugol, thugol chunga thugol, hilai a themkhat chuleh khulanga themkhat, hitia chu amaho kipal a lhudiu ahi. Amaho chu kisukha diu, Oh diu, chuleh mattup a umdiu ahi.
en: Therefore the LORD’s word will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.
text:
ISA 28:13
Thadou: Hijeh a chu Pakai in thuhil amite ahin peh kitding, thugol chunga thugol, thugol chunga thugol, hilai a themkhat chuleh khulanga themkhat, hitia chu amaho kipal a lhudiu ahi. Amaho chu kisukha diu, Oh diu, chuleh mattup a umdiu ahi.
English: Therefore the LORD’s word will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.

tcz: Hijeh chun, Pakai akona thuhil hunglhung hi ngaijun nangho mi ija seplou Jerusalem a thunei leh vaihom ho.
en: Therefore hear the LORD’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:
text:
ISA 28:14
Thadou: Hijeh chun, Pakai akona thuhil hunglhung hi ngaijun nangho mi ija seplou Jerusalem a thunei leh vaihom ho.
English: Therefore hear the LORD’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:

tcz: Hitihin na kisonge, “ Thina lhemlha din kinoptona kanei uvin, chule thivui namun peldoh din thulhuhna kanei taovin ahi. Manthah na hung lhung chun eisuhkhah louhel diu ahi. Ajehchu jou le lheplhah na akon in kichol dona lhouding tahkhat kasao ve.”
en: “Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing scourge passes through, it won’t come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.’”
text:
ISA 28:15
Thadou: Hitihin na kisonge, “ Thina lhemlha din kinoptona kanei uvin, chule thivui namun peldoh din thulhuhna kanei taovin ahi. Manthah na hung lhung chun eisuhkhah louhel diu ahi. Ajehchu jou le lheplhah na akon in kichol dona lhouding tahkhat kasao ve.”
English: “Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing scourge passes through, it won’t come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.’”

tcz: Hijeh chun, thanei pen Pakai in aseije: “Ven! Keiman bulphu na songpi Jerusalem'a katunge, dettah le hoitah song ahi. Inning song man tamtah,achunga insah nadia jong lhou tah hiding ahi. A tahsan chan chu kilong louhel ding ahi.
en: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.
text:
ISA 28:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun, thanei pen Pakai in aseije: “Ven! Keiman bulphu na songpi Jerusalem'a katunge, dettah le hoitah song ahi. Inning song man tamtah,achunga insah nadia jong lhou tah hiding ahi. A tahsan chan chu kilong louhel ding ahi.
English: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.

tcz: Thutan dihna golkai na manga ka patep ding, chonphatna chu athuh adon vetna ka man ding ahi. Na kisel nachu jouva kisem ahijeh'in, huise gel in ano lhah ding ahi. Lhep lhahna akon ahijeh'in, tuilen in alhoh mang ding ahi.
en: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.
text:
ISA 28:17
Thadou: Thutan dihna golkai na manga ka patep ding, chonphatna chu athuh adon vetna ka man ding ahi. Na kisel nachu jouva kisem ahijeh'in, huise gel in ano lhah ding ahi. Lhep lhahna akon ahijeh'in, tuilen in alhoh mang ding ahi.
English: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.

tcz: Thina joulhep nadia na kihou toh nao kasuh haiding ahin, thina lhankhuh peldoh ding natiu jong kale hei ding ahi.Tijat umtah galmi ho ahung teng uleh, tol'a chotpha a naum diu ahi.
en: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.
text:
ISA 28:18
Thadou: Thina joulhep nadia na kihou toh nao kasuh haiding ahin, thina lhankhuh peldoh ding natiu jong kale hei ding ahi.Tijat umtah galmi ho ahung teng uleh, tol'a chotpha a naum diu ahi.
English: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.

tcz: Avel avel a tui hung len ding, jingkah sim jingkah seh a, sun le jan'a puimanga na um kah a.” Hiche thuhil hin namite asuh tijat dingu ahi.
en: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”
text:
ISA 28:19
Thadou: Avel avel a tui hung len ding, jingkah sim jingkah seh a, sun le jan'a puimanga na um kah a.” Hiche thuhil hin namite asuh tijat dingu ahi.
English: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”

tcz: Na jalkhun chu lup nadin achom val e. Samulpon hojong aneo val in, na kisil khop lou ding ahi.
en: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.
text:
ISA 28:20
Thadou: Na jalkhun chu lup nadin achom val e. Samulpon hojong aneo val in, na kisil khop lou ding ahi.
English: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.

tcz: Perazim lhanga philistines douna anei banga Pakai chu hung ding ahin, Gibeon a Amorites te douna atoh bang ding ahi. Thil kidang tah bol a hung ding ahi; bolkhah louhel bol dia hung ding ahi.
en: For the LORD will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and bring to pass his act, his extraordinary act.
text:
ISA 28:21
Thadou: Perazim lhanga philistines douna anei banga Pakai chu hung ding ahin, Gibeon a Amorites te douna atoh bang ding ahi. Thil kidang tah bol a hung ding ahi; bolkhah louhel bol dia hung ding ahi.
English: For the LORD will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and bring to pass his act, his extraordinary act.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai, van janel Pakai chun gamsung jouse suhmang ding hi ka tupten ahi tin jangpet in aseijin ahi,.Hijeh chun ija selouvin koi tahih in, achutilouleh gotna nachan chu sang cheh ding ahi.
en: Now therefore don’t be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord, GOD of Armies, on the whole earth.
text:
ISA 28:22
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakai, van janel Pakai chun gamsung jouse suhmang ding hi ka tupten ahi tin jangpet in aseijin ahi,.Hijeh chun ija selouvin koi tahih in, achutilouleh gotna nachan chu sang cheh ding ahi.
English: Now therefore don’t be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord, GOD of Armies, on the whole earth.

tcz: Ka thusei hi ngaijun; lunglut tah in hung naijun lang, ngaijun.
en: Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!
text:
ISA 28:23
Thadou: Ka thusei hi ngaijun; lunglut tah in hung naijun lang, ngaijun.
English: Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!

tcz: Lou bolpan muchi tulouva, lou alhojing jeng ding ham? Muchi ima tulou hel'a lei alholho jeng ding ham ?
en: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?
text:
ISA 28:24
Thadou: Lou bolpan muchi tulouva, lou alhojing jeng ding ham? Muchi ima tulou hel'a lei alholho jeng ding ham ?
English: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?

tcz: Lei alho chaiteng hiche muchi ho hi atuji hilou ham?- Lengmusel, jira,gehu,butun, chuleh suhlou chang-amun cheh'a kitu ji ahi.
en: When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?
text:
ISA 28:25
Thadou: Lei alho chaiteng hiche muchi ho hi atuji hilou ham?- Lengmusel, jira,gehu,butun, chuleh suhlou chang-amun cheh'a kitu ji ahi.
English: When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?

tcz: Loubol pan ipi abol ding akihet nin, ajehchu Pathenin het theina apeh ahi.
en: For his God instructs him in right judgment and teaches him.
text:
ISA 28:26
Thadou: Loubol pan ipi abol ding akihet nin, ajehchu Pathenin het theina apeh ahi.
English: For his God instructs him in right judgment and teaches him.

tcz: Lengmusel jepnan sehlentah akimangji poi; mol jangkhai joh in akijep jin ahi. Kangtalai jong jira chunga a kitang poi; chusangin, jangtah in avohna mol a, akivoji boivin ahi.
en: For the dill isn’t threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.
text:
ISA 28:27
Thadou: Lengmusel jepnan sehlentah akimangji poi; mol jangkhai joh in akijep jin ahi. Kangtalai jong jira chunga a kitang poi; chusangin, jangtah in avohna mol a, akivoji boivin ahi.
English: For the dill isn’t threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.

tcz: Changlhah ding chang chu bailam tah in akisudi thei jin, hijeh achu asuhdi jing louding ahi. Achunga kangtalai a lih khum in, ahinla asubong joudeh poi.
en: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses don’t grind it.
text:
ISA 28:28
Thadou: Changlhah ding chang chu bailam tah in akisudi thei jin, hijeh achu asuhdi jing louding ahi. Achunga kangtalai a lih khum in, ahinla asubong joudeh poi.
English: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses don’t grind it.

tcz: Van janel Pakai hi mihil kidangtah leh loubol ho hetna sangtah pe’a chu ahi.
en: This also comes out from the LORD of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.
text:
ISA 28:29
Thadou: Van janel Pakai hi mihil kidangtah leh loubol ho hetna sangtah pe’a chu ahi.
English: This also comes out from the LORD of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.

tcz: “Ipi lunghem nan nanga hitam, Ariel, David khopi. Kumseh le golnop anneh namang jingin.
en: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;

tcz: Hijong leh nachunga manthahna kahin lhut ding, chuleh hichea chu lunghem naleh kana sangtah umding ahi. Ajehchu Jerusalem hi Ariel min kisah akoudoh chu hung hiding ahi-maicham thisan in atom khum.
en: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth.
text:
ISA 29:2
Thadou: Hijong leh nachunga manthahna kahin lhut ding, chuleh hichea chu lunghem naleh kana sangtah umding ahi. Ajehchu Jerusalem hi Ariel min kisah akoudoh chu hung hiding ahi-maicham thisan in atom khum.
English: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth.

tcz: Keima hi nagal mi kahiding, Jerusalem kakol khum'a nabang hou kaphut ding ahi. Kul sangtah'a kasah a, ka suhmang ding ahi.
en: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.
text:
ISA 29:3
Thadou: Keima hi nagal mi kahiding, Jerusalem kakol khum'a nabang hou kaphut ding ahi. Kul sangtah'a kasah a, ka suhmang ding ahi.
English: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.

tcz: Chuteng, leiset thuhtah noija kon'a nahin seiding; leivui noi langa patna nathu hungding ahi. Tol'a kon'a na awgin chu thilha lhannoi akon'a olcha a awgin tobang hiding ahi.
en: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.
text:
ISA 29:4
Thadou: Chuteng, leiset thuhtah noija kon'a nahin seiding; leivui noi langa patna nathu hungding ahi. Tol'a kon'a na awgin chu thilha lhannoi akon'a olcha a awgin tobang hiding ahi.
English: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.

tcz: Ahin hetman lou in, lungsetna neilou nagal mite chu leivui hoitah banga ki suchip dingu ahi. Na hinsat hou chu huilah a changvai banga delmanga umdiu ahi. Photlot louvin, apet pet nin.
en: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.
text:
ISA 29:5
Thadou: Ahin hetman lou in, lungsetna neilou nagal mite chu leivui hoitah banga ki suchip dingu ahi. Na hinsat hou chu huilah a changvai banga delmanga umdiu ahi. Photlot louvin, apet pet nin.
English: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.

tcz: Keima, van janel Pakai in nadinga thil kahin bol ding ahi; vang'in, lingki hot leh husa sangtah, chimpei, hui le go kitho leh mi halvam jeng thei meikonga kahung vilding nahi.
en: She will be visited by the LORD of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.
text:
ISA 29:6
Thadou: Keima, van janel Pakai in nadinga thil kahin bol ding ahi; vang'in, lingki hot leh husa sangtah, chimpei, hui le go kitho leh mi halvam jeng thei meikonga kahung vilding nahi.
English: She will be visited by the LORD of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.

tcz: Chitin namtin Jerusalem douna a galsat ho jouse mang banga manghel diu ahi! A kulpiu nokhum ho jouse jan mang banga manghel diu ahi.
en: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.
text:
ISA 29:7
Thadou: Chitin namtin Jerusalem douna a galsat ho jouse mang banga manghel diu ahi! A kulpiu nokhum ho jouse jan mang banga manghel diu ahi.
English: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.

tcz: Gilkel thohpan nehding amang mat in, ahin ahung khah teng leh ana gilkel thou thou ve. Dang chah pan donding a mang mat in, ahin jingkah ahung hiteng leh dang chah in alhachom in ahi. Hitobanga chu na melma teu hung hiding, Zion lhang nokhum ho jong hidiu ahi.”
en: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.
text:
ISA 29:8
Thadou: Gilkel thohpan nehding amang mat in, ahin ahung khah teng leh ana gilkel thou thou ve. Dang chah pan donding a mang mat in, ahin jingkah ahung hiteng leh dang chah in alhachom in ahi. Hitobanga chu na melma teu hung hiding, Zion lhang nokhum ho jong hidiu ahi.”
English: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.

tcz: Na lungdonga natahsan lel ham? Na tahsan lou ham? Hichu ahileh che masan lang khomu lou in umtan. Na ngolbeh buh in ahin ju akon ahipoi! Na lundong dongin ahi, ahin ju akon ahipoi!
en: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
text:
ISA 29:9
Thadou: Na lungdonga natahsan lel ham? Na tahsan lou ham? Hichu ahileh che masan lang khomu lou in umtan. Na ngolbeh buh in ahin ju akon ahipoi! Na lundong dongin ahi, ahin ju akon ahipoi!
English: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

tcz: Ajehchu Pakai in imut lhuh na lhagao nachunga ahin sun lhah ahitai. Na themgao ho leh gao chang ho mit chu a sing tup tan ahi.
en: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.
text:
ISA 29:10
Thadou: Ajehchu Pakai in imut lhuh na lhagao nachunga ahin sun lhah ahitai. Na themgao ho leh gao chang ho mit chu a sing tup tan ahi.
English: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.

tcz: Ahung lhung ding thilsoh ding jouse gaova kimu hi amaho a dinga lekhabu Mohor kinam khum tobang ahi. Asim thei ding ho napeh teng leh, hitia hi aseidingu ahi. “Mohor a kinam khum jeh in kasim theipouve” atidiu ahi.
en: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed;”
text:
ISA 29:11
Thadou: Ahung lhung ding thilsoh ding jouse gaova kimu hi amaho a dinga lekhabu Mohor kinam khum tobang ahi. Asim thei ding ho napeh teng leh, hitia hi aseidingu ahi. “Mohor a kinam khum jeh in kasim theipouve” atidiu ahi.
English: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed;”

tcz: Asimthei louho napeh teng leh, hitia hi aseidiu ahi, “Iti simdiham kahepou ve,” atidiu ahi.
en: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t read.”
text:
ISA 29:12
Thadou: Asimthei louho napeh teng leh, hitia hi aseidiu ahi, “Iti simdiham kahepou ve,” atidiu ahi.
English: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t read.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai in aseije, “Hiche mite hin amaho hi keija ahi tin aseijuve. Akam un ei jabol un, ahin alungu keija konin agam lhai. Eihou u jong hi ima ahipoi, ahin mihem semthu danthu holeh mohchin chin thu a bou ahi.
en: The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, but they have removed their heart far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment of men which has been taught;

tcz: Hiche jeh ahi, keiman avel'a mipha lhem ho paomo leova hatah a adatmo na diuva kakoi ding ahi. Miching chihna chu hung mangin tin, chihna nei hetna ho hung beiding ahitai.”
en: therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.”
text:
ISA 29:14
Thadou: Hiche jeh ahi, keiman avel'a mipha lhem ho paomo leova hatah a adatmo na diuva kakoi ding ahi. Miching chihna chu hung mangin tin, chihna nei hetna ho hung beiding ahitai.”
English: therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.”

tcz: Ipi lung genthei nan a nga u ahita dem, Pakai kom'a kon athilgon hou selmang guhon, muthim noi'a thilse bolhon! “ Pakai in eimu thei pouvin, ipi ibol'u jong ahepoi,” tin asei juve.
en: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from the LORD, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?” and “Who knows us?”
text:
ISA 29:15
Thadou: Ipi lung genthei nan a nga u ahita dem, Pakai kom'a kon athilgon hou selmang guhon, muthim noi'a thilse bolhon! “ Pakai in eimu thei pouvin, ipi ibol'u jong ahepoi,” tin asei juve.
English: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from the LORD, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?” and “Who knows us?”

tcz: Ichan gei'a hung ngol ding nahi tam ? Amachu beldengpa ahin, amachu tahbeh in nang leingan sanga lenjo ahi! “Aman eisem ahipoi,” tia thilsem in asempa kom'a aseiding ham? “Eisem pa beldengpa hi mingol ahi, “ tia bel in aseikhah mong ding ham?
en: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay, that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn’t make me;” or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding”?
text:
ISA 29:16
Thadou: Ichan gei'a hung ngol ding nahi tam ? Amachu beldengpa ahin, amachu tahbeh in nang leingan sanga lenjo ahi! “Aman eisem ahipoi,” tia thilsem in asempa kom'a aseiding ham? “Eisem pa beldengpa hi mingol ahi, “ tia bel in aseikhah mong ding ham?
English: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay, that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn’t make me;” or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding”?

tcz: Mangang tah'a-geisang behseh talou ding- Lebanon gammang lah ho chu loupha lai hung soh in tin, lousoh tampi asosah ding ahi.
en: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?
text:
ISA 29:17
Thadou: Mangang tah'a-geisang behseh talou ding- Lebanon gammang lah ho chu loupha lai hung soh in tin, lousoh tampi asosah ding ahi.
English: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?

tcz: Hiche niteng chuleh lekhabua thucheng kisim, nangong in ajahding, chule mitchon lungjin naleh muthim amu ding ahi.
en: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.
text:
ISA 29:18
Thadou: Hiche niteng chuleh lekhabua thucheng kisim, nangong in ajahding, chule mitchon lungjin naleh muthim amu ding ahi.
English: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.

tcz: Mi kineosah hon Pakai akon'a kipana thahbeh amudim sohdiu ahi. Migenthei ho chu Israel Mitheng Pa a kipah thanom diu ahi.
en: The humble also will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
text:
ISA 29:19
Thadou: Mi kineosah hon Pakai akon'a kipana thahbeh amudim sohdiu ahi. Migenthei ho chu Israel Mitheng Pa a kipah thanom diu ahi.
English: The humble also will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

tcz: Mi ija seplou ho umtalou diu, mi kithupi sah ho mangthah diu, chuleh thilpha lou bolgoho kithat diu ahi.
en: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—
text:
ISA 29:20
Thadou: Mi ija seplou ho umtalou diu, mi kithupi sah ho mangthah diu, chuleh thilpha lou bolgoho kithat diu ahi.
English: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—

tcz: Mona neilou themmo chansah ho mangthah diu ahi. Thutandih lamhilouva hei mangho leh mona neiloi suhmang nadinga jou sei hon akibang chet gotna kipe chu chang diu ahi.
en: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for one who reproves in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.
text:
ISA 29:21
Thadou: Mona neilou themmo chansah ho mangthah diu ahi. Thutandih lamhilouva hei mangho leh mona neiloi suhmang nadinga jou sei hon akibang chet gotna kipe chu chang diu ahi.
English: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for one who reproves in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.

tcz: Hijeh achu Pakai, Abraham huhdoh pan,Israel mite henga aseijin, “Kamite jachatna a hung um talou diu, kichat jeh a dang kehkoh talou diu ahi.
en: Therefore the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, says concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.
text:
ISA 29:22
Thadou: Hijeh achu Pakai, Abraham huhdoh pan,Israel mite henga aseijin, “Kamite jachatna a hung um talou diu, kichat jeh a dang kehkoh talou diu ahi.
English: Therefore the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, says concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.

tcz: Ajehchu achateu tamtah ahin mu tengu leh, phatthei na jouse achateu kaboh khum amu tengu leh Israel Mitheng Pa thenselna chu ahin hetdoh diu ahi. Jacob Pathen mai'a kichatah a ding diu ahi.
en: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the middle of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
text:
ISA 29:23
Thadou: Ajehchu achateu tamtah ahin mu tengu leh, phatthei na jouse achateu kaboh khum amu tengu leh Israel Mitheng Pa thenselna chu ahin hetdoh diu ahi. Jacob Pathen mai'a kichatah a ding diu ahi.
English: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the middle of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.

tcz: Ngol thit thet hon hettheina hin nei untin, phun sehon kihilna asandiu ahi.
en: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”
text:
ISA 29:24
Thadou: Ngol thit thet hon hettheina hin nei untin, phun sehon kihilna asandiu ahi.
English: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”

tcz: “Ipi lung genthei nan na ngao ham, thu'a nunglou kachate ho,” tin Pakai in aseije. “Keija toh akikalin thilgon nanei un ahi. Ka lhagao in adeilou hotoh kigop khomna nanei jun, hichun na chonset nao na sesang toupeh taovin ahi.
en: “Woe to the rebellious children”, says the LORD, “who take counsel, but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin;

tcz: Ajehchu keima donglou vin, nache suh un Egypt panpina naga thum uve. Pharaoh huhbitna chu natahsan un ahi. Ama lima chun nakisel gu uvin ahi.
en: who set out to go down into Egypt without asking for my advice, to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!
text:
ISA 30:2
Thadou: Ajehchu keima donglou vin, nache suh un Egypt panpina naga thum uve. Pharaoh huhbitna chu natahsan un ahi. Ama lima chun nakisel gu uvin ahi.
English: who set out to go down into Egypt without asking for my advice, to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!

tcz: Ahin Pharaoh natahsan jeh uva suh molphou'a naumdiu, amachunga nakingap jeh uva jachatna a naum diu ahi.
en: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
text:
ISA 30:3
Thadou: Ahin Pharaoh natahsan jeh uva suh molphou'a naumdiu, amachunga nakingap jeh uva jachatna a naum diu ahi.
English: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

tcz: Ahin thaneina Zoan chan gei a keh beh in um jeng jongleh a noidou ho Hanes gei hung lhung ta jong leu,
en: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.
text:
ISA 30:4

English: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.

tcz: ama tahsan jouse chun jumna amudiu ahi. Aman nakithopiu malah a na suhmol phoudiu ahi.”
en: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can’t profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”
text:

en: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.

tcz: Egypt kihahselna ho chu panna bei ahibouve! Hijeh chun, Rahab tin kakouve-setna neilou Dragon.
en: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.
text:
ISA 30:7
Thadou: Egypt kihahselna ho chu panna bei ahibouve! Hijeh chun, Rahab tin kakouve-setna neilou Dragon.
English: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.

tcz: Tun chenlang hiche thucheng hohi sun lhan. Lekhabu a sun lut in. Phat kichai kah adinga hettoh sah a pang diu ahitai.
en: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever.
text:
ISA 30:8
Thadou: Tun chenlang hiche thucheng hohi sun lhan. Lekhabu a sun lut in. Phat kichai kah adinga hettoh sah a pang diu ahitai.
English: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever.

tcz: Hichu, hiche mite hi milouchal midouhat ho ahiuvin, Pakai thuhil lunglutna ngaiding nomlou ahiu ve.
en: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear the LORD’s law;

tcz: Mitvah neiho jah'a hitin asei uve, “Themgao ho jah a, Thudih neiseipeh hih uvin. Ngainom um chacha neisei peh uvin. Jouthu leh semthu ho neisei peh un.
en: who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.

en: Get out of the way. Turn away from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”

en: He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken pieces a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.”

ISA 30:14

en: For thus said the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,

en: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore those who pursue you will be swift.
text:
ISA 30:16

tcz: Alah uva khatnin ahindel ding chu nangho sangkhat hiding ahi. Alah uva nga in nabonu va najamsah soh diu ahi. Thinglhang chunga ponlah khom khat bou kidalha banga na kidalha ding nahin, molvum'a ponlap kikhai pheleng leng toh nabah ding ahi. Hijeh a chu Pakai in ama kom'a nahung ding anga teiding, hitia chu aman nangailut dan leh nakhoto dan chu nahetsah nom ahi. Ajehchu Pakai hi tahsan umtah Pathen ahi. Apan pina ngahjing ho chu a nunnom ahiuve.
en: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.
text:
ISA 30:17
Thadou: Alah uva khatnin ahindel ding chu nangho sangkhat hiding ahi. Alah uva nga in nabonu va najamsah soh diu ahi. Thinglhang chunga ponlah khom khat bou kidalha banga na kidalha ding nahin, molvum'a ponlap kikhai pheleng leng toh nabah ding ahi. Hijeh a chu Pakai in ama kom'a nahung ding anga teiding, hitia chu aman nangailut dan leh nakhoto dan chu nahetsah nom ahi. Ajehchu Pakai hi tahsan umtah Pathen ahi. Apan pina ngahjing ho chu a nunnom ahiuve.
English: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.

tcz: Aw Jerusalem'a cheng, Zion mite, nangho naka kit loudiu ahitai. Ahenga panpina nathum uleh Ama chu mi lungset them ahi. Na kanau awgin chu Aman adonbut teitei ding ahi.
en: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.
text:
ISA 30:19
Thadou: Aw Jerusalem'a cheng, Zion mite, nangho naka kit loudiu ahitai. Ahenga panpina nathum uleh Ama chu mi lungset them ahi. Na kanau awgin chu Aman adonbut teitei ding ahi.
English: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.

tcz: Pakai in an adin vangsetna, chuleh don din thoh natna nahin pe jong lechun, nahil din nakom'a umjing nalai di ahi. Na hil'a chu namit tah'a namu ding ahi.
en: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any more, but your eyes will see your teachers;

tcz: Na nakol tah a najah ding ahi. Na nunglang tah a kon thu hung kisei ding,”Hiche lampi hi ahi nachena got chu,” Jetlang hihen,veilang hijong le.
en: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”
text:
ISA 30:21
Thadou: Na nakol tah a najah ding ahi. Na nunglang tah a kon thu hung kisei ding,”Hiche lampi hi ahi nachena got chu,” Jetlang hihen,veilang hijong le.
English: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

tcz: Chuteng na dangka a kisem milim kihou, chule nagou lutah sana'a kisem lim hochu, na suhmang ding ahi. Ponse nen paimang banga na paimang ding, “Phasel to!” tia nasei khum ding ahi.
en: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”
text:
ISA 30:22
Thadou: Chuteng na dangka a kisem milim kihou, chule nagou lutah sana'a kisem lim hochu, na suhmang ding ahi. Ponse nen paimang banga na paimang ding, “Phasel to!” tia nasei khum ding ahi.
English: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”

tcz: Chuteng Pakai in gojuh a phatthei naboh ding ahi, thil tuphat ahiteng. Kidang tah'a agaho naki khop khom ding, chuleh na ganchate nehding hamhing ninglhing setna umding ahi.
en: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.
text:
ISA 30:23
Thadou: Chuteng Pakai in gojuh a phatthei naboh ding ahi, thil tuphat ahiteng. Kidang tah'a agaho naki khop khom ding, chuleh na ganchate nehding hamhing ninglhing setna umding ahi.
English: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.

tcz: Loukhoi bongchal ho leh sangan hon anpha anehdiu, avai vang huijin alhoh mang ding ahi.
en: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory feed, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.
text:
ISA 30:24
Thadou: Loukhoi bongchal ho leh sangan hon anpha anehdiu, avai vang huijin alhoh mang ding ahi.
English: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory feed, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.

tcz: Hiche nikho teng leh na galmi hou akitha a,insang ho ahung lhuh teng, vadung tui ho mol le lhang jouse hung longlha ding ahi.
en: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
text:
ISA 30:25
Thadou: Hiche nikho teng leh na galmi hou akitha a,insang ho ahung lhuh teng, vadung tui ho mol le lhang jouse hung longlha ding ahi.
English: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

tcz: Lha chu nisa vah bangin vah intin, chuleh nisa vah chu jat sagi'a vah cheh ding ahi- nisagi sunga vah chu nikhat'a vah tobang ahi! Hitichu hiding ahi Pakai in amite sudam dinga akipatna, akisuh khah nao maha hou damna ahin peh teng.
en: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.
text:
ISA 30:26
Thadou: Lha chu nisa vah bangin vah intin, chuleh nisa vah chu jat sagi'a vah cheh ding ahi- nisagi sunga vah chu nikhat'a vah tobang ahi! Hitichu hiding ahi Pakai in amite sudam dinga akipatna, akisuh khah nao maha hou damna ahin peh teng.
English: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.

tcz: Ven! Pakai chu mun gamlatah akonin ahunge, lungsa pum leh meikhu nasatah in atomkhum in ahi. Amuh hoa lunghan na adimmin; athuho, meiyin asuhmang toh abange.
en: Behold, the LORD’s name comes from far away, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke. His lips are full of indignation. His tongue is as a devouring fire.
text:
ISA 30:27
Thadou: Ven! Pakai chu mun gamlatah akonin ahunge, lungsa pum leh meikhu nasatah in atomkhum in ahi. Amuh hoa lunghan na adimmin; athuho, meiyin asuhmang toh abange.
