en: The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at the soles of your feet. They will call you the LORD’s City, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
text:
ISA 60:14
Thadou: Nangma nana bolgenthei chilhah ho chu nahenga hunguva, na angsunga kineosah tah’a hungkun ding ahiuve.Nangma nahsahmo tah’a nabolho chun nakengphang ahin chop dingu ahi. Amahon Pakai Khopi le Zion, Israel lah’a Athengpa nati dingu ahitai.
English: The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at the soles of your feet. They will call you the LORD’s City, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

tcz: Nangma hi nahsahmo le thet’uma khatvei ana kibolla, kholjin vahle ho koiman nahopa nomlou hi jongle chun, Keiman a’itih’a kajep hoi ding, akhang khanga mite kipana nahi jing dingu ahitai.
en: “Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no one passed through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
text:
ISA 60:15
Thadou: Nangma hi nahsahmo le thet’uma khatvei ana kibolla, kholjin vahle ho koiman nahopa nomlou hi jongle chun, Keiman a’itih’a kajep hoi ding, akhang khanga mite kipana nahi jing dingu ahitai.
English: “Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no one passed through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

tcz: Thanei tah Leng ho le nam hattah tah ho chun na ngaichat chan, lengnu noituija kivah chapang tobanga lungna chimsetna napeh dingu ahi. Nangman Keima Pakai na-Huhhingpa le na- Lhatdampa, Israel tedinga Mihatpa chu kahi.
en: You will also drink the milk of the nations, and will nurse from royal breasts. Then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
text:
ISA 60:16
Thadou: Thanei tah Leng ho le nam hattah tah ho chun na ngaichat chan, lengnu noituija kivah chapang tobanga lungna chimsetna napeh dingu ahi. Nangman Keima Pakai na-Huhhingpa le na- Lhatdampa, Israel tedinga Mihatpa chu kahi.
English: You will also drink the milk of the nations, and will nurse from royal breasts. Then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

tcz: Keiman na sum eng’u chu Sana’a kakhel peh’a, na thih’u chu dangka’a ka khelpeh ding chule na song’u chu thih’a ka khelpeh sohkei ding ahije. Keiman chamna napuile dinga chule chonphatna chun navai hom dia kapansah ding ahi.
en: For bronze I will bring gold; for iron I will bring silver; for wood, bronze, and for stones, iron. I will also make peace your governor, and righteousness your ruler.
text:
ISA 60:17
Thadou: Keiman na sum eng’u chu Sana’a kakhel peh’a, na thih’u chu dangka’a ka khelpeh ding chule na song’u chu thih’a ka khelpeh sohkei ding ahije. Keiman chamna napuile dinga chule chonphatna chun navai hom dia kapansah ding ahi.
English: For bronze I will bring gold; for iron I will bring silver; for wood, bronze, and for stones, iron. I will also make peace your governor, and righteousness your ruler.

tcz: Na gam sunga nosopma kibolna kija kit tapontin: Galjeh’a gamna le suhmangna kichai ding ahitai. Huhhingna chu khopi bangho tobang'in na kimvelin kisungin tin, chule chuchea lut ho jouse chun akamuva avahchoi dingu ahitai.
en: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, nor desolation or destruction within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.
text:
ISA 60:18
Thadou: Na gam sunga nosopma kibolna kija kit tapontin: Galjeh’a gamna le suhmangna kichai ding ahitai. Huhhingna chu khopi bangho tobang'in na kimvelin kisungin tin, chule chuchea lut ho jouse chun akamuva avahchoi dingu ahitai.
English: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, nor desolation or destruction within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.

tcz: Sun teng jongle nisa vah ngaicha ta pon natin, jan teng jongleh lha chun avah chu ahin vahdohsah ngaibe taponte, ajeh iham itileh Pakai na Pathen chu tonsot vah hijing tading chule na Pathen chu naloupina hijing ding ahitai.
en: The sun will be no more your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.
text:
ISA 60:19
Thadou: Sun teng jongle nisa vah ngaicha ta pon natin, jan teng jongleh lha chun avah chu ahin vahdohsah ngaibe taponte, ajeh iham itileh Pakai na Pathen chu tonsot vah hijing tading chule na Pathen chu naloupina hijing ding ahitai.
English: The sun will be no more your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.

tcz: Na nisan lhumtih neitapon tin; na lhathah jong lhum taponte. Ajeh iham itileh Pakai chu nangma dinga tonsotna navah’a pang jing ding ahitai. Na lung hemna nikho ho chu hung kichai ding ahitai.
en: Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will end.
text:
ISA 60:20
Thadou: Na nisan lhumtih neitapon tin; na lhathah jong lhum taponte. Ajeh iham itileh Pakai chu nangma dinga tonsotna navah’a pang jing ding ahitai. Na lung hemna nikho ho chu hung kichai ding ahitai.
English: Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will end.

tcz: Na mite jouse chonpha ding ahiuve. Amahon agam sungu chu a’itih’a alo jing dingu ahitai, ajeh iham itileh kaloupina pohlut theina dinga amaho chu chuche muna chu kaphudet ding ahitai
en: Then your people will all be righteous. They will inherit the land forever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
text:
ISA 60:21
Thadou: Na mite jouse chonpha ding ahiuve. Amahon agam sungu chu a’itih’a alo jing dingu ahitai, ajeh iham itileh kaloupina pohlut theina dinga amaho chu chuche muna chu kaphudet ding ahitai
English: Then your people will all be righteous. They will inherit the land forever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

tcz: Insung mi lhom penna jong chu mi sang khat hung lhing dingu ahitai, chule ahon lhom pen jong chu mihat tah nam kiti dingu ahi. Aphat bep cha, Keima Pakaiyin hichu kahin bulhit ding ahitai.
en: The little one will become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation. I, the LORD, will do this quickly in its time.”
text:
ISA 60:22
Thadou: Insung mi lhom penna jong chu mi sang khat hung lhing dingu ahitai, chule ahon lhom pen jong chu mihat tah nam kiti dingu ahi. Aphat bep cha, Keima Pakaiyin hichu kahin bulhit ding ahitai.
English: The little one will become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation. I, the LORD, will do this quickly in its time.”

tcz: Pakai thaneipen Lhagao chu kachunga aume, ajeh iham itileh Pakaiyin Kipana Thupha avaichate henga polut dingin thao einutai.Ama hin along chang naho lhamon dinga chule sohchang ho lhadohna seiphong peh dingin chule songkullut ho chamlhat sahna dinga eisol ahi.
en: The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound,
text:
ISA 61:1
Thadou: Pakai thaneipen Lhagao chu kachunga aume, ajeh iham itileh Pakaiyin Kipana Thupha avaichate henga polut dingin thao einutai.Ama hin along chang naho lhamon dinga chule sohchang ho lhadohna seiphong peh dingin chule songkullut ho chamlhat sahna dinga eisol ahi.
English: The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound,

tcz: Aman lung hemna neiho dinga Pakai mikhotona chu ahung lhung taiti seija, chule Pathen lunghanna nikho chu, amelma teu douna dingin ahunge ti seipeh dinga eisol ahi.
en: to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,
text:
ISA 61:2
Thadou: Aman lung hemna neiho dinga Pakai mikhotona chu ahung lhung taiti seija, chule Pathen lunghanna nikho chu, amelma teu douna dingin ahunge ti seipeh dinga eisol ahi.
English: to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,

tcz: Israel sunga alunghem jouse dinga- Aman vutvai‘a konna lallukhuh hoitah, lunghemna khella phattheiboh kipana, lunglhahna khella vahchoina golnop hung hijo ding ahitai. Achonphat nauva amaho chu khongnang phung lentah ho tobanga Pakaiyin Aloupina dinga anaphudoh ahitai.
en: to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he may be glorified.
text:
ISA 61:3
Thadou: Israel sunga alunghem jouse dinga- Aman vutvai‘a konna lallukhuh hoitah, lunghemna khella phattheiboh kipana, lunglhahna khella vahchoina golnop hung hijo ding ahitai. Achonphat nauva amaho chu khongnang phung lentah ho tobanga Pakaiyin Aloupina dinga anaphudoh ahitai.
English: to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he may be glorified.

tcz: Khopi ana mah thah saho chu asah phat kit dingu,masang peh’a ana kisumang khopiho chu kibolphakit ding, khang tampi donlou hella anaum ho jong chu avella kiledoh kit ding ahiuve.
en: They will rebuild the old ruins. They will raise up the former devastated places. They will repair the ruined cities that have been devastated for many generations.
text:
ISA 61:4
Thadou: Khopi ana mah thah saho chu asah phat kit dingu,masang peh’a ana kisumang khopiho chu kibolphakit ding, khang tampi donlou hella anaum ho jong chu avella kiledoh kit ding ahiuve.
English: They will rebuild the old ruins. They will raise up the former devastated places. They will repair the ruined cities that have been devastated for many generations.

tcz: Gamchom miho chu nasoh’uva hung pang dingu ahitai. Amahon na gancha hou avah dingu, nalou hou akhoi bot dingu, chule na lengpi lei’u jong nahon peh dingu ahije.
en: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards.
text:
ISA 61:5
Thadou: Gamchom miho chu nasoh’uva hung pang dingu ahitai. Amahon na gancha hou avah dingu, nalou hou akhoi bot dingu, chule na lengpi lei’u jong nahon peh dingu ahije.
English: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards.

tcz: Nangho chu Pakai thempu nahi dingu, I Pathen’u lhachaho kiti ding nahitauve. Nangho chitin-namtin neile gou hoa kivah ding nahiuvin, chule ahaonau chu na kithangatpi ding ahitai.
en: But you will be called the LORD’s priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.
text:
ISA 61:6
Thadou: Nangho chu Pakai thempu nahi dingu, I Pathen’u lhachaho kiti ding nahitauve. Nangho chitin-namtin neile gou hoa kivah ding nahiuvin, chule ahaonau chu na kithangatpi ding ahitai.
English: But you will be called the LORD’s priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.

tcz: Jachatna le noisana sanga nang hon achan nia jabolna na kimu dingu ahi.Nanghon nagam sunguva ning lhinna achan nia nanei dingu, chule tonsot kipana chu nanghoa hiding ahitai.
en: Instead of your shame you will have double. Instead of dishonor, they will rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double. Everlasting joy will be to them.
text:
ISA 61:7
Thadou: Jachatna le noisana sanga nang hon achan nia jabolna na kimu dingu ahi.Nanghon nagam sunguva ning lhinna achan nia nanei dingu, chule tonsot kipana chu nanghoa hiding ahitai.
English: Instead of your shame you will have double. Instead of dishonor, they will rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double. Everlasting joy will be to them.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Keima, Pakaiyin thu adih’a tan ka ngailui. Keiman gou kichompeh le thil dihlou kibol kathet ahi. Keiman ka mite chu athohgim jaluva lolhingtah’a lethuhna kapeh ding chule amaho toh tonsot kitepna kasem ding ahi.
en: “For I, the LORD, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
text:
ISA 61:8
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Keima, Pakaiyin thu adih’a tan ka ngailui. Keiman gou kichompeh le thil dihlou kibol kathet ahi. Keiman ka mite chu athohgim jaluva lolhingtah’a lethuhna kapeh ding chule amaho toh tonsot kitepna kasem ding ahi.
English: “For I, the LORD, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

tcz: Achilhah teu hettheija hung um dingu chule namtin lah’a jabolna chang ding ahiuve.Mitinin amaho Pakaiyin a phattheiboh mite ahiuve ti ageldoh dingu ahi.
en: Their offspring will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge them, that they are the offspring which the LORD has blessed.”
text:
ISA 61:9
Thadou: Achilhah teu hettheija hung um dingu chule namtin lah’a jabolna chang ding ahiuve.Mitinin amaho Pakaiyin a phattheiboh mite ahiuve ti ageldoh dingu ahi.
English: Their offspring will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge them, that they are the offspring which the LORD has blessed.”

tcz: Keima Pakai ka Pathen’a hapia kipanan eidip dime! Ajeh iham itileh Ama’n Huhhingna pon chu eisilpeh in, chule chonphatna’a pon ah chu ei’ah pehtai. Keima kichenna’a mou neipa (moulang) kivonpa tobang'in, ahilou leh mounu song mantama kijem tobang chu kahi.
en: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
text:
ISA 61:10
Thadou: Keima Pakai ka Pathen’a hapia kipanan eidip dime! Ajeh iham itileh Ama’n Huhhingna pon chu eisilpeh in, chule chonphatna’a pon ah chu ei’ah pehtai. Keima kichenna’a mou neipa (moulang) kivonpa tobang'in, ahilou leh mounu song mantama kijem tobang chu kahi.
English: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

tcz: Pakai thunei chungnungpa chun vannoi nam mite henga athutan dih je avetsah ding ahi. Mitinin Ama avahchoi dingu ahi! Achonphatna chu chavang kipattil tobang ding, muntina thingphung ho hung kehdoh tobang hi ding ahije.
en: For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
text:
ISA 61:11
Thadou: Pakai thunei chungnungpa chun vannoi nam mite henga athutan dih je avetsah ding ahi. Mitinin Ama avahchoi dingu ahi! Achonphatna chu chavang kipattil tobang ding, muntina thingphung ho hung kehdoh tobang hi ding ahije.
English: For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.

tcz: Keiman Zion kangailut jeh’a, keima thip beh’a ka’umlou hel ding , kalungin Jerusalen alungvil jing jeh’a kathip beh louhel ding ahi. Keiman chonphatna chu kho hungvah doh tobanga ahung vahlhah masangsea, amanu(Jerusalem) dinga hi tang louva katao jing ding ahi.
en: For Zion’s sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a burning lamp.
text:
ISA 62:1
Thadou: Keiman Zion kangailut jeh’a, keima thip beh’a ka’umlou hel ding , kalungin Jerusalen alungvil jing jeh’a kathip beh louhel ding ahi. Keiman chonphatna chu kho hungvah doh tobanga ahung vahlhah masangsea, amanu(Jerusalem) dinga hi tang louva katao jing ding ahi.
English: For Zion’s sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a burning lamp.

tcz: Chitin-namtinin nachonphatna mu’uvintin, vannoi vaipipo ho jong chu na loupina avet ngam lou dingu ahi. Chule nangma hi Pakai kamsung tah in minthah napeh ding ahi.
en: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name, which the LORD’s mouth will name.
text:
ISA 62:2
Thadou: Chitin-namtinin nachonphatna mu’uvintin, vannoi vaipipo ho jong chu na loupina avet ngam lou dingu ahi. Chule nangma hi Pakai kamsung tah in minthah napeh ding ahi.
English: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name, which the LORD’s mouth will name.

tcz: Pakaiyin nangma khutnin natuh intin, mi jousen amutheina dinga -Pathen khutna loupina lallukhuh na khuhpeh ding ahi.
en: You will also be a crown of beauty in the LORD’s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.
text:
ISA 62:3
Thadou: Pakaiyin nangma khutnin natuh intin, mi jousen amutheina dinga -Pathen khutna loupina lallukhuh na khuhpeh ding ahi.
English: You will also be a crown of beauty in the LORD’s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.

tcz: ‘Dalhah Khopi’ahilouleh ‘Gamdaigam’ tia nakikou kit talou hel ding ahi. Minthah naput ding chu: “Pathen Lunglhaina Tah” chule “Pathen Mounu” kiti ding ahitai, ajeh iham itileh Pakai chu nachunga along lhaijin, chule a mounu tia naseipeh ding ahi.
en: You will not be called Forsaken any more, nor will your land be called Desolate any more; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD delights in you, and your land will be married.
text:
ISA 62:4
Thadou: ‘Dalhah Khopi’ahilouleh ‘Gamdaigam’ tia nakikou kit talou hel ding ahi. Minthah naput ding chu: “Pathen Lunglhaina Tah” chule “Pathen Mounu” kiti ding ahitai, ajeh iham itileh Pakai chu nachunga along lhaijin, chule a mounu tia naseipeh ding ahi.
English: You will not be called Forsaken any more, nor will your land be called Desolate any more; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD delights in you, and your land will be married.

tcz: Vo Jerusalem, khangthah chun aji adeilhennu komma akipehlut tobanga chu- nachateu amaho mong mong nangma heng’a hung kipelut dingu ahi. Chutengleh, moulangin mounu chunga akipa thanop tobanga chu, Pakai chu nachunga hungkipah thanom ding ahi.
en: For as a young man marries a virgin, so your sons will marry you. As a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.
text:
ISA 62:5
Thadou: Vo Jerusalem, khangthah chun aji adeilhennu komma akipehlut tobanga chu- nachateu amaho mong mong nangma heng’a hung kipelut dingu ahi. Chutengleh, moulangin mounu chunga akipa thanop tobanga chu, Pakai chu nachunga hungkipah thanom ding ahi.
English: For as a young man marries a virgin, so your sons will marry you. As a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.

tcz: Vo Jerusalem, Keiman khongah ho chu nakulpi banghoa kapan satsah in ahi; amaho hi sunle jana taojom jing ding ahiuve.
en: I have set watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem. They will never be silent day nor night. You who call on the LORD, take no rest,
text:
ISA 62:6
Thadou: Vo Jerusalem, Keiman khongah ho chu nakulpi banghoa kapan satsah in ahi; amaho hi sunle jana taojom jing ding ahiuve.
English: I have set watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem. They will never be silent day nor night. You who call on the LORD, take no rest,

tcz: Jerusalem chu leiset kithang atpi thei ahunghi kahsen, Pakaiyin anatoh abulhit molso kahsen, Pakai chu kicholdo sah hih hel’uvin.
en: and give him no rest until he establishes, and until he makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
text:
ISA 62:7
Thadou: Jerusalem chu leiset kithang atpi thei ahunghi kahsen, Pakaiyin anatoh abulhit molso kahsen, Pakai chu kicholdo sah hih hel’uvin.
English: and give him no rest until he establishes, and until he makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

tcz: Pakai chu Athahatna Jerusalem henga hung kihah sella: “Keiman nangho melmate khutna avella kapehdoh kit tah lou hel ding nahiuve, ati. Gamdang mi na gamga hou le na lengpi twi hou lamang dinga gal nabol khum dinguva hungkon kit talou hel ding ahiuve.
en: The LORD has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, “Surely I will no more give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners will not drink your new wine, for which you have labored,
text:
ISA 62:8
Thadou: Pakai chu Athahatna Jerusalem henga hung kihah sella: “Keiman nangho melmate khutna avella kapehdoh kit tah lou hel ding nahiuve, ati. Gamdang mi na gamga hou le na lengpi twi hou lamang dinga gal nabol khum dinguva hungkon kit talou hel ding ahiuve.
English: The LORD has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, “Surely I will no more give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners will not drink your new wine, for which you have labored,

tcz: Louva tohga na kimu dingu, nanghon hichu naneh’uva Pathen na vahchoi dingu ahi.Hou’In mai lama nangma hotah in naheh lhah’u lengpi-twi chu nadon dingu ahitai.
en: but those who have harvested it will eat it, and praise the LORD. Those who have gathered it will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.”
text:
ISA 62:9
Thadou: Louva tohga na kimu dingu, nanghon hichu naneh’uva Pathen na vahchoi dingu ahi.Hou’In mai lama nangma hotah in naheh lhah’u lengpi-twi chu nadon dingu ahitai.
English: but those who have harvested it will eat it, and praise the LORD. Those who have gathered it will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.”

tcz: Kelkot pam lama gapotdoh’uvin! Kamite ahungkile kitna dinguvin lamlhongpi gongtoh’uvin! Lamlen chu sunam’uvin, songpi ho loidoh un, chitin-namtin nin ahinvet dinguvin ponlap khai sangun.
en: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples.
text:
ISA 62:10
Thadou: Kelkot pam lama gapotdoh’uvin! Kamite ahungkile kitna dinguvin lamlhongpi gongtoh’uvin! Lamlen chu sunam’uvin, songpi ho loidoh un, chitin-namtin nin ahinvet dinguvin ponlap khai sangun.
English: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples.

tcz: Pakaiyin hiche thuhi gamtina asoldohtai: Israel nam mite seipeh’uvin, Veuvin, na Huhhingpu chu ahunge. Ven, tohman kichoi tothon Ama ahunge.
en: Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the end of the earth: “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes! Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him!’”
text:
ISA 62:11
Thadou: Pakaiyin hiche thuhi gamtina asoldohtai: Israel nam mite seipeh’uvin, Veuvin, na Huhhingpu chu ahunge. Ven, tohman kichoi tothon Ama ahunge.
English: Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the end of the earth: “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes! Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him!’”

tcz: Amaho chu, “Athenga Mite”le “Thisanna Pakaiyin Achohdohsa Mite”kiti ding ahiuve. Chule Jerusalem hi “Dei umtah Mun” le “Khopi Kinungsun kit talou ding” kiti ding ahitai.
en: They will call them “The Holy People, The LORD’s Redeemed”. You will be called “Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken”.
text:
ISA 62:12
Thadou: Amaho chu, “Athenga Mite”le “Thisanna Pakaiyin Achohdohsa Mite”kiti ding ahiuve. Chule Jerusalem hi “Dei umtah Mun” le “Khopi Kinungsun kit talou ding” kiti ding ahitai.
English: They will call them “The Holy People, The LORD’s Redeemed”. You will be called “Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken”.

tcz: Edoma kona hunga, Bozrah khopia konna hung'ah, aponsil thisan beh hi koi hija ham? Alalna sangkhol chol puma, athahatna’a hungpa chu koi hija ham? Hiche hi Keima, Pakai huhhing'a naumna ding phongdohpa chu kahi!Hiche hi Keima Pakai, nangho huhdoh thei thaneipa chu kahi!
en: Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching in the greatness of his strength? “It is I who speak in righteousness, mighty to save.”
text:
ISA 63:1
Thadou: Edoma kona hunga, Bozrah khopia konna hung'ah, aponsil thisan beh hi koi hija ham? Alalna sangkhol chol puma, athahatna’a hungpa chu koi hija ham? Hiche hi Keima, Pakai huhhing'a naumna ding phongdohpa chu kahi!Hiche hi Keima Pakai, nangho huhdoh thei thaneipa chu kahi!
English: Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching in the greatness of his strength? “It is I who speak in righteousness, mighty to save.”

tcz: Nangman lengpi-ga nachil khat tou hiya, ipi itia navon hi tia hi san ahidem?
en: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat?
text:
ISA 63:2
Thadou: Nangman lengpi-ga nachil khat tou hiya, ipi itia navon hi tia hi san ahidem?
English: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat?

tcz: Keiman kachangseh’a lengpi-ga chu kachil ahin, eipanpi ding koima aumpoi.Ka lunghan jeh’a ka melmate chu lengpiga kachil tobanga kaban chil jeng ahitauve. Athisanu chu kavon ho chunga behden’a ahije.
en: “I have trodden the wine press alone. Of the peoples, no one was with me. Yes, I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my wrath. Their lifeblood is sprinkled on my garments, and I have stained all my clothing.
text:
ISA 63:3
Thadou: Keiman kachangseh’a lengpi-ga chu kachil ahin, eipanpi ding koima aumpoi.Ka lunghan jeh’a ka melmate chu lengpiga kachil tobanga kaban chil jeng ahitauve. Athisanu chu kavon ho chunga behden’a ahije.
English: “I have trodden the wine press alone. Of the peoples, no one was with me. Yes, I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my wrath. Their lifeblood is sprinkled on my garments, and I have stained all my clothing.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh ka mite abol hesoh nauva konna lhatdohna’a, phuba kalahna ding phat hung lhunga ahitai.
en: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed has come.
text:
ISA 63:4
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh ka mite abol hesoh nauva konna lhatdohna’a, phuba kalahna ding phat hung lhunga ahitai.
English: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed has come.

tcz: Keiman amaho agimbol pa’uva konna pan hu dinga koima cha akikum lou hi kadatmo lheh in ahi. Hijeh’a hi, keima tah mong kakikuma kabanjang thahatna amaho kahuhdoh kigot ahin, ka lunghanin eichoh thoudoh jenge.
en: I looked, and there was no one to help; and I wondered that there was no one to uphold. Therefore my own arm brought salvation to me. My own wrath upheld me.
text:
ISA 63:5
Thadou: Keiman amaho agimbol pa’uva konna pan hu dinga koima cha akikum lou hi kadatmo lheh in ahi. Hijeh’a hi, keima tah mong kakikuma kabanjang thahatna amaho kahuhdoh kigot ahin, ka lunghanin eichoh thoudoh jenge.
English: I looked, and there was no one to help; and I wondered that there was no one to uphold. Therefore my own arm brought salvation to me. My own wrath upheld me.

tcz: Keiman chitin-namtin hohi ka lunghanna’ a ka chilgoi ahin, chule amaho lon le leuva tolla lhu lhop’uva, athisannu leisetna ahin vatlhah sah ding’u ahi.
en: I trod down the peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my wrath. I poured their lifeblood out on the earth.”
text:
ISA 63:6
Thadou: Keiman chitin-namtin hohi ka lunghanna’ a ka chilgoi ahin, chule amaho lon le leuva tolla lhu lhop’uva, athisannu leisetna ahin vatlhah sah ding’u ahi.
English: I trod down the peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my wrath. I poured their lifeblood out on the earth.”

tcz: Keiman Pakai ngailutna lhadai ngailou chu kasei ding, athibol ho jouse jal'a hi Pakai chu ka vahchoi ding, akhotona le angailutna jal'a lungsetna anei chu, Israel dinga aphat behset jeh’a hi kipah thanom ding kahi.
en: I will tell of the loving kindnesses of the LORD and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD has given to us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has given to them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
text:
ISA 63:7
Thadou: Keiman Pakai ngailutna lhadai ngailou chu kasei ding, athibol ho jouse jal'a hi Pakai chu ka vahchoi ding, akhotona le angailutna jal'a lungsetna anei chu, Israel dinga aphat behset jeh’a hi kipah thanom ding kahi.
English: I will tell of the loving kindnesses of the LORD and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD has given to us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has given to them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

tcz: Aman aseijin, “Ama ho hi Ka mite mong mong ahiuve. Ama hohin keima eipedoh kit talou diu ahi.” Chule Ama ahuhhingpu’u ahung hitai.
en: For he said, “Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely;” so he became their Savior.
text:
ISA 63:8
Thadou: Aman aseijin, “Ama ho hi Ka mite mong mong ahiuve. Ama hohin keima eipedoh kit talou diu ahi.” Chule Ama ahuhhingpu’u ahung hitai.
English: For he said, “Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely;” so he became their Savior.

tcz: Gim hesoh athoh nauva Aman jong agim pin, Ama tah amaho huhdoh in apange. Angailutna le akhotona jallin, amaho alhatdamin, Ama’n amaho hi kum sunghoa ahin domkhang’in chule apole’in ahi.
en: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he redeemed them. He bore them, and carried them all the days of old.
text:
ISA 63:9
Thadou: Gim hesoh athoh nauva Aman jong agim pin, Ama tah amaho huhdoh in apange. Angailutna le akhotona jallin, amaho alhatdamin, Ama’n amaho hi kum sunghoa ahin domkhang’in chule apole’in ahi.
English: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he redeemed them. He bore them, and carried them all the days of old.

tcz: Hinla amaho hi Ama douna’a akisauvin, a Lhagao Theng alung phatmo sah’uvin, hijeh chun Ama amaho dingin melma akisoh in, amaho ahin doutai.
en: But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought against them.
text:
ISA 63:10
Thadou: Hinla amaho hi Ama douna’a akisauvin, a Lhagao Theng alung phatmo sah’uvin, hijeh chun Ama amaho dingin melma akisoh in, amaho ahin doutai.
English: But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought against them.

tcz: Chuphatnin amahon Mose in amite apuidoh lai phat’u, nikho chesaho chu ageldoh tauve. Chujeh in amahon asamuvin: Twipi-sanna Israel te hin pui galkaipa chu hoiya uma ham? Mose achingpau chu anahi lou ham? Lhagao Theng hinsolpa Amite umpipa chu hoiya uma ham?
en: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying, “Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is he who put his Holy Spirit among them?”
text:
ISA 63:11
Thadou: Chuphatnin amahon Mose in amite apuidoh lai phat’u, nikho chesaho chu ageldoh tauve. Chujeh in amahon asamuvin: Twipi-sanna Israel te hin pui galkaipa chu hoiya uma ham? Mose achingpau chu anahi lou ham? Lhagao Theng hinsolpa Amite umpipa chu hoiya uma ham?
English: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying, “Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is he who put his Holy Spirit among them?”

tcz: Mose in a khut ajah’a chu koiham athahatna hin vetsah’a chu? Amasang tah’uva twipi-san hop nia so’a, Ama tah minthanna atonsotna hin semdoh pachu hoiya umham?
en: Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses’ right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
text:
ISA 63:12
Thadou: Mose in a khut ajah’a chu koiham athahatna hin vetsah’a chu? Amasang tah’uva twipi-san hop nia so’a, Ama tah minthanna atonsotna hin semdoh pachu hoiya umham?
English: Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses’ right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

tcz: Twi khanglen thuh tah noinung lampeh’a konna amiteho hin pui galkai’pachu hoi lamba hitam? Ama hohi Sakolchal til kilalou hoitah ho tobang'in gamthip gam'a ahung kilhaitet’uva jong kipal lou hel ahiuve.
en: Who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn’t stumble?
text:
ISA 63:13
Thadou: Twi khanglen thuh tah noinung lampeh’a konna amiteho hin pui galkai’pachu hoi lamba hitam? Ama hohi Sakolchal til kilalou hoitah ho tobang'in gamthip gam'a ahung kilhaitet’uva jong kipal lou hel ahiuve.
English: Who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn’t stumble?

tcz: Gancha hotoh phaicham lhunga lung monga kilhonuva, Pakai Lhagaovin amaho chu akicholdo sah ahiiai. Pakai nangman namite chu napui jin, chua chun minthanna loupitah chu
en: As the livestock that go down into the valley, the LORD’s Spirit caused them to rest. So you led your people to make yourself a glorious name.
text:
ISA 63:14
Thadou: Gancha hotoh phaicham lhunga lung monga kilhonuva, Pakai Lhagaovin amaho chu akicholdo sah ahiiai. Pakai nangman namite chu napui jin, chua chun minthanna loupitah chu
English: As the livestock that go down into the valley, the LORD’s Spirit caused them to rest. So you led your people to make yourself a glorious name.

tcz: Pakai, vanna konin neihin vesuh’uvin: na chenna In thengtah le loupitah’a konin hin ven. Kachunguva neihin gelkhoh nau le nahatna neivetsah jiu chu hoilamba hitam?
en: Look down from heaven, and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory. Where are your zeal and your mighty acts? The yearning of your heart and your compassion is restrained toward me.
text:
ISA 63:15
Thadou: Pakai, vanna konin neihin vesuh’uvin: na chenna In thengtah le loupitah’a konin hin ven. Kachunguva neihin gelkhoh nau le nahatna neivetsah jiu chu hoilamba hitam?
English: Look down from heaven, and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory. Where are your zeal and your mighty acts? The yearning of your heart and your compassion is restrained toward me.

tcz: Thonlou hella nangma ka Pa’u nahi jinge! Abraham le Jacob’in einol diu hijongleh, Pakai, nangma ka Pa’u nahi jing nahlai ding ahi.Nangma akhang akhana achesa phat hoa ei-Lhatdampu’u chu nahi.
en: For you are our Father, though Abraham doesn’t know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, LORD, are our Father. Our Redeemer from everlasting is your name.
text:
ISA 63:16
Thadou: Thonlou hella nangma ka Pa’u nahi jinge! Abraham le Jacob’in einol diu hijongleh, Pakai, nangma ka Pa’u nahi jing nahlai ding ahi.Nangma akhang akhana achesa phat hoa ei-Lhatdampu’u chu nahi.
English: For you are our Father, though Abraham doesn’t know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, LORD, are our Father. Our Redeemer from everlasting is your name.

tcz: Pakai, iti danna na lampia konna kihei mang dinga neiphal jengu hitam? Ipi dinga Nangma kagin louna dinguva louchalna lungthim neipeh’u hitam? Hung kilehei kitnin lang chule nei pan piuvin, ajeh iham itileh keiho na lhachate kahiuvin, nangman na deilhen phunga mite kahiuve.
en: O LORD, why do you make us wander from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.
text:
ISA 63:17
Thadou: Pakai, iti danna na lampia konna kihei mang dinga neiphal jengu hitam? Ipi dinga Nangma kagin louna dinguva louchalna lungthim neipeh’u hitam? Hung kilehei kitnin lang chule nei pan piuvin, ajeh iham itileh keiho na lhachate kahiuvin, nangman na deilhen phunga mite kahiuve.
English: O LORD, why do you make us wander from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.

tcz: Chomcha kahsung bou ahi nalaije na mun theng sung namiten kalo nau phatsung hi, hinla tun ka melma teuvin eisugam hel tauve.
en: Your holy people possessed it but a little while. Our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.
text:
ISA 63:18
Thadou: Chomcha kahsung bou ahi nalaije na mun theng sung namiten kalo nau phatsung hi, hinla tun ka melma teuvin eisugam hel tauve.
English: Your holy people possessed it but a little while. Our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.

tcz: Khatvei kom le keihohi nangma’a hikhalou helto kabang jitauvin, keiho hi nangma mite tia kihekhalou hel kabanguve.
en: We have become like those over whom you never ruled, like those who were not called by your name.
text:
ISA 63:19
Thadou: Khatvei kom le keihohi nangma’a hikhalou helto kabang jitauvin, keiho hi nangma mite tia kihekhalou hel kabanguve.
English: We have become like those over whom you never ruled, like those who were not called by your name.

tcz: Oh, van hoa konna nahung kijaldoh jeng’a chule nahung kum suh hita ve leh! Na masanga lhangsang ho jong ti kithing thing jeng diu ahije!
en: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—
text:
ISA 64:1
Thadou: Oh, van hoa konna nahung kijaldoh jeng’a chule nahung kum suh hita ve leh! Na masanga lhangsang ho jong ti kithing thing jeng diu ahije!
English: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—

tcz: Meiyin thing go akahvama chule twiho asatsah tobang'in, nangma hung chun chitin- namtin kithing uvintin, chutah le na melma ten na minthanna ajeh ahetdoh dingu ahitai.
en: as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!
text:
ISA 64:2
Thadou: Meiyin thing go akahvama chule twiho asatsah tobang'in, nangma hung chun chitin- namtin kithing uvintin, chutah le na melma ten na minthanna ajeh ahetdoh dingu ahitai.
English: as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!

tcz: Ma sanglaipeh’a na hungkumsuh chun, nangman kidangtah tah kagel phah’u kalval peh in thilho naboldohsa ahije.Hiti chun lhangsangho jong chu akihot jenguve!
en: When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.
text:
ISA 64:3
Thadou: Ma sanglaipeh’a na hungkumsuh chun, nangman kidangtah tah kagel phah’u kalval peh in thilho naboldohsa ahije.Hiti chun lhangsangho jong chu akihot jenguve!
English: When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh vannoi bul kiphu’a patnin, koima’n ajah khahlou, chule Ama ngah jing ho hitobang athil bolpeh umkha lou, mihem koima mitnin nang tobang Pathen hi amukha pouve!
en: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.
text:
ISA 64:4
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh vannoi bul kiphu’a patnin, koima’n ajah khahlou, chule Ama ngah jing ho hitobang athil bolpeh umkha lou, mihem koima mitnin nang tobang Pathen hi amukha pouve!
English: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.

tcz: Kipah thanom’a apha bol ho, Pathen ngaisah ho chu kipah’in nakimupi ji'e.Hinla keiho pathen-ngaisah lou kahi jeh’un, kachunguva nalung hang lheh jenge. Keiho chonset bol bol jeng ka hiuvin; keiho tobangbep hi iti ka sochat dingu ham?
en: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?
text:
ISA 64:5
Thadou: Kipah thanom’a apha bol ho, Pathen ngaisah ho chu kipah’in nakimupi ji'e.Hinla keiho pathen-ngaisah lou kahi jeh’un, kachunguva nalung hang lheh jenge. Keiho chonset bol bol jeng ka hiuvin; keiho tobangbep hi iti ka sochat dingu ham?
English: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?

tcz: Keiho hi ka bonchauva achonsea le athenglou chu kahiuve. Ka chonphat thilbol hou jong, imacha dang hilou ponse-namse tobang bou ahi. Khal laiya thingna apul tobang'in keiho kagop pai jiuvin chule kapullha ji tauve, chule hui hung nung tobang'in ka chonset’uvin eipui mang ji tauve.
en: For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.
text:
ISA 64:6
Thadou: Keiho hi ka bonchauva achonsea le athenglou chu kahiuve. Ka chonphat thilbol hou jong, imacha dang hilou ponse-namse tobang bou ahi. Khal laiya thingna apul tobang'in keiho kagop pai jiuvin chule kapullha ji tauve, chule hui hung nung tobang'in ka chonset’uvin eipui mang ji tauve.
English: For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.

tcz: Ahivangin na mina taova koima aumpouvin chule na khotona angeh pouve. Hijeh hin, nangma keihoa konin na kihei mangin, chule ka chonset nau lama nei lehei mang tauve.
en: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.
text:
ISA 64:7
Thadou: Ahivangin na mina taova koima aumpouvin chule na khotona angeh pouve. Hijeh hin, nangma keihoa konin na kihei mangin, chule ka chonset nau lama nei lehei mang tauve.
English: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.

tcz: Chuti hijongleh,Vo Pakai, nangma ka Pa’u nahije. Nangma bel dengpa chu nahin chule keiho leingan kahiuve. Keima ho jouse hi nakhutna neisemu ahije.
en: But now, LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.
text:
ISA 64:8
Thadou: Chuti hijongleh,Vo Pakai, nangma ka Pa’u nahije. Nangma bel dengpa chu nahin chule keiho leingan kahiuve. Keima ho jouse hi nakhutna neisemu ahije.
English: But now, LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.

tcz: Pakai, neilunghan hih beh’uvin. Ka chonsetna ho’u chu geldoh jom jing tahih beh in. Nei hin vetem’un, katao’u ahi, chule keima ho jouse hi namite kahiuve.
en: Don’t be furious, LORD. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.
text:
ISA 64:9
Thadou: Pakai, neilunghan hih beh’uvin. Ka chonsetna ho’u chu geldoh jom jing tahih beh in. Nei hin vetem’un, katao’u ahi, chule keima ho jouse hi namite kahiuve.
English: Don’t be furious, LORD. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.

tcz: Na khopi thengho jong suhmangin aumtai. Zion hi gamthip akisoh in; henge, Jerusalem hi amangthah hel ahitai.
en: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
text:
ISA 64:10
Thadou: Na khopi thengho jong suhmangin aumtai. Zion hi gamthip akisoh in; henge, Jerusalem hi amangthah hel ahitai.
English: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

tcz: Hou’in theng le hoitah, kapu kapa teuvin na vahchoila asah nau mun chu, akihal vam’a ahitai, chule vet hoithei jouse chu kisumang soh’a ahitai.
en: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.
text:
ISA 64:11
Thadou: Hou’in theng le hoitah, kapu kapa teuvin na vahchoila asah nau mun chu, akihal vam’a ahitai, chule vet hoithei jouse chu kisumang soh’a ahitai.
English: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.

tcz: Pakaiyin, “Keima ei dongloute henga Keima ka kiphongin; Keima eihol louten ei mudoh’uve.Keima ka minna eikou lou, namkhat koma. Keiman, “Hia kaume, hia kaume!” tin kaseije .
en: “I am inquired of by those who didn’t ask. I am found by those who didn’t seek me. I said, ‘See me, see me,’ to a nation that was not called by my name.
text:
ISA 65:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin, “Keima ei dongloute henga Keima ka kiphongin; Keima eihol louten ei mudoh’uve.Keima ka minna eikou lou, namkhat koma. Keiman, “Hia kaume, hia kaume!” tin kaseije .
English: “I am inquired of by those who didn’t ask. I am found by those who didn’t seek me. I said, ‘See me, see me,’ to a nation that was not called by my name.

tcz: Nilhum keijin Keiman mi louchal tah ho henga kaban kajah e. Hinla ama hon alam piu phalou bou ajui nomun, chule amaho lung gon dihlou chu asuh bulhit nom jouve.
en: I have spread out my hands all day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;

tcz: Nilhum keijin ama hon ka maikoh’a jachat sahna eipeuvin, chule semthu-pathen henga kilhaina ahonsung’uva abol’uvin ahi. Ama hon gamdang -pathen kihouna maicham chunga kilhaina abol’uvin ahi.
en: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens, and burning incense on bricks;

tcz: Jan tengleh amaho lhan munna aga cheuvin, mithi ahou jiuve. Ama hon vohchasa aneuvin, chule neh ngailou ding dangho to abutnin apeltha’uvin ahon’uve.
en: who sit among the graves, and spend nights in secret places; who eat pig’s meat, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

tcz: Hijeng jongleh amaho khat le khatnin, “Hin naival hih un, neisu boh get’uvinate! Nang sanga gam chenga thenga kahi! atiuvin ahi. Hiche mite hi kanah hom teni dinga namsetah, gah nah theihoi ahipon, athang nam chu mangthei talou hel ahitai.
en: who say, ‘Stay by yourself, don’t come near to me, for I am holier than you.’ These are smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all day.
text:
ISA 65:5
Thadou: Hijeng jongleh amaho khat le khatnin, “Hin naival hih un, neisu boh get’uvinate! Nang sanga gam chenga thenga kahi! atiuvin ahi. Hiche mite hi kanah hom teni dinga namsetah, gah nah theihoi ahipon, athang nam chu mangthei talou hel ahitai.
English: who say, ‘Stay by yourself, don’t come near to me, for I am holier than you.’ These are smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all day.

tcz: Ven, ka thulhuhna hi ka masanga jihdoh san aume: Thip beh’a kamoh din loubeh ding ahi: Keiman amaho lethuh lou hella kamoh umthim beh lou ding ahi! Tah beh’a Keiman kale thuh tei ding ahi-
en: “Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will repay, yes, I will repay into their bosom
text:
ISA 65:6
Thadou: Ven, ka thulhuhna hi ka masanga jihdoh san aume: Thip beh’a kamoh din loubeh ding ahi: Keiman amaho lethuh lou hella kamoh umthim beh lou ding ahi! Tah beh’a Keiman kale thuh tei ding ahi-
English: “Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will repay, yes, I will repay into their bosom

tcz: Achonset nau jeh’a le apu apa teu chonsetna jeh’a ka lethuh tei ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.”Ajeh iham itileh ama hon lhangsangho chunga thil namtui ahal’uvin, chule lhangsang hoa ei jumsouvin ahi. Hijeh’a hi keiman bulhingsetna kalethuh ding ahiuve!
en: your own iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together”, says the LORD, “who have burned incense on the mountains, and blasphemed me on the hills. Therefore I will first measure their work into their bosom.”
text:
ISA 65:7
Thadou: Achonset nau jeh’a le apu apa teu chonsetna jeh’a ka lethuh tei ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.”Ajeh iham itileh ama hon lhangsangho chunga thil namtui ahal’uvin, chule lhangsang hoa ei jumsouvin ahi. Hijeh’a hi keiman bulhingsetna kalethuh ding ahiuve!
English: your own iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together”, says the LORD, “who have burned incense on the mountains, and blasphemed me on the hills. Therefore I will first measure their work into their bosom.”

tcz: Hijeng jongleh Keiman amaho kasuhgam pailou dingu ahi. Ajeh iham itileh lengpi ga aphalou holah’a agapha aum tobanga (khat touvin, abonin paisoh hih in-lengpi ga phabep apha aumna lainai atiding tobanga) chu, Keiman jong Israel mi jouse kasuh mang lou dingu ahi. Ajeh iham itileh amaho lah’a lhacha dihtah phabep kanei nalaije” ati.
en: The LORD says, “As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, ‘Don’t destroy it, for a blessing is in it:’ so I will do for my servants’ sake, that I may not destroy them all.
text:
ISA 65:8
Thadou: Hijeng jongleh Keiman amaho kasuhgam pailou dingu ahi. Ajeh iham itileh lengpi ga aphalou holah’a agapha aum tobanga (khat touvin, abonin paisoh hih in-lengpi ga phabep apha aumna lainai atiding tobanga) chu, Keiman jong Israel mi jouse kasuh mang lou dingu ahi. Ajeh iham itileh amaho lah’a lhacha dihtah phabep kanei nalaije” ati.
English: The LORD says, “As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, ‘Don’t destroy it, for a blessing is in it:’ so I will do for my servants’ sake, that I may not destroy them all.

tcz: Keiman Israel lah’a le Judah lah’a konna amohthem chu kakhendoh ho chun ka gamsung alo dingu ahi. Ka lhendoh ho chun gamsung chu alo dingu, chule ka lhachate ho chu chea chu gacheng ding ahiuve.
en: I will bring offspring out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains. My chosen will inherit it, and my servants will dwell there.
text:
ISA 65:9
Thadou: Keiman Israel lah’a le Judah lah’a konna amohthem chu kakhendoh ho chun ka gamsung alo dingu ahi. Ka lhendoh ho chun gamsung chu alo dingu, chule ka lhachate ho chu chea chu gacheng ding ahiuve.
English: I will bring offspring out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains. My chosen will inherit it, and my servants will dwell there.

tcz: Sharon phaicham chu kamite, Keima eihol ho dinga kelngoihon ho hung lhadimset dingu chule AKhor phaicham jong chu hampa phatna mun hung hiding ahiuve.
en: Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people who have sought me.
text:
ISA 65:10
Thadou: Sharon phaicham chu kamite, Keima eihol ho dinga kelngoihon ho hung lhadimset dingu chule AKhor phaicham jong chu hampa phatna mun hung hiding ahiuve.
English: Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people who have sought me.

tcz: Ahinla nangho lah’a amoh adang chengsen Pakai le Ama Hou In chu nanung sunuva chule nasuhmil tah jeh’uva chule nanghon vangsanna pathen jabolna’a golvahho nabol jeh’uva chule nanghon ju kihaltha chu Lhunna ding pathen koma nakatdoh th jeh’uvin,,
en: “But you who forsake the LORD, who forget my holy mountain, who prepare a table for Fortune, and who fill up mixed wine to Destiny;

tcz: Tua hi Keiman chemjama lou dinga nachung thu’u katan lhah ahitai.Nangho jouse hi mi khailih dinga thutanpa koma nakun sohkei dingu ahitai. Ajeh iham itileh, kakou petnin, neidonbut pouve. Thu kasei petnin, kasei nei ngaipeh pouve.Na lungchamtah’uva chonset na bolu ahin-kamitmu changtah’a nabol jeh’uva hi- chule keiman ijakaselou chu nalhenuva nabol tah jeh’u ahi.”
en: I will destine you to the sword, and you will all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, you didn’t answer. When I spoke, you didn’t listen; but you did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”
text:
ISA 65:12
Thadou: Tua hi Keiman chemjama lou dinga nachung thu’u katan lhah ahitai.Nangho jouse hi mi khailih dinga thutanpa koma nakun sohkei dingu ahitai. Ajeh iham itileh, kakou petnin, neidonbut pouve. Thu kasei petnin, kasei nei ngaipeh pouve.Na lungchamtah’uva chonset na bolu ahin-kamitmu changtah’a nabol jeh’uva hi- chule keiman ijakaselou chu nalhenuva nabol tah jeh’u ahi.”
English: I will destine you to the sword, and you will all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, you didn’t answer. When I spoke, you didn’t listen; but you did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”

tcz: Hijeh’a hi Thuneichungnungpen Pakaiyin asei chu: “Kalhachaten anehdingu,hinla nanghon kel nathoh dingu ahi. Kalhachaten adonding, hinla nangho nadangchah dingu ahi. Kalhachate kipah dingu, hinla nangho nalungu khama najachat dingu ahi.
en: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, my servants will rejoice, but you will be disappointed.
text:
ISA 65:13
Thadou: Hijeh’a hi Thuneichungnungpen Pakaiyin asei chu: “Kalhachaten anehdingu,hinla nanghon kel nathoh dingu ahi. Kalhachaten adonding, hinla nangho nadangchah dingu ahi. Kalhachate kipah dingu, hinla nangho nalungu khama najachat dingu ahi.
English: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, my servants will rejoice, but you will be disappointed.

tcz: Kalhachaten kipahtah’a la asah dingu, hinla nangho lungnom moa le lunghem’a naka dingu ahi.
en: Behold, my servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will wail for anguish of spirit.
text:
ISA 65:14
Thadou: Kalhachaten kipahtah’a la asah dingu, hinla nangho lungnom moa le lunghem’a naka dingu ahi.
English: Behold, my servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will wail for anguish of spirit.

tcz: Kamiteho lah’a dinga maminu chu gaosapna tobanga nadalhah dingu, Thunei chungnungpen Pakai chun nasuhmang dingu, hinla Ama’n alhachate henga minthah khat apeh ding ahitai.
en: You will leave your name for a curse to my chosen, and the Lord GOD will kill you. He will call his servants by another name,
text:
ISA 65:15
Thadou: Kamiteho lah’a dinga maminu chu gaosapna tobanga nadalhah dingu, Thunei chungnungpen Pakai chun nasuhmang dingu, hinla Ama’n alhachate henga minthah khat apeh ding ahitai.
English: You will leave your name for a curse to my chosen, and the Lord GOD will kill you. He will call his servants by another name,

tcz: Pathen’a phattheina kithum le kihahselna neiho jouse chuThutah Pathen’a bolluhen. Ajeh chu kalung hanna chu kachonmang’a, chule nikho masahoa phatlouna ho chu kasuhmil ding ahitai.
en: so that he who blesses himself in the earth will bless himself in the God of truth; and he who swears in the earth will swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hidden from my eyes.
text:
ISA 65:16
Thadou: Pathen’a phattheina kithum le kihahselna neiho jouse chuThutah Pathen’a bolluhen. Ajeh chu kalung hanna chu kachonmang’a, chule nikho masahoa phatlouna ho chu kasuhmil ding ahitai.
English: so that he who blesses himself in the earth will bless himself in the God of truth; and he who swears in the earth will swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hidden from my eyes.

tcz: Veuvin Keiman Van thahho le leiset thah kasem’in, koima chan aluiho chu agel phahlou hel dingu ahitai.
en: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.
text:
ISA 65:17
Thadou: Veuvin Keiman Van thahho le leiset thah kasem’in, koima chan aluiho chu agel phahlou hel dingu ahitai.
English: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.

tcz: Kipah thanomuvin, Kathilsemna chunga a’itih’in kipah thanom jinguvin! Chule veuvin! Keiman Jerusalem hi kipana muna kasem teiding, amite jouse chu kipana hung kondohna hiding ahiuve.
en: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people a joy.
text:
ISA 65:18
Thadou: Kipah thanomuvin, Kathilsemna chunga a’itih’in kipah thanom jinguvin! Chule veuvin! Keiman Jerusalem hi kipana muna kasem teiding, amite jouse chu kipana hung kondohna hiding ahiuve.
English: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people a joy.

tcz: Keima Jerusalem chunga kipah thanom ing ting chule Kamite chunga ka lunglhaina um teiding ahitai. Chule chuche muna chu kana le pen aw gin kija kit talou helding ahitai.
en: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more.
text:
ISA 65:19
Thadou: Keima Jerusalem chunga kipah thanom ing ting chule Kamite chunga ka lunglhaina um teiding ahitai. Chule chuche muna chu kana le pen aw gin kija kit talou helding ahitai.
English: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more.

tcz: Naosen ho jong nikho phabep hipan bep ho moh thi talou hel dingu. Chujongleh akikhan lhit ho jong chu hinkho lhingset aman masanguva moh thi talou dingu ahitai. Kum jakhat lhingho jong koiman tehse tia agel tahlou dingu ahitai! Gaosap chang ho bou chu khangdon laiya thiding ahive.
en: “No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child will die one hundred years old, and the sinner being one hundred years old will be accursed.
text:
ISA 65:20
Thadou: Naosen ho jong nikho phabep hipan bep ho moh thi talou hel dingu. Chujongleh akikhan lhit ho jong chu hinkho lhingset aman masanguva moh thi talou dingu ahitai. Kum jakhat lhingho jong koiman tehse tia agel tahlou dingu ahitai! Gaosap chang ho bou chu khangdon laiya thiding ahive.
English: “No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child will die one hundred years old, and the sinner being one hundred years old will be accursed.

tcz: Chuchelai teng chule miho chun ainsahsau sunguva chu cheng sohkei diu, chule alengpi lei’uva lengpi ga chu aneh dingu ahi.
en: They will build houses and inhabit them. They will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
text:
ISA 65:21
Thadou: Chuchelai teng chule miho chun ainsahsau sunguva chu cheng sohkei diu, chule alengpi lei’uva lengpi ga chu aneh dingu ahi.
English: They will build houses and inhabit them. They will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

tcz: Masang lai bang chu hitalou ding, gal hung bol ho chun a’in hou alahpeh tah lou dingu, chule alengpi lei’u mi dang chang talou ding ahi. Ajeh iham itileh ka mite chu thingdam channa damthei dingu chule kalhendoh ho chun atohgao tampi nopsahna phat amankhom dingu ahi.
en: They will not build and another inhabit. They will not plant and another eat; for the days of my people will be like the days of a tree, and my chosen will long enjoy the work of their hands.
text:
ISA 65:22
Thadou: Masang lai bang chu hitalou ding, gal hung bol ho chun a’in hou alahpeh tah lou dingu, chule alengpi lei’u mi dang chang talou ding ahi. Ajeh iham itileh ka mite chu thingdam channa damthei dingu chule kalhendoh ho chun atohgao tampi nopsahna phat amankhom dingu ahi.
English: They will not build and another inhabit. They will not plant and another eat; for the days of my people will be like the days of a tree, and my chosen will long enjoy the work of their hands.

tcz: Amahon mohseh’a atoh lou dingu, chule achateu jong hamsetna mahthah lou dingu ahi. Ajeh chu amaho Pakaiyin phatthei abohte ahiuvin, chule achateu jong phattheina chang diu ahi.
en: They will not labor in vain nor give birth for calamity; for they are the offspring of the LORD’s blessed and their descendants with them.
text:
ISA 65:23
Thadou: Amahon mohseh’a atoh lou dingu, chule achateu jong hamsetna mahthah lou dingu ahi. Ajeh chu amaho Pakaiyin phatthei abohte ahiuvin, chule achateu jong phattheina chang diu ahi.
English: They will not labor in vain nor give birth for calamity; for they are the offspring of the LORD’s blessed and their descendants with them.

tcz: Amahon eihin kou masanga kadonbut ding,amahon angaichat’u asei seipet’uva jong kedima ka kimapatna amaho ka donbutpai jeng ding ahi.
en: It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
text:
ISA 65:24
Thadou: Amahon eihin kou masanga kadonbut ding,amahon angaichat’u asei seipet’uva jong kedima ka kimapatna amaho ka donbutpai jeng ding ahi.
English: It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

tcz: Ngei le kelcha’n an aneh khom dingu ahi.Keipin bongpi banga bi aneh ding ahi. Hinla gullin vutvai aneh neh jeng ding ahi. Chuche nikho hoa chu koiman ka lhang theng chu asuhlem lou dingu ahitai, ti Keima Pakaiyin kaphondoh ahitai.
en: The wolf and the lamb will feed together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent’s food. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain,” says the LORD.
text:
ISA 65:25
Thadou: Ngei le kelcha’n an aneh khom dingu ahi.Keipin bongpi banga bi aneh ding ahi. Hinla gullin vutvai aneh neh jeng ding ahi. Chuche nikho hoa chu koiman ka lhang theng chu asuhlem lou dingu ahitai, ti Keima Pakaiyin kaphondoh ahitai.
English: The wolf and the lamb will feed together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent’s food. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain,” says the LORD.

tcz: Hiche hi Pakaiyin asei chu ahi: Van hi ka Laltouna ahi, chule leiset hi ka kengphang ngapna ahi.Nanghon hou’in phatah nasah jou dingu hinam? Nanghon hitobang kicholdona khat chu neisahpeh dingu ham?
en: The LORD says: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I rest?
text:
ISA 66:1
Thadou: Hiche hi Pakaiyin asei chu ahi: Van hi ka Laltouna ahi, chule leiset hi ka kengphang ngapna ahi.Nanghon hou’in phatah nasah jou dingu hinam? Nanghon hitobang kicholdona khat chu neisahpeh dingu ham?
English: The LORD says: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I rest?

tcz: Ka khutnin van le leiset asem gel ahin, amaho le asunga uho jouse keima’a ahi, tin Pakai keiman ka naseije! Keiman akineosah le lungchang kisihna neithei mi ka thuseija kithing thei mi chu phatthei kaboh ding ahi.
en: For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says the LORD: “but I will look to this man, even to he who is poor and of a contrite spirit, and who trembles at my word.
text:
ISA 66:2
Thadou: Ka khutnin van le leiset asem gel ahin, amaho le asunga uho jouse keima’a ahi, tin Pakai keiman ka naseije! Keiman akineosah le lungchang kisihna neithei mi ka thuseija kithing thei mi chu phatthei kaboh ding ahi.
English: For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says the LORD: “but I will look to this man, even to he who is poor and of a contrite spirit, and who trembles at my word.

tcz: Hinla ama ama deilam bou kilhenna, amaho chonsetna hobou deilhen miho chu, akikatdohnau thilto ho jong santhei hilou ding ahi. Hitobang miho chun bongchal kilhainan tohdoh jonguleh, hiho chu mihem’a kilhaina kitohdoh tobangbep’a kila ding ahibouve.Ama hon kelngoi atoji tenguleh, uicha’a kilhaina tobang bepma kila ding ahi! Amahon lousoh ga ahinto ji tengu jongleh, amahon vohcha’a kilhaina thilto abol’uva kila ding ahi. Amahon bego a kilhaina aneijiu jongleh,limsemthu phatthei aboh ‘u tobanga kigel ding ahi.
en: He who kills an ox is as he who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, as he who breaks a dog’s neck; he who offers an offering, as he who offers pig’s blood; he who burns frankincense, as he who blesses an idol. Yes, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.
text:
ISA 66:3
Thadou: Hinla ama ama deilam bou kilhenna, amaho chonsetna hobou deilhen miho chu, akikatdohnau thilto ho jong santhei hilou ding ahi. Hitobang miho chun bongchal kilhainan tohdoh jonguleh, hiho chu mihem’a kilhaina kitohdoh tobangbep’a kila ding ahibouve.Ama hon kelngoi atoji tenguleh, uicha’a kilhaina tobang bepma kila ding ahi! Amahon lousoh ga ahinto ji tengu jongleh, amahon vohcha’a kilhaina thilto abol’uva kila ding ahi. Amahon bego a kilhaina aneijiu jongleh,limsemthu phatthei aboh ‘u tobanga kigel ding ahi.
English: He who kills an ox is as he who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, as he who breaks a dog’s neck; he who offers an offering, as he who offers pig’s blood; he who burns frankincense, as he who blesses an idol. Yes, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.

tcz: Amahon akichatnau jouseuva hahsatna kasolpeh ding ahi. Ajeh iham itileh amahon kakou petnin eidonbut pouvin, chule keiman kaseipetnin angaipouve. Ka mitmutah’a amahon chonset abol’uvin, chule ija kaselou chu bol dingin akilhen johtauve.
en: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears on them, because when I called, no one answered; when I spoke, they didn’t listen, but they did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”
text:
ISA 66:4
Thadou: Amahon akichatnau jouseuva hahsatna kasolpeh ding ahi. Ajeh iham itileh amahon kakou petnin eidonbut pouvin, chule keiman kaseipetnin angaipouve. Ka mitmutah’a amahon chonset abol’uvin, chule ija kaselou chu bol dingin akilhen johtauve.
English: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears on them, because when I called, no one answered; when I spoke, they didn’t listen, but they did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”

tcz: Hiche thuhi Pakaiya konin ngaijuvin, Athuseija kithing le ging geh’a umho: Namite chun nahot bol’uvin, chule kaminna kitah tah’a napanjeh in nanotthap tauve. Amahon ataitomu’uvin, “Pakai chu jabollin umhen! Ama’a kipah thanomin um'in! tin seijonguleh, amaho chu hung kijumso tei ding ahiuve.
en: Hear the LORD’s word, you who tremble at his word: “Your brothers who hate you, who cast you out for my name’s sake, have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified, that we may see your joy;’ but it is those who shall be disappointed.
text:
ISA 66:5
Thadou: Hiche thuhi Pakaiya konin ngaijuvin, Athuseija kithing le ging geh’a umho: Namite chun nahot bol’uvin, chule kaminna kitah tah’a napanjeh in nanotthap tauve. Amahon ataitomu’uvin, “Pakai chu jabollin umhen! Ama’a kipah thanomin um'in! tin seijonguleh, amaho chu hung kijumso tei ding ahiuve.
English: Hear the LORD’s word, you who tremble at his word: “Your brothers who hate you, who cast you out for my name’s sake, have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified, that we may see your joy;’ but it is those who shall be disappointed.

tcz: Khopi sunga boina ho jouse hi ipi hija ham? Hou’In'a konna ging thethua khu ipi hija ham?Hiche hi Pakai awgin, amelmate ho douna’a athilbol hija ahi!”
en: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that repays his enemies what they deserve.
text:
ISA 66:6
Thadou: Khopi sunga boina ho jouse hi ipi hija ham? Hou’In'a konna ging thethua khu ipi hija ham?Hiche hi Pakai awgin, amelmate ho douna’a athilbol hija ahi!”
English: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that repays his enemies what they deserve.

tcz: Naosonat ahung kipat masanga, Jerusalem’in chapa khat ahingtai
en: “Before she travailed, she gave birth. Before her pain came, she delivered a son.
text:
ISA 66:7
Thadou: Naosonat ahung kipat masanga, Jerusalem’in chapa khat ahingtai
English: “Before she travailed, she gave birth. Before her pain came, she delivered a son.

tcz: Hitobang thil kidang hi koiyin anamu khah em? Hitobang hi kon anajah khah em? Nam khat chu nikho khatseh’a hungpeng thei ding ham?Chomkhat kahlouva gamkhat chu hung kitungdoh thei ding ham?Hinla Jerusalem’in naosonat athoh pat teng, achate hungpeng doh ding ahi.
en: Who has heard of such a thing? Who has seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? Shall a nation be born at once? For as soon as Zion travailed, she gave birth to her children.
text:
ISA 66:8
Thadou: Hitobang thil kidang hi koiyin anamu khah em? Hitobang hi kon anajah khah em? Nam khat chu nikho khatseh’a hungpeng thei ding ham?Chomkhat kahlouva gamkhat chu hung kitungdoh thei ding ham?Hinla Jerusalem’in naosonat athoh pat teng, achate hungpeng doh ding ahi.
English: Who has heard of such a thing? Who has seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? Shall a nation be born at once? For as soon as Zion travailed, she gave birth to her children.

tcz: Hiche nam mite hi naosonat thoh dinga kapuidoh’a ahia napa ahinlou ding hija ham? tin Pakaiyin adongin ahi. Na Pathen chun, “ Hilouve, Keiman hiche nam mite hi peng louva kaumlou ding ahi.
en: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to be delivered?” says the LORD. “Shall I who cause to give birth shut the womb?” says your God.
text:
ISA 66:9
Thadou: Hiche nam mite hi naosonat thoh dinga kapuidoh’a ahia napa ahinlou ding hija ham? tin Pakaiyin adongin ahi. Na Pathen chun, “ Hilouve, Keiman hiche nam mite hi peng louva kaumlou ding ahi.
English: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to be delivered?” says the LORD. “Shall I who cause to give birth shut the womb?” says your God.

tcz: Jerusalem toh kipah thanomun!Amanu ngailou ho jouse le ama lung hempi jouse, nabonchauvin kipah thanomun.
en: “Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all you who mourn over her;

tcz: Chapang sen anu noitwi’a alungmon bang chun amanu aloupina chamkimna chu bulhingsetnin kipa piuvin.
en: that you may nurse and be satisfied at the comforting breasts; that you may drink deeply, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.”
text:
ISA 66:11
Thadou: Chapang sen anu noitwi’a alungmon bang chun amanu aloupina chamkimna chu bulhingsetnin kipa piuvin.
English: that you may nurse and be satisfied at the comforting breasts; that you may drink deeply, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.”

tcz: Hiche hi Pakaiyin asei ahi: Keiman Jerusalem hi ninglhinna le chamna lui dung kalonsah ding . Chitin-namtin ahenga hunglut dingu, achateu chu noitwija kivah vaset dingu, abantenia apom’a chule aphei chunga atousah ding ahi.
en: For the LORD says, “Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream, and you will nurse. You will be carried on her side, and will be dandled on her knees.
text:
ISA 66:12
Thadou: Hiche hi Pakaiyin asei ahi: Keiman Jerusalem hi ninglhinna le chamna lui dung kalonsah ding . Chitin-namtin ahenga hunglut dingu, achateu chu noitwija kivah vaset dingu, abantenia apom’a chule aphei chunga atousah ding ahi.
English: For the LORD says, “Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream, and you will nurse. You will be carried on her side, and will be dandled on her knees.

tcz: Minun acha alhamon tobanga keiman nangho hi Jerusalem’a kalhamon ding nahiuve.
en: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”
text:
ISA 66:13
Thadou: Minun acha alhamon tobanga keiman nangho hi Jerusalem’a kalhamon ding nahiuve.
English: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”

tcz: Hiche ho jouse hi namusoh tengleh,nalungsung kipah ding chule hampa banga nakidodoh ding ahi. Mitinin Pakai phattheina khut chu asohte chunga amu thei dingu chule amelmate chunga alunghanna amudiu ahije.
en: You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. The LORD’s hand will be known among his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.
text:
ISA 66:14
Thadou: Hiche ho jouse hi namusoh tengleh,nalungsung kipah ding chule hampa banga nakidodoh ding ahi. Mitinin Pakai phattheina khut chu asohte chunga amu thei dingu chule amelmate chunga alunghanna amudiu ahije.
English: You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. The LORD’s hand will be known among his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.

tcz: Ven, Pakai chu meikoutoh kilhonin ahungin chule asakol kangtalai chu huipi hung nung gin tobang'in agingdoh jenge. Aman alunghanna’a gimbol dinga hung ding chule aphosalna meikou tobang hiding ahi.
en: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and his chariots will be like the whirlwind; to render his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
text:
ISA 66:15
Thadou: Ven, Pakai chu meikoutoh kilhonin ahungin chule asakol kangtalai chu huipi hung nung gin tobang'in agingdoh jenge. Aman alunghanna’a gimbol dinga hung ding chule aphosalna meikou tobang hiding ahi.
English: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and his chariots will be like the whirlwind; to render his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

tcz: Pakai chun vannoi hi alunghanna le achem jama agimbol ding ahi. Ama’n leiset chung thu atanna Chula mi tampi chu ahintha ding ahi.
en: For the LORD will execute judgment by fire and by his sword on all flesh; and those slain by the LORD will be many.
text:
ISA 66:16
Thadou: Pakai chun vannoi hi alunghanna le achem jama agimbol ding ahi. Ama’n leiset chung thu atanna Chula mi tampi chu ahintha ding ahi.
English: For the LORD will execute judgment by fire and by his sword on all flesh; and those slain by the LORD will be many.

tcz: Amaho tah kisuthenguva chule honsung lailunga thingphung nung lama lim semthua kisuthenga- thet umtah vohsale juchasa’a chule thil thenglou hoa kivahvaset ho chu hoisetah’a mangthah ding ahiuve.
en: “Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, following one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together,” says the LORD.
text:
ISA 66:17
Thadou: Amaho tah kisuthenguva chule honsung lailunga thingphung nung lama lim semthua kisuthenga- thet umtah vohsale juchasa’a chule thil thenglou hoa kivahvaset ho chu hoisetah’a mangthah ding ahiuve.
English: “Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, following one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together,” says the LORD.

tcz: Amahon ipi abol’u kamudoh theijin chule ipi agellu kahedoh theije.Hijeh’a hi keiman nam jouse le mipite kakhop khom’a chule amahon kaloupina amu dingu ahi.
en: “For I know their works and their thoughts. The time comes that I will gather all nations and languages, and they will come, and will see my glory.
text:
ISA 66:18
Thadou: Amahon ipi abol’u kamudoh theijin chule ipi agellu kahedoh theije.Hijeh’a hi keiman nam jouse le mipite kakhop khom’a chule amahon kaloupina amu dingu ahi.
English: “For I know their works and their thoughts. The time comes that I will gather all nations and languages, and they will come, and will see my glory.

tcz: Keiman amaho lah’a melchihna khat kavetsah ding ahi. Chule chitin-namtin lah’a thupoa pang ding ho chu - Tarshis’a, Libia miho lah’a, chule Lydia miho (thalkap them tah’ho tobang lah)’a, Tubal ho le Greek mite ho lah’a chule twikhanglen gal lama umho jouse keiman min jakhalou ho , kaloupina mukhaloulaiho henga kasol ding ahiuve.
en: “I will set a sign among them, and I will send those who escape of them to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to far-away islands, who have not heard my fame, nor have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the nations.
text:
ISA 66:19
Thadou: Keiman amaho lah’a melchihna khat kavetsah ding ahi. Chule chitin-namtin lah’a thupoa pang ding ho chu - Tarshis’a, Libia miho lah’a, chule Lydia miho (thalkap them tah’ho tobang lah)’a, Tubal ho le Greek mite ho lah’a chule twikhanglen gal lama umho jouse keiman min jakhalou ho , kaloupina mukhaloulaiho henga kasol ding ahiuve.
English: “I will set a sign among them, and I will send those who escape of them to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to far-away islands, who have not heard my fame, nor have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the nations.

tcz: Amaho chun chitin ho lah’akonna namite amohthem ho chu ahinpui khom dingu ahi. Amaho chun kalhangtheng Jerusalema amaho chu Pakaiya kilhaina dinga ahin puilut dingu ahi. Amaho chun sakol ho chunga, sakol kangtalaiho chunga chule sangan chungle sangong sangho chunga hungtou’uva hung ding ahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
en: They shall bring all your brothers out of all the nations for an offering to the LORD, on horses, in chariots, in litters, on mules, and on camels, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says the LORD, as the children of Israel bring their offering in a clean vessel into the LORD’s house.
text:
ISA 66:20
Thadou: Amaho chun chitin ho lah’akonna namite amohthem ho chu ahinpui khom dingu ahi. Amaho chun kalhangtheng Jerusalema amaho chu Pakaiya kilhaina dinga ahin puilut dingu ahi. Amaho chun sakol ho chunga, sakol kangtalaiho chunga chule sangan chungle sangong sangho chunga hungtou’uva hung ding ahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
English: They shall bring all your brothers out of all the nations for an offering to the LORD, on horses, in chariots, in litters, on mules, and on camels, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says the LORD, as the children of Israel bring their offering in a clean vessel into the LORD’s house.

tcz: Chule keiman amaho lah’a abangkhat chu thempua le Levi mia kalhendoh ding ahije, tia keima Pakaijin kaseisa ahitai.
en: Of them I will also select priests and Levites,” says the LORD.
text:
ISA 66:21
Thadou: Chule keiman amaho lah’a abangkhat chu thempua le Levi mia kalhendoh ding ahije, tia keima Pakaijin kaseisa ahitai.
English: Of them I will also select priests and Levites,” says the LORD.

tcz: Vanthaho le leithah aumden jing ding tobanga chu , nangho jong chu min amangkit theilou kamite nahi jing dingu ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
en: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me,” says the LORD, “so your offspring and your name shall remain.
text:
ISA 66:22
Thadou: Vanthaho le leithah aumden jing ding tobanga chu , nangho jong chu min amangkit theilou kamite nahi jing dingu ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
English: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me,” says the LORD, “so your offspring and your name shall remain.

tcz: Hapta ahapta seh’a chule lhakhatna kona lhakit geija mihem jouse kahenga keima eihou dia hung hung jeng ding ahiuve.
en: It shall happen that from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, all flesh will come to worship before me,” says the LORD.
text:
ISA 66:23
Thadou: Hapta ahapta seh’a chule lhakhatna kona lhakit geija mihem jouse kahenga keima eihou dia hung hung jeng ding ahiuve.
English: It shall happen that from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, all flesh will come to worship before me,” says the LORD.

tcz: Chule amaho chu apotdoh tenguleh hitia hi: Tahsa thisa ho ahin laijuva keima eidou ho chun ahin mu dingu ahi. Ajeh chu amaho vallhuma lungtol ho jong chu thilou hel dingu ahi, chule amaho gou dinga mei jong chu itih’a mit thei talou ding chule lampia hungvah le ho jouse chun kidang asahuva tija ding ahiuve.
en: “They will go out, and look at the dead bodies of the men who have transgressed against me; for their worm will not die, nor will their fire be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind.”
text:
ISA 66:24
