en: Her gates have sunk into the ground. He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not. Yes, her prophets find no vision from the LORD.
text:
LAM 2:9
Thadou: Jerusalem kelkot phung jouse jong tol ah aki jamchap soh helin, akel kot gol jouse jong aheh bongin a sumang soh tai. Jerusalem lengpa leh milen milal ho jong namtin vaipi laha akithe thangsoh taove. Danthu kitila abeitan Themgao hon jong Pakaiya konin mu anei tapouve.
English: Her gates have sunk into the ground. He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not. Yes, her prophets find no vision from the LORD.

tcz: Khopi hoitah Jerusalem sunga lamkaiho tolla thip beh chan atouvun, a lujang uva leivui a kinuvin, khaodip pon akisil un, Jerusalem nungah jousen jum le jachat tothon a kaiku jeng taove.
en: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground. They keep silence. They have cast up dust on their heads. They have clothed themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
text:
LAM 2:10
Thadou: Khopi hoitah Jerusalem sunga lamkaiho tolla thip beh chan atouvun, a lujang uva leivui a kinuvin, khaodip pon akisil un, Jerusalem nungah jousen jum le jachat tothon a kaiku jeng taove.
English: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground. They keep silence. They have cast up dust on their heads. They have clothed themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

tcz: Kamitlhi twi kan tokahin ka kap jingin, ka lungsung achip lhatai. Kholai dunga chapang neocha ho athileh aki saisaijuva, kamite hahsatna khankho ka mu jeh in ka lungthim sung jong akap doh jeng in ahi.
en: My eyes fail with tears. My heart is troubled. My bile is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city.
text:
LAM 2:11
Thadou: Kamitlhi twi kan tokahin ka kap jingin, ka lungsung achip lhatai. Kholai dunga chapang neocha ho athileh aki saisaijuva, kamite hahsatna khankho ka mu jeh in ka lungthim sung jong akap doh jeng in ahi.
English: My eyes fail with tears. My heart is troubled. My bile is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city.

tcz: Anuteu henga, Nehding le donding kangaichai tin athumun. Galsatpa galmunna akimavo bangin, kholai dunga thabeiyin apengun, anu teuvin apom nau chunga ahinkho’u abeithu thu jeng in ahi.
en: They ask their mothers, “Where is grain and wine?” when they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.
text:
LAM 2:12
Thadou: Anuteu henga, Nehding le donding kangaichai tin athumun. Galsatpa galmunna akimavo bangin, kholai dunga thabeiyin apengun, anu teuvin apom nau chunga ahinkho’u abeithu thu jeng in ahi.
English: They ask their mothers, “Where is grain and wine?” when they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

tcz: Hichan geija lungkhamna toh ho chunga ipi kasei thei ding ham? Vo Jerusalem Chanute, na lung hesoh naohi ipitoh kitekah ding ahm? Oh Zion chanu thengte iti ka lhamon jou ding na hiuvem? Ajeh chu nathoh gimnao hi twikhanglen bangin athuh jengin koiham na boldam jou diu vah?
en: What shall I testify to you? What shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Zion? For your breach is as big as the sea. Who can heal you?
text:
LAM 2:13
Thadou: Hichan geija lungkhamna toh ho chunga ipi kasei thei ding ham? Vo Jerusalem Chanute, na lung hesoh naohi ipitoh kitekah ding ahm? Oh Zion chanu thengte iti ka lhamon jou ding na hiuvem? Ajeh chu nathoh gimnao hi twikhanglen bangin athuh jengin koiham na boldam jou diu vah?
English: What shall I testify to you? What shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Zion? For your breach is as big as the sea. Who can heal you?

tcz: Na themgao teuvinla jouthu ngen leh ngolhoi thu ngen na seipeh uvin, na soh chan nauva konna nahung kiledoh theina diuva na chonsetnau phondoh peh ding la ago pouvin, chutia bolsang in jouthu ngen jeng apat thu uvin, thil dihlou ngen na kinep sah jiuvin ahi.
en: Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you. They have not uncovered your iniquity, to reverse your captivity, but have seen for you false revelations and causes of banishment.
text:
LAM 2:14
Thadou: Na themgao teuvinla jouthu ngen leh ngolhoi thu ngen na seipeh uvin, na soh chan nauva konna nahung kiledoh theina diuva na chonsetnau phondoh peh ding la ago pouvin, chutia bolsang in jouthu ngen jeng apat thu uvin, thil dihlou ngen na kinep sah jiuvin ahi.
English: Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you. They have not uncovered your iniquity, to reverse your captivity, but have seen for you false revelations and causes of banishment.

tcz: Ache le avahle ho jousen na nel peh un khopi hoitah Jerusalem hi noise tah in atot chatvei khummun; “hiche hi vannoi leisetna khopi hoipen vannoi pumpin achoi sang uchu ham?” atiuve.
en: All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this the city that men called ‘The perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth’?”
text:
LAM 2:15
Thadou: Ache le avahle ho jousen na nel peh un khopi hoitah Jerusalem hi noise tah in atot chatvei khummun; “hiche hi vannoi leisetna khopi hoipen vannoi pumpin achoi sang uchu ham?” atiuve.
English: All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this the city that men called ‘The perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth’?”

tcz: Nagalmite jousen na nelpeh un noise tah in anop nop na seikhumun, “suhmang dinga phat sottah ina nga’u chu tun ahung guilhung tai!” atiuve.
en: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have swallowed her up. Certainly this is the day that we looked for. We have found it. We have seen it.”
text:
LAM 2:16
Thadou: Nagalmite jousen na nelpeh un noise tah in anop nop na seikhumun, “suhmang dinga phat sottah ina nga’u chu tun ahung guilhung tai!” atiuve.
English: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have swallowed her up. Certainly this is the day that we looked for. We have found it. We have seen it.”

tcz: Ahinlah hiche hi Pakaiyin a tohgon chu aboldoh ahin, hamsetna hunglhung dinga ana gonsa chu a suhbulhit ahi. Aman Jerusalem chu khotona beihella ana suhbei ahin, Aman agalmiteu chu amaho chunga thaneina anapeh ahi.
en: The LORD has done that which he planned. He has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old. He has thrown down, and has not pitied. He has caused the enemy to rejoice over you. He has exalted the horn of your adversaries.
text:
LAM 2:17
Thadou: Ahinlah hiche hi Pakaiyin a tohgon chu aboldoh ahin, hamsetna hunglhung dinga ana gonsa chu a suhbulhit ahi. Aman Jerusalem chu khotona beihella ana suhbei ahin, Aman agalmiteu chu amaho chunga thaneina anapeh ahi.
English: The LORD has done that which he planned. He has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old. He has thrown down, and has not pitied. He has caused the enemy to rejoice over you. He has exalted the horn of your adversaries.

tcz: Khopi hoi Jerusalem, Pakai angah hakan kap in, Sun le jan in vadung bangin na mitlhi long hen. kicholdo hihhel in; Na mitlhi lon jong tansah dan.
en: Their heart cried to the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief. Don’t let your eyes rest.
text:
LAM 2:18
Thadou: Khopi hoi Jerusalem, Pakai angah hakan kap in, Sun le jan in vadung bangin na mitlhi long hen. kicholdo hihhel in; Na mitlhi lon jong tansah dan.
English: Their heart cried to the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief. Don’t let your eyes rest.

tcz: Janlai jong leh thouvin pengjah jengin. Pakai angah na lung ngaichat twi bangin lonsah in. Nachateu dingin na taonao khut chu domsang jing un, ajeh chu kholai dung jousea gilkela lhalhop gamsoh ahitaove.
en: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street.
text:
LAM 2:19
Thadou: Janlai jong leh thouvin pengjah jengin. Pakai angah na lung ngaichat twi bangin lonsah in. Nachateu dingin na taonao khut chu domsang jing un, ajeh chu kholai dung jousea gilkela lhalhop gamsoh ahitaove.
English: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street.

tcz: Vo Pakai hiche thoh gimna hi gel temin! Na chate hi hiti lom lom’a nabol jing ding hitam? Minuten a angsunga hung kitolchem, achateu kisanhi aneh jeng diu hitam? Thempu holeh themgao ho kisan hi Pakai houin sunga kithat jeng ding hitam?
en: “Look, LORD, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held and bounced on their knees? Should the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
text:
LAM 2:20
Thadou: Vo Pakai hiche thoh gimna hi gel temin! Na chate hi hiti lom lom’a nabol jing ding hitam? Minuten a angsunga hung kitolchem, achateu kisanhi aneh jeng diu hitam? Thempu holeh themgao ho kisan hi Pakai houin sunga kithat jeng ding hitam?
English: “Look, LORD, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held and bounced on their knees? Should the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?

tcz: Ven, lamlen dunga kijam chap ho khu – Khangdong le tehseho, Numei chapang holeh pasal chapang ho, Galmite chemjam a thijeng ahiuve. Na lung han petin nathat gamin, Lungsetna beihelin nabol’e.
en: “The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets. My virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have killed them in the day of your anger. You have slaughtered, and not pitied.
text:
LAM 2:21
Thadou: Ven, lamlen dunga kijam chap ho khu – Khangdong le tehseho, Numei chapang holeh pasal chapang ho, Galmite chemjam a thijeng ahiuve. Na lung han petin nathat gamin, Lungsetna beihelin nabol’e.
English: “The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets. My virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have killed them in the day of your anger. You have slaughtered, and not pitied.

tcz: Golvah nikhoa mipi nakou khom bangin, Muntin jousea tijatna nakoukhom’e. Pakai lunghanna nikhon, Koi macha a sohcha le ahingdoh a um poi. Kahin khoukhah le kahin puihoi chate chengse, Galmiten a thatgamsoh heltai.
en: “You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side. There was no one that escaped or remained in the day of the LORD’s anger. My enemy has consumed those whom I have cared for and brought up.
text:
LAM 2:22
Thadou: Golvah nikhoa mipi nakou khom bangin, Muntin jousea tijatna nakoukhom’e. Pakai lunghanna nikhon, Koi macha a sohcha le ahingdoh a um poi. Kahin khoukhah le kahin puihoi chate chengse, Galmiten a thatgamsoh heltai.
English: “You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side. There was no one that escaped or remained in the day of the LORD’s anger. My enemy has consumed those whom I have cared for and brought up.

tcz: Pakai lunghanna tanggolla kon hungpotdoh thohgimna chu keima tahin kamuchet ahi.
en: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
text:
LAM 3:1
Thadou: Pakai lunghanna tanggolla kon hungpotdoh thohgimna chu keima tahin kamuchet ahi.
English: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

tcz: Aman vah jouse daltanin, Muthim laha eipuilut e.
en: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
text:
LAM 3:2
Thadou: Aman vah jouse daltanin, Muthim laha eipuilut e.
English: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.

tcz: Nilhum keijin avel vellin keima dounan ka chunga a khut a lamin ahi.
en: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.
text:
LAM 3:3
Thadou: Nilhum keijin avel vellin keima dounan ka chunga a khut a lamin ahi.
English: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.

tcz: Aman kaphe leh kavun agotsah jenge. Kagu kachang jong a sungoi jengin ahi.
en: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.
text:
LAM 3:4
Thadou: Aman kaphe leh kavun agotsah jenge. Kagu kachang jong a sungoi jengin ahi.
English: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.

tcz: Aman lunggimna leh gentheina eisun khumin chatmo hellin eilha tai.
en: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
text:
LAM 3:5
Thadou: Aman lunggimna leh gentheina eisun khumin chatmo hellin eilha tai.
English: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.

tcz: Aman mithisa ho bangin, Muthim laha eivuiye.
en: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
text:
LAM 3:6
Thadou: Aman mithisa ho bangin, Muthim laha eivuiye.
English: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

tcz: Aman pal eikai khumin, Keima ka jamdoh thei tapoi. Thihkhao gihtahin jong eikan chah e.
en: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.
text:
LAM 3:7
Thadou: Aman pal eikai khumin, Keima ka jamdoh thei tapoi. Thihkhao gihtahin jong eikan chah e.
English: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.

tcz: Keima kapengjah jeng vang'in, Aman ka taona adalten del tai.
en: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
text:
LAM 3:8
Thadou: Keima kapengjah jeng vang'in, Aman ka taona adalten del tai.
English: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.

tcz: Songpal sangtah in ka lampi akhah tannin; Ka lampi eisuh setpeh e.
en: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.
text:
LAM 3:9
Thadou: Songpal sangtah in ka lampi akhah tannin; Ka lampi eisuh setpeh e.
English: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.

tcz: Keima man dingin, Kei le vompi bang in kiselin eichang lei.
en: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.
text:
LAM 3:10
Thadou: Keima man dingin, Kei le vompi bang in kiselin eichang lei.
English: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.

tcz: Aman ka lampia kon in eimanin eimal tel tel in, Hesoh genthei le panpi beiyin eilhai.
en: He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.
text:
LAM 3:11
Thadou: Aman ka lampia kon in eimanin eimal tel tel in, Hesoh genthei le panpi beiyin eilhai.
English: He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.

tcz: Aman athal-pou aloisalin, Keima abidoiyin eineiye.
en: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
text:
LAM 3:12
Thadou: Aman athal-pou aloisalin, Keima abidoiyin eineiye.
English: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

tcz: Ka lungchang laitaha, Athalchang chu a kaplut jenge.
en: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
text:
LAM 3:13
Thadou: Ka lungchang laitaha, Athalchang chu a kaplut jenge.
English: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.

tcz: Kamiten nuisatbepseu kahi tai. Nilhum keijin musetna la eisah khum uve.
en: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.
text:
LAM 3:14
Thadou: Kamiten nuisatbepseu kahi tai. Nilhum keijin musetna la eisah khum uve.
English: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.

tcz: Aman lunggimna jengin eisu dimin, Lungkhamna khacheh khon chu eidon sah e.
en: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
text:
LAM 3:15
Thadou: Aman lunggimna jengin eisu dimin, Lungkhamna khacheh khon chu eidon sah e.
English: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.

tcz: Aman songchang eilhai sahin, vutvai laha eilehluttan ahi.
en: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.
text:
LAM 3:16
Thadou: Aman songchang eilhai sahin, vutvai laha eilehluttan ahi.
English: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.

tcz: Chamna chu eilah mang pehin, Phatthei channa ding chu keidin gelphah ahi tapoi.
en: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.
text:
LAM 3:17
Thadou: Chamna chu eilah mang pehin, Phatthei channa ding chu keidin gelphah ahi tapoi.
English: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.

tcz: Ka loupina nikho akichai tan, Pakaiya ka kinepna jouse jong ahomkiu ahitai, tin kakap jah jeng tai.
en: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from the LORD.”
text:
LAM 3:18
Thadou: Ka loupina nikho akichai tan, Pakaiya ka kinepna jouse jong ahomkiu ahitai, tin kakap jah jeng tai.
English: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from the LORD.”

tcz: Kathoh gimna leh ka lengvaina hinkho hin eisugim thei val jeng e.
en: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
text:
LAM 3:19
Thadou: Kathoh gimna leh ka lengvaina hinkho hin eisugim thei val jeng e.
English: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.

tcz: Ka thohgimna le in le kagentheina hi, seiya seijou hoi ahita poi.
en: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
text:
LAM 3:20
Thadou: Ka thohgimna le in le kagentheina hi, seiya seijou hoi ahita poi.
English: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.

tcz: Ahin hiche hi kahin geldoh teng, Kinepna kanei jou jin ahi:
en: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
text:
LAM 3:21
Thadou: Ahin hiche hi kahin geldoh teng, Kinepna kanei jou jin ahi:
English: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.

tcz: Pakai neingailutna dihtah chun beitih anei pon, Amikhotona jong atangdeh poi.
en: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.
text:
LAM 3:22
Thadou: Pakai neingailutna dihtah chun beitih anei pon, Amikhotona jong atangdeh poi.
English: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

tcz: A kitahna hi longlou ahin, Ami khotona jong jingkah sehin athah jingin ahi.
en: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
text:
LAM 3:23
Thadou: A kitahna hi longlou ahin, Ami khotona jong jingkah sehin athah jingin ahi.
English: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

tcz: Kahinna ka lhagaovin aseijin Pakai hi keima gou ahi. Hijeh chun Ama a kakinepna hi umjing ahije.
en: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
text:
LAM 3:24
Thadou: Kahinna ka lhagaovin aseijin Pakai hi keima gou ahi. Hijeh chun Ama a kakinepna hi umjing ahije.
English: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”

tcz: Pakai ging jingte leh hinna dinga hol jing tedinga phatah ahi.
en: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
text:
LAM 3:25
Thadou: Pakai ging jingte leh hinna dinga hol jing tedinga phatah ahi.
English: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaija konna huhhing na muna dinga thipbeh cha nga hat angaije.
en: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
text:
LAM 3:26
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakaija konna huhhing na muna dinga thipbeh cha nga hat angaije.
English: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.

tcz: Chu leh khan don laiya Ama angsunga kipehlut leh Ami thununna koljon kikhum lut aphai.
en: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
text:
LAM 3:27
Thadou: Chu leh khan don laiya Ama angsunga kipehlut leh Ami thununna koljon kikhum lut aphai.
English: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

tcz: Ama chu Pakaiyin atohsah nomna dung juiyin thipbeh in aching seh in ngah jing hen.
en: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.
text:
LAM 3:28
Thadou: Ama chu Pakaiyin atohsah nomna dung juiyin thipbeh in aching seh in ngah jing hen.
English: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.

tcz: Amaho chun amaijun tollam ngatnu henlang kijammu hen ajeh chu amahon ajona leh akinepna’u dung jui'a amu thei diu ahi.
en: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.
text:
LAM 3:29
Thadou: Amaho chun amaijun tollam ngatnu henlang kijammu hen ajeh chu amahon ajona leh akinepna’u dung jui'a amu thei diu ahi.
English: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.

tcz: Amaho chun a ngei phe bengho chu alangkhat jong dopeh uhenlang agalmi ten anoise nau jong kisan u-hen.
en: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
text:
LAM 3:30
Thadou: Amaho chun a ngei phe bengho chu alangkhat jong dopeh uhenlang agalmi ten anoise nau jong kisan u-hen.
English: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.

tcz: Ajeh chu koi macha hi Pakaiyin apaidoh paipai aum poi.
en: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
text:
LAM 3:31
Thadou: Ajeh chu koi macha hi Pakaiyin apaidoh paipai aum poi.
English: For the Lord will not cast off forever.

tcz: Aman lungkhamna asosahje vang'in ami khotona dimset jeh chun angailutna ahop jinge.
en: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
text:
LAM 3:32
Thadou: Aman lungkhamna asosahje vang'in ami khotona dimset jeh chun angailutna ahop jinge.
English: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai hi milungkham sahle alungthim sunhat peh ahi along lhaina ahipoi.
en: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
text:
LAM 3:33
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakai hi milungkham sahle alungthim sunhat peh ahi along lhaina ahipoi.
English: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

tcz: Mihon gamsunga songkullut hochu akelngoi tol chotpha jongle’u,
en: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
text:
LAM 3:34
Thadou: Mihon gamsunga songkullut hochu akelngoi tol chotpha jongle’u,
English: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

tcz: Hitobang miho chun Pathen douna in midang chan ding dolho lahpeh jongleu,
en: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
text:
LAM 3:35
Thadou: Hitobang miho chun Pathen douna in midang chan ding dolho lahpeh jongleu,
English: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

tcz: Chuleh aman a thutan nauva achanding dol’u thudih chu chansah hih jong leu, hitiho jouse Pakaiyin amu sohkei hilou ham?
en: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
text:
LAM 3:36
Thadou: Chuleh aman a thutan nauva achanding dol’u thudih chu chansah hih jong leu, hitiho jouse Pakaiyin amu sohkei hilou ham?
English: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.

tcz: Pakai phatsah louva koiham thilho hung soh doh na ding thupeh neithei ding chu?
en: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
text:
LAM 3:37
Thadou: Pakai phatsah louva koiham thilho hung soh doh na ding thupeh neithei ding chu?
English: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?

tcz: Chungnungpen Pathen in thilpha le thilse ahin sosah ji hilou ham?
en: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
text:
LAM 3:38
Thadou: Chungnungpen Pathen in thilpha le thilse ahin sosah ji hilou ham?
English: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?

tcz: Chuti ahileh mihon eiho e-chonset jeh uva engbolna e-chan jiuhi i-kiphin thei ding uham?
en: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
text:
LAM 3:39
Thadou: Chuti ahileh mihon eiho e-chonset jeh uva engbolna e-chan jiuhi i-kiphin thei ding uham?
English: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

tcz: Chuti louvin, eihon e-chonnau hi kikhuol’u hitin chuleh Pakai kom’a iki lehei kit lou diu ham?
en: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
text:
LAM 3:40
Thadou: Chuti louvin, eihon e-chonnau hi kikhuol’u hitin chuleh Pakai kom’a iki lehei kit lou diu ham?
English: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

tcz: Eihon e-lung thim ule e-khut’u Van Pathen anga domsangu hitin seiju hite,
en: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
text:
LAM 3:41
Thadou: Eihon e-lung thim ule e-khut’u Van Pathen anga domsangu hitin seiju hite,
English: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.

tcz: Keiho nangma dounan ka chonse tauvin nangman nei ngaidam pouvin ahi,
en: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.
text:
LAM 3:42
Thadou: Keiho nangma dounan ka chonse tauvin nangman nei ngaidam pouvin ahi,
English: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.

tcz: Nangman nalung hanna neibuh lhah khum tauvin chuleh khotona beihelin neidel khumun nei that gam tauve.
en: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.
text:
LAM 3:43
Thadou: Nangman nalung hanna neibuh lhah khum tauvin chuleh khotona beihelin neidel khumun nei that gam tauve.
English: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.

tcz: Mei lah’a na kiselin, katao na’u na kom ahung lhung jou tapoi,
en: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
text:
LAM 3:44
Thadou: Mei lah’a na kiselin, katao na’u na kom ahung lhung jou tapoi,
English: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.

tcz: Nangman chitin namtin laha thet le notthapin nei koitauvin ahi.
en: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.
text:
LAM 3:45
Thadou: Nangman chitin namtin laha thet le notthapin nei koitauvin ahi.
English: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.

tcz: “Ka melmateuvin Keiho dounan thu asei sei jingun.
en: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
text:
LAM 3:46
Thadou: “Ka melmateuvin Keiho dounan thu asei sei jingun.
English: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

tcz: Keiho kichat le tijatnan Ka dimset tauve, Ajeh chu keiho kimana, kisugepa amang thah kahitauve.”
en: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”
text:
LAM 3:47
Thadou: Keiho kichat le tijatnan Ka dimset tauve, Ajeh chu keiho kimana, kisugepa amang thah kahitauve.”
English: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”

tcz: Ka miteu kisuhmang jeh'in, Ka mitlhi’u twilon in along e!
en: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
text:
LAM 3:48
Thadou: Ka miteu kisuhmang jeh'in, Ka mitlhi’u twilon in along e!
English: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

tcz: Kamitlhiu tanglou helin alonge; Tang lou ding ahi,
en: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,
text:
LAM 3:49
Thadou: Kamitlhiu tanglou helin alonge; Tang lou ding ahi,
English: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,

tcz: Pakaiyin Vanna konna ahin vetsuh, Ahin lainatpi tokah un,
en: until the LORD looks down, and sees from heaven.
text:
LAM 3:50
Thadou: Pakaiyin Vanna konna ahin vetsuh, Ahin lainatpi tokah un,
English: until the LORD looks down, and sees from heaven.

tcz: Jerusalem Chanute khankho gelnan, Ka lungthim hi apohkeh ding akisa jing’e.
en: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
text:
LAM 3:51
Thadou: Jerusalem Chanute khankho gelnan, Ka lungthim hi apohkeh ding akisa jing’e.
English: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

tcz: Keiman kasuhset louhel galmin, Vaacha bangin eideljam e.
en: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
text:
LAM 3:52
Thadou: Keiman kasuhset louhel galmin, Vaacha bangin eideljam e.
English: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.

tcz: Kokhuh’a ei nolutun, Ka chunga song eiset khume.
en: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
text:
LAM 3:53
Thadou: Kokhuh’a ei nolutun, Ka chunga song eiset khume.
English: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.

tcz: Ka luchang geiyin twiyin eichupin, “Athi ding kahitai” tin ka peng jah’e.
en: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”
text:
LAM 3:54
Thadou: Ka luchang geiyin twiyin eichupin, “Athi ding kahitai” tin ka peng jah’e.
English: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”

tcz: Ahin kokhuh sunga konin, Pakai, Nangma kahin kouve.
en: I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon.
text:
LAM 3:55
Thadou: Ahin kokhuh sunga konin, Pakai, Nangma kahin kouve.
English: I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon.

tcz: Nangman ka kouna najan, “Kataona nei sanpehin, Panpi ngehna a kataona nei san peh e!”
en: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”
text:
LAM 3:56
Thadou: Nangman ka kouna najan, “Kataona nei sanpehin, Panpi ngehna a kataona nei san peh e!”
English: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”

tcz: Keiman kahin kou chun nangma na hung in “kicha hih in” neiti.
en: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”
text:
LAM 3:57
Thadou: Keiman kahin kou chun nangma na hung in “kicha hih in” neiti.
English: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”

tcz: Pakai nangman ka thutanpa nahin, ka chung thu neiseipehin! Ajeh chu eihuhdoha Nang na hi.
en: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.
text:
LAM 3:58
Thadou: Pakai nangman ka thutanpa nahin, ka chung thu neiseipehin! Ajeh chu eihuhdoha Nang na hi.
English: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.

tcz: Pakai amahon ka chunga i-chan geija thilse abol’u hitam namu sohkeiye, kathu nei kholtohpihin lang, kadihna neitahlang pehin,
en: LORD, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.
text:
LAM 3:59
Thadou: Pakai amahon ka chunga i-chan geija thilse abol’u hitam namu sohkeiye, kathu nei kholtohpihin lang, kadihna neitahlang pehin,
English: LORD, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.

tcz: Ka galmiten kei douna tohgon aneiyu Nangman nahesoh keiye.
en: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.
text:
LAM 3:60
Thadou: Ka galmiten kei douna tohgon aneiyu Nangman nahesoh keiye.
English: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.

tcz: Pakai nangin eitaitomnao na jasoh keijin chuleh ka chunga thilse abolgot hou jong na hesoh keiye.
en: You have heard their reproach, LORD, and all their plans against me,
text:
LAM 3:61
Thadou: Pakai nangin eitaitomnao na jasoh keijin chuleh ka chunga thilse abolgot hou jong na hesoh keiye.
English: You have heard their reproach, LORD, and all their plans against me,

tcz: Ka galmite ka chunga akihou un Keima dounan akihou lhi jingun ahi.
en: the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.
text:
LAM 3:62
Thadou: Ka galmite ka chunga akihou un Keima dounan akihou lhi jingun ahi.
English: the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.

tcz: Amaho khu ven! Atoupetu hihen adinpetu hijongle, keima nuisatna la jeng asaove.
en: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.
text:
LAM 3:63
Thadou: Amaho khu ven! Atoupetu hihen adinpetu hijongle, keima nuisatna la jeng asaove.
English: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.

tcz: Pakai ka chunga thilse abol jouseu hi, Amaho chunga chuhsahin.
en: You will pay them back, LORD, according to the work of their hands.
text:
LAM 3:64
Thadou: Pakai ka chunga thilse abol jouseu hi, Amaho chunga chuhsahin.
English: You will pay them back, LORD, according to the work of their hands.

tcz: Amaho hi lungtahna leh sei ngailouna lungthim penlang, Achunguva sapsetna chuh sah in.
en: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.
text:
LAM 3:65
Thadou: Amaho hi lungtahna leh sei ngailouna lungthim penlang, Achunguva sapsetna chuh sah in.
English: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.

tcz: Achung uvah na lunghanna chuhsah inlang, Pakai vansem ho noi jahin amaho khu suhmang tan.
en: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.
text:
LAM 3:66
Thadou: Achung uvah na lunghanna chuhsah inlang, Pakai vansem ho noi jahin amaho khu suhmang tan.
English: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.

tcz: Sana jong adeite khuta among joutai! Sana hoi pen jong amoljeng tai. Muntheng sunga um songmantam ho jeng, jong lam lhongp dunga athangsoh tai.
en: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.
text:
LAM 4:1
Thadou: Sana jong adeite khuta among joutai! Sana hoi pen jong amoljeng tai. Muntheng sunga um songmantam ho jeng, jong lam lhongp dunga athangsoh tai.
English: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.

tcz: Veuvin Jerusalem chate, Mipha chomtah tahsan hoitah tah sanga mantam jo hochu, Tun leibelho tobang'in aboltauvin ahi.
en: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
text:
LAM 4:2
Thadou: Veuvin Jerusalem chate, Mipha chomtah tahsan hoitah tah sanga mantam jo hochu, Tun leibelho tobang'in aboltauvin ahi.
English: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

tcz: Sialte jengin jong anoute avah jiuvin, ahinla kami Isrealten avah pouvin ahi. Neldi gamma vacha len “Vagonsang” hon achasenteu anahsah lou bangun ama hon jong a nahsah pouvin ahi.
en: Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
text:
LAM 4:3
Thadou: Sialte jengin jong anoute avah jiuvin, ahinla kami Isrealten avah pouvin ahi. Neldi gamma vacha len “Vagonsang” hon achasenteu anahsah lou bangun ama hon jong a nahsah pouvin ahi.
English: Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

tcz: Dangchahin achateu lhei jouse adanga abehden jouve. Achateu gilkelin an aholun, Ahin koiman pehding aneipoi.
en: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst. The young children ask for bread, and no one breaks it for them.
text:
LAM 4:4
Thadou: Dangchahin achateu lhei jouse adanga abehden jouve. Achateu gilkelin an aholun, Ahin koiman pehding aneipoi.
English: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst. The young children ask for bread, and no one breaks it for them.

tcz: An twitah tah ana neji ho chun tun lampi dunga khut don apang tauvin ahi. Phatkhatna vonhoi tahtah anavon ho chun tun thilnen kikholna munhoa neh ding aholun ahi.
en: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills.
text:
LAM 4:5
Thadou: An twitah tah ana neji ho chun tun lampi dunga khut don apang tauvin ahi. Phatkhatna vonhoi tahtah anavon ho chun tun thilnen kikholna munhoa neh ding aholun ahi.
English: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills.

tcz: Kamite chonsetna hi Sodom mite chonset na sangin alenjon ahi. Hiche munna chun hetman louvin suhmangna nasatah anachun koimacha akithopi thei ana umpoiye.
en: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No hands were laid on her.
text:
LAM 4:6
Thadou: Kamite chonsetna hi Sodom mite chonset na sangin alenjon ahi. Hiche munna chun hetman louvin suhmangna nasatah anachun koimacha akithopi thei ana umpoiye.
English: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No hands were laid on her.

tcz: Ka lengteu jong phatkhat chun amel hoidanu chu bongnoi leh buhbang sangin ana bangjon, amai’u jong songmantam bangin ana vah'in ahi.
en: Her nobles were purer than snow. They were whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their polishing was like sapphire.
text:
LAM 4:7
Thadou: Ka lengteu jong phatkhat chun amel hoidanu chu bongnoi leh buhbang sangin ana bangjon, amai’u jong songmantam bangin ana vah'in ahi.
English: Her nobles were purer than snow. They were whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their polishing was like sapphire.

tcz: Tunvang amelu jong meihol sangin avomjoi. Lampi dunga jong koiman ahedoh thei tapouve. Avunu jong agu uva abehdan gamin, thing go bangin, agon atah jenge.
en: Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is withered. It has become like wood.
text:
LAM 4:8
Thadou: Tunvang amelu jong meihol sangin avomjoi. Lampi dunga jong koiman ahedoh thei tapouve. Avunu jong agu uva abehdan gamin, thing go bangin, agon atah jenge.
English: Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is withered. It has become like wood.

tcz: Chamjamma kithat hochu gelkella thiho sangin avangphajo ahitaove. Ajeh chu lou laiya neh aput tahlou jeh'in kelthohin amangthah jitaove.
en: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; for these pine away, stricken through, for lack of the fruits of the field.
text:
LAM 4:9
Thadou: Chamjamma kithat hochu gelkella thiho sangin avangphajo ahitaove. Ajeh chu lou laiya neh aput tahlou jeh'in kelthohin amangthah jitaove.
English: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; for these pine away, stricken through, for lack of the fruits of the field.

tcz: Masanga mi lainatpi theitah tah nute hon achateu chu neh dingin akihon gam tauve. Amahon gim hesoha konna hoi dohna dingin achateu chu ana nejengun ahi.
en: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children. They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
text:
LAM 4:10
Thadou: Masanga mi lainatpi theitah tah nute hon achateu chu neh dingin akihon gam tauve. Amahon gim hesoha konna hoi dohna dingin achateu chu ana nejengun ahi.
English: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children. They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

tcz: Tunvang alunghanna a kon chun Pakai alungna chim tai. Alunghanna hoise tah chu abuhlhah ahitai. Jerusalema lunghanna mei ana kou dohin hichun khopi chu aleibul kiphuna gei chun ana hallha jeng’e.
en: The LORD has accomplished his wrath. He has poured out his fierce anger. He has kindled a fire in Zion, which has devoured its foundations.
text:
LAM 4:11
Thadou: Tunvang alunghanna a kon chun Pakai alungna chim tai. Alunghanna hoise tah chu abuhlhah ahitai. Jerusalema lunghanna mei ana kou dohin hichun khopi chu aleibul kiphuna gei chun ana hallha jeng’e.
English: The LORD has accomplished his wrath. He has poured out his fierce anger. He has kindled a fire in Zion, which has devoured its foundations.

tcz: Leist lengte ahin - Vannoi mite koiman - Jerusalem kelkot sunga galmi alutthei ding chu ana tahsan pouve.
en: The kings of the earth didn’t believe, neither did all the inhabitants of the world, that the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.
text:
LAM 4:12
Thadou: Leist lengte ahin - Vannoi mite koiman - Jerusalem kelkot sunga galmi alutthei ding chu ana tahsan pouve.
English: The kings of the earth didn’t believe, neither did all the inhabitants of the world, that the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.

tcz: Ahinlah a themgao ho chonsetna leh a thempu ho chonsetna jeh chun hiti hin anasohdoh tan ahi. Amaho chonset jeh'a themmona bei miho thisan kisoa, khopi kisuboh ahi.
en: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the middle of her.
text:
LAM 4:13
Thadou: Ahinlah a themgao ho chonsetna leh a thempu ho chonsetna jeh chun hiti hin anasohdoh tan ahi. Amaho chonset jeh'a themmona bei miho thisan kisoa, khopi kisuboh ahi.
English: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the middle of her.

tcz: Amahohi lamlhongpi dunga ana vahle uvin mi thisana akisubohun koiman amaho atong kha ngam pouvin ahi.
en: They wander as blind men in the streets. They are polluted with blood, So that men can’t touch their garments.
text:
LAM 4:14
Thadou: Amahohi lamlhongpi dunga ana vahle uvin mi thisana akisubohun koiman amaho atong kha ngam pouvin ahi.
English: They wander as blind men in the streets. They are polluted with blood, So that men can’t touch their garments.

tcz: Mipiten chemangun tin asamun aboh nahitauve, neitong khahihun atiuve. Amaho gamla tahin ajamun gamchom mite laha avahle uvin ahinlah koiman achensah nom pouvin ahi.
en: “Go away!” they cried to them. “Unclean! Go away! Go away! Don’t touch! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, “They can’t live here any more.”
text:
LAM 4:15
Thadou: Mipiten chemangun tin asamun aboh nahitauve, neitong khahihun atiuve. Amaho gamla tahin ajamun gamchom mite laha avahle uvin ahinlah koiman achensah nom pouvin ahi.
English: “Go away!” they cried to them. “Unclean! Go away! Go away! Don’t touch! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, “They can’t live here any more.”

tcz: Pakai amatahin amaho hi apanpi nom tapouvin muchom chomma athethang gam’u ahitai. Mipihon jong thempuho hi anahsah tapouvin, alamkai hou jong jana anei tapouvin ahi.
en: The LORD’s anger has scattered them. He will not pay attention to them any more. They didn’t respect the persons of the priests. They didn’t favor the elders.
text:
LAM 4:16
Thadou: Pakai amatahin amaho hi apanpi nom tapouvin muchom chomma athethang gam’u ahitai. Mipihon jong thempuho hi anahsah tapouvin, alamkai hou jong jana anei tapouvin ahi.
English: The LORD’s anger has scattered them. He will not pay attention to them any more. They didn’t respect the persons of the priests. They didn’t favor the elders.

tcz: Eihon i-pankhompi houvin eihung huhdoh diuvin ingaichauvin, eikithopi theiloudiu nam mite kom jenga jong panpi ingaichauvin a phachom pon ahi.
en: Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.
text:
LAM 4:17
Thadou: Eihon i-pankhompi houvin eihung huhdoh diuvin ingaichauvin, eikithopi theiloudiu nam mite kom jenga jong panpi ingaichauvin a phachom pon ahi.
English: Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.

tcz: Thiding kichat jeh'in lampi dunga jong kavah le ngam pouvin, amahthah ding nikhou jong ahung naitan, amah thah ding ihitauve.
en: They hunt our steps, so that we can’t go in our streets. Our end is near. Our days are fulfilled, for our end has come.
text:
LAM 4:18
Thadou: Thiding kichat jeh'in lampi dunga jong kavah le ngam pouvin, amahthah ding nikhou jong ahung naitan, amah thah ding ihitauve.
English: They hunt our steps, so that we can’t go in our streets. Our end is near. Our days are fulfilled, for our end has come.

tcz: Igalmiteu hi mulaopi sangin jong aleng hat jon, Molsang chung dunga jammang go jong leuhen eimudohdiu ahin, gamthip langa kisel jong leuhen hiche munna jong chu eina chan nahlai dingu ahiye.
en: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky. They chased us on the mountains. They set an ambush for us in the wilderness.
text:
LAM 4:19
Thadou: Igalmiteu hi mulaopi sangin jong aleng hat jon, Molsang chung dunga jammang go jong leuhen eimudohdiu ahin, gamthip langa kisel jong leuhen hiche munna jong chu eina chan nahlai dingu ahiye.
English: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky. They chased us on the mountains. They set an ambush for us in the wilderness.

tcz: Eihon leiset nam pumpi jouse hoa konna eihuhdoh diuva ina monpiu Pakai thaonu i-engpau jeng jong, akiselna munna konin a mandoh tauvin ahi.
en: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will live among the nations.
text:
LAM 4:20
Thadou: Eihon leiset nam pumpi jouse hoa konna eihuhdoh diuva ina monpiu Pakai thaonu i-engpau jeng jong, akiselna munna konin a mandoh tauvin ahi.
English: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will live among the nations.

tcz: Vo! Edom mite Uz gamsunga hi nakipa theiju hinam? Ahin nangin jong Pakai lunghanna khonna konna hi na don tei ding ahi. Nang jeng jong na jukhamna munna sagoh keova naki koi ding ahi.
en: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, who dwells in the land of Uz. The cup will pass through to you also. You will be drunken, and will make yourself naked.
text:
LAM 4:21
Thadou: Vo! Edom mite Uz gamsunga hi nakipa theiju hinam? Ahin nangin jong Pakai lunghanna khonna konna hi na don tei ding ahi. Nang jeng jong na jukhamna munna sagoh keova naki koi ding ahi.
English: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, who dwells in the land of Uz. The cup will pass through to you also. You will be drunken, and will make yourself naked.

tcz: Vo khopi hoitah Jerusalem, naki engbolna nihko kichai ding ahitai, Naki engbolna gamma konna nahung kile vahding ahitai. Ahinlah Edom naki engbolna hi kipan bepseu ahinalaiye; Nachonsetna ho jouse hung kiphongdoh vahding ahi tai.
en: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion. He will no more carry you away into captivity. He will visit your iniquity, daughter of Edom. He will uncover your sins.
text:
LAM 4:22
Thadou: Vo khopi hoitah Jerusalem, naki engbolna nihko kichai ding ahitai, Naki engbolna gamma konna nahung kile vahding ahitai. Ahinlah Edom naki engbolna hi kipan bepseu ahinalaiye; Nachonsetna ho jouse hung kiphongdoh vahding ahi tai.
English: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion. He will no more carry you away into captivity. He will visit your iniquity, daughter of Edom. He will uncover your sins.

tcz: Pakai ka chunguva thilsoh ho hi hingeldoh temin, ven ichan geija vetset ka chan’u hitam?
en: Remember, LORD, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
text:
LAM 5:1
Thadou: Pakai ka chunguva thilsoh ho hi hingeldoh temin, ven ichan geija vetset ka chan’u hitam?
English: Remember, LORD, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.

tcz: Ka goulo diu chengse hi namchom miho achang tauvin, Ka in ka lou jouseu la gamchom miho’a ahitai.
en: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.
text:
LAM 5:2
Thadou: Ka goulo diu chengse hi namchom miho achang tauvin, Ka in ka lou jouseu la gamchom miho’a ahitai.
English: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.

tcz: Keiho hi nunei lou panei lou kahi tauvin, kanuteu jong meithai ahi gam tauve.
en: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.
text:
LAM 5:3
Thadou: Keiho hi nunei lou panei lou kahi tauvin, kanuteu jong meithai ahi gam tauve.
English: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.

tcz: Ka dondiu twi jeng jong kakichoh thu diuvin aumdoh tan, Ti ding thing jeng jong kakichoh thudiu ahitai.
en: We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us.
text:
LAM 5:4
Thadou: Ka dondiu twi jeng jong kakichoh thu diuvin aumdoh tan, Ti ding thing jeng jong kakichoh thudiu ahitai.
English: We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us.

tcz: Eihin nungdelteuvin eihin phah pai dingu ahitan, Keiho ka haisam tauvin, ahinlah kingahna ding mun ka neipouve.
en: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.
text:
LAM 5:5
Thadou: Eihin nungdelteuvin eihin phah pai dingu ahitan, Keiho ka haisam tauvin, ahinlah kingahna ding mun ka neipouve.
English: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.

tcz: Neh leh chah ning lhinga kanei jouseu, Ka kihinso jou nadiuvin Egypt leh Asssyria khutna ka kipelut tauvin ahi.
en: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
text:
LAM 5:6
Thadou: Neh leh chah ning lhinga kanei jouseu, Ka kihinso jou nadiuvin Egypt leh Asssyria khutna ka kipelut tauvin ahi.
English: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

tcz: Kapu kapateu ana chonseuvin ahinlah amaho athi gamtauve, Hijeh chun amaho chan ding thoh gimna leh engbolna hi keiho chunga achu tan ahi.
en: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.
text:
LAM 5:7
Thadou: Kapu kapateu ana chonseuvin ahinlah amaho athi gamtauve, Hijeh chun amaho chan ding thoh gimna leh engbolna hi keiho chunga achu tan ahi.
English: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.

tcz: Ka sohteu chu tun keiho Pakaiyin apang gamtauvin, ahinlah koima eihuhdoh diu aum pon ahi.
en: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.
text:
LAM 5:8
Thadou: Ka sohteu chu tun keiho Pakaiyin apang gamtauvin, ahinlah koima eihuhdoh diu aum pon ahi.
English: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.

tcz: Gamsun’a pum hatin vai ahop jeh'in thiding kicha pum pumin anneh kakiholun ahi.
en: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.
text:
LAM 5:9
Thadou: Gamsun’a pum hatin vai ahop jeh'in thiding kicha pum pumin anneh kakiholun ahi.
English: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.

tcz: Kel khoh jeh'in ka vousou tapkonga changlhah kikang bangin avom gam tai.
en: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.
text:
LAM 5:10
Thadou: Kel khoh jeh'in ka vousou tapkonga changlhah kikang bangin avom gam tai.
English: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.

tcz: Kagal miteuvin Jerusalema numei ho Judah khosunga nungah khang dong ho kichep nan anei gamtauve.
en: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.
text:
LAM 5:11
Thadou: Kagal miteuvin Jerusalema numei ho Judah khosunga nungah khang dong ho kichep nan anei gamtauve.
English: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.

tcz: Ka lengteu jong akhutpiuvin akhaisangun, Ka lamkaiteu jong noise tahin ei bolpeh tauvin ahi.
en: Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.
text:
LAM 5:12
Thadou: Ka lengteu jong akhutpiuvin akhaisangun, Ka lamkaiteu jong noise tahin ei bolpeh tauvin ahi.
English: Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.

tcz: Gollhang ho chu sumhei goi dingin akaimangun, chuleh pasal chapang ho chu tiding thing aputsahnauva a lonlele jeng tauvin ahi.
en: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.
text:
LAM 5:13
Thadou: Gollhang ho chu sumhei goi dingin akaimangun, chuleh pasal chapang ho chu tiding thing aputsahnauva a lonlele jeng tauvin ahi.
English: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.

tcz: Lamkai ho khopi kelkot ngahin apang tapouve. Khangthahten lam leh la sah abol tapouvin ahi.
en: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.
text:
LAM 5:14
Thadou: Lamkai ho khopi kelkot ngahin apang tapouve. Khangthahten lam leh la sah abol tapouvin ahi.
English: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.

tcz: Kana lam nao chu lung khamna asohdoh tan, Ka lungsunguva kipana abeitai.
en: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.
text:
LAM 5:15
Thadou: Kana lam nao chu lung khamna asohdoh tan, Ka lungsunguva kipana abeitai.
English: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.

tcz: Ka luchang uva konin ka lallukhuhu alhamang gam tai. Ka chonset jeh'un ka chung uva sapsetna achu tai.
en: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
text:
LAM 5:16
Thadou: Ka luchang uva konin ka lallukhuhu alhamang gam tai. Ka chonset jeh'un ka chung uva sapsetna achu tai.
English: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

tcz: Hijeh hin kalungu alhalhop tan chuleh kamit uvah mitlhi adimtan ahi.
en: For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim:
text:
LAM 5:17
Thadou: Hijeh hin kalungu alhalhop tan chuleh kamit uvah mitlhi adimtan ahi.
English: For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim:

tcz: Ajehchu Jerusalem hi akeosehin aki jam tan, Sialten lhat nan anei tauve.
en: for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.
text:
LAM 5:18
Thadou: Ajehchu Jerusalem hi akeosehin aki jam tan, Sialten lhat nan anei tauve.
English: for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.

tcz: Ahinlah Pakai nangma abang na hi jing jeng e, nalal touna chu akhang khangin aum jing e.
en: You, LORD, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.
text:
LAM 5:19
Thadou: Ahinlah Pakai nangma abang na hi jing jeng e, nalal touna chu akhang khangin aum jing e.
English: You, LORD, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.

tcz: Ipi dinga nei suhmil jing nahlaiyu ham? Ipi dinga donlou dai louva neikoi nahlaiyu ham?
en: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?
text:
LAM 5:20
Thadou: Ipi dinga nei suhmil jing nahlaiyu ham? Ipi dinga donlou dai louva neikoi nahlaiyu ham?
English: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?

tcz: O Pakai neikiledohsah kitnun lang nangma komma nei puilut kittauvin! Ka kipanao masa chu neipe kittaovin!
en: Turn us to yourself, LORD, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.
text:
LAM 5:21
Thadou: O Pakai neikiledohsah kitnun lang nangma komma nei puilut kittauvin! Ka kipanao masa chu neipe kittaovin!
English: Turn us to yourself, LORD, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.

tcz: Ahilou leh neipui doh mong mong diu hitam? Ole Ka chunguva nalung hangjing nalai ham?
en: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.
text:
LAM 5:22
Thadou: Ahilou leh neipui doh mong mong diu hitam? Ole Ka chunguva nalung hangjing nalai ham?
English: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.

tcz: Juda mi Babylon gam Chebar vadung pang a sohchang ho lah a kana umna kum somle kumthum alhin kum July 31 lhinni achun van ana kihongin chule Pathen thilmu theina chu kana mui.
en: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
text:
EZK 1:1
Thadou: Juda mi Babylon gam Chebar vadung pang a sohchang ho lah a kana umna kum somle kumthum alhin kum July 31 lhinni achun van ana kihongin chule Pathen thilmu theina chu kana mui.
English: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

tcz: Hiche hi Jehoiachin lengpa asohchan jou kal kum nga lhin kuma chu soh ahi.
en: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,
text:
EZK 1:2
Thadou: Hiche hi Jehoiachin lengpa asohchan jou kal kum nga lhin kuma chu soh ahi.
English: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,

tcz: (Pakaiyin hiche thuhi Buzi chapa Ezekiel thempupa kom a Babylon lenggam Chebar vadung panga aum petna anapeh ahin, chule Pakai khut chu achungah ana kingame)
en: the LORD’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the LORD’s hand was there on him.
text:
EZK 1:3
Thadou: (Pakaiyin hiche thuhi Buzi chapa Ezekiel thempupa kom a Babylon lenggam Chebar vadung panga aum petna anapeh ahin, chule Pakai khut chu achungah ana kingame)
English: the LORD’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the LORD’s hand was there on him.

tcz: Keiman kavet pettah chun Sahlam a kon huipi gopi nasatah ahung kitol kamun, Meilhang lentah masanga kolphe toh kitho a vah pempumin ahunge. Meilom lah a chun meikou aumin, chule meikou lailunga chun khichang tobang meikou vahlap lap aume.
en: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.
text:
EZK 1:4
Thadou: Keiman kavet pettah chun Sahlam a kon huipi gopi nasatah ahung kitol kamun, Meilhang lentah masanga kolphe toh kitho a vah pempumin ahunge. Meilom lah a chun meikou aumin, chule meikou lailunga chun khichang tobang meikou vahlap lap aume.
English: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.

tcz: Meilom lailunga kon chun mihem melput tobang thil hing thei li ahung doh e.
en: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.
text:
EZK 1:5
Thadou: Meilom lailunga kon chun mihem melput tobang thil hing thei li ahung doh e.
English: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.

tcz: Maili leh lhaving li aneiyu tailouvin,
en: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.
text:
EZK 1:6
Thadou: Maili leh lhaving li aneiyu tailouvin,
English: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.

tcz: Akeng hou chu ajangpet in, akengphangu chu bongnou keng to abangin alange.
en: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.
text:
EZK 1:7
Thadou: Akeng hou chu ajangpet in, akengphangu chu bongnou keng to abangin alange.
English: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.

tcz: Alhaving li noicheh a chun mihem ho khut kamu doh e.
en: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:
text:
EZK 1:8
Thadou: Alhaving li noicheh a chun mihem ho khut kamu doh e.
English: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:

tcz: Ahingthei ho lhaving ho chu khat le khat akijop jel cheh in ahi. Khat cheh a chu akipat doh teng leh kihei louvin jangpet in masang lam ngan akijot jiuve.
en: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.
text:
EZK 1:9
Thadou: Ahingthei ho lhaving ho chu khat le khat akijop jel cheh in ahi. Khat cheh a chu akipat doh teng leh kihei louvin jangpet in masang lam ngan akijot jiuve.
English: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.

tcz: Amasang uva chun mihem mai aneiyun, ajetlang uva chun keipi mai aneiyun, aveilang uva chun bongchal mai aneiyun, chule anung lam uva chun muvanlai mai anei cheh uve.
en: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.
text:
EZK 1:10
Thadou: Amasang uva chun mihem mai aneiyun, ajetlang uva chun keipi mai aneiyun, aveilang uva chun bongchal mai aneiyun, chule anung lam uva chun muvanlai mai anei cheh uve.
English: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.

tcz: Khat cheh chun lhaving kijal doh kopni cheh aneiyun, kopn khat cheh chu akijal doh teng ganhing achom khat cheh lhaving chutoh akijop mat jel jengin, chule kop khat cheh chun atahsao akhu chah kheh cheh un ahi.
en: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.
text:
EZK 1:11
Thadou: Khat cheh chun lhaving kijal doh kopni cheh aneiyun, kopn khat cheh chu akijal doh teng ganhing achom khat cheh lhaving chutoh akijop mat jel jengin, chule kop khat cheh chun atahsao akhu chah kheh cheh un ahi.
English: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.

tcz: Amaho chu ipi hijongle lhagaovin alhenpeh nalam ngan ajet aveija kiheidoh lou hellin jangpet in ache pai jeng jiuve.
en: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.
text:
EZK 1:12
Thadou: Amaho chu ipi hijongle lhagaovin alhenpeh nalam ngan ajet aveija kiheidoh lou hellin jangpet in ache pai jeng jiuve.
English: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.

tcz: Ganhing liho chu meihol ampem puma kou abangin, ahilouleh meisel lou vah pempum kide abangin, chule kolphe vah bangin amaho lah a chun aki nungtol akima tollun ahi.
en: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.
text:
EZK 1:13
Thadou: Ganhing liho chu meihol ampem puma kou abangin, ahilouleh meisel lou vah pempum kide abangin, chule kolphe vah bangin amaho lah a chun aki nungtol akima tollun ahi.
English: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.

tcz: Chule ganhing liho chu kolphe vahlap lap bang khun achom le jap jap jeng uvin ahi.
en: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
text:
EZK 1:14
Thadou: Chule ganhing liho chu kolphe vahlap lap bang khun achom le jap jap jeng uvin ahi.
English: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

tcz: Hitia keiman ganhing liho chu kavetna ahileh leiset chunga chun kangtalai kang ho chu akomuva chun kamun kang khat cheh chu amaho khat cheh a achandiu chu ahi.
en: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.
text:
EZK 1:15
Thadou: Hitia keiman ganhing liho chu kavetna ahileh leiset chunga chun kangtalai kang ho chu akomuva chun kamun kang khat cheh chu amaho khat cheh a achandiu chu ahi.
English: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.

tcz: Kangtalai khat cheh chu hoitah a vahsetna song en tobanga kisemin akimun, liho chu abpn uvin kibang cheh akimun, chule amaho chu kibang cheh a kisem ahiuvin kang khat cheh velkol a chu kangni na aneicheh uve.
en: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.
text:
EZK 1:16
Thadou: Kangtalai khat cheh chu hoitah a vahsetna song en tobanga kisemin akimun, liho chu abpn uvin kibang cheh akimun, chule amaho chu kibang cheh a kisem ahiuvin kang khat cheh velkol a chu kangni na aneicheh uve.
English: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.

tcz: Hiche ho chu akitol tengule kihei lou hella gamkai li a achu angat na lam lama chu kihei jeng thei ahiuve.
en: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.
text:
EZK 1:17
Thadou: Hiche ho chu akitol tengule kihei lou hella gamkai li a achu angat na lam lama chu kihei jeng thei ahiuve.
English: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.

tcz: Hiche kang li ho chu sang tah cheh ahiuvin, chule timul tho aumin, chule akang ho kimvel a chun met jeng mit jeng in atom dimsetne.
en: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.
text:
EZK 1:18
Thadou: Hiche kang li ho chu sang tah cheh ahiuvin, chule timul tho aumin, chule akang ho kimvel a chun met jeng mit jeng in atom dimsetne.
English: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.

tcz: Ganhing ho chu ache tenguleh kangtalai kang ho jong chu amaho toh thakhat'in achekhom jiuvin, chung langa alen tou teng uleh akang ho jong chu ache tou jiuve.
en: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
text:
EZK 1:19
Thadou: Ganhing ho chu ache tenguleh kangtalai kang ho jong chu amaho toh thakhat'in achekhom jiuvin, chung langa alen tou teng uleh akang ho jong chu ache tou jiuve.
English: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

tcz: Ganhing ho lhagao chu akang ho a chu uma ahi. Hijeh a chu lhagao chena lam lama chu akang ho le ganhing ho jong che jiu ahi.
en: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
text:
EZK 1:20
Thadou: Ganhing ho lhagao chu akang ho a chu uma ahi. Hijeh a chu lhagao chena lam lama chu akang ho le ganhing ho jong che jiu ahi.
English: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

tcz: Hiche ho chu ache teng uleh akang ho chu che jiu ahin, hiche ho chu adin teng uleh akang ho kinga ji ahi. Hiche ho chu chung langa alen tou tengu leh akanga chu ganhing ho lhagao uma ahijeh chun akang ho chu akipat doh jiuvin ahi.
en: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
text:
EZK 1:21
Thadou: Hiche ho chu ache teng uleh akang ho chu che jiu ahin, hiche ho chu adin teng uleh akang ho kinga ji ahi. Hiche ho chu chung langa alen tou tengu leh akanga chu ganhing ho lhagao uma ahijeh chun akang ho chu akipat doh jiuvin ahi.
English: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

tcz: Aluvum uva kijal doh chu vanthamjol tobang khat akidalin songvalset vah'in avahsetne.
en: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.
text:
EZK 1:22
Thadou: Aluvum uva kijal doh chu vanthamjol tobang khat akidalin songvalset vah'in avahsetne.
English: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.

tcz: Anoija chun ganhing ho lhavingu chu khat leh khat kijop cheh in akijal doh in chule alhaving ni chun atahsau khat cheh chu akhun ahi.
en: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.
text:
EZK 1:23
Thadou: Anoija chun ganhing ho lhavingu chu khat leh khat kijop cheh in akijal doh in chule alhaving ni chun atahsau khat cheh chu akhun ahi.
English: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.

tcz: Alen teng ule alhaving ho gin husau chu keima jah in twitam tah in twipang hattah a atagin ahiloule Hatchungung ogin ahiloule, sepai hon tamtah husa gin bangin kajan ahi. Adin teng uleh alhaving u chu akhailha jiuve.
en: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.
text:
EZK 1:24
Thadou: Alen teng ule alhaving ho gin husau chu keima jah in twitam tah in twipang hattah a atagin ahiloule Hatchungung ogin ahiloule, sepai hon tamtah husa gin bangin kajan ahi. Adin teng uleh alhaving u chu akhailha jiuve.
English: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.

tcz: Alhaving u akhailhah uva adin teng uleh vanthamjol tobang valset chunga kon chun o khat in thu ahin seijin ahi.
en: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.
text:
EZK 1:25
Thadou: Alhaving u akhailhah uva adin teng uleh vanthamjol tobang valset chunga kon chun o khat in thu ahin seijin ahi.
English: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.

tcz: Achung vum'a chun songval duma kisem laltouna tobang khat akimun ahi. Chule hiche laltouna sangtah chunga kitousah pachu mihem lim leh melput tobang ahi.
en: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.
text:
EZK 1:26
Thadou: Achung vum'a chun songval duma kisem laltouna tobang khat akimun ahi. Chule hiche laltouna sangtah chunga kitousah pachu mihem lim leh melput tobang ahi.
English: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.

tcz: Akongbuh akipat akilah dan chu khichang vala meikou olla kimujap bangin akimun ahi. Chule akongbuh noilamse chu meikou tobang'in akimvel vah pempum bangin akimun ahi.
en: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.
text:
EZK 1:27
Thadou: Akongbuh akipat akilah dan chu khichang vala meikou olla kimujap bangin akimun ahi. Chule akongbuh noilamse chu meikou tobang'in akimvel vah pempum bangin akimun ahi.
English: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.

tcz: Gojuh nikho a meilah a lhagui kimu bang khun avah pempum in ahi. Hiche hi Pakai loupina keiman kamu abangin, keiman hichehi kamu phat in kamai tollah kasulut in ahileh ogin khat in keima koma ogin kkhat anasei chu kajan ahi.
en: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the LORD’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.
text:
EZK 1:28
Thadou: Gojuh nikho a meilah a lhagui kimu bang khun avah pempum in ahi. Hiche hi Pakai loupina keiman kamu abangin, keiman hichehi kamu phat in kamai tollah kasulut in ahileh ogin khat in keima koma ogin kkhat anasei chu kajan ahi.
English: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the LORD’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.

tcz: Ogin chun mihem chapa dingdoh in keiman nang koma thu seinom kaneije ati.
en: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”
text:
EZK 2:1
Thadou: Ogin chun mihem chapa dingdoh in keiman nang koma thu seinom kaneije ati.
English: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”

tcz: Aman kajah a thu asei phat chun kasunga lhagao ahung lut in chuin kakeng phang tenin eidiinsah tai. Keiman kajah a thusei ho chu phatechan kangaije.
en: The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard him who spoke to me.
text:
EZK 2:2
Thadou: Aman kajah a thu asei phat chun kasunga lhagao ahung lut in chuin kakeng phang tenin eidiinsah tai. Keiman kajah a thusei ho chu phatechan kangaije.
English: The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard him who spoke to me.

tcz: Mihem chapa keiman nangma hi Israel nam mite keima doumah mah bol nam mite koma kasol nahi. Amaho leh apu apateu hin tuni chanin keima eidou jing uve.
en: He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.
text:
EZK 2:3
Thadou: Mihem chapa keiman nangma hi Israel nam mite keima doumah mah bol nam mite koma kasol nahi. Amaho leh apu apateu hin tuni chanin keima eidou jing uve.
English: He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.

tcz: Amahohi milungtah leh milouchal te ahiuve. Thanei vaihom Pakai chun thu ahin seije ti aseipeh dinga kasol nahi tin eiseipeh e.
en: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’
text:
EZK 2:4
Thadou: Amahohi milungtah leh milouchal te ahiuve. Thanei vaihom Pakai chun thu ahin seije ti aseipeh dinga kasol nahi tin eiseipeh e.
English: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’

tcz: Amahon ngaiju hen lang ngaida jong leu amahohi doumah bol ahiuhi, nahetna hijeh a chu amaho lah hin themgao khat aum jinge ti beh henau vinte.
en: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.
text:
EZK 2:5
Thadou: Amahon ngaiju hen lang ngaida jong leu amahohi doumah bol ahiuhi, nahetna hijeh a chu amaho lah hin themgao khat aum jinge ti beh henau vinte.
English: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.

tcz: Mihem chapa amaho ahiloule athuseiju kicha hih in, ling leh khao thahpi chule midep thei aipi lah a um bang in nagih jong leu kicha hih in. Mitvom letlut a navet tengu jongleh nangma kicha hih in.
en: You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Don’t be afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.
text:
EZK 2:6
Thadou: Mihem chapa amaho ahiloule athuseiju kicha hih in, ling leh khao thahpi chule midep thei aipi lah a um bang in nagih jong leu kicha hih in. Mitvom letlut a navet tengu jongleh nangma kicha hih in.
English: You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Don’t be afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.

tcz: Amahon ngaiju hen lang ngaida jong leu nangman kathusei hi nasei peh ding ahi. Ahinlah amaho hi doumah boljing nom mite ahijeh un kathusei ngai pouvinte.
en: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
text:
EZK 2:7
Thadou: Amahon ngaiju hen lang ngaida jong leu nangman kathusei hi nasei peh ding ahi. Ahinlah amaho hi doumah boljing nom mite ahijeh un kathusei ngai pouvinte.
English: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.

tcz: “Mihem chapa, nakoma ipi kasei ahi phaten ngaijin, doumah mah abol nauva khun jau hih beh in, nakam kan lang chule khat peh peh hi nen”
en: But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat that which I give you.”
text:
EZK 2:8
Thadou: “Mihem chapa, nakoma ipi kasei ahi phaten ngaijin, doumah mah abol nauva khun jau hih beh in, nakam kan lang chule khat peh peh hi nen”
English: But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat that which I give you.”

tcz: Hichun kavet leh vetan khut khat kaheng lama hung kilhung doh chu kamui. Hichun lekhajol khat achoijin
en: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.
text:
EZK 2:9
Thadou: Hichun kavet leh vetan khut khat kaheng lama hung kilhung doh chu kamui. Hichun lekhajol khat achoijin
English: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.

tcz: Alham lhan ahile alangto a thilhahna la ho, lunghemna thu cheng ho, chule manthahna thu kiphongdoh ho jeng dimset kamun ahi.
en: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.
text:
EZK 2:10
Thadou: Alham lhan ahile alangto a thilhahna la ho, lunghemna thu cheng ho, chule manthahna thu kiphongdoh ho jeng dimset kamun ahi.
English: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.

tcz: Ogin khat chun kajah a thu aseijin, “Mihem chapa, ipi hile kapeh hohi nen – hiche lekhajol hi nen. Chuti chun chen lang kathusei ho hi Israel mipi gasei peh tan,” eiti.
en: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”
text:
EZK 3:1
Thadou: Ogin khat chun kajah a thu aseijin, “Mihem chapa, ipi hile kapeh hohi nen – hiche lekhajol hi nen. Chuti chun chen lang kathusei ho hi Israel mipi gasei peh tan,” eiti.
English: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”

tcz: Hijeh chun kakam kakat leh lekhajol eineh sah e.
en: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.
text:
EZK 3:2
Thadou: Hijeh chun kakam kakat leh lekhajol eineh sah e.
