English: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.

tcz: “Hichu oiva set in nen,” atin ahi. Chule keiman kanen ahileh hichu kakamah khoiju lhumin alhume.
en: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it.” Then I ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth.
text:
EZK 3:3
Thadou: “Hichu oiva set in nen,” atin ahi. Chule keiman kanen ahileh hichu kakamah khoiju lhumin alhume.
English: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it.” Then I ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth.

tcz: Hichun kajah a “Mihem chapa Israel mipi ho henga khun chen lang kathusei ho hi amaho gaseipeh tan” tin aseije.
en: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.
text:
EZK 3:4
Thadou: Hichun kajah a “Mihem chapa Israel mipi ho henga khun chen lang kathusei ho hi amaho gaseipeh tan” tin aseije.
English: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.

tcz: Keiman nangma gamdang mi apauvu nangin kahet lou miho koma kasol nahi poi.
en: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel—
text:
EZK 3:5
Thadou: Keiman nangma gamdang mi apauvu nangin kahet lou miho koma kasol nahi poi.
English: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel—

tcz: Ahipoi keiman hetkhah lou miho leh kihoupi hahsa miho koma kasol nahipoi.
en: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.
text:
EZK 3:6
Thadou: Ahipoi keiman hetkhah lou miho leh kihoupi hahsa miho koma kasol nahipoi.
English: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.

tcz: Ahinlah mipite chun kei thusei angainom lou sang uvin ngainom deh pouvinte. Ijeh inem itile apumpiuva hi milungtah te le milouchalte ahiuve.
en: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted.
text:
EZK 3:7
Thadou: Ahinlah mipite chun kei thusei angainom lou sang uvin ngainom deh pouvinte. Ijeh inem itile apumpiuva hi milungtah te le milouchalte ahiuve.
English: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted.

tcz: Ahinlah ven keiman nangma hi amaho tobanga louchal tah leh lungtah tah a kasem nahi.
en: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.
text:
EZK 3:8
Thadou: Ahinlah ven keiman nangma hi amaho tobanga louchal tah leh lungtah tah a kasem nahi.
English: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.

tcz: Sontah pen tah sanga tah jon nachalpang kasem peh e. Hijeh chun amaho khu kicha hih in, ahiloule doumah in chon uhen lunghang tah in nahin ve jong leu
en: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”
text:
EZK 3:9
Thadou: Sontah pen tah sanga tah jon nachalpang kasem peh e. Hijeh chun amaho khu kicha hih in, ahiloule doumah in chon uhen lunghang tah in nahin ve jong leu
English: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”

tcz: Hichun aman abelap in mihem chapa kathuho jouse hi nangma lungchang mong monga longlut masa hen. Nanga ding tumin hicheho chu ngaiphan.
en: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.
text:
EZK 3:10
Thadou: Hichun aman abelap in mihem chapa kathuho jouse hi nangma lungchang mong monga longlut masa hen. Nanga ding tumin hicheho chu ngaiphan.
English: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.

tcz: Chuti chun namite sohchangho koma khun chen lang chuleh amaho gasei peh tan, “Hichehi thanei vaihom Pakai thusei ahi, ngaiju hen lang ngaihih jong leu gabol in,” atin ahi.
en: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.”
text:
EZK 3:11
Thadou: Chuti chun namite sohchangho koma khun chen lang chuleh amaho gasei peh tan, “Hichehi thanei vaihom Pakai thusei ahi, ngaiju hen lang ngaihih jong leu gabol in,” atin ahi.
English: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.”

tcz: Hichun lhagaovin keima eidomsang in ahile keiman kanung langa thilging lutlut husa gin khat kajan ahi. (Pakai loupina chu amun a chun vahchoijin umhen).
en: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be the LORD’s glory from his place.”
text:
EZK 3:12
Thadou: Hichun lhagaovin keima eidomsang in ahile keiman kanung langa thilging lutlut husa gin khat kajan ahi. (Pakai loupina chu amun a chun vahchoijin umhen).
English: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be the LORD’s glory from his place.”

tcz: Hiche ho chu ganhing ho lhaving khat leh khat akijap khah tou gin le amaho noija kangtalai ho ging lullul husa gin chu ahi.
en: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.
text:
EZK 3:13
Thadou: Hiche ho chu ganhing ho lhaving khat leh khat akijap khah tou gin le amaho noija kangtalai ho ging lullul husa gin chu ahi.
English: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.

tcz: Lhagao chun keima eidomsang in eipo mangtai. Keima lunghang tah le lung chih lah lah a kaumin ahi, ahinlah Pakai chu akhut thahattah chun eituh e.
en: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and the LORD’s hand was strong on me.
text:
EZK 3:14
Thadou: Lhagao chun keima eidomsang in eipo mangtai. Keima lunghang tah le lung chih lah lah a kaumin ahi, ahinlah Pakai chu akhut thahattah chun eituh e.
English: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and the LORD’s hand was strong on me.

tcz: Hichun Kebar vadung pang Tel-abib mun a Juda sohchang ho chenna munna chun kahung lhunge, kalung akham val in amaho lah a chun nisagi kaga touve.
en: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv who lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.
text:
EZK 3:15
Thadou: Hichun Kebar vadung pang Tel-abib mun a Juda sohchang ho chenna munna chun kahung lhunge, kalung akham val in amaho lah a chun nisagi kaga touve.
English: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv who lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.

tcz: Nisagi kichaijin Pakaiyin kakoma thu aseitai, aman aseijin,
en: At the end of seven days, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 3:16
Thadou: Nisagi kichaijin Pakaiyin kakoma thu aseitai, aman aseijin,
English: At the end of seven days, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: “Miihem chapa, keiman nangma hi Israel ngah ding kapansah nahitai. Keija konna thu najah tihtih leh mipi ho chu gangtah in gihsal jengin.
en: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.
text:
EZK 3:17
Thadou: “Miihem chapa, keiman nangma hi Israel ngah ding kapansah nahitai. Keija konna thu najah tihtih leh mipi ho chu gangtah in gihsal jengin.
English: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.

tcz: Keiman migiloupa chu thina chan gimna chang ding nahitai tia kaseija, ahialah nangin nagihsal louva ahileh amaho chu achonset naova thiden diu ahitai. Chule athinao themmona a chu nang chung kahin del ding ahi.
en: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.
text:
EZK 3:18
Thadou: Keiman migiloupa chu thina chan gimna chang ding nahitai tia kaseija, ahialah nangin nagihsal louva ahileh amaho chu achonset naova thiden diu ahitai. Chule athinao themmona a chu nang chung kahin del ding ahi.
English: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.

tcz: Nangin nagih salla ahija la amapa chun alung ahei nom louva a chonset jinga ahileh achonset na a chu thiden ding ahitai. Ahinlah nangin keima thu nangai jeh a nahinkho naki huhhong ding ahi.
en: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”
text:
EZK 3:19
Thadou: Nangin nagih salla ahija la amapa chun alung ahei nom louva a chonset jinga ahileh achonset na a chu thiden ding ahitai. Ahinlah nangin keima thu nangai jeh a nahinkho naki huhhong ding ahi.
English: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”

tcz: Michonpha ho chu achonphat nauva konna akihei mang uva akituh oh nao alampiuva kakoi peh akihetmo sah uva ahitah leh thiden diu ahitan, chule nangin nagihsal louva nakoija ahileh achonset nauva thidiu ahitai. Achonphat naoo khat cha jong kigeldoh peh talou diu ahitan, chule themmona chu nachunga kahin lhut ding ahi.
en: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.
text:
EZK 3:20
Thadou: Michonpha ho chu achonphat nauva konna akihei mang uva akituh oh nao alampiuva kakoi peh akihetmo sah uva ahitah leh thiden diu ahitan, chule nangin nagihsal louva nakoija ahileh achonset nauva thidiu ahitai. Achonphat naoo khat cha jong kigeldoh peh talou diu ahitan, chule themmona chu nachunga kahin lhut ding ahi.
English: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.

tcz: Ahinlah michonpha ho chu achonphat nauva konna achonset lou nadiuva nagih salla chule amahon nathusei angai uva achonset dauva ahileh amaho chu hingdoh diu ahi. Chutengleh nangin jong nahinkho nakihuh hing ding ahi.”
en: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul.”
text:
EZK 3:21
Thadou: Ahinlah michonpha ho chu achonphat nauva konna achonset lou nadiuva nagih salla chule amahon nathusei angai uva achonset dauva ahileh amaho chu hingdoh diu ahi. Chutengleh nangin jong nahinkho nakihuh hing ding ahi.”
English: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul.”

tcz: Chuin Pakai chun ituh chah in chule ahin seije, “Kipat doh in lang phaicham langa khun chen chule hiche munna chu keiman najah a thu kaseipeh ding nahi,” ati.
en: The LORD’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”
text:
EZK 3:22
Thadou: Chuin Pakai chun ituh chah in chule ahin seije, “Kipat doh in lang phaicham langa khun chen chule hiche munna chu keiman najah a thu kaseipeh ding nahi,” ati.
English: The LORD’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”

tcz: Hijeh chun keijong kakipat doh in kachetai. Chule hiche munna chun Kebar vadung pang kana mu masat tobang chun Pakai loupina chu kamun hichun kamai tolla kasulut tai.
en: Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, the LORD’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. Then I fell on my face.
text:
EZK 3:23
Thadou: Hijeh chun keijong kakipat doh in kachetai. Chule hiche munna chun Kebar vadung pang kana mu masat tobang chun Pakai loupina chu kamun hichun kamai tolla kasulut tai.
English: Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, the LORD’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. Then I fell on my face.

tcz: Chuin Lhagao chu kasunga ahung lut in kakeng phang tenin eidin sah tai, Aman eihoulim pin kajah a “Chenlang nainsunga nangma chang kot ga kikha khum tan” ati.
en: Then the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.
text:
EZK 3:24
Thadou: Chuin Lhagao chu kasunga ahung lut in kakeng phang tenin eidin sah tai, Aman eihoulim pin kajah a “Chenlang nainsunga nangma chang kot ga kikha khum tan” ati.
English: Then the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.

tcz: Mihem chapa, hiche munna chu nangma khaova naki kanchah a hijeh a chu miho henga nachedoh theilou ding ahi.
en: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.
text:
EZK 3:25
Thadou: Mihem chapa, hiche munna chu nangma khaova naki kanchah a hijeh a chu miho henga nachedoh theilou ding ahi.
English: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.

tcz: Chule keiman nalei chu nadang chunga kabe den sah a hijeh a chu paomo a naum ding amaho chu nasap set thei louding ahi. Ajeh chu amaho khu doumah bolte ahiuve.
en: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be mute and will not be able to correct them, for they are a rebellious house.
text:
EZK 3:26
Thadou: Chule keiman nalei chu nadang chunga kabe den sah a hijeh a chu paomo a naum ding amaho chu nasap set thei louding ahi. Ajeh chu amaho khu doumah bolte ahiuve.
English: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be mute and will not be able to correct them, for they are a rebellious house.

tcz: Amavang keiman thu kaseipeh tengleh nalei kalhap kang peh a thu kasei sah ding nahi. Chutengleh nangin amaho koma chu, hiche thanei vaihom Pakai thusei ahi, nati ding ahi. Koi hileh ngai ding goho chun ngaijuhen amavang angainom louho chun ngaida hen ajeh chu ama chu doumah bolte ahiuve.
en: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”
text:
EZK 3:27
Thadou: Amavang keiman thu kaseipeh tengleh nalei kalhap kang peh a thu kasei sah ding nahi. Chutengleh nangin amaho koma chu, hiche thanei vaihom Pakai thusei ahi, nati ding ahi. Koi hileh ngai ding goho chun ngaijuhen amavang angainom louho chun ngaida hen ajeh chu ama chu doumah bolte ahiuve.
English: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”

tcz: Chule tun, mihem chapa, leisetna kisem cheh lhang lentah khat lan lang namasanga chun koiyin chuche song chunga chun Jerusalem khopi lim semin
en: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.
text:
EZK 4:1
Thadou: Chule tun, mihem chapa, leisetna kisem cheh lhang lentah khat lan lang namasanga chun koiyin chuche song chunga chun Jerusalem khopi lim semin
English: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.

tcz: Khopi hunama akilahpehna lim vetsah in. Koimacha sochatna theilou ding akim vella chun pal kaijin. Akim vella chun melma sepaiho camp leh khopi nakhumna dinga kalbi tobang lampi sangtou keija kisem leh kulpi suhsetna dinga kisem thingtum lentah tah alulam a thih kisem lim semin.
en: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.
text:
EZK 4:2
Thadou: Khopi hunama akilahpehna lim vetsah in. Koimacha sochatna theilou ding akim vella chun pal kaijin. Akim vella chun melma sepaiho camp leh khopi nakhumna dinga kalbi tobang lampi sangtou keija kisem leh kulpi suhsetna dinga kisem thingtum lentah tah alulam a thih kisem lim semin.
English: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

tcz: Chuleh changlhah semna a kimang thihpeh lan lang nang le khopi kikah a chun koiyin. Khopi langa chun heijin Jerusalem khopi hunam a akilah ding nasat ding dan vetsah in. Hiche hi Israel mipi tedinga gihsalna a pang ding ahi.
en: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.
text:
EZK 4:3
Thadou: Chuleh changlhah semna a kimang thihpeh lan lang nang le khopi kikah a chun koiyin. Khopi langa chun heijin Jerusalem khopi hunam a akilah ding nasat ding dan vetsah in. Hiche hi Israel mipi tedinga gihsalna a pang ding ahi.
English: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

tcz: Tun naveilang napang peh a chun lumin lang chule Israel chonsetna chu nangma chung tah a chun koiyin. Amaho chonsetna chu napangpeh a nalup nijat chu napoh ding ahi.
en: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.
text:
EZK 4:4
Thadou: Tun naveilang napang peh a chun lumin lang chule Israel chonsetna chu nangma chung tah a chun koiyin. Amaho chonsetna chu napangpeh a nalup nijat chu napoh ding ahi.
English: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

tcz: Keiman Israel chonset napoh nading ni jathum le somko nanga kona kangaichat ahin – nikhat hi achonset nau kumkhat a kisim ding ahi.
en: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
text:
EZK 4:5
Thadou: Keiman Israel chonset napoh nading ni jathum le somko nanga kona kangaichat ahin – nikhat hi achonset nau kumkhat a kisim ding ahi.

EZK 4:6
Thadou: Hiche jou teng chuleh kile heijin lang najet lang napang peh a chun ni somli sungin lumin – nikhat chu ?Juda chonsetna kumkhatna kisim ding ahi.

en: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.

EZK 4:7
Thadou: Jerusalem hunama akino khumna navet jing lai sungin naban jang kiuvin lumin lang chule khopi manthah nading gaovin seisei jengin.
English: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.

tcz: Hunama nakimatna nikhojat alhin kahsea najet naveija nakihei doh thei louna dinga keiman khao janga kakan ding nahi.
en: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.
text:
EZK 4:8
Thadou: Hunama nakimatna nikhojat alhin kahsea najet naveija nakihei doh thei louna dinga keiman khao janga kakan ding nahi.
English: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.

tcz: Tun chen lang chule suhlou chang, sakol chang, bechang, bekan chang, butun le kolbutun kilah in lang hiche ho chu bel khat sunga hal khomin. Hiche ho chu ni jathum le somko napang lang khat a nalupna phat sunga din changlhah in kisem in.
en: “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.
text:
EZK 4:9
Thadou: Tun chen lang chule suhlou chang, sakol chang, bechang, bekan chang, butun le kolbutun kilah in lang hiche ho chu bel khat sunga hal khomin. Hiche ho chu ni jathum le somko napang lang khat a nalupna phat sunga din changlhah in kisem in.
English: “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.

tcz: Hiche neh leh chah chu ounce get get in tetoh in lang hiche an chu aphat kipe dungjuija nikhatna khatvei bou naneh ding ahi.
en: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.
text:
EZK 4:10
Thadou: Hiche neh leh chah chu ounce get get in tetoh in lang hiche an chu aphat kipe dungjuija nikhatna khatvei bou naneh ding ahi.
English: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.

tcz: Hitia chu twi jeng jong atena a kitetoh aphat kitep dung jui'a atena khat bou nadon ding ahi.
en: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.
text:
EZK 4:11
Thadou: Hitia chu twi jeng jong atena a kitetoh aphat kitep dung jui'a atena khat bou nadon ding ahi.
English: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.

tcz: Sakol changa kisem changlhah chu na anneh dinga nakigon ding ahi. Mipihon avet jing laiju changlhah chu mihem ehgoho meiya kitih chunga chu changlhah chu nakana naneh ding ahi.
en: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”
text:
EZK 4:12
Thadou: Sakol changa kisem changlhah chu na anneh dinga nakigon ding ahi. Mipihon avet jing laiju changlhah chu mihem ehgoho meiya kitih chunga chu changlhah chu nakana naneh ding ahi.
English: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”

tcz: Chuti chun, Pakai chun “Keiman kadel mang nao gentile gam'a chu hitobang a hi chang kisuboh ho Israel ten ahin neh diu ahi,” tin aseije.
en: The LORD said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”
text:
EZK 4:13
Thadou: Chuti chun, Pakai chun “Keiman kadel mang nao gentile gam'a chu hitobang a hi chang kisuboh ho Israel ten ahin neh diu ahi,” tin aseije.
English: The LORD said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”

tcz: Hichun keiman, O thaneipen Pakai hiche mihem ehho manga eiki suboh ding hitam? Ajeh chu hibang hint u masangin kana kisuboh kha hih helle. Kaneo laiya kipat tuni chan ganhing damlouva thi ahiloule ganhing dangin athasa jong kane khah hih helle. Danin aphallou sa jong kane khapoi.
en: Then I said, “Ah Lord GOD! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”
text:
EZK 4:14
Thadou: Hichun keiman, O thaneipen Pakai hiche mihem ehho manga eiki suboh ding hitam? Ajeh chu hibang hint u masangin kana kisuboh kha hih helle. Kaneo laiya kipat tuni chan ganhing damlouva thi ahiloule ganhing dangin athasa jong kane khah hih helle. Danin aphallou sa jong kane khapoi.
English: Then I said, “Ah Lord GOD! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”

tcz: “Ahileh aphai, nangin mihem eh sangin bongeh in kisemiun,” tin Pakaiyin aseije.
en: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”
text:
EZK 4:15
Thadou: “Ahileh aphai, nangin mihem eh sangin bongeh in kisemiun,” tin Pakaiyin aseije.
English: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”

tcz: Hichun aman “Mihem chapa, keiman Jerusalema an kalhahsam sah ding ahi. Hitia chu chingthei tah a kitea chule kicha tah a kine ding ahi. Twi chu avatna kisima kite ding chule mihem hon lungdong tijat pum puma adon diu ahi.
en: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness. They will drink water by measure, and in dismay;

tcz: An le twi lhahsam jeh a mihem ho chu khat khat kikicha to tah a kiveto diu chuke a kigimbol nau phatsung chu hitia chu aman lhum diu ahi,” tin aseipeh e.
en: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.
text:
EZK 4:17
Thadou: An le twi lhahsam jeh a mihem ho chu khat khat kikicha to tah a kiveto diu chuke a kigimbol nau phatsung chu hitia chu aman lhum diu ahi,” tin aseipeh e.
English: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.

tcz: Mihem chapa, chemjam hemtah khat kilah in lang hichu sam chem. man bangin mangin lang nalu jang sam le nanemul vou chaijin. Nasam chu atetohna mang chan hop thum'in kibang cheh in hom khenin.
en: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.
text:
EZK 5:1
Thadou: Mihem chapa, chemjam hemtah khat kilah in lang hichu sam chem. man bangin mangin lang nalu jang sam le nanemul vou chaijin. Nasam chu atetohna mang chan hop thum'in kibang cheh in hom khenin.
English: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.

tcz: Hopthum na chu Jerusalem khopi lim nasem na lailung tah a chun koiyin. Khopi hetman louva kilon khum banga naum jouteng hiche sam chu hal vamin. Hopthuma hop khatma chu Jersualem lim nasem kimvella chun thelha ngimin lang chule chemjamin sat tan tanin. Hop thum'a hop khat achainapen chu huilah a chun the thangin, ijeh inem itile keiman kamite chu chemjama kahin deljam dingu ahi.
en: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.
text:
EZK 5:2
Thadou: Hopthum na chu Jerusalem khopi lim nasem na lailung tah a chun koiyin. Khopi hetman louva kilon khum banga naum jouteng hiche sam chu hal vamin. Hopthuma hop khatma chu Jersualem lim nasem kimvella chun thelha ngimin lang chule chemjamin sat tan tanin. Hop thum'a hop khat achainapen chu huilah a chun the thangin, ijeh inem itile keiman kamite chu chemjama kahin deljam dingu ahi.
English: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.

tcz: Nasam themkhat chu koiyin lang nasangkhol chol monga chun khit in.
en: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe.
text:
EZK 5:3
Thadou: Nasam themkhat chu koiyin lang nasangkhol chol monga chun khit in.
English: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe.

tcz: Hiti chun hicheng lah a chun nasam them khat chu ladoh in lang chule meilah a chun seplut in lang halvam in. hiche amoh chengse a konna chu mei hung jaldoh a chule Israel jouse asuhmang ding ahi.
en: Of these again you shall take, and cast them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it a fire will come out into all the house of Israel.
text:
EZK 5:4
Thadou: Hiti chun hicheng lah a chun nasam them khat chu ladoh in lang chule meilah a chun seplut in lang halvam in. hiche amoh chengse a konna chu mei hung jaldoh a chule Israel jouse asuhmang ding ahi.
English: Of these again you shall take, and cast them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it a fire will come out into all the house of Israel.

tcz: “Hiche hi thaneipen Pakai thusei ahi. Hiche hi Jerusalem khopia ipi ahung lhun ding vetsahna chu hiding ahi. Amachu keiman nampi lailunga chu kakoi ahi.
en: “The Lord GOD says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.
text:
EZK 5:5
Thadou: “Hiche hi thaneipen Pakai thusei ahi. Hiche hi Jerusalem khopia ipi ahung lhun ding vetsahna chu hiding ahi. Amachu keiman nampi lailunga chu kakoi ahi.
English: “The Lord GOD says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.

tcz: Ahinlah aman kachon dan ho leh kadan thupeh ho chu akimvella miho sangin jong gilou jon doumah mah bollin a pang tai. Aman ajui ding kapeh ka chondan thuho leh kathupeh jui ding anom tapoi.
en: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’
text:
EZK 5:6
Thadou: Ahinlah aman kachon dan ho leh kadan thupeh ho chu akimvella miho sangin jong gilou jon doumah mah bollin a pang tai. Aman ajui ding kapeh ka chondan thuho leh kathupeh jui ding anom tapoi.
English: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’

tcz: Hiti ahijeh a chu Pakai thaneipen pan hiche hi asei ahi. Nangho hi nakim vel uva cheng namtin ho sangin nagilou jouvin chule kathupeh ho le kachondan ho jui ding nanom pouve. Nakim vella cheng namtin vaipi ho khantou bangin jong na khangtou jou pouve.
en: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you;

tcz: Hiti ahijeh a chu thaneitah Pakai keima mong mong hi nadouva tua kapan ahitai. Keiman namtin vaipi ho mitmu chang tah a ka engbol ding ahi.
en: therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.
text:
EZK 5:8
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh a chu thaneitah Pakai keima mong mong hi nadouva tua kapan ahitai. Keiman namtin vaipi ho mitmu chang tah a ka engbol ding ahi.
English: therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.

tcz: Thet umtah namilim semthu ho jeh a chu koimacha tu masanga kana engbol khah louhel na tunung jongle kanung bolkit tahlou helna dinga chu ka engbol ding nahi.
en: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.
text:
EZK 5:9
Thadou: Thet umtah namilim semthu ho jeh a chu koimacha tu masanga kana engbol khah louhel na tunung jongle kanung bolkit tahlou helna dinga chu ka engbol ding nahi.
English: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.

tcz: Nulepa ten ahinsao achatesa aneh uva chule chaten ahinga anu apateo sa aneh diu ahi. Hitia chu ka engbolla chule amoh chengse chu huilah a kathei mang ding ahi.
en: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments on you; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.
text:
EZK 5:10
Thadou: Nulepa ten ahinsao achatesa aneh uva chule chaten ahinga anu apateo sa aneh diu ahi. Hitia chu ka engbolla chule amoh chengse chu huilah a kathei mang ding ahi.
English: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments on you; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.

tcz: Dihtah mongin keima kahinge tin thaneipen Pakaiyin aseije. Keiman nangma hi bulhingsetna kasat lhah ding, mkidah umtah namilim ho leh thet umtah nachonsetna ho a kahouin nasuhboh tah jeh a nachunga lainatna jong kamu sah lou hel ding ahi.
en: Therefore as I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you. My eye won’t spare, and I will have no pity.
text:
EZK 5:11
Thadou: Dihtah mongin keima kahinge tin thaneipen Pakaiyin aseije. Keiman nangma hi bulhingsetna kasat lhah ding, mkidah umtah namilim ho leh thet umtah nachonsetna ho a kahouin nasuhboh tah jeh a nachunga lainatna jong kamu sah lou hel ding ahi.
English: Therefore as I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you. My eye won’t spare, and I will have no pity.

tcz: Namite hop thum'a hopkhat chu khopi lailung tah a nat nale gilkella thidiu ahi. Hopthuma hop khat kit ho chu khopi kulpam a melma ten chemjam a asatlih diu ahi. Chule hopthuma hopkhat ma chu keiman ka chemjama kadella huilah a kathe thang ding ahiuve.
en: A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I will scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.
text:
EZK 5:12
Thadou: Namite hop thum'a hopkhat chu khopi lailung tah a nat nale gilkella thidiu ahi. Hopthuma hop khat kit ho chu khopi kulpam a melma ten chemjam a asatlih diu ahi. Chule hopthuma hopkhat ma chu keiman ka chemjama kadella huilah a kathe thang ding ahiuve.
English: A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I will scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.

tcz: Hitia chu kalung hanna kabulhitna chule lungna chima kaum ding ahi. Chule achung'uva kalung hanna tuhtang jou gol hilou chu adailhah tengleh Israel mite jousen lungna chang tah a katom ngaina a konna keima Pakaiyin ajah uva kathusei hi hin hedoh tauvinte.
en: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, the LORD, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.
text:
EZK 5:13
Thadou: Hitia chu kalung hanna kabulhitna chule lungna chima kaum ding ahi. Chule achung'uva kalung hanna tuhtang jou gol hilou chu adailhah tengleh Israel mite jousen lungna chang tah a katom ngaina a konna keima Pakaiyin ajah uva kathusei hi hin hedoh tauvinte.
English: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, the LORD, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.

tcz: Nakim vella cheng namtin vaipi ho le najotpa ho jouse mitmua amangthah sa leh nuijat jat uma keima tah in kahei doh ding nahi.
en: “‘Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.
text:
EZK 5:14
Thadou: Nakim vella cheng namtin vaipi ho le najotpa ho jouse mitmua amangthah sa leh nuijat jat uma keima tah in kahei doh ding nahi.
English: “‘Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.

tcz: Nangma hi mu nuijat nopna, phin lunghang dingle kichat chat um nahungso ding ahi. Nakim vella um namtin vaipi jouse dinga gihsalna nahung hiding, ama ho chun Pakaiyin lung hanga nam khat chu a engbolla chule ahilchahna chu amu diu ahi,” tin Pakaiyin aseije.
en: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, the LORD, have spoken it—
text:
EZK 5:15
Thadou: Nangma hi mu nuijat nopna, phin lunghang dingle kichat chat um nahungso ding ahi. Nakim vella um namtin vaipi jouse dinga gihsalna nahung hiding, ama ho chun Pakaiyin lung hanga nam khat chu a engbolla chule ahilchahna chu amu diu ahi,” tin Pakaiyin aseije.
English: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, the LORD, have spoken it—

tcz: Keiman kella thina thalpi chang nangho sumang dinga kahin kap khum ding nahi. Kellhah chu anmal khat chan geija abei kahsea khoh cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. I will increase the famine on you and will break your staff of bread.
text:
EZK 5:16
Thadou: Keiman kella thina thalpi chang nangho sumang dinga kahin kap khum ding nahi. Kellhah chu anmal khat chan geija abei kahsea khoh cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. I will increase the famine on you and will break your staff of bread.

tcz: Chule kellhah toh kilhonna gamsa ten nahin bullu uvintin, nachateu nachom mang peh diu ahi. Nagam sunga natna le kidouna akungpin pangin chule nangma douna a melma te chemjam kahin choi ding atin keima Pakai kitipan kasei ahi.
en: I will send on you famine and evil animals, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you. I will bring the sword on you. I, the LORD, have spoken it.’”
text:
EZK 5:17
Thadou: Chule kellhah toh kilhonna gamsa ten nahin bullu uvintin, nachateu nachom mang peh diu ahi. Nagam sunga natna le kidouna akungpin pangin chule nangma douna a melma te chemjam kahin choi ding atin keima Pakai kitipan kasei ahi.
English: I will send on you famine and evil animals, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you. I will bring the sword on you. I, the LORD, have spoken it.’”

tcz: Pakai thusei kahenga ahung lhung kit in,
en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 6:1
Thadou: Pakai thusei kahenga ahung lhung kit in,
English: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: “Mihem chapa, kiheiyin lang Israel molsang lang khu namai ngat in lang ama ho dounan gao thu seijin.
en: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,
text:
EZK 6:2
Thadou: “Mihem chapa, kiheiyin lang Israel molsang lang khu namai ngat in lang ama ho dounan gao thu seijin.
English: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,

tcz: Israel molsang ho douna a Thaneipen Pakaija kon thu kisei hi lhangsapin. Hiche hi thaneipen Pakai thusei ahi. Molsang ho leh molho chuleh komtong laileh phaicham ho keiman Pathen houlou ho muntheng ho a ahal halla suchip dinga nachunga gal kahin pohlut ding tin aseije.
en: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.
text:
EZK 6:3
Thadou: Israel molsang ho douna a Thaneipen Pakaija kon thu kisei hi lhangsapin. Hiche hi thaneipen Pakai thusei ahi. Molsang ho leh molho chuleh komtong laileh phaicham ho keiman Pathen houlou ho muntheng ho a ahal halla suchip dinga nachunga gal kahin pohlut ding tin aseije.
English: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.

tcz: Namaicham jouseu kisusea chule na Pathen hounau mun jouse kisumang ding ahi, namilim doi hou masanga namiho katha katha ding ahi.
en: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols.
text:
EZK 6:4
Thadou: Namaicham jouseu kisusea chule na Pathen hounau mun jouse kisumang ding ahi, namilim doi hou masanga namiho katha katha ding ahi.
English: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

tcz: Nami thilong hou chu namilim doi masang a kajam ding chule nagubuh hou chu na maicham kimvella kathethang ding ahi.
en: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.
text:
EZK 6:5
Thadou: Nami thilong hou chu namilim doi masang a kajam ding chule nagubuh hou chu na maicham kimvella kathethang ding ahi.
English: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.

tcz: Hoilaimun hijongle nachenna mun jouse chu mi chen louna mun hintin, chule keiman na Pathen houna muntheng jong kasuh mang peh ding nahi. Namaicham ho jouseu kisusea namillim doiho kitat chip a namilim houna mun jouse kiloi chim ding, chule houlam thua tup le doi nasem jouseu jong kisumang ding ahi.
en: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
text:
EZK 6:6
Thadou: Hoilaimun hijongle nachenna mun jouse chu mi chen louna mun hintin, chule keiman na Pathen houna muntheng jong kasuh mang peh ding nahi. Namaicham ho jouseu kisusea namillim doiho kitat chip a namilim houna mun jouse kiloi chim ding, chule houlam thua tup le doi nasem jouseu jong kisumang ding ahi.
English: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

tcz: Hiche mun chu thilhong ho hung thangdeh duh ding chutah le nangman keima changseh hi Pakai kiti chu kahi ti nahin hetdoh ding ahi.
en: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
text:
EZK 6:7
Thadou: Hiche mun chu thilhong ho hung thangdeh duh ding chutah le nangman keima changseh hi Pakai kiti chu kahi ti nahin hetdoh ding ahi.
English: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

tcz: Ahinvang keiman kamite phabep khat hiche suhgamna a konna hi kasochat sah ding chuleh amaho vannoija namtin vaipi ho lah a kithethang diu ahi.
en: “‘“Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.
text:
EZK 6:8
Thadou: Ahinvang keiman kamite phabep khat hiche suhgamna a konna hi kasochat sah ding chuleh amaho vannoija namtin vaipi ho lah a kithethang diu ahi.
English: “‘“Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.

tcz: Chutia chu amaho namtin vaipi ho lah a hi akidelmang teng ule amahon eihin geldoh diu ahi. Alungthim u tahsan aum lounau le milim doi angaichat nau mitvet jeh a hahsat genthei athoh u ahi ahetdoh dingu ahi. Hitia chu achaina leh kidah umtah'a achonset nau jeh a amaho leh amaho hung kideimo diu ahi.
en: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols. Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
text:
EZK 6:9
Thadou: Chutia chu amaho namtin vaipi ho lah a hi akidelmang teng ule amahon eihin geldoh diu ahi. Alungthim u tahsan aum lounau le milim doi angaichat nau mitvet jeh a hahsat genthei athoh u ahi ahetdoh dingu ahi. Hitia chu achaina leh kidah umtah'a achonset nau jeh a amaho leh amaho hung kideimo diu ahi.
English: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols. Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

tcz: Amahon keima changseh hi Pakai kahi ti ahin het uva chuleh keiman hitia hi vangsetna kahin pohlut khum ding ahi tia tomngai tah a kasei thu hin aphetdoh diu ahi.
en: They will know that I am the LORD. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.”’
text:
EZK 6:10
Thadou: Amahon keima changseh hi Pakai kahi ti ahin het uva chuleh keiman hitia hi vangsetna kahin pohlut khum ding ahi tia tomngai tah a kasei thu hin aphetdoh diu ahi.
English: They will know that I am the LORD. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.”’

tcz: Hiche hi thaneipen Pakai thusei ahi. Kichat chat um'in nakhut beng inlang nakeng kho tat in, Israel mipite kidah um chonset ana boldoh hou jouseu jeh in kap jengin, tua hi amaho galla kel lha a chuleh natna a thiding ahiuve.
en: “The Lord GOD says: ‘Strike with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, “Alas!”, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they will fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
text:
EZK 6:11
Thadou: Hiche hi thaneipen Pakai thusei ahi. Kichat chat um'in nakhut beng inlang nakeng kho tat in, Israel mipite kidah um chonset ana boldoh hou jouseu jeh in kap jengin, tua hi amaho galla kel lha a chuleh natna a thiding ahiuve.
English: “The Lord GOD says: ‘Strike with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, “Alas!”, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they will fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

tcz: Natna hise chun gamla tah a kidelmang ho chu ahin lhun khuma thudiu, anaija umho chu galla thidiu ahi. Chule koitobang khat a hing galkai ana umjongleh kel in atha ding ahi, hijeh a chu achung uva kahin manchai ding ahi.
en: He who is far off will die of the pestilence. He who is near will fall by the sword. He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine. Thus I will accomplish my wrath on them.
text:
EZK 6:12
Thadou: Natna hise chun gamla tah a kidelmang ho chu ahin lhun khuma thudiu, anaija umho chu galla thidiu ahi. Chule koitobang khat a hing galkai ana umjongleh kel in atha ding ahi, hijeh a chu achung uva kahin manchai ding ahi.
English: He who is far off will die of the pestilence. He who is near will fall by the sword. He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine. Thus I will accomplish my wrath on them.

tcz: Molsang ho leh molho chule thingna, thingphungna engnoi tin leh thingphung lim jousea amilim doi hou leh amai houva milim doihou kilhai thilto atonau munho a mikithatsa ahung kithethang tengleh keima hi Pakai kahi ti ahin hetdoh diu ahi.
en: You will know that I am the LORD when their slain men are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak—the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols.
text:
EZK 6:13
Thadou: Molsang ho leh molho chule thingna, thingphungna engnoi tin leh thingphung lim jousea amilim doi hou leh amai houva milim doihou kilhai thilto atonau munho a mikithatsa ahung kithethang tengleh keima hi Pakai kahi ti ahin hetdoh diu ahi.
English: You will know that I am the LORD when their slain men are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak—the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols.

tcz: Lhanglang gammang a patna sahlang Riblah chan geija konna amaho hi kasuh keh a chu khopi jong ahom keuva kalha ding ahi. Hitia chu amahon keima hi Pakai kahi ti ahin hetdoh dingu ahi.
en: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
text:
EZK 6:14
Thadou: Lhanglang gammang a patna sahlang Riblah chan geija konna amaho hi kasuh keh a chu khopi jong ahom keuva kalha ding ahi. Hitia chu amahon keima hi Pakai kahi ti ahin hetdoh dingu ahi.
English: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

tcz: Hiti chun Pakaija thusei hiche hi kahenga ahungin hitina aseije.
en: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 7:1
Thadou: Hiti chun Pakaija thusei hiche hi kahenga ahungin hitina aseije.
English: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: “Mihem chapa hiche hi Israelte chungchang thudolla thaneipen Pakai thusei ahi. Hoilai mun hijong leh solam lhumlam sahlang ahilouleh lhanglang nagamsung navetna jouse chu abei ahitan, hiche laihi akichaina ahitai.
en: “You, son of man, the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.
text:
EZK 7:2
Thadou: “Mihem chapa hiche hi Israelte chungchang thudolla thaneipen Pakai thusei ahi. Hoilai mun hijong leh solam lhumlam sahlang ahilouleh lhanglang nagamsung navetna jouse chu abei ahitan, hiche laihi akichaina ahitai.
English: “You, son of man, the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.

tcz: Kinepna ho beisoh a ahitai. Ijeh inem itile keiman nangma douna a kalungsat kahin bulhah a kidah umtah nachonsetna ho chengse thudolla kingaito dinga kakou ding nahi.
en: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.
text:
EZK 7:3
Thadou: Kinepna ho beisoh a ahitai. Ijeh inem itile keiman nangma douna a kalungsat kahin bulhah a kidah umtah nachonsetna ho chengse thudolla kingaito dinga kakou ding nahi.
English: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

tcz: Keiman kamit teni kahei manga chule lainatna him him kamusah tahlou ding, kidah umtah nachonsetna ho jouse jeh a kale thuhding nahi.
en: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’
text:
EZK 7:4
Thadou: Keiman kamit teni kahei manga chule lainatna him him kamusah tahlou ding, kidah umtah nachonsetna ho jouse jeh a kale thuhding nahi.
English: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’

tcz: Hiche hi thuneipen Pakai thusei ahi, manthahna khatchunga manthahna nalampi a ahung lhunge.
en: “The Lord GOD says: ‘A disaster! A unique disaster! Behold, it comes.
text:
EZK 7:5
Thadou: Hiche hi thuneipen Pakai thusei ahi, manthahna khatchunga manthahna nalampi a ahung lhunge.
English: “The Lord GOD says: ‘A disaster! A unique disaster! Behold, it comes.

tcz: Achaina chu hunga ahitai. Akhonna keija hung lhung ahin, namanthah ding akhon na chun na ngai ahi.
en: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes.
text:
EZK 7:6
Thadou: Achaina chu hunga ahitai. Akhonna keija hung lhung ahin, namanthah ding akhon na chun na ngai ahi.
English: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes.

tcz: O Israel mipite na kisuh mang nadiu jing kola hung kikeuve, phat achu ahung lhunga ahitan, hesoh genthei nikho ahung naije, molsang ho chung dunga chun kipana hilouhel lungnatna ogin thong akijan ahi.
en: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.
text:
EZK 7:7
Thadou: O Israel mipite na kisuh mang nadiu jing kola hung kikeuve, phat achu ahung lhunga ahitan, hesoh genthei nikho ahung naije, molsang ho chung dunga chun kipana hilouhel lungnatna ogin thong akijan ahi.
English: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.

tcz: Khongaisot louhella kalungsatna le kalung hanna nangma douna a kahin lhadoh a kahin buh lhah khum ding nahi. Kidah umtah na chonsetna ho chungchang kingaito diinga kahin kou ding nahi.
en: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.
text:
EZK 7:8
Thadou: Khongaisot louhella kalungsatna le kalung hanna nangma douna a kahin lhadoh a kahin buh lhah khum ding nahi. Kidah umtah na chonsetna ho chungchang kingaito diinga kahin kou ding nahi.
English: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

tcz: Keiman kamit teni kahei manga chule lainatna him him kamusah tah louding, kidah umtah nachonsetna ho jouse jeh a kalethuh ding chuteng thilse nahin dengpa chu Pakai kahi ti nangman nahin hetdoh ding ahi.
en: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, the LORD, strike.
text:
EZK 7:9
Thadou: Keiman kamit teni kahei manga chule lainatna him him kamusah tah louding, kidah umtah nachonsetna ho jouse jeh a kalethuh ding chuteng thilse nahin dengpa chu Pakai kahi ti nangman nahin hetdoh ding ahi.
English: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, the LORD, strike.

tcz: Thu kitan nading nikho chu hilaija aume, namanthah nadiu chun nangah jinge, mihemte naphatloouna le akiletsahna chu pahcha pah lhingset in apah lhatai.
en: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.
text:
EZK 7:10
Thadou: Thu kitan nading nikho chu hilaija aume, namanthah nadiu chun nangah jinge, mihemte naphatloouna le akiletsahna chu pahcha pah lhingset in apah lhatai.
English: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.

tcz: Alunghan nao hoisetah chu thihjol bangin khang doh in hichun aphat lounau jeh a ahin jep diu ahi. Hiche miphalou leh migilou te hi khatcha sohcha lou hel diu ahi. Anei agou jouseu leh aloupinao jouse kitheh ngim hel ding ahi.
en: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.
text:
EZK 7:11
Thadou: Alunghan nao hoisetah chu thihjol bangin khang doh in hichun aphat lounau jeh a ahin jep diu ahi. Hiche miphalou leh migilou te hi khatcha sohcha lou hel diu ahi. Anei agou jouseu leh aloupinao jouse kitheh ngim hel ding ahi.
English: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.

tcz: Henge aphat chu hung lhunga ahitai, nikho chu hilaija aume, thilcho ho jong aphatchom nau jeh in kipa dau hen, chuleh thiljoh ho jong aman amulou jeh un lunggim dau hen. Ijeh inem itile abonchauva kalung hanna hoise tah noija lhulham sohkei diu ahi.
en: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.
text:
EZK 7:12
Thadou: Henge aphat chu hung lhunga ahitai, nikho chu hilaija aume, thilcho ho jong aphatchom nau jeh in kipa dau hen, chuleh thiljoh ho jong aman amulou jeh un lunggim dau hen. Ijeh inem itile abonchauva kalung hanna hoise tah noija lhulham sohkei diu ahi.
English: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.

tcz: Kivei miho chu ana sohcha mama jong leu asumkol veinau munna chu amaho kile kit louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pathen lunghanna chu amichang cheh chunga kimangcha ding ahin, kikhel kit louhel ding ahi.
en: For the seller won’t return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it. None will return. None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
text:
EZK 7:13
Thadou: Kivei miho chu ana sohcha mama jong leu asumkol veinau munna chu amaho kile kit louhel diu ahi. Ajeh chu Pathen lunghanna chu amichang cheh chunga kimangcha ding ahin, kikhel kit louhel ding ahi.
English: For the seller won’t return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it. None will return. None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

tcz: Sumkon gin chun Israel sepai ho chu galsat dinga kigo din ahin kouvin koimachan angai pouve. Ajeh chu kalungsatna chu amaho jouse douna chu ahi,” ati.
en: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude.
text:
EZK 7:14
Thadou: Sumkon gin chun Israel sepai ho chu galsat dinga kigo din ahin kouvin koimachan angai pouve. Ajeh chu kalungsatna chu amaho jouse douna chu ahi,” ati.
English: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude.

tcz: Khopi polamah gal kidou aumin asunga gamna hise leh kel alange. Khopi kulpi polama umho melma chemjam in athauva khopi sunga umho chu gamna hise leh kella thidiu ahi.
en: “‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. He who is in the field will die by the sword. He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence.
text:
EZK 7:15
Thadou: Khopi polamah gal kidou aumin asunga gamna hise leh kel alange. Khopi kulpi polama umho melma chemjam in athauva khopi sunga umho chu gamna hise leh kella thidiu ahi.
English: “‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. He who is in the field will die by the sword. He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence.

tcz: Molsang ho chung lama kiseldoh a hing ho chu vakhu ho banga achonsetnau akapi dingu ahi.
en: But of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, everyone in his iniquity.
text:
EZK 7:16
Thadou: Molsang ho chung lama kiseldoh a hing ho chu vakhu ho banga achonsetnau akapi dingu ahi.
English: But of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, everyone in his iniquity.

tcz: Akhut jouseu thabeijin hung kikhaijin tin akhup jouseu twi bangin hung nem gam tante.
en: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.
text:
EZK 7:17
Thadou: Akhut jouseu thabeijin hung kikhaijin tin akhup jouseu twi bangin hung nem gam tante.
English: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.

tcz: Amaho khaodip pon in kivon untin kichat um leh jachatna in atom khum diu ahi. Lung hesoh leh chonsetna jeh a lung kisih pumma alujang sammu akivochai dingu ahi.
en: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.
text:
EZK 7:18
Thadou: Amaho khaodip pon in kivon untin kichat um leh jachatna in atom khum diu ahi. Lung hesoh leh chonsetna jeh a lung kisih pumma alujang sammu akivochai dingu ahi.
English: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.

tcz: Amahon asumu lamlena aselhah diu, thilse man nei tobanga abol diu ahi. Pakai lunghan nikho chule adangka hou le asana hou vin huhdoh jou pouvinte. Hiche ho chun lungchamna ahilouleh vahva thei tapouvinte. Ajeh chu akiloset nau chun akipal lhuhsah gamu ahitai.
en: They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath. They won’t satisfy their souls or fill their bellies; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.
text:
EZK 7:19
Thadou: Amahon asumu lamlena aselhah diu, thilse man nei tobanga abol diu ahi. Pakai lunghan nikho chule adangka hou le asana hou vin huhdoh jou pouvinte. Hiche ho chun lungchamna ahilouleh vahva thei tapouvinte. Ajeh chu akiloset nau chun akipal lhuhsah gamu ahitai.
English: They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath. They won’t satisfy their souls or fill their bellies; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.

tcz: Amaho akijep nai hoitah tah jeh chun akiloupi sah un chule hiche ho chu kidah umtah milim semna leh kidah um milim ho semnan amang uve. Hiche ho jeh a chu keiman anei agou hou chu amaho dinga deimo um kahisah peh diu ahi.
en: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.
text:
EZK 7:20
Thadou: Amaho akijep nai hoitah tah jeh chun akiloupi sah un chule hiche ho chu kidah umtah milim semna leh kidah um milim ho semnan amang uve. Hiche ho jeh a chu keiman anei agou hou chu amaho dinga deimo um kahisah peh diu ahi.
English: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.

tcz: Keiman amaho hi gal thil kichom banga gamdang miho kapeh doh ding, nam gilou pen pen te khut a kapeh doh a chule amahon asuh thang dingu ahi.
en: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it.
text:
EZK 7:21
Thadou: Keiman amaho hi gal thil kichom banga gamdang miho kapeh doh ding, nam gilou pen pen te khut a kapeh doh a chule amahon asuh thang dingu ahi.
English: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it.

tcz: Keiman amaho a konna kamit teni kahei manga gucha michom ho chin dellut khum uva chuleh kagou chin gam chu asuhthang diu ahi.
en: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.
text:
EZK 7:22
Thadou: Keiman amaho a konna kamit teni kahei manga gucha michom ho chin dellut khum uva chuleh kagou chin gam chu asuhthang diu ahi.
English: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.

tcz: Kamite dingin kihenna ding thihchao gontup san koijun, ajeh chu gamsung hi tijat kichat umtah dan suhkeh nan thisan adip soh tai. Jerusalem hi ahat kivetna pumhatna kinoto nana dip letset ahitai.
en: “‘Make chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
text:
EZK 7:23
Thadou: Kamite dingin kihenna ding thihchao gontup san koijun, ajeh chu gamsung hi tijat kichat umtah dan suhkeh nan thisan adip soh tai. Jerusalem hi ahat kivetna pumhatna kinoto nana dip letset ahitai.
English: “‘Make chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

tcz: Keiman achennau inho a cheng dinga namtin lah a lungsetna him him neiloute chu kahin puilut ding ahi. Keiman akiloupi sah nau khopi kulpi pal ho kasuhchim a chuleh amuntheng ho kasuhboh ding ahi.
en: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned.
text:
EZK 7:24
Thadou: Keiman achennau inho a cheng dinga namtin lah a lungsetna him him neiloute chu kahin puilut ding ahi. Keiman akiloupi sah nau khopi kulpi pal ho kasuhchim a chuleh amuntheng ho kasuhboh ding ahi.
English: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned.

tcz: Kichat tijatna khohtah leh kithing thinga umna chun kamite ahin lhunkhum teng ule, amahon cham leh lungmonna ahol diu, ahinlah amudoh lou diu ahi.
en: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.
text:
EZK 7:25
Thadou: Kichat tijatna khohtah leh kithing thinga umna chun kamite ahin lhunkhum teng ule, amahon cham leh lungmonna ahol diu, ahinlah amudoh lou diu ahi.
English: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.

tcz: Vangsetna chunga vangsetnan hinjui intin, thuthang khat chunga thuthang khat in hin juijinte. Amahon themgao ho a kon in mu neina holun ahinlah panna bei hiding ahi. Amahon thempu ho a konna kihilna ding imacha achangpouvin, chule alamkai houva konin kithumopna aum tapoi.
en: Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor will be on rumor. They will seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.
text:
EZK 7:26
Thadou: Vangsetna chunga vangsetnan hinjui intin, thuthang khat chunga thuthang khat in hin juijinte. Amahon themgao ho a kon in mu neina holun ahinlah panna bei hiding ahi. Amahon thempu ho a konna kihilna ding imacha achangpouvin, chule alamkai houva konin kithumopna aum tapoi.
English: Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor will be on rumor. They will seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

tcz: Lengpa ahin leng chapa ahin, kithopi ding beijin adingun, kinepna ding beijin akap uve. Chuleh mipiho khut chu kichat in akithing thing uve. Midang chunga athilse bol hou keiman achung'uva kahin lhut khum ding, chuleh amahon hausatah a ana khol khom chengseu chu amaho ki engbolna dinga akisan diu ahi. Hitia chu amaho keima hi Pakai kahi ti ahin hetdoh dingu ahi.”
en: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
text:
EZK 7:27
Thadou: Lengpa ahin leng chapa ahin, kithopi ding beijin adingun, kinepna ding beijin akap uve. Chuleh mipiho khut chu kichat in akithing thing uve. Midang chunga athilse bol hou keiman achung'uva kahin lhut khum ding, chuleh amahon hausatah a ana khol khom chengseu chu amaho ki engbolna dinga akisan diu ahi. Hitia chu amaho keima hi Pakai kahi ti ahin hetdoh dingu ahi.”
English: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

tcz: Jehoiachin lengpa sohchan kal kumgup lhin kum, lhalam som le sagi nikhon Juda lamkai ho kain a ana um pet un thaneitah Pakai chun eina tuhchah e.
en: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord GOD’s hand fell on me there.
text:
EZK 8:1
Thadou: Jehoiachin lengpa sohchan kal kumgup lhin kum, lhalam som le sagi nikhon Juda lamkai ho kain a ana um pet un thaneitah Pakai chun eina tuhchah e.
English: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord GOD’s hand fell on me there.

tcz: Mihem put tobang pu gongso khat kamui, kathilmu pa kongbuh noilam chu akilangin, amapa chu meikong toh abange. Akongbuh a pat achunglang chu khisong valla val meikou ol a kimu jap jap bangin akimui.
en: Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire—from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire, and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.
text:
EZK 8:2
Thadou: Mihem put tobang pu gongso khat kamui, kathilmu pa kongbuh noilam chu akilangin, amapa chu meikong toh abange. Akongbuh a pat achunglang chu khisong valla val meikou ol a kimu jap jap bangin akimui.
English: Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire—from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire, and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.

tcz: Amapa chunk hut toh kilou khat ahin lhang doh in kasamin eihin manne. Hichun lhagaovin vanthamjol lang gei eidom tou tan, chuleh Pathen a konna thilmu nei dingin Jerusalem ah ei thah tan ahi. Hichun keima houin leitol sahlang kelkot sunga chun eipuije, hiche mun chu nasatah a Pakai alungnat sah milim loi lentah umna mun chu ahi.
en: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north, where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.
text:
EZK 8:3
Thadou: Amapa chunk hut toh kilou khat ahin lhang doh in kasamin eihin manne. Hichun lhagaovin vanthamjol lang gei eidom tou tan, chuleh Pathen a konna thilmu nei dingin Jerusalem ah ei thah tan ahi. Hichun keima houin leitol sahlang kelkot sunga chun eipuije, hiche mun chu nasatah a Pakai alungnat sah milim loi lentah umna mun chu ahi.
English: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north, where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

tcz: Phulou helouvin phat masa laiya phaichama kana musa Israel Pathen loupina ana um'in ahi.
en: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.
text:
EZK 8:4
Thadou: Phulou helouvin phat masa laiya phaichama kana musa Israel Pathen loupina ana um'in ahi.
English: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin kajah a aseije, “Mihem chapa sahlang sang khu ven” atin hijeh chun keiman kaven ahileh sahlang sang kelkot gah lutna pama maicham koma chun Pakai nasatah ana lunghan sah milim doi kitung chu ana dinge.
en: Then he said to me, “Son of man, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north.” So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and saw, northward of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
text:
EZK 8:5
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin kajah a aseije, “Mihem chapa sahlang sang khu ven” atin hijeh chun keiman kaven ahileh sahlang sang kelkot gah lutna pama maicham koma chun Pakai nasatah ana lunghan sah milim doi kitung chu ana dinge.
English: Then he said to me, “Son of man, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north.” So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and saw, northward of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.

tcz: “Mihem chapa,” ahin tin, “Ipi abulu namu tah em? Ka houin a konna kei nodohna dinga kidah umtah chonsetna abol'u khu namu tah em? Ahin kahungin nangin hiche ho sanga kidah umjo chonsetna tamtah namube ding ahi.”
en: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But you will again see yet other great abominations.”
text:
EZK 8:6
Thadou: “Mihem chapa,” ahin tin, “Ipi abulu namu tah em? Ka houin a konna kei nodohna dinga kidah umtah chonsetna abol'u khu namu tah em? Ahin kahungin nangin hiche ho sanga kidah umjo chonsetna tamtah namube ding ahi.”
English: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But you will again see yet other great abominations.”

tcz: Hichun aman banghoma konna asunglang kimu theina houin leitol kotphunga chun eipuilut e.
en: He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.
text:
EZK 8:7
Thadou: Hichun aman banghoma konna asunglang kimu theina houin leitol kotphunga chun eipuilut e.
English: He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.

tcz: Aman kakoma aseijin “Tun mihem chapa, bang khu lai vang'in,” eiti. Hijeh chun keiman bang chu kalai vang'in ahileh lampi kiselguh chu kamutai.
en: Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.” When I had dug in the wall, I saw a door.
text:
EZK 8:8
Thadou: Aman kakoma aseijin “Tun mihem chapa, bang khu lai vang'in,” eiti. Hijeh chun keiman bang chu kalai vang'in ahileh lampi kiselguh chu kamutai.
English: Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.” When I had dug in the wall, I saw a door.

tcz: “Lut in,” ati. “Chuleh gitlouna leh chonsetna abol'u khu ven,” eiti.
en: He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.”
text:
EZK 8:9
Thadou: “Lut in,” ati. “Chuleh gitlouna leh chonsetna abol'u khu ven,” eiti.
English: He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.”

tcz: Hijeh chun kalut tan ahileh, bang dunga ganhing kitholtho ho lim leh kidah dah um thimsem ho lim khet thi a kisem ho chu kamutai. Israel mipiten ahouvu milim doi jatchom chom ho jong chu keiman kamudoh tai.
en: So I went in and looked, and saw every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.
text:
EZK 8:10
Thadou: Hijeh chun kalut tan ahileh, bang dunga ganhing kitholtho ho lim leh kidah dah um thimsem ho lim khet thi a kisem ho chu kamutai. Israel mipiten ahouvu milim doi jatchom chom ho jong chu keiman kamudoh tai.
English: So I went in and looked, and saw every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.

tcz: Israel lamkai som sagi ho chutoh alai juva Shaphan chapa Jaajaniah adin jong kamudoh tai, amaho khat cheh chun gim namtwi hal bom chu akichoijun, hichea kon chun gim namtwi kihalna meikhu meilom tobang chu aluchung uva ahung kitom jenjun jenge.
en: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood, every man with his censer in his hand; and the smell of the cloud of incense went up.
text:
EZK 8:11
Thadou: Israel lamkai som sagi ho chutoh alai juva Shaphan chapa Jaajaniah adin jong kamudoh tai, amaho khat cheh chun gim namtwi hal bom chu akichoijun, hichea kon chun gim namtwi kihalna meikhu meilom tobang chu aluchung uva ahung kitom jenjun jenge.
English: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood, every man with his censer in his hand; and the smell of the cloud of incense went up.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin kahenga hin ahinseije, “Mihem chapa pindan thim sung khu Israel lamkai hon ipi abol'u ahi namu khah tah em? Pakaiyin igam u adalhah sa ahitah jeh in eimu pouvinte,” tin amahon asei uve.
en: Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For they say, ‘The LORD doesn’t see us. The LORD has forsaken the land.’”
text:
EZK 8:12
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin kahenga hin ahinseije, “Mihem chapa pindan thim sung khu Israel lamkai hon ipi abol'u ahi namu khah tah em? Pakaiyin igam u adalhah sa ahitah jeh in eimu pouvinte,” tin amahon asei uve.
English: Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For they say, ‘The LORD doesn’t see us. The LORD has forsaken the land.’”

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin aseiben “Hungin chule keiman hiche ho sanga tamjo kidah dah umjo ho chu navetsah inge.”
en: He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”
text:
EZK 8:13
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin aseiben “Hungin chule keiman hiche ho sanga tamjo kidah dah umjo ho chu navetsah inge.”
English: He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”

tcz: Aman Pakai houin sahlang kelkot a chun eipuijin, hiche a chun numei themkhat ana tou uvin, a pathen u Tammuz chu ana kauve.
en: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’s house which was toward the north; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.
text:
EZK 8:14
Thadou: Aman Pakai houin sahlang kelkot a chun eipuijin, hiche a chun numei themkhat ana tou uvin, a pathen u Tammuz chu ana kauve.
English: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’s house which was toward the north; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.

tcz: “Hiche hi namu hitam” tin aman eidonge. “Ahinlah hiche ho sanga tamjo kidah dah um chonsetna ho navetsah inge” ati.
en: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”
text:
EZK 8:15
Thadou: “Hiche hi namu hitam” tin aman eidonge. “Ahinlah hiche ho sanga tamjo kidah dah um chonsetna ho navetsah inge” ati.
English: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”

tcz: Hichun aman Pakai houin leitol sungnung a chun eipuilut e. pindan sung nung lutna leh sum eng maicham kikah a muntheng phung lutna a chun upa somni le nga tobang Pakai muntheng lam nung ngat in ading uve. Amaho chun solam angauvin, nisa hou nan tol ah abohkhup uve.
en: He brought me into the inner court of the LORD’s house; and I saw at the door of the LORD’s temple, between the porch and the altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs toward the LORD’s temple and their faces toward the east. They were worshiping the sun toward the east.
text:
EZK 8:16
Thadou: Hichun aman Pakai houin leitol sungnung a chun eipuilut e. pindan sung nung lutna leh sum eng maicham kikah a muntheng phung lutna a chun upa somni le nga tobang Pakai muntheng lam nung ngat in ading uve. Amaho chun solam angauvin, nisa hou nan tol ah abohkhup uve.
English: He brought me into the inner court of the LORD’s house; and I saw at the door of the LORD’s temple, between the porch and the altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs toward the LORD’s temple and their faces toward the east. They were worshiping the sun toward the east.
