tcz: “Mihem chapa, hiche hohi namu khah tah em? tin aman eidonge. Hitobanga kidah umtah chonsetna abol uhi Juda mite dinga imalou thema angaito u ham? Hiche hin anam pumpiuva thaguma kino tona a apui uva, nahko hom leng lunga eivet uva chuleh eiphin lunghang bebe jeng ding ham?
en: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? For they have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger. Behold, they put the branch to their nose.
text:
EZK 8:17
Thadou: “Mihem chapa, hiche hohi namu khah tah em? tin aman eidonge. Hitobanga kidah umtah chonsetna abol uhi Juda mite dinga imalou thema angaito u ham? Hiche hin anam pumpiuva thaguma kino tona a apui uva, nahko hom leng lunga eivet uva chuleh eiphin lunghang bebe jeng ding ham?
English: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? For they have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger. Behold, they put the branch to their nose.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh a chu kalung hanna kadonbut diu, khatcha jong kahing hoi lou ding, chuleh keiman kalungthim a jong, kalainat pilou hel ding ahi. Chuleh kahepina diuvin hung kap jong leu keiman kangaipeh louhel diu ahi.”
en: Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I will not hear them.”
text:
EZK 8:18
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh a chu kalung hanna kadonbut diu, khatcha jong kahing hoi lou ding, chuleh keiman kalungthim a jong, kalainat pilou hel ding ahi. Chuleh kahepina diuvin hung kap jong leu keiman kangaipeh louhel diu ahi.”
English: Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I will not hear them.”

tcz: Hichun Pakai ahung kitumin, khopi sugam dinga kinganse ho chu hin puidoh un, agal manchah u toh hung kondoh tha din seipeh un.
en: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”
text:
EZK 9:1
Thadou: Hichun Pakai ahung kitumin, khopi sugam dinga kinganse ho chu hin puidoh un, agal manchah u toh hung kondoh tha din seipeh un.
English: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”

tcz: Pasal gup gangtah in sahlanga kelkot chungnung a kon chun ahung kilah doh uvin, amichang cheh chun thina thei manchah khat cheh akichoi uve. Amaho lah a chun tupat ponnem kisil a akhut lekha jih pa thilkoina bom khat apang langkhat a kichoi pasal khat ajauve. Amaho abon'un houin leitol a chun alut uvin, sum eng maicham geija chun ading uve.
en: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.
text:
EZK 9:2
Thadou: Pasal gup gangtah in sahlanga kelkot chungnung a kon chun ahung kilah doh uvin, amichang cheh chun thina thei manchah khat cheh akichoi uve. Amaho lah a chun tupat ponnem kisil a akhut lekha jih pa thilkoina bom khat apang langkhat a kichoi pasal khat ajauve. Amaho abon'un houin leitol a chun alut uvin, sum eng maicham geija chun ading uve.
English: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.

tcz: Hichun Israel Pathen loupina chu Cherubim teni kikah a kon chun ahung dingdoh e. Akicholngah muna kon houin lutna lampi a chun alut tai. Hichun tupat ponnem kisil a lekha jihpa thilkoina bom choipa chu Pakai chun ahin kouve.
en: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.
text:
EZK 9:3
Thadou: Hichun Israel Pathen loupina chu Cherubim teni kikah a kon chun ahung dingdoh e. Akicholngah muna kon houin lutna lampi a chun alut tai. Hichun tupat ponnem kisil a lekha jihpa thilkoina bom choipa chu Pakai chun ahin kouve.
English: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.

tcz: Amapa koma chun Jersusalem khopi lamlen a chun, chen lang khopi sunga kidah umtah chonsetna kibol ho jeh a kap le khoisa ho jouse chalpang a khun melchihna gakoi peh cheh in” ati.
en: The LORD said to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”
text:
EZK 9:4
Thadou: Amapa koma chun Jersusalem khopi lamlen a chun, chen lang khopi sunga kidah umtah chonsetna kibol ho jeh a kap le khoisa ho jouse chalpang a khun melchihna gakoi peh cheh in” ati.
English: The LORD said to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin pasal achom dang khat koma hitia asei hi kajai. “Amapa hung hi khopi sunga khun jui jin lang, achalpang melchihna kipe lou jouse khu that gam tan.
en: To the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. Don’t let your eye spare, neither have pity.
text:
EZK 9:5
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin pasal achom dang khat koma hitia asei hi kajai. “Amapa hung hi khopi sunga khun jui jin lang, achalpang melchihna kipe lou jouse khu that gam tan.
English: To the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. Don’t let your eye spare, neither have pity.

tcz: Khotona leh lainatpi musah hih in tehse khangdong, nungah leh nupi, chuleh chapang neoho geijin that soh hel in. Amavang achalpang melchihna nei jouse vang tongkha hih in. Hiche houin mun laitah a hin pan jengin, hijeh chun mitha chu lamkai 70 ho a chun apan tauve.
en: Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don’t come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” Then they began at the old men who were before the house.
text:
EZK 9:6
Thadou: Khotona leh lainatpi musah hih in tehse khangdong, nungah leh nupi, chuleh chapang neoho geijin that soh hel in. Amavang achalpang melchihna nei jouse vang tongkha hih in. Hiche houin mun laitah a hin pan jengin, hijeh chun mitha chu lamkai 70 ho a chun apan tauve.
English: Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don’t come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” Then they began at the old men who were before the house.

tcz: “Houin chu suboh un,” tin Pakaiyin thu apei, chen lang chu leitol chu mithilong dipset in. Hijeh chun amaho alut un khopi sunga chu mihem athat pan tauvin ahi.
en: He said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” They went out, and struck in the city.
text:
EZK 9:7
Thadou: “Houin chu suboh un,” tin Pakaiyin thu apei, chen lang chu leitol chu mithilong dipset in. Hijeh chun amaho alut un khopi sunga chu mihem athat pan tauvin ahi.
English: He said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” They went out, and struck in the city.

tcz: Amaho mithat a achedoh lai sung seuvin keima kachang seh in kana ume. Kamai tolla kasulut in “O thanei pen Pakai! Jerusalem douna nalungsatna hin Israelte hi khat beh cha jeng jong dalha louhela natheh mang hel jeng ding hitam” tin kahung kap doh jeng tai.
en: While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord GOD! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?”
text:
EZK 9:8
Thadou: Amaho mithat a achedoh lai sung seuvin keima kachang seh in kana ume. Kamai tolla kasulut in “O thanei pen Pakai! Jerusalem douna nalungsatna hin Israelte hi khat beh cha jeng jong dalha louhela natheh mang hel jeng ding hitam” tin kahung kap doh jeng tai.
English: While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord GOD! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?”

tcz: Hichun Pakaiji kajah a “Israel insung mite le Juda insung mipite chonsetna hi asang val behseh jeng tai. Agamsung pumpi hi kitolthana adimtai. ‘Pakaiyin eimu pouvinte, Pakaiyin agam hi adalhahsa ahitai’ tin amahon asei uve.
en: Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion; for they say, ‘The LORD has forsaken the land, and the LORD doesn’t see.’
text:
EZK 9:9
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiji kajah a “Israel insung mite le Juda insung mipite chonsetna hi asang val behseh jeng tai. Agamsung pumpi hi kitolthana adimtai. ‘Pakaiyin eimu pouvinte, Pakaiyin agam hi adalhahsa ahitai’ tin amahon asei uve.
English: Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion; for they say, ‘The LORD has forsaken the land, and the LORD doesn’t see.’

tcz: Koima kakhen louhel ding chule laijong kalainat pilou hel dingu ahi. Atoh dungjui cheh uva bulhingsetna lethuhna kapeh diu ahi,” tin aseije.
en: As for me also, my eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head.”
text:
EZK 9:10
Thadou: Koima kakhen louhel ding chule laijong kalainat pilou hel dingu ahi. Atoh dungjui cheh uva bulhingsetna lethuhna kapeh diu ahi,” tin aseije.
English: As for me also, my eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head.”

tcz: Lekha sunpa thilkoina bom choipa tupat ponnem kisilpa chun thu ahin nung lhut in, “Nangman nei peh bang bang chu kaga bolchai tai,” tin aseije.
en: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”
text:
EZK 9:11
Thadou: Lekha sunpa thilkoina bom choipa tupat ponnem kisilpa chun thu ahin nung lhut in, “Nangman nei peh bang bang chu kaga bolchai tai,” tin aseije.
English: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”

tcz: Kagao thilmuna a chun songval dumjel songmantama kisem laltouna tobang khat chung langa song val set mai Cherubim luchung donna chun kamun ahi.
en: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
text:
EZK 10:1
Thadou: Kagao thilmuna a chun songval dumjel songmantama kisem laltouna tobang khat chung langa song val set mai Cherubim luchung donna chun kamun ahi.
English: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

tcz: Hichun tupat ponnem kisilpa jah chun, Cherubim noija kangtalai kang kipei teni kikah chun chen lang songmeihol am khu nakhut dimset galan lang khopi chunga khun gathe khum jeng tan; tin aseipeh in ahile kavet vet pettah chun aga boltai.
en: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” He went in as I watched.
text:
EZK 10:2
Thadou: Hichun tupat ponnem kisilpa jah chun, Cherubim noija kangtalai kang kipei teni kikah chun chen lang songmeihol am khu nakhut dimset galan lang khopi chunga khun gathe khum jeng tan; tin aseipeh in ahile kavet vet pettah chun aga boltai.
English: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” He went in as I watched.

tcz: Mihempa agalut chun Cherubim houin leitol lhang langa chun adingin chule aloupina meibang lom chun leitol sung nung lang chu adimsetne.
en: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
text:
EZK 10:3
Thadou: Mihempa agalut chun Cherubim houin leitol lhang langa chun adingin chule aloupina meibang lom chun leitol sung nung lang chu adimsetne.
English: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

tcz: Hichun Pakai loupi chu Cherubim chung lang chung kikhang touvin houin kotphung lang chun achetai. Houin sung chu loupina meibang lom chu adimset in chu leitol lang chu Pakai loupina chu avah pem pum jenge.
en: The LORD’s glory mounted up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.
text:
EZK 10:4
Thadou: Hichun Pakai loupi chu Cherubim chung lang chung kikhang touvin houin kotphung lang chun achetai. Houin sung chu loupina meibang lom chu adimset in chu leitol lang chu Pakai loupina chu avah pem pum jenge.
English: The LORD’s glory mounted up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.

tcz: Cherubim lhaving kithin gin chun Hatchungnung Pathen ogin bang leitol polam geijin ahing kijaphan ahi.
en: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.
text:
EZK 10:5
Thadou: Cherubim lhaving kithin gin chun Hatchungnung Pathen ogin bang leitol polam geijin ahing kijaphan ahi.
English: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

tcz: Tupat ponnem kisil mipa jah chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije “Chen lang Cherubim teni kikah a meihol am themkhat khu galan” ati. Hijeh chun mihempa chu achen akang ho lah a khat panga chun ana dinge.
en: It came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” that he went in and stood beside a wheel.
text:
EZK 10:6
Thadou: Tupat ponnem kisil mipa jah chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije “Chen lang Cherubim teni kikah a meihol am themkhat khu galan” ati. Hijeh chun mihempa chu achen akang ho lah a khat panga chun ana dinge.
English: It came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” that he went in and stood beside a wheel.

tcz: Hichun Cherubim ho lah a khat chun akhut in ahin lhangdoh in meikou ho lah kon chu mei am phabep alan tupat ponnem kisilpa khut a chun akoi peh in, hiti chun mihem pa chun mei am ho chu alan achedoh tai.
en: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.
text:
EZK 10:7
Thadou: Hichun Cherubim ho lah a khat chun akhut in ahin lhangdoh in meikou ho lah kon chu mei am phabep alan tupat ponnem kisilpa khut a chun akoi peh in, hiti chun mihem pa chun mei am ho chu alan achedoh tai.
English: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.

tcz: (Cherubim ho jouse chun alhaving noiju va chun mihem khut tobang bang anei cheh uve)
en: The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.
text:
EZK 10:8
Thadou: (Cherubim ho jouse chun alhaving noiju va chun mihem khut tobang bang anei cheh uve)
English: The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.

tcz: Kaven ahile Cherubim li ho khat cheh chun apang cheh uva kang anei cheh uvin, akang ho chu Beryl song bang apah lah lah e.
en: I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub. The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.
text:
EZK 10:9
Thadou: Kaven ahile Cherubim li ho khat cheh chun apang cheh uva kang anei cheh uvin, akang ho chu Beryl song bang apah lah lah e.
English: I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub. The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.

tcz: Akangli ho jouse akilimlo cheh un, chuleh kibanga kisem ahiuvin, kang khat cheh chun anichan kang ho chutoh khat leh khat kipei pel toh chet un ahi.
en: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.
text:
EZK 10:10
Thadou: Akangli ho jouse akilimlo cheh un, chuleh kibanga kisem ahiuvin, kang khat cheh chun anichan kang ho chutoh khat leh khat kipei pel toh chet un ahi.
English: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.

tcz: Cherubim ho chu akiuva angat nalang lang cheh uva kihei doh louhel a kitol jeng thei jiu ahi. Amaijun angat ngat nalanga kiheidoh louhel a jang keija kitol jiu ahi.
en: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it. They didn’t turn as they went.
text:
EZK 10:11
Thadou: Cherubim ho chu akiuva angat nalang lang cheh uva kihei doh louhel a kitol jeng thei jiu ahi. Amaijun angat ngat nalanga kiheidoh louhel a jang keija kitol jiu ahi.
English: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it. They didn’t turn as they went.

tcz: Cherubim leh akang ho chu aniuva amit jeng amit jengin atom dimset e. cherubim ho chun atahsau dimset in mit anei uve. Akhut uva ahin, atungtun langu ahin, chuleh alhaving jouseuva jong aneiyu ahi.
en: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.
text:
EZK 10:12
Thadou: Cherubim leh akang ho chu aniuva amit jeng amit jengin atom dimset e. cherubim ho chun atahsau dimset in mit anei uve. Akhut uva ahin, atungtun langu ahin, chuleh alhaving jouseuva jong aneiyu ahi.
English: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.

tcz: Kantalai kang ho khu kang kipeito ahi tia eikiseipeh kajan ahi.
en: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, “the whirling wheels”.
text:
EZK 10:13
Thadou: Kantalai kang ho khu kang kipeito ahi tia eikiseipeh kajan ahi.
English: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, “the whirling wheels”.

tcz: Cherubim liho chun maili cheh aneiyun, amasapen chun bonchal mai apun, anina chun mihem mai apun, athum channa chu keipi lim abangin, chuleh alichanna chun muvanlai lim apun ahi.
en: Every one of them had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The third face was the face of a lion. The fourth was the face of an eagle.
text:
EZK 10:14
Thadou: Cherubim liho chun maili cheh aneiyun, amasapen chun bonchal mai apun, anina chun mihem mai apun, athum channa chu keipi lim abangin, chuleh alichanna chun muvanlai lim apun ahi.
English: Every one of them had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The third face was the face of a lion. The fourth was the face of an eagle.

tcz: Hichun Cherubim ho chu akaltou tauve. Amaho chu Kebar vadung pangah kamu ganho toh chun thakhat ahiuve.
en: The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.
text:
EZK 10:15
Thadou: Hichun Cherubim ho chu akaltou tauve. Amaho chu Kebar vadung pangah kamu ganho toh chun thakhat ahiuve.
English: The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.

tcz: Cherubim ho chu akitol phat un akang ho jong chu ama toh chun akitol tha tauve. Amahon akeng dinga alhavingu akidop sang uva ahileh akang ho chu apangpeh uva aum chah kheh cheh uve.
en: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.
text:
EZK 10:16
Thadou: Cherubim ho chu akitol phat un akang ho jong chu ama toh chun akitol tha tauve. Amahon akeng dinga alhavingu akidop sang uva ahileh akang ho chu apangpeh uva aum chah kheh cheh uve.
English: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.

tcz: Cherubim ho akingah phat uvin akang ho jong akinga tauve. Amaho alentou teng uleh akang ho jong akipat doh ji tauve. Ajeh chu ganhing ho lhagao chu akang ho a chu uma ahi.
en: When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
text:
EZK 10:17
Thadou: Cherubim ho akingah phat uvin akang ho jong akinga tauve. Amaho alentou teng uleh akang ho jong akipat doh ji tauve. Ajeh chu ganhing ho lhagao chu akang ho a chu uma ahi.
English: When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

tcz: Hichun Pakai loupina chu houin kotphunga kon chun akitol doh in Cherubim ho chunga chun akilap den tai.
en: The LORD’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.
text:
EZK 10:18
Thadou: Hichun Pakai loupina chu houin kotphunga kon chun akitol doh in Cherubim ho chunga chun akilap den tai.
English: The LORD’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.

tcz: Chuin keiman kavet vet pet tah chun Cherubim ho chu akang ho chutoh Pakai houin solam kelkot langa chun alenguve. Chuleh Israel Pathen loupina chu hiche ho chunga chun akilap den tai.
en: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
text:
EZK 10:19
Thadou: Chuin keiman kavet vet pet tah chun Cherubim ho chu akang ho chutoh Pakai houin solam kelkot langa chun alenguve. Chuleh Israel Pathen loupina chu hiche ho chunga chun akilap den tai.
English: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

tcz: Hiche ganhing hohi Kebar vadung panga kaum pet a Israel Pathen noija kana mu ho chu ahiuve. Amaho chu Cherubim ho ahiuve, ti keiman kahei.
en: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.
text:
EZK 10:20
Thadou: Hiche ganhing hohi Kebar vadung panga kaum pet a Israel Pathen noija kana mu ho chu ahiuve. Amaho chu Cherubim ho ahiuve, ti keiman kahei.
English: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile amaho chun maili cheh leh lhaving li cheh aneiyun chuleh alhanoi uva mihem khut tobang anei cheh uve.
en: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
text:
EZK 10:21
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile amaho chun maili cheh leh lhaving li cheh aneiyun chuleh alhanoi uva mihem khut tobang anei cheh uve.
English: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

tcz: Chuleh amai hou chu Kebar vadung panga kanamu ganhing ho mai chutoh akibang chet un ahi. Aki u-chu adanga bangin jangpet in acheuvin ahi.
en: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.
text:
EZK 10:22
Thadou: Chuleh amai hou chu Kebar vadung panga kanamu ganhing ho mai chutoh akibang chet un ahi. Aki u-chu adanga bangin jangpet in acheuvin ahi.
English: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.

tcz: Hichun lhagao chun eidom sangin chuleh Pakai houin solam kelkot phung khopi sunga milal cheh mi somnile nga ho kanamu namun a chun eipuilut e. Amaho lah a chun Azzur chapa Jaazaniah le Beniah chapa Pelatiah, mipiho lamkai teni jong chu ana um lhone.
en: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the LORD’s house, which looks eastward. Behold, twenty-five men were at the door of the gate; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
text:
EZK 11:1
Thadou: Hichun lhagao chun eidom sangin chuleh Pakai houin solam kelkot phung khopi sunga milal cheh mi somnile nga ho kanamu namun a chun eipuilut e. Amaho lah a chun Azzur chapa Jaazaniah le Beniah chapa Pelatiah, mipiho lamkai teni jong chu ana um lhone.
English: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the LORD’s house, which looks eastward. Behold, twenty-five men were at the door of the gate; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

tcz: Lhagao chun kakomah “Mihem chapa, hiche mihem ho hi khopi sunga thildihlou gonga, chuleh thuhil dihlou jeng hilho chu ahiuve.
en: He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity, and who give wicked counsel in this city;

tcz: Amaho chu mipi jah a chun insah phat hilou ham? Hiche khopi hi thihbel tobang ahin, eihohi belsunga umsa bang kihong bit ihiuve tin amaho chun aseipeh uve tin kajah a aseije.
en: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’
text:
EZK 11:3
Thadou: Amaho chu mipi jah a chun insah phat hilou ham? Hiche khopi hi thihbel tobang ahin, eihohi belsunga umsa bang kihong bit ihiuve tin amaho chun aseipeh uve tin kajah a aseije.
English: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’

tcz: Hijeh chun mihem chapa amaho dounan ging tah leh kicheh tah in gau thu seijin.
en: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man.”
text:
EZK 11:4
Thadou: Hijeh chun mihem chapa amaho dounan ging tah leh kicheh tah in gau thu seijin.
English: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man.”

tcz: Hichun Pakai lhagao kachungah ahung um'in kajah a hiche thuhi seijin eiti. Hiche Israel mipite koma Pakai thusei ahi, keiman nathusei u chu kahenai, ijeh inem itile nalungsung uva hung lut a lunggel jouse chu keiman kahet ahi.
en: The LORD’s Spirit fell on me, and he said to me, “Speak, ‘The LORD says: “Thus you have said, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.
text:
EZK 11:5
Thadou: Hichun Pakai lhagao kachungah ahung um'in kajah a hiche thuhi seijin eiti. Hiche Israel mipite koma Pakai thusei ahi, keiman nathusei u chu kahenai, ijeh inem itile nalungsung uva hung lut a lunggel jouse chu keiman kahet ahi.
English: The LORD’s Spirit fell on me, and he said to me, “Speak, ‘The LORD says: “Thus you have said, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.

tcz: Nangman khopi sunga mi tamtah nathat in lamlen ho chu mithi nadip set e.
en: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.”
text:
EZK 11:6
Thadou: Nangman khopi sunga mi tamtah nathat in lamlen ho chu mithi nadip set e.
English: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.”

tcz: Hijeh a chu thaneitah Pakai chun hitia hi asei ahi, aphai hiche khopi hi thihbel chu ahi. Ahinlah asahal ho chu nanghon thudih louva natha hou sa chu ahi. Ahin nanga dingin vang keiman hiche bel sunga kona khu kaloidoh ding nahi.
en: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Your slain whom you have laid in the middle of it, they are the meat, and this is the cauldron; but you will be brought out of the middle of it.
text:
EZK 11:7
Thadou: Hijeh a chu thaneitah Pakai chun hitia hi asei ahi, aphai hiche khopi hi thihbel chu ahi. Ahinlah asahal ho chu nanghon thudih louva natha hou sa chu ahi. Ahin nanga dingin vang keiman hiche bel sunga kona khu kaloidoh ding nahi.
English: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Your slain whom you have laid in the middle of it, they are the meat, and this is the cauldron; but you will be brought out of the middle of it.

tcz: Keiman nachunga kichat umtah chemjama kidouna nachunga kahin pohlut khum ding nahi tin thanei tah Pakai chun aseije.
en: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 11:8
Thadou: Keiman nachunga kichat umtah chemjama kidouna nachunga kahin pohlut khum ding nahi tin thanei tah Pakai chun aseije.
English: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Jerusalema kona keiman kadeldoh ding, nadouna a kathutanna mangcha a thu hin tanding, gamdang miho khut a kapeh doh ding nahi.
en: “I will bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
text:
EZK 11:9
Thadou: Jerusalema kona keiman kadeldoh ding, nadouna a kathutanna mangcha a thu hin tanding, gamdang miho khut a kapeh doh ding nahi.
English: “I will bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

tcz: Israel gamgi dung, nalampi dunga chu nakisat chap diu hitia chu keiman nachunga thutanna kahin bolla chutah le nangin keima hi Pakai kahi tihi nahin hetdoh ding ahi.
en: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you in the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
text:
EZK 11:10
Thadou: Israel gamgi dung, nalampi dunga chu nakisat chap diu hitia chu keiman nachunga thutanna kahin bolla chutah le nangin keima hi Pakai kahi tihi nahin hetdoh ding ahi.
English: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you in the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

tcz: Ahipoi hiche khopi hi nang ding thihbel chu hilou ding, chule sable sunga umsa tobang jong chu nehilou ding ahi. Keiman Israel gamgi chin geija nathu kahin tanding ahi.
en: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel.
text:
EZK 11:11
Thadou: Ahipoi hiche khopi hi nang ding thihbel chu hilou ding, chule sable sunga umsa tobang jong chu nehilou ding ahi. Keiman Israel gamgi chin geija nathu kahin tanding ahi.
English: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel.

tcz: Chutia chu nangin keima hi Pakai kiti chu nahin hetdoh ding ahi ati. Ijeh inem itile nangin kadan thupeh hole kachondan ho jui ding nanom pon, nakim vella nam mite chondan joh najui jin ahi.”
en: You will know that I am the LORD, for you have not walked in my statutes. You have not executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”
text:
EZK 11:12
Thadou: Chutia chu nangin keima hi Pakai kiti chu nahin hetdoh ding ahi ati. Ijeh inem itile nangin kadan thupeh hole kachondan ho jui ding nanom pon, nakim vella nam mite chondan joh najui jin ahi.”
English: You will know that I am the LORD, for you have not walked in my statutes. You have not executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”

tcz: Hitia gaothu kasei jing laihin Beniah chapa Pelatiah chu athitai. Hichun keiman tolla chun kamai kasulut in kakap doh tai. “O thaneipen Pakai, nangin Israel sunga mi jouse natha gam ding hitam?”
en: When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord GOD! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”
text:
EZK 11:13
Thadou: Hitia gaothu kasei jing laihin Beniah chapa Pelatiah chu athitai. Hichun keiman tolla chun kamai kasulut in kakap doh tai. “O thaneipen Pakai, nangin Israel sunga mi jouse natha gam ding hitam?”
English: When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord GOD! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”

tcz: Hichun Pakaija thusei chu kahenga ahung lhunge.
en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 11:14
Thadou: Hichun Pakaija thusei chu kahenga ahung lhunge.
English: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: “Mihem chapa, Jerusalem kidalha nalai chengsen, nangma leh Israel mi akidal mangsa miho thu jeng bou asei jiuve”. Amahon mipiho chu “Pakaija konna agamlat tah jeh uva tua hi agam u chu eiho eiki peuvah ahitai” tin asei uve.
en: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far away from the LORD. This land has been given to us for a possession.’
text:
EZK 11:15
Thadou: “Mihem chapa, Jerusalem kidalha nalai chengsen, nangma leh Israel mi akidal mangsa miho thu jeng bou asei jiuve”. Amahon mipiho chu “Pakaija konna agamlat tah jeh uva tua hi agam u chu eiho eiki peuvah ahitai” tin asei uve.
English: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far away from the LORD. This land has been given to us for a possession.’

tcz: Hijeh chun soh chang ho chu seipeh un, hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei chu ahi. Keiman nangho vannoi gam jousea sohchanga kathemang jeng vangun, keima hi nasoh chan phat sunga jong namun theng u kahi jinge.
en: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come.”’
text:
EZK 11:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun soh chang ho chu seipeh un, hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei chu ahi. Keiman nangho vannoi gam jousea sohchanga kathemang jeng vangun, keima hi nasoh chan phat sunga jong namun theng u kahi jinge.
English: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come.”’

tcz: Keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kathethang nau namtin vaipi ho lah a konna kahin le khop tup kit uva, chuleh Israel gamsung chu khatvei kalepeh kit ding nahiuve.
en: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.”
text:
EZK 11:17
Thadou: Keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kathethang nau namtin vaipi ho lah a konna kahin le khop tup kit uva, chuleh Israel gamsung chu khatvei kalepeh kit ding nahiuve.
English: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.”

tcz: “Mipiho chu achennau gamsunga ahung kile kit teng ule, amahon kidah um milim hole, kidah dah um milim doi ho melchih jouse alahdoh diu ahitai.
en: “‘They will come there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.
text:
EZK 11:18
Thadou: “Mipiho chu achennau gamsunga ahung kile kit teng ule, amahon kidah um milim hole, kidah dah um milim doi ho melchih jouse alahdoh diu ahitai.
English: “‘They will come there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.

tcz: Chule keiman amaho chu alungchang uva lung ngaitona khatseh kapeh uva, chuleh asung uva lhagao thah khat kakhum peh diu ahi. Keiman alung tah nau song tobang chu kalah mang peh uva, chuleh lungnem nachu alungchang uva kakhum peh dingu ahi.
en: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,
text:
EZK 11:19
Thadou: Chule keiman amaho chu alungchang uva lung ngaitona khatseh kapeh uva, chuleh asung uva lhagao thah khat kakhum peh diu ahi. Keiman alung tah nau song tobang chu kalah mang peh uva, chuleh lungnem nachu alungchang uva kakhum peh dingu ahi.
English: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,

tcz: Hitia amahon kathupeh leh kachondan ho ajui diu ahi. Amaho chu kamite dihtah hiuvin tin, keima a Pathen u kahi ding ahi.”
en: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
text:
EZK 11:20
Thadou: Hitia amahon kathupeh leh kachondan ho ajui diu ahi. Amaho chu kamite dihtah hiuvin tin, keima a Pathen u kahi ding ahi.”
English: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

tcz: Ahinlah kidah um milim leh kidah dah um milim doi ngaicha jing nalai ho chu achonset nau jeh a bulhingsetna lethuhna kapeh dingu ahi tin keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kasei ahi.
en: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,’ says the Lord GOD.”
text:
EZK 11:21
Thadou: Ahinlah kidah um milim leh kidah dah um milim doi ngaicha jing nalai ho chu achonset nau jeh a bulhingsetna lethuhna kapeh dingu ahi tin keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kasei ahi.
English: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,’ says the Lord GOD.”

tcz: Hiti chun Cherubim ho chun alhaving u ajah un, apangpeh uva akang ho chutoh huilah a chun aleng tou tauve.
en: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
text:
EZK 11:22
Thadou: Hiti chun Cherubim ho chun alhaving u ajah un, apangpeh uva akang ho chutoh huilah a chun aleng tou tauve.
English: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

tcz: Hichun Pakai loupina chu khopi chunglanga alengtou vin, solam mol chunga akingan ahi.
en: The LORD’s glory went up from the middle of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
text:
EZK 11:23
Thadou: Hichun Pakai loupina chu khopi chunglanga alengtou vin, solam mol chunga akingan ahi.
English: The LORD’s glory went up from the middle of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

tcz: Hicheng jou nung chun Pathen lhagao chun Babylon gam'a sohchang ho koma chun eilepui kit tai. Chuleh chuti chun lhagao thilmu na chu akichai tai.
en: The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
text:
EZK 11:24
Thadou: Hicheng jou nung chun Pathen lhagao chun Babylon gam'a sohchang ho koma chun eilepui kit tai. Chuleh chuti chun lhagao thilmu na chu akichai tai.
English: The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

tcz: Chule ken sohchang ho chu Pakaiyin keima eimusah ho jouse chu kaseipeh tai.
en: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that the LORD had shown me.
text:
EZK 11:25
Thadou: Chule ken sohchang ho chu Pakaiyin keima eimusah ho jouse chu kaseipeh tai.
English: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that the LORD had shown me.

tcz: Avel in kahenga Pakai thusei ahung lhung kit e.
en: The LORD’s word also came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 12:1
Thadou: Avel in kahenga Pakai thusei ahung lhung kit e.
English: The LORD’s word also came to me, saying,

tcz: “Mihem chapa, mitni neija vet ding nom louva, doumah mah mite lah a chenga nahi. Nakhang ni neija khojah ding anom pouve. Hijeh a chu amaho hi doumah mah bol mite hiuva ahi.
en: “Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to hear, and don’t hear; for they are a rebellious house.
text:
EZK 12:2
Thadou: “Mihem chapa, mitni neija vet ding nom louva, doumah mah mite lah a chenga nahi. Nakhang ni neija khojah ding anom pouve. Hijeh a chu amaho hi doumah mah bol mite hiuva ahi.
English: “Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to hear, and don’t hear; for they are a rebellious house.

tcz: Hijeh chun tun mihem chapa sohchang khat bangin um temin. Thilthem sohchang khat in akipoh bangin gong in lang munchom dang khat jon ding bangin nachen na in chu dalhan. Mipi hon amu theina diuvin, amasang tah uva adihtah chu bollin. Ijeh inem itile doumah bol mite ahi vanguva ijemtia ahin gel khoh maithei u ahi.
en: “Therefore, you son of man, prepare your baggage for moving, and move by day in their sight. You shall move from your place to another place in their sight. It may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.
text:
EZK 12:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun tun mihem chapa sohchang khat bangin um temin. Thilthem sohchang khat in akipoh bangin gong in lang munchom dang khat jon ding bangin nachen na in chu dalhan. Mipi hon amu theina diuvin, amasang tah uva adihtah chu bollin. Ijeh inem itile doumah bol mite ahi vanguva ijemtia ahin gel khoh maithei u ahi.
English: “Therefore, you son of man, prepare your baggage for moving, and move by day in their sight. You shall move from your place to another place in their sight. It may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.

tcz: Amahon namu theina dingun sunlai chang tah in nasoh chang pot chu kipoh inlang potdoh jengin. Hiti chun nilhah lang tengleh sohchang ho gamla tah jon ding kipatdoh ho bang khun amaho mitmu chang tah in nachenna chu dalhan.
en: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for moving. You shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as when men go out into exile.
text:
EZK 12:4
Thadou: Amahon namu theina dingun sunlai chang tah in nasoh chang pot chu kipoh inlang potdoh jengin. Hiti chun nilhah lang tengleh sohchang ho gamla tah jon ding kipatdoh ho bang khun amaho mitmu chang tah in nachenna chu dalhan.
English: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for moving. You shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as when men go out into exile.

tcz: Amaho navel jing laitah u khun bang chu vut hom jengin lang, hiche a kon chun potdoh'in.
en: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your baggage out that way.
text:
EZK 12:5
Thadou: Amaho navel jing laitah u khun bang chu vut hom jengin lang, hiche a kon chun potdoh'in.
English: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your baggage out that way.

tcz: Hitia avet jing lai u hin, napot poh ding chu naleng kouva lehdoh inlang, jan laijin che mang jengin. Nadalhah nagam chu namu thei louna dingin namai chu kitom in. Ijeh inem itile, keiman nangma hi Israel mipi hetsah nadinga kasem nahi.
en: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face, so that you don’t see the land, for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”
text:
EZK 12:6
Thadou: Hitia avet jing lai u hin, napot poh ding chu naleng kouva lehdoh inlang, jan laijin che mang jengin. Nadalhah nagam chu namu thei louna dingin namai chu kitom in. Ijeh inem itile, keiman nangma hi Israel mipi hetsah nadinga kasem nahi.
English: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face, so that you don’t see the land, for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”

tcz: Hijeh chun keima eikiseipeh bangin kabol tai. Sun chang laitah chun keiman ka sohchanna kakipoh ding bangin kapot asunga athilkeu kaki het dimset chu kahin podoh tai. Hichun nilhah lang mihon eivet jing laitah u chun kakhut in bang chu kavut hom in, kaleng kouva kapot chu kapon, jan lai chun kapot doh tai.
en: I did so as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.
text:
EZK 12:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun keima eikiseipeh bangin kabol tai. Sun chang laitah chun keiman ka sohchanna kakipoh ding bangin kapot asunga athilkeu kaki het dimset chu kahin podoh tai. Hichun nilhah lang mihon eivet jing laitah u chun kakhut in bang chu kavut hom in, kaleng kouva kapot chu kapon, jan lai chun kapot doh tai.
English: I did so as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.

tcz: Ajing jingkah in Pakaija konin hiche thuhi ahung lhunge.
en: In the morning, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 12:8
Thadou: Ajing jingkah in Pakaija konin hiche thuhi ahung lhunge.
English: In the morning, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: “Mihem chapa, Israel mite doumah mah bol mite hin, hiche ho jouse hi ipi tina ham tia nadoh teng uleh.
en: “Son of man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’
text:
EZK 12:9
Thadou: “Mihem chapa, Israel mite doumah mah bol mite hin, hiche ho jouse hi ipi tina ham tia nadoh teng uleh.
English: “Son of man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’

tcz: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei chu ahi tin amaho khu seipeh in. hiche natoh hin Jerusalem a um leng Zedekiah leh Israel mipite thudola kiseina ahi.
en: “Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.”’
text:
EZK 12:10
Thadou: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei chu ahi tin amaho khu seipeh in. hiche natoh hin Jerusalem a um leng Zedekiah leh Israel mipite thudola kiseina ahi.
English: “Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.”’

tcz: Hiche natoh hin gangtah a sohchanga kaiding nakidel mang diu ahi, ti vetsahna ahi tin seichet peh in.
en: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.
text:
EZK 12:11
Thadou: Hiche natoh hin gangtah a sohchanga kaiding nakidel mang diu ahi, ti vetsahna ahi tin seichet peh in.
English: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.

tcz: Zedekiah jengin jan lai leh bang akivu hom a avon akipoh jou kham bep akipoh a Jerusalem adalhah ding ahi. Aman amai akitoma adalhahna gam chu amitna anungmu kit louhel ding ahi.
en: “‘The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.
text:
EZK 12:12
Thadou: Zedekiah jengin jan lai leh bang akivu hom a avon akipoh jou kham bep akipoh a Jerusalem adalhah ding ahi. Aman amai akitoma adalhahna gam chu amitna anungmu kit louhel ding ahi.
English: “‘The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.

tcz: Hitia chu keiman kalen kakhu khuma, kathanga kamat chom ding ahi. Babylon mite gam Babylon a chu keiman kapoh lut a hichenga amulou ding ahin, amavang hiche gam'a chu thiden ding ahi.
en: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.
text:
EZK 12:13
Thadou: Hitia chu keiman kalen kakhu khuma, kathanga kamat chom ding ahi. Babylon mite gam Babylon a chu keiman kapoh lut a hichenga amulou ding ahin, amavang hiche gam'a chu thiden ding ahi.
English: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.

tcz: Keiman asohte chu kathethanga chuleh agalhang hou chu kolning li a kathethanga amaho nunga chu chemjam kalan sah ding ahi.
en: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.
text:
EZK 12:14
Thadou: Keiman asohte chu kathethanga chuleh agalhang hou chu kolning li a kathethanga amaho nunga chu chemjam kalan sah ding ahi.
English: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.

tcz: Chule keiman amaho chu namtin vaipi ho lah a kathethang jou teng uleh, keima hi Pakai kitipa chu kahi ti ahet doh dingu ahi.
en: “‘They will know that I am the LORD when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.
text:
EZK 12:15
Thadou: Chule keiman amaho chu namtin vaipi ho lah a kathethang jou teng uleh, keima hi Pakai kitipa chu kahi ti ahet doh dingu ahi.
English: “‘They will know that I am the LORD when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

tcz: Ahin, keiman amaho lah a konna chu mi phabep khat galla kel lha a chuleh natna hisea thina a konna kakhen doh ding hijeh a chu amaho manna pang ho masanga kidah dah um chonsetna abol hou akidah uva alungu ahin hei diu ahi. Hitia chu amahon keima Pakai kahi ti ahet doh dingu ahi.
en: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
text:
EZK 12:16
Thadou: Ahin, keiman amaho lah a konna chu mi phabep khat galla kel lha a chuleh natna hisea thina a konna kakhen doh ding hijeh a chu amaho manna pang ho masanga kidah dah um chonsetna abol hou akidah uva alungu ahin hei diu ahi. Hitia chu amahon keima Pakai kahi ti ahet doh dingu ahi.
English: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

tcz: Hichun Pakaija konna kahenga hiche thuhi ahung lhunge.
en: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 12:17
Thadou: Hichun Pakaija konna kahenga hiche thuhi ahung lhunge.
English: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: “Mihem chapa, kicha a kithing pum pumin an nen lang, kicha a kihot pum pumin natwi chu donin.”
en: “Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.
text:
EZK 12:18
Thadou: “Mihem chapa, kicha a kithing pum pumin an nen lang, kicha a kihot pum pumin natwi chu donin.”
English: “Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.

tcz: Hiche hi thanei tah Pakai thusei ahi tin mipiho chu seipeh in. Hiche hi Israel leh Jerusalem a cheng ho chung chang thudol ahi. Amahon kithing pum puma an aneh uva chuleh kinepna beija twi adon diu ahi. Ijeh inem itil agitlou jeh uva agam u hi aguoh keuva kikoi peh dingu ahi.
en: Tell the people of the land, ‘The Lord GOD says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: “They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.
text:
EZK 12:19
Thadou: Hiche hi thanei tah Pakai thusei ahi tin mipiho chu seipeh in. Hiche hi Israel leh Jerusalem a cheng ho chung chang thudol ahi. Amahon kithing pum puma an aneh uva chuleh kinepna beija twi adon diu ahi. Ijeh inem itil agitlou jeh uva agam u hi aguoh keuva kikoi peh dingu ahi.
English: Tell the people of the land, ‘The Lord GOD says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: “They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.

tcz: Khopi hi kisumanga ahonlei hou jong ahomkeuva kikoi ding ahi. Hiteng chule nangman keima hi Pakai kahi nahin hetdoh dingu ahi.
en: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”
text:
EZK 12:20
Thadou: Khopi hi kisumanga ahonlei hou jong ahomkeuva kikoi ding ahi. Hiteng chule nangman keima hi Pakai kahi nahin hetdoh dingu ahi.
English: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”

tcz: Kahengah avel in Pakai thusei ahung lhung kit e.
en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 12:21
Thadou: Kahengah avel in Pakai thusei ahung lhung kit e.
English: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: “Mihem chapa, phat lah ache joutan, gaothu kisei jong panna bei asoh tai, tia Israel thudolla thuchih kisei chu najah sa ahitai.
en: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?
text:
EZK 12:22
Thadou: “Mihem chapa, phat lah ache joutan, gaothu kisei jong panna bei asoh tai, tia Israel thudolla thuchih kisei chu najah sa ahitai.
English: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?

tcz: Hiche thuchih kisei hi keiman kasuhbei ahitan, nangho lah a nahin seikit lou ding u ahi. Thuchih masapa kheldoh nading chun tun hiche thuchih thah hi kapeh nahiuve. Gao thu kisei jouse hi aban banna akisuh bulhing nading phat chu hung lhungah ahitai. Hichu thanei tah Pakai thusei ahi tin mipioho chu seipeh in.
en: Tell them therefore, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel;”’ but tell them, ‘“The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.
text:
EZK 12:23
Thadou: Hiche thuchih kisei hi keiman kasuhbei ahitan, nangho lah a nahin seikit lou ding u ahi. Thuchih masapa kheldoh nading chun tun hiche thuchih thah hi kapeh nahiuve. Gao thu kisei jouse hi aban banna akisuh bulhing nading phat chu hung lhungah ahitai. Hichu thanei tah Pakai thusei ahi tin mipioho chu seipeh in.
English: Tell them therefore, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel;”’ but tell them, ‘“The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.

tcz: Israel te lah a gaothilmu dihlou le alhema gaothu kisei kit talou ding ahi.
en: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
text:
EZK 12:24
Thadou: Israel te lah a gaothilmu dihlou le alhema gaothu kisei kit talou ding ahi.
English: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

tcz: Keima Pakai kahi jeh chun, keiman hung lhung ding ahi tia kasei chu hijeng ding ahi. Vo Israel, doumah mah bol mite, khongaisot um talou ding ahi. Nangma hinlai sunga hi keiman suhmang dinga kagihsal ding nahi. Kasuhbulhit ding ahi tin, keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kaseidoh ahi.
en: For I am the LORD. I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred; for in your days, rebellious house, I will speak the word and will perform it,” says the Lord GOD.’”
text:
EZK 12:25
Thadou: Keima Pakai kahi jeh chun, keiman hung lhung ding ahi tia kasei chu hijeng ding ahi. Vo Israel, doumah mah bol mite, khongaisot um talou ding ahi. Nangma hinlai sunga hi keiman suhmang dinga kagihsal ding nahi. Kasuhbulhit ding ahi tin, keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kaseidoh ahi.
English: For I am the LORD. I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred; for in your days, rebellious house, I will speak the word and will perform it,” says the Lord GOD.’”

tcz: Hiti chun kahenga Pakai thusei ahung lhunge.
en: Again the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 12:26
Thadou: Hiti chun kahenga Pakai thusei ahung lhunge.
English: Again the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: “Mihem chapa, aman khonung phat sottah nunga hung lhung ding thu asei ahibouve. Ama gao thilmu hohi khonung sottah jou jongle hung lhung ponte tia Israel mipi ten aseiju ahi.
en: “Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesies of times that are far off.’
text:
EZK 12:27
Thadou: “Mihem chapa, aman khonung phat sottah nunga hung lhung ding thu asei ahibouve. Ama gao thilmu hohi khonung sottah jou jongle hung lhung ponte tia Israel mipi ten aseiju ahi.
English: “Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesies of times that are far off.’

tcz: Hijeh chun hiche hi thanei tah Pakai thusei ahi, Keiman kamigih salna jouse hi kakhongai sot tah louhel ding, tu tua hi imajouse kabol ding ahitai, tin thanei pen Pakaiyin aseije tin seipeh in.
en: “Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “None of my words will be deferred any more, but the word which I speak will be performed,” says the Lord GOD.’”
text:
EZK 12:28
Thadou: Hijeh chun hiche hi thanei tah Pakai thusei ahi, Keiman kamigih salna jouse hi kakhongai sot tah louhel ding, tu tua hi imajouse kabol ding ahitai, tin thanei pen Pakaiyin aseije tin seipeh in.
English: “Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “None of my words will be deferred any more, but the word which I speak will be performed,” says the Lord GOD.’”

tcz: Hiti chun kahenga Pakai thusei ahung lhunge.
en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 13:1
Thadou: Hiti chun kahenga Pakai thusei ahung lhunge.
English: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: “Mihem chapa kilam thu a gao thusei Israel themgao lhem ho dou nan gao thu seijin. Pakai kamsung thusoh hi ngaijun, tin amaho khu seipeh in.
en: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear the LORD’s word:
text:
EZK 13:2
Thadou: “Mihem chapa kilam thu a gao thusei Israel themgao lhem ho dou nan gao thu seijin. Pakai kamsung thusoh hi ngaijun, tin amaho khu seipeh in.
English: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear the LORD’s word:

tcz: Pakai thanei pen in hitin thu aseije. Imacha mong mong mulou hella amalung ngaito to ho jui'a, themgao lhemho itobang getheina nangao hitam?”
en: The Lord GOD says, “Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
text:
EZK 13:3
Thadou: Pakai thanei pen in hitin thu aseije. Imacha mong mong mulou hella amalung ngaito to ho jui'a, themgao lhemho itobang getheina nangao hitam?”
English: The Lord GOD says, “Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

tcz: O Israel mite, nalah uva themgao umho khu ingem lah khot khot jeng sial tobang ahiuve.
en: Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.
text:
EZK 13:4
Thadou: O Israel mite, nalah uva themgao umho khu ingem lah khot khot jeng sial tobang ahiuve.
English: Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.

tcz: Amahon namsung bang chip saho semphatna dingin imacha abol pouve. Pakai nikho galsat petna din jou theina dingin, amahon imacha akithopi thei pouve.
en: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the LORD’s day.
text:
EZK 13:5
Thadou: Amahon namsung bang chip saho semphatna dingin imacha abol pouve. Pakai nikho galsat petna din jou theina dingin, amahon imacha akithopi thei pouve.
English: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the LORD’s day.

tcz: Hiti ho sang chun amaho ajouvu aseijun, chuleh adih louvin khonunga thilsoh dingho asemthu jiuve. Pakaiyin asol louhel vang'in hiche thuhi Pakaija kon ahi atiuve. Chute chun amahon Pakai gaothu kisei hohi ahin suh bulhit din akinep piuve.
en: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, ‘The LORD says;’ but the LORD has not sent them. They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.
text:
EZK 13:6
Thadou: Hiti ho sang chun amaho ajouvu aseijun, chuleh adih louvin khonunga thilsoh dingho asemthu jiuve. Pakaiyin asol louhel vang'in hiche thuhi Pakaija kon ahi atiuve. Chute chun amahon Pakai gaothu kisei hohi ahin suh bulhit din akinep piuve.
English: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, ‘The LORD says;’ but the LORD has not sent them. They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.

tcz: Keiman nangma koma imacha kisei kha louhel a jong nang ho thusei hi Pakaija kon ahi tia nasei chu thudih lou ahin, na gaothil mu chu imacha hilou ham?
en: Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘The LORD says;’ but I have not spoken?”
text:
EZK 13:7
Thadou: Keiman nangma koma imacha kisei kha louhel a jong nang ho thusei hi Pakaija kon ahi tia nasei chu thudih lou ahin, na gaothil mu chu imacha hilou ham?
English: Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘The LORD says;’ but I have not spoken?”

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu thaneitah Pakaiyin hitia hi thu asei ahi. Ajeh chu nasei chu adihlou ahin, nagao thilmu jong adihlou ahi, keima nangma douva pang kahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 13:8
Thadou: Hiche jeh a chu thaneitah Pakaiyin hitia hi thu asei ahi. Ajeh chu nasei chu adihlou ahin, nagao thilmu jong adihlou ahi, keima nangma douva pang kahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Themgao ajouva thilmu ho leh khonunga thil hunglhung ding jou thu semthu seiji douna a kakhut tum kahin dop ding, chuleh Israel kikhop khom nalah a konna kidel mang ding ahiuve. Israelte min kisut lutna lekhabu a konna amin u kathaimanga, chutia chu amaho gamsung chotlut nadinga akal ahin sonlut dingu ahitai. Hiteng chuleh nanghon keima hi thaneitah Pakai kahi nahin hetdoh dingu ahi.
en: “My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.”
text:
EZK 13:9
Thadou: Themgao ajouva thilmu ho leh khonunga thil hunglhung ding jou thu semthu seiji douna a kakhut tum kahin dop ding, chuleh Israel kikhop khom nalah a konna kidel mang ding ahiuve. Israelte min kisut lutna lekhabu a konna amin u kathaimanga, chutia chu amaho gamsung chotlut nadinga akal ahin sonlut dingu ahitai. Hiteng chuleh nanghon keima hi thaneitah Pakai kahi nahin hetdoh dingu ahi.
English: “My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.”

tcz: Hiche ho hi themgao gilou hon cham bon um louhel a chamna bulhingset ahi tia kamite alhep lhah jeh uva hungsoh ding ahi. Mipite hin kulbang lhou tah aget uva chuleh themgao hon amaho thahat sah be nading uva rong kanga nu khum dan u tobang ahi.
en: “‘Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.
text:
EZK 13:10
Thadou: Hiche ho hi themgao gilou hon cham bon um louhel a chamna bulhingset ahi tia kamite alhep lhah jeh uva hungsoh ding ahi. Mipite hin kulbang lhou tah aget uva chuleh themgao hon amaho thahat sah be nading uva rong kanga nu khum dan u tobang ahi.
English: “‘Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.

tcz: Hiche rong kang nu ho koma chun nabang u chu lhuloi ding ahitai tin seipeh un. Huipi gopi in hattah in abul asemdoh a, gellen nasatah le hui thahattah hon ahin sem lhuh diu ahi.
en: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.
text:
EZK 13:11
Thadou: Hiche rong kang nu ho koma chun nabang u chu lhuloi ding ahitai tin seipeh un. Huipi gopi in hattah in abul asemdoh a, gellen nasatah le hui thahattah hon ahin sem lhuh diu ahi.
English: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.

tcz: Chutia bang chu ahung chimlhah tengle mipi ho chun ‘na rong kang nu u chu ipi iti hitam?’ atiuva hung kap doh diu ahi.
en: Behold, when the wall has fallen, won’t it be said to you, “Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?”
text:
EZK 13:12
Thadou: Chutia bang chu ahung chimlhah tengle mipi ho chun ‘na rong kang nu u chu ipi iti hitam?’ atiuva hung kap doh diu ahi.
English: Behold, when the wall has fallen, won’t it be said to you, “Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?”

tcz: Keiman kalung hanna twisoh tobanga vetda umtah huipi gopi leh kalungsatna gelpi changa nabang u rong kang kinu chu katol ngim hel jeng ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin asei ahi.
en: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.
text:
EZK 13:13
Thadou: Keiman kalung hanna twisoh tobanga vetda umtah huipi gopi leh kalungsatna gelpi changa nabang u rong kang kinu chu katol ngim hel jeng ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin asei ahi.
English: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.

tcz: Nabang u chu abul'a kipatna keiman kahin suh chim ding chutia alhuh tengle keiman nangma kasuh chip ding nahi. Hiteng chuleh nangman Pakai kahi chu nahet doh ding ahi.
en: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
text:
EZK 13:14
Thadou: Nabang u chu abul'a kipatna keiman kahin suh chim ding chutia alhuh tengle keiman nangma kasuh chip ding nahi. Hiteng chuleh nangman Pakai kahi chu nahet doh ding ahi.
English: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

tcz: Achaina leh bangleh chunga rong kinu ho douna a kalungsatna kalung nachim bep ding ahi. Hiteng chule keiman najah a kaseija, bang chuleh achunga rong nuho agomun aum tapouve kati ding ahi.
en: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it—
text:
EZK 13:15
Thadou: Achaina leh bangleh chunga rong kinu ho douna a kalungsatna kalung nachim bep ding ahi. Hiteng chule keiman najah a kaseija, bang chuleh achunga rong nuho agomun aum tapouve kati ding ahi.
English: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it—

tcz: Chamna bon um louhel a Jerusalem a chamna hung lhung ding ahi tia seiho chu themgao jou ho chu ahiuve, tia keim thaneitah Pakaiyin kasei ahi.
en: to wit, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace,’” says the Lord GOD.’”
text:
EZK 13:16
Thadou: Chamna bon um louhel a Jerusalem a chamna hung lhung ding ahi tia seiho chu themgao jou ho chu ahiuve, tia keim thaneitah Pakaiyin kasei ahi.
English: to wit, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace,’” says the Lord GOD.’”

tcz: Tun mihem chapa, ama ama lung ngaito a thusei numeiho dounan gaothu seijun.
en: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,
text:
EZK 13:17
Thadou: Tun mihem chapa, ama ama lung ngaito a thusei numeiho dounan gaothu seijun.
English: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,

tcz: Hichehi thanei ta Pakaiyin asei ahi. Kamite khangdong ho hihen lang tehseho hijongle a lhagao u thanga manna pang numei itobang gentheina nanga jingu hitam? Akhut chong uva doikhao ho nabu peh uva, chuleh akijep nau athil keuho doithu kisap khum delvang nana khukhum peh uve. Nangho chunga manthahna ahung lhun louna dinga nanghon midang ho mat dinga nagel u ham?
en: and say, “The Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves?
text:
EZK 13:18
Thadou: Hichehi thanei ta Pakaiyin asei ahi. Kamite khangdong ho hihen lang tehseho hijongle a lhagao u thanga manna pang numei itobang gentheina nanga jingu hitam? Akhut chong uva doikhao ho nabu peh uva, chuleh akijep nau athil keuho doithu kisap khum delvang nana khukhum peh uve. Nangho chunga manthahna ahung lhun louna dinga nanghon midang ho mat dinga nagel u ham?
English: and say, “The Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves?

tcz: Nanghon sakol chang khut dim khat leh changlhah hal khat jeh in kamite lah a jachat umjeh tah in nahin polut e. Thujou kisei ngailua kamite lah a nacheng un, athilou ding ho nathat un chule ahing lou ding ho chu hinghoi dingin natep peh uve.
en: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not die and to save the souls alive who should not live, by your lying to my people who listen to lies.’
text:
EZK 13:19
Thadou: Nanghon sakol chang khut dim khat leh changlhah hal khat jeh in kamite lah a jachat umjeh tah in nahin polut e. Thujou kisei ngailua kamite lah a nacheng un, athilou ding ho nathat un chule ahing lou ding ho chu hinghoi dingin natep peh uve.
English: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not die and to save the souls alive who should not live, by your lying to my people who listen to lies.’

tcz: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Kamite vacha mat banga namat a namilunglut sahna ai chu keiman kadou ahi. Vacha aboma konna kilhadoh banga keiman kakhut kakeu doh a kamite chu naban janga konna kachu lhah a kacham lhat sah diu ahi.
en: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against your magic bands, with which you hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms. I will let the souls fly free, even the souls whom you ensnare like birds.
text:
EZK 13:20
Thadou: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Kamite vacha mat banga namat a namilunglut sahna ai chu keiman kadou ahi. Vacha aboma konna kilhadoh banga keiman kakhut kakeu doh a kamite chu naban janga konna kachu lhah a kacham lhat sah diu ahi.
English: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against your magic bands, with which you hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms. I will let the souls fly free, even the souls whom you ensnare like birds.

tcz: Keiman nnadoi pon chu kabo keh a nakhut a natuh chah kheh na a konna kahuhdoh dingu ahi. Amaho chu namibol genthei chu hilou diu ahitai. Chuteng nangin keihi Pakai kahi ti nahet doh ding ahi.
en: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand; and they will no longer be in your hand to be ensnared. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
text:
EZK 13:21
Thadou: Keiman nnadoi pon chu kabo keh a nakhut a natuh chah kheh na a konna kahuhdoh dingu ahi. Amaho chu namibol genthei chu hilou diu ahitai. Chuteng nangin keihi Pakai kahi ti nahet doh ding ahi.
English: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand; and they will no longer be in your hand to be ensnared. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

tcz: Jouvin michonpha ho chu nalung lhahsah in, ahinlah keiman amaho lungkhama a umdiu kanom poi. Chuleh nanghon migilou chu achonsetna a natilkhouvin, ahinkho huhhing peh din natilkhouve.
en: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.
text:
EZK 13:22
Thadou: Jouvin michonpha ho chu nalung lhahsah in, ahinlah keiman amaho lungkhama a umdiu kanom poi. Chuleh nanghon migilou chu achonsetna a natilkhouvin, ahinkho huhhing peh din natilkhouve.
English: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse jeh a hi namu ngailou hel gao thilmu nasei ji ho chu naseibe kit louhel ding, chule khonung thu ding jong nasei kit lou ding ahitai. Ijeh inem itile kamite chu nakhutna kon kaki huhdoh diu ahi, hiteng chule nangin keihi Pakai kahi ti chu nahin hetdoh dingu ahi.
en: Therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”
text:
EZK 13:23
Thadou: Hiche ho jouse jeh a hi namu ngailou hel gao thilmu nasei ji ho chu naseibe kit louhel ding, chule khonung thu ding jong nasei kit lou ding ahitai. Ijeh inem itile kamite chu nakhutna kon kaki huhdoh diu ahi, hiteng chule nangin keihi Pakai kahi ti chu nahin hetdoh dingu ahi.
English: Therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”

tcz: Hitah chun Israel sunga lamkai phabep kahenga ahungun, hitia amaho kakoma atou pet un,
en: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.
text:
EZK 14:1
Thadou: Hitah chun Israel sunga lamkai phabep kahenga ahungun, hitia amaho kakoma atou pet un,
English: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.

tcz: Kahenga Pakaija konin hiche thuhi ahung lhunge.
en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 14:2
Thadou: Kahenga Pakaija konin hiche thuhi ahung lhunge.
English: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: Mihem chapa, hiche lamkai hohin alungsung uva milim doi kisemthu akitun u ahi. Amahon chonsetna alhuh nadiu thilho chu akol chahkheh un ahi. Ipi jeh a athum nau chu kangai peh ding ham?
en: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?
text:
EZK 14:3
Thadou: Mihem chapa, hiche lamkai hohin alungsung uva milim doi kisemthu akitun u ahi. Amahon chonsetna alhuh nadiu thilho chu akol chahkheh un ahi. Ipi jeh a athum nau chu kangai peh ding ham?
English: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?

tcz: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi tin seipeh in. Israel mipi ten alungthim sung uva milim doi kisemthu akitun soh kei u ahi. Chonsetna lha ahitauvin, chuti chun amaho themgao ho koma thu aga dong jiuve.
en: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him there according to the multitude of his idols,
text:
EZK 14:4
Thadou: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi tin seipeh in. Israel mipi ten alungthim sung uva milim doi kisemthu akitun soh kei u ahi. Chonsetna lha ahitauvin, chuti chun amaho themgao ho koma thu aga dong jiuve.
English: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him there according to the multitude of his idols,

tcz: Hijeh a chu Pakai keiman, amaho chu nasatah a amilim doi hou nauva akhol khom jat dungjui ja kahin donbut diu ahi. Hiche ho kidah dah um amilim doi hounauva konna kamite lungthim leh alungchang u kakhum khom theina ding uva kabol dingu ahi.
en: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.”’
text:
EZK 14:5
Thadou: Hijeh a chu Pakai keiman, amaho chu nasatah a amilim doi hou nauva akhol khom jat dungjui ja kahin donbut diu ahi. Hiche ho kidah dah um amilim doi hounauva konna kamite lungthim leh alungchang u kakhum khom theina ding uva kabol dingu ahi.
English: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.”’

tcz: Hiche jeh chun Israel mipite chu seipeh in, hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Kisih unlang namilim doi hou nauva konin kihei mangun. Chuleh kidah dah um nachonset nau chu ngau vin.
en: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Return, and turn yourselves from your idols! Turn away your faces from all your abominations.
text:
EZK 14:6
Thadou: Hiche jeh chun Israel mipite chu seipeh in, hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Kisih unlang namilim doi hou nauva konin kihei mangun. Chuleh kidah dah um nachonset nau chu ngau vin.
English: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Return, and turn yourselves from your idols! Turn away your faces from all your abominations.

tcz: Kei Pakaiyin Israel insung mi hihen, gamdang mi hijongle, keima eipaija alungchang uva milim doi kitundoh a chonsetna lha ho, chule kei thuhil ngaicha a themgao ho koma che jouse agoma donbutna kapeh ding ahi.
en: “‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I the LORD will answer him by myself.
text:
EZK 14:7
