Thadou: Kei Pakaiyin Israel insung mi hihen, gamdang mi hijongle, keima eipaija alungchang uva milim doi kitundoh a chonsetna lha ho, chule kei thuhil ngaicha a themgao ho koma che jouse agoma donbutna kapeh ding ahi.
English: “‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I the LORD will answer him by myself.

tcz: Hitobanga chon miho douna a kahung kiheija amaho dinga tijat umtah vetsahna kapeh a, kamite a konna amaho hi kasuhmang jeng ding ahi. Hiteng chule nangin keihi Pakai kahi ti nahin hetdoh ding ahi.
en: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from among my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
text:
EZK 14:8
Thadou: Hitobanga chon miho douna a kahung kiheija amaho dinga tijat umtah vetsahna kapeh a, kamite a konna amaho hi kasuhmang jeng ding ahi. Hiteng chule nangin keihi Pakai kahi ti nahin hetdoh ding ahi.
English: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from among my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

tcz: Chuleh ijemtia themgaopa thusei dinga akijou klhep lhah khah tah a ahileh, hiche themgao pachu keima Pakaiyin kajou lhep jeh hiding ahi. Keiman hiche themgao pa chunga chu kakhut tum kahin lap sanga, Israel mite lah a konna amaho chu kasat lhah ding ahi.
en: “‘“If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, the LORD, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.
text:
EZK 14:9
Thadou: Chuleh ijemtia themgaopa thusei dinga akijou klhep lhah khah tah a ahileh, hiche themgao pachu keima Pakaiyin kajou lhep jeh hiding ahi. Keiman hiche themgao pa chunga chu kakhut tum kahin lap sanga, Israel mite lah a konna amaho chu kasat lhah ding ahi.
English: “‘“If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, the LORD, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.

tcz: Themgao lhem ho leh amaho lamkai ngaichaho jouse chu achonset nau jeh a talen kapeh soh kei diu ahi.
en: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him,
text:
EZK 14:10
Thadou: Themgao lhem ho leh amaho lamkai ngaichaho jouse chu achonset nau jeh a talen kapeh soh kei diu ahi.
English: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him,

tcz: Hitia hi Israel mipi te keija konna vahmang kit talou hel diu ahi. Amaho leh amaho chonsetna a kisuboh kit talou diu ahi. Amaho chu kamite hiuva chuleh keima a Pathen u kahi ding ahi, tia Pakai kitipa keiman kaseidoh ahi.
en: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God,” says the Lord GOD.’”
text:
EZK 14:11
Thadou: Hitia hi Israel mipi te keija konna vahmang kit talou hel diu ahi. Amaho leh amaho chonsetna a kisuboh kit talou diu ahi. Amaho chu kamite hiuva chuleh keima a Pathen u kahi ding ahi, tia Pakai kitipa keiman kaseidoh ahi.
English: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God,” says the Lord GOD.’”

tcz: Chutah chun hiche thusei hi kahenga Pakaija kon in ahung lhunge.
en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 14:12
Thadou: Chutah chun hiche thusei hi kahenga Pakaija kon in ahung lhunge.
English: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: Mihem chapa, gamsung khat a mite chu kei dounan hung chonse kha ta leu, keiman amaho suhchipna dinga kakhut kahin lap a aneh hol nau lampi kasuhtang peh a, mihem leh gancha agoma suhmang nadinga kel kalhah sah ding ahi.
en: “Son of man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of its bread and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal—
text:
EZK 14:13
Thadou: Mihem chapa, gamsung khat a mite chu kei dounan hung chonse kha ta leu, keiman amaho suhchipna dinga kakhut kahin lap a aneh hol nau lampi kasuhtang peh a, mihem leh gancha agoma suhmang nadinga kel kalhah sah ding ahi.
English: “Son of man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of its bread and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal—

tcz: Noah, Daniel chule Job ho jeng jong achonphat nauvin midang khat jong ahuhhing jou pouvin, amavang amaho changseh bou akihuhhing jou uve, tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 14:14
Thadou: Noah, Daniel chule Job ho jeng jong achonphat nauvin midang khat jong ahuhhing jou pouvin, amavang amaho changseh bou akihuhhing jou uve, tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Ahilouleh keiman gamsa ho chu agamsunga kadel khum sah a miho chu athauva chuleh agam chu mi chen louna gam aso uva, chuleh koiman ajot le ngamlou ding ahitai. Ajotpa le ho dinga kichat tijat um kahisah thei ahi.
en: “If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals—
text:
EZK 14:15
Thadou: Ahilouleh keiman gamsa ho chu agamsunga kadel khum sah a miho chu athauva chuleh agam chu mi chen louna gam aso uva, chuleh koiman ajot le ngamlou ding ahitai. Ajotpa le ho dinga kichat tijat um kahisah thei ahi.
English: “If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals—

tcz: Adihtah mong mongin, keiman kahin laisen pasal thum ana umkhom kha tajong leu achapa teu leh achanu teu huhdoh jou pouvintin, amaho changseh bou kihuhdoh uva, amavang agamsung uhi ahomkeu kiso ding ahi.
en: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.
text:
EZK 14:16
Thadou: Adihtah mong mongin, keiman kahin laisen pasal thum ana umkhom kha tajong leu achapa teu leh achanu teu huhdoh jou pouvintin, amaho changseh bou kihuhdoh uva, amavang agamsung uhi ahomkeu kiso ding ahi.
English: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.

tcz: Ahilouleh agamsung douna a gal kahin pohlut khuma chule mihem leh ganchaho sumang dinga melma sepaite kahin sollut khum thei ahi.
en: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and animal’—
text:
EZK 14:17
Thadou: Ahilouleh agamsung douna a gal kahin pohlut khuma chule mihem leh ganchaho sumang dinga melma sepaite kahin sollut khum thei ahi.
English: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and animal’—

tcz: Adih tahbeh mongin keima kahin laisen tin thaneipen Pakijin aseije. Pasal thum ana umkhom jong leu amaho chapate leh chanuteu huhdoh jou pouvintin, amaho changseh bou kihuhdoh jou diu ahi,
en: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only would be delivered themselves.
text:
EZK 14:18
Thadou: Adih tahbeh mongin keima kahin laisen tin thaneipen Pakijin aseije. Pasal thum ana umkhom jong leu amaho chapate leh chanuteu huhdoh jou pouvintin, amaho changseh bou kihuhdoh jou diu ahi,
English: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only would be delivered themselves.

tcz: Ahiloule keiman kalungsatna hi agamsunga natna hi kasunlhah khuma chuleh hiche natna chun mihem leh gancha kibanga athagam sah thei ahi.
en: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal—
text:
EZK 14:19
Thadou: Ahiloule keiman kalungsatna hi agamsunga natna hi kasunlhah khuma chuleh hiche natna chun mihem leh gancha kibanga athagam sah thei ahi.
English: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal—

tcz: Atahbeh mongin keima kahin laisen tin thaneipen Pakaiyin aseije. Noah, Daniel, Job ho ana umun, amahon amaho chapte leh achanuteu ana kihuhdoh jou pouve. Achonphat nauvin amaho bouseh akihuhhing jouvun ahi.
en: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither son nor daughter; they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness.”
text:
EZK 14:20
Thadou: Atahbeh mongin keima kahin laisen tin thaneipen Pakaiyin aseije. Noah, Daniel, Job ho ana umun, amahon amaho chapte leh achanuteu ana kihuhdoh jou pouve. Achonphat nauvin amaho bouseh akihuhhing jouvun ahi.
English: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither son nor daughter; they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness.”

tcz: Tun thaneipen Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi. Jerusalem chunga hiche engbolna hoise tah tah liho hung lhung ding hi ichan a tijat um hiding hitam? Gala kisat a kel lha, gamsaho, chuleh natna hise amanu amite leh aganchate jouse sumang dinga hung lhung ding ahi tin aseije.
en: For the Lord GOD says: “How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence—to cut off from it man and animal!
text:
EZK 14:21
Thadou: Tun thaneipen Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi. Jerusalem chunga hiche engbolna hoise tah tah liho hung lhung ding hi ichan a tijat um hiding hitam? Gala kisat a kel lha, gamsaho, chuleh natna hise amanu amite leh aganchate jouse sumang dinga hung lhung ding ahi tin aseije.
English: For the Lord GOD says: “How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence—to cut off from it man and animal!

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in ahing doh umnalai ding ahin, amaho chun Babylon langa delmanga umdinga nangma nung ahin jui diu ahi. Itobang tah a migilou hiuvem? ti nangin namit tah a nahin mu ding, hiteng chule keiman Jerusalema ipi kabol ding ham ti nahet doh thei ding ahi.
en: Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will come out to you, and you will see their way and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought on it.
text:
EZK 14:22
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in ahing doh umnalai ding ahin, amaho chun Babylon langa delmanga umdinga nangma nung ahin jui diu ahi. Itobang tah a migilou hiuvem? ti nangin namit tah a nahin mu ding, hiteng chule keiman Jerusalema ipi kabol ding ham ti nahet doh thei ding ahi.
English: Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will come out to you, and you will see their way and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought on it.

tcz: Nangin amaho nakimuto pi tengleh aum chanu nahin mu a, hitobang thil hohi ajeh beija kabol ahilou chu nahin hetdoh ding ahi tia keima thaneipen Pakaiyin kasei ahi.
en: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 14:23
Thadou: Nangin amaho nakimuto pi tengleh aum chanu nahin mu a, hitobang thil hohi ajeh beija kabol ahilou chu nahin hetdoh ding ahi tia keima thaneipen Pakaiyin kasei ahi.
English: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Hiti hin kahenga Pakaija kon in thukhat ahung lhunge.
en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 15:1
Thadou: Hiti hin kahenga Pakaija kon in thukhat ahung lhunge.
English: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: “Mihem chapa, lengpigui chu thingphung toh iti kitekah thei ding ham? Lengpi gui hi thingphung tahbeh man bang banga kimang thei ding hinam?
en: “Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?
text:
EZK 15:2
Thadou: “Mihem chapa, lengpigui chu thingphung toh iti kitekah thei ding ham? Lengpi gui hi thingphung tahbeh man bang banga kimang thei ding hinam?
English: “Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?

tcz: Hiche lengpigui thing chu thilkeuva kisem theija belho leh haipeh ho khaina kisem thei ding hinam?
en: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?
text:
EZK 15:3
Thadou: Hiche lengpigui thing chu thilkeuva kisem theija belho leh haipeh ho khaina kisem thei ding hinam?
English: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?

tcz: Ahipoi, tiding thing in bou akimangjin, hiche jeng jong chu bailam tah in acajou loichel jin ahi.
en: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?
text:
EZK 15:4
Thadou: Ahipoi, tiding thing in bou akimangjin, hiche jeng jong chu bailam tah in acajou loichel jin ahi.
English: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?

tcz: Lengpigui chu meiya akiti masang hihen, akiti jou hijongleh pannabei ahibouve.
en: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”
text:
EZK 15:5
Thadou: Lengpigui chu meiya akiti masang hihen, akiti jou hijongleh pannabei ahibouve.
English: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”

tcz: Chule hiche hi thanei tah Pakai thusei ahi. Jerusalem mite chu gammang thingphung lah a keh langpigui tobangbep bou ahiuve. Pannabei ahiuva kipatna chu keiman akavam dinga meilah a kalelut dingu ahi.
en: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “As the vine wood among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
text:
EZK 15:6
Thadou: Chule hiche hi thanei tah Pakai thusei ahi. Jerusalem mite chu gammang thingphung lah a keh langpigui tobangbep bou ahiuve. Pannabei ahiuva kipatna chu keiman akavam dinga meilah a kalelut dingu ahi.
English: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “As the vine wood among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

tcz: Keiman meilah a kon in sohcha jong leu meikou dangkhat lah a lhalut kit thou thou ding ahi. Keiman amaho douna kaki hei teng, nangin keima hi Pakai kahi chu nahet doh ding ahi.
en: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I set my face against them.
text:
EZK 15:7
Thadou: Keiman meilah a kon in sohcha jong leu meikou dangkhat lah a lhalut kit thou thou ding ahi. Keiman amaho douna kaki hei teng, nangin keima hi Pakai kahi chu nahet doh ding ahi.
English: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I set my face against them.

tcz: Kamite hi keija dinga tahsan umlou ahi jeh uva gamsung chu mihem chenna lou gam'a kasem ding tia,” keima thanei tah Pakaiyin kasei ahi.
en: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 15:8
Thadou: Kamite hi keija dinga tahsan umlou ahi jeh uva gamsung chu mihem chenna lou gam'a kasem ding tia,” keima thanei tah Pakaiyin kasei ahi.
English: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Hichun kahenga Pakai thusei achom khat ahung lhunge.
en: Again the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 16:1
Thadou: Hichun kahenga Pakai thusei achom khat ahung lhunge.
English: Again the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: “Mihem chapa, Jerusalem hi kidah dah um achonsetna jeh chun kamai topin.
en: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;

tcz: Amanu chu thaneitah Pakaija kon hiche thu kasei hi pen. Nangma imacha nahipoi, Canaan mi mai mai bou nahi. Nagou chu Amor mi ahin, nanu chu Hit mi ahi.
en: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.
text:
EZK 16:3
Thadou: Amanu chu thaneitah Pakaija kon hiche thu kasei hi pen. Nangma imacha nahipoi, Canaan mi mai mai bou nahi. Nagou chu Amor mi ahin, nanu chu Hit mi ahi.
English: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.

tcz: Nahung pen nikho chun koima chan nakhoh sah pon, nalai jong ana kitan poi. Chule napenna pat silkhah lou hel nahi. Chi kinu a ponna kichun nahi.
en: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.
text:
EZK 16:4
Thadou: Nahung pen nikho chun koima chan nakhoh sah pon, nalai jong ana kitan poi. Chule napenna pat silkhah lou hel nahi. Chi kinu a ponna kichun nahi.
English: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.

tcz: Mihem khat chan jong nalai nat peh hih helluvin, koimachan nalungset poi. Koiman nadon poi. Nangma napen nikho chun dei umlou nahin, tollhang bohse panga kikoi nahin chule athi dinga kidalha nahi.
en: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.
text:
EZK 16:5
Thadou: Mihem khat chan jong nalai nat peh hih helluvin, koimachan nalungset poi. Koiman nadon poi. Nangma napen nikho chun dei umlou nahin, tollhang bohse panga kikoi nahin chule athi dinga kidalha nahi.
English: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.

tcz: Ahinlah, keiman kahin pana a nangma kamun nathisan lah a kithopi ding beijin nakipeh lelen ahi. Nangma hitia nalup pet chun keiman hingin tin kaseije.
en: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’
text:
EZK 16:6
Thadou: Ahinlah, keiman kahin pana a nangma kamun nathisan lah a kithopi ding beijin nakipeh lelen ahi. Nangma hitia nalup pet chun keiman hingin tin kaseije.
English: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’

tcz: Keiman gamlah thingphung banga khangtou dingin kana kithopin ahi. Nangma nahung khang doh in songmantam hoitah nahung hitai. Na ang teini ahung kikhan lhittan, natahsa le na sam jong asao doh tai, ahin nangma sagoh keu nahi nalaije.
en: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.

EZK 16:7
Thadou: Keiman gamlah thingphung banga khangtou dingin kana kithopin ahi. Nangma nahung khang doh in songmantam hoitah nahung hitai. Na ang teini ahung kikhan lhittan, natahsa le na sam jong asao doh tai, ahin nangma sagoh keu nahi nalaije.
English: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.

tcz: Chule kahin jotpa kitphat in nangma kilungsetpi theijin nana khangdoh tai. Hijeh chun najamo khunan kasongkhol cholin kakhum tai. Chule nang toh kichenna dinga kakitepna jong kaphondoh a phat phapen chu keiman kasem ahi, tia thaneipen Pakaiyin kaseija hitia chu nangma keija nahung hi ahitai.
en: “‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I pledged myself to you and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord GOD, “and you became mine.
text:

Chule nang toh kichenna dinga kakitepna jong kaphondoh a phat phapen chu keiman kasem ahi, tia thaneipen Pakaiyin kaseija hitia chu nangma keija nahung hi ahitai.

en: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.

tcz: Ngailut thilpeh kapeh ho jouse milim doi ho jep hoinan nangin namang chan hiche mun nachun notin napange. Tahsan umlou lout ah a, hichu itidan a soh jeng theiham?
en: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.

Thadou: Keiman kapeh pon hoitah a kikhong chu namilim doi nasil peh in ahi. Chutichun thao hoi dehsetna kisem ho le thil namtwi ho chu hiche ho houna chun namange.
English: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.

tcz: Nalungin gah gel temin, deilhen tum changbong olive thao chuleh khoiju keiman nangma kapeh ho chu hiche milimdoi ho anga kilhainan namang jenge tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Jon thanhoi leh kidah dah um nachonset jinglai sung sese ahi masanglai peh a tollhanga sagoh keuva nalup leh nangma thisan lah a nakipeh peh lai chu khatvei beh jong nageldoh louhel jeng ham?

English: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.

tcz: Egypt mi jon lung puho chu na kilungsetpi ben, benatum neilouva nachon jing nachun neiphin lunghang hang jengin ahi.

tcz: Hiche ho jeh a chu kakhut tuma kahinsah a chule nagamgi kasuh neo peh tai. Keiman melma Philistine ho khut na kapeh doh nahin, najon lung put umchan chun amaho jeng jong alung linglau vun ahi.
en: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.

EZK 16:27
Thadou: Hiche ho jeh a chu kakhut tuma kahinsah a chule nagamgi kasuh neo peh tai. Keiman melma Philistine ho khut na kapeh doh nahin, najon lung put umchan chun amaho jeng jong alung linglau vun ahi.

en: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.

tcz: Kilungsetpi belapna ding Babylon mite jong chu nakol chuh chuh jenge. Ahinlah nalung nachim deh hih laiye.

Thadou: Henge, nanghi naji tahbeh pa sangin jong het phah lou miho jong ji numei nahi.
English: “‘“Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!

tcz: Noti hon a noti chonman akilah jiuvin, ahin nangma nachuti poi. Nakidei piho chu ahung uva nahung jonpi ding midang ahin puina dingun thilpeh nape jon ahi.
en: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.
text:
EZK 16:33
Thadou: Noti hon a noti chonman akilah jiuvin, ahin nangma nachuti poi. Nakidei piho chu ahung uva nahung jonpi ding midang ahin puina dingun thilpeh nape jon ahi.
English: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.

en: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’

en: ‘The Lord GOD says, “Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers; and because of all the idols of your abominations, and for the blood of your children, that you gave to them;

en: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.

EZK 16:37
Thadou: Hitia hi keiman kahin bol ding ahi. Nadeichatna nachonsetpi ho jouse chu keiman kahin khop khoma, nadeichat ho hihen nahot ho hijong leh keiman amaho masanga nasagoh keuva kakoija amahon navet dingu ahi.

tcz: Natoltah jeh leh na jonthanhoi jeh a keiman kahin engbolla kalung hanna nasatah a chu na thisanna kahin tom jol ding nahi.
en: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.
text:
EZK 16:38
Thadou: Natoltah jeh leh na jonthanhoi jeh a keiman kahin engbolla kalung hanna nasatah a chu na thisanna kahin tom jol ding nahi.
English: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.

tcz: Nadeichat namtin vaipi ho koma kahin pehdoh a hitia chu amahon nahin suhmang dingu ahi. Amahon tahsanlou ho muntheng ho chule namilim doi ho dunga namaicham sem ho chu ahin hochim diu ahi. Amahon navon asutlhah uva nakijepna ahoilai jouse akilah uva napumcha keija sagoh keuva nadalhah dingu ahi.
en: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.
text:
EZK 16:39
Thadou: Nadeichat namtin vaipi ho koma kahin pehdoh a hitia chu amahon nahin suhmang dingu ahi. Amahon tahsanlou ho muntheng ho chule namilim doi ho dunga namaicham sem ho chu ahin hochim diu ahi. Amahon navon asutlhah uva nakijepna ahoilai jouse akilah uva napumcha keija sagoh keuva nadalhah dingu ahi.
English: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.

tcz: Nangma hi songa selih ding leh chemjama sat tel dinga nakan chom uva mipi lah a nahin puilut dingu ahi.
en: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.

EZK 16:40
Thadou: Nangma hi songa selih ding leh chemjama sat tel dinga nakan chom uva mipi lah a nahin puilut dingu ahi.
English: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.

tcz: Amahon naguho ahal vamuva chule numei tamtah ho maichanga nahin engbol diu ahi. Keiman na noti chonna kasuh tanga chule nadeichat ho sum napeh ji chu kaki chaisah ding ahi.
en: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.

EZK 16:41
Thadou: Amahon naguho ahal vamuva chule numei tamtah ho maichanga nahin engbol diu ahi. Keiman na noti chonna kasuh tanga chule nadeichat ho sum napeh ji chu kaki chaisah ding ahi.
English: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.

tcz: Hitia chu kalung hanna nasatah chu keiman kahin man chaija chule nachunga kalungsatna nasatah chu hung dailha ding ahi. Keima kaum thima nachunga kalung han kit tah lou ding ahi.
en: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.
text:
EZK 16:42
Thadou: Hitia chu kalung hanna nasatah chu keiman kahin man chaija chule nachunga kalungsatna nasatah chu hung dailha ding ahi. Keima kaum thima nachunga kalung han kit tah lou ding ahi.
English: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.

tcz: Hinlah, amasatah, nangin na khangdon lai nasuh mil jeh leh hitobang thil gillou nabol jeh a nei lung hansah ahin, keiman nachonsetna jouse dungjui a bulhingsetna lethuhna kapeh ding nahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije. Ijeh inem itile kidah dah um nachonset na ho chu huh na in nabelap jinge.
en: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord GOD: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.
text:
EZK 16:43
Thadou: Hinlah, amasatah, nangin na khangdon lai nasuh mil jeh leh hitobang thil gillou nabol jeh a nei lung hansah ahin, keiman nachonsetna jouse dungjui a bulhingsetna lethuhna kapeh ding nahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije. Ijeh inem itile kidah dah um nachonset na ho chu huh na in nabelap jinge.
English: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord GOD: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.

tcz: Thuchih sem hon achanu jong anu keh ahi tin hin sei uvinte.
en: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’
text:
EZK 16:44
Thadou: Thuchih sem hon achanu jong anu keh ahi tin hin sei uvinte.
English: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’

tcz: Nanun ajipa leh achate ada banga nangin jong nabol ahi. Chule adihtah mongin nang jong nasopinu tobang nahi. Ijeh inem itile amahon a inneipu te le achateo ija aselou jeh u ahi. Atah beh in nanu chu Hit mi ahin, napa chu Amor mi ahi.
en: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
text:
EZK 16:45
Thadou: Nanun ajipa leh achate ada banga nangin jong nabol ahi. Chule adihtah mongin nang jong nasopinu tobang nahi. Ijeh inem itile amahon a inneipu te le achateo ija aselou jeh u ahi. Atah beh in nanu chu Hit mi ahin, napa chu Amor mi ahi.
English: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

tcz: Nanu chu Samaria ahin, achanute toh sahlang kaijah aching uve. Nanaonu chu ahileh Sodom ahin achanute toh lhang lang kaija achenguve.
en: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.
text:
EZK 16:46
Thadou: Nanu chu Samaria ahin, achanute toh sahlang kaijah aching uve. Nanaonu chu ahileh Sodom ahin achanute toh lhang lang kaija achenguve.
English: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.

tcz: Ahivangin ama chon bangin na chon sepoi. Dan kallin amaho sangin nahung masa jotai.
en: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.
text:
EZK 16:47
Thadou: Ahivangin ama chon bangin na chon sepoi. Dan kallin amaho sangin nahung masa jotai.
English: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.

tcz: Keima kahin lai sung sea nei tahsanun tin thanei tah Pakaiyin aseije. Sodom leh achanute hi nang leh nachanute gitlou tobang lom lom in agilou pouve.
en: As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.
text:
EZK 16:48
Thadou: Keima kahin lai sung sea nei tahsanun tin thanei tah Pakaiyin aseije. Sodom leh achanute hi nang leh nachanute gitlou tobang lom lom in agilou pouve.
English: As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.

tcz: Sodom chonsetna chu kiloupi sahna, neipap, chule thasetna ahin, mivaichate le migentheiten vang akot polam uvah genthei athoh uve.
en: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
text:
EZK 16:49
Thadou: Sodom chonsetna chu kiloupi sahna, neipap, chule thasetna ahin, mivaichate le migentheiten vang akot polam uvah genthei athoh uve.
English: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

tcz: Amanu chu akiloupi sah in chule kidah dah um chonsetna a akipelut in namu bangin amanu katheh mang tan ahi.
en: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.
text:
EZK 16:50
Thadou: Amanu chu akiloupi sah in chule kidah dah um chonsetna a akipelut in namu bangin amanu katheh mang tan ahi.
English: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.

tcz: Samaria in jong nang chonset akeh kaht jat jong aboldoh hih naije. Nasopinu tenin aboldoh sang sanga tamjo kidah dah umtah nabol doh tan ahi. Nang toh tekha ding amahi achonpha jo dan in aum uve.
en: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.
text:
EZK 16:51
Thadou: Samaria in jong nang chonset akeh kaht jat jong aboldoh hih naije. Nasopinu tenin aboldoh sang sanga tamjo kidah dah umtah nabol doh tan ahi. Nang toh tekha ding amahi achonpha jo dan in aum uve.
English: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.

tcz: Nachonsetna ho tijat umbehseh jeng ahijeh chun sopi teni hi chonpha jo asosah tan chule achonpha jo lhon tan ahi.
en: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.
text:
EZK 16:52
Thadou: Nachonsetna ho tijat umbehseh jeng ahijeh chun sopi teni hi chonpha jo asosah tan chule achonpha jo lhon tan ahi.
English: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.

tcz: Ahinlah nikhat teng Sodom leh Samaria haosatna kasem phat peh kit lhon ding chule nang jong kasem phat kit ding nahi.
en: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;

tcz: Hiteng chule nathilbol masaho jal'a najahcha tah tah a, ijeh inem itile nachonsetna ho toh tekah dinga chu hung phajo ding ahitai.
en: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.
text:
EZK 16:54
Thadou: Hiteng chule nathilbol masaho jal'a najahcha tah tah a, ijeh inem itile nachonsetna ho toh tekah dinga chu hung phajo ding ahitai.
English: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.

tcz: Henge, nasopi teni Sodom leh Samaria chule amite jouse kasem phat kit uva hiteng chule nang jong kasem phat kit ding nahi.
en: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.
text:
EZK 16:55
Thadou: Henge, nasopi teni Sodom leh Samaria chule amite jouse kasem phat kit uva hiteng chule nang jong kasem phat kit ding nahi.
English: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.

tcz: Nakiletsah laiya chu Sodom nana musit lheh jenge.
en: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,
text:
EZK 16:56
Thadou: Nakiletsah laiya chu Sodom nana musit lheh jenge.
English: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,

tcz: Ahinlah nagitlouna melsetah chu vannoi pumpia akiphong jal tan, Edom leh akimvella cheng jouse le Philistine te deimo chu nahitai.
en: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.
text:
EZK 16:57
Thadou: Ahinlah nagitlouna melsetah chu vannoi pumpia akiphong jal tan, Edom leh akimvella cheng jouse le Philistine te deimo chu nahitai.
English: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.

tcz: Hiche hi najon lungputna le kidah dah umna chonsetna jeh a nahiti engbol na chu ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije.
en: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says the LORD.
text:
EZK 16:58
Thadou: Hiche hi najon lungputna le kidah dah umna chonsetna jeh a nahiti engbol na chu ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije.
English: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says the LORD.

tcz: Tun hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Naki hahselna le nakitepna nasuhkeh chule nathilbol doh dungjuija kana peh ding nahi.
en: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
text:
EZK 16:59
Thadou: Tun hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Naki hahselna le nakitepna nasuhkeh chule nathilbol doh dungjuija kana peh ding nahi.
English: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

tcz: Hiteng chule nakhang dong laiya kitepna kasem ho nahin geldoh a chuteng leh keimnan atonsotna ding kitepna khat kaphudoh kit ding ahi.
en: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
text:
EZK 16:60
Thadou: Hiteng chule nakhang dong laiya kitepna kasem ho nahin geldoh a chuteng leh keimnan atonsotna ding kitepna khat kaphudoh kit ding ahi.
English: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

tcz: Hitia chu nangin jachat pum puma nathilbol masaho nahin geldoh ding keiman nasopi teni Samaria le Sodom teni chu nakitep na a pang phalhon hih jong le nachanu tenia kasem peh ding nahi.
en: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.
text:
EZK 16:61
Thadou: Hitia chu nangin jachat pum puma nathilbol masaho nahin geldoh ding keiman nasopi teni Samaria le Sodom teni chu nakitep na a pang phalhon hih jong le nachanu tenia kasem peh ding nahi.
English: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.

tcz: Chule keiman nang toh kaki tepna chu kaphu det ding, hitia chu nangin Pakai kahi nahin hetdoh ding ahi.
en: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am the LORD;

tcz: Keiman nathilbol masah ho kangaidam teng leh nachonset naho nahin geldoh a jachat jeh a nakam nakisip ding ahi tin thanei tah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord GOD.’”
text:
EZK 16:63
Thadou: Keiman nathilbol masah ho kangaidam teng leh nachonset naho nahin geldoh a jachat jeh a nakam nakisip ding ahi tin thanei tah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord GOD.’”

tcz: Hiti chun kahenga Pakai thusei hiche hi ahung lhunge.
en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 17:1
Thadou: Hiti chun kahenga Pakai thusei hiche hi ahung lhunge.
English: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: “Mihem chapa, hiche thuchih hi pen lang, Israel mipi techu hiche thusim hi seipeh in.
en: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;

tcz: Thaneitah Pakaija kon hiche thusei hi pen: ‘Muvanlai lentah khat alhaving teni jong lent ah le amul jong sao tah, amul ho pahbet na kitom khat Lebanon lama ahungin Cedar thing leh vum'a ahung touve.
en: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.
text:
EZK 17:3
Thadou: Thaneitah Pakaija kon hiche thusei hi pen: ‘Muvanlai lentah khat alhaving teni jong lent ah le amul jong sao tah, amul ho pahbet na kitom khat Lebanon lama ahungin Cedar thing leh vum'a ahung touve.
English: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.

tcz: Chuleh abah asang pen tah chu alou lhan kivei miho chenna khopi khatna apomang tai. Kivei miho chenna khopi a chun aphut tai.
en: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.
text:
EZK 17:4
Thadou: Chuleh abah asang pen tah chu alou lhan kivei miho chenna khopi khatna apomang tai. Kivei miho chenna khopi a chun aphut tai.
English: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.

tcz: Aman hiche gam'a kon chun muchi ho chu apon chule leiphatna laikhatna agatun ahi. Thingnem banga akhan theina dingin vadung len panga atun ahi.
en: “‘“He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.
text:
EZK 17:5
Thadou: Aman hiche gam'a kon chun muchi ho chu apon chule leiphatna laikhatna agatun ahi. Thingnem banga akhan theina dingin vadung len panga atun ahi.
English: “‘“He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.

tcz: Hilaimun nahun ajung akho lut in, lengpigui nem cha bangin akhang dohtai. Abahho chu muvanlai lam ngan ahung khang doh in, chule ajung ho chu tolla chun akhang lut peh tai. Abah lhou tah tah ahin sep doh in ana ahung nou tai.
en: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.
text:
EZK 17:6
Thadou: Hilaimun nahun ajung akho lut in, lengpigui nem cha bangin akhang dohtai. Abahho chu muvanlai lam ngan ahung khang doh in, chule ajung ho chu tolla chun akhang lut peh tai. Abah lhou tah tah ahin sep doh in ana ahung nou tai.
English: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.

tcz: Ahinla muvanlai lentah a chomkhat alhaving lentah leh amul dimsetna pol khat ahunge. Hijeh chun lengpigui chu twi ngaichat najeh chun tun vang ajung ho leh abah ho jouse chu amalam ngan ahung jamdoh tauve.
en: “‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.
text:
EZK 17:7
Thadou: Ahinla muvanlai lentah a chomkhat alhaving lentah leh amul dimsetna pol khat ahunge. Hijeh chun lengpigui chu twi ngaichat najeh chun tun vang ajung ho leh abah ho jouse chu amalam ngan ahung jamdoh tauve.
English: “‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.

tcz: Twi ninglhin namun leh lei phatna munna kiphut ahijeng vang chun, hijeh chun lengpiphung loupi tah khat in ahung khangdoh in chule ana thalhingset leh thei namtwi tah tah ahin sep doh tan ahi.
en: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’
text:
EZK 17:8
Thadou: Twi ninglhin namun leh lei phatna munna kiphut ahijeng vang chun, hijeh chun lengpiphung loupi tah khat in ahung khangdoh in chule ana thalhingset leh thei namtwi tah tah ahin sep doh tan ahi.
English: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’

tcz: Hijeh chun tun thaneitah Pakai chun adong tai. Hiche lengpi phung hi khang touva chule phatou cheh cheh ding hinam? Ahipoi keiman ajung le adangho kabodoh a, atheiga ho kasat lhah gam ding, chule ana ho goplha a thidiu ahin, ban thahattah le sepai tamtah jaulouva bailam tah a kabodoh ding ahi.
en: “Say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Will it prosper? Won’t he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, that it may wither, that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? It can’t be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people.
text:
EZK 17:9
Thadou: Hijeh chun tun thaneitah Pakai chun adong tai. Hiche lengpi phung hi khang touva chule phatou cheh cheh ding hinam? Ahipoi keiman ajung le adangho kabodoh a, atheiga ho kasat lhah gam ding, chule ana ho goplha a thidiu ahin, ban thahattah le sepai tamtah jaulouva bailam tah a kabodoh ding ahi.
English: “Say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Will it prosper? Won’t he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, that it may wither, that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? It can’t be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people.

tcz: Ahin lengpi phung chu akiphu chon teng leh ahing thei nadem? Ahipoi, goplha ding ahitai. Solam huijin ahinsem teng hoitah a akhan dohna mun chu leiphatah namun hijongleh thiden tante.”
en: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won’t it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew.”’”
text:
EZK 17:10
Thadou: Ahin lengpi phung chu akiphu chon teng leh ahing thei nadem? Ahipoi, goplha ding ahitai. Solam huijin ahinsem teng hoitah a akhan dohna mun chu leiphatah namun hijongleh thiden tante.”
English: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won’t it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew.”’”

tcz: Hichun kahenga Pakaija konin hiche thuhi ahung lhunge.
en: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 17:11
Thadou: Hichun kahenga Pakaija konin hiche thuhi ahung lhunge.
English: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: Hiche doumah bol Israel koma seipeh in. Hiche muvanlai thuchih kisei hi nahet doh theilouvu ham? Babylon lengpa hi Jerusalem a hungin tin, amanu lengpa le leng chapate manin tin Babylon a atolmang diu ahi.
en: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.
text:
EZK 17:12
Thadou: Hiche doumah bol Israel koma seipeh in. Hiche muvanlai thuchih kisei hi nahet doh theilouvu ham? Babylon lengpa hi Jerusalem a hungin tin, amanu lengpa le leng chapate manin tin Babylon a atolmang diu ahi.
English: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.

tcz: Aman leng insung mite toh kitepna semin tin chule thahat sanin tahsan umtah kihahselna neipinte. Aman gamsung a lamkai luboh pen pen ho jong galhinga kaimang tante.
en: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land,
text:
EZK 17:13
Thadou: Aman leng insung mite toh kitepna semin tin chule thahat sanin tahsan umtah kihahselna neipinte. Aman gamsung a lamkai luboh pen pen ho jong galhinga kaimang tante.
English: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land,

tcz: Hijeh a chu Israel chu hung hatdoh kit talou ding chule kile thuh jou talou ding ahitai. Babylon te toh akitepnau vin bou ahinso diu ahitai.
en: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.
text:
EZK 17:14
Thadou: Hijeh a chu Israel chu hung hatdoh kit talou ding chule kile thuh jou talou ding ahitai. Babylon te toh akitepnau vin bou ahinso diu ahitai.
English: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

tcz: Israel leng insung pasal hon Babylon douna gal bol dingin Egypt gam'a Pakai sollin sepai tamtah le sakol ho thum jongleu galbol dingin kipatdoh jou kit tapouvinte. Hitia chu Israel in akitepna asuh keh a chemang jeng thei ding ham?
en: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?
text:
EZK 17:15
Thadou: Israel leng insung pasal hon Babylon douna gal bol dingin Egypt gam'a Pakai sollin sepai tamtah le sakol ho thum jongleu galbol dingin kipatdoh jou kit tapouvinte. Hitia chu Israel in akitepna asuh keh a chemang jeng thei ding ham?
English: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?

tcz: Ahipoi tahbeh mongin keima kahing jinge tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije. Akitepna donse louva asuhkeh peh leng vaipo tung doh pa Babylon gamsunga chu Israel lengpa thiden ding ahitai.
en: “‘As I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.
text:
EZK 17:16
Thadou: Ahipoi tahbeh mongin keima kahing jinge tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije. Akitepna donse louva asuhkeh peh leng vaipo tung doh pa Babylon gamsunga chu Israel lengpa thiden ding ahitai.
English: “‘As I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.

tcz: Pharaoh leh sepai thahattah ho jong Israelte Babylon in Avella galhinga ahin kaija mi tamtah hinkho ahin suhmang dinga konin huhdoh jou pouvin te.
en: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.
text:
EZK 17:17
Thadou: Pharaoh leh sepai thahattah ho jong Israelte Babylon in Avella galhinga ahin kaija mi tamtah hinkho ahin suhmang dinga konin huhdoh jou pouvin te.
English: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.

tcz: Ajeh chu Israel lengpan kitepna anot thapma chule akihahsel jou nunga asuhkeh kit jeh a sohcha louhel ding ahi.
en: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.
text:
EZK 17:18
Thadou: Ajeh chu Israel lengpan kitepna anot thapma chule akihahsel jou nunga asuhkeh kit jeh a sohcha louhel ding ahi.
English: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu thaneitah Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi. Thabeh mongin keima kahinge. Kamma kitah tah a akihahselna leh akitepna ho asuhkeh jeh a keiman ka engbol ding ahi.
en: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.
text:
EZK 17:19
Thadou: Hiche jeh a chu thaneitah Pakai thusei chu hiche hi ahi. Thabeh mongin keima kahinge. Kamma kitah tah a akihahselna leh akitepna ho asuhkeh jeh a keiman ka engbol ding ahi.
English: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.

tcz: Keiman kalen achunga kakhukhuma, kathanga kamat ding ahi. Babylonna kapuilutna keidouna agalmi ho kithopia apanjeh a athu katandiing ahi.
en: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.
text:
EZK 17:20
Thadou: Keiman kalen achunga kakhukhuma, kathanga kamat ding ahi. Babylonna kapuilutna keidouna agalmi ho kithopia apanjeh a athu katandiing ahi.
English: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.

tcz: Chule agal hangsan phapen pen ho jong kidouna munna kithat den diu ahin, ahing doh ho jong hui ninglia kithe thang soh diu ahi. Hiteng chuleh nangin keima Pakaiyin kasei hi nahin hetdoh ding ahi.
en: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it.’
text:
EZK 17:21
Thadou: Chule agal hangsan phapen pen ho jong kidouna munna kithat den diu ahin, ahing doh ho jong hui ninglia kithe thang soh diu ahi. Hiteng chuleh nangin keima Pakaiyin kasei hi nahin hetdoh ding ahi.
English: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it.’

tcz: Hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Cedar thingphung sang tah khat a konna abah khat kalah a chule Israel molsang pen laitah chunga kaphu dong ahi.
en: “The Lord GOD says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
text:
EZK 17:22
Thadou: Hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Cedar thingphung sang tah khat a konna abah khat kalah a chule Israel molsang pen laitah chunga kaphu dong ahi.
English: “The Lord GOD says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

tcz: Hiche chu Cedar thing loupi tah, abah tamtah hin sep doh a, ga ahin sep doh dng ahi. Vacha jat chom chom in buh hin san tin, abah ho lim noija chu kiselna a ahin neidingu ahi.
en: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches.
text:
EZK 17:23
Thadou: Hiche chu Cedar thing loupi tah, abah tamtah hin sep doh a, ga ahin sep doh dng ahi. Vacha jat chom chom in buh hin san tin, abah ho lim noija chu kiselna a ahin neidingu ahi.
English: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches.

tcz: Chuleh thingphung jousen thingphung sang jouse kasatlhah a thingphung nem ho chu sangtah'a kakhandoh sah a, chuti chu Pakai kahi ti ahetsoh kei diu ahi. Thing ana eng jouse goplhah sah a athiho thah hin sah kit chu keibol ahi tin Pakai keiman kana sei ahin, chule kasei doh sa chu kabol doh ding ahi ati.
en: All the trees of the field will know that I, the LORD, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree flourish. “‘I, the LORD, have spoken and have done it.’”
text:
EZK 17:24
Thadou: Chuleh thingphung jousen thingphung sang jouse kasatlhah a thingphung nem ho chu sangtah'a kakhandoh sah a, chuti chu Pakai kahi ti ahetsoh kei diu ahi. Thing ana eng jouse goplhah sah a athiho thah hin sah kit chu keibol ahi tin Pakai keiman kana sei ahin, chule kasei doh sa chu kabol doh ding ahi ati.
English: All the trees of the field will know that I, the LORD, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree flourish. “‘I, the LORD, have spoken and have done it.’”

tcz: Hichun kahenga Pakai thusei achom dang khat ahung lhunge.
en: The LORD’s word came to me again, saying,
text:
EZK 18:1
Thadou: Hichun kahenga Pakai thusei achom dang khat ahung lhunge.
English: The LORD’s word came to me again, saying,

tcz: “Ipi dinga hiche thuchih hi Israel gamsung chung thudol nasei kit kit uva, “Minu mipate lengpithei thuh aneuvin ahinlah achateu athei twina jeh chun akamsungu atol lhatai,” tia nasei jiu ham?
en: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?
text:
EZK 18:2
Thadou: “Ipi dinga hiche thuchih hi Israel gamsung chung thudol nasei kit kit uva, “Minu mipate lengpithei thuh aneuvin ahinlah achateu athei twina jeh chun akamsungu atol lhatai,” tia nasei jiu ham?
English: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?

tcz: Tahbeh mongin keima kahing jinge tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije. Israel lah a hiche hi nanungsei kit louhel diu ahitai.
en: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.
text:
EZK 18:3
Thadou: Tahbeh mongin keima kahing jinge tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije. Israel lah a hiche hi nanungsei kit louhel diu ahitai.
English: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile mijouse hi keiman athu katan cheh ding ahin, mipate hihen achateu hijongleu agoma kibang cheh ahiuve. Hiche hi kachonna dan ahi, ‘Koi hile chonset bolla chu thitei ding ahi.’
en: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.
text:
EZK 18:4
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile mijouse hi keiman athu katan cheh ding ahin, mipate hihen achateu hijongleu agoma kibang cheh ahiuve. Hiche hi kachonna dan ahi, ‘Koi hile chonset bolla chu thitei ding ahi.’
English: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.

tcz: Tekah nan, mipa khat chu michonpha ahi, adih chetna atoh a chuleh adih a ahile,
en: “But if a man is just, and does that which is lawful and right,
text:
EZK 18:5
Thadou: Tekah nan, mipa khat chu michonpha ahi, adih chetna atoh a chuleh adih a ahile,
English: “But if a man is just, and does that which is lawful and right,

tcz: Amapa chun molsang chunga Israel milim manga an aneh khah hih hella ahiloule ahouva apna louva ahileh, amapa chun jonthanhoi abolda a, ahilouleh numei khat chu athinei pet a aluppi da a,
en: and has not eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife, hasn’t come near a woman in her impurity,
text:
EZK 18:6
Thadou: Amapa chun molsang chunga Israel milim manga an aneh khah hih hella ahiloule ahouva apna louva ahileh, amapa chun jonthanhoi abolda a, ahilouleh numei khat chu athinei pet a aluppi da a,
English: and has not eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife, hasn’t come near a woman in her impurity,

tcz: Amapa chu sumbat hom mikhoto them ahia, mivaichan bat mana athiltun u akoiden louva ahileh, mivaicha ho neile gou achom peh hih leh, hiche sanga chu agilkel ho ann aneh sah a, saguoh keuva umho ponsil apeh a,
en: and has not wronged any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has taken nothing by robbery, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;

tcz: Sum akan lalouva sumbat ahomma, thudih louva thu kitanna konna akikangse a, lungthengsel ahia, chule midang thutanna agamlat a,
en: he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true justice between man and man,
text:
EZK 18:8
Thadou: Sum akan lalouva sumbat ahomma, thudih louva thu kitanna konna akikangse a, lungthengsel ahia, chule midang thutanna agamlat a,
English: he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true justice between man and man,

tcz: Chuleh tahsan umtah kathupeh le kachondan ho ajuija ahileh, mikhat touvin hiche thilho hi adih a abolla ahile ama chu hing teitei ding ahi” tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 18:9
Thadou: Chuleh tahsan umtah kathupeh le kachondan ho ajuija ahileh, mikhat touvin hiche thilho hi adih a abolla ahile ama chu hing teitei ding ahi” tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Ahin hitobang mipa khat chun chapa khat nei hen lang, amapa chu michom tolthat hihen lang, chule thilpha bol ding chu nom tahih henlang hileh,
en: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,
text:
EZK 18:10
Thadou: Ahin hitobang mipa khat chun chapa khat nei hen lang, amapa chu michom tolthat hihen lang, chule thilpha bol ding chu nom tahih henlang hileh,
English: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,

tcz: Chule hiche chapa chun apan abol khah louhel thilphalou jouse bol tahen lang, molsang chung dunga milim doiho chu gahou hen jonthanhoi bol taleh,
en: or who does not do any of those things but has eaten at the mountain shrines and defiled his neighbor’s wife,
text:
EZK 18:11
Thadou: Chule hiche chapa chun apan abol khah louhel thilphalou jouse bol tahen lang, molsang chung dunga milim doiho chu gahou hen jonthanhoi bol taleh,
English: or who does not do any of those things but has eaten at the mountain shrines and defiled his neighbor’s wife,

tcz: Mivaicha leh panpi ding neilou ho chu a engse sea abol'a, asumbat neipa a konna gucha jia, athilbat manna kitungho kilelhat sah ding nom louva, milim doiho hou kidah dah um chonset bolna a kipumpeh,
en: has wronged the poor and needy, has taken by robbery, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,
text:
EZK 18:12
Thadou: Mivaicha leh panpi ding neilou ho chu a engse sea abol'a, asumbat neipa a konna gucha jia, athilbat manna kitungho kilelhat sah ding nom louva, milim doiho hou kidah dah um chonset bolna a kipumpeh,
English: has wronged the poor and needy, has taken by robbery, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,

tcz: Chule sum homma aval vala akan kilah, hitobanga chonsepa chu hing thing ding hinam? Ahipoi amachu thitei tei ding chule themmona dimsetna akilah ding ahi.
en: has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor, shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood will be on him.
text:
EZK 18:13
Thadou: Chule sum homma aval vala akan kilah, hitobanga chonsepa chu hing thing ding hinam? Ahipoi amachu thitei tei ding chule themmona dimsetna akilah ding ahi.
English: has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor, shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood will be on him.

tcz: Ahinlah hitobang chonsetna dim mipa chun chapa khat nei henlang hiche achapa chun apa gitlouna chengse chu amudoh tengle hitobang hinkho chu mang talou dingin kigeltha taleh,
en: “Now, behold, if he fathers a son who sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and fears, and doesn’t do likewise,
text:
EZK 18:14
Thadou: Ahinlah hitobang chonsetna dim mipa chun chapa khat nei henlang hiche achapa chun apa gitlouna chengse chu amudoh tengle hitobang hinkho chu mang talou dingin kigeltha taleh,
English: “Now, behold, if he fathers a son who sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and fears, and doesn’t do likewise,

tcz: Hiche chapa chu molsang chung dunga milim doi ho chu hou ding nom tahih hen lang chuleh jonthanhoi jin kipeh lut da jeng taleh,
en: who hasn’t eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife,
text:
EZK 18:15
Thadou: Hiche chapa chu molsang chung dunga milim doi ho chu hou ding nom tahih hen lang chuleh jonthanhoi jin kipeh lut da jeng taleh,
English: who hasn’t eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife,

tcz: Mivaicha ho adihlouvin bolda henlang, ahinlah hicheho sang chun mi sumbat a lahna a kitah hen lang amaho chu chommang da hen. Aman agilkel ho ann nehsah hen lang chule angaiho ponsil peleh,
en: hasn’t wronged any, hasn’t taken anything to pledge, hasn’t taken by robbery, but has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;

tcz: Mivachaho kithopi hen, akan dingin sum hom dahen. Chuleh kachondan ho leh kathupeh ho jui bukim soh hen, hitobang mi chu apa chonset jeh a thilou hel ding, amavang hing teitei ding ahi.
en: who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who hasn’t received interest or increase, has executed my ordinances, has walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father. He shall surely live.
text:
EZK 18:17
Thadou: Mivachaho kithopi hen, akan dingin sum hom dahen. Chuleh kachondan ho leh kathupeh ho jui bukim soh hen, hitobang mi chu apa chonset jeh a thilou hel ding, amavang hing teitei ding ahi.
English: who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who hasn’t received interest or increase, has executed my ordinances, has walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father. He shall surely live.

tcz: Ahinlah apa vang chu achonsetna tamtah ho jeh a, akhanset jeh a, miho achom jeh a, chule mitmu a kicheh tah a thildihlou abolho jeh a chu thiding ahi.
en: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.
text:
EZK 18:18
Thadou: Ahinlah apa vang chu achonsetna tamtah ho jeh a, akhanset jeh a, miho achom jeh a, chule mitmu a kicheh tah a thildihlou abolho jeh a chu thiding ahi.
English: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.

tcz: Iti danna apa chonset man achapan apeh lou ham ipi jeh ham natiuve. Ahipoi chapang chun thilpha abolla adih a achonna chuleh kathupehho ajuija ahile hing teitei ding ahi.
en: “Yet you say, ‘Why doesn’t the son bear the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he will surely live.
text:
EZK 18:19
Thadou: Iti danna apa chonset man achapan apeh lou ham ipi jeh ham natiuve. Ahipoi chapang chun thilpha abolla adih a achonna chuleh kathupehho ajuija ahile hing teitei ding ahi.
English: “Yet you say, ‘Why doesn’t the son bear the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he will surely live.

tcz: Ahinkho a chonsepa vang chu thiding ahi. Apa chonset jeh a achapa ki engbol lou ding, chule achapa chonset jeh a apa ki engbol lou ding ahi. Michonpha ho chu achonphatna jal'a tohphatman asan uva, chuleh migilou techu agitlou nau jal'a, ki engbol dingu ahi.
en: The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.
text:
EZK 18:20
Thadou: Ahinkho a chonsepa vang chu thiding ahi. Apa chonset jeh a achapa ki engbol lou ding, chule achapa chonset jeh a apa ki engbol lou ding ahi. Michonpha ho chu achonphatna jal'a tohphatman asan uva, chuleh migilou techu agitlou nau jal'a, ki engbol dingu ahi.
English: The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.

tcz: Ahinlah ijem tin migilou techun achonset nau jousea kon in hung kihei mang uhenlang chuleh kathupeh ho hin jui pan uhen, chule thilpha leh adih chu hin bol uhenlang hileh hing teitei dingu ahin, thilou hel dingu ahi.
en: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.
text:
EZK 18:21
Thadou: Ahinlah ijem tin migilou techun achonset nau jousea kon in hung kihei mang uhenlang chuleh kathupeh ho hin jui pan uhen, chule thilpha leh adih chu hin bol uhenlang hileh hing teitei dingu ahin, thilou hel dingu ahi.
English: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

tcz: Achesa phat a achonset nau jouse kisuhmil peh a chuleh chonphat abol hou jouse jeh a hing diu ahi.
en: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.
text:
EZK 18:22
Thadou: Achesa phat a achonset nau jouse kisuhmil peh a chuleh chonphat abol hou jouse jeh a hing diu ahi.
English: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.

tcz: Migilouho thi chu kamu nomma nangaitou ham tin thaneitah Pakai chun aseije. Migilou chu agitlouna a konna akihei manga ahin ding chu kadei louva nabolu ham?
en: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord GOD, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?
text:
EZK 18:23
Thadou: Migilouho thi chu kamu nomma nangaitou ham tin thaneitah Pakai chun aseije. Migilou chu agitlouna a konna akihei manga ahin ding chu kadei louva nabolu ham?
English: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord GOD, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?

tcz: Iti hen lang hijongle michonpha khat tou chu achonphatna lampia konna akihei manga chonset abolpat tah a, midang chonset banga achonset tah a ahileh, amaho chu ahin diu kiphal peh ding ham. Ahipoi hithei louhel ding ahibouve. Achonphat nahou jouse chu kisuhmil peh a chule achonset nauva thiden diu ahi.
en: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.
text:
EZK 18:24
Thadou: Iti hen lang hijongle michonpha khat tou chu achonphatna lampia konna akihei manga chonset abolpat tah a, midang chonset banga achonset tah a ahileh, amaho chu ahin diu kiphal peh ding ham. Ahipoi hithei louhel ding ahibouve. Achonphat nahou jouse chu kisuhmil peh a chule achonset nauva thiden diu ahi.
English: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in Pakaiyin thilpha chu abollou ham tin nasei jiuve. O Israel mipite! Thilpha bollou chu kei kahi ham? Ahiloule nangho nahiu ham?
en: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?
text:
EZK 18:25
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in Pakaiyin thilpha chu abollou ham tin nasei jiuve. O Israel mipite! Thilpha bollou chu kei kahi ham? Ahiloule nangho nahiu ham?
English: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?

tcz: Michonpha ho chu achonphat nauva konna akihei mang uva chonset thil abolpat tah uva ahile hiche a chu thi diu ahi. Henge achonset nau jeh a chu thidiu ahi.
en: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.
text:
EZK 18:26
Thadou: Michonpha ho chu achonphat nauva konna akihei mang uva chonset thil abolpat tah uva ahile hiche a chu thi diu ahi. Henge achonset nau jeh a chu thidiu ahi.
English: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.

tcz: Chuleh migilou ho chun agitlou nauva konna ahung kihei doh uva, dan ajui uva, chuleh thilpha leh adih abol uva ahileh, amaho chun ahinkhou chu akihuhdoh diu ahi.
en: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.
text:
EZK 18:27
Thadou: Chuleh migilou ho chun agitlou nauva konna ahung kihei doh uva, dan ajui uva, chuleh thilpha leh adih abol uva ahileh, amaho chun ahinkhou chu akihuhdoh diu ahi.
English: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.

tcz: Achonset nauva konna kiheidoh dinga akigel lhah nau alunggel ho jeh a amaho chu hing diu ahi. Hitobang mi chu thilou ding ahi.
en: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.
text:
EZK 18:28
Thadou: Achonset nauva konna kiheidoh dinga akigel lhah nau alunggel ho jeh a amaho chu hing diu ahi. Hitobang mi chu thilou ding ahi.
English: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in Israel mipi ten hitin aseije uve. Pakaiyin thilpha abolpoi, “O Israel mipite, thilpha bollou chu nangho nahiuvin kei kahipoi.”
en: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways unfair?
text:
EZK 18:29
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in Israel mipi ten hitin aseije uve. Pakaiyin thilpha abolpoi, “O Israel mipite, thilpha bollou chu nangho nahiuvin kei kahipoi.”
English: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways unfair?

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu O Israel mipite, nachon nau dungjui cheh uva khat cheh a nachung thu katan ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije. Nalung heijun lang chule nachonset nauva kon in keihei mangun kisuhmang sah hih un.
en: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord GOD. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.
text:
EZK 18:30
Thadou: Hiche jeh a chu O Israel mipite, nachon nau dungjui cheh uva khat cheh a nachung thu katan ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije. Nalung heijun lang chule nachonset nauva kon in keihei mangun kisuhmang sah hih un.
English: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord GOD. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.

tcz: Doumah mah nabol chengseu chu nanung languvah koijun, lungthah sem uvin lang lhagao thah neijun. Ipijeh a nathi jeng diu ham O Israel mite.
en: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?
text:
EZK 18:31
Thadou: Doumah mah nabol chengseu chu nanung languvah koijun, lungthah sem uvin lang lhagao thah neijun. Ipijeh a nathi jeng diu ham O Israel mite.
English: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?

tcz: Kinung heijun lang hingun, nathi diu kadeipoi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord GOD. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!
text:
EZK 18:32
Thadou: Kinung heijun lang hingun, nathi diu kadeipoi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord GOD. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!

tcz: Hiche thi lhahna la a hi Israel leng chapate dingin sah peh in.
en: “Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
text:
EZK 19:1
Thadou: Hiche thi lhahna la a hi Israel leng chapate dingin sah peh in.
English: “Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

tcz: Nanu chu ipi ham? Keipi ho lah a keipi api chu ahi. Keipi lagol ho lah a luma chuleh anoute akivah ahi.
en: and say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.
text:
EZK 19:2
Thadou: Nanu chu ipi ham? Keipi ho lah a keipi api chu ahi. Keipi lagol ho lah a luma chuleh anoute akivah ahi.
English: and say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.
