tcz: Leng Jehoiachin sohchan kal kum somleni channa Bulte nithum lhinni hin Pakaija konin hichethu hi kahenga ahung lhunge.
en: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 26:1
Thadou: Leng Jehoiachin sohchan kal kum somleni channa Bulte nithum lhinni hin Pakaija konin hichethu hi kahenga ahung lhunge.
English: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: Mihem chapa, Jerusalem lhuhna chunga kipana aneiyin, amanu solam jotna haosatah aluina lampi chu akitum hong tai, aha tin aseije. Chule keima agou ding kahitai. Amanu ahom keuva akikoi tah jeh a chu keiman kahao sah ding ahitai.
en: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;’
text:
EZK 26:2
Thadou: Mihem chapa, Jerusalem lhuhna chunga kipana aneiyin, amanu solam jotna haosatah aluina lampi chu akitum hong tai, aha tin aseije. Chule keima agou ding kahitai. Amanu ahom keuva akikoi tah jeh a chu keiman kahao sah ding ahitai.
English: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;’

tcz: Ajeh chu keima thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Keima namelmapa kahin, O Tyre, twikhanglen'a twi kinongin vapam atah a tah banga nam tamtah nangma douding kahin puidoh ding ahi.
en: therefore the Lord GOD says, ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.
text:
EZK 26:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu keima thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Keima namelmapa kahin, O Tyre, twikhanglen'a twi kinongin vapam atah a tah banga nam tamtah nangma douding kahin puidoh ding ahi.
English: therefore the Lord GOD says, ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.

tcz: Amahon Tyre kulbang ho asuhmang uva chule insang ho chu akoi chim diu ahi. Aleiset ho jouse kakhodoh a song lheo keoseh kahi sah ding ahi.
en: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.
text:
EZK 26:4
Thadou: Amahon Tyre kulbang ho asuhmang uva chule insang ho chu akoi chim diu ahi. Aleiset ho jouse kakhodoh a song lheo keoseh kahi sah ding ahi.
English: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.

tcz: Keimahi twikhanglen'a songpi a kapan ding ngaman hon alen asejal nao kahi ding ahi tin keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kaseisa ahitai. Amaho namtin vaipi anchah a pang diu ahi.
en: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.
text:
EZK 26:5
Thadou: Keimahi twikhanglen'a songpi a kapan ding ngaman hon alen asejal nao kahi ding ahi tin keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kaseisa ahitai. Amaho namtin vaipi anchah a pang diu ahi.
English: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.

tcz: Chule agam lailung penna kho jong chu chemjama kasuhmang ding ahi. Hiteng chule amahon keima Pakai kahi ahet diu ahi.
en: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’
text:
EZK 26:6
Thadou: Chule agam lailung penna kho jong chu chemjama kasuhmang ding ahi. Hiteng chule amahon keima Pakai kahi ahet diu ahi.
English: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’

tcz: Hichehi Pakai thusei ahi: Keiman Tyre douna leng Nebuchadnezzar chu sahlanga konna kahin puiding ahi. Ama chu leng ho leng ahin chule asakolho, sakol kangtalai ho, kangtalai tolho chule sepai tamtah ahin puiding ahi.
en: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.
text:
EZK 26:7
Thadou: Hichehi Pakai thusei ahi: Keiman Tyre douna leng Nebuchadnezzar chu sahlanga konna kahin puiding ahi. Ama chu leng ho leng ahin chule asakolho, sakol kangtalai ho, kangtalai tolho chule sepai tamtah ahin puiding ahi.
English: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.

tcz: Amapan nagam lailunga kho ho asuhbei ding ahi. Hiteng leh aman leisang asema kulpi nakai khuma chule nangma douna ding lum aset thoma nahin bulu ding ahi.
en: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.
text:
EZK 26:8
Thadou: Amapan nagam lailunga kho ho asuhbei ding ahi. Hiteng leh aman leisang asema kulpi nakai khuma chule nangma douna ding lum aset thoma nahin bulu ding ahi.
English: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.

tcz: Amahon nakul bang ho chu thingtum lentah tah a akhet chim uva chule nainsang ho chu seh a akhet chim diu ahi.
en: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.
text:
EZK 26:9
Thadou: Amahon nakul bang ho chu thingtum lentah tah a akhet chim uva chule nainsang ho chu seh a akhet chim diu ahi.
English: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.

tcz: Sakol tin kika ho chun na khopi chu achil thanga vutvai asoding chule sakol kangtalai le sakol kang ho chun nakul bang ho chu aholing ding, huipi gopi kitho banga kelkot kitum honga chuteng lut diu ahi.
en: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.
text:
EZK 26:10
Thadou: Sakol tin kika ho chun na khopi chu achil thanga vutvai asoding chule sakol kangtalai le sakol kang ho chun nakul bang ho chu aholing ding, huipi gopi kitho banga kelkot kitum honga chuteng lut diu ahi.
English: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.

tcz: Amapa sakol tou miho chun nakhopi lamlen jouse achot chin soh diu ahi. Amahon namite asattel gamuva chule akhompi detlai ho jouse aholing sohdiu ahi.
en: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.
text:
EZK 26:11
Thadou: Amapa sakol tou miho chun nakhopi lamlen jouse achot chin soh diu ahi. Amahon namite asattel gamuva chule akhompi detlai ho jouse aholing sohdiu ahi.
English: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.

tcz: Amahon nahaosat najouse uva chu kiveina thil jouse akichom mang uva chule nabang jouse avohchim soh diu ahi. Amahon nadei tah nain hou asuhmang uva, nasong hou le nain thing chule nalei phalai jouse twikhanglen'a aselut diu ahi.
en: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.
text:
EZK 26:12
Thadou: Amahon nahaosat najouse uva chu kiveina thil jouse akichom mang uva chule nabang jouse avohchim soh diu ahi. Amahon nadei tah nain hou asuhmang uva, nasong hou le nain thing chule nalei phalai jouse twikhanglen'a aselut diu ahi.
English: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.

tcz: Keiman nalasah nau tumging thei jouse kasuh thip ding ahi. Naselang dah gin jouse jong namite lah a kinung jah kit louhel ding ahi.
en: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.
text:
EZK 26:13
Thadou: Keiman nalasah nau tumging thei jouse kasuh thip ding ahi. Naselang dah gin jouse jong namite lah a kinung jah kit louhel ding ahi.
English: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.

tcz: Keiman natwikol gam songlheo keuseh kasosah a ngamanho dinga lense namun kahisah ding ahi. Nangin avella nanung sah doh kit lou hel ding ahi, hijeh a chu kei Pakaiyin kasei ahi, henge keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kasei ahi.
en: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I the LORD have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 26:14
Thadou: Keiman natwikol gam songlheo keuseh kasosah a ngamanho dinga lense namun kahisah ding ahi. Nangin avella nanung sah doh kit lou hel ding ahi, hijeh a chu kei Pakaiyin kasei ahi, henge keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kasei ahi.
English: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I the LORD have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakaiyin Tyre henga asei ahi. Nangma lhuh ginna chu twikhanglen pam jouse kihot ling ding ahi. Hichu kithana mun a amachang ho pen pen gin tobang hiding ahi.
en: “The Lord GOD says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?
text:
EZK 26:15
Thadou: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakaiyin Tyre henga asei ahi. Nangma lhuh ginna chu twikhanglen pam jouse kihot ling ding ahi. Hichu kithana mun a amachang ho pen pen gin tobang hiding ahi.
English: “The Lord GOD says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?

tcz: Kong kai munna vaihom ho jousen alal tounauva konna hung kum lhauva chuleh aleng ponsil chol jong akisutlhah uva chule aponsil hoi lai jouse jong asutlhah diu ahi. Amaho chu nangma kisuhmang najeh a chu tijatna kithing pum puma tolla tou diu ahi.
en: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.
text:
EZK 26:16
Thadou: Kong kai munna vaihom ho jousen alal tounauva konna hung kum lhauva chuleh aleng ponsil chol jong akisutlhah uva chule aponsil hoi lai jouse jong asutlhah diu ahi. Amaho chu nangma kisuhmang najeh a chu tijatna kithing pum puma tolla tou diu ahi.
English: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.

tcz: Hiteng chuleh nang dinga kap loi loijuva hiche thi lhahna la hi asah diu ahi. O minthang tah a twikol gam khatvei twikhanglen vaihompa iti danna naki sumang jeng hitam? Namite kong sepai thahat nanei ho khatvei vannoi leiset a kichat uma kithang
en: They will take up a lamentation over you, and tell you, “How you are destroyed, who were inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, who was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who caused their terror to be on all who lived there!”
text:
EZK 26:17
Thadou: Hiteng chuleh nang dinga kap loi loijuva hiche thi lhahna la hi asah diu ahi. O minthang tah a twikol gam khatvei twikhanglen vaihompa iti danna naki sumang jeng hitam? Namite kong sepai thahat nanei ho khatvei vannoi leiset a kichat uma kithang
English: They will take up a lamentation over you, and tell you, “How you are destroyed, who were inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, who was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who caused their terror to be on all who lived there!”

tcz: Tun twikhanglen pam jouse nangma lhuh jeh in akithonge. Nakitol mang chun twikol gamho alung thoi tai.
en: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall. Yes, the islands that are in the sea will be dismayed at your departure.’
text:
EZK 26:18
Thadou: Tun twikhanglen pam jouse nangma lhuh jeh in akithonge. Nakitol mang chun twikol gamho alung thoi tai.
English: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall. Yes, the islands that are in the sea will be dismayed at your departure.’

English: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep on you, and the great waters cover you,

en: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with those who go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.
text:
EZK 26:20
Thadou: Masang laiya anakum suh sa lah a lha dinga kokhuh sunga kasol lhah ding nahi. Na khopi chu ahom keuva kajama leinoiya kavui ding ahitai. Mihing gam'a hi nangma jabolna nachan louhel ding ahitai.
English: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with those who go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.

tcz: Keiman nangma kichat tijatna munna kahin puilutna chuleh avella naum kit tah lou ding ahitai. Henge nakihol in ahinlah nangma nakinung mukit lou ding ahi tia thaneitah Pakaiyin kaseidoh sa ahi.
en: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord GOD.”

EZK 26:21
Thadou: Keiman nangma kichat tijatna munna kahin puilutna chuleh avella naum kit tah lou ding ahitai. Henge nakihol in ahinlah nangma nakinung mukit lou ding ahi tia thaneitah Pakaiyin kaseidoh sa ahi.
English: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord GOD.”

tcz: Hichun Pakai thusei hiche hi kahenga ahung lhunge.
en: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
text:
EZK 27:1
Thadou: Hichun Pakai thusei hiche hi kahenga ahung lhunge.
English: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,

tcz: “Mihem chapa, Tyre a dinga thi lhahna la a sah peh in.
en: “You, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;

tcz: Vannoi leisetna sumkol veina munpi pen twikhanglen'a kongkai mun thupitah chu ahi. Thanei natah Pakaija kon hiche thuhi Tyre mite pen. O Tyre! Nangman nakiletsah in kaoi chamkim soh e nati.
en: and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord GOD says: “You, Tyre, have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’
text:
EZK 27:3
Thadou: Vannoi leisetna sumkol veina munpi pen twikhanglen'a kongkai mun thupitah chu ahi. Thanei natah Pakaija kon hiche thuhi Tyre mite pen. O Tyre! Nangman nakiletsah in kaoi chamkim soh e nati.
English: and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord GOD says: “You, Tyre, have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’

tcz: Nangin nagamgi twikhanglen chanin nakeh lenne. Nasem doh hon nasem hoi chamkim soh tauve.
en: Your borders are in the heart of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.
text:
EZK 27:4
Thadou: Nangin nagamgi twikhanglen chanin nakeh lenne. Nasem doh hon nasem hoi chamkim soh tauve.
English: Your borders are in the heart of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.

tcz: Nangma kong innei lentah tobang nahi. Nangma Senir gam'a chahthing hoi pen pena kisem nahi. Kong chunga kitung doh dingin amahon Lebanon gam Cedar thing alauve.
en: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir. They have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
text:
EZK 27:5
Thadou: Nangma kong innei lentah tobang nahi. Nangma Senir gam'a chahthing hoi pen pena kisem nahi. Kong chunga kitung doh dingin amahon Lebanon gam Cedar thing alauve.
English: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir. They have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.

tcz: Bashan gam'a gangpi thing ho chun nakong khe ho nasuipeh uve. Nalhong ho chu Cyprus twipang chah thinggo kisem ahin, asung saiha a kisem ahi.
en: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan. They have made your benches of ivory inlaid in cypress wood from the islands of Kittim.
text:
EZK 27:6
Thadou: Bashan gam'a gangpi thing ho chun nakong khe ho nasuipeh uve. Nalhong ho chu Cyprus twipang chah thinggo kisem ahin, asung saiha a kisem ahi.
English: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan. They have made your benches of ivory inlaid in cypress wood from the islands of Kittim.

tcz: Nakong tolna ponlap chu Egypt gam'a tupat ponnem hoipen a kisem ahin, chule nachunga chun ponlap bangin akijal e. Nangma nakong khunna chu twikhanglen panga konna vandum le ponsandup a vah set kisem noija chun nadinge.
en: Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, that it might be to you for a banner. Blue and purple from the islands of Elishah was your awning.
text:
EZK 27:7
Thadou: Nakong tolna ponlap chu Egypt gam'a tupat ponnem hoipen a kisem ahin, chule nachunga chun ponlap bangin akijal e. Nangma nakong khunna chu twikhanglen panga konna vandum le ponsandup a vah set kisem noija chun nadinge.
English: Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, that it might be to you for a banner. Blue and purple from the islands of Elishah was your awning.

tcz: Nakong khe jap a pang ho chu Sidon leh Arvad a kon ahiuvin, nakong suija pang ho chu Tyre mun khutthem ho ahiuve.
en: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your wise men, Tyre, were in you. They were your pilots.
text:
EZK 27:8
Thadou: Nakong khe jap a pang ho chu Sidon leh Arvad a kon ahiuvin, nakong suija pang ho chu Tyre mun khutthem ho ahiuve.
English: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your wise men, Tyre, were in you. They were your pilots.

tcz: Geballa kon khut them mihon akong chu twilut louna dingin athoimat peh un ahi. Asumkol veina khantouna ding chun gamtinna kon in thilpoh pumin kong tol hon kong ahin tollut lut uve.
en: The old men of Gebal and its wise men were your repairers of ship seams in you. All the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to deal in your merchandise.
text:
EZK 27:9
Thadou: Geballa kon khut them mihon akong chu twilut louna dingin athoimat peh un ahi. Asumkol veina khantouna ding chun gamtinna kon in thilpoh pumin kong tol hon kong ahin tollut lut uve.
English: The old men of Gebal and its wise men were your repairers of ship seams in you. All the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to deal in your merchandise.

tcz: Gamla tah a um Persia, Lydia chuleh Libya a hung kon pasal ho chun thahat nasepai a chun apang uve. Amahon nangma nasatah a najanao vetsah in alummu leh apho hou nabanga akhai uve.
en: “‘“Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war. They hung the shield and helmet in you. They showed your beauty.
text:
EZK 27:10
Thadou: Gamla tah a um Persia, Lydia chuleh Libya a hung kon pasal ho chun thahat nasepai a chun apang uve. Amahon nangma nasatah a najanao vetsah in alummu leh apho hou nabanga akhai uve.
English: “‘“Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war. They hung the shield and helmet in you. They showed your beauty.

tcz: Arvad leh Helech a kon pasal ho chu kulbang chunga chun ading uve. Na insung ho jong Gammad a kon mihon nasah peh u ahi. Nahoina suh chamkimnan alumu nabanga akhai uve.
en: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around, and valiant men were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around. They have perfected your beauty.
text:
EZK 27:11
Thadou: Arvad leh Helech a kon pasal ho chu kulbang chunga chun ading uve. Na insung ho jong Gammad a kon mihon nasah peh u ahi. Nahoina suh chamkimnan alumu nabanga akhai uve.
English: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around, and valiant men were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around. They have perfected your beauty.

tcz: Tarshish miten kivei miho chu nathil joh lah a dangka, thih, langva, chule ngen ho chu ahung kichoh jiuvin ahi.
en: “‘“Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead.
text:
EZK 27:12
Thadou: Tarshish miten kivei miho chu nathil joh lah a dangka, thih, langva, chule ngen ho chu ahung kichoh jiuvin ahi.
English: “‘“Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead.

tcz: Greece gam, Tubal gam, chuleh Meshech gam'a konna kivei miho chun soh ho le sum enga kisem thilkeu ho chu nang ho toh kiveito nading in ahin pouve.
en: “‘“Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.
text:
EZK 27:13
Thadou: Greece gam, Tubal gam, chuleh Meshech gam'a konna kivei miho chun soh ho le sum enga kisem thilkeu ho chu nang ho toh kiveito nading in ahin pouve.
English: “‘“Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.

tcz: Beth-togarmah a konin sakol, sakol kangtalai chule sangan ho jouse chu nathilkeu toh kithot to dingin ahunguve.
en: “‘“They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules.
text:
EZK 27:14
Thadou: Beth-togarmah a konin sakol, sakol kangtalai chule sangan ho jouse chu nathilkeu toh kithot to dingin ahunguve.
English: “‘“They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules.

tcz: Dedan a konna kivei miho chun saiha ho leh ebony thinga kisem thilkeu ho chu thil manna peh dingin ahin pouvin, hiti chun twikhanglen panga kailhang munho tamtah chu nangma thuneina noija um ahiuve.
en: “‘“The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and ebony in exchange.
text:
EZK 27:15
Thadou: Dedan a konna kivei miho chun saiha ho leh ebony thinga kisem thilkeu ho chu thil manna peh dingin ahin pouvin, hiti chun twikhanglen panga kailhang munho tamtah chu nangma thuneina noija um ahiuve.
English: “‘“The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and ebony in exchange.

tcz: Syria ten asumkol vei mihou chu nahao satna thilkeu jat tamtah ho chodin ahin solluve. Amahon songmantam engdum, ponsandup, pahcha jemhoi tah tah a kikhong pon, tupat ponnem chule Coral leh Ruby songmantam a kisem kijepna ho a kisumkol veipi to dingin ahin pouve.
en: “‘“Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.
text:
EZK 27:16
Thadou: Syria ten asumkol vei mihou chu nahao satna thilkeu jat tamtah ho chodin ahin solluve. Amahon songmantam engdum, ponsandup, pahcha jemhoi tah tah a kikhong pon, tupat ponnem chule Coral leh Ruby songmantam a kisem kijepna ho a kisumkol veipi to dingin ahin pouve.
English: “‘“Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.

tcz: Judah leh Israel in thih a kisem thilho Minnith na kon kilhaina suhlou chang, theichang, khoiju, Olive thao leh than namtwi ho hin nangto akivei khome.
en: “‘“Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.
text:
EZK 27:17
Thadou: Judah leh Israel in thih a kisem thilho Minnith na kon kilhaina suhlou chang, theichang, khoiju, Olive thao leh than namtwi ho hin nangto akivei khome.
English: “‘“Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.

tcz: Damuscus in asumkol vei miho chu Hebronna konin Jul eh Zahar la kon Samul kang ho ahin poh sah in, nahaosatna natilkeu ho chodin ahin sole.
en: “‘“Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
text:
EZK 27:18
Thadou: Damuscus in asumkol vei miho chu Hebronna konin Jul eh Zahar la kon Samul kang ho ahin poh sah in, nahaosatna natilkeu ho chodin ahin sole.
English: “‘“Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

tcz: Greek miho Uz a konin nasumkol veiho toh kivei khom din ahin sole. Thih a kisem, thingthal thinga kisem chule thil namtwi ho chu na thih ho toh lhet din ahin pouve.
en: “‘“Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise.
text:
EZK 27:19
Thadou: Greek miho Uz a konin nasumkol veiho toh kivei khom din ahin sole. Thih a kisem, thingthal thinga kisem chule thil namtwi ho chu na thih ho toh lhet din ahin pouve.
English: “‘“Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise.

tcz: Dedan in asumkolvei miho chun nangma toh kivei khom din kampola sakol pho mantam tah tah ho chu ahin poi.
en: “‘“Dedan was your merchant in precious saddle blankets for riding.
text:
EZK 27:20
Thadou: Dedan in asumkolvei miho chun nangma toh kivei khom din kampola sakol pho mantam tah tah ho chu ahin poi.
English: “‘“Dedan was your merchant in precious saddle blankets for riding.

tcz: Arabian te leh Kedar leng chapaten asumkol vei miho chu kelngoi nou ho le kelngoichal ho chu nang thilkeu to kilhet to din ahin pouvin ahi.
en: “‘“Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favorite dealers in lambs, rams, and goats. In these, they were your merchants.
text:
EZK 27:21
Thadou: Arabian te leh Kedar leng chapaten asumkol vei miho chu kelngoi nou ho le kelngoichal ho chu nang thilkeu to kilhet to din ahin pouvin ahi.
English: “‘“Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favorite dealers in lambs, rams, and goats. In these, they were your merchants.

tcz: Sehba leh Raamah a sumkolvei miho chu thing ai-eng, songmantam chule sana ho chu ajat jousen nangma thih akisem thilho toh kilheh dingin ahunguve.
en: “‘“The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the best of all spices, all precious stones, and gold.
text:
EZK 27:22
Thadou: Sehba leh Raamah a sumkolvei miho chu thing ai-eng, songmantam chule sana ho chu ajat jousen nangma thih akisem thilho toh kilheh dingin ahunguve.
English: “‘“The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the best of all spices, all precious stones, and gold.

tcz: Haran, Canneh, Eden, Sheba, Asshur chule Kilmad ho jong asumkol veimi ho toh ahunguve.
en: “‘“Haran, Canneh, Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders.
text:
EZK 27:23
Thadou: Haran, Canneh, Eden, Sheba, Asshur chule Kilmad ho jong asumkol veimi ho toh ahunguve.
English: “‘“Haran, Canneh, Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders.

tcz: Amaho chun deitum pon jatchom cjhoma kisem ho –pondum, pon kijem pah bitbet ho, lhong ponpha apolla kisem ho kijel tupma chule khaova kikantup ho ahin pouvin ahi.
en: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in cedar chests of rich clothing bound with cords, among your merchandise.
text:
EZK 27:24
Thadou: Amaho chun deitum pon jatchom cjhoma kisem ho –pondum, pon kijem pah bitbet ho, lhong ponpha apolla kisem ho kijel tupma chule khaova kikantup ho ahin pouvin ahi.
English: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in cedar chests of rich clothing bound with cords, among your merchandise.

tcz: Tarshish ho kong len ho chu nanga ding twikhanglen chunga kiveina gari ho chu ahiuve. Na twikol gamsunga nathih john a inho a chun agei chan adimin ahi.
en: “‘“The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise. You were replenished and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.
text:
EZK 27:25
Thadou: Tarshish ho kong len ho chu nanga ding twikhanglen chunga kiveina gari ho chu ahiuve. Na twikol gamsunga nathih john a inho a chun agei chan adimin ahi.
English: “‘“The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise. You were replenished and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.

tcz: Ahivangin ven, nakong tol hon twikhanglen na huipi gopi kitholah a natollut u ahitai. Solam kong kai mun thahattah chun nakong atatkha in twikhanglen lailunga chun napolut tai.
en: Your rowers have brought you into great waters. The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.
text:
EZK 27:26
Thadou: Ahivangin ven, nakong tol hon twikhanglen na huipi gopi kitholah a natollut u ahitai. Solam kong kai mun thahattah chun nakong atatkha in twikhanglen lailunga chun napolut tai.
English: Your rowers have brought you into great waters. The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.

tcz: Imajouse mangah ahitai. Nahaosatna jouse leh nachihna jouse leh nakong tolho leh nakong lamkai te ahiuvin, nakong semho ahin, nasumkol veiho ahin, chule na gollhang ho ahiuvin, namanthah nikho chun nakong sunga touho jouse twikhanglen tollanga alhalhum soh tauve.
en: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise, your mariners, your pilots, your repairers of ship seams, the dealers in your merchandise, and all your men of war who are in you, with all your company which is among you, will fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your ruin.
text:
EZK 27:27
Thadou: Imajouse mangah ahitai. Nahaosatna jouse leh nachihna jouse leh nakong tolho leh nakong lamkai te ahiuvin, nakong semho ahin, nasumkol veiho ahin, chule na gollhang ho ahiuvin, namanthah nikho chun nakong sunga touho jouse twikhanglen tollanga alhalhum soh tauve.
English: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise, your mariners, your pilots, your repairers of ship seams, the dealers in your merchandise, and all your men of war who are in you, with all your company which is among you, will fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your ruin.

tcz: Twikhanglen panga nakhop ho chu kong lamkaite kichat tijat a aka jeh u chun akihot lhu gam tauve.
en: At the sound of the cry of your pilots, the pasture lands will shake.
text:
EZK 27:28
Thadou: Twikhanglen panga nakhop ho chu kong lamkaite kichat tijat a aka jeh u chun akihot lhu gam tauve.
English: At the sound of the cry of your pilots, the pasture lands will shake.

tcz: Nakong khechun jousen akong u adalha tauve. Kong tolho leh kong lamkai ho chu twikhanglen pam neldi lah a chun ahung ding uve.
en: All who handle the oars, the mariners and all the pilots of the sea, will come down from their ships. They will stand on the land,
text:
EZK 27:29
Thadou: Nakong khechun jousen akong u adalha tauve. Kong tolho leh kong lamkai ho chu twikhanglen pam neldi lah a chun ahung ding uve.
English: All who handle the oars, the mariners and all the pilots of the sea, will come down from their ships. They will stand on the land,

tcz: Amaho hapen in apeng uvin chuleh lhase tah in akap uve. Amahon aluchung uvah leivui akithe khumun leivui lah a akitang leuve.
en: and will cause their voice to be heard over you, and will cry bitterly. They will cast up dust on their heads. They will wallow in the ashes.
text:
EZK 27:30
Thadou: Amaho hapen in apeng uvin chuleh lhase tah in akap uve. Amahon aluchung uvah leivui akithe khumun leivui lah a akitang leuve.
English: and will cause their voice to be heard over you, and will cry bitterly. They will cast up dust on their heads. They will wallow in the ashes.

tcz: Amahon nachunga alunggim najeh in alujang sam u akivo chai uvin chule khaodip pon akisil uve. Nanga dingin ama lungna tah in akap uvin, chuleh lunghem tah in aum uve.
en: They will make themselves bald for you, and clothe themselves with sackcloth. They will weep for you in bitterness of soul, with bitter mourning.
text:
EZK 27:31
Thadou: Amahon nachunga alunggim najeh in alujang sam u akivo chai uvin chule khaodip pon akisil uve. Nanga dingin ama lungna tah in akap uvin, chuleh lunghem tah in aum uve.
English: They will make themselves bald for you, and clothe themselves with sackcloth. They will weep for you in bitterness of soul, with bitter mourning.

tcz: Nang chunga peng loi loijun akap pum uvin chuleh nalung hem piuve. Amahon hiche thilhahna la hi lungkham tah in asauve. Tyre tobang khopi dang ana um kham! Tun twikhanglen tol lang in thipchet in aumtai.
en: In their wailing they will take up a lamentation for you, and lament over you, saying, ‘Who is there like Tyre, like her who is brought to silence in the middle of the sea?’
text:
EZK 27:32
Thadou: Nang chunga peng loi loijun akap pum uvin chuleh nalung hem piuve. Amahon hiche thilhahna la hi lungkham tah in asauve. Tyre tobang khopi dang ana um kham! Tun twikhanglen tol lang in thipchet in aumtai.
English: In their wailing they will take up a lamentation for you, and lament over you, saying, ‘Who is there like Tyre, like her who is brought to silence in the middle of the sea?’

tcz: Nakiveina thil ho chun namtin vaipi tamtah ngaichat abulhit peh in leiset ning langa lengho chu nakiveina chun ahaosah e.
en: When your wares came from the seas, you filled many peoples. You enriched the kings of the earth with the multitude of your riches and of your merchandise.
text:
EZK 27:33
Thadou: Nakiveina thil ho chun namtin vaipi tamtah ngaichat abulhit peh in leiset ning langa lengho chu nakiveina chun ahaosah e.
English: When your wares came from the seas, you filled many peoples. You enriched the kings of the earth with the multitude of your riches and of your merchandise.

tcz: Tun nang kong kitatgep chu nahitai. Twikhanglen toa chip deh a um nahi. Nakiveina thilho leh kong sunga natongho jouse nangma toh nakum suh khom tauve.
en: In the time that you were broken by the seas, in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company fell within you.
text:
EZK 27:34
Thadou: Tun nang kong kitatgep chu nahitai. Twikhanglen toa chip deh a um nahi. Nakiveina thilho leh kong sunga natongho jouse nangma toh nakum suh khom tauve.
English: In the time that you were broken by the seas, in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company fell within you.

tcz: Twikhanglen pama cheng ho jouse tijat kichat umtah nevangsetna jeh in akicha gam tauve. Aleng teu kichat in adim tauve, chule maimol deh duh in aveuve.
en: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you, and their kings are horribly afraid. They are troubled in their face.
text:
EZK 27:35
Thadou: Twikhanglen pama cheng ho jouse tijat kichat umtah nevangsetna jeh in akicha gam tauve. Aleng teu kichat in adim tauve, chule maimol deh duh in aveuve.
English: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you, and their kings are horribly afraid. They are troubled in their face.

tcz: Namtin vaipi lah sumkolvei mihon nangma mitmun alu nathin khum taove. Ajeh chu nangma tijat umtah naki chaitan, chule naa hung nung umdoh kit louhel ding ahitai.
en: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you. You have come to a terrible end, and you will be no more.”’”
text:
EZK 27:36
Thadou: Namtin vaipi lah sumkolvei mihon nangma mitmun alu nathin khum taove. Ajeh chu nangma tijat umtah naki chaitan, chule naa hung nung umdoh kit louhel ding ahitai.
English: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you. You have come to a terrible end, and you will be no more.”’”

tcz: Hiti hin thaneitah Pakaija konin hiche thusei hi kahenga ahung lhunge.
en: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,

EZK 28:1
Thadou: Hiti hin thaneitah Pakaija konin hiche thusei hi kahenga ahung lhunge.
English: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,

tcz: Mihem chapa thaneitah Pakai thusei hiche hi Tyre leng chapa koma seipeh in, nangman loupi tah a nakiletsahna chun keima Pathen khat kahi tin naseiyin tukhanglen lailunga pathente touna alal touna chunga katouve natin, ahivangin nangma mihem mai mai bou nahin, chule Pathen nahipoi. en: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the middle of the seas;’ yet you are man, and no god, though you set your heart as the heart of a god—
text:
EZK 28:2
Thadou: Mihem chapa thaneitah Pakai thusei hiche hi Tyre leng chapa koma seipeh in, nangman loupi tah a nakiletsahna chun keima Pathen khat kahi tin naseiyin tukhanglen lailunga pathente touna alal touna chunga katouve natin, ahivangin nangma mihem mai mai bou nahin, chule Pathen nahipoi. Nangin pathen kahi tia nakiletsah lheh jeng vang'in
English: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the middle of the seas;’ yet you are man, and no god, though you set your heart as the heart of a god—

tcz: Nangma Daniel sangin chingjo in nakigel in chule namanga konna hetmo akiselguh imacha aumpoi tin nagelle.’
en: behold, you are wiser than Daniel. There is no secret that is hidden from you.
text:
EZK 28:3
Thadou: Nangma Daniel sangin chingjo in nakigel in chule namanga konna hetmo akiselguh imacha aumpoi tin nagelle.’
English: behold, you are wiser than Daniel. There is no secret that is hidden from you.

tcz: Nachihna leh nathil hetkhen theina jallin neile gou tampi nakilam doh tai. Sana leh dangka nagou dingin
en: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasuries.
text:
EZK 28:4
Thadou: Nachihna leh nathil hetkhen theina jallin neile gou tampi nakilam doh tai. Sana leh dangka nagou dingin
English: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasuries.

tcz: Henge nachihna chun haosatah in nasem doh in chule nahaosat nachun nalung thim akiletsah e.
en: By your great wisdom and by your trading you have increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches—”
text:
EZK 28:5
Thadou: Henge nachihna chun haosatah in nasem doh in chule nahaosat nachun nalung thim akiletsah e.
English: By your great wisdom and by your trading you have increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches—”

text:
EZK 28:6
Thadou: Hijeh a chu hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Nangman Pathen tobang bang aching kahi tia nagel jeh chun,
English: “‘therefore the Lord GOD says: “Because you have set your heart as the heart of God,

en: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you, the terrible of the nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom. They will defile your brightness.
text:
EZK 28:7

tcz: Hijeh a chu, hiche hi thaneitah Pakaiyin kaseije. Keiman Egypt gam Nebuchadnezzar, Babylon Lengpa kapeh ding ahitai. Aman ahaosatna jouse akipoh doh a anei jouse achomgam peh a chutileh asepai ho chu achan diuva lom apeh jou ding ahi.

English: In the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: Mihem chapa hiche thuhi Egypt lengpa Pharaoh leh amite seipeh in.
en: “Son of man, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt and his multitude: ‘Whom are you like in your greatness?
text:
EZK 31:2
Thadou: Mihem chapa hiche thuhi Egypt lengpa Pharaoh leh amite seipeh in.
English: “Son of man, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt and his multitude: ‘Whom are you like in your greatness?

tcz: Nangma naloupina chu koija toh natekah pi tadem? Lebanon a Cedar thing phung tobang nabah hoitah tah gammang sung le thim jeng ajih lhang lah a kitung doh jenga thahat Assyria tobang nahi.
en: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.
text:
EZK 31:3
Thadou: Nangma naloupina chu koija toh natekah pi tadem? Lebanon a Cedar thing phung tobang nabah hoitah tah gammang sung le thim jeng ajih lhang lah a kitung doh jenga thahat Assyria tobang nahi.
English: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.

tcz: Twi thuhtah in sangtah le abah bompem puma akhandoh theina dinga achapnou jing jeng ahi. Akimvel jousea vadung banga alonsah a akoma thingphung dang jouse jong vadung neo hon alonkhum ahi.
en: The waters nourished it. The deep made it to grow. Its rivers ran all around its plantation. It sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.
text:
EZK 31:4
Thadou: Twi thuhtah in sangtah le abah bompem puma akhandoh theina dinga achapnou jing jeng ahi. Akimvel jousea vadung banga alonsah a akoma thingphung dang jouse jong vadung neo hon alonkhum ahi.
English: The waters nourished it. The deep made it to grow. Its rivers ran all around its plantation. It sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.

tcz: Hiche thing lentah ho chu sangtah tah in akhangin, akimvella thingphung dang jouse sangin asangjoi. Ajung khona abul twi thalhin jeh chun akhangtou cheh cheh in abah ho jong saotah tah le lentah tah aphan ahi.
en: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field; and its boughs were multiplied. Its branches became long by reason of many waters, when it spread them out.
text:
EZK 31:5
Thadou: Hiche thing lentah ho chu sangtah tah in akhangin, akimvella thingphung dang jouse sangin asangjoi. Ajung khona abul twi thalhin jeh chun akhangtou cheh cheh in abah ho jong saotah tah le lentah tah aphan ahi.
English: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field; and its boughs were multiplied. Its branches became long by reason of many waters, when it spread them out.

tcz: Chungleng vachate abah lah a chun akichol ngauvin chule anoilima gamsa ho jousen anou sonan amang uve. Vannoi leisetna nam minthang jouse alim noija chun achenguve.
en: All the birds of the sky made their nests in its boughs. Under its branches, all the animals of the field gave birth to their young. All great nations lived under its shadow.
text:
EZK 31:6
Thadou: Chungleng vachate abah lah a chun akichol ngauvin chule anoilima gamsa ho jousen anou sonan amang uve. Vannoi leisetna nam minthang jouse alim noija chun achenguve.
English: All the birds of the sky made their nests in its boughs. Under its branches, all the animals of the field gave birth to their young. All great nations lived under its shadow.

tcz: Ajung jouse twi thalhin namun thuh tah a akholut jeh chun adet in, chule ahoijin abahho saotah tah in ajamme.
en: Thus it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its root was by many waters.
text:
EZK 31:7
Thadou: Ajung jouse twi thalhin namun thuh tah a akholut jeh chun adet in, chule ahoijin abahho saotah tah in ajamme.
English: Thus it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its root was by many waters.

tcz: Pathen honsunga Cedar thing ho khat chan jong tet jou pontin, Cypress bah ho khat chan jong tet jou lou diu ahi. Pathen honsung a keh thingphung khat cha jong ahoina tetdin akom hung lut theiponte.
en: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it. The cypress trees were not like its branches. The pine trees were not like its branches; nor was any tree in the garden of God like it in its beauty.
text:
EZK 31:8
Thadou: Pathen honsunga Cedar thing ho khat chan jong tet jou pontin, Cypress bah ho khat chan jong tet jou lou diu ahi. Pathen honsung a keh thingphung khat cha jong ahoina tetdin akom hung lut theiponte.
English: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it. The cypress trees were not like its branches. The pine trees were not like its branches; nor was any tree in the garden of God like it in its beauty.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman hiche thingphung chu kajem hoijin ado, abah chuleh ajung jouse loupi dehsetna kapen ahi. Hiche thingphung chu Eden na Pathen honsunga thingphung dang jousen athangset piu ahije.
en: I made it beautiful by the multitude of its branches, so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied it.’
text:
EZK 31:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman hiche thingphung chu kajem hoijin ado, abah chuleh ajung jouse loupi dehsetna kapen ahi. Hiche thingphung chu Eden na Pathen honsunga thingphung dang jousen athangset piu ahije.
English: I made it beautiful by the multitude of its branches, so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied it.’

tcz: Hijeh a chu thaneitah Pakaiyin hiche thuhi a sei ahi: Egypt chu akiletsah in chule akiloupi sah tan ajeh chu adang jouse sanga sangjo a ahung khandoh a aleh in meilhang lah aphatan ahi.
en: “Therefore thus said the Lord GOD: ‘Because he is exalted in stature, and he has set his top among the thick branches, and his heart is lifted up in his height,
text:
EZK 31:10
Thadou: Hijeh a chu thaneitah Pakaiyin hiche thuhi a sei ahi: Egypt chu akiletsah in chule akiloupi sah tan ajeh chu adang jouse sanga sangjo a ahung khandoh a aleh in meilhang lah aphatan ahi.
English: “Therefore thus said the Lord GOD: ‘Because he is exalted in stature, and he has set his top among the thick branches, and his heart is lifted up in his height,

tcz: Keiman namtin vaipi lah athahat khutna kapeh doh a aman agitlou dungjuija asuhmang ding ahi. Keiman kapai dohsa ahitai.
en: I will deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He will surely deal with him. I have driven him out for his wickedness.
text:
EZK 31:11
Thadou: Keiman namtin vaipi lah athahat khutna kapeh doh a aman agitlou dungjuija asuhmang ding ahi. Keiman kapai dohsa ahitai.
English: I will deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He will surely deal with him. I have driven him out for his wickedness.

tcz: Gamdang sepai namtin vaipi kichatpan asatlhah a tolla ajamden ding ahi. Abah ho jouse agamsunga chu molsang ho a le phaicham ho a chule komthuh tah tah lah a kathethang soh ding ahi. Alim noija chengho jousen adalhah sih uva chule akijamna a chu adalhah diu ahi.
en: Foreigners, the tyrants of the nations, have cut him off and have left him. His branches have fallen on the mountains and in all the valleys, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land. All the peoples of the earth have gone down from his shadow and have left him.
text:
EZK 31:12
Thadou: Gamdang sepai namtin vaipi kichatpan asatlhah a tolla ajamden ding ahi. Abah ho jouse agamsunga chu molsang ho a le phaicham ho a chule komthuh tah tah lah a kathethang soh ding ahi. Alim noija chengho jousen adalhah sih uva chule akijamna a chu adalhah diu ahi.
English: Foreigners, the tyrants of the nations, have cut him off and have left him. His branches have fallen on the mountains and in all the valleys, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land. All the peoples of the earth have gone down from his shadow and have left him.

tcz: Chunga leng vachate akungbul chunga hung kicholdo uvintin chule gamlah a gamsate abah lah a hung geh diu ahi.
en: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches,
text:
EZK 31:13
Thadou: Chunga leng vachate akungbul chunga hung kicholdo uvintin chule gamlah a gamsate abah lah a hung geh diu ahi.
English: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches,

tcz: Namtin vaipi dangho hiche thingphung akiloupi sah a akhantouna kipapi dahen. Thutah'a konin twi kichap nou jing hen lang chule alehvum in meilhang lah phajeng jong leh, ajeh chu amaho chu thia leiset noilang thuhtah'a kumsuh dinga gotna kipesa ahitai. Leiset chunga mijouse toh kokhuh sunga kilhonkhom cheh diu ahi.
en: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, and don’t set their top among the thick boughs. Their mighty ones don’t stand up on their height, even all who drink water; for they are all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, among the children of men, with those who go down to the pit.’
text:
EZK 31:14
Thadou: Namtin vaipi dangho hiche thingphung akiloupi sah a akhantouna kipapi dahen. Thutah'a konin twi kichap nou jing hen lang chule alehvum in meilhang lah phajeng jong leh, ajeh chu amaho chu thia leiset noilang thuhtah'a kumsuh dinga gotna kipesa ahitai. Leiset chunga mijouse toh kokhuh sunga kilhonkhom cheh diu ahi.
English: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, and don’t set their top among the thick boughs. Their mighty ones don’t stand up on their height, even all who drink water; for they are all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, among the children of men, with those who go down to the pit.’

tcz: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi: Assyria in lhahkhuh ajotsuh chun keiman thuhtah'a um twinah ho apul kadou sah e. Avadung katan sah in twithalhing tah chu kagotsah tai. Lebanon chu ponvom kisilpeh in chule lou jauva thingphung ho chu kagot lhah sah tai.
en: “The Lord GOD says: ‘In the day when he went down to Sheol, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers. The great waters were stopped. I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
text:
EZK 31:15
Thadou: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi: Assyria in lhahkhuh ajotsuh chun keiman thuhtah'a um twinah ho apul kadou sah e. Avadung katan sah in twithalhing tah chu kagotsah tai. Lebanon chu ponvom kisilpeh in chule lou jauva thingphung ho chu kagot lhah sah tai.
English: “The Lord GOD says: ‘In the day when he went down to Sheol, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers. The great waters were stopped. I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

tcz: Keiman namtin vaipi hi ama lhuh husan ginna chu kichatna kihot lhusoh diu ahi, ajeh chu keiman lhan khuh kasol lhah ding chule khula ana lutsa ho chutoh noimigama kaselut ding ahi. Chule Edenna thing loupitah tah ho lah a hoi chungnung pen chule Lebanonna ahoipen pen ajung thuh tah twi thalhinna muna kholut nau leiset noilam thuh a lungmonna kihol dinga lutkhom cheh diu ahi.
en: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with those who descend into the pit. All the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.
text:
EZK 31:16
Thadou: Keiman namtin vaipi hi ama lhuh husan ginna chu kichatna kihot lhusoh diu ahi, ajeh chu keiman lhan khuh kasol lhah ding chule khula ana lutsa ho chutoh noimigama kaselut ding ahi. Chule Edenna thing loupitah tah ho lah a hoi chungnung pen chule Lebanonna ahoipen pen ajung thuh tah twi thalhinna muna kholut nau leiset noilam thuh a lungmonna kihol dinga lutkhom cheh diu ahi.
English: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with those who descend into the pit. All the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.

tcz: Apan khompi chengse jong kisumang soh a chule che mangsa ahitauve. Alim noija cheng ho jouse abonchauva lhankhuh a lutkhom cheh diu ahi.
en: They also went down into Sheol with him to those who are slain by the sword; yes, those who were his arm, who lived under his shadow in the middle of the nations.
text:
EZK 31:17
Thadou: Apan khompi chengse jong kisumang soh a chule che mangsa ahitauve. Alim noija cheng ho jouse abonchauva lhankhuh a lutkhom cheh diu ahi.
English: They also went down into Sheol with him to those who are slain by the sword; yes, those who were his arm, who lived under his shadow in the middle of the nations.

tcz: O Egypt, Eden honna thingphung hoiche pentah toh khun nangma thahat nale naloupina toh naki takah pi ding ham? Nangma tah jong namtin vaipi ho khu kokhuh sunga nakipo lut dingu ahi. Nangma tah jong chemjama ana kithatsa paidohsa ho chengse khu hiche munna chu nakijam khom cheh dingu ahi. Hiche hi Pharaoh leh amite dinga aumsa chu ahi, tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: “‘To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You will lie in the middle of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword. “‘This is Pharaoh and all his multitude,’ says the Lord GOD.”
text:
EZK 31:18
Thadou: O Egypt, Eden honna thingphung hoiche pentah toh khun nangma thahat nale naloupina toh naki takah pi ding ham? Nangma tah jong namtin vaipi ho khu kokhuh sunga nakipo lut dingu ahi. Nangma tah jong chemjama ana kithatsa paidohsa ho chengse khu hiche munna chu nakijam khom cheh dingu ahi. Hiche hi Pharaoh leh amite dinga aumsa chu ahi, tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: “‘To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You will lie in the middle of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword. “‘This is Pharaoh and all his multitude,’ says the Lord GOD.”

EZK 32:1

English: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, “the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: Mihem chapa Egypt lengpa Pharaoh pul douvin lang chule hiche thuhi seipeh in, nangma namtin vaipi lah a keipi bahkai golpai khat banga kigel ah nahin ahivangin nangma hi twikhanglen'a ganhing melse tah alen mong mong nahi bouvin, nalungin bonlhoh nasai doh in nangma vadunga chun gihsa tah in naume.
en: ‘Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and tell him, “You were likened to a young lion of the nations; yet you are as a monster in the seas. You broke out with your rivers, and troubled the waters with your feet, and fouled their rivers.”
text:
EZK 32:2
Thadou: Mihem chapa Egypt lengpa Pharaoh pul douvin lang chule hiche thuhi seipeh in, nangma namtin vaipi lah a keipi bahkai golpai khat banga kigel ah nahin ahivangin nangma hi twikhanglen'a ganhing melse tah alen mong mong nahi bouvin, nalungin bonlhoh nasai doh in nangma vadunga chun gihsa tah in naume.
English: ‘Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and tell him, “You were likened to a young lion of the nations; yet you are as a monster in the seas. You broke out with your rivers, and troubled the waters with your feet, and fouled their rivers.”

tcz: Hijeh a chu hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Keiman mitamtah kahin sol a kalen nana mat uva chule twi lah'a konna nakaidoh diu ahi.
en: The Lord GOD says: “I will spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples. They will bring you up in my net.
text:
EZK 32:3
Thadou: Hijeh a chu hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Keiman mitamtah kahin sol a kalen nana mat uva chule twi lah'a konna nakaidoh diu ahi.
English: The Lord GOD says: “I will spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples. They will bring you up in my net.

tcz: Keiman leiset chunga thidinga kadalhah ding nahi. Vanna vachate jouse nachunga kachuhsah a chuleh leiset pumpia gamsa jouse amaho leh amaho kivahna a nanei ding ahi.
en: I will leave you on the land. I will cast you out on the open field, and will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you. I will satisfy the animals of the whole earth with you.
text:
EZK 32:4
Thadou: Keiman leiset chunga thidinga kadalhah ding nahi. Vanna vachate jouse nachunga kachuhsah a chuleh leiset pumpia gamsa jouse amaho leh amaho kivahna a nanei ding ahi.
English: I will leave you on the land. I will cast you out on the open field, and will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you. I will satisfy the animals of the whole earth with you.

tcz: Keiman natahsa chu molle lhanga kathethang soh a chule tollhanga nagu kadip ding ahi.
en: I will lay your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.
text:
EZK 32:5
Thadou: Keiman natahsa chu molle lhanga kathethang soh a chule tollhanga nagu kadip ding ahi.
English: I will lay your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.

tcz: Keiman nathisan kikholhah a chu molsang jotna lampi dunga leiset kasuh chet ding chule twilam ho nathisanna agei channa kadip ding ahi.
en: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood, even to the mountains. The watercourses will be full of you.
text:
EZK 32:6
Thadou: Keiman nathisan kikholhah a chu molsang jotna lampi dunga leiset kasuh chet ding chule twilam ho nathisanna agei channa kadip ding ahi.
English: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood, even to the mountains. The watercourses will be full of you.

tcz: Keiman nangma kachop kang tengle keiman kakhumma chu ahsi ho thim den ding, nisa meilhanga katom jol a chule lha in nasal vah tahlou ding ahi.
en: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and make its stars dark. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon won’t give its light.
text:
EZK 32:7
Thadou: Keiman nangma kachop kang tengle keiman kakhumma chu ahsi ho thim den ding, nisa meilhanga katom jol a chule lha in nasal vah tahlou ding ahi.
English: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and make its stars dark. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon won’t give its light.

tcz: Keiman nalu chunga ahsi ho kathim sah a, chule nagam leiset pumpia muthim kajin sah ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseidohsa ahi.
en: I will make all the bright lights of the sky dark over you, and set darkness on your land,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 32:8
Thadou: Keiman nalu chunga ahsi ho kathim sah a, chule nagam leiset pumpia muthim kajin sah ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseidohsa ahi.
English: I will make all the bright lights of the sky dark over you, and set darkness on your land,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Nangman namukhah lou gamla tah a um namtin vaipi ho chu nangma lhuh lham thuthang kasei peh a lungdonga kaumsah ding ahi.
en: “I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring your destruction among the nations, into the countries which you have not known.
text:
EZK 32:9
Thadou: Nangman namukhah lou gamla tah a um namtin vaipi ho chu nangma lhuh lham thuthang kasei peh a lungdonga kaumsah ding ahi.
English: “I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring your destruction among the nations, into the countries which you have not known.

tcz: Henge, gam tamtah kaho linga chule nangma chungchanga aleng hou katijat sah ding ahi. Keiman nalhuh nikho tengleh kachemjam kavaipei lea a amahon akihinso theina diuva kithing tun tuna kitihot hot diu ahi.
en: Yes, I will make many peoples amazed at you, and their kings will be horribly afraid for you, when I brandish my sword before them. They will tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of your fall.”
text:
EZK 32:10
Thadou: Henge, gam tamtah kaho linga chule nangma chungchanga aleng hou katijat sah ding ahi. Keiman nalhuh nikho tengleh kachemjam kavaipei lea a amahon akihinso theina diuva kithing tun tuna kitihot hot diu ahi.
English: Yes, I will make many peoples amazed at you, and their kings will be horribly afraid for you, when I brandish my sword before them. They will tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of your fall.”

tcz: Ijeh inem itile hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Babylon lengpa chemjam chu nangma dou dinga hung ding ahi.
en: For the Lord GOD says: “The sword of the king of Babylon will come on you.
text:
EZK 32:11
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Babylon lengpa chemjam chu nangma dou dinga hung ding ahi.
English: For the Lord GOD says: “The sword of the king of Babylon will come on you.

tcz: Keiman namite chu galhat pa chemjama kasuh mang ding ahi. Namtin vaipi akichat pen teu chu amahon Egypt loupina chu asuhchip uva chule amijouse aboncha kisumang diu ahi.
en: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of the mighty. They are all the ruthless of the nations. They will bring the pride of Egypt to nothing, and all its multitude will be destroyed.
text:
EZK 32:12
Thadou: Keiman namite chu galhat pa chemjama kasuh mang ding ahi. Namtin vaipi akichat pen teu chu amahon Egypt loupina chu asuhchip uva chule amijouse aboncha kisumang diu ahi.
English: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of the mighty. They are all the ruthless of the nations. They will bring the pride of Egypt to nothing, and all its multitude will be destroyed.

tcz: Keiman na kelngoi hon hole na gancha hon lui panga hampa neho jouse kasuh mang diu ahi. Mihem hihen gancha hijongle akenga hiche twi chu achotlutna achotkang kit lou hel ding ahitai.
en: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters. The foot of man won’t trouble them any more, nor will the hoofs of animals trouble them.
text:
EZK 32:13
Thadou: Keiman na kelngoi hon hole na gancha hon lui panga hampa neho jouse kasuh mang diu ahi. Mihem hihen gancha hijongle akenga hiche twi chu achotlutna achotkang kit lou hel ding ahitai.
English: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters. The foot of man won’t trouble them any more, nor will the hoofs of animals trouble them.

tcz: Hiteng chule keiman Egypt gam twi chu thip chetna hung um intin, chule vadung Olive thao bangin nem heuvin hung long tante tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: Then I will make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 32:14
Thadou: Hiteng chule keiman Egypt gam twi chu thip chetna hung um intin, chule vadung Olive thao bangin nem heuvin hung long tante tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: Then I will make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Chule keiman Egypt kasuh mang tenga chule achunga kai anei jouse kasutlhah peh a namite kasat lhuh soh teng tahleh nangin keima hi Pakai kahi ti nahet doh ding ahi.
en: “When I make the land of Egypt desolate and waste, a land destitute of that of which it was full, when I strike all those who dwell therein, then they will know that I am the LORD.
text:
