text:
EZK 33:14
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in keiman migilouho nathi teitei diu ahi tin kasei peh tajong leng hitia chu achonset nauva konna akihei manguva adihle thilpha ahin bolluva ahileh,
English: Again, when I say to the wicked, “You will surely die,” if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right,

tcz: Ijem tin gangtah in abat lahna a thil kitung chengse chu pedoh henlang, athilguh hou jong nung peh hen, chule hinkho a chondan ding kapeh ho juijo henlang thilse bolda jeng taleh, hitia chu ahung chonuva ahileh amaho chu hing teitei diu ahin thi chu thilou ding ahitai.
en: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity, he will surely live. He will not die.
text:
EZK 33:15
Thadou: Ijem tin gangtah in abat lahna a thil kitung chengse chu pedoh henlang, athilguh hou jong nung peh hen, chule hinkho a chondan ding kapeh ho juijo henlang thilse bolda jeng taleh, hitia chu ahung chonuva ahileh amaho chu hing teitei diu ahin thi chu thilou ding ahitai.
English: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity, he will surely live. He will not die.

tcz: Achonset nau masa ho avella kinung pohdoh kit louding ijeh inem itile amahon adih leh thilpha abol joh ahitan, amaho hing teitei diu ahitai.
en: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.
text:
EZK 33:16
Thadou: Achonset nau masa ho avella kinung pohdoh kit louding ijeh inem itile amahon adih leh thilpha abol joh ahitan, amaho hing teitei diu ahitai.
English: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.

tcz: Namiten, Pakaiyin thilpha abolpoi, atiuvin ahinlah thilpha bollou chu amaho joh ahibouve.
en: “‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.
text:
EZK 33:17
Thadou: Namiten, Pakaiyin thilpha abolpoi, atiuvin ahinlah thilpha bollou chu amaho joh ahibouve.
English: “‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile avella kasei kit ahi, michonpha techu achonphat nauva konna akihei manguva thilse abolluva ahileh thidiu ahi.
en: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will even die therein.
text:
EZK 33:18
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile avella kasei kit ahi, michonpha techu achonphat nauva konna akihei manguva thilse abolluva ahileh thidiu ahi.
English: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will even die therein.

tcz: Hijeh chun thilse bolte chu athil bol nauva konna ahung kihei doh uva adih le thilpha abolluva ahileh hing diu ahi.
en: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.
text:
EZK 33:19
Thadou: Hijeh chun thilse bolte chu athil bol nauva konna ahung kihei doh uva adih le thilpha abolluva ahileh hing diu ahi.
English: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.

tcz: O Israel mite! Nanghon Pakaiyin thilpha abolpoi natiuvin ahinlah keiman amichang cheh natoh dungjui juva nathu katana hi.
en: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.’”
text:
EZK 33:20
Thadou: O Israel mite! Nanghon Pakaiyin thilpha abolpoi natiuvin ahinlah keiman amichang cheh natoh dungjui juva nathu katana hi.
English: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.’”

tcz: Kasoh channao kum somle kum ni lhin kum Tolbol niget nin Jerusalema konna ahingdoh khat kahenga ahungin chule hitin aseije: khopi alhutai, ati.
en: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been defeated!”
text:
EZK 33:21
Thadou: Kasoh channao kum somle kum ni lhin kum Tolbol niget nin Jerusalema konna ahingdoh khat kahenga ahungin chule hitin aseije: khopi alhutai, ati.
English: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been defeated!”

tcz: Hiche masangni nilhah chun Pakaiyin eituhchah kheh in chule Pakaiyin kakam eikeh peh in kapao thei kittai. Hijeh chun ajing jingkah a amapa hunglhun phat chun kei thuseijin kaumtai.
en: Now the LORD’s hand had been on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.
text:
EZK 33:22
Thadou: Hiche masangni nilhah chun Pakaiyin eituhchah kheh in chule Pakaiyin kakam eikeh peh in kapao thei kittai. Hijeh chun ajing jingkah a amapa hunglhun phat chun kei thuseijin kaumtai.
English: Now the LORD’s hand had been on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.

tcz: Hichun Pakaija kon hiche thuhi kahenga ahung lhunge:
en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 33:23
Thadou: Hichun Pakaija kon hiche thuhi kahenga ahung lhunge:
English: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: Mihem chapa, Judate akithe thang amoh chengse khopi lumsa a cheng hon hitin aseijuvin, Abraham chu mikhat ahijeng vang'in agam pumpi analon ahi. Keiho mitamtah kahiuvin hiche gam hi kagoulo diu mong monga eikipeu ahi atiuve.
en: “Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.’
text:
EZK 33:24
Thadou: Mihem chapa, Judate akithe thang amoh chengse khopi lumsa a cheng hon hitin aseijuvin, Abraham chu mikhat ahijeng vang'in agam pumpi analon ahi. Keiho mitamtah kahiuvin hiche gam hi kagoulo diu mong monga eikipeu ahi atiuve.
English: “Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.’

tcz: Hijeh chun hiche mite hi seipeh in, hichehi thaneitah Pakaiyin asei ahi: nanghon sa athisan pumin naneuvin, nanghon milimdoi na houvun chule mona neilou ho nathat uve. Gam leiset hi nangho a dinga ngellu ham?
en: Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. So should you possess the land?
text:
EZK 33:25
Thadou: Hijeh chun hiche mite hi seipeh in, hichehi thaneitah Pakaiyin asei ahi: nanghon sa athisan pumin naneuvin, nanghon milimdoi na houvun chule mona neilou ho nathat uve. Gam leiset hi nangho a dinga ngellu ham?
English: Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. So should you possess the land?

tcz: Tolthat teho, milim doi houho, jon thanhoi bolhon gamsung hi nachan mong diu hinam?
en: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. So should you possess the land?”’
text:
EZK 33:26
Thadou: Tolthat teho, milim doi houho, jon thanhoi bolhon gamsung hi nachan mong diu hinam?
English: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. So should you possess the land?”’

tcz: Amaho chu seipeh in, hiche thuhi thaneitah Pakaiyin asei ahi. Tahbeh mongin keima kahing jinge, khopi gemsa a cheng ho chu chemjama kithat diu ahi, chule keiman gamsaho chu loujau chengho negam dinga kahinsol ding ahi. Kulpi kikai khum sunga le songko ho a chengse chu natna thidiu ahi.
en: “You shall tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword. I will give whoever is in the open field to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence.
text:
EZK 33:27
Thadou: Amaho chu seipeh in, hiche thuhi thaneitah Pakaiyin asei ahi. Tahbeh mongin keima kahing jinge, khopi gemsa a cheng ho chu chemjama kithat diu ahi, chule keiman gamsaho chu loujau chengho negam dinga kahinsol ding ahi. Kulpi kikai khum sunga le songko ho a chengse chu natna thidiu ahi.
English: “You shall tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword. I will give whoever is in the open field to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence.

tcz: Keiman agam kasuhmang hella chule aloupina a kasuhset peh ding ahi. Amanu kiletsahna thahatna chu kichai ding ahitai. Israel molsang ho chu ahom keuva kijama koi machan agam chu ajotpa lou ding ahi.
en: I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment. The pride of her power will cease. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, so that no one will pass through.
text:
EZK 33:28
Thadou: Keiman agam kasuhmang hella chule aloupina a kasuhset peh ding ahi. Amanu kiletsahna thahatna chu kichai ding ahitai. Israel molsang ho chu ahom keuva kijama koi machan agam chu ajotpa lou ding ahi.
English: I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment. The pride of her power will cease. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, so that no one will pass through.

tcz: Keiman achonset nau kidah dah umho a agamu kasuhmang hel teng tah chuleh amahon keima Pakai kahi ti ahetdoh diu ahi.
en: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed.”’
text:
EZK 33:29
Thadou: Keiman achonset nau kidah dah umho a agamu kasuhmang hel teng tah chuleh amahon keima Pakai kahi ti ahetdoh diu ahi.
English: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed.”’

tcz: Mihem chapa, namite ainsunguvah nangma chungchang akihou limuvin chule akotphung hou vah guh thimin akihoulim uve. Amaho khat leh khat akihouvun, hungun themgaopa koma cheu hitin Pakai thusei gangaiju hite atiuve.
en: “As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to one another, everyone to his brother, saying, ‘Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from the LORD.’
text:
EZK 33:30
Thadou: Mihem chapa, namite ainsunguvah nangma chungchang akihou limuvin chule akotphung hou vah guh thimin akihoulim uve. Amaho khat leh khat akihouvun, hungun themgaopa koma cheu hitin Pakai thusei gangaiju hite atiuve.
English: “As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to one another, everyone to his brother, saying, ‘Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from the LORD.’

tcz: Hijeh chun kamite chu lungtheng tah bangin ahungun chule nama sangah atou uve. Nathusei angai uvin ahin nathusei nahsah in anei pouvin bolding jong ago pouve. Akamsungu jonthanhoi thu jeng adimin chule alung thimuvin sum jeng aholluve.
en: They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.
text:
EZK 33:31
Thadou: Hijeh chun kamite chu lungtheng tah bangin ahungun chule nama sangah atou uve. Nathusei angai uvin ahin nathusei nahsah in anei pouvin bolding jong ago pouve. Akamsungu jonthanhoi thu jeng adimin chule alung thimuvin sum jeng aholluve.
English: They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.

tcz: Nanghi amaho ding nopsah pi thei tah nahi. Koitobang joldeila aw ngeitah tah sa a ahilouleh tumging thei ngeitah tah saiho toh nabange. Nathusei angaijuvin amahon abol pouve.
en: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don’t do them.
text:
EZK 33:32
Thadou: Nanghi amaho ding nopsah pi thei tah nahi. Koitobang joldeila aw ngeitah tah sa a ahilouleh tumging thei ngeitah tah saiho toh nabange. Nathusei angaijuvin amahon abol pouve.
English: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don’t do them.

tcz: Ahivnagin hiche tijat umtah thilho achung'uva ahung lhun tengleh hiche hi hung guilhung tei ding ahi. Hiteng tah chule amahon alah uva themgao aume ti ahetdoh diu ahi.
en: “When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”
text:
EZK 33:33
Thadou: Ahivnagin hiche tijat umtah thilho achung'uva ahung lhun tengleh hiche hi hung guilhung tei ding ahi. Hiteng tah chule amahon alah uva themgao aume ti ahetdoh diu ahi.
English: “When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”

tcz: Hichun hiche thusei hi Pakaija konin kahenga ahung lhunge.
en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 34:1
Thadou: Hichun hiche thusei hi Pakaija konin kahenga ahung lhunge.
English: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: Mihem chapa, Israel lamkai kelngoi chingho dou nan gaothu seijin. Thaneitha Pakaija kon hiche thusei hi seipeh in. Akelngoiho vah louva amaho leh amaho kivah ho itobang tah a lunggenthei nan nga hitam. Kelngoi chingho chun akelngoi ho avahva ding hilou ham?
en: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Shouldn’t the shepherds feed the sheep?
text:
EZK 34:2
Thadou: Mihem chapa, Israel lamkai kelngoi chingho dou nan gaothu seijin. Thaneitha Pakaija kon hiche thusei hi seipeh in. Akelngoiho vah louva amaho leh amaho kivah ho itobang tah a lunggenthei nan nga hitam. Kelngoi chingho chun akelngoi ho avahva ding hilou ham?
English: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Shouldn’t the shepherds feed the sheep?

tcz: Nangin anoitwi chun amul akisil ahi tin nagellin chule ahoi pen pen naki thauvin ahin nanghon kelngoi hon ho kel nathoh sah uve.
en: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.
text:
EZK 34:3
Thadou: Nangin anoitwi chun amul akisil ahi tin nagellin chule ahoi pen pen naki thauvin ahin nanghon kelngoi hon ho kel nathoh sah uve.
English: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.

tcz: Nanghon alhasam la nadon pouvin, adamlou la najen pouvin, ahilouleh amaha jong natompeh pouve. Nanghon avahmang khat jong naga hoilut pouvin, chule amang khat jong naga holdoh pouve. Hiche sang chun nanghon gilou tah le lungsetna beihellin achunguva vai nahom uve.
en: You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.
text:
EZK 34:4
Thadou: Nanghon alhasam la nadon pouvin, adamlou la najen pouvin, ahilouleh amaha jong natompeh pouve. Nanghon avahmang khat jong naga hoilut pouvin, chule amang khat jong naga holdoh pouve. Hiche sang chun nanghon gilou tah le lungsetna beihellin achunguva vai nahom uve.
English: You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.

tcz: Hijeh chun ka kelngoite aching beijin akithethang soh tauve. Chule gamsaho din bailamtah a neh thei diuvin nahoije.
en: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.
text:
EZK 34:5
Thadou: Hijeh chun ka kelngoite aching beijin akithethang soh tauve. Chule gamsaho din bailamtah a neh thei diuvin nahoije.
English: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.

tcz: Amaho molle lhang ho ah avah thang soh tauve, ahijeng vang'in koimachan amaho chu agahol doh pouve.
en: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth. There was no one who searched or sought.”
text:
EZK 34:6
Thadou: Amaho molle lhang ho ah avah thang soh tauve, ahijeng vang'in koimachan amaho chu agahol doh pouve.
English: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth. There was no one who searched or sought.”

tcz: Hichejeh chun nangho kelngoi chingho Pakai thusei hi ngaijuvin.
en: “‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word:
text:
EZK 34:7
Thadou: Hichejeh chun nangho kelngoi chingho Pakai thusei hi ngaijuvin.
English: “‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word:

tcz: Keima kahing jinge tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije. Nanghon kelngoiho nadalhauvin chule gamsa hon abullu diuvin nada lhauve. Nangho kakelngoi ching nahi vangun kakelngoi mangsa ho koimachan na holdoh pouve. Nangho leh nangho na kikhoh sah un chule kelngoite gilkel thoh in nada lhauve.
en: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds didn’t search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn’t feed my sheep,
text:
EZK 34:8
Thadou: Keima kahing jinge tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije. Nanghon kelngoiho nadalhauvin chule gamsa hon abullu diuvin nada lhauve. Nangho kakelngoi ching nahi vangun kakelngoi mangsa ho koimachan na holdoh pouve. Nangho leh nangho na kikhoh sah un chule kelngoite gilkel thoh in nada lhauve.
English: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds didn’t search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn’t feed my sheep,

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu nangho kelngoi chingho Pakai thusei hi ngaijuvin.
en: therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word!”
text:
EZK 34:9
Thadou: Hiche jeh a chu nangho kelngoi chingho Pakai thusei hi ngaijuvin.
English: therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word!”

tcz: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Keiman hiche kelngoi chingho nangho hi kamelma a kangaito ahitai. Chule keiman ka kelngoi ho chung changa thilsoh jouse amaho chunga kadel ding ahi. Akel ngoi chinnu kangah sah a, chule keiman amaho le amaho akivah u jong kalah peh ding ahi. Akamsung uva konna ka kelngoi ho kai huhdoh uva, kelngoi ho chu avella ama anchah a pangkit lou ding ahitai.
en: The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won’t feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.”
text:
EZK 34:10
Thadou: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Keiman hiche kelngoi chingho nangho hi kamelma a kangaito ahitai. Chule keiman ka kelngoi ho chung changa thilsoh jouse amaho chunga kadel ding ahi. Akel ngoi chinnu kangah sah a, chule keiman amaho le amaho akivah u jong kalah peh ding ahi. Akamsung uva konna ka kelngoi ho kai huhdoh uva, kelngoi ho chu avella ama anchah a pangkit lou ding ahitai.
English: The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won’t feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.”

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche hi Pakai thusei ahi. Keimatah in kaholla chu ka kelngoiho chu kahoikhom ding ahi.
en: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
text:
EZK 34:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu hiche hi Pakai thusei ahi. Keimatah in kaholla chu ka kelngoiho chu kahoikhom ding ahi.
English: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.

tcz: Keima tah akithethangsa kelngoi hon chinga kapan ding ahi. Keima tah in ka kelngoi ho chu kaholdoh a chuleh akiththang nao muthim lah le muijong noija aumnau mun cheh a konna kaki huhdoh diu ahi.
en: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
text:
EZK 34:12
Thadou: Keima tah akithethangsa kelngoi hon chinga kapan ding ahi. Keima tah in ka kelngoi ho chu kaholdoh a chuleh akiththang nao muthim lah le muijong noija aumnau mun cheh a konna kaki huhdoh diu ahi.
English: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

tcz: Keiman amaho chu amaho gam mong mong Israel gam'a mitin vaipi leh namtin vaipi lah a konna ain cheh uva kahin lepui kit diu ahi. Keiman Israel molsang chung dungle vadung pang ho a chule mihem chenna mun jousea kavah diu ahi.
en: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
text:
EZK 34:13
Thadou: Keiman amaho chu amaho gam mong mong Israel gam'a mitin vaipi leh namtin vaipi lah a konna ain cheh uva kahin lepui kit diu ahi. Keiman Israel molsang chung dungle vadung pang ho a chule mihem chenna mun jousea kavah diu ahi.
English: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

tcz: Henge keiman Israel molsang ho chunga hamhing phatna mun chu kapeh diu ahi. Hiche lungmonna munna chu kachen sah diu chule Israel lhang chung hamhing phatna gam chu kapeh diu ahi.
en: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
text:
EZK 34:14
Thadou: Henge keiman Israel molsang ho chunga hamhing phatna mun chu kapeh diu ahi. Hiche lungmonna munna chu kachen sah diu chule Israel lhang chung hamhing phatna gam chu kapeh diu ahi.
English: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

tcz: Keima tah in ka kelngoite kaki china chule lungmong tah a akol nadiu kapeh ding ahitin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 34:15
Thadou: Keima tah in ka kelngoite kaki china chule lungmong tah a akol nadiu kapeh ding ahitin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Keiman avah mangsa kaholdoh a chule inlang bitsella kahin puikit diu ahi. Keiman maha puho katom peh a chule alha samho kahat doh sah kit ding ahi. Ahinlah a athao ho leh athahat ho kasuhmang ding ahi. Keiman kavah diu ahi – henge thutah'a kavah diu ahi.
en: “I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’
text:
EZK 34:16
Thadou: Keiman avah mangsa kaholdoh a chule inlang bitsella kahin puikit diu ahi. Keiman maha puho katom peh a chule alha samho kahat doh sah kit ding ahi. Ahinlah a athao ho leh athahat ho kasuhmang ding ahi. Keiman kavah diu ahi – henge thutah'a kavah diu ahi.
English: “I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’

tcz: Chule nangma dingin vang kakelngoi ho hiche hi thaneitah Pakaiyin mihemte koma asei chu ahi. Keiman ahonlah koma gancha khat leh adangho chunga thu katan ding keltah a konna kelngoi kachom khen ding ahi.
en: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.
text:
EZK 34:17
Thadou: Chule nangma dingin vang kakelngoi ho hiche hi thaneitah Pakaiyin mihemte koma asei chu ahi. Keiman ahonlah koma gancha khat leh adangho chunga thu katan ding keltah a konna kelngoi kachom khen ding ahi.
English: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.

tcz: Nangma dinga hamhing phalai pentah nakikoi ding chu phaset jeng louham? Nangman jong adang dang ho chu nachot ngim jeng ding ham? Twichim lai lai nadon chu nang dinga phajeng lou ham? Nangin jong nadon moh ho chu nakenga nachot neh neh jeng ding ham?
en: Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet?
text:
EZK 34:18
Thadou: Nangma dinga hamhing phalai pentah nakikoi ding chu phaset jeng louham? Nangman jong adang dang ho chu nachot ngim jeng ding ham? Twichim lai lai nadon chu nang dinga phajeng lou ham? Nangin jong nadon moh ho chu nakenga nachot neh neh jeng ding ham?
English: Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet?

tcz: Keima kelngoi hon nang chot ngemsa chu aneh uva chule nang chotnehsa chu iti aneh uva adon diu ham?
en: As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.’
text:
EZK 34:19
Thadou: Keima kelngoi hon nang chot ngemsa chu aneh uva chule nang chotnehsa chu iti aneh uva adon diu ham?
English: As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.’

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Keiman tahbeh a kelngoi athao ho le kelngoi gong ho kikah a thu katan ding ahi.
en: “Therefore the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
text:
EZK 34:20
Thadou: Hiche jeh a chu hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Keiman tahbeh a kelngoi athao ho le kelngoi gong ho kikah a thu katan ding ahi.
English: “Therefore the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

tcz: Ajeh chu athao hon agong ho leh agilkelho chu tamtah'in kakelngoi ho chu aumkim vellun gam latah a akithe cheh masang seuvin nenh un chule nakiuvin natat un ahi.
en: Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad,
text:
EZK 34:21
Thadou: Ajeh chu athao hon agong ho leh agilkelho chu tamtah'in kakelngoi ho chu aumkim vellun gam latah a akithe cheh masang seuvin nenh un chule nakiuvin natat un ahi.
English: Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad,

tcz: Hijeh a chu keiman ka kelngoi hon chu kaki huhdoh a chule amaho suhset a umkit talou diu ahi. Keiman gan khat chu ahon lah a konna achom dang khat kah a thu katan ding ahi.
en: therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep.
text:
EZK 34:22
Thadou: Hijeh a chu keiman ka kelngoi hon chu kaki huhdoh a chule amaho suhset a umkit talou diu ahi. Keiman gan khat chu ahon lah a konna achom dang khat kah a thu katan ding ahi.
English: therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep.

tcz: Chule amaho chunga chu kelngoi ching phatah khat kachapa David kapansah ding ahi. Aman avah uva chule aching uva pang ding ahi.
en: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd.
text:
EZK 34:23
Thadou: Chule amaho chunga chu kelngoi ching phatah khat kachapa David kapansah ding ahi. Aman avah uva chule aching uva pang ding ahi.
English: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd.

tcz: Chule keiman Pakai hi a Pathen u kahi a chule kalhachapa chu kamite lah a leng chapa a pang ding ahi tia keima Pakaiyin kaseidoh sa ahi.
en: I, the LORD, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken it.
text:
EZK 34:24
Thadou: Chule keiman Pakai hi a Pathen u kahi a chule kalhachapa chu kamite lah a leng chapa a pang ding ahi tia keima Pakaiyin kaseidoh sa ahi.
English: I, the LORD, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken it.

tcz: Keiman kamite toh chamna dinga kitepna khat kasemdoh a chule agamsunga konna gamsa hang ho chu kadel mang ding ahi. Hitia chu amaho bitsella gammang lah a lhale theidiu chule thingphung lah ho a chu kichatna beihella ihmu diu ahi.
en: “‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.
text:
EZK 34:25
Thadou: Keiman kamite toh chamna dinga kitepna khat kasemdoh a chule agamsunga konna gamsa hang ho chu kadel mang ding ahi. Hitia chu amaho bitsella gammang lah a lhale theidiu chule thingphung lah ho a chu kichatna beihella ihmu diu ahi.
English: “‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.

tcz: Keiman kamite phatthei kaboh a chule kalhang theng kimvella chu ain hou akisah diu ahi. Chule aphat phat cha kum kihei chin dungjuija angaichat kham khamu go kajuhsah ji ding ahi. Hiche a chu phattheina gohong ju ding ahi.
en: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.
text:
EZK 34:26
Thadou: Keiman kamite phatthei kaboh a chule kalhang theng kimvella chu ain hou akisah diu ahi. Chule aphat phat cha kum kihei chin dungjuija angaichat kham khamu go kajuhsah ji ding ahi. Hiche a chu phattheina gohong ju ding ahi.
English: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.

tcz: Kamite thei lei leh louho chun gaphatah atama tam asodoh peh a chule bitsella amichang cheh a hing diu ahi. Keiman asoh channao chain katum tan peh a chule soh a ahen nauva konna kahuhdoh tenguleh amahon keima hi Pakai kahiti ahetdoh diu ahi.
en: The tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the earth will yield its increase, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.
text:
EZK 34:27
Thadou: Kamite thei lei leh louho chun gaphatah atama tam asodoh peh a chule bitsella amichang cheh a hing diu ahi. Keiman asoh channao chain katum tan peh a chule soh a ahen nauva konna kahuhdoh tenguleh amahon keima hi Pakai kahiti ahetdoh diu ahi.
English: The tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the earth will yield its increase, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.

tcz: Amaho namdang te anchah a pang kit talou diu ahi. Chule gamsa hon jong vallhum kit tapouvinte. Amaho bitsella hingun tin chule koiman akichat sah tah lou diu ahi.
en: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.
text:
EZK 34:28
Thadou: Amaho namdang te anchah a pang kit talou diu ahi. Chule gamsa hon jong vallhum kit tapouvinte. Amaho bitsella hingun tin chule koiman akichat sah tah lou diu ahi.
English: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.

tcz: Chule keiman amaho chu achang leh mim jeh a gam chu kakithansah ding ahi. Hijeh a chu kamite avella kellhah jeh a genthei athoh kit tah loudiu ahilouleh namdang ten ajumso kit lou diu ahitai.
en: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not bear the shame of the nations any more.
text:
EZK 34:29
Thadou: Chule keiman amaho chu achang leh mim jeh a gam chu kakithansah ding ahi. Hijeh a chu kamite avella kellhah jeh a genthei athoh kit tah loudiu ahilouleh namdang ten ajumso kit lou diu ahitai.
English: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not bear the shame of the nations any more.

tcz: Hitia chu amahon keima Pakai a Pathenu amaho lah a kaume ti ahetdoh diu ahi. Chule amahon amaho –Israel techu kamite ahi ti ahetdoh diu ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: They will know that I, the LORD, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 34:30
Thadou: Hitia chu amahon keima Pakai a Pathenu amaho lah a kaume ti ahetdoh diu ahi. Chule amahon amaho –Israel techu kamite ahi ti ahetdoh diu ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: They will know that I, the LORD, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Nangma ka kelngoi hon nahin, kahamhing kelngoiho nahiuve. Nangho kamite nahiuvin chule keima na Pathenu kahi tia thaneitah Pakaiyin kasei ahi.
en: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord GOD.”
text:
EZK 34:31
Thadou: Nangma ka kelngoi hon nahin, kahamhing kelngoiho nahiuve. Nangho kamite nahiuvin chule keima na Pathenu kahi tia thaneitah Pakaiyin kasei ahi.
English: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord GOD.”

English: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

en: and tell it, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.

English: and tell it, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.

en: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
text:
EZK 35:4
Thadou: Keiman nakhopi ho kasuhsetna chule ahomkeuva kajam ding ahi. Hiteng chule nangman keima Pakai kahi ti nahet doh ding ahi.
English: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

en: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.
text:
EZK 35:7
Thadou: Keiman Seir molsang kam hella kajama, amite jamdoh dinga kigo jouse leh ahung kinung le jouse katha gam ding ahi.
English: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.

tcz: Keiman na molsang jong mithi kadip ding ahi. Nalhang sangho naphaicham ho chuleh nagam kotong ho jouse chemjama mihem kithatsa kadipset ding ahi.
en: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.
text:
EZK 35:8
Thadou: Keiman na molsang jong mithi kadip ding ahi. Nalhang sangho naphaicham ho chuleh nagam kotong ho jouse chemjama mihem kithatsa kadipset ding ahi.
English: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.

tcz: Keiman nangma atonsot a kam hel dinga kasem ding nahi. Nakhopi ho avella kisapha kit louhel ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh nangin keima Pakai kahi ti neihet doh ding ahi.
en: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
text:
EZK 35:9
Thadou: Keiman nangma atonsot a kam hel dinga kasem ding nahi. Nakhopi ho avella kisapha kit louhel ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh nangin keima Pakai kahi ti neihet doh ding ahi.
English: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

en: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

EZK 35:11

Keiman nalung hanna toh nathangsetna chuleh namihotna ho jouse jeh a ka engbol ding nahi. Nangma chunga kathilbol a konna keima tah Israel te lah a kaphondoh ding ahi.

en: You will know that I, the LORD, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’
text:
EZK 35:12
Thadou: Hiteng chuleh nangin keima Pakaiyin Israel molsang douna a musitna thucheng nasei jouse hi ajadoh taiti nahet doh ding ahi. Ajeh chu nangin amahohi dalhahsa ahiuvin neh dinga eiho eiki peuvah ahi tin naseije.
English: You will know that I, the LORD, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’

tcz: Hitichun naseiyin kei dounan nasatah in naki loupi sah in, chuleh hiche ho jouse chu kajan ahi.
en: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”
text:
EZK 35:13
Thadou: Hitichun naseiyin kei dounan nasatah in naki loupi sah in, chuleh hiche ho jouse chu kajan ahi.
English: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”

tcz: Hichehi thuneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Vannoi leiset pumpi hi keiman nangma ahom keuva kakoi tengleh kipah diu ahi.
en: The Lord GOD says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
text:
EZK 35:14
Thadou: Hichehi thuneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Vannoi leiset pumpi hi keiman nangma ahom keuva kakoi tengleh kipah diu ahi.
English: The Lord GOD says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

tcz: Israel gam ahom keuva akijam petna nangin nakipapi ahi. Tua keima nangma chungchanga kipah ding kahi. Nangma nahin nangho Seir molsang mite chule Edoma cheng jouse nakithe ngim hel diu ahi. Hiteng chuleh nanghon keima hi Pakai kahi ti nahetdoh diu ahi.
en: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
text:
EZK 35:15
Thadou: Israel gam ahom keuva akijam petna nangin nakipapi ahi. Tua keima nangma chungchanga kipah ding kahi. Nangma nahin nangho Seir molsang mite chule Edoma cheng jouse nakithe ngim hel diu ahi. Hiteng chuleh nanghon keima hi Pakai kahi ti nahetdoh diu ahi.
English: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

en: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear the LORD’s word.
text:
EZK 36:1

English: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear the LORD’s word.

en: The Lord GOD says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in possession!”’
text:
EZK 36:2

English: The Lord GOD says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in possession!”’
