en: therefore prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;”
text:
EZK 36:3
Thadou: Hiche jeh chun mihem chapa, Israel molsang ho chu thaneitah Pakaija kon hiche thusei hi seipeh in. Muntinna kon in namelma ten nahin bullu tauve. Namtin vaipi neile gou ding leh midangho totnop naleh suh minset dingin nasem doh tauve.
English: therefore prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;”

tcz: Hijeh chun O Israel molsang ho, thaneitah Pakai thusei hohi ngai temin. Aman lhang sang ho leh molsang ho gam kokhuh holeh phaicham ho chule ahomkeu leh alheng lholla kijamsa khopi kisumang saho chuleh akim vella namtin vaipi nuisat ding bepma um nahitauve tin aseije.
en: therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD: The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;

tcz: Hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Thangse tenna kalung hanna meikou chu hiche nam mite ho ahideh set in Edom dounan hung kou doh tai. Ajeh chu kagam chu kipah tah in amading in achom gam un nasatah a deimo aseiju eivetsah un ahi.
en: therefore the Lord GOD says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.”’
text:
EZK 36:5
Thadou: Hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Thangse tenna kalung hanna meikou chu hiche nam mite ho ahideh set in Edom dounan hung kou doh tai. Ajeh chu kagam chu kipah tah in amading in achom gam un nasatah a deimo aseiju eivetsah un ahi.
English: therefore the Lord GOD says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.”’

tcz: Hiche jeh chun Israel lhang sang ho leh molsang ho kokhuh ho leh phaicham ho dounan gaothu seijin, hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Nakim vella cheng namtin vaipi ho masanga jachatna nathoh thoh jengu chu keima nasatah in kalung ahang behseh jenge.
en: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.”
text:
EZK 36:6
Thadou: Hiche jeh chun Israel lhang sang ho leh molsang ho kokhuh ho leh phaicham ho dounan gaothu seijin, hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Nakim vella cheng namtin vaipi ho masanga jachatna nathoh thoh jengu chu keima nasatah in kalung ahang behseh jenge.
English: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.”

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi, keiman dettah a kitepna kanei ahitai. Hiche namtin vaipi techun jachatna athoh diu ahi.
en: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’
text:
EZK 36:7
Thadou: Hiche jeh a chu hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi, keiman dettah a kitepna kanei ahitai. Hiche namtin vaipi techun jachatna athoh diu ahi.
English: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’

tcz: Ahivangin Israel molsang ho chun kamite dinga theiga tamtah tah asodoh peh ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile amaho agamuva hung kile loi diu ahitai.
en: “‘“But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.
text:
EZK 36:8
Thadou: Ahivangin Israel molsang ho chun kamite dinga theiga tamtah tah asodoh peh ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile amaho agamuva hung kile loi diu ahitai.
English: “‘“But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.

tcz: Ven keiman nangma kahoi tupma chule keiman nangma lunggil tah a kaumpi ding nahi, chule naleiset chu kikal bot intin chule namuchi ho chu kitu ding ahi.
en: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown.
text:
EZK 36:9
Thadou: Ven keiman nangma kahoi tupma chule keiman nangma lunggil tah a kaumpi ding nahi, chule naleiset chu kikal bot intin chule namuchi ho chu kitu ding ahi.
English: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown.

tcz: Keiman Israel mijat hapun puna kapunsah ding ahi. Chule khopi ahomkeuva kijamsa ho chu kisa pha kitna chule mihem in alo kit ding ahi.
en: I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built.
text:
EZK 36:10
Thadou: Keiman Israel mijat hapun puna kapunsah ding ahi. Chule khopi ahomkeuva kijamsa ho chu kisa pha kitna chule mihem in alo kit ding ahi.
English: I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

tcz: Keiman mihem ho keuseh kapunsah lou ding, chuleh na gancha ho jong kapunsah ding ahi. O Israel molsang ho nachunga hung cheng dinga mihemte khatvei kahin puilut peh ding nahi, keiman nangma masanga nahaosat nasanga kahaosat sah be nahlai ding nahi. Hiteng chule nangman keima hi Pakai kahi ti nahet doh ding ahi.
en: I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
text:
EZK 36:11
Thadou: Keiman mihem ho keuseh kapunsah lou ding, chuleh na gancha ho jong kapunsah ding ahi. O Israel molsang ho nachunga hung cheng dinga mihemte khatvei kahin puilut peh ding nahi, keiman nangma masanga nahaosat nasanga kahaosat sah be nahlai ding nahi. Hiteng chule nangman keima hi Pakai kahi ti nahet doh ding ahi.
English: I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

tcz: Keiman kamite nachunga khatvei kahung lamlen sah kit ding ahi. Chuleh nangma chu agamu nahi ding ahi. Nangman avella achateu nachom gam kit lou ding ahitai.
en: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will never again bereave them of their children.”
text:
EZK 36:12
Thadou: Keiman kamite nachunga khatvei kahung lamlen sah kit ding ahi. Chuleh nangma chu agamu nahi ding ahi. Nangman avella achateu nachom gam kit lou ding ahitai.
English: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will never again bereave them of their children.”

tcz: Hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei chu ahi. Namtin vaipi danghon totnan naneijun, hitin aseijuve. Israel tehi amaho mite vallhuma chuleh ahinsao achateo kichom mang peh te ahiuve, atiuve.
en: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’
text:
EZK 36:13
Thadou: Hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei chu ahi. Namtin vaipi danghon totnan naneijun, hitin aseijuve. Israel tehi amaho mite vallhuma chuleh ahinsao achateo kichom mang peh te ahiuve, atiuve.
English: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’

tcz: Ahinlah nangin namite navallhum kit tah lou ding ahilouleh nachateu jong na chom gam kit louhel dingu ahitai, tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 36:14
Thadou: Ahinlah nangin namite navallhum kit tah lou ding ahilouleh nachateu jong na chom gam kit louhel dingu ahitai, tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Keiman nam dang ten najumso nau thu kajah sah kit lou dingu ahi, amaho tot thang hoiya naum kittah lou hel diu ahitai. Nangma anam mite lhahsah gam chu nahi lou ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord GOD.’”
text:
EZK 36:15
Thadou: Keiman nam dang ten najumso nau thu kajah sah kit lou dingu ahi, amaho tot thang hoiya naum kittah lou hel diu ahitai. Nangma anam mite lhahsah gam chu nahi lou ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord GOD.’”

tcz: Hiti chun Pakaija konin hiche thuhi kahenga ahung lhun be kitne.
en: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 36:16
Thadou: Hiti chun Pakaija konin hiche thuhi kahenga ahung lhun be kitne.
English: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: Mihem chapa, Israel mite agamsungu mong monguva ana chen laiju chun athilse bol uchin agamsung ana suboh uve. Keija aum chanu chu numei anihsop neijouva apon thisan dimset bangin anen uve.
en: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
text:
EZK 36:17
Thadou: Mihem chapa, Israel mite agamsungu mong monguva ana chen laiju chun athilse bol uchin agamsung ana suboh uve. Keija aum chanu chu numei anihsop neijouva apon thisan dimset bangin anen uve.
English: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.

tcz: Amahon agam sung chu toltha naleh milim doi hounan anasu nen uve, hiche jeh chun kalung han achunguva kana bung lhai.
en: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.
text:
EZK 36:18
Thadou: Amahon agam sung chu toltha naleh milim doi hounan anasu nen uve, hiche jeh chun kalung han achunguva kana bung lhai.
English: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.

tcz: Thilse jeng abol jeh u chun amaho engbol nan gamtin ah kana thethang in ahi.
en: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds.
text:
EZK 36:19
Thadou: Thilse jeng abol jeh u chun amaho engbol nan gamtin ah kana thethang in ahi.
English: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds.

tcz: Ahinlah amaho namtin vaipi lah a akithe thang u chun kamin theng chungah jumna ahin polut tauve. Ijeh inem itile namtin vaipi ten aseijuvin, amahohi Pakai mite ahiuvin, ahinlah ama agamsungah bit sellin akoi theipoi atiuve.
en: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, ‘These are the LORD’s people, and have left his land.’
text:
EZK 36:20
Thadou: Ahinlah amaho namtin vaipi lah a akithe thang u chun kamin theng chungah jumna ahin polut tauve. Ijeh inem itile namtin vaipi ten aseijuvin, amahohi Pakai mite ahiuvin, ahinlah ama agamsungah bit sellin akoi theipoi atiuve.
English: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, ‘These are the LORD’s people, and have left his land.’

tcz: Hichun keiman kamintheng chung changa namtin vaipi masanga jumna asosah u chu kahin he doh tai.
en: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.
text:
EZK 36:21
Thadou: Hichun keiman kamintheng chung changa namtin vaipi masanga jumna asosah u chu kahin he doh tai.
English: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.

tcz: Hiche jeh chun thaneitah Pakaija kon hichethu hi Israel mipite chu seipeh in. Keiman kahin nungpui kitnu hi nathil bol phat jeh u ahipoi, keiman kamintheng huhdohna dinga kabol ahibouve. Namtin vaipi lah a naki thethang laijuva kamintheng tah jachat umtah'a nasokhah jeh u ahibouve.
en: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.
text:
EZK 36:22
Thadou: Hiche jeh chun thaneitah Pakaija kon hichethu hi Israel mipite chu seipeh in. Keiman kahin nungpui kitnu hi nathil bol phat jeh u ahipoi, keiman kamintheng huhdohna dinga kabol ahibouve. Namtin vaipi lah a naki thethang laijuva kamintheng tah jachat umtah'a nasokhah jeh u ahibouve.
English: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.

tcz: Keiman kamintheng chu ichana loupi ham ti kavetsah diu nahi – namtin vaipite lah a jachat umtah'a nabollu chu. Chuleh keiman nangho a konna kathenna kahin phondoh teng leh amahon amit cheh uva amu diu ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD,” says the Lord GOD, “when I am proven holy in you before their eyes.
text:
EZK 36:23
Thadou: Keiman kamintheng chu ichana loupi ham ti kavetsah diu nahi – namtin vaipite lah a jachat umtah'a nabollu chu. Chuleh keiman nangho a konna kathenna kahin phondoh teng leh amahon amit cheh uva amu diu ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD,” says the Lord GOD, “when I am proven holy in you before their eyes.

tcz: Keiman nangho namtin vaipi a konna kakhop khomuva chule nagamsung mong monguva nain u kahin lepui kit ding nahiuve.
en: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.
text:
EZK 36:24
Thadou: Keiman nangho namtin vaipi a konna kakhop khomuva chule nagamsung mong monguva nain u kahin lepui kit ding nahiuve.
English: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.

tcz: Chuteng leh keiman nachunguva twitheng kachap khumuva chuel nangho nathen dingu ahi. Nanet nau jouse kisop thenga chule chutia chu nanghon milim doi nahou kit tahlou diu ahitai.
en: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.
text:
EZK 36:25
Thadou: Chuteng leh keiman nachunguva twitheng kachap khumuva chuel nangho nathen dingu ahi. Nanet nau jouse kisop thenga chule chutia chu nanghon milim doi nahou kit tahlou diu ahitai.
English: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.

tcz: Chule keiman nangho lungthim thah khat kapeh uva chule lhagao thah khat kakhum peh ding nahiuve. Keiman nalung chang song tobanga louchal tah chu kalah doh peh uva chule keiman nunnem tah, gangtah a donbut jeng thei lungchang kapeh ding nahi.
en: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
text:
EZK 36:26
Thadou: Chule keiman nangho lungthim thah khat kapeh uva chule lhagao thah khat kakhum peh ding nahiuve. Keiman nalung chang song tobanga louchal tah chu kalah doh peh uva chule keiman nunnem tah, gangtah a donbut jeng thei lungchang kapeh ding nahi.
English: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

tcz: Chule keiman kalhagao nasunga kakhum peh a nangman kathupeh phatecha najui theija chule kadan thuho ching thei tah a najui thei ding ahitai.
en: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.
text:
EZK 36:27
Thadou: Chule keiman kalhagao nasunga kakhum peh a nangman kathupeh phatecha najui theija chule kadan thuho ching thei tah a najui thei ding ahitai.
English: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.

tcz: Chule keiman masang laipeh a napu napate kana pehsa Israel gamsunga nachen ding ahi. Nangho kmaite nahiuva chule keima na Pathenu kahiding ahi.
en: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
text:
EZK 36:28
Thadou: Chule keiman masang laipeh a napu napate kana pehsa Israel gamsunga nachen ding ahi. Nangho kmaite nahiuva chule keima na Pathenu kahiding ahi.
English: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

tcz: Keiman nachon nau thenglou jousea konna kasil theng uva, keiman lhosoh ga phatah tah kapeh diu, chule keiman agam sunga chu kel kalhah sah kit lou ding ahitai.
en: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.
text:
EZK 36:29
Thadou: Keiman nachon nau thenglou jousea konna kasil theng uva, keiman lhosoh ga phatah tah kapeh diu, chule keiman agam sunga chu kel kalhah sah kit lou ding ahitai.
English: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.

tcz: Keiman nathei phungho nalou ho a konna ga tamtah tah kasosah a chule nakim vella cheng namtin vaipi hon nagam sunga kellhah jeh a nanuisat kitlou hel diu ahitai.
en: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.
text:
EZK 36:30
Thadou: Keiman nathei phungho nalou ho a konna ga tamtah tah kasosah a chule nakim vella cheng namtin vaipi hon nagam sunga kellhah jeh a nanuisat kitlou hel diu ahitai.
English: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.

tcz: Hiteng chule nangin nachon setna masa ho chu nageldoh kitna chule kidah dah um thil nabolsa chengse jeh a nang le nang imacha nakigel lou ding ahi.
en: “‘“Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
text:
EZK 36:31
Thadou: Hiteng chule nangin nachon setna masa ho chu nageldoh kitna chule kidah dah um thil nabolsa chengse jeh a nang le nang imacha nakigel lou ding ahi.
English: “‘“Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

tcz: Ahivangin kihet themin tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije. Keiman hiche hi natoh dungjuija kabol ahipoi, O kami Israelte, nathilse bolsa hou jeh a jachatna nadimset diu ahi.
en: I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord GOD. “Let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.”
text:
EZK 36:32
Thadou: Ahivangin kihet themin tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije. Keiman hiche hi natoh dungjuija kabol ahipoi, O kami Israelte, nathilse bolsa hou jeh a jachatna nadimset diu ahi.
English: I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord GOD. “Let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.”

tcz: Hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Keiman nachonset nauva konna kasil theng tenguleh, nakhopi ho jong avella mihem kachen sah kit ding, chule khogemsa jong kisathah kit ding ahi.
en: “‘The Lord GOD says: “In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built.
text:
EZK 36:33
Thadou: Hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Keiman nachonset nauva konna kasil theng tenguleh, nakhopi ho jong avella mihem kachen sah kit ding, chule khogemsa jong kisathah kit ding ahi.
English: “‘The Lord GOD says: “In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

tcz: Loumun lholouva umsa ho leh dalhahsa phaicham ho miten amujing ho chu louva kithah sem kit ding ahi.
en: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.
text:
EZK 36:34
Thadou: Loumun lholouva umsa ho leh dalhahsa phaicham ho miten amujing ho chu louva kithah sem kit ding ahi.
English: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.

tcz: Chule keiman nangho kahin lepui kit tenguleh mihon hitin seijunte. Ahomkeuva kijamsa gam chu tun Eden hon tobang ahitai tiuvinte. Dalhah sa leh suhchim sa khopi ho chun tun bang lhou tah tah aneiyin chule asunga mihemte acheng kittai.
en: They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’
text:
EZK 36:35
Thadou: Chule keiman nangho kahin lepui kit tenguleh mihon hitin seijunte. Ahomkeuva kijamsa gam chu tun Eden hon tobang ahitai tiuvinte. Dalhah sa leh suhchim sa khopi ho chun tun bang lhou tah tah aneiyin chule asunga mihemte acheng kittai.
English: They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’

tcz: Namtin vaipi akimvella cheng hon akiledoh kit ahetdoh tenguleh keima Pakaiyin khogemsa chu athahsah kit in chule ahom keuva kijamsa munna thingphung akehdoh kittai, ti ahetdoh diu ahi. Ijeh inem itile keima Pakaiyin kaseidohsa ahin chule kaseidohsa chu kabol teitei ding ahi ati.
en: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, the LORD, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken it, and I will do it.”
text:
EZK 36:36
Thadou: Namtin vaipi akimvella cheng hon akiledoh kit ahetdoh tenguleh keima Pakaiyin khogemsa chu athahsah kit in chule ahom keuva kijamsa munna thingphung akehdoh kittai, ti ahetdoh diu ahi. Ijeh inem itile keima Pakaiyin kaseidohsa ahin chule kaseidohsa chu kabol teitei ding ahi ati.
English: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, the LORD, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken it, and I will do it.”

tcz: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Keima Israel taona ngai dingin gotsan kaum jinge, chule kelngoi banga ajatnu punsah dingin.
en: “‘The Lord GOD says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.
text:
EZK 36:37
Thadou: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Keima Israel taona ngai dingin gotsan kaum jinge, chule kelngoi banga ajatnu punsah dingin.
English: “‘The Lord GOD says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.

tcz: Amaho chu kut lai teng leh Jerusalem khopi lamlen a ahon hon'a kilhai gantha dinga atam a tam ho banga hung kijot le diu ahi. Khopi ahom keuva kijamsa ho chu mipi hung dimset kit diu ahin chule mi jousen keima hi Pakai kahi ahin hetdoh diu ahi.
en: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
text:
EZK 36:38
Thadou: Amaho chu kut lai teng leh Jerusalem khopi lamlen a ahon hon'a kilhai gantha dinga atam a tam ho banga hung kijot le diu ahi. Khopi ahom keuva kijamsa ho chu mipi hung dimset kit diu ahin chule mi jousen keima hi Pakai kahi ahin hetdoh diu ahi.
English: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

tcz: Pakaiyin akhut in eituh chah kheh in chule Pakai lhagaovin ei pomang in gule chang dimsetna phaichama chun eipuilut e.
en: The LORD’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in the LORD’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.
text:
EZK 37:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin akhut in eituh chah kheh in chule Pakai lhagaovin ei pomang in gule chang dimsetna phaichama chun eipuilut e.
English: The LORD’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in the LORD’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.

tcz: Aman tollhanga gule chang dimsetna phaichama chun eipuilen ahi. Tollhanga chun adimset in gule chang akithang jengin, chule abonchan agosa ahisoh keije.
en: He caused me to pass by them all around; and behold, there were very many in the open valley, and behold, they were very dry.
text:
EZK 37:2
Thadou: Aman tollhanga gule chang dimsetna phaichama chun eipuilen ahi. Tollhanga chun adimset in gule chang akithang jengin, chule abonchan agosa ahisoh keije.
English: He caused me to pass by them all around; and behold, there were very many in the open valley, and behold, they were very dry.

tcz: Hichun aman eidongin mihem chapa hiche gu hohi mihing hung soh kit thei diu ham? O thaneipen Pakai tin keiman kadonbut e. Nang changseh in hiche khu adonbutna nahet ahi.
en: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord GOD, you know.”
text:
EZK 37:3
Thadou: Hichun aman eidongin mihem chapa hiche gu hohi mihing hung soh kit thei diu ham? O thaneipen Pakai tin keiman kadonbut e. Nang changseh in hiche khu adonbutna nahet ahi.
English: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord GOD, you know.”

tcz: Hichun aman kajah ah aseijin hiche guho jah a hin gaovin lang thu seijin, chule gu gosa ho Pakai thusei hi ngaijun tin seipeh in.
en: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear the LORD’s word.
text:
EZK 37:4
Thadou: Hichun aman kajah ah aseijin hiche guho jah a hin gaovin lang thu seijin, chule gu gosa ho Pakai thusei hi ngaijun tin seipeh in.
English: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear the LORD’s word.

tcz: Hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi, ven keiman nasunga changlhah kakoi peh ding nahi. Chule kahin sah kit ding nahi.
en: The Lord GOD says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.
text:
EZK 37:5
Thadou: Hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi, ven keiman nasunga changlhah kakoi peh ding nahi. Chule kahin sah kit ding nahi.
English: The Lord GOD says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.

tcz: Keiman tahsa kakoi peh chule, thajung jam ho chule vunna katom ding nahi. Kahin hu nasunga kakhum peh a chule nahung hindoh kit ding ahi. Hiteng chule nangin keima hi Pakai kahi ti nahet doh ding ahi.
en: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”
text:
EZK 37:6
Thadou: Keiman tahsa kakoi peh chule, thajung jam ho chule vunna katom ding nahi. Kahin hu nasunga kakhum peh a chule nahung hindoh kit ding ahi. Hiteng chule nangin keima hi Pakai kahi ti nahet doh ding ahi.
English: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”

tcz: Hijeh chun hiche thusei hi eikiseipeh bang bangin kaseitai. Phulou helouvin kathusei laitah in phaicham lhungkei jin aphatna phatah gin khat ahung ginge. Tahsa gule chang ho chu ahung kigom khomun chule mihem khat dinga lhingset gu keuseh chun akimat soh tai.
en: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.
text:
EZK 37:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun hiche thusei hi eikiseipeh bang bangin kaseitai. Phulou helouvin kathusei laitah in phaicham lhungkei jin aphatna phatah gin khat ahung ginge. Tahsa gule chang ho chu ahung kigom khomun chule mihem khat dinga lhingset gu keuseh chun akimat soh tai.
English: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.

tcz: Keiman hitia kavet jing laijin guho chunga chun thajung ho leh phe ahung kisem doh tai. Hiti chun tahsa chu vun in atom tan ahi. Ahinlah hichan gei jong chun asunguvah haina hu anei hih laijuve.
en: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
text:
EZK 37:8
Thadou: Keiman hitia kavet jing laijin guho chunga chun thajung ho leh phe ahung kisem doh tai. Hiti chun tahsa chu vun in atom tan ahi. Ahinlah hichan gei jong chun asunguvah haina hu anei hih laijuve.
English: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.

tcz: Hichun aman kahenga ahin seijin, gauvin lang huiho lah a khun thu seijin, mihem chapa gaothu seijin chule hiche hi thuneitah Pakai thusei ahi tin seijin. O haina hu! Chule hiche kolning li a kon hui nungin, hiche tahsa thilong ho hintheina dingin hin haikhumin.
en: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”
text:
EZK 37:9
Thadou: Hichun aman kahenga ahin seijin, gauvin lang huiho lah a khun thu seijin, mihem chapa gaothu seijin chule hiche hi thuneitah Pakai thusei ahi tin seijin. O haina hu! Chule hiche kolning li a kon hui nungin, hiche tahsa thilong ho hintheina dingin hin haikhumin.
English: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”

tcz: Hijeh chun aman eithupeh bang bangin keiman kaseitai. Chule haina hu chu atahsauva aluttai. Amaho abonchauvin ahing tauve chule sepai tamtah'in akengun ahung dingdoh tauve.
en: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.
text:
EZK 37:10
Thadou: Hijeh chun aman eithupeh bang bangin keiman kaseitai. Chule haina hu chu atahsauva aluttai. Amaho abonchauvin ahing tauve chule sepai tamtah'in akengun ahung dingdoh tauve.
English: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.

tcz: Hichun aman kahenga aseijin, mihem chapa hiche guho hin israelte thalhenga um ahiuve. Amahon aseijuvin eiho gu gosa isoh gam tauve – kinepna jouse abeitai, inam uhi akichaitai.
en: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’
text:
EZK 37:11
Thadou: Hichun aman kahenga aseijin, mihem chapa hiche guho hin israelte thalhenga um ahiuve. Amahon aseijuvin eiho gu gosa isoh gam tauve – kinepna jouse abeitai, inam uhi akichaitai.
English: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’

tcz: Hijeh chun gauvin lang amaho chung chang thu seijin, hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. O kamite! Keiman kasol mang nau lhankhuh ho kahondoh a chule kathodoh kit ding nahiuve. Hitia chu keiman nangho Israel gam'a chu kahin lepui kitding nahiuve.
en: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.
text:
EZK 37:12
Thadou: Hijeh chun gauvin lang amaho chung chang thu seijin, hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. O kamite! Keiman kasol mang nau lhankhuh ho kahondoh a chule kathodoh kit ding nahiuve. Hitia chu keiman nangho Israel gam'a chu kahin lepui kitding nahiuve.
English: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.

tcz: Thil hicheng ahung so teng, O kamite nanghon keima Pakai kahi nahet doh diu ahi.
en: You will know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.
text:
EZK 37:13
Thadou: Thil hicheng ahung so teng, O kamite nanghon keima Pakai kahi nahet doh diu ahi.
English: You will know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.

tcz: Keiman kalhagao nasunga kakhumpeh uva chule nagam uva nain chuh uva nakile kit diu ahi. Hiteng chule nanghon keim Pakaiyin kasei ahi ti nahetdoh uva chule kaseisa chu kabol ahi. Henge, Pakaiyin asei ahi.
en: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it and performed it,” says the LORD.’”
text:
EZK 37:14
Thadou: Keiman kalhagao nasunga kakhumpeh uva chule nagam uva nain chuh uva nakile kit diu ahi. Hiteng chule nanghon keim Pakaiyin kasei ahi ti nahetdoh uva chule kaseisa chu kabol ahi. Henge, Pakaiyin asei ahi.
English: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it and performed it,” says the LORD.’”

tcz: Pakaija konin kahenga thukhat ahung lhung kitne.
en: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
text:
EZK 37:15
Thadou: Pakaija konin kahenga thukhat ahung lhung kitne.
English: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,

tcz: Mihem chapa thing halkhat lan lang chule hiche thucheng hohi jihdoh in. Hiche hin Juda leh apanpi phung mite thakhel ahiuve. Hiti chun thinghal chom dang khat jong lan lang chule hiche thuho hi jih doh in. Hiche hohin Ephraim leh sahlang gam cheng Israel phungho thakhel hidiu ahi.
en: “You, son of man, take one stick and write on it, ‘For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions.’ Then take another stick, and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions.’
text:
EZK 37:16
Thadou: Mihem chapa thing halkhat lan lang chule hiche thucheng hohi jihdoh in. Hiche hin Juda leh apanpi phung mite thakhel ahiuve. Hiti chun thinghal chom dang khat jong lan lang chule hiche thuho hi jih doh in. Hiche hohin Ephraim leh sahlang gam cheng Israel phungho thakhel hidiu ahi.
English: “You, son of man, take one stick and write on it, ‘For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions.’ Then take another stick, and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions.’

tcz: Tun hiche thinghal ho chu khatseh bangin nakhut in tuh chah kheh temin.
en: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.
text:
EZK 37:17
Thadou: Tun hiche thinghal ho chu khatseh bangin nakhut in tuh chah kheh temin.
English: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.

tcz: Namiten hiche nathilbol chu ipi vetsahna ham tia nadoh tengu leh
en: “When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’
text:
EZK 37:18
Thadou: Namiten hiche nathilbol chu ipi vetsahna ham tia nadoh tengu leh
English: “When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’

tcz: Amaho jah a chun hiche hi thaneitah Pakaiyin asei ahi, keiman Ephraim leh sahlang gamkai phung miho chu kapui khoma chule Judate toh kagop khomm, amaho chu kakhutna thinghal khatseh banga kameh khom ding ahi.
en: tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.
text:
EZK 37:19
Thadou: Amaho jah a chun hiche hi thaneitah Pakaiyin asei ahi, keiman Ephraim leh sahlang gamkai phung miho chu kapui khoma chule Judate toh kagop khomm, amaho chu kakhutna thinghal khatseh banga kameh khom ding ahi.
English: tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.

tcz: Hiti chun thinghal thucheng najihna ho chu amahon amu theina ding uvin dom sangin.
en: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.”’
text:
EZK 37:20
Thadou: Hiti chun thinghal thucheng najihna ho chu amahon amu theina ding uvin dom sangin.
English: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.”’

tcz: Chule thaneitah Pakaija kon hiche thuhi amaho chu seipeh uvin, keiman Israelte chu namtin vaipi a konna kakhop khom dingu ahi tin keiman amaho chu akithecheh naumun jousea kon amaho gamsung mong monga ain cheh uva kapuilut diu ahi.
en: Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.
text:
EZK 37:21
Thadou: Chule thaneitah Pakaija kon hiche thuhi amaho chu seipeh uvin, keiman Israelte chu namtin vaipi a konna kakhop khom dingu ahi tin keiman amaho chu akithecheh naumun jousea kon amaho gamsung mong monga ain cheh uva kapuilut diu ahi.
English: Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.

tcz: Israel molsang chunga chu keiman kagop khomuva nam khat kasem ding ahi. Amaho chu abonchauva leng khat in achung'uva vai ahom ding ahilouleh lenggam nia jong kikhen kit talou diu ahi.
en: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.
text:
EZK 37:22
Thadou: Israel molsang chunga chu keiman kagop khomuva nam khat kasem ding ahi. Amaho chu abonchauva leng khat in achung'uva vai ahom ding ahilouleh lenggam nia jong kikhen kit talou diu ahi.
English: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.

tcz: Amaho amilim doi semthuva kon chule kidah um mihem chule doumah bol keipi limho a avella kisuboh kit talou diu ahi. Ajeh chu amaho chonsetna akinung hei kit nauva kon kahuhdoh uva, kakisop theng diu ahi. Amaho chu kamite tah tah chu hidiu chule keima a Pathenu kahi ding ahi.
en: They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.
text:
EZK 37:23
Thadou: Amaho amilim doi semthuva kon chule kidah um mihem chule doumah bol keipi limho a avella kisuboh kit talou diu ahi. Ajeh chu amaho chonsetna akinung hei kit nauva kon kahuhdoh uva, kakisop theng diu ahi. Amaho chu kamite tah tah chu hidiu chule keima a Pathenu kahi ding ahi.
English: They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.

tcz: Kasohpa David chu amaho lengpa hiding chule mahon kelngoi ching khat bou anei diu ahi. Amahon kachondan ho ajuijuva chule kathupeh ho chingthei tah a anit diu ahitai.
en: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes, and do them.
text:
EZK 37:24
Thadou: Kasohpa David chu amaho lengpa hiding chule mahon kelngoi ching khat bou anei diu ahi. Amahon kachondan ho ajuijuva chule kathupeh ho chingthei tah a anit diu ahitai.
English: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes, and do them.

tcz: Keiman Jacob kana peh nagam apu apa teu ana chenna gam'a chu cheng diu ahi. Hiche munna amaho hin chule achateu le atuson geijuva amaho nung teng atonsotna akhang khang hung cheng diu ahitai. Chule kasohpa David chu atonsot a alengpao chapa hijing ding ahi.
en: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince forever.
text:
EZK 37:25
Thadou: Keiman Jacob kana peh nagam apu apa teu ana chenna gam'a chu cheng diu ahi. Hiche munna amaho hin chule achateu le atuson geijuva amaho nung teng atonsotna akhang khang hung cheng diu ahitai. Chule kasohpa David chu atonsot a alengpao chapa hijing ding ahi.
English: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince forever.

tcz: Chutengle keiman amaho to chamna kinoptona khat kasema hiche tonsot kinoptona hiding ahitai. Keiman agamu kale peh kit a chule amijat kapunsah ding, chule alaijuva atonsotna dinga kahouin katun doh ding ahi.
en: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more.
text:
EZK 37:26
Thadou: Chutengle keiman amaho to chamna kinoptona khat kasema hiche tonsot kinoptona hiding ahitai. Keiman agamu kale peh kit a chule amijat kapunsah ding, chule alaijuva atonsotna dinga kahouin katun doh ding ahi.
English: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more.

tcz: Keiman amaho lah a chu chenna kaki sema, keima a Pathenu kahi ding chule amaho kamite hidiu ahi.
en: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
text:
EZK 37:27
Thadou: Keiman amaho lah a chu chenna kaki sema, keima a Pathenu kahi ding chule amaho kamite hidiu ahi.
English: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

tcz: Chule atonsotna dinga kahouin alaijuva aum teng, anam mite chun Israel sopthengpa Pakai kahi ahetdoh dingu ahi.
en: The nations will know that I am the LORD who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forever more.”’”
text:
EZK 37:28
Thadou: Chule atonsotna dinga kahouin alaijuva aum teng, anam mite chun Israel sopthengpa Pakai kahi ahetdoh dingu ahi.
English: The nations will know that I am the LORD who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forever more.”’”

tcz: Hichehi Pakaija konna kahenga thudang khat hung lhung chu ahi.
en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
EZK 38:1
Thadou: Hichehi Pakaija konna kahenga thudang khat hung lhung chu ahi.
English: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: Mihem chapa kihei jinlang Megog gam'a Gog, Meshech le Tubal nammite chunga vaihom leng chapa lama namai ngat inlang chule amaho dounan gaothu seijin.
en: “Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
text:
EZK 38:2
Thadou: Mihem chapa kihei jinlang Megog gam'a Gog, Meshech le Tubal nammite chunga vaihom leng chapa lama namai ngat inlang chule amaho dounan gaothu seijin.
English: “Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

tcz: Amapa chu thaneitah Pakaija kon hiche thuhi seipeh in, Gog, keima hi namelmapa kahi ati.
en: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.
text:
EZK 38:3
Thadou: Amapa chu thaneitah Pakaija kon hiche thuhi seipeh in, Gog, keima hi namelmapa kahi ati.
English: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

tcz: Keiman nangma kapei kim vella chule nakhalhanga ngakoi kabupeh a nangma leh nasepai jouse –nasakol jouse galvon lhingsetna kivonna sakol kangtalai touho jouse chukitle namite chemjam le lum kitho nabon chauva kapui mang diu ahi.
en: I will turn you around, and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, with all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in full armor, a great company with buckler and shield, all of them handling swords;

tcz: Persia, Ethopia chuleh Libya ho jong agalvon pum piu puma nahin jop diu ahi.
en: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;

tcz: Gomer leh asepaite jousen Beth-Togamah, sahlang gamkai leh adang tamtah gam latah tah konna sepaihon jong nahin jop diu ahi.
en: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes—even many peoples with you.
text:
EZK 38:6
Thadou: Gomer leh asepaite jousen Beth-Togamah, sahlang gamkai leh adang tamtah gam latah tah konna sepaihon jong nahin jop diu ahi.
English: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes—even many peoples with you.

tcz: Gotsan um'in, semtup san um'in, nasepai techu galsat dingin kigosan koiyin chule ama thupeh pen.
en: “‘“Be prepared, yes, prepare yourself, you, and all your companies who are assembled to you, and be a guard to them.
text:

en: You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you, and all your hordes, and the peoples who are with you. I will give you to the ravenous birds of every sort and to the animals of the field to be devoured.

en: “‘“I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I won’t allow my holy name to be profaned any more. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.

EZK 39:7

en: “‘“Those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and will make fires of the weapons and burn them, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the war clubs and the spears, and they will make fires with them for seven years;

en: so that they will take no wood out of the field, and not cut down any out of the forests; for they will make fires with the weapons. They will plunder those who plundered them, and rob those who robbed them,” says the Lord GOD.

EZK 39:10

en: “‘“It will happen in that day, that I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea; and it will stop those who pass through. They will bury Gog and all his multitude there, and they will call it ‘The valley of Hamon Gog’.
text:
EZK 39:11
Thadou: Chule keiman Gog leh amite dinga Twithi Solam sang, kholjin miho phaicham munna chu lhanmol lentah kasem peh diu ahi. Hichun hiche mun jotpa ho lampi chu akha ding chule amahon hichelai mun chu amin akhelluva Gog leh amite phaicham kiti ding ahitai.

en: “‘“The house of Israel will be burying them for seven months, that they may cleanse the land.

EZK 39:12

EZK 39:13

English: Yes, all the people of the land will bury them; and they will become famous in the day that I will be glorified,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Lha sagi jou teng chuleh pasal phabep khat alhendoh uva amaho chun mihem aholdoh uva avui diu dingu hitia chu gamsung asuh theng kit dingu ahi.
en: “‘“They will set apart men of continual employment who will pass through the land. Those who pass through will go with those who bury those who remain on the surface of the land, to cleanse it. After the end of seven months they will search.
text:
EZK 39:14
Thadou: Lha sagi jou teng chuleh pasal phabep khat alhendoh uva amaho chun mihem aholdoh uva avui diu dingu hitia chu gamsung asuh theng kit dingu ahi.
English: “‘“They will set apart men of continual employment who will pass through the land. Those who pass through will go with those who bury those who remain on the surface of the land, to cleanse it. After the end of seven months they will search.

en: Those who search through the land will pass through; and when anyone sees a man’s bone, then he will set up a sign by it, until the undertakers have buried it in the valley of Hamon Gog.
text:
EZK 39:15
Thadou: Hoilai mun hijongle gu akimudoh a ahile amelchihna asem uva, hijeh a chu gule chang vuidinga kinganse hon Gog le amite phaichama chu avui diu ahi.
English: Those who search through the land will pass through; and when anyone sees a man’s bone, then he will set up a sign by it, until the undertakers have buried it in the valley of Hamon Gog.

tcz: (Hiche mun chu khopi khat amin Hamonah kiti khat umintin, hichu Gog mite tina ahi) chule chutia chu achaina leh gamsung kisutheng ding ahi.
en: Hamonah will also be the name of a city. Thus they will cleanse the land.”’
text:
EZK 39:16
Thadou: (Hiche mun chu khopi khat amin Hamonah kiti khat umintin, hichu Gog mite tina ahi) chule chutia chu achaina leh gamsung kisutheng ding ahi.
English: Hamonah will also be the name of a city. Thus they will cleanse the land.”’

tcz: Chule tun, mihem chapa hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi, vacha hole gamma gamsa ho chu kouvin, hungun hung kikhom uvin lang gamlatah tah a kon chule anaija konin Israel molsang chunga hung unlang keiman kilhaina gantha golvah loupi tah kabolpeh uva hiche sa naneh uva chule thisan nadon dingu ahi.
en: “You, son of man, the Lord GOD says: ‘Speak to the birds of every sort, and to every animal of the field, “Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, that you may eat meat and drink blood.
text:
EZK 39:17
Thadou: Chule tun, mihem chapa hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi, vacha hole gamma gamsa ho chu kouvin, hungun hung kikhom uvin lang gamlatah tah a kon chule anaija konin Israel molsang chunga hung unlang keiman kilhaina gantha golvah loupi tah kabolpeh uva hiche sa naneh uva chule thisan nadon dingu ahi.
English: “You, son of man, the Lord GOD says: ‘Speak to the birds of every sort, and to every animal of the field, “Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, that you may eat meat and drink blood.

tcz: Pasal thahat ho sa neuvin chule leng chapate thisan don uvin – amaho chu Bushan gam sunga kelngoi chal ho, kelngoi ho, kelchal ho chule bongchal ho – gancha thao ho jousen hung neuvin tin amaho chu seipeh in.
en: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
text:
EZK 39:18
Thadou: Pasal thahat ho sa neuvin chule leng chapate thisan don uvin – amaho chu Bushan gam sunga kelngoi chal ho, kelngoi ho, kelchal ho chule bongchal ho – gancha thao ho jousen hung neuvin tin amaho chu seipeh in.
English: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

tcz: Nachim set kahsen nengchet in nalung nachim set in nen lang nang le nang kivahva in chule nakhamset kahsen thisan jong chu don don jengin. Hiche hi nangho dinga kagotpeh kilhaina gantha golvah chu ahi.
en: You shall eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
text:
EZK 39:19
Thadou: Nachim set kahsen nengchet in nalung nachim set in nen lang nang le nang kivahva in chule nakhamset kahsen thisan jong chu don don jengin. Hiche hi nangho dinga kagotpeh kilhaina gantha golvah chu ahi.
English: You shall eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

tcz: Kagolvahna ankong dokhang chunga chu sakolho sa, chule sakol chunga tou mithahat ho sa chule galsatna hangsan ho jouse sa chu hung neuvin tia thahattah Pakai chun aseije.
en: You shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men, and with all men of war,” says the Lord GOD.’
text:
EZK 39:20
Thadou: Kagolvahna ankong dokhang chunga chu sakolho sa, chule sakol chunga tou mithahat ho sa chule galsatna hangsan ho jouse sa chu hung neuvin tia thahattah Pakai chun aseije.
English: You shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men, and with all men of war,” says the Lord GOD.’

tcz: Hitia hi keiman namtin vaipi ho henga kaloupi kahil chet ding ahi. Keiman amaho ka engbolla kasuh natna mitinin avet uva chule kakhut tuma kakhet teng kathahat dan chu ahetdoh dingu ahi.
en: “I will set my glory among the nations. Then all the nations will see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.
text:
EZK 39:21
Thadou: Hitia hi keiman namtin vaipi ho henga kaloupi kahil chet ding ahi. Keiman amaho ka engbolla kasuh natna mitinin avet uva chule kakhut tuma kakhet teng kathahat dan chu ahetdoh dingu ahi.
English: “I will set my glory among the nations. Then all the nations will see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.

tcz: Chule hiche akipatna chu Israel ten keima a Pakai a Pathenu kahi ahetdoh diu ahi.
en: So the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God, from that day and forward.
text:
EZK 39:22
Thadou: Chule hiche akipatna chu Israel ten keima a Pakai a Pathenu kahi ahetdoh diu ahi.
English: So the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God, from that day and forward.

tcz: Namtin vaipin ipi jeh a Israel te hi kasol mang hiu ham ti ahetdoh uva – hichu a Pathen uva dinga akitah lou nau chonsetna jeh a engbolna chu ahi. Hijeh a chu keiman kaki heimang sanna chule melmate suhmang dinga kana peh soh ahitai.
en: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they trespassed against me, and I hid my face from them; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.
text:
EZK 39:23
Thadou: Namtin vaipin ipi jeh a Israel te hi kasol mang hiu ham ti ahetdoh uva – hichu a Pathen uva dinga akitah lou nau chonsetna jeh a engbolna chu ahi. Hijeh a chu keiman kaki heimang sanna chule melmate suhmang dinga kana peh soh ahitai.
English: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they trespassed against me, and I hid my face from them; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.

tcz: Keiman kamai kahei manga akisuhboh jeh u leh achonset jeh uva engbolna ahi.
en: I did to them according to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions. I hid my face from them.
text:
EZK 39:24
Thadou: Keiman kamai kahei manga akisuhboh jeh u leh achonset jeh uva engbolna ahi.
English: I did to them according to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions. I hid my face from them.

tcz: Hijeh a chu tua hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi kamite sohchanna a kasuh tang ding ahi. Keiman Israel te jouse chunga hepina kanei ding, ajeh inem itile keiman kamintheng dinga katom panna kachin jing ding ahi.
en: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Now I will reverse the captivity of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel. I will be jealous for my holy name.
text:
EZK 39:25
Thadou: Hijeh a chu tua hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi kamite sohchanna a kasuh tang ding ahi. Keiman Israel te jouse chunga hepina kanei ding, ajeh inem itile keiman kamintheng dinga katom panna kachin jing ding ahi.
English: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Now I will reverse the captivity of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel. I will be jealous for my holy name.

tcz: Amaho ho kicha ding beihella agamsung uva lung mong tah a ahung chen teng uleh masanga ajachatna hou leh tahsan aum louna hou jouse jeh a chu amopohna hou jouse akisan thei diu ahitai.
en: They will forget their shame and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me, when they dwell securely in their land. No one will make them afraid
text:
EZK 39:26
Thadou: Amaho ho kicha ding beihella agamsung uva lung mong tah a ahung chen teng uleh masanga ajachatna hou leh tahsan aum louna hou jouse jeh a chu amopohna hou jouse akisan thei diu ahitai.
English: They will forget their shame and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me, when they dwell securely in their land. No one will make them afraid

tcz: Keiman amaho amelma teuva konna ain lamuva kahin lepui tenguleh namtin vaipi mitmu anga amaho lah a kathenna hi kavetsah ding ahi.
en: when I have brought them back from the peoples, gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am shown holy among them in the sight of many nations.
text:
EZK 39:27
Thadou: Keiman amaho amelma teuva konna ain lamuva kahin lepui tenguleh namtin vaipi mitmu anga amaho lah a kathenna hi kavetsah ding ahi.
English: when I have brought them back from the peoples, gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am shown holy among them in the sight of many nations.

tcz: Hiteng chule kamiten keima hi a Pakai a Pathen u kahi ti ahetdoh diu, ijeh inem itile keiman amaho chu sohchanga kasol mang a chule ain languva kahin puilut kitnu ahi. Keiman kamite khatcha jong kanunga kadalhah louhel diu ahi.
en: They will know that I am the LORD their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them to their own land. Then I will leave none of them captive any more.
text:
EZK 39:28
Thadou: Hiteng chule kamiten keima hi a Pakai a Pathen u kahi ti ahetdoh diu, ijeh inem itile keiman amaho chu sohchanga kasol mang a chule ain languva kahin puilut kitnu ahi. Keiman kamite khatcha jong kanunga kadalhah louhel diu ahi.
English: They will know that I am the LORD their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them to their own land. Then I will leave none of them captive any more.

tcz: Chule keiman amaho a konna kamai kahei mang kit tah lou ding ahi, ijeh inem itile keiman kamite Israel te chunga ka lhagao kasun lhah ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: I won’t hide my face from them any more, for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,’ says the Lord GOD.”
text:
EZK 39:29
Thadou: Chule keiman amaho a konna kamai kahei mang kit tah lou ding ahi, ijeh inem itile keiman kamite Israel te chunga ka lhagao kasun lhah ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: I won’t hide my face from them any more, for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,’ says the Lord GOD.”

tcz: Ka sohchan kal u akum somni leh nga lhin kum – Jerusalem lhuh kal kum som le kum li lhin jou – Lhatun ni somni le get nin – Pakaiyin keima eituh chah kheh e.
en: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck, in the same day, the LORD’s hand was on me, and he brought me there.
text:
EZK 40:1
Thadou: Ka sohchan kal u akum somni leh nga lhin kum – Jerusalem lhuh kal kum som le kum li lhin jou – Lhatun ni somni le get nin – Pakaiyin keima eituh chah kheh e.
English: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck, in the same day, the LORD’s hand was on me, and he brought me there.

tcz: Pathenna konna lhagao thilmuna a chun Israel gam'a eipuijin chule mol sangtah khat chunga eitou sah e. Hiche a konna chun khopi tobang khat lhanglang gamkaija kamun ahi.
en: In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was something like the frame of a city to the south.
text:
EZK 40:2
Thadou: Pathenna konna lhagao thilmuna a chun Israel gam'a eipuijin chule mol sangtah khat chunga eitou sah e. Hiche a konna chun khopi tobang khat lhanglang gamkaija kamun ahi.
English: In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was something like the frame of a city to the south.

tcz: Aman eihin pui naijep phat chun keiman amai sum eng tobang mihem khat khopi sung lutna kelkot koma ding chu kamui. Hiche mipa chun thil tena pon'a kisem khao khat leh thil tena mol khat akichoije.
en: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
text:
EZK 40:3
Thadou: Aman eihin pui naijep phat chun keiman amai sum eng tobang mihem khat khopi sung lutna kelkot koma ding chu kamui. Hiche mipa chun thil tena pon'a kisem khao khat leh thil tena mol khat akichoije.
English: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

tcz: Aman kakoma aseijin, Mihem chapa, ven lang chule ngaijin. Keiman kavet sah jouse hi naijin lang lunglut tah in gellin. Keiman nangma thil tamtah kavetsah thei nadinga hiche munna hi nahung kipui lut ahi. Chuteng nangma Israel mite koma nakile kitna chule namu jouse hi amaho naseipeh ding ahi.
en: The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”
text:
EZK 40:4
Thadou: Aman kakoma aseijin, Mihem chapa, ven lang chule ngaijin. Keiman kavet sah jouse hi naijin lang lunglut tah in gellin. Keiman nangma thil tamtah kavetsah thei nadinga hiche munna hi nahung kipui lut ahi. Chuteng nangma Israel mite koma nakile kitna chule namu jouse hi amaho naseipeh ding ahi.
English: The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”

tcz: Keiman houin kim vel alhung keija pal kikai kamun ahi. Mipa khat chun thil tena mol khat feet som le akeh’a sao khat akichoijin chule akulbang chu aten ahileh, abang chu feet som le akeh maa sang ahi.
en: Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each. So he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
text:
EZK 40:5
Thadou: Keiman houin kim vel alhung keija pal kikai kamun ahi. Mipa khat chun thil tena mol khat feet som le akeh’a sao khat akichoijin chule akulbang chu aten ahileh, abang chu feet som le akeh maa sang ahi.
English: Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each. So he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

tcz: Hichun ama solam kot langa chun achen ahi. Ama pachu kalbi a chun akallin chule kotpi bul chu aten ahile anunglang leh amalang feet som le akeh ahi.
en: Then he came to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide; and the other threshold, one reed wide.
text:
EZK 40:6
Thadou: Hichun ama solam kot langa chun achen ahi. Ama pachu kalbi a chun akallin chule kotpi bul chu aten ahile anunglang leh amalang feet som le akeh ahi.
English: Then he came to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide; and the other threshold, one reed wide.

tcz: Hiche a chu khopi ngah ho umna in dan chu kelkot lampi lang toa chu kisa ahi. Hiche indan ho chu aning li a kibang ahin feet som leh akeh cheh ahi, lampi dung lhung keija chu indan khat leh khat kikah kikah chu feet get leh hopli a hopkhat cheh a kigamlat ahi. Hongcha kelkot mai asung lang patna achaina chan amalanga pat anung lang channa lampi chu feet som leh akeh ahi.
en: Every lodge was one reed long and one reed wide. Between the lodges was five cubits. The threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.
text:
EZK 40:7
Thadou: Hiche a chu khopi ngah ho umna in dan chu kelkot lampi lang toa chu kisa ahi. Hiche indan ho chu aning li a kibang ahin feet som leh akeh cheh ahi, lampi dung lhung keija chu indan khat leh khat kikah kikah chu feet get leh hopli a hopkhat cheh a kigamlat ahi. Hongcha kelkot mai asung lang patna achaina chan amalanga pat anung lang channa lampi chu feet som leh akeh ahi.
English: Every lodge was one reed long and one reed wide. Between the lodges was five cubits. The threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.

tcz: Aman hongcha kelkot lampi jong aten ahi.
en: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.
text:
EZK 40:8
Thadou: Aman hongcha kelkot lampi jong aten ahi.
English: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.

tcz: Hichu achaina channa feet som leh feet li ahin chule adouna feet thum leh akeh sa ahi. Hiche hongcha hin kelkot tampi kigon dungjuija houin lang amaingat ahi.
en: Then he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its posts, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.
text:
EZK 40:9
Thadou: Hichu achaina channa feet som leh feet li ahin chule adouna feet thum leh akeh sa ahi. Hiche hongcha hin kelkot tampi kigon dungjuija houin lang amaingat ahi.
English: Then he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its posts, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.

tcz: Hiche a chun ingah ho umna indent hum kelkot lampi jet leh veija chu umah ahi. Hiche ho chu alet aneo chule akikhenna abanglai ho jouse akibang cheh in ahi.
en: The side rooms of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side. The three of them were of one measure. The posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
text:
EZK 40:10
Thadou: Hiche a chun ingah ho umna indent hum kelkot lampi jet leh veija chu umah ahi. Hiche ho chu alet aneo chule akikhenna abanglai ho jouse akibang cheh in ahi.
English: The side rooms of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side. The three of them were of one measure. The posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

tcz: Mipa chun kelkot lutna lampi chu akihonna a pat availam feet somleh feet sagi leh akeh ahin chule kelkot lampi chu availam feet somni leh feet ni ahi.
en: He measured the width of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;

tcz: Khopi ngah ho umna indan khat cheh maija chun atuhna khat cheh aumin hichu inche somni leh inche khat cheh ahi. Indan khat cheh chu aning jouse feet som leh akeh ahicheh e.
en: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the side rooms, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
text:
EZK 40:12
Thadou: Khopi ngah ho umna indan khat cheh maija chun atuhna khat cheh aumin hichu inche somni leh inche khat cheh ahi. Indan khat cheh chu aning jouse feet som leh akeh ahicheh e.
English: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the side rooms, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

tcz: Hichun aman kelkot lampi ingahho umna indan nunglang nga chu asaodan apumpia aten ahi leh asao dan chu feet somle feet thum leh hop lia hopkhat ahi.
en: He measured the gate from the roof of the one side room to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, door against door.
text:
EZK 40:13
Thadou: Hichun aman kelkot lampi ingahho umna indan nunglang nga chu asaodan apumpia aten ahi leh asao dan chu feet somle feet thum leh hop lia hopkhat ahi.
English: He measured the gate from the roof of the one side room to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, door against door.

tcz: Aman hongcha lampi kikah abang chu alhung keijin asaodan feet jakhat leh feet nga ahi.
en: He also made posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.
text:
EZK 40:14
Thadou: Aman hongcha lampi kikah abang chu alhung keijin asaodan feet jakhat leh feet nga ahi.
English: He also made posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.

tcz: Kelkot lampi dung lhung keijin alang khatna konna among lang khat chan chu feet somget leh feet sagi le akeh ahi.
en: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.
text:
EZK 40:15
Thadou: Kelkot lampi dung lhung keijin alang khatna konna among lang khat chan chu feet somget leh feet sagi le akeh ahi.
English: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.

tcz: Hiche a chun bangkot ho aumin choldona in lam ngan ajum jep jep in chule akihop khen nao bang ho jong aume. Hongcha sung lutna ho a jong chun bang kot ho aume. Hiche akihop khenna bang maiho chu tum thinga milim kisem in akijem pollin ahi.
en: There were closed windows to the side rooms, and to their posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches. Windows were around inward. Palm trees were on each post.
text:
EZK 40:16
Thadou: Hiche a chun bangkot ho aumin choldona in lam ngan ajum jep jep in chule akihop khen nao bang ho jong aume. Hongcha sung lutna ho a jong chun bang kot ho aume. Hiche akihop khenna bang maiho chu tum thinga milim kisem in akijem pollin ahi.
English: There were closed windows to the side rooms, and to their posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches. Windows were around inward. Palm trees were on each post.

tcz: Hichun mipa chun kotpi ahon chun houin leitol apolama chun eihin puilutne. Leitol bang lhung keijin keng lampi a chotpha ding song akiphan chule keng lampi lang ngan banga chun pindan somthum jen akisan ahi.
en: Then he brought me into the outer court. Behold, there were rooms and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty rooms were on the pavement.
text:
EZK 40:17
Thadou: Hichun mipa chun kotpi ahon chun houin leitol apolama chun eihin puilutne. Leitol bang lhung keijin keng lampi a chotpha ding song akiphan chule keng lampi lang ngan banga chun pindan somthum jen akisan ahi.
English: Then he brought me into the outer court. Behold, there were rooms and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty rooms were on the pavement.

tcz: Hiche lampi chu kelkot panga um ahin chule leitol sung banga kipat kotpi lutna chan geija kilhung lut peh ahin hichu keng lampi noinung chu ahi.
en: The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.
text:
EZK 40:18
Thadou: Hiche lampi chu kelkot panga um ahin chule leitol sung banga kipat kotpi lutna chan geija kilhung lut peh ahin hichu keng lampi noinung chu ahi.
English: The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.

tcz: Hichun mipa chun Houin polang thutanna in kotpi polang leh asung lang alhung keijin aten ahileh asaodan chu feet jakhat leh feet som sagi le nga ahi.
en: Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.
text:
EZK 40:19
Thadou: Hichun mipa chun Houin polang thutanna in kotpi polang leh asung lang alhung keijin aten ahileh asaodan chu feet jakhat leh feet som sagi le nga ahi.
English: Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.

tcz: Mipa chun sahlang kotpi chu solam lang khat bang bangin aten ahi.
en: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north.
text:
EZK 40:20
Thadou: Mipa chun sahlang kotpi chu solam lang khat bang bangin aten ahi.
English: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north.

tcz: Hilaijah jong hin khopi ngah ho choldona in alangto a thum cheh aumin, akihop khennau bang toh hitah cheh a chule dansung lutna um cheh ahi. Thil kite jouse chu solam kotpi kitena toh chun kigom khom cheh ahi. Kotpi lutna lampi chu feet somget leh feet sagi leh akeh sau ahin, chule feet somli leh feet thum hopli a hop thum len ahin, hichu bang nunglang khopi ngah ho choldona inalng ngat chan chu ahi.
en: The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side. Its posts and its arches were the same as the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.
text:
EZK 40:21
Thadou: Hilaijah jong hin khopi ngah ho choldona in alangto a thum cheh aumin, akihop khennau bang toh hitah cheh a chule dansung lutna um cheh ahi. Thil kite jouse chu solam kotpi kitena toh chun kigom khom cheh ahi. Kotpi lutna lampi chu feet somget leh feet sagi leh akeh sau ahin, chule feet somli leh feet thum hopli a hop thum len ahin, hichu bang nunglang khopi ngah ho choldona inalng ngat chan chu ahi.
English: The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side. Its posts and its arches were the same as the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.

tcz: Bangkot ho a hin, hongcha ho ahin, tum thinga kijem pol ho chu ahin abonchan niso lam ngat ho chutoh alet aneu kibang cheh ahiuve. Chule kalbi dan sagi a kikhap tou ahin chule hong cha chu kotpi lampi jona asung langa chu uma ahi.
en: Its windows, its arches, and its palm trees were the same as the measure of the gate which faces toward the east. They went up to it by seven steps. Its arches were before them.
text:
EZK 40:22
Thadou: Bangkot ho a hin, hongcha ho ahin, tum thinga kijem pol ho chu ahin abonchan niso lam ngat ho chutoh alet aneu kibang cheh ahiuve. Chule kalbi dan sagi a kikhap tou ahin chule hong cha chu kotpi lampi jona asung langa chu uma ahi.
English: Its windows, its arches, and its palm trees were the same as the measure of the gate which faces toward the east. They went up to it by seven steps. Its arches were before them.

tcz: Hilaija hin sahlam ngatna kisem kelkot toh kotpi chu niso lam nga a kisem bang bangin akisem in, hiche a kon chun houin jotna thutanna insung nung polang kotpi to kigalsai laitah chun aume. Kotpi teni kikah chu feet jakhat leh somsagi leh feet nga ahi.
en: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate.
text:
EZK 40:23
Thadou: Hilaija hin sahlam ngatna kisem kelkot toh kotpi chu niso lam nga a kisem bang bangin akisem in, hiche a kon chun houin jotna thutanna insung nung polang kotpi to kigalsai laitah chun aume. Kotpi teni kikah chu feet jakhat leh somsagi leh feet nga ahi.
English: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate.

tcz: Hichun mipa lhanlang sang kotpi kimvella chun eipuilen chule amun jouse chu aten ahile sahlang sanga adangho toh chun akibang chetne.
en: He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.
text:
EZK 40:24
Thadou: Hichun mipa lhanlang sang kotpi kimvella chun eipuilen chule amun jouse chu aten ahile sahlang sanga adangho toh chun akibang chetne.
English: He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.

tcz: Hilai ho a jong chun adangho abang bang chun bangkot anei cheh e. Chule polang thutanna lang jotna kotpi lampi kihonna a chun hongcha aume. Adangho bang bang chun kotpi lampi chu feet som get leh feet sagi leh akeh sao ahin, availam chu feet somle feet thum leh hopli a hopthum ahin, hiche khopi ngahho in ngatna nung lang bang teni kikah chu ahi.
en: There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like the other windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.
text:
EZK 40:25
Thadou: Hilai ho a jong chun adangho abang bang chun bangkot anei cheh e. Chule polang thutanna lang jotna kotpi lampi kihonna a chun hongcha aume. Adangho bang bang chun kotpi lampi chu feet som get leh feet sagi leh akeh sao ahin, availam chu feet somle feet thum leh hopli a hopthum ahin, hiche khopi ngahho in ngatna nung lang bang teni kikah chu ahi.
English: There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like the other windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.

tcz: Kotpi chun kalbi dan sagi chung lang lhung keijin aneiye, achule asung lang a jong chun hongcha aumin chule tumthing a kijem pol chu lhungpin apangin ahi.
en: There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before them. It had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.
text:
EZK 40:26
Thadou: Kotpi chun kalbi dan sagi chung lang lhung keijin aneiye, achule asung lang a jong chun hongcha aumin chule tumthing a kijem pol chu lhungpin apangin ahi.
English: There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before them. It had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.

tcz: Chule hilaijah jong hin polang kelkot toh kigalsai laitha a chun kotpi dang khat thutan indan sungnung lang jotna kotpi dang khatma aume. Kotpi teni kikah chu feet jakhat leh feet som sagilenga ahi.
en: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south.
text:
EZK 40:27
Thadou: Chule hilaijah jong hin polang kelkot toh kigalsai laitha a chun kotpi dang khat thutan indan sungnung lang jotna kotpi dang khatma aume. Kotpi teni kikah chu feet jakhat leh feet som sagilenga ahi.
English: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south.

tcz: Thutanna insung nung jotna lhanglam kotpi a kipat chun mipa chun eipuije. Aten ahileh hiche kotpi jong adangho tebep bep ma ahi.
en: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;

tcz: Khopi ngahho choldona in ahin, ajotpi ho cheng ahin, chule hongcha ahin adang hotoh alet aneu kibang cheh ahiuve. Chule bang ho kimvella chun bangkot leh hongcha aum cheh e. Chule adang dang ho bangin kotpi keng lampi chu asao feet somli leh feet sagi ahin chule availam feet somli leh feet thum leh hopli a hopthum ahi.
