en: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.
text:
EZK 40:29
Thadou: Khopi ngahho choldona in ahin, ajotpi ho cheng ahin, chule hongcha ahin adang hotoh alet aneu kibang cheh ahiuve. Chule bang ho kimvella chun bangkot leh hongcha aum cheh e. Chule adang dang ho bangin kotpi keng lampi chu asao feet somli leh feet sagi ahin chule availam feet somli leh feet thum leh hopli a hopthum ahi.
English: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

tcz: Hongcha kelkotna konna thutanna sungnung chan chu alhung keija feet somle li ahin chule availam feet som leh feet thum ahi.
en: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.
text:
EZK 40:30
Thadou: Hongcha kelkotna konna thutanna sungnung chan chu alhung keija feet somle li ahin chule availam feet som leh feet thum ahi.
English: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.

tcz: Ahongcha chun polam thutanna inden chu angat in, tumthing chu ajolpi in apange. Chule kalbi dan sagi in akikhap touve.
en: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts. The ascent to it had eight steps.
text:
EZK 40:31
Thadou: Ahongcha chun polam thutanna inden chu angat in, tumthing chu ajolpi in apange. Chule kalbi dan sagi in akikhap touve.
English: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts. The ascent to it had eight steps.

tcz: Thutanna in lutna solam kotpi phung a chun amapa chun apuije. Amapan aten ahile kotpi dang ho a chutoh alet aneo akibang cheh e.
en: He brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements;

tcz: Khopi ngah ho choldona in, ajolpi teni ahin chule hongcha ahin abonchan a dang dang ho a toh alet aneu akibang cheh in chule abang ho achun bangkot aum cheh in chule hongcha jong aume. Kotpi keng lampi chu feet somget leh feet sagi leh akeh asauvin, chule availam feet somli leh feet thum leh hopthuma hop khat ahi.
en: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.
text:
EZK 40:33
Thadou: Khopi ngah ho choldona in, ajolpi teni ahin chule hongcha ahin abonchan a dang dang ho a toh alet aneu akibang cheh in chule abang ho achun bangkot aum cheh in chule hongcha jong aume. Kotpi keng lampi chu feet somget leh feet sagi leh akeh asauvin, chule availam feet somli leh feet thum leh hopthuma hop khat ahi.
English: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

tcz: Ahongcha chun polam thutanna indan chu angan ahi. Ajolpi chu tumthing kijempol ahi, chule lutna chan gei chu kalbi get akikhap touve.
en: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.
text:
EZK 40:34
Thadou: Ahongcha chun polam thutanna indan chu angan ahi. Ajolpi chu tumthing kijempol ahi, chule lutna chan gei chu kalbi get akikhap touve.
English: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.

tcz: Hichun aman thutanna insungnung jotna sahlang kotpi a chun eipuilen ahi. Amapan aten ahileh kotpi dang ho jouse chutoh alet aneu akibang soh keije.
en: He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements—
text:
EZK 40:35
Thadou: Hichun aman thutanna insungnung jotna sahlang kotpi a chun eipuilen ahi. Amapan aten ahileh kotpi dang ho jouse chutoh alet aneu akibang soh keije.
English: He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements—

tcz: Khopi ngah ho choldona in ajolpi ahin chule kotpi hongcha ahin abonchan alet aneu akibang soh keijin chule bangkot kisem dan jong kibang cheh ahi. Kotpi keng lampi chu feet somget leh feet sagi leh akeh sao ahin, chule availam feet somli leh feet thum leh hopli a hopthum a len ahi.
en: its lodges, its posts, and its arches. There were windows in it all around. The length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits.
text:
EZK 40:36
Thadou: Khopi ngah ho choldona in ajolpi ahin chule kotpi hongcha ahin abonchan alet aneu akibang soh keijin chule bangkot kisem dan jong kibang cheh ahi. Kotpi keng lampi chu feet somget leh feet sagi leh akeh sao ahin, chule availam feet somli leh feet thum leh hopli a hopthum a len ahi.
English: its lodges, its posts, and its arches. There were windows in it all around. The length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits.

tcz: Hongcha chun polang thutanna inlang angan chule tumthing kijem polla kidou ahi. Alutna a chu kalbi dan get aum tou peh e.
en: Its posts were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.
text:
EZK 40:37
Thadou: Hongcha chun polang thutanna inlang angan chule tumthing kijem polla kidou ahi. Alutna a chu kalbi dan get aum tou peh e.
English: Its posts were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.

tcz: Kotpi hongcha akipatna kotpi sungnung a chun kotkhat aumin chule apanga chun indan khat aumin, hichea chu pumgo thilto ding sa kisop ji ahi.
en: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates. They washed the burnt offering there.
text:
EZK 40:38
Thadou: Kotpi hongcha akipatna kotpi sungnung a chun kotkhat aumin chule apanga chun indan khat aumin, hichea chu pumgo thilto ding sa kisop ji ahi.
English: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates. They washed the burnt offering there.

tcz: Hongcha alangto a chun dokhang ni aumin, hiche chunga chu govam thilto ding gancha ho kithat ji ahin, chonset thilto chule themmo thilto ahi.
en: In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to kill the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.
text:
EZK 40:39
Thadou: Hongcha alangto a chun dokhang ni aumin, hiche chunga chu govam thilto ding gancha ho kithat ji ahin, chonset thilto chule themmo thilto ahi.
English: In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to kill the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.

tcz: Hijeh chun agomin dokhang get aumin – li asunga aumin, chule li ma apolanga aume – hiche munna chu kilhaina gantha ho chu kichen bong a chule gonsa kikoi ahi.
en: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables, on which they killed the sacrifices.
text:
EZK 40:41
Thadou: Hijeh chun agomin dokhang get aumin – li asunga aumin, chule li ma apolanga aume – hiche munna chu kilhaina gantha ho chu kichen bong a chule gonsa kikoi ahi.
English: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables, on which they killed the sacrifices.

tcz: Hiche a chun songa kikheng dokhang li ma aumin, hiche a chu govam thilto ding semna a kimang ji ahin, khatcheh chu inche somthum khat leh akeh adung avai kibang ahin inche somni khatna sang ahin. Hiche dokhang chunga chu govam thilto ding sasatna chem holeh sasatna dinga kimang manchah jouse kikoija ahi.
en: There were four cut stone tables for the burnt offering, a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high. They laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice on them.
text:
EZK 40:42
Thadou: Hiche a chun songa kikheng dokhang li ma aumin, hiche a chu govam thilto ding semna a kimang ji ahin, khatcheh chu inche somthum khat leh akeh adung avai kibang ahin inche somni khatna sang ahin. Hiche dokhang chunga chu govam thilto ding sasatna chem holeh sasatna dinga kimang manchah jouse kikoija ahi.
English: There were four cut stone tables for the burnt offering, a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high. They laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice on them.

tcz: Hiche japi kimutona in banga detchetna kikil thihkoi inche thum'a sau ho chu kikhaijah ahi. Hiche kilhaina gantha sa ho chu hiche chunga chu kikoiji ahi.
en: The hooks, a hand width long, were fastened within all around. The meat of the offering was on the tables.
text:
EZK 40:43
Thadou: Hiche japi kimutona in banga detchetna kikil thihkoi inche thum'a sau ho chu kikhaijah ahi. Hiche kilhaina gantha sa ho chu hiche chunga chu kikoiji ahi.
English: The hooks, a hand width long, were fastened within all around. The meat of the offering was on the tables.

tcz: Thutanna in sungnung sunga chu indan ni uma ahi. Khat chu sahlang kotpi a chu uma lhanglang angatna khat chu lhanglang kotpi a chu uma sahlang angat ahi.
en: Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate. They faced toward the south. One at the side of the east gate faced toward the north.
text:
EZK 40:44
Thadou: Thutanna in sungnung sunga chu indan ni uma ahi. Khat chu sahlang kotpi a chu uma lhanglang angatna khat chu lhanglang kotpi a chu uma sahlang angat ahi.
English: Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate. They faced toward the south. One at the side of the east gate faced toward the north.

tcz: Chule mipa chun kajah a sahlang kelkot sungnung a indan chu houin kiman chah ding dan hil lea pang thempuho umna ding ahi.
en: He said to me, “This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests who perform the duty of the house.
text:
EZK 40:45
Thadou: Chule mipa chun kajah a sahlang kelkot sungnung a indan chu houin kiman chah ding dan hil lea pang thempuho umna ding ahi.
English: He said to me, “This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests who perform the duty of the house.

tcz: Lhanglang kelkot sunga um indan chu maicham thempuho a ding ahin – Zadok chilhah ho ahiuvin – ajeh chu amaho hin Levi te jouse thakhella amaho bou hin Pakai anailut uva ama ding kin abolpeh ji diu ahi.
en: The room which faces toward the north is for the priests who perform the duty of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to the LORD to minister to him.”
text:
EZK 40:46
Thadou: Lhanglang kelkot sunga um indan chu maicham thempuho a ding ahin – Zadok chilhah ho ahiuvin – ajeh chu amaho hin Levi te jouse thakhella amaho bou hin Pakai anailut uva ama ding kin abolpeh ji diu ahi.
English: The room which faces toward the north is for the priests who perform the duty of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to the LORD to minister to him.”

tcz: Hichun mipa chun thutanna sungnung chu aten ahileh hichu aningli kibang ahin, feet jakhat leh feet som sagi leh feet nga a avail en ahin, agallang channa feet jakhat leh feet somsagi leh nga ahi. Maicham chu houin mai thutanna in na chu uma ahi.
en: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was before the house.
text:
EZK 40:47
Thadou: Hichun mipa chun thutanna sungnung chu aten ahileh hichu aningli kibang ahin, feet jakhat leh feet som sagi leh feet nga a avail en ahin, agallang channa feet jakhat leh feet somsagi leh nga ahi. Maicham chu houin mai thutanna in na chu uma ahi.
English: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was before the house.

tcz: Hichun amapa chun houin hongcha a chun eipuije. Amapan hongcha bang bang alang to in aten ahileh alangto in feet get leh hopli a hopthum a sau ahi. Alutna seh seh chu aten ahileh feet somni leh feet li leh akeh availam ahin chule lutna bang teni chu aten ahileh feet nga leh hoplia hopkat a sau ben ahi.
en: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side. The width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.
text:
EZK 40:48
Thadou: Hichun amapa chun houin hongcha a chun eipuije. Amapan hongcha bang bang alang to in aten ahileh alangto in feet get leh hopli a hopthum a sau ahi. Alutna seh seh chu aten ahileh feet somni leh feet li leh akeh availam ahin chule lutna bang teni chu aten ahileh feet nga leh hoplia hopkat a sau ben ahi.
English: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side. The width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.

tcz: Hongcha chu availam feet somthum leh feet nga ahin, chule feet somni leh feet khat thuh ahi. Achung lang channa chu kalbi som chetou peh ah ahin, ajet aveija chu ajolpi uma ahi.
en: The length of the porch was twenty cubits and the width eleven cubits, even by the steps by which they went up to it. There were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
text:
EZK 40:49
Thadou: Hongcha chu availam feet somthum leh feet nga ahin, chule feet somni leh feet khat thuh ahi. Achung lang channa chu kalbi som chetou peh ah ahin, ajet aveija chu ajolpi uma ahi.
English: The length of the porch was twenty cubits and the width eleven cubits, even by the steps by which they went up to it. There were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

tcz: Hiche jou chun amapa chun houin muntheng phung langa chun eipui lutne. Amapan kotkhah jotna lampi bang alang to in aten ahi. Chule hiche ho chu feet somle akeh asana hi.
en: He brought me to the nave and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.
text:
EZK 41:1
Thadou: Hiche jou chun amapa chun houin muntheng phung langa chun eipui lutne. Amapan kotkhah jotna lampi bang alang to in aten ahi. Chule hiche ho chu feet somle akeh asana hi.
English: He brought me to the nave and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.

tcz: Kotkhah jotna lampi chu availing feet som leh sagi leh akeh ahin, bang ho chu alanto a feet get leh hopli a hopthum asauve. Muntheng phung changseh chu feet som sagi asauvin chule avai lang feet somthum leh feet nga ahi.
en: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.
text:
EZK 41:2
Thadou: Kotkhah jotna lampi chu availing feet som leh sagi leh akeh ahin, bang ho chu alanto a feet get leh hopli a hopthum asauve. Muntheng phung changseh chu feet som sagi asauvin chule avai lang feet somthum leh feet nga ahi.
English: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.

tcz: Hichun amapa chu muntheng khel lama dan sungnung a chun achen ahi. Lutna bang alangto in aten ahileh hiche ho chu feet somthum leh feet khat le akeh asan ahi. Lutna chu availam feet som leh akeh ahin, chule lutna bang alangto in feet som le feet nileh hopli a hopkhat asauvin ahi.
en: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.
text:
EZK 41:3
Thadou: Hichun amapa chu muntheng khel lama dan sungnung a chun achen ahi. Lutna bang alangto in aten ahileh hiche ho chu feet somthum leh feet khat le akeh asan ahi. Lutna chu availam feet som leh akeh ahin, chule lutna bang alangto in feet som le feet nileh hopli a hopkhat asauvin ahi.
English: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.

tcz: Muntheng mun dan sungnung chu feet somthum leh feet nga asauvin, chule availam feet somthum leh feet nga ahi. “Hiche hi” tin amapan kakoma aseije. Muntheng chungnung ahi ati.
en: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”
text:
EZK 41:4
Thadou: Muntheng mun dan sungnung chu feet somthum leh feet nga asauvin, chule availam feet somthum leh feet nga ahi. “Hiche hi” tin amapan kakoma aseije. Muntheng chungnung ahi ati.
English: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”

tcz: Hichun houin bang chu aten ahi, chule hichu feet som leh akeh asana hi. Apolang banga chun indan agol gol in aumin, indan khat chu availang feet sagi ahi.
en: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.
text:
EZK 41:5
Thadou: Hichun houin bang chu aten ahi, chule hichu feet som leh akeh asana hi. Apolang banga chun indan agol gol in aumin, indan khat chu availang feet sagi ahi.
English: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.

tcz: Hiche a inpanga indan ho chu dan thum'a kisa ahi. Khat chunga khat kisa thom ahin, dan khatna chu indan somthum cheh uma ahi. Hiche inpanga indan ho douna chu houin banga ajum laiya chu kingam ahi. Amaho chun abang ho chu aphah louvu ahi.
en: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.
text:
EZK 41:6
Thadou: Hiche a inpanga indan ho chu dan thum'a kisa ahi. Khat chunga khat kisa thom ahin, dan khatna chu indan somthum cheh uma ahi. Hiche inpanga indan ho douna chu houin banga ajum laiya chu kingam ahi. Amaho chun abang ho chu aphah louvu ahi.
English: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.

tcz: Dan khat chu anoija dan sanga lenjo jep a houin bang chu asan jep jeh leh jum jep jep a khat leh khat hiti chu kidou toa ahi. Achung den pen chan gei chu chetouna dinga chu atonung penna patna kalbi kaltou peh ah ahi.
en: The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the width of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.
text:
EZK 41:7
Thadou: Dan khat chu anoija dan sanga lenjo jep a houin bang chu asan jep jeh leh jum jep jep a khat leh khat hiti chu kidou toa ahi. Achung den pen chan gei chu chetouna dinga chu atonung penna patna kalbi kaltou peh ah ahi.
English: The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the width of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.

tcz: Houin a chu thusei namun kidosang namun ahi, hichun inpanga indan chengse bulpi jong chu kisemtha ahi. Hiche thuseina mun chu feet som leh akeh asangin ahi.
en: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.
text:
EZK 41:8
Thadou: Houin a chu thusei namun kidosang namun ahi, hichun inpanga indan chengse bulpi jong chu kisemtha ahi. Hiche thuseina mun chu feet som leh akeh asangin ahi.
English: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.

tcz: Houin panga indan kisem ho inbang chu feet geat leh hopli a hopthum sa ahi. Hiche inpanga indan teni kikah chun a onglai aum in ahi.
en: The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.
text:
EZK 41:9
Thadou: Houin panga indan kisem ho inbang chu feet geat leh hopli a hopthum sa ahi. Hiche inpanga indan teni kikah chun a onglai aum in ahi.
English: The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.

tcz: Chule thutanna in sungnung lang bang polanga chu indan kigol aumin ahi. Hiche a onglai mun chu feet somthum leh feet nga availam len ahin, houin kimvel lhung kei ahi.
en: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.
text:
EZK 41:10
Thadou: Chule thutanna in sungnung lang bang polanga chu indan kigol aumin ahi. Hiche a onglai mun chu feet somthum leh feet nga availam len ahin, houin kimvel lhung kei ahi.
English: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.

tcz: Chuleh inpanga in kisem ho dinga kotpi ho chengse chu thusei mun kido sang mun chunga chu kihong ahiuvin, hichu availam feet geat leh hopli a hopthum len ahi. Kot khat chun sahlang bang angan chule khat chun lhanglang angai.
en: The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.
text:
EZK 41:11
Thadou: Chuleh inpanga in kisem ho dinga kotpi ho chengse chu thusei mun kido sang mun chunga chu kihong ahiuvin, hichu availam feet geat leh hopli a hopthum len ahi. Kot khat chun sahlang bang angan chule khat chun lhanglang angai.
English: The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.

tcz: Lhumlam lang a chun inlen tah khat kisa aumin hichun houin thutanna lang angan ahi. Hichu availam feet jakhat leh feet somni leh feet ni ahin, chule feet jakhat leh soomnga asauvin, chuleh abang ho chu feet geat leh hopli a hopthum sa ahi.
en: The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.
text:
EZK 41:12
Thadou: Lhumlam lang a chun inlen tah khat kisa aumin hichun houin thutanna lang angan ahi. Hichu availam feet jakhat leh feet somni leh feet ni ahin, chule feet jakhat leh soomnga asauvin, chuleh abang ho chu feet geat leh hopli a hopthum sa ahi.
English: The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.

tcz: Hichun mipa chun houin chu aten ahile hichu feet jakhat leh somsagi leh nga asauve. Hichu in kisa leh akimvella thutanna in chu in abang ho puma chu feet jakhat leh som sagi leh nga sau ahi.
en: So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;

tcz: Thutanna insung nung houin solam lang chu avai feet jakhat leh somsagi leh nga ahi.
en: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.
text:
EZK 41:14
Thadou: Thutanna insung nung houin solam lang chu avai feet jakhat leh somsagi leh nga ahi.
English: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.

tcz: Solam lang nga a in kisa chule abang teni puma chu avai feet jakhat leh somsagi leh nga ahi. Muntheng indan sungnung chule houin hongcha
en: He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits from the inner temple, and the porches of the court,
text:
EZK 41:15
Thadou: Solam lang nga a in kisa chule abang teni puma chu avai feet jakhat leh somsagi leh nga ahi. Muntheng indan sungnung chule houin hongcha
English: He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits from the inner temple, and the porches of the court,

tcz: abonchauva thing amai neija kisem cheh ahin, chule aning langa bangkot ho jong chu chutobang ma a chu kisem cheh ahiuve. Houin bang sungnung lang ho jong chu achung lang bang kotho noilang chu aboncha thing thing amai neija kisem cheh ahi.
en: the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),
text:
EZK 41:16
Thadou: abonchauva thing amai neija kisem cheh ahin, chule aning langa bangkot ho jong chu chutobang ma a chu kisem cheh ahiuve. Houin bang sungnung lang ho jong chu achung lang bang kotho noilang chu aboncha thing thing amai neija kisem cheh ahi.
English: the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),

tcz: Kot chung a onglai indan sungnung channa chetou peh a chule abang asung apo chutobang ma a chu kisem ahi.
en: to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.
text:
EZK 41:17
Thadou: Kot chung a onglai indan sungnung channa chetou peh a chule abang asung apo chutobang ma a chu kisem ahi.
English: to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.

tcz: Abang jouse Cherubim lim kisema kijem a khat cheh chun maini anei cheh in, chule hiche Cherubim ho kikah a chun tumthing kijem pol aumin ahi.
en: It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces,
text:
EZK 41:18
Thadou: Abang jouse Cherubim lim kisema kijem a khat cheh chun maini anei cheh in, chule hiche Cherubim ho kikah a chun tumthing kijem pol aumin ahi.
English: It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces,

tcz: Mihem mai khat in tumthing phung lang angan khat kit chun ahile keipi nou mai ahin hichun tumthing phung lang khatma chu angai. Hiche ho chu houin sung lhung keija kisem soh hela ahin,
en: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around.
text:
EZK 41:19
Thadou: Mihem mai khat in tumthing phung lang angan khat kit chun ahile keipi nou mai ahin hichun tumthing phung lang khatma chu angai. Hiche ho chu houin sung lhung keija kisem soh hela ahin,
English: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around.

tcz: Tolla bangleh chan ahin, muntheng polam bang ho jong ahoptha ahi.
en: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.
text:
EZK 41:20
Thadou: Tolla bangleh chan ahin, muntheng polam bang ho jong ahoptha ahi.
English: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.

tcz: Muntheng sung lutna a khom ho chu aningli kibang a kisui ahi cheh in, chule muntheng chungnung lutna a ho jong chu akibang cheh e.
en: The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.
text:
EZK 41:21
Thadou: Muntheng sung lutna a khom ho chu aningli kibang a kisui ahi cheh in, chule muntheng chungnung lutna a ho jong chu akibang cheh e.
English: The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.

tcz: Chuleh maicham thinga kisem feet nga leh hopli a hopkhat sang chule feet thum leh akeh sau ahin, aning akitunna chule abang aboncha thinga kisem ahicheh e. Hiche mipa chun eisei peh in Pakai angsunga um dokhang chu ahi.
en: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before the LORD.”
text:
EZK 41:22
Thadou: Chuleh maicham thinga kisem feet nga leh hopli a hopkhat sang chule feet thum leh akeh sau ahin, aning akitunna chule abang aboncha thinga kisem ahicheh e. Hiche mipa chun eisei peh in Pakai angsunga um dokhang chu ahi.
English: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before the LORD.”

tcz: Muntheng phung leh muntheng chungnung teni chun kotpi ni gel aneicheh lhone.
en: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
text:
EZK 41:23
Thadou: Muntheng phung leh muntheng chungnung teni chun kotpi ni gel aneicheh lhone.
English: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

tcz: Kot ihon nalam lama kihong chule amachama kikhah thei cheh ahi.
en: The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.
text:
EZK 41:24
Thadou: Kot ihon nalam lama kihong chule amachama kikhah thei cheh ahi.
English: The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.

tcz: Muntheng lutna kot chu Cherubim lima kisem tumthing ho a abang ho kijem cheh ahi. Houin hongcha achung thinga kikhu khat aume.
en: There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.
text:
EZK 41:25
Thadou: Muntheng lutna kot chu Cherubim lima kisem tumthing ho a abang ho kijem cheh ahi. Houin hongcha achung thinga kikhu khat aume.
English: There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.

tcz: Hongcha alangto gel a chun tum thing kijem pola kisem bang kot anei cheh e. Bang polanga inpanga indan ho jong chu achung khu anei cheh u ahi.
en: There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch. This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged.
text:
EZK 41:26
Thadou: Hongcha alangto gel a chun tum thing kijem pola kisem bang kot anei cheh e. Bang polanga inpanga indan ho jong chu achung khu anei cheh u ahi.
English: There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch. This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged.

tcz: Sahlang kotpi a kon chun houin thutanna pamlang a chun mipa chun eipui doh e. Polam thutanna in na chun kalut lhonin chule thutanna insung nunga sahlang bang ho a um indan ho a chun kahung lhone.
en: Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.
text:
EZK 42:1
Thadou: Sahlang kotpi a kon chun houin thutanna pamlang a chun mipa chun eipui doh e. Polam thutanna in na chun kalut lhonin chule thutanna insung nunga sahlang bang ho a um indan ho a chun kahung lhone.
English: Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.

tcz: Sahlang lutna kihong bang kigon dan chu adung lang feet jakhat le som sagi le nga ahin chule availam somget le akeh ahi.
en: Facing the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.
text:
EZK 42:2
Thadou: Sahlang lutna kihong bang kigon dan chu adung lang feet jakhat le som sagi le nga ahin chule availam somget le akeh ahi.
English: Facing the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.

tcz: Inlentah a kisa indan ho chu thutanna in toh kijop mat ahin, hichu availam feet somthum le nga ahi. Indan dang khat chu polang thutanna keng lampi toh ki ang ngat ahi. Indan teni chu song thum sanga kisa ahin, chule khat leh khat kisa galkai ahi.
en: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the three stories.
text:
EZK 42:3
Thadou: Inlentah a kisa indan ho chu thutanna in toh kijop mat ahin, hichu availam feet somthum le nga ahi. Indan dang khat chu polang thutanna keng lampi toh ki ang ngat ahi. Indan teni chu song thum sanga kisa ahin, chule khat leh khat kisa galkai ahi.
English: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the three stories.

tcz: Indan teni kikah a keng lampi chu availam feet som le sagi le akeh ahi, akivel hop sung sese chu feet jakhat som sagi le nga ahin, chule akot jousen sahlang angan ahi.
en: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.
text:
EZK 42:4
Thadou: Indan teni kikah a keng lampi chu availam feet som le sagi le akeh ahi, akivel hop sung sese chu feet jakhat som sagi le nga ahin, chule akot jousen sahlang angan ahi.
English: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.

tcz: Asong chungnung teni a indan ho chu anoinung sangin ajum jep jep in ahi. Ajeh chu song chungnung hoa chu keng lampi amalang anei ngai ahi.
en: Now the upper rooms were shorter; for the galleries took away from these more than from the lower and the middle in the building.
text:
EZK 42:5
Thadou: Asong chungnung teni a indan ho chu anoinung sangin ajum jep jep in ahi. Ajeh chu song chungnung hoa chu keng lampi amalang anei ngai ahi.
English: Now the upper rooms were shorter; for the galleries took away from these more than from the lower and the middle in the building.

tcz: In chu asong thum'a kisa ahin, chule amaho chun thutanna in na bang adou ding neilou ahi. Asong chungnung chu asong noinunga chu kitung jang jep ahi.
en: For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.
text:
EZK 42:6
Thadou: In chu asong thum'a kisa ahin, chule amaho chun thutanna in na bang adou ding neilou ahi. Asong chungnung chu asong noinunga chu kitung jang jep ahi.
English: For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.

tcz: Polam thutanna in na kona achom khen in polang bang chu feet som get le sagi le akeh’a sau ahi.
en: The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, was fifty cubits long.
text:
EZK 42:7
Thadou: Polam thutanna in na kona achom khen in polang bang chu feet som get le sagi le akeh’a sau ahi.
English: The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, was fifty cubits long.

tcz: Polam indan bang ho a chun ajopsau be a hichea chu feet som get le sagi le akeh kikeh be ahin, inlen sungnung lang houin toh kijopmat indan ho chu feet jakhat le som sagi le nga kehlet be ahi.
en: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, those facing the temple were one hundred cubits.
text:
EZK 42:8
Thadou: Polam indan bang ho a chun ajopsau be a hichea chu feet som get le sagi le akeh kikeh be ahin, inlen sungnung lang houin toh kijopmat indan ho chu feet jakhat le som sagi le nga kehlet be ahi.
English: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, those facing the temple were one hundred cubits.

tcz: Hicheng indan ho a chun thutanna'a konna lutna khat aume.
en: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.
text:
EZK 42:9
Thadou: Hicheng indan ho a chun thutanna'a konna lutna khat aume.
English: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.

tcz: Houin pang lhanglang sang sung thutanna houin leh thutanna in kikah a chun indan ni aume. Hiche indan ho chu sahlang sanga indan ho bang banga kisem ahi.
en: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.
text:
EZK 42:10
Thadou: Houin pang lhanglang sang sung thutanna houin leh thutanna in kikah a chun indan ni aume. Hiche indan ho chu sahlang sanga indan ho bang banga kisem ahi.
English: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.

tcz: Hiche a chun houin sahlang panga bang bang chun indan teni kikah a chun keng lampi aume. Hiche indan let dan chu adung avai adang dang ho abang bang ahi. Chuleh adangho a banga lutna leh kot jong aneiyin ahi. Alet aneo dan dankhat chu amuthei jeng ahi.
en: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north. Their length and width were the same. All their exits had the same arrangement and doors.
text:
EZK 42:11
Thadou: Hiche a chun houin sahlang panga bang bang chun indan teni kikah a chun keng lampi aume. Hiche indan let dan chu adung avai adang dang ho abang bang ahi. Chuleh adangho a banga lutna leh kot jong aneiyin ahi. Alet aneo dan dankhat chu amuthei jeng ahi.
English: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north. Their length and width were the same. All their exits had the same arrangement and doors.

tcz: Indan sungnung lang angat in lutna khat aume. Chule sung lang keng lampi kichai solam langa jong chun adang khat aume.
en: Like the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.
text:
EZK 42:12
Thadou: Indan sungnung lang angat in lutna khat aume. Chule sung lang keng lampi kichai solam langa jong chun adang khat aume.
English: Like the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.

tcz: Hichun mihem pa chun kajah a eiseipeh in hiche indan ho houin kisuh vetna a kon sahlang leh lhanglang ho chu atheng ahi. Hilai munna chu Pakaija kilhaina thilto toh'a pang thempu ho chun thil theng chungnung kitoh ho chu aneh diu ahi. Chule indan ho athen jeh a chu thiltheng kitoh ho kholna a anei diu ahi. Chang thilto ho chonset thilto ho, chuleh themmo thilto ho ahiuve.
en: Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are opposite the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to the LORD shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.
text:
EZK 42:13
Thadou: Hichun mihem pa chun kajah a eiseipeh in hiche indan ho houin kisuh vetna a kon sahlang leh lhanglang ho chu atheng ahi. Hilai munna chu Pakaija kilhaina thilto toh'a pang thempu ho chun thil theng chungnung kitoh ho chu aneh diu ahi. Chule indan ho athen jeh a chu thiltheng kitoh ho kholna a anei diu ahi. Chang thilto ho chonset thilto ho, chuleh themmo thilto ho ahiuve.
English: Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are opposite the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to the LORD shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

tcz: Thempuho chun muntheng chu adalhah teng uleh thutanna in polama chu che pai jeng theilou diu ahi. Amahon kin theng abolnau pon ho chu akilah doh masat diu ahi. Ajeh chu hiche pon ho chu atheng ahi. Amahon mipi kititna insung alut masang uva avon u akikhel masat dingu ahi.
en: When the priests enter in, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court until they lay their garments in which they minister there; for they are holy. Then they shall put on other garments, and shall approach that which is for the people.”
text:
EZK 42:14
Thadou: Thempuho chun muntheng chu adalhah teng uleh thutanna in polama chu che pai jeng theilou diu ahi. Amahon kin theng abolnau pon ho chu akilah doh masat diu ahi. Ajeh chu hiche pon ho chu atheng ahi. Amahon mipi kititna insung alut masang uva avon u akikhel masat dingu ahi.
English: When the priests enter in, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court until they lay their garments in which they minister there; for they are holy. Then they shall put on other garments, and shall approach that which is for the people.”

tcz: Mipa chu houin kimvel sung ho ate jou phat in aman agam hop kol sung sese te ding solam kot a chun eipui doh tai.
en: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east, and measured it all around.
text:
EZK 42:15
Thadou: Mipa chu houin kimvel sung ho ate jou phat in aman agam hop kol sung sese te ding solam kot a chun eipui doh tai.
English: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east, and measured it all around.

tcz: Amapa chun thiltena tenglhon chun solam lang sang chu aten ahi. Chule hichu feet jaget le som sagi le nga’n asauvin ahi.
en: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.
text:
EZK 42:16
Thadou: Amapa chun thiltena tenglhon chun solam lang sang chu aten ahi. Chule hichu feet jaget le som sagi le nga’n asauvin ahi.
English: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.

tcz: Hichun sahlang sang aten ahile hichu feet jaget le som sagi le nga ahi.
en: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.
text:
EZK 42:17
Thadou: Hichun sahlang sang aten ahile hichu feet jaget le som sagi le nga ahi.
English: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.

tcz: Lhanglang sang jong chu feet jaget le som sagi le nga ahi.
en: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
text:
EZK 42:18
Thadou: Lhanglang sang jong chu feet jaget le som sagi le nga ahi.
English: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

tcz: Chuleh lhumlam sang jong chu feet jaget le som sagi le nga ma ahi.
en: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
text:
EZK 42:19
Thadou: Chuleh lhumlam sang jong chu feet jaget le som sagi le nga ma ahi.
English: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

tcz: Hijeh chun alang jouse ajet avei asah alhang feet jaget le som sagi le nga cheh ahin, muntheng leh mi kititna mun sepkhen dingin bang akigen lhung keije.
en: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.
text:
EZK 42:20
Thadou: Hijeh chun alang jouse ajet avei asah alhang feet jaget le som sagi le nga cheh ahin, muntheng leh mi kititna mun sepkhen dingin bang akigen lhung keije.
English: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.

tcz: Hicheng jou nung chun mipa chun solam kotpi vella chun eilepui lutne.
en: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looks toward the east.
text:
EZK 43:1
Thadou: Hicheng jou nung chun mipa chun solam kotpi vella chun eilepui lutne.
English: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looks toward the east.

tcz: Phulou helouvin Pathen loupina chu solam langa kon chun ahung kilah e. Ama hung kitol gin chu twi tampi kitol gin toh abangin, chule leiset pumpi chu aloupinan asalvah e.
en: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth was illuminated with his glory.
text:
EZK 43:2
Thadou: Phulou helouvin Pathen loupina chu solam langa kon chun ahung kilah e. Ama hung kitol gin chu twi tampi kitol gin toh abangin, chule leiset pumpi chu aloupinan asalvah e.
English: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth was illuminated with his glory.

tcz: Hiche gao thilmu jong hi adanga kamu ho toh abangin, amasan Kebar vadung panga chule Jerusalem sumang dinga ahungna hichun keiman kamai tolla kasulut jenge.
en: It was like the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.
text:
EZK 43:3
Thadou: Hiche gao thilmu jong hi adanga kamu ho toh abangin, amasan Kebar vadung panga chule Jerusalem sumang dinga ahungna hichun keiman kamai tolla kasulut jenge.
English: It was like the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.

tcz: Chule Pakai loupina chu solam kotpi a konin houin sungah ahung lutne.
en: The LORD’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.
text:
EZK 43:4
Thadou: Chule Pakai loupina chu solam kotpi a konin houin sungah ahung lutne.
English: The LORD’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.

tcz: Hichun lhagao chun eihung pui touvin, thutanna sungnung langa chun eipuilutne. Chule Pakai loupina chun houin adipset jenge.
en: The Spirit took me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, the LORD’s glory filled the house.
text:
EZK 43:5
Thadou: Hichun lhagao chun eihung pui touvin, thutanna sungnung langa chun eipuilutne. Chule Pakai loupina chun houin adipset jenge.
English: The Spirit took me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, the LORD’s glory filled the house.

tcz: Chule keiman houin sunga konna kahenga thusei khat kajai. Hichun houin te a pang pachu kakoma ana dinge.
en: I heard one speaking to me out of the house, and a man stood by me.
text:
EZK 43:6
Thadou: Chule keiman houin sunga konna kahenga thusei khat kajai. Hichun houin te a pang pachu kakoma ana dinge.
English: I heard one speaking to me out of the house, and a man stood by me.

tcz: Pakaiyin kahenga aseijin mihem chapa hiche hi kalal touna ahin, chuleh kakeng kangapna ding mun chu ahi. Keima atonsotna Israel tetoh kachen khom ding ahi. Amaho aleng teuvin kamin asuh boh kit talou diu ahi. Jon thanhoi dimsetna Pathen dang ahou nauva kon ahilouleh aleng teu thisa ho ajabol nauva konna
en: He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell among the children of Israel forever. The house of Israel will no more defile my holy name, neither they nor their kings, by their prostitution and by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places;

tcz: Amahon milim doi maicham chu keija ban tah a akoijun hichu bangin keija leh amaho chu akhen mai mai bou ahi. Amahon kidah dah uma chonset nauva chu kamintheng asuhboh jiu ahin, hijeh a chu keiman kalung hanna a chu kabah gamu ahi.
en: in their setting of their threshold by my threshold and their door post beside my door post. There was a wall between me and them; and they have defiled my holy name by their abominations which they have committed. Therefore I have consumed them in my anger.
text:
EZK 43:8
Thadou: Amahon milim doi maicham chu keija ban tah a akoijun hichu bangin keija leh amaho chu akhen mai mai bou ahi. Amahon kidah dah uma chonset nauva chu kamintheng asuhboh jiu ahin, hijeh a chu keiman kalung hanna a chu kabah gamu ahi.
English: in their setting of their threshold by my threshold and their door post beside my door post. There was a wall between me and them; and they have defiled my holy name by their abominations which they have committed. Therefore I have consumed them in my anger.

tcz: Tun amahon pathen dang hou nga tauhen, chuleh aleng teu thisa ho ajabol nau. Chule keima atonsotna amaho lah a kachen ding ahi.
en: Now let them put away their prostitution, and the dead bodies of their kings far from me. Then I will dwell among them forever.
text:
EZK 43:9
Thadou: Tun amahon pathen dang hou nga tauhen, chuleh aleng teu thisa ho ajabol nau. Chule keima atonsotna amaho lah a kachen ding ahi.
English: Now let them put away their prostitution, and the dead bodies of their kings far from me. Then I will dwell among them forever.

tcz: Mihem chapa keiman kavetsah houin chu Israel mite koma kicheh tah in seipeh in. Chutileh achonset nau hou jouse a kijapi diu ahi. Athilgon hou kihil uhen.
en: “You, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.
text:
EZK 43:10
Thadou: Mihem chapa keiman kavetsah houin chu Israel mite koma kicheh tah in seipeh in. Chutileh achonset nau hou jouse a kijapi diu ahi. Athilgon hou kihil uhen.
English: “You, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.

tcz: Chuleh athilbol sa houva chu jahcha diu ahi. Houin kisem ding dan kicheh tah kavetsah chu kicheh tah in hilchen in alutna ding leh apotdohna dingho pumin chuleh aboncha keijin thupeh holeh chondan ho seipeh in. Hiche ho chungchang chu kicheh tah in sutdoh peh in. Chu thupeh avet uva hitia chu ageldoh kitnuva chule ajui theina diuvin.
en: If they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the form of the house, its fashion, its exits, its entrances, its structure, all its ordinances, all its forms, and all its laws; and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form of it, and all its ordinances, and do them.
text:
EZK 43:11
Thadou: Chuleh athilbol sa houva chu jahcha diu ahi. Houin kisem ding dan kicheh tah kavetsah chu kicheh tah in hilchen in alutna ding leh apotdohna dingho pumin chuleh aboncha keijin thupeh holeh chondan ho seipeh in. Hiche ho chungchang chu kicheh tah in sutdoh peh in. Chu thupeh avet uva hitia chu ageldoh kitnuva chule ajui theina diuvin.
English: If they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the form of the house, its fashion, its exits, its entrances, its structure, all its ordinances, all its forms, and all its laws; and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form of it, and all its ordinances, and do them.

tcz: Chule hiche houin athenna den jouse kipatna ahin, houin kisahna molsang pumpi hi thenga ahi. Henge, hiche houin chonna dan bulpi ahi.
en: “This is the law of the house. On the top of the mountain the whole limit around it shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.
text:
EZK 43:12
Thadou: Chule hiche houin athenna den jouse kipatna ahin, houin kisahna molsang pumpi hi thenga ahi. Henge, hiche houin chonna dan bulpi ahi.
English: “This is the law of the house. On the top of the mountain the whole limit around it shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

tcz: Hiche ho hi maicham tena chu ahi. Maicham kimvella chun twikai aumin, hichu inche somni le khat a thuh ahin, chule avai inche somni le khat ma ahi. Atuhna aning chan geija inche ko ahi. Hiche hi maicham asan dan ahi.
en: “These are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit is a cubit and a hand width): the bottom shall be a cubit, and the width a cubit, and its border around its edge a span; and this shall be the base of the altar.
text:
EZK 43:13
Thadou: Hiche ho hi maicham tena chu ahi. Maicham kimvella chun twikai aumin, hichu inche somni le khat a thuh ahin, chule avai inche somni le khat ma ahi. Atuhna aning chan geija inche ko ahi. Hiche hi maicham asan dan ahi.
English: “These are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit is a cubit and a hand width): the bottom shall be a cubit, and the width a cubit, and its border around its edge a span; and this shall be the base of the altar.

tcz: Maicham chu atuhna a patna feet thumle akeh’a kikhang sang ahin, hichun maicham chu akol lhung kei ahi. Chuleh hichu athuh lam inche somi le khat ahin, chuleh availam inche somni le khat ahi. Anoinung jum laiya pat maicham chu feet sagia sang ahin, availam inche somni le khat a achung lang ajum chan geija kikhang doh ahi.
en: From the bottom on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the width one cubit; and from the lesser ledge to the greater ledge shall be four cubits, and the width a cubit.
text:
EZK 43:14
Thadou: Maicham chu atuhna a patna feet thumle akeh’a kikhang sang ahin, hichun maicham chu akol lhung kei ahi. Chuleh hichu athuh lam inche somi le khat ahin, chuleh availam inche somni le khat ahi. Anoinung jum laiya pat maicham chu feet sagia sang ahin, availam inche somni le khat a achung lang ajum chan geija kikhang doh ahi.
English: From the bottom on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the width one cubit; and from the lesser ledge to the greater ledge shall be four cubits, and the width a cubit.

tcz: Maicham chun tapkong chu feet sagia sanga kikhang sang ahin, aninglia kipatna saki hung kitung doh ahi.
en: The upper altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns.
text:
EZK 43:15
Thadou: Maicham chun tapkong chu feet sagia sanga kikhang sang ahin, aninglia kipatna saki hung kitung doh ahi.
English: The upper altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns.

tcz: Maicham chung chu aningli ahin, hichu inche somni le khat a konna inche somni le khat ma ahi.
en: The altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve wide, square in its four sides.
text:
EZK 43:16
Thadou: Maicham chung chu aningli ahin, hichu inche somni le khat a konna inche somni le khat ma ahi.
English: The altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve wide, square in its four sides.

tcz: Achunglang ajum lai jong chu aningli ma asem ahin, hichu ateng dungjuija feet somni le khat le akeh chule somni le khat ma ahin, hichu twikai inche somni le khat chule atuhna inche som le akeh agei lhung keija toh hitha ahi. Hiche a chu maicham solam lang sanga chun kalbi dang eat achetouvin ahi.
en: The ledge shall be fourteen cubits long by fourteen wide in its four sides; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and its bottom shall be a cubit around; and its steps shall look toward the east.”
text:
EZK 43:17
Thadou: Achunglang ajum lai jong chu aningli ma asem ahin, hichu ateng dungjuija feet somni le khat le akeh chule somni le khat ma ahin, hichu twikai inche somni le khat chule atuhna inche som le akeh agei lhung keija toh hitha ahi. Hiche a chu maicham solam lang sanga chun kalbi dang eat achetouvin ahi.
English: The ledge shall be fourteen cubits long by fourteen wide in its four sides; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and its bottom shall be a cubit around; and its steps shall look toward the east.”

tcz: Hichun aman kahenga aseijin mihem chapa hiche thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Hiche hohi maicham pumgo thilto kibol ding dan ho chu ahi. Chule maicham akisah tengleh thisan thekhum dan ho ahi.
en: He said to me, “Son of man, the Lord GOD says: ‘These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they make it, to offer burnt offerings on it, and to sprinkle blood on it.
text:
EZK 43:18
Thadou: Hichun aman kahenga aseijin mihem chapa hiche thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Hiche hohi maicham pumgo thilto kibol ding dan ho chu ahi. Chule maicham akisah tengleh thisan thekhum dan ho ahi.
English: He said to me, “Son of man, the Lord GOD says: ‘These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they make it, to offer burnt offerings on it, and to sprinkle blood on it.

tcz: Hiche phatteng chule Zadok insung mi Levi te thempu ho ka angsunga kakin bolla pangho chu chonset thilto dinga bongchal gol khat kipe ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: You shall give to the Levitical priests who are of the offspring of Zadok, who are near to me, to minister to me,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘a young bull for a sin offering.
text:
EZK 43:19
Thadou: Hiche phatteng chule Zadok insung mi Levi te thempu ho ka angsunga kakin bolla pangho chu chonset thilto dinga bongchal gol khat kipe ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: You shall give to the Levitical priests who are of the offspring of Zadok, who are near to me, to minister to me,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘a young bull for a sin offering.

tcz: Nang thisan them khat naham doh a maichama saki li ho chunga chu naloi ding ahi. Achunglang aningli laiya chu nanu ding ahi. Chuleh agei kimvel lhung keija atunna a chu nanu tha ding ahi. Hiche chun maicham asuhtheng naleh chonset thoidamna hiding ahi.
en: You shall take of its blood and put it on its four horns, and on the four corners of the ledge, and on the border all around. You shall cleanse it and make atonement for it that way.
text:
EZK 43:20
Thadou: Nang thisan them khat naham doh a maichama saki li ho chunga chu naloi ding ahi. Achunglang aningli laiya chu nanu ding ahi. Chuleh agei kimvel lhung keija atunna a chu nanu tha ding ahi. Hiche chun maicham asuhtheng naleh chonset thoidamna hiding ahi.
English: You shall take of its blood and put it on its four horns, and on the four corners of the ledge, and on the border all around. You shall cleanse it and make atonement for it that way.

tcz: Chuteng chonset thilto bongchal lagol chu alah a chule houin kimvella lhendohsa kikoi laiya chu agovam ding ahi.
en: You shall also take the bull of the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house, outside of the sanctuary.
text:
EZK 43:21
Thadou: Chuteng chonset thilto bongchal lagol chu alah a chule houin kimvella lhendohsa kikoi laiya chu agovam ding ahi.
English: You shall also take the bull of the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house, outside of the sanctuary.

tcz: Anini channi leh chonset thilto kilhaina dinga chu nolna bei kelchal gol khat nato ding ahi. Chuteng leh bongchal khat na chonset suhthengna leh thoidamna nabol bang banga chu maicham suhthengna leh thoidamna nabol ding ahi.
en: “On the second day you shall offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they cleansed it with the bull.
text:
EZK 43:22
Thadou: Anini channi leh chonset thilto kilhaina dinga chu nolna bei kelchal gol khat nato ding ahi. Chuteng leh bongchal khat na chonset suhthengna leh thoidamna nabol bang banga chu maicham suhthengna leh thoidamna nabol ding ahi.
English: “On the second day you shall offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they cleansed it with the bull.

tcz: Hiche suhthenga kin chu nabol jou tengleh nolna bei bongchal dang khat leh nolnabei khat ma a kon lah a ahonna nalah doh a nato ding ahi.
en: When you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a young bull without defect and a ram out of the flock without defect.
text:
EZK 43:23
Thadou: Hiche suhthenga kin chu nabol jou tengleh nolna bei bongchal dang khat leh nolnabei khat ma a kon lah a ahonna nalah doh a nato ding ahi.
English: When you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a young bull without defect and a ram out of the flock without defect.

tcz: Nangin hiche ho chu Pakaija natodoh a chule thempuhon hiche ho chunga chu chi athekhum uva chule Pakaija dinga pumgo thilto a ato dingu ahi.
en: You shall bring them near to the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt on them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering to the LORD.
text:
EZK 43:24
Thadou: Nangin hiche ho chu Pakaija natodoh a chule thempuhon hiche ho chunga chu chi athekhum uva chule Pakaija dinga pumgo thilto a ato dingu ahi.
English: You shall bring them near to the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt on them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering to the LORD.

tcz: Hitia chu ni sagi sunga kelchal khat, bongchal gol khat, chuleh kelngoi khat ahonlah a konna nalah doh a chonset thilto kilhaina dinga nato ding ahi. Hiche gancha ho chu nolna bei seisetna bei cheh hidiu ahi.
en: “Seven days you shall prepare every day a goat for a sin offering. They shall also prepare a young bull and a ram out of the flock, without defect.
text:
EZK 43:25
Thadou: Hitia chu ni sagi sunga kelchal khat, bongchal gol khat, chuleh kelngoi khat ahonlah a konna nalah doh a chonset thilto kilhaina dinga nato ding ahi. Hiche gancha ho chu nolna bei seisetna bei cheh hidiu ahi.
English: “Seven days you shall prepare every day a goat for a sin offering. They shall also prepare a young bull and a ram out of the flock, without defect.

tcz: Hitia hi nisagi sunga niseh leh maicham dinga suhthengna leh lhatdohna nabol peh peh ding ahi. Athenga manchah dinga asekhen diu ahi.
en: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it. So shall they consecrate it.
text:
EZK 43:26
Thadou: Hitia hi nisagi sunga niseh leh maicham dinga suhthengna leh lhatdohna nabol peh peh ding ahi. Athenga manchah dinga asekhen diu ahi.
English: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it. So shall they consecrate it.

tcz: Nisagi lhingset chu aboljou teng uleh aniget channi leh maicham chunga chu thempu hon govam thilto kilhaina abol diu chule mipiho dinga chamna thilto ato doh diu ahi. Chuteng leh keiman nang kakisan lut diu nahi, keima thaneitah Pakai kitipan kaseidoh sa ahi.
en: When they have accomplished the days, it shall be that on the eighth day and onward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings on the altar and your peace offerings. Then I will accept you,’ says the Lord GOD.”
text:
EZK 43:27
Thadou: Nisagi lhingset chu aboljou teng uleh aniget channi leh maicham chunga chu thempu hon govam thilto kilhaina abol diu chule mipiho dinga chamna thilto ato doh diu ahi. Chuteng leh keiman nang kakisan lut diu nahi, keima thaneitah Pakai kitipan kaseidoh sa ahi.
English: When they have accomplished the days, it shall be that on the eighth day and onward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings on the altar and your peace offerings. Then I will accept you,’ says the Lord GOD.”

tcz: Hichun mipa chun polam kelkot nisolam ngatna kihoi laiya chun eihin nung puilut kit in ahileh kelkot chu ana kikhah chah tai.
en: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.
text:
EZK 44:1
Thadou: Hichun mipa chun polam kelkot nisolam ngatna kihoi laiya chun eihin nung puilut kit in ahileh kelkot chu ana kikhah chah tai.
English: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin kajah a hiche kelkot hi kikhah jing ding kihong kit lou hel ding chule
en: The LORD said to me, “This gate shall be shut. It shall not be opened, no man shall enter in by it; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered in by it. Therefore it shall be shut.
text:
EZK 44:2
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin kajah a hiche kelkot hi kikhah jing ding kihong kit lou hel ding chule
English: The LORD said to me, “This gate shall be shut. It shall not be opened, no man shall enter in by it; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered in by it. Therefore it shall be shut.

tcz: Mihem in jong lutna anei louhel ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile hiche kelkot a hi Pakai Israel Pathen hung lutna ahitai. Hijeh a chu a itih a kikhah jing ding ahitai. Lengpa chapa changseh bou chu asunga touva Pakai angsunga an aga neh ding ahi. Ahinlah amachu hiche hongcha lampia kotpia chu lutna chule potna jong anei ding ahi.
en: As for the prince, he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before the LORD. He shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out the same way.”
text:
EZK 44:3
Thadou: Mihem in jong lutna anei louhel ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile hiche kelkot a hi Pakai Israel Pathen hung lutna ahitai. Hijeh a chu a itih a kikhah jing ding ahitai. Lengpa chapa changseh bou chu asunga touva Pakai angsunga an aga neh ding ahi. Ahinlah amachu hiche hongcha lampia kotpia chu lutna chule potna jong anei ding ahi.
English: As for the prince, he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before the LORD. He shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out the same way.”

tcz: Hichun mipa chun houin mai sahlang kelkotna kon chun eihin puilutne. Keiman kaven ahile Pakai loupina Pakai houin dimsetna aum chu kamui. Hichun keiman kamai tolla kasulut tai.
en: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house; so I fell on my face.
text:
EZK 44:4
Thadou: Hichun mipa chun houin mai sahlang kelkotna kon chun eihin puilutne. Keiman kaven ahile Pakai loupina Pakai houin dimsetna aum chu kamui. Hichun keiman kamai tolla kasulut tai.
English: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house; so I fell on my face.

tcz: Chuleh Pakaiyin kahenga aseijin, mihem chapa hetsahna hi chingthei tah in melchih in. Namit leh nanakhang mangchan lang thil jouse ngaijin. Keiman Pathen houin chondan hohi kaseipeh ding nahi. Houin lutna leh potna aum ding dan ho chingthei tah in melchih in.
en: The LORD said to me, “Son of man, mark well, and see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I tell you concerning all the ordinances of the LORD’s house and all its laws; and mark well the entrance of the house, with every exit of the sanctuary.
text:
EZK 44:5
Thadou: Chuleh Pakaiyin kahenga aseijin, mihem chapa hetsahna hi chingthei tah in melchih in. Namit leh nanakhang mangchan lang thil jouse ngaijin. Keiman Pathen houin chondan hohi kaseipeh ding nahi. Houin lutna leh potna aum ding dan ho chingthei tah in melchih in.
English: The LORD said to me, “Son of man, mark well, and see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I tell you concerning all the ordinances of the LORD’s house and all its laws; and mark well the entrance of the house, with every exit of the sanctuary.

tcz: Chuleh hiche doumah bol Israel mite khu hiche thaneitah Pakai thusei hi seipeh in. O Israel mipite! Kidah dah um chonset nabol u chu phatante.
en: You shall tell the rebellious, even the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “You house of Israel, let that be enough of all your abominations,
text:
EZK 44:6
Thadou: Chuleh hiche doumah bol Israel mite khu hiche thaneitah Pakai thusei hi seipeh in. O Israel mipite! Kidah dah um chonset nabol u chu phatante.
English: You shall tell the rebellious, even the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “You house of Israel, let that be enough of all your abominations,

tcz: Pathenna dinga lungthim neilou mite, cheptan lou gamdang mite chu kamun, thingphung nahin puilut uva, hiti hin ka houin nasuboh un chule kaneh ding an jong chu nasuboh tha ji tauve. Athau chule kilhaina thisan ho pumin kidah dah umna chonsetnau ho keuseh hilouvin keima kitepna ho nasukeh be nalai juve.
en: in that you have brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to profane it, even my house, when you offer my bread, the fat and the blood; and they have broken my covenant, to add to all your abominations.
text:
EZK 44:7
Thadou: Pathenna dinga lungthim neilou mite, cheptan lou gamdang mite chu kamun, thingphung nahin puilut uva, hiti hin ka houin nasuboh un chule kaneh ding an jong chu nasuboh tha ji tauve. Athau chule kilhaina thisan ho pumin kidah dah umna chonsetnau ho keuseh hilouvin keima kitepna ho nasukeh be nalai juve.
English: in that you have brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to profane it, even my house, when you offer my bread, the fat and the blood; and they have broken my covenant, to add to all your abominations.

tcz: Kachon dan thengho nitding khellin kamun theng vettup dingin gamdang miho chu nathalah tauve.
en: You have not performed the duty of my holy things; but you have set performers of my duty in my sanctuary for yourselves.”
text:
EZK 44:8
Thadou: Kachon dan thengho nitding khellin kamun theng vettup dingin gamdang miho chu nathalah tauve.
English: You have not performed the duty of my holy things; but you have set performers of my duty in my sanctuary for yourselves.”

tcz: Hijeh a chu hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Cheptan lou chule Pakai koma kipeh dohna neilou Israel te lah a chengsa ho jeng jong koima kamuntheng phunga lut theilou hel diu ahi.
en: The Lord GOD says, “No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any foreigners who are among the children of Israel.
text:
EZK 44:9
Thadou: Hijeh a chu hichehi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Cheptan lou chule Pakai koma kipeh dohna neilou Israel te lah a chengsa ho jeng jong koima kamuntheng phunga lut theilou hel diu ahi.
English: The Lord GOD says, “No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any foreigners who are among the children of Israel.

tcz: Chuleh Levi phunga mipa te milim doi hou dinga keija konna achemang laijuva eidalha ho, akitah lou nau dungjuija akipoh diu ahi.
en: “‘“But the Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols, they will bear their iniquity.
text:
EZK 44:10
Thadou: Chuleh Levi phunga mipa te milim doi hou dinga keija konna achemang laijuva eidalha ho, akitah lou nau dungjuija akipoh diu ahi.
English: “‘“But the Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols, they will bear their iniquity.

tcz: Amaho chu houin veng tupma pang chuleh kelkot ngah a pang chuleh pumgo thilto dinga hung kichoi ganchaho that in pang uhenlang chuleh mipi ho kithopi in pang jong leu
en: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house. They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.
text:
EZK 44:11
Thadou: Amaho chu houin veng tupma pang chuleh kelkot ngah a pang chuleh pumgo thilto dinga hung kichoi ganchaho that in pang uhenlang chuleh mipi ho kithopi in pang jong leu
English: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house. They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in amahon kamite chu milim doi hou dingin ana tilkhou jiuvinm Israel techu chonsetna thuhtah in alhuhsah jiuve. Hijeh chun keiman kihahselna dettah in kaneijin hijeh a chu amahon achonset nau ga chu akipoh cheh diu ahi, tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I have lifted up my hand against them,” says the Lord GOD, “and they will bear their iniquity.
text:
EZK 44:12
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in amahon kamite chu milim doi hou dingin ana tilkhou jiuvinm Israel techu chonsetna thuhtah in alhuhsah jiuve. Hijeh chun keiman kihahselna dettah in kaneijin hijeh a chu amahon achonset nau ga chu akipoh cheh diu ahi, tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I have lifted up my hand against them,” says the Lord GOD, “and they will bear their iniquity.

tcz: Amahon thempu khat hina a kakin bol dinga eihin nailut louhel dingu ahi. Amahon kathil thengho khat atohkhah theilou diu, ahilouleh thilto thengho jong chu athamkhah theilou diu ahi. Ijeh inem itile kidah dah uma chonset nau anabol dohsa hou jouse jachatna chu akipoh diu ahi.
en: They shall not come near to me, to execute the office of priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, to the things that are most holy; but they will bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed.
text:
EZK 44:13
Thadou: Amahon thempu khat hina a kakin bol dinga eihin nailut louhel dingu ahi. Amahon kathil thengho khat atohkhah theilou diu, ahilouleh thilto thengho jong chu athamkhah theilou diu ahi. Ijeh inem itile kidah dah uma chonset nau anabol dohsa hou jouse jachatna chu akipoh diu ahi.
English: They shall not come near to me, to execute the office of priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, to the things that are most holy; but they will bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed.

tcz: Amaho chun houin phat chomkhat a dinga vaihoma pang diu, vettupma natoh ho a mopona anei diu chule lhangpia natoh jouse jong atoh dingu ahi.
en: Yet I will make them performers of the duty of the house, for all its service and for all that will be done therein.
text:
EZK 44:14
Thadou: Amaho chun houin phat chomkhat a dinga vaihoma pang diu, vettupma natoh ho a mopona anei diu chule lhangpia natoh jouse jong atoh dingu ahi.
English: Yet I will make them performers of the duty of the house, for all its service and for all that will be done therein.

tcz: Itihen lang hijongleh Zadok insung miten Levi themput dolla Israel insung miten milim doi hou dinga adalhah nung uva houin a kitah tah lim aboljiu ahi. Hiche miho hi lhacha natoh a kakin abol diu ahi. Amaho chu kalanga dinguva chuleh kilhaina thisanna atodoh diu ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: “‘“But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who performed the duty of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, shall come near to me to minister to me. They shall stand before me to offer to me the fat and the blood,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 44:15
Thadou: Itihen lang hijongleh Zadok insung miten Levi themput dolla Israel insung miten milim doi hou dinga adalhah nung uva houin a kitah tah lim aboljiu ahi. Hiche miho hi lhacha natoh a kakin abol diu ahi. Amaho chu kalanga dinguva chuleh kilhaina thisanna atodoh diu ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: “‘“But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who performed the duty of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, shall come near to me to minister to me. They shall stand before me to offer to me the fat and the blood,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Amaho bou chu kamun theng phunga hunglut uva chuleh ka thempu kin bol dinga ka dokhang ahin nailut dingu ahi. Amahon kangaichat jouse eisuh bulhit peh diu ahi.
en: “They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister to me, and they shall keep my instruction.
text:
EZK 44:16
Thadou: Amaho bou chu kamun theng phunga hunglut uva chuleh ka thempu kin bol dinga ka dokhang ahin nailut dingu ahi. Amahon kangaichat jouse eisuh bulhit peh diu ahi.
English: “They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister to me, and they shall keep my instruction.

tcz: Amaho thutanna insung kotpi ahung lut teng uleh amahon tupat ponnem bou akivon diu ahi. Amahon thutanna insunga na atoh tengu leh samul pon akisil theilou diu, ahilouleh houin sunga atoh teng uleh
en: “‘“It will be that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments. No wool shall come on them while they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.
text:
EZK 44:17
Thadou: Amaho thutanna insung kotpi ahung lut teng uleh amahon tupat ponnem bou akivon diu ahi. Amahon thutanna insunga na atoh tengu leh samul pon akisil theilou diu, ahilouleh houin sunga atoh teng uleh
English: “‘“It will be that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments. No wool shall come on them while they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

tcz: Amahon tupat ponnem aluva delkop akikop diu chuleh tupat ponnem von sungnung a akivon diu ahi. Amahon tiul kaina thei imacha akivon lou diu ahi.
en: They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and shall have linen trousers on their waists. They shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat.
text:
EZK 44:18
Thadou: Amahon tupat ponnem aluva delkop akikop diu chuleh tupat ponnem von sungnung a akivon diu ahi. Amahon tiul kaina thei imacha akivon lou diu ahi.
English: They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and shall have linen trousers on their waists. They shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat.

tcz: Amaho thutanna in polanga akile doh uva mipi kititna mun alhun teng uleh akinbol nauva akivon hou chu akisut lhah diu ahi. Amahon avon hou chu indan theng sungnunga akikoi diu chule hiche vonna konna midang ho thenna apohlut khumuva akichat sahna lou diuva von dang akivon diu ahi.
en: When they go out into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments in which they minister and lay them in the holy rooms. They shall put on other garments, that they not sanctify the people with their garments.
text:
EZK 44:19
Thadou: Amaho thutanna in polanga akile doh uva mipi kititna mun alhun teng uleh akinbol nauva akivon hou chu akisut lhah diu ahi. Amahon avon hou chu indan theng sungnunga akikoi diu chule hiche vonna konna midang ho thenna apohlut khumuva akichat sahna lou diuva von dang akivon diu ahi.
English: When they go out into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments in which they minister and lay them in the holy rooms. They shall put on other garments, that they not sanctify the people with their garments.

tcz: Amahon alujang sam akivo tol lou diu, chujongleh ahoi sau behseh lou diu hiche ho khella chu akisuh jol jing diu ahi.
en: “‘“They shall not shave their heads, or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads.
text:
EZK 44:20
Thadou: Amahon alujang sam akivo tol lou diu, chujongleh ahoi sau behseh lou diu hiche ho khella chu akisuh jol jing diu ahi.
English: “‘“They shall not shave their heads, or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads.

tcz: Thutanna sungnung alut masang uva athempu hon ju adon theilou diu ahi.
en: None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court.
text:
EZK 44:21
Thadou: Thutanna sungnung alut masang uva athempu hon ju adon theilou diu ahi.
English: None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court.

tcz: Amahon aji diu chu Israel sunga nungah thengho bou akilhen diu, ahilouleh thempu ji hisa meithai ho akilhen diu ahi. Amahon meithai dang leh akidasa numei akilhen theilou diu ahi.
en: They shall not take for their wives a widow, or her who is put away; but they shall take virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.
text:
EZK 44:22
Thadou: Amahon aji diu chu Israel sunga nungah thengho bou akilhen diu, ahilouleh thempu ji hisa meithai ho akilhen diu ahi. Amahon meithai dang leh akidasa numei akilhen theilou diu ahi.
