English: They shall not take for their wives a widow, or her who is put away; but they shall take virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.

tcz: Amahon kamite thiltheng leh athenglou chuleh hou chondan na atheng leh athenglou ipi ham ti ahil diu ahi.
en: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
text:
EZK 44:23
Thadou: Amahon kamite thiltheng leh athenglou chuleh hou chondan na atheng leh athenglou ipi ham ti ahil diu ahi.
English: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

tcz: Amahon kamite lah a lunggel kitolouna aum tengleh asuhchamna dinga thutanna pang diu ahi. Athutan lhah nau chu ka chondan ho toh kitoh a atan diu ahi. Chuleh thempu ho amaho tah in kahilna ho leh kathupeh hohi kut theng hochu kut abol chanuva kut abol diu, chule ka cholngah nikho ho jouse jong athenga anit jing dingu ahi.
en: “‘“In a controversy they shall stand to judge. They shall judge it according to my ordinances. They shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my appointed feasts. They shall make my Sabbaths holy.
text:
EZK 44:24
Thadou: Amahon kamite lah a lunggel kitolouna aum tengleh asuhchamna dinga thutanna pang diu ahi. Athutan lhah nau chu ka chondan ho toh kitoh a atan diu ahi. Chuleh thempu ho amaho tah in kahilna ho leh kathupeh hohi kut theng hochu kut abol chanuva kut abol diu, chule ka cholngah nikho ho jouse jong athenga anit jing dingu ahi.
English: “‘“In a controversy they shall stand to judge. They shall judge it according to my ordinances. They shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my appointed feasts. They shall make my Sabbaths holy.

tcz: Thempu khat chu ama leh ama thilong phunga chea kisuboh lou ding ahi. Amavang ijemtia athi chu apa ham, anu ham, acha ham, asopipa ham, ahilouleh jinei loulai asopinu ham ahileh vang hitobang ho chunga vang chu phal ahi.
en: “‘“They shall go in to no dead person to defile themselves; but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister who has had no husband, they may defile themselves.
text:
EZK 44:25
Thadou: Thempu khat chu ama leh ama thilong phunga chea kisuboh lou ding ahi. Amavang ijemtia athi chu apa ham, anu ham, acha ham, asopipa ham, ahilouleh jinei loulai asopinu ham ahileh vang hitobang ho chunga vang chu phal ahi.
English: “‘“They shall go in to no dead person to defile themselves; but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister who has had no husband, they may defile themselves.

tcz: Hiche jeng jong chu hou chondan ho a akisuh theng jou chule ni sagi anga a chujou teng leh houin kin bol dinga kile thei ding ahi.
en: After he is cleansed, they shall reckon to him seven days.
text:
EZK 44:26
Thadou: Hiche jeng jong chu hou chondan ho a akisuh theng jou chule ni sagi anga a chujou teng leh houin kin bol dinga kile thei ding ahi.
English: After he is cleansed, they shall reckon to him seven days.

tcz: Nikho masa pen nia thutanana insung nung leh muntheng phunga alutna chuleh naotng ding ahung kile tengleh ama a ding monga chonset thilto anei ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: In the day that he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 44:27
Thadou: Nikho masa pen nia thutanana insung nung leh muntheng phunga alutna chuleh naotng ding ahung kile tengleh ama a ding monga chonset thilto anei ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: In the day that he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Thempu khat chun gou akhol lou diu ahilouleh gamtum anei lou diu ahi. Ijeh inem itile keima changseh hi amaho dinga gotchom beh bou chu kahi.
en: “‘They shall have an inheritance: I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no possession in Israel. I am their possession.
text:
EZK 44:28
Thadou: Thempu khat chun gou akhol lou diu ahilouleh gamtum anei lou diu ahi. Ijeh inem itile keima changseh hi amaho dinga gotchom beh bou chu kahi.
English: “‘They shall have an inheritance: I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no possession in Israel. I am their possession.

tcz: Amaho anneh ding chu mipi hon houin athilpeh hou leh kilhaina ahinpoh hou jouse chang thilto chonset thilto chuleh themmo thilto ho jouse a konna hung diu ahi. Ipi hijongleh mikhat in Pakaija ding asekhen tapou thempu ho chan ding ahi.
en: They shall eat the meal offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs.
text:
EZK 44:29
Thadou: Amaho anneh ding chu mipi hon houin athilpeh hou leh kilhaina ahinpoh hou jouse chang thilto chonset thilto chuleh themmo thilto ho jouse a konna hung diu ahi. Ipi hijongleh mikhat in Pakaija ding asekhen tapou thempu ho chan ding ahi.
English: They shall eat the meal offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs.

tcz: Thingga min masa jouse chule Pakaija dinga thilpeh hung kipolut jouse chu thempu ho koma cheding ahi. Tohga masa pen ho chule na changbong masa pen ho jong chu thempu ho kipe ding ahi. Chutileh na in chu phatthei kiboh ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: The first of all the first fruits of every thing, and every offering of everything, of all your offerings, shall be for the priest. You shall also give to the priests the first of your dough, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.
text:
EZK 44:30
Thadou: Thingga min masa jouse chule Pakaija dinga thilpeh hung kipolut jouse chu thempu ho koma cheding ahi. Tohga masa pen ho chule na changbong masa pen ho jong chu thempu ho kipe ding ahi. Chutileh na in chu phatthei kiboh ding ahi tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: The first of all the first fruits of every thing, and every offering of everything, of all your offerings, shall be for the priest. You shall also give to the priests the first of your dough, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.

tcz: Thempuhon vacha sa ahilouleh gancha moh thi a thi, ahilouleh ganhing dangin adella atha ho chu aneh theilou diu ahi.
en: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself or is torn, whether it is bird or animal.
text:
EZK 44:31
Thadou: Thempuhon vacha sa ahilouleh gancha moh thi a thi, ahilouleh ganhing dangin adella atha ho chu aneh theilou diu ahi.
English: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself or is torn, whether it is bird or animal.

tcz: Nangman gam chu Israel phung mite lah a nahoppeh teng leh gambeh khat chu Pakaija dinga gamtheng khat dinga na khendoh ding ahi. Hiche gam beh a chu mile get leh akeh saoding chule availam chu mile gup leh hop thum'a hopni hiding ahi. Hiche gam hop sungse se chu athenga umding ahi.
en: “‘“Moreover, when you divide by lot the land for inheritance, you shall offer an offering to the LORD, a holy portion of the land. The length shall be the length of twenty-five thousand reeds, and the width shall be ten thousand. It shall be holy in all its border all around.
text:
EZK 45:1
Thadou: Nangman gam chu Israel phung mite lah a nahoppeh teng leh gambeh khat chu Pakaija dinga gamtheng khat dinga na khendoh ding ahi. Hiche gam beh a chu mile get leh akeh saoding chule availam chu mile gup leh hop thum'a hopni hiding ahi. Hiche gam hop sungse se chu athenga umding ahi.
English: “‘“Moreover, when you divide by lot the land for inheritance, you shall offer an offering to the LORD, a holy portion of the land. The length shall be the length of twenty-five thousand reeds, and the width shall be ten thousand. It shall be holy in all its border all around.

tcz: Hiche gambeh khat chu feet jaget le som sagi le nga leh feet jaget le som sagi le nga, hopsung chu houin dinga nakhen doh ding ahi. Akimvel feet jaget le som sagi le ngaa len chu alhung keija gam onga koi ding ahi.
en: Of this there shall be a five hundred by five hundred square for the holy place, and fifty cubits for its pasture lands all around.
text:
EZK 45:2
Thadou: Hiche gambeh khat chu feet jaget le som sagi le nga leh feet jaget le som sagi le nga, hopsung chu houin dinga nakhen doh ding ahi. Akimvel feet jaget le som sagi le ngaa len chu alhung keija gam onga koi ding ahi.
English: Of this there shall be a five hundred by five hundred square for the holy place, and fifty cubits for its pasture lands all around.

tcz: Nangman gamtheng kihoi laiya konna chu gambeh khat mile get leh hopthuma hopkhat sau chule availam mile thum leh hopthuma hopkhat nate doh ding ahi. Hiche gambeh theng sunga chu Muntheng Chungnung chu umding ahi.
en: Of this measure you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand, and a width of ten thousand. In it shall be the sanctuary, which is most holy.
text:
EZK 45:3

English: Of this measure you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand, and a width of ten thousand. In it shall be the sanctuary, which is most holy.

tcz: Hiche gambeh chu athenga umding, muntheng phunga lutna Pakai kin bol ding thempuho ding a kisep khen ding ahi. Amahon chenna inmunna aneijuva chule Houin chu hiche sunga chu umding ahi.
en: It is a holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to minister to the LORD. It shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.
text:
EZK 45:4
Thadou: Hiche gambeh chu athenga umding, muntheng phunga lutna Pakai kin bol ding thempuho ding a kisep khen ding ahi. Amahon chenna inmunna aneijuva chule Houin chu hiche sunga chu umding ahi.
English: It is a holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to minister to the LORD. It shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.

tcz: Pathenna dinga kikatdohsa banna gambeh jom jitjet khat um ding chu asau lang mile get leh hop thum'a hopkhat chule availam mile thum leh hopthuma hopkhat chu houin natonga pang Levite dinga chenna mun hiding, agou lou diu leh akhopiu hiding ahi.
en: Twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites, the ministers of the house, as a possession for themselves, for twenty rooms.
text:
EZK 45:5
Thadou: Pathenna dinga kikatdohsa banna gambeh jom jitjet khat um ding chu asau lang mile get leh hop thum'a hopkhat chule availam mile thum leh hopthuma hopkhat chu houin natonga pang Levite dinga chenna mun hiding, agou lou diu leh akhopiu hiding ahi.

en: “‘“You shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand long, side by side with the offering of the holy portion. It shall be for the whole house of Israel.
text:
EZK 45:6

tcz: Leng chapate ding gambeh ni nasekhen peh diu ahi. Gambeh khat gamgi chu atheng dinga kikatdohsa solam lang gamgi toh kimatna chule khopi leh gambeh anina chu lhumlam lang gamgi toh kimat ding ahi. Hitia chu solam gamkai gamlatah leh lhumlam gamkaija Leng chapate gamgi a chu kigol toupeh a solam gamkai le lhumlam gamkaija thinglhang miho gamgi toh kijopmat ding ahi.
en: “‘“What is for the prince shall be on the one side and on the other side of the holy allotment and of the possession of the city, in front of the holy allotment and in front of the possession of the city, on the west side westward, and on the east side eastward, and in length corresponding to one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.
text:
EZK 45:7
Thadou: Leng chapate ding gambeh ni nasekhen peh diu ahi. Gambeh khat gamgi chu atheng dinga kikatdohsa solam lang gamgi toh kimatna chule khopi leh gambeh anina chu lhumlam lang gamgi toh kimat ding ahi. English: “‘“What is for the prince shall be on the one side and on the other side of the holy allotment and of the possession of the city, in front of the holy allotment and in front of the possession of the city, on the west side westward, and on the east side eastward, and in length corresponding to one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.

tcz: Hiche gambeh hohi leng chapate chanvou hija, hitia chu leng chapaten koima a engse sea aboltah lou diu chule kamite achom tah lou diu ahi. Amahon agambeh aval chengse chu aphung phunga chenmuna apeh cheh diu ahi.
en: In the land it shall be to him for a possession in Israel. My princes shall no more oppress my people, but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.”
text:
EZK 45:8
Thadou: Hiche gambeh hohi leng chapate chanvou hija, hitia chu leng chapaten koima a engse sea aboltah lou diu chule kamite achom tah lou diu ahi. Amahon agambeh aval chengse chu aphung phunga chenmuna apeh cheh diu ahi.
English: In the land it shall be to him for a possession in Israel. My princes shall no more oppress my people, but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.”

tcz: Ijeh inem itile hiche hi Pakai thusei ahi. Israel leng chapate phakhop set tante, pumhatna thil kibol leh bolgenthei ho chu nga tauvin, thil akitoh chet leh adih chu ipi ham bollun. Kamite agamsunga kona nachomgam naleh najou lhep nau dalha tauvin. Achennau in na kona nadelmang u chu nga tauvin tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Enough you, princes of Israel! Remove violence and plunder, and execute justice and righteousness! Stop dispossessing my people!” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 45:9
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile hiche hi Pakai thusei ahi. Israel leng chapate phakhop set tante, pumhatna thil kibol leh bolgenthei ho chu nga tauvin, thil akitoh chet leh adih chu ipi ham bollun. Kamite agamsunga kona nachomgam naleh najou lhep nau dalha tauvin. Achennau in na kona nadelmang u chu nga tauvin tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Enough you, princes of Israel! Remove violence and plunder, and execute justice and righteousness! Stop dispossessing my people!” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Thilgih tena chu adih chacha naman uva chule achom sau adih a naleuva chuleh alet aneu tenna adih, ago hinhen atwi hijong leh naman diu ahi.
en: “You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.
text:
EZK 45:10
Thadou: Thilgih tena chu adih chacha naman uva chule achom sau adih a naleuva chuleh alet aneu tenna adih, ago hinhen atwi hijong leh naman diu ahi.
English: “You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.

tcz: Homer hi alhangpi a thil atam alhom tena a naman diu ahi. Ephah leh Bath hi homer hopsoma hopkhat toh kibang hiding ahi.
en: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer, and the ephah one tenth of a homer. Its measure shall be the same as the homer.
text:
EZK 45:11
Thadou: Homer hi alhangpi a thil atam alhom tena a naman diu ahi. Ephah leh Bath hi homer hopsoma hopkhat toh kibang hiding ahi.
English: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer, and the ephah one tenth of a homer. Its measure shall be the same as the homer.

tcz: Alhangpia agih hi Shekel a kite ding ahin, shekel khat chun gera somni adol ding chule shekel somgup chu mina khat toh kibang ding ahi.
en: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels shall be your mina.
text:
EZK 45:12
Thadou: Alhangpia agih hi Shekel a kite ding ahin, shekel khat chun gera somni adol ding chule shekel somgup chu mina khat toh kibang ding ahi.
English: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels shall be your mina.

tcz: Nanghon leng chapa chu agam mandinga suhlou chang ahilouleh sakolcang atena somgup lah atena khat chu nalhosoh uva konna napeh diu ahi.
en: “‘“This is the offering that you shall offer: the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of barley,
text:
EZK 45:13
Thadou: Nanghon leng chapa chu agam mandinga suhlou chang ahilouleh sakolcang atena somgup lah atena khat chu nalhosoh uva konna napeh diu ahi.
English: “‘“This is the offering that you shall offer: the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of barley,

tcz: Israel sunga kelngoi ahilouleh kelcha jani chenga kiloi ho lah a konna chu khat khatna lahdoh ding ahi. Hiche ho chu chang thilto, govam thilto, chule chamna thilto a kitoh dingho chu ahin, hichun ahin toh ho dinga lhatdohna sempeh ding ahi, tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
en: and one lamb of the flock out of two hundred, from the well-watered pastures of Israel—for a meal offering, for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 45:15
Thadou: Israel sunga kelngoi ahilouleh kelcha jani chenga kiloi ho lah a konna chu khat khatna lahdoh ding ahi. Hiche ho chu chang thilto, govam thilto, chule chamna thilto a kitoh dingho chu ahin, hichun ahin toh ho dinga lhatdohna sempeh ding ahi, tin thaneitah Pakaiyin aseije.
English: and one lamb of the flock out of two hundred, from the well-watered pastures of Israel—for a meal offering, for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Israel mipte jousen hiche thilto hi leng chapa apeh diu ahi.
en: “All the people of the land shall give to this offering for the prince in Israel.
text:
EZK 45:16
Thadou: Israel mipte jousen hiche thilto hi leng chapa apeh diu ahi.
English: “All the people of the land shall give to this offering for the prince in Israel.

tcz: Leng chapa chun houlang golnop; lhathah vahchoina, cholngah nikho chule hitobang adang dang phattah hileh amite ding agon peh ding chu ngaijah ahi. Aman chonset thilto, govam thilto, chang thilto, donthei thilto chule chamna thilto Israel mipite suhtheng nading Pakaija dinga adih asem doh nadinga ahi.
en: It shall be the prince’s part to give the burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the drink offerings, in the feasts, and on the new moons, and on the Sabbaths, in all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He shall prepare the sin offering, the meal offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.”
text:
EZK 45:17
Thadou: Leng chapa chun houlang golnop; lhathah vahchoina, cholngah nikho chule hitobang adang dang phattah hileh amite ding agon peh ding chu ngaijah ahi. Aman chonset thilto, govam thilto, chang thilto, donthei thilto chule chamna thilto Israel mipite suhtheng nading Pakaija dinga adih asem doh nadinga ahi.
English: It shall be the prince’s part to give the burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the drink offerings, in the feasts, and on the new moons, and on the Sabbaths, in all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He shall prepare the sin offering, the meal offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.”

tcz: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Chamkang kipat til kumthah nimasani houin suhtheng nadinga bongchal gol nolnabei khatna katdoh ding ahi.
en: “‘The Lord GOD says: “In the first month, on the first day of the month, you shall take a young bull without defect, and you shall cleanse the sanctuary.
text:
EZK 45:18
Thadou: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Chamkang kipat til kumthah nimasani houin suhtheng nadinga bongchal gol nolnabei khatna katdoh ding ahi.
English: “‘The Lord GOD says: “In the first month, on the first day of the month, you shall take a young bull without defect, and you shall cleanse the sanctuary.

tcz: Thempu pa chun chonset thilto a konna chu athisan alahdoh a chule houin kotbenga maicham achung ajumlai aninglia chule thutanna sungnung lutna kelkot khom ho a chu aloinat ding ahi.
en: The priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the door posts of the house, and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the posts of the gate of the inner court.
text:
EZK 45:19
Thadou: Thempu pa chun chonset thilto a konna chu athisan alahdoh a chule houin kotbenga maicham achung ajumlai aninglia chule thutanna sungnung lutna kelkot khom ho a chu aloinat ding ahi.
English: The priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the door posts of the house, and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the posts of the gate of the inner court.

tcz: Hichehi kumthah nisagi lhinni jong leh nabol koitobang ham khat hatchet jeh a ham ahilouleh bolkhel jeh hama chonset bolho dinga lhatdohna nabol peh ding ahi. Hitia houin chu nasuh theng diu ahi.
en: So you shall do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who errs, and for him who is simple. So you shall make atonement for the house.
text:
EZK 45:20
Thadou: Hichehi kumthah nisagi lhinni jong leh nabol koitobang ham khat hatchet jeh a ham ahilouleh bolkhel jeh hama chonset bolho dinga lhatdohna nabol peh ding ahi. Hitia houin chu nasuh theng diu ahi.
English: So you shall do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who errs, and for him who is simple. So you shall make atonement for the house.

tcz: Lhamasapen nisom leh nili lhinni leh nangin Kalchuh Kut nabol ding ahi. Hiche golvah nisagi sunga nabol ding ahi. Hiche phat sunga changlhah naneh ding chu cholsolou hiding ahi.
en: “‘“In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
text:
EZK 45:21
Thadou: Lhamasapen nisom leh nili lhinni leh nangin Kalchuh Kut nabol ding ahi. Hiche golvah nisagi sunga nabol ding ahi. Hiche phat sunga changlhah naneh ding chu cholsolou hiding ahi.
English: “‘“In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

tcz: Kalchuh Kut nikho tengleh leng chapan ama a ding leh Israel mite a dinga chonset thilto bongchal gol khat agon ding ahi.
en: On that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering.
text:
EZK 45:22
Thadou: Kalchuh Kut nikho tengleh leng chapan ama a ding leh Israel mite a dinga chonset thilto bongchal gol khat agon ding ahi.
English: On that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering.

tcz: Hiche nisagi Kut sunga chu niseh a Pakaija dinga govam thilto ding bongchal gol sagi leh kelngoi chal sagi nolna beihel cheh gotsa akoi ding ahi. Niseh leh Kelchal khat cheh chonset thilto dinga atotha ding ahi.
en: The seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bulls and seven rams without defect daily the seven days; and a male goat daily for a sin offering.
text:
EZK 45:23
Thadou: Hiche nisagi Kut sunga chu niseh a Pakaija dinga govam thilto ding bongchal gol sagi leh kelngoi chal sagi nolna beihel cheh gotsa akoi ding ahi. Niseh leh Kelchal khat cheh chonset thilto dinga atotha ding ahi.
English: The seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bulls and seven rams without defect daily the seven days; and a male goat daily for a sin offering.

tcz: Leng chapan changbong pocha khat chang thilto dinga chule Olive thao gallon khat bongchal gol khat leh kelngoi chalk hat cheh to hitha ding ahi.
en: He shall prepare a meal offering, an ephah for a bull, an ephah for a ram, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
text:
EZK 45:24
Thadou: Leng chapan changbong pocha khat chang thilto dinga chule Olive thao gallon khat bongchal gol khat leh kelngoi chalk hat cheh to hitha ding ahi.
English: He shall prepare a meal offering, an ephah for a bull, an ephah for a ram, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

tcz: Chavang laileh hung lhungji Hoidohna Kut nisagi sunga hi hiche thilto ho – chonset thilto, govam thilto, chule chang thilto chule Olive thao angaichat dungjuija leng chapan gotsa akoi jing ding ahi.
en: “‘“In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, during the feast, he shall do like that for seven days. He shall make the same provision for sin offering, the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the oil.”
text:
EZK 45:25
Thadou: Chavang laileh hung lhungji Hoidohna Kut nisagi sunga hi hiche thilto ho – chonset thilto, govam thilto, chule chang thilto chule Olive thao angaichat dungjuija leng chapan gotsa akoi jing ding ahi.
English: “‘“In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, during the feast, he shall do like that for seven days. He shall make the same provision for sin offering, the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the oil.”

tcz: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Thutanna sungnung solam kelkot hapta seh a natoh nikho nigup sunga kikhah jing ding chule Sabbath nikho chuleh Lhathah nikho Kut kibol tengleh bou kihong ding ahi.
en: “‘The Lord GOD says: “The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
text:
EZK 46:1
Thadou: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Thutanna sungnung solam kelkot hapta seh a natoh nikho nigup sunga kikhah jing ding chule Sabbath nikho chuleh Lhathah nikho Kut kibol tengleh bou kihong ding ahi.
English: “‘The Lord GOD says: “The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

tcz: Leng chapa chu apolanga konna hongcha lutna kelkot na konna lut ding ahi. Hitia chu thempu ama ding govam thilto leh chamna thilto atolai sungseuva chu kelkot khom phunga chu ding den ding ahi. Ama chu Pathen houding kelkot kenglampi sunga chu kumlha ding chule ahung lutna lang mama a chu pot doh kit ding ahi. Hiche kelkot chu nilhah kahsea kikhah lou ding ahi.
en: The prince shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate outside, and shall stand by the post of the gate; and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate. Then he shall go out, but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
text:
EZK 46:2
Thadou: Leng chapa chu apolanga konna hongcha lutna kelkot na konna lut ding ahi. Hitia chu thempu ama ding govam thilto leh chamna thilto atolai sungseuva chu kelkot khom phunga chu ding den ding ahi. Ama chu Pathen houding kelkot kenglampi sunga chu kumlha ding chule ahung lutna lang mama a chu pot doh kit ding ahi. Hiche kelkot chu nilhah kahsea kikhah lou ding ahi.
English: The prince shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate outside, and shall stand by the post of the gate; and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate. Then he shall go out, but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

tcz: Sabbath nikho teng kelkot phung maija chu mipi ho chu Pakai hou dinga kun cheh diu, chule lhathah niho nikho teng jong leh abol diu ahi.
en: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before the LORD on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.
text:
EZK 46:3
Thadou: Sabbath nikho teng kelkot phung maija chu mipi ho chu Pakai hou dinga kun cheh diu, chule lhathah niho nikho teng jong leh abol diu ahi.
English: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before the LORD on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.

tcz: Sabbath nikho seh leh leng chapan Pakaija govam thilto dinga kelngoi gup leh kelngoi chalkhat ma nolna beihel khat ato dingu ahi.
en: The burnt offering that the prince shall offer to the LORD shall be on the Sabbath day, six lambs without defect and a ram without defect;

tcz: Kelngoi chal toh totha ding deilhen changbong chang thilto ding chule kelngoi to totha changbong atojou jat jat ato ding chule changbong pocha khatna dinga Olive thao gallon khat atotha ding ahi.
en: and the meal offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and the meal offering for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
text:
EZK 46:5
Thadou: Kelngoi chal toh totha ding deilhen changbong chang thilto ding chule kelngoi to totha changbong atojou jat jat ato ding chule changbong pocha khatna dinga Olive thao gallon khat atotha ding ahi.
English: and the meal offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and the meal offering for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

tcz: Lhahthah nikho Kut kibol niteng leh bongchal gol khat, kelngoi gup chule kelngoi chalkhat nolna beihel cheh ato tha ding ahi.
en: On the day of the new moon it shall be a young bull without defect, six lambs, and a ram. They shall be without defect.
text:
EZK 46:6
Thadou: Lhahthah nikho Kut kibol niteng leh bongchal gol khat, kelngoi gup chule kelngoi chalkhat nolna beihel cheh ato tha ding ahi.
English: On the day of the new moon it shall be a young bull without defect, six lambs, and a ram. They shall be without defect.

tcz: Bongchal gol toh totha dinga chu deilhen changbong pocha khat chang thilto dinga ato tha ding ahi. Kelngoi chal ding chang bong pocha khat ahin choi tha ding ahi. Chule kelngoi khat cheh a ding chu ijat hijongle aman atojou kham khama apeh ding ahi. Changbong pocha khat ding a chu Olive thao gallon khat ato ding ahi.
en: He shall prepare a meal offering: an ephah for the bull, and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs according as he is able, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
text:
EZK 46:7
Thadou: Bongchal gol toh totha dinga chu deilhen changbong pocha khat chang thilto dinga ato tha ding ahi. Kelngoi chal ding chang bong pocha khat ahin choi tha ding ahi. Chule kelngoi khat cheh a ding chu ijat hijongle aman atojou kham khama apeh ding ahi. Changbong pocha khat ding a chu Olive thao gallon khat ato ding ahi.
English: He shall prepare a meal offering: an ephah for the bull, and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs according as he is able, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

tcz: Leng chapa chu hongcha a konna kelkotna lut ding ahi. Chule hiche lampi mama a chu adalhah kit ding ahi.
en: When the prince enters, he shall go in by the way of the porch of the gate, and he shall go out by its way.
text:
EZK 46:8
Thadou: Leng chapa chu hongcha a konna kelkotna lut ding ahi. Chule hiche lampi mama a chu adalhah kit ding ahi.
English: When the prince enters, he shall go in by the way of the porch of the gate, and he shall go out by its way.

tcz: Lhentum Kut ho abolluva mipi Pakai hou dinga lhumlam kelkotna ahung lut teng uleh amahon lhanglang kelkotna adalhah diu ahi. Chule koi hileh lhanglang kelkotna hung lut ho chu sahlang kelkot a adalhah diu ahi. Amaho chun ahunglutna lang uva chu adalhah theilou diu ahi. Ahinlah alangkhat kelkot bou chu amandiu ahi.
en: “‘“But when the people of the land come before the LORD in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he who enters by the way of the south gate shall go out by the way of the north gate. He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall go out straight before him.
text:
EZK 46:9
Thadou: Lhentum Kut ho abolluva mipi Pakai hou dinga lhumlam kelkotna ahung lut teng uleh amahon lhanglang kelkotna adalhah diu ahi. Chule koi hileh lhanglang kelkotna hung lut ho chu sahlang kelkot a adalhah diu ahi. Amaho chun ahunglutna lang uva chu adalhah theilou diu ahi. Ahinlah alangkhat kelkot bou chu amandiu ahi.
English: “‘“But when the people of the land come before the LORD in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he who enters by the way of the south gate shall go out by the way of the north gate. He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall go out straight before him.

tcz: Leng chapa chu hunglutna chuleh hiche phat sunga hi mipi hotoh potdoh khom theidiu ahi.
en: The prince shall go in with them when they go in. When they go out, he shall go out.
text:
EZK 46:10
Thadou: Leng chapa chu hunglutna chuleh hiche phat sunga hi mipi hotoh potdoh khom theidiu ahi.
English: The prince shall go in with them when they go in. When they go out, he shall go out.

Changbong pocha khatna dinga chu Olive thao gallon khatma hiding ahi.
en: “‘“In the feasts and in the appointed holidays, the meal offering shall be an ephah for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
text:
EZK 46:11
Thadou: Hijeh a chu golvah jat chom beh chuleh katdohsa Kut teng leh chang thilto ding chu changbong pocha khat bongchal golkhat to hitha ding, chule kelngoi chal toh totha ding chang bong pocha khatna hiding chule kelngoi khat dinga chu leng chapan changbong atojou jat jat atojeng ding ahi. Changbong pocha khatna dinga chu Olive thao gallon khatma hiding ahi.
English: “‘“In the feasts and in the appointed holidays, the meal offering shall be an ephah for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

tcz: Lengchapa chun achamcham'a govam thilto ahilouleh chamna thilto Pakaija dinga ato tengleh ama dinga solam kelkot thutanna sungnung lutna chu kihon peh ding ahi. Hitia chu adalhah'a chule hiche kelkot chu amanung leh kikhah ding ahi.
en: When the prince prepares a free will offering, a burnt offering or peace offerings as a free will offering to the LORD, one shall open for him the gate that looks toward the east; and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out; and after his going out one shall shut the gate.
text:
EZK 46:12
Thadou: Lengchapa chun achamcham'a govam thilto ahilouleh chamna thilto Pakaija dinga ato tengleh ama dinga solam kelkot thutanna sungnung lutna chu kihon peh ding ahi. Hitia chu adalhah'a chule hiche kelkot chu amanung leh kikhah ding ahi.
English: When the prince prepares a free will offering, a burnt offering or peace offerings as a free will offering to the LORD, one shall open for him the gate that looks toward the east; and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out; and after his going out one shall shut the gate.

tcz: Jingkah she leh Pakaija dinga pumgo thilto dinga nolna bei kumkhat lhing kelngoija kilhaina abol ding ahi.
en: “‘“You shall prepare a lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering to the LORD daily. Morning by morning you shall prepare it.
text:
EZK 46:13
Thadou: Jingkah she leh Pakaija dinga pumgo thilto dinga nolna bei kumkhat lhing kelngoija kilhaina abol ding ahi.
English: “‘“You shall prepare a lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering to the LORD daily. Morning by morning you shall prepare it.

tcz: Pakaija thilto ding kelngoi khat chu changbong thilto toh pehtha ding ahin changbong hopthuma hopkhat leh Olive thao gallon khat hopthuma hopkhat changbong toh mehhalsa hiding ahi. Hiche hi a itih a umjing ding dan nang ho dinga kipe ahi.
en: You shall prepare a meal offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour; a meal offering to the LORD continually by a perpetual ordinance.
text:
EZK 46:14
Thadou: Pakaija thilto ding kelngoi khat chu changbong thilto toh pehtha ding ahin changbong hopthuma hopkhat leh Olive thao gallon khat hopthuma hopkhat changbong toh mehhalsa hiding ahi. Hiche hi a itih a umjing ding dan nang ho dinga kipe ahi.
English: You shall prepare a meal offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour; a meal offering to the LORD continually by a perpetual ordinance.

tcz: Kelngoi chang thilto chule Olive thao hohi jingkah she le thon louhella nikho kichaina tokah a kitoh jing jeng ding ahi.
en: Thus they shall prepare the lamb, the meal offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt offering.”
text:
EZK 46:15
Thadou: Kelngoi chang thilto chule Olive thao hohi jingkah she le thon louhella nikho kichaina tokah a kitoh jing jeng ding ahi.
English: Thus they shall prepare the lamb, the meal offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt offering.”

tcz: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Leng chapa chun achapate lah a khat chu gam leiset agoulo dinga apeh khah tah a ahileh ama a hijeng ding ahi. Chule a achilhah tedinga hichu atonsot gouvuva pang ding ahitai.
en: “‘The Lord GOD says: “If the prince gives a gift to any of his sons, it is his inheritance. It shall belong to his sons. It is their possession by inheritance.
text:
EZK 46:16
Thadou: Hiche hi thaneitah Pakai thusei ahi. Leng chapa chun achapate lah a khat chu gam leiset agoulo dinga apeh khah tah a ahileh ama a hijeng ding ahi. Chule a achilhah tedinga hichu atonsot gouvuva pang ding ahitai.
English: “‘The Lord GOD says: “If the prince gives a gift to any of his sons, it is his inheritance. It shall belong to his sons. It is their possession by inheritance.

tcz: Amavang leng chapan ama gouva konna asohte khat chu gamleiset kipa thilpeh a apeh khah tah a ahile sohpa chun Jubilee hung lhun kahsea bou akikoi thei ding ahi. Hichu kum somnga seh a hunglhung ji ahi. Hiche pet teng chuleh gam leiset chu leng chapa koma kile kit ding ahitai. Ahin leng chapa chun kipa thilpeh chu achapa apeh ahileh hichu kipa thilpeh a umden ding ahitai.
en: But if he gives of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince; but as for his inheritance, it shall be for his sons.
text:
EZK 46:17
Thadou: Amavang leng chapan ama gouva konna asohte khat chu gamleiset kipa thilpeh a apeh khah tah a ahile sohpa chun Jubilee hung lhun kahsea bou akikoi thei ding ahi. Hichu kum somnga seh a hunglhung ji ahi. Hiche pet teng chuleh gam leiset chu leng chapa koma kile kit ding ahitai. Ahin leng chapa chun kipa thilpeh chu achapa apeh ahileh hichu kipa thilpeh a umden ding ahitai.
English: But if he gives of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince; but as for his inheritance, it shall be for his sons.

tcz: Amapa chun agou ho chu achapate apeh khah tah a ahileh, hichu ama gam leisetna kon hitei ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile keiman kamite chu dihlou tah a anei agouva konna akino doh ding kadeipoi.
en: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance, to thrust them out of their possession. He shall give inheritance to his sons out of his own possession, that my people not each be scattered from his possession.”’”
text:
EZK 46:18
Thadou: Amapa chun agou ho chu achapate apeh khah tah a ahileh, hichu ama gam leisetna kon hitei ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile keiman kamite chu dihlou tah a anei agouva konna akino doh ding kadeipoi.
English: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance, to thrust them out of their possession. He shall give inheritance to his sons out of his own possession, that my people not each be scattered from his possession.”’”

tcz: Kagao thilmuna a mipa chun lutna kom kelkotna kon chule atheng dinga kikoi indan thempuho umna amai sahlam ngatna chun eipuilutne. Aman indan kingah aning chong kheh lhum lang a um chu eivet sah e.
en: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy rooms for the priests, which looked toward the north. Behold, there was a place on the back part westward.
text:
EZK 46:19
Thadou: Kagao thilmuna a mipa chun lutna kom kelkotna kon chule atheng dinga kikoi indan thempuho umna amai sahlam ngatna chun eipuilutne. Aman indan kingah aning chong kheh lhum lang a um chu eivet sah e.
English: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy rooms for the priests, which looked toward the north. Behold, there was a place on the back part westward.

tcz: Aman hiche laimun hi thempuhon themmo thilto le chonset thilto sahonna amanuva chule chang thilto dinga chang bonga kona changthah kanna anei diu ahi. Hiche hohi thutanna inpolanga kilhaina thilho apohdoh louna dingu chuleh thenna chu mipi ho lah a apohlout uva mipiho akichat sah lou nadiuva kibol ahi tin eihilchene.
en: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the meal offering, that they not bring them out into the outer court, to sanctify the people.”
text:
EZK 46:20
Thadou: Aman hiche laimun hi thempuhon themmo thilto le chonset thilto sahonna amanuva chule chang thilto dinga chang bonga kona changthah kanna anei diu ahi. Hiche hohi thutanna inpolanga kilhaina thilho apohdoh louna dingu chuleh thenna chu mipi ho lah a apohlout uva mipiho akichat sah lou nadiuva kibol ahi tin eihilchene.
English: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the meal offering, that they not bring them out into the outer court, to sanctify the people.”

tcz: Hichun aman thutanna in polama chun eihin lepui kit in chule aning liho khat cheh a chun eipuije. Aning khat cheh a chun ahongsung chu akimun ahi.
en: Then he brought me out into the outer court and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.
text:
EZK 46:21
Thadou: Hichun aman thutanna in polama chun eihin lepui kit in chule aning liho khat cheh a chun eipuije. Aning khat cheh a chun ahongsung chu akimun ahi.
English: Then he brought me out into the outer court and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

tcz: Ahungsung khat cheh chu asao lang feet som sagi chule availam feet somnga leni leh akeh ahin, bangin aum kimvel soh kei ahi.
en: In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits long and thirty wide. These four in the corners were the same size.
text:
EZK 46:22
Thadou: Ahungsung khat cheh chu asao lang feet som sagi chule availam feet somnga leni leh akeh ahin, bangin aum kimvel soh kei ahi.
English: In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits long and thirty wide. These four in the corners were the same size.

tcz: Hiche bang kigen sunga chun song aning jousea kikheng aumin, hiche song kigol togolla chun thuh khuh akisem soh keije.
en: There was a wall around in them, around the four, and boiling places were made under the walls all around.
text:
EZK 46:23
Thadou: Hiche bang kigen sunga chun song aning jousea kikheng aumin, hiche song kigol togolla chun thuh khuh akisem soh keije.
English: There was a wall around in them, around the four, and boiling places were made under the walls all around.

tcz: Mipa chun kahenga hiche hi mipi hon kilhaina thilto atodoh hou chu houin natonga pang hon anhonna in chu ahi tin aseije.
en: Then he said to me, “These are the boiling houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.”
text:
EZK 46:24
Thadou: Mipa chun kahenga hiche hi mipi hon kilhaina thilto atodoh hou chu houin natonga pang hon anhonna in chu ahi tin aseije.
English: Then he said to me, “These are the boiling houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.”

tcz: Keiman kagao thilmuna a mipa chun houin lutna langa chun einung puikit tai. Houin kotpi noija kon in niso lam ngan twi ana longe chule maicham jet lang lhang langa chu longa ahi.
en: He brought me back to the door of the temple; and behold, waters flowed out from under the threshold of the temple eastward, for the front of the temple faced toward the east. The waters came down from underneath, from the right side of the temple, on the south of the altar.
text:
EZK 47:1
Thadou: Keiman kagao thilmuna a mipa chun houin lutna langa chun einung puikit tai. Houin kotpi noija kon in niso lam ngan twi ana longe chule maicham jet lang lhang langa chu longa ahi.
English: He brought me back to the door of the temple; and behold, waters flowed out from under the threshold of the temple eastward, for the front of the temple faced toward the east. The waters came down from underneath, from the right side of the temple, on the south of the altar.

tcz: Mipa chun sahlam kelkotna kon chun bang polanga chun eipui doh in chule solam kelkot chu eivel pin ahi. Hilaija chun twi chu solam kelkot lhang lang sanga ana longin ahi.
en: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.
text:
EZK 47:2
Thadou: Mipa chun sahlam kelkotna kon chun bang polanga chun eipui doh in chule solam kelkot chu eivel pin ahi. Hilaija chun twi chu solam kelkot lhang lang sanga ana longin ahi.
English: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.

tcz: Mipa chun thiltena akichoijin vadung langa chun eipuijin feet 1750 jen atedoh in, chuti chun vadunga chun eipui galkaije. Atwi chu ka ahkhomit chan athuh e.
en: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.
text:
EZK 47:3
Thadou: Mipa chun thiltena akichoijin vadung langa chun eipuijin feet 1750 jen atedoh in, chuti chun vadunga chun eipui galkaije. Atwi chu ka ahkhomit chan athuh e.
English: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.

tcz: Amapan feet 1750 atedoh be kit in chule vadunga chun eipui galkaije. Hiche phatna hin atwi chu kakhup chan aphatai. Chujouvin feet 1750 ma atedoh kit in hichu kong chan ahitai.
en: Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist.
text:
EZK 47:4
Thadou: Amapan feet 1750 atedoh be kit in chule vadunga chun eipui galkaije. Hiche phatna hin atwi chu kakhup chan aphatai. Chujouvin feet 1750 ma atedoh kit in hichu kong chan ahitai.
English: Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist.

tcz: Chuin feet 1750 ma atedoh be kit in ahile twi athuh vallin pal galkai thei ahitapoi. Hichu kijapna thei ahin pal galkai dingin athuh behseh tai.
en: Afterward he measured one thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be walked through.
text:
EZK 47:5
Thadou: Chuin feet 1750 ma atedoh be kit in ahile twi athuh vallin pal galkai thei ahitapoi. Hichu kijapna thei ahin pal galkai dingin athuh behseh tai.
English: Afterward he measured one thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be walked through.

tcz: Hichun aman kajah a mihem chapa, nangman navet jing hinam eti. Hichun aman vadunga chun eilepui kitne.
en: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen this?” Then he brought me and caused me to return to the bank of the river.
text:
EZK 47:6
Thadou: Hichun aman kajah a mihem chapa, nangman navet jing hinam eti. Hichun aman vadunga chun eilepui kitne.
English: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen this?” Then he brought me and caused me to return to the bank of the river.

tcz: Keiman kanung che phat chun vadung apang tenia thing tampi ana ke chu kamun kadatmo lheh e.
en: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
text:
EZK 47:7
Thadou: Keiman kanung che phat chun vadung apang tenia thing tampi ana ke chu kamun kadatmo lheh e.
English: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.

tcz: Hichun amapan kajah a hiche vadung hi nisolam a konna nelgam ajot twithi umna phaicham ajotpa ahi. Hiche vadung twihin Twithi a twi al chu asuh thenga chule atwi chu chim ding ahitai.
en: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.
text:
EZK 47:8
Thadou: Hichun amapan kajah a hiche vadung hi nisolam a konna nelgam ajot twithi umna phaicham ajotpa ahi. Hiche vadung twihin Twithi a twi al chu asuh thenga chule atwi chu chim ding ahitai.
English: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.

tcz: Hiche vadung twi lonna channa chu ganhing ahon hon kijot ho umdiu ahi. Nga jeng jong hiche twithia chu atama tam umdiu ahitai, ijeh inem itile atwi chu kisuthenga ahitan, hichu vadung lonphahna channa chu ganhing hon hinna anei diu ahitai.
en: It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.
text:
EZK 47:9
Thadou: Hiche vadung twi lonna channa chu ganhing ahon hon kijot ho umdiu ahi. Nga jeng jong hiche twithia chu atama tam umdiu ahitai, ijeh inem itile atwi chu kisuthenga ahitan, hichu vadung lonphahna channa chu ganhing hon hinna anei diu ahitai.
English: It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.

tcz: Ngaman miho jong twikhanglen panga hung dinguvin te. Engedi a kipatna En-eglaim chan twipang chu len kiphou dimset ding ahi. Mideterrenean a nga ho atam banga khu twithi a jong nga jatkima hung dimding ahitai.
en: It will happen that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.
text:
EZK 47:10
Thadou: Ngaman miho jong twikhanglen panga hung dinguvin te. Engedi a kipatna En-eglaim chan twipang chu len kiphou dimset ding ahi. Mideterrenean a nga ho atam banga khu twithi a jong nga jatkima hung dimding ahitai.
English: It will happen that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.

tcz: Ahivangin dam kotong ho leh doplah vang kisuchim lou ding amaho chu chial banga al jing diu ahitai.
en: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.
text:
EZK 47:11
Thadou: Ahivangin dam kotong ho leh doplah vang kisuchim lou ding amaho chu chial banga al jing diu ahitai.
English: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.

tcz: Vadung apang lang to gella chu thei jatchom chom hung keh doh ding ahi. Hiche thing hohi ana jong agao leh apullha umlou diu, chule a itih a beitih neilouva abah ho a chu aga umjing ding ahi. Lhaseh in changlhah lhung jingin tin, ijeh inem itile houin a konna hung long doh vadung chun achap nou jing ding ahi.
en: By the river banks, on both sides, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”
text:
EZK 47:12
Thadou: Vadung apang lang to gella chu thei jatchom chom hung keh doh ding ahi. Hiche thing hohi ana jong agao leh apullha umlou diu, chule a itih a beitih neilouva abah ho a chu aga umjing ding ahi. Lhaseh in changlhah lhung jingin tin, ijeh inem itile houin a konna hung long doh vadung chun achap nou jing ding ahi.
English: By the river banks, on both sides, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”

tcz: Hiche hi Pakai thusei ahi. Hiti hin agam chu Israel phungsom leh phungni ho hoppeh tan, Joshep chilhah ho chu agam leiset channi kipediu ahi.
en: The Lord GOD says: “This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.
text:
EZK 47:13
Thadou: Hiche hi Pakai thusei ahi. Hiti hin agam chu Israel phungsom leh phungni ho hoppeh tan, Joshep chilhah ho chu agam leiset channi kipediu ahi.
English: The Lord GOD says: “This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.

tcz: Adangho chengse vang chu kibanga chang cheh diu ahin, keiman kitah tah a kaki hahsella chule kitepna kaneija napu napa teu chu hiche gam hi kapeh ding kana tia kana sei chu tua hi nnangho gouloa a hung panga ahitai.
en: You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers. This land will fall to you for inheritance.
text:
EZK 47:14
Thadou: Adangho chengse vang chu kibanga chang cheh diu ahin, keiman kitah tah a kaki hahsella chule kitepna kaneija napu napa teu chu hiche gam hi kapeh ding kana tia kana sei chu tua hi nnangho gouloa a hung panga ahitai.
English: You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers. This land will fall to you for inheritance.

tcz: Hiche hohi agam leiset gamgia pang diu ahi. Sahlang gamgi ding chu Mideterrenean napat Hethlon ahin jot ding Lebo Hamath ajot paija Zedah ajot ding
en: “This shall be the border of the land: “On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, to the entrance of Zedad;

tcz: Chutia chu Berothah chule Siberea teni hi Damascus leh Hamath kikah a agamgi laiya umding, chule Hauran gamgi a um Hazar-hatticon geija kilhung lutpeh ding ahi.
en: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath), to Hazer Hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.
text:
EZK 47:16
Thadou: Chutia chu Berothah chule Siberea teni hi Damascus leh Hamath kikah a agamgi laiya umding, chule Hauran gamgi a um Hazar-hatticon geija kilhung lutpeh ding ahi.
English: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath), to Hazer Hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.

tcz: Sahlang gamgi chu Mediterranean twikhanglen napat Hazar-enan geija hung kilhung lut ding, sahlang Hamath leh lhanglanga Damascus teni kikah chu gamgi hiding ahi.
en: The border from the sea shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.
text:
EZK 47:17
Thadou: Sahlang gamgi chu Mediterranean twikhanglen napat Hazar-enan geija hung kilhung lut ding, sahlang Hamath leh lhanglanga Damascus teni kikah chu gamgi hiding ahi.
English: The border from the sea shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.

tcz: Solam gamgi chu Hauran leh Damuscus kikah a kipanna, Israel leh Gilead kikah Jordan vadung pang lhanglanga lhaisuh peh a Twithi ajotpa a Tamar geija kilhung lut peh ding ahi. Hiche hi Solam gamgi chu hiding ahi.
en: “The east side, between Hauran, Damascus, Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side.
text:
EZK 47:18
Thadou: Solam gamgi chu Hauran leh Damuscus kikah a kipanna, Israel leh Gilead kikah Jordan vadung pang lhanglanga lhaisuh peh a Twithi ajotpa a Tamar geija kilhung lut peh ding ahi. Hiche hi Solam gamgi chu hiding ahi.
English: “The east side, between Hauran, Damascus, Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side.

tcz: Lhanglang sang gamgi chun lhumlam lang ajotna Tamar a kipatna Kadesh a um Meribah twidung chan hiding ahi. Chule hiche a konna hi Egypt vadung ajui peh a Mediterranean twikhanglen chan geija leng lhading ahi. Hiche hi lhanglang gamgi hiding ahi.
en: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea. This is the south side southward.
text:
EZK 47:19
Thadou: Lhanglang sang gamgi chun lhumlam lang ajotna Tamar a kipatna Kadesh a um Meribah twidung chan hiding ahi. Chule hiche a konna hi Egypt vadung ajui peh a Mediterranean twikhanglen chan geija leng lhading ahi. Hiche hi lhanglang gamgi hiding ahi.
English: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea. This is the south side southward.

tcz: Nilhum lang chu Mediterranean twikhanglen hi agamgi a pang ding lhanglang gamgi akipatna sahlang gamgi kipatna chan chu hiding, Lebo-hamath toh kigalsai ding ahi.
en: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.
text:
EZK 47:20
Thadou: Nilhum lang chu Mediterranean twikhanglen hi agamgi a pang ding lhanglang gamgi akipatna sahlang gamgi kipatna chan chu hiding, Lebo-hamath toh kigalsai ding ahi.
English: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.

tcz: Hicheng gamgi sunga gam hohi Israel phungsom leh phung niho nahoppeh ding ahi.
en: “So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.
text:
EZK 47:21
Thadou: Hicheng gamgi sunga gam hohi Israel phungsom leh phung niho nahoppeh ding ahi.
English: “So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

tcz: Nanghon agam hi nangho leh nangho goulo dinga chule gamdangmi ahivanga nangho lah a chale nao hingsa ho ahiuvin, amaho jong chu Israel chate tobang bang hidiu ahin, chan jong nangho lah a chan anei diu ahi.
en: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you, who will father children among you. Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel. They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
text:
EZK 47:22
Thadou: Nanghon agam hi nangho leh nangho goulo dinga chule gamdangmi ahivanga nangho lah a chale nao hingsa ho ahiuvin, amaho jong chu Israel chate tobang bang hidiu ahin, chan jong nangho lah a chan anei diu ahi.
English: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you, who will father children among you. Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel. They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

tcz: Hiche gamdang miho hi koiphung penna cheng kha hiu jongleh achen khah nau phungin achan gam sunga chu achandiu napeh diu ahi. Keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kaseisa ahi.
en: In whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 47:23
Thadou: Hiche gamdang miho hi koiphung penna cheng kha hiu jongleh achen khah nau phungin achan gam sunga chu achandiu napeh diu ahi. Keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kaseisa ahi.
English: In whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Hiche hi Israel phungmin gam kihopna a chan chang ding ho chu ahiuve. Dan chan ding gamkol chu sahlang aning chong kheh khu ahi. Agamgi chun Hethlon lamlen napat Lebo-hamath chan chule Hazar-enan chan gei hija, Hazar-enan hi Hamath gal Damascus dinga sahlam gamgi a panga ahi. Dan gamkol chu Israel gam solam a pat lhumlam galkai peh a kikeh len ding ahi.
en: “Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.
text:
EZK 48:1
Thadou: Hiche hi Israel phungmin gam kihopna a chan chang ding ho chu ahiuve. Dan chan ding gamkol chu sahlang aning chong kheh khu ahi. Agamgi chun Hethlon lamlen napat Lebo-hamath chan chule Hazar-enan chan gei hija, Hazar-enan hi Hamath gal Damascus dinga sahlam gamgi a panga ahi. Dan gamkol chu Israel gam solam a pat lhumlam galkai peh a kikeh len ding ahi.
English: “Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.

tcz: Asher gamkol chu Dan gam lhanglang sanga aumin chule solama pat lhumlam chan geijin akikeh lene.
en: “By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.
text:
EZK 48:2
Thadou: Asher gamkol chu Dan gam lhanglang sanga aumin chule solama pat lhumlam chan geijin akikeh lene.
English: “By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.

tcz: Naptali gamkol chu Asher gam lhanglang sang um ahin solama kipat in lhumlam chanin akikeh e.
en: “By the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali, one portion.
text:
EZK 48:3
Thadou: Naptali gamkol chu Asher gam lhanglang sang um ahin solama kipat in lhumlam chanin akikeh e.
English: “By the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali, one portion.

tcz: Hichun Manasseh chan chu Naptali lhanglang sang ahin chule agamkol chu solama pat nilhum chanin akikeh e.
en: “By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.
text:
EZK 48:4
Thadou: Hichun Manasseh chan chu Naptali lhanglang sang ahin chule agamkol chu solama pat nilhum chanin akikeh e.
English: “By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.

tcz: Manasseh gamkol lhanglang chu Ephraim chan ahin
en: “By the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion.
text:
EZK 48:5
Thadou: Manasseh gamkol lhanglang chu Ephraim chan ahin
English: “By the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion.

tcz: Chule Juda chan ahin, hichengho gamgi jouse gamgi chu solama kipat lhumlam changei ahicheh e.
en: “By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.
text:
EZK 48:7
Thadou: Chule Juda chan ahin, hichengho gamgi jouse gamgi chu solama kipat lhumlam changei ahicheh e.
English: “By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.

tcz: Juda gamkol lhanglang chu atumbeh a thil jatchom beh khat dinga natedoh diu ahi. Hichu availam mile get leh hopthuma hopkhat chule hiche solama pat nilhum chan gei kibang peh a phungkhat chan chutoh kibang ding ahin alailunga chu houin umding ahi.
en: “By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in width, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side to the west side; and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it.
text:
EZK 48:8
Thadou: Juda gamkol lhanglang chu atumbeh a thil jatchom beh khat dinga natedoh diu ahi. Hichu availam mile get leh hopthuma hopkhat chule hiche solama pat nilhum chan gei kibang peh a phungkhat chan chutoh kibang ding ahin alailunga chu houin umding ahi.
English: “By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in width, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side to the west side; and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it.

tcz: Pakai houin dinga natedoh diu chu adung lang mile get leh hopthuma hopkhat hija chule availam chu mile gup leh hopthuma hopni hiding ahi.
en: “The offering that you shall offer to the LORD shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.
text:
EZK 48:9
Thadou: Pakai houin dinga natedoh diu chu adung lang mile get leh hopthuma hopkhat hija chule availam chu mile gup leh hopthuma hopni hiding ahi.
English: “The offering that you shall offer to the LORD shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.

tcz: Thempu hon jong gam jom jitjet khat chang diu ahi mile get leh hopthuma hopkhat sao ding chule availam chu mile thum leh hopthuma hopkhat ma hiding ahin, alailunga chu houin um ding ahi.
en: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in width, and toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length; and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the middle of it.
text:
EZK 48:10
Thadou: Thempu hon jong gam jom jitjet khat chang diu ahi mile get leh hopthuma hopkhat sao ding chule availam chu mile thum leh hopthuma hopkhat ma hiding ahin, alailunga chu houin um ding ahi.
English: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in width, and toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length; and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the middle of it.

tcz: Hiche atuma nasekhen nau gam chu thensosa thempuho kitah tah a keima kin anabol jingsa Zadok chapate ho Israel chate ana vamang laijuva jong ana vahmang lou ho Levite umbanga ana umdet jing ho chang ding ahi.
en: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
text:
EZK 48:11
Thadou: Hiche atuma nasekhen nau gam chu thensosa thempuho kitah tah a keima kin anabol jingsa Zadok chapate ho Israel chate ana vamang laijuva jong ana vahmang lou ho Levite umbanga ana umdet jing ho chang ding ahi.
English: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

tcz: Gam chu akihop tengleh hichelai munna chu atum beh a kikhen doh gam thengpen hiding, hichu amaho chan ding ahi. Thempuho gam ban tah chu Levite chenna gam to kijoma umding ahi.
en: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites.
text:
EZK 48:12
Thadou: Gam chu akihop tengleh hichelai munna chu atum beh a kikhen doh gam thengpen hiding, hichu amaho chan ding ahi. Thempuho gam ban tah chu Levite chenna gam to kijoma umding ahi.
English: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites.

tcz: Levite dinga kipe gam chu thempuho chan gam toh alet aneu kibang ding ahi – asau lang mile get leh hopthuma hopkhat hiding availang mile thum leh hopthuma hopkhat hidng ahi. Agam pumpi hopma chu adung mile getleh hopthuma hopkhat hiding availam mile gup leh hopthuma hopni hiding ahi.
en: “Alongside the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. All the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.
text:
EZK 48:13
Thadou: Levite dinga kipe gam chu thempuho chan gam toh alet aneu kibang ding ahi – asau lang mile get leh hopthuma hopkhat hiding availang mile thum leh hopthuma hopkhat hidng ahi. Agam pumpi hopma chu adung mile getleh hopthuma hopkhat hiding availam mile gup leh hopthuma hopni hiding ahi.
English: “Alongside the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. All the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.

tcz: Hiche gam hi themkhat cha jong kipeh tha lou ding, ahilouleh suma kiveina a jong kimang theilou ding, ahilouleh midangin amanchah theilou ding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche hi Pakaija ahin, gamtheng dinga kisep khen ahi.
en: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated, for it is holy to the LORD.
text:
EZK 48:14
Thadou: Hiche gam hi themkhat cha jong kipeh tha lou ding, ahilouleh suma kiveina a jong kimang theilou ding, ahilouleh midangin amanchah theilou ding ahi. Ajeh chu hiche hi Pakaija ahin, gamtheng dinga kisep khen ahi.
English: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated, for it is holy to the LORD.

tcz: Abelap ding gam jom jitjet khat adung mile get leh hopthuma hopkhat availam mile khat leh hopthuma hopni houinna dinga kikat doh gamtheng lhanglanga uma – hichu mipin adei deija amancha diu – insahna, gancha vahna leh gam onga umding alaija chu khopi umding ahi.
en: “The five thousand cubits that are left in the width, in front of the twenty-five thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for pasture lands; and the city shall be in the middle of it.
text:
EZK 48:15
Thadou: Abelap ding gam jom jitjet khat adung mile get leh hopthuma hopkhat availam mile khat leh hopthuma hopni houinna dinga kikat doh gamtheng lhanglanga uma – hichu mipin adei deija amancha diu – insahna, gancha vahna leh gam onga umding alaija chu khopi umding ahi.
English: “The five thousand cubits that are left in the width, in front of the twenty-five thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for pasture lands; and the city shall be in the middle of it.

tcz: Khopi dinga chu – sahlang, lhanglang, solam chule lhumlam hiding – alang jousea mile khat leh akeh len ding ahi.
en: These shall be its measurements: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
text:
EZK 48:16
Thadou: Khopi dinga chu – sahlang, lhanglang, solam chule lhumlam hiding – alang jousea mile khat leh akeh len ding ahi.
English: These shall be its measurements: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

tcz: Khopi chun gam ong lai aneija hichun khopi chu aum kimvel ding ahin, hichu feet 450 akimvel lhung kei hiding ahi.
en: The city shall have pasture lands: toward the north two hundred fifty, and toward the south two hundred fifty, and toward the east two hundred fifty, and toward the west two hundred fifty.
text:
EZK 48:17
Thadou: Khopi chun gam ong lai aneija hichun khopi chu aum kimvel ding ahin, hichu feet 450 akimvel lhung kei hiding ahi.
English: The city shall have pasture lands: toward the north two hundred fifty, and toward the south two hundred fifty, and toward the east two hundred fifty, and toward the west two hundred fifty.

tcz: Khopi kimvella chun honlei bolna thei gam mile thum leh hopthuma hopkhat gamtheng solam langa kilhung lha a chule mile thum leh hopthuma hopkhat lhum langa kilhung peh ding ahi. Hiche honlei hin khopi sung natongho dinga neh leh chah asodoh ding ahi.
en: The remainder of the length, alongside the holy offering, shall be ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward; and it shall be alongside the holy offering. Its increase shall be for food to those who labor in the city.
text:
EZK 48:18
Thadou: Khopi kimvella chun honlei bolna thei gam mile thum leh hopthuma hopkhat gamtheng solam langa kilhung lha a chule mile thum leh hopthuma hopkhat lhum langa kilhung peh ding ahi. Hiche honlei hin khopi sung natongho dinga neh leh chah asodoh ding ahi.
English: The remainder of the length, alongside the holy offering, shall be ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward; and it shall be alongside the holy offering. Its increase shall be for food to those who labor in the city.

tcz: Koiphunga kon hijong leh khopi sunga natong dinga hung ho jousen honlei akibol thei diu ahi.
en: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.
text:
EZK 48:19
Thadou: Koiphunga kon hijong leh khopi sunga natong dinga hung ho jousen honlei akibol thei diu ahi.
English: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.

tcz: Agam hop apumpia gamtheng leh khopi puma asung chu aning jousea mile get leh akeh hiding ahi.
en: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall offer it as a holy offering, with the possession of the city.
text:
EZK 48:20
Thadou: Agam hop apumpia gamtheng leh khopi puma asung chu aning jousea mile get leh akeh hiding ahi.
English: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall offer it as a holy offering, with the possession of the city.

tcz: Gamleiset gamtheng leh khopi solam lang leh lhum lam lang a ong lai sese chu leng chapa a hiding ahin, aninia agam chu availam mile get leh hopthuma hopkhat hia hichu Israel solam leh lhumlam toh kigalsai gamgi teni chan hiding ahin, chua houin muntheng chu alaija umding ahi.
en: “The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city; in front of the twenty-five thousand of the offering toward the east border, and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border, alongside the portions, it shall be for the prince. The holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the middle of it.
text:
EZK 48:21
Thadou: Gamleiset gamtheng leh khopi solam lang leh lhum lam lang a ong lai sese chu leng chapa a hiding ahin, aninia agam chu availam mile get leh hopthuma hopkhat hia hichu Israel solam leh lhumlam toh kigalsai gamgi teni chan hiding ahin, chua houin muntheng chu alaija umding ahi.
English: “The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city; in front of the twenty-five thousand of the offering toward the east border, and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border, alongside the portions, it shall be for the prince. The holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the middle of it.

tcz: Leng chapa chan ding chu gamtheng leh khopi tailou adang sese Judah leh Benjamin chan gamkol kika lai chu hiding ahi.
en: Moreover, from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the middle of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.
text:
EZK 48:22
Thadou: Leng chapa chan ding chu gamtheng leh khopi tailou adang sese Judah leh Benjamin chan gamkol kika lai chu hiding ahi.
English: Moreover, from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the middle of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

tcz: Hiche gamkol hohi phungdang ho chanding chu ahi – Benjamin chan ding agamkol chu lengchapa gam lhanglang sanga aumin Israel gam lhungkei solam a kipat lhumlam chan na kilhung lut peh ding ahi.
en: “As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.
text:
EZK 48:23
Thadou: Hiche gamkol hohi phungdang ho chanding chu ahi – Benjamin chan ding agamkol chu lengchapa gam lhanglang sanga aumin Israel gam lhungkei solam a kipat lhumlam chan na kilhung lut peh ding ahi.
English: “As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.

tcz: Benjamin chan gamkol lhanglang sanga chu Simeon chan gamkol chu uma hichu Israel gam solam a pat lhumlam galkai peh ding ahi.
en: “By the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one portion.
text:
EZK 48:24
Thadou: Benjamin chan gamkol lhanglang sanga chu Simeon chan gamkol chu uma hichu Israel gam solam a pat lhumlam galkai peh ding ahi.
English: “By the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one portion.

tcz: Abana chu Issachar chan ding ahin solam leh lhumlam gamgi changei ma hiding ahi.
en: “By the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one portion.
text:
EZK 48:25
Thadou: Abana chu Issachar chan ding ahin solam leh lhumlam gamgi changei ma hiding ahi.
English: “By the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one portion.

tcz: Hitia chu aban Zebulun gamkol ahin hichu solama pat lhumlam galkai peh kit ding ahi.
en: “By the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one portion.
text:
EZK 48:26
Thadou: Hitia chu aban Zebulun gamkol ahin hichu solama pat lhumlam galkai peh kit ding ahi.
English: “By the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one portion.

tcz: Gad gamkol chan ding Zebulun chan lhanglang chu agamgi chu solama pat lhumlam chan hipeh ding ahi.
en: “By the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one portion.
text:
EZK 48:27
Thadou: Gad gamkol chan ding Zebulun chan lhanglang chu agamgi chu solama pat lhumlam chan hipeh ding ahi.
English: “By the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one portion.

tcz: Gad gamkol lhanglang sang chu Tamar a pat Kadesh munna Meribah twidung juisuh a Egypt vacha dung amatna Mediterranean twikhanglen chan hiding ahi.
en: “By the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar to the waters of Meribath Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea.
text:
EZK 48:28
Thadou: Gad gamkol lhanglang sang chu Tamar a pat Kadesh munna Meribah twidung juisuh a Egypt vacha dung amatna Mediterranean twikhanglen chan hiding ahi.
English: “By the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar to the waters of Meribath Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea.

tcz: Hiche gamho hi aphung aphunga achan cheh diuva kisepkhen ahin amaho neile gou kisim thalou ding ahi, tin keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kaseidohsa ahi.
en: “This is the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their several portions, says the Lord GOD.
text:
EZK 48:29
Thadou: Hiche gamho hi aphung aphunga achan cheh diuva kisepkhen ahin amaho neile gou kisim thalou ding ahi, tin keima thaneitah Pakaiyin kaseidohsa ahi.
English: “This is the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their several portions, says the Lord GOD.

tcz: Hiche hohi khopi a kon potdohna hiding ahi. Sahlang banga akitena dungjuija mile khat leh akeh hiding ahi.
en: “These are the exits of the city: On the north side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure;

tcz: Hichea chu kelkot thum umding ahin, kelkot jouse chu Israel te phungmin kisah soh keiding ahi. Amasapen chu Reuben kelkot kiti ding, anina min chu Judah, chule athum channa chu Levi kiti ding ahi.
en: and the gates of the city shall be named after the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.
text:
EZK 48:31
Thadou: Hichea chu kelkot thum umding ahin, kelkot jouse chu Israel te phungmin kisah soh keiding ahi. Amasapen chu Reuben kelkot kiti ding, anina min chu Judah, chule athum channa chu Levi kiti ding ahi.
English: and the gates of the city shall be named after the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.

tcz: Solam bang lang sang jong chu ahileh mile khatleh akeh sauva chu kelkot um ding ahin, hiho chu Joshep, Benjamin chule Dan kelkot kiti ding ahi.
