en: So the king of the north will come and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city. The forces of the south won’t stand, neither will his select troops, neither will there be any strength to stand.
text:
DAN 11:15
Thadou: Chutah leh, sahlam lengpa chu hungkon intin, dettah’a pal kikaikhum kulpi umna khopi jeng jong anokhum’a alahding ahi. Hiche phatleh, lhanglam gam’a sepai ahatlai lai ho jeng jong amasanga pang joulou diu ahi, ajeh chu ama nan jou nading tha anei lou diu ahitai.
English: So the king of the north will come and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city. The forces of the south won’t stand, neither will his select troops, neither will there be any strength to stand.

tcz: Chuteng sahlam lengpa chu adou jou ding beihel’a hung machal ding, anop nop abol’a koiman akhamtang joulou ding ahitai. Aman Israel gamloupi chu achotpha-a asuhmang gotding chuleh athu noija akoi ding ahi.
en: But he who comes against him will do according to his own will, and no one will stand before him. He will stand in the glorious land, and destruction will be in his hand.
text:
DAN 11:16
Thadou: Chuteng sahlam lengpa chu adou jou ding beihel’a hung machal ding, anop nop abol’a koiman akhamtang joulou ding ahitai. Aman Israel gamloupi chu achotpha-a asuhmang gotding chuleh athu noija akoi ding ahi.
English: But he who comes against him will do according to his own will, and no one will stand before him. He will stand in the glorious land, and destruction will be in his hand.

tcz: Aman alenggam thahatna pumpi chutoh hungkon’a, lhanggam lengpa toh kimaito’a kihouchamna agonding ahi. Chuleh aman alenggam suhmang peh nading a achanu chu lhanggam lengpa ji dinga agon ding, ahivanga, athilgon ho abon’a losam ding ahi.
en: He will set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and with him equitable conditions. He will perform them. He will give him the daughter of women, to destroy the kingdom, but she will not stand, and won’t be for him.
text:
DAN 11:17
Thadou: Aman alenggam thahatna pumpi chutoh hungkon’a, lhanggam lengpa toh kimaito’a kihouchamna agonding ahi. Chuleh aman alenggam suhmang peh nading a achanu chu lhanggam lengpa ji dinga agon ding, ahivanga, athilgon ho abon’a losam ding ahi.
English: He will set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and with him equitable conditions. He will perform them. He will give him the daughter of women, to destroy the kingdom, but she will not stand, and won’t be for him.

tcz: Hiche ban’a chu, aman twikhanglen pang’a gamho ahin lunglutpi ding, gal abolkhum kit ding chuleh khopi tampi alah ding ahi. Ahivang in, gamdang sepai lamkai khat in, hichea hi, lengpa kiloupisahna ho chu achaina ahin semding chuleh jumleh ja thoh’a akinungle sah ding ahi.
en: After this he will turn his face to the islands, and will take many, but a prince will cause the reproach offered by him to cease. Yes, moreover, he will cause his reproach to turn on him.
text:
DAN 11:18
Thadou: Hiche ban’a chu, aman twikhanglen pang’a gamho ahin lunglutpi ding, gal abolkhum kit ding chuleh khopi tampi alah ding ahi. Ahivang in, gamdang sepai lamkai khat in, hichea hi, lengpa kiloupisahna ho chu achaina ahin semding chuleh jumleh ja thoh’a akinungle sah ding ahi.
English: After this he will turn his face to the islands, and will take many, but a prince will cause the reproach offered by him to cease. Yes, moreover, he will cause his reproach to turn on him.

tcz: Hitia chu, aman agamsung’a akiselna kulpi chu anung jot kit ding chuleh kimukit talou ding ahitai.
en: Then he will turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land; but he will stumble and fall, and won’t be found.
text:
DAN 11:19
Thadou: Hitia chu, aman agamsung’a akiselna kulpi chu anung jot kit ding chuleh kimukit talou ding ahitai.
English: Then he will turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land; but he will stumble and fall, and won’t be found.

tcz: Chutah leh, ama ban’a lengkhat hunglen doh ding, ama chun leng Inpi loupina dia, mipitea kon’a kai dong ding vaipo asolding ahi. Hijong leh, amahin phat chomcha lengvai apoh ding, chujou leh, lunghan jeh leh gal kisat jeh hilouva, amahi kisumang ding ahi tai.
en: “Then one who will cause a tax collector to pass through the kingdom to maintain its glory will stand up in his place; but within few days he shall be destroyed, not in anger, and not in battle.
text:
DAN 11:20
Thadou: Chutah leh, ama ban’a lengkhat hunglen doh ding, ama chun leng Inpi loupina dia, mipitea kon’a kai dong ding vaipo asolding ahi. Hijong leh, amahin phat chomcha lengvai apoh ding, chujou leh, lunghan jeh leh gal kisat jeh hilouva, amahi kisumang ding ahi tai.
English: “Then one who will cause a tax collector to pass through the kingdom to maintain its glory will stand up in his place; but within few days he shall be destroyed, not in anger, and not in battle.

tcz: Ama ban’a hi, duhdah lou migilou khat, lengpa son leh chilhah jong hilou khat, lengvaipo’a hung pang ding ahi. Aman alep lep’a thu asei ding chuleh duha thutah’a thilgon aneiding, mihon agellou pettah’a, lenggam thaneina chu alah ding ahi.
en: “In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
text:
DAN 11:21
Thadou: Ama ban’a hi, duhdah lou migilou khat, lengpa son leh chilhah jong hilou khat, lengvaipo’a hung pang ding ahi. Aman alep lep’a thu asei ding chuleh duha thutah’a thilgon aneiding, mihon agellou pettah’a, lenggam thaneina chu alah ding ahi.
English: “In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

tcz: Ama masang’a sepai tamtah kitheh ngim ding, kisumang hel ding chuleh kitepna leng chapa geija kisumang ding ahi.
en: The overwhelming forces will be overwhelmed from before him, and will be broken. Yes, also the prince of the covenant.
text:
DAN 11:22
Thadou: Ama masang’a sepai tamtah kitheh ngim ding, kisumang hel ding chuleh kitepna leng chapa geija kisumang ding ahi.
English: The overwhelming forces will be overwhelmed from before him, and will be broken. Yes, also the prince of the covenant.

tcz: Aman jouleh nal aseija kitepna abol ding, chuleh kichamna tampi asemdoh ding ahi.
en: After the treaty made with him he will work deceitfully; for he will come up and will become strong with few people.
text:
DAN 11:23
Thadou: Aman jouleh nal aseija kitepna abol ding, chuleh kichamna tampi asemdoh ding ahi.
English: After the treaty made with him he will work deceitfully; for he will come up and will become strong with few people.

tcz: Gihsalna neimasa louva, gamsunga leipha laipen munho aholdoh ding, apu apaten anabol khah louhel abol ding ahi. Aman mihaosa ho neileh gou alah peh’a athe thang ding, anung juiho ahoppeh ding, chuleh kulpi detlai lai ho suhset nading thilgon aneiding ahi. Ahi vanga, athilbol jouse phat chomkhat kah’a ding bou hiding ahi.
en: In time of security he will come even on the fattest places of the province. He will do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers. He will scatter among them prey, plunder, and wealth. Yes, he will devise his plans against the strongholds, but only for a time.
text:
DAN 11:24
Thadou: Gihsalna neimasa louva, gamsunga leipha laipen munho aholdoh ding, apu apaten anabol khah louhel abol ding ahi. Aman mihaosa ho neileh gou alah peh’a athe thang ding, anung juiho ahoppeh ding, chuleh kulpi detlai lai ho suhset nading thilgon aneiding ahi. Ahi vanga, athilbol jouse phat chomkhat kah’a ding bou hiding ahi.
English: In time of security he will come even on the fattest places of the province. He will do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers. He will scatter among them prey, plunder, and wealth. Yes, he will devise his plans against the strongholds, but only for a time.

tcz: Chujou teng, ama hung kitil doh ding, lhanggam lengpa douna-a sepai tampi asemdoh ding chuleh amaho chutoh gal kisat ding, ahivanga, aman ajolou ding ahi. Ajeh chu, ama suhmangna dinga thilgon aguh’a tampi umdoh ahi tai.
en: “He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army, but he won’t stand; for they will devise plans against him.
text:
DAN 11:25
Thadou: Chujou teng, ama hung kitil doh ding, lhanggam lengpa douna-a sepai tampi asemdoh ding chuleh amaho chutoh gal kisat ding, ahivanga, aman ajolou ding ahi. Ajeh chu, ama suhmangna dinga thilgon aguh’a tampi umdoh ahi tai.
English: “He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army, but he won’t stand; for they will devise plans against him.

tcz: Ama insung miten, ama manthahna aboldoh ding, a sepaite abon’a kitheh ngim ding chuleh mi tampin thina ato ding ahi.
en: Yes, those who eat of his delicacies will destroy him, and his army will be swept away. Many will fall down slain.
text:
DAN 11:26
Thadou: Ama insung miten, ama manthahna aboldoh ding, a sepaite abon’a kitheh ngim ding chuleh mi tampin thina ato ding ahi.
English: Yes, those who eat of his delicacies will destroy him, and his army will be swept away. Many will fall down slain.

tcz: Hiche leng teni hin, thildang boipi louva, amani kah’a kisuhmang to nading bou agellhon ding, chuleh kihouchamna ankong phung jeng’a jong thujouva kilhem lhon ding ahi. Amavang aphachom imacha umdoh dehlou ding, ajeh chu, Pathen phat tepsa bang’a achaina chu thou thou ding ahi.
en: As for both these kings, their hearts will be to do evil, and they will speak lies at one table; but it won’t prosper, for the end will still be at the appointed time.
text:
DAN 11:27
Thadou: Hiche leng teni hin, thildang boipi louva, amani kah’a kisuhmang to nading bou agellhon ding, chuleh kihouchamna ankong phung jeng’a jong thujouva kilhem lhon ding ahi. Amavang aphachom imacha umdoh dehlou ding, ajeh chu, Pathen phat tepsa bang’a achaina chu thou thou ding ahi.
English: As for both these kings, their hearts will be to do evil, and they will speak lies at one table; but it won’t prosper, for the end will still be at the appointed time.

tcz: Chuteng, sahlam lengpa chu, nei leh gou tampi akipoh’a agam’a kilekit ding ahi; ama hin, kitepna theng nam mite douna anop nop abol ding, chuleh agamsung jong asuhgep’a adalhah ding ahi.
en: Then he will return into his land with great wealth. His heart will be against the holy covenant. He will take action, and return to his own land.
text:
DAN 11:28
Thadou: Chuteng, sahlam lengpa chu, nei leh gou tampi akipoh’a agam’a kilekit ding ahi; ama hin, kitepna theng nam mite douna anop nop abol ding, chuleh agamsung jong asuhgep’a adalhah ding ahi.
English: Then he will return into his land with great wealth. His heart will be against the holy covenant. He will take action, and return to his own land.

tcz: Chuleh, achaina phat kitep chu ahung lhin tengleh, ama hung kilekit’a, lhanggam lengpa chu gal abolkhum kit ding ahi. Amavang, hiche hi, masang a agalbol tobang’a hungsoh talou ding ahitai.
en: “He will return at the appointed time and come into the south; but it won’t be in the latter time as it was in the former.
text:
DAN 11:29
Thadou: Chuleh, achaina phat kitep chu ahung lhin tengleh, ama hung kilekit’a, lhanggam lengpa chu gal abolkhum kit ding ahi. Amavang, hiche hi, masang a agalbol tobang’a hungsoh talou ding ahitai.
English: “He will return at the appointed time and come into the south; but it won’t be in the latter time as it was in the former.

tcz: Ajeh chu, lhumlam twipi pang’a kon’a, kong-innei tampi ama doudinga hungkon diu, hichun ama akichatsah ding, lung himo tah’a agam lang’a kilekit ding ahi. Aman hichea alunghanna chu kitepna theng mite chung a achuhsah ding, chuleh kitepna donselou miho chu akihoutheipi ding, amaho toh pangkhom diu ahi.
en: For ships of Kittim will come against him. Therefore he will be grieved, and will return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and will take action. He will even return, and have regard to those who forsake the holy covenant.
text:
DAN 11:30
Thadou: Ajeh chu, lhumlam twipi pang’a kon’a, kong-innei tampi ama doudinga hungkon diu, hichun ama akichatsah ding, lung himo tah’a agam lang’a kilekit ding ahi. Aman hichea alunghanna chu kitepna theng mite chung a achuhsah ding, chuleh kitepna donselou miho chu akihoutheipi ding, amaho toh pangkhom diu ahi.
English: For ships of Kittim will come against him. Therefore he will be grieved, and will return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and will take action. He will even return, and have regard to those who forsake the holy covenant.

tcz: Chutahleh, ama sepaiten, houin kulpi alodiu, asuhthang’uva asuhbohdiu, tanglouva kiboljing kilhaina gamtha jong asuhtangdiu chuleh thet umtah milimdoi chu atundoh diu ahi.
en: “Forces from him will profane the sanctuary, even the fortress, and will take away the continual burnt offering. Then they will set up the abomination that makes desolate.
text:
DAN 11:31
Thadou: Chutahleh, ama sepaiten, houin kulpi alodiu, asuhthang’uva asuhbohdiu, tanglouva kiboljing kilhaina gamtha jong asuhtangdiu chuleh thet umtah milimdoi chu atundoh diu ahi.
English: “Forces from him will profane the sanctuary, even the fortress, and will take away the continual burnt offering. Then they will set up the abomination that makes desolate.

tcz: Aman kitepna sukeh ho chu jou leh nal’a ajollhah’a. amaho kithopina amu ding ahi. Hijong leh, Pathen hejing mite vang chu dettah’a pang’uva, ama chu akisatpi diu ahi.
en: He will corrupt those who do wickedly against the covenant by flatteries; but the people who know their God will be strong and take action.
text:
DAN 11:32
Thadou: Aman kitepna sukeh ho chu jou leh nal’a ajollhah’a. amaho kithopina amu ding ahi. Hijong leh, Pathen hejing mite vang chu dettah’a pang’uva, ama chu akisatpi diu ahi.
English: He will corrupt those who do wickedly against the covenant by flatteries; but the people who know their God will be strong and take action.

tcz: Mipi lamkai chingtah ho chun, miho chu ahil uva ahetthemsah diu, hijong leh amaho vang chu meiya kihallih loi, chemjam’a kithat loi, chuleh konkhat chu achomuva songkul tangden loi, um ding ahiuve.
en: “Those who are wise among the people will instruct many; yet they will fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder, many days.
text:
DAN 11:33
Thadou: Mipi lamkai chingtah ho chun, miho chu ahil uva ahetthemsah diu, hijong leh amaho vang chu meiya kihallih loi, chemjam’a kithat loi, chuleh konkhat chu achomuva songkul tangden loi, um ding ahiuve.
English: “Those who are wise among the people will instruct many; yet they will fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder, many days.

tcz: Hiche bolgenthei naphat sunga hi, Pathen miten panpina themcha amu diu, ahivanga miho chun amaho chu, lungtho nei pum’a akivoppi diu ahi.
en: Now when they fall, they will be helped with a little help; but many will join themselves to them with flatteries.
text:
DAN 11:34
Thadou: Hiche bolgenthei naphat sunga hi, Pathen miten panpina themcha amu diu, ahivanga miho chun amaho chu, lungtho nei pum’a akivoppi diu ahi.
English: Now when they fall, they will be helped with a little help; but many will join themselves to them with flatteries.

tcz: Chuleh lamkai miching phabep vang chu, bolgentheina jal’a pang joulou umdiu ahi. Hitia chu, achaina phat kitepsa alhinkah sea chu, amahohi kisutheng’uva chuleh kithenso jing diu ahi. Ajeh chu, achaina phat tep chu, vatjep nalai ahi.
en: Some of those who are wise will fall—to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the end, because it is yet for the time appointed.
text:
DAN 11:35
Thadou: Chuleh lamkai miching phabep vang chu, bolgentheina jal’a pang joulou umdiu ahi. Hitia chu, achaina phat kitepsa alhinkah sea chu, amahohi kisutheng’uva chuleh kithenso jing diu ahi. Ajeh chu, achaina phat tep chu, vatjep nalai ahi.
English: Some of those who are wise will fall—to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the end, because it is yet for the time appointed.

tcz: Chutia chu, lengpan ama nop nop abol ding, amatah kichoisanga chuleh ama chu Pathen ho sang’a loupijo’a kisei ding, chuleh Pathen jong ataitom ding ahi. Ama lolhinna leh loupina hi chomkhat kah’a dingbou hiding, hichu Pathen lungsatna phat kitep hunglhin kah’a dingbou ahi. Ajeh chu, Pathen thutepsa chu thonlouva lhung tei ding ahi.
en: “The king will do according to his will. He will exalt himself and magnify himself above every god, and will speak marvelous things against the God of gods. He will prosper until the indignation is accomplished, for that which is determined will be done.
text:
DAN 11:36
Thadou: Chutia chu, lengpan ama nop nop abol ding, amatah kichoisanga chuleh ama chu Pathen ho sang’a loupijo’a kisei ding, chuleh Pathen jong ataitom ding ahi. Ama lolhinna leh loupina hi chomkhat kah’a dingbou hiding, hichu Pathen lungsatna phat kitep hunglhin kah’a dingbou ahi. Ajeh chu, Pathen thutepsa chu thonlouva lhung tei ding ahi.
English: “The king will do according to his will. He will exalt himself and magnify himself above every god, and will speak marvelous things against the God of gods. He will prosper until the indignation is accomplished, for that which is determined will be done.

tcz: Aman apute apate doi- pathen ho chu donlouva akoiding, chuleh numeiten akhohsah pen’u doi-pathen jong donlouva akoiding ahi. Ajeh chu, ama chu pathen ho sang’a loupijo’a kigel ahitan, pathen houna kiti poupou chu apum donlou ding ahitai.
en: He won’t regard the gods of his fathers, or the desire of women, or regard any god; for he will magnify himself above all.
text:
DAN 11:37
Thadou: Aman apute apate doi- pathen ho chu donlouva akoiding, chuleh numeiten akhohsah pen’u doi-pathen jong donlouva akoiding ahi. Ajeh chu, ama chu pathen ho sang’a loupijo’a kigel ahitan, pathen houna kiti poupou chu apum donlou ding ahitai.
English: He won’t regard the gods of his fathers, or the desire of women, or regard any god; for he will magnify himself above all.

tcz: Hiche seh hilouva, apu apaten anahet khahlou, kulpi ngah pathen chu aman ahou ding, song mantam leh sana-dangka chuleh manlutah tah thilpeh ho apeh’a ajabol ding ahi.
en: But in their place, he will honor the god of fortresses. He will honor a god whom his fathers didn’t know with gold, silver, and with precious stones and pleasant things.
text:
DAN 11:38
Thadou: Hiche seh hilouva, apu apaten anahet khahlou, kulpi ngah pathen chu aman ahou ding, song mantam leh sana-dangka chuleh manlutah tah thilpeh ho apeh’a ajabol ding ahi.
English: But in their place, he will honor the god of fortresses. He will honor a god whom his fathers didn’t know with gold, silver, and with precious stones and pleasant things.

tcz: Hiche gamdang doi-pathen toh pangkhom kahi tia asei ding, kulpi detlai jouse anokhum ding ahi. Chuleh ama heng’a hung kipelut miho chu ajabol ding, amaho chu gamkai ahoppeh’a, thunei vaihom’a apansah ding ahi.
en: He will deal with the strongest fortresses by the help of a foreign god. He will increase with glory whoever acknowledges him. He will cause them to rule over many, and will divide the land for a price.
text:
DAN 11:39
Thadou: Hiche gamdang doi-pathen toh pangkhom kahi tia asei ding, kulpi detlai jouse anokhum ding ahi. Chuleh ama heng’a hung kipelut miho chu ajabol ding, amaho chu gamkai ahoppeh’a, thunei vaihom’a apansah ding ahi.
English: He will deal with the strongest fortresses by the help of a foreign god. He will increase with glory whoever acknowledges him. He will cause them to rule over many, and will divide the land for a price.

tcz: Chuteng, achaina phat alhinteng leh, lhanglam lengpan sahlam lengpa chu gal abol khum ding ahi. Hijongleh, sahlam lengpan, sakol kangtalai tamtah leh sakol sepai tamtah toh chuleh kong-innei tamtah toh kitho’a, chingpei bang’a lhanglam lengpa ahin nokhum ding ahi. Chuleh aman gam chom chom jong ahinjotpa-a, twipi hungsoh bang’a ahin lekhup ding ahi.
en: “At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, with horsemen, and with many ships. He will enter into the countries, and will overflow and pass through.
text:
DAN 11:40
Thadou: Chuteng, achaina phat alhinteng leh, lhanglam lengpan sahlam lengpa chu gal abol khum ding ahi. Hijongleh, sahlam lengpan, sakol kangtalai tamtah leh sakol sepai tamtah toh chuleh kong-innei tamtah toh kitho’a, chingpei bang’a lhanglam lengpa ahin nokhum ding ahi. Chuleh aman gam chom chom jong ahinjotpa-a, twipi hungsoh bang’a ahin lekhup ding ahi.
English: “At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, with horsemen, and with many ships. He will enter into the countries, and will overflow and pass through.

tcz: Chuleh ama chu Israel gamloupia hunglut ding, nam chom chom ho a-angsung’a lhulham dingu, ahivanga Moab mite, Edom mite chuleh gamlailung’a cheng Ammon mite ho vang, kihuhdoh diu ahi.
en: He will enter also into the glorious land, and many countries will be overthrown; but these will be delivered out of his hand: Edom, Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
text:
DAN 11:41
Thadou: Chuleh ama chu Israel gamloupia hunglut ding, nam chom chom ho a-angsung’a lhulham dingu, ahivanga Moab mite, Edom mite chuleh gamlailung’a cheng Ammon mite ho vang, kihuhdoh diu ahi.
English: He will enter also into the glorious land, and many countries will be overthrown; but these will be delivered out of his hand: Edom, Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

tcz: Aman gam tampi ahin lahding, chuleh Egypt gamsung jeng jong hoidohlou ding ahi.
en: He will also stretch out his hand on the countries. The land of Egypt won’t escape.
text:
DAN 11:42
Thadou: Aman gam tampi ahin lahding, chuleh Egypt gamsung jeng jong hoidohlou ding ahi.
English: He will also stretch out his hand on the countries. The land of Egypt won’t escape.

tcz: Sana leh dangka jouse chunga aman thunei vaihomna aneiding chuleh Egypt gamsunga neileh gou jouse chunga jong vai ahomding ahi. Chuleh Libya mite leh Ethiopia mite chunga vai ahom ding, amaho chu asoh’a pangdiu ahi.
en: But he will have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt. The Libyans and the Ethiopians will follow his steps.
text:
DAN 11:43
Thadou: Sana leh dangka jouse chunga aman thunei vaihomna aneiding chuleh Egypt gamsunga neileh gou jouse chunga jong vai ahomding ahi. Chuleh Libya mite leh Ethiopia mite chunga vai ahom ding, amaho chu asoh’a pangdiu ahi.
English: But he will have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt. The Libyans and the Ethiopians will follow his steps.

tcz: Ahinlah, niso lam’a konleh sahlam’a kon’a thu hung kithang chun ama akichatsah ding, chuleh, hiche jeh’a chu, ama lunghang tah’a mi tampi thatgam dingleh sumang ding’a, hungkon doh ding ahi.
en: But news out of the east and out of the north will trouble him; and he will go out with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.
text:
DAN 11:44
Thadou: Ahinlah, niso lam’a konleh sahlam’a kon’a thu hung kithang chun ama akichatsah ding, chuleh, hiche jeh’a chu, ama lunghang tah’a mi tampi thatgam dingleh sumang ding’a, hungkon doh ding ahi.
English: But news out of the east and out of the north will trouble him; and he will go out with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.

tcz: Aman, loupitah lhangtheng leh twipi kikah’a chu ngahmun asem ding, aleng ponbuh loupi chu ason ding ahi. Ahivangin, chulai mun’a aumpet’a chu, ama dinga aphat kichaina hung lhung ding, koiman ama chu apanhu jou lou ding ahi.
en: He will plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.
text:
DAN 11:45
Thadou: Aman, loupitah lhangtheng leh twipi kikah’a chu ngahmun asem ding, aleng ponbuh loupi chu ason ding ahi. Ahivangin, chulai mun’a aumpet’a chu, ama dinga aphat kichaina hung lhung ding, koiman ama chu apanhu jou lou ding ahi.
English: He will plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.

tcz: Chuche nikho leh, namite veng jing’a pang, vantil pipu Michael chu hung kipandoh ding, chutah leh, gim gentheina nasatah phat hung lhung ding ahi. Hitobang phat hahsa chu, mihem khang hung umdoh apat, hiche nikho geiya chu soh khalou hellai ahi. Ahivangin, hiche phat hileh, na mite koi hileh, lekhabua amin kisun chengse vang chu kihuhdoh tei ding ahiuve.
en: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time your people will be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.
text:
DAN 12:1
Thadou: Chuche nikho leh, namite veng jing’a pang, vantil pipu Michael chu hung kipandoh ding, chutah leh, gim gentheina nasatah phat hung lhung ding ahi. Hitobang phat hahsa chu, mihem khang hung umdoh apat, hiche nikho geiya chu soh khalou hellai ahi. Ahivangin, hiche phat hileh, na mite koi hileh, lekhabua amin kisun chengse vang chu kihuhdoh tei ding ahiuve.
English: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time your people will be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.

tcz: Chuteng leh mikhem tamtah athia kivuisa ho hungthoudoh’untin, mi phabep chu tonsot kemlouva kipana chang’untin, chuleh abang vang chu tonsot’a kijumsona damun chang’a hung thou ding ahiuve.
en: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
text:
DAN 12:2
Thadou: Chuteng leh mikhem tamtah athia kivuisa ho hungthoudoh’untin, mi phabep chu tonsot kemlouva kipana chang’untin, chuleh abang vang chu tonsot’a kijumsona damun chang’a hung thou ding ahiuve.
English: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

tcz: Hichea hin, koi hileh, michingho vang chu, vanthamjol vah banga vah diu chuleh mihem tamtah chondihna lampia heilut hojong chu, van’a ahsite bang’a atonsot’a vah jing ding ahiuve.
en: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.
text:
DAN 12:3
Thadou: Hichea hin, koi hileh, michingho vang chu, vanthamjol vah banga vah diu chuleh mihem tamtah chondihna lampia heilut hojong chu, van’a ahsite bang’a atonsot’a vah jing ding ahiuve.
English: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.

tcz: Amavang Daniel nangin, hiche gaothu hi imchah inlang, chuleh hiche lekhabu hi khumtup in, phat nunung hunglhun kahin, Mohor namkhum inlang chuleh aguhin koitan. Hiche tah chuleh, mihem chihna leh hetna hungkhang ding, mihemten khonung khoma ding thu holna-a, adung avaija lhaile diu ahi.
en: But you, Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and knowledge will be increased.”
text:
DAN 12:4
Thadou: Amavang Daniel nangin, hiche gaothu hi imchah inlang, chuleh hiche lekhabu hi khumtup in, phat nunung hunglhun kahin, Mohor namkhum inlang chuleh aguhin koitan. Hiche tah chuleh, mihem chihna leh hetna hungkhang ding, mihemten khonung khoma ding thu holna-a, adung avaija lhaile diu ahi.
English: But you, Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and knowledge will be increased.”

tcz: Chuin, Daniel keiman kaven ahileh, michom mini tah vadung pang langkhat cheh’a, adinlhon kamun ahi.
en: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on the river bank on this side, and the other on the river bank on that side.
text:
DAN 12:5
Thadou: Chuin, Daniel keiman kaven ahileh, michom mini tah vadung pang langkhat cheh’a, adinlhon kamun ahi.
English: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on the river bank on this side, and the other on the river bank on that side.

tcz: Amani lah’a miklhat chun, tupat ponnem kisil’a vadung twi chunga ana ding jingpa jah’a chun adong in, Hicheng thil kidang ho kichai nading chu, phat itih chan lut ding ham? ati.
en: One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these wonders?”
text:
DAN 12:6
Thadou: Amani lah’a miklhat chun, tupat ponnem kisil’a vadung twi chunga ana ding jingpa jah’a chun adong in, Hicheng thil kidang ho kichai nading chu, phat itih chan lut ding ham? ati.
English: One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these wonders?”

tcz: Hichun tupat ponnem kisil’a, vadung twi chunga ana ding jingpa chun, akhut tenin vanlam asangin, chuleh tonsot’a hing jing Pathen min’in, kihahselna aneiyin, aseiye. “Hiche hi kumkhat, kumni chuleh kumkeh khat, hungche nalai ding, chuleh mithengte ahung kithe cheh soh’a, achaina phat ahung lhin teng leh, thil hichengse hi guilhung soh ding ahi,’’ ati.
en: I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by him who lives forever that it will be for a time, times, and a half; and when they have finished breaking in pieces the power of the holy people, all these things will be finished.
text:
DAN 12:7
Thadou: Hichun tupat ponnem kisil’a, vadung twi chunga ana ding jingpa chun, akhut tenin vanlam asangin, chuleh tonsot’a hing jing Pathen min’in, kihahselna aneiyin, aseiye. “Hiche hi kumkhat, kumni chuleh kumkeh khat, hungche nalai ding, chuleh mithengte ahung kithe cheh soh’a, achaina phat ahung lhin teng leh, thil hichengse hi guilhung soh ding ahi,’’ ati.
English: I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by him who lives forever that it will be for a time, times, and a half; and when they have finished breaking in pieces the power of the holy people, all these things will be finished.

tcz: Keiman amapa thusei chu kajan, ahivangin ipi aseina ham, kahepoi. Hijeh chun, ken jong amapa chu ka dong in, “Kapu thil hicheng jouse hi, achaina ipi hung soh ding ham?” kati.
en: I heard, but I didn’t understand. Then I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
text:
DAN 12:8
Thadou: Keiman amapa thusei chu kajan, ahivangin ipi aseina ham, kahepoi. Hijeh chun, ken jong amapa chu ka dong in, “Kapu thil hicheng jouse hi, achaina ipi hung soh ding ham?” kati.
English: I heard, but I didn’t understand. Then I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”

tcz: Chuin aman kajah’a, Chetan Daniel, keiman nakom’a kaseisa bang chun, phat kichaina hunglhun kah’a dingin, khumkhana Mohor kinam khumsa chu, thuguhin koi tan.
en: He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.
text:
DAN 12:9
Thadou: Chuin aman kajah’a, Chetan Daniel, keiman nakom’a kaseisa bang chun, phat kichaina hunglhun kah’a dingin, khumkhana Mohor kinam khumsa chu, thuguhin koi tan.
English: He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.

tcz: Mi tamtah hiche patepna thohgimna-a kon’a, kisuthenguva, kisopthengdiu chuleh kithenso ding ahiuve. Amavang, migilouten assetnau boljom jing untin, imacha ahetkhen theilouhel diu ahi. Miching hon vang, ipi kisei ham ti, ahin hetdoh diu ahi.
en: Many will purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined, but the wicked will do wickedly; and none of the wicked will understand, but those who are wise will understand.
text:
DAN 12:10
Thadou: Mi tamtah hiche patepna thohgimna-a kon’a, kisuthenguva, kisopthengdiu chuleh kithenso ding ahiuve. Amavang, migilouten assetnau boljom jing untin, imacha ahetkhen theilouhel diu ahi. Miching hon vang, ipi kisei ham ti, ahin hetdoh diu ahi.
English: Many will purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined, but the wicked will do wickedly; and none of the wicked will understand, but those who are wise will understand.

tcz: Hitia chu, tanglouva ana kibol jing kilhaina pumgo thilto akisuhtang nia pat chuleh muntheng akisuh boh’a thet umtah misugam houna akitun doh niapat, nikho sangkhat leh jani toh somko lhing ding ahi.
en: “From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days.
text:
DAN 12:11
Thadou: Hitia chu, tanglouva ana kibol jing kilhaina pumgo thilto akisuhtang nia pat chuleh muntheng akisuh boh’a thet umtah misugam houna akitun doh niapat, nikho sangkhat leh jani toh somko lhing ding ahi.
English: “From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days.

tcz: Chuleh koi hijong leh, akhonna geija nikho sangkhat leh jathum toh somthum leh nga chan ngahdoh’a umho chu, anun nom ahiuve.
en: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.
text:
DAN 12:12
Thadou: Chuleh koi hijong leh, akhonna geija nikho sangkhat leh jathum toh somthum leh nga chan ngahdoh’a umho chu, anun nom ahiuve.
English: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.

tcz: Tun, nangma phat kichaina hunglhun kah’a din che tan, kichol inlang achaina nikho ahunglhun phatleh, nangma nakipatdoh kit’a, nang ding’a gotsa nadinmun ding chu nalo ding ahi,’’ati.
en: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”
text:
DAN 12:13
Thadou: Tun, nangma phat kichaina hunglhun kah’a din che tan, kichol inlang achaina nikho ahunglhun phatleh, nangma nakipatdoh kit’a, nang ding’a gotsa nadinmun ding chu nalo ding ahi,’’ati.
English: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”

tcz: Pakaiyin hiche thuhi Beeri chapa Hosea anapeh ahi. Hiche hi Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, chule Hezekiah ho Judah lenga anapanlaiyu chule Jehoash chapa Jeroboam Israelte lenga anapanlai ahi.
en: The LORD’s word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
text:
HOS 1:1
Thadou: Pakaiyin hiche thuhi Beeri chapa Hosea anapeh ahi. Hiche hi Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, chule Hezekiah ho Judah lenga anapanlaiyu chule Jehoash chapa Jeroboam Israelte lenga anapanlai ahi.
English: The LORD’s word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

tcz: Hiche hi amasatah-a Pakaiyin Israel mite koma Hosea anamanchaha thu anasei pat chu ahi. “Chenlang noti khat kichenpin, chutileh achate phabep khat noti cha-a hungkijil ding ahiuve. Hiche chun Israel chate Pakaija kona akiheimanguva, gamchom mite milim doi ahou-u chun noti chonna achonnao chu avetsah ahi.”
en: When the LORD spoke at first by Hosea, the LORD said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness; for the land commits great adultery, forsaking the LORD.”
text:
HOS 1:2
Thadou: Hiche hi amasatah-a Pakaiyin Israel mite koma Hosea anamanchaha thu anasei pat chu ahi. “Chenlang noti khat kichenpin, chutileh achate phabep khat noti cha-a hungkijil ding ahiuve. Hiche chun Israel chate Pakaija kona akiheimanguva, gamchom mite milim doi ahou-u chun noti chonna achonnao chu avetsah ahi.”
English: When the LORD spoke at first by Hosea, the LORD said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness; for the land commits great adultery, forsaking the LORD.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Hosea in Diblaim chanu Gomer akichenpin ahile, chuin ahung gaiyin Hosea dingin chapa khat ahinpeh in ahi.
en: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.
text:
HOS 1:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun Hosea in Diblaim chanu Gomer akichenpin ahile, chuin ahung gaiyin Hosea dingin chapa khat ahinpeh in ahi.
English: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.

tcz: Chule Pkaiyin aseiyin, amin “Jezreel nasah ding ahi, ati, ajeh chu keiman phat chomkhat jouleh Jezreel thisan kiso jeh'a Jehu lengpa alenggam talen kamat saha, Israel mite chamlhatna lenggam kasuhbei ding ahitai.
en: The LORD said to him, “Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.
text:
HOS 1:4
Thadou: Chule Pkaiyin aseiyin, amin “Jezreel nasah ding ahi, ati, ajeh chu keiman phat chomkhat jouleh Jezreel thisan kiso jeh'a Jehu lengpa alenggam talen kamat saha, Israel mite chamlhatna lenggam kasuhbei ding ahitai.
English: The LORD said to him, “Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.

tcz: Hiche niteng chuleh Jezreel phaichama Israel galhatna kasuhbei ding ahi.
en: It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”
text:
HOS 1:5
Thadou: Hiche niteng chuleh Jezreel phaichama Israel galhatna kasuhbei ding ahi.
English: It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”

tcz: Gangtah in Gomer in nao ahinvop kitin, chanu khat ahing kit in, chuin Pakaiyin Hosea jaha aseikitin, nachanu hi amin, “Dipdamna-bei, ‘Ngailutna–bei’ (Lo- ruhamah) - ajeh chu keiman Israel mite hi kangailut tah louhel ding ahitai ahiloule kangaidam lou ding ahitai, ati.
en: She conceived again, and bore a daughter. Then he said to him, “Call her name Lo-Ruhamah, for I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel, that I should in any way pardon them.
text:
HOS 1:6
Thadou: Gangtah in Gomer in nao ahinvop kitin, chanu khat ahing kit in, chuin Pakaiyin Hosea jaha aseikitin, nachanu hi amin, “Dipdamna-bei, ‘Ngailutna–bei’ (Lo- ruhamah) - ajeh chu keiman Israel mite hi kangailut tah louhel ding ahitai ahiloule kangaidam lou ding ahitai, ati.
English: She conceived again, and bore a daughter. Then he said to him, “Call her name Lo-Ruhamah, for I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel, that I should in any way pardon them.

tcz: Ahinla Judah mite chunga kangailutna kavetsah ding, Pakai Pathen thahatna jal'a kahuhdoh ding ahi, galhat mite galmanchah jeh, sakol le sakol kangtalai thahatna jeh hilouva Pakai Pathen thahatna jal'a kajosah ding bou ahi.”
en: But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, sword, battle, horses, or horsemen.”
text:
HOS 1:7
Thadou: Ahinla Judah mite chunga kangailutna kavetsah ding, Pakai Pathen thahatna jal'a kahuhdoh ding ahi, galhat mite galmanchah jeh, sakol le sakol kangtalai thahatna jeh hilouva Pakai Pathen thahatna jal'a kajosah ding bou ahi.”
English: But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, sword, battle, horses, or horsemen.”

tcz: Ngailutna beiyin anoichep aban phatin- Gomer in nao ahin vopkit in chapa ani channa ahing kittai.
en: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.
text:
HOS 1:8
Thadou: Ngailutna beiyin anoichep aban phatin- Gomer in nao ahin vopkit in chapa ani channa ahing kittai.
English: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.

tcz: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Amin chu-‘Kamite-hilou’ tin min sahin, ajeh chu Israel mite hi kamite ahitapouve, chule a Pathen-u jong kahitapoi,” ati.
en: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi, for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.
text:
HOS 1:9
Thadou: Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Amin chu-‘Kamite-hilou’ tin min sahin, ajeh chu Israel mite hi kamite ahitapouve, chule a Pathen-u jong kahitapoi,” ati.
English: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi, for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.

tcz: Hicheni teng chuleh, nasopipa chu Ami- ‘Kamite’ chule nasopinu chu-Rahamah- ‘Kangailut khat’ nati ding ahi.
en: “Say to your brothers, ‘My people!’ and to your sisters, ‘My loved one!’
text:
HOS 2:1
Thadou: Hicheni teng chuleh, nasopipa chu Ami- ‘Kamite’ chule nasopinu chu-Rahamah- ‘Kangailut khat’ nati ding ahi.
English: “Say to your brothers, ‘My people!’ and to your sisters, ‘My loved one!’

tcz: Nahingnu chu dondauvin, Dondauvin hitobang numei hi kaji ahipoi, keijong amadin aji kahipoi, ajon maiput hi kheldohhen, anoiteni kaha ajon na thangnam jong chu sutheng hen.
en: Contend with your mother! Contend, for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband; and let her put away her prostitution from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts;

tcz: Achuti louva ahile keiman avon jouse kahodoh’a akeoseh’a kaum sah ding ahi.
en: lest I strip her naked, and make her bare as in the day that she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and kill her with thirst.
text:
HOS 2:3
Thadou: Achuti louva ahile keiman avon jouse kahodoh’a akeoseh’a kaum sah ding ahi.
English: lest I strip her naked, and make her bare as in the day that she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and kill her with thirst.

tcz: Achate jouse jong kangailut louhel ding ahi, ajeh chu ahung kigil’uva kon’a notia hung kigil ahitauve
en: Indeed, on her children I will have no mercy, for they are children of unfaithfulness.
text:
HOS 2:4
Thadou: Achate jouse jong kangailut louhel ding ahi, ajeh chu ahung kigil’uva kon’a notia hung kigil ahitauve
English: Indeed, on her children I will have no mercy, for they are children of unfaithfulness.

tcz: Ahingnu-u jong jachatna neilouva notia kijoh ahin, anaovop’a jong chu jumle ja helouva chon ahi.
en: For their mother has played the prostitute. She who conceived them has done shamefully; for she said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.’
text:
HOS 2:5
Thadou: Ahingnu-u jong jachatna neilouva notia kijoh ahin, anaovop’a jong chu jumle ja helouva chon ahi.
English: For their mother has played the prostitute. She who conceived them has done shamefully; for she said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.’

tcz: Amanun aseijin, eingailu midang ho koma lhaitange, kanehding an, kadonding twi eipeho chule kasilding samul le tupat ponnem eipeho koma chetange ati.
en: Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her way.
text:
HOS 2:6
Thadou: Amanun aseijin, eingailu midang ho koma lhaitange, kanehding an, kadonding twi eipeho chule kasilding samul le tupat ponnem eipeho koma chetange ati.
English: Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her way.

tcz: Angailu ho kom’a lhai jongle, anungu aphah jou lou ding ahitai, amaho chu holle le jongle mujong amujou lou ding ahitai. Chule amanun jong asei ding, tun chengting kaji masapa henga kilekit tange, ajeh chu tulai kaumchan sangin chulaija kaumchan anomjoi.
en: She will follow after her lovers, but she won’t overtake them; and she will seek them, but won’t find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go and return to my first husband, for then it was better with me than now.’
text:
HOS 2:7
Thadou: Angailu ho kom’a lhai jongle, anungu aphah jou lou ding ahitai, amaho chu holle le jongle mujong amujou lou ding ahitai. Chule amanun jong asei ding, tun chengting kaji masapa henga kilekit tange, ajeh chu tulai kaumchan sangin chulaija kaumchan anomjoi.
English: She will follow after her lovers, but she won’t overtake them; and she will seek them, but won’t find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go and return to my first husband, for then it was better with me than now.’

tcz: Hiche numeinu hin kana thilpeh ho anei jouse, sana, dangka, lengpiwi thah, olive thao, kathilpeh ho jouse Baal doi apegam tan ahi.
en: For she didn’t know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied to her silver and gold, which they used for Baal.
text:
HOS 2:8
Thadou: Hiche numeinu hin kana thilpeh ho anei jouse, sana, dangka, lengpiwi thah, olive thao, kathilpeh ho jouse Baal doi apegam tan ahi.
English: For she didn’t know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied to her silver and gold, which they used for Baal.

tcz: Ahinlah kachang jong a atphat le kakilelah kit ding, lengpi twi thah jouse jong, kakilelah ding ahi. Asagoh keu hupna dinga kanapeh samul ponsil le tupat ponnem jong kanung lah kit ding ahi.
en: Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my new wine in its season, and will pluck away my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness.
text:
HOS 2:9
Thadou: Ahinlah kachang jong a atphat le kakilelah kit ding, lengpi twi thah jouse jong, kakilelah ding ahi. Asagoh keu hupna dinga kanapeh samul ponsil le tupat ponnem jong kanung lah kit ding ahi.
English: Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my new wine in its season, and will pluck away my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness.

tcz: Tua hi akideipi ho mitmu changtaha, ajamo kahodohpeh ding ahi, ahin kakhut’a kona koiman amanu hi eichulhah jou lou ding ahi.
en: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of my hand.
text:
HOS 2:10
Thadou: Tua hi akideipi ho mitmu changtaha, ajamo kahodohpeh ding ahi, ahin kakhut’a kona koiman amanu hi eichulhah jou lou ding ahi.
English: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of my hand.

tcz: Agolnop kut hihenlang, a lhathah kut hihenlang, akumlhun kut hijongleh kasuhbei ding ahi.
en: I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.
text:
HOS 2:11
Thadou: Agolnop kut hihenlang, a lhathah kut hihenlang, akumlhun kut hijongleh kasuhbei ding ahi.
English: I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.

tcz: Alengpi gui jouse kavohsetna, chule atheichang phung jouse jong kavoh heo ding ahi.
en: I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees, about which she has said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers have given me,’ and I will make them a forest, and the animals of the field shall eat them.
text:
HOS 2:12
Thadou: Alengpi gui jouse kavohsetna, chule atheichang phung jouse jong kavoh heo ding ahi.
English: I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees, about which she has said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers have given me,’ and I will make them a forest, and the animals of the field shall eat them.

tcz: Baal doi masanga gimnamtwi ahalna ho kasuhset peh’a chule a sana jempah chengsea akivonna, adongma akideipi hotoh kei suhmilna dinga akijepna jeh'a talen kapeh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en: I will visit on her the days of the Baals, to which she burned incense when she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and went after her lovers and forgot me,” says the LORD.
text:
HOS 2:13
Thadou: Baal doi masanga gimnamtwi ahalna ho kasuhset peh’a chule a sana jempah chengsea akivonna, adongma akideipi hotoh kei suhmilna dinga akijepna jeh'a talen kapeh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
English: I will visit on her the days of the Baals, to which she burned incense when she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and went after her lovers and forgot me,” says the LORD.

tcz: Ahin keiman hichenu hi kanung jollhah kitna, gamthip noiya kapui mang ding, chule awnem heuva kaki houlimpi ding ahi.
en: “Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.
text:
HOS 2:14
Thadou: Ahin keiman hichenu hi kanung jollhah kitna, gamthip noiya kapui mang ding, chule awnem heuva kaki houlimpi ding ahi.
English: “Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.

tcz: Alengpi leiya kahin lepui kitna, Achor phaicham jong kinepna kotpi phung kasosah ding, hikoma chu amanun jong anungah lai banga adonbutna, Egypt gam'a ahung potdoh til banga eidonbut ding ahi.
en: I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
text:
HOS 2:15
Thadou: Alengpi leiya kahin lepui kitna, Achor phaicham jong kinepna kotpi phung kasosah ding, hikoma chu amanun jong anungah lai banga adonbutna, Egypt gam'a ahung potdoh til banga eidonbut ding ahi.
English: I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

tcz: Hiche nikho chu ahunglhun nile Pakaiyin aseiye, Ka Pakai tilouva “Kajipa tia neikou ding ahi”.
en: It will be in that day,” says the LORD, “that you will call me ‘my husband,’ and no longer call me ‘my master.’
text:
HOS 2:16
Thadou: Hiche nikho chu ahunglhun nile Pakaiyin aseiye, Ka Pakai tilouva “Kajipa tia neikou ding ahi”.
English: It will be in that day,” says the LORD, “that you will call me ‘my husband,’ and no longer call me ‘my master.’

tcz: O Israel, namuha kona Baal min tamtah kasuh manga chule naminphah kittahlou ding ahi chule
en: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by name.
text:
HOS 2:17
Thadou: O Israel, namuha kona Baal min tamtah kasuh manga chule naminphah kittahlou ding ahi chule
English: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by name.

tcz: Hiche nikho chule gam'a gamsa jouse le chunga leng vacha jouse toh kitepna khat kasema, thalpi kasuh beija chemjam kalensah lou ding, chuteng nakichat tahlou dingu, cham le lungmonga naimut dingu ahi.
en: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the creeping things of the ground. I will break the bow, the sword, and the battle out of the land, and will make them lie down safely.
text:
HOS 2:18
Thadou: Hiche nikho chule gam'a gamsa jouse le chunga leng vacha jouse toh kitepna khat kasema, thalpi kasuh beija chemjam kalensah lou ding, chuteng nakichat tahlou dingu, cham le lungmonga naimut dingu ahi.
English: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the creeping things of the ground. I will break the bow, the sword, and the battle out of the land, and will make them lie down safely.

tcz: Keiman atonsot’a kajinua kasem ding nahitai, chutengle Chondihna le thutah kavetsah ding nahi.
en: I will betroth you to me forever. Yes, I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion.
text:
HOS 2:19
Thadou: Keiman atonsot’a kajinua kasem ding nahitai, chutengle Chondihna le thutah kavetsah ding nahi.
English: I will betroth you to me forever. Yes, I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion.

tcz: Hitia chu ken kitahna neitah-a jia kanei ding nahin, nangin jong Pakai chu nahetdoh ding ahiye.
en: I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know the LORD.
text:
HOS 2:20
Thadou: Hitia chu ken kitahna neitah-a jia kanei ding nahin, nangin jong Pakai chu nahetdoh ding ahiye.
English: I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know the LORD.

tcz: Hicheni chule, keiman nadonbut inge, Tin Pakaiyin aseiye. “Hiche nikho tengleh keiman van mun ho jouse kahouva thu kasei ding, amahon jong, van mun jousen jong leiset jaha gojuh puma thu asei diu ahi.
en: It will happen in that day, that I will respond,” says the LORD. “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth;

tcz: Chuteng leiset in jong awgin puma penga asapma adonbutna, chang, lengpitwi, chule olive thaovin jong adonbut ding, Jezeel jaha thu aseidiu ahi.
en: and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they will respond to Jezreel.
text:
HOS 2:22
Thadou: Chuteng leiset in jong awgin puma penga asapma adonbutna, chang, lengpitwi, chule olive thaovin jong adonbut ding, Jezeel jaha thu aseidiu ahi.
English: and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they will respond to Jezreel.

tcz: Hiche phatteng chule keiman Israel dinga muchi katu ding, keima dinga kakhansah ding. Keiman ‘kangailupoi’ katiho koma ngailutna kavetsah ding, chule kami nahitapouve tia kaseiho koma ‘tun nangho kamite nahitauve’ tia kasei ding ahi. Chule amahon eidonbutnuva, ‘Nangma ka Pathen-u nahi’ eitidiu ahi.
en: I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; and I will tell those who were not my people, ‘You are my people;’ and they will say, ‘You are My God!’”
text:
HOS 2:23
Thadou: Hiche phatteng chule keiman Israel dinga muchi katu ding, keima dinga kakhansah ding. Keiman ‘kangailupoi’ katiho koma ngailutna kavetsah ding, chule kami nahitapouve tia kaseiho koma ‘tun nangho kamite nahitauve’ tia kasei ding ahi. Chule amahon eidonbutnuva, ‘Nangma ka Pathen-u nahi’ eitidiu ahi.
English: I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; and I will tell those who were not my people, ‘You are my people;’ and they will say, ‘You are My God!’”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin kakoma aseiye, “Chenlang nainneipi ngailukittan, amanun michom dang toh jonthanhoina neijeng jongle ngailukitin. Hichun vetsah chu Israel mite pathen dang ho koma kiheimangu henlang, hou jongleu, Pathen in angailu jing nalaijuve.
en: The LORD said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as the LORD loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”
text:
HOS 3:1
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin kakoma aseiye, “Chenlang nainneipi ngailukittan, amanun michom dang toh jonthanhoina neijeng jongle ngailukitin. Hichun vetsah chu Israel mite pathen dang ho koma kiheimangu henlang, hou jongleu, Pathen in angailu jing nalaijuve.
English: The LORD said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as the LORD loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”

tcz: Keiman amanu chu dangka som le nga chule butun pocha nga a kakile choh kit ahitai.
en: So I bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley.
text:
HOS 3:2
Thadou: Keiman amanu chu dangka som le nga chule butun pocha nga a kakile choh kit ahitai.
English: So I bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley.

tcz: Chuin amanu koma kaseiyin, tuphat laihin, nangma midangtoh chule keima tohjong nakitimat hihlaiye.
en: I said to her, “You shall stay with me many days. You shall not play the prostitute, and you shall not be with any other man. I will also be so toward you.”
text:
HOS 3:3
Thadou: Chuin amanu koma kaseiyin, tuphat laihin, nangma midangtoh chule keima tohjong nakitimat hihlaiye.
English: I said to her, “You shall stay with me many days. You shall not play the prostitute, and you shall not be with any other man. I will also be so toward you.”

tcz: Hiche hin avetsah chu, Israel hi lengnu le lengpa neilouva chule gan kilhaina neilouva le thempu theng ahiloule milim doi jeng jong, phat sottah aneilou diu ahi.
en: For the children of Israel shall live many days without king, without prince, without sacrifice, without sacred stone, and without ephod or idols.
text:
HOS 3:4
Thadou: Hiche hin avetsah chu, Israel hi lengnu le lengpa neilouva chule gan kilhaina neilouva le thempu theng ahiloule milim doi jeng jong, phat sottah aneilou diu ahi.
English: For the children of Israel shall live many days without king, without prince, without sacrifice, without sacred stone, and without ephod or idols.

tcz: Ahin khonungleh, hung kilehei kitun tin, Pakai Pathen hengle alengpau David alhangaidiu; khonung teng leh, Pakai a Pathen’u phatna agin diu ahi.
en: Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the LORD their God, and David their king, and shall come with trembling to the LORD and to his blessings in the last days.
text:
HOS 3:5
Thadou: Ahin khonungleh, hung kilehei kitun tin, Pakai Pathen hengle alengpau David alhangaidiu; khonung teng leh, Pakai a Pathen’u phatna agin diu ahi.
English: Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the LORD their God, and David their king, and shall come with trembling to the LORD and to his blessings in the last days.

tcz: Pakai thusei ngaiyuvin, O Israel mite! Ajeh chu Pakaiyin gamsunga chengte toh kinelna khat aneiye. “Kitahna aumpoi, kikhotona jong aumpoi, nagamsunguva Pathen hetna jong aumpoi.
en: Hear the LORD’s word, you children of Israel, for the LORD has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.
text:
HOS 4:1
Thadou: Pakai thusei ngaiyuvin, O Israel mite! Ajeh chu Pakaiyin gamsunga chengte toh kinelna khat aneiye. “Kitahna aumpoi, kikhotona jong aumpoi, nagamsunguva Pathen hetna jong aumpoi.
English: Hear the LORD’s word, you children of Israel, for the LORD has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.

tcz: Kihahselna jeng alengin, jouthu jeng akiseiyin, na kithatun chule naguchauvin, jonthanhoi nabollun, muntin jousea nakisatun, khatle khat nakithat touvin ahi.
en: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.
text:
HOS 4:2
Thadou: Kihahselna jeng alengin, jouthu jeng akiseiyin, na kithatun chule naguchauvin, jonthanhoi nabollun, muntin jousea nakisatun, khatle khat nakithat touvin ahi.
English: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.

tcz: Hijeh chun nagamsungu hi mihem lunghem bangin alunghemtan, gamsunga cheng miho jong alunggimsoh tauve. Chule mijousen phat namoh mansahuvin, gamlaha gamsaho jeng jong alunghem sohtauvin, chunga leng vachate jengjong alunghem gamtauve. Twilaha nga ho jeng jong, aum gam tapouve.
en: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.
text:
HOS 4:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun nagamsungu hi mihem lunghem bangin alunghemtan, gamsunga cheng miho jong alunggimsoh tauve. Chule mijousen phat namoh mansahuvin, gamlaha gamsaho jeng jong alunghem sohtauvin, chunga leng vachate jengjong alunghem gamtauve. Twilaha nga ho jeng jong, aum gam tapouve.
English: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.

tcz: Koimacha nakhutjungin koh hihin, chule akiheh tojong koima umda jenghen! Ajeh chu keitoh kinelkal, nangjoh nahi, vo thempu.
en: “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.
text:
HOS 4:4
Thadou: Koimacha nakhutjungin koh hihin, chule akiheh tojong koima umda jenghen! Ajeh chu keitoh kinelkal, nangjoh nahi, vo thempu.
English: “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.

tcz: Hijeha chu sunlai changa jong nakipal lhuh ding, jan tengle themgao pa jong nakipal lhuh tha ding ahi.
en: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.
text:
HOS 4:5
Thadou: Hijeha chu sunlai changa jong nakipal lhuh ding, jan tengle themgao pa jong nakipal lhuh tha ding ahi.
English: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.

tcz: Thempu atam chenin, chonse kei douding atame.
en: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.
text:
HOS 4:7
Thadou: Thempu atam chenin, chonse kei douding atame.
English: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.

tcz: Miten chonset thilto ahin pohlut chanin, thempuho athaouve.
en: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.
text:
HOS 4:8
Thadou: Miten chonset thilto ahin pohlut chanin, thempuho athaouve.
English: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.

tcz: Chule thempun bolkhat aneile, mipiten jong abolluve.
en: It will be like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.
text:
HOS 4:9
Thadou: Chule thempun bolkhat aneile, mipiten jong abolluve.
English: It will be like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.

tcz: Amahon neuvintin, ahijeng vanga gilkel ding ahiuve. Notin panguvin tin hinlah pungthei lou ding ahiuve. Ajeh chu Pakai dalhan notia pang dingin, donlouvin akoitauve.
en: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned listening to the LORD.
text:
HOS 4:10
Thadou: Amahon neuvintin, ahijeng vanga gilkel ding ahiuve. Notin panguvin tin hinlah pungthei lou ding ahiuve. Ajeh chu Pakai dalhan notia pang dingin, donlouvin akoitauve.
English: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned listening to the LORD.

tcz: Ju jeng, juthah jeng adonuvin, jun kamite aguhmang ahitai.
en: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
text:
HOS 4:11
Thadou: Ju jeng, juthah jeng adonuvin, jun kamite aguhmang ahitai.
English: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.

tcz: Amahon thing khat pou adongun, molkang khattouvin akhonung thu-u aseipeh theiding atahsanun ahi. Milim doihou angaichat chun, angolsah-u ahitai. Amahon noti hi akichepnauvin, pathen dang ajenun ahi.
en: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.
text:
HOS 4:12
Thadou: Amahon thing khat pou adongun, molkang khattouvin akhonung thu-u aseipeh theiding atahsanun ahi. Milim doihou angaichat chun, angolsah-u ahitai. Amahon noti hi akichepnauvin, pathen dang ajenun ahi.
English: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.

tcz: Amahon molsangvumah, kilhainan gan athatuve. Amaho lhangvumah akaltouvun, gimnamtwi ahaluve.
en: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks, poplars, and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.
text:
HOS 4:13
Thadou: Amahon molsangvumah, kilhainan gan athatuve. Amaho lhangvumah akaltouvun, gimnamtwi ahaluve.
English: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks, poplars, and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.

tcz: Ahinlah ibola kagimbol dingham natia apanu leh ajon thanhoi jeh-a? O hetna lhasam mingol ho! thil hetkhanna nanotthap tauve. Namiten jong amaho bol bang bang abolluvin ahi.
en: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.
text:
HOS 4:14
Thadou: Ahinlah ibola kagimbol dingham natia apanu leh ajon thanhoi jeh-a? O hetna lhasam mingol ho! thil hetkhanna nanotthap tauve. Namiten jong amaho bol bang bang abolluvin ahi.
English: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.

tcz: Israel, nang notin pangjeng jongle chun, Juda vang themmo chansah loujenin. Gilgal khopia hunglut dan, Beth-aven a jong hung lutdan.
en: “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth Aven, nor swear, ‘As the LORD lives.’
text:
HOS 4:15
Thadou: Israel, nang notin pangjeng jongle chun, Juda vang themmo chansah loujenin. Gilgal khopia hunglut dan, Beth-aven a jong hung lutdan.
English: “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth Aven, nor swear, ‘As the LORD lives.’

tcz: Bongla gol louchal bangin Israel hi alou challe. Pakaiyin hamhing gam lentaha kelngoi avah banga, Israelte hi avah jing jeng ding hinam ong?
en: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will the LORD feed them like a lamb in a meadow?
text:
HOS 4:16
Thadou: Bongla gol louchal bangin Israel hi alou challe. Pakaiyin hamhing gam lentaha kelngoi avah banga, Israelte hi avah jing jeng ding hinam ong?
English: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will the LORD feed them like a lamb in a meadow?

tcz: Israel hi achangin dalhan, ajeh chu amahi jonthanhoi toh kicheng ahitai.
en: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!
text:
HOS 4:17
Thadou: Israel hi achangin dalhan, ajeh chu amahi jonthanhoi toh kicheng ahitai.
English: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!

tcz: Jukham hon khat chu noti ho toh alumkhomtauve. Aloupi diu sangin ajachat diu adeijouve.
en: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.
text:
HOS 4:18
Thadou: Jukham hon khat chu noti ho toh alumkhomtauve. Aloupi diu sangin ajachat diu adeijouve.
English: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.

tcz: Khoppi huijin alhaving tenin achun chah kheh in Maicham hijat asemthu jouse jeh'a hi kijumso diu ahi.
en: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
text:
HOS 4:19
Thadou: Khoppi huijin alhaving tenin achun chah kheh in Maicham hijat asemthu jouse jeh'a hi kijumso diu ahi.
English: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.

tcz: Hiche hi ngaiyin, nang thempuho. Lunglutin ngaiyin, nang Israelte lamkai. Nangho leng insung mite jousen jong ngaichehuvin. Ajeh chu nachunguva thutanna hi kingam sohkei ahitai. Nanghon Mizpah le Tabor khoa dingin kipalna thang nakamuve.
en: “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.
text:
HOS 5:1
Thadou: Hiche hi ngaiyin, nang thempuho. Lunglutin ngaiyin, nang Israelte lamkai. Nangho leng insung mite jousen jong ngaichehuvin. Ajeh chu nachunguva thutanna hi kingam sohkei ahitai. Nanghon Mizpah le Tabor khoa dingin kipalna thang nakamuve.
English: “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.

tcz: Kotong thuhtah in nachouvun thang nakampehuvin ahi. Ahinlah nathil bol hi kenjong kahin vetjing ahiye.
en: The rebels are deep in slaughter, but I discipline all of them.
text:
HOS 5:2
Thadou: Kotong thuhtah in nachouvun thang nakampehuvin ahi. Ahinlah nathil bol hi kenjong kahin vetjing ahiye.
English: The rebels are deep in slaughter, but I discipline all of them.

tcz: O Ephraim, keiman nang koitobang nahi kahenai. Nang keiya konin kisel theipon nate, O Israel, notinun ajipa adalhah bangin, kei neidalha tai, nangma thanghoitah-a kisubohdeh nahi ahitai.
en: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.
text:
HOS 5:3
Thadou: O Ephraim, keiman nang koitobang nahi kahenai. Nang keiya konin kisel theipon nate, O Israel, notinun ajipa adalhah bangin, kei neidalha tai, nangma thanghoitah-a kisubohdeh nahi ahitai.
English: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.

tcz: Nachon nauvin Pathen henga nakilesah thei tapouve. Ajeh chu nalahuva noti dinga lunggel jeng nagel jeh'un, Na Pathen-u umna lam nagel phatapouvin ahi.
en: Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God, for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know the LORD.
text:
HOS 5:4
Thadou: Nachon nauvin Pathen henga nakilesah thei tapouve. Ajeh chu nalahuva noti dinga lunggel jeng nagel jeh'un, Na Pathen-u umna lam nagel phatapouvin ahi.
English: Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God, for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know the LORD.

tcz: Israel chu akiletsahnan achunga aheh jingin, Ephraim chu aphatlouna-a kipal lhu ding ahin, Juda jong Israel le Ephraim toh kipal’a lhukhom tha ding ahi.
en: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.
text:
HOS 5:5
Thadou: Israel chu akiletsahnan achunga aheh jingin, Ephraim chu aphatlouna-a kipal lhu ding ahin, Juda jong Israel le Ephraim toh kipal’a lhukhom tha ding ahi.
English: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.

tcz: Akelngoi jouseu le abong jouseuvin pumgo thilto Pakaiya hungbol jongleu, amu loudiu ahitai, ajeh chu amahoa kona kikhin gamla ahitai.
en: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD, but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.
text:
HOS 5:6
Thadou: Akelngoi jouseu le abong jouseuvin pumgo thilto Pakaiya hungbol jongleu, amu loudiu ahitai, ajeh chu amahoa kona kikhin gamla ahitai.
English: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD, but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.

tcz: Amahon Pakai chu kitahna beiyin anabol tauvin, hibangtah in jatdng mitoh cha anahing tauvin ahi. Tua hi mi sumongpa chun ama ho jong aloumunu jong asuhmongtha ding ahi.
en: They are unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.
text:
HOS 5:7
Thadou: Amahon Pakai chu kitahna beiyin anabol tauvin, hibangtah in jatdng mitoh cha anahing tauvin ahi. Tua hi mi sumongpa chun ama ho jong aloumunu jong asuhmongtha ding ahi.
English: They are unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.

tcz: Gibeah khoa kelki mutuvinlang! Ramah khoa sumkon mutuvin, Beth-aven khoa galkonding in kiginna lhang samuvin. Vo Benjamin kiti hot hotin!
en: “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!
text:
HOS 5:8
Thadou: Gibeah khoa kelki mutuvinlang! Ramah khoa sumkon mutuvin, Beth-aven khoa galkonding in kiginna lhang samuvin. Vo Benjamin kiti hot hotin!
English: “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!

tcz: Ephraim dinga talen kapeh nikho leh ahomkeuva kijam ding, Israel phung laha thonlou hella kaphondoh ding ahi.
en: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.
text:
HOS 5:9
Thadou: Ephraim dinga talen kapeh nikho leh ahomkeuva kijam ding, Israel phung laha thonlou hella kaphondoh ding ahi.
English: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.

tcz: Juda gam'a milen milalho jong gucha bangdiu, achunguva kalunghanna twilhabom bang ding ahi.
en: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.
text:
HOS 5:10
Thadou: Juda gam'a milen milalho jong gucha bangdiu, achunguva kalunghanna twilhabom bang ding ahi.
English: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.

tcz: Ephraim hin thu adiha katan jeng jong asunoh phahtai. Ajeh chu amahi pannabeiya kipedoh-a vahthaile ahitai.
en: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.
text:
HOS 5:11
Thadou: Ephraim hin thu adiha katan jeng jong asunoh phahtai. Ajeh chu amahi pannabeiya kipedoh-a vahthaile ahitai.
English: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.

tcz: Hijeh a chu keijong Ephraim dinga nget tobanga kahi ding, Juda insung dinga jong agotlhahsah-a pang ding kahi.
en: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.
text:
HOS 5:12
Thadou: Hijeh a chu keijong Ephraim dinga nget tobanga kahi ding, Juda insung dinga jong agotlhahsah-a pang ding kahi.
English: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.

tcz: Ephraim chu adammona akimu doh phat in, Judah chun amaha akimudoh phatin, Ephraim chu Assyria gam'a achen lenglenpa henga mi asole. Ahinlah aman hom naboldam theilou ding, amaha jong asuhdam thei lou ding ahi.
en: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to King Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.
text:
HOS 5:13
Thadou: Ephraim chu adammona akimu doh phat in, Judah chun amaha akimudoh phatin, Ephraim chu Assyria gam'a achen lenglenpa henga mi asole. Ahinlah aman hom naboldam theilou ding, amaha jong asuhdam thei lou ding ahi.
English: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to King Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.

tcz: Keima Ephraim dinga keipi kabah ding, Judah dinga keipi golpai hattah kabah ding ahi. Kei mong mong in kabotel jengjung ding ahi. Keiman kalhoh manga koiman eichulhah jou lou ding ahi.
en: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.
text:
HOS 5:14
Thadou: Keima Ephraim dinga keipi kabah ding, Judah dinga keipi golpai hattah kabah ding ahi. Kei mong mong in kabotel jengjung ding ahi. Keiman kalhoh manga koiman eichulhah jou lou ding ahi.
English: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.

tcz: Chuteng kagam langa kakile kit ding, Amahon athemmonau akihet dohuva, keima angsung ahinhol kit kahseu, kachenna muna kache ding, agenthei behseh tengule eihin holdiu ahi.
en: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”
text:
HOS 5:15
Thadou: Chuteng kagam langa kakile kit ding, Amahon athemmonau akihet dohuva, keima angsung ahinhol kit kahseu, kachenna muna kache ding, agenthei behseh tengule eihin holdiu ahi.
English: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”

tcz: Hungun, Pakai henga kilekit tauhite. Aman ahal hallin eimal teldeh jongleu, tua hi ei-damsah kitdiu ahitai. Aman eimavou ahitan, tua hi imaha hou eitompeh dingu ahitai.
en: “Come! Let’s return to the LORD; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.
text:
HOS 6:1
Thadou: Hungun, Pakai henga kilekit tauhite. Aman ahal hallin eimal teldeh jongleu, tua hi ei-damsah kitdiu ahitai. Aman eimavou ahitan, tua hi imaha hou eitompeh dingu ahitai.
English: “Come! Let’s return to the LORD; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.

tcz: Chomlou kahin ei-kiledohsah kituvin tin, chuteng eiho ama umna-a iumdiu ahi.
en: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.
text:
HOS 6:2
Thadou: Chomlou kahin ei-kiledohsah kituvin tin, chuteng eiho ama umna-a iumdiu ahi.
English: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.

tcz: Chuteng eihon Pakai ihetdiu ahitai! Kihetthemu hitin, Pakai chu hettei tei ding gouhite. Ahung kumlhah ding teng eihetsah tei nauvinte. Ahiloule leiset chapkotna pangji khalgo banga hung Lenglha jeng ding ahi, tia asei dingu ahi.”
en: Let’s acknowledge the LORD. Let’s press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, the LORD will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”
text:
HOS 6:3
Thadou: Chuteng eihon Pakai ihetdiu ahitai! Kihetthemu hitin, Pakai chu hettei tei ding gouhite. Ahung kumlhah ding teng eihetsah tei nauvinte. Ahiloule leiset chapkotna pangji khalgo banga hung Lenglha jeng ding ahi, tia asei dingu ahi.”
English: Let’s acknowledge the LORD. Let’s press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, the LORD will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”

tcz: “O Israel le Juda, Ipi kabolpeh ding nahim?” tin Pakaiyin adonge. “Nangin nei ngailut nahi jingkah meibol bep ahin, nisan asahgot loi jeng daitwi bep ahibouve.
en: “Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that disappears early.
text:
HOS 6:4
Thadou: “O Israel le Juda, Ipi kabolpeh ding nahim?” tin Pakaiyin adonge. “Nangin nei ngailut nahi jingkah meibol bep ahin, nisan asahgot loi jeng daitwi bep ahibouve.
English: “Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that disappears early.

tcz: Ka themgao ho nasatan tan din kasolin, Kakamsung thuseiya kona thatgam din kasol’e. Kathutan khovah banga kikhodoh tothon kasol’e.
en: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.
text:
HOS 6:5
Thadou: Ka themgao ho nasatan tan din kasolin, Kakamsung thuseiya kona thatgam din kasol’e. Kathutan khovah banga kikhodoh tothon kasol’e.
English: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.

tcz: Keiman kithoina sangin nei ngailutdiu kadeijon, Pumgo thito sanga, Keima neihetdiu kadeijon ahi.
en: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
text:
HOS 6:6
