Thadou: Hiche khopi hin kisuhdihna him him adoudal in, koima thudih sei ging aum poi. Amahon Pakai chu atahsan pouvin chuleh ama Pathen’u kom jong anaideh pouve.
English: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in the LORD. She didn’t draw near to her God.

tcz: Khopi sung vaipo’a pangho chu, Sakei bahkai bangin kitumlet lutin, aneh ding bou akihol’un. A Thutan vaihom ho jong, kamkei hon, gilkei keija nilhah ngah’a, jan muthim lah’a nehding kihol’a, jingkah teng neh moh ima khenlouva umho tobang ahiuve.
en: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
text:
ZEP 3:3
Thadou: Khopi sung vaipo’a pangho chu, Sakei bahkai bangin kitumlet lutin, aneh ding bou akihol’un. A Thutan vaihom ho jong, kamkei hon, gilkei keija nilhah ngah’a, jan muthim lah’a nehding kihol’a, jingkah teng neh moh ima khenlouva umho tobang ahiuve.
English: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.

tcz: A themgao ho jong , jouleh nal’a ama phatchomna ding kihol ngen ahiuve. Chuleh Thempua pangho jong , Pathen thupeh nitlouvin, Hou-in sung asuboh gam tauvin ahi.
en: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.
text:
ZEP 3:4
Thadou: A themgao ho jong , jouleh nal’a ama phatchomna ding kihol ngen ahiuve. Chuleh Thempua pangho jong , Pathen thupeh nitlouvin, Hou-in sung asuboh gam tauvin ahi.
English: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.

tcz: Ahivang in, Pakaiyin khopi sung adalha pon, aumpi jing in, chuleh amaho din ima setna abolpoi. Aniseh in, aman thudih chu aphongdoh jing in, chuleh aman ima bolkhel anei poi. Amavang, thudih louva chonpa chem jum le ja lam ahepoi.
en: The LORD, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.
text:
ZEP 3:5
Thadou: Ahivang in, Pakaiyin khopi sung adalha pon, aumpi jing in, chuleh amaho din ima setna abolpoi. Aniseh in, aman thudih chu aphongdoh jing in, chuleh aman ima bolkhel anei poi. Amavang, thudih louva chonpa chem jum le ja lam ahepoi.
English: The LORD, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.

tcz: “Keiman nampi vaipi katheh ngim in, akisel nau kulpi bang le in ho jon ahomkeuvin kakoi tai, kholai dung ajong koima avahle aumpon, athip gamtai. Ajeh chu ahing doh amoh khat jong umlou ahitauve.
en: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.
text:
ZEP 3:6
Thadou: “Keiman nampi vaipi katheh ngim in, akisel nau kulpi bang le in ho jon ahomkeuvin kakoi tai, kholai dung ajong koima avahle aumpon, athip gamtai. Ajeh chu ahing doh amoh khat jong umlou ahitauve.
English: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.

tcz: Keiman kagel chu, tunvang hiche te hin eijabol intin, eiging tauvinte, kati. Ka hilchehna ho jong sang tei tauvinte, kati.Chu teng keiman achung'uva jepna pehkit dang’e, chuleh achennau inho jong kisuhmang kit dahen, kati. Ahivangin, amaho jingpitah In athouvun, abolngaiju setna jeng abolun, akhoh cheh cheh jingin ahi.”
en: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.
text:
ZEP 3:7
Thadou: Keiman kagel chu, tunvang hiche te hin eijabol intin, eiging tauvinte, kati. Ka hilchehna ho jong sang tei tauvinte, kati.Chu teng keiman achung'uva jepna pehkit dang’e, chuleh achennau inho jong kisuhmang kit dahen, kati. Ahivangin, amaho jingpitah In athouvun, abolngaiju setna jeng abolun, akhoh cheh cheh jingin ahi.”
English: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.

tcz: Pakaiyin aseiye,” Hijeh chun khongai jin, ngahhat in, keiman hiche namtin vaipi gitlou bolte hohi, keima kadin’a, themmo kachan sah ding ahi. Ajeh chu leiset chunga lenggam ho kasuhkhom ding, achung'uva ka lunghanna khosetah meikong tobang chu kabuh khum ding ahiuve. Hiche ka lunghanna meikong chun leiset pumpi ahalvam ding ahi.
en: “Therefore wait for me”, says the LORD, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
text:
ZEP 3:8
Thadou: Pakaiyin aseiye,” Hijeh chun khongai jin, ngahhat in, keiman hiche namtin vaipi gitlou bolte hohi, keima kadin’a, themmo kachan sah ding ahi. Ajeh chu leiset chunga lenggam ho kasuhkhom ding, achung'uva ka lunghanna khosetah meikong tobang chu kabuh khum ding ahiuve. Hiche ka lunghanna meikong chun leiset pumpi ahalvam ding ahi.
English: “Therefore wait for me”, says the LORD, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

tcz: Chuteng leh keiman namtin vaipi kamcheng ka sutheng’n kakhel peh ding, chute leh mitin in lung kitoh’a Pakai ahou cheh ding ahi.
en: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on the LORD’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.
text:
ZEP 3:9
Thadou: Chuteng leh keiman namtin vaipi kamcheng ka sutheng’n kakhel peh ding, chute leh mitin in lung kitoh’a Pakai ahou cheh ding ahi.
English: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on the LORD’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

tcz: Chuteng leh, Ethiopia vadung gal‘a umho, chehsa kamiten jong, thilto ahin choi uva apeh dingu ahi.
en: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.
text:
ZEP 3:10
Thadou: Chuteng leh, Ethiopia vadung gal‘a umho, chehsa kamiten jong, thilto ahin choi uva apeh dingu ahi.
English: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh, nangman jum le ja nathuh tah lou ding, ajeh chu keima douva napantah lou ding ahi. Keiman nalah uva kon’a mi kiletsah ho chuleh ama kichoisang ho ka paidoh ding ahi. Chuteng kalhang theng’a chu kiletsah hoithona um talou ding ahi.
en: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.
text:
ZEP 3:11
Thadou: Hiche nikho chuleh, nangman jum le ja nathuh tah lou ding, ajeh chu keima douva napantah lou ding ahi. Keiman nalah uva kon’a mi kiletsah ho chuleh ama kichoisang ho ka paidoh ding ahi. Chuteng kalhang theng’a chu kiletsah hoithona um talou ding ahi.
English: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.

tcz: Ahingdoh amoh chengse, amaho chu, abon’a mi lungneng leh mi kinem sah ho jeng ahitauve. Ajeh chu amaho chu Pakai min’a taojing ho ahiuve.
en: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the LORD’s name.
text:
ZEP 3:12
Thadou: Ahingdoh amoh chengse, amaho chu, abon’a mi lungneng leh mi kinem sah ho jeng ahitauve. Ajeh chu amaho chu Pakai min’a taojing ho ahiuve.
English: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the LORD’s name.

tcz: Akidalha Israel amoh chengsen, adihlou abolkit tahlou ding’u, jou leh nal’a jong khat le khat kilhem talou ding ahiuve. Ajeh chu, amaho chu, koiman akichatsah tah lou dingu chuleh lungmong’a, nomsel’a aneh uva chuleh kichol diu ahitai.
en: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”
text:
ZEP 3:13
Thadou: Akidalha Israel amoh chengsen, adihlou abolkit tahlou ding’u, jou leh nal’a jong khat le khat kilhem talou ding ahiuve. Ajeh chu, amaho chu, koiman akichatsah tah lou dingu chuleh lungmong’a, nomsel’a aneh uva chuleh kichol diu ahitai.
English: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”

tcz: Vo, Zion chanu, O thongin la sauvin; Vo Israel kholhang sam in! Nalungthim pumpin kipah le thanom in um'in, Vo Jerusalem chanu!
en: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
text:
ZEP 3:14
Thadou: Vo, Zion chanu, O thongin la sauvin; Vo Israel kholhang sam in! Nalungthim pumpin kipah le thanom in um'in, Vo Jerusalem chanu!
English: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin akhut’a na chungthu atan ding chu alamang tan, chuleh na melma te jouse jong anomang soh tai. Pakai amatah Israel leng ahin, nalah uva aching jing e. Nangman navel’a thilse nagin kit tahlou ding chuleh na gentheina jouse beisoh ding ahitai.
en: The LORD has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.
text:
ZEP 3:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin akhut’a na chungthu atan ding chu alamang tan, chuleh na melma te jouse jong anomang soh tai. Pakai amatah Israel leng ahin, nalah uva aching jing e. Nangman navel’a thilse nagin kit tahlou ding chuleh na gentheina jouse beisoh ding ahitai.
English: The LORD has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh, Jerusalem kiseipeh ding cu, “Vo, Zion, kipah thanom in, kicha hih in, natha jong lhahsam sah hih in!
en: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”
text:
ZEP 3:16
Thadou: Hiche nikho chuleh, Jerusalem kiseipeh ding cu, “Vo, Zion, kipah thanom in, kicha hih in, natha jong lhahsam sah hih in!
English: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”

tcz: Ajeh chu, na lailung uva Pakai na Pathen chu aching jing in, ama chu thaneitah huhingpu ahi. Aman thanom tah’a nakipapi ding, ami lungsetna chun na lungmon sah ding, nang dinga kipah thanom’a chuleh kipa la asah ding ahi.
en: The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
text:
ZEP 3:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu, na lailung uva Pakai na Pathen chu aching jing in, ama chu thaneitah huhingpu ahi. Aman thanom tah’a nakipapi ding, ami lungsetna chun na lungmon sah ding, nang dinga kipah thanom’a chuleh kipa la asah ding ahi.
English: The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

tcz: “Keiman nangho, kut nikho’a lunghem leh lhasa umho jouse, kakhop khom soh ding, chuleh nangho avel’a koiman nabolset kit tahlou dingu ahi.
en: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.
text:
ZEP 3:18
Thadou: “Keiman nangho, kut nikho’a lunghem leh lhasa umho jouse, kakhop khom soh ding, chuleh nangho avel’a koiman nabolset kit tahlou dingu ahi.
English: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.

tcz: Chuleh keiman nangho bol genthei ja pangho chu nasatah’a ka bolgim ding ahi. Keiman alhasam holeh bel ding neilou ho jouse kahuh doh ding, chuleh muntin’a ana kidel magho, keiman kahin puikhom ding ahi. Keiman amaho chu, loupina leh minthana akpeh ding, amaho dinga ajumnao leh ajachat nau jouse chu kilamang ding ahi.
en: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.
text:
ZEP 3:19
Thadou: Chuleh keiman nangho bol genthei ja pangho chu nasatah’a ka bolgim ding ahi. Keiman alhasam holeh bel ding neilou ho jouse kahuh doh ding, chuleh muntin’a ana kidel magho, keiman kahin puikhom ding ahi. Keiman amaho chu, loupina leh minthana akpeh ding, amaho dinga ajumnao leh ajachat nau jouse chu kilamang ding ahi.
English: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.

tcz: Hiche nikho chuleh, keiman nangho jouse ka khopkhom ding, inlam’a ka puilut kitding nahiuve. Keiman nangho, leiset chung namtin vaipi lah’a, minphatna leh minthanna kapeh ding, chuleh amitmu cheng uva Hamphatna kapeh ding nahiuve. Hiche hi, keima Pakai Pathen in ka seidoh ahitai.
en: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the LORD.
text:
ZEP 3:20
Thadou: Hiche nikho chuleh, keiman nangho jouse ka khopkhom ding, inlam’a ka puilut kitding nahiuve. Keiman nangho, leiset chung namtin vaipi lah’a, minphatna leh minthanna kapeh ding, chuleh amitmu cheng uva Hamphatna kapeh ding nahiuve. Hiche hi, keima Pakai Pathen in ka seidoh ahitai.
English: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the LORD.

tcz: Darius lengvaipoh kal kum ni lhinna, Lhajing nisim som ni le ko nin, Judah gamvaipo Shealtiel chapa Zerubabel le thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua henga Pakai in Haggai a konin thu ahinseiye.
en: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,
text:
HAG 1:1
Thadou: Darius lengvaipoh kal kum ni lhinna, Lhajing nisim som ni le ko nin, Judah gamvaipo Shealtiel chapa Zerubabel le thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua henga Pakai in Haggai a konin thu ahinseiye.
English: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

tcz: “Van Pakai chun hitin aseiye: Hiche miten, ‘Pakai hou in sahphatna ding avatna laiye atiuve.’”
en: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for the LORD’s house to be built.’”
text:
HAG 1:2
Thadou: “Van Pakai chun hitin aseiye: Hiche miten, ‘Pakai hou in sahphatna ding avatna laiye atiuve.’”
English: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for the LORD’s house to be built.’”

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai in Haggai themgao kamin ahin seiye:
en: Then the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
text:
HAG 1:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakai in Haggai themgao kamin ahin seiye:
English: Then the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

tcz: “I-atileh ka in asesa kijam’a nang ho in nomtah taha chen nahiuvem?
en: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?
text:
HAG 1:4
Thadou: “I-atileh ka in asesa kijam’a nang ho in nomtah taha chen nahiuvem?
English: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?

tcz: Hiche hi Van Pakai sei ahi: Ipiti nahiu ham phaten kiveuvin!
en: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.
text:
HAG 1:5
Thadou: Hiche hi Van Pakai sei ahi: Ipiti nahiu ham phaten kiveuvin!
English: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

tcz: Muchi tamtah natudoh naovin, ahinlah lhomcha bou nakiat doh uve. An nane naovin, ahinlah navaset thei pouve. Twi nadon naovin, ahinlah na dangchah-u achimdeh poi. Von na kivon naovin, ahinlah lum nasah jou pouve. Na tohman jouseu jong akoina sumdip avangsa bangin amang pai ji'e!
en: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’
text:
HAG 1:6
Thadou: Muchi tamtah natudoh naovin, ahinlah lhomcha bou nakiat doh uve. An nane naovin, ahinlah navaset thei pouve. Twi nadon naovin, ahinlah na dangchah-u achimdeh poi. Von na kivon naovin, ahinlah lum nasah jou pouve. Na tohman jouseu jong akoina sumdip avangsa bangin amang pai ji'e!
English: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’

tcz: Van Pakai chun hitin aseiye: Ipiti nahiu ham phaten kiveuvin!
en: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.
text:
HAG 1:7
Thadou: Van Pakai chun hitin aseiye: Ipiti nahiu ham phaten kiveuvin!
English: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

tcz: Tun thinglhang langa kal’uvin, thing gasuivin lang, ka in sa phauvin. Chutileh keima kalung lhaiding chule kaloupi thei ding ahi, tin Pakai in aseiye.
en: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says the LORD.
text:
HAG 1:8
Thadou: Tun thinglhang langa kal’uvin, thing gasuivin lang, ka in sa phauvin. Chutileh keima kalung lhaiding chule kaloupi thei ding ahi, tin Pakai in aseiye.
English: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says the LORD.

tcz: Tohga tampi nakineppi uve, ahinlah na vaicha cheh jouve. Chule na tohga’u in nahin pohlut tengu, ka sem mangpeh jitaove. Ipijha ham? Ajeh chu ka in ase san akijamin, ahinlah nang ho amitaki’in ama in nomtah tah kisahnan naki salel uve, tin Van Pakai sepai chun aseiye.
en: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says the LORD of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.
text:
HAG 1:9
Thadou: Tohga tampi nakineppi uve, ahinlah na vaicha cheh jouve. Chule na tohga’u in nahin pohlut tengu, ka sem mangpeh jitaove. Ipijha ham? Ajeh chu ka in ase san akijamin, ahinlah nang ho amitaki’in ama in nomtah tah kisahnan naki salel uve, tin Van Pakai sepai chun aseiye.
English: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says the LORD of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.

tcz: Nang ho jeh'a van mun jousen gotwi daitwi atuhkih’a, chule leiset in jong ga asemdoh lou ahi.
en: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.
text:
HAG 1:10
Thadou: Nang ho jeh'a van mun jousen gotwi daitwi atuhkih’a, chule leiset in jong ga asemdoh lou ahi.
English: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.

tcz: Na louma dung jouse le na thinglhang jouseuva nichang kasat sahding – hiche nichang sat chun chang jouse agotsah ding, lengpi phung jouse jong, olive phung jouse jong, chule muchi chivo dang jouse jong agotlhah sah soh ding, hichun nang le na gancha jong kel natohsah diu, chule na tohga jouseu jong aboncha asuhset soh kei ding ahi.”
en: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”
text:
HAG 1:11
Thadou: Na louma dung jouse le na thinglhang jouseuva nichang kasat sahding – hiche nichang sat chun chang jouse agotsah ding, lengpi phung jouse jong, olive phung jouse jong, chule muchi chivo dang jouse jong agotlhah sah soh ding, hichun nang le na gancha jong kel natohsah diu, chule na tohga jouseu jong aboncha asuhset soh kei ding ahi.”
English: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”

tcz: Chuin Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel le thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua chuleh ahingdoh Pathen mite amoh chengin Pakai a Pathen’u thusei anit tauvin ahi. Pakai a Pathenun ahinsol Haggai themgao thusei ajah doh-u chun mipin Pakai aging cheh taove.
en: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the LORD their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him; and the people feared the LORD.
text:
HAG 1:12
Thadou: Chuin Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel le thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua chuleh ahingdoh Pathen mite amoh chengin Pakai a Pathen’u thusei anit tauvin ahi. Pakai a Pathenun ahinsol Haggai themgao thusei ajah doh-u chun mipin Pakai aging cheh taove.
English: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the LORD their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him; and the people feared the LORD.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai thangkouva pang Haggai chun mipi jaha Pakai thupeh chu hitin: “Keiman ka umpi jing nauve, tin Pakai in aseiye,” atin ahi.
en: Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, spoke the LORD’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says the LORD.
text:
HAG 1:13
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakai thangkouva pang Haggai chun mipi jaha Pakai thupeh chu hitin: “Keiman ka umpi jing nauve, tin Pakai in aseiye,” atin ahi.
English: Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, spoke the LORD’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says the LORD.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakai in Judah gamvaipo Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel lungthim ahin, thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua lunghtim ahin, chuleh Pathen mite ahingdoh amoh chengse lunghtim atildoh in ahi. Hiti chun van Pakai, a Pathenu hou in chu asapan taovin ahi.
en: The LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the LORD of Armies, their God,
text:
HAG 1:14
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakai in Judah gamvaipo Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel lungthim ahin, thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua lunghtim ahin, chuleh Pathen mite ahingdoh amoh chengse lunghtim atildoh in ahi. Hiti chun van Pakai, a Pathenu hou in chu asapan taovin ahi.
English: The LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the LORD of Armies, their God,

tcz: Darius lengvaipoh kal kumni lhinna, lhalam som ni le khat nia atohpat’u ahi.
en: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
text:
HAG 1:15
Thadou: Darius lengvaipoh kal kumni lhinna, lhalam som ni le khat nia atohpat’u ahi.
English: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

tcz: Chuin chuche kum leh chuche lha ma ma nisim somni le sagi nin Pakai in themgao Haggai koma thu ahin seikit tai.
en: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
text:
HAG 2:1
Thadou: Chuin chuche kum leh chuche lha ma ma nisim somni le sagi nin Pakai in themgao Haggai koma thu ahin seikit tai.
English: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

tcz: “Judah gamvaipo Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel ahin, thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua ahin, chuleh Pathen mite ahingdoh amoh cheng henga hitin seiyin:
en: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
text:
HAG 2:2
Thadou: “Judah gamvaipo Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel ahin, thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua ahin, chuleh Pathen mite ahingdoh amoh cheng henga hitin seiyin:
English: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

tcz: ‘Koipen ham hiche in hejing nalaiya? – hiche houin – masanga aloupina leh ahoina he nalai? Hiche toh chun tedinga tua hi i-toh nabah sah uvem? Imacha hiloubeh toh abang jeng tai!
en: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?
text:
HAG 2:3
Thadou: ‘Koipen ham hiche in hejing nalaiya? – hiche houin – masanga aloupina leh ahoina he nalai? Hiche toh chun tedinga tua hi i-toh nabah sah uvem? Imacha hiloubeh toh abang jeng tai!
English: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?

tcz: Ahin tun Pakai in aseiye: Zerubbabel hat’in. Thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua hat’in. Gamsunga umcheng mipi teho nang ho jong hat’uvin. Chuleh tun kipat-un, tong pan’un, ajeh chu keiman ka umpi naove tin Pakai Van Sepai chun aseiye.
en: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the LORD. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the LORD, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says the LORD of Armies.
text:
HAG 2:4
Thadou: Ahin tun Pakai in aseiye: Zerubbabel hat’in. Thempu chungnung Jehozadak chapa Jeshua hat’in. Gamsunga umcheng mipi teho nang ho jong hat’uvin. Chuleh tun kipat-un, tong pan’un, ajeh chu keiman ka umpi naove tin Pakai Van Sepai chun aseiye.
English: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the LORD. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the LORD, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says the LORD of Armies.

tcz: Egypt nahin dalhah uva, kakitepna bang bangin, kalhagao nalah uva, aum jing nai. Hijeh chun kichah hih hel’un.”
en: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’
text:
HAG 2:5
Thadou: Egypt nahin dalhah uva, kakitepna bang bangin, kalhagao nalah uva, aum jing nai. Hijeh chun kichah hih hel’un.”
English: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’

tcz: Ijeh-inem itihleh Pakai Van Sepai chun hitin aseiye: Chomkhat jouleh van le leiset kaholing kit ding, twikhanglen leh gam go lai jouse jong ka holing ding ahi.
en: For this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;

tcz: Namtin vaipi kaholing ding ahi, chuleh athil khol jouseu hiche houin sunga hung kilhut soh ding, Loupi taha kadip soh hel ding ahi, tin Pakai Van Sepai chun aseiyin ahi.
en: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Armies.
text:
HAG 2:7
Thadou: Namtin vaipi kaholing ding ahi, chuleh athil khol jouseu hiche houin sunga hung kilhut soh ding, Loupi taha kadip soh hel ding ahi, tin Pakai Van Sepai chun aseiyin ahi.
English: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Armies.

tcz: Sana jong keiya ahin, dangka jong keiya ahi tin Pakai Van Sepai chun aseiye.
en: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says the LORD of Armies.
text:
HAG 2:8
Thadou: Sana jong keiya ahin, dangka jong keiya ahi tin Pakai Van Sepai chun aseiye.
English: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says the LORD of Armies.

tcz: Masanga aloupina sanga hiche houin hi hung loupi jo cheh ding ahi, tin Pakai Van Sepai chun seiyin ahi.
en: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.”
text:
HAG 2:9
Thadou: Masanga aloupina sanga hiche houin hi hung loupi jo cheh ding ahi, tin Pakai Van Sepai chun seiyin ahi.
English: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.”

tcz: Darius lengvaipoh kal kumni lhin kum, Ollha nisim som le get nin Pakai in themgao Haggai henga thu ahin seiye:
en: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
text:
HAG 2:10
Thadou: Darius lengvaipoh kal kumni lhin kum, Ollha nisim som le get nin Pakai in themgao Haggai henga thu ahin seiye:
English: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

tcz: “Hiche hi Pakai van sepai chun asei ahi. Hiche dan thupeh chung changa thudoh ho chu thempu ho dongin:
en: “The LORD of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
text:
HAG 2:11
Thadou: “Hiche hi Pakai van sepai chun asei ahi. Hiche dan thupeh chung changa thudoh ho chu thempu ho dongin:
English: “The LORD of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

en: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’”

English: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’”

tcz: “Hichu ahung lhung teng, ka lhacha Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel, jabolna kapeh ding nahi, tin Pakai Van Sepai chun aseiye. Keiman mohor kisemna khutjem banga kasem ding nahi, ajeh chu kalhendohsa nahi tai, tin Pakai Van Sepai chun aseiye. Pakai Van Sepai, Keiman tahin kasei ahi!” ati.
en: In that day, says the LORD of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says the LORD, ‘and will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ says the LORD of Armies.”

tcz: Napu napateo bangin chonhih’un, amaho jaha chu themgao hon lhang asap piuve, thaneipen Pakaiyin aseijin ase lamma nachon nauva kon leh thilse na bolnauva kon in hungkile kit’uvintin aseije. Ahivangin amahon angai pouvin khohsah injong anei pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
en: Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: The LORD of Armies says, ‘Return now from your evil ways and from your evil doings;’ but they didn’t hear nor listen to me, says the LORD.

en: But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of Armies determined to do to us, according to our ways and according to our practices, so he has dealt with us.’”

en: “I had a vision in the night, and behold, a man riding on a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine; and behind him there were red, brown, and white horses.

ZEC 1:8

en: The man who stood among the myrtle trees answered, “They are the ones the LORD has sent to go back and forth through the earth.”
text:
ZEC 1:10
Thadou: Hichun huisum thing laha ding mipa hin adonbut in, hicheng pihi Pakaiyin leiset pumpi khol le dinga asohdoh ahiuve ati.
English: The man who stood among the myrtle trees answered, “They are the ones the LORD has sent to go back and forth through the earth.”

tcz: Huisum phung laha ding Pakai vantil komma chun sakol chunga tou adangho chun aseijun, “keihon leiset pumpi ka khollun, leiset chunghi lungmong in aum nauve”atiuve.
en: They reported to the LORD’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”
text:

English: They reported to the LORD’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”

tcz: Hichehi ajah phatnin Pakai vantil chu hitihin ataove. Vo hatchungnung Pakai kum som sagi sung ahi nangma Jerusalem leh Judah khopiho chunga hung lung hanga nahitam, itih chan gei hi amaho chunga khotona na musah loulai ding ham.
en: Then the LORD’s angel replied, “O LORD of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”

Thadou: Hichehi ajah phatnin Pakai vantil chu hitihin ataove. Vo hatchungnung Pakai kum som sagi sung ahi nangma Jerusalem leh Judah khopiho chunga hung lung hanga nahitam, itih chan gei hi amaho chunga khotona na musah loulai ding ham.
English: Then the LORD’s angel replied, “O LORD of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”

tcz: Keikoma thusei vantil komma chun Pakaiyin lungmonna thucheng in ana donbut in ahi.

text:
ZEC 1:13
Thadou: Keikoma thusei vantil komma chun Pakaiyin lungmonna thucheng in ana donbut in ahi.
English: The LORD answered the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words.

en: So the angel who talked with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
text:
ZEC 1:14
Thadou: Hitichun kakihoulimpi vantil chun kakomma hitin anasei jin ahi. Hatchungnung Pakai chun hitin aseije. Keiman Jerusalem le Zion phatna dinghi gelkhoh naleh khotona kanei lheh jing in ahi.
English: So the angel who talked with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

tcz: Keiman tu tua chamna leh lungmonga um namdang ho komma kalung ahang lheh jeng in kamite chunga vang kaha lunghan pon ahi. Namdang hohin aha bolset val tauvin ahi.
en: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”
text:
ZEC 1:15
Thadou: Keiman tu tua chamna leh lungmonga um namdang ho komma kalung ahang lheh jeng in kamite chunga vang kaha lunghan pon ahi. Namdang hohin aha bolset val tauvin ahi.
English: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseiye,keima Jerusalema khotona neijin kahung kile tai. Kahouin kisa phading Chuleh Jerusalem kithah semphat ding ahi. tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiye.
en: Therefore the LORD says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says the LORD of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’
text:
ZEC 1:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseiye,keima Jerusalema khotona neijin kahung kile tai. Kahouin kisa phading Chuleh Jerusalem kithah semphat ding ahi. tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseiye.
English: Therefore the LORD says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says the LORD of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’

tcz: Hatchungnung Pakijin jong hitin aseiye, Israel khopi ho bulhingset a hung kile dohding chuteng leh Pakai Zion alung monsahding chuleh Jerusalema dinga alahlut ding ahi.
en: “Proclaim further, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and the LORD will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”
text:
ZEC 1:17
Thadou: Hatchungnung Pakijin jong hitin aseiye, Israel khopi ho bulhingset a hung kile dohding chuteng leh Pakai Zion alung monsahding chuleh Jerusalema dinga alahlut ding ahi.
English: “Proclaim further, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and the LORD will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”

tcz: Keiman kavet kitleh, pasal khat in thiltena molkhat akichoi kamui
en: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
text:
ZEC 2:1
Thadou: Keiman kavet kitleh, pasal khat in thiltena molkhat akichoi kamui
English: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

tcz: Hiti chun keiman hoilanga che ding nahim tin ka dong in ahileh aman, “Keima hin Jerusalem hi adung avai itiham tetoh dinga hunga kahi” ati.
en: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”
text:
ZEC 2:2
Thadou: Hiti chun keiman hoilanga che ding nahim tin ka dong in ahileh aman, “Keima hin Jerusalem hi adung avai itiham tetoh dinga hunga kahi” ati.
English: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”

ZEC 2:3

en: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.
text:
ZEC 2:4
Thadou: Vantil khatpa chun aseiye, hungloijin lang hiche gollhangpa komma chun seijin, Jerusalem hi phatkhat leh mipi leh ganchaho hung dimset diu ahindol loudiu ahi, hitia chu mipi tamtah khopi polanga hung cheng diu ahi.
English: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.

tcz: Chu teng keima tah in Jerusalem kimvel chu meikong palla ka kolkhum ding ahi tin Pakaiyin aseiye. Chuleh keiman khopi sung chu kaloupina kahi sah ding ahi,” ati.
en: For I,’ says the LORD, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.
text:
ZEC 2:5
Thadou: Chu teng keima tah in Jerusalem kimvel chu meikong palla ka kolkhum ding ahi tin Pakaiyin aseiye. Chuleh keiman khopi sung chu kaloupina kahi sah ding ahi,” ati.
English: For I,’ says the LORD, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.

tcz: Pakijin aseiye,” Babylon sahlanga konin hung jamdoh un, nanghohi leiset kol ning lia konna thecheh na hiuve.
en: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says the LORD; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says the LORD.
text:
ZEC 2:6
Thadou: Pakijin aseiye,” Babylon sahlanga konin hung jamdoh un, nanghohi leiset kol ning lia konna thecheh na hiuve.
English: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says the LORD; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says the LORD.

tcz: Zion mipite hungpot doh uvin, nangho Babylon gamma ana jam lut ho!”
en: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’
text:
ZEC 2:7
Thadou: Zion mipite hungpot doh uvin, nangho Babylon gamma ana jam lut ho!”
English: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’

tcz: Loupi Pathen hatchung nung Pakai chun nangho nachom gamma namite chu doudinga eihinsol ahi, nangho nabolse hochun kei eibolset a kalah ahi. Keiman kakhut hinlam ingting amaho chu kasuhchip ding chuteng asoh houvin amaho achomdiu ahi. Chuteng leh hat chungnung Pakaiyin eihin sol ahi ahet diu ahi tin,
en: For the LORD of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.
text:
ZEC 2:8
Thadou: Loupi Pathen hatchung nung Pakai chun nangho nachom gamma namite chu doudinga eihinsol ahi, nangho nabolse hochun kei eibolset a kalah ahi. Keiman kakhut hinlam ingting amaho chu kasuhchip ding chuteng asoh houvin amaho achomdiu ahi. Chuteng leh hat chungnung Pakaiyin eihin sol ahi ahet diu ahi tin,
English: For the LORD of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.

tcz: Pakaiyin aseiye, Vo khopi hoitah Jerusalem kipah tahin kho asam un, ajeh chu nangho lah a cheng dinga kahung ding ahi.
en: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me.
text:
ZEC 2:9
Thadou: Pakaiyin aseiye, Vo khopi hoitah Jerusalem kipah tahin kho asam un, ajeh chu nangho lah a cheng dinga kahung ding ahi.
English: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me.

tcz: Hiche nikho teng chuleh namtamtah in Pakai keima eihin jop diu chuleh amaho chu kamite hidiu ahi. Keima nangho lah a kachen ding chu teng leh hat chungnung Pakaiyin Keima nangho komma eihinsol hi nahetdingu ahi.
en: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says the LORD.
text:
ZEC 2:10
Thadou: Hiche nikho teng chuleh namtamtah in Pakai keima eihin jop diu chuleh amaho chu kamite hidiu ahi. Keima nangho lah a kachen ding chu teng leh hat chungnung Pakaiyin Keima nangho komma eihinsol hi nahetdingu ahi.
English: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says the LORD.

tcz: Gamthenga chu Judah gamchu Pakaiyin Ama gam tumbeh a dinga alahkut ding chu leh Jerusalem chu amatah in akhopi dinga alhen kit ding ahi.
en: Many nations shall join themselves to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.
text:
ZEC 2:11
Thadou: Gamthenga chu Judah gamchu Pakaiyin Ama gam tumbeh a dinga alahkut ding chu leh Jerusalem chu amatah in akhopi dinga alhen kit ding ahi.
English: Many nations shall join themselves to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.

tcz: Pakai angsunga mihem jouse thipbeh chan umhen ajeh chu Amachu amunthenga konna hung kipat doh ding ahitai.
en: Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”
text:
ZEC 2:13
Thadou: Pakai angsunga mihem jouse thipbeh chan umhen ajeh chu Amachu amunthenga konna hung kipat doh ding ahitai.
English: Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”

tcz: Hijou chun Vantil chun Pakai Vantil masanga ding ah thempu chungnung chu eivetsah in ahi. Akidoupi Satan chu Vantil jetlanga aumin Joshua chunga dounathu aseijin ahi.
en: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the LORD’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.
text:
ZEC 3:1
Thadou: Hijou chun Vantil chun Pakai Vantil masanga ding ah thempu chungnung chu eivetsah in ahi. Akidoupi Satan chu Vantil jetlanga aumin Joshua chunga dounathu aseijin ahi.
English: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the LORD’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.

tcz: Pakaichun satan jah a aseijin, Pakai keiman namidem naho chu ka sangpoi, Jerusalem kei dingin kalhenpa keiman nang chu kahin samsei ati. Hiche mipahi meikong laha kisatdoh thingkhong tobang ahi.
en: The LORD said to Satan, “The LORD rebuke you, Satan! Yes, the LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”
text:
ZEC 3:2
Thadou: Pakaichun satan jah a aseijin, Pakai keiman namidem naho chu ka sangpoi, Jerusalem kei dingin kalhenpa keiman nang chu kahin samsei ati. Hiche mipahi meikong laha kisatdoh thingkhong tobang ahi.
English: The LORD said to Satan, “The LORD rebuke you, Satan! Yes, the LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”

tcz: Joshua Vantil masanga adin chun anen dehduh in ahi
en: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.
text:
ZEC 3:3
Thadou: Joshua Vantil masanga adin chun anen dehduh in ahi
English: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.

tcz: Hijeh chun Vantil chun hiche munna ding adangho komma chun, “avonho chu lahdoh peh un ati. Chuin Joshua langchu angat in “Ven, na chonsetna jouse chu ka lamang tan vonthah leh kape tan ahi” ati.
en: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.”
text:
ZEC 3:4
Thadou: Hijeh chun Vantil chun hiche munna ding adangho komma chun, “avonho chu lahdoh peh un ati. Chuin Joshua langchu angat in “Ven, na chonsetna jouse chu ka lamang tan vonthah leh kape tan ahi” ati.
English: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.”

tcz: Hichun keiman “aluchunga chun delkop bang kop peh-un” ati. Hijeh chun, amaho chun aluchunga chun thempu delkop thengtah akhuhpeh un chuleh akomma chun Pakai Vantil chu ading jing in ahi.
en: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and the LORD’s angel was standing by.
text:
ZEC 3:5
Thadou: Hichun keiman “aluchunga chun delkop bang kop peh-un” ati. Hijeh chun, amaho chun aluchunga chun thempu delkop thengtah akhuhpeh un chuleh akomma chun Pakai Vantil chu ading jing in ahi.
English: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and the LORD’s angel was standing by.

tcz: Chuin Pakai vantil chun Joshua kom ah ahilchah nan aseijin,
en: The LORD’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,
text:
ZEC 3:6
Thadou: Chuin Pakai vantil chun Joshua kom ah ahilchah nan aseijin,
English: The LORD’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,

tcz: “Hiche hi hatchungnung Pakaiyin asei ahi, nangin kathu nangaija chingthei tah a kakin na bolla ahileh, ka houin leh ahongcha a thu neina na kipe ding, chuleh hichea dingho lah a hikavale sah ding nahi, ati.
en: “The LORD of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.
text:
ZEC 3:7
Thadou: “Hiche hi hatchungnung Pakaiyin asei ahi, nangin kathu nangaija chingthei tah a kakin na bolla ahileh, ka houin leh ahongcha a thu neina na kipe ding, chuleh hichea dingho lah a hikavale sah ding nahi, ati.
English: “The LORD of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.

tcz: Vo thempu chungnung Joshua chuleh thempu dangdang ho kathu seihi ngaijun, nangho hi ahung lhung ding thilho hettheina nahiuve. Keihon kalhacha Abah thah chu kahin puivah ding ahitai.
en: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.
text:
ZEC 3:8
Thadou: Vo thempu chungnung Joshua chuleh thempu dangdang ho kathu seihi ngaijun, nangho hi ahung lhung ding thilho hettheina nahiuve. Keihon kalhacha Abah thah chu kahin puivah ding ahitai.
English: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.

tcz: Tun veovin, Joshua masang hin keiman songvah khatseh amai sagia kisem ka tung’e. Keiman ahunga chu lekhajem kajih ding chuleh keiman hiche gamsunga achonset na jouse nikhat sunga kasuh mang ding ahi, tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
en: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
text:
ZEC 3:9
Thadou: Tun veovin, Joshua masang hin keiman songvah khatseh amai sagia kisem ka tung’e. Keiman ahunga chu lekhajem kajih ding chuleh keiman hiche gamsunga achonset na jouse nikhat sunga kasuh mang ding ahi, tin hatchungnung Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
English: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

tcz: Hiche nikho tengle chun mikhat chehin naheng nakom chehchu na lengpithei le theichang phung noiya lungmonga toukhompi dinga nakikoudiu ahi.
en: In that day,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”
text:
ZEC 3:10
Thadou: Hiche nikho tengle chun mikhat chehin naheng nakom chehchu na lengpithei le theichang phung noiya lungmonga toukhompi dinga nakikoudiu ahi.
English: In that day,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”

tcz: Hijou chun kakihoupi Vantil chu ahung kile kitin a-ihmu bangin eihin sukhangin ahi.
en: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.
text:
ZEC 4:1
Thadou: Hijou chun kakihoupi Vantil chu ahung kile kitin a-ihmu bangin eihin sukhangin ahi.
English: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.

tcz: Tuahi ipi namum tin eidong in ahi, keiman ka donbut nin, sanna ngenna kisem thaomei tunna achunga thaotwi khonkhat akitun kamui kati. Hiche khon vella chun thaomei sagi aum in khat cheh chun avahna patjang khat neicheh ahom sagi aummin ahi.
en: He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it; there are seven pipes to each of the lamps which are on the top of it;

tcz: Chuleh keiman hiche khon langte achun Olive thing ni kamun ahi.
en: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”
text:
ZEC 4:3
Thadou: Chuleh keiman hiche khon langte achun Olive thing ni kamun ahi.
English: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”

tcz: Hijou chun keiman Vantil chu ka dong in Pakai hiche hohi ipi tina ham? katin ahileh,
en: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”
text:
ZEC 4:4
Thadou: Hijou chun keiman Vantil chu ka dong in Pakai hiche hohi ipi tina ham? katin ahileh,
English: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”

tcz: Vantil chun na hetlou ham tin eidong in ahileh keiman ka hepoi ka Pakai katin ahi.
en: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”
text:
ZEC 4:5
Thadou: Vantil chun na hetlou ham tin eidong in ahileh keiman ka hepoi ka Pakai katin ahi.
English: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

tcz: Hijou chun aman ei seipeh in, “Hiche hi Pakaiyin Zerubbabel komma asei chu ahi, hunamma natoh naleh thahat vanga hilou ding amavang keima Lhagao vanga hiding ahibouve, tin thaneipen Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
en: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is the LORD’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.
text:
ZEC 4:6
Thadou: Hijou chun aman ei seipeh in, “Hiche hi Pakaiyin Zerubbabel komma asei chu ahi, hunamma natoh naleh thahat vanga hilou ding amavang keima Lhagao vanga hiding ahibouve, tin thaneipen Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
English: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is the LORD’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.

tcz: Imachan nang jou lou ding, mol sangpen jeng in jong Zerubbabel lampi chu asuh tang jou lou ding ama masanga chu phaicham sohjeng ding ahi. Zerubbabel hin houin semphatna a achaina song asettoh phattengleh, mipihon Pathen in phattheiboh hen, Pathen in phattheiboh hen!” tia asapdiu ahi.
en: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”
text:
ZEC 4:7
Thadou: Imachan nang jou lou ding, mol sangpen jeng in jong Zerubbabel lampi chu asuh tang jou lou ding ama masanga chu phaicham sohjeng ding ahi. Zerubbabel hin houin semphatna a achaina song asettoh phattengleh, mipihon Pathen in phattheiboh hen, Pathen in phattheiboh hen!” tia asapdiu ahi.
English: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”

tcz: Hijeh chun Pakaija kon nin thupeh chomkhat ahung lhung kit-in,
en: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
ZEC 4:8
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pakaija kon nin thupeh chomkhat ahung lhung kit-in,
English: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: Zerubbabal hi Hou-in aleibul ana tungdoh a chu ahin, aman asahchai ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh hatchungnung Pakai chun eihin sol ahi ti na het diu ahi.
en: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.
text:
ZEC 4:9
Thadou: Zerubbabal hi Hou-in aleibul ana tungdoh a chu ahin, aman asahchai ding ahi. Hiteng chuleh hatchungnung Pakai chun eihin sol ahi ti na het diu ahi.
English: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.

tcz: Natoh ahina ding banga amachal lou jeh in alungthoi’un ahi, ahinla Zerubbabel hin houin asah chu atoh jom amuteng uleh kipah tauvinte. Thaomei sagi kiti hin Pakai mit-in vannoi leiset pumpi akholsoh vetsahna ahi.
en: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are the LORD’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”
text:
ZEC 4:10
Thadou: Natoh ahina ding banga amachal lou jeh in alungthoi’un ahi, ahinla Zerubbabel hin houin asah chu atoh jom amuteng uleh kipah tauvinte. Thaomei sagi kiti hin Pakai mit-in vannoi leiset pumpi akholsoh vetsahna ahi.
English: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are the LORD’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”

tcz: Hijou chun keiman vantil chu ka dong in, hiche thaomei khom pang tenia Olive thingphung nihi ipi tina hintem,
en: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”
text:
ZEC 4:11
Thadou: Hijou chun keiman vantil chu ka dong in, hiche thaomei khom pang tenia Olive thingphung nihi ipi tina hintem,
English: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”

tcz: Thaotwi kisun lhah naji sana luong teni komma Olive thingbah teni khun ipi asatsat hin tem? kati.
en: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”
text:
ZEC 4:12
Thadou: Thaotwi kisun lhah naji sana luong teni komma Olive thingbah teni khun ipi asatsat hin tem? kati.
English: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”

tcz: Aman eidong in na hetlou ham eiti. Keiman ka donbut in ka hepoi Pakai kati.
en: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”
text:
ZEC 4:13
Thadou: Aman eidong in na hetlou ham eiti. Keiman ka donbut in ka hepoi Pakai kati.
English: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

tcz: Hichun aman, “Hiche hin thao kinusa leiset pumpi Pakai laltouna komma ding jing van mi teni chu avetsah ahi”ati.
en: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”
text:
ZEC 4:14
Thadou: Hichun aman, “Hiche hin thao kinusa leiset pumpi Pakai laltouna komma ding jing van mi teni chu avetsah ahi”ati.
English: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”

tcz: Keima ka dahdoh kit in kavet leh lekhajol lengle khat kamun ahi.
en: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.
text:
ZEC 5:1
Thadou: Keima ka dahdoh kit in kavet leh lekhajol lengle khat kamun ahi.
English: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.

tcz: Vantil chun “Ipi namum” eiti. Keiman jong ka donbut in lekhajol lengle kamun, adunglam khuchang somthum chuleh availam khutchang somlenga tobang ahi.
en: He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”
text:
ZEC 5:2
Thadou: Vantil chun “Ipi namum” eiti. Keiman jong ka donbut in lekhajol lengle kamun, adunglam khuchang somthum chuleh availam khutchang somlenga tobang ahi.
English: He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”

tcz: Hichun aman eiseipeh in, “Hiche lekhajol hi leiset pumpia hung potdoh gaosapna ahi. Hiche lekajol dangkhat hin, koi hileh agucha a chu hiche gamma kon ahi kideldoh ahi ati, adangkhat hin koi hileh jou a kihahsel jong chu hiche gamma konna hi kidel doh ding ahi” ati.
en: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.
text:
ZEC 5:3
Thadou: Hichun aman eiseipeh in, “Hiche lekhajol hi leiset pumpia hung potdoh gaosapna ahi. Hiche lekajol dangkhat hin, koi hileh agucha a chu hiche gamma kon ahi kideldoh ahi ati, adangkhat hin koi hileh jou a kihahsel jong chu hiche gamma konna hi kidel doh ding ahi” ati.
English: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.

tcz: Chuleh hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Keiman guchaho jouse insunga hiche sapset nahi kalhun sah ding ahin, chuleh kamin panna jou leh nalla kihehse ho insunga jong sapsetna kalhunsah ding ahi. Chuleh hiche ka sapsetna hi a insung uva umden intin, a insung pumpiu athing asong pumma ka suhmang ding ahi.
en: I will cause it to go out,” says the LORD of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”
text:
ZEC 5:4
Thadou: Chuleh hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Keiman guchaho jouse insunga hiche sapset nahi kalhun sah ding ahin, chuleh kamin panna jou leh nalla kihehse ho insunga jong sapsetna kalhunsah ding ahi. Chuleh hiche ka sapsetna hi a insung uva umden intin, a insung pumpiu athing asong pumma ka suhmang ding ahi.
English: I will cause it to go out,” says the LORD of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”

tcz: Hijou chun eiki houlimpi Vantil chu ahung in ka kom mah hitin aseije, “Khodah inlang ipi hunglhung ding ham galdot in” eiti.
en: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”
text:
ZEC 5:5
Thadou: Hijou chun eiki houlimpi Vantil chu ahung in ka kom mah hitin aseije, “Khodah inlang ipi hunglhung ding ham galdot in” eiti.
English: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”

tcz: “Ipi ham” tin kadong in ahileh aman eihin donbut in, hiche pocha hi chang tena ahin, hiche gamsung pumpia miho jouse chonset na ahi”ati.
en: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He said moreover, “This is their appearance in all the land—
text:
ZEC 5:6
Thadou: “Ipi ham” tin kadong in ahileh aman eihin donbut in, hiche pocha hi chang tena ahin, hiche gamsung pumpia miho jouse chonset na ahi”ati.
English: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He said moreover, “This is their appearance in all the land—

tcz: Hijou chun hiche pocha kikhuna thihgih chu ahongdoh in ahileh asunga chun numei khat ana touvin ahi.
en: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”
text:
ZEC 5:7
Thadou: Hijou chun hiche pocha kikhuna thihgih chu ahongdoh in ahileh asunga chun numei khat ana touvin ahi.
English: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”

tcz: Vantil chun ahin seije,” hiche numeinu hi gitlouna vetsahna ahi, atin aman asinna thihtum gihchun alesin kitnin akhahchah tai.

text:
ZEC 5:8

en: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.
text:
ZEC 5:9
Thadou: Hijou chun keiman chunglang kagah ven ahileh, lhaving nei numeini huilah a keima komlanga ahungleng lhon in ahi. Amani hin vacha kang bang in lha anei lhon in hiche pocha chu adamdoh lhon in vanlai jollah a lhon toupi hon tan ahi.
English: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.

tcz: Hiche pocha chu hoilang’a akoi lhon hitam tia Vantil chu ka doh leh,

text:
ZEC 5:10
Thadou: Hiche pocha chu hoilang’a akoi lhon hitam tia Vantil chu ka doh leh,
English: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”

en: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”
text:
ZEC 5:11

English: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”

tcz: Hijou chun keiman chunglang kaven ahileh sakol kangtalai li sumang molsang teni kikah a kon in ahung doh in ahi.
en: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.

ZEC 6:1

English: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.

en: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.
text:
ZEC 6:2
Thadou: Sakol kangtalai masa chu sakol san in ahin kaijin, ani channa chu sakol vommin ahin kaijin ahi.
English: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.

tcz: Athum channa chu sakol kangin ahinkai jin, ali channa chu sakolpol hattah ahiuve.
en: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.
text:
ZEC 6:3
Thadou: Athum channa chu sakol kangin ahinkai jin, ali channa chu sakolpol hattah ahiuve.
English: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.

tcz: Vantil eihoulimpi pachu ka dong in, Pakai hiche khopi hi ipi hitam ka tileh,
en: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”
text:
ZEC 6:4
Thadou: Vantil eihoulimpi pachu ka dong in, Pakai hiche khopi hi ipi hitam ka tileh,
English: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”

tcz: Vantil chun eidonbut in, “Hiche hohi leiset pumpi Pakai masanga ding lhagao li hochu ahiuve ati. Amahohi anatong dinga hung potdoh ahiuve.
en: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
text:
ZEC 6:5
Thadou: Vantil chun eidonbut in, “Hiche hohi leiset pumpi Pakai masanga ding lhagao li hochu ahiuve ati. Amahohi anatong dinga hung potdoh ahiuve.
English: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

tcz: Sakol vommin akaihi sahlanga che ding, akang in akai hi lhumlama che ding chu leh apollin akaihi lhanglanga che ding ahi.
en: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”
text:
ZEC 6:6
Thadou: Sakol vommin akaihi sahlanga che ding, akang in akai hi lhumlama che ding chu leh apollin akaihi lhanglanga che ding ahi.
English: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”

tcz: Hiche sakol hattah hohi leiset chung kholtoh leding a thanomtah a hung kipatdoh ahiuve. Chuleh Pakai chun aseijin,” cheuvin leiset chung gakhol tauvin” ati. Hiti chun amaho akhol toh din ache tauve.
en: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. He said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.
text:
ZEC 6:7
Thadou: Hiche sakol hattah hohi leiset chung kholtoh leding a thanomtah a hung kipatdoh ahiuve. Chuleh Pakai chun aseijin,” cheuvin leiset chung gakhol tauvin” ati. Hiti chun amaho akhol toh din ache tauve.
English: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. He said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.

tcz: Hijou chun Pakaiyin eihin kouvin aseijin ahi, “Vetan, sahlang gamsunga dinga kitolho khu hiche sahlam gamsunga kalung hanna achen dai taovin ahi.
en: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”
text:
ZEC 6:8
Thadou: Hijou chun Pakaiyin eihin kouvin aseijin ahi, “Vetan, sahlang gamsunga dinga kitolho khu hiche sahlam gamsunga kalung hanna achen dai taovin ahi.
English: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”

tcz: Pakai thupeh ka kom ah ahung lhung kitnin hitin aseije
en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
text:
ZEC 6:9
Thadou: Pakai thupeh ka kom ah ahung lhung kitnin hitin aseije
English: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

tcz: Babylon gamma konna sohchang hundoh holah a kon in Heldai leh Tebiah chuleh Judiah hichenghi puijin lang hiche nikho ma chun Zephaniah chapa Josiah hengah chen ati.
en: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.
text:
ZEC 6:10
Thadou: Babylon gamma konna sohchang hundoh holah a kon in Heldai leh Tebiah chuleh Judiah hichenghi puijin lang hiche nikho ma chun Zephaniah chapa Josiah hengah chen ati.
English: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.

tcz: Chuteng leh dangka le sana la uvin lang lallukhuh sem un thempu chungnung Joshediah chapa Joshua chu khuhpeh un,
en: Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;

tcz: Chuleh ama komma hitin seijun, hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin hitin aseije, veuvin Abah kiti mikhat munna kon in hung khangtou tauvin tin chuteng leh aman Pakai Hou-in chu ahin tun doh ding ahi.
en: and speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build the LORD’s temple.
text:
ZEC 6:12
Thadou: Chuleh ama komma hitin seijun, hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin hitin aseije, veuvin Abah kiti mikhat munna kon in hung khangtou tauvin tin chuteng leh aman Pakai Hou-in chu ahin tun doh ding ahi.
English: and speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build the LORD’s temple.

tcz: Hichepa hin Pakai Hou-in asahdoh a loupina jong hung in chang ing chuleh alaltouna-a jong hung touva chuleh alaltouna-a chu thempua hung pang ding chuleh akikah lhonna chamnale lungmonna,
en: He will build the LORD’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.
text:
ZEC 6:13
Thadou: Hichepa hin Pakai Hou-in asahdoh a loupina jong hung in chang ing chuleh alaltouna-a jong hung touva chuleh alaltouna-a chu thempua hung pang ding chuleh akikah lhonna chamnale lungmonna,
English: He will build the LORD’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.

tcz: Chuteng leh lallukhuh chu Pakai Hou-in sunga kikoija Heldai, Tebiah chu leh Zephaniah chapa Josiah hetdoh jingna dinga kikoi ding ahi.
en: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the LORD’s temple.
text:
ZEC 6:14
Thadou: Chuteng leh lallukhuh chu Pakai Hou-in sunga kikoija Heldai, Tebiah chu leh Zephaniah chapa Josiah hetdoh jingna dinga kikoi ding ahi.
English: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the LORD’s temple.

tcz: Hitia chu khol gamla tah a konna jong hung diu Pakai Hou-in sahna a hi hung pang ding, hiteng chuleh hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin eihinsol ahi ti nahet diu ahi. Nangin Pakai na Pathen thuthu nanunna ahileh hiti ahi hung guilhung ding ahi.
en: Those who are far off shall come and build in the LORD’s temple; and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen, if you will diligently obey the LORD your God’s voice.”’”
text:
ZEC 6:15
Thadou: Hitia chu khol gamla tah a konna jong hung diu Pakai Hou-in sahna a hi hung pang ding, hiteng chuleh hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin eihinsol ahi ti nahet diu ahi. Nangin Pakai na Pathen thuthu nanunna ahileh hiti ahi hung guilhung ding ahi.
English: Those who are far off shall come and build in the LORD’s temple; and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen, if you will diligently obey the LORD your God’s voice.”’”

tcz: Darius lengpa Vaipoh kumli channa lhako lhinna Chislea lha kiti nili lhinnin Pakaiyin Zechariah henga thu ahin seije:
en: In the fourth year of King Darius, the LORD’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
text:
ZEC 7:1
Thadou: Darius lengpa Vaipoh kumli channa lhako lhinna Chislea lha kiti nili lhinnin Pakaiyin Zechariah henga thu ahin seije:
English: In the fourth year of King Darius, the LORD’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.

tcz: Hichun Bethel khomiten Saherzer le Regem-molech toh amiteu chu Pakai lunglhaina holdin asol tauve,

text:
ZEC 7:2
Thadou: Hichun Bethel khomiten Saherzer le Regem-molech toh amiteu chu Pakai lunglhaina holdin asol tauve,
English: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat the LORD’s favor,

en: and to speak to the priests of the house of the LORD of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”
text:
ZEC 7:3
Thadou: Chujong leh thaneipan Pakai Hou-in na thempu leh themgao hochu thu aga dong’e, “Keiman hitih chan khanga kahin bolngai banga chu lhanga lhinseh leh lunghem kabolla an kangol ding ham, kum hijat sunga kabol bang banga?” tin sei uvintin asol uve.
English: and to speak to the priests of the house of the LORD of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”

tcz: Hiche ahin thanei pen Pakaiyin kajah in thu ahin seijin hitin ati.
en: Then the word of the LORD of Armies came to me, saying,
text:
ZEC 7:4
Thadou: Hiche ahin thanei pen Pakaiyin kajah in thu ahin seijin hitin ati.
English: Then the word of the LORD of Armies came to me, saying,

tcz: Gamsunga mite jahle thempuho jah a khun hiti hin seijin, nanghon lhanga lhin leh lha sagi teng leh lunghem anbollu khu, hiche kum som-sagi sunga hi keima dinga anngolla nahiuvem?
en: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?
text:
ZEC 7:5
Thadou: Gamsunga mite jahle thempuho jah a khun hiti hin seijin, nanghon lhanga lhin leh lha sagi teng leh lunghem anbollu khu, hiche kum som-sagi sunga hi keima dinga anngolla nahiuvem?
English: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?

tcz: Chuleh nanghon an naneh uva twi na donteng u-jongleh khun nangho le nangho dia na kineh uva chule nangho le nangho dia na kidon jiu hilou ham?
en: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?
text:
ZEC 7:6
Thadou: Chuleh nanghon an naneh uva twi na donteng u-jongleh khun nangho le nangho dia na kineh uva chule nangho le nangho dia na kidon jiu hilou ham?
English: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?

tcz: Jerusalem khopia mi achen lai, neile gou thalhin lai akimvel dunga jong khopi tampi aumna lhanglam gamla gammon lai dung jong min achenpha laiya chu hicheng mahi Pakaiyin themgao masaho komma aphondoh sa hilou ham?” tin ati.
en: Aren’t these the words which the LORD proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”
text:
ZEC 7:7
Thadou: Jerusalem khopia mi achen lai, neile gou thalhin lai akimvel dunga jong khopi tampi aumna lhanglam gamla gammon lai dung jong min achenpha laiya chu hicheng mahi Pakaiyin themgao masaho komma aphondoh sa hilou ham?” tin ati.
English: Aren’t these the words which the LORD proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”

tcz: Pakai thupeh chu Zechariah komma ahung lhung in hitin ati.
en: The LORD’s word came to Zechariah, saying,
text:
ZEC 7:8
Thadou: Pakai thupeh chu Zechariah komma ahung lhung in hitin ati.
English: The LORD’s word came to Zechariah, saying,

tcz: Thaneipen Pakaiyin hitin aseije, min asopi kom ah ngailutna leh khotona nei tahin thudih in thu tanhen,
en: “Thus has the LORD of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.
text:
ZEC 7:9
Thadou: Thaneipen Pakaiyin hitin aseije, min asopi kom ah ngailutna leh khotona nei tahin thudih in thu tanhen,
English: “Thus has the LORD of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.

tcz: Meithai hihen nuneilou pa neilou hijong leh kholjin hihen mivaicha hijong leh bol genthei hihen chuleh na lungthim in na sopi chunga thilse gel hihen,
en: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’
text:
ZEC 7:10
Thadou: Meithai hihen nuneilou pa neilou hijong leh kholjin hihen mivaicha hijong leh bol genthei hihen chuleh na lungthim in na sopi chunga thilse gel hihen,
English: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’

tcz: Amahon nathuseiju ngaida uhenlang, nanung ngat’u henlang na thuseiju ajah lou na diuvin akollu sip jong leu,
en: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.
text:
ZEC 7:11
Thadou: Amahon nathuseiju ngaida uhenlang, nanung ngat’u henlang na thuseiju ajah lou na diuvin akollu sip jong leu,
English: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.

tcz: A lungthi un nanahsah dau henlang danthu jong kihet mosah jongleu themgao masaho komma hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin ana phondoh ija tihih jong leu, hijeh achu hatchungnung Pakaija konna hung deojah jenga ahi.
en: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which the LORD of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from the LORD of Armies.
text:
ZEC 7:12
Thadou: A lungthi un nanahsah dau henlang danthu jong kihet mosah jongleu themgao masaho komma hatchungnung pen Pakaiyin ana phondoh ija tihih jong leu, hijeh achu hatchungnung Pakaija konna hung deojah jenga ahi.
English: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which the LORD of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from the LORD of Armies.

tcz: Keiman amaho kakouva eingaipeh lou jeh'un amahon eihin kouteng ujongleh keiman jong kangai peh lou ding,ahi tin thaneipen Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
en: It has come to pass that, as he called and they refused to listen, so they will call and I will not listen,” said the LORD of Armies;

tcz: Ama hohi ahet khah louvu chitin namtin lah a chimpei banga ka thethang gam ding ahi. Hitia chu agamsung uchu akeo hella kijam ding koi machan ahung vilkhah lou ding ahitan, agam nomtah uchu manlou asodoh sah u ahitai.
en: “but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.”
text:
ZEC 7:14
Thadou: Ama hohi ahet khah louvu chitin namtin lah a chimpei banga ka thethang gam ding ahi. Hitia chu agamsung uchu akeo hella kijam ding koi machan ahung vilkhah lou ding ahitan, agam nomtah uchu manlou asodoh sah u ahitai.
English: “but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.”

tcz: Hiche jou chun hatchungnung Pakaija kon in thupeh khat ahung kitnin hitin ati,
en: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me.
text:
ZEC 8:1
Thadou: Hiche jou chun hatchungnung Pakaija kon in thupeh khat ahung kitnin hitin ati,
English: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me.

tcz: Hatchungnung Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Zion kangailut nahi agil lheh jeng in ahi, Jerusalem ka ngailut nahin eival-lhum jeng in ahi.
en: The LORD of Armies says: “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.”
text:
ZEC 8:2
