English: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

tcz: muthim lah a touho chun vah loupi tah amu tauve, chule thina gam le alim a touho chu achung'uva kho avah tai,” ati chu agui lhunna ahi.
en: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”
text:
MAT 4:16
Thadou: muthim lah a touho chun vah loupi tah amu tauve, chule thina gam le alim a touho chu achung'uva kho avah tai,” ati chu agui lhunna ahi.
English: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”

tcz: Hichea pat chun Yeshuan thu asei phong in, “Na chonset nauva kon in lung heiyun chule Pathen lama hung ki heiyun, ijeh inem itileh Van gam anai tai,” ati.
en: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
text:
MAT 4:17
Thadou: Hichea pat chun Yeshuan thu asei phong in, “Na chonset nauva kon in lung heiyun chule Pathen lama hung ki heiyun, ijeh inem itileh Van gam anai tai,” ati.
English: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”

tcz: Nikhat hi Yeshua Galilee twipi pam'a achea avale pet in, aman uchani—Simon, Peter jong kitipa le Andrew in twi lah a len asepet lhon agatoh e, ajeh chu amani ngaman a kivah lhon ahi.
en: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
text:
MAT 4:18
Thadou: Nikhat hi Yeshua Galilee twipi pam'a achea avale pet in, aman uchani—Simon, Peter jong kitipa le Andrew in twi lah a len asepet lhon agatoh e, ajeh chu amani ngaman a kivah lhon ahi.
English: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

tcz: Yeshuan amani chu akouvin, “Hung lhon in, kanung hinjui lhon in chule keiman miho iti mat ding ahi navetsah lhon inge,” ati.
en: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
text:
MAT 4:19
Thadou: Yeshuan amani chu akouvin, “Hung lhon in, kanung hinjui lhon in chule keiman miho iti mat ding ahi navetsah lhon inge,” ati.
English: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”

tcz: Chuin amanin apet tah chun alen lhon adalha lhon in chule Ama nung ajui lhon tai.
en: They immediately left their nets and followed him.
text:
MAT 4:20
Thadou: Chuin amanin apet tah chun alen lhon adalha lhon in chule Ama nung ajui lhon tai.
English: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

tcz: Chule Ama chukom'a kon chun ache pai in ahileh, ucha dang mini Jacob le anaopa John kong sunga apau Zebedee toh atou khom uva len akhui phat pet'u aga mun, chuin Aman amani jong chu akouvin ahi.
en: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.
text:
MAT 4:21
Thadou: Chule Ama chukom'a kon chun ache pai in ahileh, ucha dang mini Jacob le anaopa John kong sunga apau Zebedee toh atou khom uva len akhui phat pet'u aga mun, chuin Aman amani jong chu akouvin ahi.
English: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

tcz: Amanin chupet tah chun kong le apa adalha lhon in, anung ajui pai jeng lhon tai.
en: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.
text:
MAT 4:22
Thadou: Amanin chupet tah chun kong le apa adalha lhon in, anung ajui pai jeng lhon tai.
English: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

tcz: Chule Yeshua chu Galilee gamkai sea akhol jin in, Judah te kikhopna intin ah thu ahil in, Lenggam Kipana Thupha aseiphong len ahi. Chule Ama chun miho natna jouse le adamlou jouse chu aboldam in ahi.
en: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
text:
MAT 4:23
Thadou: Chule Yeshua chu Galilee gamkai sea akhol jin in, Judah te kikhopna intin ah thu ahil in, Lenggam Kipana Thupha aseiphong len ahi. Chule Ama chun miho natna jouse le adamlou jouse chu aboldam in ahi.
English: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

tcz: Ama chung chang thu chu Syria geiyin aki thang doh in, hiti chun miho chun ana damlou jouse chu akom a ahin puiyuve. Chule itobang natna le hivei neiya nat thoh lel ho, thilha vop ho le alung chavai ho hihen, chule langthi ho hijong leh Ama koma ahin puiyun, aman amaho chu aboncha uvin aboldam sohkeiyin ahi.
en: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.
text:
MAT 4:24
Thadou: Ama chung chang thu chu Syria geiyin aki thang doh in, hiti chun miho chun ana damlou jouse chu akom a ahin puiyuve. Chule itobang natna le hivei neiya nat thoh lel ho, thilha vop ho le alung chavai ho hihen, chule langthi ho hijong leh Ama koma ahin puiyun, aman amaho chu aboncha uvin aboldam sohkeiyin ahi.
English: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

tcz: Ama chena chan a chun Galilee, Decapolis (Khopi som kitina), Jerusalem chule Judea gama kon le Jordan gal lama kon in, mipi tamtah'in anung ajui tauvin ahi.
en: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
text:
MAT 4:25
Thadou: Ama chena chan a chun Galilee, Decapolis (Khopi som kitina), Jerusalem chule Judea gama kon le Jordan gal lama kon in, mipi tamtah'in anung ajui tauvin ahi.
English: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

tcz: Nikhat hi mihonpi kikhom chu amu phat in, Yeshua chu moul chung a akaldoh in chule atou phat in aseijuite chu akimvel'a ahung kikhom un ahi.
en: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.
text:
MAT 5:1
Thadou: Nikhat hi mihonpi kikhom chu amu phat in, Yeshua chu moul chung a akaldoh in chule atou phat in aseijuite chu akimvel'a ahung kikhom un ahi.
English: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

tcz: Chuin Ama apaodoh in amaho chu hiche thuhi ahil pan in, ajah uva asei tai.
en: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
text:
MAT 5:2
Thadou: Chuin Ama apaodoh in amaho chu hiche thuhi ahil pan in, ajah uva asei tai.
English: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

tcz: “Lhagaova vaichaho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh Van gam chu amaho'a ahi.
en: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

MAT 5:3

tcz: Lhasetna neiho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amaho chu lhamonga umdiu ahi.
en: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
text:
MAT 5:4
Thadou: Lhasetna neiho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amaho chu lhamonga umdiu ahi.
English: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

tcz: Mi lungneng ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh ama hon leiset chung pumpi alo diu ahi.
en: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
text:
MAT 5:5
Thadou: Mi lungneng ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh ama hon leiset chung pumpi alo diu ahi.
English: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.

tcz: Thudih a din jeh a gilkel dangchah thoh ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh ama hon lung nachimna anei diu ahi.
en: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.
text:
MAT 5:6
Thadou: Thudih a din jeh a gilkel dangchah thoh ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh ama hon lung nachimna anei diu ahi.
English: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.

tcz: Mi lungset them ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amaho chu lungsetna chang diu ahi.
en: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
text:
MAT 5:7
Thadou: Mi lungset them ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amaho chu lungsetna chang diu ahi.
English: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

tcz: Mi lungtheng ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amahon Pathen amu diu ahi.
en: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
text:
MAT 5:8
Thadou: Mi lungtheng ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amahon Pathen amu diu ahi.
English: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

tcz: Mi sucham ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amaho Pathen chate kiti diu ahi.
en: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
text:
MAT 5:9
Thadou: Mi sucham ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh amaho Pathen chate kiti diu ahi.
English: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

tcz: Adih boljeh a hesohna chang ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh Van gam chu amahoa ahi.
en: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
text:
MAT 5:10
Thadou: Adih boljeh a hesohna chang ho Pathen in phatthei aboh diu ahi, ijeh inem itileh Van gam chu amahoa ahi.
English: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

tcz: Kanung jui nahi jeh uva mihon nahouset uva, nabol hesoh uva, jouva nabol'uva chule nang ho douna a thil phalou jouse aseiteng uleh Pathen phatthei boh chang ding nahi uve.
en: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
text:
MAT 5:11
Thadou: Kanung jui nahi jeh uva mihon nahouset uva, nabol hesoh uva, jouva nabol'uva chule nang ho douna a thil phalou jouse aseiteng uleh Pathen phatthei boh chang ding nahi uve.
English: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

tcz: Nang ho kipah thanom'un chule hapan kipah uvin, ajeh chu van a nasan dingu kipaman alen e. Ajehchu amahon themgao masaho jong chu hitobanga hi anabol hesoh'u ahi.
en: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
text:
MAT 5:12
Thadou: Nang ho kipah thanom'un chule hapan kipah uvin, ajeh chu van a nasan dingu kipaman alen e. Ajehchu amahon themgao masaho jong chu hitobanga hi anabol hesoh'u ahi.
English: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

tcz: “Nangho leiset chi nahiuve. Hinlah chi chu a alna beitaleh ipin ki alsah kit tantem? Chule ima chan phachom tapon tin, pai mang le miho chotpha bep hiding ahi.
en: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.
text:
MAT 5:13
Thadou: “Nangho leiset chi nahiuve. Hinlah chi chu a alna beitaleh ipin ki alsah kit tantem? Chule ima chan phachom tapon tin, pai mang le miho chotpha bep hiding ahi.
English: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

tcz: ‘Nang ho vannoi vah nahiuve, lhang vuma khopi kisel theilou tobang chu nahi uve.’
en: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.
text:
MAT 5:14
Thadou: ‘Nang ho vannoi vah nahiuve, lhang vuma khopi kisel theilou tobang chu nahi uve.’
English: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

tcz: Koiman thaomei avah in chujouleh lo akhu khum jipoi. Hisang chun akhom chunga aki tung in, in sunga um jouse avah chun asalvah jin ahi.
en: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.
text:
MAT 5:15
Thadou: Koiman thaomei avah in chujouleh lo akhu khum jipoi. Hisang chun akhom chunga aki tung in, in sunga um jouse avah chun asalvah jin ahi.
English: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.

tcz: Hitobang chun navah uchu miho masang ah kilang hen, chuteng amahon na thilpha bol uchu mu uvin tin, van'a um na Pau chu avahchoi diu ahi.
en: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
text:
MAT 5:16
Thadou: Hitobang chun navah uchu miho masang ah kilang hen, chuteng amahon na thilpha bol uchu mu uvin tin, van'a um na Pau chu avahchoi diu ahi.
English: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

tcz: “Ipi jeh a hunga kahi nei hekhel hih un. Keima hi Mose Danbu ahilouleh themgao ho lekhajih subei dinga hung kahipoi. Asumang dinga hunga hijo louva, asubulhit a hung kahijoi.
en: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
text:
MAT 5:17
Thadou: “Ipi jeh a hunga kahi nei hekhel hih un. Keima hi Mose Danbu ahilouleh themgao ho lekhajih subei dinga hung kahipoi. Asumang dinga hunga hijo louva, asubulhit a hung kahijoi.
English: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.

tcz: Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, Van le leiset aman masanga Pathen Dan thu chu aguilhun sohkei masang sea, ajem neopen le ajem sipah geiya jong mang lou ding ahi.
en: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.
text:
MAT 5:18
Thadou: Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, Van le leiset aman masanga Pathen Dan thu chu aguilhun sohkei masang sea, ajem neopen le ajem sipah geiya jong mang lou ding ahi.
English: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

tcz: Nang man thupeh aneopen na nahsah moa chule midang jong hitia chu nahil'a ahileh, Van gama chu aneopen nahi ding ahi. Hinlah koi hijongleh Pathen Dan thu juiya chule hiche ho chu ahil'a ahileh Van gama alen kiti ding ahi.
en: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.
text:
MAT 5:19
Thadou: Nang man thupeh aneopen na nahsah moa chule midang jong hitia chu nahil'a ahileh, Van gama chu aneopen nahi ding ahi. Hinlah koi hijongleh Pathen Dan thu juiya chule hiche ho chu ahil'a ahileh Van gama alen kiti ding ahi.
English: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

tcz: Hinlah kahil chah nahiuve. Nangho na chonphat nau chu Dan thuhil ho le Pharisee ho sanga aphat joh louva ahileh Van gam'a chu nalut louhel diu ahi.
en: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
text:
MAT 5:20
Thadou: Hinlah kahil chah nahiuve. Nangho na chonphat nau chu Dan thuhil ho le Pharisee ho sanga aphat joh louva ahileh Van gam'a chu nalut louhel diu ahi.
English: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

tcz: “Nanghon ipu ipateu jah a, ‘Tolthat hih in, koi hijong leh mithat chu thupi tanna dinga kicha jinga um ding ahi’ tia ana kiseipeh chu naja tauve.
en: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’
text:
MAT 5:21
Thadou: “Nanghon ipu ipateu jah a, ‘Tolthat hih in, koi hijong leh mithat chu thupi tanna dinga kicha jinga um ding ahi’ tia ana kiseipeh chu naja tauve.
English: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’

tcz: Hinlah keiman nangho jah a kaseipeh nahi uve, koi hijongleh khat chunga lunghanga chu athu kitan ding ahi. Nangman koiham khat chu mingol pannabei natileh thutanna mun'a kipuilut ding kicha'a um ding nahi. Nangman mi na gaosap'a ahileh Damun meidil'a kicha a um ding nahi.
en: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.
text:
MAT 5:22
Thadou: Hinlah keiman nangho jah a kaseipeh nahi uve, koi hijongleh khat chunga lunghanga chu athu kitan ding ahi. Nangman koiham khat chu mingol pannabei natileh thutanna mun'a kipuilut ding kicha'a um ding nahi. Nangman mi na gaosap'a ahileh Damun meidil'a kicha a um ding nahi.
English: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangman hou in a maicham thilto ding nachoiya, mi koiham khat in nangma kilung doupina nanei na geldoh a ahileh,
en: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,
text:
MAT 5:23
Thadou: Hijeh chun nangman hou in a maicham thilto ding nachoiya, mi koiham khat in nangma kilung doupina nanei na geldoh a ahileh,
English: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,

tcz: Maicham mun'a na thilto ding chu dalhan, gachen chuche mi chuto gakicham lhon in, chuteng leh hung in chule Pathen maicham'a kilhaina thilto chu napeh ding ahi.
en: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
text:
MAT 5:24
Thadou: Maicham mun'a na thilto ding chu dalhan, gachen chuche mi chuto gakicham lhon in, chuteng leh hung in chule Pathen maicham'a kilhaina thilto chu napeh ding ahi.
English: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

tcz: Na kidoupi chutoh thutanna mun'a dinga na kilhon pina lampia chun, agan na theiyin kihou champi jeng in. Achuti louleh themmo na chanpa chun thutan vaihompa khut a napedoh intin, ama chun amopo khat khut a peson intin, chule songkul a na khumpai ding ahi.
en: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.
text:
MAT 5:25
Thadou: Na kidoupi chutoh thutanna mun'a dinga na kilhon pina lampia chun, agan na theiyin kihou champi jeng in. Achuti louleh themmo na chanpa chun thutan vaihompa khut a napedoh intin, ama chun amopo khat khut a peson intin, chule songkul a na khumpai ding ahi.
English: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

tcz: Hiti chu hita henlang hileh, nangman achaina pen sum nasah chai masang sea chu itinama jongleh chua kona chu nalha ong thol kit lou ding ahitai.
en: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.
text:
MAT 5:26
Thadou: Hiti chu hita henlang hileh, nangman achaina pen sum nasah chai masang sea chu itinama jongleh chua kona chu nalha ong thol kit lou ding ahitai.
English: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.

tcz: “Thupeh a thu ana kiseisa, ‘Nangman jonbol hih in’ kiti hi nana ja tauve.
en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’
text:
MAT 5:27
Thadou: “Thupeh a thu ana kiseisa, ‘Nangman jonbol hih in’ kiti hi nana ja tauve.
English: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’

tcz: Hinlah keiman kaseipeh nahi uve, koi hileh numei khat jon lunga ve achu amanu chutoh alunga jong ahitai.
en: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
text:
MAT 5:28
Thadou: Hinlah keiman kaseipeh nahi uve, koi hileh numei khat jon lunga ve achu amanu chutoh alunga jong ahitai.
English: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

tcz: Hijeh chun namit chu mitpha hikhat tou jongleh hichun na kipal lhuhsah a ahileh, kaldoh in lang paimang jeng in, nangma ding in natibah khat namansah chu na tahsa pumpi damun a akilelut sang in aphajoi.
en: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
text:
MAT 5:29
Thadou: Hijeh chun namit chu mitpha hikhat tou jongleh hichun na kipal lhuhsah a ahileh, kaldoh in lang paimang jeng in, nangma ding in natibah khat namansah chu na tahsa pumpi damun a akilelut sang in aphajoi.
English: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

tcz: Chule nakhut jetlam in na chonset sah a ahileh sat lhan lang paimang jeng in. Ajeh chu nangma dinga na tahsa pumpi damun a akilelut sang in, natibah khat aman chu apha joi.
en: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
text:
MAT 5:30
Thadou: Chule nakhut jetlam in na chonset sah a ahileh sat lhan lang paimang jeng in. Ajeh chu nangma dinga na tahsa pumpi damun a akilelut sang in, natibah khat aman chu apha joi.
English: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

tcz: “Danbua thu kisun, ‘Pasal in ajinu ada ding leh amanu chu dana lekha apeh a ahetsah leh ahithei jenge’ tia kisei chu naja tauve.
en: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’
text:
MAT 5:31
Thadou: “Danbua thu kisun, ‘Pasal in ajinu ada ding leh amanu chu dana lekha apeh a ahetsah leh ahithei jenge’ tia kisei chu naja tauve.
English: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’

tcz: Hinlah keiman kasei ahi, mikhat in aji chu pasal dang toh alup khom jeh tilouva thu dang jeh'a ada ahileh, amanu chu ajonsah ahitai: chule koi hi jongleh akidasa numei ki chenpia chu mi jong ahi.
en: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.
text:
MAT 5:32
Thadou: Hinlah keiman kasei ahi, mikhat in aji chu pasal dang toh alup khom jeh tilouva thu dang jeh'a ada ahileh, amanu chu ajonsah ahitai: chule koi hi jongleh akidasa numei ki chenpia chu mi jong ahi.
English: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.

tcz: “Chule malai mite ki seipehsa thu nana jahsau chu, ‘Nangman nakihahsel na chu sukeh hih in, nangman Pakaiya naki hahselna nabulhit tei ding ahi’ kiti ahi.
en: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’
text:
MAT 5:33
Thadou: “Chule malai mite ki seipehsa thu nana jahsau chu, ‘Nangman nakihahsel na chu sukeh hih in, nangman Pakaiya naki hahselna nabulhit tei ding ahi’ kiti ahi.
English: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’

tcz: Hinlah keiman kaseipeh nahi uve, imachan ki hahsel hih beh un! Van pan in ki hahsel hih un, ajeh chu van chu Pathen laltouna ahi.
en: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;

tcz: Chule leiset pan in ki hahsel hih un, ajeh chu leiset hi akengto ngapna ahi. Chule Jerusalem pan in ki hahsel hih un, ajeh chu Jerusalem hi Leng loupi khopi ahi.
en: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
text:
MAT 5:35
Thadou: Chule leiset pan in ki hahsel hih un, ajeh chu leiset hi akengto ngapna ahi. Chule Jerusalem pan in ki hahsel hih un, ajeh chu Jerusalem hi Leng loupi khopi ahi.
English: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

tcz: Ka luchung pan beh a kaki hahsel ding hitante ti hih in. Ajeh chu nangman na samjang khat cha jong nakan sah thei lou chule na vom sah thei poi.
en: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.
text:
MAT 5:36
Thadou: Ka luchung pan beh a kaki hahsel ding hitante ti hih in. Ajeh chu nangman na samjang khat cha jong nakan sah thei lou chule na vom sah thei poi.
English: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.

tcz: Hinlah naki houlim nau chu ‘Henge, ka nom e ahilouleh ka nompoi’ tia sei chu hi jeng hen. Hi cheng kalval chu agi loupa a kon ahi.
en: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.
text:
MAT 5:37
Thadou: Hinlah naki houlim nau chu ‘Henge, ka nom e ahilouleh ka nompoi’ tia sei chu hi jeng hen. Hi cheng kalval chu agi loupa a kon ahi.
English: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.

tcz: “Dan thun gim bolna chu atotoh hi ding: Mit khat khel'a mi khat, chule ha khat khel'a ha khat hi ding ahi kiti chu naja tauve.
en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
text:
MAT 5:38
Thadou: “Dan thun gim bolna chu atotoh hi ding: Mit khat khel'a mi khat, chule ha khat khel'a ha khat hi ding ahi kiti chu naja tauve.
English: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’

tcz: Hinlah kaseipeh nahi uve, mi gilou lethuh hih un! Koiham khat in na ngeiphe jetlam abeh'a ahileh, na ngeiphe alang khat jong dopeh in.
en: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
text:
MAT 5:39
Thadou: Hinlah kaseipeh nahi uve, mi gilou lethuh hih un! Koiham khat in na ngeiphe jetlam abeh'a ahileh, na ngeiphe alang khat jong dopeh in.
English: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

tcz: Chule koi hileh nahehse aum a chule na sangkhol ah alah mang a ahileh na ponchol jong chu pehtha jeng tan.
en: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.
text:
MAT 5:40
Thadou: Chule koi hileh nahehse aum a chule na sangkhol ah alah mang a ahileh na ponchol jong chu pehtha jeng tan.
English: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

tcz: Chule sepai khat in athilpo dia nacham louva, mile khat napui leh mile ni chan gathah peh in.
en: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.
text:
MAT 5:41
Thadou: Chule sepai khat in athilpo dia nacham louva, mile khat napui leh mile ni chan gathah peh in.
English: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

tcz: Na henga thum ho chu pen, chule nangma koma bat a thum chu kihei mangsan go hih in.
en: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
text:
MAT 5:42
Thadou: Na henga thum ho chu pen, chule nangma koma bat a thum chu kihei mangsan go hih in.
English: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

tcz: “Danbu in, ‘Naheng nakom ngailun’ chule namelma chu hot bol in, tia asei chu naja tauve.
en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
text:
MAT 5:43
Thadou: “Danbu in, ‘Naheng nakom ngailun’ chule namelma chu hot bol in, tia asei chu naja tauve.
English: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

tcz: Hinlah keiman kasei ahi, na melma teu chu ngailu uvin, na gaosap teu chu phatthei boh un, na hotbol teu ding in thilpha bol un, chule nahsah mo tah a nabol teu le na gimbol teu ding in taovun.
en: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
text:
MAT 5:44
Thadou: Hinlah keiman kasei ahi, na melma teu chu ngailu uvin, na gaosap teu chu phatthei boh un, na hotbol teu ding in thilpha bol un, chule nahsah mo tah a nabol teu le na gimbol teu ding in taovun.
English: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

tcz: Hitia na bol uchu nangho van'a um na Pau chate tahbeh nahiu kihetna ahi. Ajeh chu Aman migilou le mipha chunga nisa vah apen, chule mi dih le mi dihlou chunga jong go ajuhsah in ahi.
en: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.
text:
MAT 5:45
Thadou: Hitia na bol uchu nangho van'a um na Pau chate tahbeh nahiu kihetna ahi. Ajeh chu Aman migilou le mipha chunga nisa vah apen, chule mi dih le mi dihlou chunga jong go ajuhsah in ahi.
English: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

tcz: Nang hon nangailu teu bou na ngailut uva ahileh, hichea chu ipi kipa man nasan diu um ding ham? Kaidong hon jong hitobang chu abolu ahi.
en: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
text:
MAT 5:46
Thadou: Nang hon nangailu teu bou na ngailut uva ahileh, hichea chu ipi kipa man nasan diu um ding ham? Kaidong hon jong hitobang chu abolu ahi.
English: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

tcz: Nang ho nagol teu dinga bou na phat uva ahileh, midang to ipi naki kheh nau um em? Hitobang chu milim houhon jong abolu ahi.
en: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
text:
MAT 5:47
Thadou: Nang ho nagol teu dinga bou na phat uva ahileh, midang to ipi naki kheh nau um em? Hitobang chu milim houhon jong abolu ahi.
English: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

tcz: Hijeh chun van a um na Pau chamkim ahi bang in, nangho jong chamkim un” ati.
en: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
text:
MAT 5:48
Thadou: Hijeh chun van a um na Pau chamkim ahi bang in, nangho jong chamkim un” ati.
English: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

tcz: Chingtheiyun! Midang pachat nachanna diuvin, mipi mu ding in thilpha bol hih un; chutia nabol leu vana na pauva kona kipa man mulou ding nahi uve.
en: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
text:
MAT 6:1
Thadou: Chingtheiyun! Midang pachat nachanna diuvin, mipi mu ding in thilpha bol hih un; chutia nabol leu vana na pauva kona kipa man mulou ding nahi uve.
English: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

tcz: Ngaichat nei michu thilpeh napeh teng uleh, mi phalhem ho bang in bol hih un; amahon kikhopna in hoa le lamlhong hoa sumkon amut'uvin mi apanpina hou chu miho ahetsah jiuvin ahi. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, amaho hin kipaman amu diu abona akimu'u ahitai.
en: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
text:
MAT 6:2
Thadou: Ngaichat nei michu thilpeh napeh teng uleh, mi phalhem ho bang in bol hih un; amahon kikhopna in hoa le lamlhong hoa sumkon amut'uvin mi apanpina hou chu miho ahetsah jiuvin ahi. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, amaho hin kipaman amu diu abona akimu'u ahitai.
English: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

tcz: Hinlah nangman koiham khat ngaichat thil napeh tengleh, nakhut jetlam in abol chu nakhut veilam hetsah hih in.
en: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,
text:
MAT 6:3
Thadou: Hinlah nangman koiham khat ngaichat thil napeh tengleh, nakhut jetlam in abol chu nakhut veilam hetsah hih in.
English: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,

tcz: Na thilpeh ding ho chu guhthim in pen, ijakai aguh-a mua napa chun nangma kipaman napeh ding ahi.
en: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
text:
MAT 6:4
Thadou: Na thilpeh ding ho chu guhthim in pen, ijakai aguh-a mua napa chun nangma kipaman napeh ding ahi.
English: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

tcz: Nangma natao tengleh, mi phalhem ho banga lamlhong pam leh kikhopna inhoa mitin in amu diu deina a tao nom hoto bang hih in. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, hichu bou ama hon kipaman asan diu chu ahi jenge.
en: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.
text:
MAT 6:5
Thadou: Nangma natao tengleh, mi phalhem ho banga lamlhong pam leh kikhopna inhoa mitin in amu diu deina a tao nom hoto bang hih in. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, hichu bou ama hon kipaman asan diu chu ahi jenge.
English: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

tcz: Hinlah nangma tao dinga nache tengleh nangma changseh chen lang, na nunglam kot khah in chule guhthima mu napa henga taovin. Chuteng napa, ijakai mupa chun, nangma kipa man napeh ding ahi.
en: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
text:
MAT 6:6
Thadou: Hinlah nangma tao dinga nache tengleh nangma changseh chen lang, na nunglam kot khah in chule guhthima mu napa henga taovin. Chuteng napa, ijakai mupa chun, nangma kipa man napeh ding ahi.
English: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

tcz: Nangma natao teng leh, houdang ho bang in naseisa chu avel vel in seikit hih in. Amaho chun taona thucheng aman jiu chu avel vel'a sei jal a ataona chu sanpeh hi dinga aginchat'u ahi.
en: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.
text:
MAT 6:7
Thadou: Nangma natao teng leh, houdang ho bang in naseisa chu avel vel in seikit hih in. Amaho chun taona thucheng aman jiu chu avel vel'a sei jal a ataona chu sanpeh hi dinga aginchat'u ahi.
English: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

tcz: Nangho amaho toh bang hih uvin, ijeh inem itileh vana um na Pauvin na ngaichat'u chu nathum masang uva ahetsa ahitai.
en: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.
text:
MAT 6:8
Thadou: Nangho amaho toh bang hih uvin, ijeh inem itileh vana um na Pauvin na ngaichat'u chu nathum masang uva ahetsa ahitai.
English: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

tcz: Hijeh chun hiti hin taovun: Van'a um ka-Pau, namin jatah in umhen.
en: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
text:
MAT 6:9
Thadou: Hijeh chun hiti hin taovun: Van'a um ka-Pau, namin jatah in umhen.
English: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

tcz: Na lenggam hung lhung loihen, Van'a nalung lhaina aum tobang in lei chunga jong na lung lhaina umhen.
en: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
text:
MAT 6:10
Thadou: Na lenggam hung lhung loihen, Van'a nalung lhaina aum tobang in lei chunga jong na lung lhaina umhen.
English: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

tcz: Tunia kangaichat'u anneh neipeu vin,
en: Give us today our daily bread.
text:
MAT 6:11
Thadou: Tunia kangaichat'u anneh neipeu vin,
English: Give us today our daily bread.

tcz: Keiho douna a chonse ho ka ngaidam bang un, keiho chonsetna jong ngaidam in.
en: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
text:
MAT 6:12
Thadou: Keiho douna a chonse ho ka ngaidam bang un, keiho chonsetna jong ngaidam in.
English: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

tcz: Chule lhepna thua nei nunsah hih un, ahin agiloupa a kon in nei huhdoh uvin.
en: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’
text:
MAT 6:13
Thadou: Chule lhepna thua nei nunsah hih un, ahin agiloupa a kon in nei huhdoh uvin.
English: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

tcz: Nang ho douna chonseho na ngaidam uva ahileh, vana na Pauvin nangho na ngaidam diu ahi.
en: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
text:
MAT 6:14
Thadou: Nang ho douna chonseho na ngaidam uva ahileh, vana na Pauvin nangho na ngaidam diu ahi.
English: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

tcz: Hinlah midang na ngaidam nom lou uva ahileh, na Pauvin nangho chonsetna angaidam lou ding ahi.
en: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
text:
MAT 6:15
Thadou: Hinlah midang na ngaidam nom lou uva ahileh, na Pauvin nangho chonsetna angaidam lou ding ahi.
English: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

tcz: “Chule nang hon an nangol tenguleh, mi pha lhem ho bang in ki nguisah hih un, ijeh inem itile amahon an angolu min ahetna din amaisou alam dansah jiuve. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, amahon kipaman hichea chu akimu-u ahitai.
en: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
text:
MAT 6:16
Thadou: “Chule nang hon an nangol tenguleh, mi pha lhem ho bang in ki nguisah hih un, ijeh inem itile amahon an angolu min ahetna din amaisou alam dansah jiuve. Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi uve, amahon kipaman hichea chu akimu-u ahitai.
English: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

tcz: Hinlah nang man an nangol tengleh, nasam kipon chule namai kiphet in.
en: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
text:
MAT 6:17
Thadou: Hinlah nang man an nangol tengleh, nasam kipon chule namai kiphet in.
English: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

tcz: Chutileh na anngol chu vana napa tailou koiman hepon tin, guhthim a na thilbol mua na Pa chun kipaman napeh ding ahi.
en: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.
text:
MAT 6:18
Thadou: Chutileh na anngol chu vana napa tailou koiman hepon tin, guhthim a na thilbol mua na Pa chun kipaman napeh ding ahi.
English: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.

tcz: “Nget'in aneh heng thei le ap in asuhmang theina, chule gucha hon asuhset uva akiguh thei nau, hiche leiset chunga hin gou khol hih un.
en: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

tcz: Amavang nget le ap in asuh mang thei louna chule gucha hon jong asuhset uva aki guhdoh theilou nau van'a nagouvu kikhol un.
en: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh nagou umna a chu, nalung ngaichat'u jong um ding ahi.
en: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
text:
MAT 6:21
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh nagou umna a chu, nalung ngaichat'u jong um ding ahi.
English: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

tcz: “Namit hi natahsa dinga vahpea pang ahi. Namit aphat pet'a natahsa pumpi hi vahsoh keiya ahi.
en: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
text:
MAT 6:22
Thadou: “Namit hi natahsa dinga vahpea pang ahi. Namit aphat pet'a natahsa pumpi hi vahsoh keiya ahi.
English: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

tcz: Hinlah namit hi aphat lou tengleh natahsa pumpi hi thimsoh jia ahitai. Chule vah neiya na kigel chu, thima hi tahbeh le hiche athim chu iti natsat ding hitam?
en: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
text:
MAT 6:23
Thadou: Hinlah namit hi aphat lou tengleh natahsa pumpi hi thimsoh jia ahitai. Chule vah neiya na kigel chu, thima hi tahbeh le hiche athim chu iti natsat ding hitam?
English: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

tcz: “Mihem koiman pakai ni aneikop theipoi. Ajeh chu aman khat chu thet bol in tin chule khat joh chu ngailun te; nangma khat a naki pehlut ding chule khat joh chu nanah sahmo ding ahi. Nangma Pathen le sum ani gel a lhacha a na pankop thei ahipoi.
en: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.
text:
MAT 6:24
Thadou: “Mihem koiman pakai ni aneikop theipoi. Ajeh chu aman khat chu thet bol in tin chule khat joh chu ngailun te; nangma khat a naki pehlut ding chule khat joh chu nanah sahmo ding ahi. Nangma Pathen le sum ani gel a lhacha a na pankop thei ahipoi.
English: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun nitin nehkhop ding an ahilouleh, twi ahilouleh ponsil thua nalung kham louna diu kaseipeh nahi uve. Hinkho hi an sanga thupi joa chule na tahsa chu ponsil sanga thupi joa hilou ham?
en: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
text:
MAT 6:25
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun nitin nehkhop ding an ahilouleh, twi ahilouleh ponsil thua nalung kham louna diu kaseipeh nahi uve. Hinkho hi an sanga thupi joa chule na tahsa chu ponsil sanga thupi joa hilou ham?
English: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

tcz: “Chunga leng vacha ho khu ven. Ajeh chu amaho khun tula atu pouvin, at la a at pouvin ahilouleh chang pang geiya aneilou vang un, vana um na Pauvin amaho khu avah nai. Chule nangho amaho sanga khu gamchenga na manlut joh'u hilou ham?
en: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
text:
MAT 6:26
Thadou: “Chunga leng vacha ho khu ven. Ajeh chu amaho khun tula atu pouvin, at la a at pouvin ahilouleh chang pang geiya aneilou vang un, vana um na Pauvin amaho khu avah nai. Chule nangho amaho sanga khu gamchenga na manlut joh'u hilou ham?
English: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

tcz: Na lungkham na hou chun, na hinkhou them khat beh ajop saobe theiyem?
en: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
text:
MAT 6:27
Thadou: Na lungkham na hou chun, na hinkhou them khat beh ajop saobe theiyem?
English: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

tcz: Chule sil le chen dinga ibol a lung khama nahiu vem? Lou jaova molhoipah khu ngaito uvin, iti khan'a hiuvin tem? Amaho khun natoh la atong pouvin, aponsil diu jong akibol pouve.
en: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,
text:
MAT 6:28
Thadou: Chule sil le chen dinga ibol a lung khama nahiu vem? Lou jaova molhoipah khu ngaito uvin, iti khan'a hiuvin tem? Amaho khun natoh la atong pouvin, aponsil diu jong akibol pouve.
English: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,

tcz: Ahivang in Solomon chu aloupina jouse pum'in jong hicheho bang'in ahoi joupoi.
en: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.
text:
MAT 6:29
Thadou: Ahivang in Solomon chu aloupina jouse pum'in jong hicheho bang'in ahoi joupoi.
English: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

tcz: Chule Pathen in gamlah a pahcha jeng jong tunia uma chule jing le meisunga kilehlut ding bon hibanga hi ajep hoiya ahileh, nangma ding jong thon louva agel khoh ding ahi. Itia hiti loma hi tahsan na neilou nahiu hin tem?
en: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?
text:
MAT 6:30
Thadou: Chule Pathen in gamlah a pahcha jeng jong tunia uma chule jing le meisunga kilehlut ding bon hibanga hi ajep hoiya ahileh, nangma ding jong thon louva agel khoh ding ahi. Itia hiti loma hi tahsan na neilou nahiu hin tem?
English: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

tcz: “Hijeh chun ipi kaneh diu, ipi kadon diu? Ipi kachen diu hitam? Tin hiche ho thua hin lungkham hih un.
en: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’
text:
MAT 6:31
Thadou: “Hijeh chun ipi kaneh diu, ipi kadon diu? Ipi kachen diu hitam? Tin hiche ho thua hin lungkham hih un.
English: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’

tcz: Hiche lunggel ho hin tahsan lou ho lunggel athu nun ahi, hinlah vana umna Pau chun hiti ho jouse na ngaichat uchu ahet ahi.
en: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
text:
MAT 6:32
Thadou: Hiche lunggel ho hin tahsan lou ho lunggel athu nun ahi, hinlah vana umna Pau chun hiti ho jouse na ngaichat uchu ahet ahi.
English: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

tcz: Hicheng jouse chung vuma chun Pathen Lenggam hol'un, chule chonpha tah in hing uvin, Aman na ngaichat chan'u chu napeh diu ahi.
en: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
text:
MAT 6:33
Thadou: Hicheng jouse chung vuma chun Pathen Lenggam hol'un, chule chonpha tah in hing uvin, Aman na ngaichat chan'u chu napeh diu ahi.
English: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun jinga ding in lungkham hih un, ajeh chu jinga ding hung um nante. Tuni gimna chu tuni khoa ding in apha settai.
en: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
text:
MAT 6:34
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun jinga ding in lungkham hih un, ajeh chu jinga ding hung um nante. Tuni gimna chu tuni khoa ding in apha settai.
English: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

tcz: “Mi koima oimodan, chutile koiman na oimo lou ding ahi.
en: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
text:
MAT 7:1
Thadou: “Mi koima oimodan, chutile koiman na oimo lou ding ahi.
English: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.

tcz: Ajeh chu midang na oimona banga chu, Pathen in na oimo ding ahi. Nangman mi nabolna bang banga chu nachunga kibol ding ahi.
en: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
text:
MAT 7:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu midang na oimona banga chu, Pathen in na oimo ding ahi. Nangman mi nabolna bang banga chu nachunga kibol ding ahi.
English: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

tcz: Chule nangma mit a bohse hal um chu boipi louva, ibol a nasopi mit a bohse hal um chu kisah boipia nahim?
en: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
text:
MAT 7:3
Thadou: Chule nangma mit a bohse hal um chu boipi louva, ibol a nasopi mit a bohse hal um chu kisah boipia nahim?
English: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

tcz: Ahilouleh nangma mit a bohse hal um muthei louva, nasopi jah'a keiman na mit a bohse hal um chu na lahdoh peh inge, iti nati thei ham?
en: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?
text:
MAT 7:4
Thadou: Ahilouleh nangma mit a bohse hal um muthei louva, nasopi jah'a keiman na mit a bohse hal um chu na lahdoh peh inge, iti nati thei ham?
English: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?

tcz: Vo mi phalhem! Nangma mit a bohse hal um chu amasan kilah doh le chun, nagol mit a bohse hal um chu ki chentah in muthei tan nate.
en: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.
text:
MAT 7:5
Thadou: Vo mi phalhem! Nangma mit a bohse hal um chu amasan kilah doh le chun, nagol mit a bohse hal um chu ki chentah in muthei tan nate.
English: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.

tcz: Uicha ho khu thil theng pe hih un, chule vohcha ho ang sunga khun twikoh chang jong lehlha hih un, chuti bol leu chun hichu akeng uvin chil'un tin chule hung kile heiyuva nangho jong nahin bah diu ahi.
en: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.
text:
MAT 7:6
Thadou: Uicha ho khu thil theng pe hih un, chule vohcha ho ang sunga khun twikoh chang jong lehlha hih un, chuti bol leu chun hichu akeng uvin chil'un tin chule hung kile heiyuva nangho jong nahin bah diu ahi.
English: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

tcz: “Na thum uchu thum jomun, chutileh na thum uchu nakipe diu ahi; na holu chu holjom un chutileh na holu chu namu diu ahi. Nakiu uchu kiu jom un chutileh nakiu uchu kot ki honpeh ding nahiuve.
en: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
text:
MAT 7:7
Thadou: “Na thum uchu thum jomun, chutileh na thum uchu nakipe diu ahi; na holu chu holjom un chutileh na holu chu namu diu ahi. Nakiu uchu kiu jom un chutileh nakiu uchu kot ki honpeh ding nahiuve.
English: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

tcz: Ajeh chu athum chan akipen, ahol chan achang uve. Chule akiu chan kot aki honpeh in ahi.
en: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
text:
MAT 7:8
Thadou: Ajeh chu athum chan akipen, ahol chan achang uve. Chule akiu chan kot aki honpeh in ahi.
English: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

tcz: Nangho minu mipa ten, na chate uvin changlhah pheng athum leh, hiche khel achu song napeh uvem?
en: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
text:
MAT 7:9
Thadou: Nangho minu mipa ten, na chate uvin changlhah pheng athum leh, hiche khel achu song napeh uvem?
English: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

tcz: Ahilouleh amahon nga thum leu, amaho chu gul nape diuvem? Napeh lou diu ahi.
en: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?
text:
MAT 7:10
Thadou: Ahilouleh amahon nga thum leu, amaho chu gul nape diuvem? Napeh lou diu ahi.
English: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

tcz: Chutia nangho chonset bol hon bon na chateu thilpha man beiya pehje nahet uva ahileh, hisanga chu gam chenga vana na Pau chun akoma thumte chu thilpha manbeiya apeh lou ding ham?
en: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
text:
MAT 7:11
Thadou: Chutia nangho chonset bol hon bon na chateu thilpha man beiya pehje nahet uva ahileh, hisanga chu gam chenga vana na Pau chun akoma thumte chu thilpha manbeiya apeh lou ding ham?
English: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

tcz: Hijeh chun imalam jousea mi dang in iti nabol leu na dei uvem, hitobang chun nang hon jong bol un. Hiche hi Dan bua kisun leh Themgao ho thuhil chu ahi.”
en: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
text:
MAT 7:12
Thadou: Hijeh chun imalam jousea mi dang in iti nabol leu na dei uvem, hitobang chun nang hon jong bol un. Hiche hi Dan bua kisun leh Themgao ho thuhil chu ahi.”
English: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

tcz: “Nangho Pathen Lenggama chu kot jima kona bou nalut thei diu ahi. Ajeh chu manthahna lam lhong chu lenpi tah ahin, chule akot jong jaotah ahin, chua lut ding kilhen'a chu mi tamtah ahiuve.
en: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.
text:
MAT 7:13
Thadou: “Nangho Pathen Lenggama chu kot jima kona bou nalut thei diu ahi. Ajeh chu manthahna lam lhong chu lenpi tah ahin, chule akot jong jaotah ahin, chua lut ding kilhen'a chu mi tamtah ahiuve.
English: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.

tcz: Hinlah Hinna kot chu akichi lheh in, chule alampi jong ahah in chule mi lhomcha bouvin akimu diu ahi.”
en: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.
text:
MAT 7:14
Thadou: Hinlah Hinna kot chu akichi lheh in, chule alampi jong ahah in chule mi lhomcha bouvin akimu diu ahi.”
English: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.

tcz: “Na heng uva hung jia themgao lhem ho, kelngoi vona kivona ahia asunglam ngei hangtah ho chu kichih theiyun.
en: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
text:
MAT 7:15
Thadou: “Na heng uva hung jia themgao lhem ho, kelngoi vona kivona ahia asunglam ngei hangtah ho chu kichih theiyun.
English: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

tcz: Nanghon amaho chu agauva, tichu achon nauva kona na hetdoh thei diu ahi: Mihon lingnang lah a kona lengpi ga alo jiuva, ahilouleh ling phunga kona theichang ga alo ngai jiu vem?
en: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?
text:
MAT 7:16
Thadou: Nanghon amaho chu agauva, tichu achon nauva kona na hetdoh thei diu ahi: Mihon lingnang lah a kona lengpi ga alo jiuva, ahilouleh ling phunga kona theichang ga alo ngai jiu vem?
English: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?

tcz: Thingphung pha chun gapha asodoh in, chule thingphung phalou chun ga phalou asodoh ji ahi.
en: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
text:
MAT 7:17
Thadou: Thingphung pha chun gapha asodoh in, chule thingphung phalou chun ga phalou asodoh ji ahi.
English: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.

tcz: Thingphung pha chun ga phalou asodoh theipon, chule thingphung phalouvin jong gapha asodoh theipoi.
en: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.
text:
MAT 7:18
Thadou: Thingphung pha chun ga phalou asodoh theipon, chule thingphung phalouvin jong gapha asodoh theipoi.
English: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.

tcz: Hitia chu thingphung gapha sodoh louse chu kiphuh lhua chule mei sunga kileh lutji ahi.
en: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
text:
MAT 7:19
Thadou: Hitia chu thingphung gapha sodoh louse chu kiphuh lhua chule mei sunga kileh lutji ahi.
English: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

tcz: Hijeh chun thingphung chu aga a kona hetdoh theina nanei bang un, miho chu achon nauva kona nang hon ahinau na hetdoh thei diu ahi.”
en: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
text:
MAT 7:20
Thadou: Hijeh chun thingphung chu aga a kona hetdoh theina nanei bang un, miho chu achon nauva kona nang hon ahinau na hetdoh thei diu ahi.”
English: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

tcz: “Keima, Pakai! Pakai! tia eikou tapou chu Van gam lut ding ahipoi. Vana kapa lunglhaina bol ho bou chu lut ding ahi.
en: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
text:
MAT 7:21
Thadou: “Keima, Pakai! Pakai! tia eikou tapou chu Van gam lut ding ahipoi. Vana kapa lunglhaina bol ho bou chu lut ding ahi.
English: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

tcz: Thutan nikho leh mitampi chun kajah a, Pakai! Pakai! Nangma min in gaothu kaseiyun, chule nangma min in thilha ho kano doh uvin, chule nangma min in thilbol theina kidang kaboldoh uve atidiu ahi.
en: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’
text:
MAT 7:22
Thadou: Thutan nikho leh mitampi chun kajah a, Pakai! Pakai! Nangma min in gaothu kaseiyun, chule nangma min in thilha ho kano doh uvin, chule nangma min in thilbol theina kidang kaboldoh uve atidiu ahi.
English: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’

tcz: Hinlah keiman, ‘Nangho itih in jong kahekha pouve. Pathen dan thu palkeh a nangho, ka koma kon in potdoh'un,’ tia ka donbut diu ahi.”
en: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
text:
MAT 7:23
Thadou: Hinlah keiman, ‘Nangho itih in jong kahekha pouve. Pathen dan thu palkeh a nangho, ka koma kon in potdoh'un,’ tia ka donbut diu ahi.”
English: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’

tcz: “Kathuhil ngaiya chule jui chan chu koi hijongleh, miching songpi chunga in kisahpa tobang ahi.
en: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.
text:
MAT 7:24
Thadou: “Kathuhil ngaiya chule jui chan chu koi hijongleh, miching songpi chunga in kisahpa tobang ahi.
English: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.

tcz: Go hungju henlang, twi hungsoh hen chule hui hungnung henlang, hiche inchu hinsu jongleh, songpi chunga kisa ahijeh a chu lhulou ding ahi.
en: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.
text:
MAT 7:25
Thadou: Go hungju henlang, twi hungsoh hen chule hui hungnung henlang, hiche inchu hinsu jongleh, songpi chunga kisa ahijeh a chu lhulou ding ahi.
English: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

tcz: Hinlah ka thuhil ngaiya ahia la juilou chan chu mingol, nel lei chunga insa tobang ahi.
en: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.
text:
MAT 7:26
Thadou: Hinlah ka thuhil ngaiya ahia la juilou chan chu mingol, nel lei chunga insa tobang ahi.
English: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

tcz: Go ahung juh a twi chu ahung soa chule hui chun hiche inchu asuh'a ahileh gimnei tah'in alhupai jeng tai,” ati.
en: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”
text:
MAT 7:27
Thadou: Go ahung juh a twi chu ahung soa chule hui chun hiche inchu asuh'a ahileh gimnei tah'in alhupai jeng tai,” ati.
English: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”

tcz: Yeshuan hicheng thu aseijou vin, mipi chun athu hil kidang asalheh jeng uve.
en: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
text:
MAT 7:28
Thadou: Yeshuan hicheng thu aseijou vin, mipi chun athu hil kidang asalheh jeng uve.
English: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

tcz: Ajeh chu aman hou lamkai ho thuhil tobanga hillouvin, thunei tah in thu ahil in ahi.
en: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
text:
MAT 7:29
Thadou: Ajeh chu aman hou lamkai ho thuhil tobanga hillouvin, thunei tah in thu ahil in ahi.
English: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

tcz: Chujouvin Yeshua mol chunga kona ahung kuma ahileh, mipi atama tam'in anung ajuiyuvin ahi.
en: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
text:
MAT 8:1
Thadou: Chujouvin Yeshua mol chunga kona ahung kuma ahileh, mipi atama tam'in anung ajuiyuvin ahi.
English: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

tcz: Photlot in, “Miphah khat'in Ama akimu pin chule a-anga abohkhup in, ajah a, Pakai nalung ahileh nei damsah a chule nei thensah thei ahi,” ahung titai.
en: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
text:
MAT 8:2
Thadou: Photlot in, “Miphah khat'in Ama akimu pin chule a-anga abohkhup in, ajah a, Pakai nalung ahileh nei damsah a chule nei thensah thei ahi,” ahung titai.
English: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan akhut alhang in chule athamin, “Kalung ahi, dam jeng in, atin ahileh apattah in aphah chu atheng tan ahi.”
en: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
text:
MAT 8:3
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan akhut alhang in chule athamin, “Kalung ahi, dam jeng in, atin ahileh apattah in aphah chu atheng tan ahi.”
English: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah a, “Hiche thudol hi koima koma seihih in, chusang in nangma thempu koma gachen lang chule aman nave chil hen. Mose Danbua miphah ho athen teng thupehsa thilto ding chu gatoh tan. Hiche hi nathengtai ti ahetna, mipi lah'a na phondohna hiding ahi,” ati.
en: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”
text:
MAT 8:4
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan ajah a, “Hiche thudol hi koima koma seihih in, chusang in nangma thempu koma gachen lang chule aman nave chil hen. Mose Danbua miphah ho athen teng thupehsa thilto ding chu gatoh tan. Hiche hi nathengtai ti ahetna, mipi lah'a na phondohna hiding ahi,” ati.
English: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

tcz: Chule Yeshua Capernaum ahung kile phat in, Rome Sepai jalamkai khat ahenga ahung in chule ama chu atem in,
en: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,
text:
MAT 8:5
Thadou: Chule Yeshua Capernaum ahung kile phat in, Rome Sepai jalamkai khat ahenga ahung in chule ama chu atem in,
English: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,

tcz: “Pakai, kasohpa alangthia ahin, jalkhun'a alume chule anatna chu athohlel lheh in ahi,” ati.
en: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”
text:
MAT 8:6
Thadou: “Pakai, kasohpa alangthia ahin, jalkhun'a alume chule anatna chu athohlel lheh in ahi,” ati.
English: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”

tcz: Yeshuan ajah a, “Keima hung ingting chule kahung damsah ding ahi,” ati.
en: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”
text:
MAT 8:7
Thadou: Yeshuan ajah a, “Keima hung ingting chule kahung damsah ding ahi,” ati.
English: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”

tcz: Hinlah sepai jalamkaipa chun, “Pakai, nangman ka-in neihung chotlut peh dinga lhingjou chu kahi poi. Na umna mun'ah thu chu hinsei lechun, kasohpa hi dam tante.”
en: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
text:
MAT 8:8
Thadou: Hinlah sepai jalamkaipa chun, “Pakai, nangman ka-in neihung chotlut peh dinga lhingjou chu kahi poi. Na umna mun'ah thu chu hinsei lechun, kasohpa hi dam tante.”
English: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

tcz: Hiche hi kahei, ajeh chu keima kachunga thunei lamkai lenho aum in chule keiman sepaite chunga thu kaneiye. Keiman, “Che uvin katileh ache uvin, ahilouleh hung un, katileh amaho ahung uve. Chule keiman kasohte jah a, ‘Hiche hi bol un katileh, amahon abol'uve,’” ati.
en: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
text:
MAT 8:9
Thadou: Hiche hi kahei, ajeh chu keima kachunga thunei lamkai lenho aum in chule keiman sepaite chunga thu kaneiye. Keiman, “Che uvin katileh ache uvin, ahilouleh hung un, katileh amaho ahung uve. Chule keiman kasohte jah a, ‘Hiche hi bol un katileh, amahon abol'uve,’” ati.
English: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

tcz: Yeshuan hichu ajah phat in adatmo lheh jenge. Aman anung juiho jah'a aseiyin, “Thudih tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, Israel ho jouse lah'ah hitobang tahsan hi kamu khapoi.
en: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.
text:
MAT 8:10
Thadou: Yeshuan hichu ajah phat in adatmo lheh jenge. Aman anung juiho jah'a aseiyin, “Thudih tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, Israel ho jouse lah'ah hitobang tahsan hi kamu khapoi.
English: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

tcz: Chule hiche hi kaseipeh nahiuve, chidang namdang ho mi tamtah vannoi mun tina kona hung diu solama kon le lhum lama kona Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob toh Van gam'a golvah an nea tou ding ahiuve.
en: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,
text:
MAT 8:11
Thadou: Chule hiche hi kaseipeh nahiuve, chidang namdang ho mi tamtah vannoi mun tina kona hung diu solama kon le lhum lama kona Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob toh Van gam'a golvah an nea tou ding ahiuve.
English: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,
