en: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
text:
MAT 8:12
Thadou: Hinlah Israel mi tamtah ho adiuva lenggam kigon peh ho chu polam muthim lah'a ale lut dingu, hichea chu ka le hagel um ding ahi,” ati.
English: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

tcz: Chutah in Yeshuan Rome sepai jalamkaipa jah a aseiyin, “In lama kile tan. Ijeh inem itileh nangman na tahsan chu aguilhung tai,” ati. Chule soh khang dongpa chu apattah chun adamtai.
en: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.
text:
MAT 8:13
Thadou: Chutah in Yeshuan Rome sepai jalamkaipa jah a aseiyin, “In lama kile tan. Ijeh inem itileh nangman na tahsan chu aguilhung tai,” ati. Chule soh khang dongpa chu apattah chun adamtai.
English: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.

tcz: Yeshua Peter In ahung lhun phat in, Peter jinu nu chu alupna a khosih natna neiya leltah a uma ahi.
en: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.
text:
MAT 8:14
Thadou: Yeshua Peter In ahung lhun phat in, Peter jinu nu chu alupna a khosih natna neiya leltah a uma ahi.
English: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan ama chu akhut athampeh in ahileh, akhosih chun adalhatai. Chuin ama athoudoh in Ama ding chun anneh ding agong in ahi.
en: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.
text:
MAT 8:15
Thadou: Hinlah Yeshuan ama chu akhut athampeh in ahileh, akhosih chun adalhatai. Chuin ama athoudoh in Ama ding chun anneh ding agong in ahi.
English: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.

tcz: Nilhah ahiphat in lhagaoboh vop mi tamtah Yeshua henga ahin pui tauvin. Aman lhagao gilou ho chu thu apen adamlou jouse chu aboldam tai.
en: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,
text:
MAT 8:16
Thadou: Nilhah ahiphat in lhagaoboh vop mi tamtah Yeshua henga ahin pui tauvin. Aman lhagao gilou ho chu thu apen adamlou jouse chu aboldam tai.
English: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,

tcz: Hiche hin Pakai thu Isaiah themgao in asei, “Aman inatnau aladoh in chule ihiveiyu ala mangtai,” atichu aguilhunsah e.
en: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”
text:
MAT 8:17
Thadou: Hiche hin Pakai thu Isaiah themgao in asei, “Aman inatnau aladoh in chule ihiveiyu ala mangtai,” atichu aguilhunsah e.
English: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”

tcz: Yeshuan mihonpi akimvel'a aum amun, aman aseijuite chu dil langkhat a galkai ding in thu apen ahi.
en: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.
text:
MAT 8:18
Thadou: Yeshuan mihonpi akimvel'a aum amun, aman aseijuite chu dil langkhat a galkai ding in thu apen ahi.
English: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

tcz: Chuphat in Hou dan thuhil ho khat in ajah a, “Houhil, na chena chan'ah najui inge,” ati.
en: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”
text:
MAT 8:19
Thadou: Chuphat in Hou dan thuhil ho khat in ajah a, “Houhil, na chena chan'ah najui inge,” ati.
English: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan adonbut in, “Sial hon chenna ding ko aneiyun, chule vacha hon gena ding bu aneiyui, hinlah Mihem Chapan alu ngapna ding mun jeng jong aneipoi,” ati.
en: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”
text:
MAT 8:20
Thadou: Hinlah Yeshuan adonbut in, “Sial hon chenna ding ko aneiyun, chule vacha hon gena ding bu aneiyui, hinlah Mihem Chapan alu ngapna ding mun jeng jong aneipoi,” ati.
English: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”

tcz: Aseijui dang khat in ajah a, “Pakai, in a gakile masang ting kapa gavui inge” ati.
en: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
text:
MAT 8:21
Thadou: Aseijui dang khat in ajah a, “Pakai, in a gakile masang ting kapa gavui inge” ati.
English: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan aseipeh in ajah a, “Tun neijui in. Lhagaova thihon ami thiu kivui nau vinte,” ati.
en: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”
text:
MAT 8:22
Thadou: Hinlah Yeshuan aseipeh in ajah a, “Tun neijui in. Lhagaova thihon ami thiu kivui nau vinte,” ati.
English: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshua kong sunga alut in, chule aseijuite chutoh dil langkhat panga chun agalkai pan tauve.
en: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.
text:
MAT 8:23
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua kong sunga alut in, chule aseijuite chutoh dil langkhat panga chun agalkai pan tauve.
English: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

tcz: Phutlot chang in, twipi kinong in dil chu ahin nuh in, chule twi kinong ho chun kong chu ahin nuh a ahileh kong sunga aluttai; hinlah Ama a'imun ahi.
en: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.
text:
MAT 8:24
Thadou: Phutlot chang in, twipi kinong in dil chu ahin nuh in, chule twi kinong ho chun kong chu ahin nuh a ahileh kong sunga aluttai; hinlah Ama a'imun ahi.
English: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.

tcz: Seijui ho chu aga che uvin, chule asukhang un, akou un, “Pakai nei huhdoh un, twiyin eichup diu ahitai,” atiuve.
en: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”
text:
MAT 8:25
Thadou: Seijui ho chu aga che uvin, chule asukhang un, akou un, “Pakai nei huhdoh un, twiyin eichup diu ahitai,” atiuve.
English: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Ipi dinga kicha a nahiu vem? Tahsanna neocha jong nanei lou uham?” ati. Chuphat in Ama aki patdoh in chule huipi le twipi kinong chu aphoh in, chuin phulou helouvin athip paitai.
en: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.
text:
MAT 8:26
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Ipi dinga kicha a nahiu vem? Tahsanna neocha jong nanei lou uham?” ati. Chuphat in Ama aki patdoh in chule huipi le twipi kinong chu aphoh in, chuin phulou helouvin athip paitai.
English: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

tcz: Seijui ho chun adatmo lheh'uvin, “Hiche mipa hi koi ham? Huipi le twipi kinong Ama thun anunge,” atiuve.
en: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
text:
MAT 8:27
Thadou: Seijui ho chun adatmo lheh'uvin, “Hiche mipa hi koi ham? Huipi le twipi kinong Ama thun anunge,” atiuve.
English: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

tcz: Yeshua chu dil langkhat pang agei tan, Gadarene gamkai alhung in ahileh lhagaoboh vop minin aki mupi lhon e. Amani chu lhan mun'a chengden lhona chule gilou huham behseh ahijeh lhon a, koiman hiche lam chu ahopa ngam lou ahi.
en: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.
text:
MAT 8:28
Thadou: Yeshua chu dil langkhat pang agei tan, Gadarene gamkai alhung in ahileh lhagaoboh vop minin aki mupi lhon e. Amani chu lhan mun'a chengden lhona chule gilou huham behseh ahijeh lhon a, koiman hiche lam chu ahopa ngam lou ahi.
English: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

tcz: Amani chun ahinsam lhon in, ajah a, “Pathen Chapa, koi nahi hiya neihung suhboiyu ham? Nangma Pathen phat tep masanga hikom muna hi eisugim diuva hunga nahim?” ati lhon e.
en: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”
text:
MAT 8:29
Thadou: Amani chun ahinsam lhon in, ajah a, “Pathen Chapa, koi nahi hiya neihung suhboiyu ham? Nangma Pathen phat tep masanga hikom muna hi eisugim diuva hunga nahim?” ati lhon e.
English: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”

tcz: Mun gamla tah a vohcha hon tampi loujaova lha a um uva ahi.
en: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.
text:
MAT 8:30
Thadou: Mun gamla tah a vohcha hon tampi loujaova lha a um uva ahi.
English: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

tcz: Hiti chun Lhagaoboh vop teni chu atao lhon in, “Nei nodoh diuva ahileh vohcha hon sunga khun neisol un,” atiuve.
en: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”
text:
MAT 8:31
Thadou: Hiti chun Lhagaoboh vop teni chu atao lhon in, “Nei nodoh diuva ahileh vohcha hon sunga khun neisol un,” atiuve.
English: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”

tcz: Yeshuan amaho chu thu apen, “Aphai, che uvin,” ati. Hiti chun lhagaoboh ho chu mitenia konin ahung potdoh un, chuin vohcha ho sunga chun alut tauvin, chule vohcha jouse chu abon'un mol pang dillen sunga chun alhai lha uvin, twi lah'a chun alhalut gam tauve.
en: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.
text:
MAT 8:32
Thadou: Yeshuan amaho chu thu apen, “Aphai, che uvin,” ati. Hiti chun lhagaoboh ho chu mitenia konin ahung potdoh un, chuin vohcha ho sunga chun alut tauvin, chule vohcha jouse chu abon'un mol pang dillen sunga chun alhai lha uvin, twi lah'a chun alhalut gam tauve.
English: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.

tcz: Gancha chinga pang ho chu akoma khopia chun alhai lut un, lhagaoboh vop teni chunga thilsoh thudol chu amitakip aseipeh tauve.
en: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.
text:
MAT 8:33
Thadou: Gancha chinga pang ho chu akoma khopia chun alhai lut un, lhagaoboh vop teni chunga thilsoh thudol chu amitakip aseipeh tauve.
English: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

tcz: Chuphat in khopia miho jouse chu ahung potdoh un, Yeshua ahung kimu piuvin, amahon Yeshua chu ache mang'a chule amaho adalhahna diuvin atem un ahi.
en: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.
text:
MAT 8:34
Thadou: Chuphat in khopia miho jouse chu ahung potdoh un, Yeshua ahung kimu piuvin, amahon Yeshua chu ache mang'a chule amaho adalhahna diuvin atem un ahi.
English: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua kong khat'a akaldoh in chule dil chu agal kaiyin, ama khomun ahung kiletai.
en: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.
text:
MAT 9:1
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua kong khat'a akaldoh in chule dil chu agal kaiyin, ama khomun ahung kiletai.
English: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.

tcz: Mi phabep chun langthi khat alupna pum in akoma ahinpui uve. Aman atahsan'u chu amu phat in langthipa jah a chun Yeshuan, “Lung nom in, ka chapa! Na chonsetna ho kingaidam ahitai,” ati.
en: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”
text:
MAT 9:2
Thadou: Mi phabep chun langthi khat alupna pum in akoma ahinpui uve. Aman atahsan'u chu amu phat in langthipa jah a chun Yeshuan, “Lung nom in, ka chapa! Na chonsetna ho kingaidam ahitai,” ati.
English: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

tcz: Hinlah Hou danthu hil phabep chu amaho le amaho aki hou un, “Hiche hi Pathen taitomna ahi! Ama Pathen a kingaitoa ham?” atiuve.
en: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”
text:
MAT 9:3
Thadou: Hinlah Hou danthu hil phabep chu amaho le amaho aki hou un, “Hiche hi Pathen taitomna ahi! Ama Pathen a kingaitoa ham?” atiuve.
English: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”

tcz: Yeshuan alung'uva ipi angaitou chu ahen, hijeh chun amaho adong in, “Ipi dinga chutobang lunggel gitlouna ho nalung'uva naneiyu ham?
en: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?
text:
MAT 9:4
Thadou: Yeshuan alung'uva ipi angaitou chu ahen, hijeh chun amaho adong in, “Ipi dinga chutobang lunggel gitlouna ho nalung'uva naneiyu ham?
English: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?

tcz: Nachonset ho kingaidam ahitai, tia sei, ahilouleh ‘Dingdoh in, chule lamjot in’ ti hoijoh baijo ham?”
en: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?
text:
MAT 9:5
Thadou: Nachonset ho kingaidam ahitai, tia sei, ahilouleh ‘Dingdoh in, chule lamjot in’ ti hoijoh baijo ham?”
English: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?

tcz: Hijeh achu Mihem Chapan leiset chunga chonset ngaidam jouna thaneina aneiye ti photchenna kapeh ding nahiuve atin, chuin Yeshua langthipa lama akiheiyin aseiyin, “Dingdoh in, nalupna kichoiyin, chule in-a chen!” ati.
en: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”
text:
MAT 9:6
Thadou: Hijeh achu Mihem Chapan leiset chunga chonset ngaidam jouna thaneina aneiye ti photchenna kapeh ding nahiuve atin, chuin Yeshua langthipa lama akiheiyin aseiyin, “Dingdoh in, nalupna kichoiyin, chule in-a chen!” ati.
English: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”

tcz: Chuin ama chu ahung kichop doh thon, chule in-a achetai!
en: He arose and departed to his house.
text:
MAT 9:7
Thadou: Chuin ama chu ahung kichop doh thon, chule in-a achetai!
English: He arose and departed to his house.

tcz: Hiche thilsoh hin mihonpi chu alungu kichatnan alo dimtai. Chule amahon hitobang tah a thuneina nei, mihem ahinsol jeh hin Pathen avahchoi tauve.
en: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
text:
MAT 9:8
Thadou: Hiche thilsoh hin mihonpi chu alungu kichatnan alo dimtai. Chule amahon hitobang tah a thuneina nei, mihem ahinsol jeh hin Pathen avahchoi tauve.
English: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua avalea ahileh, mikhat Matthew kitipa chu kai adonna muna atou amun, ajah a, “Neijuiyin chule kaseijui in pang in,” ati. Hi chun Matthew akipatdoh in anung ajuitai.
en: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.
text:
MAT 9:9
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua avalea ahileh, mikhat Matthew kitipa chu kai adonna muna atou amun, ajah a, “Neijuiyin chule kaseijui in pang in,” ati. Hi chun Matthew akipatdoh in anung ajuitai.
English: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin, Matthew in Yeshua le Aseijuite ho toh chun kaidong adang ho chule midang minphatna neilou chonse ho chu jin-gun in a-ina akouvin ahi.
en: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
text:
MAT 9:10
Thadou: Chomkhat jouvin, Matthew in Yeshua le Aseijuite ho toh chun kaidong adang ho chule midang minphatna neilou chonse ho chu jin-gun in a-ina akouvin ahi.
English: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

tcz: Hinlah Pharisee hon hichu amu phat un aseijuite adong un, itia na jilkung pauvin amot mot'a thusei ho toh an aneh khom ham? atiuve.
en: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
text:
MAT 9:11
Thadou: Hinlah Pharisee hon hichu amu phat un aseijuite adong un, itia na jilkung pauvin amot mot'a thusei ho toh an aneh khom ham? atiuve.
English: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

tcz: Yeshuan hiche thu ajah phat in, “Mi damthei hon louthem angaicha pouve, ana damlou hon bou angai chauve,” ati.
en: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
text:
MAT 9:12
Thadou: Yeshuan hiche thu ajah phat in, “Mi damthei hon louthem angaicha pouve, ana damlou hon bou angai chauve,” ati.
English: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

tcz: Aman aseiben, “Tun cheuvin chule Pathen Thubun ipi asei ahi ga kihil un: Keiman khotona bou kangeh ahin, kilhaina nabol diu ahipoi. Ajeh chu keima midih a kigel ho kouva hunga kahipon, chonse ahi kihet ho bou kouva hunga kahi,” ati.
en: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
text:
MAT 9:13
Thadou: Aman aseiben, “Tun cheuvin chule Pathen Thubun ipi asei ahi ga kihil un: Keiman khotona bou kangeh ahin, kilhaina nabol diu ahipoi. Ajeh chu keima midih a kigel ho kouva hunga kahipon, chonse ahi kihet ho bou kouva hunga kahi,” ati.
English: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

tcz: Nikhat hi John Baptist seijuiho chu Yeshua henga ahung un chule adong un, ipi iti dana keiho le Pharisee hon an ka ngol jiu tobanga na seijuiten an angol lou-u hintem? atiuve.
en: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”
text:
MAT 9:14
Thadou: Nikhat hi John Baptist seijuiho chu Yeshua henga ahung un chule adong un, ipi iti dana keiho le Pharisee hon an ka ngol jiu tobanga na seijuiten an angol lou-u hintem? atiuve.
English: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Golvah kibolna a jin ho chun moulang toh akipa khom pet'uva alunghem'u ngaiyintem? Chuti ponte. Ahinlah moulang chu nikhat le amahoa kona kipui mang ding ahi, chutah le an angol diu ahi.”
en: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
text:
MAT 9:15
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Golvah kibolna a jin ho chun moulang toh akipa khom pet'uva alunghem'u ngaiyintem? Chuti ponte. Ahinlah moulang chu nikhat le amahoa kona kipui mang ding ahi, chutah le an angol diu ahi.”
English: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

tcz: “Ajeh chu koiman ponsop nem lou ahal chun ponlui abeh jipoi, achutibol le abehna chun hiche pon chu aloi-eh ding ahi.”
en: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.
text:
MAT 9:16
Thadou: “Ajeh chu koiman ponsop nem lou ahal chun ponlui abeh jipoi, achutibol le abehna chun hiche pon chu aloi-eh ding ahi.”
English: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

tcz: “Chukal valin koiman lengpitwi thah chu abom luiya akoiji poi. Ajeh chu abom lui chu pohkeh intin, chule lengpitwi chu jal ding, akoina bom chu seding ahitai. Lengpitwi thah chu abom thah a ikhum leh ania huhbit a um ding ahi,” ati.
en: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”
text:
MAT 9:17
Thadou: “Chukal valin koiman lengpitwi thah chu abom luiya akoiji poi. Ajeh chu abom lui chu pohkeh intin, chule lengpitwi chu jal ding, akoina bom chu seding ahitai. Lengpitwi thah chu abom thah a ikhum leh ania huhbit a um ding ahi,” ati.
English: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”

tcz: Yeshuan hiche thuho asei laiyin kikhopna in vaipopa chu ahung in chule amasanga ahung dilsun, “Kachanu tupet tah chun athi” hinlah nangma na hunga chule achunga nakhut na ngap'a ahileh nahinsah kit thei ding ahi, ahungti.
en: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”
text:
MAT 9:18
Thadou: Yeshuan hiche thuho asei laiyin kikhopna in vaipopa chu ahung in chule amasanga ahung dilsun, “Kachanu tupet tah chun athi” hinlah nangma na hunga chule achunga nakhut na ngap'a ahileh nahinsah kit thei ding ahi, ahungti.
English: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

tcz: Hiti chun Yeshua le Aseijuite chu akipatdoh un, chule amato chun akilhon un ahi.
en: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
text:
MAT 9:19
Thadou: Hiti chun Yeshua le Aseijuite chu akipatdoh un, chule amato chun akilhon un ahi.
English: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

tcz: Chupet tah chun numei khat athilon tang louva gimthoh nu chu anung lama ahunge. Amanu hin apon mongkai chu ahung tham e.
en: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

tcz: Ajeh chu ama nun agel chu, keiman apon mongkai khu thamkha jeng jong leng kadam ding ahi, ati.
en: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”
text:
MAT 9:21
Thadou: Ajeh chu ama nun agel chu, keiman apon mongkai khu thamkha jeng jong leng kadam ding ahi, ati.
English: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

tcz: Yeshua akihei kimvel in chule aman amanu chu amuphat in ajah a, “Chanu lungthoi hih in! Natasan in nadam thengsah ahitai,” ati. Chuche pettah chun amanu chu adam paitai.
en: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.
text:
MAT 9:22
Thadou: Yeshua akihei kimvel in chule aman amanu chu amuphat in ajah a, “Chanu lungthoi hih in! Natasan in nadam thengsah ahitai,” ati. Chuche pettah chun amanu chu adam paitai.
English: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

tcz: Kikhopna vaipopa in a Yeshua alhun phat in mihonpi chu achoh thethu jeng un chule thi opna a kimut theile ging chu ajatai.
en: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,
text:
MAT 9:23
Thadou: Kikhopna vaipopa in a Yeshua alhun phat in mihonpi chu achoh thethu jeng un chule thi opna a kimut theile ging chu ajatai.
English: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,

tcz: Amaho jah'a chun, “Potdoh tem un, chapang nu hi athia ahipoi, amahi a-ihmua ahibouve” ati. Hinlah mihonpi chun anuisat tauve.
en: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.
text:
MAT 9:24
Thadou: Amaho jah'a chun, “Potdoh tem un, chapang nu hi athia ahipoi, amahi a-ihmua ahibouve” ati. Hinlah mihonpi chun anuisat tauve.
English: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.

tcz: Mihonpi chu polama asoldoh jouvin, Yeshua agalut in chule chapang nu chu akhut a atuh in ahileh amanu chu ahung ding dohtai.
en: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
text:
MAT 9:25
Thadou: Mihonpi chu polama asoldoh jouvin, Yeshua agalut in chule chapang nu chu akhut a atuh in ahileh amanu chu ahung ding dohtai.
English: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

tcz: Hiche thil kidang kibol thuthang chu agamkai pumpi'ah akithe chansoh tai.
en: The report of this went out into all that land.
text:
MAT 9:26
Thadou: Hiche thil kidang kibol thuthang chu agamkai pumpi'ah akithe chansoh tai.
English: The report of this went out into all that land.

tcz: Yeshuan numei chapang nu in chu adalhah jouvin, anunga mitcho minin ahinjui peh in, amanin, “David Chapa neikhoto lhon in,” tin asam lhon in ahi.
en: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”
text:
MAT 9:27
Thadou: Yeshuan numei chapang nu in chu adalhah jouvin, anunga mitcho minin ahinjui peh in, amanin, “David Chapa neikhoto lhon in,” tin asam lhon in ahi.
English: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”

tcz: Amani chu aumna insunga ajuilut lhon in, Yeshuan adong in, “Keima hin khomu theina eineisah lhon ding ahi ti natahsan em?” ati. Ama nin adonbut in, henge, Pakai, katahsan lhone, tin asei lhontai.
en: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”
text:
MAT 9:28
Thadou: Amani chu aumna insunga ajuilut lhon in, Yeshuan adong in, “Keima hin khomu theina eineisah lhon ding ahi ti natahsan em?” ati. Ama nin adonbut in, henge, Pakai, katahsan lhone, tin asei lhontai.
English: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”

tcz: Chuphat in Aman amit lhon atham in, chuin, “Natahsan lhon jeh a, hung hithei ding ahi” ati.
en: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”
text:
MAT 9:29
Thadou: Chuphat in Aman amit lhon atham in, chuin, “Natahsan lhon jeh a, hung hithei ding ahi” ati.
English: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”

tcz: Chutah in amit lhon ahah in chule kho amulhon tai. Yeshuan amani agih in, “Hiiche thuhi koima seipeh lhon hih in,” ati.
en: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”
text:
MAT 9:30
Thadou: Chutah in amit lhon ahah in chule kho amulhon tai. Yeshuan amani agih in, “Hiiche thuhi koima seipeh lhon hih in,” ati.
English: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”

tcz: Hinlah amani apotdoh lhon in chuin Amin chu agamkai kimvela aseiphong lhon tai.
en: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
text:
MAT 9:31
Thadou: Hinlah amani apotdoh lhon in chuin Amin chu agamkai kimvela aseiphong lhon tai.
English: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

tcz: Amani apotdoh lhon phat'in lhagaoboh vop mikhat pao theilou chu, Yeshua koma ahin puiyuve.
en: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
text:
MAT 9:32
Thadou: Amani apotdoh lhon phat'in lhagaoboh vop mikhat pao theilou chu, Yeshua koma ahin puiyuve.
English: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

tcz: Hitia Yeshuan lhagaoboh chu anodoh jouvin amapa chu apao theitai. Hichu mi honpin adatmo lheh jeng uvin, “Hitobang hi Israel lah a anasoh khahih hel le,” atiuve.
en: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
text:
MAT 9:33
Thadou: Hitia Yeshuan lhagaoboh chu anodoh jouvin amapa chu apao theitai. Hichu mi honpin adatmo lheh jeng uvin, “Hitobang hi Israel lah a anasoh khahih hel le,” atiuve.
English: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

tcz: Hinlah Pharisee hon, “Aman lhagaoboh chu Lhagaoboh ho Lengpa thahat vanga anodoh ahi,” atiuve.
en: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”
text:
MAT 9:34
Thadou: Hinlah Pharisee hon, “Aman lhagaoboh chu Lhagaoboh ho Lengpa thahat vanga anodoh ahi,” atiuve.
English: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”

tcz: Yeshua chuche gamkaiya khopi tinle khoneo tin a avahlen, akikhop nau inhoa thu ahil in, chule Lenggam Kipana Thupha chu aseiphong in ahi. Chuin Aman hivei ho le ana damlou ho aboldam in ahi.
en: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
text:
MAT 9:35
Thadou: Yeshua chuche gamkaiya khopi tinle khoneo tin a avahlen, akikhop nau inhoa thu ahil in, chule Lenggam Kipana Thupha chu aseiphong in ahi. Chuin Aman hivei ho le ana damlou ho aboldam in ahi.
English: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

tcz: Aman mihonpi amu phat'in, Aman amaho chu akhoto lheh e, ajeh chu amaho chu alungdong uvin chule panpi bei ahiuvin, kelngoi achingbei tobang ahiu amudoh in ahi.
en: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.
text:
MAT 9:36
Thadou: Aman mihonpi amu phat'in, Aman amaho chu akhoto lheh e, ajeh chu amaho chu alungdong uvin chule panpi bei ahiuvin, kelngoi achingbei tobang ahiu amudoh in ahi.
English: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

tcz: Aman Aseijuite koma aseiyin, “Chang at ding atam lheh in, hinlah anatong ding alhom e.
en: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
text:
MAT 9:37
Thadou: Aman Aseijuite koma aseiyin, “Chang at ding atam lheh in, hinlah anatong ding alhom e.
English: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

tcz: Hijeh chun chang atna lou muna natong ding ahin soldoh theina ding in, lou neipa Pakai henga taovun,” ati.
en: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
text:
MAT 9:38
Thadou: Hijeh chun chang atna lou muna natong ding ahin soldoh theina ding in, lou neipa Pakai henga taovun,” ati.
English: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

tcz: Yeshuan aseijui som le ni ho chu akoukhom in chule amaho chu lhagao gilou ho nodoh theina le hivei namkim le natna ho damsah theina thuneina apen ahi.
en: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.
text:
MAT 10:1
Thadou: Yeshuan aseijui som le ni ho chu akoukhom in chule amaho chu lhagao gilou ho nodoh theina le hivei namkim le natna ho damsah theina thuneina apen ahi.
English: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

tcz: Seijui som le ni ho min: Amasapen, Simon (Peter jong akitin), aban Andrew (Peter sopipa), James (Zebedee chapa), John (James sopipa),
en: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

tcz: Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew (kaidongpa ahin), James (Alpheus chapa), Thaddaeus,
en: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;

tcz: Simon (Zealot mi) chule Iscariot'a kon Judas (ama matsah a pang), hi chengse hi ahiuve.
en: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
text:
MAT 10:4
Thadou: Simon (Zealot mi) chule Iscariot'a kon Judas (ama matsah a pang), hi chengse hi ahiuve.
English: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

tcz: Yeshuan seijui som le ni ho hiti hin ahil in: “Nangho chidang namdang ho kom ahilou leh Samaria mite koma che hih un.
en: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.
text:
MAT 10:5
Thadou: Yeshuan seijui som le ni ho hiti hin ahil in: “Nangho chidang namdang ho kom ahilou leh Samaria mite koma che hih un.
English: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.

tcz: Pathen kelngoi mangsa Israel te koma bou che uvin.
en: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
text:
MAT 10:6
Thadou: Pathen kelngoi mangsa Israel te koma bou che uvin.
English: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

tcz: Chule nache nauva Van gam chu ahung naitai ti phongdoh un.
en: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’
text:
MAT 10:7
Thadou: Chule nache nauva Van gam chu ahung naitai ti phongdoh un.
English: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’

tcz: Ana sudam un, mithi kaithou un, phahvei ho ngimsah un, chule lhagaoboh ho nodoh un. Man beiya kilah a nahi bang un, phaldoh jeng un!
en: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.
text:
MAT 10:8
Thadou: Ana sudam un, mithi kaithou un, phahvei ho ngimsah un, chule lhagaoboh ho nodoh un. Man beiya kilah a nahi bang un, phaldoh jeng un!
English: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

tcz: “Na sumdip uva sum, na konggah uvah sana dangka ahilouleh sum goi jeng jong kipoh hih-un.
en: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.
text:
MAT 10:9
Thadou: “Na sumdip uva sum, na konggah uvah sana dangka ahilouleh sum goi jeng jong kipoh hih-un.
English: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.

tcz: Kholjin na a sakhau jeng jong akop in pohih un, kengchot ho le tenggol jeng jong kiken hih un chule min najen phat uleh ki phalam hih un, ijeh inem itileh natonga chun aneh ding dol ahi.
en: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
text:
MAT 10:10
Thadou: Kholjin na a sakhau jeng jong akop in pohih un, kengchot ho le tenggol jeng jong kiken hih un chule min najen phat uleh ki phalam hih un, ijeh inem itileh natonga chun aneh ding dol ahi.
English: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

tcz: “Khopi sung hihen, khoneo sung hijongleh nalut nauva chun lhunna theija kilom michu holdoh un chule khosung ho nadalhah kahse uvin hichepa in a chun umun.
en: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.
text:
MAT 10:11
Thadou: “Khopi sung hihen, khoneo sung hijongleh nalut nauva chun lhunna theija kilom michu holdoh un chule khosung ho nadalhah kahse uvin hichepa in a chun umun.
English: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.

tcz: In nalut teng uleh phatthei na chu peuvin.
en: As you enter into the household, greet it.
text:
MAT 10:12
Thadou: In nalut teng uleh phatthei na chu peuvin.
English: As you enter into the household, greet it.

tcz: Achang dinga kilom in ahiuleh na phatthei nau chu umden hen, kilom lou in ahiuleh phattheina chu nunglah doh un.
en: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.
text:
MAT 10:13
Thadou: Achang dinga kilom in ahiuleh na phatthei nau chu umden hen, kilom lou in ahiuleh phattheina chu nunglah doh un.
English: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.

tcz: Koi insung hihen, ahilouleh khopi sung hijongleh na lamdot lou uva, ahilouleh na thupoh-u angainom lou uleh, na dalhah ding teng uleh nakeng uva vutvai geiyin thing lhauvin.
en: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.
text:
MAT 10:14
Thadou: Koi insung hihen, ahilouleh khopi sung hijongleh na lamdot lou uva, ahilouleh na thupoh-u angainom lou uleh, na dalhah ding teng uleh nakeng uva vutvai geiyin thing lhauvin.
English: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.

tcz: Thu tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, thutan nikho teng chuleh chutobang khopin athoh ding chu, gitlouna dim khopi teni: Sodom le Gomorrah thoh gamchenga oljo ding ahi.
en: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.
text:
MAT 10:15
Thadou: Thu tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, thutan nikho teng chuleh chutobang khopin athoh ding chu, gitlouna dim khopi teni: Sodom le Gomorrah thoh gamchenga oljo ding ahi.
English: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

tcz: “Veuvin, keiman ngeihon lah a kelngoi tobanga kasol nahiuve. Hiti chun gul ho tobang'in chingthei jun chule vapal ho tobang in suhset khoiset neihih un.
en: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.
text:
MAT 10:16
Thadou: “Veuvin, keiman ngeihon lah a kelngoi tobanga kasol nahiuve. Hiti chun gul ho tobang'in chingthei jun chule vapal ho tobang in suhset khoiset neihih un.
English: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.

tcz: Hinlah ching theiyun! Ijeh inem itileh thutan ho khut a nahin pehdoh diu chule ki khopna in hoa sakol jepna a nahin jep diu ahi.
en: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
text:
MAT 10:17
Thadou: Hinlah ching theiyun! Ijeh inem itileh thutan ho khut a nahin pehdoh diu chule ki khopna in hoa sakol jepna a nahin jep diu ahi.
English: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

tcz: Nangho kanungjui nahi jeh uva gam vaipo holeh leng ho ang sunga na chung thu'u kitan ding ahi. Ahin hichu vaipoa pangho le atahsan lou ho henga, keima thu nasei theina diu phat kijentah hung hi ding ahi.
en: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
text:
MAT 10:18
Thadou: Nangho kanungjui nahi jeh uva gam vaipo holeh leng ho ang sunga na chung thu'u kitan ding ahi. Ahin hichu vaipoa pangho le atahsan lou ho henga, keima thu nasei theina diu phat kijentah hung hi ding ahi.
English: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

tcz: Amahon nahin mat teng uleh, iti ka donbut ding ham tin lungkham hih un; nasei diu apettah a Pathen in napeh diu ahi.
en: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.
text:
MAT 10:19
Thadou: Amahon nahin mat teng uleh, iti ka donbut ding ham tin lungkham hih un; nasei diu apettah a Pathen in napeh diu ahi.
English: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

tcz: Ijeh nem itileh thuseija chu nangho hita louva na Pau Lhagao chun nang hoa kona thu ahin seidoh ding ahi.
en: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.
text:
MAT 10:20
Thadou: Ijeh nem itileh thuseija chu nangho hita louva na Pau Lhagao chun nang hoa kona thu ahin seidoh ding ahi.
English: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

tcz: “Sopi khat chun asopi chu thi dinga apeh doh ding, apa chun acha tahbeh jong chu apehdoh ding chule achaten anule pa adou uva chule athasah diu ahi.
en: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.
text:
MAT 10:21
Thadou: “Sopi khat chun asopi chu thi dinga apeh doh ding, apa chun acha tahbeh jong chu apehdoh ding chule achaten anule pa adou uva chule athasah diu ahi.
English: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

tcz: Chule nanghon keima nung najuijeh uva nam jousen nahin hotbol diu ahi. Hijongleh achaina geiya thoh lhung jou chengse bou chu, huhhing a um ding ahiuve.
en: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
text:
MAT 10:22
Thadou: Chule nanghon keima nung najuijeh uva nam jousen nahin hotbol diu ahi. Hijongleh achaina geiya thoh lhung jou chengse bou chu, huhhing a um ding ahiuve.
English: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

tcz: Nang hon khopi khat abol hesohna nato teng uleh, aban khoa jam lut un. Thu tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, Israel kho jouse naphah masang uva, Mihem Chapa hi hung ding ahi.
en: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.
text:
MAT 10:23
Thadou: Nang hon khopi khat abol hesohna nato teng uleh, aban khoa jam lut un. Thu tahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, Israel kho jouse naphah masang uva, Mihem Chapa hi hung ding ahi.
English: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.

tcz: “Ahil uva pangpa sang in akihil ho alenjo ngaipoi chule soh ho jong apu sang in alenjo pouve!
en: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.
text:
MAT 10:24
Thadou: “Ahil uva pangpa sang in akihil ho alenjo ngaipoi chule soh ho jong apu sang in alenjo pouve!
English: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

tcz: Akihil ho chu ahilpau to abah uva chule soh ho jong apu uto abah diu chu phaset ahi. Chule keima insung pumpi neipa bon lhagao bohho lengpa eitiuva ahileh, ka insung mite chu hisanga phamo joa akou diu ahi.
en: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!
text:
MAT 10:25
Thadou: Akihil ho chu ahilpau to abah uva chule soh ho jong apu uto abah diu chu phaset ahi. Chule keima insung pumpi neipa bon lhagao bohho lengpa eitiuva ahileh, ka insung mite chu hisanga phamo joa akou diu ahi.
English: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!

tcz: “Hijongleh nagih uva pang ho chu kicha hihbeh un. Ajeh chu akisel guh jouse ki phondoh phat hung lhug ding ahi. Chule aguh a kisel jouse jong mi jouse het a um ding ahi.
en: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.
text:
MAT 10:26
Thadou: “Hijongleh nagih uva pang ho chu kicha hihbeh un. Ajeh chu akisel guh jouse ki phondoh phat hung lhug ding ahi. Chule aguh a kisel jouse jong mi jouse het a um ding ahi.
English: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.

tcz: Tua keiman muthim lah a kasei hi, kho ahungvah tengleh lhang phonga ki phongdoh ding ahi. Keiman na koluva thol a kasei hi mi jouse jah dinga, in chunga kisam doh ding ahi!
en: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
text:
MAT 10:27
Thadou: Tua keiman muthim lah a kasei hi, kho ahungvah tengleh lhang phonga ki phongdoh ding ahi. Keiman na koluva thol a kasei hi mi jouse jah dinga, in chunga kisam doh ding ahi!
English: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

tcz: “Na tahsau that go ho kicha hih un, amahon na lhagao atongkha thei pouve. Pathen bou ging un, Ama chun na lhagao le na tahsau asuhmang thei chule damun a akoi thei ahi.
en: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.
text:
MAT 10:28
Thadou: “Na tahsau that go ho kicha hih un, amahon na lhagao atongkha thei pouve. Pathen bou ging un, Ama chun na lhagao le na tahsau asuhmang thei chule damun a akoi thei ahi.
English: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.

tcz: Inva nin ijat amat na het em? Paisa khat man bou ahi. Hinlah inva khat jeng jong na Pau het louva leiset a lhalou ahi.
en: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.
text:
MAT 10:29
Thadou: Inva nin ijat amat na het em? Paisa khat man bou ahi. Hinlah inva khat jeng jong na Pau het louva leiset a lhalou ahi.
English: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.

Thadou: Yeshua chu suhlou chang umna lou jaova, cholngah nia aseijuite toh ahopa nauvah agilkel tauvin, hijeh chun amahon suhlou changvui chu amal lhauvin ane pan tauve.
English: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

tcz: Hinlah Pharisee ho phabep in amaho um chan amuvin chule nopmo sahna aphongdoh un, “Ven, na seijuiten cholngah nikhoa suhlou changvui amal'u hin dan apalkeh uve,” atiuve.
en: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”
text:
MAT 12:2
Thadou: Hinlah Pharisee ho phabep in amaho um chan amuvin chule nopmo sahna aphongdoh un, “Ven, na seijuiten cholngah nikhoa suhlou changvui amal'u hin dan apalkeh uve,” atiuve.
English: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

tcz: Yeshuan ajah uva, “Nangho Pathen Lekhabu simkhalou nahi uvem? David in agilkel pet'a chu aki lhonpi hotoh ipi abol uvem?
en: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:
text:
MAT 12:3
Thadou: Yeshuan ajah uva, “Nangho Pathen Lekhabu simkhalou nahi uvem? David in agilkel pet'a chu aki lhonpi hotoh ipi abol uvem?
English: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:

tcz: Ama Pathen in a alut in chule ama leh aloihon dan apalkeh uvin, thempu ho bouvin aneh ding uva kiphal changlhah theng chu ane uvin ahi.
en: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?
text:
MAT 12:4

tcz: Chule Mose danbua Thempu hou-in a lhacha hon cholngah nikhoa na atoh thei diu phal ahi chu simdoh khalou nahi uvem?
en: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?
text:
MAT 12:5
Thadou: Chule Mose danbua Thempu hou-in a lhacha hon cholngah nikhoa na atoh thei diu phal ahi chu simdoh khalou nahi uvem?
English: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?

tcz: Kaseipeh nahi uve, Hou in sanga lenjo khat hichea aum e.
en: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.
text:
MAT 12:6
Thadou: Kaseipeh nahi uve, Hou in sanga lenjo khat hichea aum e.
English: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

tcz: Hiche Pathen Thubun asei, ‘Keiman kilhai na thilto hi louvin, khotona nanei diu ka deijoh ahi,’ ti hi ipi kiseina ahi nahetdoh'u hileh them mona neilou Ka seijui ho themmo na chan lou diu ahi.
en: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.

MAT 12:8

English: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

tcz: Chutah in Yeshuan akikhop nau in chu ajon paitai.
en: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.
text:
MAT 12:9
Thadou: Chutah in Yeshuan akikhop nau in chu ajon paitai.
English: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.

tcz: Chu muna chun khut ngoi khat amudoh in ahi. Pharisee ho chun Yeshua adong un, “Cholngah nikhoa ana damsah na chu dan in aphal em?” atiuve. (Amaho chun Aman aphal'e tin seihen lang Ama themmo chansah na kinei hen atiu ahi).
en: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.
text:
MAT 12:10
Thadou: Chu muna chun khut ngoi khat amudoh in ahi. Pharisee ho chun Yeshua adong un, “Cholngah nikhoa ana damsah na chu dan in aphal em?” atiuve. (Amaho chun Aman aphal'e tin seihen lang Ama themmo chansah na kinei hen atiu ahi).
English: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.

tcz: Chuin Aman adonbut in, “Nanghon kelngoi khat twikul a cholngah nin lhalut hen lang hileh, lahdoh tei ding nagon lou diu ham? Thon moa na gon diu ahi.
en: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?
text:
MAT 12:11
Thadou: Chuin Aman adonbut in, “Nanghon kelngoi khat twikul a cholngah nin lhalut hen lang hileh, lahdoh tei ding nagon lou diu ham? Thon moa na gon diu ahi.
English: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?

tcz: Chule kelngoi khat sanga mihem khat ichan geiya lujoa hitam? Tahbeh in cholngah nikhoa mikhat in thilpha abol ding chu dan in aphal ahi,” ati.
en: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”
text:
MAT 12:12
Thadou: Chule kelngoi khat sanga mihem khat ichan geiya lujoa hitam? Tahbeh in cholngah nikhoa mikhat in thilpha abol ding chu dan in aphal ahi,” ati.
English: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

tcz: Chutah in Aman mipa jah'a chun, “Nakhut domin” ati. Hiti chun aman jong akhut adom in ahileh adamtai.
en: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.
text:

tcz: Chuphat in Pharisee ho aki khom uvin, Yeshua chu iti tha ding ham ti tohgon anei tauve.
en: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.
text:
MAT 12:14
Thadou: Chuphat in Pharisee ho aki khom uvin, Yeshua chu iti tha ding ham ti tohgon anei tauve.
English: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan ipi agonu ahen, hiche mun chu adalhan chule mi atama tamin anung ajuitai. Amaho lah a ana damlou jouse aboldam in ahi.
en: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
text:
MAT 12:15

English: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

en: and commanded them that they should not make him known,
text:
MAT 12:16

en: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
text:
MAT 12:17
Thadou: Hiche hi Isaiah thusei Ama chunga agui lhunna ahi.
English: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

tcz: Ka lhacha Ka lhendoh hi ven, Amahi Ka cha deitah, Ka lung lhaina tah ahi. Keiman Ka Lhagao achunga kakoi ding, chule Aman chitin namtin lah'a dih tah'a thu atan ding ahi.
en: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.
text:
MAT 12:18
Thadou: Ka lhacha Ka lhendoh hi ven, Amahi Ka cha deitah, Ka lung lhaina tah ahi. Keiman Ka Lhagao achunga kakoi ding, chule Aman chitin namtin lah'a dih tah'a thu atan ding ahi.
English: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

tcz: Aman doumah abollou ding, kisenlou ding, jalah a awsanga thu asei lou ding ahi.
en: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.
text:
MAT 12:19
Thadou: Aman doumah abollou ding, kisenlou ding, jalah a awsanga thu asei lou ding ahi.
English: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

tcz: Aman pumpeng chip jong aheboh pailou ding ahilouleh khoilu thaomei kihal khu atha mit pai lou ding ahi. Aman thudih'a thutan chu jona aumsah kahsea ding ahi.
en: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.
text:
MAT 12:20
