tcz: Chule Amin chu vannoi pumpi kinepna hi ding ahi.
en: In his name, the nations will hope.”
text:
MAT 12:21
Thadou: Chule Amin chu vannoi pumpi kinepna hi ding ahi.
English: In his name, the nations will hope.”

tcz: Chujouvin lhagaoboh vop khat, ama chu mitcho le pao theilou ahin, Yeshua koma ahin pui tauve. Ama chu adamsah'in ahileh thu asei theiyin chule kho jong amu tai.
en: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.
text:
MAT 12:22
Thadou: Chujouvin lhagaoboh vop khat, ama chu mitcho le pao theilou ahin, Yeshua koma ahin pui tauve. Ama chu adamsah'in ahileh thu asei theiyin chule kho jong amu tai.
English: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

tcz: Mi honpi chun adatmo uvin chule adong tauvin, “Hiche Yeshua hi David Chapa Messiah chu hi talou ding ham?” atiuve.
en: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”
text:
MAT 12:23
Thadou: Mi honpi chun adatmo uvin chule adong tauvin, “Hiche Yeshua hi David Chapa Messiah chu hi talou ding ham?” atiuve.
English: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

tcz: Hinlah Pharisee ho chun thil kidang kibol thu ajah phat un, asei un, “Aman lhagaoboh ho anodoh datmo hih un. Aman athanei na hi lhagaoboh ho lengpa Satan thahatna kon ahibouve,” atiuve.
en: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
text:
MAT 12:24
Thadou: Hinlah Pharisee ho chun thil kidang kibol thu ajah phat un, asei un, “Aman lhagaoboh ho anodoh datmo hih un. Aman athanei na hi lhagaoboh ho lengpa Satan thahatna kon ahibouve,” atiuve.
English: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

tcz: Yeshuan alunggelu ahen, chuin adonbut in, “Lenggam ama le ama kidou amah thahjin, chule khopi hihen insung hijongleh akidou chan chu ding jou lou ding ahi.”
en: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.
text:
MAT 12:25
Thadou: Yeshuan alunggelu ahen, chuin adonbut in, “Lenggam ama le ama kidou amah thahjin, chule khopi hihen insung hijongleh akidou chan chu ding jou lou ding ahi.”
English: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

tcz: Chule Satan in Satan anodoh a ahileh, amale ama kikhen tela chule kidouva hiding, a lenggam chu ding doh joulou ding ahi.
en: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
text:
MAT 12:26
Thadou: Chule Satan in Satan anodoh a ahileh, amale ama kikhen tela chule kidouva hiding, a lenggam chu ding doh joulou ding ahi.
English: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

tcz: Chule Keima Satan in thahatna eipeh ahileh nalah uva, lhagaoboh nodoh ho khula? Amahon jong lhagaoboh ho anodoh-u ahin, hijeh a chu na thusei uva chu themmo nahin chan diu ahi.
en: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
text:
MAT 12:27
Thadou: Chule Keima Satan in thahatna eipeh ahileh nalah uva, lhagaoboh nodoh ho khula? Amahon jong lhagaoboh ho anodoh-u ahin, hijeh a chu na thusei uva chu themmo nahin chan diu ahi.
English: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

tcz: Hinlah Keiman Pathen Lhagao jal a lhagaoboh ho kanodoh a ahileh, Pathen Lenggam chu nalah uva hung lhunga ahitai.
en: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.
text:
MAT 12:28
Thadou: Hinlah Keiman Pathen Lhagao jal a lhagaoboh ho kanodoh a ahileh, Pathen Lenggam chu nalah uva hung lhunga ahitai.
English: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

tcz: Ajeh chu Satan tobang leuva hat mi khat in athanei tah galut a chule aneiho gachom ding koi ham? Ama sanga hatjoa bou chun ama chu akan tuma chule a in chu aphet lhahpeh ding ahi.
en: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.
text:
MAT 12:29
Thadou: Ajeh chu Satan tobang leuva hat mi khat in athanei tah galut a chule aneiho gachom ding koi ham? Ama sanga hatjoa bou chun ama chu akan tuma chule a in chu aphet lhahpeh ding ahi.
English: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

tcz: “Koi hijongleh Keima lama pang lou chun eidou ahi, chule koihileh Keima toh tong khom lou chun Keima douna a na atoh ahi.”
en: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.
text:
MAT 12:30
Thadou: “Koi hijongleh Keima lama pang lou chun eidou ahi, chule koihileh Keima toh tong khom lou chun Keima douna a na atoh ahi.”
English: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

tcz: “Ka seipeh nahiuve, itobang chonset kibol hihen chule Pathen taitomna thusei doh hijongleh kingaidam thei ahi; Lhagao Theng taitomna athusei doh vang ki ngaidam lou ding ahi.
en: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.
text:
MAT 12:31
Thadou: “Ka seipeh nahiuve, itobang chonset kibol hihen chule Pathen taitomna thusei doh hijongleh kingaidam thei ahi; Lhagao Theng taitomna athusei doh vang ki ngaidam lou ding ahi.
English: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

tcz: Mihem Chapa douna a thusei doh koi hijongleh ki ngaidam ding ahi, hinlah Lhagao Theng douna a thusei doh ho chu hiche vannoiya hihen, ahilouleh ahung lhung nalai ding vannoiya hijongleh ki ngaidam talou ding ahi.”
en: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.
text:
MAT 12:32
Thadou: Mihem Chapa douna a thusei doh koi hijongleh ki ngaidam ding ahi, hinlah Lhagao Theng douna a thusei doh ho chu hiche vannoiya hihen, ahilouleh ahung lhung nalai ding vannoiya hijongleh ki ngaidam talou ding ahi.”
English: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.

tcz: “Thingphung khat chu agan aphotchet ahi. Thingphung khat chu aphat'a ahileh aga pha ding ahi. Thingphung khat chu aphat louva ahileh, aga phalou ding ahi.
en: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.
text:
MAT 12:33
Thadou: “Thingphung khat chu agan aphotchet ahi. Thingphung khat chu aphat'a ahileh aga pha ding ahi. Thingphung khat chu aphat louva ahileh, aga phalou ding ahi.
English: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

tcz: Nangho gul chilhah ho! Mi gilouvin thupha le thudih iti nasei thei diu ham? Ajeh chu na lunguva nagel lhah chan uchu ipi hijongleh na phondoh ahitai.
en: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.
text:
MAT 12:34
Thadou: Nangho gul chilhah ho! Mi gilouvin thupha le thudih iti nasei thei diu ham? Ajeh chu na lunguva nagel lhah chan uchu ipi hijongleh na phondoh ahitai.
English: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

tcz: Mipha khat chun alung gela thilpha kikhol jeh'a apha chu ahin phondoh ahin chule mi phalou khat chun alung gela thil phalou akikhol jeh a aphalou aphondoh ahi.
en: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.
text:
MAT 12:35
Thadou: Mipha khat chun alung gela thilpha kikhol jeh'a apha chu ahin phondoh ahin chule mi phalou khat chun alung gela thil phalou akikhol jeh a aphalou aphondoh ahi.
English: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

tcz: Chule hiche hi ka seipeh nahiuve, mohthu nasei chengse chungchang thu chu thutanna nikhoa napeh ding ahi.
en: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
text:
MAT 12:36
Thadou: Chule hiche hi ka seipeh nahiuve, mohthu nasei chengse chungchang thu chu thutanna nikhoa napeh ding ahi.
English: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

tcz: Nathusei ho chun nathem chan ahilouleh na themmo chansah ding ahi.” ati.
en: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”
text:
MAT 12:37
Thadou: Nathusei ho chun nathem chan ahilouleh na themmo chansah ding ahi.” ati.
English: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

tcz: Nikhat hou dan thuhil ho le Pharisee ho Yeshua henga ahung un chule aseiyun, “Pu, na thuneina photchet na nangma a kon'in melchihna kidang khat kamu nom uve,” ahung tiuve.
en: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”
text:
MAT 12:38
Thadou: Nikhat hou dan thuhil ho le Pharisee ho Yeshua henga ahung un chule aseiyun, “Pu, na thuneina photchet na nangma a kon'in melchihna kidang khat kamu nom uve,” ahung tiuve.
English: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan adonbut in, “Khang gilou le chon thanghoi khang miten melchihna ahol uve, hinlah melchihna khatbou kapeh ding chu Themgao Jonah melchihna hiding ahi.
en: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
text:
MAT 12:39
Thadou: Hinlah Yeshuan adonbut in, “Khang gilou le chon thanghoi khang miten melchihna ahol uve, hinlah melchihna khatbou kapeh ding chu Themgao Jonah melchihna hiding ahi.
English: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

tcz: Ajeh chu Jonah ngapi oisunga ni thumle jan thum aum banga, Mihem Chapa hi leilai gil a ni thumle jan thum um ding ahi.”
en: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
text:
MAT 12:40
Thadou: Ajeh chu Jonah ngapi oisunga ni thumle jan thum aum banga, Mihem Chapa hi leilai gil a ni thumle jan thum um ding ahi.”
English: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

tcz: “Thutan nikho teng leh Nineveh mite hung dingdoh uva, tulai khang mite hi themmo ahin chan diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon Jonah thusei phonga chun lung aheiyuve. Tun Jonah sanga chungnungjo hikoma hin aum in, hinlah nanghon lung nahei nom deh pouve.
en: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.
text:
MAT 12:41
Thadou: “Thutan nikho teng leh Nineveh mite hung dingdoh uva, tulai khang mite hi themmo ahin chan diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon Jonah thusei phonga chun lung aheiyuve. Tun Jonah sanga chungnungjo hikoma hin aum in, hinlah nanghon lung nahei nom deh pouve.
English: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

tcz: Sheba Lengnu chu thutan nikho tengleh tulai khang mite douna a hung ding'a themmo ahin chan ding ahi, ajeh chu ama mun gam latah a kon in Solomon chihna thu ngaidin ahung e. Tuhin Solomon sanga chungnungjo hikoma hin aum in, hinlah nanghon asei nangai pouve.
en: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.
text:
MAT 12:42
Thadou: Sheba Lengnu chu thutan nikho tengleh tulai khang mite douna a hung ding'a themmo ahin chan ding ahi, ajeh chu ama mun gam latah a kon in Solomon chihna thu ngaidin ahung e. Tuhin Solomon sanga chungnungjo hikoma hin aum in, hinlah nanghon asei nangai pouve.
English: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

tcz: “Lhagao phalou chun mikhat chu adalhah tengleh gamthip a aga chen, choldona ding ahol len, hinlah amu joupoi.
en: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.
text:
MAT 12:43
Thadou: “Lhagao phalou chun mikhat chu adalhah tengleh gamthip a aga chen, choldona ding ahol len, hinlah amu joupoi.
English: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.

tcz: Chuteng aman aseiyin, ‘Keima ka hung potdohna pa koma gaki lekit tange ati. Hiti chun ahung kile kit in ahileh ahung dohna in chu koima ana umpon, ki theh ngim le kitup keicha aum chu amun ahi.
en: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.
text:
MAT 12:44
Thadou: Chuteng aman aseiyin, ‘Keima ka hung potdohna pa koma gaki lekit tange ati. Hiti chun ahung kile kit in ahileh ahung dohna in chu koima ana umpon, ki theh ngim le kitup keicha aum chu amun ahi.
English: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

tcz: Chutah in lhagao chun ama sanga phaloujo lhagao sagi chu aga mun, chule mihempa sunga chun alut un acheng den tauve. Hiti chun ama chu masanga sang in akhohsejo chehtai.’ Hichu tukhang gilou mite hin, ahin hetchet diu ahi,” ati.
en: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”
text:
MAT 12:45
Thadou: Chutah in lhagao chun ama sanga phaloujo lhagao sagi chu aga mun, chule mihempa sunga chun alut un acheng den tauve. Hiti chun ama chu masanga sang in akhohsejo chehtai.’ Hichu tukhang gilou mite hin, ahin hetchet diu ahi,” ati.
English: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

tcz: Yeshuan mihonpi henga thu aseipet in, anule asopi pasal ho ahung un, polama aumun, akihou limpi nom uvin ahi.
en: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.
text:
MAT 12:46
Thadou: Yeshuan mihonpi henga thu aseipet in, anule asopi pasal ho ahung un, polama aumun, akihou limpi nom uvin ahi.
English: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

tcz: Chuphat in mi khat in ajah a, “Ven, nanu le nasopi pasal ho polama ading un, namu nom uve,” tin ahung seiyin ahi.
en: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”
text:
MAT 12:47
Thadou: Chuphat in mi khat in ajah a, “Ven, nanu le nasopi pasal ho polama ading un, namu nom uve,” tin ahung seiyin ahi.
English: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

tcz: Hinlah Aman adonbut in chule ajah a aseiyin, “Koiham Kanu? Chule koiham Kasopi ho chu?” ati.
en: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
text:
MAT 12:48
Thadou: Hinlah Aman adonbut in chule ajah a aseiyin, “Koiham Kanu? Chule koiham Kasopi ho chu?” ati.
English: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

tcz: Chuin aman akhut chun aseijuite lam akoh in aseitai, “Veuvin, Kanu le Kasopite hohi!
en: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
text:
MAT 12:49
Thadou: Chuin aman akhut chun aseijuite lam akoh in aseitai, “Veuvin, Kanu le Kasopite hohi!
English: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

tcz: Ajeh chu Koi hijongleh Vana um Ka Pa lunglam bol ho chu Kanu, Kasopipa chule Kasopinu te ahiuve,” ati.
en: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”
text:
MAT 12:50
Thadou: Ajeh chu Koi hijongleh Vana um Ka Pa lunglam bol ho chu Kanu, Kasopipa chule Kasopinu te ahiuve,” ati.
English: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

tcz: Chujouvin hiche ni chun Yeshuan in chu adalhan chule dillen pama chun atouvin ahi.
en: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.
text:
MAT 13:1
Thadou: Chujouvin hiche ni chun Yeshuan in chu adalhan chule dillen pama chun atouvin ahi.
English: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.

tcz: Mihonpi akimvela aki khom un, hiti chun ama kong khat a alut e. Chuche muna chun atouvin chule mihonpi vapama umho chu thu ahil tai.
en: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.
text:
MAT 13:2
Thadou: Mihonpi akimvela aki khom un, hiti chun ama kong khat a alut e. Chuche muna chun atouvin chule mihonpi vapama umho chu thu ahil tai.
English: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.

tcz: Aman thulem tampi mangchan amaho chu thusim tampi ahil in, hiche thusim hi aseiye: “Ngaiyun! Loubol mi khat muchi the ding in aga potdoh e.
en: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.
text:
MAT 13:3
Thadou: Aman thulem tampi mangchan amaho chu thusim tampi ahil in, hiche thusim hi aseiye: “Ngaiyun! Loubol mi khat muchi the ding in aga potdoh e.
English: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

tcz: Chule aman muchi chu loulaiya athea ahileh, muchi phabep chu lampia a-chu in ahileh vacha ho ahung un anejou tauve.
en: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.
text:
MAT 13:4
Thadou: Chule aman muchi chu loulaiya athea ahileh, muchi phabep chu lampia a-chu in ahileh vacha ho ahung un anejou tauve.
English: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

tcz: Muchi dang phabep chu songlheu chung lei patna a achutai. Lei apat jeh chun muchi chu ahung kehdoh loichel in ahi.
en: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.
text:
MAT 13:5
Thadou: Muchi dang phabep chu songlheu chung lei patna a achutai. Lei apat jeh chun muchi chu ahung kehdoh loichel in ahi.
English: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

tcz: Hinlah nisa ahung satan ahileh, leiset achu ajung alut thuh lou jeh in asang gop pai jeng in ahi.
en: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.
text:
MAT 13:6
Thadou: Hinlah nisa ahung satan ahileh, leiset achu ajung alut thuh lou jeh in asang gop pai jeng in ahi.
English: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

tcz: Muchi dang phabep ma chu ling lah a a-chu in ling chu akhang in chule chang phung dong nalai chu adep lihtai.
en: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.
text:
MAT 13:7
Thadou: Muchi dang phabep ma chu ling lah a a-chu in ling chu akhang in chule chang phung dong nalai chu adep lihtai.
English: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

tcz: Hinlah muchi adang chengse vang leiphatna a a-chu in chule hiche ho chu ajat som thum, ajat somgup chule ajat jakhat chan geiyin apung uvin ahi.
en: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.
text:
MAT 13:8
Thadou: Hinlah muchi adang chengse vang leiphatna a a-chu in chule hiche ho chu ajat som thum, ajat somgup chule ajat jakhat chan geiyin apung uvin ahi.
English: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

tcz: Khojahna ding nakol nei ami chang cheh in angaiya chule ahetkhen angaiye,” ati.
en: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
text:
MAT 13:9
Thadou: Khojahna ding nakol nei ami chang cheh in angaiya chule ahetkhen angaiye,” ati.
English: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

tcz: Aseijuite ahung un chule adong uvin, “Iti dana nangman miho thu nahil tengleh thulem naseiji ham?” atiuve.
en: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
text:
MAT 13:10
Thadou: Aseijuite ahung un chule adong uvin, “Iti dana nangman miho thu nahil tengleh thulem naseiji ham?” atiuve.
English: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

tcz: Aman adonbut in, “Nangho hi van Lenggam thuguh hettheina kipea nahi tauve, hinlah amaho kipe lou ahiuve.
en: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
text:
MAT 13:11
Thadou: Aman adonbut in, “Nangho hi van Lenggam thuguh hettheina kipea nahi tauve, hinlah amaho kipe lou ahiuve.
English: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

tcz: Ka thuhil ngai ho chu hetkhen na kipeh be ding chule amahon hetna bulhingset anei diu ahi. Hinlah ka thuhil ngaisah lou ho chu hetna phabep aneiyu jong chu kilah mangpeh nalai diu ahi.
en: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.
text:
MAT 13:12
Thadou: Ka thuhil ngai ho chu hetkhen na kipeh be ding chule amahon hetna bulhingset anei diu ahi. Hinlah ka thuhil ngaisah lou ho chu hetna phabep aneiyu jong chu kilah mangpeh nalai diu ahi.
English: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

tcz: Hijeh chun hiche thulem ho hi Kaman chah ahi. Ajeh chu amahon avet vang uva amu tahbeh lou ding u, ajah uva ahivanga angaiyu chu hetdohna tahbeh neilou ding ahiuve.”
en: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.
text:
MAT 13:13
Thadou: Hijeh chun hiche thulem ho hi Kaman chah ahi. Ajeh chu amahon avet vang uva amu tahbeh lou ding u, ajah uva ahivanga angaiyu chu hetdohna tahbeh neilou ding ahiuve.”
English: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

tcz: Hiche hi Isaiah themgao thusei, “Ipi kasei najah tenguleh hetkhenna nanei thei lou diu ahi. Ka thilbol namu tenguleh, geldohna nanei thei lou dingu ahi.
en: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche mite hi alung gelu atah cheh in, chule akol'uva khojahna aumpoi chule amahon amit asing uvin, amit un kho amu tapon, chule ana koluvin kho ajapon, chule alung un hetkhenna aneipon, chule keiman kasuhdam theina ding in ka heng lama ahung kihei pouve.”
en: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’
text:
MAT 13:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu hiche mite hi alung gelu atah cheh in, chule akol'uva khojahna aumpoi chule amahon amit asing uvin, amit un kho amu tapon, chule ana koluvin kho ajapon, chule alung un hetkhenna aneipon, chule keiman kasuhdam theina ding in ka heng lama ahung kihei pouve.”
English: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’

tcz: “Hinlah namit teni uvin amu jeh un, namit-u mitvang pha ahi chule nana kolte niuvin ajah jeh un, nakol vangpha ahi.
en: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
text:
MAT 13:16
Thadou: “Hinlah namit teni uvin amu jeh un, namit-u mitvang pha ahi chule nana kolte niuvin ajah jeh un, nakol vangpha ahi.
English: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

tcz: Thu tahbeh ka seipeh nahiuve, themgao tamtah le mi chonpha tamtah'in namu uhi amu nomun, hinlah amu pouve. Chule thu najah chengseu hi ajah nomun, hinlah ajah lou-u ahitai.”
en: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.
text:
MAT 13:17
Thadou: Thu tahbeh ka seipeh nahiuve, themgao tamtah le mi chonpha tamtah'in namu uhi amu nomun, hinlah amu pouve. Chule thu najah chengseu hi ajah nomun, hinlah ajah lou-u ahitai.”
English: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

tcz: “Tuhin lou bolpa chun amuchi the ahil chetna ngaiyuvin.
en: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.
text:
MAT 13:18
Thadou: “Tuhin lou bolpa chun amuchi the ahil chetna ngaiyuvin.
English: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

tcz: Lampia chu-ah muchin avetsah chu Lenggam thu kihil ja'a, ahivanga hechen lou ho ahiuve. Chujouvin agi loupa chu ahung in chule alung sung uva kitulut muchi chu ahung lamang jitai.
en: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.
text:
MAT 13:19
Thadou: Lampia chu-ah muchin avetsah chu Lenggam thu kihil ja'a, ahivanga hechen lou ho ahiuve. Chujouvin agi loupa chu ahung in chule alung sung uva kitulut muchi chu ahung lamang jitai.
English: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

tcz: Songlheu chunga chua muchi hin thu kisei chu ngaiya chule apet petna kipah tah a sanga mitoh tekah thei ahi.
en: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;

tcz: Hinlah ajung athuh loujeh in ahingsot tapoi. Amaho chun hahsatna ato tenguleh ahilouleh Pathen Thu jeh a gim bolna ato tenguleh alhamang ji tauve.
en: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.
text:
MAT 13:21
Thadou: Hinlah ajung athuh loujeh in ahingsot tapoi. Amaho chun hahsatna ato tenguleh ahilouleh Pathen Thu jeh a gim bolna ato tenguleh alhamang ji tauve.
English: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

tcz: Muchi ling lah a chu ho chu Pathen Thu ja a ahia tu hinlai vannoi lung gimna ho leh, haona ngaichatna ho jeh in gaso louvin aum jitai.
en: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
text:
MAT 13:22
Thadou: Muchi ling lah a chu ho chu Pathen Thu ja a ahia tu hinlai vannoi lung gimna ho leh, haona ngaichatna ho jeh in gaso louvin aum jitai.
English: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

tcz: Muchi lei phatna a chuho vang thu chu atahbeh a ja a chule hetchetna nei ahiuvin, chule amaho chun ajat som thum, ajat som gup chule ajat jakhat ahin sodoh e!” ati.
en: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”
text:
MAT 13:23
Thadou: Muchi lei phatna a chuho vang thu chu atahbeh a ja a chule hetchetna nei ahiuvin, chule amaho chun ajat som thum, ajat som gup chule ajat jakhat ahin sodoh e!” ati.
English: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”

tcz: Yeshuan thusim jatchom khat hichea hin aseiye: “Van gam chu loubol mi khat in alouva muchi pha athea toh tekah thei ahi.
en: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,
text:
MAT 13:24
Thadou: Yeshuan thusim jatchom khat hichea hin aseiye: “Van gam chu loubol mi khat in alouva muchi pha athea toh tekah thei ahi.
English: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

tcz: Hinlah chuche jan chun natong ho aihmut pat un, melmapa chu ahung in chuin changtah lah a chun changlhem ahung then, ache mangtai.
en: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.
text:
MAT 13:25
Thadou: Hinlah chuche jan chun natong ho aihmut pat un, melmapa chu ahung in chuin changtah lah a chun changlhem ahung then, ache mangtai.
English: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

tcz: Changphung ahung khanlhit phat in, aga jong ahung um'in chule changlhem jong chu ahung khang len in ahi.
en: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.
text:
MAT 13:26
Thadou: Changphung ahung khanlhit phat in, aga jong ahung um'in chule changlhem jong chu ahung khang len in ahi.
English: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

tcz: Loubolpa natong ho akoma agache uvin, chuin ajah a, ‘Hepu louva muchipha nathe na'a khun changlhem akeh dimset in, hoiya kon iti hung um hintem?’ atiuve.
en: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’
text:
MAT 13:27
Thadou: Loubolpa natong ho akoma agache uvin, chuin ajah a, ‘Hepu louva muchipha nathe na'a khun changlhem akeh dimset in, hoiya kon iti hung um hintem?’ atiuve.
English: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’

tcz: ‘Melma khat'in abol hichu’ tin loubolpa chun ahin phongdoh tai. ‘Changlhem ho kaga bodoh dingu ham?’ tin adong uve.
en: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’
text:
MAT 13:28
Thadou: ‘Melma khat'in abol hichu’ tin loubolpa chun ahin phongdoh tai. ‘Changlhem ho kaga bodoh dingu ham?’ tin adong uve.
English: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’

tcz: “Ahipoi, chutia nabol uleh changtah bodoh tha get nuvin nate.
en: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.
text:
MAT 13:29
Thadou: “Ahipoi, chutia nabol uleh changtah bodoh tha get nuvin nate.
English: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

tcz: A at phat lhin kah in khantha jengu hen. Chuteng keiman chang at ho jah'a changlhem chu lhengdoh unlang, kan khomun chule meiya halvam un, chule changtah chu changkul'a khum uvin tina nge” ati.
en: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”
text:
MAT 13:30
Thadou: A at phat lhin kah in khantha jengu hen. Chuteng keiman chang at ho jah'a changlhem chu lhengdoh unlang, kan khomun chule meiya halvam un, chule changtah chu changkul'a khum uvin tina nge” ati.
English: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”

tcz: Hichea hin vetsahna chomkhat Yeshuan amange: “Van Lenggam chu ankam mu louva kithe tobang ahi.
en: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,
text:
MAT 13:31
Thadou: Hichea hin vetsahna chomkhat Yeshuan amange: “Van Lenggam chu ankam mu louva kithe tobang ahi.
English: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,

tcz: Muchi jouse lah a aneopen ahi, hinlah hon a kitu lah a aphung lenpen ahung hitan, ahungkhang len in, thingphung ahung kisoh in, chule vacha ho ahungun chuin abah hoa abu akiset uvin ahi,” ati.
en: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”
text:
MAT 13:32
Thadou: Muchi jouse lah a aneopen ahi, hinlah hon a kitu lah a aphung lenpen ahung hitan, ahungkhang len in, thingphung ahung kisoh in, chule vacha ho ahungun chuin abah hoa abu akiset uvin ahi,” ati.
English: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”

tcz: Yeshuan hiche thulem jong hi aseiyin: “Van gam hi numei khat'in changlhah semna dinga chol aman tobang ahi. Ama hin chol neocha chu chang bong tetohna thum'a akoi jeng vang'in, changbong chu apumpin apomsah soh hel in ahi.” ati.
en: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”
text:
MAT 13:33
Thadou: Yeshuan hiche thulem jong hi aseiyin: “Van gam hi numei khat'in changlhah semna dinga chol aman tobang ahi. Ama hin chol neocha chu chang bong tetohna thum'a akoi jeng vang'in, changbong chu apumpin apomsah soh hel in ahi.” ati.
English: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”

tcz: Yeshuan mihonpi lah a thu aseina'a thusimle thulem hitobang ho hi amangcha jing in ahi. Ahimong in hitobang thulem mang cha louvin amaho koma thu asei jipoi.
en: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,
text:
MAT 13:34
Thadou: Yeshuan mihonpi lah a thu aseina'a thusimle thulem hitobang ho hi amangcha jing in ahi. Ahimong in hitobang thulem mang cha louvin amaho koma thu asei jipoi.
English: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,

tcz: Hiche hi Pathen in Themgao kam'a anaseisa: “Keiman nakom uva thulema kaseiding, Keiman vannoi kisem kipat apat thuguh kisel kahilchet peh ding ahi,” ti aguilhunna ahi.
en: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”
text:
MAT 13:35
Thadou: Hiche hi Pathen in Themgao kam'a anaseisa: “Keiman nakom uva thulema kaseiding, Keiman vannoi kisem kipat apat thuguh kisel kahilchet peh ding ahi,” ti aguilhunna ahi.
English: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”

tcz: Chuin mihonpi chu polama adalhan, Yeshua chu insung agalut in ahileh aseijuiten, “Changlhem loulaiya um thulem chu nei hilchet peh un,” atiuve.
en: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
text:
MAT 13:36
Thadou: Chuin mihonpi chu polama adalhan, Yeshua chu insung agalut in ahileh aseijuiten, “Changlhem loulaiya um thulem chu nei hilchet peh un,” atiuve.
English: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Loubolpa, muchipha the a-chu Mihem Chapa ahi.
en: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,
text:
MAT 13:37
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Loubolpa, muchipha the a-chu Mihem Chapa ahi.
English: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

tcz: Lou chu vannoi leiset ahi, chule muchipha chu Lenggam mite ahiuve. Changlhem chu agiloupa mite ho ahiuve.
en: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.
text:
MAT 13:38
Thadou: Lou chu vannoi leiset ahi, chule muchipha chu Lenggam mite ahiuve. Changlhem chu agiloupa mite ho ahiuve.
English: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

tcz: Melma changlhem changtah lah a thepa chu Diabol ahi. Chang at phat chu vannoi kichaina phat ahi, chule chang at ho chu Vantilte ho ahiuve.”
en: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
text:
MAT 13:39
Thadou: Melma changlhem changtah lah a thepa chu Diabol ahi. Chang at phat chu vannoi kichaina phat ahi, chule chang at ho chu Vantilte ho ahiuve.”
English: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

tcz: “Changlhem ho lhendoh a aum'uva chule meiya akigo banga chu, vannoi kichaini jongleh chuti ding ahi.
en: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.
text:
MAT 13:40
Thadou: “Changlhem ho lhendoh a aum'uva chule meiya akigo banga chu, vannoi kichaini jongleh chuti ding ahi.
English: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

tcz: Mihem Chapa chun a-Vantilte ahinsol ding, chule amaho chun Lenggama kon chonset hin umdohsah ho le thilse bol jouse asuhmang dingu ahi.
en: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,
text:
MAT 13:41
Thadou: Mihem Chapa chun a-Vantilte ahinsol ding, chule amaho chun Lenggama kon chonset hin umdohsah ho le thilse bol jouse asuhmang dingu ahi.
English: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,

tcz: Chule Vantil ho chun amaho chu meikou jejua chu alelut dingu, hichea chu kana chule hagelna umding ahi.
en: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
text:
MAT 13:42
Thadou: Chule Vantil ho chun amaho chu meikou jejua chu alelut dingu, hichea chu kana chule hagelna umding ahi.
English: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

tcz: Chuteng michonpha ho chengse a Pau Lenggam sunga nisa tobanga vahding ahiuve. Thungaina ding nakol neiya chun ngaiyu hen chule heuhen!”
en: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
text:
MAT 13:43
Thadou: Chuteng michonpha ho chengse a Pau Lenggam sunga nisa tobanga vahding ahiuve. Thungaina ding nakol neiya chun ngaiyu hen chule heuhen!”
English: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

tcz: “Van'a Lenggam chu mi khat in loulaiya gou kiselguh amudoh tobang ahi. Kipah thanom pum'in aselkit'in chule anei jouse chu ajoh doh in asumnei sun chun lou chu achotai.”
en: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.
text:
MAT 13:44
Thadou: “Van'a Lenggam chu mi khat in loulaiya gou kiselguh amudoh tobang ahi. Kipah thanom pum'in aselkit'in chule anei jouse chu ajoh doh in asumnei sun chun lou chu achotai.”
English: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

tcz: “Chujongleh Van'a Lenggam chu kivei mi khat in twikoh chang manlutah ahol tobang ahi.
en: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,
text:
MAT 13:45
Thadou: “Chujongleh Van'a Lenggam chu kivei mi khat in twikoh chang manlutah ahol tobang ahi.
English: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

tcz: Aman twikoh chang man lutah chu amudoh phat in anei jouse ajoh doh in, chule lou chu achotai.”
en: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.
text:
MAT 13:46
Thadou: Aman twikoh chang man lutah chu amudoh phat in anei jouse ajoh doh in, chule lou chu achotai.”
English: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.

tcz: “Chule Van'a Lenggam chu nga matna len twi lah'a kiseplha a chule nga jouse man tobang ahi.
en: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,
text:
MAT 13:47
Thadou: “Chule Van'a Lenggam chu nga matna len twi lah'a kiseplha a chule nga jouse man tobang ahi.
English: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,

tcz: Len chu adimset phat in, hichu vapama aloidoh uvin, atou khomun chule nga aphaho chu aboma akoiyun, hinlah aphalou ho chu apai mang tauve.
en: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.
text:
MAT 13:48
Thadou: Len chu adimset phat in, hichu vapama aloidoh uvin, atou khomun chule nga aphaho chu aboma akoiyun, hinlah aphalou ho chu apai mang tauve.
English: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

tcz: Vannoi kichaini jongleh chuti ding ahi. Vantil ho hunguvin tin michonpha hoa konna mi gilou ho ahin chom khendoh dingu ahi.
en: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,
text:
MAT 13:49
Thadou: Vannoi kichaini jongleh chuti ding ahi. Vantil ho hunguvin tin michonpha hoa konna mi gilou ho ahin chom khendoh dingu ahi.
English: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

tcz: Miphalou ho chu mei deujeju sunga chun lehlut uvintin, hichea chu kana le hagelna umding ahi.”
en: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
text:
MAT 13:50
Thadou: Miphalou ho chu mei deujeju sunga chun lehlut uvintin, hichea chu kana le hagelna umding ahi.”
English: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

tcz: Hiche hohi aboncha nahet nah uvem? atileh amahon “Henge,” atiuve.
en: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”
text:
MAT 13:51
Thadou: Hiche hohi aboncha nahet nah uvem? atileh amahon “Henge,” atiuve.
English: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

tcz: Chujouvin aman aseiben, “Van'a Lenggama Hou thuhila pang seijui hung hi ho hi, in neipan aneikholna muna kona Thutah gou alui le athah ahin pohdoh tobang ahi,” ati.
en: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”
text:
MAT 13:52
Thadou: Chujouvin aman aseiben, “Van'a Lenggama Hou thuhila pang seijui hung hi ho hi, in neipan aneikholna muna kona Thutah gou alui le athah ahin pohdoh tobang ahi,” ati.
English: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

tcz: Hiche thusimho le vetsahna ho ahil jouvin, aman chuche gam chu adalhan,
en: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.
text:
MAT 13:53
Thadou: Hiche thusimho le vetsahna ho ahil jouvin, aman chuche gam chu adalhan,
English: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

tcz: Achenna khopi Nazareth lama ahung kiletai. Aman amaho hou kikhopna in'a thu ahil pet'in amitakip in adatmo uvin chule aseiyun, “Hoiya kona hiche chihna le thil kidang boltheina hoiya thaneina akilah ahidem?” tin asei-uve.
en: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?
text:
MAT 13:54
Thadou: Achenna khopi Nazareth lama ahung kiletai. Aman amaho hou kikhopna in'a thu ahil pet'in amitakip in adatmo uvin chule aseiyun, “Hoiya kona hiche chihna le thil kidang boltheina hoiya thaneina akilah ahidem?” tin asei-uve.
English: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?

tcz: Amahon anoisebol uvin, “Ama thing thembol chapa ahi, anu Mary le asopi pasal ho—James, Joseph, Simon le Judah abonun ihecheh uve.
en: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
text:
MAT 13:55
Thadou: Amahon anoisebol uvin, “Ama thing thembol chapa ahi, anu Mary le asopi pasal ho—James, Joseph, Simon le Judah abonun ihecheh uve.
English: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

tcz: Asopi numeiho jouse jong ilah uva aumcheh uvin. Hiche ho jouse hi hoiya kona akihetdoh hintem?” atiuvin ahi.
en: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”
text:
MAT 13:56
Thadou: Asopi numeiho jouse jong ilah uva aumcheh uvin. Hiche ho jouse hi hoiya kona akihetdoh hintem?” atiuvin ahi.
English: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

tcz: Chuin amaho chu hatah in alung-lhalheh uvin, chule Ama atahsan nomta pouve. Chuphat in Yeshuan amaho aseipeh in, “Themgao chu ama insung le akhopia mite lah tilouvin mun jousea jabolna achange,” ati.
en: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”
text:
MAT 13:57
Thadou: Chuin amaho chu hatah in alung-lhalheh uvin, chule Ama atahsan nomta pouve. Chuphat in Yeshuan amaho aseipeh in, “Themgao chu ama insung le akhopia mite lah tilouvin mun jousea jabolna achange,” ati.
English: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”

tcz: Chuin amahon atahsan lou jeh uvin thil kidang themkhat bou aboltai.
en: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
text:
MAT 13:58
Thadou: Chuin amahon atahsan lou jeh uvin thil kidang themkhat bou aboltai.
English: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

tcz: Galilee vaipopa Herod Antipas hin Yeshua thu ajah phat in.
en: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
text:
MAT 14:1
Thadou: Galilee vaipopa Herod Antipas hin Yeshua thu ajah phat in.
English: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

tcz: Aman asemang ho koma chun, “Hiche hi Twilutsah John athia thoudoh kit'a hitei inte! Hijeh achu hitobang thil kidang hohi aboldoh ahi,” ati.
en: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
text:
MAT 14:2
Thadou: Aman asemang ho koma chun, “Hiche hi Twilutsah John athia thoudoh kit'a hitei inte! Hijeh achu hitobang thil kidang hohi aboldoh ahi,” ati.
English: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

tcz: Ajeh chu Herod in John chu ajinu Herodias (Herod naopa Philip ji ana hi) lung holna'a amat a songkul'a ahen ahi.
en: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
text:
MAT 14:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu Herod in John chu ajinu Herodias (Herod naopa Philip ji ana hi) lung holna'a amat a songkul'a ahen ahi.
English: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

tcz: John chun Herod jah'a “Amanu na ki chenpi hi Pathen Danthutoh kikal ahi,” atipeh jing anahi.
en: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
text:
MAT 14:4
Thadou: John chun Herod jah'a “Amanu na ki chenpi hi Pathen Danthutoh kikal ahi,” atipeh jing anahi.
English: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

tcz: Herod chun John chu atha nom ahin, hinlah mipin adou diu chu kicha'a ahi, ajeh chu mi jousen John chu Themgao khat ahi tia atahsan'u ahi.
en: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
text:
MAT 14:5
Thadou: Herod chun John chu atha nom ahin, hinlah mipin adou diu chu kicha'a ahi, ajeh chu mi jousen John chu Themgao khat ahi tia atahsan'u ahi.
English: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

tcz: Hinlah Herod in apen nikhoa golnop abol nauva, Herodias chanu alam chun ama alunglhai lheh jeng in.
en: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.
text:
MAT 14:6
Thadou: Hinlah Herod in apen nikhoa golnop abol nauva, Herodias chanu alam chun ama alunglhai lheh jeng in.
English: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

tcz: Hijeh chun amanu hin adei chan ipi hi jong leh pe dinga Herod in kitepna anei ahi.
en: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.
text:
MAT 14:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun amanu hin adei chan ipi hi jong leh pe dinga Herod in kitepna anei ahi.
English: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

tcz: Anu ngeh dungjuiyin, “Nungahnu chun, keiman Twilutsah John luchang chu lheng konga kadeiye,” atitai.
en: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”
text:
MAT 14:8
Thadou: Anu ngeh dungjuiyin, “Nungahnu chun, keiman Twilutsah John luchang chu lheng konga kadeiye,” atitai.
English: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

tcz: Chuphat in lengpan thu-asei chu akisih in, hinlah jin gunho masanga akitepna ahijeh chun, aman aki ngehna bang chun bol ding in asoltai.
en: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,
text:
MAT 14:9
Thadou: Chuphat in lengpan thu-asei chu akisih in, hinlah jin gunho masanga akitepna ahijeh chun, aman aki ngehna bang chun bol ding in asoltai.
English: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

tcz: Hiti chun Twilutsah John chu songkul'a alu atantai.
en: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
text:
MAT 14:10
Thadou: Hiti chun Twilutsah John chu songkul'a alu atantai.
English: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

tcz: Chuin alu chu konga ahung kidom in chule nungahnu chu apen, ama chun anu apetai.
en: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.
text:
MAT 14:11
Thadou: Chuin alu chu konga ahung kidom in chule nungahnu chu apen, ama chun anu apetai.
English: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

tcz: Khonung in, John seijui ho chu ahung un atahsa chu ahung lauvin chule avui tauve. Chutah in amaho aga che uvin, chuin Yeshua jah'a ipi soh a ham ahung hil tauve.
en: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.
text:
MAT 14:12
Thadou: Khonung in, John seijui ho chu ahung un atahsa chu ahung lauvin chule avui tauve. Chutah in amaho aga che uvin, chuin Yeshua jah'a ipi soh a ham ahung hil tauve.
English: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

tcz: Yeshuan thusoh chu ajah jah in, Ama munchom beh a konga aga chen, achanga aga umtai. Hinlah mipi chun hoilama chea ahi ahe uvin, chuin khopi tin'a kon in Ama chu akeng in ajui tauve.
en: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.
text:
MAT 14:13
Thadou: Yeshuan thusoh chu ajah jah in, Ama munchom beh a konga aga chen, achanga aga umtai. Hinlah mipi chun hoilama chea ahi ahe uvin, chuin khopi tin'a kon in Ama chu akeng in ajui tauve.
English: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

tcz: Yeshua chu konga kona ahung kumlhah a ahileh mi honpi chu amun, chule Aman amaho chu akhoton chule anat nau adamsah tai.
en: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.
text:
MAT 14:14
Thadou: Yeshua chu konga kona ahung kumlhah a ahileh mi honpi chu amun, chule Aman amaho chu akhoton chule anat nau adamsah tai.
English: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

tcz: Hiche nilhah chun seijui ho ahung un chule aseiyun, “Hiche lai mun hi mun ningkoi ahin chule phat hi geisanga ahitai. Nangman mi honpi hi soldoh tan, amaho ache uva khotin'a aneh diu akichoh theina ding un,” atiuvin ahi.
en: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”
text:
MAT 14:15
Thadou: Hiche nilhah chun seijui ho ahung un chule aseiyun, “Hiche lai mun hi mun ningkoi ahin chule phat hi geisanga ahitai. Nangman mi honpi hi soldoh tan, amaho ache uva khotin'a aneh diu akichoh theina ding un,” atiuvin ahi.
English: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan aseiyin, “Hichu hithei ponte, nanghon neh ding peuvin,” ati.
en: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”
text:
MAT 14:16
Thadou: Hinlah Yeshuan aseiyin, “Hichu hithei ponte, nanghon neh ding peuvin,” ati.
English: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

tcz: Amahon adonbut uvin, “keihon changlhah pheng nga leh nga ni bou kaneiyuve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”
text:
MAT 14:17
Thadou: Amahon adonbut uvin, “keihon changlhah pheng nga leh nga ni bou kaneiyuve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

tcz: Yeshuan aseiyin “Hichu hin choiyun,” ati.
en: He said, “Bring them here to me.”
text:
MAT 14:18
Thadou: Yeshuan aseiyin “Hichu hin choiyun,” ati.
English: He said, “Bring them here to me.”

tcz: Chutah in aman miho chu phoilah'a tou ding in asei pehtai. Yeshuan changlhah pheng nga le nga ni chu alan vanlam aven, chule phatthei aboh in, chuin aman changlhah chu alan, ahehbal bal in, aseijui ho apen, amaho chun mi honpi chu apeuve.
en: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.
text:
MAT 14:19
Thadou: Chutah in aman miho chu phoilah'a tou ding in asei pehtai. Yeshuan changlhah pheng nga le nga ni chu alan vanlam aven, chule phatthei aboh in, chuin aman changlhah chu alan, ahehbal bal in, aseijui ho apen, amaho chun mi honpi chu apeuve.
English: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

tcz: Amahon angaichat chanun ane uvin, aval chu seijuihon paipeh som le ni alohdoh uve.
en: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.
text:
MAT 14:20
Thadou: Amahon angaichat chanun ane uvin, aval chu seijuihon paipeh som le ni alohdoh uve.
English: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

tcz: Chuche nikho chun pasal cheh mi sang nga chun ane vaset uvin, numei leh chapang ho jong ajao un ahi.
en: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.
text:
MAT 14:21
Thadou: Chuche nikho chun pasal cheh mi sang nga chun ane vaset uvin, numei leh chapang ho jong ajao un ahi.
English: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

tcz: Hiche jou chun Aman miho chu ain uva asol laiyin, aseijuite chu konga lut'a chule Dil gal langkhatna ana galkai ding in asol in ahi.

text:
MAT 14:22

English: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

tcz: Amaho ain uva asoldoh jouvin, ama mol chunga tao ding in akaldoh in ahi. Jan ahung hitan, Ama achangseh'in mol a aum tai.
en: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.
text:
MAT 14:23

text:
MAT 14:24

MAT 14:25

text:
MAT 14:26

en: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
text:
MAT 14:27

English: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

tcz: Chuphat in Peter in Ama ahin houvin, “Pakai, Nangma nahi monga ahileh, nahenga twi chunga lam kahin jotna ding in neihin seipeh in,” ati.

text:
MAT 14:28

English: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

text:
MAT 14:29

text:
MAT 14:30

tcz: Apettah chun Yeshuan akhut alhang in chule ama chu aman in, “Na tahsan aneo behseh'e, ipi dinga nei sonlel ham?” ati.
en: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”
text:
MAT 14:31
Thadou: Apettah chun Yeshuan akhut alhang in chule ama chu aman in, “Na tahsan aneo behseh'e, ipi dinga nei sonlel ham?” ati.

text:

tcz: Chuphat in seijuiho ahung un, Ama a-Hou tauve. Amahon, “Nangma Pathen Chapa tahbeh nahi monge,” atiuve.

text:
MAT 14:33

text:
MAT 14:34

en: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

tcz: Amaho chun apon mongkai beh atham ding uvin angeh uvin, chule Ama thamkha jouse adam tauve.

MAT 14:36

text:

text:
MAT 15:3

English: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

en: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
text:
MAT 15:4

text:

en: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.
text:
MAT 15:6

English: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

English: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

MAT 15:8

tcz: Eihou-u jong bolthu ahibouve, ajeh chu amahon mihem lung suhtoa agelu chu Pathen Thupeh in ahiluvin ahi,” ati.
en: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”
text:
MAT 15:9

English: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”

text:
MAT 15:10

tcz: Nasung uva lut chun nasuboh pouve ti heuvin; nakam uva kona hung potdoh thu joh chun nasuhboh'u ahi” ati.
en: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”
text:

text:
MAT 15:12
Thadou: Chujouvin seijui ho chu akoma ahung un chule adong uvin, “Tua nathusei chun Pharisee ho alung nopmo sah chu nagel doh em?” atiuve.

text:
MAT 15:13

en: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
text:
MAT 15:14

text:
MAT 15:15
Thadou: Chutah in Peter in Yeshua jah a, “Mihon aneh uva akisu bohpoi nati thulem chu neihil chen un,” ati.
English: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

text:
MAT 15:16

English: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

tcz: “Naneh'u chu gilpia alut in chule posona ah aki thadoh jitai.

text:

tcz: Hichengse hin nasuhboh'u ahi. Khutsop louva anneh hin nasuhboh'u ahi poi,” ati.

text:
MAT 15:20

text:
MAT 15:21
Thadou: Chujouvin Yeshuan Galilee chu adalhan chuin Tyre le Sidon gamkai sahlama agache toutai.

en: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”
text:
MAT 15:22
Thadou: Chidang namdang numei khat chuche muna chun ahung in, angeh in, “O Pakai, David Chapa, nei lungset in! Ajeh chu kachanu hi lhagao phalouvin atomin asugim lheh jenge,” ahung ti.

en: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”
text:
MAT 15:23
Thadou: Hinlah Yeshuan kamcheng khat in jong adonbut poi. Chuphat in aseijuite ahung uvin, “Amanu soldoh tan, amanu hi achena ding in seipeh in,” tin asei tauve.
English: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

en: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
text:
MAT 15:24

English: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

text:
MAT 15:25
Thadou: Hinlah amanu ahung in chule a-houvin, chuin angeh kit in, “Pakai nei panhu in,” ati.
English: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Chate nehdi changlhah lahdoh peh a chule uicha peh angai ahipoi,” ati.
en: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
text:
MAT 15:26
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Chate nehdi changlhah lahdoh peh a chule uicha peh angai ahipoi,” ati.
English: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

en: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”
text:
MAT 15:27

en: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.
text:
MAT 15:28

English: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

MAT 15:29

en: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,
text:

en: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.
text:
MAT 15:31
Thadou: Mi honpi chun adatmo lheh uve. Apao thei louho jong apao theiyun, akhel a toi ho jong adamdoh un, chule nakong chatmo ho jong adamdoh un, chule mitcho hon jong kho amu tauve. Chuin amahon Israel Pathen chu avahchoi tauve.

Amaho hi gilkel'a soldoh ding kanompoi, achuti louva ahileh lampia lhasampa a alhuhkam diu ka nompoi,” ati.
en: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”
text:
MAT 15:32
Thadou: Chujouvin Yeshuan aseijui ho akou khom in, ajah uvah, “Hiche mihonpi hi ka khoto'e. Amaho hi hiche muna hi keimato ni thum jen um ahitauve. Chule amahon aneh diu imacha khendoh anei pouve. Amaho hi gilkel'a soldoh ding kanompoi, achuti louva ahileh lampia lhasampa a alhuhkam diu ka nompoi,” ati.
English: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

tcz: Seijuihon adonbut uvin, “Mi honpi hibang loma tam hi aneh diu gamthip muna hi hoiya ilah diu ham?” atiuve.
en: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”
text:
MAT 15:33
Thadou: Seijuihon adonbut uvin, “Mi honpi hibang loma tam hi aneh diu gamthip muna hi hoiya ilah diu ham?” atiuve.
English: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

tcz: Yeshuan adong in, “Changlhah ijat na neiyuvem,” ati. Amahon adonbut un, “Changlhah pheng sagi le nga them khat,” atiuve.
en: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”
text:
MAT 15:34
Thadou: Yeshuan adong in, “Changlhah ijat na neiyuvem,” ati. Amahon adonbut un, “Changlhah pheng sagi le nga them khat,” atiuve.
English: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

tcz: Hiti chun Yeshua chun mi jouse chu, tol a tou ding in aseipeh tai.
en: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

tcz: Chuin aman changlhah pheng sagi le nga chu alan, amaho ding in Pathen thangvahna aneiyin, chule ahal halin ahehbal bal in, Aman aseijuiho apen, amaho chun neh ding chu mi honpi lah a chun ahom tauve.
en: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

MAT 15:36

English: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

tcz: Amahon angaichat jat dungjuiyun aboncha uvin ane tauve. Hiche jou chun aseijuite chun anehval'u chu paipeh sagi alohdoh uvin ahi.
en: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.
text:
MAT 15:37

English: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

tcz: Amaho chu pasal sang li jen alhing uvin, numei ho le chapang ho jong ajao un ahi.
en: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.
text:
MAT 15:38
Thadou: Amaho chu pasal sang li jen alhing uvin, numei ho le chapang ho jong ajao un ahi.
English: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

tcz: Chujouvin Yeshuan mi honpi chu a-incheh ah asol in, chuin Ama chu kong khat'a alut'in Magadan gamkai lam a agalkai tai.
en: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

MAT 15:39

tcz: Nikhat hi Pharisee ho leh Sadducee ho Yeshua koma apatep ding in ahung un, athuneina thudola melchihna kidang khat ahung ngeh uvin ahi.
en: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
text:
MAT 16:1
Thadou: Nikhat hi Pharisee ho leh Sadducee ho Yeshua koma apatep ding in ahung un, athuneina thudola melchihna kidang khat ahung ngeh uvin ahi.
English: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

tcz: Aman adonbut in, “Nanghon janteng van asan le jing leh kho phading ahi natiuvin,
en: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’
text:
MAT 16:2
Thadou: Aman adonbut in, “Nanghon janteng van asan le jing leh kho phading ahi natiuvin,
English: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’

tcz: Jingkah a van asan le nilhuma kho phalou ding ahi natiuva nahet'u ahi. Nanghon kho phat ding thua vana melchihna a kona nahet'u ahi, hinlah phat umdol amelchihna na hedoh thei pouve.
en: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!
text:
MAT 16:3
Thadou: Jingkah a van asan le nilhuma kho phalou ding ahi natiuva nahet'u ahi. Nanghon kho phat ding thua vana melchihna a kona nahet'u ahi, hinlah phat umdol amelchihna na hedoh thei pouve.
English: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!

tcz: Khang gilou le jonthan hoina khang miten melchihna kidang ahol uve, hinlah melchihna khat bou amaho kapeh dingu chu Themgao Jonah melchihna bou hiding ahi,” ati.
en: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.
text:
