Thadou: Khang gilou le jonthan hoina khang miten melchihna kidang ahol uve, hinlah melchihna khat bou amaho kapeh dingu chu Themgao Jonah melchihna bou hiding ahi,” ati.
English: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.

tcz: Chuche jouvin, Dillen langkhat lama agalkai phat in, seijui hon changlhah apoh lou uchu ahin geldoh tauve.
en: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.
text:
MAT 16:5
Thadou: Chuche jouvin, Dillen langkhat lama agalkai phat in, seijui hon changlhah apoh lou uchu ahin geldoh tauve.
English: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

tcz: Yeshuan amaho agih salin, “Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho chol'a kon in kichih theiyun,” ati.
en: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
text:
MAT 16:6
Thadou: Yeshuan amaho agih salin, “Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho chol'a kon in kichih theiyun,” ati.
English: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

tcz: Amahon changlhah apoh tahlou jeh'u chun khat le khat akinel den tauve.
en: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”
text:
MAT 16:7
Thadou: Amahon changlhah apoh tahlou jeh'u chun khat le khat akinel den tauve.
English: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”

tcz: Yeshuan amahon ipi seija ahiu chu ahen, hiti chun, “Na tahsanu alhom tave! Changlhah neilou jeh'a ipi dia kinela nahi uvem?
en: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?
text:
MAT 16:8
Thadou: Yeshuan amahon ipi seija ahiu chu ahen, hiti chun, “Na tahsanu alhom tave! Changlhah neilou jeh'a ipi dia kinela nahi uvem?
English: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?

tcz: Tugeiya hi nahetdoh lou uham? Mi sang nga changlhah pheng nga'a kavahva chu aval paipeh ijat nalodoh'u hitam?
en: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,
text:
MAT 16:9
Thadou: Tugeiya hi nahetdoh lou uham? Mi sang nga changlhah pheng nga'a kavahva chu aval paipeh ijat nalodoh'u hitam?
English: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,

tcz: Ahilou jongleh mi sang li changlhah pheng sagia, chule aval paipeh tamtah nalodoh uchu?
en: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
text:
MAT 16:10
Thadou: Ahilou jongleh mi sang li changlhah pheng sagia, chule aval paipeh tamtah nalodoh uchu?
English: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

tcz: Ipi iti dana changlhah chung thua kasei ahipoi ti hedoh theilou nahi uvem? Hitia hi avela kasei ahi, Pharisee ho leh Sadducee ho chol lah achun kichih theiyun kati ahi,” ati.
en: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
text:
MAT 16:11
Thadou: Ipi iti dana changlhah chung thua kasei ahipoi ti hedoh theilou nahi uvem? Hitia hi avela kasei ahi, Pharisee ho leh Sadducee ho chol lah achun kichih theiyun kati ahi,” ati.
English: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

tcz: Chuphat in anunung pena, Aman changlhah'a chol thu asei hilouva, Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho doha lhep lhahna thuhil aneiyuva achihthei diuva ahil chu ahedoh tauve.
en: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
text:
MAT 16:12
Thadou: Chuphat in anunung pena, Aman changlhah'a chol thu asei hilouva, Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho doha lhep lhahna thuhil aneiyuva achihthei diuva ahil chu ahedoh tauve.
English: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

tcz: Yeshuan Caesarea Philippi ahunggei phat in, aseijui ho jah a “Mihon, Mihem Chapa hi koi ahi atiuvem?” tin adong tai.
en: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”
text:
MAT 16:13
Thadou: Yeshuan Caesarea Philippi ahunggei phat in, aseijui ho jah a “Mihon, Mihem Chapa hi koi ahi atiuvem?” tin adong tai.
English: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”

tcz: Amahon adonbut un, “Mi phabep chun Twilutsah John ahi atiuvin, mi phabep chun Elijah ahi atiuvin, chule adang phabepma chun Jeremiah ahilouleh themgao ho lah'a khatpen hinte,” atiuve.
en: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
text:
MAT 16:14
Thadou: Amahon adonbut un, “Mi phabep chun Twilutsah John ahi atiuvin, mi phabep chun Elijah ahi atiuvin, chule adang phabepma chun Jeremiah ahilouleh themgao ho lah'a khatpen hinte,” atiuve.
English: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

tcz: Chujouvin, amaho chu thu adong in, “Nanghon koi ahi neitiu vem?” ati.
en: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”
text:
MAT 16:15
Thadou: Chujouvin, amaho chu thu adong in, “Nanghon koi ahi neitiu vem?” ati.
English: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”

tcz: Simon Peter in adonbut in, “Nangma Messiah, Pathen hing Chapa nahi,” ati.
en: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
text:
MAT 16:16
Thadou: Simon Peter in adonbut in, “Nangma Messiah, Pathen hing Chapa nahi,” ati.
English: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nangma anunnom a nahi, John chapa Simon, ajeh chu nangman mihem koima'a kona nahet ahipon, vana ka-Pan na henga hiche hi ahin phondoh ahi.
en: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.
text:
MAT 16:17
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nangma anunnom a nahi, John chapa Simon, ajeh chu nangman mihem koima'a kona nahet ahipon, vana ka-Pan na henga hiche hi ahin phondoh ahi.
English: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

tcz: Na henga kasei ahi, nangma Peter (Song) nahi, chule hiche Songpi (Christa) chunga hi Ka houbung Ka tundoh ding ahi, chule Damun thaneina in ajo joulou ding ahi.
en: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
text:
MAT 16:18
Thadou: Na henga kasei ahi, nangma Peter (Song) nahi, chule hiche Songpi (Christa) chunga hi Ka houbung Ka tundoh ding ahi, chule Damun thaneina in ajo joulou ding ahi.
English: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

tcz: Chule Keiman Van gam kot heh ho kapeh ding nahi. Leiset chunga ipi hijongleh bollou dinga na thupeh chan chu vana jong kibol lou ding, chule leiset chunga ipi hijongleh na noppeh chan chu vana jong kinop peh ding ahi,” ati.
en: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”
text:
MAT 16:19
Thadou: Chule Keiman Van gam kot heh ho kapeh ding nahi. Leiset chunga ipi hijongleh bollou dinga na thupeh chan chu vana jong kibol lou ding, chule leiset chunga ipi hijongleh na noppeh chan chu vana jong kinop peh ding ahi,” ati.
English: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

tcz: Chujouvin Aman aseijui ho jah achun koima koma Messiah ahi chu, aphondoh louna ding uvin hatah in agihtai.
en: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.
text:
MAT 16:20
Thadou: Chujouvin Aman aseijui ho jah achun koima koma Messiah ahi chu, aphondoh louna ding uvin hatah in agihtai.
English: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

tcz: Chuchea pat chun Yeshuan aseijuite koma kichen tah in, Jerusalem a aga che ding angai khohna aseiyin, chule aman hou vaipo loi le thempu le houdan thuhil hoa kona thil tampi gimnei hahsa ho athoh ding chu ahiltai. Ama ahin tha diu, hinlah anithum lhin nileh thina a kona thoudoh ding ahi.
en: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
text:
MAT 16:21
Thadou: Chuchea pat chun Yeshuan aseijuite koma kichen tah in, Jerusalem a aga che ding angai khohna aseiyin, chule aman hou vaipo loi le thempu le houdan thuhil hoa kona thil tampi gimnei hahsa ho athoh ding chu ahiltai. Ama ahin tha diu, hinlah anithum lhin nileh thina a kona thoudoh ding ahi.
English: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

tcz: Hinlah Peter chun Ama apuidoh in chule chutia thu asei chu haphon aphoh in, “Pakai Vanin jong oiponte, hiche hi na chunga lhung hih beh jeng hen,” atitai.
en: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”
text:
MAT 16:22
Thadou: Hinlah Peter chun Ama apuidoh in chule chutia thu asei chu haphon aphoh in, “Pakai Vanin jong oiponte, hiche hi na chunga lhung hih beh jeng hen,” atitai.
English: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”

tcz: Yeshua, Peter lama aki heiyin, ajah a, “Satan, kakoma konin chemang in! Nang hi keima dinga tijat um thangkol nahi! Nangman Pathen a kon hilouvin mihem lunggel a kona navet jeh ahi,” ati.
en: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”
text:
MAT 16:23
Thadou: Yeshua, Peter lama aki heiyin, ajah a, “Satan, kakoma konin chemang in! Nang hi keima dinga tijat um thangkol nahi! Nangman Pathen a kon hilouvin mihem lunggel a kona navet jeh ahi,” ati.
English: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”

tcz: Chuphat in Yeshuan aseijuite koma, “Nalah uva koi hijongleh eijui noma chun, nacham chon nauva kona nahung kiheiyuva, na thingpel nakiput uva, chule neijui diu ahi.
en: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
text:
MAT 16:24

English: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

tcz: Na hinkhou naki kolchah jom uva ahileh, na mansah dingu ahi. Hinlah nanghon keima jal'a nahin nau naphal doh uva ahileh, naki huhhing diu ahi.
en: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.
text:
MAT 16:25
Thadou: Na hinkhou naki kolchah jom uva ahileh, na mansah dingu ahi. Hinlah nanghon keima jal'a nahin nau naphal doh uva ahileh, naki huhhing diu ahi.
English: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

tcz: Chule vannoi apumpi nanga hihen lang, na hinna chan tale chun ipi phachom ding ham? Na hinna sanga man lujo ipi um nalaiyem?
en: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
text:

tcz: Ajeh chu Mihem Chapa hi avantil teho toh'a Pa loupina a hung ding chule mi jouse chu atoh dung juicheh a athu'u atan ding ahi.
en: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according to his deeds.
text:
MAT 16:27

tcz: Chule Keiman thutah kaseipeh nahi uve, hikoma tupetna ding ho lah'a Mihem Chapa a Lenggama ahung masanga thilou ding aum uve,” ati.
en: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”
text:
MAT 16:28
Thadou: Chule Keiman thutah kaseipeh nahi uve, hikoma tupetna ding ho lah'a Mihem Chapa a Lenggama ahung masanga thilou ding aum uve,” ati.

tcz: Ni gup jouvin Yeshuan Peter chule ucha teni Jacob le John chu molsang tah khat'a achanga umpi ding in apui touvin ahi.
en: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.
text:
MAT 17:1
Thadou: Ni gup jouvin Yeshuan Peter chule ucha teni Jacob le John chu molsang tah khat'a achanga umpi ding in apui touvin ahi.
English: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

tcz: Amaho chun avet pettah un Yeshua limso chu ahung kikhel in, hiti chun amaiso chu nisa bang in avah jeng in, chule aponsil chu vah bang in avah jeng in ahi.
en: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.
text:
MAT 17:2
Thadou: Amaho chun avet pettah un Yeshua limso chu ahung kikhel in, hiti chun amaiso chu nisa bang in avah jeng in, chule aponsil chu vah bang in avah jeng in ahi.
English: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

tcz: Phot lot in Mose le Elijah ahung kilah in, chuin Yeshua chu akihou limpi pai lhon in ahi.
en: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.
text:
MAT 17:3
Thadou: Phot lot in Mose le Elijah ahung kilah in, chuin Yeshua chu akihou limpi pai lhon in ahi.
English: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

tcz: Peter chun Pakai, “Hikoma iumu hi aki dang lheh jenge! Nadeiya ahileh nang ding khat, Mose ding khat chule Elijah ding khat melchihna ponbuh thum song inge,” ati.
en: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
text:
MAT 17:4
Thadou: Peter chun Pakai, “Hikoma iumu hi aki dang lheh jenge! Nadeiya ahileh nang ding khat, Mose ding khat chule Elijah ding khat melchihna ponbuh thum song inge,” ati.
English: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

tcz: Hinlah aman athusei pet chun meibang in amaho chu ahin tom khum un, chule vana konin aw khat in ahin-seiyin, “Hiche hi Ka Chapa ngailut tahbeh, ei kipa sah'a ahi, Athu ngaiyun,” ati.
en: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”
text:
MAT 17:5
Thadou: Hinlah aman athusei pet chun meibang in amaho chu ahin tom khum un, chule vana konin aw khat in ahin-seiyin, “Hiche hi Ka Chapa ngailut tahbeh, ei kipa sah'a ahi, Athu ngaiyun,” ati.
English: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

tcz: Seijui ho chu akicha behseh'un, chuin tol a amaiyu asulut tauve.
en: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.
text:
MAT 17:6
Thadou: Seijui ho chu akicha behseh'un, chuin tol a amaiyu asulut tauve.
English: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

tcz: Chuphat in Yeshua amaho lama ahung in chule amaho chu atham in, “Thoudoh un, kicha hih un,” ati.
en: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”
text:
MAT 17:7
Thadou: Chuphat in Yeshua amaho lama ahung in chule amaho chu atham in, “Thoudoh un, kicha hih un,” ati.
English: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”

tcz: Chuin amaho adadoh uva ahileh, Mose le Elijah chu ana chedoh tan, chule Yeshua bou chu amu tauve.
en: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.
text:
MAT 17:8
Thadou: Chuin amaho adadoh uva ahileh, Mose le Elijah chu ana chedoh tan, chule Yeshua bou chu amu tauve.
English: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

tcz: Amaho molchunga kona ahung kinung le suh phat'un Yeshuan Amaho chu thu apen, “Mihem Chapa thina a kona kaithouva aum kahsen koima koma na thilmu'u hi seidoh hih un,” ati.
en: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”
text:
MAT 17:9
Thadou: Amaho molchunga kona ahung kinung le suh phat'un Yeshuan Amaho chu thu apen, “Mihem Chapa thina a kona kaithouva aum kahsen koima koma na thilmu'u hi seidoh hih un,” ati.
English: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

tcz: Chujou chun aseijui-ten Ama adong un, “Ipi jeh a Dan thuhil hon Messiah hung masanga Elijah hung kile ding ahi tia asei sei jingu hintem?” atiuve.
en: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
text:
MAT 17:10
Thadou: Chujou chun aseijui-ten Ama adong un, “Ipi jeh a Dan thuhil hon Messiah hung masanga Elijah hung kile ding ahi tia asei sei jingu hintem?” atiuve.
English: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Elijah chu tahbeh a hunga ijakai agontup masat ding ahi.
en: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;

tcz: Hinlah Keiman kaseipeh nahiuve. Elijah ana hunga ahitai, ama chu isah louvin abol tauve. Chule chutobang ma'a Mihem Chapan jong athoh gim ding ahi,” ati.
en: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”
text:
MAT 17:12
Thadou: Hinlah Keiman kaseipeh nahiuve. Elijah ana hunga ahitai, ama chu isah louvin abol tauve. Chule chutobang ma'a Mihem Chapan jong athoh gim ding ahi,” ati.
English: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”

tcz: Chuin seijui ho chun Twilutsah John chung thu asei ahi ahedoh tauve.
en: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.
text:
MAT 17:13
Thadou: Chuin seijui ho chun Twilutsah John chung thu asei ahi ahedoh tauve.
English: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

tcz: Mi tampi chun Ama chu mol chunga ana ngah tauvin, mikhat chu ahung in chuin Yeshua ang-ah adilsun chule aseiyin,
en: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,
text:
MAT 17:14
Thadou: Mi tampi chun Ama chu mol chunga ana ngah tauvin, mikhat chu ahung in chuin Yeshua ang-ah adilsun chule aseiyin,
English: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

tcz: “Pakai Ka chapa lungsetna neiyin, ama abuhthia ahin, chule athoh gim lheh e. Ama meisunga ahilouleh twi lah'a alhu matchet jin ahi.
en: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.
text:
MAT 17:15
Thadou: “Pakai Ka chapa lungsetna neiyin, ama abuhthia ahin, chule athoh gim lheh e. Ama meisunga ahilouleh twi lah'a alhu matchet jin ahi.
English: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

tcz: Hitia hi naseijuite koma kahin puiyin, hinlah amahon adamsah jou pouve,” ati.
en: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”
text:
MAT 17:16
Thadou: Hitia hi naseijuite koma kahin puiyin, hinlah amahon adamsah jou pouve,” ati.
English: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

tcz: Yeshuan, “Vo tahsan neilou le miduh dahlou ho! Itih chan kaumpi nahlai ding nahiu vem? Chapangpa chu kakoma hin hinpuiyun,” ati.
en: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”
text:
MAT 17:17
Thadou: Yeshuan, “Vo tahsan neilou le miduh dahlou ho! Itih chan kaumpi nahlai ding nahiu vem? Chapangpa chu kakoma hin hinpuiyun,” ati.
English: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

tcz: Chutah in chapangpa sunga lhagaoboh chu Yeshuan aphoh in, hichun ama adalhatai. Hichea pat chun chapang chu adamtheng tai.
en: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.
text:
MAT 17:18
Thadou: Chutah in chapangpa sunga lhagaoboh chu Yeshuan aphoh in, hichun ama adalhatai. Hichea pat chun chapang chu adamtheng tai.
English: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

tcz: Chujou chun seijuiho chun guhthim in Yeshua chu adong un, “Keihon itia lhagaoboh chu nodoh joulou kahiu ham?” atiuve.
en: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”
text:
MAT 17:19
Thadou: Chujou chun seijuiho chun guhthim in Yeshua chu adong un, “Keihon itia lhagaoboh chu nodoh joulou kahiu ham?” atiuve.
English: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

tcz: Yeshuan aseipeh un, “Tahsan bulhing naneilou jeh'u ahi. Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, tahsana aneova neo ankam mu tebep geiya naneiyuva ahileh, nanghon hiche mol jah'a hin, hichea kon khun kichon in tia nasei uleh, kichon thei ahi. Imacha ahimo ding aumpoi.
en: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.
text:
MAT 17:20
Thadou: Yeshuan aseipeh un, “Tahsan bulhing naneilou jeh'u ahi. Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, tahsana aneova neo ankam mu tebep geiya naneiyuva ahileh, nanghon hiche mol jah'a hin, hichea kon khun kichon in tia nasei uleh, kichon thei ahi. Imacha ahimo ding aumpoi.
English: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

tcz: Hinlah hitobang lhagaoboh hi taona chule an ngol tilou potdoh lou ahi,” ati.
en: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”
text:
MAT 17:21
Thadou: Hinlah hitobang lhagaoboh hi taona chule an ngol tilou potdoh lou ahi,” ati.
English: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”

tcz: Galilee a amaho akikhop kit phat un, Yeshuan aseipeh un, “Mihem Chapa hi amelmate khut'a pehdoh a um ding ahi.
en: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,
text:
MAT 17:22
Thadou: Galilee a amaho akikhop kit phat un, Yeshuan aseipeh un, “Mihem Chapa hi amelmate khut'a pehdoh a um ding ahi.
English: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

tcz: Ama atha diu, hinlah ani thum nileh athia kona kai thouva um ding ahi,” ati. Chuin seijuiho chu lunghem nan adim tauve.
en: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.
text:
MAT 17:23
Thadou: Ama atha diu, hinlah ani thum nileh athia kona kai thouva um ding ahi,” ati. Chuin seijuiho chu lunghem nan adim tauve.
English: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

tcz: Capernaum ahunglhun un, Hou'in a kaidong ho Peter koma ahung un chuin ajah a, “Na houhil pauvin Hou in kai apeh ngailou ham?” tin adong uve.
en: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”
text:
MAT 17:24
Thadou: Capernaum ahunglhun un, Hou'in a kaidong ho Peter koma ahung un chuin ajah a, “Na houhil pauvin Hou in kai apeh ngailou ham?” tin adong uve.
English: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”

tcz: “Henge, apejie,” tin Peter in adonbut e. Chuphat in in sunga agaluttai. Hinlah aman thu asei masang in, Yeshuan anadong in, “Peter, ipi iti nagel em? Lengho khun ama mite kai adon jiu ha? Ahilouleh gal'a ajosa hou koma kai adonu ham?” ati.
en: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”
text:
MAT 17:25
Thadou: “Henge, apejie,” tin Peter in adonbut e. Chuphat in in sunga agaluttai. Hinlah aman thu asei masang in, Yeshuan anadong in, “Peter, ipi iti nagel em? Lengho khun ama mite kai adon jiu ha? Ahilouleh gal'a ajosa hou koma kai adonu ham?” ati.
English: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

tcz: Peter in adonbut in, “Gal'a ajohou koma kai adong uve,” ati. Yeshuan aseiyin, “Chuti ahileh aphai, agam mite chu ongthola ahiuve.
en: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.
text:
MAT 17:26
Thadou: Peter in adonbut in, “Gal'a ajohou koma kai adong uve,” ati. Yeshuan aseiyin, “Chuti ahileh aphai, agam mite chu ongthola ahiuve.
English: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

tcz: Hijongleh, amaho lung thoisah pohite, hiti hin Dil a gakum lhan chule ngakoi galeh lhan. Nga namat masatpen kam chu keh in, chuteng nangman sana dangka apeh len khat namu ding ahi. Hichu choiyin lang, ini lhon ding in ga petan,” ati.
en: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”
text:
MAT 17:27
Thadou: Hijongleh, amaho lung thoisah pohite, hiti hin Dil a gakum lhan chule ngakoi galeh lhan. Nga namat masatpen kam chu keh in, chuteng nangman sana dangka apeh len khat namu ding ahi. Hichu choiyin lang, ini lhon ding in ga petan,” ati.
English: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”

tcz: Hichepet chun seijuiho Yeshua henga ahung un chule thudoh aneiyun, “Van Lenggama chu koipen alenpen hi ding ham?” atiuve.
en: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”
text:
MAT 18:1
Thadou: Hichepet chun seijuiho Yeshua henga ahung un chule thudoh aneiyun, “Van Lenggama chu koipen alenpen hi ding ham?” atiuve.
English: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

tcz: Yeshuan chapang neocha khat akoma din akouvin, chuin chapang chu alah uva adinsah in.
en: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them
text:
MAT 18:2
Thadou: Yeshuan chapang neocha khat akoma din akouvin, chuin chapang chu alah uva adinsah in.
English: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them

tcz: Chuphat in aseitai, “Tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, nangho nachonset nauva kona nakile heiyuva chule chapang neocha ho tobang nahung hilou uva ahileh, Van Lenggam a nalut louhel diu ahi.
en: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
text:
MAT 18:3
Thadou: Chuphat in aseitai, “Tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, nangho nachonset nauva kona nakile heiyuva chule chapang neocha ho tobang nahung hilou uva ahileh, Van Lenggam a nalut louhel diu ahi.
English: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

tcz: Hijeh chun koi hijongleh chapang neocha ho tobanga kineosah mi chu, Van Lenggam a alenpen hi ding ahi.
en: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
text:
MAT 18:4
Thadou: Hijeh chun koi hijongleh chapang neocha ho tobanga kineosah mi chu, Van Lenggam a alenpen hi ding ahi.
English: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

tcz: Chule koi hijongleh Keima khel a chapang neokhat sanga chun, Keima eisan ahi.”
en: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,
text:
MAT 18:5
Thadou: Chule koi hijongleh Keima khel a chapang neokhat sanga chun, Keima eisan ahi.”
English: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

tcz: Hinlah nanghon hiche aneocha ho lah'a khat Keima eitahsan achu chonsetna nalhahsah uva ahileh, sumhei lentah khat na ngong changa kihen henlang twikhanglen'a kileh lut lechun nangma ding in aphajoi.
en: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.
text:
MAT 18:6
Thadou: Hinlah nanghon hiche aneocha ho lah'a khat Keima eitahsan achu chonsetna nalhahsah uva ahileh, sumhei lentah khat na ngong changa kihen henlang twikhanglen'a kileh lut lechun nangma ding in aphajoi.
English: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

tcz: “Vannoiya hi itobang gimnan ahinphah ding hitam! Ajeh chu miho chonse din alhem in ahi. Lhep patepna hohi pel theilou ahi, hinlah alhema pang mi chu iti hahsat ding hitan tem?
en: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!
text:
MAT 18:7
Thadou: “Vannoiya hi itobang gimnan ahinphah ding hitam! Ajeh chu miho chonse din alhem in ahi. Lhep patepna hohi pel theilou ahi, hinlah alhema pang mi chu iti hahsat ding hitan tem?
English: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

tcz: Hijeh chun nakhut ahilouleh nakeng in chonset nabolsah leh tanbong in chule paimang in khutkhat ahilouleh kengkhat neiya tonsot hinna'a nalut chu, khut ni ahilouleh keng ni neiya tonsot meidila nalut sang in gamcheng in aphajon ahi.
en: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.
text:
MAT 18:8
Thadou: Hijeh chun nakhut ahilouleh nakeng in chonset nabolsah leh tanbong in chule paimang in khutkhat ahilouleh kengkhat neiya tonsot hinna'a nalut chu, khut ni ahilouleh keng ni neiya tonsot meidila nalut sang in gamcheng in aphajon ahi.
English: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

tcz: Chule namit in nachonset sah'a ahileh, kaldoh'in lang chule paimang jeng in. Mit khat neiya tonsot hinna'a lut chu mit ni neiya meidila lut ding sang in aphajoi.”
en: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.
text:
MAT 18:9
Thadou: Chule namit in nachonset sah'a ahileh, kaldoh'in lang chule paimang jeng in. Mit khat neiya tonsot hinna'a lut chu mit ni neiya meidila lut ding sang in aphajoi.”
English: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

tcz: Ching theiyun, nanghon hiche ho lah a aneopen ho jong noise hih un. Ajeh chu van a avantil teu van a ka Pa ang sunga um jing ahiuve.
en: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.
text:
MAT 18:10
Thadou: Ching theiyun, nanghon hiche ho lah a aneopen ho jong noise hih un. Ajeh chu van a avantil teu van a ka Pa ang sunga um jing ahiuve.
English: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.

tcz: Chule Mihem Chapa hi amangthah ho chu huhhing dinga hung ahi.
en: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.
text:
MAT 18:11
Thadou: Chule Mihem Chapa hi amangthah ho chu huhhing dinga hung ahi.
English: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.

tcz: “Mikhat in kelngoi jakhat neihen lang, chule hiche ho lah a khat chu vahmang taleh amapa chun ipi aboldem? Aman adangse somko le ko chu mol achun dalhan tin chule amang chu holding a chedoh lou ding ham?
en: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?
text:
MAT 18:12
Thadou: “Mikhat in kelngoi jakhat neihen lang, chule hiche ho lah a khat chu vahmang taleh amapa chun ipi aboldem? Aman adangse somko le ko chu mol achun dalhan tin chule amang chu holding a chedoh lou ding ham?
English: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

tcz: Chule aman amu tengleh, tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, ama chunga akipana chu avah manglou somko le ko sanga lenjo ding ahi.
en: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.
text:
MAT 18:13
Thadou: Chule aman amu tengleh, tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, ama chunga akipana chu avah manglou somko le ko sanga lenjo ding ahi.
English: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

tcz: Hitobangma achu, hiche aneocha ho lah'a khatpen amah thah ding chu van a um Ka Pa lunglam ahipoi.”
en: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.
text:
MAT 18:14
Thadou: Hitobangma achu, hiche aneocha ho lah'a khatpen amah thah ding chu van a um Ka Pa lunglam ahipoi.”
English: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

tcz: “Tahsan nei mi dang khat nangma douna a achonset a ahileh, na chang in chen chule athemmona chu seipeh in. Aman nasei angaiya chule hichu aphondoh'a ahileh, nangman ama chu nathujo ahitai.
en: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.
text:
MAT 18:15
Thadou: “Tahsan nei mi dang khat nangma douna a achonset a ahileh, na chang in chen chule athemmona chu seipeh in. Aman nasei angaiya chule hichu aphondoh'a ahileh, nangman ama chu nathujo ahitai.
English: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

tcz: Hinlah nathujo joulou tah'a ahileh, nangman mikhat ahilouleh mini kipuiyin, gache kit in, hitia chu nangman nasei chu hettohsahna ni ahilouleh thum in phochen hen.
en: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
text:
MAT 18:16
Thadou: Hinlah nathujo joulou tah'a ahileh, nangman mikhat ahilouleh mini kipuiyin, gache kit in, hitia chu nangman nasei chu hettohsahna ni ahilouleh thum in phochen hen.
English: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

tcz: Ama ada nahlaiya nasei angai louva ahileh, nachung thu chu houbunga lhut in. Chutengleh ama chun houbung thu angai louva ahileh, hichepa chu milim hou ahilouleh chidang nam dang in kisim jeng hen.”
en: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.
text:
MAT 18:17
Thadou: Ama ada nahlaiya nasei angai louva ahileh, nachung thu chu houbunga lhut in. Chutengleh ama chun houbung thu angai louva ahileh, hichepa chu milim hou ahilouleh chidang nam dang in kisim jeng hen.”
English: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.

tcz: “Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, nanghon leiset chunga najahda chan uchu vana jong kijada ding, chule leiset chunga naphal chanu chu vana jong kiphal peh ding ahi. Leiset chunga ipi hijongleh bollou ding nati chan chu vana jong kibol lou ding, chule leiset chunga ipi hijongleh na phalpeh chan chu vana jong kiphal peh ding ahi.
en: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.
text:
MAT 18:18
Thadou: “Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, nanghon leiset chunga najahda chan uchu vana jong kijada ding, chule leiset chunga naphal chanu chu vana jong kiphal peh ding ahi. Leiset chunga ipi hijongleh bollou ding nati chan chu vana jong kibol lou ding, chule leiset chunga ipi hijongleh na phalpeh chan chu vana jong kiphal peh ding ahi.
English: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

tcz: Hiche jong hi ka seipeh nahiuve: Nalah uva mi ni na kinop touva ipi hijongleh leiset chunga nathum chan'u chu, vana Ka Pan nang ho dinga abol ding ahi.
en: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.
text:
MAT 18:19
Thadou: Hiche jong hi ka seipeh nahiuve: Nalah uva mi ni na kinop touva ipi hijongleh leiset chunga nathum chan'u chu, vana Ka Pan nang ho dinga abol ding ahi.
English: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh Kamin a ni ahilouleh thum naki khop khom nau chana chun, Keima nalah uva kaum jing e,” ati.
en: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
text:
MAT 18:20
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh Kamin a ni ahilouleh thum naki khop khom nau chana chun, Keima nalah uva kaum jing e,” ati.
English: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

tcz: Chujouvin, Peter Ama koma ahung in chuin ajah a, “Pakai, mi koiham khat chu keima douna a achonset a ahileh, ijatvei kijoma kangaidam thei ham? Sagi vei chan gei ham?” ati.
en: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”
text:
MAT 18:21
Thadou: Chujouvin, Peter Ama koma ahung in chuin ajah a, “Pakai, mi koiham khat chu keima douna a achonset a ahileh, ijatvei kijoma kangaidam thei ham? Sagi vei chan gei ham?” ati.
English: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Keiman najah'a sagi vei katipoi, hinlah sagi mun som sagi vei kaseina ahijoi.”
en: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
text:
MAT 18:22
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Keiman najah'a sagi vei katipoi, hinlah sagi mun som sagi vei kaseina ahijoi.”
English: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

tcz: “Hiche jeh'a hi van Lenggam chu Lengpa khat in asohte toh, ama koma sum baho chuto sum suto dinga akou khom toh kitekah thei ahi.
en: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
text:
MAT 18:23
Thadou: “Hiche jeh'a hi van Lenggam chu Lengpa khat in asohte toh, ama koma sum baho chuto sum suto dinga akou khom toh kitekah thei ahi.
English: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

tcz: Aman sum asuhto khom nauva chun, ama koma sum sang som bapa chu ahinkai tauve.
en: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.
text:
MAT 18:24
Thadou: Aman sum asuhto khom nauva chun, ama koma sum sang som bapa chu ahinkai tauve.
English: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

tcz: Aman asah joulou phat in, apupa chun aji leh achate chule anei jouse ajoh'a abat chu asah dingin thu apetai.”
en: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
text:
MAT 18:25
Thadou: Aman asah joulou phat in, apupa chun aji leh achate chule anei jouse ajoh'a abat chu asah dingin thu apetai.”
English: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

tcz: “Hinlah ama chu apupa ang sunga chun abohkhup in chuin athum in, ‘Lungsettah in, nei khongaiyin, keiman abonchan pena nge’” ati.
en: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’
text:
MAT 18:26
Thadou: “Hinlah ama chu apupa ang sunga chun abohkhup in chuin athum in, ‘Lungsettah in, nei khongaiyin, keiman abonchan pena nge’” ati.
English: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’

tcz: Chuphat in apupa chun akhoto lheh in, chuin alhadoh in chule abat angaidam tai.
en: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.
text:
MAT 18:27
Thadou: Chuphat in apupa chun akhoto lheh in, chuin alhadoh in chule abat angaidam tai.
English: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.

tcz: Hinlah aman lengpa ada lhah chun, asoh chanpi sum asang mai mai bapa koma chun achen, angonga aman'in chule apetpet in neipen atitai.
en: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’
text:
MAT 18:28
Thadou: Hinlah aman lengpa ada lhah chun, asoh chanpi sum asang mai mai bapa koma chun achen, angonga aman'in chule apetpet in neipen atitai.
English: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

tcz: Asoh chanpi a-anga adilsun chule phat chomkhat bep anga dingin angeh in: Nei khongaiyin, keiman penange tin angeh jeng e.
en: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’
text:
MAT 18:29
Thadou: Asoh chanpi a-anga adilsun chule phat chomkhat bep anga dingin angeh in: Nei khongaiyin, keiman penange tin angeh jeng e.
English: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

tcz: Hinlah abat napa chun angah jou tapoi. Aman mi amatsah in chule batchu asah chaisoh kahsea dingin songkul a akhum tai.
en: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.
text:
MAT 18:30
Thadou: Hinlah abat napa chun angah jou tapoi. Aman mi amatsah in chule batchu asah chaisoh kahsea dingin songkul a akhum tai.
English: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.

tcz: “Soh achom dang hon hichu amuvin, alung nommo lheh tauvin ahi. Amaho lengpa koma acheuvin chule thilsoh chu agasei sohkei tauve.”
en: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.
text:
MAT 18:31
Thadou: “Soh achom dang hon hichu amuvin, alung nommo lheh tauvin ahi. Amaho lengpa koma acheuvin chule thilsoh chu agasei sohkei tauve.”
English: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

tcz: Chuphat'in lengpa chun angaidamsa pachu akoulut'in chuin ajah a, Nangma soh-gilou! Keima henga nathum jeh'a bat chujat jenpi chu kangaidam nahitai.
en: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.
text:
MAT 18:32
Thadou: Chuphat'in lengpa chun angaidamsa pachu akoulut'in chuin ajah a, Nangma soh-gilou! Keima henga nathum jeh'a bat chujat jenpi chu kangaidam nahitai.
English: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

tcz: Keiman nangma kakhoto tobanga chu nasoh chanpi nakhoto ding hilou ham? ati.
en: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’
text:
MAT 18:33
Thadou: Keiman nangma kakhoto tobanga chu nasoh chanpi nakhoto ding hilou ham? ati.
English: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

tcz: Chuphat'in alung hang'ah lengpa chun abat aboncha asahchai kahsea dingin hichepa chu songkul'a akhumtai.
en: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.
text:
MAT 18:34
Thadou: Chuphat'in alung hang'ah lengpa chun abat aboncha asahchai kahsea dingin hichepa chu songkul'a akhumtai.
English: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

tcz: “Vana um ka-Pa chun nanghon nasopiteu chu nalungil'uva na ngaidam louva ahileh nachung'uva hitia chu achutibol ding ahi,” ati.
en: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”
text:
MAT 18:35
Thadou: “Vana um ka-Pa chun nanghon nasopiteu chu nalungil'uva na ngaidam louva ahileh nachung'uva hitia chu achutibol ding ahi,” ati.
English: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”

tcz: Yeshuan hicheng thu asei jouvin, Galilee adalhan chuin Jordan vadung solama Judea gamkaiya achesuhtai.
en: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.
text:
MAT 19:1
Thadou: Yeshuan hicheng thu asei jouvin, Galilee adalhan chuin Jordan vadung solama Judea gamkaiya achesuhtai.
English: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

tcz: Chuche muna chun mihon tamtah'in anung ajui tauvin, chuin Aman anaho adamsah tai.
en: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.
text:
MAT 19:2
Thadou: Chuche muna chun mihon tamtah'in anung ajui tauvin, chuin Aman anaho adamsah tai.
English: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

tcz: Chuin Pharisee ho phabep ahung un hiche thudoh a hi kipalsah ding in apatep un: “Mikhat chun ajeh khat aum pouva ahileh aji ada thei hiya ham?” atiuve.
en: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
text:
MAT 19:3
Thadou: Chuin Pharisee ho phabep ahung un hiche thudoh a hi kipalsah ding in apatep un: “Mikhat chun ajeh khat aum pouva ahileh aji ada thei hiya ham?” atiuve.
English: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Thubua simdoh khalou nahi uvem? Hichea chun, atil abula pat Pathen in amaho chu pasal le numeiya asem ahi.”
en: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,
text:
MAT 19:4
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Thubua simdoh khalou nahi uvem? Hichea chun, atil abula pat Pathen in amaho chu pasal le numeiya asem ahi.”
English: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

tcz: Chuin aman aseiyin, “Hiche hin ipi jeh a pasal khat in apa le anu adalhah a chule ajinu akolchah ding, chule ani lhona khat hilhon ding ahitai ti ahil chen e.”
en: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?
text:
MAT 19:5
Thadou: Chuin aman aseiyin, “Hiche hin ipi jeh a pasal khat in apa le anu adalhah a chule ajinu akolchah ding, chule ani lhona khat hilhon ding ahitai ti ahil chen e.”
English: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?

tcz: “Ama ni chu mini hita louva khat ahilhon tah jeh in, Pathen in agop khomsa chu koiman sukhen tahih hen,” ati.
en: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”
text:
MAT 19:6
Thadou: “Ama ni chu mini hita louva khat ahilhon tah jeh in, Pathen in agop khomsa chu koiman sukhen tahih hen,” ati.
English: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

tcz: “Chuti ahileh ipi jeh a Mose chun Danbua pasal khat in ajinu chu, dana lekha jih henlang chule solmang hen ati hintem,” atiuve.
en: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”
text:
MAT 19:7
Thadou: “Chuti ahileh ipi jeh a Mose chun Danbua pasal khat in ajinu chu, dana lekha jih henlang chule solmang hen ati hintem,” atiuve.
English: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nalung thimu atah behseh jeh'a kida thua phatsahna napeh'u ahibouve, hinlah hichu Pathen in ana lunggon ahipoi.
en: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.
text:
MAT 19:8
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nalung thimu atah behseh jeh'a kida thua phatsahna napeh'u ahibouve, hinlah hichu Pathen in ana lunggon ahipoi.
English: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

tcz: Chule hiche hi kaseipeh nahiuve, koihileh aji da a chule achom ki chenpia chun jon abol ahitai, ajinu chun kitahna neilou hinkho mang ahingal louleh,” ati.
en: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”
text:
MAT 19:9
Thadou: Chule hiche hi kaseipeh nahiuve, koihileh aji da a chule achom ki chenpia chun jon abol ahitai, ajinu chun kitahna neilou hinkho mang ahingal louleh,” ati.
English: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”

tcz: Yeshua seijuite chun ajah a aseiyun, “Hiti chu ahia ahileh jinei lou aphajoi!” atiuve.
en: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”
text:
MAT 19:10
Thadou: Yeshua seijuite chun ajah a aseiyun, “Hiti chu ahia ahileh jinei lou aphajoi!” atiuve.
English: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”

tcz: Yeshuan aseiyin, “Hiche thu kisei hi mi jousen sang thei ponte. Pathen panpi na changhoa ding bou ahi.
en: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.
text:
MAT 19:11
Thadou: Yeshuan aseiyin, “Hiche thu kisei hi mi jousen sang thei ponte. Pathen panpi na changhoa ding bou ahi.
English: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

tcz: Mi phabep chu apena cha hing theilou dia gonsa aum in, mi phabepma chu midang'in chutia asempeh loi jong aum in, chule abang phabep kit chu Pathen Lenggam jal'a jinei lou deilhen'a jong aumuve. Koi hileh hiche hi asang theiyin kisan hen,” ati.
en: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”
text:
MAT 19:12
Thadou: Mi phabep chu apena cha hing theilou dia gonsa aum in, mi phabepma chu midang'in chutia asempeh loi jong aum in, chule abang phabep kit chu Pathen Lenggam jal'a jinei lou deilhen'a jong aumuve. Koi hileh hiche hi asang theiyin kisan hen,” ati.
English: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

tcz: Nikhat hi chapang ho chu anu leh apa teuvin, Yeshuan achung uva akhut angap a ataopeh din ahin puijui. Ahin seijuite chun anu leh apa teu chu mi nasugim uve tin ana houseuvin ahi.
en: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.
text:
MAT 19:13
Thadou: Nikhat hi chapang ho chu anu leh apa teuvin, Yeshuan achung uva akhut angap a ataopeh din ahin puijui. Ahin seijuite chun anu leh apa teu chu mi nasugim uve tin ana houseuvin ahi.
English: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan, “Chapang ho chu kakoma hungsah un. Hungda sah hih un. Ajeh chu Van Lenggam chu hitobang chapang hoa ding bou hiya ahi,” ati.
en: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
text:
MAT 19:14
Thadou: Hinlah Yeshuan, “Chapang ho chu kakoma hungsah un. Hungda sah hih un. Ajeh chu Van Lenggam chu hitobang chapang hoa ding bou hiya ahi,” ati.
English: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

tcz: Chuin Aman alu chunguva akhut teni angam in, chuin phatthei aboh jouvin adalhatai.
en: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.
text:
MAT 19:15
Thadou: Chuin Aman alu chunguva akhut teni angam in, chuin phatthei aboh jouvin adalhatai.
English: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

tcz: Mikhatma Yeshua koma hiche thudoh hi dong ding in ahung in, “Houhil, Tonsot Hinna kanei theina dinga ipi natoh pha kabol ngai hintem?” ahung ti.
en: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”
text:
MAT 19:16
Thadou: Mikhatma Yeshua koma hiche thudoh hi dong ding in ahung in, “Houhil, Tonsot Hinna kanei theina dinga ipi natoh pha kabol ngai hintem?” ahung ti.
English: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Ipi dinga apha chu ipi ham tia neidoh ham? Apha khatseh bou ahi. Hinlah na thudoh donbutna ding in Tonsot Hinna chu nanei nomleh, thupeh ho juiyin,” ati.
en: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”
text:
MAT 19:17
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Ipi dinga apha chu ipi ham tia neidoh ham? Apha khatseh bou ahi. Hinlah na thudoh donbutna ding in Tonsot Hinna chu nanei nomleh, thupeh ho juiyin,” ati.
English: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

tcz: Ama chun adong in, “Hoipen chu ham?” ati. Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nangman tolthat hih in, nangman jon bolhih in, nangma gucha hih in, nangman thujou seiphong hih in.
en: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’
text:
MAT 19:18
Thadou: Ama chun adong in, “Hoipen chu ham?” ati. Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nangman tolthat hih in, nangman jon bolhih in, nangma gucha hih in, nangman thujou seiphong hih in.
English: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’

tcz: Napa le nanu jabol in. Nangma na kingailut bang in naheng nakom ngailun,” ati.
en: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”
text:
MAT 19:19
Thadou: Napa le nanu jabol in. Nangma na kingailut bang in naheng nakom ngailun,” ati.
English: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”

tcz: Khangdongpa chun adonbut in, “Hiche thupeh ho jouse hi kajui sasoh kei ahitai. Ipi adang kabol ding um nalaiyem?” ati.
en: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”
text:
MAT 19:20
Thadou: Khangdongpa chun adonbut in, “Hiche thupeh ho jouse hi kajui sasoh kei ahitai. Ipi adang kabol ding um nalaiyem?” ati.
English: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”

tcz: Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Nangma chamkim nahi nom leh, chenlang nanei jouse abon'in gajoh in chule asum chu mi vaicha ho gapen, chutileh vana gou khol ding nanei ding ahitai. Chujouleh hung in, neijuiyin,” ati.
en: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”
text:
MAT 19:21
Thadou: Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Nangma chamkim nahi nom leh, chenlang nanei jouse abon'in gajoh in chule asum chu mi vaicha ho gapen, chutileh vana gou khol ding nanei ding ahitai. Chujouleh hung in, neijuiyin,” ati.
English: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”

tcz: Hinlah khangdong pan hichu ajahdoh phat in, gouthil tamtah nei ahijeh'in, lungnom motah in achemang tai.
en: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.
text:
MAT 19:22
Thadou: Hinlah khangdong pan hichu ajahdoh phat in, gouthil tamtah nei ahijeh'in, lungnom motah in achemang tai.
English: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

tcz: Chuphat in Yeshuan aseijui ho jah a, “Thu tahbeh ka seipeh nahiuve, mihao khat ding in Van Lenggam lut ding chu ahahsa lheh jeng e.
en: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.
text:
MAT 19:23
Thadou: Chuphat in Yeshuan aseijui ho jah a, “Thu tahbeh ka seipeh nahiuve, mihao khat ding in Van Lenggam lut ding chu ahahsa lheh jeng e.
English: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

tcz: Keiman seikit inge—Sangong sang dinga heobil hom sunga alut ding chu, mihao khat Pathen Lenggam a alut sanga baijo ding ahi,” ati.
en: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
text:
MAT 19:24
Thadou: Keiman seikit inge—Sangong sang dinga heobil hom sunga alut ding chu, mihao khat Pathen Lenggam a alut sanga baijo ding ahi,” ati.
English: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

tcz: Seijui hon adatmo lheh jeng un, chutobang ahileh vannoiya hi Huhhinga koi umjou ding ham? atiuve.
en: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”
text:
MAT 19:25
Thadou: Seijui hon adatmo lheh jeng un, chutobang ahileh vannoiya hi Huhhinga koi umjou ding ham? atiuve.
English: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”

tcz: Yeshuan amaho chu ave chang mel'in chuin aseijin, “Mihem hina lamdol a seiding in, hithei chu ahipoi. Hinlah Pathen toh pankhom na a ijakai ahithei soh keiye,” ati.
en: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
text:
MAT 19:26
Thadou: Yeshuan amaho chu ave chang mel'in chuin aseijin, “Mihem hina lamdol a seiding in, hithei chu ahipoi. Hinlah Pathen toh pankhom na a ijakai ahithei soh keiye,” ati.
English: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
