Thadou: Hiche thilsoh hi Themgao thusei guilhunna dinga soh ahi,
English: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

tcz: “Jerusalem a cheng ho jah a seiyin, ‘Veuvin, na Lengpau chu na komuva ahung e. Ama nunnemtah ahin, sangan chunga atouvin—sangan nou chunga ahung touve,’” tia kisei chu,
en: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”
text:
MAT 21:5
Thadou: “Jerusalem a cheng ho jah a seiyin, ‘Veuvin, na Lengpau chu na komuva ahung e. Ama nunnemtah ahin, sangan chunga atouvin—sangan nou chunga ahung touve,’” tia kisei chu,
English: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”

tcz: Seijui teni chun Yeshuan athupeh bang'in abol lhon in ahi.
en: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,
text:
MAT 21:6
Thadou: Seijui teni chun Yeshuan athupeh bang'in abol lhon in ahi.
English: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,

tcz: Amanin sangan chule anou chu Ama koma ahin pui lhon in chule amaho chun apon uchu sangan nou chunga aphauvin, Ama achunga atouvin ahi.
en: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.
text:
MAT 21:7
Thadou: Amanin sangan chule anou chu Ama koma ahin pui lhon in chule amaho chun apon uchu sangan nou chunga aphauvin, Ama achunga atouvin ahi.
English: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.

tcz: Mi honpi atamjo chun Ama masang sang-ah aponsil hou chu lam lhonga chun aphauvin, chule mi abang loi chun theoboh ho alham un chuin lampia apha tauve.
en: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
text:
MAT 21:8
Thadou: Mi honpi atamjo chun Ama masang sang-ah aponsil hou chu lam lhonga chun aphauvin, chule mi abang loi chun theoboh ho alham un chuin lampia apha tauve.
English: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

tcz: Akijot nauva Yeshua chu alai lunga aum in chule Ama kimvel sea ho chun asam un, “David Chapa jeh in Pathen vahchoiyun! Pakai mina hungpa chunga nunnom hen! Chung Van sang pen a Pathen vahchoiyun!” atiuve.
en: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
text:
MAT 21:9
Thadou: Akijot nauva Yeshua chu alai lunga aum in chule Ama kimvel sea ho chun asam un, “David Chapa jeh in Pathen vahchoiyun! Pakai mina hungpa chunga nunnom hen! Chung Van sang pen a Pathen vahchoiyun!” atiuve.
English: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

tcz: Jerusalem kho mite jouse chu khopi sung Ama alut lut chun aboisoh jeng tauvin, amahon adong un, “Ama hi koihiya ham?” atiuve.
en: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”
text:
MAT 21:10
Thadou: Jerusalem kho mite jouse chu khopi sung Ama alut lut chun aboisoh jeng tauvin, amahon adong un, “Ama hi koihiya ham?” atiuve.
English: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”

tcz: Chuin mipi ho chun, “Ama hi themgao Yeshua, Galilee gamkai Nazareth khoa kon ahi,” atiuve.
en: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”
text:
MAT 21:11
Thadou: Chuin mipi ho chun, “Ama hi themgao Yeshua, Galilee gamkai Nazareth khoa kon ahi,” atiuve.
English: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”

tcz: Yeshua Hou'in sunga chun alut in, chuin maichama kilhaina thilto dinga ajoh'a le acho ho chu anodoh in, Aman vapal joh ho touna le sum lhenglea pang ho dokhang chu alekhutp pehtai.
en: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.
text:
MAT 21:12
Thadou: Yeshua Hou'in sunga chun alut in, chuin maichama kilhaina thilto dinga ajoh'a le acho ho chu anodoh in, Aman vapal joh ho touna le sum lhenglea pang ho dokhang chu alekhutp pehtai.
English: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

tcz: Aman ajah uva, “Pathen lekhabua, Ka Hou'in chu taona in kiti ding ahi akiti, hinlah nanghon gucha ho thil kiselguhna mun naso tauve,” ati.
en: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”
text:
MAT 21:13
Thadou: Aman ajah uva, “Pathen lekhabua, Ka Hou'in chu taona in kiti ding ahi akiti, hinlah nanghon gucha ho thil kiselguhna mun naso tauve,” ati.
English: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”

tcz: Mitcho le elbai ho Hou'in a chun ahung un, Aman amaho chu aboldam in ahi.
en: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.
text:
MAT 21:14
Thadou: Mitcho le elbai ho Hou'in a chun ahung un, Aman amaho chu aboldam in ahi.
English: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

tcz: Thempu pipui ho le houdan thuhil hon athil kidang bol chu amu uvin, chule chapang hon Hou'in sunga “David Chapa jal'in Pathen vahchoiyin umhen,” tia kisam aja uvin. Hinlah lamkai ho chu alunghang thei lheh jeng uve.
en: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,
text:
MAT 21:15
Thadou: Thempu pipui ho le houdan thuhil hon athil kidang bol chu amu uvin, chule chapang hon Hou'in sunga “David Chapa jal'in Pathen vahchoiyin umhen,” tia kisam aja uvin. Hinlah lamkai ho chu alunghang thei lheh jeng uve.
English: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,

tcz: Ama hon Yeshua adong uvin, “Hiche chapang ho hin ipi aseiyu najah em?” atiuvin, Aman “Henge kajanai, naosen chapang noi cheplai kam'in vahchoina achamkim sah e, ti nasim doh nailou'u ham?” ati.
en: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have perfected praise’?”
text:
MAT 21:16
Thadou: Ama hon Yeshua adong uvin, “Hiche chapang ho hin ipi aseiyu najah em?” atiuvin, Aman “Henge kajanai, naosen chapang noi cheplai kam'in vahchoina achamkim sah e, ti nasim doh nailou'u ham?” ati.
English: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have perfected praise’?”

tcz: Chujouvin Ama Bethany akile kit in hichea chun ajan geh dentai.
en: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.
text:
MAT 21:17
Thadou: Chujouvin Ama Bethany akile kit in hichea chun ajan geh dentai.
English: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

tcz: Jingkah in Yeshua chu Jerusalem a ahung kilen ahileh, agil akel tai.
en: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.
text:
MAT 21:18
Thadou: Jingkah in Yeshua chu Jerusalem a ahung kilen ahileh, agil akel tai.
English: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

tcz: Aman lam pama theichang phung um chu agatoh tan. Ama jong aga um ding ham tin aga ve in, hinlah ado jeng bou amun ahi. Chuphat in Aman theichang phung chu, “Nangma itih in jong gakit tahih in!” ati. Chuin apettah chun theichang phung chu agoppai jeng e.
en: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.
text:
MAT 21:19
Thadou: Aman lam pama theichang phung um chu agatoh tan. Ama jong aga um ding ham tin aga ve in, hinlah ado jeng bou amun ahi. Chuphat in Aman theichang phung chu, “Nangma itih in jong gakit tahih in!” ati. Chuin apettah chun theichang phung chu agoppai jeng e.
English: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.

tcz: Seijuiho chun hichu amu phat'un alung dong un chule adong un, “Iti dana theichang phung chu goppai jeng ahi dem?” tin adatmo tauve.
en: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”
text:
MAT 21:20
Thadou: Seijuiho chun hichu amu phat'un alung dong un chule adong un, “Iti dana theichang phung chu goppai jeng ahi dem?” tin adatmo tauve.
English: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”

tcz: Chutah in Yeshuan Amaho aseipeh in, “Keiman Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, nanghon na tahsan uva chule lungthoina neiloubeh nahiuleh hitobang hi nabol thei diu ahi, chule asanga lenjong nabol theidiu ahi. Nanghon mouljah'a jong nangma kichon mang in lang chule twikhanglen'a kileh lut'in tileu chun chuti jeng ding ahi.
en: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.
text:
MAT 21:21
Thadou: Chutah in Yeshuan Amaho aseipeh in, “Keiman Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, nanghon na tahsan uva chule lungthoina neiloubeh nahiuleh hitobang hi nabol thei diu ahi, chule asanga lenjong nabol theidiu ahi. Nanghon mouljah'a jong nangma kichon mang in lang chule twikhanglen'a kileh lut'in tileu chun chuti jeng ding ahi.
English: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

tcz: Ipia ding hijongleh natao theiyu, chule tahsanna naneiyuva ahileh namu diu ahi” ati.
en: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”
text:
MAT 21:22
Thadou: Ipia ding hijongleh natao theiyu, chule tahsanna naneiyuva ahileh namu diu ahi” ati.
English: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”

tcz: Yeshua Hou'in a kona ahung kilekit in chule thu ahilpan in ahileh, thempu pipui holeh upa ho Ama koma ahung un ahi. Amahon adong un, Koi thuneina'a hiche ho jouse hi nabol ham? Kon bolin tia thu napeh ham? natiuve.
en: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
text:
MAT 21:23
Thadou: Yeshua Hou'in a kona ahung kilekit in chule thu ahilpan in ahileh, thempu pipui holeh upa ho Ama koma ahung un ahi. Amahon adong un, Koi thuneina'a hiche ho jouse hi nabol ham? Kon bolin tia thu napeh ham? natiuve.
English: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nang hon thudoh khat hi nadonbut'uva ahileh koi thuneina a hiche ho jouse hi kabol ham seipeh nauvinge.
en: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
text:
MAT 21:24
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nang hon thudoh khat hi nadonbut'uva ahileh koi thuneina a hiche ho jouse hi kabol ham seipeh nauvinge.
English: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

tcz: John chun miho baptize theina thuneina anei chu vana kon ham ahilouleh mihem a kon bep bou ham?” ati. Amaho le amaho akihouvun, “Eihon vana kon ahi itiuva ahileh Aman ipi jeh'a eihon John thusei chu itahsan lou uham, tia eidoh dingu,
en: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
text:
MAT 21:25
Thadou: John chun miho baptize theina thuneina anei chu vana kon ham ahilouleh mihem a kon bep bou ham?” ati. Amaho le amaho akihouvun, “Eihon vana kon ahi itiuva ahileh Aman ipi jeh'a eihon John thusei chu itahsan lou uham, tia eidoh dingu,
English: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

tcz: Hinlah ama mihem bepbou ahi tin seileu hen, mipi oimo ichan diu ahi, ajeh chu miho chun John chu themgao ahi atiuve ti aseiyun ahi.”
en: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”
text:
MAT 21:26
Thadou: Hinlah ama mihem bepbou ahi tin seileu hen, mipi oimo ichan diu ahi, ajeh chu miho chun John chu themgao ahi atiuve ti aseiyun ahi.”
English: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”

tcz: Hiti chun achaina keiyin adonbut un, “Keihon kahe pouve,” atiuve. Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Chuti ahitah le koi thuneina a hiche ho jouse kabol ham kaseipeh lou ding nahiuve” tin aseitai.
en: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.
text:
MAT 21:27
Thadou: Hiti chun achaina keiyin adonbut un, “Keihon kahe pouve,” atiuve. Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Chuti ahitah le koi thuneina a hiche ho jouse kabol ham kaseipeh lou ding nahiuve” tin aseitai.
English: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

tcz: “Hinlah hiche thudol hi ipi nagel uvem? Mi khat chapa ni nei chun, alen jopa koma, ‘Chapa gache doh inlang, tunin lengpi leiya na gatong in’” ati.
en: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’
text:
MAT 21:28
Thadou: “Hinlah hiche thudol hi ipi nagel uvem? Mi khat chapa ni nei chun, alen jopa koma, ‘Chapa gache doh inlang, tunin lengpi leiya na gatong in’” ati.
English: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

tcz: Chapa chun adonbut in, “Ka-e, kachelou ding ahiye,” atin hinlah chujoupeh chun alunggel akhel in agache tai.
en: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.
text:
MAT 21:29
Thadou: Chapa chun adonbut in, “Ka-e, kachelou ding ahiye,” atin hinlah chujoupeh chun alunggel akhel in agache tai.
English: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

tcz: Chuphat in apa chun chapa khatpa jah a, “Nangchen” atileh ama chun “Henge,” Hepa tin aseiyin, ahin aga chedeh poi.
en: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.
text:
MAT 21:30
Thadou: Chuphat in apa chun chapa khatpa jah a, “Nangchen” atileh ama chun “Henge,” Hepa tin aseiyin, ahin aga chedeh poi.
English: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

tcz: Chapa teni lah'a chu koijoh apa seingai hiya ham? Amahon adonbut un, Amasapa atiuve. Chuphat in Yeshuan ahil chen in, “Keiman tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, kaidong kitahlou ho le numei kijoh ho Pathen Lenggam a nangho masanga lut diu ahi.”
en: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.
text:
MAT 21:31
Thadou: Chapa teni lah'a chu koijoh apa seingai hiya ham? Amahon adonbut un, Amasapa atiuve. Chuphat in Yeshuan ahil chen in, “Keiman tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, kaidong kitahlou ho le numei kijoh ho Pathen Lenggam a nangho masanga lut diu ahi.”
English: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.

tcz: Ajeh chu Twilutsah John chu anahung in, chule adih'a hinna ding lampi chu nakopeh uvin, ahin nanghon ama chu natahsan pouve, hinlah kaidong ho le numei kijoh hon atahsan uve. Chule hiche aso nung in jong Ama natahsan nom pouvin chule nachonset nauva nakisih pouve.
en: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.
text:
MAT 21:32
Thadou: Ajeh chu Twilutsah John chu anahung in, chule adih'a hinna ding lampi chu nakopeh uvin, ahin nanghon ama chu natahsan pouve, hinlah kaidong ho le numei kijoh hon atahsan uve. Chule hiche aso nung in jong Ama natahsan nom pouvin chule nachonset nauva nakisih pouve.
English: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

tcz: “Tun thusim achom khat ngaiyun. Lounei khat hin lengpilei abol in, apal agen kimvel'in, lengpi theiga lhohna ding leiko alaiyin, chule gahvet suina ding in insang asan ahi. Chujouvin aman lengpilei chu alei-lhou ho khut'a apedoh in, chule gamchoma agache tai.”
en: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.
text:
MAT 21:33
Thadou: “Tun thusim achom khat ngaiyun. Lounei khat hin lengpilei abol in, apal agen kimvel'in, lengpi theiga lhohna ding leiko alaiyin, chule gahvet suina ding in insang asan ahi. Chujouvin aman lengpilei chu alei-lhou ho khut'a apedoh in, chule gamchoma agache tai.”
English: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

tcz: Lengpiga alhun phat in, alei lhou'a pang ho koma asohte asolin ahi.
en: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.
text:
MAT 21:34
Thadou: Lengpiga alhun phat in, alei lhou'a pang ho koma asohte asolin ahi.
English: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.

tcz: Hinlah alei lhou hon asoh ho chu aman un, khat avouvin, khat athat un chule achom khat chu songa asep tauve.
en: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
text:
MAT 21:35
Thadou: Hinlah alei lhou hon asoh ho chu aman un, khat avouvin, khat athat un chule achom khat chu songa asep tauve.
English: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

tcz: Hichun alou neipa chun asoh atamjo cheh chu lengpi theiga lohkhom dingin asolin ahileh abolngai ngai anabol un ahi.
en: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.
text:
MAT 21:36
Thadou: Hichun alou neipa chun asoh atamjo cheh chu lengpi theiga lohkhom dingin asolin ahileh abolngai ngai anabol un ahi.
English: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.

tcz: “Achaina keiyin alouneipa chun achapa asolin, amaho chun achapa chu anajabol teiyunte tin agel'in ahi.”
en: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
text:
MAT 21:37
Thadou: “Achaina keiyin alouneipa chun achapa asolin, amaho chun achapa chu anajabol teiyunte tin agel'in ahi.”
English: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

tcz: “Hinlah loubol ho chun achapa hung amu phat un, amaho khatle khat akihou un, ‘Agou lo’ dingpa hikoma ahunge. Hungun, ama that'u hitin agam hi eiho chan ding'in kiheidoh'u hite,” atiuve.
en: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’
text:
MAT 21:38
Thadou: “Hinlah loubol ho chun achapa hung amu phat un, amaho khatle khat akihou un, ‘Agou lo’ dingpa hikoma ahunge. Hungun, ama that'u hitin agam hi eiho chan ding'in kiheidoh'u hite,” atiuve.
English: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’

tcz: Hitichun amahon aman'un, lengpi leiya kon in akaidoh un, chule ama chu athat tauve.
en: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.
text:
MAT 21:39
Thadou: Hitichun amahon aman'un, lengpi leiya kon in akaidoh un, chule ama chu athat tauve.
English: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.

tcz: Yeshuan adong in, “Lengpi lei neipa chu ahung kile teng loubol ho chu i-lonte tia nagel uvem?” ati.
en: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”
text:
MAT 21:40
Thadou: Yeshuan adong in, “Lengpi lei neipa chu ahung kile teng loubol ho chu i-lonte tia nagel uvem?” ati.
English: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”

tcz: Hou lamkai ho chun adonbut uvin, Aman mi-engseho chu melse tah in that intin, chule alengpi lei chu alougasoh achanding pethei midang henga apehdoh ding ahitai, atiuve.
en: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”
text:
MAT 21:41
Thadou: Hou lamkai ho chun adonbut uvin, Aman mi-engseho chu melse tah in that intin, chule alengpi lei chu alougasoh achanding pethei midang henga apehdoh ding ahitai, atiuve.
English: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”

tcz: Chutah in Yeshuan amahotah adong in, “Hiche hi nanghon Pathen Thutheng bua nasimdoh khah lou u ham? In-sa hon adei-lou song chu aning'ah apipen in apang tai. Hichehi Pakai thilbol ahi chule gahvet ding in aki-dange.
en: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?
text:
MAT 21:42
Thadou: Chutah in Yeshuan amahotah adong in, “Hiche hi nanghon Pathen Thutheng bua nasimdoh khah lou u ham? In-sa hon adei-lou song chu aning'ah apipen in apang tai. Hichehi Pakai thilbol ahi chule gahvet ding in aki-dange.
English: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?

tcz: Keiman nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen Lenggam chu nanghoa kona kiladoh a, chule phatea ga sodoh thei nam dang kipe ding ahi.
en: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.
text:
MAT 21:43
Thadou: Keiman nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen Lenggam chu nanghoa kona kiladoh a, chule phatea ga sodoh thei nam dang kipe ding ahi.
English: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.

tcz: Koi hijongleh hiche songa kipal chan chu ahal hal'a chip ding chule alhuhkhum chan chu atagoi ding ahi,” ati.
en: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”
text:
MAT 21:44
Thadou: Koi hijongleh hiche songa kipal chan chu ahal hal'a chip ding chule alhuhkhum chan chu atagoi ding ahi,” ati.
English: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”

tcz: Thempu pipuho le Pharisee ho chun hiche thulem hi ajah phat un, amaho douna'a thusim kisei–loubol mi engse ahiu chu akihetdoh tauve.
en: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.
text:
MAT 21:45
Thadou: Thempu pipuho le Pharisee ho chun hiche thulem hi ajah phat un, amaho douna'a thusim kisei–loubol mi engse ahiu chu akihetdoh tauve.

text:
MAT 21:46

MAT 22:1

English: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,

tcz: “Van Lengam chu lengkhat in achapa jineina golvah loupitah abol thusim toh tekah thei ahi.
en: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,
text:
MAT 22:2
Thadou: “Van Lengam chu lengkhat in achapa jineina golvah loupitah abol thusim toh tekah thei ahi.
English: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,

tcz: Neh le don ding gontupsoh ahiphat in, asohte asolin akikou ho chu agahetsah tauve. Ahin, amaho abon'un ahungnom tapouve.”
en: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.
text:
MAT 22:3
Thadou: Neh le don ding gontupsoh ahiphat in, asohte asolin akikou ho chu agahetsah tauve. Ahin, amaho abon'un ahungnom tapouve.”
English: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.

tcz: “Hiti chun aman asoh dangho chu amaho gaseipeh dingin asolin, Golvah anneh ding gontupsa ahitai. Bongchal hole gancha thaotah ho chu kithat a, ijakai kigong tupma ahitai. Ankong um ding'in hung un agatisah-e.”
en: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’
text:
MAT 22:4
Thadou: “Hiti chun aman asoh dangho chu amaho gaseipeh dingin asolin, Golvah anneh ding gontupsa ahitai. Bongchal hole gancha thaotah ho chu kithat a, ijakai kigong tupma ahitai. Ankong um ding'in hung un agatisah-e.”
English: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’

tcz: Hinlah akikou ho chun anahsah pouvin chule ama lampi cheh'a ache tauve, khat alouva, achom dang khat akiveinaa,
en: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;

tcz: Adang-sen asottol leho chu aman'un chule jachat umtah in abol'un chule athat tauve.
en: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.
text:
MAT 22:6
Thadou: Adang-sen asottol leho chu aman'un chule jachat umtah in abol'un chule athat tauve.
English: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.

tcz: “Lengpa chu alung hang in, chule asepaite asoldoh in tolthat ho chu asumang'in chule akhopiu jong ahal tauve.”
en: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
text:
MAT 22:7
Thadou: “Lengpa chu alung hang in, chule asepaite asoldoh in tolthat ho chu asumang'in chule akhopiu jong ahal tauve.”
English: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

tcz: Chule aman asohte jah a, Golvah an gonsan aumtai, chule jin'a kikouho jong jaboltah a kilom ahipouve.
en: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.
text:
MAT 22:8
Thadou: Chule aman asohte jah a, Golvah an gonsan aumtai, chule jin'a kikouho jong jaboltah a kilom ahipouve.
English: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

tcz: Tun lamlhong aningkoi tin'ah cheuvin chule namu mu hou chu gakou uvin, ati.
en: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’
text:
MAT 22:9
Thadou: Tun lamlhong aningkoi tin'ah cheuvin chule namu mu hou chu gakou uvin, ati.
English: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’

tcz: Hiti chun sohte chun amu chanu chu mipha le miphalou geiyin akou uvin ahileh, golvah in chu jin adim tai.
en: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.
text:
MAT 22:10
Thadou: Hiti chun sohte chun amu chanu chu mipha le miphalou geiyin akou uvin ahileh, golvah in chu jin adim tai.
English: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.

tcz: “Hinlah lengpa chu jinho kimu pia ahunga ahileh, aman mikhat chu kichenna Golvah vona kivonlou amudoh tai.”
en: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,
text:
MAT 22:11
Thadou: “Hinlah lengpa chu jinho kimu pia ahunga ahileh, aman mikhat chu kichenna Golvah vona kivonlou amudoh tai.”
English: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

tcz: Aman ajah a, kichenna Golvah vona kivon louva iti dana hikoma naum ham tia adoh le imachan adonbut tapoi.
en: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.
text:
MAT 22:12
Thadou: Aman ajah a, kichenna Golvah vona kivon louva iti dana hikoma naum ham tia adoh le imachan adonbut tapoi.
English: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.

tcz: Chutah in lengpa chun alhachate ho jah a akhut le akeng ho kan'un lang chule polam muthima lehdoh tauvin, hichea chu kana le hagelna um ding ahi.
en: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’
text:
MAT 22:13
Thadou: Chutah in lengpa chun alhachate ho jah a akhut le akeng ho kan'un lang chule polam muthima lehdoh tauvin, hichea chu kana le hagelna um ding ahi.
English: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

tcz: “Ajeh chu mitampi kikouva ahi, hinlah mi themcha bou deilhen ahi,” ati.
en: For many are called, but few chosen.”
text:
MAT 22:14
Thadou: “Ajeh chu mitampi kikouva ahi, hinlah mi themcha bou deilhen ahi,” ati.
English: For many are called, but few chosen.”

tcz: Chutah in Pharisee ho akihou-un Yeshua chu athuseiya kipal sah'a mat ding angaito tauve.
en: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.
text:
MAT 22:15
Thadou: Chutah in Pharisee ho akihou-un Yeshua chu athuseiya kipal sah'a mat ding angaito tauve.
English: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

tcz: Amahon aseijuiteu phabep asol'un, chule Herod lama pangho jong jaotha ahiuve. Amahon “Houhil,” mikitah nahi ti kaheuve. “Nangman Pathen lampi dihtah nahil'in koima dat-khen naneipoi chule maipha nave poi,” atiuvin ahi.
en: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.
text:
MAT 22:16
Thadou: Amahon aseijuiteu phabep asol'un, chule Herod lama pangho jong jaotha ahiuve. Amahon “Houhil,” mikitah nahi ti kaheuve. “Nangman Pathen lampi dihtah nahil'in koima dat-khen naneipoi chule maipha nave poi,” atiuvin ahi.
English: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.

tcz: “Tun hiche thua hi ipi nagel em neiseipeh'un: Caesar henga kai peh hi dih'am ole dihlou ham?” atiuve.
en: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
text:
MAT 22:17
Thadou: “Tun hiche thua hi ipi nagel em neiseipeh'un: Caesar henga kai peh hi dih'am ole dihlou ham?” atiuve.
English: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

tcz: Hinlah Yeshuan alunggel'u phalou chu ahen, aseiyin, “Nangho mi phalhem ho! Ipi dinga doha'a neimat got'u ham?”
en: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?
text:
MAT 22:18
Thadou: Hinlah Yeshuan alunggel'u phalou chu ahen, aseiyin, “Nangho mi phalhem ho! Ipi dinga doha'a neimat got'u ham?”
English: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

tcz: Kai kipehna sum chu neivetsah un, ati. Ama hon Rome te sum avetsah tauve.
en: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.
text:
MAT 22:19
Thadou: Kai kipehna sum chu neivetsah un, ati. Ama hon Rome te sum avetsah tauve.
English: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.

tcz: Aman adong in, “Koilim le koipen min ham?” tin adong tai.
en: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”
text:
MAT 22:20
Thadou: Aman adong in, “Koilim le koipen min ham?” tin adong tai.
English: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”

tcz: Amahon adonbut'un, “Caesar a,” atiuve. Aman aseipeh in, “Caesar a chu Caesar peuvin, chule Pathen achu Pathen peuvin,” ati.
en: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
text:
MAT 22:21
Thadou: Amahon adonbut'un, “Caesar a,” atiuve. Aman aseipeh in, “Caesar a chu Caesar peuvin, chule Pathen achu Pathen peuvin,” ati.
English: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

tcz: Aman adonbutna chu adatmo-uvin chuin achemang tauve.
en: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.
text:
MAT 22:22
Thadou: Aman adonbutna chu adatmo-uvin chuin achemang tauve.
English: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.

tcz: Hiche nikho mama chun Sadducee hon mithi ho thokitna aumpoi ti hou lamkai ho Yeshua henga ahung un, hiche thudoh hi ahung bol tauve.

MAT 22:23

English: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

tcz: “Houhil, Mose chun mi koi ham khat cha neilouva athi khahtah'a ahileh anaopa chun meithainu chu akichenpia chule acha chun aupa min apohding ahi ati.
en: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’
text:
MAT 22:24
Thadou: “Houhil, Mose chun mi koi ham khat cha neilouva athi khahtah'a ahileh anaopa chun meithainu chu akichenpia chule acha chun aupa min apohding ahi ati.
English: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

tcz: Aphai, vetsahnan sopi pasal sagi aume. Atahpen pa chun ji aneiyin cha neilou vin athitai, chuti chun asopipa chun meithainu chu akichen pitai.
en: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.
text:
MAT 22:25
Thadou: Aphai, vetsahnan sopi pasal sagi aume. Atahpen pa chun ji aneiyin cha neilou vin athitai, chuti chun asopipa chun meithainu chu akichen pitai.
English: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

tcz: Hinlah asopi ani napa jong chu athitan, chule asopi athum channa pan amanu chu akichenpi tai. Asagina chan in hiti chun abonchauvin aum tauve.
en: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.
text:
MAT 22:26
Thadou: Hinlah asopi ani napa jong chu athitan, chule asopi athum channa pan amanu chu akichenpi tai. Asagina chan in hiti chun abonchauvin aum tauve.
English: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

tcz: Achainan, numeinu jong athitai.
en: After them all, the woman died.
text:
MAT 22:27
Thadou: Achainan, numeinu jong athitai.
English: After them all, the woman died.

tcz: Hijeh chun neiseipeh un, thokitna'a chu koipen ji hiding hitam? Ajeh chu asagi-uva chu amanu akichenpiu ahi” tin adong tauve.
en: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”
text:
MAT 22:28
Thadou: Hijeh chun neiseipeh un, thokitna'a chu koipen ji hiding hitam? Ajeh chu asagi-uva chu amanu akichenpiu ahi” tin adong tauve.
English: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Thule Pathen Thahatna nahet lou jeh uva nasuhkhel jiu ahi.
en: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.
text:
MAT 22:29
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Thule Pathen Thahatna nahet lou jeh uva nasuhkhel jiu ahi.
English: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

tcz: Ajeh chu mithiho chu thokitna'a amaho kicheng talou, kichen jong kibolsah talou ahiuve. Amaho chu vana Vantilte tobang ahiuve.
en: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.
text:
MAT 22:30
Thadou: Ajeh chu mithiho chu thokitna'a amaho kicheng talou, kichen jong kibolsah talou ahiuve. Amaho chu vana Vantilte tobang ahiuve.
English: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

tcz: Hinlah tun, mithiho thokitna umham tithua Pathen Thua nasimdoh khahlouvu ham? Masang peh'a anathisaho Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob ho chu athijoupeh uvin, Pathen in aseiyin,
en: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,
text:
MAT 22:31
Thadou: Hinlah tun, mithiho thokitna umham tithua Pathen Thua nasimdoh khahlouvu ham? Masang peh'a anathisaho Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob ho chu athijoupeh uvin, Pathen in aseiyin,
English: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

tcz: Keima Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob Pathen kahi. Hitia chu Ama ahing ho Pathen ahin, athiho Pathen ahipoi,” ati.
en: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
text:
MAT 22:32
Thadou: Keima Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob Pathen kahi. Hitia chu Ama ahing ho Pathen ahin, athiho Pathen ahipoi,” ati.
English: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

tcz: Mihonpi chun athusei ajah phat un, athuhil chu adatmo lheh tauve.
en: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.
text:
MAT 22:33
Thadou: Mihonpi chun athusei ajah phat un, athuhil chu adatmo lheh tauve.
English: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

tcz: Ahin aman Sadducee ho paomo hel'a alha chu Pharisee hon ajahdoh phat un, amaho akikhom un, ama thudohna neikit ding'in akinopto tauve.
en: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.
text:
MAT 22:34
Thadou: Ahin aman Sadducee ho paomo hel'a alha chu Pharisee hon ajahdoh phat un, amaho akikhom un, ama thudohna neikit ding'in akinopto tauve.
English: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

tcz: Amaho lah'a mikhat Hou Dan thuthem khat chun hiche thudoh'a hi kipalsah ding agon ahi.
en: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
text:
MAT 22:35
Thadou: Amaho lah'a mikhat Hou Dan thuthem khat chun hiche thudoh'a hi kipalsah ding agon ahi.
English: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

tcz: “Houhil, Mose dan dung juiya hoipen hi thupeh lenpen ham?” ati.
en: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”
text:
MAT 22:36
Thadou: “Houhil, Mose dan dung juiya hoipen hi thupeh lenpen ham?” ati.
English: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nangman Pakai na Pathen chu nalung pumpia, nahinna pumpia chule nalungthim pumpia na-ngailut ding ahi.
en: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
text:
MAT 22:37
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nangman Pakai na Pathen chu nalung pumpia, nahinna pumpia chule nalungthim pumpia na-ngailut ding ahi.
English: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

tcz: Hiche hi thupeh amasa le alenpen ahitai.
en: This is the first and great commandment.
text:
MAT 22:38
Thadou: Hiche hi thupeh amasa le alenpen ahitai.
English: This is the first and great commandment.

tcz: Anina jong athupina kibang ahi. Nangma na kingailut banga naheng nakom na-ngailut ding ahi.
en: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
text:
MAT 22:39
Thadou: Anina jong athupina kibang ahi. Nangma na kingailut banga naheng nakom na-ngailut ding ahi.
English: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

tcz: Hiche thupeh tenia hi Dan thu apumpi le themgao hon angeh jouseu chu kikhaiya ahi,” ati.
en: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”
text:
MAT 22:40
Thadou: Hiche thupeh tenia hi Dan thu apumpi le themgao hon angeh jouseu chu kikhaiya ahi,” ati.
English: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

tcz: Hipet chun Pharisee hon aum-kimvel un, Yeshuan amaho thudoh khat adongin:
en: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,
text:
MAT 22:41
Thadou: Hipet chun Pharisee hon aum-kimvel un, Yeshuan amaho thudoh khat adongin:
English: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

tcz: “Messiah chung chang thua ipi nagel uvem? Ama koicha ham? ati. Amahon adonbut un, Ama David Chapa ahi,” atiuve.
en: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”
text:
MAT 22:42
Thadou: “Messiah chung chang thua ipi nagel uvem? Ama koicha ham? ati. Amahon adonbut un, Ama David Chapa ahi,” atiuve.
English: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Chuti ahileh iti dan'a David chun Lhagao Theng'in ahetsa'a kona Messiah chu ‘Ka-Pakai’ ati hintem?” Ajeh chu David chun,
en: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,
text:
MAT 22:43
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Chuti ahileh iti dan'a David chun Lhagao Theng'in ahetsa'a kona Messiah chu ‘Ka-Pakai’ ati hintem?” Ajeh chu David chun,
English: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

tcz: Pakai chun kapakai koma, Keiman na melmate kasuh nem'a nakengto noiya ka koi masang sen, kijabolna kakhut jet'ah tou jingin, ati.
en: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?
text:
MAT 22:44
Thadou: Pakai chun kapakai koma, Keiman na melmate kasuh nem'a nakengto noiya ka koi masang sen, kijabolna kakhut jet'ah tou jingin, ati.
English: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?

tcz: David in Messiah chu Ka-Pakai, tia akou thei leh, Messiah chu iti achapa hithei ding ham? ati.
en: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”
text:
MAT 22:45
Thadou: David in Messiah chu Ka-Pakai, tia akou thei leh, Messiah chu iti achapa hithei ding ham? ati.
English: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”

tcz: Chuin koima chan ama chu adonbut thei tapouve. Chule hiche jouva pat chun, koiman thudoh abolngam tapouve.
en: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.
text:
MAT 22:46
Thadou: Chuin koima chan ama chu adonbut thei tapouve. Chule hiche jouva pat chun, koiman thudoh abolngam tapouve.
English: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

tcz: Chutah in Yeshuan mi honpi le aseijuiho jah a chun,
en: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,
text:
MAT 23:1
Thadou: Chutah in Yeshuan mi honpi le aseijuiho jah a chun,
English: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

tcz: “Hou Dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho Mose Danbu ho sutoh dinga houhil lamkaiya lhen doh ahiuve.”
en: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.
text:
MAT 23:2
Thadou: “Hou Dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho Mose Danbu ho sutoh dinga houhil lamkaiya lhen doh ahiuve.”
English: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.

tcz: Hijeh chun amahon nahil chan'u chu bol un chule nahil nauva aseiyu ngaiyun, hinlah aum chan'u vang jui hih un. Ajeh chu amahon ahilu chu abol pouve.
en: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.
text:
MAT 23:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun amahon nahil chan'u chu bol un chule nahil nauva aseiyu ngaiyun, hinlah aum chan'u vang jui hih un. Ajeh chu amahon ahilu chu abol pouve.
English: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.

tcz: Amaho hin mihon apoh joudiu kalval chonna angeh un, hinlah pohgih ngai jangna ding in akhut jung khat'u jong chasah lou ahiuve.
en: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.
text:
MAT 23:4
Thadou: Amaho hin mihon apoh joudiu kalval chonna angeh un, hinlah pohgih ngai jangna ding in akhut jung khat'u jong chasah lou ahiuve.
English: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

tcz: “Athilbol jouseu chu mimu dinga bou bol ahiuve. Abanjang uva taona bom akoiyun, asungah Pathen Lekhabua thucheng kijih aneiyun, chule amahon sangkhol chol mong kailha agei kikhit ho akiah-uve.”
en: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,
text:
MAT 23:5
Thadou: “Athilbol jouseu chu mimu dinga bou bol ahiuve. Abanjang uva taona bom akoiyun, asungah Pathen Lekhabua thucheng kijih aneiyun, chule amahon sangkhol chol mong kailha agei kikhit ho akiah-uve.”
English: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,

tcz: Chule amaho hi anneh khomna dokhang mun thupi laiya touva chule hou-kikhopna in'a jabolna'a tou anom'uvin ahi.
en: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,
text:
MAT 23:6
Thadou: Chule amaho hi anneh khomna dokhang mun thupi laiya touva chule hou-kikhopna in'a jabolna'a tou anom'uvin ahi.
English: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

tcz: Amahon kailhang mun'a min jaboltah'a alem diu adeiyun, chule houhil ati diu adei-uve.
en: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.
text:
MAT 23:7
Thadou: Amahon kailhang mun'a min jaboltah'a alem diu adeiyun, chule houhil ati diu adei-uve.
English: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.

tcz: “Koiman houhil nati diu janom hih un, ajeh chu nanghon houhil khat naneiyun, chule nangho nabon chauva sopite hina a kibang cheh nahiu ahi.”
en: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.
text:
MAT 23:8
Thadou: “Koiman houhil nati diu janom hih un, ajeh chu nanghon houhil khat naneiyun, chule nangho nabon chauva sopite hina a kibang cheh nahiu ahi.”
English: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

tcz: Chule hiche leiset chunga koima Pa sah hih un, ajeh chu vana um Pathen chu Lhagaova na-Pau ahi.
en: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.
text:
MAT 23:9
Thadou: Chule hiche leiset chunga koima Pa sah hih un, ajeh chu vana um Pathen chu Lhagaova na-Pau ahi.
English: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

tcz: Chule koiman nangho houhil tin kikousah hih un, ajeh chu nanghon houhil naneiyun, Messiah chu ahi.
en: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.
text:
MAT 23:10
Thadou: Chule koiman nangho houhil tin kikousah hih un, ajeh chu nanghon houhil naneiyun, Messiah chu ahi.
English: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

tcz: Nalah uva alen pen hinoma chu soh ahi angaiye.
en: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.
text:
MAT 23:11
Thadou: Nalah uva alen pen hinoma chu soh ahi angaiye.
English: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

tcz: Hinlah ama kichoisang ho chu kisu nem'intin, chule akingai nem ho chu kichoi sang ding ahiuve.
en: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
text:
MAT 23:12
Thadou: Hinlah ama kichoisang ho chu kisu nem'intin, chule akingai nem ho chu kichoi sang ding ahiuve.
English: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho hou dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Mipha lhem ho! Ajeh chu miho maikoh'ah nanghon Van Lenggam kot chu nakhah'un ahi. Nang hola nalut pouvin chule midang ho jong alut diu na janom deh pouve.”
en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.
text:
MAT 23:13
Thadou: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho hou dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Mipha lhem ho! Ajeh chu miho maikoh'ah nanghon Van Lenggam kot chu nakhah'un ahi. Nang hola nalut pouvin chule midang ho jong alut diu na janom deh pouve.”
English: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Hou dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Nanghon meithai ho anei-agou thil chung'ah jachatna thei leuvin dohan nabol'un, chule hou ngaisah tah tobang'in mipi lah'a sotpi natao un ahi. Hiche jeh'a hi gimbolna nasatah kipe ding nahiuve.”
en: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.
text:
MAT 23:14
Thadou: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Hou dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Nanghon meithai ho anei-agou thil chung'ah jachatna thei leuvin dohan nabol'un, chule hou ngaisah tah tobang'in mipi lah'a sotpi natao un ahi. Hiche jeh'a hi gimbolna nasatah kipe ding nahiuve.”
English: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Hou dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon mi khat na loilutna ding un, gam tina twikhanglen gal geiyin navah leuvin, chule khat touvin lung ahin heiya ahileh nangho amachu nivei jen Damun cha in nasem un, nangho jong nahiu ahi!”
en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.
text:
MAT 23:15
Thadou: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Hou dan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon mi khat na loilutna ding un, gam tina twikhanglen gal geiyin navah leuvin, chule khat touvin lung ahin heiya ahileh nangho amachu nivei jen Damun cha in nasem un, nangho jong nahiu ahi!”
English: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

tcz: “Mitcho lamhil ho! Itobang lunghemna in nahin pha diuvem! Ajeh chu nang hon Pathen hou-in'a kihahsel ima akhohpoi natiuve; hinlah hou-in sunga Sana'a kihahsel chu khoh'ah ahi, natiuve.”
en: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’
text:
MAT 23:16
Thadou: “Mitcho lamhil ho! Itobang lunghemna in nahin pha diuvem! Ajeh chu nang hon Pathen hou-in'a kihahsel ima akhohpoi natiuve; hinlah hou-in sunga Sana'a kihahsel chu khoh'ah ahi, natiuve.”
English: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

tcz: Mitcho mingol ho! Hou-in'a sana ahilouleh Hou-in sana suthenga chu hoijoh thupijo hintem?
en: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
text:
MAT 23:17
Thadou: Mitcho mingol ho! Hou-in'a sana ahilouleh Hou-in sana suthenga chu hoijoh thupijo hintem?
English: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

tcz: Chule nanghon maicham muna kihahsel chu imacha akhohpoi, hinlah maicham chunga thil kipedoh'a kihahsel chu khoh ahi, natiuve.
en: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’
text:
MAT 23:18
Thadou: Chule nanghon maicham muna kihahsel chu imacha akhohpoi, hinlah maicham chunga thil kipedoh'a kihahsel chu khoh ahi, natiuve.
English: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’

tcz: Itobang loma mitcho nahiu ham! Maicham chunga thilto kichoi chuleh thilto suthenga maicham joh chu hoiche thupijo ham?
en: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
text:
MAT 23:19
Thadou: Itobang loma mitcho nahiu ham! Maicham chunga thilto kichoi chuleh thilto suthenga maicham joh chu hoiche thupijo ham?
English: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

tcz: Nangho maicham pan'a nakihahsel tenguleh hiche maichama kihahsela chule maicham chunga umho geiya chu kihahsela nahi tai.
en: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.
text:
MAT 23:20
Thadou: Nangho maicham pan'a nakihahsel tenguleh hiche maichama kihahsela chule maicham chunga umho geiya chu kihahsela nahi tai.
English: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.

tcz: Chule nangho Hou-in pan'a na kihahsel tenguleh hiche maicham munle maichama cheng Pathen'a kihahsel nahiu ahitai.
en: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.
text:
MAT 23:21
Thadou: Chule nangho Hou-in pan'a na kihahsel tenguleh hiche maicham munle maichama cheng Pathen'a kihahsel nahiu ahitai.
English: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.

tcz: Chule van min pan'a nakihahsel teng Pathen laltouna le Pathen laltouna'a toupa'a chu kihahsel nahi ahitai.
en: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.
text:
MAT 23:22
Thadou: Chule van min pan'a nakihahsel teng Pathen laltouna le Pathen laltouna'a toupa'a chu kihahsel nahi ahitai.
English: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.

tcz: “Itobang lung hemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan thuhil ho le Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon nahonsoh uva kona muchi neopen geiyin som'a khat napeuve, hinlah danthupeh akhohjo, adih'a thutan khotona chule tahsan nahsah in nagel pouve!”
en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
text:
MAT 23:23
Thadou: “Itobang lung hemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan thuhil ho le Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon nahonsoh uva kona muchi neopen geiyin som'a khat napeuve, hinlah danthupeh akhohjo, adih'a thutan khotona chule tahsan nahsah in nagel pouve!”
English: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

tcz: Mitcho lamhil ho! Thousi vaibong naval louna ding uvin twina lhiu vin, hilah nanghon sangongsang napum val uve!
en: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!
text:
MAT 23:24
Thadou: Mitcho lamhil ho! Thousi vaibong naval louna ding uvin twina lhiu vin, hilah nanghon sangongsang napum val uve!
English: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan Thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon khon le kong chu apolam siltheng nathem un, hinlah nasung lamu, chip setna le kichang khohsahnan nadim uve.”
en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.
text:
MAT 23:25
Thadou: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan Thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon khon le kong chu apolam siltheng nathem un, hinlah nasung lamu, chip setna le kichang khohsahnan nadim uve.”
English: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

tcz: Mitcho Pharisee ho! Amasan khon le kong chu asung soptheng un, chutengleh apolam jong chu hungtheng tante.
en: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.
text:
MAT 23:26
Thadou: Mitcho Pharisee ho! Amasan khon le kong chu asung soptheng un, chutengleh apolam jong chu hungtheng tante.
English: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan Thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu lhan kiloibang tobangbep nahiuve, apolam vet hoi, hinlah nasunglam'u mithi gu le nen dimset nahiuve.”
en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.
text:
MAT 23:27
Thadou: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan Thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu lhan kiloibang tobangbep nahiuve, apolam vet hoi, hinlah nasunglam'u mithi gu le nen dimset nahiuve.”
English: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

tcz: Polama vet ding'in midihho to nakilou uvin, hinlah nasung gil lamu phatlhemna le danbei nahibou uve.
en: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
text:
MAT 23:28
Thadou: Polama vet ding'in midihho to nakilou uvin, hinlah nasung gil lamu phatlhemna le danbei nahibou uve.
English: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon napu napa teuvin anathau themgao hole Pathen ngaisah ho lhan chu nasemhoiyun ahi.”
en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,
text:
MAT 23:29
Thadou: “Itobang lunghemnan nahin phah diu hitam nangho Houdan thuhil hole Pharisee ho. Miphalhem ho! Ajeh chu nanghon napu napa teuvin anathau themgao hole Pathen ngaisah ho lhan chu nasemhoiyun ahi.”
English: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

tcz: Chujongleh nanghon kapu kapateu phatlai chun keiho anahing leuveng themgao ho athanauva kajaolou beh dingu ahi, natiuve.
en: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’
text:
MAT 23:30
Thadou: Chujongleh nanghon kapu kapateu phatlai chun keiho anahing leuveng themgao ho athanauva kajaolou beh dingu ahi, natiuve.
English: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

tcz: “Hinlah hitia nasei jeng vangun, nanghon themgao that ho sonle chi lhah nahiuve tiphot chetna nakiphondoh u ahiye.”
en: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.
text:
MAT 23:31
Thadou: “Hinlah hitia nasei jeng vangun, nanghon themgao that ho sonle chi lhah nahiuve tiphot chetna nakiphondoh u ahiye.”
English: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

tcz: Cheuvin lang napu napa teuvin ana-patsau chu nanghon gabulhit un.
en: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.
text:
MAT 23:32
Thadou: Cheuvin lang napu napa teuvin ana-patsau chu nanghon gabulhit un.
English: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

tcz: Gulho, gulse chilhah ho! Damun thutanna chu iti napel thei mong ding'u ham?
en: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?
text:
MAT 23:33
Thadou: Gulho, gulse chilhah ho! Damun thutanna chu iti napel thei mong ding'u ham?
English: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

tcz: “Hijeh'a chu keiman themgao ho le miching ho chule Houdan thuhil ho na henguva ka hinsol ahi. Hinlah nanghon abang chu thingpela na khetbeh dingu, chule adangse chu hou ki khopna in'a najep dingu, chule khopi khat'a kona khopi choma nadelle dingu ahi.”
en: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,
text:
MAT 23:34
Thadou: “Hijeh'a chu keiman themgao ho le miching ho chule Houdan thuhil ho na henguva ka hinsol ahi. Hinlah nanghon abang chu thingpela na khetbeh dingu, chule adangse chu hou ki khopna in'a najep dingu, chule khopi khat'a kona khopi choma nadelle dingu ahi.”
English: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

tcz: Hitia chu michonpha Abel kitha'a pat Barachiah chapa Zechariah Hou'in maicham teni kikah'a kithat ho jouse chunga themmona nahin kipoh dingu ahi.
en: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.
text:
MAT 23:35
Thadou: Hitia chu michonpha Abel kitha'a pat Barachiah chapa Zechariah Hou'in maicham teni kikah'a kithat ho jouse chunga themmona nahin kipoh dingu ahi.
English: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

tcz: Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche thutanna hi tukhang mite chunga hung lhung ding ahi.
en: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
text:
MAT 23:36
Thadou: Thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche thutanna hi tukhang mite chunga hung lhung ding ahi.
English: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

tcz: “Vo Jerusalem, Jerusalem themgao ho that le Pathen thupole ho that'a pangho! Ahpin anoute alhaving tenia a-opkhum tobanga nachateu itobang tah'a kakhoptup kigot hitam! Hinlah nanghon neiphal peh pouve.
en: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!
text:
MAT 23:37
Thadou: “Vo Jerusalem, Jerusalem themgao ho that le Pathen thupole ho that'a pangho! Ahpin anoute alhaving tenia a-opkhum tobanga nachateu itobang tah'a kakhoptup kigot hitam! Hinlah nanghon neiphal peh pouve.
English: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

tcz: Chule tun veuvin, na in'u chu dalhahsa le ahomkeo ahitai.
en: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.
text:
MAT 23:38
Thadou: Chule tun veuvin, na in'u chu dalhahsa le ahomkeo ahitai.
English: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche thutahbeh hi kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche thutanna hi tukhang mite chunga chu ding ahi!”
en: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
text:
MAT 23:39
Thadou: Ajeh chu hiche thutahbeh hi kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche thutanna hi tukhang mite chunga chu ding ahi!”
English: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

tcz: Yeshuan Hou'in leitol mun adalhah ding chun, aseijuite ho chun Hou'in kisahna in tampi ho chu avetsah uve.
en: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.
text:
MAT 24:1
Thadou: Yeshuan Hou'in leitol mun adalhah ding chun, aseijuite ho chun Hou'in kisahna in tampi ho chu avetsah uve.
English: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

en: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
