MAT 26:41
Thadou: Lhepna'a nalhah louna ding un kiging un chule taovun. Ajeh chu Lhagaovin ago-nan, hinlah tahsan ajoupoi,” ati.
English: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu anivei nan adalhan chule ataovin, “Hepa! Hiche khon hi kadon louva kichondoh lou ding ahileh, nalung got hita hen,” ati.
en: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”
text:
MAT 26:42
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu anivei nan adalhan chule ataovin, “Hepa! Hiche khon hi kadon louva kichondoh lou ding ahileh, nalung got hita hen,” ati.
English: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”

tcz: Chuin Ama amaho koma akile kit in, amaho chu a-ihmut'u ahung mukit tan ahi, ajeh chu amaho a-ihmut'u soh behseh jenga ahitai.
en: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
text:
MAT 26:43
Thadou: Chuin Ama amaho koma akile kit in, amaho chu a-ihmut'u ahung mukit tan ahi, ajeh chu amaho a-ihmut'u soh behseh jenga ahitai.
English: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

tcz: Hiti chun Ama athum veinan agatao kit in, asei ngaima chu agasei kit in ahi.
en: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.
text:
MAT 26:44
Thadou: Hiti chun Ama athum veinan agatao kit in, asei ngaima chu agasei kit in ahi.
English: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

tcz: Chujouvin aseijuite koma ahung in, hiti hin aseiye, “I-mu jeng un. Ki choldo uvin, hinlah veuvin phat ahung lhung e. Mihem Chapa hi mi chonse ho khut a pehdoh'a uma ahitai.
en: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
text:
MAT 26:45
Thadou: Chujouvin aseijuite koma ahung in, hiti hin aseiye, “I-mu jeng un. Ki choldo uvin, hinlah veuvin phat ahung lhung e. Mihem Chapa hi mi chonse ho khut a pehdoh'a uma ahitai.
English: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

tcz: Kipat un cheu hite. Veuvin, eipe dohpa hichea aum e,” ati.
en: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
text:
MAT 26:46
Thadou: Kipat un cheu hite. Veuvin, eipe dohpa hichea aum e,” ati.
English: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thu aseina laiyin, seijui som le ni ho lah'a khatpen Judas chu mihon tampi toh chemjam le moltum choi pum in ahunglhung un ahi. Amaho chu miho lah'a upa ho le thempu pipui ho hinsol ahiuve.
en: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
text:
MAT 26:47
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thu aseina laiyin, seijui som le ni ho lah'a khatpen Judas chu mihon tampi toh chemjam le moltum choi pum in ahunglhung un ahi. Amaho chu miho lah'a upa ho le thempu pipui ho hinsol ahiuve.
English: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

tcz: Amatsah'a pang Judas chun amaho melchihna gon tohsan akoiyin: “Nang hon koipen mat ding chu nahet theina ding uva, keiman kalem-a abeng kachop peh ding ahi,” ati.
en: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”
text:
MAT 26:48
Thadou: Amatsah'a pang Judas chun amaho melchihna gon tohsan akoiyin: “Nang hon koipen mat ding chu nahet theina ding uva, keiman kalem-a abeng kachop peh ding ahi,” ati.
English: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”

tcz: Hiti chun Judas chun Yeshua ahinjon pai jel in, “Chibai houhil,” atin abeng achop tai.
en: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.
text:
MAT 26:49
Thadou: Hiti chun Judas chun Yeshua ahinjon pai jel in, “Chibai houhil,” atin abeng achop tai.
English: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

tcz: Yeshuan ajah a, “Kajol, ipi boldia hung'ah nahim? Nabol ding chu boltan,” ati. Chujouvin amahon Yeshua chu aman tauve.
en: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
text:
MAT 26:50
Thadou: Yeshuan ajah a, “Kajol, ipi boldia hung'ah nahim? Nabol ding chu boltan,” ati. Chujouvin amahon Yeshua chu aman tauve.
English: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshua to um khom ho lah'a khat chun achemjam aladoh in, chuin Thempu chungnung sohpa chu asat le abilkol asat lha jeng e.
en: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
text:
MAT 26:51
Thadou: Hinlah Yeshua to um khom ho lah'a khat chun achemjam aladoh in, chuin Thempu chungnung sohpa chu asat le abilkol asat lha jeng e.
English: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

tcz: Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Na chemjam chu koidoh in. Chemjam mangcha ho chu chemjam a thi ding ahiuve.
en: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.
text:
MAT 26:52
Thadou: Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Na chemjam chu koidoh in. Chemjam mangcha ho chu chemjam a thi ding ahiuve.
English: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

tcz: Keiman Kapa jah'a Vantil asang sang ho chu eihuhdoh diuva kathum mo ham? Chule Aman apettah'a ahinsol paijeng thei ahi, nageldoh lou uham?
en: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?
text:
MAT 26:53
Thadou: Keiman Kapa jah'a Vantil asang sang ho chu eihuhdoh diuva kathum mo ham? Chule Aman apettah'a ahinsol paijeng thei ahi, nageldoh lou uham?
English: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

tcz: Hinlah keiman chuti bol leng, Pathen Thubun asei tua guilhung ding ati hi, iti hithei ding hitam?” ati.
en: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”
text:
MAT 26:54
Thadou: Hinlah keiman chuti bol leng, Pathen Thubun asei tua guilhung ding ati hi, iti hithei ding hitam?” ati.
English: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”

tcz: Chujouvin Yeshuan mihonpi jah'a chun, “Keima hi gamsung vaipohna khelgoa nei ngai touva chemjam le moltum thoa eiman dinga hunga nahi uvem? Ipi dinga Hou-in a neimat lou uham? Chua chu niseh'a thu kanahil ji ahi.
en: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.
text:
MAT 26:55
Thadou: Chujouvin Yeshuan mihonpi jah'a chun, “Keima hi gamsung vaipohna khelgoa nei ngai touva chemjam le moltum thoa eiman dinga hunga nahi uvem? Ipi dinga Hou-in a neimat lou uham? Chua chu niseh'a thu kanahil ji ahi.
English: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.

tcz: Hinlah hicheng jouse hi Pathen Thubua thu kisei, aguilhun na dinga hitia ahi,” ati.
en: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.
text:
MAT 26:56
Thadou: Hinlah hicheng jouse hi Pathen Thubua thu kisei, aguilhun na dinga hitia ahi,” ati.
English: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.

tcz: Chujouvin Yeshua man ho chun Caiaphas Thempu chungnung in'a apui tauvin, hiche muna chu hou danthu hil holeh upa ho kikhoma ahiuve.
en: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.
text:
MAT 26:57
Thadou: Chujouvin Yeshua man ho chun Caiaphas Thempu chungnung in'a apui tauvin, hiche muna chu hou danthu hil holeh upa ho kikhoma ahiuve.
English: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

tcz: Hiche phatkah sunga chu Peter in gal kanga Yeshua chu ajui ahi. Ama agalut in chule avesuiya pang ho chutoh atoukhom in, chujongleh iti kichai yuvem ti angah tai.
en: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.
text:
MAT 26:58
Thadou: Hiche phatkah sunga chu Peter in gal kanga Yeshua chu ajui ahi. Ama agalut in chule avesuiya pang ho chutoh atoukhom in, chujongleh iti kichai yuvem ti angah tai.
English: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

tcz: Asunga thempu pipui holeh upa ho akikhom jouse chun Yeshua chu jouthua hettohsahna neiya, hiti chun athemomna ding angai touvin ahi.
en: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,
text:
MAT 26:59
Thadou: Asunga thempu pipui holeh upa ho akikhom jouse chun Yeshua chu jouthua hettohsahna neiya, hiti chun athemomna ding angai touvin ahi.
English: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,

tcz: Hinlah amahon jouthua hettohsahna ding tamtah anei vang un, midang thua hettohsahje ahe tapouve. Ajonan mini masang lama ahungdoh lhon in,
en: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward
text:
MAT 26:60
Thadou: Hinlah amahon jouthua hettohsahna ding tamtah anei vang un, midang thua hettohsahje ahe tapouve. Ajonan mini masang lama ahungdoh lhon in,
English: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward

tcz: amani chun, “Hichepa hin keiman Pathen Hou'in kasuh mang'a chule ni thum sunga katundoh kit thei ding ahi tin aseiye,” atilhon in ahi.
en: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”
text:
MAT 26:61
Thadou: amani chun, “Hichepa hin keiman Pathen Hou'in kasuh mang'a chule ni thum sunga katundoh kit thei ding ahi tin aseiye,” atilhon in ahi.
English: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”

tcz: Chuphat in thempu chungnung chu ading doh in, chuin Yeshua jah'a chun, “Nathemmo channau hi nadonbut lou ding ham? Nachung thua ipi na kisei nom um'em?” ati.
en: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”
text:
MAT 26:62
Thadou: Chuphat in thempu chungnung chu ading doh in, chuin Yeshua jah'a chun, “Nathemmo channau hi nadonbut lou ding ham? Nachung thua ipi na kisei nom um'em?” ati.
English: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”

tcz: Hinlah Yeshua chu thipbeh'in aum in ahi. Thempu chungnung chun ajah a, “Pathen hing mina katem nahi, Nangma Pathen Chapa Messiah chu nahim, neiseipeh un,” ati.
en: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”
text:
MAT 26:63
Thadou: Hinlah Yeshua chu thipbeh'in aum in ahi. Thempu chungnung chun ajah a, “Pathen hing mina katem nahi, Nangma Pathen Chapa Messiah chu nahim, neiseipeh un,” ati.
English: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nasei khai. Chule khonung teng nanghon Mihem Chapa hi Pathen jetlam thaneina'a atou namu diu ahi,” ati.
en: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”
text:
MAT 26:64
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nasei khai. Chule khonung teng nanghon Mihem Chapa hi Pathen jetlam thaneina'a atou namu diu ahi,” ati.
English: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”

tcz: Chutah chun Thempu chungnung chun hoise val asah chu vetsahna'in aponsil abotkeh in chule aseiyin, Pathen ataitom e! Ipi hettohsah dang ingaichat beu ngaiyem? Nang ho jousen Pathen ataitomna thucheng naja tauve.
en: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.
text:
MAT 26:65
Thadou: Chutah chun Thempu chungnung chun hoise val asah chu vetsahna'in aponsil abotkeh in chule aseiyin, Pathen ataitom e! Ipi hettohsah dang ingaichat beu ngaiyem? Nang ho jousen Pathen ataitomna thucheng naja tauve.
English: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

tcz: Ipi ham nang ho thulhuh chu? Tia adoh le amahon, “Athemmoa ahi, athi dinga pha ahi,” atiuve.
en: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”
text:
MAT 26:66
Thadou: Ipi ham nang ho thulhuh chu? Tia adoh le amahon, “Athemmoa ahi, athi dinga pha ahi,” atiuve.
English: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”

tcz: Hiphat chun amahon Yeshua maiya chil aset un chule akhut tumuva achum tauve. Chule abang phabep in angeiphe abeng un,
en: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
text:
MAT 26:67
Thadou: Hiphat chun amahon Yeshua maiya chil aset un chule akhut tumuva achum tauve. Chule abang phabep in angeiphe abeng un,
English: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

tcz: anuisat un, Messiah gaovin seiyin! Koipen in navoh ham? atiuve.
en: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”
text:
MAT 26:68
Thadou: anuisat un, Messiah gaovin seiyin! Koipen in navoh ham? atiuve.
English: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”

tcz: Hiche pet'a chu Peter chu thutanna mun pamlama touva ahi. Chuin soh numei khat ahung pheiyin “Nangma Galilee a Yeshua nungjui ho lah'a khat nahi,” ahung ti.
en: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”
text:
MAT 26:69
Thadou: Hiche pet'a chu Peter chu thutanna mun pamlama touva ahi. Chuin soh numei khat ahung pheiyin “Nangma Galilee a Yeshua nungjui ho lah'a khat nahi,” ahung ti.
English: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”

tcz: Hinlah Peter chun miho masanga chun aseilep in, “Ipi thu nasei ahi keiman kahepoi,” ati.
en: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”
text:
MAT 26:70
Thadou: Hinlah Peter chun miho masanga chun aseilep in, “Ipi thu nasei ahi keiman kahepoi,” ati.
English: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”

tcz: Chujouvin kelkot phung ageipet in, soh numei chom khat in ama chu ahen chule akimvel'a touho koma chun, “Hi chepa hi Nazareth Yeshua toh um khom jia ahi,” ati.
en: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
text:
MAT 26:71
Thadou: Chujouvin kelkot phung ageipet in, soh numei chom khat in ama chu ahen chule akimvel'a touho koma chun, “Hi chepa hi Nazareth Yeshua toh um khom jia ahi,” ati.
English: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

tcz: Peter in avelin aseilep in, kihahsel toh thon, “Hichepa chu ahet'a ka hetlou ahi,” atitai.
en: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”
text:
MAT 26:72
Thadou: Peter in avelin aseilep in, kihahsel toh thon, “Hichepa chu ahet'a ka hetlou ahi,” atitai.
English: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”

tcz: Chule chomkhat jouvin achom dang khat akimvela ding ho chu Peter koma ahung in, aseiyin, “Nangma amaho lah'a khat nahi, Galilee mi nahi, na pao aw chun ka hedoh jeng uve,” atiuve.
en: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”
text:
MAT 26:73
Thadou: Chule chomkhat jouvin achom dang khat akimvela ding ho chu Peter koma ahung in, aseiyin, “Nangma amaho lah'a khat nahi, Galilee mi nahi, na pao aw chun ka hedoh jeng uve,” atiuve.
English: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”

tcz: Peter ki hahsel tothon, “Jou kaseile gaosap chang ing'e keiman hichepa hi kahepoi,” ati. Chuin apettah chun ahchal akhongtai.
en: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
text:
MAT 26:74
Thadou: Peter ki hahsel tothon, “Jou kaseile gaosap chang ing'e keiman hichepa hi kahepoi,” ati. Chuin apettah chun ahchal akhongtai.
English: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.

tcz: Apettah chun Yeshua thusei chu Peter lunggela ahung kilangdoh in, “Ahkhon masanga thumvei nei seilep ding, Keima hi koi ahi kahe khapoi,” tia nasei ding ahi, tichu ageldoh in polama apot'in lhasetah in akap tai.
en: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.
text:
MAT 26:75
Thadou: Apettah chun Yeshua thusei chu Peter lunggela ahung kilangdoh in, “Ahkhon masanga thumvei nei seilep ding, Keima hi koi ahi kahe khapoi,” tia nasei ding ahi, tichu ageldoh in polama apot'in lhasetah in akap tai.
English: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.

tcz: Jingpi matah in thempu pipui holeh miho lah'a upa ho atoukhom kit un, Yeshua thana ding angaito tauve.
en: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.
text:
MAT 27:1
Thadou: Jingpi matah in thempu pipui holeh miho lah'a upa ho atoukhom kit un, Yeshua thana ding angaito tauve.
English: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

tcz: Chujouvin amaho chun Ama akan un, apui mang un, chuin Rome gamvaipo Pilate henga apui tauve.
en: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
text:
MAT 27:2
Thadou: Chujouvin amaho chun Ama akan un, apui mang un, chuin Rome gamvaipo Pilate henga apui tauve.
English: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

tcz: Ama pedoh'a pangpa Judas chun Yeshua chu thi chan geiya dinga themo achan'u chu ahen, alunga akisih lheh jeng tai. Hiti chun aman dangka somthum chu alan, thempu pipui holeh upa ho koma achoiyin,
en: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
text:
MAT 27:3
Thadou: Ama pedoh'a pangpa Judas chun Yeshua chu thi chan geiya dinga themo achan'u chu ahen, alunga akisih lheh jeng tai. Hiti chun aman dangka somthum chu alan, thempu pipui holeh upa ho koma achoiyin,
English: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

tcz: aman aphongdoh in, “Ka chonse tai, ajeh chu keiman themmona neilou chu kapedoh tai” ati. Ama hon adonbut'un, “Keihon ija kageldeh uvem, hichu nangma boina hibouva chu,” atiuve.
en: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”
text:
MAT 27:4
Thadou: aman aphongdoh in, “Ka chonse tai, ajeh chu keiman themmona neilou chu kapedoh tai” ati. Ama hon adonbut'un, “Keihon ija kageldeh uvem, hichu nangma boina hibouva chu,” atiuve.
English: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

tcz: Chujouvin Judas chun dangka sum nong chu Hou'in sunga aleh lhan chule apotdoh in ama le ama akikhai lihtai.
en: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.
text:
MAT 27:5
Thadou: Chujouvin Judas chun dangka sum nong chu Hou'in sunga aleh lhan chule apotdoh in ama le ama akikhai lihtai.
English: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.

tcz: Thempu pipui ho chun sum nong chu aloh khom un, aseiyun, “Hiche sum hi Hou'in a sumkoina a koikhom nom ponte, ajeh chu mithana dinga ki pedohsa ahi,” atiuve.
en: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”
text:
MAT 27:6
Thadou: Thempu pipui ho chun sum nong chu aloh khom un, aseiyun, “Hiche sum hi Hou'in a sumkoina a koikhom nom ponte, ajeh chu mithana dinga ki pedohsa ahi,” atiuve.
English: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

tcz: Aki houtoh jouvun, ajonan amahon bel dengpa honlei chohna ding in agellha tauve. Chule hichu gam pam mi kivuina ding in asem tauve.
en: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.
text:
MAT 27:7
Thadou: Aki houtoh jouvun, ajonan amahon bel dengpa honlei chohna ding in agellha tauve. Chule hichu gam pam mi kivuina ding in asem tauve.
English: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

tcz: Hijeh'a chu leimun min chu Thisan Man kitia ahi.
en: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.
text:
MAT 27:8

text:
MAT 27:19
Thadou: Pilate thutanna'a atoupet tah in ajinu chun hiche thuhi athot in: “Hiche themmona beipa hi limsah hih in. Ama jeh hin tujan ka-ihmutna'a chun kathoh gimlheh jenge,” ati.

MAT 27:20

en: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”
text:
MAT 27:22
Thadou: Pilate in adonbut in, “Messiah kiti Yeshua hila ikalo ding ham?” ati. Amahon, “Thingpel'a khenbeh in,” atiuve.
English: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

tcz: Pilate in “Ipi jeh inem? Ipi suhkhel len anei ham?” ati. Hinlah mi honpi chun aha sap cheh uvin, “Thingpel'a khenbeh in,” atiuve.
en: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
text:
MAT 27:23
Thadou: Pilate in “Ipi jeh inem? Ipi suhkhel len anei ham?” ati. Hinlah mi honpi chun aha sap cheh uvin, “Thingpel'a khenbeh in,” atiuve.
English: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

tcz: Plate chun imacha phatchomna aum-louva chusanga boina asocheh ding chu amu phat in, aman cha-konga twi athum in chule mi honpi masanga chun akhut akisop in aseitai, hichepa thisan kisona'a hin themmona kaneipoi: Nanghon kimopoh tauvin'ati.
en: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”
text:
MAT 27:24
Thadou: Plate chun imacha phatchomna aum-louva chusanga boina asocheh ding chu amu phat in, aman cha-konga twi athum in chule mi honpi masanga chun akhut akisop in aseitai, hichepa thisan kisona'a hin themmona kaneipoi: Nanghon kimopoh tauvin'ati.
English: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

text:
MAT 27:25
Thadou: Chuin miho jouse chun, Ama thina chunga keiho le ka chateu geiyin mo kipoh naveh tangu tin ale donbut un ahi.

tcz: Chuin aman Barabbas chu alhadoh peh in, Yeshua vang chu sakol jepna thih lingneiya jep ding in Rome sepai ho thu apen chule amahon thingpel'a akhetbeh diuvin apedoh tai.

MAT 27:26

English: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

text:
MAT 27:27
Thadou: Gamvaipopa sepai ho chun Yeshua chu atol-piu thutanna mun'a apuiyun chule sepai ho chu akou doh un ahi.
English: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

MAT 27:28

English: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

text:

MAT 27:46
Thadou: Nilhangkai nidan thum don in, Yeshuan aw sangtah in asam in, “Eli, Eli, lema sabach thani?” hichu “Ka Pathen, ka Pathen, ipi dinga neidon lou hitam?” ti kiseina ahi.
English: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

tcz: Akimvela dingho phabep chun ahekhel-uvin, chuti chun themgao Elijah akouvin agel uve.

MAT 27:47
Thadou: Akimvela dingho phabep chun ahekhel-uvin, chuti chun themgao Elijah akouvin agel uve.
English: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

MAT 27:48

text:

MAT 27:50

English: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

MAT 27:51

en: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

Thadou: Rome sepai ja lamkai pa le sepai dang ho akikhetbehna mun'a umho chun ling akihoa hiti ho thusoh chun atijatsah lheh uvin ahi. Amahon aseiyun, “Hiche hi Pathen Chapa tahbeh ahiye,” atiuve.
English: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”

tcz: Chule numei tampi Yeshua toh Galilee akon'a ahin lhonpi ama gelkhoh ho chun gamlatah a kon in aveu vin ahi.
en: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.
text:
MAT 27:55
Thadou: Chule numei tampi Yeshua toh Galilee akon'a ahin lhonpi ama gelkhoh ho chun gamlatah a kon in aveu vin ahi.
English: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

tcz: Amaho lah'a Mary Magdalene, James le Joseph nu Mary, chule James le John (Zebedee chapateni) ahiuve:
en: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
text:
MAT 27:56
Thadou: Amaho lah'a Mary Magdalene, James le Joseph nu Mary, chule James le John (Zebedee chapateni) ahiuve:
English: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

tcz: Nilhah ahung hi phat in, Joseph Arimathea khoa mihaopa, amahin Yeshua nung anajui ahin,
en: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.
text:
MAT 27:57
Thadou: Nilhah ahung hi phat in, Joseph Arimathea khoa mihaopa, amahin Yeshua nung anajui ahin,
English: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

tcz: Pilate henga aga chen chule Yeshua tahsa chu athum in ahi. Chule Pilate chun ama pehdoh ding in phalna apetai.
en: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.
text:
MAT 27:58
Thadou: Pilate henga aga chen chule Yeshua tahsa chu athum in ahi. Chule Pilate chun ama pehdoh ding in phalna apetai.
English: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

tcz: Joseph hin atahsa chu alan tupat ponnem thengsel'in atom in ahi.
en: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth
text:
MAT 27:59
Thadou: Joseph hin atahsa chu alan tupat ponnem thengsel'in atom in ahi.
English: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

tcz: Aman ama lhan thah, songpia kon'a kigeihom sunga chun akoiyin ahi. Chujouvin aman alutna mun'a chun songlentah khat atahlut jouvin achemangtai.
en: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.
text:
MAT 27:60
Thadou: Aman ama lhan thah, songpia kon'a kigeihom sunga chun akoiyin ahi. Chujouvin aman alutna mun'a chun songlentah khat atahlut jouvin achemangtai.
English: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

tcz: Mary le Magdalene chule Mary chomnu lhan'a atou un chule angah un ahi.
en: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
text:
MAT 27:61
Thadou: Mary le Magdalene chule Mary chomnu lhan'a atou un chule angah un ahi.
English: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

tcz: Ajingin, Sabbath nikhon thempu pipuho le Pharisee ho Pilate kimupidin aga-cheuvin ahi.
en: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,
text:
MAT 27:62
Thadou: Ajingin, Sabbath nikhon thempu pipuho le Pharisee ho Pilate kimupidin aga-cheuvin ahi.
English: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

tcz: Amahon ajah a, “Pu, hiche milhem lhapa chun ahinlaiya khatvei anasei chu kageldoh uve. Aman ni thum joule thina'a kon'a kathodoh kit ding ahi.
en: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’
text:
MAT 27:63
Thadou: Amahon ajah a, “Pu, hiche milhem lhapa chun ahinlaiya khatvei anasei chu kageldoh uve. Aman ni thum joule thina'a kon'a kathodoh kit ding ahi.
English: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

tcz: Hijeh'a hi lhan chu ni thum lhinkah'a ding in mohor nam in. Hiche hin aseijuite ahung uva chule atahsa guhmangna chule mijouse koma ama athilah'a kon in athoudohtai atina diu umta ponte. Hiti chu hileh amasa suhkhel sang'a phajo hiding ahi,” ati.
en: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”
text:
MAT 27:64
Thadou: Hijeh'a hi lhan chu ni thum lhinkah'a ding in mohor nam in. Hiche hin aseijuite ahung uva chule atahsa guhmangna chule mijouse koma ama athilah'a kon in athoudohtai atina diu umta ponte. Hiti chu hileh amasa suhkhel sang'a phajo hiding ahi,” ati.
English: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

tcz: Pilate in adonbut in, “Hou'in ngah ho chu puiyun lang chule nahonbit thei chan un hongbit un,” ati.
en: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”
text:
MAT 27:65
Thadou: Pilate in adonbut in, “Hou'in ngah ho chu puiyun lang chule nahonbit thei chan un hongbit un,” ati.
English: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

tcz: Hiti chun amahon lhan chu mohor anam'un chule avetup ding'in angah akoi tauve.
en: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.
text:
MAT 27:66
Thadou: Hiti chun amahon lhan chu mohor anam'un chule avetup ding'in angah akoi tauve.
English: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

tcz: Cholngah nikho kichai hapta kipatni jingpi matah in, Mary Magdalene le Mary chomnu chu lhan gave ding in apotdoh lhon in ahi.
en: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.
text:
MAT 28:1
Thadou: Cholngah nikho kichai hapta kipatni jingpi matah in, Mary Magdalene le Mary chomnu chu lhan gave ding in apotdoh lhon in ahi.
English: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

tcz: Phulou helouvin ling hattah in akihot in ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai vantil chu van'a kon in ahung kumlhan, song chu atangdoh in, chule achunga chun atouvin ahi.
en: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.
text:
MAT 28:2
Thadou: Phulou helouvin ling hattah in akihot in ahi. Ajeh chu Pakai vantil chu van'a kon in ahung kumlhan, song chu atangdoh in, chule achunga chun atouvin ahi.
English: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

tcz: Amai chu kolphe bang in avah in, chule aponsil chu buhbang ban'in abangin ahi.
en: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
text:
MAT 28:3
Thadou: Amai chu kolphe bang in avah in, chule aponsil chu buhbang ban'in abangin ahi.
English: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

tcz: Angah ho chun ama chu amu phat-un kichatnan adim un, chuin athia to abang jeng uve.
en: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.
text:
MAT 28:4
Thadou: Angah ho chun ama chu amu phat-un kichatnan adim un, chuin athia to abang jeng uve.
English: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

tcz: Chujouvin vantil chun numei ho jah a, “Kicha hih uvin, keiman thingpel'a ana kikhenbeh Yeshua chu nahol'u ahi kahenai.
en: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.
text:
MAT 28:5
Thadou: Chujouvin vantil chun numei ho jah a, “Kicha hih uvin, keiman thingpel'a ana kikhenbeh Yeshua chu nahol'u ahi kahenai.
English: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

tcz: Ama hiche muna hin aum tapoi! Aman aseisa bang in, Ama thina a kon'in athou dohtai. Hung'un lang, Pakai tahsa lupna mun hi hung vetauvin.
en: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.
text:
MAT 28:6
Thadou: Ama hiche muna hin aum tapoi! Aman aseisa bang in, Ama thina a kon'in athou dohtai. Hung'un lang, Pakai tahsa lupna mun hi hung vetauvin.
English: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

tcz: Chule tuhin, chepai jeng un, chule aseijui ho koma Ama thina a kon'in athou dohtai, chule Ama nama sanguva Galilee a anache masa ding ahi. Chuche muna Ama namu diu ahi. Keiman kana seipeh'u geldoh uvin,” ati.
en: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”
text:
MAT 28:7
Thadou: Chule tuhin, chepai jeng un, chule aseijui ho koma Ama thina a kon'in athou dohtai, chule Ama nama sanguva Galilee a anache masa ding ahi. Chuche muna Ama namu diu ahi. Keiman kana seipeh'u geldoh uvin,” ati.
English: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

tcz: Numei ho chu lhan akon'in achepai jeng un ahi. Amaho chu aha kichat'u toh chule kipa thanop toh thon, vantil thupoh chu seiding in alhailoi jeng un ahi.
en: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
text:
MAT 28:8
Thadou: Numei ho chu lhan akon'in achepai jeng un ahi. Amaho chu aha kichat'u toh chule kipa thanop toh thon, vantil thupoh chu seiding in alhailoi jeng un ahi.
English: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

tcz: Chuin amaho acheuva ahileh, Yeshuan amaho akimupin chujongleh ana lamtouvin ahi. Chuin amaho akom lama chun alhaiyun, akeng atuh uvin, chule dilsun ahou tauve.
en: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.
text:
MAT 28:9
Thadou: Chuin amaho acheuva ahileh, Yeshuan amaho akimupin chujongleh ana lamtouvin ahi. Chuin amaho akom lama chun alhaiyun, akeng atuh uvin, chule dilsun ahou tauve.
English: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

tcz: Chujouvin Yeshuan ajah uva, “Kicha hih uvin! Cheuvin, kasopite koma chun Galilee a che ding'in gaseipeh un, chule chua chu keima eimu diu ahi, ti gaseipeh un,” ati.
en: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”
text:
MAT 28:10
Thadou: Chujouvin Yeshuan ajah uva, “Kicha hih uvin! Cheuvin, kasopite koma chun Galilee a che ding'in gaseipeh un, chule chua chu keima eimu diu ahi, ti gaseipeh un,” ati.
English: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

tcz: Numei ho chu lampi ageina laiyun, lhan ngah phabep chu khopi sunga alut'un chule thempu pipuho henga ipi thusoh ahi chu agasei tauve.
en: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.
text:
MAT 28:11
Thadou: Numei ho chu lampi ageina laiyun, lhan ngah phabep chu khopi sunga alut'un chule thempu pipuho henga ipi thusoh ahi chu agasei tauve.
English: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

tcz: Upa ho chun kihou khomna aneiyun, chule amaho chun sepaiho chu sum tamtah pehguh ding'in aseilha tauve.
en: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,
text:
MAT 28:12
Thadou: Upa ho chun kihou khomna aneiyun, chule amaho chun sepaiho chu sum tamtah pehguh ding'in aseilha tauve.
English: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

tcz: Amahon sepaiho jah'a chun, “Nanghon Yeshua seijuite chu jan'a ka-ihmut pet-un ahung un, chujongleh along chu ahung gudoh tauve, tin seiyun.
en: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.
text:
MAT 28:13
Thadou: Amahon sepaiho jah'a chun, “Nanghon Yeshua seijuite chu jan'a ka-ihmut pet-un ahung un, chujongleh along chu ahung gudoh tauve, tin seiyun.
English: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

tcz: Gamvaipo chun hiche thu chu ajahdoh'a ahileh, keihon nadinpiu ving ting hahsatna nachunguva lhunsah pouvinge,” atiuvin ahi.
en: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”
text:
MAT 28:14
Thadou: Gamvaipo chun hiche thu chu ajahdoh'a ahileh, keihon nadinpiu ving ting hahsatna nachunguva lhunsah pouvinge,” atiuvin ahi.
English: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

tcz: Hiti chun lhan ngah ho chun sum aguh'a kipe chu akilah un, hiti chun asei dinguva kinganse chu aseitauve. Amaho thusim hi Judahte lah'a thusim in akiseison peh in, chule tuni geiyin akisei jing nalaiye.
en: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.
text:
MAT 28:15
Thadou: Hiti chun lhan ngah ho chun sum aguh'a kipe chu akilah un, hiti chun asei dinguva kinganse chu aseitauve. Amaho thusim hi Judahte lah'a thusim in akiseison peh in, chule tuni geiyin akisei jing nalaiye.
English: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

tcz: Chujouvin seijui som le khat ho chun Galilee adalhauvin, Yeshuan ateppeh nau mola chun agache tauve.
en: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.
text:
MAT 28:16
Thadou: Chujouvin seijui som le khat ho chun Galilee adalhauvin, Yeshuan ateppeh nau mola chun agache tauve.
English: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

tcz: Ama amu phat'un, dilsun a-hou tauve, hinlah phabep in aging chalel-uvin ahi.
en: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.
text:
MAT 28:17
Thadou: Ama amu phat'un, dilsun a-hou tauve, hinlah phabep in aging chalel-uvin ahi.
English: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua ahung in, chujongleh aseijuite jah'a chun, “Van'a le leiset chunga thuneina jouse Keima eikipedoh'a ahitai.
en: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
text:
MAT 28:18
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua ahung in, chujongleh aseijuite jah'a chun, “Van'a le leiset chunga thuneina jouse Keima eikipedoh'a ahitai.
English: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

tcz: Hijeh chun, nangho cheuvin chule namtin jouse seijuiyin gasemun, amaho chu Pa le Chapa chule Lhagao Theng min-in Twilutsah uvin.
en: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
text:
MAT 28:19
Thadou: Hijeh chun, nangho cheuvin chule namtin jouse seijuiyin gasemun, amaho chu Pa le Chapa chule Lhagao Theng min-in Twilutsah uvin.
English: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

tcz: Keiman Kathupeh ho jouse hi seijui thah hochun aboncha ajui sohkeina dingun hil-uvin. Chule hiche khang kichai kahsea dingin Keiman nangho Ka-umpi jing nauve,” ati.
en: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
text:
MAT 28:20
Thadou: Keiman Kathupeh ho jouse hi seijui thah hochun aboncha ajui sohkeina dingun hil-uvin. Chule hiche khang kichai kahsea dingin Keiman nangho Ka-umpi jing nauve,” ati.
English: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

tcz: Hiche hi Messiah Yeshua Christa, Pathen Chapa thudola kipana thupha chu ahi.
en: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
text:
MRK 1:1
Thadou: Hiche hi Messiah Yeshua Christa, Pathen Chapa thudola kipana thupha chu ahi.
English: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

tcz: Isaiah Themgaovin anasei: “Veuvin, keiman na masang uva thupole kahin sol e. Aman lampi nagonpeh diu ahi.
en: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:
text:
MRK 1:2
Thadou: Isaiah Themgaovin anasei: “Veuvin, keiman na masang uva thupole kahin sol e. Aman lampi nagonpeh diu ahi.
English: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:

tcz: Ama chu ahi gamthip a aw sam ging a, ‘Pakai hungna ding lampi semtoh-un! Amadin lampi sutheng un!’ tia chu,” anati bang in ahung kipan in ahi.
en: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”
text:
MRK 1:3
Thadou: Ama chu ahi gamthip a aw sam ging a, ‘Pakai hungna ding lampi semtoh-un! Amadin lampi sutheng un!’ tia chu,” anati bang in ahung kipan in ahi.
English: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”

tcz: Hiche thupole chu Twilutsah John chu ahi. Ama chu gamthip ah aumin chule mihon achonset kisih nau chule ngaidam channa dia Pathen ang aki heilut nau vetsahna dinga baptize achan diuvin thu ahil in ahi.
en: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
text:
MRK 1:4
Thadou: Hiche thupole chu Twilutsah John chu ahi. Ama chu gamthip ah aumin chule mihon achonset kisih nau chule ngaidam channa dia Pathen ang aki heilut nau vetsahna dinga baptize achan diuvin thu ahil in ahi.
English: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

tcz: Juda gam jouse, Jerusalem mite jouse chutoh, John mu ding le thusei ngai ding in ache uvin ahi. Chule amahon achonset nau aphondoh phat un, aman Jordan Luiyah baptize achansah in ahi.
en: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.
text:
MRK 1:5
Thadou: Juda gam jouse, Jerusalem mite jouse chutoh, John mu ding le thusei ngai ding in ache uvin ahi. Chule amahon achonset nau aphondoh phat un, aman Jordan Luiyah baptize achansah in ahi.
English: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

tcz: Akivonna chu sangongsang mul pon ahin, savun konggah-in akong ageh in, chule a-anneh chu khaokho le gam khoiju ahi.
en: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.
text:
MRK 1:6
Thadou: Akivonna chu sangongsang mul pon ahin, savun konggah-in akong ageh in, chule a-anneh chu khaokho le gam khoiju ahi.
English: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

tcz: John'in, “Koiham khat hungvah ding ahitai, Ama chu keima sanga lenjo kei sanga lenjo cheh hi ding, keima akengchot khao sutlham dinga jong lom kahipoi.
en: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.
text:
MRK 1:7
Thadou: John'in, “Koiham khat hungvah ding ahitai, Ama chu keima sanga lenjo kei sanga lenjo cheh hi ding, keima akengchot khao sutlham dinga jong lom kahipoi.
English: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

tcz: Keiman twiya baptize kachansah nahi uvin, ahivangin Ama chun nangho Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah diu ahi!” ati.
en: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
text:
MRK 1:8
Thadou: Keiman twiya baptize kachansah nahi uvin, ahivangin Ama chun nangho Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah diu ahi!” ati.
English: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”

tcz: Nikhat Galilee gamsunga Nazareth khoa kon in Yeshua ahung in, Jordan vadung ah John khut'in baptize achangtan ahi.
en: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
text:
MRK 1:9
Thadou: Nikhat Galilee gamsunga Nazareth khoa kon in Yeshua ahung in, Jordan vadung ah John khut'in baptize achangtan ahi.
English: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua twi lah-a konin ahungdoh in, van akikehson Lhagao Theng vakhu bang in achungah ahungchu e.
en: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
text:
MRK 1:10
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua twi lah-a konin ahungdoh in, van akikehson Lhagao Theng vakhu bang in achungah ahungchu e.
English: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

tcz: Van'ah aw ahung ging in: “Nangma kachapa deitah nahi, nachungah kalung alhai tangeiye,” ati.
en: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
text:
MRK 1:11
Thadou: Van'ah aw ahung ging in: “Nangma kachapa deitah nahi, nachungah kalung alhai tangeiye,” ati.
English: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

tcz: Chuin Lhagaochun gamthip'a apuimang paiyin,
en: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
text:
MRK 1:12
Thadou: Chuin Lhagaochun gamthip'a apuimang paiyin,
English: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

tcz: Chua chun ni somli Satan lhep patep in aum in, gamsa ho laha aum in, vantil hon avengkol un ahi.
en: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.
text:
MRK 1:13
Thadou: Chua chun ni somli Satan lhep patep in aum in, gamsa ho laha aum in, vantil hon avengkol un ahi.
English: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin John songkul'a akhum jou un, Yeshua Galilee gamah achen, Pathen Kipana Thupha ahil lhanglen,
en: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,
text:
MRK 1:14
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin John songkul'a akhum jou un, Yeshua Galilee gamah achen, Pathen Kipana Thupha ahil lhanglen,
English: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

tcz: “Pathen phattep ahung lhungtai,” tin asam peh in, “Pathen Lenggam chu anaitai. Chonset na kon kisih unlang, Kipana Thupha hi tahsan un!” atin ahi.
en: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
text:
MRK 1:15
Thadou: “Pathen phattep ahung lhungtai,” tin asam peh in, “Pathen Lenggam chu anaitai. Chonset na kon kisih unlang, Kipana Thupha hi tahsan un!” atin ahi.
English: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan Galilee Dillen pang ajotpana ah ngaman'a kivah le nehhol, Simon le asopipa Andrew chun dillen a ngamatna len anase lhon aga tohkhan ahi.
en: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
text:
MRK 1:16
Thadou: Nikhat Yeshuan Galilee Dillen pang ajotpana ah ngaman'a kivah le nehhol, Simon le asopipa Andrew chun dillen a ngamatna len anase lhon aga tohkhan ahi.
English: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

tcz: Yeshuan akou doh in, “Kanung hinjui lhon in, keiman miho matje nahil lhon inge!” atin ahi.
en: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”
text:
MRK 1:17
Thadou: Yeshuan akou doh in, “Kanung hinjui lhon in, keiman miho matje nahil lhon inge!” atin ahi.
English: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

tcz: Chuin amanin alen adalha lhon in anung ajuipai jeng lhontai.
en: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.
text:
MRK 1:18
Thadou: Chuin amanin alen adalha lhon in anung ajuipai jeng lhontai.
English: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

tcz: Chuin twipanga kon themkhat ache chon jepleh Yeshuan Zebedee chapateni, James le anaopa John chun kong sunga len ana khuiphat pet lhon amun,
en: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
text:
MRK 1:19
Thadou: Chuin twipanga kon themkhat ache chon jepleh Yeshuan Zebedee chapateni, James le anaopa John chun kong sunga len ana khuiphat pet lhon amun,
English: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

tcz: Amani chu akouvin ahileh, aman nin apau Zebedee toh kong sunga um thaloa agoihou chu adalha lhon in ajui lhontai.
en: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
text:
MRK 1:20
Thadou: Amani chu akouvin ahileh, aman nin apau Zebedee toh kong sunga um thaloa agoihou chu adalha lhon in ajui lhontai.
English: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

tcz: Yeshua le akilhonpiho Capernaum khopiah achelut'un ahi. Cholngahni ahung lhunchun houin'ah ache uvin, hia chun thu ahil pantan ahi.
en: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
text:
MRK 1:21
Thadou: Yeshua le akilhonpiho Capernaum khopiah achelut'un ahi. Cholngahni ahung lhunchun houin'ah ache uvin, hia chun thu ahil pantan ahi.
English: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

tcz: Aman danthu sunho banga hillouva, thuneitah banga ahil jeh'in miho chun athuhil chu kidang asalheh-un ahi.
en: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
text:
MRK 1:22
Thadou: Aman danthu sunho banga hillouva, thuneitah banga ahil jeh'in miho chun athuhil chu kidang asalheh-un ahi.
English: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

tcz: Chuin hetloukah'in lhagao-boh vop mikhat houin'ah anaum in, ama chun ahin sampaiyin,
en: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
text:
MRK 1:23
Thadou: Chuin hetloukah'in lhagao-boh vop mikhat houin'ah anaum in, ama chun ahin sampaiyin,
English: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

tcz: “Nazareth Yeshua, ipi dinga kalah'uva hung kikum nahim? Keiho suchimit dinga hung nahim? Nangma koi nahi kahenai—Pathen Theng chu nahi!” ati.
en: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”
text:
MRK 1:24
Thadou: “Nazareth Yeshua, ipi dinga kalah'uva hung kikum nahim? Keiho suchimit dinga hung nahim? Nangma koi nahi kahenai—Pathen Theng chu nahi!” ati.
English: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

tcz: Yeshuan amachu aphoh in, “Thip in! Ama a kon chun hungdoh in,” tin thu apen ahi.
en: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”
text:
MRK 1:25
Thadou: Yeshuan amachu aphoh in, “Thip in! Ama a kon chun hungdoh in,” tin thu apen ahi.
English: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”

tcz: Chuin lhagaoboh chun mipa chu aheh-in, hapen in apeng in ahung potdoh tai.
en: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
text:
MRK 1:26
Thadou: Chuin lhagaoboh chun mipa chu aheh-in, hapen in apeng in ahung potdoh tai.
English: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

tcz: Mijousen kidang asauvin, thilsoh chungchanga chun khat le khat akidong un ahi. “Hiche hi ipi kihilna thuthah hikit hitam? Itobang thuneina hitantem! Lhagaoboh jeng in jong athupeh angaiye!” atiuvin ahi.
en: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”
text:
MRK 1:27
Thadou: Mijousen kidang asauvin, thilsoh chungchanga chun khat le khat akidong un ahi. “Hiche hi ipi kihilna thuthah hikit hitam? Itobang thuneina hitantem! Lhagaoboh jeng in jong athupeh angaiye!” atiuvin ahi.
English: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”

tcz: Yeshua Christa thu chu Galilee gamsung pumpiah aki thangsoh pai jeng tan ahi.
en: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.
text:
MRK 1:28
Thadou: Yeshua Christa thu chu Galilee gamsung pumpiah aki thangsoh pai jeng tan ahi.
English: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

tcz: Kikhopna in chu Yeshuan James le John toh adalhah jouvin Simon le Andrew in'ah alut un ahi.
en: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
text:
MRK 1:29
Thadou: Kikhopna in chu Yeshuan James le John toh adalhah jouvin Simon le Andrew in'ah alut un ahi.
English: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

tcz: Chua chun Simon nupanu chu khosih dammon analum e. Amahon adammo thu chu Yeshua ahetsah paiyun ahi.
en: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.
text:
MRK 1:30
Thadou: Chua chun Simon nupanu chu khosih dammon analum e. Amahon adammo thu chu Yeshua ahetsah paiyun ahi.
English: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

tcz: Hichun amanu koma chun achepheiyin akhut in atuh-in, akai thouvin atousah tai. Hichun akhosih chun alhatan, chuin amanu chu amaho neh ding sem in apangtai.
en: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.
text:
MRK 1:31
Thadou: Hichun amanu koma chun achepheiyin akhut in atuh-in, akai thouvin atousah tai. Hichun akhosih chun alhatan, chuin amanu chu amaho neh ding sem in apangtai.
English: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.

tcz: Nilhum jou nilhah-in mihon ana damlou leh, thilhavop ho chu Yeshua koma ahin puiyun.
en: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.
text:
MRK 1:32
Thadou: Nilhum jou nilhah-in mihon ana damlou leh, thilhavop ho chu Yeshua koma ahin puiyun.
English: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.

tcz: Kho mite jouse chu ave din kot khah phunga akitit dimsoh jeng e.
en: All the city was gathered together at the door.
text:
MRK 1:33
Thadou: Kho mite jouse chu ave din kot khah phunga akitit dimsoh jeng e.
English: All the city was gathered together at the door.

tcz: Chuin Aman hivei chom chom veiya damlou mi tamtah adamsah'in, chule thilha tamtahma adeldoh'in ahi. Hinla Ama Christa ahi chu thilhahon ahet'u ahijeh-in thilhaho chu apaodoh sahpoi.
en: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.
text:
MRK 1:34
Thadou: Chuin Aman hivei chom chom veiya damlou mi tamtah adamsah'in, chule thilha tamtahma adeldoh'in ahi. Hinla Ama Christa ahi chu thilhahon ahet'u ahijeh-in thilhaho chu apaodoh sahpoi.
English: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

tcz: Khovahlhah masang ajing jingkah-in Yeshua athouvin, apotdoh in gamthip munah achen, chua chun taona agamang in ahi.
en: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.
text:
MRK 1:35
Thadou: Khovahlhah masang ajing jingkah-in Yeshua athouvin, apotdoh in gamthip munah achen, chua chun taona agamang in ahi.
English: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin Simon le aloiho apotdohun, chuin agamudoh tauvin ahi.
en: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.
text:
MRK 1:36
Thadou: Chomkhat jouvin Simon le aloiho apotdohun, chuin agamudoh tauvin ahi.
English: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.

tcz: Amudoh phat un ajah-a, “Mijouse hinla Nang nahol cheh-un,” atiuvin ahi.
en: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”
text:
MRK 1:37
Thadou: Amudoh phat un ajah-a, “Mijouse hinla Nang nahol cheh-un,” atiuvin ahi.
English: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in “Khopi danga jong kahil lhangle theina din che ute, hiche dinga chu hung kahi,” ati.
en: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”
text:
MRK 1:38
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in “Khopi danga jong kahil lhangle theina din che ute, hiche dinga chu hung kahi,” ati.
English: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”

tcz: Chuin Galilee gam sungsea achelen, akikhop nau intin'ah thu ahil lhanglen chule thilha adel dohpeh in ahi.
en: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
text:
MRK 1:39
Thadou: Chuin Galilee gam sungsea achelen, akikhop nau intin'ah thu ahil lhanglen chule thilha adel dohpeh in ahi.
English: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

tcz: Chuin miphah khat Yeshua hengah kijen damsah dingin ahung in, adilsun, ajah a, “Nalung ahileh neidamsah'a neisuh theng thei ahi,” ahung titai.
en: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”
text:
MRK 1:40
Thadou: Chuin miphah khat Yeshua hengah kijen damsah dingin ahung in, adilsun, ajah a, “Nalung ahileh neidamsah'a neisuh theng thei ahi,” ahung titai.
English: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”

tcz: Athusei chun alung atohkhah behseh jeh in, Yeshuan akhut alhang in atham in, “Kalung ahi,” atitai. Chuin, “Damthengtan!” ati leh,
en: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”
text:
MRK 1:41
Thadou: Athusei chun alung atohkhah behseh jeh in, Yeshuan akhut alhang in atham in, “Kalung ahi,” atitai. Chuin, “Damthengtan!” ati leh,
English: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”

tcz: Apetpet'in aphah chu aphapai jengin, adamtheng tai.
en: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.
text:
MRK 1:42
Thadou: Apetpet'in aphah chu aphapai jengin, adamtheng tai.
English: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.

tcz: Chuin amapa chu khamgahna aneiyin asoldohtai.
en: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,
text:
MRK 1:43
Thadou: Chuin amapa chu khamgahna aneiyin asoldohtai.
English: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,

tcz: “Hichehi koima komah seidoh hih in. Hisang chun thempu koma chen lang gakivetsah'in. Mose dan thupehsa dungjuiya phah kijen damhon maicham thilto apeh ding dol chu choiyin lang gape tan. Hichu nadam thengna mipi het'a phondohna hiding ahi,” tin thupeh aneiyin ahi.
en: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
text:
MRK 1:44
Thadou: “Hichehi koima komah seidoh hih in. Hisang chun thempu koma chen lang gakivetsah'in. Mose dan thupehsa dungjuiya phah kijen damhon maicham thilto apeh ding dol chu choiyin lang gape tan. Hichu nadam thengna mipi het'a phondohna hiding ahi,” tin thupeh aneiyin ahi.
English: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

tcz: Ahivang in amapa apotdoh in, thil umdol chu aseiphongle tan ahi. Hichea kon chun Yeshua chu mipin aum kimvelle jeng tan, hijeh chun lhangphong in khopi sunga alut thei tapoi. Hichun munthip thip lah-a aumjo tan, ahijeng vang'in muntina kon in mipin ahin jonlut jing nalaiyun ahi.
en: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.
text:
MRK 1:45
Thadou: Ahivang in amapa apotdoh in, thil umdol chu aseiphongle tan ahi. Hichea kon chun Yeshua chu mipin aum kimvelle jeng tan, hijeh chun lhangphong in khopi sunga alut thei tapoi. Hichun munthip thip lah-a aumjo tan, ahijeng vang'in muntina kon in mipin ahin jonlut jing nalaiyun ahi.
English: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.

tcz: Nikho phabep jouva Yeshua Capernaum'a akile kit chun, in lama akile kittai ti muntin a ana thangsoh man kittan ahi.
en: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.
text:
MRK 2:1
Thadou: Nikho phabep jouva Yeshua Capernaum'a akile kit chun, in lama akile kittai ti muntin a ana thangsoh man kittan ahi.
English: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

tcz: Chomlou kah'in aumna in a chun mipi ahung kitit dim jeng in, umna ding kotphung polam jeng jong onglou khop'in mi adimlha jeng tai. Mipi chu Pathen thu ahil jing laiyin,
en: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.
text:
MRK 2:2
Thadou: Chomlou kah'in aumna in a chun mipi ahung kitit dim jeng in, umna ding kotphung polam jeng jong onglou khop'in mi adimlha jeng tai. Mipi chu Pathen thu ahil jing laiyin,
English: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

tcz: Pasal li-in langthi khat pheh chunga ahin pulut un ahi.
en: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.
text:
MRK 2:3
Thadou: Pasal li-in langthi khat pheh chunga ahin pulut un ahi.
English: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

tcz: Mipi atam behseh jeh chun Yeshua kom alutthei tahih un, hijeh chun Ama luchung don tah'a inchung alhong chu aphevang un, langthipa chu alupna pumin a angsunga akhailha jeng tauvin ahi.
en: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.
text:
MRK 2:4
Thadou: Mipi atam behseh jeh chun Yeshua kom alutthei tahih un, hijeh chun Ama luchung don tah'a inchung alhong chu aphevang un, langthipa chu alupna pumin a angsunga akhailha jeng tauvin ahi.
English: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

tcz: Atahsan uchu Yeshuan amun, langthipa jah achun, “Chapa, na chonset naho kingaidam ahitai,” ati.
en: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”
text:
MRK 2:5
Thadou: Atahsan uchu Yeshuan amun, langthipa jah achun, “Chapa, na chonset naho kingaidam ahitai,” ati.
English: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

tcz: Ahinlah danthu sun phabep khat chua touho chun alungthim uva,
en: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,
text:
MRK 2:6
Thadou: Ahinlah danthu sun phabep khat chua touho chun alungthim uva,
English: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

tcz: “Ibola hitia chu thu aseiham? Hiche hi kitaitomna ahi. Pathen bouvin chonset angaidam thei ahi!” tin agel un ahi.
en: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
text:
MRK 2:7
Thadou: “Ibola hitia chu thu aseiham? Hiche hi kitaitomna ahi. Pathen bouvin chonset angaidam thei ahi!” tin agel un ahi.
English: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

tcz: Alunguva ipi agelu chu Yeshuan ahepai jeng in ajah uvah, “Ibola lung opkai le lungboi nahi uvem?
en: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?
text:
MRK 2:8
Thadou: Alunguva ipi agelu chu Yeshuan ahepai jeng in ajah uvah, “Ibola lung opkai le lungboi nahi uvem?
English: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

tcz: Langthipa koma, ‘Na chonset naho kingaidama ahitai’ ti toh ‘Thouvin, nalupna pheh chu kichoi inlang lam jottan,’ ti chu hoijoh baijo ham?”
en: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?
text:
MRK 2:9
Thadou: Langthipa koma, ‘Na chonset naho kingaidama ahitai’ ti toh ‘Thouvin, nalupna pheh chu kichoi inlang lam jottan,’ ti chu hoijoh baijo ham?”
English: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?

tcz: Ahoi hita jongleh leiset chunga Mihem Chapan chonset ngaidamna thahat aneiye ti, nahetna diuva photchenna kavetsah ding nahiuve, ati.
en: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—
text:
MRK 2:10
Thadou: Ahoi hita jongleh leiset chunga Mihem Chapan chonset ngaidamna thahat aneiye ti, nahetna diuva photchenna kavetsah ding nahiuve, ati.
English: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—

tcz: Chuin langthipa lamah Yeshua akiheiyin, “Thouvin, nalupna pheh kichoiyin lang in lama chetan!” ati.
en: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”
text:
MRK 2:11
Thadou: Chuin langthipa lamah Yeshua akiheiyin, “Thouvin, nalupna pheh kichoiyin lang in lama chetan!” ati.
English: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”

tcz: Chutah chun langthipa chu akichom in, alupna pheh akilah-in japi lungdong ho mitmutah chun achedoh tai. Amaho chun kidang asalheh jeng un, “Hitobang himhim kamu kha pouve,” atiuvin Pathen avahchoi avahchoi tauve.
en: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”
text:
MRK 2:12
Thadou: Chutah chun langthipa chu akichom in, alupna pheh akilah-in japi lungdong ho mitmutah chun achedoh tai. Amaho chun kidang asalheh jeng un, “Hitobang himhim kamu kha pouve,” atiuvin Pathen avahchoi avahchoi tauve.
English: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

tcz: Chuin Yeshua apotdoh in dillen pangah achekit tan, chuah mipi ahenga hungho chu thu ahil e.
en: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.
text:
MRK 2:13
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua apotdoh in dillen pangah achekit tan, chuah mipi ahenga hungho chu thu ahil e.
English: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

tcz: Chuin achephei leh, Alphaeus chapa Levi chu akaidonna mun'a atou amun ahi. Hichun ajah a, “Neijuiyin lang kaseijui hitan,” atileh ama chu akipatdoh'in anung ajuitai.
en: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.
text:
MRK 2:14
Thadou: Chuin achephei leh, Alphaeus chapa Levi chu akaidonna mun'a atou amun ahi. Hichun ajah a, “Neijuiyin lang kaseijui hitan,” atileh ama chu akipatdoh'in anung ajuitai.
English: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.

tcz: Chujouvin Levin Yeshua leh aseijuite ain'a an nedin akouvin, chuleh kaidong ho le mi chonse ho tamtah jong akou than ahi. (Yeshua nungjui ho lah-a hitobang mi chu tamtah um ahi).
en: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.
text:
MRK 2:15
Thadou: Chujouvin Levin Yeshua leh aseijuite ain'a an nedin akouvin, chuleh kaidong ho le mi chonse ho tamtah jong akou than ahi. (Yeshua nungjui ho lah-a hitobang mi chu tamtah um ahi).
English: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

tcz: Dan thuhil ho lah-a Pharisee hon Yeshuan mi chonse holeh kaidong ho toh an aneh khom chu amu phat un, aseijuite jah-a, “Itidan a kaidong ho le mi chonse ho toh an aneh khom ham?” ati tauvin ahi.
en: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”
text:
MRK 2:16
Thadou: Dan thuhil ho lah-a Pharisee hon Yeshuan mi chonse holeh kaidong ho toh an aneh khom chu amu phat un, aseijuite jah-a, “Itidan a kaidong ho le mi chonse ho toh an aneh khom ham?” ati tauvin ahi.
English: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”

tcz: Hichu Yeshuan ajatan, hichun ajah uvah, “Atidam ten louthem angai pouve, adam louten bou angaiyui. Mi chonphate kouva hung kahipoi, lunghei dia mi chonsete kouva hungjoh kahi bouve,” atipeh un ahi.
en: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
text:
MRK 2:17
Thadou: Hichu Yeshuan ajatan, hichun ajah uvah, “Atidam ten louthem angai pouve, adam louten bou angaiyui. Mi chonphate kouva hung kahipoi, lunghei dia mi chonsete kouva hungjoh kahi bouve,” atipeh un ahi.
English: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

tcz: Khatvei John seijui holeh Pharisee hon an angol laiyun, mi phabep ahungun Yeshua jah-ah, “I-atileh John seijuiho le pharisee hon an angol jiuva, nangma seijui hon an angolji louham?” tin adong un,
en: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”
text:
MRK 2:18
Thadou: Khatvei John seijui holeh Pharisee hon an angol laiyun, mi phabep ahungun Yeshua jah-ah, “I-atileh John seijuiho le pharisee hon an angol jiuva, nangma seijui hon an angolji louham?” tin adong un,
English: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Mou loma chehon golnop anei laiyuva an angol jiuvem? Achutilou ding hetsa ahi. Moulang in aumpi laiseuva an angol lou diu ahi.
en: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.
text:
MRK 2:19
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Mou loma chehon golnop anei laiyuva an angol jiuvem? Achutilou ding hetsa ahi. Moulang in aumpi laiseuva an angol lou diu ahi.
English: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

tcz: Amavang moulang chu akomuva kon'a aki puimang ni hung lhung ding ahi—chuche nileh an angol diu ahi.
en: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.
text:
MRK 2:20
Thadou: Amavang moulang chu akomuva kon'a aki puimang ni hung lhung ding ahi—chuche nileh an angol diu ahi.
English: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

tcz: Chujongleh, koiyin pon thah hal chu ponluiya abeh ngaiyem? Beh taleh abehna joh chun kai ehjo cheh intin, athah joh chun alui chu akaiset ding ahi.
en: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.
text:
MRK 2:21
Thadou: Chujongleh, koiyin pon thah hal chu ponluiya abeh ngaiyem? Beh taleh abehna joh chun kai ehjo cheh intin, athah joh chun alui chu akaiset ding ahi.
English: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

tcz: Chule koiman Lengpitwi thah savun pengluiya akhum ngaipoi; achuti kibol leh alengpitwi chun asavun peng chu tumkeh intin, lengpitwi le savun peng akop a mang ding ahi. Lengpitwi thah chu peng thah-a akhumji bou uve,” ati.
en: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”
text:
MRK 2:22
Thadou: Chule koiman Lengpitwi thah savun pengluiya akhum ngaipoi; achuti kibol leh alengpitwi chun asavun peng chu tumkeh intin, lengpitwi le savun peng akop a mang ding ahi. Lengpitwi thah chu peng thah-a akhumji bou uve,” ati.
English: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

tcz: Cholngah ni khat hin Yeshuan buleilai ajot in ahileh, aseijui ten ache pum un changvui chu asih pan tauvin ahi.
en: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.
text:
MRK 2:23
Thadou: Cholngah ni khat hin Yeshuan buleilai ajot in ahileh, aseijui ten ache pum un changvui chu asih pan tauvin ahi.
English: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

tcz: Chuin Pharisee hon Yeshua jah-a, “Vetang, ibola Cholngah nia bolngai lou abol uham?” atiuve.
en: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”
text:
MRK 2:24
Thadou: Chuin Pharisee hon Yeshua jah-a, “Vetang, ibola Cholngah nia bolngai lou abol uham?” atiuve.
English: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “David le aloiho alhahsam uva agilkel pet'uva chu ipi-abolu nasim khah hih uvem?
en: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?
text:
MRK 2:25
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “David le aloiho alhahsam uva agilkel pet'uva chu ipi-abolu nasim khah hih uvem?
English: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?

tcz: Abiathar Thempu chungnung ahilaiyin Pathen in a alut in, Thempu tailou adang in aneh dia phal hilou changlhah ho chu anen, aloi ho jong apen ahi,” ati.
en: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”
text:
MRK 2:26
Thadou: Abiathar Thempu chungnung ahilaiyin Pathen in a alut in, Thempu tailou adang in aneh dia phal hilou changlhah ho chu anen, aloi ho jong apen ahi,” ati.
English: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”
