tcz: Yeshuan amaho jah-a aseipehben, Cholngah ni chu mihem dinga kisem ahi. Cholngahni dinga mihem kisemjoh ahipoi.
en: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
text:
MRK 2:27
Thadou: Yeshuan amaho jah-a aseipehben, Cholngah ni chu mihem dinga kisem ahi. Cholngahni dinga mihem kisemjoh ahipoi.
English: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

tcz: Hijeh chun, Mihem Chapa chu Pakai ahin, Cholngah ni Pakai jong ahi, ati.
en: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”
text:
MRK 2:28
Thadou: Hijeh chun, Mihem Chapa chu Pakai ahin, Cholngah ni Pakai jong ahi, ati.
English: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”

tcz: Yeshua Judah ho Pathen houna in'a achekit leh, hichea chun mi khutlang ngoi khat agamui.
en: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.
text:
MRK 3:1
Thadou: Yeshua Judah ho Pathen houna in'a achekit leh, hichea chun mi khutlang ngoi khat agamui.
English: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.

tcz: Hichu cholngah ni ahijeh'in amel maten, ahehset theina diu achanglhi jing uvin ahi. Khutlang ngoipa chu cholngahnia adamsah-a ahileh, themmo chan ding tohgon aneiyu ahi.
en: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.
text:
MRK 3:2
Thadou: Hichu cholngah ni ahijeh'in amel maten, ahehset theina diu achanglhi jing uvin ahi. Khutlang ngoipa chu cholngahnia adamsah-a ahileh, themmo chan ding tohgon aneiyu ahi.
English: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

tcz: Yeshuan khutlang ngoipa jah-a, “Hung in lang mipi masanga hung dingdoh-in,” atitai.
en: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”
text:
MRK 3:3
Thadou: Yeshuan khutlang ngoipa jah-a, “Hung in lang mipi masanga hung dingdoh-in,” atitai.
English: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”

tcz: Chuin Ama doudal le nelkal-ho lang ngan akiheiyin ajah-uva, “Cholngahnia thilpha bol ding danthun aphal em, ole ase bolna ding nikho ham? Hiche nikho hi hinna huhdoh nikho ham, suhmang nikho joh ham?” tia adoh leh, amahon adonbut tapouve.
en: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.
text:
MRK 3:4
Thadou: Chuin Ama doudal le nelkal-ho lang ngan akiheiyin ajah-uva, “Cholngahnia thilpha bol ding danthun aphal em, ole ase bolna ding nikho ham? Hiche nikho hi hinna huhdoh nikho ham, suhmang nikho joh ham?” tia adoh leh, amahon adonbut tapouve.
English: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.

tcz: Hichun Aman lunghangtah in amaho chu avekim velin, alungtah jeh'u chun phamo asalheh in ahi. Hichun khutlang ngoipa jah a, nakhut lhang in, atin chuin alhang in ahileh, akhut chu adamtan ahi.
en: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.
text:
MRK 3:5
Thadou: Hichun Aman lunghangtah in amaho chu avekim velin, alungtah jeh'u chun phamo asalheh in ahi. Hichun khutlang ngoipa jah a, nakhut lhang in, atin chuin alhang in ahileh, akhut chu adamtan ahi.
English: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

tcz: Chuin Pharisee ho chu apotdoh-un Ama suhmang theina ding angaito uvin, Herod solchah ho toh akihou toh tauvin ahi.
en: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
text:
MRK 3:6
Thadou: Chuin Pharisee ho chu apotdoh-un Ama suhmang theina ding angaito uvin, Herod solchah ho toh akihou toh tauvin ahi.
English: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

tcz: Yeshua aseijuite toh dil lama chun ache uvin, mihon tamtah'in ajuiyun ahi. Amaho chu Galilee le Judah gam'a kon,
en: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,
text:
MRK 3:7
Thadou: Yeshua aseijuite toh dil lama chun ache uvin, mihon tamtah'in ajuiyun ahi. Amaho chu Galilee le Judah gam'a kon,
English: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

tcz: Chule Jerusalem, Idumia, Solam Jordan luigala kon, Tyre le Sidon chunglam gam'a kon jong ahiuve. Athil bol kidang thuthanga kon in gamlatah tah'a kipan in ahung veuvin ahi.
en: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.
text:
MRK 3:8
Thadou: Chule Jerusalem, Idumia, Solam Jordan luigala kon, Tyre le Sidon chunglam gam'a kon jong ahiuve. Athil bol kidang thuthanga kon in gamlatah tah'a kipan in ahung veuvin ahi.
English: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

tcz: Yeshuan aseijuite asolin, mihonpin Ama lam ahin phutlou nadin kong gotsa-a akoi diuvin athuhil in ahi.
en: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.
text:
MRK 3:9
Thadou: Yeshuan aseijuite asolin, mihonpin Ama lam ahin phutlou nadin kong gotsa-a akoi diuvin athuhil in ahi.
English: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

tcz: Chuche nikho chun mi tamtah adamsah'in, hijeh chun adamlou ho chun Ama atohkhah theina ding un Ama lam chu ahin no tentun jeng un ahi.
en: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.
text:
MRK 3:10
Thadou: Chuche nikho chun mi tamtah adamsah'in, hijeh chun adamlou ho chun Ama atohkhah theina ding un Ama lam chu ahin no tentun jeng un ahi.
English: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

tcz: Lhagaoboh vop ho vang chun Ama amu chan un, tolsenan akineiyun, a-ang sunga abohkhup un, “Nangma Pathen Chapa chu nahi!” tin asam jiuve.
en: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”
text:
MRK 3:11
Thadou: Lhagaoboh vop ho vang chun Ama amu chan un, tolsenan akineiyun, a-ang sunga abohkhup un, “Nangma Pathen Chapa chu nahi!” tin asam jiuve.
English: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

tcz: Ahin Aman lhagao phalou ho chu Ama koi ahi aphondoh louna diuvin agih in ahi.
en: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.
text:
MRK 3:12
Thadou: Ahin Aman lhagao phalou ho chu Ama koi ahi aphondoh louna diuvin agih in ahi.
English: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

tcz: Chujouvin Yeshua molchunga akaltouvin, alhonpi dinga angaichat chengse chu akouvin, amahon jong ajuiyun ahi.
en: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.
text:
MRK 3:13
Thadou: Chujouvin Yeshua molchunga akaltouvin, alhonpi dinga angaichat chengse chu akouvin, amahon jong ajuiyun ahi.
English: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

tcz: Chuin mi somleni alhengdoh'in, asolchah dingin apansahtan ahi. Amaho chu Ama kilhonpi ding le thuhillhang le asollea pang ding ahiuvin,
en: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach
text:
MRK 3:14
Thadou: Chuin mi somleni alhengdoh'in, asolchah dingin apansahtan ahi. Amaho chu Ama kilhonpi ding le thuhillhang le asollea pang ding ahiuvin,
English: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach

tcz: Chuleh thilha ho nodoh theina thuneina jong apen ahi.
en: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:
text:
MRK 3:15
Thadou: Chuleh thilha ho nodoh theina thuneina jong apen ahi.
English: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

tcz: Hiche somleni alhen ho chu: Simon (Aman Peter asahpa chu),
en: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

tcz: James le John (Zebedee chapateni, Yeshuan, Boanerges (Van-ging chapate tina) tia amin aphohpehteni),
en: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

tcz: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James (Alphaeus chapa), Thaddaeus, Simon (mi kipum pehpa),
en: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

tcz: Judas Iscariot (Ama johdohpa); hicheng hi ahiuve.
en: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.
text:
MRK 3:19
Thadou: Judas Iscariot (Ama johdohpa); hicheng hi ahiuve.
English: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

tcz: Khatvei Yeshua in khat'a alut leh, mihonpi ahung kikhomkit tauve. Hijeh chun Ama le aseijuiten an nehphat tahbah jong aneithei tapouve.
en: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
text:
MRK 3:20
Thadou: Khatvei Yeshua in khat'a alut leh, mihonpi ahung kikhomkit tauve. Hijeh chun Ama le aseijuiten an nehphat tahbah jong aneithei tapouve.
English: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

tcz: Hichu ainkoten ajah phat uvin apuidoh dingin ahungui. “Ama hi angol a hita hi,” atitauve.
en: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”
text:
MRK 3:21
Thadou: Hichu ainkoten ajah phat uvin apuidoh dingin ahungui. “Ama hi angol a hita hi,” atitauve.
English: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

tcz: Jerusalem a kon'a hung danthu sunho ma jong chun, “Amahi thilhate lengpa, Satan in avop ahi. Ama a kon'a chu thilhate nodoh theina tha anei ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”
text:
MRK 3:22
Thadou: Jerusalem a kon'a hung danthu sunho ma jong chun, “Amahi thilhate lengpa, Satan in avop ahi. Ama a kon'a chu thilhate nodoh theina tha anei ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
English: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu akouvin, ahilchet na ding in, Satan in Satan iti anodoh thei ding ham?
en: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?
text:
MRK 3:23
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu akouvin, ahilchet na ding in, Satan in Satan iti anodoh thei ding ham?
English: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

tcz: “Lenggam khat amite kikhentel'a kidouto chu mahthah-a lhutei ding ahi.
en: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
text:
MRK 3:24
Thadou: “Lenggam khat amite kikhentel'a kidouto chu mahthah-a lhutei ding ahi.
English: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

tcz: Hibang chun insung kikhentel chu chehchaova dingdoh theilou ding ahi.
en: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
text:
MRK 3:25
Thadou: Hibang chun insung kikhentel chu chehchaova dingdoh theilou ding ahi.
English: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

tcz: Satan jong kisepkhen henlang ama le ama kidou taleh iti dingdet thei ding ham? Dingdoh joulouhel ding ahi.
en: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.
text:
MRK 3:26
Thadou: Satan jong kisepkhen henlang ama le ama kidou taleh iti dingdet thei ding ham? Dingdoh joulouhel ding ahi.
English: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

tcz: Seichenbe inge. Satan tobanga hat mi khat in'a chu koiham thanei tah'a galut'a chule aneiho gachom ding chu? Ama sanga hatjoa bou chun ama chu akantuma chutengle bou athil achomthei ding ahi.
en: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.
text:
MRK 3:27
Thadou: Seichenbe inge. Satan tobanga hat mi khat in'a chu koiham thanei tah'a galut'a chule aneiho gachom ding chu? Ama sanga hatjoa bou chun ama chu akantuma chutengle bou athil achomthei ding ahi.
English: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

tcz: Chule tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, itobang chonsetna le kitaitomna hijongle kingaidam thei ding ahi.
en: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

tcz: Amavang koihileh Lhagao Theng taitom vang chu imatih chan'a ngaidam changlou ding, hichu tonsot geiya ngaidam changlou ding chonsetna ahi,” ati.
en: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”
text:
MRK 3:29
Thadou: Amavang koihileh Lhagao Theng taitom vang chu imatih chan'a ngaidam changlou ding, hichu tonsot geiya ngaidam changlou ding chonsetna ahi,” ati.
English: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

tcz: Hicheho aseinajeh pentah chu amahon Ama chu, “Lhagao phalouvin avop ahi,” ati jeh-u ahi.
en: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”
text:
MRK 3:30
Thadou: Hicheho aseinajeh pentah chu amahon Ama chu, “Lhagao phalouvin avop ahi,” ati jeh-u ahi.
English: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

tcz: Chuin anu le asopite ahungun inpoah ading un, Ama ahungdoh-a ki houlimpi ding in thu athot'un ahi.
en: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.
text:
MRK 3:31
Thadou: Chuin anu le asopite ahungun inpoah ading un, Ama ahungdoh-a ki houlimpi ding in thu athot'un ahi.
English: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

tcz: Hipet chun mihonpi Yeshua kimvelin atou chahkheh-in, thupopa chun ajah-a, “Nanu le nasopite polamah aumun, nahin hol uve,” ahung tin ahi.
en: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”
text:
MRK 3:32
Thadou: Hipet chun mihonpi Yeshua kimvelin atou chahkheh-in, thupopa chun ajah-a, “Nanu le nasopite polamah aumun, nahin hol uve,” ahung tin ahi.
English: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Koiham kanu? Koiham kasopiteho?” ati.
en: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”
text:
MRK 3:33
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Koiham kanu? Koiham kasopiteho?” ati.
English: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

tcz: Chuin akimvela touho chu avegol in, “Ven, amaho hi kanu le kasopi ho ahiuve,”
en: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
text:
MRK 3:34
Thadou: Chuin akimvela touho chu avegol in, “Ven, amaho hi kanu le kasopi ho ahiuve,”
English: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

tcz: Koihileh Pathen lunglama chon hochu kasopipa, kasopinu chule kanu ahi, ati.
en: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”
text:
MRK 3:35
Thadou: Koihileh Pathen lunglama chon hochu kasopipa, kasopinu chule kanu ahi, ati.
English: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”

tcz: Avelin dil panga thu ahilpan kit tai. Mipi tamtah akoma ahung kikhom pai jeng un, Ama kong sunga aluttan ahi. Kong sunga chun atouvin, mipite chu vaokama atouvun ahi.
en: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.
text:
MRK 4:1
Thadou: Avelin dil panga thu ahilpan kit tai. Mipi tamtah akoma ahung kikhom pai jeng un, Ama kong sunga aluttan ahi. Kong sunga chun atouvin, mipite chu vaokama atouvun ahi.
English: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

tcz: Amaho chu thulem'in thu tamtah ahil in,
en: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,
text:
MRK 4:2
Thadou: Amaho chu thulem'in thu tamtah ahil in,
English: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

tcz: “Ngaiyun! Muchi thepa muchi then achen ahi.
en: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.
text:
MRK 4:3
Thadou: “Ngaiyun! Muchi thepa muchi then achen ahi.
English: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.

tcz: Athe atheleh abang lamsih-ah achun, hiho chu vachaten ahungloh un anegam tauvin ahi.
en: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.
text:
MRK 4:4
Thadou: Athe atheleh abang lamsih-ah achun, hiho chu vachaten ahungloh un anegam tauvin ahi.
English: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.

tcz: Chule abang songlheo chunga leipatna lah a achun, alei asalou jeh'in akehdoh jeng in,
en: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.
text:
MRK 4:5
Thadou: Chule abang songlheo chunga leipatna lah a achun, alei asalou jeh'in akehdoh jeng in,
English: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

tcz: Ahivang in nisan ahin kah phat in asang gon, jung aneilou jeh'in agoplha paitan ahi.
en: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
text:
MRK 4:6
Thadou: Ahivang in nisan ahin kah phat in asang gon, jung aneilou jeh'in agoplha paitan ahi.
English: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

tcz: Chule abang linglah-a achun, ling hochu ahung khang in chang phung dong nalaiho chu adep lihtan, ahinga aum tapoi.
en: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
text:
MRK 4:7
Thadou: Chule abang linglah-a achun, ling hochu ahung khang in chang phung dong nalaiho chu adep lihtan, ahinga aum tapoi.
English: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

tcz: Adang ho chu leiphalaiya achun, ahung khang in agatan, hiho chu ajat somthum, ajat somgup, ajat jakhat cheng in apungtan ahi!”
en: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”
text:
MRK 4:8
Thadou: Adang ho chu leiphalaiya achun, ahung khang in agatan, hiho chu ajat somthum, ajat somgup, ajat jakhat cheng in apungtan ahi!”
English: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”

tcz: Chuin Aman aseiyin, “Koihileh khojahna ding nakhang neiyin ngaihen,” ati.
en: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”
text:
MRK 4:9
Thadou: Chuin Aman aseiyin, “Koihileh khojahna ding nakhang neiyin ngaihen,” ati.
English: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin aseijui somleni ho toh akimvela mi dangho toh aum khom pet in, amahon athulem seiho chu ipi kiseina ham tin adong un.
en: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
text:
MRK 4:10
Thadou: Chomkhat jouvin aseijui somleni ho toh akimvela mi dangho toh aum khom pet in, amahon athulem seiho chu ipi kiseina ham tin adong un.
English: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

tcz: Aman adonbut in, “Pathen gam thuguh chu nangho kipea nahi tauve. Hinlah thulema kaseina jeh chu polam miho jah ding ahi,
en: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,
text:
MRK 4:11
Thadou: Aman adonbut in, “Pathen gam thuguh chu nangho kipea nahi tauve. Hinlah thulema kaseina jeh chu polam miho jah ding ahi,
English: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

tcz: Hichu Lekhabun aseisa agui lhunna ding: ‘Ka thilbol amu tengule, ima jildoh hetdoh aneilou diu. Ka thusei ajah tengule, ima hetdoh aneilou diu. Achutiloule keima lam'ah hung kiheiyuntin, ngaidam chang get unte,’ kiti chu ahi,” ati.
en: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”
text:
MRK 4:12
Thadou: Hichu Lekhabun aseisa agui lhunna ding: ‘Ka thilbol amu tengule, ima jildoh hetdoh aneilou diu. Ka thusei ajah tengule, ima hetdoh aneilou diu. Achutiloule keima lam'ah hung kiheiyuntin, ngaidam chang get unte,’ kiti chu ahi,” ati.
English: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

tcz: Abanin Yeshuan akomuva, “Nanghon hiche thulem hi nahetlou monguham? Achutile thulem dang jouse iti nahet tadiu vem?
en: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?
text:
MRK 4:13
Thadou: Abanin Yeshuan akomuva, “Nanghon hiche thulem hi nahetlou monguham? Achutile thulem dang jouse iti nahet tadiu vem?
English: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

tcz: Lou bolpan muchi athe chu Pathen thu midang koma kihil lhang tobang ahi.
en: The farmer sows the word.
text:
MRK 4:14
Thadou: Lou bolpan muchi athe chu Pathen thu midang koma kihil lhang tobang ahi.
English: The farmer sows the word.

tcz: Muchi kithe lamsih-a chuhon avetsah chu ahileh, Pathen thu ja-a ahivanga Satan in ahung kilhoh mang pai toh tekah ahi.
en: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.
text:
MRK 4:15
Thadou: Muchi kithe lamsih-a chuhon avetsah chu ahileh, Pathen thu ja-a ahivanga Satan in ahung kilhoh mang pai toh tekah ahi.
English: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

tcz: Songlheo chung leipatna lah-a chuhon avetsah chu, athu ajah jah-a thanomtah'a joppai jengho ahi.
en: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.
text:
MRK 4:16
Thadou: Songlheo chung leipatna lah-a chuhon avetsah chu, athu ajah jah-a thanomtah'a joppai jengho ahi.
English: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

tcz: Ahivang in amaho chu jung neilou ahi jeh-un, apangsot jouji pouve. Pathen thutahsan jeh'a boina le suhgimna ato tengule, jung aneilou jeh-uvin alhupaiji tauve.
en: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.
text:
MRK 4:17
Thadou: Ahivang in amaho chu jung neilou ahi jeh-un, apangsot jouji pouve. Pathen thutahsan jeh'a boina le suhgimna ato tengule, jung aneilou jeh-uvin alhupaiji tauve.
English: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

tcz: Ling lah a muchi kithehon avetsah chu Pathen thu ja a,
en: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,
text:
MRK 4:18
Thadou: Ling lah a muchi kithehon avetsah chu Pathen thu ja a,
English: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

tcz: Ahivanga leiset hinkho lungkhamna ten alodimsetna, haona lungthim chule thildang dang ngaichatnan thu chu adeplih jeh-a ga sodoh joulou tobang ahi.
en: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
text:
MRK 4:19
Thadou: Ahivanga leiset hinkho lungkhamna ten alodimsetna, haona lungthim chule thildang dang ngaichatnan thu chu adeplih jeh-a ga sodoh joulou tobang ahi.
English: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

tcz: Chule leipha laiya chuhon avetsah chu athu ja-a, hea jopte chu ahiuvin, abang ajat somthum, abang jat somgup chule abang ajat ja-a aga punsah beho ahiuve,” ati.
en: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”
text:
MRK 4:20
Thadou: Chule leipha laiya chuhon avetsah chu athu ja-a, hea jopte chu ahiuvin, abang ajat somthum, abang jat somgup chule abang ajat ja-a aga punsah beho ahiuve,” ati.
English: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah uva, “Koiyin meivah khu lo sung le jalkhun noiya atun ngaiyem? Koiman bolponte! Meivah chu avah hoiselna ding muna aki tungjin ahi.
en: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?
text:
MRK 4:21
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan ajah uva, “Koiyin meivah khu lo sung le jalkhun noiya atun ngaiyem? Koiman bolponte! Meivah chu avah hoiselna ding muna aki tungjin ahi.
English: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh thil kiselguh chengse chu achaina leh kiphongdoh ding, chuleh akiselguh jouse chu vahdoh ding ahi.
en: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.
text:
MRK 4:22
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itileh thil kiselguh chengse chu achaina leh kiphongdoh ding, chuleh akiselguh jouse chu vahdoh ding ahi.
English: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.

tcz: Koihileh khojahna ding nakhang neiyin ngaihen,” ati.
en: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”
text:
MRK 4:23
Thadou: Koihileh khojahna ding nakhang neiyin ngaihen,” ati.
English: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”

tcz: Chuin ajah uva, “Najah chengseu chu lungluttah in ngaiyun. Phataha nangai chan uva, hetgilna nakipe diu ahi—chule kipehbe dingbon nahiuve.
en: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.
text:
MRK 4:24
Thadou: Chuin ajah uva, “Najah chengseu chu lungluttah in ngaiyun. Phataha nangai chan uva, hetgilna nakipe diu ahi—chule kipehbe dingbon nahiuve.
English: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.

tcz: Koihileh kathuhil ngaiho chu hetbena kipehbe ding, ahinlah koihileh kathuhil ngailou chu ahetsa themkhat jong amahoa kon'a kilahmang peh ding ahi,” ati.
en: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”
text:
MRK 4:25
Thadou: Koihileh kathuhil ngaiho chu hetbena kipehbe ding, ahinlah koihileh kathuhil ngailou chu ahetsa themkhat jong amahoa kon'a kilahmang peh ding ahi,” ati.
English: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

tcz: Yeshuan ajah uva, “Pathen gam umdol chu loubolmi khat'in leiya muchi athe tobang ahi.
en: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,
text:
MRK 4:26
Thadou: Yeshuan ajah uva, “Pathen gam umdol chu loubolmi khat'in leiya muchi athe tobang ahi.
English: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

tcz: Asun ajan'a a-imut pet chuleh aha pet hijongleh, amuchi the chu ahung kehdoh-in, akhanglen in, hinlah aman hitia chu thil iti hung umdoh ham ahepoi.
en: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.
text:
MRK 4:27
Thadou: Asun ajan'a a-imut pet chuleh aha pet hijongleh, amuchi the chu ahung kehdoh-in, akhanglen in, hinlah aman hitia chu thil iti hung umdoh ham ahepoi.
English: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.

tcz: Leiset'in acham in ahin gadohsah jin, amasapen in avui ahung dondoh in, chuteng achaina leh ahung gadoh in aminji tai.
en: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
text:
MRK 4:28
Thadou: Leiset'in acham in ahin gadohsah jin, amasapen in avui ahung dondoh in, chuteng achaina leh ahung gadoh in aminji tai.
English: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

tcz: Aga chu amin phatleh, a atphat ahitah jeh'in loubolpa achen, koiten a atpai jitai,” ati.
en: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
text:
MRK 4:29
Thadou: Aga chu amin phatleh, a atphat ahitah jeh'in loubolpa achen, koiten a atpai jitai,” ati.
English: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

tcz: Yeshuan aseiben, “Pathen gam hi ipitoh kitekah ding hitam? Ipi thulema ka hilchet ding hitam?
en: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?
text:
MRK 4:30
Thadou: Yeshuan aseiben, “Pathen gam hi ipitoh kitekah ding hitam? Ipi thulema ka hilchet ding hitam?
English: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

tcz: Ankam mu chang leiya kithe tobang ahi, hichu muchi lah-a aneopen ahi.
en: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,
text:
MRK 4:31
Thadou: Ankam mu chang leiya kithe tobang ahi, hichu muchi lah-a aneopen ahi.
English: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

tcz: Ahivang in ahung kedoh tengleh hampa dang jouse sangin alenjon, abah lentah jong ahin sodoh jin, chutichun chunga leng vachate abah lim noiya ahung geh jiuvin ahi,” ati.
en: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”
text:
MRK 4:32
Thadou: Ahivang in ahung kedoh tengleh hampa dang jouse sangin alenjon, abah lentah jong ahin sodoh jin, chutichun chunga leng vachate abah lim noiya ahung geh jiuvin ahi,” ati.
English: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

tcz: Chuin chutobang thulem tamtah mangchan amahon ahetthei diu kham thu ahil e.
en: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
text:
MRK 4:33
Thadou: Chuin chutobang thulem tamtah mangchan amahon ahetthei diu kham thu ahil e.
English: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

tcz: Mihonpi jah-a thulem tilouvin imacha aseikhapoi. Ahinla aseijuite chengse vang chu guhthimin ijakai ahilchen jinai.
en: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
text:
MRK 4:34
Thadou: Mihonpi jah-a thulem tilouvin imacha aseikhapoi. Ahinla aseijuite chengse vang chu guhthimin ijakai ahilchen jinai.
English: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

tcz: Chuin nilhah in Yeshuan aseijuite koma, “Hung un, dil khu agal langa galkaiyu hite,” ati.
en: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”
text:
MRK 4:35
Thadou: Chuin nilhah in Yeshuan aseijuite koma, “Hung un, dil khu agal langa galkaiyu hite,” ati.
English: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

tcz: Chuti chun mihonpi chu adalha uvin, Yeshua chu konga akitolpi tauvin, kong dang phabep'in vang ahinjuiyun ahi.
en: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.
text:
MRK 4:36
Thadou: Chuti chun mihonpi chu adalha uvin, Yeshua chu konga akitolpi tauvin, kong dang phabep'in vang ahinjuiyun ahi.
English: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

tcz: Chuin khopi hui ahung nung in ahileh, twi kinong chu kong sunga ahung kinonglut matchet jeng tan, adimpai ding ahitan ahi.
en: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.
text:
MRK 4:37
Thadou: Chuin khopi hui ahung nung in ahileh, twi kinong chu kong sunga ahung kinonglut matchet jeng tan, adimpai ding ahitan ahi.
English: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

tcz: Apet chun Yeshua chu kong mei lama lukhap kikhap'in ana ihmun, aseijuiten asukhang'un ajah-a, “Houhil, kalhummang gam dingu hi imalouva nagel ham?” atitauve.
en: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”
text:
MRK 4:38
Thadou: Apet chun Yeshua chu kong mei lama lukhap kikhap'in ana ihmun, aseijuiten asukhang'un ajah-a, “Houhil, kalhummang gam dingu hi imalouva nagel ham?” atitauve.
English: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

tcz: Yeshua akhah phat'in huipi chu aphoh-in, twi-nong jah-a, “Thipmin! Thipchet in!” tia thu apeh leh, apettah'in huipi chu athipchet jeng tan, kho aphaseltan ahi.
en: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.
text:
MRK 4:39
Thadou: Yeshua akhah phat'in huipi chu aphoh-in, twi-nong jah-a, “Thipmin! Thipchet in!” tia thu apeh leh, apettah'in huipi chu athipchet jeng tan, kho aphaseltan ahi.
English: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

tcz: Chuin Aman ajah uva, “Ibola nakichat uham? Tahsanna nanei nailou uham?” atitai.
en: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”
text:
MRK 4:40
Thadou: Chuin Aman ajah uva, “Ibola nakichat uham? Tahsanna nanei nailou uham?” atitai.
English: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

tcz: Seijui ho chu akithing jeng tauvin, “Hichepa hi koi mongmong hiya, huipi le twi-nongin jong athu angai ahitadem?” tin aki dongto tauvin ahi.
en: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
text:
MRK 4:41
Thadou: Seijui ho chu akithing jeng tauvin, “Hichepa hi koi mongmong hiya, huipi le twi-nongin jong athu angai ahitadem?” tin aki dongto tauvin ahi.
English: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

tcz: Chuti chun dil gal langkhat lama, Gerasene gam agalkai tauvin ahi.
en: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
text:
MRK 5:1
Thadou: Chuti chun dil gal langkhat lama, Gerasene gam agalkai tauvin ahi.
English: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

tcz: Konga pat Yeshua ahung potleh, lhan'a konin lhagaoboh vop khat'in ahung kimupin ahi.
en: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.
text:
MRK 5:2
Thadou: Konga pat Yeshua ahung potleh, lhan'a konin lhagaoboh vop khat'in ahung kimupin ahi.
English: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

tcz: Ama chu lhanmol'a cheng ahin, koiman atuhtang joulou, thih khaova jong ahen joulou-u ahi.
en: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,
text:
MRK 5:3
Thadou: Ama chu lhanmol'a cheng ahin, koiman atuhtang joulou, thih khaova jong ahen joulou-u ahi.
English: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

tcz: Bul atuhsah uva thih khaova jong ahen ji vang un thih khao chu asattan jin, bul chu atumkeh jin, koima chan abolngoi jou louhel ahitai.
en: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.
text:
MRK 5:4
Thadou: Bul atuhsah uva thih khaova jong ahen ji vang un thih khao chu asattan jin, bul chu atumkeh jin, koima chan abolngoi jou louhel ahitai.
English: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

tcz: Sunle jan in lhan mola chun aumin chule molchunga a-aole a-aolejin, songhem in ama aki-at chen jin ahi.
en: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.
text:
MRK 5:5
Thadou: Sunle jan in lhan mola chun aumin chule molchunga a-aole a-aolejin, songhem in ama aki-at chen jin ahi.
English: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

tcz: Gal a pat'in Yeshua ahin mun, ahung lhaijel in a-angah abohkhup in ahi.
en: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,
text:
MRK 5:6
Thadou: Gal a pat'in Yeshua ahin mun, ahung lhaijel in a-angah abohkhup in ahi.
English: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

tcz: “Pathen chungnungpen Chapa Yeshua, ipi dinga neihung suhboi got ham? Pathen min'a nahenga katao ahi, neibolgim hih-in,” tin apeng jeng tai.
en: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”
text:
MRK 5:7
Thadou: “Pathen chungnungpen Chapa Yeshua, ipi dinga neihung suhboi got ham? Pathen min'a nahenga katao ahi, neibolgim hih-in,” tin apeng jeng tai.
English: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ajah-a, “Mipa-a kon chun hung potdoh in, nang lhagao boh,” tin ano tai.
en: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”
text:
MRK 5:8
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan ajah-a, “Mipa-a kon chun hung potdoh in, nang lhagao boh,” tin ano tai.
English: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”

tcz: Chuin, “Namin ipiham?” tia adohleh, aman adonbut in, “Tamtah kahi jeh'un kamin Janel ahi,” ati.
en: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”
text:
MRK 5:9
Thadou: Chuin, “Namin ipiham?” tia adohleh, aman adonbut in, “Tamtah kahi jeh'un kamin Janel ahi,” ati.
English: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

tcz: Chuin chuche gamkai sunga kon'a nodoh ahilouna ding un Yeshua henga hataovin ataotan ahi.
en: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
text:
MRK 5:10
Thadou: Chuin chuche gamkai sunga kon'a nodoh ahilouna ding un Yeshua henga hataovin ataotan ahi.
English: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

tcz: Hiche mun lhang pang khat'a chu voh hon tamtah kilha-a ahi.
en: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.
text:
MRK 5:11
Thadou: Hiche mun lhang pang khat'a chu voh hon tamtah kilha-a ahi.
English: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

tcz: Janelte chun, “Voh hon lah-a kaluttheina ding un neisol un,” tin athum tauve.
en: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”
text:
MRK 5:12
Thadou: Janelte chun, “Voh hon lah-a kaluttheina ding un neisol un,” tin athum tauve.
English: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

tcz: Yeshuan jong aphalpeh tan, lhagaoboh ho chu ahung potdoh-un vohcha ho sunga chun alut tauvin, hichun vohcha sangni jen chu halhaiyin alhaiyun, kol ah alhai lhauvin dil ah alhalut'un, twi lah-a chun alhumgam tauvin ahi.
en: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.
text:
MRK 5:13
Thadou: Yeshuan jong aphalpeh tan, lhagaoboh ho chu ahung potdoh-un vohcha ho sunga chun alut tauvin, hichun vohcha sangni jen chu halhaiyin alhaiyun, kol ah alhai lhauvin dil ah alhalut'un, twi lah-a chun alhumgam tauvin ahi.
English: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

tcz: Chuin ganching ho chu ajam un, khopi sung le loujaovah athu chu aseile tauvin ahi. Mipi chun ipi tidan hitam tin ave dingin ahung lhaipheiyun ahi.
en: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.
text:
MRK 5:14
Thadou: Chuin ganching ho chu ajam un, khopi sung le loujaovah athu chu aseile tauvin ahi. Mipi chun ipi tidan hitam tin ave dingin ahung lhaipheiyun ahi.
English: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua kom ahung lhun un, thilha Janel voppa chun pon akisila chule lunglima anatou chu amuvin akicha lheh jeng uve.
en: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.
text:
MRK 5:15
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua kom ahung lhun un, thilha Janel voppa chun pon akisila chule lunglima anatou chu amuvin akicha lheh jeng uve.
English: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

tcz: Chuin thilha voppa leh vohcha ho umchan achen achaiya mua hetoh hon thil umje chu aseipeh tauve.
en: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.
text:
MRK 5:16
Thadou: Chuin thilha voppa leh vohcha ho umchan achen achaiya mua hetoh hon thil umje chu aseipeh tauve.
English: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

tcz: Hichun amahon Yeshua chu agamsung uva kon'a potdoh ding in ahenga atao uvin ahi.
en: They began to beg him to depart from their region.
text:
MRK 5:17
Thadou: Hichun amahon Yeshua chu agamsung uva kon'a potdoh ding in ahenga atao uvin ahi.
English: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

tcz: Chuin konga alut konin masanga thilha voppa chun ama toh kilhon khom dingin angeh tai.
en: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.
text:
MRK 5:18
Thadou: Chuin konga alut konin masanga thilha voppa chun ama toh kilhon khom dingin angeh tai.
English: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

tcz: Ahivang in Yeshuan ajadan ajah a, “Na in a chen lang nain kote henga Pakaiyin itobang thil loupi nabolpeh a, iti nakhoto'em abonchan gaseitan,” atipeh tai.
en: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”
text:
MRK 5:19
Thadou: Ahivang in Yeshuan ajadan ajah a, “Na in a chen lang nain kote henga Pakaiyin itobang thil loupi nabolpeh a, iti nakhoto'em abonchan gaseitan,” atipeh tai.
English: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”

tcz: Chuin amapa chu akipatdoh in Decapolis (Khopi som) jousea Yeshuan thil lentah abolpeh chu lhangphong tah'in aseile pantai. Mijousen kidang asa lheh jeng un ahi.
en: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
text:
MRK 5:20
Thadou: Chuin amapa chu akipatdoh in Decapolis (Khopi som) jousea Yeshuan thil lentah abolpeh chu lhangphong tah'in aseile pantai. Mijousen kidang asa lheh jeng un ahi.
English: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua konga akitol in agal langkhat alhung in, hiachun mi honpi tamtah ahenga ahung kikhom un ahi.
en: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.
text:
MRK 5:21
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua konga akitol in agal langkhat alhung in, hiachun mi honpi tamtah ahenga ahung kikhom un ahi.
English: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.

tcz: Hichun kikhopna in'a vaipo holah-a mi khat, amin Jairus chu ahung in, Yeshua amu phat in akengbulah abohkhup in,
en: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet
text:
MRK 5:22
Thadou: Hichun kikhopna in'a vaipo holah-a mi khat, amin Jairus chu ahung in, Yeshua amu phat in akengbulah abohkhup in,
English: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet

tcz: “Kachanu khangdongcha thiding dinmun'in aumtan, lungset in hung in lang achunga nakhut hung ngam in lang, ahinna ding in neijen dampeh-in,” tin ahung taove.
en: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”
text:
MRK 5:23
Thadou: “Kachanu khangdongcha thiding dinmun'in aumtan, lungset in hung in lang achunga nakhut hung ngam in lang, ahinna ding in neijen dampeh-in,” tin ahung taove.
English: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”

tcz: Chuin Ama chutoh akilhon pheiyin, mi honpin jong ahin juiyun, atom lellul jeng un ahi.
en: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.
text:
MRK 5:24
Thadou: Chuin Ama chutoh akilhon pheiyin, mi honpin jong ahin juiyun, atom lellul jeng un ahi.
English: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

tcz: Hikahlah chun numei khat jong kumsom le kumni athi longa damlou aum in ahi.
en: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,
text:
MRK 5:25
Thadou: Hikahlah chun numei khat jong kumsom le kumni athi longa damlou aum in ahi.
English: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,

tcz: Louthem tamtah akivetsahna-a sum le pai anei jouse sumang jouva ahitan, imala phachom louvin khoh chehcheh a um ahi.
en: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,
text:
MRK 5:26
Thadou: Louthem tamtah akivetsahna-a sum le pai anei jouse sumang jouva ahitan, imala phachom louvin khoh chehcheh a um ahi.
English: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

tcz: Amanu chun Yeshua thudol anajan, hijeh chun mi honpi lah achun ahung in Yeshua pon mong chu ahung tham tai.
en: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.
text:
MRK 5:27
Thadou: Amanu chun Yeshua thudol anajan, hijeh chun mi honpi lah achun ahung in Yeshua pon mong chu ahung tham tai.
English: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.

tcz: Amanu chu aki ngaiton, “Apon jengjong hi thamleng dam nange,” ti atahsan ahi.
en: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”
text:
MRK 5:28
Thadou: Amanu chu aki ngaiton, “Apon jengjong hi thamleng dam nange,” ti atahsan ahi.
English: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

tcz: Chomloukah'in athiput chu akang in atang jeng tan, anat thoh lel a kon aol leh adamdoh dan chu atichunga akihettan ahi.
en: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
text:
MRK 5:29
Thadou: Chomloukah'in athiput chu akang in atang jeng tan, anat thoh lel a kon aol leh adamdoh dan chu atichunga akihettan ahi.
English: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

tcz: Chutah chun Yeshuan atichunga kon'a amidamsahna tha apotdoh chu akihet in, hichun mipi lah-a chun akihei kimvelin, “Kapon thama chu koiham?” tin adongtai.
en: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
text:
MRK 5:30
Thadou: Chutah chun Yeshuan atichunga kon'a amidamsahna tha apotdoh chu akihet in, hichun mipi lah-a chun akihei kimvelin, “Kapon thama chu koiham?” tin adongtai.
English: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

tcz: Aseijuiten ajah-a, “Mipi hijat'in naneh le jeng uva, itidan'a, ‘Koiham eithama?’ tia dohna nabol ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
text:
MRK 5:31
Thadou: Aseijuiten ajah-a, “Mipi hijat'in naneh le jeng uva, itidan'a, ‘Koiham eithama?’ tia dohna nabol ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

tcz: Hinlah Aman chuche bol a chu mudohna dingin avelen ahi.
en: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.
text:
MRK 5:32
Thadou: Hinlah Aman chuche bol a chu mudohna dingin avelen ahi.
English: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

tcz: Amanu chun achunga thilsoh chu ahen, kicha sasan kihot pum in ahung in a-angah abohkhup in, ama ahi akiseidohtai.
en: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
text:
MRK 5:33
Thadou: Amanu chun achunga thilsoh chu ahen, kicha sasan kihot pum in ahung in a-angah abohkhup in, ama ahi akiseidohtai.
English: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah a, “Boinu, natahsan in nadamsah ahitai. Lungmong in chetan. Na thohnatna chu kichai ahitai,” ati.
en: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”
text:
MRK 5:34
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan ajah a, “Boinu, natahsan in nadamsah ahitai. Lungmong in chetan. Na thohnatna chu kichai ahitai,” ati.
English: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

tcz: Amanu koma thu asei jinglaiyin, thupole khat Jairus in'a konin ahung in, “Nachanu athitai. Houhil hi kisahboisah ngaitaponte,” tin Jairus komah ahung seiye.
en: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”
text:
MRK 5:35
Thadou: Amanu koma thu asei jinglaiyin, thupole khat Jairus in'a konin ahung in, “Nachanu athitai. Houhil hi kisahboisah ngaitaponte,” tin Jairus komah ahung seiye.
English: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

tcz: Aki hounau chu Yeshuan ajatan, Jairus koma chun, “Kicha hih-in, tahsan poupoutan,” ati.
en: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”
text:
MRK 5:36
Thadou: Aki hounau chu Yeshuan ajatan, Jairus koma chun, “Kicha hih-in, tahsan poupoutan,” ati.
English: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”

tcz: Chuin Peter, James le John (James naopa), hicheng tailou midang koiman ajuiding ajadan akijuisah poi.
en: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
text:
MRK 5:37
Thadou: Chuin Peter, James le John (James naopa), hicheng tailou midang koiman ajuiding ajadan akijuisah poi.
English: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

tcz: Kikhopna in vaihompa, Jairus in alhun'u chun, mihonpi chu anapoh cheichoi jeng un, kap le maova aum'u chu Yeshuan amun ahi.
en: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.
text:
MRK 5:38
Thadou: Kikhopna in vaihompa, Jairus in alhun'u chun, mihonpi chu anapoh cheichoi jeng un, kap le maova aum'u chu Yeshuan amun ahi.
English: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

tcz: Chuin ama alut'in ajah uva, “Ibola hitia hi napo cheichoiyuva nakau ham? Chapangnu chu athi ahipoi, aihmu ahibouve,” ati.
en: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”
text:
MRK 5:39
Thadou: Chuin ama alut'in ajah uva, “Ibola hitia hi napo cheichoiyuva nakau ham? Chapangnu chu athi ahipoi, aihmu ahibouve,” ati.
English: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”

tcz: Thi op mi honpi chun anuisat uve. Hichun aboncha uvin asoldohsoh in, chapangnu nu le pa toh chule ahin kilhonpi seijui thum ho chengsetoh chapangnu umna'a chun alut un ahi.
en: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.
text:
MRK 5:40
Thadou: Thi op mi honpi chun anuisat uve. Hichun aboncha uvin asoldohsoh in, chapangnu nu le pa toh chule ahin kilhonpi seijui thum ho chengsetoh chapangnu umna'a chun alut un ahi.
English: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

tcz: Chuin chapangnu khut chu atuh in, “Talitha koum,” atin ahi. Hichu “Boinu, kithouvin!” tina ahi.
en: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”
text:
MRK 5:41
Thadou: Chuin chapangnu khut chu atuh in, “Talitha koum,” atin ahi. Hichu “Boinu, kithouvin!” tina ahi.
English: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”

tcz: Chupettah chun chapangnu chu ahung thouvin, ading in lam ajotpai jeng tai. Amanu chu kum som le ni bou ahina laiye. Chutah chun amaho chun kidang asa lheh jeng un.
en: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.
text:
MRK 5:42
Thadou: Chupettah chun chapangnu chu ahung thouvin, ading in lam ajotpai jeng tai. Amanu chu kum som le ni bou ahina laiye. Chutah chun amaho chun kidang asa lheh jeng un.
English: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

tcz: Hiche thuhi koima ahetsah louna diuvin Yeshuan akhamgah in, chule amanun aneh ding an apeh diuvin thu apen ahi.
en: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.
text:
MRK 5:43
Thadou: Hiche thuhi koima ahetsah louna diuvin Yeshuan akhamgah in, chule amanun aneh ding an apeh diuvin thu apen ahi.
English: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

tcz: Chuin chua kon chun Yeshua ache doh'in, achenna Nazareth lama aseijuite toh ache tan ahi.
en: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.
text:
MRK 6:1
Thadou: Chuin chua kon chun Yeshua ache doh'in, achenna Nazareth lama aseijuite toh ache tan ahi.
English: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

tcz: Cholngahni ahung hi phat in Judah ho kikhopna in'ah thu ahil pan in, chuin athu hil chu mi tamtah ajaho chun kidang asa uvin, “Hichepa hin hoiya kon'a chihna le thibol theina hi chengpi hi akilah ahitadem?” atiuvin ahi.
en: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?
text:
MRK 6:2
Thadou: Cholngahni ahung hi phat in Judah ho kikhopna in'ah thu ahil pan in, chuin athu hil chu mi tamtah ajaho chun kidang asa uvin, “Hichepa hin hoiya kon'a chihna le thibol theina hi chengpi hi akilah ahitadem?” atiuvin ahi.
English: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

tcz: Chuin nuisat toh atho uvin, “Ama hi thingthem bol maimai, Mary chapa, chule James, Joseph (Joses), Juda le Simon sopipa ahibouve. Chule asopi numei ho jong ilah uva acheng uve,” atiuvin ahi. Amaho chu alung-u adong in ahivang in atahsan nom pouvin ahi.
en: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.
text:
MRK 6:3
Thadou: Chuin nuisat toh atho uvin, “Ama hi thingthem bol maimai, Mary chapa, chule James, Joseph (Joses), Juda le Simon sopipa ahibouve. Chule asopi numei ho jong ilah uva acheng uve,” atiuvin ahi. Amaho chu alung-u adong in ahivang in atahsan nom pouvin ahi.
English: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in ajah uva, “Themgao chu ama achenna gamsung le ainkote lah chule ama insung tailouvin mun dang jousea jabolna achang jin ahi,” ati.
en: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”
text:
MRK 6:4
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in ajah uva, “Themgao chu ama achenna gamsung le ainkote lah chule ama insung tailouvin mun dang jousea jabolna achang jin ahi,” ati.
English: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”

tcz: Chukoma miten atahsan lou jeh'un ana damlou phabep khat chunga, akhut angapma adamsah tailou chun thil kidang ima abol thei tapoi.
en: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.
text:
MRK 6:5
Thadou: Chukoma miten atahsan lou jeh'un ana damlou phabep khat chunga, akhut angapma adamsah tailou chun thil kidang ima abol thei tapoi.
English: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

tcz: Atahsan lou dan'u chu adatmo lheh jeng e. Chuin kho anai dunga achelen thu ahil-le tai.
en: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.
text:
MRK 6:6
Thadou: Atahsan lou dan'u chu adatmo lheh jeng e. Chuin kho anai dunga achelen thu ahil-le tai.
English: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

tcz: Chuin aseijui somleni ho chu akouvin, lhagaoboh chunga thaneina apen, chujouvin mi ni-nin asoldoh tai.
en: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
text:
MRK 6:7
Thadou: Chuin aseijui somleni ho chu akouvin, lhagaoboh chunga thaneina apen, chujouvin mi ni-nin asoldoh tai.
English: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

tcz: Chule ajin nauva tenggol tailou ima dang, changlhah jong, sakhao jong, dangka dip sunga sum them jong—aken louhel diuvin thu apei.
en: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,
text:
MRK 6:8
Thadou: Chule ajin nauva tenggol tailou ima dang, changlhah jong, sakhao jong, dangka dip sunga sum them jong—aken louhel diuvin thu apei.
English: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

tcz: Kengchot vang akise uva, sangkhol thoni vang aki ahlou diuvin aseipeh in ahi.
en: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.
text:
MRK 6:9
Thadou: Kengchot vang akise uva, sangkhol thoni vang aki ahlou diuvin aseipeh in ahi.
English: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

tcz: “Hoikom hijongle nachena chan uva, nalhun lhunnau in'a chun, khosung na potdoh kahse uvin umun.
en: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.
text:
MRK 6:10
Thadou: “Hoikom hijongle nachena chan uva, nalhun lhunnau in'a chun, khosung na potdoh kahse uvin umun.
English: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

tcz: Ahinlah koi kho hileh nahin lhunsah lou uleh, nathu seiyu ngailou khomite nadalhah tenguleh, dalhah ahitauve ti ahettohsah nan nakeng phang uva agam leivui chu thinglha uvin,” tin thu apei.
en: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”
text:
MRK 6:11
Thadou: Ahinlah koi kho hileh nahin lhunsah lou uleh, nathu seiyu ngailou khomite nadalhah tenguleh, dalhah ahitauve ti ahettohsah nan nakeng phang uva agam leivui chu thinglha uvin,” tin thu apei.
English: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

tcz: Chuti chun akipatdoh un, mihemten lunghei ding ahi ti chu ahil lhangle uvin,
en: They went out and preached that people should repent.
text:
MRK 6:12
Thadou: Chuti chun akipatdoh un, mihemten lunghei ding ahi ti chu ahil lhangle uvin,
English: They went out and preached that people should repent.

tcz: Thilha tamtah jong anodoh'un, ana damlou tamtah jong thao anu uvin aboldam un ahi.
en: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.
text:
MRK 6:13
Thadou: Thilha tamtah jong anodoh'un, ana damlou tamtah jong thao anu uvin aboldam un ahi.
English: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.

tcz: Yeshua min gamtina akithan tah jeh chun, Leng Herod Antipas in hiti thu chu ajatan, mi phabep in, “Ama hi John Baptist athia kon'a thoudoh kit hinte. Hijeh'a chu thil kidang boltheina anei ahi,” tin aseiji uve.
en: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”
text:
MRK 6:14
Thadou: Yeshua min gamtina akithan tah jeh chun, Leng Herod Antipas in hiti thu chu ajatan, mi phabep in, “Ama hi John Baptist athia kon'a thoudoh kit hinte. Hijeh'a chu thil kidang boltheina anei ahi,” tin aseiji uve.
English: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”

tcz: Loikhat in, “Themgao Elijah ahi,” atiuvin, loikhat kit chun, “Malai themgao minthang ho banga themgao khat ahi,” atiuve.
en: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”
text:
MRK 6:15
Thadou: Loikhat in, “Themgao Elijah ahi,” atiuvin, loikhat kit chun, “Malai themgao minthang ho banga themgao khat ahi,” atiuve.
English: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”

tcz: Herod'in Yeshua chung thu ajah phat in, “Alu katansa John chu athia kon'a hung thoukit hinante,” ati.
en: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”
text:
MRK 6:16
Thadou: Herod'in Yeshua chung thu ajah phat in, “Alu katansa John chu athia kon'a hung thoukit hinante,” ati.
English: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh Herod in anaopa Philip jinu Herodias chu aki chenpi ahin, amanu jal'a chu ama tah'in mi asola John chu amatsah a, akan'a songkula akhum ahi.
en: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.
text:
MRK 6:17
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itileh Herod in anaopa Philip jinu Herodias chu aki chenpi ahin, amanu jal'a chu ama tah'in mi asola John chu amatsah a, akan'a songkula akhum ahi.
English: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.

tcz: John chun Herod jah a, “Nasopi ji jia naneiya naki chenpi hi dan ngai ahipoi,” anatin ahi.
en: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
text:
MRK 6:18
Thadou: John chun Herod jah a, “Nasopi ji jia naneiya naki chenpi hi dan ngai ahipoi,” anatin ahi.
English: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

tcz: Hiche jeh'a chu Herodias chun ama chu hahot in ahot in, tha ding in atup in, ahivanginla Herod phalna louvin abol theipon ahi.
en: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,
text:
MRK 6:19
Thadou: Hiche jeh'a chu Herodias chun ama chu hahot in ahot in, tha ding in atup in, ahivanginla Herod phalna louvin abol theipon ahi.
English: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh Herod chun John chu michon phatah le mithengtah ahi ti chu ahet jeh'in ajabolin, chuleh avesuiyin ahi. Herod'in John ahoulimpi teng ahimo ji lheh in, ahijeng vang'in, athusei angainom kit jin ahi.
en: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.
text:
MRK 6:20
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itileh Herod chun John chu michon phatah le mithengtah ahi ti chu ahet jeh'in ajabolin, chuleh avesuiyin ahi. Herod'in John ahoulimpi teng ahimo ji lheh in, ahijeng vang'in, athusei angainom kit jin ahi.
English: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

tcz: Hinlah Herodias in phat gomkom anga jing chu Herod pen nikho chun ahung lhung tai. Chuche nikhoa chun gamvaipo natong alen alal ho, galsat-thalchoi lamkai ho chule Galilee gam'a milun ho chengse vahnan golvah abolin ahi.
en: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.
text:
MRK 6:21
Thadou: Hinlah Herodias in phat gomkom anga jing chu Herod pen nikho chun ahung lhung tai. Chuche nikhoa chun gamvaipo natong alen alal ho, galsat-thalchoi lamkai ho chule Galilee gam'a milun ho chengse vahnan golvah abolin ahi.
English: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

tcz: Hiachun achanu chu ahung lut in, alam in ahileh leng Herod le atou khompi chengse chu alung lhaisah sohtan, chuphat'in lengpan nungahnu jah achun, “Nagot chan thum'in, keiman peng kate,”
en: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”
text:
MRK 6:22
Thadou: Hiachun achanu chu ahung lut in, alam in ahileh leng Herod le atou khompi chengse chu alung lhaisah sohtan, chuphat'in lengpan nungahnu jah achun, “Nagot chan thum'in, keiman peng kate,”
English: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

tcz: “Nathum chan chu kapeh ding ahi, ka lenggam akeh khat geiya jong kapeh thei nahi,” atitai.
en: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”
text:
MRK 6:23
Thadou: “Nathum chan chu kapeh ding ahi, ka lenggam akeh khat geiya jong kapeh thei nahi,” atitai.
English: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

tcz: Chuin amanu apotdoh in, anu komah, “Ipi kathum ding ham?” tia agadoh leh, anun, “John Baptist luchang thum in,” ahin titai.
en: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”
text:
MRK 6:24
Thadou: Chuin amanu apotdoh in, anu komah, “Ipi kathum ding ham?” tia agadoh leh, anun, “John Baptist luchang thum in,” ahin titai.
English: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”

tcz: Chuphat'in amanu kintah'in lengpa hengah ahung loiyin, “John Baptist luchang tutah in konglheng khat'in neipe lechun kati penne,” tin athumtai.
en: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”
text:
MRK 6:25
Thadou: Chuphat'in amanu kintah'in lengpa hengah ahung loiyin, “John Baptist luchang tutah in konglheng khat'in neipe lechun kati penne,” tin athumtai.
English: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”

tcz: Chuin lengpa alunggim lheh jeng tan, ahivanginla mi masanga athutep le akihahselna chule a-ankong umpiho jal chun, amanu thil thum chu nahsahmon akoithei tapoi.
en: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.
text:
MRK 6:26
Thadou: Chuin lengpa alunggim lheh jeng tan, ahivanginla mi masanga athutep le akihahselna chule a-ankong umpiho jal chun, amanu thil thum chu nahsahmon akoithei tapoi.
English: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

tcz: Hijeh chun asolchah hemchoi ho khat chu John lu gala ding in asoltan, ama achen songkul sungah alu agatang dentai.
en: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
text:
MRK 6:27
Thadou: Hijeh chun asolchah hemchoi ho khat chu John lu gala ding in asoltan, ama achen songkul sungah alu agatang dentai.
English: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

tcz: Chuin alu chu kong khat'in ahin domin nungahnu chu apen, aman anu aga petai.
en: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.
text:
MRK 6:28
Thadou: Chuin alu chu kong khat'in ahin domin nungahnu chu apen, aman anu aga petai.
English: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

tcz: Chuin aseijuiten ajah phat'un ahung un along chu ahung lauvin lhan'ah avui tauve.
en: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.
text:
MRK 6:29
Thadou: Chuin aseijuiten ajah phat'un ahung un along chu ahung lauvin lhan'ah avui tauve.
English: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.

tcz: Chuin solchah hochu anatoh nauva kon in Yeshua henga ahung kile uvin, akiman chah dan'u le athuhil danho uchu aseiyun ahi.
en: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.
text:
MRK 6:30
Thadou: Chuin solchah hochu anatoh nauva kon in Yeshua henga ahung kile uvin, akiman chah dan'u le athuhil danho uchu aseiyun ahi.
English: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah uva, “Hung un, munthip'ah chomkhat gakichol ute,” ati. Ijeh-inem itileh ahungle achele mi atam behseh jeng in, an jeng jong ne manlou ahi tauve.
en: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
text:
MRK 6:31
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan ajah uva, “Hung un, munthip'ah chomkhat gakichol ute,” ati. Ijeh-inem itileh ahungle achele mi atam behseh jeng in, an jeng jong ne manlou ahi tauve.
English: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

tcz: Hiti chun amaho munthip lam jonin kong in akitolphei tauvin ahi.
en: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.
text:
MRK 6:32
Thadou: Hiti chun amaho munthip lam jonin kong in akitolphei tauvin ahi.
English: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

tcz: Hinlah mi tamtah'in hitia akitoldoh uchu anamu uvin, hichun khopi mun chomchoma kon in mi tamtah chu twipang achun anache pheiyun, agal langa chun analhung masakit tauvin ahi.
en: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.
text:
MRK 6:33
Thadou: Hinlah mi tamtah'in hitia akitoldoh uchu anamu uvin, hichun khopi mun chomchoma kon in mi tamtah chu twipang achun anache pheiyun, agal langa chun analhung masakit tauvin ahi.
English: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

tcz: Kong sunga kon Yeshuan kal ahin sedoh leh hitia mi honpi anaum chu Yeshuan amun, achingbei kelngoi hontoh abah jeh uchun alung asen, hichun amaho chu thil tampi ahil in ahi.
en: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.
text:
MRK 6:34
Thadou: Kong sunga kon Yeshuan kal ahin sedoh leh hitia mi honpi anaum chu Yeshuan amun, achingbei kelngoi hontoh abah jeh uchun alung asen, hichun amaho chu thil tampi ahil in ahi.
English: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

tcz: Nilhah lam'in aseijuite ahung un ahenga, “Hikom hi gamthip ahin, phat hila agei lheh tan,
en: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.
text:
MRK 6:35
Thadou: Nilhah lam'in aseijuite ahung un ahenga, “Hikom hi gamthip ahin, phat hila agei lheh tan,
English: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

tcz: mi honpi hi ikimvel uva loujao le khosung hoa acheuva neh ding imathem aga kichoh diuvin soldoh tan,” atiuvin ahi.
en: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”
text:
MRK 6:36
Thadou: mi honpi hi ikimvel uva loujao le khosung hoa acheuva neh ding imathem aga kichoh diuvin soldoh tan,” atiuvin ahi.
English: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nanghon aneh diu peuvin,” ati leh, “Ipi-em kapeh diu? Mi hijatpi vahna ding vang chu sum tampi kakilona diuvin lha tampi lut inte!” tin ahin donbut uve.
en: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”
text:
MRK 6:37
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nanghon aneh diu peuvin,” ati leh, “Ipi-em kapeh diu? Mi hijatpi vahna ding vang chu sum tampi kakilona diuvin lha tampi lut inte!” tin ahin donbut uve.
English: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan, “Changlhah pheng ijat naneiyum? Gave temun,” atin, hichun agave uvin, “Changlhah pheng nga toh ngani aum e,” atiuvin ahi.
en: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
text:
MRK 6:38
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan, “Changlhah pheng ijat naneiyum? Gave temun,” atin, hichun agave uvin, “Changlhah pheng nga toh ngani aum e,” atiuvin ahi.
English: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

tcz: Chuin mi honpi chu aboncha uvin hamhing eng lah-a chu ahon hon'a atousah diuvin aseijuite athu hil tan.
en: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
text:
MRK 6:39
Thadou: Chuin mi honpi chu aboncha uvin hamhing eng lah-a chu ahon hon'a atousah diuvin aseijuite athu hil tan.
English: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

tcz: Chuin amaho agol golin—ja khat cheng, som nga cheng in atou tauvin ahi.
en: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.
text:
MRK 6:40
Thadou: Chuin amaho agol golin—ja khat cheng, som nga cheng in atou tauvin ahi.
English: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

tcz: Yeshuan changlhah pheng nga toh nga ni chu alan, vanlam aven, phatthei aboh-in changlhah chu ahehbal bal in, a anguvah luipeh ding in aseijuite apen, nga ni jong chu ahoppeh soh keiyin ahi.
en: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.
text:
MRK 6:41
Thadou: Yeshuan changlhah pheng nga toh nga ni chu alan, vanlam aven, phatthei aboh-in changlhah chu ahehbal bal in, a anguvah luipeh ding in aseijuite apen, nga ni jong chu ahoppeh soh keiyin ahi.
English: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

tcz: Hichu amahon aneuvin, abonun aneva sohkei tauve.
en: They all ate and were filled.
text:
MRK 6:42
Thadou: Hichu amahon aneuvin, abonun aneva sohkei tauve.
English: They all ate and were filled.

tcz: Akivahva jouvun changlhah le nga aval chengse paipeh somleni aloh dimun ahi.
en: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.
text:
MRK 6:43
Thadou: Akivahva jouvun changlhah le nga aval chengse paipeh somleni aloh dimun ahi.
English: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.
