tcz: Mi honpi kivahva chu numei le chapang ho sim louvin pasal cheh mi sang nga alhing in ahi.
en: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.
text:
MRK 6:44
Thadou: Mi honpi kivahva chu numei le chapang ho sim louvin pasal cheh mi sang nga alhing in ahi.
English: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan mi honpi chu alhadoh jinglai chun aseijuite chu, gal langkhat lama Bethsaida anagalkai masa ding in konga chun alutsah in asoltan ahi.
en: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.
text:
MRK 6:45
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan mi honpi chu alhadoh jinglai chun aseijuite chu, gal langkhat lama Bethsaida anagalkai masa ding in konga chun alutsah in asoltan ahi.
English: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

tcz: Abonuva alhahdoh soh phat in, tao ding in mol chunga akal toutai.
en: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
text:
MRK 6:46
Thadou: Abonuva alhahdoh soh phat in, tao ding in mol chunga akal toutai.
English: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

tcz: Jansot lamin aseijuite chu dil lailunga kong chunga aumun, Ama achangin tolgo chunga aum den e.
en: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.
text:
MRK 6:47
Thadou: Jansot lamin aseijuite chu dil lailunga kong chunga aumun, Ama achangin tolgo chunga aum den e.
English: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

tcz: Chuin amaho dil chunga konga akitol uva, hui le twi nong in anuh uva alungdon uchu amun, khovah ding kon lamin akeng in dil chunga lam ahinjot in, amaho chu khel ding agon ahi.
en: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,
text:
MRK 6:48
Thadou: Chuin amaho dil chunga konga akitol uva, hui le twi nong in anuh uva alungdon uchu amun, khovah ding kon lamin akeng in dil chunga lam ahinjot in, amaho chu khel ding agon ahi.
English: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,

tcz: Ahin amahon dil chunga kenga lam ahin jot amu phat'un thilha hinte atiuvin, a aosot jeng un ahi.
en: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

tcz: Aboncha uva Amachu amu sohkeiyu ahin, atija lheh jeng un, ahivang in Aman amaho chu ahin houpaiyin ajah uva, “Ki chahih'un, hangsan uvin, keima hichea kaum nai,” ati.
en: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
text:
MRK 6:50
Thadou: Aboncha uva Amachu amu sohkeiyu ahin, atija lheh jeng un, ahivang in Aman amaho chu ahin houpaiyin ajah uva, “Ki chahih'un, hangsan uvin, keima hichea kaum nai,” ati.
English: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

tcz: Chuin kong chunga chun akaldoh in, hui jong athip jengtai. Amaho chu alungdong lheh jengui.
en: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

tcz: Ajehchu changlhah kidang thudol jong chu hephatalou ahitauve. Alungtah behseh nalam uva chuti ahi.
en: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
text:
MRK 6:52
Thadou: Ajehchu changlhah kidang thudol jong chu hephatalou ahitauve. Alungtah behseh nalam uva chuti ahi.
English: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

tcz: Chuin agalkaiyun Gennesaret gamsung alhung un, kong chu twipam chin'ah anga tauve.
en: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.
text:
MRK 6:53
Thadou: Chuin agalkaiyun Gennesaret gamsung alhung un, kong chu twipam chin'ah anga tauve.
English: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.

tcz: Chuin konga konin apotdoh doh un, miho chun anahepai tauvin ahi.
en: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,
text:
MRK 6:54
Thadou: Chuin konga konin apotdoh doh un, miho chun anahepai tauvin ahi.
English: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

tcz: Agamsung uva alhai kimvel leuvin, chuah aume ti ahetna chanuvin ana damlou ho chu alupna pheh pumin ahinpu uvin ahi.
en: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.
text:
MRK 6:55
Thadou: Agamsung uva alhai kimvel leuvin, chuah aume ti ahetna chanuvin ana damlou ho chu alupna pheh pumin ahinpu uvin ahi.
English: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.

tcz: Achena chan khoneo, khopi chule loujao gamkochong alutna chan'ah adamlouho chu japi kititna kailhang mun'ah alupsah un, apon mongkaibeh atham dingun ahenga ataovun ahi. Hichun athamkha chan chu adam jeng un ahi.
en: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.
text:
MRK 6:56
Thadou: Achena chan khoneo, khopi chule loujao gamkochong alutna chan'ah adamlouho chu japi kititna kailhang mun'ah alupsah un, apon mongkaibeh atham dingun ahenga ataovun ahi. Hichun athamkha chan chu adam jeng un ahi.
English: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

tcz: Nikhat hi Pharisee holeh hou lamkai danthu sunho phabep Jerusalem a kipat'in Yeshua kimupi dingin ahung un ahi.
en: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.
text:
MRK 7:1
Thadou: Nikhat hi Pharisee holeh hou lamkai danthu sunho phabep Jerusalem a kipat'in Yeshua kimupi dingin ahung un ahi.
English: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

tcz: Aseijuite mi phabep khat in dan nitlou leh, khut soplouva an aneh uchu ahung mudoh tauve.
en: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.
text:
MRK 7:2
Thadou: Aseijuite mi phabep khat in dan nitlou leh, khut soplouva an aneh uchu ahung mudoh tauve.
English: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.

tcz: (Judah ho adehset'a, Pharisee hon akhang akhanga chonna dan dungjuiya khut phatea sopngim louva anehji lou u ahi.
en: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.
text:
MRK 7:3
Thadou: (Judah ho adehset'a, Pharisee hon akhang akhanga chonna dan dungjuiya khut phatea sopngim louva anehji lou u ahi.
English: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

tcz: Hitobangma chun, amahon kailhanga kicho hijongle twiya khut adelutlou leh ima anengai pouve. Hiche chu chonnangai tampi—khomho, belho, sum-eng chule jalkhun ho sopthengna kin-gun—hitobang chondan tampi anei lah-uva khat ahi.)
en: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)
text:
MRK 7:4
Thadou: Hitobangma chun, amahon kailhanga kicho hijongle twiya khut adelutlou leh ima anengai pouve. Hiche chu chonnangai tampi—khomho, belho, sum-eng chule jalkhun ho sopthengna kin-gun—hitobang chondan tampi anei lah-uva khat ahi.)
English: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

tcz: Hiti chun, Pharisee holeh hou dan thuhil hon adong un, “Ipijeh'a naseijuiten akhang akhanga ichonna ngaiyu banga khut soplouva an aneh-uham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”
text:
MRK 7:5
Thadou: Hiti chun, Pharisee holeh hou dan thuhil hon adong un, “Ipijeh'a naseijuiten akhang akhanga ichonna ngaiyu banga khut soplouva an aneh-uham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Isaiah Themgaovin mi phalhem nangho chungchang thua: ‘Hiche nam mite hin akamsung uvin eichoian un, alung thimula keiya konin gamlatah ahi.
en: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
text:
MRK 7:6
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Isaiah Themgaovin mi phalhem nangho chungchang thua: ‘Hiche nam mite hin akamsung uvin eichoian un, alung thimula keiya konin gamlatah ahi.
English: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

tcz: Amahon eihouvuhi moh ahi. Mihem semthu lungsuhto ho chu Pathen thupeh dan'a ahil u ahi,’ tin anaseiye.
en: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’
text:
MRK 7:7
Thadou: Amahon eihouvuhi moh ahi. Mihem semthu lungsuhto ho chu Pathen thupeh dan'a ahil u ahi,’ tin anaseiye.
English: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’

tcz: Nanghon Pathen danthupeh ahibangtah chu nahsahmon nakoiyun nangho chonnamlhah joh natuhdetjo tauve.
en: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”
text:
MRK 7:8
Thadou: Nanghon Pathen danthupeh ahibangtah chu nahsahmon nakoiyun nangho chonnamlhah joh natuhdetjo tauve.
English: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”

tcz: Nachonna ngaiyu natuh dettheina diuvin Pathen danthupeh tahbeh chu nahei lamdang uve.
en: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.
text:
MRK 7:9
Thadou: Nachonna ngaiyu natuh dettheina diuvin Pathen danthupeh tahbeh chu nahei lamdang uve.
English: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

tcz: Atekahnan, Mose'n Pathen'a hungkon danthu napeuve: ‘Nanu le napa jabolun,’ chule ‘Koihileh anu le apa housea chu thi jeng hen,’ ati.
en: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
text:
MRK 7:10
Thadou: Atekahnan, Mose'n Pathen'a hungkon danthu napeuve: ‘Nanu le napa jabolun,’ chule ‘Koihileh anu le apa housea chu thi jeng hen,’ ati.
English: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

tcz: Hinlah mihon anu le apa koma, ‘Gelse hih'un, kahinpanhu joupoi, ajehchu kahinpeh ding chu Pathen'a dia kapeh dingin kakiteptai,’ tia aseitheiyu jongleh aphatmona aumpoi natiuve.
en: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,
text:
MRK 7:11
Thadou: Hinlah mihon anu le apa koma, ‘Gelse hih'un, kahinpanhu joupoi, ajehchu kahinpeh ding chu Pathen'a dia kapeh dingin kakiteptai,’ tia aseitheiyu jongleh aphatmona aumpoi natiuve.
English: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,

tcz: Hiti chun nule pate agel-thupitah diu angaikhohpoi natiuve.
en: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,
text:
MRK 7:12
Thadou: Hiti chun nule pate agel-thupitah diu angaikhohpoi natiuve.
English: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

tcz: Hitia hi nangho chon-namlhah joh najui jing theina diuva Pathen thupeh hochu juilouva nakahlhah jiu ahitai,” ati.
en: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”
text:
MRK 7:13
Thadou: Hitia hi nangho chon-namlhah joh najui jing theina diuva Pathen thupeh hochu juilouva nakahlhah jiu ahitai,” ati.
English: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”

tcz: Chuin mipite chu athuhil ngaidin akouvin, “Nabonuvin ngaiyun, chule hetthem ding gouvin.
en: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.
text:
MRK 7:14
Thadou: Chuin mipite chu athuhil ngaidin akouvin, “Nabonuvin ngaiyun, chule hetthem ding gouvin.
English: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.

tcz: Polama kon'asunga lutchun ima asubohpon; lungsunga kon'a hung potdoh joh chun asuhbohji ahibouve.
en: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
text:
MRK 7:15
Thadou: Polama kon'asunga lutchun ima asubohpon; lungsunga kon'a hung potdoh joh chun asuhbohji ahibouve.
English: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

tcz: Angaina ding nakhang neiyin ngaihen,” ati.
en: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”
text:
MRK 7:16
Thadou: Angaina ding nakhang neiyin ngaihen,” ati.
English: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan mihonpi chu adalhan insung alut leh aseijuiten thulem asei chun ipilamdol akoa avetsah ham tin adongui.
en: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.
text:
MRK 7:17
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan mihonpi chu adalhan insung alut leh aseijuiten thulem asei chun ipilamdol akoa avetsah ham tin adongui.
English: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

tcz: “Nanghon jong nahet theilou laiyu ong? Natahsa sunga lut an nanehho chun nahin suhboh lou u ahi chu namu theilouvuham?
en: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,
text:
MRK 7:18
Thadou: “Nanghon jong nahet theilou laiyu ong? Natahsa sunga lut an nanehho chun nahin suhboh lou u ahi chu namu theilouvuham?
English: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,

tcz: An nanehlut'u chu lungsunga lutlouvin oisungah alut in posona-ah ahungdoh jitai.” (Hitia kiseihi, Pathen mitmun an jouse hi santhei dol ahisoh keiye ti aphondohna ahi).
en: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”
text:
MRK 7:19
Thadou: An nanehlut'u chu lungsunga lutlouvin oisungah alut in posona-ah ahungdoh jitai.” (Hitia kiseihi, Pathen mitmun an jouse hi santhei dol ahisoh keiye ti aphondohna ahi).
English: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”

tcz: Chule Aman aseibe kit'in, “Lungsunga kon'a hungpot chun mi asuhboh ahi.
en: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.
text:
MRK 7:20
Thadou: Chule Aman aseibe kit'in, “Lungsunga kon'a hungpot chun mi asuhboh ahi.
English: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

tcz: Ijeh inem iti leh mihem lungsunga konin apolamah—lunggitlou, jonthanhoi, guchat, toltha,
en: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
text:
MRK 7:21
Thadou: Ijeh inem iti leh mihem lungsunga konin apolamah—lunggitlou, jonthanhoi, guchat, toltha,
English: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

tcz: Midangtoh-jon, papset, gitlou, mi-dohabol, huhna, kimitthipna, kitaitom, hoitho, ngolna kitiho hi ahung sohdoh ji'e.
en: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
text:
MRK 7:22
Thadou: Midangtoh-jon, papset, gitlou, mi-dohabol, huhna, kimitthipna, kitaitom, hoitho, ngolna kitiho hi ahung sohdoh ji'e.
English: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

tcz: Hiche thilpha louho hi lungsunga potdoh ahin, mihem suboh ji chu ahiuve,” ati.
en: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”
text:
MRK 7:23
Thadou: Hiche thilpha louho hi lungsunga potdoh ahin, mihem suboh ji chu ahiuve,” ati.
English: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan Galilee gam adalhan, sahlama Tyre gamsungah achetai. Hikoma chun in khat'a alhungin, aumna in chu koima hetsah anompoi, ahinlah akiselthei deh tapoi.
en: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.
text:
MRK 7:24
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan Galilee gam adalhan, sahlama Tyre gamsungah achetai. Hikoma chun in khat'a alhungin, aumna in chu koima hetsah anompoi, ahinlah akiselthei deh tapoi.
English: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.

tcz: Hiachun Ama thudol anajakha numei khat ahungin, akengbula ahung bohkhup in ahi. Amanu achanu chu lhagaoboh vop ahin,
en: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
text:
MRK 7:25
Thadou: Hiachun Ama thudol anajakha numei khat ahungin, akengbula ahung bohkhup in ahi. Amanu achanu chu lhagaoboh vop ahin,
English: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

tcz: Achanu a kon'a lhagaoboh anodohpeh dingin ahung taovin ahi. Amanu chu Syrian Phoenicia tolkon, Gentile-ho ahijeh chun,
en: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.
text:
MRK 7:26
Thadou: Achanu a kon'a lhagaoboh anodohpeh dingin ahung taovin ahi. Amanu chu Syrian Phoenicia tolkon, Gentile-ho ahijeh chun,
English: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

tcz: Yeshuan ajah-a, “Amasapenin keima insung, Judate chateho kavahva masat tahdi ding ahi. Chate changlhah lahpeh-a uichate masanga selhah angai ahipoi,” ati.
en: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
text:
MRK 7:27
Thadou: Yeshuan ajah-a, “Amasapenin keima insung, Judate chateho kavahva masat tahdi ding ahi. Chate changlhah lahpeh-a uichate masanga selhah angai ahipoi,” ati.
English: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

tcz: Amanun jong, “Hichu ahinai, Pakai, hijongle dokhang noiya um uichan jong chate lhengkonga kon tolkhe changlhah nehmoh anehkhah jiu khula-em,” tin adonbut in ahi.
en: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
text:
MRK 7:28
Thadou: Amanun jong, “Hichu ahinai, Pakai, hijongle dokhang noiya um uichan jong chate lhengkonga kon tolkhe changlhah nehmoh anehkhah jiu khula-em,” tin adonbut in ahi.
English: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan, “Nadonbut hoilheh-e! Tuhin na-in'ah chetan, nachanu chu thilhan adalhatai,” atipehtai.
en: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”
text:
MRK 7:29
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan, “Nadonbut hoilheh-e! Tuhin na-in'ah chetan, nachanu chu thilhan adalhatai,” atipehtai.
English: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”

tcz: Hichun Amanu jong a-in'a acheleh achanu chu jalkhun'a analup amun, lhagaoboh anapotdohtan ahi.
en: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.
text:
MRK 7:30
Thadou: Hichun Amanu jong a-in'a acheleh achanu chu jalkhun'a analup amun, lhagaoboh anapotdohtan ahi.
English: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

tcz: Yeshuan Tyre gamkol sungse adalhan, Sidon ajotpan Decapolis gamkai ajotpeh in, Galilee Dillen alhungtai.
en: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.
text:
MRK 7:31
Thadou: Yeshuan Tyre gamkol sungse adalhan, Sidon ajotpan Decapolis gamkai ajotpeh in, Galilee Dillen alhungtai.
English: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.

tcz: Chuin anangong, pao jong paochen theilou khat hi ahenga ahin puiyun, achunga akhut angap dingin ataovun ahi.
en: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.
text:
MRK 7:32
Thadou: Chuin anangong, pao jong paochen theilou khat hi ahenga ahin puiyun, achunga akhut angap dingin ataovun ahi.
English: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

tcz: Hichun Aman mipi lah'a konin apuidohin, akhutchalin akol sung akhoiyin,
en: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.
text:
MRK 7:33
Thadou: Hichun Aman mipi lah'a konin apuidohin, akhutchalin akol sung akhoiyin,
English: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.

tcz: Achil aset in, alei athamin, chuin vanlam aven akhoisan, “Ephphatha,” ati. Hichu kihongin! tina ahi.
en: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”
text:
MRK 7:34
Thadou: Achil aset in, alei athamin, chuin vanlam aven akhoisan, “Ephphatha,” ati. Hichu kihongin! tina ahi.
English: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”

tcz: Chuphat tah chun ana avangin, aleigui jong akilham tan, kichehtah'in apaotheitai.
en: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.
text:
MRK 7:35
Thadou: Chuphat tah chun ana avangin, aleigui jong akilham tan, kichehtah'in apaotheitai.
English: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

tcz: Chuin Aman amaho chu koima jah-a aseidohlou diuvin akhamtan ahi. Ahinla amahon ahaseiphong cheh'un ahi.
en: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.
text:
MRK 7:36
Thadou: Chuin Aman amaho chu koima jah-a aseidohlou diuvin akhamtan ahi. Ahinla amahon ahaseiphong cheh'un ahi.
English: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

tcz: Kidang asabehseh jengun, avel avelin, “Aman ijakai abol jouse hi aloupi lheh jenge. Nangongla ana avansah-in, paomola apaosah-e,” atiuvin ahi.
en: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”
text:
MRK 7:37
Thadou: Kidang asabehseh jengun, avel avelin, “Aman ijakai abol jouse hi aloupi lheh jenge. Nangongla ana avansah-in, paomola apaosah-e,” atiuvin ahi.
English: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”

tcz: Hiche laichun mipi ho chu atamlheh jengtan chule neh ding ima aneilou jeh un Yeshuan aseijuite chu akouvin ajah uva,
en: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,
text:
MRK 8:1
Thadou: Hiche laichun mipi ho chu atamlheh jengtan chule neh ding ima aneilou jeh un Yeshuan aseijuite chu akouvin ajah uva,
English: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

tcz: “Mi honpi hi kakoma aumnau nithum ahitan, amahon nehding ima aneipouve,
en: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.
text:
MRK 8:2
Thadou: “Mi honpi hi kakoma aumnau nithum ahitan, amahon nehding ima aneipouve,
English: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

tcz: Chule annelouvin a-inlam chan uva solleng lampia lhasampa ding ahiuve. Akimkhat hi gamlatah a kon hung ahiuve,” ati.
en: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”
text:
MRK 8:3
Thadou: Chule annelouvin a-inlam chan uva solleng lampia lhasampa ding ahiuve. Akimkhat hi gamlatah a kon hung ahiuve,” ati.
English: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

tcz: Aseijuiten adonbut un, “Hikom gamthip laiya mi hichengpi lhingset'a vahna ding changlhah kon hoiya alahding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”
text:
MRK 8:4
Thadou: Aseijuiten adonbut un, “Hikom gamthip laiya mi hichengpi lhingset'a vahna ding changlhah kon hoiya alahding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

tcz: Yeshuan adongin, “Changlhah pheng ijat naneiyum?” ati leh, “Pheng sagi aum e,” atiuvin ahi.
en: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”
text:
MRK 8:5
Thadou: Yeshuan adongin, “Changlhah pheng ijat naneiyum?” ati leh, “Pheng sagi aum e,” atiuvin ahi.
English: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

tcz: Chuin Aman mihonpi chu tolla tou din asolin, changlhah pheng sagi chu alan, athangvah-in, chujouvin ahehbalbalin a-angsunguva luipeh dingin aseijuite chu apen, amahon mipi anga chun aluipeh-ui.
en: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.
text:
MRK 8:6
Thadou: Chuin Aman mihonpi chu tolla tou din asolin, changlhah pheng sagi chu alan, athangvah-in, chujouvin ahehbalbalin a-angsunguva luipeh dingin aseijuite chu apen, amahon mipi anga chun aluipeh-ui.
English: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

tcz: Chule aseijuiten nga neochacha phabep khat jong aneiyun, hijong chu phatthei aboh-in a-angsunguva luipeh dingin asoltan ahi.
en: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.
text:
MRK 8:7
Thadou: Chule aseijuiten nga neochacha phabep khat jong aneiyun, hijong chu phatthei aboh-in a-angsunguva luipeh dingin asoltan ahi.
English: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

tcz: Chuin amahon aneuvin, avasoh keiyun, anehmoh-u anong aval chu longkai sagi alohdoh-un ahi.
en: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
text:
MRK 8:8
Thadou: Chuin amahon aneuvin, avasoh keiyun, anehmoh-u anong aval chu longkai sagi alohdoh-un ahi.
English: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

tcz: Amaho chu numei-chapang simlouvin mi sangli jen ahiuvin, anehva jouvun Yeshuan in lamah asoltauve.
en: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.
text:
MRK 8:9
Thadou: Amaho chu numei-chapang simlouvin mi sangli jen ahiuvin, anehva jouvun Yeshuan in lamah asoltauve.
English: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Ama aseijuite toh konga alutpaiyun, Dalmanutha gam alhung tauve.
en: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.
text:
MRK 8:10
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Ama aseijuite toh konga alutpaiyun, Dalmanutha gam alhung tauve.
English: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

tcz: Pharisee hon Yeshua ahunglhung taiti ajah phatnun, kinelkalpi dingin ahungun ahi. Athuneina photchenna dingin van'a kon melchihna avetsah diuvin angeh-un ahi.
en: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.
text:
MRK 8:11
Thadou: Pharisee hon Yeshua ahunglhung taiti ajah phatnun, kinelkalpi dingin ahungun ahi. Athuneina photchenna dingin van'a kon melchihna avetsah diuvin angeh-un ahi.
English: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.

tcz: Chuin alungsungah akhoisan, “Tukhang mite hin ibol a melchihna ahol uham? Tahbeha kasei ahi, hiche tukhang mite hi imacha melchihna kipelou ding ahi,” atitai.
en: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
text:
MRK 8:12
Thadou: Chuin alungsungah akhoisan, “Tukhang mite hin ibol a melchihna ahol uham? Tahbeha kasei ahi, hiche tukhang mite hi imacha melchihna kipelou ding ahi,” atitai.
English: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

tcz: Chuin amaho chu adalhan, konga alut kit'in, langkhat panga dingin akipat dohtai.
en: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.
text:
MRK 8:13
Thadou: Chuin amaho chu adalhan, konga alut kit'in, langkhat panga dingin akipat dohtai.
English: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

tcz: Hinlah aseijuiten changlhah kipoh ding ahin haimil tauve. Konga chunla changlhah phengkhat tailou adang aum hihhel in ahi.
en: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.
text:
MRK 8:14
Thadou: Hinlah aseijuiten changlhah kipoh ding ahin haimil tauve. Konga chunla changlhah phengkhat tailou adang aum hihhel in ahi.
English: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

tcz: Chuin Aman amaho chu ahilchah-in, “Chingtheiyun, Pharisee ho le Herod chol lah-a kihongpha uvin,” ati.
en: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”
text:
MRK 8:15
Thadou: Chuin Aman amaho chu ahilchah-in, “Chingtheiyun, Pharisee ho le Herod chol lah-a kihongpha uvin,” ati.
English: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

tcz: Hiche aseiya kon chun changlhah ahin poh haimil jeh-un amaho akihoulimun, akioimoto uvin ahi.
en: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”
text:
MRK 8:16
Thadou: Hiche aseiya kon chun changlhah ahin poh haimil jeh-un amaho akihoulimun, akioimoto uvin ahi.
English: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

tcz: Akihounau chu Yeshuan ahen, ajah uva, “Changlhah naneilou jeh uva ibola kioimoto le nahiuvem? Tugeiya nalunguva hedoh loulai nahiuvem? Hetthemna dinga nalungu hibangloma tah lheh jeng ham?
en: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?
text:
MRK 8:17
Thadou: Akihounau chu Yeshuan ahen, ajah uva, “Changlhah naneilou jeh uva ibola kioimoto le nahiuvem? Tugeiya nalunguva hedoh loulai nahiuvem? Hetthemna dinga nalungu hibangloma tah lheh jeng ham?
English: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?

tcz: Mit neiyuva—mutheilou nahiuvem? Nakhang neiyuva—jatheilou nahiuvem? Gel jong nagel dohlou monguham?
en: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
text:
MRK 8:18
Thadou: Mit neiyuva—mutheilou nahiuvem? Nakhang neiyuva—jatheilou nahiuvem? Gel jong nagel dohlou monguham?
English: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

tcz: Mi sang-nga changlhah pheng nga kahoppeh-a chu amoh-ahal paipeh ijat nalodimum?” atileh amahon, “Somleni ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”
text:
MRK 8:19
Thadou: Mi sang-nga changlhah pheng nga kahoppeh-a chu amoh-ahal paipeh ijat nalodimum?” atileh amahon, “Somleni ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
English: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

tcz: Mi sangli lah-a changlhah pheng sagi kihoppeh-a chu nehmoh aval longkai ijat nalodimum? ati kit leh, “Sagi ahi,” atiuvin,
en: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”
text:
MRK 8:20
Thadou: Mi sangli lah-a changlhah pheng sagi kihoppeh-a chu nehmoh aval longkai ijat nalodimum? ati kit leh, “Sagi ahi,” atiuvin,
English: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

tcz: “Achutile tugeiya jong hedoh loulai nahiu ham?” atin ahi.
en: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”
text:
MRK 8:21
Thadou: “Achutile tugeiya jong hedoh loulai nahiu ham?” atin ahi.
English: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”

tcz: Amaho Bethsaida alhun phat'un, mi phabep in mitchopa chu Yeshua henglama ahin puiyun, chule amahon atohkhah-a adamsah din angeh-uvin ahi.
en: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.
text:
MRK 8:22
Thadou: Amaho Bethsaida alhun phat'un, mi phabep in mitchopa chu Yeshua henglama ahin puiyun, chule amahon atohkhah-a adamsah din angeh-uvin ahi.
English: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.

tcz: Yeshuan mitchopa chu akhut in atuh-in, khosunga konin apuidohtan ahi. Chuin amit a achil aset in achunga akhut angam in, “Tua hi kho namum?” tin adongin ahi.
en: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.
text:
MRK 8:23
Thadou: Yeshuan mitchopa chu akhut in atuh-in, khosunga konin apuidohtan ahi. Chuin amit a achil aset in achunga akhut angam in, “Tua hi kho namum?” tin adongin ahi.
English: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

tcz: Mipa chun akimvel dung aven, “Henge, miho kamun, ahinla kichentah'in ka muthei poi, thingphungte chat lele tobang'in kamui,” ati.
en: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”
text:
MRK 8:24
Thadou: Mipa chun akimvel dung aven, “Henge, miho kamun, ahinla kichentah'in ka muthei poi, thingphungte chat lele tobang'in kamui,” ati.
English: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”

tcz: Chujouvin amit akhut'in atham kit'in, ave changmelin ahileh adamhel jengtan, ima jouse kichentah'in amu thei tan ahi.
en: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.
text:
MRK 8:25
Thadou: Chujouvin amit akhut'in atham kit'in, ave changmelin ahileh adamhel jengtan, ima jouse kichentah'in amu thei tan ahi.
English: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

tcz: Yeshuan ama asoldoh in, “Khosunga chun lutpa tahih-in,” tin akham'in ahi.
en: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”
text:
MRK 8:26
Thadou: Yeshuan ama asoldoh in, “Khosunga chun lutpa tahih-in,” tin akham'in ahi.
English: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”

tcz: Yeshua le aseijuiten Galilee gam adalha uvin, Caesarea Philippi koma khohoa chun ache leuvin ahi. Lampia alamjot laiyun thu adongin, “Keima hi mihon koi ahi eitiuvem?” ati leh,
en: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”
text:
MRK 8:27
Thadou: Yeshua le aseijuiten Galilee gam adalha uvin, Caesarea Philippi koma khohoa chun ache leuvin ahi. Lampia alamjot laiyun thu adongin, “Keima hi mihon koi ahi eitiuvem?” ati leh,
English: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”

tcz: Aseijuiten, “Loikhat in John Baptist, loikhat in Elijah chule loikhat kit chun Nangma hi themgaoho lah a achom khat hinte atiuve,” tin adonbut uve.
en: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”
text:
MRK 8:28
Thadou: Aseijuiten, “Loikhat in John Baptist, loikhat in Elijah chule loikhat kit chun Nangma hi themgaoho lah a achom khat hinte atiuve,” tin adonbut uve.
English: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan, “Ahileh nanghonla keihi koi ahi neitiuvem?” tia adoh leh, Peter in, “Nangma Messiah chu nahi,” ati.
en: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
text:
MRK 8:29
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan, “Ahileh nanghonla keihi koi ahi neitiuvem?” tia adoh leh, Peter in, “Nangma Messiah chu nahi,” ati.
English: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

tcz: Ahinlah Yeshuan koimacha koma aseidohlou beh diuvin ahilchahtan ahi.
en: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.
text:
MRK 8:30
Thadou: Ahinlah Yeshuan koimacha koma aseidohlou beh diuvin ahilchahtan ahi.
English: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

tcz: Chuin Aman amaho chu Mihem Chapan thohgimna tamtah athoh-a, vaipo upa hole thempu pipuho chule danthu sunhon adoudal diu thuho aseipeh-e. Chule thalih-a auma, nithum jouleh thoudoh kit teiding ahi chu ahil pantan ahi.
en: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
text:
MRK 8:31
Thadou: Chuin Aman amaho chu Mihem Chapan thohgimna tamtah athoh-a, vaipo upa hole thempu pipuho chule danthu sunhon adoudal diu thuho aseipeh-e. Chule thalih-a auma, nithum jouleh thoudoh kit teiding ahi chu ahil pantan ahi.
English: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

tcz: Aman hichu phongtaha aseijuite koma asei jinglaiyin, Peter in apuidohin hitobang thuho chu aseilou din angeh-in ahi.
en: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.
text:
MRK 8:32
Thadou: Aman hichu phongtaha aseijuite koma asei jinglaiyin, Peter in apuidohin hitobang thuho chu aseilou din angeh-in ahi.
English: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

tcz: Ahin Ama akiheiyin, aseijuiteho aven Peter chu aphoh-in, “Kanung lama chen, Satan! Nangman Pathen thulam gellouvin, mihem thulam jeng nagele,” atin ahi.
en: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”
text:
MRK 8:33
Thadou: Ahin Ama akiheiyin, aseijuiteho aven Peter chu aphoh-in, “Kanung lama chen, Satan! Nangman Pathen thulam gellouvin, mihem thulam jeng nagele,” atin ahi.
English: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

tcz: Chuin Aman aseijuiho le mihonpi chu ahenglama akouvin, “Nalah-uva koi hijongleh eijui noma chun, nacham chonnauva kon'a nahung kiheiyuva, na thingpel nakiput uva, chule neijui dingu ahi.
en: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
text:
MRK 8:34
Thadou: Chuin Aman aseijuiho le mihonpi chu ahenglama akouvin, “Nalah-uva koi hijongleh eijui noma chun, nacham chonnauva kon'a nahung kiheiyuva, na thingpel nakiput uva, chule neijui dingu ahi.
English: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh koi hile ahinna huhhing nom'a chun alhaso ding ahi. Amavang koi hile keima jal le Kipana Thupha jal'a ahinna lhaso'a chun akihuhhing joh ding ahi.
en: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.
text:
MRK 8:35
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh koi hile ahinna huhhing nom'a chun alhaso ding ahi. Amavang koi hile keima jal le Kipana Thupha jal'a ahinna lhaso'a chun akihuhhing joh ding ahi.
English: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh min vannoi pumpi neihenlang ahinna chan taleh, ipi phatchomna anei ding ham?
en: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?
text:
MRK 8:36
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itileh min vannoi pumpi neihenlang ahinna chan taleh, ipi phatchomna anei ding ham?
English: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

tcz: Min ahinna khel'a ipi apeh dingham?
en: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?
text:
MRK 8:37
Thadou: Min ahinna khel'a ipi apeh dingham?
English: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh koihileh tulai chonthanhoinale chonsetna khanga keima le kathuhil jachatpi chu Mihem Chapan jong apa loupina-a vantil thengtetoh ahung nileh, amapa chu ajachatpi ding ahi,” ati.
en: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
text:
MRK 8:38
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh koihileh tulai chonthanhoinale chonsetna khanga keima le kathuhil jachatpi chu Mihem Chapan jong apa loupina-a vantil thengtetoh ahung nileh, amapa chu ajachatpi ding ahi,” ati.
English: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

tcz: Yeshuan aseibe nalaiyin, “Keiman tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, tua hichea dingho kimkhat hi Pathen gam thaneitah'a ahung lhun amu kahseuva thina tepkhalou ding aumuve!” ati.
en: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”
text:
MRK 9:1
Thadou: Yeshuan aseibe nalaiyin, “Keiman tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, tua hichea dingho kimkhat hi Pathen gam thaneitah'a ahung lhun amu kahseuva thina tepkhalou ding aumuve!” ati.
English: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”

tcz: Nigup jouvin Yeshuan Peter, James chule John atumbeh in molsang chungah apui touvin ahi. Chuah amaho angsung laitah-a Yeshua avou akikheltan,
en: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.
text:
MRK 9:2
Thadou: Nigup jouvin Yeshuan Peter, James chule John atumbeh in molsang chungah apui touvin ahi. Chuah amaho angsung laitah-a Yeshua avou akikheltan,
English: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

tcz: Aponsil chu vah bangin aemleng jengin, leiya koiman pon hitobanga chu asop bang theilou khop'in abangin ahi.
en: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
text:
MRK 9:3
Thadou: Aponsil chu vah bangin aemleng jengin, leiya koiman pon hitobanga chu asop bang theilou khop'in abangin ahi.
English: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

tcz: Chuin Elijah le Mose ahung kilah lhonin Yeshua chu ahoulimpi lhonin ahi.
en: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.
text:
MRK 9:4
Thadou: Chuin Elijah le Mose ahung kilah lhonin Yeshua chu ahoulimpi lhonin ahi.
English: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

tcz: Chuin Peter in, “Houhil, hikoma iumuhi eiho din anom ngeiye! Geldoh jingna din lhambuh thum song uhite—Nang ding khat, Mose ding khat chule Elijah ding khat,” atin ahi.
en: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
text:
MRK 9:5
Thadou: Chuin Peter in, “Houhil, hikoma iumuhi eiho din anom ngeiye! Geldoh jingna din lhambuh thum song uhite—Nang ding khat, Mose ding khat chule Elijah ding khat,” atin ahi.
English: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

tcz: Hiche asei hi akichat behseh jeh'a seiding hetmoa asei ahi.
en: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.
text:
MRK 9:6
Thadou: Hiche asei hi akichat behseh jeh'a seiding hetmoa asei ahi.
English: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.

tcz: Chuin meilhang khat'in amaho chu ahin lekhun, meilah-a konin aw ahung gingin, “Hichehi ka-Chapa deitah chu ahi, athu ngaiyun!” ati.
en: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”
text:
MRK 9:7
Thadou: Chuin meilhang khat'in amaho chu ahin lekhun, meilah-a konin aw ahung gingin, “Hichehi ka-Chapa deitah chu ahi, athu ngaiyun!” ati.
English: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”

tcz: Chuin akimvelu avet uleh, koimacha amutahih un, Mose le Elijah chu anachemang tan, Yeshua changseh le amaho changbou aumtauvin ahi.
en: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.
text:
MRK 9:8
Thadou: Chuin akimvelu avet uleh, koimacha amutahih un, Mose le Elijah chu anachemang tan, Yeshua changseh le amaho changbou aumtauvin ahi.
English: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

tcz: Molla kon'a ahung kumsuh jing laiyun, Yeshuan athilto-u chu Mihem Chapa athia kon'a athodoh kit kahsea koima jah-a aseidohlou diuvin akhamgah-in ahi.
en: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
text:
MRK 9:9
Thadou: Molla kon'a ahung kumsuh jing laiyun, Yeshuan athilto-u chu Mihem Chapa athia kon'a athodoh kit kahsea koima jah-a aseidohlou diuvin akhamgah-in ahi.
English: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

tcz: Athusei chu alunguva aching jingun, athia kon'a athodoh kit chu ipi aseina ahidem, tin akidongto jiuvin ahi.
en: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.
text:
MRK 9:10
Thadou: Athusei chu alunguva aching jingun, athia kon'a athodoh kit chu ipi aseina ahidem, tin akidongto jiuvin ahi.
English: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

tcz: Chuin amahon adongun, “Ibola danthusunhon Messiah hung masanga Elijah hung kit masa ding ahi atiuham?” atiuleh Aman adonbut in,
en: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
text:
MRK 9:11
Thadou: Chuin amahon adongun, “Ibola danthusunhon Messiah hung masanga Elijah hung kit masa ding ahi atiuham?” atiuleh Aman adonbut in,
English: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

tcz: “Elijah chu hungmasa'a ijakai ahung semphat ding mong ahi. Ahinla Pathen Thubun Mihem Chapan gimhesoh tamtah athoh ding chule mite nahsahmoa um ding ati ham?
en: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?
text:
MRK 9:12
Thadou: “Elijah chu hungmasa'a ijakai ahung semphat ding mong ahi. Ahinla Pathen Thubun Mihem Chapan gimhesoh tamtah athoh ding chule mite nahsahmoa um ding ati ham?
English: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

tcz: Kaseipeh nahiuve, Elijah chu hunga ahitai, chule thil hungsoh ding anakisut bangtah'in isahlou tah'in anabol tauve,” atin ahi.
en: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”
text:
MRK 9:13
Thadou: Kaseipeh nahiuve, Elijah chu hunga ahitai, chule thil hungsoh ding anakisut bangtah'in isahlou tah'in anabol tauve,” atin ahi.
English: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

tcz: Chuin seijui dangho henglama ahung kileuva ahileh, amaho chu mipin anaumkimvelu chu amuvin, hou lamkai phabep khattoh jong anakinel un ahi.
en: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.
text:
MRK 9:14
Thadou: Chuin seijui dangho henglama ahung kileuva ahileh, amaho chu mipin anaumkimvelu chu amuvin, hou lamkai phabep khattoh jong anakinel un ahi.
English: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

tcz: Mihonpin Yeshua amu phatnun, akipah thanomun ahengah ahung lhaiyun, ahung lamtouvin ahi.
en: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.
text:
MRK 9:15
Thadou: Mihonpin Yeshua amu phatnun, akipah thanomun ahengah ahung lhaiyun, ahung lamtouvin ahi.
English: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan, “Amaho khutoh ipi thua kinel nahiuvem?” tin adongtai.
en: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”
text:
MRK 9:16
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan, “Amaho khutoh ipi thua kinel nahiuvem?” tin adongtai.
English: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

tcz: Mipi lah'a konin mi khat in ahin donbut in, “Pakai, kachapa nadamsah dingin nahenga kahin puiye. Amahi lhagaoboh-in avop in, apao dohsah thei tapoi.
en: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

tcz: Hoikom hijongle lhagaoboh hin amat matna'ah aheh lhujin, chule achilphon alhan, aha ageljin chule alhasamdel ji tai. Hijeh a chu naseijuite koma einodohpeh diuva kangeh leh abolthei pouve,” ati.
en: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”
text:
MRK 9:18
Thadou: Hoikom hijongle lhagaoboh hin amat matna'ah aheh lhujin, chule achilphon alhan, aha ageljin chule alhasamdel ji tai. Hijeh a chu naseijuite koma einodohpeh diuva kangeh leh abolthei pouve,” ati.
English: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan akomuvah, “Tahsanna neilou mite! Itihchan kaumpi ding nahiuvem? Kahenga chapangpa chu hin pui tangu,” atitai.
en: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”
text:
MRK 9:19
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan akomuvah, “Tahsanna neilou mite! Itihchan kaumpi ding nahiuvem? Kahenga chapangpa chu hin pui tangu,” atitai.
English: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”

tcz: Hichun chapangpa chu ahin puiyui. Ahin lhagaoboh-in Yeshua amu phatnin, chapangpa chu nasatah'in aveingoiyin ahileh tolla alhun, achilphon akai letlut in akitel lelen ahi.
en: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.
text:
MRK 9:20
Thadou: Hichun chapangpa chu ahin puiyui. Ahin lhagaoboh-in Yeshua amu phatnin, chapangpa chu nasatah'in aveingoiyin ahileh tolla alhun, achilphon akai letlut in akitel lelen ahi.
English: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan chapangpa apa jah-a, “Ahitinahi itih-a pat hitam?” tia adoh leh, apan, “Aneolaiya kipan ahitai.
en: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.
text:
MRK 9:21
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan chapangpa apa jah-a, “Ahitinahi itih-a pat hitam?” tia adoh leh, apan, “Aneolaiya kipan ahitai.
English: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.

tcz: Tha dingin abangleh meiya, abangleh twiyah alehlutjin ahi. Hijongle Nangman alonaje nahet leh kachunguva khotona neipumin neikithopin,” tin aseitai.
en: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”
text:
MRK 9:22
Thadou: Tha dingin abangleh meiya, abangleh twiyah alehlutjin ahi. Hijongle Nangman alonaje nahet leh kachunguva khotona neipumin neikithopin,” tin aseitai.
English: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”

tcz: “Alonaje nahet leh, nati chu ipi naseina ham? Atahsanho dingin ijakai ahithei soh keiye,” tin Yeshuan adonbut e.
en: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
text:
MRK 9:23
Thadou: “Alonaje nahet leh, nati chu ipi naseina ham? Atahsanho dingin ijakai ahithei soh keiye,” tin Yeshuan adonbut e.
English: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

tcz: Hichun hetman louvin chapangpa apa chu ahung kapjah jengin, “Pakai, katahsan'e, katahsan lelna abeina din neikithopin,” tin ataotai.
en: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
text:
MRK 9:24
Thadou: Hichun hetman louvin chapangpa apa chu ahung kapjah jengin, “Pakai, katahsan'e, katahsan lelna abeina din neikithopin,” tin ataotai.
English: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan mi ahung kikhop tam chehcheh amu phatnin lhagao-boh chu aphoh-in, ajah-a, “Ngaiyin, nang lhagao phalou, chapangpa paomosah le nangonsahpa, thu kapeh nahi, chapangpa sunga konin hung Potdoh inlang lutkit tahih-in!” ati.
en: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”
text:
MRK 9:25
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan mi ahung kikhop tam chehcheh amu phatnin lhagao-boh chu aphoh-in, ajah-a, “Ngaiyin, nang lhagao phalou, chapangpa paomosah le nangonsahpa, thu kapeh nahi, chapangpa sunga konin hung Potdoh inlang lutkit tahih-in!” ati.
English: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”

tcz: Hichun lhagaoboh chu apengjah jengin, chapangpa chu hatah in aveingoiyin, chuin adalhatai. Chapangpa chu athi bangin aumtan, mihonpi chu akihou lahlah-un, “Athi hitakhu!” atiuvin ahi.
en: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”
text:
MRK 9:26
Thadou: Hichun lhagaoboh chu apengjah jengin, chapangpa chu hatah in aveingoiyin, chuin adalhatai. Chapangpa chu athi bangin aumtan, mihonpi chu akihou lahlah-un, “Athi hitakhu!” atiuvin ahi.
English: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”

tcz: Ahin Yeshuan akhut in amanin, akaithouvin ahileh ahung thoudoh jengtan ahi.
en: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.
text:
MRK 9:27
Thadou: Ahin Yeshuan akhut in amanin, akaithouvin ahileh ahung thoudoh jengtan ahi.
English: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.

tcz: Chujou chomkhat jouva Yeshua le aseijuite insunga aumlaiyun aseijuiten, “I-atileh keihon kanodoh lel'u ahidem?” tia adoh-ule,
en: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”
text:
MRK 9:28
Thadou: Chujou chomkhat jouva Yeshua le aseijuite insunga aumlaiyun aseijuiten, “I-atileh keihon kanodoh lel'u ahidem?” tia adoh-ule,
English: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Hitobang hi taona thahatna'a bou kinodoh thei ahi,” ati.
en: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”
text:
MRK 9:29
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Hitobang hi taona thahatna'a bou kinodoh thei ahi,” ati.
English: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”

tcz: Chumun chu adalha uvin, Galilee gam ajot un, min ahetdoh diu chu Yeshuan adeipoi.
en: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,
text:
MRK 9:30
Thadou: Chumun chu adalha uvin, Galilee gam ajot un, min ahetdoh diu chu Yeshuan adeipoi.
English: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,

tcz: Ijeh-inem iti leh Aman aseijuite toh phat mankhoma thuhil ding phat angaichan ahi. Hichun Aman ajah-uva, “Mihem Chapa chu melmate khut'a pehdoh-a umding ahi. Amahon atha dingu, ahivanga nithum nileh Ama thoudoh kit ding ahi,” ati.
en: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”
text:
MRK 9:31
Thadou: Ijeh-inem iti leh Aman aseijuite toh phat mankhoma thuhil ding phat angaichan ahi. Hichun Aman ajah-uva, “Mihem Chapa chu melmate khut'a pehdoh-a umding ahi. Amahon atha dingu, ahivanga nithum nileh Ama thoudoh kit ding ahi,” ati.
English: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”

tcz: Athusei chu ipi asei ham ti ahethei pouvin Ama doh dingla akichauvin adong ngam pouve.
en: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
text:
MRK 9:32
Thadou: Athusei chu ipi asei ham ti ahethei pouvin Ama doh dingla akichauvin adong ngam pouve.
English: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

tcz: Amaho Capernaum ahung lhungun, chuin insung aumpet'un ajah uva, “Lamdunga chu ipi nangaitou ham?” tin adongin ahi.
en: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”
text:
MRK 9:33
Thadou: Amaho Capernaum ahung lhungun, chuin insung aumpet'un ajah uva, “Lamdunga chu ipi nangaitou ham?” tin adongin ahi.
English: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

tcz: Ahin, adonbut theipouve, ajehchu alah uva koichu alenpen hintem ti akinel ahiuve.
en: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.
text:
MRK 9:34
Thadou: Ahin, adonbut theipouve, ajehchu alah uva koichu alenpen hintem ti akinel ahiuve.
English: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.

tcz: Hichun Yeshua atouvin somleni ho chu akouvin, “Koihileh amasapen hinom chu nukhah pending ahi, chule mijouse jenlea pang hiding ahi,” ati.
en: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”
text:
MRK 9:35
Thadou: Hichun Yeshua atouvin somleni ho chu akouvin, “Koihileh amasapen hinom chu nukhah pending ahi, chule mijouse jenlea pang hiding ahi,” ati.
English: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

tcz: Chuin chapang neocha khat alaiyuva adinsah-in, chuin apomin ajah uva,
en: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,
text:
MRK 9:36
Thadou: Chuin chapang neocha khat alaiyuva adinsah-in, chuin apomin ajah uva,
English: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

tcz: “Koihileh keima min'a hitobang chapang neokhat sanga chun keima eisan ahi, chule koihileh keima eisang chan chun, keima bou eisan hilouvin eihinsolpa jong sana hi,” ati.
en: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”
text:
MRK 9:37
Thadou: “Koihileh keima min'a hitobang chapang neokhat sanga chun keima eisan ahi, chule koihileh keima eisang chan chun, keima bou eisan hilouvin eihinsolpa jong sana hi,” ati.
English: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”

tcz: Hichun John'in Yeshua komah, “Houhil, amin'a thilha nodoh mi khat kamu uvin, hinla ama chu eiho lah-a pang ahilou jeh-in kakham tauve,” ati.
en: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”
text:
MRK 9:38
Thadou: Hichun John'in Yeshua komah, “Houhil, amin'a thilha nodoh mi khat kamu uvin, hinla ama chu eiho lah-a pang ahilou jeh-in kakham tauve,” ati.
English: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kham hih-un, kamin'a thil kidang bol a keima eiseiseloi thei koima aumpoi.”
en: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.
text:
MRK 9:39
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kham hih-un, kamin'a thil kidang bol a keima eiseiseloi thei koima aumpoi.”
English: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

tcz: Koi hijongle eidouloupou chu eilama pang ahi.
en: For whoever is not against us is on our side.
text:
MRK 9:40
Thadou: Koi hijongle eidouloupou chu eilama pang ahi.
English: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

tcz: Koi hijongle Messiah nungjui-mi ahi tiatwi khon khat donding napechan'u chu, tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, itinama jongle ama chun kipaman asan ding ahi.
en: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.
text:
MRK 9:41
Thadou: Koi hijongle Messiah nungjui-mi ahi tiatwi khon khat donding napechan'u chu, tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, itinama jongle ama chun kipaman asan ding ahi.
English: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

tcz: Chule koi hijongleh keima eitahsan khangdongchaho jeng jong setna-a kipallhuh sah chun angonga sumhei songlentah kikhai henlang twikhanglen'a kilehlut leh ama dingin aphajoi.
en: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.
text:
MRK 9:42
Thadou: Chule koi hijongleh keima eitahsan khangdongchaho jeng jong setna-a kipallhuh sah chun angonga sumhei songlentah kikhai henlang twikhanglen'a kilehlut leh ama dingin aphajoi.
English: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

tcz: “Chule nakhut langkhat'in nachonsetsah'a ahileh tanbong jengin. Khut ni neiya meikong mittheilou damun'a che sangin tibukimlou khut langkhatseh toh hinkemlouna-a lut aphajoi.
en: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,
text:
MRK 9:43
Thadou: “Chule nakhut langkhat'in nachonsetsah'a ahileh tanbong jengin. Khut ni neiya meikong mittheilou damun'a che sangin tibukimlou khut langkhatseh toh hinkemlouna-a lut aphajoi.
English: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

tcz: Chu mun'a chu thanho thi dehlou ding, mei jeng jong mit talou ding ahi.
en: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
text:
MRK 9:44
Thadou: Chu mun'a chu thanho thi dehlou ding, mei jeng jong mit talou ding ahi.
English: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

tcz: Nakeng langkhat'in nachonsetsah'a ahileh tanbong jeng in, keng ni neiya damun jot sangin keng langbeiya hinkem louna mun'a lut aphajoi.
en: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—
text:
MRK 9:45
Thadou: Nakeng langkhat'in nachonsetsah'a ahileh tanbong jeng in, keng ni neiya damun jot sangin keng langbeiya hinkem louna mun'a lut aphajoi.
English: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—

tcz: Chu mun'a chu thanho thi dehlou ding, mei jeng jong mit talou ding ahi.
en: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
text:
MRK 9:46
Thadou: Chu mun'a chu thanho thi dehlou ding, mei jeng jong mit talou ding ahi.
English: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

tcz: Namit langkhat'in nakipal lhuhsah'a ahileh kaldoh jengin, mit ni neiya damun'a nakilelut sangin mit lang choa Pathen gam'a lut nangma ding in aphajoi.
en: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,
text:
MRK 9:47
Thadou: Namit langkhat'in nakipal lhuhsah'a ahileh kaldoh jengin, mit ni neiya damun'a nakilelut sangin mit lang choa Pathen gam'a lut nangma ding in aphajoi.
English: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

tcz: Chu mun'a chu thanho thi dehlou ding, mei jeng jong mit talou ding ahi.
en: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
text:
MRK 9:48
Thadou: Chu mun'a chu thanho thi dehlou ding, mei jeng jong mit talou ding ahi.
English: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

tcz: Ijeh-inem itileh mijouse meiya chisoa kiso ding, chule gankikat jouse chi kiso-al ding ahi.
en: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.
text:
MRK 9:49
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itileh mijouse meiya chisoa kiso ding, chule gankikat jouse chi kiso-al ding ahi.
English: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

tcz: Chihi apha ahivang in a-alna beita henlang tamtaleh ipia ki-alsah kit ding hitam? Chi bang in gun neiyun lang khat le khat chamdelin um uvin,” ati.
en: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”
text:
MRK 9:50
Thadou: Chihi apha ahivang in a-alna beita henlang tamtaleh ipia ki-alsah kit ding hitam? Chi bang in gun neiyun lang khat le khat chamdelin um uvin,” ati.
English: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan Capernaum adalhan chua kon in Judah gamkol sung leh, Jordan Lui solam gamkaiyah ache suhtan ahi. Mi honpi chu ahenga ahung kikhom kit tauvin, chuti chun Aman amaho chu thu ahilkittan ahi.
en: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.
text:
MRK 10:1
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan Capernaum adalhan chua kon in Judah gamkol sung leh, Jordan Lui solam gamkaiyah ache suhtan ahi. Mi honpi chu ahenga ahung kikhom kit tauvin, chuti chun Aman amaho chu thu ahilkittan ahi.
English: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

tcz: Chua chun Pharisee ho mi phabep ahenga ahung un mochan theina dinga kipalsahna ding in, “Pasal in aji ada hi danngai hinam?” tin thudoh ahung neiyui.
en: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”
text:
MRK 10:2
Thadou: Chua chun Pharisee ho mi phabep ahenga ahung un mochan theina dinga kipalsahna ding in, “Pasal in aji ada hi danngai hinam?” tin thudoh ahung neiyui.
English: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

tcz: Yeshuan athudoh-u chu adonbut in, “Mose'n nang ho jida thua danthu itobang napeh uvem?” tia adoh leh,
en: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”
text:
MRK 10:3
Thadou: Yeshuan athudoh-u chu adonbut in, “Mose'n nang ho jida thua danthu itobang napeh uvem?” tia adoh leh,
English: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”

tcz: Amahon, “Da ding aphalnai. Mi khat'in aji adana dia lekhasut apeh lut'a, chule amanu chu asoldoh thei ahi, tin aseiye,” atiuvin ahi.
en: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”
text:
MRK 10:4
Thadou: Amahon, “Da ding aphalnai. Mi khat'in aji adana dia lekhasut apeh lut'a, chule amanu chu asoldoh thei ahi, tin aseiye,” atiuvin ahi.
English: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan adonbutnan: “Nang ho lungtah behseh jeh'a hitia chu dan nahin ngaijang peh-u ahibouve.
en: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.
text:
MRK 10:5
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan adonbutnan: “Nang ho lungtah behseh jeh'a hitia chu dan nahin ngaijang peh-u ahibouve.
English: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

tcz: Ahivang in semtila pat'a Pathen in pasal le numei anasem ahitai.
en: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.
text:
MRK 10:6
Thadou: Ahivang in semtila pat'a Pathen in pasal le numei anasem ahitai.
English: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

tcz: Hichun ipijeh'a pasal in anulepa adalhah-a ajia beh ham ti avetsah-in,
en: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,
text:
MRK 10:7
Thadou: Hichun ipijeh'a pasal in anulepa adalhah-a ajia beh ham ti avetsah-in,
English: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

tcz: Chule ama ni chu pumni hitalouva pumkhat, tahsa khat hilhon ding ahi tai.
en: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.
text:
MRK 10:8
Thadou: Chule ama ni chu pumni hitalouva pumkhat, tahsa khat hilhon ding ahi tai.
English: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pathen gopsa chu mihemin sukhen hih hen,” ati.
en: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”
text:
MRK 10:9
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pathen gopsa chu mihemin sukhen hih hen,” ati.
English: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, aseijuite toh insunga amaho bou aumpet'un, hiche thuhi ahin podoh kit'un,
en: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.
text:
MRK 10:10
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin, aseijuite toh insunga amaho bou aumpet'un, hiche thuhi ahin podoh kit'un,
English: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

tcz: Aman aseipeh-in, “Koihileh aji da-a jidang neichun ajinu chu ajonsan ahi.
en: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.
text:
MRK 10:11
Thadou: Aman aseipeh-in, “Koihileh aji da-a jidang neichun ajinu chu ajonsan ahi.
English: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

tcz: Numeiyin jong apasal ada-a midang toh akichen leh amanu jong chu ajong ahi,” ati.
en: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”
text:
MRK 10:12
Thadou: Numeiyin jong apasal ada-a midang toh akichen leh amanu jong chu ajong ahi,” ati.
English: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”

tcz: Nikhat hi minu mipate phabep khat'in achateu chu Yeshuan atham'a phatthei aboh diuvin ahin puiyun ahileh, aseijuiten anajadauvin ahi.
en: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.
text:
MRK 10:13
Thadou: Nikhat hi minu mipate phabep khat'in achateu chu Yeshuan atham'a phatthei aboh diuvin ahin puiyun ahileh, aseijuiten anajadauvin ahi.
English: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

tcz: Yeshuan hichu ajah phat in aseijuite chunga alung phamon, ajah uva aseiyin, “Chapang neocha ho chu kahenga hung sah'un, jahda hih-un! Ijeh-inem iti leh Pathen Lenggam chu amaho tobang hoa bou ahi.
en: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
text:
MRK 10:14
Thadou: Yeshuan hichu ajah phat in aseijuite chunga alung phamon, ajah uva aseiyin, “Chapang neocha ho chu kahenga hung sah'un, jahda hih-un! Ijeh-inem iti leh Pathen Lenggam chu amaho tobang hoa bou ahi.
English: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

tcz: Tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, koihileh chapang neoho banga Pathen Lenggam sanglou chu itinama jongleh hichea chu lutlou ding ahi,” ati.
en: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
text:
MRK 10:15
Thadou: Tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, koihileh chapang neoho banga Pathen Lenggam sanglou chu itinama jongleh hichea chu lutlou ding ahi,” ati.
English: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

tcz: Chuin chapangho chu apomin akhut achung uva angam'in phatthei abohtai.
en: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.
text:
MRK 10:16
Thadou: Chuin chapangho chu apomin akhut achung uva angam'in phatthei abohtai.
English: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

tcz: Chuin Ama Jerusalem lang jon'a ache ding konin mi khat ahung lhaijelin a-angsungah adilsun, ajah-ah, “Houhil pha, tonsot hinkemlou kanei theina dinga ipi kabol ding ham?” ati.
en: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”
text:
MRK 10:17
Thadou: Chuin Ama Jerusalem lang jon'a ache ding konin mi khat ahung lhaijelin a-angsungah adilsun, ajah-ah, “Houhil pha, tonsot hinkemlou kanei theina dinga ipi kabol ding ham?” ati.
English: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”

tcz: Yeshuan, “Ibola apha neitiham? Pathen khatseh tailou koima apha aumpoi,
en: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.
text:
MRK 10:18
Thadou: Yeshuan, “Ibola apha neitiham? Pathen khatseh tailou koima apha aumpoi,
English: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.

tcz: Ahin, nathudoh donbutna dingin Thupeh chengse: Tolthat hih-in, Jonbol hih-in, gucha hih-in, dohan mi bol hih-in, nanu-napa jabolin, ti chu nahetai,” ati.
en: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”
text:
MRK 10:19
Thadou: Ahin, nathudoh donbutna dingin Thupeh chengse: Tolthat hih-in, Jonbol hih-in, gucha hih-in, dohan mi bol hih-in, nanu-napa jabolin, ti chu nahetai,” ati.
English: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”

tcz: Hichun khangdongpan, “Houhil, hichengse chu kachapan laiya pat kahin nitpeh ahitai,” ati.
en: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”
text:
MRK 10:20
Thadou: Hichun khangdongpan, “Houhil, hichengse chu kachapan laiya pat kahin nitpeh ahitai,” ati.
English: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amachu aven, angailu lheh jenge. Adonbutnan, “Thil khat nabat nalaiye, chen lang nanei chengse gajoh-in langvaicha gentheiho gahoppehtan, chutileh vangou nanei ding ahi. Chuleh hungin lang kanung juiyin,” ati.
en: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”
text:
MRK 10:21
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan amachu aven, angailu lheh jenge. Adonbutnan, “Thil khat nabat nalaiye, chen lang nanei chengse gajoh-in langvaicha gentheiho gahoppehtan, chutileh vangou nanei ding ahi. Chuleh hungin lang kanung juiyin,” ati.
