English: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”

tcz: Chucheng asei ajah phat'in amai athim jengtan, gou haotah ahijehin lungnom motah in achemangtan ahi.
en: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.
text:
MRK 10:22
Thadou: Chucheng asei ajah phat'in amai athim jengtan, gou haotah ahijehin lungnom motah in achemangtan ahi.
English: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan aseijuite avekimvelin, “Mihao theiho hi Pathen gam'a alut diu iti hahsat hitam!” ati.
en: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”
text:
MRK 10:23
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan aseijuite avekimvelin, “Mihao theiho hi Pathen gam'a alut diu iti hahsat hitam!” ati.
English: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”

tcz: Athusei chu aseijuiten adatmo lheh-uve, ahinlah Yeshuan asei kit'in, “Chateho, Pathen Lenggama luttheina ding hi thil hahsatah jong ahi,
en: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!
text:
MRK 10:24
Thadou: Athusei chu aseijuiten adatmo lheh-uve, ahinlah Yeshuan asei kit'in, “Chateho, Pathen Lenggama luttheina ding hi thil hahsatah jong ahi,
English: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

tcz: Tahbehin, mihaoho Pathen Lenggam alut sangin sangongsang heo-bil hom'a alut ding abaijoi!” ati.
en: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
text:
MRK 10:25
Thadou: Tahbehin, mihaoho Pathen Lenggam alut sangin sangongsang heo-bil hom'a alut ding abaijoi!” ati.
English: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

tcz: Amahon kidang asalheh jengun, “Achuti ahileh koi huhhing'a umjou ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”
text:
MRK 10:26
Thadou: Amahon kidang asalheh jengun, “Achuti ahileh koi huhhing'a umjou ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

tcz: Yeshuan amaho aven, “Mihem dingin hitheihih jongleh Pathen dingin ahimo aumpoi,” ati.
en: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”
text:
MRK 10:27
Thadou: Yeshuan amaho aven, “Mihem dingin hitheihih jongleh Pathen dingin ahimo aumpoi,” ati.
English: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

tcz: Chuin Peter ahung paodohin, “Keihon ijakai kadalhauvin nanung kahin juitauve,” ati.
en: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all and have followed you.”
text:
MRK 10:28
Thadou: Chuin Peter ahung paodohin, “Keihon ijakai kadalhauvin nanung kahin juitauve,” ati.
English: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all and have followed you.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Henge, ahinai. Chuleh tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, keima jal le Kipana Thupha jal'a a-in, asopi pasalho, asopi numei ho, anu, apa, achate chule anei-agou dalha hon,
en: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,
text:
MRK 10:29
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Henge, ahinai. Chuleh tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, keima jal le Kipana Thupha jal'a a-in, asopi pasalho, asopi numei ho, anu, apa, achate chule anei-agou dalha hon,
English: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,

tcz: Ajatja-a in le lou, sopi pasal, sopi numei, nulepa, chate chuleh nei le gou—bolsetna thohpum puma akisan ding ahi. Chuleh khonung hinkhoa tonsot hinkemlou anei ding ahi.
en: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.
text:
MRK 10:30
Thadou: Ajatja-a in le lou, sopi pasal, sopi numei, nulepa, chate chuleh nei le gou—bolsetna thohpum puma akisan ding ahi. Chuleh khonung hinkhoa tonsot hinkemlou anei ding ahi.
English: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

tcz: Amavang tua athupipenho hung thupimo pen intin, tua thupimo penho hung thupipen tante,” ati.
en: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”
text:
MRK 10:31
Thadou: Amavang tua athupipenho hung thupimo pen intin, tua thupimo penho hung thupipen tante,” ati.
English: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”

tcz: Hichun Jerusalem jonin achetou tauvin, Yeshua chu amasanguva achen ahileh aseijuiten adatmo lheh jeng uvin, chuleh anung uva cheho chu kichatnan adimuvin ahi. Aseijui somleni ho apangin achesah-in, hichun khonunga Ama chunga hunglhung ding thuho aseipeh kittan ahi.
en: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.
text:
MRK 10:32
Thadou: Hichun Jerusalem jonin achetou tauvin, Yeshua chu amasanguva achen ahileh aseijuiten adatmo lheh jeng uvin, chuleh anung uva cheho chu kichatnan adimuvin ahi. Aseijui somleni ho apangin achesah-in, hichun khonunga Ama chunga hunglhung ding thuho aseipeh kittan ahi.
English: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

tcz: “Veuvin, Jerusalem jonin ichetauve, chukoma chu Mihem Chapa hi thempu pipui hole danthu sunho khut'a pehdoh-a umding, chule amaho chun athina dinga themmo achansah uva hiding nam dangte khut'a apehdoh dingu,
en: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.
text:
MRK 10:33
Thadou: “Veuvin, Jerusalem jonin ichetauve, chukoma chu Mihem Chapa hi thempu pipui hole danthu sunho khut'a pehdoh-a umding, chule amaho chun athina dinga themmo achansah uva hiding nam dangte khut'a apehdoh dingu,
English: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.

tcz: Chuleh amaho chun a-el ela aboluva chil asetkhum dingu, avoh-uva chuleh atha dingu, chuleh nithum jouleh ama thoudoh kit ding ahi,” ati.
en: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”
text:
MRK 10:34
Thadou: Chuleh amaho chun a-el ela aboluva chil asetkhum dingu, avoh-uva chuleh atha dingu, chuleh nithum jouleh ama thoudoh kit ding ahi,” ati.
English: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

tcz: Chuin James le John, Zebedee chateni ahung lhonin akihoulimpi lhonin, “Houhil, kathum lhon neibolpeh tei lhon in,” atilhon e.
en: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”
text:
MRK 10:35
Thadou: Chuin James le John, Zebedee chateni ahung lhonin akihoulimpi lhonin, “Houhil, kathum lhon neibolpeh tei lhon in,” atilhon e.
English: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

tcz: Yeshuan, “Nathum lhon chu ipiham?” ati leh,
en: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
text:
MRK 10:36
Thadou: Yeshuan, “Nathum lhon chu ipiham?” ati leh,
English: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

tcz: Amanin, “Naloupina'a natou tengle khat najet lamah khat naveiyah neitousah lhonin,” atilhon tai.
en: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”
text:
MRK 10:37
Thadou: Amanin, “Naloupina'a natou tengle khat najet lamah khat naveiyah neitousah lhonin,” atilhon tai.
English: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan, “Nathum lhon nakihet lhon poi! Keiman chomkhat joule kahin don ding thohgimna khon khachep'a chu nadon ngapchat lhon ding hinam? Thohgimna twilut'a kachan ding chu nachan ngam lhon ding hinam?” tin adongtai.
en: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”
text:
MRK 10:38
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan, “Nathum lhon nakihet lhon poi! Keiman chomkhat joule kahin don ding thohgimna khon khachep'a chu nadon ngapchat lhon ding hinam? Thohgimna twilut'a kachan ding chu nachan ngam lhon ding hinam?” tin adongtai.
English: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

tcz: Amanin jong, “Henge, kangam lhonne!” tin aseilhon e. Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kadon ding khon'a vang nadon lhon ding ahin chule thohgimna twilut kachanna jong changngam lhon nan nate,
en: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

tcz: Ahivangin kajet le veiya tousah ding vang chu keima boltheidol ahipoi. Pathen in hichu alhendohsaho dinga agotsa ahitabouve,” ati.
en: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”
text:
MRK 10:40
Thadou: Ahivangin kajet le veiya tousah ding vang chu keima boltheidol ahipoi. Pathen in hichu alhendohsaho dinga agotsa ahitabouve,” ati.
English: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

tcz: Seijui som ho chun James le John thilthum ajah-u chun athimah-un alungphamouvin ahi.
en: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.
text:
MRK 10:41
Thadou: Seijui som ho chun James le John thilthum ajah-u chun athimah-un alungphamouvin ahi.
English: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

tcz: Yeshuan amaho chu akoukhomin, “Nanghon naheuve, leiset mite lah'a vaipo ho khu amite pakaiyin apangun chuleh gamvaipo milun milal-hon anoidouhou chunga athuneinau asouvin vai ahomuvin ahi.
en: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
text:
MRK 10:42
Thadou: Yeshuan amaho chu akoukhomin, “Nanghon naheuve, leiset mite lah'a vaipo ho khu amite pakaiyin apangun chuleh gamvaipo milun milal-hon anoidouhou chunga athuneinau asouvin vai ahomuvin ahi.
English: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

tcz: Nangho lah'a vang chutilou ding ahi. Koihileh nangho lah'a alen hinoma chu nalhachauva pang ding ahi.
en: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.
text:
MRK 10:43
Thadou: Nangho lah'a vang chutilou ding ahi. Koihileh nangho lah'a alen hinoma chu nalhachauva pang ding ahi.
English: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

tcz: Chuleh nalahuva apipuipen hinoma chu mijouse soh ahi ding angaiye.
en: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.
text:
MRK 10:44
Thadou: Chuleh nalahuva apipuipen hinoma chu mijouse soh ahi ding angaiye.
English: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.

tcz: Ijeh inem iti leh Mihem Chapa tah jong chu jen dinga hung hilouvin mijenle ding le mitampi lhatdohna dinga ahinna tohdoh ding joh-a hung ahibouve,” ati.
en: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
text:
MRK 10:45
Thadou: Ijeh inem iti leh Mihem Chapa tah jong chu jen dinga hung hilouvin mijenle ding le mitampi lhatdohna dinga ahinna tohdoh ding joh-a hung ahibouve,” ati.
English: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

tcz: Chuin amaho Jericho khopi alhungun, Yeshua le aseijuiten khopi sung adalhah ding kon'un mihonpi tamtah'in anung ahin juiyui. Chuti lai chun mitcho khat, Timaeus chapa Bartimaeus chu lampam'ah anatouve.
en: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.
text:
MRK 10:46
Thadou: Chuin amaho Jericho khopi alhungun, Yeshua le aseijuiten khopi sung adalhah ding kon'un mihonpi tamtah'in anung ahin juiyui. Chuti lai chun mitcho khat, Timaeus chapa Bartimaeus chu lampam'ah anatouve.
English: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

tcz: Nazareth Yeshua chu nailam chan aum taiti ahet phatnin, “Vo David chapa, neilungset in!” tin ahin sam pantan ahi.
en: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
text:
MRK 10:47
Thadou: Nazareth Yeshua chu nailam chan aum taiti ahet phatnin, “Vo David chapa, neilungset in!” tin ahin sam pantan ahi.
English: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

tcz: Mi tamtah chun, “Thipmin!” tin ama chu aphoh-un, ahivangin aman ging cheh-in, “David chapa, neilungset in!” tin ahin sam kit'e.
en: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
text:
MRK 10:48
Thadou: Mi tamtah chun, “Thipmin!” tin ama chu aphoh-un, ahivangin aman ging cheh-in, “David chapa, neilungset in!” tin ahin sam kit'e.
English: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

tcz: Yeshuan ajah phatnin adingdenin, “Hilama hung din seipeh-un,” atin, amahon jong mitchopa chu aganai pheiyun, “Kipah thanomin! Hungtan, Aman nakouve,” atipeh-un ahin pui tauve.
en: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”
text:
MRK 10:49
Thadou: Yeshuan ajah phatnin adingdenin, “Hilama hung din seipeh-un,” atin, amahon jong mitchopa chu aganai pheiyun, “Kipah thanomin! Hungtan, Aman nakouve,” atipeh-un ahin pui tauve.
English: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”

tcz: Hichun Bartimaeus chun asangkhol-tho chu asut in akoilhan, chuin akichom touvin Yeshua heng ahin jon tai.
en: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.
text:
MRK 10:50
Thadou: Hichun Bartimaeus chun asangkhol-tho chu asut in akoilhan, chuin akichom touvin Yeshua heng ahin jon tai.
English: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

tcz: Yeshuan, “Ipi bolpehleng nadeiyem?” tia adoh leh, mitchopan, “Houhil, kho muleng kati,” ati.
en: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”
text:
MRK 10:51
Thadou: Yeshuan, “Ipi bolpehleng nadeiyem?” tia adoh leh, mitchopan, “Houhil, kho muleng kati,” ati.
English: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah-a, “Chetan, natahsan in nadamsah tai,” ati leh, chupet tah chun kho amupai jengin, lamlhungin Yeshua ahin juitai.
en: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.
text:
MRK 10:52
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan ajah-a, “Chetan, natahsan in nadamsah tai,” ati leh, chupet tah chun kho amupai jengin, lamlhungin Yeshua ahin juitai.
English: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.

tcz: Hiti chun Yeshua le aseijuiten Jerusalem ahinjon tauvin, Olive Lhanga Bethphage le Bethany kho alhung tauve. Yeshuan aseijui mi ni anache masadin asol masan,
en: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples
text:
MRK 11:1
Thadou: Hiti chun Yeshua le aseijuiten Jerusalem ahinjon tauvin, Olive Lhanga Bethphage le Bethany kho alhung tauve. Yeshuan aseijui mi ni anache masadin asol masan,
English: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples

tcz: “Che lhon inlang, namasang jon lhon'a khopi sunga khun lut lhonin. Nalut lut lhon leh sangannou kihen, achunga koima touna khahlou lai khat namu pai lhon ding ahi. Hichu sutlha lhon inlang hinkaiphei lhonin.”
en: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.
text:
MRK 11:2
Thadou: “Che lhon inlang, namasang jon lhon'a khopi sunga khun lut lhonin. Nalut lut lhon leh sangannou kihen, achunga koima touna khahlou lai khat namu pai lhon ding ahi. Hichu sutlha lhon inlang hinkaiphei lhonin.”
English: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.

tcz: Mi khat touvin, “Ibola nasut lhonham? tia ahin doh leh, ‘Pakaiyin manna nom aneiye, chomkhat jouteng hinthahvah kit lhon nange,’ tilhon'in,” atipeh-e.
en: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”
text:
MRK 11:3
Thadou: Mi khat touvin, “Ibola nasut lhonham? tia ahin doh leh, ‘Pakaiyin manna nom aneiye, chomkhat jouteng hinthahvah kit lhon nange,’ tilhon'in,” atipeh-e.
English: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”

tcz: Seijui teni achelhon in, khopi sung lamlen'a inkot poa kotphunga sangannou kihen agamu lhontan ahi.
en: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.
text:
MRK 11:4
Thadou: Seijui teni achelhon in, khopi sung lamlen'a inkot poa kotphunga sangannou kihen agamu lhontan ahi.
English: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

tcz: Chuin asut lhon leh akoma anadingho loikhat in, “Ibola sangannou chu nasut lhon ham?” atiuvin,
en: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”
text:
MRK 11:5
Thadou: Chuin asut lhon leh akoma anadingho loikhat in, “Ibola sangannou chu nasut lhon ham?” atiuvin,
English: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”

tcz: Chuin amanin Yeshuan asei bang chun amaho komah aseilhonin ahile ahin phalpeh tauve.
en: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.
text:
MRK 11:6
Thadou: Chuin amanin Yeshuan asei bang chun amaho komah aseilhonin ahile ahin phalpeh tauve.
English: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

tcz: Sangannou chu Yeshua henga ahinkai lhonin, achunga apon'u asep'un, Ama achunga atoutan ahi.
en: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.
text:
MRK 11:7
Thadou: Sangannou chu Yeshua henga ahinkai lhonin, achunga apon'u asep'un, Ama achunga atoutan ahi.
English: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

tcz: Mipi atama tamin lampiah apon'u aphauvin, mi abangkhat in loulaiya theoboh asat'un lampiah aphauvin ahi.
en: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.
text:
MRK 11:8
Thadou: Mipi atama tamin lampiah apon'u aphauvin, mi abangkhat in loulaiya theoboh asat'un lampiah aphauvin ahi.
English: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.

tcz: Yeshua chu alailunga achesah'un, amasang lam le anunglama, “Pathen thangvah-in umhen! Pakai min'a hungpa chu anunnome!
en: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!
text:
MRK 11:9
Thadou: Yeshua chu alailunga achesah'un, amasang lam le anunglama, “Pathen thangvah-in umhen! Pakai min'a hungpa chu anunnome!
English: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!

tcz: Lenggam hung lhung ding Pu David gam chu phattheiboh chang hihen! Chungnungpen'a Pathen chu thangvah-in umhen!” tin asam asam'un ahi.
en: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
text:
MRK 11:10
Thadou: Lenggam hung lhung ding Pu David gam chu phattheiboh chang hihen! Chungnungpen'a Pathen chu thangvah-in umhen!” tin asam asam'un ahi.
English: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

tcz: Chuin Jerusalem khopia houin'a chun Yeshua agalut'in, ijakai avet kimvel sohkei jouvin, nilhah lam jong ahitan, apot in somleni ho cheng toh Bethany'a akilekit tauvin ahi.
en: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.
text:
MRK 11:11
Thadou: Chuin Jerusalem khopia houin'a chun Yeshua agalut'in, ijakai avet kimvel sohkei jouvin, nilhah lam jong ahitan, apot in somleni ho cheng toh Bethany'a akilekit tauvin ahi.
English: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

tcz: Chuin ajingkah-in Bethany'a kon'a ahung potdoh leh agil akeltan ahi.
en: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.
text:
MRK 11:12
Thadou: Chuin ajingkah-in Bethany'a kon'a ahung potdoh leh agil akeltan ahi.
English: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

tcz: Hichun theichangphung amun, aga aum khattoule tia agavetle theiga phat lhingjep nailou ahitoh lhonin ado tailou aga ima amutapoi.
en: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
text:
MRK 11:13
Thadou: Hichun theichangphung amun, aga aum khattoule tia agavetle theiga phat lhingjep nailou ahitoh lhonin ado tailou aga ima amutapoi.
English: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

tcz: Yeshuan thingphung jah-a chun, “Tukallhah koiman natheiga nekit tahih hen!” atitan ahi. Chutia aseichu aseijuiten anajauvin ahi.
en: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.
text:
MRK 11:14
Thadou: Yeshuan thingphung jah-a chun, “Tukallhah koiman natheiga nekit tahih hen!” atitan ahi. Chutia aseichu aseijuiten anajauvin ahi.
English: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

tcz: Chuin Jerusalem ahung lhun'un, Yeshua houin sunga alut in, asunga thiljoh holeh thilchoho anodoh pantan, chule sumlhengho dokhang le vakhu johho touna chu alekhup peh tan ahi.
en: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.
text:
MRK 11:15
Thadou: Chuin Jerusalem ahung lhun'un, Yeshua houin sunga alut in, asunga thiljoh holeh thilchoho anodoh pantan, chule sumlhengho dokhang le vakhu johho touna chu alekhup peh tan ahi.
English: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

tcz: Houin sunga chun koima thilkeo apohle ding ajanom tapoi.
en: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.
text:
MRK 11:16
Thadou: Houin sunga chun koima thilkeo apohle ding ajanom tapoi.
English: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

tcz: Ajah-uva aseiyin, “Thubua: ‘Ka-in chu namtin dinga taona in kitiding ahi,’ tia kisun hilouham? Ahin nanghon gucha michomho kokhuh in naso tauve,” atin ahousetai.
en: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”
text:
MRK 11:17
Thadou: Ajah-uva aseiyin, “Thubua: ‘Ka-in chu namtin dinga taona in kitiding ahi,’ tia kisun hilouham? Ahin nanghon gucha michomho kokhuh in naso tauve,” atin ahousetai.
English: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”

tcz: Hichu thempu pipui hole hou danthu themhon ajauvin ahile, athimah tauvin, Yeshua tha ding tohgon aneipan tauve. Hinlah mipin athuhil chu kidang asah-uva angainom jeh-u chun Ama chu akichauvin ahi.
en: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.
text:
MRK 11:18
Thadou: Hichu thempu pipui hole hou danthu themhon ajauvin ahile, athimah tauvin, Yeshua tha ding tohgon aneipan tauve. Hinlah mipin athuhil chu kidang asah-uva angainom jeh-u chun Ama chu akichauvin ahi.
English: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

tcz: Hiche nilhah chun Yeshua le aseijuiten khopi adalha tauve.
en: When evening came, he went out of the city.
text:
MRK 11:19
Thadou: Hiche nilhah chun Yeshua le aseijuiten khopi adalha tauve.
English: When evening came, he went out of the city.

tcz: Ajing jingkah-a theichang phung chu ahin jotpau leh anagoplhasa-a aum chu amutauve.
en: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
text:
MRK 11:20
Thadou: Ajing jingkah-a theichang phung chu ahin jotpau leh anagoplhasa-a aum chu amutauve.
English: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

tcz: Chuin Peter in ageldoh-in, “Vetan Houhil, theichangphung nagaosap chu agoptai!” ati.
en: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”
text:
MRK 11:21
Thadou: Chuin Peter in ageldoh-in, “Vetan Houhil, theichangphung nagaosap chu agoptai!” ati.
English: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen tahsanun,
en: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.
text:
MRK 11:22
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen tahsanun,
English: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.

tcz: Tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, koihileh hiche mol jah-a, ‘Kichondoh'in lang twikhanglen'ah kilehlut tan,’ ati leh chutijeng ding ahi. Hinlah hichu tahsanna dihtah nei lelung-opkaina beihel ahi angaiye.
en: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.
text:
MRK 11:23
Thadou: Tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, koihileh hiche mol jah-a, ‘Kichondoh'in lang twikhanglen'ah kilehlut tan,’ ati leh chutijeng ding ahi. Hinlah hichu tahsanna dihtah nei lelung-opkaina beihel ahi angaiye.
English: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu kasei ahi, nataova thil nathum chan chu namusan ngaito leuchun namu dingu ahi.
en: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
text:
MRK 11:24
Thadou: Hiche jeh a chu kasei ahi, nataova thil nathum chan chu namusan ngaito leuchun namu dingu ahi.
English: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

tcz: Chule atao dinga nadinpet leh van'a na-Pauvin jong nasuh khelnau angaidam theina din koi hijongle nadou uchu ngaidamun.
en: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.
text:
MRK 11:25
Thadou: Chule atao dinga nadinpet leh van'a na-Pauvin jong nasuh khelnau angaidam theina din koi hijongle nadou uchu ngaidamun.
English: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

tcz: Nanghon mi suhkhel nangaidamlou vangule van'a na-Pauvin nangho suhkhel jong angaidam louding ahi,” ati.
en: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”
text:
MRK 11:26
Thadou: Nanghon mi suhkhel nangaidamlou vangule van'a na-Pauvin nangho suhkhel jong angaidam louding ahi,” ati.
English: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”

tcz: Jerusalem ahung lhung kit tauvin, Yeshua Houin sungah agavahlen ahileh thempu pipui holeh danthusunho ahenga ahungun,
en: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,
text:
MRK 11:27
Thadou: Jerusalem ahung lhung kit tauvin, Yeshua Houin sungah agavahlen ahileh thempu pipui holeh danthusunho ahenga ahungun,
English: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,

tcz: “Ipi thuneina'a hitihohi nabolham? Hitobang bolna dinga kon thaneina napeh ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”
text:
MRK 11:28
Thadou: “Ipi thuneina'a hitihohi nabolham? Hitobang bolna dinga kon thaneina napeh ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

tcz: “Keiman thukhat nadong uvingting neidonbut'un lang chuteng keiman jong ipi thuneina'a hichehi kabol ham naseipeh nauvinge,” tin Yeshuan adonbut in ahi.
en: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
text:
MRK 11:29
Thadou: “Keiman thukhat nadong uvingting neidonbut'un lang chuteng keiman jong ipi thuneina'a hichehi kabol ham naseipeh nauvinge,” tin Yeshuan adonbut in ahi.
English: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

tcz: Hichun, “John chun twilutsah abol thuneina chu vanna kon ha, mihem a kon ham? Nei donbut'un!” tin adongtai.
en: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”
text:
MRK 11:30
Thadou: Hichun, “John chun twilutsah abol thuneina chu vanna kon ha, mihem a kon ham? Nei donbut'un!” tin adongtai.
English: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”

tcz: Amaho le amaho akidongto uvin, “Vanna kon ahi tileu hen achutileh ibola John natoh natahsanlou uham tintin,
en: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
text:
MRK 11:31
Thadou: Amaho le amaho akidongto uvin, “Vanna kon ahi tileu hen achutileh ibola John natoh natahsanlou uham tintin,
English: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

tcz: Mihem a kon ahi iti ngam diu baham?” akitiuvin ahi. Amaho akichauvin ahi—mijousen John chu themgao tahbeh'a angaito cheh-u ahijeh chun.
en: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.
text:
MRK 11:32
Thadou: Mihem a kon ahi iti ngam diu baham?” akitiuvin ahi. Amaho akichauvin ahi—mijousen John chu themgao tahbeh'a angaito cheh-u ahijeh chun.
English: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

tcz: Achainan adonbut un, “Kahepouve,” atitauve. Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Achutile ipi thuneina'a hicheng hi kabol ham ti keiman jong naseipeh povinge,” atitai.
en: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
text:
MRK 11:33
Thadou: Achainan adonbut un, “Kahepouve,” atitauve. Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Achutile ipi thuneina'a hicheng hi kabol ham ti keiman jong naseipeh povinge,” atitai.
English: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan thulem in thu ahil pantan: “Mikhatnin lengpilei abolin, akimvel ah pal agenin ahi. Chuin achilna ding khuh alaiyin, insang asan, chuin aleilhouho khut'ah lousan dingin apedoh in gamdangah achetan ahi.
en: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.
text:
MRK 12:1
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan thulem in thu ahil pantan: “Mikhatnin lengpilei abolin, akimvel ah pal agenin ahi. Chuin achilna ding khuh alaiyin, insang asan, chuin aleilhouho khut'ah lousan dingin apedoh in gamdangah achetan ahi.
English: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

tcz: Aga lo phat ahi phat'in ama chan ding chu lading in aleilhou ho henga asoh ho khat asoltai.
en: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
text:
MRK 12:2
Thadou: Aga lo phat ahi phat'in ama chan ding chu lading in aleilhou ho henga asoh ho khat asoltai.
English: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

tcz: Hinlah leilhouho chun amapa chu amanun avouvin, khutgoh keovin ahin soldoh tauve.
en: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.
text:
MRK 12:3
Thadou: Hinlah leilhouho chun amapa chu amanun avouvin, khutgoh keovin ahin soldoh tauve.
English: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

tcz: Chuin lou neipan asohho khat asol kit leh ama jongchu ajumso uvin, alu ahin vohpeh-uve.
en: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
text:
MRK 12:4
Thadou: Chuin lou neipan asohho khat asol kit leh ama jongchu ajumso uvin, alu ahin vohpeh-uve.
English: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

tcz: Chujouvin achom khat asol kit'in ahile ama chu ahin that tauve. Chule adang asol ho jong abang ahin vouvin, abang ahin that un ahi.
en: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.
text:
MRK 12:5
Thadou: Chujouvin achom khat asol kit'in ahile ama chu ahin that tauve. Chule adang asol ho jong abang ahin vouvin, abang ahin that un ahi.
English: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.

tcz: Asolthei ding khat bou aumtan, ama chu achapa deitah chu ahi. Lou neipan achainakeiyin, ‘Kachapa ahijeh'in anajabol nauvinte,’ tin ama chu asoltan,
en: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
text:
MRK 12:6
Thadou: Asolthei ding khat bou aumtan, ama chu achapa deitah chu ahi. Lou neipan achainakeiyin, ‘Kachapa ahijeh'in anajabol nauvinte,’ tin ama chu asoltan,
English: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

tcz: Ahinlah aleilhouho chu akihouvun, ‘Veuvin, agamngah ding, agou loding pa ahunge, khaiye! Thatdoh-utin agam hi eiho chang taute,’ aki tiuvin ahi.
en: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
text:
MRK 12:7
Thadou: Ahinlah aleilhouho chu akihouvun, ‘Veuvin, agamngah ding, agou loding pa ahunge, khaiye! Thatdoh-utin agam hi eiho chang taute,’ aki tiuvin ahi.
English: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

tcz: Chuin aman'un, athat'un along chu lengpilei polam'ah alehdoh tauvin ahi.
en: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
text:
MRK 12:8
Thadou: Chuin aman'un, athat'un along chu lengpilei polam'ah alehdoh tauvin ahi.
English: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

tcz: Hichan gei chu ahitahleh lengpilei neipa chun leilhou ho chu i-lotante tia nagel uvem? Naseipeh-unge—ama hung intin aleilhouho chu sugamintin lengpilei chu midang pedoh tante.
en: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.
text:
MRK 12:9
Thadou: Hichan gei chu ahitahleh lengpilei neipa chun leilhou ho chu i-lotante tia nagel uvem? Naseipeh-unge—ama hung intin aleilhouho chu sugamintin lengpilei chu midang pedoh tante.
English: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

tcz: Thubua kisun: ‘Insahon adeimouva apaiyu song chu inning songin apangtan,
en: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.
text:
MRK 12:10
Thadou: Thubua kisun: ‘Insahon adeimouva apaiyu song chu inning songin apangtan,
English: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.

tcz: hichehi Pakai thilbol ahin, vetdingin avetlom lheh-e,’ tia kisun chu nasim dohkhah-uvem?” tin adonge.
en: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”
text:
MRK 12:11
Thadou: hichehi Pakai thilbol ahin, vetdingin avetlom lheh-e,’ tia kisun chu nasim dohkhah-uvem?” tin adonge.
English: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”

tcz: Chupet'a um hou lamkaiho chun—leilhou migilou ho chu amaho toh kitekahna'a kisei ahi tin agel tauvin, Yeshua chu matding ago tauvin ahi. Ahinlah mipiho akichat kit jeh-uvin, adalha uvin achemang tauve.
en: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.
text:
MRK 12:12
Thadou: Chupet'a um hou lamkaiho chun—leilhou migilou ho chu amaho toh kitekahna'a kisei ahi tin agel tauvin, Yeshua chu matding ago tauvin ahi. Ahinlah mipiho akichat kit jeh-uvin, adalha uvin achemang tauve.
English: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin lamkaiho chun thua themmo chansah-a mattheina ding in Pharisee ho phabep khat le Herod miho phabep chu Yeshua thudoh bol ding in asol un ahi.
en: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
text:
MRK 12:13
Thadou: Chomkhat jouvin lamkaiho chun thua themmo chansah-a mattheina ding in Pharisee ho phabep khat le Herod miho phabep chu Yeshua thudoh bol ding in asol un ahi.
English: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

tcz: Hichun agacheuvin, “Houhil, Nangma midih nahin, koima gin naneipoi. Dihtah'a Pathen lampi chu nahil ahi chu kaheuve. Ahile neiseipehun—Caesar kai kapeh-uhi dihthei ding hinam ahiloule dihlou ding ham?”
en: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
text:
MRK 12:14
Thadou: Hichun agacheuvin, “Houhil, Nangma midih nahin, koima gin naneipoi. Dihtah'a Pathen lampi chu nahil ahi chu kaheuve. Ahile neiseipehun—Caesar kai kapeh-uhi dihthei ding hinam ahiloule dihlou ding ham?”
English: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

tcz: Kapeh diu ham, kapehlou diu ham? agatiuve. Yeshuan aphatlhemnau chu amudoh'in, adonbutnan, “Ibola neilunglah patep uham? Romte dangka-pumkhat hinchoiyun langnei vetsah un, chule naseipeh-uvinge,” ati.
en: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”
text:
MRK 12:15
Thadou: Kapeh diu ham, kapehlou diu ham? agatiuve. Yeshuan aphatlhemnau chu amudoh'in, adonbutnan, “Ibola neilunglah patep uham? Romte dangka-pumkhat hinchoiyun langnei vetsah un, chule naseipeh-uvinge,” ati.
English: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”

tcz: Ahin choi phat'un, Yeshuan aven, “Hichea kinam hi koi lim le koi min ham?” tia adohleh, amahon “Caesar a ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
text:
MRK 12:16
Thadou: Ahin choi phat'un, Yeshuan aven, “Hichea kinam hi koi lim le koi min ham?” tia adohleh, amahon “Caesar a ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
English: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan, “Chuti ahile aphai, Caesar a chu Caesar peuvin lang, Pathen'a chu Pathen peuvin,” atipeh tai. Adonbutna chu adatmo lheh jeng un ahi.
en: Jesus answered them, “Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.
text:
MRK 12:17
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan, “Chuti ahile aphai, Caesar a chu Caesar peuvin lang, Pathen'a chu Pathen peuvin,” atipeh tai. Adonbutna chu adatmo lheh jeng un ahi.
English: Jesus answered them, “Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.

tcz: Chujouvin Sadducee—mithi thokitna aumpoi tiho—chu ahengah ahung un, ajah-a thudoh aneiyun,
en: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,
text:
MRK 12:18
Thadou: Chujouvin Sadducee—mithi thokitna aumpoi tiho—chu ahengah ahung un, ajah-a thudoh aneiyun,
English: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,

tcz: “Houhil, Mosen eithupeh dungjuiyun mi khattouvin cha neilouva ajinu adalhah'a, athi tah'a ahile, asopipa chun ajinu chu vehen lang asopipa phunggui amanlouna ding chun chi khaipeh hen tin akiseiye.
en: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’
text:
MRK 12:19
Thadou: “Houhil, Mosen eithupeh dungjuiyun mi khattouvin cha neilouva ajinu adalhah'a, athi tah'a ahile, asopipa chun ajinu chu vehen lang asopipa phunggui amanlouna ding chun chi khaipeh hen tin akiseiye.
English: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

tcz: Achutile, tekahnan ucha pasal sagi aume. Amasapenpa chun ji aneiyin chikhai louvin athitai.
en: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.
text:
MRK 12:20
Thadou: Achutile, tekahnan ucha pasal sagi aume. Amasapenpa chun ji aneiyin chikhai louvin athitai.
English: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

tcz: Aban'a pan amanu chu jin aneiyin chikhai louvin athin, athumnapa jong chutima chu ahin,
en: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

tcz: Hitichun akitol suhpeh tauvin, asagiuvin chikhailou ahitauve. Achainan numeinu jong chu athitai.
en: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.
text:
MRK 12:22
Thadou: Hitichun akitol suhpeh tauvin, asagiuvin chikhailou ahitauve. Achainan numeinu jong chu athitai.
English: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

tcz: Ahileh tun neiseipeh-un, thokit nia amanu chu alah uva koipen ji hitantem? Ijeh-inem iti leh asagiuva amanu chu jia anei cheh-u ahitai,” atiuve.
en: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”
text:
MRK 12:23
Thadou: Ahileh tun neiseipeh-un, thokit nia amanu chu alah uva koipen ji hitantem? Ijeh-inem iti leh asagiuva amanu chu jia anei cheh-u ahitai,” atiuve.
English: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nasuhkhel'u chu Pathen thubua thu kisei nahethem pouvin chule Pathen thaneina nahet lou uhi ahi.
en: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?
text:
MRK 12:24
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nasuhkhel'u chu Pathen thubua thu kisei nahethem pouvin chule Pathen thaneina nahet lou uhi ahi.
English: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?

tcz: Ijeh-inem iti leh mithiho athodoh tengu chule ji anei tahlou diu chujongleh kichensahna umtalou ding ahi. Hiche thudol'a hi vanna Vantilte tobang hiding ahitauve.
en: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
text:
MRK 12:25
Thadou: Ijeh-inem iti leh mithiho athodoh tengu chule ji anei tahlou diu chujongleh kichensahna umtalou ding ahi. Hiche thudol'a hi vanna Vantilte tobang hiding ahitauve.
English: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

tcz: Ahileh, mithiho kaithouva aum diu thudol hi—Mose'n hamboh meikou thudol asutna-ah, Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob thi jou khonungpeh-a Pathen in Mose koma, ‘Keima Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen chule Jacob Pathen kahi,’ tia asei thu chu sim khalou nahiuvem?
en: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
text:
MRK 12:26
Thadou: Ahileh, mithiho kaithouva aum diu thudol hi—Mose'n hamboh meikou thudol asutna-ah, Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob thi jou khonungpeh-a Pathen in Mose koma, ‘Keima Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen chule Jacob Pathen kahi,’ tia asei thu chu sim khalou nahiuvem?
English: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

tcz: Chu dungjuiya chu ama ahingho Pathen ahin, athihoa ahipoi. Nanghon thuhettohlou suhkhelna lentah naneiyu ahitai,” ati.
en: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”
text:
MRK 12:27
Thadou: Chu dungjuiya chu ama ahingho Pathen ahin, athihoa ahipoi. Nanghon thuhettohlou suhkhelna lentah naneiyu ahitai,” ati.
English: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”

tcz: Chua hou danthuhilho lah'a khat in akihounau chu anajan, Yeshuan kichentah'a ahil chu ahechen in, hijeh chun aman Yeshua jah-a, “Thupeh jouse lah'a hoichepen hi thupipen ham?” tin adongtai.
en: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”
text:
MRK 12:28
Thadou: Chua hou danthuhilho lah'a khat in akihounau chu anajan, Yeshuan kichentah'a ahil chu ahechen in, hijeh chun aman Yeshua jah-a, “Thupeh jouse lah'a hoichepen hi thupipen ham?” tin adongtai.
English: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Thupeh pipen chu hichehi ahi: ‘Ngaiyun, vo Israel! Pakai Pathen hi khatseh bou ahi.
en: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.
text:
MRK 12:29
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Thupeh pipen chu hichehi ahi: ‘Ngaiyun, vo Israel! Pakai Pathen hi khatseh bou ahi.
English: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

tcz: Nangman Pakai na-Pathen chu, nalung pumpi, nahinna pumpi, nangaitona pumpi chule nathaneina jousea nangailut mong mong ding ahi.’
en: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.
text:
MRK 12:30
Thadou: Nangman Pakai na-Pathen chu, nalung pumpi, nahinna pumpi, nangaitona pumpi chule nathaneina jousea nangailut mong mong ding ahi.’
English: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.

tcz: Anina jong kibangchet'in athupin ahi, hichu: ‘Nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun.’ Hicheteni sanga thupijo thupeh dang aumpoi,” ati.
en: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”
text:
MRK 12:31
Thadou: Anina jong kibangchet'in athupin ahi, hichu: ‘Nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun.’ Hicheteni sanga thupijo thupeh dang aumpoi,” ati.
English: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

tcz: Hou dan thuhilpan adonbut in, “Naseihoi ngeiye, Houhil. Nangman thudihtah in thu naseiyin Pathen khatseh bou aume, Pathen dang aumpoi nati-e.
en: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;

tcz: Chule Pathen chu lungthim pumpi, khohet theina pumpi le thanei jousea ngailut ding ahi chu kahen, chule eima ikingailut banga iheng ikom ngailut ding jong chu kahei. Hichu ganpum goa kilhainale longlhenna sangin gamchengin aphajoi,” ati.
en: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
text:
MRK 12:33
Thadou: Chule Pathen chu lungthim pumpi, khohet theina pumpi le thanei jousea ngailut ding ahi chu kahen, chule eima ikingailut banga iheng ikom ngailut ding jong chu kahei. Hichu ganpum goa kilhainale longlhenna sangin gamchengin aphajoi,” ati.
English: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

tcz: Danthuhilpan kichentah'a adonbut ajah phat'in Yeshuan ajah-a aseiyin, “Nangma Pathen Lenggam toh nakigamlat poi,” atipeh tai. Chukal chun koiman thudang adongngam tapoi. David Chapa Thudol Asei
en: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.
text:
MRK 12:34
Thadou: Danthuhilpan kichentah'a adonbut ajah phat'in Yeshuan ajah-a aseiyin, “Nangma Pathen Lenggam toh nakigamlat poi,” atipeh tai. Chukal chun koiman thudang adongngam tapoi. David Chapa Thudol Asei
English: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Yeshuan houin sungathu ahil pet'in miho adongin, “Danthusunhon Messiah chu iti David chapa ahi atiu hintem?
en: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
text:
MRK 12:35
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Yeshuan houin sungathu ahil pet'in miho adongin, “Danthusunhon Messiah chu iti David chapa ahi atiu hintem?
English: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

tcz: Ijeh-inem iti leh Lhagao Thengin ahil a konin David jengin jong, ‘Pakaiyin ka-Pakai jah-ah, jabolna mun'ah kajet lamin touvin namelmate cheng nakeng chotphaa kaneisah masangsen,’ anatin ahi.
en: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
text:
MRK 12:36
Thadou: Ijeh-inem iti leh Lhagao Thengin ahil a konin David jengin jong, ‘Pakaiyin ka-Pakai jah-ah, jabolna mun'ah kajet lamin touvin namelmate cheng nakeng chotphaa kaneisah masangsen,’ anatin ahi.
English: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

tcz: David amatah'in Pakai chu Pakai asah-in, achutileh achapa iti hithei dingham?” atin ahi. Mipi chun Yeshua thusei chu thanomtah'in angaiyui.
en: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.
text:
MRK 12:37
Thadou: David amatah'in Pakai chu Pakai asah-in, achutileh achapa iti hithei dingham?” atin ahi. Mipi chun Yeshua thusei chu thanomtah'in angaiyui.
English: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

tcz: Yeshuan aseibe kit'in, “Danthusunhoa konin kihongphauvin! Ajehchu amahon sangkhol chol kiah-a kholailenna chule kailhanga min chibai aboh diu athanoppiuve.
en: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,
text:
MRK 12:38
Thadou: Yeshuan aseibe kit'in, “Danthusunhoa konin kihongphauvin! Ajehchu amahon sangkhol chol kiah-a kholailenna chule kailhanga min chibai aboh diu athanoppiuve.
English: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

tcz: Chule kikhopna in le golvahna'a touna pipen adeiyui.
en: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,
text:
MRK 12:39
Thadou: Chule kikhopna in le golvahna'a touna pipen adeiyui.

en: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.

English: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

en: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.
text:
MRK 14:5
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itileh hiche thaonamtui hi kijohleh kum lhunga thalo jat toh kikot intin, hichu vaicha gentheiho pehthei hiding!” atiuvin aphunkhum tauvin ahi.
English: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.

tcz: Ahinlah Yeshuan adonbut in, “Amanu chu oimo hih-un, keima'a dinga thilphatah abol ahitai.
en: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.
text:
MRK 14:6
Thadou: Ahinlah Yeshuan adonbut in, “Amanu chu oimo hih-un, keima'a dinga thilphatah abol ahitai.
English: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

tcz: Ijeh inem iti leh vaicha le gentheiho nakomuva aum jing nauve, nagot chan uva nahu theiyu ahi. Kei vang nakom uva um jing ding kahipoi.
en: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.
text:
MRK 14:7
Thadou: Ijeh inem iti leh vaicha le gentheiho nakomuva aum jing nauve, nagot chan uva nahu theiyu ahi. Kei vang nakom uva um jing ding kahipoi.
English: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

tcz: Amanun abolthei chan abol ahitai. Ka thilong chu vuiya ahung umtheina dinga thao einu masat ahitai.
en: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.
text:
MRK 14:8
Thadou: Amanun abolthei chan abol ahitai. Ka thilong chu vuiya ahung umtheina dinga thao einu masat ahitai.
English: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

tcz: Keiman tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, vannoi pumpia Kipana Thupha kilhangsapna chan'a hiche numeinu thilbol jong hi amanu hetjingna'a kisei toupeh ding ahi,” ati.
en: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”
text:
MRK 14:9
Thadou: Keiman tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, vannoi pumpia Kipana Thupha kilhangsapna chan'a hiche numeinu thilbol jong hi amanu hetjingna'a kisei toupeh ding ahi,” ati.
English: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”

tcz: Chuin somleni ho lah'a mi khat Juda Iscariot chun Yeshua chu matsah theina dingin thempu ho henga aga chen ahi.
en: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.
text:
MRK 14:10
Thadou: Chuin somleni ho lah'a mi khat Juda Iscariot chun Yeshua chu matsah theina dingin thempu ho henga aga chen ahi.
English: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

tcz: Amahon ahet phat'un akipatdoh un, ama chu sumpeh ding in atem tauvin ahi. Chuin aman Yeshua chu pehdoha matsah theina ding agomkom aholtan ahi.
en: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.
text:
MRK 14:11
Thadou: Amahon ahet phat'un akipatdoh un, ama chu sumpeh ding in atem tauvin ahi. Chuin aman Yeshua chu pehdoha matsah theina ding agomkom aholtan ahi.
English: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

tcz: Cholsolou Changlhah Kut nimasa nia Kalchuh Kut kelngoi atha pet uvin aseijuiten ajah-ah, “Kalchuh Kut Ankong hoikoma kagon diu nadeiyem?” atiuvin ahi.
en: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”
text:
MRK 14:12
Thadou: Cholsolou Changlhah Kut nimasa nia Kalchuh Kut kelngoi atha pet uvin aseijuiten ajah-ah, “Kalchuh Kut Ankong hoikoma kagon diu nadeiyem?” atiuvin ahi.
English: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

tcz: Hichun aseijui mi ni khopi sunga gache lhon din asolin, “Khopi sung nalut lhon teng, twibel pua mi khat nato lhon ding ahi. Amachu jui lhonin.
en: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,
text:
MRK 14:13
Thadou: Hichun aseijui mi ni khopi sunga gache lhon din asolin, “Khopi sung nalut lhon teng, twibel pua mi khat nato lhon ding ahi. Amachu jui lhonin.
English: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,

tcz: Ama alutna inneipa jah-a chun, ‘Houhil'in: kaseijuite toh Kalchuh Kut ankong kasokhomna diu indan chu hoilai ham? ati,’ gati lhon in.
en: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
text:
MRK 14:14
Thadou: Ama alutna inneipa jah-a chun, ‘Houhil'in: kaseijuite toh Kalchuh Kut ankong kasokhomna diu indan chu hoilai ham? ati,’ gati lhon in.
English: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

tcz: Chule ama tah-in insong chunga indan lentah gontupsa a kikoi khat navetsah lhon ding ahi. Hikom chu ahi inehkhomna diuva nagonna diu mun chu,” ati.
en: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”
text:
MRK 14:15
Thadou: Chule ama tah-in insong chunga indan lentah gontupsa a kikoi khat navetsah lhon ding ahi. Hikom chu ahi inehkhomna diuva nagonna diu mun chu,” ati.
English: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”

tcz: Chuin seijui teni chu apot lhon in, khopi sungah alut lhon in, akisei bang chun imajouse chu agatoh lhonin, Kalchuh Kut an ding chu agagong lhon tai.
en: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.
text:
MRK 14:16
Thadou: Chuin seijui teni chu apot lhon in, khopi sungah alut lhon in, akisei bang chun imajouse chu agatoh lhonin, Kalchuh Kut an ding chu agagong lhon tai.
English: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

tcz: Hichun nilhah-in Yeshua aseijuite toh chua chun agalhung tauve.
en: When it was evening he came with the twelve.
text:
MRK 14:17
Thadou: Hichun nilhah-in Yeshua aseijuite toh chua chun agalhung tauve.
English: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

tcz: Atou uva an aneh laitah-un, Yeshuan aseiyin, “Tahbeha kasei ahi, tua kaneh khompi lah-a khat hin eipeh doh ding ahi,” ati.
en: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”
text:
MRK 14:18
Thadou: Atou uva an aneh laitah-un, Yeshuan aseiyin, “Tahbeha kasei ahi, tua kaneh khompi lah-a khat hin eipeh doh ding ahi,” ati.
English: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”

tcz: Amaho alungkham pan tauvin, banneichan khat khat in ahin dongui, “Kei kahim?” tin.
en: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”
text:
MRK 14:19
Thadou: Amaho alungkham pan tauvin, banneichan khat khat in ahin dongui, “Kei kahim?” tin.
English: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”

tcz: Aman adonbut in, “Nangho somleni lah'a khat, tua lhengkong kasokhompi hi ahi.
en: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.
text:
MRK 14:20
Thadou: Aman adonbut in, “Nangho somleni lah'a khat, tua lhengkong kasokhompi hi ahi.
English: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

tcz: Mihem Chapa chu athi ding dol masanglai peh'a pat Thubua anakiseisa ahitai. Hinama jongleh, Mihem Chapa melmate khut'a pedoh-a johdohpa chu—Ohe, ada nading e! Ama chu apen'a anapenglou hile ama dinga phajo dinga!” ati.
en: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
text:
MRK 14:21
Thadou: Mihem Chapa chu athi ding dol masanglai peh'a pat Thubua anakiseisa ahitai. Hinama jongleh, Mihem Chapa melmate khut'a pedoh-a johdohpa chu—Ohe, ada nading e! Ama chu apen'a anapenglou hile ama dinga phajo dinga!” ati.
English: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

tcz: Chuin a-anneh laitah'un Yeshuan changlhah phabep alan, hichu phatthei aboh in, chuin ahehbalbal'in aseijuiteho apen, “Hichehi katahsa ahi, neuvin,” ati.
en: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”
text:
MRK 14:22
Thadou: Chuin a-anneh laitah'un Yeshuan changlhah phabep alan, hichu phatthei aboh in, chuin ahehbalbal'in aseijuiteho apen, “Hichehi katahsa ahi, neuvin,” ati.
English: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”

tcz: Chule khon'a lengpitwi alan, phatthei aboh-in amahochu apen, chutichun abonchauvin adonsohkei tauvin ahi.
en: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.
text:
MRK 14:23
Thadou: Chule khon'a lengpitwi alan, phatthei aboh-in amahochu apen, chutichun abonchauvin adonsohkei tauvin ahi.
English: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

tcz: Chuin Aman ajah'uva aseiyin, “Hiche hi ka thisan, Pathen le amite kah'a kitepna thah um photchetna ahi. Hiche hi mi tamtah chonset ngaidamna dinga longdoh ahi.
en: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.
text:
MRK 14:24
Thadou: Chuin Aman ajah'uva aseiyin, “Hiche hi ka thisan, Pathen le amite kah'a kitepna thah um photchetna ahi. Hiche hi mi tamtah chonset ngaidamna dinga longdoh ahi.
English: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

tcz: Tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, keiman Pathen Lenggama athah-a kadon kit ni ding tailou lengpitwi hi kadonlou ding ahitai,” ati.
en: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”
text:
MRK 14:25
Thadou: Tahbeha kaseipeh nahiuve, keiman Pathen Lenggama athah-a kadon kit ni ding tailou lengpitwi hi kadonlou ding ahitai,” ati.
English: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”

tcz: Hichun la asauvin, chujouvin apotdoh'un Olive Lhang lamah ache tauvin ahi.
en: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
text:
MRK 14:26
Thadou: Hichun la asauvin, chujouvin apotdoh'un Olive Lhang lamah ache tauvin ahi.
English: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

tcz: Lampia achepet'un Yeshuan ajah'uva aseiye, “Nangho naboncha uva nalungthoi sohkeidiu ahi. Ijeh-inem iti leh, Pathen thubun: ‘Keiman kelngoi chingpa kavohlhuh ding ahi, chujou teng akelngoite chu chehchao diu ahi,’ ati.
en: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
text:
MRK 14:27
Thadou: Lampia achepet'un Yeshuan ajah'uva aseiye, “Nangho naboncha uva nalungthoi sohkeidiu ahi. Ijeh-inem iti leh, Pathen thubun: ‘Keiman kelngoi chingpa kavohlhuh ding ahi, chujou teng akelngoite chu chehchao diu ahi,’ ati.
English: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

tcz: Ahinlah keima thina-a kon kahung thodoh jouteng Galilee gam lama namasanguva kache ding chua chu neimu diu ahi,” ati.
en: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
text:
MRK 14:28
Thadou: Ahinlah keima thina-a kon kahung thodoh jouteng Galilee gam lama namasanguva kache ding chua chu neimu diu ahi,” ati.
English: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

tcz: Chuin Peter in aseiyin, “Aboncha uvin lungthoi jongleu, kei vang lungthoi ponge,” ati.
en: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”
text:
MRK 14:29
Thadou: Chuin Peter in aseiyin, “Aboncha uvin lungthoi jongleu, kei vang lungthoi ponge,” ati.
English: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan, “Keiman tahbeh'a kasei ahi, Peter—nangman tu jan'a ah ni vei akhon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi,” atipeh-e.
en: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”
text:
MRK 14:30
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan, “Keiman tahbeh'a kasei ahi, Peter—nangman tu jan'a ah ni vei akhon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi,” atipeh-e.
English: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”

tcz: Peter in, “Kanompoi! Nang matoh thitha teiding hijongleng, naseilep hihhel ing kate,” atichang melin ahi. Chule abonchauvin achuti seicheh-un ahi.
en: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.
text:
MRK 14:31
Thadou: Peter in, “Kanompoi! Nang matoh thitha teiding hijongleng, naseilep hihhel ing kate,” atichang melin ahi. Chule abonchauvin achuti seicheh-un ahi.
English: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

tcz: Amaho olive thinglei lah-a Gethsemane atiu honsung achun ahungun, chuah Yeshuan aseiyin, “Keima katao sungsen nangho hikoma hin anatou jingun,” ati.
en: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”
text:
MRK 14:32
Thadou: Amaho olive thinglei lah-a Gethsemane atiu honsung achun ahungun, chuah Yeshuan aseiyin, “Keima katao sungsen nangho hikoma hin anatou jingun,” ati.
English: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

tcz: Aman Peter, James chule John akipuiyin, alunghem lheh jeng tai.
en: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
text:
MRK 14:33
Thadou: Aman Peter, James chule John akipuiyin, alunghem lheh jeng tai.
English: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan, “Thina khop helin kalung hesoh behseh jengtai. Hikoma hin um unlang eina kiginpeh-un,” ati.
en: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”
text:
MRK 14:34
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan, “Thina khop helin kalung hesoh behseh jengtai. Hikoma hin um unlang eina kiginpeh-un,” ati.
English: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”

tcz: Chule amasang lamah neokhat ache chon'in tollah akhupboh-in alhun, ahitheile hiche phat chu Ama-a kon'a akitolmang theina dingin ataove.
en: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
text:
MRK 14:35
Thadou: Chule amasang lamah neokhat ache chon'in tollah akhupboh-in alhun, ahitheile hiche phat chu Ama-a kon'a akitolmang theina dingin ataove.
English: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

tcz: Akapjah-in, “Abba, Hepa! Imajouse Nanga dinga hithei ahi. Ahitheile hiche gimthohna khon hi keiya konin kitolmang hen. Hinla Nangma lunggot bang joh hihen lang, keima lunggot bang hida hen,” tin ataotai.
en: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
text:
MRK 14:36
Thadou: Akapjah-in, “Abba, Hepa! Imajouse Nanga dinga hithei ahi. Ahitheile hiche gimthohna khon hi keiya konin kitolmang hen. Hinla Nangma lunggot bang joh hihen lang, keima lunggot bang hida hen,” tin ataotai.
English: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

tcz: Chujouvin ahungdohle khatteho chu ana imutlhuh-u ahung toh'in, Peter jah-a, “Simon, na-imut hitam? Nidan khat jeng jong kiginga umjoulou nahim?
en: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?
text:
MRK 14:37
Thadou: Chujouvin ahungdohle khatteho chu ana imutlhuh-u ahung toh'in, Peter jah-a, “Simon, na-imut hitam? Nidan khat jeng jong kiginga umjoulou nahim?
English: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?

tcz: Lhepna-a nalhahlouna dingun, kigingun, taovun ijeh-inem iti leh lhagaovin agonan, tahsan ajolou ahi,” ati.
en: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
text:
MRK 14:38
Thadou: Lhepna-a nalhahlouna dingun, kigingun, taovun ijeh-inem iti leh lhagaovin agonan, tahsan ajolou ahi,” ati.
English: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

tcz: Chuin amaho adalhan, ache kit'in atao ngai bangin agatao kittai.
en: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.
text:
MRK 14:39
Thadou: Chuin amaho adalhan, ache kit'in atao ngai bangin agatao kittai.
English: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.

tcz: Chuin ahung kile kit'in ahile amaho chu ana-imut'u ahung toh kit'in, aimutso behseh jeh-un adonbutje ahepouve.
en: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.
text:
MRK 14:40
Thadou: Chuin ahung kile kit'in ahile amaho chu ana-imut'u ahung toh kit'in, aimutso behseh jeh-un adonbutje ahepouve.
English: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.

tcz: Athumvei channa-a ahung kile kit chun ajah uva, “Tun i-mu uvin lang kithaol tauvin. Aphasettai, phat alhingtai. Hinla—veuvin, Mihem Chapa hi michonsete khut'a kipedoh ahitai.
en: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
text:
MRK 14:41
Thadou: Athumvei channa-a ahung kile kit chun ajah uva, “Tun i-mu uvin lang kithaol tauvin. Aphasettai, phat alhingtai. Hinla—veuvin, Mihem Chapa hi michonsete khut'a kipedoh ahitai.
English: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

tcz: Kipat'un, chetauhite. Veuvin, eipedohpa hiakhun aumtai!” ati.
en: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
text:
MRK 14:42
Thadou: Kipat'un, chetauhite. Veuvin, eipedohpa hiakhun aumtai!” ati.
English: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

tcz: Yeshuan hichu asei jou jouvin, hetman louvin, Judas, aseijuiho lah'a khat, chu mihonpi moltum le chemjam kichoi puma hungho toh ahung kilhon khom'in ahi. Amaho chu thempu pipui holeh hou lamkai hon ahinsol'u ahi.
en: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.
text:
MRK 14:43
Thadou: Yeshuan hichu asei jou jouvin, hetman louvin, Judas, aseijuiho lah'a khat, chu mihonpi moltum le chemjam kichoi puma hungho toh ahung kilhon khom'in ahi. Amaho chu thempu pipui holeh hou lamkai hon ahinsol'u ahi.
English: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

tcz: Ajohdoh-a pangpa, Juda Iscariot chun melchihna ahil masan, “Namat diu chu chibai kaboh-a kachop penpen chu hiding ahi. Ama chu puimang un,” ati.
en: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”
text:
MRK 14:44
Thadou: Ajohdoh-a pangpa, Juda Iscariot chun melchihna ahil masan, “Namat diu chu chibai kaboh-a kachop penpen chu hiding ahi. Ama chu puimang un,” ati.
English: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”

tcz: Ahung lhun lhun'un Juda chu Yeshua hengah achen, “Houhil!” tin chibai bohnan achoptai.
en: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.
text:
MRK 14:45
Thadou: Ahung lhun lhun'un Juda chu Yeshua hengah achen, “Houhil!” tin chibai bohnan achoptai.
English: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.

tcz: Chuin akhut alhauvin Yeshua amantauvin ahi.
en: They laid their hands on him and seized him.
text:
MRK 14:46
Thadou: Chuin akhut alhauvin Yeshua amantauvin ahi.
English: They laid their hands on him and seized him.

tcz: Yeshua nungjuiho lah'a mi khat'in achemjam asatdohin thempu chungnung sohpa asat leh abilkol langkhat asatlhan ahi.
en: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
text:
MRK 14:47
Thadou: Yeshua nungjuiho lah'a mi khat'in achemjam asatdohin thempu chungnung sohpa asat leh abilkol langkhat asatlhan ahi.
English: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

tcz: Yeshuan adongin, “Galguh bolho mandinga kon banga moltumle chemjam thoa keiman dinga nahung uham?
en: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?
text:
MRK 14:48
Thadou: Yeshuan adongin, “Galguh bolho mandinga kon banga moltumle chemjam thoa keiman dinga nahung uham?
English: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

tcz: Houin sunga kaum laiya ibola neimatlou uham? Niseh leh nalah'uva thujong kanahil jinge. Ahinlah Thubua thukiseisa aguilhunna dinga hitia hi thilsoh vang ahinai,” ati.
en: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”
text:
MRK 14:49
Thadou: Houin sunga kaum laiya ibola neimatlou uham? Niseh leh nalah'uva thujong kanahil jinge. Ahinlah Thubua thukiseisa aguilhunna dinga hitia hi thilsoh vang ahinai,” ati.
English: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”

tcz: Chuin aseijuite jouse akithecheh-un, ajamgam tauve.
en: They all left him, and fled.
text:
MRK 14:50
Thadou: Chuin aseijuite jouse akithecheh-un, ajamgam tauve.
English: They all left him, and fled.

tcz: Alah'uva gollhang khat asangkhol tupat ponnem khatseh kiah aumin, ama chu ahungkon hon amat'ule,
en: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,
text:
MRK 14:51
Thadou: Alah'uva gollhang khat asangkhol tupat ponnem khatseh kiah aumin, ama chu ahungkon hon amat'ule,
English: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

tcz: Aman apon-ah chu akhut'uva adalhan, asagohkeovin ajam mangtai.
en: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.
text:
MRK 14:52
Thadou: Aman apon-ah chu akhut'uva adalhan, asagohkeovin ajam mangtai.
English: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.

tcz: Amahon Yeshua chu thempu chungnung hengah akaiyun, chua chun thempu pipui chengse le vaipo upa ho chule danthusunho ahung kikhomun ahi.
