en: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.
text:
MRK 14:53
Thadou: Amahon Yeshua chu thempu chungnung hengah akaiyun, chua chun thempu pipui chengse le vaipo upa ho chule danthusunho ahung kikhomun ahi.
English: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

tcz: Peter in galkangin ahin juipeh-in chule jangpet'in thempu chungnung inpi leitol sungnung geiyin ajuilutpeh in chua chun sottolleho lah'a atouve.
en: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.
text:
MRK 14:54
Thadou: Peter in galkangin ahin juipeh-in chule jangpet'in thempu chungnung inpi leitol sungnung geiyin ajuilutpeh in chua chun sottolleho lah'a atouve.
English: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

tcz: Asunglamah, thempu pipui holeh houlamkaiho chengsen Yeshua tha theinadia hehsetna le themmo channa ding pansattheina ding ahol un ahivanginla amupouvin ahi.
en: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.
text:
MRK 14:55
Thadou: Asunglamah, thempu pipui holeh houlamkaiho chengsen Yeshua tha theinadia hehsetna le themmo channa ding pansattheina ding ahol un ahivanginla amupouvin ahi.
English: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

tcz: Jouthu tamtah'in ahehseuvin, ahinlah akitoh tapouvin ahi.
en: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.
text:
MRK 14:56
Thadou: Jouthu tamtah'in ahehseuvin, ahinlah akitoh tapouvin ahi.
English: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

tcz: Akhonna-in, mi phabep akipatdoh'un,
en: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,
text:
MRK 14:57
Thadou: Akhonna-in, mi phabep akipatdoh'un,
English: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,

tcz: “Amaa kon'a kajah-u chu: khut'a kisa hiche houinthenghi suse-ingting, nithum jouleh khut'a sahlou achom dang khat katundoh ding ahi,” ati-e tin ahin hehse tauvin ahi.
en: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”
text:
MRK 14:58
Thadou: “Amaa kon'a kajah-u chu: khut'a kisa hiche houinthenghi suse-ingting, nithum jouleh khut'a sahlou achom dang khat katundoh ding ahi,” ati-e tin ahin hehse tauvin ahi.
English: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”

tcz: Ahivanginla hichea jongchun athuseiyu akitoh kitpouvin ahi.
en: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.
text:
MRK 14:59
Thadou: Ahivanginla hichea jongchun athuseiyu akitoh kitpouvin ahi.
English: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.

tcz: Chuin thempu chungnung chu mipi masanga adingdoh in, Yeshua thudoh abolin, “Hitehon nahehnau thu aseiyuhi nadonbut lou dingham?” ati.
en: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”
text:
MRK 14:60
Thadou: Chuin thempu chungnung chu mipi masanga adingdoh in, Yeshua thudoh abolin, “Hitehon nahehnau thu aseiyuhi nadonbut lou dingham?” ati.
English: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan donbut louvin thipbeh'in aumin, chuin thempu chungnungin adongin, “Nangma Nunnom Chapa, Messiah chu nahim?” atitai.
en: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”
text:
MRK 14:61
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan donbut louvin thipbeh'in aumin, chuin thempu chungnungin adongin, “Nangma Nunnom Chapa, Messiah chu nahim?” atitai.
English: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kahi,” atin, chuleh, “Nanghon Mihem Chapa hi thuneina mun'a Pathen jetlam'a atouva chule van meilah-a ahung namu dingu ahinalaiye,” ati.
en: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”
text:
MRK 14:62
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kahi,” atin, chuleh, “Nanghon Mihem Chapa hi thuneina mun'a Pathen jetlam'a atouva chule van meilah-a ahung namu dingu ahinalaiye,” ati.
English: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”

tcz: Chuin Thempu chungnung chun alunghan vetsahnan aponsil abotkeh-in, “Hettohsahna ipi iholbe nahlai dingu ham?
en: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?
text:
MRK 14:63
Thadou: Chuin Thempu chungnung chun alunghan vetsahnan aponsil abotkeh-in, “Hettohsahna ipi iholbe nahlai dingu ham?
English: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

tcz: Pathen ataitomna thu naja tauve. Nanghon iti nagel um?” atileh abonchauvin asam'un, “Athidinga lom ahi!” tin aeo lahlah jengun ahi.
en: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.
text:
MRK 14:64
Thadou: Pathen ataitomna thu naja tauve. Nanghon iti nagel um?” atileh abonchauvin asam'un, “Athidinga lom ahi!” tin aeo lahlah jengun ahi.
English: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

tcz: Mi abangkhat'in achil asetkhum'un chule amit akanpeh-un, akhutnun achumun, “Gaothu neiseipeh-un,” tin eltolin ahouvun, angeiphe abengun apuimang tauve.
en: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.
text:
MRK 14:65
Thadou: Mi abangkhat'in achil asetkhum'un chule amit akanpeh-un, akhutnun achumun, “Gaothu neiseipeh-un,” tin eltolin ahouvun, angeiphe abengun apuimang tauve.
English: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

tcz: Hichepet'a chu Peter noilama leitola uma ahin, thempu chungnung ole numei khat ahungin ahile,
en: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,
text:
MRK 14:66
Thadou: Hichepet'a chu Peter noilama leitola uma ahin, thempu chungnung ole numei khat ahungin ahile,
English: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

tcz: Peter in mei aoi chu amun, amanu chun aven ajah a, “Nang jong Nazareth Yeshua toh kiloi nahi,” ati.
en: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”
text:
MRK 14:67
Thadou: Peter in mei aoi chu amun, amanu chun aven ajah a, “Nang jong Nazareth Yeshua toh kiloi nahi,” ati.
English: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”

tcz: Ahinlah Peter in, “Nasei chu kahehih hel'e,” tin adonbut'in, leitol maiya apotdohleh ahchal akhongtai.
en: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.
text:
MRK 14:68
Thadou: Ahinlah Peter in, “Nasei chu kahehih hel'e,” tin adonbut'in, leitol maiya apotdohleh ahchal akhongtai.
English: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

tcz: Chuin sohnu chun amun akoma dingho jah-a, “Hichepa hi amaho lah'a khat ahi!” atikit e.
en: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”
text:
MRK 14:69
Thadou: Chuin sohnu chun amun akoma dingho jah-a, “Hichepa hi amaho lah'a khat ahi!” atikit e.
English: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”

tcz: Ahinlah Peter akilepkittai. Chomkhat jouvin, akoma dingho chun, “Amaho lah'a khat mong mong nahi, ajehchu Galilee mi nahi-e,” atikit tauvin ahi.
en: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”
text:
MRK 14:70
Thadou: Ahinlah Peter akilepkittai. Chomkhat jouvin, akoma dingho chun, “Amaho lah'a khat mong mong nahi, ajehchu Galilee mi nahi-e,” atikit tauvin ahi.
English: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”

tcz: Ahivangin aman, “Kajou kasei leh gaosap chang inge—naseipau hi kahekha hihbeh-e!” atijeng tai.
en: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”
text:
MRK 14:71
Thadou: Ahivangin aman, “Kajou kasei leh gaosap chang inge—naseipau hi kahekha hihbeh-e!” atijeng tai.
English: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”

tcz: Chujou jouvin aniveina'in ah ahung khong paitan ahi. Chutah chun, Yeshua thusei: Ah ni vei akhon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi, ati chu ageldoh tan, hakan akaptan ahi.
en: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.
text:
MRK 14:72
Thadou: Chujou jouvin aniveina'in ah ahung khong paitan ahi. Chutah chun, Yeshua thusei: Ah ni vei akhon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi, ati chu ageldoh tan, hakan akaptan ahi.
English: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.

tcz: Chuin jingpi tah'in thempu pipuho, vaipo upa ho, danthusunho, chule hou vaipoloi chengse akihoupaiyun, Yeshua chu akan'un, akaiyun Pilate khut'ah apedoh tauve.
en: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.
text:
MRK 15:1
Thadou: Chuin jingpi tah'in thempu pipuho, vaipo upa ho, danthusunho, chule hou vaipoloi chengse akihoupaiyun, Yeshua chu akan'un, akaiyun Pilate khut'ah apedoh tauve.
English: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

tcz: Pilate in Yeshua adong in, “Nangma Judate Lengpa nahim?” ati leh, Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nasei chu adih-e,” ati.
en: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”
text:
MRK 15:2
Thadou: Pilate in Yeshua adong in, “Nangma Judate Lengpa nahim?” ati leh, Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nasei chu adih-e,” ati.
English: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”

tcz: Chuin thempu pipuihon thu tamtah'in ahehse tauvin ahi.
en: The chief priests accused him of many things.
text:
MRK 15:3
Thadou: Chuin thempu pipuihon thu tamtah'in ahehse tauvin ahi.
English: The chief priests accused him of many things.

tcz: Pilate in adong kit'in, “Amaho hi nadonbutlou ding ham? Vetang thu hijat'a nahin heh-uhi?” Yeshuan adonbutlou beh phat'in Pilate in adatmo lheh jenge.
en: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”
text:
MRK 15:4
Thadou: Pilate in adong kit'in, “Amaho hi nadonbutlou ding ham? Vetang thu hijat'a nahin heh-uhi?” Yeshuan adonbutlou beh phat'in Pilate in adatmo lheh jenge.
English: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut lou phat in, Pilate in adatmo lheh jeng in ahi.
en: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.
text:
MRK 15:5
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut lou phat in, Pilate in adatmo lheh jeng in ahi.
English: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

tcz: Vaipopa chena-ngai dol'a kumseh a Kut sungse leh, sohchang ho lah-a amipin athum pen penkhat chu alhadohpeh ji ahi.
en: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.
text:
MRK 15:6
Thadou: Vaipopa chena-ngai dol'a kumseh a Kut sungse leh, sohchang ho lah-a amipin athum pen penkhat chu alhadohpeh ji ahi.
English: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.

tcz: Chulai chun songkul'ah Barabbas atiu gamsung chohnoh-bol le tolthat khat aumin ahi.
en: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
text:
MRK 15:7
Thadou: Chulai chun songkul'ah Barabbas atiu gamsung chohnoh-bol le tolthat khat aumin ahi.
English: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

tcz: Mihonpi chu Pilate henga acheuvin, angaina banga songkultang khat lhadoh din agaseiyui.
en: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.
text:
MRK 15:8
Thadou: Mihonpi chu Pilate henga acheuvin, angaina banga songkultang khat lhadoh din agaseiyui.
English: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

tcz: Chuin Pilate in, “Judate lengpa hi lhadohpeh leuveng nadeiyum?” tin asei tai.
en: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
text:
MRK 15:9
Thadou: Chuin Pilate in, “Judate lengpa hi lhadohpeh leuveng nadeiyum?” tin asei tai.
English: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

tcz: Ama chun thempu pipuihon thangset man'a apehdoh-u ahi ti chu ahet ahi.
en: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.
text:
MRK 15:10
Thadou: Ama chun thempu pipuihon thangset man'a apehdoh-u ahi ti chu ahet ahi.
English: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

tcz: Ahivang'in thempu pipuihon Barabbas joh chu lhadohna dingin mipi chu atilseuvin ahi.
en: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.
text:
MRK 15:11
Thadou: Ahivang'in thempu pipuihon Barabbas joh chu lhadohna dingin mipi chu atilseuvin ahi.
English: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

tcz: Hichun Pilate in ajah uva, “Achutileh Judah te Lengpa natipau hi i-kalo ding bahitam?” ati.
en: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”
text:
MRK 15:12
Thadou: Hichun Pilate in ajah uva, “Achutileh Judah te Lengpa natipau hi i-kalo ding bahitam?” ati.
English: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

tcz: Chuin amahon asamkit'un, “Thingpela khenbeh-in!” atitauve.
en: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”
text:
MRK 15:13
Thadou: Chuin amahon asamkit'un, “Thingpela khenbeh-in!” atitauve.
English: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”

tcz: “Ijeh-inem? Ipi abolset em?” tia Pilate in asei vang'in, mipi chun ahasap cheh-un, “Thingpel'a khenbeh-in!” atitauve.
en: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”
text:
MRK 15:14
Thadou: “Ijeh-inem? Ipi abolset em?” tia Pilate in asei vang'in, mipi chun ahasap cheh-un, “Thingpel'a khenbeh-in!” atitauve.
English: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”

tcz: Mipite lunglhaina dingin Barabbas alhadoh-in, Yeshua chu ajep jouvun thingpela khetbeh dingin apedohtan ahi.
en: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.
text:
MRK 15:15
Thadou: Mipite lunglhaina dingin Barabbas alhadoh-in, Yeshua chu ajep jouvun thingpela khetbeh dingin apedohtan ahi.
English: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

tcz: Chuin hemchoi (Sepai) sottol hon Ama chu Praetorium atiu, vaipo inpi sunga chun akailut'un, sepai jouse akoukhom sohkeiyun ahi.
en: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.
text:
MRK 15:16
Thadou: Chuin hemchoi (Sepai) sottol hon Ama chu Praetorium atiu, vaipo inpi sunga chun akailut'un, sepai jouse akoukhom sohkeiyun ahi.
English: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua chu ponsandup asilpeh-un, leng-lukhuh tobanga linga kiphan chu akhuhpeh-ui.
en: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
text:
MRK 15:17
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua chu ponsandup asilpeh-un, leng-lukhuh tobanga linga kiphan chu akhuhpeh-ui.
English: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

tcz: Chuin, “Judah te Lengpa, choianun!” tin, totnopnan chibai aboh-un ahi.
en: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
text:
MRK 15:18
Thadou: Chuin, “Judah te Lengpa, choianun!” tin, totnopnan chibai aboh-un ahi.
English: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

tcz: Chuin amaho chun peng tenggolin alu avo avouvin, chule achil asetkhum'un, totnopnan adilsu uvin chibai aboh-ui.
en: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
text:
MRK 15:19
Thadou: Chuin amaho chun peng tenggolin alu avo avouvin, chule achil asetkhum'un, totnopnan adilsu uvin chibai aboh-ui.
English: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

tcz: Achainan ael-ela totnopna'a aboljouvun aponsan chu ahoh lhauvin, ama pon ale silpeh-un thingpela khetbeh dingin apuiphei tauvin ahi.
en: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.
text:
MRK 15:20
Thadou: Achainan ael-ela totnopna'a aboljouvun aponsan chu ahoh lhauvin, ama pon ale silpeh-un thingpela khetbeh dingin apuiphei tauvin ahi.
English: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

tcz: Cyrene kiti gam kochong langa pat hungkon, Simon kitipa chutoh amaho chu lamkah-a akitohpa uvin, hichun ama chu achamlouvin Yeshuan ahinput thingpel chu aputsah-un ahi. (Simon hi Alexander le Rufus penna pa ahi.)
en: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.
text:
MRK 15:21
Thadou: Cyrene kiti gam kochong langa pat hungkon, Simon kitipa chutoh amaho chu lamkah-a akitohpa uvin, hichun ama chu achamlouvin Yeshuan ahinput thingpel chu aputsah-un ahi. (Simon hi Alexander le Rufus penna pa ahi.)
English: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua chu lugu-mun atiu Golgotha mun'achun alhut tauvin ahi.
en: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”
text:
MRK 15:22
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua chu lugu-mun atiu Golgotha mun'achun alhut tauvin ahi.
English: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”

tcz: Chuah myrrh toh kihal lengpitwi apeuvin ahile Ama anompoi.
en: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.
text:
MRK 15:23
Thadou: Chuah myrrh toh kihal lengpitwi apeuvin ahile Ama anompoi.
English: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.

tcz: Chuin thingpel'a akhenbeh-un, aponsil chu avangpha pha chang hen tin vang asangtauve.
en: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.
text:
MRK 15:24
Thadou: Chuin thingpel'a akhenbeh-un, aponsil chu avangpha pha chang hen tin vang asangtauve.
English: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

tcz: Yeshua akhetbeh-u chun jingvai nidan ko ahitan ahi.
en: It was the third hour when they crucified him.
text:
MRK 15:25
Thadou: Yeshua akhetbeh-u chun jingvai nidan ko ahitan ahi.
English: It was the third hour when they crucified him.

tcz: Achunga chun ahehnau hetnan, “Judate Lengpa” tia kisun chu atah-un ahi.
en: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
text:
MRK 15:26
Thadou: Achunga chun ahehnau hetnan, “Judate Lengpa” tia kisun chu atah-un ahi.
English: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

tcz: Ama toh gamsunga chohnohbol mi ni, khat aveilamah, khat ajetlamah akhenbeh-un ahi.
en: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.
text:
MRK 15:27
Thadou: Ama toh gamsunga chohnohbol mi ni, khat aveilamah, khat ajetlamah akhenbeh-un ahi.
English: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.

tcz: “Ama michonse chochibol-ho toh akisimtha tai,” tia Lekhabua kisun chu aguilhungtan ahi.
en: The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”
text:
MRK 15:28
Thadou: “Ama michonse chochibol-ho toh akisimtha tai,” tia Lekhabua kisun chu aguilhungtan ahi.
English: The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”

tcz: Chuin achele avahle ho jousen akhasuh khumun, “Katei! Nangin houin kasuhchima nithum nileh kasahdoh kit ding ahi natin, tuchun kivet in.
en: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,
text:
MRK 15:29
Thadou: Chuin achele avahle ho jousen akhasuh khumun, “Katei! Nangin houin kasuhchima nithum nileh kasahdoh kit ding ahi natin, tuchun kivet in.
English: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,

tcz: Nangma kihuhhing inlang thingpel'a kon chun hung kumlha tangem!” atiuvin ael-elin ahouvun ahi.
en: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”
text:
MRK 15:30
Thadou: Nangma kihuhhing inlang thingpel'a kon chun hung kumlha tangem!” atiuvin ael-elin ahouvun ahi.
English: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”

tcz: Chutobangma chun thempu pipui hole danthusunhon jong abol ui. “Aman midang ahuhhingin, Ama akihuhhing theipoi!
en: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.
text:
MRK 15:31
Thadou: Chutobangma chun thempu pipui hole danthusunhon jong abol ui. “Aman midang ahuhhingin, Ama akihuhhing theipoi!
English: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.

tcz: Kamu'uva kahettheina dingun Israelte lengpa chu tutah hin thingpel chunga kon'in hung kumlha hen!” atiuvin totnopnan abol'un ahi. Ama toh kikhet behtha teni jong chun hitichun asei lhon e.
en: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.
text:
MRK 15:32
Thadou: Kamu'uva kahettheina dingun Israelte lengpa chu tutah hin thingpel chunga kon'in hung kumlha hen!” atiuvin totnopnan abol'un ahi. Ama toh kikhet behtha teni jong chun hitichun asei lhon e.
English: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

tcz: Chuin sunkim velhin gam jouseah nidan thum chan mu athimtan ahi.
en: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
text:
MRK 15:33
Thadou: Chuin sunkim velhin gam jouseah nidan thum chan mu athimtan ahi.
English: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

tcz: Hichun nidan thum dontah'in Yeshua hapen in apengin, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabach thani?” atitai. Hichu: “Ka-Pathen, ka-Pathen, ibola neidalhah hitam?” atina ahi.
en: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
text:
MRK 15:34
Thadou: Hichun nidan thum dontah'in Yeshua hapen in apengin, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabach thani?” atitai. Hichu: “Ka-Pathen, ka-Pathen, ibola neidalhah hitam?” atina ahi.
English: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

tcz: Avel'a umho phabep chun Elijah akou hinte atiuve.
en: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”
text:
MRK 15:35
Thadou: Avel'a umho phabep chun Elijah akou hinte atiuve.
English: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

tcz: Hichun mi khat alhaijelin, lengpitwi thuh-a twichop phon adelhop in, adontheina din peng tenggol leh chu ajah-in, amapa chun, “Khongaiyutin, Elijah ahung huhdoh-em veuhite!” ati.
en: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”
text:
MRK 15:36
Thadou: Hichun mi khat alhaijelin, lengpitwi thuh-a twichop phon adelhop in, adontheina din peng tenggol leh chu ajah-in, amapa chun, “Khongaiyutin, Elijah ahung huhdoh-em veuhite!” ati.
English: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshua kithongtah'in ahung peng kit'in ahai atantai.
en: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.
text:
MRK 15:37
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua kithongtah'in ahung peng kit'in ahai atantai.
English: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

tcz: Hichun Houin'a pondal len chu achunga pat anoilam geiyin aehlha paiyin, kehni akisotan ahi.
en: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.
text:
MRK 15:38
Thadou: Hichun Houin'a pondal len chu achunga pat anoilam geiyin aehlha paiyin, kehni akisotan ahi.
English: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

tcz: Chule Rome sepai jalamkai khat'in thilsoh ijakai amu jouvin, “Hichepa hi Pathen Chapa tahbeh ahimonge!” tin aphongdoh jeng tai.
en: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
text:
MRK 15:39
Thadou: Chule Rome sepai jalamkai khat'in thilsoh ijakai amu jouvin, “Hichepa hi Pathen Chapa tahbeh ahimonge!” tin aphongdoh jeng tai.
English: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”

tcz: Numei phabep chun thilsoh chu gal'a konin ahin galdot ui. Amaho lah'a chun Mary Magdalene toh Mary (James le Joseph dinga anu) chule Salome jong apangun ahi.
en: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

tcz: Amaho cheng chu Yeshua Galilee gam'a aumlaiya, Ama ajuile ajenlea anapangho chu ahiuve. Chule numei tamtah Jerusalem'a Ama hin kilhon toupi ho jong chu ahiuve.
en: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.
text:
MRK 15:41
Thadou: Amaho cheng chu Yeshua Galilee gam'a aumlaiya, Ama ajuile ajenlea anapangho chu ahiuve. Chule numei tamtah Jerusalem'a Ama hin kilhon toupi ho jong chu ahiuve.
English: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hichengse hi Cholngahni masang Kiginnia soh ahi. Chuin nilhahlam ahung hitan,
en: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,
text:
MRK 15:42
Thadou: Hichengse hi Cholngahni masang Kiginnia soh ahi. Chuin nilhahlam ahung hitan,
English: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

tcz: Arimathea Joseph chun Yeshua longdamsa chunga mopohna ladingin Pilate koma agathumtan ahi. (Arimathea Joseph chu mi jaumtah vaipo holah-a khat ahin, chule Pathen Lenggam hunglhun ding ngahjing mi khat ahi.)
en: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
text:
MRK 15:43
Thadou: Arimathea Joseph chun Yeshua longdamsa chunga mopohna ladingin Pilate koma agathumtan ahi. (Arimathea Joseph chu mi jaumtah vaipo holah-a khat ahin, chule Pathen Lenggam hunglhun ding ngahjing mi khat ahi.)
English: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

tcz: Pilate in Yeshua chutia athiloi jeng ding chu atahsanpon, hijeh chun Rome sepai jalamkaipa chu akouvin Yeshua athi tahbeh hitam tin adongin ahi.
en: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.
text:
MRK 15:44
Thadou: Pilate in Yeshua chutia athiloi jeng ding chu atahsanpon, hijeh chun Rome sepai jalamkaipa chu akouvin Yeshua athi tahbeh hitam tin adongin ahi.
English: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

tcz: Chuin Rome sepai jalamkaipan athi chu aphotchen phatnin along chu Arimathea Joseph koma apedohtai.
en: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
text:
MRK 15:45
Thadou: Chuin Rome sepai jalamkaipan athi chu aphotchen phatnin along chu Arimathea Joseph koma apedohtai.
English: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

tcz: Chuin Joseph chun along chu alalhan, tupat ponnem achon, hichun atomin, songpi kivut-hom lhan sungah chun alupsahtai. Chujouvin lhankot'a chun songlen khat atanglut'in, lhan chu asinnan ahi.
en: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
text:
MRK 15:46
Thadou: Chuin Joseph chun along chu alalhan, tupat ponnem achon, hichun atomin, songpi kivut-hom lhan sungah chun alupsahtai. Chujouvin lhankot'a chun songlen khat atanglut'in, lhan chu asinnan ahi.
English: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

tcz: Chule Mary Magdalene toh Mary (James nu) chun Yeshua longdamsa akoinau chu avelhi jing lhon in ahi.
en: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.
text:
MRK 15:47
Thadou: Chule Mary Magdalene toh Mary (James nu) chun Yeshua longdamsa akoinau chu avelhi jing lhon in ahi.
English: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

tcz: Chuin Cholngahni nilhah ahung hia, cholngah nit akichai jouvin, Mary Magdalene, James nu Mary, chule Salome chu apotdoh'un thaonamtui gachoh-a Yeshua tahsaa nu ding in akigong uve.
en: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
text:
MRK 16:1
Thadou: Chuin Cholngahni nilhah ahung hia, cholngah nit akichai jouvin, Mary Magdalene, James nu Mary, chule Salome chu apotdoh'un thaonamtui gachoh-a Yeshua tahsaa nu ding in akigong uve.
English: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

tcz: Hapta nimasapen jingpi matah niso kon vel in, amaho lhan lama chun agacheuvin ahi.
en: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.
text:
MRK 16:2
Thadou: Hapta nimasapen jingpi matah niso kon vel in, amaho lhan lama chun agacheuvin ahi.
English: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

tcz: Lampiah amaho akihouvun, “Lhankot song chu kon eitahdohpeh tauvintem?” aki tiuvin ahi.
en: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”
text:
MRK 16:3
Thadou: Lampiah amaho akihouvun, “Lhankot song chu kon eitahdohpeh tauvintem?” aki tiuvin ahi.
English: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

tcz: Chuin ahung lhun phat'un avet uleh song chu tahdohsa'a anaum chu amutauve. Asong chu lenpitah ahi.
en: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.
text:
MRK 16:4
Thadou: Chuin ahung lhun phat'un avet uleh song chu tahdohsa'a anaum chu amutauve. Asong chu lenpitah ahi.
English: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

tcz: Hichun lhan sunga chu alut'ule gollhang khat ponbangleh kisil'a jetlam'a tou amu'uvin chuin amaho chu atijalheh jengun ahi.
en: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.
text:
MRK 16:5
Thadou: Hichun lhan sunga chu alut'ule gollhang khat ponbangleh kisil'a jetlam'a tou amu'uvin chuin amaho chu atijalheh jengun ahi.
English: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

tcz: Ahivangin vantil chun amaho jah-ah, “Nangho tijahih'un, nanghon thingpela kithat Nazareth Yeshua chu nahol'u ahi. Ama hikoma aumtapoi! Ama thinaa konin athoudohtai! Hungun, hung veuvin, hilai hi alonglupna chu ahi.
en: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!
text:
MRK 16:6
Thadou: Ahivangin vantil chun amaho jah-ah, “Nangho tijahih'un, nanghon thingpela kithat Nazareth Yeshua chu nahol'u ahi. Ama hikoma aumtapoi! Ama thinaa konin athoudohtai! Hungun, hung veuvin, hilai hi alonglupna chu ahi.
English: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

tcz: Tun cheuvinlang Peter le aloiho komah Aman athi masanga anasei bang chun Galilee gam'a namasanguvah anache masatai, chua chu Ama namu diu ahi, ti gaseipeh tauvin,” ati.
en: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”
text:
MRK 16:7
Thadou: Tun cheuvinlang Peter le aloiho komah Aman athi masanga anasei bang chun Galilee gam'a namasanguvah anache masatai, chua chu Ama namu diu ahi, ti gaseipeh tauvin,” ati.
English: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

tcz: Numeiho chu atijauvin, kihot pumin lhan'a konin ahung potdoh'un, akichat behseh jeh-un imasei je jong ahepouve. Chuin amahon agan'a gangin seijuiho—Peter le aloiho komah agaseipeh tauvin ahi.
en: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.
text:
MRK 16:8
Thadou: Numeiho chu atijauvin, kihot pumin lhan'a konin ahung potdoh'un, akichat behseh jeh-un imasei je jong ahepouve. Chuin amahon agan'a gangin seijuiho—Peter le aloiho komah agaseipeh tauvin ahi.
English: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

tcz: Hapta nimasapen jingkah-a Yeshua athodohkit jouva akimutopi masatpen chu Mary Magdalene, asunga thilha sagi anodohpeh nu chu ahi.
en: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
text:
MRK 16:9
Thadou: Hapta nimasapen jingkah-a Yeshua athodohkit jouva akimutopi masatpen chu Mary Magdalene, asunga thilha sagi anodohpeh nu chu ahi.
English: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

tcz: Amanu chun seijui lunghemtah'a anaumho jah'a chun thilsoh umdolho chu agaseipeh tai.
en: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
text:
MRK 16:10
Thadou: Amanu chun seijui lunghemtah'a anaumho jah'a chun thilsoh umdolho chu agaseipeh tai.
English: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

tcz: Ahivangin amahon athusei chu atahsanpouvin ahi.
en: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.
text:
MRK 16:11
Thadou: Ahivangin amahon athusei chu atahsanpouvin ahi.
English: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin lim chombeh-in aseijuiteni Jerusalema kipan'a thinglhang lama cheteni komah akilah-in ahi.
en: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.
text:
MRK 16:12
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin lim chombeh-in aseijuiteni Jerusalema kipan'a thinglhang lama cheteni komah akilah-in ahi.
English: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

tcz: Amani achelhon in seijui dangho jah-a agasei lhon leh amahon atahsandeh pouve.
en: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.
text:
MRK 16:13
Thadou: Amani achelhon in seijui dangho jah-a agasei lhon leh amahon atahsandeh pouve.
English: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

tcz: Chuin ankong aum laitah'un seijui somlekhat-ho hengah Yeshua akilah-in athodohkit nunga amuho thusei atahsanlou jeh-u le alungtah jeh-un asosalin ahi.
en: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
text:
MRK 16:14
Thadou: Chuin ankong aum laitah'un seijui somlekhat-ho hengah Yeshua akilah-in athodohkit nunga amuho thusei atahsanlou jeh-u le alungtah jeh-un asosalin ahi.
English: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

tcz: Chuin Aman ajah uva, “Nangho vannoi leiset gamjouseah cheuvin lang thilsem mihem namtin jah-a hiche Kipana Thuphahi gahil lhang leuvin.
en: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
text:
MRK 16:15
Thadou: Chuin Aman ajah uva, “Nangho vannoi leiset gamjouseah cheuvin lang thilsem mihem namtin jah-a hiche Kipana Thuphahi gahil lhang leuvin.
English: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

tcz: Koihileh, atahsan'a baptize chang chu sohcha ding ahi. Atahsanlou vang chu themmo hange umding ahi.
en: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
text:
MRK 16:16
Thadou: Koihileh, atahsan'a baptize chang chu sohcha ding ahi. Atahsanlou vang chu themmo hange umding ahi.
English: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

tcz: Chule atahsante chu melchihna kidangin ajuipeh dingu ahi: Keima min'a thilha anodoh dingu, paothah, pao choma pao dingu,
en: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

tcz: Gul akhut'a adop dingu, Thinathei ima don ongleur ima tilou ding ahiuve. Chule ana-damlou chunga khut ngamleu ana chu damding ahi,” ati. Yeshua Vanna Akaltou
en: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”
text:
MRK 16:18
Thadou: Gul akhut'a adop dingu, Thinathei ima don ongleur ima tilou ding ahiuve. Chule ana-damlou chunga khut ngamleu ana chu damding ahi,” ati. Yeshua Vanna Akaltou
English: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah uva chucheng asei jouvin van'ah lahtouvin aumin, Pathen jetlam'ah atoutai.
en: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
text:
MRK 16:19
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan ajah uva chucheng asei jouvin van'ah lahtouvin aumin, Pathen jetlam'ah atoutai.
English: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

tcz: Chuin amaho achedoh'un muntin'ah ahillhangleuvin anatohna chan'uvah Pakaiyin akithopiuvin, chule melchih nain ajuisah-in athuseiyu chu aphudetpeh-in ahi.
en: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
text:
MRK 16:20
Thadou: Chuin amaho achedoh'un muntin'ah ahillhangleuvin anatohna chan'uvah Pakaiyin akithopiuvin, chule melchih nain ajuisah-in athuseiyu chu aphudetpeh-in ahi.
English: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

tcz: Mi tampin eiho lah'a ana guilhung thilsoh ho chungchang sutdoh agouvin ahi.
en: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,
text:
LUK 1:1
Thadou: Mi tampin eiho lah'a ana guilhung thilsoh ho chungchang sutdoh agouvin ahi.
English: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

tcz: Amahon amittah'a mu seijui masaho thulhut amangchauvin ahi.
en: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,
text:
LUK 1:2
Thadou: Amahon amittah'a mu seijui masaho thulhut amangchauvin ahi.
English: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

tcz: Thil jouse abul'a pat phatah'a kholchil ahitoh lhon'in, keiman jong chingthei tah'a nangma dinga jihdoh ding kakigel lhah ahitai, jana sangpen chang Theophilus,
en: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

tcz: chutia chu thutah nana kihil jouse chu ahimong nai ti nanop nading ahi.
en: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.
text:
LUK 1:4
Thadou: chutia chu thutah nana kihil jouse chu ahimong nai ti nanop nading ahi.
English: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

tcz: Judea gam'a Herod leng ahi laiyin, Zechariah kiti Judah thempu khat ana um'in ahi. Ama chu Abijah thempu loi lah'a khat ahin chule a'inneipi Elizabeth jong chu Aaron thempu khailhah'a kon ahi.
en: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
text:
LUK 1:5
Thadou: Judea gam'a Herod leng ahi laiyin, Zechariah kiti Judah thempu khat ana um'in ahi. Ama chu Abijah thempu loi lah'a khat ahin chule a'inneipi Elizabeth jong chu Aaron thempu khailhah'a kon ahi.
English: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

tcz: Zechariah le Elizabeth chu Pathen mitmun achonpha lhon'in, Pakai dan thupeh le chon na dan jouse chingthei tah'a jui ahilhon'e.
en: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
text:
LUK 1:6
Thadou: Zechariah le Elizabeth chu Pathen mitmun achonpha lhon'in, Pakai dan thupeh le chon na dan jouse chingthei tah'a jui ahilhon'e.
English: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

tcz: Elizabeth in nao avop theilou jeh chun cha aneilhon pon, chule ani lhon'in hateh'in ateh gel lhon tai.
en: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.
text:
LUK 1:7
Thadou: Elizabeth in nao avop theilou jeh chun cha aneilhon pon, chule ani lhon'in hateh'in ateh gel lhon tai.
English: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

tcz: Nikhat Zechariah chun Hou'in sungah Pathen kin abolin, ajeh chu chuche hapta sunga chu mopohna chang ahi.
en: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division
text:
LUK 1:8
Thadou: Nikhat Zechariah chun Hou'in sungah Pathen kin abolin, ajeh chu chuche hapta sunga chu mopohna chang ahi.
English: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division

tcz: Thempuho chonna ngai banga, ama chu Hou'in muntheng sunga lut'a chule thil namtui hal dinga lhendoh hi ahi.
en: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
text:
LUK 1:9
Thadou: Thempuho chonna ngai banga, ama chu Hou'in muntheng sunga lut'a chule thil namtui hal dinga lhendoh hi ahi.
English: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

tcz: Thil namtui akihal jing laiyin, mipi tamtah pamlangah ading'un taona amang uve.
en: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
text:
LUK 1:10
Thadou: Thil namtui akihal jing laiyin, mipi tamtah pamlangah ading'un taona amang uve.
English: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

tcz: Zechariah muntheng sunga aumpet in Pakai vantil khat ahengah ahung kilah in, maicham phung jetlam a chun adingin ahi.
en: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
text:
LUK 1:11
Thadou: Zechariah muntheng sunga aumpet in Pakai vantil khat ahengah ahung kilah in, maicham phung jetlam a chun adingin ahi.
English: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

tcz: Zechariah in hichu amuphat in akithing'in hatah in akicha tan ahi.
en: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
text:
LUK 1:12
Thadou: Zechariah in hichu amuphat in akithing'in hatah in akicha tan ahi.
English: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

tcz: Ahivangin vantil chun aseiyin, “Kicha hih'in Zechariah! Pathen in nataona asangtai. Na inneipi Elizabeth in chapa khat nahinpeh ding, chule amin John nasah ding ahi.
en: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
text:
LUK 1:13
Thadou: Ahivangin vantil chun aseiyin, “Kicha hih'in Zechariah! Pathen in nataona asangtai. Na inneipi Elizabeth in chapa khat nahinpeh ding, chule amin John nasah ding ahi.
English: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

tcz: Nangman kipana lentah nanei ding, chule mi tampi ama pen a kipah ding ahi,
en: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.
text:
LUK 1:14
Thadou: Nangman kipana lentah nanei ding, chule mi tampi ama pen a kipah ding ahi,
English: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.

tcz: ijeh inem itile ama chu Pakai mitmua hung len ding. Aman ju kiti le khamna thei thil kiti atohkhah thei lou ding. Ama chu apen masang jenga jong Lhagao Theng dimset ding ahi.
en: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.
text:
LUK 1:15
Thadou: ijeh inem itile ama chu Pakai mitmua hung len ding. Aman ju kiti le khamna thei thil kiti atohkhah thei lou ding. Ama chu apen masang jenga jong Lhagao Theng dimset ding ahi.
English: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.

tcz: Chule aman Israel mi tamtah Pakai a-Pathen'u henga alehei ding ahi.
en: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.
text:
LUK 1:16
Thadou: Chule aman Israel mi tamtah Pakai a-Pathen'u henga alehei ding ahi.
English: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.

tcz: Ama chun Elijah lhagao le thahat aken ding ahi. Aman mipiho chu Pakai hung na dinga agontup ding ahi. Mipa te lung achate chunga aheiya chule doudal lungput neiho michonphaho chihna akisan sah ding ahi,” ati.
en: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”
text:
LUK 1:17
Thadou: Ama chun Elijah lhagao le thahat aken ding ahi. Aman mipiho chu Pakai hung na dinga agontup ding ahi. Mipa te lung achate chunga aheiya chule doudal lungput neiho michonphaho chihna akisan sah ding ahi,” ati.
English: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”

tcz: Zechariah chun vantil jah'a aseiyin, “Hitobang hi aso ding ken iti kahet thei ding ham? Tun keima kateh tan, chule ka inneipi jong kum tamtah alhing tai,” tin adong tai.
en: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”
text:
LUK 1:18
Thadou: Zechariah chun vantil jah'a aseiyin, “Hitobang hi aso ding ken iti kahet thei ding ham? Tun keima kateh tan, chule ka inneipi jong kum tamtah alhing tai,” tin adong tai.
English: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”

tcz: Chuin vantil chun aseiyin, “Keima Gabriel kahi! Pathen angsung tah a ding kahi. Ama ahi keima nahenga hiche kipana thupha podinga eihin sol ah;
en: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.

tcz: Ahinlah tun, nangman kasei natahsan pon, chujeh'a nangma nathipbeh ding chule nao apen tokah'a paothei louva naum ding ahitai. Ajeh chu kathusei chengse hi aphat cha guilhung tei ding ahi,” ati.
en: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”
text:
LUK 1:20
Thadou: Ahinlah tun, nangman kasei natahsan pon, chujeh'a nangma nathipbeh ding chule nao apen tokah'a paothei louva naum ding ahitai. Ajeh chu kathusei chengse hi aphat cha guilhung tei ding ahi,” ati.
English: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”

tcz: Achutilai chun mipi hon Zechariah chu ahung potdoh ding angah jingun, ipi bol'a hibanga hi sot den hitam tin alungdong gam tauvin ahi.
en: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.
text:
LUK 1:21
Thadou: Achutilai chun mipi hon Zechariah chu ahung potdoh ding angah jingun, ipi bol'a hibanga hi sot den hitam tin alungdong gam tauvin ahi.
English: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

tcz: Achainakeiya ahung potdoh phat chun ama apaodoh thei tapon ahi. Chuin amahon amaiso le apaotheilouva kon chun Hou'in muntheng sunga chu mu anei hinte ti ahedoh un ahi.
en: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.
text:
LUK 1:22
Thadou: Achainakeiya ahung potdoh phat chun ama apaodoh thei tapon ahi. Chuin amahon amaiso le apaotheilouva kon chun Hou'in muntheng sunga chu mu anei hinte ti ahedoh un ahi.
English: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

tcz: Zechariah in Hou'in a athempu natoh hapta alhin phat in inlam'a akile tan ahi.
en: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.
text:
LUK 1:23
Thadou: Zechariah in Hou'in a athempu natoh hapta alhin phat in inlam'a akile tan ahi.
English: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin ajinu Elizabeth chu ahung gai paiyin chule lhanga jen potdoh louvin aum thipbeh tan ahi.
en: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,
text:
LUK 1:24
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin ajinu Elizabeth chu ahung gai paiyin chule lhanga jen potdoh louvin aum thipbeh tan ahi.
English: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

tcz: “Pakai iti phat hitam!” tin aphongdoh in “Aman kacha neilou jeh'a jumna eilah mang peh tai,” ati.
en: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
text:
LUK 1:25
Thadou: “Pakai iti phat hitam!” tin aphongdoh in “Aman kacha neilou jeh'a jumna eilah mang peh tai,” ati.
English: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”

tcz: Elizabeth naovop kal lhagup lhin'in, Pathen in Gabriel vantil chu Galilee gam Nazareth kho ah,
en: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,
text:
LUK 1:26
Thadou: Elizabeth naovop kal lhagup lhin'in, Pathen in Gabriel vantil chu Galilee gam Nazareth kho ah,
English: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,

tcz: nungah theng Mary hengah asol'in ahi. Amanu chu Joseph kiti Leng David insung khailhah pasal khat toh kicheng dinga got'a um ahitai.
en: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.
text:
LUK 1:27
Thadou: nungah theng Mary hengah asol'in ahi. Amanu chu Joseph kiti Leng David insung khailhah pasal khat toh kicheng dinga got'a um ahitai.
English: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.

tcz: Gabriel chu amanu hengah akilah in aseitai, “Chibai, sahluttah nu! Pakaiyin naumpi,” ati.
en: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”
text:
LUK 1:28
Thadou: Gabriel chu amanu hengah akilah in aseitai, “Chibai, sahluttah nu! Pakaiyin naumpi,” ati.
English: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”

tcz: Lungdong le lung kika lahlah pum in Mary'in vantil thusei chu ipi tina ahi agel tai.
en: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.
text:
LUK 1:29
Thadou: Lungdong le lung kika lahlah pum in Mary'in vantil thusei chu ipi tina ahi agel tai.
English: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

tcz: “Kicha hih'in Mary,” tin vantil chun aseitan ahi, “Ajeh chu nangman Pathen lunglhaina nakimutai!”
en: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
text:
LUK 1:30
Thadou: “Kicha hih'in Mary,” tin vantil chun aseitan ahi, “Ajeh chu nangman Pathen lunglhaina nakimutai!”
English: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

tcz: “Nangma gaiyin natin chapa khat nahin ding chule amin Yeshua nasah ding ahi.
en: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’
text:
LUK 1:31
Thadou: “Nangma gaiyin natin chapa khat nahin ding chule amin Yeshua nasah ding ahi.
English: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’

tcz: Ama hung len ding chule Chungnung pen Chapa kiti ding ahi. Pakai Pathen in apu David laltouna apehding ahi.
en: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,
text:
LUK 1:32
Thadou: Ama hung len ding chule Chungnung pen Chapa kiti ding ahi. Pakai Pathen in apu David laltouna apehding ahi.
English: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

tcz: Chule Israel chunga tonsot'a vai apoh ding, alenggam in beitih aneilou ding ahi!” ati.
en: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”
text:
LUK 1:33
Thadou: Chule Israel chunga tonsot'a vai apoh ding, alenggam in beitih aneilou ding ahi!” ati.
English: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

tcz: Mary'n vantil chu adongin, “Hinlah, hichu iti hithei ding ham? Keima nungah theng kahi,” ati.
en: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”
text:
LUK 1:34
Thadou: Mary'n vantil chu adongin, “Hinlah, hichu iti hithei ding ham? Keima nungah theng kahi,” ati.
English: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”

tcz: Vantil chun adonbut in, “Lhagao Theng nachunga hung chu ding, chule chungnung pen thanei na in nalekhu ding ahi. Hijeh a chu naosen apeng ding chu atheng hiding chule ama chu Pathen Chapa kiti ding ahi.
en: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.
text:
LUK 1:35
Thadou: Vantil chun adonbut in, “Lhagao Theng nachunga hung chu ding, chule chungnung pen thanei na in nalekhu ding ahi. Hijeh a chu naosen apeng ding chu atheng hiding chule ama chu Pathen Chapa kiti ding ahi.
English: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

tcz: Ipi aval um ding ham, nasopinu Elizabeth in jong ateh nungin nao avop tai! Mi hon aching'ah ahi atiuvin, hinlah tun chapa khat avop'in lhagup alhingtai.
en: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.
text:
LUK 1:36
Thadou: Ipi aval um ding ham, nasopinu Elizabeth in jong ateh nungin nao avop tai! Mi hon aching'ah ahi atiuvin, hinlah tun chapa khat avop'in lhagup alhingtai.
English: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen dingin ima ahimo aumpoi” ati.
en: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
text:
LUK 1:37
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen dingin ima ahimo aumpoi” ati.
English: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

tcz: Mary'n adonbut in, “Keima Pakai sohnu kahi, kachunga lhungding nasei jouse hung guilhung hen,” ati. Chuti chun vantil chun amanu chu adalhatai.
en: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.
text:
LUK 1:38
Thadou: Mary'n adonbut in, “Keima Pakai sohnu kahi, kachunga lhungding nasei jouse hung guilhung hen,” ati. Chuti chun vantil chun amanu chu adalhatai.
English: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.

tcz: Ni phabep jouvin Mary jong Judea gam thinglhang lang,
en: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,
text:
LUK 1:39
Thadou: Ni phabep jouvin Mary jong Judea gam thinglhang lang,
English: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

tcz: Zechariah chen na khoa chun acheloi chal'in ahi. Amanu insung alut in Elizabeth chu chibai aboh'e.
en: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
text:
LUK 1:40
Thadou: Zechariah chen na khoa chun acheloi chal'in ahi. Amanu insung alut in Elizabeth chu chibai aboh'e.
English: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

tcz: Mary'n chibai aboh gin ajah chun Elizabeth naosen chu a-oisung a chun ahung kichom in, chule Elizabeth chu Lhagao Theng adimset tan ahi.
en: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
text:
LUK 1:41
Thadou: Mary'n chibai aboh gin ajah chun Elizabeth naosen chu a-oisung a chun ahung kichom in, chule Elizabeth chu Lhagao Theng adimset tan ahi.
English: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

tcz: Elizabeth in kipanan ka cheng ahinlon Mary jah'a chun aseitai, “Pathen in numei jouse chunga phatthei naboh ahitai, chule na cha jong anunnom'e.
en: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
text:
LUK 1:42
Thadou: Elizabeth in kipanan ka cheng ahinlon Mary jah'a chun aseitai, “Pathen in numei jouse chunga phatthei naboh ahitai, chule na cha jong anunnom'e.
English: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

tcz: Ipi jeh'a hibanga jana kachan a ka pakai nu in eihung vil ham?
en: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
text:
LUK 1:43
Thadou: Ipi jeh'a hibanga jana kachan a ka pakai nu in eihung vil ham?
English: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

tcz: Nei lemna awcheng kajah chun kasunga naocha kipah in ahung kichom'e.
en: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!
text:
LUK 1:44
Thadou: Nei lemna awcheng kajah chun kasunga naocha kipah in ahung kichom'e.
English: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

tcz: Anun nom nahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin aseichu abol ding ahi ti natahsan e,” ati.
en: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”
text:
LUK 1:45
Thadou: Anun nom nahi, ajeh chu Pakaiyin aseichu abol ding ahi ti natahsan e,” ati.
English: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

tcz: Mary'n adonbut in “Kalhagao vin Pakai achoi-an e.
en: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
text:
LUK 1:46
Thadou: Mary'n adonbut in “Kalhagao vin Pakai achoi-an e.
English: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.

tcz: Kalhagao eihuhhing pu Pathen chunga iti kipah thanom hitam!
en: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
text:
LUK 1:47
Thadou: Kalhagao eihuhhing pu Pathen chunga iti kipah thanom hitam!
English: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

tcz: Ajeh chu aman asoh numei nu dinmun ave jingin, chule tua pat'a khang jousen nunnom eiti diu ahitai.
en: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
text:
LUK 1:48
Thadou: Ajeh chu aman asoh numei nu dinmun ave jingin, chule tua pat'a khang jousen nunnom eiti diu ahitai.
English: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

tcz: Ajeh chu Hatchungnungpa chu atheng ahi, chule aman keima din thil loupi abol'e
en: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.
text:
LUK 1:49
Thadou: Ajeh chu Hatchungnungpa chu atheng ahi, chule aman keima din thil loupi abol'e
English: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

tcz: Aman ahepina akhang akhang'in ama gingte amusah jinge.
en: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.
text:
LUK 1:50
Thadou: Aman ahepina akhang akhang'in ama gingte amusah jinge.
English: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.

tcz: Abanthahat chun kichat um tahtah thil abol'e! Aman mikiletsah le hoitho ho athecheh ji'e.
en: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
text:
LUK 1:51
Thadou: Abanthahat chun kichat um tahtah thil abol'e! Aman mikiletsah le hoitho ho athecheh ji'e.
English: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

tcz: Leng chapate alaltounau-vakon in aloilhan mi kineosah te adomsang ji'e.
en: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.
text:
LUK 1:52
Thadou: Leng chapate alaltounau-vakon in aloilhan mi kineosah te adomsang ji'e.
English: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.

tcz: Aman agilkel te thil pha phan avah in chule ahao te khutgoh keovin asoldoh ji'e
en: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
text:
LUK 1:53
Thadou: Aman agilkel te thil pha phan avah in chule ahao te khutgoh keovin asoldoh ji'e
English: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

tcz: Aman asoh Israel akithopin khoto dingin ageldoh'e.
en: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
text:
LUK 1:54
Thadou: Aman asoh Israel akithopin khoto dingin ageldoh'e.
English: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

tcz: Ajeh chu aman hiche kitepna hi iputeu, Abraham, chule achate dinga asem ahi.”
en: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
text:
LUK 1:55
Thadou: Ajeh chu aman hiche kitepna hi iputeu, Abraham, chule achate dinga asem ahi.”
English: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”

tcz: Mary chu Elizabeth koma lhathum tobang aum jouvin a'inlam ah akile tai.
en: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.
text:
LUK 1:56
Thadou: Mary chu Elizabeth koma lhathum tobang aum jouvin a'inlam ah akile tai.
English: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

tcz: Elizabeth chu anaoso phat alhin phat in amanun chapa khat ahingin ahi.
en: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
text:
LUK 1:57
Thadou: Elizabeth chu anaoso phat alhin phat in amanun chapa khat ahingin ahi.
English: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.

tcz: Chuleh aheng akom le asopi chengin Pakaiyin akhoto naho ajahdoh phat un, mijouse amanu toh akipah khom cheh tauve.
en: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.
text:
LUK 1:58
Thadou: Chuleh aheng akom le asopi chengin Pakaiyin akhoto naho ajahdoh phat un, mijouse amanu toh akipah khom cheh tauve.
English: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.

tcz: Naosen chu niget alhin in, amaho abon'un cheptansah dingin ahung'un ahi. Amahon apa banga amin Zechariah sahding agouvin,
en: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
text:
LUK 1:59
Thadou: Naosen chu niget alhin in, amaho abon'un cheptansah dingin ahung'un ahi. Amahon apa banga amin Zechariah sahding agouvin,
English: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

tcz: ahivangin Elizabeth in, “Ahipoi, amin John ahi,” atitai.
en: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”
text:
LUK 1:60
Thadou: ahivangin Elizabeth in, “Ahipoi, amin John ahi,” atitai.
English: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”

tcz: “Ipi natim?” tin amaho ahung eojah jengun “Na insung uvah hitobang min chu aum khapoi,” atiuve.
en: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”
text:
LUK 1:61
Thadou: “Ipi natim?” tin amaho ahung eojah jengun “Na insung uvah hitobang min chu aum khapoi,” atiuve.
English: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”

tcz: Hijeh chun naosen min chu apan ipi akisah nom am ti mit-heiyin adongun ahi.
en: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.
text:
LUK 1:62
Thadou: Hijeh chun naosen min chu apan ipi akisah nom am ti mit-heiyin adongun ahi.
English: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

tcz: Aman lekhasutna pheng athum'in, mijouse lungdong in alhan “Amin John ahi” tin ahinjih e.
en: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.
text:
LUK 1:63
Thadou: Aman lekhasutna pheng athum'in, mijouse lungdong in alhan “Amin John ahi” tin ahinjih e.
English: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.

tcz: Chutah chun Zechariah jong ahung paothei tan chule Pathen avahchoi pan tai.
en: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.
text:
LUK 1:64
Thadou: Chutah chun Zechariah jong ahung paothei tan chule Pathen avahchoi pan tai.
English: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

tcz: Akimvel'a cheng chengse din kichatna alhung tan chule Judea thinglhang gam sungse ah thilsoh umchan chu akithejal soh tai.
en: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.
text:
LUK 1:65
Thadou: Akimvel'a cheng chengse din kichatna alhung tan chule Judea thinglhang gam sungse ah thilsoh umchan chu akithejal soh tai.
English: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

tcz: Chuche thilsoh jajouse chun athilsoh hochu alungin aching geh'un, “Hiche chapang hi ipibep ahungsoh tadem?” atiuvin ahi.
en: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.
text:
LUK 1:66
Thadou: Chuche thilsoh jajouse chun athilsoh hochu alungin aching geh'un, “Hiche chapang hi ipibep ahungsoh tadem?” atiuvin ahi.
English: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.

tcz: Chuin apa Zechariah chu Lhagao Theng adimset tan chule hiche gaothu hi aphongdoh in ahi:
en: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,
text:
LUK 1:67
Thadou: Chuin apa Zechariah chu Lhagao Theng adimset tan chule hiche gaothu hi aphongdoh in ahi:
English: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

tcz: Vahchoiyun Pakai, Israel Pathen chu; ajehchu aman amite avil'in alhatdoh tai
en: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;

tcz: Aman huhhing hattah khat asoh David khailhah a kon in eipeuve.
en: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David
text:
LUK 1:69
Thadou: Aman huhhing hattah khat asoh David khailhah a kon in eipeuve.
English: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

tcz: Athemgao thengte henga malaiya akitepna banga
en: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),
text:
LUK 1:70
Thadou: Athemgao thengte henga malaiya akitepna banga
English: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),

tcz: Tua eiho igalmiteu vakon le eihotbolteu va kona huhdoh a umding ihitauve.
en: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;

tcz: Aman ipu ipateu khotonan akitepna thengho ageldoh jingin–
en: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
text:
LUK 1:72
Thadou: Aman ipu ipateu khotonan akitepna thengho ageldoh jingin–
English: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,

tcz: Akitepna ipuluiyu Abraham koma anakitepna bangtah in
en: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,
text:
LUK 1:73
Thadou: Akitepna ipuluiyu Abraham koma anakitepna bangtah in
English: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,

tcz: i-galmiteuva kon in eihuhdoh uve, Pathen kichatna beihel'a ijen thei nadiuvin
en: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
text:
LUK 1:74
Thadou: i-galmiteuva kon in eihuhdoh uve, Pathen kichatna beihel'a ijen thei nadiuvin
English: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,

tcz: Then na le chondihna a ihin laiseuva dingin
en: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
text:
LUK 1:75
Thadou: Then na le chondihna a ihin laiseuva dingin
English: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

tcz: “Chule kachapa, nangma chungnung pen themgao kiti ding nahi; ajeh chu nangman Pakai lampi semtoh sa nakoi ding ahi.
en: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,
text:
LUK 1:76
Thadou: “Chule kachapa, nangma chungnung pen themgao kiti ding nahi; ajeh chu nangman Pakai lampi semtoh sa nakoi ding ahi.
English: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,

tcz: Nangman amite, achonset nau ngaidam na'a kona huhhingna akimudoh nadiu naseipeh ding ahi.
en: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,
text:
LUK 1:77
Thadou: Nangman amite, achonset nau ngaidam na'a kona huhhingna akimudoh nadiu naseipeh ding ahi.
English: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

tcz: Pathen mikhotona nemheo vanga jingkhovah chu van'a kona eiho chunga hung kisukeh go ahitai.
en: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,
text:
LUK 1:78
Thadou: Pathen mikhotona nemheo vanga jingkhovah chu van'a kona eiho chunga hung kisukeh go ahitai.
English: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,

tcz: Muthim'a touho le thina lim'a touho vah pedinga, chule chamna lampi komu peh dinga ahi,” ati.
en: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
text:
LUK 1:79
Thadou: Muthim'a touho le thina lim'a touho vah pedinga, chule chamna lampi komu peh dinga ahi,” ati.
English: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”

tcz: John chu ahung khanglen in chule lhagaovin ahung hatdoh in ahi. Chule Israel koma lhangphonga natoh apat kahsen ama gamthip lah dungah aumin ahi.
en: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.
text:
LUK 1:80
Thadou: John chu ahung khanglen in chule lhagaovin ahung hatdoh in ahi. Chule Israel koma lhangphonga natoh apat kahsen ama gamthip lah dungah aumin ahi.
English: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

tcz: Chuphat lai chun Rome gamvaipo, Augustus chun Rome gamsung pumpia minsut ding thupeh ahin neitan ahi.
en: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.
text:
LUK 2:1
Thadou: Chuphat lai chun Rome gamvaipo, Augustus chun Rome gamsung pumpia minsut ding thupeh ahin neitan ahi.
English: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

tcz: (Hiche hi minsut amasapen Quirinius Syria gamvaipo ahilai anahi).
en: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
text:
LUK 2:2
Thadou: (Hiche hi minsut amasapen Quirinius Syria gamvaipo ahilai anahi).
English: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

tcz: Mijouse ama ama hung kondoh na khopi ah minsut na a kijihlut dingin akile un ahi.
en: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.
text:
LUK 2:3
Thadou: Mijouse ama ama hung kondoh na khopi ah minsut na a kijihlut dingin akile un ahi.
English: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

tcz: Chule Joseph chu leng David chilhah ahijeh chun, Judea gam Bethlehem, David gollui laiya achenna in'a ache angaitai. Chua chun ama akholjin in Galilee gam Nazareth kho a pat in akipatdoh'e.
en: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,
text:
LUK 2:4
Thadou: Chule Joseph chu leng David chilhah ahijeh chun, Judea gam Bethlehem, David gollui laiya achenna in'a ache angaitai. Chua chun ama akholjin in Galilee gam Nazareth kho a pat in akipatdoh'e.
English: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,

tcz: Aman agolngai Mary chu akipuiyin, amanu chu agaiyah ahi akichen in ahi.
en: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.
text:
LUK 2:5
Thadou: Aman agolngai Mary chu akipuiyin, amanu chu agaiyah ahi akichen in ahi.
English: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

tcz: Chule chumun a aum laiyun, naoso phat chu ahung lhing tan ahi.
en: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.
text:
LUK 2:6
Thadou: Chule chumun a aum laiyun, naoso phat chu ahung lhing tan ahi.
English: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.

tcz: Amanun acha masa, chapa khat ahingin, pon'in phatah in ajel in gan ankong ah alupsah'e, ajeh chu gemun amaho dia onglou anahi.
en: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.
text:
LUK 2:7
Thadou: Amanun acha masa, chapa khat ahingin, pon'in phatah in ajel in gan ankong ah alupsah'e, ajeh chu gemun amaho dia onglou anahi.
English: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

tcz: Chuche jan chun kelngoi chingho loujao anai dungah aum'un, kelngoiho aventup u ahi.
en: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.
text:
LUK 2:8
Thadou: Chuche jan chun kelngoi chingho loujao anai dungah aum'un, kelngoiho aventup u ahi.
English: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

tcz: Phulou helouvin Pakai vantil khat ahenguvah ahung kilah in, chule Pakai loupina in akimvel'u asalvah soh'e. Amaho akichauvin,
en: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
text:
LUK 2:9
Thadou: Phulou helouvin Pakai vantil khat ahenguvah ahung kilah in, chule Pakai loupina in akimvel'u asalvah soh'e. Amaho akichauvin,
English: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

tcz: ahivangin vantil chun alhamon in, “Kicha hih'un” tin aseiyin “Keiman nangho kipana thupha, mijouse dinga kipana hinso ding kahin pohpeh uve.
en: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.
text:
LUK 2:10
Thadou: ahivangin vantil chun alhamon in, “Kicha hih'un” tin aseiyin “Keiman nangho kipana thupha, mijouse dinga kipana hinso ding kahin pohpeh uve.
