English: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

tcz: Huhhingpu, ahi, Messiah chu, Pakai chu tunin David khopi Bethlehem ah apengtai!
en: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
text:
LUK 2:11
Thadou: Huhhingpu, ahi, Messiah chu, Pakai chu tunin David khopi Bethlehem ah apengtai!
English: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

tcz: Chule nanghon hiche melchihna a hi nahetdoh thei diu ahi: Nanghon naosen pon ajol jol'a kitup sel'a kijel, gan ankonga kilupsah nagamu diu ahi,” ati.
en: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”
text:
LUK 2:12
Thadou: Chule nanghon hiche melchihna a hi nahetdoh thei diu ahi: Nanghon naosen pon ajol jol'a kitup sel'a kijel, gan ankonga kilupsah nagamu diu ahi,” ati.
English: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

tcz: Phulou helouvin vantil chu vanmi janel honpi hon ahinjop'un–van sepai hotoh–Pathen avahchoiyun chule hitin aseiyuve,
en: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,
text:
LUK 2:13
Thadou: Phulou helouvin vantil chu vanmi janel honpi hon ahinjop'un–van sepai hotoh–Pathen avahchoiyun chule hitin aseiyuve,
English: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

tcz: “Van chungnung pen'a Pathen loupi hen, chule leiset chunga Pathen lunglhaina mi ho lah'a cham leng hen,” atiuve.
en: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
text:
LUK 2:14
Thadou: “Van chungnung pen'a Pathen loupi hen, chule leiset chunga Pathen lunglhaina mi ho lah'a cham leng hen,” atiuve.
English: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

tcz: Vantilte van lam'a akilephat un kelngoi chingho khat le khat akihouvun, “Bethlehem a cheu hite! Hiche thilsoh ho Pakaiyin eiseipeh uhi gaveuhite,” akitiuve.
en: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
text:
LUK 2:15
Thadou: Vantilte van lam'a akilephat un kelngoi chingho khat le khat akihouvun, “Bethlehem a cheu hite! Hiche thilsoh ho Pakaiyin eiseipeh uhi gaveuhite,” akitiuve.
English: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

tcz: Amaho khosung a chun kinloi tah'in acheuvin Mary le Joseph agamu uvin, chule naosen chu gan ankong a chun analum'e.
en: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.
text:
LUK 2:16
Thadou: Amaho khosung a chun kinloi tah'in acheuvin Mary le Joseph agamu uvin, chule naosen chu gan ankong a chun analum'e.
English: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

tcz: Ama amuphat uvin kelngoi chinghon thilsoh ho le vantil in naosen chungchanga amaho jah'a aseiho mijouse aseipeh tauvin ahi.
en: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
text:
LUK 2:17
Thadou: Ama amuphat uvin kelngoi chinghon thilsoh ho le vantil in naosen chungchanga amaho jah'a aseiho mijouse aseipeh tauvin ahi.
English: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

tcz: Kelngoi chingho thusei jajouse chu alungdong lheh jeng tauvin,
en: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.
text:
LUK 2:18
Thadou: Kelngoi chingho thusei jajouse chu alungdong lheh jeng tauvin,
English: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

tcz: ahivangin Mary'n hitiho jouse hi alungsungah akoiyin khatvei vei kom le ahin geldoh ji'e.
en: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
text:
LUK 2:19
Thadou: ahivangin Mary'n hitiho jouse hi alungsungah akoiyin khatvei vei kom le ahin geldoh ji'e.
English: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

tcz: Kelngoi chingho akelngoi hon teu hengah akile kit un, athilmu hou le ajah hou jal'in Pathen aloupisah un chule avahchoi tauve. Vantil in aseipeh'u bang chet in thil asoh'e.
en: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.
text:
LUK 2:20
Thadou: Kelngoi chingho akelngoi hon teu hengah akile kit un, athilmu hou le ajah hou jal'in Pathen aloupisah un chule avahchoi tauve. Vantil in aseipeh'u bang chet in thil asoh'e.
English: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

tcz: Niget jouvin naosen chu chep atanpeh un amin Yeshua asah tauve, hichu vantil in akijil masanga pat'a anaminsah sa ahitai.
en: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
text:
LUK 2:21
Thadou: Niget jouvin naosen chu chep atanpeh un amin Yeshua asah tauve, hichu vantil in akijil masanga pat'a anaminsah sa ahitai.
English: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

tcz: Chuin kisuhthengna thilto phat alhing tan, Mose dan'in chapang khat apen jouva boldinga angeh dungjuiyin; chuti chun anu le apan Pakai henga pehdoh dingin Jerusalem'a ahin pui lhon'e.
en: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord
text:
LUK 2:22
Thadou: Chuin kisuhthengna thilto phat alhing tan, Mose dan'in chapang khat apen jouva boldinga angeh dungjuiyin; chuti chun anu le apan Pakai henga pehdoh dingin Jerusalem'a ahin pui lhon'e.
English: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

tcz: Pakai danthu chun hitia hi asei ahi, “Numei cha masa chu pasal ahia leh, amapa chu Pakai henga kikatdoh ding ahi.”
en: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),
text:
LUK 2:23
Thadou: Pakai danthu chun hitia hi asei ahi, “Numei cha masa chu pasal ahia leh, amapa chu Pakai henga kikatdoh ding ahi.”
English: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),

tcz: Chuin Pakai danthua kingeh bangtah in kilhaina chu atoh lhon in ahi–vakhu kop khat ahiloule vapal ni hiji ahi.
en: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”
text:
LUK 2:24
Thadou: Chuin Pakai danthua kingeh bangtah in kilhaina chu atoh lhon in ahi–vakhu kop khat ahiloule vapal ni hiji ahi.
English: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”

tcz: Chuphat lai chun Jerusalem ah Simeon kiti mikhat anaum'e. Amachu michonpha le Pathen hou guttah chule Messiah ahunga Israel ahung lhatdoh ding kinem'a ngahjing khat anahi. Lhagao Theng achungah achun,
en: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.
text:
LUK 2:25
Thadou: Chuphat lai chun Jerusalem ah Simeon kiti mikhat anaum'e. Amachu michonpha le Pathen hou guttah chule Messiah ahunga Israel ahung lhatdoh ding kinem'a ngahjing khat anahi. Lhagao Theng achungah achun,
English: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

tcz: chule Pakai Messiah amutokah'a thilou dinga anaseipeh anahi.
en: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
text:
LUK 2:26
Thadou: chule Pakai Messiah amutokah'a thilou dinga anaseipeh anahi.
English: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

text:
LUK 3:17
Thadou: Ama phol jap-ngimna mangcha a changsi le atah lhehkhen dinga phasadem'a um ahitai. Chuteng aman changchilna phol asuhthenga changtah chengse chu achangsal'a asun'a asi ho vang chu mit theilou meilhum sunga aselut ding ahi,” ati.
English: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

tcz: John chun kipana thupha miho koma aseiphong na achun chutobang gihsalna kamcheng jong amangchan ahi.
en: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,
text:
LUK 3:18
Thadou: John chun kipana thupha miho koma aseiphong na achun chutobang gihsalna kamcheng jong amangchan ahi.
English: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

tcz: John in jong lhangphong tah in Galilee gam vaihompa, Herod Antipas chu, Herodius, asopipa jinu, akichenpi jeh le athilse bol adang tamtah jeh chun demna aneiyin ahi.
en: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
text:
LUK 3:19
Thadou: John in jong lhangphong tah in Galilee gam vaihompa, Herod Antipas chu, Herodius, asopipa jinu, akichenpi jeh le athilse bol adang tamtah jeh chun demna aneiyin ahi.
English: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

tcz: Hijeh chun Herod in John chu songkul'ah akhum'in, achonsetna dangtoh hiche hi akibelap tan ahi.
en: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
text:
LUK 3:20
Thadou: Hijeh chun Herod in John chu songkul'ah akhum'in, achonsetna dangtoh hiche hi akibelap tan ahi.
English: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

tcz: Nikhat mihonpi chu baptize achan laiyun, Yeshua amatah jong baptize achangin ahi. Ama atao leh vanho ahung kihongin,
en: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,
text:
LUK 3:21
Thadou: Nikhat mihonpi chu baptize achan laiyun, Yeshua amatah jong baptize achangin ahi. Ama atao leh vanho ahung kihongin,
English: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,

tcz: chule Lhagao Theng, tahsa lim pu'in van vakhu bangin ahung kumsuh in achunga chun achu'e. Van'a kon chun aw khat'in hitin ahinseiye, “Nangma kangailut tah kachapa nahi, chule kipana lentah neihin pohpeh'e,” ati.
en: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”
text:
LUK 3:22
Thadou: chule Lhagao Theng, tahsa lim pu'in van vakhu bangin ahung kumsuh in achunga chun achu'e. Van'a kon chun aw khat'in hitin ahinseiye, “Nangma kangailut tah kachapa nahi, chule kipana lentah neihin pohpeh'e,” ati.
English: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”

tcz: Yeshua chu kum somthum alhingtai, aman japi lah'a natoh ahinpat chun. Yeshua chu Joseph chapa tin akihen ahi. Joseph chu Heli chapa ahi.
en: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
text:
LUK 3:23
Thadou: Yeshua chu kum somthum alhingtai, aman japi lah'a natoh ahinpat chun. Yeshua chu Joseph chapa tin akihen ahi. Joseph chu Heli chapa ahi.
English: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

tcz: Heli chu Matthat chapa ahi. Matthat chu Levi chapa ahi. Levi chu Melki chapa ahi. Melki chu Jannai chapa ahi. Jannai chu Joseph chapa ahi.
en: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

LUK 3:24

English: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

tcz: Joseph chu Mattathias chapa ahi. Mattathias chu Amos chapa ahi. Amos chu Nahum chapa ahi. Nahum chu Esli chapa ahi. Esli chu Naggai chapa ahi.

LUK 3:25

English: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

tcz: Naggai chu Maath chapa ahi. Maath chu Mattathias chapa ahi. Mattathias chu Semein chapa ahi. Semein chu Josech chapa ahi. Josech chu Joda chapa ahi.
en: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

LUK 3:26
Thadou: Naggai chu Maath chapa ahi. Maath chu Mattathias chapa ahi. Mattathias chu Semein chapa ahi. Semein chu Josech chapa ahi. Josech chu Joda chapa ahi.
English: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

tcz: Joda chu Joanan chapa ahi. Joanan chu Rhesa chapa ahi. Rhesa chu Zerubbabel chapa ahi. Zerubbabel chu Shealtiel chapa ahi. Shealtiel chu Neri chapa ahi.
en: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

LUK 3:27
Thadou: Joda chu Joanan chapa ahi. Joanan chu Rhesa chapa ahi. Rhesa chu Zerubbabel chapa ahi. Zerubbabel chu Shealtiel chapa ahi. Shealtiel chu Neri chapa ahi.
English: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

tcz: Neri chu Melki chapa ahi. Melki chu Addi chapa ahi. Addi chu Cosam chapa ahi. Cosam chu Elmadam chapa ahi. Elmadam chu Er chapa ahi.
en: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

LUK 3:28
Thadou: Neri chu Melki chapa ahi. Melki chu Addi chapa ahi. Addi chu Cosam chapa ahi. Cosam chu Elmadam chapa ahi. Elmadam chu Er chapa ahi.
English: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

tcz: Er chu Joshua chapa ahi. Joshua chu Eliezar chapa ahi. Eliezar chu Jorim chapa ahi. Jorim chu Matthat chapa ahi. Matthat chu Levi chapa ahi.
en: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
text:
LUK 3:29
Thadou: Er chu Joshua chapa ahi. Joshua chu Eliezar chapa ahi. Eliezar chu Jorim chapa ahi. Jorim chu Matthat chapa ahi. Matthat chu Levi chapa ahi.
English: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

tcz: Levi chu Simeon chapa ahi. Simeon chu Judah chapa ahi. Judah chu Joseph chapa ahi. Joseph chu Jonam chapa ahi. Jonam chu Eliakim chapa ahi.
en: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,
text:
LUK 3:30
Thadou: Levi chu Simeon chapa ahi. Simeon chu Judah chapa ahi. Judah chu Joseph chapa ahi. Joseph chu Jonam chapa ahi. Jonam chu Eliakim chapa ahi.
English: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

tcz: Eliakim chu Melea chapa ahi. Melea chu Menna chapa ahi. Menna chu Mattatha chapa ahi. Mattatha chu Nathan chapa ahi. Nathan chu David chapa ahi.
en: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
text:
LUK 3:31
Thadou: Eliakim chu Melea chapa ahi. Melea chu Menna chapa ahi. Menna chu Mattatha chapa ahi. Mattatha chu Nathan chapa ahi. Nathan chu David chapa ahi.
English: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

tcz: David chu Jesse chapa ahi. Jesse chu Obed chapa ahi. Obed chu Boaz chapa ahi. Boaz chu Salmon chapa ahi. Salmon chu Nahshon chapa ahi.
en: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
text:
LUK 3:32
Thadou: David chu Jesse chapa ahi. Jesse chu Obed chapa ahi. Obed chu Boaz chapa ahi. Boaz chu Salmon chapa ahi. Salmon chu Nahshon chapa ahi.
English: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

tcz: Nahshon chu Aminnadab chapa ahi. Aminnadab chu Admin chapa ahi. Admin chu Arni chapa ahi. Arni chu Hezron chapa ahi. Hezron chu Perez chapa ahi. Perez chu Judah chapa ahi.
en: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
text:
LUK 3:33
Thadou: Nahshon chu Aminnadab chapa ahi. Aminnadab chu Admin chapa ahi. Admin chu Arni chapa ahi. Arni chu Hezron chapa ahi. Hezron chu Perez chapa ahi. Perez chu Judah chapa ahi.
English: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

tcz: Judah chu Jacob chapa ahi. Jacob chu Isaac chapa ahi. Isaac chu Abraham chapa ahi. Abraham chu Terah chapa ahi. Terah chu Nahor chapa ahi.
en: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
text:
LUK 3:34
Thadou: Judah chu Jacob chapa ahi. Jacob chu Isaac chapa ahi. Isaac chu Abraham chapa ahi. Abraham chu Terah chapa ahi. Terah chu Nahor chapa ahi.
English: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

tcz: Nahor chu Serug chapa ahi. Serug chu Reu chapa ahi. Reu chu Peleg chapa ahi. Peleg chu Eber chapa ahi. Eber chu Shelah chapa ahi.
en: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
text:
LUK 3:35
Thadou: Nahor chu Serug chapa ahi. Serug chu Reu chapa ahi. Reu chu Peleg chapa ahi. Peleg chu Eber chapa ahi. Eber chu Shelah chapa ahi.
English: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

tcz: Shelah chu Cainan chapa ahi. Cainan chu Arphaxad chapa ahi. Arphaxad chu Shem chapa ahi. Shem chu Noah chapa ahi. Noah chu Lamech chapa ahi.
en: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
text:
LUK 3:36
Thadou: Shelah chu Cainan chapa ahi. Cainan chu Arphaxad chapa ahi. Arphaxad chu Shem chapa ahi. Shem chu Noah chapa ahi. Noah chu Lamech chapa ahi.
English: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

tcz: Lamech chu Methuselah chapa ahi. Methuselah chu Enoch chapa ahi. Enoch chu Jared chapa ahi. Jared chu Mahalalel chapa ahi Mahalalel chu Kenan chapa ahi.
en: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,
text:
LUK 3:37
Thadou: Lamech chu Methuselah chapa ahi. Methuselah chu Enoch chapa ahi. Enoch chu Jared chapa ahi. Jared chu Mahalalel chapa ahi Mahalalel chu Kenan chapa ahi.
English: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

tcz: Kenan chu Enosh chapa ahi. Enosh chu seth chapa ahi. Seth chu Adam chapa ahi. Adam chu Pathen chapa ahi.
en: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
text:
LUK 3:38
Thadou: Kenan chu Enosh chapa ahi. Enosh chu seth chapa ahi. Seth chu Adam chapa ahi. Adam chu Pathen chapa ahi.
English: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua, Lhagao Theng dimset pumin, Jordan vadunga kon in akile tan ahi. Ama chu gamthip'a din Lhagao puidoh in aumin,
en: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness
text:
LUK 4:1
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua, Lhagao Theng dimset pumin, Jordan vadunga kon in akile tan ahi. Ama chu gamthip'a din Lhagao puidoh in aumin,
English: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

tcz: hichea chun diabol lhep patep'in ni somli sung aume. Yeshuan hiche phatsungse chun ima anepon chule gilkel lheh jengah ahitai.
en: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.
text:
LUK 4:2
Thadou: hichea chun diabol lhep patep'in ni somli sung aume. Yeshuan hiche phatsungse chun ima anepon chule gilkel lheh jengah ahitai.
English: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

tcz: Chuin diabol chun ahengah ahinseiyin, “Nangma Pathen chapa nahile hiche songhi changlhah pheng akiso nadin seiyin,” ati.
en: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”
text:
LUK 4:3
Thadou: Chuin diabol chun ahengah ahinseiyin, “Nangma Pathen chapa nahile hiche songhi changlhah pheng akiso nadin seiyin,” ati.
English: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”

tcz: Ahin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Ahipoi! Pathen Lekhabun mihem changlhah bouseh'a hinglou ding ahi” ati.
en: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”
text:
LUK 4:4
Thadou: Ahin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Ahipoi! Pathen Lekhabun mihem changlhah bouseh'a hinglou ding ahi” ati.
English: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”

tcz: Chuin diabol chun apuitouvin, phat chomkhat kah sung in vannoiya lenggam ho avetsah soh keiyin ahi.
en: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
text:
LUK 4:5
Thadou: Chuin diabol chun apuitouvin, phat chomkhat kah sung in vannoiya lenggam ho avetsah soh keiyin ahi.
English: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

tcz: “Hiche lenggam ho loupina le achunguva thuneina nangma kapeh ding nahi,” tin diabol chun aseiyin, “Ajehchu aboncha keiya ahin kapeh nom nom kapeh thei ahi.
en: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.
text:
LUK 4:6
Thadou: “Hiche lenggam ho loupina le achunguva thuneina nangma kapeh ding nahi,” tin diabol chun aseiyin, “Ajehchu aboncha keiya ahin kapeh nom nom kapeh thei ahi.
English: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.

tcz: Aboncha nangma kapeh ding nahi nangman keima nei hou leh,” tin aseitai.
en: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”
text:
LUK 4:7
Thadou: Aboncha nangma kapeh ding nahi nangman keima nei hou leh,” tin aseitai.
English: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Lekhabun hitin aseiye, ‘Nangman Pakai na Pathen bouseh nahou ding, ama kin jeng bou nabol ding ahi’” atipeh tai.
en: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
text:
LUK 4:8
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Lekhabun hitin aseiye, ‘Nangman Pakai na Pathen bouseh nahou ding, ama kin jeng bou nabol ding ahi’” atipeh tai.
English: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

tcz: Chuin diabol chun Jerusalem houin tingvum ah apuiyin chule aseitai, “Pathen Chapa nahile chomlhan!
en: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,
text:
LUK 4:9
Thadou: Chuin diabol chun Jerusalem houin tingvum ah apuiyin chule aseitai, “Pathen Chapa nahile chomlhan!
English: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen Lekhabun hitin aseiye, Aman avantilte navengtup ding le nahoidam dingin thupeh hin neiyin te.
en: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’
text:
LUK 4:10
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen Lekhabun hitin aseiye, Aman avantilte navengtup ding le nahoidam dingin thupeh hin neiyin te.
English: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’

tcz: Chule amahon akhut uvin natuh intin, chutia chu nangman nakengpah jengjong song chunga naki suhkhah lou ding ahi,” ati.
en: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”
text:
LUK 4:11
Thadou: Chule amahon akhut uvin natuh intin, chutia chu nangman nakengpah jengjong song chunga naki suhkhah lou ding ahi,” ati.
English: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Lekhabun hitin jong aseikit'e, Nangman Pakai na Pathen napatep lou ding ahi” ati.
en: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”
text:
LUK 4:12
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Lekhabun hitin jong aseikit'e, Nangman Pakai na Pathen napatep lou ding ahi” ati.
English: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”

tcz: Diabol chun Yeshua alhep patep jou phat in, phat gomkom umkit kah a din adalhatai.
en: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.
text:
LUK 4:13
Thadou: Diabol chun Yeshua alhep patep jou phat in, phat gomkom umkit kah a din adalhatai.
English: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua Galilee langah Lhagao Theng thahatna dimset pumin akiletai. Ama chungchang thulhut ho agamkai pumpi ah gangtah'in akithejal soh tai.
en: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.
text:
LUK 4:14
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua Galilee langah Lhagao Theng thahatna dimset pumin akiletai. Ama chungchang thulhut ho agamkai pumpi ah gangtah'in akithejal soh tai.
English: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

tcz: Akikhopnau in tin'ah thu ahil jin mijousen apahcha lheh'e.
en: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
text:
LUK 4:15
Thadou: Akikhopnau in tin'ah thu ahil jin mijousen apahcha lheh'e.
English: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

tcz: Ama Narareth kho, ahung seilet na khoa ahung chun, abolngai jing bangin Sabbath nin akikhopnau in'ah alut in Pathen Lekhabu sim dingin adingdoh in ahi.
en: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.
text:
LUK 4:16
Thadou: Ama Narareth kho, ahung seilet na khoa ahung chun, abolngai jing bangin Sabbath nin akikhopnau in'ah alut in Pathen Lekhabu sim dingin adingdoh in ahi.
English: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

tcz: Isaiah themgao lekhajol chu apeuvin ahi. Aman lekhajol chu alhamlhan hitia kijihna mun chu amudoh tai:
en: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
text:
LUK 4:17
Thadou: Isaiah themgao lekhajol chu apeuvin ahi. Aman lekhajol chu alhamlhan hitia kijihna mun chu amudoh tai:
English: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

tcz: “Pakai Lhagao kachungah aume, ajehchu mivaicha ho dinga kipana thupha podingin thao einui, Aman sohchang ho akilhadoh diu thu phongjal din eisol'e—mitchon kho amuding, Suhnem a umho kijalen sah ding ahiuve.
en: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,
text:
LUK 4:18
Thadou: “Pakai Lhagao kachungah aume, ajehchu mivaicha ho dinga kipana thupha podingin thao einui, Aman sohchang ho akilhadoh diu thu phongjal din eisol'e—mitchon kho amuding, Suhnem a umho kijalen sah ding ahiuve.
English: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

tcz: Chuleh Pakai khotona phat ahunglhung tai,” kiti lai chu asimdoh tai.
en: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”
text:
LUK 4:19
Thadou: Chuleh Pakai khotona phat ahunglhung tai,” kiti lai chu asimdoh tai.
English: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”

tcz: Lekhajol chu anungjel in, lhachale pa khut'ah anungpeh in, atoutai. Kikhopna in'a mijousen ama chu mit-lhalouvin aveuvin,
en: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.
text:
LUK 4:20
Thadou: Lekhajol chu anungjel in, lhachale pa khut'ah anungpeh in, atoutai. Kikhopna in'a mijousen ama chu mit-lhalouvin aveuvin,
English: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

tcz: chuin aman amaho jah'a thu aseipan tai. “Pathen Lekhabua kisun tua najah'u chu tuni tah hin aguilhung tai!” ati.
en: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”
text:
LUK 4:21
Thadou: chuin aman amaho jah'a thu aseipan tai. “Pathen Lekhabua kisun tua najah'u chu tuni tah hin aguilhung tai!” ati.
English: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”

tcz: Mijousen aseiphalheh jengun chule akamsunga kona aphondoh lungsetna thuho chu kidang asauvin ahi. “Hiche hi iti ham?” tin amahon adongun, “Hiche hi Joseph chapa hilou ham?” atiuve.
en: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”
text:
LUK 4:22
Thadou: Mijousen aseiphalheh jengun chule akamsunga kona aphondoh lungsetna thuho chu kidang asauvin ahi. “Hiche hi iti ham?” tin amahon adongun, “Hiche hi Joseph chapa hilou ham?” atiuve.
English: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”

tcz: Chuin aman aseiyin, “Nanghon lung opkai loubeh'a hiche thuchih hi nei seikhum teidiu ahi: Louthem, nangma kisudam in–aledohna, ‘Capernaum a nabol tobang thil kidang ho chu hilai nakhomun'a jong bol'in’” tiuvin nate.
en: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”
text:
LUK 4:23
Thadou: Chuin aman aseiyin, “Nanghon lung opkai loubeh'a hiche thuchih hi nei seikhum teidiu ahi: Louthem, nangma kisudam in–aledohna, ‘Capernaum a nabol tobang thil kidang ho chu hilai nakhomun'a jong bol'in’” tiuvin nate.
English: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”

tcz: Ahivanga thutah chu kaseipeh nahiuve, themgao koima ama gamsungah min apom ngaipoi.
en: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.
text:
LUK 4:24
Thadou: Ahivanga thutah chu kaseipeh nahiuve, themgao koima ama gamsungah min apom ngaipoi.
English: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

tcz: “Tahbeh in Elijah phat laiyin Israel gamsungah ngaichat khohtah nei meithai tamtah anaume, vankot kum thumle akeh akikha'a gamsunga kel nasatah analhun chun.
en: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.
text:
LUK 4:25
Thadou: “Tahbeh in Elijah phat laiyin Israel gamsungah ngaichat khohtah nei meithai tamtah anaume, vankot kum thumle akeh akikha'a gamsunga kel nasatah analhun chun.
English: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

tcz: Ahivangin Elijah chu koima komah ana kisol poi. Gamchom mi kom joh'a sol anahi–Sidon gam'a Zarephath khoa meithai nu kom.
en: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
text:
LUK 4:26
Thadou: Ahivangin Elijah chu koima komah ana kisol poi. Gamchom mi kom joh'a sol anahi–Sidon gam'a Zarephath khoa meithai nu kom.
English: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

tcz: Chule themgao Elisha phat laiyin jong Israel gamsungah miphah tampi ana um'in, ahivangin Syria mi Naaman bouseh suhdamin anaume,” ati.
en: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”
text:
LUK 4:27
Thadou: Chule themgao Elisha phat laiyin jong Israel gamsungah miphah tampi ana um'in, ahivangin Syria mi Naaman bouseh suhdamin anaume,” ati.
English: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”

tcz: Hiche thu ajah phat un, kikhopna in'a umho chu alunghang tauvin ahi.
en: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.
text:
LUK 4:28
Thadou: Hiche thu ajah phat un, kikhopna in'a umho chu alunghang tauvin ahi.
English: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.

tcz: Achomdoh un, aman'un akhochen nau kol mong lama chun apui tauve. Hiche kol'a chu sotlhah ding atiu ahi,
en: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.
text:
LUK 4:29
Thadou: Achomdoh un, aman'un akhochen nau kol mong lama chun apui tauve. Hiche kol'a chu sotlhah ding atiu ahi,
English: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

tcz: ahivangin akikah lah uva akihehdoh in akiva mang tai.
en: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.
text:
LUK 4:30
Thadou: ahivangin akikah lah uva akihehdoh in akiva mang tai.
English: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua Capernaum kiti Galilee gam kho khat'ah achen, chukom mun'a chun choldo nikho seh le akikhopnau in'a chun thu ahil ji'e.
en: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,
text:
LUK 4:31
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua Capernaum kiti Galilee gam kho khat'ah achen, chukom mun'a chun choldo nikho seh le akikhopnau in'a chun thu ahil ji'e.
English: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,

tcz: Hikom'a jong chun mihon athuhil chu kidang asalheh'un ahi, ajeh chu aman thuneitah'a aseijeh ahi.
en: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.
text:
LUK 4:32
Thadou: Hikom'a jong chun mihon athuhil chu kidang asalheh'un ahi, ajeh chu aman thuneitah'a aseijeh ahi.
English: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

tcz: Khatvei akikhopnau in'a aumpet in, thilhavop khat–lhagao boh'in avop khat–Yeshua henga chun ahung pengjah jengin,
en: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,
text:
LUK 4:33
Thadou: Khatvei akikhopnau in'a aumpet in, thilhavop khat–lhagao boh'in avop khat–Yeshua henga chun ahung pengjah jengin,
English: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,

tcz: “Che mangin! Ipijeh'a kalah'uva hung kikumlut nahim, Nazereth Yeshua? Keiho sumang dinga hung'ah nahim? Keiman nangma koi nahi kahenai–Pathen Mithengpa!” atin ahi.
en: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”
text:
LUK 4:34
Thadou: “Che mangin! Ipijeh'a kalah'uva hung kikumlut nahim, Nazereth Yeshua? Keiho sumang dinga hung'ah nahim? Keiman nangma koi nahi kahenai–Pathen Mithengpa!” atin ahi.
English: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

tcz: Yeshuan athusei alatan in, “Thip'in! hiche mipa'a kon chun hung potdoh'in,” tin thupeh aneitan ahi. Chutah chun thilha chun mipa chu lhonglaiyah ahin seplhun, mihonpin avetjing laichun; chuin ama'a kon chun ima bolsebe talouvin ahung potdoh tan ahi.
en: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.
text:
LUK 4:35
Thadou: Yeshuan athusei alatan in, “Thip'in! hiche mipa'a kon chun hung potdoh'in,” tin thupeh aneitan ahi. Chutah chun thilha chun mipa chu lhonglaiyah ahin seplhun, mihonpin avetjing laichun; chuin ama'a kon chun ima bolsebe talouvin ahung potdoh tan ahi.
English: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

tcz: Kidang san mipi ho chun aphongdoh un, “Ipi thuneina le thilboltheina hiche mipa hin anei hitam! Lhagao boh jeng jong athun anungin, athupeh'a kon in ajam uve!” atiuvin ahi.
en: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”
text:
LUK 4:36
Thadou: Kidang san mipi ho chun aphongdoh un, “Ipi thuneina le thilboltheina hiche mipa hin anei hitam! Lhagao boh jeng jong athun anungin, athupeh'a kon in ajam uve!” atiuvin ahi.
English: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”

tcz: Chuche gamkai pumpi a chun Yeshua thu chu khotin'ah akithang tan ahi.
en: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.
text:
LUK 4:37
Thadou: Chuche gamkai pumpi a chun Yeshua thu chu khotin'ah akithang tan ahi.
English: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

tcz: Chuche nikhoa akikhopnau in adalhah jouvin, Yeshua Simon in'ah achen, hikom'a chun Simon nupanu khosihpi jeh'a nasatah a dammo agatoh khan ahi. “Lungset'in sudam teiyin,” tin mijousen athum tauve.
en: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.
text:
LUK 4:38
Thadou: Chuche nikhoa akikhopnau in adalhah jouvin, Yeshua Simon in'ah achen, hikom'a chun Simon nupanu khosihpi jeh'a nasatah a dammo agatoh khan ahi. “Lungset'in sudam teiyin,” tin mijousen athum tauve.
English: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.

tcz: A-jalkhun komah adingin, akhosih chu aphoh thip tan ahileh akhosih chun amanu adalhatai. Chuin amanu athoudoh pai ngallin amaho ding anneh sem in apangtai.
en: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.
text:
LUK 4:39
Thadou: A-jalkhun komah adingin, akhosih chu aphoh thip tan ahileh akhosih chun amanu adalhatai. Chuin amanu athoudoh pai ngallin amaho ding anneh sem in apangtai.
English: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

tcz: Nisa alhum toh lhon'in, chuche nilhah chun, khosung pumpia a-insungmi damlou neiho sen Yeshua hengah ahin puiyun ahi. Itobang natna hijong leh akhut'in atohkhah chan chu suhdamin aum tauve.
en: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
text:
LUK 4:40
Thadou: Nisa alhum toh lhon'in, chuche nilhah chun, khosung pumpia a-insungmi damlou neiho sen Yeshua hengah ahin puiyun ahi. Itobang natna hijong leh akhut'in atohkhah chan chu suhdamin aum tauve.
English: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

tcz: Mi tamtah chu thilhavop ahiuvin; chule thilha ho chu athupeh'a kon in ahung potdoh'un, apengjah un, “Nangma Pathen Chapa nahi,” atiuvin ahi. Ahivangin ama Messiah ahi ahetjeh'u chun, aman amaho chu aphohthip in thu aseidoh sah tapoi.
en: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.
text:
LUK 4:41
Thadou: Mi tamtah chu thilhavop ahiuvin; chule thilha ho chu athupeh'a kon in ahung potdoh'un, apengjah un, “Nangma Pathen Chapa nahi,” atiuvin ahi. Ahivangin ama Messiah ahi ahetjeh'u chun, aman amaho chu aphohthip in thu aseidoh sah tapoi.
English: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

tcz: Ajing jingkah matah in Yeshua munthip lah khat ah achedoh tan ahi. Mihonpi chun amachu muntin aholle un, achaina kheh a amu phat uvin, aman amaho adalhah nalou diuvin atao tauve.
en: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.
text:
LUK 4:42
Thadou: Ajing jingkah matah in Yeshua munthip lah khat ah achedoh tan ahi. Mihonpi chun amachu muntin aholle un, achaina kheh a amu phat uvin, aman amaho adalhah nalou diuvin atao tauve.
English: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.

tcz: Ahivangin aman adonbut in, “Keiman Pathen Lenggam Kipana Thuphahi khodang'a jong kaseiphong ding ahi, ajeh chu hiche dinga chu eikisol ahi,” ati.
en: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”
text:
LUK 4:43
Thadou: Ahivangin aman adonbut in, “Keiman Pathen Lenggam Kipana Thuphahi khodang'a jong kaseiphong ding ahi, ajeh chu hiche dinga chu eikisol ahi,” ati.
English: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”

tcz: Chuti chun akholjin abanjop'in, Judea gam pumpia akikhopnau in tin'ah thu ahillhang len ahi.
en: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
text:
LUK 4:44
Thadou: Chuti chun akholjin abanjop'in, Judea gam pumpia akikhopnau in tin'ah thu ahillhang len ahi.
English: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan Galilee dillen panga thu asei laiyin, mihonpi tamtah'in Pathen thu ngainom na jal'in aneh chinto tauvin ahi.
en: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.
text:
LUK 5:1
Thadou: Nikhat Yeshuan Galilee dillen panga thu asei laiyin, mihonpi tamtah'in Pathen thu ngainom na jal'in aneh chinto tauvin ahi.
English: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

tcz: Kong ni akeuva tuipi pamchin'a akingah amudoh tan, ajehchu ngaman mi ho chun adalhah uva alen'u akisop u ahi.
en: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.
text:
LUK 5:2
Thadou: Kong ni akeuva tuipi pamchin'a akingah amudoh tan, ajehchu ngaman mi ho chun adalhah uva alen'u akisop u ahi.
English: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.

tcz: Kong khatpa sunga chun alut in, kong neipa Simon jah'a Yeshuan twi lah'a asot lut dingin aseiye. Hijeh chun kong sunga chun atouvin, mihonpi chu chua kon in thu ahil'in ahi.
en: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.
text:
LUK 5:3
Thadou: Kong khatpa sunga chun alut in, kong neipa Simon jah'a Yeshuan twi lah'a asot lut dingin aseiye. Hijeh chun kong sunga chun atouvin, mihonpi chu chua kon in thu ahil'in ahi.
English: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

tcz: Thu asei jouvin Simon jah'a, “Tun chen, lithuh langjep ah, nalen chu seplhan, nga themkhat manding in,” ati.
en: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”
text:
LUK 5:4
Thadou: Thu asei jouvin Simon jah'a, “Tun chen, lithuh langjep ah, nalen chu seplhan, nga themkhat manding in,” ati.
English: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”

tcz: “Pipu” tin Simon in ahin donbut in, “Jankhovah hel'a habol'a kabol u ahin chule ima manlou kahiuve. Hinlah nangman nasei ahileh len seplha kit inge,” ati.
en: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”
text:
LUK 5:5
Thadou: “Pipu” tin Simon in ahin donbut in, “Jankhovah hel'a habol'a kabol u ahin chule ima manlou kahiuve. Hinlah nangman nasei ahileh len seplha kit inge,” ati.
English: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”

tcz: Tu vang'in alen'u nga adimset in akehlha pan tai!
en: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.
text:
LUK 5:6
Thadou: Tu vang'in alen'u nga adimset in akehlha pan tai!
English: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

tcz: Kithopi angeh nauva konin akivoppi hou kong dang khat'ah ahung un, chule chomlou kah'in kong teni chu anigel'in nga adimset in alhalut paiding ahilhon tai.
en: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.
text:
LUK 5:7
Thadou: Kithopi angeh nauva konin akivoppi hou kong dang khat'ah ahung un, chule chomlou kah'in kong teni chu anigel'in nga adimset in alhalut paiding ahilhon tai.
English: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

tcz: Simon Peter in thilsoh ho amuchet phat in Yeshua masangah adilsun chule aseitai, “Oh Pakai, lungset in neidalhan–keima navel'a um ding'in kachonse behseh jenge,” ati.
en: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”
text:
LUK 5:8
Thadou: Simon Peter in thilsoh ho amuchet phat in Yeshua masangah adilsun chule aseitai, “Oh Pakai, lungset in neidalhan–keima navel'a um ding'in kachonse behseh jenge,” ati.
English: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”

tcz: Ijeh inem itile nga chujat amat jeng uchu kidang asah val ahi, adangho jong chutima chu ahiuve.
en: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

tcz: Akiloipi teu, James le John, Zebedee chapateni jong chun kidang asalhon'e. Yeshuan Simon adonbut'in, “Kicha hih'in! tua pat'a miman joh'a napan ding ahitai,” ati.
en: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”
text:
LUK 5:10
Thadou: Akiloipi teu, James le John, Zebedee chapateni jong chun kidang asalhon'e. Yeshuan Simon adonbut'in, “Kicha hih'in! tua pat'a miman joh'a napan ding ahitai,” ati.
English: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”

tcz: Chule tolgo lah alhun lhun uchun, amahon thil jouse adalhauvin Yeshua nung ajui tauve.
en: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.
text:
LUK 5:11
Thadou: Chule tolgo lah alhun lhun uchun, amahon thil jouse adalhauvin Yeshua nung ajui tauve.
English: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

tcz: Khokhat a hin Yeshuan phat sottah phah nat a dammo khat amui. Hiche mipa chun Yeshua amu chun amai tol'a asulut in adamsah din athum'e. “Pakai” tin aseiyin, “Nalung ahileh nei sudam theiyin chule nei sutheng theiye,” ati.
en: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
text:
LUK 5:12
Thadou: Khokhat a hin Yeshuan phat sottah phah nat a dammo khat amui. Hiche mipa chun Yeshua amu chun amai tol'a asulut in adamsah din athum'e. “Pakai” tin aseiyin, “Nalung ahileh nei sudam theiyin chule nei sutheng theiye,” ati.
English: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

tcz: Yeshuan akhut alhangin atham'in, “Kalung ahi” tin aseiyin, “Damin!” ati. Chupet tah chun phahnat na chu abeihel tai.
en: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.
text:
LUK 5:13
Thadou: Yeshuan akhut alhangin atham'in, “Kalung ahi” tin aseiyin, “Damin!” ati. Chupet tah chun phahnat na chu abeihel tai.
English: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amapa chu koima jah'a thilsoh ho aseipeh louna din ahilchah tai. Aman aseipeh in, “Thempupa koma chen chule aman na vechil hen. Mose dan'in angeh dungjuiya atiphah nat kiboldam peh hon apeh dinga lom ho kichoiyin. Hiche hi japi lah'a suhthenga naum phondohna ahi,” ati.
en: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
text:
LUK 5:14
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan amapa chu koima jah'a thilsoh ho aseipeh louna din ahilchah tai. Aman aseipeh in, “Thempupa koma chen chule aman na vechil hen. Mose dan'in angeh dungjuiya atiphah nat kiboldam peh hon apeh dinga lom ho kichoiyin. Hiche hi japi lah'a suhthenga naum phondohna ahi,” ati.
English: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

tcz: Yeshuan chutia ahilchah jeng vang chun, athilbol theina thuho gangjep joh'in thejal ahin, chule mihonpi tamtah athusei ngai ding le anatnau damsah nomna jeh'in ahung uve.
en: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
text:
LUK 5:15
Thadou: Yeshuan chutia ahilchah jeng vang chun, athilbol theina thuho gangjep joh'in thejal ahin, chule mihonpi tamtah athusei ngai ding le anatnau damsah nomna jeh'in ahung uve.
English: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

tcz: Ahin Yeshua ataodin gamthip lah'a achemang jin ahi. Yeshuan Langthi Khat Adamsah
en: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.
text:
LUK 5:16
Thadou: Ahin Yeshua ataodin gamthip lah'a achemang jin ahi. Yeshuan Langthi Khat Adamsah
English: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan thu ahil laiyin, Pharisee phabep khat le hou dan thuhil ho ama kom naina ah atou uve. (Hiche miho hi Galilee le Judea chule Jerusalem gam pumpi khotin'a hungdoh hiuleh akilom'e). Chule Pakai misuhdam na thilboltheina chu Yeshua komah hatah in aumin ahi.
en: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.
text:
LUK 5:17
Thadou: Nikhat Yeshuan thu ahil laiyin, Pharisee phabep khat le hou dan thuhil ho ama kom naina ah atou uve. (Hiche miho hi Galilee le Judea chule Jerusalem gam pumpi khotin'a hungdoh hiuleh akilom'e). Chule Pakai misuhdam na thilboltheina chu Yeshua komah hatah in aumin ahi.
English: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

tcz: Miphabep khat in elbai nakong khat alupna pumin ahin pouvin ahung uve. Insunga Yeshua kom pohlut tei agouvin,
en: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.
text:
LUK 5:18
Thadou: Miphabep khat in elbai nakong khat alupna pumin ahin pouvin ahung uve. Insunga Yeshua kom pohlut tei agouvin,
English: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

tcz: hinlah mihonpi jeh chun aphajou tapouve. Hijeh chun inchungah akaldoh un inting aphelhauvin, chuin amahon adamloupa chu alupna pheh pumin mihonpi lah Yeshua maikoh laitah achun ahin khaisuh uve.
en: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.
text:
LUK 5:19
Thadou: hinlah mihonpi jeh chun aphajou tapouve. Hijeh chun inchungah akaldoh un inting aphelhauvin, chuin amahon adamloupa chu alupna pheh pumin mihonpi lah Yeshua maikoh laitah achun ahin khaisuh uve.
English: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.

tcz: Atahsan jeu amuchun Yeshuan mipa koma chun aseitai, “Gollhang, nachonset akingaidam tai” atipeh e.
en: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”
text:
LUK 5:20
Thadou: Atahsan jeu amuchun Yeshuan mipa koma chun aseitai, “Gollhang, nachonset akingaidam tai” atipeh e.
English: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”

tcz: Ahivangin Pharisee hole hou danthuhil hochu amaho le amaho akihouvun, “Amahi koiya kigel ham? Pathen taitom ahi! Pathen bouseh in chonset angaidam thei ahi,” atitauve.
en: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”
text:
LUK 5:21
Thadou: Ahivangin Pharisee hole hou danthuhil hochu amaho le amaho akihouvun, “Amahi koiya kigel ham? Pathen taitom ahi! Pathen bouseh in chonset angaidam thei ahi,” atitauve.
English: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”

tcz: Yeshuan ipi agel'u ahen, hijeh chun amaho chu adongin, “Ipi jeh'a nalungsung uva hiche hi nadoh uham?
en: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?
text:
LUK 5:22
Thadou: Yeshuan ipi agel'u ahen, hijeh chun amaho chu adongin, “Ipi jeh'a nalungsung uva hiche hi nadoh uham?
English: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

tcz: Hoiche joh seidinga baijo em ‘Nachonset kingaidam ahitai’ kiti le ‘dingin lang lamjot tan’ tihi?” ati.
en: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?
text:
LUK 5:23
Thadou: Hoiche joh seidinga baijo em ‘Nachonset kingaidam ahitai’ kiti le ‘dingin lang lamjot tan’ tihi?” ati.
English: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?

tcz: “Hijeh a chu keiman Mihem Chapan leiset ah chonset ngaidam na tha aneiye ti kavetsah ding nahiuve,” ati. Chuin Yeshuan elbai nakong pa lam ngan akiheiyin aseitai, “Dingin, nalupna pheh kilahdoh in lang, inlam'ah chetan,” ati.
en: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”
text:
LUK 5:24
Thadou: “Hijeh a chu keiman Mihem Chapan leiset ah chonset ngaidam na tha aneiye ti kavetsah ding nahiuve,” ati. Chuin Yeshuan elbai nakong pa lam ngan akiheiyin aseitai, “Dingin, nalupna pheh kilahdoh in lang, inlam'ah chetan,” ati.
English: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”

tcz: Chuin gangtah in, mihon avetjing layin, mipa chu ahung chomdoh in, alupna akilahdoh in, chule inlam Pathen thangvah pumin achetai.
en: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.
text:
LUK 5:25
Thadou: Chuin gangtah in, mihon avetjing layin, mipa chu ahung chomdoh in, alupna akilahdoh in, chule inlam Pathen thangvah pumin achetai.
English: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

tcz: Mijouse chu lungdon nale tijatnan alodim un, chule Pathen avahchoiyun, “Tunin thil kidang ho kamu uve,” tin aphongdoh uve.
en: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”
text:
LUK 5:26
Thadou: Mijouse chu lungdon nale tijatnan alodim un, chule Pathen avahchoiyun, “Tunin thil kidang ho kamu uve,” tin aphongdoh uve.
English: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Yeshuan khopi adalhah le, kaidong khat amin Levi kiti akaidon na munah amun, “Neijuiyin lang ka seijui hin” tin Yeshuan asei tai.
en: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”
text:
LUK 5:27
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin, Yeshuan khopi adalhah le, kaidong khat amin Levi kiti akaidon na munah amun, “Neijuiyin lang ka seijui hin” tin Yeshuan asei tai.
English: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”

tcz: Hiti chun Levi jong akipatdoh in, thil jouse adalhan ama ajuitai.
en: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.
text:
LUK 5:28
Thadou: Hiti chun Levi jong akipatdoh in, thil jouse adalhan ama ajuitai.
English: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

tcz: Chujouvin Levin a'in ah Yeshua jin-ja-um hinan an-nehkhom abol in ahi. Levi tohkhompi kaidong tampi le maljin dang in jong an anekhom uve.
en: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.
text:
LUK 5:29
Thadou: Chujouvin Levin a'in ah Yeshua jin-ja-um hinan an-nehkhom abol in ahi. Levi tohkhompi kaidong tampi le maljin dang in jong an anekhom uve.
English: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

tcz: Ahivangin Pharisee hole ahou danthuhil houvin Yeshua seijui ho hengah aphunchel uvin, “Ipi dinga khutobang aboh hotoh naneh uva nadonkhom uham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”
text:
LUK 5:30
Thadou: Ahivangin Pharisee hole ahou danthuhil houvin Yeshua seijui ho hengah aphunchel uvin, “Ipi dinga khutobang aboh hotoh naneh uva nadonkhom uham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Midamthei ten louthem angaicha pouve–adamlouten vang angaichauve.
en: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
text:
LUK 5:31
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Midamthei ten louthem angaicha pouve–adamlouten vang angaichauve.
English: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

tcz: Keima achonpha'a kigel ho kouva hung kahipoi, amavang chonse ahi kihetdoh'a lunghei dingho kouva hung'ah kahibouve” ati.
en: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”
text:
LUK 5:32
Thadou: Keima achonpha'a kigel ho kouva hung kahipoi, amavang chonse ahi kihetdoh'a lunghei dingho kouva hung'ah kahibouve” ati.
English: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”

tcz: Nikhat miphabep in Yeshua jah'a, “Tuilutsah John seijui hon an angol'un atao jom jing un, chule Pharisee ho seijui honjong chutima chun aboluve. Ipi jeh a nangma seijui hon phatseh'a aneh uva adon jing jengu hitam?” tin aseiyun ahi.
en: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”
text:
LUK 5:33
Thadou: Nikhat miphabep in Yeshua jah'a, “Tuilutsah John seijui hon an angol'un atao jom jing un, chule Pharisee ho seijui honjong chutima chun aboluve. Ipi jeh a nangma seijui hon phatseh'a aneh uva adon jing jengu hitam?” tin aseiyun ahi.
English: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Moupui golvahna a maljin hon moulang toh mou aloplaiyuva an angol ngaiyum? Tahbeh in achutipoi.
en: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?
text:
LUK 5:34
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Moupui golvahna a maljin hon moulang toh mou aloplaiyuva an angol ngaiyum? Tahbeh in achutipoi.
English: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

tcz: Amavang moulang chu nikhat amahoa kona kilamang ding ahi, chuteng tah le amahon an angol diu ahi.” ati.
en: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”
text:
LUK 5:35
Thadou: Amavang moulang chu nikhat amahoa kona kilamang ding ahi, chuteng tah le amahon an angol diu ahi.” ati.
English: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thutekah hi apen ahi: “Koiman ponhal vonthah'a konin acheplhan chule vonlui behnan aneipoi. Ijeh inem itileh vonthah chu seding ahitai, chule hiche vonthah hal chu vonlui chutoh kijot lou ding ahi.”
en: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.
text:
LUK 5:36
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thutekah hi apen ahi: “Koiman ponhal vonthah'a konin acheplhan chule vonlui behnan aneipoi. Ijeh inem itileh vonthah chu seding ahitai, chule hiche vonthah hal chu vonlui chutoh kijot lou ding ahi.”
English: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

tcz: “Chuleh koiman lengpitwi thah peng luiyah akhum ngaipoi. Ijeh inem itile lengpitwi thah chun savun peng chu aphutjah ding, lengpitwi chu kisujah ding chule peng chu kisuse ding ahi.
en: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.
text:
LUK 5:37
Thadou: “Chuleh koiman lengpitwi thah peng luiyah akhum ngaipoi. Ijeh inem itile lengpitwi thah chun savun peng chu aphutjah ding, lengpitwi chu kisujah ding chule peng chu kisuse ding ahi.
English: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.

tcz: Lengpitwi thah chu savun peng thah a khum ding ahi.
en: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.
text:
LUK 5:38
Thadou: Lengpitwi thah chu savun peng thah a khum ding ahi.
English: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

tcz: Ahin koima lengpitwi lui don'in athah chu adeiji tapoi. ‘Aluipa ma aphajenge’ atijiuve,” tin aseiye. Yeshua Seijuihon Cholngah Nikhoa Changvui Asiu
en: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”
text:
LUK 5:39
Thadou: Ahin koima lengpitwi lui don'in athah chu adeiji tapoi. ‘Aluipa ma aphajenge’ atijiuve,” tin aseiye. Yeshua Seijuihon Cholngah Nikhoa Changvui Asiu
English: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”

tcz: Cholngahni khat Yeshuan bulei lai ajot lai hin, aseijui ten changvui asihtan un, akhut uvah anoiyun, chang chu aneuvin ahi.
en: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.
text:
LUK 6:1
Thadou: Cholngahni khat Yeshuan bulei lai ajot lai hin, aseijui ten changvui asihtan un, akhut uvah anoiyun, chang chu aneuvin ahi.
English: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

tcz: Ahivangin Pharisee ho phabep in, “Ipi jeh'a nanghon dan nasuhkeh uva Cholngah nia bolngailou chang-ga nalolhah uham?” atiuve.
en: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”
text:
LUK 6:2
Thadou: Ahivangin Pharisee ho phabep in, “Ipi jeh'a nanghon dan nasuhkeh uva Cholngah nia bolngailou chang-ga nalolhah uham?” atiuve.
English: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Lekhabua kisun David le aloiten agilkel pettah uva ipi anabol'u nasimdoh khah lou u ham?
en: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,
text:
LUK 6:3
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Lekhabua kisun David le aloiten agilkel pettah uva ipi anabol'u nasimdoh khah lou u ham?
English: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,

tcz: Ama Pathen in'a alut'in, dan asukeh in, thempu ho bouseh in anehthei changlhah theng chu anen ahi. Akiloipi ho jong phabep khat apen ahi.” ati.
en: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”
text:
LUK 6:4
Thadou: Ama Pathen in'a alut'in, dan asukeh in, thempu ho bouseh in anehthei changlhah theng chu anen ahi. Akiloipi ho jong phabep khat apen ahi.” ati.
English: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

tcz: Chule Yeshuan aseiben, “Mihem Chapa hi Cholngah ni chung jenga jong pakai ahi” ati. Yeshuan Khut-Jetlang Ngoi Pasal Khat Adamsah
en: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”
text:
LUK 6:5
Thadou: Chule Yeshuan aseiben, “Mihem Chapa hi Cholngah ni chung jenga jong pakai ahi” ati. Yeshuan Khut-Jetlang Ngoi Pasal Khat Adamsah
English: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”

tcz: Cholngah nikho dang khat a Yeshuan kikhopna in'a thu ahil laiyin mikhat akhut jetlang ngoi khat aumin ahi.
en: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.
text:
LUK 6:6
Thadou: Cholngah nikho dang khat a Yeshuan kikhopna in'a thu ahil laiyin mikhat akhut jetlang ngoi khat aumin ahi.
English: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

tcz: Hou danthuhil ho le Pharisee hon Yeshua chu avelhi keuvun ahi. Hichepa chu asuhdam poupouleh Cholngah nin na atonge tia ngohna neiding atiu ahi.
en: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.
text:
LUK 6:7
Thadou: Hou danthuhil ho le Pharisee hon Yeshua chu avelhi keuvun ahi. Hichepa chu asuhdam poupouleh Cholngah nin na atonge tia ngohna neiding atiu ahi.
English: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan alunggel'u ahen ahi. Akhut ngoipa jah'a chun, “Hungin lang mijouse masangah hung ding tem'in,” tin akou tai. Hijehchun mipa jong chu malangah ahungin ahi.
en: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.
text:
LUK 6:8
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan alunggel'u ahen ahi. Akhut ngoipa jah'a chun, “Hungin lang mijouse masangah hung ding tem'in,” tin akou tai. Hijehchun mipa jong chu malangah ahungin ahi.
English: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan anelkal ho jah'a, “Ken nangho thudoh khat kaneiye. Danthun Cholngah nia thilphabol aphal'am, ahilouleh thilse bolnading nikho ham? Hiche nikho hi hinkho huhhing nading nikho hai ahiloule suhset nading nikho ham?” ati.
en: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”
text:
LUK 6:9
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan anelkal ho jah'a, “Ken nangho thudoh khat kaneiye. Danthun Cholngah nia thilphabol aphal'am, ahilouleh thilse bolnading nikho ham? Hiche nikho hi hinkho huhhing nading nikho hai ahiloule suhset nading nikho ham?” ati.
English: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

tcz: Aman amaho chu khat khat in ahin golvet vet in chule mipa jah'a chun aseitai, “Nakhut lhangdoh in” ati. Chutichun mipa chun akhut alhangdoh in ahile thahsemphat ahitai.
en: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.
text:
LUK 6:10
Thadou: Aman amaho chu khat khat in ahin golvet vet in chule mipa jah'a chun aseitai, “Nakhut lhangdoh in” ati. Chutichun mipa chun akhut alhangdoh in ahile thahsemphat ahitai.
English: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

tcz: Hiche a hin Yeshua galmi ho chu alunghang un amachu ilo ding ham ti akihoukhom tauve. Yeshuan Seijui Ding Som Le Ni Alhendoh
en: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.
text:
LUK 6:11
Thadou: Hiche a hin Yeshua galmi ho chu alunghang un amachu ilo ding ham ti akihoukhom tauve. Yeshuan Seijui Ding Som Le Ni Alhendoh
English: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

tcz: Nikhat hitiho jou sotloulaiyin Yeshua molchung khat ah taona mang din achetouvin, chule jankhovah in Pathen hengah ataove.
en: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.
text:
LUK 6:12
Thadou: Nikhat hitiho jou sotloulaiyin Yeshua molchung khat ah taona mang din achetouvin, chule jankhovah in Pathen hengah ataove.
English: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

tcz: Ajing khovah in aseijuite jouse akoukhom soh keiyin amaho lah achun solchah dingin somleni alhengdoh in ahi. Amin hou chu hiche ahi:
en: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:
text:
LUK 6:13
Thadou: Ajing khovah in aseijuite jouse akoukhom soh keiyin amaho lah achun solchah dingin somleni alhengdoh in ahi. Amin hou chu hiche ahi:
English: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

tcz: Simon (Peter asah), Andrew (Peter sopipa), James, John, Philip, Bartholomew
en: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

tcz: Matthew, Thomas, James (Alphaeus chapa), Simon (Zealot tia kikou),
en: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;

tcz: Judas (James chapa), chule Judas Iscariot (khonunga ajohdohpa) ahiuve. Yeshuan Mi Tamtah Na-Atoh Peh
en: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.
text:
LUK 6:16
Thadou: Judas (James chapa), chule Judas Iscariot (khonunga ajohdohpa) ahiuve. Yeshuan Mi Tamtah Na-Atoh Peh
English: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

tcz: Molchunga pat amaho ahungsuh uchun aseijui ho Yeshua toh, mun beh achamlai len khat ah adingun, anungjui tamtah chule mihonpi chun aumkimvel uve. Hichea chun mipi Judea gam pumpi le Jerusalem a kon chule sahlam Tyre le Sidon gam twipang langa pat'a hung jong aumun ahi.
en: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,
text:
LUK 6:17
Thadou: Molchunga pat amaho ahungsuh uchun aseijui ho Yeshua toh, mun beh achamlai len khat ah adingun, anungjui tamtah chule mihonpi chun aumkimvel uve. Hichea chun mipi Judea gam pumpi le Jerusalem a kon chule sahlam Tyre le Sidon gam twipang langa pat'a hung jong aumun ahi.
English: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,

tcz: Amaho chu ama thusei ngai ding le anat nahou kijendam sah dinga hungu ahi; chule lhagao boh in asuh genthei hojong jendam in aumuve.
en: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.
text:
LUK 6:18
Thadou: Amaho chu ama thusei ngai ding le anat nahou kijendam sah dinga hungu ahi; chule lhagao boh in asuh genthei hojong jendam in aumuve.
English: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.

tcz: Mijousen ama chu tohkhah agocheh un ahi ajeh chu suhdam na thaneina chu ama a kona potdoh ahi, chule mijouse asudam in ahi.
en: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.
text:
LUK 6:19
Thadou: Mijousen ama chu tohkhah agocheh un ahi ajeh chu suhdam na thaneina chu ama a kona potdoh ahi, chule mijouse asudam in ahi.
English: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan aseijuite henglam ngan aseitai “Avaichate Pathen in phatthei naboh uhen, Ijeh inem itile Pathen Lenggam chu nanghoa ahi.
en: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.
text:
LUK 6:20
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan aseijuite henglam ngan aseitai “Avaichate Pathen in phatthei naboh uhen, Ijeh inem itile Pathen Lenggam chu nanghoa ahi.
English: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.

tcz: Tua gilkel te Pathen in phatthei naboh uhen, ijeh inem itile lungnachima naum diu ahi. Tua kap te Pathen in phatthei naboh uhen, ijeh inem itile phat khatleh nanui diu ahi”
en: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
text:
LUK 6:21
Thadou: Tua gilkel te Pathen in phatthei naboh uhen, ijeh inem itile lungnachima naum diu ahi. Tua kap te Pathen in phatthei naboh uhen, ijeh inem itile phat khatleh nanui diu ahi”
English: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

tcz: Phattheinan nangah uve, Mihem Chapa najui jeh uva mihon namuda uva napampai uva nataitom uva chule aphalouva nagaosap teng uleh.
en: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.
text:
LUK 6:22
Thadou: Phattheinan nangah uve, Mihem Chapa najui jeh uva mihon namuda uva napampai uva nataitom uva chule aphalouva nagaosap teng uleh.
English: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.

tcz: Hichu aso teng leh kipah un! Henge, kipah'in kichom un! Ijeh inem itile tohphatman lentah in Van-gam ah nangah uve. Chule geldoh jingun, apu apateu chun khanglui lai themgao hojong chutobang chun anabol uve.
en: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.
text:
LUK 6:23
Thadou: Hichu aso teng leh kipah un! Henge, kipah'in kichom un! Ijeh inem itile tohphatman lentah in Van-gam ah nangah uve. Chule geldoh jingun, apu apateu chun khanglui lai themgao hojong chutobang chun anabol uve.
English: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

tcz: Ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam nangho ahaote ho, ijeh inem itile nakipanau chu tua bou naneiyu ahitai.
en: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.
text:
LUK 6:24
Thadou: Ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam nangho ahaote ho, ijeh inem itile nakipanau chu tua bou naneiyu ahitai.
English: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

tcz: Ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam nangho tua thaochet'a uma ninglhing te, ijeh inem itile gilkelna nasatah Phat khat'in nangah jing uve. Ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam tua nui te, ijeh inem itile nanui nau chu kana le lunghem na kisoh ding ahi.
en: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
text:
LUK 6:25
Thadou: Ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam nangho tua thaochet'a uma ninglhing te, ijeh inem itile gilkelna nasatah Phat khat'in nangah jing uve. Ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam tua nui te, ijeh inem itile nanui nau chu kana le lunghem na kisoh ding ahi.
English: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

tcz: Ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam nangho japin apachat ho, ijeh inem itile apu apateu jong chun themgao lhem ho ana pachat u anahi. Melma Chunga Lungsetna Nei Ding
en: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.
text:
LUK 6:26
Thadou: Ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam nangho japin apachat ho, ijeh inem itile apu apateu jong chun themgao lhem ho ana pachat u anahi. Melma Chunga Lungsetna Nei Ding
English: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

tcz: “Ahin, nangho thu ngainom ho, keiman kasei ahi, nagalmi teu ngailu'uvin! Namuda teu hengah thilpha bol'un.”
en: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
text:
LUK 6:27
Thadou: “Ahin, nangho thu ngainom ho, keiman kasei ahi, nagalmi teu ngailu'uvin! Namuda teu hengah thilpha bol'un.”
English: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

tcz: Nasamse teu phattheiboh un. Nasukha teu dingin taovun.
en: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
text:
LUK 6:28
Thadou: Nasamse teu phattheiboh un. Nasukha teu dingin taovun.
English: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

tcz: Mi khattou vin nabengphe langkhat abeh le, nabeng langkhat jong do peh in. Khattouvin na ponlen alah got leh na sangkhol jong peh than.
en: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.
text:
LUK 6:29
Thadou: Mi khattou vin nabengphe langkhat abeh le, nabeng langkhat jong do peh in. Khattouvin na ponlen alah got leh na sangkhol jong peh than.
