English: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

tcz: Athum chan chu pein; chule nathil nanga kona akilahdoh teng leh, nunglah ding gohih in.
en: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.
text:
LUK 6:30
Thadou: Athum chan chu pein; chule nathil nanga kona akilahdoh teng leh, nunglah ding gohih in.
English: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

tcz: Min nang nabol nadinga nadei dan bang bangin midang komah bol'in.
en: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
text:
LUK 6:31
Thadou: Min nang nabol nadinga nadei dan bang bangin midang komah bol'in.
English: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

tcz: Nangman nangailu ho bou nangailut le, ipi jeh'a nakithang at ding ham? Michonse ten jong angailuteu angailut u ahi!
en: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
text:
LUK 6:32
Thadou: Nangman nangailu ho bou nangailut le, ipi jeh'a nakithang at ding ham? Michonse ten jong angailuteu angailut u ahi!
English: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

tcz: Chuleh nachunga thilpha bol ho kom bouseh a thilpha nabol leh, ipijeh a nakithang at ding ham? Michonse ten jong hichan chu abol'u ahi!
en: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.
text:
LUK 6:33
Thadou: Chuleh nachunga thilpha bol ho kom bouseh a thilpha nabol leh, ipijeh a nakithang at ding ham? Michonse ten jong hichan chu abol'u ahi!
English: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

tcz: Chuleh nangman nahin sajou ding hokom'a bou sum naphal leh, ipi jeh a nang kithang-at ding nahim? Michonse ten jong michonse te kom ma'a abon'a nungmu dinga aphal thei ahi.
en: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.
text:
LUK 6:34
Thadou: Chuleh nangman nahin sajou ding hokom'a bou sum naphal leh, ipi jeh a nang kithang-at ding nahim? Michonse ten jong michonse te kom ma'a abon'a nungmu dinga aphal thei ahi.
English: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.

tcz: “Nagalmiteu ngailu uvin! Amaho komah thilpha bol'un. Nungmu ding kinem louvin phal'un. Chuteng van'a kon natohphat man'u chu len ding ahi, chule Chungnung pen chate umchan tahtah natho diu ahi, ajeh chu ama hi kipaje helou hole migilou ho dinga pha ahi.
en: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.
text:
LUK 6:35
Thadou: “Nagalmiteu ngailu uvin! Amaho komah thilpha bol'un. Nungmu ding kinem louvin phal'un. Chuteng van'a kon natohphat man'u chu len ding ahi, chule Chungnung pen chate umchan tahtah natho diu ahi, ajeh chu ama hi kipaje helou hole migilou ho dinga pha ahi.
English: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.

tcz: Napau mikhoto them ahi banga nangho jong khoto them nahi diu ahi. Midang Chunga Thu-Tanna
en: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
text:
LUK 6:36
Thadou: Napau mikhoto them ahi banga nangho jong khoto them nahi diu ahi. Midang Chunga Thu-Tanna
English: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

tcz: Midang chungthu tan hih'in chule nang chungthu jong kitan louding ahi. Midang demna thu seihih in, achutiloule nachunga hung lhung ding ahi. Midang ho ngaidam in nang jong nakingaidam ding ahi.
en: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.
text:
LUK 6:37
Thadou: Midang chungthu tan hih'in chule nang chungthu jong kitan louding ahi. Midang demna thu seihih in, achutiloule nachunga hung lhung ding ahi. Midang ho ngaidam in nang jong nakingaidam ding ahi.
English: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

tcz: Pein, chutileh namu ding ahi. Nathilpeh chu aboncha a nangma kom hung kile ding ahi–akison chahkheh, lo chah kheh sa, mun a-on nadinga, letset'a chule naphei chunga kisunglha ding ahi. Napehdoh jat chun namu ding jat aphotchen ding ahi,” ati.
en: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”
text:
LUK 6:38
Thadou: Pein, chutileh namu ding ahi. Nathilpeh chu aboncha a nangma kom hung kile ding ahi–akison chahkheh, lo chah kheh sa, mun a-on nadinga, letset'a chule naphei chunga kisunglha ding ahi. Napehdoh jat chun namu ding jat aphotchen ding ahi,” ati.
English: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan thutekah hicheng hi aseiye: “Mitcho khat chun midang kaihoi theiyin tem? Anilhon'a kokhuh a lhalut lhon talou ding ham?”
en: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?
text:
LUK 6:39
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan thutekah hicheng hi aseiye: “Mitcho khat chun midang kaihoi theiyin tem? Anilhon'a kokhuh a lhalut lhon talou ding ham?”
English: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

tcz: Jillai ho ajilkungpau sangin alenjo poi. Amavang jillai khat bulhingset'a kichuh chu ajilkungpa tobang hiding ahi.
en: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.
text:
LUK 6:40
Thadou: Jillai ho ajilkungpau sangin alenjo poi. Amavang jillai khat bulhingset'a kichuh chu ajilkungpa tobang hiding ahi.
English: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

tcz: “Chuleh ibol'a naloi nagol mit'a bohhal um chu nalunggim pi ham nangma mit'a inkam uma chu?”
en: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
text:
LUK 6:41
Thadou: “Chuleh ibol'a naloi nagol mit'a bohhal um chu nalunggim pi ham nangma mit'a inkam uma chu?”
English: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

tcz: Nangma mit'a inkam kimu louva, “Jol, namit'a bohhal um chu nalahdoh peh inge, tia seiding iti nagel theiyuham? Miphalhem, amasan nangma mit'a inkam chu kilah doh masat in, chutileh nagol mit'a bohhal um chu abol ding dan nahet ding ahi. Thingphung Agan Aki-Hedoh In Ahi.”
en: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.
text:
LUK 6:42
Thadou: Nangma mit'a inkam kimu louva, “Jol, namit'a bohhal um chu nalahdoh peh inge, tia seiding iti nagel theiyuham? Miphalhem, amasan nangma mit'a inkam chu kilah doh masat in, chutileh nagol mit'a bohhal um chu abol ding dan nahet ding ahi. Thingphung Agan Aki-Hedoh In Ahi.”
English: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

tcz: “Thingphung pha khat in ga phalou asodoh theipoi, chule thingphung phalou vin ga pha asodoh ngaipoi.
en: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.
text:
LUK 6:43
Thadou: “Thingphung pha khat in ga phalou asodoh theipoi, chule thingphung phalou vin ga pha asodoh ngaipoi.
English: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

tcz: Thingphung khat chu agan akihen ahi. Theichang ga lingphung hoa konin akilou khapoi, chule lengpiga jong lingboh ah akilou poi.
en: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.
text:
LUK 6:44
Thadou: Thingphung khat chu agan akihen ahi. Theichang ga lingphung hoa konin akilou khapoi, chule lengpiga jong lingboh ah akilou poi.
English: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

tcz: Miphan alungsung thilkholna pha a konin thilpha asodoh in, chule migilouvin alungsung thilkholna phalouva konin thilse asodohe. Nasei chu ipi hileh nalungsunga hung kondoh ahi.
en: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.
text:
LUK 6:45
Thadou: Miphan alungsung thilkholna pha a konin thilpha asodoh in, chule migilouvin alungsung thilkholna phalouva konin thilse asodohe. Nasei chu ipi hileh nalungsunga hung kondoh ahi.
English: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

tcz: “Hijeh a chu ibol'a ‘Pakai, Pakai’ tia neikou jing uham, kasei bon bollou uva?
en: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?
text:
LUK 6:46
Thadou: “Hijeh a chu ibol'a ‘Pakai, Pakai’ tia neikou jing uham, kasei bon bollou uva?
English: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?

tcz: Keiman koiham khat kahenga hunga, kathuhil ngaiya, chule eijui ho chu itobang hidiu ham navetsah unge.
en: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.
text:
LUK 6:47
Thadou: Keiman koiham khat kahenga hunga, kathuhil ngaiya, chule eijui ho chu itobang hidiu ham navetsah unge.
English: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.

tcz: Ama chu mikhat inkhat sa'a abulphu ding thuhtah'a laiya akhombul song chunga phut tobang ahi. Twi ahungso'a in chu ahin nuh jong leh dettah a kisa ahijeh chun adingdet kheh in ahi.
en: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.
text:
LUK 6:48
Thadou: Ama chu mikhat inkhat sa'a abulphu ding thuhtah'a laiya akhombul song chunga phut tobang ahi. Twi ahungso'a in chu ahin nuh jong leh dettah a kisa ahijeh chun adingdet kheh in ahi.
English: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

tcz: Amavang koihileh athu ja'a chule nunglou hochu mikhat akhombul umlouva insa tobang ahi. Twipi ahungso'a hasuh a asuh le alhu pai ji tai.” ati.
en: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”
text:
LUK 6:49
Thadou: Amavang koihileh athu ja'a chule nunglou hochu mikhat akhombul umlouva insa tobang ahi. Twipi ahungso'a hasuh a asuh le alhu pai ji tai.” ati.
English: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”

tcz: Yeshuan hiche ho jouse miho koma aseijou phat chun, Capernaum langah akile tai.
en: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
text:
LUK 7:1
Thadou: Yeshuan hiche ho jouse miho koma aseijou phat chun, Capernaum langah akile tai.
English: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

tcz: Hiche lai chun Rome sepai jalamkai khat dinga asoh sahlut tah khat chu hatah in adammon thiding kon cha ahitai.
en: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
text:
LUK 7:2
Thadou: Hiche lai chun Rome sepai jalamkai khat dinga asoh sahlut tah khat chu hatah in adammon thiding kon cha ahitai.
English: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

tcz: Sepai jalamkai pan Yeshua chungchang ajahdoh phat in, aman ja umtah Juda upa ho asolin, ahinkou uva asohpa ahung damsah din asol'e.
en: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.
text:
LUK 7:3
Thadou: Sepai jalamkai pan Yeshua chungchang ajahdoh phat in, aman ja umtah Juda upa ho asolin, ahinkou uva asohpa ahung damsah din asol'e.
English: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

tcz: Hijeh chun amahon jong ngehkhoh tah in Yeshua chun mipa akithopi din atao tauve. “Napanpina chang dinga lom khattou aumleh, ama hi ahi,” atiuvin ahi
en: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,
text:
LUK 7:4
Thadou: Hijeh chun amahon jong ngehkhoh tah in Yeshua chun mipa akithopi din atao tauve. “Napanpina chang dinga lom khattou aumleh, ama hi ahi,” atiuvin ahi
English: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,

tcz: “Ajeh chu aman Juda miho eilungset un kikhopna in jong eisah pehuve,” atiuve.
en: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”
text:
LUK 7:5
Thadou: “Ajeh chu aman Juda miho eilungset un kikhopna in jong eisah pehuve,” atiuve.
English: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Yeshua jong amaho toh alhon'in achetai. Ahivangin in ahunglhun masangjep un, sepai jalamkai pan loi phabep asol'in hitin agasei sah e, “Pakai, ka-in'a hung dingin nang le nang kisugim hih in, ajehchu keima chutobang loma jana chang dinga kilom kahipoi.”
en: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.
text:
LUK 7:6
Thadou: Hijeh chun Yeshua jong amaho toh alhon'in achetai. Ahivangin in ahunglhun masangjep un, sepai jalamkai pan loi phabep asol'in hitin agasei sah e, “Pakai, ka-in'a hung dingin nang le nang kisugim hih in, ajehchu keima chutobang loma jana chang dinga kilom kahipoi.”
English: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

tcz: Keima hungdoh a nangma toh kimuto dinga jong lhingjou lou kahi. Naum na'a kon chun thu chu seijeng'in, kasohpa suhdam'a umding ahi.
en: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.
text:
LUK 7:7
Thadou: Keima hungdoh a nangma toh kimuto dinga jong lhingjou lou kahi. Naum na'a kon chun thu chu seijeng'in, kasohpa suhdam'a umding ahi.
English: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

tcz: Ken hiche hi kahenai, ajehchu keima jong kachunga ho thunoiya um kahin, chule kenjong ka sepai ho chunga thuneina kanei ahi. Keiman “Chen” ti bouseh kasei le acheuvin, “Hungin” katileh ahung uve. Chule kasohte komah “Hiche bol'in kati leh abol jenguve,” atiuve.
en: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
text:
LUK 7:8
Thadou: Ken hiche hi kahenai, ajehchu keima jong kachunga ho thunoiya um kahin, chule kenjong ka sepai ho chunga thuneina kanei ahi. Keiman “Chen” ti bouseh kasei le acheuvin, “Hungin” katileh ahung uve. Chule kasohte komah “Hiche bol'in kati leh abol jenguve,” atiuve.
English: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

tcz: Yeshuan hiche thu ajah doh phat in, atija lheh jenge. Mihonpi anungjui ho heng lam angan hitin aseiye, “Kaseipeh nahiuve, hitobang tahsan na hi Israel pumpi sungah kamukha poi!” ati.
en: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”
text:
LUK 7:9
Thadou: Yeshuan hiche thu ajah doh phat in, atija lheh jenge. Mihonpi anungjui ho heng lam angan hitin aseiye, “Kaseipeh nahiuve, hitobang tahsan na hi Israel pumpi sungah kamukha poi!” ati.
English: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”

tcz: Chuin sepai jalamkaipa loiho chu a'inah akile tauvin ahileh sohpa damthengsel'a anaum chu amu'uvin ahi. Yeshuan Meithainu Chapa Athisa Akaithou
en: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.
text:
LUK 7:10
Thadou: Chuin sepai jalamkaipa loiho chu a'inah akile tauvin ahileh sohpa damthengsel'a anaum chu amu'uvin ahi. Yeshuan Meithainu Chapa Athisa Akaithou
English: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin Yeshua aseijui hotoh Nain kho langah acheuvin, mihonpi tamtah'in ajui uve.
en: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.
text:
LUK 7:11
Thadou: Chomkhat jouvin Yeshua aseijui hotoh Nain kho langah acheuvin, mihonpi tamtah'in ajui uve.
English: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

tcz: Thivui dinga hung kijotdoh honkhat khopi kelkot phunga chun atohkha uvin ahi. Khangdong athipa chu meithainu chapa changkhatseh ahin, chule khosunga pat mihonpi tamtah'in amanu aumpiu ahi.
en: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.
text:
LUK 7:12
Thadou: Thivui dinga hung kijotdoh honkhat khopi kelkot phunga chun atohkha uvin ahi. Khangdong athipa chu meithainu chapa changkhatseh ahin, chule khosunga pat mihonpi tamtah'in amanu aumpiu ahi.
English: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

tcz: Pakaiyin amanu amu chun, alungsung khotonan adimtan ahi. “Kap hih'in!” tin aga lhamon e.
en: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”
text:
LUK 7:13
Thadou: Pakaiyin amanu amu chun, alungsung khotonan adimtan ahi. “Kap hih'in!” tin aga lhamon e.
English: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”

tcz: Chuin thikong lama chun achen atongkhan ahile apoho adingden'un ahi. “Gollhang” atin “Kaseipeh nahi, thoudoh in” ati.
en: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”
text:
LUK 7:14
Thadou: Chuin thikong lama chun achen atongkhan ahile apoho adingden'un ahi. “Gollhang” atin “Kaseipeh nahi, thoudoh in” ati.
English: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”

tcz: Chuin athiah pasal chapang chu ahung toudoh in thu aseipan tai! Chule Yeshuan anu anungpeh tan ahi.
en: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.
text:
LUK 7:15
Thadou: Chuin athiah pasal chapang chu ahung toudoh in thu aseipan tai! Chule Yeshuan anu anungpeh tan ahi.
English: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.

tcz: Kichatna lentah in mihonpi chu alonvuh tai, chule amahon Pathen avahchoiyun, “Thil nasatah bolthei themgao khat ilah uvah akisepdoh tai,” atiuvin chule “Pathen in tunin amite aviltai,” atiuve.
en: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”
text:
LUK 7:16
Thadou: Kichatna lentah in mihonpi chu alonvuh tai, chule amahon Pathen avahchoiyun, “Thil nasatah bolthei themgao khat ilah uvah akisepdoh tai,” atiuvin chule “Pathen in tunin amite aviltai,” atiuve.
English: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”

tcz: Chule Yeshua chungchang thusoh Judea gam pumpi le akimvel thinglhang gamkai ho'ah the chansoh'in aumtai.
en: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.
text:
LUK 7:17
Thadou: Chule Yeshua chungchang thusoh Judea gam pumpi le akimvel thinglhang gamkai ho'ah the chansoh'in aumtai.
English: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.

tcz: Twilutsah John seijui hon Yeshua thilbol jouse chu John aseipeh tauve. Hijeh chun John in aseijuite lah'a mini akouvin,
en: The disciples of John told him about all these things.
text:
LUK 7:18
Thadou: Twilutsah John seijui hon Yeshua thilbol jouse chu John aseipeh tauve. Hijeh chun John in aseijuite lah'a mini akouvin,
English: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

tcz: chule adong dingin Pakai komah asoltai. “Nangma Messiah kanga jingu chu nahim, ahilouleh achom dang khat kavet nahlai diu ham?” agatisah e.
en: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”
text:
LUK 7:19
Thadou: chule adong dingin Pakai komah asoltai. “Nangma Messiah kanga jingu chu nahim, ahilouleh achom dang khat kavet nahlai diu ham?” agatisah e.
English: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”

tcz: John seijui tenin Yeshua amu lhon phat in aseilhon tai, “Twilutsah John in hiche dong dinga eihin sollhon ahi, Nangma Messiah, kanga jing pau chu nahim, ahilouleh achom dang khat kavetjing nahlai diu ham?” atilhon e.
en: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”
text:
LUK 7:20
Thadou: John seijui tenin Yeshua amu lhon phat in aseilhon tai, “Twilutsah John in hiche dong dinga eihin sollhon ahi, Nangma Messiah, kanga jing pau chu nahim, ahilouleh achom dang khat kavetjing nahlai diu ham?” atilhon e.
English: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”

tcz: Hiche pettah a chu Yeshuan mi tampi anatnau, adammo nahou asuhdam pet, lhagaoboh vop ho aboldam pet, chule khomulou ho kho amusah pet anahie.
en: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.
text:
LUK 7:21
Thadou: Hiche pettah a chu Yeshuan mi tampi anatnau, adammo nahou asuhdam pet, lhagaoboh vop ho aboldam pet, chule khomulou ho kho amusah pet anahie.
English: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

tcz: Yeshuan John seijui teni chu aseipeh in, “John hengah kile lhon in lang nathilmu lhon le nathujah lhon chengse seipeh lhon tan–mitchon kho amun, elbaiyin lam ajot'in, miphah ho jendam ahin, nangong'in kho ajan, mithiho kaithouvin aumin, chule Kipana Thuphahi mivaichate hengah seiphong'in aumtai.
en: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
text:
LUK 7:22
Thadou: Yeshuan John seijui teni chu aseipeh in, “John hengah kile lhon in lang nathilmu lhon le nathujah lhon chengse seipeh lhon tan–mitchon kho amun, elbaiyin lam ajot'in, miphah ho jendam ahin, nangong'in kho ajan, mithiho kaithouvin aumin, chule Kipana Thuphahi mivaichate hengah seiphong'in aumtai.
English: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

tcz: Chule seipeh lhon'in, keima jeh a kiheimang louho chu Pathen in phatthei aboh'e,” ati.
en: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
text:
LUK 7:23
Thadou: Chule seipeh lhon'in, keima jeh a kiheimang louho chu Pathen in phatthei aboh'e,” ati.
English: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

tcz: John seijui tenin adalhah jouvin Yeshuan ama thudol mihonpi jah'a chun aseiyin ahi. “Itobang mi veding'a gamthip a chu nache uham? Ama chu huimut lingle peng don anem ham?
en: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
text:
LUK 7:24
Thadou: John seijui tenin adalhah jouvin Yeshuan ama thudol mihonpi jah'a chun aseiyin ahi. “Itobang mi veding'a gamthip a chu nache uham? Ama chu huimut lingle peng don anem ham?
English: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

tcz: Ahiloule ponsil mantamtah'a kivon mi mudinga nakiginchat um? Ahipoi, von hoitah kivon hole nomsatah'a hingho chu leng inpia bou akimui.
en: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.
text:
LUK 7:25
Thadou: Ahiloule ponsil mantamtah'a kivon mi mudinga nakiginchat um? Ahipoi, von hoitah kivon hole nomsatah'a hingho chu leng inpia bou akimui.
English: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.

tcz: Themgao ve nahiu ham? Henge, chule themgao sanga chungnung jo ahi.
en: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
text:
LUK 7:26
Thadou: Themgao ve nahiu ham? Henge, chule themgao sanga chungnung jo ahi.
English: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

tcz: John chu Pathen Lekhabu in hitia aseipa chu ahi, Ven, keiman namasangah ka thu lhangsam kasol'e, chule aman nalampi namasanga asemtup ding ahi.
en: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
text:
LUK 7:27
Thadou: John chu Pathen Lekhabu in hitia aseipa chu ahi, Ven, keiman namasangah ka thu lhangsam kasol'e, chule aman nalampi namasanga asemtup ding ahi.
English: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

tcz: Kaseipeh nahiuve, anahing jouse lah'a, koima John sanga lenjo aumpoi. Ahin Pathen lenggam a aneopen jengjong chu ama sangin alenjon ahi!” ati.
en: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”
text:
LUK 7:28
Thadou: Kaseipeh nahiuve, anahing jouse lah'a, koima John sanga lenjo aumpoi. Ahin Pathen lenggam a aneopen jengjong chu ama sangin alenjon ahi!” ati.
English: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”

tcz: Hiche thu ajah tah'un, mipi jouse–kaidong ho jengin jong–Pathen lampi chu adih ahi ti apom'un ahi, ajeh chu amaho John khut'a baptize anachang ahiuve.
en: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.
text:
LUK 7:29
Thadou: Hiche thu ajah tah'un, mipi jouse–kaidong ho jengin jong–Pathen lampi chu adih ahi ti apom'un ahi, ajeh chu amaho John khut'a baptize anachang ahiuve.
English: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.

tcz: Amavang Pharisee hole hou danthu themhon Pathen thilgon apampaiyun ahi, ijeh inem itile amahon John tuilutsah chu apomlouvu ahi.
en: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.
text:
LUK 7:30
Thadou: Amavang Pharisee hole hou danthu themhon Pathen thilgon apampaiyun ahi, ijeh inem itile amahon John tuilutsah chu apomlouvu ahi.
English: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

tcz: “Tukhang mite hi ipi toh katekah tadem?” tin Yeshuan adongin “Iti kahilchet ding ham?” ati.
en: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?
text:
LUK 7:31
Thadou: “Tukhang mite hi ipi toh katekah tadem?” tin Yeshuan adongin “Iti kahilchet ding ham?” ati.
English: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

tcz: Amaho hi kailhang lah'a chapang kichem tobang ahiuve. Amaho aloi agol ho komah aphunchel un, “Keihon moupui golvah la kalhauvin, nalam pouve” hijeh chun thivuina la joh kalhauvin chule nakap pouve.
en: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’
text:
LUK 7:32
Thadou: Amaho hi kailhang lah'a chapang kichem tobang ahiuve. Amaho aloi agol ho komah aphunchel un, “Keihon moupui golvah la kalhauvin, nalam pouve” hijeh chun thivuina la joh kalhauvin chule nakap pouve.
English: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’

tcz: Ajeh chu Tuilutsah John chun aphat ho changlhah neh ahiloule lengpitwi don kiti hohin asumang pon, chule nanghon, “Thilhavop ahi” natiuve.
en: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
text:
LUK 7:33
Thadou: Ajeh chu Tuilutsah John chun aphat ho changlhah neh ahiloule lengpitwi don kiti hohin asumang pon, chule nanghon, “Thilhavop ahi” natiuve.
English: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’

tcz: Mihem Chapan, alangkhat'ah, anen adonin, chule naseiyun, “Milop jukham chule kaidong ho le chonse dang ho jol le gol!” natiuve.
en: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
text:
LUK 7:34
Thadou: Mihem Chapan, alangkhat'ah, anen adonin, chule naseiyun, “Milop jukham chule kaidong ho le chonse dang ho jol le gol!” natiuve.
English: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’

tcz: Ahinla chihna chu adih ahi ti anungjui ho hinkho'ah tahlangin aume, ati.
en: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”
text:
LUK 7:35
Thadou: Ahinla chihna chu adih ahi ti anungjui ho hinkho'ah tahlangin aume, ati.
English: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”

tcz: Pharisee ho lah'a khat in Yeshua toh nilhah an nehkhom din angeh in, hijeh chun Yeshua jong ama in'a chun achen an nedin atoutai.
en: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.
text:
LUK 7:36
Thadou: Pharisee ho lah'a khat in Yeshua toh nilhah an nehkhom din angeh in, hijeh chun Yeshua jong ama in'a chun achen an nedin atoutai.
English: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.

tcz: Chukom muna an aneh ding chu numei jonthanhoi a chonse khat in ahetphat in, amanun songval bom khat'ah thao namtui mantamtah kikhum ahinchoiye.
en: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.
text:
LUK 7:37
Thadou: Chukom muna an aneh ding chu numei jonthanhoi a chonse khat in ahetphat in, amanun songval bom khat'ah thao namtui mantamtah kikhum ahinchoiye.
English: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

tcz: Chuin amanu chu adilsun Amapa kengmuh gal lam'a chun adilsun akaptai. Amitlhi akengmuh lamah avalhan, hichu asam in athehgo in ahi. Chuin akengmuh chu namtui athe in achop chuh chuh tan ahi.
en: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
text:
LUK 7:38
Thadou: Chuin amanu chu adilsun Amapa kengmuh gal lam'a chun adilsun akaptai. Amitlhi akengmuh lamah avalhan, hichu asam in athehgo in ahi. Chuin akengmuh chu namtui athe in achop chuh chuh tan ahi.
English: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

tcz: Pharisee mipa anne a koupa chun hichu amuphat in ama le ama akihoulim in, “Hiche mipa hi themgao ahipou pouleh, itobang numei ham athamkha nu hi, amanu hi michonse ahi! ti ahet tei ding ahi,” atin ahi.
en: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”
text:
LUK 7:39
Thadou: Pharisee mipa anne a koupa chun hichu amuphat in ama le ama akihoulim in, “Hiche mipa hi themgao ahipou pouleh, itobang numei ham athamkha nu hi, amanu hi michonse ahi! ti ahet tei ding ahi,” atin ahi.
English: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”

tcz: Chutah chun Yeshuan alunggel chu ahin donbut in, “Simon” tin Pharisee pa koma chun, “Thilkhat nakomah kaseinom'e” ati. “Sei jeng in, houhil” tin Simon in adonbut paiyin ahi.
en: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”
text:
LUK 7:40
Thadou: Chutah chun Yeshuan alunggel chu ahin donbut in, “Simon” tin Pharisee pa koma chun, “Thilkhat nakomah kaseinom'e” ati. “Sei jeng in, houhil” tin Simon in adonbut paiyin ahi.
English: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thusim hi aseipeh tai: “Mikhat in mini sum abatsah in–khatpa dangka ja-nga chule khat dangka som-nga.
en: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
text:
LUK 7:41
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thusim hi aseipeh tai: “Mikhat in mini sum abatsah in–khatpa dangka ja-nga chule khat dangka som-nga.
English: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

tcz: Ahin anigel lhon in asajou lhon tapon, hijeh chun hepi na neitah in angaidam in abat lhon akah peh tai. Chujou chun koijoh chun ama chu ngailu jon tem tia nagel em?” tin adongtai.
en: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”
text:
LUK 7:42
Thadou: Ahin anigel lhon in asajou lhon tapon, hijeh chun hepi na neitah in angaidam in abat lhon akah peh tai. Chujou chun koijoh chun ama chu ngailu jon tem tia nagel em?” tin adongtai.
English: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

tcz: Simon in adonbut in, “Keigel in abat tamjopa chu,” ati. “Hichu adih'e” tin Yeshuan aseitai.
en: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”
text:
LUK 7:43
Thadou: Simon in adonbut in, “Keigel in abat tamjopa chu,” ati. “Hichu adih'e” tin Yeshuan aseitai.
English: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

tcz: Chuin numeinu heng lam ngan akiheiyin Simon jah'a aseitai, “Hiche numeinu hichea dilsu nu hi ven. Keima na'in a kahung lut chun, nangman tui kakenga vutkhu sillhah nading neipepon, ahivangin hiche nu hin amitlhi tuiyin asop lhan, chule asam in atheh ngim in ahi.”
en: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.
text:
LUK 7:44
Thadou: Chuin numeinu heng lam ngan akiheiyin Simon jah'a aseitai, “Hiche numeinu hichea dilsu nu hi ven. Keima na'in a kahung lut chun, nangman tui kakenga vutkhu sillhah nading neipepon, ahivangin hiche nu hin amitlhi tuiyin asop lhan, chule asam in atheh ngim in ahi.”
English: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

tcz: Nangman chibai neiboh pon, ahin kahung lut a pat hichenu hin kakengmuh achop chop jong anga hih laiye.
en: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.
text:
LUK 7:45
Thadou: Nangman chibai neiboh pon, ahin kahung lut a pat hichenu hin kakengmuh achop chop jong anga hih laiye.
English: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

tcz: Nangman kalua olive thao nuding na gelkhoh pon, amanu vang hin kakeng phang thao namtuiyin anui.
en: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.
text:
LUK 7:46
Thadou: Nangman kalua olive thao nuding na gelkhoh pon, amanu vang hin kakeng phang thao namtuiyin anui.
English: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

tcz: “Kaseipeh nahi, amanu chonsetna ho–tamtah ahiuvin, ngaidam ahitai, hijeh a chu amanun ngailutna lentah eimusah ahi. Amavang mi akingaidam lhom chu akipah lhom in ahi” ati.
en: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”
text:
LUK 7:47
Thadou: “Kaseipeh nahi, amanu chonsetna ho–tamtah ahiuvin, ngaidam ahitai, hijeh a chu amanun ngailutna lentah eimusah ahi. Amavang mi akingaidam lhom chu akipah lhom in ahi” ati.
English: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan numeinu jah'a, “Nachonsetna ho kingaidam ahitai” ati.
en: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
text:
LUK 7:48
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan numeinu jah'a, “Nachonsetna ho kingaidam ahitai” ati.
English: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

tcz: Dokhanga tou miho chu ama ho le amaho akihouvun, “Hiche mipa hi koi hiya mi chonse jong angaidam ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
text:
LUK 7:49
Thadou: Dokhanga tou miho chu ama ho le amaho akihouvun, “Hiche mipa hi koi hiya mi chonse jong angaidam ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

tcz: Chule Yeshuan numeinu jah'a aseitai, “Natahsan in nahuhhing ahitai, lungmongin chetan,” ati.
en: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
text:
LUK 7:50
Thadou: Chule Yeshuan numeinu jah'a aseitai, “Natahsan in nahuhhing ahitai, lungmongin chetan,” ati.
English: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”

tcz: Chujou vin Yeshua anaivellah kho ho vilding in akipandoh in, Pathen Lenggam chungchang Kipana Thupha seiphong leh hillhang le akop in ahi. Aseijui somleni ho jong akipuiyin,
en: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,
text:
LUK 8:1
Thadou: Chujou vin Yeshua anaivellah kho ho vilding in akipandoh in, Pathen Lenggam chungchang Kipana Thupha seiphong leh hillhang le akop in ahi. Aseijui somleni ho jong akipuiyin,
English: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,

tcz: lhagaoboh vop'a kon le anatna kisudam numei phabep khat jong ahiuve. Amaho lah a chun Mary Magdelene, thilha sagi anodoh peh nu;
en: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

tcz: Joanna, Chuza jinu, Herod sumkolveina vesuipa; Susanna; chule adang mi tamtah Yeshua le aseijui te anei agouva panpi na hintoh doh jing ho jong ahiuve.
en: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.
text:
LUK 8:3
Thadou: Joanna, Chuza jinu, Herod sumkolveina vesuipa; Susanna; chule adang mi tamtah Yeshua le aseijui te anei agouva panpi na hintoh doh jing ho jong ahiuve.
English: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan thusim khat thulem'in mihonpi tamtah, kho chom chom'a kon hung kisutoa athusei ngaidinga hung ho komah hitin aseiye:
en: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable:
text:
LUK 8:4
Thadou: Nikhat Yeshuan thusim khat thulem'in mihonpi tamtah, kho chom chom'a kon hung kisutoa athusei ngaidinga hung ho komah hitin aseiye:
English: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable:

tcz: “Loubol mi khat amuchi tu dingin achedoh tai. Aloulai dungah athe len ahileh, muchi abang chu lamsih'a achun, chuva chun chotphan aumin, chule vachaten anedoh tauve.
en: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.
text:
LUK 8:5
Thadou: “Loubol mi khat amuchi tu dingin achedoh tai. Aloulai dungah athe len ahileh, muchi abang chu lamsih'a achun, chuva chun chotphan aumin, chule vachaten anedoh tauve.
English: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

tcz: Muchi adang songlah'a achui. Ahung khang doh'in, ahin akehdoh chu agoplha loiyin asunou ding alhomjeh in athidoh tai.
en: Other seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
text:
LUK 8:6
Thadou: Muchi adang songlah'a achui. Ahung khang doh'in, ahin akehdoh chu agoplha loiyin asunou ding alhomjeh in athidoh tai.
English: Other seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.

tcz: Muchi adang chu linglah'a achun, ahung kehdoh in chule ling chun adeplih jitai.
en: Other fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.
text:
LUK 8:7
Thadou: Muchi adang chu linglah'a achun, ahung kehdoh in chule ling chun adeplih jitai.
English: Other fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.

tcz: Muchi adang khat kit chu leipha laiyah achui. Hiche muchi chu akhang in, ga ahin son anakitu sangin ajat jakhat in agan ahi” ati. Hiche aseijouvin ahung pengjah jengin, “Koihileh angai na ding nakhang nei chan in angaiya ahetchet ding ahi,” ati.
en: Other fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”
text:
LUK 8:8
Thadou: Muchi adang khat kit chu leipha laiyah achui. Hiche muchi chu akhang in, ga ahin son anakitu sangin ajat jakhat in agan ahi” ati. Hiche aseijouvin ahung pengjah jengin, “Koihileh angai na ding nakhang nei chan in angaiya ahetchet ding ahi,” ati.
English: Other fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”

tcz: Aseijui hon hiche thulem hi ipi kisei na ham adongun ahi.
en: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”
text:
LUK 8:9
Thadou: Aseijui hon hiche thulem hi ipi kisei na ham adongun ahi.
English: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”

tcz: Aman adonbut in, “Nanghon Pathen Lenggam thuguh nahet thei nadiuva phalpehna chang nahiuve. Amavang midangho hilna a thulem kaman hi Pathen Lekhabua kisun guilhun nadinga ahi: Ahin vet teng uleh, amu tahtah lou diu ahi. Ajah teng uleh, ahetthei lou diu ahi.”
en: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’
text:
LUK 8:10
Thadou: Aman adonbut in, “Nanghon Pathen Lenggam thuguh nahet thei nadiuva phalpehna chang nahiuve. Amavang midangho hilna a thulem kaman hi Pathen Lekhabua kisun guilhun nadinga ahi: Ahin vet teng uleh, amu tahtah lou diu ahi. Ajah teng uleh, ahetthei lou diu ahi.”
English: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’

tcz: “Hiche hi thulem kisei avetsahna chu ahi: Muchi chu Pathen thu ahi.
en: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
text:
LUK 8:11
Thadou: “Hiche hi thulem kisei avetsahna chu ahi: Muchi chu Pathen thu ahi.
English: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

tcz: Lamsih a chu muchin avetsah chu, thu kisei ja'a ahivanga agiloupa hunga atahsan thei nalou ding le asochat lou na dinga alungsunga kon alahmang peh miho aseina ahi.
en: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.
text:
LUK 8:12
Thadou: Lamsih a chu muchin avetsah chu, thu kisei ja'a ahivanga agiloupa hunga atahsan thei nalou ding le asochat lou na dinga alungsunga kon alahmang peh miho aseina ahi.
English: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

tcz: Muchi songlah'a chu hon avetsah chu, thu kisei ja'a chule kipah tah'a kisanta, ahivanga jung akhothuh loujeh uva phat chomkhat kah'a bou tahsan, lhepna atoteng uleh lhuji ho aseina ahi.
en: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.
text:
LUK 8:13
Thadou: Muchi songlah'a chu hon avetsah chu, thu kisei ja'a chule kipah tah'a kisanta, ahivanga jung akhothuh loujeh uva phat chomkhat kah'a bou tahsan, lhepna atoteng uleh lhuji ho aseina ahi.
English: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

tcz: Muchi linglah'a chu hon avetsah chu, athu ja'a ahivanga athujah chu leiset gimna haosatna chule nopsahna hon atomchah a khangdoh thei talou ho aseina ahi. Hijeh chun apilhing thei tapouvin ahi.
en: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.
text:
LUK 8:14
Thadou: Muchi linglah'a chu hon avetsah chu, athu ja'a ahivanga athujah chu leiset gimna haosatna chule nopsahna hon atomchah a khangdoh thei talou ho aseina ahi. Hijeh chun apilhing thei tapouvin ahi.
English: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.

tcz: Chule muchi leipha laiya chu chun milungtheng, lungthim pha, Pathen thu ja'a nung ho, chule lungneng tah'a ga tamtah sodoh ho aseina ahi. Meivah Lheng Akikhu Den Ngaipoi”
en: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.
text:
LUK 8:15
Thadou: Chule muchi leipha laiya chu chun milungtheng, lungthim pha, Pathen thu ja'a nung ho, chule lungneng tah'a ga tamtah sodoh ho aseina ahi. Meivah Lheng Akikhu Den Ngaipoi”
English: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.

tcz: “Koiman meivah avah in chule lheng'in akhun ahiloule jalkhun noiyah asel ngaipoi. Meivah chu atunna ah akitungin, chuva chun avah chu insunga lut jousen amuthei bouve.
en: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.
text:
LUK 8:16
Thadou: “Koiman meivah avah in chule lheng'in akhun ahiloule jalkhun noiyah asel ngaipoi. Meivah chu atunna ah akitungin, chuva chun avah chu insunga lut jousen amuthei bouve.
English: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile akiselguh jouse lhangphonga hung kipodoh ding, chule akiphongdoh lou jouse meivah noiya kipodoh ding mijouse kihetsah ding ahi.”
en: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.
text:
LUK 8:17
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile akiselguh jouse lhangphonga hung kipodoh ding, chule akiphongdoh lou jouse meivah noiya kipodoh ding mijouse kihetsah ding ahi.”
English: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.

tcz: “Hijeh chun iti najah uvem chingtheiyun. Kathuhil ngai jouse, hetthem theina kipeh be ding. Amavang thungai louho chu, ahetsa dan'a agel hou jeng jong amahoa kona kilamang ding ahi.” ati. Yeshua Le A-Insung Mite
en: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”
text:
LUK 8:18
Thadou: “Hijeh chun iti najah uvem chingtheiyun. Kathuhil ngai jouse, hetthem theina kipeh be ding. Amavang thungai louho chu, ahetsa dan'a agel hou jeng jong amahoa kona kilamang ding ahi.” ati. Yeshua Le A-Insung Mite
English: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshua anu le asopiho amatoh kimudin ahung un, ahin mihonpi jeh chun ama kom nailut theilouvin aum tauve.
en: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.
text:
LUK 8:19
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua anu le asopiho amatoh kimudin ahung un, ahin mihonpi jeh chun ama kom nailut theilouvin aum tauve.
English: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

tcz: Koiham khat'in Yeshua aseipeh in, “Nanu le nasopiho polangah aumuve, chule nakimutopi nom uve,” atipeh tai.
en: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”
text:
LUK 8:20
Thadou: Koiham khat'in Yeshua aseipeh in, “Nanu le nasopiho polangah aumuve, chule nakimutopi nom uve,” atipeh tai.
English: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kanu le kasopi ho chu koi hileh Pathen thu ja'a athua nungho chu ahiuve” ati.
en: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”
text:
LUK 8:21
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kanu le kasopi ho chu koi hileh Pathen thu ja'a athua nungho chu ahiuve” ati.
English: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan aseijuite jah'a aseiyin, “Dil gal langkhat ah galkaiyu hite” ati. Hijeh chun kong sungah alut'un akipatdoh tauve.
en: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.
text:
LUK 8:22
Thadou: Nikhat Yeshuan aseijuite jah'a aseiyin, “Dil gal langkhat ah galkaiyu hite” ati. Hijeh chun kong sungah alut'un akipatdoh tauve.
English: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.

tcz: Konga akitol laiyun, Yeshua chomkhat kichol din a-imu'e. Ahin sotloulaiyin, huipi hattah tuipi chungah chun anungsuh'e. Kong chu tui adim tan, amaho setoh teiding dinmun'ah achutauve.
en: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.
text:
LUK 8:23
Thadou: Konga akitol laiyun, Yeshua chomkhat kichol din a-imu'e. Ahin sotloulaiyin, huipi hattah tuipi chungah chun anungsuh'e. Kong chu tui adim tan, amaho setoh teiding dinmun'ah achutauve.
English: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

tcz: Aseijuite acheuvin agakaithou un, “Pipu, Pipu, alhalut ding ihitauve!” tin apengjah jeng tauve. Yeshua athodoh phat in, huipi le tui kinonglai chu aphohthip tai. Chuin apettah in huipi athip'in imajouse anomsel tai.
en: They came to him and awoke him, saying, “Master, Master, we are dying!” He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; then they ceased, and it was calm.
text:
LUK 8:24
Thadou: Aseijuite acheuvin agakaithou un, “Pipu, Pipu, alhalut ding ihitauve!” tin apengjah jeng tauve. Yeshua athodoh phat in, huipi le tui kinonglai chu aphohthip tai. Chuin apettah in huipi athip'in imajouse anomsel tai.
English: They came to him and awoke him, saying, “Master, Master, we are dying!” He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; then they ceased, and it was calm.

tcz: Chuin amaho chu adongin, “Natahsan'u hoiba ham?” ati. Amaho akihoulhi chilchel'un, “Thupeh anei teng huipi le tuikinong jengin jong athu angaiye!” akitiuve.
en: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”
text:
LUK 8:25
Thadou: Chuin amaho chu adongin, “Natahsan'u hoiba ham?” ati. Amaho akihoulhi chilchel'un, “Thupeh anei teng huipi le tuikinong jengin jong athu angaiye!” akitiuve.
English: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”

tcz: Hichun amaho Galilee a pat in dil gallang, Gerasene gamkai ahunglhung tauve.
en: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.
text:
LUK 8:26
Thadou: Hichun amaho Galilee a pat in dil gallang, Gerasene gamkai ahunglhung tauve.
English: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

tcz: Yeshua konga kona apotdoh leh, mikhat thilhavop khat ahungin ahung kimupin ahi. Phat sottah amapa chu in beiya chule sagoh keova khopi pam lhanmol lah'a cheng ji ahi.
en: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.
text:
LUK 8:27
Thadou: Yeshua konga kona apotdoh leh, mikhat thilhavop khat ahungin ahung kimupin ahi. Phat sottah amapa chu in beiya chule sagoh keova khopi pam lhanmol lah'a cheng ji ahi.
English: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.

tcz: Yeshua amu mu chun apeng'in chule amasanga alhu jengin ahi. Chuin ahung peng in, “Ipi jeh a kakoma hung kikumlut nahim, Yeshua, Chungnung pen Pathen Chapa? Lungsettah in, katao ahi, nei gimbol hih in,” ati.
en: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”
text:
LUK 8:28
Thadou: Yeshua amu mu chun apeng'in chule amasanga alhu jengin ahi. Chuin ahung peng in, “Ipi jeh a kakoma hung kikumlut nahim, Yeshua, Chungnung pen Pathen Chapa? Lungsettah in, katao ahi, nei gimbol hih in,” ati.
English: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Yeshuan hiche lhagaoboh chu amapa a kona ahungdoh nadinga ana thupehsa ahitai. Hiche lhagao boh hin mipa hi athunun ji ahi. Akimattup'a thihkhaova akibultuh jeng jong leh, aman imalouva atumtan jia gammang lah adelji, apumpia thilha thaneina noiya um ahitai.
en: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.
text:
LUK 8:29
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile Yeshuan hiche lhagaoboh chu amapa a kona ahungdoh nadinga ana thupehsa ahitai. Hiche lhagao boh hin mipa hi athunun ji ahi. Akimattup'a thihkhaova akibultuh jeng jong leh, aman imalouva atumtan jia gammang lah adelji, apumpia thilha thaneina noiya um ahitai.
English: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

tcz: Yeshuan adongin, “Namin ipi ham?” ati. “Janel” tin ahin donbut'e, ajehchu hiche mipa chu thilha tampin abop ahi.
en: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.
text:
LUK 8:30
Thadou: Yeshuan adongin, “Namin ipi ham?” ati. “Janel” tin ahin donbut'e, ajehchu hiche mipa chu thilha tampin abop ahi.
English: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.

tcz: Thilha ho chun Yeshuan atosin bei onghom'a asol louna diuvin angeh tauve.
en: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.
text:
LUK 8:31
Thadou: Thilha ho chun Yeshuan atosin bei onghom'a asol louna diuvin angeh tauve.
English: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

tcz: Hiche mun'a chu voh hon tampi mollanga lha ahiuvin, chule thilhaho chun hiche vohchaho sunga alut nadiu joh in athum'un ahi. Hijeh chun Yeshuan phalna apen,
en: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.
text:
LUK 8:32
Thadou: Hiche mun'a chu voh hon tampi mollanga lha ahiuvin, chule thilhaho chun hiche vohchaho sunga alut nadiu joh in athum'un ahi. Hijeh chun Yeshuan phalna apen,
English: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.

tcz: chuin thilhaho chu mipa a konin ahung potdoh'un vohchaho sungah alut uvin, chule vohcha honpi chu molchung akensuh'a pat chun alhaisuh un dillen a chun alhai lhauvin alhum lut gam tauve.
en: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.
text:
LUK 8:33
Thadou: chuin thilhaho chu mipa a konin ahung potdoh'un vohchaho sungah alut uvin, chule vohcha honpi chu molchung akensuh'a pat chun alhaisuh un dillen a chun alhai lhauvin alhum lut gam tauve.
English: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

tcz: Achinghon thilsoh chu amuphat un, anai vel'a khoho le akimvel thinglhang gam ho ah alhai lut un thusoh chu athejal le tauve.
en: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.
text:
LUK 8:34
Thadou: Achinghon thilsoh chu amuphat un, anai vel'a khoho le akimvel thinglhang gam ho ah alhai lut un thusoh chu athejal le tauve.
English: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.

tcz: Thilsoh umchan veding in mipiho ahung lhaidoh uve. Mihonpi chomloukah in Yeshua hengah ahung kikhom un, chule hiche mipa thilhaho a kona kilha ongpa chu amuuvin ahi. Amapa chu Yeshua kengbul'ah atouvin, von akivon'in, chule alimgeh tan, chule amaho chu abonun akicha tauvin ahi.
en: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
text:
LUK 8:35
Thadou: Thilsoh umchan veding in mipiho ahung lhaidoh uve. Mihonpi chomloukah in Yeshua hengah ahung kikhom un, chule hiche mipa thilhaho a kona kilha ongpa chu amuuvin ahi. Amapa chu Yeshua kengbul'ah atouvin, von akivon'in, chule alimgeh tan, chule amaho chu abonun akicha tauvin ahi.
English: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

tcz: Chuin thilsoh umchan muho chun adangho jah'a thilha voppa chu iti suhdam'a umham ti aseipeh un ahi.
en: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.
text:
LUK 8:36
Thadou: Chuin thilsoh umchan muho chun adangho jah'a thilha voppa chu iti suhdam'a umham ti aseipeh un ahi.
English: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

tcz: Chuin Gerasene gamkaiya mipiho jousen Yeshua hengah agam'u adalhah'a achemang nadin angeh tauve, ajehchu kichatna nasatah huinun chun alodim u ahitai. Hijeh chun Yeshua jong kong sungah alelut in adalhatai, dil gal langkhat le galkai kit dingin.
en: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.
text:
LUK 8:37
Thadou: Chuin Gerasene gamkaiya mipiho jousen Yeshua hengah agam'u adalhah'a achemang nadin angeh tauve, ajehchu kichatna nasatah huinun chun alodim u ahitai. Hijeh chun Yeshua jong kong sungah alelut in adalhatai, dil gal langkhat le galkai kit dingin.
English: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.

tcz: Mipa thilha kinodoh peh pa chun amatoh lhonkhom din athum'in, ahin Yeshuan inlang joh a asol'in, hitin aseipeh e,
en: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,
text:
LUK 8:38
Thadou: Mipa thilha kinodoh peh pa chun amatoh lhonkhom din athum'in, ahin Yeshuan inlang joh a asol'in, hitin aseipeh e,
English: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

tcz: “Ahipoi, na insungmite kom joh'a chen lang, chule Pathen in nadinga nabolpeh jouse hi gaseipeh tan,” ati. Hijeh chun amapa chu khopi dung lah'a achen, Yeshuan thil loupi abolpeh ho aseiphong len ahi.
en: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.
text:
LUK 8:39
Thadou: “Ahipoi, na insungmite kom joh'a chen lang, chule Pathen in nadinga nabolpeh jouse hi gaseipeh tan,” ati. Hijeh chun amapa chu khopi dung lah'a achen, Yeshuan thil loupi abolpeh ho aseiphong len ahi.
English: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

tcz: Dil gallang a chun mihonpin Yeshua ana lem'un ahi, ajeh chu amahon ananga jingu ahi.
en: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.
text:
LUK 8:40
Thadou: Dil gallang a chun mihonpin Yeshua ana lem'un ahi, ajeh chu amahon ananga jingu ahi.
English: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

tcz: Chuin Jairus kiti akikhopnau in'a lamkai khat, ahungin Yeshua kengbul'a abohkhup in a'ina akilhonpi din ahung tem'e.
en: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,
text:
LUK 8:41
Thadou: Chuin Jairus kiti akikhopnau in'a lamkai khat, ahungin Yeshua kengbul'a abohkhup in a'ina akilhonpi din ahung tem'e.
English: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,

tcz: Achanu changkhat seh, kum somleni bep chu, thiah ahi. Yeshua amapa chutoh alhon khom'in ahileh amachu mihonpi chun atom chahkheh jengin ahi.
en: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.
text:
LUK 8:42
Thadou: Achanu changkhat seh, kum somleni bep chu, thiah ahi. Yeshua amapa chutoh alhon khom'in ahileh amachu mihonpi chun atom chahkheh jengin ahi.
English: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

tcz: Mihonpi lah'a chun numei khat kum somleni jen thilong'a damlou aumin, amanun damna akimu jou lou ahi.
en: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,
text:
LUK 8:43
Thadou: Mihonpi lah'a chun numei khat kum somleni jen thilong'a damlou aumin, amanun damna akimu jou lou ahi.
English: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,

tcz: Yeshua nung lang'a pat ahungin, amanun Yeshua ponmang athamtai. Apettah chun athilon atang hel tai.
en: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.
text:
LUK 8:44
Thadou: Yeshua nung lang'a pat ahungin, amanun Yeshua ponmang athamtai. Apettah chun athilon atang hel tai.
English: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

tcz: “Koiham ei tongkha?” tin Yeshuan ahin dongtai. Mijousen ahilounau aseiyun chuin Peter in, “Pipu, mihonpi hin nasuhkhah ahi,” ati.
en: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
text:
LUK 8:45
Thadou: “Koiham ei tongkha?” tin Yeshuan ahin dongtai. Mijousen ahilounau aseiyun chuin Peter in, “Pipu, mihonpi hin nasuhkhah ahi,” ati.
English: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Koiham khat in thamkhah ding lungput neimonga eitham ahi, ijeh inem itile keiya kona suhdamna thaneina apot kahei,” ati.
en: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”
text:
LUK 8:46
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Koiham khat in thamkhah ding lungput neimonga eitham ahi, ijeh inem itile keiya kona suhdamna thaneina apot kahei,” ati.
English: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”

tcz: Numei nu chun ki-immang thei kahitapoi ti ahet phat in, kithing pumin akengbul'ah adilsutan ahi. Mihonpi chun ipi jeh a atohkhah ham chule adampai jeng thu ahilchet hochu ajauvin ahi.
en: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
text:
LUK 8:47
Thadou: Numei nu chun ki-immang thei kahitapoi ti ahet phat in, kithing pumin akengbul'ah adilsutan ahi. Mihonpi chun ipi jeh a atohkhah ham chule adampai jeng thu ahilchet hochu ajauvin ahi.
English: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

tcz: “Chanu” tin amanu jah'a chun, “Natahsan in nadamsah ahitai, lungmongin chetan” ati.
en: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”
text:
LUK 8:48
Thadou: “Chanu” tin amanu jah'a chun, “Natahsan in nadamsah ahitai, lungmongin chetan” ati.
English: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”

tcz: Amanu koma thu aseijing laiyin, kikhopna in'a lamkai pa, Jairus, in'a kon thupole khat ahung vailhungin ahi. Aman amapa jah'a aseipeh in, “Nachanu athitai. Tua houhil nasuhboi chu phachomlou ding ahitai,” ati.
en: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”
text:
LUK 8:49
Thadou: Amanu koma thu aseijing laiyin, kikhopna in'a lamkai pa, Jairus, in'a kon thupole khat ahung vailhungin ahi. Aman amapa jah'a aseipeh in, “Nachanu athitai. Tua houhil nasuhboi chu phachomlou ding ahitai,” ati.
English: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”

tcz: Ahin Yeshuan thilsoh ajah chun, Jairus jah'a hitin aseiye, “Kicha hih'in, tahsan poupouvin, amanu suhdam'a umding ahi,” atipeh e.
en: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”
text:
LUK 8:50
Thadou: Ahin Yeshuan thilsoh ajah chun, Jairus jah'a hitin aseiye, “Kicha hih'in, tahsan poupouvin, amanu suhdam'a umding ahi,” atipeh e.
English: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”

tcz: Amaho in ahunglhun phat'un, Yeshuan Peter, John, le James, chule numei chapangnu nulepa tailou midang koima toh alut ding anompoi.
en: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.
text:
LUK 8:51
Thadou: Amaho in ahunglhun phat'un, Yeshuan Peter, John, le James, chule numei chapangnu nulepa tailou midang koima toh alut ding anompoi.
English: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

tcz: In chu mi tamtah akap le amaovah dimset'a um ahi, ahin aman aseiyin, “Kap tahih un! Athi ahipoi, a-imu ahibouve,” atipeh'e.
en: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”
text:
LUK 8:52
Thadou: In chu mi tamtah akap le amaovah dimset'a um ahi, ahin aman aseiyin, “Kap tahih un! Athi ahipoi, a-imu ahibouve,” atipeh'e.
English: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”

tcz: Ahivangin mihonpi chun anuisat un, ajeh chu athitai tichu hoitah a ahet'u ahi.
en: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.
text:
LUK 8:53
Thadou: Ahivangin mihonpi chun anuisat un, ajeh chu athitai tichu hoitah a ahet'u ahi.
English: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan akhut in atuh in chule aw sangtah in, “Chanu, thoudoh in!” tin aseitai.
en: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”
text:
LUK 8:54
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan akhut in atuh in chule aw sangtah in, “Chanu, thoudoh in!” tin aseitai.
English: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

tcz: Chuin hiche pet tah chun amanu hinna chu ahung kilen, kinloitah in ahung dingdoh e! Chuin Yeshuan nehding khattou apeh diuvin aseipeh tai.
en: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.
text:
LUK 8:55
Thadou: Chuin hiche pet tah chun amanu hinna chu ahung kilen, kinloitah in ahung dingdoh e! Chuin Yeshuan nehding khattou apeh diuvin aseipeh tai.
English: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

tcz: Anu le apa chu akipah val behseh jengin, ahin Yeshuan thilsoh chu koima koma seidoh lou din ahilchah e.
en: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.
text:
LUK 8:56
Thadou: Anu le apa chu akipah val behseh jengin, ahin Yeshuan thilsoh chu koima koma seidoh lou din ahilchah e.
English: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan aseijui somleni ho chu akoukhom in, thilhaho jouse le natna jouse suhdamna thahatna le thilboltheina apen ahi.
en: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.
text:
LUK 9:1
Thadou: Nikhat Yeshuan aseijui somleni ho chu akoukhom in, thilhaho jouse le natna jouse suhdamna thahatna le thilboltheina apen ahi.
English: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

tcz: Chuin aman amaho chu Pathen Lenggam thudol mijouse seipeh ding leh adamlou te damsah dingin asoldoh'e.
en: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.
text:
LUK 9:2
Thadou: Chuin aman amaho chu Pathen Lenggam thudol mijouse seipeh ding leh adamlou te damsah dingin asoldoh'e.
English: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

tcz: “Najin nadiuvah imacha kipoh hih'un” tin ahilchah in “Tenggol ham, sakhao ham, an neh ding ham, sum ham ahilouleh von khel jeng jong kipoh hih'un.
en: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.
text:
LUK 9:3
Thadou: “Najin nadiuvah imacha kipoh hih'un” tin ahilchah in “Tenggol ham, sakhao ham, an neh ding ham, sum ham ahilouleh von khel jeng jong kipoh hih'un.
English: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.

tcz: Nache na chan uvah khopi nadalhah tokah uvin nalhun nau in a chun um'un.
en: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.
text:
LUK 9:4
Thadou: Nache na chan uvah khopi nadalhah tokah uvin nalhun nau in a chun um'un.
English: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

tcz: Chule khopi khat chun nangho lemding adauva ahileh, nakengphang uva vutkhu ho thinglhauvin, hiche miho chu aso so kisoh tauhen tia lhahdohna in,” ati.
en: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”
text:
LUK 9:5
Thadou: Chule khopi khat chun nangho lemding adauva ahileh, nakengphang uva vutkhu ho thinglhauvin, hiche miho chu aso so kisoh tauhen tia lhahdohna in,” ati.
English: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”

tcz: Hitichun amahon khotin'a gamchot apan'un, Kipana Thupha lhangsap chule ana damlou damsah toh aboluve. Herod In Yeshua Aki-Mupi Nom
en: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.
text:
LUK 9:6
Thadou: Hitichun amahon khotin'a gamchot apan'un, Kipana Thupha lhangsap chule ana damlou damsah toh aboluve. Herod In Yeshua Aki-Mupi Nom
English: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.

tcz: Herod Antipas, Galilee gamvaipopan Yeshua natoh thilbol jouse ajahdoh phat in alungboi dentai. Mi konkhat chun Twilutsah John athilah'a kon thoudoh kit ahi atiuve.
en: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,
text:
LUK 9:7
Thadou: Herod Antipas, Galilee gamvaipopan Yeshua natoh thilbol jouse ajahdoh phat in alungboi dentai. Mi konkhat chun Twilutsah John athilah'a kon thoudoh kit ahi atiuve.
English: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

tcz: Adanghon Yeshua chu Elijah ahilouleh themgao holah'a khat athia kon thoukit ahi atiuve.
en: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.
text:
LUK 9:8
Thadou: Adanghon Yeshua chu Elijah ahilouleh themgao holah'a khat athia kon thoukit ahi atiuve.
English: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

tcz: “Keiman la John kathat tan,” tin Herod in aseiyin, “Ahileh hiche mipa, athusim kajah pa hi koiham?” ati. Chule ama chu mutei ding atup jing tan ahi. Yeshuan Mi Sang Nga Val Jen Avahva
en: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.
text:
LUK 9:9
Thadou: “Keiman la John kathat tan,” tin Herod in aseiyin, “Ahileh hiche mipa, athusim kajah pa hi koiham?” ati. Chule ama chu mutei ding atup jing tan ahi. Yeshuan Mi Sang Nga Val Jen Avahva
English: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.

tcz: Seijui ho ahung kileu chun, Yeshua hengah athilbol jouseu aseipeh tauve. Chuin ama amaho chutoh guhthim chan Bethsaida kho langah ache tauvin ahi.
en: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.
text:
LUK 9:10
Thadou: Seijui ho ahung kileu chun, Yeshua hengah athilbol jouseu aseipeh tauve. Chuin ama amaho chutoh guhthim chan Bethsaida kho langah ache tauvin ahi.
English: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.

tcz: Ahivangin mihonpi chun hoiya ache aholdoh un chule ajui tauve. Aman amaho chu alem in, Pathen Lenggam thudol ahil'in, chule ana damlou ho asudam in ahi.
en: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.
text:
LUK 9:11
Thadou: Ahivangin mihonpi chun hoiya ache aholdoh un chule ajui tauve. Aman amaho chu alem in, Pathen Lenggam thudol ahil'in, chule ana damlou ho asudam in ahi.
English: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.

tcz: Nilhangkai vaigei thim lang hin seijui somleni akoma ahungun aseitauve, “Mihonpi hi naivellah khoho le loujao dungah soldoh tan, anneh le jan gena ding akimu thei nadiuvin. Hikom munthip'a hin neh ding imacha aumpoi,” ahung tiuve.
en: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”
text:
LUK 9:12
Thadou: Nilhangkai vaigei thim lang hin seijui somleni akoma ahungun aseitauve, “Mihonpi hi naivellah khoho le loujao dungah soldoh tan, anneh le jan gena ding akimu thei nadiuvin. Hikom munthip'a hin neh ding imacha aumpoi,” ahung tiuve.
English: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”
