tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Nanghon amaho vah'un” ati. “Ahin keihon changlhah pheng-nga le nga ni bouseh kaneiyuve,” tin ahin donbut'un, “Ahilou le kacheuva nehding mihonpi hijat dinga hi kagachoh diuva nangaitom?” atiuve.
en: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”
text:
LUK 9:13
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Nanghon amaho vah'un” ati. “Ahin keihon changlhah pheng-nga le nga ni bouseh kaneiyuve,” tin ahin donbut'un, “Ahilou le kacheuva nehding mihonpi hijat dinga hi kagachoh diuva nangaitom?” atiuve.
English: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

tcz: Ajeh chu chukoma chu mi pasal sang nga jen umah ahi. Yeshuan adonbut in, “Mi somnga nga bep'a aloi loiya tou dingin seipeh un,” ati.
en: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”
text:
LUK 9:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu chukoma chu mi pasal sang nga jen umah ahi. Yeshuan adonbut in, “Mi somnga nga bep'a aloi loiya tou dingin seipeh un,” ati.
English: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

tcz: Hijeh chun mipi abon'un atou tauve.
en: They did so, and made them all sit down.
text:
LUK 9:15
Thadou: Hijeh chun mipi abon'un atou tauve.
English: They did so, and made them all sit down.

tcz: Yeshuan changlhah pheng nga le nga ni chu alan, vanlam aven, phatthei abohtai. Chuin changlhah ho chu ahal hal'a asuhkeh toh kilhon in, changlhah le nga chu aseijuite komah ahin pedoh doh jengin, amahon mipi ho ahoppeh uve.
en: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.
text:
LUK 9:16
Thadou: Yeshuan changlhah pheng nga le nga ni chu alan, vanlam aven, phatthei abohtai. Chuin changlhah ho chu ahal hal'a asuhkeh toh kilhon in, changlhah le nga chu aseijuite komah ahin pedoh doh jengin, amahon mipi ho ahoppeh uve.
English: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

tcz: Chuin abon'un aduchan chan aneuvin, chule chomkhat jouvin seijui hon nehmoh paipeh somleni alohdoh uve.
en: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
text:
LUK 9:17
Thadou: Chuin abon'un aduchan chan aneuvin, chule chomkhat jouvin seijui hon nehmoh paipeh somleni alohdoh uve.
English: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

tcz: Nikhat achangseh'a tao dingin Yeshuan mihonpi adalhan ahi. Aseijuite bouseh toh um ahin, aman hitin adong tai, “Mihon kei hi koi ahi eitiuvem?” atileh,
en: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”
text:
LUK 9:18
Thadou: Nikhat achangseh'a tao dingin Yeshuan mihonpi adalhan ahi. Aseijuite bouseh toh um ahin, aman hitin adong tai, “Mihon kei hi koi ahi eitiuvem?” atileh,
English: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”

tcz: amahon adonbut un, “Abangin Twilutsah John nahi atiuvin, abangin Elijah, chule adanghon malai themgaoho lah'a khat thoukit nahi atiuve,” atipeh uve.
en: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”
text:
LUK 9:19
Thadou: amahon adonbut un, “Abangin Twilutsah John nahi atiuvin, abangin Elijah, chule adanghon malai themgaoho lah'a khat thoukit nahi atiuve,” atipeh uve.
English: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”

tcz: Chuin aman amaho chu adong'in, “Nanghon la koi ahi neitiuvem?” atileh Peter in adonbut in, “Nangma Messiah, Pathen a kon hung kisol chu nahi,” ati.
en: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”
text:
LUK 9:20
Thadou: Chuin aman amaho chu adong'in, “Nanghon la koi ahi neitiuvem?” atileh Peter in adonbut in, “Nangma Messiah, Pathen a kon hung kisol chu nahi,” ati.
English: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

tcz: Yeshuan aseijuite koi ahi koima koma aseidoh louna diuvin agihsal'in ahi.
en: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,
text:
LUK 9:21
Thadou: Yeshuan aseijuite koi ahi koima koma aseidoh louna diuvin agihsal'in ahi.
English: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,

tcz: “Mihem Chapa hin gim genthei tampi athoh ding,” tin ahinseiyin, “Amachu upa ho, thempuho, chule hou danthuhil hon ahin pampai diu ahi. Ama chu tha a umding, amavang anithum nileh athilah'a kona kaithouva umding ahi” ati.
en: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”
text:
LUK 9:22
Thadou: “Mihem Chapa hin gim genthei tampi athoh ding,” tin ahinseiyin, “Amachu upa ho, thempuho, chule hou danthuhil hon ahin pampai diu ahi. Ama chu tha a umding, amavang anithum nileh athilah'a kona kaithouva umding ahi” ati.
English: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”

tcz: Chuin mihonpi jah'a chun aseiyin, “Nangho koi tobang kanungjui nom naum uleh, nangma chang kingailutna'a konin kiheidoh un, na thingpel niseh'in kiput un, chule neijuiyun.
en: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
text:
LUK 9:23
Thadou: Chuin mihonpi jah'a chun aseiyin, “Nangho koi tobang kanungjui nom naum uleh, nangma chang kingailutna'a konin kiheidoh un, na thingpel niseh'in kiput un, chule neijuiyun.
English: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

tcz: Nahinkho nahuhhing nom le nachan ding, amavang keima jal'a nakatdoh le nahuhhing ding ahi.
en: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.
text:
LUK 9:24
Thadou: Nahinkho nahuhhing nom le nachan ding, amavang keima jal'a nakatdoh le nahuhhing ding ahi.
English: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.

tcz: Chuleh ipi phatchomna mun natem, vannoi pumpi neiyin lang nangma tah kisusen kisumang le chun?
en: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?
text:
LUK 9:25
Thadou: Chuleh ipi phatchomna mun natem, vannoi pumpi neiyin lang nangma tah kisusen kisumang le chun?
English: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

tcz: Khattouvin keima le ka thusei eijachat pi leh, Mihem Chapan jong amachu aloupina a chule Pa le vantil thengte loupina a ahung kile tengleh ajachatpi ding ahi.
en: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.
text:
LUK 9:26
Thadou: Khattouvin keima le ka thusei eijachat pi leh, Mihem Chapan jong amachu aloupina a chule Pa le vantil thengte loupina a ahung kile tengleh ajachatpi ding ahi.
English: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

tcz: Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, tutua hikom'a dingho lah'a mi phabep'in Pathen Lenggam amu tokah uva thina atolou diu ahi,” ati.
en: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”
text:
LUK 9:27
Thadou: Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, tutua hikom'a dingho lah'a mi phabep'in Pathen Lenggam amu tokah uva thina atolou diu ahi,” ati.
English: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”

tcz: Niget hamkhat jouvin Yeshuan Peter, John, le James hocheng hi molchung khat'ah taodingin apuitouve.
en: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.
text:
LUK 9:28
Thadou: Niget hamkhat jouvin Yeshuan Peter, John, le James hocheng hi molchung khat'ah taodingin apuitouve.
English: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

tcz: Chuin atao laiyin, amaiso ahung kikhel'in, chule avon'ah ho kidangtah'in abangsel jengin ahi.
en: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.
text:
LUK 9:29
Thadou: Chuin atao laiyin, amaiso ahung kikhel'in, chule avon'ah ho kidangtah'in abangsel jengin ahi.
English: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

tcz: Phulou helouvin mini, Mose le Elijah ahung kilah lhonin Yeshua toh akihoulim pan tauve.
en: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,
text:
LUK 9:30
Thadou: Phulou helouvin mini, Mose le Elijah ahung kilah lhonin Yeshua toh akihoulim pan tauve.
English: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

tcz: Amaho chu vet ding'in aloupi lheh jengui. Chule amaho chu leiset a pat'a apotdoh ding thu, Jerusalem a guilhung vahding thun akihoulim un ahi.
en: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
text:
LUK 9:31
Thadou: Amaho chu vet ding'in aloupi lheh jengui. Chule amaho chu leiset a pat'a apotdoh ding thu, Jerusalem a guilhung vahding thun akihoulim un ahi.
English: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

tcz: Peter le adang teni chu ihmu lhugam ahitauve. Akhahdoh uchun, Yeshua loupina chu amu'uvin chule mi ni amatoh adinkhom chu amu'uve.
en: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.
text:
LUK 9:32
Thadou: Peter le adang teni chu ihmu lhugam ahitauve. Akhahdoh uchun, Yeshua loupina chu amu'uvin chule mi ni amatoh adinkhom chu amu'uve.
English: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

tcz: Mose le Elijah in adalhah kigot pan laiyuvin, Peter in, aseijeng jong helou khop'in ahung eodoh'in, “Pipu, hilai mun'a ium'u hi anom'e! liem munthum hetjingnan song uhite–khat nang ding, khat Mose ding, chule khat Elijah ding,” ahintie.
en: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.
text:
LUK 9:33
Thadou: Mose le Elijah in adalhah kigot pan laiyuvin, Peter in, aseijeng jong helou khop'in ahung eodoh'in, “Pipu, hilai mun'a ium'u hi anom'e! liem munthum hetjingnan song uhite–khat nang ding, khat Mose ding, chule khat Elijah ding,” ahintie.
English: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.

tcz: Ahin, hitia asei jeng vang chun, meilhang khat in alekhu tauvin, meilhangin atomkhum toh lhonin kichat nan amaho alodim tauve.
en: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.
text:
LUK 9:34
Thadou: Ahin, hitia asei jeng vang chun, meilhang khat in alekhu tauvin, meilhangin atomkhum toh lhonin kichat nan amaho alodim tauve.
English: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

tcz: Chuin meibol lah kon chun awgin khat'in hitin ahin seiye, “Hiche hi Kachapa ahi, Kalhendoh pa ahi. Athu ngaiyun,” ati.
en: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”
text:
LUK 9:35
Thadou: Chuin meibol lah kon chun awgin khat'in hitin ahin seiye, “Hiche hi Kachapa ahi, Kalhendoh pa ahi. Athu ngaiyun,” ati.
English: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”

tcz: Awgin athip chun Yeshua chu achangseh anahitai. Hiche athilmu houchu chuche phat laichun koima komah aseidoh pouve.
en: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.
text:
LUK 9:36
Thadou: Awgin athip chun Yeshua chu achangseh anahitai. Hiche athilmu houchu chuche phat laichun koima komah aseidoh pouve.
English: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

tcz: Ajing'a molchunga pat ahung suh jou uchun, mihonpi tamtah'in Yeshua akimupi uve.
en: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.
text:
LUK 9:37
Thadou: Ajing'a molchunga pat ahung suh jou uchun, mihonpi tamtah'in Yeshua akimupi uve.
English: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.

tcz: Mihonpi lah'a mikhat chun ahin kouvin, “Houhil, lungset'in kachapa neivet peh in tia katao ahi, ajeh chu ama bouseh hi kacha neisun ahi.
en: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.
text:
LUK 9:38
Thadou: Mihonpi lah'a mikhat chun ahin kouvin, “Houhil, lungset'in kachapa neivet peh in tia katao ahi, ajeh chu ama bouseh hi kacha neisun ahi.
English: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.

tcz: Lhagao gilouvin aman jin, phulouvin apengjah jin, chule akam ah achilphon alhajin ahi. Ahehlhujin achangin amoh dalhah ji poi.
en: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.
text:
LUK 9:39
Thadou: Lhagao gilouvin aman jin, phulouvin apengjah jin, chule akam ah achilphon alhajin ahi. Ahehlhujin achangin amoh dalhah ji poi.
English: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

tcz: Na seijuite hengah einodoh peh nadiuvin kathum'in hinlah anodoh jou pouve,” ahung ti.
en: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”
text:
LUK 9:40
Thadou: Na seijuite hengah einodoh peh nadiuvin kathum'in hinlah anodoh jou pouve,” ahung ti.
English: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

tcz: Yeshuan aseitai, “Nangho tahsan bei le midihlou ho! Nangho itih chan kaumpiuva kakhongai jing ding nahiu ham?” atin, chuin mipa jah'a chun, “Nachapa hikomah hinpuiyin,” ati.
en: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”
text:
LUK 9:41
Thadou: Yeshuan aseitai, “Nangho tahsan bei le midihlou ho! Nangho itih chan kaumpiuva kakhongai jing ding nahiu ham?” atin, chuin mipa jah'a chun, “Nachapa hikomah hinpuiyin,” ati.
English: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”

tcz: Chapang pa ahung machon jep laiyin, thilha chun tol'ah ahin sulhun, nasatah in aveingoi jenge. Ahivangin Yeshuan lhagao gilou chu aphoh thip in chapangpa chu asudam tai. Chuin aman amapa chu apa alepeh kittai.
en: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
text:
LUK 9:42
Thadou: Chapang pa ahung machon jep laiyin, thilha chun tol'ah ahin sulhun, nasatah in aveingoi jenge. Ahivangin Yeshuan lhagao gilou chu aphoh thip in chapangpa chu asudam tai. Chuin aman amapa chu apa alepeh kittai.
English: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

tcz: Chutobang thilsoh Pathen thilboltheina kidangtah amu uchun mipi chu atiu ajalheh jeng tai. Athilbolho jouse mijousen adatmah laiyin, Yeshuan aseijuite jah'a hitin aseiye,
en: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,
text:
LUK 9:43
Thadou: Chutobang thilsoh Pathen thilboltheina kidangtah amu uchun mipi chu atiu ajalheh jeng tai. Athilbolho jouse mijousen adatmah laiyin, Yeshuan aseijuite jah'a hitin aseiye,
English: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

tcz: “Ngaiyuvin chule kathusei hi geldoh jingun. Mihem Chapa hi agalmite khut'a pehdoh a umding ahi,” ati.
en: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”
text:
LUK 9:44
Thadou: “Ngaiyuvin chule kathusei hi geldoh jingun. Mihem Chapa hi agalmite khut'a pehdoh a umding ahi,” ati.
English: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”

tcz: Ahin amahon ipi aseina ham ahethei pouve. Athupina chu amahoa kona kiselguh ahi, hijeh chun ahethei pouve, chule doh ding jong kichakit ahiuve.
en: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
text:
LUK 9:45
Thadou: Ahin amahon ipi aseina ham ahethei pouve. Athupina chu amahoa kona kiselguh ahi, hijeh chun ahethei pouve, chule doh ding jong kichakit ahiuve.
English: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

tcz: Chuin aseijuite koi alenpen ham ti akinel salah lah jeng tauvin ahi.
en: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.
text:
LUK 9:46
Thadou: Chuin aseijuite koi alenpen ham ti akinel salah lah jeng tauvin ahi.
English: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.

tcz: Ahin, Yeshuan alunggel u ahen, hijeh chun chapang neocha khat akoma dingin alai.
en: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,
text:
LUK 9:47
Thadou: Ahin, Yeshuan alunggel u ahen, hijeh chun chapang neocha khat akoma dingin alai.
English: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

tcz: Chuin aman amaho jah'a aseiye, “Koi hileh hitobang chapang neocha keima thalheng'a sang'a chun keima eisan ahi, chule keima eisanga chun eisol'ah kapa jong asan ahi. Nalah uva aneopen chu alenpen ahi,” ati.
en: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”
text:
LUK 9:48
Thadou: Chuin aman amaho jah'a aseiye, “Koi hileh hitobang chapang neocha keima thalheng'a sang'a chun keima eisan ahi, chule keima eisanga chun eisol'ah kapa jong asan ahi. Nalah uva aneopen chu alenpen ahi,” ati.
English: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”

tcz: John in Yeshua jah'a, “Pipu, koihamkhat in namin'a thilha anodoh kamu uvin, ahivangin eiho loilah'a ajao loujeh in angah dingin kaseipeh tauve,” ahin ti.
en: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”
text:
LUK 9:49
Thadou: John in Yeshua jah'a, “Pipu, koihamkhat in namin'a thilha anodoh kamu uvin, ahivangin eiho loilah'a ajao loujeh in angah dingin kaseipeh tauve,” ahin ti.
English: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kham hih un, koihileh nadoudal lou phot chu nanga ding ahi” ati.
en: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”
text:
LUK 9:50
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kham hih un, koihileh nadoudal lou phot chu nanga ding ahi” ati.
English: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

tcz: Van'a lahtouva aumna ding phat ahung naitoh lhonin, Yeshua Jerusalem jon din dettah a kigellha pumin achen ahi.
en: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem
text:
LUK 9:51
Thadou: Van'a lahtouva aumna ding phat ahung naitoh lhonin, Yeshua Jerusalem jon din dettah a kigellha pumin achen ahi.
English: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem

tcz: Aman thupole ho Samaria khokhat'ah, availhun na dinga akigot theina diuvin asol masan ahi.
en: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.
text:
LUK 9:52
Thadou: Aman thupole ho Samaria khokhat'ah, availhun na dinga akigot theina diuvin asol masan ahi.
English: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

tcz: Ahivangin hiche khoa mipi ho chun Yeshua chu asang tapouve, ajehchu ama Jerusalem jona achejing lai ahi.
en: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.
text:
LUK 9:53
Thadou: Ahivangin hiche khoa mipi ho chun Yeshua chu asang tapouve, ajehchu ama Jerusalem jona achejing lai ahi.
English: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.

tcz: James le John in hiche amudoh lhon phat in, amanin Yeshua jah'a, “Pakai, van'a kona amaho gouvam jeng ding mei ikou lhah diu ham?” atilhone.
en: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”
text:
LUK 9:54
Thadou: James le John in hiche amudoh lhon phat in, amanin Yeshua jah'a, “Pakai, van'a kona amaho gouvam jeng ding mei ikou lhah diu ham?” atilhone.
English: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”

tcz: Ahin Yeshua akiheiyin amani chu aphoh'in ahi.
en: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.
text:
LUK 9:55
Thadou: Ahin Yeshua akiheiyin amani chu aphoh'in ahi.
English: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

tcz: Hijeh chun amaho khochom khat ah ache tauve.
en: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.
text:
LUK 9:56
Thadou: Hijeh chun amaho khochom khat ah ache tauve.
English: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

tcz: Amahon chutia lam ajot laiyun, koiham khat'in Yeshua jah'a, “Nache na chan'ah najui inge,” ati.
en: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”
text:
LUK 9:57
Thadou: Amahon chutia lam ajot laiyun, koiham khat'in Yeshua jah'a, “Nache na chan'ah najui inge,” ati.
English: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

tcz: Ahin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Si-al hon chenna ding ko aneiyun, vachaten gena ding bu aneiyun, ahivangin Mihem Chapan alu ngapna ding jeng jong aneipoi,” atipeh e.
en: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”
text:
LUK 9:58
Thadou: Ahin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Si-al hon chenna ding ko aneiyun, vachaten gena ding bu aneiyun, ahivangin Mihem Chapan alu ngapna ding jeng jong aneipoi,” atipeh e.
English: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

tcz: Aman midang khat jah'a, “Hungin, neijuiyin” ati. Mipa chu anom in hinlah hitin aseiye, “Pakai, amasan inlam kileng ting kapa gavui masa tadinge,” ati.
en: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
text:
LUK 9:59
Thadou: Aman midang khat jah'a, “Hungin, neijuiyin” ati. Mipa chu anom in hinlah hitin aseiye, “Pakai, amasan inlam kileng ting kapa gavui masa tadinge,” ati.
English: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Lhagaova thihon amithi hou kivuiyuhen! Nangma kin chu chele a Pathen Lenggam thudol seiphong chu ahi,” ati.
en: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”
text:
LUK 9:60
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Lhagaova thihon amithi hou kivuiyuhen! Nangma kin chu chele a Pathen Lenggam thudol seiphong chu ahi,” ati.
English: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

tcz: Achom khat in aseiyin, “Henge Pakai, keiman najui inge, ahin amasan ka insungmi tetoh gakivailhah tadinge,” ati.
en: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”
text:
LUK 9:61
Thadou: Achom khat in aseiyin, “Henge Pakai, keiman najui inge, ahin amasan ka insungmi tetoh gakivailhah tadinge,” ati.
English: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

tcz: Ahin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Koi hileh akhut'a langkon tuhta chule nunglam ve chu Pathen Lenggam a dingin alhing poi,” ati.
en: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”
text:
LUK 9:62
Thadou: Ahin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Koi hileh akhut'a langkon tuhta chule nunglam ve chu Pathen Lenggam a dingin alhing poi,” ati.
English: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”

tcz: Tun Pakai in seijui adang mi somsagi le ni alhengdoh in amaho chu akop kop'in khotin le muntin vilding agot naho ah asol in ahi.
en: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.
text:
LUK 10:1
Thadou: Tun Pakai in seijui adang mi somsagi le ni alhengdoh in amaho chu akop kop'in khotin le muntin vilding agot naho ah asol in ahi.
English: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.

tcz: Hiche ho cheng hi amaho ahilchahna ahi: “Lousoh ga khoptup ding atam, ahin natong ho alhome. Hijeh chun Pakai hengah taovun amachu ga chomtup dia mopo ahi; alouva natong ding mi ahin solbe nadin thum'un.”
en: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.
text:
LUK 10:2
Thadou: Hiche ho cheng hi amaho ahilchahna ahi: “Lousoh ga khoptup ding atam, ahin natong ho alhome. Hijeh chun Pakai hengah taovun amachu ga chomtup dia mopo ahi; alouva natong ding mi ahin solbe nadin thum'un.”
English: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

tcz: Tun cheuvin, chuleh geldoh jingun keiman si-al lah'a kelngoi kisol tobanga kasol nahiuve.
en: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
text:
LUK 10:3
Thadou: Tun cheuvin, chuleh geldoh jingun keiman si-al lah'a kelngoi kisol tobanga kasol nahiuve.
English: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

tcz: Sum le pai ima kipoh hih'un, sakhao jong kipoh hih'un, kengchot akop'in jong pohih un. Chuleh lampi dungah khattou lem dingin kingapa hih'un.
en: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
text:
LUK 10:4
Thadou: Sum le pai ima kipoh hih'un, sakhao jong kipoh hih'un, kengchot akop'in jong pohih un. Chuleh lampi dungah khattou lem dingin kingapa hih'un.
English: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

tcz: Khattou in'a nalut teng uleh, amasan “Pathen lungmonna hiche in'a hin umhen” tin asauvin.
en: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
text:
LUK 10:5
Thadou: Khattou in'a nalut teng uleh, amasan “Pathen lungmonna hiche in'a hin umhen” tin asauvin.
English: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

tcz: Hichea cheng ho chu alungmon uleh, phattheina chu umden ding; achutilou uleh, phattheina chu nahenguva hung kile ding ahi.
en: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
text:
LUK 10:6
Thadou: Hichea cheng ho chu alungmon uleh, phattheina chu umden ding; achutilou uleh, phattheina chu nahenguva hung kile ding ahi.
English: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

tcz: In khat'a kon inkhat ah vahle hih'un. Munkhat bou ah um unlang, amahon napeh peh uchu neuvin chule don'un. Min phatah a najen nau sanding kiphalam hih'un, ajehchu anatong chun alosan amuding mong ahi.
en: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.
text:
LUK 10:7
Thadou: In khat'a kon inkhat ah vahle hih'un. Munkhat bou ah um unlang, amahon napeh peh uchu neuvin chule don'un. Min phatah a najen nau sanding kiphalam hih'un, ajehchu anatong chun alosan amuding mong ahi.
English: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

tcz: “Khopi khat a nalut uva nasan uleh, namasanga ahin luidoh doh uchu neuvin.”
en: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.
text:
LUK 10:8
Thadou: “Khopi khat a nalut uva nasan uleh, namasanga ahin luidoh doh uchu neuvin.”
English: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

tcz: Adamlou sudam'un lang seipeh'un, “Pathen Lenggam chu tun nakom uva aumtai” tiuvin.
en: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
text:
LUK 10:9
Thadou: Adamlou sudam'un lang seipeh'un, “Pathen Lenggam chu tun nakom uva aumtai” tiuvin.
English: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

tcz: Ahin khopi khattou in nasan dauleh, alampiu dunga chun chedoh unlang seiyun,
en: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,
text:
LUK 10:10
Thadou: Ahin khopi khattou in nasan dauleh, alampiu dunga chun chedoh unlang seiyun,
English: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,

tcz: Nakhopiu sunga vutkhu ho geiyin kakenguva kon'in kathing lhauve, nasoso kisoh dinga dalhah nahiuve ti vetsahnan. Chule hiche hi heuvin–Pathen Lenggam chu anaitai!
en: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
text:
LUK 10:11
Thadou: Nakhopiu sunga vutkhu ho geiyin kakenguva kon'in kathing lhauve, nasoso kisoh dinga dalhah nahiuve ti vetsahnan. Chule hiche hi heuvin–Pathen Lenggam chu anaitai!
English: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

tcz: Kaseipeh nahiuve thupi kitan nileh agilou Sodom kho chu chutobang khopi ho sanga phajep diu ahi.
en: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.
text:
LUK 10:12
Thadou: Kaseipeh nahiuve thupi kitan nileh agilou Sodom kho chu chutobang khopi ho sanga phajep diu ahi.
English: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

tcz: “Itobang lunghemnan nangau hitam, vo Korazin le Bethsaida! Ijeh inem itile nalah'a thilkidang kibol hohi agilou Tyre le Sidon khohoa kibol hitaveleh, sotlaiya pat'in amipihon achonset nauva kon lungheina nei untin, khaodippon kisil untin chule akisih'u tahlang nan aluchung uvah vutvam kiloi tauvinte.
en: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
text:
LUK 10:13
Thadou: “Itobang lunghemnan nangau hitam, vo Korazin le Bethsaida! Ijeh inem itile nalah'a thilkidang kibol hohi agilou Tyre le Sidon khohoa kibol hitaveleh, sotlaiya pat'in amipihon achonset nauva kon lungheina nei untin, khaodippon kisil untin chule akisih'u tahlang nan aluchung uvah vutvam kiloi tauvinte.
English: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

tcz: Henge, Tyre le Sidon khopi teni hi thupi kitan nileh nangho sanga phajep diu ahi.
en: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
text:
LUK 10:14
Thadou: Henge, Tyre le Sidon khopi teni hi thupi kitan nileh nangho sanga phajep diu ahi.
English: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

tcz: Chule nangho Capernaum mite, van-gam'ah jabolna chang nauvin natem? Nachan loudiu ahi, thina mun'a nachesuh joh diu ahi,” ati.
en: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
text:
LUK 10:15
Thadou: Chule nangho Capernaum mite, van-gam'ah jabolna chang nauvin natem? Nachan loudiu ahi, thina mun'a nachesuh joh diu ahi,” ati.
English: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.

tcz: Chuin aseijuite jah'a aseiyin, “Koihileh nathuhil'u kisan a chun keijong eisan ahi. Chule napampai chan'u chun keijong eipampai ahi. Chule koihileh keima eipampai chan chun Pathen, eihinsolpa apampai ahi” ati.
en: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”
text:
LUK 10:16
Thadou: Chuin aseijuite jah'a aseiyin, “Koihileh nathuhil'u kisan a chun keijong eisan ahi. Chule napampai chan'u chun keijong eipampai ahi. Chule koihileh keima eipampai chan chun Pathen, eihinsolpa apampai ahi” ati.
English: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”

tcz: Seijui somsagi leni ho ahung kileuvin, thanom tah in thulhut ahin bol'un ahi. “Pakai, thilhaho jeng jong kathu uvin anunge nangma min kapat ule,” atiuve.
en: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”
text:
LUK 10:17
Thadou: Seijui somsagi leni ho ahung kileuvin, thanom tah in thulhut ahin bol'un ahi. “Pakai, thilhaho jeng jong kathu uvin anunge nangma min kapat ule,” atiuve.
English: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”

tcz: “Henge” tin amaho aseipeh in, “Keiman Satan van'a kona kolphe banga alhahsuh kamui!
en: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.
text:
LUK 10:18
Thadou: “Henge” tin amaho aseipeh in, “Keiman Satan van'a kona kolphe banga alhahsuh kamui!
English: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

tcz: Veuvin, keiman nangho galmi thilboltheina chunga thuneina kapeh nahiuve, chule nanghon gul le aipi chunga lam najot diu chule nachilgoi dingu ahi. Imachan nasuhkhah loudiu ahi.
en: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.
text:
LUK 10:19
Thadou: Veuvin, keiman nangho galmi thilboltheina chunga thuneina kapeh nahiuve, chule nanghon gul le aipi chunga lam najot diu chule nachilgoi dingu ahi. Imachan nasuhkhah loudiu ahi.
English: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

tcz: Amavang lhagao gilou nathuuva anun jeh in kipah hih'un, ahin van-gam'a namin'u akijihlut jeh joh in kipah un,” ati.
en: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
text:
LUK 10:20
Thadou: Amavang lhagao gilou nathuuva anun jeh in kipah hih'un, ahin van-gam'a namin'u akijihlut jeh joh in kipah un,” ati.
English: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

tcz: Hiche pettah chun Yeshua Lhagao Thenga kipana adimset tan, chuin hitin aseiye, “O Hepa, van le lei Pakai, hiche thilho nangman aching le athem'a kigel hoa pat'a naselguh a, chapang ho henga naphondoh jeh in kakipah'e. Henge Pa, hitia kibol hin nangma nalunglhai sah'e,” ati.
en: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”
text:
LUK 10:21
Thadou: Hiche pettah chun Yeshua Lhagao Thenga kipana adimset tan, chuin hitin aseiye, “O Hepa, van le lei Pakai, hiche thilho nangman aching le athem'a kigel hoa pat'a naselguh a, chapang ho henga naphondoh jeh in kakipah'e. Henge Pa, hitia kibol hin nangma nalunglhai sah'e,” ati.
English: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

tcz: “Kapan keima imajouse chunga mopohna eipeh ahitai. Pa tailou koiman Chapa chu dihtah in ahepoi, chule Chapa tailou le Chapa in hetsah dinga alhen ho tailouvin koiman Pachu dihtah in ahepoi” ati.
en: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”
text:
LUK 10:22
Thadou: “Kapan keima imajouse chunga mopohna eipeh ahitai. Pa tailou koiman Chapa chu dihtah in ahepoi, chule Chapa tailou le Chapa in hetsah dinga alhen ho tailouvin koiman Pachu dihtah in ahepoi” ati.
English: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

tcz: Chuin amaho changseh aumpet un, aman aseijuite heng lam ngan aseiye, “Nathilmu chengseu mu ah mit hochu anunnom e.
en: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,
text:
LUK 10:23
Thadou: Chuin amaho changseh aumpet un, aman aseijuite heng lam ngan aseiye, “Nathilmu chengseu mu ah mit hochu anunnom e.
English: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

tcz: Kaseipeh nahiuve, themgao ho le lengho tamtah'in nathilmu chengseu hi muding anagaldot jingu ahin, hinlah anamupouve. Chuleh najah houhi jah ding anagaldot jing'u ahin, hinlah anaja pouve,” ati.
en: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”
text:
LUK 10:24
Thadou: Kaseipeh nahiuve, themgao ho le lengho tamtah'in nathilmu chengseu hi muding anagaldot jingu ahin, hinlah anamupouve. Chuleh najah houhi jah ding anagaldot jing'u ahin, hinlah anaja pouve,” ati.
English: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

tcz: Nikhat hou danthua them khat Yeshua patep dingin adingdoh in hiche thudoh hi adonge, “Houhil, tonsot hinna kanei thei nadia ipi kabol ding ham?” ati.
en: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
text:
LUK 10:25
Thadou: Nikhat hou danthua them khat Yeshua patep dingin adingdoh in hiche thudoh hi adonge, “Houhil, tonsot hinna kanei thei nadia ipi kabol ding ham?” ati.
English: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Mose dan in ipi asei em? Iti nasim am?” tin adongtai.
en: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
text:
LUK 10:26
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Mose dan in ipi asei em? Iti nasim am?” tin adongtai.
English: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”

tcz: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Nangman nalung pumpin, na lhagao pumpin, na thaneina pumpin, chule nalungthim pumpin Pakai naPathen chu ngailun. Chule nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun,” tin aseiye ati.
en: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”
text:
LUK 10:27
Thadou: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Nangman nalung pumpin, na lhagao pumpin, na thaneina pumpin, chule nalungthim pumpin Pakai naPathen chu ngailun. Chule nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun,” tin aseiye ati.
English: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”

tcz: “Adih'e” tin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Hichu bol'in chule nahin ding ahi!” ati.
en: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”
text:
LUK 10:28
Thadou: “Adih'e” tin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Hichu bol'in chule nahin ding ahi!” ati.
English: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”

tcz: Mipa chun athilbol them akichan nom'in, hijeh chun Yeshua chu adongin, “Koiham kaheng kakom?” ati.
en: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”
text:
LUK 10:29
Thadou: Mipa chun athilbol them akichan nom'in, hijeh chun Yeshua chu adongin, “Koiham kaheng kakom?” ati.
English: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

tcz: Yeshuan thusim khat in adonbut in: “Juda mikhat Jerusalem a pat Jericho lam jon in ajin suh in ahi, chule ama chu lamkah ah migucha michom hon abulu un, aponsil aholhah peh un, avouvin, chule athisa tobang'in lam pang'ah adalha tauve.”
en: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
text:
LUK 10:30
Thadou: Yeshuan thusim khat in adonbut in: “Juda mikhat Jerusalem a pat Jericho lam jon in ajin suh in ahi, chule ama chu lamkah ah migucha michom hon abulu un, aponsil aholhah peh un, avouvin, chule athisa tobang'in lam pang'ah adalha tauve.”
English: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

tcz: Thempu khat in agatoh khan, hinlah mipa chuva akijam amu mu chun, lampi pang langkhat joh apal in adalhatai.
en: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
text:
LUK 10:31
Thadou: Thempu khat in agatoh khan, hinlah mipa chuva akijam amu mu chun, lampi pang langkhat joh apal in adalhatai.
English: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

tcz: Hou'in lhachale ho khat agachen chule chukom'a akijam chu amun, ahin aman jong lamsih lang khat ah apeldoh tai.
en: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.
text:
LUK 10:32
Thadou: Hou'in lhachale ho khat agachen chule chukom'a akijam chu amun, ahin aman jong lamsih lang khat ah apeldoh tai.
English: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

tcz: “Chuin musit'a um Samaria mikhat ahung pheiyin, mipa amu chun, avoujang nat peh tan ahi.”
en: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,
text:
LUK 10:33
Thadou: “Chuin musit'a um Samaria mikhat ahung pheiyin, mipa amu chun, avoujang nat peh tan ahi.”
English: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

tcz: Akom ah ache naiyin, Samaria mipa chun akivohna maha chu ajen'in olive thao le ju asunkhum in, atompeh tai. Chuin mipa chu ama sangan chungah ahin puiyin, in khat ah ahin puilut in chukoma chun ajenlen ahi.
en: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
text:
LUK 10:34
Thadou: Akom ah ache naiyin, Samaria mipa chun akivohna maha chu ajen'in olive thao le ju asunkhum in, atompeh tai. Chuin mipa chu ama sangan chungah ahin puiyin, in khat ah ahin puilut in chukoma chun ajenlen ahi.
English: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

tcz: Ajing in in-ngahpa chu dangka cheng ni apen, aseiyin, “Hichepa hi anavesui in. Achunga lutjat hiche sanga atamjoh khah le, kahung kit teng kapeh ding ahi,” ati.
en: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’
text:
LUK 10:35
Thadou: Ajing in in-ngahpa chu dangka cheng ni apen, aseiyin, “Hichepa hi anavesui in. Achunga lutjat hiche sanga atamjoh khah le, kahung kit teng kapeh ding ahi,” ati.
English: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’

tcz: “Tun seiyin hiche mithum ho lah'a chu koipen tah chu hiche mipa gucha michom hon avoh pau dinga aheng akom hi ham?” tin Yeshuan adongtai.
en: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”
text:
LUK 10:36
Thadou: “Tun seiyin hiche mithum ho lah'a chu koipen tah chu hiche mipa gucha michom hon avoh pau dinga aheng akom hi ham?” tin Yeshuan adongtai.
English: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

tcz: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Akhoto pachu ahi,” ati. Chuin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Adih'e, tun chenlang chutobang chun gabol tan,” ati.
en: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”
text:
LUK 10:37
Thadou: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Akhoto pachu ahi,” ati. Chuin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Adih'e, tun chenlang chutobang chun gabol tan,” ati.
English: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

tcz: Yeshua le aseijuite Jerusalem lam jona achejing laiyun, khokhat ahung lhung un, chua chun Martha kiti nun a-in'a dingin alemin ahi.
en: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
text:
LUK 10:38
Thadou: Yeshua le aseijuite Jerusalem lam jona achejing laiyun, khokhat ahung lhung un, chua chun Martha kiti nun a-in'a dingin alemin ahi.
English: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

tcz: Asopinu Mary chu Pakai kengbul ah atouvin, athuhil chu angaiye.
en: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.
text:
LUK 10:39
Thadou: Asopinu Mary chu Pakai kengbul ah atouvin, athuhil chu angaiye.
English: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.

tcz: Ahivangin Martha chu jan anneh lentah agon jeh chun alunggim in ahi. Yeshua komah ahungin ahung seitai, “Pakai dihtheilou nasah lou khattou ham kasopinu thipbeh a atouva ken natoh jouse katoh? Eihung kithopi na dingin hinsol in,” ati.
en: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”
text:
LUK 10:40
Thadou: Ahivangin Martha chu jan anneh lentah agon jeh chun alunggim in ahi. Yeshua komah ahungin ahung seitai, “Pakai dihtheilou nasah lou khattou ham kasopinu thipbeh a atouva ken natoh jouse katoh? Eihung kithopi na dingin hinsol in,” ati.
English: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”

tcz: Ahivangin Pakai in amanu hengah aseiyin, “Ngailut Martha, nangma hitiho jouse chunga hi lunggima lung himo nahi.”
en: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,
text:
LUK 10:41

English: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

tcz: “Thilkhat bouseh khohsah le lunggim nading aume. Maryn hichu akimudoh in, chule amanu a kona kilamang thei lou ding ahitai,” ati.
en: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
text:
LUK 10:42
Thadou: “Thilkhat bouseh khohsah le lunggim nading aume. Maryn hichu akimudoh in, chule amanu a kona kilamang thei lou ding ahitai,” ati.
English: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

tcz: Khatvei hi Yeshua munkhat ah taona mangin aume. Ahin chai chun, aseijuite lah'a khat akom'ah ahungin aseiye, “Pakai, taoje neihil'un John in aseijuite ahil bangin” ahung ti.
en: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”
text:
LUK 11:1
Thadou: Khatvei hi Yeshua munkhat ah taona mangin aume. Ahin chai chun, aseijuite lah'a khat akom'ah ahungin aseiye, “Pakai, taoje neihil'un John in aseijuite ahil bangin” ahung ti.
English: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

tcz: Yeshuan aseiyin, hitia hi natao dingu ahi: “Hepa, namin chu thengtah in kikoi hen, nalenggam hung lhung loi hen
en: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
text:
LUK 11:2
Thadou: Yeshuan aseiyin, hitia hi natao dingu ahi: “Hepa, namin chu thengtah in kikoi hen, nalenggam hung lhung loi hen
English: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

tcz: Niseh a kangaichat u anneh nei peuvin
en: Give us day by day our daily bread.
text:
LUK 11:3
Thadou: Niseh a kangaichat u anneh nei peuvin
English: Give us day by day our daily bread.

tcz: Chule kachonset nau ngaidam in, Kachunguva chonse ho kangaidam bangun chule lhepna ah nei lhahlut sah hih'un” ati.
en: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”
text:
LUK 11:4
Thadou: Chule kachonset nau ngaidam in, Kachunguva chonse ho kangaidam bangun chule lhepna ah nei lhahlut sah hih'un” ati.
English: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”

tcz: Chuin taoding dan ahilben, hiche thusim hi amangchai: “Tekah nan nangma jankhang kim in naloi nagol in khat'ah nachen, changlhah pheng thum palah ding nadei jal'in naga chetai” Nangman akom'ah naseiyin,
en: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
text:
LUK 11:5
Thadou: Chuin taoding dan ahilben, hiche thusim hi amangchai: “Tekah nan nangma jankhang kim in naloi nagol in khat'ah nachen, changlhah pheng thum palah ding nadei jal'in naga chetai” Nangman akom'ah naseiyin,
English: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

tcz: “Kaloi khat tuchun eivil dingin ahung vailhungin, chule keiman ima nehsah ding kaneipoi, tin nathum tai.”
en: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’
text:
LUK 11:6
Thadou: “Kaloi khat tuchun eivil dingin ahung vailhungin, chule keiman ima nehsah ding kaneipoi, tin nathum tai.”
English: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’

tcz: Chuleh tekahnan, ama chun alupna dan sunga kon chun, “Nei houloh tahih in. Kot jong tujana dinga kikhah ahitai, ka insungmi te le keima jong jalkhun'a kabon chauva umah kahi tauve. Nakithopi thei ponge,” ahin ti.
en: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?
text:
LUK 11:7
Thadou: Chuleh tekahnan, ama chun alupna dan sunga kon chun, “Nei houloh tahih in. Kot jong tujana dinga kikhah ahitai, ka insungmi te le keima jong jalkhun'a kabon chauva umah kahi tauve. Nakithopi thei ponge,” ahin ti.
English: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?

tcz: Hiche hi kaseipeh nahi–ihamtin ajol le agol ahijeh chun bolhih jongle, nangman kot sottah nasuh suh jenga ahileh, ama thoudoh intin nathil thum chan chu napeh ding ahi, jahcha lou hel'a napansot jeh'a chu, ati.
en: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.
text:
LUK 11:8
Thadou: Hiche hi kaseipeh nahi–ihamtin ajol le agol ahijeh chun bolhih jongle, nangman kot sottah nasuh suh jenga ahileh, ama thoudoh intin nathil thum chan chu napeh ding ahi, jahcha lou hel'a napansot jeh'a chu, ati.
English: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

tcz: “Chule hijeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, thum jing jengun, chule nathum chu namu ding ahi.” Hol jingin chule namu ding ahi. Kot chu kiu jing in chutileh kot chu nakihonpeh ding ahi.
en: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
text:
LUK 11:9
Thadou: “Chule hijeh a chu kaseipeh nahiuve, thum jing jengun, chule nathum chu namu ding ahi.” Hol jingin chule namu ding ahi. Kot chu kiu jing in chutileh kot chu nakihonpeh ding ahi.
English: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

tcz: Ajeh chu athum chan'in akisan in, ahol jousen amun. Chule kot kiu jouse akot kihonpeh ding ahi.
en: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
text:
LUK 11:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu athum chan'in akisan in, ahol jousen amun. Chule kot kiu jouse akot kihonpeh ding ahi.
English: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

tcz: Ahilouleh ahtui athum nauva aipi napeh uvam? Henge nape pouve!
en: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?
text:
LUK 11:12
Thadou: Ahilouleh ahtui athum nauva aipi napeh uvam? Henge nape pouve!
English: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?

tcz: Hijeh a chu nangho mi chonsen bon nacha teu thilpha pehje nahet uleh, van'a um napauvin Lhagao Theng iti napehda diu ham athum ho jouse dinga” ati.
en: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”
text:
LUK 11:13
Thadou: Hijeh a chu nangho mi chonsen bon nacha teu thilpha pehje nahet uleh, van'a um napauvin Lhagao Theng iti napehda diu ham athum ho jouse dinga” ati.
English: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan mi apaotheilou khat a konin thilha anodoh peh in ahi, chule thilha chu apotdoh jou chun, mipa chu ahung paodoh pan tai. Mihonpi chun kidang asauvin,
en: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
text:
LUK 11:14
Thadou: Nikhat Yeshuan mi apaotheilou khat a konin thilha anodoh peh in ahi, chule thilha chu apotdoh jou chun, mipa chu ahung paodoh pan tai. Mihonpi chun kidang asauvin,
English: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

tcz: ahin miphabep khat chun, “Athilha nodoh chu lungdon ding ahipoi. Aman athilbol theina khu Satan, thilhate lengpa'a kona amu ahi,” atiuve.
en: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
text:
LUK 11:15
Thadou: ahin miphabep khat chun, “Athilha nodoh chu lungdon ding ahipoi. Aman athilbol theina khu Satan, thilhate lengpa'a kona amu ahi,” atiuve.
English: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

tcz: Adanghon, Yeshua patep nom nan, van'a kon melchihna kidang, athaneina photchetna a avetsah dingin angeh un ahi.
en: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.
text:
LUK 11:16
Thadou: Adanghon, Yeshua patep nom nan, van'a kon melchihna kidang, athaneina photchetna a avetsah dingin angeh un ahi.
English: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

tcz: Alunggel u ahetan, hijeh chun aman aseitai, “Itobang lenggam hileh khat le khat kidouna a kibung khen kiti chu amangthah ding ahi. Insungkhat jong kidouna a kibung khen chu lhulham ding ahi.
en: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.
text:
LUK 11:17
Thadou: Alunggel u ahetan, hijeh chun aman aseitai, “Itobang lenggam hileh khat le khat kidouna a kibung khen kiti chu amangthah ding ahi. Insungkhat jong kidouna a kibung khen chu lhulham ding ahi.
English: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

tcz: Nanghon keima Satan in eisuh thahat danin naseiyuve. Ahin Satan chu akikhentel'a ama le ama akidou le alenggam chu iti khantou tantem?
en: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.
text:
LUK 11:18
Thadou: Nanghon keima Satan in eisuh thahat danin naseiyuve. Ahin Satan chu akikhentel'a ama le ama akidou le alenggam chu iti khantou tantem?
English: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

tcz: Chuleh kei chu Satan suhthahat kahi leh, nalah uva thilha nodoh ho la? Amahon jong thilha anodoh u ahi, hijeh a chu amahon nathusei jeh uva chu nahin dem diu ahi.
en: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
text:
LUK 11:19
Thadou: Chuleh kei chu Satan suhthahat kahi leh, nalah uva thilha nodoh ho la? Amahon jong thilha anodoh u ahi, hijeh a chu amahon nathusei jeh uva chu nahin dem diu ahi.
English: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

tcz: Amavang keiman Pathen thahatna jal'a thilha kanodoh ahileh, Pathen lenggam chu nalah uva hunglhung ahitai.
en: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.
text:
LUK 11:20
Thadou: Amavang keiman Pathen thahatna jal'a thilha kanodoh ahileh, Pathen lenggam chu nalah uva hunglhung ahitai.
English: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

tcz: Ajeh chu Satan banga mihat tah khat chu amanchah kimkeiya akivon a a'inpi akiventup teng leh anei agou ho bit ahi–
en: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.
text:
LUK 11:21
Thadou: Ajeh chu Satan banga mihat tah khat chu amanchah kimkeiya akivon a a'inpi akiventup teng leh anei agou ho bit ahi–
English: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

tcz: ama sanga thahatjo khat'in ahung bulhu a, athaneina alahmanga, agal manchah achom'a, chule anei agou apoh mang ho ahopcheh kah'a chu.
en: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.
text:
LUK 11:22
Thadou: ama sanga thahatjo khat'in ahung bulhu a, athaneina alahmanga, agal manchah achom'a, chule anei agou apoh mang ho ahopcheh kah'a chu.
English: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

tcz: Koi hileh keimatoh pangkhom lou chu eidoudal ahi, chule eikhop khompi lou chu athecheh ahi.”
en: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.
text:
LUK 11:23
Thadou: Koi hileh keimatoh pangkhom lou chu eidoudal ahi, chule eikhop khompi lou chu athecheh ahi.”
English: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

tcz: Lhagao gilou khat in mihem khat adalhah teng leh, nelgam lah dungah achejin, kicholna ding mun aholjin ahi. Ahin khatcha amulou teng leh aseijin, “Kahungdoh na mipa koma kile tange,” ati.
en: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’
text:
LUK 11:24
Thadou: Lhagao gilou khat in mihem khat adalhah teng leh, nelgam lah dungah achejin, kicholna ding mun aholjin ahi. Ahin khatcha amulou teng leh aseijin, “Kahungdoh na mipa koma kile tange,” ati.
English: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’

tcz: Hijeh chun akilen ahileh ana umnasa in chu akitheh thengsel'a chule kitup sel'a aumchu amun ahi.
en: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.
text:
LUK 11:25
Thadou: Hijeh chun akilen ahileh ana umnasa in chu akitheh thengsel'a chule kitup sel'a aumchu amun ahi.
English: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

tcz: “Chuin hiche lhagao chun ama sanga giloujo lhagao sagi ma amun, chule amaho abon'un hiche mipa sunga chun alut un aching tauve. Chuin chuche mipa chu amasa'a sangin akhoh cheh jitai,” ati.
en: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”
text:
LUK 11:26
Thadou: “Chuin hiche lhagao chun ama sanga giloujo lhagao sagi ma amun, chule amaho abon'un hiche mipa sunga chun alut un aching tauve. Chuin chuche mipa chu amasa'a sangin akhoh cheh jitai,” ati.
English: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

tcz: Hitia thu asei lai chun, mihonpi lah'a kon chun numei khat in ahin kouvin, “Pathen in nanu phattheiboh hen–nahung kondoh na naobu, chule nahin chep noi jong,” ati.
en: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”
text:
LUK 11:27
Thadou: Hitia thu asei lai chun, mihonpi lah'a kon chun numei khat in ahin kouvin, “Pathen in nanu phattheiboh hen–nahung kondoh na naobu, chule nahin chep noi jong,” ati.
English: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Ahin hiche sanga chu Pathen thu ja'a anatoh a podoh ho chu anunnom cheh ahiuve” ati.
en: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
text:
LUK 11:28
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Ahin hiche sanga chu Pathen thu ja'a anatoh a podoh ho chu anunnom cheh ahiuve” ati.
English: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

tcz: Mihonpin Yeshua anehchin to laitah in, aman hitin aseiye, “Hiche khang gilou hin melchihna kidang kavetsah dingin asei sei jenguvin; ahin melchihna kapeh ding chu Jonah melchihna bouseh hiding ahi.
en: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
text:
LUK 11:29
Thadou: Mihonpin Yeshua anehchin to laitah in, aman hitin aseiye, “Hiche khang gilou hin melchihna kidang kavetsah dingin asei sei jenguvin; ahin melchihna kapeh ding chu Jonah melchihna bouseh hiding ahi.
English: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

tcz: Ama chunga thilsoh chengchu Pathen in Nineveh mite henga asol ahi ti melchihna ahi. Mihem Chapa chunga thilsoh jong hiche miho dinga Pathen sol ahi melchihna ahi.”
en: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.
text:
LUK 11:30
Thadou: Ama chunga thilsoh chengchu Pathen in Nineveh mite henga asol ahi ti melchihna ahi. Mihem Chapa chunga thilsoh jong hiche miho dinga Pathen sol ahi melchihna ahi.”
English: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.

tcz: “Sheba lengnun, thupi kitan nikho leh hiche khang mite douna'a dingdoh ding themmo achanding ahi, ijeh inem itile ama mun gamlatah a konin Solomon chihna thungai dingin ahunge. Tun Solomon sanga lenjo khat hikom'ah aume–ahin nanghon athu nangai pouve.
en: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.
text:
LUK 11:31
Thadou: “Sheba lengnun, thupi kitan nikho leh hiche khang mite douna'a dingdoh ding themmo achanding ahi, ijeh inem itile ama mun gamlatah a konin Solomon chihna thungai dingin ahunge. Tun Solomon sanga lenjo khat hikom'ah aume–ahin nanghon athu nangai pouve.
English: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

tcz: Nineveh khomite jong thupi kitan nileh hiche khang mite douna'a dingdoh diu chule themmo achandiu ahi. Ijeh inem itile amahon Jonah thuseiya konin achonset nauva kon lungheina aneiyuve. Tun Jonah sanga lenjo khat hikom'ah aume–ahin, nanghon athu nangaipouve.”
en: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.
text:
LUK 11:32
Thadou: Nineveh khomite jong thupi kitan nileh hiche khang mite douna'a dingdoh diu chule themmo achandiu ahi. Ijeh inem itile amahon Jonah thuseiya konin achonset nauva kon lungheina aneiyuve. Tun Jonah sanga lenjo khat hikom'ah aume–ahin, nanghon athu nangaipouve.”
English: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

tcz: “Koiman meivah avah in chule aselmang in ahilouleh lo akhukhum ngaipoi. Chusang chun, meivah atunna ah akitung jin, chua kon chun insung lut jousen avah amuthei bou uve.”
en: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.
text:
LUK 11:33
Thadou: “Koiman meivah avah in chule aselmang in ahilouleh lo akhukhum ngaipoi. Chusang chun, meivah atunna ah akitung jin, chua kon chun insung lut jousen avah amuthei bou uve.”
English: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

tcz: “Namit chu natahsa dinga vah hinpedoh meivah ahi. Namit chu ahoi laisea, natichung pumpi chu vah dimset ahi. Ahin, aphatmo teng, natichung chu mithum in atom ahi.
en: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.
text:
LUK 11:34
Thadou: “Namit chu natahsa dinga vah hinpedoh meivah ahi. Namit chu ahoi laisea, natichung pumpi chu vah dimset ahi. Ahin, aphatmo teng, natichung chu mithum in atom ahi.
English: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

tcz: Vah kaneiye tia nakigel chu muthim tahtah ahipoi ti kiphot chen in.
en: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.
text:
LUK 11:35
Thadou: Vah kaneiye tia nakigel chu muthim tahtah ahipoi ti kiphot chen in.
English: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

tcz: Vah'a chu nadimset'a, aning akah a muthim behlou nahileh, na hinkho pumpi chu, meivah vahtah in asalvah banga vahset ding ahi.” ati
en: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”
text:
LUK 11:36
Thadou: Vah'a chu nadimset'a, aning akah a muthim behlou nahileh, na hinkho pumpi chu, meivah vahtah in asalvah banga vahset ding ahi.” ati
English: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”

tcz: Yeshuan thu aseilaiyin, Pharisee holah'a khat'in a-in'a anne ding in atem'in ahi. Hijeh chun ama alut in dokhanga atouna mun alotai.
en: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.
text:
LUK 11:37
Thadou: Yeshuan thu aseilaiyin, Pharisee holah'a khat'in a-in'a anne ding in atem'in ahi. Hijeh chun ama alut in dokhanga atouna mun alotai.
English: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.

tcz: A an-vailhun pan, amasa'a Juda chondan a khutsil bollouva an nedia atoulhah jeng chu amun adatmo lheh jengin ahi.
en: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.
text:
LUK 11:38
Thadou: A an-vailhun pan, amasa'a Juda chondan a khutsil bollouva an nedia atoulhah jeng chu amun adatmo lheh jengin ahi.
English: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

tcz: Chuin Pakai chun amapa jah'a, “Nangho Pharisee hohin khon le lheng apolam siltheng chingthei tah'in nabol'un, ahin asunglam vang anen–kiloset nale gitlouna a dimset nahiuve!
en: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
text:
LUK 11:39
Thadou: Chuin Pakai chun amapa jah'a, “Nangho Pharisee hohin khon le lheng apolam siltheng chingthei tah'in nabol'un, ahin asunglam vang anen–kiloset nale gitlouna a dimset nahiuve!
English: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

tcz: Vo mingol! Pathen in asung jong chule apolam jong asem gel hilou ham?
en: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?
text:
LUK 11:40
Thadou: Vo mingol! Pathen in asung jong chule apolam jong asem gel hilou ham?
English: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?

tcz: Hijeh chun asung lang jong mivaicha ho thilpeh peh'a konin kisutheng un, chutile apumpia nathen dingu ahitai.”
en: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.
text:
LUK 11:41
Thadou: Hijeh chun asung lang jong mivaicha ho thilpeh peh'a konin kisutheng un, chutile apumpia nathen dingu ahitai.”
English: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

tcz: “Itobang lunghem nan nangau hitam Pharisee ho! Ajeh chu nanghon som'a khat nahon sung uva anche aneopen geiyin natoh dimdem'un, hinlah adih'a thutan le Pathen ngailut nakhohsah pouve. Henge, somakhat napeh diu mong ahinai ahivangin athupijo thilho notthap hih'un.”
en: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
text:
LUK 11:42
Thadou: “Itobang lunghem nan nangau hitam Pharisee ho! Ajeh chu nanghon som'a khat nahon sung uva anche aneopen geiyin natoh dimdem'un, hinlah adih'a thutan le Pathen ngailut nakhohsah pouve. Henge, somakhat napeh diu mong ahinai ahivangin athupijo thilho notthap hih'un.”
English: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

tcz: “Itobang lunghem nan nangau hitam Pharisee ho! Ijeh inem itile nanghon kikhopna in dunga touna thupi hoa tou le kailhang mun lah'a navale nauva min chibai naboh ding nadeiyun ahi.
en: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.
text:
LUK 11:43
Thadou: “Itobang lunghem nan nangau hitam Pharisee ho! Ijeh inem itile nanghon kikhopna in dunga touna thupi hoa tou le kailhang mun lah'a navale nauva min chibai naboh ding nadeiyun ahi.
English: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.

tcz: Henge ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam! Ijeh inem itile nangho loulaiya lhankhuh kiselguh tobang nahiuve. Mihon lepthol kibol chu helouvin achungah lam ajot un ahi” ati.
en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”
text:
LUK 11:44
Thadou: Henge ipi lungkham nan nangau hitam! Ijeh inem itile nangho loulaiya lhankhuh kiselguh tobang nahiuve. Mihon lepthol kibol chu helouvin achungah lam ajot un ahi” ati.
English: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

tcz: “Houhil” tin Hou danthu them khat in ahinkouvin, “Nathusei chun keiho jong eisujum uve,” ati.
en: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”
text:
LUK 11:45
Thadou: “Houhil” tin Hou danthu them khat in ahinkouvin, “Nathusei chun keiho jong eisujum uve,” ati.
English: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

tcz: “Henge,” tin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Itobang lunghem nan nangau hitam nangho hou danthu themho!” Ajeh chu nanghon pohjou lou ding houthua ngehna nasem uvin mipi na sugenthei uvin, hinlah nakhut jung khat jong apohgih'u ngaijang peh nadingin nalam khapouve.
en: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.
text:
LUK 11:46
Thadou: “Henge,” tin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Itobang lunghem nan nangau hitam nangho hou danthu themho!” Ajeh chu nanghon pohjou lou ding houthua ngehna nasem uvin mipi na sugenthei uvin, hinlah nakhut jung khat jong apohgih'u ngaijang peh nadingin nalam khapouve.
English: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

tcz: Lungkham na itobangin nangau hitam! Napu napa teuvin malaiya anathau themgao ho lhan nasem uvin ahi.
en: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
text:
LUK 11:47
Thadou: Lungkham na itobangin nangau hitam! Napu napa teuvin malaiya anathau themgao ho lhan nasem uvin ahi.
English: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

tcz: Ahin tahbeh in, napu napa teuvin anabolkhel u napom u vetsahna a ahetoh'a napan u ahitai. Amahon themgaoho anathat'un, chule nanghon amaho najopnau photchetnan alhan nasem uve!
en: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.
text:
LUK 11:48
Thadou: Ahin tahbeh in, napu napa teuvin anabolkhel u napom u vetsahna a ahetoh'a napan u ahitai. Amahon themgaoho anathat'un, chule nanghon amaho najopnau photchetnan alhan nasem uve!
English: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

tcz: Hiche hi Pathen in achihna a nangho chungchang anasei chu, Keiman themgao le solchah ahenguva kasol ding, ahivanga amahon abang athauva abang abolset diu ahi.
en: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,
text:
LUK 11:49
Thadou: Hiche hi Pathen in achihna a nangho chungchang anasei chu, Keiman themgao le solchah ahenguva kasol ding, ahivanga amahon abang athauva abang abolset diu ahi.
English: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

tcz: “Chutia chu hiche khang mite hi vannoi kiphudoh a pat Pathen themgao kithat ho jouse chunga mopo diu ahi.”
en: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,
text:
LUK 11:50
Thadou: “Chutia chu hiche khang mite hi vannoi kiphudoh a pat Pathen themgao kithat ho jouse chunga mopo diu ahi.”
English: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,

tcz: Abel kitha a pat a Zechariah, maicham le muntheng kikah a kithat pa geiya hiche khang mite kingoh ding ahi.
en: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.
text:
LUK 11:51
Thadou: Abel kitha a pat a Zechariah, maicham le muntheng kikah a kithat pa geiya hiche khang mite kingoh ding ahi.
English: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

tcz: “Itobang lunghem nan nangau hitam nangho hou danthu them ho! Ajeh chu mipi a kon'in hetna kot-heh mihoa konin naladoh un, nangho tah jong lenggam sungah nalut pouve, chule adang alut ding jong najada uve,” ati.
en: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”
text:
LUK 11:52
Thadou: “Itobang lunghem nan nangau hitam nangho hou danthu them ho! Ajeh chu mipi a kon'in hetna kot-heh mihoa konin naladoh un, nangho tah jong lenggam sungah nalut pouve, chule adang alut ding jong najada uve,” ati.
English: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”

tcz: Yeshuan adalhah got toh kilhon in, hou danthu hilho Pharisee ho chun ahin galmimu cheh cheh un, chule thudoh tamtah doh a suh lunghang ding agouvin ahi.
