en: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,
text:
LUK 11:53
Thadou: Yeshuan adalhah got toh kilhon in, hou danthu hilho Pharisee ho chun ahin galmimu cheh cheh un, chule thudoh tamtah doh a suh lunghang ding agouvin ahi.
English: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,

tcz: Amahon thangkol'a osah ding hehset nathei thuseidoh sah ding atiu ahi.
en: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
text:
LUK 11:54
Thadou: Amahon thangkol'a osah ding hehset nathei thuseidoh sah ding atiu ahi.
English: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

tcz: Hiche pet chun, mihonpi chu asang ajan ahung khang in akisucheh chuh un chule khat le khat kichonkha ton aumun, Yeshuan hichun aseijuite henglam ahin ngan agih sal in, “Pharisee ho chol a konin kihong phauvin”—aphat lhemnauva kon'in.
en: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
text:
LUK 12:1
Thadou: Hiche pet chun, mihonpi chu asang ajan ahung khang in akisucheh chuh un chule khat le khat kichonkha ton aumun, Yeshuan hichun aseijuite henglam ahin ngan agih sal in, “Pharisee ho chol a konin kihong phauvin”—aphat lhemnauva kon'in.
English: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

tcz: Phat ahung lhunge, thil akikhukhum jouse kiphongdoh ding ahi, chule aguh'a umjouse jong mijouse koma kihetsah ding ahi.
en: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.
text:
LUK 12:2
Thadou: Phat ahung lhunge, thil akikhukhum jouse kiphongdoh ding ahi, chule aguh'a umjouse jong mijouse koma kihetsah ding ahi.
English: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.

tcz: Muthim'a nasei jouseu chu khovah a kija ding ahi, chule kot kikhakhum na a olcha nakiseipeh toujong chu inchunga mijouse jah'a kisamphong ding ahi! Gin Ding Koipen Ham?
en: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.
text:
LUK 12:3
Thadou: Muthim'a nasei jouseu chu khovah a kija ding ahi, chule kot kikhakhum na a olcha nakiseipeh toujong chu inchunga mijouse jah'a kisamphong ding ahi! Gin Ding Koipen Ham?
English: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

tcz: “Ngailut umtah jol le gol te, natahsa that thei hochu kicha hih'un.” Hiche jou le chun nachungah ima abolthei tapouve.
en: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
text:
LUK 12:4
Thadou: “Ngailut umtah jol le gol te, natahsa that thei hochu kicha hih'un.” Hiche jou le chun nachungah ima abolthei tapouve.
English: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

tcz: Ahin kichat ding koi ham naseipeh unge. Pathen kichauvin, aman nangho tha nathei le damun'a lelut nathei thilboltheina tha anei ahi. Henge, ama ahi kichat ding.
en: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.
text:
LUK 12:5
Thadou: Ahin kichat ding koi ham naseipeh unge. Pathen kichauvin, aman nangho tha nathei le damun'a lelut nathei thilboltheina tha anei ahi. Henge, ama ahi kichat ding.
English: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

tcz: “Vasah nga man ijat ham–paisa ni man ham?” Ahin Pathen in khat jeng jong asumil pon ahi.
en: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.
text:
LUK 12:6
Thadou: “Vasah nga man ijat ham–paisa ni man ham?” Ahin Pathen in khat jeng jong asumil pon ahi.
English: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

tcz: Chuleh nalu'a na samjang ho jengjong aboncha kisimtoh soh ahitai. Hijeh chun kicha hih'un; nangma vasah honpi jouse sanga manlujo nahi.
en: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
text:
LUK 12:7
Thadou: Chuleh nalu'a na samjang ho jengjong aboncha kisimtoh soh ahitai. Hijeh chun kicha hih'un; nangma vasah honpi jouse sanga manlujo nahi.
English: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

tcz: Kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh hiche leiset'a lhangphonga keima eiseidoh chan chu, Mihem Chapan jong Pathen Vantilte jaona'a aseidoh ding ahi.
en: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;

tcz: Amavang koi hileh hiche leiset'a eiseilep chan chu Pathen Vantilte masanga kiseilep diu ahi.
en: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.
text:
LUK 12:9
Thadou: Amavang koi hileh hiche leiset'a eiseilep chan chu Pathen Vantilte masanga kiseilep diu ahi.
English: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.

tcz: Koihileh Mihem Chapa douna thusei chan chu kingaidam ding ahi, amavang koi hileh Lhagao Theng taitom'ah vang chu kingaidam louding ahi.
en: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
text:
LUK 12:10
Thadou: Koihileh Mihem Chapa douna thusei chan chu kingaidam ding ahi, amavang koi hileh Lhagao Theng taitom'ah vang chu kingaidam louding ahi.
English: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

tcz: “Chuleh kikhopna in'a vaipo hole thuneiho anga athu tan dinga nahin kai teng uleh, iti nakiven ding ham ahiloule ipi nasei ding thu ah lunggim hih un.
en: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;

tcz: Ajeh chu Lhagao Theng chun apettah a seiding napeh diu ahi,” ati.
en: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”
text:
LUK 12:12
Thadou: Ajeh chu Lhagao Theng chun apettah a seiding napeh diu ahi,” ati.
English: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”

tcz: Chuin koiham khat'in mipi lah'a kon chun ahin kouvin, “Houhil, kasopipa jah'a kapa nei le gou eikihoppi nadingin seiyin,” ati.
en: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”
text:
LUK 12:13
Thadou: Chuin koiham khat'in mipi lah'a kon chun ahin kouvin, “Houhil, kasopipa jah'a kapa nei le gou eikihoppi nadingin seiyin,” ati.
English: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Jol, kon nangni kah'a thutan'a eipansah'a, hiti khati iti kagel lhah ding ham?” ati.
en: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”
text:
LUK 12:14
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Jol, kon nangni kah'a thutan'a eipansah'a, hiti khati iti kagel lhah ding ham?” ati.
English: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”

tcz: Chuin aman aseiben, “Chingtheiyun! Neipap kiloset kiti jouseah kivengun. Hinkho hi naneijat a kisim ahipoi,” ati.
en: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”
text:
LUK 12:15
Thadou: Chuin aman aseiben, “Chingtheiyun! Neipap kiloset kiti jouseah kivengun. Hinkho hi naneijat a kisim ahipoi,” ati.
English: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”

tcz: Chuin aman thusim khat aseipeh tai: “Mihao khat hin loumun khat, alei phatah, ga hoitah tah sodoh aneiyin ahi.
en: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.
text:
LUK 12:16
Thadou: Chuin aman thusim khat aseipeh tai: “Mihao khat hin loumun khat, alei phatah, ga hoitah tah sodoh aneiyin ahi.
English: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.

tcz: Amapa achangin akihoulim in, ‘Ipi kabol ding hitam? Ka lousoh ga jouse koina ding mun la kanei pon,’” ati.
en: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’
text:
LUK 12:17
Thadou: Amapa achangin akihoulim in, ‘Ipi kabol ding hitam? Ka lousoh ga jouse koina ding mun la kanei pon,’” ati.
English: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’

tcz: Chuin aman aseiyin, Kahetai! Kachangsal jouse phelhangting asanga lenjo cheh thahsah inge. Chutileh keiman ka chang le mim jouse kholkhomna ding dan ninglhingset in nei tange.
en: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.
text:
LUK 12:18
Thadou: Chuin aman aseiyin, Kahetai! Kachangsal jouse phelhangting asanga lenjo cheh thahsah inge. Chutileh keiman ka chang le mim jouse kholkhomna ding dan ninglhingset in nei tange.
English: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

tcz: Chutengleh keima nomtah'a katouva keima le keiman hitia hi kasei ding ahi, “Kajol, nangman kumsottah a ding ninglhing set'a kikhol khom naneiye. Tun lung olmo hih in! nen lang, don'in lang, chule kipah in!” tinge ati.
en: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’
text:
LUK 12:19
Thadou: Chutengleh keima nomtah'a katouva keima le keiman hitia hi kasei ding ahi, “Kajol, nangman kumsottah a ding ninglhing set'a kikhol khom naneiye. Tun lung olmo hih in! nen lang, don'in lang, chule kipah in!” tinge ati.
English: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’

tcz: Ahivangin Pathen in amapa jah'a chun, “Mingol! Tujan ma ma'a nathi ding ahitai. Chuteng leh nanatoh ga jouse hi koi chang tantem?” ati.
en: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’
text:
LUK 12:20
Thadou: Ahivangin Pathen in amapa jah'a chun, “Mingol! Tujan ma ma'a nathi ding ahitai. Chuteng leh nanatoh ga jouse hi koi chang tantem?” ati.
English: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’

tcz: “Henge, lei gouthil bouseh kholkhom'a Pathen toh haosatah'a kiguijopna neilou mi chu angol ahi” ati.
en: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”
text:
LUK 12:21
Thadou: “Henge, lei gouthil bouseh kholkhom'a Pathen toh haosatah'a kiguijopna neilou mi chu angol ahi” ati.
English: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”

tcz: Chuin, aseijuite kom lang ngan Yeshuan aseitai, “Hiche jeh'a hi keiman nitin hinkho a dingin lunggim hih'un kati ahi”—neh le chah ninglhing set'a chule sil le chen lhingset'a kanei ding hinam tin.
en: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.
text:
LUK 12:22
Thadou: Chuin, aseijuite kom lang ngan Yeshuan aseitai, “Hiche jeh'a hi keiman nitin hinkho a dingin lunggim hih'un kati ahi”—neh le chah ninglhing set'a chule sil le chen lhingset'a kanei ding hinam tin.
English: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

tcz: Ajeh chu hinkho hi anneh ding sanga lujo, chule natahsa jong sille chen sanga lujo ahi.
en: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
text:
LUK 12:23
Thadou: Ajeh chu hinkho hi anneh ding sanga lujo, chule natahsa jong sille chen sanga lujo ahi.
English: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

tcz: Va-ah ho khu veuvin, amahon tula atu pouvin, at la a-at pouvin ahiloule khol la akholkhom pouvin, ajeh chu Pathen in avahnai. Chule nangho vacha ho sanga ama dinga loupijo nahiuve!
en: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!
text:
LUK 12:24
Thadou: Va-ah ho khu veuvin, amahon tula atu pouvin, at la a-at pouvin ahiloule khol la akholkhom pouvin, ajeh chu Pathen in avahnai. Chule nangho vacha ho sanga ama dinga loupijo nahiuve!
English: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

tcz: Nalunggim nau jousen nahinkho phat bihkhat ajopbe theiyem?
en: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?
text:
LUK 12:25
Thadou: Nalunggim nau jousen nahinkho phat bihkhat ajopbe theiyem?
English: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

tcz: Chule lunggim nan imacha chutobang thil neocha jong alolhin sah theilouleh, thil lentah chunga jong lunggim chu ipi phachom ding ham?
en: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?
text:
LUK 12:26
Thadou: Chule lunggim nan imacha chutobang thil neocha jong alolhin sah theilouleh, thil lentah chunga jong lunggim chu ipi phachom ding ham?
English: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

tcz: “Lily pah ho le akhan doh dan khu veuvin. Amahon na jong atong pouvin chule avon hou jong akisem thei pouvin, ahin, Solomon jeng jong, aloupina jouse a akivon chun amaho tobang lom'in ahoijou poi.
en: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
text:
LUK 12:27
Thadou: “Lily pah ho le akhan doh dan khu veuvin. Amahon na jong atong pouvin chule avon hou jong akisem thei pouvin, ahin, Solomon jeng jong, aloupina jouse a akivon chun amaho tobang lom'in ahoijou poi.
English: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

tcz: Chuleh Pathen in pahcha ho tunia uma jing a meilhum sunga selut ding bon kidangtah'a akhohsah'a ahileh, aman nangma thonlouva nakhohsah teitei ding ahi. Ipi bol'a hibanga tahsan na neo hi naneiyu ham?”
en: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?
text:
LUK 12:28
Thadou: Chuleh Pathen in pahcha ho tunia uma jing a meilhum sunga selut ding bon kidangtah'a akhohsah'a ahileh, aman nangma thonlouva nakhohsah teitei ding ahi. Ipi bol'a hibanga tahsan na neo hi naneiyu ham?”
English: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

tcz: “Chuleh ipi kaneh ding ham ipi kadon ding ham tin lungboi hih'un. Hiche ho thil'a chun lunggim hih'un.
en: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.
text:
LUK 12:29
Thadou: “Chuleh ipi kaneh ding ham ipi kadon ding ham tin lungboi hih'un. Hiche ho thil'a chun lunggim hih'un.
English: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

tcz: Hiche thil hohin vannoi pumpia atahsanlou ho lungsung alodim'in ahi, ahivangin Napauvin nangaichat changseu chu ahemasa jitai.
en: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.
text:
LUK 12:30
Thadou: Hiche thil hohin vannoi pumpia atahsanlou ho lungsung alodim'in ahi, ahivangin Napauvin nangaichat changseu chu ahemasa jitai.
English: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

tcz: Pathen lenggam chu thil jouse sangin hol'un, chule aman nangaichat chan'u napeh diu ahi.”
en: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.
text:
LUK 12:31
Thadou: Pathen lenggam chu thil jouse sangin hol'un, chule aman nangaichat chan'u napeh diu ahi.”
English: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

tcz: “Hijeh chun kicha hih'un, hon lhom ho, ajeh chu nangho lenggam peh ding hi napau dinga kipana lentah ahi.”
en: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
text:
LUK 12:32
Thadou: “Hijeh chun kicha hih'un, hon lhom ho, ajeh chu nangho lenggam peh ding hi napau dinga kipana lentah ahi.”
English: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

tcz: “Nanei nagou ho joh'un lang angaicha ho peuvin. Hichun van'a gou nakhol peh dingu ahi! Chule van-gam a sumdip hon chultih aneipouvin chule atovang aum khapoi. Nagou khol chu bitkeiya umding ahi; guchan jong aguhmang theilou ding ahi chule nget'in jong asuhset thei lou ding ahi.”
en: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.
text:
LUK 12:33
Thadou: “Nanei nagou ho joh'un lang angaicha ho peuvin. Hichun van'a gou nakhol peh dingu ahi! Chule van-gam a sumdip hon chultih aneipouvin chule atovang aum khapoi. Nagou khol chu bitkeiya umding ahi; guchan jong aguhmang theilou ding ahi chule nget'in jong asuhset thei lou ding ahi.”
English: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.

tcz: Nanei nagou umna'a chu nalung ngaichat jong aum ding ahi. Hetman Louva Yeshua Hung Kit Ding
en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
text:
LUK 12:34
Thadou: Nanei nagou umna'a chu nalung ngaichat jong aum ding ahi. Hetman Louva Yeshua Hung Kit Ding
English: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

tcz: “Natohna dingin kivontup san umun chule nathaomei vahjing'un;
en: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

tcz: Na Pakai pa moupui golvah na'a kon ahung kile ding nanga bangin. Chutileh ahung lhun'a kot ahinsuh teng leh kot nahonpeh a nalutsah thei nadia phasadema naum ding ahi.
en: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.
text:
LUK 12:36
Thadou: Na Pakai pa moupui golvah na'a kon ahung kile ding nanga bangin. Chutileh ahung lhun'a kot ahinsuh teng leh kot nahonpeh a nalutsah thei nadia phasadema naum ding ahi.
English: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

tcz: Soh ho kiging jinga umho le ahung kile ding ngah jing ho chu kipaman kipediu ahi. Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, amatah in amaho chu atousah ding, atai akikhi ding, amaho chu atou uva aneh laiyuva chu ajen ding ahi.
en: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.
text:
LUK 12:37
Thadou: Soh ho kiging jinga umho le ahung kile ding ngah jing ho chu kipaman kipediu ahi. Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, amatah in amaho chu atousah ding, atai akikhi ding, amaho chu atou uva aneh laiyuva chu ajen ding ahi.
English: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.

tcz: Ama jankim lah ahilou le khovah kon'a hung maithei ahi. Ahin, ahung pet a kiging jinga um sohte chu kipaman apehding ahiuve.”
en: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.
text:
LUK 12:38
Thadou: Ama jankim lah ahilou le khovah kon'a hung maithei ahi. Ahin, ahung pet a kiging jinga um sohte chu kipaman apehding ahiuve.”
English: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.

tcz: “Hiche hi hethem in, in-neipan itih phatchet'a gucha hung ding ham ti heleh, aman a-in chu veihonga aumsah lou ding ahi.
en: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.
text:
LUK 12:39
Thadou: “Hiche hi hethem in, in-neipan itih phatchet'a gucha hung ding ham ti heleh, aman a-in chu veihonga aumsah lou ding ahi.
English: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.

tcz: Nangjong kiging jinga naum jing ding ahi ijeh inem itile Mihem Chapa chu naginchat lou pettah uva hung ding ahi,” ati.
en: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”
text:
LUK 12:40
Thadou: Nangjong kiging jinga naum jing ding ahi ijeh inem itile Mihem Chapa chu naginchat lou pettah uva hung ding ahi,” ati.
English: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”

tcz: Peter in adong in, “Pakai hiche thutekah chu keihoa ding bou hai mijousea ding ham?” ati.
en: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”
text:
LUK 12:41
Thadou: Peter in adong in, “Pakai hiche thutekah chu keihoa ding bou hai mijousea ding ham?” ati.
English: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin adonbut in, “Soh kitah le lung limgeh chu apakai pan insung pumpi le sohdang ho chunga jong mopohna apeh'a avahsah ho chu ahi.
en: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?
text:
LUK 12:42
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin adonbut in, “Soh kitah le lung limgeh chu apakai pan insung pumpi le sohdang ho chunga jong mopohna apeh'a avahsah ho chu ahi.
English: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

tcz: Apakai pa ahung kile a asohpan na phatah'a atoh ahung mu leh, kipaman umding ahi.”
en: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.
text:
LUK 12:43
Thadou: Apakai pa ahung kile a asohpan na phatah'a atoh ahung mu leh, kipaman umding ahi.”
English: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

tcz: Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, hitobang soh chu apakai pan anei jouse chunga mopohna apehding ahi.
en: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
text:
LUK 12:44
Thadou: Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, hitobang soh chu apakai pan anei jouse chunga mopohna apehding ahi.
English: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

tcz: Ahinlah, iti tantem asohpa chun, “Kapakai pa hi tem'in hung ponte” tin gelhen lang, asohdang ho vo hen, neh nom ne hen, ju kham kham jeng taleh?
en: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,
text:
LUK 12:45
Thadou: Ahinlah, iti tantem asohpa chun, “Kapakai pa hi tem'in hung ponte” tin gelhen lang, asohdang ho vo hen, neh nom ne hen, ju kham kham jeng taleh?
English: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,

tcz: Apakai pachu seiphong masa lou leh ginchat umlou pettah in hungin tin, chuteng aman asohpa chu asat goi goi ding mikitah louho toh asolmang tha ding ahitai.
en: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.
text:
LUK 12:46
Thadou: Apakai pachu seiphong masa lou leh ginchat umlou pettah in hungin tin, chuteng aman asohpa chu asat goi goi ding mikitah louho toh asolmang tha ding ahitai.
English: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

tcz: “Chule soh khat apakai pa dei he'a, ahivanga kigongtup lou chule akihilchah na ho tongdoh lou chu, nasatah a bolgimna ato ding ahi.
en: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
text:
LUK 12:47
Thadou: “Chule soh khat apakai pa dei he'a, ahivanga kigongtup lou chule akihilchah na ho tongdoh lou chu, nasatah a bolgimna ato ding ahi.
English: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

tcz: Ahivanga ahelou khattou chun thilse abol leh, ama chu gihsa louva kigimbol ding ahi. Koiham khat chu tamtah akipeh le, ama a kona chu tamtah kile ngeh ding ahi; chuleh khattou chu mopohna tamtah akipeh le, asanga tamjo chu kingeh ding ahi.”
en: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.
text:
LUK 12:48
Thadou: Ahivanga ahelou khattou chun thilse abol leh, ama chu gihsa louva kigimbol ding ahi. Koiham khat chu tamtah akipeh le, ama a kona chu tamtah kile ngeh ding ahi; chuleh khattou chu mopohna tamtah akipeh le, asanga tamjo chu kingeh ding ahi.”
English: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

tcz: “Keima vannoi hi meiya tih dinga kahung ahi, chule akoudoh hitaleh katilheh jenge!
en: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.
text:
LUK 12:49
Thadou: “Keima vannoi hi meiya tih dinga kahung ahi, chule akoudoh hitaleh katilheh jenge!
English: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

tcz: Keiman thoh hahsa tah baptize chanding kamakho'ah kaneiye chule hichu akimolso kah a kalung khamna iti san tam!
en: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!
text:
LUK 12:50
Thadou: Keiman thoh hahsa tah baptize chanding kamakho'ah kaneiye chule hichu akimolso kah a kalung khamna iti san tam!
English: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

tcz: Leiset a chamna hinpo dinga hunga nei gel'um? Ahipoi, keima miho kibung khensah dia hung'ah kahi!
en: Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.
text:
LUK 12:51
Thadou: Leiset a chamna hinpo dinga hunga nei gel'um? Ahipoi, keima miho kibung khensah dia hung'ah kahi!
English: Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

tcz: Tua pat'a insung ho kikhentel diu ahitai, thum'in eijop uva, nin eidoudal ding–ahiloule nin eijop'a thum'in eidou ding ahi.
en: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
text:
LUK 12:52
Thadou: Tua pat'a insung ho kikhentel diu ahitai, thum'in eijop uva, nin eidoudal ding–ahiloule nin eijop'a thum'in eidou ding ahi.
English: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

tcz: Mipa chu chapa douna'a chule chapa chu mipa douna a kibungkhen ding ahi; chanu douna minu chule minu douna'a chanu; chuleh ateh in mou douna chule mouvin ateh douna'a kikhenna um ding ahi” ati. Phat Kihei-Dan Hetna
en: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”
text:
LUK 12:53
Thadou: Mipa chu chapa douna'a chule chapa chu mipa douna a kibungkhen ding ahi; chanu douna minu chule minu douna'a chanu; chuleh ateh in mou douna chule mouvin ateh douna'a kikhenna um ding ahi” ati. Phat Kihei-Dan Hetna
English: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan mihonpi lam aven aseiye, “Nanghon meibol lhumlam langa ahung umdoh phat le, nasei jiuvin, ‘go hung juding ahi’ natiuve. Chuleh nangho nadih uve.
en: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.
text:
LUK 12:54
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan mihonpi lam aven aseiye, “Nanghon meibol lhumlam langa ahung umdoh phat le, nasei jiuvin, ‘go hung juding ahi’ natiuve. Chuleh nangho nadih uve.
English: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.

tcz: Lhanglam hui ahung nun teng leh, naseijiuvin, ‘Tuni chu salheh ding ahi’ natiuvin, chule achuti ji'e.
en: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.
text:
LUK 12:55
Thadou: Lhanglam hui ahung nun teng leh, naseijiuvin, ‘Tuni chu salheh ding ahi’ natiuvin, chule achuti ji'e.
English: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

tcz: Nangho mingolho! nanghon leiset chunga van umje nasuto theiyun, ahin nanghon tuphat umdan naledoh thei pouve.”
en: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?
text:
LUK 12:56
Thadou: Nangho mingolho! nanghon leiset chunga van umje nasuto theiyun, ahin nanghon tuphat umdan naledoh thei pouve.”
English: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?

tcz: “Ipi jeh'a nangho dinga adih chu naki gellhah thei lou u ham?”
en: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
text:
LUK 12:57
Thadou: “Ipi jeh'a nangho dinga adih chu naki gellhah thei lou u ham?”
English: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

tcz: “Nangho thukitanna muna nahehse hou toh nache teng uleh, amun nalhun masang in kihoutoh pi ding gon. Achuti louleh thutan vaihompa masanga nahehse pan nakai ding, aman vaipopa henga napehdoh a, aman songkul'a nakhum ding ahi.
en: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.
text:
LUK 12:58
Thadou: “Nangho thukitanna muna nahehse hou toh nache teng uleh, amun nalhun masang in kihoutoh pi ding gon. Achuti louleh thutan vaihompa masanga nahehse pan nakai ding, aman vaipopa henga napehdoh a, aman songkul'a nakhum ding ahi.
English: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

tcz: Chule hichu aso leh nangman achainapen sum geiya napeh doh masang sea itinama jong leh nakilhadoh louhel ding ahi,” ati.
en: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.”
text:
LUK 12:59
Thadou: Chule hichu aso leh nangman achainapen sum geiya napeh doh masang sea itinama jong leh nakilhadoh louhel ding ahi,” ati.
English: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.”

tcz: Hiche phatlai hin Pilate in Galilee gam mi phabep'in Hou'in a kilhaina gantha abollaiyun athat'e tithu Yeshua seipeh in aumin ahi.
en: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
text:
LUK 13:1
Thadou: Hiche phatlai hin Pilate in Galilee gam mi phabep'in Hou'in a kilhaina gantha abollaiyun athat'e tithu Yeshua seipeh in aumin ahi.
English: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

tcz: “Hiche Galilee miho chu Galilee gam midang ho jouse sanga chonse joa nangaito uvam?” tin Yeshuan adongin, “Hijeh a chu chutia thoh genthei athoh u ahi natiuvem?
en: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?
text:
LUK 13:2
Thadou: “Hiche Galilee miho chu Galilee gam midang ho jouse sanga chonse joa nangaito uvam?” tin Yeshuan adongin, “Hijeh a chu chutia thoh genthei athoh u ahi natiuvem?
English: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

tcz: Ahipoi, kaseipeh nahiuve, nalung nahei uva Pathen lam'a nakihei lou uleh nangho jong mangthah ding nahiuve.
en: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.
text:
LUK 13:3
Thadou: Ahipoi, kaseipeh nahiuve, nalung nahei uva Pathen lam'a nakihei lou uleh nangho jong mangthah ding nahiuve.
English: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

tcz: Chuleh Siloam inting achima adellih mi somleget hochu la? Amaho chu Jerusalem a dinga michonse pen ho hitauvam?
en: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?
text:
LUK 13:4
Thadou: Chuleh Siloam inting achima adellih mi somleget hochu la? Amaho chu Jerusalem a dinga michonse pen ho hitauvam?
English: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

tcz: Ahipoi, chule kaseipeh kit nahiuve, nalung nahei lou uleh namanthah diu ahi” ati.
en: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”
text:
LUK 13:5
Thadou: Ahipoi, chule kaseipeh kit nahiuve, nalung nahei lou uleh namanthah diu ahi” ati.
English: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thusim hi ahinseiye: “Mikhat in ahonsung ah theichang phungkhat atun chule avel vel in aga umding ham tin ahung ve jin, hinlah amapa alung lhalheh jeng jin ahi.
en: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.
text:
LUK 13:6
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thusim hi ahinseiye: “Mikhat in ahonsung ah theichang phungkhat atun chule avel vel in aga umding ham tin ahung ve jin, hinlah amapa alung lhalheh jeng jin ahi.
English: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.

tcz: Achainan honlhou pa jah'a, Kumthum hulteh kanga ahitai, ahin tuchan'in theichang khatbeh jong aga poi! Phuhlhu uvin,” ati. Honsungah mun alobep seuvin anohphah e, ati.
en: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’
text:
LUK 13:7
Thadou: Achainan honlhou pa jah'a, Kumthum hulteh kanga ahitai, ahin tuchan'in theichang khatbeh jong aga poi! Phuhlhu uvin,” ati. Honsungah mun alobep seuvin anohphah e, ati.
English: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’

tcz: “Hon lhoupan adonbut in, ‘Pakai phat khatvei peh ben, kumkhat umsah ben, chule keiman phatechan vesui ingting leiphat na ding tampi sung inge.
en: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
text:
LUK 13:8
Thadou: “Hon lhoupan adonbut in, ‘Pakai phat khatvei peh ben, kumkhat umsah ben, chule keiman phatechan vesui ingting leiphat na ding tampi sung inge.
English: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

tcz: Khovei leh theichang imu le aphai. Imulou uleh, na phuhlhuh thei ahitai’ ati” tin aseiye.
en: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”
text:
LUK 13:9
Thadou: Khovei leh theichang imu le aphai. Imulou uleh, na phuhlhuh thei ahitai’ ati” tin aseiye.
English: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

tcz: Cholngah ni khat hi Yeshuan kikhopna in'a thu ahil pet hin,
en: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.
text:
LUK 13:10
Thadou: Cholngah ni khat hi Yeshuan kikhopna in'a thu ahil pet hin,
English: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

tcz: Numei khat lhagaoboh in lam jot moa alha amui. Kum somleget jen tingbong'a dingjang thei louva alha ahi.
en: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.
text:
LUK 13:11
Thadou: Numei khat lhagaoboh in lam jot moa alha amui. Kum somleget jen tingbong'a dingjang thei louva alha ahi.
English: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.

tcz: Yeshuan amanu amu chun, ahinkouvin aseitai, “Ngailut umtah numeinu, nanat na'a kona kisudam'ah nahitai,” ati.
en: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”
text:
LUK 13:12
Thadou: Yeshuan amanu amu chun, ahinkouvin aseitai, “Ngailut umtah numeinu, nanat na'a kona kisudam'ah nahitai,” ati.
English: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

tcz: Chuin amanu chu atham'in ahileh amanu jong chupettah chun adingjang thei tai. Pathen iti avahchoi hitam!
en: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.
text:
LUK 13:13
Thadou: Chuin amanu chu atham'in ahileh amanu jong chupettah chun adingjang thei tai. Pathen iti avahchoi hitam!
English: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.

tcz: Ahivangin kikhopna in'a lhacha mopopa chun cholngah nia amisuhdam jeh chun nommo asan. “Hapta sunga nigup natoh nading um ahi,” tin mihonpi jah'a chun, “Hiche nikho ho a chun hungun, Cholngahni hilouvin” ati.
en: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”
text:
LUK 13:14
Thadou: Ahivangin kikhopna in'a lhacha mopopa chun cholngah nia amisuhdam jeh chun nommo asan. “Hapta sunga nigup natoh nading um ahi,” tin mihonpi jah'a chun, “Hiche nikho ho a chun hungun, Cholngahni hilouvin” ati.
English: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”

tcz: Ahivangin Pakaiyin adonbut in, “Miphalhem ho! Nabon uva Cholngah nia na natoh sohkeiyu chula! Na bongchal ham ahiloule na sangan ham Cholngah nia akihenna a pat a sutlham'a tui donsah dia napui jiu hilou ham?
en: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?
text:
LUK 13:15
Thadou: Ahivangin Pakaiyin adonbut in, “Miphalhem ho! Nabon uva Cholngah nia na natoh sohkeiyu chula! Na bongchal ham ahiloule na sangan ham Cholngah nia akihenna a pat a sutlham'a tui donsah dia napui jiu hilou ham?
English: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?

tcz: Hiche lungset umtah numeinu, Abraham chanu hi, Satan in kum somleget jen soh'a ahentang ahi. Cholngahni hijongleh chutobang suhdam chu dihlou ham?” ati.
en: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”
text:
LUK 13:16
Thadou: Hiche lungset umtah numeinu, Abraham chanu hi, Satan in kum somleget jen soh'a ahentang ahi. Cholngahni hijongleh chutobang suhdam chu dihlou ham?” ati.
English: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

tcz: Hichun agalmi ho asujum in, ahin mijousen thilkidang abolho jeh chun akipah tauve.
en: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
text:
LUK 13:17
Thadou: Hichun agalmi ho asujum in, ahin mijousen thilkidang abolho jeh chun akipah tauve.
English: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Pathen Lenggam chu itobang ham? Iti katekah ding ham?
en: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?
text:
LUK 13:18
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Pathen Lenggam chu itobang ham? Iti katekah ding ham?
English: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?

tcz: Ankam mu neocha tobang mikhat in hon'a atu tobang ahi; ahung khangin chule thingphung ahung kisoh e, chule vachaten abah tin'ah genading bu akisah jiuve,” ati.
en: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”
text:
LUK 13:19
Thadou: Ankam mu neocha tobang mikhat in hon'a atu tobang ahi; ahung khangin chule thingphung ahung kisoh e, chule vachaten abah tin'ah genading bu akisah jiuve,” ati.
English: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”

tcz: Aman adong kit in, “Pathen Lenggam chu ipi toh kitekah ding ham?
en: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?
text:
LUK 13:20
Thadou: Aman adong kit in, “Pathen Lenggam chu ipi toh kitekah ding ham?
English: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

tcz: Nupi khat in changlhah asemna a amanchah chol tobang ahi. Changbong atena dimthum'a chol neocha akoi ahivangin, apumpin ahin thulha jin ahi,” ati.
en: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”
text:
LUK 13:21
Thadou: Nupi khat in changlhah asemna a amanchah chol tobang ahi. Changbong atena dimthum'a chol neocha akoi ahivangin, apumpin ahin thulha jin ahi,” ati.
English: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”

tcz: Yeshua khopi hole khoneo tin'ah achen, achena chan'ah thu ahil'in, Jerusalem lam amano jinge.
en: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.
text:
LUK 13:22
Thadou: Yeshua khopi hole khoneo tin'ah achen, achena chan'ah thu ahil'in, Jerusalem lam amano jinge.
English: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

tcz: Koiham khat in ahin dongin, “Pakai, mi themkhat bou huhhing'a um ding ham?” ati. Aman adonbut in,
en: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,
text:
LUK 13:23
Thadou: Koiham khat in ahin dongin, “Pakai, mi themkhat bou huhhing'a um ding ham?” ati. Aman adonbut in,
English: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

tcz: “Pathen Lenggam lutna a kotjim lam'a lutna dingin kihabol un, ajeh chu mi tamtah'in lutding agotding ahivanga losam diu ahi.
en: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.
text:
LUK 13:24
Thadou: “Pathen Lenggam lutna a kotjim lam'a lutna dingin kihabol un, ajeh chu mi tamtah'in lutding agotding ahivanga losam diu ahi.
English: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

tcz: In neipan kot akam jou teng, geisang val ding ahitai. Nangma pamlam'a nadin'a kot nakiu ding chule natao ding, ‘Pakai, keiho dingin kot neihon peh un!’ nati ding, ahivanga aman nahin donbut diu, ‘Keiman nangho koi nahiu ahiloule hoiya kon nahiu kahekhapoi’ ati ding ahi.
en: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’
text:
LUK 13:25
Thadou: In neipan kot akam jou teng, geisang val ding ahitai. Nangma pamlam'a nadin'a kot nakiu ding chule natao ding, ‘Pakai, keiho dingin kot neihon peh un!’ nati ding, ahivanga aman nahin donbut diu, ‘Keiman nangho koi nahiu ahiloule hoiya kon nahiu kahekhapoi’ ati ding ahi.
English: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’

tcz: Chuteng nanghon naseidiu, ‘Ahivanga nangma toh kaneh uva kadon uva, chule kalampiu lah dunga jong neinahil u chula’ natidiu ahi.
en: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
text:
LUK 13:26
Thadou: Chuteng nanghon naseidiu, ‘Ahivanga nangma toh kaneh uva kadon uva, chule kalampiu lah dunga jong neinahil u chula’ natidiu ahi.
English: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

tcz: Chule aman hitia hi ahin donbut ding, ‘Kaseipeh nahiuve, keiman nangho kahekhapoi chule hoiya kona hung nahiu kahepoi. Kakoma konin potdoh'un, nangho thilse bolteho.’
en: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
text:
LUK 13:27
Thadou: Chule aman hitia hi ahin donbut ding, ‘Kaseipeh nahiuve, keiman nangho kahekhapoi chule hoiya kona hung nahiu kahepoi. Kakoma konin potdoh'un, nangho thilse bolteho.’
English: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

tcz: Chumun'a chu ka le hagel um ding ahi, ijeh inem itile Pathen lenggam a chu Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, chule themgao jouse namudiu ahi, amavang nangma nakipaidoh ding ahi.
en: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.
text:
LUK 13:28
Thadou: Chumun'a chu ka le hagel um ding ahi, ijeh inem itile Pathen lenggam a chu Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, chule themgao jouse namudiu ahi, amavang nangma nakipaidoh ding ahi.
English: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.

tcz: Chule miho vannoi pumpi–solam le lhumlam a pat, sah le lhang a pat–Pathen lenggam'a amun'u kilo dinga hung khom diu ahi.
en: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.
text:
LUK 13:29
Thadou: Chule miho vannoi pumpi–solam le lhumlam a pat, sah le lhang a pat–Pathen lenggam'a amun'u kilo dinga hung khom diu ahi.
English: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.

tcz: Chule hiche hi kichin in: mi phabep tua mi-noinung pen dan'a umhohi khonung leh alenpen hidiu ahi, chule tua alenpen hohi aneopen hidiu ahi,” ati.
en: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”
text:
LUK 13:30
Thadou: Chule hiche hi kichin in: mi phabep tua mi-noinung pen dan'a umhohi khonung leh alenpen hidiu ahi, chule tua alenpen hohi aneopen hidiu ahi,” ati.
English: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”

tcz: Hiche pet chun Pharisee ho phabep khat in ajah'a, “Hikoma konin potdoh'in nakihinso nom leh! Herod in nathatdoh nom'e!” atiuve.
en: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”
text:
LUK 13:31
Thadou: Hiche pet chun Pharisee ho phabep khat in ajah'a, “Hikoma konin potdoh'in nakihinso nom leh! Herod in nathatdoh nom'e!” atiuve.
English: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Cheuvin lang chuche si-al chu gaseipeh un, thilha kanodoh jing ding chule ana damlou kasuhdam jing ding, tunia jong jinga jong; chule anithum nile kahung lona kasuh bulhit ding ahi.
en: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.
text:
LUK 13:32
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Cheuvin lang chuche si-al chu gaseipeh un, thilha kanodoh jing ding chule ana damlou kasuhdam jing ding, tunia jong jinga jong; chule anithum nile kahung lona kasuh bulhit ding ahi.
English: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

tcz: Henge, tuni le jing, chule ajing kit le kalampia chu kachejom ding ahi. Ajeh chu Jerusalem tailouva themgao kithat theilou ding ahi.”
en: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’
text:
LUK 13:33
Thadou: Henge, tuni le jing, chule ajing kit le kalampia chu kachejom ding ahi. Ajeh chu Jerusalem tailouva themgao kithat theilou ding ahi.”
English: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

tcz: “O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, themgaoho that le Pathen sottolle ho songa seplih khopi! Ijat vei ahpin anoute alhaving noiya a-opkhum banga nachate khoptup ding kagot ham, ahivangin neibolsah poi.
en: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!
text:
LUK 13:34
Thadou: “O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, themgaoho that le Pathen sottolle ho songa seplih khopi! Ijat vei ahpin anoute alhaving noiya a-opkhum banga nachate khoptup ding kagot ham, ahivangin neibolsah poi.
English: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

tcz: Chuleh tun, ven, na-in hi kidalha ahitai. Chuleh nangman neimu kitlou ding ahitai, ‘Pakai min'a hungpa anunnom'e!’ tia naseikit tokah'a,” ati.
en: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
text:
LUK 13:35
Thadou: Chuleh tun, ven, na-in hi kidalha ahitai. Chuleh nangman neimu kitlou ding ahitai, ‘Pakai min'a hungpa anunnom'e!’ tia naseikit tokah'a,” ati.
English: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

tcz: Cholngahni khat Yeshua nilhah an nedin Pharisee ho lamkai khat in'ah achen, chule miho chun phatah in avelhiuvin ahi.
en: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
text:
LUK 14:1
Thadou: Cholngahni khat Yeshua nilhah an nedin Pharisee ho lamkai khat in'ah achen, chule miho chun phatah in avelhiuvin ahi.
English: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

tcz: Hiche a chun mikhat, aban le akengho pom khat aumin ahi.
en: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.
text:
LUK 14:2
Thadou: Hiche a chun mikhat, aban le akengho pom khat aumin ahi.
English: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

tcz: Yeshuan Pharisee hole danthu themho chu adongin, “Cholngah nikhoa misuhdam danthun aphal hai aphallou ham?” ati.
en: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
text:
LUK 14:3
Thadou: Yeshuan Pharisee hole danthu themho chu adongin, “Cholngah nikhoa misuhdam danthun aphal hai aphallou ham?” ati.
English: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

tcz: Amahon adonbut nom lou phat un, Yeshuan anapa chu atham'in chule asudam'in asolmang tai.
en: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.
text:
LUK 14:4
Thadou: Amahon adonbut nom lou phat un, Yeshuan anapa chu atham'in chule asudam'in asolmang tai.
English: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

tcz: Chuin amaho lam ngan aseitai, “Nangho cholngah nia natonglou koi naum uvam? Nachapa ham ahiloule na bongchal hamkhat kokhuh a alhahlut le, aladoh dinga nakino ji hih um?” ati.
en: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”
text:
LUK 14:5
Thadou: Chuin amaho lam ngan aseitai, “Nangho cholngah nia natonglou koi naum uvam? Nachapa ham ahiloule na bongchal hamkhat kokhuh a alhahlut le, aladoh dinga nakino ji hih um?” ati.
English: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”

tcz: Avel'in adonbut thei kit tapouve.
en: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.
text:
LUK 14:6
Thadou: Avel'in adonbut thei kit tapouve.
English: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.

tcz: Nilhah anne a hung jouse chun touna nom nom jabolna mun achu cheh'u Yeshuan amu phat in, aman amaho chu hiche thumop hi apen ahi.
en: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,
text:
LUK 14:7
Thadou: Nilhah anne a hung jouse chun touna nom nom jabolna mun achu cheh'u Yeshuan amu phat in, aman amaho chu hiche thumop hi apen ahi.
English: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

tcz: “Moupui golvah na'a kouna namu teng uleh, jabolna munhoa tou hih un. Ijem tin nang sanga jabolna chang ding khat ana kikou khataleh ipi tin tem?”
en: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,
text:
LUK 14:8
Thadou: “Moupui golvah na'a kouna namu teng uleh, jabolna munhoa tou hih un. Ijem tin nang sanga jabolna chang ding khat ana kikou khataleh ipi tin tem?”
English: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

tcz: Kinneipa chun ahung seiding, “Natouna chu hiche mipa hi pen” atiding ahi. Chuteng nangma najah cha ding ahi, chutengleh dokhang noiya kikoi touna hoa chu natou ding ahitai!
en: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.
text:
LUK 14:9
Thadou: Kinneipa chun ahung seiding, “Natouna chu hiche mipa hi pen” atiding ahi. Chuteng nangma najah cha ding ahi, chutengleh dokhang noiya kikoi touna hoa chu natou ding ahitai!
English: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

tcz: “Chusang chun dokhang kengbul mun nemnung pen'a chun touvin. Chuteng kinneipan nahin muding nahenga hunga, ‘Jol, nang dingin mun phajep kaneiyuve!’ ahung tiding ahi. Chuteng nangma chu jin kikou dang ho masanga jana nachan ding ahi.
en: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.
text:
LUK 14:10
Thadou: “Chusang chun dokhang kengbul mun nemnung pen'a chun touvin. Chuteng kinneipan nahin muding nahenga hunga, ‘Jol, nang dingin mun phajep kaneiyuve!’ ahung tiding ahi. Chuteng nangma chu jin kikou dang ho masanga jana nachan ding ahi.
English: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile ama kichoisang chan chu suhnem'a umdiu ahi, chule akineosah chan chu dopsang'a umdiu ahi” ati.
en: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
text:
LUK 14:11
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile ama kichoisang chan chu suhnem'a umdiu ahi, chule akineosah chan chu dopsang'a umdiu ahi” ati.
English: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

tcz: Chuin in-neipa chu aven, hitin aseiye “Nangman nehkhom ahilouleh golvah nabol teng, naloi nagol ho, nasopiho, na inkote, chule naheng nakom mihao ho kou hih'in. Ajeh chu amahon nangma nahin koukit diu ahin, hiche bou chu natohga hiding ahitai.
en: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.
text:
LUK 14:12
Thadou: Chuin in-neipa chu aven, hitin aseiye “Nangman nehkhom ahilouleh golvah nabol teng, naloi nagol ho, nasopiho, na inkote, chule naheng nakom mihao ho kou hih'in. Ajeh chu amahon nangma nahin koukit diu ahin, hiche bou chu natohga hiding ahitai.
English: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

tcz: Chusang chun mivaichaho, chatmo ho, elbai ho, chule mitcho ho kou jon.
en: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

tcz: Chuteng michonpha thokitna'a Pathen in nanungsah joulou ding ho nakou jeh a nangma tohphatman napeh ding ahi,” ati.
en: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”
text:
LUK 14:14
Thadou: Chuteng michonpha thokitna'a Pathen in nanungsah joulou ding ho nakou jeh a nangma tohphatman napeh ding ahi,” ati.
English: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”

tcz: Hiche thu ajah hin mikhat dokhanga Yeshua toh toukhom khat in, “Pathen Lenggam'a golvah ankonga galhah ding iti anop tadem!” tin ahin phongdoh e.
en: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”
text:
LUK 14:15
Thadou: Hiche thu ajah hin mikhat dokhanga Yeshua toh toukhom khat in, “Pathen Lenggam'a golvah ankonga galhah ding iti anop tadem!” tin ahin phongdoh e.
English: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut nan hiche thusim hi aseipeh e: Mikhat hin golvah lentah abol in kouna lekha jong tamtah athot doh tai.
en: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.
text:
LUK 14:16
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut nan hiche thusim hi aseipeh e: Mikhat hin golvah lentah abol in kouna lekha jong tamtah athot doh tai.
English: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

tcz: Golvah anneh khom chu gontup ahiphat in, asohte asol'in, akikou ho jah'a, “Hungun golvah ankong gontup ahitai” agatisah'e.
en: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’
text:
LUK 14:17
Thadou: Golvah anneh khom chu gontup ahiphat in, asohte asol'in, akikou ho jah'a, “Hungun golvah ankong gontup ahitai” agatisah'e.
English: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’

tcz: Ahivangin amahon abon'un ahitheilou nau thu aseiyun ahi. Khat in, “Tutah chun loumun kachon kavettoh lou akhoh'e, lungsettah in nei ngaidam in” ati.
en: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’
text:
LUK 14:18
Thadou: Ahivangin amahon abon'un ahitheilou nau thu aseiyun ahi. Khat in, “Tutah chun loumun kachon kavettoh lou akhoh'e, lungsettah in nei ngaidam in” ati.
English: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’

tcz: Khat kit chun, Keiman tutah chun bongchal to-nga kahin chon, hithei nam ti kavet got ahi, lungset'in nei ngaidam un, ati.
en: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’
text:
LUK 14:19
Thadou: Khat kit chun, Keiman tutah chun bongchal to-nga kahin chon, hithei nam ti kavet got ahi, lungset'in nei ngaidam un, ati.
English: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’

tcz: Achom khat in, tun ji kaneiyin, hijeh chun hung thei ponge, ati.
en: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’
text:
LUK 14:20
Thadou: Achom khat in, tun ji kaneiyin, hijeh chun hung thei ponge, ati.
English: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’

tcz: “Sohpa chu akilen apakai pa kom ah ipi iti adonbut'u aseipeh tai. Apakai pachu alung hang in hitin ahinsei tai, ‘Kintah'in chenlang, khopi sung lamlen tin'ah mivaicha ho, chatmo ho, mitcho ho, chule elbai ho gakou tan’ ati.
en: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’
text:
LUK 14:21
Thadou: “Sohpa chu akilen apakai pa kom ah ipi iti adonbut'u aseipeh tai. Apakai pachu alung hang in hitin ahinsei tai, ‘Kintah'in chenlang, khopi sung lamlen tin'ah mivaicha ho, chatmo ho, mitcho ho, chule elbai ho gakou tan’ ati.
English: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’

tcz: Asohpan hichu aboljou phat in, ahung hetsah in, ‘Mun a-ong nalaiye’ ahung ti.
en: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’
text:
LUK 14:22
Thadou: Asohpan hichu aboljou phat in, ahung hetsah in, ‘Mun a-ong nalaiye’ ahung ti.
English: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’

tcz: Hijeh chun apakai pan aseiyin, ‘Chedoh in lang lamlen pam lah dung chule aning kah lah'a um koi hijong leh, namu mu hinkouvin, ka-in mi adim nadingin’ ati.
en: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
text:
LUK 14:23
Thadou: Hijeh chun apakai pan aseiyin, ‘Chedoh in lang lamlen pam lah dung chule aning kah lah'a um koi hijong leh, namu mu hinkouvin, ka-in mi adim nadingin’ ati.
English: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

tcz: Ajeh chu kakou masat ho chun golvah an chu aneokhat jong atekhah lou diu ahitai,” ati.
en: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen.’”
text:
LUK 14:24
Thadou: Ajeh chu kakou masat ho chun golvah an chu aneokhat jong atekhah lou diu ahitai,” ati.
English: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen.’”

tcz: Mihonpi tamtah chun Yeshua nung ajuiyu ahin, ama akihei kol'in ajah'uva aseitai,
en: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,
text:
LUK 14:25
Thadou: Mihonpi tamtah chun Yeshua nung ajuiyu ahin, ama akihei kol'in ajah'uva aseitai,
English: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

tcz: “Nangho kaseijui nahi nom uleh, mijouse nahot ngaiyu ahi, tekah nan–nanu napa, naji nachate, nasopi ho, nangma hinkho tah jong, achuti louleh kaseijui nahithei lou diu ahi.”
en: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.
text:
LUK 14:26
Thadou: “Nangho kaseijui nahi nom uleh, mijouse nahot ngaiyu ahi, tekah nan–nanu napa, naji nachate, nasopi ho, nangma hinkho tah jong, achuti louleh kaseijui nahithei lou diu ahi.”
English: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.

tcz: Chule na thingpel nakipoh'a kanung najui lou leh, kaseijui nahithei lou diu ahi.
en: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.
text:
LUK 14:27
Thadou: Chule na thingpel nakipoh'a kanung najui lou leh, kaseijui nahithei lou diu ahi.
English: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.

tcz: Ahivangin kipan hih'un athoh hah ding dan nasimtoh masang'un. Ijeh inem itile, kon insah apat ding ham amasa'a alutding jat vetoh'a, ajona dinga sum ninglhing ding hinam ti simtoh masalouva?
en: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?
text:
LUK 14:28
Thadou: Ahivangin kipan hih'un athoh hah ding dan nasimtoh masang'un. Ijeh inem itile, kon insah apat ding ham amasa'a alutding jat vetoh'a, ajona dinga sum ninglhing ding hinam ti simtoh masalouva?
English: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

tcz: Achuti loule akhombul bou najoa sum nabei maithei ahi, chuteng chuleh mijousen nanuisat bepding ahitai.
en: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,
text:
LUK 14:29
Thadou: Achuti loule akhombul bou najoa sum nabei maithei ahi, chuteng chuleh mijousen nanuisat bepding ahitai.
English: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

tcz: Amahon seiyunte, “Hiche pa khu ahi, insah kipan'a aban ajona ding boldoh joulou pa khu” tiuvinte.
en: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’
text:
LUK 14:30
Thadou: Amahon seiyunte, “Hiche pa khu ahi, insah kipan'a aban ajona ding boldoh joulou pa khu” tiuvinte.
English: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

tcz: “Ahilouleh, Leng khat galbol ding, koi athumop them hotoh toukhom'a, asepai sang som chun ama nokhum dinga hung kon sang som ni chu ajoding hinam ti kigel masalou ding'ah?
en: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?
text:
LUK 14:31
Thadou: “Ahilouleh, Leng khat galbol ding, koi athumop them hotoh toukhom'a, asepai sang som chun ama nokhum dinga hung kon sang som ni chu ajoding hinam ti kigel masalou ding'ah?
English: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

tcz: Chuleh ajolou ding leh, palai sol'in tin, agalmi ho gamlat pet'a chu kihoucham ding agot tei ding ahi.
en: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.
text:
LUK 14:32
Thadou: Chuleh ajolou ding leh, palai sol'in tin, agalmi ho gamlat pet'a chu kihoucham ding agot tei ding ahi.
English: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.

tcz: Hijeh a chu nanei jouse napehdoh tokah a kaseijui nahithei lou diu ahi.
en: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.
text:
LUK 14:33
Thadou: Hijeh a chu nanei jouse napehdoh tokah a kaseijui nahithei lou diu ahi.
English: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.

tcz: “Chi hi asu-al dingin aphai. Ahin, a-al na chu mansah taleh, iti na-alsah kit ding ham?”
en: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?
text:
LUK 14:34
Thadou: “Chi hi asu-al dingin aphai. Ahin, a-al na chu mansah taleh, iti na-alsah kit ding ham?”
English: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?

tcz: A-al lou chi chu leiset a dinga jong chule leithao a dinga jong phachom lou ahi. Paidoh in aumji tai. Koi hileh nakol neichan in ngai hen chule hetthem hen.
en: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
text:
LUK 14:35
Thadou: A-al lou chi chu leiset a dinga jong chule leithao a dinga jong phachom lou ahi. Paidoh in aumji tai. Koi hileh nakol neichan in ngai hen chule hetthem hen.
English: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

tcz: Kaidong hole adang michonse ho Yeshua thuhil ngai dingin ahung jiuvin ahi.
en: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.
text:
LUK 15:1
Thadou: Kaidong hole adang michonse ho Yeshua thuhil ngai dingin ahung jiuvin ahi.
English: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

tcz: Hiche hin Pharisee hole hou danthu hil ho aphunchel sah tan, michonse hotoh akipol'in nejong anekhom uve! tin aseitauve.
en: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
text:
LUK 15:2
Thadou: Hiche hin Pharisee hole hou danthu hil ho aphunchel sah tan, michonse hotoh akipol'in nejong anekhom uve! tin aseitauve.
English: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Yeshuan hiche thusim hi aseipeh in ahi:
en: He told them this parable:
text:
LUK 15:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun Yeshuan hiche thusim hi aseipeh in ahi:
English: He told them this parable:

tcz: “Mikhat in kelngoi jakhat neihen chule alah'a khat chu vahmang taleh, ipi bol tantem? Adang somko le ko ho chu gamthip a adalhah'a chule avahmang pachu amu tokah'a agahol lou ding ham?
en: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?
text:
LUK 15:4
Thadou: “Mikhat in kelngoi jakhat neihen chule alah'a khat chu vahmang taleh, ipi bol tantem? Adang somko le ko ho chu gamthip a adalhah'a chule avahmang pachu amu tokah'a agahol lou ding ham?
English: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

tcz: Chuteng ahinmu tengleh, kipah tah in a'in lam'a din alengkouvah hin kipoh tante.
en: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
text:
LUK 15:5
Thadou: Chuteng ahinmu tengleh, kipah tah in a'in lam'a din alengkouvah hin kipoh tante.
English: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

tcz: Ahung vailhun tengleh amapan aloi agol chule aheng akom koukhom in tin, ‘Nei kipa khom piuvin ajeh chu keiman ka kelngoi mangna chu kakimutai’ tinte.
en: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’
text:
LUK 15:6
Thadou: Ahung vailhun tengleh amapan aloi agol chule aheng akom koukhom in tin, ‘Nei kipa khom piuvin ajeh chu keiman ka kelngoi mangna chu kakimutai’ tinte.
English: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’

tcz: Chutobang a chu michonse khat in lunghei na aneiya Pathen lama akile kit chun adang somko le ko lunghei ngailou michonpha ho chung sangin van'ah kipana aume. Sum-Pum Kimansah
en: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.
text:
LUK 15:7
Thadou: Chutobang a chu michonse khat in lunghei na aneiya Pathen lama akile kit chun adang somko le ko lunghei ngailou michonpha ho chung sangin van'ah kipana aume. Sum-Pum Kimansah
English: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

tcz: Ahilouleh, tekah nan, numei khat hin sum dangka som aneiyin chule khat amansah tai. Amanun meivah adet'a insung pumpi atheh'a chule chingthei tah'a amu tokah'a ahol lou ding ham?
en: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?
text:
LUK 15:8
Thadou: Ahilouleh, tekah nan, numei khat hin sum dangka som aneiyin chule khat amansah tai. Amanun meivah adet'a insung pumpi atheh'a chule chingthei tah'a amu tokah'a ahol lou ding ham?
English: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?

tcz: Chule amanun hichu amuteng, aloi apai chule aheng akom cheng akoukhom ding, ‘Nei kipapiuvin, ajeh chu kasum mang kakinungmu tai’ atiding ahi.
en: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’
text:
LUK 15:9
Thadou: Chule amanun hichu amuteng, aloi apai chule aheng akom cheng akoukhom ding, ‘Nei kipapiuvin, ajeh chu kasum mang kakinungmu tai’ atiding ahi.
English: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’

tcz: Chutobang chun van'ah Pathen Vantilte pan na'in, michonse khatseh lunghei na chungah kipana aum'e” ati.
en: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”
text:
LUK 15:10
Thadou: Chutobang chun van'ah Pathen Vantilte pan na'in, michonse khatseh lunghei na chungah kipana aum'e” ati.
English: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”

tcz: Athusei hilchet be theina din hiche thusim hi aseiyin ahi: “Mikhat in chapa ni aneiye.
en: He said, “A certain man had two sons.
text:
LUK 15:11
Thadou: Athusei hilchet be theina din hiche thusim hi aseiyin ahi: “Mikhat in chapa ni aneiye.
English: He said, “A certain man had two sons.

tcz: Aneojo pan apa jah'a, ‘Nathi masangin nanei nagou kachan ding ho tun kadei tai’ ati. Hijeh chun apan achateni chu anei agou ho hoppeh dingin anomtai.
en: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.
text:
LUK 15:12
Thadou: Aneojo pan apa jah'a, ‘Nathi masangin nanei nagou kachan ding ho tun kadei tai’ ati. Hijeh chun apan achateni chu anei agou ho hoppeh dingin anomtai.
English: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.

tcz: Niphabep jouvin hiche chapa neojo pa chun anei jouse akisemtup in mun gamlatah a dingin achetai, chule hia chun asum le pai jouse hindan kinomsah nan asumang tai.
en: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.
text:
LUK 15:13
Thadou: Niphabep jouvin hiche chapa neojo pa chun anei jouse akisemtup in mun gamlatah a dingin achetai, chule hia chun asum le pai jouse hindan kinomsah nan asumang tai.
English: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.

tcz: Chutia asum akiman chai phat chun, gamsunga chun kel nasatah alhan, kel athoh pan tai.
en: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.
text:
LUK 15:14
Thadou: Chutia asum akiman chai phat chun, gamsunga chun kel nasatah alhan, kel athoh pan tai.
English: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.

tcz: Chumun'a loulhoumi khat in natoh apeh na dingin akithujon, amapan jong aloumun langah vohchate vah dingin asol'in ahi.”
en: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.
text:
LUK 15:15
Thadou: Chumun'a loulhoumi khat in natoh apeh na dingin akithujon, amapan jong aloumun langah vohchate vah dingin asol'in ahi.”
English: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

tcz: Khangdong pachu agilkel lheh tan, vohchate anehsah ji voh-an jeng jong chu twilheh dingin amitmun akilang tan ahi. Ahivangin koiman nehding ape tapon ahi.
en: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.
text:
LUK 15:16
Thadou: Khangdong pachu agilkel lheh tan, vohchate anehsah ji voh-an jeng jong chu twilheh dingin amitmun akilang tan ahi. Ahivangin koiman nehding ape tapon ahi.
English: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

tcz: “Achainakeiya ahung khahdoh phat chun, ama le ama akihoulim in, Ka-in ah soh thalah ho jengin jong anehval set'u anneh aneiyun, kei hiche'ah gilkel'a thidingin kaume! ati.
en: But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!
text:
LUK 15:17
Thadou: “Achainakeiya ahung khahdoh phat chun, ama le ama akihoulim in, Ka-in ah soh thalah ho jengin jong anehval set'u anneh aneiyun, kei hiche'ah gilkel'a thidingin kaume! ati.
English: But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!

tcz: Ka-in a kache ding kapa koma, ‘Hepa, van le nangma dounan kachonse tai,
en: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.
text:
LUK 15:18
Thadou: Ka-in a kache ding kapa koma, ‘Hepa, van le nangma dounan kachonse tai,
English: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.

tcz: chule keima nacha tiding hoi kahitapoi. Lungset tah in soh thalah khat bangin nei sangin, tinge’ atitai.”
en: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’
text:
LUK 15:19
Thadou: chule keima nacha tiding hoi kahitapoi. Lungset tah in soh thalah khat bangin nei sangin, tinge’ atitai.”
English: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’
