tcz: Chuin ama apa koma dingin inlam akile tai. Chule amapa mun gamlatah ahung gei nalaiyin, apan ahung amutan ahi. Ngailutna le khotona dimset pum'in achapa komah alhaiyin, akolchuh chuh in, achoptai.
en: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.
text:
LUK 15:20
Thadou: Chuin ama apa koma dingin inlam akile tai. Chule amapa mun gamlatah ahung gei nalaiyin, apan ahung amutan ahi. Ngailutna le khotona dimset pum'in achapa komah alhaiyin, akolchuh chuh in, achoptai.
English: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.

tcz: Achapan ahin seitai, “Hepa, keima van le nangma dounan kachonse tai, chule tun nacha tiding jong kalhing jou tapoi,” ati.
en: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
text:
LUK 15:21
Thadou: Achapan ahin seitai, “Hepa, keima van le nangma dounan kachonse tai, chule tun nacha tiding jong kalhing jou tapoi,” ati.
English: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

tcz: Ahinlah apan asohte komah aseitai, Gang'un! Insunga ponsil hoipen pen hinchoiyun lang silpeh un. Akhutjung'a akibu ding khutjem le akise ding kengchot hinchoiyun.
en: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.
text:
LUK 15:22
Thadou: Ahinlah apan asohte komah aseitai, Gang'un! Insunga ponsil hoipen pen hinchoiyun lang silpeh un. Akhutjung'a akibu ding khutjem le akise ding kengchot hinchoiyun.
English: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.

tcz: Chule bongnou ivahthao uchu that un. Eihon golvah loupi tah a ilop diu ahi,
en: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let’s eat and celebrate;

tcz: ajehchu hiche kachapa hi athi anahitan, tua hi hung hingdoh kit ahi. Amangsa anahin, tua hi kimukit ahitai. Hiti chun golnop chu akipan tai.
en: for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.
text:
LUK 15:24
Thadou: ajehchu hiche kachapa hi athi anahitan, tua hi hung hingdoh kit ahi. Amangsa anahin, tua hi kimukit ahitai. Hiti chun golnop chu akipan tai.
English: for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.

tcz: Chutia aumlai chun, chapa a'upajo pachu loulanga um natong ahi. Inlam ahung kile chun, in'a chun tumging le lam gin ajatan,
en: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.
text:
LUK 15:25
Thadou: Chutia aumlai chun, chapa a'upajo pachu loulanga um natong ahi. Inlam ahung kile chun, in'a chun tumging le lam gin ajatan,
English: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

tcz: chuin asohte khat komah ipi thilsoh umham ti adongin ahi.
en: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on.
text:
LUK 15:26
Thadou: chuin asohte khat komah ipi thilsoh umham ti adongin ahi.
English: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on.

tcz: Nasopipa hung kile ahi, tin aseipeh un, chuleh napan bongnou thaotah chu athapeh ahi. Damsel'a ahunglhun jeh'a ilop'u ahi, tin aseipeh tai.
en: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’
text:
LUK 15:27
Thadou: Nasopipa hung kile ahi, tin aseipeh un, chuleh napan bongnou thaotah chu athapeh ahi. Damsel'a ahunglhun jeh'a ilop'u ahi, tin aseipeh tai.
English: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’

tcz: A'upajo pachu alung hangin insung alut tapon ahi. Apa ahungdoh in ahung tem'e,
en: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.
text:
LUK 15:28
Thadou: A'upajo pachu alung hangin insung alut tapon ahi. Apa ahungdoh in ahung tem'e,
English: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.

tcz: ahin aman adonbut in, Kum hijat hi nasoh banga kaum chule bol'in nati jouse kada na umkhalou ahi. Chuleh hiche phat jouse achun nangman kaloi kagol hotoh kaneh khom diuvin kelcha nou khatbeh neinape khapoi.
en: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.
text:
LUK 15:29
Thadou: ahin aman adonbut in, Kum hijat hi nasoh banga kaum chule bol'in nati jouse kada na umkhalou ahi. Chuleh hiche phat jouse achun nangman kaloi kagol hotoh kaneh khom diuvin kelcha nou khatbeh neinape khapoi.
English: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.

tcz: Ahivangin hiche nachapan noti ho chunga nasum jouse aveichai nungin, nangman bongnou thaotah nathapeh in nalop peh e, ati.
en: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’
text:
LUK 15:30
Thadou: Ahivangin hiche nachapan noti ho chunga nasum jouse aveichai nungin, nangman bongnou thaotah nathapeh in nalop peh e, ati.
English: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’

tcz: Apan ajah'a aseiyin, “Ven, kachapa ngaitah, nangma kakomah naum jinge, chuleh kanei jouse jong hi nanga ahi.
en: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.
text:
LUK 15:31
Thadou: Apan ajah'a aseiyin, “Ven, kachapa ngaitah, nangma kakomah naum jinge, chuleh kanei jouse jong hi nanga ahi.
English: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.

tcz: Eihon hiche kipa nikho hi ilop diu ahi. Ijeh inem itile nasopipa hi athi'ah ahitan chule hung hingdoh kit ahi! Amangsa anahin, hinlah tun akimutai!” ati.
en: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”
text:
LUK 15:32
Thadou: Eihon hiche kipa nikho hi ilop diu ahi. Ijeh inem itile nasopipa hi athi'ah ahitan chule hung hingdoh kit ahi! Amangsa anahin, hinlah tun akimutai!” ati.
English: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”

tcz: Yeshuan hiche thusim hi aseijuite aseipeh e: “Mihaotah khat ana um'in, aman neiching khat ima ma vesuiya anganse aneiye, ahin aneichin na ah akitah poi ti thulamleng ahunge.
en: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.
text:
LUK 16:1
Thadou: Yeshuan hiche thusim hi aseijuite aseipeh e: “Mihaotah khat ana um'in, aman neiching khat ima ma vesuiya anganse aneiye, ahin aneichin na ah akitah poi ti thulamleng ahunge.
English: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

tcz: Hijeh chun apansah pan ama chu akouvin aseitai, ‘Ipi ham nathu kajah hi? Na neichin ho sutup in lang neihin pen ajeh chu nachungthu kisei ding ahitai’” ati.
en: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’
text:
LUK 16:2
Thadou: Hijeh chun apansah pan ama chu akouvin aseitai, ‘Ipi ham nathu kajah hi? Na neichin ho sutup in lang neihin pen ajeh chu nachungthu kisei ding ahitai’” ati.
English: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

tcz: Neichingpa akingaiton, “Tua ipi kabol ding?” tin akihoulim'in, “Kapakai pan la eihaisah ahitan, lei lai dingla katha ahatpon, chule thum ding la hibanga kikiletsah'a,
en: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.
text:
LUK 16:3
Thadou: Neichingpa akingaiton, “Tua ipi kabol ding?” tin akihoulim'in, “Kapakai pan la eihaisah ahitan, lei lai dingla katha ahatpon, chule thum ding la hibanga kikiletsah'a,
English: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

tcz: aphai, eihaisah tengleh loi le pai tampi kaneiya amahon a-in'a eilhunsah nadiuvin hitin bol inge” ati.
en: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’
text:
LUK 16:4
Thadou: aphai, eihaisah tengleh loi le pai tampi kaneiya amahon a-in'a eilhunsah nadiuvin hitin bol inge” ati.
English: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’

tcz: Hijeh chun apansah pa sumba jouse chu ahungkhom uva athu seitoh ahina din akoukhom sohtai. Amasapa jah'a, “Ijat nabat ham?” atileh,
en: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’
text:
LUK 16:5
Thadou: Hijeh chun apansah pa sumba jouse chu ahungkhom uva athu seitoh ahina din akoukhom sohtai. Amasapa jah'a, “Ijat nabat ham?” atileh,
English: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

tcz: mipa chun adonbut in, “Keiman olive thao twipai dim jaget kabai” ati. Chuin neichingpan aseipeh in, “Aman kijihna lekha hi kilah loiyin lang twipai jali jih in” ati.
en: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’
text:
LUK 16:6
Thadou: mipa chun adonbut in, “Keiman olive thao twipai dim jaget kabai” ati. Chuin neichingpan aseipeh in, “Aman kijihna lekha hi kilah loiyin lang twipai jali jih in” ati.
English: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’

tcz: Ahileh nangin ijat nabat em? tin anina pa adonge. Keiman suhlou chang lhuh sangkhat kabai, tin ahin donbut'e. Neiching pan aseiyin, hin, lekha hi kilah in lang lhuh jaget in jih in, ati.
en: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’
text:
LUK 16:7
Thadou: Ahileh nangin ijat nabat em? tin anina pa adonge. Keiman suhlou chang lhuh sangkhat kabai, tin ahin donbut'e. Neiching pan aseiyin, hin, lekha hi kilah in lang lhuh jaget in jih in, ati.
English: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

tcz: Mihao pa chun chuche chondih lou neichingpan chingthei tah a abol chu apahcha tan ahi. Adih ahi, hiche vannoi chaten avel uva ho toh kipol ding dan hi khovah chate sangin achingjouve.
en: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.
text:
LUK 16:8
Thadou: Mihao pa chun chuche chondih lou neichingpan chingthei tah a abol chu apahcha tan ahi. Adih ahi, hiche vannoi chaten avel uva ho toh kipol ding dan hi khovah chate sangin achingjouve.
English: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

tcz: Kijildoh ding chu hiche ahi: Vannoiya nagouthil ho se hi midang phatchomna le jol le gol kisem nan mangin. Chuteng, nalei gouthil ho jouse abeisoh teng cheho chun tonsot in'a dinga nanalem diu ahi.
en: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.
text:
LUK 16:9
Thadou: Kijildoh ding chu hiche ahi: Vannoiya nagouthil ho se hi midang phatchomna le jol le gol kisem nan mangin. Chuteng, nalei gouthil ho jouse abeisoh teng cheho chun tonsot in'a dinga nanalem diu ahi.
English: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

tcz: Nangho thil neocha chunga nakitah ule, thil lentah ho chunga jong nakitah diu ahi. Amavang thil neocha chunga nakitahlou ule, mopohna lentah ho chunga jong kitahlou ding nahiuve.
en: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.
text:
LUK 16:10
Thadou: Nangho thil neocha chunga nakitah ule, thil lentah ho chunga jong nakitah diu ahi. Amavang thil neocha chunga nakitahlou ule, mopohna lentah ho chunga jong kitahlou ding nahiuve.
English: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

tcz: Chuleh leiset gouthil chunga tahsan naum louleh, kon vangou dihtah chunga natahsan dingu ham?
en: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
text:
LUK 16:11
Thadou: Chuleh leiset gouthil chunga tahsan naum louleh, kon vangou dihtah chunga natahsan dingu ham?
English: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

tcz: Chuleh midang thil chunga nakitah louleh ipi jeh a nangma thil chunga nakitahsan ding ham?
en: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
text:
LUK 16:12
Thadou: Chuleh midang thil chunga nakitah louleh ipi jeh a nangma thil chunga nakitahsan ding ham?
English: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?

tcz: “Koiman pakai ni sohna atongkop theipoi. Ajeh chu nangman khat namuda a khat nangailut tum ding ahi; khat dinga nakiphal theng'a khat nadonda thei ahi. Nanghon Pathen le sum sohna tongkhom thei pouvin nate,” ati.
en: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”
text:
LUK 16:13
Thadou: “Koiman pakai ni sohna atongkop theipoi. Ajeh chu nangman khat namuda a khat nangailut tum ding ahi; khat dinga nakiphal theng'a khat nadonda thei ahi. Nanghon Pathen le sum sohna tongkhom thei pouvin nate,” ati.
English: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”

tcz: Pharisee ho, sum ngailu dehset hon, ajasoh keiyun ama chu anelpeh un ahi.
en: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.
text:
LUK 16:14
Thadou: Pharisee ho, sum ngailu dehset hon, ajasoh keiyun ama chu anelpeh un ahi.
English: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

tcz: Chuin aman amaho jah'a aseitai, “Jalah'a miho mitmu'a michonpha nahinom, ahin Pathen in nalungthim ahei.” Hiche vannoi miten ajabol chu Pathen mitmua thet umtah ahi.
en: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.
text:
LUK 16:15
Thadou: Chuin aman amaho jah'a aseitai, “Jalah'a miho mitmu'a michonpha nahinom, ahin Pathen in nalungthim ahei.” Hiche vannoi miten ajabol chu Pathen mitmua thet umtah ahi.
English: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

tcz: Twilutsah John phatlai chan'a chu, Mose dan le themgao ho thuhil chu nakai hoi leuva pang anahi. Ahin, tun Pathen Lenggam Kipana thupha chu seiphongin aumtan, chule mijouse lutding athanom in ahi.
en: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
text:
LUK 16:16
Thadou: Twilutsah John phatlai chan'a chu, Mose dan le themgao ho thuhil chu nakai hoi leuva pang anahi. Ahin, tun Pathen Lenggam Kipana thupha chu seiphongin aumtan, chule mijouse lutding athanom in ahi.
English: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

tcz: Ahivangin danthu chu apanna umtalou tina ahipoi. Van le lei amanthah ding hi Pathen danthu neopen khat kilekhup ding sanga gamchenga baijo ahi.
en: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.
text:
LUK 16:17
Thadou: Ahivangin danthu chu apanna umtalou tina ahipoi. Van le lei amanthah ding hi Pathen danthu neopen khat kilekhup ding sanga gamchenga baijo ahi.
English: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

tcz: “Vetsahnan, mikhat chun ajinu ada'a midang khat akichenpi le ajong'ah ahi. Chuleh koihileh ajipan ahindasa numei kichenpi jong chu ajong'ah ahi” ati.
en: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.
text:
LUK 16:18
Thadou: “Vetsahnan, mikhat chun ajinu ada'a midang khat akichenpi le ajong'ah ahi. Chuleh koihileh ajipan ahindasa numei kichenpi jong chu ajong'ah ahi” ati.
English: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

tcz: Yeshuan aseiye, “Mihaotah khat, ponsandup le tupet ponnem kisil'a loupitah'a kivon le niseh a nomsatah'a umkhat anaum in ahi.
en: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
text:
LUK 16:19
Thadou: Yeshuan aseiye, “Mihaotah khat, ponsandup le tupet ponnem kisil'a loupitah'a kivon le niseh a nomsatah'a umkhat anaum in ahi.
English: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

tcz: Akelkot phunga chun Lazarus kiti tiphah natna dimset, mivaicha khat aum jin ahi.
en: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,
text:
LUK 16:20
Thadou: Akelkot phunga chun Lazarus kiti tiphah natna dimset, mivaicha khat aum jin ahi.
English: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,

tcz: Chutia Lazarus jong mihaopa dokhanga an lhajah ho ducha'a aumlaiyin, uicha ho ahung jiuvin atiphah namun ho chu ahung leh jiuve.
en: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
text:
LUK 16:21
Thadou: Chutia Lazarus jong mihaopa dokhanga an lhajah ho ducha'a aumlaiyin, uicha ho ahung jiuvin atiphah namun ho chu ahung leh jiuve.
English: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

tcz: Achainan, mivaichapa chu athitan chule Vantilte Abraham koma um ding'in apotauve. Mihaopa jong athin avui tauve,
en: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.
text:
LUK 16:22
Thadou: Achainan, mivaichapa chu athitan chule Vantilte Abraham koma um ding'in apotauve. Mihaopa jong athin avui tauve,
English: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.

tcz: chule alhagao chu mithi ho lah'a achetai. Chua athoh gentheina mun achun, Abraham gamlatah a aum chule Lazarus akoma atou chu amun ahi.
en: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
text:
LUK 16:23
Thadou: chule alhagao chu mithi ho lah'a achetai. Chua athoh gentheina mun achun, Abraham gamlatah a aum chule Lazarus akoma atou chu amun ahi.
English: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.

tcz: Mihaopa chu ahung pengjah'in, ‘Hepa Abraham, themkhat neilungset in! Lazarus hinsol in lang akhutjung twiyah hin delut henlang kalei hung sudap hen. Keima hiche meikong lah a hin kahesoh lheh jeng'e,’” ati.
en: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’
text:
LUK 16:24
Thadou: Mihaopa chu ahung pengjah'in, ‘Hepa Abraham, themkhat neilungset in! Lazarus hinsol in lang akhutjung twiyah hin delut henlang kalei hung sudap hen. Keima hiche meikong lah a hin kahesoh lheh jeng'e,’” ati.
English: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’

tcz: Ahin Abraham'in amapa jah'a aseiyin, chapa, geldoh in, nangman nahinlai sungin nadei jouse naneisoh keiyin chule Lazarus in ima ananeipoi. Hijeh a chu tua hi ama hikom mun'a nomtah'a kiumsah a nangman hesoh nathoh ahitai.
en: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.
text:
LUK 16:25
Thadou: Ahin Abraham'in amapa jah'a aseiyin, chapa, geldoh in, nangman nahinlai sungin nadei jouse naneisoh keiyin chule Lazarus in ima ananeipoi. Hijeh a chu tua hi ama hikom mun'a nomtah'a kiumsah a nangman hesoh nathoh ahitai.
English: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.

tcz: Chule chuche tilouvin jong, ikikah uva hin eikhen uvah onghom lentah aume. Koiman hikom mun'a pat'a apal galkai thei lou, chule chua pat'a jong keiho kom lang koiman apal galkal thei lou ahi, ati.
en: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’
text:
LUK 16:26
Thadou: Chule chuche tilouvin jong, ikikah uva hin eikhen uvah onghom lentah aume. Koiman hikom mun'a pat'a apal galkai thei lou, chule chua pat'a jong keiho kom lang koiman apal galkal thei lou ahi, ati.
English: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’

tcz: Chuin mihaopan asei kit in, Lungset tah in, Hepa Abraham, kapa in beh'a gasol in.
en: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—
text:
LUK 16:27
Thadou: Chuin mihaopan asei kit in, Lungset tah in, Hepa Abraham, kapa in beh'a gasol in.
English: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman sopi pasal nga kaneiye, chule amachun hikom thoh gentheina muna ahung lou nadiuva aga gihsal ding kadeiye, ati.
en: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’
text:
LUK 16:28
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman sopi pasal nga kaneiye, chule amachun hikom thoh gentheina muna ahung lou nadiuva aga gihsal ding kadeiye, ati.
English: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’

tcz: “Ahin Abraham'in aseipeh in, ‘Mose le Themgaohon agihsal nauve. Nasopi hon chua ipi asut'u hin kisimdoh nauvinte,’ atipeh e.
en: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’
text:
LUK 16:29
Thadou: “Ahin Abraham'in aseipeh in, ‘Mose le Themgaohon agihsal nauve. Nasopi hon chua ipi asut'u hin kisimdoh nauvinte,’ atipeh e.
English: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’

tcz: Mihaopan adonbut kit'in, ‘Ahipoi, Hepa Abraham! Koiham khat athilah'a kona akisol le, achonset nauva kona lungheina aneidiu chule Pathen lam'a kihei diu ahi,’ ati.
en: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’
text:
LUK 16:30
Thadou: Mihaopan adonbut kit'in, ‘Ahipoi, Hepa Abraham! Koiham khat athilah'a kona akisol le, achonset nauva kona lungheina aneidiu chule Pathen lam'a kihei diu ahi,’ ati.
English: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’

tcz: Ahivangin Abraham'in aseikit in, ‘Amahon Mose le Themgaoho thu angailou uleh, athilah'a konin khat thoudoh jongleh ngaideh pouvinte,’” ati.
en: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”
text:
LUK 16:31
Thadou: Ahivangin Abraham'in aseikit in, ‘Amahon Mose le Themgaoho thu angailou uleh, athilah'a konin khat thoudoh jongleh ngaideh pouvinte,’” ati.
English: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan aseijuite jah'a aseiye, “Chonset na dia lhepna hi aumjing ding mong ahi, hinlah itobang lungkhamnan anga hitam alhem'a pang mi chu!”
en: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!
text:
LUK 17:1
Thadou: Nikhat Yeshuan aseijuite jah'a aseiye, “Chonset na dia lhepna hi aumjing ding mong ahi, hinlah itobang lungkhamnan anga hitam alhem'a pang mi chu!”
English: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

tcz: “Na-ngongchanga sumhei song naki-o a twikhanglen'a nakilelut chu hiche aneocha ho nakipal lhuhsah sanga phachomjo ding ahi.
en: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
text:
LUK 17:2
Thadou: “Na-ngongchanga sumhei song naki-o a twikhanglen'a nakilelut chu hiche aneocha ho nakipal lhuhsah sanga phachomjo ding ahi.
English: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

tcz: Hijeh chun chingtheiyun! Tahsan cha adang khat achonset leh, amachu sosal'in; chutia alung ahei le ngaidam in.
en: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.
text:
LUK 17:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun chingtheiyun! Tahsan cha adang khat achonset leh, amachu sosal'in; chutia alung ahei le ngaidam in.
English: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

tcz: Hiche mipa chun ihamtia nikhat'a sagi vei nachunga thildihlou abol'a, abol phat jousea jong ngaidam athum leh ngaidam in” ati.
en: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”
text:
LUK 17:4
Thadou: Hiche mipa chun ihamtia nikhat'a sagi vei nachunga thildihlou abol'a, abol phat jousea jong ngaidam athum leh ngaidam in” ati.
English: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

tcz: Seijuiten Pakai jah'a aseiyun, “Tahsan na kangaichat be uve, iti kanei diu ham neisei peh un” atiuve.
en: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”
text:
LUK 17:5
Thadou: Seijuiten Pakai jah'a aseiyun, “Tahsan na kangaichat be uve, iti kanei diu ham neisei peh un” atiuve.
English: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”

tcz: Pakai in adonbut in, “Nanghon tahsanna ankammu te cha hijongleh naneiyuleh, hiche thing theimi phung koma hi, ‘Kibotdoh in lang twikhanglen'ah kilehlut in’ tijongleu chun nathu'u angai ding ahi! Sohpa Natoh Ding
en: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.
text:
LUK 17:6
Thadou: Pakai in adonbut in, “Nanghon tahsanna ankammu te cha hijongleh naneiyuleh, hiche thing theimi phung koma hi, ‘Kibotdoh in lang twikhanglen'ah kilehlut in’ tijongleu chun nathu'u angai ding ahi! Sohpa Natoh Ding
English: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.

tcz: Soh khat chu aloukai na ham ahiloule akelngoi chinna ham'a pat'a ahung lut teng, apakai pan, ‘Hunglut in an nekhom hite’ tin tem?
en: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?
text:
LUK 17:7
Thadou: Soh khat chu aloukai na ham ahiloule akelngoi chinna ham'a pat'a ahung lut teng, apakai pan, ‘Hunglut in an nekhom hite’ tin tem?
English: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?

tcz: Tiponte! Hitijoh hin seiyinte, ‘Ka anneh ding nei gonpeh in, natai kigeh in lang, kaneh sungsen neijen in. chuteng ajoujep le nenan nate’ atiding ahi.
en: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?
text:
LUK 17:8
Thadou: Tiponte! Hitijoh hin seiyinte, ‘Ka anneh ding nei gonpeh in, natai kigeh in lang, kaneh sungsen neijen in. chuteng ajoujep le nenan nate’ atiding ahi.
English: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?

tcz: Chuleh apakai pan asohpa chu atoh dinga lom atoh jeh a apachat em? Apahcha deh poi.
en: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.
text:
LUK 17:9
Thadou: Chuleh apakai pan asohpa chu atoh dinga lom atoh jeh a apachat em? Apahcha deh poi.
English: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

tcz: Chutobang a chu nanghon kathua nanun teng uleh hitia hi nasei diu, ‘Keiho soh lhingjoulou kanatoh diuva lom bou tong kahiuve’ nati diu ahi,” ati.
en: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”
text:
LUK 17:10
Thadou: Chutobang a chu nanghon kathua nanun teng uleh hitia hi nasei diu, ‘Keiho soh lhingjoulou kanatoh diuva lom bou tong kahiuve’ nati diu ahi,” ati.
English: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”

tcz: Yeshua Jerusalem lam jon'a achejom jing laiyin, Galilee le Samaria kigamgit na mun alhung tai.
en: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.
text:
LUK 17:11
Thadou: Yeshua Jerusalem lam jon'a achejom jing laiyin, Galilee le Samaria kigamgit na mun alhung tai.
English: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

tcz: Chutia khokhat agalut laiyin, chua chun miphah som gamla thimtah in adingun,
en: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.
text:
LUK 17:12
Thadou: Chutia khokhat agalut laiyin, chua chun miphah som gamla thimtah in adingun,
English: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

tcz: ahung eodoh un, “Yeshua, Pipu, nei khoto un!” atiuve.
en: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”
text:
LUK 17:13
Thadou: ahung eodoh un, “Yeshua, Pipu, nei khoto un!” atiuve.
English: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

tcz: Aman amaho chu aven, “Cheuvin lang thempuho gakimusah tauvin,” atipeh tai. Chutia acheuleh, aphah natnau chu suhtheng in aumtai.
en: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.
text:
LUK 17:14
Thadou: Aman amaho chu aven, “Cheuvin lang thempuho gakimusah tauvin,” atipeh tai. Chutia acheuleh, aphah natnau chu suhtheng in aumtai.
English: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

tcz: Alah uva khat chun suhdam a aumchu akimu phat in, Yeshua hengah ahung kilen, “Pathen Vahchoiyin umhen!” tin apengjah tai.
en: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.
text:
LUK 17:15
Thadou: Alah uva khat chun suhdam a aumchu akimu phat in, Yeshua hengah ahung kilen, “Pathen Vahchoiyin umhen!” tin apengjah tai.
English: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

tcz: Ama Yeshua kengbul'ah abohkhup in, athil bolpeh na chungah kipathu aseiyin ahi. Hiche mipa chu Samaria mi ahi.
en: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.
text:
LUK 17:16
Thadou: Ama Yeshua kengbul'ah abohkhup in, athil bolpeh na chungah kipathu aseiyin ahi. Hiche mipa chu Samaria mi ahi.
English: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

tcz: Yeshuan adongin, “Mi som kasuhdam hilou ham? Adang mi ko ho la?
en: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?
text:
LUK 17:17
Thadou: Yeshuan adongin, “Mi som kasuhdam hilou ham? Adang mi ko ho la?
English: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

tcz: Koiman Pathen loupina peh ding ageldoh lou hitam hiche gamdang mipa tailou?” atin ahi.
en: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”
text:
LUK 17:18
Thadou: Koiman Pathen loupina peh ding ageldoh lou hitam hiche gamdang mipa tailou?” atin ahi.
English: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

tcz: Chule Yeshuan hichepa koma chun aseiyin, “Dingdoh in lang che tan, natahsan in nasuhdam ahitai,” ati. Pathen Lenggam
en: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”
text:
LUK 17:19
Thadou: Chule Yeshuan hichepa koma chun aseiyin, “Dingdoh in lang che tan, natahsan in nasuhdam ahitai,” ati. Pathen Lenggam
English: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

tcz: Nikhat Pharisee hon Yeshua adongun, “Pathen Lenggam itih le hung lhung ding ham?” atiuve. Yeshuan adonbut in, “Pathen Lenggam chu muthei melchihna ah akihedoh thei poi.
en: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

tcz: Nanghon, ‘Hikom'ah aum'e’ ahiloule ‘hichea khun aume’ tin seithei pouvin nate, ajeh chu Pathen Lenggam chu nalah'uva aumtai” ati.
en: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”
text:
LUK 17:21
Thadou: Nanghon, ‘Hikom'ah aum'e’ ahiloule ‘hichea khun aume’ tin seithei pouvin nate, ajeh chu Pathen Lenggam chu nalah'uva aumtai” ati.
English: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

tcz: Chuin aseijuite hengah hitin aseiye, “Phat ahung lhunge Mihem Chapa ahung kile na ding nikho mu nom'a naum diu, ahivanga namu lou diu ahi.”
en: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
text:
LUK 17:22
Thadou: Chuin aseijuite hengah hitin aseiye, “Phat ahung lhunge Mihem Chapa ahung kile na ding nikho mu nom'a naum diu, ahivanga namu lou diu ahi.”
English: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

tcz: Mihon ahinsei diu, “Veuvin Mihem Chapa khukom'ah aume” ahilouleh hivah aume, atidiu ahi, ahivangin potdoh hih un, chule jui hih'un.
en: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,
text:
LUK 17:23
Thadou: Mihon ahinsei diu, “Veuvin Mihem Chapa khukom'ah aume” ahilouleh hivah aume, atidiu ahi, ahivangin potdoh hih un, chule jui hih'un.
English: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

tcz: Ijeh inem itile kolphe ahung phet'a van mong langkhat'a pat mong langkhat gei asalvah soh banga Mihem Chapa hung ni jong chutobang hiding ahi.
en: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.
text:
LUK 17:24
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile kolphe ahung phet'a van mong langkhat'a pat mong langkhat gei asalvah soh banga Mihem Chapa hung ni jong chutobang hiding ahi.
English: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

tcz: Ahin amasa'a Mihem Chapa hin thoh hahsa tampi athoh a hiche khang miten apampai diu ahi.
en: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
text:
LUK 17:25
Thadou: Ahin amasa'a Mihem Chapa hin thoh hahsa tampi athoh a hiche khang miten apampai diu ahi.
English: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

tcz: Mihem Chapa ahung kile teng leh, Noah nikholai toh bang ding ahi.
en: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.
text:
LUK 17:26
Thadou: Mihem Chapa ahung kile teng leh, Noah nikholai toh bang ding ahi.
English: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.

tcz: Chuche nikholai chun mihon golvah neh le don chule kichen abol'un, Noah kongsunga alut'a chule tuisang ahunglet'a abonchauva asuhmang nikho geiyin nomsatah in hinkho amangun ahi.
en: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.
text:
LUK 17:27
Thadou: Chuche nikholai chun mihon golvah neh le don chule kichen abol'un, Noah kongsunga alut'a chule tuisang ahunglet'a abonchauva asuhmang nikho geiyin nomsatah in hinkho amangun ahi.
English: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

tcz: Chule vannoi leiset jong Lot nikho lai toh bang ding ahi. Miho nitin akimanchah nauvah akisaboi un–neh le don, choh le joh, loulho le insah,
en: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

tcz: Lot in Sodom khopi adalhah ni jingkah chan in abol'un ahi. Chuin van'a konin mei le kath ahung julhan abonchauvin asumang soh tan ahi.
en: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.
text:
LUK 17:29
Thadou: Lot in Sodom khopi adalhah ni jingkah chan in abol'un ahi. Chuin van'a konin mei le kath ahung julhan abonchauvin asumang soh tan ahi.
English: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

tcz: Henge, angaima banga kiseimona Mihem Chapa ahung kile kit ni geiya umding ahi.
en: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.
text:
LUK 17:30
Thadou: Henge, angaima banga kiseimona Mihem Chapa ahung kile kit ni geiya umding ahi.
English: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

tcz: Chuche nikho chuleh indan chunga um chun insunga athil kisemtup din lutkit da hen. Mi louva kondoh jong inlam a kile da hen.
en: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.
text:
LUK 17:31
Thadou: Chuche nikho chuleh indan chunga um chun insunga athil kisemtup din lutkit da hen. Mi louva kondoh jong inlam a kile da hen.
English: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

tcz: Lot inneipi chunga ipi anasoh em geldoh un!
en: Remember Lot’s wife!
text:
LUK 17:32
Thadou: Lot inneipi chunga ipi anasoh em geldoh un!
English: Remember Lot’s wife!

tcz: Nahinkho tuhchah jing nagot le namansah ding, chule nahinkho nachesah le, nahuhhing joh ding ahi.
en: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.
text:
LUK 17:33
Thadou: Nahinkho tuhchah jing nagot le namansah ding, chule nahinkho nachesah le, nahuhhing joh ding ahi.
English: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

tcz: Chuche jan leh mini jalkhun khat'a lumkhom ding; khat kila ding, khatpa kidalha ding.
en: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.
text:
LUK 17:34
Thadou: Chuche jan leh mini jalkhun khat'a lumkhom ding; khat kila ding, khatpa kidalha ding.
English: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

tcz: Nupi nin sumhei khat'a chang agoikhom lhon ding, khat kila ding khat kidalha ding,
en: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”
text:
LUK 17:35
Thadou: Nupi nin sumhei khat'a chang agoikhom lhon ding, khat kila ding khat kidalha ding,
English: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

tcz: “Pakai, hitiho hi itih leh soh ding ham?” tin aseijuiten adongun ahi. Yeshuan adonbut in, “Muthong ho kititna achun mithi long naivel ah aume ti aphotchet banga hiche melchihna ho jong chun akichaina anaitai ti avetsah ahi,” ati.
en: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”
text:
LUK 17:37
Thadou: “Pakai, hitiho hi itih leh soh ding ham?” tin aseijuiten adongun ahi. Yeshuan adonbut in, “Muthong ho kititna achun mithi long naivel ah aume ti aphotchet banga hiche melchihna ho jong chun akichaina anaitai ti avetsah ahi,” ati.
English: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan aseijuite ataojing nadiu leh alhahdai lou nadiu vetsahnan thusim khat aseipeh e.
en: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,
text:
LUK 18:1
Thadou: Nikhat Yeshuan aseijuite ataojing nadiu leh alhahdai lou nadiu vetsahnan thusim khat aseipeh e.
English: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,

tcz: “Khopi khat a hin thutan khat Pathen ginglou chule miho khohsah na jong neilou khat aumin ahi.
en: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.
text:
LUK 18:2
Thadou: “Khopi khat a hin thutan khat Pathen ginglou chule miho khohsah na jong neilou khat aumin ahi.
English: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.

tcz: Chuche khopia meithai khat chu kinong chel'in ahung jingin, ‘Kagalmi hotoh kakiboinau hi thu adih in neitan peh'in,’ ahung tijin ahi.
en: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’
text:
LUK 18:3
Thadou: Chuche khopia meithai khat chu kinong chel'in ahung jingin, ‘Kagalmi hotoh kakiboinau hi thu adih in neitan peh'in,’ ahung tijin ahi.
English: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

tcz: Thutan pan phat chomkhat amanu chu isahlou tah in anakoiyin, ahin achainakeiyin hitin akihoulim in, Keiman Pathen kaging pon ahiloule miho jong hole tilou kahi,
en: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,
text:
LUK 18:4
Thadou: Thutan pan phat chomkhat amanu chu isahlou tah in anakoiyin, ahin achainakeiyin hitin akihoulim in, Keiman Pathen kaging pon ahiloule miho jong hole tilou kahi,
English: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,

tcz: ahivangin hiche numei nu hin eisungol lhatai. Keiman thu adih'a tanlhah peh ahinadin vetpeh inge. Ajeh chu amanu hin athilthum jinga kon hin ei sulungvai lhatai,” ati.
en: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”
text:
LUK 18:5
Thadou: ahivangin hiche numei nu hin eisungol lhatai. Keiman thu adih'a tanlhah peh ahinadin vetpeh inge. Ajeh chu amanu hin athilthum jinga kon hin ei sulungvai lhatai,” ati.
English: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hiche chondihlou thutanpa a konin kihil un.”
en: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.
text:
LUK 18:6
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Hiche chondihlou thutanpa a konin kihil un.”
English: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

tcz: “Ama jengin jong achaina a thu adih'a tandia ahin gellhah ahi. Hijeh a chu Pathen in alhenchom te, ama koma asun ajan'a kapjing techu thu adih'a atanpeh ding ahi ti nagel lou u ham? Amaho chu donlouvin koijing in te natim?
en: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?
text:
LUK 18:7
Thadou: “Ama jengin jong achaina a thu adih'a tandia ahin gellhah ahi. Hijeh a chu Pathen in alhenchom te, ama koma asun ajan'a kapjing techu thu adih'a atanpeh ding ahi ti nagel lou u ham? Amaho chu donlouvin koijing in te natim?
English: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

tcz: Kaseipeh nahiuve, aman kinloitah a thu adih'a atanpeh ding ahi! Ahinlah Mihem Chapa hung kit teng, leiset chunga hin mi ijat tahsan nei mudoh intem?” ati.
en: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
text:
LUK 18:8
Thadou: Kaseipeh nahiuve, aman kinloitah a thu adih'a atanpeh ding ahi! Ahinlah Mihem Chapa hung kit teng, leiset chunga hin mi ijat tahsan nei mudoh intem?” ati.
English: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thusim hi mi konkhat ama chonphatna a kisonga midang musit ho dingin aseiye:
en: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:
text:
LUK 18:9
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan hiche thusim hi mi konkhat ama chonphatna a kisonga midang musit ho dingin aseiye:
English: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

tcz: “Mi ni houin ah taona mangin ache lhon'e. Khat chu Pharisee mi ahin, chule adang khatpa chu musit umtah kaidong ahi.
en: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.
text:
LUK 18:10
Thadou: “Mi ni houin ah taona mangin ache lhon'e. Khat chu Pharisee mi ahin, chule adang khatpa chu musit umtah kaidong ahi.
English: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

tcz: Pharisee mipa chu adingin hitin ataove: ‘Kakipah'e Pathen, adangho banga chonse kahilou jeh in. Ajeh chu lepthol in kabol pon, kachonse pon, chule jonthanhoi jong kabolpoi. Keima atahbeh in khuche kaidongpa tobang kahipoi!
en: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
text:
LUK 18:11
Thadou: Pharisee mipa chu adingin hitin ataove: ‘Kakipah'e Pathen, adangho banga chonse kahilou jeh in. Ajeh chu lepthol in kabol pon, kachonse pon, chule jonthanhoi jong kabolpoi. Keima atahbeh in khuche kaidongpa tobang kahipoi!
English: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

tcz: Keiman hapta khat in nivei an kangol'in, kasum mu jat a konin soma khat kapei,’ ati.
en: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’
text:
LUK 18:12
Thadou: Keiman hapta khat in nivei an kangol'in, kasum mu jat a konin soma khat kapei,’ ati.
English: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

tcz: Ahivangin kaidong pachu gamlatah a adingin chule amit jeng'a jong vanlam ve ngamlouvin ataove. Chusang chun lungkham tah in aman a-op achum'in hitin aseiye, ‘O’ Pathen, neilungset in, ijeh inem itile chonse kahibouve, ati.
en: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’
text:
LUK 18:13
Thadou: Ahivangin kaidong pachu gamlatah a adingin chule amit jeng'a jong vanlam ve ngamlouvin ataove. Chusang chun lungkham tah in aman a-op achum'in hitin aseiye, ‘O’ Pathen, neilungset in, ijeh inem itile chonse kahibouve, ati.
English: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

tcz: Kaseipeh nahiuve, Pharisee pa hilou, hiche chonsepa chu Pathen ang-ah them achangin inlam akiletai. Ijeh inem itile ama kichoisang hochu suhnem'a umding, chule akineosah hochu dopsang'a umdiu ahi,” ati.
en: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”
text:
LUK 18:14
Thadou: Kaseipeh nahiuve, Pharisee pa hilou, hiche chonsepa chu Pathen ang-ah them achangin inlam akiletai. Ijeh inem itile ama kichoisang hochu suhnem'a umding, chule akineosah hochu dopsang'a umdiu ahi,” ati.
English: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

tcz: Nikhat nule pa phabep in achateu chapang neocha chaho chu Yeshuan atham'a phatthei aboh dingin ahin puiyun ahi. Ahivangin aseijuiten hichu amuphat un, anule apateu koma chun ama nasuboi bep uve tin ahouse uvin ahi.
en: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
text:
LUK 18:15
Thadou: Nikhat nule pa phabep in achateu chapang neocha chaho chu Yeshuan atham'a phatthei aboh dingin ahin puiyun ahi. Ahivangin aseijuiten hichu amuphat un, anule apateu koma chun ama nasuboi bep uve tin ahouse uvin ahi.
English: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan chapang ho chu akouvin chule aseijuite hengah aseitai, “Chapang ho chu kahengah hung uhen. Jahda hih'un! Ajeh chu Pathen Lenggam chu hiche chapang neocha tobanghoa ding bou ahi.
en: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
text:
LUK 18:16
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan chapang ho chu akouvin chule aseijuite hengah aseitai, “Chapang ho chu kahengah hung uhen. Jahda hih'un! Ajeh chu Pathen Lenggam chu hiche chapang neocha tobanghoa ding bou ahi.
English: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

tcz: Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh chapang neocha banga Pathen Lenggam sanglou chu lutlou hel ding ahi,” ati.
en: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
text:
LUK 18:17
Thadou: Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh chapang neocha banga Pathen Lenggam sanglou chu lutlou hel ding ahi,” ati.
English: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

tcz: Khatvei hou lamkai khat hin hiche thudoh hi adonge: “Houhil pha, tonsot hinna kanei thei na dinga ipi kabol ding ham?” ati.
en: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
text:
LUK 18:18
Thadou: Khatvei hou lamkai khat hin hiche thudoh hi adonge: “Houhil pha, tonsot hinna kanei thei na dinga ipi kabol ding ham?” ati.
English: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

tcz: “Ipi bol'a apha tia nei kou ham” tin aledoh in, Pathen bouseh dihtah'a pha ahi.
en: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.
text:
LUK 18:19
Thadou: “Ipi bol'a apha tia nei kou ham” tin aledoh in, Pathen bouseh dihtah'a pha ahi.
English: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

tcz: Ahin nathudoh donbut nan, thupeh ho nahet chula: “Nangman jon bol hih'in, tolthat hih'in, gucha hih'in, jouvin mi hehse hih in, nanu napa jabol in,” ati.
en: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”
text:
LUK 18:20
Thadou: Ahin nathudoh donbut nan, thupeh ho nahet chula: “Nangman jon bol hih'in, tolthat hih'in, gucha hih'in, jouvin mi hehse hih in, nanu napa jabol in,” ati.
English: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”

tcz: Mipan adonbut in, “Hiche thupeh ho jouse hi kachapan laiya pat kajui sohkei ahitai,” ati.
en: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”
text:
LUK 18:21
Thadou: Mipan adonbut in, “Hiche thupeh ho jouse hi kachapan laiya pat kajui sohkei ahitai,” ati.
English: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbutna thu ajah phat chun, hitin aseitai, “Nabol loulai thilkhat aume. Nanei jouse joh in lang hiche sum chu mivaicha ho pen, chutileh van'a gou nanei ding ahi. Chuteng hungin, neijuiyin,” ati.
en: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”
text:
LUK 18:22
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbutna thu ajah phat chun, hitin aseitai, “Nabol loulai thilkhat aume. Nanei jouse joh in lang hiche sum chu mivaicha ho pen, chutileh van'a gou nanei ding ahi. Chuteng hungin, neijuiyin,” ati.
English: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

tcz: Ahivangin mipa chun hichu ajahdoh phat in alung kham lheh tan ahi, ijeh inem itile amachu haosatah ahi.
en: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.
text:
LUK 18:23
Thadou: Ahivangin mipa chun hichu ajahdoh phat in alung kham lheh tan ahi, ijeh inem itile amachu haosatah ahi.
English: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

tcz: Yeshuan hichu amuphat in, aseitai, “Mihaosa Pathen Lenggam alut ding hi iti hah hitam!”
en: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!
text:
LUK 18:24
Thadou: Yeshuan hichu amuphat in, aseitai, “Mihaosa Pathen Lenggam alut ding hi iti hah hitam!”
English: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

tcz: “Atahbeh in, heobil hom'a sangongsao alut galkai ding hi mihaosa Pathen Lenggam a alut ding sangin abaijoi,” ati.
en: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
text:
LUK 18:25
Thadou: “Atahbeh in, heobil hom'a sangongsao alut galkai ding hi mihaosa Pathen Lenggam a alut ding sangin abaijoi,” ati.
English: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

tcz: Hiche akisei jajouse chun aseiyun, “Achutileh vannoi leiset'a koiham huhhing na chang jou ding?” atiuve.
en: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”
text:
LUK 18:26
Thadou: Hiche akisei jajouse chun aseiyun, “Achutileh vannoi leiset'a koiham huhhing na chang jou ding?” atiuve.
English: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

tcz: Aman adonbut in, “Mihem dinga hithei lou chu Pathen dinga hithei ahi,” ati.
en: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”
text:
LUK 18:27
Thadou: Aman adonbut in, “Mihem dinga hithei lou chu Pathen dinga hithei ahi,” ati.
English: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

tcz: Peter in aseiyin, “Keihon nangma jui dingin ka-in'u kadalhauve,” ati.
en: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”
text:
LUK 18:28
Thadou: Peter in aseiyin, “Keihon nangma jui dingin ka-in'u kadalhauve,” ati.
English: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Henge” chuleh ka lhamon nahiuve, “Koihileh Pathen Lenggam jal'a a'in ham, ajinu ham, asopiho ham, ahiloule anu apa ham achate ham pedoh chan chu,
en: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,
text:
LUK 18:29
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Henge” chuleh ka lhamon nahiuve, “Koihileh Pathen Lenggam jal'a a'in ham, ajinu ham, asopiho ham, ahiloule anu apa ham achate ham pedoh chan chu,
English: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

tcz: tamtahvei tuhinkhoa hi lepeh'a umdiu chule ahunglhung ding khang'a jong tonsot hinkemlou amuding'u ahi,” ati.
en: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”
text:
LUK 18:30
Thadou: tamtahvei tuhinkhoa hi lepeh'a umdiu chule ahunglhung ding khang'a jong tonsot hinkemlou amuding'u ahi,” ati.
English: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

tcz: Seijui somleni ho atumbeh'in apuidoh in, Yeshuan ajah uva aseiye, “Ngaiyun, eiho Jerusalem chetou ding ihiuve, Mihem Chapa chungchang thudol'a themgao thusei jouse guilhun na ding mun chu ahi.
en: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.
text:
LUK 18:31
Thadou: Seijui somleni ho atumbeh'in apuidoh in, Yeshuan ajah uva aseiye, “Ngaiyun, eiho Jerusalem chetou ding ihiuve, Mihem Chapa chungchang thudol'a themgao thusei jouse guilhun na ding mun chu ahi.
English: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

tcz: Amachu Rome te khut'a pehdoh'a umding ahi, chule amachu tot thanghoi'a umding, jachat umtah'a kibol ding, chil kisetkhum ding ahi.
en: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.
text:
LUK 18:32
Thadou: Amachu Rome te khut'a pehdoh'a umding ahi, chule amachu tot thanghoi'a umding, jachat umtah'a kibol ding, chil kisetkhum ding ahi.
English: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

tcz: Amahon avoh'uva chule athadiu ahi, ahivanga anithum nileh thoukit ding ahi,” ati.
en: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”
text:
LUK 18:33
Thadou: Amahon avoh'uva chule athadiu ahi, ahivanga anithum nileh thoukit ding ahi,” ati.
English: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

tcz: Ahin, amahon hitiho thuhi khatcha ahethei pouve. Athusei ho athupije chu amaho a kona ki im mang ahi, hijeh a chu athusei chu amattoh thei lou u ahitai.
en: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.
text:
LUK 18:34
Thadou: Ahin, amahon hitiho thuhi khatcha ahethei pouve. Athusei ho athupije chu amaho a kona ki im mang ahi, hijeh a chu athusei chu amattoh thei lou u ahitai.
English: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

tcz: Yeshuan Jericho anaisuh lai hin, mitcho khutdo khat lamsih'ah ana touve.
en: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.
text:
LUK 18:35
Thadou: Yeshuan Jericho anaisuh lai hin, mitcho khutdo khat lamsih'ah ana touve.
English: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

tcz: Aman mihonpi kijot khuto gin ajah phat in, ipi thu hitam ti adongin ahi.
en: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.
text:
LUK 18:36
Thadou: Aman mihonpi kijot khuto gin ajah phat in, ipi thu hitam ti adongin ahi.
English: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

tcz: Nazereth Yeshuan hikom chu ahopa ahi ti aseipeh tauve.
en: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
text:
LUK 18:37
Thadou: Nazereth Yeshuan hikom chu ahopa ahi ti aseipeh tauve.
English: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

tcz: Hijeh chun amapa ahung eojah tan, “Yeshua, David chapa, neilungset in!” ahintin ahi.
en: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
text:
LUK 18:38
Thadou: Hijeh chun amapa ahung eojah tan, “Yeshua, David chapa, neilungset in!” ahintin ahi.
English: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

tcz: “Thip'in” tin masang langa miho chun ahutot tauvin ahi. Ahivangin ama awgingjep in ahapen cheh tan, “David Chapa, neilungset in!” ati.
en: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
text:
LUK 18:39
Thadou: “Thip'in” tin masang langa miho chun ahutot tauvin ahi. Ahivangin ama awgingjep in ahapen cheh tan, “David Chapa, neilungset in!” ati.
English: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

tcz: Yeshuan ajahdoh phat in, adingin mipa chu ahinpui lut diuvin athupeh tai. Mipa ahung nai toh lhonin Yeshuan adongin,
en: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,
text:
LUK 18:40
Thadou: Yeshuan ajahdoh phat in, adingin mipa chu ahinpui lut diuvin athupeh tai. Mipa ahung nai toh lhonin Yeshuan adongin,
English: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

tcz: “Ipi nabolpeh leng natim?” tin adong tai. Aman, “Pakai, kho muleng kati!” ati.
en: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”
text:
LUK 18:41
Thadou: “Ipi nabolpeh leng natim?” tin adong tai. Aman, “Pakai, kho muleng kati!” ati.
English: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Aphai, kho mutan! Natahsan in nadamsah ahitai,” ati.
en: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”
text:
LUK 18:42
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Aphai, kho mutan! Natahsan in nadamsah ahitai,” ati.
English: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”

tcz: Apettah chun mipa chun kho amutai chuleh amapan Yeshua nung ajuiyin Pathen avahchoi tai. Chuleh amujousen jong Pathen avahchoi cheh tauve.
en: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.
text:
LUK 18:43
Thadou: Apettah chun mipa chun kho amutai chuleh amapan Yeshua nung ajuiyin Pathen avahchoi tai. Chuleh amujousen jong Pathen avahchoi cheh tauve.
English: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

tcz: Yeshua Jericho alut'in, chule akhopi sung chu ajot in ahi.
en: He entered and was passing through Jericho.
text:
LUK 19:1
Thadou: Yeshua Jericho alut'in, chule akhopi sung chu ajot in ahi.
English: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

tcz: Mi khat amin Zacchaeus kiti chua chun aume. Ama chu hiche lhang'a dinga kaidong pipu ahin, ahaova haosa ahitai.
en: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.
text:
LUK 19:2
Thadou: Mi khat amin Zacchaeus kiti chua chun aume. Ama chu hiche lhang'a dinga kaidong pipu ahin, ahaova haosa ahitai.
English: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

tcz: Aman Yeshua chu mutei ding agon, hinlah ama anem behseh jeh chun mihonpi lah'a chun amutheipoi.
en: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.

LUK 19:4

tcz: Yeshua ahung phat chun, Zacchaeus chu avetouvin chule amin in akouvin, “Zacchaeus! gang'in, hungkum'in! tunia na in'a maljin kahi ding ahi,” ahinti.

LUK 19:5

English: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

tcz: Zacchaeus jong kinloitah in ahung kumlhan, Yeshua chu a'in ah kipah le thanom tah'in apuilut tai.

LUK 19:6

tcz: Chuphat chun, Zacchaeus jong Pakai angsungah adingdoh in aseitai, “Pakai, kanei kagou akehkhat mivaicha ho peing'e, chule kai kadon na'a miho lepthol'a kabol aumleh, amaho chu ajatlin nungpeh inge!” ati.
en: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”

LUK 19:8

LUK 19:9

text:
LUK 19:47
Thadou: Chujou chun, aman niseh leh houin ah thu ahiljin, ahin thempuho, hou danthu hil ho chule adang mipi lamkai hon ama chu iti tha ding ham ti thilgon akisem pat un ahi.
English: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

tcz: Ahivangin ima dang ageldoh chom pouve, ajeh chu mijousen athuhil apomchah jeh chun.
en: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
text:
LUK 19:48
Thadou: Ahivangin ima dang ageldoh chom pouve, ajeh chu mijousen athuhil apomchah jeh chun.
English: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

tcz: Nikhat Yeshuan mipi thu ahil'a Kipana Thupha houin'a aseiphong laiyin, thempu pipui ho, hou danthu hil ho, chule upa ho cheng ahengah ahungun.
en: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.
text:
LUK 20:1
Thadou: Nikhat Yeshuan mipi thu ahil'a Kipana Thupha houin'a aseiphong laiyin, thempu pipui ho, hou danthu hil ho, chule upa ho cheng ahengah ahungun.
English: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

tcz: “Ipi thuneina noiya nangman hiche hohi nabol ham? Kon thaneina napeh ham?” tin ahung dong uve.
en: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”
text:
LUK 20:2
Thadou: “Ipi thuneina noiya nangman hiche hohi nabol ham? Kon thaneina napeh ham?” tin ahung dong uve.
English: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

tcz: “Ken thudoh khat nanei masauvinge” tin adonbut in,
en: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:
text:
LUK 20:3
Thadou: “Ken thudoh khat nanei masauvinge” tin adonbut in,
English: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

tcz: “Twilutsah John thaneina chu van'a kon ham ahilouleh mihem a kon ham?” tin adongtai.
en: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”
text:
LUK 20:4
Thadou: “Twilutsah John thaneina chu van'a kon ham ahilouleh mihem a kon ham?” tin adongtai.
English: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”

tcz: Amaho akihouvun, “Van'a kon ahi tileu hen, ibol'a John natahsan lou u ham eiti kit diu.
en: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’
text:
LUK 20:5
Thadou: Amaho akihouvun, “Van'a kon ahi tileu hen, ibol'a John natahsan lou u ham eiti kit diu.
English: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

tcz: Ahin iham tin mihem a kon ahi tileu hen, mipin songa eise kit diu, ajehchu John chu themgao ahi tia apom'u ahi” akitiuvin ahi.
en: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”
text:
LUK 20:6
Thadou: Ahin iham tin mihem a kon ahi tileu hen, mipin songa eise kit diu, ajehchu John chu themgao ahi tia apom'u ahi” akitiuvin ahi.
English: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

tcz: Hijeh chun achainakeiyin kahepouve tin ahin donbut tauve.
en: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.
text:
LUK 20:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun achainakeiyin kahepouve tin ahin donbut tauve.
English: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Achutileh kenjong ipi thuneina noiya kabol ham ti naseipeh pouvinge,” ati. Lengpi-Lei Le Alei Lhouho Thulem
en: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
text:
LUK 20:8
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Achutileh kenjong ipi thuneina noiya kabol ham ti naseipeh pouvinge,” ati. Lengpi-Lei Le Alei Lhouho Thulem
English: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

tcz: Tun Yeshuan mipi lam angakit in hiche thusim hi aseipeh e: Mikhat hin lengpilei abol in, aloulhou miho komah apedoh in, gamdang khat ah kumsottah tham dingin achetai.
en: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.
text:
LUK 20:9
Thadou: Tun Yeshuan mipi lam angakit in hiche thusim hi aseipeh e: Mikhat hin lengpilei abol in, aloulhou miho komah apedoh in, gamdang khat ah kumsottah tham dingin achetai.
English: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

tcz: Lengpi ga khoptup phat alhin in, asohte khat ama chanding lan asol'e. Ahin loulhou ho chun sohpa chu ahin bolseuvin, avouvin, khutgoh keovin ahin lesol tauve.
en: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.
text:
LUK 20:10
Thadou: Lengpi ga khoptup phat alhin in, asohte khat ama chanding lan asol'e. Ahin loulhou ho chun sohpa chu ahin bolseuvin, avouvin, khutgoh keovin ahin lesol tauve.
English: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

tcz: Hijeh chun lou neipan soh dang khat asol kit in, ahivangin amahon ahinsujum kit un, avouvin, khutgoh keovin ahin lesol kit tauve.
en: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
text:
LUK 20:11
Thadou: Hijeh chun lou neipan soh dang khat asol kit in, ahivangin amahon ahinsujum kit un, avouvin, khutgoh keovin ahin lesol kit tauve.
English: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

tcz: Athumna pa asolkit in, chule ama jong chu ahin mavouvin adelmang tauve.
en: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.
text:
LUK 20:12
Thadou: Athumna pa asolkit in, chule ama jong chu ahin mavouvin adelmang tauve.
English: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

tcz: “Ipi kabol ding hitam?” tin louneipa akihoulim in ahi. “Kahetai! Keiman kachapa kasahlut tah hi sol'inge. Tahbeh in jana hinpe nauvinte” ati.
en: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’
text:
LUK 20:13
Thadou: “Ipi kabol ding hitam?” tin louneipa akihoulim in ahi. “Kahetai! Keiman kachapa kasahlut tah hi sol'inge. Tahbeh in jana hinpe nauvinte” ati.
English: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

tcz: Ahinlah, aloulhou hon achapa amu phat un, amaho akihou som'un, “Agoulo ding pa ahunge, thatdoh utin agoulo ding hi eiho chang tauhite!” akitiuve.
en: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’
text:
LUK 20:14
Thadou: Ahinlah, aloulhou hon achapa amu phat un, amaho akihou som'un, “Agoulo ding pa ahunge, thatdoh utin agoulo ding hi eiho chang tauhite!” akitiuve.
English: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

tcz: Hijeh chun ama chu lengpilei pam langah akaidoh un athat tauve. “Lengpilei neipa chun amaho chungah ipi bol'in te tia nangaitouvam?” tin Yeshuan ahin dongin,
en: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?
text:
LUK 20:15
Thadou: Hijeh chun ama chu lengpilei pam langah akaidoh un athat tauve. “Lengpilei neipa chun amaho chungah ipi bol'in te tia nangaitouvam?” tin Yeshuan ahin dongin,
English: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

tcz: “Naseipeh unge–ama hungin tin loulhou ho chu athadoh a lengpilei chu midang asan sah ding ahitai” ati. “Iti khoh hitam chutobang thil aso jeng ding chu,” atiuvin athusei jaho chun ahin donbut uve.
en: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”
text:
LUK 20:16
Thadou: “Naseipeh unge–ama hungin tin loulhou ho chu athadoh a lengpilei chu midang asan sah ding ahitai” ati. “Iti khoh hitam chutobang thil aso jeng ding chu,” atiuvin athusei jaho chun ahin donbut uve.
English: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”

tcz: Yeshuan amaho chu aven aseitai, “Achutileh, Pathen Lekhabun ipi ati naham? Insa hon apaidoh u song chu Inning songpin apangtai,”
en: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?
text:
LUK 20:17
Thadou: Yeshuan amaho chu aven aseitai, “Achutileh, Pathen Lekhabun ipi ati naham? Insa hon apaidoh u song chu Inning songpin apangtai,”
English: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?

tcz: “Hiche songpia kipal jouse chu ahal hal'a keh ding, chule achunga lhu chu ipi hijong leh chip ding ahi” ati.
en: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”
text:
LUK 20:18
Thadou: “Hiche songpia kipal jouse chu ahal hal'a keh ding, chule achunga lhu chu ipi hijong leh chip ding ahi” ati.
English: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

tcz: Hou danthuhil ho le thempu pipuihon Yeshua chu kintah a matding adeilheh un ahi ajeh chu athusim seichu amaho kiseina ahi ahin kihetdoh u ahitai–amaho chu loulhou agilou hochu hiuvah ahi. Ahivangin mipi ho lethuh na chu akichauvin ahi.
en: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.
text:
LUK 20:19
Thadou: Hou danthuhil ho le thempu pipuihon Yeshua chu kintah a matding adeilheh un ahi ajeh chu athusim seichu amaho kiseina ahi ahin kihetdoh u ahitai–amaho chu loulhou agilou hochu hiuvah ahi. Ahivangin mipi ho lethuh na chu akichauvin ahi.
English: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

tcz: Phat kilemchang vepum'in, alamkai houvin avelhi le ding miphalhem asol uve. Yeshuan seikhel khat neihen Rome gamvaipo komah amat nadingin kipedoh le ti agon u ahi.
en: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.
text:
LUK 20:20
Thadou: Phat kilemchang vepum'in, alamkai houvin avelhi le ding miphalhem asol uve. Yeshuan seikhel khat neihen Rome gamvaipo komah amat nadingin kipedoh le ti agon u ahi.
English: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

tcz: Amahon “Houhil, Nangman adih chu nahil'a nasei ahi chule midang lunggel in nasuhboi joulou ahi keihon kaheuve.”
en: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.
text:
LUK 20:21
Thadou: Amahon “Houhil, Nangman adih chu nahil'a nasei ahi chule midang lunggel in nasuhboi joulou ahi keihon kaheuve.”
English: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

tcz: “Tun neiseipeh un–Caesar henga kai pehding hi dih hai dihlou ham?” tin adong tauve.
en: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
text:
LUK 20:22
Thadou: “Tun neiseipeh un–Caesar henga kai pehding hi dih hai dihlou ham?” tin adong tauve.
English: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

tcz: Aman alungthim bol'u ahichu ahen aseitai,
en: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?
text:
LUK 20:23
Thadou: Aman alungthim bol'u ahichu ahen aseitai,
English: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?

tcz: “Rome te sumpum khat neivetsah'un. Koi lim le thucheng kijih ham achunga chu?” tin adongtai. Amahon adonbut un, “Caesar a ahi,” atiuve.
en: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”
text:
LUK 20:24
Thadou: “Rome te sumpum khat neivetsah'un. Koi lim le thucheng kijih ham achunga chu?” tin adongtai. Amahon adonbut un, “Caesar a ahi,” atiuve.
English: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

tcz: Aman asei kit in, “Aphai ahileh, Caesar a chu Caesar peuvin lang Pathen a chu Pathen peuvin,” ati.
en: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
text:
LUK 20:25
Thadou: Aman asei kit in, “Aphai ahileh, Caesar a chu Caesar peuvin lang Pathen a chu Pathen peuvin,” ati.
English: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

tcz: Chuti chun amahon mipi masanga athu seikhel'a kipal sah ding atiu chu ajou tapouve. Chusang chun, amahon athu donbut hochu kidang asauvin, athipchet tauve.
en: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.
text:
LUK 20:26
Thadou: Chuti chun amahon mipi masanga athu seikhel'a kipal sah ding atiu chu ajou tapouve. Chusang chun, amahon athu donbut hochu kidang asauvin, athipchet tauve.
English: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua chu Sadducee–hou lamkai, thokitna aumpoi tihon kimupi din ahin naiyun ahi.
en: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.
text:
LUK 20:27
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua chu Sadducee–hou lamkai, thokitna aumpoi tihon kimupi din ahin naiyun ahi.
English: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.
