tcz: Hiche thudoh hi adongun ahi: “Houhil, Mosen dan khat eipeuvin, mikhat chu athia ajinu adalhah'a chaneilou ahileh, asopipan hiche meithai chu akichenpi ding, cha aneipi ding hichun asopipa min apoh ding ahi.
en: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.
text:
LUK 20:28
Thadou: Hiche thudoh hi adongun ahi: “Houhil, Mosen dan khat eipeuvin, mikhat chu athia ajinu adalhah'a chaneilou ahileh, asopipan hiche meithai chu akichenpi ding, cha aneipi ding hichun asopipa min apoh ding ahi.
English: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.

tcz: Aphai, tun tekahnan ucha pasal sagi aume. A'upen ajineiyin cha neilouvin athitai.
en: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.
text:
LUK 20:29
Thadou: Aphai, tun tekahnan ucha pasal sagi aume. A'upen ajineiyin cha neilouvin athitai.
English: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

tcz: Hijeh chun ani napan akichenpin, ama jong athitai.
en: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.
text:
LUK 20:30
Thadou: Hijeh chun ani napan akichenpin, ama jong athitai.
English: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

tcz: Chuin athumna pan akichenpi kit in ahi. Hiti hin asagiuvin achelhan abon'uva chaneilou ahitauve.
en: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.
text:
LUK 20:31
Thadou: Chuin athumna pan akichenpi kit in ahi. Hiti hin asagiuvin achelhan abon'uva chaneilou ahitauve.
English: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

tcz: Achainan numeinu jong athi tai.
en: Afterward the woman also died.
text:
LUK 20:32
Thadou: Achainan numeinu jong athi tai.
English: Afterward the woman also died.

tcz: Hijeh chun neiseipeh un, thokitna'a chu koi ji a pang ding ham? Ajeh chu asagiuva chu akichenpi cheh u anahi!”
en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”
text:
LUK 20:33
Thadou: Hijeh chun neiseipeh un, thokitna'a chu koi ji a pang ding ham? Ajeh chu asagiuva chu akichenpi cheh u anahi!”
English: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kichen hi hiche leiset chunga cheng miho ding bou ahi.”
en: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.
text:
LUK 20:34
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kichen hi hiche leiset chunga cheng miho ding bou ahi.”
English: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

tcz: Ahin, ahung lhung ding khang'ah, athilah a kona thoudoh dinga lom ho chu akicheng tapouvin chule chen jong akichensah tapouve.
en: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.
text:
LUK 20:35
Thadou: Ahin, ahung lhung ding khang'ah, athilah a kona thoudoh dinga lom ho chu akicheng tapouvin chule chen jong akichensah tapouve.
English: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

tcz: Chule amaho thikit talou diu, hitia chu amaho van'a Vantilte tobang hidiu ahitai. Amaho Pathen chate ahitauvin chule thoukit chate ahitauve.
en: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.
text:
LUK 20:36
Thadou: Chule amaho thikit talou diu, hitia chu amaho van'a Vantilte tobang hidiu ahitai. Amaho Pathen chate ahitauvin chule thoukit chate ahitauve.
English: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

tcz: “Ahin tun, mithi thoukit mong ding hinam ti thudol ah”—Mose jengin jong nanglah meikong thudol asut chun avetsah in ahi. Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob thijou phat sottah jou nungin, Pakai chu Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, Jacob Pathen tia akou ahi.
en: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
text:
LUK 20:37
Thadou: “Ahin tun, mithi thoukit mong ding hinam ti thudol ah”—Mose jengin jong nanglah meikong thudol asut chun avetsah in ahi. Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob thijou phat sottah jou nungin, Pakai chu Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, Jacob Pathen tia akou ahi.
English: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

tcz: “Hijeh a chu ama chu ahingho Pathen ahin, athiho a hilou ahi, ajeh chu amaho abonchauva ama'a hingah ahitauve.”
en: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”
text:
LUK 20:38
Thadou: “Hijeh a chu ama chu ahingho Pathen ahin, athiho a hilou ahi, ajeh chu amaho abonchauva ama'a hingah ahitauve.”
English: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

tcz: Chukom mun'a ding, hou danthu hil ho phabep khat chun, “Nasei hoiye, houhil” atiuve.
en: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”
text:
LUK 20:39
Thadou: Chukom mun'a ding, hou danthu hil ho phabep khat chun, “Nasei hoiye, houhil” atiuve.
English: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

tcz: Chule koiman thudoh adong ngam tapouvin ahi.
en: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.
text:
LUK 20:40
Thadou: Chule koiman thudoh adong ngam tapouvin ahi.
English: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan thudoh toh thon hiche hi aseipeh kit e, “Ipi jeh a Messiah chu David chapa kiti ding ham?”
en: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?
text:
LUK 20:41
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan thudoh toh thon hiche hi aseipeh kit e, “Ipi jeh a Messiah chu David chapa kiti ding ham?”
English: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

tcz: Ajeh chu David amatah in jong Labu'a anajihlut ahi: “Pakai in ka Pakai jah'a, Kajet lam'a kijana mun'ah touvin,”
en: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,
text:
LUK 20:42
Thadou: Ajeh chu David amatah in jong Labu'a anajihlut ahi: “Pakai in ka Pakai jah'a, Kajet lam'a kijana mun'ah touvin,”
English: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

tcz: Namelmate kasuh nem a, Nakengto chotpha'a kakoi masang sen, ati.
en: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
text:
LUK 20:43
Thadou: Namelmate kasuh nem a, Nakengto chotpha'a kakoi masang sen, ati.
English: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

tcz: “David in Messiah chu Pakai, tia akou leh, Messiah chu iti David chapa hithei ding ham?” ati.
en: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”
text:
LUK 20:44
Thadou: “David in Messiah chu Pakai, tia akou leh, Messiah chu iti David chapa hithei ding ham?” ati.
English: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

tcz: Chuin mihonpi jah dingin, aseijuite kom langah akiheiyin aseitai,
en: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,
text:
LUK 20:45
Thadou: Chuin mihonpi jah dingin, aseijuite kom langah akiheiyin aseitai,
English: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

tcz: “Hiche hou danthu hil hoa kon hin kichih theiyun! Ajeh chu amahon vonhoi tahtah kivon a kailhang lah dunga min chibai aboh diu adeiyun, chule kikhopna in le golvah na mun ho ah touna mun thupi lai lai aholjiuve.
en: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

tcz: Ahin, amahon jahcha louhel in meithai ho anei agou uva kona lheplhah ding agel uvin, chule kilhagao misah tah bangin taona sottah tah japi lah'a amang jiuvin ahi; hiche jeh'a hi amaho hatah a bolgimna changding ahiuve,” ati. Meithainu Sumto
en: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”
text:
LUK 20:47
Thadou: Ahin, amahon jahcha louhel in meithai ho anei agou uva kona lheplhah ding agel uvin, chule kilhagao misah tah bangin taona sottah tah japi lah'a amang jiuvin ahi; hiche jeh'a hi amaho hatah a bolgimna changding ahiuve,” ati. Meithainu Sumto
English: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

tcz: Yeshua houin aumlaiyin, mihao hon sumdolna bom'a athilpeh houchu aven ahi.
en: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.
text:
LUK 21:1
Thadou: Yeshua houin aumlaiyin, mihao hon sumdolna bom'a athilpeh houchu aven ahi.
English: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

tcz: Chuin meithai mivaicha khat jong ahungin sumsan pehni alehlut in ahi.
en: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.
text:
LUK 21:2
Thadou: Chuin meithai mivaicha khat jong ahungin sumsan pehni alehlut in ahi.
English: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.

tcz: Yeshuan aseitai, “Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche mivaicha meithainu hin adang jouse sangin atam to joi.
en: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,
text:
LUK 21:3
Thadou: Yeshuan aseitai, “Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche mivaicha meithainu hin adang jouse sangin atam to joi.
English: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon aneival hou lah'a themkhat bou atou ahin, amavang amanu hin, avaichat totoh'a, anei chasun apeh ahitai,” ati.
en: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”
text:
LUK 21:4
Thadou: Ajeh chu amahon aneival hou lah'a themkhat bou atou ahin, amavang amanu hin, avaichat totoh'a, anei chasun apeh ahitai,” ati.
English: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”

tcz: Aseijuite lah'a phabep khat chun Hou'in kisah na'a song kikheng ho chule bang'a melchihna kijempah ho chu anatsat dan aseipan tauvin ahi. Ahivangin Yeshuan aseitai,
en: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,
text:
LUK 21:5
Thadou: Aseijuite lah'a phabep khat chun Hou'in kisah na'a song kikheng ho chule bang'a melchihna kijempah ho chu anatsat dan aseipan tauvin ahi. Ahivangin Yeshuan aseitai,
English: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

tcz: “Phat ahunglhung e, hiti ho jouse hi aboncha kisuchim ding ahi. Song khatcha khat chunga kisethom namu lou diu ahi,” ati.
en: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”
text:
LUK 21:6
Thadou: “Phat ahunglhung e, hiti ho jouse hi aboncha kisuchim ding ahi. Song khatcha khat chunga kisethom namu lou diu ahi,” ati.
English: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”

tcz: Amahon adongun, “Houhil, hitiho hi itih le soh ding ham? Melchihna itobang in hitiho chu sohding ahitai ti eivetsah diu ham?” atiuve.
en: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”
text:
LUK 21:7
Thadou: Amahon adongun, “Houhil, hitiho hi itih le soh ding ham? Melchihna itobang in hitiho chu sohding ahitai ti eivetsah diu ham?” atiuve.
English: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

tcz: Aman adonbut in, “Koima kilheplhah sah hih un, ajeh chu mi tamtah kamin'a hung ding, ‘Keima Messiah kahi’ tia aseidiu ‘Phat ahung lhung tai!’ ahin tidiu ahi. Ahivangin tahsan hih un.
en: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.
text:
LUK 21:8
Thadou: Aman adonbut in, “Koima kilheplhah sah hih un, ajeh chu mi tamtah kamin'a hung ding, ‘Keima Messiah kahi’ tia aseidiu ‘Phat ahung lhung tai!’ ahin tidiu ahi. Ahivangin tahsan hih un.
English: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.

tcz: Chuleh gal kisat le thunoh najah teng uleh tijahih'un. Ahinai, hiti hohi soh masa ding ahi, ahin achaina chu hijeng loulai ding ahi,” ati.
en: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”
text:
LUK 21:9
Thadou: Chuleh gal kisat le thunoh najah teng uleh tijahih'un. Ahinai, hiti hohi soh masa ding ahi, ahin achaina chu hijeng loulai ding ahi,” ati.
English: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”

tcz: Chuin aman aseiben, “Namkhat chu namkhat toh gal kisat a konding, chule lenggam khat jong lenggam dang khattoh kidou ding ahi.
en: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
text:
LUK 21:10
Thadou: Chuin aman aseiben, “Namkhat chu namkhat toh gal kisat a konding, chule lenggam khat jong lenggam dang khattoh kidou ding ahi.
English: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

tcz: Lingpi nasatah tah kihot ding, kel lhading, chule mun tin'a gamna hise lang ding, tijat um tahtah thilsoh chule van'a melchihna kidang tahtah namu diu ahi.
en: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.
text:
LUK 21:11
Thadou: Lingpi nasatah tah kihot ding, kel lhading, chule mun tin'a gamna hise lang ding, tijat um tahtah thilsoh chule van'a melchihna kidang tahtah namu diu ahi.
English: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

tcz: Ahivanga hiche ho ahung so masanga, suhgenthei na phat nasatah umding ahi. Nangho kikhopna in tinle songkul hoa nakikai diu, chule kanungjui nahijeh uva lengho le gamvaipo ho thutanna angsunga nadin diu ahi.
en: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.
text:
LUK 21:12
Thadou: Ahivanga hiche ho ahung so masanga, suhgenthei na phat nasatah umding ahi. Nangho kikhopna in tinle songkul hoa nakikai diu, chule kanungjui nahijeh uva lengho le gamvaipo ho thutanna angsunga nadin diu ahi.
English: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

tcz: Ahivanga hiche hi nangho dinga keima neiseiphong nadiu phat kilemchang chu hiding ahi.
en: It will turn out as a testimony for you.
text:
LUK 21:13
Thadou: Ahivanga hiche hi nangho dinga keima neiseiphong nadiu phat kilemchang chu hiding ahi.
English: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

tcz: Hijeh chun nakihehset nau chu iti kadonbut dem tin lunggim masat dauvin,
en: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,
text:
LUK 21:14
Thadou: Hijeh chun nakihehset nau chu iti kadonbut dem tin lunggim masat dauvin,
English: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

tcz: ajeh chu keiman nangho thu adihtah chule chihna, nadoudal teuvin nahin donbut theilou nadiu ahiloule nanelkal joulou nadiuva kapeh ding nahiuve.
en: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
text:
LUK 21:15
Thadou: ajeh chu keiman nangho thu adihtah chule chihna, nadoudal teuvin nahin donbut theilou nadiu ahiloule nanelkal joulou nadiuva kapeh ding nahiuve.
English: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

tcz: Nakinaipi pen'u–nanu napa, nasopiho, na inkote, chule naloi le pai ho jengin jong nahin pehdoh nahlai diu ahi. Amahon nangho abangkhat nahin tha nahlai diu ahi.
en: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.
text:
LUK 21:16
Thadou: Nakinaipi pen'u–nanu napa, nasopiho, na inkote, chule naloi le pai ho jengin jong nahin pehdoh nahlai diu ahi. Amahon nangho abangkhat nahin tha nahlai diu ahi.
English: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

tcz: Chule mijousen kanungjui nahi jeh uva nahin muda diu ahi.
en: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.
text:
LUK 21:17
Thadou: Chule mijousen kanungjui nahi jeh uva nahin muda diu ahi.
English: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

tcz: Amavang naluchung'a nasamjang khat jengjong mahthah lou ding ahi!
en: And not a hair of your head will perish.
text:
LUK 21:18
Thadou: Amavang naluchung'a nasamjang khat jengjong mahthah lou ding ahi!
English: And not a hair of your head will perish.

tcz: Dettah a nadin uleh, na lhagao naki huhdoh diu ahi.”
en: “By your endurance you will win your lives.
text:
LUK 21:19
Thadou: Dettah a nadin uleh, na lhagao naki huhdoh diu ahi.”
English: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

tcz: Chuleh nanghon Jerusalem galmi sepai hon aum kimvel namu teng uleh, nanghon alhuh nading phat hunglhung ahitai ti nahet diu ahi.
en: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.
text:
LUK 21:20
Thadou: Chuleh nanghon Jerusalem galmi sepai hon aum kimvel namu teng uleh, nanghon alhuh nading phat hunglhung ahitai ti nahet diu ahi.
English: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

tcz: Chuteng Judea gam'a cheng ho thinglhang langa najam doh diu ahi. Jerusalem'a umho napotdoh diu, chule thinglhang langa umdoh ho khopi langa nakile lou diu ahi.
en: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.
text:
LUK 21:21
Thadou: Chuteng Judea gam'a cheng ho thinglhang langa najam doh diu ahi. Jerusalem'a umho napotdoh diu, chule thinglhang langa umdoh ho khopi langa nakile lou diu ahi.
English: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche ho chu Pathen phulah nikholai hiding, chule Pathen Lekhabua themgao thusei ho guilhung ding ahi.
en: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
text:
LUK 21:22
Thadou: Ajeh chu hiche ho chu Pathen phulah nikholai hiding, chule Pathen Lekhabua themgao thusei ho guilhung ding ahi.
English: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

tcz: Chuche nikholai chu numei naovop hole naosen sin minute dinga iti da umding hitam. Ajeh chu gamsunga hesoh genthei khohtah chule hiche miho chunga lunghanna nasatah chuding ahi.
en: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.
text:
LUK 21:23
Thadou: Chuche nikholai chu numei naovop hole naosen sin minute dinga iti da umding hitam. Ajeh chu gamsunga hesoh genthei khohtah chule hiche miho chunga lunghanna nasatah chuding ahi.
English: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

tcz: Amaho chemjam'a kithat diu ahilouleh sohchang'a vannoi nam jouse lah'a solmanga umdiu ahi. Chuleh chidang namdang te phatsung kichai kahsea Jerusalem hi chidang namdang ten achotpha ding ahi.
en: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
text:
LUK 21:24
Thadou: Amaho chemjam'a kithat diu ahilouleh sohchang'a vannoi nam jouse lah'a solmanga umdiu ahi. Chuleh chidang namdang te phatsung kichai kahsea Jerusalem hi chidang namdang ten achotpha ding ahi.
English: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

tcz: “Chule nisa, lha, chule ahsi hoa melchihna kidang tahtah hung umding ahi. Chule leichung'a hi namtin boina'a dim ding, twikhanglen kitum le tuikinong gimnei chun asuh lungjin diu ahi.
en: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

tcz: Miho chu leiset chunga thillhung ho amuuva kona kicha diu ahi, ajeh chu van munhoa thaneina cheng kihot ling gam ding ahitai.
en: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
text:
LUK 21:26
Thadou: Miho chu leiset chunga thillhung ho amuuva kona kicha diu ahi, ajeh chu van munhoa thaneina cheng kihot ling gam ding ahitai.
English: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

tcz: Chuteng mijousen Mihem Chapa meilom chunga thahat le loupi tah a ahung amudiu ahi.
en: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
text:
LUK 21:27
Thadou: Chuteng mijousen Mihem Chapa meilom chunga thahat le loupi tah a ahung amudiu ahi.
English: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

tcz: Hijeh a chu hitiho jouse hi ahung kipat teng leh, dingun lang chunglam veuvin, ajehchu nasochat nau nai ahitai!” ati.
en: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”
text:
LUK 21:28
Thadou: Hijeh a chu hitiho jouse hi ahung kipat teng leh, dingun lang chunglam veuvin, ajehchu nasochat nau nai ahitai!” ati.
English: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

tcz: Chuin aman hiche thutekah hi apen ahi: “Theichang phung khu veuvin, ahiloule thingphung dang hijong leh.
en: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.
text:
LUK 21:29
Thadou: Chuin aman hiche thutekah hi apen ahi: “Theichang phung khu veuvin, ahiloule thingphung dang hijong leh.
English: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.

tcz: Ado ahung pullhah teng, nanghon seipeh louvin jong naheuve, nipi anaitai.
en: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.
text:
LUK 21:30
Thadou: Ado ahung pullhah teng, nanghon seipeh louvin jong naheuve, nipi anaitai.
English: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

tcz: Chutobang chun, hitiho jouse aguilhun namu tenguleh, Pathen Lenggam chu anaitai ti nahet thei diu ahi.
en: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.
text:
LUK 21:31
Thadou: Chutobang chun, hitiho jouse aguilhun namu tenguleh, Pathen Lenggam chu anaitai ti nahet thei diu ahi.
English: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

tcz: Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche khang hi chemang lou ding ahi, hitiho jouse aguilhun masang sea.
en: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.
text:
LUK 21:32
Thadou: Thutah kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche khang hi chemang lou ding ahi, hitiho jouse aguilhun masang sea.
English: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

tcz: Van le lei mang ding ahi, ahin kathu ho vang manglou beh ding ahi.”
en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.
text:
LUK 21:33
Thadou: Van le lei mang ding ahi, ahin kathu ho vang manglou beh ding ahi.”
English: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

tcz: “Kihong phauvin! Nalungu, nopchon nale juneh motchon na jeh, chule tuhinkhoa lunggim naho jeh'in motsah hih'un. Hiche nikho chu hetlou kah'a thang banga kimatsah bolhih'un.
en: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.
text:
LUK 21:34
Thadou: “Kihong phauvin! Nalungu, nopchon nale juneh motchon na jeh, chule tuhinkhoa lunggim naho jeh'in motsah hih'un. Hiche nikho chu hetlou kah'a thang banga kimatsah bolhih'un.
English: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche nikho chu leiset chunga hing mijouse chunga lhung ding ahi.
en: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.
text:
LUK 21:35
Thadou: Ajeh chu hiche nikho chu leiset chunga hing mijouse chunga lhung ding ahi.
English: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.

tcz: Phat jousen kiging jingin um'un. Chuleh hitobang kichat umtah hunglhung ding peldoh nadia nahat jing thei nadiu le Mihem Chapa angsunga nadin jou thei nadiuvin taovun,” ati.
en: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”
text:
LUK 21:36
Thadou: Phat jousen kiging jingin um'un. Chuleh hitobang kichat umtah hunglhung ding peldoh nadia nahat jing thei nadiu le Mihem Chapa angsunga nadin jou thei nadiuvin taovun,” ati.
English: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

tcz: Niseh le Yeshua houin'ah thuhil dingin achejin, chule nilhah seh le Olive mol'a jan phat mang dingin ahung kile jin ahi.
en: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.
text:
LUK 21:37
Thadou: Niseh le Yeshua houin'ah thuhil dingin achejin, chule nilhah seh le Olive mol'a jan phat mang dingin ahung kile jin ahi.
English: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

tcz: Mihonpi chu houin'ah jingkah seh le athuhil ngai dingin akikhom jiuvin ahi.
en: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.
text:
LUK 21:38
Thadou: Mihonpi chu houin'ah jingkah seh le athuhil ngai dingin akikhom jiuvin ahi.
English: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

tcz: Cholsolou Changlhah Kut, Kalchuh kut tiajong kihe chu ahung naitai.
en: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.
text:
LUK 22:1
Thadou: Cholsolou Changlhah Kut, Kalchuh kut tiajong kihe chu ahung naitai.
English: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

tcz: Thempu pipui hole hou danthuhil hon Yeshua chu iti tha ding ham ti agong pan tauvin, ahin mipin ahinlethuh ding akichauvin ahi.
en: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.
text:
LUK 22:2
Thadou: Thempu pipui hole hou danthuhil hon Yeshua chu iti tha ding ham ti agong pan tauvin, ahin mipin ahinlethuh ding akichauvin ahi.
English: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

tcz: Chuin Judas Iscariot, seijui somleni holah'a khat, sungah Satan alut tan,
en: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.
text:
LUK 22:3
Thadou: Chuin Judas Iscariot, seijui somleni holah'a khat, sungah Satan alut tan,
English: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

tcz: chule ama thempu pipui hole houin ngahtup lamkai hotoh Yeshua amaho henga pehdoh nadinga lampi phapen ho kihoulim dingin achetai.
en: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.
text:
LUK 22:4
Thadou: chule ama thempu pipui hole houin ngahtup lamkai hotoh Yeshua amaho henga pehdoh nadinga lampi phapen ho kihoulim dingin achetai.
English: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

tcz: Amaho akipah un, sum peh dingin akitem tauve.
en: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.
text:
LUK 22:5
Thadou: Amaho akipah un, sum peh dingin akitem tauve.
English: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

tcz: Chuti chun amajong anom in chule Yeshua pehdoh na dinga phat kilemchang chu avelhi jingin, mihonpi umlou pet'a amat thei na diuvin avejinge.
en: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.
text:
LUK 22:6
Thadou: Chuti chun amajong anom in chule Yeshua pehdoh na dinga phat kilemchang chu avelhi jingin, mihonpi umlou pet'a amat thei na diuvin avejinge.
English: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

tcz: Tun Cholsolou Changlhah Kut chu ahunglhung tai, Kalchuh kut'a kelngoi akitha chun.
en: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.
text:
LUK 22:7
Thadou: Tun Cholsolou Changlhah Kut chu ahunglhung tai, Kalchuh kut'a kelngoi akitha chun.
English: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

tcz: Yeshuan Peter le John asol masan, “Chelhon in lang kalchuh kut anneh nading hin gongtup lhontan, thakhat'a ineh khom thei nadiuvin” ati.
en: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”
text:
LUK 22:8
Thadou: Yeshuan Peter le John asol masan, “Chelhon in lang kalchuh kut anneh nading hin gongtup lhontan, thakhat'a ineh khom thei nadiuvin” ati.
English: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

tcz: Amanin jong ahindong lhon in, “Hoilai mun'ah gongtup lhon leng natim?” atilhon'e.
en: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”
text:
LUK 22:9
Thadou: Amanin jong ahindong lhon in, “Hoilai mun'ah gongtup lhon leng natim?” atilhon'e.
English: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”

tcz: Aman adonbut in, “Jerusalem nalut lut lhon leh mikhat twibel a tui pu khat namu lhon ding ahi.” Amachu juilhon'in. Alutna in a chun,
en: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.
text:
LUK 22:10
Thadou: Aman adonbut in, “Jerusalem nalut lut lhon leh mikhat twibel a tui pu khat namu lhon ding ahi.” Amachu juilhon'in. Alutna in a chun,
English: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

tcz: inneipa jah'a seilhon in, houhil'in adonge: jinlhun in, kaseijuite toh kalchuh kut an kaneh nading mun chu hoiba ham? ati tilhon'in.
en: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
text:
LUK 22:11
Thadou: inneipa jah'a seilhon in, houhil'in adonge: jinlhun in, kaseijuite toh kalchuh kut an kaneh nading mun chu hoiba ham? ati tilhon'in.
English: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

tcz: Aman indan chung ka-lentah gotsa um khat'a napuilut lhon ding ahi. Hiche lai mun'a chu nangnin i-anneh diu nagon lhon ding ahi, ati.
en: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”
text:
LUK 22:12
Thadou: Aman indan chung ka-lentah gotsa um khat'a napuilut lhon ding ahi. Hiche lai mun'a chu nangnin i-anneh diu nagon lhon ding ahi, ati.
English: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”

tcz: Amani khopi lam'a chun achelhon in ahileh imajouse Yeshuan asei bang bangin agatoh lhon in chukoma chun kalchuh kut anneh ahinsem lhon tai.
en: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.
text:
LUK 22:13
Thadou: Amani khopi lam'a chun achelhon in ahileh imajouse Yeshuan asei bang bangin agatoh lhon in chukoma chun kalchuh kut anneh ahinsem lhon tai.
English: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

tcz: Phat ahung lhun phat in Yeshua le aseijuite dokhang ah atoukhom tauve.
en: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.
text:
LUK 22:14
Thadou: Phat ahung lhun phat in Yeshua le aseijuite dokhang ah atoukhom tauve.
English: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

tcz: Yeshuan aseiye, “Kathoh gim kipat kah a hitobang kalchuh kut ankong nangho toh nehkhom ding hi kana ngalel jing ahi.
en: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,
text:
LUK 22:15
Thadou: Yeshuan aseiye, “Kathoh gim kipat kah a hitobang kalchuh kut ankong nangho toh nehkhom ding hi kana ngalel jing ahi.
English: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

tcz: Ajeh chu tua kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen lenggam'a aguilhunna aum tokah'a hiche an hi kaneh kit lou ding ahitai,” ati.
en: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”
text:
LUK 22:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu tua kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen lenggam'a aguilhunna aum tokah'a hiche an hi kaneh kit lou ding ahitai,” ati.
English: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”

tcz: Chuin khon'a lengpitwi chu alan Pathen thangvah na apen ahi. Chuin aseitai, “Hiche hi kilah unlang nangho kihom un,
en: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,
text:
LUK 22:17
Thadou: Chuin khon'a lengpitwi chu alan Pathen thangvah na apen ahi. Chuin aseitai, “Hiche hi kilah unlang nangho kihom un,
English: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,

tcz: ajeh chu Pathen lenggam ahung lhun kah'a lengpitwi kadon lou ding ahitai,” ati.
en: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”
text:
LUK 22:18
Thadou: ajeh chu Pathen lenggam ahung lhun kah'a lengpitwi kadon lou ding ahitai,” ati.
English: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”

tcz: Aman changlhah themkhat alan Pathen thangvah na apen ahi. Chuin ahehbal bal'in aseijuite apen, “Hiche hi katahsa, nangho dinga kipe chu ahi. Keima geldoh nan bol'un” ati.
en: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”
text:
LUK 22:19
Thadou: Aman changlhah themkhat alan Pathen thangvah na apen ahi. Chuin ahehbal bal'in aseijuite apen, “Hiche hi katahsa, nangho dinga kipe chu ahi. Keima geldoh nan bol'un” ati.
English: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”

tcz: Jan anneh jouvin, lengpitwi khon dang khat alan hitin aseiye, “Hiche khon hi Pathen le amite kikah a kitepna thah–kinoptona kathisan a kisudet, nangho dinga kilhaina a kisunglha chu ahi,” ati.
en: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
text:
LUK 22:20
Thadou: Jan anneh jouvin, lengpitwi khon dang khat alan hitin aseiye, “Hiche khon hi Pathen le amite kikah a kitepna thah–kinoptona kathisan a kisudet, nangho dinga kilhaina a kisunglha chu ahi,” ati.
English: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

tcz: “Ahivangin hiche dokhang a hin, ilah uva jol le gol hina'a tou, mikhat eipedoh ding aume.
en: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.
text:
LUK 22:21
Thadou: “Ahivangin hiche dokhang a hin, ilah uva jol le gol hina'a tou, mikhat eipedoh ding aume.
English: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

tcz: Ajeh chu Mihem Chapa athi ding chu gotsa anahitai. Ahin, itobang lungkham nan anga hitam apedoh a pang pachu,” ati.
en: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”
text:
LUK 22:22
Thadou: Ajeh chu Mihem Chapa athi ding chu gotsa anahitai. Ahin, itobang lungkham nan anga hitam apedoh a pang pachu,” ati.
English: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”

tcz: Seijuite khat le khat akidong to un, alah uva koipen chun chutobang chu abol mong ding ham akitiuve. Let Thudol'a Kinelna
en: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.
text:
LUK 22:23
Thadou: Seijuite khat le khat akidong to un, alah uva koipen chun chutobang chu abol mong ding ham akitiuve. Let Thudol'a Kinelna
English: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

tcz: Chuin amaho khat le khat alenpen koi ahidiu thu'ah aki nelkal lah lah jeng tauve.
en: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.
text:
LUK 22:24
Thadou: Chuin amaho khat le khat alenpen koi ahidiu thu'ah aki nelkal lah lah jeng tauve.
English: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

tcz: Yeshuan aseipeh un, “Hiche vannoi leiset a hin lengho le milen milal ten amiho potgih apohsah un ahin ‘mipi ho jol le gol’ tin akiminvo uve.
en: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’
text:
LUK 22:25
Thadou: Yeshuan aseipeh un, “Hiche vannoi leiset a hin lengho le milen milal ten amiho potgih apohsah un ahin ‘mipi ho jol le gol’ tin akiminvo uve.
English: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’

tcz: Ahin, nangho lah'a vang achomdeu ngai ahi. Nalah uva alenpen chun panmun nem pen alo ngai ahi, chule alamkai chu soh tobang ahi ngai ahi.
en: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.
text:
LUK 22:26
Thadou: Ahin, nangho lah'a vang achomdeu ngai ahi. Nalah uva alenpen chun panmun nem pen alo ngai ahi, chule alamkai chu soh tobang ahi ngai ahi.
English: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

tcz: Koi thupijo ham, dokhanga toupa le ajenlea pangpa? Ahinai, dokhanga toupa athupijo nai. Amavang hikom'a chutilou ahi! ajeh chu keima nangho lah a ajenlea kapan ahi.
en: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.
text:
LUK 22:27
Thadou: Koi thupijo ham, dokhanga toupa le ajenlea pangpa? Ahinai, dokhanga toupa athupijo nai. Amavang hikom'a chutilou ahi! ajeh chu keima nangho lah a ajenlea kapan ahi.
English: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

tcz: Nanghon kathoh genthei na ah nei umpiuve.
en: “But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.
text:
LUK 22:28
Thadou: Nanghon kathoh genthei na ah nei umpiuve.
English: “But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

tcz: Chule kapan Lenggam eipeh banga, kenjong tua thaneina kapeh nahiuve,
en: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,
text:
LUK 22:29
Thadou: Chule kapan Lenggam eipeh banga, kenjong tua thaneina kapeh nahiuve,
English: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

tcz: Chuche lenggam'a chu ka dokhanga naneh uva chule nadon thei nadiuvin. Chule nangho laltouna a natou diu Israel phungsom le phungni chunga thu natan diu ahi. Yeshuan Peter in Aseilep Ding Asei-Masah
en: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”
text:
LUK 22:30
Thadou: Chuche lenggam'a chu ka dokhanga naneh uva chule nadon thei nadiuvin. Chule nangho laltouna a natou diu Israel phungsom le phungni chunga thu natan diu ahi. Yeshuan Peter in Aseilep Ding Asei-Masah
English: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

tcz: Simon, Simon, Satan in nabonchauvin chang kilhah chil banga lhah chil dingin nathum uve.
en: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,
text:
LUK 22:31
Thadou: Simon, Simon, Satan in nabonchauvin chang kilhah chil banga lhah chil dingin nathum uve.
English: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,

tcz: Ahivangin taona ah kathumpeh uve, Simon chule natahsan chu alosap lou ngai ahi. Hijeh a chu nalung naheiya keilam a nahung kile kit teng nasopi ho suthahat in,” ati.
en: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”
text:
LUK 22:32
Thadou: Ahivangin taona ah kathumpeh uve, Simon chule natahsan chu alosap lou ngai ahi. Hijeh a chu nalung naheiya keilam a nahung kile kit teng nasopi ho suthahat in,” ati.
English: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”

tcz: Peter in aseiyin, “Pakai, nangma to songkullut dinga kigosa kahi, chule thina hijong leh thingap cha kahi,” ati.
en: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”
text:
LUK 22:33
Thadou: Peter in aseiyin, “Pakai, nangma to songkullut dinga kigosa kahi, chule thina hijong leh thingap cha kahi,” ati.
English: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Peter, thilkhat naseipeh inge. Jing jingkah ahchal khon masanga, nangman thumvei neiseilep ding, kahekha poi nati ding ahi,” ati.
en: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”
text:
LUK 22:34
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut in, “Peter, thilkhat naseipeh inge. Jing jingkah ahchal khon masanga, nangman thumvei neiseilep ding, kahekha poi nati ding ahi,” ati.
English: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu adongin, “Keiman Kipana Thupha seiphonga kanasol uva, sum polou, sakhao kiken lou, ahiloule kengchot khel kichoilouva naum uva chu ipi ngaichat naneiyuvam?” atileh, amahon adonbut un, “Imacha” atiuve.
en: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”
text:
LUK 22:35
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu adongin, “Keiman Kipana Thupha seiphonga kanasol uva, sum polou, sakhao kiken lou, ahiloule kengchot khel kichoilouva naum uva chu ipi ngaichat naneiyuvam?” atileh, amahon adonbut un, “Imacha” atiuve.
English: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

tcz: “Ahinlah tun nasum ule sakhao kipoh tauvin. Chule chemjam naneilou uleh naponsil joh unlang khat kichoh un.
en: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.
text:
LUK 22:36
Thadou: “Ahinlah tun nasum ule sakhao kipoh tauvin. Chule chemjam naneilou uleh naponsil joh unlang khat kichoh un.
English: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

tcz: Ajeh chu phat ahung lhunge kei chungchanga hiche themgao thusei guilhun na dingin: ‘Ama adoudal hotoh akisimtha tai’ tia kisun chu. Henge keima chungchanga kisun themgao thusei jouse guilhung ding ahi,” ati.
en: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”
text:
LUK 22:37
Thadou: Ajeh chu phat ahung lhunge kei chungchanga hiche themgao thusei guilhun na dingin: ‘Ama adoudal hotoh akisimtha tai’ tia kisun chu. Henge keima chungchanga kisun themgao thusei jouse guilhung ding ahi,” ati.
English: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”

tcz: “Ven Pakai” tin ahin donbut un, “Chemjam ni eiho lah'a aumnai,” atiuvin, hichu aphatai, tin aseiye.
en: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”
text:
LUK 22:38
Thadou: “Ven Pakai” tin ahin donbut un, “Chemjam ni eiho lah'a aumnai,” atiuvin, hichu aphatai, tin aseiye.
English: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”

tcz: Chuin, seijuite toh kivop in, Yeshuan indan chung adalhan chule abolngai ma bangin Olive mol langah achetai.
en: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.
text:
LUK 22:39
Thadou: Chuin, seijuite toh kivop in, Yeshuan indan chung adalhan chule abolngai ma bangin Olive mol langah achetai.
English: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

tcz: Hia chun amaho aseipeh in, “Taovun, lhepna a nalhah lou nadiuvin,” ati.
en: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”
text:
LUK 22:40
Thadou: Hia chun amaho aseipeh in, “Taovun, lhepna a nalhah lou nadiuvin,” ati.
English: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”

tcz: Themkhat, song sephah nathei chan bep ah, ache chon jep'in, chule adilsun ataotai,
en: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,
text:
LUK 22:41
Thadou: Themkhat, song sephah nathei chan bep ah, ache chon jep'in, chule adilsun ataotai,
English: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

tcz: “Hepa, nalung ahileh, lungsettah in thoh gentheina khon hi keiya konin ladoh in. Ahin, keima lunggot hilouvin, nangma lunggot joh akibol ding kadeiye,” ati.
en: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”
text:
LUK 22:42
Thadou: “Hepa, nalung ahileh, lungsettah in thoh gentheina khon hi keiya konin ladoh in. Ahin, keima lunggot hilouvin, nangma lunggot joh akibol ding kadeiye,” ati.
English: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”

tcz: Chuin van'a konin vantil khat ahung kilah in chule atha asuhhat peh in ahi.
en: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.
text:
LUK 22:43
Thadou: Chuin van'a konin vantil khat ahung kilah in chule atha asuhhat peh in ahi.
English: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

tcz: Ama lungluttah in ataoben, chule alhagao thohgim natsat dan chu, a-ul sa chu thisan vat lentah tah bangin alenglhan ahi.
en: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.
text:
LUK 22:44
Thadou: Ama lungluttah in ataoben, chule alhagao thohgim natsat dan chu, a-ul sa chu thisan vat lentah tah bangin alenglhan ahi.
English: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

tcz: Achainan adingdoh kit in aseijuite hengah ahung kilen ahileh ana ihmut u ahung mun, lungkham na'a kon joilha gamu ahitai.
en: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,
text:
LUK 22:45
Thadou: Achainan adingdoh kit in aseijuite hengah ahung kilen ahileh ana ihmut u ahung mun, lungkham na'a kon joilha gamu ahitai.
English: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,

tcz: “Ipi bol'a na-imut u ham?” tin adongin, “Thoudoh unlang taovun, lhepna a nalhah lut louna dingun,” ati.
en: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”
text:
LUK 22:46
Thadou: “Ipi bol'a na-imut u ham?” tin adongin, “Thoudoh unlang taovun, lhepna a nalhah lut louna dingun,” ati.
English: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan chutia asei jeng vang chun, mihonpin ahin nai pheiyun, Judas, seijui somleni lah'a khat, in ahin lamkai ahi. Judas jong Yeshua kom langah chibai boh a chop ding in achen ahi.
en: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.
text:
LUK 22:47
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan chutia asei jeng vang chun, mihonpin ahin nai pheiyun, Judas, seijui somleni lah'a khat, in ahin lamkai ahi. Judas jong Yeshua kom langah chibai boh a chop ding in achen ahi.
English: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

tcz: Ahin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Judas, nangman Mihem Chapa hi chop'a pehdoh ding nagot ham?” ati.
en: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”
text:
LUK 22:48
Thadou: Ahin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Judas, nangman Mihem Chapa hi chop'a pehdoh ding nagot ham?” ati.
English: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

tcz: Seijui danghon thilsoh ding chu amuphat un ahung eojah un, “Pakai, ikidel pidiu ham? Chemjam kahin pouve!” ahin tiuve.
en: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”
text:
LUK 22:49
Thadou: Seijui danghon thilsoh ding chu amuphat un ahung eojah un, “Pakai, ikidel pidiu ham? Chemjam kahin pouve!” ahin tiuve.
English: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

tcz: Chule alah uva khat chun Thempu chungnung sohpa jetlang kol asatlhah peh in ahi.
en: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
text:
LUK 22:50
Thadou: Chule alah uva khat chun Thempu chungnung sohpa jetlang kol asatlhah peh in ahi.
English: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

tcz: Ahin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Kidoupi tahih un,” atin chule mipa kol chu atham in asuhdam peh'e.
en: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.
text:
LUK 22:51
Thadou: Ahin Yeshuan aseiyin, “Kidoupi tahih un,” atin chule mipa kol chu atham in asuhdam peh'e.
English: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ama mandinga hungho thempu pipui ho, Houin ngah lamkaiho, chule upa ho komah thu aseiye. Amaho chu adongin, “Keima tijat umtah doudal natong kahim, chemjam toh moltum thoa keima man dinga nahung u?
en: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?
text:
LUK 22:52
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan ama mandinga hungho thempu pipui ho, Houin ngah lamkaiho, chule upa ho komah thu aseiye. Amaho chu adongin, “Keima tijat umtah doudal natong kahim, chemjam toh moltum thoa keima man dinga nahung u?
English: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

tcz: Ipi jeh a houin a neimat lou u ham? Keima niseh'a ana kium jinga. Ahivangin tuhi naphat'u ahi, muthim thaneinan vai apoh pet ahi,” ati.
en: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”
text:
LUK 22:53
Thadou: Ipi jeh a houin a neimat lou u ham? Keima niseh'a ana kium jinga. Ahivangin tuhi naphat'u ahi, muthim thaneinan vai apoh pet ahi,” ati.
English: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”

tcz: Hijeh chun amahon aman'un thempu chungnung pa in'ah apuiphei tauve. Chule Peter chun galkang in ahinjuiye.
en: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.
text:
LUK 22:54
Thadou: Hijeh chun amahon aman'un thempu chungnung pa in'ah apuiphei tauve. Chule Peter chun galkang in ahinjuiye.
English: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

tcz: Angah ho chun leitol lailunga chu mei atiuva toubem u ahin, chule Peter jong agajaovin ahi.
en: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.
text:
LUK 22:55
Thadou: Angah ho chun leitol lailunga chu mei atiuva toubem u ahin, chule Peter jong agajaovin ahi.
English: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

tcz: Soh numei chapang khat in mei kitivah na'a kon chun ahin mun ama chu ave vejeng tai. Achainan amanun ahinseiyin, “Hiche mipa hi Yeshua nungjui holah'a khat ahi,” ahin ti.
en: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”
text:
LUK 22:56
Thadou: Soh numei chapang khat in mei kitivah na'a kon chun ahin mun ama chu ave vejeng tai. Achainan amanun ahinseiyin, “Hiche mipa hi Yeshua nungjui holah'a khat ahi,” ahin ti.
English: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”

tcz: Ahin Peter in aseilep in, “Numei, ama khu koi ahi jong kahet lou ahi,” ati.
en: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”
text:
LUK 22:57
Thadou: Ahin Peter in aseilep in, “Numei, ama khu koi ahi jong kahet lou ahi,” ati.
English: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin koiham khat in ahinven aseitai, “Nang jong amaho lah'a khat nahi tei ding ahi,” ati. Peter in adonbut in, “Ahipoiye, kahipoi,” ati.
en: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”
text:
LUK 22:58
Thadou: Chomkhat jouvin koiham khat in ahinven aseitai, “Nang jong amaho lah'a khat nahi tei ding ahi,” ati. Peter in adonbut in, “Ahipoiye, kahipoi,” ati.
English: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

tcz: Nidan khat jou lang hin koiham khat in angoh kit in, “Hiche mipa jong hi amaho lah'a khat hitei tei ding ahi, ajeh chu ama jong Galilee gammi ahi,” ati.
en: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”
text:
LUK 22:59
Thadou: Nidan khat jou lang hin koiham khat in angoh kit in, “Hiche mipa jong hi amaho lah'a khat hitei tei ding ahi, ajeh chu ama jong Galilee gammi ahi,” ati.
English: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

tcz: Ahivangin Peter in aseiyin, “Ipi nasei ham kahehih beh e,” atitai. Chuin chutia asei lai tah chun ahchal ahung khong tai.
en: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
text:
LUK 22:60
Thadou: Ahivangin Peter in aseiyin, “Ipi nasei ham kahehih beh e,” atitai. Chuin chutia asei lai tah chun ahchal ahung khong tai.
English: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

tcz: Hiche pettah chun Pakai chu ahung kiheiyin Peter chu ahin ven ahi. Kinloitah in Peter lung sungah Pakai thusei ho chu ahung kilangin: “Ahkhon masanga, jing jingkah le, nangman neiseilep ding, kahekha poi nati ding ahi” atichu.
en: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”
text:
LUK 22:61
Thadou: Hiche pettah chun Pakai chu ahung kiheiyin Peter chu ahin ven ahi. Kinloitah in Peter lung sungah Pakai thusei ho chu ahung kilangin: “Ahkhon masanga, jing jingkah le, nangman neiseilep ding, kahekha poi nati ding ahi” atichu.
English: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”

tcz: Chuin Peter chun leitol adalhan, lainatah'in agakap tai.
en: He went out, and wept bitterly.
text:
LUK 22:62
Thadou: Chuin Peter chun leitol adalhan, lainatah'in agakap tai.
English: He went out, and wept bitterly.

tcz: Yeshua ngah'a pangho lah'a mopopa chun totnopnan aneiyin chule avopan tai.
en: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.
text:
LUK 22:63
Thadou: Yeshua ngah'a pangho lah'a mopopa chun totnopnan aneiyin chule avopan tai.
English: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

tcz: Amit atompeh un, “Gaovin lang seiyin, koiham nadeng'a chu?” atiuvin ahi.
en: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”
text:
LUK 22:64
Thadou: Amit atompeh un, “Gaovin lang seiyin, koiham nadeng'a chu?” atiuvin ahi.
English: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

tcz: Chule ama suhjum nan bolthei jouse abol'un ahi. Hou Vaipo Ho Ang-Sunga Yeshua
en: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.
text:
LUK 22:65
Thadou: Chule ama suhjum nan bolthei jouse abol'un ahi. Hou Vaipo Ho Ang-Sunga Yeshua
English: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

tcz: Jingkho avah in, upa ho jouse, thempu pipui hole hou danthuhil ho pan nan akikhom un ahi. Yeshua chu akikhom mipi angsungah ahin puiyun,
en: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,
text:
LUK 22:66
Thadou: Jingkho avah in, upa ho jouse, thempu pipui hole hou danthuhil ho pan nan akikhom un ahi. Yeshua chu akikhom mipi angsungah ahin puiyun,
English: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

tcz: chule amahon adongun, “Neiseipeh un nangma Messiah chu nahim?” atiuve. Ahivangin aman adonbut in, “Naseipeh uleng, neitahsan lou diu ahi.
en: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,
text:
LUK 22:67
Thadou: chule amahon adongun, “Neiseipeh un nangma Messiah chu nahim?” atiuve. Ahivangin aman adonbut in, “Naseipeh uleng, neitahsan lou diu ahi.
English: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,

tcz: Chule thudoh naneiyu leng neidonbut lou diu ahi.
en: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.
text:
LUK 22:68
Thadou: Chule thudoh naneiyu leng neidonbut lou diu ahi.
English: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

tcz: Ahin, tua pat'a Mihem Chapa hi thaneitah a Pathen khut jetlam a touding ahi,” ati.
en: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”
text:
LUK 22:69
Thadou: Ahin, tua pat'a Mihem Chapa hi thaneitah a Pathen khut jetlam a touding ahi,” ati.
English: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

tcz: Amaho abonchauvin ahung eojah jeng'un, “Ahileh, Pathen Chapa kahie natina ham?” ahintiuve. Chuin aman adonbut in, “Naseiyu chu kahi” ati.
en: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”
text:
LUK 22:70
Thadou: Amaho abonchauvin ahung eojah jeng'un, “Ahileh, Pathen Chapa kahie natina ham?” ahintiuve. Chuin aman adonbut in, “Naseiyu chu kahi” ati.
English: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”

tcz: Chuin amahon, “Ipi dinga hettohsah dang ingaikhoh uham? Eiho tah in athusei ija tauve,” atiuve.
en: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”
text:
LUK 22:71
Thadou: Chuin amahon, “Ipi dinga hettohsah dang ingaikhoh uham? Eiho tah in athusei ija tauve,” atiuve.
English: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”

tcz: Chuin mipi kikhom chengse chun Yeshua chu Rome Gamvaipo, Pilate hengah ahin pui tauve.
en: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.
text:
LUK 23:1
Thadou: Chuin mipi kikhom chengse chun Yeshua chu Rome Gamvaipo, Pilate hengah ahin pui tauve.
English: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

tcz: Amahon apansat nau thu chu aseipan un: “Hiche mipa hin kamiteu apuileng'in, Rome solkal koma kai peh lou ding tin aseiyin chule ama tahjong Messiah, Leng akihisah e,” atiuve.
en: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”
text:
LUK 23:2
Thadou: Amahon apansat nau thu chu aseipan un: “Hiche mipa hin kamiteu apuileng'in, Rome solkal koma kai peh lou ding tin aseiyin chule ama tahjong Messiah, Leng akihisah e,” atiuve.
English: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Pilate in ama chu adongin, “Nangma Juda te Lengpa nahim?” ati. Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kahi chu nasei khai” ati.
en: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”
text:
LUK 23:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pilate in ama chu adongin, “Nangma Juda te Lengpa nahim?” ati. Yeshuan adonbut in, “Kahi chu nasei khai” ati.
English: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”

tcz: Pilate chu thempu pipui hole mihonpi hengah ahung kiheiyin chule aseitai, “Hiche mipa chunga hin ima adihlou kamupoi!” ati.
en: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
text:
LUK 23:4
Thadou: Pilate chu thempu pipui hole mihonpi hengah ahung kiheiyin chule aseitai, “Hiche mipa chunga hin ima adihlou kamupoi!” ati.
English: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

tcz: Chuin amahon asei teitei jengun, “Ahivanga, amahin achena chan'a athuhil a kona boina asem jing jeng ahi–Judea pumpia, Galilee a pat Jerusalem geiya!” atiuve.
en: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”
text:
LUK 23:5
Thadou: Chuin amahon asei teitei jengun, “Ahivanga, amahin achena chan'a athuhil a kona boina asem jing jeng ahi–Judea pumpia, Galilee a pat Jerusalem geiya!” atiuve.
English: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”

tcz: “Oh, Galilee gammi ham?” tin Pilate in ahin dong'e.
en: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
text:
LUK 23:6
Thadou: “Oh, Galilee gammi ham?” tin Pilate in ahin dong'e.
English: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

tcz: Amahon ahi atipeh phat un, Pilate in Herod Antipas koma dingin asol tai, ajeh chu Galilee chu Herod vaipoh nanoi anahi, chule Herod jong chu Jerusalem a aumpet anahi khan ahi.
en: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.
text:
LUK 23:7
Thadou: Amahon ahi atipeh phat un, Pilate in Herod Antipas koma dingin asol tai, ajeh chu Galilee chu Herod vaipoh nanoi anahi, chule Herod jong chu Jerusalem a aumpet anahi khan ahi.
English: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

tcz: Herod in Yeshua mu na dinga phat hoitah amujeh chun akitai lheh jengin ahi, ajeh chu ama chung chang thudol anajah'a chule sot'a pat'a thilkidang abolho anamu nomten ahi.
en: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.
text:
LUK 23:8
Thadou: Herod in Yeshua mu na dinga phat hoitah amujeh chun akitai lheh jengin ahi, ajeh chu ama chung chang thudol anajah'a chule sot'a pat'a thilkidang abolho anamu nomten ahi.
English: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

tcz: Aman Yeshua chu thudoh tamtah adongin, ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut nom poi.
en: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.
text:
LUK 23:9
Thadou: Aman Yeshua chu thudoh tamtah adongin, ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut nom poi.
English: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

tcz: Hiche lai chun thempu pipui hole hou danthuhil ho chua chun adingun ahehset nathu'u chu asam un ahi.
en: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.
text:
LUK 23:10
Thadou: Hiche lai chun thempu pipui hole hou danthuhil ho chua chun adingun ahehset nathu'u chu asam un ahi.
English: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

tcz: Chuin Herod le asepaiten Yeshua chu totnopnan aneiyun adaichavai pan tauve. Achainan, amahon leng ponsil asilpeh un Pilate hengah ahinle sol tauve.
en: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.
text:
LUK 23:11
Thadou: Chuin Herod le asepaiten Yeshua chu totnopnan aneiyun adaichavai pan tauve. Achainan, amahon leng ponsil asilpeh un Pilate hengah ahinle sol tauve.
English: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

tcz: (Herod le Pilate, masanga kimelmah teni chu, hiche ni chun jol le gol ahung hilhon'e). Yeshua Tha Dinga Athu Atan-U
en: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.
text:
LUK 23:12
Thadou: (Herod le Pilate, masanga kimelmah teni chu, hiche ni chun jol le gol ahung hilhon'e). Yeshua Tha Dinga Athu Atan-U
English: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

tcz: Chuin Pilate in thempu pipui hole hou lamkai adangho, mipiho jaonan, akoukhom in,
en: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
text:
LUK 23:13
Thadou: Chuin Pilate in thempu pipui hole hou lamkai adangho, mipiho jaonan, akoukhom in,
English: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

tcz: chule athulhuh sem aphongdoh in ahi. “Nanghon hiche mipa hi kakoma nahin puiyun, doudal natoh atonge tia ngohna naneiyu ahi. Keiman hiche thudol a hin phatah in nangho mitmun kavelhan chule bolset neilou ahi kamudoh'e.
en: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.
text:
LUK 23:14
Thadou: chule athulhuh sem aphongdoh in ahi. “Nanghon hiche mipa hi kakoma nahin puiyun, doudal natoh atonge tia ngohna naneiyu ahi. Keiman hiche thudol a hin phatah in nangho mitmun kavelhan chule bolset neilou ahi kamudoh'e.
English: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

tcz: Herod in jong themmona amulou jeh a eiho koma ahinle sol ahi. Thina thei chan gotna peh nading natoh hiche mipan abolpoi.
en: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.
text:
LUK 23:15
Thadou: Herod in jong themmona amulou jeh a eiho koma ahinle sol ahi. Thina thei chan gotna peh nading natoh hiche mipan abolpoi.
English: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

tcz: Hijeh chun keiman gimbolna peing ting, hinlhadoh tange,” ahinti.
en: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
text:
LUK 23:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun keiman gimbolna peing ting, hinlhadoh tange,” ahinti.
English: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

tcz: Ajeh chu kut sunga chu amahon mikhat alhadoh jing-u ahi.
en: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.
text:
LUK 23:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu kut sunga chu amahon mikhat alhadoh jing-u ahi.
English: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.

tcz: Chutah chun mihonpi lah a kon chun awgin sangtah ahung gingin, thakhat tah in ahin sam'un, “Amahi thatdoh'in, chule Barabbas chu neilhadoh peh un!” atiuve.
en: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—
text:
LUK 23:18
Thadou: Chutah chun mihonpi lah a kon chun awgin sangtah ahung gingin, thakhat tah in ahin sam'un, “Amahi thatdoh'in, chule Barabbas chu neilhadoh peh un!” atiuve.
English: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—

tcz: (Barabbas chu agam solkal douna natoh jeh le toltha jeh'a songkul'a kikhum anahi.)
en: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.
text:
LUK 23:19
Thadou: (Barabbas chu agam solkal douna natoh jeh le toltha jeh'a songkul'a kikhum anahi.)
English: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

tcz: Pilate in amaho anelkal'in ahi, ajehchu aman Yeshua alhadoh nom jeh ahi.
en: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,
text:
LUK 23:20
Thadou: Pilate in amaho anelkal'in ahi, ajehchu aman Yeshua alhadoh nom jeh ahi.
English: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

tcz: Ahivangin amahon asam sam jengun, “Thingpel'a khenbeh in! thingpel'a khenbeh in!” atiuve.
en: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”
text:
LUK 23:21
Thadou: Ahivangin amahon asam sam jengun, “Thingpel'a khenbeh in! thingpel'a khenbeh in!” atiuve.
English: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”

tcz: Athumvei channa din aman adongin, “Ipi bol'in em? Ipi them mona aneiyem? Keiman thina chan'a gotna peh nading thu ima kamupoi. Hijeh chun hin vogim ingting hinlhadoh tange,” ati.
en: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
text:
LUK 23:22
Thadou: Athumvei channa din aman adongin, “Ipi bol'in em? Ipi them mona aneiyem? Keiman thina chan'a gotna peh nading thu ima kamupoi. Hijeh chun hin vogim ingting hinlhadoh tange,” ati.
English: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

tcz: Ahivangin mihonpi chun awsang jep in aha sapcheh un, Yeshua chu thingpel'a khetbeh ahinadin athum'un, chule a-awgin u chun ajoujotai.
en: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.
text:
LUK 23:23
Thadou: Ahivangin mihonpi chun awsang jep in aha sapcheh un, Yeshua chu thingpel'a khetbeh ahinadin athum'un, chule a-awgin u chun ajoujotai.
English: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pilate in Yeshua chu angeh dungjuiyun athi dingin atanlhah peh tai.
en: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.
text:
LUK 23:24
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pilate in Yeshua chu angeh dungjuiyun athi dingin atanlhah peh tai.
English: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

tcz: Amahon athum dungjuiyun Barabbas, michohnoh le toltha jeh a songkul'a umpa, alhadoh peh in ahi. Ahin Yeshua vang chu amaho khut'ah anop nop alodiuvin apedoh tai.
en: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.
text:
LUK 23:25
Thadou: Amahon athum dungjuiyun Barabbas, michohnoh le toltha jeh a songkul'a umpa, alhadoh peh in ahi. Ahin Yeshua vang chu amaho khut'ah anop nop alodiuvin apedoh tai.
English: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

tcz: Chutia Yeshua ahinpuidoh uchun, Simon kiti Cyrene gam mi khat thinglhang langa pat'a ahung pettah anahi. Sepai ho chun aman un thingpel chu achungah akoiyun Yeshua nunga chun apohsah tauve.
en: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.
text:
LUK 23:26
Thadou: Chutia Yeshua ahinpuidoh uchun, Simon kiti Cyrene gam mi khat thinglhang langa pat'a ahung pettah anahi. Sepai ho chun aman un thingpel chu achungah akoiyun Yeshua nunga chun apohsah tauve.
English: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.

tcz: Mihonpi tamtah'in anung ahinjuiyun, a-op chum'a kap nupiho jong ahiuve.
en: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.
text:
LUK 23:27
Thadou: Mihonpi tamtah'in anung ahinjuiyun, a-op chum'a kap nupiho jong ahiuve.
English: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshua amaho langah akiheiyin aseitai, “Jerusalem chanute, keiya dingin kap hih'un, amavang nangho le nachateu dingin kap jouvin.
en: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
text:
LUK 23:28
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshua amaho langah akiheiyin aseitai, “Jerusalem chanute, keiya dingin kap hih'un, amavang nangho le nachateu dingin kap jouvin.
English: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile amahon hitia aseina diu nikho hung lhung ding ahi. Cha neilou numeiho, naovop khalou naobu, chule nao noichepsah khalou ho anunnom uve, kiti ding ahi.
en: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’
text:
LUK 23:29
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile amahon hitia aseina diu nikho hung lhung ding ahi. Cha neilou numeiho, naovop khalou naobu, chule nao noichepsah khalou ho anunnom uve, kiti ding ahi.
English: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’

tcz: Mihon mol ho jah'a ‘Neilhuh khum'un’ tia athum dingu, lhang jah'a ‘neikhu khum'un’ atidiu ahi.
en: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’
text:
LUK 23:30
Thadou: Mihon mol ho jah'a ‘Neilhuh khum'un’ tia athum dingu, lhang jah'a ‘neikhu khum'un’ atidiu ahi.
English: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’

tcz: Ajeh chu thingphung ahinlai'a bon hitia hi abol ule, iti da ding ham agot teng,” ati.
en: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”
text:
LUK 23:31
Thadou: Ajeh chu thingphung ahinlai'a bon hitia hi abol ule, iti da ding ham agot teng,” ati.
English: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”

tcz: Adang mini, anilhona miphalou, teni jong chu amatoh tha thading'in ahin puidoh uve.
en: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.
text:
LUK 23:32
Thadou: Adang mini, anilhona miphalou, teni jong chu amatoh tha thading'in ahin puidoh uve.
English: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

tcz: Lugu mun atinau mun ahung lhun phat un, amahon thingpel ah thingkil'in akilbeh un ahi. Chuleh miphalou teni jong chu akhetbeh tauve–khat ajet ah chule khat aveiyah.
en: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.
text:
LUK 23:33
Thadou: Lugu mun atinau mun ahung lhun phat un, amahon thingpel ah thingkil'in akilbeh un ahi. Chuleh miphalou teni jong chu akhetbeh tauve–khat ajet ah chule khat aveiyah.
English: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

tcz: Yeshuan aseitai, “Hepa, ngaidam in, ajeh chu ipi abol'u ahepouve,” ati. Chule sepai hon aponsil chu vang asang'un achang ding akivelhauve.
en: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.
text:
LUK 23:34
Thadou: Yeshuan aseitai, “Hepa, ngaidam in, ajeh chu ipi abol'u ahepouve,” ati. Chule sepai hon aponsil chu vang asang'un achang ding akivelhauve.
English: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

tcz: Mihonpi chun aveuvin chule alamkai hon ajontai'un. “Aman midang ho ahuhhingin” tin amahon aseiyun, “Ama le ama kihuhhing tahta Pathen thaonu, Akilhengdoh pachu ahi mong mong leh,” atiuvin ahi.
en: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”
text:
LUK 23:35
Thadou: Mihonpi chun aveuvin chule alamkai hon ajontai'un. “Aman midang ho ahuhhingin” tin amahon aseiyun, “Ama le ama kihuhhing tahta Pathen thaonu, Akilhengdoh pachu ahi mong mong leh,” atiuvin ahi.
English: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”

tcz: Sepai hon jong adai chavaiyun, donding juthuh apeuvin ahi.
en: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,
text:
LUK 23:36
Thadou: Sepai hon jong adai chavaiyun, donding juthuh apeuvin ahi.
English: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

tcz: Ama ahin kou uvin, “Nangma Judate lengpa nahileh, kihuhhing in!” atiuve.
en: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”
text:
LUK 23:37
Thadou: Ama ahin kou uvin, “Nangma Judate lengpa nahileh, kihuhhing in!” atiuve.
English: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”

tcz: Achungah chun melchihna khat atah uvin, “Hiche hi Judate lengpa ahi” tin asun uve.
en: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
text:
LUK 23:38
Thadou: Achungah chun melchihna khat atah uvin, “Hiche hi Judate lengpa ahi” tin asun uve.
English: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
