tcz: Miphalou akikhetbeh pi teni khatpa chun ahin jontaiyin, “Nang, Messiah nahi hilou ham?” Nahi vetsahnan nang le nang kihuhhing in lang chule keini jong neihuhdoh lhon tang'em, hitia nathoh gim laihin! ati.
en: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”
text:
LUK 23:39
Thadou: Miphalou akikhetbeh pi teni khatpa chun ahin jontaiyin, “Nang, Messiah nahi hilou ham?” Nahi vetsahnan nang le nang kihuhhing in lang chule keini jong neihuhdoh lhon tang'em, hitia nathoh gim laihin! ati.
English: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”

tcz: Ahivangin miphalou khatpa chun ahin phohsal in, “Pathen nagin lou ham athidinga naum kisan'a?
en: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?
text:
LUK 23:40
Thadou: Ahivangin miphalou khatpa chun ahin phohsal in, “Pathen nagin lou ham athidinga naum kisan'a?
English: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

tcz: Eini hi athidinga lom ihi ithil bolkhel jeh'a, ahin hiche pa hin imacha bolkhel aneipoi,” ati.
en: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”
text:
LUK 23:41
Thadou: Eini hi athidinga lom ihi ithil bolkhel jeh'a, ahin hiche pa hin imacha bolkhel aneipoi,” ati.
English: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”

tcz: Chuin aman aseitai, “Yeshua, neigeldoh in nalenggam'a nahung teng,” ati.
en: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”
text:
LUK 23:42
Thadou: Chuin aman aseitai, “Yeshua, neigeldoh in nalenggam'a nahung teng,” ati.
English: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahi, tunia Paradise a iumkhom ding ahi,” ati.
en: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”
text:
LUK 23:43
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahi, tunia Paradise a iumkhom ding ahi,” ati.
English: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

tcz: Hiche phat hi sunkim dontah ahin, chule nidan thum chan in gamsung pumpi muthim ahung jingin ahi.
en: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.
text:
LUK 23:44
Thadou: Hiche phat hi sunkim dontah ahin, chule nidan thum chan in gamsung pumpi muthim ahung jingin ahi.
English: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

tcz: Nisa a kon vah achemang in, chule kinloitah in houin muntheng'a pondal chu akimlai tah'a akehlhasuh in ahi.
en: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.
text:
LUK 23:45
Thadou: Nisa a kon vah achemang in, chule kinloitah in houin muntheng'a pondal chu akimlai tah'a akehlhasuh in ahi.
English: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

tcz: Chutah chun Yeshua ahung peng in, “Pa, nakhut'ah kalhagao kapedoh e” ati. Chule chuche thucheng asei toh kilhon in ahinna alhatai.
en: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.
text:
LUK 23:46
Thadou: Chutah chun Yeshua ahung peng in, “Pa, nakhut'ah kalhagao kapedoh e” ati. Chule chuche thucheng asei toh kilhon in ahinna alhatai.
English: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.

tcz: Rome sepai jalamkaipa, kithana velhalea pang pan thilsoh umchan chu amun, Pathen chibai aboh in aseitai, “Hiche mipa vang michonpha ahi,” ati.
en: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”
text:
LUK 23:47
Thadou: Rome sepai jalamkaipa, kithana velhalea pang pan thilsoh umchan chu amun, Pathen chibai aboh in aseitai, “Hiche mipa vang michonpha ahi,” ati.
English: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

tcz: Chuleh mihonpi akikhetbeh ve'a hung sesen jong thilsoh umchan chu amu uvin, amaho lungkham tah in inlam ache tauve.
en: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.
text:
LUK 23:48
Thadou: Chuleh mihonpi akikhetbeh ve'a hung sesen jong thilsoh umchan chu amu uvin, amaho lungkham tah in inlam ache tauve.
English: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshua jol le gol te, Galilee gam'a pat'a hinjui numeiho chengtoh, amaho chu gamla thimtah in adingun ahin galvet uve. Yeshua Long Avui-U
en: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.
text:
LUK 23:49
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshua jol le gol te, Galilee gam'a pat'a hinjui numeiho chengtoh, amaho chu gamla thimtah in adingun ahin galvet uve. Yeshua Long Avui-U
English: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.

tcz: Tun Joseph kiti mipha le chondih tah khat aume. Amachu Judate vaipoloi lah a khat ahi.
en: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man
text:
LUK 23:50
Thadou: Tun Joseph kiti mipha le chondih tah khat aume. Amachu Judate vaipoloi lah a khat ahi.
English: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

tcz: Ahin aman houlamkai dang ho thulhuhna sem le natoh chu ana noppeh lou ahi. Amachu Judea gam'a Arimathea khoa kon ahi, chule Pathen lenggam hung ding chu anga jing ahi.
en: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.
text:
LUK 23:51
Thadou: Ahin aman houlamkai dang ho thulhuhna sem le natoh chu ana noppeh lou ahi. Amachu Judea gam'a Arimathea khoa kon ahi, chule Pathen lenggam hung ding chu anga jing ahi.
English: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.

tcz: Ama Pilate koma achen Yeshua long chu athum'in ahi.
en: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
text:
LUK 23:52
Thadou: Ama Pilate koma achen Yeshua long chu athum'in ahi.
English: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

tcz: Chuin aman atahsa chu thingpel a pat in alalhan, tupat ponnem ajolsao thimtah khat in atom in, chule song kilai lhanthah khat ah alupsah tai.
en: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.
text:
LUK 23:53
Thadou: Chuin aman atahsa chu thingpel a pat in alalhan, tupat ponnem ajolsao thimtah khat in atom in, chule song kilai lhanthah khat ah alupsah tai.
English: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

tcz: Hiche chu kigotni nilhangkai don a vaigei thimtah a kibol ahi, ajeh chu Cholngah ni kipan ding kon cha ahitai.
en: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.
text:
LUK 23:54
Thadou: Hiche chu kigotni nilhangkai don a vaigei thimtah a kibol ahi, ajeh chu Cholngah ni kipan ding kon cha ahitai.
English: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

tcz: Atahsa akilah mang phat chun, Galilee a pat'a hung numei ho chun ahin jui yun, atahsa kikoina lhan chu agamu uvin ahi.
en: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.
text:
LUK 23:55
Thadou: Atahsa akilah mang phat chun, Galilee a pat'a hung numei ho chun ahin jui yun, atahsa kikoina lhan chu agamu uvin ahi.
English: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.

tcz: Chuin inlam acheuvin chule thil namtui le atahsa a nuding nuthei akisem uvin ahi. Ahin athilsem u ajo phat'un Cholngah ni anakipan tai, hijeh chun dan thun angeh dungjui in akichol tauve.
en: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.
text:
LUK 23:56
Thadou: Chuin inlam acheuvin chule thil namtui le atahsa a nuding nuthei akisem uvin ahi. Ahin athilsem u ajo phat'un Cholngah ni anakipan tai, hijeh chun dan thun angeh dungjui in akichol tauve.
English: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

tcz: Ahin nimasani jingpi tah in, numeiho chu lhan lam'ah acheuvin, thil namtui asem u jong akichoiyun ahi.
en: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.
text:
LUK 24:1
Thadou: Ahin nimasani jingpi tah in, numeiho chu lhan lam'ah acheuvin, thil namtui asem u jong akichoiyun ahi.
English: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

tcz: Lhan sung lut na'a um song anakitang doh chu agamu uve.
en: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
text:
LUK 24:2
Thadou: Lhan sung lut na'a um song anakitang doh chu agamu uve.
English: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

tcz: Hijeh chun alut un, ahivangin Yeshua long chu amutapouve.
en: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.
text:
LUK 24:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun alut un, ahivangin Yeshua long chu amutapouve.
English: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

tcz: Chutia lungboi tah'a adin laitah un, mini apettah in ahung kilah in, ponbang vallah lah akisil lhone.
en: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.
text:
LUK 24:4
Thadou: Chutia lungboi tah'a adin laitah un, mini apettah in ahung kilah in, ponbang vallah lah akisil lhone.
English: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

tcz: Numei ho chu atijauvin chule amaiyu tol'ah akunlhah sah un ahi. Chuin miteni chun ahin sei lhon in, “Ipi bol'a athiho lah'a ahingdoh khat nahol uham?
en: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?
text:
LUK 24:5
Thadou: Numei ho chu atijauvin chule amaiyu tol'ah akunlhah sah un ahi. Chuin miteni chun ahin sei lhon in, “Ipi bol'a athiho lah'a ahingdoh khat nahol uham?
English: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

tcz: Ama hikom'ah aumtapoi! Ama athilah a konin athoudoh tai! Galilee a aumlaiya nanaseipeh houchu geldoh un,
en: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,
text:
LUK 24:6
Thadou: Ama hikom'ah aumtapoi! Ama athilah a konin athoudoh tai! Galilee a aumlaiya nanaseipeh houchu geldoh un,
English: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

tcz: Mihem Chapa michonse ho khut'a pehdoh a umding, thingpel'a akhetbeh diu, chule anithum nile thoukit ding ahi, tia anasei chu,” atilhone.
en: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”
text:
LUK 24:7
Thadou: Mihem Chapa michonse ho khut'a pehdoh a umding, thingpel'a akhetbeh diu, chule anithum nile thoukit ding ahi, tia anasei chu,” atilhone.
English: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

tcz: Chuin amahon hiche hi anasei mongnai ti ageldoh un ahi.
en: They remembered his words,
text:
LUK 24:8
Thadou: Chuin amahon hiche hi anasei mongnai ti ageldoh un ahi.
English: They remembered his words,

tcz: Hijeh chun amaho lhan mun'a konin aseijui somlekhat ho–chule adangho jouse–thilsoh umchan seipeh dingin kintah in akile loi tauve.
en: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.
text:
LUK 24:9
Thadou: Hijeh chun amaho lhan mun'a konin aseijui somlekhat ho–chule adangho jouse–thilsoh umchan seipeh dingin kintah in akile loi tauve.
English: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

tcz: Solchah ho thilsoh umchan seipeh chu Mary Magdalene, Joanna, James nu Mary, chule numei adangho jong ahiuve.
en: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.
text:
LUK 24:10
Thadou: Solchah ho thilsoh umchan seipeh chu Mary Magdalene, Joanna, James nu Mary, chule numei adangho jong ahiuve.
English: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

tcz: Ahivangin miho ding chun athusim jah'u chu mohthu homkeo dan in agel uvin, hijeh chun atahsan tapouve.
en: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.
text:
LUK 24:11
Thadou: Ahivangin miho ding chun athusim jah'u chu mohthu homkeo dan in agel uvin, hijeh chun atahsan tapouve.
English: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.

tcz: Ahin Peter vang chu achomdoh in lhan veding chun alhaijel'in ahi. Abung'in aven ahileh tompon akeova um bouseh chu amun, chuin inlam akile kit in, ipi iti hitam alungdong lheh jeng tai. Emmaus Kho Lampia Yeshua Akilah
en: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.
text:
LUK 24:12
Thadou: Ahin Peter vang chu achomdoh in lhan veding chun alhaijel'in ahi. Abung'in aven ahileh tompon akeova um bouseh chu amun, chuin inlam akile kit in, ipi iti hitam alungdong lheh jeng tai. Emmaus Kho Lampia Yeshua Akilah
English: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

tcz: Hiche ni mama chun Yeshua nungjui mini, Emmaus kho jotna lampi, Jerusalem a pat mel sagia gamla achun ache lhone.
en: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.
text:
LUK 24:13
Thadou: Hiche ni mama chun Yeshua nungjui mini, Emmaus kho jotna lampi, Jerusalem a pat mel sagia gamla achun ache lhone.
English: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

tcz: Amanin lamjot toh thilsoh umchan jouse chungchang thudol kihoulim toh akop lhon ahi.
en: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.
text:
LUK 24:14
Thadou: Amanin lamjot toh thilsoh umchan jouse chungchang thudol kihoulim toh akop lhon ahi.
English: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

tcz: Hitiho jouse thu akihoulim lhon laiyin, Yeshua jong amatah kinloi tah in ahungin amanitoh alhon khom tai.
en: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.
text:
LUK 24:15
Thadou: Hitiho jouse thu akihoulim lhon laiyin, Yeshua jong amatah kinloi tah in ahungin amanitoh alhon khom tai.
English: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

tcz: Ahivangin Pathen in ahetdoh lhon louna din aumsah e.
en: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
text:
LUK 24:16
Thadou: Ahivangin Pathen in ahetdoh lhon louna din aumsah e.
English: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

tcz: Aman adongin, “Nalamjot pum lhon'a chu ipi thu lom lungluttah a nakihoulim lhon hitaimo?” ati. Chomkhat akhongai lhonin, amaiso lhon lungkham na maiso apulhon in.
en: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”
text:
LUK 24:17
Thadou: Aman adongin, “Nalamjot pum lhon'a chu ipi thu lom lungluttah a nakihoulim lhon hitaimo?” ati. Chomkhat akhongai lhonin, amaiso lhon lungkham na maiso apulhon in.
English: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

tcz: Chuin amani lah a khat pa, Cleopas chun adonbut in, “Tu niphabep masanga thilsoh ho jouse helou Jerusalem miho lah'a nang bouseh hin nate,” atilhone.
en: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”
text:
LUK 24:18
Thadou: Chuin amani lah a khat pa, Cleopas chun adonbut in, “Tu niphabep masanga thilsoh ho jouse helou Jerusalem miho lah'a nang bouseh hin nate,” atilhone.
English: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”

tcz: Yeshuan adong in, “Ipi thilsoh ho am?” ati. “Nazareth a hung kon Yeshua chunga thilsoh umchan ho,” tin aseipeh lhontai, “Ama thilkidang nasatah bolthei themgao khat anahin, chule Pathen le miho mitmu a thaneitah houhil ahi.
en: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

tcz: Ahivangin kathempu pipui hou le adang hou lamkai hon thina chan gotna changdin themmo achan'un, chule amahon thingpel'ah akhenbeh tauve.
en: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.
text:
LUK 24:20
Thadou: Ahivangin kathempu pipui hou le adang hou lamkai hon thina chan gotna changdin themmo achan'un, chule amahon thingpel'ah akhenbeh tauve.
English: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

tcz: Keihon Israel huhdoh dinga hungpa Messiah chu ahi tia kakineppiu ahi. Hiche hi nithum masanga thilsoh ahitai.
en: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.
text:
LUK 24:21
Thadou: Keihon Israel huhdoh dinga hungpa Messiah chu ahi tia kakineppiu ahi. Hiche hi nithum masanga thilsoh ahitai.
English: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

tcz: Chutichun keiho lah'a ama nungjui numei phabep khat tujingkah matah chun alhan'ah aum uvin, chule amaho ahung kileuvin kidangtah thulhut ahinpouvin ahi.
en: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

tcz: Amahon atahsa akiholmoi atiuvin, chule vantil amuuvin, aman Yeshua ahingkit tai ati.
en: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.
text:
LUK 24:23
Thadou: Amahon atahsa akiholmoi atiuvin, chule vantil amuuvin, aman Yeshua ahingkit tai ati.
English: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

tcz: Keiho lah'a pasal phabep khat avedingin alhaidoh un, atahbeh in, Yeshua long chu numei ho seibang chun anaum tapoi,” atilhone.
en: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”
text:
LUK 24:24
Thadou: Keiho lah'a pasal phabep khat avedingin alhaidoh un, atahbeh in, Yeshua long chu numei ho seibang chun anaum tapoi,” atilhone.
English: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amani jah'a, “Vo lungthim bei miho! Themgaohon Pathen Lekhabua ajihlut ho tahsan ding hahsa nasah uve.
en: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
text:
LUK 24:25
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan amani jah'a, “Vo lungthim bei miho! Themgaohon Pathen Lekhabua ajihlut ho tahsan ding hahsa nasah uve.
English: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

tcz: Messiah chu aloupina a alut masanga hitiho jouse hi athoh galkai ding ahi ti kichen tah a kivetsah anahilou ham?” ati.
en: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”
text:
LUK 24:26
Thadou: Messiah chu aloupina a alut masanga hitiho jouse hi athoh galkai ding ahi ti kichen tah a kivetsah anahilou ham?” ati.
English: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amani chu Mose le themgao lekhasut hojouse le Pathen Lekhabu jousea kipat in ama chungchang hilchet abolpeh in ahi.
en: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.
text:
LUK 24:27
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan amani chu Mose le themgao lekhasut hojouse le Pathen Lekhabu jousea kipat in ama chungchang hilchet abolpeh in ahi.
English: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

tcz: Hiche pet a hi amaho Emmaus kho lhung koncha ahitauve. Yeshua chu achejom ding dan in aum'in,
en: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.
text:
LUK 24:28
Thadou: Hiche pet a hi amaho Emmaus kho lhung koncha ahitauve. Yeshua chu achejom ding dan in aum'in,
English: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

tcz: ahin amanin alho lhonin, “Tujan keini komah gehtan, ajeh chu avaigei tai,” atilhone. Hitichun ama jong amani chutoh alhon tai.
en: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.
text:
LUK 24:29
Thadou: ahin amanin alho lhonin, “Tujan keini komah gehtan, ajeh chu avaigei tai,” atilhone. Hitichun ama jong amani chutoh alhon tai.
English: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.

tcz: Anne dinga atoulhah uchun, aman changlhah chu alan phatthei aboh'e. Chuin ahehbal in amani chu apen ahi.
en: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.
text:
LUK 24:30
Thadou: Anne dinga atoulhah uchun, aman changlhah chu alan phatthei aboh'e. Chuin ahehbal in amani chu apen ahi.
English: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.

tcz: Chupettah chun amit lhon ahung hahdoh in, chule amanin koi ahichu ahinhedoh lhon tai. Chuin hiche pettah chun Ama amangtai!
en: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.
text:
LUK 24:31
Thadou: Chupettah chun amit lhon ahung hahdoh in, chule amanin koi ahichu ahinhedoh lhon tai. Chuin hiche pettah chun Ama amangtai!
English: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.

tcz: Amani khat in khat jah'a asei lhon in, “Lampia ikihoulim uva Pathen Lekhabu hilchet abola chu ilungchang lhon kileojap bang louham?” atilhone.
en: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”
text:
LUK 24:32
Thadou: Amani khat in khat jah'a asei lhon in, “Lampia ikihoulim uva Pathen Lekhabu hilchet abola chu ilungchang lhon kileojap bang louham?” atilhone.
English: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”

tcz: Chule hiche nidan kah sung mama chun Jerusalem langah akile lhon tai. Chua chun seijui somlekhat le adang amahotoh anakikhom khom ho amulhon in,
en: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,
text:
LUK 24:33
Thadou: Chule hiche nidan kah sung mama chun Jerusalem langah akile lhon tai. Chua chun seijui somlekhat le adang amahotoh anakikhom khom ho amulhon in,
English: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

tcz: amahon, “Pakai chu tahbeh in athoudoh tai! Peter henga akilah'e!” tin ahinseiyuve.
en: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”
text:
LUK 24:34
Thadou: amahon, “Pakai chu tahbeh in athoudoh tai! Peter henga akilah'e!” tin ahinseiyuve.
English: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

tcz: Chuin Emmaus khoa pat hung tenin jong amani thusim, Yeshua aheng lhona lampia akijot laiyuva ahung kilah dan, chule changlhah ahin hebal phat'a ahin hetdoh lhondan, aseilhon in ahi.
en: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.
text:
LUK 24:35
Thadou: Chuin Emmaus khoa pat hung tenin jong amani thusim, Yeshua aheng lhona lampia akijot laiyuva ahung kilah dan, chule changlhah ahin hebal phat'a ahin hetdoh lhondan, aseilhon in ahi.
English: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

tcz: Chule chutia asei laitah uvin, Yeshua alah uva hetmanlou kah'in anadingin ahi. Aman ahinseiyin, “Chamnan naumpiu hen!” ahinti.
en: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
text:
LUK 24:36
Thadou: Chule chutia asei laitah uvin, Yeshua alah uva hetmanlou kah'in anadingin ahi. Aman ahinseiyin, “Chamnan naumpiu hen!” ahinti.
English: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

tcz: Ahivangin amaho abonchauvin atijauvin akichauvin, thilha mudan'in akigel uve!
en: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
text:
LUK 24:37
Thadou: Ahivangin amaho abonchauvin atijauvin akichauvin, thilha mudan'in akigel uve!
English: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

tcz: “Ipi jeh a kicha nahiu ham?” tin ahin dongin, “Ipi bol'a nalung sungu chu lungthoina a dim ham?
en: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?
text:
LUK 24:38
Thadou: “Ipi jeh a kicha nahiu ham?” tin ahin dongin, “Ipi bol'a nalung sungu chu lungthoina a dim ham?
English: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

tcz: Kakhut veuvin, kakeng veuvin, nanghon keima mong mong kahinai ti namu uve. Nei tham uvin lang thilha kahilou hi hechen un, ajeh chu thilhan tahsa mel tua neimu bangu hi aneipoi,” ati.
en: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”
text:
LUK 24:39
Thadou: Kakhut veuvin, kakeng veuvin, nanghon keima mong mong kahinai ti namu uve. Nei tham uvin lang thilha kahilou hi hechen un, ajeh chu thilhan tahsa mel tua neimu bangu hi aneipoi,” ati.
English: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

tcz: Thu aseitoh thon akhut le akeng avetsah in ahi.
en: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
text:
LUK 24:40
Thadou: Thu aseitoh thon akhut le akeng avetsah in ahi.
English: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

tcz: Chutichun amaho tahsan loutah in adingjing nalaiyun, kipana le lungdon nan adimset un ahi. Chuin aman ajah uva, “Neh ding nanei uvam?” ahinti.
en: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
text:
LUK 24:41
Thadou: Chutichun amaho tahsan loutah in adingjing nalaiyun, kipana le lungdon nan adimset un ahi. Chuin aman ajah uva, “Neh ding nanei uvam?” ahinti.
English: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

tcz: Amahon nga kikang khat apeuvin ahi,
en: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.
text:
LUK 24:42
Thadou: Amahon nga kikang khat apeuvin ahi,
English: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

tcz: chule aman hichu anen amahon aveuve.
en: He took them, and ate in front of them.
text:
LUK 24:43
Thadou: chule aman hichu anen amahon aveuve.
English: He took them, and ate in front of them.

tcz: Chuin Aman aseiyin, “Masanga nangho toh iumkhom laiyuva, kanaseipeh soh nahi tauve, Kei chungchang thudol Mose danthua, themgao ho lekhabua, chule labua kisun jouse chu guilhung ding ahi,” ati.
en: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”
text:
LUK 24:44
Thadou: Chuin Aman aseiyin, “Masanga nangho toh iumkhom laiyuva, kanaseipeh soh nahi tauve, Kei chungchang thudol Mose danthua, themgao ho lekhabua, chule labua kisun jouse chu guilhung ding ahi,” ati.
English: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”

tcz: Chuin aman alungkot u Pathen Lekhabua thuho ahetthei nadiuvin ahonpeh in ahi.
en: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.
text:
LUK 24:45
Thadou: Chuin aman alungkot u Pathen Lekhabua thuho ahetthei nadiuvin ahonpeh in ahi.
English: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

tcz: Chuin aseitai, “Henge, masanglai a pat'a chu Messiah hi thohgim ding chule thiding chule anithum ni le athilah'a kona thoudoh ding tia anakisun ahi.
en: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,
text:
LUK 24:46
Thadou: Chuin aseitai, “Henge, masanglai a pat'a chu Messiah hi thohgim ding chule thiding chule anithum ni le athilah'a kona thoudoh ding tia anakisun ahi.
English: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

tcz: Hitia jong hi anakisun ahi, hiche thuhi namtin jouse henga amin thaneina'a seiphonga umding ahi, Jerusalem a kipan ding: ‘Chonset ngaidamna alung hei jousea dingin aume.’
en: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
text:
LUK 24:47
Thadou: Hitia jong hi anakisun ahi, hiche thuhi namtin jouse henga amin thaneina'a seiphonga umding ahi, Jerusalem a kipan ding: ‘Chonset ngaidamna alung hei jousea dingin aume.’
English: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

tcz: Nangho hicheho jouse hettohsah nahiuve.
en: You are witnesses of these things.
text:
LUK 24:48
Thadou: Nangho hicheho jouse hettohsah nahiuve.
English: You are witnesses of these things.

tcz: Chuleh tua Lhagao Theng kahinsol peh ding nahiuve, kapa anakitepna banga. Ahin Lhagao Theng ahung'a van'a kon thilboltheina nadimset tokah uvin hiche khopi a hin um uvin,” ati.
en: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”
text:
LUK 24:49
Thadou: Chuleh tua Lhagao Theng kahinsol peh ding nahiuve, kapa anakitepna banga. Ahin Lhagao Theng ahung'a van'a kon thilboltheina nadimset tokah uvin hiche khopi a hin um uvin,” ati.
English: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu Bethany langah apuiyin, vanlam'a akhut alhangin amaho chu phatthei aboh'e.
en: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.
text:
LUK 24:50
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu Bethany langah apuiyin, vanlam'a akhut alhangin amaho chu phatthei aboh'e.
English: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

tcz: Amaho phatthei aboh laitah in, amaho chu adalhan chule van langah lahtou vin aumtai.
en: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.
text:
LUK 24:51
Thadou: Amaho phatthei aboh laitah in, amaho chu adalhan chule van langah lahtou vin aumtai.
English: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

tcz: Hijeh chun amahon amachu ahouvun chuin Jerusalem lamah kipana dimset pumin ahung kile tauve.
en: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
text:
LUK 24:52
Thadou: Hijeh chun amahon amachu ahouvun chuin Jerusalem lamah kipana dimset pumin ahung kile tauve.
English: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

tcz: Chuin aphat jouseu chu houin ah Pathen vahchoinan amang tauve.
en: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
text:
LUK 24:53
Thadou: Chuin aphat jouseu chu houin ah Pathen vahchoinan amang tauve.
English: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

tcz: Thu chu atil abul'a ana umsa ahi. Thu chu Pathen toh umkhom ahin, chule Thu chu Pathen ahi.
en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
text:
JHN 1:1
Thadou: Thu chu atil abul'a ana umsa ahi. Thu chu Pathen toh umkhom ahin, chule Thu chu Pathen ahi.
English: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

tcz: Ama chu atil abul'a Pathen toh umkhomsa ahi.
en: The same was in the beginning with God.
text:
JHN 1:2
Thadou: Ama chu atil abul'a Pathen toh umkhomsa ahi.
English: The same was in the beginning with God.

tcz: Pathen in ama vanga thil jouse anasem ahin, chule Ama louva kisem doh khatcha jong aumpoi.
en: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
text:
JHN 1:3
Thadou: Pathen in ama vanga thil jouse anasem ahin, chule Ama louva kisem doh khatcha jong aumpoi.
English: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

tcz: Thu chun thil jouse hinna apeh ahin, chule Ama hinna chun amichang cheh vah apeh ahitai.
en: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
text:
JHN 1:4
Thadou: Thu chun thil jouse hinna apeh ahin, chule Ama hinna chun amichang cheh vah apeh ahitai.
English: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

tcz: Vah chun muthim lah ahinsal in, chule muthin'in vah chu asumit joupoi.
en: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
text:
JHN 1:5
Thadou: Vah chun muthim lah ahinsal in, chule muthin'in vah chu asumit joupoi.
English: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

tcz: Pathen in mikhat, Twilutsah John ahin sol'in,
en: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.
text:
JHN 1:6
Thadou: Pathen in mikhat, Twilutsah John ahin sol'in,
English: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

tcz: aman vah thu ahettoh sah chu ama thuseiya kona amichang cheh in atahsan thei na dingu ahi.
en: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
text:
JHN 1:7
Thadou: aman vah thu ahettoh sah chu ama thuseiya kona amichang cheh in atahsan thei na dingu ahi.
English: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

tcz: John amatah chu vah ahipoi, vah thudol hettohsah'a seiphong chu ahije.
en: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
text:
JHN 1:8
Thadou: John amatah chu vah ahipoi, vah thudol hettohsah'a seiphong chu ahije.
English: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

tcz: Vannoiya hunga, amichang cheh vah hung pea, Ama bou chu vah tahbeh ahi.
en: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
text:
JHN 1:9
Thadou: Vannoiya hunga, amichang cheh vah hung pea, Ama bou chu vah tahbeh ahi.
English: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

tcz: Asemsa vannoiya ama ana hungin, hinla vannoiyin ama ahedoh pouve.
en: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
text:
JHN 1:10
Thadou: Asemsa vannoiya ama ana hungin, hinla vannoiyin ama ahedoh pouve.
English: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

tcz: Ama amite henga anahung chun, amiten ama ana sang tapouve.
en: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
text:
JHN 1:11
Thadou: Ama amite henga anahung chun, amiten ama ana sang tapouve.
English: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

tcz: Ahivangin koi hileh ama tahsan le ama kisa'n jouse chu Pathen chate hitheina thuneina apetai.
en: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
text:
JHN 1:12
Thadou: Ahivangin koi hileh ama tahsan le ama kisa'n jouse chu Pathen chate hitheina thuneina apetai.
English: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

tcz: Amaho penthah chu tahsa pen ngai'a mihem lung lam'a kona tahsa lungon'a penga ahipouvin, Pathen'a kon peng'a ahibou'uve.
en: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
text:
JHN 1:13
Thadou: Amaho penthah chu tahsa pen ngai'a mihem lung lam'a kona tahsa lungon'a penga ahipouvin, Pathen'a kon peng'a ahibou'uve.
English: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

tcz: Hitihin Thu chu tahsapu mihem ahung kisoh in, chule ilah uva ahung chengtai. Ama lhadahlou ngailut le kitahna dimset ahin, keihon ama loupina, Pa Chapa changkhat seh ahina loupitah chu kamutauve.
en: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
text:
JHN 1:14
Thadou: Hitihin Thu chu tahsapu mihem ahung kisoh in, chule ilah uva ahung chengtai. Ama lhadahlou ngailut le kitahna dimset ahin, keihon ama loupina, Pa Chapa changkhat seh ahina loupitah chu kamutauve.
English: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

tcz: John chun Yeshua thudol ahettohsah in, mipiho henga asam'in “Hichepa hi ahi, athudol kana hettohsah chu, Kanunga mi khat ahungin, ama chu kei sanga gamchenga lenjo ahi, ajehchu ama keima masang peh'a anaumsa ahitai, kati chu,” ati.
en: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
text:
JHN 1:15
Thadou: John chun Yeshua thudol ahettohsah in, mipiho henga asam'in “Hichepa hi ahi, athudol kana hettohsah chu, Kanunga mi khat ahungin, ama chu kei sanga gamchenga lenjo ahi, ajehchu ama keima masang peh'a anaumsa ahitai, kati chu,” ati.
English: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

tcz: Ama aning lhinsetna kona eiho jouse lungset vangbohna hi aban ban'a changa ihitauve.
en: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
text:
JHN 1:16
Thadou: Ama aning lhinsetna kona eiho jouse lungset vangbohna hi aban ban'a changa ihitauve.
English: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh danthu chu Mose a kon ahin, hinla lhadahlou Pathen mingailut na le kitahna chu Yeshua Messiah vanga hungah ahibouve.
en: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
text:
JHN 1:17
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh danthu chu Mose a kon ahin, hinla lhadahlou Pathen mingailut na le kitahna chu Yeshua Messiah vanga hungah ahibouve.
English: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

tcz: Koima Pathen mukha ana umpoi, Ahin atepi umlou, amatah Pathen Chapa chang khat seh, Pa lung to kinaicha umjing chun, eiho henga aphondoh ahitai.
en: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
text:
JHN 1:18
Thadou: Koima Pathen mukha ana umpoi, Ahin atepi umlou, amatah Pathen Chapa chang khat seh, Pa lung to kinaicha umjing chun, eiho henga aphondoh ahitai.
English: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

tcz: Hiche hi Judate lamkai hon Jerusalem'a pat'a thempu ho leh Hou'in a sottol le ho, John henga “Nang koi nahim?” tia aga dohsah nauva, John in ahettohsah chu ahi.
en: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
text:
JHN 1:19
Thadou: Hiche hi Judate lamkai hon Jerusalem'a pat'a thempu ho leh Hou'in a sottol le ho, John henga “Nang koi nahim?” tia aga dohsah nauva, John in ahettohsah chu ahi.
English: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

tcz: Ama ahung kiphong doh paijin, “Keima Messiah kahipoi” ati jenge.
en: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
text:
JHN 1:20
Thadou: Ama ahung kiphong doh paijin, “Keima Messiah kahipoi” ati jenge.
English: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

tcz: Chuphatnin amahon adongun, “Achutile aphai, koi nahi ham? Nangma Elijah nahim?” atiuve. Aman adonbut'in “Kahipoi” ati. “Ahile kagin chatnu themgao chu nahim?” atiuve. Aman “Kahipoi” ati.
en: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”
text:
JHN 1:21
Thadou: Chuphatnin amahon adongun, “Achutile aphai, koi nahi ham? Nangma Elijah nahim?” atiuve. Aman adonbut'in “Kahipoi” ati. “Ahile kagin chatnu themgao chu nahim?” atiuve. Aman “Kahipoi” ati.
English: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

tcz: “Achutile koi nahim? Eihinsol ho koma lhutding donbutna kangai chauve. Nangman koi kahi nakiti em?” atiuve.
en: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
text:
JHN 1:22
Thadou: “Achutile koi nahim? Eihinsol ho koma lhutding donbutna kangai chauve. Nangman koi kahi nakiti em?” atiuve.
English: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

tcz: John in adonbut'in Keima gamthip a khosam awgin'in, “Pakai hung nading lampi sutheng un,” tia Isaiah themgao thusei chu kahi, ati.
en: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”
text:
JHN 1:23
Thadou: John in adonbut'in Keima gamthip a khosam awgin'in, “Pakai hung nading lampi sutheng un,” tia Isaiah themgao thusei chu kahi, ati.
English: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

tcz: Hichun Pharisai ho ahung kisol hochun,
en: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
text:
JHN 1:24
Thadou: Hichun Pharisai ho ahung kisol hochun,
English: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

tcz: Ama adong un, “Messiah nahi louva, Elijah nahi louva, chule themgao nahilou le, ipi thuneina naneiya Baptize nachan sah ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
text:
JHN 1:25
Thadou: Ama adong un, “Messiah nahi louva, Elijah nahi louva, chule themgao nahilou le, ipi thuneina naneiya Baptize nachan sah ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

tcz: Chuin John in amaho jah'a, “Keiman twiya Baptize kachan sah ahin, ahinlah mipi lah'a nanghon nahet dohlou'u mikhat aume.
en: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
text:
JHN 1:26
Thadou: Chuin John in amaho jah'a, “Keiman twiya Baptize kachan sah ahin, ahinlah mipi lah'a nanghon nahet dohlou'u mikhat aume.
English: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

tcz: Ama keima nunga hung ahivangin keima ama soh dinga jong lhingjou lou chule akengchot khao sutlham dinga jong kilom kahipoi,” ati.
en: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
text:
JHN 1:27
Thadou: Ama keima nunga hung ahivangin keima ama soh dinga jong lhingjou lou chule akengchot khao sutlham dinga jong kilom kahipoi,” ati.
English: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

tcz: Hicheng chu Jordan vadung gal solam Bethany mun'a John in Baptize achansah na'a thilsoh ahi.
en: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
text:
JHN 1:28
Thadou: Hicheng chu Jordan vadung gal solam Bethany mun'a John in Baptize achansah na'a thilsoh ahi.
English: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

tcz: Ajingin John in amaheng lam'a Yeshua ahung amun, “Veuvin, vannoi chonset pomang Pathen kelngoinou khu,”
en: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
text:
JHN 1:29
Thadou: Ajingin John in amaheng lam'a Yeshua ahung amun, “Veuvin, vannoi chonset pomang Pathen kelngoinou khu,”
English: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

tcz: Amahi ahi keiman kasei, kanunga hunga kei sanga gamchenga lenjo, kati chu, ajehchu ama kei um masang peh'a ana umsa ahitai, ati.
en: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
text:
JHN 1:30
Thadou: Amahi ahi keiman kasei, kanunga hunga kei sanga gamchenga lenjo, kati chu, ajehchu ama kei um masang peh'a ana umsa ahitai, ati.
English: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

tcz: “Keiman ama Christa ahilam kana hepoi, ahivangin ama chu Israel lah'a phondoh'a aumna ding'a keiman twiya Baptize kachan sah ahi,” ati.
en: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”
text:
JHN 1:31
Thadou: “Keiman ama Christa ahilam kana hepoi, ahivangin ama chu Israel lah'a phondoh'a aumna ding'a keiman twiya Baptize kachan sah ahi,” ati.
English: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

tcz: Chuin John in athu hettohsah nan, “Keiman van'a kon'a Lhagao Theng vakhu banga ahung lenlhah'a achunga aumden kamui.”
en: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
text:
JHN 1:32
Thadou: Chuin John in athu hettohsah nan, “Keiman van'a kon'a Lhagao Theng vakhu banga ahung lenlhah'a achunga aumden kamui.”
English: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

tcz: Keiman ama ahilam kana hepoi, ahivang'in Pathen in twiya Baptize chan sah dinga eisol chun, aman kakoma “Achunga Lhagao Theng achuh'a a umden namupa chun, Lhagao Thenga baptize ahin chan sah ding ahi,”
en: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
text:
JHN 1:33
Thadou: Keiman ama ahilam kana hepoi, ahivang'in Pathen in twiya Baptize chan sah dinga eisol chun, aman kakoma “Achunga Lhagao Theng achuh'a a umden namupa chun, Lhagao Thenga baptize ahin chan sah ding ahi,”
English: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

tcz: “Chule keiman Yeshua chunga hicheng asopet hi kamun, hijeh'a chu amahi Pathen in alhen doh achapa khat seh chu ahi tia kahettoh sah ahitai,” ati.
en: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
text:
JHN 1:34
Thadou: “Chule keiman Yeshua chunga hicheng asopet hi kamun, hijeh'a chu amahi Pathen in alhen doh achapa khat seh chu ahi tia kahettoh sah ahitai,” ati.
English: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

tcz: Ajing kit'in, John aseijui mini toh adinpet un,
en: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
text:
JHN 1:35
Thadou: Ajing kit'in, John aseijui mini toh adinpet un,
English: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

tcz: Yeshuan ahinjotpa chu amun, ama chu aven, “Veuvin Pathen kelngoinou khu,” ati.
en: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
text:
JHN 1:36
Thadou: Yeshuan ahinjotpa chu amun, ama chu aven, “Veuvin Pathen kelngoinou khu,” ati.
English: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

tcz: Chuin John seijui teni chun athusei chu ajalhon in, Yeshua nung ajuilhon tai.
en: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
text:
JHN 1:37
Thadou: Chuin John seijui teni chun athusei chu ajalhon in, Yeshua nung ajuilhon tai.
English: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua akihei leh amanin ajuilhon chu amun, “Ipi nangai chat lhon ham?” atitai. Amanin adonbut lhon'in “Rabbi” (Hichu houhil tina ahi) hoiya na umji ham? atilhon e.
en: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
text:
JHN 1:38
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua akihei leh amanin ajuilhon chu amun, “Ipi nangai chat lhon ham?” atitai. Amanin adonbut lhon'in “Rabbi” (Hichu houhil tina ahi) hoiya na umji ham? atilhon e.
English: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

tcz: Chuin aman, “Hunglhon in hungve lhon in,” ati. Amani Yeshua toh akilhon khom lhonin, aumna chu agamu lhon tai. Chule hiche nikho chun aumkhom tauve. Hichu nilhangkai nidan li don ahi.
en: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
text:
JHN 1:39
Thadou: Chuin aman, “Hunglhon in hungve lhon in,” ati. Amani Yeshua toh akilhon khom lhonin, aumna chu agamu lhon tai. Chule hiche nikho chun aumkhom tauve. Hichu nilhangkai nidan li don ahi.
English: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

tcz: John thuseija, Yeshua nung jui teni lah'a khat joh chu, Simon Peter naopa Andrew chu ahi.
en: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
text:
JHN 1:40
Thadou: John thuseija, Yeshua nung jui teni lah'a khat joh chu, Simon Peter naopa Andrew chu ahi.
English: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

tcz: Andrew chun asopipa Simon agahol doh in ajah'a, “Keihon Messiah (Christa tina ahi) kamu tauve,” ati.
en: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
text:
JHN 1:41
Thadou: Andrew chun asopipa Simon agahol doh in ajah'a, “Keihon Messiah (Christa tina ahi) kamu tauve,” ati.
English: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

tcz: Chuin Andrew in Simon chu Yeshua henga ahinpuiyin ahi. Hichun Yeshuan Simon chu aven ajah'a, “Nangma John chapa Simon nahi, hijongle Cephas kisah ding nahitai. (Hichu Peter tina ahi).”
en: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
text:
JHN 1:42
Thadou: Chuin Andrew in Simon chu Yeshua henga ahinpuiyin ahi. Hichun Yeshuan Simon chu aven ajah'a, “Nangma John chapa Simon nahi, hijongle Cephas kisah ding nahitai. (Hichu Peter tina ahi).”
English: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

tcz: Ajingin Yeshua Galilee lam'a che dingin aume. Hichun aman Philip amun, ajah'a “Hungin neijuijin,” ati.
en: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
text:
JHN 1:43
Thadou: Ajingin Yeshua Galilee lam'a che dingin aume. Hichun aman Philip amun, ajah'a “Hungin neijuijin,” ati.
English: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

tcz: Philip chu Andrew leh Peter chenna khopi Bethsaida kho'a kon ahi.
en: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
text:
JHN 1:44
Thadou: Philip chu Andrew leh Peter chenna khopi Bethsaida kho'a kon ahi.
English: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

tcz: Chuin Philip in Nathanael aholdoh'in ajah'a, “Mose le themgao hon athudol anasut'u amapa tah chu kamutauve. Ama chu Nazareth khomi, Joseph chapa, Yeshua ahi,” ati.
en: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
text:
JHN 1:45
Thadou: Chuin Philip in Nathanael aholdoh'in ajah'a, “Mose le themgao hon athudol anasut'u amapa tah chu kamutauve. Ama chu Nazareth khomi, Joseph chapa, Yeshua ahi,” ati.
English: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

tcz: Hichun Nathanael in adatmo lheh in, “Nazareth khoa kon'a pha sohdoh thei hinam?” ati. Philip in adonbut'in “Hungin nangma tah in hungven” ati.
en: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
text:
JHN 1:46
Thadou: Hichun Nathanael in adatmo lheh in, “Nazareth khoa kon'a pha sohdoh thei hinam?” ati. Philip in adonbut'in “Hungin nangma tah in hungven” ati.
English: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

tcz: A kom lhon'a amani ahung lhon chu Yeshuan amun, ajah lhon'a, “Phat lhemna beihel mikitahpa, Israel chapa dihtah chu tun aumtai,” ati.
en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
text:
JHN 1:47
Thadou: A kom lhon'a amani ahung lhon chu Yeshuan amun, ajah lhon'a, “Phat lhemna beihel mikitahpa, Israel chapa dihtah chu tun aumtai,” ati.
English: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

tcz: Nathenael in adongin, “Iti neihet jeng ham?” ati. Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Philip in naholdoh masanga theichang phung noiya na umpet'a chu kamu n ahitai,” ati.
en: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
text:
JHN 1:48
Thadou: Nathenael in adongin, “Iti neihet jeng ham?” ati. Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Philip in naholdoh masanga theichang phung noiya na umpet'a chu kamu n ahitai,” ati.
English: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

tcz: Chuin Nathanael tijatah'in, “Rabbi nangma Pathen Chapa, Israelte lengpa nahi,” tin aphongtai.
en: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
text:
JHN 1:49
Thadou: Chuin Nathanael tijatah'in, “Rabbi nangma Pathen Chapa, Israelte lengpa nahi,” tin aphongtai.
English: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan adongin, “Theichang phung noiya na umpet kamu ahitai, kati jeh'a chu natahsan ham? Hiche sanga chungnungjo namu ding ahi,” ati.
en: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
text:
JHN 1:50
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan adongin, “Theichang phung noiya na umpet kamu ahitai, kati jeh'a chu natahsan ham? Hiche sanga chungnungjo namu ding ahi,” ati.
English: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

tcz: Chujouvin ama jah'a, “Atahbeh kaseipeh nahi, nangman van akihon'a chule Pathen vantil ho Mihem Chapa chunga akaltou le akumsuh namu ding ahi, ajehchu ama tah chu van le lei kimatna kalbilei ahi,” ati. Cana khoa moupui golvah
en: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
text:
JHN 1:51
Thadou: Chujouvin ama jah'a, “Atahbeh kaseipeh nahi, nangman van akihon'a chule Pathen vantil ho Mihem Chapa chunga akaltou le akumsuh namu ding ahi, ajehchu ama tah chu van le lei kimatna kalbilei ahi,” ati. Cana khoa moupui golvah
English: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

tcz: Ajingin Galilee gamsunga Cana khoa kichena golvah kingon khat aumin ahi. Chua chun Yeshua nu jong aumiin,
en: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.
text:
JHN 2:1
Thadou: Ajingin Galilee gamsunga Cana khoa kichena golvah kingon khat aumin ahi. Chua chun Yeshua nu jong aumiin,
English: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

tcz: Chule hiche kingona'a chun Yeshua leh aseijui ho jong akouvu ahi.
en: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.
text:
JHN 2:2
Thadou: Chule hiche kingona'a chun Yeshua leh aseijui ho jong akouvu ahi.
English: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

tcz: Golvahna aum petnin lengpi twi alhing tahih in, anu chun Yeshua jah'a “Lengpi twi anei tapouve,” ati.
en: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”
text:
JHN 2:3
Thadou: Golvahna aum petnin lengpi twi alhing tahih in, anu chun Yeshua jah'a “Lengpi twi anei tapouve,” ati.
English: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”

tcz: “Ngailut umtah numei, hichu eiho boipidi ahipoi” tia Yeshuan adonbut ahi. “Keima phat lhing loulai hichu,” ati.
en: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
text:
JHN 2:4
Thadou: “Ngailut umtah numei, hichu eiho boipidi ahipoi” tia Yeshuan adonbut ahi. “Keima phat lhing loulai hichu,” ati.
English: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”

tcz: Ahivangin anu chun lhacha ho jah'a, “Aman najah uva asei ipi hijongleh bol un,” ati.
en: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
text:
JHN 2:5
Thadou: Ahivangin anu chun lhacha ho jah'a, “Aman najah uva asei ipi hijongleh bol un,” ati.
English: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

tcz: Akom tah uva chun Judate dan dung jui'a kisuhtheng na songbel lentah gup uma ahi. Bel khat chu twi-thei dim som nia pat somthum dol cheh ahi.
en: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
text:
JHN 2:6
Thadou: Akom tah uva chun Judate dan dung jui'a kisuhtheng na songbel lentah gup uma ahi. Bel khat chu twi-thei dim som nia pat somthum dol cheh ahi.
English: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

tcz: Yeshuan soh ho jah'a “Songbel ho chu twi sung dimun,” ati. Amahon songbel ho chu twi asung dim phatnun,
en: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.
text:
JHN 2:7
Thadou: Yeshuan soh ho jah'a “Songbel ho chu twi sung dimun,” ati. Amahon songbel ho chu twi asung dim phatnun,
English: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

tcz: Aman ajah'uva, “Tun phabep thaldoh unlang golvah vaihompa henga choiyun,” ati. Hiti chun lhacha ho chun athupeh bang chun aboltauve.
en: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.
text:
JHN 2:8
Thadou: Aman ajah'uva, “Tun phabep thaldoh unlang golvah vaihompa henga choiyun,” ati. Hiti chun lhacha ho chun athupeh bang chun aboltauve.
English: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

tcz: Golvah vaihompa chun, twisih lengpi twi kisosah chu atep khah phatnin, ahung kondohna hechen louvin (Lhacha hon vang aheuve), moulang chu akoutai.
en: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom
text:
JHN 2:9
Thadou: Golvah vaihompa chun, twisih lengpi twi kisosah chu atep khah phatnin, ahung kondohna hechen louvin (Lhacha hon vang aheuve), moulang chu akoutai.
English: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom

tcz: Aman ajah'a, “Kinbol'a chun lengpi twi chihpen ahomdoh masa jin, mihon adon khop tengle, adaojep ahomji bouve. Ahin nangman tugeiyin achih pen nahom nalaiye!” ati.
en: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”
text:
JHN 2:10
Thadou: Aman ajah'a, “Kinbol'a chun lengpi twi chihpen ahomdoh masa jin, mihon adon khop tengle, adaojep ahomji bouve. Ahin nangman tugeiyin achih pen nahom nalaiye!” ati.
English: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

tcz: Galilee gam'a Cana khoa hiche melchih na kidang abol hi ama loupi kiphon dohna dinga anatoh masapen ahi. Chuin aseijuiten ama atahsan tauve.
en: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
text:
JHN 2:11
Thadou: Galilee gam'a Cana khoa hiche melchih na kidang abol hi ama loupi kiphon dohna dinga anatoh masapen ahi. Chuin aseijuiten ama atahsan tauve.
English: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

tcz: Kichena golvah kichai jin, ama le anu toh, asopiho toh, chule aseijui ho toh Capernaum a nikho phabep din ache tauvin ahi.
en: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.
text:
JHN 2:12
Thadou: Kichena golvah kichai jin, ama le anu toh, asopiho toh, chule aseijui ho toh Capernaum a nikho phabep din ache tauvin ahi.
English: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

tcz: Chuin Judah te kalchuh kut anai phat in, Yeshua Jerusalem'a achetai.
en: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
text:
JHN 2:13
Thadou: Chuin Judah te kalchuh kut anai phat in, Yeshua Jerusalem'a achetai.
English: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

tcz: Houin sunga chun aman kivei mihon kilhaina thilto ding bongho, kelngoiho chule vapal ho ajoh'uva chuleh sum lhengho atouvu amu dohtai.
en: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
text:
JHN 2:14
Thadou: Houin sunga chun aman kivei mihon kilhaina thilto ding bongho, kelngoiho chule vapal ho ajoh'uva chuleh sum lhengho atouvu amu dohtai.
English: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan khao phabep'a jepna ding asem in, amaho jouse chu Houin a konin adeldoh in, chule aman bongho le kelngoi ho anodoh'in, sum lhengho sumnong chu athethang peh'in chule adokhangu alekhup pehtai.
en: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.
text:
JHN 2:15
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan khao phabep'a jepna ding asem in, amaho jouse chu Houin a konin adeldoh in, chule aman bongho le kelngoi ho anodoh'in, sum lhengho sumnong chu athethang peh'in chule adokhangu alekhup pehtai.
English: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.

tcz: Chuin, vapal joh ho koma achen ajah uva, “Hiche hohi hilai mun'a konin podoh un. Kapa In chu nanghon kailhang mun sosah hih un,” ati.
en: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
text:
JHN 2:16
Thadou: Chuin, vapal joh ho koma achen ajah uva, “Hiche hohi hilai mun'a konin podoh un. Kapa In chu nanghon kailhang mun sosah hih un,” ati.
English: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

tcz: Hichun aseijuiten, Pathen lekhabua themgao thusei, “Na-in dinga katompan hin katha jouse eine chaiye,” tichu ahin gel doh tauve.
en: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”
text:
JHN 2:17
Thadou: Hichun aseijuiten, Pathen lekhabua themgao thusei, “Na-in dinga katompan hin katha jouse eine chaiye,” tichu ahin gel doh tauve.
English: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”

tcz: Ahivangin Judah vaipo hon ajah'a “Ipi ham nabol? Hitobang bolna dinga thuneina Pathen in napeh mong ahileh amelchihna kidang khat neimusah un,” atiuve.
en: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”
text:
JHN 2:18
Thadou: Ahivangin Judah vaipo hon ajah'a “Ipi ham nabol? Hitobang bolna dinga thuneina Pathen in napeh mong ahileh amelchihna kidang khat neimusah un,” atiuve.
English: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Aphai, hiche Houin hi suchim un, chule Keiman nithum in tungdoh inge,” ati.
en: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”
text:
JHN 2:19
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Aphai, hiche Houin hi suchim un, chule Keiman nithum in tungdoh inge,” ati.
English: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

tcz: Hichun amaho tijatah'in, “Hiche Houin sah na a kum som li le kum gup jen lut'a, nangin nithum'a iti nasah doh ding ong?” atiuve.
en: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”
text:
JHN 2:20
Thadou: Hichun amaho tijatah'in, “Hiche Houin sah na a kum som li le kum gup jen lut'a, nangin nithum'a iti nasah doh ding ong?” atiuve.
English: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

tcz: Ahivangin, Yeshuan hiche Houin ati chu Ama tahsa aseina ahibouve.
en: But he spoke of the temple of his body.
text:
JHN 2:21
Thadou: Ahivangin, Yeshuan hiche Houin ati chu Ama tahsa aseina ahibouve.
English: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

tcz: Hiche hi Ama thina a kona kaithouva a um nung chun, aseijuiten ipi aseina ahi ahin geldoh un, Pathen lekhabua thuho leh Yeshua thusei ho atahsan tauve.
en: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.
text:
JHN 2:22
Thadou: Hiche hi Ama thina a kona kaithouva a um nung chun, aseijuiten ipi aseina ahi ahin geldoh un, Pathen lekhabua thuho leh Yeshua thusei ho atahsan tauve.
English: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.

tcz: Kalchuh kut laiya, Jerusalem'a aumpet'a Yeshuan thil kidang melchihna abolho jeh chun mitamtah in ama atahsan tauve.
en: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.
text:
JHN 2:23
Thadou: Kalchuh kut laiya, Jerusalem'a aumpet'a Yeshuan thil kidang melchihna abolho jeh chun mitamtah in ama atahsan tauve.
English: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

tcz: Ahivangin amaho chu Yeshuan atahsan poi, ajehchu mihem hina chu aman ahetsa ahi.
en: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,
text:
JHN 2:24
Thadou: Ahivangin amaho chu Yeshuan atahsan poi, ajehchu mihem hina chu aman ahetsa ahi.
English: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

tcz: Ama dingin mikhat thudol adang khat in ama henga hettohsah angaipoi, ajeh chu mijouse lungsung ahetsa ahi.
en: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
text:
JHN 2:25
Thadou: Ama dingin mikhat thudol adang khat in ama henga hettohsah angaipoi, ajeh chu mijouse lungsung ahetsa ahi.
English: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

tcz: Pharisee mi amin Nicodemus kiti Judah teho'u lamkai khat aum e.
en: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
text:
JHN 3:1
Thadou: Pharisee mi amin Nicodemus kiti Judah teho'u lamkai khat aum e.
English: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

tcz: Amapa chu jankhat Yeshua henga ahungin Yeshua jah'a, “Houhil, keiho dinga Pathen in nahin sol ahi kaheuve; melchihna kidang hijat nabol hohi Pathen'a kon nahi aphot chetna ahitai,” ati.
en: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
text:
JHN 3:2
Thadou: Amapa chu jankhat Yeshua henga ahungin Yeshua jah'a, “Houhil, keiho dinga Pathen in nahin sol ahi kaheuve; melchihna kidang hijat nabol hohi Pathen'a kon nahi aphot chetna ahitai,” ati.
English: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, nangma napen kit loule Pathen lenggam namu lou ding ahi,” ati.
en: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
text:
JHN 3:3
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, nangma napen kit loule Pathen lenggam namu lou ding ahi,” ati.
English: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

tcz: Nicodemus chun datmo tah in, “Mi ateh nunga iti anu naobu a lelut kit'a hung peng kit thei ding ham?” ati.
en: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”
text:
JHN 3:4
Thadou: Nicodemus chun datmo tah in, “Mi ateh nunga iti anu naobu a lelut kit'a hung peng kit thei ding ham?” ati.
English: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Thutah chu ahileh, twiya le lhagaova apenlou le koima Pathen lenggam alut thei poi.
en: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
text:
JHN 3:5
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Thutah chu ahileh, twiya le lhagaova apenlou le koima Pathen lenggam alut thei poi.
English: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

tcz: Mihem tahsaphe a penga chu tahsa a hinna bou ahin, ahivangin Lhagao Thenga penga chu Lhagaova hinna chang ahi.
en: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
text:
JHN 3:6
Thadou: Mihem tahsaphe a penga chu tahsa a hinna bou ahin, ahivangin Lhagao Thenga penga chu Lhagaova hinna chang ahi.
English: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangma napen kit ding ahi, kati chu datmo hih'in.
en: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’
text:
JHN 3:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun nangma napen kit ding ahi, kati chu datmo hih'in.
English: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’

tcz: Huikhu anopna lam lam'a anungin, nangin agin najan, ahivangin hoiya hungkon hoilam ajot nahepoi, chutobang chun Lhagaova pengho jong nangin nahethei poi,” ati.
en: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”
text:
JHN 3:8
Thadou: Huikhu anopna lam lam'a anungin, nangin agin najan, ahivangin hoiya hungkon hoilam ajot nahepoi, chutobang chun Lhagaova pengho jong nangin nahethei poi,” ati.
English: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

tcz: Chuin Nicodemus chun ajah'a “Hiche ho chu iti hithei ding ham?” ati.
en: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
text:
JHN 3:9
Thadou: Chuin Nicodemus chun ajah'a “Hiche ho chu iti hithei ding ham?” ati.
English: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nangla Judah te houhil pipu khat nahin, hiche hohi iti nahet thei lou ham?
en: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
text:
JHN 3:10
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Nangla Judah te houhil pipu khat nahin, hiche hohi iti nahet thei lou ham?
English: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

tcz: Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, keihon kahet kaseiyu ahin, kamu kahettohsah'u ahi; ahivangin kahettohsah'u hi nanghon nasang pouve.
en: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
text:
JHN 3:11
Thadou: Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, keihon kahet kaseiyu ahin, kamu kahettohsah'u ahi; ahivangin kahettohsah'u hi nanghon nasang pouve.
English: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

tcz: Keiman leiset thil ho kaseiya natahsan lou leh, van'a thil ho thudol seileng iti natahsan ding ham?
en: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
text:
JHN 3:12
Thadou: Keiman leiset thil ho kaseiya natahsan lou leh, van'a thil ho thudol seileng iti natahsan ding ham?
English: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

tcz: Koima van'a akal'in, ahung kile khapoi; ahivangin Mihem Chapa vang chu van'a kona hung kumlha ahi.
en: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
text:
JHN 3:13
Thadou: Koima van'a akal'in, ahung kile khapoi; ahivangin Mihem Chapa vang chu van'a kona hung kumlha ahi.
English: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

tcz: Chuleh Mose in gamthip'a thing'a sum-eng gul adop sang banga chu, Mihem Chapa kidom sang ding ahi.
en: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
text:
JHN 3:14
Thadou: Chuleh Mose in gamthip'a thing'a sum-eng gul adop sang banga chu, Mihem Chapa kidom sang ding ahi.
English: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

tcz: Hijeh chun amitakip ama tahsan chan in tonsot hinna anei ding ahi.
en: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
text:
JHN 3:15
Thadou: Hijeh chun amitakip ama tahsan chan in tonsot hinna anei ding ahi.
English: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in hibanga hi vannoi angailut ahin, koi hijongleh Ama tahsan chan chu mangthah louva tonsot hinna anei na dingin, aneisun achapa changkhat chu apetan ahi.
en: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
text:
JHN 3:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen in hibanga hi vannoi angailut ahin, koi hijongleh Ama tahsan chan chu mangthah louva tonsot hinna anei na dingin, aneisun achapa changkhat chu apetan ahi.
English: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

tcz: Pathen in achapa vannoiya ahinsol chu, vannoi huhhing'a aumna ding joh ahibouve.
en: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
text:
JHN 3:17
Thadou: Pathen in achapa vannoiya ahinsol chu, vannoi huhhing'a aumna ding joh ahibouve.
English: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

tcz: Koi hile ama tahsan chan chu, achunga thutanna umlou ahitai; ahivangin koi hijongleh atahsanlou vang chu, Pathen chapa changkhat chu atahsan loujeh a achunga thutanna umsa ahitai.
en: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.
text:
JHN 3:18
Thadou: Koi hile ama tahsan chan chu, achunga thutanna umlou ahitai; ahivangin koi hijongleh atahsanlou vang chu, Pathen chapa changkhat chu atahsan loujeh a achunga thutanna umsa ahitai.
English: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

tcz: Chule thutanna chu hiche hi ahi; Pathen vah chu vannoiya ahungin, ahivangin mihon vah sangin, achonnau aphatlou jeh in muthim joh adeijouvin ahi.
en: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.
text:
JHN 3:19
Thadou: Chule thutanna chu hiche hi ahi; Pathen vah chu vannoiya ahungin, ahivangin mihon vah sangin, achonnau aphatlou jeh in muthim joh adeijouvin ahi.
English: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

tcz: Michonphalou jousen vah athet'un, nai jong anailut ngam pouve, ajeh chu achonset nau hinphong doh khante tin akichauve.
en: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
text:
JHN 3:20
Thadou: Michonphalou jousen vah athet'un, nai jong anailut ngam pouve, ajeh chu achonset nau hinphong doh khante tin akichauve.
English: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

tcz: Ahivangin thudih'a chonphat bol ho vang chun Pathen lungdei abol'u chu mihon amuthei na dingin vah'a aum jinguve.” Tuilutsah John in Yeshua achoisang
en: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
text:
JHN 3:21
Thadou: Ahivangin thudih'a chonphat bol ho vang chun Pathen lungdei abol'u chu mihon amuthei na dingin vah'a aum jinguve.” Tuilutsah John in Yeshua achoisang
English: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshua leh seijuiten Jerusalem adalhauvin, Judea gam thinglhang lam ajontauve; chukom a chun phat chomkhat a umkhom'un, miho baptize achansah jin ahi.
en: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.
text:
JHN 3:22
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua leh seijuiten Jerusalem adalhauvin, Judea gam thinglhang lam ajontauve; chukom a chun phat chomkhat a umkhom'un, miho baptize achansah jin ahi.
