English: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

tcz: Hiche pet chun Tuilutsah John injong Salim koma Aenon mun'a twi ninglhing tah'a aum jeh chun, miho baptize achansah jin, chule aphat seh in, miho jong baptize chang dingin ahung jingun ahi.
en: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;

tcz: Hichu John songkul'a akikhum masang ahi.
en: for John was not yet thrown into prison.
text:
JHN 3:24
Thadou: Hichu John songkul'a akikhum masang ahi.
English: for John was not yet thrown into prison.

tcz: Hichun kisuhtheng na thudol'a John seijui ho leh Judah mi phabep kikah'a kinelna anasoh in ahi.
en: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
text:
JHN 3:25
Thadou: Hichun kisuhtheng na thudol'a John seijui ho leh Judah mi phabep kikah'a kinelna anasoh in ahi.
English: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

tcz: Hijeh chun John seijui ho ahenga ahung'un, ajah'a “Rabbi (hichu houhil tina ahi), Jordan luigala nakimupi a ama Messiah ahi tia nahettoh sah pa jong chun miho baptize achansah jin ahi. Chuleh mi tampi eiho henga hungtalouvin ama henga ache tauve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
text:
JHN 3:26
Thadou: Hijeh chun John seijui ho ahenga ahung'un, ajah'a “Rabbi (hichu houhil tina ahi), Jordan luigala nakimupi a ama Messiah ahi tia nahettoh sah pa jong chun miho baptize achansah jin ahi. Chuleh mi tampi eiho henga hungtalouvin ama henga ache tauve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”

tcz: Chuin John in adonbut'in “Pathen in vana kona apehlou chu, koima ima achangthei poi.
en: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.
text:
JHN 3:27
Thadou: Chuin John in adonbut'in “Pathen in vana kona apehlou chu, koima ima achangthei poi.
English: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.

tcz: Keiman nahenguva kasei chu, nangho ahetoh'ah nahiuve; keima Christa kahipoi, ama lampi semtoh dinga hung kahi bouve.
en: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
text:
JHN 3:28
Thadou: Keiman nahenguva kasei chu, nangho ahetoh'ah nahiuve; keima Christa kahipoi, ama lampi semtoh dinga hung kahi bouve.
English: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

tcz: Hiche hi ahi, mou kichenpia chu moulang ahin; chuleh moulang jolpa vang chu moulang koma adin'a moulang kitep na ajah chu akipana ahijenge. Hijeh chun ama lolhin na chun keima kipana dim'a eikoi ahi.
en: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.
text:
JHN 3:29
Thadou: Hiche hi ahi, mou kichenpia chu moulang ahin; chuleh moulang jolpa vang chu moulang koma adin'a moulang kitep na ajah chu akipana ahijenge. Hijeh chun ama lolhin na chun keima kipana dim'a eikoi ahi.
English: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.

tcz: Ama chu khangtou touding, chule keima kemsuh suh ding kahi. Vana hungkon Yeshua
en: He must increase, but I must decrease.
text:
JHN 3:30
Thadou: Ama chu khangtou touding, chule keima kemsuh suh ding kahi. Vana hungkon Yeshua
English: He must increase, but I must decrease.

tcz: Ama chunga hungkon ahin, mijouse sanga chung nungjo ahi; Eiho leiset'a kon ihiuvin, leiset thu iseiyu ahi, ahivangin ama chu chunga kon ahijeh'in mi jouse chunga achungnungpen ahi.
en: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
text:
JHN 3:31
Thadou: Ama chunga hungkon ahin, mijouse sanga chung nungjo ahi; Eiho leiset'a kon ihiuvin, leiset thu iseiyu ahi, ahivangin ama chu chunga kon ahijeh'in mi jouse chunga achungnungpen ahi.
English: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

tcz: Aman amu leh ajah chu ahettohsah ahi, ahivangin ama hettohsah chu koiman asangpoi.
en: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
text:
JHN 3:32
Thadou: Aman amu leh ajah chu ahettohsah ahi, ahivangin ama hettohsah chu koiman asangpoi.
English: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

tcz: Hijeh chun koi hileh, athu hettohsah tahsan'a kisan chun Pathen dihtah chu apomdet ahitai.
en: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
text:
JHN 3:33
Thadou: Hijeh chun koi hileh, athu hettohsah tahsan'a kisan chun Pathen dihtah chu apomdet ahitai.
English: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

tcz: Ama chu Pathen hinsol ahi, Aman Pathen thutah aseiye, ajeh chu ama Pathen lhagao dimset'a kipe ahi.
en: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
text:
JHN 3:34
Thadou: Ama chu Pathen hinsol ahi, Aman Pathen thutah aseiye, ajeh chu ama Pathen lhagao dimset'a kipe ahi.
English: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

tcz: Pa chun Achapa angailun, chule ima jouse ama khut'a apetai.
en: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
text:
JHN 3:35
Thadou: Pa chun Achapa angailun, chule ima jouse ama khut'a apetai.
English: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

tcz: Hijeh chun, koi hijongleh Pathen tahsan'a chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai. Pathen chapa thungailou vang chu tonsot hinna changlouva Pathen lunghan na thutan chu achunga chu ding ahi,” ati.
en: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
text:
JHN 3:36
Thadou: Hijeh chun, koi hijongleh Pathen tahsan'a chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai. Pathen chapa thungailou vang chu tonsot hinna changlouva Pathen lunghan na thutan chu achunga chu ding ahi,” ati.
English: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”

tcz: Pakai chun John sangin seijui tamjo asem'in miho Baptize achansah jinge ti Pharisee hon ajatauve ti chu Yeshuan ahetan ahi.
en: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
text:
JHN 4:1
Thadou: Pakai chun John sangin seijui tamjo asem'in miho Baptize achansah jinge ti Pharisee hon ajatauve ti chu Yeshuan ahetan ahi.
English: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

tcz: Hichun Yeshua amatah in baptize achansah lou vang'in, aseijuiten abol'u ahi.
en: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),
text:
JHN 4:2
Thadou: Hichun Yeshua amatah in baptize achansah lou vang'in, aseijuiten abol'u ahi.
English: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),

tcz: Hijeh chun aman Judea gam adalhan Galilee gam'a akile tai.
en: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.
text:
JHN 4:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun aman Judea gam adalhan Galilee gam'a akile tai.
English: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.

tcz: Aman alampi'a chun Samaria gamsung ajotpa in;
en: He needed to pass through Samaria.

tcz: Chutichun Samaria mite khokhat Sychar mun chu ahung lhungtai; hiche mun chu Jacob in achapa Joseph ana peh loumun kom ahi.
en: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
text:
JHN 4:5
Thadou: Chutichun Samaria mite khokhat Sychar mun chu ahung lhungtai; hiche mun chu Jacob in achapa Joseph ana peh loumun kom ahi.
English: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

tcz: Chukom'a chu Jacob twikul um'ah ahi, Yeshua chu lamsao ajotna'ah acholtan, twikul panga chun leltah in atouvin ahi; Hichu sunkim dontah ahi.
en: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
text:
JHN 4:6
Thadou: Chukom'a chu Jacob twikul um'ah ahi, Yeshua chu lamsao ajotna'ah acholtan, twikul panga chun leltah in atouvin ahi; Hichu sunkim dontah ahi.
English: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

tcz: Hichun Samaria numei khat twithal dingin ahungin, Yeshuan amanu jah'a “Twi donding neipeh thei ding ham?” ati.
en: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
text:
JHN 4:7
Thadou: Hichun Samaria numei khat twithal dingin ahungin, Yeshuan amanu jah'a “Twi donding neipeh thei ding ham?” ati.
English: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

tcz: Hichepet a chu Yeshua achangseh'a bou um ahi, ajehchu aseijuite khosunga anneh ding cho'a achedoh kah'u ahi.
en: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
text:
JHN 4:8
Thadou: Hichepet a chu Yeshua achangseh'a bou um ahi, ajehchu aseijuite khosunga anneh ding cho'a achedoh kah'u ahi.
English: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

tcz: Numeinu chu atija lheh e, ajehchu Judah hon Samaria miho chu athet uva imacha akikoppi ngailou'u ahi; hijehchun amanun Yeshua jah'a “Nangla Judah mi nahin, keila Samaria numei kahin, ipi dinga keikom'a donding twi nathum ham?” ati.
en: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
text:
JHN 4:9
Thadou: Numeinu chu atija lheh e, ajehchu Judah hon Samaria miho chu athet uva imacha akikoppi ngailou'u ahi; hijehchun amanun Yeshua jah'a “Nangla Judah mi nahin, keila Samaria numei kahin, ipi dinga keikom'a donding twi nathum ham?” ati.
English: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in amanu jah'a “Pathen thilpeh nachan ding hi henlang, chule naki houpi hi koi ahi hele chun nangin keikom'a nathum joh ding, chule keiman nangma hintwi pedinga,” ati.
en: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”
text:
JHN 4:10
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in amanu jah'a “Pathen thilpeh nachan ding hi henlang, chule naki houpi hi koi ahi hele chun nangin keikom'a nathum joh ding, chule keiman nangma hintwi pedinga,” ati.
English: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

tcz: Chuin amanun ajah'a, “Pu nangman athaldoh nading khao le bel jong neilouva, twikul jong athuh in, hintwi nati chu hoiya nalah ding ham?
en: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?
text:
JHN 4:11
Thadou: Chuin amanun ajah'a, “Pu nangman athaldoh nading khao le bel jong neilouva, twikul jong athuh in, hintwi nati chu hoiya nalah ding ham?
English: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

tcz: Chukit jongleh hiche twikul eina peuva kapului'u Jacob sang'a nangma chung nungjo nahim? Amatah in anadon'a achate leh agancha ho anadonsah'a hiche twi sanga phajo hoiya nalah ding ham?” ati.
en: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”
text:
JHN 4:12
Thadou: Chukit jongleh hiche twikul eina peuva kapului'u Jacob sang'a nangma chung nungjo nahim? Amatah in anadon'a achate leh agancha ho anadonsah'a hiche twi sanga phajo hoiya nalah ding ham?” ati.
English: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in ajah'a, “Koi hileh hiche twi don'a chu dangchah kit ding ahi.
en: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
text:
JHN 4:13
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in ajah'a, “Koi hileh hiche twi don'a chu dangchah kit ding ahi.
English: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

tcz: Ahivangin Keiman kapeh ding twidon jouse chu a itih'a dangchah kitlou ding, amaho chu asung uva hintwi put'a twinah theng soh ding, chule tonsot hinna chang ding ahiuve.”
en: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
text:
JHN 4:14
Thadou: Ahivangin Keiman kapeh ding twidon jouse chu a itih'a dangchah kitlou ding, amaho chu asung uva hintwi put'a twinah theng soh ding, chule tonsot hinna chang ding ahiuve.”
English: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

tcz: Chuin numeinun ajah'a “Pu lungset in hiche twi chu kei neipen, chuteng avel'a kadang chah kitlou na ding, chuleh hilai mun'a twithal'a kahungkit lou nadingin,” ati.
en: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
text:
JHN 4:15
Thadou: Chuin numeinun ajah'a “Pu lungset in hiche twi chu kei neipen, chuteng avel'a kadang chah kitlou na ding, chuleh hilai mun'a twithal'a kahungkit lou nadingin,” ati.
English: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amanu jah'a, “Chenlang najipa gakouvin,” ati.
en: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
text:
JHN 4:16
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan amanu jah'a, “Chenlang najipa gakouvin,” ati.
English: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

tcz: Amanun adonbut'in, “Keiman ji kaneipoi,” ati, hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Nasei dih'e, nangman ji kicheh naneipoi,” ati.
en: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
text:
JHN 4:17
Thadou: Amanun adonbut'in, “Keiman ji kaneipoi,” ati, hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Nasei dih'e, nangman ji kicheh naneipoi,” ati.
English: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

tcz: “Nangman ji ngatah naneitan chule tua naum khompi pa jong khu naji tah ahipoi, nasei dih lheh jenge,” ati.
en: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”
text:
JHN 4:18
Thadou: “Nangman ji ngatah naneitan chule tua naum khompi pa jong khu naji tah ahipoi, nasei dih lheh jenge,” ati.
English: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

tcz: Chuin numeinun ajah'a, “Pu nangma themgao khat nahi.
en: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
text:
JHN 4:19
Thadou: Chuin numeinun ajah'a, “Pu nangma themgao khat nahi.
English: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

tcz: Ahile neisei peh in ipi dinga keiho Samaria mihon, kapuluiteu bolbanga hiche Gerizim mol'a Pathen kahou'uva, ahivanga nangho Judah mihon Pathen houna ding mun chu Jerusalem bou ahi, natiu ham?” ati.
en: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
text:
JHN 4:20
Thadou: Ahile neisei peh in ipi dinga keiho Samaria mihon, kapuluiteu bolbanga hiche Gerizim mol'a Pathen kahou'uva, ahivanga nangho Judah mihon Pathen houna ding mun chu Jerusalem bou ahi, natiu ham?” ati.
English: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Numei neitahsan in nanghon Pathen nahou na dingu mun chu hiche mol'a jong hilou, chuleh Jerusalem'a jong hilou, phat chu ahung lhung e.”
en: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
text:
JHN 4:21
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Numei neitahsan in nanghon Pathen nahou na dingu mun chu hiche mol'a jong hilou, chuleh Jerusalem'a jong hilou, phat chu ahung lhung e.”
English: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

tcz: Nangho Samaria mihon nahet chen lou u nahouvun, ahivangin keiho Judah mihon vang kahou'u ama chu kahet chen'u ahi; ajehchu huhhingna chu Judahte a kona hung ahibouve.
en: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
text:
JHN 4:22
Thadou: Nangho Samaria mihon nahet chen lou u nahouvun, ahivangin keiho Judah mihon vang kahou'u ama chu kahet chen'u ahi; ajehchu huhhingna chu Judahte a kona hung ahibouve.
English: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

tcz: Ahivangin phat chu ahung lhunge, tutah hi ahi, ahou tahbeh hon Pachu Lhagao leh thutah'a ahouding phat; ajeh chu Pa chun chutobanga houho bou chu ama hou dinga ahol ahi.
en: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
text:
JHN 4:23
Thadou: Ahivangin phat chu ahung lhunge, tutah hi ahi, ahou tahbeh hon Pachu Lhagao leh thutah'a ahouding phat; ajeh chu Pa chun chutobanga houho bou chu ama hou dinga ahol ahi.
English: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

tcz: Ajehchu “Pathen chu lhagao ahin, ahouten lhagao leh thutah'a ahou ding mong ahi” ati.
en: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
text:
JHN 4:24
Thadou: Ajehchu “Pathen chu lhagao ahin, ahouten lhagao leh thutah'a ahou ding mong ahi” ati.
English: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

tcz: Chuin numeinun ajah'a, “Keiman Messiah hung ding chu kahenai, ama chu Christa ahi. Ama chu ahung tengleh aman ijakai eihil dingu ahi,” ati.
en: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
text:
JHN 4:25
Thadou: Chuin numeinun ajah'a, “Keiman Messiah hung ding chu kahenai, ama chu Christa ahi. Ama chu ahung tengleh aman ijakai eihil dingu ahi,” ati.
English: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amanu jah'a, “Keima Christa chu kahi,” ati.
en: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
text:
JHN 4:26
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan amanu jah'a, “Keima Christa chu kahi,” ati.
English: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

tcz: Hiche pettah chun, aseijuite ahung kiletauve, amahon Yeshua leh numeinu kihou chu amu'uvin, atija lheh jengun ahi, ahivangin koiman ajah'a, “Amanu henga ipi nathum ham?” ahilouleh, “Ipi dinga amanu naki houpi ham?” tia dong ngam aum pouve.
en: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
text:
JHN 4:27
Thadou: Hiche pettah chun, aseijuite ahung kiletauve, amahon Yeshua leh numeinu kihou chu amu'uvin, atija lheh jengun ahi, ahivangin koiman ajah'a, “Amanu henga ipi nathum ham?” ahilouleh, “Ipi dinga amanu naki houpi ham?” tia dong ngam aum pouve.
English: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

tcz: Hichun numeinu chun a twibel chu twikul panga adalhan khosung lam'a alelhai kit'in miho jouse henga;
en: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,

tcz: “Hungun mikhat hungveu vin, aman kathilbol leh kachon na jouse aseidoh soh keiye, Ama hi Christa hitei yinte,” ati.
en: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”
text:
JHN 4:29
Thadou: “Hungun mikhat hungveu vin, aman kathilbol leh kachon na jouse aseidoh soh keiye, Ama hi Christa hitei yinte,” ati.
English: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”

tcz: Chuin khosunga kon chun mipi tamtah ahung potdoh'un ama chu ahung veuvin ahi.
en: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.
text:
JHN 4:30
Thadou: Chuin khosunga kon chun mipi tamtah ahung potdoh'un ama chu ahung veuvin ahi.
English: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

tcz: Hichepet chun aseijuiten Yeshua heng'ah, “Rabbi an themkhat beh nen,” atiuve.
en: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
text:
JHN 4:31
Thadou: Hichepet chun aseijuiten Yeshua heng'ah, “Rabbi an themkhat beh nen,” atiuve.
English: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman nangho het phahlou anneh kaneiye,” ati.
en: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
text:
JHN 4:32
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman nangho het phahlou anneh kaneiye,” ati.
English: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

tcz: Hichun aseijuite amaho akidong touvin, “Eiho chedoh kah'a mikhat touvin anneh ding ahin choipeh khat ham?” atiuve.
en: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”
text:
JHN 4:33
Thadou: Hichun aseijuite amaho akidong touvin, “Eiho chedoh kah'a mikhat touvin anneh ding ahin choipeh khat ham?” atiuve.
English: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ahilchen in ajah'uva, “Eisolpa Pathen lunggot lam bol leh akin subulhit chu keima anneh ahi,” ati.
en: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
text:
JHN 4:34
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan ahilchen in ajah'uva, “Eisolpa Pathen lunggot lam bol leh akin subulhit chu keima anneh ahi,” ati.
English: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

tcz: “Nanghon changphu'a pat chang at khom na ding lha li alut'e natiuvin ahi, ahivangin keiman najah uva kasei ahi, khodah uvin loujao khu veuvin, chang amin in a-atphat val ahitai.
en: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
text:
JHN 4:35
Thadou: “Nanghon changphu'a pat chang at khom na ding lha li alut'e natiuvin ahi, ahivangin keiman najah uva kasei ahi, khodah uvin loujao khu veuvin, chang amin in a-atphat val ahitai.
English: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

tcz: Chang-at chun atha man akisanji mong ahi, chule a-atkhom lousoh ga chu miho tonsot hinna'a apuilut chu ahi; chutia chu aphut pa le a atpa anilhon'a kipahkhom jiahi.
en: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
text:
JHN 4:36
Thadou: Chang-at chun atha man akisanji mong ahi, chule a-atkhom lousoh ga chu miho tonsot hinna'a apuilut chu ahi; chutia chu aphut pa le a atpa anilhon'a kipahkhom jiahi.
English: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

tcz: Akisei ji bang chun, ‘mikhat in aphut in adang khat in a-at khomji,’” kiti chu adihtah ahi.
en: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
text:
JHN 4:37
Thadou: Akisei ji bang chun, ‘mikhat in aphut in adang khat in a-at khomji,’” kiti chu adihtah ahi.
English: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

tcz: Hijeh chun keiman nangho, na phulou nauva a-atkhom dinga kasol nahiuve; midang in atoh gimnasa chu nanghon aga nakhop tup'u ahi. Samaria Mihon Yeshua Atahsan'u
en: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
text:
JHN 4:38
Thadou: Hijeh chun keiman nangho, na phulou nauva a-atkhom dinga kasol nahiuve; midang in atoh gimnasa chu nanghon aga nakhop tup'u ahi. Samaria Mihon Yeshua Atahsan'u
English: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

tcz: Numeinu chun, “Kathilbol leh kachon na jouse eisei doh peh'e,” tia ahet tohsah'a kon chun, chuche kho'a Samaria mi tamtah'in Yeshua chu atahsan tauve.
en: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”
text:
JHN 4:39
Thadou: Numeinu chun, “Kathilbol leh kachon na jouse eisei doh peh'e,” tia ahet tohsah'a kon chun, chuche kho'a Samaria mi tamtah'in Yeshua chu atahsan tauve.
English: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”

tcz: Chuin amaho Yeshua henga ahung'un, akom'uva umden dingin a ngeh'un ahi, chuin Yeshua chukom'a chun nikho ni achongden tan ahi;
en: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

tcz: Chua aumsung chun mi tamtah'in athusei ajah'uva kon chun ama chu atahsan tauve.
en: Many more believed because of his word.
text:
JHN 4:41
Thadou: Chua aumsung chun mi tamtah'in athusei ajah'uva kon chun ama chu atahsan tauve.
English: Many more believed because of his word.

tcz: Chuin amahon numeinu jah'a, “Nangma thu hettohsah jengseh hilouvin, keiho tah in ama thusei kajauvin, tun katahsan tauve, chuleh amahi vannoi huhhing dihtah ahi kahechen tauve,” atiuvin ahi. Galilee mihon Yeshua asan u
en: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
text:
JHN 4:42
Thadou: Chuin amahon numeinu jah'a, “Nangma thu hettohsah jengseh hilouvin, keiho tah in ama thusei kajauvin, tun katahsan tauve, chuleh amahi vannoi huhhing dihtah ahi kahechen tauve,” atiuvin ahi. Galilee mihon Yeshua asan u
English: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

tcz: Chua ni ni achon jou chun, Yeshuan Galilee ajontai.
en: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.
text:
JHN 4:43
Thadou: Chua ni ni achon jou chun, Yeshuan Galilee ajontai.
English: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

tcz: Yeshua amatah in themgao chu achenna agamsung'a jabol na achangpoi, tia anasei dohsa ahi.
en: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
text:
JHN 4:44
Thadou: Yeshua amatah in themgao chu achenna agamsung'a jabol na achangpoi, tia anasei dohsa ahi.
English: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

tcz: Ahijeng vang chun Galilee miten ama chu ana sanguve, ajehchu amaho chu kalchuh kut laiya Jerusalem'a ana um uva, chumun'a Yeshua thilbol ho ana musoh keiyu ahi.
en: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.
text:
JHN 4:45
Thadou: Ahijeng vang chun Galilee miten ama chu ana sanguve, ajehchu amaho chu kalchuh kut laiya Jerusalem'a ana um uva, chumun'a Yeshua thilbol ho ana musoh keiyu ahi.
English: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

tcz: Aman Galilee gamsung ajot'in twisih lengpi twi asosah na Cana kho'a chun ache kit'in ahi, chuche kho koma Capernaum kho'a chun vaipo milal khat a um'in, achapa chu ha dammo lheh jeng ahi.
en: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
text:
JHN 4:46
Thadou: Aman Galilee gamsung ajot'in twisih lengpi twi asosah na Cana kho'a chun ache kit'in ahi, chuche kho koma Capernaum kho'a chun vaipo milal khat a um'in, achapa chu ha dammo lheh jeng ahi.
English: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

tcz: Chuin aman Yeshua chu Judea gam'a kon'in Galilee gam'a ahunge ti ajah phat in, amatah Yeshua henga achen, Capernaum geiya ahunga achapa ahung damsah dingin ataotai, ajeh chu achapa chu athikon cha ahitai.
en: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
text:
JHN 4:47
Thadou: Chuin aman Yeshua chu Judea gam'a kon'in Galilee gam'a ahunge ti ajah phat in, amatah Yeshua henga achen, Capernaum geiya ahunga achapa ahung damsah dingin ataotai, ajeh chu achapa chu athikon cha ahitai.
English: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

tcz: Yeshuan ajah'a, “Melchih na kidang hicheng hohi mulou hile chun neitahsan nadem?” ati.
en: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
text:
JHN 4:48
Thadou: Yeshuan ajah'a, “Melchih na kidang hicheng hohi mulou hile chun neitahsan nadem?” ati.
English: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

tcz: Hichun vaipopa chun, “Pakai lungset in kachapa athi masang in hungin,” tin ataotai.
en: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
text:
JHN 4:49
Thadou: Hichun vaipopa chun, “Pakai lungset in kachapa athi masang in hungin,” tin ataotai.
English: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

tcz: Yeshuan amapa jah'a, “Na in'ah kiletan nachapa ahinge!” ati. Chuin mipa chun, Yeshua thusei chu atahsan in, a inlam ajontai.
en: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
text:
JHN 4:50
Thadou: Yeshuan amapa jah'a, “Na in'ah kiletan nachapa ahinge!” ati. Chuin mipa chun, Yeshua thusei chu atahsan in, a inlam ajontai.
English: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

tcz: Chuin mipa chu a In alhun masang in, asohten lampia ahung lamtou vin, achapa damtheng thu chu ahung seipeh uvin ahi.
en: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”
text:
JHN 4:51
Thadou: Chuin mipa chu a In alhun masang in, asohten lampia ahung lamtou vin, achapa damtheng thu chu ahung seipeh uvin ahi.
English: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

tcz: Hichun aman asohte jah'a, “Itih phat a chu damdoh ham?” tin adongin ahileh, amahon, “Janhi sun nidan khat dontah chun akhosih abeitai,” atiuvin ahi.
en: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
text:
JHN 4:52
Thadou: Hichun aman asohte jah'a, “Itih phat a chu damdoh ham?” tin adongin ahileh, amahon, “Janhi sun nidan khat dontah chun akhosih abeitai,” atiuvin ahi.
English: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”

tcz: Chuin mipa chun hiche phat laitah chu, Yeshuan ajah'a nachapa ahinge tia aseipet tah ahi chu ahedohtan ahi; hiche jeh chun ama leh a Insung mite chengsen Yeshua atahsan tauve.
en: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.
text:
JHN 4:53
Thadou: Chuin mipa chun hiche phat laitah chu, Yeshuan ajah'a nachapa ahinge tia aseipet tah ahi chu ahedohtan ahi; hiche jeh chun ama leh a Insung mite chengsen Yeshua atahsan tauve.
English: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

tcz: Hiche hi Judea gam'a kon'a Galilee gam'a ahungna'a Yeshuan melchihna kidang abol aniveina ahitai.
en: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
text:
JHN 4:54
Thadou: Hiche hi Judea gam'a kon'a Galilee gam'a ahungna'a Yeshuan melchihna kidang abol aniveina ahitai.
English: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

tcz: Hiche jou chun, Judah ho kut nikho thengho jeh'in Yeshua chu Jerusalem'a akile kit in ahi.
en: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
text:
JHN 5:1
Thadou: Hiche jou chun, Judah ho kut nikho thengho jeh'in Yeshua chu Jerusalem'a akile kit in ahi.
English: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

tcz: Khopi sunglam'a kelngoi kotphung koma chun, Bethsaida kiti twikul khat aum in akimvel'a chu leibuh nga kisa ahi.
en: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
text:
JHN 5:2
Thadou: Khopi sunglam'a kelngoi kotphung koma chun, Bethsaida kiti twikul khat aum in akimvel'a chu leibuh nga kisa ahi.
English: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.

tcz: Hiche mun'a chu ana damlou mitcho, elbai, langthi, chatmo tampi lum ahiuve, ajehchu twi kicholing ngah jing'a um ahiuve.
en: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

tcz: Ajeh chu phatkhat kom kom leh Pakai Vantil hungkum lha jia, twi chu acholing ji ahi; chuleh twi kicholoh nung'a twilah'a kumlha masapen pen chu itobang natna hijong leh damhel ji ahi.
en: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.
text:
JHN 5:4
Thadou: Ajeh chu phatkhat kom kom leh Pakai Vantil hungkum lha jia, twi chu acholing ji ahi; chuleh twi kicholoh nung'a twilah'a kumlha masapen pen chu itobang natna hijong leh damhel ji ahi.
English: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.

tcz: Hilai mun'a umho lah'a mikhat chu kum somthum leh kum get jen nakong chatmo'a lum ahitai.
en: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
text:
JHN 5:5
Thadou: Hilai mun'a umho lah'a mikhat chu kum somthum leh kum get jen nakong chatmo'a lum ahitai.
English: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

tcz: Yeshuan amapa chu amun, kum sottah damlou va um ahi ahen, amapa jah'a, “Nadam nom em?” ati.
en: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”
text:
JHN 5:6
Thadou: Yeshuan amapa chu amun, kum sottah damlou va um ahi ahen, amapa jah'a, “Nadam nom em?” ati.
English: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”

tcz: Nakong chatmo pa chun, “Pu kadam joulou hila, twi akicholing teng twikul'a eikoi lhavah ding mi kaneipon, keima kacheji le kalhun masangin midang amasa jitai,” ati.
en: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”
text:
JHN 5:7
Thadou: Nakong chatmo pa chun, “Pu kadam joulou hila, twi akicholing teng twikul'a eikoi lhavah ding mi kaneipon, keima kacheji le kalhun masangin midang amasa jitai,” ati.
English: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kipat doh in nalupna pheh kichoiyin lam jottan,” ati.
en: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
text:
JHN 5:8
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kipat doh in nalupna pheh kichoiyin lam jottan,” ati.
English: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

tcz: Apettah chun mipa chu adamtan ahi, hichun aman alupna pheh chu akijel doh in lam ajottai, hiche thil kidang aso ni chu Cholngahni ahi.
en: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.
text:
JHN 5:9
Thadou: Apettah chun mipa chu adamtan ahi, hichun aman alupna pheh chu akijel doh in lam ajottai, hiche thil kidang aso ni chu Cholngahni ahi.
English: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.

tcz: Hijeh chun Judah vaipo hon hichu ajadauvin, akisu dampa jah'a “Cholngah nikho'a natoh phal ahipoi, nangman nalupna pheh nakichoiya lam najot chu dan ngai ahipoi,” atiuve.
en: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”
text:
JHN 5:10
Thadou: Hijeh chun Judah vaipo hon hichu ajadauvin, akisu dampa jah'a “Cholngah nikho'a natoh phal ahipoi, nangman nalupna pheh nakichoiya lam najot chu dan ngai ahipoi,” atiuve.
English: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”

tcz: Ahivangin amapan adonbut'in ajah'a, “Eisudampa amatah in kajah'a nalupna kichoiyin lam jottan eiti chula em,” ati.
en: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”
text:
JHN 5:11
Thadou: Ahivangin amapan adonbut'in ajah'a, “Eisudampa amatah in kajah'a nalupna kichoiyin lam jottan eiti chula em,” ati.
English: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”

tcz: Chuin amahon, “Koi ham najah'a chutia sei chu?” atiuve.
en: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”
text:
JHN 5:12
Thadou: Chuin amahon, “Koi ham najah'a chutia sei chu?” atiuve.
English: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”

tcz: Ahinla mipa chun, asudampa chu koi ahi ahepoi, ajeh chu Yeshua mipi lah'a achelut mangtan ahi.
en: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
text:
JHN 5:13
Thadou: Ahinla mipa chun, asudampa chu koi ahi ahepoi, ajeh chu Yeshua mipi lah'a achelut mangtan ahi.
English: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

tcz: Ahivangin chom khat jouvin, Yeshuan amapa chu Houin'ah amun ajah'a, “Tua hi akisudam nahitai, chonse kit tahih in, ajole akhohjo cheh nachunga chuget inte,” ati.
en: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”
text:
JHN 5:14
Thadou: Ahivangin chom khat jouvin, Yeshuan amapa chu Houin'ah amun ajah'a, “Tua hi akisudam nahitai, chonse kit tahih in, ajole akhohjo cheh nachunga chuget inte,” ati.
English: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

tcz: Chuin mipa chun Judah vaipo ho jah'a ama sudam chu Yeshua ahi ti agaseitan ahi.
en: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
text:
JHN 5:15
Thadou: Chuin mipa chun Judah vaipo ho jah'a ama sudam chu Yeshua ahi ti agaseitan ahi.
English: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

tcz: Hijeh chun Judah vaipo hon Yeshua amatah in Cholngah nikho apalkeh jeh in, achunga bolsetna apantauvin ahi.
en: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
text:
JHN 5:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun Judah vaipo hon Yeshua amatah in Cholngah nikho apalkeh jeh in, achunga bolsetna apantauvin ahi.
English: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kapan aphat jousen na atongin, keiman jong katong jinge,” ati.
en: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
text:
JHN 5:17
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kapan aphat jousen na atongin, keiman jong katong jinge,” ati.
English: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

tcz: Hiche jeh tah chun, Judah vaipo hon Yeshua thana ding aha hol cheh tauvin ahi, ajehchu aman Cholngah nikho apalkeh keo hilouvin, Pathen chu apa ahisah a chuleh Pathen toh kibanga aumjeh chu ahi.
en: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
text:
JHN 5:18
Thadou: Hiche jeh tah chun, Judah vaipo hon Yeshua thana ding aha hol cheh tauvin ahi, ajehchu aman Cholngah nikho apalkeh keo hilouvin, Pathen chu apa ahisah a chuleh Pathen toh kibanga aumjeh chu ahi.
English: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

tcz: Hijeh chun Yeshuan ahilchen in, ajah'uva, “Thutah chu nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, Chapa chun ama cham cham in ima abolpoi; Pan abol amu ho chacha bou chu aman abolji ahi, hijeh chun Pan abol jouse chu Chapan jong abol ahi.
en: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
text:
JHN 5:19
Thadou: Hijeh chun Yeshuan ahilchen in, ajah'uva, “Thutah chu nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, Chapa chun ama cham cham in ima abolpoi; Pan abol amu ho chacha bou chu aman abolji ahi, hijeh chun Pan abol jouse chu Chapan jong abol ahi.
English: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

tcz: Ajehchu Pan chapa chu angailun, anatoh athilbol jouse avetsah in ahi. Chule tahbeh in Pa chun hiche mipa kisuhdam na sanga chungnungjo avetsah ding ahi, hichu nanghon kidang nasah cheh dingu ahi.
en: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
text:
JHN 5:20
Thadou: Ajehchu Pan chapa chu angailun, anatoh athilbol jouse avetsah in ahi. Chule tahbeh in Pa chun hiche mipa kisuhdam na sanga chungnungjo avetsah ding ahi, hichu nanghon kidang nasah cheh dingu ahi.
English: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pan mithi ho akaithouva ahinsah ji bang chun Chapan jong ahinsah nom ho chu hinna apeh ji ahi.
en: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
text:
JHN 5:21
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pan mithi ho akaithouva ahinsah ji bang chun Chapan jong ahinsah nom ho chu hinna apeh ji ahi.
English: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

tcz: Chuleh Pan koima thu atanpoi, aman thutanna leh thuneina jouse abon'a Chapa apeh ahitai.
en: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
text:
JHN 5:22
Thadou: Chuleh Pan koima thu atanpoi, aman thutanna leh thuneina jouse abon'a Chapa apeh ahitai.
English: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, mijousen Pa ajabol banga Chapa chu ajabol cheh ding ahi; ajeh chu Chapa jabol lou chun ahinsol'a Pachu ajabollou ahi.
en: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
text:
JHN 5:23
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun, mijousen Pa ajabol banga Chapa chu ajabol cheh ding ahi; ajeh chu Chapa jabol lou chun ahinsol'a Pachu ajabollou ahi.
English: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

tcz: Keiman atahbeh chu nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, kathusei ngaiya chuleh eisolpa Pathen tahsan'a chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai; amaho chu a itih'a chonset themmo channa geita louva thina akon'a hinna galkai ahitauve.
en: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
text:
JHN 5:24
Thadou: Keiman atahbeh chu nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, kathusei ngaiya chuleh eisolpa Pathen tahsan'a chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai; amaho chu a itih'a chonset themmo channa geita louva thina akon'a hinna galkai ahitauve.
English: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

tcz: Chuleh keiman nangho tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, phat chu ahung lhunge, tuhi ahi, mithi hon ka aw (Pathen Chapa aw) ajah ding'u, chuleh aja chengse hing ding ahiuve.
en: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.
text:
JHN 5:25
Thadou: Chuleh keiman nangho tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, phat chu ahung lhunge, tuhi ahi, mithi hon ka aw (Pathen Chapa aw) ajah ding'u, chuleh aja chengse hing ding ahiuve.
English: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pa chun ama'a hinna anei ahin, chuleh aman hiche hinna pe thanei na chu Chapa apeh ahitai.
en: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
text:
JHN 5:26
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pa chun ama'a hinna anei ahin, chuleh aman hiche hinna pe thanei na chu Chapa apeh ahitai.
English: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

tcz: Chuleh aman mi jouse chung'a thutanna leh thuneina chu chapa apeh ahitai, ajeh chu ama Mihem Chapa ahi.
en: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
text:
JHN 5:27
Thadou: Chuleh aman mi jouse chung'a thutanna leh thuneina chu chapa apeh ahitai, ajeh chu ama Mihem Chapa ahi.
English: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangho lung dong hih'un, phat chu ahung lhunge, lhankhuh'a mithi ho jousen Pathen chapa Aw ajah ding'u;
en: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

tcz: Chuleh amaho thoukit ding, chuleh thilpha bol ho chu tonsot hinna a thoukit ding, chule thilpha lou bolho chu thupi tanna'a themmo chang'a thoukit ding ahiuve.
en: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
text:
JHN 5:29
Thadou: Chuleh amaho thoukit ding, chuleh thilpha bol ho chu tonsot hinna a thoukit ding, chule thilpha lou bolho chu thupi tanna'a themmo chang'a thoukit ding ahiuve.
English: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

tcz: Chuleh keiman kacham in ima kabol theipoi, Pathen in eisei peh banga thutanna kanei ahijeh'in, kathutan chu dihtah ahi, ajeh chu keima lunggot lam hilouva eisolpa ama lunggot lam'a kabol ahi.
en: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
text:
JHN 5:30
Thadou: Chuleh keiman kacham in ima kabol theipoi, Pathen in eisei peh banga thutanna kanei ahijeh'in, kathutan chu dihtah ahi, ajeh chu keima lunggot lam hilouva eisolpa ama lunggot lam'a kabol ahi.
English: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

tcz: Chule kachungthu chu keima man kahet tohsah leh kathu hettohsah chu adih'a pomthei hilou ding ahi.
en: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
text:
JHN 5:31
Thadou: Chule kachungthu chu keima man kahet tohsah leh kathu hettohsah chu adih'a pomthei hilou ding ahi.
English: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

tcz: Ahivangin keima chungthu chu midang khat'in jong ahettohsah'a ahileh tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, amapan ahettohsah keima chungthu jouse chu adih ahi.
en: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
text:
JHN 5:32
Thadou: Ahivangin keima chungthu chu midang khat'in jong ahettohsah'a ahileh tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, amapan ahettohsah keima chungthu jouse chu adih ahi.
English: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

tcz: Chuleh nanghon John Baptist henga thu kholtoh dingin mi nasol'un, chuleh aman kachung chang thu dihtah chu ahettoh sahtai.
en: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
text:
JHN 5:33
Thadou: Chuleh nanghon John Baptist henga thu kholtoh dingin mi nasol'un, chuleh aman kachung chang thu dihtah chu ahettoh sahtai.
English: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

tcz: Keiman mihem a kon hettohsah kangaipoi, ahivangin nangho huhhing'a naum na ding'uva hiche hi kasei ahi.
en: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
text:
JHN 5:34
Thadou: Keiman mihem a kon hettohsah kangaipoi, ahivangin nangho huhhing'a naum na ding'uva hiche hi kasei ahi.
English: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

tcz: John chu meivah koujing leh vahjing tobang ahin, chuleh ama thusei chu nanghon chomkhat dinga bou nalunglut piu ahi.
en: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
text:
JHN 5:35
Thadou: John chu meivah koujing leh vahjing tobang ahin, chuleh ama thusei chu nanghon chomkhat dinga bou nalunglut piu ahi.
English: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

tcz: Ahivangin, keiman John sanga chung nungjo hettohsah kaneiye-hiche kathuhil leh melchihna kidang kabol hi ahi. Chuleh Pan eisol lona photchenna dinga, hiche hohi kabol dinga eipeh ahi.
en: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
text:
JHN 5:36
Thadou: Ahivangin, keiman John sanga chung nungjo hettohsah kaneiye-hiche kathuhil leh melchihna kidang kabol hi ahi. Chuleh Pan eisol lona photchenna dinga, hiche hohi kabol dinga eipeh ahi.
English: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

tcz: Chuleh eihin sol'a Pa amatah chun kachungthu ahettohsah ahitai, nanghon a imatih in ama aw najakha pouve, chuleh kimaito pin jong namukha pouve.
en: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
text:
JHN 5:37
Thadou: Chuleh eihin sol'a Pa amatah chun kachungthu ahettohsah ahitai, nanghon a imatih in ama aw najakha pouve, chuleh kimaito pin jong namukha pouve.
English: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

tcz: Chuleh nalung sung'uva ama thusei achengpoi; ajehchu aman nangho dinga ahinsol keima hi natahsan pouve.
en: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
text:
JHN 5:38
Thadou: Chuleh nalung sung'uva ama thusei achengpoi; ajehchu aman nangho dinga ahinsol keima hi natahsan pouve.
English: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

tcz: Nanghon Pathen Lekhabu thu nahol'un, ajeh chu hiche ho chun tonsot hinna napeh dan'un nagel uve, ahivangin Pathen Lekhabu'a thuchun, keima thudol ahettohsah ahibouve.
en: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
text:
JHN 5:39
Thadou: Nanghon Pathen Lekhabu thu nahol'un, ajeh chu hiche ho chun tonsot hinna napeh dan'un nagel uve, ahivangin Pathen Lekhabu'a thuchun, keima thudol ahettohsah ahibouve.
English: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

tcz: Ahivangin nanghon hiche hinna chu chantheina dingin keima henga nahung nompouve.
en: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
text:
JHN 5:40
Thadou: Ahivangin nanghon hiche hinna chu chantheina dingin keima henga nahung nompouve.
English: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

tcz: Chule nangho phatsah peh chu keima dingin a ngaikhoh poi.
en: I don’t receive glory from men.
text:
JHN 5:41
Thadou: Chule nangho phatsah peh chu keima dingin a ngaikhoh poi.
English: I don’t receive glory from men.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh, Pathen ngailutna chu nasung'uvah achengpoi ti kahei.
en: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
text:
JHN 5:42
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh, Pathen ngailutna chu nasung'uvah achengpoi ti kahei.
English: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima kapa min'a naheng'uva kahung ahin, nanghon neisang pouve. Ahinlah midangho chu amaho min'a naheng'uva ahungleh kipahtah in nasang'uve.
en: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
text:
JHN 5:43
Thadou: Ajeh chu keima kapa min'a naheng'uva kahung ahin, nanghon neisang pouve. Ahinlah midangho chu amaho min'a naheng'uva ahungleh kipahtah in nasang'uve.
English: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

tcz: Chule nanghon natahsan theilou chu datmo aumpoi, ajeh chu nanghon khat leh khat kijabolto natha noppiuvin, Pathen khatseh ama ahung kon chu, jabol ding nakhoh sah pouve.
en: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
text:
JHN 5:44
Thadou: Chule nanghon natahsan theilou chu datmo aumpoi, ajeh chu nanghon khat leh khat kijabolto natha noppiuvin, Pathen khatseh ama ahung kon chu, jabol ding nakhoh sah pouve.
English: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

tcz: Hijeng jongleh Pa ang'a themmon achansah ding'u chu keima kahipoi; nanghon nakinep piu Mose chun themmo na chan sah dingu ahi.
en: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
text:
JHN 5:45
Thadou: Hijeng jongleh Pa ang'a themmon achansah ding'u chu keima kahipoi; nanghon nakinep piu Mose chun themmo na chan sah dingu ahi.
English: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

tcz: Chuleh nanghon Mose chu natahsan tahtah'u ahileh keima neitahsan dingu ahi, ajeh chu aman keima thudol asut ahibouve.
en: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
text:
JHN 5:46
Thadou: Chuleh nanghon Mose chu natahsan tahtah'u ahileh keima neitahsan dingu ahi, ajeh chu aman keima thudol asut ahibouve.
English: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

tcz: Ahivangin nanghon Mose chu natahsan lou jeh'un kathu sei hohi nanghon iti natahsan dingu ham?” ati.
en: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
text:
JHN 5:47
Thadou: Ahivangin nanghon Mose chu natahsan lou jeh'un kathu sei hohi nanghon iti natahsan dingu ham?” ati.
English: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”

tcz: Hiche jeh chun Yeshua chun Galilee dillen (Tiberias dillen tiajong kihe) agalkaiyin alangkhat gal langa chun achetan ahi.
en: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.
text:
JHN 6:1
Thadou: Hiche jeh chun Yeshua chun Galilee dillen (Tiberias dillen tiajong kihe) agalkaiyin alangkhat gal langa chun achetan ahi.
English: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

tcz: Chuin mihonpi tamtah'in, melchih na kidang abolho leh anaho asuhdam amu jeh'u chun achena chan'a anung ajui tauve.
en: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.
text:
JHN 6:2
Thadou: Chuin mihonpi tamtah'in, melchih na kidang abolho leh anaho asuhdam amu jeh'u chun achena chan'a anung ajui tauve.
English: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua chu mol chung khat'a akal touvin, aseijui ho toh atoukhom'uvin ahi.
en: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.
text:
JHN 6:3
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua chu mol chung khat'a akal touvin, aseijui ho toh atoukhom'uvin ahi.
English: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

tcz: Hichu Judah ho kalchuh kut nikho koncha ahitai.
en: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
text:
JHN 6:4
Thadou: Hichu Judah ho kalchuh kut nikho koncha ahitai.
English: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

tcz: Hichun mihonpi tamtah ama henglam jon'a ahung'u chu Yeshuan amun Philip jah'a, “Mipi hijat nehding changlhah hoiya ichoh dingu hitam,” ati.
en: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”
text:
JHN 6:5
Thadou: Hichun mihonpi tamtah ama henglam jon'a ahung'u chu Yeshuan amun Philip jah'a, “Mipi hijat nehding changlhah hoiya ichoh dingu hitam,” ati.
English: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

tcz: Hiche hi Philip patep na a asei ahibouve, aman abol ding ageltoh sa ahitai.
en: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
text:
JHN 6:6
Thadou: Hiche hi Philip patep na a asei ahibouve, aman abol ding ageltoh sa ahitai.
English: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

tcz: Hichun Philip in adonbut'in, “Eihon kum lhungin na tong jong leu hen mi hijat in themkhat khat'a aneh khop'u chohna ding kinga jouponte,” ati.
en: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”
text:
JHN 6:7
Thadou: Hichun Philip in adonbut'in, “Eihon kum lhungin na tong jong leu hen mi hijat in themkhat khat'a aneh khop'u chohna ding kinga jouponte,” ati.
English: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”

tcz: Chuin Simon Peter sopipa, Andrew chun ajah'uva.
en: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
text:
JHN 6:8
Thadou: Chuin Simon Peter sopipa, Andrew chun ajah'uva.
English: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

tcz: “Hilaiya chapang khat in changlhah pheng nga leh nga ni aneiye, ahivangin mipi hijat lah'a hicheng hi ipia pang kham ding ham,” ati.
en: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”
text:
JHN 6:9
Thadou: “Hilaiya chapang khat in changlhah pheng nga leh nga ni aneiye, ahivangin mipi hijat lah'a hicheng hi ipia pang kham ding ham,” ati.
English: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Miho jouse chu tousah'un,” ati; chuin amaho chu abon'un hamhing chung'a chun atoutauve. (Numei chapang simlouvin mipilhing sangnga jen ahive).
en: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
text:
JHN 6:10
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Miho jouse chu tousah'un,” ati; chuin amaho chu abon'un hamhing chung'a chun atoutauve. (Numei chapang simlouvin mipilhing sangnga jen ahive).
English: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan changlhah chu alan, Pathen athangvah'in miho hoppeh dingin apedohtai; chujouvin aman nga jong chutima chun abol in, chuleh mipi ho chun avaset cheh in ane tauve.
en: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.
text:
JHN 6:11
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan changlhah chu alan, Pathen athangvah'in miho hoppeh dingin apedohtai; chujouvin aman nga jong chutima chun abol in, chuleh mipi ho chun avaset cheh in ane tauve.
English: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

tcz: Hitichun amitakip ava soh phat'un, Yeshuan aseijui ho jah'a, “Tun neh moh chengse loh khom'un, moh suhmang hih un,” ati.
en: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
text:
JHN 6:12
Thadou: Hitichun amitakip ava soh phat'un, Yeshuan aseijui ho jah'a, “Tun neh moh chengse loh khom'un, moh suhmang hih un,” ati.
English: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”

tcz: Chuin amahon changlhah pheng nga-a kon'a mipi nehmoh anong aval chengse aloh khom'un ahileh paipeh som le paipeh ni aloh dim'un ahi.
en: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.
text:
JHN 6:13
Thadou: Chuin amahon changlhah pheng nga-a kon'a mipi nehmoh anong aval chengse aloh khom'un ahileh paipeh som le paipeh ni aloh dim'un ahi.
English: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

tcz: Chuin amahon, Yeshuan hiche melchih na kidang abol chu amuphat'un, atija behseh un, “Eihon themgao ina nga jingu chu ama hi ahi mong monge,” atiuve.
en: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
text:
JHN 6:14
Thadou: Chuin amahon, Yeshuan hiche melchih na kidang abol chu amuphat'un, atija behseh un, “Eihon themgao ina nga jingu chu ama hi ahi mong monge,” atiuve.
English: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”

tcz: Chuin amahon Yeshua chu ada achamlouva alengpau hisah ding agotauve, ti ahet jeh in, ama achangin thinglhang lam'a akilep mangtan ahi. Yeshuan twi chunga lam ajot
en: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
text:
JHN 6:15
Thadou: Chuin amahon Yeshua chu ada achamlouva alengpau hisah ding agotauve, ti ahet jeh in, ama achangin thinglhang lam'a akilep mangtan ahi. Yeshuan twi chunga lam ajot
English: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

tcz: Chuin nilhah ahiphat in aseijuite dillen pang lam'a acheuvin, Yeshua angah tauve.
en: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.
text:
JHN 6:16
Thadou: Chuin nilhah ahiphat in aseijuite dillen pang lam'a acheuvin, Yeshua angah tauve.
English: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.

tcz: Ahivangin khothim geiya Yeshua ahung kile lou phat'in, amaho kongsunga alut'un, Capernaum lam jon'in akitol tauvin ahi.
en: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
text:
JHN 6:17
Thadou: Ahivangin khothim geiya Yeshua ahung kile lou phat'in, amaho kongsunga alut'un, Capernaum lam jon'in akitol tauvin ahi.
English: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

tcz: Chuin phulou helouvin hui hattah khat in amaho chu ahinno khum'in twi kinong chu asang jep asang jep'in, akhohse lheh jengtai.
en: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
text:
JHN 6:18
Thadou: Chuin phulou helouvin hui hattah khat in amaho chu ahinno khum'in twi kinong chu asang jep asang jep'in, akhohse lheh jengtai.
English: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

tcz: Hitichun amaho mile li vel akitol lhungun, phulou helouvin Yeshua amaho lam jon'a twi chunga lam ahinjot chu amu uvin, akicha lheh jeng'un ahi.
en: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.
text:
JHN 6:19
Thadou: Hitichun amaho mile li vel akitol lhungun, phulou helouvin Yeshua amaho lam jon'a twi chunga lam ahinjot chu amu uvin, akicha lheh jeng'un ahi.
English: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan amaho akouvin, “Kicha hih'un keima kahi bouve,” ati.
en: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
text:
JHN 6:20
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan amaho akouvin, “Kicha hih'un keima kahi bouve,” ati.
English: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”

tcz: Chuphat in aseijuiten, Yeshua chu kong sunga lutsah loi ding athanom'un hetman lou kah chun ajotnau mun alhung tauve.
en: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
text:
JHN 6:21
Thadou: Chuphat in aseijuiten, Yeshua chu kong sunga lutsah loi ding athanom'un hetman lou kah chun ajotnau mun alhung tauve.
English: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

tcz: Ajingin dillen panga mihonpi umho chun, seijui hon kong khat umsun chu alah'uva akitol'u chu amu'uvin chuleh amaho lah'a Yeshua ajaopoi ti aheuvin ahi.
en: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.
text:
JHN 6:22
Thadou: Ajingin dillen panga mihonpi umho chun, seijui hon kong khat umsun chu alah'uva akitol'u chu amu'uvin chuleh amaho lah'a Yeshua ajaopoi ti aheuvin ahi.
English: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

tcz: Chuleh Tiberias a kon'a hung lhung kong dang tamtah, Yeshuan changlhah phatthei aboh a mipin anehnau mun koma chu uma ahi.
en: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
text:
JHN 6:23
Thadou: Chuleh Tiberias a kon'a hung lhung kong dang tamtah, Yeshuan changlhah phatthei aboh a mipin anehnau mun koma chu uma ahi.
English: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

tcz: Hijeh chun mihonpi chun, Yeshua leh aseijuite chukom'a aum tapouve ti amuphat'un amaho jong kong hoa chun alut'un Yeshua hol in Capernaum lang agal kaitauvin ahi.
en: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
text:
JHN 6:24
Thadou: Hijeh chun mihonpi chun, Yeshua leh aseijuite chukom'a aum tapouve ti amuphat'un amaho jong kong hoa chun alut'un Yeshua hol in Capernaum lang agal kaitauvin ahi.
English: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

tcz: Chuin amahon dil gal lang khat'a Yeshua amuphat'un, “Rabbi nangma itih'a hilai mun nalhun ham?” atiuve.
en: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”
text:
JHN 6:25
Thadou: Chuin amahon dil gal lang khat'a Yeshua amuphat'un, “Rabbi nangma itih'a hilai mun nalhun ham?” atiuve.
English: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu adonbut'in, “Keiman nangho tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, nanghon keima neihol'u hi neh ding changlhah kapeh jeh'a bou ahin, melchihna kidang kabol ho nahet chen jeh'uva ahipoi.
en: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.
text:
JHN 6:26
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan amaho chu adonbut'in, “Keiman nangho tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, nanghon keima neihol'u hi neh ding changlhah kapeh jeh'a bou ahin, melchihna kidang kabol ho nahet chen jeh'uva ahipoi.
English: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.

tcz: Hijeh chun, amang thahji nehding holnan hibang lom'in kisugim hih'un, hisang chun mihem chapan napeh ding'u tonsot hinna joh chu hol'in kisugim jouvin; ajehchu Pa Pathen in keima hiche dinga chu Mohor einamdet ahitai,” ati.
en: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”
text:
JHN 6:27
Thadou: Hijeh chun, amang thahji nehding holnan hibang lom'in kisugim hih'un, hisang chun mihem chapan napeh ding'u tonsot hinna joh chu hol'in kisugim jouvin; ajehchu Pa Pathen in keima hiche dinga chu Mohor einamdet ahitai,” ati.
English: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”

tcz: Chuin amahon adonbut'un, “Keihon jong Pathen'a ding na katoh nom'uve; ipi kabol dingu ham?” atiuve.
en: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”
text:
JHN 6:28
Thadou: Chuin amahon adonbut'un, “Keihon jong Pathen'a ding na katoh nom'uve; ipi kabol dingu ham?” atiuve.
English: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”

tcz: Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Hiche bou hi Pathen in nanghoa kon'a adei natoh chu ahi, ahinsolpa hi tahsan un,” ati.
en: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
text:
JHN 6:29
Thadou: Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Hiche bou hi Pathen in nanghoa kon'a adei natoh chu ahi, ahinsolpa hi tahsan un,” ati.
English: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

tcz: Hichun amahon adonbut'un, “Nang katahsan thei nading'un ipi ham nabolthei melchihna kidang khat neimu sah un,” atiuve.
en: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?
text:
JHN 6:30
Thadou: Hichun amahon adonbut'un, “Nang katahsan thei nading'un ipi ham nabolthei melchihna kidang khat neimu sah un,” atiuve.
English: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?

tcz: “Chule kapu kapateu chun gamthip ajotlaiyun manna aneuvin ahi, hichu Pathen Lekhabun asei Mose in amaho chu van'a kona changlhah neh ding apeuve,” kiti chu ahi.
en: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”
text:
JHN 6:31
Thadou: “Chule kapu kapateu chun gamthip ajotlaiyun manna aneuvin ahi, hichu Pathen Lekhabun asei Mose in amaho chu van'a kona changlhah neh ding apeuve,” kiti chu ahi.
English: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Keiman nangho atahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, Mose in vana kon changlhah apekhapoi, kapan apeh ahi, chuleh tun nangho dingin van'a kon changlhah tahbeh chu apetai.
en: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
text:
JHN 6:32
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Keiman nangho atahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, Mose in vana kon changlhah apekhapoi, kapan apeh ahi, chuleh tun nangho dingin van'a kon changlhah tahbeh chu apetai.
English: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

tcz: Pathen a kon'a changlhah tahbeh chu, van'a kona hung kumlha-a vannoiya hinna pea amabou chu ahi.”
en: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”
text:
JHN 6:33
Thadou: Pathen a kon'a changlhah tahbeh chu, van'a kona hung kumlha-a vannoiya hinna pea amabou chu ahi.”
English: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”

tcz: Chuin amahon ajah'a, “Pu chuche changlhah chu keiho aniseh'in neipeuvin,” atiuve.
en: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
text:
JHN 6:34
Thadou: Chuin amahon ajah'a, “Pu chuche changlhah chu keiho aniseh'in neipeuvin,” atiuve.
English: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima hinna changlhah kahi, koi hileh kahenga hung jouse gilkel kitlou ding, chuleh koi hileh keima eitahsan jouse a itih'a dangchah kitlou ding ahi.”
en: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
text:
JHN 6:35
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima hinna changlhah kahi, koi hileh kahenga hung jouse gilkel kitlou ding, chuleh koi hileh keima eitahsan jouse a itih'a dangchah kitlou ding ahi.”
English: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

tcz: Ahivangin nanghon keima neimu vang'un neitahsan deh pouve.
en: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
text:
JHN 6:36
Thadou: Ahivangin nanghon keima neimu vang'un neitahsan deh pouve.
English: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

tcz: Hijongleh, Paneipeh chengse ho chu kahenga hung ding ahiuve, chuleh keiman amaho chu kaledoh louhel ding ahi.
en: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
text:
JHN 6:37
Thadou: Hijongleh, Paneipeh chengse ho chu kahenga hung ding ahiuve, chuleh keiman amaho chu kaledoh louhel ding ahi.
English: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima eihin solpa Pathen lunglam bol dinga vana kon'a hung kumlha kahin keima lunggot bol dinga hung kahipoi.
en: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
text:
JHN 6:38
Thadou: Ajeh chu keima eihin solpa Pathen lunglam bol dinga vana kon'a hung kumlha kahin keima lunggot bol dinga hung kahipoi.
English: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

tcz: Chuleh Pathen lunglam chu hiche ahi, Aman keima eipeh chengse hi khatcha mansah louva, ni nunung nileh amaho kakai thou ding ahi.
en: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
text:
JHN 6:39
Thadou: Chuleh Pathen lunglam chu hiche ahi, Aman keima eipeh chengse hi khatcha mansah louva, ni nunung nileh amaho kakai thou ding ahi.
English: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche hi kapa lunglam ahi, Chapa mua chuleh tahsan jousen tonsot hinna anei ahitai; keiman amaho chu ni nunung nileh kakai thou ding ahi, ati.
en: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”
text:
JHN 6:40
Thadou: Ajeh chu hiche hi kapa lunglam ahi, Chapa mua chuleh tahsan jousen tonsot hinna anei ahitai; keiman amaho chu ni nunung nileh kakai thou ding ahi, ati.
English: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

tcz: Chuin Judah ho chu lunglhai lou tah'in aphun gam tauve, ajeh chu Yeshuan, “Keima vana kon'a hung kumlha hinna changlhah kahi,” ati.
en: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
text:
JHN 6:41
Thadou: Chuin Judah ho chu lunglhai lou tah'in aphun gam tauve, ajeh chu Yeshuan, “Keima vana kon'a hung kumlha hinna changlhah kahi,” ati.
English: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”

tcz: Hichun amaho akihouvun, “Hichepa hi Joseph chapa Yeshua hilou ham? Apa leh anu kihe'a iti aman keima vana kon'a hung kumlha kahi atithei ham?” atiuve.
en: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”
text:
JHN 6:42
Thadou: Hichun amaho akihouvun, “Hichepa hi Joseph chapa Yeshua hilou ham? Apa leh anu kihe'a iti aman keima vana kon'a hung kumlha kahi atithei ham?” atiuve.
English: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kathusei ho jeh in phun hih un.
en: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.
text:
JHN 6:43
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kathusei ho jeh in phun hih un.
English: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima eihinsol'a Pa chun kahenga aloilut ho tilou chu koima ama cham in, kahenga ahung thei poi, chuleh keiman amaho chu ni nunung nileh kakai thou ding ahi.
en: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.
text:
JHN 6:44
Thadou: Ajeh chu keima eihinsol'a Pa chun kahenga aloilut ho tilou chu koima ama cham in, kahenga ahung thei poi, chuleh keiman amaho chu ni nunung nileh kakai thou ding ahi.
English: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

tcz: Pathen Lekhabu'a Pathen in amaho abon'uva ahilding ahi, kitibang chun, koi hileh Pa thu ngaiya chuleh ama a kon'a kihil ho bou chu kahenga hungji ahiuve.
