en: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.
text:
JHN 6:45
Thadou: Pathen Lekhabu'a Pathen in amaho abon'uva ahilding ahi, kitibang chun, koi hileh Pa thu ngaiya chuleh ama a kon'a kihil ho bou chu kahenga hungji ahiuve.
English: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

tcz: Chule koiman Pathen amukhapoi, Pathen'a kon hung kisol amabou chun Pathen chu amu ahi.
en: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.
text:
JHN 6:46
Thadou: Chule koiman Pathen amukhapoi, Pathen'a kon hung kisol amabou chun Pathen chu amu ahi.
English: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

tcz: Keiman nangho tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh ama tahsan chan chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai.
en: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.
text:
JHN 6:47
Thadou: Keiman nangho tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh ama tahsan chan chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai.
English: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

tcz: Keima hinna changlhah kahi.
en: I am the bread of life.
text:
JHN 6:48
Thadou: Keima hinna changlhah kahi.
English: I am the bread of life.

tcz: Napu napateu vin gamthip'a manna aneuvin, ahivangin amaho abon'un athisoh heltauve.
en: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.
text:
JHN 6:49
Thadou: Napu napateu vin gamthip'a manna aneuvin, ahivangin amaho abon'un athisoh heltauve.
English: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

tcz: Koihileh vana kon'a changlhah neho vang chu a itih'a thita lou ding ahi.”
en: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
text:
JHN 6:50
Thadou: Koihileh vana kon'a changlhah neho vang chu a itih'a thita lou ding ahi.”
English: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

tcz: Keima vana kon hung kumlha changlhah hing chu kahi, koi hileh hiche changlhah neho chu tonsot'a hing ding ahi; chuleh vannoi hinna dinga kapeh ding changlhah chu katahsa hi ahi.
en: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
text:
JHN 6:51
Thadou: Keima vana kon hung kumlha changlhah hing chu kahi, koi hileh hiche changlhah neho chu tonsot'a hing ding ahi; chuleh vannoi hinna dinga kapeh ding changlhah chu katahsa hi ahi.
English: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

tcz: Chuin miho chu khat leh khat Yeshua thuseidoh chun akinel'un, “Iti hichepan atahsa chu eiho nehding'a apeh thei ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
text:
JHN 6:52
Thadou: Chuin miho chu khat leh khat Yeshua thuseidoh chun akinel'un, “Iti hichepan atahsa chu eiho nehding'a apeh thei ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman nangho tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, nanghon Mihem Chapa sa naneh lou'uva chuleh athisan nadonlou'uleh, nasung'uva tonsot hinna naneilou dingu ahi.
en: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.
text:
JHN 6:53
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman nangho tahbeh'a kaseipeh nahiuve, nanghon Mihem Chapa sa naneh lou'uva chuleh athisan nadonlou'uleh, nasung'uva tonsot hinna naneilou dingu ahi.
English: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.

tcz: Ahivangin koi hileh kasa ne'a, chuleh kathisan don'a vang chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai. Chuleh keiman ama chu ni nunung nileh kakai thou ding ahi.
en: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
text:
JHN 6:54
Thadou: Ahivangin koi hileh kasa ne'a, chuleh kathisan don'a vang chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai. Chuleh keiman ama chu ni nunung nileh kakai thou ding ahi.
English: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

tcz: Ajeh chu nehding tahbeh chu kasa ahin, chule donding tahbeh chu kathisan ahi.
en: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
text:
JHN 6:55
Thadou: Ajeh chu nehding tahbeh chu kasa ahin, chule donding tahbeh chu kathisan ahi.
English: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

tcz: Hijeh chun koi hileh kasa ne'a chuleh kathisan don'a chu keima sunga ama aum'in chuleh ama sunga keima ka um'in ahi.
en: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
text:
JHN 6:56
Thadou: Hijeh chun koi hileh kasa ne'a chuleh kathisan don'a chu keima sunga ama aum'in chuleh ama sunga keima ka um'in ahi.
English: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

tcz: Chule eihinsol'a hing jing Pa jal'a keima hing kahi; hiche bang chun keima'a kon'a kivah chu keima jal'a hing ding ahi.
en: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.
text:
JHN 6:57
Thadou: Chule eihinsol'a hing jing Pa jal'a keima hing kahi; hiche bang chun keima'a kon'a kivah chu keima jal'a hing ding ahi.
English: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima vana kon'a hung kumlha changlhah tahbeh chu kahi, hijeh chun koi hileh hiche changlhah ne'a chu, napu napa teuvin Manna ana neh'uva athisoh hel'u bang hita louva, amaho chu tonsot'a hing jing ding ahiuve.”
en: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”
text:
JHN 6:58
Thadou: Ajeh chu keima vana kon'a hung kumlha changlhah tahbeh chu kahi, hijeh chun koi hileh hiche changlhah ne'a chu, napu napa teuvin Manna ana neh'uva athisoh hel'u bang hita louva, amaho chu tonsot'a hing jing ding ahiuve.”
English: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”

tcz: Thu hicheng hi aman Capernaum kho'a kikhop na In'a athuhil pet'a asei ahi.
en: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
text:
JHN 6:59
Thadou: Thu hicheng hi aman Capernaum kho'a kikhop na In'a athuhil pet'a asei ahi.
English: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

tcz: Chuin aseijuiten ajah'a, “Hiche thuhi hetchen ahahsa vale koiman sangthei ponte,” atiuve.
en: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
text:
JHN 6:60
Thadou: Chuin aseijuiten ajah'a, “Hiche thuhi hetchen ahahsa vale koiman sangthei ponte,” atiuve.
English: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan aseijuite alung himo thim'u chu ahen, ajah'uva, “Hiche kathusei hin nalungu asuh noh phah hitam?
en: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?
text:
JHN 6:61
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan aseijuite alung himo thim'u chu ahen, ajah'uva, “Hiche kathusei hin nalungu asuh noh phah hitam?
English: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?

tcz: Achutileh nanghon Mihem Chapa vana lahtou va aum mukit leu chun, ipi nati tadiu vem?
en: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
text:
JHN 6:62
Thadou: Achutileh nanghon Mihem Chapa vana lahtou va aum mukit leu chun, ipi nati tadiu vem?
English: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

tcz: Lhagao bouvin tonsot hinna apehji ahi, Mihem tahsa kihabol in ima abukim joupoi, chuleh keiman najah uva kasei doh thucheng hohi, abon'a Lhagao leh hinna thu ahi.
en: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
text:
JHN 6:63
Thadou: Lhagao bouvin tonsot hinna apehji ahi, Mihem tahsa kihabol in ima abukim joupoi, chuleh keiman najah uva kasei doh thucheng hohi, abon'a Lhagao leh hinna thu ahi.
English: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

tcz: Ahivangin nalah'uva keima eitahsan lou na um'uve,” ati, ajeh chu Yeshuan atil'a pat'a koiham ama tahsan lou chuleh koiham ama pedoh ding ti ahetsa ahitai.
en: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.
text:
JHN 6:64
Thadou: Ahivangin nalah'uva keima eitahsan lou na um'uve,” ati, ajeh chu Yeshuan atil'a pat'a koiham ama tahsan lou chuleh koiham ama pedoh ding ti ahetsa ahitai.
English: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

tcz: Chuin aman ajah'uva, “Hiche jeh'a chu Pan eipeh lou chu mi koima kahenga ahung theipoi, tia kasei ahi,” ati.
en: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
text:
JHN 6:65
Thadou: Chuin aman ajah'uva, “Hiche jeh'a chu Pan eipeh lou chu mi koima kahenga ahung theipoi, tia kasei ahi,” ati.
English: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

tcz: Hiche apat chun, aseijui ho tamtah ache mang'un, ama adalha tauvin ahi.
en: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.
text:
JHN 6:66
Thadou: Hiche apat chun, aseijui ho tamtah ache mang'un, ama adalha tauvin ahi.
English: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan somle ni ho jah'a adongin, “Nanghon jong neidalhah dingu ham?” ati.
en: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”
text:
JHN 6:67
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan somle ni ho jah'a adongin, “Nanghon jong neidalhah dingu ham?” ati.
English: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”

tcz: Hichun Simon Peter in adonbut'in, “Pakai koi henga kache ding'u ham? Tonsot hinna pe'a thunei nangbou nahi.
en: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
text:
JHN 6:68
Thadou: Hichun Simon Peter in adonbut'in, “Pakai koi henga kache ding'u ham? Tonsot hinna pe'a thunei nangbou nahi.
English: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

tcz: Keihon nangma Pathen theng khat seh nahi kaheuve, hichu katahsan uve,” ati.
en: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
text:
JHN 6:69
Thadou: Keihon nangma Pathen theng khat seh nahi kaheuve, hichu katahsan uve,” ati.
English: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan ajah'uva, “keiman nangho somle ni kalhendoh nahiuvin, ahivangin nalah'uva satan khat aume,” ati.
en: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
text:
JHN 6:70
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan ajah'uva, “keiman nangho somle ni kalhendoh nahiuvin, ahivangin nalah'uva satan khat aume,” ati.
English: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”

tcz: Hichu aman alhen doh somle ni ho lah'a Simon Iscariot chapa Judas in khonunga ama apehdoh ding aseina ahi.
en: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.
text:
JHN 6:71
Thadou: Hichu aman alhen doh somle ni ho lah'a Simon Iscariot chapa Judas in khonunga ama apehdoh ding aseina ahi.
English: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

tcz: Hiche jou chun, Yeshuan Galilee gamsung muntin achon'in avahlen ahi, ajeh chu Judah vaipo hon ama thadinga agot jeh'un, ama Judea gam'a chun aumnom tapon ahi.
en: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
text:
JHN 7:1
Thadou: Hiche jou chun, Yeshuan Galilee gamsung muntin achon'in avahlen ahi, ajeh chu Judah vaipo hon ama thadinga agot jeh'un, ama Judea gam'a chun aumnom tapon ahi.
English: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

tcz: Ahivang in hiche pet chu Judah te lhambuh kut kon cha ahijeh chun,
en: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.
text:
JHN 7:2
Thadou: Ahivang in hiche pet chu Judah te lhambuh kut kon cha ahijeh chun,
English: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

tcz: Asopiten Yeshua jah'a, “Hilai mun dalhan lang Judea gam'a chen, chukom'a chu naseijuiten thil kidang nabol hohi amuthei ding'u ahi.
en: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.
text:
JHN 7:3
Thadou: Asopiten Yeshua jah'a, “Hilai mun dalhan lang Judea gam'a chen, chukom'a chu naseijuiten thil kidang nabol hohi amuthei ding'u ahi.
English: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

tcz: Hitia nakisel leh iti namin kithang ding ham? Hitobang thil kidang hohi nabol dingleh vannoi kimu sah in,” atiuve.
en: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”
text:
JHN 7:4
Thadou: Hitia nakisel leh iti namin kithang ding ham? Hitobang thil kidang hohi nabol dingleh vannoi kimu sah in,” atiuve.
English: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

tcz: Ajeh chu asopi ho jengin jong ama chu atahsan lou ahi.
en: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.
text:
JHN 7:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu asopi ho jengin jong ama chu atahsan lou ahi.
English: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Tuhi kei che na dinga phatpha ahipoi, ahivangin nangho chena dingin phat jouse ahitheiye.
en: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
text:
JHN 7:6
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Tuhi kei che na dinga phatpha ahipoi, ahivangin nangho chena dingin phat jouse ahitheiye.
English: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

tcz: Chuleh vannoiyin nangho nadou pouve, keima bou eidou'u ahi, ajeh chu amahon setna aboljeh'uva kaphoji ahi.
en: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
text:
JHN 7:7
Thadou: Chuleh vannoiyin nangho nadou pouve, keima bou eidou'u ahi, ajeh chu amahon setna aboljeh'uva kaphoji ahi.
English: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

tcz: Chule nangho cheuvin, keima chethei ponge, ajeh chu keima phat alhing jep poi,” ati.
en: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”
text:
JHN 7:8
Thadou: Chule nangho cheuvin, keima chethei ponge, ajeh chu keima phat alhing jep poi,” ati.
English: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

tcz: Chule thil hicheng aseijou chun Yeshua Galilee gam'a aumden in ahi. Lhambuh Kut laiya Yeshua
en: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.
text:
JHN 7:9
Thadou: Chule thil hicheng aseijou chun Yeshua Galilee gam'a aumden in ahi. Lhambuh Kut laiya Yeshua
English: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

tcz: Ahivangin asopiho kut'a achejou nung'un, mipi ho kimu sah louvin, Yeshua jong guhthim in achen ahi.
en: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
text:
JHN 7:10
Thadou: Ahivangin asopiho kut'a achejou nung'un, mipi ho kimu sah louvin, Yeshua jong guhthim in achen ahi.
English: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

tcz: Kut lai chun Judah vaipo hon Yeshua chu ahol'un, mipi lah'a khat khat henga chun Yeshua namu em? tin adong leuvin ahi.
en: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”
text:
JHN 7:11
Thadou: Kut lai chun Judah vaipo hon Yeshua chu ahol'un, mipi lah'a khat khat henga chun Yeshua namu em? tin adong leuvin ahi.
English: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

tcz: Hichun mipi holah'a, Yeshua chung chang kinel bautam na asoh dohtan ahi, mi phabep chun, Yeshua chu mipha ahi, atiuvin, ahivangin adang phabep chun Yeshua chu imacha hilou mi lhem chavai bou ahi, atiuvin ahi.
en: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”
text:
JHN 7:12
Thadou: Hichun mipi holah'a, Yeshua chung chang kinel bautam na asoh dohtan ahi, mi phabep chun, Yeshua chu mipha ahi, atiuvin, ahivangin adang phabep chun Yeshua chu imacha hilou mi lhem chavai bou ahi, atiuvin ahi.
English: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

tcz: Ahivangin Judah vaipo hon abol genthei diu ginna jal chun, Yeshua thudol panpi na mipi maiya ngamtah'a seiphong ding koima a umpouvin ahi.
en: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.
text:
JHN 7:13
Thadou: Ahivangin Judah vaipo hon abol genthei diu ginna jal chun, Yeshua thudol panpi na mipi maiya ngamtah'a seiphong ding koima a umpouvin ahi.
English: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

tcz: Chuin kut kibol kimlai tah chun, Yeshua Houin'ah achetouvin chuleh thu ahilpantan ahi.
en: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
text:
JHN 7:14
Thadou: Chuin kut kibol kimlai tah chun, Yeshua Houin'ah achetouvin chuleh thu ahilpantan ahi.
English: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

tcz: Athusei ajah'u chun Judah ho chu alung dong lheh un, “Hichepa hin kijil na neilou hel'a iti thil hijat hi ahet ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
text:
JHN 7:15
Thadou: Athusei ajah'u chun Judah ho chu alung dong lheh un, “Hichepa hin kijil na neilou hel'a iti thil hijat hi ahet ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

tcz: Hijeh chun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Kathu hil hi keima cham'a hung kon ahipon, eihin sol'a Pathen'a kon ahi.
en: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
text:
JHN 7:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Kathu hil hi keima cham'a hung kon ahipon, eihin sol'a Pathen'a kon ahi.
English: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

tcz: Koi hileh Pathen lunglam hol'a bol ding go'a chun kathu hil hi keima cham'a ham ahilou leh Pathen'a kon ham ti ahet ding ahi.
en: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.
text:
JHN 7:17
Thadou: Koi hileh Pathen lunglam hol'a bol ding go'a chun kathu hil hi keima cham'a ham ahilou leh Pathen'a kon ham ti ahet ding ahi.
English: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

tcz: Ajeh chu ama cham'a thuhil chun, ama chang kichoi-at na adeiyun, ahivangin ahinsol pa jabol na leh choi-at na holpa vang chun thutah asei ahi, ama a chun jou aumpoi.
en: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
text:
JHN 7:18
Thadou: Ajeh chu ama cham'a thuhil chun, ama chang kichoi-at na adeiyun, ahivangin ahinsol pa jabol na leh choi-at na holpa vang chun thutah asei ahi, ama a chun jou aumpoi.
English: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

tcz: Mose in danthu napeh'u ahin, ahivangin nangho khat in jong najui pouve, nanghon keima tha tahtah dinga neigot jingu ahi,” ati.
en: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
text:
JHN 7:19
Thadou: Mose in danthu napeh'u ahin, ahivangin nangho khat in jong najui pouve, nanghon keima tha tahtah dinga neigot jingu ahi,” ati.
English: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

tcz: Chuin mipi chun adonbut'un, “Koiham nang tha dinga nagong'ah? Nanghi thilha vop nahi bouve,” atiuve.
en: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
text:
JHN 7:20
Thadou: Chuin mipi chun adonbut'un, “Koiham nang tha dinga nagong'ah? Nanghi thilha vop nahi bouve,” atiuve.
English: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman Cholngah nikhoa thil kidang khat kabol chu nanghon nadatmo lheh uve.
en: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.
text:
JHN 7:21
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman Cholngah nikhoa thil kidang khat kabol chu nanghon nadatmo lheh uve.
English: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

tcz: Ahivangin nanghon jong nabol'uve, Mose dan thupeh palkeh lou bangtah in Cholngah nikhon mi chep natan peh jiuve; tahbeh mongin cheptan hi Mose danthu peh um masanga napului teuvin ana phudohsa ahitai.
en: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
text:
JHN 7:22
Thadou: Ahivangin nanghon jong nabol'uve, Mose dan thupeh palkeh lou bangtah in Cholngah nikhon mi chep natan peh jiuve; tahbeh mongin cheptan hi Mose danthu peh um masanga napului teuvin ana phudohsa ahitai.
English: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

tcz: Chuleh nanghon nachapa teu cheptan nikho chu Cholngah ni ato khah jongleh Mose dan thupeh palkeh lou bangin hichu nabol jiuve, achutile ipi dinga keiman Cholngah nikho'a mi kasuh dam chu nanghon nalunghan piu ham?
en: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?
text:
JHN 7:23
Thadou: Chuleh nanghon nachapa teu cheptan nikho chu Cholngah ni ato khah jongleh Mose dan thupeh palkeh lou bangin hichu nabol jiuve, achutile ipi dinga keiman Cholngah nikho'a mi kasuh dam chu nanghon nalunghan piu ham?
English: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

tcz: Hijeh chun kun'un noilang veuvin, kingaito phauvin, chutileh adihtah chu nahet ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
text:
JHN 7:24
Thadou: Hijeh chun kun'un noilang veuvin, kingaito phauvin, chutileh adihtah chu nahet ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

tcz: Hichun Jerusalem miho chu amaho leh amaho aki dong touvin, “Vaipo hon tha dinga agot jing'u chu hichepa hi hilou ham?
en: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
text:
JHN 7:25
Thadou: Hichun Jerusalem miho chu amaho leh amaho aki dong touvin, “Vaipo hon tha dinga agot jing'u chu hichepa hi hilou ham?
English: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

tcz: Amapa la hilaiya aum in, phongtah in mipi lah'a thu aseiyin, chuleh vaipo hon jong ima alopouve. Achutileh amahon jong hichepa hi Messiah ahi ti apom ngap'u ahitadem?
en: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?
text:
JHN 7:26
Thadou: Amapa la hilaiya aum in, phongtah in mipi lah'a thu aseiyin, chuleh vaipo hon jong ima alopouve. Achutileh amahon jong hichepa hi Messiah ahi ti apom ngap'u ahitadem?
English: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

tcz: Ahivangin amapa hi hichu iti hithei ding ham? Eihon ama ahung konna kihesoh keiya, Messiah vang chu ahung tengleh koiman ahung konna ahetlou ding, hung kilah jeng ding ahibouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”
text:
JHN 7:27
Thadou: Ahivangin amapa hi hichu iti hithei ding ham? Eihon ama ahung konna kihesoh keiya, Messiah vang chu ahung tengleh koiman ahung konna ahetlou ding, hung kilah jeng ding ahibouve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan Houin'a athuhil pet chun, ajah'uva, “Adih'e, nanghon keima neiheuve, chuleh kahung konna jong naheuve, ahivangin keima kacham'a hilaiya um kahipoi, keima eihinsolpa chu thudihtah ahi, chuleh nanghon ama chu nahe pouve.
en: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.
text:
JHN 7:28
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan Houin'a athuhil pet chun, ajah'uva, “Adih'e, nanghon keima neiheuve, chuleh kahung konna jong naheuve, ahivangin keima kacham'a hilaiya um kahipoi, keima eihinsolpa chu thudihtah ahi, chuleh nanghon ama chu nahe pouve.
English: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

tcz: Ahivangin keiman ama kahe chen'e, ajeh chu keima ama-a hung kon kahi, chuleh aman keima naheng'uva eihinsol ahi,” ati.
en: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”
text:
JHN 7:29
Thadou: Ahivangin keiman ama kahe chen'e, ajeh chu keima ama-a hung kon kahi, chuleh aman keima naheng'uva eihinsol ahi,” ati.
English: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

tcz: Chuin vaipo hon ama chu mat ding agouvin, ahivangin ama phat alhin lou lai jeh in, koiman achunga khut alhapouve.
en: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
text:
JHN 7:30
Thadou: Chuin vaipo hon ama chu mat ding agouvin, ahivangin ama phat alhin lou lai jeh in, koiman achunga khut alhapouve.
English: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

tcz: Hichun Houin'a um mitamtah chun Yeshua atahsan tauve, chule amaho akihouvun, “Messiah ahung teng, hichepan abol kalval'a nasajo melchih na kidang abolnah ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”
text:
JHN 7:31
Thadou: Hichun Houin'a um mitamtah chun Yeshua atahsan tauve, chule amaho akihouvun, “Messiah ahung teng, hichepan abol kalval'a nasajo melchih na kidang abolnah ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

tcz: Chuin mihonpi chu, Yeshua thudol akihoulhih melmul'u chu Pharisee hon ajahdoh phat'un, thempu pipui hotoh kijaton, Yeshua man dingin Houin ngah ho chu asol tauvin ahi.
en: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
text:
JHN 7:32
Thadou: Chuin mihonpi chu, Yeshua thudol akihoulhih melmul'u chu Pharisee hon ajahdoh phat'un, thempu pipui hotoh kijaton, Yeshua man dingin Houin ngah ho chu asol tauvin ahi.
English: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Keima nangho toh phat chomcha bou ka umkhom ding ahi, chuleh keima eihinsolpa heng'a kakile kit ding ahi.
en: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
text:
JHN 7:33
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Keima nangho toh phat chomcha bou ka umkhom ding ahi, chuleh keima eihinsolpa heng'a kakile kit ding ahi.
English: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

tcz: Nanghon keima neihol'un natin, neimulou dingu ahi, chuleh keima chena'a chu nangho nahung thei lou dingu ahi,” ati.
en: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”
text:
JHN 7:34
Thadou: Nanghon keima neihol'un natin, neimulou dingu ahi, chuleh keima chena'a chu nangho nahung thei lou dingu ahi,” ati.
English: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”

tcz: Chuin Judah vaipo ho chun, hiche Yeshua thusei chu adatmo lheh un ahi, amaho akidong touvin, “Hichepa hi hoilanga che ding kigo ham? Oleh, amahi hiche gam dalha'a mun danga um Judah ho henga cheding kigo ahidem? Amahin Greek miho jeng jong agahil got hinte.
en: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
text:
JHN 7:35
Thadou: Chuin Judah vaipo ho chun, hiche Yeshua thusei chu adatmo lheh un ahi, amaho akidong touvin, “Hichepa hi hoilanga che ding kigo ham? Oleh, amahi hiche gam dalha'a mun danga um Judah ho henga cheding kigo ahidem? Amahin Greek miho jeng jong agahil got hinte.
English: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

tcz: Chuleh ipi aseina mong ahidem? Nanghon neihol'un natin, neimulou dingu chuleh keima chena'a chu nangho nahung theilou dingu atihi,” akitiuvin ahi.
en: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”
text:
JHN 7:36
Thadou: Chuleh ipi aseina mong ahidem? Nanghon neihol'un natin, neimulou dingu chuleh keima chena'a chu nangho nahung theilou dingu atihi,” akitiuvin ahi.
English: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”

tcz: Chuin kut kichaini aniloupi pen nin, Yeshua mihonpi lah'a ading doh'in, ajah'uva, “Koi hileh adangchah'a chu kahenga hunghen.
en: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!
text:
JHN 7:37
Thadou: Chuin kut kichaini aniloupi pen nin, Yeshua mihonpi lah'a ading doh'in, ajah'uva, “Koi hileh adangchah'a chu kahenga hunghen.
English: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

tcz: Koi hileh keima eitahsan'a chu kahenga hunghen chuleh hungdon hen, ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun aphondoh banga ama lung sunga kon'a chu twi hing luiya longdoh ding ahi,” tin asamtai.
en: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
text:
JHN 7:38
Thadou: Koi hileh keima eitahsan'a chu kahenga hunghen chuleh hungdon hen, ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun aphondoh banga ama lung sunga kon'a chu twi hing luiya longdoh ding ahi,” tin asamtai.
English: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

tcz: Aman twi-hing ati chu ama tahsan jouse chunga Lhagao aum ding aseina ahi, ahivangin Yeshua chu aloupina'a alut loulai jeh'in hiche Lhagao chu kipeloulai ahiuve.
en: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.
text:
JHN 7:39
Thadou: Aman twi-hing ati chu ama tahsan jouse chunga Lhagao aum ding aseina ahi, ahivangin Yeshua chu aloupina'a alut loulai jeh'in hiche Lhagao chu kipeloulai ahiuve.
English: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.

tcz: Chuin mihonpi chun, hiche asei chu ajauvin, alah'uva phabep chun, “Hichepa hi inga jingu themgao pachu hitei yinte,” atiuvin ahi.
en: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
text:
JHN 7:40
Thadou: Chuin mihonpi chun, hiche asei chu ajauvin, alah'uva phabep chun, “Hichepa hi inga jingu themgao pachu hitei yinte,” atiuvin ahi.
English: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

tcz: Chuleh adang phabep chun, “Amapa hi Messiah ahi,” atiuvin ahi, ahivangin adang phabep chun, “Hiponte, iti Messiah chu Galilee gam'a hungsoh doh thei ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
text:
JHN 7:41
Thadou: Chuleh adang phabep chun, “Amapa hi Messiah ahi,” atiuvin ahi, ahivangin adang phabep chun, “Hiponte, iti Messiah chu Galilee gam'a hungsoh doh thei ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen lekhabu'a kicheh tah'a kiphong dohsa bangin, Messiah chu David chilhah hiding, David khopi Bethlehem a kon hiding ahibouve, atiuvin ahi.
en: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
text:
JHN 7:42
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen lekhabu'a kicheh tah'a kiphong dohsa bangin, Messiah chu David chilhah hiding, David khopi Bethlehem a kon hiding ahibouve, atiuvin ahi.
English: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”

tcz: Hijeh chun, Yeshua chung chang thua, mihonpi chu akikhen tel gamtauvin ahi.
en: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.
text:
JHN 7:43
Thadou: Hijeh chun, Yeshua chung chang thua, mihonpi chu akikhen tel gamtauvin ahi.
English: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.

tcz: Chuleh alah'uva mi phabep chun, Yeshua chu mat tei ding angaitou vin, ahivang in koiman achunga khut alhapouve. Judah vaipo hon Yeshua atahsan lou
en: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.
text:
JHN 7:44
Thadou: Chuleh alah'uva mi phabep chun, Yeshua chu mat tei ding angaitou vin, ahivang in koiman achunga khut alhapouve. Judah vaipo hon Yeshua atahsan lou
English: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

tcz: Chuin Houin ngah sottol le ho chu Yeshua manlouva ahung kile phat'un, thempu pipui holeh Pharisee ho chun ajah'uva, “Ibol'a ama nahin puilut lou u ham?” tin adongun ahi.
en: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
text:
JHN 7:45
Thadou: Chuin Houin ngah sottol le ho chu Yeshua manlouva ahung kile phat'un, thempu pipui holeh Pharisee ho chun ajah'uva, “Ibol'a ama nahin puilut lou u ham?” tin adongun ahi.
English: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”

tcz: Houin ngah sottol le hon adonbut'un, “Keihon hichepa thusei tobang kaja khapouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
text:
JHN 7:46
Thadou: Houin ngah sottol le hon adonbut'un, “Keihon hichepa thusei tobang kaja khapouve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

tcz: Hichun Pharisee hon anuisat un, “Nangho jong lhep lhah'a na um'u hitam?
en: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
text:
JHN 7:47
Thadou: Hichun Pharisee hon anuisat un, “Nangho jong lhep lhah'a na um'u hitam?
English: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?

tcz: Eiho lah'a vaipo ho leh Pharisee ho khat beh injong amapa chu atahsan em?
en: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?
text:
JHN 7:48
Thadou: Eiho lah'a vaipo ho leh Pharisee ho khat beh injong amapa chu atahsan em?
English: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?

tcz: Khohelou mihonpi in dan thupeh ima ahetlou jeh'uva ama nung ajuiyu ahibouve, chuleh achung'uva Pathen sapset chuding ahi,” atiuve.
en: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”
text:
JHN 7:49
Thadou: Khohelou mihonpi in dan thupeh ima ahetlou jeh'uva ama nung ajuiyu ahibouve, chuleh achung'uva Pathen sapset chuding ahi,” atiuve.
English: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”

tcz: Hichun masanga Yeshua toh gakimuto sa vaipo lah'a khat amin Nicodemus chun, ajah'uva;
en: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

tcz: “Mikhat chu ama thu kija masa louva, achunga themmo chansah jeng chu dan ngai na ham?” ati.
en: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
text:
JHN 7:51
Thadou: “Mikhat chu ama thu kija masa louva, achunga themmo chansah jeng chu dan ngai na ham?” ati.
English: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

tcz: Chuin amahon adonbut un, “Nang jong Galilee mi nahim? Pathen Lekhabu'a phet inlang sim'in Galilee gam'a kon'a themgao sohdoh khalou hel ahi,” atiuve.
en: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
text:
JHN 7:52
Thadou: Chuin amahon adonbut un, “Nang jong Galilee mi nahim? Pathen Lekhabu'a phet inlang sim'in Galilee gam'a kon'a themgao sohdoh khalou hel ahi,” atiuve.
English: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”

tcz: Hichun akikhop nau aki khen'un mijousen a-in cheh akijot tauvin ahi.
en: Everyone went to his own house,
text:
JHN 7:53
Thadou: Hichun akikhop nau aki khen'un mijousen a-in cheh akijot tauvin ahi.
English: Everyone went to his own house,

tcz: Yeshua chu Olive lhang lam'a akile kittai.
en: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
text:
JHN 8:1
Thadou: Yeshua chu Olive lhang lam'a akile kittai.
English: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

tcz: Ahivangin ajing jingkah matah in ama Houin'ah ahungkit in ahi. Chuin hetman louvin, mihonpi khat aheng'a ahung kikhom'un ama atouvin, amaho chu thu ahiltan ahi.
en: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.
text:
JHN 8:2
Thadou: Ahivangin ajing jingkah matah in ama Houin'ah ahungkit in ahi. Chuin hetman louvin, mihonpi khat aheng'a ahung kikhom'un ama atouvin, amaho chu thu ahiltan ahi.
English: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.

tcz: Hitia athuhil laitah chun, Danthu them hole Pharisee hon, ajonpet tah'a kiman numei khat ahin kaiyun, mipi lailunga chun adinsah'un ahi.
en: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,
text:
JHN 8:3
Thadou: Hitia athuhil laitah chun, Danthu them hole Pharisee hon, ajonpet tah'a kiman numei khat ahin kaiyun, mipi lailunga chun adinsah'un ahi.
English: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,

tcz: Hichun amahon Yeshua jah'a, “Houhil hiche numei hi ajon pettah'a kiman ahi.
en: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.
text:
JHN 8:4
Thadou: Hichun amahon Yeshua jah'a, “Houhil hiche numei hi ajon pettah'a kiman ahi.
English: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

tcz: Hijeh chun Mose danthu peh dungjui in, amanu hi songa selih ding ahi, nangman ipi nagel em?” atiuve.
en: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”
text:
JHN 8:5
Thadou: Hijeh chun Mose danthu peh dungjui in, amanu hi songa selih ding ahi, nangman ipi nagel em?” atiuve.
English: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”

tcz: Hichu ama hehset na thei ding ikhat beh aseidoh khat leh tia thangkam peh ahiuve; ahivangin Yeshua akun'in ima seilouvin akhut jungin tol chu ajih in ahi.
en: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
text:
JHN 8:6
Thadou: Hichu ama hehset na thei ding ikhat beh aseidoh khat leh tia thangkam peh ahiuve; ahivangin Yeshua akun'in ima seilouvin akhut jungin tol chu ajih in ahi.
English: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

tcz: Hichun amahon Yeshua chun adonbut teidinga ano jeh'un Yeshua ading doh in ajah'uva, “Aphai nalah uva chonset bolkhalou hel pen penin amanu chu songin sep masa hen,” ati.
en: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”
text:
JHN 8:7
Thadou: Hichun amahon Yeshua chun adonbut teidinga ano jeh'un Yeshua ading doh in ajah'uva, “Aphai nalah uva chonset bolkhalou hel pen penin amanu chu songin sep masa hen,” ati.
English: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”

tcz: Chuin ama akun'in tol chu ajih kit in ahi.
en: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
text:
JHN 8:8
Thadou: Chuin ama akun'in tol chu ajih kit in ahi.
English: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

tcz: Chuin amahon hichu ajah phat'un, atehpen'a pat aneopen geiyin ama ho khat khat in achemang gamtauvin, mihonpi lailunga chun Yeshua changseh leh numeinu bou adalha tauvin ahi.
en: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.
text:
JHN 8:9
Thadou: Chuin amahon hichu ajah phat'un, atehpen'a pat aneopen geiyin ama ho khat khat in achemang gamtauvin, mihonpi lailunga chun Yeshua changseh leh numeinu bou adalha tauvin ahi.
English: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

tcz: Hichun Yeshua adingdoh in amanu jah'a, “Nahinkai ho hoilam gei hitauvem? Koiman themmo nachan lou hitam?” ati.
en: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”
text:
JHN 8:10
Thadou: Hichun Yeshua adingdoh in amanu jah'a, “Nahinkai ho hoilam gei hitauvem? Koiman themmo nachan lou hitam?” ati.
English: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”

tcz: Hichun amanun, “Pakai koiman themmo eichan tapoi,” ati. Hichun Yeshuan amanu jah'a, “Keiman jong themmo kachan poi chetan, ahin tukal chonsekit tahih'in,” ati.
en: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”
text:
JHN 8:11
Thadou: Hichun amanun, “Pakai koiman themmo eichan tapoi,” ati. Hichun Yeshuan amanu jah'a, “Keiman jong themmo kachan poi chetan, ahin tukal chonsekit tahih'in,” ati.
English: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan avelin miho jah'a, “Keima vannoi Vah kahi, kanung najui uleh nangho muthim'a vahle lou nahi tauve, ajeh chu nanghon hinna vah chu naneiyu ahitai,” ati.
en: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
text:
JHN 8:12
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan avelin miho jah'a, “Keima vannoi Vah kahi, kanung najui uleh nangho muthim'a vahle lou nahi tauve, ajeh chu nanghon hinna vah chu naneiyu ahitai,” ati.
English: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

tcz: Hichun Pharisee hon adonbut'un, “Na chungthu nangma tah in na hettoh sah chu hettoh sah dih ahipoi,” atiuve.
en: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”
text:
JHN 8:13
Thadou: Hichun Pharisee hon adonbut'un, “Na chungthu nangma tah in na hettoh sah chu hettoh sah dih ahipoi,” atiuve.
English: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Kachungthu keima tah'in kahet tohsah hi, hettoh sah dihtah ahi. Ajeh chu keiman kahung kona leh kajot na ding kakihet in, ahivangin hichu nanghon nahe pouve.”
en: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.
text:
JHN 8:14
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Kachungthu keima tah'in kahet tohsah hi, hettoh sah dihtah ahi. Ajeh chu keiman kahung kona leh kajot na ding kakihet in, ahivangin hichu nanghon nahe pouve.”
English: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.

tcz: Chule nanghon tahsa mihem hina dol'in ka chungthu natan'un, keiman vang koima chungthu chuti chun katan jipoi.
en: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
text:
JHN 8:15
Thadou: Chule nanghon tahsa mihem hina dol'in ka chungthu natan'un, keiman vang koima chungthu chuti chun katan jipoi.
English: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

tcz: Ijemtia thutanna kabol tah jongle, kathu tan jouse abon'a dihtah ahi; ajeh chu keima kachang kahipon, eihinsol'a Kapa toh kahilhon'e.
en: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
text:
JHN 8:16
Thadou: Ijemtia thutanna kabol tah jongle, kathu tan jouse abon'a dihtah ahi; ajeh chu keima kachang kahipon, eihinsol'a Kapa toh kahilhon'e.
English: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho danthu dungjui in minin kitoh tah'a ahettoh sah leh hichu hettoh sah dihtah'a kipom ahi.
en: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
text:
JHN 8:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangho danthu dungjui in minin kitoh tah'a ahettoh sah leh hichu hettoh sah dihtah'a kipom ahi.
English: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

tcz: Hijeh chun, keima tah hettoh sah khat kahin, chuleh eihinsol'a kapa chu hettohsah adang khat chu ahi.
en: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
text:
JHN 8:18
Thadou: Hijeh chun, keima tah hettoh sah khat kahin, chuleh eihinsol'a kapa chu hettohsah adang khat chu ahi.
English: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”

tcz: Hichun amahon adong'un, “Napa hoiya umham?” atiuve, Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Nanghon keima neihe pouve, kapa jong nahe pouve, keima neihe leu chun kapa jong nahet diu ahi,” ati.
en: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”
text:
JHN 8:19
Thadou: Hichun amahon adong'un, “Napa hoiya umham?” atiuve, Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Nanghon keima neihe pouve, kapa jong nahe pouve, keima neihe leu chun kapa jong nahet diu ahi,” ati.
English: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

tcz: Hicheng jouse chu, Yeshuan Houin sunga sumkhol na kiti mun'a athuhil pet'a asei ahi. Ahivangin anikho alhin jep loulai jeh in, koiman ama chu amanpoi.
en: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
text:
JHN 8:20
Thadou: Hicheng jouse chu, Yeshuan Houin sunga sumkhol na kiti mun'a athuhil pet'a asei ahi. Ahivangin anikho alhin jep loulai jeh in, koiman ama chu amanpoi.
English: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

tcz: Chujouvin Yeshuan avel in ajah'uva, “Keima kache mang ding ahi, nangho kache na-a nahung thei pouve, ajeh chu na chonset nau chu nathipi ding'u ahi,” ati.
en: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”
text:
JHN 8:21
Thadou: Chujouvin Yeshuan avel in ajah'uva, “Keima kache mang ding ahi, nangho kache na-a nahung thei pouve, ajeh chu na chonset nau chu nathipi ding'u ahi,” ati.
English: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

tcz: Hichun miho chu akidong touvin, “Hiche pa hi ama leh ama kithat go khat ham? Chuleh kache na-a nangho nahung thei pouve ati hi ipi aseina ahidem?” atiuve.
en: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”
text:
JHN 8:22
Thadou: Hichun miho chu akidong touvin, “Hiche pa hi ama leh ama kithat go khat ham? Chuleh kache na-a nangho nahung thei pouve ati hi ipi aseina ahidem?” atiuve.
English: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan avel in ajah'uva, “Nangho noiya kon nahiuvin, keima chunga kon kahi, chuleh nangho hiche vannoiya um nahiuvin, keima kahipoi.
en: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.
text:
JHN 8:23
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan avel in ajah'uva, “Nangho noiya kon nahiuvin, keima chunga kon kahi, chuleh nangho hiche vannoiya um nahiuvin, keima kahipoi.
English: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu najah'uva kasei ahi, nanghon keima koi kahi kahet tohsah hi natahsan lou uleh, na chonset nau chu nathipi teiding'u ahi,” ati.
en: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”
text:
JHN 8:24
Thadou: Hiche jeh a chu najah'uva kasei ahi, nanghon keima koi kahi kahet tohsah hi natahsan lou uleh, na chonset nau chu nathipi teiding'u ahi,” ati.
English: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

tcz: Hichun amahon adong'un, Nang koi nahim? atiuve, Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima ama chu kahi tia kaseijing tah chula em,” ati.
en: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.
text:
JHN 8:25
Thadou: Hichun amahon adong'un, Nang koi nahim? atiuve, Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima ama chu kahi tia kaseijing tah chula em,” ati.
English: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

tcz: “Keiman nangho chunga demna dingleh sei ding adim'in kaneiye, ahivangin seipong e; ajeh chu keima eisolpa chu thudihtah ahin, ama-a kon'a kajah ho bou kasei ahi.”
en: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”
text:
JHN 8:26
Thadou: “Keiman nangho chunga demna dingleh sei ding adim'in kaneiye, ahivangin seipong e; ajeh chu keima eisolpa chu thudihtah ahin, ama-a kon'a kajah ho bou kasei ahi.”
English: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

tcz: Ahivangin Yeshuan hiche asei chu, Pa thudol aseina ahiti amahon ahedoh thei deh pouve.
en: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.
text:
JHN 8:27
Thadou: Ahivangin Yeshuan hiche asei chu, Pa thudol aseina ahiti amahon ahedoh thei deh pouve.
English: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

tcz: Hiche jeh chun, Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Nanghon Mihem Chapa chu thingpel a nadop sang teng'u leh ama chu keima tah kahi nahet dingu ahi, ajeh chu keiman kacham'a imacha kabolpoi, Pa chun eihil ho bou kasei ahi.
en: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.
text:
JHN 8:28
Thadou: Hiche jeh chun, Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Nanghon Mihem Chapa chu thingpel a nadop sang teng'u leh ama chu keima tah kahi nahet dingu ahi, ajeh chu keiman kacham'a imacha kabolpoi, Pa chun eihil ho bou kasei ahi.
English: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

tcz: Chuleh keima eisolpa chun ei umpi jinge, aman kachangin eidalha poi, ajeh chu keiman phat jousen ama lunglhai na bou kabol jin ahi,” ati.
en: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
text:
JHN 8:29
Thadou: Chuleh keima eisolpa chun ei umpi jinge, aman kachangin eidalha poi, ajeh chu keiman phat jousen ama lunglhai na bou kabol jin ahi,” ati.
English: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

tcz: Chuin mitam tah in thu hicheng asei chu ajah phat'un, ama chu atahsan tauve.
en: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.
text:
JHN 8:30
Thadou: Chuin mitam tah in thu hicheng asei chu ajah phat'un, ama chu atahsan tauve.
English: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ama tahsan ho henga chun, “Nangho kathuhil'a hi kitah tah'a na umjing'u leh nangho kaseijui tahbeh nahiuve.
en: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
text:
JHN 8:31
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan ama tahsan ho henga chun, “Nangho kathuhil'a hi kitah tah'a na umjing'u leh nangho kaseijui tahbeh nahiuve.
English: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

tcz: Chuleh nanghon thutah chu heuvin natin, chuteng thutah chun nacham lhat sah dingu ahi,” ati.
en: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
text:
JHN 8:32
Thadou: Chuleh nanghon thutah chu heuvin natin, chuteng thutah chun nacham lhat sah dingu ahi,” ati.
English: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

tcz: Hichun amahon, ajah'a, “Keiho vang Abraham son leh pah kahiuve, keiho imatih in koima soh'in ka um khapouve; nangho nacham lhat sah ding'u nati chu ipi naseina ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”
text:
JHN 8:33
Thadou: Hichun amahon, ajah'a, “Keiho vang Abraham son leh pah kahiuve, keiho imatih in koima soh'in ka um khapouve; nangho nacham lhat sah ding'u nati chu ipi naseina ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman atahbeh chu kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh chonset bol jinga chu chonset soh ahi.”
en: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
text:
JHN 8:34
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman atahbeh chu kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh chonset bol jinga chu chonset soh ahi.”
English: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

tcz: Chuleh soh chu insungmi tahtah ahiden thei poi, ahin chapa vang chu a itih'a insungmi dihtah ahijinge.
en: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
text:
JHN 8:35
Thadou: Chuleh soh chu insungmi tahtah ahiden thei poi, ahin chapa vang chu a itih'a insungmi dihtah ahijinge.
English: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

tcz: Hijeh chun, Chapa chun nangho nalha-ong'uva ahileh nangho achamlhat tahbeh nahiu ahitai.
en: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
text:
JHN 8:36
Thadou: Hijeh chun, Chapa chun nangho nalha-ong'uva ahileh nangho achamlhat tahbeh nahiu ahitai.
English: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

tcz: Adih e, nangho Abraham son leh pah nahiu kahenai; ahivangin nanghon keima tha ding neigo jing'uve, ajeh chu nalung sung uva kathu hil hi alutpoi.
en: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
text:
JHN 8:37
Thadou: Adih e, nangho Abraham son leh pah nahiu kahenai; ahivangin nanghon keima tha ding neigo jing'uve, ajeh chu nalung sung uva kathu hil hi alutpoi.
English: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

tcz: Chuleh keiman kapa koma kamu chengse nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, ahivangin nanghon napau thumop bou najuiuve.
en: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”
text:
JHN 8:38
Thadou: Chuleh keiman kapa koma kamu chengse nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, ahivangin nanghon napau thumop bou najuiuve.
English: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”

tcz: Ama hon adonbut'un, “Kapau chu Abraham ahi,” atiuve, hichun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Ahipoi,” nangho Abraham chate hileu chun, ama thilbol nung najui dingu ahi.
en: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
text:
JHN 8:39
Thadou: Ama hon adonbut'un, “Kapau chu Abraham ahi,” atiuve, hichun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Ahipoi,” nangho Abraham chate hileu chun, ama thilbol nung najui dingu ahi.
English: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.

tcz: Ahinlah keiman Pathen'a kon'a kajah thutah cheng nangho kaseipeh jeh'un, nanghon keima tha ding neigo jinguve, Abraham chun imatih chan in chutobang thil abolpoi.
en: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
text:
JHN 8:40
Thadou: Ahinlah keiman Pathen'a kon'a kajah thutah cheng nangho kaseipeh jeh'un, nanghon keima tha ding neigo jinguve, Abraham chun imatih chan in chutobang thil abolpoi.
English: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.

tcz: “Nanghon napau dihtah adang khat umchan najui'u ahibouve,” ati. Hichun amahon adonbut'un, “Keiho jaocha kahipouve, Pathen amatah chu kapau dihtah ahi,” atiuve.
en: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”
text:
JHN 8:41
Thadou: “Nanghon napau dihtah adang khat umchan najui'u ahibouve,” ati. Hichun amahon adonbut'un, “Keiho jaocha kahipouve, Pathen amatah chu kapau dihtah ahi,” atiuve.
English: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Pathen chu napau ahileh nanghon keima nei ngailut dingu ahi. Ajeh chu keima Pathen'a kon hung kipan kahi. Keima kacham'a hung kahipoi, aman eihin sol ahibouve.
en: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.
text:
JHN 8:42
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Pathen chu napau ahileh nanghon keima nei ngailut dingu ahi. Ajeh chu keima Pathen'a kon hung kipan kahi. Keima kacham'a hung kahipoi, aman eihin sol ahibouve.
English: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.

tcz: Chuleh nanghon ibol'a kathusei nahet thei lou'u ham? hiche hi nanghon kathu sei nangailou jeh'u ahi.
en: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
text:
JHN 8:43
Thadou: Chuleh nanghon ibol'a kathusei nahet thei lou'u ham? hiche hi nanghon kathu sei nangailou jeh'u ahi.
English: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.

tcz: Nangho napau Satan chate nahi jeh'un, ama thilbol aphalou ho bol ding nanomui, ama chu atil'a pat'a tolthat ahin, ama-a thutah'a umlou jeh chun, phat jousen aman thutah ahot in ahi; aman jou asei chu achonna'a behden ahitai, ajeh chu ama mijou ahin, jou kondon na pa ahi.
en: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.
text:
JHN 8:44
Thadou: Nangho napau Satan chate nahi jeh'un, ama thilbol aphalou ho bol ding nanomui, ama chu atil'a pat'a tolthat ahin, ama-a thutah'a umlou jeh chun, phat jousen aman thutah ahot in ahi; aman jou asei chu achonna'a behden ahitai, ajeh chu ama mijou ahin, jou kondon na pa ahi.
English: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.

tcz: Hijeh a chu keiman nangho thutah kasei peh'u jongleh nanghon keima neitahsan theilou'u ahi.
en: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
text:
JHN 8:45
Thadou: Hijeh a chu keiman nangho thutah kasei peh'u jongleh nanghon keima neitahsan theilou'u ahi.
English: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.

tcz: Chuleh nangho koipen in hettohsah kichehtah'a mi chonse kahina nei ngoh thei uvem? Achutileh na henguva keiman thutah kasei ahi, ibol'a neitahsan lou'u ham?
en: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
text:
JHN 8:46
Thadou: Chuleh nangho koipen in hettohsah kichehtah'a mi chonse kahina nei ngoh thei uvem? Achutileh na henguva keiman thutah kasei ahi, ibol'a neitahsan lou'u ham?
English: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

tcz: Hijeh chun koi hileh Pathen'a hiho chun kipah tah in Pathen thu angaiyun ahi; ahivangin nangho Pathen'a nahilou jeh'un athu na ngaipouve,” ati.
en: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
text:
JHN 8:47
Thadou: Hijeh chun koi hileh Pathen'a hiho chun kipah tah in Pathen thu angaiyun ahi; ahivangin nangho Pathen'a nahilou jeh'un athu na ngaipouve,” ati.
English: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”

tcz: Chuin amahon ajah'a, “Nangma Samaria mi nahin, thilha vop nahi tia kana seijingu hita lou ham?” atiuve.
en: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
text:
JHN 8:48
Thadou: Chuin amahon ajah'a, “Nangma Samaria mi nahin, thilha vop nahi tia kana seijingu hita lou ham?” atiuve.
English: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kahipoi, keima thilhavop kahipoi, ajeh chu keiman kapa kajabol ahin, nanghon keima neija bol pouve.
en: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
text:
JHN 8:49
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kahipoi, keima thilhavop kahipoi, ajeh chu keiman kapa kajabol ahin, nanghon keima neija bol pouve.
English: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

tcz: Ahivangin, keiman keima chang kichoi-at kaholpoi, Pathen in keima eichoi sang dingbou ahi; ajeh chu ama thutan dihtah ahi.
en: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.
text:
JHN 8:50
Thadou: Ahivangin, keiman keima chang kichoi-at kaholpoi, Pathen in keima eichoi sang dingbou ahi; ajeh chu ama thutan dihtah ahi.
English: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

tcz: Chule keiman nangho atahbeh chu kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh kathuhil ngaiya bol'a chu a itih'a thi lou ding ahi,” ati.
en: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
text:
JHN 8:51
Thadou: Chule keiman nangho atahbeh chu kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh kathuhil ngaiya bol'a chu a itih'a thi lou ding ahi,” ati.
English: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

tcz: Chuin amahon ajah'a, “Thilhavop nahi kahe tauve, Abraham leh themgao ho athigam tauvin, ahivangin nangman kathuhil nit'a chu a itih'a thilou ding ahi, nati.
en: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
text:
JHN 8:52
Thadou: Chuin amahon ajah'a, “Thilhavop nahi kahe tauve, Abraham leh themgao ho athigam tauvin, ahivangin nangman kathuhil nit'a chu a itih'a thilou ding ahi, nati.
English: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’

tcz: Chule kapau Abraham sang'a chungnung jo nahim? Ama athitan, themgao ho jong athitauvin, ahileh nangman koi kahi tia naki gel ham?” atiuve.
en: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”
text:
JHN 8:53
Thadou: Chule kapau Abraham sang'a chungnung jo nahim? Ama athitan, themgao ho jong athitauvin, ahileh nangman koi kahi tia naki gel ham?” atiuve.
English: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima kichang choi-at na hol kahileh hichu keima ima hilou kahitai; ahinlah nanghon ka Pathen'u natiu kapa ama chun keima ei choi-at ding ahibouve.
en: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
text:
JHN 8:54
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima kichang choi-at na hol kahileh hichu keima ima hilou kahitai; ahinlah nanghon ka Pathen'u natiu kapa ama chun keima ei choi-at ding ahibouve.
English: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

tcz: Ahivangin nanghon ama chu nahe pouve, kenvang ama chu kahei, chuleh keiman ama chu kahepoi tileng keimatah hi nangho banga mijou kahi khah ding ahi, ahivangin keiman ama kahet jeh chun, amathu kangaiyin ahi.
en: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.
text:
JHN 8:55
Thadou: Ahivangin nanghon ama chu nahe pouve, kenvang ama chu kahei, chuleh keiman ama chu kahepoi tileng keimatah hi nangho banga mijou kahi khah ding ahi, ahivangin keiman ama kahet jeh chun, amathu kangaiyin ahi.
English: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.

tcz: Chuleh napau Abraham chun keima nikho mu ding anagal dot ahin, chule aman hichu anamun chuleh akipah lheh jengin ahi,” ati.
en: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”
text:
JHN 8:56
Thadou: Chuleh napau Abraham chun keima nikho mu ding anagal dot ahin, chule aman hichu anamun chuleh akipah lheh jengin ahi,” ati.
English: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”

tcz: Chuin Judah ho chun ajah'a, “Nangma kum somnga bon lhinglou laiya, iti nangin Abraham kamutai nati ham?” atiuve.
en: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”
text:
JHN 8:57
Thadou: Chuin Judah ho chun ajah'a, “Nangma kum somnga bon lhinglou laiya, iti nangin Abraham kamutai nati ham?” atiuve.
English: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman nangho atahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, Abraham masanga keima ana umsa jing kahitai,” ati.
en: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
text:
JHN 8:58
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman nangho atahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, Abraham masanga keima ana umsa jing kahitai,” ati.
English: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”

tcz: Chuche phat chun, Judah hon ama sena dingin song akilah tauvin ahi, ahivangin alah'uva kon'in Yeshua chu akiseldoh in, Houin'a kon chun achemangtai.
en: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.
text:
JHN 8:59
Thadou: Chuche phat chun, Judah hon ama sena dingin song akilah tauvin ahi, ahivangin alah'uva kon'in Yeshua chu akiseldoh in, Houin'a kon chun achemangtai.
English: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.

tcz: Chuin Yeshua chu avahlen ahileh, apen'a mitcho'a peng mikhat amun ahi.
en: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
text:
JHN 9:1
Thadou: Chuin Yeshua chu avahlen ahileh, apen'a mitcho'a peng mikhat amun ahi.
English: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

tcz: Hichun aseijuiten ajah'a, “Houhil, hichepa hi ipi jeh'a apen'a mitcho'a peng ham? Ama chonse ham? Oleh anu leh apa chonse a ham?” atiuve.
en: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
text:
JHN 9:2
Thadou: Hichun aseijuiten ajah'a, “Houhil, hichepa hi ipi jeh'a apen'a mitcho'a peng ham? Ama chonse ham? Oleh anu leh apa chonse a ham?” atiuve.
English: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Hiche hi ama chonset jeh jong ahipon, chuleh anuleh apa chonset jeh jong ahipoi; hiche a hi Pathen thahatna ama chunga akiphon na dinga ahibouve.
en: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.
text:
JHN 9:3
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Hiche hi ama chonset jeh jong ahipon, chuleh anuleh apa chonset jeh jong ahipoi; hiche a hi Pathen thahatna ama chunga akiphon na dinga ahibouve.
English: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

tcz: Hijeh chun eihon kinloi tah'a eisol pauvin einganse nau hi itoh dingu ahitai.
en: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
text:
JHN 9:4
Thadou: Hijeh chun eihon kinloi tah'a eisol pauvin einganse nau hi itoh dingu ahitai.
English: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

tcz: Ahivangin keima hiche vannoiya kaum laisea hi vannoi vah kahi,” ati.
en: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
text:
JHN 9:5
Thadou: Ahivangin keima hiche vannoiya kaum laisea hi vannoi vah kahi,” ati.
English: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

tcz: Chuin aman tol'ah achil aset in, achil a chun bonlhoh asemin chuleh hiche bonlhoh chu mitchopa mit'a aloiyin ahi.
en: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,
text:
JHN 9:6
Thadou: Chuin aman tol'ah achil aset in, achil a chun bonlhoh asemin chuleh hiche bonlhoh chu mitchopa mit'a aloiyin ahi.
English: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,

tcz: Hichun aman ajah'a, “Chen Siloam (sol tina ahi) twikul'a nangma tah in gaki phetlhah in,” ati. Hijeh chun mipa chu achen agakiphet lhahtai, chuleh kho amun ahung kiletan ahi.
en: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.
text:
JHN 9:7
Thadou: Hichun aman ajah'a, “Chen Siloam (sol tina ahi) twikul'a nangma tah in gaki phetlhah in,” ati. Hijeh chun mipa chu achen agakiphet lhahtai, chuleh kho amun ahung kiletan ahi.
English: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

tcz: Chuin aheng akom achenkhompi ho chuleh masanga amapa khutdo ji musa ho chu akidong touvin, “Toumun'a khutdo jipa chu hichepa hi hilou ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”
text:
JHN 9:8
Thadou: Chuin aheng akom achenkhompi ho chuleh masanga amapa khutdo ji musa ho chu akidong touvin, “Toumun'a khutdo jipa chu hichepa hi hilou ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

tcz: Mi phabep chun “Amapa chu ahi” atiuvin, chuleh adang phabep chun, “Amapa chu ahipoi akilopi joh ahibouve,” atiuvin ahi; hichun amapa chun, “Henge ama chu kahinai,” ati jengtan ahi.
en: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”
text:
JHN 9:9
Thadou: Mi phabep chun “Amapa chu ahi” atiuvin, chuleh adang phabep chun, “Amapa chu ahipoi akilopi joh ahibouve,” atiuvin ahi; hichun amapa chun, “Henge ama chu kahinai,” ati jengtan ahi.
English: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

tcz: Chuin amahon adong'un, “koiham kho namu sah? ipi iti dan ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”
text:
JHN 9:10
Thadou: Chuin amahon adong'un, “koiham kho namu sah? ipi iti dan ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”

tcz: Hichun amapan ajah'uva, “Yeshua atipau chun bonlhon asem in, hichu kamit'a eiloi peh in chuin kajah'a ‘chen Siloam twikul'a nangma tah'in gaki phetlhah tan eiti,’ hijeh chun keima kachen kaga phetlhah leh kho kahin mu ahitai,” ati.
en: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”
text:
JHN 9:11
Thadou: Hichun amapan ajah'uva, “Yeshua atipau chun bonlhon asem in, hichu kamit'a eiloi peh in chuin kajah'a ‘chen Siloam twikul'a nangma tah'in gaki phetlhah tan eiti,’ hijeh chun keima kachen kaga phetlhah leh kho kahin mu ahitai,” ati.
English: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

tcz: Chuin amahon adongun, “Amapa chu tua hoiya um tam?” atiuvin ahi, aman adonbut in, “Kahepoi,” ati.
en: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”
text:
JHN 9:12
Thadou: Chuin amahon adongun, “Amapa chu tua hoiya um tam?” atiuvin ahi, aman adonbut in, “Kahepoi,” ati.
English: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

tcz: Chuin amahon masanga mitchopa chu Pharisee ho henga ahinpui tauvin ahi.
en: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.
text:
JHN 9:13
Thadou: Chuin amahon masanga mitchopa chu Pharisee ho henga ahinpui tauvin ahi.
English: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

tcz: Ajeh chu Yeshuan bonlhoh asem'a amapa asuhdam nikho chu Cholngah ni ahi.
en: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
text:
JHN 9:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu Yeshuan bonlhoh asem'a amapa asuhdam nikho chu Cholngah ni ahi.
English: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

tcz: Chuin Pharisee hon amapa chu amit khomu dol abonchan adongun ahi, hijeh chun aman ajah'uva, “Aman bonlhoh chu kamit'a aloiyin, chuin keiman kaga phetlhah leh kho kamu jeng ahitai,” ati.
en: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”
text:
JHN 9:15
Thadou: Chuin Pharisee hon amapa chu amit khomu dol abonchan adongun ahi, hijeh chun aman ajah'uva, “Aman bonlhoh chu kamit'a aloiyin, chuin keiman kaga phetlhah leh kho kamu jeng ahitai,” ati.
English: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

tcz: Chuin Pharisee ho phabep chun, “Hiche mipa Yeshua hi Pathen a kon ahipoi, ajeh chu aman Cholngah nikho apalkeh e atiuvin ahi.” Ahivangin adang phabep chun, “Iti michonse khat in hitobang melchihna kidang hohi abolthei ding ham?” atiuvin, amaho lah'a chun kibung khenna lentah a umdohtan ahi.
en: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.
text:
JHN 9:16
Thadou: Chuin Pharisee ho phabep chun, “Hiche mipa Yeshua hi Pathen a kon ahipoi, ajeh chu aman Cholngah nikho apalkeh e atiuvin ahi.” Ahivangin adang phabep chun, “Iti michonse khat in hitobang melchihna kidang hohi abolthei ding ham?” atiuvin, amaho lah'a chun kibung khenna lentah a umdohtan ahi.
English: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

tcz: Chuin Pharisee hon, mitcho kho mupa chu adong kit'un, “Namit kho namu sahpa chu nangman koi ahi natim?” atiuvin, aman adonbut'in, “Themgao khat hiteiyinte,” ati.
en: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”
text:
JHN 9:17
Thadou: Chuin Pharisee hon, mitcho kho mupa chu adong kit'un, “Namit kho namu sahpa chu nangman koi ahi natim?” atiuvin, aman adonbut'in, “Themgao khat hiteiyinte,” ati.
English: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

tcz: Hiche jeng jong chun, Judah vaipo hon hiche mipa chu, mitcho anahia tua kho amu ahitai, tichu atahsan pouve, hijeh chun amahon anu leh apa akimu piuvin ahi.
en: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,
text:
JHN 9:18
Thadou: Hiche jeng jong chun, Judah vaipo hon hiche mipa chu, mitcho anahia tua kho amu ahitai, tichu atahsan pouve, hijeh chun amahon anu leh apa akimu piuvin ahi.
English: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

tcz: Chuleh amahon anu leh apa chu adong'un, “Hichepa hi apen'a mitcho'a peng'a hinam? Ahileh tua iti kho amuthei ham?” atiuve.
en: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”
text:
JHN 9:19
Thadou: Chuleh amahon anu leh apa chu adong'un, “Hichepa hi apen'a mitcho'a peng'a hinam? Ahileh tua iti kho amuthei ham?” atiuve.
English: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”
