tcz: Hichun anu leh apan adonbut'in, “Ama hi apen'a mitcho'a peng kachapa lhon ahi, kahe lhon e,” ati.
en: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

tcz: “Ahivangin aman iti kho amu ham, koiyin amit adamsah ham, kahe lhonpoi; ama dong'un, amatah achungthu kiseitheiya upa ahitai,” atilhon e.
en: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”
text:
JHN 9:21
Thadou: “Ahivangin aman iti kho amu ham, koiyin amit adamsah ham, kahe lhonpoi; ama dong'un, amatah achungthu kiseitheiya upa ahitai,” atilhon e.
English: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”

tcz: Hichu anuleh apan Judah vaipo ho kichat na jeh'a achuti seilhon ahi, ajeh chu amahon, “Koi hileh Yeshua chu Messiah ahi tia sei aum leh kikhop na in'a kon'a nomang ding tia ana phon dohsau ahitai.”
en: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
text:
JHN 9:22
Thadou: Hichu anuleh apan Judah vaipo ho kichat na jeh'a achuti seilhon ahi, ajeh chu amahon, “Koi hileh Yeshua chu Messiah ahi tia sei aum leh kikhop na in'a kon'a nomang ding tia ana phon dohsau ahitai.”
English: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

tcz: Hiche jeh'a chu amanin ajah'uva, “Ama kidoh un amatah chu athu kiseithei ja len ahitai,” atilhon ahi.
en: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”
text:
JHN 9:23
Thadou: Hiche jeh'a chu amanin ajah'uva, “Ama kidoh un amatah chu athu kiseithei ja len ahitai,” atilhon ahi.
English: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”

tcz: Chuin amahon anivei nan mitcho khomupa chu akouvun, ajah'a, “Hiche thua hi Pathen bou loupi sah in, ajeh chu Yeshua kitipa chu michonse ahi, keihon kaheuve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”
text:
JHN 9:24
Thadou: Chuin amahon anivei nan mitcho khomupa chu akouvun, ajah'a, “Hiche thua hi Pathen bou loupi sah in, ajeh chu Yeshua kitipa chu michonse ahi, keihon kaheuve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

tcz: Hichun aman adonbut'in, “Ama michonse ahi ahilou kahepoi, ahivangin kahet chu hiche ahi, ‘keima mitcho kana hin tunvang kho kamutai,’” ati.
en: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
text:
JHN 9:25
Thadou: Hichun aman adonbut'in, “Ama michonse ahi ahilou kahepoi, ahivangin kahet chu hiche ahi, ‘keima mitcho kana hin tunvang kho kamutai,’” ati.
English: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

tcz: Chuin amahon adongkit tei teiyun, “Ama chun ipi abol'a iti namit chu asuhdam ham?” atiuve.
en: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
text:
JHN 9:26
Thadou: Chuin amahon adongkit tei teiyun, “Ama chun ipi abol'a iti namit chu asuhdam ham?” atiuve.
English: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

tcz: Aman ajah'uva, “Veuvin khatvei kaseisa ahitai, nanghon nangai pouve, ibol'a avel'a najah nom kit'u ham? Nangho jong ama seijui nahi nom'u ham?” ati.
en: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”
text:
JHN 9:27
Thadou: Aman ajah'uva, “Veuvin khatvei kaseisa ahitai, nanghon nangai pouve, ibol'a avel'a najah nom kit'u ham? Nangho jong ama seijui nahi nom'u ham?” ati.
English: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

tcz: Chuin amahon mipa chu agaosap'un, ajah'a, “Nangbou ama seijui nahin, keiho vang Mose seijui kahiuve.
en: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
text:
JHN 9:28
Thadou: Chuin amahon mipa chu agaosap'un, ajah'a, “Nangbou ama seijui nahin, keiho vang Mose seijui kahiuve.
English: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

tcz: Pathen in Mose heng'a thu asei chu kaheuve, ahinlah hichepa hi hoiya hungkon koi ahi kahepouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”
text:
JHN 9:29
Thadou: Pathen in Mose heng'a thu asei chu kaheuve, ahinlah hichepa hi hoiya hungkon koi ahi kahepouve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

tcz: Chuin amapan adonbut'in, “Hichu datmo umtah ahi, aman kamit kho musahta'a ahivanga nanghon ama hungkon na nahetlou'u chu;
en: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

tcz: Pathen in michonse ho thu angaipoi, ahivangin ama guttah a houva alunglam bolho thubou angaiye, ti iheuve.
en: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.
text:
JHN 9:31
Thadou: Pathen in michonse ho thu angaipoi, ahivangin ama guttah a houva alunglam bolho thubou angaiye, ti iheuve.
English: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.

tcz: Chuleh vannoi leiset umtil apat koiham khat'in, apen'a mitcho'a peng kho amusah lam akija khapoi.
en: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.
text:
JHN 9:32
Thadou: Chuleh vannoi leiset umtil apat koiham khat'in, apen'a mitcho'a peng kho amusah lam akija khapoi.
English: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

tcz: Hichepa hi Pathen'a kon ahilou leh aman hitobang hi abolthei lou hel ding ahi,” ati.
en: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”
text:
JHN 9:33
Thadou: Hichepa hi Pathen'a kon ahilou leh aman hitobang hi abolthei lou hel ding ahi,” ati.
English: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

tcz: Hichun amahon adonbut'un, “Nang napum'a chonse sa-a peng'a nangin keiho neihil got'u ham?” atiuvin, kikhopna in'a kon chun anodoh tauvin ahi.
en: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.
text:
JHN 9:34
Thadou: Hichun amahon adonbut'un, “Nang napum'a chonse sa-a peng'a nangin keiho neihil got'u ham?” atiuvin, kikhopna in'a kon chun anodoh tauvin ahi.
English: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.

tcz: Yeshuan thilsoh umchan chu ajan, chuin mipa chu amun, ajah'a, “Nangman Mihem Chapa chu natahsan em?” ati.
en: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
text:
JHN 9:35
Thadou: Yeshuan thilsoh umchan chu ajan, chuin mipa chu amun, ajah'a, “Nangman Mihem Chapa chu natahsan em?” ati.
English: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”

tcz: Amapan adonbut'in, “Pu, ama chu koi ham? Keiman katahsan ding nati chu,” ati.
en: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”
text:
JHN 9:36
Thadou: Amapan adonbut'in, “Pu, ama chu koi ham? Keiman katahsan ding nati chu,” ati.
English: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut'in ajah'a, “Nangman ama chu namutai, chuleh nahenga thuseiya hi ama chu ahi,” ati.
en: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”
text:
JHN 9:37
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut'in ajah'a, “Nangman ama chu namutai, chuleh nahenga thuseiya hi ama chu ahi,” ati.
English: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”

tcz: Hiche pettah chun mipa chun, ajah'a, “Henge Pakai katahsan e,” atin, Yeshua chu chibai abohtai.
en: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.
text:
JHN 9:38
Thadou: Hiche pettah chun mipa chun, ajah'a, “Henge Pakai katahsan e,” atin, Yeshua chu chibai abohtai.
English: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan amapa jah'a, “Keima mitcho hon kho amu'uva chuleh khomu'a kigel ahivanga la mitcho, hon akigel doh thei nading'uva thutan dinga vannoiya hung kahi,” ati.
en: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”
text:
JHN 9:39
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan amapa jah'a, “Keima mitcho hon kho amu'uva chuleh khomu'a kigel ahivanga la mitcho, hon akigel doh thei nading'uva thutan dinga vannoiya hung kahi,” ati.
English: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”

tcz: Hichun avel'a um Pharisee hon ajah'a, “Keiho hi mitcho neihi sah'u ham?” atiuve.
en: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”
text:
JHN 9:40
Thadou: Hichun avel'a um Pharisee hon ajah'a, “Keiho hi mitcho neihi sah'u ham?” atiuve.
English: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Mitcho hileu chun chonset na naneilou dingu ahin, tunvang nanghon kho kamui nati jeh'un, nachung'uva chonset um ahitai,” ati.
en: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
text:
JHN 9:41
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Mitcho hileu chun chonset na naneilou dingu ahin, tunvang nanghon kho kamui nati jeh'un, nachung'uva chonset um ahitai,” ati.
English: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.

tcz: Keiman nangho atahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh kelngoi hongkot'a lut louva bang'a kal'a hunglut chu gucha michom ahi.
en: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.
text:
JHN 10:1
Thadou: Keiman nangho atahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hileh kelngoi hongkot'a lut louva bang'a kal'a hunglut chu gucha michom ahi.
English: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

tcz: Ahivangin kelngoi hongkot'a hunglut ama vang chu kelngoi chingpa ahi.
en: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
text:
JHN 10:2
Thadou: Ahivangin kelngoi hongkot'a hunglut ama vang chu kelngoi chingpa ahi.
English: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

tcz: Ama chu kot ngahpan kot ahonpeh jin, chuleh kelngoi hon ama aw aheuvin, aheng'a ahungjiuve, chule aman akelngoite chu amin cheh in akouvin, apuidoh jin ahi.
en: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
text:
JHN 10:3
Thadou: Ama chu kot ngahpan kot ahonpeh jin, chuleh kelngoi hon ama aw aheuvin, aheng'a ahungjiuve, chule aman akelngoite chu amin cheh in akouvin, apuidoh jin ahi.
English: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

tcz: Chule aman akelngoi ho ahoidoh soh tengleh, amaho chu alamkaiyin, chuleh akelngoi hon anung ajuijiuve, ajeh chu amahon amapa Aw chu aheuve.
en: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
text:
JHN 10:4
Thadou: Chule aman akelngoi ho ahoidoh soh tengleh, amaho chu alamkaiyin, chuleh akelngoi hon anung ajuijiuve, ajeh chu amahon amapa Aw chu aheuve.
English: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

tcz: Chuleh kelngoi hon hetphahlou midang nungjui louhel ding ahiuve, ama-a kon'a jam mang ding ahiuve ajeh chu amahon michom dang aw ahepouve.
en: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”
text:
JHN 10:5
Thadou: Chuleh kelngoi hon hetphahlou midang nungjui louhel ding ahiuve, ama-a kon'a jam mang ding ahiuve ajeh chu amahon michom dang aw ahepouve.
English: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

tcz: Yeshuan hiche thulem asei jaho chun, aman ipi aseina ahi ahepouve.
en: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.
text:
JHN 10:6
Thadou: Yeshuan hiche thulem asei jaho chun, aman ipi aseina ahi ahepouve.
English: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

tcz: Hijeh chun Yeshuan ajah'uva, asei chen in, “Keiman nangho atahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, keima hi kelngoi hongkot chu kahi.
en: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.
text:
JHN 10:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun Yeshuan ajah'uva, asei chen in, “Keiman nangho atahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve, keima hi kelngoi hongkot chu kahi.
English: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

tcz: Kamasanga hung masa ho jouse abon'uva gucha leh michom ahiuve, ahinlah ama ho thu chu kelngoihon angaipeh pouve.
en: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.
text:
JHN 10:8
Thadou: Kamasanga hung masa ho jouse abon'uva gucha leh michom ahiuve, ahinlah ama ho thu chu kelngoihon angaipeh pouve.
English: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.

tcz: Henge, keima kelngoi hongkot dihtah chu kahi, koi hileh keiya hunglut'a chu huhhing'a umding ahi; amaho chu nom tah'a lutle potle dingu, chuleh hamhing hoitah akimu dingu ahi.
en: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.
text:
JHN 10:9
Thadou: Henge, keima kelngoi hongkot dihtah chu kahi, koi hileh keiya hunglut'a chu huhhing'a umding ahi; amaho chu nom tah'a lutle potle dingu, chuleh hamhing hoitah akimu dingu ahi.
English: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

tcz: Guchapa hunglo na chu agu mang ding leh asumang ding bou ahi, keima vang amahon ninglhin na leh lunglhai na hinkho aneina dinguva hunga kahi.
en: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
text:
JHN 10:10
Thadou: Guchapa hunglo na chu agu mang ding leh asumang ding bou ahi, keima vang amahon ninglhin na leh lunglhai na hinkho aneina dinguva hunga kahi.
English: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

tcz: Keima kelngoi chingpha kahi, kelngoi chingpha chun akelngoite dingin ahinna apejin ahi.
en: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
text:
JHN 10:11
Thadou: Keima kelngoi chingpha kahi, kelngoi chingpha chun akelngoite dingin ahinna apejin ahi.
English: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

tcz: Ahin thalah kelngoi chingpa vang chun, ngei hung amuteng ama ajamjin chuleh akelngoite adalha jitai; ajeh chu ama kelngoi chingtah ahipon, kelngoite jong ama-a ahipoi, chutengleh ngei chun kelngoite chu adelkhum in aman in chuleh asu cheh jitan ahi.
en: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.
text:
JHN 10:12
Thadou: Ahin thalah kelngoi chingpa vang chun, ngei hung amuteng ama ajamjin chuleh akelngoite adalha jitai; ajeh chu ama kelngoi chingtah ahipon, kelngoite jong ama-a ahipoi, chutengleh ngei chun kelngoite chu adelkhum in aman in chuleh asu cheh jitan ahi.
English: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh ama thalah kelngoi ching, sum muna ding bouva natong ahijeh chun, aman kelngoite ngailut na aneipoi.
en: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.
text:
JHN 10:13
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh ama thalah kelngoi ching, sum muna ding bouva natong ahijeh chun, aman kelngoite ngailut na aneipoi.
English: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.

tcz: Keima kelngoi chingpha kahi, keiman ka kelngoite kahen, chuleh amahon keima eiheuve.
en: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

tcz: Kapan keima eihet tobang bangin keiman Pachu kahei; hijeh chun, keiman ka kelngoite dingin ka hinna kapei.
en: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
text:
JHN 10:15
Thadou: Kapan keima eihet tobang bangin keiman Pachu kahei; hijeh chun, keiman ka kelngoite dingin ka hinna kapei.
English: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

tcz: Chuleh keiman hiche hong sunga umlou kelngoi dang jong kaneiye, chule keiman amaho jong chu kaga puilut ding chuleh amahon ka-aw ahet dingu chuteng kelngoi ho chu honkhat hiuva achingpa jong khatseh hiding ahi.
en: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.
text:
JHN 10:16
Thadou: Chuleh keiman hiche hong sunga umlou kelngoi dang jong kaneiye, chule keiman amaho jong chu kaga puilut ding chuleh amahon ka-aw ahet dingu chuteng kelngoi ho chu honkhat hiuva achingpa jong khatseh hiding ahi.
English: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

tcz: Pan keima eingailui, ajeh chu keiman kahinna chu avel'a kilelah kit ding'a kakatdoh tah jeh chun;
en: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

tcz: Khattouvin, keiya kon'a kahinna chu eilah peh thei ahipoi, keiman kacham'a kakat doh ahibouve, ajeh chu keiman katdoh nale avel'a kile lah kit theina chu kanei ahi. Hichu kapan keima eithupeh ahi,” ati.
en: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”
text:
JHN 10:18
Thadou: Khattouvin, keiya kon'a kahinna chu eilah peh thei ahipoi, keiman kacham'a kakat doh ahibouve, ajeh chu keiman katdoh nale avel'a kile lah kit theina chu kanei ahi. Hichu kapan keima eithupeh ahi,” ati.
English: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

tcz: Aman thu hicheng asei jeh chun, Judah ho chu abung bungin akikhen kit tauve.
en: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.
text:
JHN 10:19
Thadou: Aman thu hicheng asei jeh chun, Judah ho chu abung bungin akikhen kit tauve.
English: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

tcz: Alah'uva phabep chun, “Hichepa hi thilhavop ahin alunggel kisuhlou ahibouve, chule ibol'a ama thusei kingai ding ham?” atiuve.
en: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”
text:
JHN 10:20
Thadou: Alah'uva phabep chun, “Hichepa hi thilhavop ahin alunggel kisuhlou ahibouve, chule ibol'a ama thusei kingai ding ham?” atiuve.
English: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

tcz: Chule adang phabep chun, “Athusei hi thilhavop umdan ahipoi, thilhan mitcho kho amusah ngaiyem?” atiuve. Juda Hon Yeshua Asandau
en: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”
text:
JHN 10:21
Thadou: Chule adang phabep chun, “Athusei hi thilhavop umdan ahipoi, thilhan mitcho kho amusah ngaiyem?” atiuve. Juda Hon Yeshua Asandau
English: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”

tcz: Hichu phalbilai ahin Houin katdohna kut abollaiyu ahin, Yeshua Jerusalem'a aumpet ahi.
en: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.
text:
JHN 10:22
Thadou: Hichu phalbilai ahin Houin katdohna kut abollaiyu ahin, Yeshua Jerusalem'a aumpet ahi.
English: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

tcz: Ama Houin'a aum in, Solomon hongcha kitilaiya chun ama avahlen ahi.
en: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.
text:
JHN 10:23
Thadou: Ama Houin'a aum in, Solomon hongcha kitilaiya chun ama avahlen ahi.
English: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

tcz: Hichun Judah hon ama chu aumkimvel un, “Itihchan keiho lung hesoh'a nei umsah ding'u ham? Nangma Messiah chu nahileh neiseipeh un,” atiuvin ahi.
en: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
text:
JHN 10:24
Thadou: Hichun Judah hon ama chu aumkimvel un, “Itihchan keiho lung hesoh'a nei umsah ding'u ham? Nangma Messiah chu nahileh neiseipeh un,” atiuvin ahi.
English: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut in, ajah'uva, “Keiman nangho kasei pehsa ahitai. Ahivangin nanghon neitahsan pouve, kapa min'a kathilbol chenghi keima thudol hettohsah ahitai.
en: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.
text:
JHN 10:25
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut in, ajah'uva, “Keiman nangho kasei pehsa ahitai. Ahivangin nanghon neitahsan pouve, kapa min'a kathilbol chenghi keima thudol hettohsah ahitai.
English: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

tcz: Ahivangin nangho ka kelngoite nahilou jeh'un, keima neitahsan pouve.
en: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.
text:
JHN 10:26
Thadou: Ahivangin nangho ka kelngoite nahilou jeh'un, keima neitahsan pouve.
English: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

tcz: Keima kelngoi hon ka aw angaiyun, keiman amaho kahen, chuleh amahon kanung eijui'uve.
en: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
text:
JHN 10:27
Thadou: Keima kelngoi hon ka aw angaiyun, keiman amaho kahen, chuleh amahon kanung eijui'uve.
English: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

tcz: Keiman amaho chu tonsot hinna kapen, chuleh amaho chu itih'a jong mangthah lou ding ahiuve. Chuleh koiman keiya kon'a amaho chu eilahpeh lou ding ahi.
en: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
text:
JHN 10:28
Thadou: Keiman amaho chu tonsot hinna kapen, chuleh amaho chu itih'a jong mangthah lou ding ahiuve. Chuleh koiman keiya kon'a amaho chu eilahpeh lou ding ahi.
English: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

tcz: Ajeh chu kapan amaho chu keima eipeh ahitai, chuleh kapa chu ima jouse'a thaneipen leh hat chungnung ahi. Koiman amaho chu kapa khut'a kon'a alahpeh lou ding ahi.”
en: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
text:
JHN 10:29
Thadou: Ajeh chu kapan amaho chu keima eipeh ahitai, chuleh kapa chu ima jouse'a thaneipen leh hat chungnung ahi. Koiman amaho chu kapa khut'a kon'a alahpeh lou ding ahi.”
English: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

tcz: “Chuleh Pa leh keima chu khatseh kahi lhon e,” ati.
en: I and the Father are one.”
text:
JHN 10:30
Thadou: “Chuleh Pa leh keima chu khatseh kahi lhon e,” ati.
English: I and the Father are one.”

tcz: Chuin Judah hon ama selih na ding song akilo tauvin ahi.
en: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
text:
JHN 10:31
Thadou: Chuin Judah hon ama selih na ding song akilo tauvin ahi.
English: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Kapa thusah bangtah a, keiman thilpha tamtah kabol ahitai. Hoiche pentah jeh'a chu nanghon keima song'a neise dingu ham?” ati.
en: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
text:
JHN 10:32
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'uva, “Kapa thusah bangtah a, keiman thilpha tamtah kabol ahitai. Hoiche pentah jeh'a chu nanghon keima song'a neise dingu ham?” ati.
English: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

tcz: Amahon adonbut un, ajah'a, “Keihon nang naphatoh jeh'a songa kase dingu nahipoi. Pathen nataitom jeh ahibouve. Chuleh nangma mihem hiya Pathen naki hisah jeh ahi,” atiuve.
en: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”
text:
JHN 10:33
Thadou: Amahon adonbut un, ajah'a, “Keihon nang naphatoh jeh'a songa kase dingu nahipoi. Pathen nataitom jeh ahibouve. Chuleh nangma mihem hiya Pathen naki hisah jeh ahi,” atiuve.
English: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut'in ajah'uva, “Hiche hi nangho Pathen lekhabua kisun hilou ham? Pathen in mihem ho jah'a anaseisa, nangho hi Pathen ho nahiuve kiti chu, kasei ahi.
en: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?
text:
JHN 10:34
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan adonbut'in ajah'uva, “Hiche hi nangho Pathen lekhabua kisun hilou ham? Pathen in mihem ho jah'a anaseisa, nangho hi Pathen ho nahiuve kiti chu, kasei ahi.
English: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?

tcz: Chuleh nanghon naheuve, Pathen lekhabua kisun chu khel thei ahipoi. Hiche jeh chun, Pathen thu lhunna miho bon Pathen ho tia akikou thei leh;
en: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

tcz: Ibol'a ken keima Pathen chapa kahi tia kasei leh, nanghon Pathen taitom nahi neitiu ham? Pan hiche dinga chu keima atumbeh'a eikhen doh'a eisuhtheng'a vannoiya eihinsol ahi.
en: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?
text:
JHN 10:36
Thadou: Ibol'a ken keima Pathen chapa kahi tia kasei leh, nanghon Pathen taitom nahi neitiu ham? Pan hiche dinga chu keima atumbeh'a eikhen doh'a eisuhtheng'a vannoiya eihinsol ahi.
English: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

tcz: Eisol'a kapa natoh ho kabol louleh neitahsan dauvin.
en: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
text:
JHN 10:37
Thadou: Eisol'a kapa natoh ho kabol louleh neitahsan dauvin.
English: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

tcz: Ahin, ama kin katoh ahivang leh, keima neitahsan theilou jongleh, melchihna kidang kabol hohi hettohsah nan neiyun lang, tahsan un. Chutileh nanghon Pa keiya aum'a chuleh keima Pa'a ka um chu hetauvinnate,” ati.
en: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
text:
JHN 10:38
Thadou: Ahin, ama kin katoh ahivang leh, keima neitahsan theilou jongleh, melchihna kidang kabol hohi hettohsah nan neiyun lang, tahsan un. Chutileh nanghon Pa keiya aum'a chuleh keima Pa'a ka um chu hetauvinnate,” ati.
English: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

tcz: Chuin avel'in amahon Yeshua chu matding ago kit'un, ahi. Ahivangin ama hiche mun'a kon chun apotdoh in amaho chu adalhatai.
en: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
text:
JHN 10:39
Thadou: Chuin avel'in amahon Yeshua chu matding ago kit'un, ahi. Ahivangin ama hiche mun'a kon chun apotdoh in amaho chu adalhatai.
English: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

tcz: Chuin ama Jordan lui gallam'a amasa-a John in baptize ana bol na lam'a chun achen aga umtai.
en: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.
text:
JHN 10:40
Thadou: Chuin ama Jordan lui gallam'a amasa-a John in baptize ana bol na lam'a chun achen aga umtai.
English: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

tcz: Chua chun, mi tamtah'in anung ajuiyun, amaho chu akihouvun, “John in melchihna kidang ho anabolpon, ahivangin Yeshua thudol aseiho abonchan atah in alhungsoh keiye,” atiuvin ahi.
en: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”
text:
JHN 10:41
Thadou: Chua chun, mi tamtah'in anung ajuiyun, amaho chu akihouvun, “John in melchihna kidang ho anabolpon, ahivangin Yeshua thudol aseiho abonchan atah in alhungsoh keiye,” atiuvin ahi.
English: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

tcz: Chuin chukom'a um mi tamtah ho chun Yeshua atahsan tauve.
en: Many believed in him there.
text:
JHN 10:42
Thadou: Chuin chukom'a um mi tamtah ho chun Yeshua atahsan tauve.
English: Many believed in him there.

tcz: Pasal khat amin Lazarus kitipa chu Bethany a cheng ahin, dammo na nei, chule asopiteni Mary leh Martha toh cheng khom ahi.
en: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.
text:
JHN 11:1
Thadou: Pasal khat amin Lazarus kitipa chu Bethany a cheng ahin, dammo na nei, chule asopiteni Mary leh Martha toh cheng khom ahi.
English: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

tcz: Hiche numeinu Mary hi ahi, Pakai kengbul'a thao nu'a asama theh ngima chu;
en: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.

tcz: Chule amanin a-ucha lhon in Pakai Yeshua heng'a thu athot lhon'in hitin asei lhon e, “Pakai nangailut nasopi naloipa hi adammo lhehtai,” atilhon in ahi.
en: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”
text:
JHN 11:3
Thadou: Chule amanin a-ucha lhon in Pakai Yeshua heng'a thu athot lhon'in hitin asei lhon e, “Pakai nangailut nasopi naloipa hi adammo lhehtai,” atilhon in ahi.
English: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”

tcz: Hichu Pakai Yeshuan ajah chun hitin aseiyin, “Lazarus dammo nahi thina a kichai ding ahipoi, Pathen loupina dinga kibol'a ahibouve ati, hiche jeh a chu Pathen Chapa loupi na hungsoh doh dinga kitah lang joh ahi,” ati.
en: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”
text:
JHN 11:4
Thadou: Hichu Pakai Yeshuan ajah chun hitin aseiyin, “Lazarus dammo nahi thina a kichai ding ahipoi, Pathen loupina dinga kibol'a ahibouve ati, hiche jeh a chu Pathen Chapa loupi na hungsoh doh dinga kitah lang joh ahi,” ati.
English: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”

tcz: Pakai Yeshuan, Mary, Martha leh asopipa Lazarus alungset lheh jeng vang chun;
en: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

tcz: Hikom'a aum na mun'a chun Pakai Yeshua chu nini tobang aumbe nalaiyin ahi.
en: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.
text:
JHN 11:6
Thadou: Hikom'a aum na mun'a chun Pakai Yeshua chu nini tobang aumbe nalaiyin ahi.
English: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

tcz: Hichun aphat ahung lhin phat chun Pakai Yeshuan aseijui ho koma aseijin, “Eiho Judea gam langa kinungle kit tauhite ati.”
en: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”
text:
JHN 11:7
Thadou: Hichun aphat ahung lhin phat chun Pakai Yeshuan aseijui ho koma aseijin, “Eiho Judea gam langa kinungle kit tauhite ati.”
English: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”

tcz: Ahin aseijuiten lung opkai na aneiyun, “Rabbi, ni ijat ham khat masanga chu Judea gam'a mihon songa selih ding nagot'u chula em,” atiuve.
en: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”
text:
JHN 11:8
Thadou: Ahin aseijuiten lung opkai na aneiyun, “Rabbi, ni ijat ham khat masanga chu Judea gam'a mihon songa selih ding nagot'u chula em,” atiuve.
English: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Nikhat sunga hi nidan som le ni niseh a um ahi, chule sun a hi mi jousen lam ajotthei cheh ding ahi. Chuleh amahon kho amuthei nau chu ahileh vannoi vah anei jeh'u ahi.
en: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
text:
JHN 11:9
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Nikhat sunga hi nidan som le ni niseh a um ahi, chule sun a hi mi jousen lam ajotthei cheh ding ahi. Chuleh amahon kho amuthei nau chu ahileh vannoi vah anei jeh'u ahi.
English: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

tcz: Ahin, jantengleh tijat natah jong aumin, kipal lhuh na thei jong aumin ahi, ajeh chu vah aumji tapon ahi,” ati.
en: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”
text:
JHN 11:10
Thadou: Ahin, jantengleh tijat natah jong aumin, kipal lhuh na thei jong aumin ahi, ajeh chu vah aumji tapon ahi,” ati.
English: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”

tcz: Hichun aman aseiyin, “Iloipau Lazarus a-imu lhatai” ati, “Amavang keima kache ding kaga thodoh ding ahi,” ati.
en: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”
text:
JHN 11:11
Thadou: Hichun aman aseiyin, “Iloipau Lazarus a-imu lhatai” ati, “Amavang keima kache ding kaga thodoh ding ahi,” ati.
English: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”

tcz: Hichun seijuiten adonbut uvin, “Pakai, Lazarus chu a'imut leh damvah ding tina ahitai,” atiuve.
en: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”
text:
JHN 11:12
Thadou: Hichun seijuiten adonbut uvin, “Pakai, Lazarus chu a'imut leh damvah ding tina ahitai,” atiuve.
English: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”

tcz: Ahin seijui ho geldan'a chu kicholdo dinga a'imut aseiyin angaitouvin, ahin Pakaiyin asei chu Lazarus thi ahitai atina ahi.
en: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.
text:
JHN 11:13
Thadou: Ahin seijui ho geldan'a chu kicholdo dinga a'imut aseiyin angaitouvin, ahin Pakaiyin asei chu Lazarus thi ahitai atina ahi.
English: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin aseichet pehin, “Lazarus chu athitai.”
en: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.
text:
JHN 11:14
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin aseichet pehin, “Lazarus chu athitai.”
English: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.

tcz: “Chuleh keima kakipah lheh e, ajeh chu nang hon natahsan theina dingu ahi, hijongle tun hungun ahenga cheu hite,” ati.
en: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”
text:
JHN 11:15
Thadou: “Chuleh keima kakipah lheh e, ajeh chu nang hon natahsan theina dingu ahi, hijongle tun hungun ahenga cheu hite,” ati.
English: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”

tcz: Hichun Thomas minlhem ni neipa chun aloi aseijui ho lah'a aseitan, “Eiho jong cheu hitin, chu a Pakai toh gathi khom'u hite,” ati.
en: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”
text:
JHN 11:16
Thadou: Hichun Thomas minlhem ni neipa chun aloi aseijui ho lah'a aseitan, “Eiho jong cheu hitin, chu a Pakai toh gathi khom'u hite,” ati.
English: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”

tcz: Yeshua Bethany kho'a ahung lhun chun Lazarus chu lhan khuh'a avui nau ni li ahitai ti aseipeh uve.
en: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.
text:
JHN 11:17
Thadou: Yeshua Bethany kho'a ahung lhun chun Lazarus chu lhan khuh'a avui nau ni li ahitai ti aseipeh uve.
English: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

tcz: Bethany chu Jerusalem kom ahin, mile themkhat bouva gamla ahi;
en: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

tcz: Chuleh Judah le midang tamtah achekhom'un, Mary leh Martha amani lungmon sah dinga hung'ah anaum'un ahi.
en: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
text:
JHN 11:19
Thadou: Chuleh Judah le midang tamtah achekhom'un, Mary leh Martha amani lungmon sah dinga hung'ah anaum'un ahi.
English: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

tcz: Hiti chun Martha in Pakai ahungtai tithu ajah phat'in amanu chu achen Pakai chu aga kimupin Mary vangchu inmun'ah aum dentai.
en: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.
text:
JHN 11:20
Thadou: Hiti chun Martha in Pakai ahungtai tithu ajah phat'in amanu chu achen Pakai chu aga kimupin Mary vangchu inmun'ah aum dentai.
English: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

tcz: Hichun Martha in Yeshua koma aseitai, “Pakai nangma hilai mun'a hi ana um hile chun kasopi pa hi thilou ding ahi” ati.
en: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.
text:
JHN 11:21
Thadou: Hichun Martha in Yeshua koma aseitai, “Pakai nangma hilai mun'a hi ana um hile chun kasopi pa hi thilou ding ahi” ati.
English: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.

tcz: Ahin tunjong Pathen in nathum chan napeh ding kahe nai ati.
en: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”
text:
JHN 11:22
Thadou: Ahin tunjong Pathen in nathum chan napeh ding kahe nai ati.
English: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”

tcz: Yeshuan amanu jah'a, “Nasopi pa thou kit ding ahi,” ati.
en: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
text:
JHN 11:23
Thadou: Yeshuan amanu jah'a, “Nasopi pa thou kit ding ahi,” ati.
English: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

tcz: Marthan adonbut'in, “Henge kanom'e, Ni nunung nia thokit nia atho doh kit ding chu kahe nai,” ati.
en: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
text:
JHN 11:24
Thadou: Marthan adonbut'in, “Henge kanom'e, Ni nunung nia thokit nia atho doh kit ding chu kahe nai,” ati.
English: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan amanu jah'a hitin aseiye, “Keima hi thokitna le hinna chu kahi; chule koi hijongleh keima eitahsan chan chu thita jongleh thoudoh kit ding ahi.
en: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
text:
JHN 11:25
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan amanu jah'a hitin aseiye, “Keima hi thokitna le hinna chu kahi; chule koi hijongleh keima eitahsan chan chu thita jongleh thoudoh kit ding ahi.
English: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

tcz: Chuleh koi hijong leh ahinga keima eitahsan a chu itih hijongle thilou ding ahi. Martha hiche hi na tahsan em?” ati.
en: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
text:
JHN 11:26
Thadou: Chuleh koi hijong leh ahinga keima eitahsan a chu itih hijongle thilou ding ahi. Martha hiche hi na tahsan em?” ati.
English: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

tcz: Marthan adonbut'in, “Henge, Pakai Pathen katahsan'e, nangma hi Pathen Chapa Messiah vannoiya hung dinga chu nahi,” ati.
en: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”
text:
JHN 11:27
Thadou: Marthan adonbut'in, “Henge, Pakai Pathen katahsan'e, nangma hi Pathen Chapa Messiah vannoiya hung dinga chu nahi,” ati.
English: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”

tcz: Hiche chu asei jouvin achemang in asopinu Mary guhthimin akouvin, “Houhil chu hikoma aumin, nakouve,” ati.
en: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
text:
JHN 11:28
Thadou: Hiche chu asei jouvin achemang in asopinu Mary guhthimin akouvin, “Houhil chu hikoma aumin, nakouve,” ati.
English: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”

tcz: Chuin Mary in hichu ajah jah in gangtah in akipat doh in ahenga achetai.
en: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.
text:
JHN 11:29
Thadou: Chuin Mary in hichu ajah jah in gangtah in akipat doh in ahenga achetai.
English: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.

tcz: Pakai Yeshua chu khopam'a Martha toh akimu to nalhon a chu umnalai ahin;
en: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

tcz: Hichun mipi ho Mary lha mon dinga umhon ama akipat doh'a kino thethu'a adalhah chu amu'u chun Lazarus lhan khuh langa gakap dingin agel'un, hichun amahon Mary nung chu ajuiyun ahi.
en: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”
text:
JHN 11:31
Thadou: Hichun mipi ho Mary lha mon dinga umhon ama akipat doh'a kino thethu'a adalhah chu amu'u chun Lazarus lhan khuh langa gakap dingin agel'un, hichun amahon Mary nung chu ajuiyun ahi.
English: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”

tcz: Hiti chun Mary chu Yeshua umna alhun phat'in ama chu amun akengphang bul'ah abohkhup jengin ajah'a, “Pakai nangma hikoma um hile chun kasopipa thi lou dinga,” ati.
en: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
text:
JHN 11:32
Thadou: Hiti chun Mary chu Yeshua umna alhun phat'in ama chu amun akengphang bul'ah abohkhup jengin ajah'a, “Pakai nangma hikoma um hile chun kasopipa thi lou dinga,” ati.
English: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan amanu aka amun ahin lhonpi mipi ho jong chu akau amun alung sunga lunghem tah le pohnat na neitah in a um uvin ahi.
en: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,
text:
JHN 11:33
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan amanu aka amun ahin lhonpi mipi ho jong chu akau amun alung sunga lunghem tah le pohnat na neitah in a um uvin ahi.
English: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ama ho chu adongin, “Hoiya nakoiyu hitam,” ati, mipi hon adonbut'un, “Pakai hungven,” atiuvin ahi.
en: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”
text:
JHN 11:34
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan ama ho chu adongin, “Hoiya nakoiyu hitam,” ati, mipi hon adonbut'un, “Pakai hungven,” atiuvin ahi.
English: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshua akaptai.
en: Jesus wept.
text:
JHN 11:35
Thadou: Hichun Yeshua akaptai.
English: Jesus wept.

tcz: Hikom mun vel'a dingho chun aseiyun, “Veuvin iti angailut hitam,” atiuve.
en: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”
text:
JHN 11:36
Thadou: Hikom mun vel'a dingho chun aseiyun, “Veuvin iti angailut hitam,” atiuve.
English: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

tcz: Ahin koitobang loichun hitin aseiyun, “Hiche pa hin mitcho ho kho amu sah hilou ham, chule Lazarus jong chu athida sah thei chula em,” atiuvin ahi.
en: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
text:
JHN 11:37
Thadou: Ahin koitobang loichun hitin aseiyun, “Hiche pa hin mitcho ho kho amu sah hilou ham, chule Lazarus jong chu athida sah thei chula em,” atiuvin ahi.
English: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

tcz: Hichun Yeshua chun lhan khuh ahin phah chun lunghem tah in aum in; chuleh alhan chu kohom khat ahin, akot chu song khat'a kising ahi.
en: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
text:
JHN 11:38
Thadou: Hichun Yeshua chun lhan khuh ahin phah chun lunghem tah in aum in; chuleh alhan chu kohom khat ahin, akot chu song khat'a kising ahi.
English: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

tcz: Yeshuan amaho jah'a aseiyin, “Song chu tangdoh'un,” ati. Chule athipa sopinu Martha chun ajah'a, “Pakai tun a uitai, ijeh inem itile ni li ahitai,” ati.
en: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”
text:
JHN 11:39
Thadou: Yeshuan amaho jah'a aseiyin, “Song chu tangdoh'un,” ati. Chule athipa sopinu Martha chun ajah'a, “Pakai tun a uitai, ijeh inem itile ni li ahitai,” ati.
English: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Natahsan'u leh Pathen loupi na namu dingu ahi kati hilou ham?” ati.
en: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”
text:
JHN 11:40
Thadou: Hijeh chun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Natahsan'u leh Pathen loupi na namu dingu ahi kati hilou ham?” ati.
English: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

tcz: Hichun amahon songpi chu atangdoh tauvin, hichun Yeshuan Vanlam aven “Pa nangman kataona na-ngai jeh in namin kathangvah e;
en: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

tcz: Chuleh nangman kataona na-ngai jinge, ti keiman kahenai, ajeh chu kakimvel a mipi ding ho hin nangma sol kahi hi ahin tahsan thei na dinguva kati ahibouve,” ati.
en: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”
text:
JHN 11:42
Thadou: Chuleh nangman kataona na-ngai jinge, ti keiman kahenai, ajeh chu kakimvel a mipi ding ho hin nangma sol kahi hi ahin tahsan thei na dinguva kati ahibouve,” ati.
English: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan hasap tah in asam in, “Vo Lazarus, hung thou doh'in,” ati.
en: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
text:
JHN 11:43
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan hasap tah in asam in, “Vo Lazarus, hung thou doh'in,” ati.
English: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

tcz: Hichun Lazarus chu akhut akeng lhanpon a kitom pumin amai ultheh pon a kitom pumin lhan khuh a konin ahungdoh tan ahi. Hichun Yeshuan ajah uva, “Lhamun lang lamjot sah'un,” ati.
en: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”
text:
JHN 11:44
Thadou: Hichun Lazarus chu akhut akeng lhanpon a kitom pumin amai ultheh pon a kitom pumin lhan khuh a konin ahungdoh tan ahi. Hichun Yeshuan ajah uva, “Lhamun lang lamjot sah'un,” ati.
English: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”

tcz: Hichun mipi tamtah Mary toh umjouse chun athilbol chu amu'uvin hichun Yeshua chu atahsan tauve.
en: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.
text:
JHN 11:45
Thadou: Hichun mipi tamtah Mary toh umjouse chun athilbol chu amu'uvin hichun Yeshua chu atahsan tauve.
English: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.

tcz: Ahin mipi lah'a mi kimkhat acheuvin Pharisee ho jah a Yeshua thilbol chengse chu agasei tauve.
en: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.
text:
JHN 11:46
Thadou: Ahin mipi lah'a mi kimkhat acheuvin Pharisee ho jah a Yeshua thilbol chengse chu agasei tauve.
English: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.

tcz: Hijeh chun thempu pipui hole Pharisee ho houvaipo loi akikhom'un, “Eihon ipi ibol'u ham? Hichepa khun la melchihna tamtah abol jing jengin ahi.
en: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.
text:
JHN 11:47
Thadou: Hijeh chun thempu pipui hole Pharisee ho houvaipo loi akikhom'un, “Eihon ipi ibol'u ham? Hichepa khun la melchihna tamtah abol jing jengin ahi.
English: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

tcz: Eihon ama hi tua banga iche jomsah jingu le mi jousen ama ahin tahsan cheh cheh dingu, hiche teng chule Rome solkal in eiho inam'u ahin i-Houin'u ahin eisuhchimpeh dingu ahitai” atiuve.
en: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
text:
JHN 11:48
Thadou: Eihon ama hi tua banga iche jomsah jingu le mi jousen ama ahin tahsan cheh cheh dingu, hiche teng chule Rome solkal in eiho inam'u ahin i-Houin'u ahin eisuhchimpeh dingu ahitai” atiuve.
English: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”

tcz: Hiche laiphat tah'a thempu a ana pang chu Caiaphas ahin aman hitin aseiye, “Nang hon nathu seiyu hi ipi kiseina ham nahe pouve ati.
en: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,
text:
JHN 11:49
Thadou: Hiche laiphat tah'a thempu a ana pang chu Caiaphas ahin aman hitin aseiye, “Nang hon nathu seiyu hi ipi kiseina ham nahe pouve ati.
English: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

tcz: Chujongle vannoi pumpi aboncha aman thah louna dinga miho dinga mikhat athi nangho dinga phajo ahi, tijong nagel pouve,” ati.
en: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”
text:
JHN 11:50
Thadou: Chujongle vannoi pumpi aboncha aman thah louna dinga miho dinga mikhat athi nangho dinga phajo ahi, tijong nagel pouve,” ati.
English: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”

tcz: Chuleh hiche ho hi Caiaphas in ama chama asei doh ahipon, thempu pipui hina'a gaova aphondoh'a, Pakai Yeshua hin vannoi nam jouse khel'a ahinkho apeh doh ding thu asei masah ahibouve.
en: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,
text:
JHN 11:51
Thadou: Chuleh hiche ho hi Caiaphas in ama chama asei doh ahipon, thempu pipui hina'a gaova aphondoh'a, Pakai Yeshua hin vannoi nam jouse khel'a ahinkho apeh doh ding thu asei masah ahibouve.
English: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

tcz: Chuleh Israel chate kisuh khom ding seh hilouvin, namtin jouse le Pathen chate jouse akikhop khoma pumkhat ahidoh na dinga jong ahi.
en: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.
text:
JHN 11:52
Thadou: Chuleh Israel chate kisuh khom ding seh hilouvin, namtin jouse le Pathen chate jouse akikhop khoma pumkhat ahidoh na dinga jong ahi.
English: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, hichea pat chun Judaten Yeshua thana ding lung angaitouvin akihousom tauve.
en: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.
text:
JHN 11:53
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun, hichea pat chun Judaten Yeshua thana ding lung angaitouvin akihousom tauve.
English: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

tcz: Hijeh chun Yeshua Judah ho lah'a lhangphongin avahle tapoi; chua kon chun Jerusalem adalhan, gamthip lama Ephraim khoa aseijui hotoh chua chun aum jing tauve.
en: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.
text:
JHN 11:54
Thadou: Hijeh chun Yeshua Judah ho lah'a lhangphongin avahle tapoi; chua kon chun Jerusalem adalhan, gamthip lama Ephraim khoa aseijui hotoh chua chun aum jing tauve.
English: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

tcz: Chuleh Judahte kalchuh kut ahung naitan, hichun kut masanga kisutheng dingin gamsunga Judahte jousen, Jerusalem ahin jon cheh tauvin ahi.
en: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
text:
JHN 11:55
Thadou: Chuleh Judahte kalchuh kut ahung naitan, hichun kut masanga kisutheng dingin gamsunga Judahte jousen, Jerusalem ahin jon cheh tauvin ahi.
English: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

tcz: Amahon Yeshua ahol'un, Houin vel'a adin uchun, khat le khat akihouvun, “Ipi na ngaito uvem? Yeshua chu kut'a hi hunglou ding ham?” akitiuve.
en: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”
text:
JHN 11:56
Thadou: Amahon Yeshua ahol'un, Houin vel'a adin uchun, khat le khat akihouvun, “Ipi na ngaito uvem? Yeshua chu kut'a hi hunglou ding ham?” akitiuve.
English: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”

tcz: Hichun thempu pipui hole Pharisee hon, lhangphongtah in aphongun, koi hijongle Yeshua umna hea chun amat theina dinguva avetsah dinguvin mipi ho thu apeuvin ahi.
en: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.
text:
JHN 11:57
Thadou: Hichun thempu pipui hole Pharisee hon, lhangphongtah in aphongun, koi hijongle Yeshua umna hea chun amat theina dinguva avetsah dinguvin mipi ho thu apeuvin ahi.
English: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

tcz: Kalchuh kut kipatna ding nigup masang'in, athi a kona athodoh Lazarus umna Bethany a chun Yeshua ahungin,
en: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
text:
JHN 12:1
Thadou: Kalchuh kut kipatna ding nigup masang'in, athi a kona athodoh Lazarus umna Bethany a chun Yeshua ahungin,
English: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

tcz: Hiti chun ama dingin jan an asemun, chuleh Marthan ajenlen Lazarus vang chu ankonga ama toh touho lah'a chun apangin ahi.
en: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
text:
JHN 12:2
Thadou: Hiti chun ama dingin jan an asemun, chuleh Marthan ajenlen Lazarus vang chu ankonga ama toh touho lah'a chun apangin ahi.
English: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

tcz: Chuin Mary in halpi bei Bego thao namtui man tamtah chu ahin choiyin Yeshua kengphanga anun asamin atheh ngimin ahileh agimnam chun insung chu alosoh jeng in ahi.
en: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
text:
JHN 12:3
Thadou: Chuin Mary in halpi bei Bego thao namtui man tamtah chu ahin choiyin Yeshua kengphanga anun asamin atheh ngimin ahileh agimnam chun insung chu alosoh jeng in ahi.
English: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

tcz: Chuin seijui holah a khat Simon chapa Judas Iscariot, amatsah a pang dingpa chun,
en: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,
text:
JHN 12:4
Thadou: Chuin seijui holah a khat Simon chapa Judas Iscariot, amatsah a pang dingpa chun,
English: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

tcz: “Hiche thao namtui hi manlutah ahi. man tamtah'a joh a mivaicha genthei ho pehding ahi,” ati.
en: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”
text:
JHN 12:5
Thadou: “Hiche thao namtui hi manlutah ahi. man tamtah'a joh a mivaicha genthei ho pehding ahi,” ati.
English: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”

tcz: Aman hiche ati chu vaicha genthei khohsah a asei ahipoi, ama chu gucha ahin, chule sumdip avop ahin, asunga kikoi chu akilahji ahi.
en: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
text:
JHN 12:6
Thadou: Aman hiche ati chu vaicha genthei khohsah a asei ahipoi, ama chu gucha ahin, chule sumdip avop ahin, asunga kikoi chu akilahji ahi.
English: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Amanu chu limsah hih'un. Kakivui nia dinga kigontup theina a abol ahi.
en: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
text:
JHN 12:7
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Amanu chu limsah hih'un. Kakivui nia dinga kigontup theina a abol ahi.
English: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

tcz: Nanghon genthei chaga aphat seh a nanei jing dingu ahi, ahin keima vang aphat seh a nangho lah a umjoulou ding kahi,” ati.
en: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”
text:
JHN 12:8
Thadou: Nanghon genthei chaga aphat seh a nanei jing dingu ahi, ahin keima vang aphat seh a nangho lah a umjoulou ding kahi,” ati.
English: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”

tcz: Chuin mipi hon Yeshua chukoma ahunge ti ajah phat'un, Judah ho mi tamtah ama chung chang jeng hilouvin, athi lah a kona athodoh Lazarus jong chu venomin ahenga ahung tauve.
en: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
text:
JHN 12:9
Thadou: Chuin mipi hon Yeshua chukoma ahunge ti ajah phat'un, Judah ho mi tamtah ama chung chang jeng hilouvin, athi lah a kona athodoh Lazarus jong chu venomin ahenga ahung tauve.
English: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

tcz: Hichun thempu pipuihon Lazarus jeng jong thadoh dingin agongun ahi.
en: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
text:
JHN 12:10
Thadou: Hichun thempu pipuihon Lazarus jeng jong thadoh dingin agongun ahi.
English: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

tcz: Ajeh chu amapa jeh tah a jong chu miho lah a tamtah pin amaho anuse uva Yeshua atahsan u ahitan ahi.
en: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
text:
JHN 12:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu amapa jeh tah a jong chu miho lah a tamtah pin amaho anuse uva Yeshua atahsan u ahitan ahi.
English: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

tcz: Hiche ni ajingin kut'a dinga hung mipi atama tamin, Yeshua Jerusalema dingin ahunge, ti ajah phat'un,
en: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
text:
JHN 12:12
Thadou: Hiche ni ajingin kut'a dinga hung mipi atama tamin, Yeshua Jerusalema dingin ahunge, ti ajah phat'un,
English: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

tcz: Lusu na akidop'un aga lamtouvin, “Hosana, Pakai min a hunga Israelte Lengpa chu anun nome,” tin asam asamun ahi.
en: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
text:
JHN 12:13
Thadou: Lusu na akidop'un aga lamtouvin, “Hosana, Pakai min a hunga Israelte Lengpa chu anun nome,” tin asam asamun ahi.
English: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan sangan chalgol khat amun, achunga atouvin ahi;
en: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

tcz: “Vo Zion chanu, kicha hih-in; Ven, nalengpa sangan nou chunga atouvin ahunge,” tia kisun bang chun.
en: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”
text:
JHN 12:15
Thadou: “Vo Zion chanu, kicha hih-in; Ven, nalengpa sangan nou chunga atouvin ahunge,” tia kisun bang chun.
English: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”

tcz: Hicheng thu chu Yeshua seijuiten amasan ana hepouvin ahi, ahin Yeshua choiat'a aumdoh phat chun, hiche thu chu ama thudol'a kisunsa ahin, amahon hitia chu abol'u ahi tichu ageldoh tauve.
en: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
text:
JHN 12:16
Thadou: Hicheng thu chu Yeshua seijuiten amasan ana hepouvin ahi, ahin Yeshua choiat'a aumdoh phat chun, hiche thu chu ama thudol'a kisunsa ahin, amahon hitia chu abol'u ahi tichu ageldoh tauve.
English: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

tcz: Hichun aman Lazarus akouva athi lah a kona athodoh pettah a aumpi mipi chengse chu athu hettohsah a pang ahiuve.
en: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.
text:
JHN 12:17
Thadou: Hichun aman Lazarus akouva athi lah a kona athodoh pettah a aumpi mipi chengse chu athu hettohsah a pang ahiuve.
English: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.

tcz: Hiche melchihna abol ajah jeh tah-uva chu mipi chun alamtou ahi.
en: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.
text:
JHN 12:18
Thadou: Hiche melchihna abol ajah jeh tah-uva chu mipi chun alamtou ahi.
English: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

tcz: Hichun Pharisee ho khat le khat akihou lim un, “Veuvin eihon imacha ibol thei dingu aumpoi; ajeh chu mijousen ama nung ajui cheh tauve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”
text:
JHN 12:19
Thadou: Hichun Pharisee ho khat le khat akihou lim un, “Veuvin eihon imacha ibol thei dingu aumpoi; ajeh chu mijousen ama nung ajui cheh tauve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”

tcz: Hiche kalchuh kut a chu Pathen hou dinga Greek mi phabep khat chetou ahiuvin;
en: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

tcz: Hichun amaho Galilee gam'a Bethsaida khoa mi Philip henga ahungun ajah'a, “Pu Yeshua chu kamu nomui,” ahung tiuve.
en: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
text:
JHN 12:21
Thadou: Hichun amaho Galilee gam'a Bethsaida khoa mi Philip henga ahungun ajah'a, “Pu Yeshua chu kamu nomui,” ahung tiuve.
English: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

tcz: Hichun Philip ahungin Andrew jah'a ahung seiyin, chuin Andrew ahungin Philip toh Yeshua jah a asei lhone.
en: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.
text:
JHN 12:22
Thadou: Hichun Philip ahungin Andrew jah'a ahung seiyin, chuin Andrew ahungin Philip toh Yeshua jah a asei lhone.
English: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Mihem Chapa choiat'a aum ding phat ahung lhunge.
en: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
text:
JHN 12:23
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Mihem Chapa choiat'a aum ding phat ahung lhunge.
English: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

tcz: Thutah chu ahile, chang malkhat chu tol'a tulut in aumjie. Hichu athilou le achangin aumden ji bouve; athi vang le tamtah agajin ahi.
en: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
text:
JHN 12:24
Thadou: Thutah chu ahile, chang malkhat chu tol'a tulut in aumjie. Hichu athilou le achangin aumden ji bouve; athi vang le tamtah agajin ahi.
English: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

tcz: Koi hijongle hiche vannoi leiset chunga ahinkho itcha ho chu mangthah ding ahi; ahin koi hijongle hiche vannoi leiset chunga ahinkho pedoh ho chun tonsot hinkemlou anei dingu ahi.
en: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
text:
JHN 12:25
Thadou: Koi hijongle hiche vannoi leiset chunga ahinkho itcha ho chu mangthah ding ahi; ahin koi hijongle hiche vannoi leiset chunga ahinkho pedoh ho chun tonsot hinkemlou anei dingu ahi.
English: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

tcz: Koi hijongle kalhacha a panga chun kanung eijuihen, keima umna'a chu kalha cha jong um ding ahi; mi koi hile kalhacha a panga chu Pa chun ajabol ding ahi.”
en: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
text:
JHN 12:26
Thadou: Koi hijongle kalhacha a panga chun kanung eijuihen, keima umna'a chu kalha cha jong um ding ahi; mi koi hile kalhacha a panga chu Pa chun ajabol ding ahi.”
English: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

tcz: Tun kalung adongtai; ipi kati ding ham? Pa, hiche nidan a kon hin neihuhdoh-in, ahivangin hiche dinga hi tu nidan geiya hi hung kahi.
en: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.
text:
JHN 12:27
Thadou: Tun kalung adongtai; ipi kati ding ham? Pa, hiche nidan a kon hin neihuhdoh-in, ahivangin hiche dinga hi tu nidan geiya hi hung kahi.
English: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.

tcz: “Pa, namin choiat in” ati. Hiche chun van'a konin Aw ahung gingin, “kachoian tai, chule choian kit nalai ding kahi,” ati.
en: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”
text:
JHN 12:28
Thadou: “Pa, namin choiat in” ati. Hiche chun van'a konin Aw ahung gingin, “kachoian tai, chule choian kit nalai ding kahi,” ati.
English: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”

tcz: Hiche chun akimvel a ding mipi chun hichu ajauvin, “Van aginge,” atiuvin; adangsen, “Vantil in ajah a thu asei ahi,” atiuve.
en: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
text:
JHN 12:29
Thadou: Hiche chun akimvel a ding mipi chun hichu ajauvin, “Van aginge,” atiuvin; adangsen, “Vantil in ajah a thu asei ahi,” atiuve.
English: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”

tcz: Hichun Pakai Yeshuan amaho chu adonbut'in, “Hiche awgin najah'u chu nangma ho phatchomna ding ahibouve, keima a ding ahipoi.
en: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
text:
JHN 12:30
Thadou: Hichun Pakai Yeshuan amaho chu adonbut'in, “Hiche awgin najah'u chu nangma ho phatchomna ding ahibouve, keima a ding ahipoi.
English: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

tcz: Hiche vannoi leiset chunga thutanna phat ahung lhungtai, Satan vannoiya vaihompa nodoh naphat jong hung lhung ding ahitai.”
en: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.
text:
JHN 12:31
Thadou: Hiche vannoi leiset chunga thutanna phat ahung lhungtai, Satan vannoiya vaihompa nodoh naphat jong hung lhung ding ahitai.”
English: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

tcz: Chule keima leiset'a kona kathodoh tengle keiman mi jouse kahenga dinga kahungpui ding nahiuve.
en: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
text:
JHN 12:32
Thadou: Chule keima leiset'a kona kathodoh tengle keiman mi jouse kahenga dinga kahungpui ding nahiuve.
English: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

tcz: Hichu aman athi ding dan tahlang na a hitia chu asei ahi.
en: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
text:
JHN 12:33
Thadou: Hichu aman athi ding dan tahlang na a hitia chu asei ahi.
English: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

tcz: Mihonpi chun adonbut'in, “Keihonla Messiah chu tonsot'a hing jing ding ahi, ti Pathen Lekhabua kon in kaheuvin; Ipi jeh a Mihem Chapa thiding ahi nati thei ham? Hiche Mihem Chapa chu amonga koi ham?” atiuve;
en: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kavah hi nalah uva chomkhat bou umnalai ding ahi; muthim in naphah louna dingun vah umpet hin vahle uvin; muthima vahlea chun achena ding ahepoi.
en: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.
text:
JHN 12:35
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kavah hi nalah uva chomkhat bou umnalai ding ahi; muthim in naphah louna dingun vah umpet hin vahle uvin; muthima vahlea chun achena ding ahepoi.
English: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.

tcz: Vah nanei pet chau hin vah chate nahi theina dingun vah chu tahsanun,” ati. Thu hicheng chu aseiyin, apotdoh-in amahoa kon chun akiseltai.
en: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.
text:
JHN 12:36
Thadou: Vah nanei pet chau hin vah chate nahi theina dingun vah chu tahsanun,” ati. Thu hicheng chu aseiyin, apotdoh-in amahoa kon chun akiseltai.
English: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

tcz: Isaiah themgao thusei: “Pakai kathuseiyu kon atahsan em? Chule Pakai ban thahat koi henga kilang am?”
en: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
text:
JHN 12:37
Thadou: Isaiah themgao thusei: “Pakai kathuseiyu kon atahsan em? Chule Pakai ban thahat koi henga kilang am?”
English: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,

tcz: Tia asei chu guilhun theina ding chun, a-ang sunguva melchihna kidang tamtah abolin, ahivangin atahsan pouve.
en: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
text:
JHN 12:38
Thadou: Tia asei chu guilhun theina ding chun, a-ang sunguva melchihna kidang tamtah abolin, ahivangin atahsan pouve.
English: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

tcz: Hiche thua hin Isaiah themgao chun avel in aseikit in:
en: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:
text:
JHN 12:39
Thadou: Hiche thua hin Isaiah themgao chun avel in aseikit in:
English: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:

tcz: “Aman amit'u asuchon, alungu asutah tai; achuti loule amit'un mu'uvin tin, chule alungun heuvin tin, chule hung kihei kit'un tin keiman boldam get inge,” ati; hiche jeh a hi amahon atahsan thei lou'u ahi.
en: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”
text:
JHN 12:40
Thadou: “Aman amit'u asuchon, alungu asutah tai; achuti loule amit'un mu'uvin tin, chule alungun heuvin tin, chule hung kihei kit'un tin keiman boldam get inge,” ati; hiche jeh a hi amahon atahsan thei lou'u ahi.
English: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”

tcz: Isaiah chun aloupi chu amu jeh a hicheng chu aseiya; ama ho thudol chu asei ahi.
en: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
text:
JHN 12:41
Thadou: Isaiah chun aloupi chu amu jeh a hicheng chu aseiya; ama ho thudol chu asei ahi.
English: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

tcz: Achuti vang'in vaipo ho jeng jong tamtah'in atahsan tauve; ahinla Pharisee ho jeh chun kikhop na akonin eiki kaidoh khante, tin aseidoh aumpouve.
en: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,
text:
JHN 12:42
Thadou: Achuti vang'in vaipo ho jeng jong tamtah'in atahsan tauve; ahinla Pharisee ho jeh chun kikhop na akonin eiki kaidoh khante, tin aseidoh aumpouve.
English: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon Pathen choiat sangin mihem choiat adei jouvin ahi.
en: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.
text:
JHN 12:43
Thadou: Ajeh chu amahon Pathen choiat sangin mihem choiat adei jouvin ahi.
English: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan aw sangtah in asam in, “Koi hijongle keima eitahsan chun keima hilou va eisolpa joh atahsan ahibouve;
en: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

tcz: Chule keima eimua chun eisolpa amu ahi.
en: He who sees me sees him who sent me.
text:
JHN 12:45
Thadou: Chule keima eimua chun eisolpa amu ahi.
English: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

tcz: Koi hijong le keima eitahsan a chu muthim a a-umlouna dinga keima vah hina a vannoiya hung kahi.
en: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
text:
JHN 12:46
Thadou: Koi hijong le keima eitahsan a chu muthim a a-umlouna dinga keima vah hina a vannoiya hung kahi.
English: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

tcz: Mikhat touvin kathu jahen nit hih jongle athu katanpoi; ijeh inem itile keima vannoi thutan'a hung kahipoi, vannoi huhhing ding joh a hung kahibouve.
en: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
text:
JHN 12:47
Thadou: Mikhat touvin kathu jahen nit hih jongle athu katanpoi; ijeh inem itile keima vannoi thutan'a hung kahipoi, vannoi huhhing ding joh a hung kahibouve.
English: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

tcz: Koi hijongle keima eipampaiya kathuhil jong joplou chu, thupi kitan nile thutah kaseidoh hin achungthu atan ding ahi.
en: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.
text:
JHN 12:48
Thadou: Koi hijongle keima eipampaiya kathuhil jong joplou chu, thupi kitan nile thutah kaseidoh hin achungthu atan ding ahi.
English: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile keiman kacham'a kasei ahipoi, eisol'a Pa chun kasei dingle kapao ding dan hi thu eipeh ahibouve.
