en: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.
text:
JHN 12:49
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile keiman kacham'a kasei ahipoi, eisol'a Pa chun kasei dingle kapao ding dan hi thu eipeh ahibouve.
English: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.

tcz: Ama thupeh chu tonsot hinna ahi, ti kahei; hiche jeh a chu kathusei hi Pan eihil bang banga kasei ahi,” ati.
en: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
text:
JHN 12:50
Thadou: Ama thupeh chu tonsot hinna ahi, ti kahei; hiche jeh a chu kathusei hi Pan eihil bang banga kasei ahi,” ati.
English: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”

tcz: Kalchuh kut masangin Yeshuan hiche vannoiya kona apa henga ache ding phat ahung lhungtai, ti ahen, vannoiya um ama a ho chu angailun akhon nigeiyin angailu lhumkeiye.
en: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
text:
JHN 13:1
Thadou: Kalchuh kut masangin Yeshuan hiche vannoiya kona apa henga ache ding phat ahung lhungtai, ti ahen, vannoiya um ama a ho chu angailun akhon nigeiyin angailu lhumkeiye.
English: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

tcz: Chuin jan anneh lai sungin diabol chun Simon chapa Judas Iscariot lung sunga ama matsah na ding lungthim khumsa akoi ahitan;
en: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,

tcz: Yeshuan, Pan thil jouse ama khut'a apeh chule ama Pathena kona hungdoh ahia, Pathen henga chea ahi chu ahen;
en: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

tcz: Ajan anneh ankonga konin akipat doh in chuin aponsil akong'ah akigah in ahi.
en: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.
text:
JHN 13:4
Thadou: Ajan anneh ankonga konin akipat doh in chuin aponsil akong'ah akigah in ahi.
English: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.

tcz: Chuin aman kisilna kong'ah twi alheiyin, aseijuiho keng asil'in, akong gahna pon chun atheh peh in ahi.
en: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
text:
JHN 13:5
Thadou: Chuin aman kisilna kong'ah twi alheiyin, aseijuiho keng asil'in, akong gahna pon chun atheh peh in ahi.
English: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

tcz: Chuin ama Simon Peter koma ahungin ahile aman ajah'a, “Pakai nangman kakeng neisilpeh ding ham?” atin ahile,
en: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
text:
JHN 13:6
Thadou: Chuin ama Simon Peter koma ahungin ahile aman ajah'a, “Pakai nangman kakeng neisilpeh ding ham?” atin ahile,
English: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kabol hi nangman tun nahepoi ajo le he nan nate,” ati.
en: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
text:
JHN 13:7
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Kabol hi nangman tun nahepoi ajo le he nan nate,” ati.
English: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

tcz: Chuin Peter in ajah a, “Nangman itih hijongle kakeng nasil lou hel ding ahi,” ati. Yeshuan adonbut in ajah a, “Keiman nangma kasil loule keiya nangman chan nanei lou ahi,” ati.
en: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”
text:
JHN 13:8
Thadou: Chuin Peter in ajah a, “Nangman itih hijongle kakeng nasil lou hel ding ahi,” ati. Yeshuan adonbut in ajah a, “Keiman nangma kasil loule keiya nangman chan nanei lou ahi,” ati.
English: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”

tcz: Simon Peter in ajah a, “Pakai kakeng keojeng hilouvin kakhut le kalu jonge,” ati.
en: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”
text:
JHN 13:9
Thadou: Simon Peter in ajah a, “Pakai kakeng keojeng hilouvin kakhut le kalu jonge,” ati.
English: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Apumpia kisil khat chu akeng tailou adang silding angai khohpoi; apumpin angim sohnai. Chule nangho nangim nauve, ahivangin nabonchau nahi pouve,” ati.
en: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”
text:
JHN 13:10
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Apumpia kisil khat chu akeng tailou adang silding angai khohpoi; apumpin angim sohnai. Chule nangho nangim nauve, ahivangin nabonchau nahi pouve,” ati.
English: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”

tcz: Ijeh inem itile ama matsah a pang dingpa chu aman ahetsa ahin, hiche jeh a chu aman, “Nabonchauvin na ngim pouve,” ati ahi.
en: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”
text:
JHN 13:11
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile ama matsah a pang dingpa chu aman ahetsa ahin, hiche jeh a chu aman, “Nabonchauvin na ngim pouve,” ati ahi.
English: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”

tcz: Aman akengu asil jouvin apon akilah in atou kit'in amaho jah a chun, “Ipi bol'a kahi, kabol chu nahet nah uvem?
en: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
text:
JHN 13:12
Thadou: Aman akengu asil jouvin apon akilah in atou kit'in amaho jah a chun, “Ipi bol'a kahi, kabol chu nahet nah uvem?
English: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?

tcz: Nanghon keima Houhil le Pakai neitiuve; hiche natiu chu aphai, ijeh inem itile keima hichu kahi.
en: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
text:
JHN 13:13
Thadou: Nanghon keima Houhil le Pakai neitiuve; hiche natiu chu aphai, ijeh inem itile keima hichu kahi.
English: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.

tcz: Hijeh chun keima Pakai le Houhil jengin bon nangho keng kasil le nang hon jong khat'in khat keng nakisilpeh to dingu thu ahi.
en: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
text:
JHN 13:14
Thadou: Hijeh chun keima Pakai le Houhil jengin bon nangho keng kasil le nang hon jong khat'in khat keng nakisilpeh to dingu thu ahi.
English: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman nangho kabol banga chu nanghon jong nabolna dinguva vetsahna a kabol ahi.
en: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.
text:
JHN 13:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman nangho kabol banga chu nanghon jong nabolna dinguva vetsahna a kabol ahi.
English: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.

tcz: Iti dih a dih hitam, Pakai sangin soh achungnungjo poi, asol'a sangin solchah jong achungnungjo poi.
en: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
text:
JHN 13:16
Thadou: Iti dih a dih hitam, Pakai sangin soh achungnungjo poi, asol'a sangin solchah jong achungnungjo poi.
English: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

tcz: Hiti ho hi nahetdoh uva nabol'u le nangho anun nom nahiuve.”
en: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
text:
JHN 13:17
Thadou: Hiti ho hi nahetdoh uva nabol'u le nangho anun nom nahiuve.”
English: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

tcz: Nang ho nabonchauva thudol'a kasei ahipoi; keiman kalhendoh ho chengse chu kahenai; ahivangin, “kachanglhah nepan kachunga akengto alamtai,” ti Pathen Lekhabua thu guilhun theina dinga ahi.
en: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’
text:
JHN 13:18
Thadou: Nang ho nabonchauva thudol'a kasei ahipoi; keiman kalhendoh ho chengse chu kahenai; ahivangin, “kachanglhah nepan kachunga akengto alamtai,” ti Pathen Lekhabua thu guilhun theina dinga ahi.
English: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’

tcz: “Tua kal'a ahung guilhun tengle keima hi ama chu kahi, nahetna dinguva ahung guilhun masanga kaseipeh nahiuve.
en: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
text:
JHN 13:19
Thadou: “Tua kal'a ahung guilhun tengle keima hi ama chu kahi, nahetna dinguva ahung guilhun masanga kaseipeh nahiuve.
English: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

tcz: tahbeh a koi hijongle kasol na a nom chan chun keima eisan ahi; chule keima eisang chan chun eisolpa asan ahi,” ati.
en: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”
text:
JHN 13:20
Thadou: tahbeh a koi hijongle kasol na a nom chan chun keima eisan ahi; chule keima eisang chan chun eisolpa asan ahi,” ati.
English: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshua alung dong lheh jengin aseitai, “Atahbeh a nangho lah a mikhat in neijoh doh dingu ahi,” tin ahin seidoh e.
en: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
text:
JHN 13:21
Thadou: Hichun Yeshua alung dong lheh jengin aseitai, “Atahbeh a nangho lah a mikhat in neijoh doh dingu ahi,” tin ahin seidoh e.
English: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

tcz: Hichun seijui ho chu khat le khat akiveto uvin, koi asei ahi agelmouve.
en: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.
text:
JHN 13:22
Thadou: Hichun seijui ho chu khat le khat akiveto uvin, koi asei ahi agelmouve.
English: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

tcz: Hiche a chu aseijui ho lah a khat Yeshuan angailut chu a-ang a ki-ngai ahin;
en: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.

tcz: Simon Peter in akhasuh in, “Koi nasei ham neisei peh'un,” ati.
en: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
text:
JHN 13:24
Thadou: Simon Peter in akhasuh in, “Koi nasei ham neisei peh'un,” ati.
English: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”

tcz: Hichun aman aki ngai bang chun aki ngaiyin, “Pakai hiche chu koiham?” tin adongin ahile;
en: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Hiche changlhah hal hi kade a kapeh dingpen tah chu ama chu ahi,” ati. Chuin aman changlhah hal chu adekot jouvin alan Simon chapa Iscariot Judas chu apetai.
en: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
text:
JHN 13:26
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Hiche changlhah hal hi kade a kapeh dingpen tah chu ama chu ahi,” ati. Chuin aman changlhah hal chu adekot jouvin alan Simon chapa Iscariot Judas chu apetai.
English: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

tcz: Chuche changlhah hal akisan joutah chun Satan asunga aluttan, chuphat chun Yeshuan ajah a, “Nabol ding chu bol loiyin,” ati.
en: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”
text:
JHN 13:27
Thadou: Chuche changlhah hal akisan joutah chun Satan asunga aluttan, chuphat chun Yeshuan ajah a, “Nabol ding chu bol loiyin,” ati.
English: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

tcz: Ahivangin aman ipi dol'a achuti sei ahidem, ankonga touho khatchan jong ahedoh pouve.
en: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.
text:
JHN 13:28
Thadou: Ahivangin aman ipi dol'a achuti sei ahidem, ankonga touho khatchan jong ahedoh pouve.
English: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.

tcz: Ijeh inem itile kimkhat'in Judas khut'a sumbom aum jeh a chu kut'a dinga manchah ding choa, ahilou le vaichaho ikhat pe dinga Yeshuan aseiyin angaitouve.
en: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
text:
JHN 13:29
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile kimkhat'in Judas khut'a sumbom aum jeh a chu kut'a dinga manchah ding choa, ahilou le vaichaho ikhat pe dinga Yeshuan aseiyin angaitouve.
English: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

tcz: Chuin aman changlhah hal chu akisanin hiche pettah chun apotdoh paijengtai. Hichu jan ahi.
en: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.
text:
JHN 13:30
Thadou: Chuin aman changlhah hal chu akisanin hiche pettah chun apotdoh paijengtai. Hichu jan ahi.
English: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

tcz: Ama apotdoh chun Yeshuan, “Mihem Chapa choiat'in aumtai, ama ah Pathen jong choian'in aumtai;
en: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

tcz: Chule Pathen in jong Chapa jeh'a choi-atna amu jeh a, aman chapa chu achoiat pai jeng ding ahi.”
en: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
text:
JHN 13:32
Thadou: Chule Pathen in jong Chapa jeh'a choi-atna amu jeh a, aman chapa chu achoiat pai jeng ding ahi.”
English: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

tcz: Chapang neocha ho nangho toh chomcha khat bou um ding kahi, nang hon neihol dingu, ahivanga Juda ho jah a kasei “Keima che na a chu nangho nahung thei lou dingu,” kati ahi.
en: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
text:
JHN 13:33
Thadou: Chapang neocha ho nangho toh chomcha khat bou um ding kahi, nang hon neihol dingu, ahivanga Juda ho jah a kasei “Keima che na a chu nangho nahung thei lou dingu,” kati ahi.
English: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.

tcz: “Keiman nangho thupeh thah kapeh nahiuve, nang ho khat le khat kingailuto cheh un; keiman nangho ka-ngailut bangu hin, nangho jong khat le khat kingailu uvin.
en: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
text:
JHN 13:34
Thadou: “Keiman nangho thupeh thah kapeh nahiuve, nang ho khat le khat kingailuto cheh un; keiman nangho ka-ngailut bangu hin, nangho jong khat le khat kingailu uvin.
English: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

tcz: Nangho khat le khat nakingailut tocheh uva ahile hichun keima seijui nahiu vannoiya natahlang'u ahi,” ati.
en: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
text:
JHN 13:35
Thadou: Nangho khat le khat nakingailut tocheh uva ahile hichun keima seijui nahiu vannoiya natahlang'u ahi,” ati.
English: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

tcz: Simon Peter in adongin, “Pakai nangma hoilama nache ding ham?” atile Yeshuan adonbut in, “Tun nangma kache na a kanung nunga hung thei pon nate, phat chomkhat jou teng vangleh kanung nunga nahung ding ahi,” ati.
en: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”
text:
JHN 13:36
Thadou: Simon Peter in adongin, “Pakai nangma hoilama nache ding ham?” atile Yeshuan adonbut in, “Tun nangma kache na a kanung nunga hung thei pon nate, phat chomkhat jou teng vangleh kanung nunga nahung ding ahi,” ati.
English: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”

tcz: Peter in ajah a “Pakai ibol'a tua nanung nunga kahung thei lou ding ham? Nangma jal'in kahinna jong penge,” ati.
en: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
text:
JHN 13:37
Thadou: Peter in ajah a “Pakai ibol'a tua nanung nunga kahung thei lou ding ham? Nangma jal'in kahinna jong penge,” ati.
English: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Keima jal'a nathi ding ham? Chutiponte, jing jingkah ahchal khon masanga kahekhapoi tia thumvei nei seilep ding ahi,” ati.
en: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
text:
JHN 13:38
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut in, “Keima jal'a nathi ding ham? Chutiponte, jing jingkah ahchal khon masanga kahekhapoi tia thumvei nei seilep ding ahi,” ati.
English: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.

tcz: “Nalung'u khamsah hih'un, Pathen tahsan'un, chule keima jong neitahsan'un.
en: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
text:
JHN 14:1
Thadou: “Nalung'u khamsah hih'un, Pathen tahsan'un, chule keima jong neitahsan'un.
English: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

tcz: Kapa In'ah chenna ding indan ninglhingset in aume; umlou hi le najah uva kasei tah hih ding ham? Ajeh chu keima nangho dinga mun sema che ding kahi.
en: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
text:
JHN 14:2
Thadou: Kapa In'ah chenna ding indan ninglhingset in aume; umlou hi le najah uva kasei tah hih ding ham? Ajeh chu keima nangho dinga mun sema che ding kahi.
English: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

tcz: Thil jouse gontup ahiteng leh, keima hung ingting, kaumna a chu naum jingthei nadiuva kahung puiding nahiuve.
en: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
text:
JHN 14:3
Thadou: Thil jouse gontup ahiteng leh, keima hung ingting, kaumna a chu naum jingthei nadiuva kahung puiding nahiuve.
English: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

tcz: Chule nanghon kache na ding mun alampi nahe nauve,” ati.
en: You know where I go, and you know the way.”
text:
JHN 14:4
Thadou: Chule nanghon kache na ding mun alampi nahe nauve,” ati.
English: You know where I go, and you know the way.”

tcz: Thomas in adonbut'in, “Pakai keihon nache na ding bon kihelou a alampi iti kahet dingu ham?” ati.
en: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
text:
JHN 14:5
Thadou: Thomas in adonbut'in, “Pakai keihon nache na ding bon kihelou a alampi iti kahet dingu ham?” ati.
English: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”

tcz: Yeshuan amapa chu adonbut'in, “Keima hi lampi le thutah chule hinna chu kahi; keima henga pat tailouvin koima Pa kom ahung theipoi.
en: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
text:
JHN 14:6
Thadou: Yeshuan amapa chu adonbut'in, “Keima hi lampi le thutah chule hinna chu kahi; keima henga pat tailouvin koima Pa kom ahung theipoi.
English: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

tcz: Chule nanghon keima neiheleu chun Kapa jong chu nahet dingu ahitai; tua pat'a vang nanghon amapa chu naheuvin chule namu tauve.”
en: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”
text:
JHN 14:7
Thadou: Chule nanghon keima neiheleu chun Kapa jong chu nahet dingu ahitai; tua pat'a vang nanghon amapa chu naheuvin chule namu tauve.”
English: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”

tcz: Hichun Philip in adonbut in, “Pakai Pachu neimu sah'un, hichu keiho dinga phaset ahi,” ati.
en: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
text:
JHN 14:8
Thadou: Hichun Philip in adonbut in, “Pakai Pachu neimu sah'un, hichu keiho dinga phaset ahi,” ati.
English: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Philip, keima hitih chan nangho toh kaum khom a jong chu neihet loulai ham? Chule keima eimua chun Ka-Pa amu ahitai; achutile Pachu neimu sah-un iti nati ham?
en: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
text:
JHN 14:9
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Philip, keima hitih chan nangho toh kaum khom a jong chu neihet loulai ham? Chule keima eimua chun Ka-Pa amu ahitai; achutile Pachu neimu sah-un iti nati ham?
English: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

tcz: Chule keima Pa a kaum a chule Pa jong keiya um ahi, hiche hi natahsan lou ham? Chule keiman nangho jah'a thu kasei chengse hi keima cham'a kasei ahipoi; Pachu keiya uma na atoh ahibouve.
en: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
text:
JHN 14:10
Thadou: Chule keima Pa a kaum a chule Pa jong keiya um ahi, hiche hi natahsan lou ham? Chule keiman nangho jah'a thu kasei chengse hi keima cham'a kasei ahipoi; Pachu keiya uma na atoh ahibouve.
English: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

tcz: Keima Pa a kauma chule Pa jong keiya aume ti chu neitahsan jengun; ahilou jongle na kitong chengse jeh tah hin tahsanun.
en: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
text:
JHN 14:11
Thadou: Keima Pa a kauma chule Pa jong keiya aume ti chu neitahsan jengun; ahilou jongle na kitong chengse jeh tah hin tahsanun.
English: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

tcz: Atahbeh a, keima eitahsan'a chun kathilbol chengse hi aman jong abol ding ahi; asanga lenjo jo abol ding ahi, chule keima Pa henga kinungle kit ding kahitai.
en: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
text:
JHN 14:12
Thadou: Atahbeh a, keima eitahsan'a chun kathilbol chengse hi aman jong abol ding ahi; asanga lenjo jo abol ding ahi, chule keima Pa henga kinungle kit ding kahitai.
English: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

tcz: Chule Pachu Chapan achoiat'a, chule nanghon thil jouse ipi hijongle Keima mina nathum chanu chu kabol peh ding nahiuve.
en: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
text:
JHN 14:13
Thadou: Chule Pachu Chapan achoiat'a, chule nanghon thil jouse ipi hijongle Keima mina nathum chanu chu kabol peh ding nahiuve.
English: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

tcz: Chule Keima mina nathum dingu chu ipi hijongle kabolpeh ding nahiuve.”
en: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
text:
JHN 14:14
Thadou: Chule Keima mina nathum dingu chu ipi hijongle kabolpeh ding nahiuve.”
English: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

tcz: “Keima neingailut uleh kathupeh ho hi nanit dingu ahi.
en: If you love me, keep my commandments.
text:
JHN 14:15
Thadou: “Keima neingailut uleh kathupeh ho hi nanit dingu ahi.
English: If you love me, keep my commandments.

tcz: Keima Pa henga taoving ting chuleh aman nangho naumpi jing dingu Lhamon sah Lhagao napeh dingu ahi.
en: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
text:
JHN 14:16
Thadou: Keima Pa henga taoving ting chuleh aman nangho naumpi jing dingu Lhamon sah Lhagao napeh dingu ahi.
English: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:

tcz: Amachu Lhagao Theng, thudih lampia napuiyuvah ahi; vannoiyin ama chu asang theipoi; ijeh inem itile ama chu mu jong amu pouvin, he jong ahepouve; nang hon vang naheuve, ajeh chu ama nangho sunga chenga ahi, umjong hung um ding ahi.
en: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
text:
JHN 14:17
Thadou: Amachu Lhagao Theng, thudih lampia napuiyuvah ahi; vannoiyin ama chu asang theipoi; ijeh inem itile ama chu mu jong amu pouvin, he jong ahepouve; nang hon vang naheuve, ajeh chu ama nangho sunga chenga ahi, umjong hung um ding ahi.
English: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

tcz: Chule keiman nangho avetup ding beiyin nadalha pouvinge; keima nahenguva hung kit ding kahi.
en: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
text:
JHN 14:18
Thadou: Chule keiman nangho avetup ding beiyin nadalha pouvinge; keima nahenguva hung kit ding kahi.
English: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

tcz: Vannoi mihon phat chomkhat jou le eimu tahlou dingu ahi, ahinla nanghon vang neimu dingu ahinai; Ajeh chu keima kahing jinge, chule nangho jong nahin dingu ahi.
en: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
text:
JHN 14:19
Thadou: Vannoi mihon phat chomkhat jou le eimu tahlou dingu ahi, ahinla nanghon vang neimu dingu ahinai; Ajeh chu keima kahing jinge, chule nangho jong nahin dingu ahi.
English: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

tcz: Keima hinna a kathodoh kit teng, nanghon nahet chen diu ahi; keima Pa a kaum a chule nangho keima a naum diu chule keima nangho a kaum ding ahi.
en: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
text:
JHN 14:20
Thadou: Keima hinna a kathodoh kit teng, nanghon nahet chen diu ahi; keima Pa a kaum a chule nangho keima a naum diu chule keima nangho a kaum ding ahi.
English: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

tcz: Koi hijongle kathupeh ho neiya chule nit chu eingailua ahi; chule keima eingailua chu Ka Pan angailut ding; chule keiman ama chu ka-ngailut a ahenga kakiphon ding ahi,” ati.
en: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
text:
JHN 14:21
Thadou: Koi hijongle kathupeh ho neiya chule nit chu eingailua ahi; chule keima eingailua chu Ka Pan angailut ding; chule keiman ama chu ka-ngailut a ahenga kakiphon ding ahi,” ati.
English: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”

tcz: Judas (Iscariot hilou, seijui achom khatpa) chun ajah'a, “Pakai, ibol'a nangma keiho henga nakiphona vannoi mi henga naki phon lou ding ham?” ati.
en: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
text:
JHN 14:22
Thadou: Judas (Iscariot hilou, seijui achom khatpa) chun ajah'a, “Pakai, ibol'a nangma keiho henga nakiphona vannoi mi henga naki phon lou ding ham?” ati.
English: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in ajah a, “Ei ngailu jouse chun kathu anit ding, chule Ka Pan amaho chu angailut ding, chule ahenguva kahunga amaho chu kachenpi ding ahi,
en: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
text:
JHN 14:23
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in ajah a, “Ei ngailu jouse chun kathu anit ding, chule Ka Pan amaho chu angailut ding, chule ahenguva kahunga amaho chu kachenpi ding ahi,
English: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

tcz: Chule koi hijongle keima eingailu lou chun kathu jong anitpoi; chule nathu jah'u hi keiya ahipoi, eisola Pa a chu ahibouve.
en: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
text:
JHN 14:24
Thadou: Chule koi hijongle keima eingailu lou chun kathu jong anitpoi; chule nathu jah'u hi keiya ahipoi, eisola Pa a chu ahibouve.
English: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

tcz: Keiman nangho kaumpi pet'a thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve.
en: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.
text:
JHN 14:25
Thadou: Keiman nangho kaumpi pet'a thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve.
English: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.

tcz: Ahinla Pan keima khel'a naki thopi dingu Lhagao Theng ahinsol teng, Ama chun thil jouse nahetsah dingu chule thil jouse kasei doh ho jouse avela nagel dohsah kit dingu ahi.
en: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
text:
JHN 14:26
Thadou: Ahinla Pan keima khel'a naki thopi dingu Lhagao Theng ahinsol teng, Ama chun thil jouse nahetsah dingu chule thil jouse kasei doh ho jouse avela nagel dohsah kit dingu ahi.
English: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

tcz: Lungmon kada lhah peh nahiuve; kalungmon kapeh nahiuve; kapeh hi vannoi mi peh bang ahipoi; nalungu donsah hih-un, kicha jong kicha hih-un.
en: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
text:
JHN 14:27
Thadou: Lungmon kada lhah peh nahiuve; kalungmon kapeh nahiuve; kapeh hi vannoi mi peh bang ahipoi; nalungu donsah hih-un, kicha jong kicha hih-un.
English: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

tcz: Nahenguva thu kana seiho gel doh jinguvin ajeh chu keima kache mang ding ahin, ahin naheng uva kahung kit ding ahi; chule keima nei ngailut mongule kei sanga laljo Pa koma kache dinghi nanghon nei kipa pi joh dingu ahi.
en: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
text:
JHN 14:28
Thadou: Nahenguva thu kana seiho gel doh jinguvin ajeh chu keima kache mang ding ahin, ahin naheng uva kahung kit ding ahi; chule keima nei ngailut mongule kei sanga laljo Pa koma kache dinghi nanghon nei kipa pi joh dingu ahi.
English: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.

tcz: Hiche ho hi nahenguva kasei peh masat'u ahi, Ajeh chu thil hohi ahungso phattengleh nanghon natahsan thei na dingu ahi.
en: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
text:
JHN 14:29
Thadou: Hiche ho hi nahenguva kasei peh masat'u ahi, Ajeh chu thil hohi ahungso phattengleh nanghon natahsan thei na dingu ahi.
English: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.

tcz: Nangho toh kihou limna ding phat kanei lhomtai, ajeh chu vannoi leiset chunga vaihompa ahung nai tai, aman kachung ah tha aneipoi.
en: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
text:
JHN 14:30
Thadou: Nangho toh kihou limna ding phat kanei lhomtai, ajeh chu vannoi leiset chunga vaihompa ahung nai tai, aman kachung ah tha aneipoi.
English: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

tcz: Amavang Pan keiya kona a ngaichat chu kabol ding ahi, chutile vannoi in Pa ngailutna hi ahin hetthei dingu ahi, hunguvin eiho che jengu hite.”
en: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.
text:
JHN 14:31
Thadou: Amavang Pan keiya kona a ngaichat chu kabol ding ahi, chutile vannoi in Pa ngailutna hi ahin hetthei dingu ahi, hunguvin eiho che jengu hite.”
English: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.

tcz: Keima lengpi gui kahi, chule kapa hi alhoungim hon neipa ahi.
en: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
text:
JHN 15:1
Thadou: Keima lengpi gui kahi, chule kapa hi alhoungim hon neipa ahi.
English: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

tcz: Chuleh keiya um abah aga lou ho chu aman apaidoh ji; chuleh aga chengse chu ahaga chehna dingin amal ngim jin ahi.
en: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
text:
JHN 15:2
Thadou: Chuleh keiya um abah aga lou ho chu aman apaidoh ji; chuleh aga chengse chu ahaga chehna dingin amal ngim jin ahi.
English: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

tcz: Kathusei vanga chu nangho angimsa nahi tauve.
en: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
text:
JHN 15:3
Thadou: Kathusei vanga chu nangho angimsa nahi tauve.
English: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

tcz: Chuleh nangho keiya umjingun, keijong nanghoa um inge, abah lengpi guia aumlou le achanga agathei lou banga chu nang ho jong keiya naum lou u le naga theilou dingu ahi.
en: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
text:
JHN 15:4
Thadou: Chuleh nangho keiya umjingun, keijong nanghoa um inge, abah lengpi guia aumlou le achanga agathei lou banga chu nang ho jong keiya naum lou u le naga theilou dingu ahi.
English: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

tcz: Henge, keima hi lengpigui chu kahi, nangho abah nahiuve. Keiya umho chule keiman jong kaumpi jouse chun ga tamtah ahin sosah dingu ahi. Ajeh chu keima louvin nanghon imacha nabol thei pouve.
en: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
text:
JHN 15:5
Thadou: Henge, keima hi lengpigui chu kahi, nangho abah nahiuve. Keiya umho chule keiman jong kaumpi jouse chun ga tamtah ahin sosah dingu ahi. Ajeh chu keima louvin nanghon imacha nabol thei pouve.
English: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

tcz: Mi keiya umlou chu pannabei abah bangin paidoh-in aumjin, chuleh agop jin chuleh achom khomun meikong sungah asep lut jiuvin ahile akavam jitai.
en: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
text:
JHN 15:6
Thadou: Mi keiya umlou chu pannabei abah bangin paidoh-in aumjin, chuleh agop jin chuleh achom khomun meikong sungah asep lut jiuvin ahile akavam jitai.
English: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

tcz: Ahin nangho keima a naum jinguva, chuleh keima thucheng ho nangho a aumle, nanghon nangai chat chan'u nathum thei'u ahi; chuleh naki bolpeh dingu ahi.
en: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
text:
JHN 15:7
Thadou: Ahin nangho keima a naum jinguva, chuleh keima thucheng ho nangho a aumle, nanghon nangai chat chan'u nathum thei'u ahi; chuleh naki bolpeh dingu ahi.
English: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

tcz: Nanghon theiga tamtah napunsah teng'ule keima seijui dihtah nahiuve, hiche jeh'a chu Pa choiat na um ding ahi.
en: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
text:
JHN 15:8
Thadou: Nanghon theiga tamtah napunsah teng'ule keima seijui dihtah nahiuve, hiche jeh'a chu Pa choiat na um ding ahi.
English: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

tcz: Pan keima eingailut bang banga keiman jong nang ho ka-ngailut nahiuve, hijeh chun kangailutna a hin umjingun.
en: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
text:
JHN 15:9
Thadou: Pan keima eingailut bang banga keiman jong nang ho ka-ngailut nahiuve, hijeh chun kangailutna a hin umjingun.
English: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

tcz: Nanghon keima thupeh napom tengule keima ngailut na'a um nahi tauve; chule keiman jong hitobanga Pa thupeh kanit jing jeh'a, ama ngailut na a umjing kahi.
en: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
text:
JHN 15:10
Thadou: Nanghon keima thupeh napom tengule keima ngailut na'a um nahi tauve; chule keiman jong hitobanga Pa thupeh kanit jing jeh'a, ama ngailut na a umjing kahi.
English: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.

tcz: Kakipana nangho a aum jingna ding le naki panau acham kimna dinga thu hicheng hi najah uva kana sei ahi.
en: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
text:
JHN 15:11
Thadou: Kakipana nangho a aum jingna ding le naki panau acham kimna dinga thu hicheng hi najah uva kana sei ahi.
English: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

tcz: Hiche hi keima thupeh ahi, “Keiman nangho kangailut bangin, nangho jong khat le khat kingailu tocheh in um'un.
en: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
text:
JHN 15:12
Thadou: Hiche hi keima thupeh ahi, “Keiman nangho kangailut bangin, nangho jong khat le khat kingailu tocheh in um'un.
English: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

tcz: Min ajol agol dinga ahinna apeh sanga ngailut chungnungjo koiman aneipoi.
en: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
text:
JHN 15:13
Thadou: Min ajol agol dinga ahinna apeh sanga ngailut chungnungjo koiman aneipoi.
English: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

tcz: Kathu peh ngai ho chu kaloi ahi.
en: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.
text:
JHN 15:14
Thadou: Kathu peh ngai ho chu kaloi ahi.
English: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.

tcz: Keiman nangho soh kati lou ding nahi tauve, ajeh chu soh in apupa thilbol ahepoi; tua nangho hi kaloi ngaitah nahiuve, ajeh chu Pan keima eihetsah jouse nangho kasei peh nahi tauve.
en: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
text:
JHN 15:15
Thadou: Keiman nangho soh kati lou ding nahi tauve, ajeh chu soh in apupa thilbol ahepoi; tua nangho hi kaloi ngaitah nahiuve, ajeh chu Pan keima eihetsah jouse nangho kasei peh nahi tauve.
English: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

tcz: Nang hon keima neilhenu ahipoi, keima joh-in nangho kalhen doh a nacheuva haga nagauva chuleh nagau aumna dinga kapansah nahiuve. Ipi hijongle nagot chanu kamin a Pa henga nathumu chu aman napeh theina dingun,
en: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
text:
JHN 15:16
Thadou: Nang hon keima neilhenu ahipoi, keima joh-in nangho kalhen doh a nacheuva haga nagauva chuleh nagau aumna dinga kapansah nahiuve. Ipi hijongle nagot chanu kamin a Pa henga nathumu chu aman napeh theina dingun,
English: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

tcz: Hiche hi keima thupeh ahi, nangho khat le khat kingailu tocheh'un,” ati.
en: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
text:
JHN 15:17
Thadou: Hiche hi keima thupeh ahi, nangho khat le khat kingailu tocheh'un,” ati.
English: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

tcz: Chule vannoiyin nahin vetda tengule geldoh un keima ei vetda masat'u ahi.
en: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
text:
JHN 15:18
Thadou: Chule vannoiyin nahin vetda tengule geldoh un keima ei vetda masat'u ahi.
English: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

tcz: Nangho vannoiya hileu chun vannoiyin ama a chu angailut ding ahin; tunla nangho vannoiya nahi lou u, vannoiya kona keiman kalhen doh nahiuvin, hiche jeh a chu vannoiyin nahot'u ahi.
en: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
text:
JHN 15:19
Thadou: Nangho vannoiya hileu chun vannoiyin ama a chu angailut ding ahin; tunla nangho vannoiya nahi lou u, vannoiya kona keiman kalhen doh nahiuvin, hiche jeh a chu vannoiyin nahot'u ahi.
English: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

tcz: Chuleh najah uva kathusei hi, “Soh apakai sangin achungnungjo poi,” kati chu geldoh-un. Amahon kei eibolseuva chu nang ho nabolset dingu ahi; kathu nit leu nang ho thujong anit dingu ahi.
en: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
text:
JHN 15:20
Thadou: Chuleh najah uva kathusei hi, “Soh apakai sangin achungnungjo poi,” kati chu geldoh-un. Amahon kei eibolseuva chu nang ho nabolset dingu ahi; kathu nit leu nang ho thujong anit dingu ahi.
English: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

tcz: Amahon keima jeh'a hiche ho jouse hi abolsoh diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon eisolpa ahet lou jeh'u ahi.
en: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
text:
JHN 15:21
Thadou: Amahon keima jeh'a hiche ho jouse hi abolsoh diu ahi, ajeh chu amahon eisolpa ahet lou jeh'u ahi.
English: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.

tcz: Keiman kana seidoh lou hile amaho hi themmo chang pouvinte. Ahinla tun amahon achonset nau jeh chun thuphat bolthei pouvinte.
en: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
text:
JHN 15:22
Thadou: Keiman kana seidoh lou hile amaho hi themmo chang pouvinte. Ahinla tun amahon achonset nau jeh chun thuphat bolthei pouvinte.
English: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

tcz: Koi hi jongleh keima eidoudal'a chun Kapa jong adoudal ding ahi.
en: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
text:
JHN 15:23
Thadou: Koi hi jongleh keima eidoudal'a chun Kapa jong adoudal ding ahi.
English: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

tcz: Keiman alah uva mi koima dangin abol khah lou thil kabol lou hile chonset aneilou dingu ahin; tuvang'in amahon keima le Ka-Pa kakop lhonin eimu tauvin, ho jong eihotauve.
en: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.
text:
JHN 15:24
Thadou: Keiman alah uva mi koima dangin abol khah lou thil kabol lou hile chonset aneilou dingu ahin; tuvang'in amahon keima le Ka-Pa kakop lhonin eimu tauvin, ho jong eihotauve.
English: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.

tcz: Hiche hin Pathen lekhabuho a kisei, “Amahon ajeh beiyin eidoudal ui” kiti chu aguilhunsah ahi.
en: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
text:
JHN 15:25
Thadou: Hiche hin Pathen lekhabuho a kisei, “Amahon ajeh beiyin eidoudal ui” kiti chu aguilhunsah ahi.
English: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

tcz: Amavang keiman thumopthem–thutah Lhagao, chu kahin solding ahi. Pa Pathen a kona hung ding ama chun keima thudol aphondoh ding ahi.
en: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
text:
JHN 15:26
Thadou: Amavang keiman thumopthem–thutah Lhagao, chu kahin solding ahi. Pa Pathen a kona hung ding ama chun keima thudol aphondoh ding ahi.
English: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

tcz: Chule nanghon jong atil'a pat kaumpi jing nahi jeh-uva chu kathu hettohsah a napan dingu ahi.
en: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
text:
JHN 15:27
Thadou: Chule nanghon jong atil'a pat kaumpi jing nahi jeh-uva chu kathu hettohsah a napan dingu ahi.
English: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.

tcz: Nakipal lhuh louna dinguva thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve.
en: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
text:
JHN 16:1
Thadou: Nakipal lhuh louna dinguva thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve.
English: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

tcz: Chuleh phat hung lhung ding ahi, kikhopna in'a kona nahin kaidoh dingu, chutengle koi hileh nathat uva pang hon athil bol'u chu Pathen'a dinga napha tonga kingaito dingu ahi.
en: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
text:
JHN 16:2
Thadou: Chuleh phat hung lhung ding ahi, kikhopna in'a kona nahin kaidoh dingu, chutengle koi hileh nathat uva pang hon athil bol'u chu Pathen'a dinga napha tonga kingaito dingu ahi.
English: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse hi ipi jeh ham itileh amahon Pa Pathen ahet lou jeh ule keima eihetthei lou jeh'u ahije.
en: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.
text:
JHN 16:3
Thadou: Hiche ho jouse hi ipi jeh ham itileh amahon Pa Pathen ahet lou jeh ule keima eihetthei lou jeh'u ahije.
English: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.

tcz: Ahinla hiti phat chu ahung lhun tengle keima tah'in kana seipehsa chengse hi nagel doh dinguva thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve. Chuleh keiman nangho jah'a kanasei masah lou na ajeh chu phat chomkhat kaumpi ding nahi jeh'u ahi.
en: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
text:
JHN 16:4
Thadou: Ahinla hiti phat chu ahung lhun tengle keima tah'in kana seipehsa chengse hi nagel doh dinguva thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve. Chuleh keiman nangho jah'a kanasei masah lou na ajeh chu phat chomkhat kaumpi ding nahi jeh'u ahi.
English: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

tcz: Ahinla tua keima eihin solpa henga kile kit ding kahitai, ahi nangho koima chan hoilam a che ding nahim tinjong neidong pouve.
en: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
text:
JHN 16:5
Thadou: Ahinla tua keima eihin solpa henga kile kit ding kahitai, ahi nangho koima chan hoilam a che ding nahim tinjong neidong pouve.
English: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

tcz: Ahin thu hicheng chu kasei jeh'in nalungu lunghem nan adimjotai.
en: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
text:
JHN 16:6
Thadou: Ahin thu hicheng chu kasei jeh'in nalungu lunghem nan adimjotai.
English: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

tcz: Ahinla tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, keima kapotdoh chu nangho dinga phatchomna joh ahi, ajehchu keima kaum laisea nangho kithopi ding chu hung theilou ding ahi. Ahin keima kapotdoh teng, Lhagao Theng chu nangho henga kahin sol ding ahi.
en: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
text:
JHN 16:7
Thadou: Ahinla tahbeh a kaseipeh nahiuve, keima kapotdoh chu nangho dinga phatchomna joh ahi, ajehchu keima kaum laisea nangho kithopi ding chu hung theilou ding ahi. Ahin keima kapotdoh teng, Lhagao Theng chu nangho henga kahin sol ding ahi.
English: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

tcz: Ama chu ahung tengleh, aman vannoi mite hi chonset thudol, chonphat thudol, chuleh thutan thudol'a ahetphotsah ding ahi.
en: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

tcz: Chonset thudol chu, ijeh ham itile amahon keima eitahsan pouve.
en: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;

tcz: Chonphat thenna ho hi chanthei ahi, ijeh inem itile keima Pa koma cheding kahi, chuleh nanghon nei mukhah lou diu ahitai.
en: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;

tcz: Chule tun thutanna ahung lhung tai ajeh chu vannoiya vaihompa hi athu tansa a uma ahitai.
en: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
text:
JHN 16:11
Thadou: Chule tun thutanna ahung lhung tai ajeh chu vannoiya vaihompa hi athu tansa a uma ahitai.
English: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

tcz: Chule keiman hiche ho tilouva thildang tamtah jong kaseipeh nom nahiuve, ahinla nanghon tua nathoh joulou diu ahi.
en: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
text:
JHN 16:12
Thadou: Chule keiman hiche ho tilouva thildang tamtah jong kaseipeh nom nahiuve, ahinla nanghon tua nathoh joulou diu ahi.
English: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

tcz: Lhagao dihtah chu ahung teng vangleh ama chun thutah lam jousea nangho napuihoi dingu ahi, ijeh inem itile aman achama aseilou ding, ajah chan asei dingbou ahi, chuleh khonung thusoh ding naseitoh peh dingu ahi.
en: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
text:
JHN 16:13
Thadou: Lhagao dihtah chu ahung teng vangleh ama chun thutah lam jousea nangho napuihoi dingu ahi, ijeh inem itile aman achama aseilou ding, ajah chan asei dingbou ahi, chuleh khonung thusoh ding naseitoh peh dingu ahi.
English: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

tcz: Chule ama chun keima eichoiat ding ahi, ajeh chu kanei chengse chu aman alah a nangho nahetsah dingu ahi.
en: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.
text:
JHN 16:14
Thadou: Chule ama chun keima eichoiat ding ahi, ajeh chu kanei chengse chu aman alah a nangho nahetsah dingu ahi.
English: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.

tcz: Pa a kona thil jouse chu keima a kona ahisoh keiye, hiche jeh a chu kaphon doh ahi; Lhagao Theng chun ana phondoh ho chu aboncha keiya kona alahson ahiye.
en: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.
text:
JHN 16:15
Thadou: Pa a kona thil jouse chu keima a kona ahisoh keiye, hiche jeh a chu kaphon doh ahi; Lhagao Theng chun ana phondoh ho chu aboncha keiya kona alahson ahiye.
English: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.

tcz: “Phat chomkhat joule nanghon neimu lou dingu ahitai; Ahinla phat chomkhat jouteng neimu kit dingu ahi,” ati.
en: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
text:
JHN 16:16
Thadou: “Phat chomkhat joule nanghon neimu lou dingu ahitai; Ahinla phat chomkhat jouteng neimu kit dingu ahi,” ati.
English: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”

tcz: Hichea chun aseijui ho khat le khat akihouvun, “Chom khat jou le neimu lou dingu, chuleh chom khat jou le neimu kit dingu, ijeh inem itile keima Pa henga che ding kahi, ati hi ipi aseina ahidem? akitiuve.
en: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
text:
JHN 16:17
Thadou: Hichea chun aseijui ho khat le khat akihouvun, “Chom khat jou le neimu lou dingu, chuleh chom khat jou le neimu kit dingu, ijeh inem itile keima Pa henga che ding kahi, ati hi ipi aseina ahidem? akitiuve.
English: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”

tcz: Chuleh phat chomkhat joule ati chu ipi aseina ham? Keihon kahe theipouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”
text:
JHN 16:18
Thadou: Chuleh phat chomkhat joule ati chu ipi aseina ham? Keihon kahe theipouve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”

tcz: Adoh nom'u chu Yeshuan ahen ajah uva, “Chomcha khat jou le neimu lou dingu, chomcha khat jou le neimu kit dingu, kati chu itidol ahi khat le khat kidongtoa nahiuvem?
en: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?
text:
JHN 16:19
Thadou: Adoh nom'u chu Yeshuan ahen ajah uva, “Chomcha khat jou le neimu lou dingu, chomcha khat jou le neimu kit dingu, kati chu itidol ahi khat le khat kidongtoa nahiuvem?
English: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?

tcz: Tahbeh a nangho keima chunga nalhiso diu chule nalungu kham ding ahi; Ahinla vannoi mite dinga kipana ahiye, ajeh chu nangho nalungu sangtah'a boiding, ahinla nalung kham nau chu hetman louva kipana thupitah hiding ahi.
en: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
text:
JHN 16:20
Thadou: Tahbeh a nangho keima chunga nalhiso diu chule nalungu kham ding ahi; Ahinla vannoi mite dinga kipana ahiye, ajeh chu nangho nalungu sangtah'a boiding, ahinla nalung kham nau chu hetman louva kipana thupitah hiding ahi.
English: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

tcz: Numei aso dinga anat tengle athoh gimlheh jin, acha chu asolhah teng vangleh vannoiya mihem khat apen jeh chun akipah jin ahile alungdon hesoh chu ahejitapoi.
en: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
text:
JHN 16:21
Thadou: Numei aso dinga anat tengle athoh gimlheh jin, acha chu asolhah teng vangleh vannoiya mihem khat apen jeh chun akipah jin ahile alungdon hesoh chu ahejitapoi.
English: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

tcz: Tua nangho nalunglhah dah nau hi, keima in nangho kahin vil kit tengle thanopna a nadim dingu, chuleh koima chan naguh mangpeh thei lou dingu ahitai.
en: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
text:
JHN 16:22
Thadou: Tua nangho nalunglhah dah nau hi, keima in nangho kahin vil kit tengle thanopna a nadim dingu, chuleh koima chan naguh mangpeh thei lou dingu ahitai.
English: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

tcz: Hiche teng chule nanghon keima imacha neidoh'u jong ngaita ponte, thutah chu ahile, Pa henga nathum jengthei'u ahitai; ajeh chu keima mina nathum jeh uva na ngaichat hou chu suhbulhit a um ding ahi.
en: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
text:
JHN 16:23
Thadou: Hiche teng chule nanghon keima imacha neidoh'u jong ngaita ponte, thutah chu ahile, Pa henga nathum jengthei'u ahitai; ajeh chu keima mina nathum jeh uva na ngaichat hou chu suhbulhit a um ding ahi.
English: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

tcz: Chule hiche hohi masanga nana bolkhah lou'u ahiye, Keima min in thum'un chuteng namu diu ahi, chutengle kipana sangtah'a nanei diu ahi.”
en: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
text:
JHN 16:24
Thadou: Chule hiche hohi masanga nana bolkhah lou'u ahiye, Keima min in thum'un chuteng namu diu ahi, chutengle kipana sangtah'a nanei diu ahi.”
English: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

tcz: “Keiman hiche ho jouse hi nangho jah'a alem a kasei ahi, ahin phat hung lhung ding chuteng chuleh keiman alema kasei tahlou ding ahi. Ahin Pathen ama hina tah'a kaphon doh ding ahi.
en: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
text:
JHN 16:25
Thadou: “Keiman hiche ho jouse hi nangho jah'a alem a kasei ahi, ahin phat hung lhung ding chuteng chuleh keiman alema kasei tahlou ding ahi. Ahin Pathen ama hina tah'a kaphon doh ding ahi.
English: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

tcz: Hiche nikho teng chuleh keima mina nathum dingu keima kanop tahlou ding ahi ajeh chu keima Pa henga nangho dinga taova kahi.
en: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,
text:
JHN 16:26
Thadou: Hiche nikho teng chuleh keima mina nathum dingu keima kanop tahlou ding ahi ajeh chu keima Pa henga nangho dinga taova kahi.
English: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,

tcz: Ijeh inem itile Pa amatah in nangho na-ngailuve, ijeh inem itile nanghon keima nei ngailuvin, chuleh keima Pa a kona hung kahi natahsan tauvin ahi.
en: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
text:
JHN 16:27
Thadou: Ijeh inem itile Pa amatah in nangho na-ngailuve, ijeh inem itile nanghon keima nei ngailuvin, chuleh keima Pa a kona hung kahi natahsan tauvin ahi.
English: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

tcz: Pa koma kona vannoiya hung kahin, vannoi kadalhah a Pa henga che kit ding kahi,” ati.
en: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”
text:
JHN 16:28
Thadou: Pa koma kona vannoiya hung kahin, vannoi kadalhah a Pa henga che kit ding kahi,” ati.
English: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”

tcz: Hichun aseijuiten adonbut'un, “Ven, tun nangin thu alem'a seita louvin phongtah in naseiye.”
en: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.
text:
JHN 16:29
Thadou: Hichun aseijuiten adonbut'un, “Ven, tun nangin thu alem'a seita louvin phongtah in naseiye.”
English: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.

tcz: “Tuhin keihon ima jouse kahe chen tauve; Nangman thil jouse nahesoh hel'in, hiche ho jeh'in keihon katahsan tauve; nangma Pathen a kona hung kondon nahi ti katahsan tauve.”
en: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
text:
JHN 16:30
Thadou: “Tuhin keihon ima jouse kahe chen tauve; Nangman thil jouse nahesoh hel'in, hiche ho jeh'in keihon katahsan tauve; nangma Pathen a kona hung kondon nahi ti katahsan tauve.”
English: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”

tcz: Yeshuan adong'in, “Achainakeiya neitahsan'u hitam?” ati.
en: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
text:
JHN 16:31
Thadou: Yeshuan adong'in, “Achainakeiya neitahsan'u hitam?” ati.
English: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?

tcz: “Veuvin, nangho nabonchauva nava cheh soh keiyuva keima kachanga neida lhah dingu phat ahung lhungtai, ahivangin keima kachang kahipoi; ijeh inem itile Pan keima ei umpinai.
en: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
text:
JHN 16:32
Thadou: “Veuvin, nangho nabonchauva nava cheh soh keiyuva keima kachanga neida lhah dingu phat ahung lhungtai, ahivangin keima kachang kahipoi; ijeh inem itile Pan keima ei umpinai.
English: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

tcz: Nanghon kachunga lungmon chamna nanei thei na dinguva thu hicheng hi kasei peh nahiuve, hiche leiset chunga hi nanghon thohgim hahsa tamtah nathoh diu ahiye, ahinla nalungu neosah hih'un, ajeh chu lungnom'un, keiman vannoi kajoutai,” ati.
en: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
text:
JHN 16:33
Thadou: Nanghon kachunga lungmon chamna nanei thei na dinguva thu hicheng hi kasei peh nahiuve, hiche leiset chunga hi nanghon thohgim hahsa tamtah nathoh diu ahiye, ahinla nalungu neosah hih'un, ajeh chu lungnom'un, keiman vannoi kajoutai,” ati.
English: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”

tcz: Yeshuan thu hicheng chu aseiyin, vanlam aven, “Pa naphat chu ahung lhunge; Chapan nangma na choiat thei na dingin na chapa choian in.
en: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

tcz: Ajeh chu nangman ama napeh ho jouse chu aboncha aman tonsot hinkemlou apeh dinga, nangman ama chu mi jouse chunga thuneina napeh ahi.
en: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
text:
JHN 17:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangman ama napeh ho jouse chu aboncha aman tonsot hinkemlou apeh dinga, nangman ama chu mi jouse chunga thuneina napeh ahi.
English: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

tcz: Pathen tahbeh khatseh nangman nasol Yeshua Christa tah chu ahet doh dingu, hiche hi tonsot hinna ahi.
en: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
text:
JHN 17:3
Thadou: Pathen tahbeh khatseh nangman nasol Yeshua Christa tah chu ahet doh dingu, hiche hi tonsot hinna ahi.
English: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

tcz: Chuleh nangman keima bol dinga neipeh chu kajouvin, chule leiset chunga nangma min ka choian tai.
en: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
text:
JHN 17:4
Thadou: Chuleh nangman keima bol dinga neipeh chu kajouvin, chule leiset chunga nangma min ka choian tai.
English: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

tcz: Chule tun, Pa vannoi leiset um masanga nangma toh ium laiya iloupina chun nangma tah toh kigomin nei choian in.
en: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
text:
JHN 17:5
Thadou: Chule tun, Pa vannoi leiset um masanga nangma toh ium laiya iloupina chun nangma tah toh kigomin nei choian in.
English: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

tcz: Vannoi leiset a neina peh ho chu keima in kahin tahlange. Amaho chu nangma a din aum jinguve, chule nangma in keima neipeh ahitan, amaho in nathu chu anit jing nauve.
en: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
text:
JHN 17:6
Thadou: Vannoi leiset a neina peh ho chu keima in kahin tahlange. Amaho chu nangma a din aum jinguve, chule nangma in keima neipeh ahitan, amaho in nathu chu anit jing nauve.
English: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

tcz: Tun amahon nangman keima neipeh thil chengse hi nanga kon ahi ahetauve.
en: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
text:
JHN 17:7
Thadou: Tun amahon nangman keima neipeh thil chengse hi nanga kon ahi ahetauve.
English: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun nangman keima neipeh thuho chu keiman amaho kapen, chule keima hi nanga hung kon kahi jong atahsan tauvin, chuleh nangman nei hin sol ahiti jong atahsan tauve.
en: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.
text:
JHN 17:8
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun nangman keima neipeh thuho chu keiman amaho kapen, chule keima hi nanga hung kon kahi jong atahsan tauvin, chuleh nangman nei hin sol ahiti jong atahsan tauve.
English: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.

tcz: Chuleh keima amaho dinga katao ahi, vannoi dinga katao ahipoi; Ahin nangman keima neipeh ho dinga bou katao ahi, Ijeh inem itile amaho nanga ahiuve.
en: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
text:
JHN 17:9
Thadou: Chuleh keima amaho dinga katao ahi, vannoi dinga katao ahipoi; Ahin nangman keima neipeh ho dinga bou katao ahi, Ijeh inem itile amaho nanga ahiuve.
English: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

tcz: Keima'a umjouse nanga ahi, chuleh nangma in keima neina peh ahitai. Ajeh chu amahon loupina eihin chansah'u ahi.
en: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
text:
JHN 17:10
Thadou: Keima'a umjouse nanga ahi, chuleh nangma in keima neina peh ahitai. Ajeh chu amahon loupina eihin chansah'u ahi.
English: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

tcz: Chuleh keima vannoiya hi kaumlou ding ahitai, amaho vang hi vannoiya aum nalaiyuve, chule keima nahenga hung ding kahitai. Ka Pa Theng, eini pumkhat ihi banga amaho jong pumkhat ahithei na dingun, nangman amaho hi vengtup'in.
en: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
text:
JHN 17:11
Thadou: Chuleh keima vannoiya hi kaumlou ding ahitai, amaho vang hi vannoiya aum nalaiyuve, chule keima nahenga hung ding kahitai. Ka Pa Theng, eini pumkhat ihi banga amaho jong pumkhat ahithei na dingun, nangman amaho hi vengtup'in.
English: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

tcz: Keima hikoma kaum sungin, amaho hi kana vengtup e. Amaho hi kaventup jal'in khat cha jong amangthah aumpouve, Pathen lekhabun anaseisa, manthahna lama chepa tailou chu.
en: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
text:
JHN 17:12
Thadou: Keima hikoma kaum sungin, amaho hi kana vengtup e. Amaho hi kaventup jal'in khat cha jong amangthah aumpouve, Pathen lekhabun anaseisa, manthahna lama chepa tailou chu.
English: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

tcz: Chuleh tua keima nangma koma hunga kahitai, chule keima leiya kaum laiya chu kipa thanopnaa adim jing thei na dinguva kana seipeh sohhel ahitai.
en: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
text:
JHN 17:13
Thadou: Chuleh tua keima nangma koma hunga kahitai, chule keima leiya kaum laiya chu kipa thanopnaa adim jing thei na dinguva kana seipeh sohhel ahitai.
English: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

tcz: Chuleh keiman nathu amaho kapetai; chule keima vannoiya kahilou banga amaho jong vannoiya ahilou jeh'un, vannoi miten ahotauve.
en: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
text:
JHN 17:14
Thadou: Chuleh keiman nathu amaho kapetai; chule keima vannoiya kahilou banga amaho jong vannoiya ahilou jeh'un, vannoi miten ahotauve.
English: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

tcz: Chule keiman kathum chu amaho hi vannoiya konin ladoh in tia katao ahipoi, agiloupa natoh na'a kon in huhdoh in katijoh ahibouve.
en: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
text:
JHN 17:15
Thadou: Chule keiman kathum chu amaho hi vannoiya konin ladoh in tia katao ahipoi, agiloupa natoh na'a kon in huhdoh in katijoh ahibouve.
English: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

tcz: Keima vannoiya kona kahilou banga, amaho jong vannoiya kon ahipouve.
en: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
text:
JHN 17:16
Thadou: Keima vannoiya kona kahilou banga, amaho jong vannoiya kon ahipouve.
English: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

tcz: Chule nathutah chun amaho jouse hi sutheng in ajeh chu nangma thuhi thutah ahiye.
en: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
text:
JHN 17:17
Thadou: Chule nathutah chun amaho jouse hi sutheng in ajeh chu nangma thuhi thutah ahiye.
English: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

tcz: Nangman keima vannoiya neina sol banga chu keiman amaho hi vannoiya kasol ahi.
en: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
text:
JHN 17:18
Thadou: Nangman keima vannoiya neina sol banga chu keiman amaho hi vannoiya kasol ahi.
English: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

tcz: Chule amaho jouse hi thutah'a suhthenga aum thei na dinguva amaho jal'a keima kisuthenga kahi. Yeshuan tahsan chate jouse dia taona anei
en: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
text:
JHN 17:19
Thadou: Chule amaho jouse hi thutah'a suhthenga aum thei na dinguva amaho jal'a keima kisuthenga kahi. Yeshuan tahsan chate jouse dia taona anei
English: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

tcz: Keima seijui ho ding seh'a tao kahipoi, amaho thusei'a kona keima eitahsan ho jouse dinga jong taova kahi.
en: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,
text:
JHN 17:20
Thadou: Keima seijui ho ding seh'a tao kahipoi, amaho thusei'a kona keima eitahsan ho jouse dinga jong taova kahi.
English: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

tcz: Chule amaho chu pumkhat ahina dinguva, Pa, keima nangma sol kahi hi vannoi miten atahsan thei na dinguva nangma keiya nauma keima nanga kaum banga hi, amaho jong einia aum theina dinga katao ahi.
en: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
text:
JHN 17:21
Thadou: Chule amaho chu pumkhat ahina dinguva, Pa, keima nangma sol kahi hi vannoi miten atahsan thei na dinguva nangma keiya nauma keima nanga kaum banga hi, amaho jong einia aum theina dinga katao ahi.
English: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

tcz: Keiman amaho chu loupina nangman neipeh ho chu kapetai, amaho eini banga pumkhat ahitheina dingu ahi.
en: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,
text:
JHN 17:22
Thadou: Keiman amaho chu loupina nangman neipeh ho chu kapetai, amaho eini banga pumkhat ahitheina dingu ahi.
English: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,

tcz: Keima amahoa kauma chule nangma keiya naum, abon'a khat a chamkim soh ahi. Chuteng vannoiyin keima neisol ahi ahetdiu chule keima nei ngailut banga hi amaho jong nangailut ahidan ahetthem diu ahi.
en: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.
text:
JHN 17:23
Thadou: Keima amahoa kauma chule nangma keiya naum, abon'a khat a chamkim soh ahi. Chuteng vannoiyin keima neisol ahi ahetdiu chule keima nei ngailut banga hi amaho jong nangailut ahidan ahetthem diu ahi.
English: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.

tcz: Hepa nangman neipeh loupina chu nangin neipeh ho hin amuthei na dingun, keima umna'a chun kakoma amaho jong umleu kati ahi; chule vannoi bul kiphu masanga nangman neingailut ahijeh chun.
en: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
text:
JHN 17:24
Thadou: Hepa nangman neipeh loupina chu nangin neipeh ho hin amuthei na dingun, keima umna'a chun kakoma amaho jong umleu kati ahi; chule vannoi bul kiphu masanga nangman neingailut ahijeh chun.
English: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

tcz: Vo Kapa Theng vannoi leiset miten nangma nahethem theipouve, ahinla keiman nangma kahen, chule keima neisol hi seijui ho hin ahetauve.
en: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
text:
JHN 17:25
Thadou: Vo Kapa Theng vannoi leiset miten nangma nahethem theipouve, ahinla keiman nangma kahen, chule keima neisol hi seijui ho hin ahetauve.
