English: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

tcz: Keiman nangma hi amaho lah'a katah lang nahitai, chule keiman hiti a chu katah lang jing ding nahi; hiche teng chule keima nei ngailut naho chu amaho'a umding chuteng keima jong amaho a ka umjing ding ahi.”
en: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
text:
JHN 17:26
Thadou: Keiman nangma hi amaho lah'a katah lang nahitai, chule keiman hiti a chu katah lang jing ding nahi; hiche teng chule keima nei ngailut naho chu amaho'a umding chuteng keima jong amaho a ka umjing ding ahi.”
English: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”

tcz: Yeshuan thu hicheng chu aseiyin apotdoh in Kidron vagal a hon umna'a chun aseijui hotoh agalkaiyun, chuin hon sunga chun amale aseijuiho aluttauve.
en: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.
text:
JHN 18:1
Thadou: Yeshuan thu hicheng chu aseiyin apotdoh in Kidron vagal a hon umna'a chun aseijui hotoh agalkaiyun, chuin hon sunga chun amale aseijuiho aluttauve.
English: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

tcz: Yeshua pedoh a pang Judas jong chun hilai mun chu ahet chen mama ahi, Ijeh inem itile Pakai Yeshuan aseijuite chu phat seh a ana pui jing ahi.
en: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
text:
JHN 18:2
Thadou: Yeshua pedoh a pang Judas jong chun hilai mun chu ahet chen mama ahi, Ijeh inem itile Pakai Yeshuan aseijuite chu phat seh a ana pui jing ahi.
English: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

tcz: Chutah in Judas chun sepaihon chule thempu pipui ho le Pharisee hoa kona sottolle ho aloiyin, meivah, meisel, chuleh hem manchah athouvin hiche kom mun chu ahung lhung tauve.
en: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
text:
JHN 18:3
Thadou: Chutah in Judas chun sepaihon chule thempu pipui ho le Pharisee hoa kona sottolle ho aloiyin, meivah, meisel, chuleh hem manchah athouvin hiche kom mun chu ahung lhung tauve.
English: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

tcz: Yeshuan achunga thil hunglhung ho jouse chu ahesoh keiyin ahi, hichun amaho kom lang chu ajonphei in adongtai, “Koi nahol'u ham?” ati.
en: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”
text:
JHN 18:4
Thadou: Yeshuan achunga thil hunglhung ho jouse chu ahesoh keiyin ahi, hichun amaho kom lang chu ajonphei in adongtai, “Koi nahol'u ham?” ati.
English: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”

tcz: Amahon adonbut'un, “Nazareth khoa kona hungkon Yeshua chu kahol'u ahi,” atiuvin ahi. Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Ama chu kahi,” ati. (Judas, apedoh a pangpa chu, amaho lah'a chu dinga ahi).
en: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
text:
JHN 18:5
Thadou: Amahon adonbut'un, “Nazareth khoa kona hungkon Yeshua chu kahol'u ahi,” atiuvin ahi. Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Ama chu kahi,” ati. (Judas, apedoh a pangpa chu, amaho lah'a chu dinga ahi).
English: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

tcz: Yeshuan, “Keima hi kahi,” ati chun amaho jouse chu anung chon'un tol'a alhu jengun ahi.
en: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.
text:
JHN 18:6
Thadou: Yeshuan, “Keima hi kahi,” ati chun amaho jouse chu anung chon'un tol'a alhu jengun ahi.
English: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.

tcz: Hichun avel'in adongkit in, “Nanghon koi nahol'u ham?” ati. Chuin amahon adonbut'un, “Nazareth khoa kona hung Yeshua chu kahol'u ahi,” atiuve.
en: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
text:
JHN 18:7
Thadou: Hichun avel'in adongkit in, “Nanghon koi nahol'u ham?” ati. Chuin amahon adonbut'un, “Nazareth khoa kona hung Yeshua chu kahol'u ahi,” atiuve.
English: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman kaseipeh nahiuve, amapa chu keima hi kahi, keima neihol'u ahijeh chun midang hohi soldoh tauvin,” ati.
en: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”
text:
JHN 18:8
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman kaseipeh nahiuve, amapa chu keima hi kahi, keima neihol'u ahijeh chun midang hohi soldoh tauvin,” ati.
English: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”

tcz: Nangman keima neipeh chengse chu khatcha jong kaman sahpoi, tia asei chu guilhunna dinga chutia ahi.
en: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”
text:
JHN 18:9
Thadou: Nangman keima neipeh chengse chu khatcha jong kaman sahpoi, tia asei chu guilhunna dinga chutia ahi.
English: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

tcz: Hichun Simon Peter in achemjam asatdoh in thempu chungnung sohpa asatle ajetlam abilkol asatlha tai, sohpa min chu Malchus ahi.
en: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
text:
JHN 18:10
Thadou: Hichun Simon Peter in achemjam asatdoh in thempu chungnung sohpa asatle ajetlam abilkol asatlha tai, sohpa min chu Malchus ahi.
English: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

tcz: Ahinla Yeshuan Peter jah'a, “Nachemjam chu apai sunga koilut kit'in, Pan eipeh gentheina khon chu donlouva ka um ding ham,” ati.
en: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”
text:
JHN 18:11
Thadou: Ahinla Yeshuan Peter jah'a, “Nachemjam chu apai sunga koilut kit'in, Pan eipeh gentheina khon chu donlouva ka um ding ham,” ati.
English: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”

tcz: Hichun sepai ho le apipui pau toh chuleh Juda ho sottolle hon Yeshua chu aman un akan tauvin ahi.
en: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,
text:
JHN 18:12
Thadou: Hichun sepai ho le apipui pau toh chuleh Juda ho sottolle hon Yeshua chu aman un akan tauvin ahi.
English: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,

tcz: Annas henga apui masauve; Ijeh inem itile ama chu chuche kuma chu Thempu chungnung pen'a pang Caiaphas nupa pa ahi.
en: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
text:
JHN 18:13
Thadou: Annas henga apui masauve; Ijeh inem itile ama chu chuche kuma chu Thempu chungnung pen'a pang Caiaphas nupa pa ahi.
English: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

tcz: Hiche Caiaphas hi ahi, “Miho jouse dinga mikhat athi aphajoi,” tia Juda ho ana thumop chu. Peter in Yeshua aseilep
en: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
text:
JHN 18:14
Thadou: Hiche Caiaphas hi ahi, “Miho jouse dinga mikhat athi aphajoi,” tia Juda ho ana thumop chu. Peter in Yeshua aseilep
English: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

tcz: Simon Peter chun, seijui dangho bangin, Yeshua chu anung ajui tan ahi. Seijui holah a khat chu Thempu pipui hotoh ana kihet jeh chun Thempu pipu pa umna gei chu Yeshua toh ana lutsah un ahi.
en: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

tcz: Ahin Peter vang chu polanga phat chomkhat aumin, hichun seijui holah a khat thempu pipuipa toh kihe pa chun kelkot ngah a pang numeinu koma phalna athumin hichun Peter insunga apuilut tai.
en: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.
text:
JHN 18:16
Thadou: Ahin Peter vang chu polanga phat chomkhat aumin, hichun seijui holah a khat thempu pipuipa toh kihe pa chun kelkot ngah a pang numeinu koma phalna athumin hichun Peter insunga apuilut tai.
English: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

tcz: Hiche numeinu chun Peter chu thudoh aneiyin, “Nangma hi hiche pa seijui ho khat nahi lou ham? Nangma nahi,” ati. Ahin Peter in adonbut'in, “Kahipoi,” ati.
en: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
text:
JHN 18:17
Thadou: Hiche numeinu chun Peter chu thudoh aneiyin, “Nangma hi hiche pa seijui ho khat nahi lou ham? Nangma nahi,” ati. Ahin Peter in adonbut'in, “Kahipoi,” ati.
English: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”

tcz: Hiche koma chu soh hole sottol le hon adapjeh'a mei akitiuva dinmuna mei aoiyu ahin, Peter jong adingin meichu aoiyin ahi.
en: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.
text:
JHN 18:18
Thadou: Hiche koma chu soh hole sottol le hon adapjeh'a mei akitiuva dinmuna mei aoiyu ahin, Peter jong adingin meichu aoiyin ahi.
English: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

tcz: Hikom insung langa chun Thempupan Yeshua chu thudoh anei'in, anungjui ho ipi ana seipeh'a chuleh ipi ana hilchah em tichu adongtan ahi.
en: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
text:
JHN 18:19
Thadou: Hikom insung langa chun Thempupan Yeshua chu thudoh anei'in, anungjui ho ipi ana seipeh'a chuleh ipi ana hilchah em tichu adongtan ahi.
English: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Mipihon ahesoh keiye ipi kana hilchah, chule Houin a jong aphat jouse in mipi ho koma kana seipeh jinge, guhthima kana seipeh imacha aumpoi.
en: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
text:
JHN 18:20
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Mipihon ahesoh keiye ipi kana hilchah, chule Houin a jong aphat jouse in mipi ho koma kana seipeh jinge, guhthima kana seipeh imacha aumpoi.
English: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

tcz: Ibol'a nangman hiche thudoh hohi neidoh ham? kathusei ngai ho le jaho chu nadoh thei lou ham? Ajeh chu amahon kathu hil jouse chu ahesohkei uve,” ati.
en: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”
text:
JHN 18:21
Thadou: Ibol'a nangman hiche thudoh hohi neidoh ham? kathusei ngai ho le jaho chu nadoh thei lou ham? Ajeh chu amahon kathu hil jouse chu ahesohkei uve,” ati.
English: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan thu hicheng chu aseiyin ahile akoma Santri dingho lah'a khat in Yeshua ngeiphe abengin, “Thempu chungnung hitia chu kidonbut ngaiyem?” ati.
en: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”
text:
JHN 18:22
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan thu hicheng chu aseiyin ahile akoma Santri dingho lah'a khat in Yeshua ngeiphe abengin, “Thempu chungnung hitia chu kidonbut ngaiyem?” ati.
English: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman kasei khel aumle neimu sah'un, ahinla thutah kasei doh jeh'a chu ibol'a neivoh uham?” ati.
en: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”
text:
JHN 18:23
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keiman kasei khel aumle neimu sah'un, ahinla thutah kasei doh jeh'a chu ibol'a neivoh uham?” ati.
English: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”

tcz: Hichun Annas chun Yeshua chu ahentup'in Caiaphas Thempu chungnung heng lama asoltai.
en: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.
text:
JHN 18:24
Thadou: Hichun Annas chun Yeshua chu ahentup'in Caiaphas Thempu chungnung heng lama asoltai.
English: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

tcz: Hiche phat dontah a chu Simon Peter chun dap asah jeh'a mei aki oi ahin, amahon adongkit'un, “Nangma hi amaho lah'a khat chu nahilou ham?” atiuve. Ahin Peter in adonbut'in, “Keima kahipoi,” ati.
en: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
text:
JHN 18:25
Thadou: Hiche phat dontah a chu Simon Peter chun dap asah jeh'a mei aki oi ahin, amahon adongkit'un, “Nangma hi amaho lah'a khat chu nahilou ham?” atiuve. Ahin Peter in adonbut'in, “Keima kahipoi,” ati.
English: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

tcz: Ahinla Thempu chungnung sohpa Simon Peter in abilkol asatlhah pehpa inko khat'in ajah'a, “Keiman Hon a chu nangma amato kamu nahi lou ham?” atin ahi.
en: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
text:
JHN 18:26
Thadou: Ahinla Thempu chungnung sohpa Simon Peter in abilkol asatlhah pehpa inko khat'in ajah'a, “Keiman Hon a chu nangma amato kamu nahi lou ham?” atin ahi.
English: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”

tcz: Hichun avel'in Peter in aseilep kit in, chule hetman louvin Ahchal akhong tai.
en: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.
text:
JHN 18:27
Thadou: Hichun avel'in Peter in aseilep kit in, chule hetman louvin Ahchal akhong tai.
English: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

tcz: Chutah chun amahon Caiaphas in a konin gamvaipo pa inlama Yeshua akaitauve; hichu jingkah ahina laiye; ahivangin kal chuh kut an aneh thei na dingun, akisuhboh louna dingun gamvaipo inpia chun amaho alutpouve.
en: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
text:
JHN 18:28
Thadou: Chutah chun amahon Caiaphas in a konin gamvaipo pa inlama Yeshua akaitauve; hichu jingkah ahina laiye; ahivangin kal chuh kut an aneh thei na dingun, akisuhboh louna dingun gamvaipo inpia chun amaho alutpouve.
English: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

tcz: Hichun Pilate apotdoh in, amaho chu aga kimupin thudoh anei'in, “Hiche pa hin ipi abolkhel atoh khel um hitam?” ati.
en: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
text:
JHN 18:29
Thadou: Hichun Pilate apotdoh in, amaho chu aga kimupin thudoh anei'in, “Hiche pa hin ipi abolkhel atoh khel um hitam?” ati.
English: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”

tcz: Hichun amahon adonbut'un, “Amapa khang-gilou ahilouleh nangma koma kahin lhut lou dingu ahi,” atiuve.
en: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”
text:
JHN 18:30
Thadou: Hichun amahon adonbut'un, “Amapa khang-gilou ahilouleh nangma koma kahin lhut lou dingu ahi,” atiuve.
English: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”

tcz: Hichun Pilate in adonbut'in, “Hiche chu ahitah le, nanghon nungpui tauvin, chuleh nangho dan dungjui in kitan lhah tauvin,” ati. Hiche phat chun Judah hon adonbut'un, “Keima ho Danthu dungjui'in koima thana ding tha kanei pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”
text:
JHN 18:31
Thadou: Hichun Pilate in adonbut'in, “Hiche chu ahitah le, nanghon nungpui tauvin, chuleh nangho dan dungjui in kitan lhah tauvin,” ati. Hiche phat chun Judah hon adonbut'un, “Keima ho Danthu dungjui'in koima thana ding tha kanei pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”

tcz: (Hiche hin avetsah chu, Yeshuan athiding dan ana seidoh masah chu guilhunna ahi).
en: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
text:
JHN 18:32
Thadou: (Hiche hin avetsah chu, Yeshuan athiding dan ana seidoh masah chu guilhunna ahi).
English: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

tcz: Hichun Pilate insung dan'ah alut'in, Yeshua chu akouvin, thudoh aneiyin, “Nangma Judate lengpa chu nahim?” ati.
en: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
text:
JHN 18:33
Thadou: Hichun Pilate insung dan'ah alut'in, Yeshua chu akouvin, thudoh aneiyin, “Nangma Judate lengpa chu nahim?” ati.
English: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Hiche thudoh ho hi nangma chama kon ham, ahiloule mi khat tou'in keima chung chang nasei peh ham?” ati.
en: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”
text:
JHN 18:34
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Hiche thudoh ho hi nangma chama kon ham, ahiloule mi khat tou'in keima chung chang nasei peh ham?” ati.
English: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”

tcz: Hichun Pilate in adonbut kit'in, “Keihi Juda mi kahi ham? Namite le thempu pipuihon kakhut'a eipeh nahi chu, ipi nabolsetba ham?” ati.
en: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”
text:
JHN 18:35
Thadou: Hichun Pilate in adonbut kit'in, “Keihi Juda mi kahi ham? Namite le thempu pipuihon kakhut'a eipeh nahi chu, ipi nabolsetba ham?” ati.
English: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima lenggam hi hiche vannoi a kon ahipoi. Hiche vannoi a kon ana hitaleh keima dingin kaseijui hon gal eisat peh intin, Judate khut'a peh doh'a kaum lou ding ahi. Ahinla keima lenggam hi hiche vannoi a kon ahipoi,” ati.
en: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”
text:
JHN 18:36
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima lenggam hi hiche vannoi a kon ahipoi. Hiche vannoi a kon ana hitaleh keima dingin kaseijui hon gal eisat peh intin, Judate khut'a peh doh'a kaum lou ding ahi. Ahinla keima lenggam hi hiche vannoi a kon ahipoi,” ati.
English: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”

tcz: Hichun Pilate in aseikit'in, “Ahileh nangma hi lengpa nahim?” atile Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Leng kahi chu nasei khai, Thutah thu hettohsah dinga hung penga, hiche dinga hi vannoiya hunga kahi. Thutah hechan chun thutah ahinphot chen diu ahi” ati.
en: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”
text:
JHN 18:37
Thadou: Hichun Pilate in aseikit'in, “Ahileh nangma hi lengpa nahim?” atile Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Leng kahi chu nasei khai, Thutah thu hettohsah dinga hung penga, hiche dinga hi vannoiya hunga kahi. Thutah hechan chun thutah ahinphot chen diu ahi” ati.
English: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”

tcz: Hichun Pilate in adonbut in, “Thutah chu ipi ham?” Hichun Pilate chu Juda mipi holah'a aga potdoh kit'in, ajah'uva aseitai, “Yeshua hi themmo na neilou ahi, ati. Yeshua tha dia alhuh sah'u
en: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.
text:
JHN 18:38
Thadou: Hichun Pilate in adonbut in, “Thutah chu ipi ham?” Hichun Pilate chu Juda mipi holah'a aga potdoh kit'in, ajah'uva aseitai, “Yeshua hi themmo na neilou ahi, ati. Yeshua tha dia alhuh sah'u
English: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.

tcz: Ahivangin nanghon kalchuh kut le mikhat nakilha doh peh dingu chonna ngai khat naneiyui; hijeh chun Juda lengpa hi lhadoh peh leu veng nalungu ham?” ati.
en: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
text:
JHN 18:39
Thadou: Ahivangin nanghon kalchuh kut le mikhat nakilha doh peh dingu chonna ngai khat naneiyui; hijeh chun Juda lengpa hi lhadoh peh leu veng nalungu ham?” ati.
English: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

tcz: Ahinla amahon asam'un, “Hiche pa hi hida hen, Barabbas joh,” atin asamtauve. (Barabbas chu doudal natong ahi).
en: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
text:
JHN 18:40
Thadou: Ahinla amahon asam'un, “Hiche pa hi hida hen, Barabbas joh,” atin asamtauve. (Barabbas chu doudal natong ahi).
English: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.

tcz: Hichun Pilate in Yeshua chu mol'a jep dingin apedoh tai.
en: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.
text:
JHN 19:1
Thadou: Hichun Pilate in Yeshua chu mol'a jep dingin apedoh tai.
English: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.

tcz: Chuin sepai hon ling lukhuh apheh'un, Pakai chu akhuh peh tauvin ahi. Chuleh amahon ponsandup asilpeh un ahi.
en: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
text:
JHN 19:2
Thadou: Chuin sepai hon ling lukhuh apheh'un, Pakai chu akhuh peh tauvin ahi. Chuleh amahon ponsandup asilpeh un ahi.
English: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

tcz: Chuin akoma ahungun, “Judate lengpa chibai,” atiuvin, totnopnan aneiyun chuleh abengphe abeh peh'un ahi.
en: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.
text:
JHN 19:3
Thadou: Chuin akoma ahungun, “Judate lengpa chibai,” atiuvin, totnopnan aneiyun chuleh abengphe abeh peh'un ahi.
English: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.

tcz: Chuin Pilate agapot kit'in, ajah uva, “Veuvin akhan gitlouna ima kamu lou nahetna dinguva ama naheng uva kahin puidoh ahi,” ati.
en: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
text:
JHN 19:4
Thadou: Chuin Pilate agapot kit'in, ajah uva, “Veuvin akhan gitlouna ima kamu lou nahetna dinguva ama naheng uva kahin puidoh ahi,” ati.
English: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshua chu ling lukhuh khuh le ponsandup kisil pum chun ahung potdoh'in, chuin Pilate in ajah uva, “Veuvin hiche mipa hi!” ati.
en: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
text:
JHN 19:5
Thadou: Hichun Yeshua chu ling lukhuh khuh le ponsandup kisil pum chun ahung potdoh'in, chuin Pilate in ajah uva, “Veuvin hiche mipa hi!” ati.
English: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”

tcz: Hichun thempu pipui hole Houin ngah'a pang sepai hon ama chu amuphat un, “Thingpel'a khenbeh-in, thingpel'a khenbeh-in,” tin asamtauve. Ahin Pilate in adonbut'in, “Nanghon natahsa tah in kai unlang thingpel'a khenbeh tauvin, keiman vang Yeshua hi amona kamu dohpoi,” ati.
en: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”
text:
JHN 19:6
Thadou: Hichun thempu pipui hole Houin ngah'a pang sepai hon ama chu amuphat un, “Thingpel'a khenbeh-in, thingpel'a khenbeh-in,” tin asamtauve. Ahin Pilate in adonbut'in, “Nanghon natahsa tah in kai unlang thingpel'a khenbeh tauvin, keiman vang Yeshua hi amona kamu dohpoi,” ati.
English: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”

tcz: Judate lamkai hon adonbut uvin, “Keiho danpi dungjui'a ama hi athi dinga lomtah ahi, ijeh inem itile ama tah Pathen Chapa akihisah jeh chun,” atiuve.
en: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”
text:
JHN 19:7
Thadou: Judate lamkai hon adonbut uvin, “Keiho danpi dungjui'a ama hi athi dinga lomtah ahi, ijeh inem itile ama tah Pathen Chapa akihisah jeh chun,” atiuve.
English: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

tcz: Hichun Pilate in hiche thu ajah phat'in, atil'a sangin akicha cheh tan;
en: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

tcz: Hichun Pilate chu inpi sunga alut kit'in Yeshua jah'a, “Nangma hoiya hung kon nahim?” ati. Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut pon ahi.
en: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.
text:
JHN 19:9
Thadou: Hichun Pilate chu inpi sunga alut kit'in Yeshua jah'a, “Nangma hoiya hung kon nahim?” ati. Ahivangin Yeshuan adonbut pon ahi.
English: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pilate in ajah'a, “Nei houpi lou ding ham? Nangma lhadoh na ding jong chuleh thingpel a khetbeh na ding jong thu kanei hi nahet lou ham?” ati.
en: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”
text:
JHN 19:10
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pilate in ajah'a, “Nei houpi lou ding ham? Nangma lhadoh na ding jong chuleh thingpel a khetbeh na ding jong thu kanei hi nahet lou ham?” ati.
English: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan aseitai, “Nangman keima chunga imacha tha nanei nading aumpoi, amavang chunglam akon tilou'in, ati. Hiti ahijeh a chu keima eipeh doh'a pangpa chonset na achungnungpen e,” ati.
en: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
text:
JHN 19:11
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan aseitai, “Nangman keima chunga imacha tha nanei nading aumpoi, amavang chunglam akon tilou'in, ati. Hiti ahijeh a chu keima eipeh doh'a pangpa chonset na achungnungpen e,” ati.
English: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”

tcz: Hichun Pilate in Yeshua chu lha doh dingin agongtan, ahinla Judah hon asam uvin, “Nangman hichepa hi nalha doh leh Caesar jol nahilou ahi; ama lenga kisem chan chu Caesar douna'a thusei ahi,” atiuve.
en: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”
text:
JHN 19:12
Thadou: Hichun Pilate in Yeshua chu lha doh dingin agongtan, ahinla Judah hon asam uvin, “Nangman hichepa hi nalha doh leh Caesar jol nahilou ahi; ama lenga kisem chan chu Caesar douna'a thusei ahi,” atiuve.
English: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”

tcz: Pilate in thu chucheng ajah phat chun Yeshua chu ahin puidoh in; chuin Pilate chu song lhongnal atiu (Hebrew paova Gabbatha) hichu thutanna'a touna, chunga chun atoutan ahi.
en: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”
text:
JHN 19:13
Thadou: Pilate in thu chucheng ajah phat chun Yeshua chu ahin puidoh in; chuin Pilate chu song lhongnal atiu (Hebrew paova Gabbatha) hichu thutanna'a touna, chunga chun atoutan ahi.
English: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

tcz: Hichu kalchuh kut dinga kigot ni, nidan gup dontah ahi; chuin Juda ho jah'a, “Veuvin na lengpau hi!” ati.
en: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
text:
JHN 19:14
Thadou: Hichu kalchuh kut dinga kigot ni, nidan gup dontah ahi; chuin Juda ho jah'a, “Veuvin na lengpau hi!” ati.
English: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

tcz: Hijeh chun amaho a-aosot jengun, “Sumangin, sumangin, thingpel'ah khenbeh-in!” atiuvin ahileh, Pilate in ajah'uva, “Nalengpau thingpel'a kakhet beh ding ham?” atileh; thempu pipuihon adonbut'un, “Keihon Caesar tailou leng dang kanei pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”
text:
JHN 19:15
Thadou: Hijeh chun amaho a-aosot jengun, “Sumangin, sumangin, thingpel'ah khenbeh-in!” atiuvin ahileh, Pilate in ajah'uva, “Nalengpau thingpel'a kakhet beh ding ham?” atileh; thempu pipuihon adonbut'un, “Keihon Caesar tailou leng dang kanei pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”

tcz: Hichun Pilate in Yeshua khetbeh na dingin amaho koma ape dohtai, Hichun Judaten Yeshua chu apuidoh tauvin ahi.
en: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.
text:
JHN 19:16
Thadou: Hichun Pilate in Yeshua khetbeh na dingin amaho koma ape dohtai, Hichun Judaten Yeshua chu apuidoh tauvin ahi.
English: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

tcz: Hichun amahon Yeshua chu akai'un, chuin a thingpel akiput'in Lugu mun (Hebrew paova Golgotha) atiu mun chu jonin achetan ahi.
en: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,
text:
JHN 19:17
Thadou: Hichun amahon Yeshua chu akai'un, chuin a thingpel akiput'in Lugu mun (Hebrew paova Golgotha) atiu mun chu jonin achetan ahi.
English: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

tcz: Chuleh hiche mun'a chun Pakai Yeshua chu thingpel chung'ah akhenbeh tauvin ahi, chuleh midang pasal ni jong asih langto gel'a amatoh akhetbeh thau vin, Yeshua chu amani lai tah a akikhenbeh in ahi.
en: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.
text:
JHN 19:18
Thadou: Chuleh hiche mun'a chun Pakai Yeshua chu thingpel chung'ah akhenbeh tauvin ahi, chuleh midang pasal ni jong asih langto gel'a amatoh akhetbeh thau vin, Yeshua chu amani lai tah a akikhenbeh in ahi.
English: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

tcz: Chuin Pilate in thingpel chunga simdoh ding atah in hichu, “Nazareth Yeshua, Judate lengpa,” tin atah doh in ahi.
en: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
text:
JHN 19:19
Thadou: Chuin Pilate in thingpel chunga simdoh ding atah in hichu, “Nazareth Yeshua, Judate lengpa,” tin atah doh in ahi.
English: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

tcz: Chuleh Yeshua akhetbeh na mun chu khopi nai ahijeh chun, hiche min chu Juda ho tamtah-in asimun; hichu Hebrew pao, Latin pao, chuleh Greek paova kisun ahi.
en: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
text:
JHN 19:20
Thadou: Chuleh Yeshua akhetbeh na mun chu khopi nai ahijeh chun, hiche min chu Juda ho tamtah-in asimun; hichu Hebrew pao, Latin pao, chuleh Greek paova kisun ahi.
English: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

tcz: Hichun thempu pipuihon Pilate henga alungkim lounau aga lhut'un, Hiche kheldoh na dingin, “Judate lengpa” khel'a “Aman aseijin, ‘keima hi Judate lengpa kahi,’” tijoh a khel dingin aseitauve.
en: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”
text:
JHN 19:21
Thadou: Hichun thempu pipuihon Pilate henga alungkim lounau aga lhut'un, Hiche kheldoh na dingin, “Judate lengpa” khel'a “Aman aseijin, ‘keima hi Judate lengpa kahi,’” tijoh a khel dingin aseitauve.
English: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”

tcz: Ahin Pilate in adonbut'in, “Hithei ponte, ajeh chu keiman kana jihdoh sa chu kajih doh ahitai,” ati.
en: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
text:
JHN 19:22
Thadou: Ahin Pilate in adonbut'in, “Hithei ponte, ajeh chu keiman kana jihdoh sa chu kajih doh ahitai,” ati.
English: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

tcz: Chule Rome sepai hon Yeshua akhetbeh uchun, aponsil alauvin, hal li asouvin sepai khat hal khat cheh in achang'un; chule asangkhol jong chu alauvin; asangkhol chu khuilou ahin, alua pat ato geiya kikhong lhungkei ahi.
en: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
text:
JHN 19:23
Thadou: Chule Rome sepai hon Yeshua akhetbeh uchun, aponsil alauvin, hal li asouvin sepai khat hal khat cheh in achang'un; chule asangkhol jong chu alauvin; asangkhol chu khuilou ahin, alua pat ato geiya kikhong lhungkei ahi.
English: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

tcz: Hichun amahon aseiyun, “Atel tel'a bokeh sangin leh sangu hitin, vang vetaote, koi chang ding ham” atiuve; Hiche hi Pathen thua kijih guilhun na dinga kisei chu ahi. Hichun amahon von chu alehsang un vangvet nan aneiyun, hitichun anabol'un ahi.
en: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.
text:
JHN 19:24
Thadou: Hichun amahon aseiyun, “Atel tel'a bokeh sangin leh sangu hitin, vang vetaote, koi chang ding ham” atiuve; Hiche hi Pathen thua kijih guilhun na dinga kisei chu ahi. Hichun amahon von chu alehsang un vangvet nan aneiyun, hitichun anabol'un ahi.
English: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.

tcz: Hiche jeh chun sepai hon hiti chun hicheng chu aboltauve, Ahin Yeshua thingpel koma chun anutoh, anu sopinu Mary (Clopas Inneipi) toh, Mary Magdalene ading jingun ahi.
en: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
text:
JHN 19:25
Thadou: Hiche jeh chun sepai hon hiti chun hicheng chu aboltauve, Ahin Yeshua thingpel koma chun anutoh, anu sopinu Mary (Clopas Inneipi) toh, Mary Magdalene ading jingun ahi.
English: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan anu le angailut aseijui chu akom'a adin amu phat'in anu jah'a, “Numei ven nachapa chu,” ati.
en: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”
text:
JHN 19:26
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan anu le angailut aseijui chu akom'a adin amu phat'in anu jah'a, “Numei ven nachapa chu,” ati.
English: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan hiche aseijui pa jah'a aseijin, “Hiche hi nanu ahi,” atin hichun hiche aseijui pa chun Yeshua nu Mariam chu a-inlam'a apui tan ahi.
en: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.
text:
JHN 19:27
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan hiche aseijui pa jah'a aseijin, “Hiche hi nanu ahi,” atin hichun hiche aseijui pa chun Yeshua nu Mariam chu a-inlam'a apui tan ahi.
English: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

tcz: Hiche jou chun Yeshuan thil ijakai akichai soh chu ahen, Pathen Lekhabua thu chu guilhun sohthei nan, “Kadang achah-e!” ati.
en: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”
text:
JHN 19:28
Thadou: Hiche jou chun Yeshuan thil ijakai akichai soh chu ahen, Pathen Lekhabua thu chu guilhun sohthei nan, “Kadang achah-e!” ati.
English: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”

tcz: Chuleh chukoma chu belkhat'a theitwi thuh kitung ahin, chule twichop phon a theitwi thuh dimset in hyssop mol leh'a atah-un akamtoh asutouvin ahi.
en: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.
text:
JHN 19:29
Thadou: Chuleh chukoma chu belkhat'a theitwi thuh kitung ahin, chule twichop phon a theitwi thuh dimset in hyssop mol leh'a atah-un akamtoh asutouvin ahi.
English: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan theitwi thuh chu adonin, “Akichaitai,” ati. Chuin akaikun alhagao alhadoh tan ahi.
en: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
text:
JHN 19:30
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan theitwi thuh chu adonin, “Akichaitai,” ati. Chuin akaikun alhagao alhadoh tan ahi.
English: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

tcz: Chuin kigin ni ahijeh chun cholngah ni a thilong ho chu thingpel'a aumden louna dingin (cholngah ni Chula ni loupi ni ahin), Judah hon Pilate henga akenggu heboh dingleh along galah mangna dingin athumun ahi.
en: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.
text:
JHN 19:31
Thadou: Chuin kigin ni ahijeh chun cholngah ni a thilong ho chu thingpel'a aumden louna dingin (cholngah ni Chula ni loupi ni ahin), Judah hon Pilate henga akenggu heboh dingleh along galah mangna dingin athumun ahi.
English: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.

tcz: Hichun Rome sepai ho ahungun mi ni kikhai Yeshua toh kikhenbeh te ni keng chu ahehbong tauvin ahi.
en: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;

tcz: Amavang Pakai Yeshua kom ahin phah uchun, ama chu ana thitan ahi, hiphat chun Yeshua keng vang chu aheh bong tapouve.
en: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.
text:
JHN 19:33
Thadou: Amavang Pakai Yeshua kom ahin phah uchun, ama chu ana thitan ahi, hiphat chun Yeshua keng vang chu aheh bong tapouve.
English: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.

tcz: Hitia aum vang chun sepai ho khat in Yeshua nah chu tengcha a asut le apet pet chun thisan le twisih ahung pot tan ahi.
en: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
text:
JHN 19:34
Thadou: Hitia aum vang chun sepai ho khat in Yeshua nah chu tengcha a asut le apet pet chun thisan le twisih ahung pot tan ahi.
English: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

tcz: Chule amupa tah chun ahettohsah ahi; chule ama thu hettohsah chu tahbeh ahi; chuleh aman atahbeh asei ahi chu ahei; nanghon jong natahsan thei na dingu ahi.
en: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
text:
JHN 19:35
Thadou: Chule amupa tah chun ahettohsah ahi; chule ama thu hettohsah chu tahbeh ahi; chuleh aman atahbeh asei ahi chu ahei; nanghon jong natahsan thei na dingu ahi.
English: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse hi Pathen thua ana kisei doh banga, “Agu khat cha jong kihehbong lou ding ahi,” ati chu guilhunna dinga thil hicheng chu soh a ahitai.
en: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”
text:
JHN 19:36
Thadou: Hiche ho jouse hi Pathen thua ana kisei doh banga, “Agu khat cha jong kihehbong lou ding ahi,” ati chu guilhunna dinga thil hicheng chu soh a ahitai.
English: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”

tcz: Chule “Amahon tengcha'a asutpau chu avet dingu ahi” kiti toh.
en: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”
text:
JHN 19:37
Thadou: Chule “Amahon tengcha'a asutpau chu avet dingu ahi” kiti toh.
English: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”

tcz: Chuin hicheng jou chun Arimathea Joseph, Yeshua seijui khat, amavang Juda ho gin jeh a guh thima hia ahin, ama chun Yeshua long chu pohdoh dingin Pilate henga aga thum'in ahileh, Pilate'in jong ana phal'e. Hijeh chun ama ahungin Yeshua long chu apo mangtai.
en: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.
text:
JHN 19:38
Thadou: Chuin hicheng jou chun Arimathea Joseph, Yeshua seijui khat, amavang Juda ho gin jeh a guh thima hia ahin, ama chun Yeshua long chu pohdoh dingin Pilate henga aga thum'in ahileh, Pilate'in jong ana phal'e. Hijeh chun ama ahungin Yeshua long chu apo mangtai.
English: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

tcz: Chule Arimathea Joseph toh hung khom pachu Nicodemus ahin, ama hi Yeshua toh kimuto dinga jan muthim'a hungpa chu ahi. Nicodemus chun Myrrh leh Aloes thao namtui kihal, sel som sagi le nga a gih ahin choiyin ahi.
en: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.
text:
JHN 19:39
Thadou: Chule Arimathea Joseph toh hung khom pachu Nicodemus ahin, ama hi Yeshua toh kimuto dinga jan muthim'a hungpa chu ahi. Nicodemus chun Myrrh leh Aloes thao namtui kihal, sel som sagi le nga a gih ahin choiyin ahi.
English: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.

tcz: Hichun amahon Yeshua long chu alauvin Judate chon na ngai bang in lounam tui toh tupat pon nemin atom tauvin ahi.
en: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
text:
JHN 19:40
Thadou: Hichun amahon Yeshua long chu alauvin Judate chon na ngai bang in lounam tui toh tupat pon nemin atom tauvin ahi.
English: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

tcz: Chuleh thingpel'a aki khetbeh nau mun'a chu hon khat uma ahin, hon a chu koima kivuina khahlou hel lhan thah khat uma ahi.
en: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.
text:
JHN 19:41
Thadou: Chuleh thingpel'a aki khetbeh nau mun'a chu hon khat uma ahin, hon a chu koima kivuina khahlou hel lhan thah khat uma ahi.
English: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

tcz: Hijeh chun Juda ho kiginni ahijeh chun lhan chu akomcha ahiman chun chukoma chun Yeshua chu avui tauvin ahi.
en: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.
text:
JHN 19:42
Thadou: Hijeh chun Juda ho kiginni ahijeh chun lhan chu akomcha ahiman chun chukoma chun Yeshua chu avui tauvin ahi.
English: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.

tcz: Chuin hapta kipatna nimasa ni jingkah matah ahung lhungtan, kho jong vah chen loulai ahin, Mary Magdalene chu lhan a chun agachen ahileh song chu lhan a kona tahdohsa aum chu agamui.
en: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
text:
JHN 20:1
Thadou: Chuin hapta kipatna nimasa ni jingkah matah ahung lhungtan, kho jong vah chen loulai ahin, Mary Magdalene chu lhan a chun agachen ahileh song chu lhan a kona tahdohsa aum chu agamui.
English: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

tcz: Hichun Mary Magdalene chu alhai in Simon Peter leh Pakaiyin a-ngailut seijui pa henga hitin thu aga lhuttai, “Pakai longdamsa chu amahon apo mangtauvin, chule lhan khuh akon'a hoilanga akoiyu ham akihetapoi” agatin ahi.
en: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”
text:
JHN 20:2
Thadou: Hichun Mary Magdalene chu alhai in Simon Peter leh Pakaiyin a-ngailut seijui pa henga hitin thu aga lhuttai, “Pakai longdamsa chu amahon apo mangtauvin, chule lhan khuh akon'a hoilanga akoiyu ham akihetapoi” agatin ahi.
English: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

tcz: Hiche jehchun Peter le seijui khatpa chu lhan khuh lam jon in ache lhontai.
en: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.
text:
JHN 20:3
Thadou: Hiche jehchun Peter le seijui khatpa chu lhan khuh lam jon in ache lhontai.
English: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

tcz: Hichun seijui teni chu hatah in lhan lam jon'in akilhaitet lhon in ahile seijui khatpa chun Peter akhokhel in lhan khuh apha masa tan ahi.
en: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.
text:
JHN 20:4
Thadou: Hichun seijui teni chu hatah in lhan lam jon'in akilhaitet lhon in ahile seijui khatpa chun Peter akhokhel in lhan khuh apha masa tan ahi.
English: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

tcz: Ama akunin asung avet le tupat ponnem ho um chu amun, ahivangin asunga alutpoi.
en: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.
text:
JHN 20:5
Thadou: Ama akunin asung avet le tupat ponnem ho um chu amun, ahivangin asunga alutpoi.
English: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

tcz: Hichun Simon Peter chu ahung lhungtan, chuin lhan sunga chun alut tai; chuin tupat ponnem ho aum chuleh,
en: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,
text:
JHN 20:6
Thadou: Hichun Simon Peter chu ahung lhungtan, chuin lhan sunga chun alut tai; chuin tupat ponnem ho aum chuleh,
English: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

tcz: Aluchunga um ultheh pon chu tupat ponnem ho chutoh umtha louva akijel'a atuma ana um aga mun ahi.
en: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.
text:
JHN 20:7
Thadou: Aluchunga um ultheh pon chu tupat ponnem ho chutoh umtha louva akijel'a atuma ana um aga mun ahi.
English: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

tcz: Hichun seijui alhung masajo pa jong chu lhan khuh sunga aga sunglhan, hichun amun atahsan tai.
en: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
text:
JHN 20:8
Thadou: Hichun seijui alhung masajo pa jong chu lhan khuh sunga aga sunglhan, hichun amun atahsan tai.
English: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

tcz: Hiche masangsea chu amahon Pathen thu akisei doh “Pakai Yeshua chu thi ding chuleh hungthou doh kit ding ahi” tichu ana tahsan thei lou'u ahi.
en: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
text:
JHN 20:9
Thadou: Hiche masangsea chu amahon Pathen thu akisei doh “Pakai Yeshua chu thi ding chuleh hungthou doh kit ding ahi” tichu ana tahsan thei lou'u ahi.
English: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

tcz: Hichun amahon Inlam ahin jon tauvin ahi.
en: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.
text:
JHN 20:10
Thadou: Hichun amahon Inlam ahin jon tauvin ahi.
English: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

tcz: Mary vang chu lhan khuh pam'a chun ading in akap'in aka pum chun lhan khuh sung chu aga ven ahi.
en: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,
text:
JHN 20:11
Thadou: Mary vang chu lhan khuh pam'a chun ading in akap'in aka pum chun lhan khuh sung chu aga ven ahi.
English: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

tcz: Hichun aban abang Vantil ni Yeshua long alupsah nauva chu khat alulhuna atouva khat akeng todop'a atou amui.
en: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
text:
JHN 20:12
Thadou: Hichun aban abang Vantil ni Yeshua long alupsah nauva chu khat alulhuna atouva khat akeng todop'a atou amui.
English: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

tcz: “Ngailut umtah numei nangma ibol'a kap nahim?” tin Vantil teni chun ahindongin ahi. Hichun amanun adonbut'in, “Ajeh chu amahon Ka Pakai apomang tauvin, chuleh along damsa chu hoiya akoiyu keiman kahe tapoi,” ati.
en: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”
text:
JHN 20:13
Thadou: “Ngailut umtah numei nangma ibol'a kap nahim?” tin Vantil teni chun ahindongin ahi. Hichun amanun adonbut'in, “Ajeh chu amahon Ka Pakai apomang tauvin, chuleh along damsa chu hoiya akoiyu keiman kahe tapoi,” ati.
English: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

tcz: Chutia aseijou chun ama aki nungheiyin ahileh, Yeshua adin amun, ahin Yeshua ahi chu ahepoi.
en: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.
text:
JHN 20:14
Thadou: Chutia aseijou chun ama aki nungheiyin ahileh, Yeshua adin amun, ahin Yeshua ahi chu ahepoi.
English: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

tcz: Yeshuan ahin dong'in, “Ngailut umtah numei ibol'a kap nahim?” ati. Amanun honlei ngahpa ahisah in, “Pu, hoilaiya nakoi hitam Ka Pakai long chu, neisei peh in keiman gapo mang ing kate,” ati.
en: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”
text:
JHN 20:15
Thadou: Yeshuan ahin dong'in, “Ngailut umtah numei ibol'a kap nahim?” ati. Amanun honlei ngahpa ahisah in, “Pu, hoilaiya nakoi hitam Ka Pakai long chu, neisei peh in keiman gapo mang ing kate,” ati.
English: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

tcz: “Mary!” tin Yeshuan ahin koutai. Mary chu Pakai henglam a ahung kihei in akap'in, “Rabboni,” ati (hichu Hebrew paova, “houhil,” tina ahi).
en: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”
text:
JHN 20:16
Thadou: “Mary!” tin Yeshuan ahin koutai. Mary chu Pakai henglam a ahung kihei in akap'in, “Rabboni,” ati (hichu Hebrew paova, “houhil,” tina ahi).
English: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Neitong khahih in; ijeh inem itile keima Pa henga chun kakaltou hih laiye; ahin chen lang kasopi ho jah'a gaseiyin, Ka-Pa, nangho Pa, Ka Pathen nangho Pathen henga kakaltouve,” ati.
en: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”
text:
JHN 20:17
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Neitong khahih in; ijeh inem itile keima Pa henga chun kakaltou hih laiye; ahin chen lang kasopi ho jah'a gaseiyin, Ka-Pa, nangho Pa, Ka Pathen nangho Pathen henga kakaltouve,” ati.
English: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

tcz: Mary Magdalene chun seijui ho akimupin, hitin aseiye, “Keiman Pakai chu kamutai,” ati. Chuin amanu chun athusei ho chu asei peh tai. Yeshua Aseijuite Henga Akilah
en: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.
text:
JHN 20:18
Thadou: Mary Magdalene chun seijui ho akimupin, hitin aseiye, “Keiman Pakai chu kamutai,” ati. Chuin amanu chun athusei ho chu asei peh tai. Yeshua Aseijuite Henga Akilah
English: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

tcz: Nikho kipat ni nilhah chun aseijuite Judah ho gin na jeh'a kot kikha khuma um ahiuvin, hichun Yeshua ahungin amaho lah'a ahung dingin ajah'uva, “Nachung'uva lungmon umhen,” ati.
en: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
text:
JHN 20:19
Thadou: Nikho kipat ni nilhah chun aseijuite Judah ho gin na jeh'a kot kikha khuma um ahiuvin, hichun Yeshua ahungin amaho lah'a ahung dingin ajah'uva, “Nachung'uva lungmon umhen,” ati.
English: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

tcz: Aman hiche chu aseijou vin amaho chu akhut thihkil maha le anah tenga kisut na maha avetsah tan ahi. Hichun amahon Pakai amu'u chun seijuite chu akipah lheh jengun ahi.
en: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.
text:
JHN 20:20
Thadou: Aman hiche chu aseijou vin amaho chu akhut thihkil maha le anah tenga kisut na maha avetsah tan ahi. Hichun amahon Pakai amu'u chun seijuite chu akipah lheh jengun ahi.
English: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin avel'in ahoulimpi kit in, “Nachunguva lungmon chamna umhen, chuleh Pan keima eisol banga nangho kasol nahiuve,” ati.
en: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
text:
JHN 20:21
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin avel'in ahoulimpi kit in, “Nachunguva lungmon chamna umhen, chuleh Pan keima eisol banga nangho kasol nahiuve,” ati.
English: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

tcz: Hichun Pakai in aseijui ho chu ahu ahai khum in, “Lhagao theng kisan un.”
en: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!
text:
JHN 20:22
Thadou: Hichun Pakai in aseijui ho chu ahu ahai khum in, “Lhagao theng kisan un.”
English: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

tcz: “Nanghon koitobang ham khat chu achonsetna nangaidam uva ahileh kingaidam ahitauve, ahin nanghon nangaidam louleh amaho chu kingaidam lou ahijenge,” ati.
en: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”
text:
JHN 20:23
Thadou: “Nanghon koitobang ham khat chu achonsetna nangaidam uva ahileh kingaidam ahitauve, ahin nanghon nangaidam louleh amaho chu kingaidam lou ahijenge,” ati.
English: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

tcz: Seijui som le ni holah'a khat Thomas (Didymus atiu) vang chu Yeshua hung kilah a chu amaho lah'a ana umlou ahi.
en: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.
text:
JHN 20:24
Thadou: Seijui som le ni holah'a khat Thomas (Didymus atiu) vang chu Yeshua hung kilah a chu amaho lah'a ana umlou ahi.
English: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

tcz: Amahon aseipeh un, “Keihon Pakai chu kamutauve,” atiuvin ahi. Ahivangin Thomas chun, “Keiman akhut phanga thingkil maha kamua kakhut junga kakhoiya, anah kakhut a katham kahsen keiman tahsan ponge,” ati.
en: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”
text:
JHN 20:25
Thadou: Amahon aseipeh un, “Keihon Pakai chu kamutauve,” atiuvin ahi. Ahivangin Thomas chun, “Keiman akhut phanga thingkil maha kamua kakhut junga kakhoiya, anah kakhut a katham kahsen keiman tahsan ponge,” ati.
English: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

tcz: Niget jouvin seijuite insunga aumkhom pettah'un, hia chu Thomas jong um'ah ahi. Aumnau in chu kot kikhah soh keiya ahi, hinlah hetmanlou kah'in, amasa'a bangin, Yeshua alah uva ana dingin ahi. “Chamnan nalon khum'u hen,” ati.
en: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”
text:
JHN 20:26
Thadou: Niget jouvin seijuite insunga aumkhom pettah'un, hia chu Thomas jong um'ah ahi. Aumnau in chu kot kikhah soh keiya ahi, hinlah hetmanlou kah'in, amasa'a bangin, Yeshua alah uva ana dingin ahi. “Chamnan nalon khum'u hen,” ati.
English: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

tcz: Hichun Thomas jah a, “Nakhutjung in hinkhoiyin, kakhut teni hi ven; chuleh nakhut hin lhangin lang kanah tham'in; chuleh gingcha lel tahih in, tahsanin,” ati.
en: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
text:
JHN 20:27
Thadou: Hichun Thomas jah a, “Nakhutjung in hinkhoiyin, kakhut teni hi ven; chuleh nakhut hin lhangin lang kanah tham'in; chuleh gingcha lel tahih in, tahsanin,” ati.
English: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

tcz: “Ka Pakai le Ka Pathen!” tin Thomas chun ahin phongdoh tai.
en: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
text:
JHN 20:28
Thadou: “Ka Pakai le Ka Pathen!” tin Thomas chun ahin phongdoh tai.
English: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

tcz: Chuin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Nangman neimu jeh a neitahsan ahi. Mulouva tahsan ho anun nomui,” ati.
en: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
text:
JHN 20:29
Thadou: Chuin Yeshuan aseipeh in, “Nangman neimu jeh a neitahsan ahi. Mulouva tahsan ho anun nomui,” ati.
English: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

tcz: Hiti tah a chu Yeshuan aseijuite ang sunga melchihna kidang tamtah abol ahin, hiti ho chu hiche lekhabu sunga hin akisunlut poi.
en: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

tcz: Ahinla nanghon Yeshua chu Messiah, Pathen Chapa, ahi chu natahsan uva chule natahsan vanguva ama min a hinna nanei theina dinguva hichengse hi hiche lekhabua hi kisun'ah ahibouve.
en: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
text:
JHN 20:31
Thadou: Ahinla nanghon Yeshua chu Messiah, Pathen Chapa, ahi chu natahsan uva chule natahsan vanguva ama min a hinna nanei theina dinguva hichengse hi hiche lekhabua hi kisun'ah ahibouve.
English: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

tcz: Hichun phat chomkhat jouvin Yeshua chu seijui hotoh Galilee dillen panga akimuto kit'un, hiti hin ana um'in ahi.
en: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.
text:
JHN 21:1
Thadou: Hichun phat chomkhat jouvin Yeshua chu seijui hotoh Galilee dillen panga akimuto kit'un, hiti hin ana um'in ahi.
English: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

tcz: Simon Peter le Thomas (Didymus atiu) chutoh, Galilee gam'a Cana khoa mi Nathanael toh, Zebedee chapa teni toh chuleh seijui dang nitoh umkhom'a ahiuvin;
en: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

tcz: Simon Peter in, “Keima nga manin chenge,” ati. Hichun amahon ajah'a, “Keiho jong kahung dingu ahi atiuvin ahi.” Chuin acheuvin kong sung khat ah aluttauve, ahin hiche jan chun imacha amanpouvin ahi.
en: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.
text:
JHN 21:3
Thadou: Simon Peter in, “Keima nga manin chenge,” ati. Hichun amahon ajah'a, “Keiho jong kahung dingu ahi atiuvin ahi.” Chuin acheuvin kong sung khat ah aluttauve, ahin hiche jan chun imacha amanpouvin ahi.
English: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

tcz: Jingkah matah in Yeshua chu vapam'a adin seijui hon amuuvin, hinlah ama chu koi ahi ageldoh pouve.
en: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
text:
JHN 21:4
Thadou: Jingkah matah in Yeshua chu vapam'a adin seijui hon amuuvin, hinlah ama chu koi ahi ageldoh pouve.
English: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

tcz: Hichun Pakaiyin amaho chu akouvin, “Sopite ho, nga ijat namat tah uvem?” ati. Ahin amahon adonbut'un, “Imacha Kaman pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”
text:
JHN 21:5
Thadou: Hichun Pakaiyin amaho chu akouvin, “Sopite ho, nga ijat namat tah uvem?” ati. Ahin amahon adonbut'un, “Imacha Kaman pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

tcz: Hichun aman, “Nalen'u chu kong jetlam'a gaseplha temun, hiteng chule namat dingu ahi,” ati. Hichun amahon aseu le nga atama atam jeh chun akaidoh joutapouve.
en: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.
text:
JHN 21:6
Thadou: Hichun aman, “Nalen'u chu kong jetlam'a gaseplha temun, hiteng chule namat dingu ahi,” ati. Hichun amahon aseu le nga atama atam jeh chun akaidoh joutapouve.
English: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan angailut seijui chun Peter jah a, “Pakai ahi,” ati. Hichu Peter in Pakai ahi ati chu ajah phat in asangkhol aki-ah loiyin, (asagoh keova um ahin) dillen a chun achom lhan chule vapam lam chu ajon'in ahi.
en: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.
text:
JHN 21:7
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan angailut seijui chun Peter jah a, “Pakai ahi,” ati. Hichu Peter in Pakai ahi ati chu ajah phat in asangkhol aki-ah loiyin, (asagoh keova um ahin) dillen a chun achom lhan chule vapam lam chu ajon'in ahi.
English: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

tcz: Adangse vang chu kong sunga atouvun, len chu vapam langa kaidoh ding agong'un, ajeh chu len a chu nga dimset ahin chule amaho vapam alhun nadingu chu tong jani tobang achebeu ngaiyah ahi.
en: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.
text:
JHN 21:8
Thadou: Adangse vang chu kong sunga atouvun, len chu vapam langa kaidoh ding agong'un, ajeh chu len a chu nga dimset ahin chule amaho vapam alhun nadingu chu tong jani tobang achebeu ngaiyah ahi.
English: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

tcz: Amaho vapam alhun uchun songmeihol meiya kitih le achunga nga kikoi chuleh changlhah, jing-an a nehding, amu'uvin ahi.
en: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
text:
JHN 21:9
Thadou: Amaho vapam alhun uchun songmeihol meiya kitih le achunga nga kikoi chuleh changlhah, jing-an a nehding, amu'uvin ahi.
English: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

tcz: Yeshuan amaho jah'a, “Namatsau nga chu themkhat hinchoiyun,” ati.
en: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
text:
JHN 21:10
Thadou: Yeshuan amaho jah'a, “Namatsau nga chu themkhat hinchoiyun,” ati.
English: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

tcz: Hichun Simon Peter kong sunga alut'in len chu vapam langa akai doh in ngalen ja khat le som nga le thum dimset len chu agakaiyin, nga achuti tam vang chun alen chu a-eh pon ahi.
en: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
text:
JHN 21:11
Thadou: Hichun Simon Peter kong sunga alut'in len chu vapam langa akai doh in ngalen ja khat le som nga le thum dimset len chu agakaiyin, nga achuti tam vang chun alen chu a-eh pon ahi.
English: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

tcz: Hiphat chun Yeshuan, “Tun nangho hungun lang jing an hung kineh tauvin,” ati. Ahinla aseijui holah a chun khat cha beh in jong, “Nang koi nahi ham?” tin adong ngam pouve. Amahon Pakai ahi chu ahesoh keiyun ahi.
en: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
text:
JHN 21:12
Thadou: Hiphat chun Yeshuan, “Tun nangho hungun lang jing an hung kineh tauvin,” ati. Ahinla aseijui holah a chun khat cha beh in jong, “Nang koi nahi ham?” tin adong ngam pouve. Amahon Pakai ahi chu ahesoh keiyun ahi.
English: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

tcz: Hichun Pakai in seijui ho chu changlhah le nga anehsah in avahva sohkei tai.
en: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
text:
JHN 21:13
Thadou: Hichun Pakai in seijui ho chu changlhah le nga anehsah in avahva sohkei tai.
English: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

tcz: Hichu athia kona athodoh nunga aseijuite henga akilah athumvei na ahi.
en: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
text:
JHN 21:14
Thadou: Hichu athia kona athodoh nunga aseijuite henga akilah athumvei na ahi.
English: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

tcz: Jing-an anehjou phat'un, Yeshuan Simon Peter adongin, “John chapa Simon nangman hiche ho jouse sanga hi nei ngailut joh em? ati. Peter in adonbut in, henge Pakai keiman kangailut nangman nahe nai,” ati.
en: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
text:
JHN 21:15
Thadou: Jing-an anehjou phat'un, Yeshuan Simon Peter adongin, “John chapa Simon nangman hiche ho jouse sanga hi nei ngailut joh em? ati. Peter in adonbut in, henge Pakai keiman kangailut nangman nahe nai,” ati.
English: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

tcz: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kakelngoi ho vah'in,” ati. Anivei nan ajah'a, “John chapa Simon nangman neingailut'em?” ati kit tai. Aman ajah'a, “Henge Pakai ka-ngailut nangman nahenai,” ati. Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kakelngoi ho vah'in,” ati.
en: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
text:
JHN 21:16
Thadou: Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kakelngoi ho vah'in,” ati. Anivei nan ajah'a, “John chapa Simon nangman neingailut'em?” ati kit tai. Aman ajah'a, “Henge Pakai ka-ngailut nangman nahenai,” ati. Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kakelngoi ho vah'in,” ati.
English: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

tcz: Yeshuan athumvei nan adongkit in, “John chapa Simon, keima hi nei ngailut tahbeh mong hinam?” ati. Thumveijen, “Neingailut'em?” atijeh chun Peter chu alungthim anommo lhehtan, ahin Peter in adonbut'in, “Pakai nangman ijakai nahe sohkeiye, keiman nangma kangailut na jouse nangman nahenai,” ati. Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kakelngoi ho vah'in” ati.
en: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
text:
JHN 21:17
Thadou: Yeshuan athumvei nan adongkit in, “John chapa Simon, keima hi nei ngailut tahbeh mong hinam?” ati. Thumveijen, “Neingailut'em?” atijeh chun Peter chu alungthim anommo lhehtan, ahin Peter in adonbut'in, “Pakai nangman ijakai nahe sohkeiye, keiman nangma kangailut na jouse nangman nahenai,” ati. Hichun Yeshuan ajah'a, “Kakelngoi ho vah'in” ati.
English: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

tcz: “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, nakhandon lai chun nangma deibang tah'in navon nakivon thei in, chuleh nangma nop nop na lama nache theiye, ahinla nakum ahungtam tan chujongleh nahung pilhingtan, hijeh a chu nakhut ho nahinjal doh'a midang koitobang in navon nahin vonpeh ding chuleh nache nom louna lam lama napui dingu ahi,” ati.
en: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
text:
JHN 21:18
Thadou: “Tahbeh a kaseipeh nahi, nakhandon lai chun nangma deibang tah'in navon nakivon thei in, chuleh nangma nop nop na lama nache theiye, ahinla nakum ahungtam tan chujongleh nahung pilhingtan, hijeh a chu nakhut ho nahinjal doh'a midang koitobang in navon nahin vonpeh ding chuleh nache nom louna lam lama napui dingu ahi,” ati.
English: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”

tcz: Hichu ama iti thia athiding Pathen achoiat ding chu hetsah na a ati ahi. Chuin hiche chu asei jouvin ajah'a, “Kanung hin jui in,” ati.
en: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
text:
JHN 21:19
Thadou: Hichu ama iti thia athiding Pathen achoiat ding chu hetsah na a ati ahi. Chuin hiche chu asei jouvin ajah'a, “Kanung hin jui in,” ati.
English: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

tcz: Peter akinung hei jin avetle anunglam uva–Yeshua ngailut seijui, jan anneh pet'a Yeshua henglam a akingailhua chule “Pakai koiham nangma napedoh dinga chu,” tia dongpa chu amun ahi.
en: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
text:
JHN 21:20
Thadou: Peter akinung hei jin avetle anunglam uva–Yeshua ngailut seijui, jan anneh pet'a Yeshua henglam a akingailhua chule “Pakai koiham nangma napedoh dinga chu,” tia dongpa chu amun ahi.
English: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

tcz: Peter in Yeshua chu thudoh aneiyin, “Pakai hichepa chula?” ati.
en: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
text:
JHN 21:21
Thadou: Peter in Yeshua chu thudoh aneiyin, “Pakai hichepa chula?” ati.
English: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

tcz: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima kahung kinungle kitkah a ana umdinga phalna kapeh chu, nangma a dinga ipi aboina uma ham? Nang man keima neihin juitan,” ati.
en: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
text:
JHN 21:22
Thadou: Yeshuan adonbut'in, “Keima kahung kinungle kitkah a ana umdinga phalna kapeh chu, nangma a dinga ipi aboina uma ham? Nang man keima neihin juitan,” ati.
English: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

English: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.
