tcz: Chuleh tun O Pakai, amigihsal nauhi ngaiyin lang nalhachate hin nathu kasapphong nadiuvin hansanna lentah chu neipeuvin.
en: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
text:
ACT 4:29
Thadou: Chuleh tun O Pakai, amigihsal nauhi ngaiyin lang nalhachate hin nathu kasapphong nadiuvin hansanna lentah chu neipeuvin.
English: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,

tcz: Namidamsah theina thahat toh thon nakhut hinlhang inlang, nalhacha theng Yeshua minin melchihna le bolmo kidang dang bolu hen” atiuve.
en: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”
text:
ACT 4:30
Thadou: Namidamsah theina thahat toh thon nakhut hinlhang inlang, nalhacha theng Yeshua minin melchihna le bolmo kidang dang bolu hen” atiuve.
English: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”

tcz: Hitia atao jouvun, akikhopnau inchu ahung kilingin, abonchauvin Lhagao Theng adimset un, hangsan tah-in Pathen thu alhangsamun ahi.
en: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
text:
ACT 4:31
Thadou: Hitia atao jouvun, akikhopnau inchu ahung kilingin, abonchauvin Lhagao Theng adimset un, hangsan tah-in Pathen thu alhangsamun ahi.
English: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

tcz: Chuin Tahsan chate jouse chu lungkhat le thakhat ahiuvin, koiman jong anei chu keiya tum ahi tilouvin, anei jouseu abonchan aneikhomun ahi.
en: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.
text:
ACT 4:32
Thadou: Chuin Tahsan chate jouse chu lungkhat le thakhat ahiuvin, koiman jong anei chu keiya tum ahi tilouvin, anei jouseu abonchan aneikhomun ahi.
English: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.

tcz: Solchah ho chun thaneitah in Pakai Yeshua thokit thudol chu ahettohsah jiuvin, chule Pathen phatthei bohna lentah chu amaho chunga aumtan ahi.
en: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.
text:
ACT 4:33
Thadou: Solchah ho chun thaneitah in Pakai Yeshua thokit thudol chu ahettohsah jiuvin, chule Pathen phatthei bohna lentah chu amaho chunga aumtan ahi.
English: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.

tcz: Amaho lah-a chun alhasam angaicha anaumpouvin ahi ajeh chu gam leiset le in neihon ahinjoh-un,
en: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,
text:
ACT 4:34
Thadou: Amaho lah-a chun alhasam angaicha anaumpouvin ahi ajeh chu gam leiset le in neihon ahinjoh-un,
English: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

tcz: asum chu solchahho kengbul'a ahinchoiyun alhasam angaicha ho chu anahop peh jiuvin ahi.
en: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.
text:
ACT 4:35
Thadou: asum chu solchahho kengbul'a ahinchoiyun alhasam angaicha ho chu anahop peh jiuvin ahi.
English: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

tcz: Chuin Joseph, solchah hon Barnabas asah-u (hichu lungmonna chapa tina ahi) chu Levi phungmi Cyprus twikol gam mi ahi.
en: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,
text:
ACT 4:36
Thadou: Chuin Joseph, solchah hon Barnabas asah-u (hichu lungmonna chapa tina ahi) chu Levi phungmi Cyprus twikol gam mi ahi.
English: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

tcz: Amapa chun lou munkhat anei chu ahinjoh in asum chu solchahte kengbul'a ahin choiyin ahi.
en: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
text:
ACT 4:37
Thadou: Amapa chun lou munkhat anei chu ahinjoh in asum chu solchahte kengbul'a ahin choiyin ahi.
English: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

tcz: Ahin Ananias kiti mipa khat ana um'in ama chun ajinu Sapphira to agou themkhat ajoh lhonin,
en: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
text:
ACT 5:1
Thadou: Ahin Ananias kiti mipa khat ana um'in ama chun ajinu Sapphira to agou themkhat ajoh lhonin,
English: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

tcz: Asum kehkhat chu solchahho henga ahin choi lhonin, abona kahin choi lhon ahitai atilhon in adangse chu ajinu toh kinopto in akikoi den lhon tan ahi.
en: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
text:
ACT 5:2
Thadou: Asum kehkhat chu solchahho henga ahin choi lhonin, abona kahin choi lhon ahitai atilhon in adangse chu ajinu toh kinopto in akikoi den lhon tan ahi.
English: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

tcz: Chuin Peter chun aseiyin, “Ananias ipi dinga nalungthim chu Satan nalodimsah hitam? Lhagao Theng najoulhep in nasum akehkhat nanga dingin nakikoi tai.
en: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?
text:
ACT 5:3
Thadou: Chuin Peter chun aseiyin, “Ananias ipi dinga nalungthim chu Satan nalodimsah hitam? Lhagao Theng najoulhep in nasum akehkhat nanga dingin nakikoi tai.
English: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?

tcz: Nagouthil chu nanga ahi, johding le johlou ding jong nangma thu ahi, najoh jouva jong asum chu nanga ahin, pehdoh ding le pehdohlou ding jong nangma thu ahi. Ipi dinga hitobanghi nabol hitam? Hiche hi keiho neijoubol nau ahipon Pathen najoubolna joh ahi” ati.
en: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”
text:
ACT 5:4
Thadou: Nagouthil chu nanga ahi, johding le johlou ding jong nangma thu ahi, najoh jouva jong asum chu nanga ahin, pehdoh ding le pehdohlou ding jong nangma thu ahi. Ipi dinga hitobanghi nabol hitam? Hiche hi keiho neijoubol nau ahipon Pathen najoubolna joh ahi” ati.
English: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”

tcz: Hichethu chu Ananias in ajah jah chun lhonglaiya chun alhun athitai, chuin hiche thu ajapha jouse chu akichathei lheh tauvin ahi.
en: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.
text:
ACT 5:5
Thadou: Hichethu chu Ananias in ajah jah chun lhonglaiya chun alhun athitai, chuin hiche thu ajapha jouse chu akichathei lheh tauvin ahi.
English: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

tcz: Chuin khangdong phabep ahungdoh un ponin atomun vuidingin apodoh tauvin ahi.
en: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.
text:
ACT 5:6
Thadou: Chuin khangdong phabep ahungdoh un ponin atomun vuidingin apodoh tauvin ahi.
English: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

tcz: Nidan thum vel chejouvin, thilsoh imacha hephalouvin ajinu chu ahungin,
en: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
text:
ACT 5:7
Thadou: Nidan thum vel chejouvin, thilsoh imacha hephalouvin ajinu chu ahungin,
English: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

tcz: Chuin Peter in adongin, “Hiche sumhi najipa toh nagam mana namu lhon chu hitam?” atileh amanun jong “Henge hichu kagam man lhon ahi,” ati.
en: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”
text:
ACT 5:8
Thadou: Chuin Peter in adongin, “Hiche sumhi najipa toh nagam mana namu lhon chu hitam?” atileh amanun jong “Henge hichu kagam man lhon ahi,” ati.
English: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”

tcz: Chuin Peter in aseiyin, “Ipi dinga nanitah lhon'a Pakai Lhagao napatep lhona hitobang thilphalou hi nabol lhon hitam? Najipa vuiya che gollhanghon kotphung ahinpha tauvin ahi, chule nangjong naputdoh diu ahitai,” ati.
en: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”
text:
ACT 5:9
Thadou: Chuin Peter in aseiyin, “Ipi dinga nanitah lhon'a Pakai Lhagao napatep lhona hitobang thilphalou hi nabol lhon hitam? Najipa vuiya che gollhanghon kotphung ahinpha tauvin ahi, chule nangjong naputdoh diu ahitai,” ati.
English: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”

tcz: Apettah chun lhonglaiya chun alhun athipaitan ahi. Gollhangho ahunglut un ahileh amanu athisa anaum chu amu uvin chuin apodoh paiyun ajipa kivuina koma chun aga vui tauvin ahi.
en: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.
text:
ACT 5:10
Thadou: Apettah chun lhonglaiya chun alhun athipaitan ahi. Gollhangho ahunglut un ahileh amanu athisa anaum chu amu uvin chuin apodoh paiyun ajipa kivuina koma chun aga vui tauvin ahi.
English: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

tcz: Chuin Houbung pumpi le athu japha jouse chunga kichatna lentah achutan ahi.
en: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.
text:
ACT 5:11
Thadou: Chuin Houbung pumpi le athu japha jouse chunga kichatna lentah achutan ahi.
English: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

tcz: Chuin solchahho chun miholah-a chun melchih nale thil kidang tampi abolun, tahsan chate jouse Houin a, Solomon kempum kiti muna chun niseh in akikhom jing tauvin ahi.
en: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
text:
ACT 5:12
Thadou: Chuin solchahho chun miholah-a chun melchih nale thil kidang tampi abolun, tahsan chate jouse Houin a, Solomon kempum kiti muna chun niseh in akikhom jing tauvin ahi.
English: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

tcz: Ahin mipihon amaho chu amusang lheh vangun alah uva jaoding chu angam pouvin ahi.
en: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.
text:
ACT 5:13
Thadou: Ahin mipihon amaho chu amusang lheh vangun alah uva jaoding chu angam pouvin ahi.
English: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.

tcz: Hijeng jongle tahsan chate chu Pakai henga hung akibe jing jengin, numei le pasal akibe jingin ahi.
en: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.
text:
ACT 5:14
Thadou: Hijeng jongle tahsan chate chu Pakai henga hung akibe jing jengin, numei le pasal akibe jingin ahi.
English: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

tcz: Solchahho natoh jehchun miho chun Peter avale komle alebeh achunguva achuh khah nading tin damlou ho jouse chu lamlen dunga ahinpodoh uvin lupna le pheh chunga alupsah un ahi.
en: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.
text:
ACT 5:15
Thadou: Solchahho natoh jehchun miho chun Peter avale komle alebeh achunguva achuh khah nading tin damlou ho jouse chu lamlen dunga ahinpodoh uvin lupna le pheh chunga alupsah un ahi.
English: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

tcz: Jerusalem kimvela khopi hoa kon chun mipi ahung khomun damlouho le lhagaoboh vop ho ahinpuiyun ahileh abonchauvin adamsoh keiyuvin ahi.
en: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.
text:
ACT 5:16
Thadou: Jerusalem kimvela khopi hoa kon chun mipi ahung khomun damlouho le lhagaoboh vop ho ahinpuiyun ahileh abonchauvin adamsoh keiyuvin ahi.
English: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.

tcz: Chuin thempu chungnung leh aloite Sadducee ho chu thangsetnan adimset un ahi.
en: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy
text:
ACT 5:17
Thadou: Chuin thempu chungnung leh aloite Sadducee ho chu thangsetnan adimset un ahi.
English: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy

tcz: Chuin solchahho chu amanun songkul'a chun ahentauvin ahi.
en: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.
text:
ACT 5:18
Thadou: Chuin solchahho chu amanun songkul'a chun ahentauvin ahi.
English: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.

tcz: Ahin jan in Pakai Lhagao ahungin, akihennau songkul kot chu ahongdohin solchahho chu apuidoh in,
en: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,
text:
ACT 5:19
Thadou: Ahin jan in Pakai Lhagao ahungin, akihennau songkul kot chu ahongdohin solchahho chu apuidoh in,
English: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,

tcz: “Hou'in a cheuvin lang miho koma hiche hinna thuhi gaseipeh tauvin,” ati.
en: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”
text:
ACT 5:20
Thadou: “Hou'in a cheuvin lang miho koma hiche hinna thuhi gaseipeh tauvin,” ati.
English: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”

tcz: Chuin ajing khovah-in solchahho chu Houin'a alut-un, Pakai Lhagaovin akomuva aseipeh bangun ahil tauvin ahi. Chuin thempu chungnung chu atohkhompi chengtoh ahungin, Israelte lah-a aupa houle houvaipoloi ho chu akoukhomun, chuin solchahho chu achungthu-u kholchet dingin songkul'a konin aga puidohsah-un ahi.
en: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
text:
ACT 5:21
Thadou: Chuin ajing khovah-in solchahho chu Houin'a alut-un, Pakai Lhagaovin akomuva aseipeh bangun ahil tauvin ahi. Chuin thempu chungnung chu atohkhompi chengtoh ahungin, Israelte lah-a aupa houle houvaipoloi ho chu akoukhomun, chuin solchahho chu achungthu-u kholchet dingin songkul'a konin aga puidohsah-un ahi.
English: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

tcz: Houin ngaha pang sottolle ho chu songkul'a ahungun ahileh, songkul'a chun koima anaum tapon ahi, chuin amaho akile uvin houvaipoho henga chun thil umchan chu aseiyun,
en: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,
text:
ACT 5:22
Thadou: Houin ngaha pang sottolle ho chu songkul'a ahungun ahileh, songkul'a chun koima anaum tapon ahi, chuin amaho akile uvin houvaipoho henga chun thil umchan chu aseiyun,
English: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

tcz: “Songkul kot chu kikhah detchet a angah ho chu apama ding ahiuvin, ahin songkul kot chu ahonuva ahile asunga chun koima anaumpon ahi!” atiuve.
en: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”
text:
ACT 5:23
Thadou: “Songkul kot chu kikhah detchet a angah ho chu apama ding ahiuvin, ahin songkul kot chu ahonuva ahile asunga chun koima anaumpon ahi!” atiuve.
English: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”

tcz: Chuin Houin ngahho lah-a lamkaipa le thempu pipuho chu alungboi lheh jengun, ipi khat ahungsoh tadem tin adatmo lheh jengun ahi.
en: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.
text:
ACT 5:24
Thadou: Chuin Houin ngahho lah-a lamkaipa le thempu pipuho chu alungboi lheh jengun, ipi khat ahungsoh tadem tin adatmo lheh jengun ahi.
English: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

tcz: Chuin mikhat ahungin kidang satah in, “Songkul'a nakhum-u miho chu Houin'a adinguvin miho thu ahil uve,” ahung tin ahi.
en: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”
text:
ACT 5:25
Thadou: Chuin mikhat ahungin kidang satah in, “Songkul'a nakhum-u miho chu Houin'a adinguvin miho thu ahil uve,” ahung tin ahi.
English: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”

tcz: Chuin Houin ngaha pang sepai lamkaipa leh a sepai techu acheuvin solchahho chu aga manun, ahin ajokhat le mipi ho chun songin eisep unte tin boina sem louvin oltah in agabolun ahi.
en: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.
text:
ACT 5:26
Thadou: Chuin Houin ngaha pang sepai lamkaipa leh a sepai techu acheuvin solchahho chu aga manun, ahin ajokhat le mipi ho chun songin eisep unte tin boina sem louvin oltah in agabolun ahi.
English: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

tcz: Chuin solchahho chu houvaipoloi angsunga ahinpuilut un, amaho chu thempu chungnung in thu adongun,
en: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,
text:
ACT 5:27
Thadou: Chuin solchahho chu houvaipoloi angsunga ahinpuilut un, amaho chu thempu chungnung in thu adongun,
English: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

tcz: “Hiche mipa min chun thu hilkit tahih-un tia hakhama kakham nahilou uham? Ahinlah nathuhil'u Jerusalem nadipsoh un hiche mipa thina chungchanga hin keiho neimoso got uve,” atin ahi.
en: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”
text:
ACT 5:28
Thadou: “Hiche mipa min chun thu hilkit tahih-un tia hakhama kakham nahilou uham? Ahinlah nathuhil'u Jerusalem nadipsoh un hiche mipa thina chungchanga hin keiho neimoso got uve,” atin ahi.
English: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”

tcz: Ahin Peter le solchahho chun adonbut'un, “Keihon mihem thuneiho sanga Pathen thu kangaijoh dingu ahi.
en: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
text:
ACT 5:29
Thadou: Ahin Peter le solchahho chun adonbut'un, “Keihon mihem thuneiho sanga Pathen thu kangaijoh dingu ahi.
English: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.

tcz: Ipu ipateu Pathen chun thingpel chunga nakhaisanguva nathau Yeshua chu thina-a kona akaithoukit ahi.
en: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
text:
ACT 5:30
Thadou: Ipu ipateu Pathen chun thingpel chunga nakhaisanguva nathau Yeshua chu thina-a kona akaithoukit ahi.
English: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

tcz: Ahin ama chu Pathen in Pakai leh Huhhingpu dinga achoisanga akhutjet lama atousah ahitai. Chule hiche hi Israel chate chonset lungheina dingle ngaidam channa dinga abol ahi.
en: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
text:
ACT 5:31
Thadou: Ahin ama chu Pathen in Pakai leh Huhhingpu dinga achoisanga akhutjet lama atousah ahitai. Chule hiche hi Israel chate chonset lungheina dingle ngaidam channa dinga abol ahi.
English: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

tcz: Keiho hi hiche thudol hettohsah chu kahiuvin, chuleh athua nungho dinga Pathen in apeh Lhagao Theng jong chu ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
text:
ACT 5:32
Thadou: Keiho hi hiche thudol hettohsah chu kahiuvin, chuleh athua nungho dinga Pathen in apeh Lhagao Theng jong chu ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
English: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”

tcz: Chuin hiche kisei ajah phat'un houvaipoloi ho chu alung hangdoh jah'un thading lung ageltauvin ahi.
en: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.
text:
ACT 5:33
Thadou: Chuin hiche kisei ajah phat'un houvaipoloi ho chu alung hangdoh jah'un thading lung ageltauvin ahi.
English: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.

tcz: Ahin houvaipoloi lah a mikhat, Pharisee mi amin Gamaliel, amapa chu hou danthu them le mijousen ajabol mikhat ahin, adingdoh in miho chu chomkhat pamlanga soldoh dingin thu apen ahi.
en: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.
text:
ACT 5:34
Thadou: Ahin houvaipoloi lah a mikhat, Pharisee mi amin Gamaliel, amapa chu hou danthu them le mijousen ajabol mikhat ahin, adingdoh in miho chu chomkhat pamlanga soldoh dingin thu apen ahi.
English: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

tcz: Chuin aman aloite henga chun aseiyin, “Nangho Israel mite, hiteho chunga bolding nagot uhi chingtheiyun!
en: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.
text:
ACT 5:35
Thadou: Chuin aman aloite henga chun aseiyin, “Nangho Israel mite, hiteho chunga bolding nagot uhi chingtheiyun!
English: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.

tcz: Tu masang chun Theudas kiti mikhat anaumin, ama chu milen khat bangin ana um'in ahile mihem jali valin anung ana jui un ahi, ahin ama chu anathat'un ahileh anungjui ho chu lamchom cheh a anavahcheh gamun, abol atoh hou jouse imalou asohtan ahi.
en: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.
text:
ACT 5:36
Thadou: Tu masang chun Theudas kiti mikhat anaumin, ama chu milen khat bangin ana um'in ahile mihem jali valin anung ana jui un ahi, ahin ama chu anathat'un ahileh anungjui ho chu lamchom cheh a anavahcheh gamun, abol atoh hou jouse imalou asohtan ahi.
English: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.

tcz: Amapa jouchun hichu min kisut lai ahin, Galilee mi Judas kiti mikhat anaum kitin ama jong chun anungjui mitampi ana neiyin, ahin athat kitun ahile anungjui ho jouse chu ana kithecheh kit tauvin ahi.
en: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
text:
ACT 5:37
Thadou: Amapa jouchun hichu min kisut lai ahin, Galilee mi Judas kiti mikhat anaum kitin ama jong chun anungjui mitampi ana neiyin, ahin athat kitun ahile anungjui ho jouse chu ana kithecheh kit tauvin ahi.
English: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

tcz: Chuti ahijeh chun hiche mite hi ima lohih un, moh lhaong uvin, ajeh chu amahon angaitouva abolgot'u hi amaho lungchama ahile chomkhat joule hungmang paiding ahi.
en: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.
text:
ACT 5:38
Thadou: Chuti ahijeh chun hiche mite hi ima lohih un, moh lhaong uvin, ajeh chu amahon angaitouva abolgot'u hi amaho lungchama ahile chomkhat joule hungmang paiding ahi.
English: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

tcz: Ahin Pathena kona ahileh nasuhmang jou lou dingu, nangho le nangho Pathen toh kidoubep nahilo dingu ahi!” ati.
en: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
text:
ACT 5:39
Thadou: Ahin Pathena kona ahileh nasuhmang jou lou dingu, nangho le nangho Pathen toh kidoubep nahilo dingu ahi!” ati.
English: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”

tcz: Chuin ama thumop chun akilol tauvin, solchahho chu akouvun ajep uvin, chujouvin Yeshua mina thu aseikit tahlou nadingun agihsalun alha tauvin ahi.
en: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
text:
ACT 5:40
Thadou: Chuin ama thumop chun akilol tauvin, solchahho chu akouvun ajep uvin, chujouvin Yeshua mina thu aseikit tahlou nadingun agihsalun alha tauvin ahi.
English: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

tcz: Chuin solchahho chu houvaipoloi angsunga kon chun apotdoh un, Yeshua mina suhgima aumjeh uchun akipah lheh jengun ahi.
en: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.
text:
ACT 5:41
Thadou: Chuin solchahho chu houvaipoloi angsunga kon chun apotdoh un, Yeshua mina suhgima aumjeh uchun akipah lheh jengun ahi.
English: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.

tcz: chule aniseh in Houin le ainson tin'ah “Yeshua chu Messiah ahi,” tichu ahil'un asamphong jom jingun ahi.
en: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.
text:
ACT 5:42
Thadou: chule aniseh in Houin le ainson tin'ah “Yeshua chu Messiah ahi,” tichu ahil'un asamphong jom jingun ahi.
English: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.

tcz: Ahin aniseh a atahsan akibejing phat in alah uva phun noina le kilunglhaito louna aumdoh tan, hichun Greek pao tho atahsanho chun Hebrew pao tho atahsanhon niseh-a neh le chah kihopna-a meithaiho akhohsah pouve tin aphunnoi tauvin ahi.
en: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.
text:
ACT 6:1
Thadou: Ahin aniseh a atahsan akibejing phat in alah uva phun noina le kilunglhaito louna aumdoh tan, hichun Greek pao tho atahsanho chun Hebrew pao tho atahsanhon niseh-a neh le chah kihopna-a meithaiho akhohsah pouve tin aphunnoi tauvin ahi.
English: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

tcz: Chuin solchah somleni hochun atahsanho chu abonchauvin akou khom uvin, “Keiho solchahho hin Pathen thuhilna-a phat kaman diu ahin neh le chah a hi kaboilou ding dol-u ahi.
en: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.
text:
ACT 6:2
Thadou: Chuin solchah somleni hochun atahsanho chu abonchauvin akou khom uvin, “Keiho solchahho hin Pathen thuhilna-a phat kaman diu ahin neh le chah a hi kaboilou ding dol-u ahi.
English: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

tcz: Hijeh chun sopite ho, nanghon jaumtah, lhagao le chihna a dim mi sagi lhengdoh uvin lang ama ho chu neh leh chah a mo kapohsah dingu ahi.
en: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
text:
ACT 6:3
Thadou: Hijeh chun sopite ho, nanghon jaumtah, lhagao le chihna a dim mi sagi lhengdoh uvin lang ama ho chu neh leh chah a mo kapohsah dingu ahi.
English: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

tcz: Chutileh keiho solchah ho hin taona le Pathen thuhila phat kamanthei dingu ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”
text:
ACT 6:4
Thadou: Chutileh keiho solchah ho hin taona le Pathen thuhila phat kamanthei dingu ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
English: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”

tcz: Abonchauvin hiche lunggel chu pha asauvin chuin, Stephen (tahsan nale lhagaova dim mipa), Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, le Antioch mi Nicolas (Jews te tahsana sang masaloi) ho chu hiche panmun loding chun alhengdoh tauvin ahi.
en: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,
text:
ACT 6:5
Thadou: Abonchauvin hiche lunggel chu pha asauvin chuin, Stephen (tahsan nale lhagaova dim mipa), Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, le Antioch mi Nicolas (Jews te tahsana sang masaloi) ho chu hiche panmun loding chun alhengdoh tauvin ahi.
English: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

tcz: Chuin hiche mi sagi kilhengdoh ho chu solchahho henga ahin puilut uvin ahileh solchah hon achunguva khut angamun ataopeh tauvin ahi.
en: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
text:
ACT 6:6
Thadou: Chuin hiche mi sagi kilhengdoh ho chu solchahho henga ahin puilut uvin ahileh solchah hon achunguva khut angamun ataopeh tauvin ahi.
English: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

tcz: Chutichun Pathen thu chu amachal jing in atahsan mi hatah in akibejing in, chule Judate thempuho jong tamtah ajau-uvin ahi.
en: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
text:
ACT 6:7
Thadou: Chutichun Pathen thu chu amachal jing in atahsan mi hatah in akibejing in, chule Judate thempuho jong tamtah ajau-uvin ahi.
English: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

tcz: Chuin Stephen chun, Pathen lungset nale thaneina dimset in thil kidang le melchihna tampi mipiho masanga abol in ahi.
en: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
text:
ACT 6:8
Thadou: Chuin Stephen chun, Pathen lungset nale thaneina dimset in thil kidang le melchihna tampi mipiho masanga abol in ahi.
English: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

tcz: Ahin nikhat chu chamlhat miho kikhop khomna a konin mi phabep, amaho chu Cyrene, Alexandria, Cilicia, le Asia gam'a kona Judah mi ahiuvin amaho chu ahungun Stephen chu ahung kinelpi tauvin ahi.
en: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.
text:
ACT 6:9
Thadou: Ahin nikhat chu chamlhat miho kikhop khomna a konin mi phabep, amaho chu Cyrene, Alexandria, Cilicia, le Asia gam'a kona Judah mi ahiuvin amaho chu ahungun Stephen chu ahung kinelpi tauvin ahi.
English: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

tcz: Ahin Stephen in chihna le Lhagao dimset puma aseidoh thucheng ang a chun koima adingjou pouvin ahi.
en: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
text:
ACT 6:10
Thadou: Ahin Stephen in chihna le Lhagao dimset puma aseidoh thucheng ang a chun koima adingjou pouvin ahi.
English: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

tcz: Chuin amahon mipi themkhat atildoh-un amaho koma chun Stephen in “Mose le Pathen ataitom,” thu kajauve atiuvin ahi.
en: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
text:
ACT 6:11
Thadou: Chuin amahon mipi themkhat atildoh-un amaho koma chun Stephen in “Mose le Pathen ataitom,” thu kajauve atiuvin ahi.
English: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

tcz: Hiche asei-uchun mipichu alung handoh sah-uvin, chuin upa hole houdanthu hilho chun Stephen chu aman uvin vaipoloi anga ahin puilut un ahi.
en: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,
text:
ACT 6:12
Thadou: Hiche asei-uchun mipichu alung handoh sah-uvin, chuin upa hole houdanthu hilho chun Stephen chu aman uvin vaipoloi anga ahin puilut un ahi.
English: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

tcz: Chuin jouthu hettoh sahna asemun, “Hiche mipa hin Houin theng dounale Mose dan dounan thu aseiyin,
en: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
text:
ACT 6:13
Thadou: Chuin jouthu hettoh sahna asemun, “Hiche mipa hin Houin theng dounale Mose dan dounan thu aseiyin,
English: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

tcz: Chule Nazareth Yeshua chun Houin hi ahinsuh chimding chule Mose'n eipeh-u danjong akhelding ahi” tia asei kajauve, atiuvin ahi.
en: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”
text:
ACT 6:14
Thadou: Chule Nazareth Yeshua chun Houin hi ahinsuh chimding chule Mose'n eipeh-u danjong akhelding ahi” tia asei kajauve, atiuvin ahi.
English: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”

tcz: Hichepettah chun vaipo loiho jouse chun Stephen chu avesoh keiyun ahi, ajeh chu Stephen maiso chu vantil ho maibanga vahset ahi.
en: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.
text:
ACT 6:15
Thadou: Hichepettah chun vaipo loiho jouse chun Stephen chu avesoh keiyun ahi, ajeh chu Stephen maiso chu vantil ho maibanga vahset ahi.
English: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

tcz: Chuin thempu chungnung chun Stephen chu adongin, “Hiche hehna thu hohi dih em?” ati.
en: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”
text:
ACT 7:1
Thadou: Chuin thempu chungnung chun Stephen chu adongin, “Hiche hehna thu hohi dih em?” ati.
English: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”

tcz: Chuin Stephen in adonbut in, “Sopite le Pateho ngaiyuvin, Ipuluiyu Abraham Haran a achen masang, Mesopotamia gam'a aumlaiyin Loupi Pathen chu ahenga ana kilah in,
en: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
text:
ACT 7:2
Thadou: Chuin Stephen in adonbut in, “Sopite le Pateho ngaiyuvin, Ipuluiyu Abraham Haran a achen masang, Mesopotamia gam'a aumlaiyin Loupi Pathen chu ahenga ana kilah in,
English: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

tcz: Hitin anaseiyin ahi, ‘napena gam leiset le na insungmi hindalhan lang, keiman kavetsah ding gamleiset a hungin’” ati.
en: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’
text:
ACT 7:3
Thadou: Hitin anaseiyin ahi, ‘napena gam leiset le na insungmi hindalhan lang, keiman kavetsah ding gamleiset a hungin’” ati.
English: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’

tcz: Chuin Abraham'in Chaldea gam ahin dalhan apa thikah in Haran a anachengin, chujouvin tua nachennau gamsunga hin ahin puilut in ahi.
en: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.
text:
ACT 7:4
Thadou: Chuin Abraham'in Chaldea gam ahin dalhan apa thikah in Haran a anachengin, chujouvin tua nachennau gamsunga hin ahin puilut in ahi.
English: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen in akengto ngapna dingkham gambeh neocha jong ana pepoi. Ahin Abraham'in chapa aneiloulai vang'in nikhatle ama le ason achilhah ten hichegam hi alodingu ahi tin Pathen in ana thutep-in ahi.
en: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.
text:
ACT 7:5
Thadou: Ahinlah Pathen in akengto ngapna dingkham gambeh neocha jong ana pepoi. Ahin Abraham'in chapa aneiloulai vang'in nikhatle ama le ason achilhah ten hichegam hi alodingu ahi tin Pathen in ana thutep-in ahi.
English: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

tcz: Chuleh Pathen in aseikit in nason nachilhate jong migama kum jali sohchang le bolgima um dingu ahi
en: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.
text:
ACT 7:6
Thadou: Chuleh Pathen in aseikit in nason nachilhate jong migama kum jali sohchang le bolgima um dingu ahi
English: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

tcz: Ahin soh-a kai nam mite chunga keiman thu katan ding, achaina le hiche gam'a hi hung kile kit uva keima eihoukit dingu ahi ati.
en: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’
text:
ACT 7:7
Thadou: Ahin soh-a kai nam mite chunga keiman thu katan ding, achaina le hiche gam'a hi hung kile kit uva keima eihoukit dingu ahi ati.
English: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’

tcz: Chule Pathen in jong Abraham chu cheptana kitepna thu anapen, chuin Abraham'in achapa Isaac ahin phat in aniget nin chep anatan in, chule hiche kitepna chu Isaac in jong Jacob ahina, chuleh Jacob in apului-u somleni ahinchan geiyin jong ahin boljom jingun ahi.
en: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.
text:
ACT 7:8
Thadou: Chule Pathen in jong Abraham chu cheptana kitepna thu anapen, chuin Abraham'in achapa Isaac ahin phat in aniget nin chep anatan in, chule hiche kitepna chu Isaac in jong Jacob ahina, chuleh Jacob in apului-u somleni ahinchan geiyin jong ahin boljom jingun ahi.
English: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

tcz: Chuin hiche puluiho chu asopipau Joseph chunga ana thangthip uvin, hijeh chun Egypt gam'a sohding in anajohdoh uvin ahi. Ahin Pathen in anaumpi jingin,
en: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him
text:
ACT 7:9
Thadou: Chuin hiche puluiho chu asopipau Joseph chunga ana thangthip uvin, hijeh chun Egypt gam'a sohding in anajohdoh uvin ahi. Ahin Pathen in anaumpi jingin,
English: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him

tcz: Gentheina ho jouse a konin anahuhdoh in Egypt lengpa Pharaoh angsunga lungsetna anapen ahi. Chule Pathen in Joseph chu kidangtah chihna anapen hijeh chun Pharaoh in Joseph chu Egypt gam pumpia vaipon ana pansah in chuleh a leng inpia jong mopon ana pansah in ahi.
en: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
text:
ACT 7:10
Thadou: Gentheina ho jouse a konin anahuhdoh in Egypt lengpa Pharaoh angsunga lungsetna anapen ahi. Chule Pathen in Joseph chu kidangtah chihna anapen hijeh chun Pharaoh in Joseph chu Egypt gam pumpia vaipon ana pansah in chuleh a leng inpia jong mopon ana pansah in ahi.
English: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

tcz: Ahin Egypt gam le Canaan gam sunga kel ahunglha tan ahileh gentheina sangtah ahunglhung tan hijeh chun ipuiluiteu jong nehding neilouvin anaum un ahi.
en: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.
text:
ACT 7:11
Thadou: Ahin Egypt gam le Canaan gam sunga kel ahunglha tan ahileh gentheina sangtah ahunglhung tan hijeh chun ipuiluiteu jong nehding neilouvin anaum un ahi.
English: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.

tcz: Chuin Jacob in Egypt gamsunga neh aum nalaiye ti ahet phatin achate-ipuiluiteu chu neh choding in asolin ahi.
en: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.
text:
ACT 7:12
Thadou: Chuin Jacob in Egypt gamsunga neh aum nalaiye ti ahet phatin achate-ipuiluiteu chu neh choding in asolin ahi.
English: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.

tcz: Anivei channa a anache uchun Joseph chu a sopite henga ana kiphongin chuin asopite chu Pharaoh henga anapuilut in ahi.
en: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.
text:
ACT 7:13
Thadou: Anivei channa a anache uchun Joseph chu a sopite henga ana kiphongin chuin asopite chu Pharaoh henga anapuilut in ahi.
English: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.

tcz: Chuin Joseph in mi asolin apa Jacob le ainsungmite somsagi le nga hochu ahenga dingin agakousah tan ahi.
en: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
text:
ACT 7:14
Thadou: Chuin Joseph in mi asolin apa Jacob le ainsungmite somsagi le nga hochu ahenga dingin agakousah tan ahi.
English: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

tcz: Chuin Jacob chu Egypt gam'a anache in athitan ahi chule ipuluiteu jong anathi tauvin ahi.
en: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;

tcz: Chun alongdamsau chu Shechem a ahin pouvin Abraham'in Hamor chapate koma anachohna lhanmuna chun avui tauvin ahi.
en: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
text:
ACT 7:16
Thadou: Chun alongdamsau chu Shechem a ahin pouvin Abraham'in Hamor chapate koma anachohna lhanmuna chun avui tauvin ahi.
English: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.

tcz: Pathen in Abraham koma athutep guilhunna ding phat anaitah jehchun miho chu Egypt gam'a chun hatah in apungun.
en: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
text:
ACT 7:17
Thadou: Pathen in Abraham koma athutep guilhunna ding phat anaitah jehchun miho chu Egypt gam'a chun hatah in apungun.
English: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

tcz: Ahin Joseph hephalou lengthah khat Egypt lengvaipoa ahung pan phat in,
en: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.
text:
ACT 7:18
Thadou: Ahin Joseph hephalou lengthah khat Egypt lengvaipoa ahung pan phat in,
English: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.

tcz: Hiche lengpa chun imiteu chu doha in abolin asugentheiyin chule achasen houchu athi nadingin anu le apa teu chu hunam'in ana paidoh sah in ahi.
en: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.
text:
ACT 7:19
Thadou: Hiche lengpa chun imiteu chu doha in abolin asugentheiyin chule achasen houchu athi nadingin anu le apa teu chu hunam'in ana paidoh sah in ahi.
English: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.

tcz: Hichephat laitah chun Pathen mitvet a chapang hoitah Mose chu anapengin, anu le apan inmun'ah lhathum hoitah in anasin lhonin ahi.
en: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.
text:
ACT 7:20
Thadou: Hichephat laitah chun Pathen mitvet a chapang hoitah Mose chu anapengin, anu le apan inmun'ah lhathum hoitah in anasin lhonin ahi.
English: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.

tcz: Chuin anu le apan Mose chu apaidoh lhontan ahileh Pharaoh chanun ana kimudoh in ama cha bang bangin ahin vahkhang tan ahi.
en: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.
text:
ACT 7:21
Thadou: Chuin anu le apan Mose chu apaidoh lhontan ahileh Pharaoh chanun ana kimudoh in ama cha bang bangin ahin vahkhang tan ahi.
English: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

tcz: Chuin Mose chu Egypt gamsung chihna ho jouse ahilun ahile ama chu thusei le natoh a thahattah'a hung hitan ahi.
en: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.
text:
ACT 7:22
Thadou: Chuin Mose chu Egypt gamsung chihna ho jouse ahilun ahile ama chu thusei le natoh a thahattah'a hung hitan ahi.
English: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.

tcz: Chuin Mose chu kum somli ahung hi phat hin nikhat chu asopite-Israel techu agavetan ahile,
en: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
text:
ACT 7:23
Thadou: Chuin Mose chu kum somli ahung hi phat hin nikhat chu asopite-Israel techu agavetan ahile,
English: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

tcz: Egypt mipa khat'in Israel mikhat alamlou tah'a abol chu amun chuin Mose chu ahungin Israel mipa chu ahuh in Egypt mipa chu athattan ahi.
en: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.
text:
ACT 7:24
Thadou: Egypt mipa khat'in Israel mikhat alamlou tah'a abol chu amun chuin Mose chu ahungin Israel mipa chu ahuh in Egypt mipa chu athattan ahi.
English: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

tcz: Mose chun hiche Israel mite chun Pathen in keiho huhdoh dinga eihinsolpeh ahi ti geldoh nauvinte tia anagel vang chun Israel mite chun anageldoh pouvin ahi.
en: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.
text:
ACT 7:25
Thadou: Mose chun hiche Israel mite chun Pathen in keiho huhdoh dinga eihinsolpeh ahi ti geldoh nauvinte tia anagel vang chun Israel mite chun anageldoh pouvin ahi.
English: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.

tcz: Chuin ajing nikhon amite agavet a ahileh, Israel mini ana kina lhonin hijeh chun aman jong chamna nasem kigon hiche miteni koma chun “Nangni sopi khat nahi lhon louham? Ipi dinga nakinah lhon ham?” atin ahile,
en: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’
text:
ACT 7:26
Thadou: Chuin ajing nikhon amite agavet a ahileh, Israel mini ana kina lhonin hijeh chun aman jong chamna nasem kigon hiche miteni koma chun “Nangni sopi khat nahi lhon louham? Ipi dinga nakinah lhon ham?” atin ahile,
English: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’

tcz: mikhatpa chun Mose chu ahin sondoh in, kon keiho chunga vaihom le thutana napansah ham? tin ahin dongin,
en: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
text:
ACT 7:27
Thadou: mikhatpa chun Mose chu ahin sondoh in, kon keiho chunga vaihom le thutana napansah ham? tin ahin dongin,
English: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

tcz: “Janhia Egypt mipa khat natha banga chu keima jong neitha got ham?” atin ahi.
en: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
text:
ACT 7:28
Thadou: “Janhia Egypt mipa khat natha banga chu keima jong neitha got ham?” atin ahi.
English: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’

tcz: Chuin Mosen hichu ajah phat chun, Egypt gam'a konin ajamin Midian gam apemin hiche muna chun chapa ni ahingin ahi.
en: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
text:
ACT 7:29
Thadou: Chuin Mosen hichu ajah phat chun, Egypt gam'a konin ajamin Midian gam apemin hiche muna chun chapa ni ahingin ahi.
English: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.

tcz: Chuin kum somli jouvin Vantil hamboh meikongin Mose chu Sinai mol toh kinai gamthip a chun ana kimupi in,
en: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
text:
ACT 7:30
Thadou: Chuin kum somli jouvin Vantil hamboh meikongin Mose chu Sinai mol toh kinai gamthip a chun ana kimupi in,
English: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.

tcz: Chuin Mosen hichu amun athilmu chu kidang asah in, achenaiya agavet kigot le Pakai awgin chun ahin kouvin,
en: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,
text:
ACT 7:31
Thadou: Chuin Mosen hichu amun athilmu chu kidang asah in, achenaiya agavet kigot le Pakai awgin chun ahin kouvin,
English: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,

tcz: “Keima napuluiteu Pathen kahi, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob Pathen kahi,” ahin tin ahile Mose jong akicha behseh jengin avengam tapon ahi.
en: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.
text:
ACT 7:32
Thadou: “Keima napuluiteu Pathen kahi, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob Pathen kahi,” ahin tin ahile Mose jong akicha behseh jengin avengam tapon ahi.
English: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.

tcz: Chuin Pathen in aseiyin, “Nakengchot sutlhan ajeh chu nadinna mun chu muntheng ahi.
en: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
text:
ACT 7:33
Thadou: Chuin Pathen in aseiyin, “Nakengchot sutlhan ajeh chu nadinna mun chu muntheng ahi.
English: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.

tcz: Egypt gam'a kamite gentheina kamutan, akanau aw kajan ahuhdoh dinga hungkumlha kahitai, hijeh chun tun keiman nangma hi Egypt gam'a kanungsol kit nahi,” ati.
en: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’
text:
ACT 7:34
Thadou: Egypt gam'a kamite gentheina kamutan, akanau aw kajan ahuhdoh dinga hungkumlha kahitai, hijeh chun tun keiman nangma hi Egypt gam'a kanungsol kit nahi,” ati.
English: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’

tcz: Chuin “Kon keiho chunga vaihom le thutana napansah ham?” tia asanlou pau chu, Pathen in hamboh lah'a kona akimusah vantil jalchun vaipo dingle thutan dingin Pathen in Mose chu alesol kit in ahile.
en: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
text:
ACT 7:35
Thadou: Chuin “Kon keiho chunga vaihom le thutana napansah ham?” tia asanlou pau chu, Pathen in hamboh lah'a kona akimusah vantil jalchun vaipo dingle thutan dingin Pathen in Mose chu alesol kit in ahile.
English: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

tcz: Mose'n thil kidang le melchihna tamtah pumin Israelte chu Egypt gam'a konin ahinpuidoh in twipisan le gamthip chu kum somli sungin ahung galkaiyun ahi.
en: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
text:
ACT 7:36
Thadou: Mose'n thil kidang le melchihna tamtah pumin Israelte chu Egypt gam'a konin ahinpuidoh in twipisan le gamthip chu kum somli sungin ahung galkaiyun ahi.
English: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.

tcz: “Chuin Mose amatah in Israelte koma anaseiyin, Pathen in keima tobang themgaokhat nangholah-a kona asodohsah ding ahi,” ati.
en: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’
text:
ACT 7:37
Thadou: “Chuin Mose amatah in Israelte koma anaseiyin, Pathen in keima tobang themgaokhat nangholah-a kona asodohsah ding ahi,” ati.
English: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’

tcz: Mose chu gamthip a ipuluiteu toh Pathen mite kikhop khomna-a anaumkhomin, Sinai Molchunga valtil in thu aseipeh chun, khonunga eiho jouse pehson dingin hinna thu eina lahpeh-uvin ahi.
en: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,
text:
ACT 7:38
Thadou: Mose chu gamthip a ipuluiteu toh Pathen mite kikhop khomna-a anaumkhomin, Sinai Molchunga valtil in thu aseipeh chun, khonunga eiho jouse pehson dingin hinna thu eina lahpeh-uvin ahi.
English: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,

tcz: Ahinlah Ipuluiteu chun Mose thusei anangai pouvin Egypt gam'a kinungle ding ana deijo un ahi.
en: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
text:
ACT 7:39
Thadou: Ahinlah Ipuluiteu chun Mose thusei anangai pouvin Egypt gam'a kinungle ding ana deijo un ahi.
English: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,

tcz: Ipuiluiteu chun Aaron koma aseiyun, “Eilamkai thei ding-u pathen lim themkhat neisempeh-un ajeh chu Egypt gam'a kona eihin puidoh pau Mose hi iti hitam kahetapouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
text:
ACT 7:40
Thadou: Ipuiluiteu chun Aaron koma aseiyun, “Eilamkai thei ding-u pathen lim themkhat neisempeh-un ajeh chu Egypt gam'a kona eihin puidoh pau Mose hi iti hitam kahetapouve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

tcz: Chuin bongnou toh kilou milim khat asem uvin, hiche milim henga chun kilhaina gantha asemuvin, athilsem uchu akipapi uvin ahi.
en: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.
text:
ACT 7:41
Thadou: Chuin bongnou toh kilou milim khat asem uvin, hiche milim henga chun kilhaina gantha asemuvin, athilsem uchu akipapi uvin ahi.
English: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.

tcz: Chuin amahoa konin Pathen akihei mangin, Vana ahsiho chu apathenu hidingin adalhatan ahi! Chuin themgao lekhabun asei “Vo Israel kum somli gamthip'a nathamlaiyuva nahin choiyu kilhaina gantha le thilto ho chu keima henga ding ham?
en: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
text:
ACT 7:42
Thadou: Chuin amahoa konin Pathen akihei mangin, Vana ahsiho chu apathenu hidingin adalhatan ahi! Chuin themgao lekhabun asei “Vo Israel kum somli gamthip'a nathamlaiyuva nahin choiyu kilhaina gantha le thilto ho chu keima henga ding ham?
English: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

tcz: Ahipoi, nanghon Molech ponbuh le pathen Rephan ahsi hou dinga alim nasemthu-u chu napole ji bouvui, hijeh a chu nangho Babylon gamsung chana soh-a kasol ding nahiuve,” ati.
en: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’
text:
ACT 7:43
Thadou: Ahipoi, nanghon Molech ponbuh le pathen Rephan ahsi hou dinga alim nasemthu-u chu napole ji bouvui, hijeh a chu nangho Babylon gamsung chana soh-a kasol ding nahiuve,” ati.
English: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’

tcz: Ipuluiteu chun gamthip noija chun Houbuh chu anapole un Pathen in Mose henga anamusah lim bang bang chun ana tungdoh ji-un ahi.
en: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;

tcz: Kum phabep jouvin Joshua lamkaina a ipuluiteuvin hiche gam'a kona Pathen in ananodohho khopimun analo-uchun Pathen Houbuh chu anapolut un Leng David khang chanin ana um'in ahi.
en: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,
text:
ACT 7:45
Thadou: Kum phabep jouvin Joshua lamkaina a ipuluiteuvin hiche gam'a kona Pathen in ananodohho khopimun analo-uchun Pathen Houbuh chu anapolut un Leng David khang chanin ana um'in ahi.
English: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,

tcz: David chu Pathen mitmun deium ana chang'in, aitih a Jacob Pathen chenna ding Houin sahna dingin anathumin ahi.
en: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.
text:
ACT 7:46
Thadou: David chu Pathen mitmun deium ana chang'in, aitih a Jacob Pathen chenna ding Houin sahna dingin anathumin ahi.
English: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

tcz: Ahin hiche houin chu Solomon in ana tungdoh in ahi.
en: But Solomon built him a house.
text:
ACT 7:47
Thadou: Ahin hiche houin chu Solomon in ana tungdoh in ahi.
English: But Solomon built him a house.

tcz: Hijeng jongle hiche khut a kisa houin a chun Chungnungpen Pathen chu achengpoi tin, Themgaovin aseiye.
en: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,
text:
ACT 7:48
Thadou: Hijeng jongle hiche khut a kisa houin a chun Chungnungpen Pathen chu achengpoi tin, Themgaovin aseiye.
English: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

tcz: “Van kalaltouna ahin leiset kakengto ngapna ahi, chutobang chenna ding inpha chu neisahpeh thei ding ham?” tin Pakai chun adongin ahi.
en: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?
text:
ACT 7:49
Thadou: “Van kalaltouna ahin leiset kakengto ngapna ahi, chutobang chenna ding inpha chu neisahpeh thei ding ham?” tin Pakai chun adongin ahi.
English: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?

tcz: Van le leiset ania kakhut a kasem hilou ham? tia asei banga chu.
en: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’
text:
ACT 7:50
Thadou: Van le leiset ania kakhut a kasem hilou ham? tia asei banga chu.
English: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’

tcz: “Nangho milouchalte, thutah'a dinga alungthim le ana ngong teho, aimatih chana Lhagao Theng nadoudalu hilou ham? Hichu na pului teuvin ana bola nanghon jong nabolu ahi.
en: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.
text:
ACT 7:51
Thadou: “Nangho milouchalte, thutah'a dinga alungthim le ana ngong teho, aimatih chana Lhagao Theng nadoudalu hilou ham? Hichu na pului teuvin ana bola nanghon jong nabolu ahi.
English: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.

tcz: Napului teuvin ana bolgim lou themgao khat umem? Chondihtah Messiah hungding thu ana sei masaho chu ana that un amatah jong namatsah un na that un ahi.
en: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.
text:
ACT 7:52
Thadou: Napului teuvin ana bolgim lou themgao khat umem? Chondihtah Messiah hungding thu ana sei masaho chu ana that un amatah jong namatsah un na that un ahi.
English: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.

tcz: chule Vantil a kona nalah son u Pathen danthu jeng jong henasa san nanit pouvin ahi,” ati.
en: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”
text:
ACT 7:53
Thadou: chule Vantil a kona nalah son u Pathen danthu jeng jong henasa san nanit pouvin ahi,” ati.
English: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”

tcz: Stephen in athemmo nau thu asei chun Judate lamkai ho chu alunghansah lheh jengun chuin amachu akhuttum ajel khumun ahi.
en: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
text:
ACT 7:54
Thadou: Stephen in athemmo nau thu asei chun Judate lamkai ho chu alunghansah lheh jengun chuin amachu akhuttum ajel khumun ahi.
English: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

tcz: Ahin Lhagao Theng dimset'in Stephen chun vanlam aven ahileh Pathen loupina le Yeshua Pathen khut jetlam jabolna muna adin chu amun ahi.
en: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
text:
ACT 7:55
Thadou: Ahin Lhagao Theng dimset'in Stephen chun vanlam aven ahileh Pathen loupina le Yeshua Pathen khut jetlam jabolna muna adin chu amun ahi.
English: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

tcz: Chuin aman amahojah a, “Ven vankot akihona chule Pathen khut jetlam jabolna muna mihem chapa adin kamui,” ati.
en: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
text:
ACT 7:56
Thadou: Chuin aman amahojah a, “Ven vankot akihona chule Pathen khut jetlam jabolna muna mihem chapa adin kamui,” ati.
English: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”

tcz: Chuin amahon akhut'un anakol akisip-un apengjah un amachu anokhum jengun,
en: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.
text:
ACT 7:57
Thadou: Chuin amahon akhut'un anakol akisip-un apengjah un amachu anokhum jengun,
English: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.

tcz: Khopi pamlanga akaidoh-un songin asep-un, chuin ama themmo chansah hochun avon chu asut-un Saul kiti khangdongpa kengbul'a chun akoiyun ahi.
en: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
text:
ACT 7:58
Thadou: Khopi pamlanga akaidoh-un songin asep-un, chuin ama themmo chansah hochun avon chu asut-un Saul kiti khangdongpa kengbul'a chun akoiyun ahi.
English: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

tcz: Chuin songa asepettah-un Stephen chu ataovin, “Pakai Ka lhagao lan,” ati.
en: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
text:
ACT 7:59
Thadou: Chuin songa asepettah-un Stephen chu ataovin, “Pakai Ka lhagao lan,” ati.
English: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”

tcz: Chuin abohkhup in apengjah jengin, “Pakai abolho jouseu hi amaho chonsetin simpeh hih-in,” atin hiti chu athitan ahi.
en: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
text:
ACT 7:60
Thadou: Chuin abohkhup in apengjah jengin, “Pakai abolho jouseu hi amaho chonsetin simpeh hih-in,” atin hiti chu athitan ahi.
English: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.

tcz: Saul jong chu Stephen kitha amittah a muho lah'a khat ahin, amatah in jong aphatsah ahi. Chuin hiche nikhoa kipat chun Jerusalema Houbung suhmangna dingin suhgentheina lentah ana kipan tan ahile Solchahho tailou tahsan chate jouse chu Judea le Samaria gam'a ana kithe cheh tauvin ahi.
en: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.
text:
ACT 8:1
Thadou: Saul jong chu Stephen kitha amittah a muho lah'a khat ahin, amatah in jong aphatsah ahi. Chuin hiche nikhoa kipat chun Jerusalema Houbung suhmangna dingin suhgentheina lentah ana kipan tan ahile Solchahho tailou tahsan chate jouse chu Judea le Samaria gam'a ana kithe cheh tauvin ahi.
English: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

tcz: Chuin Pathen a dinga kipumpeh mi themkhat in Stephen chu lunghemtah in ana vuiyun ahi.
en: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.
text:
ACT 8:2
Thadou: Chuin Pathen a dinga kipumpeh mi themkhat in Stephen chu lunghemtah in ana vuiyun ahi.
English: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

tcz: Ahin Saul chu achelen Houbungho chu ana sugentheiyin, a in tina alut in numei pasal akaidoh in songkul'a anaseplut jin ahi.
en: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.
text:
ACT 8:3
Thadou: Ahin Saul chu achelen Houbungho chu ana sugentheiyin, a in tina alut in numei pasal akaidoh in songkul'a anaseplut jin ahi.
English: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.

tcz: Ahinlah akithecheh tahsan chate chun achena lam lam uvah Yeshua thudol kipana thupha chu alhangsamle tauvin ahi.
en: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.
text:
ACT 8:4
Thadou: Ahinlah akithecheh tahsan chate chun achena lam lam uvah Yeshua thudol kipana thupha chu alhangsamle tauvin ahi.
English: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

tcz: Vetsahnan, Philip chu Samaria khopi sunga analut in miho koma Messiah chu ana samphong in ahi.
en: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.
text:
ACT 8:5
Thadou: Vetsahnan, Philip chu Samaria khopi sunga analut in miho koma Messiah chu ana samphong in ahi.
English: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.

tcz: Chuin mipi chun Philip thusei chu lungluttah in ana ngai uvin ahi.
en: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.
text:
ACT 8:6
Thadou: Chuin mipi chun Philip thusei chu lungluttah in ana ngai uvin ahi.
English: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

tcz: Chuin lhagaoboh tampi anodohin ahileh amaho chu apenguvin apotdoh tauvin chule lhangthi le elbai tampi jong aboldam in ahi.
en: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.
text:
ACT 8:7
Thadou: Chuin lhagaoboh tampi anodohin ahileh amaho chu apenguvin apotdoh tauvin chule lhangthi le elbai tampi jong aboldam in ahi.
English: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

tcz: Chuin hiche khopi achun kipana lentah alhungtan ahi.
en: There was great joy in that city.
text:
ACT 8:8
Thadou: Chuin hiche khopi achun kipana lentah alhungtan ahi.
English: There was great joy in that city.

tcz: Chuin Simon kiti doithemmi khat hiche gam'a chu kumsotpi anauma ahin, ama chun milen khat kahi tia Samaria mite chu kidang satah-a anaumsah ahi.
en: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,
text:
ACT 8:9
Thadou: Chuin Simon kiti doithemmi khat hiche gam'a chu kumsotpi anauma ahin, ama chun milen khat kahi tia Samaria mite chu kidang satah-a anaumsah ahi.
English: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

tcz: Mijouse aneova pat alen changeiyin hichepa chu “Milen khat-Pathen thahat” tia aseiyu ahi.
en: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”
text:
ACT 8:10
Thadou: Mijouse aneova pat alen changeiyin hichepa chu “Milen khat-Pathen thahat” tia aseiyu ahi.
English: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”

tcz: Chule ama chun adoiya kona phatsottah kidang satah-a anaumsah jeh-u chun amahon aseijouse chu abonchan angai jiuvin ahi.
en: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.
text:
ACT 8:11
Thadou: Chule ama chun adoiya kona phatsottah kidang satah-a anaumsah jeh-u chun amahon aseijouse chu abonchan angai jiuvin ahi.
English: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

tcz: Ahivangin mipi ho chun Philip in Pathen lenggam thule Yeshua Christa mina thupha asei chu atahsan tauvin, hijeh chun numei-pasal tampi twiyin baptize achang tauvin ahi.
en: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
text:
ACT 8:12
Thadou: Ahivangin mipi ho chun Philip in Pathen lenggam thule Yeshua Christa mina thupha asei chu atahsan tauvin, hijeh chun numei-pasal tampi twiyin baptize achang tauvin ahi.
English: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

tcz: Hichun Simon jengin jong atahsan in twiyin baptize achangtan, chule Philip chena chana anung ajuitan, Philip in melchihna le thil kidang lentah tampi abol chu kidang asalheh jengin ahi.
en: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.
text:
ACT 8:13
Thadou: Hichun Simon jengin jong atahsan in twiyin baptize achangtan, chule Philip chena chana anung ajuitan, Philip in melchihna le thil kidang lentah tampi abol chu kidang asalheh jengin ahi.
English: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

tcz: Chuin Jerusalema um solchah hon Samaria miten Pathen thu asang tauve ti ajah phat'un Peter le John chu asol tauvin ahi.
en: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,
text:
ACT 8:14
Thadou: Chuin Jerusalema um solchah hon Samaria miten Pathen thu asang tauve ti ajah phat'un Peter le John chu asol tauvin ahi.
English: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

tcz: Chuin alhun lhun lhonin hiche tahsan thahho chu Lhagao Theng achanna dingun atao tauvin ahi.
en: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

tcz: Chule tahsan thahho chunga chu Lhagao Theng hungloulai ahi, ajeh chu amaho chu Yeshua mina bou baptize chang nalaiyu ahi.
en: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.
text:
ACT 8:16
Thadou: Chule tahsan thahho chunga chu Lhagao Theng hungloulai ahi, ajeh chu amaho chu Yeshua mina bou baptize chang nalaiyu ahi.
English: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

tcz: Chuin Peter le John in hiche tahsan thahho chunga chu khut angap lhona ahileh amaho chu Lhagao Theng achang tauvin ahi.
en: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
text:
ACT 8:17
Thadou: Chuin Peter le John in hiche tahsan thahho chunga chu khut angap lhona ahileh amaho chu Lhagao Theng achang tauvin ahi.
English: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

tcz: Chuin Simon in Solchahho khutngap jeh a miho Lhagao Theng achanu chu amun ahileh aman jong sum peha hiche thahat chu kichoh ding agon,
en: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,
text:
ACT 8:18
Thadou: Chuin Simon in Solchahho khutngap jeh a miho Lhagao Theng achanu chu amun ahileh aman jong sum peha hiche thahat chu kichoh ding agon,
English: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,

tcz: “Kenjong hiche thaneina hi neijing kate chutile kenjong miho chunga khut kangap teng amaho jong Lhagao Theng chang dingu ahi!” ati.
en: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”
text:
ACT 8:19
Thadou: “Kenjong hiche thaneina hi neijing kate chutile kenjong miho chunga khut kangap teng amaho jong Lhagao Theng chang dingu ahi!” ati.
English: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”

tcz: Chuin Peter in adonbut in, “Nasum le nangma suhmangin umtha tan ajeh chun Pathen thilpeh hi chohtho dingin nangaitoi,
en: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!
text:
ACT 8:20
Thadou: Chuin Peter in adonbut in, “Nasum le nangma suhmangin umtha tan ajeh chun Pathen thilpeh hi chohtho dingin nangaitoi,
English: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

tcz: Hichea hin nangman chan naneipoi, ajeh chu Pathen mitmun nalungthim adihpoi.
en: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.
text:
ACT 8:21
Thadou: Hichea hin nangman chan naneipoi, ajeh chu Pathen mitmun nalungthim adihpoi.
English: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.

tcz: Hijeh chun nachonset lungheiyin lang, Pakai henga tao lechun aman nachonset lungput angaidam maithei ahi.
