en: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
text:
ACT 8:22
Thadou: Hijeh chun nachonset lungheiyin lang, Pakai henga tao lechun aman nachonset lungput angaidam maithei ahi.
English: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma hi thangthipna a dimset leh chonset'a kihen-oh nahi kamuchen tai,” ati
en: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”
text:
ACT 8:23
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangma hi thangthipna a dimset leh chonset'a kihen-oh nahi kamuchen tai,” ati
English: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”

tcz: Chuin Simon chun Peter koma, “Hitobang kichat umtah naseiho hi kachunga alhun lou nadingin Pakai koma nei taopeh in,” ati.
en: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”
text:
ACT 8:24
Thadou: Chuin Simon chun Peter koma, “Hitobang kichat umtah naseiho hi kachunga alhun lou nadingin Pakai koma nei taopeh in,” ati.
English: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”

tcz: Chuin Samaria-a Photchet nale Pathen thu lhangsapna aneijou lhon chun, Peter le John chu Jerusalem jonin ahung kile lhon in Samaria kho muntampi ah ahung kibangpa lhonin Kipana thupha ahin lhangsam peh lhonin ahi.
en: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.
text:
ACT 8:25
Thadou: Chuin Samaria-a Photchet nale Pathen thu lhangsapna aneijou lhon chun, Peter le John chu Jerusalem jonin ahung kile lhon in Samaria kho muntampi ah ahung kibangpa lhonin Kipana thupha ahin lhangsam peh lhonin ahi.
English: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

tcz: Philip vang chu Pakai vantil, “Lhanglam a Jerusalem a pat Gaza jotna gamthip'a chesuh lampi a khun chetan,” atipeh in ahi.
en: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”
text:
ACT 8:26
Thadou: Philip vang chu Pakai vantil, “Lhanglam a Jerusalem a pat Gaza jotna gamthip'a chesuh lampi a khun chetan,” atipeh in ahi.
English: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”

tcz: Chuin akipatdoh in achesuh tan ahileh Ethiopia gouching mikhat akimupin, ama chu Ethiopia lengnu noiya natong lentah nukiso ahin, hiche nukiso chu Jerusalema Pathen houva che ahi.
en: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.
text:
ACT 8:27
Thadou: Chuin akipatdoh in achesuh tan ahileh Ethiopia gouching mikhat akimupin, ama chu Ethiopia lengnu noiya natong lentah nukiso ahin, hiche nukiso chu Jerusalema Pathen houva che ahi.
English: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

tcz: Chule ahung kile lama kangtalaiya hungtouva Isaiah themgao lekhabu hi gingtah-a ahin sim ahi.
en: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.
text:
ACT 8:28
Thadou: Chule ahung kile lama kangtalaiya hungtouva Isaiah themgao lekhabu hi gingtah-a ahin sim ahi.
English: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

tcz: Chuin Lhagao Theng in Philip henga chun ahin seiyin, “Chenlang Kangtalaiya khun kilhon khom lhonin,” ati.
en: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”
text:
ACT 8:29
Thadou: Chuin Lhagao Theng in Philip henga chun ahin seiyin, “Chenlang Kangtalaiya khun kilhon khom lhonin,” ati.
English: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”

tcz: Chuin Philip chun aheng anaiyin ahileh mipan Isaiah themgao lekhabu asim chu ajan, hichun Philip in adongin “Nasim chu ipi kiseina ahi nahet nah em?” atile,
en: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
text:
ACT 8:30
Thadou: Chuin Philip chun aheng anaiyin ahileh mipan Isaiah themgao lekhabu asim chu ajan, hichun Philip in adongin “Nasim chu ipi kiseina ahi nahet nah em?” atile,
English: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”

tcz: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Eihil ding mikhat aum loule iti kahet ding ham?” atin ahi. Chuin mipa chun Philip chu akouvin hungin lang kangtalaiya toukhom hite ati.
en: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.
text:
ACT 8:31
Thadou: Mipa chun adonbut in, “Eihil ding mikhat aum loule iti kahet ding ham?” atin ahi. Chuin mipa chun Philip chu akouvin hungin lang kangtalaiya toukhom hite ati.
English: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

tcz: Chule Pathen lekhabu sunga asimmun chu hiche hi ahi, “Ama chu tha dinga kikai kelngoi nou bangin akaiyun, kelngoinou amul vouho angsunga thipbeh cha-a aum bangin, ama jong akam keh pon ahi.
en: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.
text:
ACT 8:32
Thadou: Chule Pathen lekhabu sunga asimmun chu hiche hi ahi, “Ama chu tha dinga kikai kelngoi nou bangin akaiyun, kelngoinou amul vouho angsunga thipbeh cha-a aum bangin, ama jong akam keh pon ahi.
English: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.

tcz: Akineosahna lamin achunga adih a thutanna aumtapon, koipen'in akhang thusim asei ding hitam? Ijeh inem itile a hinkho chu leiset'a kona alahdoh'u ahitai.”
en: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”
text:
ACT 8:33
Thadou: Akineosahna lamin achunga adih a thutanna aumtapon, koipen'in akhang thusim asei ding hitam? Ijeh inem itile a hinkho chu leiset'a kona alahdoh'u ahitai.”
English: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”

tcz: Chuin nukiso chun Philip chu adongin, “Themgaopa hin ama chung chang thudol asei ham ahiloule midang khat thudol asei ham nei seipeh in,” atin ahi.
en: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”
text:
ACT 8:34
Thadou: Chuin nukiso chun Philip chu adongin, “Themgaopa hin ama chung chang thudol asei ham ahiloule midang khat thudol asei ham nei seipeh in,” atin ahi.
English: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”

tcz: Chuin in Philip jong chuche Pathen lekhabu muna kona pansa in Yeshua thudol kipana thupha chu aseipeh pantan ahi.
en: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.
text:
ACT 8:35
Thadou: Chuin in Philip jong chuche Pathen lekhabu muna kona pansa in Yeshua thudol kipana thupha chu aseipeh pantan ahi.
English: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.

tcz: Chuin ache che lhonin ahile twi umna khat ahin phah hon phatin Nukiso chun, “Ven! Hikoma khun twi aume! Baptize kachanmo nading ipi um'em?” ati.
en: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”
text:
ACT 8:36
Thadou: Chuin ache che lhonin ahile twi umna khat ahin phah hon phatin Nukiso chun, “Ven! Hikoma khun twi aume! Baptize kachanmo nading ipi um'em?” ati.
English: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”

tcz: Chuin akangtalai lhon chu akham lhonin, twi lah'a chun akumsuh lhonin Philip in ama chu baptize achansah tan ahi.
en: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.
text:
ACT 8:38
Thadou: Chuin akangtalai lhon chu akham lhonin, twi lah'a chun akumsuh lhonin Philip in ama chu baptize achansah tan ahi.
English: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

tcz: Chuin twi lah-a kona ahung potdoh lhon chun Pakai Lhagaovin Philip chu alamang tan ahile, nukiso chun Philip chu amupha tapon, ahin alampi a chun kipah thanom tah'in achetan ahi.
en: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.
text:
ACT 8:39
Thadou: Chuin twi lah-a kona ahung potdoh lhon chun Pakai Lhagaovin Philip chu alamang tan ahile, nukiso chun Philip chu amupha tapon, ahin alampi a chun kipah thanom tah'in achetan ahi.
English: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

tcz: Chomkhat jouvin Philip chu sahlam a um Azotus muna chun akimudoh kit in, hichun aman Caesarea ahinphah chanin kipana thupha chu ahin sam phonglen ahi.
en: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.
text:
ACT 8:40
Thadou: Chomkhat jouvin Philip chu sahlam a um Azotus muna chun akimudoh kit in, hichun aman Caesarea ahinphah chanin kipana thupha chu ahin sam phonglen ahi.
English: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.

tcz: Ahin Saul vang chu Pakai nungjuiho gihsal le that dingin ahai hai nalaiyin, hijeh chun thempu chungnung henga achen,
en: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
text:
ACT 9:1
Thadou: Ahin Saul vang chu Pakai nungjuiho gihsal le that dingin ahai hai nalaiyin, hijeh chun thempu chungnung henga achen,
English: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

tcz: Damascus khopia kikhopna in hoa dingin lekha agathumin, chule koi hijongle hiche lampi tahsanho jouse chu numei hihen, pasal hijongle akana Jerusalem ahinlhutna dingin kithopina agathumin ahi.
en: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
text:
ACT 9:2
Thadou: Damascus khopia kikhopna in hoa dingin lekha agathumin, chule koi hijongle hiche lampi tahsanho jouse chu numei hihen, pasal hijongle akana Jerusalem ahinlhutna dingin kithopina agathumin ahi.
English: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

tcz: Hiche tupna neipuma achelaiyin Damascus khopi anaitah chun vana konin phulou helouvin vah-in akimvel ahin salin,
en: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.
text:
ACT 9:3
Thadou: Hiche tupna neipuma achelaiyin Damascus khopi anaitah chun vana konin phulou helouvin vah-in akimvel ahin salin,
English: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

tcz: Chuin ama tol'a alhun chule “Saul! Saul! Ipi dinga neibolset ham?” tia kisam aw khat ajan,
en: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
text:
ACT 9:4
Thadou: Chuin ama tol'a alhun chule “Saul! Saul! Ipi dinga neibolset ham?” tia kisam aw khat ajan,
English: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”

tcz: Chuin Saul in jong “Pakai nang koi nahim?” tin adong tan ahi. Chuin aw chun ahin donbut-in “Keima Yeshua, nabolset jingpa chu kahi!
en: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
text:
ACT 9:5
Thadou: Chuin Saul in jong “Pakai nang koi nahim?” tin adong tan ahi. Chuin aw chun ahin donbut-in “Keima Yeshua, nabolset jingpa chu kahi!
English: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

tcz: Tun kipatdoh in khopi sunga khun lut-in nabol ding ho nakiseipeh ding ahi,” ati.
en: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”
text:
ACT 9:6
Thadou: Tun kipatdoh in khopi sunga khun lut-in nabol ding ho nakiseipeh ding ahi,” ati.
English: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

tcz: Chuin Saul toh kilhon khom ho chu paopoh loubeh-in aum tauvin ahi, ajehchu Saul koma thusei aw chu ajauvin ahin koima la amu pouvin ahi.
en: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
text:
ACT 9:7
Thadou: Chuin Saul toh kilhon khom ho chu paopoh loubeh-in aum tauvin ahi, ajehchu Saul koma thusei aw chu ajauvin ahin koima la amu pouvin ahi.
English: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

tcz: Chuin Saul chu tol'a kona ahung dindoh-a amit ahasah-le kho amutapon hijeh chun alhonkhompi hon akhut-in akaiyun Damascus khopi sung alut tauvin ahi.
en: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.
text:
ACT 9:8
Thadou: Chuin Saul chu tol'a kona ahung dindoh-a amit ahasah-le kho amutapon hijeh chun alhonkhompi hon akhut-in akaiyun Damascus khopi sung alut tauvin ahi.
English: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

tcz: Chuin khopi sunga chun nithum sungin an nelou twidon louvin aumden tan ahi.
en: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.
text:
ACT 9:9
Thadou: Chuin khopi sunga chun nithum sungin an nelou twidon louvin aumden tan ahi.
English: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

tcz: Chuin Damascus khopi sunga tahsan mikhat amin Ananias kitipa chu Pakaiyin akimusah in “Ananias!” tin akouvin ahileh amapan, “Hikoma kaumnai Pakai!” atin ahi.
en: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”
text:
ACT 9:10
Thadou: Chuin Damascus khopi sunga tahsan mikhat amin Ananias kitipa chu Pakaiyin akimusah in “Ananias!” tin akouvin ahileh amapan, “Hikoma kaumnai Pakai!” atin ahi.
English: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”

tcz: Chuin Pakaiyin adonbut in “Namasanga lampi jangkeiya khun chenlang Judas in'a khun galut tan, chule insunga khu nalut tengle Tarsus gammi Saul kitipa chu gahol tan ajeh chu ama kahenga ataopettah ahi.
en: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,
text:
ACT 9:11
Thadou: Chuin Pakaiyin adonbut in “Namasanga lampi jangkeiya khun chenlang Judas in'a khun galut tan, chule insunga khu nalut tengle Tarsus gammi Saul kitipa chu gahol tan ajeh chu ama kahenga ataopettah ahi.
English: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

tcz: Chule hichepa khun Ananias kiti mikhat ahenga hunga aluchunga khut angap'a chutengle kho amukit ding khu kamusah ahi,” ati.
en: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”
text:
ACT 9:12
Thadou: Chule hichepa khun Ananias kiti mikhat ahenga hunga aluchunga khut angap'a chutengle kho amukit ding khu kamusah ahi,” ati.
English: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”

tcz: Ahivangin Ananias in adonbut in “Pakai hiche mipa hin Jerusalema tahsan chate kichat umtah-a abol genthei thu mitam tah-a kona kajah ahitai,
en: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.
text:
ACT 9:13
Thadou: Ahivangin Ananias in adonbut in “Pakai hiche mipa hin Jerusalema tahsan chate kichat umtah-a abol genthei thu mitam tah-a kona kajah ahitai,
English: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

tcz: chule hoilai mun hijong le nangma min kouho jouse amat a songkul'a akhum thei nadinga thempu pipuihon thaneina apeh'u ahitai,” ati.
en: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”
text:
ACT 9:14
Thadou: chule hoilai mun hijong le nangma min kouho jouse amat a songkul'a akhum thei nadinga thempu pipuihon thaneina apeh'u ahitai,” ati.
English: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”

tcz: Ahin Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Chen ajeh chu Saul khu chidang namdangte le lengho chuleh Israelte henga kathu lhangsam dinga kalhendoh ahitai,
en: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.
text:
ACT 9:15
Thadou: Ahin Pakaiyin aseiyin, “Chen ajeh chu Saul khu chidang namdangte le lengho chuleh Israelte henga kathu lhangsam dinga kalhendoh ahitai,
English: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

tcz: Chule tua hi kamin jal'a itobang genthei athoh ding ham kavetsah ding ahi,” ati.
en: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
text:
ACT 9:16
Thadou: Chule tua hi kamin jal'a itobang genthei athoh ding ham kavetsah ding ahi,” ati.
English: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”

tcz: Chuin Ananias chu achen ahileh Saul chu amutan hichun aluchunga akhut angamin aseitai, “Sopi Saul, kho namukit nading le Lhagao Thenga nadimsetna dinga lampia nakimusah Pakai Yeshua chun nahenga eihin sol ahi,” ati.
en: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
text:
ACT 9:17
Thadou: Chuin Ananias chu achen ahileh Saul chu amutan hichun aluchunga akhut angamin aseitai, “Sopi Saul, kho namukit nading le Lhagao Thenga nadimsetna dinga lampia nakimusah Pakai Yeshua chun nahenga eihin sol ahi,” ati.
English: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

tcz: Chuin apettah chun lip tobang thilkhat Saul mit a kon chun ahung kilehlhan ahileh Saul chun kho amutan ahi. Chutah chun Saul chu akipatdoh in baptize achangtan ahi.
en: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.
text:
ACT 9:18
Thadou: Chuin apettah chun lip tobang thilkhat Saul mit a kon chun ahung kilehlhan ahileh Saul chun kho amutan ahi. Chutah chun Saul chu akipatdoh in baptize achangtan ahi.
English: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

tcz: Chujouvin Saul chun an themkhat anen ahileh athahatdoh kit tan, chuin Damascus khopi sunga tahsan chate koma chun nikho phabep aum den tan ahi.
en: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
text:
ACT 9:19
Thadou: Chujouvin Saul chun an themkhat anen ahileh athahatdoh kit tan, chuin Damascus khopi sunga tahsan chate koma chun nikho phabep aum den tan ahi.
English: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

tcz: Chule apettah chun Yeshua thudol chu asamphong pantan kikhopna in tin'ah, “Yeshua chu Pathen Chapa ahi,” tin asamle tan ahi.
en: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.
text:
ACT 9:20
Thadou: Chule apettah chun Yeshua thudol chu asamphong pantan kikhopna in tin'ah, “Yeshua chu Pathen Chapa ahi,” tin asamle tan ahi.
English: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

tcz: Chuin athu lhangsap japha jousen kidang asauvin, “Hichepa hi Jerusalema Yeshua seijuiho suhmang ding gopa chu hilou ham?” atiuvin ahi. Chule “Hikoma hi seijuiho man dingle kanchoma thempu ho henga kaidinga hung hilou ham?” atiuvin ahi
en: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”
text:
ACT 9:21
Thadou: Chuin athu lhangsap japha jousen kidang asauvin, “Hichepa hi Jerusalema Yeshua seijuiho suhmang ding gopa chu hilou ham?” atiuvin ahi. Chule “Hikoma hi seijuiho man dingle kanchoma thempu ho henga kaidinga hung hilou ham?” atiuvin ahi
English: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”

tcz: Saul thulhangsap chu ahung thahat cheh cheh jeng tan ahileh Damascus khopia um Juda mite chun Yeshua chu Messiah ahi ti avetsahna apeh ho chu anel jou tapouvin ahi.
en: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.
text:
ACT 9:22
Thadou: Saul thulhangsap chu ahung thahat cheh cheh jeng tan ahileh Damascus khopia um Juda mite chun Yeshua chu Messiah ahi ti avetsahna apeh ho chu anel jou tapouvin ahi.
English: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

tcz: Chuche phat chomkhat jou chun Judah mite phabep khat ahung khomun ama chu thading agouvin,
en: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,
text:
ACT 9:23
Thadou: Chuche phat chomkhat jou chun Judah mite phabep khat ahung khomun ama chu thading agouvin,
English: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

tcz: Ama chu thatei nadingin khopi kelkot dunga sun le jan in achanglhi jingun, ahin mihon thading agonu thu chu aseipeh un,
en: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,
text:
ACT 9:24
Thadou: Ama chu thatei nadingin khopi kelkot dunga sun le jan in achanglhi jingun, ahin mihon thading agonu thu chu aseipeh un,
English: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

tcz: Hijeh chun seijuiho mi phabep khat chun jankah in Saul chu boma akhumun khopi bang onglai khat'ah khaovin akhai lha tauvin ahi.
en: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.
text:
ACT 9:25
Thadou: Hijeh chun seijuiho mi phabep khat chun jankah in Saul chu boma akhumun khopi bang onglai khat'ah khaovin akhai lha tauvin ahi.
English: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

tcz: Chuin Saul chu Jerusalem ahung lhunin, seijuiho kimupi ding agon ahileh amaho abonun akichauvin ahi ajeh chu seijui dihtah ahiding chu atahsan lou-u ahi!
en: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
text:
ACT 9:26
Thadou: Chuin Saul chu Jerusalem ahung lhunin, seijuiho kimupi ding agon ahileh amaho abonun akichauvin ahi ajeh chu seijui dihtah ahiding chu atahsan lou-u ahi!
English: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

tcz: Chuin Barnabas chun Saul chu solchah ho henga apuilut in Damascus lampia Saul in Pakai akimupi thule Pakaiyin Saul henga asei thuho abonchan solchah ho henga aseipeh in chule Damascus khopia Saul in Yeshua mina hangsan tah-a thu asei jong chu aseipeh in ahi.
en: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.
text:
ACT 9:27
Thadou: Chuin Barnabas chun Saul chu solchah ho henga apuilut in Damascus lampia Saul in Pakai akimupi thule Pakaiyin Saul henga asei thuho abonchan solchah ho henga aseipeh in chule Damascus khopia Saul in Yeshua mina hangsan tah-a thu asei jong chu aseipeh in ahi.
English: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

tcz: Chuin Greek pao tho Juda te toh akinil un ahile Juda miho chun thading agouvin ahi.
en: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.
text:
ACT 9:29
Thadou: Chuin Greek pao tho Juda te toh akinil un ahile Juda miho chun thading agouvin ahi.
English: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.

tcz: Seijui hon chuche thu ajah phat'un Caesarea lama apuisuh un achenna Tarsus lama asol mang tauvin ahi.
en: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
text:
ACT 9:30
Thadou: Seijui hon chuche thu ajah phat'un Caesarea lama apuisuh un achenna Tarsus lama asol mang tauvin ahi.
English: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

tcz: Chuin Judea gam le Galilee gamsung chule Samaria gamsung pumpia Houbung chu mongtah-in aumtauvin chule seijui hon Pakai agin jeh'u chun athahat cheh cheh uvin ahi. Chule Lhagao Theng in aumpi jeh-u chun seijui jong akibe jingin ahi.
en: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.
text:
ACT 9:31
Thadou: Chuin Judea gam le Galilee gamsung chule Samaria gamsung pumpia Houbung chu mongtah-in aumtauvin chule seijui hon Pakai agin jeh'u chun athahat cheh cheh uvin ahi. Chule Lhagao Theng in aumpi jeh-u chun seijui jong akibe jingin ahi.
English: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

tcz: Chujongle Peter chu munkhat a konin munkhat ah avahle len chuin Lydda khopia seijui ho vilding in ahung kumsuh in ahile,
en: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.
text:
ACT 9:32
Thadou: Chujongle Peter chu munkhat a konin munkhat ah avahle len chuin Lydda khopia seijui ho vilding in ahung kumsuh in ahile,
English: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

tcz: Hikoma chun Aeneas kiti mikhat langthi-a kumget jen jalkhun a lumpa chu agamudoh tan,
en: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.
text:
ACT 9:33
Thadou: Hikoma chun Aeneas kiti mikhat langthi-a kumget jen jalkhun a lumpa chu agamudoh tan,
English: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.

tcz: Chuin Peter in ajah a “Aeneas, Yeshua Christan nadamsah ahitai! Thouvin lang nalupna kijeldoh tan,” ati. Chupettah chun ama adamtan ahi.
en: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.
text:
ACT 9:34
Thadou: Chuin Peter in ajah a “Aeneas, Yeshua Christan nadamsah ahitai! Thouvin lang nalupna kijeldoh tan,” ati. Chupettah chun ama adamtan ahi.
English: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

tcz: Chuin Lydda le Sharon khopi sunga mijouse chun Aeneas in lam ajot-a avale chu amu-uvin, abonchauvin Pakai lamah ahung kihei tauvin ahi.
en: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.
text:
ACT 9:35
Thadou: Chuin Lydda le Sharon khopi sunga mijouse chun Aeneas in lam ajot-a avale chu amu-uvin, abonchauvin Pakai lamah ahung kihei tauvin ahi.
English: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

tcz: Chuin Joppa atiu mun a chun seijui mikhat Tabitha (Greek paova Dorcas) atiu chu aumin, amanu chun midang dingin thilpha abol jingin, genthei ho akithopi jingin ahi.
en: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.
text:
ACT 9:36
Thadou: Chuin Joppa atiu mun a chun seijui mikhat Tabitha (Greek paova Dorcas) atiu chu aumin, amanu chun midang dingin thilpha abol jingin, genthei ho akithopi jingin ahi.
English: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

tcz: Amanu chu ahung dammo in athitan ahileh atahsa chu asiltheng-uvin vuidingin indan chungnunga chun alupsah tauvin ahi.
en: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.
text:
ACT 9:37
Thadou: Amanu chu ahung dammo in athitan ahileh atahsa chu asiltheng-uvin vuidingin indan chungnunga chun alupsah tauvin ahi.
English: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

tcz: Ahivangin seijuiho chun Peter chu Lydda koma aume tithu ajauvin hijeh chun mini asol-uvin, Peter henga “Lungset tah-in aganna thei penin hungin,” tin aga kousah tauvin ahi.
en: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
text:
ACT 9:38
Thadou: Ahivangin seijuiho chun Peter chu Lydda koma aume tithu ajauvin hijeh chun mini asol-uvin, Peter henga “Lungset tah-in aganna thei penin hungin,” tin aga kousah tauvin ahi.
English: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

tcz: Chuin Peter chu akouva cheteni chutoh ahung kile khomin ahileh ahung lhun lhun chun amahon Peter chu indan chungnunga chun apuitouvun ahileh insunga chun meithai ho adimset uvin kap pumin a sangkhol hou-le von dang Dorcas in adam laiya anabolpeh houchu avetsah'un ahi.
en: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.
text:
ACT 9:39
Thadou: Chuin Peter chu akouva cheteni chutoh ahung kile khomin ahileh ahung lhun lhun chun amahon Peter chu indan chungnunga chun apuitouvun ahileh insunga chun meithai ho adimset uvin kap pumin a sangkhol hou-le von dang Dorcas in adam laiya anabolpeh houchu avetsah'un ahi.
English: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

tcz: Ahivangin Peter chun abonchauvin insunga konchun asoldoh-in chuin ama adilsun atahsa alupsah-u chu aven “Thoudoh in Tabitha,” tin atao tan ahileh amit ahung hahdoh in, chuin amanun Peter amuphat in ahung toudoh tan ahi.
en: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
text:
ACT 9:40
Thadou: Ahivangin Peter chun abonchauvin insunga konchun asoldoh-in chuin ama adilsun atahsa alupsah-u chu aven “Thoudoh in Tabitha,” tin atao tan ahileh amit ahung hahdoh in, chuin amanun Peter amuphat in ahung toudoh tan ahi.
English: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

tcz: Chuin aman akhut in akaiding in chule meithaiho le seijuiho chu abonchan akoulut-in amanu chu ahing in apetan ahi.
en: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
text:
ACT 9:41
Thadou: Chuin aman akhut in akaiding in chule meithaiho le seijuiho chu abonchan akoulut-in amanu chu ahing in apetan ahi.
English: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

tcz: Hiche thu chu khopi sunga akithang soh tan ahileh mitam tah-in Pakai atahsan tan ahi.
en: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
text:
ACT 9:42
Thadou: Hiche thu chu khopi sunga akithang soh tan ahileh mitam tah-in Pakai atahsan tan ahi.
English: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

tcz: Chule Peter chu Joppa muna savun sem Simon in'ah nisottah aum dentan ahi.
en: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
text:
ACT 9:43
Thadou: Chule Peter chu Joppa muna savun sem Simon in'ah nisottah aum dentan ahi.
English: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.

tcz: Rome te sepai lamkai Cornelius atiu mikhat Caesarea ah ana chengin, ama chu Italia loi atiu sepai jalamkai ahi.
en: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
text:
ACT 10:1
Thadou: Rome te sepai lamkai Cornelius atiu mikhat Caesarea ah ana chengin, ama chu Italia loi atiu sepai jalamkai ahi.
English: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

tcz: Amapa chu Pathen ngaisah tah le ainsung mi jouse toh Pathen gingmi ahin; migenthei ho hongphal tah-a pejing le Pathen henga taojing mi ahi.
en: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.
text:
ACT 10:2
Thadou: Amapa chu Pathen ngaisah tah le ainsung mi jouse toh Pathen gingmi ahin; migenthei ho hongphal tah-a pejing le Pathen henga taojing mi ahi.
English: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

tcz: Nikhat nilhah lam nidan thum donin mu aneiyin athilmu achun Pathen vantil khat ahenga ahungin “Cornelius!” ahung tin ahi.
en: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”
text:
ACT 10:3
Thadou: Nikhat nilhah lam nidan thum donin mu aneiyin athilmu achun Pathen vantil khat ahenga ahungin “Cornelius!” ahung tin ahi.
English: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”

tcz: Chuin Cornelius chun kichatah-in aven, “Ipi ham Pakai,” tin adong tan ahi. Chule Vantil chun ahin donbut in, “Nataona le migenthei ho dinga nathilpeh ho chu Pathen in thilto bangin nasanpeh tai!
en: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.
text:
ACT 10:4
Thadou: Chuin Cornelius chun kichatah-in aven, “Ipi ham Pakai,” tin adong tan ahi. Chule Vantil chun ahin donbut in, “Nataona le migenthei ho dinga nathilpeh ho chu Pathen in thilto bangin nasanpeh tai!
English: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.

tcz: Tun nangman mi themkhat solin lang Joppa-a um Simon Peter kitipa khu gakousah tan.
en: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.
text:
ACT 10:5
Thadou: Tun nangman mi themkhat solin lang Joppa-a um Simon Peter kitipa khu gakousah tan.
English: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

tcz: Ama twikhanglen panga Simon kiti savun sem mikhat in'ah aume,” ati.
en: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.
text:
ACT 10:6
Thadou: Ama twikhanglen panga Simon kiti savun sem mikhat in'ah aume,” ati.
English: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.

tcz: Chuin vantil in adalhah lhah in Cornelius chun ainsunga lhacha ni le akinbola pang jing Pathen ngaisah tah sepai ho lah a khat akouvin,
en: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.
text:
ACT 10:7
Thadou: Chuin vantil in adalhah lhah in Cornelius chun ainsunga lhacha ni le akinbola pang jing Pathen ngaisah tah sepai ho lah a khat akouvin,
English: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

tcz: Thilsoh jouse aseipeh jouvin amaho chu Joppa ah asol tan ahi.
en: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.
text:
ACT 10:8
Thadou: Thilsoh jouse aseipeh jouvin amaho chu Joppa ah asol tan ahi.
English: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

tcz: Ajing nikho in Cornelius thupoho khopi sung alhun ding konun Peter chu indan chunga tao dingin ahung kaldoh in hichu sun nidan som don ahi.
en: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.
text:
ACT 10:9
Thadou: Ajing nikho in Cornelius thupoho khopi sung alhun ding konun Peter chu indan chunga tao dingin ahung kaldoh in hichu sun nidan som don ahi.
English: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

tcz: Chule ama chu agilkel in, ahivangin aneh ding an asem laitah-un ama agaochangin,
en: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.
text:
ACT 10:10
Thadou: Chule ama chu agilkel in, ahivangin aneh ding an asem laitah-un ama agaochangin,
English: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

tcz: Chuin vankot akihona lekha pheng lentah tobang khat aning lia ahung kikhai lhah amun,
en: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,
text:
ACT 10:11
Thadou: Chuin vankot akihona lekha pheng lentah tobang khat aning lia ahung kikhai lhah amun,
English: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

tcz: Chuin hiche lekha pheng lentah tobang sunga chun ganhing namkim le tol'a vah ganhing chule chunga leng vacha ho aumun,
en: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.
text:
ACT 10:12
Thadou: Chuin hiche lekha pheng lentah tobang sunga chun ganhing namkim le tol'a vah ganhing chule chunga leng vacha ho aumun,
English: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

tcz: Chuin aw khat in ahenga ahin seiyin, “Peter, kipatdoh inlang chule kithan lang nen,” ati.
en: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”
text:
ACT 10:13
Thadou: Chuin aw khat in ahenga ahin seiyin, “Peter, kipatdoh inlang chule kithan lang nen,” ati.
English: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”

tcz: Chuin Peter in adonbut in, “Ahipoi Pakai, ajeh chu imatih chanin keiman Judate dan thu dungjuiya satheng lou le saboh kanekhapoi,” ati.
en: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”
text:
ACT 10:14
Thadou: Chuin Peter in adonbut in, “Ahipoi Pakai, ajeh chu imatih chanin keiman Judate dan thu dungjuiya satheng lou le saboh kanekhapoi,” ati.
English: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”

tcz: Ahivangin aw chun ahinsei kit-in, “Pathen in asuhtheng sa chu athenglou tidan,” ati.
en: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
text:
ACT 10:15
Thadou: Ahivangin aw chun ahinsei kit-in, “Pathen in asuhtheng sa chu athenglou tidan,” ati.
English: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”

tcz: chuti chun thumveijen kibang chet'in mu aneiyin chujouvin hetmanlou kah'in lekha pheng lentah tobang chu vana khai touvin aumtan ahi.
en: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.
text:
ACT 10:16
Thadou: chuti chun thumveijen kibang chet'in mu aneiyin chujouvin hetmanlou kah'in lekha pheng lentah tobang chu vana khai touvin aumtan ahi.
English: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.

tcz: Chuin Peter chun gaova athilmu chu ipi kiseina ahidem tia lunggim tah-a ana umlaitah in Cornelius in ahin sol miho chun Simon in chu ahin holdoh-un, amaho chu kelkot ah ana dinguvin,
en: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,
text:
ACT 10:17
Thadou: Chuin Peter chun gaova athilmu chu ipi kiseina ahidem tia lunggim tah-a ana umlaitah in Cornelius in ahin sol miho chun Simon in chu ahin holdoh-un, amaho chu kelkot ah ana dinguvin,
English: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,

tcz: Amaho chun hiche laiya hi Simon Peter kiti mikhat cheng em tin adong-un ahi.
en: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.
text:
ACT 10:18
Thadou: Amaho chun hiche laiya hi Simon Peter kiti mikhat cheng em tin adong-un ahi.
English: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.

tcz: Chuin Peter in gaova athilmu chu ipi ahidem tia ana gel jing laiyin Lhagao Thengin ahenga thu ahin seiyin, “Mithum tah in nangma nahol'e,
en: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.
text:
ACT 10:19
Thadou: Chuin Peter in gaova athilmu chu ipi ahidem tia ana gel jing laiyin Lhagao Thengin ahenga thu ahin seiyin, “Mithum tah in nangma nahol'e,
English: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.

tcz: Kipatdoh in, kumsuh inlang amaho toh kilhon ding khu thase hih beh in, chule lungkham hih in ajeh chu keiman amaho khu kahin sol ahi,” ati.
en: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”
text:
ACT 10:20
Thadou: Kipatdoh in, kumsuh inlang amaho toh kilhon ding khu thase hih beh in, chule lungkham hih in ajeh chu keiman amaho khu kahin sol ahi,” ati.
English: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”

tcz: Chuin Peter akum suh in amaho koma “Nahol-u mipa chu keima kahi, ipi dinga hung nahiu vem?” tin adong tan ahile,
en: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”
text:
ACT 10:21
Thadou: Chuin Peter akum suh in amaho koma “Nahol-u mipa chu keima kahi, ipi dinga hung nahiu vem?” tin adong tan ahile,
English: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”

tcz: Amahon adonbut-un, “Keiho hi Cornelius kiti Pathen gingtah mi chule Judaten ajabol-u Rome sepai jalamkai pa chun eihin sol-u ahin, chule nangma thusei hi ainsung mite toh angaithei nadinga vantil theng khat'in thu apeh bang banga nakouva hung kahiuve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”
text:
ACT 10:22
Thadou: Amahon adonbut-un, “Keiho hi Cornelius kiti Pathen gingtah mi chule Judaten ajabol-u Rome sepai jalamkai pa chun eihin sol-u ahin, chule nangma thusei hi ainsung mite toh angaithei nadinga vantil theng khat'in thu apeh bang banga nakouva hung kahiuve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”

tcz: Chuin Peter in amaho chu akoulut in a-in'ah jankhat agesah-in, ajing in Joppa a kona sopi themkhat toh akilhon tauvin ahi.
en: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.
text:
ACT 10:23
Thadou: Chuin Peter in amaho chu akoulut in a-in'ah jankhat agesah-in, ajing in Joppa a kona sopi themkhat toh akilhon tauvin ahi.
English: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

tcz: Ajing nikhon amaho Caesarea ahung lhung tauvin ahile Cornelius in a-insung mite le aloi agolho ana koukhomin ana ngah tauvin ahi.
en: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.
text:
ACT 10:24
Thadou: Ajing nikhon amaho Caesarea ahung lhung tauvin ahile Cornelius in a-insung mite le aloi agolho ana koukhomin ana ngah tauvin ahi.
English: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.

tcz: Chuin Peter insunga alut in ahile Cornelius chu akengbula abohkhup in chibai abohtan ahi.
en: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
text:
ACT 10:25
Thadou: Chuin Peter insunga alut in ahile Cornelius chu akengbula abohkhup in chibai abohtan ahi.
English: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

tcz: Ahinlah Peter chun akai dingin, “Dingdoh in keijong nang banga mihem khat kahi bouve!” ati.
en: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”
text:
ACT 10:26
Thadou: Ahinlah Peter chun akai dingin, “Dingdoh in keijong nang banga mihem khat kahi bouve!” ati.
English: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

tcz: Chuti chun amani akihoulim lim lhonin insunga mitampi kikhop khomna achun alut lhon in,
en: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.
text:
ACT 10:27
Thadou: Chuti chun amani akihoulim lim lhonin insunga mitampi kikhop khomna achun alut lhon in,
English: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.

tcz: Chuin Peter in amaho henga chun, “Judah mikhat hitia chidang namdangte in'a alut hi Judah te chonna dan toh kitoh lou ahi naheuve, Ahin Pathen in koima aboh le athenglou tia kagel lou nadinga eimusah ahitai.
en: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.
text:
ACT 10:28
Thadou: Chuin Peter in amaho henga chun, “Judah mikhat hitia chidang namdangte in'a alut hi Judah te chonna dan toh kitoh lou ahi naheuve, Ahin Pathen in koima aboh le athenglou tia kagel lou nadinga eimusah ahitai.
English: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.

tcz: Hijeh a chu lungthoi louhela eihin kou banga kahung jeng ahi. Tun ipi dinga neihin kou ham seitan,” ati.
en: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”
text:
ACT 10:29
Thadou: Hijeh a chu lungthoi louhela eihin kou banga kahung jeng ahi. Tun ipi dinga neihin kou ham seitan,” ati.
English: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”

tcz: Chuin Cornelius in adonbut in, “Nili masang, tuphat chet nilhah lang nidan thum donin ka insunga kataovin ahileh, hetman lou kah-in ka masang laitah a ponbanga kivon mikhat ka-anga ahung dingin;
en: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing

tcz: Hitin ahin seiyin ahi, ‘Cornelius Pathen in nataona ajatan genthei ho dinga nathil pha bol jong amutai!
en: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.
text:
ACT 10:31
Thadou: Hitin ahin seiyin ahi, ‘Cornelius Pathen in nataona ajatan genthei ho dinga nathil pha bol jong amutai!
English: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

tcz: Tun nangman Joppa a mi solin lang, Simon Peter kiti mipa khu gakousah tan. Ama twikhanglen panga Simon kiti savun sempa in'ah aume’ ati.
en: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’
text:
ACT 10:32
Thadou: Tun nangman Joppa a mi solin lang, Simon Peter kiti mipa khu gakousah tan. Ama twikhanglen panga Simon kiti savun sempa in'ah aume’ ati.
English: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’

tcz: Hijeh a chu nangma kouva mi kahin sol ahin, nahung hi apha lheh jenge, chule tun Pakaiyin thu napehho ngaiding in hikoma Pathen angsunga ahin ibon chauvin iki khom tauve,” ati.
en: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”
text:
ACT 10:33
Thadou: Hijeh a chu nangma kouva mi kahin sol ahin, nahung hi apha lheh jenge, chule tun Pakaiyin thu napehho ngaiding in hikoma Pathen angsunga ahin ibon chauvin iki khom tauve,” ati.
English: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”

tcz: Chuin Peter in adon but-in, “Pathen in mi lungset tum anei poi ti kichen tah in kamutai;
en: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;

tcz: Ahin chitin namtin lah a koi hijongle Ama ginga thildih bolho chu ama dinga lahthei ahi.
en: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
text:
ACT 10:35
Thadou: Ahin chitin namtin lah a koi hijongle Ama ginga thildih bolho chu ama dinga lahthei ahi.
English: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

tcz: Chule hiche hi Israel chatea dinga kipana thupha ahi–Yeshua Christa mijouse Pakai vanga Pathen toh kichamna aum hi.
en: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
text:
ACT 10:36
Thadou: Chule hiche hi Israel chatea dinga kipana thupha ahi–Yeshua Christa mijouse Pakai vanga Pathen toh kichamna aum hi.
English: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—

tcz: John in twilut thudol ahin lhangsap pat a pat Galilee a kipan Judea gam pumpia ipi thilsoh em nanghon naheuve.
en: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

tcz: Chule Pathen in Nazareth Yeshua chu Lhagao Theng le thahatna-a thao anua chule Yeshua avalea thilpha abolho leh Pathen in aumpi jal'a satan suhgima umho aboldam chu nanghon naheuve.
en: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
text:
ACT 10:38
Thadou: Chule Pathen in Nazareth Yeshua chu Lhagao Theng le thahatna-a thao anua chule Yeshua avalea thilpha abolho leh Pathen in aumpi jal'a satan suhgima umho aboldam chu nanghon naheuve.
English: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

tcz: Chule keiho solchahho hi Judah gam pumpi le Jerusalema athilbol ho jouse hettohsah kahiuve. Ama chu thingpel chunga akhaisang un athat tauve.
en: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.
text:
ACT 10:39
Thadou: Chule keiho solchahho hi Judah gam pumpi le Jerusalema athilbol ho jouse hettohsah kahiuve. Ama chu thingpel chunga akhaisang un athat tauve.
English: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.

tcz: Ahin Pathen in ama chu anithum nin akaithou vin aki phondohsah tan ahi.
en: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,
text:
ACT 10:40
Thadou: Ahin Pathen in ama chu anithum nin akaithou vin aki phondohsah tan ahi.
English: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,

tcz: Hichu mijouse henga hilouvin, athu hettohsah dinga Pathen in ana lhendoh sa, athodoh jouva amatoh nekhom le donkhom keiho henga kiphong ahi.
en: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
text:
ACT 10:41
Thadou: Hichu mijouse henga hilouvin, athu hettohsah dinga Pathen in ana lhendoh sa, athodoh jouva amatoh nekhom le donkhom keiho henga kiphong ahi.
English: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

tcz: Chule Yeshua chu mihing le mithi ho jouse thutan ahi ti thudol hi hille ding le hettoh sah dinga keiho hi thu eipeh-u ahi.
en: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.
text:
ACT 10:42
Thadou: Chule Yeshua chu mihing le mithi ho jouse thutan ahi ti thudol hi hille ding le hettoh sah dinga keiho hi thu eipeh-u ahi.
English: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

tcz: Ama tahsan ho jouse Amin jal a achonset nau kingaidam ding ahi tia themgao ho jousen ahettoh sah-u chu ama chu ahi,” ati.
en: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”
text:
ACT 10:43
Thadou: Ama tahsan ho jouse Amin jal a achonset nau kingaidam ding ahi tia themgao ho jousen ahettoh sah-u chu ama chu ahi,” ati.
English: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”

tcz: Chuin Peter in thu hicheng asei jing laiyin athu ngaiho jouse chunga Lhagao Theng ahung chutan ahile,
en: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.
text:
ACT 10:44
Thadou: Chuin Peter in thu hicheng asei jing laiyin athu ngaiho jouse chunga Lhagao Theng ahung chutan ahile,
English: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

tcz: Peter toh hung khom Judah mi atahsan ho chun chidang namdang te chunga jong Lhagao Theng akipeh chu kidang asalheh jengun ahi.
en: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.
text:
ACT 10:45
Thadou: Peter toh hung khom Judah mi atahsan ho chun chidang namdang te chunga jong Lhagao Theng akipeh chu kidang asalheh jengun ahi.
English: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

tcz: Ijeh-inem itile amahon paochom paochoma thu aseiyuva Pathen avahchoi uchu ajah-u ahi.
en: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,
text:
ACT 10:46
Thadou: Ijeh-inem itile amahon paochom paochoma thu aseiyuva Pathen avahchoi uchu ajah-u ahi.
English: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

tcz: Chuin Peter in adong un, “Eiho banga Lhagao Theng changa hiteho baptize chanlouna dinga twi kham theiya koi umam?” ati.
en: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”
text:
ACT 10:47
Thadou: Chuin Peter in adong un, “Eiho banga Lhagao Theng changa hiteho baptize chanlouna dinga twi kham theiya koi umam?” ati.
English: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”

tcz: Chuin aman Yeshua Christa mina baptize chang dingin amaho chu thu apetan, chujouvin Cornelius in amaho henga nikho phabep um ding'in alhotan ahi.
en: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
text:
ACT 10:48
Thadou: Chuin aman Yeshua Christa mina baptize chang dingin amaho chu thu apetan, chujouvin Cornelius in amaho henga nikho phabep um ding'in alhotan ahi.
English: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

tcz: Chidang namdang ten Pathen thu akisan thu chu Judah gam'a um solchahho le seijui dangho henga gangtah in alhung tan;
en: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

tcz: Ahinlah Peter Jerusalem ahung lelhun phat in Judahmi atahsanho chun ana oimo un;
en: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

tcz: “Chidang namdang te insunga nalut in chule an jong naga neh khompie,” atiuvin ahi.
en: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”
text:
ACT 11:3
Thadou: “Chidang namdang te insunga nalut in chule an jong naga neh khompie,” atiuvin ahi.
English: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”

tcz: Chuin Peter in amaho heng-ah thilsoh jouse kicheh tah-in aseipeh in hitin aseiyin ahi.
en: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,
text:
ACT 11:4
Thadou: Chuin Peter in amaho heng-ah thilsoh jouse kicheh tah-in aseipeh in hitin aseiyin ahi.
English: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

tcz: “Keima Joppa khopia kauma katao jing laiyin gaochangin mu kaneiyin, lekha pheng lentah tobang aning lin vana konin ahung kikhai lhan, keima komtah ahung geiyin;
en: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.

tcz: Chuin keiman hiche lekha pheng lentah tobang sung chu kaven ahileh leiset chunga umsa akengli hole gamsa chule aop a kithol le chunga leng vacha kamun,
en: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.
text:
ACT 11:6
Thadou: Chuin keiman hiche lekha pheng lentah tobang sung chu kaven ahileh leiset chunga umsa akengli hole gamsa chule aop a kithol le chunga leng vacha kamun,
English: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.

tcz: Chuin vana kona awgin khat kajan ‘Peter thoudoh inlang kitha inlang nen’” ati.
en: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’
text:
ACT 11:7
Thadou: Chuin vana kona awgin khat kajan ‘Peter thoudoh inlang kitha inlang nen’” ati.
English: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’

tcz: Ahipoi Pakai, keiho Judah te chona danin aboh le athenglou tia asei jouse imacha kane khapoi kati.
en: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’
text:
ACT 11:8
Thadou: Ahipoi Pakai, keiho Judah te chona danin aboh le athenglou tia asei jouse imacha kane khapoi kati.
English: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’

tcz: “Ahin vana kona awgin chun avelin ahin seikit in, ‘Pathen in asuhthengsa thilkhat chu athenglou tihih in,’” ati.
en: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’
text:
ACT 11:9
Thadou: “Ahin vana kona awgin chun avelin ahin seikit in, ‘Pathen in asuhthengsa thilkhat chu athenglou tihih in,’” ati.
English: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’

tcz: Hiche thilsoh chu thumveijen kijomin eimusah in chujouvin abonchan vana akikhai tou kit tan ahi.
en: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
text:
ACT 11:10
Thadou: Hiche thilsoh chu thumveijen kijomin eimusah in chujouvin abonchan vana akikhai tou kit tan ahi.
English: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.

tcz: Chutah chun Caesarea a kona mithum hung kisol ho chu kaum nau inmun ahung lhung paiyun ahi.
en: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.
text:
ACT 11:11
Thadou: Chutah chun Caesarea a kona mithum hung kisol ho chu kaum nau inmun ahung lhung paiyun ahi.
English: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

tcz: Chuin Lhagao Theng in kahenga ahin seiyin amaho chutoh kilhon'a chule amaho chidang namdang ahijeh'a ima lungthoina neilou dingin ahin seiyin ahi. Chuin sopi migup chun ei kilhonpiuvin gangtah in ahin solpau in chu kaga lhung tauvin ahi.
en: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.
text:
ACT 11:12
Thadou: Chuin Lhagao Theng in kahenga ahin seiyin amaho chutoh kilhon'a chule amaho chidang namdang ahijeh'a ima lungthoina neilou dingin ahin seiyin ahi. Chuin sopi migup chun ei kilhonpiuvin gangtah in ahin solpau in chu kaga lhung tauvin ahi.
English: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.

tcz: Chuin amapa chun thilsoh umchan jouse chu keiho henga chun aseiyin, ahenga vantil akilah-a Joppa a mi solin lang Simon Peter kiti mipa khu gakousah tan,
en: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,
text:
ACT 11:13
Thadou: Chuin amapa chun thilsoh umchan jouse chu keiho henga chun aseiyin, ahenga vantil akilah-a Joppa a mi solin lang Simon Peter kiti mipa khu gakousah tan,
English: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,

tcz: Chutengle aman nang le na insungmi te jouse huhhing nathu naseipeh ding ahi! ati.
en: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’
text:
ACT 11:14
Thadou: Chutengle aman nang le na insungmi te jouse huhhing nathu naseipeh ding ahi! ati.
English: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’

tcz: Chuin Peter chun aseikit in, “Thusei kahinpan in ahileh abul'a eiho chunga ahung kibuh lhah bangin ama ho jouse chunga Lhagao Theng ahung kibunglhan,
en: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
text:
ACT 11:15
Thadou: Chuin Peter chun aseikit in, “Thusei kahinpan in ahileh abul'a eiho chunga ahung kibuh lhah bangin ama ho jouse chunga Lhagao Theng ahung kibunglhan,
English: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.

tcz: Chun Pakaiyin ‘John in twiya baptize achansah ahin ahinlah nangman Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah dinga ahi’ tia Pakai thusei chu kalunga ahung kilang in ahi.
en: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’
text:
ACT 11:16
Thadou: Chun Pakaiyin ‘John in twiya baptize achansah ahin ahinlah nangman Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah dinga ahi’ tia Pakai thusei chu kalunga ahung kilang in ahi.
English: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’

tcz: Chule eihon Pakai Yeshua Christa itahsan nikhouva Pathen in eipeh-u Lhagao Theng chu chidang namdang te jong apeh ahitah le kei chu koi kahi-a Pathen masanga kadin ding ham?” atin ahi.
en: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”
text:
ACT 11:17
Thadou: Chule eihon Pakai Yeshua Christa itahsan nikhouva Pathen in eipeh-u Lhagao Theng chu chidang namdang te jong apeh ahitah le kei chu koi kahi-a Pathen masanga kadin ding ham?” atin ahi.
English: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”

tcz: Chuin midang hon chuche thu chu ajah phat-un athip tauvin Pathen avahchoi tauvin ahi. Chule amahon aseiyun, “Pathen in chidang namdang tedinga jong chonset lunghei nading le tonsot hina akisan thei nadinguva phatpha apeh hi imu tauve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”
text:
ACT 11:18
Thadou: Chuin midang hon chuche thu chu ajah phat-un athip tauvin Pathen avahchoi tauvin ahi. Chule amahon aseiyun, “Pathen in chidang namdang tedinga jong chonset lunghei nading le tonsot hina akisan thei nadinguva phatpha apeh hi imu tauve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”

tcz: Alangkhat ah Stephen thijouva seijuiho kibol gentheina jeh a jamcheh ho chu Phoenicia, Cyprus le Syria gam'a Antioch changeiyin ajamun, chule Judah te henga bou Pathen thu alhangsamun ahi.
en: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.
text:
ACT 11:19
Thadou: Alangkhat ah Stephen thijouva seijuiho kibol gentheina jeh a jamcheh ho chu Phoenicia, Cyprus le Syria gam'a Antioch changeiyin ajamun, chule Judah te henga bou Pathen thu alhangsamun ahi.
English: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

tcz: Hijeng jongle Cyprus le Cyrene gam'a kona Antioch khopia che seijui phabep ho chun chidang namdang te henga Pakai Yeshua thu alhangsam uvin ahi.
en: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.
text:
ACT 11:20
Thadou: Hijeng jongle Cyprus le Cyrene gam'a kona Antioch khopia che seijui phabep ho chun chidang namdang te henga Pakai Yeshua thu alhangsam uvin ahi.
English: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

tcz: Pakai thahatna amaho chunga aumjeh chun chidang namdang te laha mitam tah in Pakai lama lung aheiyun atahsan tauvin ahi.
en: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
text:
ACT 11:21
Thadou: Pakai thahatna amaho chunga aumjeh chun chidang namdang te laha mitam tah in Pakai lama lung aheiyun atahsan tauvin ahi.
English: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

tcz: Chuin Jerusalema Houbung in hiche thu ajah phat-un Barnabas chu Antioch'a asol tauvin ahile,
en: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,
text:
ACT 11:22
Thadou: Chuin Jerusalema Houbung in hiche thu ajah phat-un Barnabas chu Antioch'a asol tauvin ahile,
English: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

tcz: Amun alhun phat in Pathen phatthei bohna chu amun akipah lheh jengin hichun aman seijui ho chu Pakaiya dihtah-a umjing dingin atilkhouvin ahi.
en: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.
text:
ACT 11:23
Thadou: Amun alhun phat in Pathen phatthei bohna chu amun akipah lheh jengin hichun aman seijui ho chu Pakaiya dihtah-a umjing dingin atilkhouvin ahi.
English: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

tcz: Ajeh chu Barnabas chu miphatah Lhagao Thenga dimjing le Tahsanna a dettah mi ahin, mitam tah Pakaiyah ahin puilutbe uvin ahi.
en: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.
text:
ACT 11:24
Thadou: Ajeh chu Barnabas chu miphatah Lhagao Thenga dimjing le Tahsanna a dettah mi ahin, mitam tah Pakaiyah ahin puilutbe uvin ahi.
English: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

tcz: Chuin Barnabas chu Tarsus lama Saul hol dingin ana chepai tan ahi.
en: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.
text:
ACT 11:25
Thadou: Chuin Barnabas chu Tarsus lama Saul hol dingin ana chepai tan ahi.
English: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

tcz: Chuin amu phat-in Antioch lama ahin nungpui kit in amani Antioch houbunga chun kumlhung keiyin aumden lhonin mipi tamtah ahiljing lhonin ahi. Hiche Antioch'a hi seijui ho Christian tia akou masat penu ahi.
en: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
text:
ACT 11:26
Thadou: Chuin amu phat-in Antioch lama ahin nungpui kit in amani Antioch houbunga chun kumlhung keiyin aumden lhonin mipi tamtah ahiljing lhonin ahi. Hiche Antioch'a hi seijui ho Christian tia akou masat penu ahi.
English: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

tcz: Hiche phatlai hin themgao phabep Jerusalema kon Antioch'a acheuvin,
en: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
text:
ACT 11:27
Thadou: Hiche phatlai hin themgao phabep Jerusalema kon Antioch'a acheuvin,
English: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

tcz: Amaho lah'a Agabus atiu themgaopa chu kikhop khomna khat'a ading doh in lhagaovin Rome gamsung pumpia kel nasatah hunglhung ding ahi tin aphondoh sah tan ahi (Hiche gaothu hi Claudius vaipoh laiyin aguilhung in ahi).
en: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.
text:
ACT 11:28
Thadou: Amaho lah'a Agabus atiu themgaopa chu kikhop khomna khat'a ading doh in lhagaovin Rome gamsung pumpia kel nasatah hunglhung ding ahi tin aphondoh sah tan ahi (Hiche gaothu hi Claudius vaipoh laiyin aguilhung in ahi).
English: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

tcz: Chuin Antioch'a um seijui ho chun Judah gam'a um sopi hoa dinga kithopina thot dingin agel lha tauvin ahile abonchauvin atamthei penin atohkhom tauvin ahi.
en: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

tcz: Chuin hiche athil tokhomu chu Barnabas le Saul in Jerusalema Houbung upa ho khut a apehlut lhon dingin nganse na anei tauvin ahi.
en: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
text:
ACT 11:30
Thadou: Chuin hiche athil tokhomu chu Barnabas le Saul in Jerusalema Houbung upa ho khut a apehlut lhon dingin nganse na anei tauvin ahi.
English: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

tcz: Chuin hiche phatlai chun Leng Herod Agrippa chun Houbung sunga seijui phabep ho chu ahin sugim pan tan ahi.
en: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.
text:
ACT 12:1
Thadou: Chuin hiche phatlai chun Leng Herod Agrippa chun Houbung sunga seijui phabep ho chu ahin sugim pan tan ahi.
English: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

tcz: Chuti chun John sopipa solchah Jacob chu chemjamin ana thattan ahi.
en: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.
text:
ACT 12:2
Thadou: Chuti chun John sopipa solchah Jacob chu chemjamin ana thattan ahi.
English: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

tcz: Hiche thilsoh hin Judah te akipahsah chu Herod in amu phat in Peter jong chu aman in, (Hiche thilsoh hi Kalchuh Kut kimanlai ahi).
en: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.
text:
ACT 12:3
Thadou: Hiche thilsoh hin Judah te akipahsah chu Herod in amu phat in Peter jong chu aman in, (Hiche thilsoh hi Kalchuh Kut kimanlai ahi).
English: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

tcz: Chuin ama chu Songkul'a akhum tan angah dingin Sepai lili a kiloikhom loili akoiyin ahi. Herod in Kalchuh Kut kichai tengle mipi anga Peter chu dinsah dinga lung angaito ahi.
en: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.
text:
ACT 12:4
Thadou: Chuin ama chu Songkul'a akhum tan angah dingin Sepai lili a kiloikhom loili akoiyin ahi. Herod in Kalchuh Kut kichai tengle mipi anga Peter chu dinsah dinga lung angaito ahi.
English: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

tcz: Ahin Peter songkul'a aum phat chun Houbung mite chu lunglut tah in ama dingin atao tauvin ahi.
en: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.
text:
ACT 12:5
Thadou: Ahin Peter songkul'a aum phat chun Houbung mite chu lunglut tah in ama dingin atao tauvin ahi.
English: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

tcz: Chuin mipi anga dinsah dinga agot jan chun Peter chu sepai ni kikah a thihkhao ni a kihena ihmu ahin; angah ho jong chu kotbula ding'ah ahiuvin ahi.
en: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.
text:
ACT 12:6
Thadou: Chuin mipi anga dinsah dinga agot jan chun Peter chu sepai ni kikah a thihkhao ni a kihena ihmu ahin; angah ho jong chu kotbula ding'ah ahiuvin ahi.
English: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

tcz: Chuin hetmanlou kah in vah hattah khat in aumna mun chu ahin salvah in chule Pakai vantil chu Peter angsunga ahung dingin, chuin Vantil chun Peter pangpeh abengin “Thoudoh loiyin,” tin asukhang tan ahile akihenna thih khao jong chu akilham tan ahi.
en: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.
text:
ACT 12:7
Thadou: Chuin hetmanlou kah in vah hattah khat in aumna mun chu ahin salvah in chule Pakai vantil chu Peter angsunga ahung dingin, chuin Vantil chun Peter pangpeh abengin “Thoudoh loiyin,” tin asukhang tan ahile akihenna thih khao jong chu akilham tan ahi.
English: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.

tcz: Chuin Vantil chun Peter jah-a “Kivondoh loiyin lang na kengchot kisen,” asei bangin Peter in aboltan ahile Vantil chun “Napon kisil in lang kanung hinjui jin,” tin thu apetan ahi.
en: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”
text:
ACT 12:8
Thadou: Chuin Vantil chun Peter jah-a “Kivondoh loiyin lang na kengchot kisen,” asei bangin Peter in aboltan ahile Vantil chun “Napon kisil in lang kanung hinjui jin,” tin thu apetan ahi.
English: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”

tcz: Chuin Peter in aumna mun chu adalhan Vantil nung chu ajui tan ahi. Ahin Peter in thilsoh jouse chu gaochanga munei bangin akigelin atah tah ahilam ahedoh pon ahi.
en: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.
text:
ACT 12:9
Thadou: Chuin Peter in aumna mun chu adalhan Vantil nung chu ajui tan ahi. Ahin Peter in thilsoh jouse chu gaochanga munei bangin akigelin atah tah ahilam ahedoh pon ahi.
English: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

tcz: Chuin amanin kot ngah masa le anina akhel phat lhonin khopi sung lam jotna a thih kot phung chu agei lhonin, kot chu amani dingin achamin akihong jengin, chuin amani achedoh lhonin khosung lamlen khat ajot lhung lhonin ahile, hichun Vantil chun ama adalha pai tan ahi.
en: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.
text:
ACT 12:10
Thadou: Chuin amanin kot ngah masa le anina akhel phat lhonin khopi sung lam jotna a thih kot phung chu agei lhonin, kot chu amani dingin achamin akihong jengin, chuin amani achedoh lhonin khosung lamlen khat ajot lhung lhonin ahile, hichun Vantil chun ama adalha pai tan ahi.
English: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

tcz: Chuin Peter in kho ahin hedoh tan, “Thilsoh chu atah ahi! Pakaiyin a Vantil ahin solin Herod lengpa leh Judah lamkai hon kachunga abolgot'u thilsea konin eihuh doh-e,” ati.
en: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”
text:
ACT 12:11
Thadou: Chuin Peter in kho ahin hedoh tan, “Thilsoh chu atah ahi! Pakaiyin a Vantil ahin solin Herod lengpa leh Judah lamkai hon kachunga abolgot'u thilsea konin eihuh doh-e,” ati.
