English: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”

tcz: Chuin aman thilsoh ho ahin hetdoh phat in John Mark nu Mary in'a achetan ahile mitam tah ana taokhomun,
en: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.
text:
ACT 12:12
Thadou: Chuin aman thilsoh ho ahin hetdoh phat in John Mark nu Mary in'a achetan ahile mitam tah ana taokhomun,
English: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

tcz: Chuin aman kot chu akiuvin ahile soh numei Rhoda kiti nu chu kot hong dingin ahung in ahi.
en: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.
text:
ACT 12:13
Thadou: Chuin aman kot chu akiuvin ahile soh numei Rhoda kiti nu chu kot hong dingin ahung in ahi.
English: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.

tcz: Chuin numei nu chun Peter awso ahi ahetdoh phat chun kot jong hong louvin insunga anung lhailut in miho jah-a chun “Peter kotbula adinge!” agatin ahi.
en: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.
text:
ACT 12:14
Thadou: Chuin numei nu chun Peter awso ahi ahetdoh phat chun kot jong hong louvin insunga anung lhailut in miho jah-a chun “Peter kotbula adinge!” agatin ahi.
English: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

tcz: Chuin miho chun amanu jah a “Angol thim nahim,” atiuve, ahin amanu chun ahi mong monge ati phat chun amaho chun akhutile “Alhagao hinah ta,” atiuvin ahi.
en: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”
text:
ACT 12:15
Thadou: Chuin miho chun amanu jah a “Angol thim nahim,” atiuve, ahin amanu chun ahi mong monge ati phat chun amaho chun akhutile “Alhagao hinah ta,” atiuvin ahi.
English: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”

tcz: Alangkhat'ah Peter in kot chu akiu kiu jengin ahi. Achainakeiya amahon kot chu ahona avet'u le Peter chu amu phat un kidang asa lheh jengun ahi.
en: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.
text:
ACT 12:16
Thadou: Alangkhat'ah Peter in kot chu akiu kiu jengin ahi. Achainakeiya amahon kot chu ahona avet'u le Peter chu amu phat un kidang asa lheh jengun ahi.
English: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.

tcz: Chuin Peter in amaho chu thipbeh a um ding'in akhut in avetsah in, amaho koma chun Pakaiyin kidangtah a songkul'a kona ahin puidoh dan thusim chu asei peh tan ahi. Chule “Hiche thu chu Jacob le asopiho seipeh un,” atin ama hikoma kon chun munchoma achetan ahi.
en: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.
text:
ACT 12:17
Thadou: Chuin Peter in amaho chu thipbeh a um ding'in akhut in avetsah in, amaho koma chun Pakaiyin kidangtah a songkul'a kona ahin puidoh dan thusim chu asei peh tan ahi. Chule “Hiche thu chu Jacob le asopiho seipeh un,” atin ama hikoma kon chun munchoma achetan ahi.
English: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.

tcz: Chuin kho ahung vah phat in sepai ho chun i-atileh Peter chu songkul'a kona potdoh thei ham tin alung dong lheh jeng uvin ahi.
en: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.
text:
ACT 12:18
Thadou: Chuin kho ahung vah phat in sepai ho chun i-atileh Peter chu songkul'a kona potdoh thei ham tin alung dong lheh jeng uvin ahi.
English: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

tcz: Chuin Herod lengpan sepai ho koma chun Peter chu phatecha ahol nadingun thu apen ahin lah amu deh lou phat un, songkul ngah a pang sepai ho chu thudoh aneiyin ajonan amaho chu athat tan ahi. Chujou chun Herod lengpa jong Judah gam dalhan phat chomkhat um ding'in Caesarea ajon tan ahi.
en: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.
text:
ACT 12:19
Thadou: Chuin Herod lengpan sepai ho koma chun Peter chu phatecha ahol nadingun thu apen ahin lah amu deh lou phat un, songkul ngah a pang sepai ho chu thudoh aneiyin ajonan amaho chu athat tan ahi. Chujou chun Herod lengpa jong Judah gam dalhan phat chomkhat um ding'in Caesarea ajon tan ahi.
English: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

tcz: Tun Herod lengpa chu Tyre le Sidon mite chunga alung hang lheh jeng tan ahileh amahon thalheng in mi asol uvin amaho chun Herod lengpa noiya natong Blastus chu athujo jouvun Herod lengpa toh chamna semding in aga thum tauvin ahi. Ajeh chu Tyre le Sidon gamsunga ding neh le chah hi Herod lengpa gamsunga kona hungji ahi.
en: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.
text:
ACT 12:20
Thadou: Tun Herod lengpa chu Tyre le Sidon mite chunga alung hang lheh jeng tan ahileh amahon thalheng in mi asol uvin amaho chun Herod lengpa noiya natong Blastus chu athujo jouvun Herod lengpa toh chamna semding in aga thum tauvin ahi. Ajeh chu Tyre le Sidon gamsunga ding neh le chah hi Herod lengpa gamsunga kona hungji ahi.
English: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.

tcz: Chuin Herod in athum nau chu asanpeh in akitep nikhou ahung lhunin Herod in aleng von ahin kivon in, aleng touna-a atouvin amaho koma chun thu asei tan ahi.
en: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.
text:
ACT 12:21
Thadou: Chuin Herod in athum nau chu asanpeh in akitep nikhou ahung lhunin Herod in aleng von ahin kivon in, aleng touna-a atouvin amaho koma chun thu asei tan ahi.
English: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

tcz: Chuin mipi ho chun “Hiche hi mihem awso ahipoi, Pathen aw ahi,” atiuvin hasap in asam tauvin ahi.
en: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
text:
ACT 12:22
Thadou: Chuin mipi ho chun “Hiche hi mihem awso ahipoi, Pathen aw ahi,” atiuvin hasap in asam tauvin ahi.
English: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”

tcz: Chuin mipi hon chutia asap pettah-u chun Herod in Pathen loupina peh sangin ama akiloupi sah tan ahile Pakai vantil in Herod chunga natna ahin lhunsah tan, chuti chun lungin anen athitan ahi.
en: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
text:
ACT 12:23
Thadou: Chuin mipi hon chutia asap pettah-u chun Herod in Pathen loupina peh sangin ama akiloupi sah tan ahile Pakai vantil in Herod chunga natna ahin lhunsah tan, chuti chun lungin anen athitan ahi.
English: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

tcz: Alangkhat'ah Pathen thu chu akithe jal jingin seijui apung jingin ahi.
en: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
text:
ACT 12:24
Thadou: Alangkhat'ah Pathen thu chu akithe jal jingin seijui apung jingin ahi.
English: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

tcz: Chuin Barnabas le Saul in Jerusalema akin hon achai lhon phat in John Mark apui lhon in akile tauvin ahi.
en: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.
text:
ACT 12:25
Thadou: Chuin Barnabas le Saul in Jerusalema akin hon achai lhon phat in John Mark apui lhon in akile tauvin ahi.
English: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.

tcz: Antioch Houbung sunga Themgao le mihil ho chu, Barnabas, Simeon (mivompa), Lucius (Cyrene mi), Manaen (Herod Antipas golpa), chule Saul ahiuve.
en: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
text:
ACT 13:1
Thadou: Antioch Houbung sunga Themgao le mihil ho chu, Barnabas, Simeon (mivompa), Lucius (Cyrene mi), Manaen (Herod Antipas golpa), chule Saul ahiuve.
English: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

tcz: Chuin Nikhat amaho hin an ngola Pathen ahoukhom pet-un Lhagao Theng in amaho koma chun “Barnabas le Saul chu kakouna natong dingin lhandoh tauvin,” ahin tin ahi.
en: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”
text:
ACT 13:2
Thadou: Chuin Nikhat amaho hin an ngola Pathen ahoukhom pet-un Lhagao Theng in amaho koma chun “Barnabas le Saul chu kakouna natong dingin lhandoh tauvin,” ahin tin ahi.
English: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”

tcz: Chuin amahon an ngola taona hatah-a anei jouvun amani chunga chun khut angam un, ataopeh jouvun asoldoh tauvin ahi.
en: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
text:
ACT 13:3
Thadou: Chuin amahon an ngola taona hatah-a anei jouvun amani chunga chun khut angam un, ataopeh jouvun asoldoh tauvin ahi.
English: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

tcz: Chuin Barnabas le Saul chu Lhagao Theng in asoldoh lhon tan ahile, amani Seleucia kongkai muna achesuh lhon in chuin Cyprus twikol jon dingin konga atou lhon tan ahi.
en: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.
text:
ACT 13:4
Thadou: Chuin Barnabas le Saul chu Lhagao Theng in asoldoh lhon tan ahile, amani Seleucia kongkai muna achesuh lhon in chuin Cyprus twikol jon dingin konga atou lhon tan ahi.
English: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

tcz: Chuche muna Salamis khopi alhun hon phat in Judah te kikhop khomna hoa alut lhon in Pathen thu asamphong le hon tan ahi. Chule John Mark jong amani kithopi dingin akilhon uvin ahi.
en: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.
text:
ACT 13:5
Thadou: Chuche muna Salamis khopi alhun hon phat in Judah te kikhop khomna hoa alut lhon in Pathen thu asamphong le hon tan ahi. Chule John Mark jong amani kithopi dingin akilhon uvin ahi.
English: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.

tcz: Chuin amani twikol sung pumpi a chun khopi khat a kon in khopi khat ah avahle lhonin Paphos chan in achelhon in ahile hiche lai muna chun Bar-Yeshua kiti Judah mi doichoi le themgao lhemkhat akimupi lhon in ahi.
en: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,
text:
ACT 13:6
Thadou: Chuin amani twikol sung pumpi a chun khopi khat a kon in khopi khat ah avahle lhonin Paphos chan in achelhon in ahile hiche lai muna chun Bar-Yeshua kiti Judah mi doichoi le themgao lhemkhat akimupi lhon in ahi.
English: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,

tcz: Chule amapa chu gamvaipo miching tah Sergius Paulus koma uma ahi. Chuin gamvaipo pa chun Pathen thu angai nom jeh chun Barnabas le Saul chu akou tan ahi.
en: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.
text:
ACT 13:7
Thadou: Chule amapa chu gamvaipo miching tah Sergius Paulus koma uma ahi. Chuin gamvaipo pa chun Pathen thu angai nom jeh chun Barnabas le Saul chu akou tan ahi.
English: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

tcz: Ahinlah Elymas kiti doichoi mikhat ahung kikum lut in gamvaipo chun Barnabas le Saul thusei chu atahsan louna tei dingin hiche teni thusei hi ngaipeh hih in tin aseiyin ahi.
en: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
text:
ACT 13:8
Thadou: Ahinlah Elymas kiti doichoi mikhat ahung kikum lut in gamvaipo chun Barnabas le Saul thusei chu atahsan louna tei dingin hiche teni thusei hi ngaipeh hih in tin aseiyin ahi.
English: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

tcz: Chuin Paul tiajong kihe Saul chu Lhagao Theng adimset in, chule aman doichoi mipa chu aven,
en: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him
text:
ACT 13:9
Thadou: Chuin Paul tiajong kihe Saul chu Lhagao Theng adimset in, chule aman doichoi mipa chu aven,
English: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him

tcz: “Nangma Diabol chapa, Jou le jona milhemlha, thilpha jouse dinga melma pa! Pathen lamdih a kona mihem puimang ding hi nangah louhel ding ham?
en: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
text:
ACT 13:10
Thadou: “Nangma Diabol chapa, Jou le jona milhemlha, thilpha jouse dinga melma pa! Pathen lamdih a kona mihem puimang ding hi nangah louhel ding ham?
English: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

tcz: Ven tun Pakai mijep na khut chu nachunga hung chu ding chule namit choding phat chomkhat khovah namulou ding ahitai.”
en: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
text:
ACT 13:11
Thadou: Ven tun Pakai mijep na khut chu nachunga hung chu ding chule namit choding phat chomkhat khovah namulou ding ahitai.”
English: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

tcz: Hiche thilsoh chu gamvaipo chun amu phat in ama jong seijui ho lah a ajao tan ahi ajeh chu Pakai thudol thuhil chu kidang asah val jeng ahi.
en: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
text:
ACT 13:12
Thadou: Hiche thilsoh chu gamvaipo chun amu phat in ama jong seijui ho lah a ajao tan ahi ajeh chu Pakai thudol thuhil chu kidang asah val jeng ahi.
English: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

tcz: Chuin Paul le alhon khompi ho chun Paphos dalhan Pamphylia jon dingin konga akitolun Perga muna akinga tauvin, chule hiche muna kon chun John Mark chu Jerusalem lama akile tan ahi.
en: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.
text:
ACT 13:13
Thadou: Chuin Paul le alhon khompi ho chun Paphos dalhan Pamphylia jon dingin konga akitolun Perga muna akinga tauvin, chule hiche muna kon chun John Mark chu Jerusalem lama akile tan ahi.
English: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

tcz: Ahin Paul le Barnabas vang chu keng lam in Pisidia gam'a Antioch chan achelhon in, chuin cholngah nikhon amani jong kikhom dingin kikhop khomna in ah alut lhon tan ahi.
en: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.
text:
ACT 13:14
Thadou: Ahin Paul le Barnabas vang chu keng lam in Pisidia gam'a Antioch chan achelhon in, chuin cholngah nikhon amani jong kikhom dingin kikhop khomna in ah alut lhon tan ahi.
English: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.

tcz: Chuin angaiya Mose le Themgao lekhabu asim jouvun kikhopna-a lamkai hon amani koma chun “Sopi teni mipi ho tilkhouna dinga seinom nanei honle hung sei lhonin,” tin phat apeuvin ahi.
en: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”
text:
ACT 13:15
Thadou: Chuin angaiya Mose le Themgao lekhabu asim jouvun kikhopna-a lamkai hon amani koma chun “Sopi teni mipi ho tilkhouna dinga seinom nanei honle hung sei lhonin,” tin phat apeuvin ahi.
English: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”

tcz: Chuin Paul ading doh in akhut alhang in mipi ho chu thipbeh cha-a um ding'in aseiyin, chuin aman aseitai, “Israel mite hole Pathen ging'ah chidang namdang teho, ngaiyuvin,
en: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.
text:
ACT 13:16
Thadou: Chuin Paul ading doh in akhut alhang in mipi ho chu thipbeh cha-a um ding'in aseiyin, chuin aman aseitai, “Israel mite hole Pathen ging'ah chidang namdang teho, ngaiyuvin,
English: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

tcz: Hiche Israel nampi Pathen chun ipu ipateu ana lhengdoh in Egypt gam'a chun apunsah uvin chule thahattah nampi khat in ahin semdoh tan ahi. Chuin athahat nan Egypt mite khut ah asoh chan nauva konin ahin huh doh in,”
en: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.
text:
ACT 13:17
Thadou: Hiche Israel nampi Pathen chun ipu ipateu ana lhengdoh in Egypt gam'a chun apunsah uvin chule thahattah nampi khat in ahin semdoh tan ahi. Chuin athahat nan Egypt mite khut ah asoh chan nauva konin ahin huh doh in,”
English: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

tcz: Gamthip noiya kum somli jen ahin puiyin,
en: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
text:
ACT 13:18
Thadou: Gamthip noiya kum somli jen ahin puiyin,
English: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

tcz: Chuin Canaan gamsunga nam sagi jen asumang in, agam sungu chu Israel ten aloding in apetan ahi.
en: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.
text:
ACT 13:19
Thadou: Chuin Canaan gamsunga nam sagi jen asumang in, agam sungu chu Israel ten aloding in apetan ahi.
English: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.

tcz: Hiche thilsoh hi kum 450 sunga soh ahi. Chujouvin Israel chate chunga vaihom ding in Pathen thutan vaihom ho ana pen ama ho chun Samuel themgao pa khang chanin vai anahom un ahi.
en: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
text:
ACT 13:20
Thadou: Hiche thilsoh hi kum 450 sunga soh ahi. Chujouvin Israel chate chunga vaihom ding in Pathen thutan vaihom ho ana pen ama ho chun Samuel themgao pa khang chanin vai anahom un ahi.
English: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

tcz: Chuin mipi chun leng ana thum'un, ahile Pathen in Benjamin phunga kon Kish chapa Saul chu ana pen ama chun kum somli lengvai anapon ahi.
en: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
text:
ACT 13:21
Thadou: Chuin mipi chun leng ana thum'un, ahile Pathen in Benjamin phunga kon Kish chapa Saul chu ana pen ama chun kum somli lengvai anapon ahi.
English: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

tcz: Ahin Pathen in Saul chu leng muna konin ana ladoh in David chu ana tung tan ahi. Pathen in David thudola hitin ana seiye “Keiman kalung gottah mi Jesse Chapa David kamutai, aman kalunggot jouse abol ding ahi” ati.
en: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’
text:
ACT 13:22
Thadou: Ahin Pathen in Saul chu leng muna konin ana ladoh in David chu ana tung tan ahi. Pathen in David thudola hitin ana seiye “Keiman kalung gottah mi Jesse Chapa David kamutai, aman kalunggot jouse abol ding ahi” ati.
English: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’

tcz: Chule Pathen in Israelte huhdoh dinga athutep Yeshua chu leng David insunga kon ahi.
en: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,
text:
ACT 13:23
Thadou: Chule Pathen in Israelte huhdoh dinga athutep Yeshua chu leng David insunga kon ahi.
English: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,

tcz: Ama ahung masang in twilutsah John in Israel mipi jousen chonset lung aheiya Pathen koma akilekit uva chule twiya Baptize achanna dingu thu ana lhangsam in ahi.
en: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.
text:
ACT 13:24
Thadou: Ama ahung masang in twilutsah John in Israel mipi jousen chonset lung aheiya Pathen koma akilekit uva chule twiya Baptize achanna dingu thu ana lhangsam in ahi.
English: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.

tcz: Chuin John in atoh ding kin achaiphat in aman adong in “keihi Messiah nei hisah uham? Kahipoi! Ahin Ama hungvah ding ahi, chule keima akengchot khao sutlha a pang asolchah khat dinga jong lhing jou kahipoi.”
en: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’
text:
ACT 13:25
Thadou: Chuin John in atoh ding kin achaiphat in aman adong in “keihi Messiah nei hisah uham? Kahipoi! Ahin Ama hungvah ding ahi, chule keima akengchot khao sutlha a pang asolchah khat dinga jong lhing jou kahipoi.”
English: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’

tcz: Sopite, Abraham son ho le chidang namdang Pathen ging mite ho, Hiche huhhingna thuphahi eiho dinga hung kisol ahi.
en: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.
text:
ACT 13:26
Thadou: Sopite, Abraham son ho le chidang namdang Pathen ging mite ho, Hiche huhhingna thuphahi eiho dinga hung kisol ahi.
English: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

tcz: Jerusalem mite le alamkai teuvin themgao hon Yeshua thudol aseiyu ahilam ahepouve. Chusang in themmo achanun hiche jeng jong hin cholngah niseh a themgao ho thucheng aguilhun sah ahi.
en: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.
text:
ACT 13:27
Thadou: Jerusalem mite le alamkai teuvin themgao hon Yeshua thudol aseiyu ahilam ahepouve. Chusang in themmo achanun hiche jeng jong hin cholngah niseh a themgao ho thucheng aguilhun sah ahi.
English: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

tcz: Chule dan dung juiya tha nading themmo najong amu pouvin, ahin Pilate henga chun atha teitei nading in angeh un ahi.
en: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.
text:
ACT 13:28
Thadou: Chule dan dung juiya tha nading themmo najong amu pouvin, ahin Pilate henga chun atha teitei nading in angeh un ahi.
English: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

tcz: Chuin themgao vin achungchang thudol asei jouse aboljou soh phat un, thingpel chunga konin ala lhauvin lhanah alup sah tauvin ahi.
en: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.
text:
ACT 13:29
Thadou: Chuin themgao vin achungchang thudol asei jouse aboljou soh phat un, thingpel chunga konin ala lhauvin lhanah alup sah tauvin ahi.
English: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.

tcz: Ahivangin Pathen in thina-a konin akaithou kittai.
en: But God raised him from the dead,
text:
ACT 13:30
Thadou: Ahivangin Pathen in thina-a konin akaithou kittai.
English: But God raised him from the dead,

tcz: Chuin nikho phabep jouvin Galilee a kona Jerusalem lampia akilhon khompi ho henga ama akiphong in tun amaho Israel mite henga hettoh sah in apang uvin ahi.
en: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
text:
ACT 13:31
Thadou: Chuin nikho phabep jouvin Galilee a kona Jerusalem lampia akilhon khompi ho henga ama akiphong in tun amaho Israel mite henga hettoh sah in apang uvin ahi.
English: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

tcz: Tunia keiho hiche laiya hi Pathen in ipu ipateu henga ana kitepna thupha choiya hung kahiuve.
en: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,
text:
ACT 13:32
Thadou: Tunia keiho hiche laiya hi Pathen in ipu ipateu henga ana kitepna thupha choiya hung kahiuve.
English: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

tcz: Chule hiche hi ason achilhah eiho jouse henga Pathen in Yeshua akaithou vanga aguilhunsah ahi. Hiche thudol hi Psalm lekhabu nina in hitin aseiyin ahi, “Nangma kachapa, tunin keima napa kahitai.”
en: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’
text:
ACT 13:33
Thadou: Chule hiche hi ason achilhah eiho jouse henga Pathen in Yeshua akaithou vanga aguilhunsah ahi. Hiche thudol hi Psalm lekhabu nina in hitin aseiyin ahi, “Nangma kachapa, tunin keima napa kahitai.”
English: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in lhana monlha bep ding hilouva thina-a kona kaithou dinga ana thutepsa ahi. Pathen in aseiyin, “David henga kakitepna phattheina kiselguh chu nangma kapeh ding nahi, ati.
en: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
text:
ACT 13:34
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen in lhana monlha bep ding hilouva thina-a kona kaithou dinga ana thutepsa ahi. Pathen in aseiyin, “David henga kakitepna phattheina kiselguh chu nangma kapeh ding nahi, ati.
English: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’

tcz: Psalm lekhabu dang khat'ah ahilchen be in, Nami theng chu lhan'a namon den sah lou ding ahi,” ati.
en: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’
text:
ACT 13:35
Thadou: Psalm lekhabu dang khat'ah ahilchen be in, Nami theng chu lhan'a namon den sah lou ding ahi,” ati.
English: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’

tcz: Chule hiche thuhi David aseina ahipoi, ajeh chu David chun ama khang sunga Pathen lunggot lam abol jouvin athi in apu apate toh akivui khomin chule atahsa jong amon mang tan ahi.
en: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.
text:
ACT 13:36
Thadou: Chule hiche thuhi David aseina ahipoi, ajeh chu David chun ama khang sunga Pathen lunggot lam abol jouvin athi in apu apate toh akivui khomin chule atahsa jong amon mang tan ahi.
English: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

tcz: Ahipoi! Hiche thuhi Pathen in atahsa mon mang louva akaithou midang khat kiseina ahi.
en: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.
text:
ACT 13:37
Thadou: Ahipoi! Hiche thuhi Pathen in atahsa mon mang louva akaithou midang khat kiseina ahi.
English: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

tcz: Sopite ho, ngaiyun! Hiche Yeshua vanga chonset ngaidamna aum thudol lhangsama kahiuve.
en: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;

tcz: Koi hijong le ama tahsan chan chu Pathen anga themchanga kisim ding ahi chule hiche hi Mose dan in aboltheipoi.
en: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
text:
ACT 13:39
Thadou: Koi hijong le ama tahsan chan chu Pathen anga themchanga kisim ding ahi chule hiche hi Mose dan in aboltheipoi.
English: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

tcz: Chingtheiyun! Themgao thusei hohi nangho chunga chuh sah hih un, ajeh chu amahon hitin aseiyuve;
en: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

tcz: “Veuvin mi nuisat ho, kidang sauvin lang thidoh un, ajeh chu nangho phat laiyin thilkhat kabolin, hiche thil khat kabol chu mikhat in naheng uva ahung sei jong le natahsan pouve.” ati.
en: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”
text:
ACT 13:41
Thadou: “Veuvin mi nuisat ho, kidang sauvin lang thidoh un, ajeh chu nangho phat laiyin thilkhat kabolin, hiche thil khat kabol chu mikhat in naheng uva ahung sei jong le natahsan pouve.” ati.
English: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”

tcz: Chuin Paul le Barnabas chu kikhopna in'a konin apotdoh lhonin ahile mipi chun akham uvin hapta kit le asei lhon jouse avelsei kit lhon dingin angeh-un ahi.
en: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.
text:
ACT 13:42
Thadou: Chuin Paul le Barnabas chu kikhopna in'a konin apotdoh lhonin ahile mipi chun akham uvin hapta kit le asei lhon jouse avelsei kit lhon dingin angeh-un ahi.
English: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

tcz: Chuin Judah mi tamtah le hougut Judah houva lut mitampi chun Paul le Barnabas chu ajui tauvin ahile amanin amaho chu Pathen milungsetna a umdet jing ding in atil khou lhon tan ahi.
en: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.
text:
ACT 13:43
Thadou: Chuin Judah mi tamtah le hougut Judah houva lut mitampi chun Paul le Barnabas chu ajui tauvin ahile amanin amaho chu Pathen milungsetna a umdet jing ding in atil khou lhon tan ahi.
English: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

tcz: Chuin a-hapta kit in khopi sunga mipi atamjo Pathen thungai ding in ahung khomun ahi.
en: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.
text:
ACT 13:44
Thadou: Chuin a-hapta kit in khopi sunga mipi atamjo Pathen thungai ding in ahung khomun ahi.
English: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

tcz: Ahin Judah mi abang chun mipi chu aveu vin ahile athangse uvin, hijeh chun Paul thusei jouse chu anelkal un ahi.
en: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.
text:
ACT 13:45
Thadou: Ahin Judah mi abang chun mipi chu aveu vin ahile athangse uvin, hijeh chun Paul thusei jouse chu anelkal un ahi.
English: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.

tcz: Chuin Paul le Barnabas chun hangsan tah in alhangsam lhonin asei lhon tai, “Nangho Judah te henga Pathen thu kalhangsap masah lhon ding hi ngaikhoh ahi, ahin nanghon napampai uva, nangho le nanghon tonsot hinna changdia lomlouva thu nakitan tah jeh un, chidang namdang te henga kache lhon ding ahitai.
en: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.
text:
ACT 13:46
Thadou: Chuin Paul le Barnabas chun hangsan tah in alhangsam lhonin asei lhon tai, “Nangho Judah te henga Pathen thu kalhangsap masah lhon ding hi ngaikhoh ahi, ahin nanghon napampai uva, nangho le nanghon tonsot hinna changdia lomlouva thu nakitan tah jeh un, chidang namdang te henga kache lhon ding ahitai.
English: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in, ‘vannoi leiset pumpia huhhing na thupole dinga, chidang namdang te lah-a vah'a kasem lhon nahi,’ atia chu chidang namdang te lah a eisol lhon ahitai,” ati lhon e.
en: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”
text:
ACT 13:47
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen in, ‘vannoi leiset pumpia huhhing na thupole dinga, chidang namdang te lah-a vah'a kasem lhon nahi,’ atia chu chidang namdang te lah a eisol lhon ahitai,” ati lhon e.
English: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”

tcz: Chuin chidang namdang ten hiche thu ajah phat un hapan akipah in Pakai athangvah un chule tonsot hina chang dinga kilhengdoh ho jouse chu seijui in apang tauvin ahi.
en: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.
text:
ACT 13:48
Thadou: Chuin chidang namdang ten hiche thu ajah phat un hapan akipah in Pakai athangvah un chule tonsot hina chang dinga kilhengdoh ho jouse chu seijui in apang tauvin ahi.
English: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

tcz: Chuin hiche gamkai sung se achun Pathen thu chu akithe jal tan ahi.
en: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.
text:
ACT 13:49
Thadou: Chuin hiche gamkai sung se achun Pathen thu chu akithe jal tan ahi.
English: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

tcz: Chuin Judah techun hougut numei ho le khopi sunga lamkai ho chu atil seuvin Paul le Barnabas chu khopi sunga konin adel mang sah tauvin ahi.
en: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.
text:
ACT 13:50
Thadou: Chuin Judah techun hougut numei ho le khopi sunga lamkai ho chu atil seuvin Paul le Barnabas chu khopi sunga konin adel mang sah tauvin ahi.
English: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

tcz: Chuin amanin apampai lhon vetsahnan akenglhona khobon athing lha lhonin Iconium ajon lhon tan ahi.
en: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.
text:
ACT 13:51
Thadou: Chuin amanin apampai lhon vetsahnan akenglhona khobon athing lha lhonin Iconium ajon lhon tan ahi.
English: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

tcz: Chule Seijui ho chu kipana le Lhagao vin adimset tauvin ahi.
en: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
text:
ACT 13:52
Thadou: Chule Seijui ho chu kipana le Lhagao vin adimset tauvin ahi.
English: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

tcz: Chuin angai ngaiyin Iconium muna jong Paul le Barnabas chu Judah te kikhopna insunga alut lhonin thanei tah in thu alhangsam kit lhonin ahile Judah te le chidang namdang mitampin atahsan kit uvin ahi.
en: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.
text:
ACT 14:1
Thadou: Chuin angai ngaiyin Iconium muna jong Paul le Barnabas chu Judah te kikhopna insunga alut lhonin thanei tah in thu alhangsam kit lhonin ahile Judah te le chidang namdang mitampin atahsan kit uvin ahi.
English: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.

tcz: Ahinlah Judah te mi konkhat in Pathen thu sanglou vin chidang namdang te lungthim sunga Barnabas le Paul dounan thina thei gu akhum peh un ahi.
en: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.
text:
ACT 14:2
Thadou: Ahinlah Judah te mi konkhat in Pathen thu sanglou vin chidang namdang te lungthim sunga Barnabas le Paul dounan thina thei gu akhum peh un ahi.
English: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

tcz: Ahin solchah teni chu hiche lai muna chun sottah aumden lhonin Pakai mi ngailutna thu chu hangsan tah in alhangsam jing lhonin chule athu lhangsap lhon chu atah ahi vetsahna dingin melchih na le bolmo kidang tampi abol lhonin ahi.
en: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
text:
ACT 14:3
Thadou: Ahin solchah teni chu hiche lai muna chun sottah aumden lhonin Pakai mi ngailutna thu chu hangsan tah in alhangsam jing lhonin chule athu lhangsap lhon chu atah ahi vetsahna dingin melchih na le bolmo kidang tampi abol lhonin ahi.
English: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

tcz: Ahinlah hiche khopi sunga miho chu lunggel ni in akihom khen un, konkhat chun Judah te ajop un konkhat ma chun solchah teni thu ajop un ahi.
en: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.
text:
ACT 14:4
Thadou: Ahinlah hiche khopi sunga miho chu lunggel ni in akihom khen un, konkhat chun Judah te ajop un konkhat ma chun solchah teni thu ajop un ahi.
English: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.

tcz: Chuin chidang namdang mitam tah le Judah techun alamkai tehou toh kithon songa se-a delkhum ding lung angaito tauvin ahi.
en: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,
text:
ACT 14:5
Thadou: Chuin chidang namdang mitam tah le Judah techun alamkai tehou toh kithon songa se-a delkhum ding lung angaito tauvin ahi.
English: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,

tcz: Chuin Solchah hon chuche thu ahet lhih phat un Lycaonia gamsunga Lystra le Derbe khopi chule akimvel gamhoa dingin ana jamlut tauvin,
en: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.
text:
ACT 14:6
Thadou: Chuin Solchah hon chuche thu ahet lhih phat un Lycaonia gamsunga Lystra le Derbe khopi chule akimvel gamhoa dingin ana jamlut tauvin,
English: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.

tcz: Chule hiche gamsunga chun kipana thupha chu asam phong le tauvin ahi.
en: There they preached the Good News.
text:
ACT 14:7
Thadou: Chule hiche gamsunga chun kipana thupha chu asam phong le tauvin ahi.
English: There they preached the Good News.

tcz: Chuin Lystra-a aumpet un, Paul le Barnabas chun apena pat a akeng phang chatmoa lam pumjot theilou mikhat amu lhonin amapa chu atouvin,
en: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.
text:
ACT 14:8
Thadou: Chuin Lystra-a aumpet un, Paul le Barnabas chun apena pat a akeng phang chatmoa lam pumjot theilou mikhat amu lhonin amapa chu atouvin,
English: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.

tcz: Chule Paul thusei chu angaiyin ahi. Chuin Paul in amapa chu ave jangkei in ahile amapa chun damna dinga tahsanna anei chu amutan ahi.
en: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,
text:
ACT 14:9
Thadou: Chule Paul thusei chu angaiyin ahi. Chuin Paul in amapa chu ave jangkei in ahile amapa chun damna dinga tahsanna anei chu amutan ahi.
English: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,

tcz: Chuin Paul in aw sangtah in akouvin, “Dingdoh in!” ati. Chuin mipa chu akichomin lam ajot tan ahi.
en: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.
text:
ACT 14:10
Thadou: Chuin Paul in aw sangtah in akouvin, “Dingdoh in!” ati. Chuin mipa chu akichomin lam ajot tan ahi.
English: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.

tcz: Chuin mipi chun Paul thilbol chu amu tauvin ahile amaho pao vin asam un, “Hiche miteni hi mihem lima um pathen ahi!” atiuvin ahi.
en: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”
text:
ACT 14:11
Thadou: Chuin mipi chun Paul thilbol chu amu tauvin ahile amaho pao vin asam un, “Hiche miteni hi mihem lima um pathen ahi!” atiuvin ahi.
English: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”

tcz: Barnabas chu Greek mite pathen Zeus ahin Paul chun thuseiya pang ahijeh chun Hermes ahi ati tauvin ahi.
en: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.
text:
ACT 14:12
Thadou: Barnabas chu Greek mite pathen Zeus ahin Paul chun thuseiya pang ahijeh chun Hermes ahi ati tauvin ahi.
English: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.

tcz: Chuin Zeus houbuh chu khopi pamlama umah ahin, houbuh a natong thempu ho le mipi ho chun bongchal le pahvui khopi kelkot phunga chun ahin pouvin solchah teni ding chun kilhaina agong tauvin ahi.
en: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.
text:
ACT 14:13
Thadou: Chuin Zeus houbuh chu khopi pamlama umah ahin, houbuh a natong thempu ho le mipi ho chun bongchal le pahvui khopi kelkot phunga chun ahin pouvin solchah teni ding chun kilhaina agong tauvin ahi.
English: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

tcz: Ahin solchah Paul le Barnabas in thil umchan thu ajah lhon phat in atija behseh lhonin avon lhon asat-eh lhonin mipi lah a konin ajam lhon tan, aw sang tah in asam lhonin,
en: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,
text:
ACT 14:14
Thadou: Ahin solchah Paul le Barnabas in thil umchan thu ajah lhon phat in atija behseh lhonin avon lhon asat-eh lhonin mipi lah a konin ajam lhon tan, aw sang tah in asam lhonin,
English: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,

tcz: “Golteho, ipi dinga hitobang hi nabol uham? Keini hi nangho tobanga mihem mai mai kahi lhon bouve! Hiche panna bei thilhoa kona van le leiset, twikhanglen le asunga thil umjouse sempa Pathen hingjing henga nahung lut nathei diuva kipana thupha kahin poh lhon ahi bouve.
en: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

tcz: Phat masa lai chun namtin ama ama lung lam cheh a ache theina dingin ana phal in ahi.
en: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.
text:
ACT 14:16
Thadou: Phat masa lai chun namtin ama ama lung lam cheh a ache theina dingin ana phal in ahi.
English: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.

tcz: Ahin amaho koma jong chun Ama hina le aphatna kiphong louvin ana umsah pon ahi. Ajeh chu aman go le dai aphat chan napeuvin anche louhing aphatsah in, nangho dingin neh le chah ning lhingset in napeuvin nalungu kipanan adim in ahi,” ati lhon e.
en: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”
text:
ACT 14:17
Thadou: Ahin amaho koma jong chun Ama hina le aphatna kiphong louvin ana umsah pon ahi. Ajeh chu aman go le dai aphat chan napeuvin anche louhing aphatsah in, nangho dingin neh le chah ning lhingset in napeuvin nalungu kipanan adim in ahi,” ati lhon e.
English: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”

tcz: Thu hicheng asei jou lhon chun amani houna dinga kilhaina bol dinga kigong mipi chu anah nah in akham jou lhonin ahi.
en: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.
text:
ACT 14:18
Thadou: Thu hicheng asei jou lhon chun amani houna dinga kilhaina bol dinga kigong mipi chu anah nah in akham jou lhonin ahi.
English: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.

tcz: Chuin Antioch le Iconium a konin Judah te mi phabep ahung lhungun mipi chu athujo uvin, Paul chu khopi pam lamah akaidoh un songa asep un athitai tin adalhauvin ahi.
en: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
text:
ACT 14:19
Thadou: Chuin Antioch le Iconium a konin Judah te mi phabep ahung lhungun mipi chu athujo uvin, Paul chu khopi pam lamah akaidoh un songa asep un athitai tin adalhauvin ahi.
English: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.

tcz: Chuin seijui ho avela atoukhom pet un Paul chu athoudoh kit in khopi sunga anung lut kit in ahi. Chuin ajing in Barnabas toh Derbe lama ding in achekit lhon tan ahi.
en: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.
text:
ACT 14:20
Thadou: Chuin seijui ho avela atoukhom pet un Paul chu athoudoh kit in khopi sunga anung lut kit in ahi. Chuin ajing in Barnabas toh Derbe lama ding in achekit lhon tan ahi.
English: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.

tcz: Chuin Derbe a kipana thupha alhangsap jou lhon a mi tampi seijuiya asem jou lhon phat in, Paul le Barnabas chu Lystra, Iconium, le Pisidia gam'a Antioch geiyin akile kit lhon in,
en: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
text:
ACT 14:21
Thadou: Chuin Derbe a kipana thupha alhangsap jou lhon a mi tampi seijuiya asem jou lhon phat in, Paul le Barnabas chu Lystra, Iconium, le Pisidia gam'a Antioch geiyin akile kit lhon in,
English: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,

tcz: Seijui ho asuhat kit lhon in, tahsan na a dingdet jing dingin atilkhou lhon in, chule Pathen lenggam lutna dinga gentheina le hahsat na tampi athoh ding danu jong ahetsah lhon in ahi.
en: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.
text:
ACT 14:22
Thadou: Seijui ho asuhat kit lhon in, tahsan na a dingdet jing dingin atilkhou lhon in, chule Pathen lenggam lutna dinga gentheina le hahsat na tampi athoh ding danu jong ahetsah lhon in ahi.
English: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.

tcz: Chule Paul le Barnabas chun houbung tina upa apansah lhonin, chuin upa a apansah lhon ho chu taona le an ngol pumin atahsan ngap nau Pakai khut'ah apelut tauvin ahi.
en: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.
text:
ACT 14:23
Thadou: Chule Paul le Barnabas chun houbung tina upa apansah lhonin, chuin upa a apansah lhon ho chu taona le an ngol pumin atahsan ngap nau Pakai khut'ah apelut tauvin ahi.
English: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.

tcz: Chuin amani Pisidia jotpaiyin Pamphylia chan achekit lhon in ahi.
en: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.
text:
ACT 14:24
Thadou: Chuin amani Pisidia jotpaiyin Pamphylia chan achekit lhon in ahi.
English: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.

tcz: Chuin Perga muna thu asei jou lhon in Attalia a achesuh kit lhon in ahi.
en: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
text:
ACT 14:25
Thadou: Chuin Perga muna thu asei jou lhon in Attalia a achesuh kit lhon in ahi.
English: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

tcz: Achainan, kong in akitol lhon in ahung kipat doh nalhon Syria gam'a Antioch muna akile kit lhon tan ahi. Hiche lai muna tahsan chaten Pathen mingailutna natoh tongdoh dinga anganse nau atong molso lhon tan ahi.
en: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.
text:
ACT 14:26
Thadou: Achainan, kong in akitol lhon in ahung kipat doh nalhon Syria gam'a Antioch muna akile kit lhon tan ahi. Hiche lai muna tahsan chaten Pathen mingailutna natoh tongdoh dinga anganse nau atong molso lhon tan ahi.
English: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.

tcz: Chuin Antioch ahung lhun lhon toh kilhon in houbung mipi akou khom lhon in Pathen in amani a kona thil abol jouse le chidang namdang tedinga jong tahsanna kot ahon dan thudol ahettohsah lhon in ahi.
en: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.
text:
ACT 14:27
Thadou: Chuin Antioch ahung lhun lhon toh kilhon in houbung mipi akou khom lhon in Pathen in amani a kona thil abol jouse le chidang namdang tedinga jong tahsanna kot ahon dan thudol ahettohsah lhon in ahi.
English: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

tcz: Chuin hiche laiya chun seijui ho toh sotpi aumkhom tauvin ahi.
en: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.
text:
ACT 14:28
Thadou: Chuin hiche laiya chun seijui ho toh sotpi aumkhom tauvin ahi.
English: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

tcz: Chuin Paul le Barnabas Syria gam'a Antioch muna aum jing lai lhon in, Judea gam'a kon in mi phabep ahung un “Mose dan dung juiya chep natan lou uleh huhhing'a naum thei lou dingu ahi,” tin seijui ho chu thu ahung hil'un ahi.
en: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”
text:
ACT 15:1
Thadou: Chuin Paul le Barnabas Syria gam'a Antioch muna aum jing lai lhon in, Judea gam'a kon in mi phabep ahung un “Mose dan dung juiya chep natan lou uleh huhhing'a naum thei lou dingu ahi,” tin seijui ho chu thu ahung hil'un ahi.
English: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”

tcz: Chuin Paul le Barnabas chun amaho thuhil chu dih asah lhon lou jeh chun nasatah in akinel tauvin ahi. Ahin achaina chan na akihoulhah thei tah loujeh un Houbung chun Paul le Barnabas chu amun houbung mi themkhat toh Jerusalema hiche thudoh chung changa solchah ho le upa ho toh kihou khom ding in ahin sol tauvin ahi.
en: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.
text:
ACT 15:2
Thadou: Chuin Paul le Barnabas chun amaho thuhil chu dih asah lhon lou jeh chun nasatah in akinel tauvin ahi. Ahin achaina chan na akihoulhah thei tah loujeh un Houbung chun Paul le Barnabas chu amun houbung mi themkhat toh Jerusalema hiche thudoh chung changa solchah ho le upa ho toh kihou khom ding in ahin sol tauvin ahi.
English: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

tcz: Chuin Houbung in Jerusalem a dinga ahin sol houchu Phoenicia le Samaria gamsunga akinga pauvin, seijui ho ahin ho pauvin chidang namdang ho lunghei thu chu aseiyun ahile ama ho hapan akipah un ahi.
en: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.
text:
ACT 15:3
Thadou: Chuin Houbung in Jerusalem a dinga ahin sol houchu Phoenicia le Samaria gamsunga akinga pauvin, seijui ho ahin ho pauvin chidang namdang ho lunghei thu chu aseiyun ahile ama ho hapan akipah un ahi.
English: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

tcz: Chuin Jerusalem alhun un Barnabas le Paul chu solchah ho le upa ho jaonan houbung mipi chun ana lemun, chuin amanin Pathen natoh ho abonchan asei lhon tan ahi.
en: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.
text:
ACT 15:4
Thadou: Chuin Jerusalem alhun un Barnabas le Paul chu solchah ho le upa ho jaonan houbung mipi chun ana lemun, chuin amanin Pathen natoh ho abonchan asei lhon tan ahi.
English: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.

tcz: Ahin Pharisee ho lah a kona seijui ho themkhat ading doh un “Chidang namdang atahsan hon Mose dan dung juiya chep atanu ngai ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”
text:
ACT 15:5
Thadou: Ahin Pharisee ho lah a kona seijui ho themkhat ading doh un “Chidang namdang atahsan hon Mose dan dung juiya chep atanu ngai ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
English: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”

tcz: Chuin solchah ho le upa ho chu hiche thua boina ho seilham ding in akikhomun ahi.
en: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.
text:
ACT 15:6
Thadou: Chuin solchah ho le upa ho chu hiche thua boina ho seilham ding in akikhomun ahi.
English: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

tcz: Akikhop khom nauva chun, phat sottah akihoulim jouvun Peter ading doh in hitin aseiyin ahi, “Sopite ho, phat masa a kona Pathen in nang ho lah a kona keima hi chidang namdang ten kipana thupha ajah thei nadingu le atahsan na dinguva eilhen ahi chu nahe sohkeiyuve,
en: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.
text:
ACT 15:7
Thadou: Akikhop khom nauva chun, phat sottah akihoulim jouvun Peter ading doh in hitin aseiyin ahi, “Sopite ho, phat masa a kona Pathen in nang ho lah a kona keima hi chidang namdang ten kipana thupha ajah thei nadingu le atahsan na dinguva eilhen ahi chu nahe sohkeiyuve,
English: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.

tcz: Pathen in mihem lungthim ahen, eiho eipeh bang uva chidang namdang te jong Lhagao Theng apeh hin Pathen san ahi nau ahettoh sah ahi.
en: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.
text:
ACT 15:8
Thadou: Pathen in mihem lungthim ahen, eiho eipeh bang uva chidang namdang te jong Lhagao Theng apeh hin Pathen san ahi nau ahettoh sah ahi.
English: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

tcz: Eiho le amaho kikah a kikhenna asem pon ahi. Ajeh chu aman tahsan na-a alungthimu asuh theng ahitai.
en: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.
text:
ACT 15:9
Thadou: Eiho le amaho kikah a kikhenna asem pon ahi. Ajeh chu aman tahsan na-a alungthimu asuh theng ahitai.
English: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

tcz: Chuti ahi jeh chun, ipi dinga chidang namdang seijui ho chu eiho le ipu ipa teuvin jong anapoh joulou pohgih chu ipohsah uva Pathen ichou dingu ham?
en: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
text:
ACT 15:10
Thadou: Chuti ahi jeh chun, ipi dinga chidang namdang seijui ho chu eiho le ipu ipa teuvin jong anapoh joulou pohgih chu ipohsah uva Pathen ichou dingu ham?
English: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

tcz: Eiho ibonchauva ichan diuva lomlou Pakai Yeshua mingailut vanga huhhing'a um ihiu chu iheuve,” ati.
en: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”
text:
ACT 15:11
Thadou: Eiho ibonchauva ichan diuva lomlou Pakai Yeshua mingailut vanga huhhing'a um ihiu chu iheuve,” ati.
English: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”

tcz: Chuin Barnabas le Paul in amani jal'a Pathen in chidang namdang te lah a melchih naleh thil kidang abol thu asei lhon chu mipi chun thipbeh in angaiyun,
en: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.
text:
ACT 15:12
Thadou: Chuin Barnabas le Paul in amani jal'a Pathen in chidang namdang te lah a melchih naleh thil kidang abol thu asei lhon chu mipi chun thipbeh in angaiyun,
English: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

tcz: Asei jou lhon in, Jacob ading doh in hiti hin aseiyin ahi, “Sopite ho, kathusei hi ngaitemuvin,
en: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.
text:
ACT 15:13
Thadou: Asei jou lhon in, Jacob ading doh in hiti hin aseiyin ahi, “Sopite ho, kathusei hi ngaitemuvin,
English: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.

tcz: Chidang namdang te lah a kona Pathen in ama dinga mi akilah tillai thu chu Peter in aseiya kon in ija tauve,
en: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.
text:
ACT 15:14
Thadou: Chidang namdang te lah a kona Pathen in ama dinga mi akilah tillai thu chu Peter in aseiya kon in ija tauve,
English: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.

tcz: Chule hiche chidang namdang te lunghei thudol hi themgao hon ana phondoh masah sau ahitai, ajeh chu hiti hin akisun in ahi.”
en: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,
text:
ACT 15:15
Thadou: Chule hiche chidang namdang te lunghei thudol hi themgao hon ana phondoh masah sau ahitai, ajeh chu hiti hin akisun in ahi.”
English: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,

tcz: “Chujou tengle kakile kit a, David in lhusa kasem phat a, asesa kasah phat kit'a chule kasem phat kit ding ahi.
en: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up
text:
ACT 15:16
Thadou: “Chujou tengle kakile kit a, David in lhusa kasem phat a, asesa kasah phat kit'a chule kasem phat kit ding ahi.
English: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up

tcz: Chutengle mijouse, chidang namdang te jaona a keima dinga kakou jousen Pakai ahin hol ding ahi tin,
en: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’
text:
ACT 15:17
Thadou: Chutengle mijouse, chidang namdang te jaona a keima dinga kakou jousen Pakai ahin hol ding ahi tin,
English: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’

tcz: Hitiho jouse phat sottah masanga kona hetsah ji Pakai chun aseiyin ahi.
en: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.
text:
ACT 15:18
Thadou: Hitiho jouse phat sottah masanga kona hetsah ji Pakai chun aseiyin ahi.
English: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.

tcz: Chuti ahijeh chun keima thutan chu hiche hi ahi, chidang namdang te Pathen lama lungheina neiho dinga pohgih igot peh lou dingu ahi.
en: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,
text:
ACT 15:19
Thadou: Chuti ahijeh chun keima thutan chu hiche hi ahi, chidang namdang te Pathen lama lungheina neiho dinga pohgih igot peh lou dingu ahi.
English: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,

tcz: Chusang chun, milim doi anga kikatdoh sa anneh, jon thanhoina, hetphah lou saneh, le thisan neh a konin kikang seuvin, tin jih thou hite.
en: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.
text:
ACT 15:20
Thadou: Chusang chun, milim doi anga kikatdoh sa anneh, jon thanhoina, hetphah lou saneh, le thisan neh a konin kikang seuvin, tin jih thou hite.
English: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche Mose danthu ho hi khopi jouse le cholngah nikho seh a khang tamtah dinga Judah te kikhopna in'a kisei jing ahi.” ati.
en: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”
text:
ACT 15:21
Thadou: Ajeh chu hiche Mose danthu ho hi khopi jouse le cholngah nikho seh a khang tamtah dinga Judah te kikhopna in'a kisei jing ahi.” ati.
English: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”

tcz: Chuin solchahho le upa hon Jerusalem houbunga konin mi phabep alheng doh un, amaho chu Paul le Barnabas toh Syria gam'a Antioch houbunga akihoulhah nau thu hettoh sah dingin asoluvin ahi. Akilheng doh teni chu houbung lamkai Judas (Barsabbas tiajong kihe) le Silas ahi.
en: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.
text:
ACT 15:22
Thadou: Chuin solchahho le upa hon Jerusalem houbunga konin mi phabep alheng doh un, amaho chu Paul le Barnabas toh Syria gam'a Antioch houbunga akihoulhah nau thu hettoh sah dingin asoluvin ahi. Akilheng doh teni chu houbung lamkai Judas (Barsabbas tiajong kihe) le Silas ahi.
English: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.

tcz: Chuin hiche lekha thot hitia kisun hi apohsah un ahi: “Hiche lekha thot hi solchahho le upa ho chule Jerusalema um sopihoa kon ahi. Hiche hi Syria gam'a Antioch le Cilicia a um chidang namdang te henga dinga kisun ahi.” Chibai!
en: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.
text:
ACT 15:23
Thadou: Chuin hiche lekha thot hitia kisun hi apohsah un ahi: “Hiche lekha thot hi solchahho le upa ho chule Jerusalema um sopihoa kon ahi. Hiche hi Syria gam'a Antioch le Cilicia a um chidang namdang te henga dinga kisun ahi.” Chibai!
English: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.

tcz: “Hichea kona mi phabep in athuhil uva nahung suhboi uva, nahung suh lunghangu chu kaheuve, ahin amaho chu keihon kahin sol u ahipoi!
en: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;

tcz: Hijeh chun kilungkhat tah a kakinopto nau toh lhonin keiho khel in ingailut tah-u Barnabas le Paul hi nangho henga kahin sol uvin ahi.
en: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
text:
ACT 15:25
Thadou: Hijeh chun kilungkhat tah a kakinopto nau toh lhonin keiho khel in ingailut tah-u Barnabas le Paul hi nangho henga kahin sol uvin ahi.
English: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

tcz: Amani hi Pakai Yeshua Christa mina ahinna chan ngam ahi lhonin ahi.
en: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text:
ACT 15:26
Thadou: Amani hi Pakai Yeshua Christa mina ahinna chan ngam ahi lhonin ahi.
English: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Chule nahin thudoh chung changuva kakihou lhah nau hettoh sah dinga Judas le Silas hi kahin sol u ahi.”
en: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.
text:
ACT 15:27
Thadou: Chule nahin thudoh chung changuva kakihou lhah nau hettoh sah dinga Judas le Silas hi kahin sol u ahi.”
English: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

tcz: “Ajeh chu nangho chunga hicheng thil themkhat tailou pohgih poh sahlou ding hi Lhagao Theng leh keiho dinga phajo ahi;
en: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

tcz: Hicheng thil themkhat ho chu: milim doi anga kikatdoh sa anneh, jon thanhoina, het phahlou saneh, le thisan neh a konin kikang seuvin, hiche hi najuiuva ahileh alhingsel ahitai.”
en: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”
text:
ACT 15:29
Thadou: Hicheng thil themkhat ho chu: milim doi anga kikatdoh sa anneh, jon thanhoina, het phahlou saneh, le thisan neh a konin kikang seuvin, hiche hi najuiuva ahileh alhingsel ahitai.”
English: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”

tcz: Chuin thupoho chu Antioch alhunun seijui ho abonun akou khomun hiche lekha thot chu ape tauvin ahi.
en: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.
text:
ACT 15:30
Thadou: Chuin thupoho chu Antioch alhunun seijui ho abonun akou khomun hiche lekha thot chu ape tauvin ahi.
English: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

tcz: Chuin hiche tilkhouna lekha thot chu asimun ahile houbung ho chunga kipana adimset tan ahi.
en: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.
text:
ACT 15:31
Thadou: Chuin hiche tilkhouna lekha thot chu asimun ahile houbung ho chunga kipana adimset tan ahi.
English: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

tcz: Chuin Judas le Silas chu ani lhonna themgao ahi toh lhonin seijui ho tilkhouna le atahsanu suhhat na thutampi asei lhon in ahi.
en: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.
text:
ACT 15:32
Thadou: Chuin Judas le Silas chu ani lhonna themgao ahi toh lhonin seijui ho tilkhouna le atahsanu suhhat na thutampi asei lhon in ahi.
English: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.

tcz: Chuin phat chomkhat aum jou lhonin seijui hon amani chu lungmong sel'in Jerusalem houbunga ale sol kit tauvin ahi.
en: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.
text:
ACT 15:33
Thadou: Chuin phat chomkhat aum jou lhonin seijui hon amani chu lungmong sel'in Jerusalem houbunga ale sol kit tauvin ahi.
English: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.

tcz: Paul le Barnabas vang chu Antioch a aum den lhonin, hilaiya chun midang ho toh Pathen thu ahil'un alhang samun ahi.
en: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
text:
ACT 15:35
Thadou: Paul le Barnabas vang chu Antioch a aum den lhonin, hilaiya chun midang ho toh Pathen thu ahil'un alhang samun ahi.
English: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

tcz: Phat chomkhat jouvin Paul in Barnabas jah-a aseiyin, “Kile kit hitin Pathen thu ilhangsapna khopi jouse chu gavil kit hitin seijui ho iti um hinauvem gave hite,” atin ahi.
en: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
text:
ACT 15:36
Thadou: Phat chomkhat jouvin Paul in Barnabas jah-a aseiyin, “Kile kit hitin Pathen thu ilhangsapna khopi jouse chu gavil kit hitin seijui ho iti um hinauvem gave hite,” atin ahi.
English: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”

tcz: Barnabas jong anomin chule John Mark jong puiding anomin ahi.
en: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.
text:
ACT 15:37
Thadou: Barnabas jong anomin chule John Mark jong puiding anomin ahi.
English: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

tcz: Ahin John Mark in Pamphylia muna ana haisan lhona, natoh na a anajao jom tah lou jeh chun ama puikit ding chu Paul akikam khonteh in ahi.
en: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.
text:
ACT 15:38
Thadou: Ahin John Mark in Pamphylia muna ana haisan lhona, natoh na a anajao jom tah lou jeh chun ama puikit ding chu Paul akikam khonteh in ahi.
English: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.

tcz: Chuphat chun akikhenlo lhonin, Barnabas in John Mark akipuiyin Cyprus lama ding in konga akitol tan ahi.
en: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,
text:
ACT 15:39
Thadou: Chuphat chun akikhenlo lhonin, Barnabas in John Mark akipuiyin Cyprus lama ding in konga akitol tan ahi.
English: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,

tcz: Paul chun Silas akilhen in, chule tahsan chaten Pakai ngailutna kivoppi dingin asoldoh tauvin ahi.
en: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.
text:
ACT 15:40
Thadou: Paul chun Silas akilhen in, chule tahsan chaten Pakai ngailutna kivoppi dingin asoldoh tauvin ahi.
English: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

tcz: Chuin Syria le Cilicia gamsungah avah len houbung ho atilkhou le tan ahi.
en: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.
text:
ACT 15:41
Thadou: Chuin Syria le Cilicia gamsungah avah len houbung ho atilkhou le tan ahi.
English: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu Derbe ah ache masan chujouvin Lystra ah achen ahile hikoma chun seijui khang dong Timothy kiti mikhat anaum in ahi. Ama chu anu Judah mi ahin, apa vang chu Greek mi ahi.
en: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.
text:
ACT 16:1
Thadou: Chuin Paul chu Derbe ah ache masan chujouvin Lystra ah achen ahile hikoma chun seijui khang dong Timothy kiti mikhat anaum in ahi. Ama chu anu Judah mi ahin, apa vang chu Greek mi ahi.
English: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.

tcz: Timothy chu Lystra le Iconium muna angaisang loi tahu seijui khat ahi.
en: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.
text:
ACT 16:2
Thadou: Timothy chu Lystra le Iconium muna angaisang loi tahu seijui khat ahi.
English: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.

tcz: Chuin Paul in ama chu alhonpi ding in adei sah in, hijeh chun akilhon khom masang lhonin Judah ten achom mu lou nadinguvin Timothy chu chep tan nading angaiton ahi. Ajeh chu mijousen apa Greek mi ahi chu ahet u ahi.
en: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
text:
ACT 16:3
Thadou: Chuin Paul in ama chu alhonpi ding in adei sah in, hijeh chun akilhon khom masang lhonin Judah ten achom mu lou nadinguvin Timothy chu chep tan nading angaiton ahi. Ajeh chu mijousen apa Greek mi ahi chu ahet u ahi.
English: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

tcz: Chuin amani chu khopi khat a konin khopi khat'ah avahle lhonin seijui ho chun Jerusalema solchahho le upa ho thulhuhna chu phatecha ajui cheh nadingun thu ahille lhon tan ahi.
en: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.
text:
ACT 16:4
Thadou: Chuin amani chu khopi khat a konin khopi khat'ah avahle lhonin seijui ho chun Jerusalema solchahho le upa ho thulhuhna chu phatecha ajui cheh nadingun thu ahille lhon tan ahi.
English: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.

tcz: Chuti chun houbung ho chu atahsan nau suh hat in aumin chule nisih in akhanglen jep jep un ahi.
en: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.
text:
ACT 16:5
Thadou: Chuti chun houbung ho chu atahsan nau suh hat in aumin chule nisih in akhanglen jep jep un ahi.
English: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.

tcz: Chuin Paul le Silas chu Phrygia le Galatia gamsunga akholjin jom lhon tan ahi ajeh chu Lhagao Theng in Asia gamsunga Pathen thulhangsap ding chu ajahda ahi.
en: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.
text:
ACT 16:6
Thadou: Chuin Paul le Silas chu Phrygia le Galatia gamsunga akholjin jom lhon tan ahi ajeh chu Lhagao Theng in Asia gamsunga Pathen thulhangsap ding chu ajahda ahi.
English: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

tcz: Chuin Mysia gamgi ahung lhun lhon phat in Bithynia jon ding in akihei toulhon in ahile hiche gam'a achelhon ding jong chu Pakai Lhagao in aphal pon ahi.
en: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.
text:
ACT 16:7
