Thadou: Chuin Mysia gamgi ahung lhun lhon phat in Bithynia jon ding in akihei toulhon in ahile hiche gam'a achelhon ding jong chu Pakai Lhagao in aphal pon ahi.
English: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.

tcz: Hijeh chun kihei tou talouvin Mysia gamsunga achepeh lhon in Troas kongkaimun chan achelhon tan ahi.
en: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.
text:
ACT 16:8
Thadou: Hijeh chun kihei tou talouvin Mysia gamsunga achepeh lhon in Troas kongkaimun chan achelhon tan ahi.
English: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

tcz: Hiche ni jan chun Paul in mu aneiyin: Athilmu achun Greece sahlam gam'a um Mecedonia akonin mikhat ahung ding in “Mecedonia gam'a hung in lang neihung kithopiuvin,” tin ahung taovin ahi.
en: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”
text:
ACT 16:9
Thadou: Hiche ni jan chun Paul in mu aneiyin: Athilmu achun Greece sahlam gam'a um Mecedonia akonin mikhat ahung ding in “Mecedonia gam'a hung in lang neihung kithopiuvin,” tin ahung taovin ahi.
English: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”

tcz: Hijeh chun keiho Mecedonia jonin kache tauvin, hiche gam'a kipana thupha lhangsam dinga Pathen in eikouvu ahi chu kahe tauvin ahi.
en: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.
text:
ACT 16:10
Thadou: Hijeh chun keiho Mecedonia jonin kache tauvin, hiche gam'a kipana thupha lhangsam dinga Pathen in eikouvu ahi chu kahe tauvin ahi.
English: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.

tcz: Chuin keiho Troas a konin konga katouvun jangjalin kacheuvin Samothrace twikol a kakinga pauvin, ajingin Neapolis kalhung tauvin ahi.
en: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

tcz: Hichea kon chun Mecedonia gamsunga khopi lenloi Rome te khosatna Philippi kalhung tauvin, hichea chun nikho tampi ka nichongun ahi.
en: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.
text:
ACT 16:12
Thadou: Hichea kon chun Mecedonia gamsunga khopi lenloi Rome te khosatna Philippi kalhung tauvin, hichea chun nikho tampi ka nichongun ahi.
English: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

tcz: Chuin cholngah nikhon khopi pamlama naicha a um vadung panga chun miho taokhom inte tia kagel jeh-u chun kacheuvin, hiche muna numei phabep anaum khom ho koma chun katouvun thu kaseiyun ahi.
en: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.
text:
ACT 16:13
Thadou: Chuin cholngah nikhon khopi pamlama naicha a um vadung panga chun miho taokhom inte tia kagel jeh-u chun kacheuvin, hiche muna numei phabep anaum khom ho koma chun katouvun thu kaseiyun ahi.
English: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.

tcz: Chuin Numei ho lah a chun Lydia kiti Thyatira gammi khat aumin ama chu ponsadup mantam tah a sumkolvei mi ahin chule ama chu Pathen hou jong ahi. Aman ka thuseiju chu phatechan angaiyin ahile Pakaiyin alungthim kot ahin hongin Paul thusei chu ajop tan ahi.
en: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.
text:
ACT 16:14
Thadou: Chuin Numei ho lah a chun Lydia kiti Thyatira gammi khat aumin ama chu ponsadup mantam tah a sumkolvei mi ahin chule ama chu Pathen hou jong ahi. Aman ka thuseiju chu phatechan angaiyin ahile Pakaiyin alungthim kot ahin hongin Paul thusei chu ajop tan ahi.
English: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.

tcz: Chuin amanu chu a insung mi jouse to baptize achangun, chule ama nun adongun “Pakai seijui dihtah ahi neitiuva ahile keima in'ah hung lhung unlang kajin in hung pangun,” tin anop tokah uvin angeh tan ahi.
en: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.
text:
ACT 16:15
Thadou: Chuin amanu chu a insung mi jouse to baptize achangun, chule ama nun adongun “Pakai seijui dihtah ahi neitiuva ahile keima in'ah hung lhung unlang kajin in hung pangun,” tin anop tokah uvin angeh tan ahi.
English: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.

tcz: Nikhat taona ding muna kache suh uva ahile lhagaoboh vop soh numei khat kamu uvin, amanu chun khonunga hung lhung ding thu aseiya aPakai tedinga sum tampi pi alo ji ahi.
en: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.
text:
ACT 16:16
Thadou: Nikhat taona ding muna kache suh uva ahile lhagaoboh vop soh numei khat kamu uvin, amanu chun khonunga hung lhung ding thu aseiya aPakai tedinga sum tampi pi alo ji ahi.
English: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

tcz: Amanu chun Paul le keiho nung ajuiyin aw sangtah in asamin, “Hiche miho hi Chung Nungpen Pathen sohte ahiuvin, chule huhhing'a naum theina dingu thu ahung seiyu ahi,” ati.
en: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”
text:
ACT 16:17
Thadou: Amanu chun Paul le keiho nung ajuiyin aw sangtah in asamin, “Hiche miho hi Chung Nungpen Pathen sohte ahiuvin, chule huhhing'a naum theina dingu thu ahung seiyu ahi,” ati.
English: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”

tcz: Hiti chun nikho tampi abolin ahile Paul jong alunghang tan, chuin akiheiyin asunga cheng lhagaoboh koma chun aseiyin, “Yeshua Christa mina thu kapeh nahi, amanu sunga konin pot in,” atile, apettah chun adalhatan ahi.
en: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.
text:
ACT 16:18
Thadou: Hiti chun nikho tampi abolin ahile Paul jong alunghang tan, chuin akiheiyin asunga cheng lhagaoboh koma chun aseiyin, “Yeshua Christa mina thu kapeh nahi, amanu sunga konin pot in,” atile, apettah chun adalhatan ahi.
English: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.

tcz: Chuin apakaiteu chun haosatna dinga akinepna jouseu akephat in Paul le Silas amanun kailhang muna thunei vaihom ho masanga akailut tauvin,
en: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.
text:
ACT 16:19
Thadou: Chuin apakaiteu chun haosatna dinga akinepna jouseu akephat in Paul le Silas amanun kailhang muna thunei vaihom ho masanga akailut tauvin,
English: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

tcz: “Hiche Judah miho jeh hin khopi sung pumpi boina asou sang tai” tin khopi vaihom ho henga asam tauvin ahi.
en: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city
text:
ACT 16:20
Thadou: “Hiche Judah miho jeh hin khopi sung pumpi boina asou sang tai” tin khopi vaihom ho henga asam tauvin ahi.
English: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city

tcz: Chule “Eiho Rome mite chonna toh kitoh lou chon dan thu ahilui,” atiuvin ahi.
en: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”
text:
ACT 16:21
Thadou: Chule “Eiho Rome mite chonna toh kitoh lou chon dan thu ahilui,” atiuvin ahi.
English: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”

tcz: Chuin mipi chu Paul le Silas dounan akikhom uvin, thing tenggol mangcha a ajep theina dingun khopi vaihom ho chun mipi chu thu ape tauvin ahi.
en: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.
text:
ACT 16:22
Thadou: Chuin mipi chu Paul le Silas dounan akikhom uvin, thing tenggol mangcha a ajep theina dingun khopi vaihom ho chun mipi chu thu ape tauvin ahi.
English: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.

tcz: Chuin melsetah a avoh jouvun songkul'a akhumun, songkul ngah ho henga chun phatechan anga tup dingun thu apeuvin ahi.
en: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.
text:
ACT 16:23
Thadou: Chuin melsetah a avoh jouvun songkul'a akhumun, songkul ngah ho henga chun phatechan anga tup dingun thu apeuvin ahi.
English: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.

tcz: Hijeh chun songkul ngah hon asung dan langpeh a akeng teni akan khomun akoi tauvin ahi.
en: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.
text:
ACT 16:24
Thadou: Hijeh chun songkul ngah hon asung dan langpeh a akeng teni akan khomun akoi tauvin ahi.
English: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.

tcz: Chuin jankhangkim laiyin Paul le Silas chu atao lhonin Pathen avahchoi lhonin ahile sonkula tangho chun angaiyuvin ahi.
en: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
text:
ACT 16:25
Thadou: Chuin jankhangkim laiyin Paul le Silas chu atao lhonin Pathen avahchoi lhonin ahile sonkula tangho chun angaiyuvin ahi.
English: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

tcz: Chuin phulou helouvin lingpi nasatah ahung kihot in, songkul khombul ho chu ahin hottan ahile, songkul kot jouse akihong tan, akihen na jouseu jong akilham tan ahi!
en: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.
text:
ACT 16:26
Thadou: Chuin phulou helouvin lingpi nasatah ahung kihot in, songkul khombul ho chu ahin hottan ahile, songkul kot jouse akihong tan, akihen na jouseu jong akilham tan ahi!
English: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.

tcz: Chuin songkul ngahpa ahung khah doh le songkul kot jouse ana kihon amu phat chun asunga umho jouse jammang gam ahitai tin achem asatdoh in ama le ama akithat kigon ahi.
en: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.
text:
ACT 16:27
Thadou: Chuin songkul ngahpa ahung khah doh le songkul kot jouse ana kihon amu phat chun asunga umho jouse jammang gam ahitai tin achem asatdoh in ama le ama akithat kigon ahi.
English: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

tcz: Ahivang in Paul chun asamin, “Khongaiyin nang le nang kithat hih in! keiho kabon chauvin kaum nauve!” atin ahi.
en: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”
text:
ACT 16:28
Thadou: Ahivang in Paul chun asamin, “Khongaiyin nang le nang kithat hih in! keiho kabon chauvin kaum nauve!” atin ahi.
English: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”

tcz: Chuin songkul ngahpa chun mei akidet in asungdan langa alhailut in Paul le Silas masanga kithing pum pumin akisep lhutan ahi.
en: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,
text:
ACT 16:29
Thadou: Chuin songkul ngahpa chun mei akidet in asungdan langa alhailut in Paul le Silas masanga kithing pum pumin akisep lhutan ahi.
English: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,

tcz: Chuin polama ahin puidoh lhonin, “Pu huhhing'a kaumna dinga ipi kabol ngaiyem?” ati.
en: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
text:
ACT 16:30
Thadou: Chuin polama ahin puidoh lhonin, “Pu huhhing'a kaumna dinga ipi kabol ngaiyem?” ati.
English: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

tcz: Amanin adonbut in “Nang le na insung miten Pakai Yeshua tahsanun chutile huhhing'a naum dingu ahi,” ati.
en: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”
text:
ACT 16:31
Thadou: Amanin adonbut in “Nang le na insung miten Pakai Yeshua tahsanun chutile huhhing'a naum dingu ahi,” ati.
English: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”

tcz: Hiti chun ama le a insung mite to Pathen thu aseikhom tauvin ahi.
en: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.
text:
ACT 16:32
Thadou: Hiti chun ama le a insung mite to Pathen thu aseikhom tauvin ahi.
English: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.

tcz: Chuin hiche ni jan ma ma chun songkul ngahpa chun akijepna maha lhon chu asop theng peh lhon in, chuin a insung mite jouse toh baptize achang tauvin ahi.
en: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.
text:
ACT 16:33
Thadou: Chuin hiche ni jan ma ma chun songkul ngahpa chun akijepna maha lhon chu asop theng peh lhon in, chuin a insung mite jouse toh baptize achang tauvin ahi.
English: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

tcz: Hiti chun amani ding chun a insunga ankong aluidoh peh un Pathen atahsan jeh-u chun ainkouvin akipah lheh jengun ahi.
en: He brought them up into his house and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly with all his household, having believed in God.
text:
ACT 16:34
Thadou: Hiti chun amani ding chun a insunga ankong aluidoh peh un Pathen atahsan jeh-u chun ainkouvin akipah lheh jengun ahi.
English: He brought them up into his house and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly with all his household, having believed in God.

tcz: Ajing jingkah in khopi vaihom ho chun songkul ngahpa henga, “Hiche mite chu soldoh in!” atiuvin ahi.
en: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”
text:
ACT 16:35
Thadou: Ajing jingkah in khopi vaihom ho chun songkul ngahpa henga, “Hiche mite chu soldoh in!” atiuvin ahi.
English: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”

tcz: Chuin songkul ngahpa chun Paul hengah aseiyin, “Khopi vaihom hon nang le Silas soldoh tan atiuvin ahi, hijeh chun lungmong in che hon tan,” ati.
en: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”
text:
ACT 16:36
Thadou: Chuin songkul ngahpa chun Paul hengah aseiyin, “Khopi vaihom hon nang le Silas soldoh tan atiuvin ahi, hijeh chun lungmong in che hon tan,” ati.
English: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”

tcz: Ahivang in Paul in adonbut in, “Keini hi Rome mi kahi lhon in kholtoh louva mipi angsunga eivoh'u ahin, guhthima eisoldoh got'u chu hithei lou ding ahi. Hijeh chun amaho tah hungu henlang eisoldoh'u hen,” ati.
en: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”
text:
ACT 16:37
Thadou: Ahivang in Paul in adonbut in, “Keini hi Rome mi kahi lhon in kholtoh louva mipi angsunga eivoh'u ahin, guhthima eisoldoh got'u chu hithei lou ding ahi. Hijeh chun amaho tah hungu henlang eisoldoh'u hen,” ati.
English: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”

tcz: Chuin hiche thu chu khopi vaihom hon ajah doh uva Paul le Silas chu Rome mi ahi ahet doh phat un,
en: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,
text:
ACT 16:38
Thadou: Chuin hiche thu chu khopi vaihom hon ajah doh uva Paul le Silas chu Rome mi ahi ahet doh phat un,
English: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,

tcz: Songkul'a ahungun amani koma chun ngaidam athum tauvin ahi. Chujouvin amani chu apuidoh uvin khopi sung dalha hon tan tin ataovun ahi.
en: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.
text:
ACT 16:39
Thadou: Songkul'a ahungun amani koma chun ngaidam athum tauvin ahi. Chujouvin amani chu apuidoh uvin khopi sung dalha hon tan tin ataovun ahi.
English: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.

tcz: Chuin Paul le Silas chu songkul'a kona ahung potdoh lhon phat in Lydia in'ah akile kit lhon in hiche in a seijui ho chu atilkhou lhonin chuin amanin khopi chu adalha lhon tan ahi.
en: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.
text:
ACT 16:40
Thadou: Chuin Paul le Silas chu songkul'a kona ahung potdoh lhon phat in Lydia in'ah akile kit lhon in hiche in a seijui ho chu atilkhou lhonin chuin amanin khopi chu adalha lhon tan ahi.
English: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.

tcz: Chuin Paul le Silas chun Amphipolis le Apollonia khopi ajot peh lhon in Thessalonica ahung lhung lhon tan ahi. Hichea chun Judah te kikhop na in aum in ahi.
en: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
text:
ACT 17:1
Thadou: Chuin Paul le Silas chun Amphipolis le Apollonia khopi ajot peh lhon in Thessalonica ahung lhung lhon tan ahi. Hichea chun Judah te kikhop na in aum in ahi.
English: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

tcz: Chuin abolngai bang in Paul chu Judah te kikhopna in'ah cholngah nikho thum kijom in achen Pathen lekhabu a pansan miho chu akihoulim pijin,
en: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
text:
ACT 17:2
Thadou: Chuin abolngai bang in Paul chu Judah te kikhopna in'ah cholngah nikho thum kijom in achen Pathen lekhabu a pansan miho chu akihoulim pijin,
English: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

tcz: Miho koma chun themgao hon asei banga Messiah chun genthei athoh'a chule thina a kona kaithouva aumding thudol ahil chen jin ahi. Chule “Hiche Yeshua athudol kaseipa hi Messiah chu ahi,” atin ahi.
en: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”
text:
ACT 17:3
Thadou: Miho koma chun themgao hon asei banga Messiah chun genthei athoh'a chule thina a kona kaithouva aumding thudol ahil chen jin ahi. Chule “Hiche Yeshua athudol kaseipa hi Messiah chu ahi,” atin ahi.
English: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”

tcz: Athusei ngaiho lah a Judah mi phabep le Pathen ging Greek mi chule numei mithupi phabep jaonan Paul le Silas thusei chu ajop uvin amani toh'a pang khom tauvin ahi.
en: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.
text:
ACT 17:4
Thadou: Athusei ngaiho lah a Judah mi phabep le Pathen ging Greek mi chule numei mithupi phabep jaonan Paul le Silas thusei chu ajop uvin amani toh'a pang khom tauvin ahi.
English: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.

tcz: Ahivang in Judah mi loikhat chu athangthip uvin hijeh chun kailhang dunga boina sem ho chu akoukhomun mipi atilseuvin, Jason in chu abulhu un, Paul le Silas chu mipi lah a kaidoh ing in ahol uvin ahi.
en: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.
text:
ACT 17:5
Thadou: Ahivang in Judah mi loikhat chu athangthip uvin hijeh chun kailhang dunga boina sem ho chu akoukhomun mipi atilseuvin, Jason in chu abulhu un, Paul le Silas chu mipi lah a kaidoh ing in ahol uvin ahi.
English: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

tcz: Chuin amani amu lou phat uvin, Jason le seijui dang phabep chu khopi vaihom ho mansanga akaidoh un, chule mipi chun asamun, “Paul le Silas hin vannoi pumpia boina asosah lhon ahin tun eiho khopi sunga jong boina aso hon tai,” atiuvin ahi.
en: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,
text:
ACT 17:6
Thadou: Chuin amani amu lou phat uvin, Jason le seijui dang phabep chu khopi vaihom ho mansanga akaidoh un, chule mipi chun asamun, “Paul le Silas hin vannoi pumpia boina asosah lhon ahin tun eiho khopi sunga jong boina aso hon tai,” atiuvin ahi.
English: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

tcz: “Hiche thilsoh hi Jason in a-in'a alhunsah jeh ahin, chule amahon Caesar dounan achonun Yeshua kiti leng dang khat aume,” atiuvin ahi.
en: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”
text:
ACT 17:7
Thadou: “Hiche thilsoh hi Jason in a-in'a alhunsah jeh ahin, chule amahon Caesar dounan achonun Yeshua kiti leng dang khat aume,” atiuvin ahi.
English: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”

tcz: Hiche thudol hin Khopi mite le vaihom ho nasatah in alungboi sah tan ahi.
en: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.
text:
ACT 17:8
Thadou: Hiche thudol hin Khopi mite le vaihom ho nasatah in alungboi sah tan ahi.
English: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

tcz: Chuin vaihom ho chun Jason le seijui dangho chu hunam'in akilhadoh theina dingun man apeh sah un chuin alhadoh tauvin ahi.
en: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.
text:
ACT 17:9
Thadou: Chuin vaihom ho chun Jason le seijui dangho chu hunam'in akilhadoh theina dingun man apeh sah un chuin alhadoh tauvin ahi.
English: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

tcz: Hiche ni jan ma ma chun seijui hon Paul le Silas chu Berea a dingin asoldoh tauvin, chuin amani Berea alhun lhon phat in Judah te kikhopna in'ah alutkit lhon in ahi.
en: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.
text:
ACT 17:10
Thadou: Hiche ni jan ma ma chun seijui hon Paul le Silas chu Berea a dingin asoldoh tauvin, chuin amani Berea alhun lhon phat in Judah te kikhopna in'ah alutkit lhon in ahi.
English: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

tcz: Berea mite chu Thessalonica mite sangin alungthim kot-u akihong jon, Paul thusei chu lunglut tah in angaiyun ahi. Niseh in Pathen Lekhabu asim jingun Paul le Silas chun thudih asei lhon hinam tin akhol chil un ahi.
en: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.
text:
ACT 17:11
Thadou: Berea mite chu Thessalonica mite sangin alungthim kot-u akihong jon, Paul thusei chu lunglut tah in angaiyun ahi. Niseh in Pathen Lekhabu asim jingun Paul le Silas chun thudih asei lhon hinam tin akhol chil un ahi.
English: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

tcz: Hiche toh kilhon chun Judah mi tampi leh Greek mithupi numei le pasal tampin atahsan tauvin ahi.
en: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.
text:
ACT 17:12
Thadou: Hiche toh kilhon chun Judah mi tampi leh Greek mithupi numei le pasal tampin atahsan tauvin ahi.
English: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

tcz: Ahin Thessalonica a um Judah mi phabep in Paul le Silas in Berea a Pathen thu asei lhon'e ti ahetdoh phat un ahung un mipi atildoh un boina asosah un ahi.
en: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.
text:
ACT 17:13
Thadou: Ahin Thessalonica a um Judah mi phabep in Paul le Silas in Berea a Pathen thu asei lhon'e ti ahetdoh phat un ahung un mipi atildoh un boina asosah un ahi.
English: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

tcz: Chuin seijui ho chun thakhat tah in Paul chu twipi gal langkhat ah asoldoh un, Silas le Timothy vang chu aumden lhon in ahi.
en: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.
text:
ACT 17:14
Thadou: Chuin seijui ho chun thakhat tah in Paul chu twipi gal langkhat ah asoldoh un, Silas le Timothy vang chu aumden lhon in ahi.
English: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.

tcz: Paul thah doh a che ho chun Athens kho chanin alhon piuvin, chuin Silas le Timothy jong gangtah a Paul kom alhun lhon nading thu ahinpouvin Berea a ahung kile kit tauvin ahi.
en: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.
text:
ACT 17:15
Thadou: Paul thah doh a che ho chun Athens kho chanin alhon piuvin, chuin Silas le Timothy jong gangtah a Paul kom alhun lhon nading thu ahinpouvin Berea a ahung kile kit tauvin ahi.
English: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

tcz: Chuin Paul in Athens khopi a Silas le Timothy anga sung chun khopi muntina milim ho chu amun alungthim ana lheh jeng in ahi.
en: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.
text:
ACT 17:16
Thadou: Chuin Paul in Athens khopi a Silas le Timothy anga sung chun khopi muntina milim ho chu amun alungthim ana lheh jeng in ahi.
English: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.

tcz: Chuin ama kikhopna in'a alut in, Judah miho le Pathen ging chidang namdang hotoh Pathen thun akihoulim khomuvin, chule niseh in jalhanga jong amuho jouse koma asei jin ahi.
en: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.
text:
ACT 17:17
Thadou: Chuin ama kikhopna in'a alut in, Judah miho le Pathen ging chidang namdang hotoh Pathen thun akihoulim khomuvin, chule niseh in jalhanga jong amuho jouse koma asei jin ahi.
English: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.

tcz: Hitichun Epicurean le Stoic chihgilna nei miho toh akinel'un, chuin Yeshua le athodoh chung chang thudol aseiyin ahile, amahon, “Hiche kamtam pa hin ipi hetkhah lou thukhat asei ham?” atiuvin, amaho lah a konkhat chun, “Hetphah lou pathen thu asei hile akilome,” atiuvin ahi.
en: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.
text:
ACT 17:18
Thadou: Hitichun Epicurean le Stoic chihgilna nei miho toh akinel'un, chuin Yeshua le athodoh chung chang thudol aseiyin ahile, amahon, “Hiche kamtam pa hin ipi hetkhah lou thukhat asei ham?” atiuvin, amaho lah a konkhat chun, “Hetphah lou pathen thu asei hile akilome,” atiuvin ahi.
English: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.

tcz: Chuin amahon Paul chu khopi vaihom ho anga apuilut un, “Hiche thuhil thah hi keiho koma hung sei kit in,” atiuvin ahi.
en: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?
text:
ACT 17:19
Thadou: Chuin amahon Paul chu khopi vaihom ho anga apuilut un, “Hiche thuhil thah hi keiho koma hung sei kit in,” atiuvin ahi.
English: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?

tcz: “Nang man thil chombeh thukhat naseiyin, hichu keihon kicheh tah in kahet nomuve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”
text:
ACT 17:20
Thadou: “Nang man thil chombeh thukhat naseiyin, hichu keihon kicheh tah in kahet nomuve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”

tcz: (Hiche thuhil thah thudol a hin Athens mite le gamchoma kona hungkhom miho chun aphatseh in kihoulim nan anei tauvin ahi).
en: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.
text:
ACT 17:21
Thadou: (Hiche thuhil thah thudol a hin Athens mite le gamchoma kona hungkhom miho chun aphatseh in kihoulim nan anei tauvin ahi).
English: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu mipi kikhopna a chun ading doh in, hitin aseiyin ahi. “Athens mite ho, nangho hi imalam jousea hougut tah nahiuhi kamudoh in ahi;
en: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

tcz: Ajeh chu kavah len ahile pathen kihouna muntheng tampi kamun, hiche maicham phung holah-a chun ‘hetphah lou pathen'a ding’ tia kisun khat kamudoh in ahi.” Keiman kasei hi hiche nahet phah lou u Pathen thu chu ahi.
en: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.
text:
ACT 17:23
Thadou: Ajeh chu kavah len ahile pathen kihouna muntheng tampi kamun, hiche maicham phung holah-a chun ‘hetphah lou pathen'a ding’ tia kisun khat kamudoh in ahi.” Keiman kasei hi hiche nahet phah lou u Pathen thu chu ahi.
English: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.

tcz: Hiche Pathen chu vannoi leiset le asunga thil umjouse sempa ahin, hijeh chun Ama chu khut a kisa houin'a acheng pon,
en: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.
text:
ACT 17:24
Thadou: Hiche Pathen chu vannoi leiset le asunga thil umjouse sempa ahin, hijeh chun Ama chu khut a kisa houin'a acheng pon,
English: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.

tcz: Chule mihem khut in angaichat ho apethei pon ahi ajeh chu aman ngaichat anei poi. Ama chun ahingthei jouse hinna apeh ahin, angai cha jouse ngaichat asuh bulhit peh ji ahi.
en: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.
text:
ACT 17:25
Thadou: Chule mihem khut in angaichat ho apethei pon ahi ajeh chu aman ngaichat anei poi. Ama chun ahingthei jouse hinna apeh ahin, angai cha jouse ngaichat asuh bulhit peh ji ahi.
English: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.

tcz: Aman mihem khat a kona leiset pumpia namtin asemdoh ahin, namkhat hung kitundoh le lhahsuh ding jong aman ahet masah sa ahi, chule agamgi geiya aman adatkhen sa ahi.
en: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,
text:
ACT 17:26
Thadou: Aman mihem khat a kona leiset pumpia namtin asemdoh ahin, namkhat hung kitundoh le lhahsuh ding jong aman ahet masah sa ahi, chule agamgi geiya aman adatkhen sa ahi.
English: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,

tcz: Athilsem lona jeh chu namtin in ama ahol'uva amu theina dingu ahi ajeh chu ama eihoa kona gamla tah a umlou ahi.
en: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.
text:
ACT 17:27
Thadou: Athilsem lona jeh chu namtin in ama ahol'uva amu theina dingu ahi ajeh chu ama eihoa kona gamla tah a umlou ahi.
English: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

tcz: Ajeh chu eiho ama a ihin uva ama'a ichale theiyuva chule ama'a ihiu ahi. Nangho zaila cheng khat'a jong, “Eiho ama chilhah ihiuve” tin akisun in ahi.
en: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
text:
ACT 17:28
Thadou: Ajeh chu eiho ama a ihin uva ama'a ichale theiyuva chule ama'a ihiu ahi. Nangho zaila cheng khat'a jong, “Eiho ama chilhah ihiuve” tin akisun in ahi.
English: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun eihon Pathen chu khutthem hon sana dangka ahiloule songa asemu milim hotoh ite loudiu ahi.
en: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.
text:
ACT 17:29
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun eihon Pathen chu khutthem hon sana dangka ahiloule songa asemu milim hotoh ite loudiu ahi.
English: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.

tcz: “Hetlouva nabol laiyuva chu Pathen kimumosah ahin, ahin tua hi hoilai hijong le mijousen chonset lungheiya ama lam ahin bel nadinga thu apeh ahitai.
en: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,
text:
ACT 17:30
Thadou: “Hetlouva nabol laiyuva chu Pathen kimumosah ahin, ahin tua hi hoilai hijong le mijousen chonset lungheiya ama lam ahin bel nadinga thu apeh ahitai.
English: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,

tcz: Ajeh chu aman vannoi thu atan ding nikho atepsa ahin, thudih'a thutan ding mikhat apansah in, ama chu mijouse mudin thina a konin akai thouvin ahi,” ati.
en: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”
text:
ACT 17:31
Thadou: Ajeh chu aman vannoi thu atan ding nikho atepsa ahin, thudih'a thutan ding mikhat apansah in, ama chu mijouse mudin thina a konin akai thouvin ahi,” ati.
English: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”

tcz: Chuin Paul in thokit thudol asei chu ajauvin ahileh mi konkhat chun anuisat un, ahin adangho chun “Hiche thudol hi olleh kangai nom kit-ui,” atiuvin ahi.
en: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”
text:
ACT 17:32
Thadou: Chuin Paul in thokit thudol asei chu ajauvin ahileh mi konkhat chun anuisat un, ahin adangho chun “Hiche thudol hi olleh kangai nom kit-ui,” atiuvin ahi.
English: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”

tcz: Hiti chun Paul in akihoulim nau achaiyin ahi.
en: Thus Paul went out from among them.
text:
ACT 17:33
Thadou: Hiti chun Paul in akihoulim nau achaiyin ahi.
English: Thus Paul went out from among them.

tcz: Ahivang in amaho lah a mi phabep chun atahsan un anung ajui tauvin ahi. Amaho chu, vaipo loiho lah a mi Dionysius, Damaris kiti numeinu chule adang mi phabep ahiuve.
en: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
text:
ACT 17:34
Thadou: Ahivang in amaho lah a mi phabep chun atahsan un anung ajui tauvin ahi. Amaho chu, vaipo loiho lah a mi Dionysius, Damaris kiti numeinu chule adang mi phabep ahiuve.
English: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu Athens a kon in Corinth achetan ahi.
en: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.
text:
ACT 18:1
Thadou: Chuin Paul chu Athens a kon in Corinth achetan ahi.
English: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.

tcz: Chuin hikoma chun Judah mi Aquila chu amun, amapa chu Pontus gam'a peng ahin, Italy gam'a kona Claudius Caesar in Rome a kona Judah te jouse ahin nodoh phat a ajinu Priscilla toh hung lhung til ahi lhone.
en: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,
text:
ACT 18:2
Thadou: Chuin hikoma chun Judah mi Aquila chu amun, amapa chu Pontus gam'a peng ahin, Italy gam'a kona Claudius Caesar in Rome a kona Judah te jouse ahin nodoh phat a ajinu Priscilla toh hung lhung til ahi lhone.
English: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,

tcz: Paul chu amaho in'ah alhung in na atong khom jiuvin ahi ajeh chu ama banga pon-in sah them cheh ahiuvin ahi.
en: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.
text:
ACT 18:3
Thadou: Paul chu amaho in'ah alhung in na atong khom jiuvin ahi ajeh chu ama banga pon-in sah them cheh ahiuvin ahi.
English: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.

tcz: Hiti chun cholngah nikho seh le Paul chu kikhopna in'a achen Judah te le Greek mite chu thu ahil jin ahi.
en: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.
text:
ACT 18:4
Thadou: Hiti chun cholngah nikho seh le Paul chu kikhopna in'a achen Judah te le Greek mite chu thu ahil jin ahi.
English: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

tcz: Chuin Silas le Timothy jong Mecedonia a kona ahung suh lhon phat chun Paul in aphat nei jousen Pathen thu alhangsam in, Judah te koma Yeshua chu Messiah ahi tin asam phong le tan ahi.
en: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.
text:
ACT 18:5
Thadou: Chuin Silas le Timothy jong Mecedonia a kona ahung suh lhon phat chun Paul in aphat nei jousen Pathen thu alhangsam in, Judah te koma Yeshua chu Messiah ahi tin asam phong le tan ahi.
English: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

tcz: Ahin Paul chu adoudal uva alunghan sah jeh un, Paul in aponsil a leivui athing lhan, “Nangho thisan nangho chung ma ma ah chu hen, keima them mo nabei kahi, tunia pat'a chidang namdang te henga kasap phong ding ahitai,” atin ahi.
en: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”
text:
ACT 18:6
Thadou: Ahin Paul chu adoudal uva alunghan sah jeh un, Paul in aponsil a leivui athing lhan, “Nangho thisan nangho chung ma ma ah chu hen, keima them mo nabei kahi, tunia pat'a chidang namdang te henga kasap phong ding ahitai,” atin ahi.
English: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”

tcz: Chuin kikhopna inkoma cheng Pathen ngaisah mi Titius Justus in'ah chun alut tan ahi.
en: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.
text:
ACT 18:7
Thadou: Chuin kikhopna inkoma cheng Pathen ngaisah mi Titius Justus in'ah chun alut tan ahi.
English: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.

tcz: Chuin kikhopna in'a lamkai loi Crispus le a-insunga umjousen Pakai atahsan un, chule Corinth a um midang tamtah'in jong Paul thusei chu ajauvin, atahsan un baptize achang tauvin ahi.
en: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.
text:
ACT 18:8
Thadou: Chuin kikhopna in'a lamkai loi Crispus le a-insunga umjousen Pakai atahsan un, chule Corinth a um midang tamtah'in jong Paul thusei chu ajauvin, atahsan un baptize achang tauvin ahi.
English: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.

tcz: Jankhat Paul henga Pakaiyin gaovin akimusah in hitin ahin seiyin, “Kicha hih in! Paodoh in! Umthim hih in!
en: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman nangma kaumpi nai, chule hiche khopi sunga hin koiman nabulhu lou ding nabol gim lou diu ahi, ajeh chu hiche khopi sunga mitamtah hi keiya ahi,” ati.
en: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”
text:
ACT 18:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman nangma kaumpi nai, chule hiche khopi sunga hin koiman nabulhu lou ding nabol gim lou diu ahi, ajeh chu hiche khopi sunga mitamtah hi keiya ahi,” ati.
English: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”

tcz: Chuin Paul chu Corinth a kum khat le akeh aumden in Pathen thu ahil len ahi.
en: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
text:
ACT 18:11
Thadou: Chuin Paul chu Corinth a kum khat le akeh aumden in Pathen thu ahil len ahi.
English: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

tcz: Ahin Gallio chu Achaia gamvaipoa ahung pan phat in Judah miho chu Paul dounan ahung sousang kit uvin, gamvaipo anga athu tan dingin ahin puiyun,
en: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,
text:
ACT 18:12
Thadou: Ahin Gallio chu Achaia gamvaipoa ahung pan phat in Judah miho chu Paul dounan ahung sousang kit uvin, gamvaipo anga athu tan dingin ahin puiyun,
English: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

tcz: “Paul in eiho dan toh kikal a Pathen hou dingin mi ajol e,” tin aheh seuvin ahi.
en: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”
text:
ACT 18:13
Thadou: “Paul in eiho dan toh kikal a Pathen hou dingin mi ajol e,” tin aheh seuvin ahi.
English: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”

tcz: Ahin Paul in akihonna thu asei toh lhon in Gallio in ahehse ho koma chun, “Judah miho, Ngaiyuvin, naheh nau thua hi thildih lou ahiloule thilse ajaukhah a ahile naheh nau hi kasanpeh ding nahiuve,
en: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

tcz: Ahin tun naheh nau thuhi thudoh mai mai, min mai mai, ahiloule Judah te danthu mai mai ahijeh'in nang hon kivet sui tauvin, hitobang thuhi katan nompoi,” atin,
en: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”
text:
ACT 18:15
Thadou: Ahin tun naheh nau thuhi thudoh mai mai, min mai mai, ahiloule Judah te danthu mai mai ahijeh'in nang hon kivet sui tauvin, hitobang thuhi katan nompoi,” atin,
English: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”

tcz: Thutanna in na kon in ahin soldoh tan ahi.
en: So he drove them from the judgment seat.
text:
ACT 18:16
Thadou: Thutanna in na kon in ahin soldoh tan ahi.
English: So he drove them from the judgment seat.

tcz: Chuin kikhopna in'a lamkai Sosthenes chu mipi chun amanun, thutanna inmai laitah a chun avotauvin ahi. Ahin Gallio chun iman jong agelpeh pouve.
en: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.
text:
ACT 18:17
Thadou: Chuin kikhopna in'a lamkai Sosthenes chu mipi chun amanun, thutanna inmai laitah a chun avotauvin ahi. Ahin Gallio chun iman jong agelpeh pouve.
English: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.

tcz: Chujouvin Paul chu Corinth ah phat chomkhat aum in chuin sopite ho koma lhahna thu aseiyin, akinaipi Cenchrea ajon tan ahi. Hiche laiya chun Paul in Judah te chona dan dung juiyin akitepna phat alhin phat in asam avoulhan, chuin Priscilla le Aquila toh Syria lam jon in konga akitol tauvin ahi.
en: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.
text:
ACT 18:18
Thadou: Chujouvin Paul chu Corinth ah phat chomkhat aum in chuin sopite ho koma lhahna thu aseiyin, akinaipi Cenchrea ajon tan ahi. Hiche laiya chun Paul in Judah te chona dan dung juiyin akitepna phat alhin phat in asam avoulhan, chuin Priscilla le Aquila toh Syria lam jon in konga akitol tauvin ahi.
English: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

tcz: Chuin Ephesus kongkaimun ahung lhun un, hichelaiya chun Paul in amani adalhan ama chu kikhopna in na alut in Juda techu asuhtoh peh in ahi.
en: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.
text:
ACT 18:19
Thadou: Chuin Ephesus kongkaimun ahung lhun un, hichelaiya chun Paul in amani adalhan ama chu kikhopna in na alut in Juda techu asuhtoh peh in ahi.
English: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

tcz: Hichea chun umsot jep ding in ana temun ahin anoppeh pon ahi.
en: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;

tcz: Adalhah ding kon chun, “Pathen lunglam ahile kahung kile kit ding ahi,” tin Ephesus a kon in konga akitol kit tan ahi.
en: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.
text:
ACT 18:21
Thadou: Adalhah ding kon chun, “Pathen lunglam ahile kahung kile kit ding ahi,” tin Ephesus a kon in konga akitol kit tan ahi.
English: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.

tcz: Chuin Caesarea kongkaimuna aki nga kit in, hichea kon chun Jerusalem houbung agavil in chuin Antioch a akile kit tan ahi.
en: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.
text:
ACT 18:22
Thadou: Chuin Caesarea kongkaimuna aki nga kit in, hichea kon chun Jerusalem houbung agavil in chuin Antioch a akile kit tan ahi.
English: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

tcz: Phat chomkhat Antioch a aum jouvin Paul chu Galatia le Phrygia lama akile kit in, seijui ho akimupi kit in asuhat kit in ahi.
en: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.
text:
ACT 18:23
Thadou: Phat chomkhat Antioch a aum jouvin Paul chu Galatia le Phrygia lama akile kit in, seijui ho akimupi kit in asuhat kit in ahi.
English: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

tcz: Alang khat'ah Egypt gam Alexandria a konin thusei them tah le Pathen Lekhabu thu hetah Judah mi Apollos chu Ephesus ahung lhung in,
en: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.
text:
ACT 18:24
Thadou: Alang khat'ah Egypt gam Alexandria a konin thusei them tah le Pathen Lekhabu thu hetah Judah mi Apollos chu Ephesus ahung lhung in,
English: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

tcz: Ama chun Pakai lampi thu ahil in, chule midang ho chu dihtah le Lhagaova thaneitah in Yeshua thudol ahil in ahi. Ahinlah ama chun twilutsah John bou ahet ahi.
en: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.
text:
ACT 18:25
Thadou: Ama chun Pakai lampi thu ahil in, chule midang ho chu dihtah le Lhagaova thaneitah in Yeshua thudol ahil in ahi. Ahinlah ama chun twilutsah John bou ahet ahi.
English: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

tcz: Chuin kikhopna in'a hangsan tah a thu asei chu Priscilla le Aquila in ajah lhon phat in ama chu akoudoh lhon in Pathen thu kicheh tah in ahil chenbe lhon in ahi.
en: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
text:
ACT 18:26
Thadou: Chuin kikhopna in'a hangsan tah a thu asei chu Priscilla le Aquila in ajah lhon phat in ama chu akoudoh lhon in Pathen thu kicheh tah in ahil chenbe lhon in ahi.
English: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

tcz: Chuin Apollos in Achaia gam'a che ding lung agel jeh chun sopite hon ama chu atil khouvun, chule Achaia gam'a seijui ho ding chun lekha khat athot un kipah tah a analem ding un angeh un ahi. Chuin alhun phat in Pakai mingailut jal'a atahsan ho jouse dinga mi phachom tah asoh tan ahi.
en: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

tcz: Judate chu lhang phongin thaneitah in anelkhup jin, Pathen thu dung juiyin Yeshua chu Messiah ahi tin ahil chen jin ahi.
en: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
text:
ACT 18:28
Thadou: Judate chu lhang phongin thaneitah in anelkhup jin, Pathen thu dung juiyin Yeshua chu Messiah ahi tin ahil chen jin ahi.
English: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

tcz: Chuin Apollos Corinth a aum jing lai chun Paul jong chuche gamkai sunga chun avah len Ephesus ahung lhun chun seijui tampi amun amaho koma chun,
en: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.
text:
ACT 19:1
Thadou: Chuin Apollos Corinth a aum jing lai chun Paul jong chuche gamkai sunga chun avah len Ephesus ahung lhun chun seijui tampi amun amaho koma chun,
English: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.

tcz: “Natahsan uva chu Lhagao Theng nachan nah uvem?” tin adong in ahile, amahon “Kachang pouve, Lhagao Theng aume akiti lam jong kajakha pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”
text:
ACT 19:2
Thadou: “Natahsan uva chu Lhagao Theng nachan nah uvem?” tin adong in ahile, amahon “Kachang pouve, Lhagao Theng aume akiti lam jong kajakha pouve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”

tcz: Chuin aman adong kit in “Ahileh ipia baptize chang nahiuvem?” ati. Amahon jong “John baptize chanin,” atiuve.
en: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”
text:
ACT 19:3
Thadou: Chuin aman adong kit in “Ahileh ipia baptize chang nahiuvem?” ati. Amahon jong “John baptize chanin,” atiuve.
English: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”

tcz: Chuin Paul in, “John baptize chan chu chonset na a kon lunghei na ding bou ahi, ahin John jeng in jong miho jah a chun ama jouva hung ding pachu tahsanun,” ati, hichu Yeshua aseina ahi.
en: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.”
text:
ACT 19:4
Thadou: Chuin Paul in, “John baptize chan chu chonset na a kon lunghei na ding bou ahi, ahin John jeng in jong miho jah a chun ama jouva hung ding pachu tahsanun,” ati, hichu Yeshua aseina ahi.
English: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.”

tcz: Chuche thu ajah jah un abonchauvin Pakai Yeshua minin baptize achang tauvin ahi.
en: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
text:
ACT 19:5
Thadou: Chuche thu ajah jah un abonchauvin Pakai Yeshua minin baptize achang tauvin ahi.
English: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

tcz: Chuin Paul in achung'uva khut angamin ahile, Lhagao Theng achung'uva ahung chutan, chule abonchauvin paochom athouvin gaothu asei tauvin ahi.
en: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.
text:
ACT 19:6
Thadou: Chuin Paul in achung'uva khut angamin ahile, Lhagao Theng achung'uva ahung chutan, chule abonchauvin paochom athouvin gaothu asei tauvin ahi.
English: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.

tcz: Amaho chu abonun mi somleni ahiuve.
en: They were about twelve men in all.
text:
ACT 19:7
Thadou: Amaho chu abonun mi somleni ahiuve.
English: They were about twelve men in all.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu kikhopna in'ah alut in hapta thum sungin hangsan tah in thu aseiyin, thununsah teina ding in Pathen lenggam thu ahilin ahi.
en: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.
text:
ACT 19:8
Thadou: Chuin Paul chu kikhopna in'ah alut in hapta thum sungin hangsan tah in thu aseiyin, thununsah teina ding in Pathen lenggam thu ahilin ahi.
English: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.

tcz: Ahin mi konkhat chu alouchal uvin thu kisei chu sanglouvin, lhang phongtah in asei seuvin ahi. Hijeh chun Paul in kikhopna in chu adalhan seijui ho chu akipui doh'in Tyrannus muna thuseina in khat'ah niseh in akihoulim pitan ahi.
en: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.
text:
ACT 19:9
Thadou: Ahin mi konkhat chu alouchal uvin thu kisei chu sanglouvin, lhang phongtah in asei seuvin ahi. Hijeh chun Paul in kikhopna in chu adalhan seijui ho chu akipui doh'in Tyrannus muna thuseina in khat'ah niseh in akihoulim pitan ahi.
English: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

tcz: Hiti chun kumni jen abol'un ahile Asia gamsung pumpia Judah te le Greek mi abonchauvin Pakai thu chu ajatauvin ahi.
en: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
text:
ACT 19:10
Thadou: Hiti chun kumni jen abol'un ahile Asia gamsung pumpia Judah te le Greek mi abonchauvin Pakai thu chu ajatauvin ahi.
English: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

tcz: Chuin Pathen in Paul chu bolmo kidang bolthei na tha ape tan ahi.
en: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,
text:
ACT 19:11
Thadou: Chuin Pathen in Paul chu bolmo kidang bolthei na tha ape tan ahi.
English: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,

tcz: Chuti chun ultheh pon hihen lang achunga kai pon poupou hijong le achoiyun adamlouho chunga akoiyun ahile adamlou nau chu adamin asunga lhagao phalou ho jong ajamdoh jin ahi.
en: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.
text:
ACT 19:12
Thadou: Chuti chun ultheh pon hihen lang achunga kai pon poupou hijong le achoiyun adamlouho chunga akoiyun ahile adamlou nau chu adamin asunga lhagao phalou ho jong ajamdoh jin ahi.
English: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.

tcz: Chuin Judah miho phabep khopi khat'a konin khopi khat ah avah leuvin, lhagao boh ho anodoh un, amaho chun Pakai Yeshua min pat ding agouvin, “Paul in alhangsap Yeshua mina thu kapeh nahi, hungpot in!” tin asei jiuvin ahi.
en: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”
text:
ACT 19:13
Thadou: Chuin Judah miho phabep khopi khat'a konin khopi khat ah avah leuvin, lhagao boh ho anodoh un, amaho chun Pakai Yeshua min pat ding agouvin, “Paul in alhangsap Yeshua mina thu kapeh nahi, hungpot in!” tin asei jiuvin ahi.
English: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”

tcz: Hitia thil bol chu thempu lenloi, Sceva chate pasal sagi ho ahiuve.
en: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.
text:
ACT 19:14
Thadou: Hitia thil bol chu thempu lenloi, Sceva chate pasal sagi ho ahiuve.
English: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.

tcz: Ahin chutia nikhat abolgot kit laitah un lhagao boh chun, “Yeshua le Paul chu kahenai, nang koi nahiuvem?” atin ahi.
en: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”
text:
ACT 19:15
Thadou: Ahin chutia nikhat abolgot kit laitah un lhagao boh chun, “Yeshua le Paul chu kahenai, nang koi nahiuvem?” atin ahi.
English: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”

tcz: Chuin lhagao boh voppa chu amaho chunga achomlut in amaho chu athajo in asugim tauvin ahile amaho chu sagohkeo le maha pun ajamdoh tauvin ahi.
en: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
text:
ACT 19:16
Thadou: Chuin lhagao boh voppa chu amaho chunga achomlut in amaho chu athajo in asugim tauvin ahile amaho chu sagohkeo le maha pun ajamdoh tauvin ahi.
English: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

tcz: Hiche thilsoh chu Ephesus khopi sunga Judate le Greek mite hengah gangtah in akithe jal tan ahile, khopi sungah kichat tijatna adim tan, Pakai Yeshua min chu nasatah in ajabol tauvin ahi.
en: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
text:
ACT 19:17
Thadou: Hiche thilsoh chu Ephesus khopi sunga Judate le Greek mite hengah gangtah in akithe jal tan ahile, khopi sungah kichat tijatna adim tan, Pakai Yeshua min chu nasatah in ajabol tauvin ahi.
English: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

tcz: Chuin seijui tamtah ho chun achonset thilbol'u aphong tauvin ahi.
en: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.
text:
ACT 19:18
Thadou: Chuin seijui tamtah ho chun achonset thilbol'u aphong tauvin ahi.
English: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.

tcz: Chuin doichoi ho mitam tah'in jong a lekhabu-u ahin choi khom uvin, mipi ang sung laitah a agouvam tauvin ahi. Hiche alekhabu-u chu dangka tamtah man ahi.
en: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.
text:
ACT 19:19
Thadou: Chuin doichoi ho mitam tah'in jong a lekhabu-u ahin choi khom uvin, mipi ang sung laitah a agouvam tauvin ahi. Hiche alekhabu-u chu dangka tamtah man ahi.
English: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.

tcz: Hiche Pakai natoh thudol chu muntina akithe jaltan thahat tah'in na atong tan ahi.
en: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.
text:
ACT 19:20
Thadou: Hiche Pakai natoh thudol chu muntina akithe jaltan thahat tah'in na atong tan ahi.
English: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.

tcz: Chuin phat chomkhat jouvin lhagao vin asoljeh chun Paul chu Jerusalem ache masang in Mecedonia le Achaia gam'a ding in achen, “Chujou tengle Rome a kache ding ahi,” tin aseiyin ahi.
en: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”
text:
ACT 19:21
Thadou: Chuin phat chomkhat jouvin lhagao vin asoljeh chun Paul chu Jerusalem ache masang in Mecedonia le Achaia gam'a ding in achen, “Chujou tengle Rome a kache ding ahi,” tin aseiyin ahi.
English: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”

tcz: Chuin ama Asia gam'a phat chomkhat aum nalaiyin, Timothy le Erastus chu akithopi ding in Mecedonia a amasol in ahi.
en: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
text:
ACT 19:22
Thadou: Chuin ama Asia gam'a phat chomkhat aum nalaiyin, Timothy le Erastus chu akithopi ding in Mecedonia a amasol in ahi.
English: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.

tcz: Chuche phatlai chun Ephesus ah hiche kithuhilna lampi chung changa boina khohtah khat ahung umdohtan ahi.
en: About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.
text:
ACT 19:23
Thadou: Chuche phatlai chun Ephesus ah hiche kithuhilna lampi chung changa boina khohtah khat ahung umdohtan ahi.
English: About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.

tcz: Ajeh chu Demetrius kiti mikhat aumin, ama chu dangka a sumkolvei mi ahin, aman khutthem ho chu dangka in Greek te pathen Artemis lim akhen sah in hoitah in akoiyin ahi.
en: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,
text:
ACT 19:24
Thadou: Ajeh chu Demetrius kiti mikhat aumin, ama chu dangka a sumkolvei mi ahin, aman khutthem ho chu dangka in Greek te pathen Artemis lim akhen sah in hoitah in akoiyin ahi.
English: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,

tcz: Chuin aman anatoh kibah piho chu akou khomin ajah uva: “Mipi ho hiche sumkolvei na hi ihaodoh nau ahi,” ati.
en: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.
text:
ACT 19:25
Thadou: Chuin aman anatoh kibah piho chu akou khomin ajah uva: “Mipi ho hiche sumkolvei na hi ihaodoh nau ahi,” ati.
English: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.

tcz: “Ahin najah uva namu bang un, hiche Paul hin miho jouse koma khut a kisem limho hi pathen tahbeh ahipoi tin aseiyin mijouse alhemlha tai, chule hiche thuhi Ephesus khopi bouseh a asei ahipon Asia gamsung pumpia asei le ahi!
en: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.
text:
ACT 19:26
Thadou: “Ahin najah uva namu bang un, hiche Paul hin miho jouse koma khut a kisem limho hi pathen tahbeh ahipoi tin aseiyin mijouse alhemlha tai, chule hiche thuhi Ephesus khopi bouseh a asei ahipon Asia gamsung pumpia asei le ahi!
English: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.

tcz: Ahinai! Isumkolvei nau mijousen nahsah moa akoi ding thubou kasei ahipoi, ahin Artemis pathen houna in thupina jouse aman a, chule Asia gamsung pumpi le vannoi pumpia hiche pathen houna aman thah ding jong hi kagelkhoh tah khat ahi!” ati.
en: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”
text:
ACT 19:27
Thadou: Ahinai! Isumkolvei nau mijousen nahsah moa akoi ding thubou kasei ahipoi, ahin Artemis pathen houna in thupina jouse aman a, chule Asia gamsung pumpi le vannoi pumpia hiche pathen houna aman thah ding jong hi kagelkhoh tah khat ahi!” ati.
English: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”

tcz: Hichun akikhom miho chu alung hangjah jeng uvin, “Ephesus mite pathen Artemis alen'e,” tin hasap in asam tauvin ahi.
en: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
text:
ACT 19:28
Thadou: Hichun akikhom miho chu alung hangjah jeng uvin, “Ephesus mite pathen Artemis alen'e,” tin hasap in asam tauvin ahi.
English: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

tcz: Hichun khopi sunga miho chu alung boilah lah jeng uvin, mipi chun Paul hin kilhonpi Macedonia gam'a kon Gaius le Aristarchus chu amanun golseh vetna muna chun akailut tauvin ahi.
en: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.
text:
ACT 19:29
Thadou: Hichun khopi sunga miho chu alung boilah lah jeng uvin, mipi chun Paul hin kilhonpi Macedonia gam'a kon Gaius le Aristarchus chu amanun golseh vetna muna chun akailut tauvin ahi.
English: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.

tcz: Chuin Paul jong chu lut ding agon, ahin seijui hon analut sah pouvin ahi.
en: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.
text:
ACT 19:30
Thadou: Chuin Paul jong chu lut ding agon, ahin seijui hon analut sah pouvin ahi.
English: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.

tcz: Chuin Asia gamsung a Paul loi le gol milen milal phabep in Paul henga thu ahin thot un, golseh vetna muna lut loubeh ding in ahung taovun ahi.
en: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.
text:
ACT 19:31
Thadou: Chuin Asia gamsung a Paul loi le gol milen milal phabep in Paul henga thu ahin thot un, golseh vetna muna lut loubeh ding in ahung taovun ahi.
English: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.

tcz: Golseh vetna mun sunga chun mipi chu apeng lah lah un mi abangin thilkhat asamun, abangin thildang khat asamun, hiti chun aeu lah lah jenguvin, abangloi chun ipi jeh a kikhom ahiu jong ahepouvin ahi.
en: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.
text:
ACT 19:32
Thadou: Golseh vetna mun sunga chun mipi chu apeng lah lah un mi abangin thilkhat asamun, abangin thildang khat asamun, hiti chun aeu lah lah jenguvin, abangloi chun ipi jeh a kikhom ahiu jong ahepouvin ahi.
English: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.

tcz: Chuin mipi lah a um Juda miho chun Alexander chu mipi masanga ahin sondoh un thilsoh thudol ahil chet dingin asolun ahi. Chuin aman mipi ho chu aphoh thip in houlim ding agon ahi.
en: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.
text:
ACT 19:33
Thadou: Chuin mipi lah a um Juda miho chun Alexander chu mipi masanga ahin sondoh un thilsoh thudol ahil chet dingin asolun ahi. Chuin aman mipi ho chu aphoh thip in houlim ding agon ahi.
English: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.

tcz: Ahinlah mipi ho chun amapa chu Juda mi ahi ahetdoh phat un, hatah in asamkit un, “Ephesus Artemis alen e, Ephesus Artemis alen e!” tin nidan ni lang asamun ahi.
en: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
text:
ACT 19:34
Thadou: Ahinlah mipi ho chun amapa chu Juda mi ahi ahetdoh phat un, hatah in asamkit un, “Ephesus Artemis alen e, Ephesus Artemis alen e!” tin nidan ni lang asamun ahi.
English: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

tcz: Ajo jo nan khopi vaipopa chun mipi ho chu aphoh thip in aman, “Vo Ephesus mite, Ephesus khopi hi vana kona hung khelha Artemis len lim houin ngah ahi hi mijousen ahet ahi,” ati.
en: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?
text:
ACT 19:35
Thadou: Ajo jo nan khopi vaipopa chun mipi ho chu aphoh thip in aman, “Vo Ephesus mite, Ephesus khopi hi vana kona hung khelha Artemis len lim houin ngah ahi hi mijousen ahet ahi,” ati.
English: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?

tcz: “Hiche thutah hi koiman aseilep theilou ahijeh'in nangho thipkhen chan um unlang imacha kinothethun bol dauvin.
en: Seeing then that these things can’t be denied, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash.
text:
ACT 19:36
Thadou: “Hiche thutah hi koiman aseilep theilou ahijeh'in nangho thipkhen chan um unlang imacha kinothethun bol dauvin.
English: Seeing then that these things can’t be denied, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash.

tcz: Hiche napuilut-u mite hin houin'a konin imacha agudoh pouvin, eiho pathen dounan jong ima asei pouve.
en: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.
text:
ACT 19:37
Thadou: Hiche napuilut-u mite hin houin'a konin imacha agudoh pouvin, eiho pathen dounan jong ima asei pouve.
English: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.

tcz: Amavang Demetrius le anatoh kibahpi khutthem hon amaho hehset nading thu aneiyuva ahile thutanna in honsan aum jinge, chule gamvaipoho henga jong athu agasei theiyu ahi. Amaho koma khun ga kihehsah tauvin.
en: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.
text:
ACT 19:38
Thadou: Amavang Demetrius le anatoh kibahpi khutthem hon amaho hehset nading thu aneiyuva ahile thutanna in honsan aum jinge, chule gamvaipoho henga jong athu agasei theiyu ahi. Amaho koma khun ga kihehsah tauvin.
English: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.

tcz: Chule ahehnau thudang aumle vang angaiya kikhopna in'a athu tanding ahi.
en: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.
text:
ACT 19:39
Thadou: Chule ahehnau thudang aumle vang angaiya kikhopna in'a athu tanding ahi.
English: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.

tcz: Ajeh beiya boina soh ahijeh'in ajole Rome vaipoten ichunguva thu ahin tan khah diu ham tin kichat nan kadime. Ajeh chu Rome vaipoten tuni thilsoh thudol hilchen dingin eihin dongule ima isei thei lou diu ahi,” ati.
en: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today’s riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn’t be able to give an account of this commotion.”
text:
ACT 19:40
Thadou: Ajeh beiya boina soh ahijeh'in ajole Rome vaipoten ichunguva thu ahin tan khah diu ham tin kichat nan kadime. Ajeh chu Rome vaipoten tuni thilsoh thudol hilchen dingin eihin dongule ima isei thei lou diu ahi,” ati.
English: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today’s riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn’t be able to give an account of this commotion.”

tcz: Chuin mipi sousang na chu athip phat in Paul in seijui ho chu agakousah in atilkhou jouvin, damselun tin akikhen pin ama Macedonia lamah achetan ahi.
en: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
text:
ACT 20:1
Thadou: Chuin mipi sousang na chu athip phat in Paul in seijui ho chu agakousah in atilkhou jouvin, damselun tin akikhen pin ama Macedonia lamah achetan ahi.
English: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.

tcz: Chuche gamsunga ajotpa na khopi jousea seijuiho atilkhou peh in chuin Greece khopi chanin achesuh tan ahi.
en: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.
text:
ACT 20:2
Thadou: Chuche gamsunga ajotpa na khopi jousea seijuiho atilkhou peh in chuin Greece khopi chanin achesuh tan ahi.
English: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.

tcz: Chuin hiche khopia chun lhathum sung aumin, Syria gam lama konga kinung tolding angaiton ahile Juda mi phabep in thading agot-u ahetdoh phat in Macedonia lang joh jotpa ding in akile kit tan ahi
en: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.
text:
ACT 20:3
Thadou: Chuin hiche khopia chun lhathum sung aumin, Syria gam lama konga kinung tolding angaiton ahile Juda mi phabep in thading agot-u ahetdoh phat in Macedonia lang joh jotpa ding in akile kit tan ahi
English: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.

tcz: Ama chu mi phabep toh alhon in ahi. Amaho chu: Berea a kon Pyrrhus chapa Sopater, Thessalonica a kon Aristarchus le Secundus, Derbe a kon Gaius, Timothy, chule Asia gam'a kona Tychicus le Trophimus ahiuve.
