en: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.
text:
ACT 20:4
Thadou: Ama chu mi phabep toh alhon in ahi. Amaho chu: Berea a kon Pyrrhus chapa Sopater, Thessalonica a kon Aristarchus le Secundus, Derbe a kon Gaius, Timothy, chule Asia gam'a kona Tychicus le Trophimus ahiuve.
English: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.

tcz: Amaho chu ana masauvin Troas muna eina ngah un ahi.
en: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.
text:
ACT 20:5
Thadou: Amaho chu ana masauvin Troas muna eina ngah un ahi.
English: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.

tcz: Chuin Kalchuh kut kichaiyin Macedonia gam'a Philippi khopia konin konga katouvun ninga jouvin Troas muna amaho heng kalhung uvin, chuin hiche muna chun hapta khat kaumun ahi.
en: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.
text:
ACT 20:6
Thadou: Chuin Kalchuh kut kichaiyin Macedonia gam'a Philippi khopia konin konga katouvun ninga jouvin Troas muna amaho heng kalhung uvin, chuin hiche muna chun hapta khat kaumun ahi.
English: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.

tcz: Chuin nimasa nin seijuiho toh Pakai anjon jong dingin kakikhomun hichea chun Paul in amaho henga thu aseiyin, ajing a ama chekit ding ahitah jeh chun jankim chan ahoulimin ahi.
en: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.
text:
ACT 20:7
Thadou: Chuin nimasa nin seijuiho toh Pakai anjon jong dingin kakikhomun hichea chun Paul in amaho henga thu aseiyin, ajing a ama chekit ding ahitah jeh chun jankim chan ahoulimin ahi.
English: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.

tcz: Hiche kakikhop nau indan chungnunga chu meivah tamtah kide ahi.
en: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.
text:
ACT 20:8
Thadou: Hiche kakikhop nau indan chungnunga chu meivah tamtah kide ahi.
English: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.

tcz: Chuin Paul in phat sottah thu asei jeh chun bangkot koma tou gollhang chapang khat amin Eutychus atiu chu aihmutso beh seh jeh chun aihmulhutan ahile bangkot a kon chun in danthum a sanga chun akileh lhan noilama athisain aga muvin ahi.
en: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.
text:
ACT 20:9
Thadou: Chuin Paul in phat sottah thu asei jeh chun bangkot koma tou gollhang chapang khat amin Eutychus atiu chu aihmutso beh seh jeh chun aihmulhutan ahile bangkot a kon chun in danthum a sanga chun akileh lhan noilama athisain aga muvin ahi.
English: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

tcz: Chuin Paul akumsuh in abungin akhut in hiche gollhang chapang pachu apomin, “lungdong hih un ahing nalaiye” ati.
en: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”
text:
ACT 20:10
Thadou: Chuin Paul akumsuh in abungin akhut in hiche gollhang chapang pachu apomin, “lungdong hih un ahing nalaiye” ati.
English: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”

tcz: Chuin amaho indan chungnunga akaltou kit-un Pakai anjon changlhah aneuvin ahi. Hiti chun Paul in thusei abanjom kit in khovah lhah phat in aman adalha tauvin ahi.
en: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.
text:
ACT 20:11
Thadou: Chuin amaho indan chungnunga akaltou kit-un Pakai anjon changlhah aneuvin ahi. Hiti chun Paul in thusei abanjom kit in khovah lhah phat in aman adalha tauvin ahi.
English: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.

tcz: Alangkhat ah gollhang chapang pa jong chu akisuhkhah na beihel in inlam'a akilen ahileh mijouse chu alungmong lheh jengun ahi.
en: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.
text:
ACT 20:12
Thadou: Alangkhat ah gollhang chapang pa jong chu akisuhkhah na beihel in inlam'a akilen ahileh mijouse chu alungmong lheh jengun ahi.
English: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu Assos chanin kenglamah ana chepeh in, keiho konga kacheuva chule ama kalahpa nadiuva agontoh ahi.
en: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.
text:
ACT 20:13
Thadou: Chuin Paul chu Assos chanin kenglamah ana chepeh in, keiho konga kacheuva chule ama kalahpa nadiuva agontoh ahi.
English: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.

tcz: Chuin hiche muna kon chun ama jong keihotoh konga katoukhomun Mitylene chan kacheuvin ahi.
en: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.
text:
ACT 20:14
Thadou: Chuin hiche muna kon chun ama jong keihotoh konga katoukhomun Mitylene chan kacheuvin ahi.
English: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.

tcz: Ajing in Kios twikol kakhokhel un, akit-in Samos twikol kajot paikit un chule nikhat jouvin Miletus twikol kalhung uvin ahi.
en: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.
text:
ACT 20:15
Thadou: Ajing in Kios twikol kakhokhel un, akit-in Samos twikol kajot paikit un chule nikhat jouvin Miletus twikol kalhung uvin ahi.
English: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.

tcz: Chuin Asia gamsunga aumsot nom lou phat in Paul in konga touva Ephesus khopi jotpai ding lung angaito tan ahi. Kinotah a cheloiya ahithei le Pentecost masanga Jerusalem lhun teiding ati ahi.
en: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.
text:
ACT 20:16
Thadou: Chuin Asia gamsunga aumsot nom lou phat in Paul in konga touva Ephesus khopi jotpai ding lung angaito tan ahi. Kinotah a cheloiya ahithei le Pentecost masanga Jerusalem lhun teiding ati ahi.
English: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

tcz: Ahin Miletus kalhun un Ephesus Houbung a um upa ho henga ahung kimupi diuvin thu athot tan ahi.
en: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.
text:
ACT 20:17
Thadou: Ahin Miletus kalhun un Ephesus Houbung a um upa ho henga ahung kimupi diuvin thu athot tan ahi.
English: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.

tcz: Chuin amaho ahung lhun phat un aman “Nanghon naheuve, Asia gamsung kahung chotlut nikhoa pat tuni chanin,
en: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,
text:
ACT 20:18
Thadou: Chuin amaho ahung lhun phat un aman “Nanghon naheuve, Asia gamsung kahung chotlut nikhoa pat tuni chanin,
English: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,

tcz: Kineosah tah le mitlhi pumin Pakai na katongin, Judate a kona gimbolna tamtah jong kathoh in ahi.
en: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;

tcz: Chule nangho jahding imacha imlouvin, japi lah le intin'ah kahilleuvin ahi.
en: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,
text:
ACT 20:20
Thadou: Chule nangho jahding imacha imlouvin, japi lah le intin'ah kahilleuvin ahi.
English: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,

tcz: Juda te le Greek te henga thukhat seh hichu, chonsetna a kon lungheiya chule Pathen lama kiheiya, chule Pakai Yeshua tahsan ding thubou chu kasei jing ahi.
en: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus.
text:
ACT 20:21
Thadou: Juda te le Greek te henga thukhat seh hichu, chonsetna a kon lungheiya chule Pathen lama kiheiya, chule Pakai Yeshua tahsan ding thubou chu kasei jing ahi.
English: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus.

tcz: Tun keima Lhagaovin Jerusalema cheding in eisom tan, ipin einga ham jong kahepoi.
en: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;

tcz: Khopi tina Lhagao Theng in eihetsah bangin thohgim nale songkul tanna tailou ima kahepoi.
en: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.
text:
ACT 20:23
Thadou: Khopi tina Lhagao Theng in eihetsah bangin thohgim nale songkul tanna tailou ima kahepoi.
English: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.

tcz: Ahin Kahinkho hi Pakai Yeshuan einganse na banga midang te henga Pathen mingailut na kidangtah kipana thupha sapphong na natoh na a kamanchah lou le thildang aman nading kahepoi.
en: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.
text:
ACT 20:24
Thadou: Ahin Kahinkho hi Pakai Yeshuan einganse na banga midang te henga Pathen mingailut na kidangtah kipana thupha sapphong na natoh na a kamanchah lou le thildang aman nading kahepoi.
English: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.

tcz: Chule tunia Pathen Lenggam thudol kaseipeh miho hin keima eimukit tah lou diu ahi.
en: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.
text:
ACT 20:25
Thadou: Chule tunia Pathen Lenggam thudol kaseipeh miho hin keima eimukit tah lou diu ahi.
English: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.

tcz: Tu nikhoa hi kaphondoh ahi, keiman kitah tah a kaseipeh nahiuvin nalah uva koi tobang khat tonsot thina toh aumkhah a ahile keima thepmo ahi tapoi.
en: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,
text:
ACT 20:26
Thadou: Tu nikhoa hi kaphondoh ahi, keiman kitah tah a kaseipeh nahiuvin nalah uva koi tobang khat tonsot thina toh aumkhah a ahile keima thepmo ahi tapoi.
English: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in nangho hetsah dinga adeisah jouse imlou hel a kasei peh nahi tauve.
en: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.
text:
ACT 20:27
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen in nangho hetsah dinga adeisah jouse imlou hel a kasei peh nahi tauve.
English: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

tcz: Chule tun, chingtheiyun, nanghon Pathen kelngoi hon, a thisan'a achohdoh houbung, chu vah unlang chingtup un, hiche dinga chu Lhagao Theng in upa a napansah-u ahi.
en: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.
text:
ACT 20:28
Thadou: Chule tun, chingtheiyun, nanghon Pathen kelngoi hon, a thisan'a achohdoh houbung, chu vah unlang chingtup un, hiche dinga chu Lhagao Theng in upa a napansah-u ahi.
English: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.

tcz: Ajeh chu kadalhah tengu le nangho lah a kona ngeihang tobang thuhillhem hunglut a kelngoi ho hi khatcha ahin hoilou ding kahei.
en: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
text:
ACT 20:29
Thadou: Ajeh chu kadalhah tengu le nangho lah a kona ngeihang tobang thuhillhem hunglut a kelngoi ho hi khatcha ahin hoilou ding kahei.
English: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

tcz: Chule nangho lah jenga jong hi mi phabep in amaho thu ahinjop a thutah chu akaleh a ahin hil dingu ahi.
en: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.
text:
ACT 20:30
Thadou: Chule nangho lah jenga jong hi mi phabep in amaho thu ahinjop a thutah chu akaleh a ahin hil dingu ahi.
English: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

tcz: Hijeh chun nangho kiging phauvin! Kumthum sunga asun ajana mitlhi tamtah puma kaumpiu chu geldoh jingun.
en: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.
text:
ACT 20:31
Thadou: Hijeh chun nangho kiging phauvin! Kumthum sunga asun ajana mitlhi tamtah puma kaumpiu chu geldoh jingun.
English: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.

tcz: Chule tunia hi keiman nangho hi Pathen le amingailutna thu alhenchomte toh goulo khom dinga natungdoh theiyu thua chu kanganse nahiuve.
en: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
text:
ACT 20:32
Thadou: Chule tunia hi keiman nangho hi Pathen le amingailutna thu alhenchomte toh goulo khom dinga natungdoh theiyu thua chu kanganse nahiuve.
English: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

tcz: Keiman koima dangka le Sana chule nihchen ponsil hoi kaotcha poi.
en: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.
text:
ACT 20:33
Thadou: Keiman koima dangka le Sana chule nihchen ponsil hoi kaotcha poi.
English: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.

tcz: Ajeh chu kakhut a kona keima ngaichat le kaum khompi ho ngaichat ding katoh a kakivah ahi.
en: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.
text:
ACT 20:34
Thadou: Ajeh chu kakhut a kona keima ngaichat le kaum khompi ho ngaichat ding katoh a kakivah ahi.
English: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.

tcz: Chule na hatoh a toh'a migenthei ho kithopi ding dan keima tah hinkhoa namu-u ahitai. Pakai Yeshuan ‘Akisan ho sanga apeho nunnom jo ahi’ ati chu geldoh jing un.”
en: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”
text:
ACT 20:35
Thadou: Chule na hatoh a toh'a migenthei ho kithopi ding dan keima tah hinkhoa namu-u ahitai. Pakai Yeshuan ‘Akisan ho sanga apeho nunnom jo ahi’ ati chu geldoh jing un.”
English: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”

tcz: Chuin thu asei jouvin adilsun amaho toh ataokhomun ahi.
en: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.
text:
ACT 20:36
Thadou: Chuin thu asei jouvin adilsun amaho toh ataokhomun ahi.
English: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.

tcz: Amaho abonchauvin akap'un akikoiyun damselin tin akikhen tauvin ahi.
en: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,
text:
ACT 20:37
Thadou: Amaho abonchauvin akap'un akikoiyun damselin tin akikhen tauvin ahi.
English: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,

tcz: Neimu kit tah lou diu ahi ati jeh chun amaho abonchauvin lungngui tah in ama chu kong muna agathah tauvin ahi.
en: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
text:
ACT 20:38
Thadou: Neimu kit tah lou diu ahi ati jeh chun amaho abonchauvin lungngui tah in ama chu kong muna agathah tauvin ahi.
English: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.

tcz: Chuin Ephesus houbung upa ho henga lhahna thu asei jouvin, Cos twikol jonin konga kakitolun, ajing in Rhodes kalhung un chule chua kon chun Patara kajonun ahi.
en: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
text:
ACT 21:1
Thadou: Chuin Ephesus houbung upa ho henga lhahna thu asei jouvin, Cos twikol jonin konga kakitolun, ajing in Rhodes kalhung un chule chua kon chun Patara kajonun ahi.
English: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.

tcz: Chua kon chun Phoenicia jonding kong khat ah katoudoh un,
en: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.
text:
ACT 21:2
Thadou: Chua kon chun Phoenicia jonding kong khat ah katoudoh un,
English: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.

tcz: Chule Cyprus twikol chu kagalmu phat un, veilama kakiheiyun Syria gam'a Tyre kongkaimun ah kakinga uvin hichea chun konga thilho chu asolhauvin ahi.
en: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.
text:
ACT 21:3
Thadou: Chule Cyprus twikol chu kagalmu phat un, veilama kakiheiyun Syria gam'a Tyre kongkaimun ah kakinga uvin hichea chun konga thilho chu asolhauvin ahi.
English: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.

tcz: Chuin vapam achun kavah leuvin ahile seijui phabep kaga mudoh un, amaho koma chun hapta khat kaumun ahi. Hichea seijuiho chun Lhagao Thenga konin gaothu aseiyun, Paul chu Jerusalema chejom lou dingin aseiyun ahi.
en: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
text:
ACT 21:4
Thadou: Chuin vapam achun kavah leuvin ahile seijui phabep kaga mudoh un, amaho koma chun hapta khat kaumun ahi. Hichea seijuiho chun Lhagao Thenga konin gaothu aseiyun, Paul chu Jerusalema chejom lou dingin aseiyun ahi.
English: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

tcz: Chuin hapta kichaiya konga kanung kaldoh ding phat un, mipi jouse, numei chapang jaonan, khopi sunga konin vapam chan'ah ahung kumsuh un, hichea chun, dilsun kataovun,
en: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.
text:
ACT 21:5
Thadou: Chuin hapta kichaiya konga kanung kaldoh ding phat un, mipi jouse, numei chapang jaonan, khopi sunga konin vapam chan'ah ahung kumsuh un, hichea chun, dilsun kataovun,
English: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.

tcz: Chule lhahna thu kaseiyun chuin keiho konga toudoh ding in kacheuvin, amaho jong inlam cheh a akile tauvin ahi.
en: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.
text:
ACT 21:6
Thadou: Chule lhahna thu kaseiyun chuin keiho konga toudoh ding in kacheuvin, amaho jong inlam cheh a akile tauvin ahi.
English: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.

tcz: Tyre kadalhah jou uva kakingah nau masapen chu Ptolemais ahi. Hichea chun sopi numei le pasal ho chibai kaboh pauvin amaho henga chun nikhat kakibangpa uvin ahi.
en: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.
text:
ACT 21:7
Thadou: Tyre kadalhah jou uva kakingah nau masapen chu Ptolemais ahi. Hichea chun sopi numei le pasal ho chibai kaboh pauvin amaho henga chun nikhat kakibangpa uvin ahi.
English: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.

tcz: Ajing in Caesarea lamah kache paiyun, an homle dinga mi sagi kilhengdoh ho lah a mikhat Evangelist Philip in'a chun kalhung tauvin ahi.
en: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
text:
ACT 21:8
Thadou: Ajing in Caesarea lamah kache paiyun, an homle dinga mi sagi kilhengdoh ho lah a mikhat Evangelist Philip in'a chun kalhung tauvin ahi.
English: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.

tcz: Amapa chun chanu jinei lou li aneiyin amaho chu abonun Lhagao thilpeh gaothu seina achangun ahi.
en: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.
text:
ACT 21:9
Thadou: Amapa chun chanu jinei lou li aneiyin amaho chu abonun Lhagao thilpeh gaothu seina achangun ahi.
English: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

tcz: Chuin nikho tamtah jouvin Lhagao thilpeh gaothuseina chang Agabus kiti mikhat, Judea gam'a konin ahung in.
en: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
text:
ACT 21:10
Thadou: Chuin nikho tamtah jouvin Lhagao thilpeh gaothuseina chang Agabus kiti mikhat, Judea gam'a konin ahung in.
English: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

tcz: Paul konggah chu alan, ama khut le keng chu asomin, “Lhagao Theng in aphondoh ahi, hiche konggah neipa hi Jerusalema Judate lamkai hon amat uva chidang namdang te henga apeh doh dingu ahi,” ati.
en: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”
text:
ACT 21:11
Thadou: Paul konggah chu alan, ama khut le keng chu asomin, “Lhagao Theng in aphondoh ahi, hiche konggah neipa hi Jerusalema Judate lamkai hon amat uva chidang namdang te henga apeh doh dingu ahi,” ati.
English: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”

tcz: Chuin hiche gaothusei kajah phatun keiho le amuna um seijui hon Paul henga Jerusalem ache lou na dingin kataovun ahi.
en: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
text:
ACT 21:12
Thadou: Chuin hiche gaothusei kajah phatun keiho le amuna um seijui hon Paul henga Jerusalem ache lou na dingin kataovun ahi.
English: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

tcz: Ahinlah Paul in aseiyin, “Ipi dinga kap nahiuvem? Kalungthim nasujun uve! Keima chea songkul tanding mai mai hilouvin Pakai Yeshua min a thidinga jong gotsa kahitai,” ati.
en: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
text:
ACT 21:13
Thadou: Ahinlah Paul in aseiyin, “Ipi dinga kap nahiuvem? Kalungthim nasujun uve! Keima chea songkul tanding mai mai hilouvin Pakai Yeshua min a thidinga jong gotsa kahitai,” ati.
English: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”

tcz: Chuin keihon kahet chet phat un imacha kaseibe tapouvin, “Pakai lunglam himaihen,” katiuvin ahi.
en: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”
text:
ACT 21:14
Thadou: Chuin keihon kahet chet phat un imacha kaseibe tapouvin, “Pakai lunglam himaihen,” katiuvin ahi.
English: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”

tcz: Chujouvin kathilhou kagong tup un Jerusalema dingin kache tauvin ahi.
en: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.
text:
ACT 21:15
Thadou: Chujouvin kathilhou kagong tup un Jerusalema dingin kache tauvin ahi.
English: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.

tcz: Chuin Caesarea a konin seijui phabep in eilhon piuvin, chuin Cyprus gammi seijui masaloi Mnason in'ah eipui lut un ahi.
en: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.
text:
ACT 21:16
Thadou: Chuin Caesarea a konin seijui phabep in eilhon piuvin, chuin Cyprus gammi seijui masaloi Mnason in'ah eipui lut un ahi.
English: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.

tcz: Chuin Jerusalem kalhun un amuna um sopi numei le pasal hon phatechan eina vailhunun ahi.
en: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.
text:
ACT 21:17
Thadou: Chuin Jerusalem kalhun un amuna um sopi numei le pasal hon phatechan eina vailhunun ahi.
English: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.

tcz: Ajing in Paul jong Jacob toh kimuto ding in keiho toh kalhonun, hichea chun Jerusalem houbung upa ho jouse jong aumun ahi.
en: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.
text:
ACT 21:18
Thadou: Ajing in Paul jong Jacob toh kimuto ding in keiho toh kalhonun, hichea chun Jerusalem houbung upa ho jouse jong aumun ahi.
English: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.

tcz: Chuin chibai aboh jouvun Paul in Pathen in chidang namdang te chunga kidang tah a na atoh ho abonchan aseitan ahi.
en: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.
text:
ACT 21:19
Thadou: Chuin chibai aboh jouvun Paul in Pathen in chidang namdang te chunga kidang tah a na atoh ho abonchan aseitan ahi.
English: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.

tcz: Chuin Paul thusei ajah phat un Pathen avahchoiyun ahi. Chule amahon aseiyun “Ngailut umtah sopipa Juda mi sang tamtah'in jong atahsan uva chule Mose danjong phatecha ajui uhi nahet em?
en: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.
text:
ACT 21:20
Thadou: Chuin Paul thusei ajah phat un Pathen avahchoiyun ahi. Chule amahon aseiyun “Ngailut umtah sopipa Juda mi sang tamtah'in jong atahsan uva chule Mose danjong phatecha ajui uhi nahet em?
English: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.

tcz: Ahinlah Jerusalema Judami atahsan ho hin, nangman chiding namdang te lah a cheng Juda mi seijui hon Mose dan anungsun dingun thu nahil e ti ajauvin, achateu chep atan lou diu chule chonna dan adang dang jong ajui lou diuvin thu nahil e ti aheuvin ahi.
en: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.
text:
ACT 21:21
Thadou: Ahinlah Jerusalema Judami atahsan ho hin, nangman chiding namdang te lah a cheng Juda mi seijui hon Mose dan anungsun dingun thu nahil e ti ajauvin, achateu chep atan lou diu chule chonna dan adang dang jong ajui lou diuvin thu nahil e ti aheuvin ahi.
English: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.

tcz: Nangma nahung hila ahet teiding'u ahin, ipi ilo diu hitam? Atiuvin ahi.
en: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.
text:
ACT 21:22
Thadou: Nangma nahung hila ahet teiding'u ahin, ipi ilo diu hitam? Atiuvin ahi.
English: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.

tcz: Hijeh chun hiche nabol ding hi pha kasauve. Hichea hin kitepna neijou mili aumun, aluchang'u kivotol dinga kigong ahiuve.
en: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.
text:
ACT 21:23
Thadou: Hijeh chun hiche nabol ding hi pha kasauve. Hichea hin kitepna neijou mili aumun, aluchang'u kivotol dinga kigong ahiuve.
English: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.

tcz: Amaho toh hin lhon inlang Houin a gakisutheng unlang, chonna dan dungjuiya sam avo nadingun seipeh in, chutile mihon athujah jouseu hi alhem ahin, chule nangma tah jeng in jong Judate dan ajuinai ti hi ahetdoh dingu ahi.
en: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.
text:
ACT 21:24
Thadou: Amaho toh hin lhon inlang Houin a gakisutheng unlang, chonna dan dungjuiya sam avo nadingun seipeh in, chutile mihon athujah jouseu hi alhem ahin, chule nangma tah jeng in jong Judate dan ajuinai ti hi ahetdoh dingu ahi.
English: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.

tcz: Chidang namdang seijuite vang chu lekhathot a isei jouseu banga chon dingu ahi. Milim anga kikatdohsa an aneh lou dingu, thisan ahiloule hetlou sa aneh lou dingu, chule jonthanhoina a kona kikangse dingu ahi,” atiuve.
en: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”
text:
ACT 21:25
Thadou: Chidang namdang seijuite vang chu lekhathot a isei jouseu banga chon dingu ahi. Milim anga kikatdohsa an aneh lou dingu, thisan ahiloule hetlou sa aneh lou dingu, chule jonthanhoina a kona kikangse dingu ahi,” atiuve.
English: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”

tcz: Chuin Paul chu ajing in hiche mili ho toh chun Houin a acheuvin, kisuhtheng na achelhah pi un, chule mipi angsunga chun phongtah in kisuhthengna nikho kichai niding le amichan cheh a kilhaina abol diu thu aseiyin ahi.
en: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.
text:
ACT 21:26
Thadou: Chuin Paul chu ajing in hiche mili ho toh chun Houin a acheuvin, kisuhtheng na achelhah pi un, chule mipi angsunga chun phongtah in kisuhthengna nikho kichai niding le amichan cheh a kilhaina abol diu thu aseiyin ahi.
English: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

tcz: Chuin ni sagi kichai konin Asia gam'a kona Juda mi phabep in houin sunga Paul amudoh phat un, mipi chu atilseuvin aman tauvin ahi.
en: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,
text:
ACT 21:27
Thadou: Chuin ni sagi kichai konin Asia gam'a kona Juda mi phabep in houin sunga Paul amudoh phat un, mipi chu atilseuvin aman tauvin ahi.
English: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

tcz: Chuin amahon aseiyun, “Israel mite nei kithopiuvin! Hiche mipa hin muntina eiho dounan thu asei jing in, chule mijouse koma Judate chonna dan ajui lou nadingun thu aseiye. Houin dounan thu aseiyin, chule Houin jenga jong chidang namdang te ahin puilut in asuboh in ahi” atiuve.
en: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”
text:
ACT 21:28
Thadou: Chuin amahon aseiyun, “Israel mite nei kithopiuvin! Hiche mipa hin muntina eiho dounan thu asei jing in, chule mijouse koma Judate chonna dan ajui lou nadingun thu aseiye. Houin dounan thu aseiyin, chule Houin jenga jong chidang namdang te ahin puilut in asuboh in ahi” atiuve.
English: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”

tcz: (Ajeh chu hiche masang jep'a chu Paul chu khopi sunga Ephesus mi Trophimus toh amu thau ahi. Paul chun hiche mipa chu Houin'ah puilut teiyinte tia agelu ahi.)
en: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian, with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
text:
ACT 21:29
Thadou: (Ajeh chu hiche masang jep'a chu Paul chu khopi sunga Ephesus mi Trophimus toh amu thau ahi. Paul chun hiche mipa chu Houin'ah puilut teiyinte tia agelu ahi.)
English: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian, with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.

tcz: Chuin hiche ahehset nau hin khopi sung chu ahotling tan, chule boina asousang tan ahi. Chuin Paul chu houin'a konin gangtah in akaidoh un kelkot akhah chah tauvin ahi.
en: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.
text:
ACT 21:30
Thadou: Chuin hiche ahehset nau hin khopi sung chu ahotling tan, chule boina asousang tan ahi. Chuin Paul chu houin'a konin gangtah in akaidoh un kelkot akhah chah tauvin ahi.
English: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

tcz: Chutia Paul tha ding agot laiyun, Jerusalem mite asousang thu chu Rome sepaite vaipi popa heng alhung tan ahi.
en: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
text:
ACT 21:31
Thadou: Chutia Paul tha ding agot laiyun, Jerusalem mite asousang thu chu Rome sepaite vaipi popa heng alhung tan ahi.
English: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

tcz: Gangtah in asepai hole alamkai hotoh mipi lah a chun achesuh tauvin ahi. Chuin mipi chun sepai vaipi popa le asepai ho hung kumsuh chu amu phat un Paul avoh'u chu anga tauvin ahi.
en: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.
text:
ACT 21:32
Thadou: Gangtah in asepai hole alamkai hotoh mipi lah a chun achesuh tauvin ahi. Chuin mipi chun sepai vaipi popa le asepai ho hung kumsuh chu amu phat un Paul avoh'u chu anga tauvin ahi.
English: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.

tcz: Chuin vaipipo chun Paul chu akan'in, thihkhao nia hen ding in thu apen, chuin mipi ho koma chun hiche mipa hi koiham chule ipi abolset ham tin adong tan ahi.
en: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.
text:
ACT 21:33
Thadou: Chuin vaipipo chun Paul chu akan'in, thihkhao nia hen ding in thu apen, chuin mipi ho koma chun hiche mipa hi koiham chule ipi abolset ham tin adong tan ahi.
English: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.

tcz: Chuin mi abangkhat in thilkhat asamin, chule abangkhat chun thildang khat ma asamun ahi. Chutia mipi eu jeh le kicheh loujeh chun ima thudih ahedoh thei tapon, hijeh chun Paul chu kulpi sunga apuilut ding'un thu apetan ahi.
en: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.
text:
ACT 21:34
Thadou: Chuin mi abangkhat in thilkhat asamin, chule abangkhat chun thildang khat ma asamun ahi. Chutia mipi eu jeh le kicheh loujeh chun ima thudih ahedoh thei tapon, hijeh chun Paul chu kulpi sunga apuilut ding'un thu apetan ahi.
English: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu kulpi sung alut kigon ahile mipi ho jeh chun alut thei tapon hijeh chun ama ventup nading in sepai hon alengkouvun aput thouvin ahi.
en: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;

tcz: Chuin mipi ho chun anung ajuiyun “Thatdoh un, thatdoh un,” tin asamun ahi.
en: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”
text:
ACT 21:36
Thadou: Chuin mipi ho chun anung ajuiyun “Thatdoh un, thatdoh un,” tin asamun ahi.
English: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”

tcz: Chuin Paul kulpi sung alhut ding konun, vaipipo koma atauvin, “Nakoma thukhat kasei thei ding ham? ati. Chuin vaipipo chun kidang satah in Greek pao nahet em, tin adong in ahi.
en: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?
text:
ACT 21:37
Thadou: Chuin Paul kulpi sung alhut ding konun, vaipipo koma atauvin, “Nakoma thukhat kasei thei ding ham? ati. Chuin vaipipo chun kidang satah in Greek pao nahet em, tin adong in ahi.
English: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?

tcz: Nangma Egypt mi, masang laiya miho tilsea mi sangli gamthip'a loidoh pachu nahi louham?” ati.
en: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”
text:
ACT 21:38
Thadou: Nangma Egypt mi, masang laiya miho tilsea mi sangli gamthip'a loidoh pachu nahi louham?” ati.
English: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”

tcz: Paul in adonbut in “Kahipoi, keima Tarsus gam'a khopi thupitah Cilicia a kon Judah mi kahibouve amaho toh hin nei kihousah in,” atin ahi.
en: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”
text:
ACT 21:39
Thadou: Paul in adonbut in “Kahipoi, keima Tarsus gam'a khopi thupitah Cilicia a kon Judah mi kahibouve amaho toh hin nei kihousah in,” atin ahi.
English: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”

tcz: Chuin vaipipo chun anoppeh jeh chun, Paul chu kalbi a chun ading in mipi ho chu thipbeh a umdingin atemin, chuin mipi thipchet'a aum phat in amaho pao Aramaic in ahoulimin ahi.
en: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,
text:
ACT 21:40
Thadou: Chuin vaipipo chun anoppeh jeh chun, Paul chu kalbi a chun ading in mipi ho chu thipbeh a umdingin atemin, chuin mipi thipchet'a aum phat in amaho pao Aramaic in ahoulimin ahi.
English: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,

tcz: Chuin Paul in, “Sopite le jaumtah pateho, kakihonna thu kasei hi ngaiyuvin,”
en: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”
text:
ACT 22:1
Thadou: Chuin Paul in, “Sopite le jaumtah pateho, kakihonna thu kasei hi ngaiyuvin,”
English: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”

tcz: Amaho paova thu asei chu ajah phat un mipi ho chu athipchet jengun,
en: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,
text:
ACT 22:2
Thadou: Amaho paova thu asei chu ajah phat un mipi ho chu athipchet jengun,
English: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,

tcz: Chuin Paul in, “Keima Tarsus gam'a Cilicia khopia peng Juda mi kahin, chule chihna thepna lama Jerusalema Gamaliel noiya hung seilen kahi. Ama noiya hung seilen khat kahi jeh chun Judate dan le chonna ho phatecha hung kijil kahi. Tunia nangho jouse banga hi Pathen a dinga tompan tah mi kana hin ahi.
en: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.
text:
ACT 22:3
Thadou: Chuin Paul in, “Keima Tarsus gam'a Cilicia khopia peng Juda mi kahin, chule chihna thepna lama Jerusalema Gamaliel noiya hung seilen kahi. Ama noiya hung seilen khat kahi jeh chun Judate dan le chonna ho phatecha hung kijil kahi. Tunia nangho jouse banga hi Pathen a dinga tompan tah mi kana hin ahi.
English: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.

tcz: Chule anung juiho ka sugentheiyin, abang kathat jin, chule numei pasal kamanin songkul'ah kakhum jin ahi.
en: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,
text:
ACT 22:4
Thadou: Chule anung juiho ka sugentheiyin, abang kathat jin, chule numei pasal kamanin songkul'ah kakhum jin ahi.
English: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,

tcz: Thempu chung nung le kivaihom na upa hon hiche hi eihetpeh-u ahi. Ajeh chu Damascus a um sopi Judate henga kahunga Christian ho kamat a suhgenthei dinga Jerusalema ka hin kai nadinga amaho koma phalna lekha kahin kichoi ahi.”
en: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.
text:
ACT 22:5
Thadou: Thempu chung nung le kivaihom na upa hon hiche hi eihetpeh-u ahi. Ajeh chu Damascus a um sopi Judate henga kahunga Christian ho kamat a suhgenthei dinga Jerusalema ka hin kai nadinga amaho koma phalna lekha kahin kichoi ahi.”
English: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.

tcz: Ahin Damascus khopi lut ding kon lampi laitah ah, hichu sunkim ahin, hichun vana konin vah hattah khat in kakimvel ahin kho tan,
en: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.
text:
ACT 22:6
Thadou: Ahin Damascus khopi lut ding kon lampi laitah ah, hichu sunkim ahin, hichun vana konin vah hattah khat in kakimvel ahin kho tan,
English: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.

tcz: Keijong tol'a kalhu jeng in ahile aw khat kajan, “Saul, Saul, ipi dinga neibolset jing ham?” ahin tin ahi.
en: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’
text:
ACT 22:7
Thadou: Keijong tol'a kalhu jeng in ahile aw khat kajan, “Saul, Saul, ipi dinga neibolset jing ham?” ahin tin ahi.
English: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’

tcz: Chuin ken jong, “Nang koi nahim?” kati. Chuin aw chun eihin donbut in “Keima nabolset jing Nazareth Yeshua chu kahi” ahin tin ahi.
en: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’
text:
ACT 22:8
Thadou: Chuin ken jong, “Nang koi nahim?” kati. Chuin aw chun eihin donbut in “Keima nabolset jing Nazareth Yeshua chu kahi” ahin tin ahi.
English: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’

tcz: Chuin kakilhonpi miho chun vah chu amuvin, ahin kakoma thusei aw chun ipi asei ham ahe pouve.
en: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.
text:
ACT 22:9
Thadou: Chuin kakilhonpi miho chun vah chu amuvin, ahin kakoma thusei aw chun ipi asei ham ahe pouve.
English: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.

tcz: Hichun “Ipi kabol ding ham Pakai” tin kadong in ahile, Pakaiyin eihin donbut in “Thoudoh inlang Damascus khosunga khun lut in chuteng ipi nabol ding nakisei peh ding ahi,” ati.
en: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’
text:
ACT 22:10
Thadou: Hichun “Ipi kabol ding ham Pakai” tin kadong in ahile, Pakaiyin eihin donbut in “Thoudoh inlang Damascus khosunga khun lut in chuteng ipi nabol ding nakisei peh ding ahi,” ati.
English: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’

tcz: Vah hattah jeh a kamit in kho amutah lou jeh in kalhonpi ho chun kakhut in eikaiyun khopi sunga eikailut un ahi.
en: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.
text:
ACT 22:11
Thadou: Vah hattah jeh a kamit in kho amutah lou jeh in kalhonpi ho chun kakhut in eikaiyun khopi sunga eikailut un ahi.
English: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.

tcz: Hichea chun Ananias ana cheng in ama chu Pathen gingtah mi ahin Judate dan juithem tah le Damascus khopia um Judate jousen angaisang tah mi khat ahi.
en: “One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,
text:
ACT 22:12
Thadou: Hichea chun Ananias ana cheng in ama chu Pathen gingtah mi ahin Judate dan juithem tah le Damascus khopia um Judate jousen angaisang tah mi khat ahi.
English: “One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,

tcz: Ama chu kakoma ahung ding in, “Sopipa Saul kho mukit tan atin ahile apettah chun ama chu kamu tan ahi.”
en: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.
text:
ACT 22:13
Thadou: Ama chu kakoma ahung ding in, “Sopipa Saul kho mukit tan atin ahile apettah chun ama chu kamu tan ahi.”
English: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.

tcz: Chuin aman, “Ipu ipateu Pathen chun alunggot lam heding le, dihtah pa mua, chule athu ngai dinga nalhen ahitai” ati.
en: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.
text:
ACT 22:14
Thadou: Chuin aman, “Ipu ipateu Pathen chun alunggot lam heding le, dihtah pa mua, chule athu ngai dinga nalhen ahitai” ati.
English: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangman namu hole najah ho jouse chu nasei phong le-a ama thu hettoh sah a napan ding ahitai.
en: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.
text:
ACT 22:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangman namu hole najah ho jouse chu nasei phong le-a ama thu hettoh sah a napan ding ahitai.
English: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.

tcz: Ipi nakhongai nahlai ham? Kipat doh in lang baptize chang tan, Pakai min kouvin lang nachonset soplhan eiti.
en: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’
text:
ACT 22:16
Thadou: Ipi nakhongai nahlai ham? Kipat doh in lang baptize chang tan, Pakai min kouvin lang nachonset soplhan eiti.
English: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’

tcz: Chuin Jerusalem kahung kile chun Houin ah dilsun kataovin ahile,
en: “When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance
text:
ACT 22:17
Thadou: Chuin Jerusalem kahung kile chun Houin ah dilsun kataovin ahile,
English: “When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance

tcz: Gaovin Yeshua kamun aman, “Kipat loiyin! Jerusalema kon in jamdoh in ajeh chu hiche laiya miho hin keima thudola nathusei asan lou dingu ahi” ati.
en: and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’
text:
ACT 22:18
Thadou: Gaovin Yeshua kamun aman, “Kipat loiyin! Jerusalema kon in jamdoh in ajeh chu hiche laiya miho hin keima thudola nathusei asan lou dingu ahi” ati.
English: and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’

tcz: Ahin keiman kaseiyin, “Pakai kikhopna in tin aseijui ho kasuh gentheiya songkul'a kakhum jong ahesoh keiyuve”
en: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.
text:
ACT 22:19
Thadou: Ahin keiman kaseiyin, “Pakai kikhopna in tin aseijui ho kasuh gentheiya songkul'a kakhum jong ahesoh keiyuve”
English: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.

tcz: Chule nasoh pa Stephen aselih pet uva asangkhol sutlhah hou akoinau koma ding jong chu kanahinai, kati.
en: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’
text:
ACT 22:20
Thadou: Chule nasoh pa Stephen aselih pet uva asangkhol sutlhah hou akoinau koma ding jong chu kanahinai, kati.
English: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’

tcz: Ahin Pakaiyin, “Chen gamlha tah a chidang namdang te lah a kasol ding nahi!” ati.
en: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’ ”
text:
ACT 22:21
Thadou: Ahin Pakaiyin, “Chen gamlha tah a chidang namdang te lah a kasol ding nahi!” ati.
English: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’ ”

tcz: Hichun mipi hon chuche Paul thusei chu ajah phat un asamuvin, “Hitobang michu delmang un, ahing dinga jong lom ahipoi!” atiuvin ahi.
en: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”
text:
ACT 22:22
Thadou: Hichun mipi hon chuche Paul thusei chu ajah phat un asamuvin, “Hitobang michu delmang un, ahing dinga jong lom ahipoi!” atiuvin ahi.
English: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”

tcz: Chuin mipi chun a sangkholu asut un, vanlama vutvai atheuvin ahi.
en: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,
text:
ACT 22:23
Thadou: Chuin mipi chun a sangkholu asut un, vanlama vutvai atheuvin ahi.
English: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,

tcz: Chuin Sepai vaipopa chun, Paul chu inpi sunga apuilut sah in, mipi achunga chubang tah a alunghannau ajeh seidoh sah ding ngaito nan jepsah ding in thu apetan ahi.
en: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.
text:
ACT 22:24
Thadou: Chuin Sepai vaipopa chun, Paul chu inpi sunga apuilut sah in, mipi achunga chubang tah a alunghannau ajeh seidoh sah ding ngaito nan jepsah ding in thu apetan ahi.
English: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu jep dinga ahin kan phat un aman akoma ding sepai lamkai pa henga chun, “Rome mikhat athemmo na khol masa louva jep ding chu dan in aphal hinam?” tin adong in ahi.
en: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”
text:
ACT 22:25
Thadou: Chuin Paul chu jep dinga ahin kan phat un aman akoma ding sepai lamkai pa henga chun, “Rome mikhat athemmo na khol masa louva jep ding chu dan in aphal hinam?” tin adong in ahi.
English: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”

tcz: Chuin sepai lamkai pan chuche ajah phat chun sepai vaipopa koma achen, “Ipi bol nahim? Amahi Rome mi hibouva hila!” atin ahi.
en: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”
text:
ACT 22:26
Thadou: Chuin sepai lamkai pan chuche ajah phat chun sepai vaipopa koma achen, “Ipi bol nahim? Amahi Rome mi hibouva hila!” atin ahi.
English: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”

tcz: Chuin sepai vaipopa chu Paul henga ahung in, “Nangma Rome mi nahim? seiyin,” tin adong tan ahile Paul in jong “Kahinai,” ati.
en: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”
text:
ACT 22:27
Thadou: Chuin sepai vaipopa chu Paul henga ahung in, “Nangma Rome mi nahim? seiyin,” tin adong tan ahile Paul in jong “Kahinai,” ati.
English: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”

tcz: Chuin sepai vaipopa chun aseiyin “Keijong sum tampi kapeh jouva Rome mihina chang kahi bouve,” atin ahile Paul in “Keivang kapena pat'a Rome mi a peng kahi,” ati.
en: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”
text:
ACT 22:28
Thadou: Chuin sepai vaipopa chun aseiyin “Keijong sum tampi kapeh jouva Rome mihina chang kahi bouve,” atin ahile Paul in “Keivang kapena pat'a Rome mi a peng kahi,” ati.
English: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”

tcz: Chuin Paul in Rome mi kahi ati ajahdoh phat in thudong dinga kigong sepai ho chu gang tah in apot doh tauvin ahi, chule sepai vaipopa jong chun chutobang thupeh anei jeh chun akicha lheh jeng in ahi.
en: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.
text:
ACT 22:29
Thadou: Chuin Paul in Rome mi kahi ati ajahdoh phat in thudong dinga kigong sepai ho chu gang tah in apot doh tauvin ahi, chule sepai vaipopa jong chun chutobang thupeh anei jeh chun akicha lheh jeng in ahi.
English: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.

tcz: Ajing nikhon Paul chung changa boina thu hetdoh nading in sepai vaipopa chun Judate kivaihom na a lamkai hole thempu ho chu hungkhom ding in thu apen, chule amaho masanga ding dingin Paul chu ana lhadoh tan ahi.
en: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.
text:
ACT 22:30
Thadou: Ajing nikhon Paul chung changa boina thu hetdoh nading in sepai vaipopa chun Judate kivaihom na a lamkai hole thempu ho chu hungkhom ding in thu apen, chule amaho masanga ding dingin Paul chu ana lhadoh tan ahi.
English: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.

tcz: Chuin Paul in houvaipo ho chu ave changmel in, “Sopite ho, Pathen angsunga se le pha hetkhen na kicheh tah neiya hing jing kahi!”
en: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”
text:
ACT 23:1
Thadou: Chuin Paul in houvaipo ho chu ave changmel in, “Sopite ho, Pathen angsunga se le pha hetkhen na kicheh tah neiya hing jing kahi!”
English: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”

tcz: Chuin thempu chungnung Ananias chun Paul toh kinaiya umho koma chun amuhsom abehpeh dingun thu apen ahi.
en: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.
text:
ACT 23:2
Thadou: Chuin thempu chungnung Ananias chun Paul toh kinaiya umho koma chun amuhsom abehpeh dingun thu apen ahi.
English: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

tcz: Ahin Paul in, “Phatlouna a dim miphalhem pa! Pathen in nangma nabeh ding ahi, itobang thutan mi nahiya nangman dan napal keh a chutobang a eibeng dinga mi thu napeh ham?” ati.
en: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”
text:
ACT 23:3
Thadou: Ahin Paul in, “Phatlouna a dim miphalhem pa! Pathen in nangma nabeh ding ahi, itobang thutan mi nahiya nangman dan napal keh a chutobang a eibeng dinga mi thu napeh ham?” ati.
English: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”

tcz: Chuin Paul kimvela ding ho chun, “Pathen thempu chungnung chu na housal ngam ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”
text:
ACT 23:4
Thadou: Chuin Paul kimvela ding ho chun, “Pathen thempu chungnung chu na housal ngam ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”

tcz: Paul in adonbut un, “Sopite ho, neingai damun, thempu chungnung ahilam kanahet lou ahi, ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun ‘nalamkai te chunga thuse nasei lou ding ahi’ tin akisune” ati.
en: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”
text:
ACT 23:5
Thadou: Paul in adonbut un, “Sopite ho, neingai damun, thempu chungnung ahilam kanahet lou ahi, ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun ‘nalamkai te chunga thuse nasei lou ding ahi’ tin akisune” ati.
English: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”

tcz: Chuin Paul in houvaipoloi ho kikhopna a chu Sadducee hole Pharisee ho kihal ahiu ahet doh phat chun, hatah in asamin, “Sopite ho, kapu kapate khanga pat'a Pharisee mi kahin! Thokit thudola kinepna kanei jeh a kachung thu kitan ahi!” atin ahi.
en: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”
text:
ACT 23:6
Thadou: Chuin Paul in houvaipoloi ho kikhopna a chu Sadducee hole Pharisee ho kihal ahiu ahet doh phat chun, hatah in asamin, “Sopite ho, kapu kapate khanga pat'a Pharisee mi kahin! Thokit thudola kinepna kanei jeh a kachung thu kitan ahi!” atin ahi.
English: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”

tcz: Hijeh chun Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho chu hopnin aki homkhen tauvin ahi.
en: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.
text:
ACT 23:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pharisee ho le Sadducee ho chu hopnin aki homkhen tauvin ahi.
English: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.

tcz: Ajeh chu Sadducee ho chun mihem thokitna, vantil, chule lhagao um thudol atahsan lou-u ahi, ahin Pharisee ho vang chun aboncha-a hi atahsanu ahi.
en: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.
text:
ACT 23:8
Thadou: Ajeh chu Sadducee ho chun mihem thokitna, vantil, chule lhagao um thudol atahsan lou-u ahi, ahin Pharisee ho vang chun aboncha-a hi atahsanu ahi.
English: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.

tcz: Chuin akah uva boina asousang tan, hou danthu hila pang Pharisee phabep chun thuneitah in, “Hichepa chunga hin thildih lou ima aumpoi, lhagao ahiloule vantil in ahenga thu asei hitei ding ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”
text:
ACT 23:9
Thadou: Chuin akah uva boina asousang tan, hou danthu hila pang Pharisee phabep chun thuneitah in, “Hichepa chunga hin thildih lou ima aumpoi, lhagao ahiloule vantil in ahenga thu asei hitei ding ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
English: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”

tcz: Chuin akah uva kitomona asan cheh cheh phat in sepai vaipopa chun Paul chu kehni sokhauvin te tin, sepai ho chu asollin Paul chu hunam in aga huhdoh sah in kulpi sunga apuilut sah tan ahi.
en: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.
text:
ACT 23:10
Thadou: Chuin akah uva kitomona asan cheh cheh phat in sepai vaipopa chun Paul chu kehni sokhauvin te tin, sepai ho chu asollin Paul chu hunam in aga huhdoh sah in kulpi sunga apuilut sah tan ahi.
English: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.

tcz: Hiche ni jan chun Paul henga Pakai akilah in, “Paul, lungneo hih in, hiche Jerusalema keima nei phondoh banga hi Rome a jong kipana thupha hettoh sah a napan ding ahi” ati.
en: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”
text:
ACT 23:11
Thadou: Hiche ni jan chun Paul henga Pakai akilah in, “Paul, lungneo hih in, hiche Jerusalema keima nei phondoh banga hi Rome a jong kipana thupha hettoh sah a napan ding ahi” ati.
English: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”

tcz: Ajing jingkah in Juda miho phabep akiloiyun Paul itha tohkah uva an ineh lou diu ahi tin akihahsel tauvin ahi.
en: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.
text:
ACT 23:12
Thadou: Ajing jingkah in Juda miho phabep akiloiyun Paul itha tohkah uva an ineh lou diu ahi tin akihahsel tauvin ahi.
English: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.

tcz: Chutia kigahna sem chu abonun mi somli avaluvin ahi.
en: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.
text:
ACT 23:13
Thadou: Chutia kigahna sem chu abonun mi somli avaluvin ahi.
English: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.

tcz: Chuin amaho thempulen hole upa ho henga acheuvin aga seiyuvin, “Paul katha tokah uva ima nelou dinga kihahsel kahiuve,” aga tiuvin ahi.
en: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.
text:
ACT 23:14
Thadou: Chuin amaho thempulen hole upa ho henga acheuvin aga seiyuvin, “Paul katha tokah uva ima nelou dinga kihahsel kahiuve,” aga tiuvin ahi.
English: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.

tcz: “Hijeh chun nangho vaipo hon sepai vaipopa henga gaseiyun lang Paul chu achungchang thudol kholchet be ding in houvaipo ho anga hin nung puikit in tin gathum uvin, chuteng le keihon ama chu lamkah a katha diu ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”
text:
ACT 23:15
Thadou: “Hijeh chun nangho vaipo hon sepai vaipopa henga gaseiyun lang Paul chu achungchang thudol kholchet be ding in houvaipo ho anga hin nung puikit in tin gathum uvin, chuteng le keihon ama chu lamkah a katha diu ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
English: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”

tcz: Ahin hiche tohgon chu Paul sopinu chapan ajah lhih phat in kulpi sunga alhailut jelin Paul henga aga sei tan ahi.
en: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.
text:
ACT 23:16
Thadou: Ahin hiche tohgon chu Paul sopinu chapan ajah lhih phat in kulpi sunga alhailut jelin Paul henga aga sei tan ahi.
English: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.

tcz: Chuin Paul in Rome sepai jalamkai khat akouvin, “Hiche khangdong pa hi sepai vaipi popa henga puilut uvin ajeh chu seiding thupitah khat aneiye,” ati.
en: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”
text:
ACT 23:17
Thadou: Chuin Paul in Rome sepai jalamkai khat akouvin, “Hiche khangdong pa hi sepai vaipi popa henga puilut uvin ajeh chu seiding thupitah khat aneiye,” ati.
English: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”

tcz: Chuin Sepai jalamkai pa chun aseiyin, “Songkul'a um Paul chun eikouvin, hiche khangdong pa hin sepai vaipipo henga seiding thupitah aneiye atin eihin puilut sah ahi,” atin ahi.
en: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”
text:
ACT 23:18
Thadou: Chuin Sepai jalamkai pa chun aseiyin, “Songkul'a um Paul chun eikouvin, hiche khangdong pa hin sepai vaipipo henga seiding thupitah aneiye atin eihin puilut sah ahi,” atin ahi.
English: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”

tcz: Chuin sepai vaipipo chun akhut in atuh in, “Ipi ham nasei nom chu?” tin adong tan ahi.
en: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”
text:
ACT 23:19
Thadou: Chuin sepai vaipipo chun akhut in atuh in, “Ipi ham nasei nom chu?” tin adong tan ahi.
English: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”

tcz: Chuin Paul sopinu chapa chun, “Jing nikho tengle Juda mi phabep in houvaipoloi anga dinsah kit dinga nahenga kona achungthu kholbe ding kisa a Paul ahung puidoh got diu ahi.
en: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.
text:
ACT 23:20
Thadou: Chuin Paul sopinu chapa chun, “Jing nikho tengle Juda mi phabep in houvaipoloi anga dinsah kit dinga nahenga kona achungthu kholbe ding kisa a Paul ahung puidoh got diu ahi.
English: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.

tcz: Ahin soldoh hih in ajeh chu mi somli valin lamkah a chanlhih a chuleh atha tokah uva ima nelou ding in akihahsel uve, chule tua hi nangma thulhuh bou angau ahitai,” tin asei tan ahi.
en: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”
text:
ACT 23:21
Thadou: Ahin soldoh hih in ajeh chu mi somli valin lamkah a chanlhih a chuleh atha tokah uva ima nelou ding in akihahsel uve, chule tua hi nangma thulhuh bou angau ahitai,” tin asei tan ahi.
English: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”

tcz: Chuin sepai vaipipo chun khangdong pa henga, “Keima koma hiche thu nahung sei hi koima hetsah hih in,” tin agihsal tan ahi.
en: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”
text:
ACT 23:22
Thadou: Chuin sepai vaipipo chun khangdong pa henga, “Keima koma hiche thu nahung sei hi koima hetsah hih in,” tin agihsal tan ahi.
English: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”

tcz: Chuin sepai vaipipo chun sepai jalamkai ni akouvin “Tujan nidan ko tengleh Caesarea jon ding in sepai jani gotsan koi lhonin, chule tengchoi sepai jani le sakol sepai somsagi jong gong tup lhonin.
en: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”
text:
ACT 23:23
Thadou: Chuin sepai vaipipo chun sepai jalamkai ni akouvin “Tujan nidan ko tengleh Caesarea jon ding in sepai jani gotsan koi lhonin, chule tengchoi sepai jani le sakol sepai somsagi jong gong tup lhonin.
English: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”

tcz: Chule Paul touna ding sakol khat jong gong lhon in lang gamvaipo Felix henga kitup selin gathah un,” atin ahi.
en: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.
text:
ACT 23:24
Thadou: Chule Paul touna ding sakol khat jong gong lhon in lang gamvaipo Felix henga kitup selin gathah un,” atin ahi.
English: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.

tcz: Chuin gamvaipo ding chun lekha khat ajih in,
en: He wrote a letter like this:
text:
ACT 23:25
Thadou: Chuin gamvaipo ding chun lekha khat ajih in,
English: He wrote a letter like this:

tcz: “Jaumtah gamvaipo Felix, Claudius Lysias akon in salam!” tin athot in ahi.
en: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.
text:
ACT 23:26
Thadou: “Jaumtah gamvaipo Felix, Claudius Lysias akon in salam!” tin athot in ahi.
English: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.

tcz: “Hiche pa hi Juda ten abulhu uva thadinga anagot pettah un sepai hotoh kagalut un, Rome mi ahi kahetdoh phat in bitkeiyin kahin huh doh e.
en: “This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.
text:
ACT 23:27
Thadou: “Hiche pa hi Juda ten abulhu uva thadinga anagot pettah un sepai hotoh kagalut un, Rome mi ahi kahetdoh phat in bitkeiyin kahin huh doh e.
English: “This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.

tcz: Chuin ahehset nau hetdoh nading in houvaipoloi angsunga kadinsah in ahileh,
en: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.
text:
ACT 23:28
Thadou: Chuin ahehset nau hetdoh nading in houvaipoloi angsunga kadinsah in ahileh,
English: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.

tcz: Aheh nau hi amaho houthu toh kisai ahi kahedoh tan, ima songkul tan nading le tha nading kamupoi ahi.
en: I found him to be accused about questions of their law, but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment.
text:
ACT 23:29
Thadou: Aheh nau hi amaho houthu toh kisai ahi kahedoh tan, ima songkul tan nading le tha nading kamupoi ahi.
English: I found him to be accused about questions of their law, but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment.

tcz: Ahin thadinga agot-u kahet doh phat a apet pet a nahenga kahin sol ahitai, chule ahehse ho jong nang ma henga hung ding in kasei peh tauve,” ati.
en: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him to you immediately, charging his accusers also to bring their accusations against him before you. Farewell.”
text:
ACT 23:30
Thadou: Ahin thadinga agot-u kahet doh phat a apet pet a nahenga kahin sol ahitai, chule ahehse ho jong nang ma henga hung ding in kasei peh tauve,” ati.
English: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him to you immediately, charging his accusers also to bring their accusations against him before you. Farewell.”

tcz: Thupeh dung juiyin sepai hon Paul chu Antipatris heng alhut un ahi.
en: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.
text:
ACT 23:31
Thadou: Thupeh dung juiyin sepai hon Paul chu Antipatris heng alhut un ahi.
English: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.

tcz: Ajing jingkah in amaho ahung kinung leuvin ahin sakol sepai hon Paul chu Caesarea chan aga thah un ahi.
en: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.
text:
ACT 23:32
Thadou: Ajing jingkah in amaho ahung kinung leuvin ahin sakol sepai hon Paul chu Caesarea chan aga thah un ahi.
English: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.

tcz: Chuin Caesarea alhun un Paul le Lekhathot chu gamvaipo Felix henga apelut tauvin ahi.
en: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.
text:
ACT 23:33
Thadou: Chuin Caesarea alhun un Paul le Lekhathot chu gamvaipo Felix henga apelut tauvin ahi.
English: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.

tcz: Chuin lekhathot chu asim jouvin Paul chu “hoilai gamkai mi nahim” tin adong in ahileh Paul in “Cilicia,” ati.
en: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,
text:
ACT 23:34
Thadou: Chuin lekhathot chu asim jouvin Paul chu “hoilai gamkai mi nahim” tin adong in ahileh Paul in “Cilicia,” ati.
English: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,

tcz: Chuin gamvaipo chun, “Nahehse ho ahung lhun teng nachung thu kakhol ding ahi,” atin chujouvin gamvaipo chun Herod inpia songkul'a koiding in thu apetan ahi.
en: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.
text:
ACT 23:35
Thadou: Chuin gamvaipo chun, “Nahehse ho ahung lhun teng nachung thu kakhol ding ahi,” atin chujouvin gamvaipo chun Herod inpia songkul'a koiding in thu apetan ahi.
English: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.

tcz: Chuin ninga jouvin gamvaipo henga Paul ahehset nauthu sei ding in thempu chungnung Ananias le Judate upa phabep chule Tertullus kiti minelkal them chu ahung lhung tauvin ahi.
en: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.
text:
ACT 24:1
Thadou: Chuin ninga jouvin gamvaipo henga Paul ahehset nauthu sei ding in thempu chungnung Ananias le Judate upa phabep chule Tertullus kiti minelkal them chu ahung lhung tauvin ahi.
English: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.

tcz: Chuin Paul chu ahin puilut uvin ahile Tertullus chun gamvaipo henga Paul hehna thu hitin ahin seitan ahi: “Nangma vaihom them nale nangma jal'a keiho Judate hi phat sottah lungmonga um kahiuve.”
