en: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,
text:
ACT 24:2
Thadou: Chuin Paul chu ahin puilut uvin ahile Tertullus chun gamvaipo henga Paul hehna thu hitin ahin seitan ahi: “Nangma vaihom them nale nangma jal'a keiho Judate hi phat sottah lungmonga um kahiuve.”
English: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,

tcz: “O Lal chungnung, hiche ho jeh hin keiho kakipah lheh jeng uve.
en: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.
text:
ACT 24:3
Thadou: “O Lal chungnung, hiche ho jeh hin keiho kakipah lheh jeng uve.
English: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.

tcz: Ahin nangma kalungjin sah nompoi hijeh chun neilungset inlang phatchom chakhat neingai peh in tia kahung tao ahi.
en: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.
text:
ACT 24:4
Thadou: Ahin nangma kalungjin sah nompoi hijeh chun neilungset inlang phatchom chakhat neingai peh in tia kahung tao ahi.
English: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.

tcz: Hichepa hi phatseh a Judate umna jousea boina semjing kei mi ahi kamudoh un, chule thuhillhem Nazareth Yeshua chon a chon ho lamkai pipu ahi ti kamudoh uve.
en: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.
text:
ACT 24:5
Thadou: Hichepa hi phatseh a Judate umna jousea boina semjing kei mi ahi kamudoh un, chule thuhillhem Nazareth Yeshua chon a chon ho lamkai pipu ahi ti kamudoh uve.
English: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.

tcz: Chukit jongle kamat uva chu aman houin jong suhboh ding agot ahi.
en: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.
text:
ACT 24:6
Thadou: Chukit jongle kamat uva chu aman houin jong suhboh ding agot ahi.
English: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.

tcz: Kaheh nauhi nangma tah in dong lechun adih tah chu namat doh ding ahi,” atin ahi.
en: By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”
text:
ACT 24:8
Thadou: Kaheh nauhi nangma tah in dong lechun adih tah chu namat doh ding ahi,” atin ahi.
English: By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”

tcz: Chuin Judah mi adangho jong chun Tertullus in asei jouse adih ahi atiuvin ahi.
en: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.
text:
ACT 24:9
Thadou: Chuin Judah mi adangho jong chun Tertullus in asei jouse adih ahi atiuvin ahi.
English: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.

tcz: Chuin gamvaipo chun Paul jong thu asei sah in, chuin Paul in, “Pu, kum tamtah Judate chunga thutan'a hung pang nahi kahen, hijeh chun namasanga kipah tah in kakihonna thu seiying kate.
en: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,
text:
ACT 24:10
Thadou: Chuin gamvaipo chun Paul jong thu asei sah in, chuin Paul in, “Pu, kum tamtah Judate chunga thutan'a hung pang nahi kahen, hijeh chun namasanga kipah tah in kakihonna thu seiying kate.
English: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,

tcz: Jerusalema Pathen hou dinga kahung lhun jouva pat ni somleni jong lhing loulai ahi hi nahetdoh jeng ding ahi.
en: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.
text:
ACT 24:11
Thadou: Jerusalema Pathen hou dinga kahung lhun jouva pat ni somleni jong lhing loulai ahi hi nahetdoh jeng ding ahi.
English: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.

tcz: Eihehse hohin houin'a mitoh kakinel na jong amu naisai lou diu ahin, kikhopna in ahiloule khopi lamlhong lah'a boina kasem jong amukhah lou dingu ahi.
en: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.
text:
ACT 24:12
Thadou: Eihehse hohin houin'a mitoh kakinel na jong amu naisai lou diu ahin, kikhopna in ahiloule khopi lamlhong lah'a boina kasem jong amukhah lou dingu ahi.
English: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.

tcz: Hiche mihon eihehset nau hi khat cha aphotchet na apeh thei lou dingu ahi.”
en: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.
text:
ACT 24:13
Thadou: Hiche mihon eihehset nau hi khat cha aphotchet na apeh thei lou dingu ahi.”
English: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.

tcz: Ahin hou dih lou lamkai ahi atiu vang chu kanom'e, ajeh chu kapu kapa teuvin ana hou Pathen chu kahou ahin, Judate dan le themgao lekhabua kisun jouse dih tah a katahsan ahi.
en: But this I confess to you, that according to the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all things which are according to the law, and which are written in the prophets;

tcz: Amaho kinep na banga keijong Pathen in nikhat le midih le midih lou ahin kaithou kit ding ahi tia kinem kahi.
en: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
text:
ACT 24:15
Thadou: Amaho kinep na banga keijong Pathen in nikhat le midih le midih lou ahin kaithou kit ding ahi tia kinem kahi.
English: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

tcz: Hiche jeh a hi mijouse le Pathen anga dih tah a hinkho manding kagot jing ahi.
en: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
text:
ACT 24:16
Thadou: Hiche jeh a hi mijouse le Pathen anga dih tah a hinkho manding kagot jing ahi.
English: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.

tcz: Chuin kum tamtah jouvin kamite kithopina sum peding le Pathen koma kilhaina bolding in Jerusalema kahung kilen ahileh,
en: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;

tcz: Houin sunga kauma ka kisuhtheng chu eiheh se hon amuvin, hiche pet'a chu kavela mipi jong umlou ahin boina ima jong aumpon ahi.
en: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.
text:
ACT 24:18
Thadou: Houin sunga kauma ka kisuhtheng chu eiheh se hon amuvin, hiche pet'a chu kavela mipi jong umlou ahin boina ima jong aumpon ahi.
English: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.

tcz: Ahin Asia gamsunga kona Judaho mi phabep umu ahi, chule amaho chu kei hehset na ding hola umjing'u ahi!
en: They ought to have been here before you and to make accusation if they had anything against me.
text:
ACT 24:19
Thadou: Ahin Asia gamsunga kona Judaho mi phabep umu ahi, chule amaho chu kei hehset na ding hola umjing'u ahi!
English: They ought to have been here before you and to make accusation if they had anything against me.

tcz: Judate houvaipoloi hon kachunga ipi chonsetna amu-uham hiche miho hi dongin,
en: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,
text:
ACT 24:20
Thadou: Judate houvaipoloi hon kachunga ipi chonsetna amu-uham hiche miho hi dongin,
English: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,

tcz: Thilkhat bouseh “thokit thudol katahsan jeh a tunia na-angsung uva kachung thu kikhol ahi,” tia kasap tailou adang ima namu lou dingu ahi.
en: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”
text:
ACT 24:21
Thadou: Thilkhat bouseh “thokit thudol katahsan jeh a tunia na-angsung uva kachung thu kikhol ahi,” tia kasap tailou adang ima namu lou dingu ahi.
English: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”

tcz: Chuche tahsanna lampi thudol hethem tah ahitoh kilhon in, Felix chun phat asuh saobe in, “Vaipipo Lysias hung lhun kah in khongaiyun, ama ahung tengle nathuu ngaito chen nange,” ati.
en: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”
text:
ACT 24:22
Thadou: Chuche tahsanna lampi thudol hethem tah ahitoh kilhon in, Felix chun phat asuh saobe in, “Vaipipo Lysias hung lhun kah in khongaiyun, ama ahung tengle nathuu ngaito chen nange,” ati.
English: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”

tcz: Chuin sepai jalamkai pa koma chun, “Paul chu songkul'a koiyun lang ahin aloi agol hon avila angaichat ho abolpeh thei nading un phalna peuvin,” ati.
en: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.
text:
ACT 24:23
Thadou: Chuin sepai jalamkai pa koma chun, “Paul chu songkul'a koiyun lang ahin aloi agol hon avila angaichat ho abolpeh thei nading un phalna peuvin,” ati.
English: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.

tcz: Nichomkhat jouvin Felix chu ajinu Juda numei Drusilla toh ahung kit in, chuin Paul chu aga kousah lhon in Paul in Yeshua Christa tahsan thudol asei chu angai lhon in ahi.
en: After some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.
text:
ACT 24:24
Thadou: Nichomkhat jouvin Felix chu ajinu Juda numei Drusilla toh ahung kit in, chuin Paul chu aga kousah lhon in Paul in Yeshua Christa tahsan thudol asei chu angai lhon in ahi.
English: After some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.

tcz: Chuin Paul in Chondih nale eima chang kitimhat chule khonunga hung lhung ding thutanna thu asei ajah phat chun Felix chu ahung kicha tan, “Tun chen lang, phat gomkom aum teng le kahin koukit ding nahi,” tin asol doh tan ahi.
en: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”
text:
ACT 24:25
Thadou: Chuin Paul in Chondih nale eima chang kitimhat chule khonunga hung lhung ding thutanna thu asei ajah phat chun Felix chu ahung kicha tan, “Tun chen lang, phat gomkom aum teng le kahin koukit ding nahi,” tin asol doh tan ahi.
English: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”

tcz: Chujongle Paul chun sum eithimpeh khante tin, akou loi loi jin ahoupi jing jin ahi.
en: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him.
text:
ACT 24:26
Thadou: Chujongle Paul chun sum eithimpeh khante tin, akou loi loi jin ahoupi jing jin ahi.
English: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him.

tcz: Chutia kumni ache jouvin, Porcius Festus in Felix pan mun chu alotan, chule Felix in Judate lung ahol jeh chun Paul chu songkul'a akhum in adalhatan ahi.
en: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.
text:
ACT 24:27
Thadou: Chutia kumni ache jouvin, Porcius Festus in Felix pan mun chu alotan, chule Felix in Judate lung ahol jeh chun Paul chu songkul'a akhum in adalhatan ahi.
English: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.

tcz: Chuin Festus in amopoh na thah jop dinga Caesarea ahung lhun nithum jouvin, Jerusalem a achen ahile,
en: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.
text:
ACT 25:1
Thadou: Chuin Festus in amopoh na thah jop dinga Caesarea ahung lhun nithum jouvin, Jerusalem a achen ahile,
English: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.

tcz: Hichea chun thempu pipui hole Judah houlamkai dang phabep in akimupiuvin Paul hehset na thu asei tauvin ahi.
en: Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul, and they begged him,
text:
ACT 25:2
Thadou: Hichea chun thempu pipui hole Judah houlamkai dang phabep in akimupiuvin Paul hehset na thu asei tauvin ahi.
English: Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul, and they begged him,

tcz: Chuin Festus henga chun ataouvin Paul chu Jerusalema ahin lesol na dingin angeh un ahi (ajeh chu lamkah a chanlhih a thading lung angaitou ahi).
en: asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem, plotting to kill him on the way.
text:
ACT 25:3
Thadou: Chuin Festus henga chun ataouvin Paul chu Jerusalema ahin lesol na dingin angeh un ahi (ajeh chu lamkah a chanlhih a thading lung angaitou ahi).
English: asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem, plotting to kill him on the way.

tcz: Ahin Festus in adonbut nah a chun, Paul chu Caesarea a kikoi ahin chule ama jeng jong khulama kilevah kit ding ahidan aseiyin,
en: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.
text:
ACT 25:4
Thadou: Ahin Festus in adonbut nah a chun, Paul chu Caesarea a kikoi ahin chule ama jeng jong khulama kilevah kit ding ahidan aseiyin,
English: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.

tcz: Chuin hitin aseiye, “Nangho athunei ho chu keitoh ikilhon uva, Paul in thilse abol khah le nanghon ahehset na thu nasei theiyu ahi,” ati.
en: “Let them therefore”, he said, “that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man, let them accuse him.”
text:
ACT 25:5
Thadou: Chuin hitin aseiye, “Nangho athunei ho chu keitoh ikilhon uva, Paul in thilse abol khah le nanghon ahehset na thu nasei theiyu ahi,” ati.
English: “Let them therefore”, he said, “that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man, let them accuse him.”

tcz: Niget ham nisom ham jouvin Festus jong Caesarea lamah akile tan, chuin alhun lhun in ama thutanna inpia atouvin Paul chu ahenga ahin puiding un thu apetan ahi.
en: When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat, and commanded Paul to be brought.
text:
ACT 25:6
Thadou: Niget ham nisom ham jouvin Festus jong Caesarea lamah akile tan, chuin alhun lhun in ama thutanna inpia atouvin Paul chu ahenga ahin puiding un thu apetan ahi.
English: When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat, and commanded Paul to be brought.

tcz: Chuin Paul ahung lhun phat in, Jerusalema kona hung Judah hou lamkai ho chu ahung khomun, photchetna jong pethei louvin hehsetna khoh tah tah aseikhum tauvin ahi.
en: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,
text:
ACT 25:7
Thadou: Chuin Paul ahung lhun phat in, Jerusalema kona hung Judah hou lamkai ho chu ahung khomun, photchetna jong pethei louvin hehsetna khoh tah tah aseikhum tauvin ahi.
English: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,

tcz: Chuin Paul in ahehset nau thu lethuh nan, “Keiman Judate dan ahin, Hou-in ahin, chule Rome te dounan themmo na kaneipoi,” ati.
en: while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I sinned at all.”
text:
ACT 25:8
Thadou: Chuin Paul in ahehset nau thu lethuh nan, “Keiman Judate dan ahin, Hou-in ahin, chule Rome te dounan themmo na kaneipoi,” ati.
English: while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I sinned at all.”

tcz: Chuin Festus in Judate lung holnan Paul thu adong in, “Nangma Jerusalema chea keima angsunga amaho toh nachung chang thu khol ding nanop em?” ati.
en: But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem and be judged by me there concerning these things?”
text:
ACT 25:9
Thadou: Chuin Festus in Judate lung holnan Paul thu adong in, “Nangma Jerusalema chea keima angsunga amaho toh nachung chang thu khol ding nanop em?” ati.
English: But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem and be judged by me there concerning these things?”

tcz: Ahin Paul in adonbut in, “Kanompoi! Hiche hi Rome te thutanna mun ahin, hiche laiya hi kathu kitan ding ahi. Ajeh chu Judate douna a kathemmo lou nahenai.
en: But Paul said, “I am standing before Caesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you also know very well.
text:
ACT 25:10
Thadou: Ahin Paul in adonbut in, “Kanompoi! Hiche hi Rome te thutanna mun ahin, hiche laiya hi kathu kitan ding ahi. Ajeh chu Judate douna a kathemmo lou nahenai.
English: But Paul said, “I am standing before Caesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you also know very well.

tcz: Chule thina ding khop themmo na kanei le thiding kada poi, ahin Caesar henga dingin kangeh joi, themmo na neilou kahi le hiche miho khut'a thiding in koiman pehdoh na tha kachunga neiponte!” ati.
en: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don’t refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!”
text:
ACT 25:11
Thadou: Chule thina ding khop themmo na kanei le thiding kada poi, ahin Caesar henga dingin kangeh joi, themmo na neilou kahi le hiche miho khut'a thiding in koiman pehdoh na tha kachunga neiponte!” ati.
English: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don’t refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!”

tcz: Chuin Festus in dohle sot'a aneiho chengse toh akihoukhom jouvin adonbut in, “Aphai! Caesar henga nathu kisei dinga nangeh ahitah le, Caesar henga nache ding ahitai!” ati.
en: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go.”
text:
ACT 25:12
Thadou: Chuin Festus in dohle sot'a aneiho chengse toh akihoukhom jouvin adonbut in, “Aphai! Caesar henga nathu kisei dinga nangeh ahitah le, Caesar henga nache ding ahitai!” ati.
English: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go.”

tcz: Nikho phabep jouvin Leng Agrippa chu asopinu Bernice toh Festus jabolna peding in ahung lhonin,
en: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus.
text:
ACT 25:13
Thadou: Nikho phabep jouvin Leng Agrippa chu asopinu Bernice toh Festus jabolna peding in ahung lhonin,
English: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus.

tcz: Chuin nikho tampi aumkhom sungu chun Festus in Paul chung thu chu Lengpa henga chun aseiyin, “Felix in keima tan dingin mikhat songkul'a ana koiyin,
en: As he stayed there many days, Festus laid Paul’s case before the king, saying, “There is a certain man left a prisoner by Felix;

tcz: Jerusalema kaum pet chun Judate thempu pipui ho le upa hon ahehset na thu aseiyun themmo nachan ding ahi eitiuvin ahi.
en: about whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, asking for a sentence against him.
text:
ACT 25:15
Thadou: Jerusalema kaum pet chun Judate thempu pipui ho le upa hon ahehset na thu aseiyun themmo nachan ding ahi eitiuvin ahi.
English: about whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, asking for a sentence against him.

tcz: Chuin Rome te dan dungjuiyin achungthu khol masa louvin mi themmo akichan thei poi kati peh e, amaho chu ahehsehou toh kimaitoa kidinsah a akihonna thu kisei sah ji ahi” kati.
en: I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met the accusers face to face and has had opportunity to make his defense concerning the matter laid against him.
text:
ACT 25:16
Thadou: Chuin Rome te dan dungjuiyin achungthu khol masa louvin mi themmo akichan thei poi kati peh e, amaho chu ahehsehou toh kimaitoa kidinsah a akihonna thu kisei sah ji ahi” kati.
English: I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met the accusers face to face and has had opportunity to make his defense concerning the matter laid against him.

tcz: “Chuin ahehse ho achungthu khola ahung phat un khongai sot louvin ajing in Paul kakou tan ahi.
en: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.
text:
ACT 25:17
Thadou: “Chuin ahehse ho achungthu khola ahung phat un khongai sot louvin ajing in Paul kakou tan ahi.
English: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.

tcz: Ahin ahehse hon aheh nau chu kaginchat tobang themmo na khat cha ana hitapon,
en: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;

tcz: Chusang in amaho houthu to kisai joh anahin ahi. Ajeh chu Judaten athia ahet'u Yeshua chu Paul in ahinge ati ahi.

ACT 25:19

tcz: Chuin keiman atan lhah je kamah jeh chun Jerusalema a nachung thu itan dingu ham tia kadoh le,

English: Being perplexed how to inquire concerning these things, I asked whether he was willing to go to Jerusalem and there be judged concerning these matters.

ACT 25:22

English: Agrippa said to Festus, “I also would like to hear the man myself.” “Tomorrow,” he said, “you shall hear him.”

en: So on the next day, when Agrippa and Bernice had come with great pomp, and they had entered into the place of hearing with the commanding officers and the principal men of the city, at the command of Festus, Paul was brought in.
text:
ACT 25:23
Thadou: Chuin ajing in Agrippa le Bernice chu loupi tah in sepai vaipipo le khopi sunga milen milal ho toh thungaina indan sunga ahunglut un, chuin Festus in Paul chu ahin puilut ding un thu apetan ahi.
English: So on the next day, when Agrippa and Bernice had come with great pomp, and they had entered into the place of hearing with the commanding officers and the principal men of the city, at the command of Festus, Paul was brought in.

ACT 25:25

tcz: Ahin leng len pen koma dinga ipi kasut ding ham? Ajeh chu amona kicheh tah kahepoi. Hijeh a chu sutding themkhat beh kahet doh nadinga tunia nangho jouse, adeh'a Leng Agrippa angsunga kahin puidoh ahi.
en: of whom I have no certain thing to write to my lord. Therefore I have brought him out before you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, that, after examination I may have something to write.
text:
ACT 25:26
Thadou: Ahin leng len pen koma dinga ipi kasut ding ham? Ajeh chu amona kicheh tah kahepoi. Hijeh a chu sutding themkhat beh kahet doh nadinga tunia nangho jouse, adeh'a Leng Agrippa angsunga kahin puidoh ahi.
English: of whom I have no certain thing to write to my lord. Therefore I have brought him out before you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, that, after examination I may have something to write.

tcz: Ajeh chu songkul'a kona mikhat athemmo na kicheh tah umlouva leng len koma sol chu angai ahipoi,” ati.
en: For it seems to me unreasonable, in sending a prisoner, not to also specify the charges against him.”
text:
ACT 25:27
Thadou: Ajeh chu songkul'a kona mikhat athemmo na kicheh tah umlouva leng len koma sol chu angai ahipoi,” ati.
English: For it seems to me unreasonable, in sending a prisoner, not to also specify the charges against him.”

tcz: Chujou chun, Agrippa in Paul jah ah, “Nakihonna thuphong thei in nate,” ati. Hichun Paul in akhut alhang doh in akihon nathu asei tai.
en: Agrippa said to Paul, “You may speak for yourself.” Then Paul stretched out his hand, and made his defense.
text:
ACT 26:1
Thadou: Chujou chun, Agrippa in Paul jah ah, “Nakihonna thuphong thei in nate,” ati. Hichun Paul in akhut alhang doh in akihon nathu asei tai.
English: Agrippa said to Paul, “You may speak for yourself.” Then Paul stretched out his hand, and made his defense.

tcz: “Kakipah lheh jeng e, Leng Agrippa, tunia Juda lamkai hon themmo eichen nau chung chang a kakihon nathu ja ah nang bou nahi.
en: “I think myself happy, King Agrippa, that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things that I am accused by the Jews,
text:
ACT 26:2

tcz: Ajeh chu judate kivaipoh dol le akinel bautam nau hethem ah nahi kahen, hijeh chun kathusei hi lung neng tah in nei ngai peh in.”
en: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.
text:
ACT 26:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu judate kivaipoh dol le akinel bautam nau hethem ah nahi kahen, hijeh chun kathusei hi lung neng tah in nei ngai peh in.”
English: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.

tcz: Keima ka chapan lai a pat a kanam mite lah le Jerusalem a kon hung seilen a, Juda nam chon le khan kichuh them sa kahi hi Juda lamkai hon ahetsoh keiyu ahi.
en: “Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;

tcz: Amahon asei nom ule, atil a pat a ahet jing sau Pharisee mi, hou thudol a chondan kikhel tah kahi aheuve.
en: having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.
text:
ACT 26:5
Thadou: Amahon asei nom ule, atil a pat a ahet jing sau Pharisee mi, hou thudol a chondan kikhel tah kahi aheuve.
English: having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

tcz: Chule tuahi kapu kapa teu heng a Pathen tepsa hung guilhung ding kakinep na thudol a, kachung thu khol dia hikom a ding ah kahi.
en: Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,
text:
ACT 26:6
Thadou: Chule tuahi kapu kapa teu heng a Pathen tepsa hung guilhung ding kakinep na thudol a, kachung thu khol dia hikom a ding ah kahi.
English: Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,

tcz: Adih tah a sei din, Israel phungsom le phung nin sun le jan a anahou jing u ahi. Vo Lengpa hiche kinep na thudol a Judaten eiheh-u ahi bouve.
en: which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, King Agrippa!
text:
ACT 26:7
Thadou: Adih tah a sei din, Israel phungsom le phung nin sun le jan a anahou jing u ahi. Vo Lengpa hiche kinep na thudol a Judaten eiheh-u ahi bouve.
English: which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, King Agrippa!

tcz: Ipijeh a Pathen in mi thisa atho doh sah thei thudol hi tahsan lel nahiu vem?
en: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?
text:
ACT 26:8
Thadou: Ipijeh a Pathen in mi thisa atho doh sah thei thudol hi tahsan lel nahiu vem?
English: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?

tcz: Keima jeng jong Nazareth Yeshua min douna a thil ijakai bol ding kana ngai tosa ahi.
en: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
text:
ACT 26:9
Thadou: Keima jeng jong Nazareth Yeshua min douna a thil ijakai bol ding kana ngai tosa ahi.
English: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

tcz: Atah beh in jong Jerusalema kana bol in, Thempu pipui ho a kon in thuneina kalan, mitheng tampi songkul'ah kana khum in chule atha jeng-u jong chu pha kasan ahi.
en: I also did this in Jerusalem. I both shut up many of the saints in prisons, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death I gave my vote against them.
text:
ACT 26:10
Thadou: Atah beh in jong Jerusalema kana bol in, Thempu pipui ho a kon in thuneina kalan, mitheng tampi songkul'ah kana khum in chule atha jeng-u jong chu pha kasan ahi.
English: I also did this in Jerusalem. I both shut up many of the saints in prisons, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death I gave my vote against them.

tcz: Phat atam jon houthu dol a akikhop nau in tina jong talent kamat sah jin, Yeshua atahsan nau taitom sah in hoise tah in kana douvin, gamdang miho khopi dung gei in kana nocheh jin ahi.
en: Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.
text:
ACT 26:11
Thadou: Phat atam jon houthu dol a akikhop nau in tina jong talent kamat sah jin, Yeshua atahsan nau taitom sah in hoise tah in kana douvin, gamdang miho khopi dung gei in kana nocheh jin ahi.
English: Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.

tcz: Kabon chau vin kalhu sohtauvin ahi, hichun, Aramaic paovin kajah a, “Saul, Saul ibola nang in nei bolset jing ham? Nei dou jinghi nang a din aphat chom na aumpoi,” eiti.
en: When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’
text:
ACT 26:14

English: When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’

en: But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness both of the things which you have seen and of the things which I will reveal to you;

en: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”
text:
ACT 26:24
Thadou: Photlot louvin Festus chu ahung pengjah jeng in, “Paul angol ah nahitai; nalekha thep nan nangol sah ahitai,” ati.
English: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”

tcz: Hichun Paul in adonbut in, “Angol a kahipoi, vo Lalchungnung Festus, kicheh tah a thudih kasei joh ahibouve.
en: But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.
text:
ACT 26:25
Thadou: Hichun Paul in adonbut in, “Angol a kahipoi, vo Lalchungnung Festus, kicheh tah a thudih kasei joh ahibouve.
English: But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.

tcz: Chule Agrippa Lengpan jong ahei. Ijeh inem itile aning koi a kibol ahilou jeh in aman hitobang ho hi ahesoh keiye ti kichen tah in kahei, hijeh a chu hangsan tah a kasei ahi,” ati.
en: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.
text:
ACT 26:26
Thadou: Chule Agrippa Lengpan jong ahei. Ijeh inem itile aning koi a kibol ahilou jeh in aman hitobang ho hi ahesoh keiye ti kichen tah in kahei, hijeh a chu hangsan tah a kasei ahi,” ati.
English: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.

tcz: Leng Agrippa, themgao ho natahsan em? Natahsan e ti kahei, ati.
en: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”
text:
ACT 26:27
Thadou: Leng Agrippa, themgao ho natahsan em? Natahsan e ti kahei, ati.
English: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”

tcz: Hichun Agrippa in, “Kintah a Christian hisah jeng thei dia nei gel ham?” ati.
en: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”
text:
ACT 26:28
Thadou: Hichun Agrippa in, “Kintah a Christian hisah jeng thei dia nei gel ham?” ati.
English: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”

tcz: Chuin Paul in adonbut in, “Gang henlang gang hih jongle, nangle hiva mipi umjouse hi, thih khaova kakihen naho tilouvin keima tobang hisoh kei ule tin, Pathen hengah kataove,” ati.
en: Paul said, “I pray to God, that whether with little or with much, not only you, but also all that hear me today, might become such as I am, except for these bonds.”
text:
ACT 26:29
Thadou: Chuin Paul in adonbut in, “Gang henlang gang hih jongle, nangle hiva mipi umjouse hi, thih khaova kakihen naho tilouvin keima tobang hisoh kei ule tin, Pathen hengah kataove,” ati.
English: Paul said, “I pray to God, that whether with little or with much, not only you, but also all that hear me today, might become such as I am, except for these bonds.”

tcz: Hichun Lengpa, Gamvaipo, Bernice chule adangho se adingdoh un adalha tauve.
en: The king rose up with the governor and Bernice, and those who sat with them.
text:
ACT 26:30
Thadou: Hichun Lengpa, Gamvaipo, Bernice chule adangho se adingdoh un adalha tauve.
English: The king rose up with the governor and Bernice, and those who sat with them.

tcz: Apotdoh uva akihou naule akinopto nau chun “Hiche mipa hin thina le songkul tan-na thei changei ima bolset aneipoi,” atiuve.
en: When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”
text:
ACT 26:31
Thadou: Apotdoh uva akihou naule akinopto nau chun “Hiche mipa hin thina le songkul tan-na thei changei ima bolset aneipoi,” atiuve.
English: When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”

tcz: Chule Agrippa in Festus jah a, “Aman Caesar henga dinga ngehna anabollou hile lhadoh thei ahitai,” ati.
en: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.”
text:
ACT 26:32
Thadou: Chule Agrippa in Festus jah a, “Aman Caesar henga dinga ngehna anabollou hile lhadoh thei ahitai,” ati.
English: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.”

tcz: Chuin aphat ahung lhun phat in Italy cheding in konga katou tauvin ahi. Paul le songkul atan khompi mi phabep chu Rome sepai lamkai holah a Julius atiu khut'a chun apedoh tauvin ahi.
en: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.
text:
ACT 27:1
Thadou: Chuin aphat ahung lhun phat in Italy cheding in konga katou tauvin ahi. Paul le songkul atan khompi mi phabep chu Rome sepai lamkai holah a Julius atiu khut'a chun apedoh tauvin ahi.
English: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.

tcz: Chule Macedonia mi Thessalonica a kona Aristarchus jaonan, Asia gamsung sah-lhumlam a Adramyttium kong ngahmuna konin konga kache tauvin ahi. Chule hiche kong chu Asia gamsung muntina kingapa dinga kigong ahi.
en: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us.
text:
ACT 27:2
Thadou: Chule Macedonia mi Thessalonica a kona Aristarchus jaonan, Asia gamsung sah-lhumlam a Adramyttium kong ngahmuna konin konga kache tauvin ahi. Chule hiche kong chu Asia gamsung muntina kingapa dinga kigong ahi.
English: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us.

tcz: Chuin ajinga Sidon kong ngahmun kalhunun, Julius chun ngailut tah a Paul chu twipanga aloiho vilthei dinga phalna apeh jeh chun achen ahileh aloihon angaichat ho jouse ahin kithopiu vin ahi.
en: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.
text:
ACT 27:3
Thadou: Chuin ajinga Sidon kong ngahmun kalhunun, Julius chun ngailut tah a Paul chu twipanga aloiho vilthei dinga phalna apeh jeh chun achen ahileh aloihon angaichat ho jouse ahin kithopiu vin ahi.
English: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.

tcz: Chuin hichea kona twi chunga kachelai tah'un huipi hat tah khat in keiho lam nga-a einun den phat un kache jom thei tapouvin, hijeh chun Cyprus twikol sahlam twipi pang a kache peh tauvin ahi.
en: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.
text:
ACT 27:4
Thadou: Chuin hichea kona twi chunga kachelai tah'un huipi hat tah khat in keiho lam nga-a einun den phat un kache jom thei tapouvin, hijeh chun Cyprus twikol sahlam twipi pang a kache peh tauvin ahi.
English: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

tcz: Hiti chun Cilicia le Pamphylia twipi kahopaiyun, Lycia gamsunga Myra munah kakingauvin ahi.
en: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
text:
ACT 27:5
Thadou: Hiti chun Cilicia le Pamphylia twipi kahopaiyun, Lycia gamsunga Myra munah kakingauvin ahi.
English: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

tcz: Chuin hikoma chun sepai jalamkai pan Alexandria a kona Egypt te kong Italy jonding khat ahin mu phat in hiche konga chun eiheng doh tauvin ahi.
en: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy, and he put us on board.
text:
ACT 27:6
Thadou: Chuin hikoma chun sepai jalamkai pan Alexandria a kona Egypt te kong Italy jonding khat ahin mu phat in hiche konga chun eiheng doh tauvin ahi.
English: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy, and he put us on board.

tcz: Chuin nikho tamtah ol olin kakitolun hahsatah-in Cnidus kanai hamhamun, huiyin eilenan jeh-un Crete twikol pang panga kakitolun, Salmone jon kajot un ahi.
en: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.
text:
ACT 27:7
Thadou: Chuin nikho tamtah ol olin kakitolun hahsatah-in Cnidus kanai hamhamun, huiyin eilenan jeh-un Crete twikol pang panga kakitolun, Salmone jon kajot un ahi.
English: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.

tcz: Twi pamchin china hahsatah in kacheuvin, nahchangsalin Lasea khopi muntoh kinaicha a um Kongkai munhoi atiu chu kalhung tauvin ahi.
en: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.
text:
ACT 27:8
Thadou: Twi pamchin china hahsatah in kacheuvin, nahchangsalin Lasea khopi muntoh kinaicha a um Kongkai munhoi atiu chu kalhung tauvin ahi.
English: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.

tcz: Chuin phat tampi kamansah jouvun, konga chejom ding la aphat toh kitoh a toset toding kichat aum jeh chun, Paul in kongtol ho akimupin,
en: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished them
text:
ACT 27:9
Thadou: Chuin phat tampi kamansah jouvun, konga chejom ding la aphat toh kitoh a toset toding kichat aum jeh chun, Paul in kongtol ho akimupin,
English: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished them

tcz: “Sopite ho, iche jom uva ahile, kongkeh thei, thil keuho jong mangthei, chule ihinkhou jeng jong ichan theiyu ahi,” tin aseitan ahi.
en: and said to them, “Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the cargo and the ship, but also of our lives.”
text:
ACT 27:10
Thadou: “Sopite ho, iche jom uva ahile, kongkeh thei, thil keuho jong mangthei, chule ihinkhou jeng jong ichan theiyu ahi,” tin aseitan ahi.
English: and said to them, “Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the cargo and the ship, but also of our lives.”

tcz: Ahivangin songkul tangho chunga mopo lamkai pa chun, Paul thusei sang in Kong neipa le kong tolho thuseijoh chu angaiyin ahi.
en: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship than to those things which were spoken by Paul.
text:
ACT 27:11
Thadou: Ahivangin songkul tangho chunga mopo lamkai pa chun, Paul thusei sang in Kong neipa le kong tolho thuseijoh chu angaiyin ahi.
English: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship than to those things which were spoken by Paul.

tcz: Chuin Kongkai munhoi chu phalbia umna dinga ahahsat jep jeh chun, konga natong ho atamjo chun Crete twipi pang a Phoenix mun lhuntei ding hikoma chu phalbi manding adeisah un ahi. Phoenix mun chu kongkaimun nomtah ahin sah-lhum le lhang-lhum angatto ahi.
en: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.
text:
ACT 27:12
Thadou: Chuin Kongkai munhoi chu phalbia umna dinga ahahsat jep jeh chun, konga natong ho atamjo chun Crete twipi pang a Phoenix mun lhuntei ding hikoma chu phalbi manding adeisah un ahi. Phoenix mun chu kongkaimun nomtah ahin sah-lhum le lhang-lhum angatto ahi.
English: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.

tcz: Chuin lhanglama konin hui ol olin ahung nung pan tan ahileh kongtol hon kong chethei nante tin khao alhauvin Crete vapang panga atol tauvin ahi.
en: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.
text:
ACT 27:13
Thadou: Chuin lhanglama konin hui ol olin ahung nung pan tan ahileh kongtol hon kong chethei nante tin khao alhauvin Crete vapang panga atol tauvin ahi.
English: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.

tcz: Ahivangin chomkhat jouvin huiche dan ahung kikhelin twikhanglen'a konin huipi le gopi hattah (solam hui) atiu chu ahung nung in twipi langa einuh lut tauvin ahi.
en: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon.
text:
ACT 27:14
Thadou: Ahivangin chomkhat jouvin huiche dan ahung kikhelin twikhanglen'a konin huipi le gopi hattah (solam hui) atiu chu ahung nung in twipi langa einuh lut tauvin ahi.
English: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon.

tcz: Chuin kongtol hon kongchu ahei jou lou phat uvin, huilah a chun kong chu amoh lha tauvin ahi.
en: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.
text:
ACT 27:15
Thadou: Chuin kongtol hon kongchu ahei jou lou phat uvin, huilah a chun kong chu amoh lha tauvin ahi.
English: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.

tcz: Chuin Cauda atiu twikol neocha pang panga chun kakitol uvin anah nah in hahsatah in kongneo khat kaman ham hamun ahi.
en: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.
text:
ACT 27:16
Thadou: Chuin Cauda atiu twikol neocha pang panga chun kakitol uvin anah nah in hahsatah in kongneo khat kaman ham hamun ahi.
English: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.

tcz: Chuin kongtol hon hichu akhaidoh un ahunan amang un, khauvin kong noilamah akanbeh tauve; chuin ajole Syrtis kileng lut get inte ti akichauvin pondal kikhaina ho akainem uvin ahile eimoh lhoh lhoh jeng tauve.
en: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.
text:
ACT 27:17
Thadou: Chuin kongtol hon hichu akhaidoh un ahunan amang un, khauvin kong noilamah akanbeh tauve; chuin ajole Syrtis kileng lut get inte ti akichauvin pondal kikhaina ho akainem uvin ahile eimoh lhoh lhoh jeng tauve.
English: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.

tcz: Chuin huipi chun eisuh gim behseh jeh-u chun ajing nikhon thil apaidoh pan tauvin ahi.
en: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.
text:
ACT 27:18
Thadou: Chuin huipi chun eisuh gim behseh jeh-u chun ajing nikhon thil apaidoh pan tauvin ahi.
English: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.

tcz: Anithum nin amaho tah in akhuttah in kong manchah ho chu apai tauvin ahi.
en: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.
text:
ACT 27:19
Thadou: Anithum nin amaho tah in akhuttah in kong manchah ho chu apai tauvin ahi.
English: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.

tcz: Chuin tijat umtah huipi hattah a nikho tamtah anun a nisa le ahsi ho eisalvah-u beihela aum phat chun kihing inte tia kinepna jong aum tapon ahi.
en: When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days, and no small storm pressed on us, all hope that we would be saved was now taken away.
text:
ACT 27:20
Thadou: Chuin tijat umtah huipi hattah a nikho tamtah anun a nisa le ahsi ho eisalvah-u beihela aum phat chun kihing inte tia kinepna jong aum tapon ahi.
English: When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days, and no small storm pressed on us, all hope that we would be saved was now taken away.

tcz: Chuin koima an nelouva nitamtah aum phat un Paul in mipi ho chu akoukhom un ajah uva, “Vo miho, kasei chu ngaiyuvin lang Crete chu dalhah da leuchun hitobang setto naleh manthah na hi ito lou dingu ahi.
en: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.
text:
ACT 27:21
Thadou: Chuin koima an nelouva nitamtah aum phat un Paul in mipi ho chu akoukhom un ajah uva, “Vo miho, kasei chu ngaiyuvin lang Crete chu dalhah da leuchun hitobang setto naleh manthah na hi ito lou dingu ahi.
English: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.

tcz: Ahin tunjong lungneu hih un, konghi twiya lhalut jongle koiman nahin nau nachan lou dingu ahi.
en: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.
text:
ACT 27:22
Thadou: Ahin tunjong lungneu hih un, konghi twiya lhalut jongle koiman nahin nau nachan lou dingu ahi.
English: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.

tcz: Ajeh chu janlhah in kahou le alhachana katoh jing ka Pathen vantil khat kahenga ahung ding in,
en: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,
text:
ACT 27:23
Thadou: Ajeh chu janlhah in kahou le alhachana katoh jing ka Pathen vantil khat kahenga ahung ding in,
English: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,

tcz: Chule hitin aseiyin ahi, kicha hih in Paul ajeh chu iti jong le nangma Caesar angsunga nading teitei ding ahi, chule konga natoupi ho jouse toh nahoidoh soh kei ding-u ahi.
en: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’
text:
ACT 27:24
Thadou: Chule hitin aseiyin ahi, kicha hih in Paul ajeh chu iti jong le nangma Caesar angsunga nading teitei ding ahi, chule konga natoupi ho jouse toh nahoidoh soh kei ding-u ahi.
English: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’

tcz: Hijeh chun kicha hih un! Ka Pathen in asei tobang hiding ahi ti katahsan'e.
en: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.
text:
ACT 27:25
Thadou: Hijeh chun kicha hih un! Ka Pathen in asei tobang hiding ahi ti katahsan'e.
English: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.

tcz: Ahin Twikol khat'a vang ikong-u seden teiding ahi,” ati.
en: But we must run aground on a certain island.”
text:
ACT 27:26
Thadou: Ahin Twikol khat'a vang ikong-u seden teiding ahi,” ati.
English: But we must run aground on a certain island.”

tcz: Chuin Adria twikhanglen'a huipi hattah in eilhoh le le nau nisomle janli lhinni jan khangkimin kongtol hon kong chu toltoh akinai taiti aging chauvin,
en: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.
text:
ACT 27:27
Thadou: Chuin Adria twikhanglen'a huipi hattah in eilhoh le le nau nisomle janli lhinni jan khangkimin kongtol hon kong chu toltoh akinai taiti aging chauvin,
English: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.

tcz: Hijeh chun twi chu ateuvin ahile feet jakhat le somni bep in athuh in, chuin chomkhat jouvin atekit-un ahile feet somko bep ahitan ahi.
en: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms.
text:
ACT 27:28
Thadou: Hijeh chun twi chu ateuvin ahile feet jakhat le somni bep in athuh in, chuin chomkhat jouvin atekit-un ahile feet somko bep ahitan ahi.
English: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms.

tcz: Hiche phat chun twipanga songho kitat khading ahitai tin akichauvin, kong nunglama chun pondal li asep doh un, ataovun khovah angah tauvin ahi.
en: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.
text:
ACT 27:29
Thadou: Hiche phat chun twipanga songho kitat khading ahitai tin akichauvin, kong nunglama chun pondal li asep doh un, ataovun khovah angah tauvin ahi.
English: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.

tcz: Chuin kongtol ho chu kongmai lama pondal khailha ding bang akisauvin, kongchu dalhan kongneova jamding angaito tauvin ahi.
en: As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship and had lowered the boat into the sea, pretending that they would lay out anchors from the bow,
text:
ACT 27:30
Thadou: Chuin kongtol ho chu kongmai lama pondal khailha ding bang akisauvin, kongchu dalhan kongneova jamding angaito tauvin ahi.
English: As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship and had lowered the boat into the sea, pretending that they would lay out anchors from the bow,

tcz: Chuin Paul in Sepai jalamkaipa le asepai ho jah a “Kongtolho kong sunga aum lou u le nangho khatcha sohcha pouvin nate,” ati.
en: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, “Unless these stay in the ship, you can’t be saved.”
text:
ACT 27:31
Thadou: Chuin Paul in Sepai jalamkaipa le asepai ho jah a “Kongtolho kong sunga aum lou u le nangho khatcha sohcha pouvin nate,” ati.
English: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, “Unless these stay in the ship, you can’t be saved.”

tcz: Chuin Sepai hon kongneo khaochu asat tanun alha mang tauve.
en: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off.
text:
ACT 27:32
Thadou: Chuin Sepai hon kongneo khaochu asat tanun alha mang tauve.
English: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off.

tcz: Chuin ajing kho ahungvah phat in Paul in miho chu an neding in asolin, “Lungkham tah'a an le twi natoh khah lounau haptani ahitai.”
en: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, “Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.
text:
ACT 27:33
Thadou: Chuin ajing kho ahungvah phat in Paul in miho chu an neding in asolin, “Lungkham tah'a an le twi natoh khah lounau haptani ahitai.”
English: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, “Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.

tcz: “Tun lungsettah in nangho phatchomna ding in an netauvin ajeh chu nasam'u jangkhat jeng jong mangthah louding ahi.” ati.
en: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”
text:
ACT 27:34
Thadou: “Tun lungsettah in nangho phatchomna ding in an netauvin ajeh chu nasam'u jangkhat jeng jong mangthah louding ahi.” ati.
English: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”

tcz: Chuin changlhah phabep alan Pathen athangvah in aheh balbal'in anetan ahi.
en: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.
text:
ACT 27:35
Thadou: Chuin changlhah phabep alan Pathen athangvah in aheh balbal'in anetan ahi.
English: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.

tcz: Hichun midangho jong ahung lunglen doh un amahon jong an anetauvin ahi.
en: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.
text:
ACT 27:36
Thadou: Hichun midangho jong ahung lunglen doh un amahon jong an anetauvin ahi.
English: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.

tcz: Kabon chauva konga touchu mi jani le somsagi le gup kahiuve.
en: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.
text:
ACT 27:37
Thadou: Kabon chauva konga touchu mi jani le somsagi le gup kahiuve.
English: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.

tcz: Chuin konga touho jousen an aneh jou phat un kongchu asujang un, asunga um suhlou chang ho chu aseplha tauvin ahi.
en: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.
text:
ACT 27:38
Thadou: Chuin konga touho jousen an aneh jou phat un kongchu asujang un, asunga um suhlou chang ho chu aseplha tauvin ahi.
English: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.

tcz: Chuin jingkah kho ahung vah phat in, aumnau vapang chu hoilai ahi ahetapouvin ahi. Ahin twi-ninglutna vapang khat amudoh un, ahithei le kong huhna-a chu hilaimuna chu tollut ding tin angaito tauvin ahi.
en: When it was day, they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.
text:
ACT 27:39
Thadou: Chuin jingkah kho ahung vah phat in, aumnau vapang chu hoilai ahi ahetapouvin ahi. Ahin twi-ninglutna vapang khat amudoh un, ahithei le kong huhna-a chu hilaimuna chu tollut ding tin angaito tauvin ahi.
English: When it was day, they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.

tcz: Chuin thihhat ho alha lhauvin, twikhanglen'a adalha tauve. Chuin chuchetoh thakhat'in kongkhe kanna chu alham lhauvin, hui chena lama pondal atungdoh un, vapam lam chu ajon tauve.
en: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.
text:
ACT 27:40
Thadou: Chuin thihhat ho alha lhauvin, twikhanglen'a adalha tauve. Chuin chuchetoh thakhat'in kongkhe kanna chu alham lhauvin, hui chena lama pondal atungdoh un, vapam lam chu ajon tauve.
English: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.

tcz: Chuin twi kinong ni kisuhtona kalut khatauvin ahile, kong manghem chu tol'a akiphut dentai. Chuin kong mailam chu long louhelin aohdentan, kong meilam chu twi kinong chun hatah in ahin sutan ahile kong chu akeh pantan ahi.
en: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.
text:
ACT 27:41
Thadou: Chuin twi kinong ni kisuhtona kalut khatauvin ahile, kong manghem chu tol'a akiphut dentai. Chuin kong mailam chu long louhelin aohdentan, kong meilam chu twi kinong chun hatah in ahin sutan ahile kong chu akeh pantan ahi.
English: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.

tcz: Chuin sepai ho chun songkul tangho chu twi aje galkaiyuva asochat louna dingun thading agouvin ahi.
en: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.
text:
ACT 27:42
Thadou: Chuin sepai ho chun songkul tangho chu twi aje galkaiyuva asochat louna dingun thading agouvin ahi.
English: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.

tcz: Ahivangin sepai jalamkai chun Paul chu ahing hoinom jeh chun ajadan, twi japthei theiyin anajap galkai masat dingin thu apetan ahi.
en: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;

tcz: Chule adang twijap theilou ho chu kong sunga um thingpeh ham ahiloule kongse hel hoa chu kitol dingin thu apen ahile, abonchauvin twipanga bitkeiyin asohchauvin ahi.
en: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.
text:
ACT 27:44
Thadou: Chule adang twijap theilou ho chu kong sunga um thingpeh ham ahiloule kongse hel hoa chu kitol dingin thu apen ahile, abonchauvin twipanga bitkeiyin asohchauvin ahi.
English: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.

tcz: Chuin kasochat phat un, Malta twikol a um kahiu chu kahedoh tauve.
en: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.
text:
ACT 28:1
Thadou: Chuin kasochat phat un, Malta twikol a um kahiu chu kahedoh tauve.
English: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.

tcz: Hiche twikol a cheng mite chu apha lheh jeng un, go ajuh a adap jeh chun, twi panga chun mei atih un eina lamtouvin ahi.
en: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.
text:
ACT 28:2
Thadou: Hiche twikol a cheng mite chu apha lheh jeng un, go ajuh a adap jeh chun, twi panga chun mei atih un eina lamtouvin ahi.
English: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.

tcz: Chuin Paul in meiya tiding thing khut dimkhat ahin choiyin meichunga chun alehlut in ahile, mei asat jeh chun gul gunei khat ahung kithol doh in akhut chu achun ahi.
en: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.
text:
ACT 28:3
Thadou: Chuin Paul in meiya tiding thing khut dimkhat ahin choiyin meichunga chun alehlut in ahile, mei asat jeh chun gul gunei khat ahung kithol doh in akhut chu achun ahi.
English: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.

tcz: Akhut a gul akikhai den chu twikol mite chun amuuvin, khat le khat akihouvun, “Tolthat hitei ding ahi! Twipi chunga ahung sochat vanga thudih chun ahing dinga aphallou ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
en: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”
text:
ACT 28:4
Thadou: Akhut a gul akikhai den chu twikol mite chun amuuvin, khat le khat akihouvun, “Tolthat hitei ding ahi! Twipi chunga ahung sochat vanga thudih chun ahing dinga aphallou ahi,” atiuvin ahi.
English: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”

tcz: Ahin Paul in akhut'a gul chu meilah a athing lhan ahile ama imacha atipon ahi.
en: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.
text:
ACT 28:5
Thadou: Ahin Paul in akhut'a gul chu meilah a athing lhan ahile ama imacha atipon ahi.
English: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.

tcz: Miho chun itih le ahung pomin ahiloule ahung moh lhuh dem tia angau ahi. Ahin sottah angauva ima tilouva aum chu amu phat un alunggel u akikhel tan, pathen hiding ahi atiuvin ahi.
en: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.
text:
ACT 28:6
Thadou: Miho chun itih le ahung pomin ahiloule ahung moh lhuh dem tia angau ahi. Ahin sottah angauva ima tilouva aum chu amu phat un alunggel u akikhel tan, pathen hiding ahi atiuvin ahi.
English: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.

tcz: Hiche kakingah nau twipanga chu twikol pipuipen Publius atiu chun gam anei ahin, ama chun eilem'un nithum sung in khoto tah in eivah un ahi.
en: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.
text:
ACT 28:7
Thadou: Hiche kakingah nau twipanga chu twikol pipuipen Publius atiu chun gam anei ahin, ama chun eilem'un nithum sung in khoto tah in eivah un ahi.
English: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.

tcz: Chutia kaum sungu chun Publius pachu khosih le ehthit in hatah in ahung dammon ahile, Paul alut in achunga khut angamin ataopeh in ahileh ahung dam tan ahi.
en: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.
text:
ACT 28:8
Thadou: Chutia kaum sungu chun Publius pachu khosih le ehthit in hatah in ahung dammon ahile, Paul alut in achunga khut angamin ataopeh in ahileh ahung dam tan ahi.
English: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.

tcz: Chuin twikol sunga damlou jouse chu ahin puiyun ahile abonun adam tauvin ahi.
en: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.
text:
ACT 28:9
Thadou: Chuin twikol sunga damlou jouse chu ahin puiyun ahile abonun adam tauvin ahi.
English: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.

tcz: Hiche jeh chun mihon eijabol lheh jeng tauvin, konga kache kit diu phat chun angai cha thil jousen eikithopi un ahi.
en: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.
text:
ACT 28:10
Thadou: Hiche jeh chun mihon eijabol lheh jeng tauvin, konga kache kit diu phat chun angai cha thil jousen eikithopi un ahi.
English: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.

tcz: Chuin kongke jouva pat lhathum jou phalbi laitah in, pathen lim alu ni neiya kisem Alexandria konga chun kakitol kit tauvin ahi.
en: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”
text:
ACT 28:11
Thadou: Chuin kongke jouva pat lhathum jou phalbi laitah in, pathen lim alu ni neiya kisem Alexandria konga chun kakitol kit tauvin ahi.
English: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”

tcz: Chuin Syracuse muna kakinga pauvin nithum kakibangpa uvin ahi.
en: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.
text:
ACT 28:12
Thadou: Chuin Syracuse muna kakinga pauvin nithum kakibangpa uvin ahi.
English: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.

tcz: Hichea pat chun Rhegium lama kakitol kit un ahile, nikhat jouvin lhanglam hui hattah in ahung nung in hichun ajing in Puteoli mun kalhung tauvin ahi.
en: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,
text:
ACT 28:13
Thadou: Hichea pat chun Rhegium lama kakitol kit un ahile, nikhat jouvin lhanglam hui hattah in ahung nung in hichun ajing in Puteoli mun kalhung tauvin ahi.
English: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,

tcz: Hichelai muna chun seijui ho ana umun, amahon eikouvun hapta khat lam kaum khomun, chujouvin Rome kajon tauvin ahi.
en: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.
text:
ACT 28:14
Thadou: Hichelai muna chun seijui ho ana umun, amahon eikouvun hapta khat lam kaum khomun, chujouvin Rome kajon tauvin ahi.
English: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.

tcz: Chuin Rome a um sopi hon keiho kacheu thu ajah phat un Appian a mipi kikhopna muna eihung kimu piuvin ahi. Chuleh adanghon jinlhun in thum'a eihung lhun piuvin ahi. Hichu Paul in amu phat in akitilkhou lheh jeng in Pathen athangvah in ahi.
en: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.
text:
ACT 28:15
Thadou: Chuin Rome a um sopi hon keiho kacheu thu ajah phat un Appian a mipi kikhopna muna eihung kimu piuvin ahi. Chuleh adanghon jinlhun in thum'a eihung lhun piuvin ahi. Hichu Paul in amu phat in akitilkhou lheh jeng in Pathen athangvah in ahi.
English: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.

tcz: Chuin Rome kalhun phat uvin, Paul chu achangin inchom khat ah aumsah un sepai ho angasah un ahi.
en: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.
text:
ACT 28:16
Thadou: Chuin Rome kalhun phat uvin, Paul chu achangin inchom khat ah aumsah un sepai ho angasah un ahi.
English: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.

tcz: Rome alhunkal nithum jouvin Paul in amuna Judah te lamkai ho chu akou khomin, “Sopite ho, Jerusalema eimanun, eiho mite leh ipu ipa teu chonna dan ima kasuhkhel lou vang'in Rome mite khut'a eipedoh un ahi.
en: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,
text:
ACT 28:17
Thadou: Rome alhunkal nithum jouvin Paul in amuna Judah te lamkai ho chu akou khomin, “Sopite ho, Jerusalema eimanun, eiho mite leh ipu ipa teu chonna dan ima kasuhkhel lou vang'in Rome mite khut'a eipedoh un ahi.
English: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,

tcz: Rome ten kachung thu akholun thina changei ding themmona ima amudoh lou jeh un lhadoh ding in eigong un ahi.
en: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.
text:
ACT 28:18
Thadou: Rome ten kachung thu akholun thina changei ding themmona ima amudoh lou jeh un lhadoh ding in eigong un ahi.
English: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.

tcz: Ahin hiche thulhuhna chu Judah vaipo hon adoudalun ahi, hijeh a chu kamite themmo chansah nomhih jong leng Caesar in kachung thu atan ding chu ngaikhoh kasah ahitai.
en: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.
text:
ACT 28:19
Thadou: Ahin hiche thulhuhna chu Judah vaipo hon adoudalun ahi, hijeh a chu kamite themmo chansah nomhih jong leng Caesar in kachung thu atan ding chu ngaikhoh kasah ahitai.
English: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.

tcz: Tunia nangho kahin koukhom lona chu ikihoulim khomuva, chule Israel te kinepna Messiah chu ahung taiti katahsan jeh a kihen kahina thu kahil chen nomu ahi,” ati.
en: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”
text:
ACT 28:20
Thadou: Tunia nangho kahin koukhom lona chu ikihoulim khomuva, chule Israel te kinepna Messiah chu ahung taiti katahsan jeh a kihen kahina thu kahil chen nomu ahi,” ati.
English: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”

tcz: Chuin amahon adonbut un “Judea gam'a konin lekhathot kamu pouvin, chule ahung holah a konin jong nangma hehset na thu ima kaja pouve.
en: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.
text:
ACT 28:21
Thadou: Chuin amahon adonbut un “Judea gam'a konin lekhathot kamu pouvin, chule ahung holah a konin jong nangma hehset na thu ima kaja pouve.
English: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.

tcz: Ahin keihon jong natahsan thudol chu kahet chet nomuve ajeh chu hiche thudol kisei na mun jousea akiseiset na thubou kaja jiuve,” atiuvin ahi.
en: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”
text:
ACT 28:22
Thadou: Ahin keihon jong natahsan thudol chu kahet chet nomuve ajeh chu hiche thudol kisei na mun jousea akiseiset na thubou kaja jiuve,” atiuvin ahi.
English: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”

tcz: Chuin phat akitemun, aphat tep nikhou chun mitamtah Paul umna'a chun ahung khomuvin ahi. Chuin Paul in Pathen lenggam thu ahilin miho tamtah chu Pathen lekhabua konin Yeshua thudol ah ajoltan ahi. Hiti chun jingkah a pat nilhah geiyin Mose danthu le themgao lekhabua konin ahoulim in ahi.
en: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.
text:
ACT 28:23
Thadou: Chuin phat akitemun, aphat tep nikhou chun mitamtah Paul umna'a chun ahung khomuvin ahi. Chuin Paul in Pathen lenggam thu ahilin miho tamtah chu Pathen lekhabua konin Yeshua thudol ah ajoltan ahi. Hiti chun jingkah a pat nilhah geiyin Mose danthu le themgao lekhabua konin ahoulim in ahi.
English: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.

tcz: Chuin mi phabep in athuhil chu ajop un, konkhat in atahsan pouvin ahi.
en: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.
text:
ACT 28:24
Thadou: Chuin mi phabep in athuhil chu ajop un, konkhat in atahsan pouvin ahi.
English: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

tcz: Chuin amaho le amaho suhnel tounel akitho jouvun hiche thuhi Paul koma konin achainan angaiyun ache tauvin ahi. Hiche athu ngaiyu chu hiche hi ahi: “Lhagao Theng in napu'u Isaiah henga ana phondoh thu chu adih ahi.
en: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,
text:
ACT 28:25
Thadou: Chuin amaho le amaho suhnel tounel akitho jouvun hiche thuhi Paul koma konin achainan angaiyun ache tauvin ahi. Hiche athu ngaiyu chu hiche hi ahi: “Lhagao Theng in napu'u Isaiah henga ana phondoh thu chu adih ahi.
English: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,

tcz: ‘Hiche mite koma khun chen lang gasei tan, kathusei hi najah tengule ipi kiseina ham nahet lou dingu, kathilbol namu tengule ipi kabol nahetthei lou dingu ahi.
en: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.
text:
ACT 28:26
Thadou: ‘Hiche mite koma khun chen lang gasei tan, kathusei hi najah tengule ipi kiseina ham nahet lou dingu, kathilbol namu tengule ipi kabol nahetthei lou dingu ahi.
English: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.

tcz: Ajeh chu hiche mite lungthim hi atah dentan, chule anakol uvin kho ajapon, chule amit'u asing tauvin ahi. Hijeh a chu amit uvin amuthei hih a, chule anakoluvin ajah theilou, chule alungthim uvin jong ahethem thei hih un, keima suhdam dingin jong kahenga ahung kihei thei tapouve,’
en: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’
text:
ACT 28:27
Thadou: Ajeh chu hiche mite lungthim hi atah dentan, chule anakol uvin kho ajapon, chule amit'u asing tauvin ahi. Hijeh a chu amit uvin amuthei hih a, chule anakoluvin ajah theilou, chule alungthim uvin jong ahethem thei hih un, keima suhdam dingin jong kahenga ahung kihei thei tapouve,’
English: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’

tcz: Hijeh chun hiche thuhi nanghon jong nahet diu kadei ahi, Pathen'a kona huhhing na thuhi chidang namdang te henga jong kipe ahin chule amahon jong asanu ahitai,” ati.
en: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”
text:
ACT 28:28
Thadou: Hijeh chun hiche thuhi nanghon jong nahet diu kadei ahi, Pathen'a kona huhhing na thuhi chidang namdang te henga jong kipe ahin chule amahon jong asanu ahitai,” ati.
English: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”

tcz: Aman hiche thuho aseijou chun, Juda hon adalhauvin, chule amaho le amaho akihanel lheh jeng tauve.
en: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.
text:
ACT 28:29
Thadou: Aman hiche thuho aseijou chun, Juda hon adalhauvin, chule amaho le amaho akihanel lheh jeng tauve.
English: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.

tcz: Chujou kumni sung chun Paul in ama sumin insan man akipeh in Rome ah achengin ama vila che jouse chu analemin,
en: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,
text:
ACT 28:30
Thadou: Chujou kumni sung chun Paul in ama sumin insan man akipeh in Rome ah achengin ama vila che jouse chu analemin,
English: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,

tcz: Chuti chun hangsan tah in Pathen Lenggam thudol asam phonglen, chule Pakai Yeshua Christa thudol chu ahil len koi machan ana kham tang joupon ahi.
en: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.
text:
ACT 28:31
Thadou: Chuti chun hangsan tah in Pathen Lenggam thudol asam phonglen, chule Pakai Yeshua Christa thudol chu ahil len koi machan ana kham tang joupon ahi.
English: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Christa Yeshua soh, solchah hidinga Pathen lhendoh, Ama Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga kisoldoh, Paul'a kon ahi:
en: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,
text:
ROM 1:1
Thadou: Hiche lekhathot hi Christa Yeshua soh, solchah hidinga Pathen lhendoh, Ama Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga kisoldoh, Paul'a kon ahi:
English: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

tcz: Hiche Kipana Thupha malaipeh'a Pathen in Lekhabu thenga a-Themgao ho ana thutepsa,
en: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,
text:
ROM 1:2
Thadou: Hiche Kipana Thupha malaipeh'a Pathen in Lekhabu thenga a-Themgao ho ana thutepsa,
