English: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,

tcz: Kipana Thuphahi Achapa thudol ahi. Ama chu leiset ahinkho'a Leng David insunga ana penga ahi,
en: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,
text:
ROM 1:3
Thadou: Kipana Thuphahi Achapa thudol ahi. Ama chu leiset ahinkho'a Leng David insunga ana penga ahi,
English: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,

tcz: Chule Ama chu Lhagaotheng thahat'a athilah a kona kaithouva aum chun, Pathen Chapa chu avetsah tai. Ama Yeshua Christa i-Pakaiyu chu ahi.
en: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,
text:
ROM 1:4
Thadou: Chule Ama chu Lhagaotheng thahat'a athilah a kona kaithouva aum chun, Pathen Chapa chu avetsah tai. Ama Yeshua Christa i-Pakaiyu chu ahi.
English: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

tcz: Christa jal'a Pathen in solchah hina chanpha le thuneina eipeh uhi muntina chidang namdangte, Pathen in abolpeh-u seipeh a, amahon atahsanuva chule seingai ahi diu chu Amin loupina ding ahiye.
en: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;

tcz: Chule nangho jong Yeshua Christa a dinga hiche chidang namdang akikou ho lah a napan'u ahitai.
en: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;

tcz: Rome khopia um Pathen ngailu ho chule Ama mithengte hiding a kikouho jouse dinga jih a kahi.
en: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text:
ROM 1:7
Thadou: Rome khopia um Pathen ngailu ho chule Ama mithengte hiding a kikouho jouse dinga jih a kahi.
English: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Keiman nangho jouse henga kasei masah nom chu, keiman Ka Pathen chu Yeshua Christa jal'in kathangvah-e, ajehchu Ama natahsanu thu chu vannoi mun jousea kisei ahitai.
en: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.
text:
ROM 1:8
Thadou: Keiman nangho jouse henga kasei masah nom chu, keiman Ka Pathen chu Yeshua Christa jal'in kathangvah-e, ajehchu Ama natahsanu thu chu vannoi mun jousea kisei ahitai.
English: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

tcz: Keima nangho dinga taojom jinga kahi hi Pathen ahetoh ahi. Sun le jan'in kalung pumpia a-Chapa Kipana Thupha seiphonga kapanna ahin, nangho le nangaichat-u thudol'a Pathen henga taova kahi.
en: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,
text:
ROM 1:9
Thadou: Keima nangho dinga taojom jinga kahi hi Pathen ahetoh ahi. Sun le jan'in kalung pumpia a-Chapa Kipana Thupha seiphonga kapanna ahin, nangho le nangaichat-u thudol'a Pathen henga taova kahi.
English: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

tcz: Kataona ajeh pipen khat chu, Pathen phatsah a phat kijenpet kamua, nangho achaina pena hung mu noma kahi hi ahi.
en: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
text:
ROM 1:10
Thadou: Kataona ajeh pipen khat chu, Pathen phatsah a phat kijenpet kamua, nangho achaina pena hung mu noma kahi hi ahi.
English: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

tcz: Ajehchu keiman nangho hungvil kanop'a chutia chu nangho Pakaiya nahatdoh theina dinguva kithopia Lhagao thilpeh hungpeh ding kati nahiuve.
en: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;

tcz: Eiho ikikhop khom tenguleh, keiman natahsan nauva tilkhou ding kanom'in, chule nanghoa kona jong kitilkhou ding kakinemin ahi.
en: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.
text:
ROM 1:12
Thadou: Eiho ikikhop khom tenguleh, keiman natahsan nauva tilkhou ding kanom'in, chule nanghoa kona jong kitilkhou ding kakinemin ahi.
English: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, nangho hungvil ding tamtahvei kana gongin, hinla tuchan hin eisumo aum jinge. Keiman chidang namdang mi adanghoa kon'a kamu tobang'in, nangho lah a jong toh'a chule Lhagao ga mu kanom'e.
en: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.
text:
ROM 1:13
Thadou: Sopi deitahte, nangho hungvil ding tamtahvei kana gongin, hinla tuchan hin eisumo aum jinge. Keiman chidang namdang mi adanghoa kon'a kamu tobang'in, nangho lah a jong toh'a chule Lhagao ga mu kanom'e.
English: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

tcz: Keiman khantouna vannoi leiset miho umna mun'a hihen, mun danga lekhathem le athemlou lah hijongle mopohna lentah neiyin kakigel'e.
en: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.
text:
ROM 1:14
Thadou: Keiman khantouna vannoi leiset miho umna mun'a hihen, mun danga lekhathem le athemlou lah hijongle mopohna lentah neiyin kakigel'e.
English: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.

tcz: Hiti chun, keima jong Rome khopia nangho henga hunga Kipana Thupha seiphong ding kanom'e.
en: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.
text:
ROM 1:15
Thadou: Hiti chun, keima jong Rome khopia nangho henga hunga Kipana Thupha seiphong ding kanom'e.
English: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

tcz: Ajehchu, keima hiche Christa Kipana Thupha chung chang thua hin kajah achapoi. Hichea hi Pathen thahat in na atoh a, atahsan chan chu ahuhhing ahi; Judahte masa ding chule chidang namdangte jong hiding ahi.
en: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.
text:
ROM 1:16
Thadou: Ajehchu, keima hiche Christa Kipana Thupha chung chang thua hin kajah achapoi. Hichea hi Pathen thahat in na atoh a, atahsan chan chu ahuhhing ahi; Judahte masa ding chule chidang namdangte jong hiding ahi.
English: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

tcz: Hiche Kipana Thupha hin Pathen in amitmua iti chonpha eisemu ham ti eihiluve. Hiche hi akipat'a pat achaina gei tahsan jal ahi. Pathen thubun asei dung juiyin, “Tahsan vanga michonpha chun hinna anei ahi,” kitia ahi.
en: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”
text:
ROM 1:17
Thadou: Hiche Kipana Thupha hin Pathen in amitmua iti chonpha eisemu ham ti eihiluve. Hiche hi akipat'a pat achaina gei tahsan jal ahi. Pathen thubun asei dung juiyin, “Tahsan vanga michonpha chun hinna anei ahi,” kitia ahi.
English: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”

tcz: Ahin Pathen in michonse, migilou agitlou nauva thutah sunem ho dou dingin, alunghanna Van'a kon'in ahin vetsah in ahi.
en: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,
text:
ROM 1:18
Thadou: Ahin Pathen in michonse, migilou agitlou nauva thutah sunem ho dou dingin, alunghanna Van'a kon'in ahin vetsah in ahi.
English: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

tcz: Amahon Pathen thudol thutah chu aheuve, ajehchu Aman amaho ahetsah masah ahitai.
en: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.
text:
ROM 1:19
Thadou: Amahon Pathen thudol thutah chu aheuve, ajehchu Aman amaho ahetsah masah ahitai.
English: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.

tcz: Ajehchu vannoi kisema pat mihon leiset le van amu'uve. Pathen in athilsem jousea kon hin, Ama mutheilou ahina gunneina ho kichentah in amuuvin, tonsot athaneina le Pathen ahina chonna ho geiya ahet'u ahi. Hitichun, Pathen ahetlou jeh uva them achanna dingu aumpoi.
en: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.
text:
ROM 1:20
Thadou: Ajehchu vannoi kisema pat mihon leiset le van amu'uve. Pathen in athilsem jousea kon hin, Ama mutheilou ahina gunneina ho kichentah in amuuvin, tonsot athaneina le Pathen ahina chonna ho geiya ahet'u ahi. Hitichun, Pathen ahetlou jeh uva them achanna dingu aumpoi.
English: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.

tcz: Ahin, amahon Pathen aheuve, hinlah amahon Pathen houvin ahou nom pouve, ahilouleh thangvahna apenom pouve. Chule amahon alunggel uva Pathen chu itobang ahidem ti ngolhoi lunggel aneiyuve. Hitichun, alung gelu athi'in chule alungu anohphah dentai.
en: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.
text:
ROM 1:21
Thadou: Ahin, amahon Pathen aheuve, hinlah amahon Pathen houvin ahou nom pouve, ahilouleh thangvahna apenom pouve. Chule amahon alunggel uva Pathen chu itobang ahidem ti ngolhoi lunggel aneiyuve. Hitichun, alung gelu athi'in chule alungu anohphah dentai.
English: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.

tcz: Ching tah a akiseinau chun angolsah gamu ahitai.
en: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
text:
ROM 1:22
Thadou: Ching tah a akiseinau chun angolsah gamu ahitai.
English: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

tcz: Chule loupitah tonsot'a hing jing Pathen hou louvin, amahon semthu, mihem le vacha, ganhing le a-oma kithola limho asemun ahou-uve.
en: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.
text:
ROM 1:23
Thadou: Chule loupitah tonsot'a hing jing Pathen hou louvin, amahon semthu, mihem le vacha, ganhing le a-oma kithola limho asemun ahou-uve.
English: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.

tcz: Hitichun, Pathen in amaho chu alung ngaichat-u dungjuiya jachat umtah boldoh dinga anungsun ahitai. Hichea kona chu, khat'in khat chunga atibah-u chu abol diuva, thenlouna lama apehdoh ahitai.
en: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;

tcz: Amahon Pathen dihtah chu kiveinan, jouvin alheng tauve. Hitichun, amahon Asempau tah chu hou sangin, Pathen thilsemsa chu ahou'un chule ajen'ui, Ama chula tonsot'a vahchoi dinga lomtah ahi, Amen.
en: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
text:
ROM 1:25
Thadou: Amahon Pathen dihtah chu kiveinan, jouvin alheng tauve. Hitichun, amahon Asempau tah chu hou sangin, Pathen thilsemsa chu ahou'un chule ajen'ui, Ama chula tonsot'a vahchoi dinga lomtah ahi, Amen.
English: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

tcz: Hijeh chun, Pathen in amaho chu ajachatnau lung ngaichat uva chu anungsun ahitai. Numei ho jeng jong angai dola kitimatna tibah aneiyu chu akale lamin amangchauvin, numei le numei kitimat nom'in, kingaichaton aum gamtauve.
en: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.
text:
ROM 1:26
Thadou: Hijeh chun, Pathen in amaho chu ajachatnau lung ngaichat uva chu anungsun ahitai. Numei ho jeng jong angai dola kitimatna tibah aneiyu chu akale lamin amangchauvin, numei le numei kitimat nom'in, kingaichaton aum gamtauve.
English: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

tcz: Chule Pasal ho jong numeito kingaichat tona neija lupkhomgo talouvin, pasal chun pasal akichenpi chu ngaichat nan adimun ahi. Pasal in a-pasal chanpi chunga jachat umtah abol'un, chutichun, hiche chonset boljeh hin, amahon tahsa chunga gimna achandiu dol cheh akimu'un ahi.
en: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.
text:
ROM 1:27
Thadou: Chule Pasal ho jong numeito kingaichat tona neija lupkhomgo talouvin, pasal chun pasal akichenpi chu ngaichat nan adimun ahi. Pasal in a-pasal chanpi chunga jachat umtah abol'un, chutichun, hiche chonset boljeh hin, amahon tahsa chunga gimna achandiu dol cheh akimu'un ahi.
English: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

tcz: Amahon Pathen phondoh ding ngolhoija ageljeh un, aman amaho angolnau lunggel chu donlouva akoiya chule amaho chun abollou beh dingu abolu ahitai.
en: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

tcz: Ahinkho man'u chu, gitlouna tincheng, chonset, kiloset, mithetbol, milop, mitha, kidou-kinah, kiduhabol, dou lungput, chule kiseiset abol'ui.
en: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,
text:
ROM 1:29
Thadou: Ahinkho man'u chu, gitlouna tincheng, chonset, kiloset, mithetbol, milop, mitha, kidou-kinah, kiduhabol, dou lungput, chule kiseiset abol'ui.
English: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

tcz: Amaho nunglama kona misunji ahiuvin, Pathen ahotbol'un, giloutah, kiletsahtah chule ham hoithoa ahiuve. Amahon chonset thah alamdoh uvin, chule amaho anuleh apateu thua nunglou ahiuve.
en: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
text:
ROM 1:30
Thadou: Amaho nunglama kona misunji ahiuvin, Pathen ahotbol'un, giloutah, kiletsahtah chule ham hoithoa ahiuve. Amahon chonset thah alamdoh uvin, chule amaho anuleh apateu thua nunglou ahiuve.
English: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

tcz: Hetna neiding ago pouvin, akitep nau sukeh a ahiuvin, lungthim bei ahiuvin, chule hepina neilou ahiuve.
en: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

tcz: Amahon Pathen thutan dihna chun hitobang bol ho chu thi dinga lom ahiuve ti aheuvin, hinla aboltei tei uve. Akhohcheh chu, amahon midang chu chutobang bol ding'in atilkhou'un ahi.
en: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.
text:
ROM 1:32
Thadou: Amahon Pathen thutan dihna chun hitobang bol ho chu thi dinga lom ahiuve ti aheuvin, hinla aboltei tei uve. Akhohcheh chu, amahon midang chu chutobang bol ding'in atilkhou'un ahi.
English: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

tcz: Nangman hitobang miho chu themmo chan theiya lom ahi nati; hinla nangma tah hitobang maa chu phalouva nahi, hichea hin them nachanna ding aumpoi. Nangman amaho agilou le gimbolna chang dinga lom ahiuve, natina a chu nangma tah kithemmo chan nahitai. Ajeh chu, nangma midang thutan'a panga chun hitobangma chu nabol'in ahi.
en: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.
text:
ROM 2:1
Thadou: Nangman hitobang miho chu themmo chan theiya lom ahi nati; hinla nangma tah hitobang maa chu phalouva nahi, hichea hin them nachanna ding aumpoi. Nangman amaho agilou le gimbolna chang dinga lom ahiuve, natina a chu nangma tah kithemmo chan nahitai. Ajeh chu, nangma midang thutan'a panga chun hitobangma chu nabol'in ahi.
English: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

tcz: Chule eima hon Pathen Thutandih ahinaa chutobang bol ho chu koi hijongleh achungthu atanding ahi, ti iheuve.
en: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.
text:
ROM 2:2
Thadou: Chule eima hon Pathen Thutandih ahinaa chutobang bol ho chu koi hijongleh achungthu atanding ahi, ti iheuve.
English: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

tcz: Nangman midang hochu hiche ho aboljeh'uva athu-u natan'a ahileh, chutobang ma a nangman nabol jeh a Pathen in nachung thu atan dinga kon'in hoidoh nange tia nakigel ham?
en: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?
text:
ROM 2:3
Thadou: Nangman midang hochu hiche ho aboljeh'uva athu-u natan'a ahileh, chutobang ma a nangman nabol jeh a Pathen in nachung thu atan dinga kon'in hoidoh nange tia nakigel ham?
English: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

tcz: Nangman Pathen itobang tah a nachunga lungset them, thohhat le lung dehat hiya ham tihi hedoh louva nahim? Hichehi, ima hilouva nagel nahlai ham? Nangman hitobang lungsetna hi nachonset lung khelna ding ahi, ti mudoh loulai nahim?
en: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?
text:
ROM 2:4
Thadou: Nangman Pathen itobang tah a nachunga lungset them, thohhat le lung dehat hiya ham tihi hedoh louva nahim? Hichehi, ima hilouva nagel nahlai ham? Nangman hitobang lungsetna hi nachonset lung khelna ding ahi, ti mudoh loulai nahim?
English: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

tcz: Hinlah nangma nalungtah a, chule nachonsetna kona nalung nahei louva ahileh, nangman lunghanna chu nakikhol khom ahitai. Ajehchu, Pathen thutan dihna alunghanna nikho chu hung lhung ding ahiye.
en: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,
text:
ROM 2:5
Thadou: Hinlah nangma nalungtah a, chule nachonsetna kona nalung nahei louva ahileh, nangman lunghanna chu nakikhol khom ahitai. Ajehchu, Pathen thutan dihna alunghanna nikho chu hung lhung ding ahiye.
English: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,

tcz: Pathen in amichang cheh chu athilbol totoh'a athu-u atan ding ahinalaiye.
en: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”
text:
ROM 2:6
Thadou: Pathen in amichang cheh chu athilbol totoh'a athu-u atan ding ahinalaiye.
English: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”

tcz: Aman thilpha bol'a pontho a lungdehat ho, chule loupina le jabolna chule thithei louna Pathen in agonpeh holjing ho, chu tonsot hinna apeh ding ahi.
en: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

tcz: Ahivangin, Aman kichang khohsah a kichamsah ho, thutah thua nunglou ho chule chonphatlou thua nung ho chu achunguva alungsatna le alunghanna chuding ahi.
en: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
text:
ROM 2:8
Thadou: Ahivangin, Aman kichang khohsah a kichamsah ho, thutah thua nunglou ho chule chonphatlou thua nung ho chu achunguva alungsatna le alunghanna chuding ahi.
English: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,

tcz: Thilse bol miho chunga chu hesoh genthei le lungdonna khohtah chu amasa a Judah mite chunga chua chule aban'a chidang namdangte chunga lhung ding ahi.
en: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
text:
ROM 2:9
Thadou: Thilse bol miho chunga chu hesoh genthei le lungdonna khohtah chu amasa a Judah mite chunga chua chule aban'a chidang namdangte chunga lhung ding ahi.
English: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

tcz: Hinlah thilpha bol ho jouse chunga chu loupina le jabolna chule cham-lungmonna chu Pathen'a kon'a hung ding ahi, Judah mite masan tin chule chidang namdang ho hiding ahi.
en: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
text:
ROM 2:10
Thadou: Hinlah thilpha bol ho jouse chunga chu loupina le jabolna chule cham-lungmonna chu Pathen'a kon'a hung ding ahi, Judah mite masan tin chule chidang namdang ho hiding ahi.
English: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen hin maipha avepoi.
en: For there is no partiality with God.
text:
ROM 2:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen hin maipha avepoi.
English: For there is no partiality with God.

tcz: Chidang namdangte chu achonset tenguleh Pathen Danthu kijih aneilou'u ahi vang'in, Danthu beiya kisumang ding ahiuve. Chule Judah mite Pathen Danthu neiho chu hiche Dan thu ajui lou nauva chu athu-u kitan ding ahi.
en: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.
text:
ROM 2:12
Thadou: Chidang namdangte chu achonset tenguleh Pathen Danthu kijih aneilou'u ahi vang'in, Danthu beiya kisumang ding ahiuve. Chule Judah mite Pathen Danthu neiho chu hiche Dan thu ajui lou nauva chu athu-u kitan ding ahi.
English: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

tcz: Ajeh chu Danthu moh ngailhah mai mai hin Pathen themchanna eisodoh peh dingu ahipoi. Danthu jui'a bolteho bou chu Amit mua chonpha eihisah dingu ahibouve.
en: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
text:
ROM 2:13
Thadou: Ajeh chu Danthu moh ngailhah mai mai hin Pathen themchanna eisodoh peh dingu ahipoi. Danthu jui'a bolteho bou chu Amit mua chonpha eihisah dingu ahibouve.
English: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

tcz: Pathen Danthu kijih neilou chidang namdangte jeng'in bon apenpiu a-lungthim'u Danthua anungun, Danthu ajahkhahlou vang'un, amaho le amahon Danthu akisem'un ahi.
en: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,
text:
ROM 2:14
Thadou: Pathen Danthu kijih neilou chidang namdangte jeng'in bon apenpiu a-lungthim'u Danthua anungun, Danthu ajahkhahlou vang'un, amaho le amahon Danthu akisem'un ahi.
English: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

tcz: Amahon alung sunguva Danthu natoh kisim ahi chu asulang'un ahi, ajehchu selepha hetna alungthimun ahettohsah-u ahi. Chutichun, amaho le amaho lunggel chun themmo sahna ahilouleh them chansahna aumsah uvin ahi.
en: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)
text:
ROM 2:15
Thadou: Amahon alung sunguva Danthu natoh kisim ahi chu asulang'un ahi, ajehchu selepha hetna alungthimun ahettohsah-u ahi. Chutichun, amaho le amaho lunggel chun themmo sahna ahilouleh them chansahna aumsah uvin ahi.
English: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

tcz: Chule thuhil kiseiphong le chu hiche hi ahi; Pathen in Yeshua Christa amanchah a, amichang cheh hinkho thuguh atanding nikho chu hung um ding ahi.
en: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.
text:
ROM 2:16
Thadou: Chule thuhil kiseiphong le chu hiche hi ahi; Pathen in Yeshua Christa amanchah a, amichang cheh hinkho thuguh atanding nikho chu hung um ding ahi.
English: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

tcz: Nangho Judah mia kiseiya Pathen Danthua kinem nahiuvin, chule Amatoh kiguijopna phatah neija kisonna nei nahiuve.
en: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,
text:
ROM 2:17
Thadou: Nangho Judah mia kiseiya Pathen Danthua kinem nahiuvin, chule Amatoh kiguijopna phatah neija kisonna nei nahiuve.
English: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,

tcz: Alungdeilam naheuvin, Adanthua kihil'a nahi jeh uva, adih ipi ahi chu nahet-u ahitai.
en: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
text:
ROM 2:18
Thadou: Alungdeilam naheuvin, Adanthua kihil'a nahi jeh uva, adih ipi ahi chu nahet-u ahitai.
English: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

tcz: Nangma mitcho lamhil'a panga chule muthim lah a lamvaiho khomusah dinga kigel'a nahi.
en: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
text:
ROM 2:19
Thadou: Nangma mitcho lamhil'a panga chule muthim lah a lamvaiho khomusah dinga kigel'a nahi.
English: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

tcz: Nangman michinglou ho chihsah a chule chapang ho Pathen henglam jotna hiltheiya kigel'ah nahi. Ajeh chu Pathen Danthu hetna bulhingset le thutah hetna neiyin nakingaiton ahi.
en: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.
text:
ROM 2:20
Thadou: Nangman michinglou ho chihsah a chule chapang ho Pathen henglam jotna hiltheiya kigel'ah nahi. Ajeh chu Pathen Danthu hetna bulhingset le thutah hetna neiyin nakingaiton ahi.
English: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

tcz: Chuti ahileh midang hil'ah nangma, nangma tah kihil louva nahim? Nangman midang guhchat louding natia nangman naguhji ham?
en: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
text:
ROM 2:21
Thadou: Chuti ahileh midang hil'ah nangma, nangma tah kihil louva nahim? Nangman midang guhchat louding natia nangman naguhji ham?
English: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

tcz: Nangman jonbol adihpoi natia, hinla nangman jon nabol em? Nangman milim hou themmo nachan'a, hinla nangman milim houna kon'a kigudoh thil ho namanchah em?
en: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
text:
ROM 2:22
Thadou: Nangman jonbol adihpoi natia, hinla nangman jon nabol em? Nangman milim hou themmo nachan'a, hinla nangman milim houna kon'a kigudoh thil ho namanchah em?
English: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

tcz: Nangman Danthu nahet nakiletsahpi lheh jengin, hinla, nangman Danthu napalkeh jeh in Pathen jalou nahi.
en: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?
text:
ROM 2:23
Thadou: Nangman Danthu nahet nakiletsahpi lheh jengin, hinla, nangman Danthu napalkeh jeh in Pathen jalou nahi.
English: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?

tcz: Pathen thun asei, “Nangho jeh in chidang namdang hon Pathen min ataitomuve,” kiti hi datmo hih un.
en: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.
text:
ROM 2:24
Thadou: Pathen thun asei, “Nangho jeh in chidang namdang hon Pathen min ataitomuve,” kiti hi datmo hih un.
English: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.

tcz: Judah mite chonna ngai cheptan hi Pathen Danthu ahi tia najui lebou naphatchompi ding ahi. Hinlah nangman Pathen Danthu chu najui louva ahileh cheptanlou chidang namdang ho sanga naphat chompina joh aum dehpoi.
en: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
text:
ROM 2:25
Thadou: Judah mite chonna ngai cheptan hi Pathen Danthu ahi tia najui lebou naphatchompi ding ahi. Hinlah nangman Pathen Danthu chu najui louva ahileh cheptanlou chidang namdang ho sanga naphat chompina joh aum dehpoi.
English: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

tcz: Chule chidang namdang ho chun Pathen Danthu ajuiyuva ahileh Pathen in amaho chu Amitea aphondoh lou dingu ham?
en: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?
text:
ROM 2:26
Thadou: Chule chidang namdang ho chun Pathen Danthu ajuiyuva ahileh Pathen in amaho chu Amitea aphondoh lou dingu ham?
English: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

tcz: Tahbeh mongin, cheptan louchidang namdang Pathen Danthu juiho chun nangho Judah mi cheptanho chule Pathen Danthu neiho hijongleu chun najuilounau chun themmo nahin chanlou ding'u ham?
en: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?
text:
ROM 2:27
Thadou: Tahbeh mongin, cheptan louchidang namdang Pathen Danthu juiho chun nangho Judah mi cheptanho chule Pathen Danthu neiho hijongleu chun najuilounau chun themmo nahin chanlou ding'u ham?
English: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

tcz: Ajeh chu nangma Judah mi hina atahbeh chu nule pa akon'a peng nahi jeh, ahilouleh cheptan chonna chu najui jeh a nahi ahipoi.
en: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

tcz: Judah mi tahbeh chu alung put Pathen mitvet'a dih a ahije. Chule cheptan dihtah jong chu Danthu kijih jui mai mai chu ahipoi. Chusangin, Pathen Lhagaova kon'a alunggel kikhel na ahinsodoh ahibouve. Chule alunggel kikhel chun miho pachat ding hollouvin, Pathen vahchoina asoding chu aholjoh ding ahi.
en: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.
text:
ROM 2:29
Thadou: Judah mi tahbeh chu alung put Pathen mitvet'a dih a ahije. Chule cheptan dihtah jong chu Danthu kijih jui mai mai chu ahipoi. Chusangin, Pathen Lhagaova kon'a alunggel kikhel na ahinsodoh ahibouve. Chule alunggel kikhel chun miho pachat ding hollouvin, Pathen vahchoina asoding chu aholjoh ding ahi.
English: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

tcz: Achutileh Judah mikhat hina ipia phachom ham? Cheptan chondan juijong apanna um hinam?
en: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?
text:
ROM 3:1
Thadou: Achutileh Judah mikhat hina ipia phachom ham? Cheptan chondan juijong apanna um hinam?
English: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

tcz: Henge, aphatchomna ho atam'e. Amasapen'in, Pathen thu kiphongdoh hi aboncha Judah mite kinganseuva ahi.
en: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.
text:
ROM 3:2
Thadou: Henge, aphatchomna ho atam'e. Amasapen'in, Pathen thu kiphongdoh hi aboncha Judah mite kinganseuva ahi.
English: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.

tcz: Ahinai, amaho phabep tahsan thejin aumpouve, hinla amaho tahsan theija aumlou nauva Pathen chu tahsan umlou kisohthei ahisah ham?
en: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?
text:
ROM 3:3
Thadou: Ahinai, amaho phabep tahsan thejin aumpouve, hinla amaho tahsan theija aumlou nauva Pathen chu tahsan umlou kisohthei ahisah ham?
English: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

tcz: Chuti thei ponte, amichang cheh jousei hijeng jongleu, Pathen adih-e, Pathen lekhabun ama chung chang thua, “Nangma na-thuseija chu nadihna photchetna umding, chule thutanna mun'a jong najo ding ahi” ati.
en: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”
text:
ROM 3:4
Thadou: Chuti thei ponte, amichang cheh jousei hijeng jongleu, Pathen adih-e, Pathen lekhabun ama chung chang thua, “Nangma na-thuseija chu nadihna photchetna umding, chule thutanna mun'a jong najo ding ahi” ati.
English: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”

tcz: Hinlah, mi koitobang khat touvin sei inte, “Eiho i-chonsetnau hin phatna lunggel asoi, ajehchu, hiche hin miho chu Pathen ichan geiya chonpha hitam ti amu dohsah ahi,” atiuve. Chuti ahileh Aman eigimbol tenguleh aphatmona umem? (Hichehi mihem hina lunggel kisei ahi).
en: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.
text:
ROM 3:5
Thadou: Hinlah, mi koitobang khat touvin sei inte, “Eiho i-chonsetnau hin phatna lunggel asoi, ajehchu, hiche hin miho chu Pathen ichan geiya chonpha hitam ti amu dohsah ahi,” atiuve. Chuti ahileh Aman eigimbol tenguleh aphatmona umem? (Hichehi mihem hina lunggel kisei ahi).
English: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

tcz: Chuti ponte! Pathen hin adih chu abollou hitaleh, iti chu vannoi thutan'a pang thei ding ham?
en: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?
text:
ROM 3:6
Thadou: Chuti ponte! Pathen hin adih chu abollou hitaleh, iti chu vannoi thutan'a pang thei ding ham?
English: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

tcz: Hinlah mi phabep khattouvin, “Itia Pathen in chonse tiathemmo eichan ding ham? Ajehchu keima lungthen lounan Ama kitahna le Aloupina aphondoh cheh lou ding ham?” tiuvinte.
en: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?
text:
ROM 3:7
Thadou: Hinlah mi phabep khattouvin, “Itia Pathen in chonse tiathemmo eichan ding ham? Ajehchu keima lungthen lounan Ama kitahna le Aloupina aphondoh cheh lou ding ham?” tiuvinte.
English: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

tcz: Chule mi phabep ho chun taipongnain, “Iha chonset cheh uleh aphatna aumjoi tin naseiuve,” eitiuvinte. Hitobanga thusei hochu themmo chansah ding dol ahiuve.
en: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.
text:
ROM 3:8
Thadou: Chule mi phabep ho chun taipongnain, “Iha chonset cheh uleh aphatna aumjoi tin naseiuve,” eitiuvinte. Hitobanga thusei hochu themmo chansah ding dol ahiuve.
English: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.

tcz: Chuti ahileh eiho Juda mite hi midang ho sangin iphajouve tia thulhuhna ibol dingu hitam? Chuti theiponte, ajehchu eihon mijouse, Judah mi hihen chidang namdang mi hijongleh, chonset thaneina noiya uma ihi tauve, tia iphondoh-u ahitai.
en: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.
text:
ROM 3:9
Thadou: Chuti ahileh eiho Juda mite hi midang ho sangin iphajouve tia thulhuhna ibol dingu hitam? Chuti theiponte, ajehchu eihon mijouse, Judah mi hihen chidang namdang mi hijongleh, chonset thaneina noiya uma ihi tauve, tia iphondoh-u ahitai.
English: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.

tcz: Pathen thubun asei dungjuiyin, “Koima michonpha aumpoi; khat jong aumpoi.
en: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.
text:
ROM 3:10
Thadou: Pathen thubun asei dungjuiyin, “Koima michonpha aumpoi; khat jong aumpoi.
English: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.

tcz: Koima aching tahbeh aumpoi. Koima Pathen hol aumpoi
en: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.
text:
ROM 3:11
Thadou: Koima aching tahbeh aumpoi. Koima Pathen hol aumpoi
English: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

tcz: Abonchauvin akiheimang tauve, abonun pannabei asohgam tauve. Koima apha bol'a aumpoi, khatcha jong aumpoi.”
en: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”
text:
ROM 3:12
Thadou: Abonchauvin akiheimang tauve, abonun pannabei asohgam tauve. Koima apha bol'a aumpoi, khatcha jong aumpoi.”
English: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”

tcz: Thumanlou aseiyun, lhankhuh kihong namse tobang ahiuvin ahi. Aleigui-u jouseinan adimset-un, anephu noijuva kon'in gulsegu ahung valhai.
en: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
text:
ROM 3:13
Thadou: Thumanlou aseiyun, lhankhuh kihong namse tobang ahiuvin ahi. Aleigui-u jouseinan adimset-un, anephu noijuva kon'in gulsegu ahung valhai.
English: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”

tcz: Akam'u jong gaosapna le thugilou seinan adimuve.
en: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”
text:
ROM 3:14
Thadou: Akam'u jong gaosapna le thugilou seinan adimuve.
English: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”

tcz: Mithana ding in akaljanguve.
en: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.
text:
ROM 3:15
Thadou: Mithana ding in akaljanguve.
English: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.

tcz: Mahthahna le lunggimnan ajui jinguve.
en: Destruction and misery are in their ways.
text:
ROM 3:16
Thadou: Mahthahna le lunggimnan ajui jinguve.
English: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

tcz: Lungmonna kimuna ding ahetapouve.
en: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”
text:
ROM 3:17
Thadou: Lungmonna kimuna ding ahetapouve.
English: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”

tcz: Amahon Pathen ginna tahbeh aneipouve.
en: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
text:
ROM 3:18
Thadou: Amahon Pathen ginna tahbeh aneipouve.
English: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

tcz: Gahsei jeng dingin Danthu chu akipehna ho a dingbou ahin, hiche Dan kipeh lona jeh chu miho athuphat louna dingu ahi. Chule vannoi pumpi Pathen masanga themmo ahiuve, ti vetsahna ding ahi.
en: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.
text:
ROM 3:19
Thadou: Gahsei jeng dingin Danthu chu akipehna ho a dingbou ahin, hiche Dan kipeh lona jeh chu miho athuphat louna dingu ahi. Chule vannoi pumpi Pathen masanga themmo ahiuve, ti vetsahna ding ahi.
English: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

tcz: Ajeh chu Danthupeh jui man'a koima themchang ding ahipoi. Danthu hin ichangeiya chonse ihiuvem ti bou eivetsah-u ahi.
en: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.
text:
ROM 3:20
Thadou: Ajeh chu Danthupeh jui man'a koima themchang ding ahipoi. Danthu hin ichangeiya chonse ihiuvem ti bou eivetsah-u ahi.
English: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

tcz: Hinlah tuvang hin Danthua hilouvin Pathen Lekhabua kona masangpeh a eiteppeh u, Pathen chonphatna hi eivetsah'u ahitai.
en: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

tcz: Eihon Yeshua Christa a itahsan nau ngaplhahna tahbeh ineijeh uva Pathen chonphatna chu chang ah ihitauve. Chule hichehi koi koi hijongleh atahsan jouse dinga ahin, koipen ihiuchu imacha akhohna umlou ahi.
en: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,
text:
ROM 3:22
Thadou: Eihon Yeshua Christa a itahsan nau ngaplhahna tahbeh ineijeh uva Pathen chonphatna chu chang ah ihitauve. Chule hichehi koi koi hijongleh atahsan jouse dinga ahin, koipen ihiuchu imacha akhohna umlou ahi.
English: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

tcz: Ajehchu amitakip chonsea ahitai, Pathen loupina chu changpha joulou ihitauve.
en: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

tcz: Hinlah, Pathen in ichan diuva lomlou khotona einei jal'uva, michonpha'a eiphondoh-u ahitai. Aman ichonset jeh uva themmo eichannauva kon'a Christa Yeshuan ei-chamlhatsah'u ahitai.
en: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,
text:
ROM 3:24
Thadou: Hinlah, Pathen in ichan diuva lomlou khotona einei jal'uva, michonpha'a eiphondoh-u ahitai. Aman ichonset jeh uva themmo eichannauva kon'a Christa Yeshuan ei-chamlhatsah'u ahitai.
English: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen in Yeshua chu chonset jeh a anakatdoh ahitai. Yeshuan ahinna ahung katdoh a, athisan asodoh chu Ama tahsanho Pathena chonphatna chu changdiu ahitai. Achesa phat masaho a anachonseho gimbolna chu penom louva alungdehat johhin Pathen thutan dihna atahlang ahi.
en: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

tcz: Ajehchu aman tupet'a ipi ahinbol doh ding chu agaldot ahi. Hichehi Pathen phatna le chondih ahinaa achonphatna vetsah dinga, michonsen Yeshua ahin tahsan teng amitmua achonpha tia aphondoh ahitai.
en: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.
text:
ROM 3:26
Thadou: Ajehchu aman tupet'a ipi ahinbol doh ding chu agaldot ahi. Hichehi Pathen phatna le chondih ahinaa achonphatna vetsah dinga, michonsen Yeshua ahin tahsan teng amitmua achonpha tia aphondoh ahitai.
English: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

tcz: Chuti ahileh eihon Pathen in eisan theina dinguva ikisonpi thei dingu tohdoh inei uvem? Aumpoi, ajehchu eiho them ichannau hi Danthu jui jal'a kon ahipoi, tahsan jal ahibouve.
en: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
text:
ROM 3:27
Thadou: Chuti ahileh eihon Pathen in eisan theina dinguva ikisonpi thei dingu tohdoh inei uvem? Aumpoi, ajehchu eiho them ichannau hi Danthu jui jal'a kon ahipoi, tahsan jal ahibouve.
English: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

tcz: Hitijeh hin, eiho Pathen to ikichamu hi tahsan jal ahi, Danthu jui jal ahipoi.
en: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
text:
ROM 3:28
Thadou: Hitijeh hin, eiho Pathen to ikichamu hi tahsan jal ahi, Danthu jui jal ahipoi.
English: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

tcz: Achungchon'a, Pathen hi Juda mite Pathen bou hiya ham? Ama chidang namdangho Pathen jong hilou ham?
en: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
text:
ROM 3:29
Thadou: Achungchon'a, Pathen hi Juda mite Pathen bou hiya ham? Ama chidang namdangho Pathen jong hilou ham?
English: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

tcz: Pathen khat bou ahi, chule Aman mihem to kilungtona anei chu Judah mite hihen, chidang namdang ho hijongleh tahsan jalbou ahi.
en: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.
text:
ROM 3:30
Thadou: Pathen khat bou ahi, chule Aman mihem to kilungtona anei chu Judah mite hihen, chidang namdang ho hijongleh tahsan jalbou ahi.
English: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.

tcz: Tahsan jal'a Danthu suhmilthei ahitai, tina ham? Ahidehpoi! Tahbeh a seiding in, eihon tahsan inei tenguleh Danthu chu isuh bulhit'u ahitai.
en: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
text:
ROM 3:31
Thadou: Tahsan jal'a Danthu suhmilthei ahitai, tina ham? Ahidehpoi! Tahbeh a seiding in, eihon tahsan inei tenguleh Danthu chu isuh bulhit'u ahitai.
English: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

tcz: Mihem lam dol a sei dingin Abraham chu Juda mite tahsan phutdohpa ahi. Pathen toh kilungto theina dinga ipi ahinbol doh em?
en: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?
text:
ROM 4:1
Thadou: Mihem lam dol a sei dingin Abraham chu Juda mite tahsan phutdohpa ahi. Pathen toh kilungto theina dinga ipi ahinbol doh em?
English: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

tcz: Athilpha bol chun Pathen santhei asodoh sah a ahileh, aman kisonpi ding ananei ding ahitai. Hinla, hichu Pathen lama dingin ahitheipoi.
en: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
text:
ROM 4:2
Thadou: Athilpha bol chun Pathen santhei asodoh sah a ahileh, aman kisonpi ding ananei ding ahitai. Hinla, hichu Pathen lama dingin ahitheipoi.
English: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen thubun, “Abraham'in Pathen atahsan'in, chule hiche atahsanna jeh chun Pathen in michonphan asimtai!” tin eiseipeh uve.
en: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
text:
ROM 4:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen thubun, “Abraham'in Pathen atahsan'in, chule hiche atahsanna jeh chun Pathen in michonphan asimtai!” tin eiseipeh uve.
English: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”

tcz: Mihon na atoh tenguleh anatoh man'u chu thilpeh akitipoi, amahon akilodoh-u ahijoi.
en: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
text:
ROM 4:4
Thadou: Mihon na atoh tenguleh anatoh man'u chu thilpeh akitipoi, amahon akilodoh-u ahijoi.
English: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

tcz: Hinlah miho michonphaa kisim ho chu, anatoh jal'u hilouvin, michonse ho ngaidampa Pathen atahsan jal'u ahibouve.
en: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
text:
ROM 4:5
Thadou: Hinlah miho michonphaa kisim ho chu, anatoh jal'u hilouvin, michonse ho ngaidampa Pathen atahsan jal'u ahibouve.
English: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

tcz: David'in jong michonpha tia kiphongdoh ho chu natoh jal jeh ahilou thudol ana seijin ahi.
en: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:
text:
ROM 4:6
Thadou: David'in jong michonpha tia kiphongdoh ho chu natoh jal jeh ahilou thudol ana seijin ahi.
English: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:

tcz: “O seingailou ahinauva kingaidama, achonset-u mukit loudia kisuhbeipeh ho chu iti kipa um hitam!
en: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
text:
ROM 4:7
Thadou: “O seingailou ahinauva kingaidama, achonset-u mukit loudia kisuhbeipeh ho chu iti kipa um hitam!
English: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

tcz: Ahinai, achungchang thu'u Pakaiyin achonsetnau jih lutsa akoi noimang peh'a um michu iti kipa um hitam!” ati.
en: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”
text:
ROM 4:8
Thadou: Ahinai, achungchang thu'u Pakaiyin achonsetnau jih lutsa akoi noimang peh'a um michu iti kipa um hitam!” ati.
English: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”

tcz: Tua hi Judah mite dinga bou phatthei channa ham? Ahilouleh chidang namdang cheptanlou ho dinga jong hiya ham? Ahinai, eihon jong Abraham chu atahsan jal'a Pathen'in themchang a anakoi ahitai, ti inasei jiuvin ahi.
en: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.
text:
ROM 4:9
Thadou: Tua hi Judah mite dinga bou phatthei channa ham? Ahilouleh chidang namdang cheptanlou ho dinga jong hiya ham? Ahinai, eihon jong Abraham chu atahsan jal'a Pathen'in themchang a anakoi ahitai, ti inasei jiuvin ahi.
English: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

tcz: Ahin, hichu iti hung hithei'ah ahidem? Ama chep kitan jouva bou themchang hiya ham? Ahilouleh cheptan masang joh ham? Chentah a seiding in, Abraham chu Pathen in cheptan masanga analah ahitai.
en: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
text:
ROM 4:10
Thadou: Ahin, hichu iti hung hithei'ah ahidem? Ama chep kitan jouva bou themchang hiya ham? Ahilouleh cheptan masang joh ham? Chentah a seiding in, Abraham chu Pathen in cheptan masanga analah ahitai.
English: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

tcz: Cheptan hi Abraham'in tahsan aneiye ti amelchihna ahi. Chule Pathen in ama chu michonpha tia asan'a chule aphondohna chu cheptan masangpeh ahitai. Hijeh'a hi, Abraham hi cheptanlou atahsanho dinga apau ahi. Atahsan nau jeh a chu amaho michonpha tia kisima ahitauve.
en: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.
text:
ROM 4:11
Thadou: Cheptan hi Abraham'in tahsan aneiye ti amelchihna ahi. Chule Pathen in ama chu michonpha tia asan'a chule aphondohna chu cheptan masangpeh ahitai. Hijeh'a hi, Abraham hi cheptanlou atahsanho dinga apau ahi. Atahsan nau jeh a chu amaho michonpha tia kisima ahitauve.
English: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

tcz: Chule Abraham hi cheptan ho dinga jong lhagaova apau ahi. Hinla hiche hi Abraham cheptan masanga tahsan anei tobanga tahsan neihoa ding bou ahi.
en: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.
text:
ROM 4:12
Thadou: Chule Abraham hi cheptan ho dinga jong lhagaova apau ahi. Hinla hiche hi Abraham cheptan masanga tahsan anei tobanga tahsan neihoa ding bou ahi.
English: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

tcz: Tahbeh mongin, Pathen in vannoi pumpi hi Abraham le achilhahte apeh ahin, hichu Pathen Danthu ajui jeh-u ahipon, chusanga tahsan jal'a kijopmatna phatah anei jaljoh ahi.
en: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
text:
ROM 4:13
Thadou: Tahbeh mongin, Pathen in vannoi pumpi hi Abraham le achilhahte apeh ahin, hichu Pathen Danthu ajui jeh-u ahipon, chusanga tahsan jal'a kijopmatna phatah anei jaljoh ahi.
English: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

tcz: Pathen Thutep hi danthu juihoa dinga bou hitaleh, tahsan ngaitalou ding ahi. Chule thutep hi ajeh bei hiding ahitai.
en: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.
text:
ROM 4:14
Thadou: Pathen Thutep hi danthu juihoa dinga bou hitaleh, tahsan ngaitalou ding ahi. Chule thutep hi ajeh bei hiding ahitai.
English: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

tcz: Ajeh chu Danthu hin athupeh ho jui dinga gimbolna jengbou ahin lhut ding ahi (Dan suhkeh louna dingin lampi khat bou aum'in, hichu Dan neitah lou ding chu ahije).
en: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
text:
ROM 4:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu Danthu hin athupeh ho jui dinga gimbolna jengbou ahin lhut ding ahi (Dan suhkeh louna dingin lampi khat bou aum'in, hichu Dan neitah lou ding chu ahije).
English: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

tcz: Chutia chu, thutep hi tahsan jal'a kimu'ah ahin, manbei thilpeh-akipea chu ahi. Abraham tahsan tobang inei uva ahileh Mose Dan ijuiyu hihen, ijuilouvu hijongleh eihon ibon'uva imu teidiu ahi. Ajeh chu Abraham chu atahsan jousea dinga pa ahi.
en: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.
text:
ROM 4:16
Thadou: Chutia chu, thutep hi tahsan jal'a kimu'ah ahin, manbei thilpeh-akipea chu ahi. Abraham tahsan tobang inei uva ahileh Mose Dan ijuiyu hihen, ijuilouvu hijongleh eihon ibon'uva imu teidiu ahi. Ajeh chu Abraham chu atahsan jousea dinga pa ahi.
English: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

tcz: Hiche hi ahi Pathen Lekhabun asei, “Keiman nangma namtin mipa a kasem nahitai” tia Pathen in ajah a anasei chu. Hiche ahitheina chu Abraham'in Pathen atahsan'a athisa hinsahkitna chule imacha louva kona thil thah asemdoh thei tahsan na jeh ahi.
en: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.
text:
ROM 4:17
Thadou: Hiche hi ahi Pathen Lekhabun asei, “Keiman nangma namtin mipa a kasem nahitai” tia Pathen in ajah a anasei chu. Hiche ahitheina chu Abraham'in Pathen atahsan'a athisa hinsahkitna chule imacha louva kona thil thah asemdoh thei tahsan na jeh ahi.
English: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

tcz: Kinepna ding umlouna jenga jong Abraham chu akinem jingin, ama namtin dinga Pa ahung hiding tahsanna aneiyin ahi. Ajehchu Pathen in ajah a, “Chutia a chu son le chilhah tampi nahin neiding ahi,” atipeh ahi.
en: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
text:
ROM 4:18
Thadou: Kinepna ding umlouna jenga jong Abraham chu akinem jingin, ama namtin dinga Pa ahung hiding tahsanna aneiyin ahi. Ajehchu Pathen in ajah a, “Chutia a chu son le chilhah tampi nahin neiding ahi,” atipeh ahi.
English: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”

tcz: Chule Abraham chu kum 100 nailam ahi jengin jong hitia atahsa chu athi tobang ahitah vang'in, chule Sarah naobu jong chu avoitah vang'in, atahsan chu adai lhadehpon ahi.
en: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.
text:
ROM 4:19
Thadou: Chule Abraham chu kum 100 nailam ahi jengin jong hitia atahsa chu athi tobang ahitah vang'in, chule Sarah naobu jong chu avoitah vang'in, atahsan chu adai lhadehpon ahi.
English: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.

tcz: Abraham chun Pathen thutep longlouvin atahsan'in ahi. Tahbeh in atahsanna chu ahatcheh in chule hichea chun Pathen loupina apen ahi.
en: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,
text:
ROM 4:20
Thadou: Abraham chun Pathen thutep longlouvin atahsan'in ahi. Tahbeh in atahsanna chu ahatcheh in chule hichea chun Pathen loupina apen ahi.
English: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

tcz: Pathen chun akitepna ipi hijongleh aboldoh ding ahi ti hetchetna kicheh aneiye.
en: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.
text:
ROM 4:21
Thadou: Pathen chun akitepna ipi hijongleh aboldoh ding ahi ti hetchetna kicheh aneiye.
English: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

tcz: Chule Abraham chu atahsan jal'a Pathen'in michonpha tia asem ahitai.
en: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”
text:
ROM 4:22
Thadou: Chule Abraham chu atahsan jal'a Pathen'in michonpha tia asem ahitai.
English: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”

tcz: Chutia Pathen in ama michonphaa asem chu Abraham dinga bou phachoma ahipoi. Eiho phatchompi dinga jong kijih a ahi.
en: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,
text:
ROM 4:23
Thadou: Chutia Pathen in ama michonphaa asem chu Abraham dinga bou phachoma ahipoi. Eiho phatchompi dinga jong kijih a ahi.
English: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua thinaa kona kaithoupa chu itahsan uva ahileh Pathen in eiho jong michonpha'a eisem dingu ahi, ti hetchetna eipeuve.
en: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,
text:
ROM 4:24
Thadou: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua thinaa kona kaithoupa chu itahsan uva ahileh Pathen in eiho jong michonpha'a eisem dingu ahi, ti hetchetna eipeuve.
English: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

tcz: Ichonset jeh uva Ama chu thi dinga pehdoh a uma ahin, chule hinna a Ama kaithouva aum hin Pathen to eisuhcham'u ahitai.
en: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
text:
ROM 4:25
Thadou: Ichonset jeh uva Ama chu thi dinga pehdoh a uma ahin, chule hinna a Ama kaithouva aum hin Pathen to eisuhcham'u ahitai.
English: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

tcz: Chuti ahijeh chun, Pathen mitmua tahsan jal'a kisudih ihi tah jeh uvin, Pakai Yeshua Christa thilbol dohsa jal'a chu Pathen to kicham'a ihi tauve.
en: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

tcz: Christa chun itahsan jaluva hiche ichan diuva kilomlou hamphatna chu tu idinmun uva hi eipuilut'u ahitai, chule eiho lungngam tah le kipah tah a Pathen loupina chu changkhom ding ihiuve.
en: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
text:
ROM 5:2
Thadou: Christa chun itahsan jaluva hiche ichan diuva kilomlou hamphatna chu tu idinmun uva hi eipuilut'u ahitai, chule eiho lungngam tah le kipah tah a Pathen loupina chu changkhom ding ihiuve.
English: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

tcz: Eihon hahsatna le patepna ho ito tenguleh ikipa thei jiu ahi, ajehchu hitobang itouva kon'a hi thohhatna ikisin dingu ahi.
en: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

tcz: Chule thohhatna chun chonchanpha sosah intin, chule ichonchan phatnau chun huhhing kinepna chu kisonpina ahin sodoh ding ahi.
en: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

tcz: Chule hiche kinepna chun eilunglhah sah pouvinte. Ajehchu eihon Pathen in ichan geiya eingailut'u hintem ti ihedoh tauve, ajehchu Ama hin a-Lhagaotheng chu Ama ngailutna ilungu lodim dingin eipetauve.
en: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
text:
ROM 5:5
Thadou: Chule hiche kinepna chun eilunglhah sah pouvinte. Ajehchu eihon Pathen in ichan geiya eingailut'u hintem ti ihedoh tauve, ajehchu Ama hin a-Lhagaotheng chu Ama ngailutna ilungu lodim dingin eipetauve.
English: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

tcz: Eihon kinepna imacha neilou hel'a ium laitah uvin, aphatchan Christa chu ahung'in michonse eiho ding in ahung thitan ahi.
en: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
text:
ROM 5:6
Thadou: Eihon kinepna imacha neilou hel'a ium laitah uvin, aphatchan Christa chu ahung'in michonse eiho ding in ahung thitan ahi.
English: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

tcz: Midih khat dingin mi atamjo thi dingin kiphal pouvinte, mipha dehset dinga thi dinga kiphaldoh khattou umjeng jong leh.
en: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.
text:
ROM 5:7
Thadou: Midih khat dingin mi atamjo thi dingin kiphal pouvinte, mipha dehset dinga thi dinga kiphaldoh khattou umjeng jong leh.
English: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

tcz: Ahivangin, Pathen in eingailut dehset nau vetsahnan, eiho chonset a ium laitah uvin Christa chu eiho dia thi dingin ahinsoltai.
en: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
text:
ROM 5:8
Thadou: Ahivangin, Pathen in eingailut dehset nau vetsahnan, eiho chonset a ium laitah uvin Christa chu eiho dia thi dingin ahinsoltai.
English: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

tcz: Chule Christa thisan jal'a eiho Pathen mitmua chondih a eikisemuva ahitah jeh in, Pathen themmo chana a kon'a chu eihuh doh teiding'u ahi.
en: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
text:
ROM 5:9
Thadou: Chule Christa thisan jal'a eiho Pathen mitmua chondih a eikisemuva ahitah jeh in, Pathen themmo chana a kon'a chu eihuh doh teiding'u ahi.
English: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

tcz: Ajehchu Achapa thi jal'a Pathen to kiloikhom kit theina ineiyu ahitah a ahileh, Achapa hin jal'a chu amelma ihinauva kona huhhing'a umtei ding ihiuve,
en: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
text:
ROM 5:10
Thadou: Ajehchu Achapa thi jal'a Pathen to kiloikhom kit theina ineiyu ahitah a ahileh, Achapa hin jal'a chu amelma ihinauva kona huhhing'a umtei ding ihiuve,
English: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

tcz: Hijeh chun, tun, Pathen to kigui jopna phatah inei jaluvin kipah thei ihitauve, ajehchu i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa chun Pathen jol-le-gol'in eisem tauve.
en: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
text:
ROM 5:11
Thadou: Hijeh chun, tun, Pathen to kigui jopna phatah inei jaluvin kipah thei ihitauve, ajehchu i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa chun Pathen jol-le-gol'in eisem tauve.
English: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

tcz: Adam achonset phat chun vannoiyah chonset ahunglut in, Adam chonsetna chun thina ahin polut'in, chutichun thina chu mitin chungah achutai, ajeh chu mijouse chonseah ahitai.
en: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.
text:
ROM 5:12
Thadou: Adam achonset phat chun vannoiyah chonset ahunglut in, Adam chonsetna chun thina ahin polut'in, chutichun thina chu mitin chungah achutai, ajeh chu mijouse chonseah ahitai.
English: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.

tcz: Ahinai! Danthu kipeh masang jengin jong miho chu anachonseuve. Hinla palkeh ding Danthu ana umlou lai jeh in chonset chu chonset anakitipoi.
en: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
text:
ROM 5:13
Thadou: Ahinai! Danthu kipeh masang jengin jong miho chu anachonseuve. Hinla palkeh ding Danthu ana umlou lai jeh in chonset chu chonset anakitipoi.
English: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

tcz: Hiti chun, Adam'a kipat Mose phat chan geiyin Adam banga chonset anabol lou Pathen Thupeh ana palkeh lou ho jong anathiuve. Hiche Adam chu ahung dinga kisei Christa vetsahna ahije.
en: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
text:
ROM 5:14
Thadou: Hiti chun, Adam'a kipat Mose phat chan geiyin Adam banga chonset anabol lou Pathen Thupeh ana palkeh lou ho jong anathiuve. Hiche Adam chu ahung dinga kisei Christa vetsahna ahije.
English: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

tcz: Ahin Adam chonsetna le Pathen Thilpeh man-lutah chu kibang louhel ahi. Ajehchu hiche mikhat, Adam, chonsetna chun mitampi chunga thina ahin pohlut ahitai. Hinla, chusanga lenjo cheh chu Pathen milungset kidang chule ngaidamna athilpeh mitampi dinga apeh, michom dang, Yeshua Christa, a apeh hi ahi.
en: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
text:
ROM 5:15
Thadou: Ahin Adam chonsetna le Pathen Thilpeh man-lutah chu kibang louhel ahi. Ajehchu hiche mikhat, Adam, chonsetna chun mitampi chunga thina ahin pohlut ahitai. Hinla, chusanga lenjo cheh chu Pathen milungset kidang chule ngaidamna athilpeh mitampi dinga apeh, michom dang, Yeshua Christa, a apeh hi ahi.
English: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

tcz: Chule Pathen lungsetna manbei thilpeh in ahinsodoh chuto, mikhat chonset'in ahinsodoh chu gamchenga phatchomna nei ahi. Ajehchu, Adam chonset chun themmo channa alhut'in, hinlah Pathen manbei thilpeh chun ichonsetnau atamlheh vang'in, Pathen to kichamna asodoh in ahi.
en: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.
text:
ROM 5:16
Thadou: Chule Pathen lungsetna manbei thilpeh in ahinsodoh chuto, mikhat chonset'in ahinsodoh chu gamchenga phatchomna nei ahi. Ajehchu, Adam chonset chun themmo channa alhut'in, hinlah Pathen manbei thilpeh chun ichonsetnau atamlheh vang'in, Pathen to kichamna asodoh in ahi.
English: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.

tcz: Ajehchu, hiche mikhat, Adam, chonsetna chun, mitampi chunga thina ahinsodoh ahi. Hinlah chusanga lenjo chu Pathen milungsetna kidangtah le achonphat thilpeh hi ahi, ajeh chu hiche kisan jouse chun hiche mikhat, Yeshua Christa, jal'a chonset le thina kona jona anei ding ahi.
en: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
text:
ROM 5:17
Thadou: Ajehchu, hiche mikhat, Adam, chonsetna chun, mitampi chunga thina ahinsodoh ahi. Hinlah chusanga lenjo chu Pathen milungsetna kidangtah le achonphat thilpeh hi ahi, ajeh chu hiche kisan jouse chun hiche mikhat, Yeshua Christa, jal'a chonset le thina kona jona anei ding ahi.
English: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

tcz: Henge, Adam khatvei achonset chun, amichang cheh themmona ahin polut'in, hinla Christa khatvei chonphatna natoh chun Pathen to kigui jopna pha le hinkhothah amichang cheh ding ahin lhuttai.
en: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.
text:
ROM 5:18
Thadou: Henge, Adam khatvei achonset chun, amichang cheh themmona ahin polut'in, hinla Christa khatvei chonphatna natoh chun Pathen to kigui jopna pha le hinkhothah amichang cheh ding ahin lhuttai.
English: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

tcz: Ajehchu mi khat'in Pathen sei angailou jeh in, mi tampi chonsea ahung hitai. Hinlah, michom dang khat Pathen thua anunjeh a, mi tampi achonphaa kisem ding ahitai.
en: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
text:
ROM 5:19
Thadou: Ajehchu mi khat'in Pathen sei angailou jeh in, mi tampi chonsea ahung hitai. Hinlah, michom dang khat Pathen thua anunjeh a, mi tampi achonphaa kisem ding ahitai.
English: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

tcz: Pathen Danthu kipeh hi miho jousen itobang loma chonse ahiu akimudoh theina dingu ahi. Hinla, miho chu achonse khohse cheh un ahileh, Pathen lungsetna kidangtah chu aning lhinbe cheh tai.
en: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,
text:
ROM 5:20
Thadou: Pathen Danthu kipeh hi miho jousen itobang loma chonse ahiu akimudoh theina dingu ahi. Hinla, miho chu achonse khohse cheh un ahileh, Pathen lungsetna kidangtah chu aning lhinbe cheh tai.
English: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,

tcz: Hijehchun, chonset chun mijouse chunga vai ahoma chule thina ahinpoh lut tobang'in, tunjong Pathen lungsetna kidangtah chun vai ahomjon, hichun Pathen toh kichamna chule i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa jal'a tonsot Hinna ahin sodohtai.
en: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
text:
ROM 5:21
Thadou: Hijehchun, chonset chun mijouse chunga vai ahoma chule thina ahinpoh lut tobang'in, tunjong Pathen lungsetna kidangtah chun vai ahomjon, hichun Pathen toh kichamna chule i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa jal'a tonsot Hinna ahin sodohtai.
English: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

tcz: Chuti ahileh aphai, Pathen in alungsetna kidangtah eichansahbe chehna dinguva ichonset jing dingu ham?
en: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
text:
ROM 6:1
Thadou: Chuti ahileh aphai, Pathen in alungsetna kidangtah eichansahbe chehna dinguva ichonset jing dingu ham?
English: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

tcz: Chuti thei ponte. Eiho chonsetna'a thisaho chu iti dan'a chuti bep'a chu ihinjom nahlai dingu ham?
en: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
text:
ROM 6:2
Thadou: Chuti thei ponte. Eiho chonsetna'a thisaho chu iti dan'a chuti bep'a chu ihinjom nahlai dingu ham?
English: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

tcz: Ahilou jongleh eiho Christa Yeshua to kijop matna'a baptize chang chengse hi, Ama thina'a thitha ihiu nasuhmil'u hitam?
en: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
text:
ROM 6:3
Thadou: Ahilou jongleh eiho Christa Yeshua to kijop matna'a baptize chang chengse hi, Ama thina'a thitha ihiu nasuhmil'u hitam?
English: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

tcz: Ajehchu eiho baptize ichan'u hi Christa toh thithaa chule kivuitha ihitauve. Ajehchu Pa thaneina loupitah chun Christa athia kona akaithou banga chu, tua hi eiho jong hinkho thah a ihinthei dingu ahitai.
en: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
text:
ROM 6:4
Thadou: Ajehchu eiho baptize ichan'u hi Christa toh thithaa chule kivuitha ihitauve. Ajehchu Pa thaneina loupitah chun Christa athia kona akaithou banga chu, tua hi eiho jong hinkho thah a ihinthei dingu ahitai.
English: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

tcz: Ama thina a thikhom'ah ihiu banga chu, Ama thokit banga eiho jong hinna'a kaithouva umkit ding ihiu ahi.
en: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

tcz: Eihoa um ihinau milui chonsetna chu Christa to khetbeh tha ihitah jeh uva, chonset in ihinkho uva tha aneina chu lahmanga um ding ahi.
en: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
text:
ROM 6:6
Thadou: Eihoa um ihinau milui chonsetna chu Christa to khetbeh tha ihitah jeh uva, chonset in ihinkho uva tha aneina chu lahmanga um ding ahi.
English: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

tcz: Ajehchu eiho Christa toh ithiuva chu chonset thaneina noija kon eichamlhatsah-u ahitai.
en: For he who has died has been freed from sin.
text:
ROM 6:7
Thadou: Ajehchu eiho Christa toh ithiuva chu chonset thaneina noija kon eichamlhatsah-u ahitai.
English: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

tcz: Chule eiho Christa toh thithaihitah jeh uva, eiho Amato ihin dingu ahi ti iheuve.
en: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,
text:
ROM 6:8
Thadou: Chule eiho Christa toh thithaihitah jeh uva, eiho Amato ihin dingu ahi ti iheuve.
English: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

tcz: Christa chu athilah a kona thoudoh'a ahitah jeh a, hiche hi ihetchen'u ahi, chule Ama chunga thinan thu aneitah loujeh-a Ama thikit talou ding ahi. Thina chun achunga thu aneitah lou ding ahitai.
en: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!
text:
ROM 6:9
Thadou: Christa chu athilah a kona thoudoh'a ahitah jeh a, hiche hi ihetchen'u ahi, chule Ama chunga thinan thu aneitah loujeh-a Ama thikit talou ding ahi. Thina chun achunga thu aneitah lou ding ahitai.
English: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!

tcz: Ama athia chu chonset sulha dinga khatvei thia ahitai. Hinla, tua Ama ahintah jeh a, Pathen loupina dinga Ama dia hinga ahitai.
en: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.
text:
ROM 6:10
Thadou: Ama athia chu chonset sulha dinga khatvei thia ahitai. Hinla, tua Ama ahintah jeh a, Pathen loupina dinga Ama dia hinga ahitai.
English: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

tcz: Hijeh a hi nangho jong chonset thaneinaa chu athia nakigel dingu, chule Christa Yeshua jal'a ahinga nakigel dingu ahitai.
en: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text:
ROM 6:11
Thadou: Hijeh a hi nangho jong chonset thaneinaa chu athia nakigel dingu, chule Christa Yeshua jal'a ahinga nakigel dingu ahitai.
English: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

tcz: Hijehchun, natahsau thithei chunga hin tahsa lung ngaichat lam'a chonna dingin chonset vaihomsah hih hel'un
