en: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
text:
ROM 6:12
Thadou: Hijehchun, natahsau thithei chunga hin tahsa lung ngaichat lam'a chonna dingin chonset vaihomsah hih hel'un
English: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

tcz: Natibah chengu chu hoipen hijongleh chonset bolnaa man dingin pedoh hihbeh-un. Chusang'in, Pathen ah kipe thengun, ajehchu nangho athisa nahiuvin, hinla tun hinna naneitauve. Hijehchun, natahsa pumpiu chu Pathen loupina dingin adihlam bolna in manguvin.
en: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
text:
ROM 6:13
Thadou: Natibah chengu chu hoipen hijongleh chonset bolnaa man dingin pedoh hihbeh-un. Chusang'in, Pathen ah kipe thengun, ajehchu nangho athisa nahiuvin, hinla tun hinna naneitauve. Hijehchun, natahsa pumpiu chu Pathen loupina dingin adihlam bolna in manguvin.
English: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

tcz: Nangho Danthu noija naum tahlou jeh uvin, chonset soh nahi tapouve. Chusangin, Pathen lungsetna noija chamlhat nahi tauve.
en: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.
text:
ROM 6:14
Thadou: Nangho Danthu noija naum tahlou jeh uvin, chonset soh nahi tapouve. Chusangin, Pathen lungsetna noija chamlhat nahi tauve.
English: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

tcz: Achutileh aphai! Pathen lungsetna chun Danthu noija kona eilha ongu ahitahleh, ichonset jom jing thei nahlaiyu ahi tina ham? Hiti chu hithei ponte.
en: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!
text:
ROM 6:15
Thadou: Achutileh aphai! Pathen lungsetna chun Danthu noija kona eilha ongu ahitahleh, ichonset jom jing thei nahlaiyu ahi tina ham? Hiti chu hithei ponte.
English: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!

tcz: Koi hijeng jongleh asoh hidinga nakipehna pen dinga chu athua naum ding chu geldoh louva nahim? Nangma chonset soh nahithei, hichun thinaa napuilut ding, ahilouleh chonphatna hinkho Pathen seingaina hinkho naman thei ahi.
en: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?
text:
ROM 6:16
Thadou: Koi hijeng jongleh asoh hidinga nakipehna pen dinga chu athua naum ding chu geldoh louva nahim? Nangma chonset soh nahithei, hichun thinaa napuilut ding, ahilouleh chonphatna hinkho Pathen seingaina hinkho naman thei ahi.
English: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

tcz: Pathen chu thangvah in umhen! Khatvei chu chonset soh nana hiu ahin, hinla tun nanghon hiche thuhil kahil nau hi nalung pum piuvin nangaiyuve.
en: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.
text:
ROM 6:17
Thadou: Pathen chu thangvah in umhen! Khatvei chu chonset soh nana hiu ahin, hinla tun nanghon hiche thuhil kahil nau hi nalung pum piuvin nangaiyuve.
English: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.

tcz: Tua hi nangho chonset soh nahiuva kona nachamlhat'u ahitan, chule chonphatna hinkhoa sohna natoh-u ahitai.
en: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.
text:
ROM 6:18
Thadou: Tua hi nangho chonset soh nahiuva kona nachamlhat'u ahitan, chule chonphatna hinkhoa sohna natoh-u ahitai.
English: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

tcz: Na mihinauva lhahsamna aumjeh a, hichea kiseiho jouse hi nahet theina dinguva soh thudol'a vetsahna a kasei ahi. Tumasang sea chu thenlouna le chonkhel na a sohchanga nahiu ahin, hichun chonset'a lhahlut thuh chehna a napui lut'u ahi. Tua hi nangho chonphatna soh a nakipeh lut joh dingu, hichun nathen sah dingu ahi.
en: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.
text:
ROM 6:19
Thadou: Na mihinauva lhahsamna aumjeh a, hichea kiseiho jouse hi nahet theina dinguva soh thudol'a vetsahna a kasei ahi. Tumasang sea chu thenlouna le chonkhel na a sohchanga nahiu ahin, hichun chonset'a lhahlut thuh chehna a napui lut'u ahi. Tua hi nangho chonphatna soh a nakipeh lut joh dingu, hichun nathen sah dingu ahi.
English: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

tcz: Nangho chonset soh nahipet uva chu thilpha bolna lama chamlhat nanahiuve.
en: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.
text:
ROM 6:20
Thadou: Nangho chonset soh nahipet uva chu thilpha bolna lama chamlhat nanahiuve.
English: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.

tcz: Chule hichun, aga ipi asodoh em? Nanghon nanabol hou chu najachat piu ahitai, hicheho chun tonsot themmona a napuilut dingu ahi.
en: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
text:
ROM 6:21
Thadou: Chule hichun, aga ipi asodoh em? Nanghon nanabol hou chu najachat piu ahitai, hicheho chun tonsot themmona a napuilut dingu ahi.
English: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

tcz: Hinlah tun, nangho chonset thaneina noiya ongthola nahi tahjeh uva Pathen sohte hung hia nahi tauve. Tun, nanghon hicheho hi nabol'u hin thenna le tonsot hinna ah nalha theitauve.
en: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.
text:
ROM 6:22
Thadou: Hinlah tun, nangho chonset thaneina noiya ongthola nahi tahjeh uva Pathen sohte hung hia nahi tauve. Tun, nanghon hicheho hi nabol'u hin thenna le tonsot hinna ah nalha theitauve.
English: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh chonset natohman thina ahi, hinla Pathen in manbeiya athilpeh hi, i-Pakaiyu Christa Yeshua jal'a Tonsot Hinna ahi.
en: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text:
ROM 6:23
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh chonset natohman thina ahi, hinla Pathen in manbeiya athilpeh hi, i-Pakaiyu Christa Yeshua jal'a Tonsot Hinna ahi.
English: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

tcz: Tuhin sopi deitahte, Danthu he nanghon mikhat chunga chu dan'in aji hin laisea bou thu anei ahi chu helou nahiuvem?
en: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?
text:
ROM 7:1
Thadou: Tuhin sopi deitahte, Danthu he nanghon mikhat chunga chu dan'in aji hin laisea bou thu anei ahi chu helou nahiuvem?
English: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

tcz: Avetsahnan, numei khat in ji anei tengleh Dan chun aji hin laisea thu anei ahi. Hinla amapa athi teng vangleh akichenna lhon Dan chu amanu chunga kimang thei talou ahi.
en: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.
text:
ROM 7:2
Thadou: Avetsahnan, numei khat in ji anei tengleh Dan chun aji hin laisea thu anei ahi. Hinla amapa athi teng vangleh akichenna lhon Dan chu amanu chunga kimang thei talou ahi.
English: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

tcz: Hitichu ahin, ajipa hinlai sungin michom khattoh kicheng taleh, amanu chu jonbol hiding ahitai. Hinla ajipa chu thileh hiche jineina dan'a chu ongthol ahitan chule amanu chu jinei jongleh jonbol ahitapoi.
en: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.
text:
ROM 7:3
Thadou: Hitichu ahin, ajipa hinlai sungin michom khattoh kicheng taleh, amanu chu jonbol hiding ahitai. Hinla ajipa chu thileh hiche jineina dan'a chu ongthol ahitan chule amanu chu jinei jongleh jonbol ahitapoi.
English: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

tcz: Hitichu ahi, kasopi deitahte, hiche akiseilona ajehchu Christa toh nathi thau chun Dan thuneina'a kon'a athia nahiu ahitai. Chule nangho athia kona thoudohpa chuto thakhat nahiu ahitai. Hichea kona chu, Pathen'a dinga gapha ihinso doh theiyu ahitai.
en: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.
text:
ROM 7:4
Thadou: Hitichu ahi, kasopi deitahte, hiche akiseilona ajehchu Christa toh nathi thau chun Dan thuneina'a kon'a athia nahiu ahitai. Chule nangho athia kona thoudohpa chuto thakhat nahiu ahitai. Hichea kona chu, Pathen'a dinga gapha ihinso doh theiyu ahitai.
English: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.

tcz: Eiho milui ihinau chun ei-thunun laiseuva chonset lung ngaichat in eiho chung'a na atoh ahi. Chule Dan hin hiche thil phalou ngaichatna chu ahin kondohsah a, hichun chonset ahin jia, thina asodoh ji ahi.
en: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.
text:
ROM 7:5
Thadou: Eiho milui ihinau chun ei-thunun laiseuva chonset lung ngaichat in eiho chung'a na atoh ahi. Chule Dan hin hiche thil phalou ngaichatna chu ahin kondohsah a, hichun chonset ahin jia, thina asodoh ji ahi.
English: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.

tcz: Ahin tun, eiho Dan'a kona eikilha onguva ahitah jeh chun hiche Danthu'a chu athia ihitauvin, chule Dan thaneina'a chu sohchang ihitapouve. Tua hi Pathen lhachana itoh thei diu ahitai. Danthu lekha jem thua nungho lamakai chu hitalouva, lampithah, Lhagaova hing ihi joh-u ahitai.
en: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.
text:
ROM 7:6
Thadou: Ahin tun, eiho Dan'a kona eikilha onguva ahitah jeh chun hiche Danthu'a chu athia ihitauvin, chule Dan thaneina'a chu sohchang ihitapouve. Tua hi Pathen lhachana itoh thei diu ahitai. Danthu lekha jem thua nungho lamakai chu hitalouva, lampithah, Lhagaova hing ihi joh-u ahitai.
English: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

tcz: Chuti ahileh aphai, keiman Pathen Danthu chu chonsea ahitia kaseina ham? Ahipoi! Tahbeh in Dan chun kachonsetna eimusah ahin, keiman mi thilnei thangset aphapoi ti kana hepon, Danthu chun, “Minei thangse hih in,” ti eihet dohsah ahibouve.
en: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”
text:
ROM 7:7
Thadou: Chuti ahileh aphai, keiman Pathen Danthu chu chonsea ahitia kaseina ham? Ahipoi! Tahbeh in Dan chun kachonsetna eimusah ahin, keiman mi thilnei thangset aphapoi ti kana hepon, Danthu chun, “Minei thangse hih in,” ti eihet dohsah ahibouve.
English: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”

tcz: Hinlah, chonset in hiche thupeh amangchan keiya neipap kilosetna lung ngaichat jouse chu atildoh in ahi. Dan chu umlou ahileh, hiche tha chu aneilou lai ahi.
en: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
text:
ROM 7:8
Thadou: Hinlah, chonset in hiche thupeh amangchan keiya neipap kilosetna lung ngaichat jouse chu atildoh in ahi. Dan chu umlou ahileh, hiche tha chu aneilou lai ahi.
English: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

tcz: Phat khat'in Danthu hetna neilouvin kana hingin, hinla keiman, thupeh in, vetsahnan, neipap kiloset lou ding tia eihil kahetdoh chun, chonset thaneina chu kachungah ahung lhunge;
en: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.

tcz: chuleh keima athia kahitai. Hitichun, keiman Danthupeh hochun hinna ahinlhut ding doltah hinlhut talouvin Lhagao thina joh ahinlhut taiti kamudoh e.
en: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;

tcz: Chuche thupeh ho chu chonset'in thuneinan aneiyin chule eilhem lhatai. Hiche chun, thupeh chu amangin eithattai.
en: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.
text:
ROM 7:11
Thadou: Chuche thupeh ho chu chonset'in thuneinan aneiyin chule eilhem lhatai. Hiche chun, thupeh chu amangin eithattai.
English: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in, Danthu hi athengin chule athupeh ho jong atheng le adih chule apha ahi.
en: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.
text:
ROM 7:12
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in, Danthu hi athengin chule athupeh ho jong atheng le adih chule apha ahi.
English: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.

tcz: Hinlah hichu iti hithei hintem? Danthu, aphachun, kathina ding ahin tohdoh jeng ham? Hiti lom chu hiponte! Chonset chun apha chu amanchah a, thina dinga kathemmo channa ahin lhutahi. Hitichun, chonset hi ichan geiya hoise ahidan mudoh theijin aume. Pathen thupeh pha chu thilphalouva dingin amangcha e.
en: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.
text:
ROM 7:13
Thadou: Hinlah hichu iti hithei hintem? Danthu, aphachun, kathina ding ahin tohdoh jeng ham? Hiti lom chu hiponte! Chonset chun apha chu amanchah a, thina dinga kathemmo channa ahin lhutahi. Hitichun, chonset hi ichan geiya hoise ahidan mudoh theijin aume. Pathen thupeh pha chu thilphalouva dingin amangcha e.
English: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.

tcz: Hitichun, Danthu chu aboiyah ahipoi, ajehchu hichu lhagao thu ahin, chule apha ahi. Ajehchu keima lei mihem kahi val behseh jeh in, chonset soh kahin, boina chu keiya kon ahi.
en: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
text:
ROM 7:14
Thadou: Hitichun, Danthu chu aboiyah ahipoi, ajehchu hichu lhagao thu ahin, chule apha ahi. Ajehchu keima lei mihem kahi val behseh jeh in, chonset soh kahin, boina chu keiya kon ahi.
English: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima le keima kakihechenpoi, ijeh inem itileh adih chu kabol nom'in, hinla keiman kabolpoi. Hisang chun, kathet chu kabolin ahi.
en: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.
text:
ROM 7:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu keima le keima kakihechenpoi, ijeh inem itileh adih chu kabol nom'in, hinla keiman kabolpoi. Hisang chun, kathet chu kabolin ahi.
English: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

tcz: Ahin keiman kathilbol chu adih ahipoi, tia kahetleh hiche hin Danthu hi adih-e, ti kanopna eivetsah ahi.
en: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
text:
ROM 7:16
Thadou: Ahin keiman kathilbol chu adih ahipoi, tia kahetleh hiche hin Danthu hi adih-e, ti kanopna eivetsah ahi.
English: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

tcz: Hitichun, ase bol'a chu keima hitalouva chonset keiya um chun abol ahi.
en: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
text:
ROM 7:17
Thadou: Hitichun, ase bol'a chu keima hitalouva chonset keiya um chun abol ahi.
English: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

tcz: Chule keiya phatna imacha aumpoi ti kahei, tichu-hiche chonset mihina kanei chun thilpha kabol nom in, hinlah kabol theijipoi.
en: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.
text:
ROM 7:18
Thadou: Chule keiya phatna imacha aumpoi ti kahei, tichu-hiche chonset mihina kanei chun thilpha kabol nom in, hinlah kabol theijipoi.
English: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.

tcz: Thilpha chu kabol nom'in, hinla kabol jipoi. Aphalou chu kabol nompon, hinla keiman kabol jitai.
en: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.
text:
ROM 7:19
Thadou: Thilpha chu kabol nom'in, hinla kabol jipoi. Aphalou chu kabol nompon, hinla keiman kabol jitai.
English: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

tcz: Ahin kabol nomlou chu kabola ahileh abola chu keitahbeh hitalouva, chonset keiya um chun ahinbolji ahi.
en: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
text:
ROM 7:20
Thadou: Ahin kabol nomlou chu kabola ahileh abola chu keitahbeh hitalouva, chonset keiya um chun ahinbolji ahi.
English: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

tcz: Keiman hiche umdan hi kahetai. Keiman adih chu kabol nom'in, keiman adihlou joh chu kanabol jitai.
en: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
text:
ROM 7:21
Thadou: Keiman hiche umdan hi kahetai. Keiman adih chu kabol nom'in, keiman adihlou joh chu kanabol jitai.
English: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

tcz: Keiman Pathen Danthu kalung pumpin kabol nom'in ahi.
en: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,
text:
ROM 7:22
Thadou: Keiman Pathen Danthu kalung pumpin kabol nom'in ahi.
English: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,

tcz: Hinlah kasunga hin athunei chom khat aum'in, hichu kalungthim to kidouva ahi. Hiche thaneina hin keiya um chonset soh eihisah ahitai.
en: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
text:
ROM 7:23
Thadou: Hinlah kasunga hin athunei chom khat aum'in, hichu kalungthim to kidouva ahi. Hiche thaneina hin keiya um chonset soh eihisah ahitai.
English: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

tcz: Ohe, itobang tah'a mikhoto um kahi hitam! Koiyin hiche tahsa chonset le thitheina vaihomna a kon'in eihuhdoh tantem?
en: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?
text:
ROM 7:24
Thadou: Ohe, itobang tah'a mikhoto um kahi hitam! Koiyin hiche tahsa chonset le thitheina vaihomna a kon'in eihuhdoh tantem?
English: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

tcz: Pathen thangvah in umhen! Adonbutna hi IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa a um ahi. Hiti umdol chu hinven: Kalungin Pathen Danthu ajui nom'in, hinla keiya chonset mihina aumjeh hin keima chonset soh kahitai.
en: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.
text:
ROM 7:25
Thadou: Pathen thangvah in umhen! Adonbutna hi IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa a um ahi. Hiti umdol chu hinven: Kalungin Pathen Danthu ajui nom'in, hinla keiya chonset mihina aumjeh hin keima chonset soh kahitai.
English: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.

tcz: Hitichun, tun Christa Yeshua a hiho (tahsa thua chonlou lhagaova chonho) dingin themmo channa ding aumtapoi.
en: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
text:
ROM 8:1
Thadou: Hitichun, tun Christa Yeshua a hiho (tahsa thua chonlou lhagaova chonho) dingin themmo channa ding aumtapoi.
English: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

tcz: Ajehchu nangma Amaa nahitah jeh in, hinna pea Lhagao chun chonset thuneina thinaa kon'a nachamlhat sah ahitai.
en: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
text:
ROM 8:2
Thadou: Ajehchu nangma Amaa nahitah jeh in, hinna pea Lhagao chun chonset thuneina thinaa kon'a nachamlhat sah ahitai.
English: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

tcz: Mose Dan chun eihuhhing jou pouve, ajehchu ichonset nomnau imihinau alhahsam jal jeh ahi. Hijehchun, Danthun atoh joulou chu Pathen in Achapa chang khat eiho tahsa melpua ahin sol'a atohdoh ahitai. Chule hiche tahsa achu Pathen'in eihoa um ichunguva chonset thuneina chu suhbeina dinga Achapa chu kilhaina a apehdoh ahitai.
en: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,
text:
ROM 8:3
Thadou: Mose Dan chun eihuhhing jou pouve, ajehchu ichonset nomnau imihinau alhahsam jal jeh ahi. Hijehchun, Danthun atoh joulou chu Pathen in Achapa chang khat eiho tahsa melpua ahin sol'a atohdoh ahitai. Chule hiche tahsa achu Pathen'in eihoa um ichunguva chonset thuneina chu suhbeina dinga Achapa chu kilhaina a apehdoh ahitai.
English: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,

tcz: Aman hiche abol chu Danthu in dihna angehna chu eihoa lungna chamkim sahna dinga ahin, eihon ichonset nom nau thua inun louna dingu ahi.
en: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
text:
ROM 8:4
Thadou: Aman hiche abol chu Danthu in dihna angehna chu eihoa lungna chamkim sahna dinga ahin, eihon ichonset nom nau thua inun louna dingu ahi.
English: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

tcz: Chonset'in avaihom ho chun chonset thil bou agel jiuvin, hinla Lhagao Theng'in athunun miho chun Lhagao lunglhaina ho agel ding'u ahi.
en: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
text:
ROM 8:5
Thadou: Chonset'in avaihom ho chun chonset thil bou agel jiuvin, hinla Lhagao Theng'in athunun miho chun Lhagao lunglhaina ho agel ding'u ahi.
English: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

tcz: Hijeh chun, nachonset nomnau lungthim chun na-thununuva ahileh thinaa napuilut ding'u ahi. Hinla, Lhagao Theng'in nalungthim'u athunun a ahileh, hinna le lungmonna hiding ahi.
en: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

tcz: Ajehchu chonsetna lungthim hin Pathen adou jinge. Hichu Pathen Danthu toh kikal ahi, chule juijong ajuilou ding ahi.
en: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
text:
ROM 8:7
Thadou: Ajehchu chonsetna lungthim hin Pathen adou jinge. Hichu Pathen Danthu toh kikal ahi, chule juijong ajuilou ding ahi.
English: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, achonset nomnau lunggel'in athujo miho chun Pathen alunglhai thei louhel dingu ahi.
en: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
text:
ROM 8:8
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun, achonset nomnau lunggel'in athujo miho chun Pathen alunglhai thei louhel dingu ahi.
English: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

tcz: Hinlah nangho nachonset nom nau lungthim in na-thunun'u ahitapoi. Nasung uva Pathen Lhagao achen vangleh nangho Pathen Lhagao chun na-thunun'u ahitai. (chule nahetdiu chu, asunga Christa Lhagaovin chenna a aneilou chengse chu ama a hilou hel ahiuve.)
en: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.
text:
ROM 8:9
Thadou: Hinlah nangho nachonset nom nau lungthim in na-thunun'u ahitapoi. Nasung uva Pathen Lhagao achen vangleh nangho Pathen Lhagao chun na-thunun'u ahitai. (chule nahetdiu chu, asunga Christa Lhagaovin chenna a aneilou chengse chu ama a hilou hel ahiuve.)
English: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

tcz: Chule Christa nasung uva cheng ahi, hijeh a chu chonset jeh in natahsau thiding hijong leh, Lhagao chun hinna napeh u ahi ajeh chu Pathen a kisudih nahi tauve.
en: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
text:
ROM 8:10
Thadou: Chule Christa nasung uva cheng ahi, hijeh a chu chonset jeh in natahsau thiding hijong leh, Lhagao chun hinna napeh u ahi ajeh chu Pathen a kisudih nahi tauve.
English: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

tcz: Yeshua athi lah a kon'a kaithoupa Pathen Lhagao nasung uva chenga ahitai. Chule Pathen in Christa Yeshua chu athia kona akaithou banga, nasung uva Lhagao um Ama chu amanchah a natahsau thithei chu Hinna apeh ding ahi.
en: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
text:
ROM 8:11
Thadou: Yeshua athi lah a kon'a kaithoupa Pathen Lhagao nasung uva chenga ahitai. Chule Pathen in Christa Yeshua chu athia kona akaithou banga, nasung uva Lhagao um Ama chu amanchah a natahsau thithei chu Hinna apeh ding ahi.
English: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

tcz: Hijehchun sopi deitahte, nachonset lung ngaichat'u thua nunna dingin imacha a mopohna nakilah dingu aumpoi.
en: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
text:
ROM 8:12
Thadou: Hijehchun sopi deitahte, nachonset lung ngaichat'u thua nunna dingin imacha a mopohna nakilah dingu aumpoi.
English: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

tcz: Ajehchu chonset thua nanun le nathi teiding ahi. Hinlah Lhagao Theng thahatna jal'a nachonset lungngaichat chu natha vangleh nahin ding ahi.
en: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
text:
ROM 8:13
Thadou: Ajehchu chonset thua nanun le nathi teiding ahi. Hinlah Lhagao Theng thahatna jal'a nachonset lungngaichat chu natha vangleh nahin ding ahi.
English: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen Lhagao puihoiya umjouse chu Pathen chate ahiuve.
en: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
text:
ROM 8:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen Lhagao puihoiya umjouse chu Pathen chate ahiuve.
English: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

tcz: Hijehchun nangho Lhagao nachan'u chun kichatsetna soh channa nasou ahipoi. Chusang'in Pathen Lhagao changa nahiuvin, hiche jal'a chu chapa-lamthu hina nachan'u ahitai. Hitia chu, tua eihon Ama chu Abba Hepa tia ikouvu ahitai.
en: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
text:
ROM 8:15
Thadou: Hijehchun nangho Lhagao nachan'u chun kichatsetna soh channa nasou ahipoi. Chusang'in Pathen Lhagao changa nahiuvin, hiche jal'a chu chapa-lamthu hina nachan'u ahitai. Hitia chu, tua eihon Ama chu Abba Hepa tia ikouvu ahitai.
English: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

tcz: Ajehchu Ama Lhagao le eiho lhagao akijopmat chun Pathen chate ihiu aphotchen ahitai.
en: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

tcz: Chule eiho Achate ihitah jeh uva goulo ding jong ihitauve. Tahbeh in, Christa to Pathen loupina chu lokhom ding ihitauve. Hinla eihon aloupina ichan khompi dingu ahileh, agimthoh jong hi ichankhompi dingu ahi.
en: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
text:
ROM 8:17
Thadou: Chule eiho Achate ihitah jeh uva goulo ding jong ihitauve. Tahbeh in, Christa to Pathen loupina chu lokhom ding ihitauve. Hinla eihon aloupina ichan khompi dingu ahileh, agimthoh jong hi ichankhompi dingu ahi.
English: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

tcz: Tupet'a ithohgim nau hi khonunga Aman ahin phondoh ding loupina chutoh tekah thei ahipoi.
en: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
text:
ROM 8:18
Thadou: Tupet'a ithohgim nau hi khonunga Aman ahin phondoh ding loupina chutoh tekah thei ahipoi.
English: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

tcz: Ajehchu thilsem jouse hin khonunga hung lhung ding, Pathen chateho kiphondoh nading nikho chu kinemtah'a ngah jing'a um'u ahi.
en: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.
text:
ROM 8:19
Thadou: Ajehchu thilsem jouse hin khonunga hung lhung ding, Pathen chateho kiphondoh nading nikho chu kinemtah'a ngah jing'a um'u ahi.
English: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

tcz: Thilsem jouse hi ama lungdeilou lam'a Pathen gaosapna chang ahitauve. Ahin kinem tah'a,
en: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
text:
ROM 8:20
Thadou: Thilsem jouse hi ama lungdeilou lam'a Pathen gaosapna chang ahitauve. Ahin kinem tah'a,
English: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

tcz: thilsem hohin Pathen chate thina leh amonmang thei a kon chamlhatna loupia ahinkhom nading'u nikho chu galdot jing ahiuve.
en: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
text:
ROM 8:21
Thadou: thilsem hohin Pathen chate thina leh amonmang thei a kon chamlhatna loupia ahinkhom nading'u nikho chu galdot jing ahiuve.
English: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

tcz: Ajehchu eihon athilsem jouse ngahlel a, naosonat thoh tobanga penga tuchan geiya um uva ahi, ti iheuve.
en: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
text:
ROM 8:22
Thadou: Ajehchu eihon athilsem jouse ngahlel a, naosonat thoh tobanga penga tuchan geiya um uva ahi, ti iheuve.
English: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

tcz: Chule eiho atahsan ho jong isunggil uva Lhagaotheng inei jaluva khonunga loupina hung lhung ding galdot'a ihiuve. Ajehchu, eiho itahsau hi chonset le gimthohna a kona ontholna imu diu kinem'a ngah a ihiuve. Eiho jengin jong kinepna neija Pathen in Acha-lamthute hina a ngansena lhingset tahsaa vouthah eithutep'u jong ngah a ihiuve.
en: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.
text:
ROM 8:23
Thadou: Chule eiho atahsan ho jong isunggil uva Lhagaotheng inei jaluva khonunga loupina hung lhung ding galdot'a ihiuve. Ajehchu, eiho itahsau hi chonset le gimthohna a kona ontholna imu diu kinem'a ngah a ihiuve. Eiho jengin jong kinepna neija Pathen in Acha-lamthute hina a ngansena lhingset tahsaa vouthah eithutep'u jong ngah a ihiuve.
English: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

tcz: Eiho huhhing'a i-um'u hin hiche kinepna hi eipeh-u ahi (eihon ineisau ipi ham khat chu mudinga kinem ihipouve).
en: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
text:
ROM 8:24
Thadou: Eiho huhhing'a i-um'u hin hiche kinepna hi eipeh-u ahi (eihon ineisau ipi ham khat chu mudinga kinem ihipouve).
English: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

tcz: Hinlah eihon ipiham khat ineilouvu chu ngah a ihiuleh eihon thoh hattah le kinem'a ingadiu ahi.
en: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
text:
ROM 8:25
Thadou: Hinlah eihon ipiham khat ineilouvu chu ngah a ihiuleh eihon thoh hattah le kinem'a ingadiu ahi.
English: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

tcz: Chule Lhagaotheng chun eiho ilhahsamnauva eipanhu jinguve. Avetsahnan, eihon adoltah a Pathen'a iti itao diu eideipeh uchu ihepouve. Hinlah Lhagao Theng hi eiho dingin athuchenga seitheilouvin apeng peng'in taopehna eineiyun ahi.
en: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
text:
ROM 8:26
Thadou: Chule Lhagaotheng chun eiho ilhahsamnauva eipanhu jinguve. Avetsahnan, eihon adoltah a Pathen'a iti itao diu eideipeh uchu ihepouve. Hinlah Lhagao Theng hi eiho dingin athuchenga seitheilouvin apeng peng'in taopehna eineiyun ahi.
English: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

tcz: Chule lunggel jouse hesoh a Pa chun, Lhagaovin athusei chu ahen ahi, ajehchu Lhagao chun atahsan eiho dingin Pathen lunglam chuto kitoh dingin eithumpeh uve.
en: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
text:
ROM 8:27
Thadou: Chule lunggel jouse hesoh a Pa chun, Lhagaovin athusei chu ahen ahi, ajehchu Lhagao chun atahsan eiho dingin Pathen lunglam chuto kitoh dingin eithumpeh uve.
English: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

tcz: Chule Pathen in Ama ngailuho le Ama lunggon a akouho dingin imalam jousea aphatna dingu abolpeh ahi, ti iheuve.
en: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
text:
ROM 8:28
Thadou: Chule Pathen in Ama ngailuho le Ama lunggon a akouho dingin imalam jousea aphatna dingu abolpeh ahi, ti iheuve.
English: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in Amite ahet masah ahi, chule hichu Ama asopite lah a apeng masapen ahitheina ding hunghia ahitai.
en: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.
text:
ROM 8:29
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in Amite ahet masah ahi, chule hichu Ama asopite lah a apeng masapen ahitheina ding hunghia ahitai.
English: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

tcz: Chuin Aman amaho alhendoh jouvin, amaho chu akoma akouvin ahi, chule Aman akou jouvin amaho chu Amato dinmun thakhat'in asem'in, chule dinmun thakhat'a asem ho chu Aloupina jong apetai.
en: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.
text:
ROM 8:30
Thadou: Chuin Aman amaho alhendoh jouvin, amaho chu akoma akouvin ahi, chule Aman akou jouvin amaho chu Amato dinmun thakhat'in asem'in, chule dinmun thakhat'a asem ho chu Aloupina jong apetai.
English: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

tcz: Hitobang loma kidangtah thil abol thudol hi ipi isei dingu hitam? Pathen chu eiho lama apanle koi eiho dou dia pang thei ding ham?
en: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
text:
ROM 8:31
Thadou: Hitobang loma kidangtah thil abol thudol hi ipi isei dingu hitam? Pathen chu eiho lama apanle koi eiho dou dia pang thei ding ham?
English: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

tcz: Aman a-Chapa tahbeh bon chu khen dehlouva, chusanga eiho jouse dinga eihungpeh doh jengtah uva ahileh, thildang jouse jong eipehlou dingu ham?
en: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
text:
ROM 8:32
Thadou: Aman a-Chapa tahbeh bon chu khen dehlouva, chusanga eiho jouse dinga eihungpeh doh jengtah uva ahileh, thildang jouse jong eipehlou dingu ham?
English: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

tcz: Pathen in Amite alhendoh ho dinga chu koiyin themmo eichan ngam dingu ham? Koimacha umlou ahi; Ajehchu Pathen Amatah in kichamna einabol peh-u ahitai.
en: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
text:
ROM 8:33
Thadou: Pathen in Amite alhendoh ho dinga chu koiyin themmo eichan ngam dingu ham? Koimacha umlou ahi; Ajehchu Pathen Amatah in kichamna einabol peh-u ahitai.
English: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

tcz: Chuti ahileh koiyin themmo eichan tauvintem? Koima cha umlou, ajehchu Christa Yeshua eiho din anathin chule thina a kon'in eiho dingin athoudohtai, chule Ama Pathen jetlam jabolna mun'a atouvin, eiho dingin eithumpeh jinguve.
en: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
text:
ROM 8:34
Thadou: Chuti ahileh koiyin themmo eichan tauvintem? Koima cha umlou, ajehchu Christa Yeshua eiho din anathin chule thina a kon'in eiho dingin athoudohtai, chule Ama Pathen jetlam jabolna mun'a atouvin, eiho dingin eithumpeh jinguve.
English: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

tcz: Christa ngailutna'a kona eikhenthei dingu aumdem? Eihon hahsatna ahilouleh settona ahilouleh gimbolna ahilouleh gilkelna ahilouleh kiphahsamna ahilouleh settona ahilouleh thichan geiya gihsalna ho itou hin, Aman eingailu tapouve tia isei dingu ham?
en: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
text:
ROM 8:35
Thadou: Christa ngailutna'a kona eikhenthei dingu aumdem? Eihon hahsatna ahilouleh settona ahilouleh gimbolna ahilouleh gilkelna ahilouleh kiphahsamna ahilouleh settona ahilouleh thichan geiya gihsalna ho itou hin, Aman eingailu tapouve tia isei dingu ham?
English: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

tcz: (Pathen lekhabun asei dung juiyin, “Ajehchu nangma jal'in niseh in eikithat un, keiho hi kelngoi bangin eikithat jiuve,” ati).
en: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
text:
ROM 8:36
Thadou: (Pathen lekhabun asei dung juiyin, “Ajehchu nangma jal'in niseh in eikithat un, keiho hi kelngoi bangin eikithat jiuve,” ati).
English: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

tcz: Achutipoi. Hicheho jouse chungvuma chun ei hon galjona loupitah, eingailupau Christa jal'in ineithei tauve.
en: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
text:
ROM 8:37
Thadou: Achutipoi. Hicheho jouse chungvuma chun ei hon galjona loupitah, eingailupau Christa jal'in ineithei tauve.
English: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

tcz: Chule keiman kigel lhahna kicheh kanei hi, koimachan Pathen ngailutna'a kona eikhen theilou ding ahitai. Thina hihen, hinna hijongleh, vantilte hihen, lhagao engseho hijongleh, imachan eikhen theilou ding ahi, tia dettah a katahsan ahitai.
en: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
text:
ROM 8:38
Thadou: Chule keiman kigel lhahna kicheh kanei hi, koimachan Pathen ngailutna'a kona eikhen theilou ding ahitai. Thina hihen, hinna hijongleh, vantilte hihen, lhagao engseho hijongleh, imachan eikhen theilou ding ahi, tia dettah a katahsan ahitai.
English: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

tcz: Chunga Van mun'a thaneina hihen, leichunga hijongleh-tahbeh a sei dingin, thilsem jouse lah a imachan Pathen ngailutna'a kona eikhen theilou dingu ahi tihi i-Pakaiyu Christa Yeshua a kiphongdoh a ahitai.
en: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text:
ROM 8:39
Thadou: Chunga Van mun'a thaneina hihen, leichunga hijongleh-tahbeh a sei dingin, thilsem jouse lah a imachan Pathen ngailutna'a kona eikhen theilou dingu ahi tihi i-Pakaiyu Christa Yeshua a kiphongdoh a ahitai.
English: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

tcz: Keiman thudih kasei hi Christa ahetoh ahi. Ase le apha hetna kaneiyin chule Lhagao Theng aphotchetna ahi.
en: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit
text:
ROM 9:1
Thadou: Keiman thudih kasei hi Christa ahetoh ahi. Ase le apha hetna kaneiyin chule Lhagao Theng aphotchetna ahi.
English: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

tcz: Kalungthim hi hatah in lunghemna le lung kicholdo theilou gimnan kadime.
en: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.
text:
ROM 9:2
Thadou: Kalungthim hi hatah in lunghemna le lung kicholdo theilou gimnan kadime.
English: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

tcz: Ajeh chu kamite Judah mite kasopiho dingin, keima Christa'a kona a-itih a gaosap chang kahinom'e; hichun amaho ahuhhing jou ding hileh kati ahi.
en: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh
text:
ROM 9:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu kamite Judah mite kasopiho dingin, keima Christa'a kona a-itih a gaosap chang kahinom'e; hichun amaho ahuhhing jou ding hileh kati ahi.
English: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh

tcz: Amaho Israel mite ahiuvin, Pathen cha-lamthu hina changah ahiuvin, Pathen in aloupina amaho heng alhut ahitai. Aman amaho to kitepna aneiya chule a-Danthu apehdoh ahiuve. Aman amaho chu ahoutheina dinguva michonpha a asem ahin, chule athutep kidangtah ahin pehdoh ahiye.
en: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

tcz: Amaho hi Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob son le chilhahte ahiuvin, chule Christa amatah chu mihem lamdola sei dingin Israel mi anahi, chule Ama Pathen ahin, thil jouse chunga vaihoma ahin, chule tonsot'a vahchoi ding'a kilom ahi.
en: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.
text:
ROM 9:5
Thadou: Amaho hi Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob son le chilhahte ahiuvin, chule Christa amatah chu mihem lamdola sei dingin Israel mi anahi, chule Ama Pathen ahin, thil jouse chunga vaihoma ahin, chule tonsot'a vahchoi ding'a kilom ahi.
English: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

tcz: Chuti ahileh aphai, Pathen in Israel techu athutep lamdola abolpeh lougot hitam? Ahipoi, Israel nam sunga peng jouse chu abonuva Pathen mite ahidehpouve.
en: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.
text:
ROM 9:6
Thadou: Chuti ahileh aphai, Pathen in Israel techu athutep lamdola abolpeh lougot hitam? Ahipoi, Israel nam sunga peng jouse chu abonuva Pathen mite ahidehpouve.
English: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.

tcz: Abraham chilhah himan'a Abraham chate tia kisim jenga ahipoi. Ajehchu Pathen thun Isaac a naphunggui kisut ding ahi ati chun, Abraham'in chapa dang anei henasa asei ahi.
en: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”
text:
ROM 9:7
Thadou: Abraham chilhah himan'a Abraham chate tia kisim jenga ahipoi. Ajehchu Pathen thun Isaac a naphunggui kisut ding ahi ati chun, Abraham'in chapa dang anei henasa asei ahi.
English: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”

tcz: Hichehi, tahsalam a Abraham'in ahindoh chate jouse chu Pathen chate ahiuve tia seina ding aumpoi. Thutep chate bou chu Abraham chate tia kisima ahije.
en: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.
text:
ROM 9:8
Thadou: Hichehi, tahsalam a Abraham'in ahindoh chate jouse chu Pathen chate ahiuve tia seina ding aumpoi. Thutep chate bou chu Abraham chate tia kisima ahije.
English: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.

tcz: ajehchu Pathen in athutep, “Khovei tuphat tengleh keima kahung kile kit ding Sarah chun chapa khat ahinding ahi,” ati.
en: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”
text:
ROM 9:9
Thadou: ajehchu Pathen in athutep, “Khovei tuphat tengleh keima kahung kile kit ding Sarah chun chapa khat ahinding ahi,” ati.
English: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”

tcz: Hiche achapa chu ipuluiyu Isaac ahi. Aman Rebekah akichenpi chun mi-ni apengkop'in ahi.
en: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.
text:
ROM 9:10
Thadou: Hiche achapa chu ipuluiyu Isaac ahi. Aman Rebekah akichenpi chun mi-ni apengkop'in ahi.
English: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

tcz: Hinlah amani ahung penlhah masang lhon'in, thilpha ahilouleh thilse abol masang lhon'in, Pathen'a kon'a thulhut amu ahi (Hiche thulhunga kona chu Pathen in Ama lunggon dungjuiya akouji ahi, tihi ahi.
en: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,
text:
ROM 9:11
Thadou: Hinlah amani ahung penlhah masang lhon'in, thilpha ahilouleh thilse abol masang lhon'in, Pathen'a kon'a thulhut amu ahi (Hiche thulhunga kona chu Pathen in Ama lunggon dungjuiya akouji ahi, tihi ahi.
English: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,

tcz: Amaho phat le set jeh jong ahidehpoi tihet ahi). Amanu koma, “Nachapa atahpa chu anaopa kinbola hung pang ding ahi,” ati.
en: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”
text:
ROM 9:12
Thadou: Amaho phat le set jeh jong ahidehpoi tihet ahi). Amanu koma, “Nachapa atahpa chu anaopa kinbola hung pang ding ahi,” ati.
English: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”

tcz: Pathen thun, “Keiman Jacob kangailun, hinla Esau chu kapampai ahi,” ati.
en: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
text:
ROM 9:13
Thadou: Pathen thun, “Keiman Jacob kangailun, hinla Esau chu kapampai ahi,” ati.
English: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”

tcz: Chuti ahileh, eihon Pathen chu athilbol adihpoi itiuvem? Ahideh poi!
en: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
text:
ROM 9:14
Thadou: Chuti ahileh, eihon Pathen chu athilbol adihpoi itiuvem? Ahideh poi!
English: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

tcz: ajehchu Pathen in Mose jah a, “Keiman ka khotona'a kalhendoh penpen chunga kalhut ding, chule kahepina chu kalhendoh pen chunga kalhut ding ahi,” ati.
en: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
text:
ROM 9:15
Thadou: ajehchu Pathen in Mose jah a, “Keiman ka khotona'a kalhendoh penpen chunga kalhut ding, chule kahepina chu kalhendoh pen chunga kalhut ding ahi,” ati.
English: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, Pathen khotona chu Ama kigel lhah thuthu hiya ahi. Eihon ilhen theiju jong hilou, toh'a itohdoh theiju jong ahidehpoi.
en: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.
text:
ROM 9:16
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun, Pathen khotona chu Ama kigel lhah thuthu hiya ahi. Eihon ilhen theiju jong hilou, toh'a itohdoh theiju jong ahidehpoi.
English: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen lekhabun, anaseisa chu Pathen in Pharaoh jah a, “Keiman kathahatna nachunga katahlang na dinga keiman nangma kalhen nahin chule kaminthanna leiset pumpia kathejal dinga nahi,” tia anasei pehsa ahi.
en: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
text:
ROM 9:17
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen lekhabun, anaseisa chu Pathen in Pharaoh jah a, “Keiman kathahatna nachunga katahlang na dinga keiman nangma kalhen nahin chule kaminthanna leiset pumpia kathejal dinga nahi,” tia anasei pehsa ahi.
English: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”

tcz: Hijeh'a chu, Pathen in ami khotona chu mi abangkhat chunga avetsah a chule aman midang lungsung chu asuhtah a asei angaipeh lou ahi.
en: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.
text:
ROM 9:18
Thadou: Hijeh'a chu, Pathen in ami khotona chu mi abangkhat chunga avetsah a chule aman midang lungsung chu asuhtah a asei angaipeh lou ahi.
English: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

tcz: Chuti ahileh aphai, nangman, “Iti dan'a athu jalou ho chu a oimo hintem? Aman amaho abolsah chan chu abol'u hijeng lou ding ham?” tin nate.
en: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”
text:
ROM 9:19
Thadou: Chuti ahileh aphai, nangman, “Iti dan'a athu jalou ho chu a oimo hintem? Aman amaho abolsah chan chu abol'u hijeng lou ding ham?” tin nate.
English: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”

tcz: Ahipoi, hichu seihih in. Nangma mihem maimai'in Pathen nanel ngam ham? Thilsem khat chun asempa jah a chu, “Ipi dinga hitobang bep'a hi neisem ham?” tia asei ngaijem!
en: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”
text:
ROM 9:20
Thadou: Ahipoi, hichu seihih in. Nangma mihem maimai'in Pathen nanel ngam ham? Thilsem khat chun asempa jah a chu, “Ipi dinga hitobang bep'a hi neisem ham?” tia asei ngaijem!
English: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”

tcz: Bel dengpa chun leiset'a kon'a belho asem tengleh ama chun aleiset leingan chu aphabep khat ajem ding'a asem'a chule phabep khat loi chu nen koina a jong asemthei hilou ham?
en: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?
text:
ROM 9:21
Thadou: Bel dengpa chun leiset'a kon'a belho asem tengleh ama chun aleiset leingan chu aphabep khat ajem ding'a asem'a chule phabep khat loi chu nen koina a jong asemthei hilou ham?
English: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

tcz: Hitobangma chun, Pathen in jong alunghanna le athahatna vetsahna dingin thaneina aneiyin, chule alunghanna chuhna ho chunga jong thohhat tah a anga'a amahthahna diu gonsa akoipeh ahitai.
en: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,
text:
ROM 9:22
Thadou: Hitobangma chun, Pathen in jong alunghanna le athahatna vetsahna dingin thaneina aneiyin, chule alunghanna chuhna ho chunga jong thohhat tah a anga'a amahthahna diu gonsa akoipeh ahitai.
English: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

tcz: Hiche abol hi aloupina ho dung juiya, aloupina tahlangna dinga mi akhotona chu kilangdoh cheh dinga agon ahi.
en: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—
text:
ROM 9:23
Thadou: Hiche abol hi aloupina ho dung juiya, aloupina tahlangna dinga mi akhotona chu kilangdoh cheh dinga agon ahi.
English: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—

tcz: Chule eiho Aman alhendoh ho lah'a hi Judah mite leh chidang namdang ho chunga hijongleh eiho jong ijaouve.
en: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?
text:
ROM 9:24
Thadou: Chule eiho Aman alhendoh ho lah'a hi Judah mite leh chidang namdang ho chunga hijongleh eiho jong ijaouve.
English: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

tcz: Chidang namdangte chung chang thua Pathen in Hosea Themgao henga gaova aseidohsa, “Kamite hilouho chu keiman kamite tia tuapat kakou ding ahitai, chule keiman kangailut louho chu kangailut ding ahitai.
en: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”
text:
ROM 9:25
Thadou: Chidang namdangte chung chang thua Pathen in Hosea Themgao henga gaova aseidohsa, “Kamite hilouho chu keiman kamite tia tuapat kakou ding ahitai, chule keiman kangailut louho chu kangailut ding ahitai.
English: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”

tcz: Chule amaho kamite nahi pouve kitina mun'a chu Pathen Hing chate kiti ding ahiuve.
en: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”
text:
ROM 9:26
Thadou: Chule amaho kamite nahi pouve kitina mun'a chu Pathen Hing chate kiti ding ahiuve.
English: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”

tcz: Chule Israel chung chang thua Themgao Isaiah chun ahinsamdoh in, Israel mite chu twikhanglen panga neldi jat tam'in tam jongleh, amoh them bou sohcha ding ahi,” ati.
en: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin leiset chunga thutanna gangtah le achaina pena dinga ahinbol ding ahi.
en: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”
text:
ROM 9:28
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin leiset chunga thutanna gangtah le achaina pena dinga ahinbol ding ahi.
English: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”

tcz: Chule Isaiah chun mundanga hitima chun aseiyin, “Ven sopite Pakai chun ichateu themkhat hi ahoidoh lou hileh eiho hi Sodom banga eikithat chaihel uvintin, Gomorrah banga eisuhmang dingu ahi,” ati.
en: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”
text:
ROM 9:29
Thadou: Chule Isaiah chun mundanga hitima chun aseiyin, “Ven sopite Pakai chun ichateu themkhat hi ahoidoh lou hileh eiho hi Sodom banga eikithat chaihel uvintin, Gomorrah banga eisuhmang dingu ahi,” ati.
English: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”

tcz: Hicheho jouse hi ipi kiseina hintem? Chidang namdang te Pathen chondan juilou ahivangun, amaho chu Pathen lungtoh dia kisema ahitauve. Chule tahsan hin hiche hi ahin hitheisah ahi.
en: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;

tcz: Hinlah Israel mite Pathen to kilunghet themna dinga kihabol ho jeng jong Danthu ajui jeng vangun alolhing joupouve.
en: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
text:
ROM 9:31
Thadou: Hinlah Israel mite Pathen to kilunghet themna dinga kihabol ho jeng jong Danthu ajui jeng vangun alolhing joupouve.
English: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.

tcz: Ipijeh a lolhinglou hiuvem? Ajeh chu amahon Pathen to kilunghet themna dinga Ama tahsan sangin Danthu ajuiyuve. Ama ho alamlhahnauva songpia kipal ahitauve.
en: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,
text:
ROM 9:32
Thadou: Ipijeh a lolhinglou hiuvem? Ajeh chu amahon Pathen to kilunghet themna dinga Ama tahsan sangin Danthu ajuiyuve. Ama ho alamlhahnauva songpia kipal ahitauve.
English: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,

tcz: Pathen lekhabun amaho gihsalna ananei'in, ajah uva, “Keiman Jerusalema songpi khat kakoiyin, hichun miho akipalsah'e, amaho lhuh kamna songpi khat ahi. Hinla koihileh Ama tahsan chan chu jachatna a chulou ding ahi,” ati.
en: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”
text:
ROM 9:33
Thadou: Pathen lekhabun amaho gihsalna ananei'in, ajah uva, “Keiman Jerusalema songpi khat kakoiyin, hichun miho akipalsah'e, amaho lhuh kamna songpi khat ahi. Hinla koihileh Ama tahsan chan chu jachatna a chulou ding ahi,” ati.
English: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”

tcz: Kasopi deitah teho, kalunga kagelkhoh jingle Pathen'a kataona hi Israel mite huhhing'a aumna dingu hi ahi.
en: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.
text:
ROM 10:1
Thadou: Kasopi deitah teho, kalunga kagelkhoh jingle Pathen'a kataona hi Israel mite huhhing'a aumna dingu hi ahi.
English: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

tcz: Amahon Pathen'a thanopna aneinau chu ipi ahi kahei, hinla hichu hetkhenna beiya kipehna nei ahiuve.
en: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
text:
ROM 10:2
Thadou: Amahon Pathen'a thanopna aneinau chu ipi ahi kahei, hinla hichu hetkhenna beiya kipehna nei ahiuve.
English: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

tcz: Ajeh chu amahon Pathen in miho chu Ama a dinga athemchan thudol hi ahethei pouve. Pathen tohgon chu amahon asan nomlou jeh uvin, amaho lung ngaito jui'a Pathen themchanna mu ding chu alunggon'u ahi.
en: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.
text:
ROM 10:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu amahon Pathen in miho chu Ama a dinga athemchan thudol hi ahethei pouve. Pathen tohgon chu amahon asan nomlou jeh uvin, amaho lung ngaito jui'a Pathen themchanna mu ding chu alunggon'u ahi.
English: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

tcz: Ajehchu Christa chun Danthu kipehlona ajehchu anasuh bulhitsa ahitai. Hiche jal'a chu Ama tahsan jouse chu Pathen themchanna asodoh ahitai.
en: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
text:
ROM 10:4
Thadou: Ajehchu Christa chun Danthu kipehlona ajehchu anasuh bulhitsa ahitai. Hiche jal'a chu Ama tahsan jouse chu Pathen themchanna asodoh ahitai.
English: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

tcz: Ajehchu Mose chun Danthua mikhat themchanna dinga athupehsa chu nit ding ahi, ati.
en: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”
text:
ROM 10:5
Thadou: Ajehchu Mose chun Danthua mikhat themchanna dinga athupehsa chu nit ding ahi, ati.
English: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”

tcz: Hinlah tahsanjal'a Pathen themchan theina ding chun, “Nangman nalung thima koi vana gakal ding ham (Christa chu vana kona agapuilhah ding kiseina ahi).
en: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);

tcz: Chule koi mithiho lah a gakumsuh ding ham? (Christa chu hinsah kitna ding in) tihih un.
en: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”
text:
ROM 10:7
Thadou: Chule koi mithiho lah a gakumsuh ding ham? (Christa chu hinsah kitna ding in) tihih un.
English: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”

tcz: Tahbeh mong'in, hitin ati. Athupoh chu ahung nailheh-e; hichu nakam sungle nalung sunga aume.” Chule chuche thupeh chu keihon kalhangsap'u tahsan thudol chu ahi.
en: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” that is, the word of faith which we preach:
text:
ROM 10:8
Thadou: Tahbeh mong'in, hitin ati. Athupoh chu ahung nailheh-e; hichu nakam sungle nalung sunga aume.” Chule chuche thupeh chu keihon kalhangsap'u tahsan thudol chu ahi.
English: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” that is, the word of faith which we preach:

tcz: Nangman nakam'a Yeshua chu Pakai ahi tia naphondoh-a chule Pathen in Ama chu athilah a kon'in akaithoutai ti nalungsunga natahsan tah-a ahileh huhhing'a um nahi ding ahitai.
en: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
text:
ROM 10:9
Thadou: Nangman nakam'a Yeshua chu Pakai ahi tia naphondoh-a chule Pathen in Ama chu athilah a kon'in akaithoutai ti nalungsunga natahsan tah-a ahileh huhhing'a um nahi ding ahitai.
English: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

tcz: Ajehchu nalung sunga natahsan chun Pathen themchanna chu nachan sah ahitai, chule na-phondoh chun nangma huhhing'a naumsah ahitai.
en: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.
text:
ROM 10:10
Thadou: Ajehchu nalung sunga natahsan chun Pathen themchanna chu nachan sah ahitai, chule na-phondoh chun nangma huhhing'a naumsah ahitai.
English: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.

tcz: Pathen lekhabun eiseipeh-u dungjuiyin, “Koi hijongleh ama tahsan chan chu jachatna a chulou ding ahi” ati.
en: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”
text:
ROM 10:11
Thadou: Pathen lekhabun eiseipeh-u dungjuiyin, “Koi hijongleh ama tahsan chan chu jachatna a chulou ding ahi” ati.
English: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”

tcz: Hiche thudol a hin Judah mite le chidang namdang ho thakhat ahitai. Amahon Pakai khat aneikhom'un, Ama kou jouse chu lungsetna bulhingset apei.
en: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.
text:
ROM 10:12
Thadou: Hiche thudol a hin Judah mite le chidang namdang ho thakhat ahitai. Amahon Pakai khat aneikhom'un, Ama kou jouse chu lungsetna bulhingset apei.
English: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

tcz: Ajehchu koihileh Pakai min'a taochan chu huhhing'a umding ahi.
en: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
text:
ROM 10:13
Thadou: Ajehchu koihileh Pakai min'a taochan chu huhhing'a umding ahi.
English: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

tcz: Hinlah amahon Ama atahsanlou uleh a-huhhing theina dinga iti akou thei dingu ham? Chule Ama thudol anajah khah lou u ahileh iti ahin tahsan thei dingu ham? Chule koiham khat'in aseipeh louva ahileh amahon iti achungchang thu ajah thei dingu ham?
en: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?
text:
ROM 10:14
Thadou: Hinlah amahon Ama atahsanlou uleh a-huhhing theina dinga iti akou thei dingu ham? Chule Ama thudol anajah khah lou u ahileh iti ahin tahsan thei dingu ham? Chule koiham khat'in aseipeh louva ahileh amahon iti achungchang thu ajah thei dingu ham?
English: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

tcz: Chule akisol aum louhela ahileh, koipen gachea amaho thu agaseipeh dingu ham? Hichejeh a chu Pathen thubun, “Kipana Thupha poa vahle ho keng iti hoiya hoi hitam,” ati ahi.
en: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”
text:
ROM 10:15
Thadou: Chule akisol aum louhela ahileh, koipen gachea amaho thu agaseipeh dingu ham? Hichejeh a chu Pathen thubun, “Kipana Thupha poa vahle ho keng iti hoiya hoi hitam,” ati ahi.
English: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”

tcz: Hinlah amichang cheh in Kipana Thupha chu anasang pouve, Ajehchu Isaiah Themgaovin, “Pakai kathupoh-u tahsan'a koi ham?” anati.
en: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
text:
ROM 10:16
Thadou: Hinlah amichang cheh in Kipana Thupha chu anasang pouve, Ajehchu Isaiah Themgaovin, “Pakai kathupoh-u tahsan'a koi ham?” anati.
English: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”

tcz: Hitichun, tahsan chu thujah a kon ahin, hichu Christa chung chang thujah a kon ahi.
en: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
text:
ROM 10:17
Thadou: Hitichun, tahsan chu thujah a kon ahin, hichu Christa chung chang thujah a kon ahi.
English: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

tcz: Hinlah ken kadongin, “Israel miten thu hunglhung thu chu ajah tahbeh-u hinam?” Henge, ajanauve. “Thu hunglhung chu leiset kolkimvel'a akithe chansoh in, chule thuchu vannoi mun jousea alhungsoh-e.”
en: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
text:
ROM 10:18
Thadou: Hinlah ken kadongin, “Israel miten thu hunglhung thu chu ajah tahbeh-u hinam?” Henge, ajanauve. “Thu hunglhung chu leiset kolkimvel'a akithe chansoh in, chule thuchu vannoi mun jousea alhungsoh-e.”
English: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”

tcz: Hinlah ken kadong'in, “Israel mipiten ahet khen mong'u hinam?” kati'e. Henge, aheuve, ajehchu Mose phatlai jeng jong chun Pathen in aseijin, “Keiman nangho namkhat hiloulai hojong miho thangset sah dinga ngolnaa chu kalunghansah ding ahi,” ati.
en: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.”
text:
ROM 10:19
Thadou: Hinlah ken kadong'in, “Israel mipiten ahet khen mong'u hinam?” kati'e. Henge, aheuve, ajehchu Mose phatlai jeng jong chun Pathen in aseijin, “Keiman nangho namkhat hiloulai hojong miho thangset sah dinga ngolnaa chu kalunghansah ding ahi,” ati.
English: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.”

tcz: Chule khonungin Isaiah chun, lung ngam tah in Pathen'a kon'in hitin aseiye, “Keiman kamite kamudoh dingho chu einahelou miho hiding ahiuve. Keima eidonlou beh ho chu keiman kakimudoh sah ding ahi,” ati.
en: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”
text:
ROM 10:20
Thadou: Chule khonungin Isaiah chun, lung ngam tah in Pathen'a kon'in hitin aseiye, “Keiman kamite kamudoh dingho chu einahelou miho hiding ahiuve. Keima eidonlou beh ho chu keiman kakimudoh sah ding ahi,” ati.
English: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”

tcz: “Hinlah, Israel chung chang thua, Pathen in aseiyin, nilhum keiyin keiman amaho chunga kakhut kajah in, hinla amaho seingai louleh engset hatte ahiuve,” ati.
en: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”
text:
ROM 10:21
Thadou: “Hinlah, Israel chung chang thua, Pathen in aseiyin, nilhum keiyin keiman amaho chunga kakhut kajah in, hinla amaho seingai louleh engset hatte ahiuve,” ati.
English: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”

tcz: Ahileh Pathen in Ami Israel techu anungsun hitam? tin kadonge. Chuti chu ahipoi! Keima tah Israel mi kahi, Abraham chilhah khat kahin, chule Benjamin phunga mi kahi.
en: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
text:
ROM 11:1
Thadou: Ahileh Pathen in Ami Israel techu anungsun hitam? tin kadonge. Chuti chu ahipoi! Keima tah Israel mi kahi, Abraham chilhah khat kahin, chule Benjamin phunga mi kahi.
English: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

tcz: Ahipoi, Pathen in Amite anungsun poi, amaho chu atil abula analhensa ahiuve. Hiche chungchang thua Pathen thun ipi aseiyem? Elijah Themgao in Pathen koma anopmosahna Israel mite chungthua aphongdoh in chule aseiyin,
en: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:
text:
ROM 11:2
Thadou: Ahipoi, Pathen in Amite anungsun poi, amaho chu atil abula analhensa ahiuve. Hiche chungchang thua Pathen thun ipi aseiyem? Elijah Themgao in Pathen koma anopmosahna Israel mite chungthua aphongdoh in chule aseiyin,
English: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

tcz: “Pakai, amahon na-Themgaoho athat'un chule namaicham phungho aphelha tauve. Keima changsehbou eiki-dalha a ahitai. Chule tun amahon keima jeng jong tha ding eigouve,” ati.
en: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”
text:
ROM 11:3
Thadou: “Pakai, amahon na-Themgaoho athat'un chule namaicham phungho aphelha tauve. Keima changsehbou eiki-dalha a ahitai. Chule tun amahon keima jeng jong tha ding eigouve,” ati.
English: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”

tcz: Chuin Pathen in ipia adonbut nageldoh em? Aman, “Ahipoi, Keiman Baal anga dilsukhalou mi sang sagi adang kanei nalaije,” ati.
en: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
text:
ROM 11:4
Thadou: Chuin Pathen in ipia adonbut nageldoh em? Aman, “Ahipoi, Keiman Baal anga dilsukhalou mi sang sagi adang kanei nalaije,” ati.
English: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”

tcz: Tulaiya jong chutima ahi, Israel mi phabep chu Pathen lungsetna jal'in tahsan umtah ahinalai uve. Aman ami hepina chang dinga kilom louva amaho alhendoh jal'a ahi.
en: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
text:
ROM 11:5
Thadou: Tulaiya jong chutima ahi, Israel mi phabep chu Pathen lungsetna jal'in tahsan umtah ahinalai uve. Aman ami hepina chang dinga kilom louva amaho alhendoh jal'a ahi.
English: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

tcz: Chule hichu Pathen lungset them ahina jal jeh-in athil phabol jeh-u ahipoi. Ajehchu, hiche thudola hi Pathen lungsetna chu ahina banga hitalou ding, manbei chule chan dinga kilom hilouva ahitai (Hinlah hichu natohjal hitaleh, lungset jal hithei talouhel ding ahitai, achuti louleh natoh chu natoh hitalou ding ahije).
en: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.
text:
ROM 11:6
Thadou: Chule hichu Pathen lungset them ahina jal jeh-in athil phabol jeh-u ahipoi. Ajehchu, hiche thudola hi Pathen lungsetna chu ahina banga hitalou ding, manbei chule chan dinga kilom hilouva ahitai (Hinlah hichu natohjal hitaleh, lungset jal hithei talouhel ding ahitai, achuti louleh natoh chu natoh hitalou ding ahije).
English: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

tcz: Hijehchun, hiche umdol hi hiti ahi: Israel mi atamjo hin Pathen lunglhaina ding gunchuten'a ahol vang'un amujou pouve. Pathen in alhendoh phabep honbou amu uve; hinla adangse lungthim chu suhtah cheh a um ahiuve.
en: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.
text:
ROM 11:7
Thadou: Hijehchun, hiche umdol hi hiti ahi: Israel mi atamjo hin Pathen lunglhaina ding gunchuten'a ahol vang'un amujou pouve. Pathen in alhendoh phabep honbou amu uve; hinla adangse lungthim chu suhtah cheh a um ahiuve.
English: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

tcz: Pathen lekhabun asei, “Pathen in amaho chu a-ihmut milsah ahitai. Tuni chan geiya hi amit'u aphelpeh hi amutheilouna dingu ahi, chule akol'u asip'u hin ajahtheilouna ding'u hiya ahitai.”
en: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”
text:
ROM 11:8
Thadou: Pathen lekhabun asei, “Pathen in amaho chu a-ihmut milsah ahitai. Tuni chan geiya hi amit'u aphelpeh hi amutheilouna dingu ahi, chule akol'u asip'u hin ajahtheilouna ding'u hiya ahitai.”
English: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”

tcz: Chutima chun David'in aseiyin, “Amahon anopneh nau dokhang chu akipalnau thangin panghen, doha a kibol'a akimatna diu chu ima tiponte tin gelu hen. Phatthei achan'u chu akipalna diu hihen, chule amahon achan diuva kilom chu kimu uhen.
en: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.
text:
ROM 11:9
Thadou: Chutima chun David'in aseiyin, “Amahon anopneh nau dokhang chu akipalnau thangin panghen, doha a kibol'a akimatna diu chu ima tiponte tin gelu hen. Phatthei achan'u chu akipalna diu hihen, chule amahon achan diuva kilom chu kimu uhen.
English: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

tcz: Amahon amit uva amutheilouna ding'un kho mulouvin umuhen, chule alungthim'u chu a-imatih a bojang theilou din umhen,” ati.
en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”
text:
ROM 11:10
Thadou: Amahon amit uva amutheilouna ding'un kho mulouvin umuhen, chule alungthim'u chu a-imatih a bojang theilou din umhen,” ati.
English: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”
